However, others criticize its confusing plot, underdeveloped characters, and manipulative use of tragedy, resulting in a frustrating and unsatisfying watch. The polarizing nature stems from whether the emotional impact outweighs the perceived narrative flaws.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation, especially the scenery and skies.
Emotionally resonant and tear-jerking story, particularly Misuzu's arc.
Beautiful and fitting soundtrack that enhances the emotional impact.
cons: Confusing and convoluted plot, especially the Kanna arc.
Underdeveloped secondary characters due to the anime's short length.
Manipulative and contrived plot elements that rely on tragedy.
Disjointed story with forgotten characters in the second half

anime.title: Babe, My Love
anime.synopsis: Katakura Kippei is in every way a high school playboy. Spending his days flirting with any girl he can see, responsibility is the last thing on his mind. Life takes an unexpected turn for him as one day he returns home to find himself with the full-time task of caring for his 5-year-old cousin. Kippei's aunt Miyako had disappeared, appearing to have abandoned his cousin, Yuzuyu. With Kippei's lack of responsibility and knowledge of childcare and Yuzuyu's injured heart with the disappearance of her mother, their time together is in for a bumpy ride.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the heartwarming story, character development, and realistic portrayal of family dynamics. While some find the animation dated and certain plot points unresolved, the overall emotional impact and relatability of the characters resonate strongly with viewers. The show is considered a touching and enjoyable slice-of-life anime.
pros: Heartwarming story and characters
Realistic portrayal of relationships and character development
Addresses mature themes effectively
cons: Dated animation and inconsistent art style
Repetitive soundtrack
Some storylines are left unresolved

anime.title: Red Riding Hood Chacha
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Mahou Shoujo, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
Chacha is a cheerful girl who spends most of her days practicing magic under her teacher Seravi, hoping to become as skilled as he is. Though Chacha is enthusiastic, her tendency to make unfortunate puns out of her magic chants leaves her teacher wondering if she is ready for magic school. Deciding that there is no better time, Seravi gifts Chacha the Princess Medallion, allowing her to transform into a magical princess capable of defeating even the fiercest opponents.

Together with her best friends Riiya, a werewolf boy, and Shiine, an apprentice of Seravi's old rival, Dorothy, Chacha sets out to defend the world from sinister forces. However, between the Great Evil Lord plotting against them, Riiya and Shiine's rivalry to win Chacha's affection, as well as Seravi and Dorothy's complicated relationship, Chacha struggles to find balance between fighting evil forces and mending relationships in her everyday life. Though obstacles continue to come her way, Chacha is determined to overcome any problem she faces with love, courage, and hope by her side.
anime.consensus_summary: Akazukin Chacha is fondly remembered as a cute and comedic anime, particularly by those who watched it during their childhood. Its simple yet entertaining storyline, charming art style, and humorous character interactions contribute to its nostalgic appeal. While the plot may not be complex, the overall experience is lighthearted and enjoyable for fans of the magical girl and slice-of-life genres.
pros: Charming art style and animation quality appropriate for its time.
Catchy and upbeat opening and ending themes.
Well-developed and enjoyable characters with fitting voice acting.
Humorous interactions and reactions between characters.
cons: Storyline is simple and not a major focus; can be generic.
Some may find the humor childish or repetitive.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Magical Girl, Slice of Life

anime.title: Ceres, Celestial Legend
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Horror, Psychological, Reincarnation, Romance, Shoujo, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ceres was a tennyo (Celestial maiden) who came down from the heavens to bathe in a stream. She hung her hagoromo (robe) on a tree nearby, which was her key to returning to the heavens. But the robe was stolen and the man who had stolen it forced her to become his wife, thus producing a family full of human and tennyo blood mixed.

Now, in modern day time, Aya Mikage is a descendent of Ceres, and has quite an amount of tennyo blood. On her 16th birthday, she and her twin brother, Aki, are thrown a party. At the "party," Aya's grandpa plans to kill her, for she has tennyo powers unlike the rest of the family, and can actually become Ceres herself and destroy the Mikage family. Aya, however, can switch back, so this transformation happens quite frequently.

With protector Yuuhi by her side, it is up to Aya to control Ceres and keep her from coming back, but her relationship with an ex-worker for her evil grandpa may be a distraction.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, appreciating the series' original plot, well-developed characters, and emotional depth. However, some viewers are critical of the inconsistent animation, plot inconsistencies, and reliance on dramatic twists. The series is considered a memorable shoujo anime with a darker tone and complex themes, but its flaws can detract from the overall experience for some viewers.
pros: Intricate and original plot with a mix of drama, fantasy, and romance.
Well-developed characters with depth and realistic portrayals.
Emotionally resonant soundtrack and voice acting that enhance the viewing experience.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality with some freeze-frame shots and erratic movements.
Plot inconsistencies and unexplained events, especially in the later episodes.
Overuse of dramatic plot twists and character changes that can feel implausible.
anime.thematic_vibe: Tragic Romance, Supernatural Drama, Family Conflict

anime.title: Boys Be...
anime.synopsis:
There are two sides to every love story, and Boys Be... reveals what's really going on—from the guy's point of view!

Meet three normal high school guys with just one thing on their minds: girls. Quiet Kyoichi has been friends with Chiharu ever since they were young, but lately, his feelings have begun to change. Lecherous Makoto, a self-proclaimed master of the rules of romance, is ready to sweep the ladies off their feet. And Yoshihiko, a handsome sports nut, is unfortunately a bit clueless in matters of the heart.

Join this hapless trio for a year of romantic misadventures that will change their lives forever!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Boys Be... are divided. Some appreciate its realistic portrayal of teenage romance and character development, finding it insightful and relatable. However, others are critical of the inconsistent animation, episodic structure, and occasional forays into unrealistic or clichéd scenarios. Despite its flaws, many find value in the show's exploration of love and life's complexities.
pros: Realistic depiction of relationships and characters.
Insightful dialogues and monologues with symbolism and imagery.
Relatable characters and exploration of love's complexities.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, particularly in early episodes.
Episodic plot structure hinders character development.
Some romantic developments feel forced or unrealistic.

anime.title: Hana Yori Dango
anime.genres: Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Shoujo
anime.synopsis: Makino Tsukushi, a girl who comes from a poor family, just wants to get through her two last years at Eitoku Gakuen quietly. But once she makes herself known by standing up for her friend to the F4, the four most popular, powerful, and rich boys at the school, she gets the red card: F4's way of a "Declaration of War." But when she doesn't let herself be beaten by them and is starting to fall for one of the F4, Hanazawa Rui, she starts to see that there is more than meets the eye...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is strongly divided. Some viewers found the series captivating, praising the strong female lead, character development, and blend of genres, stating that the series restored their faith in romance anime. However, many others criticized the outdated animation, unrealistic plot points, problematic themes of abuse and bullying, and the heroine's ultimate romantic choice, leading to a highly polarized response.
pros: Strong female lead in Tsukushi Makino
Character development of the main characters, especially Tsukasa Domyoji
Captivating story with a good balance of drama, romance, and comedy
cons: Outdated animation and sound quality
Unrealistic scenarios and character actions
Problematic portrayal of bullying and abusive relationships
Slow pacing and repetitive drama
Controversial love triangle

anime.title: Jing: King of Bandits
anime.synopsis: Jing may appear to be a young boy, but his remarkable skills make him one of the most feared thieves on the planet. Along with his feathered partner Kir, Jing travels from town to town, stealing anything of value regardless of the amount of security. But when he's in a pinch, he has one more trick up his sleeve: Kir bonds with Jing's right arm to perform the effectively deadly "Kir Royale" attack. And because of all this, Jing is infamously known by many as the "King of Bandits."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding the anime enjoyable and nostalgic due to its unique art style and episodic adventures. However, others criticize the repetitive storylines, lack of depth, and outdated animation. The anime is considered a light-hearted, fun watch, but not a masterpiece.
pros: Unique and creative art style, reminiscent of 2000s anime.
Interesting and entertaining episodic stories with imaginative world-building.
Catchy opening and ending songs, enjoyable sound design.
cons: Repetitive story patterns and predictable plot twists in each episode.
Lack of a strong overarching storyline and shallow character development.
Outdated animation quality due to budget limitations.

anime.title: Jing: King of Bandits - Seventh Heaven
anime.romaji_title: Ou Dorobou Jing in Seventh Heaven
anime.synopsis: Jing, the infamous King of Bandits, finds himself and his feathered partner Kir behind bars in Seventh Heaven, the most notorious prison complex in the world. There, they seek to steal the Dream Orb from the convict Campari. But before doing so, they must escape from the prison of dreams that Campari has conjured for them.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a well-regarded, surreal experience that blends dream elements with philosophical themes. The art and sound are praised, especially in the English dub. Some viewers may find the pacing quick or the impact lessened with prior series knowledge, but overall, it's a positively received addition to the Jing, King of Bandits universe.
pros: Excellent art that merges with sound
Encourages deeper thinking while being fun
Good English dub
cons: Experience may vary depending on prior knowledge of the series
Fast-moving pace might not suit all viewers

anime.title: Burst Angel
anime.synopsis:
In Japan's not-too-distant future, crime has become so common that the government has legalised firearms for citizens to use in self-defence. To combat this new wave of wrongdoing, the Recently Armed Police of Tokyo was established in hopes of hunting down criminals with lethal force.

Kyohei Tachibana is a gifted culinary student who dreams of saving up enough money to become a pastry chef in France. When four young mercenaries ask him to be their cook, he's forced into making a tough choice. As Jo, Meg, Sei, and Amy take on the bloodiest jobs in the chaotic city of Tokyo, Kyohei accepts an imminent descent into the world of crime—and he'll do a lot more than just cooking!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Burst Angel. While the action, character designs, and futuristic setting appeal to some, many find the plot weak, the characters underdeveloped, and the fan service excessive.  The series is considered a 'guilty pleasure' by some, while others find it a waste of time due to its lack of depth and originality. Overall, the show's flaws prevent it from being highly recommended.
pros: Good action sequences and fight choreography.
Appealing character designs (though often impractical).
Unique futuristic setting with potential.
Enjoyable mecha designs and integration.
Catchy opening theme music.
Decent CGI for its time.
cons: Weak and meandering plot with many filler episodes.
Inconsistent art quality and animation errors.
Underdeveloped and stereotypical characters.
Excessive and often pointless fanservice.
Poor character development.
Repetitive storyline (Meg gets captured, Jo saves her).
English dub voice acting is criticized as poor.

anime.title: Cooking Master Boy
anime.synopsis:
The story takes place in 19th century China during the Qing Dynasty, where the Emperor was weakened and the country was close to chaos. It is also during a fictitious era called "The Era of the Cooking Wars". It was an era in which top chefs with different cooking styles tried their best to improve their skills and to become the best chef in China. It is a country where insulting a high-grade chef or fooling around with cooking could land a person in a jail, and impersonating a top-chef is as good as usurpation of authority. Chefs compete with each other in order to gain respect and even power, but also with the risks of losing everything.

The country of China has four major regions: Beijing, Szechuan, Shanghai, and Guangdong.

The beginning of the story takes place in Szechuan, Mao's birthplace.

After the death of Mao's mother, Pai, who was called the 'Fairy of Cuisine', Mao becomes a Super Chef in order to take the title as Master Chef of his mother's restaurant. However, before he takes his mother's place as Master Chef, he continues to travel China in order to learn more of the many ways of cooking, in the hopes of becoming a legendary chef, just like his mother. During his journey, he meets great friends and fierce rivals who wish to challenge him in the field of cooking.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally enjoy Chuuka Ichiban! for its nostalgic value, engaging characters, and creative take on Chinese cuisine. While some find the plot simplistic and the animation repetitive, the show is mostly appreciated for its light-hearted entertainment and unique art style. Many find it enjoyable and exciting with some unexpected twists.
pros: Enjoyable and exciting plot with unexpected twists.
Memorable characters with engaging backstories related to their passion for cooking.
Creative reimagining of traditional Chinese cuisine.
Nostalgic and light-hearted entertainment.
Art style is unique and cooking scenes are a great watch.
cons: Over exaggerated cooking style and food appearances.
Animation repetition and cost-cutting measures are noticeable.
The ending feels rushed and doesn't live up to the manga.
Simplistic plot

anime.title: Corrector Yui
anime.synopsis: Yui is an average schoolgirl who lives in a future where all computers are supported by a single global network known as COMNET. Yui is a computer-illiterate girl who after a computer-lab accident is approached by IR, a raccoon looking corrector computer program, which tells her she must save COMNET. She must stop the rogue A.I. (Artificial Intelligence) computer program known as Grosser and his hench-programs from taking over the world. Grosser was originally designed to be that manager of all of COMNET. At first she's very reluctant to play the heroine because of her complete lack of knowledge and ability with computers. To save COMNET she must find and gain the trust of the other seven wayward corrector programs. They must also find the creator or COMNET Professor Inukai, to help stop Grosser for good.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers holding nostalgic affection for Corrector Yui, praising its characters and unique premise. However, others find it a generic magical girl show with pacing issues and an outdated portrayal of technology. The show seems to appeal more to those who watched it during its original airing or those seeking a lighthearted, nostalgic experience.
pros: Unique concept blending magical girl with cyberspace themes.
Likeable characters with good dynamics, especially Yui's development.
The show has a great worldbuilding surrounding ComNet
cons: Inconsistent pacing, especially in the second half.
Episodic structure with limited continuity.
Inaccurate depiction of technology for modern viewers.

anime.title: The Cosmopolitan Prayers
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Koto unknowingly seals away the Sun Goddess Amaterasu, and now she is in a different world and can't return. Meeting priestesses who combat the evil in this strange place she learns that Black Towers throughout the land keep Amaterasu sealed away and are guarded by evil monsters. Koto must now find a way to help defeat these monsters and return the world to the way it was.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is strongly divided. Many find it terrible when viewed in isolation, citing a nonsensical plot and unlikable characters. However, some appreciate it as part of the m.o.e. trilogy, viewing its flaws as intentional and part of a meta-commentary on anime production. This meta-appreciation gives it a niche appeal despite its shortcomings.
pros: Unique concept within the m.o.e. trilogy.
Soundtrack and sound effects reminiscent of classic mecha anime.
Animation is well done, especially during action scenes.
cons: Incoherent plot and poorly introduced storyline.
Characters are flat, boring archetypes with little development.
Story feels rushed with poor camera work and amateurish acting.

anime.title: Stellvia
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2167, a wave of radiation released by the supernova of the nearby star Hydrus Beta caused cataclysmic damage on Earth, leaving millions dead. Now, it is the year 2356. United to rebuild Earth, humanity prepares for the supernova's second wave of destruction. 

In order to protect the planet from future harm, massive space colonies called "Foundations" have been built throughout the Solar System. Acting as centers for both knowledge and exploration, it is at one of these Foundations—the Stellvia—that Shima Katase applies to be a preparatory student against her mother's wishes, aspiring to see space directly with her own eyes.

At the Stellvia, Katase trains to become a pilot and hopes to be selected for the "Great Mission" to shield Earth from the second wave. While she struggles with both her pilot classes and her tumultuous social life, she slowly grows into someone who might just be able to protect humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Uchuu no Stellvia' is viewed as a character-driven sci-fi anime that explores themes of growing up, friendship, and facing adversity. While praised for its well-developed characters and unique storyline, some viewers find the excessive emotional displays and the introduction of aliens to be detrimental to the overall experience. The series tends to evoke a generally positive sentiment, although the latter half is considered weaker compared to the first.
pros: Well-developed characters with distinct personalities.
Exploration of the challenges of growing up and dealing with complex emotions.
Unique storyline that blends slice-of-life elements with a looming cosmic threat.
cons: Inconsistent pacing, with a weaker second half of the series.
Overuse of emotional outbursts and crying from the main character, which can be annoying.
Introduction of aliens feels unnecessary and detracts from the main storyline.
Some plot points are left unresolved, leading to an unsatisfying ending for some viewers.

anime.title: Cromartie High School
anime.genres: Comedy, Delinquents, Gag Humor, Parody, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Takashi Kamiyama is your typical mild-mannered high school student—polite, aloof, and pacifistic, with a slightly above-average IQ. But would your average high school student really enroll himself at the infamous Cromartie High School, known as a breeding ground for the toughest delinquents out there?

Apparently so, as that is exactly what Takashi does, though for reasons he'd rather leave unmentioned. However, one thing is for sure: the "hard-boiled rabbit in a den full of hungry lions" is never going to have another dull day. And how could he, now that he's surrounded by mohawked punks, obnoxious robots, and... gorillas? And was that Freddie Mercury riding a horse down the corridor? Follow Takashi as he earnestly dedicates his new high school life to better his school's reputation while his classmates are hellbent on wreaking havoc.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's unique brand of humor and memorable characters. Some find the lack of plot and repetitive jokes to be a drawback, but the overall sentiment is that Cromartie High School is a hilarious and enjoyable comedy anime. The show's absurdity and parody of delinquent tropes are its strongest assets, making it a standout in the genre.
pros: Hilarious and witty humor that defies typical anime tropes.
Unique and memorable characters with distinct personalities.
Excellent English dub that enhances the comedic experience.
Catchy opening theme and well-suited soundtrack.
cons: Lack of a strong overarching plot, with episodic nature potentially leading to aimlessness.
Crude animation style
Humor can be hit or miss, potentially becoming predictable.
Flat character development beyond comedic quirks.

anime.title: El Hazard: The Alternative World
anime.synopsis: Miz plans to retire as a Great Priestess of Water to married life with her darling Fujisawa and as replacement the young Qawoor Towles arrives to Floristica. Jinnai sees Qawoor's initiation ceremony as a chance to infiltrate Makoto's laboratory but accidentally activates a mysterious thingy that sends them all through the dimensions to a grey industrial city protected by a huge castle in an alternative world.
anime.consensus_summary: Ijigen no Sekai El-Hazard: The Alternative World is largely considered a significant disappointment compared to its predecessor. Viewers criticize the confusing plot, poor art quality, and unlikeable characters. The disturbing content and lack of humor further contribute to the negative reception, making it only recommendable for dedicated completionists.
cons: Poor art and animation quality compared to previous installments
Incoherent and confusing plot with numerous plot holes
Underdeveloped and flanderized characters
Boring and unfunny humor relying on slapstick
Disturbing and non-consensual content played off as comedy
Unexplained world-building and unsatisfying dream ending

anime.title: El-Hazard: The Wanderers
anime.synopsis:
High school science-whiz Makoto Mizuhara is working on his newest project in preparation for the school festival, alongside his best friend Nanami Jinnai. Nanami's brother and Makoto's lifelong rival, the unscrupulous student council president Katsuhiko Jinnai, is under scrutiny for mishandling the school festival planning and is convinced that Makoto is plotting to steal his position. One night, as Makoto and Nanami are taking a break with their teacher Masamichi Fujisawa, Jinnai sneaks into the science lab and sabotages Makoto's device, which suddenly opens a portal that flings all four of them into another world!

Upon arrival, Makoto is immediately attacked by a horde of giant bug monsters. While running from them, he comes across Fujisawa and a girl named Rune Venus. After Fujisawa fights off the monsters, a group of dignitaries arrives, looking for Rune, their princess. They inform Makoto and Fujisawa that they are in a world called El-Hazard and take them back to the palace of Roshtaria, their kingdom. Though her advisors are suspicious of the newcomers, Rune decrees that they are to be treated as guests and quickly befriends Makoto. Unaware that Nanami and Jinnai are in this world as well, Makoto gets to work trying to figure out a way back to Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some appreciating the light-hearted and expanded world of the TV series, while others find it inferior to the original OVA. Some viewers find the changes refreshing, while others consider them a simplification that detracts from the original's depth. Jinnai is a universally appreciated villain.
pros: Fun and diverse cast of characters
Great story with unique world
Light-hearted and chill adaptation
Jinnai is a compelling villain
cons: Changes might anger fans of the original OVA
Simplified and more childish compared to the OVA
Some additions may be considered filler
Plot can be boring and characters uninteresting

anime.title: Final Approach
anime.synopsis: Ever since their parents died a few years ago, Ryo and his sister Akane have been living alone together. Despite their difficult situation, they are still living reasonably happy and normal lives. However, everything is about to be flipped upside-down due to a secret government project. Due to increasingly low birth rates in Japan, the Japanese government is testing a program in which two young people are forced to marry. Ryo wants no part of it, but he is given little choice in the matter; his new fiancée, Shizuka, comes to his home late one night with several dozen government issued bodyguards, who are there to ensure the success of the new couple. Unlike Ryo, Shizuka couldn’t be more willing to go along with this new program, and eagerly goes about her wifely duties, despite his objections. With meddling friends, pushy bodyguards, and an overenthusiastic new fiancée, Ryo’s life has taken a turn in a direction the young man certainly didn’t expect.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Final Approach are mixed. While some viewers found the anime enjoyable due to its humor, characters, and short runtime, others criticized its absurd plot, unrealistic scenarios, and underdeveloped characters. The series is generally considered a lighthearted romantic comedy, but its flaws prevent it from being a standout in the genre.
pros: Enjoyable characters and their interactions, particularly Ryo and Shizuka
Humorous moments and comedic elements are well-executed
Short episode length makes it a quick and easy watch
Unique character designs and voices
The anime deviates from typical romantic comedy cliches
cons: Absurd and illogical plotlines
Unrealistic scenarios
Underdeveloped or static characters
Ending may be unsatisfying
Forced comedy
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Comedy, Forced Marriage, Slice of Life

anime.title: Fruits Basket
anime.genres: Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Shoujo, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
After the accident in which she lost her mother, 16-year-old Tooru moves in with her grandfather, but due to his home being renovated, is unable to continue living with him. Claiming she will find someone to stay with but also fearing the criticism of her family and not wanting to burden any of her friends, Tooru resorts to secretly living on her own in a tent in the woods.

One night on her way back from work, she finds her tent buried underneath a landslide. Yuki Souma, the "prince" of her school, and his cousin Shigure Souma, a famous author, stumble across Tooru's situation and invite her to stay with them until her grandfather's home renovations are complete.

Upon arriving at the Souma house, Tooru discovers their secret: if a Souma is hugged by someone of the opposite gender, they temporarily transform into one of the animals of the zodiac! However, this strange phenomenon is no laughing matter; rather, it is a terrible curse that holds a dark history. As she continues her journey, meeting more members of the zodiac family, will Tooru's kindhearted yet resilient nature be enough to prepare her for what lies behind the Souma household's doors?
anime.consensus_summary: Fruits Basket is a generally beloved anime, praised for its heartwarming story, well-developed characters, and exploration of emotional themes. Some viewers find the plot slow or repetitive, and the incomplete adaptation is a common point of criticism. Despite its flaws, the anime is considered a touching and enjoyable experience for many, especially those who appreciate character-driven stories and gentle narratives.
pros: Characters are well-developed, likable, and relatable, with unique personalities and backstories.
The story is heartwarming and touching, with a good balance of comedy, drama, and romance.
The anime explores themes of family, friendship, trauma, and healing in a sensitive and meaningful way.
The English dub is well-cast and the voice acting is excellent.
The animation complements the story and creates a visually appealing experience.
cons: The plot can be slow-paced and repetitive, with some episodes feeling like filler.
The story is incomplete, as the anime only covers part of the manga and leaves some plot threads unresolved.
The main character, Tohru, can be seen as overly naive,clueless or unrealistically kind.
The ending is not satisfactory.
Some viewers may find the show to be overly sentimental or cheesy.

anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Award Winning, Drama, Fantasy, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Edward Elric, a young, brilliant alchemist, has lost much in his twelve-year life: when he and his brother Alphonse try to resurrect their dead mother through the forbidden act of human transmutation, Edward loses his brother as well as two of his limbs. With his supreme alchemy skills, Edward binds Alphonse's soul to a large suit of armor.

A year later, Edward, now promoted to the fullmetal alchemist of the state, embarks on a journey with his younger brother to obtain the Philosopher's Stone. The fabled mythical object is rumored to be capable of amplifying an alchemist's abilities by leaps and bounds, thus allowing them to override the fundamental law of alchemy: to gain something, an alchemist must sacrifice something of equal value. Edward hopes to draw into the military's resources to find the fabled stone and restore his and Alphonse's bodies to normal. However, the Elric brothers soon discover that there is more to the legendary stone than meets the eye, as they are led to the epicenter of a far darker battle than they could have ever imagined.
anime.consensus_summary: The original Fullmetal Alchemist anime is viewed as a classic by many, though some find its ending and divergence from the manga disappointing. Its strengths lie in its well-developed characters, emotional depth, and thematic complexity. While pacing issues and filler episodes exist, the overall experience is considered highly enjoyable, with a strong English dub contributing to its appeal.
pros: Well-developed characters with depth, especially the Elric brothers.
Intricate and complex plot that explores mature themes.
Excellent voice acting, particularly the English dub.
Strong balance of comedy, action, and drama.
cons: Uneven pacing in the early episodes.
Filler episodes that detract from the main story.
Inconsistent character development compared to the manga.
Rushed or unsatisfying ending for some viewers.

anime.title: Looking for the Full Moon
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Music, Romance, Shoujo, Showbiz, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Two years ago, Mitsuki Kouyama's friend, Eichi Sakurai, moved to America before she could confess her feelings to him. Though she cannot contact him, they made a promise to fulfill their respective dreams: Mitsuki wants to become a professional singer, and Eichi an astronomer. She hopes that one day her music will reach him across the world with a brilliance like that of the full moon.

There is just one catch: Mitsuki suffers from throat cancer, which makes her voice quiet and singing strenuous. Her grandmother, who has a hatred of music, insists that Mitsuki undergo surgery to remove the cancer, but she refuses due to the risk of losing her voice. One day, two shinigami—Meroko Yui and Takuto Kira—appear to tell her that she only has one year left to live. This sudden revelation spurs Mitsuki into action, and she decides that with Meroko and Takuto's help, she will become a professional singer in the time she has left.

Full Moon wo Sagashite follows the emotional story of Mitsuki and her shinigami friends as they discover what it means to sing—and ultimately, what it means to live.
anime.consensus_summary: Full Moon wo Sagashite is overwhelmingly praised as a heartwarming and emotional anime with well-developed characters and a fantastic soundtrack. While some criticize the filler episodes and deviations from the manga, the majority agrees that the series is a must-watch, especially for those who enjoy shoujo anime. The ending is frequently cited as one of the best in the genre, leaving a lasting impact on viewers.
pros: Incredible story with a mix of comedy and drama.
Well-developed characters with unique motivations and backstories.
Astounding music, especially the songs sung by Mitsuki's voice actress.
Perfect ending that ties up all loose ends and evokes strong emotions.
cons: Character design can be inconsistent at times.
First half of the series contains many filler episodes.
Some feel that Mitsuki's singing voice does not match her speaking voice.
Anime deviates quite a bit from the manga.

anime.title: Mysterious Play
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Isekai, Martial Arts, Reverse Harem, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
During a visit to the National Library, Miaka Yuuki and Yui Hongo stumble upon a strange old book that casts a red light, sucking them inside its unfamiliar world. Upon arrival, the two encounter hostile slave traders and barely escape with the help of Tamahome—a powerful young man bearing a Chinese symbol on his forehead. But, a moment later, the red light returns and takes Yui away. 

Desperate to reunite with her companion, Miaka asks Tamahome for assistance. However, the situation escalates when the pair encounters the land's emperor, Hotohori, who believes Miaka is the foretold priestess of the kingdom's protector god Suzaku. By gathering the god's seven Celestial Warriors, the priestess can summon Suzaku and have all her wishes granted. Hotohori hopes this will save his country, and since it appears to be a fitting solution to the girl's problems as well, he convinces her to accept the role.

Meanwhile, at the library, Yui realizes she has been brought back alone. Unable to intervene, she helplessly witnesses Miaka traversing through courageous trials as the mysterious book's heroine.
anime.consensus_summary: Fushigi Yuugi is a divisive anime, particularly regarding the main character Miaka, with fans either loving or hating her. Some find the romance repetitive and the plot drawn out. However, the series is praised for its mix of genres, character designs, and exploration of themes like friendship and love, leading to a nostalgic and enjoyable experience for many, despite its flaws.
pros: Diverse cast of characters with unique contributions.
Mixes love, friendship, deceit, and war into a decent story.
Beautiful and bright character designs, particularly the eyes.
Voices fit the characters perfectly in both English and Japanese.
Good blend of comedy, romance, fantasy, and drama.
Character developments are good in the aspect of each one developing like a life of their own.
cons: Miaka's character is annoying, stupid, and indecisive.
Romantic interactions between Miaka and Tamahome are repetitive and drag on.
Pacing issues and filler episodes.
Animation quality declines in the second season.
Story can be cliché by modern standards.
Some characters lack depth and development.
Excessive chibi use and ill-timed humor detract from dramatic intensity.

anime.title: Mysterious Play: Eikoden
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Isekai, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
After years of hardships interfered with their love, Miaka Yuuki and Taka Sukunami are finally married and expecting a baby—the pinnacle of their unbreakable bond. Unfortunately, not everyone rejoices alongside the blessed couple. Mayo Sakaki, one of Taka's students, has a crush on him and cannot bear witnessing the pair's flourishing relationship.

Upon discovering The Universe of the Four Gods, Mayo learns that the old book is where Miaka and Taka first met as the priestess of the god Suzaku and the god's Celestial Warrior Tamahome. Unscrupulous about destroying a happy family, Mayo readily ventures inside with hopes of becoming the new priestess of Suzaku and rewriting the story to her advantage.

Meanwhile, her actions do not delay to show devastating effects. Leaving an unconscious Miaka at the hospital, Taka must follow Mayo to The Universe of the Four Gods and stop her before the circumstances worsen for his wife and their unborn child.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is largely negative, criticizing the unlikeable new character, weak and unoriginal story, and inconsistencies with the original canon. Some viewers found it enjoyable for comedic value or as die-hard fans of the series. The production quality, particularly the CGI, was also a point of criticism.
pros: Good music and sound design retained from the original series.
Enjoyable for viewers who are die-hard Fushigi Yuugi fans, especially Miaka/Tamahome shippers.
Offers comedic value when approached with the intent to make fun of its flaws.
cons: Unlikeable and poorly developed new character, Mayo Sakaki.
Unoriginal and weak story that feels like a bad fanfiction.
Inconsistencies with the original series canon.
Poor CGI animation that detracts from the viewing experience.
Plot holes and forced story advancement.
anime.thematic_vibe: Unrequited Love, Fanfiction Critique, Canon Inconsistency

anime.title: Twin Love
anime.synopsis: With his mother dead and his father working abroad, Futami Nozomu returns to the town where he lived as a child, to attend high school and work part-time at a local shrine. He soon finds himself caught up in a local legend of twin girls loving the same man. And there are many twin girls in this town....
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Futakoi are mixed. While some appreciate the romantic tension, pacing, and overall enjoyment, others find the storyline unoriginal, the characters underdeveloped, and the art inconsistent. The series is seen as a decent harem anime with some interesting ideas, but ultimately suffers from wasted potential due to its large cast and weak protagonist.
pros: Enjoyable romantic tension
Well-paced story
Good sound design and voice acting
Satisfying blend of comedy, drama, and romance
cons: Unoriginal harem storyline
Underdeveloped minor characters
Inconsistent art and animation quality
Repetitive or boring twin dynamics
Weak or indecisive protagonist

anime.title: Twin Love 2
anime.synopsis: The Futaba Detective Agency, being run by Rentarou, who has taken over the family business, after his father's death 3 weeks ago. Along with Sara & Souju, his live-in identical twin assistants. He ends up running afoul of the local Yakuza.
anime.consensus_summary: Futakoi Alternative is a unique anime that blends action, comedy, romance, and drama, resulting in a polarizing viewing experience. Many praise its well-developed characters, engaging story, and seamless genre transitions. However, some find the plot convoluted and the mood swings jarring, making it an anime with both strong supporters and detractors.
pros: Unique mix of action, comedy, drama, and romance.
Well-developed and likable characters, especially Rentarou.
Engaging story that transitions effectively between genres.
Excellent art style that suits the atmosphere of the anime.
Satisfying and beautiful finale.
cons: Sudden and jarring mood swings, especially in later episodes.
Plot can become convoluted and nonsensical, particularly with the introduction of 'squid nazis'.
The first few episodes can be confusing and difficult to follow.
Inconsistent pacing, with the story progressing slowly at times.

anime.title: Gate Keepers
anime.synopsis:
Technology, science, and industry—this is 1969 Tokyo, and there is no better time to be alive! But a shadow looms quietly around every corner: "Invaders" have infiltrated the populace, and nobody knows who or what they are.

Only the members of the top-secret agency AEGIS know of their existence. Covertly fighting the enemy is their job, but only those with the ability to open "Gates" to another world can truly defeat them. Within AEGIS is a specialized task force known as the "Gate Keepers." Composed of extraordinary individuals with a variety of Gate-related abilities, they are the only ones who can save humanity from the vicious Invaders plaguing the planet.

Shun Ukiya is an average high school student who lives with his widowed mother and little sister. While on his way home from school one day, he comes across a group of Invaders heading toward his house. In a desperate plight to save his family, Shun discovers he possesses the ability to open a Gate, allowing him to harness massive amounts of energy. With his newfound ability exposed, he catches the attention of AEGIS, and particularly the interest of one of its Gate Keepers, Shun's childhood friend Ruriko Ikusawa.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Gate Keepers', praising its nostalgic feel, engaging story, and likable characters. Some find the animation impressive for its time, while others note dated CG and repetitive scenes. Overall, it's considered a refreshing and worthwhile anime, especially for those who appreciate a blend of classic and modern elements.
pros: Exciting and fun to watch with a blend of old-school and contemporary anime feel.
Good mix of comedic moments that blend well with the situations.
Impressive animation, especially considering the time it was made.
Memorable sound design, particularly the 'Gate Open' sequences.
Likable characters with good voice acting.
Engaging story with historical references.
cons: Some CG elements haven't aged well.
Occasional repeated scenes.
One reviewer disliked Reiko's character design and found her too air-headed.

anime.title: Gate Keepers 21
anime.synopsis: Thirty-two years have passed since the initial defeat of the Invaders. A.E.G.I.S is all but dismantled now and has become an underground organization consisting of only a few Gate Keepers left to save humanity. One of the members, Ayane Isuzu, is sick of society as a whole, though she continues to defeat the Invaders out of spite for her father. Suddenly, she learns of the revival of Machine General (Kikai Shogun) and Devil Count (Akuma Hakushaku), but a mysterious ghost girl now accompanies them. It is up to Ayane and the remnants of A.E.G.I.S to stop them and save humanity once again.
anime.consensus_summary: Gate Keepers 21 is viewed as a darker and more serious follow-up to the original series, with improved animation but a potentially less appealing tone for some fans. While praised for its character development and standalone story, some find the music and characters less compelling than its predecessor. The series seems to be generally well-received as a worthwhile addition to the Gate Keepers universe.
pros: Improved animation and upgraded invader designs compared to the original series.
Well-performed sound effects and fitting background music.
Character development, especially for Ayane, Miu, and Ghost Girl.
Standalone story that doesn't require knowledge of the prequel.
Good voice acting, particularly Mamiko Noto as Ghost Girl.
cons: Music is not as good as the original
Some find the characters less charismatic than in the original series.
Dark tone might not appeal to fans of the original's light-heartedness.

anime.title: Saiyuki
anime.synopsis: Many years ago, humans and demons lived in harmony. But that unity ended when demons started attacking humans and plotted a mission to unleash Gyumao—an evil demon imprisoned for thousands of years. Now, Genjo Sanzo, a rogue priest, must team up with three demons—Sha Gojyo, Son Goku, and Cho Hakkai—and embark on a perilous journey to the west to stop these demons from resurrecting Gyumao and restore the balance between humans and demons on Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: Gensoumaden Saiyuuki is a beloved anime with a strong emphasis on character dynamics and an adventurous journey. While the animation quality and episodic plot progression are points of criticism, the engaging characters, their backstories, and the overall entertainment value resonate well with viewers.  Many appreciate the blend of action, comedy, and darker themes, with the characters being the main highlight.
pros: Strong and well-developed main characters with compelling backstories.
Excellent character chemistry and interactions, particularly the comedic banter.
Enjoyable episodic format with some dark and moody storylines.
Memorable and catchy soundtrack with well-suited background music.
Good English dub with voice acting that enhances character personalities (though controversial).
cons: Inconsistent animation quality with frequent use of still shots and recycled animation.
Episodic nature can make the overall plot feel slow and lacking momentum.
Villains are often one-dimensional and forgettable.
Some find the humor subpar or the main character Goku annoying.
Inaccurate representation of 'Journey to the West'

anime.title: Saiyuki Reload
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Josei, Mythology, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Priest Genjo Sanzo and companions Cho Hakkai, Sha Gojyo, and Son Goku maintain their westward journey to stop the resurrection of the demon Gyoumao. As the reputation of the Sanzo Ikkou precedes them, they continue to fight demon assassins at every turn, but they must also deal with increasing tensions within their group in order to defeat a powerful enemy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Saiyuki Reload is mixed, with some appreciating the improved visuals and character dynamics, while others criticize the weaker plot and changes in production. Many feel that the series deviates too much from the original manga and earlier anime adaptation. Overall, the series is considered a decent watch for fans of the characters, but falls short as a compelling and cohesive narrative.
pros: Improved art and animation compared to the original series.
Enjoyable character interactions and humor.
Surprising plot twists and story developments.
cons: Lack of a solid overarching plot or clear goal, leading to episodic feel.
Changes in animation style and voice actors negatively impacting the viewing experience.
Filler episodes and deviation from the original manga story.
Inconsistent quality of story arcs

anime.title: Saiyuki Gunlock
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Josei, Mythology, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: The Sanzo Ikkou continues its westward journey, on a mission to prevent a demonic resurrection. As Genjo Sanzo, Cho Hakkai, Sha Gojyo, and Son Goku fight their way to their goal, their path is fraught with internal strife. When they encounter a formidable pair of adversaries from the west, the cohesion of the group -- and the fate of the mission -- may be at stake.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Saiyuuki Reload Gunlock is largely negative, with significant disappointment expressed regarding the story's direction, character development, and overall adaptation quality. Many feel it deviates significantly from the source material and earlier installments, resulting in a tedious and unfulfilling experience. While some appreciate the character designs and occasional action, the overwhelming consensus points to a poorly executed sequel.
pros: Appealing character designs (bishounen)
Some thrilling action sequences
Decent music
cons: Poor story progression and plot development
Meaningless filler episodes
Repetitive and irritating character interactions
Weak animation quality with cheap effects
Characters acting out of character
Poor adaptation of the source material
Annoying voice acting (Goku)
Offensive opening theme

anime.title: Getbackers
anime.genres: Action, Mystery, Shounen, Super Power, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Mido Ban and Amano Ginji are known as the Get Backers, retrievers with a success rate of 100%. Whatever is lost or stolen, they can definitely get it back. Despite their powerful abilities and enthusiastic behavior, Ban and Ginji are terminally broke no matter what they do simply because few people would actually desire to hire them. As a result, the pair of them tend to do dangerous jobs, often leading to unwanted re-encounters with their old (and dangerous) friends.
anime.consensus_summary: GetBackers is a decent shonen anime with a unique premise, but it suffers from an incomplete story and inconsistent production quality. While many enjoy the characters, humor, and action, the anime's ending leaves viewers unsatisfied. The show is considered enjoyable for casual fans, but those seeking depth and originality may be disappointed.
pros: Engaging characters with interesting backstories
Good mix of action, humor, and drama
Catchy and diverse music selection
cons: Incomplete story with abrupt ending and cliffhangers
Inconsistent animation quality, especially in later episodes and fillers
Repetitive plot structure and reliance on shonen cliches

anime.title: Green Green
anime.synopsis:
Kanenone Gakuen is an all-male boarding school located in the countryside of Japan. Although an all-male school is nothing new, life can become quite difficult when there are no female students for miles around. In order to help the psychological health of everyone involved, the school board has decided to try and merge with the nearest all-girl boarding school in order to become co-ed. The boys of Kanenone are more than thrilled at the prospect, and the girls are curious as to how interesting school life might become if there were more boys around. Before any serious decisions are made, the girls have been invited to stay at Kanenone for one month as a test.

Green Green follows Yuusuke Takazaki and his naughty room mates called the Baka (Idiot) Trio, and their ability to talk to the girls without making complete fools of themselves. But as soon as the school bus with the girls arrives, things become weird, hormonal, and hysterical. In particular, a girl named Midori Chitose leaps off the bus and immediately embraces a very confused Yuusuke. Is he a natural ladies' man, or do the two of them have a shared history that he is not aware of?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Green Green" is overwhelmingly negatively received as a poorly written and executed ecchi harem anime. Critics cite a weak plot, unlikeable characters, and excessive fan service as major flaws. While some viewers found it funny and enjoyable, the majority consider it a waste of time and even potentially offensive.
pros: Some found the comedy enjoyable and funny.
Some viewers appreciated the cute female characters and their varied personalities.
Catchy opening and ending songs were praised by some reviewers.
cons: The plot is weak, generic, and often described as non-existent or poorly executed.
Many found the characters bland, stereotypical, and unlikeable, especially the male lead and the 'idiot trio'.
The ecchi content is excessive, bordering on hentai, and often used gratuitously without adding to the story.
The ending is rushed and unsatisfying.
Some reviewers found the show offensive due to its perverted humor and portrayal of female characters.
anime.thematic_vibe: Ecchi Comedy, Harem, Slice of Life

anime.title: Gunslinger Girl
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Military, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis: In the heart of Italy, the Social Welfare Agency rescues young girls from hospital beds and gives them a second chance at life using the latest in cybernetic advancements. With their artificially enhanced bodies, the girls are brainwashed and trained as assassins to carry out the dirty work of the Italian Government. Despite all the modifications, they are still just children at heart, struggling for recognition from those they love, even knowing the love they feel is manufactured. This tragic tale unfolds as these girls grapple with their emotions in an agency that treats them as nothing but ruthless killers.
anime.consensus_summary: Gunslinger Girl is a deeply moving and thought-provoking anime that explores the tragic lives of young assassins and the ethical dilemmas surrounding their existence. While praised for its complex characters, high production quality, and mature themes, some viewers find the slow pace, lack of a strong plot, and disturbing content to be drawbacks. The series elicits a strong emotional response, making it a memorable but potentially divisive experience.
pros: Complex characters and their relationships are well-developed.
High-quality animation, especially the realistic details of firearms and settings.
Soundtrack effectively enhances the atmosphere, with well-chosen opening and ending themes.
Exploration of ethical dilemmas and social commentary.
The series's slow pace allows for deep immersion and character development.
cons: The story is slow-paced and sometimes jumps around chronologically, making it hard to follow.
Some find the lack of a strong overarching plot and conclusive ending disappointing.
Limited action sequences despite initial expectations.
The themes may be disturbing to some viewers.
Some reviewers found the series to be attracting the wrong audience (pedophiles)

anime.title: Hikaru no Go
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, School, Shounen, Strategy Game, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
While searching through his grandfather's attic, Hikaru Shindou stumbles upon an old go board. Touching it, he is greeted by a mysterious voice, and soon after falls unconscious. When he regains his senses, he discovers that the voice is still present and belongs to Fujiwara no Sai, the spirit of an ancient go expert. A go instructor for the Japanese Emperor in the Heian Era, Sai's passion for the game transcends time and space, allowing him to continue playing his beloved game as a ghostly entity. Sai's ultimate goal is to master a divine go technique that no player has achieved so far, and he seeks to accomplish this by playing the board game through Hikaru.

Despite having no interest in board games, Hikaru reluctantly agrees to play, executing moves as instructed by Sai. However, when he encounters the young go prodigy Akira Touya, a passion for the game is slowly ignited within him. Inspired by his newfound rival, Hikaru's journey into the world of go is just beginning.
anime.consensus_summary: Hikaru no Go is overwhelmingly praised for its character development, engaging story, and emotional depth, making it enjoyable even for viewers unfamiliar with Go. The series explores themes of rivalry, personal growth, and the pursuit of excellence. While a few critics mention filler episodes and minor animation flaws, the overall sentiment is highly positive, with many considering it a masterpiece and recommending it wholeheartedly.
pros: Excellent character development, with realistic and gradual growth.
Captivating and well-executed Go matches, even for those unfamiliar with the game.
The soundtrack is fitting, enhancing the emotional impact of the series.
The story explores the characters' motivations and relationships in-depth.
Consistent art style that improves as the anime progresses.
Seamless blending of humor and seriousness.
Faithful to the original source material, with well-developed characters.
cons: Filler episodes that disrupt the plot's momentum.
Some plot holes and underdeveloped side characters.
The animation, while good, can be a bit cheap, with frequent panning shots.
The over the top shonen style production such as lightning streaked backgrounds and BGM seems out of place a lot of the time.

anime.title: Hunter x Hunter
anime.synopsis:
Hunters are specialized in a wide variety of fields, ranging from treasure hunting to cooking. They have access to otherwise unavailable funds and information that allow them to pursue their dreams and interests. However, being a hunter is a special privilege, only attained by taking a deadly exam with an extremely low success rate.

Gon Freecss, a 12-year-old boy with the hope of finding his missing father, sets out on a quest to take the Hunter Exam. Along the way, he picks up three companions who also aim to take the dangerous test: the revenge-seeking Kurapika, aspiring doctor Leorio Paladiknight, and a mischievous child the same age as Gon, Killua Zoldyck.

As the four aspiring hunters embark on a perilous adventure, they fight for their dreams while defying the odds.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Hunter x Hunter" is highly regarded as a standout shonen anime with a compelling storyline and well-developed characters. While some criticize the dated visuals and initial pacing, the majority praise its unique plot twists, intricate combat system, and strong emphasis on character relationships. The series is considered a must-watch for shonen fans and those seeking a more mature and nuanced adventure.
pros: Well-developed and likeable characters with depth.
Intricate plot with many twists and turns, avoiding typical shonen cliches.
Excellent fight sequences with creative power-leveling system (Nen).
cons: Dated animation and sound quality (especially in the older series).
Pacing can be slow in the beginning.
Some find the initial plot simple or the protagonist's ideals annoying.

anime.title: Hunter x Hunter: Original Video Animation
anime.romaji_title: Hunter x Hunter: Original Video Animation
anime.synopsis: After reuniting with Gon and his friends, Kurapika explained to them the risks he bears because of his abilities. Believing that his target of revenge is no longer alive and the search for his fallen comrade's eyes could truly begin, Kurapika soon after receives a message informing him that all the Spiders still lived. After much discussion between his friends, Gon, Kurapika and company decided to hunt after the one Spider member who's ability could ultimately result in Kurapika's defeat and death. Based on the manga by Togashi Yoshihiro.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is highly praised for its intricate plot, character development, and thematic depth, particularly Kurapika's revenge arc and the exploration of loyalty within the Phantom Troupe. While some find the visuals dated, the strong narrative and character-driven storytelling outweigh this drawback for most viewers. The ending and later episodes are criticized for rushed development, but overall, the OVA provides a satisfying continuation and conclusion to the Yorknew arc.
pros: Well-written plot with twists and turns.
Strong character development, especially for Kurapika and the Spiders.
Intense and entertaining pacing.
Effective use of psychological warfare.
Dark and serious soundtrack fitting the arc's style.
cons: Art and animation may appear dated compared to newer series.
Some found the opening theme not fitting the tone.
Pacing slows down in later episodes; financial troubles.
Convenient patches to fill holes in the narrative and the ending being rushed and undeveloped.

anime.title: Hunter x Hunter: Greed Island
anime.synopsis: After the battle with the Spiders, the search for Ging continues as Gon and Killua decided to once again attempt to purchase the rare game "Greed Island." However, Gon came up with a better plan, which was to volunteer to complete the game for the billionaire who owned it. But some training must be done, as Gon and Killua's abilities are still at a developing stage and "Greed Island" is no simple game for anyone to play with. It is the infamous game that could easily lead to one's death. Based on the manga by Togashi Yoshihiro.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the Greed Island arc, appreciating its faithfulness to the manga and exciting MMORPG elements. Fans find the character development and the blend of humor and seriousness particularly engaging. While there are minor criticisms regarding pacing and visual choices, the overall sentiment is positive, with many recommending it to Hunter x Hunter enthusiasts.
pros: Exciting and well-thought-out game world.
Strong character development, especially Gon and Killua.
Enjoyable blend of humor and serious moments.
Nostalgic feel reminiscent of classic anime.
Good animation and sound quality for its time.
Faithful to the manga's storyline.
cons: Pacing issues, potentially skipping parts of the Yorknew City arc.
Lighter color scheme may strain the eyes.
Character designs can sometimes appear disproportionate.
Limited introduction of new characters with significant screentime.

anime.title: Hunter x Hunter: Greed Island Final
anime.romaji_title: Hunter x Hunter: Greed Island Final
anime.synopsis: Continuing with their adventure at Greed Island, Gon and Killua train furiously under the guidance of Biscuit for better preparation at attempting the game. With their abilities vastly improving and the threat of player killers menacing Greed Island, Gon and company continue the game despite the dangers that they will face with the game activities and encounters with other players. Based on the manga by Togashi Yoshihiro.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mostly positive, praising the character development and action, but some find the pacing and animation lacking. There are complaints about Killua's diminished role. Some fans felt the story was rushed, while others enjoyed the nostalgia and heartwarming elements.
pros: Character development is excellent, especially for Gon and Killua.
Action scenes are well-executed and engaging.
The OVA provides a satisfying continuation of the Greed Island arc.
Some reviewers found the ending to be perfect and captivating.
Soundtrack praised for fight scenes.
cons: Pacing issues with skipped content.
Animation quality is considered outdated by some.
Killua's role is diminished in the story.
Some found the soundtrack unmemorable
Story felt rushed to some.

anime.title: Jinki: Extend
anime.synopsis: Aoba is a young girl who loves to build models of robots. She lived alone with her grandmother until her grandmother passes away. Shortly after she is kidnapped and brought to a secret base where she discovers a huge robot. The piloted robots fight against Ancient-Jinki in The Grand Savanna, but the true meaning behind the fights is hidden. Aoba works hard at the base so one day she can pilot one of the robots and discover these secrets.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Jinki:Extend. Some appreciate the show's ambition and action, while others find the narrative confusing and rushed due to its shortened format. Character development suffers, and the art style is dated. Ultimately, it's seen as a flawed but potentially enjoyable experience for those who can overlook its shortcomings.
pros: Interesting premise with potential for a female-led mech show.
Engaging mech designs, particularly the Moribito.
Enjoyable action sequences and plot twists (for some viewers).
cons: Rushed plot with 26 episodes worth of material crammed into 12.
Poor character development due to time constraints.
Confusing narrative structure with simultaneous storylines and time jumps.
Dated art style and character designs.

anime.title: Kamikaze Kaitou Jeanne
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Mahou Shoujo, Reincarnation, Romance, School, Shoujo, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: A normal looking high school girl on the outside, Kusakabe Maron is actually the reincarnation of Jeanne d' Arc. With the help of the angel, Fin Fish, Maron works as the thief Jeanne at night to seal the demons that reside in pieces of artwork, preying upon the weak hearts of the owners. She is branded as a thief due to the fact that the artworks disappear after she seals the demons. One day, a new neighbor and classmate appears, as well as a rival in her night job, the thief Sinbad. With her own best friend being the detective's daughter, out to capture her and the appearance of her new rival, Maron's work is anything but easy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many viewers appreciating the characters and romance elements, but finding the anime repetitive and flawed in animation. Many fans of the manga were disappointed with the anime adaptation, especially the rushed pacing and changes to character relationships. While some find it enjoyable as a typical magical girl show, others are critical of its unoriginal plot and weak ending.
pros: Strong character development, especially the leads
Catchy opening and ending themes
Enjoyable blend of adventure, fantasy, romance, drama, and comedy
The developing romantic relationship between the main characters is a highlight
cons: Repetitive transformation sequences and demon sealing animations
Inconsistent animation quality with frequent use of still screens
Monster-of-the-week format in the first half can feel episodic and repetitive
Rushed or incomplete feeling ending in the anime compared to the manga
The plot twist is unoriginal.
The art and animation do not do justice to the manga's style.

anime.title: Destiny of the Shrine Maiden
anime.genres: Drama, Girls Love, Mecha, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Kannazuki no Miko begins in the village of Mahoroba, where time passes slowly for both man and nature. Two students from the village's prestigious Ototachibana Academy might as well be night and day. Himeko is shy and unassertive, while Chikane is bold and elegant. Despite this, they love each other, and nothing can come between them, no matter how hard they try.

On the two girls' shared birthday, a sinister voice corrupts one of their friends into attacking them, and just when it seemed grimmest, the lunar and solar priestess powers that lay dormant in the two girls awaken, dispelling the evil. That was only the first hurdle, however. The two must now fend off the countless others who would threaten their well-being—even the people closest to them!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers highly appreciating the yuri romance and character dynamics, particularly Chikane's. However, many find the plot clichéd, the mecha elements out of place, and the melodrama excessive. The series is divisive, with strong opinions on both sides, resulting in a polarized viewing experience, and controversy score of 7.
pros: Compelling character relationships, especially Chikane's development
High-quality opening and ending themes
Visually appealing character designs and animation (for its time)
cons: Generic plot elements and reliance on anime stereotypes
Inconsistent pacing, particularly in the first half
Forced melodrama and cheesy dialogue
Problematic inclusion of a sexual assault scene

anime.title: Kanon
anime.synopsis:
It’s been 7 years since Yuuichi Aizawa visited his aunt Akiko, but now that his parents have gone to Africa to pursue their careers, he is finally back in the little northern town. Yuuichi is not really overjoyed with the prospect of living here though, because all of his memories of this place and the people living in it have mysteriously vanished. His cute cousin Nayuki seems like a stranger as well, even though he used to play with her all the time when they were younger.

On the day of moving into his new home, Yuuichi starts unpacking the boxes and stumbles upon a red headband that no one seems to recognize. This is one of the first clues that will make Yuuichi take a stroll through the snow-covered town and make him start recalling fragments of his past, broken promises and buried secrets. Yuuichi soon realizes that there is something supernatural going on, and all of his new female acquaintances seem to have links to his forgotten past.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Kanon 2002. Some appreciate its emotional depth and character-driven narrative, while others are critical of its dated art style, rushed pacing, and incomplete storytelling. The series evokes a sense of nostalgia for some, but its flaws prevent it from being universally praised, especially when compared to its remake.
pros: Realistic character emotions and strong human-like behavior
Story tells deeper character relations
Good mix of supernatural/slice of life/harem elements
cons: Crammed story in 13 episodes
Unanswered questions and superficial story
Exaggerated big chins in character art
Rushed pacing, especially towards the end
Uneven character arc development

anime.title: His and Her Circumstances
anime.synopsis:
Yukino Miyazawa is the female representative for her class and the most popular girl among the freshmen at her high school. Good at both academics and sports on top of being elegant and sociable, she has been an object of admiration all her life. However, in reality, she is an incredibly vain person who toils relentlessly to maintain her good grades, athleticism, and graceful appearance. She wants nothing more than to be the center of attention and praise—which is why she cannot stand Souichirou Arima, the male representative for her class and the only person more perfect than her. Since the first day of high school, she has struggled to steal the spotlight from her new rival but to no avail.

At last, on the midterm exams, Yukino gets the top score and beats Souichirou. But, to her surprise, he congratulates her on her achievement, leading her to question her deceptive lifestyle. When Souichirou confesses his love to Yukino, she turns him down and gloats about it at home with only a hint of regret. But the very next day, Souichirou visits Yukino house to bring her a CD and sees her uninhibited self in action; now equipped with the truth, he blackmails her into completing his student council duties. Coerced into spending time with Souichirou, Yukino learns that she is not the only one hiding secrets.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Kareshi Kanojo no Jijou are divided. Many appreciate the unique characters, engaging romance, and experimental visual style, while others are disappointed by the inconsistent animation, abrupt ending, and deviation from the initial storyline. The series is considered a flawed but worthwhile watch for fans of the romance genre, but viewers should be aware of its shortcomings.
pros: Well-developed characters with depth and interesting motivations, especially the main couple.
Unique and experimental visual style that adds to the storytelling.
Strong emotional connection and relatable characters.
The series challenges typical shoujo tropes and presents a mature female lead.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, especially in the later episodes, due to budget constraints.
Abrupt and unsatisfying ending that doesn't resolve plot points.
Excessive recap episodes and filler content.
The story deviates from its initial focus, leading to poorly written angst and drama in the later part of the series.
Some characters disappear randomly without explanation.

anime.title: This Ugly Yet Beautiful World
anime.synopsis: High school student Takeru Takemoto works part time as a (motor)bike courier. During one of his deliveries, he saw a mysterious light passing him and fell into a forest. What he had found was a beautiful girl coming out from a glowing cocoon, calling herself "Hikari." While Takeru was quite embarrassed because of Hikari's nudity, a strange monster suddenly showed up and immediately attacked the two. Both Takeru and Hikari demonstrated the power of their other selves before Takeru had a clue of what's going on.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the initial concept, characters, and opening theme, while others criticizing the poor pacing, generic plot, and excessive fan service. Many feel it tries to do too much and fails to execute any genre well. Some consider it a hidden gem, while others find it a forgettable and disappointing experience, especially when compared to similar anime such as Elfen Lied.
pros: Interesting initial concept of life rebirth and cleansing.
Some likable main characters that viewers cared about.
Opening theme ('Metamorphose') is highly praised and memorable.
Dynamic mix of shojo, shonen, slice of life, and supernatural elements.
cons: Poor pacing, feels rushed and sidetracked with filler episodes.
Underdeveloped characters with stereotypical anime tropes.
Inconsistent art quality, with distracting color shifts and animation shortcuts.
Story becomes generic with lack of originality
Overreliance on fan service and ecchi elements detracts from the plot.
Predictable and uninspired plot points and character arcs.

anime.title: Rumbling Hearts
anime.synopsis:
In the warmth of a golden sun, timid high school student Haruka Suzumiya confesses to Takayuki Narumi, the boy she admires. Takayuki accepts Haruka's confession and the two become a couple, supported by their mutual friends Mitsuki Hayase and Shinji Taira. All is well for these friends—until tragedy strikes. 

One of them is sent to an unenviable fate, lying dormant in a coma. Three years later, they awaken, but their sudden reappearance in everyone's lives threatens to test the limits of these friends' bonds.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Kimi ga Nozomu Eien' are strongly divided. Some find it to be a deeply moving and realistic portrayal of love and loss, praising its characters and emotional depth. Others criticize its melodramatic nature, unrealistic scenarios, and frustrating character decisions, leading to a polarized viewing experience.
pros: Excellent depiction of human emotion and complex relationships.
Interesting story with a good theme tying it all together.
Strong cast of characters that come across as real people with real-world problems.
Soundtrack enhances the nostalgic and depressive atmosphere.
cons: Pacing issues with moments that feel dragged out.
Misplaced comic relief that ruins the impact of sadder moments.
Unrealistic plot points and character decisions that break immersion.
Inconsistent art style and animation quality.

anime.title: Diamond Daydreams
anime.synopsis: If a couple sees the diamond dust together, then they will certainly find eternal happiness. Or so it is said. This is a drama about the romances, friendships and conflicts of six girls from Hokkaido and how the diamond dust affects them and eventually links them together in the search for happiness.
anime.consensus_summary: Kita e.: Diamond Dust Drops is generally well-received as a gentle and nostalgic romance anime. While some find the stories to be somewhat clichéd and the animation inconsistent, many appreciate the excellent pacing, charming characters, and the emotional impact of the music and visuals. The series is recommended for those who enjoy slice-of-life anime with a touch of romance and don't mind the episodic format.
pros: Well-polished stories with unique twists.
Excellent pacing that keeps the series lively and prevents it from dragging.
Beautiful animation, especially the use of colors to enhance the atmosphere.
Good voice acting and well-placed background music that complements the mood.
Likeable characters with distinct personalities and some character growth.
A great last episode that brings all the girls together in a perfect way, providing a happy ending.
cons: Some stories follow classic romance/drama plots and lack originality.
Character proportions can be unnatural, and the detail quality sometimes jumps wildly.
The opening song feels out of place compared to the mellow and nostalgic atmosphere of the show.
One particular story arc felt rushed and could have benefited from more development.

anime.title: Blood+
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Horror, Military, Mystery, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Saya Otonashi is a seemingly ordinary girl living a mundane life with her adoptive family in Okinawa City. In fact, her only peculiarities are suffering from anemia and being unable to remember any of her life beyond the previous year.

However, Saya's forgotten past quickly comes back to haunt her—one night, she is attacked at school by a creature that feeds on human blood. Just when all hope seems lost, a mysterious man named Haji appears and fends off the creature temporarily. But when her rescuer forces her to drink his blood, Saya suddenly enters a trance and slays the monster with ease, using her own blood as a catalyst. 

Saya then learns of an organization named Red Shield, founded for the sole purpose of defeating the hellish beasts. Now Saya and Haji must work together with Red Shield to fight these fearsome monsters and unlock the secrets to the girl's past.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Blood+ are mixed, with some praising its complex story, character development, and technical aspects like animation and music. Others find it slow-paced, predictable, and bogged down by unnecessary subplots. While many appreciate its unique take on the vampire genre, the series' length and occasional inconsistencies seem to divide viewers.
pros: Complex and intricate narrative with deliberate pacing.
Exceptional character development; characters feel like real people.
Hauntingly evocative soundtrack and superb animation.
Unique art style and character designs.
Well-developed plot with twists and turns; deeper than initial impression.
cons: Story starts slow and can be boring/dull at the beginning.
Some find the plot too simple and predictable.
Pacing issues with unnecessary subplots and tangents.
Inconsistent animation quality with shortcuts.
Overuse of certain musical tracks.

anime.title: Solty Rei
anime.synopsis:
In a future-based disaster-ridden city with an enormous gap between the rich and the poor, it is hard to tell which humans are walking around with cybernetic body parts. This makes Roy Revant's job as a renegade bounty hunter/bodyguard-for-hire even more difficult. When a young girl with unbeliveable strength rescues him from a particularly dangerous criminal, Roy realizes that perhaps help can be found in the strangest of places. Joining together with a few others, they engage in a battle to find out the truth behind the giant conglomerates that are supposedly serving mankind and making life better.

Solty, an android who has lost her memory, has escaped and is being hunted by the RUC Security Bureau. She encounters the bounty hunter Roy and he adopts her as his daughter after being hired as a bodygaurd for Miranda.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While praised for its strong character development, emotional depth, and exploration of family themes, Solty Rei is criticized for its slow start, inconsistent animation, and some underdeveloped plot elements.  Many viewers found the ending satisfying and emotionally resonant, while others felt the series had wasted potential due to production issues. Overall, it's considered a decent watch with a strong emotional core.
pros: Strong focus on character development, especially Solty and Roy.
Meaningful exploration of family bonds and relationships.
Satisfying and emotionally resonant ending.
Voice acting is well-done
Story is well-rounded and keeps it interesting until the end
cons: Slow-paced beginning with episodic format.
