She wants nothing to do with him, and runs away, only to bump into a very tall and beautiful purple-haired woman with a flower pattern around her eye. Yukari faints from shock and wakes up later in a strange place called the Atelier. It turns out that these strangers are fashion designers who attend the most famous art school around, Yazawa Art Academy, and their group wants Yukari to model for their brand in Yazawa Academy's upcoming show.

Yukari turns down their offer and escapes the Atelier, but unknowingly leaves her school ID behind. George Koizumi, the head designer, later sees it and immediately knows she would be the perfect model for them and will not stop until he gets what he wants—and he wants her. Yukari had never considered something as frivolous as modeling before, but could life among these eccentric designers actually prove to be fun? Or will Yukari lose herself in this world of art and passion?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Paradise Kiss is well-received for its unique art style, realistic characters, and exploration of personal growth. While the ending and some character choices are divisive, the show is considered a mature and stylish take on the shoujo genre. The series appeals to those seeking a drama-filled romance that deviates from typical anime tropes.
pros: Unique and stylish art style with detailed fashion designs.
Realistic portrayal of character relationships and personal growth.
Excellent opening and ending themes that fit the show's mood.
cons: Rushed ending and some plot points feel disconnected.
Main characters can be unlikable or frustrating at times.
Inconsistent animation quality.

anime.title: Paranoia Agent
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Avant Garde, Award Winning, Detective, Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
The infamous Shounen Bat is terrorizing the residents of Musashino City. Flying around on his rollerblades and beating people down with a golden baseball bat, the assailant seems impossible to catch—much less understand. His first victim, the well-known yet timid character designer Tsukiko Sagi, is suspected of orchestrating the attacks. Believed only by her anthropomorphic pink stuffed animal, Maromi, Tsukiko is just one of Shounen Bat's many victims.

As Shounen Bat continues his relentless assault on the town, detectives Keiichi Ikari and Mitsuhiro Maniwa begin to investigate the identity of the attacker. However, more and more people fall victim to the notorious golden bat, and news of the assailant begins circulating around the town. Paranoia starts to set in as chilling rumors spread amongst adults and children alike.

Will the two detectives be able to unravel the truth behind Shounen Bat, or will the paranoia get to them first?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising its psychological depth, unique style, and thought-provoking themes, while others criticize its confusing plot, unattractive art style, and unlikeable characters. Many find the series initially engaging but feel it loses focus and coherence as it progresses. Despite its flaws, it is recognized for its ambition and exploration of complex social issues.
pros: Intriguing and complex narrative explores themes of paranoia, social anxiety, and escapism.
Unique animation style and character design that deviates from traditional anime aesthetics.
Effective use of music and sound design to create an eerie and suspenseful atmosphere.
The series benefits from strong direction, expertly blurring the lines between reality and fantasy.
The English dub is well-regarded and enhances the viewing experience for some.
cons: The plot can become confusing and convoluted, especially in the later episodes.
Some viewers found the episodic structure and detours from the main storyline frustrating.
Character development is lacking, with many characters feeling underdeveloped or unlikable.
The art style and character designs were criticized for being unattractive or disturbing.
The ending was considered disappointing or unsatisfying by some viewers.

anime.title: Patlabor: The Mobile Police - The TV Series
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Mecha, Sci-Fi, Workplace
anime.synopsis: In the future, advanced robotics has created heavy robots ("labors") for use in a variety of functions: construction, fire-fighting, military, and more. However, though the robots are only machines, their operators are also only human—and humans sometimes turn to crime. Since a heavy labor unit can be a dangerous weapon, the police of the future are set to fight fire with fire, using advanced patrol labor units, "patlabors." This is the story of the Second Special Vehicles Division, a motley crew of patlabor policemen and women doing their best to fight crime and live a normal life.
anime.consensus_summary: Patlabor: On Television is generally well-received as a unique and charming mecha anime that focuses on character development and slice-of-life elements rather than intense action. Viewers appreciate its relatable characters, humor, and grounded portrayal of a society with mecha. Some find the lack of a strong overarching plot and inconsistent episode quality to be drawbacks, but overall, it's considered an enjoyable and accessible entry point into the mecha genre.
pros: Well-developed and relatable characters with distinct personalities
Unique and grounded take on the mecha genre
Humorous and heartwarming storylines
Exploration of realistic, mundane aspects of police work and society with labors
Good animation and sound quality for its time
cons: Episodic nature lacks an overarching plot for some viewers
Inconsistent episode quality, with some feeling like filler
Some storylines are unresolved
English dub voice acting is criticized as being poor

anime.title: Peach Girl: Super Pop Love Hurricane
anime.genres: Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
With her gorgeous, tan skin and long, bleached hair, former high school swim team member Momo Adachi seems like the kind of girl who could get any guy she wants. In reality, however, she is only in love with Kazuya "Toji" Toujigamori, a baseball player whom she fell for in junior high and who reportedly only likes pale-skinned girls. Despite her attempts to change her appearance, many of her jealous classmates have begun spreading rumors about her promiscuous and "easy to get with" personality. Momo's friend Sae Kashiwagi is always there to comfort her, but is secretly the source of the rumors about Momo as part of her own scheme to steal Toji. Further complicating things is Kairi Okayasu, a popular male student at Momo's high school who has publicly declared his love for her and is determined to date her.

Hoping to find love in a nearly impossible predicament, Momo must navigate complicated love triangles, back-stabbing friends, and her insecurities about her appearance to discover who she really is.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception to Peach Girl is mixed. While some appreciate the romantic elements and specific characters like Kairi, many find the plot and characters frustrating due to excessive melodrama, lack of realism, and annoying personalities. The technical aspects, such as animation and soundtrack, also receive criticism for being uninspired and repetitive.
pros: Some viewers found the loveable and humorous character of Kairi enjoyable.
The opening and ending themes were found to be catchy and fitting by some viewers.
cons: Many found the characters, especially Momo and Sae, annoying, indecisive, and unrealistic.
The plot was often criticized for being overly dramatic, repetitive, and unrealistic with too many dragged-out conflicts and plot twists.
The animation quality was considered average to below average, with stiff character designs and unmemorable scenery.
The soundtrack was repetitive and overused.

anime.title: Pet Shop of Horrors
anime.synopsis: Count D, a quite interesting pet shop owner from an area called Chinatown, sells rare and hard to come by pets to people longing for something special, but with each sale comes a contract. If the rules of the contract are followed, everything goes fine, but if someone should break the rules of the contract, the pet shop cannot be held responsible for anything unfortunate that might happen. Leon Orcot, a homicide detective, has linked many odd and unexplainable deaths together; they all were customers of Count D's pet shop, and he intends to find out why.
anime.consensus_summary: Petshop of Horrors is a short, episodic anime with a unique premise and creepy atmosphere. While the stories are interesting and offer moral lessons, the execution is inconsistent, and the technical aspects are lacking. The underdeveloped characters and short length leave viewers wanting more, resulting in a mixed reception.
pros: Interesting and unique stories with morals.
Creepy atmosphere and engaging mysteries.
Count D is a charming and intriguing character.
cons: Inconsistent quality between episodes.
Poor animation and sound quality.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of character development.
Stories can be predictable and lack subtlety.
Too short, leaving many unanswered questions.

anime.title: Petite Princess Yucie
anime.synopsis:
Despite recently turning 17, the otherwise ordinary Yucie still has the body of a child. Having stopped growing past the age of 10, Yucie yearns to fully mature into an adult body. One day, she is chosen as a candidate for the title of "Platinum Princess," given once in a thousand years to whoever is worthy of the Eternal Tiara—a mysterious crown said to grant any wish. She's not alone either, as four other candidates also compete to have their own wishes granted by the crown.

As a result, Yucie enrolls at the nearby Princess Academy in order to grow her heart and work towards becoming qualified for the Eternal Tiara. With her family, rivals, and even the principal of the academy there to lend a hand, will Yucie's much-desired wish finally come true?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Puchi Pri*Yucie' is viewed as a charming and heartwarming series with a strong emphasis on friendship and character development. While some find the plot predictable and the animation inconsistent, the likable characters and fairytale atmosphere contribute to a positive viewing experience, particularly for fans of the shoujo genre. The series is considered an underrated gem that offers a simple and earnest story suitable for all ages.
pros: Charming and wholesome with a fairytale-like atmosphere.
Characters are likable and have distinct personalities, emphasizing friendship and emotional growth.
The story, while straightforward, offers a mix of fantasy, romance, and magic suitable for shoujo fans and newcomers alike.
cons: Animation quality can be inconsistent, with occasional moments of cheapness.
The plot is predictable and lacks significant twists, potentially deterring viewers seeking surprises.
The dub has voice acting issues. Voices don't match the characters.

anime.title: Piano: The Melody of a Young Girl's Heart
anime.synopsis:
When Miu was young, she was fascinated by the piano and took up lessons.

When the show opens, Miu is in middle school. She is shy, a soft-spoken girl who doesn't have a lot of confidence in herself. Her friends would describe her as "sweet" and "quiet." At this point, Miu has been taking piano lessons for some time and while people have told her that she's gotten very good over the years, Miu herself feels she's not really good at anything—including the piano. Her teacher, Mr. Shirakawa, is often frustrated with her playing. Although she plays every note exactly correct, her heart just isn't in it...

Meanwhile, Miu's come of the age when she's noticing boys and this shy young lady has noticed the handsome Kazuya Takahashi—even if he hasn't noticed her.

This is Miu's story. The story of a young girl who is on a journey to discover the melody within her own heart and the courage to express it.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely lukewarm, with many finding the show boring and uneventful, despite its relaxing qualities. While some appreciate the relatable characters and slice-of-life themes, the lack of significant plot or drama leaves many viewers disappointed. The music is a highlight for some, but others feel it's underutilized. Overall, 'Piano' is considered a forgettable and unremarkable anime.
pros: Relatable characters and themes.
Simple and relaxing to watch.
Good voice acting (especially English dub).
Pleasant piano music soundtrack.
cons: Boring and uneventful plot.
Lack of significant drama or conflict.
Underdeveloped characters.
Repetitive and slow pacing.
Not enough focus on the piano/music aspect.

anime.title: Planetes
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Award Winning, Drama, Romance, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Space, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
In 2075, space travel is no longer just a dream, but an everyday reality for mankind. Advancements in science and technology have led to the colonization of the moon, the commercialization of outer space, and the formation of large space corporations. Ai Tanabe, an upbeat woman whose interests lie in the cosmos, joins Technora Corporation as a member of their Debris Section, a department dedicated to the removal of dangerous space junk between the orbits of the Earth and Moon.

However, Ai soon discovers how unappreciated her job is. As the laughingstock of Technora, the Debris Section is severely understaffed, poorly funded, and is forced to use a dilapidated spaceship nicknamed the "Toy Box" for debris retrieval. Undeterred, Ai perseveres and gradually becomes acquainted with the strange personalities that make up the Debris Section's staff, such as the bumbling but good-natured chief clerk Philippe Myers; the mysterious and tight-lipped temp worker Edelgard Rivera; and the hotheaded and passionate Hachirouta Hoshino, who longs for a spaceship to call his own.

Planetes is an unconventional sci-fi series that portrays the vastness of space as a backdrop for the personal lives of ordinary people—people who may have been born on Earth, but whose hopes and dreams lie amongst the stars.
anime.consensus_summary: Planetes is largely praised for its realistic portrayal of space exploration, strong character development, and thought-provoking themes. While some find the initial pacing slow and the episodic format unengaging, the series is generally considered a mature and rewarding sci-fi experience. The emotional core resonates with viewers, who appreciate the depth and complexity of the characters and their struggles in a believable future setting.
pros: Realistic depiction of space travel and its challenges.
Strong character development and relatable adult characters.
Thought-provoking themes about humanity's future in space and socio-economic issues.
High-quality animation and detailed artwork.
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the first half.
Episodic nature can be off-putting initially.
Some comedic elements feel out of place.
Romance subplot can be unconvincing or underdeveloped.

anime.title: Midori Days
anime.genres: Comedy, Delinquents, Ecchi, Romance, School, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
There isn't a single person in Sakuradamon High who hasn't heard the legends about Seiji "The Mad Dog" Sawamura's demonically powerful right hand. His reputation makes it fairly difficult for him to approach girls, and after being rejected 20 times straight, he half-jokingly vows to finish high school with his right hand for a girlfriend.

Much to his surprise, after waking up the next morning, Seiji discovers that his demon right hand has mysteriously turned into a miniature girl, Midori Kasugano, who reveals that she has had a crush on Seiji for the past three years. Because their situation is not ideal for either of them, Seiji attempts to return Midori to normal. But after causing a big misunderstanding at the Kasugano household, the pair decide to keep their predicament between them until a solution is found. Thus begins an odd relationship, and what could be the only chance for Midori to finally be with the one she loves.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Midori no Hibi' is well-received as a heartwarming romantic comedy with a unique premise. While some viewers find the series to be predictable or criticize its fan service elements, the majority appreciate the charming characters, comedic situations, and the emotional depth of the story. The ending provides a satisfying resolution, making it a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre.
pros: Unique and original premise
Likable and well-developed characters, especially the main duo
Good balance of comedy and romance
Ending provides closure
Enjoyable and catchy music
Exploration of inner feelings and suppressed personality traits
cons: Some episodes feel like filler with minimal plot progression
Occasional reliance on ecchi and fanservice elements that may not appeal to all viewers
Inconsistent character development for some supporting characters
Animation quality can be inconsistent
Predictable storyline
Some character arcs are dropped or unresolved

anime.title: Magical Circle Guru Guru
anime.synopsis:
There is a small village called Jimuna on the continent of Jamu Jamu. This village is home to a girl named Kukuri. She is the last descendant of the Migu Migu Tribe. She is raised by an old witch who teaches her the secret magic of the tribe, but Kukuri is not a good student.

In the same village lives a boy named Nike. He has been raised by very strict parents. They discipline their son to become a brave hero of the village. Nike himself does not want to be a hero at all, but he grows up to become a mighty boy.

One day the king of the village, Kodai, recruits troops to fight against the ruler of the darkness, Giri. Kukuri and Nike are accepted. The two children, the strong but reluctant hero Nike, and the eager but unskilled little witch Kukuri, set out on a wonderful journey full of adventures and friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: Mahoujin Guru Guru is a beloved, light-hearted fantasy comedy that provides a consistent stream of laughs and memorable characters. Its chibi art style and silly humor are praised, though some find the innuendo surprising. The show is considered a nostalgic favorite by many, with the only major critique being that the sequel doesn't live up to the original.
pros: Charming and light-hearted comedy
Adorable and fun art style (chibi)
Constant slapstick and silliness
Appeals to fans of fantasy stories and RPGs
cons: Innuendo might startle some viewers
Mahoujin Guru Guru 2 is not as good as the original

anime.title: Magical Circle Guru Guru 2
anime.synopsis:
Join the new legend of Guruguru, where Nike, the reluctant hero, and Kukuri, the innocent heroine, return to save the world. The magical adventure that unfolds, with its unique monsters and eccentric characters, is sure to draw you into this curious and exciting realm.

To save the world from evil King Giri, Kukuri must locate the monsters in each territory and win them, one by one, over to her side. Meanwhile Nike's task is to be recognized by the Four Kings of Nature and collect their swords. These swords are known as the "Sword of Wind," the "Sword of Water," the "Sword of Earth" and the "Sword of Fire."

Can Nike and Kukuri truly become hero and heroine? Follow their journey and find out!
anime.consensus_summary: The reboot of Mahoujin Guru Guru is largely seen as a disappointment compared to the original.  The shift in art style to 3D and the over-the-top humor are major points of criticism.  Viewers find it difficult to pinpoint the intended audience and feel that the charm of the original is lost.
cons: 3D art style is disliked
Exaggerated embarrassment humor is excessive
Unclear target audience (not suitable for children, adolescents, or adults)
Inferior to the original Mahoujin Guru Guru series

anime.title: Mama is Just a Fourth Grade Pupil
anime.genres: Award Winning, Childcare, Comedy, Drama, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: Natsumi Mizuki is a 4th grader whose parents have gone to London. Her Aunt Izumi comes to live with her. Izumi is an aspiring manga writer who is trying to get her first big break, so she doesn't have time for a baby that appears out of thin air on Natsumi's first night alone. The baby's name is Mirai and her mother is *Natsumi*, but 15 years older. Somehow, Mirai had traveled back in time. Now the young Natsumi has to raise Mirai while trying to keep her 4th grade life from falling apart and keep Mirai-chan secret from everyone. She has the dubious help of Izumi and some baby-care gadgets from the future.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime "Mama wa Shougaku 4-nensei" is generally well-received as a cute and heartwarming slice-of-life story with a unique time-travel premise. Viewers appreciate the character development, nostalgic art style, and the adorable nature of the characters, particularly Mirai. While some find certain aspects, like the aunt's initial behavior or the focus on specific relationships, less appealing, the overall sentiment is positive, with many recommending it for its enjoyable and family-friendly content.
pros: Interesting time travel storyline
Cute and adorable characters, especially Mirai
Character development of Natsumi and Izumi
Nostalgic 90s art style
Enjoyable and heartwarming episodes
cons: Some find the aunt annoying at first
Some wanted more focus on Daisuke and Natsumi's relationship
Time travel can be a bit confusing
Lack of English subtitles

anime.title: Marmalade Boy
anime.synopsis:
When Miki Koishikawa welcomes her parents home from their trip to Hawaii, the last thing she expects is for them to gleefully announce that they are getting a divorce. To her shock, they plan to switch partners with another couple they met on vacation. Barely able to keep her emotions in check, Miki begrudgingly attends dinner to meet the other couple and their strikingly handsome son, Yuu Matsuura.

After moving into a spacious house with her newly blended family, Miki struggles to adjust to her new lifestyle and her blooming feelings for Yuu. She attempts to navigate the coming school year with the help of her best friend, Meiko Akizuki, who is hiding a scandalous relationship of her own. However, the road ahead is not simple, as both Miki and Yuu have other potential suitors and emotional baggage from their pasts they are reluctant to reveal.
anime.consensus_summary: Marmalade Boy is a classic shoujo anime that evokes strong feelings of nostalgia and attachment in many viewers, with emphasis on its addicting drama, lovable characters, and exploration of complex relationships. However, some find its dated animation, repetitive plot, and unlikeable protagonist to be major drawbacks. While appreciated by fans of the genre, it may not appeal to those who dislike melodrama and predictable storylines.
pros: Addictive, soap opera-like plot with constant twists
Lovable and well-developed characters
Soundtrack complements the mood of the series
Exploration of themes like growing up, understanding others, and dealing with complex relationships
Captures the atmosphere of 90s Japan
Addresses realistic relationships and obstacles
cons: Dated animation and art style
Overuse of flashbacks and repetitive themes
Predictable plot developments
Annoying or unlikable main character (Miki)
Unnecessary angst and melodrama
Questionable relationship dynamics (e.g., step-siblings romance, student-teacher relationship)
Inconsistent plot points and character behavior

anime.title: Mythical Detective Loki Ragnarok
anime.synopsis: Loki, the Norse god of mischief, has been exiled to the human world for what was apparently a bad joke. Along with being exiled, he's forced to take the form of a child. He's told the only way he can get back to the world of the gods is if he can collect auras of evil that take over human hearts, and so to do this he runs a detective agency. Loki is soon joined by a human girl named Mayura who is a maniac for mysteries, and she soon helps out in her own way. However, soon other Norse gods begin to appear, and most have the intent to assassinate Loki for reasons unclear.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers find the series entertaining due to its humorous take on Norse mythology and charming characters, while others are critical of its weak writing, inconsistent characters, and repetitive humor. The anime is appreciated for having a self-contained story with an ending, but the execution of the plot and character development leaves much to be desired.
pros: Good clean animation.
Enjoyable music and voice acting, especially the English dub.
Intriguing concept of Norse gods living among humans.
Norse mythology themes are present.
cons: Mediocre writing with little relation to the original manga.
Pointless comedic episodes that get on the nerves.
Rushed and hastily thrown together ending.
Characters are poorly developed and inconsistent with their source material.
Repetitive use of 'mystery' catchphrase.
Mystery element diminishes as the series progresses.

anime.title: Ginyuu Mokushiroku Meine Liebe
anime.synopsis: The first season begins with introducing the characters, their past and their ambitions. Orpherus, Eduard, Camus, Lui, and Naoji are five noblemen who attend the prestigious Rozenstolz academy, and who are a part of the Strahl class—a class for potential candidates for the advisory positions in the royal palace in the small European country of Kuchen. Isaac is an English writer who visits Kuchen. While still students, the five noblemen are forced to deal with corrupted politicians, secret agents, attempted murder and ambitious individuals from both inside and outside of school who threatens to break the fragile peace in their country, and even assassinate the king.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally appreciative of the characters and the overall premise, but feels the execution is lacking. Pacing issues and a predictable plot are major drawbacks. The character designs and music choices are also criticized for not fully complementing the show's intended serious tone, but the interesting setting and character backstories keep viewers engaged.
pros: Interesting characters with sad backstories
Enjoyable despite flaws; kept the viewer engaged until the end
Deep friendship dynamics, particularly between Orpherus and Eduard
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the first season
Synopsis serves as a spoiler due to lack of plot development
Underdeveloped emotional expression in character art
Incongruent soundtrack choice that does not match the show's atmosphere

anime.title: Psychic Academy
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Insecure Ai Shiomi begins attending the prestigous Psychic Academy for psychically gifted students, following in the footsteps of his legendary older brother.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding nostalgic value or enjoyment in its quick, supernatural elements. However, many criticize the over-reliance on fan service, weak plot, and poor production quality. While some appreciate it as a gateway anime, most agree that the manga offers a superior experience.
pros: Some genuinely nice moments between characters
For some, it served as an entry point to anime
Quick and easy watch
cons: Rushed story
Little to no character development
Overabundance of fan service overshadows plot
Poor animation and CGI
Weak story and shallow characters

anime.title: The Rose of Versailles
anime.genres: Crossdressing, Drama, Historical, Military, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
In a time of class stratification and rising tensions amongst the impoverished population, the Austrian Empire sends Princess Marie Antoinette to France to be wed to Crown Prince Louis XVI. The political marriage is arranged to strengthen the alliance between both countries, but the future queen is deeply unsatisfied with her fate being decided for her. Upon arrival in the country, Marie Antoinette is acquainted with Oscar Fançois de Jarjayes—Commander of the Royal Guard.

Due to her father's desire for a son, Oscar is raised as a boy with an expectation to inherit his title as The Commander. Though she is revered by both men and women alike, Oscar cannot help but desire to live life as a woman instead of masquerading as a man. As Oscar reluctantly serves the young, spoiled queen, the growing resentment and suffering of the poor become harder for her to ignore—especially when Marie Antoinette frivolously spends her wealth.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely regards Versailles no Bara as a masterpiece, praising its complex characters, historical narrative, and artistic merit, especially for its time. However, there's a noticeable divide regarding its pacing and whether its 'shoujo' roots detract from its historical drama elements, with some finding the older production values a barrier.
pros: Exceptional character development, particularly for Oscar, showcasing complex internal struggles and growth.
Masterful storytelling that integrates historical events compellingly with fictional narratives, making history engaging.
Visually stunning animation and character designs, especially considering the era of production.
Rich exploration of societal issues like class struggle, gender roles, and corruption.
Emotionally resonant and sophisticated romance plots that feel earned and impactful.
cons: Pacing can be slow or repetitive, particularly in the early episodes focusing on court drama.
Dated animation and sound production may deter modern viewers unfamiliar with older anime.
Attempts to garner sympathy for Marie Antoinette are sometimes perceived as heavy-handed or ineffective.
Some critics feel the 'shoujo' elements overshadow the historical context, making it less 'mature' than claimed.

anime.title: Serial Experiments Lain
anime.genres: Avant Garde, Award Winning, Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Lain Iwakura, an awkward and introverted fourteen-year-old, is one of the many girls from her school to receive a disturbing email from her classmate Chisa Yomoda—the very same Chisa who recently committed suicide. Lain has neither the desire nor the experience to handle even basic technology; yet, when the technophobe opens the email, it leads her straight into the Wired, a virtual world of communication networks similar to what we know as the internet. Lain's life is turned upside down as she begins to encounter cryptic mysteries one after another. Strange men called the Men in Black begin to appear wherever she goes, asking her questions and somehow knowing more about her than even she herself knows. With the boundaries between reality and cyberspace rapidly blurring, Lain is plunged into more surreal and bizarre events where identity, consciousness, and perception are concepts that take on new meanings.

Written by Chiaki J. Konaka, whose other works include Texhnolyze, Serial Experiments Lain is a psychological avant-garde mystery series that follows Lain as she makes crucial choices that will affect both the real world and the Wired. In closing one world and opening another, only Lain will realize the significance of their presence.
anime.consensus_summary: Serial Experiments Lain is a highly divisive anime that sparks intense discussion. While praised for its thought-provoking themes and unique atmosphere, it's equally criticized for its convoluted plot, slow pacing, and dated visuals. Viewers either find it a profound exploration of existentialism and technology or a pretentious and confusing mess, resulting in a significant split in opinions.
pros: Thought-provoking themes exploring identity, reality, and technology's impact on human connection.
Unique and surreal visuals that enhance the atmosphere and symbolism.
Characters are deep and relevant, allowing for profound exploration of existential concepts.
Minimalist sound design effectively creates an ominous and unsettling mood.
Intricate plot that rewards attentive viewing and contemplation.
cons: Convoluted and confusing narrative that can be difficult to follow.
Pacing can be slow and uneven, leading to boredom or frustration.
Dated animation and art style may not appeal to modern viewers.
Ending may be divisive or unsatisfying for some.
Reliance on symbolism and ambiguity can feel pretentious or lacking in substance for some viewers.

anime.title: Time of Shura
anime.romaji_title: Mutsu Enmei Ryuu Gaiden: Shura no Toki
anime.genres: Action, Historical, Martial Arts, Samurai, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Legends tell of an invincible martial art known as Mutsu Enmei-Ryu, an unarmed style that allows the user to defeat any number of armed opponents using incredible speed and strength. This is the story of three generations of those who bear the name Mutsu, and their encounters and battles with the strongest fighters of their era.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is well-regarded for its realistic (relative to other anime) depiction of martial arts and incorporation of Japanese history. However, the animation quality is considered average, and later arcs suffer from weaker plot and repetitive action.  Many viewers appreciate the historical context and the engaging characters, making it a worthwhile watch for martial arts enthusiasts despite its flaws.
pros: Technically impressive martial arts without excessive stylistic elements.
Engaging characters and historical interpretations.
Fights are interesting to watch, well-choreographed and realistic (for anime).
cons: Animation quality is inconsistent; backgrounds sometimes disappear during fights.
Later arcs are less engaging, with too much plot and less martial arts action.
Repetitive fight choreography in later arcs.
Some historical inaccuracies and simplifications.

anime.title: Spiral: Bond of Reasoning
anime.synopsis:
Ayumu Narumi has lived all his life in the shadow of his famous detective brother, Kiyotaka. However, Kiyotaka disappeared two years ago, leaving behind his wife Madoka and Ayumu himself, along with a cryptic message about the "Blade Children."

One day, a girl at Ayumu's school suddenly dies. What seemed like a suicide at first glance turns out to be a murder, and Ayumu is the prime suspect. While investigating the person responsible for framing him, he discovers that the mysterious Blade Children are involved—and they somehow know Kiyotaka personally. Ayumu soon finds out just how dangerous the Blade Children are and learns that, in reality, he and Kiyotaka are intertwined more closely than he had ever believed.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Spiral: Suiri no Kizuna. Many appreciate the intriguing mystery, complex characters, and initial gripping storyline. However, a common complaint is the disappointing ending which feels rushed and fails to resolve key plot points. This leaves viewers feeling unsatisfied, despite the anime's strong potential and engaging elements.
pros: Engaging storyline with a captivating beginning.
Well-developed and interesting characters with depth.
Fitting background music that enhances the mood.
cons: Unsatisfactory and rushed ending that leaves many questions unanswered.
Plot deterioration and filler-like episodes towards the end.
Incomplete explanation of mysteries and ambiguous elements.

anime.title: Starship Operators
anime.synopsis: For the 73rd class of cadets of the Defense University of the small planet Kibi, a shakedown cruise on the fleet's new starship "Amaterasu" is a fitting lead-up to graduation. As they are returning to their home planet, however, they are shocked to hear news of a declaration of war by the aggressive Kingdom against Kibi. When their planetary government surrenders without a struggle, the cadets decide to launch their own war, aboard the "Amaterasu". To gain funding, they make a deal with a galactic news network - and find themselves the "stars" of their own "reality show". Unfortunately, this is the kind of reality show that can get you killed...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Starship Operators. Many appreciate the series for its realistic space battles and political intrigue, drawing comparisons to Heinlein's works. However, flaws such as rushed plot development, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent animation hold it back from being a highly recommended show. Most agree that it's an average space opera with some serious themes that appeal to older viewers.
pros: Realistic depiction of space battles and physics.
Well-developed political elements.
Engaging storyline with tactical depth.
cons: Rushed plot and underdeveloped characters.
Inconsistent tone and pacing.
Mediocre animation quality in character design.
anime.thematic_vibe: Military Sci-Fi, Political Intrigue, Space Opera

anime.title: Tsukuyomi: Moon Phase
anime.synopsis:
Freelance photographer Kouhei Morioka is traveling to a castle in Germany to take photos of paranormal activity for his friend Hiromi Anzai, editor of an occult magazine. Upon entering the castle, he's confronted by a young girl in a white dress and cat ears who calls herself Hazuki. She takes a keen interest in Kouhei and offers him a kiss, but she instead reveals herself to be a vampire, sucks his blood, and turns him into her slave.

Much to Hazuki's dismay, however, Kouhei is unaffected by her bite. Hoping to escape the castle and her possessive butler Vigo, Hazuki instead forces Kouhei to help her. With the help of his powerful exorcist cousin Seiji Midou, the two make it out safely. Finally free, Hazuki flees to Japan in search of her mother. Not long after Kouhei returns home, he discovers Hazuki has nested in his home, where he reluctantly allows her to stay. Meanwhile, other vampires set out to find the missing Hazuki.

Equal parts gothic and adorable, Tsukuyomi: Moonphase is a charming and mystical story where two unlikely allies form a unique bond in an attempt to defy a society of immortals.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Tsukuyomi: Moon Phase are mixed. Viewers appreciate the unique visual style and catchy music. However, the series suffers from tonal inconsistencies, a weak plot in the later half, and potentially uncomfortable romantic elements, leading to an overall lukewarm reception.
pros: Interesting use of light and color, particularly in backgrounds and character designs.
Catchy opening theme that is appropriate for the show's tone.
Well-developed relationship between Hazuki and Kouhei in the first half.
cons: Inconsistent tone, shifting between dark/gothic and cutesy/moe, leading to a lack of emotional depth.
Plot becomes nonsensical and unsatisfying in the later episodes, with unanswered questions and forced drama.
Overuse of comedic gags, such as objects falling on characters' heads, that become irritating.
Unease with the potential romance between Kouhei and Hazuki due to her young age.

anime.title: Twin Spica
anime.synopsis: When Kamogawa Asumi was just a baby, her mother was grievously injured when a rocket crashed to the ground. Five years later, having been in a coma all the time, Asumi's mother finally dies, and the little girl struggles to come to terms with the death of a mother she barely remembers. In the midst of her turmoil, she meets "Lion-san," a strange figure wearing a lion mask and claiming to be a ghost. Lion-san helps Asumi to bury her mother's ashes, and finally, Asumi reaches her own decision: "When I grow up, I'm going to be a rocket pilot."
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Futatsu no Spica" is viewed as a heartwarming and character-driven anime with a strong emphasis on overcoming tragedy and pursuing dreams. While praised for its character development and emotional depth, it's criticized for losing focus in the middle, its open ending, and mediocre production qualities. Most find it to be a solid, if not exceptional, watch with some calling it a hidden gem.
pros: Strong character development, especially Asumi and her friends
The story explores themes of overcoming tragedy and pursuing dreams
Believable depiction of astronaut training
Meaningful and heartwarming
cons: The story loses focus and becomes slow-paced in the middle
Open-ended ending with unanswered questions
Generic and uninspired artwork
Music and sound are not very versatile

anime.title: Emma: A Victorian Romance
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Historical, Romance, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Emma has been a maid for most of her life. Working for a retired governess—the strict but compassionate Kelly Stownar—Emma has grown to love her work and has long since accepted her place in society. Beautiful, hardworking, and exceptionally kind, Emma has captured the hearts of many of London's working men—but their feelings always remain unrequited. Emma is waiting for love, and she finds it in the most unlikely of places.

William is the eldest son of the wealthy Jones household—a family that has only recently been accepted into the gentry, securing their position in high society. He is also the former ward of Mrs. Stownar, and on his first visit in years, he falls madly in love with her maid. His earnest attempts to win her affection, coupled with his good nature and warm personality, have captured Emma's heart.

But the polite society of 19th century England does not take kindly to the rejection of tradition. As a result, Emma and William's relationship could not face more opposition. In a world where the class lines are as strongly defended as the borders of nations, does their love have the strength to survive?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Eikoku Koi Monogatari Emma" is well-received as a charming and historically accurate Victorian romance. The slow pacing and perceived lack of character development for Emma are minor drawbacks for some. The anime is recommended for fans of period dramas and those who appreciate a gentle, character-driven story.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga with beautiful animation and detailed art style.
Well-developed and likable characters, even those intended as antagonists.
Historically accurate depiction of Victorian England, including costumes, settings, and social customs.
Soothing and well-fitting instrumental soundtrack enhances the atmosphere.
Simple yet engaging story with a slow-burn romance that feels genuine.
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers.
The main character, Emma, can come across as passive or lacking in emotion.
Animation can appear dated.
Some viewers find the story bland or uninspired.
anime.thematic_vibe: Victorian Romance, Class Conflict, Historical Accuracy

anime.title: Double Wish
anime.synopsis:
Based on a game by Princess Soft

The main character, Junna has a twin sister Senna. He is an ordinal student of an elite school. However, in the past, a traffic accident deprived him of his parents and his memory. Junna survived the accident, and he has lived only with his sister though he has been looked after by his relatives.

And present...
The life with Senna in the same high school is so pleasant that he can forget the severe past. Because he has been in the world where there is only Senna, his lives in this town, such as the beginning of a new life, new environments, and the meetings, are so refreshing.

However, he begins to recall the memories he lost in the accident. Though he enjoys happy and pleasant days, he is tossed by the past, the present, and the future. What is the truth hidden in his memory?
anime.consensus_summary: W: Wish is viewed as a decent, short anime with good pacing, especially considering its short episode length. However, the plot is predictable and the sibling relationship is a point of contention for some viewers. The series is not particularly deep or memorable, but it is a light and easy watch.
pros: Good pacing considering the short episode length.
Decent story with a novel element.
Realistic portrayal of teenagers.
Appealing art style.
cons: Predictable story.
Borderline-incestuous relationship between siblings is disturbing to some viewers.
Shallow character development, especially for secondary characters.
Music is unremarkable.

anime.title: Wild Arms
anime.synopsis: This anime is based on a playstation game under the same title. The story is about four people who travel the desolated land of Filgaea and carve themselves a legendary story while they're at it. These adventurers are Sheyenne Rainstorm, a gunslinger who holds the legendary weapon called ARMs; Kiel Aromax, a scientist who looks like he should be carrying a sword; Roleta Oratorio the Crest Sorceress, a magic-user who uses cards called Crests to cast spells; and Mirabelle Graceland, one of the Noble Red, which are a family of vampiric creatures who live alongside human beings They also travel with cute little intelligent furry things, from the Popepi Pipepo Tribe, named Isaac and Jerusha.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with significant criticism directed at the animation quality, pacing, and abundance of filler episodes. Some viewers appreciate the unique story and blend of genres, while others find it boring and uninspired, especially if they are not already fans of the Wild Arms game series. The consensus suggests that the anime has potential but falls short due to its execution.
pros: Story offers something new and refreshing.
Good blend of action and romance with interesting characters (in some opinions).
Some viewers may find affection, humor, and curiosity for the characters as the story progresses.
cons: Many filler episodes.
Mediocre art and animation.
Repetitive and uninspired opening/closing themes (closing theme is particularly disliked).
Voice acting is considered poor.
Characters are underdeveloped initially.
Story doesn't tie up loose ends well.
Pacing issues; slow story development.

anime.title: Bottle Fairy
anime.synopsis:
Set in the year 2004, Binzume Yousei is a slice-of-life fairy tale that revolves around four fairies, each represented by four unique colors as seen with their magical bottle jars. These fairies are the extremely peppy Kururu, the reserved and feminine Chiriri, the samurai-loving tomboy Sarara, and the quiet yet quirky Hororo.

Fascinated by the human world, these fairies arrived from the fairy world in hopes of participating in the annual traditions and overall way of human life. However, they have a very limited understanding of the human world. Luckily, they are befriended and guided by two humans—"Sensei-san," a university student who they live with, and a first-grade girl they call "Tama-chan," who is sometimes as naive as the fairies themselves.

Though these bottle fairies have strange ideas and sometimes have difficulty understanding this new world, they try to make the most of the human experience in their own cute little ways.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally considered a cute and lighthearted watch, especially for those interested in Japanese culture. However, its simplistic plot, characters, and humor may not appeal to viewers seeking more depth or serious themes.  Some reviewers express concerns about the questionable moral examples presented in the show, but overall it is seen as an enjoyable, albeit not particularly memorable, series.
pros: Mildly humorous and easy to watch with short episodes.
Characters are fun and have unique personalities.
Good for learning about Japanese culture and traditions.
Creative and imaginative scenarios are employed throughout the show.
Energetic voice acting performances.
cons: Plot is shapeless and easily forgotten.
Characters are simplistic and can be bland.
Humor relies heavily on Japanese culture, which may not translate well.
Some episodes are weaker and lack imaginative play.
Sensei-san character is bland and underdeveloped.
Simplistic animation and generic music.
Questionable moral themes.

anime.title: Magical Kanan
anime.synopsis: Five dangerous "seeds" have been stolen from their vault in the world of Evergreen and taken to Earth. Natsuki, an agent of the Queen, has been sent to retrieve them. However, he cannot do this alone and enlists the aid of Chihaya, a middle school student, who is "the only one" who can help him. With his aid she transforms into Magical Warrior Carmine in order to save the humans possessed by the seeds. Questions abound though, such as why Chihaya's mother appears to know all about this secret activity, why Chihaya remembers her father who reportedly died before her birth, and why she dreams of Evergreen, which she has never seen.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely viewed negatively due to its sexualization of children and poorly executed plot. Although some see potential in the underlying story, the excessive filler and distasteful elements overshadow any redeeming qualities. The series is considered a waste of potential and ultimately a disappointment.
pros: Story with potential underneath distasteful elements
Could have been a well-paced series with fewer episodes
cons: Sexualizes characters explicitly stated to be children
Filler episodes make the story rushed and unsubstantial
Poor characterization of villains
TV adaptation of a lewd fanfiction

anime.title: Magical DoReMi
anime.synopsis:
Harukaze Doremi considers herself to be the unluckiest girl in the world. Her parents are always fighting, her little sister makes fun of her, and her crush pines after another girl. If only Doremi could just wave a magic wand, she would have a much better life—or so she used to think.

After a mishap with a real witch, Doremi becomes an apprentice witch herself, and it turns out she's pretty horrible at that, too.

Now she and her two friends must study to become better at magic so they can become good witches. That is, if they can focus on their magic studies!

The three apprentices will need all the luck they can get if they want to pass the witch exams and become full-fledged witches. Only then will Doremi's debt to the witch Majorika be repaid. Until then, Doremi will remain a useless little witch girl!
anime.consensus_summary: Ojamajo Doremi is a heartwarming and charming magical girl series that resonates with viewers of all ages due to its strong emphasis on friendship, personal growth, and positive life lessons. While some find the episodic nature and simple animation to be drawbacks, the well-developed characters and relatable scenarios create a strong emotional connection with the audience. The series is generally well-received as a delightful and nostalgic experience, particularly for fans of the magical girl genre.
pros: Strong emotional connections with characters
Positive messages of personal growth, positivity, and friendship
Well-developed characters with individual hidden traits
Delightful character dynamics and interactions
Memorable music and superb voice acting
Expressive visuals and charming art style
Relatable personal problems of school kids
The show helps you learn positive and valuable life lessons.
cons: Simple and sometimes childish story
Repetitive episodic format with similar storylines
Average animation quality, especially for its time
Overemphasis on romance for very young characters
Filler episodes focused on classmates' problems
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Slice of Life, Comedy

anime.title: Magical DoReMi 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
At the end of the first season, Doremi and her friends all had to give up their witch powers and be normal girls again. This also meant that they couldn't see Majorika, Lala, and the fairies again. The MAHO-Dou was also deserted and the door to the Majokai was locked.

The Queen, having seen all this through her crystal ball, secretly makes it so that Doremi and co. all end up heading into the Majokai again, with the excuse to return Majorika's hair dryer. However they end up stumbling into a garden, and one of the roses reveals a baby!

The Queen tells the girls that they must raise the baby for a whole year. To help them, they receive newer and stronger witch powers than before! The adventure isn't over yet!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Ojamajo Doremi Sharp for its themes of childcare, friendship, and the expansion of the magical world. However, the series is criticized for repetitive plot elements, inconsistent writing, and a rushed ending. Despite its flaws, the show is appreciated for its animation and the positive messages it conveys.
pros: Strong sense of responsibility portrayed in the characters.
Fleshing out of Witch World with the addition of Wizard World.
Important lessons about unconditional love and caring for children.
Enjoyable music and lively transformation scenes.
Animation is super.
cons: Rushed ending episode.
Repetitive 'health examination' episodes that lack substance.
Unused or retconned plot devices and merchandising items.
Inconsistent character motives.
Poorly written episodes with one-note side characters.
Contradictions in the series' own rules on forbidden magic.
Underdeveloped implications of the rules.
Ending twist that comes out of nowhere and undermines a previous episode.

anime.title: Motto! Ojamajo Doremi
anime.synopsis: After losing their magical abilities, the girls once again become witches. However, now they have to go through tests from the Witches of the Witch World. They also meet a new member from New York, Momoko.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, with praise for character development, especially the introduction of Momoko and the exploration of cultural themes. Some find the plot less developed than previous seasons and note a decline in the opening song quality. Overall, the season is well-received for its heartwarming interactions and creative storytelling.
pros: Strong character development, especially for Momoko.
Well-handled introduction of a new character and exploration of cultural differences.
Creative use of food as a medium for communication and building relationships.
Effective integration of Hana's storyline without overshadowing other characters.
cons: Plot development is little in this season.
Opening song quality decreased compared to season 1.
Some character behavior, like Aiko scolding Momoko, is questionable.

anime.title: Ultimate Girls
anime.synopsis: During a monster attack on the city, which is something that happens quite often, Silk and her two friends try get close to the attacking monster for a better view. An unfortunate choice of location to watch from leads to UFO-man, the city's giant protector, to land on the girls crushing them to death. Feeling sorry, UFO-man blames their death on the monster and promises to bring Silk and her friends back to life by lending them his power but the catch is that they now have to become the city's protector as well.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is highly polarized, with many finding the show offensive, demeaning, and poorly executed. While some viewers appreciate the parody and ecchi elements, the overwhelming consensus is negative.  Critics find the show insulting to both men and women, and a poor representation of the Ultraman series.
pros: Enjoyable as a low-expectation spoof for some viewers
Some find the combination of ecchi and giant monsters interesting
The main girls are likeable enough and cutely drawn for some viewers
cons: Story is terrible and repetitive
Fanservice is demeaning and offensive
Animation and music are cheap
Characters are stereotypes
Parody elements fall flat and become cringe-worthy
Concept is poorly executed and insulting to the Ultraman series

anime.title: Shakugan no Shana: Season I
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
The world has become a slaughtering ground for the Crimson Denizens, mysterious beings from a parallel universe who thrive on the life energy of humans. These merciless murderers only leave behind scant remainders of souls called "Torches," which are mere residues that will eventually be destroyed, along with the very fact of the victims' existence from the minds of the living. In an ambitious endeavor to put an end to this invisible, hungry massacre, warriors called Flame Hazes relentlessly fight these monsters.

One fateful day, Yuuji Sakai ceases to be a regular high schooler—he becomes trapped in a crevice of time and is suddenly attacked by a Denizen. Coming to his rescue just in the nick of time is a nameless hunter who seems no different from an ordinary young girl except for her blazing eyes and burning crimson hair. However, before Yuuji can learn anything more about his situation, he discovers that he has already been reduced to a Torch—merely a scrap of memory waiting to be extinguished.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Shakugan no Shana are mixed. Some appreciate the character development, action, and initial story premise, finding it an enjoyable watch. However, others are critical of the slow pacing, predictable plot, and annoying character traits, particularly Shana's tsundere behavior, leading to a somewhat polarized but overall lukewarm reception.
pros: Strong character development, especially for Shana and Yuuji
Well-animated fight scenes with detailed flame effects
Interesting premise with exploration of existence and memory
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the first half of the series
Predictable plot and repetitive elements
Annoying tsundere character traits in Shana and weak romance

anime.title: Fate/stay night
anime.synopsis:
After a mysterious inferno kills his family, Shirou is saved and adopted by Kiritsugu Emiya, who teaches him the ways of magic and justice.

One night, years after Kiritsugu's death, Shirou is cleaning at school, when he finds himself caught in the middle of a deadly encounter between two superhumans known as Servants. During his attempt to escape, the boy is caught by one of the Servants and receives a life-threatening injury. Miraculously, he survives, but the same Servant returns to finish what he started. In desperation, Shirou summons a Servant of his own, a knight named Saber. The two must now participate in the Fifth Holy Grail War, a battle royale of seven Servants and the mages who summoned them, with the grand prize being none other than the omnipotent Holy Grail itself.

Fate/stay night follows Shirou as he struggles to find the fine line between a hero and a killer, his ideals clashing with the harsh reality around him. Will the boy become a hero like his foster father, or die trying?
anime.consensus_summary: Fate/stay night receives mixed reviews, with praise for its visuals, sound, and some characters, but is heavily criticized for a rushed, predictable plot, and an unlikeable protagonist. Many feel the anime's story and character development are incomplete without additional context from the visual novel, leading to frustration. While enjoyable for some, the series is often considered overrated and falls short of its potential.
pros: Well-developed characters with distinct traits and backgrounds.
Animation quality is gorgeous, especially considering the release year, with excellent character designs and color palettes.
Catchy and memorable soundtrack with well-done voice acting, including noteworthy English and German segments.
cons: Story feels rushed and incomplete due to budget/time constraints, with important details and character relationships underdeveloped.
The plot is linear, predictable, and borrows heavily from other shounen anime.
The main character, Shirou, is often irritating and unlikeable, hindering enjoyment.

anime.title: Bludgeoning Angel Dokuro-chan
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Gag Humor, Gore, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Sakura Kusakabe, a mere junior high student, has committed a horrible crime. Or, rather, he will commit a crime—20 years into the future. The crime in question? He will prevent all women from developing past the age of 12, with immortality as an unintended side effect. As a result, the angel Dokuro Mitsukai is sent from the future as an assassin, armed with with a magical spiked bat named Excalibolg. However, rather than kill him, Dokuro wants to take a different approach. She resolves to be a constant nuisance to Sakura, in an attempt to prevent him from focusing on anything long enough to create his criminal technology. 

With Dokuro going against orders, the angel Sabato is sent out to complete Dokuro's mission. Between the impulsive Dokuro—who often murders Sakura with her bat before reviving him with the magic words "Pipiru piru piru pipiru pi"—and the electric baton-wielding Sabato, Sakura's life will never be peaceful again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some viewers find the anime's over-the-top violence and absurd humor hilarious, while others are put off by the lack of plot, shallow characters, and excessive gore. The show's reliance on shock value and potential loli themes also contribute to its controversial nature. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on individual tolerance for extreme and nonsensical content.
pros: Some found the random humor and over-the-top violence funny and entertaining.
The opening theme song and voice acting were considered well done by some.
The show's absurdity can be appealing for viewers looking for brainless fun.
cons: Many found the humor to be repetitive, relying too heavily on gore and shock value.
The lack of a coherent plot and shallow characters were major drawbacks for many viewers.
The excessive fanservice and potential loli themes were off-putting and disturbing to some.

anime.title: Sky of Iriya, Summer of UFO
anime.romaji_title: Iriya no Sora, UFO no Natsu
anime.synopsis: Asaba Naoyuki is an ordinary high school student. As a member of his school's press club, he's just spent the summer camping outside the local military base, in hopes of seeing the UFOs that are secretly kept there, according to local legend. Returning to school, he meets a strange girl, Iriya Kana, and gradually comes to realize that she is more than merely strange - and that a dark secret lies beneath the world that he knows.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mostly positive, appreciating the emotional impact and visual appeal of 'Iriya no Sora, UFO no Natsu'. However, many find the plot and character development lacking due to its short length. While some consider it a touching and memorable experience, others are left confused by the unexplained elements and underdeveloped characters, leading to a bittersweet overall impression.
pros: Touching and emotional story with a lasting impact despite being short.
Beautiful character designs and well-done visuals, especially for its time.
Effective use of atmosphere and mood to draw the viewer into the story.
cons: Underdeveloped characters and plot elements due to the limited number of episodes.
Unexplained events and disjointed storytelling, leading to confusion.
Some characters feel irrelevant and serve only for comedic relief, detracting from the main plot.

anime.title: Legend of Himiko
anime.synopsis: In a world where the dead walk, where good and evil exist as palpable forces, a darkness is stirring. The undead march against the cities of light, to capture the sacred fire that is the source of their power. But one hope remains. Called into this world by the magical flame, a young girl named Himiko is thrust into the maelstrom of danger, betrayal, and war. For she is heir to the sacred fire, and holds a power that could save its Guardians... if she survives!
anime.consensus_summary: The anime has an interesting premise but fails in execution. Reviewers criticize the poor art, shallow characters, and confusing plot. The overall experience is seen as a let-down, with many finding it hard to connect with the characters or understand the story.
pros: Interesting premise (isekai in feudal Japan)
Magic and mysticism are present
cons: Poor art quality with disproportionate characters
Shallow characters with little depth or background
Confusing and grating story execution
Inconsistent pacing (too fast and too slow)
Random cuts and missing story elements
Unexplained plot points and conflicts
Title character does nothing

anime.title: Memories Off
anime.synopsis: Tomoya Mikami was enjoying a blissful youth with his girlfriend, Ayaka Hizuki, until her tragic death suddenly brought everything to a halt. Feeling guilty and unmotivated, he struggles to move forward. But with Ayaka's spirit watching over him, Tomoya resolves to try to find love and happiness once again.
anime.consensus_summary: The Memories Off OVA series is largely panned by viewers for its rushed plot, poor animation, and weak character development. Many find the story confusing and the relationships unconvincing due to the condensed format. While a few viewers appreciate the variety in the heroines and some unexpected plot turns, the overall consensus is that the series fails to deliver a compelling romance or drama.
pros: Varied heroines offer some intrigue.
Some routes have unexpected, even tragic, turns.
Music is enjoyable for some viewers.
cons: Rushed and confusing plot due to OVA format.
Poor animation quality with a lack of expressive faces.
Weak character development and rushed relationships.
Cliche story elements and uninspired writing.
Poor voice acting.

anime.title: Gallery Fake
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Seinen, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis: Fujita Reiji is the owner of an art gallery, Gallery Fake. He deals with fake items, and is also familiar with the black market. However, he has a special talent for art, and used to work for the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York as a curator.
anime.consensus_summary: Gallery Fake is a generally well-received anime, praised for its blend of art history, interesting characters, and engaging stories. Some viewers find Fujita's behavior towards Sara problematic, and the self-contained nature of episodes can lead to underdeveloped plot threads. Overall, the anime is considered charming and educational, with strong recommendations for fans of the seinen genre.
pros: Interesting stories about art history.
Fun and engaging characters, especially Fujita and Sara.
High-quality music that enhances the viewing experience.
cons: Inconsistent character behavior, particularly Fujita's treatment of Sara.
Self-contained episodes lead to underdeveloped or dropped characters.
Varying quality in episode writing.

anime.title: Boogiepop Phantom
anime.genres: Avant Garde, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Boogiepop, a rumored shinigami, is said to lurk where they cannot be seen. Five years ago, a string of gruesome murders shocked the populace, and students attributed some of those killings to the aforementioned death god. When mysterious happenings once again affect the lives of those attending Hijiridani High School and Shinyo Academy, whispers of the enigmatic Boogiepop are resurrected. The stories being told may contain partial truths, or perhaps the world as humans know it is more dangerous than previously believed.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Boogiepop Phantom are divided. Many appreciate the anime's unique atmosphere, sound design, and exploration of psychological themes, while others are frustrated by its confusing plot, similar character designs, and dated animation. The non-linear storytelling is a point of contention, with some finding it intriguing and others finding it alienating. Despite its flaws, Boogiepop Phantom is generally considered a thought-provoking and memorable anime.
pros: Excellent sound design and music create a strong atmosphere.
Intriguing non-linear storytelling keeps viewers engaged.
Exploration of complex and mature themes related to the human psyche.
cons: Confusing and convoluted plot can be difficult to follow.
Character designs are too similar, making it hard to distinguish characters.
Animation quality is dated and inconsistent.

anime.title: Cardcaptor Sakura The Movie
anime.genres: Award Winning, Comedy, Drama, Mahou Shoujo, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
During an after-school shopping trip, Sakura Kinomoto decides to participate in the Tomoeda Shopping District's year-end lottery, with the grand prize being a round trip to Hong Kong. Surprisingly, she draws the winning ball. Alongside her best friend Tomoyo Daidouji, her older brother Touya, her crush Yukito Tsukishiro, and Keroberos, Sakura heads off to Hong Kong.

However, vacation for the Cardcaptor will get cut short. Little does Sakura know, the trip may be connected to her recent, prophetic dreams featuring a mysterious woman and Clow Reed himself, creator of the Clow Cards.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many acknowledging the film's high production values, particularly its stunning animation and sound design. However, a significant portion of viewers find the plot predictable, reliant on plot conveniences, and lacking the charm and narrative depth of the original series. While some fans appreciate the continuation of the characters and the expanded lore, others feel it's an unnecessary, extended episode that doesn't significantly contribute to the overall story.
pros: Gorgeous and fluid animation, detailed expressions, and stunning scenery.
Authentic portrayal of Hong Kong culture and locales.
Exceptional voice acting and a well-suited, eclectic soundtrack.
Strong sense of character personalities and sibling dynamics.
Visually impressive, higher quality animation and art than the series, especially for its time.
cons: Trite and highly predictable story for the remainder of the film.
Relies on absurd plot conveniences and unanswered questions.
Lack of relevance to the overarching story, with underdeveloped characters and antagonist.
Much of the film takes itself too seriously, lacking the charm and comedic balance of the TV series.
Sakura's role is reduced to running and talking, with underutilization of stronger cards.
The ending is disappointing and the resolution doesn't live up to the setup.
Feels like a longer, extended episode rather than a cinematic experience; not necessary for the series' plot.
The antagonist is lackluster, with weak motivations and underdeveloped powers.
New characters and plot additions serve little purpose and feel like props.

anime.title: Cardcaptor Sakura Movie 2: The Sealed Card
anime.romaji_title: Cardcaptor Sakura Movie 2: Fuuin Sareta Card
anime.genres: Award Winning, Comedy, Drama, Mahou Shoujo, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
For this year's Nadeshiko Festival, Sakura Kinomoto's elementary school class is presenting a play. She will portray a princess who struggles to respond to the love confession of the neighboring country's prince. Sakura empathizes with her character all too well, since she herself still owes an answer to the boy who confessed his love for her four months ago.

When cousins Shaoran and Meiling Li return from Hong Kong to pay a surprise visit to their friends in Japan, Sakura receives further encouragement to finally declare her feelings. However, she is repeatedly distracted by a presence reminiscent of a Clow Card as well as unexplained disappearances around town.

Eventually, Sakura learns of another of Clow Reed's creations—the "Nothing"—which was formerly sealed away beneath the magician's old house. It has power equal to all 52 cards Sakura possesses, and furthermore, it wants to take those cards away from her! Objects, space, and people disappear from Tomoeda with each card that is stolen. Sakura sets out to capture the Nothing so everything will return to normal, but what must she sacrifice in the process?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Reviewers appreciate the movie's heartfelt continuation of the series, particularly the resolution of Sakura and Syaoran's relationship. The consistent character development and art style also contribute to the positive reception, with minor criticisms regarding sound quality and occasional pacing issues. Most viewers see this film as a must-watch for Cardcaptor Sakura fans.
pros: Satisfying resolution to Sakura and Syaoran's relationship.
High-quality animation and art style consistent with the series.
Well-developed characters that stay true to their personalities.
Engaging story that builds upon the original series.
Thematic exploration of love, friendship, and loneliness.
Foreshadowing and focused narrative contribute to a compelling story
cons: Occasional awkward scene transitions and mood whiplash due to music choices.
Sound quality issues in some versions.
Plot similarities to the first movie may lead to deja vu for some viewers.
Antagonist is somewhat disappointing.
Pacing issues; drawing out the 'will they/won't they' dynamic for too long.

anime.title: All Purpose Cultural Cat Girl Nuku Nuku TV
anime.synopsis: Each episode centers on Nuku Nuku's adventures and mishaps in high school, and her relationship to students, the overall series plot centers on the evil Mishima Industries' scheme to dominate the world through its products. In opposition to this plan are the slightly nutty Kyuusaku Natsume and Nuku Nuku, the android who acts as a companion to his young son. Nuku Nuku's classmates are all eccentrics, Futaba, the class president, is a domineering control-freak, who cannot leave her authority in school. Chieko Shirakaba is the rich snob with the two yes-girls who always take her side. There is a bookworm, a mystic, a scientist, and a pop singer. All of these are true to their descriptions: the mystic is always foretelling doom via tarot cards, spirits, or some other occult technique. The pop singer never says anything except as a song. The bookworm always has her nose in a book. These eccentricities add to the series' humor.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely views Bannou Bunka Neko-Musume (1998) as a fun, under-rated comedic series with excellent voice acting and enjoyable music. While praised for its unique humor and blend of absurdities, some find its episodic nature, repetitive jokes, and dated art to be drawbacks. The show is generally well-liked by those who appreciate its quirky, over-the-top comedic style.
pros: Excellent voice acting, particularly from the lead.
Strong comedic elements derived from character interactions and absurd situations.
Well-executed musical numbers that enhance the comedic tone.
Unique blend of outlandish and ordinary elements creating comedic situations.
Good character dynamics contributing to humor.
cons: Lacks an over-arching story, being primarily episodic.
The final episode's attempt at a dramatic moment fails.
Some jokes and running gags are not consistently funny or become repetitive.
Characters are largely one-dimensional stereotypes, even when used for comedy.
Art style is dated and hasn't aged gracefully.

anime.title: Elfen Lied: In the Passing Rain, or, How Can a Girl Have Reached Such Feelings?
anime.romaji_title: Elfen Lied: Tooriame nite Arui wa, Shoujo wa Ikani Shite Sono Shinjou ni Itatta ka? - Regenschauer
anime.genres: Drama, Gore, Horror, Psychological, Seinen, Super Power, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Having been accepted into the Kaede Inn, Nana struggles to find some way to contribute, though she inadvertently brings more trouble than assistance. However, Nana's worries are directed more towards fellow resident Nyu, whom she had only known as Lucy, the violent Diclonius. Fearful that Nyu will unleash the same horrific savagery—violence that scars Nana to this day—upon those close to her, Nana faces a dilemma: attempt to live peacefully alongside Lucy with all the uncertainty that that entails or dispose of the source of her worries, shattering the relationships she has formed at the inn. As Nana struggles to come to a decision, Nyu recalls a painful memory of one of her dearest friends and one of her greatest rivals.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the lighthearted comedy and backstory, while others find it unnecessary and poorly executed, feeling like a filler episode that doesn't contribute significantly to the overall narrative. The OVA's placement within the series timeline is also a point of contention. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on investment in the characters and a willingness to accept a less serious tone.
pros: Provides additional backstory on Lucy's capture.
Develops the relationship between Lucy/Nyuu and Nana.
Offers a break from the tragedy of the main series with comedic elements.
Some found it enjoyable as an addition, clarifying certain plot points.
cons: Feels like filler; adds little to the main plot.
Inconsistencies in character development.
Raises more questions than it answers for some viewers.
Animation is drastically inferior.
The OVA teases interesting backstory, but runs out of time to explain details.

anime.title: eX-Driver
anime.synopsis: eX-Driver is set in the future, where all transportation is easily controlled by AI. Though, like all machines, they tend to break down, lose control, or get re-programmed. This is where three high schoolers with non-AI cars—a Subaru WRX, a Caterham Super 7, and a Lotus Europa—come in to save the day and make sure the public is safe at all times.
anime.consensus_summary: eX-Driver is viewed as a flawed but fun anime, particularly for car enthusiasts. The premise is interesting, but the execution is hampered by a short run and repetitive plot. While the animation is dated, the attention to detail in the cars and action sequences is appreciated, leaving many viewers with a sense of unfulfilled potential.
pros: Unique premise of drivers versus rogue AI cars.
Appeals to car enthusiasts with detailed vehicle animation and accurate sounds.
Enjoyable, easy-to-watch action with well-defined characters (though not deep).
cons: Repetitive plot with similar runaway car scenarios.
Underdeveloped characters and relationships due to the short series length.
Dated animation style and inconsistent art quality.
Shallow story that doesn't explore the potential of its premise.

anime.title: eX-Driver the Movie
anime.synopsis:
After winning domestic preliminary round, Lisa, Lorna, and Soichi advance to ex-Driver world race competition held in Los Angeles as representative team from Japan. Like a bad omen, they encountered a reckless AI car the first night they arrived at Los Angeles. Although they successfully stopped the car, the local police department is not very happy about that and insists to examine their car overnight. 

However, the problem did not stop just there. The daughter of the United States team`s sponsor, Angela, has gone missing. Lorna realized that Angela was on the reckless AI car before. Soichi who guessed that Angel could be in danger then start looking for her. But Soichi got captured by a mysterious man, and he shocked to find Angela is also there. 

During the confinement inside a warehouse, Soichi finds out that apparently there is a connection between the series of incident and illegal gambling on the ex-Driver world race competition. Now Soichi must escape from the warehouse with Angela...
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is generally considered a step up from the original series, with a more engaging storyline and improved production quality. However, some aspects like the CGI and lack of world-building are seen as drawbacks. Overall, viewers appreciate the movie's attempt to polish and expand upon the series' potential, though it's not without its flaws.
pros: More enjoyable storyline compared to the series.
Improved animation quality compared to the series.
Stellar sound design, especially car sounds.
Better character relationships and interactions.
