More developed characters and plot compared to the series.
cons: Early 2000s CGI for cars looks dated.
Doesn't explore differences between Japan and America dealing with AI cars.
The movie title is uncreative.
The series suffers from it's six episode short run

anime.title: Excel Saga
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, Sci-Fi, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
It is hard to take over the world, and the enigmatic Il Palazzo, head of the ACROSS organization, knows this, so he aims to start small by conquering the city of Fukuoka. Two young officers, Excel and her partner Hyatt, are tasked with executing this plan, but standing in their way are the City Security workers, a group consisting of three mostly normal guys, a very severe girl, and some robots. Regardless of simplicity, Excel and Hyatt always manage to screw up their missions, which usually result in death and lots of destruction.

Heppoko Jikken Animation Excel♥Saga chronicles the elaborate troubles that the ACROSS officers get themselves into, as Excel and Hyatt never fail to do their jobs improperly.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Excel Saga is strongly divided. While many appreciate its over-the-top humor, creative parodies, and energetic presentation, others find the randomness and main character's antics to be grating and off-putting.  The show's unconventional nature makes it a love-it-or-hate-it experience, resulting in a polarized audience.
pros: Creative and varied animation styles that complement the parodies.
Excellent voice acting, especially in the English dub, enhances the humor.
The show's randomness and parodies are well-executed and make the series a unique and memorable experience
cons: The humor can be too random and chaotic, making it difficult to follow or enjoy for some viewers.
Excel's character can be grating and annoying to some viewers
The story is weak and exists mostly as a vehicle for the parodies.

anime.title: Galaxy Angel
anime.synopsis: The Angel Brigade, an elite branch of the Transbaal Empire military, are assigned to search for The Lost Technology, mysterious items from the past that hold unknown powers. Led by the soon to retire Colonel Volcott O' Huey, the Angel Brigade travel to different planets using their specially designed Emblem Frame ships to search for Lost Technology. Unfortunately, they usually mess up somehow and end up getting into all kinds of weird and troublesome situations.
anime.consensus_summary: Galaxy Angel is generally well-received as a lighthearted and comedic anime, praised for its unique humor, catchy music, and fun characters. While its lack of a consistent plot and somewhat dated art style are noted as drawbacks, most viewers find it an enjoyable and easy watch. The series excels as a skit show, offering a blend of sitcom-style humor, parodies, and occasional serious episodes.
pros: Unique and funny jokes
Catchy music and opening themes
Fun characters with unique personalities
Good voice acting, especially the English dub
Enjoyable lightheartedness
Memorable characters
Well-paced comedy
cons: Lack of overarching plot or storyline
Episodic nature can feel repetitive
Dated art style
Some storylines feel mediocre or underdeveloped
Inconsistent quality with some serious episodes disrupting the comedy
Some might not like the fast-paced comedy
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Sci-Fi Parody

anime.title: Gantz
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, High Stakes Game, Horror, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Knowing that he is risking his life, Kei Kurono makes the uncharacteristic decision to jump onto train tracks to save a homeless man from death, only to perish in the process. But when he comes to, Kei finds himself in a room with several other recently deceased people, as well as a large, mysterious black ball. While the people in the room are trying to make sense of their situation, the ball suddenly opens, revealing a cache of weapons and strange black suits. The ball then instructs everyone that they have to hunt down an alien and teleports them to an unknown location.

With very little information to work off of, Kei teams up with his childhood friend Masaru Katou and an unfamiliar woman, and the trio explore their new surroundings. It quickly becomes apparent, however, that they have stumbled into a dark and dangerous world where anything could happen to them.
anime.consensus_summary: Gantz is a highly divisive anime due to its excessive violence, nudity, and unlikeable characters. Some appreciate its unique premise, edgy feel, and strong technical aspects, while others criticize its weak plot, shallow characters, and slow pacing. The series sparks debate about its social commentary, with some finding it insightful and others deeming it nihilistic.
pros: Interesting premise with edgy feel.
Unique gun design and suit elements.
Strong visual and sound design.
cons: Weak plot and underdeveloped themes.
Unlikeable and shallow characters.
Slow pacing with stretched scenes.

anime.title: Gilgamesh
anime.synopsis:
In an attempt to gather information on immortality, scientists from around the world have assembled to study "Heaven's Gate"—the tomb turned laboratory of the mythical king Gilgamesh. But soon enough, the research is deemed unethical and all planned work comes to a halt. However, a group of terrorists pay this no thought and storm into Heaven's Gate, ultimately causing an explosion that leads to the collapse of the advanced information civilization.

Many years after the incident, the siblings Tatsuya and Kiyoko Madoka are on the run from thugs. Yet this seems to be the least of their worries as they find themselves in the midst of a war between two powerful cryptic factions. With both groups claiming to fight for the betterment of society, Tatsuya and Kiyoko will have to find a way to decide who to trust.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with some praising the show's originality, dark atmosphere, and complex narrative, while others criticize its slow pacing, confusing plot, and divisive ending. The unique art style and strong character designs are generally appreciated, but inconsistent animation quality and underdeveloped action sequences detract from the overall experience. The series evokes strong emotions, but its niche appeal may not resonate with all viewers, making it a polarizing anime.
pros: Original and intricate story with mysteries that unfold gradually.
Distinctive art style with strong character designs.
Excellent sound design and music, enhancing the atmosphere.
cons: Ending can be divisive and requires external knowledge to fully appreciate.
Inconsistent animation quality, particularly in action sequences.
Plot can be slow-paced and confusing, leading to disappointment.

anime.title: H2
anime.genres: Comedy, Romance, Shounen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: Hiro has two loves: baseball and porn, but due to an elbow injury, gives up baseball, choosing a school with no baseball team. His childhood friend Hikari attends a different school with baseball ace Hideo. The two of them wish that Hiro had not given up baseball. Hiro joins the soccer team and meets Haruka, a very clumsy girl who is also the daughter of his father's boss. Haruka is the manager of the unofficial baseball club at Hiro's school. When the soccer team challenges the baseball club to a game, with hopes of humiliating them, the baseball club nearly loses until Hiro, disgusted by the soccer team's arrogance, switches to the baseball club.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with praise for the baseball aspects and unique storytelling but criticism for the incomplete ending and flawed romance. Many feel the series doesn't live up to its potential, especially compared to other works by the same creator. The abrupt conclusion and unsatisfying character arcs are major points of contention.
pros: Enjoyable baseball story
Sweet and innocent romance
Good atmosphere and pacing
Witty and strong-willed characters
Unique way of presenting facts, developments, thoughts, and emotions through dialogues
cons: Unresolved storylines due to abrupt ending
Romance focused on too much and not enough on baseball
Weak or pathetic character progression
Unsatisfying or awful ending

anime.title: Haibane Renmei
anime.synopsis:
Born from a cocoon in the village of Old Home, a young Haibane—a being with a halo and small gray wings—awakens to a world she does not understand without memories of her past. Named Rakka for the dream of falling she had while inside the cocoon, she soon becomes accustomed to life in the strange town. However, there are strict rules for the Haibane, such as being forbidden to leave the village or go near the walls surrounding it. These, along with mysterious disappearances of their kind on their "Day of Flight," begin to unsettle Rakka and the others since they know almost nothing about their own kind.
 
As Rakka and the other Haibane live their lives with no memories of the past, they try to break free from their former pain and ultimately find salvation.
anime.consensus_summary: Haibane Renmei is a deeply moving and thought-provoking anime that resonates with viewers on an emotional level. Its artistic style, music, and thematic depth are highly praised, though the slow pace and ambiguous storytelling may not appeal to everyone. Many appreciate its exploration of complex themes like sin, redemption, and the search for meaning, while others find it pretentious or lacking in clear answers.
pros: Beautiful and detailed background art creates a dreamlike atmosphere.
Soundtrack enhances the emotional impact, especially the opening and ending themes.
Meaningful exploration of themes like forgiveness, guilt, and self-discovery.
Unique character designs contribute to the show's distinct aesthetic.
Subtle and poignant storytelling allows for thematic richness.
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers.
Plot points and settings are not always explicitly explained.
Some find the characters underdeveloped or stereotypical.
Animation quality is not consistently high.
Ending leaves too many questions unanswered for some viewers.

anime.title: Capeta
anime.synopsis:
After losing his mother at a very young age, elementary school student Capeta Taira is forced to become more independent to avoid his father worrying for him. Working in a paving company, his father is often busy and has to work overtime to make ends meet. However, no matter how tough he acts in front of his father, Capeta is ultimately just a lonely kid with a rough life. In addition to his typical house duties, he has to deal with the bully Nobu Andou which makes him feel worse, despite support from his classmate, Monami Suzuki.

One day, Capeta's father sees young go-kart drivers racing at high speeds and gets inspired by the scene. He then decides to collect scrapped parts available on the track and begins working on a gift for his son. Meanwhile, Capeta and Monami sneak into his workplace, suspecting that his father is up to something.  Much to their surprise, they see a go-kart built from discarded parts—with Capeta's name attached to it! Although it lacks an engine and looks worn out, the kart is mostly complete and functional.

Despite the heavy rain, Capeta cannot resist the urge to try out this new machinery. As he drives the kart downhill on a wet road, an incident that is almost a dangerous accident instead becomes a thrilling obsession. No longer bored with life, the engine of Capeta's heart is ignited with a new passion as he journeys into the world of racing.
anime.consensus_summary: Capeta is a highly appreciated sports anime centered around racing, praised for its inspirational story of an underdog overcoming challenges with the help of friends and family. The racing scenes are exciting, and the soundtrack enhances the emotional impact. While some criticize the art style and voice acting, the series is generally considered a hidden gem, although it is incomplete.
pros: Heartwarming story with a focus on friendship and overcoming adversity.
Exciting and well-executed racing scenes.
Soundtrack enhances the emotional impact of the story.
Characters are relatable and well-developed.
cons: Art style may not appeal to all viewers.
Some voice acting can be irritating.
Show can be melodramatic and somewhat generic.
The anime is clearly unfinished.
Some characters feel superfluous or annoying.

anime.title: Karas
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Gore, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
The world of the humans and the world of the demons (youkai) have overlapped one another, leaving humans to walk the streets of life as they normally would, while demons walk, hidden from the naked eye, down the very same streets. A seemingly young woman named Yurine and her servant, the Karas (from the Japanese word for "Crow"), have long maintained order and balance between the overlapped worlds, ultimately keeping the demons from interrupting the lives of humans. However, humans have come to forget and jest at the existence of demons, and no longer understand the privilege it is to live without fear. Disgusted by this arrogance, an old Karas turns his back on the laws he had once upheld, and in his human form, named Eko, he creates an army of Mikura, or mechanized demons, to ready an attack on the human race.

A young man named Otoha inherits the powers of the Karas and takes his place at the side of Yurine, who claims that his soul called out for her while he lived the life of a human. They live in the world of the demons. It is now up to Otoha to prove himself as a Karas, and restore the balance that Eko threatens to upset.

Meanwhile, a superstitious police officer named Sagisaka and his rational new recruit, Kure, follow the trail of the murders dealt by Eko's Mikura, as well as the trail of a rogue Mikura named Nue. The prophecy unfolds from here into a grave revelation for all in the city.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Karas are divided. Many praise its exceptional visuals and sound, considering them highlights of the series. However, the complex and often confusing plot, coupled with underdeveloped characters, leaves some viewers feeling detached and underwhelmed despite the impressive presentation.
pros: Visually stunning animation with a blend of 2D and 3D CGI.
Excellent sound design and music that complements the action and emotional scenes.
Unique character designs.
cons: Convoluted and confusing plot that is difficult to follow, especially in the initial episodes.
Underdeveloped characters with minimal background information.
Pacing issues, with some finding it rushed and others finding it slow.

anime.title: Suzuka
anime.synopsis:
Teenager Yamato Akitsuki has moved from the Hiroshima countryside to Tokyo to begin his high school career. In return for room and board, he has agreed to help his aunt and cousin run their bathhouse and the adjacent girls-only dormitory where he will be staying. On his way to meet his relatives, he passes by a local high school track and is mesmerized by a high jumper practicing her technique.

Later on, Yamato finds out that the high jumper is not just another resident of the dorm, but is also his neighbor. Suzuka Asahina is a heavily scouted track and field athlete who is attending the same high school he is enrolled in. A perfectionist by nature, Suzuka is put off by Yamato's clumsy and carefree attitude and finds it difficult to be near him.

Determined to win her over, Yamato joins the track team after discovering his hidden talent for sprinting. Through his interactions with the track team, his classmates, and the ever-inebriated college students in the dorm, Yamato finds the resolve to become a better athlete and a more suitable companion to Suzuka, even if it means pushing himself to the point of exhaustion.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is very mixed. Many find the main characters, particularly Suzuka, unlikable and the plot full of contrived melodrama. Some viewers appreciate the realistic portrayal of emotions and the development of certain supporting characters, however, the negative aspects appear to outweigh the positives for a significant portion of the audience.
pros: Realistic portrayal of embarrassment, confusion and other emotions.
Some supporting characters are well-written and likable.
The soundtrack is good, especially the piano tracks that accompany dramatic scenes.
cons: Poor art and animation quality.
Main characters are unlikable and poorly written, especially Suzuka who is often seen as a 'bitch'.
Predictable plot and contrived melodrama.
Lack of chemistry between the main characters.
Yamato's obsession with Suzuka is grating and unrealistic.
anime.thematic_vibe: Melodramatic, Slice of Life, Unrealistic Romance

anime.title: Tales of Phantasia
anime.synopsis:
Tragedy strikes the lives of Cless Alvein, a young swordsman, and Chester Barklight, a young archer, as they return to their village of Totus to find it razed to the ground by the mysterious Black Knight. To take over the world, the Black Knight seeks to claim the power of the Demon King, Dhaos—sealed away by the ancestors of Cless and a young cleric named Mint Adnade. Dhaos' reawakening signals not only the end of the Black Knight, but potentially the world. Cless and Mint must now journey a century into the past to rally allies capable of vanquishing the Demon King once and for all.

Tales of Phantasia The Animation follows Cless and Mint's journey through time to long ago, where they forge an alliance with the half-elf sorceress Arche Klaine and the summoner Klarth F. Lester. Together, they strive to defeat Dhaos and his army in saving the past as well as the years to come.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Tales of Phantasia' OVA is a visually appealing but ultimately flawed adaptation, mainly appreciated by fans of the game. Critics highlight the rushed plot and missing character development, making it difficult for newcomers to fully grasp the story. While the animation and voice acting are commendable, the series serves better as a brief recap or companion piece to the game rather than a standalone narrative.
pros: Fluid animation, especially during action scenes.
Well-executed voice acting enhances character portrayals.
Music effectively uses themes from the original game.
cons: Rushed storyline due to the limited number of episodes.
Significant plot points and character development are skipped or underdeveloped.
Confusing for viewers unfamiliar with the game.

anime.title: Yu Yu Hakusho: Ghost Files
anime.genres: Action, Martial Arts, Mythology, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
One fateful day, Yuusuke Urameshi, a 14-year-old delinquent with a dim future, gets a miraculous chance to turn it all around when he throws himself in front of a moving car to save a young boy. His ultimate sacrifice is so out of character that the authorities of the spirit realm are not yet prepared to let him pass on. Koenma, heir to the throne of the spirit realm, offers Yuusuke an opportunity to regain his life through completion of a series of tasks. With the guidance of the death god Botan, he is to thwart evil presences on Earth as a Spirit Detective.

To help him on his venture, Yuusuke enlists ex-rival Kazuma Kuwabara, and two demons, Hiei and Kurama, who have criminal pasts. Together, they train and battle against enemies who would threaten humanity's very existence.
anime.consensus_summary: Yu Yu Hakusho is largely regarded as a classic shonen anime with strong characters and a well-balanced story. While some criticize the dated animation and repetitive fight sequences, the character development, humor, and engaging plot are frequently praised. The English dub is particularly well-regarded. Most fans view it with nostalgia and appreciate its unique elements compared to other shonen series of its time.
pros: Strong character development, especially Yusuke's growth
Unique and interesting characters with well-explored backstories
Well-balanced mix of action, humor, and serious themes
Excellent English dub with memorable voice acting
Engaging story with minimal filler, especially in the anime adaptation
cons: Dated animation and artwork, even for its time
Repetitive fight formula in some arcs
Inconsistent animation quality across episodes
Some villains lack depth or development
Plot conveniences and contrived power-ups

anime.title: Escaflowne: A Girl in Gaea
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Isekai, Love Polygon, Mecha, Romance
anime.synopsis: Hitomi Kanzaki is in a very depressed mood. She only wants to sleep and fade away. Her misery summons Lord Folken who sends her to Gaea. The people of Gaea think she is the Wing Goddess, who can call upon the legendary Dragon Armor called Escaflowne. On Gaea, King Van, the sole survior of the White Dragon Clan, is also in a depressed state. Swearing an oath to get his revenge on the Black Dragon Clan that obliterated Van's kingdom, he lives by the sword. Now that the Wing Goddess has finally appeared, she posseses Gaea's world fate in her heart. Escaflowne will either lead Gaea to peace or total ruin.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the movie's darker tone and improved visuals, while others criticize its rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and confusing plot. Many feel it fails to capture the depth and complexity of the original TV series. The movie is seen as a reimagining rather than a faithful adaptation, leading to polarized opinions among fans.
pros: Visually stunning animation and improved character designs.
Excellent soundtrack by Yoko Kanno.
Streamlined and concise storytelling compared to the TV series.
cons: Rushed pacing and underdeveloped characters.
Inconsistent character motivations and actions.
Plot holes and confusing story elements.

anime.title: Ai Yori Aoshi: Enishi
anime.synopsis:
Two years after meeting Aoi, Kaoru and gang are still up to their normal habits. Kaoru now in grad school and the tenants being as rowdy as ever what will become of Aoi and Kaoru's love.

Two years has passed since Aoi and Kaoru were freed from the bonds of their families. They continue to live their normal lives with their usual friends in their house.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers enjoyed the series as a pleasant slice-of-life continuation with likable characters and appreciated the further development of the supporting cast. However, many were disappointed by the lack of plot progression, the sidelining of the main characters, and the repetitive nature of the series, leading to a sense of boredom and unfulfilled expectations. Overall, it's considered a decent watch for fans of the first season but falls short of being a standout sequel.
pros: Characters are likable and well-developed, especially the supporting cast.
The series offers a continuation of the romance established in the first season.
Visually appealing art style and animation.
Enjoyable and light-hearted with some emotional moments.
cons: Lack of significant plot progression or resolution.
Repetitive formula and pacing issues leading to boredom.
Main characters Aoi and Kaoru get sidelined for side characters.
Inconsistent English dubbing close to the Japanese translation.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Romantic Comedy, Harem

anime.title: Gantz: Second Stage
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, High Stakes Game, Horror, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Despite having seemingly returned to their normal lives, Kei Kurono, Masaru Katou, and Kei Kishimoto are forced back into the lethal game after Gantz's recent activity. The black sphere continues to summon recently deceased people to fight alien invaders. And having survived the two previous encounters, the trio are more than prepared for the upcoming missions.

As they progress through the tournament's stages, the three proceed in their attempt to earn 100 points, which is said to be the only way to leave the parallel dimension for good. However, with the constant onslaught of alien invaders and the threat of imminent death, they must first focus on the task at hand—immediate survival.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating the unique premise and action while criticizing the poor pacing, character development, and ending. Some find the gore and violence excessive, while others feel it contributes to the show's themes. There is a strong sentiment that the manga provides a more satisfying experience.
pros: Unique premise and interesting concept
Good action scenes and fight choreography
Some character development, particularly for Kei
Soundtrack and voice acting are well-received
Exploration of dark themes and human depravity
Ending is a good stopping point to read the manga
cons: Poor pacing and slow story progression
Tedious and drawn-out fight scenes
Inconsistent character development; many flat or unlikable characters
Poorly executed plot with numerous holes and nonsensical elements
Repetitive flashbacks and lengthy dialogues during battles
Disappointing and anticlimactic ending
Overreliance on gore and violence
Use of CGI and animation quality is inconsistent
Philosophical themes that are not well-integrated

anime.title: Banner of the Stars
anime.synopsis:
Three years since the end of their intergalactic excursion, both Lafiel Abriel and Jinto Linn have reunited; Lafiel as the captain of the attack ship Basroil and Jinto as her supply officer. The restart of the war between the Abh Empire and the Triple Alliance thrusts the inexperienced duo into the forefront of the deadly conflict.

As the catastrophic battle between pure humankind and their greatest creation, the Abh, rages on, both sides accept that their conflict is not merely about territory, but about settling the inherent differences between themselves.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, appreciating the character development and tactical battles. Some find the series emotionally dry and criticize the reused animation. There's a minor split regarding the show's thematic depth, with some finding it thought-provoking and others finding it inconsistent.
pros: Strong character development, especially of the main duo and supporting cast.
Tactical and well-executed battle scenes.
Exploration of characters' roles and place in the universe.
cons: Reused animation and soundtrack.
Thematic inconsistencies and halfhearted attempts at exploring complex ideas.
Dryness in dialogue delivery from some characters, lacking emotional range.

anime.title: Banner of the Stars II
anime.synopsis: Due to a lack of ambassadors for the recently-conquered worlds the rapidly advancing fleet of the Bebaus brothers leave behind, Lafiel is appointed Territorial Ambassador of the planet Lobnas II. Upon arriving to the planet Jinto and Lafiel discover that the planet was used by the United Mankind as a prison planet and now has a million prisoners on the only inhabited island. The prisoners are parted in three blocks. The western where women are housed, the eastern belongs to the men and the central is mixed under the restriction that all prisoners living there are sterilized. The women in the western sector want to emigrate from the planet of fear for the men and when they do the men in the east rebel, overthrowing the guards and capturing Jinto to try to stop the emigration of the women. At the same time an enemy fleet heads toward the system forcing Lafiel to abandon Jinto.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Seikai no Senki II', praising the character development, particularly the exploration of Jinto and Lafiel's relationship, and the emotional impact of the ending. Some find the plot predictable and the animation lacking, but these are minor criticisms. The series is considered a worthwhile watch, especially for fans of space operas and character-driven stories.
pros: Strong character development, particularly of Jinto and Lafiel.
Exploration of the central relationship between the two main characters.
Ending song evokes strong emotions and enhances the viewing experience.
Intricate world-building with compelling politics and lore.
Engaging dialogue with good pacing and directing.
Well-developed opposing factions with compelling motives.
cons: Plot can be predictable.
Animation quality is not the best and has reuse of scenes.
Can be long-winded at some points.

anime.title: Seikai no Senki Special
anime.synopsis: A compilation of the Seikai no Senki Tokubetsuhens series with additional footage.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is considered a good recap of Seikai no Senki, potentially suitable for newcomers. Its pacing and structure are praised, creating a cohesive narrative. However, additional scenes are noted as not significantly impactful and the story remains identical to the original series.
pros: Good pacing
Scenes tie together well
Suitable as introduction to the series
cons: Extra scenes not impactful
Story developments are the same as the TV series

anime.title: Outlaw Star
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Space
anime.synopsis:
Gene Starwind has always dreamed of piloting his own ship out into the vast sea of stars. Unfortunately, not all dreams come true, as he spends his days working odd jobs alongside his partner, James Hawking, on the small planet Sentinel III instead. However, this all takes a turn when the duo takes on a job from Rachel Sweet who, unbeknownst to them, is actually a treasure-hunting outlaw. Tasked with protecting a mysterious girl known as Melfina, the meeting irrevocably changes the pair's lives as they are sent out into the great unknown aboard the highly advanced ship, Outlaw Star.
 
Seihou Bukyou Outlaw Star follows Gene and his ragtag crew as they brave the final frontier, navigating the stars in search of answers to the mysteries surrounding Melfina. Encountering dangerous bounty hunters, space pirates, Taoist mages, and even catgirls, there is sure to be an exhilarating adventure around every corner.
anime.consensus_summary: Outlaw Star is a generally well-regarded space adventure anime, praised for its creative world, fun characters, and enjoyable mix of action and humor. However, some viewers find the plot and character development lacking, especially towards the end of the series, and point to inconsistent art quality. Despite these flaws, the show remains a nostalgic favorite for many, particularly those who watched it during its original run.
pros: Creative and imaginative world-building with diverse planets and aliens
Enjoyable mix of action, adventure, and humor
Memorable and likable characters with good chemistry, particularly Gene and Jim
Good soundtrack that enhances the scenes
cons: Inconsistent art quality, especially in later episodes
Episodic plot with a weak overarching story and a rushed ending
Shallow character development for some characters
Filler episodes that don't contribute to the main plot

anime.title: Samurai X: Reflection
anime.romaji_title: Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan - Seisou-hen
anime.synopsis: Kaoru goes to the harbor every day to see if Kenshin has returned. After a while, she starts looking back at her life with Kenshin and all the things that have happened.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reaction is highly polarized, with many manga purists expressing strong disapproval due to deviations from the source material and a perceived betrayal of established character arcs. While some appreciate the animation and emotional depth, the overwhelming sentiment is one of disappointment and sadness. The ending is particularly divisive, with many feeling it does a disservice to the characters and the overall Rurouni Kenshin legacy.
pros: Stunning animation and remastered visuals enhance flashback scenes.
Orchestral score and sound design amplify emotional impact.
Original voice actors provide continuity and depth.
cons: Story deviates significantly from the manga, altering character personalities and motivations.
Excessive use of flashbacks disrupts narrative flow and pacing.
Depressing tone and ending alienate fans expecting a more hopeful resolution.
Character designs are considered unattractive

anime.title: Hanaukyou Maid-tai
anime.synopsis:
Having recently lost his mother, middle schooler Tarou Hanaukyou is now supposed to go live with his grandfather in Tokyo. When the boy arrives at his grandfather's supposed place of residence, however, he is met with a surprise—the house turns out to be a massive mansion tended to by hundreds of maids!

After a warm welcome, the head maid Mariel presents Tarou with a short video message from his grandfather, insisting that his grandson inherit his whole fortune. Though unsure about the situation, Tarou begins settling into his new life, in which the maids of the mansion will do anything for their young master.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the show entertaining due to its humor and lighthearted nature, while others criticize its generic plot, weak characters, and excessive fan service. Many find the show dated and lacking in depth, leading to a generally mediocre impression. There is a slight polarization with some viewers able to overlook the flaws for the comedic elements.
pros: Some found the humor genuinely funny and enjoyable.
Certain characters, like Taro and Mariel, were considered likeable and charming.
The series offered lighthearted entertainment and a departure from serious storylines for some viewers.
cons: Generic and unoriginal plot with overused tropes.
Weak character development and lack of depth.
Dated animation style and sound quality.
Excessive fan service and ecchi elements detract from the story.
Inconsistent storyline with a lack of resolution.
anime.thematic_vibe: Ecchi Comedy, Harem, Slice of Life

anime.title: Bastard!!
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Ecchi, Fantasy, Gore, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
The kingdom of Metallicana is under attack from the Four Lords of Havoc. This party of villains—ninja master Gara, deadly thunder empress Nei Arshes, cold and calculating Kall-Su, and enigmatic dark priest Abigail—will stop at nothing to get what they want, even if it leaves utter destruction in their wake.

High Priest Geo is desperate to help save the kingdom and its people. He unleashes the mighty wizard Dark Schneider, a man who used to be an ally of the villains. Unfortunately, Dark Schneider has his own plans in mind. Will he stop the Four Lords of Havoc or join them in their conquest of the world?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Bastard!! is highly polarized, largely hinging on an appreciation for its unashamedly over-the-top, 'so bad it's good' 90s aesthetic and a legendary English dub. While many find its parody of dark fantasy tropes and absurd humor incredibly entertaining, others are put off by its cliched plot, gratuitous ecchi content, and perceived lack of narrative depth.
pros: The English dub is frequently cited as a major strength, with specific praise for Daran Norris's voice acting as Dark Schneider, elevating the comedic timing and overall enjoyment.

The show's over-the-top nature, particularly its parody of fantasy tropes and blatant embrace of 90s aesthetics, is a significant draw for many, leading to it being described as 'so bad it's good' and highly entertaining.
Visuals and character designs are praised for their quality, especially for a 90s OVA, with detailed backgrounds and striking character designs that capture the dark fantasy aesthetic.
cons: The plot is often described as cliché, nonsensical, and lacking in depth or clear motivations, with a story that becomes predictable or 'snoozeworthy' in its latter half.
Inconsistencies in animation, particularly choppiness and noticeable shifts in artistic style between episodes, detract from the viewing experience.
The show's reliance on gratuitous nudity, ecchi humor, and explicit sexual themes is off-putting to some viewers and is seen as a significant detractor from any serious narrative merit.

anime.title: Blood: The Last Vampire
anime.genres: Award Winning, Gore, Horror, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Teropterids are evil beasts which pose as humans and live only to drink human blood. Fortunately for the human world there are groups dedicated to destroying them. A brooding and mysterious girl named Saya is the best teropterid slayer there is, and now, in 1960s Japan, she is sent to a U. S. army base which may be infested...
anime.consensus_summary: Viewers are impressed by the groundbreaking animation and action, but disappointed by the thin plot and lack of character development. Many feel the film is more of a visually appealing tech demo or prologue than a complete story. The short runtime and open ending leave some viewers unsatisfied, while others appreciate its straightforwardness.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style.
Fast-paced and fluid action sequences.
Innovative use of English and Japanese voice acting.
cons: Underdeveloped characters and plot.
Short runtime leaves many questions unanswered.
Lacking in emotional depth and substance.

anime.title: Buzzer Beater
anime.synopsis: Hideyoshi is a homeless boy living in New York in the near future, who survives by hustling other kids in basketball games. But now he's been drafted into a pro team-a pro team with a very unique goal. There once was a time when humans dominated the game of basketball. But times have changed, and now the physically superior alien players have taken over the game, and there are barely any human players left. But Hideyoshi's team-the first all-human team to compete in the Space League-intends to change all that, and bring the championship back home to Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the unique blend of sci-fi and sports, while others find the execution lacking. Common criticisms include rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent animation. Ultimately, it's seen as an entertaining but flawed anime, not reaching its full potential.
pros: Unique premise of intergalactic basketball.
Relatable characters despite alien opponents.
Distinct visual style with contrasting hues.
cons: Rushed story with skipped events.
Underdeveloped supporting characters.
Mediocre animation quality with inconsistent use of CG.
Matches lack excitement and have frustrating skips.

anime.title: Detective School Q
anime.synopsis: Kyuu is your average boy with a knack for logic and reasoning. Desiring to become a detective, he finds out about the existence of the Dan Detective School (DDS); a famed school where students are allowed to bear arms. Together with Megu, a girl with photographic memory, the martial arts master Kinta, the genius programmer Kazuma and the mysterious Ryuu, Kyuu tackles many well planned out crimes, always seeking the truth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Fans of the mystery genre appreciate the intriguing cases and focus on deduction. However, many find the character development lacking, the ending unsatisfying, and the animation unremarkable, leading to a somewhat lukewarm reception overall.
pros: Intriguing mysteries and well-thought-out cases
Enjoyable for mystery and detective genre fans
Satisfying voice acting and background music
cons: Weak character development and generic characters
Unsatisfying and unresolved ending
Predictable plot elements and cliches
Animation quality is plain and sometimes disfigured
Some cases are unrealistic or too predictable

anime.title: Final Fantasy VII: Last Order
anime.synopsis:
With reports of monsters terrorizing the reactor at Mount Nibel, the Shinra Electric Power Company dispatches their elite fighting force SOLDIER to investigate. Accompanied by fellow SOLDIER First Class Zack Fair and a small contingent of company guards, the war hero Sephiroth is to assess the condition of the Mako reactor at the behest of the company. In Nibelheim, the village that the reactor powers, Sephiroth discovers the source of the monsters and the origins of Shinra's legendary Jenova Project.

Running through the woods months later, Zack is no longer the hero he once dreamt of becoming. He flees from the General Affairs Department of the Shinra Electric Power Company, better known as the Turks, who desperately seek to bury the evidence living within the two.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is split, primarily based on familiarity with the original game. Fans of Final Fantasy VII appreciate the visual expansion of backstory and action sequences, but many find the short runtime and repetitive story elements disappointing. Detractors feel it's a "nostalgia-bait" cash grab that doesn't add substantial new content.
pros: Stunning animation and character designs that faithfully recreate the Final Fantasy VII world.
The voice acting is generally well-received, with specific praise for Sephiroth's voice actor.
Provides a satisfying visual representation of key backstory events for fans of the game.
Features excellent action sequences, particularly the fight between Zack and Sephiroth.
cons: The story is largely a recap of events already known to fans of the game, offering little new insight.
The short runtime (under 30 minutes) leaves many feeling unsatisfied and wanting more depth.
Transitions between story segments can be abrupt and disorienting.
The music, while decent, is often criticized for not using original game tracks and lacking emotional impact.

anime.title: Gun x Sword
anime.synopsis: Van, a lanky and apathetic swordsman, is on a journey to kill the murderer of his fiancé. The only characteristic he has to go by is that the murderer has a claw for an arm, hence the murderer being referred to as The Claw Man. During his travels, Van happens to pass through the city of Evergreen, which is defending itself from bandits who aim to rob the city of its treasury. It is in this city that Van meets Wendy Garret, a timid young girl who is looking for her kidnapped brother. When the city pleads for Van's assistance to defend it, he refuses, claiming it has nothing to do with him and thus leaves the city on its own to deal with the peril. Soon after, Van comes across the raiding bandits himself and they eventually tick off the swordsman to a degree where he takes action against them for his own personal vendetta. Surprisingly, Van learns that the bandits had ties with The Claw Man, and in kidnapping Wendy's brother for a reason they did not disclose. After the bandits are dealt with easily, Van and, much to his chagrin, Wendy continue the journey in search of The Claw Man. Little do they know, however, that The Claw Man is involved with something more atrocious than either could fathom.
anime.consensus_summary: Gun x Sword receives mixed reviews, with some viewers appreciating its unique blend of genres, action sequences, and well-developed supporting characters. However, others find the plot and main characters generic, with inconsistent pacing and underdeveloped elements. Despite its flaws, many find it to be an enjoyable anime that successfully combines Western, sci-fi, and mecha elements.
pros: Unique blend of Western, sci-fi, and mecha genres
Strong action sequences and creative fight choreography
Well-developed supporting characters that enhance the story
Music is good, especially the opening and ending themes
Ending leaves viewers with a sense of satisfaction and mystery
cons: Generic plot and characters
Inconsistent pacing
Some characters are underdeveloped or annoying
The story can be predictable and unoriginal
Relies too heavily on tropes from other anime

anime.title: Mars of Destruction
anime.synopsis:
Several months after a probe returning from Mars burns up during reentry, strange creatures dubbed "Ancients" begin to appear throughout Tokyo. Aggressive and dangerous, they cannot be killed with ordinary weapons. As scientists struggle to find the cause of their sudden appearance, the monsters wreak havoc across the world.

Humanity finds hope in the form of the MARS suit—a new weapon developed to take down these enemies. The suit, however, can only be worn by those with specific DNA. Enter Takeru Hinata, an ordinary teen with a troubled past and one of the few capable of piloting the only weapon against the Ancients. With the help of the AAST, a special police force established to defeat the dangerous creatures, the young man battles against demons both personal and global whilst trying to discover the true nature of Earth's new aggressors.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Hametsu no Mars is overwhelmingly negative, with nearly universal agreement that it is a 'terrible' or 'worst anime ever.' However, a significant portion of viewers find its extreme incompetence to be hilariously entertaining, creating a polarized divide between those who see it as an abject failure and those who consider its badness to be its greatest asset. This dichotomy positions it as a legendary 'so bad it's good' experience.
pros: The explicit gore and massacres are highlighted as a visual positive by some.
The show's sheer incompetence leads to unintentional comedy, which some viewers found highly entertaining.
The plot twist regarding Earthlings and Martians is noted as surprising, albeit poorly executed.
The potential for a deeper philosophical message or parody is recognized by some viewers.
cons: Animation and art quality are consistently panned as stiff, uninspired, bland, and amateurish, even for its time.
Character designs are described as identical, lacking distinctiveness, and uninspired.
Plot is universally criticized as nonsensical, nonexistent, disjointed, full of unanswered questions, and illogical.
Voice acting is frequently described as horrible, monotonous, subpar, and uninspired.
Sound design and music usage are heavily criticized for being out of place, poorly integrated, and amateurish.
Character development is non-existent, with characters being bland, lacking personality, and having low intelligence.
The use of shaky camera effects and character vibration during movement is seen as a production flaw.

anime.title: My Neighbors the Yamadas
anime.synopsis: From squabbles about groceries against the ambient noise of the TV to their daily shenanigans, the Yamada family invites only a few unusual gazes—similar to any typical household. But despite their prickly exteriors, each of them genuinely cares for one another, making sure to smile and laugh through their otherwise dull and mundane lives. Tonari no Yamada-kun is an intimate and fun look into the lives of a typical Japanese family.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to "Tonari no Yamada-kun" is notably divided, largely due to its unconventional, episodic structure and unique art style. While many praise its relatable humor, heartwarming portrayal of family life, and distinctive visual aesthetic, a significant portion finds these same elements to be a detriment, leading to feelings of boredom or detachment due to the lack of a cohesive narrative.
pros: Unique and charming watercolor/comic strip art style that complements the slice-of-life nature.
Relatable and humorous depiction of everyday family situations that resonates with viewers.
Strong voice acting, particularly in the English dub, enhances character interactions and comedic timing.
Funny and heartwarming portrayal of family bonds and the importance of togetherness.
cons: Lack of a strong, overarching plot can make the film feel disjointed or boring to some.
The episodic, skit-based structure may not appeal to viewers seeking a traditional narrative.
Art style is divisive, with some finding it unappealing or amateurish.
Cultural references and poetic quotes can be confusing or inaccessible to a non-Japanese audience.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Comedy, Family Drama

anime.title: Porco Rosso
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Award Winning, Comedy, Drama, Historical, Military, Romance
anime.synopsis:
After a curse turned him into a pig, World War I ace Marco Pagot becomes Porco Rosso, a mysterious bounty hunter who takes down sky pirates in the Adriatic Sea. He whiles away his days on a secluded island, rarely leaving other than to collect bounties or to visit the beautiful Gina, a songstress and owner of the Hotel Adriano.

One day, while traveling to fix his faulty engine, Porco Rosso is gunned down by a young American hotshot named Donald Curtis. Thrilled at the possibility of fame, Donald boldly declares that the flying pig is dead. Not wanting to disappoint Gina, Porco Rosso flees to the famous Piccolo S.P.A. airplane company and takes out a massive loan in order to repair and improve his fighter plane. There, he is surprised to find that the chief engineer of Piccolo S.P.A. is the 17-year-old Fio Piccolo, who hungers for a chance to prove herself. With Fio's improvements, Porco Rosso prepares to challenge Donald officially and regain his honor.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences largely appreciate Porco Rosso for its unique charm, masterful direction, and iconic protagonist. While some find the plot to be too simple or the ending abrupt, the film is widely praised for its artistic beauty, compelling characters, and Joe Hisaishi's score. It's seen as a beloved, if slightly unconventional, entry in Miyazaki's filmography.
pros: Exceptional direction and artistic vision, particularly in its depiction of flight sequences and European settings.
Strong and witty dialogue that enhances the comedic elements.
Well-developed and charismatic main character (Porco Rosso) who is a blend of classic cinematic archetypes.
Joe Hisaishi's masterful musical score that perfectly complements the film's mood and scenes.
Unique blend of light-hearted comedy and subtle, deeper dramatic themes.
High-quality animation with vibrant colors and meticulous attention to detail, characteristic of Studio Ghibli.
cons: Minimalistic and simplistic storyline that may disappoint viewers seeking complex plots.
Abrupt or too subtle ending that leaves some viewers wanting more.
Some critics found the art style, particularly character designs and background elements, to be less inspired or dated.
The film's pacing, while often relaxed and atmospheric, can be seen as meandering by some.
Lack of explicit explanations for certain plot points, such as Porco's transformation.

anime.title: Ragnarok the Animation
anime.synopsis:
A great evil is sweeping over the realm; an evil that the young swordsman Roan and his life-long companion, the acolyte Yufa, must face head on! For these two travel toward their destiny, from the highest towers to the depths of the underworld, through forest and desert alike. With an ever-growing cast of fellow heroes, fate will grasp these travelers by their very souls and propel the band of skilled adventurers towards a noble end. Or ignoble, if they don't watch their step!

Monsters are afoot and the way rife with danger and magic, the path forward may be unclear... But where will is strong, there is a way! Lessons wait in the depths of darkness, and good must prevail. The journey starts now!
anime.consensus_summary: Ragnarök The Animation receives mixed reviews, with strong opinions on both ends.  Fans of the Ragnarok Online game tend to be more critical, often disappointed by the generic storyline and character deviations. Others, unfamiliar with the game, find some enjoyment in the fantasy elements but still acknowledge the weak plot and character development. Ultimately, the series is considered a mediocre adaptation with missed potential.
pros: Some enjoy seeing familiar locations, monsters, and skills from the game animated.
The art is decent and character designs stick to the original game.
Some supporting characters like Maya and Takius are well-written and interesting.
cons: The story is generic, clichéd, and predictable with a weak plot and uninspired writing.
Main characters are annoying, bland, and underdeveloped with exaggerated behavior.
The anime deviates from the original game's story and contains numerous plot holes.
There is overuse of recycled scenes, flashbacks, and skill animations due to budget constraints.

anime.title: Samurai Deeper Kyo
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Historical, Samurai, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
In the year 1600, at the fog-covered battlefield of Sekigahara, a fierce battle was waged by two exemplary swordsmen. One was Kyoushirou Mibu, a skilled and noble warrior in possession of the unique powers of the Mibu Clan. The other was the thousand-man slayer, with eyes and hair the color of blood, "Demon Eyes" Kyou. Their legendary clash was cut short when a meteor from the heavens fell down upon that battlefield, leaving both to vanish in its wake.

Samurai Deeper Kyou begins four years after that battle, when a gun-wielding bounty hunter by the name of Yuya Shiina hunts down Kyoushirou—now a perverted, traveling medicine-man who has built up a large debt. On her way to claim his bounty, they are attacked by an inhuman monster that seeks to devour Kyoushirou. This encounter awakens "Demon Eyes" Kyou, whose mind has been trapped inside of Kyoushirou's body ever since that fateful battle. Thus begins a grand tale of legendary two swordsmen and the discovery of their secrets.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers enjoyed the unique historical take, cool characters, and soundtrack, while others found the story convoluted, repetitive, and ultimately disappointing. The anime's quality declines in the latter half, with animation and character development issues contributing to a mediocre experience for many.
pros: Unique take on Edo history with twists.
Cool protagonist and badass-looking characters.
Good character development.
Impressive artwork and animation (initially).
Excellent soundtrack with memorable guitar riffs.
Fluid alliances and good/evil dynamics.
Story line characters and plot
cons: Story is a mixed mash of things that doesn't sit well.
Repetitive and boring fights.
Villains are defeated then more pop up.
Animation quality declines, becoming limited and quaint.
Story becomes repetitive, frustrating, and filled with exposition.
Bland characters with little development.
Inconsistent protagonist personality.
Poorly ensembled supporting characters outfought.
The story and fights could of been better.

anime.title: Stratos 4
anime.synopsis:
In the early 21st century, Earth has come under threat from giant comets. In response, the United Nations institutes the Cosmic Emergency Management Agency (CEMA) and establishes a two-part defense program. Taking off from orbital stations, spacecraft launch specialized missiles to intercept and break up the threatening celestial objects, while fighter jets back on Earth deal with the remaining fragments. Competition among the pilots is fierce, as everyone wants to be one of the highly regarded Comet Blasters in space instead of the Meteor Sweepers on airbases.

Although from an esteemed lineage of pilots, recruit Mikaze Honjou finds the path to become a Comet Blaster arduous, which only results in her neglecting her studies. However, after a successful mission with her friends—Karin Kikuhara, Shizuha Doi, and Ayamo Nakamura—Mikaze rediscovers her motivation and sets out to make it through the training with the others.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the technical details and retro designs, along with the conspiracy subplot. Others find the pacing slow, the fan service unnecessary, and the plot shallow. There's also disappointment from viewers who expected yuri elements.
pros: Attention to technical details is top-notch; aircraft and spacecraft are retrofitted cold-war era designs, mirroring a realistic scenario.
Good art direction and animation.
The government conspiracy plot adds complication to the main story.
cons: Pacing is slow, and episodes feel like they go nowhere.
Unnecessary fan service with panty shots.
The plot is not deep or hard to understand; it's more for fun.

anime.title: Araiso Private High School Student Council Executive Committee
anime.synopsis: Kubota Makoto and Tokitoh Minoru (characters from Kazuya Minekura's manga Wild Adaptor—though no reference is made to the darker storyline of WA in this light-hearted anime)—are the muscle of their high school's all-powerful student council. They defend the student body from disorder—generated by both humans and demons—while avoiding their classes.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the lighthearted and fun nature of 'Shiritsu Araiso Koutougakkou Seitokai Shikkoubu,' particularly its take on the relationship between the two main characters. Some viewers find the sexual innuendos a bit much, but overall, it's positively received, especially by fans of Kazuya Minekura and the shonen ai genre. The OVA format works well in delivering self-contained, entertaining stories.
pros: Fun and enjoyable stories
Easy-to-know characters
Interesting supporting characters
cons: OVA's tend to bring on a bit of skepticism as they are short and too the point
Stories rely on sexual innuendo

anime.title: Kaleido Star
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Performing Arts, Showbiz, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
The Kaleido Stage is known throughout the world for captivating audiences with its amazing acrobatics, innovative routines, and extravagant costumes and sets. It is a place for guests to believe in magic, and Sora Naegino wants nothing more than to be a part of that magic—by becoming an acrobat for the famed circus herself.

To realize her dream, she travels from Japan to California to audition for a place in the group. However, Sora learns that she needs much more than her natural talent to bring joy to the faces in the crowd. She quickly discovers just how difficult it is to be a professional performer where the stakes—and the stunts—are higher and mistakes spell danger! To put on performances worthy of the Kaleido Stage, she will need to endure rigorous training, unconventional assignments, fierce competition, and the antics of a mischievous spirit named Fool.

Can Sora reach new heights, make new friends, conquer her fears, and surpass her limits to become a Kaleido Star?
anime.consensus_summary: Kaleido Star is overwhelmingly praised for its inspirational story, strong characters, and dazzling stage performances. While some find the plot inconsistent and the challenges Sora faces excessive, especially in the second season, the series is generally considered a heartwarming and enjoyable experience. Many viewers felt motivated and emotionally moved by Sora's journey to achieve her dreams.
pros: Strong character development and likeable characters.
Visually dazzling stage performances with fluid animation and creative direction.
Uplifting story about pursuing dreams with hard work and perseverance.
Music enhances the magical feel and emotional impact.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality outside of stage performances.
Repetitive music.
Plot inconsistencies, especially in the second season.
Sora faces too many challenges, especially in season 2 which may be seen as excessive or contrived.

anime.title: Kaleido Star: New Wings Extra Stage
anime.romaji_title: Kaleido Star: Aratanaru Tsubasa - Extra Stage
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Performing Arts, Showbiz, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Sora Naegino has finally consolidated herself as Kaleido Stage's greatest star ever, and a new star starts to shine as Rosetta Passel is selected to participate in the next attraction in a main role. But when things start to go wrong in the rehearsals, Rosetta starts to question her abillity to take the role, as her own capacity to remain in Kaleido Stage. Meanwhile, Fool also struggles with his demons from the past.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience expresses significant disappointment with the OVA, finding it inferior to the original series. Common complaints include the sexualization of characters, weak plot, and poor character development. While some appreciate the visual and musical aspects, these elements are not enough to redeem the OVA's shortcomings, leading to a generally negative reception.
pros: Dynamic color palette
Stellar backgrounds
Enjoyable music, particularly the opening theme
cons: Sexualization of female characters
Characters acting out of character
Poor character development and utilization of established characters
Weak and underdeveloped storyline, especially regarding the Fool's backstory
Cop-out ending with deus ex machina elements
Inferior in comparison to original series

anime.title: Kaleido Star: Legend of Phoenix - The Layla Hamilton Story
anime.romaji_title: Kaleido Star: Legend of Phoenix - Layla Hamilton Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Layla is going to perform Phoenix in Broadway. Playing this important role, she sets out on a journey by bicycle alone without leaving any message in order to find out what she's missing inside.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers find the OVA a beautiful and emotionally resonant exploration of Layla's character and her relationship with Sora. Others are disappointed by Sora's excessive involvement, Layla's perceived inconsistent character development, and the reliance on shoujo tropes. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on one's tolerance for shoujo storytelling and preference for Sora.
pros: Beautiful animation and color palette, improved over the original series.
Moving exploration of Layla's character and her relationship with Sora.
Cathartic and uplifting experience with poignant and innocent simplicity.
cons: Sora's prominence overshadows Layla, despite Layla being the focus.
Layla's character development feels inconsistent and nonsensical.
Plot relies on shoujo tropes and lacks depth; Contrived philosophical self-discovery journey.

anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Movie - Conqueror of Shamballa
anime.romaji_title: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Conqueror of Shamballa
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Award Winning, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
In desperation, Edward Elric sacrificed his body and soul to rescue his brother Alphonse, and is now displaced in the heart of Munich, Germany. He struggles to adapt to a world completely foreign to him in the wake of the economic crisis that followed the end of World War I. Isolated and unable to return home with his alchemy skills, Edward continues to research other methods of escaping the prison alongside colleagues who bear striking resemblances to many of the people he left behind. As dissent brews among the German citizenry, its neighbors also feel the unrest of the humiliated nation.

Meanwhile, Alphonse continues to investigate Edward's disappearance, delving into the science of alchemy in the hopes of finally reuniting with his older brother.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the film's attempt to provide closure to the original series with its strong visuals and voice acting. However, many are disappointed by plot inconsistencies, underdeveloped characters, and a departure from the series' core themes, resulting in a divisive conclusion.
pros: Provides closure to the original series
Visually appealing with detailed animation and backgrounds
Strong voice acting and music, consistent with the series
Explores mature themes and character development
cons: Plot inconsistencies and contrivances
Underdeveloped new characters
Forced or unsatisfying ending for some viewers
Strays from the alchemy focus of the original series
Some characters act out of character
Unresolved plot points

anime.title: Howl's Moving Castle
anime.genres: Adventure, Award Winning, Drama, Fantasy, Romance
anime.synopsis:
That jumbled piece of architecture, that cacophony of hissing steam and creaking joints, with smoke billowing from it as it moves on its own... That castle is home to the magnificent wizard Howl, infamous for both his magical prowess and for being a womanizer—or so the rumor goes in Sophie Hatter's small town. Sophie, as the plain daughter of a hatmaker, does not expect much from her future and is content with working hard in the shop. 

However, Sophie's simple life takes a turn for the exciting when she is ensnared in a disturbing situation, and the mysterious wizard appears to rescue her. Unfortunately, this encounter, brief as it may be, spurs the vain and vengeful Witch of the Waste—in a fit of jealousy caused by a past discord with Howl—to put a curse on the maiden, turning her into an old woman.

In an endeavor to return to normal, Sophie must accompany Howl and a myriad of eccentric companions—ranging from a powerful fire demon to a hopping scarecrow—in his living castle, on a dangerous adventure as a raging war tears their kingdom apart.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Howl's Moving Castle. While praised for its stunning visuals, animation, and music, many find the plot convoluted and underdeveloped, leading to a disappointing viewing experience. Some appreciate the characters and thematic elements, while others criticize their inconsistency and lack of depth. Ultimately, the film's narrative shortcomings overshadow its artistic strengths for a significant portion of viewers.
pros: Stunning animation and visual artistry, typical of Studio Ghibli and Miyazaki's work.
Beautiful and memorable musical score by Joe Hisaishi.
Charming and lovable characters, with distinct personalities, that appeal to a wide audience.
cons: Incoherent and convoluted plot with numerous unexplained elements and plot holes.
Rushed and unsatisfying ending that lacks proper resolution and explanations.
Weak character development and inconsistent motivations, making it difficult to connect with the characters.

anime.title: The Place Promised in Our Early Days
anime.romaji_title: Kumo no Mukou, Yakusoku no Basho
anime.genres: Award Winning, Drama, Military, Romance, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Hiroki Fujisawa and Takuya Shirakawa harbor admiration for two things in their life: their classmate Sayuri Sawatari and the vast Ezo Tower that stands boundlessly across the Tsugaru Strait. Fascinated by the limitless structure beyond their reach, Hiroki and Takuya begin constructing an aeroplane from a fallen drone they discovered—naming it the Bella Ciela—to fulfill their dream of one day reaching the sky-scraping top of the tower. Later joined by the girl they love, Hiroki and Takuya promise Sayuri to fly with her to the seemingly otherworldly top together. However, Japan has suffered a North-South partitioning that has fueled conflict near the base of the tower, which marks the border between the America-controlled Southern islands and the Northern lands occupied by the Soviet Union.

Further along, Sayuri suddenly disappears, and Hiroki and Takuya never see her again. Unbeknownst to them, she fell victim to a sleeping disorder that left her comatose for the past three years. Although Hiroki and Takuya later learn about Sayuri's condition, they also discover that the girl's unconscious state is oddly linked to the same tower the trio had promised to conquer together.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Kumo no Mukou, Yakusoku no Basho' are mixed. While the film is praised for its stunning visuals and evocative music, many find the plot confusing, the characters underdeveloped, and the pacing slow.  The film's emotional impact varies, with some viewers connecting deeply with the themes of friendship and love, while others find the storytelling superficial.
pros: Stunning visuals and backgrounds with great attention to detail, lighting, and color palettes.
Beautiful and emotionally resonant music score that enhances the mood.
Exploration of themes like long-distance relationships, friendship, and the impact of time.
Strong artistic direction that creates a unique and memorable viewing experience.
cons: Slow pacing that can lead to boredom and a lack of engagement.
Underdeveloped characters with superficial relationships and unclear motivations.
Poorly explained plot with confusing sci-fi elements and a lack of focus.
Over-reliance on internal monologue and expository dialogue.
Pacing issues, moving too fast and too slow at the same time.

anime.title: Magic Knight Rayearth
anime.synopsis:
Hikaru Shidou, Umi Ryuuzaki, and Fuu Hououji are strangers brought together by fate when they meet during a seemingly normal field trip to Tokyo Tower. Accompanied by a great flash of light, they hear a mysterious woman's plea to save "Cephiro," and the junior high heroines are suddenly swept away by a giant flying fish. Afterwards, they arrive in an unknown land, where they encounter a man called Master Mage Clef.

Clef informs the girls that they were summoned by Princess Emeraude to fulfill their destinies as Magic Knights, restoring peace and balance in Cephiro. The formerly lively and peaceful land has been in disarray ever since High Priest Zagato imprisoned the princess, who acted as Cephiro's pillar of stability. The Magic Knights reluctantly accept Clef's words as truth and embark on a journey to save Cephiro from the clutches of evil.
anime.consensus_summary: Magic Knight Rayearth is a beloved classic magical girl isekai with a strong emphasis on friendship and courage that is still enjoyed by many. While praised for its nostalgic charm, art style, and memorable characters, some find the plot simple, predictable, and with some frustrating animation limitations. The ending also tends to divide the audience, making the ending score tilt toward 5/10.
pros: Nostalgic and charming with classic CLAMP art style.
Strong focus on friendship, courage, and believing in oneself.
Memorable characters with relatable struggles and friendships.
Good balance of action, adventure, comedy and drama.
Excellent music and opening theme that enhances the series.
cons: Simple and predictable story with plot holes.
Repetitive fight scenes and recycled animation sequences.
Inconsistent pacing with filler episodes.
Underdeveloped side characters.
Animation shows its age.
Ending divisive with frustrating character choices.

anime.title: Perfect Blue
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Avant Garde, Award Winning, Drama, Horror, Psychological, Showbiz, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
J-pop idol group CHAM! has spent the last two years entertaining its fans. Sadly, all good things must come to an end, and CHAM! must see one of its members, Mima Kirigoe, leave the group to pursue her acting career. While Mima's choice is met with a mixed response, she hopes her fans will continue to support her.

However, Mima's life begins to change drastically after her departure from the group. Wanting to shed her pop-idol image, she takes on a role in a crime drama series, and her career as an actress gradually becomes more demanding and taxing for both Mima and her manager, Rumi Hidaka. To add to Mima's growing unease, an obsessed fan who is incapable of accepting that Mima has quit being an innocent idol, begins stalking her; a new anonymous website begins to impersonate her life with intricate detail; and CHAM! also appears to be doing better without her. One by one, each disturbing development drives Mima to become increasingly unhinged and unable to distinguish reality from fantasy.
anime.consensus_summary: Perfect Blue is widely acclaimed as a masterpiece of psychological thrillers, lauded for its masterful direction, intricate plot, and profound thematic exploration. However, its deliberate ambiguity and mature content are points of contention, leading to some viewers finding it confusing or overwhelming, while others appreciate its challenging nature.
pros: Masterful blurring of reality and fantasy, creating intense suspense and psychological depth.
Exceptional character development, particularly Mima's descent into paranoia and confusion.
Brilliant direction and cinematography, with seamless editing and effective camera work.
Thought-provoking exploration of themes like identity, fame, the entertainment industry, and mental illness.
Compelling and intricate plot with significant plot twists that keep the viewer engaged.
cons: Can be confusing and difficult to follow, especially on the first viewing, with some ambiguity potentially frustrating viewers.
The pacing can be slow at times due to extensive 'dementia moments' that some find unnecessary.
Some critics found the use of red herrings to be gimmicky and confusing rather than additive.
The film contains mature and disturbing content (rape, violence, nudity) making it unsuitable for younger or squeamish audiences.

anime.title: Phantom: The Animation
anime.synopsis: Zwei was an ordinary person, until one day, while walking the streets a night, he witnessed a brutal assassination. He managed to avoid the sniper, a young girl named Ein, but was soon captured, and had the memories of his former life erased. He is spared death only by accepting a condition: to train to become an assassin alongside Ein. Now, he must find a way to free himself from this shady world and reclaim his life once again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed regarding "Phantom: The Animation." Some appreciate the action, music, and characters, considering it a decent short OVA. However, others criticize its poor adaptation, weak plot, and inconsistent art. The series is seen as a condensed version of the source material, leaving some viewers wanting more depth and development.
pros: Good action scenes, especially for its time (2004).
Memorable characters, particularly Ein and Zwei.
Great music, including the opening and ending themes.
Story is well delivered despite being short.
cons: Poor adaptation of the Visual Novel, with many scenes changed or removed.
Weak plot and lack of character development.
Ugly art and inconsistent character designs.
Confusing story with underdeveloped motivations.

anime.title: Revolutionary Girl Utena
anime.genres: Award Winning, Drama, Mahou Shoujo, Psychological, School
anime.synopsis:
Years ago, a tragic incident befell a young princess when both her parents died. Devastated, it seemed nothing would calm this poor soul. However, a prince traveling through the area came to see the princess, hoping to cheer her up. After wiping her sorrowful tears, the prince gave her a ring carrying a rose emblem and told her as long as she holds onto the ring, they are destined to meet again. The event leaves a deep impression on the girl, Utena Tenjou, leading her to become a prince herself. 

Years later, Utena attends Ootori Academy, recognized by the same rose emblem as her precious ring's. There, attracted by the scent of roses, she witnesses Anthy Himemiya tending the flowers, accompanied by the Student Council President Touga Kiryuu and Vice President Kyouichi Saionji, who seem to be arguing over Anthy. While Utena thinks nothing of the occurrence, the Student Council gathers to discuss an important matter. 

Subsequently, a misunderstanding leads to Utena being dragged into the world of Duelists—those with rings similar to her own. The Duelists fight for the ownership of the Rose Bride, Anthy Himemiya, who is said to possess great power. Wanting to prove her capabilities as a prince, and enraged that Anthy is being wronged and objectified, Utena resolves to fight against the Duelists to save her from the cruel fate.
anime.consensus_summary: Revolutionary Girl Utena is a highly influential and thought-provoking anime praised for its complex characters, rich symbolism, and unique soundtrack. However, some viewers find it repetitive, slow-paced, and overly abstract. The series explores mature themes and challenges gender norms, but its unconventional storytelling may not appeal to all audiences. Despite its flaws, many consider Utena a masterpiece of the shoujo genre.
pros: Complex characters with depth and development
Symbolism and metaphors add layers of meaning
Unique and well-orchestrated soundtrack
Exploration of taboo subjects in a subtle and tasteful manner
Visually stunning art and animation
Intriguing and thought-provoking plot
cons: Repetitive scenes and stock footage
Pacing issues, especially in early episodes and side character arcs
Overly abstract and surreal elements may be difficult to grasp
Formulaic "Duelist of the Week" structure
Some characters may be considered bland or unlikable

anime.title: Naruto the Movie 1: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow
anime.romaji_title: Naruto Movie 1: Dai Katsugeki!! Yuki Hime Ninpouchou Dattebayo!
anime.synopsis:
Naruto Uzumaki and his squadmates, Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno, are sent on a mission to escort a movie crew on its way to film in the Land of Snow. They soon find out that they are accompanying a famous actress, Yukie Fujikaze, who persistently refuses to travel there, making the trip far more difficult than originally intended. After a surprising encounter with ninjas from the Land of Snow, Naruto discovers that there is more to Yukie than meets the eye.
 
Dai Katsugeki!! Yuki Hime Ninpouchou Dattebayo! follows the group as they attempt to overcome the obstacles in the Land of Snow and unveil Yukie's true purpose there as well.
anime.consensus_summary: The first Naruto movie is considered a decent, but not exceptional, addition to the franchise. While it offers well-animated action sequences and some world-building, it suffers from a predictable plot and uninspired characters. Fans of Naruto may find it enjoyable, but it's unlikely to win over those unfamiliar with the series.
pros: Well-animated fight scenes, especially for its time
Enjoyable for fans of the Naruto series
Decent world-building with the Land of Snow concept
cons: Predictable and uninspired plot
Underdeveloped or unlikable new characters
Inconsistencies with the established Naruto world (modern technology)
Generic soundtrack
Poor utilization of Sasuke and Sakura.

anime.title: Please Teacher!: Secret Couple
anime.synopsis: Kei and Mizuho are having some marital difficulties, and Mizuho's family decides it's high time for a visit.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is largely seen as a fanservice episode that deviates from the original series' tone and themes. Many viewers found the plot redundant and the characters underdeveloped, ultimately considering it a low point compared to the main series. However, a minority appreciated it as a change of pace or a source of closure, while others found that it gave them a greater appreciation for the original series.
pros: Closure for the series (for some)
More expressions and 'lols' moments compared to the series
Appreciation for the original series (in retrospect)
cons: Redundant plot
Juvenile dialogue
Unnecessary fanservice
Lacking story
Poor character development
Doesn't feel like the original series

anime.title: Maria Watches Over Us: Printemps
anime.synopsis:
The spring term is beginning for the students at Lillian Girls' Academy. Friends are reunited, but for the Yamayuri Council, it's a bittersweet time. Yoko, Eriko, and Sei are busy preparing to depart Lillian while Sachiko, Rei, and Shimako are doing their best to ensure that their dear sisters receive a memorable commencement.

Sei's departure will leave a sizable hole in the White Roses, and filling it won't be easy. But is there anyone who could appeal to Shimako enough to become the next Rosa Gigantea en bouton?
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Maria-sama ga Miteru is generally well-received as a continuation of the first, with a stronger focus on character development and emotional depth.
