Visually appealing art style contributes to the show's charm and lightheartedness.
Engaging storyline with unexpected twists keeps viewers entertained.
cons: Slow initial pacing may deter some viewers.
Kings and Queens being easily manipulated is frustrating.
Some plot elements may be considered childish or simplistic.

anime.title: Hamtaro
anime.synopsis:
He's small, fluffy, and absolutely adorable: Hamtarou is one perfect little hamster! After moving to a new house with his owner, 5th grader Hiroko Haruna, Hamtarou discovers other hamsters and quickly makes friends.

The group of hamster explorers call themselves the Ham-Hams, and there's nowhere they won't go. The Ham-Hams go on crazy adventures all around the city while their owners are away, visiting everything from plays to magical lands of candy. Meanwhile, the humans face their own dramas..

Hamtarou meets a huge cast of different personalities, gets himself into—and out of—some pretty tight spots, and even helps Hiroko and her friends out more than once. Through it all, he never stops being unbearably cute. It's Hamtarou time!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, driven by nostalgia and the show's ability to evoke childhood joy. Reviewers praise the themes of friendship and adventure, along with the uplifting soundtrack. The main criticisms center around the episodic nature of the plot and the simplicity of the animation style, but these are generally forgiven due to the show's target audience.
pros: Brings out liveliness, kindness, adventure, and even childlike romance.
Uplifting soundtrack filled with positivity.
Great anime that doesn't take itself too seriously but can still trigger emotions when it needs to.
The story and character get a perfect ten.
cons: Lacks a main plot, relies on episodic themes and filler episodes.
Art and sound quality may not be perfect due to the target audience.

anime.title: I My Me! Strawberry Eggs
anime.synopsis: Amawa Hibiki is a young man just out of college, with an education to be an athletics teacher. He's been having a hard time finding a job since he graduated, so all his money has gone towards living expenses. When his landlady demands his first payment to live in her living establishment upfront, he heads to the local middle school to get hired as a teacher. However, the principal refuses to hire him without hesitation. She will not hire men as teachers and makes it clear that she hates all men, saying they put no love into their passions and work. Amawa does not give up and with the help of his landlady, he crossdresses as a woman without a second thought, and gets hired, so he can earn money and also prove the principal wrong. Now, he has to keep his real gender a secret, and avoid strange situations, including the affections of his students (from both genders).
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the heartwarming story and exploration of gender and acceptance, while others criticize the dated art style, problematic premise, and uncomfortable teacher-student relationship.  The series evokes strong emotions, both positive and negative, and struggles to balance its comedic and dramatic elements effectively. Ultimately, enjoyment appears highly subjective and dependent on individual tolerance for the show's controversial themes.
pros: Heartwarming story with genuine laughs.
Explores themes of love, gender equality, and acceptance.
Some viewers found the characters and their development enjoyable.
Voice acting, particularly Yuki Masuda as Hibiki, is well-received by many.
Soundtrack considered fine
Well paced plot and direction
cons: The plot is far-fetched and relies on a problematic premise.
Many find the jokes stale and the comedy unsuccessful.
The art style is dated and considered mediocre or unpleasant.
The teacher-student relationship is viewed as creepy and inappropriate by many.
Inconsistent character development
Ending deemed rushed and unsatisfying.
Some found that is had primitive messages.

anime.title: Kakyusei 2
anime.romaji_title: Kakyuusei 2: Hitomi no Naka no Shoujo-tachi
anime.synopsis: Many people have fond memories of meeting a certain teenage boy in their younger years. However, their ages vary widely, and each remembers him as a teen. This story follows the intricate intertwining of their various stories and how this young man, who apparently lives outside of time, has affected each of them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding the anime poorly executed and confusing. Some appreciate the initial mystery and character designs, but are ultimately disappointed by the slow pace, repetitive content, and lack of resolution. Others enjoyed it, and consider it to be a hidden gem, thus creating a polarized audience.
pros: Appealing character designs
Intriguing initial hook
Suspenseful music
Humorously goofy characters
Series manages to be a little serious with an overarching plot
cons: Poor pacing with little happening
Repetitive scenes
Inconsistent art style and animation
Poor character development
Underdeveloped story with plot holes
Repetitive music

anime.title: Moeyo Ken TV
anime.synopsis: Set in an alternate version of the Meiji Era, a boy named Sakamoto Ryunosuke returns to Kyoto from Shanghai with his monster (youkai) Nekomaru. The law states that in order to live freely with humans, a youkai must be liscensed. The Kidou Shinsengumi Co. Ltd. is responsible for the capture of unliscensed youkais but must fight with the Tsubamegumi, who resents the new law. It turns out that Ryunosuke is the son of the owner of the Shinsengumis.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is considered an average, 'just fine' viewing experience. While some elements like the recurring villains and likeable characters are appreciated, the overall narrative and character development lack depth. The anime's failure to fully explore intriguing plot points, such as the war between Shinto and Buddhism, leaves viewers wanting more, but ultimately, the show is seen as a passable but unremarkable diversion.
pros: Likeable characters
Enjoyable stories in some episodes
Recurring villains are entertaining and have interesting backstory potential
cons: Characters are not particularly memorable
Stories are generally unexceptional
Unexplained plot elements and world-building details
Anime feels mediocre and forgettable

anime.title: Kiki's Delivery Service
anime.genres: Adventure, Award Winning, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Kiki, a 13-year-old witch-in-training, must spend a year living on her own in a distant town in order to become a full-fledged witch. Leaving her family and friends, Kiki undertakes this tradition when she flies out into the open world atop her broomstick with her black cat Jiji.

As she settles down in the coastal town of Koriko, Kiki struggles to adapt and ends up wandering the streets with no place to stay—until she encounters Osono, who offers Kiki boarding in exchange for making deliveries for her small bakery. Before long, Kiki decides to open her own courier service by broomstick, beginning her journey to independence. In attempting to find her place among the townsfolk, Kiki brings with her exciting new experiences and comes to understand the true meaning of responsibility.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences overwhelmingly praise Kiki's Delivery Service for its heartwarming charm, beautiful animation, and relatable coming-of-age narrative. While some find the plot too simple and the magical elements underdeveloped, the film is widely cherished as a comforting and uplifting experience that resonates deeply with viewers.
pros: Beautiful and detailed animation with a charming art style.
Joe Hisaishi's soundtrack is perfect, evoking nostalgia and complementing scenes effectively.
Kiki is a relatable and complex protagonist, showcasing realistic emotions and growth.
The film is heartwarming, charming, and offers a comforting and uplifting experience.
The narrative effectively explores themes of independence, self-discovery, and overcoming insecurities.
cons: The plot is too simple and lacks a strong narrative drive for some viewers.
The 'witch' elements feel underdeveloped and are secondary to the coming-of-age story.
Some find the pacing slow or uneventful, leading to a feeling of 'nothing really happens'.
The English dub made some edits and changed the music, which might detract from the original intent for some.
The film can feel somewhat dated in its animation style and overall execution compared to modern anime.

anime.title: Castle in the Sky
anime.synopsis:
In a world filled with planes and airships, Sheeta is a young girl who has been kidnapped by government agents who seek her mysterious crystal amulet. While trapped aboard an airship, she finds herself without hope—that is, until the ship is raided by pirates. Taking advantage of the ensuing confusion, Sheeta manages to flee from her captors. Upon her escape, she meets Pazu, a boy who dreams of reaching the fabled flying castle, Laputa. The two decide to embark on a journey together to discover this castle in the sky. However, they soon find the government agents back on their trail, as they too are trying to reach Laputa for their own greedy purposes.

Tenkuu no Shiro Laputa follows the soaring adventures of Sheeta and Pazu, all while they learn how dreams and dire circumstances can bring two people closer together.
anime.consensus_summary: Castle in the Sky is widely praised for its breathtaking animation, masterful score, and sense of adventure, evoking a strong sense of childhood wonder. While some find the plot and main characters to be somewhat simplistic or underdeveloped, the film's overall charm, visual splendor, and thematic depth secure its place as a beloved classic for many.
pros: Visually stunning animation with gorgeous artwork and breathtaking flight sequences that hold up even by today's standards.
Joe Hisaishi's enchanting and evocative musical score perfectly complements the film's atmosphere and emotional beats.
Engaging action sequences and a sense of wonder and mystery that captivate the audience.
Memorable and endearing characters, particularly Dola and Muska, who command their scenes with charisma.
Themes of environmentalism and the consequences of unchecked technological advancement are subtly woven into the narrative.
Captures a childlike sense of wonder and escapism, making it enjoyable for all ages.
cons: The plot can be simplistic and somewhat generic, relying on familiar tropes.
The main characters, Pazu and Sheeta, are sometimes criticized for lacking depth or being underdeveloped, occasionally falling into 'damsel in distress' tropes.
The villain, Muska, is often seen as a one-dimensional, archetypal antagonist.
Some reviewers found the pacing to be too fast, suggesting a longer runtime would have allowed for better character development and narrative breathing room.
The blend of steampunk, fantasy, and sci-fi elements can feel inconsistent or confusing to some viewers.

anime.title: Le Portrait de Petit Cossette
anime.genres: Drama, Gore, Horror, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis:
Eiri Kurahashi is a Japanese art student who works in an antique shop. His friends begin to notice a dramatic, and rather concerning, change in Eiri, as he becomes more absent-minded and his behavior completely changes. They quickly decide to blame their friend's troubles on a girl.

They may be right, however, as Eiri has begun seeing a beautiful, doll-like girl trapped within an antique Venetian glass that his uncle bought in France. She seems to be living in a strange other world, contained entirely inside this glass, but her image refuses to leave Eiri's mind. His sketchbook becomes filled with her likeness, and he realizes he has become completely infatuated with this strange little girl. When he recognizes her in a portrait by the mysterious Italian artist, Marchello Orlando, he learns her name is Cossette d’Auvergne, and that she was tragically murdered along with the rest of her family.

One night, as he closes up the shop, he hears a voice asking him not to leave. Finally making contact with the object of his obsession, he makes a deal that he doesn't fully understand.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with many praising the visual and auditory experience while criticizing the confusing narrative and shallow characters. Some viewers find the OVA pretentious but artistically brilliant, while others find it incomprehensible and boring.  The series' dark themes and ambiguous storytelling contribute to the polarization.
pros: Visually stunning art style and animation with detailed backgrounds.
Haunting and effective soundtrack by Yuki Kajiura enhances the atmosphere.
The OVA explores complex themes of love, art, and sacrifice.
cons: Storytelling is confusing, non-linear, and requires significant interpretation.
Characters are underdeveloped and lack depth, making it difficult to connect with them.
The plot contains potentially disturbing elements, including gore and Lolita themes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Gothic Horror, Tragic Romance, Artistic Obsession

anime.title: Sgt. Frog
anime.synopsis:
It is the year 2004 AD, and pandemonium breaks as a mysterious frog-like alien race fills the sky with UFOs—or so 12-year-old Fuyuki Hinata dreams. Coincidentally, Sergeant Keroro, leader of a preliminary squad for the Keronian invasion of Pekopon—the alien name for Earth—begins his mission by invading Fuyuki's home. After subduing the boy and his sister, Keroro plans to reunite with his comrades and return to the mothership to repair his invaluable invasion device, the Kero Ball. Unfortunately, he receives word that headquarters has abandoned his unit's retrieval due to an unprecedented issue that forced the rest of the Keronians to flee. 

Consequently, Keroro is forced to stay at the Hinata residence together with the friendly, starry-eyed Fuyuki; his athletic, short-tempered sister Natsumi; and their hardworking, attractive mother Aki. Now stuck until further notice, Keroro and his platoon spend each day plotting world domination, but are thwarted each and every time by various unexpected factors. Nevertheless, as they live alongside humans, they learn to treat them as friends and allies, forming comedic yet meaningful connections that make their lives on Earth worthwhile.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers find it hilarious, charming, and even meaningful, while others find it repetitive, boring, and reliant on tired tropes. The show's episodic nature and lack of overall progression seem to be major dividing factors.
pros: Hilarious and funny, especially for those who enjoy lighthearted comedy.
Characters are charming and likable, even the minor ones.
Some viewers found the show to be a meaningful experience, forming connections with the characters.
cons: Repetitive formula and lack of character progression lead to boredom after many episodes.
Relies heavily on overused slapstick, tired references, and predictable punchlines.
Story gets lost throughout the series, with many filler episodes.

anime.title: School Rumble: Extra Class
anime.synopsis: This two-part OVA is a series of shorts in relation to the School Rumble series. This OVA fills in gaps with new content between episodes from beginning to nearly the end.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a passable addition to the School Rumble series, best enjoyed by existing fans. While it offers some funny moments and expands on secondary characters, the humor is not as strong as the original series, and the plot can be disjointed. Overall, it's a non-essential watch but can be enjoyable for those seeking more School Rumble content.
pros: Wacky character antics and characters
Excellent dubbing
Expands on secondary characters
cons: Gags aren't very funny
Passable and non-essential viewing
Sketches are taken from different parts of the original continuity, making it hard to follow
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Romantic Comedy

anime.title: Mahoraba: Heartful Days
anime.synopsis: Shiratori Ryuushi is a young artist-in-training, about to start studying at a vocational school. Arriving at his new lodgings, Narutakisou, he finds himself the focus of attention for the collection of weirdos that inhabit the place. He also meets and falls for the landlady, Aoba Kozue, who seems to be both lovely and charming. However, Kozue is not what she seems to be... in fact, she's more.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Mahoraba: Heartful Days" is well-received as a heartful and character-driven slice-of-life anime. It is praised for its unique and likable characters, sensitive portrayal of mental illness, and blend of comedy and drama. While some criticize the dated animation, slow pacing, and weak central romance, the series is generally recommended for those seeking a wholesome and enjoyable viewing experience.
pros: Well-developed and unique characters that are likable and memorable.
Sensitive and humorous portrayal of mental illness.
Good balance of comedy and drama.
The integration of 4-koma manga and storybook elements into the anime is well-executed.
Wholesome and heartful series
The series deviates from overdone troupes
cons: Dated character designs and animation style.
Main romance can lack impact and development.
Some storylines feel underdeveloped or rushed.
Can be slow-paced and uneventful at times.
Ending may feel incomplete or unsatisfying for some viewers.
Some viewers see it as a copycat anime.
anime.thematic_vibe: Heartwarming, Slice of Life, Romantic Comedy

anime.title: Mermaid Melody: Pichi Pichi Pitch
anime.synopsis: As the mermaid princess of the North Pacific (one of the seven mermaid kingdoms), Lucia entrusts a magical pearl to a boy who falls overboard a ship one night. Lucia must travel to the human world to reclaim her pearl and protect the mermaid kingdoms. Using the power of music Lucia is able to protect herself and the mermaid kingdoms from a growing evil force.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many viewers feeling nostalgic while acknowledging the show's flaws.  The music and art style are generally praised, but the repetitive plot, weak characters, and excessive filler are significant criticisms. Some find enjoyment in its cheesiness, while others are frustrated by the lack of depth and originality.  Overall, it's seen as a decent anime for younger audiences or fans of the magical girl genre willing to overlook its shortcomings.
pros: Catchy and memorable music.
Colorful and cute art style.
Characters have unique and fun traits.
cons: Repetitive songs and filler episodes.
Weak character development and unlikeable characters.
Predictable and clichéd plot.

anime.title: Metropolis
anime.synopsis:
During an investigation, private detective Shunsaku Ban and his nephew Kenichi travel from Japan to Metropolis—a restless high-tech city where people brutally persecute their robot cohabitants and a dictatorial force rises in power. The two are investigating Dr. Laughton, a scientist suspected of human organ trading, who is supposedly hiding there. Unbeknownst to all, Dr. Laughton has built a cutting-edge female android called Tima for the most influential man in Metropolis, Duke Red.

When Dr. Laughton's laboratory ends up in flames following an unforeseen incident, Shunsaku and Kenichi are separated while looking for survivors. Kenichi rescues a disoriented Tima and struggles to protect her from Duke Red's ruthless foster son, Rock, who pursues the robot girl. Unaware of Tima's true nature, Kenichi befriends her as a human being. Meanwhile, Shunsaku tries to reunite with the boy, unraveling dark schemes that evolve in the city's background—including the key role of Kenichi's protegee in Duke Red's ambitious goal for domination.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Metropolis is mixed. While praised for its visual splendor, music, and thematic depth, it's often criticized for its slow pacing, weak character development, and predictable story. Many find the film visually impressive but lacking emotional resonance due to unengaging characters.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation quality, especially the detailed backgrounds and character movements.
Excellent music, particularly the New Orleans jazz soundtrack which enhances the atmosphere.
Thought-provoking themes related to class conflict, government corruption, and the dangers of unchecked ambition.
cons: Slow pacing due to excessive world-building scenes that don't advance the plot.
Underdeveloped and uninteresting main characters, making it difficult to connect with them emotionally.
Weak and predictable story elements, particularly the romance between Tima and Kenichi and Duke Red's ultimate scheme.

anime.title: My Neighbor Totoro
anime.synopsis: In 1950s Japan, Tatsuo Kusakabe relocates himself and his two daughters, Satsuki and Mei, to the countryside to be closer to their mother, who is hospitalized due to long-term illness. As the girls grow acquainted with rural life, Mei encounters a small, bunny-like creature in the yard one day. Chasing it into the forest, she finds "Totoro"—a giant, mystical forest spirit whom she soon befriends. Before long, Satsuki too meets Totoro, and the two girls suddenly find their lives filled with magical adventures in nature and fantastical creatures of the woods.
anime.consensus_summary: Tonari no Totoro is widely praised for its breathtaking animation, charming characters, and profound evocation of childhood wonder and nostalgia. While many find it a near-perfect, heartwarming experience, a minority express dissatisfaction with its perceived lack of a strong plot and slow pacing, feeling it is too simple or uneventful.
pros: Outstanding and detailed animation with lively, realistic frames.
Captures the innocence and wonder of childhood exceptionally well.
Creates an imaginative and immersive world that resonates with both children and adults.
Joe Hisaishi's musical score is charming, varied, and perfectly complements the mood of the scenes.
The characters, especially the sisters, are portrayed with genuine, lifelike charm and believable emotions.
Successfully blends realism with fantasy in a natural and unobtrusive way.
The film evokes a strong sense of nostalgia and a childlike sense of adventure.
cons: Lack of a strong, engaging plot or significant stakes leaves some viewers feeling bored.
The story is considered by some to be too simple or lacking depth.
The pacing is described as too slow or laid-back for some viewers.
The resolution of dramatic elements, like the mother's illness, is seen as too immediate.
The fantastical elements might not appeal to all viewers, particularly older ones.
Some find the dialogue and script could be tighter.

anime.title: Please Twins!: The Summer Never Ends
anime.synopsis: Two weeks have passed since the dilemma between Maiku, Karen and Miina was resolved, but their lives are more hectic than ever. Karen has become possessed in her newly discovered brother and Miina is desperate for attention as well, which leaves little time for Maiku to concentrate on his work. Therefore he decides to head out in the woods and set up a camp, where he can be work in peace. But, as always, we have Morino who is up to no good. To make things a bit more interesting, she organizes a field trip to Maiku's camp site, and encourages everyone to make some good summer memories.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a mixed bag for fans. Some enjoy the added comedy and fan service, finding it more entertaining than the original series. However, others criticize the plot as too simple, the art as poor quality, and especially the character inconsistency and excessive fan service which detracts from the original story. Overall, opinions are divided, with some recommending it for fans of the series and others considering it a waste of time.
pros: Builds on the conclusion of the series
Entertaining with comedy, fan service and ecchi
Comic and romantic moments
cons: Plot is straightforward
Crappy art
Character inconsistency
Blatant excuse for fan service

anime.title: Otogi Zoshi: The Legend of Magatama
anime.synopsis: The year is 972 A.D. in Kyoto, the capital of ancient Japan. Kyoto is becoming a corrupt and run-down city; selfish samurai and onmyoji, who care only about gaining political power are everywhere. To make matters worse the city is suffering from famine and widespread disease. Unable to ignore the condition of the city any longer, the Imperial Court decides to send Minamoto no Raiko, a famous samurai well-known for his archery skills, to recover a legendary gem said to hold mysterious power to save the world. However Raiko also falls ill to disease. Instead his youngest sister, Hikaru, decides secretely to make the journey in his place. Hikaru meets many people, and has many adventures while on her trip for the legendary gem.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided between the two story arcs. The Heian Arc is praised for its engaging story, strong characters, and beautiful art, while the Tokyo Arc is criticized for its slow pace, weaker plot, and disconnect from the first arc. Many feel the second arc detracts from the overall quality of the series, with some suggesting to only watch the first half.
pros: Strong character development, especially in the Heian Arc.
Beautiful art and animation in the Heian Arc, with detailed backgrounds.
Engaging story and plot twists in the first arc.
cons: The modern-day Tokyo Arc is considered a significant drop in quality.
Inconsistent animation quality, with budget-saving techniques used.
The two arcs feel disconnected and the plot is slow-paced in the second arc.

anime.title: Pokémon
anime.synopsis:
Pokémon are peculiar creatures with a vast array of different abilities and appearances; many people, known as Pokémon trainers, capture and train them, often with the intent of battling others. Young Satoshi has not only dreamed of becoming a Pokémon trainer but also a "Pokémon Master," and on the arrival of his 10th birthday, he finally has a chance to make that dream a reality. Unfortunately for him, all three Pokémon available to beginning trainers have already been claimed and only Pikachu, a rebellious Electric-type Pokémon, remains. However, this chance encounter would mark the start of a lifelong friendship and an epic adventure!

Setting off on a journey to become the very best, Satoshi and Pikachu travel across beautiful, sprawling regions with their friends Kasumi, a Water-type trainer, and Takeshi, a Rock-type trainer. But danger lurks around every corner. The infamous Team Rocket is always nearby, seeking to steal powerful Pokémon through nefarious schemes. It'll be up to Satoshi and his friends to thwart their efforts as he also strives to earn the eight Pokémon Gym Badges he'll need to challenge the Pokémon League, and eventually claim the title of Pokémon Master.
anime.consensus_summary: The Pokemon anime is viewed with nostalgia by many who grew up with it, appreciating its themes of adventure and friendship. However, it is also criticized for its repetitive formula, lack of character development, and inconsistent plot. While beloved by children, older audiences often find it shallow and unengaging.
pros: Teaches good values like friendship, loyalty, and trust.
Appeals to children with simple stories and likeable characters.
The original designs of the first 150 Pokémon are creative and iconic.
Engaging music scores that enhance battles.
cons: Repetitive and formulaic plot with little character development.
Inconsistent storyline and lack of overarching narrative.
Animation quality is dated and often reuses assets.
Pointless filler episodes that detract from the main story.

anime.title: Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Award Winning, Comedy, Fantasy, Kids
anime.synopsis:
Using the fossil of the Legendary Pokémon Mew, Team Rocket has created the first successful Pokémon clone. Named Mewtwo, the man-made Pokémon quickly becomes upset with the circumstances of its creation and goes on a rampage. It is soon approached by Sakaki, the leader of Team Rocket, and is manipulated into committing evil acts.

Repulsed by the tricks of mankind and the cruelties it has suffered, Mewtwo isolates itself from everyone and plots against humans whilst trying to discover its true purpose in life. Disguising as the world's strongest Pokémon trainer, Mewtwo draws in the region's most powerful trainers who want to fight the new, mysterious opponent. With the fate of the world at stake, renowned trainers Satoshi, Takeshi, and Kasumi must battle against Mewtwo and defeat it before it brings about the downfall of humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely agrees that Pokemon: The First Movie is a standout entry in the franchise, praised for its surprisingly deep philosophical themes, emotional impact, and darker tone compared to the series. However, a significant point of contention is the heavily altered international dubs, which many feel diluted the original message and context, leading to a divided opinion on the film's ultimate thematic clarity.
pros: Mewtwo's characterization and exploration of philosophical themes like purpose, identity, and the nature of life resonate strongly with audiences.
The movie's dark and serious tone, particularly the themes of creation, suffering, and the human condition, are noted as impactful and surprisingly deep for a children's film.
The animation and art style are generally praised as being a step up from the series, with good use of music to enhance the emotional impact of key scenes.
The exploration of cloning and genetic modification themes provides a thought-provoking element that appeals to both younger and older viewers.
The emotional weight of certain scenes, particularly those involving Mewtwo's pain and the Pokémon's reactions, are frequently cited as being genuinely heartbreaking and memorable.
cons: Significant portions of the original Japanese version's depth and context were cut from the international dubs (particularly the 4Kids version), leading to a distorted or dumbed-down message.
The 'fighting is wrong' message is perceived by some as hypocritical and shoehorned into a movie about monster battles.
The original series' characters are noted as not having much development, and the clones themselves are described as generic.
The animation, while better than the series, is still considered average by some, and the CGI integration is seen as dated.
The movie is considered inaccessible to those unfamiliar with the Pokémon franchise, lacking sufficient background information.

anime.title: She, The Ultimate Weapon
anime.genres: Drama, Military, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Chise is an ordinary schoolgirl: small, frail, and not particularly intelligent. Her greatest joy is her budding romance with her classmate and childhood friend, Shuuji. They both live in a small military town in Hokkaido, where high schoolers have few concerns other than who is dating whom and complaining about the steep climb up "Hell Hill" every day before school.

One day, Shuuji and his friends make a trip to Sapporo to buy gifts for their girlfriends. A massive air raid on Sapporo that day kills thousands, including one of Shuuji's friends, and signals the beginning of a war. Fleeing from the carnage, Shuuji spots Chise, though now she has steel wings and a massive gun where her right arm should be. Against her will, she has been transformed into the ultimate cyborg weapon, capable of leveling entire cities.

As the war rages closer and closer to their hometown, Chise and Shuuji's relationship is strained by her transformation, and they are left to wonder whether she is even still human.
anime.consensus_summary: Saikano evokes strong reactions, but opinions are divided. Some find it a deeply moving and tragic love story set against a backdrop of war, appreciating its art style and music. Others criticize its pacing, unlikable characters, and reliance on forced melodrama, ultimately finding it emotionally manipulative and unsatisfying. The series has potential but fails in execution.
pros: Visually delicate art style, surprising given the studio's reputation for CG.
Memorable and emotionally resonant opening and closing themes.
Effectively portrays the characters' struggles with loss of humanity and the horrors of war.
cons: Pacing issues, particularly in the middle, leading to emotional fatigue.
Characters can be unlikable or difficult to connect with, hindering emotional investment.
Lack of explanation for the world's setting and the sci-fi elements creates confusion and reduces believability.
Overreliance on melodrama and forced tragedy, resulting in emotional manipulation.

anime.title: Sailor Moon
anime.synopsis:
Usagi Tsukino is an average student and crybaby klutz who constantly scores low on her tests. Unexpectedly, her humdrum life is turned upside down when she saves a cat with a crescent moon on its head from danger. The cat, named Luna, later reveals that their meeting was not an accident: Usagi is destined to become Sailor Moon, a planetary guardian with the power to protect the Earth. Given a special brooch that allows her to transform, she must use her new powers to save the city from evil energy-stealing monsters sent by the malevolent Queen Beryl of the Dark Kingdom.

But getting accustomed to her powers and fighting villains are not the only things she has to worry about. She must find the lost princess of the Moon Kingdom, the other Sailor Guardians, and the Legendary Silver Crystal in order to save the planet from destruction.
anime.consensus_summary: Sailor Moon is fondly remembered as a classic magical girl anime with strong characters and themes, though its age shows in repetitive plots and dated production. Many viewers appreciate its nostalgic charm and exploration of female friendships and love, while some find its repetitive nature and occasional plot holes tiresome. Despite some criticisms, it remains a highly influential and enjoyable series for many, particularly those who grew up with it.
pros: Strong and distinct characters with good development
Exploration of complex relationships and friendships
Humorous and enjoyable despite repetitive elements
Addresses deeper themes of love, sacrifice, and past lives
Impactful and nostalgic for many viewers
cons: Repetitive monster-of-the-week format
Dated animation and sound quality
Simplistic and formulaic action sequences
Inconsistent writing and plot contrivances
Dubbing inaccuracies and censorship in some versions

anime.title: Sailor Moon R: The Movie - The Promise of the Rose
anime.romaji_title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon R: The Movie
anime.synopsis: When Mamoru was little he gave a rose to a little boy named Fiore. Fiore promised that one day he would bring Mamoru lots of flowers. Now Fiore has come back to earth but his intentions are not merely to fulfil a promise...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely considers Sailor Moon R: The Movie to be a standout entry, often cited as a favorite among the franchise's films. Its emotional depth, character development (particularly for Fiore and Mamoru's past), and high production values in animation and music are frequently praised. While the film is overwhelmingly recommended for its heartfelt story and strong themes, a minority note a weak or abrupt ending as a significant flaw.
pros: Strong characterizations, particularly for the Sailor Soldiers and Fiore, with well-developed emotional arcs.
Engaging and heartfelt story that provides meaningful backstory for Tuxedo Mask and explores themes of loneliness and love.
High-quality animation and art direction, with detailed backgrounds and fluid action sequences, especially for a 90s film.
Superb vocal performances and a memorable soundtrack that enhances the emotional impact.
Self-contained narrative that is accessible even to those unfamiliar with the Sailor Moon series.
Thematic exploration of loneliness, symbolism, and love is well-integrated and provides a deeper message.
cons: The ending is described as abrupt, cheap, and lacking proper resolution.
Mamoru's character is perceived as bland and generically good, making his prominence in this film more noticeable and less engaging.
Chibi-Usa is mentioned as being annoying despite having some funny moments.
Some plot elements, particularly the resolution, felt contrived to a few reviewers.

anime.title: Sailor Moon S
anime.synopsis:
The Sailor Guardians and their leader, Sailor Moon, continue their duty of protecting Earth from any who would dare cause it harm. However, Sailor Mars' apocalyptic visions and the appearance of two new guardians—Sailor Neptune and Sailor Uranus—signal that a new battle will soon begin.
 
These newcomers seek three Talismans that are inside the Pure Heart Crystals within human beings. Once brought together, these objects form The Holy Grail, a magical relic with extraordinary abilities. They want to use the Grail to save the world, but an evil organization known as the Death Busters seeks its power for their own desires.

The removal of a Talisman from a person's Heart Crystal will cause their death, something that Uranus and Neptune see as a necessary sacrifice to form the Grail, while Sailor Moon and her group deem it unforgivable. But can any sacrifice be worth the cost if it saves the lives of the entire human race?
anime.consensus_summary: Sailor Moon S is a season praised for its introduction of complex characters and darker themes, marking a high point for many fans. However, it also receives criticism for its repetitive structure, uneven pacing, and underdevelopment of existing characters. While many appreciate the fresh elements, some find the series suffers from familiar flaws and inconsistent execution.
pros: Introduction of compelling new characters like Uranus, Neptune, and Saturn.
Improved animation quality and character designs.
The story is more exciting and complex than previous seasons
Incorporation of darker themes and morally ambiguous characters, leading to great episodes.
The humor and action coalesce well.
cons: Repetitive monster-of-the-week formula.
Uneven character development, with Inner Senshi sidelined and Outer Senshi prioritized.
Inconsistent pacing, with some arcs dragging and others feeling rushed.
Filler episodes that can be boring and pointless.
The villains devolve into cartoonish caricatures.
Reused animation sequences and stock footage attacks.
Usagi's new voice actress is worse than the original.
The ending is underwhelming, specifically the Messiah subplot.

anime.title: Teacher's Time
anime.romaji_title: Sensei no Ojikan: Dokidoki School Hours
anime.synopsis: Meet Suzuki Mika, teacher at Okitsu High School. Mika-sensei is a good teacher, but she has a small problem... literally. Although she's 27, she is only 148 cm tall, and has the face of a child. As a result, it is often difficult for Mika-sensei to get anyone to take her seriously.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Sensei no Ojikan is viewed as a lighthearted and funny moe comedy with a diverse cast of characters. While some find the humor and cultural references enjoyable, others may find it too niche or the animation lacking. The overuse of on-screen text is a common criticism, but the show is generally considered a pleasant experience for fans of the genre.
pros: Variety of character personalities, including male characters which is uncommon in the genre.
Subtle adult jokes that are still humorous.
Introduction to Japanese culture and traditions.
cons: Simpler artistic design compared to similar anime.
Average animation quality.
Overuse of on-screen text, resembling an animated manga.
Jokes may be too 'Japanese' and hard to understand without cultural knowledge.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Moe Comedy, School Life

anime.title: Slayers
anime.synopsis:
Powerful, avaricious sorceress Lina Inverse travels around the world, stealing treasures from bandits who cross her path. Her latest victims, a band of thieves, wait in ambush in a forest, thirsting for revenge. When Lina is about to effortlessly pummel her would-be attackers, the swordsman Gourry Gabriev suddenly announces his presence. Assuming Lina to be a damsel in distress, the foolish yet magnanimous man confronts the brigands in order to rescue her. After defeating them posthaste, the oblivious cavalier decides to escort Lina to Atlas City. Though not very keen on this idea, she ends up accepting his offer.

However, without realizing it, Lina has chanced upon a mighty magical item among her most recent spoils. Now two mysterious men are hunting the young magician and her self-proclaimed guardian to obtain this powerful object for apparently nefarious purposes. This way they begin their adventure, one where the fate of the world itself may be at stake.
anime.consensus_summary: Slayers is viewed as a nostalgic and humorous fantasy anime with memorable characters and witty parodies, though some find the animation dated and the humor repetitive. Fans generally appreciate the series for its lighthearted tone and subversion of genre tropes. While pacing issues and dated jokes are noted, the overall sentiment is positive, especially for older fans who grew up with the series.
pros: Memorable and well-developed characters, especially Lina Inverse, who subverts typical female lead tropes.
Strong comedic elements with witty dialogue and parodies of the fantasy genre, RPGs, and anime tropes.
Engaging story with a good balance of humor and serious moments, often recalling past events.
Excellent voice acting, particularly the English dub, which features voice actors from the original Pokemon series.
Good music that fits well with the anime.
cons: Dated animation quality.
Repetitive humor and running gags that can become annoying.
Uneven pacing, with some filler episodes and story arcs that slow down the overall narrative.
Some jokes do not age well, such as those based on homosexual stereotypes or Lina's bust size.
Recycled animation sequences.

anime.title: Slayers Next
anime.synopsis:
In the kingdom of Xoana, Lina Inverse and Gourry Gabriev unexpectedly come across their old companions, Zelgadis Graywords and Princess Ameilia Wil Tesla Saillune. Upon their reunion, the friends end up easily foiling the King of Xoana and his daughter's dastardly plans of world conquest.

Soon after, it is revealed that Zelgadis is in search of the world's most valuable magical tome, the Claire Bible, hoping to discover a method to recover his human body among the many secrets sheltered within it. Despite his protests, the rest of the group decides to join in the quest after hearing of his mission. However, just when they were wondering where to start looking for the legendary book, they stumble upon a mysterious priest by the name of Xellos, who claims that he may be of some help in their pursuit.
anime.consensus_summary: Slayers Next is a well-regarded sequel that improves upon the original in many aspects, particularly in pacing, character development, and humor. While some reviewers note flaws such as animation inconsistencies and a weak ending, the overall sentiment is positive, with many considering it a must-watch for fans of the first season and the fantasy-comedy genre. The series is praised for its balanced mix of action, comedy, and character-driven storytelling.
pros: Improved pacing and story flow compared to the first season
Well-developed and likeable characters, especially Lina Inverse
Excellent voice acting and music
Balanced mix of humor, action, and serious moments
Strong sense of continuity in art and sound with the previous season
Memorable and funny filler episodes
cons: Some recycled animation and awkward character animation
Climactic battle and ending feel rushed or like an 'ass pull'
Villains are not as memorable or empathetic as in the first season
Some jokes and plot elements become redundant or repetitive
First half of the season meanders with boring plot elements

anime.title: Tenchi in Tokyo
anime.synopsis:
Tenchi Masaki heads out to tackle the big world, setting off to school in Tokyo! But not everyone is happy to hear he is moving away, as his female friends sulk and complain at the prospect of him being alone. However, Tenchi is not by himself for very long, as he soon meets a kind and compassionate girl named Sakuya Kumashiro who helps him get used to life in Tokyo.

The two become close friends, but Sakuya wants more than just that, so she proclaims her love for Tenchi. This confession comes as a shock not only to Tenchi, but also the girls back home. In response, the girls decide to step up their game, and they immediately flock to Tokyo to take Tenchi for themselves. 

With the girls competing for his love, Tenchi must decide once and for all who the most important woman in his life is. However, he is going to have a hard time deciding, as strange events start happening that drive Tenchi further apart from his friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Shin Tenchi Muyo! is a divisive entry in the Tenchi franchise, with many fans disliking the changes to the established formula and character dynamics. Some appreciate the exploration of character depth and the intriguing twist introduced by Sakuya, while others find the plot and character deviations to be a betrayal of the original series. The art style and music are also points of contention, contributing to the mixed reception.
pros: Exploration of character depth, especially for Ryoko and Ayeka
Intriguing twist to the premise with the introduction of Sakuya
Addresses the girls' struggles and emotional drama realistically
cons: Unpopular art style compared to previous series
Repetitive and generic background music
Introduction of Sakuya is seen as a 'Mary Sue' character by some
Plot deviates from the original Tenchi series and diminishes the established characters
Character regression and flanderization of the original cast

anime.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki
anime.synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old Tenchi Masaki grew up hearing stories about how his ancestor used a sword to seal a demon inside a cave seven hundred years ago. When curiosity gets the better of him, Tenchi goes to the cave and stumbles across the sword from the legend. Thinking that the story is nothing more than a fairy tale, he removes the blade and inadvertently releases the demon, who turns out to be a space pirate named Ryouko Hakubi. Furious about being trapped for so long, she attacks Tenchi, but he is able to repel her with the sword, awakening his inner power. After seeing this, Ryouko takes an interest in her unlikely savior and decides to crash at his place.

As if it were a chain reaction, more alien women—Aeka Jurai Masaki, an uptight princess from the planet Jurai; Sasami, Aeka's sweet younger sister; Mihoshi Kuramitsu, a ditzy Galactic Police Officer; and Washuu Hakubi, a wisecracking genius—gradually come in contact with Tenchi and begin living with him. Through his encounters with these five women, Tenchi begins to learn more about his ancestry, newfound power, and the looming threat lurking beyond the skies.
anime.consensus_summary: Tenchi Muyou! Ryououki is widely regarded as a classic and a foundational series for the harem genre, praised for its well-developed characters and a successful blend of sci-fi, comedy, and romance. While many viewers appreciate its unique charm and pioneering status, a notable segment of the audience finds the plot convoluted and the romantic developments to be forced or poorly executed, leading to divided opinions on its overall narrative quality.
pros: Well-developed characters with unique pasts and complex facets.
Engaging blend of action, comedy, and plot progression that avoids stagnation.
Distinctive 90s art style and detailed character/background designs.
Effective use of humor derived from character chemistry and ironic situations.
Pioneering in popularizing the harem genre with a focus on character depth over gratuitous fanservice.
cons: Plot can be complex and difficult to grasp fully within the initial episodes/OVAs.
Some viewers find the romantic development and character relationships forced or lacking buildup.
Pacing can be slow at times, with some episodes focusing heavily on character bickering.
The later OVAs or spin-offs are perceived as a decline in quality or cash grabs.

anime.title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki 3rd Season
anime.synopsis:
Ever since his powers awakened, Tenchi Masaki has attracted the attention of many powerful galactic beings, including the mysterious Lady Takami who dispatches her best warrior, Z, to observe him. Though he is under strict orders not to harm Tenchi, Z has no intention of playing by the rules and begins plotting his demise. 

Meanwhile, on Earth, Tenchi tries to piece together more information about his family and the universe. But as usual, his life won't be getting any easier, as his entire household enters a state of panic when Noike Kamiki Jurai—a woman claiming to be Tenchi’s fiancée—shows up out of the blue.
anime.consensus_summary: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki 3rd Season is largely considered a disappointment, especially when compared to the original OVAs. While some appreciate the expansion of the lore and character development, the changes in art style, introduction of many new characters, and slow pacing are major criticisms. The series evokes nostalgia but ultimately fails to capture the charm and excitement of its predecessors, leading to a mixed reception among fans.
pros: Expansion of lore regarding the Great Goddesses is appreciated by long-time fans.
Soundtrack retains the mystical and comedic tone of the original OVAs.
Character arcs progress well from the preceding anime.
cons: Significant disappointment among long-time fans due to changes in art style and story direction.
Introduction of numerous new characters late in the series feels unnecessary and disjointed.
Pacing issues with too much focus on introductions and not enough significant plot development in early episodes.
Established characters feel lifeless and reduced to predictable roles.

anime.title: Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Romance, Sci-Fi, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
When the soothing comfort of sunlight starts to fade, beings of seraphic beauty become the undisputed masters of the night, instilling fear in every living creature. Water turns into ice before these blood-sucking monsters, and their victims realize that this uncanny chill is the harbinger of their inevitable demise. Fortunately, the number of vampires is dwindling thanks to the dauntless bounty hunters who track down and slay the near-immortal predators.

One night, tragedy befalls the Elbourne family as their daughter, Charlotte, is abducted by Meier Link, a revered vampire lord protected by an army of monsters. To save their beloved Charlotte, her family recruits the Marcus Brothers, a group of vampire hunters known for their ruthlessness; and D, a sword-wielding dhampir—a half-vampire, half-human who has the strengths of both species and the weaknesses of neither.

The hunters rush to rescue Charlotte, but if her abductor decides to turn her into a vampire, they should eliminate her. Moreover, their mission must be completed before Meier reaches the impregnable vampire castle of Carmilla and takes Charlotte out of humanity's reach forever.
anime.consensus_summary: Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust is widely praised for its stunning visuals and unique gothic aesthetic. Many appreciate the complex characters and the blend of action and romance. While some find the plot and character development lacking, the overall consensus is that it's a beautifully animated and entertaining film, highly recommended for fans of the genre.
pros: Stunning animation and detailed art style create a visually captivating experience.
Well-developed characters with complex motivations add depth to the story.
Unique blend of gothic and sci-fi elements creates a distinctive world.
Excellent pacing and action choreography make for an engaging watch.
cons: Some minor villains lack clear motivations.
Character development, particularly of D, is considered weak by some.
The plot, while engaging, can be simplistic and predictable.
Art style may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Mousou Kagaku Series: Wandaba Style
anime.synopsis:
Genius scientist Tsukumo Susumu knows each and every single theory behind aerodynamics that exists on earth despite being only 13 years old. He wants to travel to the moon without the use of fossil fuels that power rockets. So begins his heavy research using his knowledge in the laws of physics, scientific theory and his wild imagination.

His test subjects are the unpopular idol group Mix JUICE (Himawari, Yuri, Ayame, Sakura). They come up with all sorts of crazy ideas to become the first humans to successfully hold a concert on the face of the moon. Will the four girls from Mix JUICE be able to struggle their way to the moon successfully?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience mood is generally positive towards Wandaba Style, appreciating its originality and humor, but noting its repetitive elements and shallow character development. While some find the humor childish, others enjoy its wacky and lighthearted nature. The series is considered an okay watch, but not particularly memorable or replayable.
pros: Original concept of a band trying to perform on the moon.
Catchy and lively soundtrack.
Charming and likable characters, particularly Kiku No. 8.
Good mixing of character charisma and gags.
Story picks up pace and gets more involving after the halfway point.
cons: Over-the-top humor may not appeal to everyone.
Repeated jokes and scenes may annoy some viewers.
Characters lack depth, remaining static throughout the series.
Music gets repetitive.

anime.title: Wind: A Breath of Heart (TV)
anime.synopsis:
Okano Makoto transferred to the school in his home town. There, he spent normal but happy school days with his sister, Hinata, a jokey classmate, Tachibana Tsutomu, Shikouin Kasumi, Tsutomu's childhood friend, and other friends.

One day, after school, Makoto heard someone playing the harmonica. That melody made him feel something old, and it brought him to the roof of the school buildings. There, he met a girl in the dusk.

It was Narukaze Minamo who turned her face to him with a smile. She was a childhood friend, but they had lived separately for years.
Hiding their true thoughts, Makoto and his friends spend their lives in school. Their stories in a mysterious town are about to begin.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime "Wind: A Breath of Heart" is largely considered a disappointment due to its weak plot execution, inconsistent character development, and abrupt ending. While some appreciate the visual aesthetics and initial setup, the majority feel the series fails to deliver on its potential. The shift in tone and introduction of supernatural elements further contribute to the negative reception, resulting in viewers feeling frustrated and unsatisfied.
pros: Visually appealing backgrounds with 3D rendering.
Decent sound and background piano soundtrack.
Potentially interesting story setup.
cons: Poorly executed plot with underdeveloped story lines.
Inconsistent character development and motivations.
Abrupt and unsatisfying ending.
Pacing issues and lack of fluidity between episodes.
Dialogue is weak when attempting to be deep.
Characters are boring, lack distinguishing features.
Poor directorial choices
Worst time constraints

anime.title: Sky Blue
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Set in 2142, Wonderful Days depicts a world that has been nearly destroyed by environmental pollution. Human life as we know it is almost extinct, and only a few were able to pull through the collapse of Earth's ecosystem. In order to deal with the chaos, a city named Ecoban was created. The city uses the very pollution that caused the disaster as an energy source.

However, although the initial plan was successful to an extent, it didn't just create a new source of energy, but also an elite group of people. This prestigious faction believes that they are above the system, and are not willing to accept survivors from outside the city unless they are put to work as laborers.

Among the people living in the wasteland outside Ecoban is a young man named Shua. He leads a very difficult life, but tries to make the most of it through the love that he feels for his childhood friend Jay. Unfortunately, Jay may be more interested in her security commander Cade than in Shua, and thus a love triangle is formed. Not only does Shua have to deal with the heartbreak, but he must also find a new way to survive in the crumbles left from the once-beautiful planet Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many praise the film's visual artistry and initial concept, but find the plot and character development lacking. The film is considered a visually impressive but narratively weak experience. Some viewers appreciate the overall aesthetic and thematic elements, while others are disappointed by the underdeveloped story and characters.
pros: Visually stunning animation, especially the backgrounds
Good world-building premise with potential
Soundtrack and music effectively enhance the mood
cons: Weak, underdeveloped characters with little depth
Generic and predictable storyline
Dialogue is flat and impersonal
Pacing issues, with scenes that drag on

anime.title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh!
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Shounen, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
Bullies often target someone frail and weak—someone exactly like Yuugi Mutou. His beautiful childhood friend, Anzu Mazaki, is always there to stand up for him, but he can't depend on her forever. Katsuya Jonouchi, who is almost always accompanied by his verbal sparring partner Hiroto Honda, doesn't seem like a bad person either, despite always bringing Yuugi trouble. But most of all, Yuugi wishes for a true friend who understands him and would never betray him.

Yuugi treasures his Millennium Puzzle, an ancient Egyptian artifact that was brought into his grandfather's game shop. Believing that solving the puzzle will grant him his wish, he completes the puzzle, unleashing a new personality within him—the soul of the "King of Games."

Dark, twisted, strong, and reliable, the new personality named Yami Yuugi is the exact opposite of Yuugi. Upon any injustice toward him, Yami Yuugi takes over Yuugi's body and forces the opponent into a "Shadow Game." The stakes are high as whoever loses shall have a taste of the darkness that resides within their own heart.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are split regarding Yu☆Gi☆Oh!. Some appreciate the darker tone, unique games, and character dynamics, while others are critical of the inconsistent art, repetitive music, and episodic structure. The series is considered a unique but flawed entry in the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise, appealing more to fans of the original manga and those seeking a different take on the series' themes.
pros: Unique games each episode
Darker tone compared to later Yu-Gi-Oh series
Creative and inventive game rules and solutions
Well-rounded characters with interesting dynamics
cons: Inconsistent art quality and animation
Repetitive soundtrack
Episodic format lacks an overarching plot
Unexplored consequences of Yami's shadow games
Overreliance on 'power of friendship' trope

anime.title: Baki the Grappler: Saidai Tournament-hen
anime.synopsis:
Mitsunari Tokugawa, the organizer of the historic Tokugawa underground fighting ring, has created a tournament featuring 38 of the world's best fighters, many of whom are grandmasters in their respective form of martial arts. With the exception of weapons, anything goes in Tokugawa's ring so that each fighter is able to showcase their true power and strongest secret moves.

Baki Hanma earned a place in the tournament due to his status as the reigning champion of Tokugawa's fighting ring. Will he be able to come out on top?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the action and fight choreography in Grappler Baki: Saidai Tournament-hen, particularly the variety of fighting styles and characters. However, some find the plot thin and the animation lacking. While some see it as a great tournament arc, others are disappointed by the ending and excessive filler.
pros: Varied and compelling fighters with unique personalities and fighting styles
Engaging tournament arc with fresh and different matches
Martial arts are represented with love and detail
cons: Animation quality is lacking and budget cuts are noticeable
Pacing is hurt by flashbacks and recaps
Story is thin, and the ending is not satisfying

anime.title: Digimon: Digital Monsters
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Kids
anime.synopsis:
When a group of seven children go to summer camp, the last thing that they expect is snow falling in July. In the confusion that follows this phenomenon, they each receive an odd device that transports them to another world. As soon as they wake up in this new world, they encounter strange creatures who call themselves "Digimon." The Digimon tell them that they've landed in the "Digital World," far from home.

With only the Digimon and the "Digivices" as protection, the seven children set off to find their way home and learn the reason why they were brought here. Led by the impulsive Taichi Yagami and his hungry Digimon partner Agumon, this group will have to fight unknown evils as they discover more about this outlandish Digital World.
anime.consensus_summary: Digimon Adventure is largely viewed fondly, especially by those who watched it during their childhood. While some acknowledge its flaws, such as animation inconsistencies and formulaic plot elements, the strong character development and exploration of mature themes are widely praised. The series is considered a nostalgic and enjoyable coming-of-age story, particularly in its original Japanese version.
pros: Strong character development, especially for the main children characters.
Exploration of mature themes like death, divorce, and fear of loss, handled with surprising maturity for a kid's show.
Catchy and memorable soundtrack (especially the Japanese version).
Well-constructed story with mysteries unveiled gradually.
Addresses themes of friendship, self-discovery and good vs evil.
cons: Animation quality can be inconsistent due to budget limitations, with noticeable stock footage and off-model moments.
Initial episodes can be slow and episodic, potentially turning off some viewers.
Villains can be one-dimensional with simple motivations.
Some find the show overly formulaic, with repetitive transformation sequences and predictable plot elements.
English dub can be heavily edited with bad attempts at humor which may detract from the original's spirit.

anime.title: Descendants of Darkness
anime.genres: Boys Love, Detective, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Shoujo, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Even after death, life is full of paperwork and criminals. Tsuzuki Asato is a 26 year old, happy-go-lucky, and dorky shinigami (god of death) whose job is to makes sure that those who are dead remain dead and stay in their proper realms. Even though he's had this job for over 70 years, he is in the worst division with horrible pay. He also has a knack for not keeping partners (since shinigami work in pairs), but now he seems to have one that will stick around; stubborn, smart-mouthed, serious and defensive 16 year old, Kurosaki Hisoka. With each case they investigate, they come closer to the conspiracies of the serial killer Dr. Muraki Kazutaka. Tsuzuki's relationship with Hisoka is growing stronger and closer...but there is a dark past to how Tsuzuki died that will not give him peace.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the unique atmosphere, character designs, and blend of dark and humorous elements, while others criticize the pacing, character development, and potentially problematic themes. The series is seen as enjoyable by fans of shounen-ai and supernatural mysteries, but its flaws prevent it from being universally appealing. Some viewers find it to be a fun, albeit flawed, guilty pleasure.
pros: Beautiful art and music enhance the supernatural atmosphere
Interesting blend of humor and dark themes
Compelling villain in Dr. Muraki
cons: Rushed pacing and inadequately explained plot elements
Mediocre characters aside from the main antagonist
Questionable treatment of sensitive themes such as sexual assault

anime.title: Steel Angel Kurumi
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Historical, Mecha, Military, Romance
anime.synopsis: During Japan's Taisho Era (1912-1926), a scientist named Ayanokoji developed the Steel Angel - an artificial humanoid with superhuman physical abilities. While the Imperial Army wanted to use the Steel Angel as a new means of modern warfare, Ayanokoji wanted his creation to be a new step in the future of mankind. Thus, he defied orders from the Army and secretly made the Steel Angel codenamed "Kurumi". Then one day, a young boy named Nakahito Kagura snuck into Ayanokoji's house as a dare by his friends and stumbled upon Kurumi's lifeless body. A sudden attack by the Imperial Army shook the house, causing Kurumi to fall on Nakahito. At that moment, their lips met, and Kurumi woke up from "the kiss that started a miracle".
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the show entertaining for its humor and character interactions, while others criticize its inconsistent tone, weak plot, and mediocre production values. The series is seen as a product of its time, with a focus on fan service and a simple formula that appealed to some viewers but alienated others. There is appreciation for the dub, but the story and animation are frequently criticised.
pros: Distinct and memorable character designs, especially the Steel Angels' costumes.
The humor, particularly the interactions between Kurumi and Karinka.
The concept of time travel and the mysteries surrounding the Demonkind are interesting plot points.
Catchy and energetic opening theme.
cons: Inconsistent tone, shifting abruptly from sugary cuteness to melodrama.
Mediocre art and animation quality, especially during fight scenes.
Poorly choreographed fight scenes with cheap animation techniques.
Shallow characters with limited personality traits.
Weak plot with nonsensical elements and a cop-out ending.
English dub quality is inconsistent, with some performances better than others but a script that doesn't fit the show's setting.
Overreliance on ecchi elements and fan service.

anime.title: Steel Angel Kurumi 2
anime.synopsis: Taking place 75 years after the first series, Steel Angel Kurumi 2 brings the Steel Angels in a new mis-adventure. High school student and aspiring cellist Nako Kagura accidentally discovers and kisses Kurumi Mk. II at her home, thus making her Kurumi's master. But things go awry as Nako's best friend Uruka gets jealous and tries anything - including her father's army of top-secret mecha - to destroy Kurumi and win back Nako. Things get more out of control when Saki Mk. II is awakened by Uruka, and Karinka Mk. II joins in to steal Nako away from Kurumi.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some find the anime to be a fun, light-hearted romantic comedy with enjoyable yuri elements, while others are disappointed by the weak plot and excessive fanservice. It's mostly enjoyed for its comedic aspects and quirky characters rather than a compelling narrative. The show is considered a decent watch for fans of the genre, but not a standout sequel.
pros: Funny and comedic with wacky situations.
Catchy music and well-sung soundtrack.
Unique and cute character designs.
cons: Weak or repetitive storyline.
Excessive fan service.
Characters can be one-dimensional.

anime.title: Steel Angel Kurumi Zero
anime.synopsis: Sometime in the distant future, Kurumi, Saki and Karinka share an apartment with another girl named Excelia. One day, after school, Kurumi tells everyone that she is in love with a man she met named Michihito Kagura, but she doesn't know when she will see him again.
anime.consensus_summary: Steel Angel Kurumi Zero is a polarizing entry in the franchise, with many viewers disappointed by its shift to a romantic drama and its departure from the action and comedy of the original series. Some appreciate the deeper character exploration and improved art direction, while others find it bland, underdeveloped, and a poor conclusion to the anime. The short length and unanswered questions contribute to the mixed reception, making it a divisive but not overwhelmingly hated addition.
pros: Deeper character drama compared to other entries in the franchise.
Better art and shot direction, especially considering the limited setting.
Music is beautiful, particularly the piano melodies and ending theme.
cons: Significant departure in tone and style from the rest of the Steel Angel Kurumi series.
Lack of action and comedy, which were key elements of the original series.
Plot is underdeveloped and leaves many questions unanswered due to the short length.
Bland art style and limited setting within a single apartment.
Characters feel different and less interesting compared to their original portrayals.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Drama, Philosophical Undertones, Slice of Life

anime.title: Steel Angel Kurumi Encore
anime.synopsis: Four additional short stories of the Steel Angels: Saki becomes a film actress, Karinka goes on a blind date with Kamihito, Kurumi practices the art of becoming a traditional Japanese woman, and the rest of the Steel Angels engage in a contest to win Nakahito's heart.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, viewing 'Encore' as a fun, lighthearted extension of the original series. While some find the lack of significant plot progression and abrupt ending disappointing, most appreciate the focus on humor and character interactions. It is primarily recommended for existing fans seeking more of the same charm and antics.
pros: Emphasis on supportive characters provides fresh perspectives.
Humorous situations and quirky characters offer enjoyment.
Audio and animation quality is consistent with the original series.
cons: Stories don't fit into the storyline of the original series.
Short episodes lead to an abrupt ending and leave viewers wanting more.
Characters don't seem to have matured much since the first season.

anime.title: Major S2
anime.synopsis:
Gorou Honda has finally returned to Mifune East Junior High School, surprising his friends upon arrival. Now, Gorou is once again surrounded by those he holds closest, and he strives to continue playing and enjoying the game he loves most.

However, things do not go as planned, as Gorou is reminded of the harsh realities of baseball as he copes with an injury he sustained while playing baseball at Hitaka Little. Between new rivals, old friends, and mending broken relationships, Gorou must overcome challenges he has never faced before. 

His goal of attending elite baseball high school Kaido may not be far from his reach, but complicated circumstances may stop him in his tracks once again. How will he deal with the immense pressures of the game? And will he ever be able to find the type of baseball he loves most?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the increased focus on baseball and character development. However, others find Goro's character unlikeable and the plot lacking a satisfying climax, viewing the season mainly as setup for future installments. There is a divide between those who enjoy the series' core elements and those who are frustrated by its flaws.
pros: Improved baseball focus compared to Season 1.
Strong soundtrack and art.
Rewatchable due to focus on baseball action.
Good character development, especially Toshi.
Plot twists that are a breath of fresh air.
cons: Goro's character can be annoying and self-centered.
Pacing issues with games spanning multiple episodes.
Lack of overall plot emphasis and climax.
Some new characters are plain and designs are lame.
Season feels like a build-up for the next season, lacking its own resolution.

anime.title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Right of Left
anime.romaji_title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Right of Left
anime.synopsis: Yumi Ikoma and Ryou Masaoka are children who have been selected to take part in a top secret mission, to be the pilots of the first Fafner combat units; the last chance of survival for the human race. The enemy is ruthless, remorseless and is able to read the minds of humans. Therefore, the details of this mission are kept a secret even from the personnel involved. The young pilots must use all their courage and faith in order to survive and complete their mission or the fate of mankind would be compromised.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is that 'Right of Left' is a vital prequel that enhances the understanding of 'Dead Aggressor,' filling in crucial backstory and character motivations. While some find the story rushed and emotionally manipulative due to its short runtime, most agree that it's a worthwhile and essential viewing experience for fans of the series. The tone is darker, setting the stage for the despair felt in the main series.
pros: Integral part of SnF: Dead Aggressor
Important lore and character development
Solid action
Likeable characters with clear arc
cons: Story not very thought out or explained
Felt short and incomplete
Tries too hard to play the tragic hand
Some elements felt forced

anime.title: Sakura Wars TV
anime.synopsis:
It is the 1920s, and Japan is under attack by demonic invaders. The government has designed sturdy, albeit steam-powered, robot armor suits for the impending battle, but only young ladies with the proper combination of virtue and spirit can pilot the robots successfully.

Enter young Sakura, arriving in the Imperial Capital from the countryside to join the Imperial Flower Combat Troop. She has the qualifications to be a fine robot pilot, but she's surprised to learn that this secret Defense Force has a cover story as a musical theatre troupe-and they take their cover jobs very seriously indeed. It's costumes, line readings and robot combat galore, as Sakura struggles to learn the ropes, learn her lines, and do her part to save the nation!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Sakura Taisen is mixed, with some finding it enjoyable due to its unique blend of steampunk, theatrical elements, and mecha action. However, many critics point out issues with pacing, generic plot, and a lack of character development, particularly in the first half. The series is generally better received by those familiar with the game franchise, but newcomers may find it less engaging.
pros: Well-designed characters with distinct visual appearances.
The soundtrack is memorable and fitting for the historical setting.
Enjoyable overall experience, especially for fans of the game series.
cons: Inconsistent pacing, especially in the first half, which is considered slow and tedious.
The plot and villains are generic and lack depth.
Assumes prior knowledge of the game, making it less accessible to new viewers.

anime.title: DNA²
anime.genres: Comedy, Romance, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: Karin, a DNA operator from the future, is on a mission to change the course of History by stopping Junta Momonari from becoming the Mega-Playboy who fathered 100 children and led to the overpopulation of the world. But Junta is no playboy; in fact he is allergic to girls. But when Karin shoots him with the wrong DNA-altering bullet, he starts sporadically becoming the Mega-Playboy capable of charming any woman. Karin must try to restore the situation to normal before the change to Mega-Playboy becomes irreversible.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some enjoyed the initial interesting premise, comedic elements, and character designs, with a nostalgic appreciation for its 90s aesthetic. However, many criticize the rushed plot, inconsistent story, and the introduction of unrelated plot elements towards the end, leading to a disappointing and unsatisfying experience overall.
pros: Interesting premise with time travel elements
Appealing character designs, especially for female characters
Good animation for its time
Upbeat and catchy opening theme
cons: Rushed and disorganized plot, especially in the later episodes
Inconsistent story with plot holes and inconsistencies
Introduction of a super antagonist that feels out of place
Poor English dubbing
Animation is outdated

anime.title: Puni Puni Poemy
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Gag Humor, Mahou Shoujo, Parody, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: Poemi "Kobayashi" Watanabe has a body full of wasteful energy and an airheaded attitude toward every aspect in her life. Though directionless, she speeds ahead at full throttle to achieve her dream of becoming a famous voice actress. However, when mysterious aliens come to Earth and upend Poemi's life, she must utilize every ounce of her power—including magic which she gains from a magic fish—if she wants to save the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Puni Puni Poemi is a highly divisive anime, celebrated by some for its boundary-pushing humor and genre parody, while condemned by others for its offensive content and lack of substance. The show's manic energy and relentless absurdity create a love-it-or-hate-it experience. Ultimately, its value depends on the viewer's tolerance for transgressive comedy and appreciation for meta-humor.
pros: Energetic and creative voice acting, especially by Yumiko Kobayashi
Effective parody of magical girl anime and genre tropes
Fast-paced and over-the-top humor
Unique and bizarre art style that complements the comedic tone
cons: Crude and offensive humor that may be off-putting to some viewers
Lack of a coherent story or character development
Overreliance on fanservice and sexualized content
Incomprehensible and hyperactive presentation that can be exhausting

anime.title: Steamboy
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Historical, Military, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
In the Victorian era, the British Empire is bustling with the energy of the steam-powered industrial revolution. Following in the footsteps of his famous family of inventors, James Ray Steam enjoys his youth in Manchester helping at local factories and stealing components for his own creations. One day, he receives a package containing a strange ball with an attached valve from his grandfather, who has been working in the United States alongside Ray's father. However, it is not long before people from the O'Hara Foundation storm into his house demanding he hand it over.

Confused and afraid, Ray attempts to flee to the home of his grandfather's colleague, Robert Stephenson, with pursuers hot on his trail. While Ray seeks to piece together the secret of the ball and discover the power it contains, it seems practically everyone in the British Empire is ready to seize it from him.
anime.consensus_summary: Steamboy is a visually impressive steampunk anime with stunning animation and detailed world-building. However, the generic plot, underdeveloped characters, and heavy-handed philosophical themes detract from the overall experience.
