While the action sequences and setting are enjoyable, the lack of depth and originality leaves some viewers disappointed.
pros: Visually stunning animation with intricate details of steam-powered machines and Victorian London.
Excellent action sequences and world-building create a captivating and immersive experience.
Good English dub with fitting voice acting that enhances the setting.
cons: Generic and predictable plot with underdeveloped characters and obscure motivations.
Philosophical speeches get old quickly, weighing down the story.
Some scenes are too dark, making it difficult to see what's happening.
anime.thematic_vibe: Steampunk Adventure, Family Conflict, Technological Dystopia

anime.title: The Big O
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Paradigm City, a city of amnesia and a place of belonging. It remains populated by forgotten pasts and the ruins of their labors due to a calamity 40 years ago. Shrouded in a fog-like mystery, it is up to people like Roger Smith to shine a light through the mist. Acting as a professional negotiator and suave agent, Roger is a self-tailored ladies man whose only love is for funeral black. However, as he gets deeply involved with his clients, what often starts as a simple negotiation evolves into Roger saving Paradigm from crime and peril.

In the process, Roger stumbles even deeper into the untold folds of the city. As a rule, things are hardly ever as they appear. Serving as gray knight in a gray world, Roger is not without allies. By his side are Norman, a loyal and widely skilled butler, and Dorothy, a human-like android with deadpan snark. Together with the relic Big O, a jet-black mecha of gargantuan size and weight, they help Roger serve iron justice to Paradigm's lurking villains as he discovers the truth about 40 years ago.
anime.consensus_summary: The Big O is a stylish and atmospheric anime that blends noir, mystery, and mecha elements to create a unique experience. While praised for its characters, music, and visual style, it's criticized for its confusing plot and disappointing ending, particularly in the second season. The audience is divided, with some appreciating its philosophical themes and artistic merits, while others find it frustrating and nonsensical. Despite its flaws, The Big O remains a cult classic with a dedicated fanbase.
pros: Unique blend of genres and styles creates a compelling and engaging experience.
Well-developed and charismatic characters with unique personalities.
Excellent music and sound design that enhances the atmosphere.
Intriguing mysteries and plot twists that keep viewers hooked.
Strong visual style inspired by Batman: The Animated Series, with gritty and detailed art.
cons: Inconsistent plot and confusing storylines, particularly in the second season.
Vague or nonsensical story elements that can be frustrating.
Underdeveloped characters, especially secondary ones.
Repetitive monster-of-the-week format in the first season.
Disappointing ending that fails to provide satisfying answers or closure.
Animation quality may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Bubblegum Crisis Tokyo 2040
anime.synopsis:
In the wake of an earthquake that devastated most of the city, Tokyo has been rebuilt in record time due to the development of humanoid robots known as boomers. After the disaster, these machines now service the city as cheap labor. Genom Corporation is the mastermind behind the boomers, having become so rich and powerful that they have extended its influence into space.

However, all is not well with the boomers. Random breakdowns in their neural structure are causing some of them to go berserk, destroying property and killing humans in violent rampages. To combat this, Tokyo has formed the Advanced Police, a peacekeeping force with jurisdiction over boomer matters. There are also rumors of a second group known as the Knight Sabers, a vigilante unit operating from the shadows.

Trying to investigate the Knight Sabers, the adventurous Linna Yamazaki travels to Tokyo in pursuit of her heroes. There, she finds the enigmatic singer Priscilla Asagiri, the beautiful entrepreneur Sylia Stingray, and the exuberant Nene Romanova, each with their own reasons for coming together. As the struggle intensifies, the girls learn that the boomer problem might delve deeper than any of them could ever imagine.
anime.consensus_summary: Bubblegum Crisis Tokyo 2040 is generally viewed as a decent remake that expands upon the original OVA with improved character development and a more complete story. However, some feel the philosophical elements in the later episodes are not well-executed and that the plot falters towards the end. The series is appreciated for its action and cyberpunk themes, but some find the animation and music to be dated.
pros: Strong character development compared to the original OVA, with each character having distinct traits and growth.
Complete story with a beginning and end, unlike the original which was more episodic.
Expands on the backstory of Sylia and the origins of the Knight Sabers, providing more depth.
Music is well-integrated and enhances the scenes, with a mix of rock and techno.
Boomer designs are creative and varied, ranging from mundane to monstrous.
cons: The last story arc delves into philosophical themes that are not fully realized, potentially derailing the plot.
Other Knight Sabers besides Sylia are underdeveloped.
Animation shortcuts are apparent.
The quality of plotting in the final episodes is lacking, relying on deus ex machina.
Music and sound haven't aged well and can feel repetitive.

anime.title: The Irresponsible Captain Tylor
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Military, Parody, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
Justy Ueki Tylor is an average 20-year-old man: lazy, greedy, and a passionate womanizer. He plans to land an easy job with the United Planets Space Force that pays decently and is also far away from the rigorous combat raging throughout the galaxy.

However, Tylor's dreams of living a simple life are brought to a sudden halt when he stumbles into a dangerous hostage situation. Through one strange mishap after another, Tylor miraculously manages to save the hostages and is awarded command of the decrepit space-cruiser Soyokaze!

Now Tylor finds himself in charge of sending mad mercenaries, proud pilots, skeptical colleagues, and harsh commanders through the infinite expanse of the universe, all the while avoiding the looming threat of the Holy Raalgon Empire. What misadventures await the irresponsible Captain Tylor?
anime.consensus_summary: Irresponsible Captain Tylor is a well-regarded sci-fi comedy that blends humor and drama effectively. While some critique the older animation style and slow pacing, many appreciate the unique story and characters, particularly Captain Tylor himself. The series offers both light-hearted entertainment and deeper commentary on military themes.
pros: Unique sci-fi comedy with a blend of genres.
The show has serious commentary on military corruption.
Captain Tylor is a remarkable anime character.
The English dub is excellent.
The music is pretty good.
cons: Animation is average and of an older anime era.
Plot progression is pretty slow.
The art isn't anything special.
The character designs were plain and somewhat irritating.
There are needless fillers and bland comedy.

anime.title: Jin-Roh: The Wolf Brigade
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Award Winning, Drama, Military, Psychological, Romance, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
In an alternate history, following World War II, civil unrest and terrorism run rampant in a devastated Japan under foreign occupation. During a botched interception of underground munitions being transferred by a terrorist organization, Constable Kazuki Fuse, a soldier in an elite counter-terrorism unit, witnesses the true terror of human nature. He fails to prevent a teenage girl from carrying out a desperate suicide bombing that subsequently causes immense destruction to Tokyo. With mental scars and his competence under question, Fuse is sent back to the military academy for re-evaluation. Unbeknownst to him, he will soon be caught up in a web of government conspiracies that have the power to determine the future of all of Japan.

As Fuse treads the fine line between human and beast, he ultimately discovers to which side he truly belongs.
anime.consensus_summary: Jin-Roh is lauded for its visual artistry, immersive world-building, and thought-provoking narrative that blends political themes with a tragic love story. However, the film suffers from pacing issues, underdeveloped characters, and an overreliance on the Little Red Riding Hood metaphor. While many appreciate its mature and serious tone, others find it dull and uninvolving, resulting in a somewhat divided audience.
pros: Visually stunning animation, particularly the realistic character designs and detailed backgrounds.
Compelling story with unique blend of political intrigue and romance, drawing on Little Red Riding Hood themes.
Excellent sound design and impactful music that enhances the atmosphere and emotional impact.
cons: Pacing can be slow and uneven, making it difficult to remain engaged throughout.
Character development is lacking, especially for secondary characters, hindering emotional connection.
Heavy-handed use of Little Red Riding Hood allusions becomes repetitive and distracting.

anime.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
anime.synopsis:
A millennium has passed since the catastrophic nuclear war named the "Seven Days of Fire," which destroyed nearly all life on Earth. Humanity now lives in a constant struggle against the treacherous jungle that has evolved in response to the destruction caused by mankind. Filled with poisonous spores and enormous insects, the jungle spreads rapidly across the Earth and threatens to swallow the remnants of the human race.

Away from the jungle exists a peaceful farming kingdom known as the "Valley of the Wind," whose placement by the sea frees it from the spread of the jungle's deadly toxins. The Valley's charismatic young princess, Nausicaä, finds her tranquil kingdom disturbed when an airship from the kingdom of Tolmekia crashes violently in the Valley. After Nausicaä and the citizens of the Valley find a sinister pulsating object in the wreckage, the Valley is suddenly invaded by the Tolmekian military, who intend to revive a dangerous weapon from the Seven Days of Fire. Now Nausicaä must fight to stop the Tolmekians from plunging the Earth into a cataclysm which humanity could never survive, while also protecting the Valley from the encroaching forces of the toxic jungle.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind is largely positive, with widespread acclaim for its stunning visuals, thematic depth, and pioneering environmental message. However, a portion of viewers find the pacing slow and some characterizations to be archetypal, leading to mild disagreement on its overall narrative execution despite its artistic merits.
pros: Stunning and imaginative world-building, particularly the depiction of the toxic jungle and giant insects.
Profound and nuanced environmentalist and pacifist themes that were ahead of their time.
Exceptional art and animation quality, especially considering its 1984 production date, with beautiful backgrounds and creature designs.
Joe Hisaishi's iconic and evocative musical score perfectly complements the film's atmosphere and emotional beats.
Nausicaä is a strong, empathetic, and well-developed protagonist who serves as an inspirational figure.
The film successfully presents morally ambiguous antagonists with understandable motivations, avoiding simple good vs. evil dichotomies.
cons: The plot pacing can be slow at times, with some viewers finding certain sections to drag.
The narrative can feel rushed in places, particularly in explaining the complex world-building and political subplots due to the adaptation constraints of the manga.
Some characters, beyond Nausicaä, are criticized for being underdeveloped archetypes rather than fully fleshed-out individuals.
The environmental and anti-war messages, while powerful, are sometimes perceived as heavy-handed or overly didactic.
Certain aspects of the setting and its inherent dangers are not fully explored or depicted with enough visceral impact for some viewers.

anime.title: Saber Marionette J
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Harem, Mecha, Romance, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: In the distant future, since the Earth has become overpopulated, efforts to find and colonize on other planets have begun. However, one of the ships, the "Mesopotamia" malfunctions and all but 6 of its inhabitants are all killed. the remaining 6 manage to escape to a nearby planet named "Terra ll ", which is similar to Earth in many respects. However, all of them are male. Therefore, as to not let their efforts go to waste, they begin to set up 6 countries and to reproduce through cloning and genetic engineering. however, there are still no women, and to make up for it they create lifelike advanced female androids called "Marionettes" which do everyday chores and work. However, they are all emotionless machines. But one day, a ordinary boy named Otaru finds and awakens 3 special battle type Marionettes that have emotions due to a "Maiden Circuit" within them. It's up to him then to teach them and allow their emotions to grow, and when a nearby country threatens with world domination, it's up to to Otaru and his "human" Marionettes to protect their country.
anime.consensus_summary: Saber Marionette J is a light-hearted sci-fi harem comedy that is considered enjoyable, especially for those who watched it during its original run. While the art style and plot may be dated, the characters and balance of genres provide entertainment. Some find the humor lacking and the plot predictable, while others appreciate the nostalgic value and character development.
pros: Characters are diverse and develop throughout the series
Good balance of romance, drama, action, and sci-fi
Catchy opening and ending songs
cons: Dated art style
Obvious plot and unfunny jokes
Small details could be considered giant plot holes

anime.title: The Wings of Rean
anime.synopsis:
Because his friends fired a rocket into the US Army camp, Suzuki was wanted by the US Army and the police. While he was running away the sea surface suddenly rose, and when a brilliant light appeared he saw a strange looking battleship flying in the air. He was dumped into the sea and when he crawled onto the battleship there was a beautiful girl standing there. She said her name was Lyx, the princess of another world, and added, "My Father is Japanese, Shinjiro Sakomizu. Please help me, Suzuki."

Based on the novel series by the Gundam creator Yoshiyuki Tomino.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Rean no Tsubasa are mixed. Some viewers appreciate the unique mecha designs and initial setup, while others are frustrated by the confusing plot, rushed pacing, and disappointing ending. The series is best enjoyed with an understanding of Yoshiyuki Tomino's directorial style and a willingness to accept its flaws.
pros: Inventive mecha designs (giant bugs)
Good art and music
Interesting characters
cons: Wordy and confusing plot in the initial episodes
Rushed pacing and underdeveloped themes
Dissatisfying ending

anime.title: Magikano
anime.synopsis: Ayumi Mamiya is a witch cursed to lose her powers and only one boy can break the spell. Haruo Yoshikawa thinks he is a normal boy but unknown to him his three sisters have magical powers and keep him protected and ignorant about the existence of magic. Now Ayumi must wake up Haruo's latent powers to save herself but his sisters will have none of that.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Magikano are mixed. Many find the anime funny and entertaining, particularly praising the voice acting and humor. However, significant criticisms target the weak plot, reliance on genre cliches, and a disappointing ending. This makes it a divisive anime, enjoyable for some but frustrating for others.
pros: Good voice acting, especially in the English dub, enhances the humor.
Catchy opening and ending themes.
Enjoyable and amusing, providing plenty of laughs.
cons: Weak or half-assed story and character development.
Ending is abrupt, unsatisfying, and renders previous events pointless.
Relies heavily on clichés and tropes of the harem genre.
Some characters are unlikeable and annoying.

anime.title: Eternal Alice
anime.romaji_title: Kagi Hime Monogatari: Eikyuu Alice Rondo
anime.synopsis:
Average high school student Aruto Kirihara is obsessed with the Alice stories, written in this alternate world by the enigmatic recluse, Alternite L. Tachyon. One night, while writing his own version of a potential "third book," he sees a girl flying in front of a full moon... and she looks just like the "Alice" in his imagination. Aruto runs out of his house and chases the flying figure from the ground, ending up at a library, where he witnesses her in combat with another costumed girl.

And so begins his sudden introduction to the world of Alices, an elite club of super-powered teenage girls who regularly fight in an extra-dimensional Wonderland in order to steal each other's "hidden stories." When all of the stories have been gathered, they will form the legendary third volume, "Eternal Alice," and the possessor will be granted one wish.

It probably won't be Aruto, who can't turn into a magical girl. But it could be his doting little sister, Kiraha. Or maybe the girl of his dreams, Arisu...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some appreciating the unique story elements, art style, and engaging episode structure. However, others criticize the generic harem elements, over-sexualization, dated animation, and uninspired characters. The show has some creative aspects, but also suffers from dull elements and generic characters, leading to a middling overall reception.
pros: Interesting subject matter with each episode leaving you with a desire to continue.
Art style is perfect, very moe-like and colourful, nothing seems out of place, even during action sequences, the art is pretty much detailed.
Original story and amusing intermingled connections.
Creative aspects make it worth watching.
cons: Generic story, sounds like a generic harem anime.
Over sexualisation of characters.
Awful animation, like animation made in the 1980s with barely any movement.
Dull opening and ending themes.
Generic and oblivious male protagonist.
Annoying little sister character.
Characters actual personalities were pretty generic.

anime.title: Grave of the Fireflies
anime.synopsis:
As World War II reaches its conclusion in 1945, Japan faces widespread destruction in the form of American bombings, devastating city after city. Hotaru no Haka, also known as Grave of the Fireflies, is the story of Seita and his sister Setsuko, two Japanese children whose lives are ravaged by the brutal war. They have lost their mother, their father, their home, and the prospect of a bright future—all tragic consequences of the war.

Now orphaned and homeless, Seita and Setsuko have no choice but to drift across the countryside, beset by starvation and disease. Met with the apathy of adults along the way, they find that desperate circumstances can turn even the kindest of people cruel yet their youthful hope shines brightly in the face of unrelenting hardship, preventing the siblings from swiftly succumbing to an inevitable fate.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus strongly affirms Grave of the Fireflies as a profoundly moving and masterfully crafted tragedy. While universally praised for its emotional impact, animation, and realistic depiction of war's toll on children, some viewers find the predictable nature of the tragedy and certain character decisions to be minor drawbacks.
pros: Deeply emotional and devastating impact
Realistic and unflinching portrayal of war's effects on children
Beautiful and evocative animation and art style
Compelling and well-developed sibling relationship
Nuanced portrayal of characters without clear heroes or villains
cons: Predictable tragic outcome lessens some impact
Some find Setsuko's characterization annoying
Seita's pride and actions can be frustrating to watch
Music, while atmospheric, is not always memorable or can be misused

anime.title: Battle Programmer Shirase
anime.synopsis: Battle Programmer Shirase, also known as BPS, is a free programmer with super hacking abilities who doesn't work for money. What he does work for is certainly something that only people like him would appreciate. But, his demeanor certainly doesn't suit the jobs he is hired for. With the evil King of America causing trouble via the internet, Shirase is nothing but busy as each new adventure brings even more interesting people into the picture.
anime.consensus_summary: Battle Programmer Shirase is a controversial anime due to its heavy reliance on potentially offensive humor and the sexualization of a minor. While some viewers appreciated its unique premise and comedic elements, others found it to be poorly executed and disturbing. The show's abrupt ending and repetitive nature further contributed to its mixed reception, leaving many feeling disappointed or uneasy.
pros: Unique concept of a programmer solving problems for unusual rewards.
Catchy opening theme and memorable voice acting.
Some found the humor enjoyable, particularly the recurring jokes, when they worked.
cons: Frequent and overt sexualization of a minor character.
Repetitive storylines and jokes that become tiresome.
Poor animation quality, unoriginal character designs, and dull color palette.
Abrupt ending due to cancellation.

anime.title: Scorched Bread
anime.synopsis: An accident in the bakery's oven caused a piece of bread to stay in the oven for way too long. Thus Kogepan was born - a piece of burnt bread, having no chance to be sold.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Kogepan to be a surprisingly thoughtful and heartwarming anime, especially considering its simple premise and short episodes. Viewers appreciate the deep themes explored, such as aging, loneliness, and self-acceptance, often presented metaphorically through the burnt bread characters. While some find the animation simplistic, most agree that it complements the overall mood and message of the show, making it a worthwhile and enjoyable watch for all ages.
pros: Deep themes explored in short episodes.
Relatable characters despite being bread.
Effective storytelling with life lessons.
Simple yet charming animation style.
Bouncy, mood-lifting music.
cons: Minimalist art style may not appeal to everyone.
Some arcs remain unresolved due to short length.
Story is very simple, more for children.

anime.title: Sexy Commando Gaiden: Sugoi yo!! Masaru-san
anime.romaji_title: Sexy Commando Gaiden: Sugoi yo!! Masaru-san
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Martial Arts, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Okometsubu Fujiyama has recently transferred over to a new school, Wakame High School. His goal is to make 100 friends--until he meets the extremely weird Masaru Hananakajima. Masaru is a martial artist whose specialty is the "Sexy Commando" form of martial art. Masaru forms a club based on this art, including Fujiyama, who he nicknames Fuumin, in the club. The club becomes full of strange, yet wacky people. Aliens, mustaches, and cute fuzzy animals are encountered as the club moves along and gets steadily more popular.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Sexy Commando Gaiden: Sugoi yo!! Masaru-san" is a highly enjoyable comedy anime known for its unique, bizarre, and random humor. While its unconventional style may not appeal to everyone, those who appreciate its particular brand of Japanese comedy will find it hilarious and memorable. The show is praised for its distinct characters, excellent voice acting, and fitting soundtrack, although the animation quality reflects its age.
pros: Unique and bizarre humor that sets it apart from other comedies
Memorable and distinct characters, especially Masaru
Excellent voice acting that enhances the comedic timing
Catchy and fitting soundtrack that complements the show's tone
Creative and unconventional art style that suits the comedy
cons: Humor can be too Japanese-specific and may not appeal to all viewers
Animation quality reflects its age and may seem choppy to some
Storyline is weak and relies heavily on random and absurd situations
First episodes can be slow to get into before the main cast is assembled
Some arcs are not as enjoyable as others

anime.title: Noein: To Your Other Self
anime.romaji_title: Noein: Mou Hitori no Kimi e
anime.synopsis:
During their last summer of elementary school, four friends decide to undertake a test of courage at their local graveyard. Before the test begins, Haruka Kaminogi makes a last effort to pull Yuu Gotou away from his controlling mother. While doing so, Haruka suddenly has a strange vision of blue snow followed by the appearance of an imposing silver-haired man. Later, a similar vision occurs at the graveyard to both Haruka and her friends before they try to escape what they assume are ghosts.

Unbeknownst to the children, the people who appeared before them are Dragon Soldiers: an elite military group from a dimension known as La'cryma. The soldiers have traveled to this dimension to secure the "Dragon Torque"—an entity they believe to be their last hope for survival.  However, both the Dragon Soldiers and Haruka are shocked to learn that the Dragon Torque is Haruka herself. She attempts to escape from the Dragon Soldiers as she finds her own last ray of hope—the strange silver-haired man who claims to be another version of Yuu himself.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for its ambitious themes and character focus being countered by criticism of inconsistent production values and a convoluted plot. Many find the blend of sci-fi and character drama compelling, while others are turned off by the slow pace and occasional animation issues. Ultimately, "Noein" seems to resonate most with viewers who appreciate its philosophical depth and are willing to overlook its technical shortcomings.
pros: Intelligent exploration of quantum physics and parallel universes.
Strong character development and relatable characters.
Unique and visually striking art style (for some).
cons: Inconsistent art and animation quality.
Confusing plot and slow pacing in the middle.
Underdeveloped or unlikeable characters (e.g., Yuu).

anime.title: Whisper of the Heart
anime.synopsis:
Shizuku Tsukishima is an energetic 14-year-old girl who enjoys reading and writing poetry in her free time. Glancing at the checkout cards of her books one evening, she notices that her library books are frequently checked out by a boy named Seiji Amasawa. Curiosity strikes Shizuku, and she decides to search for the boy who shares her love for literature.

Meeting a peculiar cat on the train, Shizuku follows the animal and is eventually led to a quaint antique shop, where she learns about a cat statuette known as "The Baron." Taking an interest in the shop, she surprisingly finds Seiji, and the two quickly befriend one another. Shizuku learns while acquainting herself with Seiji that he has a dream that he would like to fulfill, causing her dismay as she remains uncertain of her future and has yet to recognize her talents.

However, as her relationship with Seiji grows, Shizuku becomes determined to work toward a goal. Guided by the whispers of her heart and inspiration from The Baron, she resolves to carve out her own potential and dreams.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience widely praises 'Whisper of the Heart' for its realistic portrayal of adolescence, character depth, and beautiful animation. While some viewers find the pacing slow or the romance underdeveloped, the overwhelming sentiment is one of appreciation for its heartwarming and inspiring coming-of-age narrative. It's considered a mature and subtly magical Ghibli film that resonates deeply with its focus on self-discovery and creativity.
pros: Exceptional attention to detail in character animation and movements, creating a realistic and vibrant feel.
Profoundly accurate and insightful portrayal of adolescent psychology and emotions.
Beautiful and expressive animation with detailed backgrounds and character designs.
Realistic and seamless character interactions that feel organic and relatable.
Inspiring depiction of self-discovery, pursuing dreams, and developing one's talents.
cons: Pacing can be slow and tedious for viewers expecting a more action-driven plot.
The romance aspect between the main characters is sometimes perceived as underdeveloped or lacking chemistry.
The film's focus on ordinary life might be considered mundane or uneventful by some.
The use of 'Country Roads' as a theme song can be overused or annoying to some viewers.
Animation inconsistency is noted by some, with character movement sometimes appearing choppy compared to backgrounds.

anime.title: Ayakashi: Samurai Horror Tales
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Historical, Horror, Mystery, Mythology, Psychological, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis: A collection of three classic Japanese horror stories: "Yotsuya Kaidan", the story of a wife betrayed by her husband who seeks vengeance even in death. "Tenshu Monogatari", the story of forbidden love between a goddess and a human, and "Bakeneko", the story of a mysterious cat monster with a vendetta against a certain family.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the unique art style and faithful adaptations of Japanese folklore, but criticism for inconsistent animation quality and uneven character development. The Bakeneko arc stands out as the most popular, while opinions on the other arcs vary. Overall, viewers appreciate the series' attempt to showcase classic Japanese horror but acknowledge its flaws.
pros: Unique art style, particularly in the Bakeneko arc, creates a visually stunning experience reminiscent of Edo-period paintings.
Faithful adaptations of classic Japanese horror stories offer insight into traditional culture and folklore.
Engaging storytelling, especially in the Yotsuya Kaidan and Bakeneko arcs, provides suspense and intrigue.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality across the arcs, with noticeable corner-cutting and budget limitations.
Uneven character development, with some characters lacking depth and compelling motivations.
The opening rap song is considered an inappropriate and jarring choice that clashes with the traditional themes.

anime.title: Looking Up At The Half-Moon
anime.romaji_title: Hanbun no Tsuki ga Noboru Sora
anime.synopsis: After contracting hepatitis A, Ezaki Yuuichi has been confined to a hospital, away from his friends and family, much to his displeasure. To relieve his boredom, he has taken to sneaking out of the hospital, usually putting himself on the receiving end of a beating from his nurse. Upon meeting a girl his age also staying in the hospital, he is immediately captivated by her beauty. Akiba Rika's personality is not quite as captivating as her beauty however. In fact, she is rather selfish, moody, and bossy. But as the two spend more time with each other, they become closer, sharing the ordinary joys and trials of a budding teenage romance, even when darkened with impending tragedy—for Rika's condition does not leave her much longer to live.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many finding the anime to be a touching and well-executed romance/drama, especially given its short length. However, others criticize the rushed plot, unrealistic elements, and tonal inconsistencies.  While the characters and emotional moments resonate, the execution leaves something to be desired for some viewers.
pros: Touching story effectively uses its short run time.
Characters are well-developed and relatable, especially the main duo.
Music and art style fit the overall theme and enhance emotional impact.
cons: Rushed plot development and forced character interactions due to the limited number of episodes.
Some character actions and plot points are unrealistic or over the top.
Inconsistent tone with humor clashing with serious themes.

anime.title: Guardian Ninja Mamoru
anime.synopsis: Kagemori Mamoru is a dowdy boy whose hair is disheveled and who wears thick glasses, but he is actually the son of a ninja family. They have protected their neighbors, the Konnyaku family, secretly for 400 years. Mamoru has personally protected their daughter, Konnyaku Yuuna, since they were in kindergarten. When Yuuna is in trouble, Mamoru puts on ninja suit and turns into a competent ninja to help her.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Kage kara Mamoru!" is viewed as a lighthearted and funny anime, mainly due to its comedic situations and quirky characters. The show blends ninja action with school comedy, but the storyline is somewhat predictable.  However, the series is let down by a poorly executed dramatic shift in the last two episodes, which diminishes the overall enjoyment, though most agree that it's still a funny anime.
pros: Funny and enjoyable comedy with well-suited characters.
Good mix of ninjas and school comedy in various situations.
Upbeat music and opening/closing themes.
Stylish combat scenes with humor.
cons: Predictable storyline.
Animation could be more dynamic during action scenes.
Disastrous ending with an abrupt shift in tone and poorly written conflict.
Clumsy and idiotic main female character may be irritating to some viewers.

anime.title: Infinite Ryvius
anime.genres: Award Winning, Drama, Mecha, Military, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis: The year is AD 2225. Kouji Aiba and Aoi Housen are serving as astronauts in-training in Liebe Delta which is located on the edge of the Geduld Sea. When saboteurs with unknown intents suddenly strike during a routine dive procedure, the space station plummets into the Geduld, a plasma field that links all the planets like a nervous system and crushes any ship that strays too far into it. With all the adults onboard killed, the young astronauts will have to survive this long journey home in midst of the growing tension amongst each other. Meanwhile the organizers of the sabotage look on and prepare to attack once more.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Mugen no Ryvius are mixed. While many appreciate the show's complex characters, exploration of human nature, and thought-provoking themes, others are put off by the dated animation, slow pacing, and confusing plot elements. The series is praised for its psychological depth and character-driven narrative, but criticized for its technical shortcomings and lack of clear resolutions.
pros: Extensive character development, with characters changing and evolving in believable ways.
Story focuses on human nature and how people act in desperate situations, creating a dark and dramatic narrative.
Exploration of complex emotions, human struggle, and societal dynamics within a confined environment.
cons: Outdated animation and soundtrack that may detract from the viewing experience for some.
Slow pacing in the first half of the series, with some viewers finding it dull and uneventful.
Unanswered questions and confusing plot elements that are never fully explained, leading to frustration.

anime.title: Naruto: The Lost Story - Mission: Protect the Waterfall Village
anime.romaji_title: Naruto: Takigakure no Shitou - Ore ga Eiyuu Dattebayo!
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
After safely escorting the cowardly Takigakure leader Shibuki to his homeland, Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, and Sakura Haruno are taken aback by the village's sudden invasion of rogue ninjas. As their teacher Kakashi Hatake had departed for Konohagakure beforehand, the team is left to deal with the attacking forces on their own. 

While the group prepares for a rescue operation, they learn that Suien, the mastermind behind the assault, is pursuing the Hero Water—an elixir that briefly increases the chakra of those who drink it by tenfold. Knowing that the liquid is in Shibuki's possession, Suien takes the villagers hostage to use them as a bargaining chip. 

Despite the odds stacked against them, Naruto fights the enemy heroically, spurring Shibuki on to discover the courage to protect his people.
anime.consensus_summary: The Naruto special is a simple, entertaining side story for Naruto fans. It features a generic plot with some underdeveloped characters, but it offers a glimpse of the original Team 7 in their early days. The animation and sound are consistent with the series, and some appreciate Shibuki's character arc.
pros: Enjoyable short story
Good chance to see old team seven in action
Shibuki's character development
cons: Generic plot
Sakura is useless
Villains are generic
Emotional payoff is minimal

anime.title: X: An Omen
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Shoujo, Super Power
anime.synopsis: In this prequel to the "X" TV series, a beautiful, young, bedridden dreamgazer named Kakyou remembers the life and death of a remarkable young woman whom he met in dreams. He also recounts his dreams of a tragic future in which the fate of the Earth will be decided.
anime.consensus_summary: The X OVA is visually appealing and presents a captivating narrative, but falls short due to an ultimately disappointing ending and underdeveloped character arcs. While the themes of sacrifice and destiny are engaging, the lack of resolution leaves viewers wanting more. The OVA is not polarizing, with a general sense of unfulfilled potential rather than strong dislike.
pros: Pretty and elaborate art style
Fascinating story
cons: Unsatisfying ending
Plot potential unfulfilled
Characters not fully explored

anime.title: Chobits: Chibits - Sumomo and Kotoko Deliver
anime.synopsis: When Hideki Motosuwa leaves his apartment and accidentally forgets his wallet, Chii takes the wallet and follows him, leaving Sumomo and Kotoko alone in the apartment. It doesn’t take long time until Sumomo discovers that Chii forgot her panties, so Sumomo and Kotoko sets out on an adventurous trip to return the panties to Chii.
anime.consensus_summary: The Chobits special 'Chibits' is a short, cute episode primarily aimed at fans of the original series. While some appreciate the consistent animation and character cuteness, others find the plot simplistic, Chi's voice jarring, and the humor exaggerated. The special also contains fan service elements and some disturbing scenes which are viewed negatively.
pros: Cute characters Sumomo and Kotoko are enjoyable.
Animation and sound effects are consistent with the original series.
A quick and enjoyable addition for fans of Chobits.
cons: The plot is simple and may not appeal to all viewers.
Chi's voice sounds different and less appealing in this special.
Some find Sumomo annoying.
Panty fetish content is prominent.
Some scenes are disturbing and hard to forget.

anime.title: The Cat Returns
anime.genres: Adventure, Anthropomorphic, Award Winning, Drama, Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
High school student Haru Yoshioka is bored with the monotony of life. One day, she saves Prince Lune of the Cat Kingdom from being run over by a truck. As a token of gratitude, the Cat King sends her "presents" and invites her to the Cat Kingdom to become Lune's wife. Haru's inability to properly communicate with the cats leads to the misunderstanding that she has accepted the proposal.

As Haru ponders on ways to escape the predicament, a mysterious voice instructs her to search for the Cat Bureau. However, not long after she finally arrives at the bureau, a horde of cats swarms in and forcibly takes her to the Cat Kingdom, along with a member of the Cat Bureau. Concerned for their safety, owner of the Cat Bureau, Baron Humbert von Gikkingen, follows close behind.

The more Haru immerses herself in the activities of the Cat Kingdom, the more cat-like she becomes. To her dismay, she soon learns that, unless she can find her true self, she may become a cat permanently. Haru's adventures in the world of cats lead her down a path to self-discovery, allowing her to return as a more confident person.
anime.consensus_summary: The Cat Returns is generally viewed as an enjoyable, lighthearted Ghibli film, though not one of their best. While praised for its humor, characters, and pleasant tone, it is criticized for a predictable story, underdeveloped protagonist, and somewhat lacking artistic depth compared to other Ghibli productions. Overall, it's a fun, whimsical adventure that is easy to enjoy but may not leave a lasting impact.
pros: Enjoyable and humorous story, especially for Studio Ghibli fans.
Memorable and lovable characters with distinct personalities.
Pleasant music and well-done English dub.
Well-paced and concise adventure.
cons: Predictable plot and lacks tension.
Underdeveloped characters, especially the protagonist Haru.
Mediocre art style compared to other Ghibli films.
Story feels too easy with deus ex machina solutions.

anime.title: Android Kikaider - The Animation
anime.synopsis:
The genius robotics professor, Dr. Komyoji has created Kikaider—a humanoid robot tasked with the protection of Dr. Komyoji's son and daughter. Gifted with the conscience circuit, Kikaider is given the power to simulate real emotions that helps to distinguish between "right and wrong."

Can Kikaider protect Dr. Komyoji's children and battle against the evil Dr. Gill and his army of androids? The fight against world domination lies in the hands of Kikaider.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the anime's faithfulness to the original source material and the main character's development. However, others criticize the pacing, simplistic writing, and outdated art style. Overall, the anime seems to appeal more to fans of the original tokusatsu series and those who appreciate a nostalgic aesthetic, but falls short for viewers seeking modern, sophisticated storytelling.
pros: Faithful to the original manga art style.
Well-developed main character with a compelling journey.
Music is well-done, especially the opening theme.
Animation is top-notch with great action scenes (Review 1).
cons: Pacing issues, especially with the initial bonding of characters.
Trite, lazy writing, particularly with the romantic subplot.
Simplistic and non-challenging handling of philosophical questions.
Low-effort artwork that resembles anime from the 70s with stiff movements and reused animation.

anime.title: Legend of Duo
anime.synopsis:
It is the early 21st century, and mankind is doomed. Due to a mysterious virus that steals the essence of human life, humanity has been pushed to the brink of extinction with only one hope for salvation: the blood of a vampire. Vampires have closely guarded the key to curing the virus for several years, which has led to an immense rift between them and humans and the world's descension into chaos.

A vampire named Duo, having leaked the secret to saving humanity, is now considered a traitor to his race, and the powerful vampire Zieg is on his trail. However, due to Zieg's sense of duty, his heart is torn: should he kill the man who betrayed his people, or will his personal history with Duo sway him to have a change of heart?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Legend of Duo are highly divided. Some viewers praise its unique artistic style, philosophical themes, and poetic dialogue, considering it a misunderstood masterpiece. However, a larger portion criticizes the show for its extremely low-budget animation, rushed storyline, flat characters, and overall lack of polish, labeling it a poorly executed and disappointing experience.
pros: Original and detailed story
Poetic dialogues
Impressive static art and character designs
Thought-provoking themes
Unique visual style for death scenes
cons: Extremely limited and cheap animation
Rushed and underdeveloped plot
Flat and stereotypical characters
Repetitive and uninspired music
Overreliance on still frames and panning shots
Poor lip-syncing

anime.title: Cat Soup
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Avant Garde, Award Winning, Comedy, Psychological
anime.synopsis: The main character, a cat named Nyatto, embarks upon a journey to save his sister's soul, which was ripped in two when Nyatto tried to save her from Death. She trails after him, brain-dead. They encounter many brilliant, mind-bending situations, beginning with a disturbing magic show.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions to Nekojiru-sou are highly divided. Some appreciate its surreal and thought-provoking nature, praising the unique visuals and open-ended storytelling. However, others find it meaningless, confusing, and ultimately boring due to its lack of narrative coherence and character development. The film's experimental style appeals to a niche audience but alienates those seeking a more traditional viewing experience.
pros: Original and imaginative visuals create a dreamlike atmosphere.
Simple yet deep storytelling allows for personal interpretation.
Effective use of sound and minimalistic dialogue enhances the surreal experience.
cons: Lack of clear plot or meaning frustrates some viewers.
Randomness and incoherence can lead to boredom and confusion.
Minimal character development makes it hard to connect with characters.

anime.title: Pretty Cure
anime.synopsis:
Middle school students Nagisa Misumi and Honoka Yukishiro are the epitome of dissimilarity. Popular with their classmates, Nagisa is the school's energetic star lacrosse player, while Honoka is the soft-spoken "Queen of Intelligence."

As unrelated as they may seem, Nagisa and Honoka live double lives as the "emissaries of light": Cure Black and Cure White of Pretty Cure. With the assistance of two fairies, Mipple and Mepple, the girls fight against the Dotsuku Zone—an evil force that has invaded the Garden of Light. In order to prevent the Dotsuku Zone from taking over the Garden of Rainbows as well, the pair must work together to find seven Prism Stones and restore the Prism Hopish to drive out the vile forces.

With strong foes standing in their way, Nagisa and Honoka learn to work together and harness their newfound powers in order to save the worlds from further ruin.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some finding the series enjoyable for its characters and action, while others are critical of the repetitive plot and weak villains. The series is considered a good starting point for the Pretty Cure franchise by some, while others recommend starting with later seasons. Overall, the series is seen as an average but enjoyable magical girl show that may be best suited for existing fans of the genre.
pros: Strong female leads with excellent dynamic.
Good character development, especially for Nagisa and Honoka.
Fun and funny moments, with some emotional depth.
Well-choreographed action scenes.
Original plot idea
cons: Repetitive plot, especially in the second half.
Villains are often one-dimensional and lack personality.
Mascot characters can be annoying.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Formulaic episodes

anime.title: Magical Stage Fancy Lala
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Idols (Female), Mahou Shoujo, Music, Romance
anime.synopsis: Miho Shinohara is a care-free third-grader and an aspiring manga artist. One day, she encounters Mogu and Pigu - two lost fairies disguised as stuffed animals. In exchange for staying at her home until they find a way to return to their own world, the fairies give Miho a special sketch pad and pencil that enable her to magically create real objects from what she draws. With the pen, Miho can also transform into Lala, a beautiful teenage girl created from her manga art. As Lala, she is discovered by a talent agency, and so begins her adventures from an ordinary school girl to a model to an idol singer.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Mahou no Stage Fancy Lala" is viewed as a hidden gem within the magical girl genre. Many appreciate its focus on character development and mature themes, setting it apart from typical idol shows. However, the ending is a point of contention for some, impacting their overall enjoyment, while others found it fitting. Despite minor issues, the show is generally praised for its art, music, and heartwarming story.
pros: Strong character development, especially Miho's growth
Subtle drama expressed through facial expressions and nuanced moments
Animation is detailed and expressive for its time
Story explores mature themes and real-world problems
cons: Lack of explanation for the magical elements and their origin
The ending is considered a downer and poorly executed by some viewers
Some find the initial episodes misleading or slow to start

anime.title: I'm Gonna Be an Angel!
anime.synopsis:
Yuusuke was just a normal kid going to high school. Then one day, the cute and behaloed Noelle fell, quite literally, into his life, naked as a baby and every bit as innocent. Before he can even fathom what's just happened, Yuusuke is inducted into a rather odd family of otherworldly beings. 

Papa is a Frankenstein monster with a taste for calisthenics. Mama is a gorgeous lady with a penchant for "round objects" -- really! The eldest sister, Sara, is literally invisible; the brother, Gabriel, is a teenage vampire with an attitude problem; and the youngest sister, Ruka, loves inventing things. There's a disapproving Grandma, who's a witch to the nth degree, and her vulture familiar. All Yuusuke wanted was for the beautiful Natsumi to even notice his attention, but now he has an angel-in-training to follow him wherever he goes. And Noelle, too, has a guide on her path to being an angel, the mysterious Michael.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Tenshi ni Narumon!. Some appreciate the comedic and romantic aspects, as well as the unique characters, while others find the plot disjointed and the ending unsatisfying. The series is seen as fun and entertaining, but also strangely dark and physiological, leading to a split in opinions regarding its overall quality.
pros: Characters are eccentric and have distinct personalities
Music is great from start to finish
The romantic aspects are well thought out and the resolution feels natural
cons: Plot is all over the place and doesn't seem to know what it wants to be
Many questions are left unanswered
Ending was disappointing

anime.title: Carried by the Wind: Tsukikage Ran
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Historical, Martial Arts, Samurai
anime.synopsis: In the Edo or Tokugawa period (1600–1868), Ran, a female wandering samurai whose skill with the katana is only matched by her taste for sake (rice wine), is joined by a chinese martial artist who calls herself Lady Meow of the Iron Cat Fist. Tsukikage Ran has individual episodes that are just short stories of their adventures.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Kazemakase Tsukikage Ran' as a lighthearted and fun anime, praising the characters and setting. However, some find the episodic nature and formulaic plots repetitive.  The lack of depth and character backstory is also a common criticism, though many appreciate it for what it is: a simple, enjoyable adventure.
pros: Enjoyable and funny characters, especially Ran
Well-choreographed action scenes
Evocative of the Edo period setting with good music and character design
Simple, fun, and doesn't try to be overly ambitious
Good mix of comedy and action
cons: Formulaic and repetitive episodes
Lack of deep story or character backgrounds
Sanitized action with virtually no blood
Meow's character can be annoying
Drama is weaker than the comedy

anime.title: Fairy Musketeers
anime.synopsis:
Long, long ago, there existed a world of magic and science. God, afraid of man's potential, split the world in to the world of science, Elde, and the world of magic, Fandavale. One day in Fandavale, a terrible witch named Cendrillon (Cinderella) revives. Cendrillon plots to rule both worlds, and searches for the "key" which holds tremendous power.

A young boy from Elde by the name of Sōta meets a mysterious girl from Fandavale, Akazukin, and her talking wolf companion, Val. Sōta learns that he is the key Cendrillon is searching for. Now it is up to Akazukin, Val, and the other Fairy Musketeers to protect Sōta from Cendrillon and her Nightmarelians who wish to obtain the power he mysteriously possesses.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is generally positive, particularly among its target demographic. Reviewers find the show enjoyable and appreciate its unique take on fairy tales, although some critique its simplistic character development and generic soundtrack. While not a standout, it's considered a worthwhile watch, especially for younger viewers.
pros: Unique twists on fairy tale lore
Consistently enjoyable animation by Madhouse
Character interaction is good, morals and themes are where they should be
cons: Lack of genuine character development; sudden and jarring changes
Some characters are irritating and serve little purpose
Generic anime soundtrack
Repetitive music

anime.title: Sakura Wars: The Movie
anime.synopsis: The Imperial Fighting Troupe is called again to defend Tokyo against the demons. However, this time, the Douglas-Stewart Company is selling a superior fighting machine that will revolutionize Japan's defense and make the Flower Division obsolete. However, the girls suspect something may be wrong when members of their team begin to vanish! But what can they do when their division has been placed on indefinite stand-by status?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, leaning towards positive for existing fans and critical for newcomers. The strong music and character art are highlights, but the predictable plot and poor CGI detract from the experience. The film is best enjoyed with prior knowledge of the Sakura Taisen universe.
pros: Great music and musical numbers
Good character art and backgrounds
Dramatic performance between Sakura and Lachette
cons: Predictable story
Poor CGI, especially in action scenes
Underdeveloped characters for newcomers
Antagonist lacks depth
Inconsistent character art with some similar character designs

anime.title: Platonic Chain
anime.synopsis: In the near future, technology has made a few leaps and bounds, and videophones and constant wireless internet access are available to everyone. However, it would seen that the government has been careless and a skilled hacker was able to break into the national information archive. Using the data held there he creates the Platonic Chain website for people to discover information about themselves and their friends. Words start to spread quickly that there is a site that enables you to look up anything. Coincidentally, three young girls, Hitomi, Rika, and Kanae, are able to access the site.
anime.consensus_summary: Platonic Chain is viewed as a unique and intriguing anime with a thought-provoking premise about technology and privacy. While the dated animation and short episodes are drawbacks, the series is appreciated for its nostalgic Y2K aesthetic and accurate portrayal of early 2000s culture. The show's exploration of mundane life in a dystopian setting resonates with viewers, making it a worthwhile watch for those interested in a historical artifact and technology exploration.
pros: Interesting premise exploring privacy in a technologically advanced world.
Accurate representation of early 2000s culture and technology.
Charming and unique early 3D CGI animation style.
Solid character designs that effectively communicate personality.
Exploration of mundane life with dystopian tech creates a surreal atmosphere.
cons: Short episodes with a significant portion dedicated to opening and ending themes.
Dated CGI animation that may not appeal to all viewers.
Incomplete or underdeveloped plot lines in later episodes.
Dull or uninspired soundtrack.
Simple characters.

anime.title: PetoPeto-san
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Mythology, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: After centuries of antagonism and misunderstanding, the Japanese finally welcome youkai into their community. In an attempt at species integration, normal children begin attending school with paranormal creatures who are quite humanoid. Shingo Ohashi finds himself developing feelings for Hatoko "Petoko" Fujimura, a half-youkai half-human girl whose powers are: uncontrollable cuteness to enchant those around her (similar to a low-power succubus), get stuck to any other person who touches her bare flesh (cured by her falling asleep), and the ability to disappear even at the molecular stage (which she can for the most part control).
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, PetoPeto-san is viewed as a cute and quirky anime with memorable characters and a surprisingly sensitive story, although the animation quality and some plot elements are criticized. The ending is considered satisfying, and the music is a highlight. Viewers appreciate the focus on friendship and racial integration over typical romance tropes.
pros: Memorable and distinct characters
Brilliant opening and ending music
Accidentally clever and sensitive take on the source material
Supportive male MC, intense friendship dynamics
Satisfying ending that returns to the story's roots
cons: Low animation budget and inconsistent character design in some episodes
Little Sister Heaven arc derails the story focus
Animation is not remarkable
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Racial Integration, Innocent Romance

anime.title: The Chronicle of the Big Battle between Yin and Yang
anime.synopsis: Riku Tachibana is an average 1st year junior high school student who was supposed to be living a peaceful, ordinary life, but just after entering junior high he ends up fighting a duel against a mysterious man calling himself “a Warrior of Earth,” and Riku’s life is changed forever! Riku discovers that he is a survivor of the believed extinct “Warriors of Heaven,” Using a device called “DRIVE” and summoning a Shikigami, or “Divine Beast,” called Kogenta to his side, Riku devotes his life to the battle against the Warriors of Earth!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Onmyou Taisenki, praising its characters, themes of friendship and betrayal, and engaging story. Some find the art and music unremarkable and the summoning system unconventional for the genre. Overall, the anime is considered an underrated gem with a heartwarming story.
pros: Unique characters
Well-developed characters
Enjoyable story with friendship and betrayal themes
cons: Typical anime art style
Unmemorable music
Pokedex-like summoning system feels out of place for Onmyouji genre

anime.title: Madam is a Magical Girl
anime.synopsis: Ureshiko Asaba, 26 years old, married. Few people know the fact that she is a magical girl named "Agnes", and she is actually the guardian of the town where she lives. One day she meets Sayaka Kurenai, aka "Cruje", another magical girl appointed by the magic realm as the legitimate sucessor to her position, but Agnes is reluctant in letting her assume because she knows that Cruje has orders to erase the whole place, including its human inhabitants with the purpose of creating a new one. To complicate matters, Ureshiko must deal with the growing distance between her and her husband, Tamotsu, her crescent feelings for Tatsumi Kagura, a young man who is now living as a tenant in her home, and the fact that in the moment she ever kisses a common human, she would lose her powers forever.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Okusama wa Mahou Shoujo' positively, appreciating its mature themes and character-driven narrative. While the fan service and occasional animation hiccups are noted, the strong writing, excellent voice acting, and surprisingly deep story resonate well. The series is recommended even to those who aren't typically fans of the magical girl genre, though the ambiguous ending might leave some viewers wanting more.
pros: Well-developed characters that drive the plot.
Mature writing that deals with complex adult problems.
High-quality animation and artwork with detailed backgrounds.
Excellent voice acting performances (Seiyuu).
cons: Repetitive fan service.
Inconsistent animation continuity in some episodes.
Unremarkable music score, particularly the battle theme.
Some important questions are left unanswered.

anime.title: Nurse Witch Komugi
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Mahou Shoujo, Otaku Culture, Parody
anime.synopsis: Ungrar, the King of Viruses, has escaped from his prison cell in Vaccine World. Maya, the Goddess of Vaccine World sends Mugimaru down to Earth to find a human to accept the powers of Vaccine World and become the Magical Nurse. He finds the best (and the only willing) person for the job when he meets Komugi Nakahara. Komugi is a playful, lazy, and easily distracted (typical) teenager whose dream is to become a cosplay idol. Balancing her career with the Kiri-Pro Promotion Company and her new job battling Ungrar's loyal henchman, the Magical Maid Koyori, Komugi delights audiences in this parody anime series.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers found Nurse Witch Komugi-chan to be a hilarious and enjoyable parody of the magical girl genre with clever references and strong character designs. Others found it annoying, poorly written, and overly reliant on fanservice. Nostalgia for early 2000s anime culture seems to heavily influence enjoyment.
pros: Humorous and referential, especially for those familiar with early 2000s otaku culture.
Strong character designs and voice acting.
Enjoyable for fans of magical girl parodies and similar anime like Excel Saga and Puni Puni Poemi.
cons: Plot is weak and often devolves into nonsense.
Relies heavily on fanservice and boob jokes.
Humor can be grating and annoying, especially Komugi's voice and the constant bickering.

anime.title: Nurse Angel Ririka SOS
anime.synopsis: The Evil Forces of Dark Joker are closing in on our planet after having destroyed the beautiful planet of Queen Earth. Now, 10 year old Moriya Ririka, with the help of her childhood friend Seiya and the mysterious Kanon, must transform into the Nurse Angel and find the elusive Flower of Life, the only way to defeat the evil forces. The Flower of Life, that once bloomed all over the Earth, is where no one thought it ever would be. And Ririka must make the hardest decision of her life in order to acquire it and rid the universe of evil once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Nurse Angel Ririka SOS is a classic magical girl anime that starts off with familiar tropes but evolves into a sincere and heartfelt story. While some find the initial cliches and music choices off-putting, others praise its character development and daring ending. The show is generally seen as a solid entry in the magical girl genre, though not particularly groundbreaking.
pros: Genuine and sincere storytelling
Characters develop nicely and avert magical girl tropes
Ballsy and daring ending
Classic shoujo art style
cons: Cliche characters at the start
Unfitting music in tear-jerking scenes
Plot is standard for the magical girl genre
forgettable music
Bland character design

anime.title: Ninja Scroll
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Gore, Historical, Horror, Martial Arts, Romance, Samurai
anime.synopsis:
Jubei Kibagami wanders feudal Japan as an itinerant swordsman-for-hire. After a past betrayal left him masterless, he has no more patience for warring political factions and their schemes. Unfortunately, both past and political intrigue collide when he meets and saves a female ninja named Kagero from a man with the ability to make his body as hard as stone.

The sole survivor of a ninja clan, Kagero continues her team's last mission: investigate a mysterious plague that wiped out an entire village. Jubei wants nothing to do with this, but the stone-like man's allies, a group of ninja with supernatural powers known as the Devils of Kimon, make that option difficult. To make matters worse, a government spy poisons Jubei, promising him an antidote if he can unravel the true intentions of the Devils of Kimon and their connection to the plague. The trail leads to shadow leaders, a plot to overthrow the government, and a man that Jubei thought he would never see again.
anime.consensus_summary: Ninja Scroll is a highly polarizing film, celebrated by many as a classic action anime for its groundbreaking animation and intense fight scenes, while others criticize its thin plot and underdeveloped characters. Audiences are divided on whether its explicit content and over-the-top supernatural elements enhance or detract from the experience, leading to strong opinions on both sides.
pros: Incredibly fluid and stylish animation, especially during action sequences.
Visually striking art style and detailed character designs for its time.
Brutal, savage, and fast-paced action sequences that are highly entertaining.
Excellent pacing that keeps the viewer engaged without filler.
Atmospheric presentation with a fitting soundtrack that enhances the dark, gritty tone.
cons: Simplistic and underdeveloped characters with little depth or originality.
Storyline is often seen as a weak device primarily serving the action sequences.
Contains gratuitous and potentially offensive elements like excessive gore, nudity, and sexual violence.
Some viewers found the "supernatural ninja" aspect to be overly fantastical and unbelievable.
Repetitive structure of Jubei facing distinct opponents.

anime.title: Ninja Scroll: The Series
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Gore, Historical, Horror, Martial Arts, Samurai
anime.synopsis: Fourteen years after defeating the immortal warrior Himuro Genma and thwarting the Shogun of the Dark's evil plans, Kibagami Jubei continues to roam all over Japan as a masterless swordsman. During his journey, he meets Shigure, a priestess who has never seen the world outside her village. But when a group of demons destroys the village and kills everyone, Jubei becomes a prime target after acquiring the Dragon Jewel—a stone with an unknown origin. Meanwhile, Shigure—along with the monk Dakuan and a young thief named Tsubute—travels to the village of Yagyu. And with two demon clans now hunting down Shigure, Dakuan must once again acquire the services of Jubei to protect the Priestess of Light.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime series is largely considered a disappointing adaptation of the Ninja Scroll movie.  Viewers criticize the simplistic story, uninspired characters, and inferior animation quality compared to the film. While some appreciate the action sequences and nostalgic feel, the consensus leans towards the series being a mediocre and forgettable entry in the ninja anime genre. Many suggest watching the movie instead.
pros: Some found the action entertaining.
The music/soundtrack was generally well-received.
Jubei's character remains consistent with the movie.
cons: Story is basic, unoriginal, and sometimes nonsensical.
Characters are one-dimensional and uninteresting.
Animation quality is significantly lower than the movie.
Episodic feeling and lack of overall plot depth.
Ending is confusing and unsatisfying.
Excessive and unneeded sexual violence.
Villains are not interesting

anime.title: Mermaid Forest
anime.romaji_title: Takahashi Rumiko Gekijou Ningyo no Mori
anime.synopsis: According to an ancient legend, mermaid's flesh can grant immortality if eaten. 500 years ago, Yuta unknowingly ate a piece of mermaid's flesh. For centuries, he travels across Japan, hoping to find a mermaid, thinking she may be able to make him a normal human again. When he finally finds one, he discovers that she and her companions have been raising a girl to be their food so they can eat her and take on her youthful looks. That is how mermaids stay young. Yuta kills the mermaids and rescues her, but she has already eaten some of the mermaid's flesh. Although he had to kill the mermaids, Yuta isn't too disappointed. Yuta's once lonely existence is now over, as he has found a companion in Mana. And Mana, who had been trapped in a small hut her whole life, finds delight in even the simplest of things. Together, Yuta and Mana attempt to seek out more mermaids, trying to become normal humans again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed but leaning towards positive. Many appreciate the anime's dark themes, unique take on mermaids, and exploration of immortality's burdens. Criticisms focus on inconsistent animation, a rushed ending, and occasionally predictable plots. Despite its flaws, many find it an enjoyable and thought-provoking watch.
pros: Interesting exploration of immortality and its consequences
Unique take on mermaid mythology, diverging from typical portrayals
Engaging side stories that enhance the main theme and character development
Atmospheric and eerie, creating a distinct mood
Good voice acting and soundtrack that complements the story
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, especially in earlier episodes
Predictable or clichéd plot developments
Ending feels rushed and unsatisfying
Uneven character development, with the female lead sometimes underdeveloped
Formulaic episodic structure can become repetitive
Dubbing quality is poor

anime.title: Nightwalker: The Midnight Detective
anime.genres: Action, Detective, Horror, Mystery, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Shido Tatsuhiko is not only a private eye... he is also a vampire with no real memory of his past. Joined by Yayoi Matsunaga, a female government agent, Riho Yamazaki, an orphaned teenage girl working as his girl Friday and Guni, a little green imp, Shido must face demonic creatures known as Nightbreed. Meanwhile, Cain, the vampire who made him what he is now, is seeking him...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the show's premise and episodic mysteries, but criticism for its underdeveloped characters, inconsistent production quality, and lack of a strong overarching plot. Some appreciate the show's accessibility and blend of genres, while others find it generic and unfulfilling. There's a general sense that the series had potential but fell short due to its rushed production and unresolved storylines.
pros: Intriguing episodic stories
Well-done English dub with fitting voice actors
Compelling premise of a vampire detective hunting monsters
cons: Inconsistent character designs and animation quality
Generic characters with underdeveloped backstories
Episodic format lacks a strong overarching plot
Abrupt ending with unresolved plot points
Inconsistencies and contradictions in the story

anime.title: Sandglass of Summer Colors
anime.synopsis: With summer vacation about to begin, Koutarou Makimura plans to confess his love to the popular Kaho Serizawa. After a strange incident, however, he finds himself traveling through time, experiencing the vacation out of order. When he learns that Kaho is going to die just before they return to school, Koutarou must use his knowledge of future events to prevent her death, no matter the cost.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Natsu-iro no Sunadokei" as a short, sweet, and nostalgic romance anime with a time travel twist. Many appreciate its ability to tell a complete and engaging story within just two episodes. While some find the animation and sound unremarkable, the well-executed plot and likeable characters make it a worthwhile watch, particularly for fans of older anime styles.
pros: Well-executed time travel plot within limited episodes
Heartfelt romance with likeable characters
Good balance of comedy and drama
Satisfying ending given the short format
cons: Limited character development for side characters
Rushed pacing due to only 2 episodes
Generic/forgettable soundtrack
Simplistic art style typical of the era, which may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Shichinin no Nana
anime.synopsis:
On the last Valentine's Day before her high school entrance exams, Nana Suzuki tries to build up the courage to confess to her longtime crush. However, when her chocolates are accidentally ruined, she rushes back to her house to make more—not realizing that the microwave has been turned into a strange invention by her grandfather. Suddenly, six additional copies of Nana appear, each possessing their own extreme personality and a crystal that grants them magic powers!

With her plans ruined, Nana vows to confess to her crush in her first year of high school. The only problem is that her crush is top student Yuuichi Kamichika, and following him to his elite high school will mean that she has to hit the books. With six new allies to help her, Nana begins to prepare for anything that the exam season might throw at her.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Shichinin no Nana' for its character development and emotional depth, especially in the latter half of the series. The dub is a highlight for many viewers. While some find the initial episodes slow or certain plot elements odd, the show is considered a worthwhile and comforting watch, particularly for those who enjoy slice-of-life anime.
pros: Enjoyable character fleshing out and development, particularly of the protagonist Nana.
The dub is well-regarded and enhances the viewing experience.
The show balances lighthearted slice-of-life elements with genuine emotional moments.
cons: The initial episodes may feel slow and lacking in progression.
The 'Nana Rangers' aspect is considered weird by some viewers.
The split personalities don't significantly affect the original Nana.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Coming-of-Age, Magical Girl

anime.title: Moekan The Animation
anime.synopsis: An anarchistic country that is said to dominate the world exists on a vast island known as Moekko Island. This is where the final works of AC Company's android combat maids (resembling beautiful young girls) are done, also where these maids get there communication training. A new maid is to come to the island to be trained, Rinia, she is a young looking girl, who has lost her all of her memories, she tries very hard to impress the owner at Moekko island, but just ends up making a lot of trouble around the mansion. Takahiro, the owner of Moekko island, a depressive young man who has also lost his memories is seen as a very unhappy person who thinks Rinia will only be trouble around the mansion. As time passes, Takahiro slowly grows attached to Rinia's attempted ways of helping and so starts a beautiful relationship among the quiet island.
anime.consensus_summary: Moekan is a highly unusual show that defies conventional logic and narrative structure, leaving viewers either bewildered and amused or frustrated by its nonsensical plot and bizarre elements. While some appreciate the show's unique, intentionally bad qualities and warm-and-fuzzy vibe, others find it to be a poorly written and confusing mess. Ultimately, reception hinges on the viewer's tolerance for the absurd and their ability to embrace a narrative that actively avoids making sense.
pros: Unique and intentionally bizarre world-building
Decent animation and sound
Warm and fuzzy vibe
cons: Insipid story with bland characters
Forced romance and dreadful pacing
Contradictory plot elements and nonsensical events
Underdeveloped character development
Comedy does not stand out

anime.title: Protect Me, Heavenly Moon Guardian!
anime.synopsis: Tasuke Shichiri is the envy of his friends because since his parents are always traveling he can do as he pleases. It's a surprise present from his father that keeps him from being lonely: an odd ring known as the shitenrin. From it comes a moon goddess named Shaorin, dedicated to protecting her "master" -- no matter how much of a mess she makes doing it!
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally considered mediocre and disappointing, especially compared to initial expectations set by the opening theme. While some find the characters and romance endearing, the weak storyline, repetitive episodes, and underdeveloped characters lead to a largely unfulfilling viewing experience. Many feel the anime doesn't live up to its potential, with the manga being a potentially better alternative.
pros: Catchy opening theme song and visuals
Some likeable side characters (hoshigami)
Endearing Tasuke-Shaorin relationship
cons: Weak storyline with shallow topics
Poor execution reminiscent of other anime but inferior
Formulaic standalone episodes with repetitive patterns
Underdeveloped characters lacking depth
Generic and uninspired background music
Overuse of comedic gags that become stale
Animation quality is inconsistent

anime.title: Major S1
anime.synopsis:
Gorou Honda, a little boy obsessed with baseball, has always admired his father, Shigeharu. Wishing to follow in his father's footsteps, Gorou dreams of becoming a professional baseball player. In turn, his son's starry-eyed admiration encourages Shigeharu to keep persevering, despite his late wife's death and his unsatisfying position on the second-string team Blue Ocean.

Unfortunately, an elbow injury forces Shigeharu off the team, and he falls into despair. However, after an offhand joke from his childhood friend, Shigeharu reevaluates his choices and decides to keep playing, leaving behind his prime position as pitcher and taking up the bat. Now motivated more than ever, Gorou works hard to carve his way in the Japanese Little League.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience highly praises Major S1 for its compelling characters, emotional depth, and inspirational story. Despite some dated animation and occasional predictable plot points, viewers find the series highly engaging and emotionally rewarding. Many recommend it even to those who are not typically fans of sports anime, citing its strong character development and heartfelt narrative.
pros: Strong character development, especially of Goro and the supporting cast.
Engaging storyline that transcends the sports genre with drama and emotional depth.
Excellent voice acting and a memorable soundtrack that enhances the emotional impact.
The series is addicting and easy to get invested in.
cons: Animation quality is dated, particularly in the earlier seasons.
Some plot points and character actions can be unrealistic or predictable.
Pacing issues in certain seasons.
Repetitive use of animation sequences.

anime.title: Magic User's Club
anime.synopsis:
The Magic User's Club is a group of five well-meaning misfits who do more than card tricks—they can use actual magic. And with that magic, they managed to defeat a giant ship from outer space! But their close encounter left an enormous cherry blossom tree right in the middle of the city. It's so big that it blocks out the sun!

Takeo Takakura, the club's noble (but perverted) president, calls a special Sunday meeting to take care of the tree. It seems simple enough, but when magic is involved, nothing ever goes according to plan… What's more, there's a ghostly figure hidden among the branches, watching their every move. Who is this silent specter, and what does he want?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are split between the OVA and TV series. The OVA is generally considered enjoyable and endearing, while the TV series is heavily criticized for its poor animation, dull story, and lazy cash grab feel. Many feel the TV series fails to live up to the potential of the OVA.
