pros: Charming character design and artwork.
Characters are fleshed out with distinct personalities.
Soundtrack is charming and catchy.
OVA is endearing and lovable, expanding upon typical archetypes.
cons: TV series animation is atrocious.
TV series story is dull and lifeless compared to the OVA.
Characters can become exhausting and linear.
Some may find a few characters annoying.
Relationships between characters are not fully resolved.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Comedy, Slice of Life

anime.title: Mahoromatic Summer Special
anime.synopsis: It's another normal day in the Misato residence when Mahoro finds yet another pornographic magazine in Suguru's room. This prompts her and Minawa to make a pact with Chizuko, Rin, Miyuki and Miss Shikijo to search and confiscate all of the perverted stash in the house. Suguru, Kiyomi and Toshiya must do whatever it takes to protect their treasure from the girls.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the special enjoyable as a light-hearted, humorous piece. The content is perceived as somewhat predictable and fan-service oriented. Overall, viewers seem to appreciate the comedic elements and don't take the special too seriously.
pros: Catchy upbeat ending credits tune.
Fun and enjoyable experience.
cons: No real flare aside from the intro song.
The plot is basic and predictable.

anime.title: Legend of Basara
anime.genres: Adventure, Award Winning, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis: In a small village, twins are born: a boy, Tatara, and a girl, Sarasa. The prophet Nagi declares that Tatara is the chosen one who will free Japan from the tyrannical rule of the King and his four sons. But when the ruthless Red King slays Tatara, Sarasa must take on her brother's name and responsibilities and embark on a quest to free Japan and deliver vengeance to the Red King.
anime.consensus_summary: Legend of Basara is viewed as a hidden gem, particularly for fans of older anime styles and historical romance. While the incomplete adaptation is a major drawback, the strong characters, complex themes, and engaging storyline are generally praised. The anime's age is noticeable in the animation and sound, but the narrative depth and emotional resonance compensate for these technical shortcomings.
pros: Strong female lead character with significant growth.
Complex characters with moral ambiguities, blurring the lines between good and evil.
Engrossing plot with a blend of romance and war.
Detailed and beautiful old-style art.
Addresses mature themes like war, death, and emotional struggles.
cons: Incomplete adaptation of the manga, leaving the story unfinished.
Animation quality is dated.
The OST lacks presence and impact.
Some shoujo romance tropes can be overly indulgent.
Pacing issues due to the limited number of episodes.

anime.title: Koi Kaze
anime.synopsis: Saeki Koushirou works as a wedding planner, but his own love life is in shambles. His background makes it difficult for him to commit himself wholeheartedly to love. The child of a divorced couple, he lives with his father. He has a mother and a sister, but he has not seen them in years. After being dumped by his girlfriend, a chance encounter with a female high school student shakes Koushirou's calm and awakens new feelings in him—but he learns that the girl is in fact his sister, who will now be staying with his father and him. Yet, the feelings in Koushirou's heart...
anime.consensus_summary: Koi Kaze is a highly divisive anime due to its exploration of incest, with some viewers praising its mature and realistic portrayal of a taboo relationship, while others are repulsed by the subject matter. The series is lauded for its well-developed characters, emotional depth, and poignant soundtrack. However, it is criticized for its simplistic animation and slow pacing, making it a challenging watch for those sensitive to its themes.
pros: Mature handling of sensitive issues
Realistic character portrayals and development
Beautiful and effective musical score
cons: Uncomfortable and controversial subject matter
Visually unimpressive animation and simplistic backgrounds
Pacing may be too slow for some viewers

anime.title: Jubei-chan the Ninja Girl: Secret of the Lovely Eyepatch
anime.synopsis: Jiyu Nanohana is an ordinary schoolgirl until she runs across a scatterbrained 300 year old samurai who tells her that she is the reincarnation of Yagyu Jubei. With the help of the "Lovely Eyepatch" she transforms into the legendary swordsman whenever she needs to use his awesome fighting ability, which she needs to do quite often as a rival clan is dead set on conquering Yagyu to satisfy an old family grudge.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are split, with some finding the show a refreshing and clever comedy that pokes fun at anime cliches. Others criticize the writing, voice acting, and inconsistent plot development. The show's humor and character interactions are praised by some, while others find them annoying and repetitive. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on approaching it with a comedic attitude and not expecting a serious samurai epic.
pros: Clever satirical comedy that subverts genre tropes
Endearing characters with good chemistry
Humor through repetition and unexpected forms
Satisfying fight scenes
cons: Pathetic writing with slow character development and repetitive dialogue
Annoying Japanese voice acting and poor English dubbing
Inconsistent animation quality
Nonsense takes over the plot in the end

anime.title: Jubei-chan 2: The Counterattack of Siberia Yagyu
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Martial Arts, Samurai
anime.synopsis: Three hundred years ago, in the frigid land of Siberia, Jubei Yagyu engaged in a fierce battle with Kitaretsusai of the Northern Yagyu clan. The duel was costly, as his daughter Freesia was frozen in suspended animation. As a result of global warming in the present day, Freesia breaks free from her icy grave and moves to Japan as a middle school transfer student, where she befriends Jiyuu Nanohana. Little does Jiyuu know that Freesia is targeting her to acquire the coveted Lovely Eye Patch, which Freesia believes is rightfully hers.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is overwhelmingly negative.  Fans of the original *Jubei-chan* are largely disappointed with the sequel's rehashing of the plot, decline in writing quality, and poor character development. The improved animation is not enough to compensate for the other shortcomings, leading to the sequel being considered a waste of time.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to the first season.
Character designs remain appealing.
Some comedic elements still work.
cons: Repetitive storyline that mirrors the first season.
Poorly developed new characters and sidelined original characters.
Incoherent plot with unexplained elements and useless filler.
Decline in humor and overall writing quality.
Uninspired battles compared to the first season.

anime.title: Honey and Clover Specials
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Drama, Josei, Romance, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis:
Two side stories:

Chapter L (or chapter 25) about Lohmeyer/Romaiya senpai.

Chapter F (or chapter 26) about Miwako finding ways to make fun of Yamazaki.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys these special episodes as a fun and insightful addition to the Hachimitsu to Clover series. They appreciate the bonus content that further develops characters and explores familiar themes with a touch of comedy. While some find them less impactful than the main storyline, they are considered a worthwhile extension for fans of the original anime.
pros: Successfully captures the humor and spirit of the original series.
Adds depth to supporting characters.
Explores themes of adolescence and unrequited love in a lighthearted way.
cons: May feel lacking in revelations or insights compared to the main series.
Some may miss these episodes if only watching the main numbered episodes.
Not part of the original broadcast TV series.

anime.title: Hikaru no Go: Hokuto Hai e no Michi
anime.romaji_title: Hikaru no Go: Hokuto Hai e no Michi
anime.synopsis: Hikaru is given a phone call asking him to appear in the Japan/China/Korea Junior's Tournament but he finds out he will have to take place in a preliminary tournament to choose Japan's three contestants. Upon discussing this with Akira, he discovers that Akira has already been chosen for the tournament and will not be taking place in the preliminaries. Hikaru then decides not to visit Akira's Go Salon until he takes his place on the team with Akira. That may be tougher than originally planned, as not only does Hikaru have to battle with old friends for one of two coveted spots, but he may have a new challenger, in a promising player from the Kansai Go Institute.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive about the special, praising its faithful continuation of the original series and Hikaru's character development. However, a significant point of frustration is the lack of a proper conclusion or tournament, leaving viewers feeling unfulfilled. The special is appreciated as an addition to the Hikaru no Go universe, but its incompleteness is a major drawback.
pros: Faithful continuation of the original series' feel and music.
Excellent character development, especially Hikaru's growth and confidence.
Exciting and complex Go match is memorable.
Superb adaptation of the source material.
cons: The special ends without a resolution, feeling incomplete.
It serves as a build-up to a tournament that never happens.
The lack of a follow-up is disappointing and hurts the overall experience.
Some consider it pointless without a proper conclusion.

anime.title: Haunted Junction
anime.synopsis: Saito High is a high school with its spiritual beings and a principal whose hobby is collecting occult paraphernalia. The school has the prophecy-chosen members of the Holy Student Council to protect it. These students have problems of their own; Haruto Houjo, the president, has a way of summoning spirits, and would resign from his duty for a normal life if it weren't for the principal. Kazumi Ryodo, the next member, is good at being possessed and has something for the Hanako. The last member is Mutsuki Asahina, who is a master of exorcism and is attracted to small boys. Unfortunately, these three are in charge of keeping the school in line and defending the world from supernatural beings, and this mission brings them through wacky predicaments.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is very positive, highlighting the show's comedic charm, lovable characters, and blend of Japanese folklore. While some find the visuals or certain elements repetitive, the overall enjoyment remains high.  Many appreciate its light-hearted and easily accessible nature.
pros: Great cast with unique personalities
Solid retro-styled comedy
Entertaining story with Japanese folklore elements
Visual comedy enhanced by character designs
cons: Mildly underused school spirits
Standard art style for its time may not appeal to everyone
Some may find certain characters or humor repetitive

anime.title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de: Ajisai Yumegatari
anime.romaji_title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de: Ajisai Yumegatari
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Isekai, Reverse Harem, Romance
anime.synopsis: Whisked away to the land of Kyou, Akane learns that she is the Ryuujin no Miko, and meets the Hachiyou, her protectors. They must defeat Akuram, a demon who wants to destroy Kyou using the power of Azusa, a woman who has the power to absorb human energy. If Akane and the Hachiyou cannot defeat Akuram and bring peace to Kyou, Azusa'a power will destroy the humans.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that this OVA is poorly written and confusing. While the character designs are visually appealing, they ultimately distract from the incoherent plot. It's best enjoyed with friends and mind-altering substances for comedic effect, or skipped entirely in favor of something better.
pros: Unique and detailed character designs (though distracting)
cons: Incomprehensible plot
Poor character development
Inconsistent and unhelpful subtitles
Poor pacing and editing

anime.title: Tsuki wa Higashi ni Hi wa Nishi ni: Operation Sanctuary
anime.romaji_title: Tsuki wa Higashi ni Hi wa Nishi ni: Operation Sanctuary
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Harem, Romance, Sci-Fi, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: Naoki Kuzumi, a junior in high school, had lost his parents in an accident five years ago, and is living with his aunt, uncle, and cousin Matsuri. He always thought his life was ordinary, besides the fact that he can't remember what happened in his youth. One sunny day as he is taking a nap on a bench, a redheaded girl -- Mikoto -- literally falls on him from the sky. For some reason, she thinks he's her younger brother. Naoki's time period is a temporal shelter for those in the future, when many are suffering from an incurable disease. When she heard her younger brother Yuusuke had been taken to Naoki's time, Mikoto herself had gone back in time.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is considered a mediocre adaptation with a generic plot and bland characters. While some viewers find it enjoyable for relaxed viewing due to its short episodes and simple plot, the majority opinion is that it fails to deliver a compelling narrative or memorable characters. The sci-fi twist is poorly executed, leading to overall disappointment.
pros: Enjoyable for relaxed viewing
Sci-fi twist in the end adds intrigue
Visually appealing moe art style
cons: Bland and lifeless characters
Overused character archetypes
Poorly executed sci-fi elements with infodumps
Underdeveloped storyline

anime.title: Hanaukyo Maid Team: La Verite
anime.synopsis: After his mother passes away, Taro Hanaukyo is invited to his grandfather's home. There, he meets a beautiful maid named Mariel and finds out that his grandfather has retired to a remote island and has given him ownership of his estate. Taro also discovers that not only is the estate a colossal mansion, it has hundreds of gorgeous maids ready to serve him 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the improved remake for its enjoyable characters and story, while others criticize the inconsistent plot, excessive ecchi content, and unsatisfying ending. Some viewers appreciate the nostalgia and comfort the anime provides, while others find it generic and poorly executed. There are polarized views on whether it surpasses the original.
pros: Improved storyline and character development compared to the original.
Enjoyable and feel-good anime with enough story to stay interesting.
Characters are unique and well-fleshed out, making them stand out.
cons: Beginning can be boring and random, with excessive ecchi content.
Plot and tone can be inconsistent, with abrupt shifts in genre.
Some find the ending unsatisfying, with no real conclusion or character growth.

anime.title: Gunsmith Cats
anime.synopsis: In the dangerous suburbs of Chicago, skilled bounty hunters Irene "Rally" Vincent and "Minnie" May Hopkins run Gunsmith Cats, a firearms store of questionable legality. One day, Bill Collins, an agent for the Chicago branch of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives, blackmails Rally and May into working with him on a case. The stakes are high, but Rally’s gunmanship and May’s knowledge of explosives are unmatched. As Rally and May unravel the secrets of the case, the two will need to use guns and grenades while being faster, stronger, and better than everyone else in order to stay alive.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus points to Gunsmith Cats as a technically brilliant OVA with fantastic action and a strong sense of place, largely carried by its charismatic leads and impressive production values. However, its narrative simplicity and underdeveloped plot are frequently cited as significant drawbacks, especially given its short runtime. Despite these criticisms, it's generally seen as a fun, action-packed ride that excels in its visual and auditory presentation.
pros: Exceptional attention to detail in recreating Chicago, including landmarks, signage, and local culture.
Highly praised for its realistic and meticulously animated car chases and gunfights.
Strong, charismatic female protagonists (Rally and May) with good chemistry.
Excellent production values for its time, particularly in animation, character design, and sound effects.
Fantastic jazz fusion soundtrack that enhances the action and atmosphere.
Well-regarded English dub, often cited as one of the best of its era.
cons: The plot is considered simple, predictable, and at times laughably bad or generic.
Lack of character and story development due to the short, 3-episode run.
Certain characters from the manga are absent or underdeveloped in the OVA.
The main antagonist in the final episode is seen as hammy and forced.
Some minor fanservice moments are criticized as being gratuitous or eye-rolling.

anime.title: Galaxy Angel Z
anime.synopsis:
In the far future, the human race advanced to space, and prospered. However, Jikushin ( earthquake of time and space ) which occurred suddenly intercepted all networks, and all the civilizations were reset. However, the human race begins to revive, and enters the prosperity age of The Second by the Transvaal imperial country which rises at the center of the galactic system. The science and technology before the civilization was reset, that is, "Lost Technology" was considered to be god`s task. And, it came to be worshiped by the priest who was called "Tsuki no miko".

On the other hand, a certain guard fleet was stationed in the frontier of the galactic system. Though it was the seemingly perfectly ordinary army, the team composed only of the woman called "Angel Corps" existed in this army. They controlled the spaceship which was called "Angel Frame" which was the relic of Lost Technology. And, they collected the lost technology by using the angel frame, and carried out the duties to manage them. They were not the elite pilots, but Angel Corps was rather an eccentric person`s group. Arms mania`s Forte, costume player`s Mint, taciturn Vanilla, showy Ranpha and Milfeulle who likes cooking ... Every time, they cause a big trouble in the mission.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Galaxy Angel Z' is well-received as a fun and silly comedy anime, particularly praised for its strong comedic timing, likable characters and improved narrative elements. Some find the lack of consistent tone and depth a drawback, but the series is generally seen as a light-hearted and enjoyable experience. The audience consensus leans towards positive, highlighting the series' strengths in delivering absurd humor without relying on darker themes.
pros: Strong comedic elements with well-defined character personalities.
Bright and cheery art style with good voice acting.
Improved story compared to the first season with surprisingly well-written non-comedic episodes.
cons: Lack of overarching story and character development.
Inconsistencies in tone with occasional serious episodes that don't fit the overall comedic style.
Generic art style and sound design.

anime.title: Galaxy Angel A
anime.synopsis: Their mission is to locate and retrieve the mysterious Lost Technology, even though these girls have never been known to stick to their mission. Milfeulle, Forte, Ranpha, Mint, and Vanilla are back for another round of hilarity. The Galaxy Angels have sworn to protect the galaxy one planet at a time. Now with some competition with the newly-formed Twin Star Brigade, they continue to find themselves in the center of chaos... though usually they're the ones at fault for its cause.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is generally positive, appreciating the humor and characters, but some find the lack of story and tonal inconsistencies jarring.  Fans of the previous seasons will likely enjoy this one. The episodic nature makes it easy to watch without requiring deep engagement, though the serious episodes are often criticized.
pros: Enjoyable and funny episodes
Characters are well-defined and fit together perfectly
Excellent music and sound, especially the ending themes
cons: Lack of a strong overarching story
Inconsistent tone with random serious episodes that don't fit
Occasional comedic episodes that fall short
Animation quality not improved from previous seasons

anime.title: Galaxy Angel X
anime.synopsis: Starting out with the new Galaxy Angel, Chitose Karasuma, the Angel Troupe continue their search for The Lost Technology while running into different kinds of mishaps.
anime.consensus_summary: Galaxy Angel X is a fun and funny anime that is best enjoyed by fans of the previous seasons. It doesn't have a strong overarching story but makes up for it with zany humor and memorable characters. The upgraded music and sound are definite highlights, though the art can be inconsistent.
pros: The characters are great and the comedy is really good.
The music and sound are hugely upgraded this season with great music choices.
It is enjoyable and easy to watch.
cons: There isn't any real overarching story, with episodes being mostly self-contained.
The art is of a budget variety and backgrounds are sometimes hastily drawn.
Characters are stereotypical with no character development.

anime.title: Air in Summer
anime.synopsis: Unwilling to move to a different shrine and leave her friends behind, Kanna escapes in the dead of night with her loyal bodyguard Ryuuya and confidant Uraha. Knowing their pursuers are not far behind, the three embark on a journey to locate Kanna's mother, who Kanna yearns to see after many years of separation. Amid the tensions, the trio explores the world outside the confines of the palace—serving as a tranquil yet temporary distraction from what is to come.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is generally positive, especially for existing fans of the 'Air' series who appreciate the added character depth and animation quality. However, there's a notable split regarding its necessity and plot significance, with some viewing it as essential supplementary material and others as enjoyable but ultimately skippable filler.
pros: Spectacular and flawless animation quality, consistent with the main series by Kyoto Animation.
Excellent character development, particularly for Ryuuya and Kanna, providing deeper insights into their pasts and relationships.
Enhances the understanding and background of the main Air TV series, filling in gaps between episodes.
Emotional OST and great music, with piano, acoustic guitar, violin, and flute contributing to the dramatic and romantic tone.
Adorable and humorous moments that lighten the mood compared to the main series.
cons: Lacks significant plot development or a clear beginning/end, often feeling like filler or 'deleted scenes'.
Not essential viewing and offers little new to the overall plot outcome of the main series.
Can be confusing if the main TV series is not watched first.
Some viewers found the pacing slow and the jokes tedious.
Slightly more 'ecchi' or suggestive content than the main series, which may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Akagi
anime.romaji_title: Touhai Densetsu Akagi: Yami ni Maiorita Tensai
anime.genres: Adult Cast, High Stakes Game, Organized Crime, Psychological, Seinen, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
While mahjong is a game that is often played with family and friends, it is also a game that is played in the darkest corners of society. Nangou is a compulsive gambler who has accumulated debt over three million yen. In a last ditch attempt to clear his record, he decides to wager his life on a game of mahjong with the mafia. Unfortunately, as the game progresses, Nangou only moves further from the prize and closer to death.

When all hope seems lost, the game parlor is suddenly intruded upon by Shigeru Akagi, a young boy on the run from the police. Desperate to turn the game around, Nangou hands the game over to Akagi after teaching him a few of the rules. The mafia can only smirk as Akagi sits down to play. However, they soon come to learn that Akagi is a natural-born gambler. An imposing figure who does not fear death. One who is destined to become a legend.
anime.consensus_summary: Akagi is a highly regarded anime for its intense psychological battles and unique atmosphere, although the unusual art style can be off-putting to some at first.  Many appreciate the show's ability to create tension even without understanding all the intricacies of mahjong. However, the drawn-out final arc and abrupt ending are common points of criticism. The anime is generally well-received by those who enjoy strategic and psychological thrillers.
pros: Intense psychological battles and mind games are a major draw.
Unique and fitting art style that enhances the grim atmosphere.
Excellent soundtrack and voice acting heighten tension and drama.
The anime effectively explains mahjong rules without requiring prior knowledge.
cons: The final arc is often criticized for being dragged out and repetitive.
The anime's ending is abrupt and unsatisfying.
The complexity of mahjong rules can be difficult for some viewers to follow.
Some find the character designs initially unappealing.

anime.title: Azumanga Daioh: The Very Short Movie
anime.synopsis: In this short movie featuring familiar characters from Azumanga Daioh, Osaka is yet again having a strange dream of Chiyo-Chan's pigtails being posessed. As Chiyo-Chan's pigtails bounce out of the window, who knows if young Chiyo will ever be happy again.
anime.consensus_summary: The short movie is generally well-received, especially by fans of the original series, as a fun and quick revisit of familiar characters and jokes. While some appreciate the improved animation, others find it unnecessary or prefer the original's style. Its main drawback is its short length and lack of new content, making it more of a supplementary piece than a standalone work.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to the original series.
Faithful representation of characters and humor from the original series.
Enjoyable and a good introduction to the Azumanga Daioh series.
cons: Reuses jokes and scenarios from the main series, lacking originality.
Short length makes it feel incomplete and unsatisfying.
Some find the art style less appealing than the original series' simplicity.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, School Life

anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Reflections
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis: A reflection on what happened during the FMA TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Fullmetal Alchemist: Reflections' as a successful recap and nostalgic experience for fans of the original series. It effectively highlights key moments and evokes emotional responses through its music and storytelling. However, it is not recommended for newcomers and cannot replace the depth and impact of watching the full series.
pros: Highlights the main scenes of the anime effectively.
Music is used periodically throughout the anime.
Evokes strong emotions and memories from the original series.
Good for fans wanting a quick refresher or nostalgic reminder.
Spectacular musical scores that blend smoothly with the scenarios.
cons: Nowhere near as good as the entirety of the series.
Watching it without seeing the series will not provide the same level of impact.
May feel rushed due to summarizing a large amount of content.
Image quality might be dated.

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (OVA)
anime.romaji_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Adventure
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Shounen, Super Power, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Kujo Jotaro is a normal, popular Japanese high-schooler, until he thinks that he is possessed by a spirit, and locks himself in prison. After seeing his grandfather, Joseph Joestar, and fighting Joseph's friend Muhammad Abdul, Jotaro learns that the "Spirit" is actually Star Platinum, his Stand, or fighting energy given a semi-solid form. Later, his mother gains a Stand, and becomes sick. Jotaro learns that it is because the vampire Dio Brando has been revived 100 years after his defeat to Jonathan Joestar, Jotaro's great-great-grandfather. Jotaro decides to join Joseph and Abdul in a trip to Egypt to defeat Dio once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: The JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (2000) OVA adaptation is a mixed bag. Some appreciate its concise storytelling and unique art style, but many find the character designs and lack of emotional impact to be major drawbacks. Most recommend the newer 2014 adaptation instead, citing superior faithfulness to the manga and overall better quality.
pros: Fights rely on trickery and wit, not just power
Concise adaptation that removes dull parts of the manga
Striking and detailed art style
Fluid Animation
cons: Poor character development (especially Joseph and Kakyoin)
Unintentionally funny execution in some scenes
Poorly directed fights
Ugly and bizarre character designs
Lifeless compared to the newer adaptation
Sound design and voice acting are poor
Trims too much story content and isn't faithful to the manga
Omits comedic elements

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Shounen, Super Power, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Kujo Jotaro is a normal, popular Japanese high-schooler, until he thinks that he is possessed by a spirit, and locks himself in prison. After seeing his grandfather, Joseph Joestar, and fighting Joseph's friend Muhammad Abdul, Jotaro learns that the "Spirit" is actually Star Platinum, his Stand, or fighting energy given a semi-solid form. Later, his mother gains a Stand, and becomes sick. Jotaro learns that it is because the vampire Dio Brando has been revived 100 years after his defeat to Jonathan Joestar, Jotaro's great-great-grandfather. Jotaro decides to join Joseph and Abdul in a trip to Egypt to defeat Dio once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure is a polarizing series celebrated for its unique art style, innovative Stand power system, and creative, strategy-driven fights. However, its unconventional narrative, eccentric character designs, and the dense lore often lead to confusion and criticism, particularly in anime adaptations that struggle to convey the full depth of the manga.
pros: Unique and stylish art direction, evolving from early 90s influences to more modern aesthetics.
Innovative 'Stand' power system that adds a unique dimension to combat, emphasizing wit and strategy over brute force.
Memorable and eccentric characters with distinct personalities and engaging interactions, despite some criticisms of depth.
Intense and imaginative fight choreography, particularly the climactic battles, often praised for their creativity and strategy.
Engaging premise and genre-bending storylines that subvert typical tropes.
cons: Adaptation issues, particularly in OVAs, leading to a lack of context, rushed pacing, and omitted material for those unfamiliar with the manga.
Inconsistent animation quality across different adaptations and episodes, with some instances described as dated or poor.
Character development can be superficial or underdeveloped in certain adaptations, leaving them feeling less fleshed out.
The 'Stand' concept and its relation to Tarot cards are often unexplained or poorly explored in adaptations, leading to confusion.
Some plot points and character motivations can feel nonsensical or illogical, especially in condensed versions of the story.

anime.title: Girl Meets Girl
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Girls Love, Love Polygon, Magical Sex Shift, School
anime.synopsis:
Hazumu was a shy boy who enjoyed gardening, collecting herbs, and long walks in the mountains. One day he finally worked up the courage to confess his love to Yasuna, but she rejected him. 

Depressed, he wandered up Mt. Kashimayama, the place where they first met, to reconsider his feelings. After getting lost, he wished upon a shooting star and received a bizarre twist of fate. 

Now he is a she, and she stumbles headfirst back into social life and relationships only to find that the entire landscape has changed!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many criticizing the absurd premise and inconsistent writing. Some viewers found the series to be a touching and thoughtful romance with well-developed characters, while others were turned off by the fanservice, shallow characterizations, and problematic handling of transsexuality. The series is polarizing, as some appreciate its attempts at emotional depth while others see it as offensive and poorly executed.
pros: Thoughtful characterization of main characters, particularly the female leads.
Gentle melodies and melancholic music enhance emotional scenes.
Beautiful animation and art style with bright color palette.
The series strives to overcome its ridiculous premise and become the best romance it could be.
cons: Ridiculous and bogus premise of boy turned into a girl by aliens.
Needless episodes revolving around mostly useless supporting characters.
Some characters fall into stereotypical roles.
Handling of transsexuality is awkward, stereotyped, unrealistic and shallow for some viewers.
Unnecessary fanservice and perverted jokes detract from the story.
Melodramatic romance and forced humor.
Inconsistent character development and motivations.
Dialogue is badly done.

anime.title: Koi Koi Seven
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Tanaka Tetsuro is excited at getting a full scholarship at a new high school, far away from his family. What he does not know is that he will be the only boy in an all girl school, and that there is a girl head-over-heels in love with him, waiting for his arrival. But his special friendship with the very cute and dynamic Asuka also causes him to get into a lot of trouble with the powerful student council leadership, as they are at open war with Asuka and her five friends, a group of super amazon warriors called the Koi Koi Seven.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Koi Koi 7 is highly mixed, with many finding the plot incoherent and characters underdeveloped. Some viewers appreciate the anime for its comedy, fanservice, and catchy theme song, while others consider it one of the worst they have ever seen. The ending is particularly criticized for being confusing and unresolved, leaving viewers feeling frustrated.
pros: Charming characters and cute voice acting.
Enjoyable for those who like ecchi and yuri content.
The opening theme song is well-received.
Comedy is pure gold.
cons: Incoherent story and nonsensical plot progression.
Lack of character development and superficial characters.
Excessive fanservice that disrupts the tone.
Poor pacing and a confusing ending that resolves nothing.
Mediocre animation and BGM.
Ending is questionable

anime.title: Lamune
anime.synopsis: Lamune tells the story of a boy named Kenji and his childhood friend Nanami. Although, everyone seems to know that they have a relationship, neither are determined to push it anymore than close friends. The story goes through flashbacks, explaining why they are such close friends and any action doesn't seem to push them apart, but draw them closer.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience finds "Lamune" to be a pleasant and relaxing slice-of-life romance, with a focus on nostalgia and the simplicity of rural life. However, some find the slow pacing and predictable story to be drawbacks. The inconsistent animation quality is also a point of criticism. Despite its flaws, many appreciate the heartwarming atmosphere and likable characters.
pros: Relaxing and light-hearted slice of life.
Good representation of rural life.
Characters are likable and relatable.
cons: Slow pacing and episodic format can be boring.
Animation quality is inconsistent and subpar.
Story is predictable and lacks significant drama.

anime.title: Lemon Angel Project
anime.synopsis: Lemon Angel was once the greatest girl band of Japan, but then it broke up and most of its members vanished. When a music producer decides to put together a new Lemon Angel, average high schooler Tomo Minaguchi is approached to audition for the group. Little does she know of the mystery behind the original Lemon Angel...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the series for its catchy music, exploration of the idol industry, and moments of heartwarming drama. However, many criticize the predictable story, inconsistent characterization, and mediocre animation. The series is generally considered a flawed but potentially enjoyable experience for those interested in idol culture.
pros: Catchy J-Pop tunes and insert songs that fit the series well.
Some characters, like Erika and Saya, have depth and interesting plotlines.
Explores the inner workings of creating an idol group, offering a look at the idol industry.
cons: Predictable and clunky story with a lack of subtlety and finesse.
Inconsistent characterization, with some characters being flat, offensive, or hyperbolic.
Mediocre animation quality, even for its time, with occasional facial derps and low-quality shots.
Main character's voice acting is stiff and monotone, which some found grating.

anime.title: Refrain Blue
anime.synopsis:
A trip to the beach turns out to be more than expected for two people who are mourning the losses of their beloved. Perhaps a mysterious girl known as the "Umi Warabe" can help them to heal their wounds and move on with their lives.

Matsunaga Yoshihiro is the chaperone for a group of high-school students on a summer trip to the beach. One night he saves one of the students, Morisawa Nao, as she attempts to drown herself. She had been on this same trip a year ago, with her fiancee, who was later killed in a plane crash. As these two get to know each other, we find that Yoshihiro also has a painful secret from his past. Watching over everything is a mysterious young girl who somehow is always there at decisive moments.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the emotional journey and soundtrack, while others critique the underdeveloped characters and unnecessary ecchi elements. The series is seen as a short, emotional experience, but its impact varies depending on individual preferences for character depth and mature content. Overall, it evokes a sense of nostalgia for older anime styles but falls short in fully realizing its emotional potential.
pros: Soundtrack enhances emotional impact
Story conveys emotional healing journey
Classic late 90s - early 2000s art style appeal
Complete story in a short time
cons: Characters feel underdeveloped
Ecchi scenes detract from emotional core
Secondary characters lack substance
Colors are scattered and odd

anime.title: Sentimental Journey
anime.synopsis: Sentimental Journey is a collection of twelve short stories about twelve different girls. Though unrelated, there is one common theme that binds the episodes together: each girl's bittersweet experience of first love.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment for Sentimental Journey is generally positive, appreciating its nostalgic charm and surprisingly good production values for its era. While not universally acclaimed, the show is viewed as a pleasant if somewhat hard-to-find watch, with individual stories leaving a positive impression.
pros: Surprisingly good art and sound for a 90s anime
Memorable characters despite brief appearances
cons: Rare to find online
Music is not exceptional

anime.title: Shadow Skill: Eigi
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: In the land of Kuruda, warriors with magical powers and incredible fighting skills battle for the ultimate prize: the title of Sevaar, the strongest warrior in the land. Elle Ragu, nicknamed Shadow Skill, is the newest Sevaar to emerge, but that doesn't make her life any easier. Teaching her "little brother," Gau, how to be a warrior, fending off assassins from other kingdoms and thwarting enemy invasions is hard enough, but her biggest challenge will be paying off her drinking debts.
anime.consensus_summary: Shadow Skill: Eigi receives mixed reviews. Some viewers praise its strong characters, entertaining story, and nostalgic feel, while others criticize its inconsistent animation, underdeveloped plot, and rushed ending. Despite its flaws, many find it to be an enjoyable fantasy anime with exciting fight scenes, but the execution of its potential leaves much to be desired.
pros: Strong and well-developed characters with interesting backstories.
Entertaining story with a good balance of comedy and serious moments.
Exciting fight scenes and martial arts choreography, despite some limitations.
Nostalgic and classic feel for fans of older anime styles.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality with reused frames and distorted faces.
Underdeveloped plot points and rushed ending.
Unnecessary comedic moments.
Costume designs feel incoherrent.

anime.title: Angel Tales
anime.synopsis: Goro's down on his luck. He keeps losing jobs and has little money. One day he meets a fortune-teller outside of a pet store who predicts that his luck will change. That night three girls appear in his appartment claiming to be his guardian angels. Soon a total of twelve girls appear to help him, each one a reincarnation of a deceased pet once owned by Goro.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is generally viewed as a cute and simple harem anime, appreciated for its lighthearted and relaxing atmosphere. However, it's criticized for its unoriginality, simplistic art style, and lack of character development. Despite its flaws, many find it enjoyable as a nostalgic and heartwarming experience, particularly for those who appreciate the harem genre without excessive fanservice or complex plots.
pros: Cute and well-developed characters.
Good voice acting.
Catchy opening theme.
Heartwarming story with little annoyances.
Relaxed and calm atmosphere.
cons: Unoriginal story and generic harem elements.
Simplistic and dated art style.
Repetitive plot and lack of significant character development.
Bland main character.
Mediocre animation.

anime.title: To Heart: Remember My Memories
anime.synopsis: Time flies by; Hiroyuki and Akari are 12th-graders now. Both of them and their friends have grown up gradually in someway, physically or mentally, but one of their best friends is missing: the lifelike android Multi. To their surprise, Multi is brought to their campus again without notice, yet she is no longer the same Multi they have known.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided, with many feeling it pales in comparison to the original To Heart in terms of production quality. However, some appreciate the stronger narrative and character development. The ending is often cited as emotionally resonant, redeeming some of the earlier shortcomings for those invested in the characters.
pros: Emotionally compelling storyline, especially towards the end.
Good character development, expanding on characters introduced in the first season.
Story is well-paced with romance neatly tied into the plot and characters.
cons: Significant drop in art and animation quality compared to the original To Heart.
Character personalities feel like an abomination of what they originally were.
Voice acting quality has dropped, with some performances sounding strained.
Generic and less detailed art style compared to the original.

anime.title: To Heart: Remember My Memories Specials
anime.romaji_title: To Heart: Remember My Memories Specials
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Martial Arts, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis: This is a special to To Heart: Remember My Memories, which includes fighting scenes between all the female characters.
anime.consensus_summary: The To Heart: Remember My Memories Specials are largely seen as a humorous, albeit nonsensical, fanservice-filled addition to the franchise. While some appreciate the short episodes and comedic value, others find the plot incoherent and the focus on panty shots excessive. The specials are considered a lighthearted, non-essential watch for fans of the series.
pros: Short episodes make it easy to watch
Humorous and entertaining
Links the To Heart and To Heart 2 universes
cons: Nonsensical plot and contradictory history
Overreliance on fanservice and panty shots
Poor music soundtrack

anime.title: Mew Mew Power
anime.synopsis:
Ichigo Momomiya expected her date with her crush, Masaya Aoyama, to have a more romantic ending than her falling asleep after she sees a vision of a cat entering her body. Things get even stranger when, the next day, she begins displaying cat-like behaviors such as an intense craving for fish. When Masaya is attacked by a monster, she discovers that she is able to transform into the cat-eared magical girl, Mew Ichigo.
 
After she saves Masaya, two researchers named Ryou Shirogane and Keiichiro Akasaka approach her and reveal they had injected her with Iriomote Cat DNA in order to create a magical girl that can save the world from aliens. Ichigo is tasked with fighting these monsters, but saving the world proves to be just too much for Ichigo to handle by herself. Fortunately, she learns that there are four other girls just like her, and now, Ichigo must find them quickly before the aliens completely take over the planet.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Tokyo Mew Mew" is viewed as an enjoyable magical girl anime, especially for those with nostalgia for the genre. While some find the story repetitive and the animation dated, many appreciate the well-developed characters, themes of environmentalism, and surprisingly complex villains. The romance elements are generally well-received, though some find Ichigo's character frustrating.
pros: Characters are well-developed and relatable, each with unique personalities.
The story blends superpowers and animal rights in a way that isn't cheesy.
The villains have depth and complexity, with understandable motivations.
Catchy music and enjoyable character interactions.
Satisfying romance elements.
cons: Repetitive transformation sequences and monster-of-the-week format.
Inconsistent plot logic and altered rules depending on the situation.
Dated animation and art style with visual inconsistencies.
Ichigo's character can be annoying and stupid at times.
Filler episodes that pad out the story.
Generic romance.

anime.title: Utakata
anime.synopsis:
It's the last day of the school term in Kamakura Girl's School, and summer is about to begin. Serious but polite 14-year-old Ichika Tachibana is excited to make her summer vacation with her friends a special break to remember! But little does Ichika know that this summer will be more special than she could have ever imagined.

While cleaning in an unused school building, Ichika notices an image of an unfamiliar girl in place of her own reflection in a large mirror. Convinced by her friends that she was just seeing things, she is surprised to see the girl in the mirror later that day, holding her lost cell phone. Introducing herself as Manatsu Kuroki, she comes out of the mirror and hands Ichika's phone back—and to Ichika's surprise, the stones on her cell phone charm have changed colors and now allow her to borrow the power of the 12 Djinn that watch over the world.

Uta Kata is a tale of a young girl who will realize new things through her interactions with these spirits. As the Djinn show her overwhelming sights, they will soon also bring to her overwhelming thoughts...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Uta Kata are divided. Some appreciate the anime's exploration of mature themes and realistic character development, considering it a hidden gem in the magical girl genre. Others find the slow pacing, excessive slice-of-life elements, and underwhelming plot twists disappointing, ultimately finding the series mediocre and not living up to its potential as a dark magical girl story.
pros: Well-written story with Ichika's inner monologue adding perspective
Realistic portrayal of Ichika's mental and physical breakdown
Exploration of the downsides of power
Haunting soundtrack that complements the light and serious moments
Richly detailed backgrounds and purposeful use of long shots
cons: Slow pacing with excessive slice-of-life elements
Unclear elements in the trials faced by Ichika
Underwhelming mystery reveal
Uncomfortable fan service
Weak character development for side characters and antagonist

anime.title: Utakata: Summer Pair of Early Winter
anime.synopsis: It's now winter in Kamakura. When Satsuki tells her friends that she'd seen Manatsu, Ichika at first doesn't believe it. But on the day before her 15th birthday, Manatsu's mirror fragment inside Ichika's desk drawer mysteriously disappears. That evening, a young girl calling herself "Mafuyu, Manatsu's identical twin" appears before Ichika with a mischievous smirk on her face.
anime.consensus_summary: The Uta-Kata special is a welcome addition that addresses some of the loose ends left by the original series, enhancing the overall experience. While it doesn't resolve every issue, it provides a satisfying conclusion to major plot points, with consistent art and enjoyable music. Some character development choices and unresolved subplots remain points of contention, but overall it is well-received.
pros: Art style consistent with the series and of very good quality.
Enjoyable plot that ties up big details from the series.
Appropriate and enjoyable music.
cons: Some subplots and details remain underdeveloped.
A character's behavior feels unnatural.
Doesn't fully resolve all loose ends or character histories.

anime.title: Vampire Princess Miyu
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Mythology, Shoujo, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Evil Shinma (shape-shifting monsters and vampires) roam the Earth on a mission to unleash their darkness upon the Human race. Miyu Royal Princess from the dark is the Chosen One—the one being who must banish the Evil Shinma from the Earth. She has the power to offer Humans the gift of eternal happiness, yet is herself, trapped between two worlds; destined for perpetual solitude and internal conflict. 

Miyu's only companion is Larva, once an evil Shimna; now her devoted guardian. Together they share a dark journey through the weakness of the human heart and the tragic loss of innocence. Cut off from humanity by the knowledge of what she is, Miyu lives an endless quest as both the hunter and the hunted, on the edge of darkness.
anime.consensus_summary: The Vampire Princess Miyu TV series is a divisive show. Some viewers appreciate its dark atmosphere, character development, and exploration of complex themes, while others are turned off by its repetitive episodic structure, subpar animation, and weak overarching plot. Ultimately, the show's success depends on individual preferences for episodic versus plot-driven narratives and tolerance for animation limitations.
pros: The series has well-developed characters, especially Miyu, Larva, and Reiha, with strong backstories and compelling interactions.
The soundtrack and sound design effectively enhance the dark and creepy atmosphere, building upon the style of the OVA.
Some reviews praise the series' exploration of darker aspects of human nature and complex moral themes.
cons: Many find the episodic "monster of the week" format repetitive and boring, especially in the first half of the series.
The animation is often criticized as being economic and subpar, with frequent off-model characters, reused frames, and awkward movements.
The overarching plot is considered rushed and abrupt, failing to deliver on its potential and lacking emotional or thematic resonance.

anime.title: Yawara!
anime.genres: Combat Sports, Comedy, Romance, Seinen, Sports
anime.synopsis:
High school student Yawara Inokuma lives a completely happy and ordinary life. She aspires to an average lifestyle as a delicate young lady with a handsome boyfriend in the near future.

Unfortunately for Yawara, she has an undesirable prodigious talent in Judo, a modern martial art that is neither feminine nor fashionable. Moreover, Yawara is the only granddaughter of the seventh dan Judo master Jigorou Inokuma, who expects her to become a Japanese Judoka superstar of the '90s.

Yawara cautiously hides her strength from everyone to maintain a normal reputation but is often pushed to situations when she must exercise her Judo skills. Observing Yawara's immense potential from the shadows, Kousaku Matsuda, a sports reporter from a substandard paper, is willing to do everything he can to bring her into the limelight.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Yawara! are mixed. While some appreciate the blend of sports and slice-of-life elements, along with the detailed judo sequences and some character development, others find the repetitive nature of the plot and the protagonist's frustrating reluctance to be major drawbacks. The pacing and romance aspects also draw criticism, leading to a somewhat divisive reception.
pros: Authentic portrayal of Judo rules and techniques.
Well-developed supporting characters with depth (e.g., Matsuda, Fujiko).
Exploration of Yawara's character as she balances judo and normal life.
cons: Repetitive plot elements and dialogue.
Yawara's initial reluctance and lack of significant character evolution can be frustrating.
Pacing issues with rushed climaxes and dragged-out scenes.
Weak romance elements.

anime.title: Canvas 2: Rainbow Colored Sketch
anime.synopsis: Kamikura Hiroki is an art student at the local school Nadesico Academy (High School and college level) whom intends to be an art teacher in the future. He is also the advisor to the high school arts society where his cousin, Housen Elis, attends. While Elis is a painter like Hiroki, Hiroki seems to have given up on his dreams and no longer paints. There appears to be some mysterious trauma in the both of their pasts which may have changed them. Meanwhile, the high school hires a new PE teacher, Kikyo Kiri. On the first day, she bumps into Hiroki and is stunned. Here is the boy she confessed to and he refused her...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for character development, engaging story, and blend of genres. However, the controversial ending significantly impacts overall enjoyment, dividing viewers. Some appreciate the show's attempt to subvert harem tropes, while others criticize the illogical plot choices and character decisions. The show has re-watch potential for those who appreciate character driven narrative.
pros: Well-developed characters, especially the main character Hiroki.
Enjoyable blend of drama, slice of life, and comedy.
Story has a nice continuity with almost no filler and some unpredictable elements.
Good voice acting and fitting soundtrack.
Series explores the characters motives and back stories.
cons: Controversial and illogical ending that polarized viewers.
Some find the art and animation to be below average or dated.
Stereotypical harem elements and predictable plot points.
Unnecessary fan service and ecchi scenes.
Some supporting characters are unnecessary or poorly developed.
anime.thematic_vibe: Love Triangle, Slice of Life, Harem (Debated)

anime.title: Tenchi Muyo! Tenchi Universe
anime.synopsis:
Tenchi Masaki's life changes forever when the ship of an infamous space pirate, Ryouko Hakubi, is shot down and crashes near his family's temple. Little did Tenchi know that by saving Ryouko, he would spark a series of events that would lead alien women from all walks of life to inhabit his home. This includes the delicate Princess Aeka of Jurai and her playful younger sister Princess Sasami; the scatterbrained first-class detective Mihoshi Kuramitsu and her more capable partner Kiyone Makibi; and the eccentric, mad scientist Washuu Hakubi.

The six women do their best to adapt to their new lives, but their more advanced and exotic lifestyle does not mesh well with the simplistic customs on Earth. As a result, they just end up making a mess and causing trouble for poor Tenchi. Though the girls are a pain, Tenchi begins to form a close relationship with each of them, and through their bond, he begins to gain a better understanding of his role in the universe.
anime.consensus_summary: Tenchi Muyou! is regarded as a classic harem anime with a good balance of sci-fi and comedy. However, some viewers find it suffers from filler and character inconsistencies compared to the OVA series. While many have nostalgic appreciation, others new to the series may find it dated or uninspired, leading to somewhat divided opinions.
pros: Delightful cast of characters with unique personalities and designs
Great balance of sci-fi and comedy elements
Satisfying and cozy conclusion
Some consider it a classic and influential harem anime
cons: Filler episodes and side-story nonsense can be boring
Some character changes compared to the OVA are considered detrimental
Animation and artwork may not hold up well compared to the OVA
Some find the main character, Tenchi, to be boring
Excessive fan service and panty shots in some versions

anime.title: Kanon Kazahana
anime.synopsis: The spring has come since Yuuichi reunited with Ayu, and lives of all major characters are back on track. When Mishio visits Makoto's birthplace, however, a miracle happens before her eyes.
anime.consensus_summary: Kanon Kazahana is generally viewed as an unnecessary and unimpactful addition to the Kanon series. While some appreciate the closure it provides, most find it uneventful and question its purpose. It doesn't evoke strong emotions, leaning more towards indifference, and is considered skippable for most viewers.
pros: Provides closure for characters not focused on in the main story.
Offers a 'happy' ending for those who found the series too bleak.
cons: Feels uneventful and pointless.
Adds little to the original narrative; events could be condensed into a montage.
Weakens the emotional impact of the main series.
Unnecessary and boring for those not invested in the side characters.

anime.title: Comic Party: Revolution
anime.synopsis:
A man-made island sits on the edge of Tokyo, well off the beaten path. The time is drawing near when this island of cold concrete will be set afire with passion. People will gather to draw manga, search for manga, and get passionate about manga! It's a joyous celebration of individuals who've staked their entire youths on doujinshi. It's Comic Party!

Kazuki and Mizuki are college students immersing themselves in the otaku subculture. Kazuki has grown more confident in his abilities as a doujinshi (amateur comic) artist, but will all the girls distract him or help him succeed? And what of Taishi's plans for world domination?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience reception to Comic Party Revolution is mixed, with many finding it inferior to the original series. While some appreciate the humor and character interactions, particularly if they are familiar with the game, others criticize the lack of plot, inconsistent character development, and subpar English dub. The shift in focus towards a more generic harem rom-com formula disappointed many viewers who were expecting a continuation of the original's unique blend of otaku culture and doujin creation.
pros: Colorful and well-animated visuals, consistent with the original series.
Catchy and memorable opening and closing themes.
Enjoyable character interactions, especially for fans of the first season and game.
cons: Lack of coherent or cohesive plot, episodes feel random and disconnected.
Inconsistent character development and reliance on pre-existing knowledge from the game.
English dub quality is lacking, with forced accents and over-the-top performances.
Genericism and shift in focus towards harem rom-com elements, diluting the original's charm.
anime.thematic_vibe: Otaku Culture, Harem Rom-Com, Random Comedy

anime.title: Secret of Cerulean Sand
anime.synopsis: Jane's mother dies when she is born, and her father, a rich English aristocrat, soon remarries to a woman with a son, William, who despises his new father and brother. George and Jane grow up with a dream to make a flying machine. George believes the distant Asian sands hold a secret: a mysterious cerulean sand which can make machines fly. He goes on an expedition to find it, and soon is reported executed for treason. William disappears too. After she recieves an unsigned letter holding a handful of pale-blue sand which floats in the air, Jane is sure her brother is alive and leaves to the East to find him and prove him innocent. There are many mysteries to unravel in store for Jane and her new friends on her journey. But perhaps a mystery should forever remain a mystery...
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is highly praised for its engaging characters, intriguing plot, and family-friendly content. While the art style and music may not be exceptional, the strong character development and emotional impact create a memorable viewing experience. The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with many viewers expressing a desire for a sequel.
pros: Engaging characters with depth and development
Intriguing plot with twists and turns
Showcases character development beautifully
Enjoyable for both adults and children
cons: Predictable villain
Art style may not appeal to all viewers
Music is good but not particularly memorable

anime.title: Mujin Wakusei Survive
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: The story is set in the 22nd century where space travel, planet colonization and anti-gravity basketball are practically everyday things. Planet Earth has become uninhabitable, and therefore people live in colonies on the surrounding planets. On a school field trip, a mistake causes the protagonist, a young transfer student named Luna, her pet robot, and six of her classmates to be thrown through a gravity storm and crash land on a seemingly uninhabited planet. There, with Luna as their leader, the robot cat Chako, the lone wolf Kaoru, the spoiled rich boy Howard, the shy Sharla, the obedient Bell, the prideful musician Menori and the young genius Shingo must fight for their survival. But is the planet really uninhabited, or is there someone or something out there, waiting in the shadows?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience generally enjoyed 'Mujin Wakusei Survive,' praising its character development, engaging storyline, and blend of survival and sci-fi elements. However, the series faced criticism for inconsistent animation and a perceived decline in quality during the later episodes, particularly regarding preachy themes. Despite these drawbacks, the show is considered a worthwhile watch, especially for fans of adventure and coming-of-age stories.
pros: Strong character development, especially considering the initial archetypes.
Well-paced story with a good balance of survival elements and sci-fi mystery.
The series evokes a genuine sense of camaraderie and teamwork among the characters.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and art style.
The later part of the series suffers from preachy messaging and plot contrivances.
Some characters' voices were not well-received.

anime.title: Rec
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Romance, Seinen, Showbiz
anime.synopsis:
After being stood up for a movie date, marketing employee Fumihiko Matsumaru is about to throw away his tickets when he is stopped by a girl who implores him to let her accompany him instead. Thanks to his upbeat and eccentric companion Aka Onda, an aspiring voice actress, Fumihiko enjoys his evening. While walking home together, they find out that they live in the same neighborhood. Mere hours later, Fumihiko wakes up from a nightmare and hears sirens outside his window. Going outside to check the situation, he sees that Aka's apartment has burned down, along with all her possessions. Fumihiko invites the distressed Aka to stay at his place, leading to them sleeping together.

In the aftermath of that fateful night, their personal and professional lives become inextricably intertwined. Not only do they begin living together platonically despite their one-night stand, they also discover that Aka will be voicing the mascot Fumihiko designed for his company's newest product. While trying to keep their live-in relationship under wraps for fear of scrutiny, the two begin to support each other throughout the difficulties in their respective careers.
anime.consensus_summary: Rec is generally well-received as a heartwarming and realistic romance anime, praised for its relatable characters and focus on career challenges. While some criticize its dated animation and predictable story, many appreciate its concise storytelling and genuine portrayal of relationships. The series is considered a good choice for romance fans looking for a short and sweet anime.
pros: Heartwarming and entertaining despite its short length.
Realistic portrayal of relationships and career challenges.
Good character development and relatable characters.
Pacing is well-managed and avoids unnecessary melodrama.
Addresses the challenges of balancing professional and personal life.
cons: Animation quality is dated and unimpressive.
Soundtrack is forgettable and lacks memorable music.
Story can be predictable and lacks originality.
Some find the initial relationship development rushed and contrived.
Some find the male lead annoying or unlikeable.
anime.thematic_vibe: Realistic Romance, Slice of Life, Career focused

anime.title: Zoids Genesis
anime.synopsis: Natural disasters have devastated planet Zi, killing off almost all life. A thousand years later humans have gradually re-established civilization, salvaging ancient Zoids through diving and mining efforts. In a village whose most previous item is a giant sword which they worship as a holy symbol. A teenage boy discovers an ancient Liger-type Zoid while on a deep water salvage operation. Suddenly the village is attacked by skeletal Bio-Zoids intent on stealing a powerful generator located in the village. Our teenage hero awakens the Liger and discovers that the town`s sacred sword is the Liger`s weapon, together they fight off the mysterious Bio-Zoids. At least for now...
anime.consensus_summary: Zoids Genesis is generally viewed as a worthwhile entry in the Zoids franchise, particularly praised for its stronger plot and character development compared to previous series. However, some viewers are put off by the departure from familiar Zoids designs and inconsistencies in the plot. The series has a slow start and some odd moments, but overall it offers an engaging mecha experience, especially for Zoids fans.
pros: Well-written story with character development
Good animation, especially Zoid run-cycles
Unique Zoids and Murasame Liger transformations
Stronger plot than other Zoids series
cons: Removal of old Zoids may be a turn off for some fans
Some characters lack development
Slow start with boring early episodes
Inconsistent depiction of character deaths
Occasional 'what the hell' moments that don't fit the Zoids theme

anime.title: Air: The Motion Picture
anime.synopsis:
Centuries ago, Kanna, a princess and the last of a winged race, was held prisoner in a castle as she was feared by the rest of the world. However, when she met a soldier named Ryuuya, she fell in love with him and told him of her wishes to see the outside world and to find her mother. Ryuuya attempted to fulfill these wishes. However, his efforts were in vain as Kanna was sealed in the sky through magic and cursed to be in pain for all eternity.

Hundreds of years later, Yukito, a decendant of Ryuuya, comes to a quiet town one week before their annual festival with hopes that he can make some money. However, when he meets an unusual girl called Misuzu, he is reminded of what his mother once told him—"When you go out on your journey, if you find the winged girl's re-incarnation, you must use your power to set her free."

Yukito and Misuzu's fates soon become intertwined with each other, with each developing feelings for the other. However when Yukito realizes Misuzu's connection to the past, he must decide on whether to leave, or to attempt to break the curse that has bound Kanna in centuries of pain.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Air' movie is a divisive adaptation, often compared unfavorably to the TV series. While some appreciate its focus on the central romance and tighter pacing, many criticize the inferior animation quality, altered character portrayals, and rushed plot. Ultimately, the movie's effectiveness depends heavily on whether the viewer can appreciate it as a standalone piece or will constantly compare it to its source material.
pros: Condensed story focuses on main relationships.
Some viewers found the movie more emotionally relatable than the TV series.
The alternate retelling offers a unique perspective.
The movie avoids extraneous subplots.
cons: Animation quality is inferior to the TV series (Kyoto Animation).
Character personalities are altered, which some viewers disliked.
Secondary characters are either removed or given minor roles.
The story feels rushed and shallow compared to the TV series.
Some viewers disliked the ending and preferred the TV series' ending.
Inconsistent character animation.
Poor plot and confusing storyline.

anime.title: If I See You in My Dreams
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Drama, Ecchi, Love Polygon, Romance, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Fuguno Matsuo has never had a girlfriend all his 24 years in life and what makes things worse is that a fortune teller predicted that he never will. However, when he laid his eye on Nagisa-sensei he fell in-love right away and began earnestly wooing her. Along comes Hamaoka, a co-worker who is smitten with Fuguno, and a love-triangle ensues.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is generally considered a decent romantic comedy for its time, with some finding the humor enjoyable while others find it overbearing and detrimental to the story. The characters are a point of contention, with some appreciating them and others finding them annoying or weak. The ending is a common point of criticism.
pros: Story is cool
Art is good for its time
Sound is good, maybe better than the art
Enjoyable characters
cons: Story ruined by comedic aspect
Characters are weak and played around with
Ending is not well-liked
Nagisa can be a b####

anime.title: Princess Tutu
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Drama, Love Polygon, Mahou Shoujo, Mystery, Performing Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis:
In a fairy tale come to life, the clumsy, sweet, and gentle Ahiru seems like an unlikely protagonist. In reality, Ahiru is just as magical as the talking cats and crocodiles that inhabit her town—for Ahiru really is a duck! Transformed by the mysterious Drosselmeyer into a human girl, Ahiru soon learns the reason for her existence. Using her magical egg-shaped pendant, Ahiru can transform into Princess Tutu—a beautiful and talented ballet dancer whose dances relieve people of the turmoil in their hearts. With her newfound ability, Ahiru accepts the challenge of collecting the lost shards of her prince's heart, for long ago he had shattered it in order to seal an evil raven away for all eternity.

Princess Tutu is a tale of heroes and their struggle against fate. Their beliefs, their feelings, and ultimately their actions will determine whether this fairy tale can reach its "happily ever after."
anime.consensus_summary: Princess Tutu is overwhelmingly praised as a unique and engaging anime that transcends typical magical girl tropes. The story, characters, and use of classical music are consistently highlighted as strengths. While some find the initial weirdness and animation style off-putting, the majority view it as a masterpiece of storytelling and character development, a hidden gem that should not be missed.
pros: Unique and well-written story that subverts fairy tale tropes.
Excellent use of classical music to enhance emotional impact.
Well-developed and complex characters with compelling arcs.
High quality English dub.
Creative and imaginative world-building with a fairy-tale atmosphere.
cons: Animation style may appear dated to some viewers.
Aggressively weird and confusing plot, especially in the beginning.
The story can get very confusing.
Soundtrack is not completely classical.

anime.title: First Kiss Story
anime.synopsis:
Moments before her upperclassman, Yoshihiko, left for college, Kana Orikura finally built up the courage to confess her love to him. Sharing their first kiss, the two decided to enter a relationship—a dream come true for Kana. 

Since that first moment, however, Kana and Yoshihiko have struggled with their relationship, resulting in Kana feeling lonely and depressed. But things take an unexpected turn when Shougo Hayakawa—the young and attractive teacher assigned to Kana's class—starts living in her house! Will Kana betray Yoshihiko for this new contender, or remain loyal to the man who took her first kiss?
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'First Kiss Monogatari' is a below-average romance anime. Many find the story simple and unengaging, with underdeveloped characters and odd pacing. While some appreciate its fluffy, feel-good nature, most viewers are left wanting more depth and meaningful conflict, making it a skippable title for those seeking a compelling romance.
pros: Decent art and sound for an older OVA
Fluffy, feel-good story (for some)
cons: Simple, unentertaining story
Undeveloped characters
Unrealistic character reactions
Odd pacing with delays in dialogue
Rushed ending
Lack of depth and meaningful conflict

anime.title: Goldfish Warning!
anime.synopsis: The show starts with the tale of Chitose Fujinomiya, a girl who goes from riches to rags and back and remains a snob despite it all. When her wealthy father dies, remaining debts leave Chitose almost broke, and she is kicked out of the affluent Tokai no Gakuen, or City Academy. She is left with nothing in the world but the clothes on her back and one pink goldfish named Gyopi-chan, the only memento she has of her father. Wandering lost, she collapses on the grounds of the poor-but-happy Inaka no Chugakko (Country Jr. High School), where the students are rough if friendly, and farm animals regularly roam the school grounds and even attend class. Recovering, she enters into the school but is repelled by its air of poverty, to which she is unaccustomed.
anime.consensus_summary: Kingyo Chuuihou! is a beloved and visually appealing comedy anime, often compared to Sailor Moon in its aesthetic sensibilities. The show is praised for its charming characters, expressive animation, and digestible episodic structure. Overall, it's considered a pleasant and enjoyable viewing experience with little to no significant criticisms.
pros: Visually appealing, reminiscent of Sailor Moon with watercolor backgrounds and pastel palettes.
Expressive animation and shifting art styles enhance the comedy.
Memorable characters with good interactions and distinct designs.
Enjoyable and digestible episodic segments with continuity.

anime.title: Interstella5555: The 5tory of The 5ecret 5tar 5ystem
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Adventure, Drama, Music, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: This musical film is the visual realization of "Discovery", an album by Daft Punk. It tells the story of a band of four extraterrestrial musicians who are kidnapped and brought back to Earth by an evil manager. Their only hopes lie with a space pilot from their home planet who, after receiving a distress call broadcasted during the abduction, seeks out to rescue them.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences appreciate the film's unique approach to storytelling and its strong connection between music and visuals. While some find the plot simplistic and the lack of dialogue a drawback, the film's nostalgic feel and Daft Punk's soundtrack are major draws. It is generally well-received, particularly by fans of Daft Punk and classic anime.
pros: Unique storytelling through music and visuals.
Excellent music and animation synchronization.
Nostalgic art style reminiscent of classic anime.
cons: Lack of dialogue limits character development.
Simple plot may not appeal to all viewers.
Repetitive music can be unengaging for some.

anime.title: Vampire Hunter D
anime.synopsis: 10,000 years in the future, the world has become a very different place; monsters roam the land freely, and people, although equipped with high tech weapons and cybernetic horses, live a humble life more suited to centuries past. The story focuses on a small hamlet plagued by monster attacks and living under the shadow of rule by Count Magnus Lee, a powerful vampire lord who has ruled the land for thousands of years. When a young girl is bitten by the Count and chosen as his current plaything, she seeks out help of a quiet wandering stranger, D. It so happens that D is one of the world's best vampire hunters, and he takes it upon himself to cut through Magnus Lee's many minions, and put an end to the Count's rule.
anime.consensus_summary: Vampire Hunter D is a divisive cult classic, lauded for its pioneering style, atmospheric world-building, and unique blend of genres that significantly influenced early anime reception in the West. However, its dated animation, incoherent plot, and underdeveloped characters are frequent points of criticism, leading to a significant split in audience opinion regarding its overall quality and watchability for modern viewers.
pros: Visually striking and atmospheric art style, especially for its era.
Unique and compelling blend of science fiction and gothic horror elements.
Intriguing world-building and monster designs.
Strong, albeit mysterious, protagonist in D.
Pioneering influence on the anime landscape in the US, contributing to the rise of the adult anime community.
cons: Dated animation and choppy fight choreography, relying heavily on speed lines.
Incoherent and disjointed plot with numerous plot holes and unexplained subplots.
Undeveloped and stereotypical characters, particularly the female lead.
Inconsistent pacing and a tendency to drag, with scenes feeling extraneous.
Visuals can be too dark and difficult to discern, especially in certain scenes.

anime.title: MÄR
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Dreaming of a magical world every night, the young Toramizu Ginta yearns to be able to go there. With only his friend Koyuki believing in his dreams, Ginta remains positive despite the slander he receives from others over his dreams. But his wishes are answered, as one day a large door appears in front of Ginta, summoning him to the land of MAR Heaven. In this land, the weapons known as ARMS exist. While initially Ginta greatly enjoyed the discovery of this magical world, he soon learns of the terrible wars that have once plagued MAR Heaven and the upcoming war that may soon appear.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some finding MÄR to be an enjoyable and nostalgic shonen anime with charming characters and fight scenes. However, many criticize its predictable plot, poor character development, and repetitive tournament arc. The animation and CGI are also points of concern, leading to a generally lukewarm reception despite some positive aspects.
pros: Enjoyable characters with distinct goals
Charming plot fitting for the genre
