Likeable main characters and their interactions.
Some arcs, like the Ashura and Kurogane arcs, are well-received.
Improved character development for Sakura compared to the first season.
cons: Excessive filler episodes that don't advance the plot.
Inconsistent and low-budget animation quality.
Rushed production and censorship due to NHK restrictions.
Poor pacing and dragging out the plot.
Lack of character development for most of the main characters.
Changes to the storyline that deviate from the manga.
Ambiguous and unsatisfying ending.

anime.title: Yokoyama Mitsuteru Sangokushi
anime.synopsis:
Around 1800 years ago in China, the ruling power of the Han dynasty became weakened and the flames of war spread throughout the land. 

Liu Bei was a young, poor straw-mat seller from the countryside of Hebai Hsing. After pledging eternal brotherhood with the two heroes, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, Liu began building his idea of a righteous kingdom that would aid citizens who suffered from persecution.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is praised for its faithfulness to the source material and historical accuracy, making it enjoyable for fans of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. However, it is criticized for its incomplete narrative, mediocre presentation, and dated visuals. While some appreciate the character consistency, others find the character development bland and the focus on the Shu faction limiting.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms story
Historically accurate and consistent
Good voice acting and music that fits the Sangoku era
Characters are portrayed accurately to historical records and the novel
cons: Incomplete story, only covers up to the Battle of Chibi
Mediocre presentation and bland character development
Dated art style and limited animation
Focus on the Shu faction limits character appeal for other sides

anime.title: Astro Boy (2003)
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
At the Ministry of Science, fervent Professor Ochanomizu alongside his coworkers strive to reactivate Atom—the first robot with a human heart. Atom is the masterpiece of enigmatic Professor Umatarou Tenma, who built the android to replace his deceased son Tobio. However, while Tenma inexplicably shut down his brainchild and disappeared, Ochanomizu refuses to let such a major breakthrough in science go to waste.

Despite having the appearance of a nine-year-old, Atom not only possesses incredible strength and intelligence, but he is also endowed with a remarkable conscience and compassion that rivals humans. Sadly, the mechanical boy soon faces rejection and learns that not everyone is as welcoming as Ochanomizu. Although automatons have integrated into society, they are accepted only as tools and even seen as an upcoming threat to mankind's dominion.

Dreaming of a world where people and robots can prosper together, Atom dedicates his existence to protecting the lives of both and inspiring them to form genuine bonds.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Astro Boy is remembered fondly, especially by those who watched it as children, with a strong sense of nostalgia. The show's moral messages and exploration of coexistence resonate well, though some find the later animation quality and English adaptation to be significant drawbacks. While primarily aimed at children, it can also be appreciated by adults for its thematic depth and classic appeal.
pros: Exploration of coexistence between robots and humans.
Charming main character with a compelling journey.
Soundtrack and art style are praised, especially in the first half.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with a noticeable drop in the later episodes.
English adaptation is heavily criticized for poor voicing, modified dialogues, and altered music.
Some storylines and characters are considered simplistic or one-dimensional.

anime.title: Glass Fleet
anime.romaji_title: Glass no Kantai: La Legende du Vent de l'Univers
anime.synopsis: The People's Army led by Michel stands against Vetti's newly founded empire. Upon seeing how strong the Glass Battleship is, Michel tries to get Cleo, the captain of the Glass Battleship, to help People's Army overthrow Vetti's empire. And together they fight against Vetti's empire.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some appreciate the unique character and costume designs, as well as the musical score. However, many find the animation subpar, the plot rushed and uninspired, and the character development weak. The series is seen as an unsuccessful attempt to blend space opera with medieval fantasy, ultimately falling short of its ambitions.
pros: Interesting costume design
Unique character designs
Good musical score
cons: Subpar animation quality
Rushed plot progression
Weak character development
Uninspired story
anime.thematic_vibe: Space Opera, Political Intrigue, Medieval Fantasy

anime.title: Dead Leaves
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gore, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Shortly after waking up in an unknown street with no clothes or memories, Retro and Pandy team up and begin a life of thrill chasing and violence. Retro's wild antics and Pandy's carefree personality make them the perfect partners in crime to cause mayhem wherever they strike.

When an accidental mistake lands them behind bars, Retro and Pandy are sent to Dead Leaves—a high-security prison on the Moon. Once there, they soon discover that the other inmates are clones, all products of genetic mutation experiments. With nothing better to do, they escape from their cell and lead a prison break with the other captives. Armed with a crew of mutants and a hunger for havoc, the chaotic duo begins their wacky escape.
anime.consensus_summary: Dead Leaves is a highly stylized and chaotic anime that polarizes viewers. While many praise its unique visuals, frenetic pace, and over-the-top humor, others find the plot incoherent, the content excessively crude and violent, and the animation style jarring. It's a love-it-or-hate-it experience that demands a tolerance for the absurd.
pros: Unique and energetic animation style
Fast-paced and action-packed
Memorable and original character designs
cons: Incomprehensible or weak plot
Over-the-top violence and gore may be off-putting
Crude humor and sexual content not for everyone

anime.title: Yokohama Kaidashi Kikou: Quiet Country Cafe
anime.romaji_title: Yokohama Kaidashi Kikou: Quiet Country Cafe
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
In the twilight of the human age, mankind continues to persevere, resisting the lull of nature's reclamation. For Alpha Hatsuseno and her café, things have not changed. The familiar sights and scenery instill a comforting solace—a sentiment cherished by Alpha. One day, however, a radio weather report forecasts an approaching typhoon that threatens to undermine the enduring peace.

After taking refuge at Ojisan's gas station and returning to the café, Alpha is devastated to see that her beloved shop had been ravaged by the storm. Determined to restore it back to its former glory, she resolves to find other jobs as a way to fund the repairs. The journey into the unknown is an opportunity to explore what remains of civilization, and Alpha seizes this chance to expand her view of the outside world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While many appreciate the relaxing atmosphere, beautiful visuals, and soothing music, there are criticisms regarding the pacing, character design, and addition of unnecessary fan service. Some feel the OVA doesn't live up to the quality of the first OVA or the source material. The series is best enjoyed as a calming slice-of-life experience, but viewers seeking a more engaging plot may be disappointed.
pros: Relaxing and calming atmosphere.
Beautiful background art and animation.
Soothing and enjoyable soundtrack.
cons: Pacing is slow and uneventful.
Character designs are generic.
Unnecessary fanservice elements.
Story is a compressed adaptation of the manga and lacks depth.

anime.title: Ground Defense Force! Mao-chan
anime.synopsis: Mao Onigawara is a happy 8-year-old grade-schooler and the granddaughter of Chief of Staff of Ground Defense Force. Equipped with her cloverleaf-shaped badge which enables her to transform (but gives her no special power whatsoever), Mao and her best friends (granddaughters of Chief of Staff of Air and Marine Defense Force, respectively) will defend Japan against the invasion from "cute aliens," who are way too cute to be dealt with by regular armed forces.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Rikujou Bouei-tai Mao-chan' to be a cute and enjoyable comedy, especially for those who appreciate childlike humor and charming characters. While some find it childish or inconsistent, the series is seen as a lighthearted and fun watch. The show's unique premise and quirky characters contribute to a positive overall reception, making it a good choice for those seeking short, comedic content.
pros: Fresh and entertaining concept with cute alien antagonists.
Charming and unique characters.
Unpredictable and funny plot in each episode.
cons: May seem childish and intended only for kids.
Questionable character designs.
Inconsistent quality compared to the first episode.

anime.title: Cosplay Complex
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Otaku Culture, Parody, School
anime.synopsis: Every cosplay club in Japan shares the same dream: to take first place at the Cosplay World Series. East Oizumi Academy's club is no different; led by Gorou Yorozuyo, the club's members spend every moment training and preparing for competitions. Still, even with ace cosplayer Chako Hasegawa and the shape-shifting powers of the fairy Delmo on their side, the club must work hard if they want to become the best in Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some find it a funny and light-hearted parody of otaku culture and cosplay, appreciating the character designs and animation for its time. Others find it falls short due to a weak story, basic characters, poor voice acting and humor that doesn't always land. Most agree it's a short, easily digestible show that doesn't require deep thinking.
pros: Good set of characters for comedy
Well-drawn animation for its time (2002)
Enjoyable for light-hearted fun if you like cosplay
Interesting cosplay designs and references
cons: Story ends abruptly, with a cliffhanger
Basic characters, nothing special
Music is almost non-existent
Voice work is amateurish (dub)
Humor can fall flat; feels like it's trying too hard

anime.title: Cosplay Complex: Extra Identification
anime.synopsis: The Extra Identification episode will allow you to match the different costumes in the series to the anime series they are from.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Cosplay Complex: Extra Identification' as a simple but informative extra episode. It serves as a convenient guide for identifying the anime series represented in the cosplay costumes. While the animation is basic and the music repetitive, it effectively quenches the curiosity of viewers interested in the cosplay origins.
pros: Comprehensive list of anime cosplays.
Satisfies curiosity about the origins of the costumes.
cons: Simple Picture Drama animation style.
Repetitive music loop.

anime.title: Dragon Ball Z: Plan to Eradicate the Saiyans
anime.romaji_title: Dragon Ball Z: Saiya-jin Zetsumetsu Keikaku
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Dr. Raichii is the only Tsufurujin (the race eradicated by the Saiyajin many years ago) thought to have survived. He now is going to take revenge on the only surviving Saiyajin still alive, Goku and Vegeta. He uses machines that emit destron, a gas that will destroy all life on Earth. Now the the Z warriors only have 72 hours to find and destroy Dr. Raichii.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely agrees this OVA is one of the weaker entries in the Dragon Ball Z franchise. Critics cite poor animation and a weak plot, stemming from its origins as a video game tie-in. While some minor elements are acknowledged positively, the overall sentiment is that it's forgettable and uninspired, with a later remake faring even worse.
pros: Dr. Raichii's character design is decent
A good fakeout gag near the end
cons: Terrible animation
A nothing-plot
Recap movie for a Super Nintendo RPG
The plot is derivative of another OVA

anime.title: Dragon Ball Z: The History of Trunks
anime.romaji_title: Dragon Ball Z Special 2: Zetsubou e no Hankou!! Nokosareta Chousenshi - Gohan to Trunks
anime.synopsis: It has been thirteen years since the Androids began their killing rampage and Son Gohan is the only person fighting back. He takes Bulma's son Trunks as a student and even gives his own life to save Trunks's. Now Trunks must figure out a way to change this apocalyptic future.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus leans heavily positive, with 'The History of Trunks' being widely regarded as one of the best, if not the best, Dragon Ball Z specials. Its departure from the usual tone, focusing on emotional depth and character tragedy, is a major strength for most viewers. Minor criticisms revolve around predictable plot points and a few narrative inconsistencies, but these do not significantly detract from the overall appreciation for its darker, more impactful storytelling.
pros: Offers a darker, more emotional, and character-driven narrative compared to typical Dragon Ball Z fare.
Effective portrayal of a bleak, apocalyptic future that resonates emotionally with viewers.
Strong character development for Trunks and Gohan, highlighting their relationship and Gohan's role as a mentor.
The soundtrack and sound design are praised for enhancing the emotional impact and action.
Villains (Androids 17 & 18) are presented as more menacing and less cliché than in other DBZ movies.
cons: Some plot conveniences and logical inconsistencies, such as civilians enjoying amusement parks amidst destruction.
The absence of Gohan's final fight against the androids is a notable missed opportunity for many viewers.
While generally good, some animation scenes are noted as rehashed or not of the highest quality, consistent with its 1993 production.
The plot can feel shallow or predictable to some, especially given the established lore of the series.
The special's length is considered by some to be too short, limiting the exploration of certain plot points or character moments.

anime.title: Dragon Ball Z: Bardock, The Father of Goku
anime.romaji_title: Dragon Ball Z Special 1: Tatta Hitori no Saishuu Kessen
anime.synopsis: Bardock, Son Goku's father, is a low-ranking Saiyan soldier who was given the power to see into the future by the last remaining alien on a planet he just destroyed. He witnesses the destruction of his race and must now do his best to stop Frieza's impending massacre.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, with many praising Bardock's characterization and the special's darker, more tragic tone as a significant departure from typical DBZ fare. However, a notable segment of the audience questions its canonicity and necessity, viewing it as potentially contradictory to established lore or redundant information. The English dub also draws significant criticism, with many recommending the original Japanese version.
pros: Strong character development for Bardock, offering a 'real' and complex protagonist.
The dark, tragic tone provides a refreshing departure from the typical Dragon Ball Z formula.
Effective use of Bardock's premonitions as a plot device to enhance the narrative.
The soundtrack significantly elevates the mood and action scenes.
Acts as a compelling prequel that adds significant background to the Frieza Saga.
Offers a unique perspective outside of Goku and the Z Fighters, focusing on the Saiyan race.
cons: The narrative's canon status and continuity with the main series are questioned by some viewers.
The story is considered by some to be unnecessary as the Frieza Saga already covered these events.
The emotional connection to Bardock and his team is difficult for some viewers to achieve.
The English dub is widely criticized for poor voice acting and script choices, detracting from the experience.
Some viewers felt the Saiyan race's portrayal was inconsistent with established lore or Toriyama's original intent.
The inclusion of Bardock's visions of the future is seen by some as a weak plot device.

anime.title: Dragon Ball GT: A Hero's Legacy
anime.romaji_title: Dragon Ball GT: Gokuu Gaiden! Yuuki no Akashi wa Suushinchuu
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Years after the end of the Dragonball GT, the story continues in this special with Son Goku's now eldery granddaughter Pan, and a new generation of super saiyajins, the great-great-grandsons of Goku and Vegeta
100 years after the end of DBGT, all the heroes of Earth have died...except for Pan, the granddaughter of Son Goku. Pan has a grandchild named Goku Jr. However, he does not have the bravery of his great-great-grandfather. Pan suffurs a heart attack, and Goku Jr. believes that he might be able to save her with the power of the 4 star Dragon Ball. Along with the school bully, he tries to find the ball...and unleashes his hidden bravery and power.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with many praising its emotional depth, relatable protagonist, and satisfying conclusion as a fitting end to GT. However, a significant portion finds it too slow, lacking in action, and a derivative imitation of the original Dragon Ball, failing to capture the franchise's typical excitement.
pros: Satisfying and emotional ending, considered one of the best in the franchise.
Charming and relatable protagonist who overcomes fear and anxiety.
Visually appealing with nice artwork and a great soundtrack.
Captures the spirit of classic Dragon Ball's adventurous roots.
Offers a human and relatable story within the Dragon Ball universe.
cons: Villains are forgettable and lack threat, not living up to Dragon Ball standards.
Plot is too simplistic and lacks innovation, feeling like a rehash of early Dragon Ball.
Not action-packed or high-stakes, disappointing for viewers expecting typical Dragon Ball fights.
The humor is not characteristic of the Dragon Ball franchise.
Some find the premise bland and lacking the charisma expected from the Dragon Ball name.

anime.title: Kamisama Kazoku
anime.synopsis: Samatarou is not just an average high-school boy, the truth is that he is the son of a god, his mother is a goddess and his sisters are candidates to become goddesses. They are living in the human world, because they want their boy to learn about the human customs and the habits of the creatures that they are protecting, so that in this way Samatarou will become a better god. Tenko is a angel assigned to look after Samatarou. She's born the same day, same year as Samatarou and have been close friends ever since. Life seems normal but things start to change with the appearance of a transfer student named Kumiko. Samatarou falls in love with her and from now on, things will be a lot more different for him. His decision of making her fall in love with him without using his powers will put him in trouble.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Kamisama Kazoku is viewed as a lighthearted and enjoyable anime, particularly for fans of romantic comedies with a supernatural twist. Viewers appreciate the unique story and well-developed characters, although some find the plot and animation to be somewhat dated or uninspired. The series is generally considered a pleasant and entertaining watch, especially for those seeking a break from more serious anime genres.
pros: Unique and refreshing story concept.
Well-developed characters with good voice acting.
Enjoyable blend of romance and comedy.
Good pacing and engaging plot arcs.
Original character designs and refreshing art style.
cons: Story can be corny or contrived at times.
Some plot loopholes and unexplained conveniences.
Animation may seem outdated to some viewers.
Superficial Romance.
Ending is not good enough.

anime.title: Dual! Parallel Trouble Adventure
anime.synopsis: Kazuki Yotsuga is your regular average nerd in high-school, except he isn't smart. He has this website which relates to his visions that only he can see. His visions are about robots who keep fighting each other battle after battle. One day he is sent to a "parallel world" where these visions exist and he joins a company to fight back against the devious RaRa, who want to take over the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Dual! Parallel Lun-Lun Monogatari is seen as a lighthearted parody of mecha anime, particularly Evangelion, with some enjoyable comedic and slice-of-life elements. However, it suffers from a generic plot, weak character development, and inconsistent animation. It's considered an okay watch for those seeking simple entertainment but falls short of being a standout title.
pros: Parodies of Evangelion are humorous and well-executed.
Slice of life elements and character interactions are enjoyable.
English dub is considered good by some viewers.
The series doesn't take itself too seriously.
cons: Plot is generic and uninspired, lacking depth.
Character development is weak, with stereotypical harem archetypes.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with dated CGI.
Serious plot developments in the second half are poorly explained and rushed.

anime.title: The Prince of Tennis: National Championship Chapter
anime.synopsis:
Freshman tennis prodigy Ryouma Echizen and the Seishun Academy Boys' Tennis Team have finally reached the National Tournament, eager to fight for the championship title and claim it as their own.

Seishun's first match is against Higa Middle School, the Okinawa-based team labeled as the "dark horse" of the tournament. After watching Higa defeat their first round of opponents using dirty tactics, the Seishun team is determined to show them the value of a fair, hard-earned victory.

Awaiting the winners of the matchup in the quarterfinals is one of Seishun's old rivals: Hyoutei Academy, who are determined to restore their pride after the events at the Kanto Regionals. Hyoutei seeks to prove to everyone that they deserve to be at the Nationals despite only qualifying through a special invitation.

Tennis no Oujisama: Zenkoku Taikai-hen covers the beginning of the long-awaited National Tournament as Ryouma and the Seishun team meet foes of past and present, each with their own unique ideals on how tennis should be played!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the improved animation and nostalgic elements, while others criticize the rushed plot, predictable outcomes due to an overpowered protagonist, and questionable production choices. The compression of the National Tournament arc and the lack of character development beyond the main cast are also points of concern.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to the original series.
Maintains iconic and nostalgic OSTs.
cons: Compressed storytelling due to limited number of episodes.
Protagonist lacks vulnerability, making victories predictable.
Poor production decisions, such as skipping early rounds of the national tournament and including filler episodes.
Loss of secondary characters that added excitement.

anime.title: Sailor Moon Sailor Stars
anime.romaji_title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon: Sailor Stars
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Mahou Shoujo, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
Like the R Season, Sailor Stars is divided into two parts:

The first part resolves some conflicts from the SuperS season, and sees the return of the Outer Senshi, Haruka, Michiru, Setsuna, and Hotaru (now reborn as a child).

In the second part Usagi bids farewell to Mamoru, who is going to America to study. At the same time, the Three Lights apper, an idol trio consisting of three boys, Seiya, Taiki, and Yaten. The new enemy is Galaxia, a woman who desires to rule the entire galaxy by collecting the Star Seeds of humans. Three new Senshi appear, the Sailor Starlights, who have their own reasons to stop Galaxia, but without Sailor Moon's help.
anime.consensus_summary: Sailor Moon Sailor Stars is viewed as a strong, albeit flawed, conclusion to the original anime series. Fans appreciate the emotional depth, character development, and improved art and sound. However, some criticisms are directed at repetitive storylines, inconsistent character focus, and the handling of new characters, leading to a somewhat divided opinion on the season's overall quality.
pros: Strong and emotional storyline with high stakes
Well-developed characters and compelling dynamics, especially Usagi's growth
Improved art and animation compared to previous seasons
Memorable and catchy soundtrack
Satisfying conclusion to the series with a focus on love and compassion
cons: Inconsistent character development for Inner Senshi
Repetitive monster-of-the-week formula can become tiresome
Questionable handling of romantic subplots and character boundaries
Uneven pacing in the mid-section of the season
Underdeveloped new characters

anime.title: Sailor Moon S Movie: Hearts in Ice
anime.romaji_title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon S: Kaguya-hime no Koibito
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Mahou Shoujo, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis: An unusual snow storm hits Tokyo and the Sailor Senshi discover that an evil snow queen Kaguya, wants to freeze the entire earth. It's up to the Inner Sailor Senshi along with the Outers, to defeat the Queen. Meanwhile, Luna falls in love with a human astronomer named Kakeru whose girlfriend is an astronaut about to take a space shuttle mission. Kakeru becomes ill and Luna wishes she could be a human to help him.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly regards Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon S: Kaguya-hime no Koibito as a standout film within the franchise, particularly for its heartfelt focus on Luna's emotional journey and romantic subplot. While minor criticisms exist regarding plot clarity and character inclusion, the consensus is that its strong emotional core, beautiful animation, and evocative music make it a highly recommended and beloved entry.
pros: The focus on Luna's character development and her romantic storyline is a significant strength.
The music and its emotional impact are frequently praised, particularly the theme associated with Luna's feelings.
The animation and artwork, especially in certain scenes and transformations, are considered beautiful and well-executed, often surpassing the main series.
The plot, while not always highly original, is generally well-paced for its runtime and hits emotional notes effectively.
The film successfully expands on characters often sidelined in the main series, offering a fresh perspective.
cons: The plot can be confusing at times, particularly regarding the mix of past and present timelines or the scientists' role.
Some supporting characters, like Himeko, are criticized for being one-dimensional or serving only as plot devices.
The absence of Hotaru (Sailor Saturn) from the film's finale is a point of disappointment for some viewers, given her importance in the S season.
The sound design, specifically the 'Snow Dancers' noises, is noted as being unpleasant by one reviewer.
While based on the manga, some feel the film missed an opportunity to delve deeper into Luna and Artemis's past as presented in the source material.

anime.title: Blue Seed
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Mythology, Romance, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Momiji is an average girl until the day she finds she is the descendant of the great Kushinada family. Only she, with her Kushinada blood, can stop the Aragami, demonic plant-like monsters threatening to destroy Japan. Along to help her is the TAC, and a possible love interest in a young man named Kusanagi.
anime.consensus_summary: Blue Seed is viewed as a solid, though somewhat dated, 90s anime with a strong blend of action, romance, and supernatural elements. While praised for its character development, story, and music, some find the animation quality, episodic early structure, and tonal inconsistencies to be drawbacks. Overall, fans appreciate the series for its nostalgic value and engaging narrative, but acknowledge its flaws.
pros: Well-developed characters with good growth arcs, especially Momiji.
Strong story that blends modern Japanese life with ancient legends.
Memorable soundtrack by Kenji Kawai.
Satisfying ending that connects well to the overall story.
Good mix of action, humor, and drama.
cons: Dated animation and faded colors.
Early episodes follow a repetitive 'monster of the week' format.
Inconsistent tone, shifting between serious and comedic.
Some find the fan service unnecessary and out of place.
Pacing issues due to the episodic nature, particularly in the first half.

anime.title: Gunbuster 2
anime.genres: Award Winning, Comedy, Drama, Mecha, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
Generations have passed since the war with the Space Monsters started, and none remain who know how it began, with even records of those times being scarce. It is a lost cause, but humanity still fights against them, relying on the "Topless": a group of elite space pilots with special powers that allow them to use the Buster Machines—the last hope against the Space Monsters.  

Nono, a girl from a remote Martian town, has heard tales all her life of the legendary pilot "Nono-Riri," and wants nothing more than to leave her humble life behind and follow in the footsteps of her idol. Though she has no idea of the dangers that lie ahead, nothing will stop her from achieving her dream. While Nono is down on her luck, she chances upon the lonesome Topless pilot Lal'C Melk Mark, and decides to stake her entire future on following Lal'C, no matter the cost.
anime.consensus_summary: Diebuster is a visually impressive anime with exciting action, but it suffers from a weaker plot and less compelling characters compared to its predecessor, Gunbuster. Some viewers find the fan service distracting, while others appreciate its high-energy style. Overall, the series is considered a decent sequel, but not a masterpiece.
pros: Stunning animation quality, especially for its time.
Exciting and well-executed action sequences.
Catchy and memorable soundtrack that enhances the viewing experience.
cons: Plot can be convoluted and hard to follow, especially for those unfamiliar with the original Gunbuster.
Characters, particularly Nono, can be one-dimensional and lack significant development.
Excessive fan service and sexualization detract from the overall narrative.

anime.title: Ah! My Goddess Specials
anime.synopsis: Due to the recent events that happened on the last episodes of the season, the Goddess have some stability problems with their body systems. The always adult looking Urd becomes a little girl and has a fateful encounter with a boy, whereas little Skuld becomes an adult and wants to experiment adulthood together with Keiichi.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Aa! Megami-sama! (TV) Specials' are generally well-received by fans of the series, particularly the episodes focusing on Urd and Skuld. While the first recap episode is considered skippable, the other two are seen as enjoyable additions that maintain the tone and feel of the original series. There's a consensus that these specials enhance the overall experience for those already invested in the characters and world.
pros: Stories focus on Urd and Skuld, providing a refreshing change.
Character development for Urd and Skuld is well-received.
Similar enjoyable experience as the TV series for fans.
cons: First episode is a recap with little new material.
Some find the stories silly and without a real point.
Keiichi's character design is sometimes awkward.

anime.title: Star Ocean EX
anime.synopsis: Claude C. Kenni, a crewmember on the spaceship Calnus and son of the commander of the ship, is transported to Expel, a backwards planet with swords and magic. He teams up with Rena Lanford, who thinks he is the legendary Warrior of Light, and other characters to investigate the Sorcery Globe, a meteorite that has been causing problems all over the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, particularly among fans of the original game. While the anime initially captures the charm and adventure of Star Ocean: The Second Story, the incomplete adaptation and deviations from the source material lead to disappointment. Many viewers feel let down by the abrupt ending and the lack of a second season to resolve the plot, creating frustration.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the game's first part, appealing to fans
Enjoyable characters, especially Ashton, provide humor
Good English dub with actors conveying emotion well
Colorful animation and music fitting the show's moods
Unique characters with some modern elements added
cons: Incomplete story due to cancellation, ending on a cliffhanger
Animation is average or amateurish, with cheap CGI
Story deviates from the game in later episodes
Uneven character development and focus, neglecting some main characters
Simplistic plot and writing, lacking depth and sophistication
anime.thematic_vibe: Sci-Fi Adventure, JRPG Adaptation, Unfinished Story

anime.title: Le Chevalier D'Eon
anime.synopsis:
In 18th century Paris, a coffin is found floating down the Seine River. It carries the corpse of noblewoman Lia de Beaumont: a spy of King Louis XV, and whose younger brother D'Eon has just been knighted. When several disappearances occur throughout Paris, the young knight believes that they are somehow connected to his sister's death. Hoping to find her killers, D'Eon joins the secret police to investigate the incidents.

Following the clues, they piece together that a conspiracy between members of the French and Russian nobility, spurred on by a cult, may be behind the disappearances. D'Eon concludes that Lia may have uncovered the truth while on a mission and was killed as a result.

That night, the secret police are to arrest the Duke of Orléans on suspicion of being the mastermind. One of their own transforms into a demon called a Gargoyle and massacres the group. D'Eon attempts to rescue the sole survivor, only to find that he too has been transformed. During the ensuing battle, D'Eon is possessed by Lia's vengeful soul, who takes command of his body and slays the Gargoyle herself. In the aftermath, D'Eon must gather allies to discover the depth of this supernatural conspiracy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Le Chevalier D'Eon. Some appreciate its unique blend of historical fiction and supernatural elements, praising its complex plot and artistic visuals. However, others are critical of its slow pacing, convoluted storyline, and inconsistent character development. The series seems to appeal more to viewers who enjoy intricate plots and are willing to invest time and patience.
pros: Unique and original storyline blending history and fantasy.
Beautiful art and animation, especially in backgrounds and fight scenes.
Complex plot with twists and turns, rewarding patient viewers.
cons: Slow pacing in the first half of the series.
Convoluted plot can be confusing and hard to follow.
Inconsistent character development, especially for the main character, D'Eon.

anime.title: Sugar: A Little Snow Fairy Summer Special
anime.synopsis: When Saga—now 15 years old—arrives at her home after a day of errands, her grandmother Regina discovers an old dress in the attic. At this point, Saga recalls the time her elementary class participated in a play titled "Princess and Fairy." She volunteered to play the role of the Princess while her rival Greta played the evil witch. The production of the school play reminded Sugar and the other fairies of the time "The Bear Pianist" played in the town not too long ago.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally has a positive view of the Chicchana Yukitsukai Sugar Specials, particularly the OVA. It is seen as a return to the strengths of the original series, improving upon its flaws. The specials are praised for their writing and animation quality, suggesting a well-received continuation of the story.
pros: The OVA avoids the flaws of the original series.
The writing is deft and shows love and understanding of the original material.
The special episodes maintain the quality of the original series in animation and writing.
cons: The original series had a vaguely pedo-ish story arc.
In the original series, the logic of Saga's interactions with fairies was inconsistent.

anime.title: Full Metal Panic! The Second Raid: A Relatively Leisurely Day in the Life of a Fleet Captain
anime.romaji_title: Full Metal Panic! The Second Raid: Wari to Hima na Sentaichou no Ichinichi
anime.synopsis: On her day off, Tessa wakes up in her commander chair. After regaining her composure, she notices that her favorite stuffed animal is missing and thus tries to remember what actually transpired the night before. To do so, she will spend time with all the main characters of the Danaan crew, and eventually recalls the events of the previous night.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received by fans of the series for its humor and character interactions. However, some find the plot unoriginal and the lack of a resolution with Tessa's teddy bear disappointing. It's considered an optional watch, mostly appealing to existing fans.
pros: Funny moments without being overboard or OOC.
Good character development for some characters.
Consistent animation quality with the series.
Enjoyable for fans of Full Metal Panic, especially Fumoffu.
cons: Lack of a proper ending theme.
The plot is a tired, played-out amnesia trope.
The episode doesn't really serve a narrative purpose.

anime.title: Battle Angel Alita
anime.synopsis:
Doc Ido, a doctor and mechanic who lives and works in the hellish, postapocalyptic "Scrapyard," finds the—miraculously preserved—remains of a female cyborg in a junk heap. After he revives and rebuilds her, the preternaturally strong, amnesiac "Gally" begins to forge a life for herself in a world where every day can bring a fight for life.

The 1993 Gunnm anime adapts the first two volumes of the Gunnm manga.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Gunnm is mixed, largely due to its nature as an incomplete adaptation of a beloved manga. While praised for its stunning visuals, compelling themes, and well-developed characters that create a strong cyberpunk atmosphere, many viewers lament the rushed pacing and insufficient story development inherent in its short OVA format. It's seen as a visually impressive but narratively unsatisfying introduction to a much larger story.
pros: Artwork and animation are very good, especially for its time, with atmospheric visuals and smooth action sequences.
Character designs are detailed and expressive, contributing to an intimately crafted feel.
Thematic depth exploring concepts like dreams, desperation, freedom, obsession, love, and the divide between social classes.
Compelling character development for the main protagonists, showing complex motivations and realistic behaviors.
The cyberpunk setting is visually striking and effectively conveys the dystopian mood.
The action scenes are well-executed, brutal, and bloody, adding to the overall narrative.
cons: The story feels rushed and underdeveloped due to the limited two-episode format, leaving many plot points and character interactions feeling incomplete.
The OVA is widely regarded as an incomplete adaptation of the manga, leaving viewers wanting more and questioning the plot's progression.
Some voice acting, particularly in the English dub, is criticized as whiny or poor.
While visually impressive, the animation can be described as rushed in places, and some character designs have odd proportions.
The pacing is too quick, with little transitional downtime, making the narrative feel like a string of important events rather than a flowing story.

anime.title: Orphen
anime.synopsis: Six years ago at the magic school known as the Tower of Fang, a grave accident happened involving the magical sword Baltanders and the magic user Azalie. Unable to control the sword's power, Azalie was transformed into the shape of a great dragon who since that day became known as Bloody August. Krilancelo, a young magician at the Tower who cared greatly for Azalie found much to his disgust that the elders of the Tower of Fang were less than willing to save Azalie and wanted rather to pretend the accident never happened. Angered by their stand, Krilanceloa swore that he would find a way to return Azalie to her former self. Thus he forsook the name Krilancelo and declared himself Orphen, leaving the Tower and his magical studies behind to wander the world...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Majutsushi Orphen is viewed as a decent fantasy anime with a good mix of humor and adventure, though its slow pacing and dated visuals are noted drawbacks. Character development is a highlight for some, while others find the characters stereotypical and the comedic elements grating. The series is generally considered enjoyable for fans of classic 90s anime but may not appeal to those seeking a deep or action-packed experience.
pros: Enjoyable story with nice changes to common fantasy elements
Well-done mix of humor, action, and story development
Character-driven narrative with solid character development
Catchy opening music and well-fitting soundtrack
Good English dub with strong voice acting
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the early episodes
Dated art style and animation quality
Stereotypical characters with limited development for some
Comic relief trolls can be annoying
Filler episodes and side quests detract from the main storyline

anime.title: Orphen 2: Revenge
anime.synopsis: Orphen and his gang has set out on an all new adventure with many monsters to battle and no peace and quiet. But a new friend has joined the group. Her name Lycorus who was sent to find Orphen. Many mysterious shadows are overhanging over head.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed 'Majutsushi Orphen: Revenge,' finding it to be a worthwhile sequel. The return of familiar characters and the introduction of new ones contributed positively to the experience. The humor throughout the series was also a point of praise, suggesting a lighthearted and entertaining viewing experience.
pros: Returning characters are well-received.
The addition of new characters is appreciated.
Humor is a highlight of many episodes.

anime.title: Mirage of Blaze
anime.genres: Action, Boys Love, Drama, Historical, Reincarnation, School, Shoujo, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Takaya Ougi is just a typical high school guy who wants nothing more than to protect his best friend and live a normal life. Enter Nobutsuna Naoe, an older man who informs Takaya that he is in fact the reincarnation of Lord Kagetora. Naoe, himself a possessor, awakens Takaya's abilities to exorcise evil spirits and fight the Fuedal Underworld. While most possessors remember their former lives before being reincarnated, Takaya does not. Naoe is thankful for this, considering his passionate and abusive past with his Lord Kagetora. As Takaya improves his abilities, he also begins to remember what Naoe did because of his love for him. Meanwhile the dark forces of the Hojo and Fuma clans begin their attack as the Fuedal Underworld descends upon the living world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, praising the character designs and initial plot, but criticizing animation inconsistencies and confusing narrative threads. The romance feels forced, and many find the plot convoluted. Overall, 'Honoo no Mirage' has interesting ideas but suffers from weak execution and a rushed conclusion, leading to a somewhat forgettable experience for some viewers.
pros: Impressive art style and character design (Itsuko Takeda)
Complex and realistic character personalities
Suspense and horror detectable through sound design
Entertaining and thrilling plot development with drama and action
cons: Animation quality inconsistent, especially in special effects
Story becomes convoluted and abandons initial plot points
Romance feels forced and lacks build-up
Characters look too similar, leading to confusion
Poorly designed episodes with unclear character roles and motivations

anime.title: Kaikan Phrase
anime.synopsis: After the break up of their old band, guitarist Yuki & drummer Santa decide to form a new one. They recruit bass player Towa, young guitarist Atsuro, and after much persuasion, vocalist Sakuya. Together they form Lucifer and they struggle to make it in the music business, and also to stay together. As well, they have to deal with personal issues, such as parental objections, and watching their old bands succeed ahead of them. Sakuya is the most troubled band member, as he has to deal with his tragic past, and his relationship with teenaged lyricist Aine.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the character development and focus on the band's journey, while others are disappointed by the dated animation, deviation from the manga's adult themes, and shoujo cliches. Many recommend reading the manga for a more complete experience. The music is generally well-received, but the pacing can be slow in the initial episodes, causing some viewers to lose interest.
pros: Character development allows viewers to connect with band members.
Music is enjoyable and fits the anime's theme.
Focus on band dynamics and struggles is engaging.
cons: Dated animation and audio quality.
Anime deviates significantly from the manga, omitting adult themes and intense moments.
Slow pacing in the beginning.
Shoujo stereotypes and cliches are present.
anime.thematic_vibe: Music Industry Drama, Character Development, Shōjo Cliches

anime.title: Generator Gawl
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Sci-Fi, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: Ryo, Gawl and Koji are 3 young boys who travel back into the past with only 1 objective: change history. In their time they discover that their country, Kubere, uses genetically enhanced persons called generators as a military tool. These generators are the cause for the Third War which kills most of the human population. Now Koji, Ryo and Gawl are there to change all the events.
anime.consensus_summary: Opinions on Generator Gawl are mixed, with some praising its engaging plot, likeable characters, and thought-provoking themes, while others criticize its pacing, episodic nature, and underwhelming ending. The series has a nostalgic following, but its production values and some story elements are seen as dated. While some view it as a classic, others find it average or disappointing.
pros: Likeable characters and a well-flowing plot.
Thought-provoking exploration of time travel and morality.
Good action sequences and animation quality.
Characters are well-written and fit their roles.
Pacing is well done, especially considering the short length of the series.
cons: The first half of the series could have had more plot development and less monster of the week.
The School Festival episode was unnecessary.
The ending was confusing and felt rushed.
Music is lacking and forgettable.
Some found the character designs simplistic and unappealing.

anime.title: Wolf's Rain OVA
anime.synopsis:
As the world accelerates toward its own destruction, Kiba and Cheza—with the help of Tsume, Hige, Toboe, and Blue—race to reach true paradise before the entire world is rendered uninhabitable. Now reunited, Cher and Hubb decide to accompany the wolves in hopes of seeing the journey through to its end, while a distraught and confused Quent wanders aimlessly into the wasteland with his mind fixated on revenge.

Meanwhile, Lord Darcia the Third has finally put his plot into motion and pursues Cheza, pitting him against the pack. As everything falls apart yet simultaneously falls into place, the wolves struggle to survive in an increasingly dangerous environment. Though the end draws near, paradise seems further away than ever before.
anime.consensus_summary: The Wolf's Rain OVA is generally well-received as a powerful and emotional conclusion to the series. Many appreciate its thematic depth, character development, and impactful ending, though some find the ending rushed, overly tragic, or confusing. While some find the open ending dissatisfying, others appreciate its deeper meaning and the opportunity for personal interpretation.
pros: Intense emotional impact and character development.
Meaningful and thought-provoking ending.
Excellent music and voice acting.
Closes the series in a stunning way
cons: Ending may feel rushed or open-ended.
Some find the ending excessively depressing or illogical.
Pacing can be inconsistent.

anime.title: Legend of Black Heaven
anime.synopsis: Oji Tanaka has a wife, a child and a mundane job as a salary man in Tokyo's modern society. But life wasn't dull for him to begin with; 15 years ago, he was known as "Gabriel", leader of a short-lived heavy metal band called Black Heaven. Oji's life gets a sudden change in direction when he is invited by a mysterious blonde woman named Layla to pick up his Gibson Flying V and once again display his "legendary" guitar skills, not knowing that his music generates power for a massive weapon in an intergalactic war.
anime.consensus_summary: Kachou Ouji is a unique anime that blends slice-of-life with sci-fi elements, appealing to older viewers who can relate to the protagonist's midlife crisis. The music is a strong point, enhancing the emotional impact of the story. However, the show suffers from inconsistent animation and a repetitive soundtrack. Some viewers find the sci-fi plot forced, detracting from the character development and relatable themes.
pros: Relatable midlife crisis themes resonate with older audiences
Music is integral and enhances emotional impact
Unique blend of slice-of-life and sci-fi elements
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and reused frames
Repetitive soundtrack with limited song variety
Sci-fi plot sometimes feels forced and detracts from character development

anime.title: Only Yesterday
anime.synopsis:
Taeko Okajima is a 27-year-old, independent woman who spent her entire life in Tokyo. Looking to unwind from the rush of the big city, she decides to visit her family in the country to help out during the harvest.

On the train there, Taeko vividly recalls her memories as a schoolgirl in the initial stages of puberty, as if she is on a trip with her childhood self. A young farmer named Toshio picks her up at the station, and they quickly develop a friendship. During her stay, Taeko forms strong bonds with family and friends, learning the contrasts between urban and rural life, as well as the struggles and joys of farming.

Nostalgic and bittersweet, Omoide Poroporo takes on Taeko's journey as an adult woman coming to terms with her childhood dreams compared to the person she is today.
anime.consensus_summary: Omoide Poroporo is widely praised for its mature themes, realistic portrayal of life, and artistic direction, often hailed as a Studio Ghibli masterpiece. However, a notable minority found the slow pacing and lack of overt plot to be a significant drawback, leading to a mild division in audience reception.
pros: Masterful direction and realistic portrayal of human experience.
Exceptional script that captures the power and impact of memory.
Superb acting, with natural and believable voice performances.
Stellar Ghibli visuals with unique hyperrealistic character depictions and nuanced facial expressions.
Thematic depth achieved through innovative use of color and visual design to explore self-discovery.
Realistic dialogue and interactions that create a profound sense of immersion.
The film's mature handling of relatable themes like childhood dreams versus adult reality resonates deeply with viewers.
cons: Some viewers found the pacing too slow or the plot to be uneventful and boring.
Certain characters were perceived as unlikeable, mean-spirited, or simply bland.
The transition between past and present timelines was jarring or felt disjointed for some.
The romantic subplot was considered underdeveloped or clichéd by a minority.
The art style, particularly character designs, was polarizing, with some finding them odd or unappealing.
The film's

anime.title: Pom Poko
anime.synopsis:
With the increasing need for Tokyo to expand as one of Japan's major cities, inevitable sacrifices must be made so that changes can take place. One of these sacrifices is that the room for nature and wildlife to flourish will decrease significantly over time. As this decline continues, many animal communities experience the brunt of urbanization. One such community known as the "Tanuki," a type of magical shape-shifting mammal, is caught up in a struggle to defend their beloved forest from being absorbed by the looming threat of an expanding Tokyo.

As more and more Tanuki find themselves with nowhere to hide and territorial fights become increasingly regular amongst the different factions of the community, the elder Tanuki Oroku decides that something must be done. For the sake of their home as well as the safety of their future generations, the Tanuki unite as one with the hope that together they may be able to repel mankind's construction projects and scare them away from the forests using their shapeshifting abilities.

But as they begin their first attempts at sabotage, the Tanuki soon realize the operation will be no easy task. Will they reclaim their forest as a united community, or will they be torn apart by a war against humanity, blinded by anger and pain after witnessing nature's destruction?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is notably divided, with strong appreciation for its unique animation, cultural depth, and environmental message, countered by significant criticism regarding pacing, explicit content, and heavy-handed delivery. While many praise its artistic merit and thematic richness, others find it slow, jarring, or even off-putting, leading to a polarized viewing experience.
pros: Imaginative and unrestrained animation, particularly in transformation sequences
Unique and culturally rich storytelling deeply rooted in Japanese folklore
Humorous and entertaining comedic moments throughout
Strong environmental message and allegory for tradition vs. modernity
Exceptional art direction, backgrounds, and character design typical of Studio Ghibli
Excellent soundtrack featuring traditional Japanese music
Thought-provoking themes that resonate beyond a simple children's story
cons: Documentary-style opening and narration can be slow or unengaging
Pacing issues, with some finding the film too long or meandering
The prominent use of tanuki genitalia can be off-putting or controversial for some viewers
Character development is minimal, with many characters serving more as plot devices
The message can be heavy-handed and delivered without subtlety
Some viewers found the plot execution and character motivations lacking or nonsensical

anime.title: Millennium Actress
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Award Winning, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance, Showbiz
anime.synopsis:
At the turn of the millennium, Ginei Studio's dilapidated buildings are set to be demolished. Ex-employee and filmmaker Genya Tachibana decides to honor this occasion with a commemorative documentary about the company's star actress: Chiyoko Fujiwara, the reclusive sweetheart of Shouwa Era cinema. Having finally obtained permission to interview the retired starlet, an enamored Genya drags along cynical cameraman Kyouji Ida to meet her, ready to put his lifelong idol back in the spotlight once more.

Hidden in this secluded mountain retreat is a thousand years of history condensed into one lifetime, waiting to be narrated. Chiyoko's recollections take them on an illusionary journey through Japanese cinematic history that transcends the boundaries of reality; the saga of her acting career intertwines with her filmography, the actors in her life blend seamlessly with the characters on screen, and the present melds with the past. Though the actress may have retired at the height of her career 30 years ago, the curtain on her life's stage has yet to fall.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, praising the film's artistic merit and innovative storytelling. Some find the plot and characters underdeveloped or the romance unconvincing, but these criticisms are relatively minor. The film is generally considered a masterpiece of animation, though its unconventional narrative might not appeal to all viewers.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style, with seamless transitions between reality and fantasy.
Creative and unique storytelling approach, blending biography with cinematic history.
Effective use of music to enhance the emotional impact of scenes.
cons: Simplistic or underdeveloped plot and characters for some viewers.
The central romance can feel unconvincing or shallow.
Non-linear narrative can be confusing or pretentious to some audiences.

anime.title: Patalliro Saiyuuki!
anime.genres: Adventure, Boys Love, Comedy, Fantasy, Shoujo
anime.synopsis: Genjou Sanzou is a Buddhist monk who has been sent by the Emperor on a journey to find the sacred Buddhist scriptures. One day, Sanzou meets an Earth Deity who tells him that Buddha has sent him a disciple: the mischievous Monkey Deity Son Goku, who was sealed inside of a mountain for five hundred years after wreaking havoc in Heaven! Together with the alcohol-loving playboy Cho Hakkai; the heavenly army General Sagojyou; and their horse, the Dragon Crown Prince Ryuuba; there are plenty of adventures to be had from fighting off monsters to bishounen contests.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Patalliro Saiyuuki!. While some appreciate the comedic and adventurous elements, along with the classic art style, others are disturbed by the portrayal of a priest's interactions with young boys. The BL elements are considered minimal, and the story is seen as somewhat average.
pros: Fun and laugh out loud often
Sexy yaoi bits
Classic art style is well done
cons: Story wasn't overly complex though a little average
Awful part is showing a priest using teachings to sleep with young boys
Very few episodes where BL happens

anime.title: Saint Beast: Seijuu Kourin-hen
anime.synopsis:
The seal which was imprisoning the fallen angels, Kirin no Yuda and Houou no Ruka, is broken and the two decide to get revenge on the God who had cast them to Hell by getting rid of the Heavens that had once been their home. Soon the guardian angels on Earth begin disappearing, and no one in Heaven can explain the happenings. But there is a sense of a vengeful animal spirit at work, and so the four Saint Beasts are called upon to investigate.

The 4 Gods of Beasts attempt to rescue the guardian angels, as well as to find out what this evil animal spirit is...
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is primarily appreciated for its attractive bishounen characters, but heavily criticized for its weak plot, forced scripting, and poorly animated fight scenes. The lack of character development and an unsatisfying conclusion further contribute to the negative reception. Ultimately, the series is considered a shallow bishounen-fest with little substance beyond its character designs.
pros: Attractive characters
cons: Forced and unrealistic scripting
Glossed over fight scenes
Convenient plot
Weak character development
Lack of story
Unsatisfying conclusion
Poor animation during action sequences

anime.title: Mizuiro (2003)
anime.synopsis:
Brother and younger sister-in-law live in the house which parents are often away from. Yuki who is the younger sister is secretly yearning for Kenji who is the elder brother. However, one girl came to show up from the closet in Kenji's room after a certain night. Moreover, her body is transparent, and she looks like the ghost. Her name is Hiyori. She is a friend in their childhood. They are pleased with reunion though Kenji and Yuki are perplexed with the way of Hiyori's strange appearance. However, Yuki gets the mind shaken as Kenji and Hiyori become intimate, and the pain in her mind in the childhood is recalled. 

At the childhood, Yuki was going to pass the light blue toy ring which Kenji had had to Hiyori in exchange for Hiyori's yoyo. However, because Hiyori became sick, and had moved, the promise was not an accomplishment. Their events in the childhood seem to be related to Hiyori's showing up in front of them. 
A painful love story of Kenji and two girls progresses.
anime.consensus_summary: Mizuiro is a well-received, albeit short, OVA that evokes a warm and nostalgic feeling. While the plot is simple, it's considered touching and charming, with excellent pacing for its length. The main criticism revolves around the limited runtime preventing deeper character and plot exploration. Overall, viewers find it a sweet and enjoyable experience, especially for those who appreciate romance anime from the early 2000s.
pros: Warm and nostalgic feel due to animation and music.
Touching and charming story despite being standard.
Expert pacing and natural character interactions for a short anime.
Soundtrack fits the theme flawlessly.
cons: Short length prevents full character and plot development.
Animation is standard and not particularly special.
Voice acting quality drops in certain moments.
Tendency to hyperfocus on seemingly random plotlines due to short runtime.

anime.title: Mizuiro Jidai
anime.synopsis: Yuuko is a shy middle school girl who has feelings for her childhood friend, the boy next door. When she finds out that her best friend also likes him, she is unsure what to do. The story explores the relationships between these three characters as they confront everyday junior high problems.
anime.consensus_summary: Mizuiro Jidai is remembered fondly as a heartwarming and nostalgic coming-of-age story. Viewers appreciate its focus on the everyday challenges of middle school, the development of friendships and romantic relationships, and the gentle way it explores universal themes of love, trust, and self-discovery. While its art style is dated, its simple narrative and relatable characters create a comforting viewing experience, particularly for those who enjoy slice-of-life anime.
pros: Pure and heartwarming story
Explores themes of love, friendship, and self-discovery
Gentle and respectful treatment of characters' worries and feelings
Nostalgic and comforting
Relatable portrayal of middle school experiences
cons: Art style typical of the 90s may not appeal to all viewers
Simplicity may not appeal to those seeking complex plots

anime.title: Those Who Hunt Elves II
anime.synopsis: After Junpei botched the second attempt to transport back to Japan, the four embark their journey once again to collect runes imprinted on skin of Elven females by stripping them. Celsia is cursed into the form of another animal this time.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is that "Elf wo Karu Mono-tachi II" is a light-hearted and humorous anime, appreciated for its simplicity and character interactions. However, it suffers from repetitive gags, crude humor, and inconsistent production quality. The series is best enjoyed as a casual, undemanding watch rather than a deep or meaningful narrative.
pros: Humorous and lighthearted, good for relaxation.
Enjoyable character interactions, especially Celcia's sarcasm.
Episodic format provides simple, funny adventures.
cons: Simplistic narration with a lack of depth.
Crude humor and repetitive gags can be tiresome.
Inconsistent artwork and animation quality.
Poor or meaningless ending.

anime.title: SoulTaker
anime.synopsis:
Kyousuke Date comes home one night and finds his mother dying in a pool of her own blood. In her final moments, she stabs him in the chest. After a swift recovery, Kyousuke searches for answers regarding his mother's motives, but finds more than he bargained for when he is attacked by two rival organizations: the Hospital and the Kirihara Group.

Kyousuke is surprised to discover that he has a twin sister named Runa, and both groups try to coerce information out of him about her despite his ignorance to her existence. As their assault continues, Kyousuke soon makes another discovery—he has the ability to transform into a terrifying mutant called SoulTaker. With these newfound powers, Kyousuke resolves to crush both organizations, uncover the truth behind his mother's actions, and protect Runa.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on The SoulTaker are divided. Some viewers appreciate its unique visual style, complex plot, and soundtrack, finding it to be an underrated gem. However, others criticize its unoriginal story, incoherent plot developments, weak characters, and inconsistent animation, deeming it a poorly executed and disappointing show.
pros: Unique and stylized visuals with innovative use of color and lighting.
Complex and intricate storyline with potential for character development.
Memorable soundtrack that complements action and drama scenes.
Creative and artistic art style
cons: Unoriginal story that borrows heavily from other anime (Tekkaman Blade, Guyver, Devilman).
Incoherent plot developments and unresolved plot holes.
Weak character development and forgettable stock characters.
Inconsistent animation quality, particularly in later episodes.
Overly complex plot that can be confusing.

anime.title: Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
In a futuristic world, the Maruhage Empire is a militant organization out to steal everyone's hair, and thus their freedom. But a brave man with an afro of gold and nose hairs of steel stands up against their tyranny. Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo, trained in the ways of hair, rescues a teenager named Beauty from the grunts of the Maruhage Empire. Together, they start on a journey to defeat Emperor Tsuru Tsurulina IV. As Bo-bobo meets new friends and battles foes along the way, so too does he begin his quest to save all the hairs of the world!

Light-hearted and comical, Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo details a wacky adventure in which Bo-bobo and his companions fight all sorts of villains and deviants within the Maruhage Empire, all the while having a fun and exciting adventure.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, celebrating the show's absurdity and humor. While some acknowledge the nonsensical plot and niche appeal, the show is lauded for its unique characters, memorable moments, and excellent dub. Many find it a source of laughter and a refreshing break from more serious anime, though a few are turned off by the randomness.
pros: Unique art style
Memorable characters
Great soundtrack
Hilarious and imaginative
Excellent voice acting (especially in the dub)
Random and unexpected humor
cons: Doesn't make sense/lacks strong story
Won't appeal to a wide audience
Can be headache-inducing
Lazy animation at times
Initial episodes are weak

anime.title: Blue Submarine No. 6
anime.genres: Adventure, Award Winning, Mecha, Military, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: The once famous and well respected scientist Zorndyke has bred a new genre of living being, one that thrives on the oceans and lives to destroy humans. Zorndyke believes it is time that the humans were relieved of their rule of the earth. It is up to Blue Submarine No. 6 and the rest of the Blue fleet to put an end to Zorndyke's madness and creations.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences are divided primarily on the dated CGI, which some find jarring while others overlook it for the series' other strengths. There's general agreement that the animation, music, and unique premise are highlights, but the underdeveloped characters and rushed plot due to the short runtime are frequent criticisms.
pros: Visually stunning animation and creative creature designs, especially for the era.
Unique and engaging jazz soundtrack that complements the atmosphere.
Thematic depth exploring man vs. nature and moral ambiguity, particularly with the antagonist.
Compelling world-building and atmospheric storytelling despite the short runtime.
cons: Heavy and dated CGI that detracts from the visuals for many viewers.
Significant lack of character development for most of the cast.
Plot holes and underdeveloped subplots due to the limited episode count.
The pacing can feel rushed, leaving some elements underexplored.

anime.title: Blame!
anime.genres: Drama, Mecha, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
The story takes place in a city where it's said that has thousands of levels.

In a shutdown area, thousands of levels overlap each other, you couldn't tell the sky from the ground and you couldn't tell which way is up or which way is down. Maybe the original purpose of this story is to unravel the mysteries bound in this time and world. For the humans who found this vast rare multi-level city, the mysterious main character "Kirii" wanders to search for the "Net Terminal Genes" that were not infected. Kirii's burden and his search for the "Net Terminal Genes" is a goal like no other and is very much the mystery of this story. Log1~Log6 contains the story of Cibo that wasn't done in the original works. The Cibo who strayed away with Kirii and wanders about. A disc thrown away in the rubble. Cibo starts downloading. Just who's "Memory" will he end up with?

anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided, with many finding it incomprehensible without reading the manga. Some appreciate the atmosphere and faithfulness to the source material's art style and sound design. However, many criticize the lack of story, poor animation, and confusing presentation, leading to overall disappointment. It is generally seen as a poor adaptation and more of a promo for the manga.
pros: Faithful to the manga's aesthetic and style
Music and sound design capture the bleak atmosphere
Art style is fitting and gives a feel for the world of Blame!
cons: Incomprehensible without prior knowledge of the manga
Lacks a coherent story and character development

anime.title: Ippatsu Kiki Musume
anime.synopsis: Kunyan lives her crazy life of misadventures from episode to episode. This comedy series is accompanied by a narrator who scientifically explains all that happens to her.
anime.consensus_summary: Ippatsu Kiki Musume is a bizarre and absurd comedy that is enjoyed for its ridiculous situations and ecchi humor. However, the show suffers from poor production quality, a lack of story, and underdeveloped characters. Overall, it's a love-it-or-hate-it type of show, with enjoyment heavily depending on one's tolerance for tasteless humor and low-budget animation.
pros: Bizarre and funny situations
Dead-serious narrator explaining weird situations with bizarre science
Original plot concept with life and death escapes
Short episodes make it easy to watch
cons: Poor video and audio quality
Terrible and overly long intro theme song
Lack of story and character development
Basic and unappealing animation

anime.title: Oruchuban Ebichu
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Comedy, Ecchi, Gag Humor, Pets, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Ebichu the hamster seems like the perfect house pet: she cleans, shops, cooks, does laundry, and anything to please her master, known only as "Office Lady" (OL). Unfortunately, OL and her unfaithful boyfriend, combined with Ebichu's uncontrollable exuberance and love for ice cream, often earn her severe and bloody punishment. However, Ebichu doesn't seem to mind the abuse if she achieves her goal of making her beloved master a little bit happier.
anime.consensus_summary: Oruchuban Ebichu is a divisive show due to its blend of cute aesthetics with adult themes and potentially disturbing content. While some find its humor unique and charming, others are put off by the crude jokes and depictions of animal cruelty. The show's simple animation and episodic nature also contribute to varied opinions, making it a love-it-or-hate-it experience.
pros: Unique and charming adult humor
Memorable and expressive voice acting, especially for Ebichu
Simple art style complements the content
Characters are relatable despite their extremes
Episodic structure allows for easy re-watching
cons: Crude humor and potentially offensive content
Simple animation might not appeal to all viewers
Animal cruelty themes can be disturbing
Lack of overarching plot may not satisfy all viewers
Art style looks amateurish at times
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Adult Humor, Slice of Life

anime.title: Nekojiru Gekijou Jirujiru Original
anime.synopsis: Based on the comics by the late Nekojiru. Contains 23 animated shorts aired TV Asahi Network's show "Bokusho Mondai Boss Chara Ou." and 4 unbroadcast episodes.
anime.consensus_summary: Nekojiru Gekijou Jirujiru Original is a divisive black comedy that relies on dark humor, gore, and shock value. While some appreciate its unique and childlike perspective, others find the humor repetitive and the content disturbing. The simplistic animation and sound design contribute to the show's atmosphere, but may not appeal to all viewers, leading to mixed reactions.
pros: Unique and dark humor
Excellent voice acting captures the characters well
Effective use of simplistic animation and sound to enhance the atmosphere
Observational humor that reflects a childlike perspective
cons: Humor can become repetitive and predictable
Simplistic animation may not appeal to all viewers
Brutal and violent content can be off-putting
Some may find the shock humor to be ineffective

anime.title: Mazinkaiser
anime.synopsis:
Dr. Hell and his Mechanical Beasts are back, and they're more dangerous than ever before. Kouji Kabuto and Tetsuya Tsurugi fight a fierce battle against these hellish machines, which are under the command of Baron Ashura. Unfortunately, they are defeated, with Kouji's Mazinger Z being captured and Tetsuya's Great Mazinger seriously damaged by the enemy.

The devious Dr. Hell quickly converts the captured robot into Ashura Mazinger and uses it to attack the Photo Power Lab. At the same time, Kouji is missing in action, which leaves Testuya to defend the lab in the damaged Great Mazinger. But the forces of Dr. Hell are too strong, even for a brave pilot such as Tetsuya, and all seems to be lost.

The battle seems to be drawing to a close, until an overpowering blast fired by an unknown robot destroys the entire Mechanical Beast army. Could this mysterious robot be the legendary Mazinkaiser, and who is piloting it?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Mazinkaiser. While fans appreciate the action, animation, and nostalgia factor, many find the lack of a strong plot and character development disappointing. Some believe it elevates classic Super Robot stories, while others feel it fails to live up to its potential and relies too heavily on fan service.
pros: Amazing fight scenes and animation
Awesome opening theme
Faithful to the original Mazinger Z universe
Elevates classic Super Robot stories
cons: Lack of overarching plot
Weak character development
Inconsistent animation quality
Mazinkaiser's appearance lacks justification

anime.title: Demonbane
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Harem, Mecha, Romance, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Kurou Daijuuji is a poor detective living in Arkham City. One day, he was requested by Ruri Hado of Hado Financial Group, to search for a magic book. While he initially refused, Ruri offered him a large sum of money upon completion of her request, in which bribed Kuro to accept. As Kurou searches for the book, he unexpectedly runs into Al, a pretty girl that is actually a powerful grimoire. 

They forge a contract with each other, bestowing Kuro with powerful magic. Soon afterwards, Al also activates Demonbane, a deus machina owned by the Hado Financial Group, to combat the mechanical menace from the Black Lodge. With this, the war between the Hado Financial Group and the Black Lodge begins....
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the conceptual blend of Lovecraftian mythos and mecha action, particularly the visual design of the grimoires. However, many criticize the complicated and poorly executed story, especially as an adaptation of the visual novel. The show's handling of Lovecraftian elements is also a point of contention, with some viewing it as a mockery.
pros: Interesting concept intermingling Cthulhu mythos and giant robot action.
Grimoires are nicely drawn and feel alive.
The world created for the anime is great, especially the grimoires.
cons: Story is too complicated with many terms and side stories.
Poor adaptation of the visual novel, cutting characters and flattening the story.
Mockery of Lovecraft with poorly animated art and uninspired music.
Pacing was awful and a lot of the events were completely inaccurate, even skipping major parts and minor important plot points.
Ridiculous mecha design gets boring and the fights aren't much better in that regard.

anime.title: Love Get Chu
anime.synopsis: Five girls came to a training school to become voice actresses holding each thought in her mind. Momoko - she wanted to be a voice actress to meet her favorite voice actor. Rinka - she is an armature voice actress, but she didn't have special purpose to become voice actress. Yurika - she likes anime very much. Tsubasa - she was a girl in love, and acted only as a boy. Amane - she found a deadlock as a actress and tried to find another way. They managed to get over the difficulty to become voice actress although they couldn't perform as main characters yet. There is a love romance with a boy works for an anime company, and you can catch a glimpse of situations of anime industries.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some enjoying the realistic portrayal of the voice acting industry and the showcase of voice talent. However, many find the plot inconsistent, the romance unnecessary, and the characters underdeveloped. The series is best suited for those specifically interested in voice acting, but it may not appeal to a broader audience due to its narrative issues.
pros: Realistic depiction of the voice acting industry.
Insightful look into the struggles of aspiring voice actors.
Showcases the talent of voice actors, both veterans and newcomers.
Enjoyable for fans of voice acting (seiyuu).
The OP is cheerful and the animation accompanying it is fantastic.
cons: Filler romance and love triangles.
Inconsistent plot with an identity crisis.
Dragged-out storyline, especially in the later episodes.
Underdeveloped characters, except for the main protagonist.
Unnecessary plot elements, such as a fake antagonist.
anime.thematic_vibe: Coming-of-age, Slice of Life, Industry Showcase

anime.title: Sweat Punch
anime.synopsis: Sweat Punch is a series of five Studio 4°C shorts collected as a direct-to-DVD package film entitled Deep Imagination.
anime.consensus_summary: Sweat Punch is a collection of animated shorts that offers a mixed bag of experiences. While praised for its experimental visuals, unique storytelling, and occasional brilliance, the anthology suffers from inconsistent quality across its segments. Viewers' reactions are highly subjective, with some finding certain stories confusing or unfulfilling, while others appreciate the artistic risks and thought-provoking themes.
