pros: Diverse and unique stories in a mini-anthology format.
Experimental and visually engaging animation style.
Some stories are considered brilliant and thought-provoking.
Memorable soundtracks, particularly in the 'Comedy' segment.
cons: Inconsistent story quality across the different segments.
Some stories may be confusing or nonsensical to some viewers.
Not all segments resonate with every viewer, leading to mixed reactions.

anime.title: Naruto: Finally a Clash!! Jounin vs. Genin!
anime.romaji_title: Naruto Narutimate Hero 3: Tsuini Gekitotsu! Jounin vs. Genin!! Musabetsu Dairansen Taikai Kaisai!!
anime.synopsis: Konohagakure hosts a special tournament for ninjas of all ranks, stirring up fervor among the rookies who are eager to prove themselves in a competition against their superiors. Additionally, the winner is granted the opportunity to create their own village decree! Despite his enthusiasm to claim the prize, Naruto Uzumaki fails to focus on the game's objective as he becomes obsessed with confronting his teacher, Kakashi Hatake, in single combat.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with many diehard fans appreciating the nostalgic return to the simpler Naruto era and praising the animation and voice acting. However, a significant portion of viewers express strong disappointment due to the OVA's lack of plot, its nature as a prolonged advertisement for a game, and unfulfilled expectations from its premise.
pros: Animation quality is praised, with fluid movement, colorful palettes, and impressive particle effects.
Voice acting is noted as high-quality, meeting or exceeding expectations.
The OVA effectively evokes nostalgia for the classic Naruto era, focusing on simpler times, character interactions, and fun battles.
The simplicity of the plot and focus on entertainment is seen as a strength, delivering a lighthearted and easy-to-watch experience.
cons: The OVA lacks a substantial plot and is described as a 'commercial' for a video game.
Disappointment stems from unfulfilled expectations regarding specific character matchups and plot progression.
The ending is a cliffhanger, and the OVA is not a complete story on its own, requiring engagement with the accompanying game.
Some viewers find the jokes to be 'dull' and the overall experience 'disgraceful' or a 'waste of time' unless one is an extremely hardcore fan.

anime.title: Cardcaptor Sakura: Leave it to Kero! Theatrical Version
anime.synopsis: Following the events of Cardcaptor Sakura Movie 2: The Sealed Card, Kero and Spinel share a plate of takoyaki (octopus balls). They get into a fight over who gets the last piece, and in the process send it flying out the window. They both chase the takoyaki, and each other, in a mighty effort to be the "takoyaki captor".
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys this short as a lighthearted and fun addition to the Cardcaptor Sakura series, praising its animation and comedic elements. While it doesn't offer anything groundbreaking in terms of plot or characters, it's considered a worthwhile and cute diversion. Some minor criticisms include the music choices, but overall the reception is positive.
pros: Top-notch animation with remarkably good composition.
Enjoyable and cute comedy highlighting the rivalry between Kero and Spinel.
Provides a fun little romp with consistent art quality.
cons: Doesn't introduce anything new to the Cardcaptor Sakura universe.
Some may not be fond of the music choices.

anime.title: Yukikaze
anime.genres: Action, Award Winning, Drama, Military, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Space, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
It has been 33 years since an alien race, known as the JAM, emerged from a hyperspace passage over Antarctica with the sole purpose of invading Earth. Despite their unexpected initial assaults, a combined effort by humanity not only pushed the JAM force off of Earth but also moved the frontlines of the battle onto the JAM's homeworld of Fairy. Though out of sight and mind for the majority of Earth's inhabitants, the conflict still rages on Fairy, where the United Nations has established five bases and a powerful, technologically advanced military—including the Fairy Air Force (FAF).

Lieutenant Rei Fukai acts as a pilot for the FAF Special Air Force’s Boomerang reconnaissance squadron, flying a Super Sylph fighter jet with the personal name "Yukikaze." Soaring high above and observing the battles for air superiority, he is responsible for collecting and analyzing valuable intelligence on JAM methods. While his flying skills are unmatched, he also heavily relies on the highly advanced weaponry and near-sentient AI system of his aircraft. 

Though despised by other members of the FAF for his antisocial and standoffish nature, Lt. Fukai continues to carry out his duties along with Yukikaze. However, during a particularly bloody battle, the appearance of an unresponsive and hostile aircraft catches the lieutenant off-guard—an aircraft which is of the same make and model as his own.
anime.consensus_summary: Sentou Yousei Yukikaze is a visually stunning and intellectually stimulating OVA that explores complex themes. However, its confusing plot and underdeveloped characters may hinder enjoyment for some viewers. While praised for its animation and mature storytelling, the series is criticized for its convoluted narrative and potential accessibility issues, leading to a somewhat divided, yet appreciative, audience.
pros: Stunning animation and visuals, blending 2D and 3D seamlessly.
Complex and thought-provoking plot that explores themes of humanity, technology, and identity.
Realistic depiction of aerial combat and military themes.
Well-developed relationship between pilot and AI aircraft.
cons: Plot can be confusing and disjointed, with missing exposition and unclear transitions.
Characters may lack sufficient development, making it difficult to connect with them.
Ending may feel unsatisfying or rushed.
Heavy use of techno-jargon can be overwhelming.

anime.title: Space Pirate Captain Herlock: Outside Legend - The Endless Odyssey
anime.romaji_title: Space Pirate Captain Herlock: Outside Legend - The Endless Odyssey
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Space
anime.synopsis: On an archaelogical mission to the end of the known universe, Professor Daiba unwitting unleashes an ancient horror from its confines. Five years later the malevolent alien force sets in motion a plan which reunites the various crewmembers of the Arcadia to sail the stars once more as well as bring Tadashi Daiba to meet Harlock for the first time (again).
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with strong criticism aimed at the plot and character handling. While some appreciate the art style and Harlock's portrayal, others find the story disjointed and the characters misused. It seems that only die-hard fans of the original may find some enjoyment in it, while newcomers are better off starting elsewhere.
pros: Faithful art style to the original series with modern enhancements.
Interesting ending.
Harlock is portrayed as a strong, silent, and relatable hero.
cons: Plot is dumb and poorly assembled.
Character mischaracterization and underutilization of the crew.
Supernatural twist doesn't work.
Voice acting is not up to par compared to the original.
Continuity snarls and plot inconsistencies.

anime.title: Daphne in the Brilliant Blue
anime.genres: Comedy, Detective, Drama, Ecchi, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
In the future, water has covered much of the Earth due to the effects of global warming. The orphaned Maia Mizuki, 15, just graduated from middle school and has already applied for employment in the elite paramilitary Ocean Agency, part of the futuristic world government. Only the best, most intelligent, and physically fit students are eligible for admission. Maia, the series' protagonist, is set to become one of the few.

But her ideal life quickly falls apart. To her disappointment, Maia unexpectedly fails her entrance exams. Making matters worse, she promptly gets evicted from her house, pick pocketed, taken hostage, then shot. She is "saved" by two women (Rena and Shizuka) that are part of an unorthodox help-for-hire organization called Nereids (inspired by the Greek mythological Nereids ). With nowhere to go, Maia joins up with Nereids, taking jobs from capturing wanted criminals to chasing stray cats, often with unexpected results. Gloria and Yu later join up with Nereids.

"Daphne" in the title refers to a subplot that starts midway into the series and eventually become important to Maia. "Brilliant Blue" refers to the fact that this is a world covered by water with almost no land. The world consists of vast oceans, a few islands, and floating cities.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed but generally positive. Many appreciate the show's blend of action, comedy, and surprising depth, praising the character development and engaging story twists. However, some find the fan service excessive and the main character irritating, hindering their overall enjoyment. The series is considered a hidden gem by some, while others view it as a flawed but entertaining experience.
pros: Great character development, especially for side characters.
Well-developed story with twists and turns, leading to a satisfying conclusion.
Excellent music score that complements the series' tone.
cons: Over-the-top fan service with skimpy outfits can be distracting.
Episodic format can become monotonous, lacking overarching plot development early on.
Main character (Maia) is often considered annoying and uninteresting.

anime.title: Human Crossing
anime.synopsis:
Families, husbands and wives, lovers and ordinary people. Dramas that emerge from life's human crossroads... Ordinary people muddling through life and intersect with one another in random ways. Like people walking along road crossings in different directions with no apparent destination in sight.

Human Crossing is a realistic portrayal of everyday people in modern Japan with all its beauty and ugliness. Human Crossing examines the lives of a boxer whose dark past is rekindled by his estranged mother in "The Wound", an idealistic lawyer who fights for an underprivileged young mother in "The 25th Hour", a workaholic businessman who rediscovers what's most important in life in "A Promise", and an independent woman who reunites with her deadbeat father in "Direction."

Human Crossing is a collection of vignettes about hope, a reminder of the small victories one can achieve amid the vicissitudes of life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response to Ningen Kousaten is mixed. While some appreciate its mature themes and realistic portrayal of everyday life, others are turned off by the low production quality and lack of traditional anime elements. The show is best suited for viewers who enjoy slice-of-life stories with a focus on character development and emotional resonance over flashy animation or complex plots.
pros: Mature storylines with meaning and moral lessons.
Relatable characters dealing with real-life problems.
Moving opening and ending themes that capture the atmosphere of Tokyo.
cons: Subpar art and animation quality.
Lack of background music and cheap production values.
Inconsistent character development and some forced characterizations.
Stories can be too real and lack comedic or climactic elements for some viewers.

anime.title: Mars Daybreak
anime.romaji_title: Kenran Butou Sai: The Mars Daybreak
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Mecha, Military, Romance, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: Mars is now almost entirely covered in water. Humanity exists in large city-ships that float through the open seas. But life is hard for those who live on Mars—the economy is in bad shape, work is scarce, and food is expensive and highly prized. Gram and his friends try to do the best they can, but the work keeps drying up. Some have taken to a life of piracy to combat the corruption in the government; one such group is the pirates of the feared Ship of Aurora. And the Earth government, which rules Mars, has dispatched a new team of military pilots to combat them. In their specialized mecha called Round Bucklers, they must make the seas of Mars safe for humanity. Caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, Gram finds himself on the run with the most notorious pirates on Mars. But here's the thing—he's starting to like them!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the initial concept and characters are appreciated, the series suffers from a decline in story quality, disappointing animation, and a lack of depth in its plot and world-building. Some find it enjoyable for casual viewing, while others are left wanting more substance and uniqueness.
pros: Interesting premise with Mars covered in water.
Good mix of drama, action, romance, and comedy elements.
Memorable characters.
cons: Story becomes weaker and relies on filler episodes.
Animation quality is disappointing compared to other works by BONES.
Music lacks emotion and doesn't add to the series.
Character development is lacking for many characters.
Plot and world-building lack depth and explanation.

anime.title: Super Dimension Fortress Macross
anime.genres: Mecha, Military, Music, Romance, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
After a mysterious spaceship crashes into Earth, humanity realizes that they are not alone. Fearing a potential threat from space, the world pushes aside their nationalism, conflicting interests, and cultural differences, unifying under the banner of the United Nations. The newly formed UN forces decide to repurpose the alien spacecraft, naming it SDF-1 Macross. Unfortunately, on the day of its maiden voyage, a fleet of spaceships belonging to a race of aliens known as the Zentradi descend upon Earth, and the SDF-1 Macross, acting of its own accord, shoots down the incoming squadron, sparking an intergalactic war.

In an attempt to escape, the Macross tries to launch itself into the Moon's orbit, but the ship—as well as the city it was in—is teleported to the far reaches of space. Caught up in this mess are Hikaru Ichijou, a free-spirited acrobatic pilot, and Minmay Lynn, an aspiring singer. These two, alongside Macross' crew, experience an epic journey rife with grief and drama, coming face-to-face with the cruelties of war along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Macross is widely praised for its innovative blend of mecha action, dramatic storytelling, and the unique integration of music and civilian life. However, opinions are divided on its pacing, the execution of its central love triangle, and the divisive nature of some characters, particularly Lynn Minmay.
pros: Unique concept blending mecha action with a civilian society within the ship
Exploration of cultural impact, media, and celebrity during wartime
Strong character development and relatable protagonists
Innovative integration of music and singing as a key narrative element
Visually impressive animation and mecha design for its era
cons: Pacing issues, particularly in the latter half of the series
Love triangle can be frustrating and feel repetitive
Some characterizations, particularly Lynn Minmay, are divisive and irritating to some viewers
Animation quality can be inconsistent and relies on reused footage
Art style is dated and may not appeal to modern audiences

anime.title: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
anime.genres: Mecha, Military, Music, Romance, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
After warping light-years away from Earth, the spacecraft Macross carries a city of civilians and soldiers back home. They continuously fight off the threat of the Zentradi and Meltrandi, giant alien races with whom humanity wages war. 

During a battle, the Macross transforms into a mecha operated by fighter pilot Hikaru Ichijou. Thrust into a number of hardships, Hikaru grows close to the city's idol Minmay Lynn. As their relationship develops, however, it is viewed unfavorably by others due to Minmay's status and popularity.

With war raging on and the state of Earth unknown, Hikaru and his fellow soldiers fight on against their mysterious enemies. Throughout the bloodshed, Hikaru and Minmay attempt to keep hold of their feelings for one another. Minmay pours her heart into her music, which may just turn out to be the key to finding peace.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Macross: Do You Remember Love? is largely positive, with overwhelming praise for its groundbreaking animation and epic scope. However, there's a noticeable split regarding the narrative's sacrifices in character development for secondary figures and the pacing of certain romantic subplots, which some feel detracts from the overall experience.
pros: Stunning and timeless animation quality, setting a benchmark for the industry.
Improved pacing and narrative cohesion compared to the TV series due to the movie format.
The iconic song 'Do You Remember Love?' serves as a powerful emotional and plot device.
Strong character chemistry and engaging interactions, particularly for the main characters.
Visually spectacular action sequences with excellent choreography and detail.
Thematic depth exploring culture, love, and humanity's potential for peace.
cons: Significant reduction in the development and screen time of secondary characters.
Some plot developments, particularly romantic ones, are perceived as rushed or less plausible.
The Zentradi redesign and the distinction between male/female Zentradi are criticized by some.
The plot can be predictable and lacks depth for those who have seen similar stories.
The focus on idol songs and romance overshadows deeper narrative elements for some viewers.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam I
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Mecha, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
In the future, with Earth's population rapidly increasing, humanity has developed giant orbiting space colonies gathered in clusters known as "Sides." As the elites on Earth force most of the populace into space, rebellion begins to brew. In the year Universal Century 0079, one of the colony clusters known as Side 3 declares itself the Principality of Zeon and launches a war of independence against the Earth Federation.

Despite having only a fraction of the resources of the Federation, Zeon quickly gains the upper hand in the conflict through the use of giant humanoid robots called mobile suits. Chief among Zeon's mobile suit ace pilots is Char Aznable, a mysterious masked man known as the "Red Comet." When Char's squadron comes across the Federation developing its own prototype mobile suit called Gundam in the colony Side 7, his men launch a brutal attack. Amuro Ray, the son of the prototype's developer, gets in the Gundam and is able to fend off the Zeon attack. As Amuro soon finds himself directly in conflict with Char, he is forced to flee the colony on a Federation ship.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus largely regards Mobile Suit Gundam I as a foundational classic, praised for its compelling characters, epic war narrative, and iconic designs. While acknowledging its dated visuals and pacing issues inherent to its compilation format, most agree it remains an influential and important entry in the mecha genre.
pros: Compelling characters, particularly Amuro and Char, with strong development arcs.
Engrossing and epic war story that explores the harsh realities of conflict and its impact on young soldiers.
Iconic and influential mecha designs that remain visually striking.
Excellent sound design and voice acting that enhance the immersive experience.
Strong world-building that establishes the Universal Century setting effectively.
Thematic depth exploring the "gray area" of war and the psychological toll it takes.
cons: Pacing issues, with sections feeling rushed or dragging, especially in the condensed movie format.
Dated animation and art style, with some scenes exhibiting inconsistent quality and '70s anime hallmarks.
Uneven character development for the supporting cast, leading to some feeling underdeveloped or one-dimensional.
Thematic elements, particularly the 'moral greyness,' are sometimes undermined by overt portrayals of villains.
Some dialogue can be perceived as cheesy or melodramatic.
The plot can feel formulaic and predictable at times, with obvious 'death flags'.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam II: Soldiers of Sorrow
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam II: Ai Senshi-hen
anime.synopsis:
As the War continues, Amuro and the White Base crew must make their way toward the Earth Federation Headquarters, Jaburo. On their way they meet several new enemies and face off against impossible odds. They fight in Operation Odessa to relieve the Earth from the clutches of the Zeon forces.

Lives are lost, new friendships are made, and discoveries at every corner. Amuro soon learns that he possesses the powers of the mysterious Newtypes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, with appreciation for the improved action, character development, and thematic depth concerning the realities of war. However, significant criticism exists regarding the narrative's compression, which leads to rushed character arcs and the dilution of core concepts. While considered a strong middle chapter, it is often seen as a necessary but flawed part of the larger trilogy.
pros: Improved character development for both protagonists and antagonists compared to the first film.
More engaging plot and action sequences, with better pacing than the previous installment.
Thoughtful exploration of the human cost of war and the complexities of both sides of the conflict.
Visually appealing animation and art direction, especially in mobile suit designs and battle scenes, despite its age.
Compelling themes of survival, responsibility, and the psychological toll of war.
cons: Compressed storytelling leads to rushed character arcs and underdeveloped emotional moments.
Thematic elements and concepts like 'Newtypes' are sometimes diluted or trivialized due to condensation.
Inconsistent tone, with some instances of unnecessary comic relief (children) detracting from the serious war setting.
Predictable plot points and 'death flags' that lessen narrative tension.
Dated animation quality may be a barrier for some modern viewers, even with improvements.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam III: Encounters in Space
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam III: Meguriai Sora-hen
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Mecha, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
The One Year War comes to a close, as the Zeon forces now retreat back into space. Amuro learns much more of his Newtype abilities and tries to use them the best way he can. He's pushed to his limit as he encounters the infamous Char Aznable once again. He also falls in love with a mysterious woman named Lalah Sune, who knows the full potential of the Newtype abilities. 

The greatest battle is about to begin, as many loved ones fall to the power of war. Can the Earth Federation defeat the Principality of Zeon? Or will they fail? Can Char prove that he's the better Newtype than Amuro? They all will be answered now...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion on Kidou Senshi Gundam III is largely positive, with many hailing it as a powerful and satisfying conclusion to the original series, particularly praising the Amuro-Char rivalry and thematic depth. However, the film is not without its detractors, with common criticisms revolving around pacing issues, rushed character arcs, and controversial thematic elements like the depiction of Zeon and the exploration of Newtypes.
pros: Captures the emotional weight and character development of the original series' conclusion.
The rivalry between Amuro and Char is compelling and reaches a satisfying, poignant conclusion.
The thematic exploration of Newtypes and human evolution is a significant strength.
Visually impressive for its era, with dynamic and well-animated space battles and mobile suit action.
The soundtrack effectively enhances both action sequences and emotional moments.
cons: Pacing issues persist, with some plot points and character relationships feeling rushed or underdeveloped due to condensing the series.
The portrayal of Zeon as 'space Nazis,' especially with direct Hitler comparisons, is noted as problematic and contradictory to attempts at sympathy.
The 'Newtype afterlife' concept is considered strange by some viewers.
Some character motivations, particularly Amuro's, are questioned, with him appearing to fight without strong personal reasons.
The inclusion of gratuitous nudity is deemed out of place and unnecessary.

anime.title: Oishinbo
anime.synopsis: Oishinbo is a drama about newspaper reporters. The main character is a cynical food critic named Yamaoka. Oishinbo is a popular mainstream comic for adults in Japan. It is even mentioned in an episode of "Iron Chef."
anime.consensus_summary: Oishinbo is a well-regarded gourmet anime and manga, especially in Japan, praised for its educational content and relatability. While not as widely known in the West, it offers valuable insights into Japanese and Asian cuisine and culture. The audience generally appreciates its unique storytelling approach, which focuses on learning and discernment rather than just competition.
pros: Insight into Japanese and Asian cuisine.
Educational storytelling.
Relatability due to focus on learning alongside characters.
cons: Relatively unknown in the western community.
Some episodes can get silly.

anime.title: One Piece: Adventure in the Ocean's Navel
anime.romaji_title: One Piece: Umi no Heso no Daibouken-hen
anime.synopsis: The Straw Hats encounter a city in the middle of a whirlpool, called the Ocean's Navel, that is being destroyed by giant monsters. These monsters supposedly protect a treasure capable of granting wishes, but in the process of defeating these guardians, the crew ends up releasing another evil.  (aired after Episode 53)
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys this special as a fun, nostalgic side story within the One Piece universe. It's considered a worthwhile watch for fans, particularly those who appreciate the earlier seasons. While some find the plot simple or the villain weak, the overall sentiment is positive, praising its entertainment value and faithful recreation of the series' early charm.
pros: Enjoyable story reminiscent of early One Piece.
Good animation quality for its time.
Fits well within the established One Piece world and characters.
Entertaining and uplifting.
cons: Story can feel like a filler episode.
Main enemy can be lame.
Some feel the story could be longer or more developed.

anime.title: Patlabor: The Movie
anime.synopsis:
The Babylon Project is a massive renovation of Tokyo's neighborhoods, including the creation of artificial islands in the Bay. Utilizing "Labors," or robots created for the express purpose of doing work, architects and construction crews are able to more efficiently progress development of the overhaul. When a key figure in the Project's conception is found dead after committing suicide under mysterious circumstances, Captain Kiichi Gotou's Patlabor police unit is tasked with getting to the bottom of the bizarre situation.

As several Labors begin to go haywire and a hacked AI program endangers the people of Tokyo, young pilot Noa Izumi and her Patlabor Alphonse work under Gotou's orders to save the city and the entire nation from a massive biblical conspiracy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus points to Kidou Keisatsu Patlabor the Movie as a highly intelligent and mature mecha thriller with exceptional direction and a thought-provoking narrative. While most praise its grounded realism, deep themes, and unique take on mechas, some viewers find the pacing too slow for the genre, wishing for more direct action.
pros: Excellent, mature storytelling with deep thematic exploration of technology, progress, and urban decay.
Masterful direction by Mamoru Oshii, characterized by exceptional visual storytelling, atmosphere, and realism.
Unique and utilitarian mecha designs that feel grounded and purposeful within the narrative.
Compelling mystery plot that builds tension subtly and intelligently.
Strong character writing, particularly for Captain Gotoh, and effective ensemble cast dynamics.
Impressive animation and art direction for its time, contributing to a realistic and lived-in Tokyo.
Kenji Kawai's score is highly praised for its atmospheric quality and memorable themes.
cons: Pacing can be slow or tedious for some viewers expecting more action-oriented mecha content.
The middle section of the film can drag, and the mystery may lose momentum once the core mechanism is revealed.
Protagonist Noa Izumi can feel less central or compelling at times, especially compared to her OVA counterpart.
While generally well-received, some find the animation's clarity lacking compared to modern standards.

anime.title: Patlabor 2: The Movie
anime.genres: Award Winning, Detective, Drama, Mecha, Military, Mystery, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Three years after the Babylon Project conspiracy is resolved, the members of Kiichi Gotou's Patlabor unit have gone their separate ways. Gotou remains with the Patlabor team, accompanied by Shinobu Nagumo, his romantic crush and comrade.

Playing into the public's skepticism toward the Japanese Ground Self-Defense Force, a terrorist organization begins to work from within the military to cause destruction and mass civil unrest throughout Japan. Nagumo learns that the mastermind behind the growing terrorist plot is none other than Yukihito Tsuge, her former mentor and lover.

Gotou reassembles his former Patlabor team, spearheaded by pilot Noa Izumi. Leading the team into a mission to arrest Tsuge, Nagumo must come to terms with her complicated past relationships in order to save Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: Patlabor 2 the Movie is widely praised as a mature, philosophical, and visually stunning film, often considered a masterpiece. However, its significant tonal shift away from traditional mecha action and its heavy political/philosophical discourse leads to a divisive reception, with some viewers feeling it strays too far from the original Patlabor identity.
pros: Mature and complex plot with deep philosophical and political themes exploring war, peace, and national identity.
Exceptional animation, cinematography, and art direction, creating a realistic and atmospheric experience.
Strong character focus on Goto and Nagumo, with subtle yet impactful development.
Thought-provoking dialogue and storytelling that encourages reflection.
Excellent voice acting and a fitting, atmospheric soundtrack.
cons: The film's heavy philosophical and political focus alienates some fans expecting more traditional mecha action or a lighter tone typical of the Patlabor franchise.
The pacing can be perceived as slow due to its dialogue-heavy nature and deliberate, meditative style.
Sidelining of the core cast, particularly Noa Izumi, disappoints fans who expected more focus on the original team.
The film's departure from the franchise's established tone and focus makes it feel less like a 'Patlabor' movie for some viewers.
The 'non-conflict' resolution, while thematically consistent, can feel anticlimactic for those expecting a major battle.

anime.title: Lime-iro Senkitan
anime.genres: Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Historical, Mecha, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Around the the 37th year of the Meiji Era (1904), in the midst of the Russo-Japanese war, the small Japanese army, in need of assistance, uses its special flying (thanks to a benevolent demon) ship, the Amanohara, to attack Russia's major base at Port Arthur (Lushun).

Umakai Shintaro, a Russian diplomat originally from Japan, defects and goes to Sapporo to teach at a girls academy. However, that girls academy is not typical—it is on board the Amanohara, and the five girls Shintaro teaches are known as the Raimu Unit—girls with the ability to summon powerful beings to fight for them. Shintaro eventually becomes their teacher and general in battle, and so the six embark on a weird and excessively erotic journey, as Shintaro helps the girls overcome their weaknesses, become stronger for the final stand at Lushun, and also understand the motives of the "Russian Spiritual Corps" that assist the opponent, which, unfortunately, has one member whom Shintaro knew well...
anime.consensus_summary: Lime-iro Senkitan is a flawed show with some redeeming qualities. While the characters and their interactions are enjoyable, the plot suffers from political insensitivity, excessive harem elements, and numerous inconsistencies. The show elicits mixed reactions, with some appreciating the character development and humor, while others are turned off by the nonsensical plot and questionable content.
pros: Endearing and interesting characters with likable interactions.
Decent character development, better than average for a half-season harem ecchi comedy.
Some decent, emotional, well-conceived dramatic scenes.
Funny comedy scenes and great interactions between the girls.
cons: Horrible plot with political discomfort due to the setting of the Russo-Japanese War.
Unlikeable male protagonist in a harem setting with excessive and inexplicable attraction from all female characters.
Plot holes and unexplained circumstances, such as the flying Russian soldiers and inconsistent magic system.
Overused and unrelated sound effects.

anime.title: Samurai Girl Real Bout High School
anime.romaji_title: Samurai Girl Real Bout High School
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, School
anime.synopsis: At Daimon High School, kids settle their disputes by dueling with each other in the school's official K-Fight battle arena. Ryoko Mitsurugi, samurai girl and undefeated K-Fight champion, is called upon by a mysterious Priestess to protect the Earth from an invasion coming from the alternate universe of Solvania. She must face battles that will test her skills, her friendships, and her heart in order to find her true strength as a samurai warrior.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. The initial episodes show promise with charming characters, intriguing story, and great humor. However, the series quickly declines into a silly and hollow narrative with a weak fantasy element, ultimately failing to deliver on its initial potential. Many find the story and plot development lacking, leading to an overall average impression.
pros: Charming characters, especially the protagonist Ryoko.
Initially intriguing story and great humor in the first episodes.
Breathtaking action sequences, particularly in the first K-Fight.
cons: Story becomes silly, empty, and hollow after the initial episodes.
Weak and badly explained demon slaying fantasy.
Lack of follow-up to the main plot and confusing development of events.
Predictable plot with shallow character development.
Uneven pacing, with some episodes being pointless flashbacks.

anime.title: Shadow Skill: Kurudaryuu Kousatsuhou no Himitsu
anime.romaji_title: Shadow Skill: Kurudaryuu Kousatsuhou no Himitsu
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: The story takes place in warrior kingdom where a deadly martial art called Shadow Skill is practiced to defend the continued existence of the kingdom. Dreaming of becoming an invincible warrior one day, like the legendary warrior named Scar Face who has defeated 2,000 opponents, the boy named Cau Ban trains hard with his older adopted sister Elle who has mastered Shadow Skill. A deadly combat breaks out when a rouge pack of intruders suddenly assaults the castle to steal a box that contains a secret...
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is not highly regarded. The animation and music are significant detractors, overshadowing any thematic depth. It's primarily recommended for those with a specific interest in 'weird bad stuff' due to its unnerving liminal vibe.
pros: Voice acting is good.
Direction has some thought and effort in moments.
cons: Plot is hard to follow.
Animation is early 3D and difficult to watch.
Music is repetitive and drives you insane.

anime.title: Marriage of God & Soul Godannar!!
anime.synopsis: Five years ago, while battling an alien force known as the "Mimesis," Dannar pilot Goh Saruwatari first met Anna Aoi. Today, on the day of their wedding, the ceremony is interrupted when the Mimesis strike again. As Goh struggles in his battle against the alien threat, Anna stumbles upon a top secret robot known as the "Neo-Okusaer" and uses it as a last-resort to save her fiancee. At that moment, Dannar and Neo-Okusaer merge to become the mighty robot "Godannar."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Shinkon Gattai Godannar!! are divided. While some appreciate the show's fun, over-the-top nature, enjoyable fights, and high-quality art, many criticize the weak storyline, shallow characters, and excessive fanservice. The show is generally seen as a lighthearted homage to older super robot anime but falls short due to its lack of depth and originality.
pros: High-quality art and consistent animation
Catchy opening theme and enjoyable soundtrack
Fun and entertaining fights, especially with hand-drawn animation
cons: Weak and generic storyline with repetitive monster-of-the-week format
Shallow character development for most characters
Excessive fanservice that overshadows the plot
Uninteresting enemies and monotonous mecha attacks

anime.title: Soul Hunter
anime.synopsis: Thousands of years ago, it was a time of witchcraft and dark magic. An evil sorceress has bewitched the emperor of the mighty dynasty and he has become a mindless puppet. The country is in shambles, and evil spirits lurk everywhere. The human world is on the verge of utter destruction. A bold mission is planned by the Confederation of the Immortal Masters. They send a young master wizard to hunt down the villains and evil warlocks in the devastated lands.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the engaging story, memorable characters, and nostalgic animation, while others criticize the rushed ending, complex plot, and inconsistent animation quality. Fans of the manga may be disappointed by the anime adaptation's deviations and lack of depth. Overall, the show is considered a decent shounen anime with both strengths and weaknesses.
pros: Memorable characters with distinct personalities
Engaging plot with unexpected twists
Well-developed world with rich lore
Nostalgic 90s animation style
cons: Overly complex plot without sufficient explanation
Rushed ending due to episode constraints
Inconsistent animation quality with limited screen frames
Forced humor and mediocre emotional scenes
Lacking character development in the anime adaptation compared to the manga

anime.title: Mermaid Melody Pichi Pichi Pitch Pure
anime.romaji_title: Mermaid Melody Pichi Pichi Pitch Pure
anime.synopsis:
After the final battle against Gaito, Sara had given her life to remain with him. The sea world is now at peace, but only with six mermaid princesses.

While Caren, Noel, and Coco have returned to their kingdoms, it should be time for Lucia, Hanon, and Rina to do the same. After all, Mitsuki Tarou is leaving for Germany, and Doumoto Kaito is heading to Hawaii. Lucia is devestated, and when things couldn't get any worse, Kaito is lost at sea! Worst of all, a strange angel named Michel has appeared, wanting the mermaids to join him. But on the lighter side, Sara's spirit tells Lucia of Sara's successor, a young mermaid named Seira. The mermaids are in for another adventure!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating the darker, more mature storyline and new musical additions. However, the low animation quality, repetitive plot devices, and annoying new characters, especially within the love triangle, are significant detractors. Some viewers find the show enjoyable for its nostalgia and lighthearted moments despite its flaws, while others are frustrated by the character's actions and the perceived lack of progress.
pros: More mature storyline than the first season with character growth.
Beautiful songs, especially the opening theme and villain songs.
Introduction of intriguing new love interests and characters.
cons: Repetitive story elements and filler episodes.
Low animation quality and reused animation sequences.
Annoying and bland villains with little character development.
Frustrating love triangle and clingy character (Mikaru).

anime.title: Pokémon: The Movie 2000
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 02: Maboroshi no Pokemon Lugia Bakutan
anime.synopsis:
An ancient prophecy tells of a day when the titans of ice, lightning, and fire are disturbed. When this occurs, Lugia, the guardian of the sea, will rise up and restore harmony. Enchanted by the words of the prophecy, Gelardan, a Pokémon collector, sets out on his airship with a dreadful plan to capture Lugia by going after these three titans. 

After Gelardan makes his move, drastic climate change begins to take place, as terrible storms start popping up all over the globe. One such storm causes the ship carrying Pokémon trainers Satoshi, Kasumi, and Kenji to drift off course and land on Shamouti Island. Upon arriving, Satoshi is told of the ancient prophecy, and of his destiny as the chosen one who will help Lugia restore balance to the world. 

With the fate of the world in his hands, Satoshi must summon the courage to face the chaos that threatens to tear everything apart and stop Gelardan.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, with many viewing it as one of the best Pokémon movies, especially for its nostalgic value and the epic portrayal of Lugia. However, there's a significant split regarding the narrative quality, with many criticizing the weak villain and thin plot while praising the action and emotional moments.
pros: Lugia's portrayal and "Guardian's Song" are majestic and emotionally resonant.
The action sequences, particularly the fight with the legendary birds and Lugia's reveal, are well-executed and visually impressive.
The voice acting, especially in the dub (Morgan Freeman comparison for Lugia), is praised.
Nostalgic value and connection for fans who grew up with the series.
Beautiful and detailed artwork with lovely imagery, especially in older animation style.
The orchestral score and Lugia's theme are highlighted as superb and emotional masterpieces.
cons: The villain is underdeveloped, predictable, and lacks stopping power, sometimes being absent for large portions of the film.
The plot is considered thin, predictable, formulaic, and at times nonsensical (e.g., the birds fighting on their own islands).
Many plot points and character interactions lack depth, payoff, or are considered pointless filler scenes.
The integration of 3D CGI backgrounds clashes with traditional 2D animation, appearing ugly and out of place.
New characters and the villain are forgettable.
The dialogue is criticized as 'omega cringe' and not appealing to a wider audience beyond young children.

anime.title: Pokémon 3: The Movie
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 03: Kesshoutou no Teiou Entei
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Kids
anime.synopsis:
Mii Snowdon is left on her own after her father disappears while investigating the mysterious letter-shaped Pokémon called the Unown. The only clue to her father's disappearance is a box containing several tiles. While playing with these tiles, Mii makes a wish to see her father again, and this wish awakens the Unown—who summon the lion-like, legendary Pokémon Entei to act as her father.

Meanwhile, Satoshi heads to Greenfield with his faithful Pokémon companion, Pikachu, to meet with his friends, Kasumi and Takeshi. When they reach the area, they are shocked to find the place crystallized. They quickly learn that the Unown are responsible for this, and that they will need to be defeated in order to restore Greenfield to its former beauty.

The situation becomes personal when Satoshi's mother is kidnapped by Entei. To discover why his mother was taken away, Satoshi, along with his friends and Pokémon, must travel the crystallized landscape to confront Entei and the Unown.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views "Pokemon Movie 03" positively, praising its emotional depth, character development, and unique narrative focused on a child's grief. Some find the plot cheesy and pacing slow, but the overall sentiment is warm and nostalgic. Many appreciate the film's art, music, and its deviation from typical Pokemon movie formulas by focusing on personal stakes rather than global threats.
pros: Heartwarming story with depth, care, and feeling
Great visual design, locations, and atmosphere
Breathtakingly beautiful and precise music and art
Intriguing premise used to create a different experience
cons: Mediocre soundtrack
Middle of the movie feels slow due to underwhelming battles
Plot can be a little bit too cheesy or horned in sometimes
Some elements were left shrouded in darkness

anime.title: Pokémon 4Ever
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 04: Celebi Toki wo Koeta Deai
anime.synopsis:
Serebii, a Legendary Pokémon known for its ability to traverse time, is hunted by an unnamed Pokémon poacher seeking to capture it. Yukinari, a young Pokémon trainer who enjoys drawing portraits of Pokémon, tries to protect Serebii after it stumbles upon him; but in the middle of its escape, both vanish without a trace.

Forty years later, ambitious Pokémon trainer Satoshi hopes to sight rare Pokémon around his local area. White, a boat driver, takes Satoshi to his village. Satoshi is accompanied by his three closest friends: Takeshi, a former gym leader training to be a great Pokémon breeder; Kasumi, a young girl wanting to become a skilled Water-type trainer; and Pikachu, Satoshi's Pokémon partner and first comrade.

Meanwhile, Yukinari and Serebii reappear in Satoshi's present time and run into his group. Masked Lord Vicious, the strongest executive staff member of Team Rocket, desires to capture Serebii. Using the Dark Ball, a variant of Monster Ball that corrupts the Pokémon caught within and draws out their maximum power, Vicious can transform innocent Pokémon into powerful and frightening obstacles—including Serebii itself! Placed in a tough position, Satoshi, Yukinari, and their friends must work together to defeat Vicious and save Serebii and themselves.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling nostalgic while acknowledging its flaws. Common praises include the visuals and pacing, but criticisms target the weak story, underdeveloped characters, and heavy-handed environmental message. The film is considered a step down from earlier Pokemon movies, appealing mostly to hardcore fans with low standards.
pros: Beautiful art and animation, especially nature scenes
Nostalgic value and captures childhood wonder
Good pacing with quiet moments for atmosphere
cons: Weak and generic story
Underdeveloped characters and a one-dimensional antagonist
Overly preachy environmental themes with a magical fix
Poor dialogue and contrivances in the plot
Inconsistent use of Pokemon type matchups

anime.title: Pokémon Heroes
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 05: Mizu no Miyako no Mamorigami Latias to Latios
anime.synopsis:
As they continue their journey through the Johto region, Satoshi and his friends visit Altomare, an island city that hosts an annual racing event called the Pokémon Water Race. While Takeshi and Kasumi are enjoying themselves, strange things seem to be happening to Satoshi—he somehow loses the water race, sees some women attack a girl with their Pokémon, and despite them saving her, the girl later denies ever seeing Satoshi and Pikachu before!

Fortunately for Satoshi, his confusion clears up as he learns that the girl he and Pikachu saved earlier was actually a Pokémon named Latias, who likes to disguise herself as her human friend, Kanon. Latias and another Pokémon, Latios, are known as the Eon Pokémon, as they inhabit and guard Altomare along with a mystical blue sphere called the Soul Dew. An ancient legend of Altomare is highly connected to the Eon Pokémon and the Soul Dew, and is well known among the locals—as well as among Latias' earlier assailants, the thief sisters Zanner and Lyon. As the thieves attempt to capture both the Eon Pokémon and the Soul Dew, Satoshi is forced to act in order to stop them from bringing disaster to Altomare.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Pokemon Heroes" is viewed as an enjoyable and visually appealing movie, particularly praised for its setting, music, and the relationship between the characters. While some find the plot and villains weak, the movie is appreciated for its nostalgic value and emotional connection, especially by those who grew up with it. The animation is considered a highlight, making it a worthwhile watch for Pokemon fans.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style, especially the portrayal of Altomare (Venice)
Excellent and evocative soundtrack that enhances the atmosphere
Strong connection and interactions between Ash, Latias, and Latios
Decent storyline centered around the history of a single city
Innovative use of CGI for environments and intricate objects
cons: Weak and unmemorable villains with little depth
Plot can be thin and unfocused with repeated themes
Misty and Brock have minimal screen time and impact on the story
Some find Latias and Latios' vocalizations (screeching) annoying
Machine used by the villains lacks grounding and raises questions

anime.title: Pokémon: Jirachi — Wish Maker
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 06: Nanayo no Negaiboshi Jirachi
anime.synopsis:
The Millennium Comet is about to make its long-awaited appearance in the sky again, supposedly granting the wishes of all those who see it in the skies above them. Of course, Satoshi and friends are equally interested in the Millennium Festival, especially when they attend a magic performance by the Great Butler. Even more interesting is the mysterious cocoon in Butler’s possession—from which Masato hears a mysterious voice calling! When Jirachi emerges from its slumber, Masato has a new friend—sadly, it’s only for the brief few days that the Millennium Comet appears in the sky.

Masato is anxious to make the most of his time with his new friend, but the Great Butler has his own plans for Jirachi, which are not so friendly. He wants to revive the Legendary Groudon, and Jirachi just might be able to grant that wish.

Can Masato, Satoshi, Haruka, and Takeshi stop Butler and save Jirachi before Groudon reappears to reign destruction over the land?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating the film's charming portrayal of Jirachi and its themes of friendship, alongside praise for the animation and music. However, a significant portion of viewers found the plot to be weak, underdeveloped, and at times nonsensical, leading to a divisive opinion on its overall quality despite its positive emotional elements.
pros: Jirachi is consistently described as adorable and charming.
The art and animation are praised for their quality, with specific mentions of beautiful backgrounds and good character design.
The soundtrack is highlighted as incredible and beautiful.
The film effectively explores themes of friendship and the bittersweet nature of goodbyes.
The villain is noted for being charismatic and having presence.
The action sequences and climactic scenes are often described as impressive and energetic.
The connection of the plot to Team Magma and Groudon is seen as a positive integration with the broader Pokémon lore.
cons: The plot is frequently criticized for being simple, nonsensical, or underdeveloped.
Some critics found the character interactions underwhelming or the characters themselves unlikable (particularly Max).
The movie is considered by some to be the weakest of the series up to that point.
The pacing is sometimes described as slow or too long, especially with a focus on 'cute stuff' over plot.
The villain's motivation, while present, is sometimes seen as not fully developed or its backstory elements as padding.
The handling of Jirachi's gender (referred to as 'he' but with a girl's voice) was a minor point of confusion or annoyance for some viewers.

anime.title: Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 07: Rekkuu no Houmonsha Deoxys
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Kids, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
High-tech LaRousse City is a pretty impressive place to visit—and a pretty impressive place for a Pokémon battle, too! Satoshi heads straight for their renowned Battle Tower, but things don't turn out too well when his battle partner turns out to be a scared boy named Tooi. Because of a frightening childhood incident, Tooi is scared of all Pokémon—even cute ones like Pikachu!

There's a lot more to be frightened by when Deoxys shows up and takes control of the city, shutting down the machines and taking everyone captive. One Pokémon that is not amused is the Legendary Rayquaza, and it will do whatever it takes to remove this invader from its territory! Meanwhile, Satoshi, Tooi, and all their friends may be caught in the middle, but they're certainly not out of the fight!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many viewing it through a lens of nostalgia. While the film is praised for its visuals, music, and the character of Tory, it's criticized for its weak plot and underdeveloped supporting characters. Some find it to be one of the better Pokemon movies, while others consider it flawed but enjoyable.
pros: Good animation and visual style, especially the futuristic city setting
Well-developed side characters, particularly Tory and his PTSD storyline
Excellent soundtrack and sound design
cons: Inconsistent plot with underdeveloped or illogical elements
Weak character development for characters other than Tory
Rayquaza's inclusion feels unnecessary and poorly integrated into the story

anime.title: Beet the Vandel Buster Excellion
anime.synopsis: It is the dark century and the people are suffering under the rule of the devil, Vandel, who is able to manipulate monsters. The Vandel Busters are a group of people who hunt these devils, and among them, the Zenon Squad is known to be the strongest busters on the continent. A young boy, Beet, dreams of joining the Zenon Squad. However, one day, as a result of Beet's fault, the Zenon squad was defeated by the devil, Beltose. The five dying busters sacrificed their life power into their five weapons, Saiga. After giving their weapons to Beet, they passed away. Years have passed since then and the young Vandel Buster, Beet, begins his adventure to carry out the Zenon Squad's will to put an end to the dark century.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season, Excellion, is largely seen as a disappointment compared to its prequel. It abandons established story elements and character goals, opting for a filler-like narrative. This shift results in a boring and average experience, failing to meet the expectations set by the first season. Audience polarization is low, with a general sentiment of disappointment rather than strong negative emotions.
cons: Abandonment of original story elements
Shift to a filler-like side story
Forced circumstances leading to stagnation
Boring and average execution

anime.title: Crest of the Stars: Birth
anime.synopsis: This is the story about how Dubus, Lafiel's father, and Plakia after an adventure on a mysterious, abandoned spaceship decided to have a daughter together and why Dubus gave her the name Lafiel.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is that this prequel episode is a mildly entertaining but non-essential addition to the series. It's appreciated for its character interactions and backstory but criticized for its slow pace and lack of significant plot development. Many feel it's only worthwhile for dedicated fans interested in Lafiel's origins.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions between Dubus and Plakia
Provides context and connection to Lafiel's character
Interesting glimpse into the ancestors' ship
cons: The episode is dialogue-heavy and lacks action
The plot can be considered uneventful; calling it an 'adventure' is a stretch.

anime.title: Figure 17: Tsubasa & Hikaru
anime.synopsis: Tsubasa Shiina is a 10-year-old girl who recently moved to Hokkaido to live with her father. In school, she is very quiet and unsociable with her classmates. Then one night, she witnesses a UFO crash in the forest near her home. She rushes to the scene and finds the pilot, codenamed "D.D.", in a barely stable condition. Also in the scene is a Maguar, a hideous alien that hatched aboard D.D.'s ship. As the Maguar is close to taking Tsubasa's life, an alien lifeform fuses with her body to form the Riberus battle armor Figure 17, which shortly destroys the alien threat. The life form takes the name Hikaru and turns into an identical twin of Tsubasa. As time passes, Tsubasa becomes more open to everyone around her, thanks to her new twin sister Hikaru. However, with Maguar eggs scattered all over Hokkaido, their ability to form Figure 17 is needed to eliminate all hatched Maguars until backup from D.D.'s home planet arrives on Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the character development and emotional depth. Some find the sci-fi elements weak and the pacing slow, but overall the show is considered a hidden gem. The focus on character relationships over action resonates with many viewers.
pros: Strong character development, particularly Tsubasa's gradual growth.
Realistic portrayal of emotions and relationships.
Well-integrated slice-of-life elements with sci-fi action.
cons: Repetitive action sequences and uninspired Maguar designs.
Pacing issues, with episodes feeling stretched out.
Unnecessary side plots that don't tie into the main story (e.g., the reporter).

anime.title: UFO Ultramaiden Valkyrie
anime.synopsis: UFO Princess Warukyure, aka UFO Princess Walkyrie is about a princess from outer space who accidentally crashes on earth, where Kazuto desperately tries to maintain the public bath of his grandfather. Due to circumstances, Kazuto receives part of princess Walkyrie's soul which forces her to stay there with him. But that's not the only problem ... because her soul lost strength, the princess transforms both mentally and physically into a little kid!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the comedic and ecchi elements while others criticize the problematic romance and generic characters. The series is noted for its inconsistent tone and dated production values. While the soundtrack receives praise, the overall consensus leans towards a flawed but potentially enjoyable experience for fans of the genre, but it may not be appealing to a broad audience.
pros: Good soundtrack and effective use of music to create atmosphere.
Some creatively designed alien characters.
Series has moments of comedic insanity and ridiculousness.
cons: Poorly developed and uncomfortable main romance due to the age regression of Valkyrie.
Bland and generic main characters with little personality.
Inconsistent tone, especially when attempting serious or tragic arcs.
Dated art style and overuse of recycled animation sequences.
Overreliance on fan service and ecchi elements can be distracting.
Questionable character designs and animation quality.
Repetitive plot elements and stalling of romantic development.

anime.title: UFO Ultramaiden Valkyrie 2: December Nocturne
anime.romaji_title: UFO Princess Valkyrie 2: Juunigatsu no Yasoukyoku
anime.synopsis: Valkyrie, Kazuto, Akina, Hydra, and friends are back for more when the Key of time suddenly appears along with many other mysterious happenings. All seemed to be linked to a person named "Valkyrie Ghost" whose only goal is stealing Kazuto for herself. As they team up against this seeming unbeatable foe they dig deeper into the mysterious past of Valkyrie's home planet, Valhalla.
anime.consensus_summary: UFO Princess Valkyrie 2 is viewed as a simple and entertaining anime, appreciated for its creative world and enjoyable soundtrack. However, it is criticized for its low-budget animation, shallow characters, and formulaic storytelling. The audience generally agrees that it is a harmless and lighthearted series, best enjoyed without taking it too seriously.
pros: Inventive and imaginative world-building
Memorable soundtrack by Kenji Kawai
Fun and lighthearted entertainment
cons: Limited animation quality and budget
One-dimensional characters with little development
Predictable episodic format

anime.title: Digimon Frontier
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Isekai
anime.synopsis: With five new kids and an exciting new mission in the Digital World, Digimon Frontier brings back all the great action and adventure of the last three seasons. Takuya, Kouji, Izumi, Junpei. and Tomoki meet each other in a train that takes them to the Digital World where a war against evil is being fought. The Angel digimon, Cherubimon, one of The three angels sent to save the World from the power-hungry Lucemon, has turned to the dark side and the entire Digital World is in peril. To fight this great battle, the five CHOSEN ONES must find the Densetsu no Spirit (Legendary Spirit).
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the unique concept and character development, but criticism for inconsistent execution. Many appreciate the series' departure from the standard Digimon formula, while others dislike the lack of traditional Digimon partners. The second half of the series is generally considered weaker, leading to a decline in overall enjoyment.
pros: Unique concept of humans transforming into Digimon.
Focus on character development and real-life issues.
Good story with surprising twists and turns.
Enjoyable action sequences
Well made story line that works together, and doesn't deserve the hate that some give it
cons: Inconsistent art quality, especially with animation synchronization.
Pacing issues with filler episodes and rushed plot development.
Uneven character development, with some characters overshadowed.
Repetitive battle sequences.
Second half of the series declines in quality.

anime.title: Tenchi Muyou! GXP
anime.synopsis:
From crashing his bike to falling in lakes, Seina Yamada just cannot shake the bad luck that follows him. But his fortune begins to change when he is forcibly recruited into the Galaxy Police and ends up capturing the most pirates in the force. 

Now, Seina is no longer just the unfortunate boy from Earth; he is a man that pirates have come to fear. Despite his reputation, Seina is still the same clumsy guy, but at least he has Amane Kaunaq, a former model, and Kiriko Masaki, his long time friend, to keep him together. With their help, Seina sets out on an adventure in the hopes of becoming a great Galaxy Police Officer.
anime.consensus_summary: Tenchi Muyo! GXP is a divisive entry in the franchise, with many finding it a pale imitation of its predecessors. While some appreciate the change of scenery and comedic elements, the uninspired characters, weak plot, and reliance on harem tropes disappoint many fans. The series is generally considered a mediocre addition to the Tenchi Muyo universe.
pros: Expands the Tenchi universe with a new setting and characters.
Some find the humor, especially facial expressions and satire of institutions, enjoyable.
The Devil Princess of Jurai, Lady Seito, is a standout and memorable character.
cons: Main character Seina is uninspired and lacks depth.
Harem cast is generic and underdeveloped, with weak motivations.
Story feels disjointed, padded with filler, and lacks a strong central plot.
Reliance on sexual humor can be repetitive and detract from the overall experience.
Continuity issues and references to later OVAs create confusion.

anime.title: Munto 2: Beyond the Walls of Time
anime.romaji_title: Munto: Toki no Kabe wo Koete
anime.synopsis: Two years have passed since the catastrophic event known as the "Continent's Dropping" from the first OVA episode. Yumemi still has not forgotten her ability to see the world above, but now she's in the last years of middle school, tests and real life take over. Unknown to the people of the world, Akuto the world still thrives, but the war rages on. In need of help, Gaz, sends Munto down to Earth once more to find the "Girl of Destiny" in order to save Heaven from its untimely demise. Yumemi must once again confront the world only she sees, and not even her friends Ichiko and Suzune can help her.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the attempt at a more mature storyline and character development. However, many are critical of the confusing and convoluted plot, inconsistent animation quality, and a perceived lack of resolution. Ultimately, the sequel fails to live up to the original and leaves viewers with more questions than answers.
pros: More mature story than the first Munto
Character development is better than the first Munto
Beautiful and sweet music during slow parts
cons: Confusing plot with unanswered questions and inconsistencies
Animation quality decreased from the original
Forced 3D animation
Rushed production feel
Weak English dub voice acting
Plot progression is slow, with the story starting late
No real ending

anime.title: Betterman
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Horror, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Keita Aono is an ordinary high school student who loves to chat with his friends about military technology and the girls in their class. One day, Keita is surprised and delighted by a new transfer student in his class, his childhood friend Hinoki Sai. But when Keita tries to catch up with Hinoki after school, he accidentally wanders into Bottom World—an underground amusement park whose opening was canceled due to an unexplained tragedy.

As Keita explores the area, he eventually finds Hinoki in the cockpit of a strange robot. She is here on behalf of Akamatsu Industries, a company contracted with the secretive international organization Mode Warp to investigate strange cases of violence worldwide. After joining Hinoki in the robot, the pair attempt to defend themselves against the various attractions of Bottom World, which have come to life and become violent. However, they are unable to escape until a man with transforming powers—dubbed "Betterman"—joins their struggle. Faced with an enemy he does not understand and a slew of mysterious new technology, Keita joins Akamatsu Industries in a fight against a force they call "Algernon."
anime.consensus_summary: Betterman is a divisive anime praised for its unique blend of genres and intricate plot, but criticized for its confusing narrative and inconsistent pacing. Some viewers find the atmosphere refreshing and the characters engaging, while others are turned off by the chaotic elements and unresolved plot points. The series leaves a lasting impression, but whether that impression is positive or negative depends heavily on individual preferences.
pros: Unique atmosphere blending lightheartedness and dark creepiness.
Intricate plot with well-motivated exposition and consistent question-answering.
Good character chemistry and complete arcs for major characters.
cons: Chaotic pacing and subtle visual foreshadowing can confuse viewers.
Plot can be tangled and confusing, especially early on.
Inconsistent setting and underdeveloped characters.

anime.title: Shinzo
anime.synopsis:
In the world of Mushrambo, human life has all but come to an end. After a deadly virus threatened the extinction of mankind, a new race called the Enterrans was created to preserve life on Earth. However, relations between the Enterrans and their creators did not remain peaceful. Soon a war broke out with the Enterrans fighting against the humans and their robots. Ultimately the Enterrans were the victors of this conflict, renaming Earth as Enterra in honor of their victory.

Before the last vestiges of humanity fell, one of the few remaining scientists put his daughter, Yakumo Shindou, into a sleep chamber. His hope was that his daughter would one day reawaken and find the human sanctuary known as Shinzo, reviving humanity and restoring peace between humans and Enterrans. Centuries have passed since the war; Yakumo now awakens and meets an Enterran named Mashura who pledges to assist in her quest. Also joined by the Enterrans Sago and Kutal, the group must now work to locate Yakumo's missing memories and locate Shinzo. But not every Enterran is as kind as Yakumo's new friends and some are prepared to commit any atrocity to prevent the return of humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has a generally positive, though nostalgic, view of Mushrambo. Many recognize its flaws, such as the simplistic plot and dated animation, but appreciate the core story and character designs. The series is seen as a simple, enjoyable adventure with a touch of childhood fondness.
pros: Cool-looking characters
Sweet plot about saving humanity
Enjoyable despite flaws
cons: Cheesy and banal dialogs
Inconsistent power scaling
Basic storyline and character profiles
Animation is dated
anime.thematic_vibe: Post-Apocalyptic Adventure, Found Family, Hope vs. Despair

anime.title: Medabots
anime.synopsis:
Medabots—powerful robots granted artificial intelligence through special "medals"—serve at the whims of their owner. They are more commonly used in "Robbatling," a popular combat sport where two medabots face off against one another. In its professional form, Medafighters use their Medabots to qualify for the World Tournament and fight amongst the elite to gain the title of champion.

Elementary schooler Ikki Tenryou has just gained his first Medabot: Metabee, an outdated model with no medal. Fortunately, however, Ikki manages to find a medal in the nearby river; but when Ikki places it into Metabee's head, the latter starts to exhibit strange behaviour. Short-tempered and rebellious, he refuses to obey Ikki's orders. However, to climb the ranks to the World Tournament, Ikki and Metabee must first learn to work together, no matter how difficult the prospect may seem…
anime.consensus_summary: Medabots is fondly remembered as a fun and engaging anime, particularly for its characters and humorous take on the battle genre. While some reviewers point out flaws such as filler episodes and repetitive elements, the overall sentiment is positive, with many appreciating its nostalgic value and unique approach. The show is considered a worthwhile watch for fans of action-oriented anime with a touch of comedy.
pros: Memorable and well-developed characters, especially Metabee.
Engaging story with a mix of humor and action.
Subversion of battle shounen cliches and exploration of deeper themes.
cons: Repetitive dialogue and some filler episodes.
Inconsistent pacing in the original Japanese version.
Unresolved plot points and abrupt ending.
Animation quality showing its age.

anime.title: Monkey Magic
anime.synopsis:
From out of the fires of space he was born... Kongo, a monkey made of stone, magically brought to life. 

Obsessed with a desire to learn and a need to be great, Kongo leaves his "family" on Flower Fruit Mountain in search of ancient knowledge and arcane wisdom. Not content to merely study and learn the mystical arts, Kongo masters the magic Jet Cloud, the first of his great weapons. 

With the power of the Jet Cloud, Kongo gains mastery of the air and returns to his adopted home just in time. Humans are laying claim to the monkeys` ancestral home. With his Jet Cloud and his newly-learned magical wisdom, Kongo defeats the humans and proclaims himself King of Flower Fruit Mountain. 

But in the Celestial Heavens, the gods are uneasy. A monkey defeating humans and declaring himself king? That cannot be allowed! They decide the monkeys must be taught a lesson and so they launch an attack on Kongo and all the monkeys of Flower Fruit Mountain.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys Monkey Magic for its unique art style, interesting story, and spiritual themes. The series is praised for its well-developed characters and engaging battles. However, some viewers find the pacing to be too fast and the series too short.
pros: Interesting story with a monkey protagonist and mysterious origins
Spiritual themes and dynamic between weak and strong characters
Well-detailed backgrounds and locations
Enjoyable art style and character designs
Solid voice acting and well-done ending theme
cons: Short series with pacing issues
Quick mastery of skills by the protagonist

anime.title: Origin: Spirits of the Past
anime.synopsis:
Three hundred years ago, a genetic experiment gone wrong caused the mutation of all forests on Earth. Armed with consciousness, the vegetation sought to destroy all of humankind, and the war that ensued turned the planet into a hellish dystopia.

In the present day, Agito, a young boy, lives with his father in Neutral City—a village maintaining an uneasy truce with the neighboring forest. One day, Agito, on his way to collect water, becomes separated from his friend and stumbles upon a relic of the past: a girl sleeping in a mysterious machine.

Agito awakens the girl, Toola Cm Sacl, and introduces her to the village. But outside forces have ulterior motives for the girl, who holds the key to restore the Earth. Misguided by Shunack, a soldier from the old world hellbent on destroying the forest, Toola follows him despite Agito's warning. Determined to save Toola and unify humankind with the forest, Agito borrows the power of the forest and pursues her.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many praising the visuals and music but criticizing the story and characters. Some find it a worthwhile watch for its aesthetic qualities, while others are disappointed by the lack of depth and originality. The film is often compared to Studio Ghibli works, but falls short in terms of emotional impact and narrative coherence.
pros: Visually stunning animation, especially the backgrounds and forest scenes
Music and sound design are well-integrated and enhance the viewing experience
Intriguing concept with unique blend of technology and fantasy
cons: Weak character development and bland characters
Rushed pacing and convoluted plot
Story lacks originality and relies heavily on familiar tropes

anime.title: A Tree of Palme
anime.synopsis:
In a remote corner of the planet Arcana, Palme, a sentient android crafted from a mystical wood that is said to absorb the memories of the civilizations it roots in, is awakened by Koram, a wounded warrior from the Sol tribe. Entrusting him with the mystical "Egg of the Roof," she implores Palme to take it to the legendary realm of Tamas.

Galvanized with purpose for his existence, he accepts Koram's quest to deliver the relic to its source: the center of the planet, which is threatened by a malevolent and destructive force.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Palme no Ki' is highly divided. While praised for its visual artistry and unique world, many find the narrative confusing, the characters inconsistent, and the overall experience disorienting. The film's ambition is evident, but its execution leaves many viewers feeling alienated and unsatisfied, resulting in a polarizing effect.
pros: Stunning animation and art style, with beautiful backgrounds.
Unique and creative world design.
Deep and thought-provoking story (for some viewers).
Well-done music that enhances the atmosphere.
cons: Confusing and muddled storytelling.
Inconsistent and unlikeable characters.
Pacing issues, with the story dragging in places.
Jarring tonal shifts and bizarre imagery that can be off-putting.
Underdeveloped themes and rushed character development.

anime.title: Honey and Clover II
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Josei, Love Polygon, Romance, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis:
Back from his journey across Japan, Yuuta Takemoto reminisces about his college life so far. He has matured significantly since his second year and is motivated to move forward.

Feeling more confident than ever before, he finally confesses to Hagumi Hanamoto, the girl he has been in love with since their first encounter. However, Hagumi has been confused by her attempts to understand the mysterious Shinobu Morita. Hiding behind a playful demeanor, Morita may be the most burdened by his own potential. Meanwhile, Takumi Mayama has become a full-fledged working adult and has landed Ayumi Yamada several pottery orders through his company in an act of friendship.

The five youths continue to face individual hardships in academics, work, love, and friendship as they push each other toward the paths that they are destined to walk.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mostly positive, praising the series for its art, music, and character development. Some viewers find the second season less impactful than the first, citing issues with character consistency and plot resolution. While the series evokes strong emotions and explores relatable themes, some find certain plot developments and the ending unsatisfying.
pros: Beautiful art style with pastel colors
Excellent music and fitting insert songs
Well-developed and relatable characters
Exploration of complex emotions and relationships
Meaningful exploration of adulthood, love, and identity
cons: Some plot points feel stale or predictable
Ending may be unsatisfying for some viewers
Inconsistent character development in the second season
Shift in focus from comedy to melodrama
Some character relationships feel forced or out of place

anime.title: .hack//Intermezzo
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Mystery, Sci-Fi, Video Game
anime.synopsis: A virtual multiplayer online role-playing game exists known as "The World." In "The World," there is an event held in the Dungeon of Nankoflank that Mimiru, a character in the game, undertakes with Bear, another character in the game. Mimiru confesses to Bear that she is not doing the event for the treasures or experiences, but for the memories and experiences of when she first started playing. The two later meet a certain character named Mimika, and together, the three proceed through quests and events as Mimiru learns the meaning of the game.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response to .hack//Intermezzo is lukewarm. While some appreciate the nostalgic elements and music, many find the story and characters uninteresting and lacking depth. The special is primarily recommended for dedicated .hack fans, while others may find it skippable due to its shallow narrative and reliance on the MMORPG theme.
pros: Soundtrack is appealing, especially the opening theme.
Nostalgic feelings evoked, especially from the opening sequence.
cons: Storyline is average and lacks depth.
Characters are uninteresting and motivations are superficial.
Narrative lacks stakes and creativity.
MMORPG theme can be a turn-off for some viewers.

anime.title: Kaze no Yojimbo
anime.synopsis: In search for Araki Genzo, George Kodama finds himself in the small town of Kimujuku. George quickly realizes that he is unwelcome and is warned to leave as soon as possible. With two rival syndicates roaming the streets and a dark violent past, the town of Kimujuku isn't what it appears to be. George challenges the town of Kimujuku in order to reveal the towns dark hidden past and discover the truth.
