While the series recovers in its final episodes, the uneven quality and pacing issues prevent it from achieving true classic status, leading to divided opinions on its overall merit.
pros: Well-developed characters with believable relationships.
Excellent character designs, especially Nadia and Gargoyle.
Soundtrack enhances emotional impact, particularly in bittersweet scenes.
Engrossing and fun, with a good balance of humor and sadness.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, especially during the 'filler' arc.
Filler arc (episodes 23-34) is poorly written, with warped characterizations and uninspired scenarios.
Uneven pacing and plot development, with some interesting story elements left unexplored.
Heavy-handed or preachy character development at times.

anime.title: Saint Seiya: The Hades Chapter - Inferno
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Seiya and the rest of the Bronze and Gold Saints who have survived the Sanctuary battle have entered the world of the Dead. They are fighting to get to Hades and defeat him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating the series' darker tone, character moments, and music. However, significant criticism is directed towards the declining animation quality, controversial voice actor changes, and rushed pacing. While some find the story engaging and emotional, others feel it falls short of its potential due to underdeveloped villains and plot issues.
pros: Expands on darker tone and atmosphere established in previous arcs.
Characters, especially Kanon and Orphe, have moments to shine.
Soundtrack retains its charm and nostalgic feel.
Strong character moments and exploration of brotherly love (Ikki and Shun).
Interesting world-building based on Greek mythology and Dante's Inferno.
cons: Animation quality declines in later episodes, with reused shots and less fluid movement.
Changes in voice actors (seiyuu) were controversial and off-putting to some fans.
Pacing feels rushed, and the Underworld setting is not fully explored.
Many villains lack charisma and depth.
Plot twists sometimes come out of nowhere, lacking foreshadowing.

anime.title: Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
In ancient times, a group of young men devoted their lives to protecting Athena, the Goddess of Wisdom and War. These men were capable of fighting without weapons—a swing of their fist alone was powerful enough to rip the very sky apart and shatter the earth beneath them. These brave heroes became known as Saints, as they could summon up the power of the Cosmos from within themselves.

Now, in present day, a new generation of Saints is about to come forth. The young and spirited Seiya is fighting a tough battle for the Sacred Armor of Pegasus, and he isn't about to let anyone get in the way of him and his prize. Six years of hard work and training pay off with his victory and new title as one of Athena's Saints.

But Seiya's endeavor doesn't end there. In fact, plenty of perils and dangerous enemies face him and the rest of the Saints throughout the series. What new quests await the heroes of the epic Saint Seiya saga?
anime.consensus_summary: Saint Seiya is a beloved classic for many, particularly those who grew up with it, praised for its epic music, distinctive armor designs, and mythological themes. However, it is also divisive, with critics pointing to repetitive fight structures, inconsistent animation, and plot conveniences that diminish the narrative tension and overall quality for modern viewers.
pros: The musical score is consistently praised as epic and fitting, with standout opening themes and instrumental tracks.
Character designs, particularly the intricate and visually appealing armors (cloths), are frequently highlighted as a major strength.
The integration of Greek mythology and astrological concepts provides a unique and engaging narrative framework.
Many reviewers highlight the strong themes of friendship, loyalty, and courage.
Despite its age, the animation is considered decent for its time, with beautiful character and background art.
The Asgard filler arc is often singled out as a surprisingly well-written and impactful addition, even praised as one of the best filler arcs.
The series is recognized as a foundational influence on later shonen anime.
The character archetypes, while sometimes stereotypical, are well-defined and contribute to strong team dynamics.
The concept of 'Cosmos' as an internal energy source is seen as a unique and well-integrated power system.
cons: Pacing issues, particularly in longer arcs like the Sanctuary Arc, with repetitive fight structures and slow progression.
A significant amount of filler content, especially in the early parts of the series, which can detract from the main plot.
The prevalence of 'deus ex machina' resolutions and plot armor leads to a lack of tension in fights, with characters often surviving seemingly fatal situations.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with some episodes suffering from low frame rates, jerkiness, and reused footage.
The plot is often described as simple, straightforward, and sometimes monodimensional.
Some viewers find the main characters' motivations and personalities to be underdeveloped or stereotypical.
The localization and dubbing, particularly for the US market, are often cited as poor and detrimental to the series' reception.
The Steel Saints filler characters are widely disliked and seen as negating the series' core concepts.

anime.title: Saint Seiya: The Hades Chapter - Sanctuary
anime.romaji_title: Saint Seiya: Meiou Hades Juuni Kyuu-hen
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Hades is planning to take over the world, to achieve that goal, he sends out deceased Gold Saints to take Athena's head. Seiya and the other Bronze Saints come to help but their help isn't appreciated by the remaining Gold Saints that are still alive.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Saint Seiya: Meiou Hades Juuni Kyuu-hen' very favorably, especially among long-time fans.  The animation and music are praised, along with the focus on the Gold Saints. Some find the animation quality or plot twists to be slightly weaker, but the nostalgia and character development provide a strong viewing experience overall. Most agree that this arc is a must-watch for Saint Seiya enthusiasts.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga.
Improved animation and art style compared to previous arcs.
Excellent music and sound design, including the use of original tracks and voice actors.
Focus on Gold Saints provides character depth and development.
Intense and emotional fight scenes.
Well-directed with spectacular moments.
Engaging plot twists and a darker, more intense story.
cons: Animation may still not be considered great by some.
Requires prior knowledge of the original series to fully understand.
Plot twist can diminish the sense of loss and conflict.
Some CGI is dated.
Serves as a setup for the next part of the series with no real ending.

anime.title: Saint Seiya: The Heaven Chapter - Overture
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: After the Saints' victory against Hades, Seiya is left wounded and motionless in a wheel chair with no possible chance of recovery. Athena's sister Artemis, the Virgin Goddess of the Moon and twin sister of Apollo, makes an elaborate proposal - to restore Seiya's physical health in exchange for the supremacy of Sanctuary. Athena accepts and Artemis and her "Knights of the Sky" swiftly take control of Sanctuary. Now Seiya and his fellow Bronze Saints combat the forces of Zeus to regain their homeland but it will not be so easy. Bronze Saints Hydra Ichi and Unicorn Jabu, and Silver Saint Ophiuchus Shaina have join forces with Artemis and Apollo.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many criticizing the confusing and poorly executed plot and character arcs, while acknowledging the high-quality animation and soundtrack. Some appreciate the attempt at a more realistic portrayal of the aftermath of the Hades arc, but the film is generally considered a disappointment and a non-canon addition to the Saint Seiya storyline. It is mostly recommended for die-hard fans who want to experience all Saint Seiya content.
pros: Visually stunning animation and character design.
Soundtrack retains the quality of the series with memorable tracks.
Presents consequences to the characters' actions, adding realism.
cons: Plot is confusing, rushed, and poorly written with multiple unintelligible endings.
Character motivations are inconsistent, with the Saints acting out of character.
Pacing is slow and boring, especially in the first half.
OST is unremarkable and forgettable.

anime.title: Samurai Pizza Cats
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Comedy, Mecha, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
In the city of Edoropolis, hundreds of mechanical animals live in harmony alongside each other. However, when Lord Wanko discovers that the shogun's chief advisor, Lord Korn, is plotting to take over the government, he knows that something must be done to preserve the peace. In order to thwart Korn's plans, Wanko forms the Nyankees—an elite ninja team led by the fearless Yattarou, who wields the mystic sword Masamasa. With all this power, the Nyankees seem unstoppable!

But Korn's schemes are not the only thing the team has to worry about. Secretly based out of the popular Pizza Cats restaurant, the Nyankees must keep their operations hidden while delivering piping-hot plates of pizza and justice.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally have fond memories of Kyattou Ninden Teyandee, praising its originality and humor, especially the self-aware, fourth-wall-breaking elements. However, many note the significant differences between the original Japanese version and the dubbed Samurai Pizza Cats, and some find certain comedic aspects repetitive or poorly executed. Despite its flaws, the show is often considered a classic and a good starter anime for kids, fostering a strong sense of nostalgia among viewers.
pros: Unique and original for its time
Memorable and nostalgic for many viewers
Humorous with fourth-wall breaking jokes
Every character gets a chance to shine
Appeals to both children and adults
cons: Dub deviates significantly from the original Japanese version
Narrator explains the obvious and repeats information
Recurring gags like cross-dressing and dirty old man jokes are not well-executed
Too many recap episodes

anime.title: Aquarian Age: The Movie
anime.romaji_title: Aquarian Age: Saga II - Don't Forget Me...
anime.synopsis:
During the chaotic period known in Western astrology as the Aquarian Age, the alien ERASER fleet attacks Earth, ravaging cities. However, a counteroffensive is launched. The four factions—ARAYASHIKI, WIZDOM, DARKLORE, and E.G.O.—who have been fighting each other for control of Earth, join forces to defeat the ERASERS.

In the aftermath, Earth is placed under the unified rule of the POLESTAR EMPIRE. However, peace is shattered when the EMPIRE begins to use forbidden magic. These dark powers cause dimensional rifts around the world and once again plunge Earth into chaos and warfare.
anime.consensus_summary: Aquarian Age: Saga II - Don't Forget Me... is a visually impressive but narratively shallow OVA. It's generally considered a better experience than the original series due to its simple revenge plot and focus on action. However, its lack of character development and rushed pacing leave viewers wanting more. It succeeds as a flashy advertisement for the card game, primarily appealing to those who prioritize visual spectacle over story depth.
pros: Visually stunning animation by Madhouse
Gory and brutal battles
Simple, straightforward plot avoids the pitfalls of the original series
cons: Barebones story and one-dimensional characters
Rushed pacing with little explanation
Lacks depth and character interaction due to short runtime

anime.title: Ghost Stories
anime.synopsis:
Years ago, all of the ghosts in a haunted schoolhouse were banished by a certain student. Now, they're back—and they want revenge...
 
Satsuki and Keiichirou Miyanoshita are two siblings recovering from the tragic loss of their mother. After moving to their mother's hometown, they learn that the local school they have transferred to is an old building—one said to be haunted. Despite initially brushing it off as a silly rumor, the two soon discover that ghosts are indeed real and that they're after them! Gakkou no Kaidan is the creepy tale of the lives of these siblings and their newfound friends as they try to survive the school's ghosts—with a little help from their pet cat along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime's English dub is highly praised for its humor and irreverent take on the original story, turning a failed series into a cult classic. However, the subbed version is widely criticized for being boring and poorly executed. While some appreciate the dark humor and pop culture references, others may find it offensive or insensitive. Overall, the show's appeal heavily relies on the viewer's enjoyment of the dub's comedic style.
pros: Hilarious English dub with improv and pop culture references.
Memorable characters due to comedic lines and interactions.
Good for casual watching and stress relief.
cons: Poor animation and sound design.
Repetitive, episodic plot with little character development.
Original Japanese version (sub) is considered unwatchable.

anime.title: Patlabor Movie 3: WXIII
anime.synopsis: When the level of Labor accidents begin to escalate around Tokyo Bay, police detectives Kusumi and Hata are assigned to investigate. What they discover leads to a series of government cover-ups, conspiracy concerning a new biological weapon entitled WXIII-Wasted Thirteen and a tragic, personal connection to Hata. The only hope to stop this threat is to cooperate with the military and lead WXIII into a showdown with the Labors of Special Vehicle Division 2.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While praised for its animation, story, and soundtrack, some find the slow pacing and deviation from traditional Patlabor elements disappointing. The film is generally viewed as a well-executed detective mystery with dark themes, but its departure from the core Patlabor cast and mecha action may not appeal to all fans. Overall, it's considered an enjoyable yet somewhat unnecessary addition to the franchise.
pros: Consistently great animation with detailed drawings and rich colors.
Well-written and paced story with great revelations and no loose plot threads.
Soundtrack complements the visuals well, creating a melancholic and tense atmosphere.
cons: Character design can look shoddy and crudely done at times.
Pacing can be slow and may feel convoluted to some viewers.
Near-total sidelining of SV2 and the Ingram, making it feel less like a Patlabor movie.

anime.title: Afro Samurai
anime.synopsis:
When he was a young boy, Afro witnessed his father be cut down in a duel at the hands of a man known only as Justice. After taking the life of Afro's father, Justice cast aside his Number Two headband and took the Number One to claim its godly powers as his own.

Years later, having obtained the Number Two headband which grants him the right to challenge the Number One, Afro moves forward in his hunt for revenge on the man who murdered his father. There is just one thing that stands in his way—everyone else in the world! Though the Number One can only be challenged by the Number Two, the Number Two can be challenged by anyone. As his enemies gather to try and take the title of Number Two, Afro must fight through a myriad of foes and obstacles if he hopes to reach the Number One and claim vengeance once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Afro Samurai are mixed. While praised for its stylish visuals, excellent voice acting, and action sequences, the series is often criticized for its weak story, underdeveloped characters, and nonsensical plot. Some viewers appreciate it as a fun, action-packed anime, while others find it disappointing and generic.
pros: Stylish animation and unique art style.
Excellent voice acting, especially Samuel L. Jackson.
Enjoyable action sequences and fight choreography.
Soundtrack by RZA complements the show's tone.
The series is short and easy to watch in one sitting.
cons: Mediocre and generic story with a predictable revenge plot.
Underdeveloped and 2D characters.
Nonsensical plot elements and unexplained world-building.
Inconsistent tone with a mix of samurai, western, and sci-fi elements.
Flashbacks taking up too much screen time.
Some reviewers found the animation too dark and gory.

anime.title: Urusei Yatsura
anime.synopsis:
Not much is notable about the lecherous Ataru Moroboshi, but his extraordinary bad luck sticks out like the horns in an alien's head. When Earth is threatened by a fleet of alien invaders known as the Oni, Ataru is selected to represent humanity in a duel against one of them. It is a stroke of rare luck for Ataru that the duel is in fact a game of tag, and that his opponent is Lum, daughter of the Oni's leader, who places her personal dignity above victory—as Ataru finds out by seizing Lum's bikini top and with it, victory.

However, misfortune kicks in again when Lum mistakes Ataru's promise to marry his girlfriend, Shinobu Miyake, as the desire to wed Lum herself, and decides she rather likes the idea. Wielding her influence as an alien princess, she moves in with him. Forced to deal with the consequences of his womanizing ways, Ataru must balance his crumbling relationship with Shinobu while keeping Lum happy, all the while flirting with every woman he meets.
anime.consensus_summary: Urusei Yatsura is widely recognized as a groundbreaking and historically significant anime, celebrated for its unique humor, iconic characters like Lum, and its immense influence on subsequent anime. While its episodic format and repetitive gags can be a point of contention, especially for modern viewers accustomed to serialized storytelling, the show's creativity and character-driven narratives generally earn it high praise, though some find the protagonist's persistent perversion off-putting.
pros: Highly influential on anime tropes and character archetypes, establishing many staples for rom-coms and harem genres.
Features iconic characters, particularly Lum, who became a cultural phenomenon and inspired future character designs.
Praised for its unique blend of surrealism, humor, and surprisingly deep character moments that can evoke a wide range of emotions.
Strong emphasis on character-driven narratives with a vast and memorable cast, contributing significantly to the show's enduring appeal.
Creative and imaginative storytelling, often incorporating Japanese mythology and cultural references.
Engaging and often hilarious humor derived from character interactions and absurd situations.
cons: Highly episodic nature can lead to repetitive plot structures and a lack of overarching narrative progression, potentially boring viewers who prefer continuous storylines.
Some characters, particularly secondary ones, can be excessively annoying or grating, especially with frequent screen time.
The humor and pacing can become repetitive over the long run (195 episodes), making it difficult to binge-watch effectively.
Art and animation, while charming for its era, can appear dated to modern viewers.
The protagonist Ataru is often criticized for being a one-dimensional, unlikable pervert with few redeeming qualities.

anime.title: Flag
anime.synopsis: In 20xx, a civil war broke out in a small country in Asia in spite of the dispatch of UN forces. But a picture taken by accident in the battlefield accelerates the peace process: a photograph of a flag, which became the symbol of peace. However, just before the peace agreement is finalized, the flag is stolen by an armed extremist group in order to obstruct the truce. To rescue the flag, the UN sends the Special Development Command (SDC, which is armed with the High Agility Versatile Weapon Carrier (HAVWC)), along with an embedded photojournalist to record their activities. That photojournalist is Saeko Shirasu—the young camerawoman who took the picture of the flag.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many appreciating the show's unique presentation and realistic approach to war and media. However, some find the narrative slow and muddled, and the characters underdeveloped. The show's anti-war message is generally well-received, but the execution is not universally praised.
pros: Unique visual presentation through camera lens perspective enhances immersion.
Well-researched and realistic depiction of military, political, and journalistic elements.
Strong character development despite limited screen time for side characters.
cons: Muddled narrative and slow pacing can lead to boredom.
Inconsistent music that sometimes detracts from the atmosphere with bombastic scores.
Characters may come across as naive, and the ending can be confusing or unsatisfying.

anime.title: Omishi Mahou Gekijou: Risky★Safety
anime.synopsis: An apprentice shinigami (Japanese Death God), Risky, is determined to take Moe's life. However, Risky is magically joined with an apprentice angel, Safety, so Risky turns into Safety whenever someone says something nice. As an apprentice shinigami can only take someone's life when that person is really depressed, Risky has quite a problem taking Moe's soul, while dealing with Safety, who often cheers Moe up.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers deeply appreciating the show's emotional and philosophical depth, while others find it to be a fairly standard and somewhat unmemorable slice-of-life anime. The unique character dynamics and storytelling are praised, but pacing issues and underdeveloped concepts are noted as drawbacks. Overall, the show is seen as slightly above average but not particularly remarkable.
pros: Emotional depth and exploration of good vs. evil.
Unique character dynamics and development.
Creative and unexpected humor and storytelling techniques.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and some detached side stories.
Underdeveloped core concept.
Generic slice-of-life elements.

anime.title: The Animatrix
anime.synopsis:
1. Final Flight of the Osiris
The crew of the Osiris discover an army preparing to invade Zion. While one crew member races inside the Matrix to get the message to Zion, the others try desperately to buy her enough time while fighting off an onslaught of Sentinels they can't possibly defeat.

2-3. The Second Renaissance Part 1 and 2
Humans have created the ultimate AI, which is just as smart as they are. But complications arise when these robots and the humans try to exist peacefully, and eventually all-out war breaks out. The humans ultimately lose the war, and become trapped in the Matrix as seen in the live-action films.

4. Kid's Story
A young man discovers that his world isn't real, that it's a computer-generated fantasy land created by robots using humans for energy. He escapes with the help of the hacker Neo. Based on the Matrix trilogy.

5. Program
Cis and Duo engage in battle in a virtual recreation of Feudal Japan.

6. World Record
While running the fastest race in his life, a champion track star breaks free of his computer-generated world for a small period of time. When he goes back to the real world, he has no memories and is placed in a nursing home. Based on the Matrix trilogy.

7. Beyond
While looking for her lost pet, a young woman meets up with some kids in Tokyo to play in a "haunted house," which is really a glitch in their computer world. Based on the Matrix trilogy.

8. Detective Story
A detective named Ash is called upon by a mysterious organization to hunt down the notorious hacker Trinity.

9. Matriculated
A group of scientists capture a robot and place it in a surreal fantasy world. When the robot's friends come in and kill most of the scientists; however, the robot and the last scientist remaining face isolation in the computer-generated world. Based on the Matrix trilogy.
anime.consensus_summary: The Animatrix is a generally well-regarded anthology that expands on the Matrix universe with creative and visually diverse stories. While some segments are considered exceptional and offer deeper philosophical explorations, others suffer from inconsistent writing or dated animation. The anthology's value largely depends on individual preferences for specific animation styles and thematic interpretations of the Matrix concept, leading to mixed but overall positive audience sentiment.
pros: Expands the Matrix universe with diverse and thought-provoking stories.
Features animation from renowned talents and studios.
Explores themes of reality, identity, and free will with creativity.
Offers a variety of visual styles and unique interpretations of the Matrix concept.
Some shorts are considered superior to the Matrix sequels.
cons: Inconsistent quality across different shorts.
Some stories are poorly written or don't add much to the Matrix universe.
Dated CG animation in some segments.
Confusion regarding the narrative timeline and connection to the main movies.
Some artistic choices (like eroticism) appear out of place.

anime.title: Chobits: Hibiya and Kotoko Chat
anime.synopsis: A DVD recap episode of the Chobits TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: The Chobits Recap is viewed as a mixed bag. Fans appreciate the sequel content, but find the extensive recap unnecessary and detrimental to the overall experience. The recap is not particularly controversial, but it does seem to be viewed as a mediocre product.
pros: Serves as a sequel to the original anime.
Provides additional content for fans of Chobits.
cons: The recap portion is unnecessary and detracts from the overall experience.
The sequel portion is too short.

anime.title: Dai-Guard: Terrestrial Defense Corp.
anime.synopsis: Thirteen years after their sudden disappearance, an alien race known as the Heterodyne resurface without warning. To combat the Heterodyne, three office workers from the 21st Century Security Corporation operate Dai-Guard - a giant robot no longer regarded as an oversized paperweight. Unfortunately, Dai-Guard is somewhat obsolete and in disrepair. It's a tough job, but salarymen can also save the world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Dai-Guard for its unique approach to the mecha genre, blending giant robot action with the mundane realities of corporate life. Reviewers appreciate the relatable characters and the show's ability to balance humor, drama, and social commentary. While some find the animation and audio lacking, the overall consensus is that Dai-Guard is a worthwhile and enjoyable experience, especially for those who appreciate character-driven stories and realistic portrayals.
pros: Relatable characters with depth and development.
Unique blend of mecha action with realistic, everyday struggles.
Intriguing story with humor and heart; avoids deus ex machina.
cons: Visually outdated animation and weak special effects.
Generic and forgettable soundtrack.
Episodic nature in the first half.
anime.thematic_vibe: Corporate Satire, Realistic Mecha, Working Class Heroism

anime.title: Digimon Adventure 02
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Kids
anime.synopsis:
Taichi Yagami and his friends have moved on to junior high, but by that time, they have lost contact with their Digimon partners. Taichi is therefore surprised to suddenly receive a distress call summoning him to the Digital World. Once there, he learns that Digimon are living in fear of the mysterious Digimon Emperor, who is somehow suppressing their ability to Digivolve!

In the real world, Hikari Yagami and Takeru Takaishi reunite in the same fifth grade class. They share three schoolmates: Daisuke Motomiya, who reminds them both of Taichi; Miyako Inoue, a technical wizard; and Iori Hida, Miyako's neighbor. When these three children receive "D-3" Digivices, they—along with Hikari and Takeru, who still possess their own original Digivices—comprise the new generation of "Chosen Children" who must save the world once again. With the power of the Armored Digi-Eggs, they must thwart the Digimon Emperor's plans to spread his influence over the entire Digital World.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many feeling it doesn't live up to the original Digimon Adventure. While some appreciate the nostalgia and Ken's character development, the new characters are criticized for being shallow and the plot for being rushed and inconsistent. The ending is a significant point of disappointment for many viewers.
pros: Recurring cast allows old fans to ease into the new group of kids.
Soundtrack is well-thought-out and great, just like the first series.
Ken's character arc is well-written and compelling.
cons: New characters lack depth and development compared to the first season's cast.
The plot has annoying plotholes and rushed developments, especially in the later episodes.
The ending is disappointing and leaves many things unexplained.

anime.title: DT Eightron
anime.synopsis: Shu is from Datania, a country that makes young children work. He and his friends were trying to escape when they met the Returners. The Returners are some kind of rebels to Datania. Shu goes with the Returners to fight Zero, Nines, and his men who are after DT, a special substance inside humans.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some viewers appreciate the unique story, world-building, and themes, especially compared to modern anime trends, and find it nostalgic and thought-provoking. However, others find the pacing slow, the animation and music repetitive, the characters uninspired, and the overall experience tedious.
pros: Unique story compared to modern anime
Explores interesting themes of human colonies and resource exploitation
Protagonist Shu starts thinking for himself
Accurate predictions about the future for a 90s show
Stops relying on deus ex machina elements after initial episodes
Interesting exploration of different human colonies and survival methods
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the initial episodes
Classic animation style with reused scenes and movements
Repetitive music
Robotic transitions and manga-like frames
Uneven quality and filler episodes
Classic and uninspired characters
Weak voice acting and dubbing
Tedious and boring to watch

anime.title: Idaten Jump
anime.synopsis:
During a race, mountain bike (MTB) enthusiast Shou Yamato is mysteriously dragged into another world alongside his friends, Kakeru and Makoto. Soon, the group discovers that this world known as "X-Zone" revolves around Idaten battles—MTB races characterized by special courses, rules, and hidden powers lying dormant within the bikes. The only way to return home is to win and obtain the MTB emblems from the defeated challengers.

Despite being perplexed and terrified of the bizarre world, Shou is surprisingly excited. He has the opportunity to compete with fellow MTB riders, make new friends and rivals, and also unearth the X-Zone's hidden truths that may dramatically change his fate. Shou and his friends must make it through an arduous journey, one rife with conspiracies against them, in order to safely return home together.
anime.consensus_summary: Idaten Jump is fondly remembered, especially by those who watched it during its initial airing. Viewers praise its unique storyline, engaging characters, and impactful music, often highlighting its influence on their interest in mountain biking. While some find the ending rushed and the series geared towards a younger audience, the overall sentiment is positive, with many recommending it as an enjoyable and memorable anime.
pros: Unique and engaging story, especially the supernatural elements and plot twists.
Lovable and well-developed characters, with special mention of Sho Yamato and Kyoichi Shido.
Excellent music and OSTs that enhance emotional impact.
The anime introduces and promotes interest in mountain biking.
Enjoyable and entertaining, especially for younger audiences.
cons: Ending feels rushed and lacks visual clarity regarding the resolution of the conflict.
Availability of Japanese version with English subtitles is limited.
Some may find the anime childish, especially compared to other series.

anime.title: Violinist of Hamelin
anime.synopsis: Trouble arises in Staccato one day. Demons show up and start to wreak havoc on the townspeople. The entire country seems to be suffering. The source of the problem is that the "barrier" which until now has kept the demons from crossing over to the human world, is weakening. The person who sustains it is losing her strength after holding it up for so many years. That person is Queen Horn of Sforzando. Hell King Bass is trying to break through the barrier and release their "supreme leader," Kestra (Orchestra). One whose power is unparalleled yet is trapped somewhere in the world of the humans.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided primarily due to the show's outdated animation and inconsistent storytelling. While some appreciate the darker, reimagined narrative and engaging characters, many are turned off by the low-budget visuals and pacing issues. The soundtrack and integration of classical music elements are generally well-received, but are not enough to overcome the technical and narrative flaws for many viewers.
pros: Engaging and dramatic storyline with sympathetic characters.
Effective soundtrack that complements the dark storytelling.
Classical music integration and character naming conventions are appreciated.
cons: Subpar and limited animation with frequent still shots.
Inconsistent tone and flip-flopping character development.
Story pacing issues with boring episodes.

anime.title: Blue Legend Shoot!
anime.genres: Love Polygon, Romance, School, Shounen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis:
Inspired by Yoshiharu Kubo's phenomenal performance that led Kakegawa High School to a miraculous victory in a soccer tournament, Toshihiko Tanaka decides to enter the same school as his idol and join the soccer club, hoping to become as successful as Kubo.

Now a high school freshman, Tanaka is devastated as his expectations suddenly start falling apart. Kubo—the captain of the club—is absent due to illness. To make matters worse, the freshmen are not allowed to practice alongside the sophomores or become regulars on the team. The final nail in the coffin is the reluctance of Tanaka's friends, Kenji Shiraishi and Kazuhiro Hiramatsu, to join him in the club. Although Tanaka and his friends were once known as a deadly soccer trio in their junior high school days, Kenji and Kazuhiro have both quit soccer for personal reasons.

When Tanaka starts to lose hope, an encounter with Kazumi Endo—a girl from his childhood—becomes the unexpected key to his freedom from despair. The disappointed Kazumi wants to see the trio reunite, so she takes matters into her own hands in her mischievous way. Thus, Tanaka's high school soccer career prepares for the kickoff.
anime.consensus_summary: Aoki Densetsu Shoot! is generally well-received as a classic sports anime with a strong emphasis on friendship, personal growth, and the love of soccer. While the animation may show its age, the engaging story, memorable soundtrack, and relatable characters create a nostalgic and enjoyable experience for fans of the genre. The series is praised for its underdog narrative and ability to evoke emotional investment in the characters' journeys.
pros: Great story about soccer and personal growth.
Soundtrack is excellent and memorable.
Characters are well-developed and relatable.
Underdog story is enjoyable and inspiring.
cons: Animation is dated due to its age.
Some parts of the story are cliche and predictable.

anime.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex: Tachikomatic Days
anime.romaji_title: Koukaku Kidoutai: Stand Alone Complex - Tachikoma na Hibi
anime.synopsis: Tachikomatic Days is a series of comedic shorts attached to the end of every episode of Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex. The shorts feature the antics of the Tachikoma think tanks of Section 9 and usually involve plot points. The average short time is a little over a minute.
anime.consensus_summary: The Tachikoma shorts are well-received as a fun and lighthearted addition to the serious Ghost in the Shell series. They offer comedic relief and showcase the Tachikomas' personalities. The shorts are generally enjoyed, with little controversy surrounding their content or execution.
pros: Highlights the Tachikomas' unique personalities
Provides comedic relief after serious episodes
Exaggerates plot points for humorous effect
cons: Short length may leave viewers wanting more
Humor may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: A.D. Police: To Protect and Serve
anime.synopsis: Set a few years before Bubblegum Crisis Tokyo 2040, A.D. Police chronicles the tales of Mega-Tokyo's special police division designed to control rogue Boomers in the city. A.D. Police Officer Kenji Sasaki faces a major dilemma: he loses another partner to a rabid boomer. A day after he's sent off-duty, he receives a new partner in the form of German cop Hans Kleif. Funny thing is that Kenji sucker-punched Hans at a bar the night before. Not only does Kenji face the everyday task of controlling Boomers, he has to learn to adjust with his new partner.
anime.consensus_summary: A.D. Police (TV) is a flawed but somewhat enjoyable cyberpunk series. While some appreciate its exploration of classic themes and the character development of the main duo, the low-budget animation, questionable voice acting, and repetitive nature of the plot are major drawbacks. Overall, the series is considered a passable addition to the Bubblegum Crisis universe, suitable for fans of older anime or those seeking a less demanding viewing experience.
pros: Interesting exploration of humanity vs. robot themes
Good character background and development
Catchy opening and ending themes
cons: Cheap and inconsistent animation
Poor voice acting
Generic plot and repetitive action scenes
Underdeveloped supporting characters
Recycled and misused music

anime.title: Parasite Dolls
anime.synopsis: A secret unit of the AD Police, known as Branch, specializes in crimes involving humanoid robots called 'Boomers'. Branch officer Buzz must cope with having a Boomer for a partner, while officer Michaelson finds the line between human and robot to be a thin one. Together they serve to protect a world that is slowly deconstructing around them. Set in the Bubblegum Crisis universe.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the show's cyberpunk atmosphere, mature themes, and soundtrack, while others criticize it for being derivative, having a disjointed plot, and inconsistent animation. Some appreciate the world-building and character interactions, while others find the characters underdeveloped and the storyline confusing. Overall, it's considered an average cyberpunk anime with potential that wasn't fully realized.
pros: Good cyberpunk atmosphere.
Interesting characters and their interactions.
Excellent soundtrack that fits the dark atmosphere.
High rewatchability due to only having 3 episodes.
Mature themes explored.
cons: Derivative story that borrows heavily from other cyberpunk films.
Inconsistent animation quality, particularly in later episodes.
Disjointed and confusing plot with plot incongruences.
Underdeveloped characters and storylines.
Ending doesn't wrap everything up on a strong note.

anime.title: New Fist of the North Star
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Martial Arts, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic Earth, the water has become entirely toxic, except for some kept safe in a reservoir. A fortified zone has been created by a man named Sanga, he calls it The Lastland. A group of villagers have discovered safe water, and Sanga wants it. He and his band of killers go to kill everyone and steal it. As they do a mysterious man appears out of nowhere, instantly killing some of Sanga's men. His name is Kenshiro, and he can beat any man with his martial art, Hokuto Shin Ken. Sanga will do anything for the water, and Kenshiro will do anything to try and stop him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with strong criticism directed at the poor integration of 3D animation and a perceived decline in story and character quality compared to the original 'Fist of the North Star.' While some appreciate the updated visuals and increased gore, many feel the remake fails to capture the essence of what made the original series compelling. The series is mainly recommended for die-hard fans who can overlook its flaws.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to the original series (excluding 3D elements).
Gore and action are well-detailed and satisfying for fans of the genre.
Some find the darker, grimmer atmosphere to be a positive aspect.
cons: Poorly integrated 3D animation clashes with the 2D art style.
Weak or rushed story and character development compared to the original series.
Music and sound design are considered uninspired or ill-fitting.
The plot relies on tired tropes and cliches

anime.title: Final Fantasy: The Spirits Within
anime.synopsis:
The year is 2065, and the planet of Earth is far removed from the place that it was in the past. Deadly alien creatures known as Phantoms have appeared all over the planet, and mere contact with these entities is lethal, whether it be an instant death or a prolonged decline. In order to try and salvage what little of the human race is left, large force-field barriers have been constructed around certain cities to repel the Phantoms.

Seeking a more permanent solution to this invasion are scientists Aki Ross and her mentor, Dr. Sid, whose investigations have revealed that there exists a form of spiritual, Gaia energy that can eradicate the Phantom's presence from this world. Aki and Sid aren't alone in their quest through Final Fantasy: The Spirits Within; the human council and the military squad "Deep Eyes" are ready to help. Not everyone is convinced of this plan though.

Aki, Sid, Grey, and their allies have to band together against forces both alien and human if they are to have any chance at restoring peace to Earth. An enemy whose mere touch is fatal, the Phantoms appear the more dangerous enemy, but as they will come to find out, their human nemeses are also not to be trifled with.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Final Fantasy: The Spirits Within' is mixed. While praised for its visuals, voice acting, and pacing, the film is criticized for its derivative plot, generic characters, and weak ties to the Final Fantasy franchise. Many feel it's a decent sci-fi movie if viewed independently, but a disappointment when compared to the games.
pros: Groundbreaking animation for its time with realistic character models and detailed environments.
Well-matched music score and sound effects that enhance the atmosphere.
Strong voice acting, particularly with the involvement of well-known actors.
Pacing of the movie keeps it engaging, preventing it from becoming too slow or preachy.
cons: Story is unoriginal and clichéd, borrowing elements from other sci-fi and fantasy narratives.
Characters are generic and lack depth, with many feeling like stock characters.
Plot contains inconsistencies and contrivances, particularly in the climax and resolution.
Lacks a strong connection to the Final Fantasy game series, disappointing fans of the franchise.
Film's ambition may have exceeded its grasp, resulting in a narrative that feels incomplete or rushed.

anime.title: Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie
anime.synopsis:
Get your quarters ready, because the world's top fighters are about to go head to head in this explosive animated adaptation of the classic Street Fighter II arcade game! M. Bison's plan to crush those who would oppose his organization, Shadowloo, is simple: brainwash the strongest martial artists around with his dreaded psycho power, and turn them into living weapons! To stop him, Interpol agent Chun-Li must team up with Major Guile of the United States Air Force, but that's no small feat.

They'll have to put aside their differences and learn to work together, and fast. Bison is closing in on Ryu, a traveling vagabond said to be the best fighter in the world. Fortunately (or not), Ryu is a hard man to find, but the same can't be said of his eternal rival, Ken. And it might just be through Ken that Bison will get what he wants! Can the World Warriors beat Bison to the punch?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus points to a highly enjoyable and faithful adaptation for fans of the Street Fighter II games, primarily due to its stellar action sequences and accurate character portrayals. However, the film is widely criticized for its thin plot, lack of character development beyond the core cast, and reliance on fan service, which alienates viewers unfamiliar with the source material.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material, capturing the essence of the Street Fighter II game.
Exceptional and fluid fight choreography, often incorporating iconic special moves from the game.
Strong character designs that closely resemble their video game counterparts.
High-quality animation and art style, particularly during action sequences.
Excellent voice acting (in both English and Japanese versions) that captures character personalities.
Soundtrack is generally praised, with specific mentions of impactful American rock bands in the English dub.
Good pacing in action-heavy scenes, making the fights engaging and well-worth watching.
cons: Weak and generic plot, often serving as a mere excuse for fight scenes.
Lack of character development and shallow storytelling for non-main characters.
Too many characters are included, leading to brief, unmemorable appearances and a feeling of fan service over substance.
Some scenes are considered gratuitous or uncomfortable (e.g., Chun-Li's shower scene).
Dialogue can be cheesy at times.
For non-fans of the franchise, the movie offers little emotional connection or understanding of the characters.

anime.title: Case Closed Movie 04: Captured In Her Eyes
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 04: Hitomi no Naka no Ansatsusha
anime.synopsis:
On a rainy afternoon, the Detective Boys witness a murder across the street. Barred by traffic, the culprit slips away and Conan Edogawa is left a single clue by a dying detective. Days later, another detective is found murdered in a parking lot, leaving the police rattled. Suspicious that the culprit is one of their own, everyone in the police department without an alibi is suspect. But despite being on high alert, they are outmaneuvered and suffer yet another attack—this time with Ran Mouri finding herself in the crossfire.

Traumatized, Ran wakes in the hospital with retrograde amnesia, remembering nothing about her life. Soon released, she struggles to remember her past and grows fearful of not regaining her memories before being targeted by the killer for what she witnessed. As she is guarded by friends and family, it is up to Conan to piece together the clues and find who the murderer is before they strike again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the movie's emotional depth, character development (especially Ran), and animation quality. While some found the mystery less compelling or the pacing slow, the strong focus on character relationships and dramatic tension resonated well with viewers. The movie is considered a classic and a highlight in the Detective Conan film series.
pros: Great characterization, especially Ran's development and resilience.
Strong emotional moments and focus on relationships.
Excellent animation and art style, particularly in the Tropical Land finale.
Suspenseful and engaging plot with a threatening villain.
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the beginning.
The mystery itself is not particularly interesting or complex.
Reliance on Japanese wordplay might be difficult for some viewers.
Some found the Detective League parts not to their liking

anime.title: Case Closed Movie 05: Countdown to Heaven
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 05: Tengoku e no Countdown
anime.synopsis:
Conan Edogawa, the Detective Boys, and Professor Hiroshi Agasa decide to visit the Nishitamashi Twin Towers. There they run into Ran Mouri; her closest friend, Sonoko Suzuki; and Ran's father, the famous Kogorou. Learning the trio are attending the towers' grand opening, Conan and company tag along for a private tour of its floors.

However, as preparations are finalized for the opening ceremony, their visit takes an unexpected turn—three brutal murders occur, seemingly linked to a mysterious Porsche 356A. Soon after, as Conan and the detectives dive deeper into the case, the towers are rocked by an explosion. With fire rapidly spreading and lives in danger, police desperately seek to evacuate everyone. But when the elevator, their only means to escape goes down, Conan and company are left behind. With help on its way, they frantically try to keep everyone safe, but time is running out if they want to bring the perpetrators to justice.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is highly regarded, particularly for its character interactions, engaging plot twists, and exciting action sequences. While some find minor flaws in the story's reasoning or the dated animation, the overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive. Many fans consider it one of the best Detective Conan movies, praising its nostalgic feel and dramatic delivery.
pros: Great character moments for the main cast, especially Conan, Ran, and Haibara.
Well-told story with engaging twists and a satisfying conclusion.
Impactful action scenes and dramatic elements enhance the viewing experience.
Strong animation and score, working well together.
cons: Some find the reasons for the murders far-fetched.
New characters lack significant development.
Dark scenes in the latter part of the film diminish the visual impact.
Animation may appear outdated to some viewers.

anime.title: Case Closed Movie 06: The Phantom of Baker Street
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 06: Baker Street no Bourei
anime.synopsis:
The latest innovation in virtual reality gaming is set for a private showcase, with the children of Japan's elite given the opportunity to playtest it. Unfortunately, their carefree fun is cut short when a company employee is found murdered, his dying message pointing to a clue hidden within the game's historical setting.

Along with the Detective Boys and Ran Mouri, Conan Edogawa enters the game to solve this mystery and ensure the perpetrator is caught. But once they load in, an artificial intelligence named Noah's Ark imprisons them and the other children within. To escape and bring the murderer to justice, Conan and company must navigate a simulated 19th-century London and track down the infamous Jack the Ripper—with the lives of 50 innocent children depending on them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some considering it one of the best Conan movies due to its engaging VR concept and Sherlock Holmes integration. However, others find the plot predictable and lacking suspense. Criticisms also focus on contrived plot elements and underdeveloped characters, leading to a somewhat overrated status despite its strengths.
pros: Interesting virtual reality concept set in London.
Good implementation of Arthur Conan Doyle's fiction and Sherlock Holmes.
Exciting story with in-game and real-life culprits.
cons: Predictable culprit and not extremely complicated mystery.
Lack of suspense and tension in life-threatening situations.
Plot contains ass-pulls and requires too much suspension of disbelief.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 07: Crossroad in the Ancient Capital
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 07: Meikyuu no Crossroad
anime.synopsis:
Under the cover of darkness, a masked samurai murders five men across the metropolis of Japan: three in Tokyo, one in Osaka, and the last in Kyoto. In their investigation, the police learn that each man was a member of the Genjibotaru—a thieves gang centered on the theft of Buddhist statues and artifacts and who go by the names of Minomoto no Yoshitune's servants.
 
Without a clear motive or clues to the other members' identities, the case runs dry until a Kyoto temple calls for the famous Kogorou Mouri. Having received an anonymous letter containing a peculiar puzzle, the temple monks ask for his assistance in solving it to recover their long lost statue. Meanwhile, Conan Edogawa and high school detective Heiji Hattori team up in order to solve the cryptic puzzle and find the murderer, as Hattori searches for his childhood love.
 
With Hattori's knowledge of Kyoto, the two scour the streets and gradually discover the truth, but not before the murderer strikes again—killing another Genjibotaru member and, after repeated attempts on Hattori's life, eventually kidnapping Hattori's childhood sweetheart. It is only by working together to bring buried clues to light can Conan and Hattori hope to end the rogue samurai's bloodshed and save Hattori's love.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the movie, particularly its focus on Japanese culture and the prominence of Heiji and Kazuha. However, some find the pacing slow and the lack of high stakes disappointing compared to other Detective Conan movies. The film is appreciated for its solid mystery and cultural elements, though the reliance on Japanese wordplay may alienate some viewers.
pros: Good plot and engaging mystery.
Showcases Japanese culture, history, and places of interest.
Strong connection to Kyoto and traditional Japanese elements.
Features the popular characters Heiji and Kazuha prominently.
Solid case with a culturally relevant code.
Good introduction to Kyoto for viewers.
Enjoyable for Detective Conan fans.
cons: Feels more like a 2-hour special episode than a movie.
Lacks high stakes and drastic events typical of Conan movies.
Action sequences are lacking compared to previous movies.
Slow pacing, particularly in setting up the case.
Reliance on Japanese wordplay may exclude some viewers.
May feel drawn out or boring to some viewers.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 08: Magician of the Silver Sky
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 08: Ginyoku no Magician
anime.synopsis:
After receiving a letter from the thief Kaitou Kid, famous actress Juri Maki seeks the help of private detective Kogorou Mouri to protect the Star Sapphire—the "Jewel of Destiny," said to represent faith, fate, and hope. Thinking he has deciphered Kid's riddle, Kogorou personally shows up to the newly constructed space theater where Juri is acting in the play "Josephine" in order to catch Kid in the act.
 
The next day, Conan and the gang are invited by Juri to her holiday home, to celebrate the thwarting of Kid's plan and the success of the play. However, their triumph crumbles when a murder occurs during the flight there. Although unintentional, this sets off a series of events that escalate to catastrophic results. Conan and Kid, unlikely allies that they are, must work together to save both their friends and every other passenger aboard the plane.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Magician of the Silver Sky' is considered a good Detective Conan movie, particularly praised for its engaging story and improved animation. While some find the later parts weaker than the beginning and the mystery less emphasized, the unexpected plot and action sequences are generally well-received. The film is considered enjoyable, especially for fans seeking a slightly different experience from the typical Detective Conan format.
pros: Interesting story structure combining different scenarios.
Improved art and animation compared to previous movies.
Exciting and enthralling sequences, especially in the first half.
Classic soundtracks that enhance the scenes.
Unexpected plot twists and a mix of genres.
cons: The first part of the movie is better than the rest, making the other parts feel weaker.
Kaito Kid's disguises as Shinichi are overused.
The mystery aspect is overshadowed by the action in the plane.
Predictable culprit.
Some scenes felt unnecessary and added to lengthen the movie.

anime.title: Detective Conan OVA 01: Conan VS KID VS Yaiba
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan OVA 01: Conan vs. Kid vs. Yaiba - Houtou Soudatsu Daikessen!!
anime.synopsis: Mitsuhiko Tsuburaya lends Conan Edogawa a massive amount of manga, which Conan starts reading, despite the overwhelming quantity. Elsewhere, Kogorou Mouri is asked by the Mine family to protect the treasured sword in their dojo, as Kaitou Kid has sent a note of his intent to steal it. Upon arriving at the dojo, Conan and the others meet Yaiba Kurogane. Together, they aim to thwart the phantom thief's plans. However, Conan begins to notice something strange about the case.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is considered a one-time watch due to its weak story and plot holes, despite the enjoyable humor and typical Detective Conan art style. The crossover element with Yaiba is not particularly well-received. Overall, it's a lighthearted but forgettable addition to the Detective Conan franchise.
pros: Typical Detective Conan art and music.
Well-done and thought-out characters.
Enjoyable humor.
cons: Weak story.
Plot holes.
Difficult to focus on.

anime.title: Mt. Head
anime.genres: Avant Garde, Award Winning, Comedy, Fantasy, Psychological, Suspense
anime.synopsis: After a stingy man eats some cherry seeds, a cherry tree grows on his head and he gets into a lot of trouble.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the film's artistic and creative elements, praising its unique visual style and incorporation of traditional Japanese storytelling methods. Some find the plot confusing and the allegorical nature difficult to fully grasp. However, most viewers acknowledge the film's thought-provoking themes and its overall artistic merit, making it a worthwhile, albeit potentially perplexing, viewing experience.
pros: Unique art style and animation
Creative storytelling through traditional Japanese narrative techniques (rakugo, rōkyoku)
Thought-provoking themes about greed, environmentalism, and human nature
Excellent voice acting and musical score, particularly the shamisen music
cons: Plot can be confusing and difficult to understand
Abstract art style may not appeal to all viewers
Ending may feel unsatisfying or unclear

anime.title: Phoenix
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Historical, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
From prehistoric times to the distant future, Hi no Tori portrays how the legendary immortal bird Phoenix acts as a witness and chronicler for the history of mankind's endless struggle in search of power, justice, and freedom.

1. Reimei-hen (Dawn)
2. Fukkatsu-hen (Resurrection)
3. Igyou-hen (Transformation)
4. Taiyou-hen (The Sun)
5. Mirai-hen (Future)
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Hi no Tori is well-regarded for its philosophical themes and thought-provoking narrative, though some find the anime adaptation incomplete compared to the manga. While praised for its artistic style and music, some find the visuals dated and the storytelling rushed in parts. Despite some shortcomings, the series is appreciated for its depth and exploration of complex themes related to life, death, and humanity.
pros: The story is emotionally and intellectually stimulating, raising questions about life and its value.
The animation is fluid and the music enhances the story.
The series presents thought-provoking themes about humanity, history, and the search for immortality.
cons: Only covers a portion of the manga's stories, which weakens the overall unity.
Some character designs are dated and recycled.
The latter half of the series felt rushed, with liberties taken with the source material.

anime.title: You're Under Arrest (1996)
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Comedy, Seinen, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Tokyo Highway Patrolwomen Natsumi and Miyuki get off to a bad start when Miyuki busts Natsumi for reckless moped driving on her way to work. Things get worse when they find out they're going to be partners!

A continuation of the OVA series, the adventures of Tokyo policewomen Natsumi and Miyuki continue in the You're Under Arrest TV series. It's back to Bokuto Precinct, where demented felons and bashful (but hunky) policemen abound, and where the cutest girl in the office... isn't a girl.
anime.consensus_summary: Viewers express strong affection for 'You're Under Arrest!', praising its heartwarming character interactions, catchy music, and blend of slice-of-life and action. While some acknowledge minor flaws like occasional corniness or filler episodes, the overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, with many highlighting the show's nostalgic charm and well-developed characters. The series is considered an underrated gem, particularly appealing to fans of character-driven stories and classic anime.
pros: Well-developed and likable characters with depth and unique personalities
Heartwarming and uplifting themes of love, friendship, and action
Catchy and nostalgic 90s jazz soundtrack that complements the setting
Good balance between daily life and police work
Detailed and recognizable vehicle designs
Strong character development, even for minor characters
cons: Occasional leaps of logic and corny episodes
Some filler episodes for comic relief
Animation quality not as great as the OVA

anime.title: Black Jack Specials: Inochi wo Meguru Yottsu no Kiseki
anime.romaji_title: Black Jack Specials: Inochi wo Meguru Yottsu no Kiseki
anime.synopsis: Black Jack is the "Surgeon with the Hands of God," a mysterious young Japanese doctor who travels the world performing feats of miraculous surgical genius. Though all recognize his skill, Black Jack is widely hated, especially by the medical establishment, because he refuses to conform to rules of any kind, and because he charges outrageous fees for his services. Black Jack's only companion is Pinoko, a child he created out of a special kind of tumor called a teratoma, who insists she is his wife.
anime.consensus_summary: The Black Jack specials serve as a palatable entry point to the franchise, particularly for those sensitive to surgical gore or daunted by the length of previous series. While not exceptional on their own, they provide a lighter-toned exploration of Black Jack's world and backstory. They are most suitable for newcomers testing the waters or dedicated fans seeking more content.
pros: Decent introduction to the world of Black Jack
Lighter tone than the 1993 series
Good for viewers who want medical anime without excessive gore
cons: Not fantastic by themselves
Only recommended for newcomers or hardcore Black Jack fans
anime.thematic_vibe: Medical Mystery, Surgical Drama, Character Backstory

anime.title: Guyver: The Bioboosted Armor
anime.genres: Action, Gore, Horror, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Sho Fukamachi, a normal teenager accidentally found an alien object called Unit and thus, changed his life forever. The Unit bonded with Sho, resulting in an incredibly powerful life-form called Guyver. With this great power, Sho battles the mysterious Chronos organization and it's Zoanoids, in order to protect his friends and his world. Unknown to Sho, the battle against Chronos will lead to the discovery of the origins of human, their destiny, and the Creators...
anime.consensus_summary: The 2005 Guyver series is a generally well-received remake, praised for its improved animation, character development, and expansion of the original story. Some viewers find it generic or were disappointed by the ending and inconsistent animation quality. While some prefer the older OVA's style, the new series is considered a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre.
pros: Improved animation and sound compared to the original OVA.
Well-paced story with excellent character development and utilization.
Engaging plot with unique elements despite similarities to other series.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality in some episodes.
The ending feels rushed and leaves many plot points unresolved.
Some find the series generic and cliched.

anime.title: My Daddy Long Legs
anime.synopsis: Daddy Long Legs is based on the novel of the same name by Jean Webster. It chronicles the adventures of Judy Abbott, an orphan in New York. During a meeting for the superintendent, with other important and rich people in attendance, a scholarship is offered to Judy by a mysterious benefactor. Catching only a glimpse of his tall shadow as he leaves, Judy calls him "Daddy Long Legs" and writes him letters every month as per his request. While studying at the Lincoln Memorial school, she makes many friends and learns about a world she never knew about before.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally appreciate 'Watashi no Ashinaga Ojisan' as a charming and endearing coming-of-age story set in early 20th century America. Viewers praise the character development, animation style, and historical accuracy, though some find the beginning slow or certain characters unrealistic. Overall, it's considered a heartwarming and memorable anime, especially for fans of the original novel.
pros: Characters have depth and are far from one-dimensional
Animation is very good, showing a very early late eighties to early nineties style with beautiful frame-by-frame hand-drawn characters and watercolour backgrounds
Accurate depiction of the educated female experience in 1910s-1920s America
Expressive character animation, especially Judy
Faithful adaptation (with some differences) of the novel
cons: Judy can be a little obnoxious at the beginning of the series
Story gets really good only around episode 25
Some characters are far from realistic
Story can become slightly boring and predictable

anime.title: Ojamajo Doremi Na-i-sho
anime.synopsis: Na-i-sho is a 13 episode OAV series detailing the summer between the ~motto~ and the Dokkaan season. It is a bit more mature than the TV seasons, and looks to develop each of the five witches romantically. Hana is back to a baby, and the mahou shop is a bakery.
anime.consensus_summary: The Ojamajo Doremi Na-i-sho OVA series is viewed positively as a mature and well-executed addition to the franchise. It is praised for its character development, subtle handling of mature themes, and improved production quality. While some episodes may be weaker than others, the series is generally considered a worthwhile complement to the main series, offering a balance of innocence and maturity that appeals to a wide audience.
pros: Mature themes handled with grace and subtlety.
Excellent character development, particularly for side characters.
OVA format allowed for better animation and music.
Serves as a good complement to the main series, exploring previously untouched themes.
Realistic in showing and dealing with problems.
Balances innocence and maturity well, appealing to both younger and older viewers.
cons: Some episodes are of mediocre or subpar quality.
May not be necessary for the series' overall success.

anime.title: Space Symphonic Poem Maetel: Galaxy Express 999 Side Story
anime.romaji_title: Uchuu Koukyoushi Maetel: Ginga Tetsudou 999 Gaiden
anime.synopsis: Maetel abandoned her mother and her home planet, the doomed and frozen La Metal, where people must become cyborgs to survive. When she is beckoned to return, her options seem slim: follow her mother's path (and with it a robot mind and the contempt of all humans), or run away and fight with humans against the machines. Yet, she is not without comrades and defenders. If she can accept the friendship of beings of metal who desire peace, and oppose those who think being made of flesh and blood is enough to make one human, she may still have a chance to find her own path.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding it a worthy addition to the Leijiverse, while others criticize the writing and CG. The show seems to evoke nostalgia for the original Galaxy Express 999, but falls short in execution for some viewers. The use of familiar plot devices is seen as both a positive and a negative, depending on the viewer's tolerance for repetition.
pros: Faithful to Leijiverse lore
Good cell animation (on par with GE999 films)
Message actually makes sense
cons: Awful CG
Tastelessly bright and contrast colors
Abysmal writing and scripting
Repetitive/uninspired plot elements (Death Star)

anime.title: Kino's Journey: In Order to Do Something - Life Goes On
anime.romaji_title: Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World - Nanika wo Suru Tame ni - Life Goes On.
anime.synopsis:
After running away from the grim future that awaited her back in her home country, a young girl takes upon a new name and identity—inspired by the man who sacrificed his life to help her escape. Alongside her newfound companion, a talking motorcycle, the two find themselves a new home in the forest—where lives an elderly woman with an expertise in guns. Under the woman's care, the girl is trained in marksmanship and motorcycle handling among other various skills needed to survive.

Although the girl is happy with her current life, her guilt regarding her savior's death continues to build within herself. She still feels responsible for her savior's death, and considers the consequences of using his name as her own. In doing so, she is denying her own identity and existence by trying to replicate another person's life, instead of living her own.

Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World - Nanika wo Suru Tame ni - Life Goes On. follows the journey of a young girl as she begins to come to terms with her new identity.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a welcome addition for fans, offering more insight into Kino's past and training. However, some find it unnecessary and lacking the depth of the original series, feeling it doesn't add much to the overall narrative. While enjoyable, it may not appeal to those seeking the philosophical themes prevalent in Kino's Journey.
pros: Good origin story for Kino, explaining her skills and backstory.
Expands on important secondary characters like Shishou.
Consistent with the original series' style and tone.
Addresses Kino's guilt and identity issues effectively.
Well-integrated philosophy without interfering with pacing
cons: Unnecessary prequel, as the original series already provided sufficient backstory.
Lacks the philosophical depth and exploration of societal issues found in the main series.
Too short, feeling more like an extended episode than a full movie.
Some find the gender presentation inconsistent with the main series.

anime.title: Blue Gender: The Warrior
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Gore, Horror, Mecha, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis: It is a time of chaos. Earth is no longer what it used to be. It has been infested with a bug like species called the Blue. 20 years ago Yuji Kaido, who has a mysterious disease, is put into suspended animation until a cure is found. When he wakes up Yuji learns that it’s been more than 20 years since he was put into suspended animation, and the world is now controlled by these creatures. He then decides to join a group of soldiers fighting against the Blue for hope of a better future.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Blue Gender: The Warrior' is a poorly executed condensation of the original series. Viewers feel that the movie rushes the plot, fails to properly develop the characters, and ultimately diminishes the impact of the original story. Most recommend watching the series instead of the movie.
pros: Some interesting scenes were added, like the brawl between Marlene and Yuji.
Details like Yuji's long hair after waking up from suspended animation are appreciated.
cons: Rushed and mediocre adaptation of the series.
Poorly paced character development.
Important plot arcs and characters are missing or underdeveloped.
Reused animation from the series is used out of context.

anime.title: Seikai no Monshou Special
anime.synopsis: A compilation of the Seikai no Monshou series with additional footage.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Seikai no Monshou Special' is viewed as a simple recap that's helpful for refreshing memories before watching the sequel. However, the chaotic editing and lack of new content make it a poor substitute for the original series. It's primarily recommended for completionists or dedicated fans wanting a quick refresher and some minor additional scenes.
pros: Good for refreshing memory of key elements before watching the sequel.
Additional minor scenes with Jinto and Lafiel.
Video quality is the same as the original series.
cons: Chaotic and sudden cut scenes disrupt the flow.
Doesn't feel like a movie.
Lacks extra narration or reanimated scenes.

anime.title: GaoGaiGar Final
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Mecha, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Following Gutsy Galaxy Guard's victory over the Zonder Empire and the 31 Primevals, a new threat makes their appearance on Earth. GGG—with Guy Shishio and the newly-constructed GaoFighGar—team up with their French counterpart Chasseur to battle the evil organization BioNet. Among Chasseur's ranks is Renais Cardiff Shishioh, a former BioNet cyborg with the relentless pursuit of destroying those who took away her humanity. But as GGG and Chasseur fight the BioNet, GGG's bases around the world are suddenly attacked, and the recently-discovered "Q-Parts" and the original Gao Machines are stolen by Mamoru Amami, who has been abducted and cloned by an even greater threat known as the "Eleven Kings of Sol." Evicted from Earth by the United Nations, GGG must now travel to the far reaches of the galaxy to battle the Eleven Kings of Sol and save Mamoru before it's too late.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many appreciating the improved visuals and action while criticizing the overabundance of fanservice and less compelling villains compared to the original series. Some feel the OVA fails to capture the charm of the original, while others find it a satisfying conclusion. The new characters introduced are not universally well-received, and the increased focus on mature themes detracts from the show's overall quality for some viewers.
pros: Improved animation and art style compared to the original series.
Exciting and never-ending action sequences.
Satisfying conclusion to the GaoGaiGar story.
cons: Overreliance on fan service and unnecessary nudity.
Villains are not as compelling or charming as those in the original series.
Plot predictability and lack of genuine stakes in some instances.
New characters are not as well-developed or likable as the original cast.

anime.title: Future GPX Cyber Formula
anime.synopsis: 14-year-old Kazami Hayato is the youngest driver of Cyber Formula, a Grand Prix in which each vehicle is equipped with computers to aid in racing. With the help of Asurada, the most advanced cybernavigation system, and team Sugo, Hayato races to become the winner of the 10th Cyber Formula Grand Prix. Along the way, Hayato will have to learn what it truly means to be a racer and that victory cannot be achieved simply by driving the best machine. In addition, Kazami will have to gain the respect of the veteran racers, thwart those who attempt to steal Asurada, and participate in races outside of Cyber Formula.
anime.consensus_summary: Cyber Formula is a well-regarded older anime that blends sports and science fiction with engaging characters and dramatic racing sequences. While the animation shows its age, the strong characters, memorable soundtrack, and unique racing concepts contribute to a positive viewing experience. The series evokes nostalgia and is considered a fun and heartwarming watch, particularly for fans of sports and mecha genres.
pros: Engaging racing sequences with unique obstacles and strategic elements.
Well-developed characters with relatable traits and significant growth.
Memorable soundtrack that enhances emotional moments.
Creative and believable mecha designs by Shoji Kawamori.
cons: Dated animation quality with inconsistencies in coloring and shading.
Filler episodes can be less engaging.

anime.title: Macross 7
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Mecha, Military, Music, Romance, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
35 years have passed since Lynn Minmay had brought peace between the Zentradi and the humans in the events of Macross. Nekki Basara is a guitarist and a singer of the band Fire Bomber. Living in a less-developed part of the flying colony City 7 which is looking for a habitable planet, he composes and sings songs in the belief that music holds a greater power.

During its flight, an unknown alien race appeared and started laying siege upon City 7. However, its attacks are not conventional -- instead of trying to destroy them, they steal what is known as "spiritia", rendering victims unresponsive and zombie-like. During these battles, Basara always goes out into the middle of the warzone, singing his songs and expecting friend and foe to listen and be moved by his music.
anime.consensus_summary: Macross 7 is a highly divisive installment in the Macross franchise, with strong opinions on both sides. While some viewers appreciate its focus on music, character development, and unique themes, others are turned off by the repetitive animation, unlikeable main character, and simplistic plot. The show's experimental nature and departure from traditional Macross elements contribute to its polarizing reception, resulting in a love-it-or-hate-it experience.
pros: Enjoyable music that integrates well with the story.
Focus on character development and relationships.
Unique and memorable characters with distinct quirks.
Subversion of typical Macross plot formulas.
Positive message of understanding and acceptance.
Experimental approach that defies expectations.
cons: Repetitive use of stock footage and animation.
Limited animation budget and dated visuals.
Repetitive music and song cycles.
Shallow and unlikeable main character (Basara) for some viewers.
Slow pacing, especially in the early episodes.
Over-reliance on 'power of music' plot device.
Filler content and stretched storyline.
Simplistic story aimed at a younger audience.

anime.title: IGPX: Immortal Grand Prix
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2035, Team Suzaku and Team Sledge Mamma are preparing to meet in the final round of the 12th Immortal Grand-1 Prix (IG1 or IGPX). Takeshi leads Team Suzaku, which is made up of a group of young amateur pilots who must make the most of their limited funds and weaponry in order to prepare for the competition designed for professionals.

This series served as the pilot to the full IGPX: Immortal Grand Prix, each episode is only 5 minutes long or less. A key difference between the two is that this series featured combat mecha competition rather than racing mecha.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience deeply appreciates the original micro-series for its engaging characters and combat-focused premise, expressing strong nostalgia and disappointment that the full series deviated so drastically. There's a longing for a true adaptation that continues the original story's potential.
