The short format is both a strength and a weakness, leaving viewers wanting more but also preventing full development.
pros: Strong proof of concept despite time constraints.
Memorable and unique characters.
Engaging story within a short timeframe.
cons: Micro-series format leaves the story incomplete.
Later adaptation significantly alters the original premise, leading to disappointment.
Limitations of being a short series.

anime.title: IGPX: Immortal Grand Prix Season 2
anime.synopsis: Team Satomi has just been deemed as the winners for the IG-2 lower league and now join the top IG-1 competition. But it's not going to be easy. Young pilots Takeshi, Liz, Amy, and River are going to have to be a team to be number 1, however one thing leads to another with these four. Most important of all, their opponents overwhelm Team Satomi in every aspect, including strategy and skill, as well as funding. One thing is for sure, this is not going to be an easy year for "Team Satomi."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views IGPX 2nd Season positively, considering it an improvement over the first. They appreciate the focus on teamwork, character development, and the blend of action with well-executed art and music. Some note minor flaws in animation quality, but the overall sentiment is one of enjoyment and high regard for the series' ability to create an engaging and thrilling experience.
pros: Improved story with focus on entire team
Well-paced tension and character development
Beautiful art and good 3D animation for its time
Great soundtrack blending hip-hop and orchestral music
cons: Animation can be lazy and not well done at times
3D animation can be choppy and awkward at times

anime.title: Lupin III: Angel Tactics
anime.romaji_title: Lupin III: Tenshi no Tactics - Yume no Kakera wa Koroshi no Kaori
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Stolen from the famous "secret" Air Force base, Area 51, Lupin's most recently stolen treasure holds a secret. Four "Bloody Angels," the toughest women Lupin has ever faced, want the treasure for their own terrorist purposes. Meanwhile Zenigata teams up with a female police officer to hunt Lupin and the terrorists down.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are polarized. Some praise the classic Lupin elements like the action, comedy, and character dynamics, along with the animation and music. However, others strongly criticize the villain design, jarring tonal shifts with gore, and overall story quality, leading to a divisive reception.
pros: Engaging story with nice twists
Classic cast in top form with fun dynamic
Great comedy, cool action, and solid drama
Terrific animation and a very cool jazz soundtrack
cons: Badly designed villain cast with appalling motivation and voice acting
Random gore and death scenes feel out of place
Story is an abomination, like eating a chocolate cake with rat poison

anime.title: Lupin III Episode 0: The First Contact
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Jigen tells the story of the gang's first meeting. Jigen, still a member of the Mafia, is hired to protect an ancient artifact - one that Lupin and Fujiko are both trying to steal. Meanwhile, Inspector Zenigata, then of the Japanese police force, has come to the U.S. on Fujiko's trail, and Ishikawa Goemon is searching for the lost treasure of his clan.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed 'Lupin III: Episode 0', praising the character interactions, action, and artwork. Some viewers noted minor contradictions with established lore and a slightly out-of-place setting, but these were largely forgiven.  The special is considered a great watch for both Lupin fans and newcomers.
pros: Enjoyable interactions between characters, especially Lupin and Jigen.
Excellent action sequences and artwork.
Good insight into the origins and motivations of Zenigata.
Faithful portrayal of characters and their interactions.
Great music and voice acting.
cons: Contradictions with previous episodes/series regarding character origins.
New York setting feels somewhat inappropriate.
Story may not be entirely accurate regarding character meetings.

anime.title: Lupin III: Missed by a Dollar
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Lupin & co. compete with a greedy bank president and her goons to solve the mystery leading to a broach, a treasure said to be behind the success of history's most powerful rulers.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience seems to enjoy 'Lupin III: $1 Money Wars' for its wacky humor, action sequences, and suspenseful soundtrack. Some find the plot inconsistent, particularly the middle section, and criticize certain character designs. However, the positive aspects, like the dialogue and villain, outweigh the negatives for most viewers.
pros: Snappy dialogue between Lupin and Jigen.
Fujiko's action sequences are a highlight.
Zenigata's emotional outbursts are hilarious.
Soundtrack is suspenseful and cool.
Unique plot with Lupin fighting a business tycoon.
cons: Goemon's role is not particularly stand out.
Story drags after they leave NYC.
Hitler brooch plot is stupid.
Ugly character designs.

anime.title: Lupin III: Operation Return the Treasure
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: After robbing a Moscow casino right under Zenigata's nose, Lupin sets his sights on stealing the Trick Diamond. He and Jigen head to the estate of the recently deceased Mark Williams, another master thief who's had the diamond, as well as other treasures, in his possession for years. However, instead of finding the diamond, Lupin & Jigen find Fujiko, who tells them about Mark's dying wish - Lupin must return all the treasures the old thief stole to their rightful place. If this is done in time, the location of the diamond will be revealed, and Lupin can use it to get the real treasure, hidden in Gaudí's Sagrada Familia. Returning the stolen goods isn't easy though, as Zenigata and the casino boss' ruthless gang are on Lupin and friends' tail.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is generally well-received as a solid Lupin III entry. The inversion of the usual formula, where Lupin returns treasures, is a clever twist. The story is fun and engaging, although it does not reach the level of the best Lupin III movies.
pros: Clever inversion of the typical Lupin plot with returning treasures instead of stealing.
Good mix of comedy, crazy capers, and supernatural elements.
Seamless integration of Goemon into the story.
Memorable climax in Gaudí's Sagrada Familia with heart and mysticism.
cons: Doesn't quite reach the heights of First Contact or the Fuma Conspiracy

anime.title: Lupin III: Return of Pycal
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Lupin steals an extraordinary gem from a Mediterranean party, only to be interrupted by Pycal, the trickster "magician" who had apparently died fighting Lupin early in his career. Pycal, now armed with real magical abilities, is determined to take revenge.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative, viewing 'Return of Pycal' as an underwhelming and disappointing Lupin installment. Reviewers criticize the weak story, poor character development, and jarring use of CGI. While some appreciate the nostalgic callbacks to the original series and Fujiko's design, the overall impression is that the OVA fails to live up to the Lupin III name, feeling like a cash-grab with a rushed and incomplete ending.
pros: Flashy robbery opening is entertaining.
Callbacks to the first Lupin series are a nice touch, such as Lupin's green jacket and Fujiko's motorcycle animation.
Fujiko's character design is closer to the first series, and her seduction scene is a standout.
cons: The story is weak and doesn't blend well with the characters.
Characters feel out of place and lack intensity; relationships between characters are poorly developed.
The use of CGI is awful, and the editing is poor.
The ending feels abrupt and leaves questions unanswered, as if a third act is missing.
The soundtrack is just okay, lacking the usual Lupin charm.
Feels like a pointless cash-grab with wasted potential.

anime.title: Lupin III: Swallowtail Tattoo
anime.romaji_title: Lupin III: Nusumareta Lupin - Copycat wa Manatsu no Chou
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: In the middle of an airborne heist, Lupin goes from stealing to stolen as he's carted off and forced to do a job for a mysterious man identifiable only by the brand of cigarette he smokes. Lupin's mission: to steal the infamous "Bull's Eye", a small green jewel best-known for the fact that everyone who's ever stolen it has ended up dead. Along with the challenge of alternately evading and pursuing a young thief with a competitive streak, Lupin and the gang must unravel the mystery of the Bull's Eye before its curse - or their mysterious taskmaster - gets the better of them.
anime.consensus_summary: The Lupin III special is generally well-received as a fun and clever heist story, although some find the comedy jarring and the voice acting and character design inconsistent. The plot's surprises are a highlight, making it an entertaining experience despite its flaws. This particular installment seems to be a good entry point into the franchise for new viewers.
pros: Clever plot with unexpected twists.
Entertaining and well-blended mixture of styles.
Smooth animation.
cons: Out-of-place comedy.
Poor voice acting.
Inconsistent character designs (retro vs modern).

anime.title: Lupin III: The Castle of Cagliostro
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Award Winning, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Arsene Lupin III discovers that the spoils from his latest casino robbery are actually "Gothic Bills," legendary counterfeits that are nigh impossible to distinguish from genuine bills. Together with colleague Daisuke Jigen, he heads to the small nation of Cagliostro to investigate the origin of these counterfeits. Upon arrival, they save a girl from a high-speed chase who turns out to be Clarisse d' Cagliostro, the daughter of the late Duke d' Cagliostro. She is running from a sinister plot by Count Cagliostro to steal her family's treasure through a forced marriage.

Natural flirt Lupin dislikes seeing a girl in distress and seeks to remedy the situation. Goemon Ishikawa XIII, Fujiko Mine, and Kouichi Zenigata also join the fray, each with their own motivations. As everyone converges at Cagliostro Castle, Lupin reminisces about his visit there 10 years ago, and the castle's secrets emerge from the depths.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience widely regards Cagliostro no Shiro as a beloved classic and a masterful directorial debut for Hayao Miyazaki. Praised for its charming characters, beautiful animation, and exciting action, it's seen as a perfect entry point into the Lupin III franchise. Minor criticisms focus on occasional dated animation and a perceived lack of deep character development for some figures, but these do not detract significantly from its overwhelmingly positive reception.
pros: Masterful animation and art direction, especially the detailed backgrounds.
Charming and well-developed characters with entertaining interactions.
Engaging and fast-paced storyline, suitable for both newcomers and fans.
Excellent musical score that enhances the mood and action.
Memorable action sequences, particularly the iconic car chase.
Miyazaki's directorial debut showcased strong storytelling and visual flair.
cons: Animation can appear choppy or dated at times.
Character development is somewhat static; personalities remain consistent throughout.
The damsel-in-distress trope with Clarisse can be perceived as underdeveloped or passive.
Plot holes and moments of disbelief, such as Clarisse not remembering Lupin.
Some find the film's pacing slow or its length excessive.
Occasional lazy animation choices, like using identical twins for henchmen.

anime.title: Reign: The Conqueror
anime.synopsis: In 356 BC, Alexander the Great arrives in Greece with the ominous destiny that he will become the "destroyer of the world." Inheriting the crown, he becomes king of the Macedonians and starts down a road of conquest with terrific speed. Alexander ultimately confronts his fated nemesis, Darius the Third, in a war with Persia which changes Alexander into the devil he was fated to become, assuring the destruction of all in his path, and possibly himself.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Alexander Senki is strongly divided. Some appreciate its unique art style, integration of philosophical themes, and unconventional narrative. However, many criticize its strange character designs, shallow plot, and subpar animation, leading to a love-it-or-hate-it experience.
pros: Excellent integration of metaphysical themes and ancient philosophical figures.
Unique art style that combines strange, technology-drenched architecture with angular faces.
Original storyline that writes itself like an ancient Greek odyssey.
The show does not shy away from taboo subjects.
cons: The art style is not very Japanese and somewhat reminiscent of Aeon Flux.
The plot is a series of pointless battles interwoven with pseudo-philosophical dialogue.
The characters are extremely flat and almost impossible to relate to.
Many of the major characters sport very revealing attire, giving the series somewhat of a homo-erotic feel.
The hand-drawn animation is mostly subpar with animation shortcuts.
The original opening song sports an upbeat, optimistic mood and lyrics that go against the intended mood this series wishes to give off.

anime.title: Brigadoon
anime.synopsis: Marin is a typical junior high school girl with a sunny disposition and a loving adoptive family. Her life takes a drastic change when a mysterious mirage is seen in the sky above the entire earth. Killer androids called Monomakia descend to earth from the formation in the sky called Brigadoon and begin to hunt down little Marin. She discovers a blue bottle in a shrine as she seeks escape and from the bottle comes a protector, a sword carrying gun slinging alien called Melan Blue, together they must save the earth and deal with family crisis, school prejudice and the police and come to an understanding of Marins past and Melans unexplained mission, as well as learn to trust each other. Set in 1969 Japan with a colorful cast of friends and enemies.
anime.consensus_summary: Brigadoon: Marin to Melan is a polarizing anime due to its unique blend of genres and unconventional storytelling. While praised for its originality and character development, it is criticized for its tonal inconsistencies and confusing plot. The series evokes a mix of nostalgia and melancholy, leaving viewers with mixed feelings about its overall execution.
pros: Original and imaginative story that defies genre conventions
Well-developed relationship between Marin and Melan with emotional depth
Strong voice acting and memorable soundtrack
cons: Inconsistent tone with jarring shifts between comedy and dark themes
Uneven pacing with monster-of-the-week episodes in the first half
Abrupt and convoluted plot developments with unresolved plot points

anime.title: Maison Ikkoku
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
In the town of Clock Hill, there is an old boarding house called Maison Ikkoku. While the residence itself is fairly normal, most of its occupants are not. Yuusaku Godai, its most quiet tenant, has finally reached his limit with his neighbors' constant disruptions and boisterous partying. Wanting a calmer place to call home so that he can study in peace, he prepares to move away.

However, his plans to leave are suddenly interrupted when he meets the new boarding house manager, Kyoko Otonashi. Falling madly in love with her, he decides that the boarding house may not be such a bad place to live after all. Unfortunately for him, Kyoko has her own romantic troubles: she is a widow whose husband died six months into their marriage. And despite her blossoming feelings for Godai, Kyoko still cherishes her dearly departed husband, and she believes that no other man could possibly fill the void in her heart. But with Godai's persistence and some help of the other eccentric tenants, she may experience true love once again.
anime.consensus_summary: Maison Ikkoku is widely praised as a masterpiece of romance and slice-of-life anime, celebrated for its mature themes, character development, and enduring humor. While its reliance on misunderstandings and lengthy runtime are noted drawbacks by some, the overwhelming sentiment is that its compelling narrative and deeply human characters make it a highly rewarding and unforgettable experience.
pros: Deep and realistic character development, particularly for the main leads Godai and Kyoko.
Mature and humanistic approach to love, life, and dealing with loss.
Exceptional humor that remains effective throughout its long run.
Satisfying and poignant ending that provides closure.
Realistic portrayal of everyday life struggles and relationships in the 1980s.
Engaging and often touching narrative that highlights human connection and growth.
High-quality soundtrack that enhances the atmosphere and emotional impact.
cons: Over-reliance on misunderstandings for plot progression, leading to frustration and repetition.
Pacing can be slow and repetitive, with characters sometimes regressing or making inexplicable decisions.
The long runtime (96 episodes) may be a deterrent for some viewers.
Dated art style and animation quality may not appeal to modern audiences.
Inconsistent characterization of minor characters over time.
Certain plot points, like the Kozue relationship, lack chemistry and feel underdeveloped.
Early episodes are perceived as weak or unengaging by some.

anime.title: Kemonozume
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Avant Garde, Gore, Horror, Mythology, Romance, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Creatures known as Shokujinki have been secretly living alongside humans for hundreds of years. Though they may look like humans, Shokujinki are able to transform into uncontrollable beasts with gigantic claws and consume humans to survive. The equally secretive Kifuuken dojo specializes in killing Shokujinki by cutting off their arms, and is the only force preventing unchecked Shokujinki domination.

Toshihiko Momota, the son of the leader of the Kifuuken, is instantly charmed by a mysterious woman named Yuka Kamitsuki. Their relationship is complicated, however, because unbeknownst to them both, Yuka is a Shokujinki and Toshihiko is sworn to kill her. Meanwhile, the Kifuuken is having a crisis of confidence as Toshihiko's brother Kazuma pushes against tradition and tries to modernize the Kifuuken. As emotions are strained and the secrets of both the past and present are revealed, who will live, and who will be eaten?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Kemonozume are divided, with strong praise for its artistic style, mature themes, and unique storytelling, contrasted by criticism of its inconsistent plot, reliance on shock value, and potentially off-putting visuals. While many appreciate its experimental approach and emotional depth, others find it pretentious and ultimately unsatisfying.  The series sparks debate due to its unconventional nature, making it a polarizing experience.
pros: Unique and experimental art style that stands out from typical anime.
Compelling love story with mature themes and complex characters.
Excellent jazz-infused soundtrack that complements the show's mood.
Intriguing plot twists and thought-provoking exploration of humanity and monstrosity.
cons: Inconsistent plot development and pacing issues in later episodes.
Overreliance on sex and nudity that detracts from the story.
Unconventional art style may not appeal to all viewers.
Underdeveloped secondary characters and confusing philosophical elements.

anime.title: Licensed by Royalty
anime.synopsis: Jack Hofner and Rowe Rikenbacker are Cloud 7's L/R. Their job is to protect the Royal family of Ishtar, their treasures, and their reputation. Jack & Rowe face one of the toughest missions of their career when they are assigned to protect Noelle, a candidate for the 15 Year Princesse contest. It starts out simple, but soon all of Cloud 7 are involved in a web of intrigue that includes bombings, corruption and murder.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many viewers finding the anime entertaining but flawed. While the catchy soundtrack, likeable main characters, and interesting mysteries in the early episodes are praised, the weak plot, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent art style are significant drawbacks. Many feel the series had potential but ultimately failed to deliver a consistently high-quality experience.
pros: Catchy and unique opening theme by Billy Preston.
Entertaining action scenes and humorous dialogue.
Smart mysteries and plot twists in early episodes.
Likeable main characters with good chemistry.
Good dubbing. Accents are distinctly British.
cons: Inconsistent plot with many holes and nonsensical elements.
Underdeveloped and generic characters with little depth.
Pale character designs with a lack of detail and emotion.
Repetitive sound stages and uninspired music in some scenes.
Story becomes less engaging in later episodes.

anime.title: Tekkaman Blade
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Mecha, Military, Romance, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis: Tekkaman Blade takes place in the year 2300 AD. On a certain moment, the Radam attack earth. A few months after the beginning of the invasion, a tekkaman appears, he calls himself Blade and with the help of the Space Knights, Blade starts to fight the radam. But there are a few things that Blade isn't telling about his past.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Uchuu no Kishi Tekkaman Blade is well-regarded for its character development, engaging story, and impressive animation for its time. While some criticize the pacing and animation inconsistencies, the series is generally praised for its emotional depth and action-packed narrative. Fans appreciate the dark storyline and the evolution of the characters, making it a memorable mecha anime.
pros: Strong character development, especially D-Boy's transformation
Top-notch art and animation for an early 90s anime
Compelling story with dark and gritty elements
Excellent voice acting
Memorable mecha designs and transformations
cons: Occasional inconsistent animation quality
Some recap episodes and slow pacing in the second half
One-dimensional villains
Dated animation may not appeal to some viewers

anime.title: Memories
anime.genres: Award Winning, Drama, Horror, Military, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Space, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Memories is a compilation of three standalone short films encompassing different genres.
 
Magnetic Rose
In the far reaches of space, after tracing a distress signal to a large abandoned space station, a pair of engineers—Heintz Beckner and Miguel Costrela—find a derelict mansion and decide to explore on foot. Their investigation reveals a dark secret surrounding the fate of Eva Friedel, a renowned opera singer with a tragic history. Hallucinations soon begin to plague them, and they must fight to retain their sanity in order to escape the station alive.
 
Stink Bomb
Hapless lab technician Nobuo Tanaka consumes some pills at his laboratory to cure a cold. Unknown to him, however, the pills are actually experimental drugs that enhance his flatulence to a lethal degree. As the toxic gas escaping him kills everyone in his vicinity, he is ordered by his superiors to retreat to the company headquarters in Tokyo. The journey to the city is made all the more arduous as Nobuo struggles with his deadly odor while the police, military, and foreign adversaries are hot on his trail.
 
Cannon Fodder
In a fortress city filled to the brim with cannons, a young boy wishes to surpass his father by becoming a revered artillery officer. Despite no proof of an enemy nation, he cannot resist the urge to partake in the daily bombardment routines organized by the city. Whether at school or just before bedtime, he only dreams of someday firing a cannon for the sake of his homeland.
anime.consensus_summary: Memories is a technically brilliant anthology with highly praised individual segments, particularly Magnetic Rose, yet it suffers from significant tonal and quality disparities between its shorts. While its artistic achievements and thematic depth in certain segments are widely lauded, the overall cohesion and the reception of Stink Bomb create a divided audience experience.
pros: Stunning and diverse animation styles that push the boundaries of the medium.
Exceptional musical scores, particularly Yoko Kanno's contributions, enhancing the atmosphere and emotional impact.
Thought-provoking narratives in Magnetic Rose and Cannon Fodder that explore complex themes of memory, isolation, and societal conformity.
Katsuhiro Otomo's distinct visual style and directorial prowess, especially in the technically impressive "one-take" of Cannon Fodder.
Satoshi Kon's masterful scriptwriting in Magnetic Rose, blending psychological thriller elements with profound emotional depth.
cons: Inconsistent quality across the three segments, with Stink Bomb often cited as a significant drop in quality.
Thematic disjointedness between the shorts, making the anthology feel less cohesive and potentially not living up to the 'Memories' title for some viewers.
Stink Bomb's humor and premise are divisive, with many finding the protagonist's idiocy frustrating rather than comedic.
Magnetic Rose, while praised, is sometimes criticized for predictable plot points or underdeveloped characters.
Cannon Fodder's social commentary can feel heavy-handed or underdeveloped, and its unique visual style may not appeal to all.

anime.title: Sadamitsu the Destroyer
anime.synopsis: Tsubaki Sadamitsu is a young delinquent and the leader of the Corpse Gang, who after a chance encounter with an alien robot is forced to take up the task of capturing intergalactic criminals named Exiled Ones. His job is made harder with the appearance of the Vulture, a last-ditch effort to keep the Exiled Ones under control.
anime.consensus_summary: Hakaima Sadamitsu is a short, lesser-known anime that may offer a pleasant surprise for viewers seeking lighthearted action and comedy. However, the series suffers from a shallow plot, uninspired animation and sound, and forgettable characters, leading to a generally underwhelming experience. While the final episodes offer some improvement, the overall consensus is that the series has unrealized potential.
pros: Enjoyable if you don't take it seriously
Good action and comedy
Pleasant surprise
Silly and engaging last few episodes
cons: Bland and boring
Fragmented story
Shallow setup
Mediocre animation
Lifeless soundtrack
Forgettable side characters

anime.title: Hakugei: Legend of the Moby Dick
anime.synopsis: A courageous young man tries to find the only person who can save his planet from the most terrifying beast in the universe—the great white whale Moby Dick—in this futuristic anime adventure set in 4699. But locating the outlaw Captain Ahab and his illusory crew of whale hunters and persuading them to put an end to the leviathan's long reign of terror won't be easy. Will Ahab take up the challenge one more time?
anime.consensus_summary: Hakugei Densetsu is a visually appealing and creatively ambitious anime that blends space opera with elements of Moby Dick. While praised for its unique art style, charismatic characters, and unpredictable plot, the series suffers from tonal inconsistencies, especially in the second season. The humor is often criticized as being dated and the dubbing choices are questionable, leading to a somewhat divisive reception among viewers.
pros: Interesting blend of space pirates and cyborgs
Fantastic art design, especially the settings and spacecraft
Memorable and charismatic characters, particularly Captain Ahab
Unpredictable plot with unexpected twists and turns
Well-made with a unique vibe
cons: Second season is schizophrenic in tone and poorly managed plot lines
Humor is dated and geared toward a Japanese audience
Inconsistent tone with sudden shifts from serious to goofy
Dubbing choice for Ahab's accent is lazy and close-minded
Story deviates significantly from the original Moby Dick novel

anime.title: Monster Rancher
anime.synopsis: Genki is a boy who loves playing video games. One day he's zapped into the world of Monster Rancher and meets the girl Holly and the monsters Mochi, Suezo, Golem, Tiger and Hare. Together, they are searching for a way to revive the Phoenix, which is the only monster capable of stopping the evil Moo.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Monster Farm: Enbanseki no Himitsu is mixed, often viewed as a less successful clone of other monster-collecting anime like Digimon and Pokemon. While some appreciate it for nostalgic reasons or its monster designs, many criticize its generic plot, weak characters, and inconsistent quality, especially in the second season. The series is generally considered suitable for children, but less appealing to older anime fans seeking depth or originality.
pros: Enjoyable for kids and those seeking a nostalgic experience.
Monster designs can be creative and interesting.
Some emotional moments and backstories resonate with viewers (e.g., Tiger's storyline).
cons: Generic and unoriginal plot, often compared unfavorably to Digimon and Pokemon.
Weak characters with little depth or development; the main character is often annoying.
Inconsistent story quality, particularly between seasons; rushed and unsatisfying ending.
Repetitive and uninspired music and sound design.
Mediocre animation quality typical of the late 90s/early 2000s.
Poor voice acting, especially in the English dub.

anime.title: City Hunter 3
anime.synopsis: Ryo Saeba is a "sweeper" know as the City Hunter. He and his sidekick Kaori Makimura are hired to solve problems that the police can't (or won't) handle. When he's not keeping the streets of Tokyo clean, Ryo is chasing the ladies, and Kaori chases after him with a giant anti-ecchi hammer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for City Hunter 3 is mixed, with some appreciating the character development and more serious undertones. However, significant changes in art style, music, and a perceived reduction in comedic elements have disappointed others, leading to a moderate level of polarization.
pros: Character development is noted as a positive improvement compared to season two.
Portrayal of strong, independent, and realistic women is praised.
Ryo is shown with more depth beyond his womanizing persona.
cons: Significant changes in art style and music detract from the 80s pop feel.
Outfit changes for Ryo and Kaori are considered "unforgivable" by one reviewer.
A perceived shift towards a more "serious" tone dampens the show's fun and comedic elements.
The show slows down significantly in terms of fun and humor, relying on "Yada yada yada" tropes.

anime.title: City Hunter '91
anime.synopsis: Ryo Saeba is back as the City Hunter, a "sweeper" (private detective) working on the streets of Tokyo. He and sidekick Kaori Makimura are hired to solve the problems of desperate people. When Ryo is not using his sharp shooting skills against bad guys, he's aiming his sites on pretty ladies. Kaori uses a giant anti-ecchi hammer to make sure he behaves.
anime.consensus_summary: City Hunter '91 is a decent, though somewhat disappointing, conclusion to the original series. Fans appreciate the familiar comedy and action, but note a decline in production quality and a lack of resolution for key relationships. Most feel it's worth watching for established fans, but it doesn't reach the heights of the earlier seasons.
pros: Classic City Hunter formula is still enjoyable
Exploration of Umibozou and Saeko's backstory
Nostalgic retro anime aesthetics
cons: Decline in visual and sound quality compared to earlier seasons
Lack of closure on major character relationships
Ending doesn't feel like a proper finale
Some episodes are weaker or more outlandish

anime.title: Sky Girls OVA
anime.synopsis: After the first war between humanity and the alien species known as Worms, the Earth is a shadow of its former self, with many landmasses submerged and countless human lives lost. When the Worms return, nearly every able body is drafted to join the desperate fight. Otoha Sakurano, Eika Ichijou, and Karen Sonomiya are three young girls tasked with forming an elite unit of "Sonic Divers": soldiers using innovative new exoskeleton technology to enhance their combat. When their covert carrier is viciously ambushed, the girls must suit up and prove that their unit has what it takes to protect humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: The Sky Girls OVA is considered a decent, though not exceptional, action title. Fans appreciate the character designs and overall charm, but are underwhelmed by the generic soundtrack and rushed ending. It is recommended for newcomers to the series as a quick introduction, but not essential for those who have already watched the full anime.
pros: Charming and likable characters with distinct personalities.
Good art style, especially the character design of the girls.
Decent pacing for a short OVA, staying with its military theme.
cons: Generic military style soundtrack.
Stereotypical character personalities.
Rushed final battle that comes too late in the episode.
Lite suggestive themes included, possibly trying to draw in a different kind of audience.

anime.title: D.Gray-man
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Losing a loved one is so painful that one may sometimes wish to be able to resurrect them—a weakness that the enigmatic Millennium Earl exploits. To make his mechanical weapons known as "Akuma," he uses the souls of the dead that are called back. Once a soul is placed in an Akuma, it is trapped forever, and the only way to save them is to exorcise them from their vessel using the Anti-Akuma weapon, "Innocence."
 
After spending three years as the disciple of General Cross, Allen Walker is sent to the Black Order—an organization comprised of those willing to fight Akuma and the Millennium Earl—to become an official Exorcist. With an arm as his Innocence and a cursed eye that can see the suffering souls within an Akuma, it's up to Allen and his fellow Exorcists to stop the Millennium Earl's ultimate plot: one that can lead to the destruction of the world.
anime.consensus_summary: D.Gray-man receives mixed reactions. While praised for its unique dark themes, well-developed characters, and excellent sound, it is criticized for inconsistent pacing, repetitive battles, and uneven character arcs. The initial slow pace and filler content deter some viewers, but the later half is often seen as a significant improvement. Ultimately, audience enjoyment hinges on patience and appreciation for character-driven narratives over plot-heavy action.
pros: Unique and intriguing plot with a dark and cruel theme, setting it apart from other shonen anime.
Well-developed characters with complex motives and mysterious pasts, even the villains evoke sympathy.
Excellent sound design with memorable opening and ending themes, enhancing the overall experience.
cons: Inconsistent pacing, with slow starts and filler episodes that can lead to boredom.
Repetitive battle sequences and irregular power levels that lack a sense of progression.
Uneven character development, with some characters devolving into simple tropes or lacking depth.

anime.title: Master Keaton
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Adventure, Drama, Historical, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: The amazing Taichi Keaton works on cases around the globe that always lead to adventure! He combines his arsenal of multidisciplinary expertise in investigation, archeology, and survival with his experience as a professor, a Falklands Conflict veteran and a SAS agent to unravel the often dangerous challenges in each riveting episode.
anime.consensus_summary: Master Keaton is generally well-regarded as an episodic series with intelligent stories and interesting characters. While some find the episodic format limiting and the animation dated, others appreciate the variety and the show's unique blend of genres. The main character is likable, and the use of European history adds depth to the individual episodes.
pros: Intelligent stories set in a real-world setting.
Episodic format allows for a staggering variety of stories.
Main character is intelligent, resourceful, and combat-proficient.
Excellent use of European history to create interesting episodes.
Emotionally relatable characters that develop within a single episode.
cons: Episodic nature hinders overall plot and character development.
Some episodes feel predictable or cliche.
Animation is dated and not as impressive compared to other anime of its time.
Writing can be trite and heavy-handed at times.
Sometimes the main character feels shoehorned into episodes.

anime.title: Baby and Me
anime.synopsis:
Takuya Enoki is living a difficult life for a fifth grader. His mother passed away in a tragic car accident a few months ago, forcing him to pick up the slack and take care of his baby brother, Minoru, as his father works the endless hours typical of a Japanese salaryman.

He will have to sacrifice his childhood in order to meet the needs of his little brother. Cooking, cleaning, worrying, and trying to discipline Minoru are some of the tasks Takuya will have on his plate, all while their neighbors blame him for Minoru’s constant crying. Meanwhile, he will watch as his friends live their carefree lives, enjoying their free time. It will not be easy and there will be plenty of stumbling blocks, but along the way, he may actually learn the true meaning of family.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally agrees that Akachan to Boku is a heartwarming and emotional anime that portrays the challenges and love within a family. While some find the art style to be dated, the touching story and relatable characters resonate with viewers. It's considered a solid slice-of-life drama that explores themes of responsibility and sibling bonds.
pros: Emotional and touching story
Explores themes of family love and responsibility
Relatable characters and realistic situations
Good voice acting
cons: Dated art style
Some may find the plot slow or uneventful

anime.title: Kodocha
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, Shoujo, Showbiz
anime.synopsis:
Sixth grader Sana Kurata has a perfect life. Her mother is a (fairly) successful author, she has a young man employed to keep her happy and safe, and best of all, she is the star of the children's television show Kodomo no Omocha. There's just one thing bothering her, and that's Akito Hayama.

Akito is a classmate of Sana's, and ever since he's started acting out in class, the rest of the boys have followed his example. Every day, the girls and the teacher wage a battle to keep the class under control and to get some actual learning done. That rotten Akito… Sana won't stand for this!

The hyperactive Sana decides to dig deeper and find out what makes Akito tick, so class can go back to normal and the teacher can stop spending every day crying instead of teaching. But the more she learns about him, the more she realizes that there might be more to Akito than meets the eye.
anime.consensus_summary: Kodocha is a beloved anime praised for its engaging characters, emotional depth, and comedic moments. While some find the art style dated and note pacing issues in the later episodes, the series is celebrated for its ability to blend humor with serious themes. Many viewers recommend both the anime and the manga, with some preferring the manga's more complete ending. Overall, it's considered a heartwarming and memorable shoujo series.
pros: Excellent character development, especially Sana and Akito
Strong emotional impact with ability to make viewers laugh and cry
Tackles serious themes like child abuse and divorce maturely
Catchy music and well-done English dub (first 51 episodes)
Unique and memorable characters with distinct personalities
cons: Art style may seem dated to modern viewers
Filler episodes that detract from the main storyline
Pacing issues in the second half
Unresolved ending in the anime compared to the manga

anime.title: .hack//Unison
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Video Game
anime.synopsis: Somewhere in the MMORPG called "The World," a group is gathered at a pub, awaiting the start of an event. There, old friends and acquaintances are reunited, including those who rarely log on. Some are even forging new relationships for the first time. Together, invited by the hacker Helba, the group leaves for the event in the Net Slums where a celebration awaits them all.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys '.hack//Unison' as a lighthearted and nostalgic epilogue that brings closure to the series. However, its impact is significantly enhanced for viewers who have experienced the broader '.hack' universe, including the PS2 games. Some find the shift in tone jarring and the plot somewhat unnecessary, but overall it's a well-received celebratory piece for dedicated fans.
pros: Provides a feel-good episode after the dark themes of .hack//SIGN.
Offers closure and interaction between characters from different .hack series.
Enjoyable for fans seeking something easy and relaxing.
cons: May feel pointless or confusing without having played the PS2 games.
Light-heartedness might feel strange compared to the bleak setting of the original series.
Plot feels like unnecessary closure with some minor character assassination.

anime.title: The Galaxy Railways
anime.synopsis:
In the distant future, trains are no longer bound by their physical tracks. Instead, they take to the skies and travel across the universe on the Galaxy Railways, transporting mankind from planet to planet. However, the Galaxy Railways are no safer than traditional trains: criminals, terrorists, and vile aliens always find a way to stir up trouble. 

Manabu Yuuki, a rash and hot-headed man, is the latest addition to the Galaxy Railways' elite Space Defence Force (SDF). These brave men and women are responsible for protecting the railways and responding to any unprecedented danger, risking their lives to protect the innocent from evil. But as this drama unfolds and the SDF's greatest crisis draws nearer, Manabu must truly learn what it means to be a member of the SDF before it is too late.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the story and characters engaging and well-developed. However, others criticize the show for its reliance on familiar tropes, inconsistent animation, and pacing issues. While some appreciate the nostalgic feel and philosophical themes, others find it unoriginal or depressing.
pros: Well-developed characters and relationships
Interesting story with a conclusive ending
Good animation with well-done backgrounds and lighting effects
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with some choppy movements and disproportionate characters
Repetitive story tropes and clichéd character archetypes, especially within the Leijiverse
Pacing issues, with some feeling it's slow for half the series

anime.title: Project ARMS
anime.genres: Action, Martial Arts, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: A boy gets involved in an accident when in kindergarten, horribly damaging his arm, but the doctors somehow manage to save it. Now, several years later, his arm seems to be becoming the focus of strange events as it turns out to be more than a normal arm. Meanwhile, a secret organization is out to get hold of him and the power he possess.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some find the story unoriginal and the production quality lacking, others are gripped by its unique charm and engaging characters. The series has a dedicated fanbase that overlooks its flaws, resulting in a polarizing experience depending on individual preferences for story and animation quality.
pros: Catchy opening and ending themes.
Some surprising plot twists.
The ARMS nanomachinery is visually cool and freaky.
Characters avoid being complete stereotypes
cons: Overused simple plots and stereotypical characters.
Inconsistent and sometimes bad animation quality, especially in early episodes and Season 2.
Mediocre voice acting in both sub and dub.
Inconsistent off modeling moments.

anime.title: Project ARMS: The 2nd Chapter
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Martial Arts, School, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: The 2nd Chapter continues the story of Ryo Takatsuki and his companions' quest to discover the secret of the mysterious A.R.M.S. they all possess and what the future may hold for them. They now know where the answers lie but to get to them, they must fight a desperate fight of survival against a powerful military corporation that wants their secrets no matter what the cost.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Project ARMS is considered a mixed bag by audiences. While it offers some character development and delves deeper into the ARMS' mysteries, it suffers from animation issues and changes to the source material. These alterations ultimately weaken character arcs and lead to an unsatisfying conclusion, resulting in a somewhat disappointed reception from fans of the manga.
pros: Decent character development for new characters.
In-depth background of the ARMS answering plot mysteries.
Better interaction and development between users and their ARMS.
cons: Animation quality suffered compared to the first season.
Plot elements and characters were cut from the manga adaptation.
Compromised character arcs due to story changes.
Kei's backstory was changed, making it less impactful.
The show ends on an icy cliffhanger.
Katsumi often plays the role of a damsel in distress.

anime.title: Maetel Legend
anime.synopsis: The artificial sun that lights the frozen planet La Metalle is dying, threatening to extinguish what little life is left there. Queen La Andromeda Prometheum decides that the only way for her people to survive is for them to submit to Hardgear's transformation process, which will turn everyone's body into machines. The Queen's daughters, Emeraldas and Maetel, refuse to submit to this process, and fight to stay human.
anime.consensus_summary: The Maetel Legend OVA is seen as a supplemental piece to the Galaxy Express 999 franchise, offering background on Maetel's origins. However, it is criticized for a simple and somewhat uninspired plot, with functional characters. Some find it bizarrely watchable despite its flaws, while others see it as a must-watch for franchise fans.
pros: Insight into Maetel's origin and the mechanized empire.
Vivid animation style, more modern than earlier works.
cons: Straightforward and uninspired plot.
Unmemorable characters.
Questionable plot logic.
Lacks a proper story and interesting characters.

anime.title: Black Blood Brothers
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Urban Fantasy, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Black Bloods and Red Bloods, vampires and humans. Despite their differences, these two races once fought together in a crusade against a formidable foe. A decade later, the vampire war hero Jirou Mochizuki, known as the "Silver Blade," travels with his younger brother Kotarou to the Special Zone—a safe haven where vampires and humans live in harmony.

However, their journey is suddenly faced with danger when a conflict erupts between vampire migrants and human forces from the Special Zone. With the rise of a developing conspiracy from an old enemy, Jirou will need the help of his new ally, Mimiko "Compromiser" Katsuragi, as well as the power of his ancient bloodline to protect what he treasures the most.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Black Blood Brothers are mixed. Some viewers appreciate the engaging story, action-packed scenes, and well-developed characters, while others criticize the incomplete plot, annoying characters, and mediocre production quality. Ultimately, the show is considered a decent but not exceptional vampire anime, with some finding it enjoyable for a quick watch while others are left disappointed.
pros: Engaging storyline with a satisfying build-up and smooth development, especially given the limited number of episodes.
Well-executed fight scenes and fluent animation, creating a visually appealing experience.
Likeable characters with well-developed personalities and a good balance of seriousness and humor.
cons: Incomplete or rushed story elements, particularly regarding the villains' motivations and background details.
Annoying or unlikeable characters, such as the main character's brother or the female sidekick, who detract from the overall enjoyment.
Mediocre production values, including bland animation, uninspired music, and lifeless English dubbing.

anime.title: Kaleido Star: Good da yo! Goood!!
anime.romaji_title: Kaleido Star: Good da yo! Goood!!
anime.synopsis: In 3 short scenes with chibi-versions of Sora, Layla, May and others you'll find out how to cook, how to play with diabolo and learn some words from seal language.
anime.consensus_summary: The Kaleido Star OVA is well-received, particularly by fans of the original series. The chibi CG art style is considered a creative and visually appealing choice, and the skits are entertaining. While some may find the animation stiff or the colors too intense, the overall sentiment is positive, with many wishing for more content in this style.
pros: Characters maintain their personalities from the series.
Catchy and charming music, consistent with the original series.
Interesting and well-executed chibi CG art style.
Entertaining and funny skits.
Appeals to both fans and non-fans of the series.
Full opening and closing themes are great additions.
cons: Some may be disappointed by the lack of appearance of all supporting cast members.
Chibi characters can be somewhat stiff compared to their traditional anime counterparts.
Some fans might find the overall color schemes to be too much for the eyes.
Short length (only 1 episode).

anime.title: Magical Project S
anime.synopsis:
The carefree Tsunami is next in line to rule over the Magical Kingdom of Juraihelm. But before she is officially crowned as queen, she must restore balance to the universe that has come to favor darkness. To accomplish her goal, Tsunami gives the ordinary Sasami Kawai a magical baton that can transform her into a magical girl. She also appoints the rabbit-like creature Ryou-Ouki to aid Sasami in the battle against evil.

However, Sasami refuses to become a magical girl—not because she is scared, but because she finds it too embarrassing! Meanwhile, the arrogant Ramia is plotting to overthrow Tsunami by enlisting her own magical girl—the eccentric Pixy Misa—to cause chaos and ensure that balance is never restored. As Pixy Misa terrorizes the planet with her Love-Love monsters, Sasami must learn to swallow her pride and accept her role as the universe's champion of justice, Pretty Sammy.
anime.consensus_summary: Mahou Shoujo Pretty Sammy is viewed as a mostly fun, albeit flawed, parody of the magical girl genre. Its connection to the Tenchi Muyo series offers some appeal, but the repetitive humor and occasionally weak production detract from the experience. While not a masterpiece, it's generally considered a lighthearted and amusing watch for those familiar with magical girl tropes.
pros: Parodies magical girl tropes effectively.
Tenchi Muyo character cameos are a highlight.
Some enjoyable background music.
cons: Corny and repetitive content.
Storyline feels bloated.
Inconsistent animation quality compared to other Tenchi series.
Uninspired soundtrack.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 09: Strategy Above the Depths
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 09: Suihei Senjou no Strategy
anime.synopsis:
Fifteen years ago in a barren stretch of the Pacific, a cruise ship collided with an iceberg and was lost at sea. More than a decade later, Hideto Yashiro—a ship engineer—died in a fatal car accident. The unlikely connection between these events only comes to light on the luxury liner St. Aphrodite during her maiden voyage.

Aboard it on a much needed vacation, Kogorou Mouri, his daughter Ran, Conan Edogawa, and the Detective Boys enjoy a trip provided by Sonoko Suzuki's family. But their fun is soon cut short when a game of hide-and-seek leads to Sonoko's disappearance. Some time later, the CEO of the Yashiro group, who built the St. Aphrodite, is found stabbed to death and her father missing. While the police's investigation turns to a dead end, Conan closes in on the culprit. Unwilling to be apprehended, the culprit threatens to blow up the St. Aphrodite and sink all her passengers.

As the ship's hull rapidly fills with water, the truth behind the vengeful murders is finally revealed. With no place to escape, Conan and Kogorou must wrestle with the elusive culprit before everyone on board is dragged to the ocean floor.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the engaging story, competent portrayal of Kogoro, and improved animation. However, criticisms include poor translation quality, illogical character behavior, and a predictable mystery due to revealing the culprit's plan too early. Overall, the film is enjoyable for fans of Detective Conan but may not appeal to everyone.
pros: Kogoro Mouri's competence is highlighted.
Culprit's actions and motives are well-developed.
Improved art and animation quality compared to previous movies.
Engaging story with surprising twists.
cons: Poor translation quality in some versions.
Irrational character behavior (Ran's actions).
Predictable mystery due to early revelation of culprit's plan.
Lack of character development for victims.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 10: The Private Eyes' Requiem
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 10: Tantei-tachi no Requiem
anime.synopsis:
After receiving a strange invitation, Kogorou Mouri pays a visit to the Miracle Land theme park along with his daughter Ran, Conan Edogawa, and the Detective Boys. Once there, Kogorou and Conan are tasked with finishing an unsolved case by a mysterious stranger. Realizing that the invitations were actually an elaborate trap, the two have just 12 hours to solve the case or face grave danger.

With the help of familiar faces like Heiji Hattori, Kaitou Kid, and even Saguru Hakuba, the group of detectives must unravel the web of clues surrounding the case in order to find the culprit and bring them to justice before it's too late.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the story's premise and pacing, while others criticize the execution, lack of tension, and subpar animation quality. Many feel the film doesn't live up to the standards of a 10th-anniversary movie, with its generic elements. Despite its flaws, some viewers still find enjoyment in the familiar characters and mystery elements.
pros: Fast-paced adventure keeps the audience engaged.
Interesting premise of detectives solving a case under pressure.
Story has a looming sense of dread and some decent character moments.
cons: Execution of the story lacks urgency and tension.
Art and animation quality is below the usual standards for Detective Conan movies.
Feels like an extended TV episode rather than a special anniversary movie.
The plot elements are generic, and have been done better in other Conan movies.

anime.title: Sci-Fi Harry
anime.genres: Drama, Horror, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Harry is definitely not your average American teenager. Instead, he is the epitome of an "alienated youth"—friendless at school, extremely weird, and nervous to the point of paranoia. But a chance occurrence causes Harry to start to demonstrate what appear to be psychic powers—yet he neither believes in them nor consciously controls them.

However, there are other ominous forces at work who do believe in Harry and attempt to make use of him in ways that are threatening and frightful.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the initial concept and mystery elements are intriguing, the unlikeable main character, slow pacing, and ultimately disappointing ending significantly detract from the experience. Many feel the show fails to deliver on its initial promise, resulting in frustration and disappointment, though some appreciate its experimental nature and unique art style.
pros: Interesting concept with damaging effects of psychic powers.
Unique art style reminiscent of European comics.
Well-executed mystery-thriller elements in early episodes.
cons: Main character is unlikeable and lacks development.
Story devolves into generic anime tropes and contrived character motives.
Vague and unsatisfying ending.
Slow pacing with excessive staring and confusing plot.
Poor animation quality.

anime.title: Save Me! Lollipop
anime.synopsis:
Nina Yamada's greatest dream is to find someone that will protect her in the same way the princesses are in her storybooks. She soon desperately needs that protection: when she swallows a strange pink ball of what she believes to be hard candy, a huge number of people fall from the sky. The ball she swallowed is the Crystal Pearl, a symbolic trinket that magic users from another world fight over. The winner of the Crystal Pearl passes a magic exam that can grant them the prestigious title of professional wizards.

Zero and Ichii, two young men taking the exam together, quickly determine that the pearl is inside Nina and promise to protect her until the exam is over. With countless other examinees after the object, their task is daunting—but not as brutal as the embarrassment Nina faces when she arrives at school with two handsome boys at her heels.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception to 'Mamotte! Lollipop' is mixed to negative. While some viewers, particularly younger ones or those fond of the shoujo genre, found it entertaining and nostalgic, the majority criticized its unoriginal story, poor animation, and annoying main character. Many felt that the anime adaptation failed to capture the essence of the manga, resulting in a disappointing experience.
pros: Some reviewers enjoyed the art style, comparing it favorably to other shoujo series.
A few reviewers found the series enjoyable and funny, especially younger viewers.
The English dub voice acting was praised by some reviewers.
cons: Many reviewers criticized the story as being unoriginal, predictable, and full of plot holes.
Several reviewers found the animation to be poor, with recycled sequences and inconsistent character designs.
The main character, Nina, was often described as annoying, whiny, and unlikeable.
The series was criticized for cutting out important plot points and character development from the manga, leading to a rushed and unsatisfying ending.
Some reviewers found the characters to be clichéd and lacking originality.

anime.title: Kirarin Revolution
anime.synopsis:
Kirari Tsukishima, a gluttonous 14-year-old beauty, is a girl who does not care about idols and the entertainment world because her mind is occupied by food. Her obsession with food only causes her to be clueless about love.

One day, after saving a turtle that is stranded in a tree, Kirari meets with a handsome and gentle boy named Seiji, who gives her ticket to a SHIPS (a popular idol group) concert to show his gratitude for her saving his pet. Kirari then storms off to the concert and runs into another boy, who tears up her ticket and warns her to stay away from Seiji because she and Seiji live in different worlds. The outraged Kirari then sneaks into the concert, only to discover that Seiji and the boy who tore her ticket, named Hiroto, are actually members of SHIPS.

Finally understanding the meaning of "different worlds" (Seiji is a popular idol while she is an average middle school student), Kirari refuses to give up. Filled with determination to be with Seiji, she declares that she will also become an idol.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the character's journey and the music, but others are critical of the declining art quality and the shift in the story's tone. There is a general feeling of disappointment as the series progresses, with some feeling that the initial promise is not maintained. Some enjoyed the anime despite its flaws.
pros: Good buildup of character fame and fortune.
Music and voice acting are well-received.
cons: Art quality deteriorates, especially after major plot points.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with scenes lacking detail.
Story becomes less comedic and more realistic over time, losing its initial appeal.
Story is close-minded and selfish.

anime.title: Silent Möbius
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Romance, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: The year is 2023 and Alien Beings known as "Lucifer Hawks" have begun invading earth from another dimension. All that stands between them and the enslavement of the human race is the Attacked Mystification Police Department - a special division of the Tokyo Police staffed by women with amazing paranormal abilities.
anime.consensus_summary: Silent Mobius is a decent anime with a unique premise and strong female characters, but it suffers from inconsistent execution. Viewers appreciate the blend of cyberpunk and magic, as well as the character-driven storylines, however, the confusing plot, rushed ending, and animation flaws hinder the overall experience. While some find it engaging and nostalgic, others find it unmemorable and ultimately unfulfilling.
pros: Strong female characters with individual development arcs
Unique blend of cyberpunk and magical elements
Engaging plot twists and character deaths that maintain suspense
Well-developed world-building, especially the depiction of a dystopian Tokyo
High-quality soundtrack that complements the atmosphere
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and occasional use of jarring CGI
Underdeveloped side characters and Lucifer Hawk villains
Rushed pacing and ambiguous ending in the final episodes
Confusing lore and unclear storytelling
Cheesy romance subplots and bland male characters
Inconsistent voice acting in the English dub

anime.title: Black Lagoon: The Second Barrage
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Organized Crime, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Rokurou "Rock" Okajima has joined the Lagoon Company, a pirate mercenary group which operates out of Roanapur, Thailand. Despite his initial protests, this filthy slum of depraved souls and merciless criminals now serves as the former salaryman's home. Stranded, with nothing left of his past life but the clothes on his back and his inner morality, Rock is forced to perform jobs alongside the other members of the Lagoon crew. Berated for his lack of spine as he wades through the underbelly of society, he must decide whether to continue on amidst the gunfire and ruthlessness or risk everything he has in an attempt to be free. Whether he chooses the comfort of a familiar land or the freedom of being an outlaw, his decision will have lasting consequences on the crew who gave him a home.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, praising the action and animation but criticizing the inconsistent storyline and character development. Some find the themes thought-provoking, while others see the plot as nonsensical and poorly executed.  The series is appreciated for its style and action, but falls short in delivering a cohesive narrative and compelling character arcs, leading to a somewhat divisive viewing experience.
pros: Excellent animation and art style
Engaging action sequences and gunfights
Exploration of character backgrounds
cons: Inconsistent story arcs and weak plots
Underdeveloped character relationships
Problematic English pronunciation

anime.title: Windy Tales
anime.genres: Iyashikei, School, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Nao, an 8th grader, is one of the only two members of a Digital Camera Club, where she also serves as the manager. It's a mystery that she shoots nothing else but the skies and clouds. One day, she finds a cat on a rooftop where she usually shoots her camera. It's a cat that knows how to manipulate the flow of a wind. Shocked to find a strange animal, Nao loses her footing and falls off from the rooftop!

Miki is the other member of the club, and also Nao's best friend. Mr. Taiki is the teacher who's taught the cat how to manipulate the flow of a wind. Ryoko is a girl who has a huge crush on Mr. Taiki. And there's Jun, who helps Nao and Miki look for a cat that can fly. Then, there's Yukio, who is the widow of Mr. Taiki's deceased brother.

On the outskirts of this big city, a town off the "Wind Handlers," has been formed—and a mysterious Wind Festival is about to begin...
anime.consensus_summary: Fuujin Monogatari is a unique slice-of-life anime praised for its experimental art style, calming atmosphere, and mature themes. While some find the episodic nature and underutilization of wind powers detract from the experience, the overall audience mood is one of appreciation and contentment. It is considered a niche anime that may not appeal to everyone, but those who appreciate its subtle beauty find it to be a special and memorable experience.
pros: Unique and experimental art style complements the wind element and enhances the atmosphere.
Calm, soothing music and sound design contribute to a relaxing and immersive experience.
Subtle and realistic dialogue reflects everyday conversations and characterizations.
Exploration of mature themes such as growing up, responsibility, and finding one's worth.
cons: Wind control powers are not explored in depth and sometimes feel like a gimmick.
Episodic nature leads to inconsistency in quality and thematic detachment.
Subdued voice acting may not relay strong emotions effectively.
Slow pace and lack of significant plot development may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Pokémon: The Legend of Thunder!
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Crystal: Raikou Ikazuchi no Densetsu
anime.synopsis: Kenta, a Pokemon master in the making, meets up with his childhood friend, Marina, at a Pokemon Center, to see how their skills have developed. Their battle is interrupted by a thunderstorm and the arrival of Bashou and Buson, two Roketto-Dan members using the Crystal System (which attracts Electric-type Pokemon). Their ultimate goal is to, under the guidance of Shiranui-hakase, bring Pokemon back to Sakaki. Kenta and Marina stumble upon this plan, and they try to stop it, but things get more difficult when the legendary Pokemon Raikou is captured.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is considered an average Pokemon film, with some viewers appreciating the change in protagonist and the unique villains. However, the plot is seen as typical and the animation quality is criticized. Overall, it's a mildly enjoyable watch for Pokemon fans, with little strong polarizing opinions.
pros: Refreshing to see a protagonist other than Ash.
Interesting villains (Attila and Hun) with contrasting personalities.
cons: Protagonist (Jimmy) can be annoying.
Plot is average for Pokemon.
Animation quality is worse than a usual episode.

anime.title: Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 08: Mew to Hadou no Yuusha Lucario
anime.synopsis:
A long time ago, the people of Camaron Palace found themselves on the brink of destruction. Fortunately, they escaped it when Sir Aaron, the True Guardian of Aura, saved them. He sacrificed himself to stop a war between kingdoms. From that day on, a tournament is held every year to commemorate his noble deed.

Satoshi, a budding Pokémon trainer from Kanto, manages to win the latest tournament and is allowed to wield a staff said to have belonged to Sir Aaron himself. Lucario, the Aura Pokémon—who is also the servant of the True Guardian—emerges from the staff. However, remembering his last memory of his master abandoning him, Lucario runs away in confusion. 

Meanwhile, Pikachu, Satoshi's companion, is abruptly taken by a Pokémon named Mew to the legendary Tree of Beginning. Only Lucario knows the way there, but he is unwilling to trust humans after his master's betrayal. Even so, to save his partner, Satoshi and his companions must acquire all the help they need and travel to the Tree of Beginning, unfolding hidden truths from centuries ago.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Lucario and the Mystery of Mew' is viewed positively, especially by long-time Pokemon fans. Many appreciate the emotional depth and the character of Lucario. While some acknowledge flaws in the plot and animation, the movie's strengths, particularly its emotional impact and nostalgic appeal, make it a favorite for many.
pros: Lucario is a well-developed and endearing character.
The movie has a moving and emotional story, particularly the ending.
The animation is generally praised, especially the backgrounds and action scenes.
The relationship between Lucario and Sir Aaron is compelling.
The movie offers a more mature and empathetic story compared to some other Pokemon movies.
cons: The CGI has aged poorly.
The plot can be predictable and formulaic.
Some secondary characters are underdeveloped.
The first half of the movie is considered weak by some viewers.
Some plot elements and resolutions are considered contrived or illogical.

anime.title: Pokémon: The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon
anime.synopsis: Dr. Yung, an enigmatic Pokémon scientist, has developed a new Mirage system that uses computer data to resurrect extinct Pokémon, like Kabutops and Armaldo. Professor Oak, Ash and his companions show up at the Mirage Mansion at Dr. Yung's invitation, and watch a demonstration of the machine's capabilities. In the middle of a battle between Dr. Yung's Mirage Pokémon and Ash, the machine goes haywire and a Mirage Aerodactyl swoops in and kidnaps Dr. Yung. A man calling himself "The Mirage Master" appears and announces to everyone that the Mirage System can be used to create Pokémon with absolutely no weaknesses. Ash, Misty, and Professor Oak struggle to stop the madman and escape with their lives.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is largely considered a disappointment, especially given its billing as a 10th-anniversary celebration. While the return of familiar faces generated initial excitement, the rehashed plot, weak villain, and inconsistencies ultimately left fans feeling underwhelmed. The special is criticized for prioritizing fan-service over a compelling narrative, resulting in a forgettable addition to the Pokémon franchise.
pros: Brings back fan-favorite characters like Misty and Mewtwo.
cons: Recycled plot elements from previous Pokémon movies.
Poorly developed villain with uninspired motivations.
Inconsistencies in character portrayals (Mewtwo).
Weak narrative and shallow exploration of themes.

anime.title: Kanon
anime.synopsis:
As a young child, Aizawa Yuuichi had often visited his cousin in the city; however, something drastic happened to keep him away for seven long years. Now, Yuuichi returns, his memories of those days are simply gone.

Settling into the wintry town, Yuuichi comes across several young girls, all of whom are connected to his past. As he befriends them and continues to interact with them, the long forgotten memories from his childhood begin to resurface...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the show's emotional depth, beautiful animation, and memorable characters. However, some find the story formulaic and the reliance on supernatural elements detracts from the overall experience. The show is considered a tear-jerker but may not resonate with viewers seeking more originality or depth.
pros: Touching and emotional storylines with well-developed characters.
High-quality animation and visually appealing art style, especially the backgrounds and winter setting.
Effective use of music to enhance the emotional impact of scenes.
cons: Formulaic story arcs that can feel repetitive and predictable.
Inconsistent character interactions and development after their individual arcs conclude.
Over-reliance on supernatural elements that can feel contrived or poorly explained.
Characters may be flat, generic, and archetypal.

anime.title: Sukisho
anime.romaji_title: Suki na Mono wa Suki Dakara Shou ga Nai!!
anime.synopsis: Hashiba Sora has fallen from a 4th story window and has lost all of his memories. When Fujimori Sunao comes to his school as his new room mate, Fujimori tells Hashiba that he is called Ran. Fujimori and Hashiba both have a split personality which they developed in their youth. Their split personalities, Yoru and Ran, are deeply in love. Even though it creeps Fujimori and Hashiba out what their other selves do with each other at night, they also start to fall for each other. Because of their relationship, Hashiba Sora finds out a lot of shocking facts about their youth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding enjoyment in the humor and character dynamics, particularly the unconventional seme perspective. However, many are critical of the weak and confusing plot, stereotypical characterizations, and dated animation. The series seems to appeal more to dedicated yaoi/shounen-ai fans who are willing to overlook its flaws, while others find it disappointing due to its lack of depth and originality.
pros: Unique seme perspective
Enjoyable character dynamics
Humorous and lighthearted
cons: Weak plot and story development
Stereotypical characters
Amateurish art style and animation
Confusing or pointless elements

anime.title: Wedding Peach
anime.synopsis: There are three known worlds—the human world, the angel world, and the devil world. The evil queen Raindevilla yearns to destroy the angel world with help or her many devil minions. The goddess Aphrodite sends an angel to the human world, Limone, to summon three love angels in the form of three school girls, Momoko Hanasaki, Yuri Tanima, and Hinagiku Tamano, who together become Angel Lilly, Angel Daisy, and Wedding Peach. The three girls must fight to overcome the evils of the devils, as well as their own lives, and restore peace to the angel world by gathering all pieces of the Sacred Four Somethings (or Saint Something Four) and defeat the evil queen once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Wedding Peach is a generally well-liked magical girl anime, particularly among fans of the genre and those who enjoy romantic comedies. While some find it repetitive or derivative of Sailor Moon, others appreciate its unique wedding theme, strong character relationships, and catchy music. The series is considered enjoyable and heartwarming, though its older animation style and filler content may not appeal to all viewers.
pros: Strong emphasis on romance and character relationships.
Catchy music and enjoyable opening/ending themes.
The wedding theme offers a unique twist within the magical girl genre.
Friendship is amazing and inspirational
The characters have strong bonds through the story
cons: Repetitive transformation sequences and stock footage.
Filler episodes detract from the overall plot.
Monster designs are uninspired.
Some viewers find the art style dated and unappealing.
The villains become progressively worse and annoying.
Heavy borrowing from Sailor Moon
Random plots and lack of build-up

anime.title: Pretty Cure Splash Star
anime.synopsis: During the summer festival five years ago, two girls met at a mysterious tree and saw two glowing spheres. Now, these two girls--Saki Hyuuga, ace pitcher on the school softball team; and Mai Mishou, who prefers sketching over stargazing--are chosen by the spirits of flowers (Flappy) and birds (Choppy) to restore the Seven Fountains and save their worlds from Dark Autumn. Together, they are the NEW Pretty Cure.
anime.consensus_summary: Splash Star is generally well-received as a solid entry in the Pretty Cure franchise, praised for its character development, particularly the redemption arc of Michiru and Kaoru. While some find the initial similarities to the original series off-putting and critique the animation and some villains, the series is appreciated for its optimistic tone and emphasis on friendship. The dynamic between the main characters is sweet, and the emotional moments resonate well with viewers.
pros: Consistent episode quality due to a simple story allows for conveying serious themes effectively.
Well-developed characters, especially Saki and Mai, with distinct personalities and interests, foster strong emotional connection.
Excellent redemption arc of Michiru and Kaoru with surprising depth and tragic moments.
Creative and interesting villain designs, with many villains being entertaining and funny.
Good pacing with villains appearing and disappearing at the right moment.
cons: Initial similarities to the original Futari wa Pretty Cure may turn off some viewers.
Animation quality can be inconsistent, with derpy faces and poor drawings at times.
Some villains are weak writing-wise, lacking depth compared to others.
Fight scenes, while occasionally great, can be anti-climactic and stiff.
Some filler episodes may not be as entertaining due to the focus on only two main characters.

anime.title: Death Note
anime.synopsis:
Brutal murders, petty thefts, and senseless violence pollute the human world. In contrast, the realm of death gods is a humdrum, unchanging gambling den. The ingenious 17-year-old Japanese student Light Yagami and sadistic god of death Ryuk share one belief: their worlds are rotten.

For his own amusement, Ryuk drops his Death Note into the human world. Light stumbles upon it, deeming the first of its rules ridiculous: the human whose name is written in this note shall die. However, the temptation is too great, and Light experiments by writing a felon's name, which disturbingly enacts his first murder.

Aware of the terrifying godlike power that has fallen into his hands, Light—under the alias Kira—follows his wicked sense of justice with the ultimate goal of cleansing the world of all evil-doers. The meticulous mastermind detective L is already on his trail, but as Light's brilliance rivals L's, the grand chase for Kira turns into an intense battle of wits that can only end when one of them is dead.
anime.consensus_summary: Death Note is widely praised for its unique premise, suspenseful plot, and intellectual depth, sparking debates about morality and justice. However, some critics find the second half of the series weaker due to contrived plot points and less compelling characters. While the series is generally well-regarded, opinions diverge on the quality of its later episodes and the depth of its philosophical themes.
pros: Unique and compelling story that challenges viewers' morals and explores themes of justice and power.
Intricate cat-and-mouse game between Light and L, filled with intelligent moves and suspense.
Well-developed characters, especially Light and L, with their unique and engaging personalities.
cons: Story quality declines in the second half, with less intelligent characters and contrived plot developments.
Over-the-top dialogue and reliance on absurd plans to portray characters as geniuses.
