Now, as he plays for the Barcelona team in a fierce game, it seems as though his dreams are on the verge of coming true.

Captain Tsubasa: Road to 2002 tells the story of how Tsubasa climbed his way through the ranks, featuring his roots in the town of Nankatsu as well as his epic journey to master the art of soccer.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Captain Tsubasa: Road to 2002' for its exciting depiction of soccer and character development, particularly Tsubasa's journey.  Fans appreciate the nostalgic feel and updated graphics.  Some find certain story elements lacking, but overall, the series is well-received as a celebration of soccer and Japanese animation.
pros: Exciting portrayal of soccer with anime action.
Strong character progression and development.
Nostalgic and captures the magic of the original series.
Appealing graphics and exciting music.
cons: Some story arcs feel cut short.
Love interest feels trite and secondary.

anime.title: Massugu ni Ikou.
anime.synopsis:
A talking dog is a beautiful story that you should have dreamt of as a child. But if you have forgotten about it, this is a reminder of that fable story. This is the story of a dog that talks, but ordinary people cannot hear his voice.

The main character, Mametaro, is an adventurous crossbreed dog. He loves his owner, Iku-chan and his girlfriend Hanako-chan very much. However, he just cannot stand Iku-chan's friend, Akiyoshi.
During this story, which will be told from Mametaro's point of view, the warm days of spring are finally here. The school and the riverbank, which is actually just an ordinary neighborhood for people, seems like a mysterious world that extends infinitely to little Mametaro and his friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, finding the show cute, heartwarming, and enjoyable, especially for children. While some find the art and music unremarkable and the plot simple, the overall experience is considered relaxing and a good short watch. It is recommended for those looking for something lighthearted and easy to enjoy.
pros: Good life lessons for children
Endearing characters, especially Mametaro
Beautiful watercolour scenery
Relaxing and lighthearted
cons: Art style could be better, especially for humans
Incidental music is unremarkable
Loose plot, not consistently explored
Simple archetypes for characters, minor character development

anime.title: Soreyuke! Uchuu Senkan Yamamoto Youko (1999)
anime.synopsis: In the year 2999: humanity is split into two factions, Terra and Ness, in a war fought by starships. One of the foremost of the pilots is the cocky teenager Yamamoto Yohko, and during one of her missions, she and her crew are sucked into a temporal anomaly (a la Star Trek) that sends her back to our time. Amnesiac, she only thinks of herself as a typical high school student - until a course of events sends her back to her ship the TA-29, with her newfound friends fighting at her side in a war that looks suspiciously like an arcade game (complete with 100 yen ignition costs!).
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding it to be a charming and enjoyable action anime with a good soundtrack and fun characters. However, others criticize the outdated art, plot holes, and unnecessary subplots. While not a universally acclaimed show, it has its fans who appreciate its light-heartedness and action elements.
pros: Fast-paced and action-packed
Quirky and light-hearted feel
Memorable opening theme and soundtrack
Fun and varied characters
Good voice acting
cons: Outdated art style with inconsistent quality
Plot holes and pointless transitions
Forced expository dialogue
Pointless romance subplots
One-dimensional supporting characters

anime.title: Kai Doh Maru
anime.synopsis: This story takes place during the Heian Period of Japan`s history, when evil spirits still resided in the forests, mountains and rivers. A girl, accompanied by her loved one, battles against these evil spirits, while she is disguised as man. This brave woman, aka "Kaidomaru", with a Chinese character "Flame" tatooed on her upper arm, was one of the "Four Devas". Kaidomaru fights for the honor of her lost love, Raikou Minamotono, who had sacrified his life in order to protect the capital Kyoto, from the evils deeds of a "princess" cursed by a malicious ogre. The princess, whom Kaidomaru used to play with as a child, has now become her ultimate enemy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative, with criticism focused on the confusing and underdeveloped plot, shallow characters, and washed-out visuals. While some appreciate the unique animation style and detailed environments, these aspects are not enough to overcome the narrative issues. Many viewers found the anime boring and difficult to follow, leading to a generally unfavorable reception.
pros: Unique animation style resembling animated scroll paintings with watercolour and pastel glory.
Detailed environments like trees, leaves, and grass.
Well-choreographed action scenes with striking contrast from bright red blood.
cons: Fragmented and disconnected plot due to insufficient time to explore the political intrigues.
Characters are not given enough time to develop, resulting in a lack of emotional connection.
Washed-out colors and disjointed animation at times.
Lack of clear motivation for character actions, leading to a sense of randomness.

anime.title: G-On Riders
anime.synopsis: At Saint Hoshikawa School there is a secret group called the G-On Riders. Students with superior strength and ability are chosen to be in the group, which was formed to fight against alien attacks on the earth. However, many of the problems that the members face are ones amongst themselves, and the same is true for the invaders. And another student at the school, Ichiro, tries desperately to confess his love to Yuki, one of the Riders.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely considered a guilty pleasure due to its heavy reliance on otaku-oriented fanservice and a childish plot. While some may find enjoyment in its collection of fetishes, the show is criticized for its poor animation quality, weak character designs, and lack of substantial narrative depth. It's generally not recommended unless the viewer is specifically seeking a fanservice-heavy experience.
pros: Enjoyable as a guilty pleasure
May appeal to those with specific otaku fetishes
cons: Childish premise
Poorly designed male cast
Constant proportion problems in animation
Lacks substance and depth

anime.title: To Heart 2 Special
anime.synopsis: Special recap episode #11.5.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is mainly a recap episode with commentary, which might disappoint viewers expecting new content. The cover art is considered misleading. However, it offers some unique elements and funny moments, making it worthwhile for dedicated fans willing to revisit the series.
pros: Unique intro and outro sequences.
Genuinely funny reactions from the characters in 'spicier' situations.
cons: Recap episode with mostly already-seen content.
Misleading cover art/marketing (clickbait).
Not recommended for casual viewers.

anime.title: Demon Lord Dante
anime.synopsis: While sleeping one night, Ryo Utsugi had a nightmare of monsters attacking him. One day he learns a mysterious power to let him hear voices and have visions of girls getting killed, but one night he hears the same voice.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the original story and thematic elements but significant criticism for its production quality, pacing, and character development. Many find it entertaining specifically as a product of Go Nagai's style, while others consider it a poorly executed adaptation. The show is seen as having potential that ultimately falls short due to its various flaws.
pros: Original and interesting story
Creepy elements similar to Doomed Megalopolis and Devilman
Entertaining for fans of Go Nagai's style
cons: Poor animation and budget quality
Mediocre music and voice acting
Boring or confusing plot progression with filler
Weak characters and dialogue
Inconsistent pacing and irrelevant plot points
anime.thematic_vibe: Occult Horror, Religious Conflict, Body Horror

anime.title: The Devil Lady
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Psychological, Seinen, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Fudo Jun is a beautiful supermodel who is idolized by many. She also has a dark secret that not even she knows about at first, for within her veins run the genes that hold the next step in the evolution of mankind. The same blood as the beastlike superhumans that terrorize the city. Unlike the rest of them, though, Jun has managed to hold a tenuous grip onto her humanity, and she is recruited by the mysterious Asuka Ran, member of a secret organization within the government, aimed at controlling, if not eliminating, these berserk destroyers of mankind. Jun, as Devilman Lady, must now exterminate her own kind, but how much longer can she keep her sanity in a situation she never chose in the first place?
anime.consensus_summary: Devilman Lady is praised for its intense and thought-provoking story, exploring themes of humanity and identity. However, some find the animation inconsistent and the plot disjointed. Despite these flaws, the show is generally considered a must-see for fans of dark and mature anime.
pros: Intensely deep story that asks questions about the human condition.
Rich story with real characters and palpable atmosphere.
Grim story that escalates with unexpected conclusions.
Exploration of mental toll on Jun and development as a character.
Haunting music builds suspense.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and detail due to low budget.
Some monster-of-the-week episodes feel irrelevant to the overall arc.
Vagueness with mythical aspects of the plot.
The ending was disappointing to some viewers.
Disjointed feel between the episodic first half and the serialized second half.

anime.title: Sugar Sugar Rune
anime.synopsis:
Chocolat Meilleure and Vanilla Mieux are both witches and childhood friends, pitted against each other in a contest to see who will become the next queen of the Magic World! In order to win, the two queen candidates must attend school in the human world, cultivating relationships to bring out their classmates hearts of friendship and love... But if a witch gives their heart to a human, they'll die?! 

In an exciting adventure filled with transformations, mystery, jealousy, and romance, join Chocolat and Vanilla as they work alongside their knights to protect the kingdom from the threat of the Ogres and do their best to become the next queen!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Sugar Sugar Rune is well-received as an enjoyable and heartwarming magical girl anime with strong themes of friendship and romance. While some find the plot and characters deeply engaging and emotionally resonant, others critique the inconsistent animation and uneven pacing. Despite these drawbacks, the show's creativity, charming characters, and positive messages make it a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre.
pros: Creative and original storyline that blends magical girl elements with deeper themes of friendship, jealousy, and love.
Beautiful art style and generally good animation, with character designs and expressions enhancing the emotional impact.
Memorable music and voice acting that matches the personalities of the characters, adding to the overall enjoyment.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with some distortions and repeating actions that detract from the visual experience.
Uneven pacing and tone shifts, particularly in the latter half of the series, which can feel rushed or disjointed.
Some character writing can feel shallow or underdeveloped, especially with Vanilla, who is sometimes relegated to a supporting role.

anime.title: UFO Ultramaiden Valkyrie 4: Banquet of Time, Dreams, and Galaxies
anime.romaji_title: UFO Princess Valkyrie 4: Toki to Yume to Ginga no Utage
anime.synopsis: The strange and magical events of the last season have left Kazuto with two Valkyries. He now finds himself living with and looking after both a teenaged-princess Valkyrie, as well as the child-princess Valkyrie! And they still have not yet gotten married...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is overwhelmingly disappointed with the ending of 'UFO Princess Valkyrie 4'. The primary complaint revolves around the lack of resolution to the central romantic plot, specifically the repeated failure to depict a wedding between Kazuto and Valkyrie. The ending is described as unsatisfying and leaving many questions unanswered, ultimately diminishing the enjoyment of the entire series.
cons: Unsatisfying ending
Unresolved plot points
Lack of closure on romantic relationships
Failed expectation of a wedding

anime.title: Nerima Daikon Brothers
anime.synopsis:
In the town of Nerima, the boisterous Hideki and his stoic brother Ichiro run a daikon radish farm along with Mako, their bubbly but vain cousin. The three dream of raising the money needed to build their own concert hall, where their band—Nerima Daikon Brothers—would perform and hopefully rise to stardom. But their farm and Ichiro's host club job aren't raising money fast enough for their liking, leading them to resort to get-rich-quick schemes.

Their plans usually involve tracking down evil-doers and then stealing their ill-gotten gains. Yet, while they usually do put a stop to the villains, they always end the day no richer than before. However, neither these failures nor interference from the policewoman Yukika Karakuri can come between this trio and their dream! With help from gadgets provided by the rental shop owner Nabeshin, the Nerima Daikon Brothers get themselves into and out of all kinds of ridiculous situations through their boisterous singing and comedy.
anime.consensus_summary: Nerima Daikon Brothers is a divisive anime with a strong emphasis on absurdist humor and musical elements. While some viewers find its zany energy and catchy songs highly entertaining, others are turned off by its repetitive nature, crude jokes, and reliance on dated references. The show is appreciated for its uniqueness but criticized for its lack of depth and inconsistent quality.
pros: Unique and zany humor
Catchy and well-written songs, especially in the dub
Memorable characters and over-the-top visuals
cons: Repetitive formula and recycled musical numbers
Crude humor that can get old quickly
Outdated political commentary and cultural references

anime.title: Puppet Princess
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Horror, Martial Arts, Samurai, Shounen
anime.synopsis: In an obscure corner of feudal Japan, a clumsy young girl carrying a massive box searches for a legendary ninja. That girl is Rangiku Ayawatari—the sole survivor of the Ayuwatari clan—and she seeks revenge against Lord Sadayoshi Karimata, the man who slaughtered her family and stole the secrets of her father's prized puppet collection. However, in place of the legendary ninja, Rangiku finds Yasaburou Manajiri, a vagabond who is being pursued by "deathless ninjas"—strange, fearless warriors who can survive seemingly fatal blows. Upon discovering that they share a common enemy, the pair team up to defeat the cruel lord and rid the world of strange puppets that conceal a horrible secret.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Karakuri no Kimi' is viewed as a short but entertaining watch, excelling in action and animation. Some find the story and characters intriguing, while others feel it lacks depth due to its limited runtime. The dated animation style and sound design are minor drawbacks, but the brisk pacing and fun concept make it a worthwhile experience for fans of feudal Japan anime.
pros: Beautiful animation, especially in motion and movement.
Brisk pacing that doesn't drag.
Interesting dynamic between main characters.
Enjoyable action sequences.
Fun concept with alright execution
cons: Lacking emotional depth and character development due to short runtime.
Mediocre sound design.
Animation style may appear dated.
Thematic elements not fully explored.

anime.title: Mai-Otome Specials
anime.synopsis: Specials that followed on the Mai-Otome DVD.
anime.consensus_summary: The Mai-Otome Specials are primarily aimed at existing fans of the franchise and Mai-Hime. They provide short, comedic skits and fanservice featuring familiar characters. While not essential viewing, they offer a lighthearted and nostalgic experience for those already invested in the series. Viewers should not expect a deep or meaningful narrative.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the main series.
Features important characters in comedy skits.
Includes characters from Mai-Hime.
cons: Not important to the overall plot.
Not a comedy masterpiece, a bit silly.
Franchise fans will appreciate the anime.

anime.title: Kurogane Communication
anime.synopsis:
In the aftermath of a great and terrible war, Haruka finds herself the last surviving human on Earth. Though humanity may have been wiped out, she is not entirely alone. Advanced robots have survived the apocalypse, and Haruka lives with five who care for her: Spike, a boyish android who is very attached to her; Trigger, hot-tempered with a penchant for firearms; Cleric, the intelligent problem solver; Reeves, whose thoughtfulness overshadows his intimidating appearance; and Angela, a sword wielding recluse with an aversion towards humans. Residing in a high-rise building at the center of the city, Haruka lives a relatively peaceful life with her mechanical family.

However, her life is far from a stable one. Not only is a lack of resources a concern, but violent, remnant robots from the war roam free, ready to destroy whomever they meet. Kurogane Communication follows Haruka as she tries to survive in an apocalyptic world while facing many dangers that will challenge her daily life.
anime.consensus_summary: Kurogane Communication is a generally well-received anime appreciated for its heartwarming story, engaging characters, and positive outlook in a post-apocalyptic setting. However, some critics point out issues with underdeveloped worldbuilding, overly human-like robots, and animation inconsistencies. While not a masterpiece, it's considered an enjoyable and memorable series, especially for fans of slice-of-life and sci-fi anime from the 90s.
pros: Heartwarming story with positive spin on post-apocalyptic setting
Well-developed characters with organic interactions
Effective use of limited episode time for narrative flow
Memorable music that enhances emotional impact
cons: Underdeveloped worldbuilding and vague plot background
Robots are too human-like, blurring the line between robot and human
Animation quality is subpar at times, especially in action scenes
Some characters are underdeveloped or fall into predictable molds
Wasted potential for exploring deeper themes about artificial intelligence

anime.title: Babel II: Beyond Infinity
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Mystery, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Life seems simple for Kouichi, a young student, until he learns that he is the reincarnation of an alien protector who crashed onto the mantle of responsibility as "defender of the Earth," Kouichi/Babel teams up with a trio of super-powered alien companions to battle the the dark forces of an evil cult leader. The war to save humanity takes Babel from the deserts of southern Asia to the upper east side of Manhattan and ultimately to a final showdown with "the master" in a hidden base nestled in the Swiss Alps. The action is fast-paced and deadly. The fate of the world rests in the ability of this courageous youth to tame his latent psychic power and use it to defeat the enemies of mankind.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with disappointment stemming from the 2001 remake compared to the 1992 OVA.  While some appreciate the expanded story and exploration of characters' capabilities, the stiff animation, toned-down character designs, and nonsensical plot were major drawbacks. One review highlights the show's flaws as so profound that they border on genius, while the other admits to enjoying the expanded scope despite the technical shortcomings.
pros: More open and wider extent of the franchise, showing more of what both good and bad guys are capable of.
Expanded story compared to the original OVA.
cons: Stiff and static animation compared to the 90s OVA.
Kid-friendly designs that tone down mature or vicious elements.
Plot is nonsensical and relies on Deus ex Machina.
Fights are boring due to lack of movement and unclear attack distinctions.

anime.title: Barom 1
anime.synopsis: Takeshi Kido and Kentaro Shiratori are a pair of friends who have been together for almost their entire life. One night, a strange being comes out from the lake and starts attacking them. When Takeshi and Kentaro are almost eliminated, a strange being named Kopu calls them and tells them that they are the chosen ones to inherit the power to protect the world from an evil being named Goumon. Now, they join their hands to transform into Barom One, a being with superior skills, who will fight to protect the city.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Barom One is viewed as a poorly executed reimagining of an obscure manga. Critics highlight its low production values, weak character writing, and outdated art style. While some viewers found the story intriguing and enjoyed the main characters, the consensus is that the anime is riddled with flaws and not worth watching, unless for ironic enjoyment of its mistakes.
pros: Intriguing story (for some viewers)
Main duo is likeable (for some viewers)
cons: Lowest production values
Barebones character writing
Bad animation that gets worse
Crusty early-2000's art direction
Generic action heroes
Uninteresting side characters
Baffling background details and production mistakes
Poor pacing
anime.thematic_vibe: Generic Action, Low Production Value, Obscure Manga Adaptation

anime.title: Beyblade G Revolution
anime.synopsis: After keeping their BitBeasts out of harm's way, a new world championship tournament is announced, but the defending champions can't all be on the same team. Their friendship will be tested and tried as each Bladebreaker goes on a quest to prove why they are the best Beyblader around. Tyson, Max, Ray, Kai, and newcomer Daichi, must keep up their winning ways...even if they must face each other. But, after the tournament is over, what awaits them is an old foe, Boris, taking over the BBA and transforming it into BEGA, the Beyblade Entertainment Global Association. To save Beybladers of the entire world from BEGA's corruption, the Bladebreakers must reunite once again...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Bakuten Shoot Beyblade G Revolution' as a strong and satisfying conclusion to the original series. Reviewers praise the improved animation, character development, and exciting battles. While some criticize the predictable plot and underutilization of past characters, the overall sentiment is positive, highlighting the series' ability to evoke nostalgia and provide an enjoyable experience.
pros: Improved animation and art style compared to previous seasons.
Well-developed characters with noticeable growth and emotional depth.
Engaging tournament arcs with exciting and impactful battles.
Soundtrack is considered the best in the series with well-fitting music.
cons: Some characters from previous seasons are excluded or have reduced roles.
Story can be predictable with reliance on the power of friendship trope.
Some character designs are not as appealing as in previous seasons.
The second arc feels rushed and some character motivations are unclear.

anime.title: Beyblade V-Force
anime.synopsis: The Bladebreakers have to join forces once again because a mysterious group under the lead of Oozuma has defeated them, but the real enemy is not Oozuma. The real threath is formed by a group of people who use cyber-BitBeasts to capture the original ones from the Bladebreakers.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Bakuten Shoot Beyblade 2002 is highly divided, particularly among fans of the first season. Many find the plot incoherent, the characters annoying or poorly developed, and the art style a step down. However, some appreciate the improved visuals in later seasons and enjoy the soundtrack, creating a sense of nostalgia mixed with disappointment.
pros: Improved art style in later seasons (Seasons 2 and 3)
Catchy and upbeat soundtrack, primarily rock genre
The concept of controlling ancient beasts with technology is appealing.
cons: Incoherent and poorly written story
Inconsistent character design, characters look younger than in previous seasons
Generic and uninspired music
Annoying and poorly designed new characters
Main character Tyson becomes more bratty and annoying
Unnecessary and irritating cheerleader character (Hilary)
Chibi art style is a downgrade from the original season

anime.title: Captain Tsubasa J
anime.synopsis: The first 34 episodes are a summary of the previous series. In the first new episodes a new character, Shingo Aoi, (playing in Italy) is introduced. After that, the World Cup begins, this time with extraordinary new countries like Sweden, Thailand, and Uzbekistan.
anime.consensus_summary: Captain Tsubasa J is a mixed bag for fans. While the new content and character development, particularly around Shingo Aoi, are praised, the extensive recap of the original series and the abrupt ending are major drawbacks. The improved graphics and music are appreciated, but some find the animation and soundtrack inferior to the original series. Overall, it's a decent watch for fans of the franchise, but the incomplete narrative leaves much to be desired.
pros: Character development of Shingo Aoi is well done
Graphics and music are better than the 80s version
The new episodes (35 onward) are fantastic, especially the internal feud and the match vs Thailand
Character designs are well-drawn
Faithful to the manga story from the 90s
cons: First 33 episodes are recaps of the original series
Animation is different and not as easy on the eyes as the original
Series stops abruptly when the story gets interesting, leaving fans with a bitter taste
Music, while good, is disappointing compared to the original
The ending leaves on a cliffhanger

anime.title: Transformers Armada
anime.romaji_title: Chou Robot Seimeitai Transformers Micron Densetsu
anime.synopsis: On the mechanical planet of Cybertron live super robotic organisms known as Transformers. There, mainly consisting of convoys, the Cybertron army, and their old enemy Destron fell into conflict to gain hold of a new power to join their side. A new breed of Transformers known as the Microns. But, grieving over the battle the Microns set off to the other end of the universe. 4 million years later, on Earth, 3 young children activated a mysterious panel inside a cave. And somehow, that was the dormant Micron...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, driven primarily by nostalgia. While the animation and dubbing are heavily criticized, Starscream's character arc and the latter part of the story are highlights. The series is seen as decent, especially for a toy-selling anime, with some finding enjoyment in the characters and overall plot despite its flaws.
pros: Starscream's character arc is compelling and well-executed.
The latter half of the series, particularly the Unicron battles, is gripping and fast-paced.
Some voice acting is praised, especially Starscream's menacing tone.
Soundtrack and openings are catchy and memorable.
cons: Animation quality is poor, with frequent errors and a rushed feel.
Dubbing errors and inconsistencies in names.
Repetitive and predictable plot in the first half.
Annoying and largely useless human characters.
Inconsistent characterization of Optimus Prime/Convoy.
Cheesy and clunky dialogue.

anime.title: Cosmo Warrior Zero
anime.synopsis: The long war between the planet Earth and the machine men is finally over, resulting in a peace that is more a victory for the machine men than the Earth. Warrius Zero lost his family in the war to the machine men but despite this he is still is a member of the Earth fleet that is now working in concert with the machine men. His ship, made up of both humans and machine men, has been given a near impossible task: capture the space pirate Captain Harlock. While Zero struggles to accomplish this task, evidence begins to surface that the peace between machine men and Earth may not be as it seems...
anime.consensus_summary: Cosmo Warrior Zero is viewed as a mediocre entry in the Leijiverse, suffering from a rushed and disjointed plot and average animation. The English dub is a highlight, but the series overall is only recommended for fans of the Leijiverse aesthetic. Its unique blend of melodrama and space opera elements may appeal to some, while others find it strange or silly.
pros: Excellent English dub, especially the lead actors like Crispin Freeman and Steve Blum.
Matsumoto Leiji's distinct character designs are a high point.
The inclusion of Emeraldas as a character is a positive.
cons: Disjointed and rushed story, feeling like too much content crammed into too few episodes.
Vague setup and poor world-building, particularly regarding the relationship between Humans and Machine Men.
Animation quality is mediocre and typical for a 20-year-old series.
Music is middle of the road, with a forgettable opening and a nonsensical ending theme.

anime.title: Cyborg 009
anime.synopsis:
Skull, the evil leader of the terrorist organization known as Black Ghost, has nine powerful cyborgs under his control. But Dr. Isaac Gilmore, the Black Ghosts cybernetics scientist, decides to go rogue, helping the cyborgs turn against Skull and his evil organization.

Black Ghost wishes to start the next major world war by flooding the market with weapons of mass destruction. It seems the nine brave cyborgs have their work cut out for them, as Black Ghost is determined to bring those nine cyborgs down.
anime.consensus_summary: Cyborg 009: The Cyborg Soldier is a classic anime with a timeless story appreciated for its emotional depth, universal themes, and impactful music. However, some viewers find fault in inconsistent character designs, forgettable villains, and a sometimes-lacking English dub. Overall, it's considered a valuable anime experience despite its flaws, appealing to both nostalgic fans and new audiences.
pros: Iconic sound design and soundtrack.
Good messages for both younger and older audiences.
Exploration of universal themes like war, poverty, and family.
Well-done fight choreography and sakuga parts.
cons: English dub may have censorship and altered dialogue.
Forgettable villains besides Black Ghost.
Characters may feel like tokens with weak chemistry.
Inconsistent character designs.
Voice acting may lack emotion.

anime.title: Green Green Character DVD
anime.synopsis:
This entry includes episodes with original footage released on Green Green Character DVD volumes:

Character DVD #1 - Midori & Reika
Character DVD #2 - Futaba & Chigusa
Character DVD #3 - Sanae & Wakaba
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views this as extra content that leans heavily into softcore hentai and fan service. While some appreciate this direction, others find it lacking in satisfying climaxes and coherent storytelling. The content is generally seen as a bonus for fans of the original series who are interested in the more explicit themes.
pros: Delivers well on its intention of being softcore hentai.
The reviewer enjoys the extra content and watches all of it.
cons: Scenes often fail to reach a proper climax.
Sappy endings that make no sense.
Sexual content may be out of character for some characters.

anime.title: Baldr Force Exe Resolution
anime.synopsis:
Any network runs all over the world, and the development of the information network reaches its acme. In this age, there are two developed worlds; "the real world" and "wired", or the virtual network world.

Soma Toru belongs to a hacking group, Steppen Wolf, which runs around the network world freely. They attack the database of the UN forces as their last work. During this attack, he loses Nonomura Yuya, his friend as well as the team leader. Toru is arrested by the army. In exchange for letting him free, he has to work for an anti-hacker organization, the first squad of the UN Security Force Information Administration Bureau.

Working for them, he is looking for the person who killed his friend, while the other members also have their own reason to fight.

The three-way fights of the terrorist group, the security enterprise, and the army, continue every day. The various events occurred during the fight seem to be independent of each other at the first glance, but they're converging on one event as if they were attracted by something. 

Based on the game by GIGA.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the action, music, and cyberpunk setting, while others criticize the derivative plot, rushed pacing, and underdeveloped characters. The series is considered a worthwhile but flawed adaptation of the source material, appealing to those who enjoy cyberpunk themes but potentially disappointing those seeking originality or depth. There is a notable divide between those familiar with the visual novel and those new to the franchise.
pros: Good CG animation and soundtrack.
Well-drawn characters and backgrounds.
Opening and ending themes are good.
cons: Rushed character development and storyline.
Plot is not original; borrows from other series.
Mediocre CGI and artwork.

anime.title: Di Gi Charat Nyo
anime.synopsis: Di Gi Charat (a.k.a. Dejiko) - along with Petit Charat (a.k.a. Puchiko) and Gema - travels to Earth as part of her training to become a full-fledged princess. They crash on a small town in Japan, where they meet the Omocha brothers (who spend most of their time thinking how cute Puchiko is) and Mr. & Mrs. Ankoro (an elderly couple that makes Japanese sweets).
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Di Gi Charat Nyo is considered an entertaining and decent remake, particularly for fans of the original series. While the story isn't revolutionary and some production aspects are lacking, its humor and returning characters are appreciated. The incomplete licensing and inconsistent subtitles are the primary sources of frustration for viewers, but the series is generally well-received as a lighthearted and enjoyable anime.
pros: Faithful to the original Di Gi Charat series.
Catchy opening, ending, and insert songs.
Enjoyable characters, including returning favorites and new additions like Aqua and Yu-Rei.
cons: Story is not groundbreaking and lacks depth.
Background music is not memorable.
Incomplete licensing and poor quality fansubs for later episodes.
Animation can be inconsistent.

anime.title: .Koni-chan
anime.synopsis: Koni (whose character is based on the famous Sumo-wrestler) and his gang have lots of crazy and incoherent adventures in their town. From fighting with their "Lovely-Teacher" and dealing with Samurai fish, to confirming if "The Armored-Guy's" wife has an affair and saving the world, Koni, High, Moro, Nari and Afro, the Afro-dog, do the craziest and funniest things to have fun.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, especially among viewers who watched the Latin American dubbed version, which is praised for its humor and cultural references. The show's energetic and random nature is a major draw, although the lack of a coherent plot and simple art style are noted as minor drawbacks. Viewers express a strong desire for more content, indicating high overall satisfaction.
pros: Hilarious and intelligent humor, especially in Latin American dubs.
Memorable and likable characters with unique quirks.
High rewatch value due to the energetic and funny nature of the show.
cons: Lack of coherent story or main plot.
Art style can be simple or lazy at times.
Humor may be heavily dependent on understanding Latin American/Mexican culture, potentially limiting enjoyment for other audiences.

anime.title: Duel Masters
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Kids, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
The world of Duel Masters is one of five great civilizations. Through a card game, duelists can bring these worlds into existence, making what was previously abstract into reality. These skilled duelists are known as Kaijudo masters.

Shobu Kirifuda is the best player at his local playground, and seeks to become a world-class master like his father. His first step on the road to conquest begins with winning a local tournament. Rather, it should have, except he is destroyed by the best Kaijudo master in the world, Knight. Shobu loses, but upon remembering the words of wisdom his father instilled into him, decides to continue on the road of becoming a duelist who can enjoy the game for what it is. And so begins his journey to victory－and as we all know, the journey is the most important part!
anime.consensus_summary: Duel Masters evokes mixed reactions. Some appreciate the nostalgia and humor, particularly in the English dub, and the engaging card game mechanics. However, many criticize the low production quality, repetitive plot, and weak character development. The show seems to appeal more to younger audiences or those already invested in the Duel Masters card game.
pros: Enjoyable for younger audiences
The card game itself is fun and well-made
English dub is humorous and self-aware, adding entertainment value
Some find the battles and monster designs visually appealing
cons: Animation quality is often poor and outdated
Story and character development are lacking
Repetitive battle sequences become stale
Seen as a Yu-Gi-Oh rip-off
Inconsistent adherence to card game rules in the anime

anime.title: Bleach the Movie: Memories of Nobody
anime.synopsis:
When a life ends, its soul departs to its final resting place known as the Soul Society. However, if a soul is left to wander in the human world for too long, it ends up turning into a corrupted "Hollow" that feeds on other souls. In such cases, spirits called "Soul Reapers" are needed to eliminate the Hollows and guide the lost souls to the Soul Society.

Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki are two Soul Reapers who are used to dealing with Hollows that appear in Karakura Town. But when they encounter the hostile "Blanks"—souls devoid of memories and immune to the "soul burial" used by Reapers—they are thrown for a loop. Senna, a fellow Reaper that neither Ichigo or Rukia are familiar with, comes to their rescue and manages to fend off the Blanks. The mystery deepens when a mirage of the human world suddenly appears over Soul Society. What could be the reason behind the strange phenomena, and how is it connected to Senna, who avoids any questions about her identity?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is notably divided. While many praise the film's emotional depth, stunning animation, and the introduction of the compelling character Senna, a significant portion criticizes its predictable plot, generic villains, and weak world-building that feels like a rehash of existing Bleach arcs. The film evokes strong emotional responses, both positive and negative, regarding its narrative quality and originality.
pros: Beautiful animation and graphics, comparable to Hayao Miyazaki's work
Touching and emotional story with good character development, particularly for Senna
Moving soundtrack and voice acting, enhancing the emotional impact
Engaging plot with mystery and existential themes that keep viewers curious
cons: Predictable story that closely mirrors the Soul Society arc, making it feel unoriginal
Weak villains who are generic and forgettable, lacking genuine threat
Pacing issues, with large portions of the movie feeling boring and drawn-out
Tacked-on cosmology that doesn't mesh well with the established Bleach universe

anime.title: Nanatsu-iro★Drops
anime.synopsis: Tsuwabuki is a normal student, though not very social. One day he meets a new transfer student, named Sumomo Akihime, and another girl, both the only members of the gardening club. Tsuwabuki is forced by a teacher to join this club. But then he bumps into a strange guy with dog ears, switching his drink with they guy's by mistake. Drinking it, he is turned in a stuffed animal. The teacher tells him that the only way to turn back to normal is to find the chosen girl and let her catch the seven stardrops. This girl is Sumomo, that accepts to help him, though she's not allowed to know the animal's true identity.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Nanatsu-iro★Drops for its cute and heartwarming romance, forgiving its predictable plot and simplistic characters. Many find the art style appealing and the story a pleasant, if not particularly original, experience. While some critique the underdeveloped magical girl elements and repetitive character traits, the overall sentiment is positive, with many viewers finding it a sweet and enjoyable anime.
pros: Cute and colorful art style, reminiscent of Noizi Ito's designs
Focus on the pure and innocent romance between the main characters
Heartwarming story that can be a remedy for depression
cons: Predictable and clichéd story elements
Overly simplistic characters, especially Sumomo's excessive crying
Weak magical girl aspects with underdeveloped spells and action sequences

anime.title: 5 Centimeters per Second
anime.synopsis:
What happens when two people love each other but just aren't meant to be together? Takaki Toono and Akari Shinohara are childhood friends, but circumstances beyond their control tear them apart. They promise to stay in contact, and although the progression of time widens the distance between them, the chain of memories remains ever-present.

Byousoku 5 Centimeter is a romantic drama that focuses on the mundane and harsh reality of long-distance relationships. Stuck in the past and unable to make any new memories, Takaki and Akari cling to the hope of seeing each other again. They live their everyday lives half-heartedly, both hurting themselves and the people around them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with many praising the film's visual beauty and emotional themes, while others criticize its shallow characters, lack of plot development, and slow pacing. Some viewers find the film deeply moving and relatable, while others find it boring and failing to meet high expectations. The film's artistic merits are generally acknowledged, but its narrative shortcomings leave some viewers disappointed.
pros: Stunning animation and detailed backgrounds create an immersive visual experience.
Soundtrack effectively amplifies the emotional mood, particularly through piano pieces.
Exploration of distance, both physical and emotional, resonates with many viewers.
cons: Characters are underdeveloped and lack depth, making it difficult to connect with them emotionally.
Story lacks proper closure and can feel anti-climactic, leaving viewers wanting more plot and character development.
Pacing issues and a predictable plot can lead to boredom and a sense of repetition.

anime.title: Bokurano
anime.genres: Drama, Mecha, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
As fifteen children at a summer camp enjoy their carefree vacation together, they stumble upon a small cave near the beach. The group finds a mysterious room deep within its caverns, where they meet a strange man who calls himself Kokopelli. The man invites the children to play a game that involves taking turns controlling a robot to protect the Earth against aliens. Thinking it might be an interesting computer game, all but one of the children sign a contract agreeing to play.

Later that day, the giant robot appears in person and the children are teleported into its cockpit, where they find Kokopelli, who pilots a fight against a similar robotic creature that has appeared nearby. After winning the battle, Kokopelli tries to apologize but is interrupted as the children are teleported back to the ground in the midst of the carnage.

As the bewilderment following the fight settles, the robot suddenly disappears and the children are left scared and confused. Despite seeming like a harmless game at first, the children never anticipated the stakes of this game and how their pasts would intertwine with their decisions going forward.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Bokurano are notably divided. While many appreciate its dark themes, character-driven narratives, and exploration of complex issues, others are put off by the inconsistent animation, pacing problems, and heavy reliance on depressing content. The series evokes strong emotional responses, leading to polarized views on its overall quality and enjoyment.
pros: Compelling character-driven narratives with unique backstories.
Exploration of complex moral and psychological issues.
Haunting and well-suited opening theme (Uninstall) that enhances the anime's atmosphere.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with noticeable and often jarring CGI during mecha battles.
Pacing issues, particularly in the latter part of the series where some character arcs are less engaging.
Overabundance of characters prevents deeper investment and development.

anime.title: Kaze no Stigma
anime.synopsis:
Kazuma Yagami is a user of "Fuujutsu," the ability to control the wind. He returns to his old home, the noble Kannagi household, after being banished four years ago for his inability to control fire and his subsequent defeat in a duel at the hands of his younger cousin, Ayano Kannagi.

Returning after such a brutal exile already gives rise to many conflicts, but to make matters worse, several Kannagi family members have recently been murdered with Fuujutsu. This leads the Kannagi family, including the hot-headed Ayano, to suspect Kazuma as the culprit. Now, Kazuma must not only clear his name, but also aid the family he shares a mutual hatred with, in order to discover the true identity of the killer.
anime.consensus_summary: Kaze no Stigma is a generally enjoyable anime, especially for fans of action, romance, and magic. While praised for its characters and fight scenes, it suffers from a predictable plot, inconsistent animation, and an uninspired soundtrack. Many viewers find it a fun but ultimately forgettable series, while others are disappointed by the lack of originality and a perceived incomplete ending.
pros: Enjoyable characters with good development, particularly the main leads.
Well-animated fight scenes and visually pleasing magic effects.
Balanced mix of comedy, action, and romance elements.
cons: Predictable storyline with common anime tropes and cliches.
Inconsistent animation quality and re-used scenes.
Uninspired music and sound effects.
Lack of originality and incomplete/unsatisfying ending for some viewers.

anime.title: Reideen
anime.synopsis: Saiga is a normal high school student with a gift in mathematics. His daily routine is disrupted when his family gets news that his Father's remains have been discovered—a noted archeologist and researcher who had gone missing while exploring a site many years before. Among his remains were notes and artifacts that needed to be identified by the family near a notable triangular mountain in Japan known as "Japan's pyramid", a place suspected by some to be man-made. A meteor containing a strange robotic lifeform falls from the sky and begins to cause destruction, putting Saiga in danger and causing a mysterious bracelet from his father's research to activate and merge him with an ancient robot burried within the pyramid—a robot the runes describe as Reideen. It is now up to Saiga and guardian Reideen to fight against this unknown alien threat from the sky.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the animation, music, and political intrigue elements that emerge later in the series. However, many are critical of the slow pacing, reliance on deus ex machina, uninspired characters, and poor mech action sequences. The show requires patience and investment, which may not be worth it for many viewers.
pros: Excellent CG animation work on the mecha and alien weaponry.
Fluid mecha battle scenes.
Good number of tense musical tracks fitting for the show's serious mood.
Interesting plot about factions struggling for control of Reideen.
Exploration of how competing incentives within the military-industrial complex can lead to irrational decision-making.
cons: Story relies on deus ex machina.
Poor job of fleshing out major story elements and characters.
Alien motives lack depth.
Slow, plodding mech action scenes with terrible CGI.
Frequent reuse of animation in mech scenes.
Drab color palette drains energy from the show.
Midorino's character is underdeveloped despite being heavily featured in advertising.

anime.title: IDOLM@STER Xenoglossia
anime.synopsis: 107 years ago, the Moon was destroyed in a massive cataclysm that shattered Earth's former satellite into 81 quintillion tons of orbital debris. However, thanks to super-science, the Earth itself was saved and today no one really thinks much about that century-past disaster. Which is why when teenage Haruka Amami auditions for something called the Idolmaster Project, she THINKS she's trying out to be a singing idol. Instead, Haruka finds herself at a secret school run by the Mondenkind Agency, living with a group of other girls who have also been selected as candidates to pilot an iDOL - an advanced robot specifically designed to intercept falling chunks of moon rock. Except, the people who run the Mondenkind Agency aren't exactly knights in shining armor. And then there's the question of whether the iDOLs are really JUST robots. Because from almost the first moment, Haruka starts to feel emotions resonating from within the iDOL called Imber.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling that Xenoglossia is a decent but flawed mecha anime. Some viewers appreciate the focus on character development and unique mecha designs, while others are disappointed by the slow pacing, convoluted plot, and deviation from the original iDOLM@STER characters. Overall, it's considered an underrated series that might appeal to mecha fans who can overlook its shortcomings.
pros: Strong character development, especially in the first half
Unique and appealing mechanical designs
Catchy OPs and EDs
cons: Plot can be ridiculous and convoluted
Inconsistent pacing, with a slow first half
Weak mecha action, especially in the first half
Character personalities are twisted compared to the original iDOLM@STER series
Unexplained plot points and character details

anime.title: Les Misérables: Shoujo Cosette
anime.synopsis:
In 19th century France, a struggling single mother, Fantine, leaves her three-year-old daughter Cosette in the care of her new acquaintances, the Thernadiers. Unfortunately, Cosette's caretakers prove to be anything but loving, and the poor girl is subjected to repeated abuse and forced servitude. Still, she endures the torment in the hopes of seeing her mother once again.

One night, while doing errands for her host family, Cosette is assisted by an honorable stranger named Jean Valjean. After a brief conversation with the young girl, Jean acknowledges her as the type of person he has been seeking and rescues her from the clutches of the Thernadiers. They make their way to a nearby town where Cosette enjoys a new life thanks to her savior.

Under Jean's guidance, Cosette promises to help others with her newfound freedom. She pledges to heal the nation, ensuring that no one else suffers her fate. Though the road ahead is paved with tragedies left by the French Revolution, this idealistic girl will not rest until France is freed from poverty and suffering.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences appreciate the anime's faithfulness to the Les Misérables story, especially given its child-friendly target. However, some viewers find the animation and certain plot changes detract from the original's depth. While some appreciate the lighter tone, others find it too simplistic and less impactful than the novel.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material, especially considering it's geared towards children.
Well-portrayed characters that stay true to the original novel's personalities.
Effective storytelling that evokes emotion and highlights valuable life lessons.
cons: Animation quality is lacking and looks dated.
Some plot changes and character survivals are deemed unnecessary and cheesy, diluting the original's impact.
Simplistic and repetitive storytelling at times, aimed too much at children, leaving little to the imagination.

anime.title: Murder Princess
anime.synopsis:
After a sudden coup d'etat by the court scientist Dr. Akamashi results in the king's death, Princess Alita Castilia Arago Forland is forced to flee the capital. During her mad dash for survival deep into the forest, Alita collides with the brutal and temperamental bounty hunter Falis, which causes the two women to magically switch bodies.

Using her original body as collateral, Alita convinces Falis—and her henchmen Dominikov and Pete—to help take back the capital from the treasonous scientist by pretending to be the real princess. However, while the plan was initially successful, the only diplomacy Falis knows is with her sword. Alita must now work hard to make sure the kingdom is not trading one royal scandal for another, all while the two displaced women look for a way to return to their original bodies.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Murder Princess' is viewed as a fun, action-oriented OVA that is best enjoyed for its fast pace and fight scenes. However, the series is criticized for its predictable plot, shallow character development, and sometimes jarring mix of sci-fi and fantasy. It's generally recommended for viewers seeking a short, entertaining action romp rather than a deep or innovative story.
pros: Fast-paced and action-oriented, delivering thrills efficiently.
Soundtrack, particularly the electric guitar music, complements the action.
Unique character designs.
cons: Plot is predictable and lacks depth.
Character development is limited due to the short length.
The blend of sci-fi and fantasy elements can feel awkward.

anime.title: Nodame Cantabile
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Josei, Music, Performing Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Shinichi Chiaki is a first class musician whose dream is to play among the elites in Europe. Coming from a distinguished family, he is an infamous perfectionist—not only is he highly critical of himself, but of others as well. The only thing stopping Shinichi from leaving for Europe is his fear of flying. As a result, he's grounded in Japan.

During his fourth year at Japan's top music university, Shinichi happens to meet Megumi Noda or, as she refers to herself, Nodame. On the surface, she seems to be an unkempt girl with no direction in life. However, when Shinichi hears Nodame play the piano for the first time, he is in awe of the kind of music she creates. Nevertheless, Shinichi is dismayed to discover that Nodame is his neighbor, and worse, she ends up falling head over heels in love with him.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Nodame Cantabile is well-received for its beautiful classical music, charming characters, and heartwarming story about growth and passion. While the animation quality is a common point of criticism, the engaging narrative and unique character dynamics outweigh the technical shortcomings for most viewers. The audience generally finds the series enjoyable and inspiring.
pros: Outstanding classical music integration and appreciation.
Well-developed and relatable characters with significant growth.
Refreshing and impeccably timed humor woven into the narrative.
cons: Plain art and awkward CG animation, especially during musical sequences.
Some side characters are developed and then abandoned.
Inconsistent story direction in the early episodes.

anime.title: Romeo x Juliet
anime.synopsis:
On the floating continent of Neo Verona, the Montague family slaughters the entire Capulet family and seizes control of the kingdom. The true heir to the throne, Juliet Fiammata Asto Capulet, manages to escape the onslaught and is hidden away by loyalists for 14 years with hope that she may one day overthrow the cruel Montague regime. 

Despite having forgotten the murder of her entire family, Juliet now secretly protects the oppressed citizens of Neo Verona as a vigilante called the Red Whirlwind. During one of her escapades she meets Romeo Candorebanto Montague, the kind and selfless son of the tyrannical Prince Laertes Montague, and without knowledge of each other's background, they both fall in love at first sight. 

Unfortunately, however, their destiny is a cursed one: not only does each of the two families wish to obliterate the other, but an ancient secret hidden beneath Neo Verona also threatens their undying love for each other. Will they be able to defy the stars, or is this truly a love that can never be?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed on Romeo x Juliet. While many appreciate the creative liberties taken with the classic story, the strong romantic elements, and the beautiful soundtrack, others are critical of the inconsistent animation, pacing issues, and weak plot resolution. The series is seen as a loose adaptation, with some praising the enhancements and others finding them detrimental to the original story's essence.
pros: Well-developed main characters, especially Romeo and Juliet, with balanced mental development.
Beautiful and influential opening theme song, 'You Raise Me Up'.
Creative interpretation and twists on Shakespeare's original play, adding new plot lines and elements.
Strong and brave protagonists who dynamically grow through each episode.
cons: Inconsistent art and animation quality, with character proportions sometimes being off.
Pacing problems and a plot that feels all over the place, especially in the second half of the series.
Weak climax build-up and a climax that is unrelated to the path leading to it.
Over-reliance on fantasy elements that don't always fit in.
Underdeveloped or rushed side characters.

anime.title: Tokyo Tribe 2
anime.synopsis: This is the other side of Tokyo, a Tokyo of a different color. There, various tribes are living. The SARU from Japan's Musashino, WU-RONZE of Bukuro, and HANDS of Shindyuku... Young men living in the city...the public of modern times builds a home out of corruption, these young men of the sordid side of life, a side called "reality," are depicted here!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the unique hip-hop soundtrack and vibrant art style, but criticism for the disjointed plot and exaggerated character designs. Some find the over-the-top violence and supernatural elements detract from the story, while others appreciate the unique blend of genres. Despite its flaws, many viewers find it an enjoyable and memorable experience.
pros: Great music that stands out, especially hip-hop soundtrack.
Amazing backgrounds with great shading and tones.
Engaging action and battles.
Characters are vibrant and memorable, even with limited face time.
Plot twists and subversive ending are well-received.
cons: Story can be disjointed with plot holes and inconsistencies.
Art style can be awkward, particularly with facial designs and exaggerated features.
Music can be repetitive.
Character development is limited to a few main characters.
Supernatural elements and over-the-top action may detract from the story's realism.
anime.thematic_vibe: Gang Violence, Hip-Hop Culture, Exaggerated Action

anime.title: Eat-Man
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Meet Bolt Crank, mercenary extraordinaire, and the man who eats metal! Through his travels, he stops along the way to make a few bucks and occasionally rescue damsels in distress. His taste for metal gives him quite an edge as he becomes capable of generating an assortment of weapons from his hand! It's a strange ability, but it seems to come in handy, so to speak. Bolt has an edge over his adversaries, but will that be enough?
anime.consensus_summary: Eat-Man '97 is a divisive anime, praised for its unique atmosphere, 90s aesthetic, and so-bad-it's-good humor. However, it's also criticized for its weak, episodic plot, inconsistent writing, and lack of character development. Some viewers appreciate the show's abstract nature and enjoy interpreting its symbolism, while others find it boring and pointless.
pros: Unique premise and protagonist with interesting abilities
Some episodes offer intriguing plots and pseudo-symbolism
Snappy music and good sound design
Distinct 90s anime art style
Entertaining and hilarious due to its absurdity
Memorable character design for Bolt Crank
cons: Episodic format lacks overarching story and continuity
Inconsistent plot quality and lazy writing in some episodes
Underutilized character powers
Forgettable supporting characters
Animation can be lacking and low-budget
Nihilistic main character with inexplicable actions
Abrupt and nonsensical endings

anime.title: Genma Wars
anime.romaji_title: Genma Taisen: Shinwa Zenya no Shou
anime.synopsis: In the distant future, monsters and inhumans roam the land, and the ruling Evil King seeks a human woman to bear him powerful, force-adept heirs. Non offers herself to the Evil King in order to save her village from Ape Clan raiders, and gives him twin sons, Loof and Jin. She and her sons are exiled by the ungrateful villagers, however, and Non's companion Nue (a Demon Clan member changed into a wolf for disobedience) takes Loof to be raised by his father, the Evil King. The Evil One's Queen Parome despises humans, however, and her malevolence towards Loof deepens...
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely considered to be poorly executed, with a nonsensical plot and unappealing visuals. While some viewers see potential in the underlying story, the overwhelming consensus is negative, citing issues with pacing, character development, and the inclusion of gratuitous sexual content. Most find it to be a poorly-made show that fails to deliver on its premise.
pros: The story has potential.
Elements from sci-fi classics.
cons: Plot is incoherent and random.
Poor character development and rushed pacing.
Animation and character designs are poor.
Sexual themes are random and unnecessary.

anime.title: Gun Frontier
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Historical, Sci-Fi, Seinen
anime.synopsis: It is a harsh and barren wasteland, where the weak aren't allowed to dream. It is also a sacred land for true men, for there is no place a man can feel more alive. This is the Gun Frontier. Sea Pirate Captain Harlock and the errant samurai, Tochiro arrive in the United States on the Western Frontier. Along with a mysterious woman they meet along the way, the two friends challenge sex rings, bandits, and corrupt sheriff. They are searching for a lost clan of Japanese immigrants, and they will tear Gun Frontier from end to end until they find it.
anime.consensus_summary: Gun Frontier is largely regarded as a poorly executed series due to its incomplete story, low production values, and offensive content. While some appreciate its unique setting and character dynamics, the majority are critical of its unfunny comedy, underdeveloped characters, and abrupt ending. The show's reliance on sexual assault as a plot device is particularly controversial, leading to strong negative reactions.
pros: Unique setting for anime
Interesting character dynamics
Vintage art style
cons: Incomplete story with abrupt ending
Poor animation quality
Offensive and gratuitous content
Unfunny and irritating comedy
Underdeveloped characters

anime.title: Ultimate Muscle
anime.synopsis:
Kinnikuman II Sei takes place several years after the events of the original Kinnikuman. Mantarou Kinniku is the 59th prince of Planet Kinniku and son of the renowned wrestler, King Suguru. Lazy, immature, and cowardly, Mantarou seems to have little in common with his heroic father. 

When a powerful group calling themselves the dMP threatens the Earth, only someone as powerful as Kinnikuman stands a chance against them. Not knowing the current whereabouts of the King, a plan is formed to have his son Mantarou take up the mantle. The idea of fighting super villains does not sit well with Mantarou, who initially runs away from his duty. He flees to Earth where he encounters Meat, his father’s old trainer. Despite Mantarou's shortcomings, Meat sees King Suguru in him, and believes he can set the prince on the right path. Thus begins Mantarou's journey to better himself and save the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the nostalgia and action, finding it an enjoyable albeit flawed experience. Others are disappointed by the weaker character development, excessive goofiness, and poor animation compared to the original series and manga. The adaptation's tonal shift and production quality are significant points of criticism.
pros: Enjoyable mix of comedy, action, and manliness.
Good art for its time with fluid and dynamic character movements.
Brings a sense of nostalgia for those who watched the original Kinnikuman.
cons: Lacks the originality and epicness of the first series.
Character development is not as strong as the original, with less focus on supporting characters.
Some find the anime to be too goofy, especially compared to the more serious manga.
Poor pacing due to a mix of half fights and poor jokes.
Animation is low effort, simplified, and ugly.

anime.title: Pokémon: Mewtwo Returns
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon: Mewtwo! Ware wa Koko ni Ari
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Kids
anime.synopsis: The Team Rocket leader, Giovanni, has found Mewtwo in a remote area of the Johto region. As Giovanni tries to re-capture Mewtwo, Ash and his friends are kidnapped by Domino, a new Team Rocket member, while trying to rescue Pikachu from Jessie and James. The Clone Pokemon are also captured and are then used as bait for Mewtwo. The situation then becomes a battle between the wills of Mewtwo and Giovanni; and Mewtwo also tries to discover if it and the clones have a purpose in life, even though they are products of science.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the continuation of themes and character development, others find the plot weaker and less engaging than the original movie. Nostalgia and appreciation for certain characters contribute positively, but plot issues and repetitiveness temper overall enthusiasm. It is considered a decent watch, but not particularly inspiring or groundbreaking.
pros: Good continuation of the first movie with similar themes and music.
Mewtwo's internal conflict and heroic actions are compelling.
Giovanni is portrayed as a compelling and evil villain.
Animation is good, especially the ending.
cons: Plot is weaker and repetitive compared to the first movie.
Domino is not as compelling as the original Team Rocket.
Storyline is generic and underwhelming.
Plot holes

anime.title: MegaMan NT Warrior
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi, Video Game
anime.synopsis: In the year of 20XX, a young boy by the name of Netto Hikari receives a very special gift as he enters the 5th grade. His very own customized net navi, Rockman! Despite Rockman's small size and far more responsible personality, the two boys quickly become the best of friends. A net navi is designed to guide his operator from the inside of his or her PErsonal Terminal, or simply PET for short. Children and adults alike enjoy friendly "Net Battles", where they spar their navis against each other to prove their worth.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views Rockman.EXE as a simple, nostalgic anime that caters primarily to fans of the game series. While the soundtrack and Net Navi designs are appreciated, the animation and writing are considered weak. Most find it watchable but not particularly engaging, with significant issues around pacing and character development.
pros: Soundtrack is surprisingly good, especially the battle themes.
Net Navis designs and battles are highlights.
The art style is good for early 2000s standards
cons: Animation quality is inconsistent, ranging from poor to decent, with heavy reliance on stock footage.
Story is simple and rushed, with pacing issues and excessive filler.
Characters are bland and lack development, with villains being particularly uninteresting.

anime.title: Ryuusei Sentai Musumet
anime.synopsis:
One day, seven shooting stars fell on to the ground. The shooting stars were colored by seven colors, and they had terrible powers. Those who took the shooting star were tuned into monsters by embodying their desires.
Dr. Mishina and Dr. Kishiwada obtained the red, green, and blue stars secretly, and they studied the stars. Finally, they could successfully control their power by putting a special helmet on.

The newly developed helmet, "Musumet", was as large as an automobile helmet. Putting Musumet on the head, it turned a person's body into the strongest one on the earth. Furthermore, it received the signal from the brain and amplified the inherent power and ability unlimitedly.

To utilize the power of "Musumet", to keep the world peace, and to protect from the disasters caused by the remaining shooting stars, Dr. Mishima and Dr. Kishida founded a secret organization "MET". However, he died before he accomplished his aim.

The bereaved daughters, Aoi, Midori, and Kurenai, made up their minds to become Musmet in order to execute the father's will.

Even if they turned into Musumet, their wearing wouldn't change except helmets, gloves, and boots. Therefore, they had to go to the scenes wearing their own clothes. The girls had to go to the incident spots occasionally wearing school uniforms, occasionally gymnasium suits, occasionally swimming suits, depending the case, they had to go there even if they were naked, and they would do great jobs. On the other hand, at other times, they were ordinal adolescent girls who were dreaming of lovely meetings with boyfriends.

Whether would they cope with the world peace and boyfriends at the same time?
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is primarily viewed as a shallow, fanservice-heavy show with a weak plot. While some find it funny and entertaining for casual viewing, those seeking deeper narratives will likely be disappointed. The only consistently praised aspect is its catchy soundtrack.
pros: Catchy soundtrack
cons: Overuse of fanservice sacrifices plot
Weak plot

anime.title: Shinseikiden Mars
anime.synopsis:
While reporting on a recently formed volcanic island, journalist Iwakura finds a stranded young man with no memories. News of the incident catches the attention of a mysterious person called Rush, who tracks down the amnesiac and explains to him the truth about his identity. The young man is named Mars and, like Rush, he is not originally from Earth. Mars was dispatched with one mission: to command a tremendously powerful robot named Gaia to destroy Earth when it becomes clear that humans are attempting to extend their influence into outer space. As a precaution, Gaia is programmed to self-destruct, taking the planet along with it, in the event that Mars dies.

In light of Mars' amnesia, Rush agrees to give him 10 days to study Earth's history and decide his course of action. Mars must now choose whether to follow through with his duty or fight to save humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the anime as a faithful adaptation of a classic manga and others finding it dated and uninspired. Nostalgia plays a significant role in the enjoyment of the series, particularly for those familiar with Mitsuteru Yokoyama's other works. The anime's simplistic plot and animation are seen as drawbacks compared to modern shows.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the original manga for the most part
Explores themes of self-discovery and moral dilemmas
Appeals to fans of Mitsuteru Yokoyama's other works, like Giant Robo
cons: Animation hasn't aged well.
Predictable plot points and simple narratives compared to modern anime.
May not be enjoyable without prior knowledge of Yokoyama's works.

anime.title: Submarine Super 99
anime.synopsis: Dr. Oki , the genius scientist who designed a new type of submarine is missing. His son, Susumu, smells an evil scheme of unknown group. He knows everything of his father's submarine called "Super 99" – equipment, weapons, functions and capacity. Susumu thinks that to find his father is to reveal the secret organization, Helmet Party, and stop their conspiracy. With the help of his friends and Marine Corps, he sets out to an underwater quest, not knowing how dangerous his endeavour is…
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative. Reviewers find the show to be derivative of Gundam, with outdated visuals and sound. While the premise had potential, poor execution in storytelling and character development led to a disappointing experience.
pros: Decent technical aspects for a 2003 title
Backgrounds and tech are decently well-drawn
Story had potential
cons: Outdated character art style
Outdated sound effects and OST
Storytelling flops
Characters are underdeveloped
Villains are nonsensical
Heavily derivative of Gundam

anime.title: Di Gi Charat: Winter Garden
anime.synopsis: This is sweet and bitter love story of Dejiko who is a grown up. The story begins on the Christmas day. Dejiko or Di Gi Carat is working part-time at a bakery shop. On her way from the shop, she happens to meet a young guy, Senba Taokuo at a park. Then, she meets him again in a town. While Dejiko begins to care for Tako and she’s looking forward meet him again, Takuo drops in at her shop.... Whether will she succeed in love?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Winter Garden to be a sweet and enjoyable, albeit simple, romance anime. Some fans of the original Di Gi Charat series are disappointed by the changes in character personalities and art style. However, many appreciate the well-paced story and calming atmosphere, making it a worthwhile watch for those seeking a light and heartwarming experience.
pros: Enjoyable and calming series with a nicely paced story.
Well-constructed plot that keeps you engaged.
Good music that enhances the winter setting.
Characters are introduced quickly and develop nicely.
cons: Animation is simple and not a strong point.
Story is average and predictable.
Dejiko's personality is stripped of its original traits.
Art style is very simple compared to the original Di Gi Charat.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sweet Romance, Slice of Life, Sentimental

anime.title: Rozen Maiden: Ouvertüre
anime.synopsis:
As Jun Sakurada fights and lives alongside the Rozen Maidens, special lifelike dolls made to battle each other, he enjoys a rare break in which he is told a story during the events of Rozen Maiden: Träumend. 

When Jun buys a brooch as a present for Shinku, the fifth doll, she refuses to accept it at any cost. Souseiseki, the fourth doll, then recounts the story of how Shinku and the first doll, Suigintou, first met. This tale tells of the cruel and heartbreaking circumstances surrounding Suigintou's birth, and how the many misunderstandings between her and Shinku shaped their longstanding rivalry fueled by Suigintou's unfettered hate towards Shinku.

The stage is set in Rozen Maiden: Ouvertüre in 19th century London as the story delves into the past of these one-time friends and the secrets that they hold.
anime.consensus_summary: Rozen Maiden: Ouvertüre is highly praised for its exploration of Suigintou's past and the origins of her rivalry with Shinku, significantly enhancing the viewer's understanding of both characters. The animation and voice acting are also highlighted as strengths. However, its short length leaves some viewers wanting more depth and development, though most agree it's a must-watch for fans of the series.
pros: Excellent character development of Suigintou, providing depth and understanding to her motivations.
High-quality art and animation, considered the pinnacle of the series.
Strong voice acting performances, particularly by Tanaka Rie (Suigintou) and Sawashiro Miyuki (Shinku).
The story effectively explores the origins of the conflict between Shinku and Suigintou.
cons: The short length of the OVA (only two episodes) leaves viewers wanting more and feeling that the plot could have been more developed.
Some found the art style not as good as the first series.
A few felt the ending of the second episode didn't fully showcase the conflict.

anime.title: To Heart 2 OVA
anime.synopsis: A collection of stories involving the girls of To Heart 2, with each episode focusing on a different character.
anime.consensus_summary: The To Heart 2 OVA is viewed as a supplementary addition to the main series, primarily serving to introduce characters who didn't receive enough screen time. While some enjoy the additional content and improved animation, others find the plot generic. The OVA is generally considered a lighthearted and enjoyable experience for fans of the franchise.
pros: Focuses on characters not fully explored in the main series.
Offers more content for fans of the To Heart 2 franchise.
Contains enjoyable and chaotic school festival episode.
Animation quality is better compared to the original series.
Has unique opening and ending songs and slides.
cons: Plot is fairly typical and generic.
Exists mainly to introduce new characters due to time constraints of main anime.
anime.thematic_vibe: Harem, Slice of Life, Character Introduction

anime.title: Hitohira
anime.genres: Drama, Performing Arts, Romance, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis: A transfer student Asai Mugi is a painfully shy girl. She is so shy that she can't speak when she becomes seriously nervous. However, for some reason, she is spotted and recruited as a member of the drama club.
anime.consensus_summary: Hitohira is generally viewed as an enjoyable and heartwarming anime, particularly praised for its character development and focus on self-confidence. While some find the plot predictable and the pacing inconsistent, the series is considered a worthwhile watch for those who appreciate character-driven school dramas. It's a sweet, simple story that doesn't demand too much from the viewer but offers a feel-good experience.
pros: Excellent character development, especially of the main character.
Imaginative and cute character designs.
Enjoyable drama with enough comic relief.
cons: Predictable plot twists.
Mediocre backgrounds.
Inconsistent pacing, particularly in the later episodes.

anime.title: Nagasarete Airantou
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Ikuto Touhohin just had a fight with his old man, one that led him to make a rash decision to run away from home. He boards a ship, deciding to take a vacation, but the ship is suddenly hit by a huge storm—one that sends Ikuto overboard! When he regains consciousness, he realizes he is still alive on some island. An isolated island. An isolated island with nothing but girls. Beautiful girls. Stranded on an island with only girls, no electricity, gas, radio, television, like he was back in the stone age.
