anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are generally positive, praising the show's comedy, characters, and enjoyable island setting. Some find the harem aspects predictable and repetitive, with the story lacking depth and originality. Despite these criticisms, many viewers found it to be a fun and lighthearted watch, particularly for those new to the harem genre.
pros: Hilarious comedy with 'WTF' moments and innovative ideas.
Cute art style and island paradise scenery.
Well-developed and interesting characters with distinct personalities.
cons: Predictable harem elements and recycled jokes.
Lack of originality and episodic filler.
Inconsistent plot elements and logical inconsistencies
anime.thematic_vibe: Harem Comedy, Slice of Life, Island Fantasy

anime.title: Clannad The Motion Picture
anime.synopsis:
Tomoya Okazaki is a cynical delinquent who lacks ambition as he apathetically labors through high school. During his childhood, a tragedy had caused his father to seek solace in alcoholism and neglect his son. Yet, meaningful human interaction can be a benediction, as Tomoya learns when he meets the enigmatic Nagisa Furukawa. The odd girl offers a gesture of friendship to Tomoya, but he rejects the request, dismissing it as a trivial incident. However, as he soon realizes that he is encountering Nagisa more and more often during school, Tomoya drops his discompassions and befriends the girl.

When he learns that Nagisa's dream is to revive the Drama Club, Tomoya decides to shed his detachment from the ordinary pleasures of life and dedicate himself to helping his new friend achieve her ambition. But what starts as a simple friendship may progress into something far more deep, intimate, and life-changing. As the pair face various hardships and afflictions, Tomoya and Nagisa gradually come to terms with the challenges of life.
anime.consensus_summary: The Clannad movie is a highly divisive entry, with opinions sharply split between those who find its condensed emotional core and dramatic ending compelling, and those who are severely disappointed by its underdeveloped characters and poor animation. Many viewers feel it is best appreciated by existing fans of the series or visual novel, serving as an alternate take rather than a standalone introduction.
pros: The latter half of the movie, particularly the aftermath of Nagisa's death and Tomoya's subsequent despair, is praised for its emotional impact and dramatic intensity, rivaling or even surpassing aspects of the TV series for some viewers.
The movie is noted for successfully focusing on the core relationship between Tomoya and Nagisa, providing a more streamlined and emotionally resonant experience for those invested in their journey.
The ending, while abrupt for some, is seen by others as a fittingly realistic and poignant conclusion, highlighting Tomoya's emotional growth and paternal instincts.
cons: The primary criticism is the movie's drastically condensed narrative, which leads to underdeveloped characters and a rushed plot, making it difficult for viewers to form attachments or fully appreciate the emotional weight of events.
The animation quality is widely criticized as being poor, inconsistent, and dated for its release year, often compared unfavorably to the TV series.
The soundtrack is frequently cited as a letdown, with music that is perceived as generic, ill-fitting, or a pale imitation of the beloved scores from the visual novel and TV series.

anime.title: Saint October
anime.synopsis:
Whether it is the future or the past it is the world of fantasy and horror hiding in the shadow of the demon city. In the city, consecutive mysterious incidents that cannot be solved by science have occurred. To solve the incidents, they gather three girl detectives possessing special abilities.

Hayama Kotono. She is an orphan living in a convent.
Shirafuji Natuski. She is Kotono's classmate and a pop idol.
Hijiri Misaki. She is a mysterious girl who fights against nightmares of her previous life.

Those who want to bring the Judgement Day to the world.
Those who want to save the world.
Which is justice, and which is evil?

When Kotono encounters a boy who lost his memory, the wheel of the story begins to move but slowly. Then, solving the mysteries, the three girls will confront the fate that will influence the existence of the human beings.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Saint October are divided. Some appreciate the show's trashy humor, unpredictable plot, and distinctive characters, finding it a fun and enjoyable experience. Others are critical of the inconsistent tone, underdeveloped characters, and weak plot progression, which detracts from the overall viewing experience. The show's reliance on comedy at the expense of serious themes leaves many feeling disappointed.
pros: Unpredictable plot twists and uncommon character solutions.
Spectacular visual effects and dynamic camera work.
Bright and distinctive characters with unique hobbies and appearances.
Humor is genuinely funny and characters are enjoyable.
cons: Inconsistent tonal shifts between comedy and drama.
Underdeveloped characterization and depth.
Repetitive format in the first half.
Weak excuses to drive the plot forward.
Insufficient motivation for characters' actions.
Logical liberties taken in comedic scenes affect other parts of the show.

anime.title: Devil May Cry
anime.synopsis:
Patty Lowell—the lost heir of a prestigious family—is found at an orphanage, and J.D. Morrison brings her to his acquaintance Dante, the owner of a business called "Devil May Cry." Dante takes on so-called "odd jobs," and at Morrison's request, he agrees to become a bodyguard for Patty. Begrudgingly, he sets out to deliver Patty to her family, though he is a bit annoyed with a job that essentially amounts to babysitting.

While Dante seems like a lazy good-for-nothing, he is actually a prolific demon hunter, which comes in handy when demons begin pursuing Patty. Soon enough, Dante realizes that there is more to this case than meets the eye, and he makes use of his particular skill set in order to keep Patty safe.
anime.consensus_summary: The Devil May Cry anime is a disappointment for many fans of the video game series, who find the story weak, the action underwhelming, and the characters poorly developed. While some appreciate the animation and music, the episodic format and lack of challenging stakes make it a mediocre adaptation. The anime is generally considered watchable but ultimately forgettable, failing to capture the essence of the games.
pros: Faithful representation of the game's character personalities (mostly Dante).
Good animation quality, especially considering the time it was made.
Awesome music, particularly the opening theme and fight tracks.
cons: Episodic format with a weak overarching plot that only develops late in the series.
Dante is overpowered and faces no real challenges, leading to boredom.
Inconsistent character development and underutilization of supporting characters like Lady and Trish.
The humor and side plots involving Patty are annoying and detract from the main story.
Action scenes are short and lack the spectacular choreography of the games.

anime.title: Polyphonica
anime.synopsis:
Phoron Tatara's no ordinary musician. As one of the rare Dantists who can summon elder spirits using music called Commandia, his gift is so strong that his spirit partner is none other than the infamous Corticarte Apa Lagranges. Sure, she may look like a young girl in her human form, but you don't get nicknames like "The Crimson Annihilator" and "The Bloody Duchess" for sitting back and watching the daisies grow.

Now, at the behest of the Tsuge Divine Music Player Office, this dynamic duet travels the continent of Polyphonica on Phoron's combination motorcycle/organ, following the song of the open road, orchestrating rescues and generally fixing whatever's baroque! Some musicians wait for a muse to hit them, but Phoron makes his work for scale!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences are intrigued by the unique musical concept but disappointed by the execution. Common criticisms include the episodic plot, shallow characters, and mediocre production quality. While some appreciate the music and voice acting, the series generally fails to live up to its potential, leaving viewers feeling underwhelmed.
pros: Unique concept of controlling spirits with music.
Good voice acting that gives characters soul.
Decent music, especially the opening and ending themes.
cons: Episodic nature with lack of overall plot depth.
Inconsistent character development, some characters feel shallow.
Mediocre or subpar animation quality and art style.
Uninspired or repetitive music despite being a music-based anime.
Weak antagonists and easily resolved conflicts.

anime.title: Super GALS!
anime.synopsis: Sporting designer clothes, make-up, and nails, Ran Kotobuki is the very picture of a trendy, young Shibuya girl, but don't let that fool you. This girl comes from a family of cops, and she’s ready to lay you out flat if you even think about causing trouble in her town! At least, she will... when she’s not distracted with karaoke, shopping, and dodging her homework. Join Ran and her friends as they defend the streets of Shibuya and attempt to shop their way into the history books as the most famous Gals ever!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Super GALS! Kotobuki Ran is a well-received anime praised for its lovable characters, comedic moments, and depiction of Shibuya culture. While some criticize the lack of a strong plot and reliance on typical shojo tropes, the majority find it an enjoyable and entertaining slice-of-life experience.  It's a fun, girly anime, though be warned that the quality of the ending is not regarded as highly as the rest of the show.
pros: Lovable and well-developed characters with unique personalities and backstories.
Excellent mix of over-the-top comedy with tender, touching moments.
Colorful and detailed art style fitting the vibrant Shibuya setting.
Catchy and fitting soundtrack blending disco and techno elements.
Showcases the growth of main characters, tackling real-life subjects.
Accurate scenery capturing the essence of Shibuya and Ikebukuro.
cons: Lack of an overarching plot, relying on episodic stories.
Some viewers may find the colorful art style overwhelming.
Typical shojo romance tropes that some may find confusing or unappealing.
Shallow characters and cheesy dialogue at times.
Inconsistent sub quality with awkward translation choices.

anime.title: Maria Watches Over Us 3rd
anime.synopsis: Summer has arrived, and the students of Lillian Girls' Academy are on break! Yumi and Sachiko head out to the Ogasawara family's summer home, but what was supposed to be a relaxing vacation takes a turn for the worse when some of Sachiko's old acquaintances drop by for tea. These rich and snobby debutantes don't think Yumi is worthy of Sachiko's affection and they're out to make this summer one she'll regret.
anime.consensus_summary: The third season OVA of Maria-sama ga Miteru is well-received, with many considering it a step up from the previous seasons. The improved animation, deeper character development (especially the central relationship), and refreshing change of scenery are praised. While some find the ending themes unfitting and the episodic nature slightly disjointed, the overall sentiment is positive, making it a must-watch for fans of the series.
pros: Improved animation quality, especially in later episodes.
Deeper exploration and development of the central relationship between Yumi and Sachiko.
More varied settings and activities outside of the school environment offer a refreshing change of pace.
Strong character development, particularly for Sachiko, who shows a more thoughtful and expressive side.
cons: Ending themes are not always fitting for the tone of the series.
Some minor characters feel underdeveloped or unnecessary.
Storylines of individual episodes can feel somewhat disconnected, lacking a strong sense of overall continuation.
Occasional oddities in character design, such as disproportionately long limbs.

anime.title: Tales of Symphonia The Animation: Sylvarant-hen
anime.romaji_title: Tales of Symphonia The Animation: Sylvarant-hen
anime.synopsis: Two worlds exist, both unaware of the existance of the other. In order for one world to flourish, the other will have to perish. On the perishing world, a Chosen one is sent on a journey to restore that world's mana by awakening the Spirits and becoming an angel. Colette Brunel, the Chosen of Sylvarant, sets out on her journey accompanied by her best friends Lloyd Irving and Genis Sage. As they travel further they meet more friends and even more enemies, while they learn more and more about the truth behind the World Regeneration.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus indicates the OVA is a visually appealing adaptation with strong voice acting and a captivating soundtrack, particularly for fans of the original game. However, widespread criticism points to severe pacing issues and underdeveloped characters due to the source material's complexity being condensed into a short format, leaving many wishing for more.
pros: Good voice acting that fits characters well.
Artwork is good, comparable to game cutscenes with fluent motion.
The opening theme perfectly captures the mood and tone.
Characters are likable with distinct personalities.
The plot takes an interesting twist after the initial 'save the planet' premise.
High-quality animation and smooth character rendering.
The relationship between Lloyd and Colette is endearing and well-developed.
Captures important aspects of the game, including emotional resonance.
Excellent art and character designs, especially notable for the time.
The soundtrack and OP/ED themes are well-regarded, fitting the anime's atmosphere.
cons: Significant plot and character development gaps due to condensing a lengthy RPG.
Pacing is extremely rushed, especially in early episodes.
Battles are short, lack intricacy, and are not intense.
Characters are not deeply fleshed out due to the short format.
The OVA feels like a promotional trailer for the game rather than a complete story.
Ends abruptly without a sense of closure, necessitating further installments.
Animation sometimes suffers from excessive blur lines during action sequences.
Newcomers to the series may be confused by technical terms and missing backstory.
Some plot points are underdeveloped, leading to confusion for those unfamiliar with the game.
The OVA is too short to fully develop its potential.

anime.title: eX-Driver: Nina & Rei Danger Zone
anime.synopsis: The story takes place on a world 100 years in the future, a few years before Lisa and Lorna joined eX-D organization. The world where people drives computer-controlled electrically powered "AI cars" which automatically take you where you want to go. However, one AI car mysteriously start to run amok. Now Nina and Rei, as the main driver for ex-D organization have to solve the mystery behind the AI car with evil plot and trap awaiting for them...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response is mixed, with disappointment stemming from a weak plot and inconsistent character portrayals compared to the original series. While the production quality receives praise for its art and sound, the narrative fails to capture the charm and depth of the main series. Overall, it's considered a skippable entry for those heavily invested in the original eX-Driver.
pros: Good art and sound quality.
English dub acting is well done.
Partnership between main characters is well-executed.
Straightforward plot avoids excessive tension.
cons: Bland story that lacks the charm of the original series.
Main characters are inconsistent with their established personalities.
Villain and plot are uninspired.
OVA feels like a filler episode rather than a standalone story.

anime.title: Ajimu: Kaigan Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Seventeen year old Nakaido Hirosuke is just your average high school student. One morning as he arrives at the train station on his way to school, he catches sight of a beautiful girl, Ajimu Yasuna, and immediately falls for her. The two of them get to know each other and become friends, but he can't confess his feelings and she is unsure of hers. As events and other people present obstacles for the potential couple to clear, their relationship begins to develop and their feelings become clear.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Ajimu: Kaigan Monogatari' is lukewarm. While some appreciate the music and certain characters, the consensus points to a generic story, dated animation, and reliance on clichés. The series is considered a light, inoffensive watch, but ultimately forgettable and lacking in originality.
pros: Music has a Hawaiian theme that is generally well-received, particularly the insert songs.
Some found Ajimu to be a refreshing character and not the typical 'moe' anime girl.
The short length (4 episodes) made it a quick and easy watch for some viewers.
The characters, despite flaws, have a sensible feel to them.
The voice acting for Ajimu is particularly praised.
cons: The story is generic, predictable, and lacks originality.
Animation quality is inconsistent and the art style is unappealing.
The first episode is considered particularly weak and forced.
Some characters are pointless and do not contribute to the story.
The series suffers from clichés and overused tropes.
The ending is considered predictable and uninspired.
Inconsistent animation and unappealing art style
Story progression felt slow despite the short length.
Unnecessary ecchi elements detract from the story.

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
It has been two and a half years since Naruto Uzumaki left Konohagakure, the Hidden Leaf Village, for intense training following events which fueled his desire to be stronger. Now Akatsuki, the mysterious organization of elite rogue ninja, is closing in on their grand plan which may threaten the safety of the entire shinobi world.
 
Although Naruto is older and sinister events loom on the horizon, he has changed little in personality—still rambunctious and childish—though he is now far more confident and possesses an even greater determination to protect his friends and home. Come whatever may, Naruto will carry on with the fight for what is important to him, even at the expense of his own body, in the continuation of the saga about the boy who wishes to become Hokage.
anime.consensus_summary: Naruto Shippuden evokes strong emotions, particularly for long-time fans, but is criticized for its pacing, excessive filler, and inconsistent quality. While the series explores meaningful themes of friendship and perseverance, the execution is considered flawed, leading to a polarized reception. Many feel the anime declined in quality in later arcs.
pros: Emotional storytelling and character development.
Soundtrack enhances the anime's tone.
Exploration of themes like trauma and identity.
Fighing scenes and transition to normal life blend nicely.
cons: Excessive filler episodes disrupt the storyline.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Repetitive flashbacks.
Pacing issues, with rushed stories and dragged-out battles.
Inconsistent character, dialogue, and story arcs.

anime.title: Ramen Fighter Miki
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Martial Arts, Parody, Shounen, Workplace
anime.synopsis: Miki Onimaru is a poster girl that works at her mother's Chinese ramen restaurant. She appears to be a normal girl, but she can become very violent if provoked. She picks a fight with her mother and accquaintances as a result on an almost daily basis, causing a series of troubling mishaps in their otherwise normal lives.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Muteki Kanban Musume for its bizarre and over-the-top comedy. While the characters are not deeply developed, their interactions and the show's absurd situations provide plenty of laughs. Some find the humor repetitive or the animation limited, but overall it's considered an enjoyable, high-energy series.
pros: Effective and genuinely funny comedy with well-executed jokes.
Good use of parody, physical humor, and zany craziness.
The art style is highly stylized and bizarre, which complements the series.
Strong voice acting cast that puts a lot of boisterous energy into their performances.
Character dynamics allow even the most useless of characters to both have some presences
cons: Characters are not particularly fleshed out or three-dimensional.
Some humor may be repetitive and pointless for some viewers.
Animation is limited, with stiff fight scenes and overexaggerated facial expressions at times.
The series may become threadbare, with jokes and characters becoming less fresh after the first few episodes.
Some character traits can become annoying.

anime.title: Super Milk-Chan
anime.synopsis:
Milk-chan is a girl who lives in a house stuck on the side of a building with her two sidekicks: Tetsu-ko, a paranoid robot that looks like a bottle and Hanage, a green blob with a mustache.

Milk is poor and she can't pay the rent, especially after her attempt to extort a local ant family fails. However, she is saved because the president himself offers her a job (some sort of a secret mission). Milk-chan answers the phone to receive missions from The President by saying something like "Hello, Bank of Hokkaido. Just kidding!"

After getting her mission, Milk-chan and her sidekicks take off aboard the "Milk-6" helicopter to go on her mission. Did I tell you this is a spoof of 1970s spy thrillers or some sort of Bond movies?
anime.consensus_summary: Super Milk-chan is a bizarre and divisive comedy that relies heavily on its cultural context and absurd humor. The ADV dub is considered essential for enjoying the show, as it translates the Japanese jokes for a Western audience. While some find the show addictive and hilarious, others find it pointless and strange, resulting in a mixed reception.
pros: ADV dub is well-received and crucial for understanding the humor
Unique and bizarre humor can be addictive
President character is consistently funny
cons: Humor is highly dependent on familiarity with Japanese culture
Story is weak and formulaic
Animation is simplistic and may not appeal to everyone

anime.title: Mirmo Zibang!
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
Kaede is a cheerful and energetic eighth grader. When it comes to boys, however, she is hopelessly shy. 

One day, on her way home from school, Kaede walks into a mysterious shop and buys a colorful cocoa mug. When she reaches home, she casually peeks into the bottom of the mug and discovers an engraved note, which says, "If you read this message aloud while pouring hot cocoa into the mug, a love fairy ("muglox") will appear and grant your every wish." The skeptical but curious Kaede follows the directions and announces her wish to date Yuuki, the class heartthrob. Suddenly, the adorable blue Mirumo appears! We soon find out, however, that this cute little muglox would rather eat chocolate and create mischief than help Kaede. 

Mirumo, it seems, is prince of the muglox world. Horrified at the prospect of having to marry Rirumu, his princess bride-to-be, Mirumo has escaped the muglox world. Hot on his heels, however, are Rirumu, Yashichi the bounty hunter, and a cast of hundreds of muglox ranging from the good to the bad to the nutty. This gang of adorable troublemakers will see to it that school life for Kaede and her friends is never the same...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience views "Wagamama☆Fairy Mirumo de Pon!" with fondness and nostalgia, primarily due to its impact on their childhoods. While some acknowledge that the anime's production quality and childish themes might not appeal to contemporary viewers or older audiences, the humor and memorable characters still resonate positively. The show is generally considered a cute and enjoyable piece of anime history.
pros: Evokes strong childhood memories and nostalgic feelings.
Characters and story were enjoyable and memorable.
Humor is effective and generates laughter.
cons: Animation and sound may not appeal to modern audiences.
Story may be too childish for older viewers.
Some characters can be annoying.

anime.title: Zoids Fuzors
anime.synopsis: R.D. is a delivery boy who works for a company called Mach Storm in order to earn money to search for the legendary Alpha Zoid. A Zoid that he heard rumours about from his dad that he passionately believes in. Mach Storm also doubles as a Zoid Battling team. In R.D.'s first Coliseum Zoid Battle, he encounters a team that can fuse Zoids. R.D. soon discovers that he has a Zoid that can computably fuse with his Zoid, Liger Zero. After this happens R.D.'s adventure to discover the truth about the Alpha Zoid begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Zoids Fuzors is mixed to negative. While some appreciate the Zoid combinations and voice acting, many criticize the weak story, poor character development, and awkward animation. The series is considered a significant departure from previous Zoids installments, leading to disappointment among long-time fans.
pros: Zoids combining is impressive.
Good voice acting in the English dub.
cons: Story is rushed and poorly translated.
Characters are poorly developed and introduced.
Animation is awkward and robotic, especially Zoid movements.
Plot is terrible, especially in the first half.
Bland and uninteresting backgrounds.

anime.title: Piyoko ni Omakase pyo!
anime.synopsis:
Leave it to Piyoko! Move over, Di Gi Charat! 

Piyoko and the Black Gema Gema Gang star in this new OVA series. From the Planet Analogue to Earth, the Black Gema Gema Gang try to kidnap Dejiko and hold her ransom to find their dream of a prosperous home!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the series cute and entertaining, particularly appreciating Piyoko's character. However, many find the plot and humor lacking, criticizing the randomness, art style and voice acting. Ultimately, it is only recommended for die-hard fans of the Di Gi Charat franchise.
pros: Cute character interactions, especially Piyoko's interactions with others.
Dub can be enjoyable.
cons: Absence of story and plot.
Humor relies on randomness and incompetence rather than structured amusement.
Lazy and schizophrenic art style with inconsistent tone.
Sub-par voice acting despite talented voice actors.
Boring music.

anime.title: Di Gi Charat Movie: A Trip To The Planet
anime.romaji_title: Di Gi Charat: Hoshi no Tabi
anime.synopsis: Dejiko decided to take a vacation and visit her home, Planet Di Gi Charat, together with Puchiko, Gema, and (accidentally) Rabi~en~Rose. However, Piyoko and her aids would not let go this chance to capture her.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is primarily aimed at existing fans of Di Gi Charat, offering a relaxed and humorous experience. While the story is simple and the art may not be impressive, it serves as a nostalgic trip for those familiar with the series. It's not recommended for newcomers, but fans may find it enjoyable for its lightheartedness and familiar characters.
pros: Humor is relaxing
Brings back memories for fans
Every important character makes an appearance
cons: Story is nothing but relaxed
Art is kinda bad
Nothing new in the music

anime.title: Di Gi Charat: Kuchi Kara Bazooka
anime.romaji_title: Di Gi Charat: Kuchi Kara Bazooka
anime.synopsis: Piyoko and her villainous friends plot for a way to use the mouth rocket to beat Dejiko's laser eyes.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted and humorous addition to the Di Gi Charat series, particularly appealing to fans of the older seasons and those who enjoy the antics of Piyoko and her gang. While it may not offer significant new content or depth, its familiar charm and silly humor make it a worthwhile watch for dedicated followers. The audience mood seems generally positive and nostalgic, with little controversy.
pros: Fun to see more specials that pay attention to Piyoko and her gang
Classic humor that the series has
Recommended for fans of Di Gi Charat
cons: Doesn't add much

anime.title: Di Gi Charat Summer Special 2000
anime.synopsis:
The Di Gi Charat Summer Special was a four episode series that aired over two days, August 22, 2000 to August 23, 2000. This was the first series that Piyoko appeared in and the plot involves her attempting to hold Dejiko hostage for ransom.

• Summer Special 2000 Episode 1 - Here comes Pyoko-nyo!
• Summer Special 2000 Episode 2 - It's the Black Gamers-nyo
• Summer Special 2000 Episode 3 - The Return of Abarenbou
• Summer Special 2000 Episode 4 - Summer Bug
anime.consensus_summary: The Di Gi Charat Summer Special 2000 is a mixed bag compared to the original series. While the introduction of Piyoko and Megumi Hayashibara's voice acting are praised, the special suffers from stretched-out episodes, a decline in humor, and an irritating antagonist. Audience reception is lukewarm, with some appreciating the satire while others find it disappointing.
pros: Introduction of Piyoko character.
Voice acting by Megumi Hayashibara.
Satire of American otaku culture.
cons: Stretched-out episodes with little plot.
Lack of decent humor compared to the original series.
Irritating antagonist character (bug guy) with too much screen time.

anime.title: Di Gi Charat Christmas Special
anime.synopsis: The Christmas Special aired in December 2000 and featured Piyoko again attempting to capture Dejiko by inviting all the characters on a cruise.
anime.consensus_summary: The Di Gi Charat Christmas Special is well-received, with reviewers finding it enjoyable and highlighting its cuteness, humor, and improved animation. The special effectively incorporates all characters into a single story, leading to a fun and laughter-filled experience. Minor critiques include cheaply-drawn backgrounds and slightly sloppy character designs, but these do not significantly detract from the overall positive reception.
pros: Includes all characters into one story
Humorous scenes and rival clashes
Improved animation and more detailed backgrounds
Highlights the pros of the anime series
cons: Cheaply-drawn backgrounds
Characters still look a bit sloppy

anime.title: Di Gi Charat Tsuyu Specials
anime.synopsis:
Di Gi Charat (call her Dejiko for short) and Petit Charat (the cute little charat) come down to Earth, where they want to be idols, or something like that. Rabi~en~Rose (a random girl with bunny ears) decides they're in her way of becoming an idol herself. They all end up working at Gamers, where various otaku, children, and humanoid fingers walk in and act like morons.

Contains:
Gema no Sumika
Tsusode shiu Engekidan (ii ne!)
anime.consensus_summary: The Di Gi Charat Tsuyu Specials are a generally watchable but weaker continuation of the original series. While the animation is technically better, the humor and pacing suffer from the extended episode length. The audience seems to agree that it's only worth watching for die-hard fans of the original who want more Di Gi Charat content, but shouldn't expect the same level of quality.
pros: More Di Gi Charat content
Improved animation quality compared to the original
cons: Lacks the unpredictable nature of the original series
Episodes feel dragged out due to longer runtime
Jokes are not as good as the original

anime.title: Kikaider 01: The Animation
anime.synopsis: Ever since the fall of the DARK organization, Jiro has been wandering everywhere and wondering if he would ever see Mitsuko again or not. During his journey Jiro meets a beautiful girl named Rieko who is protecting Akira, a little boy from the evil Professor Gill. Ironicly, he's the son of Professor Gill, but he is also the key to Gill’s menacing secret weapon and his plans to conquer the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers praise the soundtrack, new characters, and Jiro's development, while others criticize the underdeveloped story, generic villain, and overly melodramatic tone. The series ultimately leaves some viewers feeling unsatisfied and that it does not hold up well over time, contrasting the original TV series' more hopeful tone.
pros: Soundtrack is a masterpiece, especially the final credits.
New characters are likeable and add to the story.
Jiro's character development is a highlight.
cons: Story feels half-baked with unexplored themes.
Professor Gill's motivations are generic and lack depth.
Overly melodramatic and 'edgy' style leads to a sense of despair.
Does not hold up to scrutiny or time, an unfitting end to the series.

anime.title: The Super Milk-Chan Show
anime.synopsis: Milk-chan is a drooling, potty-mouthed baby who lives in an apartment with an obsolete robot named Tetsuko, a slug named Hanage, and an uncontrollable pet named Robodog. Whenever the President calls, Milk-chan and the gang rush to the scene to solve any type of problem - whether it's stopping a money counterfeiter hungry for Belgian waffles or counselling a school of drunk fish. At the same time, they have to avoid a nagging landlord, as they're six months behind their rent.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the show's bizarre humor, unique art style, and charming characters. Others find it confusing, pointless, and overly reliant on niche Japanese pop culture references. The show's transition to a longer format is also criticized for pacing issues.
pros: Unique and quirky art style reminiscent of Japanese character franchises.
Charming characters that viewers can become invested in.
Running gags and catchphrases create a comfortable viewing experience.
cons: Lacks a coherent plot and relies heavily on absurd humor, which may not appeal to all viewers.
Relies heavily on Japanese pop culture references, which can be lost on Western audiences.
Pacing issues in the longer format, with episodes feeling longer than they are.

anime.title: Ring ni Kakero 1 Episode: The Pacific War
anime.synopsis: Immediately after Ryuuji Takane won the Champion Carnival, the U.S. Junior Champion Black Shaft appeared, and challenged the best Japan has to offer, just before the World Tournament is about to happen. Now Ryuuji, Takeshi Kawai, Kazuki Shinatora, Ishimatsu Katori, and Superstar Jun Kenzaki have to prove to not only Black Shaft, but the world, that they are truly world-class boxers before the World Tournament starts. But Shaft is not recruiting boxers for his challenge, but instead gets a life-timer criminal from Death Row, the leader of the Great Angels, one of the toughest gangs in America, a mysterious woman, and the "Dark Emperor of the South". Also, Shaft negotiates with Don Juliano, the Italian Junior Champion, just in case...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience seems divided on the anime's old-school charm and creative liberties taken with the source material. While some appreciate the faithful character designs and over-the-top action, others are critical of the pacing issues and lack of animation improvements.  The anime's unique cultural elements might not appeal to a broad audience, limiting its overall impact.
pros: Faithful character designs to the manga.
Creative and funny depiction of cultural diversity, albeit potentially stereotypical.
Dramatic fight angles and shots enhance the Shonen action feel.
cons: No significant improvement in animation quality compared to the previous season.
Filler content and extended fight scenes deviate from the manga's pacing.
The old-school style and cultural references might not resonate with contemporary or non-Japanese audiences.
anime.thematic_vibe: Old-School Shonen, Superpowered Boxing, National Pride

anime.title: Fist of the North Star: Raoh Side Story Junai Arc
anime.romaji_title: Hokuto no Ken: Raoh Gaiden Junai-hen
anime.synopsis:
Kenshiro is the heir of the legendary martial arts known as Hokuto Shinken, which can kill a man with a single blow, by striking the pressure points in the enemy's body. Hokuto Shinken can be passed only to one successor at a time. When he was chosen as the successor, he parted ways with his brothers, Toki and Raoh. The former decided to use what he knew of the art to cure people... while the latter has chosen to use his supreme strength to install peace in the world by power. 
Kenshiro is accompanied by Lynn and Bart, and the movie's story begins when an overlord starts kidnapping children to use them as slaves for building his own pyramid...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Hokuto no Ken: Raoh Gaiden Junai-hen" is well-received, especially by fans of the original series. Reviewers appreciate the updated art style, exciting action, and faithfulness to the source material. Some criticize the simplicity of the story and occasional lack of emotional depth, but the general sentiment is positive, considering it an enjoyable and entertaining entry in the Fist of the North Star franchise.
pros: Faithful to the spirit of the original series
Exciting action sequences with a cool 80s vibe
Modern art style and character design are enjoyable
Well-developed characters and interesting relationships
Good sound design and voice acting
cons: Simple story, potentially cliché
Some heavier moments lack emotional impact
Pacing and character introductions could be improved
Fight scenes could be more crisp
Minor animation errors

anime.title: Dimension Movement of Nazca
anime.synopsis: Miura Kyoji, a dedicated kendo student, discovers that his shisho (master) Tate Masanari is a reincarnated Incan warrior named Yawaru who wishes to destroy the world to purify it. Kyoji himself is the warrior Bilka, who foiled Yawaru's plans in their previous lives. Yawaru gathers other awakened spirits to release the powers of nature. Now Kyoji must wrestle with his own fate and decide if he is merely a vessel for the reincarnated soul or if he is truly Miura Kyoji and which will be better able to save the world and the future as he knows it.
anime.consensus_summary: Nazca is a unique but flawed anime with an interesting premise that fails to fully deliver. The series has a number of technical issues, including animation inconsistencies and a poor English dub. While some appreciate the music and the underlying themes, the plot is often confusing and the characters are underdeveloped, leading to a mixed reception.
pros: Unique premise with reincarnation of Incan warriors
Music is remixed Bach, which works incredibly well and gives a grand and serious tone
Some genuinely touching moments
Interesting plot
Good characterization
Soundtrack is exotic and harmonious
cons: Mediocre animation
Stilted English dub with bored voice acting
Poor character designs for Incan flashbacks (skin-tight one pieces)
Disjointed plot progression with confusing transitions
Weak explanation for setting in Japan
Underdeveloped characters and shallow interpersonal relationships
Unclear goals of the evil faction and missed opportunity for addressing hypocrisy
Inaccurate historically

anime.title: Dae Jang Geum: Jang Geum's Dream
anime.romaji_title: Dae Jang Geum: Jang Geum's Dream
anime.synopsis:
Story is about the girl Jang Geum who wants to be a cook. She gets accepted as a palace servant. Clever and cheerful Jang Geum quickly finds friends. But all to soon she encounters intrigue and corruption. 

A Korean/Japanese joint production.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences respond positively to 'Dae Jang Geum's Dream', appreciating its engaging narrative that extends beyond cooking, its well-developed and unique characters, and the immersive cultural experience it provides. While some minor criticisms exist regarding the art style or plot contrivances, the general sentiment leans heavily towards enjoyment and recommendation, particularly for those seeking a relaxed and inspiring story. The show successfully blends adventure, character growth, and cultural elements to create a memorable viewing experience.
pros: Unique characters with distinct personalities and backstories.
Engaging story that goes beyond just cooking, incorporating adventure and cultural elements.
Strong character development, with the MC and supporting characters evolving throughout the series.
Immersive experience through art, music, and setting in feudal Korea.
Relaxed yet good story
cons: Some may find the art style not to their preference, though it improves as the series progresses.
Occasional instances of the main character experiencing continuous bad luck.
Japanese openings and endings viewed as pointless by one reviewer.

anime.title: Argento Soma: Hitori to Hitori
anime.synopsis: The pilot Sue Harris goes to a mission on a frozen country, there she suffers an accident on the mountains and her life is in severe danger. Trying to survive on the harsh enviroment, she encounters an alien and engages in combat with it. The two beings will use all means possible to escape of that dead trap alive.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience sentiment leans positive. The episode is valued for developing Sue's character and exploring her motivations.  However, some viewers feel it would have been more impactful as part of a larger series with broader character development.
pros: Adds better understanding of Sue's character
Fascinating exploration of Sue's reactions and insecurities
Hilarious ending credit
cons: Could benefit from more episodes fleshing out other characters' backstories
Limited to a single episode

anime.title: Overman King Gainer
anime.synopsis: Sometime in the distant future, mankind is forced to live in domed cities while the rest of the world is left to recover from years of environmental hardships. In the Siberian Dome-polis, professional gamer Gainer Sanga and mercenary Gain Bijou commandeer an Overman and lead a mass exodus out of the city.
anime.consensus_summary: Overman King Gainer is viewed as a fun and quirky mecha anime that prioritizes entertainment over a complex plot. While some find the plot confusing and the characters somewhat shallow, the show's unique designs, catchy music, and lighthearted tone are generally well-received. It's considered a 'Happy Tomino' show, and overall enjoyable experience if viewers don't take it too seriously.
pros: Unique mech designs and interesting fight choreography.
Colorful personalities and fun character interactions.
Catchy opening theme and generally well-done music.
The show prioritizes fun over thematic lectures
cons: Plot jumps around and can be confusing, lacking exposition.
Reliance on information overload for plot development.
Minor characters are one-dimensional.

anime.title: Animation Runner Kuromi
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Drama, Otaku Culture, Parody, Workplace
anime.synopsis: Having just graduated from animation school, Mikiko Oguro eagerly arrives at Studio Petit for her first day of work. However, an unfortunate situation suddenly paves the way for the novice animator to become the production manager of Time Journeys: an upcoming TV anime with a tight production schedule. Struggling to pull various creatives together to keep the series on track for broadcasting, Mikiko quickly learns how stressful anime production can be and gets some first-hand experience with the herculean efforts it takes to create a work that can touch viewers' hearts.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally find Animation Runner Kuromi to be a fun and insightful look into the anime production process. The show's comedic and exaggerated style is well-received, with viewers appreciating the unique characters and the glimpse into the industry's challenges.  While some find the animation and music dated, the overall consensus is positive, with many recommending it as a lighthearted and educational watch.
pros: Provides insight into the anime production process.
The characters are diverse and memorable, effectively conveying their personalities and quirks.
The over-the-top comedy and exaggerated animation style enhances the show's charm and entertainment value.
cons: The art style is dated, typical of early 2000s anime.
The music is repetitive.
Story is basic.

anime.title: Animation Runner Kuromi 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Drama, Otaku Culture, Parody, Workplace
anime.synopsis: After rookie producer Mikiko Oguro manages to guide her team through the production of the anime Time Journeys, the president of Studio Petit announces that the studio will be producing three different shows for the upcoming season. With Mikiko barely able to hold the tiny team together, the president calls in a veteran producer to ease the burden on her shoulders. However, when the new producer starts cutting corners in order to meet the strict deadlines, the team becomes jaded and wonder if they are working on a production they can truly be proud of.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the second installment of Kuromi-chan, appreciating its cute animation and the energy of the English dub. However, some find the plot contrived and the overall experience too short and lacking in depth. There's a sentiment that a longer TV series format would have been more beneficial to the narrative.
pros: Cute animation style reminiscent of early 2000s anime.
Energetic English dub enhances the experience.
Continuing charm and personality of the core crew.
cons: Story feels somewhat contrived with the introduction of a villain.
Lacks depth due to its short format (OVA vs. TV series).
Doesn't offer much to chew on; needed more content.

anime.title: Master of Mosquiton '99
anime.synopsis: Catholic schoolgirl Inaho discovers that a vampire, Mosquiton, is feeding off of her classmates. So she stakes him, but he is revived after her blood comes in contact with the his remains. Mosquiton becomes her slave and also a history teacher. Together, along with Yuuki and Honou, the unlikely duo have many escapades and adventures. One of Inaho's main goals is to find the mythical O-Part to make some money!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, particularly when comparing the TV series to the OVA. While some appreciate the lightheartedness and character development in the later episodes, many find the plot repetitive and the animation inconsistent. The absence of the darker, adult elements that defined the OVA is a significant point of contention, leading to disappointment for fans of the original.
pros: Music is well-received, particularly the incorporation of themes from the OVA.
Ending episodes are considered the strongest, offering touching character development.
Some viewers appreciate the light-hearted tone and the addition of characters like Wolf Lady and Frankie.
cons: Story is repetitive and stretched thin compared to the OVA.
Animation quality is inconsistent and considered a downgrade from the OVA.
The main character, Inaho, is often found annoying, and some new characters like Akito are disliked.
The adult humor and darker elements from the OVA are missing, making the TV series less compelling for some fans.
Characters' backstories appear too late in the series to fully compensate for earlier shortcomings.

anime.title: Prism Ark
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
The Sablum Empire has been attempting to take over the kingdom of Windland for many years, and are now plotting with the mercenaries Sister Hell and Darkness Knight to start a new offensive using powerful magical beings called Angels. 

Hyaweh, a carefree yet talented swordsman, and Priecia, who just might be the lost princess of Windland, are enrolled at the Knight's Academy in Windland to hone their skill at swords and sorcery. There they meet many friends and allies who can help them protect their homeland from the impending invasion.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Prism Ark for its cute romance, character designs, and art. However, many feel that the plot is rushed and incomplete, with unrealized potential due to its short length. The inconsistent tone and inclusion of too many genres also detract from the overall experience, leaving viewers wanting more substantial plot development and a more cohesive narrative.
pros: Amazing character design and detailed art style.
Upbeat music that fits the scenes well.
Enjoyable romance elements and character interactions.
cons: Incomplete or rushed plot development, especially towards the end.
Inconsistent tone and chaotic narrative due to inclusion of too many genres.
Underdeveloped complex story and potential for a deeper narrative.

anime.title: Kamichama Karin
anime.genres: Comedy, Mahou Shoujo, Romance, School, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
Thirteen-year-old Karin Hanazono feels like her life can't get any worse, Her parents died when she was younger, leaving her with an aunt who doesn't hesitate to call her stupid and useless over her poor grades. Her only friend, her cat named Shii-chan, passed away recently, leaving her completely alone. All she has left of her parents is a ring given to her by her mother, which she treasures dearly as the sole thing left of her past.

Kamichama Karin begins the moment her life takes a turn for the better, when she is approached by Himeka Kuujou, a cute girl who has also lost her parents, and Kazune Kuujou, her cousin who finds girls to be troublesome, both of whom are searching for a goddess. Her mother's memento ring shines brightly in their presence and fills her with its radiance, making her smarter, faster, and capable of granting wishes. It turns out that her ring allows her to become the very goddess they were looking for, and now that she has awakened that power, others will come after her for it…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some find the anime enjoyable for its cute characters, romance, and surprising plot twists, especially early on. However, others are critical of the confusing and inconsistent storyline, weak character development, and disappointing ending, with the plot only becoming clear when watching Kamichama Karin Chu. Despite the flaws, many viewers maintain a nostalgic fondness for the series.
pros: Engaging story with twists and turns.
Adorable and unique character designs.
Enjoyable blend of comedy, romance, and serious moments.
Heartwarming and emotional story.
cons: Confusing plot with pacing issues and plot holes.
Inconsistent animation quality, with some episodes having poor art.
Disappointing character development, especially for the main character Karin.
Predictable and unoriginal characters.
Ending and last few episodes are not well-received by some viewers.

anime.title: Shattered Angels
anime.synopsis: Kyoshiro to Towa no Sora revolves around the life of Kuu Shiratori, a seemingly normal high school girl who enjoys her school life in the giant city Academia, which is thought of as a symbol of recovery for humanity since already ten years have passed since the greatest disaster mankind had ever seen, occurred. Kuu has recently been having a recurring dream where a prince meets her and takes her away. One day, while all the students at her school are preparing for the upcoming school festival, the prince, whom she has met several times in her dreams, appears. The prince, Kyoshiro Ayanokoji, requests of her just as he had done in Kuu's dreams, "Let's go... together..."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers find the series enjoyable due to its character development and emotional moments, while others are turned off by the excessive fan service, confusing plot, and unlikable protagonist. The series is best appreciated by those who enjoy the genre despite its flaws, or those familiar with the creator's previous works.
pros: Strong and unique characters with impressive development, especially Setsuna.
Visually appealing art style with bright colors and well-done character designs.
Ending provides an emotional payoff for viewers invested in the characters.
cons: Overabundance of fan service elements that detract from the plot.
Inconsistent story pacing with confusing early episodes and late exposition dumps.
Protagonist (Kuu) is often considered annoying and underdeveloped.

anime.title: Hanoka
anime.synopsis:
Years ago, extraterrestrials known as the Citizens of the Stars descended upon the planet of Tokinea and wreaked havoc on humanity. To fight back against them, the military developed the Majin project to create hybrids between humans and the Citizens of the Stars. With this combination of genes, they hope to exploit both the subservience of man and the powers of the alien.

Majin no.7, a young girl kept under lock and key in a military base, is released after the Citizens of the Stars launch an attack. Despite possessing a plethora of abilities capable of effortlessly eliminating the enemy, she is burdened with doubt on the battlefield. However, when a boy named Yuuri tells her that she must fight to earn her freedom, Majin no. 7 is inspired by his courage and defeats the remaining Citizens of the Stars. The two decide to embark on a journey together, determined to find their calling in a time when humanity knows no peace.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience consensus is negative. Reviewers heavily criticize Hanoka for its poor animation, unoriginal story, and underdeveloped characters. Some find it so bad it's good, while others consider it a waste of time, but most agree that it fails to deliver a compelling or enjoyable experience. The show's technical shortcomings and narrative flaws overshadow any potential merits.
pros: Some reviewers appreciated the soundtrack, calling it dramatic and fun.
The DVD version includes touch-ups, such as new and extended scenes, as well as some re-recorded and new dialogue that add a tiny bit more plot to the whole thing.
cons: Poor animation quality due to the use of Adobe Flash.
The story is unoriginal and filled with clichés, with minimal character development.
Pacing issues due to short episode length and long opening sequence.
Incoherent plot and nonsensical events.

anime.title: Genshiken OVA
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Otaku Culture, Parody, Seinen
anime.synopsis: It's the start of a new year for the Genshiken crew, and that means recruiting new members. Always a dreaded task, The Society for the Study of Modern Visual Culture manages to get Chika Ogiue pushed onto them from the Manga Club. With her introduction of "I'm Ogiue and I hate otaku," this year certainly will be anything but boring.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the OVA a funny and enjoyable continuation, while others are disappointed by the decline in art quality and character consistency. The introduction of new characters is a highlight for many, but the overall feel is considered less subtle and more cartoony than the original series. The OVA serves as a bridge to the second season, but is considered a weaker entry in the franchise by some fans.
pros: Introduction of new characters Ogiue and Kuchiki adds humor.
Good continuation of the story from the first season.
Enjoyable for fans of Genshiken.
cons: Art and animation quality is a letdown compared to the first season.
Some character personalities feel inconsistent with the original series.
Story feels less subtle and more comical than the original Genshiken.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Otaku Culture, Slice of Life

anime.title: Shakugan no Shana: The Movie
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Crimson Denizens and Rinne, beings from a parallel world, seek to devour humans' precious existences. To restore the delicate balance of the world, Flame Hazes hunt these entities down.

Yet such things are unknown to Yuuji Sakai, who starts his day like any other and heads to school. His day, however, takes a turn for the extraordinary when he witnesses everyone around him freeze in place and is left the only one able to move. Immediately, a Rinne begins devouring the souls of those around him, but as the creature sets its sights on Yuuji, a katana-wielding Flame Haze with blazing red hair saves him.

After his protector fixes the damage done, she explains why Yuuji was able to move: he has become a Torch, a remnant of a dead human being that will eventually fade from memory. Furthermore, he is also a Mystes, a Torch that houses an unknown treasure. Before his flame burns out completely, a Crimson Denizen will try to seize the treasure he holds, so the fiery hunter decides to watch over him. As Yuuji comes to terms with being dead, he resolves to live his life the best he can with the time he has remaining.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a decent recap of the initial story arc, boasting superb animation and sound. However, it suffers from a rushed pace and underdeveloped character arcs. It is best viewed before the anime series to avoid feeling like a repetitive experience, and opinions diverge on the value of changes made to characters and plot elements.
pros: High-quality animation, especially Shana's flaming hair and fighting scenes.
Excellent musical score and sound design enhances the atmosphere.
Friagne is more fleshed out and a more compelling villain than in the anime series.
Well-paced story that quickly summarizes the initial plot.
cons: Feels rushed, especially in the first half, due to compressing several episodes into a short runtime.
Character development is sacrificed due to time constraints, making some relationships feel underdeveloped.
Inclusion of certain characters (e.g., Margery Daw, Wilhelmina) feels gratuitous and detrimental to the story.
The movie is too similar to the first episodes, making it feel like a recap for those familiar with the series.

anime.title: Sonic X
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Anthropomorphic, Comedy, Kids, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Sonic the Hedgehog's typical irreverence leads to the coveted chaos emeralds being caught in the crossfire and rendered unstable just before activation. The resulting chaos control engulfs everything for miles around Dr. Eggman's base, and, with scrambled input, nobody can predict the outcome. 

Isolated from his friends and enemies alike, Sonic awakes in a strange world: an unknown city surrounded by mysterious people. He realizes he has been warped across the universe to an entirely different planet—Earth. As he rushes to escape the equally confused authorities, Sonic finds himself falling head-first into the pool of the illustrious Thorndyke family. 

Thankfully, Christopher, Thonrdykes' son, saves Sonic and offers protection from a society that mistakenly believes him to be hostile. Sheltered by the family, Sonic resolves to regroup with his friends, save this new world from the threat he brought to them, and find a way home.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Sonic X is divided, particularly concerning the English dub and the inclusion of new characters. While some appreciate the nostalgic value, faithful character representation (in the Japanese version), and action-packed later seasons, many criticize the poor writing, slow pacing, and the annoying presence of characters like Chris. The show is generally considered a decent anime adaptation for kids, but it falls short of its potential and pales in comparison to other Sonic series.
pros: Faithful character representation from the games (in the Japanese version)
Good animation quality and fluid action scenes
Catchy and iconic opening themes
Enjoyable plot arcs in later seasons (specifically seasons 2 and 3)
cons: Poor English dubbing and script, with edits and content cuts (4Kids version)
Inconsistent pacing and slow storytelling, especially in Season 1
Annoying and useless new characters (e.g., Chris Thorndyke)
Generic and clichéd plot elements
Flanderization of established characters

anime.title: DearS: Is It a Golden Ball?
anime.romaji_title: DearS: Kin no Tama desu no?
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Miu wins the grand prize in the local shopping district raffle, which is a free pass for up to four people to Yuniataru Studio, a spa resort. She decides to take Takeya, Ren and Neneko since her grandparents couldn't attend.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'DearS' special is largely considered a fanservice episode with excessive nudity and little plot development. It's viewed as a non-essential addition to the series, primarily suitable for those already invested in 'DearS'. While it doesn't drastically deviate from the series' tone, it's not recommended for those seeking substantial character development or plot progression.
pros: Doesn't distort the characters or tone of the series too much
Good timekiller
cons: Excessive nudity
Lack of character development or plot
forgettable soundtrack
Art style isn't visually appealing
Not worth watching if you haven't seen the main series

anime.title: Claymore
anime.synopsis:
When a shapeshifting demon with a thirst for human flesh, known as "youma," arrives in Raki's village, a lone woman with silver eyes walks into town with only a sword upon her back. She is a "Claymore," a being manufactured as half-human and half-youma, for the express purpose of exterminating these monsters. After Raki's family is killed, the Claymore saves his life, but he is subsequently banished from his home. With nowhere else to go, Raki finds the Claymore, known as Clare, and decides to follow her on her journeys.

As the pair travel from town to town, defeating youma along the way, more about Clare's organization and her fellow warriors comes to light. With every town cleansed and every demon destroyed, they come closer to the youma on which Clare has sought vengeance ever since she chose to become a Claymore.
anime.consensus_summary: Claymore receives mixed reactions, praised for its dark fantasy setting, unique character designs, and action sequences. However, many find the ending rushed and unsatisfying, with repetitive character backstories and an annoying sidekick. The series shows promise but ultimately falls short due to poor plot decisions and a failure to fully develop its characters and world.
pros: Unique and detailed character designs, especially the Claymores.
Well-choreographed and exciting action sequences.
Compelling world-building with gradual introduction of elements.
Strong female characters with depth and complex motivations.
cons: Unsatisfying and rushed ending that deviates from the manga.
Repetitive backstories for Claymore characters.
Underdeveloped secondary characters.
Annoying and useless sidekick character (Raki).
Inconsistent sound effects and music.
Generic plot elements and predictable fights.
Inability to distinguish Claymores due to similar designs.

anime.title: Shin Hakkenden
anime.synopsis:
Based on the long cherished, classic Japanese novel Nanso Satomi Hakkenden by Bakin Kyokutei Takizawa (1767), a modified version of it was made into animation.

Taking place in the future, during this time wars were occuring in heaven, mostly for possession between the eight moons created by the savior Fuse that surrounded God's land. When the war ended, there was only one ruling family - that of the Oowaris, and the remaining son gained control of all the moons of heaven, except for one. Meiten, the moon of the pope, where people refrained from war and were therefore out of it's terms.

Eight people. Each from one of the eight moons. Each possessing one of the jewels - the elements that compose Earth. They are those who are destined to become saviors of humanity. All of them have sacrificed for these jewels, and are determined to complete their duty to Queen Fuse who entrusted these to them. When the mad emperor Kai threatens to revive a ghost who wants to prevent the restoration of Earth, these eight must battle using the powers given by their jewels in order to create Earth and defeat those who want to prevent it.

So they all go to Kusanagi, the ship in the center of God's land. They must gather the jewels in the key called Yatsufusa at Kusanagi's center, in order to create Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: Shin Hakkenden is appreciated for its character-driven narrative and exploration of deep themes, although it is weighed down by its dated production values and some narrative inconsistencies. The strong character development and unique world-building compensate for the flaws, leading to a mixed but generally positive reception. Viewers find the story and characters engaging, but are often distracted by the animation and sound quality.
pros: Well-developed characters with tragic backstories
Good pacing with meaningful fight scenes
Exploration of character development and motivations
cons: Outdated and low-budget animation and art
Repetitive and limited music
Lack of depth in villains
Unbalanced fantasy elements that interfere with the Sci-Fi vibe

anime.title: Barefoot Gen
anime.synopsis:
In 1945, World War II is at its peak. As Japanese cities are fire-bombed and the nation is cornered by US forces, Japan is collapsing under the immense pressure. Gen Nakaoka, a bold, free-spirited young boy, lives in Hiroshima. Struggling with wartime scarcity and barely making ends meet, Gen and his family are hopeful that the conflict will soon end with Japan's imminent defeat and their city unscathed.

However, unbeknownst to them, their fate is already sealed with the impending dropping of "Little Boy," the US atomic bomb set to cause the devastating cataclysm that will forever change Japanese society.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus highly regards 'Hadashi no Gen' for its powerful and graphic depiction of the Hiroshima bombing's horrors, serving as a significant anti-war statement. While praised for its emotional impact and historical significance, some criticism is directed at its dated production values and occasional tonal inconsistencies, leading to a moderately divided but generally respectful reception.
pros: The film's graphic and unflinching depiction of the horrors of the atomic bombing and its aftermath is considered a powerful and effective portrayal of war's devastation.

The use of animation, particularly the 'cartoony' art style, is noted as an effective contrast to the horrific subject matter, enhancing the emotional impact and making difficult scenes more impactful.
The narrative, based on a survivor's real-life experiences, provides a deeply personal and human perspective on the tragedy, making it a significant historical document and an anti-war statement.
The film successfully conveys the suffering of civilians caught in war, highlighting their struggles for survival and the long-term effects of radiation.
cons: The animation and sound design are noted as dated, with some sound effects occasionally feeling overwhelming or off-kilter.
The tone can be inconsistent, with moments of slapstick or 'mood whiplash' that can detract from the serious subject matter.
Some viewers feel the film's character development is lacking or that Gen's consistent upbeat nature in the face of tragedy can feel unrealistic.
The film's focus on the American bombing, without mentioning Japan's prior wartime actions, can lead to it being perceived as propaganda by viewers unfamiliar with the full historical context.

anime.title: Deltora Quest
anime.synopsis:
Long ago, the blacksmith Adin forged a belt of seven powerful gems, one from each of the seven tribes of Deltora. Wielding the belt's unparalleled power, he repelled the Shadow Lord's attempt to overthrow the kingdom. Adin was crowned king of Deltora, but he never forgot that the enemy remained unbeaten. 

Centuries later, memory of the Shadow Lord has become faded and almost forgotten, and the people of Deltora see their monarchy as detached and uncaring. Much to their dismay, the Shadow Lord strikes once more, breaking the Belt of Deltora by scattering the seven gems across the continent. Jarred, a close friend of the young king Endon, assists him and his wife in escaping from the castle as the Shadow Lord takes over, and they part ways to go into hiding.

The Shadow Lord now reigns over Deltora and many years pass under his tyrannical rule. However, there is a glimmer of hope in Jarred's son Lief, whom he has lovingly raised and trained to find the scattered gemstones and reassemble the Belt of Deltora. Along with his companions Barda and Jasmine, Lief must face devious enemies and dangerous beasts to oust the Shadow Lord and return peace to Deltora.
anime.consensus_summary: Deltora Quest is generally viewed as a nostalgic and enjoyable, if somewhat simple, adventure story, particularly by those who read the books as children. While the adaptation is praised for its faithfulness to the source material and solid pacing, it is often criticized for its predictable plot, uninspired animation, and weak voice acting. The series seems to evoke a sense of fondness and appreciation for its straightforward storytelling and adherence to classic fantasy tropes.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material
Well-paced story with a clear narrative
Enjoyable adventure despite its simplicity
cons: Predictable plot and cliched characters
Mediocre animation and dated CGI
Inconsistent voice acting, especially in the English dub

anime.title: Moribito - Guardian of the Spirit
anime.synopsis:
On the precipice of a cataclysmic drought, the Star Readers of the Shin Yogo Empire must devise a plan to avoid widespread famine. It is written in ancient myths that the first emperor, along with eight warriors, slew a water demon to avoid a great drought and save the land that was to become Shin Yogo. If a water demon was to appear once more, its death could bring salvation. However, the water demon manifests itself within the body of the emperor's son, Prince Chagum—by the emperor's order, Chagum is to be sacrificed to save the empire.

Meanwhile, a mysterious spear-wielding mercenary named Balsa arrives in Shin Yogo on business. After saving Chagum from a thinly veiled assassination attempt, she is tasked by Chagum's mother to protect him from the emperor and his hunters. Bound by a sacred vow she once made, Balsa accepts.

Seirei no Moribito follows Balsa as she embarks on her journey to protect Chagum, exploring the beauty of life, nature, family, and the bonds that form between strangers.
anime.consensus_summary: Seirei no Moribito is generally well-received for its strong production values, compelling characters, and immersive world. While some find the pacing uneven and the plot somewhat predictable, most agree that it is a worthwhile fantasy anime. Balsa is often praised as a standout female character, and the fight scenes are noted for their impressive animation.
pros: Stunning animation and background art by Production I.G, creating a visually captivating world.
Well-developed and realistic characters, especially Balsa, who defies typical female lead tropes.
Intricate world-building with attention to detail, seamlessly integrated into the story.
Excellent fight choreography and animation, making action sequences engaging and impactful.
cons: Pacing issues, with the story slowing down considerably in the middle episodes.
Some characters and plot points feel underdeveloped or unnecessary.
Occasional use of cel-shaded CG that can be distracting.
The plot may feel generic or predictable to some viewers.

anime.title: Catblue Dynamite
anime.synopsis:
It is the end of 70s. Blue – a woman with cat ears and tail – has solved many incidents and troubles with her special ability to see a ghost and her technique to handle three guns at one using her tail.

One day, two couriers, Bill and Robert are assaulted by mysterious masked men. They don't know why they were assaulted. Blue asks a dead masked man their purpose. It is incredible. What they are aiming at is the cassette tape of Sinatra that Bill owns. Over the cassette tape, a long day begins...
anime.consensus_summary: Catblue: Dynamite is seen as a flawed but interesting project. While praised for its style, music and character concepts, the execution is criticized heavily, particularly the animation and voice acting. Viewers are divided on whether its campy nature is a strength or a weakness, leading to mixed feelings overall. The anime's unique premise and homage to 70s action films generate some appreciation, but its technical shortcomings prevent widespread enjoyment.
pros: Stylish presentation and 70s aesthetic
Catchy music fitting the era
Characters are archetypal and potentially engaging
cons: Poor voice acting and dialogue
Inconsistent and dated CG animation
Incongruous references breaking the 70s immersion

anime.title: Tales from Earthsea
anime.synopsis:
Calamities are plaguing the land of Earthsea and dragons have been seen fighting above the clouds—something which has never happened before. Sparrowhawk, a powerful Archmage, sets out to uncover the mystery behind these concerning events and meets Prince Arren along the way. Arren is the fugitive heir to the Kingdom of Enlad and a seemingly quiet and distressed lad. Wandering aimlessly in an attempt to escape the dark presence haunting him, he decides to tag along Sparrowhawk on his journey.

However, their arrival in the seaside settlement of Hort Town is met with unexpected trouble—Lord Cob, a powerful evil wizard obsessed with eternal life, stands in their way. Forced to confront him, the pair joins forces with Tenar—an old friend of Sparrowhawk—and Therru, the ill-fated orphan girl she took in. But the enemy's cunning hobby of manipulating emotions may just prove to be catastrophic for the young prince.

Set in a magical world, Ged Senki goes beyond the classical battle between the forces of good and evil, as it explores the inner battles of the heart.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is quite divided on Tales from Earthsea. While many praise its stunning visuals, beautiful soundtrack, and philosophical themes, a significant portion finds the storytelling convoluted, the characters underdeveloped, and the pacing problematic. Many viewers feel the film fails as an adaptation and as a standalone narrative, leading to a strong split between those who appreciate its artistry and thematic ambition and those who are frustrated by its execution.
pros: Breathtaking scenery and animation quality.
Exceptional and moving soundtrack with a distinct Celtic feel.
Thematic depth exploring life, death, and inner struggles.
Strong voice acting, particularly Willem Dafoe as Cob.
Captures the 'feel' and themes of the source material for book readers.
cons: Confusing and disorganized plot, likely due to adapting too much source material.
Lack of explanation for plot points, character motivations, and world-building elements.
Pacing issues, with long stretches of padding and rushed critical moments.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of emotional resonance for many viewers.
Thematic messages are sometimes too overtly stated or 'beaten like a dead horse'.

anime.title: Megaman Star Force
anime.synopsis: In the year 220X, the world has advanced toward radio-wave technology, and the world is connected through the Wave Road. Meet Subaru Hoshikawa, a fifth-grade student who lost his father in a space accident. Subaru meets an extraterrestrial radio-wave being named War-Rock, descending from a distant FM planet. War-Rock claims to know about Subaru's father, but many alien beings are after War-Rock. The two work together and merge into Rockman, a radio-wave human capable of traversing the Wave Road and battling the radio-wave viruses and FMs that threaten the Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Ryuusei no Rockman' anime adaptation receives mixed reviews, often compared unfavorably to the game. Some appreciate its expansion of minor characters and interesting designs, while others criticize its poor character development, altered storyline, and mediocre animation. The anime is generally seen as a kid-friendly adaptation that may appeal to existing fans but falls short of doing the games justice.
pros: Expands on personalities of minor characters.
Interesting character designs.
Music is pretty nice in its own ways.
cons: Character development is poor, trauma is downplayed.
Story is lacking, changed completely from the game.
Art is mediocre, animation is basic.

anime.title: Shuffle! Memories
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: A recap of the Shuffle world, set ten years in the future. Gods, Demons, and Humans freely visit the other worlds as if traveling overseas, and romance is in the air. Demons, Gods, And Humans together have been falling in love and creating new families, breaking down the wall that once seperated them. Past memories are visited by Rin Tsuchimi and the events that occured between him and Lisianthus, Nerine, Kaede, Asa, and Primula.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that "Shuffle! Memories" is a disappointing recap of the original series. Fans found it redundant and lacking in new content, with the exception of the final episode. While newcomers to the series might find it useful as a summary, most viewers recommend watching the original "Shuffle!" instead.
pros: New opening music for each character provides a pleasant, fresh element.
The final, original episode offers some enjoyment and laughs for fans of the original series.
Good for newcomers to the series as a summary of the original story.
cons: The series is essentially a recap of the original Shuffle! with no new story or character development.
Important story and character details are missing or condensed, negatively impacting the narrative.
The recap format spoils events from later episodes of the original series.
Most viewers felt that watching the original is better than watching this recap.

anime.title: Dokkoida?!
anime.romaji_title: Sumeba Miyako no Cosmos-sou Suttoko Taisen Dokkoida
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Parody, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: The Galaxy Federation Police (GFP) desperately wants to cover-up its personnel shortage with new mechanized power-suits. Suzuo, 19-years old, desperately needs a job. Tampopo needs an earthling to fit the prototype of her company's suit and declares Suzuo the perfect candidate! Strong competitors and the wacky A-class criminals fight against our hero in diapers, but they must not recognize each other out of costume or the test results will be a failure- but it's OK if they all live in the same apartment building to save money, right?
anime.consensus_summary: The show is well-received, especially for its comedic elements and character development. Some viewers find the art style and soundtrack unmemorable. Overall, it is considered an enjoyable and clever superhero satire.
pros: Good comedy
Fun and bouncy songs
Great voice acting
Characters get enough development to care about them
Clever storytelling
Chemistry between actors
cons: Childish story
Art style not visually pleasing to everyone
forgettable OST and BGM
Some sexual comedy
Characters don’t normally keep their shape
Wall of dialogue that never went anywhere

anime.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
anime.romaji_title: Zero no Tsukaima: Futatsuki no Kishi
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Revered as heroes for their role in defending Tristain, Louise Françoise and her familiar Saito Hiraga face heavy pressure to continue protecting the Kingdom. With an uneasy peace now established within Albion, the newly crowned Queen Henrietta must deal with a political struggle brewing on the horizon.
