To make matters worse, a new villain has begun plotting in the shadows against the Crown.

With the continuing threats that face the Kingdom, Louise and Saito are compelled to work together once more. No longer "Louise the Zero," the young mage's newfound aptitude for Void magic gives her enough power to wipe out an entire village; however, wielding these abilities comes with its share of challenges. As more conflicts arise, the idea of placing honor above oneself is put into question—regardless of their answer, their only choice is to see it through until the end.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling the second season doesn't live up to the first. While some appreciate the attempts at character development and the more thrilling action, others are turned off by the increased fan service, inconsistent plot, and the perceived degradation of Saito's character. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on tolerance for the harem elements and forgiving the narrative shortcomings.
pros: Improved animation and art quality compared to the first season.
Enjoyable new opening and ending themes.
Some character development, particularly with Henrietta and Colbert.
Strong emotional moments and a satisfying finale for some viewers.
The action is more thrilling and enjoyable.
cons: Inconsistent story, with disjointed arcs and unresolved plot points.
Increased and often poorly executed fan service.
Saito's character devolves into an annoying pervert.
Marginalization of established characters from the first season.
Unnecessary slapstick ruins serious moments
Predictable plot and overuse of the Louise-Saito love/hate dynamic.

anime.title: Dai Mahou Touge Omake
anime.synopsis: Omake (extra) of Dai Mahou Touge.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is positive, especially for fans of the original Dai Mahou Touge series. The Omake is appreciated for delivering more of the same humor and Punie's characteristic antics in a short, easily digestible format. Familiarity with the main series is considered a prerequisite for enjoying the Omake.
pros: Continues the humor of the main series
Short and easy to watch
Features Punie's antics
cons: Requires familiarity with the main series
Plot is simple and episodic

anime.title: Major S3
anime.synopsis:
Having bid farewell to his former teammates at Kaido High School's baseball club, Gorou Honda returns to his hometown eager to continue playing. Attending a new high school proves to be more difficult than he initially expected, as Tetsufumi Egashira's merciless slandering of his name prevents Gorou from being accepted into any school with an existing baseball team. 

Left with no other options, Gorou joins Seishuu High School, where his childhood friend Kaoru Shimizu also attends. However, Seishuu has always been an all-girls school until two years ago, so there is not yet a dedicated men’s baseball team.

But nothing will stop Gorou in his pursuit of Koshien. He must now create a baseball team from scratch with the seven male students at Seishuu, but all of them are complete amateurs! He decides to train the incompetent team up to nationally competitive levels, but such a feat is easier said than done. Will Gorou once again perform miracles? Or will he give up on achieving his goal of defeating Kaido with his own team?
anime.consensus_summary: Season 3 of Major is generally well-received, particularly for its exciting baseball action and character development. While some find the storyline repetitive or Goro's personality off-putting, the satisfying conclusion and themes of teamwork and perseverance resonate with viewers. Most agree that this season is a worthwhile addition to the series, though perhaps not as strong as Season 2.
pros: Exciting baseball action
Fantastic character development of Goro
Satisfying clash with Kaido
Themes of trust, friendship, and willingness
Accurate baseball technical aspects
cons: Can feel repetitive to Season 1
Goro can come off as self-centered
Transition between seasons can feel rushed

anime.title: Yomigaeru Sora: Rescue Wings - Saigo no Shigoto
anime.romaji_title: Yomigaeru Sora: Rescue Wings - Saigo no Shigoto
anime.synopsis: Episode 13 of Yomigaeru Sora: Rescue Wings, released as a DVD special. Takes place before the events in the series.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is seen as a touching and worthwhile addition to the series, particularly for fans interested in Motomura's backstory. While the rescue mission is less dramatic than those in the main series, it holds personal significance for the character. Overall, the episode offers a sentimental and character-focused experience.
pros: Touching backstory for Motomura
Nice animation quality (same as TV series)
Provides closure for the series
cons: Ureshii's subs may have translation issues regarding ranks
The rescue mission is milder compared to the TV series

anime.title: CLAMP School Detectives
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Detective, Mystery, School, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
The CLAMP school, with its integrated curriculum from kindergarten to post-graduate studies, was founded by the largest of Japanese business empires, the House of Imonoyama. Funded entirely out of its own deep pockets, it was hoped that the school would be a haven for young men and women on whose shoulders our future would rest.

The School is open to any talented individual, irrespective of his or her lineage or financial standing and is known to count scores of singularly talented pupils. It is furthermore also famous for its harboring of a remarkable percentage of party animals. Not even the bright and talented minds of CLAMP School can keep the campus free of crimes and mysteries. Or can they? Join Nokoru, Suoh and Akira, our case-cracking kid detectives, as they save the day and even the odd damsel in distress!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Clamp Gakuen Tanteidan is generally positive, particularly among those who appreciate CLAMP's signature style and light-hearted episodic stories. While the characters and art style are praised, some find the plot simplistic and the lack of an overarching narrative unsatisfying. The show is considered enjoyable for casual viewers or those new to CLAMP's works, but may not appeal to hardcore fans seeking depth and complexity.
pros: Charming characters with distinct personalities
CLAMP's art style is considered gorgeous and detailed for its time
Enjoyable and amusing, especially for fans of light-hearted stories
cons: Episodic nature can make the overall storyline feel weak or lacking a clear goal
Simplicity and predictability can be a turn-off for some viewers
Romance elements may not appeal to all, especially given the characters' ages

anime.title: Gaiking: Legend of Daiku-Maryu
anime.synopsis:
A boy, Tsuwabaki Daiya found a black fire in an ocean when he and his father were in a small boat. A big monster came out of the fire, and the father and the crews were disappeared into the sea. When he was about to become the next victim, a large mecka dragon appeared and saved him.

5 years later since then, Daiya becomes a junior high school student. A big monster reappear, and he meets the mecha dragon,"Daiku Maryu". The head of the dragon separates from the body, and it turns into the body of a super robot, Gaiking. He gets in Gaiking, fights against the monster, and beats it.

He learns that there is an enemy that plots to conquer the world, and he leaves for another world, Darius, to stop the plot.
anime.consensus_summary: Gaiking: Legend of Daiku-Maryu is a well-received remake that pays homage to classic super robot shows while adding its own unique flavor. The show is praised for its action, music, voice acting, and mecha designs. While some critique the inconsistent character artwork and reliance on genre tropes, the overall audience mood is positive, with many considering it a modern super robot classic.
pros: Successfully homages and parodies classic super robot shows.
Evocative music and outstanding voice acting.
Gorgeous and action-packed mechanical artwork.
Enjoyable plot development with nice twists.
Avoids annoying plot clichés.
Packed with moments that make you think 'Fuck yeah'.
Excellent intro with catchy song and animation.
cons: Character artwork sometimes goes between the outstanding and the generic anime look.
Requires acceptance of genre tropes.

anime.title: Princess Nine
anime.synopsis: Keiko Himuro, Chairman of the Kisuragi School, puts together an all-girl baseball team led by Ryo Hayakawa, daughter of a legendary pitcher, in hopes of proving that girls can compete just as well as boys. Their goal: Koshien Stadium, where only the best teams get the opportunity to play.
anime.consensus_summary: Princess Nine receives mixed reviews, with many praising its likeable characters and focus on teamwork, while others criticize its excessive melodrama and lack of baseball content. The love triangle is a major point of contention, with some finding it detracting from the main plot. Overall, the show is considered a charming but flawed sports anime with a strong emphasis on character relationships over athletic competition.
pros: Likeable characters with individual backstories and development
Good 90s animation and art style with well-designed main characters
Sound design, especially the dub, enhances the viewing experience
Focus on character bonds and teamwork creates an engaging experience
cons: Overemphasis on melodrama and romantic developments detracts from the main plot
Underwhelming depiction of Koshien tournament with little focus on baseball
Repetitive animation and reused frames during baseball scenes
Unnecessary love triangle consumes too much time and affects team dynamics
Lack of in-depth baseball knowledge and sudden expertise of characters

anime.title: Rec: Yurusarezarumono
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Romance, Seinen, Showbiz
anime.synopsis:
While going out to eat with his roommate Aka Onda, Fumihiko Matsumaru encounters Tanaka, a woman from his company's accounting department who had previously stood him up on a date. Dumped by her boyfriend just minutes before, Tanaka forces Fumihiko to drink with her, spurring Aka's jealousy.

After Fumihiko escorts a drunk Tanaka home, he ends up tending to her the entire night, leading Aka to become suspicious. How will Fumihiko clear up the misunderstanding?
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA 'Rec: Yurusarezarumono' is well-received and considered a valuable addition to the main series. It seamlessly blends into the narrative, enhancing character development and providing humor. Viewers highly recommend watching it after episode 7, as it feels like a natural continuation of the story.
pros: Adds depth to characters, especially Tanaka and Aka.
Feels seamless with the main series; high production quality maintained.
Humorous and enjoyable; enhances the overall series experience.
cons: None explicitly mentioned in the provided review, but OVAs may not appeal to all viewers.
Short episode; may leave viewers wanting more content.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Comedy, Slice of Life, Character-Driven

anime.title: Lord of Lords Ryu Knight
anime.synopsis: Adeu the Sonic, brash young pilot of the Ryu Knight Zephyr, is joined in his travels by Princess Paffy, Priest Izumi and Ninja Sarutobi. They encounter various people of the land, including other Ryus. On the way, Adeu seeks to test his Ryu against others and thereby grow in his abilities.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is well-loved, with many fans considering it an all-time favorite. It blends mecha with fantasy elements like swords and magic. The characters are distinct and relatable, and the series balances comedy and drama effectively, despite a slow start.
pros: Combination of mechs with swords, old style guns, and magic
Characters are very different and relatable
Balance between comedy and drama
Art style similar to Slayers and other early nineties series
Music is great and awesome listening
cons: Plot is a fairly common one
Sound effects aren't as impressive as they were at the time
Series gets off to a rather slow start

anime.title: Hidamari Sketch
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Slice of Life, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis:
Ever since she was young, Yuno has always had an interest in art. Now that she has been accepted to Yamabuki Arts High School, it means one thing—moving out. Living in a dorm at Hidamari Apartments alone, Yuno meets her neighbors: the hyperactive Miyako, the self-conscious Hiro, and the mature Sae. Despite their different personalities, they go to the same school, spend time together, and develop a strong friendship. Yuno's life won't be so lonely after all!

Hidamari Sketch revolves around the antics and day-to-day lives of the girls living at Hidamari Apartments.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising Hidamari Sketch for its relaxing atmosphere, unique art style, and lovable characters. Viewers appreciate the show's ability to evoke feelings of warmth and happiness through its simple yet effective storytelling. While some note the lack of a strong plot and the potential for cultural inaccessibility, the overall sentiment is that Hidamari Sketch is a cherished and comforting slice-of-life anime.
pros: Unique and creative art style with integration of real-life photos.
Lovable and well-developed characters with distinct personalities.
Catchy and mood-setting soundtrack with cheerful opening and calming ending themes.
Humorous and heartwarming moments that evoke a warm, fuzzy feeling.
The animation is very creative with fast camera switching
Well voice acted, fitting the cute voices to the personalities
cons: Lack of a strong, linear plot; episodic format may not appeal to all viewers.
Simplified animation style might not appeal to those seeking high production value.
Japanese one-shot gags may be confusing or inaccessible to casual anime viewers unfamiliar with Japanese culture.

anime.title: Cutey Honey F
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, Sci-Fi, Shoujo
anime.synopsis: On her sixteenth birthday, Honey Kisaragi goes to meet her father. However, he shows up injured and on the run. Out of nowhere, a group of thugs and a monster show up. A detective, Seiji Hayama, rescues Honey and her father. Unfortunately, the monster captures Honey`s father. A grieving Honey goes home to find it in ruins, but a handsome man gives her hope and a device to use against the monsters who took her father. With them, Honey can transform into multiple forms and destroy Panther Zora, the evil behind this.
anime.consensus_summary: Cutie Honey F is generally well-received as a magical girl anime with a refreshing take on the original series. The animation and character designs are praised, along with its engaging plot. While some criticize the slow pacing and repetitive monster-of-the-week format, the show is considered an enjoyable and heartfelt series overall.
pros: Refreshing take on the Cutie Honey franchise, appealing to a broader audience.
Well-written plot with humor, action, and plot twists.
Likeable and interesting characters with unique characteristics.
Great visuals, including character designs and animation, especially in fight scenes.
cons: Monster of the Week formula can become repetitive.
Slow pacing at times.
Some instances of Japanese sexism, portraying marriage and children as a woman's only dream.

anime.title: MegaMan: Wishing upon a Star
anime.synopsis:
"This Anime (Episode 2, to be exact), where Rockman travels from the Game-World to the real world, to learn some cultural differences about Japan, was intended to be a Special Episode for the original Mega Man Cartoon Series by Ruby-Spears, which aired around 1995 in the US.
As it seems, the special was finished before Ruby-Spears decided to redo their whole show with a completely new design, better suited for American audiences.

Thus, not fitting the new style anymore, it never was included in the series. Still, two more episodes about the same story were produced a bit later, this time under the main title "Rockman" (unlike Episode 2, where he's called Mega Man, even in the japanese dub).

It's unknown if these 3 Episodes ever saw an official release, until 2002, when Capcom of Japan decided to finally (re)release them on DVD for Rockman's 15th Anniversary (all featuring a Japanese and English dub, but no subs).

It's unknown if there are any more secret animated works of the original Rockman game-series."
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience has mixed feelings. Some viewers find the OVA to be a charming and nostalgic trip, appreciating its educational elements and faithful recreation of the game's aesthetics. However, others criticize its simplistic and somewhat nonsensical plot, annoying characters, and underutilization of established characters, ultimately finding it a poorly executed attempt at edutainment.
pros: Charming characters with nice interactions
Educational content integrated well without being boring
Nostalgic feel reminiscent of classic Saturday morning cartoons
Animation is crisp and vibrant, bringing the familiar faces to life
Sound effects and music taken straight from the game
cons: Simplistic and somewhat stupid narrative
Educational elements don't mesh well with the plot
Annoying human sidekicks
Underutilization of robot masters
Mediocre voice acting and sound mixing

anime.title: Taiyou no Mokushiroku: A Spirit of the Sun
anime.romaji_title: Taiyou no Mokushiroku: A Spirit of the Sun
anime.synopsis: On August 10 2002, the eruption of Mount Fuji, as well as a series of large-scale earthquakes tsunamis inflict tremendous damage to Japan, sending the country into a state of emergency. Furthermore, another massive earthquake hit Japan on August 15, splitting the country into two. While Japanese refugees were taken in by various countries, the Japanese government accepted aid from China and the United States, which eventually caused China to govern the North, and the USA to govern the South. 15 years later, the Japanese refugees residing in Taiwan and the Taiwanese citizens find themselves clashing with one another, due to job competition and the unimproving conditions of the Japanese refugees. Genichiro Ryu is a survivor of the catastrophic events that took place in Japan, but was raised in Taiwan by a couple who adopted him. He gets himself involved in the situation between the Taiwanese and the Japanese, hoping that the two parties will be able to coexist with one another.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the show's mature themes, realistic portrayal of disaster, and engaging story. Others criticize the animation quality, contrived plot elements, and inconsistent tone. While some find it a gripping and thought-provoking experience, others struggle to take it seriously due to its flaws.
pros: Gripping tale of geopolitics and survival
Realistic portrayal of disaster and refugee life
Strong characters and engaging story
Addresses complex themes like racism, family ties, and loyalty
cons: Stiff animation, especially in the beginning
Contrived plot and unrealistic elements
Inconsistent direction and tone
Over the top at times

anime.title: Gakuen Utopia Manabi Straight!
anime.synopsis:
Manabi Straight! follows the lives of a group of young high school girls living in the year 2035 while they attend the all-girl Seioh Private High School. Since the birth rate has dropped dramatically, schools are being closed down due to the sheer lack of students available to teach. Morale in schools has dropped dramatically, and Seioh is no exception.

The story begins when the main character, Manami Amamiya, transfers to Seioh. After some initial hijinks involving a futuristic scooter and a swim meet, followed by an inspirational school song performance, she is inducted as the student council president. The story that follows pertains to Manami working with Mika Inamori, the only other student council member, and three other classmates named Mutsuki Uehara, Mei Etoh, and Momoha Odori, in student council matters.  After some remodeling of the student council room, Manami and her friends set forth to plan for the upcoming student festival.
anime.consensus_summary: Gakuen Utopia Manabi Straight! is generally well-received as a cute and heartwarming slice-of-life anime with a unique setting and focus on friendship. While praised for its animation, music, and social commentary, some find the characters and plot to be generic and underdeveloped. The series' emphasis on 'cute' aesthetics and loli-style character designs can also be a point of contention for some viewers.
pros: Heartwarming story about friendship and school spirit.
Unique setting with social commentary on Japan's declining population.
Excellent animation and vibrant art style.
Memorable opening and ending themes.
Unique and well-executed use of music, especially the percussion-based OST.
cons: Generic character archetypes with underdeveloped personalities.
Simplistic plot lacking depth and meaningful conflict.
Repetitive soundtrack and forgettable BGM.
Overreliance on 'cute' aesthetics can overshadow the story.
Loli-style character designs may be off-putting to some viewers.

anime.title: Tokyo Majin
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Martial Arts, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Something evil is stirring in the shadows of Tokyo...

During the spring of his senior year in high school, quiet Tatsuma Hiyuu transfers to Magami Academy in Shinjuku. The mysterious boy's "outsider" status and his profound skills in martial arts quickly earn him the friendship of class delinquent Kyouichi Houraiji. Through an uncanny connection and a happenstance challenge, he also meets Yuuya Daigo of the wrestling club, the captain of the girls' archery club, Komaki Sakurai, and Aoi Misato, the Student Council President.

During their encounter, there is a sudden, harsh disruption of the Ryumyaku (literally Dragon Pulse, otherwise known as Dragon Vein or Dragon Stream), the flow of arcane energy. The surge awakens within the five teenagers a latent power, giving them each a supernatural ability. Enlightened to their newly acquired gifts by Hisui, the young heir of the Kisaragi Clan who maintains his family's antiques shop - as well as their duty to protect Tokyo from Oni (demons) - the Magami students decide to use their power to protect the city from the onslaught of dark forces.

Battling the demons alongside Hisui Kisaragi, the five unlikely friends discover that they may have to face a greater threat to Tokyo other than destroying a few malevolent, random monsters. The Ryumyaku had been disrupted by force, from someone invoking the Dark Arts - and that person has a wicked desire to unleash a long-dead evil.

Can the teenagers overcome their own fears and flaws to fight against the Dark Arts? And soon they will also have to face their own destinies as they discover their Stars of Fate.

This anime is based on a manga, which was based on the Nintendo role-playing video game originally released in 1998.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with viewers appreciating the action, dark themes, and character dynamics, particularly the male leads. However, the confusing plot, inconsistent animation, and weak female characters are significant drawbacks. While some find the series highly enjoyable, others are left disappointed, resulting in a moderate level of polarization.
pros: Excellent fight choreography and action sequences, often described as intense and gory.
Strong male characters, particularly the friendship between Tatsuma and Kyouichi, are a highlight.
The soundtrack is well-suited to the eerie and intense mood of the anime.
cons: The plot can be confusing, especially in the initial episodes, with unclear explanations and abrupt time changes.
Some viewers find the female characters annoying or weak, detracting from their overall enjoyment.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with some scenes being too dark or character faces degrading at a distance.
anime.thematic_vibe: Dark Fantasy, Supernatural Action, High School Drama

anime.title: Loving Angel Angelique: Radiant Tomorrow
anime.romaji_title: Koisuru Tenshi Angelique: Kagayaki no Ashita
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Reverse Harem, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis: Ange is now trapped in the Seijuu Universe, and cannot leave until she awakens Seijuu's Queen. In order to do this, she must gather nine new guardians. It sounds like a fairly simple task, but how can she convince these men to tear away from their own lives and protect the life of another?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the series enjoyable if they are fans of the reverse harem and bishounen genres. There is appreciation for the improved storyline and character development compared to the previous season, but the large cast and occasional animation inconsistencies are drawbacks.  Viewers felt the ending was surprisingly good and worth watching.
pros: Improved story compared to the previous season.
Character development, especially for Ange.
Bright and colorful animation.
cons: Too many characters, making it difficult to distinguish personalities.
Light-hearted music doesn't always fit serious situations.
Inconsistent animation quality in some episodes.

anime.title: Mina
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Parody, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
An animated spin-off from the Densha Otoko (Trainman) TV drama.

In the drama, actor Itoh Atsushi plays the otaku Yamada, whose main love in life is the Mina anime, a cutesy busty heroine with floppy rabbit ears and carrots sticking out her rear.

Mina itself is a character homage which triggers back to the Daicon Animation done by GAINAX where a similar nameless bunny girl appeared. Densha Otoko futher featured an opening with scenes which were appearing back in the Daicon Animation.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers found 'Getsumen to Heiki Mina' to be an entertaining and unique spin-off with enjoyable characters and fresh takes on the magical girl genre. However, others criticized the nonsensical plot, lack of character development, and uninspired writing. The show seems to appeal to those who appreciate its absurdity and lightheartedness, while others find it boring and poorly conceived.
pros: Unique take on the magical girl genre, avoiding typical tropes.
Entertaining and able to hold interest throughout the season.
Good transformation sequences with nice details and colors.
The opening and ending themes are well-suited to the series.
cons: Plot can be farfetched, unnecessarily complicated, and boring.
Some found the writing to be lacking in ideas and vision.
Character development is lacking, especially for the supporting characters.
Standard art style with small eyes and unremarkable backgrounds.

anime.title: Giniro no Olynsis: Tokito
anime.synopsis:
AD 3567. Mankind has lost its once great civilization, now living in the ruins of the aftermath. But even though their lives are threatened by Gardeners — mysterious unmanned mobile weapons (of different ranks) sent from the Moon — brave teenagers have to become Gardener hunters to earn their living. And although human civilization at large lies in ruins due to high-tech maintenance free technology, some parts of the remaining cities still work in limited ways, supporting the humans living there.

One fateful day Tokito Aizawa meets Tea, awakening a power older and beyond that of the Gardeners, and inadvertently opening up the door to a possibly much brighter future for the remainder of mankind...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience finds 'Giniro no Olynsis: Tokito' to be a worthwhile watch, especially for fans of mecha and romance. While some find the story confusing at first, the plot twists and satisfying conclusion make up for it. The main criticism is that the short length forces the story to be rushed.
pros: Satisfying story in a short amount of time
Good mix of mecha, romance, action, and drama
Plot twists keep the story interesting
cons: Character designs and animation are lacking
Story can be confusing initially
Too much crammed into 12 episodes

anime.title: Nana Recaps
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Music, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
Nana Episode 11.5: Junko's Room 
Nana Episode 21.5: Junko's Room 2 
Nana Episode 36.5: Junko's Room 3
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the Nana Recaps, particularly the 'Junko's Room' segments, for their humor and meta-commentary. They serve as helpful summaries of the main series, though watching them prematurely can lead to spoilers. The dubbing quality is praised, and the recaps offer a unique perspective by featuring minor characters. Overall, viewers find them to be a worthwhile addition to the Nana series.
pros: Excellent dubbing quality by Viz Media.
Funny and interesting original content in 'Junko's Place'.
Helpful recaps that remind viewers of subtle details.
cons: Recaps spoil the main series if watched at the wrong time.
Main characters are not featured enough in 'Junko's Place'.
Recaps are not as entertaining as the original episodes because they repeat content.

anime.title: Ape Escape
anime.synopsis: An evil monkey, Specter, has escaped a circus, using a mind-controlling device which allows him to become smarter and have access to controlling the monkeys. Kakeru is called over by a professor in order to capture all the monkeys, including the one's who's controlling them: Specter.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is generally well-received as an enjoyable and fast-paced children's series, based on the Ape Escape franchise. While the story is compelling and the animation is surprisingly pleasant, the character development is lacking and the repetitive music can be grating. Overall, viewers find it a satisfying and entertaining watch despite its shortcomings.
pros: Compelling story for a kid's show
Fast-paced plot avoids slow monologues
Calming and nice-looking CG animation
Enjoyable plot twists and obstacles
cons: Lax character development with stereotypical one-liners
Repetitive music that can become annoying
Childish humor may not appeal to all adults

anime.title: Love♥Love? Specials
anime.synopsis:
DVD Special containing:

Rhapsody of July (DVD Episode 2.5)
If it becomes September (DVD Episode 3.5)
Bitch Actress dropped into Hell (DVD Episode 5.5)
History is Made Through Women (DVD Episode 9.5)
anime.consensus_summary: The "Love♥Love?" Specials are viewed as a slight improvement over the main series, primarily due to a reduced emphasis on exploitative content. Viewers express relief at the calmer tone and absence of major dramatic conflicts. However, the specials are still perceived as lacking a substantial narrative and burdened by the negative reputation of the original series.
pros: Specials are better than the main series.
Less focus on fanservice.
Some character personality.
Lack of major romance drama.
cons: Terrible series overall.
Still some objectionable content from the main series.
Not enough time for an actual story.

anime.title: Kaze no Shoujo Emily
anime.synopsis: Based on the Emily of New Moon novel by Lucy Maud Montgomery. Emily is an orphan who gets sent to live with her relatives on Prince Edward Island, after her father dies. In New Moon she lives with her Aunt Elizabeth, Aunt Laura, and Cousin Jimmy, and learns to adapt with the help of her imagination and new friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is generally positive, with praise for its charming story, beautiful art, and immersive sound. Some find the pacing slow and Emily's character unlikeable. The negative reviews seem to stem from the dub and character choices, while positive reviews highlight the nostalgic and heartwarming elements.
pros: Charming series with realistic characters.
Gorgeous artwork with detailed backgrounds.
Engaging storytelling that leaves a warm, fuzzy feeling.
Soundtrack is orchestral, melodic, and atmospheric, fitting the historical setting perfectly.
cons: Pacing is very slow.
Character designs may be considered ugly by some.
Some may find Emily's character annoying and selfish.
Dubbing may have changed the story, leading to a negative experience.

anime.title: Sasami Magical Girls Club
anime.synopsis: In this world lives a group of people who call themselves "Majo" or "Magical Girls." They hide their powers so as to assimilate into society. They have been living together in harmony with humans for many years, as had their predecessors long before them. Sasami has had magical powers since her birth. However, at the age of three, she was told by her parents never to use her innate powers, and from then on, she kept them secret. On the first day of a new school term, newly transferred teacher Wajuu arrives, and from then on, Sasami's life begins to change tremendously.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the cute art and magical girl themes, finding enjoyment in the series despite its flaws. However, others criticize the filler content, weak characters, and unoriginal plot, leading to overall disappointment. The show seems to appeal more to dedicated magical girl fans willing to overlook its shortcomings.
pros: Cute art style
Catchy opening theme
Enjoyable for hardcore magical girl fans
cons: Filler episodes in season one
Clichéd plot development
Weak characters
Poor English voice acting
Uninspired story
Sasami is an annoying protagonist
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Slice of Life, Friendship

anime.title: How to Breed Kappas
anime.synopsis: A young man passes a pet shop on his way home, and seeing a kappa in the window, decides to buy it on a whim. He brings the creature home, and names him Kaatan. He's never owned a kappa before, so he relies heavily on a book he purchased on the subject of raising and training kappa. The books gives several good tips for bringing up a smart and well behaved kappa, and it all seems very simple. Unfortunately, putting these techniques into practice and actually making them work is not quite as easy as the book implies. Kaatan seems to understand things at first, but usually ends up either forgetting what he's learned, or isn't interested in learning in the first place. However, this particular young man has a lot of patience, and continues his possibly fruitless effort to raise Kaatan into a pet he can be proud of.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Kappa no Kaikata' to be a cute and enjoyable short series.  Viewers appreciate its lighthearted nature and ease of consumption. The main criticism revolves around the lack of a substantial narrative and limited exploration of the Kappa mythology.
pros: Adorable animation
Quick and easy to watch
cons: Lacks a strong overall story
Doesn't delve deeply into Kappa mythology

anime.title: Princess Beware
anime.synopsis: Himeko is supposed to be a common high school student... until she happens to obtain a crown and she becomes a princess. Since then, Nana, the true princess, follows her around to take the crown back. In addition, Leslie and Caren, the thieves, appear to rob her of the crown, and her peaceful life turns into turmoil.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a flawed comedy with a nonsensical and crazy plot that some find enjoyable despite its issues. The main character is often cited as annoying, but the soundtrack and other characters provide some entertainment. While unique in its approach to comedy, the show suffers from poor animation quality and underdeveloped plot elements, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Catchy opening song
Unique use of a cliche idea
Jolly soundtrack
Funny characters
cons: Annoying main character
Absent character development
Lazy backgrounds
Jokes that go on for too long
Underdeveloped secret powers plot point

anime.title: Master of Epic: The Animation Age
anime.romaji_title: Master of Epic: The Animation Age
anime.synopsis: Over millions of years, there have been many ages - war, gods, and future to name a few. Each of these was infinitely less exciting than the current Animation Age! In this RPG-esque existence, becoming stronger is paramount to one's survival and leveling up is a must. From pacifists to news casting, from fishing woes to love advice, there's nothing the Animation Age can't show or teach us about life in a game world! Armed with healing spells, changes of clothes and plenty of summoned familiars, the characters of Master of Epic will do what it takes to level up and live to fight another day!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in its satirical take on RPGs, while others criticize its nonsensical skits, flat characters, and low production value. The humor is targeted towards a niche audience familiar with RPG tropes. The show is self-aware and doesn't take itself seriously, which appeals to some viewers.
pros: Effective satire of RPG idiosyncrasies
Good at explaining game facets
Memorable, repeating sketches
cons: Flat, one-dimensional characters
Nonsensical skits
Bland art style, low-budget feel
Unmemorable music

anime.title: Lucky☆Star
anime.genres: CGDCT, Comedy, Gag Humor, Otaku Culture, School
anime.synopsis:
Lucky☆Star follows the daily lives of four cute high school girls—Konata Izumi, the lazy otaku; the Hiiragi twins, Tsukasa and Kagami (sugar and spice, respectively); and the smart and well-mannered Miyuki Takara.

As they go about their lives at school and beyond, they develop their eccentric and lively friendship and making humorous observations about the world around them. Be it Japanese tradition, the intricacies of otaku culture, academics, or the correct way of preparing and eating various foods—no subject is safe from their musings.
anime.consensus_summary: Lucky Star is a polarizing slice-of-life comedy that heavily relies on otaku culture references. While some viewers find its relatable humor and characters enjoyable, others criticize its repetitive nature and lack of a compelling plot. The series' success largely depends on the viewer's familiarity with anime and Japanese pop culture, leading to a divided audience.
pros: Relatable everyday situations and humor.
Catchy opening theme and varied ending themes.
Likable characters with unique personalities.
cons: Repetitive jokes and lack of plot progression.
Heavy reliance on anime/otaku references that may alienate some viewers.
Inconsistent art style and animation quality.

anime.title: Higurashi: When They Cry – Kai
anime.romaji_title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kai
anime.synopsis: In the small village of Hinamizawa, Rika Furude and her friends live together in relative harmony. Beneath this mask of peace, however, lies a hidden darkness, one that Rika understands all too well. In this eternal summer, she has been witness to unspeakable horrors. Every time the clock resets, Rika must try to find the villain behind these senseless deaths before tragedy strikes again. However, trying to decipher a mystery when only half the clues are present proves time and again to be disastrous, and each time she believes that things will change, she inevitably fails. As the annual festival approaches, Rika begins her descent from hope to despair in her struggle to break the chains of fate entangling them all.
anime.consensus_summary: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kai is generally well-received for providing answers to the mysteries set up in the first season and for its character development. However, some viewers found the pacing to be slow and the atmosphere less tense compared to the original. While the ending is appreciated by some, others found it weak, leading to a somewhat divided opinion on whether it surpasses the first season.
pros: Satisfying answers to mysteries from the first season
Strong character development, especially Rika and previously minor characters
Improved animation quality compared to the first season
Excellent voice acting, particularly Yukari Tamura as Rika
Compelling and intriguing narrative with deceit and betrayal
cons: Pacing issues, with some arcs feeling stretched out
Loss of paranoia and tension compared to the first season
Ending may feel weak or rushed compared to the build-up
Inconsistent animation quality at times
Some viewers found the shift in atmosphere too different from the first season

anime.title: YAT Anshin! Uchuu Ryokou
anime.synopsis: The emergence of the dimensional tunnel sets the background for a new space era in which space travelling can be designated to planets outside the solar system. Hoshiwatari Goro is a space traveller who goes in search for his father whose whereabouts are shrouded with obscurity. His only link to his father is an old photograph. In order to attain his goal, Goro participates in a young space travelling company known as "YAT" which organises tours to different planets. However, in the midst of his journey, he was involved in an accident which resulted in the destruction of the spaceship. As a form of compensation, he had to work for YAT and this sparks off a train of space adventures for him.
anime.consensus_summary: YAT Anshin! Uchuu Ryokou is generally well-received, especially the first season, which is praised for its blend of humor and emotional moments, appealing to both children and adults with its focus on friendship and family. The second season receives criticism for becoming repetitive and shifting away from the space tourism aspect, focusing more on conflicts with the villain. Overall, the series is considered enjoyable and heartwarming, although the second season is seen as a step down in quality.
pros: Humor and emotional moments blend well.
Appeals to both children and adults.
Emphasizes the bonds between friends and the importance of family.
The ending is wonderful.
cons: The second season is monotonous due to repetitive clashes with the villain.
The second season shifts focus away from space tourism.

anime.title: Azuki-chan
anime.synopsis: Azusa Noyama is a 12-year-old girl student, taking 5th grade, but everyone knows her as Azuki-Chan, nickname that she dislikes. Yuunosuke Ogasawara, a new student, asks her about her nickname, saying that he likes it. Azuki falls in love with him, and they start going out together. They share a diary, and become boyfriend and girlfriend.
anime.consensus_summary: Azuki-chan is a simple and heartwarming slice-of-life anime appreciated for its innocent portrayal of first love and childhood friendships. While some episodes might be a bit too silly for some viewers, the positive messages and relatable characters generally create a pleasant viewing experience. The show is largely forgotten, but those who have seen it tend to have fond memories of its simple charm.
pros: Simple and fun stories, easy to follow.
Kindhearted and respectful characters, especially Yunosuke.
Relatable portrayal of childhood experiences and relationships.
cons: Some episodes can be silly or weird.
Ken is an unlikeable character.
Not many people talk about this show.

anime.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Movie
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Shounen, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis: Anubis, an ancient Egyptian evil that was defeated by Yugi's alter ego centuries ago, has returned to exact revenge. Wielding the power of the Eighth Millennium Item, Anubis is determined to destroy Yugi and take over the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, leaning towards a slightly positive sentiment due to nostalgia. Many appreciate the movie for its visuals, character interactions, and introduction of new elements to the card game. However, the unoriginal plot, weak villain, and underwhelming duels leave some viewers disappointed, especially when compared to the Yu-Gi-Oh! series.
pros: Nostalgia factor for childhood viewers
Good art and animation for its time
Enjoyable character interactions, especially between Kaiba, Pegasus, and Yugi
Introduction of new cards and monsters
cons: Unoriginal plot and villain
Underwhelming duels and strategies compared to the series
Repetitive or cliche elements
Poorly written minor characters and dialogue
Anubis's late and underwhelming entrance

anime.title: Cybuster
anime.synopsis: In an enviromentally wrecked future Tokyo, a young man named Ken Ando joins an organization called DC. Little does he realize that his fate and that of Earth will be linked to a mysterious mecha from another world.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Cybuster is considered a lackluster and disappointing series. It fails to capture the magic of the Super Robot Wars source material, featuring uninspired mecha designs, boring fight scenes, and weak character development. The poor animation quality further detracts from the viewing experience, resulting in a generally negative reception.
cons: Uninspired mecha designs compared to Super Robot Wars counterparts
Boring and slow-paced fight scenes
Stock characters with little development
Poor animation quality for its time, with recycled animation and cost-cutting measures
Weak storyline that waters down elements from Super Robot Wars

anime.title: Happiness! OVA
anime.romaji_title: Happiness!: Watarase Jun no Kareinaru Ichinichi
anime.synopsis: With the help of the combination of many different magic, Jun gets turned into an actual girl.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is poorly received due to its handling of gender themes, inconsistent character development, and questionable plot elements. Some viewers appreciate the focus on Jun, but the overall consensus is negative. The writing is criticized for being offensive and the production values are considered lackluster.
pros: Focus on Jun as a character.
Continuation of original series' style.
cons: Inconsistent character development of Jun.
Offensive and poorly handled gender themes.
Questionable writing and plot elements (e.g., implied sexual assault).
Dull art and uninspired sound design.
Characters acting out of character
anime.thematic_vibe: Gender Transformation, Gag Humor, Slice of Life

anime.title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 2: Shiroki Ryuu no Miko
anime.romaji_title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 2: Shiroki Ryuu no Miko
anime.genres: Fantasy, Historical, Isekai, Romance, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 2 takes place 100 years after the original Harukanaru Toki no Naka de story. In the past that is, very little time has gone by in the future. Kyou, which resembles Kyoto in the Heian period, is in turmoil because of a power struggle going on between the emperor and the retired emperor, and the people of Kyou are falling into desperation, fearing the coming of the end of the world. Karin was walking with her friends when suddenly she is brought by the White Dragon to the land of Kyou. She was chosen as the new priestess of the White Dragon and she must fight against the evil with the help of her guardians while meantime, she keeps having visions of a mysterious man...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience feels that this short series is a superior reimagining of the original Harukanaru Toki no Naka de. The characters, plot, and world-building are praised, particularly the heroine's relatable struggles. The main point of contention is the limited number of episodes, leaving viewers wanting more and questioning the unexplained character design changes.
pros: More believable plot than the original.
More in-depth characters than the original.
Well-established world and conflict.
Karin is a likable heroine due to her struggles and modern outlook.
cons: Only 3 episodes were produced, leaving the story unfinished.
Unexplained changes in character designs and names from the original.
Frustration that this wasn't developed into a full series.
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Duty vs. Desire, Heroine's Burden

anime.title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de: Hachiyou Shou Specials
anime.romaji_title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de: Hachiyou Shou Specials
anime.genres: Fantasy, Historical, Isekai, Romance, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: Short clips about what happens after the TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is disappointment with the specials. Viewers felt the content was repetitive and failed to provide satisfying conclusions for the characters after the main series. The romantic implications felt forced and inconsistent with the established relationships.
cons: Lack of meaningful post-series narrative
Repetitive scenes with minimal dialogue
Forced romantic implications with multiple characters
Disappointing resolution for character relationships

anime.title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de: Maihitoyo
anime.romaji_title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de: Maihitoyo
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Isekai, Romance, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: One rainy day, Akane crosses path with a kind young man who tacitly offers to her his coat. On their second encounter, he confesses that he has no recollection of who he is, his name or his past, but feels contented by just being with her. Besotted, Akane sets out to find his name, and to unravel his enigmatic connection with a famous cursed dance rumoured to kill anyone who attempts to perform it.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is generally positive, particularly for those who appreciate character-driven stories and emotional depth. Many find the movie a significant improvement over the original series, praising its animation, music, and character development, particularly Akane's internal struggles. Some criticize the simple plot and reliance on the original series, but overall, the movie is seen as a worthwhile experience.
pros: Improved animation and art quality compared to the TV series.
Stronger character depth and development, especially for Akane.
Well-paced and emotionally resonant story.
Music enhances the emotional impact, particularly the dance music.
cons: Plot may be considered simple or predictable.
Some find the connection to the original series a drawback.
Pacing/Screen time distribution is off.

anime.title: Marginal Prince: Gekkeiju no Ouji-tachi
anime.synopsis: "Marginal Prince" based off of the hit love simulation game series for girls! Yuta studies abroad in a tiny, far away island in the pacific ocean name Alphonso where he enters the all-dorm, all-male Alphonso Gakuen. However, the school is really a place for the children of the famous . . . and the school specializes in classes on empires and alchemy! And one day, after studying enough at the school, the students become known as "Marginal Princes"! Learn about the stories of fate and trial as each of the students studies to become kings!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative, citing a weak plot, underdeveloped characters, and awkward musical elements. However, some viewers find the show so bad it's funny, turning it into a guilty pleasure. The show is considered a poorly executed dating sim adaptation with random and nonsensical elements.
pros: The music is enjoyable, pretty standard VA theme song fare.
The art was pretty okay really. It had good details, nice colors.
cons: There is no back story to Marginal Prince, or any consistent plot.
The character interaction is so dull and predictable
Singing is awkward and out of place.
Plot is scattered, random and pointless.

anime.title: Young GTO
anime.synopsis:
Eikichi Onizuka and Ryuji Danma are members of infamous biker duo, the Oni Baku. When not out riding around, they can be found in school, trying to pick up young women. This is the story of the young Onizuka, who would later become the greatest teacher in Japan, and his partner Ryuji in their quest to lose their virginity and reach maturity.

They are widely feared bosozoku, and are known for their tenacity and viciousness in a fight. However, this lifestyle does not exactly endear them to the opposite gender, so they decide to change their ways. However, this is easier said than done.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Shonan Junai Gumi! is largely positive, especially among fans of GTO who appreciate the humorous and action-packed prequel. While its narrative structure and animation are frequently criticized for being simplistic or dated, the show is generally seen as an entertaining, albeit flawed, look into the roots of beloved characters.
pros: Captures the essence of adolescence with a profound sense of freedom, high expectations, thirst for liberty, and the quest to win girls over.
Humor is consistently funny and crude, aligning with the Onizuka essence.
Action and fights are well-done, violent, and comedic, making it enjoyable despite lack of substance.
Strong focus on the bond and friendship between Onizuka and Ryuji, showcasing their respect for each other's differences.
cons: Storyline devolves into a 'bad guy of the week' style action show after a short promising start.
Injecting drama is usually not believable.
Pacing is strange and can be confusing due to perceived omissions.
Animation quality is poor by modern standards, with choppy motion, stills, and looped animation during fights.
Sound design is weak, lacking an opening/ending theme and having generic background music.
Character development for Onizuka is minimal, with little change from beginning to end.
The ending feels abrupt and the OVA's narrative lacks focus and clear direction, leaving plots unresolved.

anime.title: Tales of Saiunkoku
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Reverse Harem, Romance, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
Shuurei Kou and her friend Eigetsu To, a boy prodigy of humble origins, have been appointed co-governors of the Sa province, one of the eight provinces in Saiunkoku. Together, they decide to make the province an academic research center in the hopes of bringing a long overdue prosperity to the region.

However, while Shuurei goes to the capital to obtain approvals for the ambitious project, the Sa province's recently established tranquility is threatened by a pandemic that brings both death and turmoil as it begins to spread among the people. Counting on Eigetsu to monitor the situation until her return, Shuurei seeks support from her allies to find a suitable treatment. Yet, Eigetsu's past personal conflicts distract him, providing an opportunity for opponents of Shuurei's position to take advantage of the troubles and undermine her authority.

Becoming a government official has been Shuurei's lifelong dream, but it is no easy task for the first woman undertaking such a position. Will she step up and overcome this great challenge or give in to the looming adversities?
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is generally well-received, with many considering it even better than the first. Viewers praise the intricate storyline and character development, particularly Shuurei's growth. However, some criticize the pacing, unresolved plot threads, and inconsistencies in character behavior, leaving them wanting more closure and explanation.
pros: Intricate storyline with important details.
Wonderful character development, especially for secondary characters.
Excellent costumes, jewelry, and building designs.
Realistic portrayal of politics, government, and economy.
cons: Long and redundant dialogs can be boring.
Some plot points and characters appear out of nowhere with little context.
Loose ends and backstories are not fully explained.
Inconsistent character behavior (Shurei's passivity towards unwanted advances).
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Character Development, Female Empowerment

anime.title: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha StrikerS
anime.synopsis:
Distinguished mages Nanoha Takamachi, Fate Testarossa, and Hayate Yagami now work as military personnel for the Time-Space Administration Bureau on the planet Midchilda, having completed their studies on Earth in the last ten years since the "Book of Darkness" incident.

One day, the three end up helping the Bureau respond to a severe airport fire, but their efforts are left unrecognized. A series of unfortunate events motivate Hayate to create the elite unit Riot Force 6, which handles cases involving public safety as well as dangerous magical objects known as Lost Logia. There the trio works alongside promising recruits Subaru Nakajima, Teana Lanster, Caro Ru Lushe, and Erio Mondial, who endure difficult training to fulfill expectations while overcoming hurdles and achieving personal goals.

However, carrying out their mission proves to be a constant struggle. Battling foes who exploit the Lost Logia and facing criticisms from within the Bureau, Riot Force 6 quickly finds itself stretched thin.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating the action, character development, and exploration of mature themes. However, there's a significant contingent disappointed by the dilution of focus on original characters, the influx of new characters, and a perceived drop in narrative quality compared to previous seasons. While enjoyable for fans of the genre, it doesn't quite capture the magic of earlier installments for some.
pros: Well-paced plot with a mix of everyday life and hectic action.
Strong character development, especially the new characters.
Excellent action sequences that are exciting and well-animated.
Uplifting and catchy opening themes; emotionally resonant music.
Exploration of mature themes such as motherhood, family, and leadership.
cons: Overabundance of new characters leads to pacing issues.
Villains are generally uninspired and unsympathetic.
Reduced focus on original characters like Nanoha and Fate.
Story becomes overly complex and convoluted.
Some find the shift towards military themes out of place for the franchise.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam MS IGLOO: Apocalypse 0079
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam MS IGLOO: Mokushiroku 0079
anime.synopsis: Lieutenant Oliver May and the 603 Technical Division Unit aboard the Jotunheim continue testing and evaluating experimental weapons to aid the Zeon war effort against the Federation Forces. At the end of each experiment, the tale of the trials and tribulations faced by the weapon and its test pilot adds a small chapter to the long history of the One Year War
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some praising the character development and unique perspective on the One Year War, while others criticize the dated CGI and underdeveloped story. Some find the series emotionally engaging and a satisfying conclusion to character arcs. However, many are disappointed by the lack of depth and inconsistent quality, resulting in a somewhat polarized, but not extremely divisive, reception.
pros: Characters are well-developed and emotionally engaging, especially the new characters.
The series provides a unique perspective on the One Year War from the Zeon side.
Action sequences are well-executed and enjoyable.
The series offers a satisfying conclusion to Oliver's character arc.
cons: CGI animation is dated and inconsistent, with some aspects looking good while others appear blocky and repetitive.
The story suffers from a lack of development due to the short OVA format, particularly with new characters.
Some weapon designs are considered uninteresting or fundamentally stupid.
Attempts at eliciting emotional responses feel predictable and lacking in depth.

anime.title: Jishu Seisaku Movie Binchou-tan
anime.synopsis: Binchou-tan wakes up in her tattered wooden hut only to discover that her water barrel is almost empty. She decides to go to the nearby stream, only to find the fast-flowing water to be brown. Walking the path to town, past green fields, Binchou-tan finally reaches an old water pump on the central marketplace, and fills her wooden bucket. On the way home it starts to rain, so she lets the rain fill the bucket to the rim, preparing herself for the next work day.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Jishu Seisaku Movie Binchou-tan' to be a relaxing and heartwarming experience, appreciating its slow pace and charming character. However, some may find the lack of plot development to be a drawback. Overall, the anime is positively received for its peaceful and nostalgic atmosphere.
pros: Relaxing and laid back atmosphere
Cute and charming character design
Kindhearted message
cons: Slow pace and uneventful nature

anime.title: Early Reins
anime.synopsis: Margaret Hart is a young woman who dreams of becoming a sheriff in the American West following the Civil War. When she boards a train to the next town over and prepares to relax, she gets caught up in a hijacking attempt by a group of bandits composed of former Confederate soldiers. After being taken hostage, Margaret teams up with the other captive women to fight back against the outlaws.
anime.consensus_summary: Early Reins is viewed as a simple but fun action anime with a unique Western setting and a cast of female characters. However, it suffers from underdeveloped characters, a weak plot, and dated animation. Most agree that it had potential but ultimately falls short due to its short runtime and lack of further development.
pros: Unique setting for anime
Fun action sequences
Distinct female characters
cons: Underdeveloped characters
Weak plot twists
Dated animation
Poor English dub

anime.title: Pretty Cure Max Heart
anime.synopsis: Shortly after the fall of the Wicked King, the Queen of the Garden of Light lost her memory and came to Earth, in the form of a 12-year-old girl named Hikari Kujou. Now, she—with the help of Nagisa and Honoka, endowed with new costumes and powers—must find the 12 Heartiels, which hold the key to restoring the Queen's lost memories. For together once again, they are Pretty Cure.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Futari wa Precure: Max Heart is mixed. While some appreciate the familiar characters and improved art, many find the series repetitive, directionless, and lacking in character development compared to the original. The forgettable villains and overuse of stock footage are also frequent points of criticism, leading to a general sentiment that the sequel doesn't live up to the first season.
pros: Nagisa and Honoka are still great characters.
Satisfying conclusion to the story.
Solid improvement in art quality compared to the first season.
cons: The show has no real direction with endless 'Monster of the Day' episodes.
Character development is practically non-existent; Nagisa and Honoka do not grow.
Shiny Luminous adds nothing and is a talking plot device.
Villains are forgettable and lack depth.
Repetitiveness and staleness due to the length of the series.
Subpar animation with too much reuse of stock footage.
Hikari's characterization is inconsistent.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Friendship, Slice of Life

anime.title: Futari wa Precure: Max Heart Movie 1
anime.romaji_title: Futari wa Precure: Max Heart Movie 1
anime.synopsis: The Courageous Warriors of the Garden of Hope have summoned Nagisa, Honoka, and Hikari to protect their kingdom from a witch who plans to steal the Diamond Line, which is a set of jewelry the queen of the Garden of Hope wears to a ceremony every year to replenish the water of the kingdom. The witch plans to resurrect the Dark Lord and if she does so, not only will the Garden of Hope be destroyed, but other kingdoms in the galaxies, including the Garden of Rainbows and the Garden of Light.
anime.consensus_summary: The Futari wa Precure: Max Heart Movie 1 is generally well-received, especially by fans of the series, with praise for its pacing, action, and the dynamic between the main characters. While some find the ending simplistic and certain characters forgettable, the positive aspects outweigh the negatives for most viewers. It's considered an enjoyable, though unremarkable, entry in the franchise.
pros: Well-paced narrative with natural flow
Strong character dynamic between Nagisa and Honoka
Visually appealing backgrounds, especially in the Garden of Hope
Enjoyable action sequences with physical combat
Good vocal performances by Honna Youko and Yukana
Underutilization of annoying characters like Pollun and Tsubomi
Solid insert song
cons: Simplistic ending that wraps up too easily
Some new characters are flat and forgettable
Antagonist is a standard villain with a lack of originality
Lazy remix of the theme tune

anime.title: Yes! Precure 5
anime.synopsis: Yumehara Nozomi, a regular student, finds a magical book called the Dream Collet in the library and meets Coco and Nuts, two creatures from the Palmier Kingdom. They plead with Nozomi to restore their world, which has been destroyed by an organization called the Nightmares, by completing the Dream Collet and finding the 55 Pinkies to make any wish come true. Meanwhile, the Nightmares are moving into the real world. Once Nozomi agrees to help, Coco and Nuts transform her into the magical girl Cure Dream and turn four fellow students into her Pretty Cure team.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Yes! Precure 5 is mixed. While the series is praised for its focus on character development, exploration of themes like hope and dreams, and a unique villain concept, it is criticized for its archetypal characters, questionable romance elements, and inconsistent plot elements. Many find it a generally enjoyable season but with noticeable flaws.
pros: Focus on character development and interactions
Exploration of dreams for the future
Unique villain setup with Nightmare as an evil business
Attempts to juggle characters and give them decent focus
Good character designs, especially for villains
Well-done performances by voice actors
Thematic focus on not giving up and giving into despair allows for a more emotional approach
Realistic characters that are generally believable
The ending has some nuance to it and really doesn't unfold like you'd expect.
Does not focus on only the main girl
cons: Plain Pretty Cure designs and transformations
Inconsistent handling of the Pinkies
Archetypical characters with limited development
Underdeveloped underling antagonists
Action scenes rely too much on special attacks
Questionable romance plots between young girls and adult animals
Boring at times
Animation gets really sloppy
Soundtrack could be better
Milk's addition to the story was awful.

anime.title: Don't Leave Me Alone, Daisy
anime.synopsis: The story begins when an innocent, but busty, young schoolgirl goes to recover her hat from what she thought was an abandoned house. But within that house, spying on her, is a deranged madman. Seeing her he becomes obsessed with controlling her, owning her, bending her to his every whim. He, and his array of high tech tools, will threaten her with death, mutilation, control, humiliation and the loss of her own will and identity. Terrors biological, chemical and nuclear will come into play in the nightmare that is her new, controlled, life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Misute♡naide Daisy is highly polarized, with strong opinions ranging from outright condemnation of its abusive themes and unlikeable characters to a grudging appreciation for its dark comedic aspects and unique artistic choices. Many viewers find the narrative premise and execution deeply unsettling and morally objectionable, particularly the protagonist's actions and the show's attempt to normalize or even romanticize abuse. However, a minority find merit in its genre-bending, dark humor, and memorable music, viewing it as a challenging, albeit deeply flawed, experience.
pros: The opening theme song is notably good.
The music is pretty good.
The art style is enjoyable.
The premise has potential for compelling stories about obsession and isolation.
The show can be experienced rather than just watched, forcing active interpretation.
The character Yamakawa X is memorable and fun, even as a punching bag.
cons: The characters are unlikable.
The art is mediocre.
The story deals with a horrific premise as if it were a light romantic comedy.
The protagonist is a boring nobody with a poorly-explained trove of advanced weapons and technology, leading to a lack of drama.
The victim-girl is a brainless doormat who communicates nothing other than her lack of consent.
The protagonist is a felony sex offender who is rewarded for his violence, with no comeuppance.
The female lead is a blank slate with no agency.
The romance is not very strong.
The show may have been stronger if it focused on more characters and interactions.
The protagonist's behavior is not called out enough.
The animation quality is sub-par compared to modern shows.
The show presents a creepy 'extreme stalker' situation that could turn some viewers off.
The creators try to frame an abusive and manipulative relationship as something to root for.
The protagonist has no redeeming qualities, making the show unsettling and hard to watch.
The ending is baffling, with the protagonist getting his way despite no character development.
The show has almost no redeeming qualities.

anime.title: Nakoruru: Ano Hito kara no Okurimono
anime.romaji_title: Nakoruru: Ano Hito kara no Okurimono
anime.synopsis: Nakoruru, finally returned to her home Kamuikotan after a long, fierce battle, receives a warm welcome from dear friends and the village children. Her spirit is uplifted by her reunion with companions Manari and Yantamuu. But as the trauma of battle falls away, Rela appears and challenges Nakoruru and the shadow of misfortune creeps closer... Nakoruru is a popular Ainu girl from SNK's Samurai Spirits fighting game (PC and Dreamcast), now she has her very own OVA series.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is viewed as a promising but ultimately incomplete adaptation of the Samurai Shodown character Nakoruru's story. Despite its cancellation, the single episode showcases a well-crafted narrative with a strong atmosphere and beautiful visuals. Fans appreciate its exploration of personal conflict and Ainu culture, although the limited scope and shoujou elements may not appeal to all viewers. The unfinished nature of the project adds a layer of charm for some, but also leaves a sense of unfulfilled potential.
pros: Amazing atmosphere
Well-built story with serious themes
Extraordinary landscapes and character designs
cons: Unfinished state due to cancellation
Too focused on Nakoruru and Rera, excluding other characters
Possibly too shoujou for some viewers
anime.thematic_vibe: Personal Conflict, Inner Strength, Ainu Culture

anime.title: Moonlight Mile 1st Season: Lift Off
anime.synopsis: After scaling Mt. Everest, mountain climbing partners Saruwatari Gorou and "Lostman" Jack F. Woodbridge see the ISA Space Station, and each vows to make the trek into outerspace. When Helium 3, a new energy source, is discovered on the moon, NASA forms a new project named "Nexus" to harness that energy for use on earth. This is the story of the two and the paths they take to see their dream become a reality in the quest to harness the next-generation energy source.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the visuals and voice acting but criticism for the characters and plot. Many find the main characters unlikeable and the narrative unrealistic, which detracts from the overall experience. While some appreciate the focus on dreams and space exploration, others feel the series fails to deliver a mature and engaging story.
pros: Excellent integration of CG-rendered objects with regular animation, creating visually splendid scenes.
Strong voice acting in both Japanese and English versions, capturing the emotional depth of the characters.
The narrative focuses on individual journeys and dreams, showcasing the characters' unique personalities.
cons: Characters, particularly Gorou and Woodbridge, are criticized for being unlikable or flat, with questionable behavior.
The plot relies on coincidences and lacks believability, undermining the attempt at a realistic portrayal.
The series is tonally inconsistent, wavering between mature themes and immature elements like gratuitous sex scenes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Technological Advancement, Space Exploration, Manly Competition

anime.title: Rocket Girls
anime.synopsis:
When Yukari Morita decided to look for her missing father who disappeared in the South Seas, she had no idea how far her journey would take her. Just traveling to the Solomon Islands is a long way for a high school girl to go on her own, but then Yukari runs into an astronaut from the Solomon Space Association, which has been trying to build a rocket powerful enough launch a man into space.

Upon meeting the petite Yukari, however, SSA director Nasuda realizes that she's small enough to go up in a less powerful rocket the SSA has already built! So he offers her a deal: if Yukari agrees to become their astronaut, the SSA will help find her missing father! Will Yukari have the right stuff to blast off in the wildest space quest ever?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences find Rocket Girls to be a surprisingly enjoyable show that blends humor, drama, and heartfelt moments. While the plot can be far-fetched, the characters and their emotional journeys resonate with viewers. Its attention to scientific detail and engaging narrative make it a worthwhile watch, though some find the later episodes weaker.
pros: Story respects character development and realistic science.
Visually appealing with vibrant colors and good animation.
Music and sound design are top-notch and enhance the experience.
cons: Story becomes ridiculous after the first half.
Inconsistent character appearances and additions.
CG scenes are poorly integrated.

anime.title: Paprika
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Avant Garde, Award Winning, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
The world of dreams can be an incredible window into the psyche, showing one's deepest desires, aspirations, and repressed memories. One hopeful tech lab has been developing the "DC Mini," a device with the power to delve into the dreams of others. Atsuko Chiba and Kosaku Tokita have been tirelessly working to develop this technology with the hopes of using it to deeply explore patients' minds and help cure them of their psychological disorders.

However, having access to the deepest corners of a person's mind comes with a tremendous responsibility. In the wrong hands, the DC Mini could be used as a form of psychological terrorism and cause mental breakdowns in the minds of targets. When this technology is stolen and people around them start acting strangely, Atsuko and Kosaku know they have a serious problem on their hands. Enlisting the help of Officer Konakawa, who has been receiving this experimental therapy, they search both the real and dream worlds for their mental terrorist.
anime.consensus_summary: Paprika is praised for its breathtaking visuals, innovative animation, and thought-provoking exploration of dreams. However, many critics find the plot confusing and the characters underdeveloped, resulting in a visually impressive but narratively flawed experience. The film's surreal nature polarizes viewers, with some appreciating its artistic merit and others finding it inaccessible.
pros: Imaginative and visually stunning animation, especially the dream sequences.
Creative and unique premise exploring the nature of dreams and reality.
Excellent soundtrack that complements the film's atmosphere.
cons: Weak or convoluted plot that can be difficult to follow.
Underdeveloped or one-dimensional characters.
Forced or nonsensical romance subplots.
Imagery sometimes overshadows the narrative.

anime.title: Tomorrow's Nadja
anime.synopsis:
This story takes place about one hundred years ago. Nadja is a bright, cheerful girl who was raised in an orphanage near London, England. Nadja was entrusted to the orphanage when she was a baby. So she thought her father and mother were dead. But before her thirteenth birthday, she found out that her mother might be alive..

Nadja sets out on a journey to find her mother! With all of Europe as the stage, Nadja's exciting adventure begins!
anime.consensus_summary: Ashita no Nadja is a well-regarded anime, particularly praised for its engaging characters, educational value, and adventurous storyline set in a charming rendition of early 20th century Europe. While some find the initial pacing slow and the ending rushed, the overall experience is considered heartwarming and memorable. The series evokes nostalgia and is appreciated for its emotional depth and quality production, leading many to consider it a hidden gem.
pros: Well-written story with a clear beginning and ending, especially for a children-oriented series.
Charming and well-developed characters with unique personalities and backstories.
Educational content integrated naturally into the plot, providing a tour of 19th/20th century Europe.
High production values, including detailed art, animation and excellent music.
cons: Story exposition is slow, with the main plot not kicking in until later in the series (around episode 33 or 35).
Animation quality can be inconsistent, with some sloppy moments and obvious use of computer graphics.
Pacing issues in the second half, leading to a rushed ending with minimal explanation.
Some historical inaccuracies and warped cultural elements due to Japanese influence.

anime.title: Strange Steel Fairy Rouran
anime.synopsis: When the secret occult society, Shiromorishuua, sends a huge monster to attack Tokyo, ASY, a peace-keeping organization in Japan, retaliates with a Gousen (metal faery). ASY's Gousen annihilates the creature after driving it into open ocean. Although successful, a surprise attack follows. A girl, floating in midair and glowing with radiance, strikes with a beam of light. This girl is "Rouran." She knows neither her identity, her origins, nor why whenever she senses the Gousen or Kyoushi (reanimated corpses) she transforms into an avenging angel. As Rouran worries about her mysterious existence, Tetsuya kindly watches over her in Tokyo Arcadia, a settlement of expatriates and dissidents.
anime.consensus_summary: Kikou Sennyo Rouran is viewed as a show with interesting ideas, but flawed execution. The fast pacing and simple antagonists detract from the overall experience. However, the animation, character designs, soundtrack, and voice acting are considered strong points, making it a potentially enjoyable watch for fans of niche mecha shows with a female protagonist.
pros: Cool concepts
Above average animation
Good character designs
Strong soundtrack and voice acting
cons: Execution ranges from good to bad
Pacing is too fast
Antagonists feel simple

anime.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion Picture Dramas
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch Picture Drama
anime.synopsis: At Ashford Academy, the girls get into juicy talks in the bath, and later plan a gender role reversal festival, which has everyone but Lelouch Lamperouge eager. The students also attend the grand opening of the Clovis Land pool, much to the scantily clad Cornelia li Britannia's embarrassment. Events from Lelouch's past show a chapter from his royal upbringing, and how he met Suzaku Kururugi. Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch Picture Drama shows that when they are away from the bloodshed and agony of war, the characters live very different and often humorous lives.
anime.consensus_summary: The Code Geass Picture Drama is well-received by fans who appreciate the additional character development and lighthearted stories it offers. While the limited animation style may not appeal to everyone, the specials are generally considered an enjoyable addition to the Code Geass universe.
