anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Oseam' to be a touching and beautiful story with strong spiritual themes.  While some appreciate its simplicity and emotional depth, others find the pacing slow and the ending unsatisfying. The film's art and music are generally praised, contributing to its overall sentimental feel.
pros: Story is moving and reflects Buddhist nature well.
Characters are easy to sympathize with and become attached to.
Beautiful scenery with detailed art and vibrant colors.
Soundtrack complements the scenes' emotions without distracting.
cons: Slow-paced story may not appeal to everyone.
Voice dubbing may not be to everyone's taste.
Ending felt blunt and could have been better.

anime.title: Blue Dragon
anime.synopsis: As Shu's village was being attacked by an unknown enemy, he and his friends, Jiro and Kluke decide to defend their home. They soon meet warrior Zola and receive the powers of Shadow, an ability that let's them transform their shadow into a powerful monster. Shu receives one of the most powerful monsters, Blue Dragon, and they all set out to defeat their enemy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the nostalgic elements and world-building, while others find the plot and characters simplistic and unoriginal. The series is seen as entertaining for younger audiences but lacking depth for more mature viewers. Pacing issues and annoying characters are common points of criticism, indicating a generally lukewarm but not intensely negative sentiment.
pros: Art style reminiscent of Dragon Ball is appealing to some.
Interesting fantasy setting with well-constructed world-building.
Memorable opening and ending songs with great voice performances.
cons: Plot and characters are simple and cliché, lacking depth.
Pacing issues, particularly towards the end, making it feel rushed.
Some characters are annoying and underdeveloped.

anime.title: Saiyuuki Reload: Burial
anime.synopsis: Taking place in the past it offers a view at the Saiyuuki quartet before their formation and their journey to the west. First OVA starts with Sanzo and his master, also with Ukoku (known as a later Ni Jianyi). Second OVA shows first meeting of Goku and Sanzo. Third OVA considers the events after Hakkai's sins and his trial (that we know from first season of "Saiyuuki") and his decision to live in Gojyo's house.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Saiyuuki Reload: Burial' for its darker tone and exploration of character origins. Fans of the series will enjoy the deeper look into the past, though newcomers may find it confusing. Some critique the rushed pacing of certain character arcs and the lack of distinct character designs, but the improved art style is widely praised.
pros: Beautiful art and shading, a significant improvement over previous Saiyuki seasons.
Enjoyable exploration of character backstories and relationships, especially Genjo Sanzo and Goku.
Eerie and fitting music that enhances the dark atmosphere.
cons: May be confusing for viewers unfamiliar with the Saiyuki series or Journey to the West.
The Hakkai and Gojyo chapter feels rushed and underdeveloped.
Some find the character designs too similar, lacking originality.

anime.title: Naruto the Movie 3: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom
anime.romaji_title: Naruto Movie 3: Dai Koufun! Mikazuki-jima no Animal Panic Dattebayo!
anime.synopsis:
Led by Kakashi Hatake, Naruto Uzumaki, Sakura Haruno, and Rock Lee are tasked to escort the extravagant Prince Michiru Tsuki and his spoiled son Hikaru to the prosperous Land of Moon when the two return from a long trip around the world. As if guarding two whimsical high-ranked individuals was not challenging enough, the prince's reckless decision to acquire an entire circus during their journey—mainly to entertain Hikaru's wish of owning the saber-toothed tiger featured in the show—further propels the mission into disarray.

Just as things are finally settling down, the arrival of Michiru's convoy at the Land of Moon is met with an unforeseen crisis—the greedy Chief Minister Shabadaba has taken over the country with the assistance of mysterious, powerful ninjas. While Kakashi's team relentlessly fights the enemy by any means necessary, the two princes are forced to confront a new outlook on life through adversity.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for this Naruto movie is sharply divided. While a significant portion of viewers found the story predictable, poorly paced, and populated by unlikable characters, others praised its high-quality animation, exciting action sequences, and solid production values. The film's core narrative elements are largely panned, but its visual and action-oriented aspects offer a redeeming quality for some fans.
pros: The animation and art style are frequently praised as being high quality, vibrant, and well-done, especially during action sequences.
The action sequences are described as fluid, fast-paced, exciting, and visually impressive.
The use of music and sound design, including well-placed silence for dramatic effect, is noted positively by some reviewers.
Some reviewers found the characters, particularly Naruto and Rock Lee, to be enjoyable and well-portrayed, despite criticisms of others.
cons: The story is overwhelmingly criticized as predictable, generic, incoherent, and uninspired, often feeling like a rehash of previous plots.
New characters are frequently described as unlikable, forgettable, or poorly developed, with the child character being a particular point of contention.
The pacing is often cited as being too slow, especially in the first half, leading to a lack of engagement.
Villains are consistently described as one-dimensional, underdeveloped, and lacking clear motives.

anime.title: Moomin
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Iyashikei, Kids, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Spring has finally arrived in Moomin Valley, giving way to another great adventure for Moomintroll and the rest of its inhabitants. With Snufkin coming home from his winter migration, the locals of the valley finally begin to rise from their hibernation. Finding a mysterious hat, the Moomins cannot bring themselves to throw it away due to its fine quality, instead hoping to eventually find its owner. 

While playing games with his friends, Moomin tries to hide in the silk hat. When his friends come looking for him, they are shocked to discover that Moomin has transformed into a hideous creature. Examining himself in the mirror, he is disgusted to find himself completely unrecognizable.

Transforming back to normal after scaring his friends and family, Moomin and Snufkin decide to toss the hat in the river. As it drifts away, they begin to wonder who the hat belonged to and whether its owner will return for their lost possession.
anime.consensus_summary: Tanoshii Muumin Ikka is a widely beloved, nostalgic series that resonates with both children and adults. It is praised for its faithful adaptation of the source material, lovable characters, beautiful animation, and heartwarming stories that impart valuable life lessons. While some find it too episodic or simplistic, the overall consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with many viewers considering it a cherished part of their childhood.
pros: Excellent adaptation of the original stories
Lovable characters with unique personalities
Beautiful art and animation
Captivating and varied soundtrack
Teaches valuable life lessons
Nostalgic and comforting
cons: Episodic nature may not appeal to all viewers
Some tonal differences from the books
May be too simplistic for some adults
Occasional scary elements (e.g., the Groke)

anime.title: Oh! Edo Rocket
anime.synopsis: In Edo in the mid-1800's, fireworks maker Seikichi Tamaya and his friends struggle to live under the harsh morality laws imposed by the strict city councilor, which ban all luxuries, including fireworks. One day, a strange girl stops by Sekichi's shop with an equally strange request: she wants Sekichi to build a firework that can reach the moon.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Oh! Edo Rocket' for its originality, humor, and strong dub. However, some find the tonal shifts jarring and feel the story loses momentum towards the end. Despite its flaws, the show is considered a unique and entertaining experience, especially for those who appreciate its blend of comedy and drama.
pros: Unique blend of comedy and drama
Original storyline and themes
High-quality animation by Madhouse
Memorable and well-executed English dub
Strong character development and interactions
cons: Inconsistent tone, shifting from comedy to dark drama
Pacing issues, with some episodes feeling unnecessary
Humor may not appeal to all viewers
Story loses steam towards the end

anime.title: Saint Beast: Angel Chronicles
anime.romaji_title: Saint Beast: Kouin Jojishi Tenshi Tan
anime.synopsis:
A long time ago, Zeus, the great god, created a three–tier hierarchy of angels, top, middle and lower, although they were supposed to be equal. Also, Zeus appointed 6 angels as Saint Beasts who govern the animals of Earth. They were: Go, the seiyu; Shin, the genbu; Rei, the suzaku; Guy, the byakko; Yuda, the kirin; and Ruka, the hooh. However, Kira, the shooting star, and Maya, the fuga, didn’t attend the selection tests and left for the Earth.

The six angels fulfilled their tasks faithfully. However, because of Zeus’s increasingly tyrannical acts, they begin to mistrust him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding enjoyment in the characters and shounen-ai hints, while others criticize the confusing plot, shallow character development, and lack of satisfying romantic payoff. Many feel the series has potential but fails to fully realize it, resulting in an unsatisfying experience. It is mainly recommended for dedicated fans of the genre willing to overlook its flaws.
pros: Interesting characters with unique qualities.
Enjoyable for fans of shounen-ai and angel/demon themes.
Some find the complex romantic relationships engaging.
cons: Poorly written plot with random monster encounters.
Shallow characters with poorly managed interactions.
Underdeveloped shounen-ai elements, lacking satisfying romantic development.
Confusing storyline requiring external research to understand.

anime.title: Tekkonkinkreet
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Award Winning, Psychological, Seinen, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
The streets of Treasure Town are said to belong to "The Cats." They know everything that goes on in the city, and no one can stir up trouble without going through them first. In reality, The Cats are a pair of orphan boys called Black and White, who aren’t afraid of anything or anyone. 

But their rule of the streets is challenged when the Yakuza come to town and start making changes. The wild Black and the carefree White have no one to rely on but themselves to get their Treasure Town back to the way it was. But their bond is tested as they quickly realize going back to how things were may no longer be an option.
anime.consensus_summary: Tekkonkinkreet is a visually and thematically rich anime that deeply resonates with many viewers due to its unique art style, complex characters, and exploration of profound themes. However, its unconventional narrative structure and occasionally confusing plot can be divisive. While praised for its artistic merits and emotional depth, some find the story underdeveloped and the ending unfulfilling, leading to a mixed but generally positive reception.
pros: Visually stunning and innovative art style
Compelling and complex characters, especially Black and White
Excellent soundtrack and voice acting that enhances the emotional impact
Exploration of deep themes like duality, innocence, and the struggle against corruption
cons: Plot can be confusing or convoluted, especially in the later half
Some character development feels rushed or incomplete
Ending may feel unsatisfying or abrupt
Art style may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Kono Aozora ni Yakusoku wo: Youkoso Tsugumi Ryou e
anime.romaji_title: Kono Aozora ni Yakusoku wo: Youkoso Tsugumi Ryou e
anime.synopsis:
One morning, Wataru Hoshino found a sleeping girl—in nothing but her underwear—in his room. When she woke up, she quickly escaped by jumping out of the window, but not without punching Wataru in the face first. This girl, Rinna Sawaki, ends up being a transfer student of Wataru's school, as well as the new roommate of Wataru's dormitory.

Wataru lives with four other girls and their school teacher, but due to Temizugawa Heavy Industry's cancellation of their aviation branch—South Sakojima Island's major company—the families involved with the corporation have to be evacuated in one year. As a result of this, the four girls have to leave the island in one year's time.

Knowing this, Rinna refuses to become friends with Wataru and the other girls, because of the pain that she might experience as a result of their eventual separation; however, Wataru disagrees with her, and over the course of the year, tries to convince her otherwise.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely negative. Many viewers found the plot weak, characters uninspired, and structure disjointed, leading to a forgettable and frustrating experience. While some appreciated the focus on friendship and slice-of-life elements, the prevailing sentiment leans toward disappointment and criticism of the show's execution.
pros: Some found the focus on friendship and slice-of-life aspects enjoyable.
A few reviewers appreciated the 'warm summery feel' and music.
One reviewer empathized with the characters and their experiences.
cons: Many found the story weak, clichéd, and pointless.
Characters were described as bland, unoriginal, and unlikeable.
The anime was criticized for a lack of romance despite harem elements.
The structure, adapted from a visual novel, was incoherent and confusing.
The animation was considered dull and simplistic.
The melodrama was excessive and hard to watch.
Some voice acting was criticized.

anime.title: Bakugan Battle Brawlers
anime.synopsis:
Mysterious cards came down from the sky one day. Capable of summoning powerful creatures from another dimension, they became the centerpiece of a new game called Bakugan. The game gained instant popularity among children and teenagers, with the best of them competing in a worldwide ranking.

Meanwhile, war for domination over Vestroia, the homeland of Bakugan cards, rages on. Invaded by the White Dragon Naga and his servants, the Doom Beings, the realm becomes increasingly destabilized. Dimensions begin to merge and many Bakugan players come to realize that their pastime is not merely a game.

Danma Kuusou, one such Bakugan player, intends to become the World Ranking's leader someday. However, during one of his fights he experiences a vision of a clash in Vestroia. The fight suddenly moves to Earth, where Danma comes into possession of a talking, mighty fire Bakugan, Pyrus Dragonoid.

He soon gets dragged into the conflict, and together with his Bakugan Brawlers team, must traverse the dimensions and restore balance in a ravaged world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Bakugan Battle Brawlers. Many appreciate its nostalgic value, the strong emphasis on friendship, and its engaging characters. However, common criticisms include its generic plot, outdated animation, and sometimes confusing gameplay, leading to a somewhat polarized reception.
pros: Enjoyable and addictive for fans of similar anime like Yu-Gi-Oh and Pokemon
Characters are likable and easy to get attached to, even the Bakugan
Satisfying adventure with a phenomenal ending and character growth
Nostalgic value for those who watched it as children
Creative story and cool merchandise
cons: Generic plot and character stereotypes
Animation and sound quality are outdated
Dubbing is cheesy and voice acting is generic
Confusing gameplay rules
Inconsistent character behavior
Animation is awful, the characters don't move naturally, the design is way too loud, and sometimes their faces look like pancakes

anime.title: Koutetsushin Jeeg
anime.synopsis: Kotetsushin Jeeg takes place fifty years after the original and features a new cast of characters—primarily the new main character Kenji Kusanagi, a high school student who becomes Kotetsushin Jeeg to fight the sudden reappearance of "Haniwa Genjin" ("Haniwa Phantom Gods", or clay robots) from the Jamada Empire ruled by Queen Himika. Other characters include Tsubaki Tamashiro (grandaughter of Miwa Uzuki); and Kyou Misumi. Other main characters from the original series also appear.
anime.consensus_summary: Koutetsushin Jeeg is a fun and exciting super robot show that doesn't take itself too seriously. However, its short length and reliance on the original series may be drawbacks for some viewers. While enjoyable, the show ultimately feels rushed and could have been much better with more episodes to flesh out the story and characters.
pros: Good soundtrack and awesome mech design.
Genuinely funny moments and well-drawn eyecatches.
Simple and effective premise with an unobtrusive combination sequence.
Excellent OP and insert song by JAM Project.
cons: References to the original series may alienate new viewers.
Rushed pacing due to only 13 episodes, hindering backstory and plot development.
Villains are not particularly interesting or memorable.
Potential for greatness unrealized due to the limited number of episodes.

anime.title: Toward the Terra (TV)
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Military, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Space, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
When humanity realized that the Earth, or Terra, had been polluted beyond fixing, the planet's governments united under a unique authoritarian system named Superior Domination (SD) and started to colonize space. Centuries later, mankind has given up its freedom in favor of the AI Grand Mother; when someone reaches the age of 14, their memories are wiped and they are automatically assigned a new role in society.

Jomy Marquis Shin, a sensitive young man raised by loving parents, is saved from this grim fate by Soldier Blue, the current leader of the Mu race—a new species of human beings blessed with psychic abilities. However, in the eyes of SD, the existence of people like Jomy threatens the new paradigm of humanity. Hunted down by the hounds of the government, Jomy finds solace in the welcoming arms of the Mu, who hide aboard the spaceship Shangri-La.

Now the leader of the Mu resistance years later, Jomy embarks on a journey toward Terra to escape from SD's manhunt led by Keith Anyan, an ambitious and ruthless rising star of humanity. Will Jomy and his people manage to reach the cradle of humanity before Keith destroys their last hope?
anime.consensus_summary: Terra e... is well regarded for its compelling story, strong characters, and thought-provoking themes, although the dated animation style may deter some viewers. The series excels in its character-driven narrative and exploration of societal issues. However, some critics point out inconsistencies and a rushed conclusion. Overall, audiences find it to be a memorable science fiction drama.
pros: Strong character development, especially Jomy and Keith.
Excellent pacing and engaging plot with few filler episodes.
Meaningful exploration of humanity, societal control, and prejudice.
High-quality animation that stays consistent, the art design is distinct, revitalizing a 70s style.
Memorable musical score and well-chosen opening/ending themes.
cons: Inconsistent character development, especially concerning Jomy's transitions.
Poorly aged CGI and 3D animation.
Plot inconsistencies.
Rushed ending.
Some viewers may not enjoy the art style.

anime.title: Big Windup!
anime.synopsis:
Ren Mihashi was the ace of his middle school's baseball team, but due to his poor pitching, they could never win. Constant losses eventually lead to his teammates bullying him and reached the point where his teammates no longer tried to win, causing Mihashi to graduate with little self-esteem. As a result, Mihashi decides to go to a high school in a different prefecture where he has no intention of playing baseball. Unfortunately, upon his arrival at Nishiura High, he is dragged into joining their new team as the starting pitcher.

Although unwilling at first, Mihashi realizes that this is a place where he will be accepted for who he is; with help from the catcher Takaya Abe, he starts to have more confidence in his own abilities. Abe, seeing the potential in Mihashi, makes it a goal to help him become a pitcher worthy of being called an ace.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves 'Ookiku Furikabutte' for its character development and realistic take on baseball. While some find the slow pace and Mihashi's character off-putting initially, most viewers become invested in the team's growth and the strategic aspects of the sport. The main criticism is that the anime's ending feels incomplete, leaving viewers wanting more.
pros: Well-developed characters, even among opposing teams
Realistic portrayal of baseball strategy and psychology
Balances slice-of-life and tense sports moments well
cons: Slow pacing, especially during matches
Main character Mihashi can be initially annoying due to extreme shyness and insecurity
Anime ends without a complete storyline conclusion

anime.title: The Skull Man
anime.synopsis:
Otomo City: where freedom and justice have atrophied to the bone; where conspiracy rules the day and death stalks the night... Death in the form of the Skull Man, a literal Grim Reaper whose skeletal grin presages grisly mayhem and murder, even to the monstrous mutants that haunt the city's underworlds! 

To investigate a bizarre slaying, journalist Minagami Hayato and photographer Kiriko Mamiya must stalk this ultimate predator, through a festering cadaver of a city where the corruption flows in rivers as deep and foul as the sins of the reigning elite, and unearth a secret so shocking that an entire city has been turned into a tomb to contain! In a nightmarish necropolis where nothing is as it seems, vengeance comes in the form of a living Death's-Head!
anime.consensus_summary: The Skull Man is a unique and gripping anime with a strong emphasis on mystery and complex themes, though it has pacing problems. Viewers appreciate its dark atmosphere and well-defined characters, but some find the plot convoluted, especially towards the ending. While some consider it underrated, others believe it is a slow burn.
pros: Intriguing plot with unexpected twists.
Well-defined characters with depth (Hayato and Kiriko).
Excellent musical score and opening theme.
Exploration of moral ambiguity and complex themes (political corruption, religious zealotry).
Connection to Ishinomori's other works adds depth for fans.
cons: Pacing issues, especially in the first half, can feel slow or rushed.
Ending can feel abrupt, confusing, or unsatisfying, leaving viewers wanting more.
Some characters are seen as bland or forgettable.
Philosophical and religious references can feel forced or poorly integrated.
Not action-packed from the beginning; leans heavily into mystery and drama.

anime.title: Koutetsu Sangokushi
anime.synopsis:
The Imperial Seal has been passed down through the generations since ancient times. It confers great power unto the warriors that it chooses. This is the story of those warriors.

It is a time of chaos and of civil war. It is a time when great armies clash in titanic battles and great heroes carve their names in history. It is also a time of death and destruction, when the people of the land live in constant fear of the sword. Onto this stage steps the reluctant Rikuson (Lu Xun), whose family had been the guardians of the Imperial Seal up until it was stolen by Sonsaku. At the behest of his mentor Rikuson offers his services to Sonsaku with the intention of confirming the will of the Imperial Seal. However, assassins strike down Sonsaku and the Imperial Seal is lost. So begins, Rikuson’s journey to recover the Imperial Seal and discover his destiny.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response to Koutetsu Sangokushi is largely negative, citing issues with plot, character development, and animation. While the character designs are appreciated, the story is criticized for being boring, illogical, and poorly executed. Some viewers found entertainment value in the series despite its flaws, while others considered it a complete waste of time.
pros: Character designs are visually appealing.
The ending, while sad, provided a sense of resolution by allowing a major character to die.
cons: Poor plot development and story telling.
Underdeveloped characters with stereotypical traits.
Poor animation quality, including overuse of distracting CGI and repetitive frames.
Boring and slow pacing with excessive dialogue about feelings and flowers instead of war.
Pointless deaths and struggles, and characters lacking common sense.

anime.title: Den-noh Coil
anime.genres: Adventure, Award Winning, Drama, Mystery, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
In the near future, augmented reality has become a key part of daily life. A gentle middle school girl named Yuuko "Yasako" Okonogi and her family have just moved to Daikoku City despite rumors of people disappearing. There, her grandmother, nicknamed "Mega-baa," runs a shop called Megasia that specializes in illegal tools which interact with parts of the virtual world.

Mega-baa also hosts an unofficial detective agency called "Coil," a group of children around Yasako's age who find and handle corruption of the virtual world. Yasako gets involved with the group when Fumie Hashimoto, a playful member of Coil, helps rescue her cyberdog Densuke after getting trapped in virtual space while chasing a mysterious virus. Also investigating these corruptions and viruses is an abrasive hacker named Yuuko Amasawa, who the others take to calling Isako.

Can Coil discover the truths behind the mysterious viruses and corruption, and if they can, at what cost?
anime.consensus_summary: Dennou Coil is a highly praised anime for its creative story, believable world, and well-developed characters, though some find the initial pacing slow. The series blends sci-fi with childhood themes, creating a nostalgic and thought-provoking experience. Overall, it's viewed as an underappreciated gem with a satisfying conclusion.
pros: Intricate plot with well-developed characters and relationships.
Believable and detailed world-building with subtle integration of augmented reality.
Thought-provoking themes about technology, childhood, and loss.
High quality animation and fitting art style.
Satisfying and well-planned ending that resolves character arcs.
cons: Slow pacing in the first half, with some episodes feeling like filler.
Some characters may be annoying or underdeveloped.
Occasional clunky exposition and forced romantic elements.
Soundtrack is not particularly memorable.

anime.title: Dojin Work
anime.synopsis: Doujin Work follows the life of a young girl named Najimi Osana and her exposure into the doujin world. She was first tempted into becoming a doujin artist after seeing how much one of her friends can make at a convention. Najimi loves to draw, though soon learns contrary to what she expected that this new world is anything but easy. As she attends more conventions and meets more people, Najimi eventually manages to find a group of very interesting friends. These friends already have some experience in the field and help her out along the way so that she can someday make a name for herself creating doujinshi.
anime.consensus_summary: Doujin Work is a short, light-hearted comedy that is best enjoyed by those familiar with otaku culture and who appreciate perverted humor. While some find it entertaining and nostalgic, others criticize its poor animation, shallow story, and potentially uncomfortable content. The show is generally considered to be a decent, but not exceptional, example of its genre.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of mid-2000s slice of life anime.
Characters are distinct and fit their personalities well.
Quick, light-hearted entertainment with good comedic moments.
cons: Animation quality is poor and simplistic.
Comedy relies heavily on sexual innuendo and cliches.
Story is formulaic and lacks depth.
Has skeevy undertones and potentially disturbing content.
Jokes may not translate well for those unfamiliar with otaku culture.
anime.thematic_vibe: Otaku Culture, Perverted Comedy, Slice of Life

anime.title: Clannad
anime.synopsis:
Tomoya Okazaki is a delinquent who finds life dull and believes he'll never amount to anything. Along with his friend Youhei Sunohara, he skips school and plans to waste his high school days away.

One day while walking to school, Tomoya passes a young girl muttering quietly to herself. Without warning she exclaims "Anpan!" (a popular Japanese food) which catches Tomoya's attention. He soon discovers the girl's name is Nagisa Furukawa and that she exclaims things she likes in order to motivate herself. Nagisa claims they are now friends, but Tomoya walks away passing the encounter off as nothing.

However, Tomoya finds he is noticing Nagisa more and more around school. Eventually he concedes and befriends her. Tomoya learns Nagisa has been held back a year due to a severe illness and that her dream is to revive the school's drama club. Claiming he has nothing better to do, he decides to help her achieve this goal along with the help of four other girls.

As Tomoya spends more time with the girls, he learns more about them and their problems. As he attempts to help each girl overcome her respective obstacle, he begins to realize life isn't as dull as he once thought.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Many viewers find Clannad to be a deeply moving and heartwarming story about family and relationships, praising its beautiful visuals and soundtrack. However, a significant number criticize it for being overly melodramatic, emotionally manipulative, and populated with stereotypical characters. This leads to a polarized viewing experience, where enjoyment hinges on tolerance for 'moe' and willingness to engage with the sentimental themes.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style, especially backgrounds and character designs.
Evocative soundtrack and fitting voice acting that enhance emotional moments.
Unique and memorable characters (Sunohara is often cited) that add depth.
cons: Overly contrived and emotionally manipulative storylines.
Female characters are often one-dimensional, infantile, and unrealistic.
Pacing issues, with slow plot progression and predictable arcs.

anime.title: Sousei no Aquarion OVA
anime.genres: Mecha, Romance, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: In a distant future there is an organization called Deava which had to fight against the so called "Shadow Angels", creatures that had survived for over 12,000 years whose only purpose was to destroy humanity. Apollo, a seemingly normal human, was in fact the reincarnation of a fallen Angel called Apollonius, who in turn had to fight against Touma, a Shadow Angel, along with his comrades in order to prevent the destruction of the Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: The Sousei no Aquarion OVA is a mixed bag, appealing to those who enjoy both mecha and romance themes, but potentially unsatisfying for die-hard fans of either genre. The story focuses on reincarnation and relationships, with a plot involving angels and humans. While some characters are well-received, the art quality and ending are points of criticism.
pros: Revisions make the OVA a better watch than the series due to a more focused story.
Apollo is a great character with development despite the short OVA length.
cons: The ending is mildly disappointing.
Inconsistent art quality, fluctuating between beautiful and shabby.
Side characters are mostly bland.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 11: Jolly Roger in the Deep Azure
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 11: Konpeki no Jolly Roger
anime.synopsis:
The luscious hills of Koumi Island are one of many reasons tourists pay its shores a visit—a reason that comes second only to its scenic coral reefs and the legend of Anne Bonnie and Mary Read. The museum that houses the cutlass and pistol of the daring pirate duo does wonders for the small island's tourism. 

On a trip to the island, the famous Kogorou Mouri is joined by his daughter Ran, her best friend Sonoko Suzuki, the Detective Boys, and Conan Edogawa. Following a mix up at the hotel regarding their rooms, the group encounters treasure hunters and becomes acquainted with the island's treasure fever. Sent on a hunt of their very own, the Detective Boys scour the isle; while in far harsher waters, Conan discovers a murder. The police, following a clue from a recent robbery, arrive soon after, and Koumi is plunged into chaos. 

What follows is a mad dash by not only the treasure hunters but also the inhabitants of Koumi to secure Anne and Mary's long lost booty. All the while, however, Conan, Kogorou, and the police search for the one thing far greater than riches—justice.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for this Detective Conan movie is decidedly mixed, with many finding the core mystery predictable and the film lacking the grander scale expected of a theatrical release. While praised for its sound design and the development of certain character relationships, it's frequently cited as one of the weaker entries in the series, failing to impress many fans despite its enjoyable moments.
pros: Sound design effectively enhances action scenes and builds suspense.
Ran and Sonoko's friendship and development are a positive highlight.
The pirate theme is well-integrated into the mystery and treasure hunt.
Meaningful interactions between characters, especially Conan/Haibara and Ran/Sonoko.
cons: The main mystery and its resolution are predictable and often considered weak or lackluster.
New characters introduced are largely forgettable and flat.
The animation, particularly 3D models, can be jarring and subpar.
The film feels more like an extended TV episode than a theatrical production.

anime.title: Crayon Shin-chan Movie 15: Arashi wo Yobu Utau Ketsu dake Bakudan!
anime.romaji_title: Crayon Shin-chan Movie 15: Arashi wo Yobu Utau Ketsu dake Bakudan!
anime.synopsis: A slapstick comedy on a bomb uproar, and a touching story about the ties between the Nohara Family and their dog Shiro. A film in the musical style including the scenes with inserted songs. When the Nohara Family enjoy a trip to Okinawa, a strange object like a flying saucer becomes stuck with Shiro's bottom. That is a special bomb dropped by "The Only Buttocks Aliens," and it has the power to destroy the whole earth. The space monitoring center "UNTI" (Unidentified Nature Team Inspection) begins to pick up the bomb, but a female terrorist group "Hinageshi Opera Company" tries to get the bomb and disturbs UNTI's work.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is primarily aimed at kids and is enjoyable due to its humor, quirky characters, and unpredictable plot. The songs are catchy, enhancing the experience. However, some find the drama to be somewhat forced, which is understandable considering the target audience.
pros: Funny and quirky characters
Unpredictable plot
Catchy songs
cons: Forced drama

anime.title: Fist of the North Star The legend of the True Savior -  Legend of Raoh: Chapter of Firece Fighting
anime.romaji_title: Hokuto no Ken: Raoh Gaiden Gekitou-hen
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Romance, Shounen
anime.synopsis: The third chapter of the pentalogy (3 Movies + 2 OVAs). A retelling of Kenshiro's final battle with Raoh.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a decent retelling of the final battle between Kenshiro and Raoh, but it doesn't reach the level of a masterpiece. Fans of the series might enjoy it, but those unfamiliar with the original or critical of its flaws will likely find little to appreciate. The stylized violence and detailed fights are positives, but issues with art style, voice acting, and missing story elements hold it back.
pros: Detailed fights
Stylized violence
cons: Art style dislikes (black lines on characters)
Voice acting criticisms (Raoh, Kenshiro's wailing)
Missing story elements from the original
Music not using classic themes

anime.title: Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World - Byouki no Kuni - For You
anime.romaji_title: Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World - Byouki no Kuni - For You
anime.synopsis:
After a long journey, Kino and Hermes finally arrive at their destination—a very beautiful and clean country with many skyscrapers. Unlike the other places they have visited so far, the country's landscape is a little peculiar. Although the countryside appears to be farmland, the area seems to be abandoned. Filled with old and damaged buildings, there is no sign of life. In contrast, the city is hidden within a mountain, confined under a fabricated sky that is generated by advanced technology. The highly developed city is focused on healthcare, practicing strict hygiene regulations and aiming to turn its citizens into the healthiest of people.

However, despite being in a beautiful and clean environment, Kino cannot help but feel a sense of uneasiness. The town's air slightly contains a peculiar smell, and there are no birds to be seen flying in the skies, bringing a sense of mystery and dizziness to the scenery. After all, as an experienced traveler, Kino knows that looks can be deceiving and that the town may not be what they had initially expected.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment for 'Kino no Tabi: Byouki no Kuni - For You' is largely positive, with many praising its return to the series' core episodic feel and improved production quality. However, a notable split exists regarding the new art style and CGI integration, with some finding it an enhancement and others lamenting the loss of the original's charm. There's also a segment of the audience that felt the story leaned too heavily on a single character's plight, detracting from the usual philosophical depth.
pros: Feels like a genuine Kino's Journey episode, capturing the series' essence.
Enhanced production values and detailed backgrounds compared to the original series.
Impeccable execution in directing, voice acting, and animation.
Thought-provoking story that is philosophical and examines human nature.
Well-written and focused narrative that doesn't feel rushed despite its length.
cons: The newer animation style, while detailed, loses some of the original series' charm and storybook feel.
The integration of CGI can be distracting at times.
Some viewers found the ending confusing or out of character.
Concerns about Kino's character design being altered to be more overtly feminine, undermining her androgyny.
The story sometimes prioritizes a single character's narrative over broader philosophical or cultural exploration, feeling underdeveloped.

anime.title: Kiddy Grade: Ignition
anime.synopsis: A recap of the original anime's first quarter.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is seen as a decent recap of the first part of the series, especially for newcomers. However, it suffers from a disjointed structure and doesn't stand well on its own compared to watching the original episodes. Viewers familiar with the series may find it enjoyable as a nostalgic refresher, but not essential.
pros: Good introduction to the science-fiction genre.
Resumes the beginning of the story well.
Improved art quality compared to the TV series.
Crisp action and understandable weapons.
cons: Questionable purpose as a movie; better to watch specific episodes.
Clip show in the middle is disjointed and uninformative.
Some parts of the story seem misplaced due to deleted scenes.

anime.title: Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 09: Pokemon Ranger to Umi no Ouji Manaphy
anime.synopsis:
Satoshi and his friends get lost in an unknown wasteland.  They eventually come across a "Water Pokemon Show" performed by the star of the Mariner Troupe, Hiromi.  Hiromi is a descendant of the troupe of Water People able to communicate with water pokemon, and she tells our heroes the legend that's been passed down by her people for generations.   According to legend, a temple the Water People built called "The Water Temple Akuusha" rests somewhere in the ocean, and a treasure called "The Water Crown" is hidden there.  It's said that no one has ever seen this treasure, but that changes when a Pokemon Ranger named Jack Walker (aka Jackie) appears to chase aftert it.

Jackie is on a top secret mission that has him protecting the egg of the leader of the water pokemon, Manaphy. This pokemon, called the "Prince of the Sea," needs to be taken to the Water Temple Akuusha, so Satoshi-tachi and Hiromi decide to help him.  Along the way, a pirate named Phantom attacks our heroes from his great submarine.  Phantom plans to use the Water Crown's power to help him conquer the world, but he'll have to solve the mystery of Manaphy's egg first.  When the Rocket-Dan get into the mix, Jackie uses his Capture Styler to borrow the power of a nearby pokemon to stand up to them.  Satoshi and Pikachu enter the fray, but they still have to contend with the attacks of Phantom's powerful high tech mecha!  Suddenly, the egg starts to shine with a vivid light, and Manpahy is born!  

What is the mystery of the legendary treasure?  What mysterious powers does Manaphy have?  Can Satoshi-tachi and Jackie complete their top secret mission?  The journey to reach the Water Temple Akuusha has begun!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is moderately divided, with many appreciating the emotional core centered on Manaphy and May's relationship and the overall animation quality. However, significant criticism exists regarding the plot's weakness, the jarring integration of CGI, and the underutilization of the Pokémon Ranger elements.
pros: Strong emotional moments, particularly the bond between May and Manaphy.
Appealing character dynamics and well-developed side characters.
Visually impressive animation, especially underwater scenes, with good use of 2D animation.
Engaging plot with a good balance between action and character development.
Manaphy and May's relationship is a standout positive element.
cons: The plot is considered weak or barebones by some, especially in the first half.
The inclusion of CGI is jarring and doesn't blend well with traditional animation.
The pacing feels off, with some reviewers finding the movie too long or short.
The Pokémon Ranger aspect is underdeveloped and feels disconnected from the main story.
The villain and plot elements can be generic or ridiculous.

anime.title: Karakuri Zoushi Ayatsuri Sakon
anime.synopsis: The dark-haired bishounen is Sakon Tachibana, a puppeteer, and the other is Ukon, his favorite puppet, and best friend. Sakon is the (only) grandson of Saemon Tachibana, a national treasure of Japan famous for his manipulation of Bunraku puppets. Ukon is a child doll puppet made in the early Meiji era by the famous female dollmaker Unosuke. Together they run into murders and solve them.
anime.consensus_summary: Ayatsuri Sakon is well-regarded as a unique and enjoyable mystery anime with interesting characters and a captivating atmosphere. While the mysteries can be predictable at times, the relationship between Sakon and Ukon, along with the integration of Bunraku puppetry, makes it a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre. It's considered an old but good anime, with a relaxing yet tense feel.
pros: Unique Holmes-Watson dynamic with Sakon and Ukon
Engrossing murder mysteries with fair play clues
Atmospheric with chilling mysticism and poignant character moments
Great soundtrack that solidifies the mood
Exploration of Bunraku puppetry adds a distinct flavor
cons: Predictable murderers due to obvious visual lead-ons
Animation is not always consistent, sometimes appearing foul
Desire for more background information on main characters

anime.title: Burst Angel: Infinity
anime.synopsis:
These events occur in Westland, New York, during the 21st century. With a sharp knife, a murderer is indiscriminately killing people… A girl witnesses one of these murders, and the knife is turned on the helpless girl shaking with fear.

Meg returns to this town with Joe to celebrate the “birthday” of Shirley, who used to live with Meg. Orphans, they had decided that the day they first met would be her birthday. In the past, Meg had taken care of three little children, including Shirley, just before meeting Joe. The children were then adopted by a police officer, Sam. He possessed a strong sense of justice and they are supposedly living happily together now.

Meg and Joe happen to help a person and receive a reward. They buy a present for Shirley with the reward money and go to meet Sam. However, they notice him acting strangely. Upon questioning him, he explains that Shirley was assaulted by a murderer and seriously injured. Joe says to the grieving and angry Meg, “Let's exact revenge on the murderer for Shirley.”

However, the murderer gradually approaches them from behind. The cruel black eyes fall on Meg and Joe… To make matters worse, a dark plot casts its shadow over Meg, Joe, Sam, and the whole town.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, fans consider this short OVA a brilliant addition to the Burst Angel franchise. Reviewers praise the action and darker themes, but note the rushed pacing and lack of significant character development. The improved animation and CGI are highlighted as strong positives.
pros: Brilliant addition to the Burst Angel franchise.
Fun story full of action.
Plot benefits from darker themes.
Animation is a big step up from the series, more polished and clearer.
Smooth character animations and brilliant CGI.
Incidental music adds menace to the darker side of the story.
cons: Can be a little rushed.
Doesn’t really add anything to the series itself.
Very little character development.

anime.title: Black Jack (TV)
anime.synopsis: Black Jack is an "unregistered" doctor with a clouded, mysterious past. He works with his little assistant Pinoko (who has a massive crush on the doctor), dealing with medical cases not very well known, which can be strange, dangerous, or not known at all. But he is a genius, and can save almost any of his patients' life (as long as they have the money for it, that is), and is known to many around the world, especially to those of medicine and science. He's a man of science himself, and does not believe much until he has seen it, yet it is many times he is surprised by love and nature often overpowering the science he bases his life in.
anime.consensus_summary: The Black Jack TV series is generally well-received for its heartwarming and unique medical stories, but some viewers find the art style childish and the length excessive. Pinoco's character is polarizing, and some feel the series deviates too much from the franchise's focus on medical drama, leaning towards slice-of-life elements, particularly in the TV adaptation compared to the OVAs.
pros: Independent storylines with heartwarming moments.
Good animation style reminiscent of Astro Boy.
Unique and life-changing medical cases.
Enjoyable music and soundtrack.
Good balance of main and side characters.
cons: Some episodes are far-fetched and moronic.
Art style may seem childish to some.
Repetitive music in some episodes.
Pinoco can be an annoying character.
The show is too long with unnecessary episodes.
Medical accuracy is questionable.
Focus on slice-of-life elements overshadows medical drama.

anime.title: Black Jack 21
anime.synopsis: No direct-relation sequel to original Black Jack. Black Jack attempts to find out the conspiracy, of why he was involved in the bombfield accident that killed his mother, while he uncovers secrets of Organization and Project "Noir", which, his father and other famous doctors were involved in...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Black Jack 21 is received as a decent continuation of the Black Jack series, though it doesn't quite reach the heights of its predecessor. Fans appreciate the focus on Black Jack's backstory and the blend of action and science. However, some find the overarching plot less engaging than the episodic format of the original, and the lack of focus on patients is a recurring critique. Despite these drawbacks, it's still considered a worthwhile watch, especially for those invested in the Black Jack universe.
pros: Story is superb and focuses on Black Jack's real identity and past.
Pacing is tight with a good balance of action, science, and character development.
Opening and ending themes match the tone of the series perfectly.
cons: Sub-plot/focus felt boring compared to the episodic nature of the original series.
Some found the sub-story uninspired, with a boring conspiracy and adventure.
Patients are not focused on as much, with more emphasis on other doctors and Black Jack himself.

anime.title: Kishin Taisen Gigantic Formula
anime.synopsis: 2035 A.D. The heads of ancient giant idols were excavated all over the world. Using those twelve stones statues, Humanity had barely overcome the threat of extinction called the "Equatorial Winter". But the stone statues had forced Humanity to construct colossal suits of armor as their bodies and demanded that the humans fight each other.
anime.consensus_summary: The series has strong visual appeal and mecha designs, but suffers from a slow plot and excessive focus on uninteresting character backstories.  Viewers found it difficult to connect with the numerous characters, and the pacing issues detracted from the overall experience.  While mech fans may find some enjoyment in the combat and plot, the series could have benefited from a more streamlined narrative.
pros: Great art style with excellent cell shading
Wide variety of mecha designs kept the series interesting
Satisfying combat, drama, and plot for mech fans
cons: Plot progression is very slow
Too much focus on boring background stories of mecha pilots/translators
Flashbacks during mecha battles detract from the action

anime.title: Shigurui: Death Frenzy
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Drama, Gore, Historical, Martial Arts, Psychological, Samurai, Seinen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
At the beginning of the Edo Era, when people enjoyed a time of peace, Lord Tokugawa Tadanaga holds a fighting tournament. In the past, matches were fought with wooden swords. This time, real swords will be used.

One-armed Fujiki Gennosuke and blind Irako Seigen will fight each other in this match. Both are disciples of Iwamoto Kogan, who is known as Japan's greatest swordsman. Each of them are determined to prove himself the successor of Iwamoto's school. However, there can only be one champion.

So begins a story of intertwining fates, conflict, and strange destinies.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions to Shigurui are mixed, with praise for its artistic visuals, sound design, and mature themes. However, many find the story confusing, slow-paced, and ultimately unsatisfying due to its incomplete ending. The intense violence and lack of likeable characters also deter some viewers.
pros: High production value with beautiful and detailed art
Atmospheric sound design enhances the setting
Mature and serious tone
Story with complex characters
cons: Confusing and slow-paced story
Incomplete ending
Excessive and gratuitous violence and gore
Underdeveloped or unlikeable characters

anime.title: Honoo no Toukyuuji: Dodge Danpei
anime.genres: Comedy, Kids, School, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: Danpei Ichihgeki is the son of Daijurou Ichigeki, a great dodgeball player. As his father, Danpei gives all he has for this game and so it shows in every match.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is well-received, particularly for its music, characters, and engaging dodgeball matches. Some find the initial episodes too childish and the ending rushed, but overall, it's a deeply enjoyed sports anime with a strong nostalgic appeal. The unique character designs and individual themes contribute to its charm.
pros: Amazing soundtrack with unique character themes
Close-to-heart and varied characters with unique designs
Enjoyable and fast-paced dodgeball matches
Beautiful art style reminiscent of the 80s and early 90s
cons: Childish and silly first few episodes
Rushed ending due to the manga not being caught up

anime.title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
anime.synopsis: After the defeat of the demon lord Hadlar all of the monsters were unleashed from his evil will and moved to the island of Delmurin to live in peace. Dai is the only human living on the island. Having been raised by the kindly monster Brass, Dai's dream is to grow up to be a hero. He gets to become one when Hadlar is resurrected and the previous hero, Avan, comes to train Dai to help in the battle. But Hadlar, announcing that he now works for an even more powerful demon lord, comes to kill Avan. To save his students Avan uses a Self-Sacrifice spell to attack, but is unable to defeat Hadlar. When it seems that Dai and Avan's other student Pop are doomed a mark appears on Dai's forehead and he suddenly gains super powers and is able to fend off Hadlar. The two students then go off on a journey to avenge Avan and bring peace back to the world.
anime.consensus_summary: The Dragon Quest: Dai no Daibouken anime is generally well-regarded, particularly for its engaging story, likable characters, and memorable music. However, the abrupt cancellation and incomplete adaptation of the manga's storyline are significant drawbacks.  Many feel the ending was rushed and that a more complete adaptation would elevate the series significantly, with some hoping for a remake or OVA to cover the remaining story arcs.
pros: Strong story with likable characters who grow and change
Memorable scenes aided by high-quality musical score
Exciting action scenes keep the viewer engaged
Charming and likable characters
Well-developed lore and character content
cons: Slow pacing at the beginning
Too many flashback scenes to pad out episodes
Anime was canceled before the story was complete, leading to a rushed and unsatisfying ending
VHS version needs an update and western release

anime.title: Funny Pets
anime.synopsis:
One day an armada of Unidentified Flying Objects (UFO) came out of nowhere under the full moon.

One of them mistakenly fell to the Earth.

The two Extra-Terrestrials, Crescent and Corona, who were on board the falling UFO, happened to be saved and picked up by an Earth girl Funny. In reality Crescent and Corona were forced to live as pet with that selfish and moody girl Funny...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is highly divided on 'Funny Pets.' Some find its bizarre and dark humor entertaining, especially those familiar with Masuda's work like 'Popee the Performer.' However, many criticize its lack of story, poor animation, and disturbing content. The show's appeal seems to depend on individual tolerance for unconventional and potentially offensive material.
pros: Unique and bizarre, attempting something new
Creative and wacky scenarios
Cult following potential
cons: No coherent story or character development
Crude CGI animation and jarring sound design
Inconsistent characters and plot
Violent and sexual content juxtaposed with childish elements may be disturbing

anime.title: Ocha-ken: Chokotto Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Ocha-ken is a children's program about tea-dogs and tea-cats, each representing a different blend. The episodes are very short and geared to teaching the audience various values. The lesson, or moral of the episode is displayed at the end.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience expresses strong positive feelings for "Ocha-ken: Chokotto Monogatari," particularly its cuteness and educational value for young viewers. There's a sense of nostalgia and a desire to reintroduce it to current audiences. The main critique is the absence of a complex plot, which is understandable for its target demographic.
pros: Cute and enjoyable for young audiences
Good meaning in each short episode
Suitable to introduce young audiences to anime
cons: No real plot

anime.title: Panda-Z: The Robonimation
anime.synopsis: Panda-Z chronicles the misadventures of Pan Taron and his giant robot Panda-Z, as they battle the evil Skull Panda and his Warunimal forces.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Panda-Z to be a light-hearted and enjoyable series, perfect for relaxation. Its simplicity is seen as both a strength and a weakness, with some appreciating the easy-to-follow humor while others desire more depth. The technical aspects, particularly the music and animation, receive mixed feedback.
pros: Simple humor and gags
Catchy music that matches the episode's mood
Relaxing and easy to follow
cons: Basic art and animation
Music can be too loud and screeching
Characters lack depth

anime.title: Aquatic Language
anime.synopsis: Several people are spending their evening in a cafe. Two gossiping girls, two debating men, a bookworm and a boy, who just broke up with his girlfriend. The cafe's waitress starts a chat with him, persuading him to take a look at certain easel, while other customers begin to notice unusual things.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the short for its atmosphere, thought-provoking themes, and experimental nature, while others find the narrative confusing, the characters underdeveloped, and the animation unrefined. It's generally considered an interesting but flawed piece, particularly as a precursor to 'Eve no Jikan'.
pros: Unique and interesting atmosphere
Well-done dialogue that feels natural
Presents interesting concepts about language and perception
Effective use of limited runtime to introduce characters and concepts
The art style complements the surreal themes
cons: Incomplete or confusing narrative
Underdeveloped characters
Choppy or unrefined animation
Ending does not deliver on the build-up
Some find the art style clunky

anime.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
anime.genres: Award Winning, Drama, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Makoto Konno is in her last year of high school, but is having a hard time deciding what to do with her future. In between enduring the pressure of her teachers and killing time with her best friends, Makoto's life suddenly changes when she accidentally discovers that she is capable of literally leaping through time.

Toki wo Kakeru Shoujo follows Makoto as she plays around with her newfound power. However, she soon learns the hard way that every choice has a consequence, and time is a lot more complicated than it may seem.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely agrees on the film's emotional resonance, beautiful art, and impactful music. However, opinions are divided on the execution of the plot, particularly the ending and certain character motivations, which some find unsatisfying or underdeveloped.
pros: Beautiful and detailed backgrounds/environments.
Poignant and effective soundtrack and music score.
Well-written and relatable characters.
Engaging character interactions and scripting.
Subtle yet effective storytelling.
Thought-provoking themes about consequences and embracing the future.
cons: Character designs are sometimes considered lackluster or too simple.
The ending and certain plot twists can be unsatisfying or create plot holes.
Some character motivations, particularly Chiaki's, are considered cryptic or poorly explained.
Pacing can be slow in parts or feel tedious for some viewers.
The transition to a more dramatic/sci-fi element in the latter half can feel jarring.

anime.title: Seraphim Call
anime.synopsis: What's it like to feel like an average girl in everything.​.. except for your one special gift.​ Eleven young hearts with eleven dreams.​ Deep in their hearts,​ each girl has a secret dream of love and sadness.​ They meet together at Acropolis Tower to see if their dreams will come true.​ Imagine what happens when eleven average girls with eleven special talents join together to make the world a better place!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are split regarding Seraphim Call. Some appreciate the underlying themes and specific episodes, particularly the music. However, many find the plot incoherent, the characters underdeveloped, and the animation unappealing, resulting in a generally negative reception.
pros: Some great moments, especially episodes 2 and 11 tackle themes and problems well.
Music is full of banger themes, especially the opening and insert ED songs.
cons: Inconsistent and incomprehensible plot threads.
Stories jump around without connections, feeling rushed with random character connections.
Giant robots and time travel feel unnecessary and poorly explained.
One-dimensional and forgettable characters due to too many main characters and side characters in each episode.
Stiff animation with barely any movement.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Slice of Life, Drama

anime.title: Mononoke
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Historical, Horror, Mystery, Mythology, Psychological, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
The "Medicine Seller" is a deadly and mysterious master of the occult who travels across feudal Japan in search of malevolent spirits called "mononoke" to slay. When he locates one of these spirits, he cannot simply kill it; he must first learn its Form, its Truth, and its Reason in order to wield the mighty Exorcism Sword and fight against it. He must begin  his strange exorcisms with intense psychological analysis and careful investigative work—an extremely dangerous step, as he must first confront and learn about the mononoke before he even has the means to defeat it.

The Medicine Seller's journey leads him to an old-fashioned inn where Shino, a pregnant woman, has finally found a place to rest. The owner has reluctantly placed her in the last vacant room; however, as she settles in, it quickly becomes clear that the room is infested by a lethal band of mononoke, the Zashiki Warashi. With his hunter's intuition, the Medicine Seller begins his investigation to discover the Form, the Truth, and the Reason before the Zashiki Warashi can kill again.
anime.consensus_summary: Mononoke is lauded for its unique artistic style, which blends vibrant visuals with Japanese folklore to create a visually stunning experience. The series excels in psychological horror, exploring the depths of human emotions and societal issues through supernatural narratives. However, some find the formulaic storytelling and visually intense art style repetitive or overwhelming. Overall, the series is appreciated for its artistic merit and thematic depth, though it may not appeal to all viewers.
pros: Unique and striking art style inspired by Ukiyo-e prints, with vibrant colors and detailed backgrounds.
Well-crafted, suspenseful storytelling with unexpected plot twists and profound themes related to human nature and emotions.
Effective use of sound design to create a tense and immersive atmosphere, enhancing the horror elements.
cons: Formulaic narrative structure with repetitive plotlines across different arcs.
Art style may be too bright or visually overwhelming for some viewers, leading to a nauseating experience.
Characters may lack emotional connection and depth, making it difficult to feel empathy for their plights.

anime.title: Naruto: Hidden Leaf Village Grand Sports Festival
anime.romaji_title: Naruto: Dai Katsugeki!! Yuki Hime Ninpouchou Dattebayo! - Konoha no Sato no Dai Undoukai
anime.synopsis: The Konohagakure Grand Sports Festival has begun with all ninja squads vying for the ultimate prize—a whole week of paid leave! Despite his enthusiasm to achieve victory alongside Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno, Naruto Uzumaki finds himself in a pinch due to unexpected digestion problems. Caught between the competition and his personal emergency, he faces never-ending obstacles in his frantic search for a way out of the troublesome situation.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds this special to be a lighthearted and humorous diversion from the main Naruto storyline. While some appreciate the absurdity and playful character interactions, others find the toilet humor and nonsensical plot to be unappealing. Overall, it's considered a fun but ultimately forgettable addition to the Naruto franchise, best enjoyed by those who don't take it too seriously.
pros: Enjoyable break from the serious Naruto storyline.
Good animation and sound quality consistent with the series.
Fun character interactions and seeing familiar characters in a playful setting.
cons: Crude toilet humor may not appeal to all viewers.
Story is nonsensical and irrelevant to the main plot.
Overuse of character cameos, including dead characters, can be distracting.

anime.title: Baccano!
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Historical, Mystery, Organized Crime, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
During the early 1930s in Chicago, the transcontinental train, Flying Pussyfoot, is starting its legendary journey that will leave a trail of blood all over the country. At the same time in New York, the ambitious scientist Szilard and his unwilling aide Ennis are looking for missing bottles of the immortality elixir. In addition, a war between the mafia groups is getting worse. On board the Advena Avis, in 1711, alchemists are about to learn the price of immortality.

Based on the award-winning light novels of the same name, Baccano! follows several events that initially seem unrelated, both in time and place, but are part of a much bigger story—one of alchemy, survival, and immortality. Merging these events together are the kindhearted would-be thieves, Isaac and Miria, connecting various people, all of them with their own hidden ambitions and agendas, and creating lifelong bonds and consequences for everyone involved.
anime.consensus_summary: Baccano! is a stylish and energetic anime praised for its unique non-linear storytelling, memorable characters, and jazzy soundtrack. However, some viewers find the narrative confusing, the characters underdeveloped, and the violence gratuitous. The series polarizes audiences, with some considering it a masterpiece and others finding it mediocre.
pros: Unique non-linear storytelling keeps the series engaging and avoids downtime.
Memorable and well-designed characters with unique voices.
Excellent jazz-themed soundtrack that fits the 1930s American setting.
High-quality animation, especially during action sequences.
Successfully blends comedy, suspense, action, and romance.
The English dub is lauded for its use of accents and slang, enhancing characterization and atmosphere.
World comes alive, thanks to the animation,music, hairstyles, and clothes all contributing to a viewer's sense of what that era in American history was like.
cons: Non-linear storytelling can be confusing and convoluted, lacking thematic reason.
Some characters are one-dimensional and underdeveloped.
Violence is sometimes used frivolously and lacks narrative significance.
The large cast of characters can be difficult to keep track of, with some feeling interchangeable.
Some viewers find the comedy relief unnecessary and detracting from the serious tone.
Plot holes and unresolved subplots due to the chaotic presentation.

anime.title: Dr. Rin ni Kiitemite!
anime.synopsis: Kanzaki Meirin, a junior high school student, posseses fusui power which can drive away evil spirits away whenever they appeared. She is in fact, the fortune teller Dr. Rin. She is in love with her best friend, soccer club member, Yuuki Asuka. However, Yuuki does not like fortune-telling and superstitious things.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is enjoyable for those who like magical girl series such as Sailor Moon and Fushigi Yuugi, although it has some elements that might deter some viewers.  Despite its flaws in animation and pacing, the story and characters are engaging enough to maintain interest. There's some division among viewers regarding the romantic pairings.
pros: Enjoyable despite not typically watching shoujo anime.
Story becomes complex and engaging as it progresses.
Some aspects of the soundtrack are memorable.
cons: Story is slow at first.
Art style is dated.
Character design is generic.
Love triangles and slow romantic progression may deter some viewers.

anime.title: Kirameki☆Project
anime.synopsis: In a world where giant rude robots are common and used to fight wars appears a giant Handcrafted robot that defeats the major armies of the world. Meanwhile in a kingdom where three sisters reign in peace and harmony there is a secret that they keep from the rest of the world until they must use a Doll-looking robot to protect their nation, even when her creator refuses to put her friend in danger.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Kirameki☆Project to be an absurd and fun parody, despite its weak story. The characters and comic timing are well-received. The heavy fan-service may be a point of contention for some viewers.
pros: Likable characters
Good music
Enjoyable comic timing and physical gags
cons: Throwaway story with unanswered questions
Obvious 3D CG mecha fights that don't always fit

anime.title: Malice@Doll
anime.synopsis: Malice, a sex robot living in an abandoned human city, is assaulted and violated by a mysterious creature. Upon awakening, Malice finds out that she has become human and can pass on her humanity to her fellow machines. However, her gift soon becomes a curse when her fellow robots rage out of control after being exposed to the pleasures of life.
anime.consensus_summary: Malice@Doll is a visually unique and conceptually interesting anime that explores themes of humanity and artificiality, but suffers from dated CG, a confusing plot, and underdeveloped characters. While the show raises thought-provoking questions, its execution leaves much to be desired, resulting in a mixed reception from viewers. The explicit content is also a point of contention.
pros: Visually striking and imaginative world design
Thought-provoking exploration of humanity and identity
Eerie and unsettling atmosphere
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and dated CG
Underdeveloped characters and shallow emotional connection
Obscure and confusing plot with inadequate explanations
Excessive and questionable sexual content

anime.title: Sin: The Movie
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Gore, Horror, Sci-Fi, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: In Sin, Blade must unravel a series of mysterious kidnappings. As he delves into the city's merciless underworld, an elaborate mystery unfold; at is heart, the SinTEK corporation and its leader, the ruthless and beautiful Elexis Sinclair. A Brilliant biochemist, Sinclair will stop at nothing to achieve her goal: a plan that could force the next step of human evolution-or spell doom for mankind.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Sin: The Movie' is largely negative. Critics pan the weak plot, cliché characters, and poor animation, while some appreciate the action, violence, and soundtrack. The film is considered a poor adaptation of the video game, with many finding it nonsensical and forgettable, though a few find it hilariously bad and worth watching for its over-the-top nature.
pros: Good action and violence.
Interesting story (to some).
Animation and sound are big movie type quality (to some).
Pacing and music score.
Soundtrack performed by Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra is shockingly good.
Over-the-top action and gore scenes.
Brilliantly designed dystopian future.
cons: Weak plot.
Characters are bland stereotypes with little to no personality.
Story is extremely cliché and cheesy.
Animation is atrocious.
CG looks really flat and doesn't mesh well with the animation.
Voice acting is poor.
Nothing is explained.

anime.title: Red Garden: Dead Girls
anime.synopsis: In the future (subsequent to the events of the television series) Kate, Rose, Rachel and Claire divide their immortal lives between study and vigilantism. Their past link to the red garden on Roosevelt Island comes back to haunt them after mysterious transfer students Louise and Edgar seek out their friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Red Garden: Dead Girls is mixed. Some appreciate the continuation of the story and the visual style, while others are disappointed by the nonsensical plot, character changes, and lack of meaningful resolution. The OVA is considered inessential, mainly recommended for dedicated fans of the original series, but even then, some advise against it due to character assassination and tarnished memories of the original.
pros: Art and animation are nice and unique.
Setting the OVA far into the future was an interesting choice.
cons: Plot hardly makes any sense.
Unanswered questions and generic ending.
Character personalities are different and not well-explained.
OVA feels pointless and doesn't add to the original series.
Music is bad.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
anime.romaji_title: Shin Kidou Senki Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz Tokubetsu-hen
anime.synopsis:
It is A.C. 196—one year after the conflict between Earth and its nearby space colonies ended with the formation of the Earth Sphere Unified Nation. As mankind enters a new era of unity and prosperity, four of the five Gundam pilots decide to follow in society's footsteps and disarm by launching their mobile suits into the sun. However, their plan is unexpectedly suspended when a rebellion erupts with the emergence of Mariemaia Khushrenada—who claims to be the child of fallen dictator Treize and desires to conquer the world in his stead.

Deciding that they are the last line of defense for the Earth Sphere, Heero Yuy, Trowa Barton, Duo Maxwell, and Quatre Raberba Winner scramble to retrieve their Gundams and fight to protect the peace the people of the colonies have pursued for so long. Despite their unwavering resolve to complete one final mission, the battle will be challenging: the pilots' former ally Wufei Chang has pledged his allegiance to Mariemaia's cause instead.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences largely agree that Endless Waltz is a visual upgrade and a satisfying conclusion to the Gundam Wing series, with praise for its animation and music. However, there is some division regarding the simplicity of the plot and the controversial redesigns of the Gundam mechs.
pros: Significantly improved animation and art quality compared to the original series, with more fluid action sequences and detailed designs.
Strong voice acting and a compelling musical score that enhances the action and emotional beats.
Provides a satisfying conclusion and natural continuation of the Gundam Wing series.
Fleshes out pilot backstories and character development more effectively than the TV show.
cons: The plot can be overly simple and at times feels like a rehash of the original series' themes.
Some character motivations, particularly for new antagonists, are underdeveloped or derivative.
The use of flashbacks for backstory can feel like padding and disrupt the narrative flow.
Divisive redesigns of the iconic Gundam suits, which clashed with original designs for some fans.

anime.title: Magical Play
anime.synopsis:
Padudu is a 12-year-old apprentice witch, chosen to represent her town in the coliseum. Donning her magical fish costume, which keeps her warm and fed, she sets off on her journey. But on the way she's swept away by a river to Dance Valley. Mayor Koffy captures her and throws her into the dungeon, hoping to eliminate the competition for Dance Valley's own coliseum candidate. Luckily for Padudu, this dungeon holds the mysterious witch Nonononn. They join together in a magical fight for survival. At the end of Blue Gender Trailer, the Magical witchland word came out!

This is the online version of Mahou Yugi...
anime.consensus_summary: Mahou Yuugi 2D is a short, quirky series with memorable character designs and surreal humor, but it suffers from a nonsensical plot, limited character development, and inconsistent animation quality. While some enjoy its unique style and comedic moments, many find the lack of direction and technical flaws disappointing. The series is generally considered a niche anime with a mixed reception, leaning towards mild enjoyment for those who appreciate its unconventional approach.
pros: Unique and cute series.
Fantastic character designs by Azuma Kiyohiko.
Inventive animation shortcuts.
Good voice acting in the dub.
Entertaining and colorful cast of characters.
Some of the humor is genuinely funny.
cons: Lacks direction in the story.
Character development is minimal.
Low technical quality animation.
Music is unremarkable.
Inconsistent animation quality, with awkward moments and cheap aesthetic.
Poorly executed 3D animation.
Ending feels rushed and unsatisfying.

anime.title: Mahou Yuugi 3D
anime.synopsis: Padudu is a 12-year-old apprentice witch, chosen to represent her town in the coliseum. Donning her magical fish costume, which keeps her warm and fed, she sets off on her journey. But on the way she's swept away by a river to Dance Valley. Mayor Koffy captures her and throws her into the dungeon, hoping to eliminate the competition for Dance Valley's own coliseum candidate. Luckily for Padudu, this dungeon holds the mysterious witch Nonononn. They join together in a magical fight for survival. At the end of Blue Gender Trailer, the Magical witchland word came out!
anime.consensus_summary: The 3D OVA offers a more structured narrative with engaging characters but suffers from a significant downgrade in visual quality due to its CGI animation. While the writing shows promise, the unresolved plot points leave the viewer wanting more. Fans of the original 2D series may be disappointed by the altered art style.
pros: Distinct 3-act structure provides better direction compared to the previous series.
Characters are likable with interesting dynamics, despite limited screen time.
Higher writing quality compared to the ONA series.
cons: Transition to CGI animation significantly detracts from the visual charm of the original.
3D animation ranges from weird to janky.
Unresolved plot elements leave the story incomplete.

anime.title: Tokyo Pig
anime.synopsis: Tokyo Pig is the wacky and crazy story of a young boy named Spencer and his magical pet pig named Sunny. This is the wierd adventures of these two wierdos.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a fondly remembered, if silly, anime that appeals to young children. Its simple humor and availability on DVD make it a nostalgic favorite for those who watched it in their childhood. While not a critical darling, it's remembered as a fun and engaging show for kids.
pros: Fun for young children
Appeals to both children and adults
Memorable and nostalgic
cons: Stupid humor
Obscure and hard to find

anime.title: Flint the Time Detective
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Mystery, Sci-Fi, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: It is the 25th century. The dark lord has 'infected' history with time-devices that could damage history beyond repair. Genshi and his father lived in the prehistorics when they got turned into fossiles. They are discovered and Genshi gets turned back to his original state. With the help of his father, a boy Tony and a girl Sara he has to travel trough time to bring the time-devices back to the land of time so history will be saved.
