anime.synopsis: Conan Edogawa and the rest of the gang are invited to Inspector Ninzaburou Shiratori's villa for a small gathering. The party's highlight is Shiratori's prized wine collection—including his most expensive vintage—and a bottle from it will be served for the evening. However, just as this wine is to be brought out, Shiratori finds the bottle smashed on the floor—and the culprit can only be among the 16 people present in the gathering.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys this OVA as a lighthearted and fun mystery, appreciating the change of pace from more serious cases. The story is considered enjoyable with fun twists, and the characters are seen in a more relaxed setting. However, some note the lack of character development and the absence of high stakes as minor drawbacks.
pros: Enjoyable story with fun twists
Nice to see the gang in a less stressful, more normal situation
Solid art and music typical of Detective Conan
cons: Limited character development due to the large cast
No high profile crime or serious stakes
anime.thematic_vibe: Lighthearted Mystery, Humorous, Slice of Life

anime.title: Detective Conan OVA 03: Conan and Heiji and the Vanished Boy
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan OVA 03: Conan to Heiji to Kieta Shounen
anime.synopsis: Conan and Ran are visiting Heiji and Kazuha in Osaka when the four come across a trio of kids while touring the city. These children, who look eerily similar to the Detective Boys but with different personalities, are looking for their friend who has gone missing—and the two young detectives agree to help find the vanished boy.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is considered a one-time watch due to a weak storyline and unoriginal characters that mimic existing ones. Some viewers find the plot interesting despite its brevity, while others feel it lacks the depth of typical Detective Conan episodes. Overall, it is considered a cute but forgettable addition to the series.
pros: Interesting storyline
cons: Weak story line
Characters are knock-offs
Storyline feels cut down
Short

anime.title: Detective Conan OVA 04: Conan and Kid and Crystal Mother
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan OVA 04: Conan to Kid to Crystal Mother
anime.synopsis:
Once again, Kaitou Kid has a target in mind: the Crystal Mother, Europe's largest topaz owned by Queen Selizabeth of the Principality of Ingram. He intends to steal this jewel while the Queen is stuck on a train from Tokyo to Osaka. However, Kid's abilities are put to the test, as the Queen has already concealed the gem somewhere aboard the train. 

Conan Edogawa, who is among train's passengers, suspects an attack from the phantom thief and begins investigating on his own, while Inspector Ginzou Nakamori is ready for a new confrontation against the elusive jewelry robber.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received, particularly by Kaitou Kid fans. Viewers appreciate the focus on Kid's character and the enjoyable story, though some find the Conan's reduced role disappointing. The production quality is considered average, but the character development and engaging plot outweigh these shortcomings for most.
pros: Well-presented characters, especially Kaitou Kid.
Enjoyable story with a good twist.
Believable character growth for the queen and prince.
Good soundtrack and solid voice cast.
cons: Conan is pushed into the background.
Art and animation are average and not overly impressive.
New characters are not well-developed due to the short runtime.
Caper isn't complicated, character motivations are basic.

anime.title: Detective Conan OVA 05: The Target is Kogoro! The Detective Boys' Secret Investigation
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan OVA 05: Target wa Kogorou!! Shounen Tanteidan Maruhi Report
anime.synopsis:
Conan Edogawa and his classmates are assigned to do a class report about a small business of their choice. After discarding other possible topics, the Detective Boys concludes that it is a perfect opportunity to find out more about Detective Kogorou Mouri's job.

Conan's friends refuse to settle for a simple interview, though, as they want to experience first-hand all the details of his work. Thus, they, along with a reluctant Conan and Ai Haibara, decide to tail the renowned detective for a day. However, the kids soon get involved in a grim situation when Kogorou's current case takes an unexpected and dangerous turn.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is considered a serviceable but unmemorable addition to the Detective Conan series. While it has some charming moments and a slightly larger role for Haibara, the premise of the Detective Boys shadowing Kogoro is not particularly engaging. The mystery element feels tacked on and the story lacks overall importance to the series.
pros: Larger role for Haibara is appreciated.
cons: Unmemorable premise.
Mystery is not important to the premise.
Story is not important to the series.

anime.title: Emma: A Victorian Romance - Intermission
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Historical, Romance, Seinen
anime.synopsis: This special is a recap of the first season of Eikoku Koi Monogatari Emma: Intermission as well as a preview of the second season Eikoku Koi Monogatari Emma: Molders Hen.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the recap special for its effectiveness in refreshing the key plot points of the first season and setting up the second season. It serves as a good refresher for viewers before diving into the next installment. Some viewers might find it less engaging if they haven't watched the first season.
pros: Effective recap of the first season.
Sets up the second season well.
Provides a different viewing point on previous scenes.
Helps remember key points of the series.
cons: Only interesting if you've seen the previous episodes.

anime.title: Haja Kyosei G Dangaiou
anime.synopsis: A mysterious explosion on Futagami Island begins a new chapter in the Dangaioh mythos! Led by the evil Professor Katou, a band of warriors calling themselves the "Tartarus Knights" have begun their campaign to lay waste to the world by way of a small research station on Futagami Island. Katou's victory seems almost certain until he encounters an advanced fortress guarding the island. From it, a group of three humanoid robots are launched—Dangaioh!
anime.consensus_summary: Great Dangaioh is largely considered a disappointing sequel that fails to live up to the original OVA. Reviewers criticize its generic plot, uninspired character and mecha designs, and low-budget animation. The story meanders aimlessly, culminating in a confusing and rushed ending that leaves many viewers unsatisfied. Overall, the audience consensus is negative, with many recommending that fans avoid this series.
pros: First episode shows promise.
Nostalgia factor with returning characters and voice actors.
cons: Mediocre story and tropes.
Poor character and mecha designs.
Low-budget animation.
Incoherent and rushed ending.
Weak male lead.
Story meanders without purpose.
Unresolved plot points (love triangle, connection to original OVA).

anime.title: Izumo: Flash of a Brave Sword
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Isekai, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: Yagi Takeru has been living in the Touma family's house since his parents are gone. He was raised by Touma Rokunosuke, the head of the house. He is surrounded by many people such as Yamato Takeshi, his best friend-cum-rival from the kendo club, the Shiratori sisters, Kotono and Asuka, and his childhood friend, Oosu Seri. Life has been blissful until one day, an earthquake strikes the school and everything changes. Takeru awakens to find that the school looks as if it has been abandoned for centuries and reduced to ruins. He also realize that all the teachers and students have disappeared as well. He meets up with Seri and Asuka and they fled from the ruins, only to realize that the town they used to live in is completely empty. Subsequently, people wrapped in cloaks appear before him. They were told that they have been brought to another world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding the anime enjoyable and visually appealing, while others criticize its unoriginality and questionable design choices. Some viewers enjoyed the series enough to rewatch it multiple times. Overall, the anime is considered decent but not exceptional, potentially appealing to viewers who are less critical of familiar themes.
pros: Visually appealing character and background designs.
Enjoyable music, including opening and ending themes.
Engaging story that captivates viewers.
cons: Story resembles themes from other anime series.
Unusual design choices (e.g., 'horses' looking like Jar Jar Binks, yellow blood).
Questionable character design choices (e.g., Minakata's short skirt).
Unpopular romantic pairing (Takeshi-Himiko).

anime.title: Kirara
anime.synopsis:
After years of pining and confusion, a romance blossoms between high school friends Chikahira Asai and Kirara Imai, leading to their marriage. But their bright future together is tragically cut short when Kirara dies in a car accident on the day of their wedding.

Kirara's love for Chikahira has allowed her to remain on Earth as a ghost, sending her eight years back in time to the moment when she becomes acquainted with her future husband. While Kirara hopes to use her ghostly powers to accelerate her younger self's romance, her good intentions might just become another obstacle on the road to love.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views 'Kirara' as a hidden gem with a bittersweet and melancholic tone. The animation and music are praised, but the pacing and ending are considered weak points. Overall, the OVA is appreciated for its emotional depth and thematic resonance, prompting viewers to reflect on life and love.
pros: Elegant character designs and background art.
Melancholic vocal tracks enhance the experience.
Thematic integration of music, especially the ending theme.
Passionate direction and pacing for its time.
cons: Breakneck pacing in the opening segment.
Anti-climatic ending.

anime.title: Angelique
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Reverse Harem, Romance, Sci-Fi, Shoujo
anime.synopsis: One woman, simply known as The Queen, rules over the universe. By harnessing the elemental powers of her nine Guardians, she nurtures life on many planets. When it is time for The Queen to appoint a successor, she sees promise within two young maidens, Angelique Limoges and Rosalia de Catargena, and she gives them a test: utilize the power of the Guardians to cultivate life and prosperity on an uninhabited planet. However, Angelique is much less prepared than her rival; she must carefully foster relationships with the Guardians if she stands any chance at success.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response is lukewarm. Fans of the original game may appreciate the OVA as a visual representation, but newcomers may find it boring and predictable. The characters are well-developed and visually appealing, but the plot and protagonist may not appeal to all viewers, especially those not interested in romance.
pros: Characters are well developed with rich personalities.
Characters have good designs, are colorful and fun to watch.
cons: OVA is boring without prior knowledge of the game.
Plot is predictable, revealing the ending from the start.
Protagonist is a typical weak and naive girl who gains power.

anime.title: Angelique: Seichi yori Ai wo Komete
anime.romaji_title: Angelique: Seichi yori Ai wo Komete
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Sci-Fi, Shoujo
anime.synopsis: The queen is collecting some jewels that apparently endanger the whole universe if they fall into the wrong hands. But Zephel screws up and loses one of the jewels. What should he do now?
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that this OVA series is only worth watching for hardcore Angelique fans. The production quality is lacking, with issues in voice acting, sound mixing, and narrative flow. Understanding the plot requires prior knowledge of the Japanese language and the Angelique games, making it inaccessible to casual viewers.
pros: Late 90s animation style (for those who like it)
cons: Poor voice acting
Bad volume mixing
Poor story flow
Requires understanding of Japanese and the games to understand the plot

anime.title: With You: Mitsumeteitai
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Love Polygon, Mystery, Romance, School
anime.synopsis: Based on a H-game with the same title released by Cocktail Soft in 1998, With You: Mitsumeteitai focuses on love triangle between the main characters who were childhood friends. They were separated because one of them had to move to Myanmar (an Asian country formerly known as Burma). After six years, they are re-united again and the story begins...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience consensus is largely negative. Reviewers cite a rushed and underdeveloped story, bland characters, and poor animation quality. While some appreciate the character designs and sound effects, the general feeling is that the adaptation failed to capture the potential of the source material.
pros: Character designs were pleasing to the eye.
The art is this anime's strongest aspect, with indulgent use of color and characteristically 90s character design.
Sound effects were the highlight of the sound experience.
cons: Plot meanders and never develops anything satisfactorily.
Characters are listless, boring, and lack any originality.
Artistically this anime is horrible.
The biggest downside is that everything is crammed into 2 episodes.
Very little to no background information or history is given on the characters which made it hard to have any emotion for the characters.

anime.title: The Great Adventures of Robin Hood
anime.synopsis:
A variant of Robin Hood in which all the principal characters are teenagers.

Several centuries ago in Nottingham County, a cruel and greedy baron by the name of Alwine ordered the destruction of the Huntingtons' castle—from the fire of which Robin and his cousins, Will, Winifred and Barbara, miraculously escaped. The youngsters sought shelter in Sherwood Forest, where, thanks to the wise guidance of the hermit better known as "Friar Tuck," they managed to face the difficulties of a life in the wilderness as as well as they could; however, in the forest there lived a fearless group of young bandits, led by Little John. Their first encounter with Robin and his cousins was at first rather stormy, as the two groups fought for the destiny of a young, noble maiden named Marian who had fallen into the hands of the bandits during an ambush.

Their bitterness, however, rapidly lead the way to friendship, and Robin and John later realized they were all victims of the same fate. The youngsters thus mutually decided to help one another. Baron Alwine was not merely enemy of the Huntingtons—in fact, a couple years earlier he had forced Little John and his gang to seek protection in the forest to avoid forced labour. He would later seek Marian Lancaster for the secret carved on a cross the girl wore as symbol of her family line.

The girl was to be adopted by the shady Bishop Herfort—Alwine's accomplice—who sought to attain the Lancaster's wealth. With all their strength, Robin and his friends were then compelled to fight against the baron's troops, led by Gilbert—a dangerous and fearless knight. When Winifred and Marian were then imprisoned in the castle's dungeons, our heroes tried in every way possible to enter until their ardour was finally rewarded with success. Thanks to his noble heart and heed for danger, Robin became rapidly known as the protector of the poor and oppressed. Beloved and highly esteemed not only by the villagers, but also and especially by the sweet and beautiful Marian he was. The boy who never parted from his loyal, magical bow, endlessly engaged in dangerous and unthinkable missions.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received, particularly by those who watched it as children, evoking nostalgia and warm memories. The story and characters are appreciated for their development and engagement, though some find the plot devices and simplistic elements to be naive. The English dub is heavily criticized for losing emotional depth and nuance compared to the original Japanese version.
pros: Story is engaging, with intrigue, conflict, and tension despite being aimed at children.
Well-developed characters with unique journeys.
Excellent art style featuring beautiful, painterly backgrounds that vividly capture the atmosphere of Sherwood Forest.
Catchy opening and ending themes, especially in the English version.
cons: Naive elements, such as children defeating armed soldiers.
Frequent use of Deus ex machina in the first half of the anime.
English dub loses an enormous amount of nuance and emotional depth, with inaccurate and cringy dialogue.
Background music missing in the English release, present in the original Japanese version.

anime.title: Tetsuko no Tabi
anime.synopsis:
Based on a seinen manga by Kikuchi Naoe and Yokomi Hirohiko, serialised in IKKI. 

The "story" is that a manga artist is asked by her boss to accompany him and a travel-writer on various train trips around Japan and draw a manga about it. 

The kicker though, is that it's completely non-fiction —the creator really did go on all these trips, and the manga simply records what happened, with no embellishment. There's a little disclaimer at the front that says "This is non-fiction, so I apologize for the lack of drama," and indeed, it mostly is just about them riding trains from place to place, waiting on platforms, etc. 

The "travel writer" turns out to be a super train-otaku who has vast knowledge of the train network, but also micro-manages all their trips, planning every detail down to the second. He cares mostly about following the schedule and successfully achieving his planned goals (e.g. visiting all stations on a line in a completely bizarre order to accomodate infrequent trains). The mangaka doesn't really care about trains; she's cynical, sarcastic, and rather lazy (she mainly just looks forward to the next eki-ben); he's completely gung-ho as long as he's following the schedule, and the inevitable conflicts are pretty entertaining. 

Throughout, though, it feels real —if you've travelled by train in Japan it will all seem very familiar, not just the scenery, but also the atmosphere and feel— and the artist does a great job of pacing and applying little tweaks to keep it consistently entertaining. In an additional bit of recursiveness, some of the characters who show up in the manga (who of course are real people, who really did show up) do so because they (really) read previous episodes of the manga! 

In addition of course, you can learn about various out of the way and interesting Japanese train lines and stations; some of them really do look cool. There's always this vague sense of surreality about it however, the trips are all planned by the train-guy (goal: visit all 9,843 stations in Japan) who seems to consider everything as part of a checklist rather than an experience to be enjoyed. You learn a bit about train-otaku culture too; there's really only the one guy in the story, but train-otaku culture is a sort of constant peripheral presence.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates "Tetsuko no Tabi" for its realistic portrayal of train travel in Japan and its unique characters. While some find the lack of traditional plot elements refreshing, others may find it uneventful. The show primarily appeals to those interested in Japanese railways or slice-of-life content, fostering a niche but positive reception.
pros: Captures the real atmosphere of train travel in Japan.
Entertaining depiction of the interactions between the characters.
Informative about obscure and interesting Japanese train lines and stations.
cons: Lack of drama may not appeal to all viewers.
Pacing can be slow at times due to the focus on mundane details.
The 'checklist' approach to travel might not resonate with everyone.
anime.thematic_vibe: Travelogue, Slice of Life, Otaku Culture

anime.title: Jungle Taitei (1989)
anime.synopsis: Leo (a.k.a. Kimba in the U.S.) is a young ambitious lion cub who takes his father's place as emperor of the jungle when is father is killed by poachers. Even though his father's fate was met by the hands of humans, Leo is one of the few animals in the Jungle that doesn't fear or feel hatred toward humans. He is not alone either, he is guided by friends of his father to help create the best animal kingdom there can be.
anime.consensus_summary: The 1989 Jungle Taitei is viewed as a decent but dated adaptation of the manga. While praised for its consistency and faithfulness to the source material, it suffers from outdated visuals and a weak story compared to other anime from the same era.  It is considered a somewhat average show from the 80s and is primarily of interest to those curious about its potential influence on The Lion King.
pros: Consistent plot and themes.
Faithful adaptation of the manga.
Alright art and sound for its time.
cons: Aged poorly compared to other shows of its time.
Art and sound are outdated.
Story is not particularly strong.

anime.title: The Trapp Family Story
anime.synopsis: Based on the same story that produced the classic musical 'The Sound of Music', this is the story of Maria, who leaves her life in a convent to take up the responsibility of taking care of Captain Trapp's children.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Trapp Ikka Monogatari' is viewed as a mellow and sweet family story, particularly appealing to children or those seeking a simple slice-of-life experience. While some find the storyline and characters lacking depth and the animation simplistic, others appreciate its warm feeling, good pacing, and emphasis on family values. There is a general agreement that the show is an easy and enjoyable watch for those in the mood for something light and heartwarming.
pros: Warm feeling throughout the series.
Good pacing that keeps the interest high.
Characters have variety and development.
Great family story with emphasis on family values.
Bright colors and easy on the eyes art style.
cons: Story is simple and lacks real twists.
Repetitive pattern.
Maria's character lacks depth and development.
Art/Music-wise, the show offers nothing much.
Animation is saving frames whenever possible.

anime.title: Little Women II: Jo's Boys
anime.synopsis: Nan Harding is the new student at Mr. and Mrs. Bhaer's school. Everyone thinks that she is a pain in the head, but not Mrs. Jo. Together with the other kids, they all embark on their personal adventures and misfortunes while learning in school.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the show enjoyable as a standalone slice-of-life story, while others are disappointed by its departure from the original 'Little Women' narrative and characterizations. Some appreciate the show's optimistic themes and cozy setting. The lack of character development and skipped content from the source material are major points of criticism.
pros: The show attempts to teach children to have a love of learning and to bring out their full potential.
The show is set in a pleasant New England countryside setting around the turn of the century.
The show includes mature topics regarding poverty and sexism in an era before women could vote.
cons: The show skips a large amount of content from the original book, feeling detached from the original anime.
The show lacks progression and spends too much time on random slice-of-life episodes, making character development feel scarce.
The transformation of Jo's character feels jarring and inconsistent with her original portrayal.

anime.title: Romeo's Blue Skies
anime.synopsis:
Romeo is a kindhearted and courageous boy living with his family in a small village in Switzerland. Unfortunately, Romeo becomes the interest of a man named Luini, known as "The God of Death," who is infamous for buying children and selling them as chimney sweeps in Milan. While visiting the village, Luini burns down Romeo's family cornfield in an attempt to have Romeo as his own. With the cornfield gone and his father sustaining a head injury trying to put out the fire, Romeo bravely sells himself to the God of Death in order to help his family afford a doctor. 

On his way to Milan, Romeo meets a boy named Alfredo Martini and they quickly become friends. Just as Alfredo is sold to a different master, the two boys swear eternal friendship and vow to meet again. As a chimney sweep, Romeo faces many hardships and abuse, especially from his master's family and a gang known as the Wolf Pack. But after reuniting with Alfredo, the two form a fraternity of chimney sweeps called "The Black Brothers," who will learn to fight against the Wolf Pack and help each other in times of need.
anime.consensus_summary: Romeo no Aoi Sora is a well-regarded anime that resonates with viewers due to its heartfelt story, likable characters, and exploration of themes such as friendship and resilience. While some find the pacing slow and the ending rushed, the series is generally praised for its emotional depth and beautiful art. Many consider it a timeless classic that leaves a lasting impression.
pros: Heartwarming story with themes of friendship, solidarity, and resilience.
Likable characters with good development and realistic portrayal.
Beautiful background art and fitting music that enhances the emotional impact.
cons: Pacing can be slow at times, especially in the beginning.
Some narration is too blunt and doesn't leave enough to interpretation.
Rushed ending due to the show being cut short, impacting plot quality.
anime.thematic_vibe: Historical Drama, Slice of Life, Coming-of-Age

anime.title: The Flowers of Hard Blood
anime.synopsis:
Defying the odds, middle school student Shion Yasuoka is becoming a rising star of the professional shogi world. Despite losing her family at a young age and being unable to speak due to the trauma, in her loving adoptive family and at the shogi association, she has found the necessary emotional support to move on with her life and very demanding career.

Her talent attracts the attention of Satoru Hani, a successful businessman and brother of the current "Meijin"—the title given to the defending champion of Japan's most prestigious shogi tournament. He decides to organize a tournament open to both men and women, including professional and amateur players, and urges Shion to participate in the competition. However, Satoru seems to know a lot about Shion's troubled past, and his actions bring suspicion from Shion's friend Ayumi Saitou and the police—who are still investigating the death of Shion's loved ones.

As the end of Satoru's tournament approaches, Shion starts remembering events related to the night when she lost everything and will have to show her mental fortitude to defeat her opponents and foil the plans of the culprits who ruined her life.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Shion no Ou is well-received as a compelling mystery anime with a unique blend of shogi and crime drama. Viewers appreciate the strong character development, particularly Shion's, and the suspenseful storyline. Criticisms focus on animation inconsistencies and a somewhat weak resolution to the central mystery, but the series is generally considered a worthwhile watch, even for those unfamiliar with shogi.
pros: Well-constructed mystery with twists and turns.
Strong character development, particularly for Shion.
Effective integration of shogi into the plot, even for viewers unfamiliar with the game.
High emotional impact and engaging storytelling.
Excellent soundtrack that enhances the atmosphere.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality.
Weak motivation and execution of the killer's reveal.
Pacing issues, with some feeling the story is unnecessarily elongated.
Underdeveloped secondary characters in the latter half of the series.
Predictable shogi match outcomes.

anime.title: Aria the OVA: Arietta
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Akari Mizunashi dreams of life after attaining her goal of becoming a Prima Undine, but upon waking realizes that she might not actually have the confidence to run Aria Company on her own. Wary of the future, she seeks advice from her mentor Alicia Florence—one of the three great "Water Fairies" of Neo-Venezia.

Much to Akari's surprise, Alicia reveals her own struggles of the past, but also shares the steps she took in overcoming her self-doubt of running the company and taking on an apprentice. Finding solace in her teacher's words, Akari prepares to embrace whatever trials she must overcome on her path toward achieving her dreams.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received as a valuable addition to the Aria series, deepening the characters and themes. While the animation is praised, some stylistic choices and Akari's characterization received critique. The story resonated with fans, providing closure and enhancing the overall experience of the franchise, despite minor issues.
pros: Excellent animation quality with rich textures and attention to detail, even surpassing previous seasons.
Story effectively explores themes of self-doubt and growth, fitting well within the series.
Well-integrated characters contribute to a heartwarming and satisfying narrative.
cons: Some viewers found the character designs, particularly the faces, to be disproportionate and distracting.
The opening song was criticized for not fitting the established sound of the series.
Some felt that Akari's sudden shift to being 'emo' was out of character.

anime.title: Code-E
anime.synopsis: Chinami Ebihara is girl with a strange ability to generate electromagnetic waves when her emotions run high. However, since this "ability" affects anything electrical, it resulted in her having to transfer from school to school when she was younger. As Chinami, now 18 years of age, transfers to a new school, she once again affects the electronic devices in the school, but this time, when another student, Kotaro Kannagi, sees her do this, he becomes obsessed in studying her "TYPE-E" ability.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Code-E is largely negative, with many viewers finding the plot confusing and the characters underdeveloped. While some appreciate the art style and premise, the overall execution is considered poor.  The series is criticized for its lack of explanation and nonsensical story elements, leading to a frustrating viewing experience for many.
pros: Art and animation are well-executed.
Some viewers find the premise and characters endearing.
Voice acting is generally well-received.
cons: Incoherent plot with many unexplained elements.
Poor character development and unlikeable characters.
Inconsistent and nonsensical music choices.
Weak story that fails to deliver on its potential.

anime.title: The Jungle Book
anime.synopsis: After his parents died, Mowgli is raised by the Wolf Pack of the Seeonee Forest led by Akela and other wild animals such as Bagheera and Baloo. The young boy goes through several heartwarming, bittersweet, and life-threatening adventures as he seeks after his true purpose in life. And one of many dangers he has to face is the man-eating tiger, Shere Khan...
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received, particularly for its heartwarming story about Mowgli's growth and his relationships with animal friends. While some episodes may be less engaging, the series offers a meaningful narrative and character development. It is considered a decent watch, especially for those interested in a faithful adaptation of The Jungle Book.
pros: Story about growing up and maturing
Exploration of friendship and loyalty
Characters with strong development arcs (Mowgli, Lala, Luri)
Faithful adaptation of Rudyard Kipling's novel
Meaningful story with a real ending
cons: Inconsistent episode quality
May appeal more to younger fans

anime.title: The Mischevious Twins
anime.romaji_title: Ochame na Futago: Claire Gakuin Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Patricia and Isabel O'Sullivan arrives at the St. Claire, a college for girls, to study and live in the new home. In there place, they meet to Alison, Wella, Catherine and Doris, who live too in the St. Claire, and join with their in the team spirit. All together, the girls play games and fun long time, living in harmony until appears Winfred, a sulky rude and antisocial girl that no will doubt in to create all kind of troubles for the O'Sullivan twins and their friends...
anime.consensus_summary: The first half of the series is well-received for its charming boarding school setting and characters. However, the second half deviates significantly from the source material, leading to disappointment. The shift in setting, character personalities, and story quality contribute to a decline in overall enjoyment.
pros: Charming story about a boarding school in England in the first half of the series
cons: Second half of the series feels like a modern Japanese high school
Character personalities change in the second half
Stories become trite in the second half
Last 12 episodes are original and not from the books

anime.title: Tsukuyomi: Moon Phase Special
anime.synopsis: Omake Special from the final DVD volume. The Special storyline has very little to do with the original series outside of having some of the same characters, and has a completely different storyline which does not fit into anything which came before it.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to the Tsukuyomi: Moon Phase Special is mixed. Some viewers appreciate its lighthearted and silly nature as a departure from the main series' darker tone. However, others find it bizarre, incoherent, and disconnected, ultimately considering it a disappointing addition that doesn't expand on the characters or provide a satisfying conclusion. The special's humor is divisive, with some finding it enjoyable and others missing the charm of the original series.
pros: Offers lighthearted humor and doesn't take itself seriously.
Provides some enjoyable character moments, particularly between Hazuki and Art.
Presents a departure from the dark tone of the main series, which some viewers appreciated.
The characters are funny and likeable.
cons: Storyline is incoherent and bizarre.
The artwork is noticeably different and uses strange techniques.
Feels disconnected from the main series and provides no meaningful closure.
Some found it unfunny and a poor representation of the series' strengths.
Poorly written and unsatisfying ending.
Characters (especially Seiji) feel inconsistent with the main series.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam 00
anime.synopsis:
In the distant future, mankind's dependence on fossil fuels will lead to their complete depletion, an energy crisis unlike anything the world witnessed. Out of retaliation and fear, humanity began focusing at an alternative source of energy: solar power. Different nations have united together to form three major factions—the Union of Solar Energy and Free Nations, the Advanced European Union, and the Human Reform League. Each of these sectors has access to a solar power generator, which gives them limitless energy.
 
As a result, countries that were once dependent on the sale of fossil fuels are now plunged in poverty, leading to years of warfare and internal strife over the control of solar energy. Amid this chaos, an unknown paramilitary organization appeared identifying themselves as "Celestial Being," aspire to end all warfare through armed intervention by using mysterious and technologically advanced Mobile Suits known as Gundams.

Mobile Suit Gundam 00 follows the story of Celestial Being's Gundam Meisters Setsuna F. Seiei, Lockon Stratos, Allelujah Haptism, and Tieria Erde. These four dive into the devastating battle between the three superpowers to accomplish their goal of changing the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Gundam 00 is generally well-received for its fresh art style, engaging political narrative, and morally complex characters. Some find the story convoluted and the character development uneven, particularly in the first season. Despite these criticisms, the series is considered a worthwhile addition to the Gundam franchise, especially for newcomers.
pros: Sleek and detailed art style with fluid animation, especially in mecha battles.
Intriguing story that explores complex political and moral themes.
Well-developed characters with unique backgrounds and motivations.
cons: Story can become convoluted with multiple factions and subplots.
Character development can be slow and uneven.
Some plot points and character deaths feel rushed or arbitrary.

anime.title: Black Cat Special
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Black Cat DVD only episode.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is seen as supplementary material that attempts to clarify plot points and character relationships from the main series. Some find it helpful for understanding Train's backstory, while others consider it confusing and unnecessary, feeling like a plothole fix. Overall, the episode is not highly controversial, with opinions leaning towards mild indifference.
pros: Links parallel events effectively.
Justifies plot points and clarifies character relationships.
Provides insight into Train's past and transformation.
cons: Feels like a plothole anime.
Explanations feel pointless and out of place.
Confusing placement in the timeline of the main story.

anime.title: The Garden of Sinners Chapter 1: Overlooking View
anime.romaji_title: Kara no Kyoukai Movie 1: Fukan Fuukei
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Mystery, Suspense, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
A series of eerily similar suicides occupy newspaper headlines in late '90s Japan. Amidst all the bizarre resemblances, there is one detail that stands out above the rest: the victims have all taken their lives by leaping from the Fujou building, a run-down abandoned structure rising high above the city.

Shiki Ryougi, a cold-hearted girl living in an empty apartment, suspects that these sinister events have a supernatural cause. Possessing a mystical power herself, Shiki works to investigate the incidents alongside Touko Aozaki, a doll-making detective specializing in magic, and her friend Mikiya Kokotou who works as Touko's assistant.

Shiki unravels the mystery as she ventures through an enigmatic world to uncover the dark secrets surrounding the strange phenomenon.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with many praising the visual and auditory elements while criticizing the confusing narrative and underdeveloped characters. Some find the film pretentious and inaccessible, while others are intrigued by the mysteries presented and willing to continue with the series. The lack of clear storytelling and character introductions is a significant point of contention.
pros: Stunning art and animation by Ufotable, with detailed backgrounds and fluid action sequences.
Well-implemented sound effects and music that heighten the atmosphere.
Intriguing premise with potential for character development and exploration of dark themes.
cons: Confusing, non-chronological storytelling that lacks proper exposition and character introductions.
Pretentious and vague dialogue that attempts to sound intelligent but lacks substance.
Weak character development, making it difficult to connect with or care about the main characters.

anime.title: The Piano Forest
anime.genres: Drama, Music, Performing Arts, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Piano no Mori tells the story of Shuuhei Amamiya, a transfer student, and Kai Ichinose, a problem child from the rough areas of town. Upon transferring to Moriwaki Elementary and telling the other kids about his talent for piano, Shuuhei quickly finds himself as the victim of bully Daigaku Kanehira. 

Daigaku dares Shuuhei to find and play a cursed piano in the forest, which leads him to meet Kai, who claims to be the owner of the piano and the only one who can play it. Intrigued, Shuuhei follows Kai to the hidden piano in the forest and listens to him play a beautiful medley.

Earning the respect of not only Shuuhei but school music teacher Sousuke Ajino as well, Kai now finds himself formally learning how to play the piano.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Piano no Mori' is well-received as a heartwarming story about friendship and passion for music. While some appreciate the animation, sound, and character interactions, others find the plot to be somewhat unrealistic and inconsistent. Despite these flaws, the film is generally recommended, especially to fans of classical music and similar anime.
pros: Excellent animation, especially during piano scenes
Good character development and realistic interactions
Sound design excels, especially the music
Heartwarming story about friendship and rivalry
Captures the passion for music effectively
cons: Story feels incomplete, with unresolved plot points
Unrealistic portrayal of musical talent and progress
Some find the narrative too fairy-tale-esque
Inconsistencies in the plot details
anime.thematic_vibe: Friendship, Musical Passion, Prodigy vs. Hard Work

anime.title: D.C.II: Da Capo II
anime.synopsis: The undying Sakura Trees return. Based on a PS2 sequel of the original DaCapo game, the story once again takes place on Hatsunejima, but is set 53 years after the events of D.C. and D.C.S.S.. Although some characters will probably look a bit familiar to the initiated eye, the cast is a new one. The new main protagonist is Yoshiyuki Sakurai, who lives next door to the Asakura sisters Yume and Otome, who are the granddaughters of Junichi and Nemu from the first season.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling the series doesn't live up to the original Da Capo. Some appreciate the pleasant experience and character designs, while others criticize the weak storyline and unfocused narrative. There's a sense that the series tries to do too much, resulting in a somewhat disappointing experience, although some find it enjoyable despite its flaws.
pros: Pleasant and enjoyable experience with likeable characters.
Visually beautiful with fantastic character designs and lively colors.
Good opening theme and overall sound design.
cons: Story lacks backbone and depth, with predictable events.
Characters resemble their ancestors too closely, with some being unnecessary.
Story tries to fit too many themes, resulting in a messy and unfocused narrative.
The shift in topic from relationships to robots was handled poorly.

anime.title: Ghost Hound
anime.synopsis:
Strange things are happening around the town of Suiten. The daughter of a priest begins to see strange visions, spirits have started to roam the mountains, and Tarou Komori is having unsettling dreams. Due to the trauma of being kidnapped 11 years ago, he has repressed most of the memories that could shed light on what really happened. But they return in his sleep, combined with encounters beyond the realm of dreams.
 
As the supernatural and psychological collide, three children struggle to face their demons and repair the breach between the spiritual and corporeal worlds.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are mixed, with praise for the complex story, well-developed characters, and atmospheric presentation. However, some find the plot confusing and slow-paced, with a disappointing ending. The series is recommended for those who enjoy psychological thrillers, but others may find it a waste of time.
pros: Complex and intriguing plot with well-developed characters.
Superb animation quality and creepy sound design enhances atmosphere.
Exploration of psychological and spiritual themes is thought-provoking.
cons: Story can be confusing with a lot of psychological terminology.
Pacing is slow, and the ending may be unsatisfying or rushed.
Some plot threads are left unresolved, leading to a sense of incompleteness.

anime.title: Detective Conan OVA 07: A Challenge from Agasa! Agasa vs. Conan and the Detective Boys
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan OVA 07: Agasa kara no Chousenjou! Agasa vs Conan & Shounen Tanteidan
anime.synopsis: Professor Agasa is kidnapped and the Detective Boys must use clues found at his house and in various parts of the city in order to find him.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is considered a fine but unremarkable entry in the series, particularly suited for completionists. While some viewers appreciate moments featuring Haibara, the overall consensus is that the plot is formulaic, the stakes are low, and the villain's motivations are underdeveloped. The sidelining of Haibara's potential is a recurring frustration.
pros: Appreciated Haibara moments
cons: Anime-original episode that doesn't reach very far
Never get details on what the villain's motivation was
They still sideline Haibara
Mystery was a small stakes-raise

anime.title: Mushi-Uta
anime.synopsis: Mushi-uta's story takes place in the near future. Ten years before the story's opening, strange insect-like creatures known as "Mushi" began appearing. The Mushi are able to consume peoples' dreams and thoughts in return for supernatural powers. At the end of episode one, protagonist Daisuke "Kakkou" Kusuriya encounters a young girl named Shiika Anmoto. The two, in time, become quite close. However, unbeknownst to Kakkou, Shiika is an escapee from a secret prison known as GARDEN where those posessed by the Mushi, known as the Mushitsuki are held. GARDEN's military force, the Special Environmental Conservation Executive Office, dispatches its finest killer to track down Shiika. However, they are faced with resistance from the Mushibane resistance organisation, led by the secretive "Ladybird."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Mushi-Uta are mixed. Many viewers were initially intrigued by the unique premise and engaging character designs. However, the confusing and rushed plot, coupled with underdeveloped characters and a weak ending, ultimately led to disappointment for a significant portion of the audience. The series is considered to have potential that was not fully realized.
pros: Interesting and original concept with the Mushi and their powers.
Good character designs and animation quality, especially for a 2007 anime.
Emotional and fitting soundtrack, with a particularly well-liked ending song.
Strong focus on character relationships and development.
cons: Convoluted and confusing storyline with many plot holes and unanswered questions.
Rushed pacing, especially towards the middle and end, leading to underdeveloped plot points.
Forced and unconvincing romance, often feeling unnecessary and detracting from the main story.
Uneven character development, with some characters feeling superficial or inconsistently written.
Ending is often criticized as being unsatisfying or poorly executed.
Missing explanations and plot devices.

anime.title: Sky Girls
anime.synopsis: In the near future, Earth is at war with aliens called Worms. The war leaves the population of Earth decimated, with young men the main casualties. The Worms were beaten back but their re-emergence heralds the creation of a mecha unit called the Sonic Divers, piloted by 3 young girls to counter this threat.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Sky Girls is generally positive, with viewers appreciating the character development and heartwarming interactions. However, some find the initial pacing slow and the animation dated. The series is considered enjoyable but not revolutionary, with its strength lying in its characters rather than its mecha action or complex plot.
pros: Well-fleshed out characters with realistic and heartwarming interactions.
Complete story with a satisfying ending.
Surprising depth and hidden themes that become apparent as the story progresses.
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the first half, with filler episodes.
Inconsistent animation quality, particularly with CGI elements.
Predictable story with standard plot elements and character archetypes.

anime.title: Sayonara, Zetsubou-Sensei
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Nozomu Itoshiki is a high school teacher so pessimistic that even the smallest of misfortunes can send him into a pit of raging despair; some of these "catastrophes" even lead to suicide attempts. Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei is a satirical slice-of-life comedy set in the modern day, covering various aspects of Japanese life and culture through Nozomu and his interactions with his students: Kiri Komori, a recluse who refuses to leave the school; Abiru Kobushi, an enigma who frequently arrives to class with severe and mysterious injuries; the hyper-optimistic Kafuuka Fuura, Nozomu's polar opposite; and several other unusual girls, all of whom are just as eccentric as their teacher.
anime.consensus_summary: Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei is a polarizing but overall well-regarded satirical comedy. Many appreciate its unique artistic style, sharp wit, and insightful social commentary, though its humor can be inaccessible and repetitive.  The lack of a strong plot and reliance on cultural references are significant drawbacks for some viewers, while others are put off by the occasional uncomfortable content.
pros: Unique and creative animation style by Shaft.
Witty and biting satire of Japanese culture and society.
Catchy and memorable opening and ending themes.
Strong voice acting performances, particularly Hiroshi Kamiya as Nozomu Itoshiki.
cons: Humor heavily reliant on knowledge of Japanese culture, making it inaccessible to some viewers.
Episodic structure with little to no overarching plot.
Repetitive jokes that wear thin over time.
Characters can be one-dimensional and lack development.
Occasional instances of uncomfortable fanservice or sexualization.

anime.title: Wangan Midnight
anime.synopsis:
From dusk until dawn, street racers gather on a Tokyo highway—the Wangan Route—in search of only one thing: speed. Among them, a newcomer attracts the attention of the route's veterans after he purchases a Nissan Fairlady Z, a car infamously nicknamed The Devil Z. The newcomer ignores the warnings of Eriko Asakura, who lost her brother, Akio, in an accident involving the same vehicle. The Devil Z's new owner, who coincidentally shares the exact same name as Eriko's brother, becomes bewitched by the car's mysterious power—even after crashing twice.

Now a high school dropout who works to pay for his car repairs, Akio befriends regular street racers of the area: the legendary owner of the Porsche 911 Turbo, a car known on the streets as "Blackbird;" the genius surgeon Tatsuya Shima; and Reina Akikawa, who works as a model by day and displays unparalleled skill in her Nissan Skyline GT-R by night. Thanks to these connections, Akio manages to find the retired designer of The Devil Z's engine, a solitary man named Jun Kitami. Following his meeting with Akio, Jun resumes building overpowered yet dangerous engines. Meanwhile, the racers of the Wangan Route are caught in a desperate race against The Devil Z with no clear end in sight.
anime.consensus_summary: Wangan Midnight appeals strongly to car enthusiasts with its detailed depiction of tuning and racing culture, but it falls short in narrative depth and character development. Many find the plot repetitive and the characters underdeveloped, leading to a mixed reception. While the sound design and exciting racing scenes are praised, the dated animation and unresolved storylines detract from the overall experience.
pros: Detailed car culture and tuning aspects are well-represented.
Racing scenes are exciting and portray a sense of danger and consequences.
Sound design, especially the car engine sounds, is highly praised.
The anime explores the relationships between people and their cars, as well as the community built around car enthusiasm.
cons: Repetitive plot structure with similar arcs appearing multiple times.
Character development is lacking, with many characters being bland and one-dimensional.
The story often feels unresolved, with plot points left hanging and an abrupt ending.
Animation quality is dated and inconsistent, particularly with 2D character designs.

anime.title: Kakyuusei (TV)
anime.synopsis: When Tsuyoshi rushed to school as usual, he found a girl who tried to help a kitten which couldn't get down from a tree. It was Minamizato Ai who had loved Tsuyoshi secretly for a long time.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Kakyuusei (TV) is viewed as a charming and underrated 90s romance anime, particularly appreciated by fans of the moe genre. While some find the initial fan service off-putting and the soundtrack unremarkable, the art style, proactive main character, and straightforward romance narrative are generally praised. The show is considered a hidden gem, especially for those seeking a classic VN adaptation without excessive harem tropes.
pros: Cute art style, peak of 90s moe animation with consistent quality.
Catchy OP and ED themes.
Main character has a distinct personality and is proactive in relationships.
Good adaptation of a VN/ Dating sim.
Straightforward romance story that pays off in the end.
cons: Soundtrack is not a strong point, background music is unremarkable.
First half has excessive ecchi fan service.
Story can be simple with some misunderstandings.
Backgrounds are ok but not great.

anime.title: Otoboku: Maidens are Falling for Me! Special
anime.romaji_title: Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru Special
anime.synopsis: Special DVD episode combining the storyline of Cinderella and Snow White (chibi style) with the "Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru" cast.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the special to be a hilarious and enjoyable parody.  Fans of the original series especially appreciate the creative use of the characters in a fairy tale setting. Some find the short length a drawback, but overall, the episode is well-received as a comedic encore to the Otoboku series.
pros: Funny and entertaining parody of Cinderella.
Creative use of Otoboku characters in fairy tale roles.
Humorous twists on the Cinderella story.
cons: Requires familiarity with the original Otoboku series to fully appreciate.
Short length may leave viewers wanting more.

anime.title: Ghiblies
anime.synopsis: Two Ghibli created shorts about the happenings in a fictional animation studio, presumably based to some extent on their own.
anime.consensus_summary: Ghiblies is a lighthearted and enjoyable short that offers a glimpse into the workings of Studio Ghibli. While the story is minimal and some find the plot disjointed, the animation and humor are generally well-received. It's particularly appreciated by Ghibli fans and those interested in animation, though its simplicity may not appeal to all adult viewers.
pros: Impressive art, especially in the second episode
Enjoyable project by Studio Ghibli
Accurate portrayal of animation studio life
Good narration
Effective use of sound
cons: Light on story, hardly even is one
Plot is jumbled some of the time
Art does not always match the plot
Inconsistent art appearances
Unanswered questions in the plot
Over-reliance on the past

anime.title: Spider Riders
anime.synopsis:
Underneath the surface of the Earth lies the Inner World, a realm where a war rages on between intelligent spiders and the invading humanoid insects known as Insectors. However, the spiders are not alone, as "Spider Riders"—humans from the Outer World, known as Earthens in the Inner World, that are chosen by the Oracle—fight alongside them. Filled with wondrous tales of a mysterious pyramid and entrusted with his grandfather's journal, a young boy called Hunter Steele sets out on an exploration. There, his destined meeting with the Oracle occurs, and he is transported into the Inner World as a Spider Rider.

Finding himself lost and confused in the middle of a forest, Hunter crosses paths with a giant spider named Shadow. Although reluctant, Shadow agrees to fight by his side. He then meets Corona—a skilled Spider Hunter and kind girl with a penchant for normal life. She shows him the ropes of being a Spider Rider, and educates him about the fate of the Inner World if the Insectors continue their tyrannical reign.

Thus begins the story of Hunter Steele, a heedless young boy on a quest to save the Inner World. But his task of retrieving the four Oracle Keys holding the Oracle's true power will lead him to an ultimate clash against Mantid, leader of the Insectors.
anime.consensus_summary: Spider Riders is viewed as an underloved and underrated adventure fantasy series with a unique story and interesting characters. However, the poor English dub and a weaker second half detract from the overall experience. Fans of the original Japanese version appreciate the show's depth and character development despite its flaws.
pros: Unique and interesting story line with twists and turns.
Great character development and growth.
Imaginative Inner World with unique spider designs and abilities.
cons: Butchered dubbing negatively impacts the viewing experience.
Second half of the series is a disappointment due to executive meddling, leaving mystery and backstory unexplained.
Slow pacing due to Bee Train's involvement.

anime.title: A Dog of Flanders: My Patrasche
anime.romaji_title: Flanders no Inu, Boku no Patrasche
anime.synopsis: A boy named Nello becomes an orphan at the age of two when his mother dies.  His grandfather, who lives in a small village takes him in. One day, Nello finds a dog who was almost beaten to death and named him Patrasche. Due to the good care of his grandfather, the dog recovers, and from then on, Nello and Patrasche are inseparable. Since they are very poor, Nello has to help his grandfather by selling milk. Patrasche helps him pull the milk cart that Nello uses to sell milk in the town.
anime.consensus_summary: Flanders no Inu is overwhelmingly regarded as a classic, albeit a deeply sad one.  Viewers praise its emotional impact and the valuable life lessons it imparts, though its tragic nature can be difficult to bear. Availability and differences from the original are minor points of contention.
pros: Heart-touching story with good lessons
Better art/animation compared to the original
More cohesive story than the original
Better music and voice acting compared to the original
cons: Story is extremely sad and emotionally taxing
Difficult to find a complete and high-quality version
Changes from the original might upset some viewers

anime.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita in the Wan-Nyan Spacetime Odyssey
anime.romaji_title: Doraemon Movie 25: Nobita no Wan Nyan Jikuuden
anime.synopsis:
One day, Nobita finds a stray dog drowning in a river while playing by the river side. Feeling sorry for the dog, he decides to take it home by hiding it in a "kennel on the wall" and names it Ichi (originated from "One", which sounds similar to "wan", the sound a dog makes according to the Japanese language), and secretly feeds it and plays with Ichi with his Kendama to find. Soon after, he also adopts a stray cat named Zubu (or wet in Japanese, due to the discovery of it in a rainstorm)... and many other stray cats and dogs. With so many stray cats and dogs, Nobita, along with his friends, decide to send them back in time, 300 million years ago, where there was no other living beings around. After using the Ray of Evolution to allow them to operate a food-making machine, they depart, with a promise to return to the present.

However, when they try to visit them the next day (from their point of view), they encountered a time-space anomaly, sending them crash landing 1,000 years before their original time-destination— to their surprise, They found out the dogs and cats have evolved enough to form a civilized society that rivaled those of Future Society. As the time machine is broken, they try to find help to repair it so they can continue their chrono-journey, only to learn of a bigger issue — a cluster of asteroids are going to Collide with Earth.

Will Nobita finally reunite with Ichi, as he promised? More over, what's with Hachi, a dog who resembles Ichi greatly? The 300 million years of time and space adventure begins.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a heartwarming and nostalgic conclusion to the original Doraemon series, praised for its animation, voice acting, and touching story. While the plot may be typical, the film offers a satisfying experience and a fitting send-off to the beloved characters and cast. The overall mood is positive, with fans appreciating the film's emotional impact and beautiful presentation.
pros: Beautiful animation and backgrounds, a peak for the 1979 series.
Excellent voice acting, the last with the original cast.
Touching story with cute friendships, especially Nobita's.
Memorable ending theme song.
cons: Movie-special characters are passable but not the best.
Storyline is somewhat typical of the Doraemon series, not too far from the ordinary.

anime.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's New Great Adventure into the Underworld
anime.romaji_title: Doraemon Movie 27: Nobita no Shin Makai Daibouken - 7-nin no Mahoutsukai
anime.synopsis:
Nobita requests of Doraemon the Moshimo-box and wishes for the world to become a place where the use of magic is possible. Witchcraft replaces science and technology and everyone makes use of it on their daily lives, except for Nobita, who, like usual, isn't very good at conjuring spells. Frustrated, he plans on returning things to their past state, but his mother threw the Moshimo-box away. 

One day, Doraemon and his friends meet Professor Mangetsu, who studies magic and magical beings such as goblins, and his daughter Miyoko, and are warned of the dangerous approximation of the "star of the Underworld" to the Earth's orbit. 

With the future of the planet at stake, the group must travel to the Underworld and pierce the heart of the Underworld King with a silver dart, as detailed in the ancient texts of "The Chronicles of the Underworld". Their attempts are, however, thwarted and Miyoko captured. 

Doraemon and his friends then decided to use the Time Machine to return to the past and, using Dorami's Moshimo-box, they manage to restore the Earth. The events on the Underworld continue, however, to take place in a Parallel Universe, where Miyoko is still captive. As a result, the group is once again forced to travel to the Underworld and defeat its tyrannical ruler once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys this Doraemon movie, praising its story, character design, and music. The movie is considered well-executed, with a satisfying ending. It's viewed as enjoyable for both kids and adults, with no significant plot holes or negative feedback mentioned.
pros: Good story that makes sense
Intriguing answers to initially confusing scenes
Different and cool character design
Good side characters
Perfect ending
Good music

anime.title: Tokyo Majin: Second Act
anime.romaji_title: Tokyo Majin Gakuen Kenpuuchou: Tou Dai Ni Maku
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Martial Arts, Mystery, School
anime.synopsis:
The battle against Tendou Kodzunu is over, and the Magami Five begin to look forward to their senior graduation, hopefully planning for their adult futures. However, life in Tokyo is not at peace...

The underground assassin group known as the Twelve Heavenly Generals of the Martial Fist begin to move against those protecting the city from demons. Normally rumored to kill criminals that the mundane law was unable to bring to justice, the Martial Fist now set their sights on Tatsuma Hiyuu, Kyouichi Houraiji, Aoi Misato, Komaki Sakurai, Yuuya Daigo, and Hisui Kisaragi. 

What is the purpose of this cruel turn of events? And who ordered the hit? New threats emerge as others awakened to powers unleashed by the Ryumyaku seek out the Magami kids - and old friends now return as enemies.

Destinies will collide as the Stars of Fate begin to merge; Yin and Yang will meet. And soon the shadowy figure pulling the strings will reveal himself, in an effort to raze Tokyo to the ground and awaken the Vessel of the Golden Dragon.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for action and character development countered by criticisms of rushed pacing and incomplete storytelling. Many find the plot convoluted and unsatisfying, particularly the ending. While some appreciate the darker tone and character focus, others are left confused by unanswered questions.
pros: Great action choreography, especially Tatsuma's fights.
Interesting character developments, particularly secondary characters.
Darker atmosphere that focuses on the emotional impact on characters.
cons: Story progression feels rushed and doesn't fully tie up loose ends.
Inconsistent character depth; some are over-explored while others are neglected.
Ending is abrupt and unfulfilling, lacking a proper resolution to the main battle.

anime.title: Buzzer Beater 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: After being drafted into the Earth Team, a basketball team comprised solely of humans, street-punk-turned-pro Hideyoshi couldn't be more cocky. The team is still up against the Gorons, a physically superior race of aliens who have dominated the game for some time. New challenges and problems stand in their way. Hideyoshi is unhappy with the team and the Gorons have new tricks up their sleeves.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely negative, particularly regarding the first season. While some appreciate the basketball gameplays and improved storyline in the second season, many find the plot ridiculous, the characters unlikeable, and the overall production quality lacking. The show appears to be primarily aimed at a younger audience, limiting its appeal to older viewers.
pros: Good gameplays of basketball in season 2
Well-made story in season 2
cons: Dreadful and unrealistic story, even for anime standards
Pathetic characters; stereotypical and annoying
Poor art quality with conflicting color themes and excessive shadowing
Lack of suspense and excitement in matches
Mediocre art, sound, and story overall

anime.title: Tsubasa RESERVoir CHRoNiCLE: Tokyo Revelations
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Continuing their journey from Record Country (the place that held the book of memories), Syaoran and company land into Tokyo Country, a blood-filled country under war from opposing factions for natural resources and survival. While reluctantly involved in the race to live, the group faces their own problems as certain revelations are made, changing their journey forever.

A shocking betrayal and a battle that risks all of their lives. After this revelation, they will never be the same again.
anime.consensus_summary: The Tsubasa: Tokyo Revelations OVA is generally well-received as a significant improvement over the original anime series, particularly in its animation and faithfulness to the manga's darker storyline. While some criticize the rushed pacing and limited new music, most appreciate the enhanced character development and emotional depth. The series is considered a must-watch for Tsubasa Chronicle fans, despite minor flaws.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to the original series.
Faithful adaptation of the manga's plot and key revelations.
Strong character development and vocal performances.
Effective use of music to enhance dramatic impact.
cons: Rushed pacing, leading to confusion at times.
Limited amount of new music composed for the OVA.
Some censorship and content cuts from the manga.
New art style may not appeal to all fans of the original series.

anime.title: Tree in the Sun
anime.genres: Action, Award Winning, Drama, Historical, Medical, Samurai, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
A story set in the mid-1800's about a young doctor who has been trained in Western-style medicine and a young samurai who is trying to live up to the old traditions of his class and culture. The story is actually based upon real people - the doctor, Ryo-an, was Tezuka's great grandfather.

During the Second Year of Ansei (1855) in Edo's Koishigawa are two young men, Manjiro Ibutani and Ryoan Tezuka. Ibutani is a low-ranking samurai who is a gifted swordsman and has a straightforward and strong sense of justice. Tezuka has a more carefree attitude. He has an eye for the ladies, but he is passionate about becoming a doctor. The two opposite characters come of age during the backdrop of the turbulent end of the Tokugawa Period (1600-1868 CE).
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Hidamari no Ki' is viewed as a thoughtfully crafted historical drama with strong characters and a compelling narrative, set against the backdrop of a transforming Japan. While some find the pacing slow and the themes familiar, many appreciate its detailed animation, evocative music, and respectful portrayal of historical events. Despite some problematic content, viewers find the series to be a hidden gem worth watching.
pros: Strong character development, particularly the contrast and growth of the two leads.
Accurate and respectful depiction of historical events and the transition of Japan during the end of the Tokugawa Shogunate.
Beautiful and detailed animation, especially the backgrounds and character designs, characteristic of the cel era.
Evocative and well-integrated orchestral music, enhancing emotional moments.
Exploration of complex themes such as cultural change, personal beliefs, and class struggle.
cons: Pacing may be slow for modern audiences used to faster narratives.
Some characters are underdeveloped and their arcs are left unresolved.
Thematic elements, while well-executed, may feel familiar due to similarities with other historical fiction works.
The endings being rock songs, a tonal mismatch
Instances of sexual abuse are depicted, which some viewers may find disturbing or unnecessary.

anime.title: Space Pirate Mito
anime.synopsis: Mito isn't just another space pirate, she's a three foot tall childlike alien with enough guts to outshine a supernova. She's known as the galaxy's most dangerous pirate, a wanted criminal who destroys a dozen police space cruisers every day before breakfast. But all she really wants is to be called "Mom."
anime.consensus_summary: Uchuu Kaizoku Mito no Daibouken is a charming and wholesome sci-fi comedy that emphasizes family bonds and acceptance. While some find the humor inconsistent and the serious moments lacking, the show is generally well-regarded for its good acting, music, and creative animation. It is considered a feel-good series suitable for family viewing, with a few dated design choices.
pros: Good acting, especially Kawakami Tomoko
Excellent music composition by Itou Masumi
Wholesome themes of familial love and acceptance
Creative freedom given to animators and episode directors resulting in cinematic feel
cons: Inconsistent comedy, ranging from mundane to great
Serious scenes are weak and undermine the comedic tone
Uninspired alien designs
Questionable character design with potential racial insensitivity
anime.thematic_vibe: Sci-Fi Comedy, Family, Slice of Life

anime.title: Bakukyuu Renpatsu!! Super B-Daman
anime.synopsis: Tamago Tosaka is a fifth-grader who loves nothing more than a B-Daman battle. One day, Ganma Nishibe, a talented bead-warrior, is transferred to Tamago's school. Their B-Daman battles set the stage for this story. Beginning as rivals, the two come together to prepare for the B-Daman championships. The two boys come to trust and help one another as they work toward their shared goal.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience sentiment is positive, driven by nostalgia and childhood memories. The show is seen as a fun, if simplistic, series that primarily appeals to children, especially those interested in the B-Daman toys. There's a desire for a remake to improve the animation quality and make it accessible to a new generation.
pros: Appeals to children with its engaging premise and toy tie-ins.
Opening and ending music are well-received and memorable.
Nostalgia factor for those who watched it as children.
cons: Animation is dated and needs a remake for modern audiences.
Plot may be simple and aimed primarily at children.
The anime is difficult to find and rewatch due to its age.

anime.title: Super YoYo
anime.synopsis:
Despite being talented in various sports, Shunichi Domoto is not passionate about any of them in particular—that is, until he discovers the world of competitive yo-yo.

It all begins when Shunichi's friend, Beso Kimura, loses his yo-yo in a duel against the school bully, Benkei Musashimaru. Albeit inexperienced, Shunichi eventually agrees to help Beso retrieve his yo-yo. After practicing for three days, Shunichi challenges and unexpectedly defeats the relatively skilled Benkei. 

Shunichi's win instills the belief that the yo-yo is easy to master, and that he is ultimately able to easily master anything he puts his mind to. However, after losing to the exceptionally gifted yo-yo player Seito Hojoin, Shinichi finds his ego shattered. As the humiliating loss ignites a spark in Shunichi, he decides to surpass Seito in Japan's national Yo-yo Championship!
anime.consensus_summary: Chousoku Spinner is a nostalgic anime that is enjoyable for its over-the-top nature and comedic elements. While the show may suffer from dated animation, a bad English dub, and filler content, the storyline and interesting characters provide enough entertainment to make it a worthwhile watch. The show is primarily appreciated for its nostalgic value and over-the-top humor.
pros: Storyline has hooks to make you want to watch the next episode.
Characters are rich and interesting.
The show is funny and over the top.
cons: Overdramatic and overexaggerated scenes.
Bad English dub.
Animation could be better due to its age.
Irrelevant filler episodes.

anime.title: Steam Detectives
anime.synopsis: The scene is Steam City, a London-ish city which represents an entire civilization run by coal and steam power. Because of steam, the city is sometimes covered in a mist. Villains take advantage of the steamy mist to hide and execute their evil plans. Only a few dare venture into what's beyond the steamy mist. They are known as the Steam Detectives: Narutaki (and his convertible all-purpose pistol), his nurse-assistant Lingling, and his Megamaton robot Gohliki.
anime.consensus_summary: Steam Detectives is a largely forgotten but enjoyable steampunk detective show with a noir atmosphere. While it may be aimed at a younger audience with a simple plot, it is engaging, has well-developed characters, and a great soundtrack. Most find it a fun watch, especially those who enjoy steampunk themes, though it doesn't particularly stand out.
pros: Atmospheric noir theme
Decent soundtrack with jazzy themes
Well-developed main characters and villains
Respectable animation quality for the 90s
Recurring plot and characters lead to a conclusion
Engaging and makes you want to watch the next episode
cons: Simple characters and plot
Other characters are bland
Episodic nature can be repetitive
Detective work is secondary to action

anime.title: Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go
anime.synopsis:
Based on the manga by Tetsuhiro Koshita, Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go!! has two main seasons evolving around the Go brothers and the TRF Victorys. The third season, Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go!! MAX evolves more around two new main characters, but the primary idea is the same... Racing!

Let's & Go!! focuses on Retsu and Go Seiba, two young brothers who receive racing cars called "Mini 4WD" by Dr. Tsuchia. From there on, the series portraits those two boys, training and customizing parts to later on participate on Japans Cup, where all of Japan's racers enter to be the best of the best!
anime.consensus_summary: The anime holds a special place in the hearts of those who watched it during their childhood, evoking nostalgia and fond memories. However, its simple and repetitive nature might not appeal to older audiences or those seeking more complex narratives. Its impact may also be limited to regions where the related toys were widely available.
pros: Shaped childhoods
Exciting from a child's perspective
cons: Simple and repetitive storyline
Predictable and childish for teens
May not appeal to North American audiences due to lack of toy availability

anime.title: Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go WGP
anime.synopsis:
After the first season, Retsu and Go have now formed a team called "TRF Victorys" which Tokichi Mikuni, J, and Ryo Takaba are part of. Together, they aim for the World Cup.

In this cup, teams from all over the globe enter. Some of the teams are, NA Astrorangers (Americans), Eisen Wolf (Germans), Rosso Estrada (Italians).
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is regarded with nostalgia by those who watched it during their childhood. However, current viewers may not appreciate it due to its old animation and the availability of better alternatives. The show's value is primarily derived from the fond memories it evokes in its original audience.
pros: Brings back childhood memories
Popular in its time
cons: Outdated animation
Better mini racing car series available now

anime.title: Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go MAX
anime.synopsis:
The story follows the life of Retsuya and Gouki, two brothers with the same objective as Go and Retsu, to race and win championships!

The two new brothers are faced with various traps set by an evil organization...together, along with other friends, they try to enjoy their races as much as possible, showing off their competitive spirit and taking down any kind of evil that might put the sport they love so much at risk!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally feels that Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go MAX is a disappointing season compared to its predecessors. While there are some enjoyable moments, the lack of originality and abundance of filler episodes detract from the overall experience. Most find the plot and characters uninspired, resulting in a generally lukewarm reception.
pros: Some cool racing scenes
Nice moments in the last 2 episodes
cons: Lack of originality in car designs and characters
Too many filler episodes
Repetitive plot elements from previous seasons

anime.title: Rockman.EXE Beast+
anime.synopsis: Beast+ continues from where Beast left off, though it is marketed as a stand-alone series. Episodes are reduced to approximately ten minutes in length, airing in the thirty minute time-slot Oha Coliseum alongside the Saru Getchu anime. Beast+ consists of a string of arcs beginning with the appearance of the Professor and Zero (both from Mega Man Network Transmission).
anime.consensus_summary: Rockman.EXE Beast+ is viewed as a short but enjoyable continuation for fans of the Mega Man franchise. The use of characters from other Mega Man games is appreciated. However, the shortened episode length is a drawback.
pros: Enjoyable for Mega Man fans
Continues story from Beast
Features characters from other Mega Man games
cons: Episodes are shortened to 10 minutes
Character designs have changed

anime.title: Urayasu Tekkin Kazoku
anime.synopsis: Join the madcap adventures of the Osawagi family. Little Kotetsu, arguably the most energetic boy in the town of Urayasu, is always getting into mischief with his band of quirky friends. Features unique, well-drawn characters and fast-paced action and humor.
