pros: Visually stunning animation, especially the dogfight scenes.
Thought-provoking themes and philosophical questions about war, existence, and purpose.
Beautiful and melancholic soundtrack enhances the atmosphere.
cons: Slow pacing and lack of emotional engagement with characters.
Bland or monotone character design and voice acting.
Story can be confusing, predictable, or lacking in clear resolution.

anime.title: xxxHOLiC◆Kei
anime.synopsis:
Kimihiro Watanuki's life was never really normal. But in addition to his ability to see spirits, this sequel to xxxHOLiC finds him still slaving away for Yuuko, the bizarre owner of a strange shop, who promised to rid him of this ability. However, this otherworldly woman can only do so when he has worked enough to earn his wish. Such is the way for anyone who finds their way into the shop to have their request granted: a compensation equal to their wish must be paid. 

In this odd shop that straddles the world of the living and the dead, Watanuki finds himself doing household chores for the seemingly lazy Yuuko and her companions, while also helping out clients. Along with his classmates, supposed romantic rival Shizuka Doumeki and his crush Himawari Kunogi, Watanuki deals with the many misfortunes surrounding Yuuko's customers, as well as those that closely follow him and his friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to xxxHOLiC Kei is generally positive, with many appreciating the shift towards character development and a more cohesive narrative. However, some feel the season suffers from unresolved plot points and inconsistencies. There is disappointment among some viewers with certain character arcs and the underutilization of interesting secondary characters.
pros: Improved character development and focus on relationships.
Stronger sense of continuity and overarching plot compared to the first season.
High-quality animation and fitting soundtrack.
cons: Some plot threads are not fully resolved due to the limited number of episodes.
Inconsistent art quality in everyday scenes.
Repetitive character interactions and predictable plot twists for some viewers.

anime.title: Junjo Romantica
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Boys Love, Comedy, Drama
anime.synopsis:
High school student Misaki Takahashi returns home to see his older brother being fondled by an unknown man. Bewildered by such a sight, Misaki finds out that the stranger is actually Akihiko Usami, a popular novelist and his brother's best friend. With the two of them slowly becoming acquainted, Akihiko ends up as Misaki's private tutor. However, after stumbling upon the author's latest boys-love novel, Misaki becomes uncertain whether or not to trust Akihiko regarding his friendship with the student's brother.

Elsewhere, Hiroki Kamijou, a university teacher of classical literature and Akihiko's friend, is grieving a failed romance. While on the edge of a mental breakdown, he meets student Nowaki Kusama, who wants his help for an upcoming exam. Despite denying Nowaki's request numerous times, Hiroki eventually lends him a hand. As the two get closer, more revelations about the student are made.

Furthermore, when wealthy teenager Shinobu Takatsuki finds out that his older sister has divorced Hiroki's coworker You Miyagi, he immediately wants to date the same man—as he saved Shinobu from a robbery three years prior. Even so, You does not feel the same way and attempts to scare him off. However, the educator soon realizes that Shinobu will do anything for their destined romance.

Junjou Romantica collects three love stories, narrating every couple's romance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized. Many find the series problematic due to its depiction of non-consensual relationships and harmful tropes, while others enjoy it as a humorous, albeit flawed, example of the BL genre. The series elicits strong reactions, with some appreciating its comedic elements and character interactions, but many others condemning its problematic themes and questionable relationship dynamics.
pros: Some found the series cute and humorous, with enjoyable character interactions and comedic moments.
The voice acting and soundtrack were appreciated by some viewers.
A few reviewers found the series entertaining as a guilty pleasure, particularly for fans of the BL genre who enjoy the clichés and over-the-top scenarios.
cons: Many reviewers criticized the problematic themes, including non-consensual acts, sexual harassment, and large age gaps between characters.
Some felt the relationships were unhealthy, forced, and based on power imbalances.
Several reviewers noted the repetitive storyline, stereotypical characters, and poor art style.
Many found the plot weak and the character development lacking, especially in the main couple.

anime.title: Shutsugeki! Machine Robo Rescue
anime.synopsis:
In the future, age is not a factor to determine whether someone can perform a certain task or not, but special talent and training. An organization, Machine Robo Rescue (MRR), was established for robots and children to become partner and rescue people from danger. Then 12 children with various abilities were selected and introduced as part of this program: Robo Rescue! 

Meet Oozora Taiyou, one of the children who were chosen as a part of MRR program. After being late on his first day of training, he went to perform a hot rescue with JETROBO. However, a mysterious Robot from mysterious organization, "The Star"(?), appeared before MRR team to interfere with the rescue. What are the motives of the mysterious organization? And what are their goals? 

Life as one of the children chosen as part of MRR has started for Oozora Taiyou. Bumpy and hard training is just ahead for MRR team in order to protect many people's life!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has a generally positive, nostalgic view of Shutsugeki! Machine Robo Rescue, particularly those who watched it as children. While the story and antagonist are criticized, the show's ability to evoke childhood dreams and its memorable music are highlights. It is considered a simple and enjoyable anime for those seeking a nostalgic experience.
pros: Appeals to childhood imagination and dreams of heroism.
Simple and lovable, enjoyable if you embrace your inner child.
Music, especially the ending theme by Endoh Masaaki, is highly praised.
cons: Antagonist is poorly developed and serves no real purpose.
Story is not particularly complex or deep, consisting of smaller episodic stories.
Animation and art style are not particularly special.

anime.title: Wild Knights Gulkeeva
anime.synopsis: The world we live in is called Earthside in this story. There are the other worlds called Nosfertia, Heavenstia, and Eternalia. When Darknoids from Nosfertia begun invasion to Earthside, Heavenstia sent 3 Animanoids (beast-humans) to prevent it. The lead character Touya had believed that he was a mere human but found he was actually a being of Eternalia. With the help of 3 Animanoids, Touya fights to defend Earthside.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is considered a standard, uninspired entry in the genre. While the animation and voice acting are decent, the plot, characters, and world-building are criticized for being generic and poorly executed. There's mild disagreement as it has some redeeming qualities, but overall it fails to impress.
pros: Solid animation
Good voice acting
cons: Generic and obnoxious main character
Poorly explained world-building
Stereotypical female characters
Uninspired plot

anime.title: F-Zero: GP Legend
anime.synopsis: Rick Wheeler was a police detective who got into a fatal car accident while pursuing the criminal Zoda. He was placed into artificial coldsleep for 150 years. Wheeler is brought back to life by Jody Summer and Dr. Stewart, who work with a group of good racers who try to keep prize money out of the hands of unsavory people like the Dark Million Organization run by Black Shadow and Deathborn.
anime.consensus_summary: The F-Zero anime is generally well-received by fans of the game series, who appreciate its deep story, character development, and nostalgic elements. While some find the early episodes slow and the animation dated, the overall consensus is that it's a worthwhile watch for F-Zero enthusiasts. The show's ability to expand on the game's lore and provide a compelling narrative is a major draw.
pros: Deep story that explains the F-Zero universe.
Excellent character development, especially Captain Falcon.
Nostalgic inclusion of game themes like Big Blue and Mute City.
The story takes such a turn in quality from start till end
Amazing stuff and lore to the pilots and characters
cons: Early episodes are filler and the beginning moves slowly.
Art style may be too dark at times.
Dub quality is not always the best.
Animation is dated
Obvious budget limitations
anime.thematic_vibe: Nostalgic, Futuristic Racing, Good vs Evil

anime.title: Kaze no Naka no Shoujo: Kinpatsu no Jeanie
anime.romaji_title: Kaze no Naka no Shoujo: Kinpatsu no Jeanie
anime.synopsis:
The story begins in a small town, Pennsylvania in 1838. Jeanie MacDowell is a cheerful and beautiful girl with light brown hair. Jeanie enjoys playing the piano and loves taking piano lessons from her mother.

Steven, a good harmonica player, and Bill, a black boy who is very good at playing the banjo, are great friends of Jeanie's. They enjoy playing music together like a small band.

However, Jeanie's happy life changes dramatically after her mother suddenly passes away.

Experiencing many difficulties and learning the importance of life, she decides to devote her life to helping many people suffering from illness.

This series is a highly emotional love story about the relationship between young Stephen Foster, who later becomes a famous composer and author of children's songs, and young Jeanie MacDowell, who becomes Stephen Foster's wife.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is seen as an enjoyable, old-school anime with strong characters, especially Jeanie and Bill. However, a mid-series plot twist and repetitive problems in the latter half diminish the overall experience. Despite these flaws, the show is recommended for those who enjoy classic anime with character-driven narratives.
pros: Strong character development for Jeanie and Bill.
Realistic portrayal of characters with flaws and motivations.
Exploration of social issues relevant to the time period.
cons: Mid-series plot twist detracts from the overall quality.
Repetitive problems in the later episodes.
Less satisfying ending due to repetitive plot elements.

anime.title: Nasu: A Migratory Bird with Suitcase
anime.synopsis: Riding off their success in La Vuelta, Pepe Benengeli and the rest of the Pao Pao Beer team prepare to take on a newly established cycling race in Japan. However, when they receive the news that team member Jean-Louis Chochi's former mentor has died by suicide, their plans are suddenly shrouded in doubt. Struggling with their personal feelings on top of the challenges presented by the new course, the team wonders whether they still have the strength to pedal on.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Nasu: Suitcase no Wataridori", appreciating its drama and realistic animation. However, some find the character development lacking due to the short runtime. Despite its strengths, it doesn't have a particularly unique standout feature, leading to a generally positive but not overwhelmingly enthusiastic reception.
pros: Fluid character animation reminiscent of Ghibli
Beautiful views of cities and green spaces
Interesting drama and introspection
cons: Not enough time to get acquainted with characters
Lacks strong standout elements
Japanese music not prominent despite setting

anime.title: Christopher Columbus
anime.romaji_title: Boukensha: The Man Was from Spain
anime.synopsis:
Christopher Columbus is a man of strong will. His life is full of drama.

Born in Genoa, he realizes his dream of becoming a sailor, dares to search for a new route, and finally reaches his goal, discovering a new land in the process.

Sometimes in desperation, sometimes in excitement, his experiences are truly extraordinary.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime attempts to portray Christopher Columbus's life but is criticized for deviating from historical accuracy and presenting a flawed character. The script is considered weak, leading to inconsistencies and a negative portrayal of Columbus. While the art and sound are appreciated, the storytelling and character development disappoint viewers, ultimately spoiling their perception of the historical figure.
pros: Art is good
Sound is good
cons: Poor story telling
Script is not good and misleading of original Christopher Columbus
Character inconsistencies
Pacing issues

anime.title: Solty Rei: Surechigau Kimochi de, Omoi Au Kokoro de.
anime.romaji_title: Solty Rei: Surechigau Kimochi de, Omoi Au Kokoro de.
anime.synopsis: This is a two part story that happened after Rose moved in to Roy's apartment. During the preparations for Appreciation Day, Solty watches people in the city going about and preparing for the celebration and is confronted with a thought: what is true happiness? While trying to understand happiness and the complexity of human emotions, a young girl who has had a falling out with her mother confronts Solty and Rose asking for their help. "Love Shared" is actually the second half of "Opportunities Missed", while "Opportunities Missed" shows the entire story.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is largely viewed negatively for undermining the original series' ending. Fans feel it's an unnecessary addition that retroactively weakens the impact of the original narrative. There's a general sentiment that the OVA should not exist, as it disrupts the resolution established in the main series.
cons: Unnecessary addition to the original series.
Detracts from the original's strong ending.
Feels out of place within the established narrative.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Sentimental, Interpersonal Drama

anime.title: Hidamari Sketch Specials
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Slice of Life, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis: The four girls at Hidamari apartment complex continue her lives having a good time together. On the first episode of this special, they go together to the pool, and on the second episode Hiro receives a love letter on her locker, who could have sent it?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, viewing the specials as a delightful continuation of the Hidamari Sketch series. Fans appreciate the addition of missing elements and the increased fan service. It's seen as a perfect complement to the original show for those who enjoyed it.
pros: Provides more of the good stuff that is Hidamari Sketch
Completes the slice of life formula with missing settings
Silly one shot jokes are all intact
All of the characters get their fair share of face time
cons: Pure fan service
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Feel-Good, Fan Service

anime.title: Ayakashi
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
As a child, Yuu Kusaka made a vow upon a shooting star that he would stand on the side of justice and defend the weak. However, the death of one of his friends robs him of the desire to live up to that vow, and he turns a blind eye to the misery of others, using the mysterious power he possesses as a means of making money instead of helping those in need. His days of living only for himself continue, until he's forced to fight for his life against another classmate with powers similar to his. He's saved by a mysterious girl named Eimu Yoake, who also has strange powers.

Eimu reveals that his powers stem from a creature known as an Ayakashi, a parasitic being that grants the user special abilities at the price of slowly draining the life of the host. She helps him fully awaken his own. Now aware of the ayakashi he possesses, Yuu must live up to his childhood vow, putting his ayakashi to use and fend off those who would use their own for evil, all while unraveling the mystery behind the death of his friend.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the dark atmosphere, unique power system, and thematic depth. However, many criticize the rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, uninspired battles, and mediocre production quality, leading to disappointment and a sense of wasted potential. Ultimately, the show is seen as watchable but flawed.
pros: Interesting premise with unique power system (Ayakashi)
Aesthetically pleasing animation and soundtrack contribute to a dark atmosphere
Exploration of themes like the price of power, ethics, and sacrifice
cons: Rushed and convoluted plot with pacing problems and lazy writing
Underdeveloped characters with clichéd archetypes and inconsistent motivations
Uninspired and dull battle sequences with poor choreography
Mediocre graphics with blurry visuals and poor animations for its time

anime.title: Time of Eve
anime.synopsis:
In future Japan, in a time when android housekeepers have become commonplace, society strictly abides by the Three Laws of Robotics, which all androids must follow. Under the influence of the Robot Ethics Committee, androids are treated the same way as lesser technology, such as household appliances. However, a minority with an adoration for androids exists, categorized as "android-holics," and are shunned by the general public.

Rikuo Sakisaka was raised to accept society's precept about androids, and is perfectly aware that they are not human. That is, until the day he discovers a strange message buried within the activity logs of his household android, Sammy. This leads him to Eve no Jikan, a cafe with only one rule that its patrons must adhere to: there must be no distinction made between humans and androids. Curiosity drives Rikuo to learn more about the shop, and he attempts to unearth the reason behind Sammy's peculiar behavior.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Eve no Jikan' for its thought-provoking themes, strong character interactions, and unique visual style. While some find the short runtime limiting, leading to underdeveloped characters and unresolved plot points, most agree that it is a worthwhile and emotionally engaging experience. The series excels in exploring the nuances of human-android relationships, prompting viewers to contemplate the essence of consciousness and equality.
pros: Excellent character development despite short runtime
Striking visuals and unique camerawork enhance the atmosphere
Exploration of complex themes like discrimination and identity
Well-integrated CGI and detailed backgrounds
cons: Lack of proper closure and unresolved plot points
Underdeveloped characters due to time constraints
Inconsistent pacing, with some episodes being less engaging
Generic sound design and amateurish sound mix in places

anime.title: Sola Specials
anime.synopsis: DVD-exclusive specials. The first takes place between episode 4 and 5 of the main series and and the second is a prologue to the series leading up to the events on the last day before the beginning of episode 1.
anime.consensus_summary: The Sola Specials OVA is a light and enjoyable addition for fans of the original series, providing a relaxed look at the characters. However, it doesn't offer much substance or character development for those unfamiliar with the main storyline. The first episode is generally favored over the second due to its humor and lightheartedness, but overall, the OVA provides a pleasant if not particularly groundbreaking experience for Sola enthusiasts.
pros: Relaxed and enjoyable for fans of the original series.
Offers a glimpse of the characters in a more normal setting after the intense ending of the TV series.
Art and animation quality is consistent with the original Sola anime.
cons: Doesn't add anything new to the story or characters.
May feel dull if you weren't a big fan of the original series.
Second episode not as funny or engaging as the first.

anime.title: Gandalla: The King of Burning Desert
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Music, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: A dispute between young band members and an unfortunate choice of melody inadverdently draws them all into the demonic horror known as  the desert-god Gandalla.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is appreciated for its unique world and monster designs, but heavily criticized for its convoluted plot, poor animation, and cheap character designs. The ending is particularly unsatisfying. Overall, it's seen as a messy but ambitious project with more flaws than successes.
pros: Creative and unique world-building
Cool monster designs with Lovecraftian elements
Vibrant and colorful visuals with a dreamlike quality
cons: Messy and convoluted plot with unclear rules and unsatisfying ending
Stilted and unprofessional animation with poor perspective
Cheap and lazy character designs resembling old American cartoons

anime.title: Massugu ni Ikou. 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Mametarou is a Crossbreed and this is about his daily activities and the friends he makes with his girlfriend, Hanako.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Massugu ni Ikou. 2nd Season' to be a heartwarming and enjoyable anime, especially for dog lovers. The show's relatability and accurate depiction of dog life are praised. However, some find the drama excessive and the human character designs uninspired.
pros: Relatable experiences for dog owners
Good representation of dog behavior and lifestyles
Upbeat and happy music
Detailed dog animation and art
cons: Overdone drama
Generic human character designs
Unnecessary detail in dog anatomy (butt holes)
Art is pretty standard

anime.title: Fortune Quest
anime.synopsis:
Our story is set in another world, parallel to ours. We meet Pastel, an orphan girl, 18 years old, who lives with a group of adventurers in a small house. Pastel works as a writer and also a "mapper", charting towns, the countryside, rivers and mountains with sketches and illustrations. 

She is highly respected by her friends as her intelligence and honesty are extraordinary. Living in the house with Pastel, we meet Clay, a young swordsman; Trapp, the son of a bandit chieftain; Kitton, literally a working dictionary and a descendant of the Family Kittons; Knoll, a big guy a with tender heart; Whitey, a baby dragon; and Rumy, an infant sorcerer of the tribe "Elf." Together this odd group become involved in many mysterious adventures from treasure hunting, to searching for a missing person, to challenging a riddle, to many more unexpected quests.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Fortune Quest L" is seen as a decent, feel-good adventure anime, particularly for those who enjoy retro anime and RPG-inspired stories. While praised for its character dynamics and engaging adventures, it's criticized for its lack of overarching plot, unsatisfying ending, and limited world-building. Many find it a fun and easy watch, but recommend keeping expectations low due to its mediocrity.
pros: Good character development, with each adventure providing background on the main characters.
Characters are diverse and blend well together.
Plot is engaging and adventures are hooking.
Fun to watch with a comedic aspect and unexpected outcomes.
Characters have good chemistry with each other and receive screen time.
cons: Lacks a main plot to lead to a deeper story beyond travels.
Ending is unsatisfying and lacks closure.
Animation is dated.
World-building and character development are lacking.
New characters appear abruptly and become important to the plot.

anime.title: Saban's Adventures of the Little Mermaid
anime.synopsis: Marina is a mermaid who is in love with Prince Justin, a human prince from a kingdom on the shore. Marina saves Justin when he almost drowns after a chase from a giant Cyclops and a shipwreck attack from a three-headed sea serpent. She then makes a deal with Hedwig the sea witch to become human temporarily to try to win Justin's love. Justin and Marina become close but Justin thinks that Princess Cecily, a human princess, was the one who saved him from drowning and therefore he gets engaged to her. Justin eventually remembers that Marina was the one who saved his life but by then Marina becomes a mermaid again. The two continue to secretly meet and try to find a way to be together while dealing with Hedwig's plans to take over the kingdom, and Cecily's attempts to get Justin to marry her. Marina and Justin are aided by their underwater friends, Winnie the seahorse, Bobo the tropical fish, and Ridley the sea otter. They are also aided by the wizard Anselm and by Chauncey, Justin's page.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views this as a charming children's fairytale with good quality for its budget and era. Strengths lie in its imaginative themes and character backstories, though some find the pacing of the main conflict to be too slow.
pros: Good quality for a low-budget, early 90s anime.
Engaging themes of land vs. sea, magic, and cultural differences.
Interesting character backstories (Seawitch, wizard Anselm).
cons: Pacing issues with the resolution of the main conflict.

anime.title: Tico and Friends
anime.synopsis: Nanami Simpson is a young girl. Her mother dies when she is young, and she goes to live with her father, Scott Simpson, on board a marine research vessel, the Peperonchino. Her father is a marine biologist, and he is in search of a creature known as the glowing whale. When he finds the bones of one of these, he is saddened, and resolves to change his mission toward preserving and caring for the creatures. Nanami befriends an Orca which she names Tico, and she goes swimming with it every day. Eventually, she learns to breathe underwater which astounds her father. Nanami nearly drowns one day, and one of the glowing whales saves her from certain death and returns her to the vessel, where her father finally gets to see it.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Nanatsu no Umi no Tico as a wholesome and adventurous anime, particularly praising its likable characters and engaging story. While some find the animation and music unremarkable, the overall experience is considered charming and enjoyable for viewers of all ages. The show is seen as a positive and heartwarming experience, leaving viewers with a sense of fulfillment.
pros: Intriguing and breath-taking adventure
Lovely story with likable characters
Enjoyable and interesting for both kids and mature viewers
Charming wholesome adventure
cons: Animation is very standard for the time
Character designs are too alike
Opening and ending themes are rather forgettable

anime.title: Winter Days
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the artistic ambition and standout segments, particularly Norstein's. However, the anthology format leads to inconsistency, with many finding the overall experience uneven and forgettable. The film is recommended primarily for those interested in experimental animation and the works of specific directors involved.
pros: Beautiful artwork and flow
Interesting animation styles and techniques
Challenging transformation of haiku into image and sound
cons: Irregular quality due to multiple directors
Contrived premise and restrictive form
Many segments are forgettable or insulting

anime.title: Gakuen Utopia Manabi Straight!: Natsu da! Manabi da! Kyouka Gasshuku da!
anime.romaji_title: Gakuen Utopia Manabi Straight!: Natsu da! Manabi da! Kyouka Gasshuku da!
anime.synopsis: This episode takes place before the actual planning of the School Fair and shows how the girls spend their summer holidays.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys this special episode, finding it a worthwhile extension of the original series. It reinforces the themes of friendship and the value of high school experiences. While not essential to the main plot, it provides enjoyable character interactions and thoughtful reflections.
pros: Fleshes out the series' themes about the purpose of high school.
Enjoyable character interactions and dynamics.
Explores different perspectives on life paths and experiences.
cons: Characters don't change much.
The special is not essential to the central storyline of the series.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Friendship, Reflection on Youth

anime.title: Minami-ke Okawari
anime.synopsis: A new year has started, and the three Minami sisters—Haruka, Kana, and Chiaki—are still living together without adult supervision. As the seasons pass, the girls continue to make friends and find new interests. No matter where they are or who they hang out with, the sisters' time remains ever vibrant.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Minami-ke Okawari is mixed, with many feeling it doesn't live up to the first season's standard. While some appreciate the improved animation, others find the change in art style and decreased humor disappointing. The increased fanservice is a point of contention, and the overall consensus is that the season is watchable but not as enjoyable as its predecessor. Some viewers even suggest skipping this season entirely.
pros: Better animation quality compared to the first season, with more detailed backgrounds and varied settings.
Enjoyable and simple humor that is characteristic of the Minami-ke series.
The voice actors remain the same, maintaining character consistency.
cons: Significant change in art style that some viewers found displeasing compared to the original.
A decline in wit and humor compared to the first season, with missed opportunities for jokes.
Increased fanservice that felt unnecessary and detracted from the comedic focus.
The opening theme did not fit the tone of the series.
Some characters, like Kana, became irritating due to changes in storytelling.

anime.title: Major S4
anime.synopsis:
Having finished high school, Gorou Honda sets his sights on becoming a professional baseball player. His dreams are much more ambitious than becoming a Japanese Baseball League player, so he instead decides to move to the birthplace of his beloved sport, America, in order to play in the Major League.

However, Gorou finds that the Major League players are much faster, stronger, and more driven than he is. Nonetheless, he is eager to catch up with them. In order to do so, Gorou must first conquer the ranks of the Minor League, where numerous skilled players compete in the grueling rise to the Majors.

Gorou learns that he will have to adapt to the stark differences of American culture and push himself to new extremes as his race to join the Major League begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the focus on character development and team dynamics, while others find the plot inconsistent and the American portrayal stereotypical. The season is seen as a step up from previous ones in terms of audiovisual quality. Overall, it's considered an enjoyable but not exceptional addition to the Major series.
pros: Improved character development, especially Goro's growth and maturity.
Stronger emphasis on team dynamics and the impact of baseball on the community.
Enhanced audiovisual quality compared to previous seasons.
cons: Inconsistent plot with some episodes feeling disconnected from the main storyline.
Stereotypical portrayal of American culture.
Animation still relatively basic compared to other anime series.

anime.title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 3: Kurenai no Tsuki
anime.romaji_title: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 3: Kurenai no Tsuki
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Historical, Isekai, Military, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: Another 100 years has passed since the end the end of Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 2 (200 years after the original anime). In the past that is, very little time has gone by in the future. One day, Kasuga Nozomi encounters a strange boy at her high school, who sends her across time and space to Kyou, a place in another world that bears a strong resemblance to Kyoto towards the end of the Heian period. There, the Minamoto clan ("Genji"), led by Minamoto no Yoritomo, is at war with the Taira clan ("Heike"), led by Taira no Kiyomori. The Heike hope to defeat the Genji by releasing vengeful spirits to disturb the earth`s natural flow of energy and to terrorize the land. The boy is revealed to be the human form of Hakuryuu, the White Dragon God that protects Kyou, who is weakened by the presence of the vengeful spirits. As the Hakuryuu no Miko (Priestess of the White Dragon God), Nozomi allies herself with the Genji because Hakuryuu cannot send her home until his power is restored...
anime.consensus_summary: The anime has potential due to its interesting characters and complex dynamics, but it suffers from being an incomplete adaptation. Viewers are left without a proper beginning or ending, making the viewing experience feel somewhat pointless. The lack of backstory and the gap between this series and its sequel further detract from the overall enjoyment.
pros: Interesting characters
Complex dynamic between friend and foe
No clearly defined right or wrong sides
cons: Incomplete story
Missing backstory
Gap in the plot between the ending of this show and the continuation in the sequel

anime.title: Zoku Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis: More crazy antics abound as Nozomu Itoshiki (a.k.a Zetsubou-sensei), who is the worlds most negative person, tries to teach class 2-F about how life is filled with despair and darkness. A harder task than it first may seem, with his students being far from ordinary themselves, including the likes of the most positive girl he has ever met, his very own stalker, a foreign exchange student with split personalities and a perfectionist acting class president, due to the fact the real class president can't be seen by anyone, among others.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Zoku Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei for its humor, unique style, and satire, especially those familiar with Japanese culture and anime. However, some find the reliance on Japanese-specific jokes alienating, and the excessive randomness and occasional use of fanservice detract from the overall experience. Despite these criticisms, the series is generally well-regarded as a funny and intellectual gag anime.
pros: Excellent continuation of the first season, surpassing it in many ways.
Ingeniously executed and highly entertaining jokes.
Innovative aesthetics and visual style.
Great OPs and EDs that suit the series perfectly.
Unique directing style fits the odd anime well.
Delightful mix of logical gags, nonsense, wordplay, and parody.
Energetic silliness and outstanding voice-over performances.
cons: Many jokes are Japan-specific, making them hard to understand for viewers without knowledge of Japanese culture and history.
Some recurring jokes, like panty shots, become annoying.
Pacing is very high, with so many things on-screen that you have to pause to see them all.
Lacks overarching narrative or character progression.
Excessive random gags that don't seem to have any point.
Unnecessary and excessive insertion of panty shots.

anime.title: They Are My Noble Masters
anime.romaji_title: Kimi ga Aruji de Shitsuji ga Ore de
anime.synopsis:
Based On a Visual Novel developed by Minato Soft.

Due to family troubles, Ren Uesugi and his sister, Mihato, leave their home. They end up moving to the city but find themselves with a lack of money. Somehow they are able to find work in the form of the Kuonji family's mansion, being employed as servants to the three sisters of the Kuonji family: Shinra, Miyu, and Yume. Being a servant also associates Ren with the mansion's additional servants and the Kuonji sisters' friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Kimi ga Aruji de Shitsuji ga Ore de" is viewed as an entertaining ecchi harem anime with notable character development, though it suffers from a weak storyline and excessive fanservice. Some appreciate its humor and lightheartedness, while others find it dull and uninspired compared to similar series. The series is recommended for fans of the genre seeking easy-to-watch content but may not appeal to those looking for depth or originality.
pros: Strong character development for many characters.
Enjoyable for viewers seeking lighthearted entertainment and fan service.
Unique and well-developed characters among the main cast.
cons: Inconsistent storyline with many filler episodes.
Excessive fan service that overshadows the romance and comedy.
Underdeveloped story and reliance on episodic comedy.
Some humor and anime references may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Tower of Druaga: The Aegis of Uruk
anime.romaji_title: Druaga no Tou: The Aegis of Uruk
anime.synopsis: It is said that every few years, there is what's known as the "Summer of Anu."  During that summer, thanks to the divine protection of the sky-god Anu, all of the demons in the tower lose their power.  The country of Uruk has begun an invasion of the tower in order to suppress the demons.  They've built up positions inside the tower, with their sights set on getting to the upper levels.  The Uruk army knows that this is the third Summer of Anu-a perfect time to launch a mission to suppress the monster Druaga once and for all.  The army soldiers aren't the only ones in the tower, though.  An enitre city called Meskia has formed inside the tower's first floor.  It plays host not just to soldiers, but also to adventurers who have heard rumors about a legendary treasure called the Blue Crystal Rod, which is said to rest at the very top of the tower.  With all these different groups in the mix, each with its own agenda, one can only guess how things will play out during this unusual summer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While praised for its animation, initial charm, and comedic moments, the series is heavily criticized for its generic plot, lack of character development, and inconsistent execution. Many feel the show had potential but was ultimately let down by its rushed pacing and conflicting tones. The first season is seen as a setup for a potentially better second season.
pros: Good animation quality, especially backgrounds
Enjoyable comedic episodes
Interesting world setting inspired by RPG elements
Likeable characters initially
Good voice acting and sound design
cons: Generic and predictable storyline
Poor character development
Inconsistent tone, mixing comedy and serious plot poorly
Rushed pacing and underdeveloped plot points due to short episode count
Confusing and disconnected episodes
Unmemorable music
Emotionless face-animation detracts from humour and drama

anime.title: Gunslinger Girl: II Teatrino
anime.synopsis: When the Social Welfare Agency investigates the disappearance of an operative, their inquiry leads them right into the lair of their rival, the Five Republics. The assassin Triela infiltrates the hostile organization, but her search is cut short when she finds herself staring down the barrel of a gun...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is heavily divided regarding Il Teatrino.  Many viewers find the stark contrast in animation quality and art style jarring and detracting from the overall experience. However, some appreciate the deeper exploration of the storyline, character development, and political themes, finding it a worthy successor despite its flaws. The series is appreciated by manga fans, but less so by those expecting a direct continuation of the first season's aesthetic.
pros: Stronger focus on overarching story and political intrigue compared to the first season.
Well-developed characters, including antagonists, with exploration of their motivations and backstories.
Faithful to the manga, offering a different interpretation of events.
Meaningful exploration of characters pasts and beliefs.
cons: Significant downgrade in animation quality and art style compared to the first season.
Overuse of flashbacks that detract from the main storyline.
Inconsistent voice acting and mispronunciation of Italian names.
Generic or lackluster music.
Character personalities feel different and less impactful than in the first season.

anime.title: Armored Trooper Votoms: Pailsen Files
anime.synopsis: OVA release from anime series "Armored Trooper Votoms" utilizing the latest in 3D CG animation. Created by the original staff of the series, with an all new story about the end of the 100 year war.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, primarily due to the dated CGI which significantly detracts from the experience. Fans of the original series appreciate the deeper exploration of the Votoms universe and the complex political narrative. However, the unimpressive visuals and sometimes formulaic plot prevent it from being a universally praised entry in the franchise, resulting in a somewhat polarized view.
pros: Exploration of Chirico's past and Astragius galaxy politics.
Creative and diverse battle sequences.
Multi-layered recontextualization with emphasis on plot and military units.
Consistent writing with political intrigue.
cons: Dated and inconsistent CGI animation quality.
Mediocre story with predictable elements.
Lackluster sound design compared to the original.
Exaggerated and flat character designs.

anime.title: .hack//G.U. Trilogy
anime.synopsis:
Based on the CyberConnect2 HIT GAME, now will be released in a CG Movie!

The Movie will be placed in the storyline of each .hack//G.U. games trilogy. The story follows Haseo, a player in the online MMORPG called The World:R2 at first depicted as a PKK (Player Killer Killer) known as the "Terror of Death", a former member of the disbanded Twilight Brigade guild. Haseo encounters Azure Kite (believing him to be Tri-Edge and blaming him for what happened to Shino) but is hopelessly outmatched. Azure Kite easily defeats Haseo and Data Drains him, reducing his level from 133 to 1 and leaving him without any items, weapons, or member addresses. He is left with a mystery on his hands as to the nature of the Data Drain and why Azure Kite is in possession of such a skill.

Eventually Haseo gains the "Avatar" of Skeith. Acquiring the ability to call Skeith and wield his abilities, such as Data Drain. With Skeith as his strength, Haseo begins the quest for a way to save Shino.

He is seen seeking out a PK (Player Killer) known as Tri-Edge, whose victims supposedly are unable to return to The World after he PKs them. Haseo's friend, Shino, was attacked six months prior to the events of the game by Tri-Edge, and the player herself, Shino Nanao, was left in a coma.
anime.consensus_summary: The .hack//G.U. Trilogy movie is largely considered a disappointment, especially for those unfamiliar with the games. Fans feel the story is rushed and key elements are missing, while newcomers find it confusing and inaccessible. The animation is a bright spot, but it's not enough to overcome the narrative flaws.
pros: Good CGI animation, reminiscent of PS2 era cutscenes.
Spectacular action scenes.
Some enjoyable music tracks, especially remixes.
cons: Poorly adapted story, incomprehensible for newcomers and rushed for fans.
Missing key plot points and character development.
Overly dramatic Japanese voice acting.
Awkward pacing and choppy editing.

anime.title: IGPX: Immortal Grand Prix
anime.synopsis: In the year 2048, people are raving about a fighting race called "Immortal Grand Prix", or IGPX in short, which is faster and more exciting than any of the existing motor sports. The phenomenon is so big that an entire city was built for the racing industry where competitions take place on a huge track. In the "Immortal Grand Prix," two teams of three IG machines, high-tech humanoid mechs driven by humans, race at speeds greater than 400km/h. The teams make three laps of a 60 km course while intercepting the opponent as they vie for a first place finish. The best machine performance, the best pilots and the best teamwork are the only factors that can make them the winners.
anime.consensus_summary: IGPX receives mixed reviews, with some praising its exciting races, animation, and unique soundtrack, while others criticize its simple story, underdeveloped characters, and reliance on sports anime clichés. Many appreciate the blend of action and slice-of-life, but some find the plot and world-building lacking depth. While some consider it underrated and a nostalgic gem, others find it a waste of time due to its weak plot and character development.
pros: Exciting and fast-paced races
Well-animated CGI mecha sequences
Unique soundtrack featuring Ninja Tune artists
Realistic and mature handling of romance
Good balance of action and slice-of-life elements
Strong voice acting cast
cons: Simple and predictable story
Underdeveloped characters
Cliche sports anime tropes
Shallow world-building and sci-fi elements
Lack of depth and substance
Overly blunt dialogue
Unnecessary explanations and banter

anime.title: Daigunder
anime.synopsis: Akira Akebono, a young boy who is competing in a robot tournament where many of the robots are capable of transforming into animal forms. Akira wants to win the ultimate prize, the Titan Belt, with the help of his group of robots, all of which are capable of forming into the robot Daigunder. Daigunder is the creation of Akira's father, Professor Hajime Akebono. Together with a girl named Haruka, they compete under the name of Team Akira. However, Team Akira faces opposition from not only their competition, but a robot named Ginzan who is under the control of the evil Professor Maelstrom.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received, particularly for its characters, story, and battles, making it an enjoyable watch for mecha fans. The animation is a weak point, and the limited availability of later episodes is a drawback. Overall, viewers find it to be a worthwhile PG show with a complete and satisfying story.
pros: Enjoyable characters with distinct personalities.
Engaging story that draws viewers in.
Good battles and mecha action.
Complete story ending.

anime.title: Kinnikuman: Kinnikusei Oui Soudatsu-hen
anime.synopsis: Kinnikuman has proven himself worthy to be crowned the next king of Planet Kinniku. But at the ceremony, five other Kinnikuman's arrive, all claiming to be the true prince of Planet Kinniku. Now, a Royal Survivor Tournament is being held to decide the true successor to the throne, and with the help and support of his friends and with his recently acquired knowledge of the Ultimate Technique (The Muscle Spark), Kinnikuman fights for what is rightfully his.
anime.consensus_summary: The Kinnikuman: Kinnikusei Oui Soudatsu-hen arc is highly praised as one of the best in the series. Viewers appreciate the well-developed characters, emotional depth, and over-the-top action. The strong themes of friendship and teamwork resonate positively, making it a recommended anime.

Dramatic moments with emotional impact.
Violent and over-the-top fight scenes.

anime.title: Skelter Heaven
anime.synopsis: When a mysterious entity suddenly appears in the center of Tokyo, the Alta Mira Agency is tasked to repel the extraterrestrial threat. Otsuya Funagai must guide his all-female unit of "Battle Sole" pilots to take down the strange being no matter the cost. However, his intimate relationship with one of the pilots, Rin Ichikawa, may spell trouble for the team and the mission itself.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is almost universally in agreement that Tenkuu Danzai Skelter+Heaven is an objectively terrible anime, often cited as one of the worst of all time. Critiques overwhelmingly focus on the abysmal animation, nonsensical plot, and offensive CGI, with only a few reviewers finding unintentional humor in its sheer awfulness.

anime.title: Gundam Evolve
anime.synopsis: A series of short films packaged with certain model kits and aired at conventions, the Gundam Evolve series chronicles a number of side-stories, alternative scenes, and even bonus omake from all around the Gundam canon. Featuring a mix of animation media—from traditional cels to 3-D CG rendering to even cel-shaded 2-D animation—these often 3-5 minute shorts cover such events as Domon Kasshu's training (and a bit of a romantic tift with Rain Mikamura) from G Gundam, Amuro Ray battling Quess Paraya from Char's Counterattack, Kamille Bidan training in the Gundam Mk.II from Zeta Gundam, and Canard Pars dueling Prayer Reverie from the Gundam SEED X Astray manga.
anime.consensus_summary: Gundam Evolve is largely considered a shallow compilation of short stories primarily aimed at die-hard fans. Its experimental animation is criticized for inconsistent quality, and the narratives are often underdeveloped and inconsequential. The series is deemed uninteresting and skippable for all but the most completionist Gundam enthusiasts, offering little substance beyond brief action sequences and fan service.
pros: Explores side stories and alternate scenes from various Gundam series.
Features a mix of animation styles, including traditional cel, 3D CG, and cel-shaded 2D.
Offers brief glimpses into character training and conflicts from different Gundam timelines.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with some episodes resembling PlayStation 2 game graphics.
Many episodes lack narrative depth and feel like filler or fan service.
Music is unmemorable and often overshadowed by mecha sound effects.
Episodes are too short to develop characters or tell meaningful stories.
Overall, the series feels rushed, uninteresting, and a waste of time for most viewers.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fan Service, Canon Divergence, Technical Showcase

anime.title: Aria the Origination
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
In the 24th century on the planet Aqua, three girls—Akari Mizunashi, Alice Carroll, and Aika S. Granzchesta—continue to work hard toward achieving their goal of becoming Prima Undines: professional tour guide gondoliers. Luckily, the girls have the guidance of the three best Prima Undines in Neo-Venezia—Alicia Florence, Athena Glory, and Akira E. Ferrari—who are known as the "Water Fairies" in honor of their skill. With their help, the young apprentices train hard and work to overcome any situations that they find themselves in.

As these three young girls experience both the joys and hardships of life, they do their best to improve as tour gondoliers in Neo-Venezia, a terraformed replica of Venice.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's ability to evoke strong emotions and create a relaxing atmosphere.  While some find the pacing slow or the sentimentality excessive, most viewers appreciate the character development, beautiful visuals, and soothing music. Many consider it a masterpiece and a deeply impactful slice-of-life anime.
pros: Strong character development and interactions, particularly in Origination.
Beautiful and memorable musical scores that enhance the atmosphere.
Visually stunning animation and art, with improvements over previous seasons, particularly in widescreen format.
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers.
Episodic nature can feel repetitive or lacking in overarching plot.
Some find the 'healing' atmosphere forced or overly sentimental.

anime.title: Hatenkou Yugi
anime.synopsis:
"See the world"

With these words, Rahzel, the daughter of a rich family, is kicked out of her house and sent on her journey. Along the way she meets up with Heat and Alzeid, two men with very different personalities but very similar journeys. Rahzel is a clever, stubborn, and confident girl, who, with the powers of her magic and mind helps the people she runs into on her journey to discover the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Hatenkou Yuugi are mixed. Many appreciate the unique characters, humor, and episodic adventures, but find the plot disjointed and underdeveloped. Some find the randomness charming, while others find it detrimental, and the series often leaves viewers with unanswered questions, contributing to a divided reception.
pros: Unique and endearing characters, especially Rahzel, who is resourceful and hilarious.
The series has a lovely balance of humor and seriousness.
The changing outfits of Rahzel each episode are interesting and unique.
cons: The story starts without much introduction of characters or a plot.
The plot has a lot of holes, and the plot development could have been better.
The series suffers from a lack of plot, disjointed and episodic.

anime.title: H2O: Footprints in the Sand
anime.synopsis: Takuma Hirose is a blind young male high school student, though the cause for his blindness is undetermined. In order to heal his medical condition, he is sent to live in a village with his uncle. There, he meets several girls, three of which stand out more than any of the others. They are Hayami Kohinata, Hinata Kangura, and Otoha. Otoha temporarily heals his blindness and Hirose uses his sight to help others. He finds out that, for some reason, Hayami Kohinata is hated in the village, and he tries his best to help her out. Meanwhile, many sad secrets unfold in the village...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding the anime emotionally resonant and enjoying its dramatic twists. However, a significant portion of the audience criticizes the show for its predictable plot, poor animation, and shallow characters. The general consensus is that while it has moments of enjoyment, it ultimately fails to live up to its potential due to poor execution and reliance on overused tropes.
pros: The soundtrack is enjoyable, particularly the opening and ending themes, with some memorable piano pieces.
Some viewers found the story engaging and full of unexpected plot twists, evoking a range of emotions.
Several reviewers appreciated the character development, noting that even initially unlikeable characters became compelling.
cons: Many found the story to be cliché-ridden, predictable, and lacking depth, with plot holes and unresolved elements.
The animation quality was criticized as being dated and inconsistent, with noticeable flaws and overuse of CG.
Several reviewers disliked the characters, finding them annoying, underdeveloped, and reliant on tired stereotypes.

anime.title: Dr. Slump
anime.synopsis:
In Penguin Village, humans live alongside talking animals and objects. Senbei Norimaki is one of these humans, and he's an inventor with the lofty dream of creating the world's best robot girl. 

The product of his efforts is Arale, but depending on your definition of perfect, she's anything but! Not only is Arale severely nearsighted, but she also has no common sense! At least she has super-strength, though that often proves to be a setback as well. 

Although she means well, Arale only causes trouble for her neighbors in the whimsical Penguin Village!
anime.consensus_summary: The 90s version of Dr. Slump is generally well-received, particularly for its character-driven comedy and adherence to the series' signature humor. Some viewers may find the episodic format and forgettable music to be drawbacks. While the character design changes might bother some long-time fans, the show generally delivers on the Dr. Slump formula.
pros: Character-driven comedy with memorable and eccentric characters
Enjoyable for fans of gag humor and absurd situations
90s animation style is a positive for fans of that era
cons: Episodic nature can lead to inconsistent enjoyment
OST is forgettable
Character design changes from previous versions may be off-putting to some fans

anime.title: Kikou Keisatsu Metal Jack
anime.synopsis:
Twenty years into the future, a city now called "Tokyo" has developed into one of the few world-class high-tech centers, "Tokyo City." The main character, Ken Kanzaki, is a young investigator assigned to the criminal investigation section of the Metropolital Police. He is one of the finest sharp shooters in the Police.One day, Ken is ordered to provide security for a party held by for "Zaizen Konzern," a world-class plutocracy.

All of a sudden, spector robots appear and distrupt the party. Zaizen, a commander-in-chief, is killed and both Ken and Jun. Zaizen's son,are fatally injured by the robots. Two of the party's guests, an auto-racer, Ryo Aguri,and a wresler, Go Goda, also receive serious injuries. Three severely injured young men are operated upon by scientists from the Metropolitan Police. Several days later, a robot corp led by a mysterious organization called "Ido" appears in the floating-town of the Tokyo Bay. But the Police and the Army have no effective strategies to contain them.

At that moment, three young men attired in mechanical suits enter. They are the very three young men, Ken, Ryo and Go, who have been turned into the cyborg investigators through the operation. They call themselves "Armored Police Metal Jacks". "Metal Jacks," dazzlingly switching from "Jack Suits" to "Jack Armors," completely demolish the robot corp and achieve victory, thus signals the beginning of the battle between the high-tech criminals and "Metal Jacks" with a futuristic "Tokyo City" in the background.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is considered alright, but nothing special.  Fans of the voice actors or 90s anime may find enjoyment. Its episodic nature and stock characters are often cited as weaknesses, preventing it from being a highly recommended show, but the voice acting is a plus.
pros: Enjoyable 90s sound and music.
Voice acting is decent, with some stand out performances, such as Nobutoshi Hayashi/Canna as Ken.
cons: Episodic nature makes it hard to maintain long term interest.
Characters are stock and don't leave much of an impression.

anime.title: Our Home's Fox Deity
anime.genres: Comedy, Magical Sex Shift, Mythology, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: The Mizuchi bloodline has long been hunted by Yokai, or monsters. Toru and Noboru Takagami are descendents of this bloodline, and under their grandmother's discretion, are given a secret weapon to combat these monsters. It is Tenko Kugen, a fox deity who can take the shape of a man or woman at will. The mischievous deity is accompanied by a shrine maiden, Ko, who will both live with the Takagami brothers at their house. Life just got complicated.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, with viewers finding the series enjoyable due to its charming characters, vibrant animation, and entertaining mix of slice-of-life and supernatural elements. However, many are disappointed by the lack of an overarching plot, the episodic nature of the show, and the unresolved character arcs. While the series is considered a lighthearted and fun watch, it ultimately fails to reach its full potential due to these shortcomings.
pros: Enjoyable characters with good screen time and development, especially Kuugen and Kou.
Excellent animation with vibrant colors and well-defined character designs.
Great music, including haunting and melodic scores as well as upbeat opening themes.
Good balance of story, action, slice-of-life, and humor, making each episode entertaining.
cons: Lack of overarching plot and story depth, with many episodes being fillers.
Poor closure, with many loose ends and unresolved character arcs.
Uneven character development, with some important characters not fleshed out enough while others are given too much screen time.
Generic character designs and backgrounds.

anime.title: The Brave Fighter Exkizer
anime.synopsis: When aliens plan to invade Earth, a young boy named Kouta must team up with a giant robot from outer space, Exkaiser, in order to save the world and his friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Yuusha Exkaiser as a nostalgic and fun mecha anime, particularly for its exciting battles and endearing characters. While some find the monster-of-the-week format and repetitive animations tiresome, the overall sentiment is positive, especially among fans of the Yuusha/Brave franchise and those looking for a lighthearted good vs. evil story. It's considered a solid introduction to the series, despite its age and simple narrative.
pros: Exciting battles and transformations
Lovable and funny human characters
Nostalgic and enjoyable soundtrack
Good introduction to the Yuusha/Brave franchise
cons: Formulaic "monster-of-the-week" plot
Repetitive animations and reused scenes
Villains are absurdly incompetent
Some may find it too childish

anime.title: Franz Kafka's A Country Doctor
anime.genres: Avant Garde, Award Winning, Drama, Historical, Psychological
anime.synopsis: A hapless country doctor describes with breathless urgency a night-time summons to attend a young patient. Events soon take on a surreal aspect as "unearthly horses" transport him instantaneously to the bedside. The doctor, preoccupied with personal distractions and grievances against those he is employed to care for, fails to find what is revealed to be a vile, fatal wound. He is humiliated by the villagers, who are "always expecting the impossible from the doctor," and doomed to an endless return trip, losing everything.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reaction is highly divided with Inaka Isha. Some appreciate the film's surreal animation style and eerie atmosphere, considering it a faithful representation of Kafka's work, while others find the story confusing, the characters shallow, and the overall experience pointless and pretentious. Understanding the source material is crucial for enjoyment, but even then, the film's experimental nature may not appeal to all viewers.
pros: The animation style is unique and adds to the weirdness of the story, creating a haunting atmosphere.
The music and sound design are outstanding and contribute to the eerie mood.
The animation sticks close to the text and visually captures the details of the story.
cons: The story is confusing and hard to follow, especially without prior knowledge of the original Kafka story.
The characters lack depth and emotional expression, making it difficult to connect with them.
The film's weirdness feels forced and doesn't contribute to any catharsis or meaning.

anime.title: School Days: Magical Heart Kokoro-chan
anime.synopsis: Originally an April's Fool in 2007, this one episode OVA is a spin-off of the School Days game by 0verflow, and shows Kokoro Katsura, the little sister of one of the main characters, from her other side. A mahou shoujo out to save the world, or something like that.
anime.consensus_summary: This OVA is a polarizing but enjoyable parody for fans of the original School Days, offering a comedic and lewd departure from the grim narrative. While many find it a hilarious breath of fresh air that redeems characters, others find its humor and reliance on prior knowledge alienating. It's a niche product that succeeds for its intended audience by leaning into its absurdity and fanservice.
pros: A hilarious and refreshing change of pace from the original series
Successfully parodies the magical girl genre and other tropes
Redeems some characters and makes them more likable/relatable
Provides fanservice and lewd humor that works for its target audience
Cute art style and character designs
cons: Not funny for those not familiar with or who don't appreciate the humor
Relies heavily on knowledge of the original School Days series
Art and animation are standard, not exceptional
Pacing can feel rushed due to packing a lot into one episode

anime.title: Mikan Enikki
anime.genres: Fantasy, Pets, Shoujo, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: A kitten, abandoned and left for dead along with his siblings, is taken in by Tomu Kusanagi, who nurtures him and discovers that the tangerine cat he so adores is actually a genius who can talk, walk, read, and has even acquired a taste for liquor!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Mikan Enikki for its fun stories and engaging characters. However, some viewers are critical of the anime's divergence from the manga and the unsatisfying ending. Despite these criticisms, the show is well-regarded overall.
pros: Fun and interesting stories
Well-written story
Invested in the anime and its episodes
cons: Anime is loosely based off the manga
Some of the chapters were never adapted into the anime
Some of the characters' personalities have changed
Anime's ending was more of a cup-out ending

anime.title: Kiddy Girl-AND
anime.synopsis:
Twenty-five years after Éclair and Lumière, (from the flagship Kiddy Grade series), rescued the galaxy from destruction's doorstep, the GTO (Galactic Trade Organization), created after the defeat of the GOTT (Galactic Organization of Trade and Tariffs), act on behalf of universal peace by combating criminal activity.

Their special ES division mirrored after the GOTT's ES (Encounter of Shadow-work) force, now includes publicly acknowledged ES member candidates. The series follows two such trainees, Ascoeur and Q-feuille, as they work their way to ES membership.
anime.consensus_summary: Kiddy GiRL-AND is a divisive series, particularly for fans of the original Kiddy Grade. Some viewers appreciate the characters, action, and fan service, while others find it to be a poor imitation with a weak plot and excessive fan service. The series does offer some entertainment value, especially after the initial episodes, but it struggles to escape the shadow of its predecessor.
pros: Great characters (Ascoeur and Q-Feuille)
Decent storyline (especially after episode 12)
Nice animation and sound
Well-done fight scenes
Strong friendship between main characters
Enjoyable filler episodes
cons: Fails to live up to Kiddy Grade
Gratuitous fan service
Weak ending
Lolicon elements
Story takes a while to start

anime.title: Gurren Lagann: There are Some Things I Just Have to See!!
anime.romaji_title: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann: Mitee Mono wa Miteen da!!
anime.synopsis: An uncut version of episode six, involving Kamina's hopes of seeing Yoko and The Black Siblings naked, even at the risk of his friends' safety.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. While some fans appreciate the additional content and humor, others dislike the episode's portrayal of Kamina and the focus on fan service. The episode is generally considered non-essential and doesn't significantly impact the main series' storyline. Some fans consider this episode to be non-canon.
pros: Animation quality is high and consistent with the series.
The OVA provides additional Gurren Lagann content for fans.
Humor and charm of the original series are captured.
cons: The episode changes Kamina's character in a negative way.
Fan service is prioritized over story or character development.
Some find the content unnecessary or detrimental to the overall series.

anime.title: Zombie-Loan
anime.synopsis: The series was originally planned to be 20+ episodes but was cut short due to unknown circumstances. These specials released on the 7th DVD volume continue the story.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is disappointed that Zombie-Loan Specials did not fully realize its potential due to its abbreviated run. They appreciate the unique premise, engaging characters, and overall dark and humorous tone. There is a strong desire for the series to be continued, reflecting a positive but unfulfilled viewing experience.
pros: Original plot with great potential.
Characters are different and funny.
Nice soundtrack, especially the opening and ending themes.
Good art style.
cons: Series was cut short and feels unfinished.
Plot holes due to the limited number of episodes.

anime.title: Kurenai
anime.synopsis:
Shinkurou Kurenai is a 16-year-old student by day and a dispute mediator by night. Though kind-hearted and patient, due to his tragic past, he has trained for years to live on. Now, despite his unimposing appearance, he is a strong martial artist, who also possesses a strange power.

While taking various jobs for his employer, Benika Juuzawa, one assignment leads Shinkurou to live with Murasaki Kuhouin as her bodyguard. Murasaki is the seven-year-old daughter of a plutocratic family, who escaped her home under peculiar circumstances with Benika's help. Commoner life, in her eyes, seems bizarre. However, by interacting with her neighbors, she grows more accustomed to the daily routine, and rids herself of her snobbish behavior, gradually growing attached to Shinkurou.

Though many details of the job remain unclear, Shinkurou still strives to protect the young lady. But to make things more complicated, he also lacks a crucial fact—what is the real threat against Murasaki?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the character dynamics, animation, and genre blending. However, criticisms include inconsistent pacing, underdeveloped supporting characters, and plot contrivances, particularly towards the end. While many found the series enjoyable, some were ultimately disappointed by the execution of the story and action elements.
pros: Strong character development and relationships, especially between Shinkurou and Murasaki.
Visually appealing animation with detailed backgrounds and expressive character designs.
Intriguing blend of genres, offering a mix of comedy, drama, and action.
cons: Inconsistent plot pacing, with meandering mid-series episodes and a rushed conclusion.
Underdeveloped supporting characters and shallow motives.
Some fight scenes appear silly.
Unrealistic and jarring plot points (e.g., a 7-year-old kissing a high schooler).

anime.title: Amatsuki
anime.genres: Action, Historical, Josei, Mythology, Supernatural, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Tokidoki Rikugou is a history-hating student who flunks out of his Japanese History course; his high school forces him to make up for his failed grade by attending a special museum lecture. Its star exhibit, a vast recreation of the Edo Period, promises to alleviate the delinquent student's poor grades with an elaborate simulation of the Tokugawa Shogunate: the Edo Bakumatsu Walking Tour and Exhibition. 

Knowing next to nothing about samurai culture or the times he's walked into, he is quickly surprised to learn of the superstitious nature of Japan during the 1600s. Quickly dismissing the existence of gods and demons, he is shocked when confronted by a demon on a bridge, who attacks the unsuspecting high-schooler. Saved by a mysterious swordsman named Kuchiha, he discovers that he can no longer escape the simulation at the history museum.

Meeting another swordsman named Kon Shinonome, he discovers another contemporary that was trapped in the simulation before him. Quickly adjusting to his new home, Tokidoki must now help protect the village from demons, while uncovering the mystery of both the simulation and the company that created it.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is that "Amatsuki" had great potential due to its interesting premise and world-building, but ultimately fell short due to poor execution. Many felt the story was incomplete and rushed, with underdeveloped characters and a confusing plot. While some appreciated the art and music, the overall feeling is one of disappointment, with many hoping for a second season to resolve the loose ends.
pros: Interesting premise and world-building with potential for a grand story.
Appealing art style with good coloring, shading, and backgrounds.
Enjoyable soundtrack with a great opening theme.
Unique character designs.
cons: Incomplete story with a rushed ending that leaves many questions unanswered.
Poor character development with many characters disappearing or not fully explored.
Slow pacing and confusing plot progression.
Uneven animation quality with occasional distortions.
Overused plot and character archetypes.

anime.title: Real Drive
anime.synopsis:
2061 AD. Fifty years have passed since mankind developed the Network society. It was anticipated that this new infrastructure would realize a utopia where people connected with each other at the level of consciousness. However, new social problems such as personal data leaks and proliferation of manipulated information began to surface. Nevertheless, people still relied on the Network to exchange information, and proved unable to opt to abandon it.

In due course, a new Network realm with more effective security measures was developed. This was called Meta Real Network, usually abbreviated as "the Metal."

The Metal accommodated personal memory data within protected virtual stand-alone organic cyber enclaves called bubble shells and eventually pervaded the everyday lives of people.

However, people gradually learned to release and explode their instincts within the secure environment of the Metal. The unleashed instincts pushed each individual's consciousness to drown in the sea of information and to be exposed to the pressures of desire. Meanwhile, norms and regulations continued to bind their real world lives. Thus, strange friction between the two worlds began to manifest themselves as aberrations beyond the bounds of the imaginable.

Experts who challenged the deep sea of the Metal to investigate and decipher such aberrations were called cyber divers.

This is a story of a cyber diver, Masamichi Haru, who investigates the incidents that lie between Reality and the Metal.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the show's philosophical themes, unique art style, and exploration of technology's impact. Others are turned off by the slow pacing, slice-of-life elements, and perceived lack of character development. While not a universally loved series, it has a dedicated following that appreciates its subtle storytelling and thought-provoking themes.
pros: Exploration of technology's impact on society is well-thought-out and subtle.
Visually stunning with crisp colors, detailed backgrounds, and fluid animation.
Character designs are unique and contribute to the believability of the anime.
The story is evenly paced and advanced accordingly, making the journey well-paced.
cons: Slow start and episodic nature can deter some viewers.
Character development is lacking, with some characters feeling bland.
The Metal's CGI visuals can look clunky compared to the rest of the animation.
The ending may feel abrupt or anticlimactic for some viewers.
Music is sometimes generic and uninspired.

anime.title: Persona: Trinity Soul
anime.genres: Action, Mystery, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: The stage is Ayanagi City, a city near the Japan Sea. It is a futuristic city that was built to carry out the recovery from the calamity caused by the "Apathy Syndrome" ten years previous. High school student Shin Kanzato with his little brother Jun, meet with their elder brother Ryou, who is the chief of the Ayanagi City Police, again after ten years. At that time, a series of strange incidents happen in Ayanagi City such as the crew of a submarine that suddenly disappears while in their submarine, or a spiritless symptom which disturbs the world after ten years, or the case of the inside out corpse where a student took on a cruel appearance. Ryou tracks down the organization behind the string of incidents, and having become involved in the incidents, Shin awakens the "Persona."
anime.consensus_summary: Persona: Trinity Soul receives mixed reviews, particularly from fans of the Persona game series. While praised for its soundtrack, art style, and character-driven narrative, it is heavily criticized for a confusing plot, inconsistencies with the Persona universe, and underwhelming Persona implementation. Many find it a disappointing spin-off that fails to capture the essence of the games.
pros: Great soundtrack with remixes from Persona 3
Beautiful art style and character designs
Focus on character development and emotional depth
cons: Convoluted and confusing plot
Inconsistent storytelling and pacing issues
Underdeveloped Persona designs and battles
Inconsistencies with established Persona lore

anime.title: Japan, Our Homeland
anime.synopsis: It was the spring of 1956, roughly 10 years after the end of the Pacific War. A new teacher named Rieko Sakamoto is assigned to an elementary school in Kiba, downtown Tokyo. At the same time, Shizu Miyanaga, a transfer student from Kobe, joins the class #4 of the 6th grade. Shizu is a bright, pretty girl who dreams to become a singer. Blessed with both athletic and academic abilities, Shizu quickly becomes the center of everyone's attention in the class. Akira, the son of a joiner and also the class president, starts to develop a special feeling for Shizu...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience recognizes the film's ambition in portraying Japan's post-war recovery and the conflict between tradition and progress. However, the sloppy writing, clichéd dialogue, and lack of foreshadowing detract from the overall experience. While the underlying themes are appreciated, the execution is seen as a significant weakness.
pros: Complex symbolism reflecting Japan’s post-war economic development.
Effort made to capture the post-war feeling in the characters and their desires.
cons: Sloppy writing with plot twists lacking foreshadowing.
Pedestrian and clichéd script with unnecessary exposition.
Characters never say anything original or clever.

anime.title: Shoubushi Densetsu Tetsuya
anime.synopsis: In the year 1947, the people of Shinjuku are down on their luck. With little money to buy food or necessities, some resort to gambling in order to survive. Traveling Tetsuya chooses to spend his time at Mahjong parlors where he is wiping the floor clean with his adversaries. However, when Tetsuya meets the intensely skilled Boushu-san, he realizes that his skills are still lacking.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Shoubushi Densetsu Tetsuya' for its mature themes, strategic gameplay, and well-developed characters within the gambling world of post-war Japan. However, enjoyment is heavily dependent on the viewer's understanding of Mahjong. While some find the focus on cheating engaging, others are put off, and the dated art style may deter some viewers.
pros: Clever and well-thought-out cheating strategies make the Mahjong games engaging.
The show features a mature and thrilling storyline with constant skill development and varied game types.
Characters are well-developed and have admirable personalities, adding depth to the narrative.
The setting of post-WWII Japan is very fitting.
The main character grows throughout the show.
cons: The art style is dated.
The show requires pre-existing knowledge of Mahjong to fully understand and enjoy.
Some viewers may find the focus on cheating unappealing.
The ending is an incomplete adaptation.
The animation is average.
anime.thematic_vibe: Gritty Realism, Gambling Thrills, Post-War Ethics

anime.title: Nadia: Secret of Blue Water Specials
anime.romaji_title: Fushigi no Umi no Nadia Omake Gekijou
anime.synopsis: Bonus episodes included on the Laserdisc box release of Nadia that expands on the world of the series. They were later rereleased in the DVD and Blu Ray box sets of the series in Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: The Nadia Omakes are well-received by fans of the original series as a lighthearted and informative extension of the Nadia universe. Viewers appreciate the comedic skits that offer additional insight into the characters and plot. However, they are primarily recommended for those who have already seen the main series due to spoiler content. The omakes serve as enjoyable Easter eggs for dedicated fans rather than a standalone experience.
pros: Expands on the world and characters of the series.
