Provides in-depth information on characters and episodes.
Offers a comedic change of pace from the more serious TV series.
Features the return of the original Japanese voice cast.
cons: The story is minimal and consists of skits.
The music is forgettable.
The art style may appear aged compared to the original series.
Contains spoilers for the main TV series.

anime.title: Bus Gamer
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Mystery, Shounen, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
One day, Toki Mishiba receives a letter in the mail promising him a large sum of money if he participates in a game. Initially dismissing the message, Toki becomes intrigued and decides to sign up after noticing fine print that says players' safety will not be guaranteed. It is not long after that he meets Nobuto Nakajou and Kazuo Saitou—the teammates assigned to him in the "Business Game," also known as "Biz Game."

The members of the trio quickly form a shaky alliance and call themselves "No Name." Bound by nothing but their shared desire for an obscene amount of money, the three step into the dangerous world of the Biz Game, where they must fight against other teams over a data disk containing vital corporate secrets in order to advance and survive.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally disappointed with Bus Gamer due to its extremely short length, which hinders the story and character development. While the premise is intriguing and the action is decent, the lack of closure and rushed execution leave viewers feeling unsatisfied. There's a shared sentiment that the series had potential to be much better if it had been given more episodes to fully flesh out its ideas.
pros: Intriguing premise with potential for development.
Unique character designs.
Enjoyable action despite lack of superpowers.
Good way to spend an hour, leaves you wanting more.
cons: Story feels rushed and unfinished due to only 3 episodes.
Poor character development.
Animation and sound quality are average or below average.
Ending leaves viewers hanging with unanswered questions.
Similarities between characters

anime.title: iDOLM@STER Xenoglossia Specials
anime.synopsis:
Specials bundled with the iDOLM@STER Xenoglossia DVD releases.

Episodes
#1: Izayoi-ryou e Youkoso!
#2: Nantettatte Idol!
#3: Komugiiro no Mermaid
#4: Watashi ga Obasan ni Natte mo
#5: Haru nanoni
#6: Sekaijuu no Dare yori Kitto
#7: SWEET MEMORIES
#8: Itoshisa to Setsunasa to Kokoro Tsuyosa to
#9: Episode 26 epilogue
anime.consensus_summary: The specials are viewed as supplemental content for fans of the main series, offering more character interactions and slice of life moments. The limited animation and short episode lengths are drawbacks, but the content is generally appreciated by those who enjoyed the original show and don't mind fan service. The epilogue is considered too brief but rounds out the story.
pros: Further fleshes out character relationships.
Provides additional lore from the main series.
Offers slice of life engagement with the characters.
cons: Short episodes with varying runtimes.
Visuals primarily consist of photographs with limited animation.
The final episode is too short.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Character Interaction, Fan Service

anime.title: Blassreiter
anime.synopsis:
Modern Germany is plagued by an outbreak of "Amalgams." Existing solely to wreak havoc, these cybernetic entities spawn from rotting flesh and can fuse with technology to gain new abilities. With society left in the wake of their destruction, the Xenogenesis Assault Team (XAT) is formed to suppress the threat. Alongside its primary mission to protect against the Amalgam attacks, the organization is also researching the newly discovered "amalgamated" humans which possess rational thought and are far deadlier than their non-sentient counterparts.

Joseph Jobson is one such amalgamated human who has full control over his powers. Although successful in his line of work as a lone warrior, an unfortunate encounter with the recently-turned-Amalgam Gerd Frentzen makes him a priority target of the XAT. As he eludes the organization and seeks new allies, Joseph is transformed into the Blassreiter—a being heralded as the strongest Amalgam in existence. Now, he must fight back with his newfound powers to uncover the truth behind not only his past, but also the entire Amalgam conflict.
anime.consensus_summary: Blassreiter is a visually interesting anime with a dark and tragic story, but it suffers from inconsistent pacing, overreliance on CGI, and underdeveloped characters. Many viewers found the plot directionless and the ending unsatisfying. While some appreciated the unique amalgam designs and emotional depth, others were turned off by the forced religious symbolism and melodramatic elements.
pros: Interesting story premise with potential.
Well-developed character backstories that add depth.
Unique amalgam designs that reflect character personalities.
Good action sequences and fight choreography.
Soundtrack by Norihiko Hibino
cons: Inconsistent pacing and directionless plot.
Overuse of CGI animation.
Forced religious symbolism and preachy themes.
Melodramatic and overbearing drama.
Underdeveloped and cliché characters.
Poor ending that feels rushed and unsatisfying.

anime.title: Sky Girls Specials
anime.synopsis:
Fishing Maniac Eika-san! Sky Girls Dynamite Fishing!

Special #1: Fierce Battle! Trout Fishing Contest.
Special #2: Big Catch! Mudskipper Fishing!
Special #3: Seashore Battle! Blackfish Fishing!
Special #4: Astonishing! Piranha Fishing!
Special #5: Protect the indigenous species! Bass Fishing Contest! Please finish eating the fish that you've caught!
Special #6: Fish the porgy with prawns, Black Porgy Fishing!
Special #7: The porgy's really tough! Getting poorer by the day! Red tai fishing!
Special #8: Tempura, deep-fried food, and sometimes, skates! Pond smelt fishing on top of ice!
Special #9: There's no part that should be thrown away! Great battle with the whale of the great deep!
anime.consensus_summary: The Sky Girls Specials are well-received as a funny and energetic anime. Its absurd humor and nostalgic art style appeal to viewers looking for lighthearted entertainment. The short runtime and aggressive pacing contribute to its enjoyability.
pros: Funny and entertaining
Charming art style
Aggressive Pacing
cons: Bad Music
Pointless Story
Might not change your life

anime.title: Yawaraka Sangokushi Tsukisase!! Ryofuko-chan
anime.synopsis: Ryofu Housen (Lu Bu) is a powerful general from the Three Kingdoms; alongside Chinkyuu (Chen Gong), Ryofu suddenly finds himself falling to Earth, and landing... in the body of an elementary school student?! With their new lives as flat-chested, women-loving children, Ryofu and Chinkyuu follow their hunger and their desire to get back to their old lives somehow; but it will be difficult, given the variety of obstacles in their way including old enemies, epic monster battles and the most important thing of all, trying to get their hands on Eri-sensei's mammoth F-cup breasts!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Yawaraka Sangokushi Tsukisase!! Ryofuko-chan. Some find the show hilarious due to its shameless parody and absurd humor, particularly praising the male characters. However, others are turned off by the overabundance of fanservice, nonsensical plot, and abrupt ending, leading to frustration and a sense of wasted potential.
pros: Hilarious male characters and their predicaments.
Shameless parody of lolicons and otaku culture.
Enjoyable if you like parody and lolis.
Funny and doesn't take itself seriously.
cons: Overreliance on sexual innuendo and visual jokes.
Plot is nonsensical and rushed.
Ending is abrupt and unsatisfying.
Feels like just nothing but fan service and little children being in adult situations.

anime.title: Jungle no Ouja Tar-chan
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Ta-chan is the king of jungle. He was abandoned in savanna, and has been raised by a chimpanzee, Etekichi. He has a dearest wife, Jane who used to be a top model in New York, but now she looks... Anyway, to protect animals from poachers, Ta-chan is fighting against them with his disciple, Pedro, and a master of Chinese martial arts, Ryo.

This anime is based on the manga with the same title; it begins as a comical parody of Tarzan. The first several episodes are comedies, but the rest of the series consists of (rather) serious episodes.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with "Jungle no Ouja Tar-chan". Many find the humor juvenile, the plot repetitive, and the characters unlikeable. While some appreciate the initial parody and Anabebe's character, the overall sentiment leans negative due to poor writing and character development. The shift to serious arcs is not well-received, and the lack of a compelling narrative makes the anime fall flat for many viewers.
pros: Anabebe's antics and jokes are genuinely funny and entertaining.
The anime starts as a comical parody of Tarzan, which some viewers might find enjoyable.
cons: The plot is largely episodic and lacks an overarching narrative or nemesis.
The comedy relies heavily on childish humor like toilet jokes and perverted situations.
Characters are generally bland and unlikable, with Jane being particularly annoying due to her treatment of Tarzan and constant fat jokes.
The tournament arcs are repetitive and uninteresting.
The art style and character designs are questionable.

anime.title: Sumomomo Momomo: The World's Strongest Bride Specials
anime.romaji_title: Sumomomo Momomo: Chijou Saikyou no Yome Specials
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Martial Arts, Romance, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
DVD episodes 23 and 24.

Based on a seinen manga by Shinobu Ohtaka, serialized in Young Gangan.

Koushi Inuzuka is a smart high school student who aims to become a public prosecutor. Unfortunately for our good guy, he was born into a martial arts family whose head (ie his father) only knows one language: violence. When Koushi was still a baby, his father made a pact with his biggest rival to marry Koushi to his opponent-turned-friend's daughter. The union of the two blood lines is supposed to bring forth Earth's strongest martial arts clan.

Skip forward: Koushi is in high school, oblivious to the marriage arranged for him at his birth. Enter Momoko Kuzuryuu: sugar bomb, airhead, loli martial arts artist and Koushi's self-proclaimed bride (the strongest on Earth, no less). Her wish for sexual intercourse meets with Koushi's square refusal as he has absolutely no desire to get it on with someone who looks like she could be his little sister, not to mention that he doesn't have the foggiest idea who she actually is.

Meanwhile, a war has broken out between the martial arts families. For Koushi, this means that numerous fighters are out to challenge him. As if that weren't bad enough, our protagonist also has a fight phobia due to a traumatic incident that took place in his childhood. Now it's up to Momoko and her superhuman fighting skills to protect her "husband." Will the two sweethearts survive the trials and tribulations ahead of them? More importantly, will Momoko get her way receiving a baby from Koushi?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys these special episodes as lighthearted, entertaining filler. They are seen as a fun addition for fans of the original series, providing a mix of fanservice, humor, and action. However, they are not considered essential viewing due to their lack of plot advancement.
pros: Entertaining filler episodes.
Good mix of fanservice and fighting.
Captures the essence of the original series.
cons: No plot movement.
Episodes are filler and don't add to the main story.
Predictable storylines.

anime.title: Shigofumi: Letters from the Departed
anime.synopsis:
There are some things that people are unable to say while they are alive; for these, there are "shigofumi," letters carried from the world of the dead to the world of the living. When a person with strong emotions dies, they are able to create a shigofumi, whether their feelings are of love, longing, or resentment. It is the quiet and mysterious Fumika's job to deliver these messages from the departed. Along with her talking magic staff Kanaka, she ensures that each shigofumi reaches its intended recipient, even if that person does not want to face its contents.

Fumika witnesses the tragedies of people, both dead and alive, and sees their deepest secrets revealed. What is unclear, however, are the details of Fumika's past. Who was she before she came to be a carrier of shigofumi?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Shigofumi's unique premise and exploration of dark themes like suicide and abuse. However, some find the main character's story weak and the ending unsatisfying. The episodic format receives mixed reactions, with some praising the individual stories and others finding it disjointed.
pros: Well-developed characters, especially in episodic stories.
Thought-provoking exploration of life and death themes.
Unique concept of delivering letters from the dead (Shigofumi).
cons: Inconsistent animation quality in some episodes.
Main plot (Fumika's story) is considered boring or predictable by some.
Ending could have been better developed or more satisfying.

anime.title: The Orphans of Simitra
anime.synopsis: Porfy, his younger sister Mina, and their parents live a humble but happy life in the Grecian countryside. They've just started running a gas station, much to Porphy's joy, and it seems like only good things are in store for their future. However, a huge earthquake changes all that, leaving Porfy without a home or a family -- sans Mina, who seems to have disappeared in the commotion. Now, Porfy is determined to find his sister and be able to live together happily again.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Porphy no Nagai Tabi" is a slow-paced, character-driven anime that focuses on the journey of a young boy and his sister. While the beautiful art and music are appreciated, the slow pacing and simple character designs may not appeal to everyone. The story emphasizes familial love, friendship, and growing up, but the abrupt ending leaves some viewers wanting more.  It's a heartwarming experience for those who enjoy slice-of-life stories and appreciate character development over a fast-paced plot.
pros: Beautiful background art and scenery throughout all 52 episodes.
Soundtrack appropriately enhances the mood, with changes to suit each location.
Character development is gradual and rewarding, allowing viewers to become emotionally attached.
Explores themes of friendship, loss, and growing up in a meaningful way.
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers, potentially leading to impatience and boredom.
Simple character designs contrast with the detailed backgrounds, which may be jarring.
The ending feels abrupt, lacking a proper epilogue to tie up loose ends.
Story is not particularly complex, hints at darker themes are subtle and underdeveloped.
anime.thematic_vibe: Coming-of-age, Familial Love, Slice of Life

anime.title: Super Demon Hero Wataru
anime.synopsis:
After the battle with Doakuder at Soukaizan (the "other" world where the rainbow has disappeared because of the devils), a demon world Devil came to Genseikai (human world) and stole Wataru's conscience. Because of that, Wataru's heart of justice and his memories of being Kyuuseishu (world savior) vanished. After Shibaraku and Himiko brought him back to Shinbukai (the "other" world, where Soukaizan is located), Wataru regained his memories, however his conscience was still missing. To get it back, Kyuuseishu Wataru must return to fight the devils, rescuing all of Soukaizan from catastrophe!

Chou Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru is the 3rd work of the Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru TV series by SUNRISE, and is considered as a "remake" series of the previous Wataru series. It started airing from October 2, 1997, and ended on September 24, 1998, every Thursday from 6:00 to 6:30pm, with a total of 51 episodes.
anime.consensus_summary: Chou Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru is a flawed but enjoyable robot anime with improved visuals and episodic plots. While the first two-thirds of the series are well-received, the latter half suffers from overpowered weaponry, poorly resolved plotlines, and underutilized characters. The series is considered a fan-favorite by some, but others feel it deviates from the original series' spirit.
pros: Improved animation and visual appeal compared to previous series
Well-developed episodic plots with memorable moments and gags
Interesting mech power-ups with varied transformations and unique music
Well-developed and empathetic recurring antagonists
The main trio is at their best, especially Himiko and Shibaraku
cons: Inability to decide whether it wants to be a sequel, reboot, or remake, leading to some inconsistencies
Overpowered Sword-King Ryujinmaru diminishes the challenge and excitement of battles
Underutilization of later Ryujinmaru forms and emotional development arc with Tama
New character Seijyu lacks chemistry and his plotline feels tacked on
Plotlines that last more than an episode are poorly resolved

anime.title: Resident Evil: Degeneration
anime.synopsis: The story is set in autumn 2005, one year after Resident Evil 4 game took place. Due to an as of yet unexplained reason, zombies appear in a United States airport. The release of the zombies leads to danger of an outbreak.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is split, with a strong contingent of dedicated Resident Evil fans appreciating the faithful adaptation and impressive CGI. However, many viewers find the story predictable and lacking in genuine horror, with criticism leveled at the voice acting and character development. While the visuals are praised, the narrative fails to resonate with a broader audience, leading to a "love it or tolerate it" reception.
pros: Visually impressive CGI animation, often described as outstanding and life-like, resembling high-end game cutscenes.
Faithful adaptation of Resident Evil lore and characters, pleasing long-time fans with familiar faces and voice actors.
Realistic and impactful sound effects, including gunfire and explosions.
Decent instrumental music and sound design that fits the horror genre.
The action sequences and fight scenes are generally well-executed and exciting.
cons: The story is considered cliché, predictable, and uninspired, with a lack of originality.
Character development is weak, with some characters feeling underdeveloped or stereotypical.
The voice acting, particularly in the English dub, is often criticized as poor, with lip-sync issues and characters lacking emotional range.
The film struggles to balance action with genuine horror or suspense, often feeling more like a video game cutscene than a compelling movie.
Plot holes and nonsensical elements in the narrative are noted by several reviewers.

anime.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex - Solid State Society: Uchikomatic Days
anime.romaji_title: Koukaku Kidoutai: Stand Alone Complex - Solid State Society - Uchikoma na Hibi
anime.synopsis:
Uchikomatic Days is a 5 minute short telling the story of the birth of the Uchikomas, the 'ugly duckling' second generation think-tanks that made substandard replacement models for the Tachikomas. The short features a music performance by the A.I. Tough Guy Uchikomas, a group of rising stars that will provide entertainment at the Harima City for Academic Research New Year's Eve Party.

This special feature is available on the Ghost in the Shell: S.A.C. Solid State Society DVD.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response is mild. Some find value in the explanation of the Uchikomas and their potential, while others criticize the lack of originality and simplistic visuals. It's generally considered a decent bonus for fans of the original series, but not particularly impactful on its own.
pros: Provides insight into the Uchikomas' origins and potential.
Offers a kind explanation for those that are different.
Catchy song and deeper explanation of the original show's plot.
Good vibe
cons: Background detail is lacking, often mostly white.
Plot is not original; a remake of the 'ugly duckling' story.
Means nothing alone, best seen as a bonus for those that enjoyed the original show

anime.title: The Goddess is a Middle School Student
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, School, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Episodes that were only released on the DVD afterwards and didn't air on TV. Episode numbers: 7.5, 9.5, 10.5, 12.5.
anime.consensus_summary: The Kamichu! Specials are well-received by fans of the original series. Viewers appreciate the enhanced plot progression and writing quality, finding the specials more satisfying than the initial episodes. While the slow pace might not suit all tastes, the series is generally considered a charming and heartwarming experience, offering a refreshing escape from more intense anime genres.
pros: Plot progression is heavier and more satisfying than the original series.
Writing is of higher quality in the specials.
The show offers a refreshing break from more intense anime genres.
The story balances the fantastical and everyday life well.
The animation style adds charm and character.
cons: The slow-paced slice-of-life genre may not appeal to everyone.
The animation style is old.

anime.title: To Love Ru
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Timid 16-year-old Rito Yuuki has yet to profess his love to Haruna Sairenji—a classmate and object of his infatuation since junior high. Sadly, his situation becomes even more challenging when one night, a mysterious, stark-naked girl crash-lands right on top of a bathing Rito.

To add to the confusion, Rito discovers that the girl, Lala Satalin Deviluke, is the crown princess of an alien empire and has run away from her home. Despite her position as the heiress to the most dominant power in the entire galaxy, Lala is surprisingly more than willing to marry the decidedly average Rito in order to avoid an unwanted political marriage.

To LOVE-Ru depicts Rito's daily struggles with the bizarre chaos that begins upon the arrival of Lala. With an evergrowing legion of swooning beauties that continuously foil his attempted confessions to Haruna, To LOVE-Ru  is a romantic comedy full of slapstick humor, sexy girls, and outlandishly lewd moments that defy the laws of physics.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for 'To LOVE-Ru' is mixed. While some appreciate the ecchi comedy, likable characters, and vibrant art style, others are critical of the weak plot, excessive fan service, and repetitive humor. The show is generally considered enjoyable for those who like the ecchi/harem genre, but not recommended for those seeking a strong plot or character development.
pros: Enjoyable and likable characters, particularly Lala.
Funny and entertaining comedy with slapstick and absurd situations.
Vibrant and colorful art style, well-done character designs.
Catchy opening and ending themes, good voice acting.
Some found it a pleasant and uplifting watch, enjoying the fan service and humor.
cons: Weak or non-existent plot, many episodes are filler.
Excessive and gratuitous fan service.
Repetitive jokes and misunderstandings.
Generic and unoriginal characters.
Lack of character development and progression.
Inconsistent humor, with some episodes lacking laughs.

anime.title: Vampire Knight
anime.genres: Drama, Love Polygon, Mystery, Romance, School, Shoujo, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
The cheerful Yuuki Cross and the gruff Zero Kiryuu are members of the disciplinary committee at Cross Academy, which houses two very distinct classes: the Day Class and the Night Class. Their job consists of upholding order between the classes when they switch out. While that may not seem like an especially difficult task, the Day Class is unaware of the truth behind the Night Class—their utterly gorgeous students are vampires.

Ten years ago, Yuuki was saved from a vampire attack by Kaname Kuran, a Pureblood vampire. Now, Kaname is the leader of the Night Class, and Yuuki's disciplinary committee position allows her to see him again, making her feelings for him grow complicated. Meanwhile, Zero bears a white-hot hatred of all vampires and believes they can never live in harmony with humans. But a secret from Zero's past soon threatens the fragile peace of all at the academy, and things may never be the same again.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception is mixed, with many finding the anime disappointing due to its weak plot, characters, and reliance on romantic tropes. While some enjoy it as a guilty pleasure or a form of wish fulfillment, others criticize its lack of depth and poor execution. The series is considered particularly appealing to teenage girls, but less satisfying for those seeking a more complex or action-packed vampire story.
pros: Appealing to teenage girls and those seeking wish fulfillment.
Visually pleasing art style, particularly the bishonen characters.
Soundtrack praised for enhancing the mood, especially the opening theme.
cons: Weak and passive female protagonist (Yuki) who constantly needs rescuing.
Story and plot criticized for being weak, predictable, and failing to deliver on potential.
Characters described as shallow, lacking depth, and relying on overused tropes.
Inconsistent character behavior and unexplained motivations.
Ending is anticlimactic and leaves the story unresolved.

anime.title: A.LI.CE
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2000, Alice Hayashi wins a trip to the moon in a sweepstake. However, when her shuttle launches, something goes terribly wrong, and the next thing she knows, she has crashed somewhere in a frozen wasteland. Before she can get her bearings, strange soldiers begin to attack her, forcing her to flee.

Eventually, Alice meets a young man called Yuan, who tells her that she is in Lapland in the year 2030. The soldiers pursuing her belong to Nero, an enigmatic leader who controls the world through his supercomputer. He is also responsible for reducing the Earth's population by over seven billion. Convinced that Nero has something to do with her time jump, Alice, Yuan, and the android maid Maria journey to Kingdom, the shadowy fortress that Nero rules from.
anime.consensus_summary: A.Li.Ce is widely considered a poorly executed and incomprehensible anime film, plagued by a messy story, dated CGI, and questionable audio. While some find it unintentionally funny and appreciate its historical significance as the first full CGI anime, the majority view it as a significant failure. The film's ambition is evident, but its execution falls short on nearly every level.
pros: Unique historical artifact as the first full CGI anime film.
So bad it's good - entertaining for a 'Friday night watch party'.
Some find the dated CGI charming and appreciate the ambition despite limitations.
cons: Incomprehensible and frustrating story with a muddled moral.
Poorly executed time travel plot with paper-thin characters.
Mediocre PS1-level visuals with ugly character designs and bland environments.
Messy sound design with mismatched audio and cheesy 90s techno music.

anime.title: Kemeko Deluxe!
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
When Sanpeita Kobayashi was a child, his lovely friend had to move away, but she vowed that in ten years, they would meet again—as husband and wife. Ten years later, Sanpeita is a high school student, but he hasn't forgotten the feelings they shared.

Sanpeita awakes from a dream about his last day with her, only to have his morning interrupted. A weird robot girl is battling other robots in his bedroom, claiming to be his wife. The robot's pilot looks like none other than Sanpeita's long-lost, childhood friend. But who is she really? Why did she have to leave? And what does she have to do with the Mishima Electronics Corporation?
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is largely negative, with many finding the anime unfunny, poorly written, and populated with unlikable characters. While some viewers appreciated the art style and found moments of enjoyment, the majority were disappointed by the generic plot, weak humor, and annoying main character. The show is generally not recommended, especially for those seeking sophisticated comedy or a well-developed story.
pros: Some found the anime funny and enjoyable, especially in the beginning.
The opening theme song was praised as fresh and excellent.
Some viewers liked the character designs, particularly the female characters, and appreciated that they weren't stick figures.
cons: Many reviewers found the humor unfunny, mean-spirited, and repetitive.
The story was criticized as being a generic, overused harem plot with plot holes and unresolved elements.
Characters were described as stereotypical, unlikable, and lacking depth, with the main character Kemeko being particularly annoying to many.
The art and animation were considered average or below average, with inconsistencies and ugly male character designs.
The ending was unsatisfying and left the story unfinished.

anime.title: Nagasaki 1945 ~ The Angelus Bells
anime.synopsis: August 1945. In a converted theological seminary on the outskirts of Nagasaki, a young doctor works to help his patients, as unsettling news comes of a new weapon used by the Americans on the city of Hiroshima. When the second nuclear weapon is dropped on Nagasaki, the hospital staff must work to save lives in the midst of the concentric circles of death that their city has become.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience recognizes the film's difficult subject matter, appreciating its focus on the human cost of war and the struggle for hope amidst devastation. While some find certain aspects too optimistic given the circumstances, the overall sentiment is one of respect for the film's portrayal of resilience and the desperate choices people face in times of extreme crisis. The film appears to be mostly well-received, with any criticism being quite mild.
pros: Deals with the realities of war and its aftermath.
Shows the impact of war on people, both physically and psychologically.
Illustrates the battle between hope and hopelessness in a desperate situation.
cons: Some situations felt too positive given the dire circumstances.
Animated nature may detract from the realism of the events.

anime.title: Kino's Journey: Tower Country
anime.romaji_title: Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World - Tou no Kuni - Free Lance
anime.synopsis:
Waking up from a nap, Kino is relieved to see that a certain tower from afar is still proudly standing. Located in the heart of the Tower Country, the immensely tall tower stretches high into the sky, reaching seemingly infinite heights. The tower looks like something out of a dream, but the breathtaking construction is unmistakably real. Intrigued, the traveling partners Kino and Hermes—the talking motorcycle—journey to the tower to get a closer look at the building.

Despite already being unbelievably tall, the tower is still being built by the townspeople to this day. Puzzled by the origins of the tower, Kino and Hermes ask around the town for information, but they fail to obtain any definitive answer. They continue to observe both the tower and the townspeople during their stay, hoping to understand the reasoning behind building a tower that requires so much effort. After all, there is always something to learn—even from the strangest of countries.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the episode as a worthwhile addition to the Kino no Tabi series. They find it thought-provoking and fitting within the show's established themes and atmosphere. However, some feel it is less impactful or exciting compared to other episodes, and its brevity is a minor drawback.
pros: The episode captures the calm and serene atmosphere of Kino no Tabi.
It's a thought-provoking addition to the series.
The episode effectively uses metaphor to explore themes of meaning and purpose.
cons: The ending lacks the usual impactful question.
The energy and excitement are not as high as in other episodes.
The short length is disappointing.

anime.title: Haruka Nogizaka's Secret
anime.synopsis:
Haruka Nogizaka is the most popular student in the prestigious Hakujo Academy, possessing unparalleled beauty, talent, and influence. Unbeknownst to her fellow students, however, she keeps an embarrassing secret of being an otaku—something that can potentially destroy her elegant reputation.

Unfortunately for Haruka, an encounter with the timid Yuuto Ayase in the school library spells the end of her well-kept secret. However, the two reach a mutual agreement with Yuuto promising to keep Haruka's secret, sparking an unexpected friendship between them. Nonetheless, with Haruka's status as the school celebrity and her friendly relationship with Yuuto, both of them are bound to be the subject of gossip everywhere they go!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience generally enjoys 'Nogizaka Haruka no Himitsu' as a lighthearted and entertaining romantic comedy with an otaku twist.  Viewers appreciate the main characters and the series' ability to capture the charm of the romance genre. However, some find the plot and character development to be somewhat generic, and the fan service unnecessary. The anime is best suited for those who enjoy slice-of-life anime and don't mind some predictable elements.
pros: Enjoyable and fun characters, especially Haruka and Yuuto.
Beautiful art and vibrant colors.
Well-executed comedy and references to anime culture.
Heartwarming romance that develops throughout the series.
Unique and interesting plot about Haruka's secret otaku life.
cons: Generic and bland art style in some instances.
Unmemorable or subpar background music.
Lack of significant character development for supporting characters.
Predictable and simplistic story progression.
Forced or excessive fanservice.
Romance lacking progression or substantial problems.
Stereotypical characters.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Comedy, Otaku Culture, Slice of Life

anime.title: Maria Watches Over Us
anime.synopsis: A series of specials included on the Maria-sama ga Miteru DVD releases.
anime.consensus_summary: The Maria-sama ga Miteru Specials are well-received as a lighthearted and humorous take on the main series. The chibi art style and meta-humor are appreciated by fans. The specials are recommended for those who have already watched the main series.
pros: Cute chibi art style
Funny gags and jokes
Quick and easy to watch
cons: Requires familiarity with the main series to understand
Very short episodes

anime.title: Maria Watches Over Us: Printemps
anime.synopsis: Specials of Maria-sama ga Miteru: Haru released on the DVDs only.
anime.consensus_summary: The Maria-sama ga Miteru: Haru Specials are a light-hearted and comedic parody of the original series. The enjoyment of these specials heavily relies on having watched the original series. Some viewers find the humor cheesy, while others appreciate the unique chibi art style and fun parodies.
pros: Fun parody of scenes from the original series
Light and comedic mood
Unique chibi art style
cons: Cheesy scenarios and outtakes
Short episodes
Enjoyment relies on having seen the original series

anime.title: Special A (S.A)
anime.synopsis:
Hikari Hanazono has always been able to do things that normal people cannot. As a child, she assumed no one could beat her—until she met Kei Takishima. Thinking she would win, Hikari challenged him to a match. But things didn’t go as planned; she lost not once but each time she rechallenged him. From that point on, she has sworn to best Kei at everything, ranging from academics to athletics.

To achieve her goal, Hikari enrolls in the same school as Kei—Hakusenkan, a prestigious institute for the wealthy. As a pair, they hold the top two rankings in school and are among seven of the academy's best students in a class known as Special A.

While Hikari treats Kei as a rival, she is completely oblivious that he harbors hidden feelings for her. Together, the members of Special A deal with competition, friendship, and just a bit of love.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Special A" is seen as a decent, enjoyable romantic comedy with likable characters and funny moments. However, the series suffers from a predictable plot, slow romantic progression, and reliance on clichés. It is recommended for fans of the genre looking for a lighthearted watch, but it may not appeal to those seeking originality or depth.
pros: Likable and well-developed characters, each with unique personalities.
Good balance of comedy and romance, with funny and heartwarming moments.
Enjoyable and lighthearted, suitable for fans of the genre.
Animation is decent, with appealing character designs and vibrant environments.
cons: Story can be predictable and rely on clichés.
Main romance progresses slowly, which can be frustrating.
Some viewers may find the female lead's obliviousness annoying.
Inconsistent story with transitions between comedy and drama relying too much on cliches.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Comedy, High School, Slice of Life

anime.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex 2nd GIG - Tachikomatic Days
anime.romaji_title: Koukaku Kidoutai: Stand Alone Complex 2nd GIG - Tachikoma na Hibi
anime.synopsis: Tachikomatic Days is a series of comedic shorts attached to the end of every episode of Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex 2nd GIG. The shorts feature the antics of the Tachikoma think tanks of Section 9 and usually involve plot points. The average short time is a little over a minute.
anime.consensus_summary: The Tachikoma na Hibi shorts are seen as a lighthearted and comedic addition to the 2nd GIG series. While some enjoy the random humor and the antics of the Tachikomas, others find that the shorts detract from the serious and intense nature of the main storyline. The shorts are generally considered a fun extra for fans of the Tachikomas, but their placement after cliffhangers can be jarring.
pros: Fun extra content
Loveable Tachikomas
cons: Takes away from the intensity of the main series
Irritating opening tune
Randomness clashes with serious themes

anime.title: Yuusha Tokkyuu Might Gaine
anime.synopsis:
Nouvelle Tokio City locates on the place where it used to be Tokyo Bay. At the first glance, the prosperous city seems to enjoy its freedom and peace, but the city is suffering from the crimes.

Senpuuji Maito is a perfect 15-year-old boy, bright, handsome, smart, and all-around sportsman. Furthermore, he is the leader of Senpuuji Trading group, and a multimillionaire. He spends his private fortune to found "Brave Express Squad"? which consists of several robots. They are the robots that have various special abilities. Above all, the leader, Gaine, has a super artificial intelligence and has own personality. They can transform into trains. In case of incidents, they will appear anywhere in the world using the highly developed railway system.
anime.consensus_summary: Might Gaine is a generally well-received entry in the Brave Series, praised for its engaging story, great music, and mecha designs. While some find the 'monster of the week' formula and certain villains repetitive or uninspired, the overall experience is enjoyable. The series is considered a strong example of the super robot anime genre, particularly for its combination sequences and character designs.
pros: Great music, especially the combination themes.
Lovable characters and engaging story.
Outstanding mecha designs and smooth animation, especially in combination scenes.
cons: Monster of the week formula can be repetitive.
Main villain is considered disappointing and lacks clear motivation.
Inconsistent art style with character designs varying between episodes.
Some villains, like Catherine Vuitton, are considered annoying.

anime.title: Sisters of Wellber Zwei
anime.romaji_title: Wellber no Monogatari: Sisters of Wellber Zwei
anime.synopsis:
The loquacious sentient tank, Gyrano De Borgerac seems very busy being pampered by solicitous maids. The fairy Sherri, too, is enjoying the luxury of the court's life. And for Rita, time has come to face her duties as princess of Wellber. But Tina is resolute: she wants to continue her search for the Man with a tattoo of Bee the Death, the devil who exterminated her family. An unspeakable feeling of sadness fills the hearts of the two girls, who shared so much and are now about to say farewell to each other.

And then, on the day of Tina's departure...

A new journey that will take Tina walking through the still sore scars of the Great War that wiped out entire cities ten years before, until the unsuspected truth about her nemesis!

Credit: Production I.G ( /www.productionig.com )
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed Wellber no Monogatari: Sisters of Wellber Zwei, finding the characters and their journey compelling. Some found the pacing slow or the melodrama excessive, but the positive aspects, such as the character development and satisfying ending, outweighed the negatives for many viewers. The series is considered underrated and worth watching for those who appreciate character-driven stories.
pros: Strong female leads with good character development.
Enjoyable story with a satisfying ending (for some).
Good animation and music.
cons: Slow pacing.
Melodramatic at times.
Inconsistent hair length for Rita.

anime.title: Brave Command Dagwon
anime.synopsis:
A huge space monster appeared in a city and began to destroy the city. People were escaping with screaming. Among them, there were five high school students, En, Kai, Shin, Yoku, and Ryu. However, they failed to escape, and they rushed into a patrol car parked nearby. The monster was approaching to them. When they began to accept their death, the patrol car glowed blue white and disappeared into a mysterious space carrying them. When they were astonished, it was an alien that appeared in front of them. He was a Bravian who is an officer of the Space Police Organization that was responsible for the peace and order of the universe. He explained them that he was aimed at by ferocious aliens in the Space Prison Sargasso. He added that he had given them a battle machine "Dag Beagle" made by copying machines on the Earth in order to fight against Sargasso.

They turned into Dagwon by the power of Bravian, and fought against space monsters. At that moment, the patrol car came in front of En. En grew into the car and turned into the Brave Robot Dag Fire, then beaten the enemy. However, the fight between the Brave Dagwon and the felonious aliens of Sargasso had just begun.
anime.consensus_summary: Yuusha Shirei Dagwon is a decent entry in the Brave series, praised for its strong characters and impressive mecha designs. However, the predictable plot and inconsistent animation hold it back from being a top-tier show. While enjoyable for mecha and tokusatsu fans, it may not appeal to everyone due to its reliance on familiar tropes and some dated character design choices.
pros: Strong characters with good chemistry
Excellent mecha designs, particularly Shadow Dagwon and Dagfire
Enjoyable transformations and combining scenes
cons: Predictable story reminiscent of Super Sentai/Tokusatsu
Inconsistent animation quality with noticeable improvement only after episode 37
Generic villains with little to no backstory
Some character designs lean too heavily into bishounen aesthetic

anime.title: Saint Seiya: The Hades Chapter - Elysion
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: After the 12 Gold Saints sacrifice their lives to destroy the Wailing Wall, The Bronze Saints enter the deepest realm of the Underworld, Elysion, where they face off against Hades's two most powerful servants: The Twin Gods, Hypnos and Thanatos, before they can reach Hades for the final battle.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with disappointment stemming from a rushed and illogical conclusion that relies too heavily on shonen tropes like 'the power of love.' Some appreciate the thematic depth and villain designs, while others find the plot contrivances and character handling weak. The final arc feels like a hasty closure, failing to live up to expectations set by earlier parts of the series.
pros: Excellent themes on the value of life, even for Gods.
Athena's role is more combative and impactful than before.
Villain designs are intimidating and well-detailed.
Animation quality remains high with explosive action.
Soundtrack maintains a consistent feel with previous installments.
cons: Rushed and bland climax with reliance on friendship power-ups.
Cheap plot contrivances like Pandora's sudden change of heart and Seika's amnesia.
Underdeveloped villains with bland personalities.
Battles against Thanatos and Hypnos do not represent their true powers.
Seiya's sister appearing out of nowhere to give an excuse for the protagonist's power up.

anime.title: Mr. Stain on Junk Alley
anime.synopsis: Mr. Stain, an artist/inventor, and his cat friend, Palvan, have numerous adventures concerning art supplies and junk found in Junk Alley.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally appreciate 'Garakuta-doori no Stain' for its creativity, dark humor, and unique animation style, noting improvements over the creator's previous work. While some find the visuals unsettling or the humor too dark, many are drawn to the show's bizarre and compassionate exploration of human desires and emotions. The lack of dialogue and surreal nature may not appeal to all, but those who enjoy unconventional storytelling and dark comedy will likely find it enjoyable.
pros: Imaginative storytelling with unique and bizarre imagery.
Effective use of exaggerated movements and non-verbal communication to convey emotion.
Improved animation and camerawork compared to Popee the Performer, creating a more immersive and cinematic experience.
Catchy music and funky dance sequences add to the show's quirky charm.
The show balances comedy with touching moments, creating an engaging viewing experience.
cons: Animation style can be creepy or off-putting for some viewers.
Some find the humor too dark or violent.
The lack of dialogue may not appeal to all audiences.
The show's surreal nature may not resonate with viewers seeking more grounded narratives.
Not weird enough, lacks the impactful bizarre scenes of Popee the Performer

anime.title: Neko Rahmen
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Comedy, Gag Humor, Gourmet, Workplace
anime.synopsis: Taishou is the entrepreneurial ramen chef of Neko Rahmen, the only restaurant in Tokyo run by a cat. All 13 episodes are produced by a different cutting-edge creator—each creator's vision and unique style harmonizes into a fantastic anime series.
anime.consensus_summary: Neko Ramen is a decent anime with a unique premise and visually interesting animation style that varies from episode to episode. However, the humor is inconsistent, and the repetitive storyline may not appeal to all viewers. It's worth a try for those looking for something different, but don't expect a laugh riot.
pros: Each episode has a unique and varied art style due to different directors.
Voice acting is well-chosen and fits the characters.
cons: The story can become repetitive.
The humor is inconsistent, with some episodes being funnier than others.
The cat's voice might be grating to some viewers.
anime.thematic_vibe: Unique Animation, Episodic Comedy, Japanese Culture

anime.title: KochiKame
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Ryoutsu, being an underpaid policeman, is always coming up with underhanded schemes in order to make a quick buck. But in the end, his plans (which are ridiculous to begin with) always go wrong and land him in big trouble with the chief.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is largely viewed positively, especially for its comedic elements and the main character Ryoutsu. Many viewers feel a sense of nostalgia and appreciate the slice-of-life portrayal of Japan. Some critique the lack of depth in supporting characters and the episodic nature of the plot, but overall, the audience has a favorable impression.
pros: Humor is timeless and enjoyable for first-time watchers.
Ryoutsu is an endearing and entertaining character due to his schemes and personality.
Show provides a glimpse into Japanese culture and life lessons.
cons: Some characters are generic and lack depth.
Standalone stories limit plot progression.
Incomplete English sub for all episodes.

anime.title: Allison & Lillia
anime.synopsis: Set in a continent divided into two commonwealths that have been engaged in war for hundreds of years, Allison and Will go on a mission to search "the treasure that will put an end to the war". Their hope is inherited to their daughter Lillia, who strives to thaw the torn nations into a united country. This anime encourages young generations to believe in a world without hatred or war regardless of nationalities and beliefs.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many appreciate the nostalgic charm, art style, and music, viewing it as a lighthearted adventure. However, the plot's simplicity, inconsistencies, and underdeveloped characters, particularly in the second half, draw criticism. The show is seen as enjoyable for casual viewing but falls short of its potential due to writing flaws.
pros: Charming retro art designs with detailed costumes, weapons, and vehicles reminiscent of the 1930s-1950s.
Catchy and charming music, including a soft-sung opening and ending, with great live orchestral background soundtracks that fit the series atmosphere.
Likeable characters, particularly Allison, who spur a sense of adventure and make viewers want to see things turn out happily for them.
Enjoyable and relaxing series that stirs up feelings of nostalgia and throwback adventures of a simpler time.
cons: Idiotic plot with irrational character behavior, characters armed to the teeth but fervent pacifists who refuse to shoot, pseudo-violence, and pseudo-tension.
Inconsistencies and plot holes, villains with contrived presences, and glaring leaps of logic in the plot that erode the credibility of the stories.
Underdeveloped second half (Lillia's tale) where the story lacks direction and characters come off as annoying or cowardly.
Characters remain at a distance by refusing to express any adult emotions, characters in love never kiss or hug, and a huge lack of realism due to the use of violence.
anime.thematic_vibe: Nostalgic Adventure, Simplistic Romance, War-Era Escapism

anime.title: Green Makibao
anime.synopsis:
Midori Makibao is a small white racehorse. Compared to other thoroughbred horses, he looks more like a donkey with wide nostrils; however, with his guts and speed as his weapon, Makibao wins in every big race.

In the beginning of his career, Makibao had a trouble making his debut as a racehorse, because of his appearance and various disadvantages he had. But Makibao had reasons to overcome his difficulties; there was a lifelong rival horse called Superhorse Cascade, that Makibao needed to defeat. Plus, he was determined to win back his mother, a horse that had been taken away for pay back the debt on the farm.

There are many hardships that Makibao has to overcome, but he thrives in the series of races to become a great racehorse.
anime.consensus_summary: Midori no Makibao is a generally well-received sports anime with a focus on comedy and an underdog story. While the show is aimed at a younger audience, the unusual art style and occasional nudity may be off-putting for some viewers. Overall, it's considered a good, normal anime that's worth watching to kill boredom.
pros: Good story
Underdog character works hard to succeed
Characters blend well
cons: Nude art may be unsuitable for younger audiences
Art style is shocking and hard to describe

anime.title: Brain Adventure Record Webdiver
anime.synopsis: Set in the year 2100 where the world is tied together by a computer network. The children of the world become Web Divers, adapting their consciousnesses into data, and love to play together in the cyber park called Magical Gate. However, a mysterious computer virus appears beginning to destroy Magical Gate from the inside out. In cyberspace, programs called Web Knights have been created to protect the children. But, the computer virus has turned all the Web Knights against the children. The only Web Knight to escape the "brainwashing" is Gladion. Gladion seeks the help of Kaito Yuki, a Web Diver who is in the fourth grade.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, often tied to nostalgia. While some appreciate the simple plot, catchy music, and unique setting, many are critical of the repetitive nature, poor CGI, and shallow character development. The show seems to appeal more to those who watched it during their childhood or enjoy similar shows despite its flaws.
pros: Catchy music and opening/ending themes.
Interesting concepts and setting, especially Diverland.
Some find the simple, generic story enjoyable.
The main character Kaito is relatable and has clear motivations.
cons: Repetitive plot and formulaic episodes.
Poorly executed CGI, especially in Magical Gate.
Basic and uninspired character development for side characters.
Underdeveloped or poorly explained antagonists.
Ending feels rushed and anticlimactic.

anime.title: Ganbarist! Shun
anime.synopsis:
First-year high school student Fujimaki Shun has a dream of becoming an olympic gold medalist as a gymnast. Having no previous training, Shun trusts his passion, boldly joins the gymnastics club, and sets out to pursue his goal.

Along the way, he meets his share of entertaining and supportive upper classmen, develops a romantic interest in his classmate, and learns about the happiness involved in devoting yourself to a sport.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Ganbarist! Shun for its comedic and feel-good aspects, particularly highlighting the main character's optimism and the humorous interactions. However, some viewers find the plot simplistic and the skill progression unrealistic. The older art style may be a barrier for some, but others find it charming.
pros: Optimistic and encouraging main character
Character interactions provide great comedic consequences
Enjoyable and classical art style
cons: Unrealistic rate of skill progression
Overly dramatic and drags on too long
Redundant music
Inconsistent animation quality
Simplistic story

anime.title: House Hunting
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Kids, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: A nameless heroine packs up her belongings into a large satchel and heads out of the city. Walking on foot across the countryside, she encounters a strange collection of creepy crawlies and ghostly spirits.
anime.consensus_summary: The short film 'Yadosagashi' is well-received, particularly for its innovative use of sound effects to drive the narrative. While the visuals are not a highlight, the film's simple yet clever storytelling makes it an enjoyable experience for a wide audience, especially children. The film is considered more charming than divisive.
pros: Clever storytelling through onomatopoeia
Accessible and enjoyable for all ages
cons: Lackluster art style

anime.title: Macross Frontier
anime.genres: Award Winning, Mecha, Military, Music, Romance, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
Following a catastrophic war against a race of giants known as the Zentradi, humanity has escaped towards the center of the galaxy aboard a fleet of colonial vessels called the Macross Frontier. As the extraterrestrial threat is left further and further behind, life on Macross Frontier proceeds as usual.

In the year 2059, a young mecha pilot trainee named Alto Saotome and his colleagues are preparing to perform an accompanying routine for the famous singer Sheryl Nome, who has come to Macross Frontier for a concert. During the performance, a biomechanical alien species known as the Vajra make a sudden appearance, breaking through the defensive perimeter surrounding the vessel and crash-landing near the concert venue, plunging the entire city into chaos. As the concertgoers evacuate, a young girl named Ranka Lee is left behind and gets targeted by the Vajra, but she is saved at the last minute by Alto. Following these events, the Strategic Military Services program notes Alto's skill in battle, resulting in his recruitment to combat the new alien threat.
anime.consensus_summary: Macross Frontier is praised for its stunning visuals and music, which are hallmarks of the Macross franchise. However, it receives criticism for its weak character development, an over-reliance on the love triangle, and a scattered plot. While many enjoy the series as a worthy successor to previous Macross installments, others find its flaws significant.
pros: Stunning animation, especially in battle and concert scenes.
Memorable and impactful music soundtrack.
Engaging story with twists and turns.
cons: Weak character development for some characters, especially Alto and Ranka.
Love triangle plot overshadows other plot elements.
Inconsistent pacing with filler episodes and rushed ending.
Plot holes and unresolved questions.

anime.title: Dinosaur King
anime.synopsis: Dr. Taylor was on a paleontology mission with his son, Max in Africa. Rex, Max's best friend, joins along as well. When Max had stumbled across some magic stone slabs with images of dinosaurs, the boys and their friend Zoe were being called out by the dinosaurs for help. It seems that an evil organization called the "Alpha Gang," led by the nefarious Dr. Z, traveled back in time to hunt down the dinosaurs so that they could take over the world by using those dinosaurs. It is up to Max, Rex, and their friend Zoe to travel around the world, defeating Dr. Z and the Alpha Gang while hunting down the dinosaurs.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings, with many viewing it through a lens of childhood nostalgia. While some appreciate its educational aspects and fun adventures, the show is largely criticized for its formulaic plot, generic characters, and uninspired animation. Many find it repetitive and derivative of other monster-collecting anime like Pokemon and Digimon, limiting its appeal to older audiences.
pros: Great for kids who love dinosaurs.
Fun and adventurous with elements of comedy and friendship.
Introduces different dinosaurs and some historical context.
cons: Repetitive, episodic plot with a predictable formula.
Characters are generic and lack depth.
Animation quality is dated and the dinosaur battles are uninspired.
Story and characters are a ripoff of Pokemon and Digimon.

anime.title: Kyouran Kazoku Nikki
anime.synopsis:
Midarezaki Ouka is used to having strange things happen to him -after all, he is the head of the Great Japanese Empire Paranormal Phenomena Bureau of Measures. But when he catches a small cat girl in the shopping district stealing apples, his whole life rearranges to fit a new operation... 

OPERATION COZY FAMILY. 

Thousands of years ago, Enka the God of Destruction, was killed. However, with a dying breath it claimed that its child would appear and destroy humanity. Now in futuristic Japan, all of the potential children of Enka have been found and placed into a haphazard family. 

Teika the lion, Gekka the jellyfish, Yuuka the oni, Ginka the cross-dressing mafia son, and Hyouka the bioweapon--along with their parents Ouka and Kyouka (the ruler of a demon underworld)--all live under one roof in a family frenzy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Kyouran Kazoku Nikki are mixed. While praised for its unique characters, vibrant art, and comedic elements, many find the show's inconsistent tone, random plot, and underdeveloped characters to be significant drawbacks. The series has potential but fails to fully deliver due to its uneven execution.
pros: Vibrant and colorful art style fitting the theme.
Catchy opening theme and diverse ending themes representative of the characters.
Unique and well-defined characters with potential for chemistry.
Successfully blends comedy with heartwarming moments.
Enjoyable and funny, especially for fans of absurd and random humor.
cons: Inconsistent tone with jarring shifts between comedy, drama, and serious backstories.
Random and intrusive events with a lack of natural progression and a weak central narrative.
Forced and boring backstories used as a cheap way to gain sympathy.
Underdeveloped characters, especially Ouka and Kyouka.
Comedy can be hit-or-miss, with some jokes falling flat or being overused.
Too many side characters and episodes that don't contribute to the main story.

anime.title: Soul Eater
anime.synopsis:
Death City is home to the famous Death Weapon Meister Academy (Shibusen), a technical academy headed by the Shinigami—Lord Death himself. Its mission: to raise Death Scythes for the Shinigami to wield against the many evils of their fantastical world. These Death Scythes, however, are not made from physical weapons; rather, they are born from human hybrids who have the ability to transform their bodies into Demon Weapons, and only after they have consumed the souls of 99 evil beings and one witch's soul.

Soul Eater Evans, a Demon Scythe who only seems to care about what's cool, aims to become a Death Scythe with the help of his straight-laced wielder, or meister, Maka Albarn. The contrasting duo work and study alongside the hot headed Black☆Star and his caring weapon Tsubaki, as well as the Shinigami's own son, Death the Kid, an obsessive-compulsive dual wielder of twin pistols Patty and Liz.

As they take on missions to collect souls and protect the city from the world's threats, the Shibusen students work together under the snickering sun to become sounder in mind, body, and soul.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Soul Eater. Many praise its unique art style, animation, and characters, particularly enjoying the first half's blend of action and comedy. However, the second half of the series receives criticism for its rushed story, inconsistent character development, and disappointing ending that departs from the manga, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Unique and stylish art and animation
Memorable and likeable characters with unique personalities
Well-choreographed and exciting fight scenes
Good balance of humor and action, especially in the first half
Engaging world-building and creative concepts
cons: Inconsistent story quality, especially in the second half of the anime
Rushed and anti-climactic ending that deviates from the manga
Uneven character development, with some characters being underdeveloped or annoying
Pacing issues and poorly handled subplots
Some repetitive jokes and overused tropes

anime.title: Tears to Tiara
anime.synopsis:
As the Holy Empire rises to power, the neighboring lands begin to gradually fall under its control. The Empire's conquest eventually reaches the small island of Erin, home to the Gael tribe. There, a priestess named Riannon is kidnapped to be offered as a living sacrifice to the demon king Arawn, a malevolent being rumored to have caused untold destruction in the past.

Riannon's brother, First Warrior Arthur, rescues her, when Arawn suddenly materializes before them as a handsome grey-haired man. Hiding his true identity and remaining enigmatic, Arawn pledges his power and leadership to the tribe's cause and joins Arthur, Riannon, and their merry band of friends—including a talented swordsman, an agile hunter, and a group of ecstatic pixies—as they fight back against the Empire, while uncovering the dark secrets of the land along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the use of mythology and well-paced story, while others find the characters and plot development lacking. The series is considered average, with potential for enjoyment for fantasy fans, but not a standout title.
pros: Intelligent use of Welsh and Arthurian mythology.
Well-paced story with impactful plot points.
Good blending of CG and traditional animation.
cons: Characters are boring and repetitive with cliche motivations.
Pacing issues with abrupt transitions and ignored conflicts.
Underdeveloped side characters and skipped plot points from the original game.

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Phantom Blood
anime.romaji_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Phantom Blood
anime.synopsis: An adaptation of the original five volume arc of the popular JoJo's Bizarre Adventure manga, covering the Phantom Blood chapters. Jonathan Joestar is an aristocratic boy whose life is suddenly turned upside down by a mysterious new boy who arrives, Dio Brando. Dio has a connection to his father, and over time, a rivalry forms as Dio becomes obsessed with a mysterious, ancient, and mystical stone mask that Jonathan's father keeps.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly negative due to the extreme inaccessibility of the film. While the core narrative and visual style are acknowledged as potentially decent, the complete lack of proper availability renders it a frustrating and nearly useless experience. It's considered more of a historical curiosity than a recommended piece of media, even for dedicated fans.
pros: Visually reminiscent of older JoJo OVAs with a serious tone.
Follows the narrative basis of the Phantom Blood arc.
cons: Extremely limited release and withdrawal from circulation makes it nearly impossible to watch.
Available versions are of very questionable quality, incomplete, and fragmented.
Noticeable cuts and alterations from the manga affect character development (especially Dio's).
Visuals do not impress despite not being ugly.
The inaccessibility compromises any fair assessment and leads to frustration.

anime.title: Hidamari Sketch x 365
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Slice of Life, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis: After passing her entrance exam, Yuno enrolls at Yamabuki High School as part of an art degree. She stays at the Hidamari Apartments along with best friend Miyako, and seniors Hiro and Sae. Each episode follows a day in her life as she mingles with her friends, close peers, overly hyper teachers and closely follows the mundane lives of the high school girls.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences find Hidamari Sketch x 365 to be an enjoyable and relaxing sequel that improves upon the original with enhanced visuals and character development. The non-linear storytelling might be a minor drawback, but the heartwarming and comical moments, coupled with the characters' charm, lead to a positive reception. It is generally considered a great iyashi (healing) anime.
pros: Improved art and animation quality compared to the first season.
Well-developed characters and exploration of their relationships.
Calming and entertaining slice-of-life content.
cons: Non-chronological order can be confusing.
Some side characters lack depth.
Episodic nature with limited overarching plot.

anime.title: Library Wars
anime.synopsis:
In the year 1989, the Japanese government passed the Media Betterment Act, allowing a group of soldiers known as the Media Betterment Committee (MBC) to destroy and censor any "problematic" media under the guise of protecting public morals. As a response, regional governments established the Library Defense Force (LDF), whose members take up arms and put their lives on the line to protect freedom of expression. At the top of the Kanto branch of the LDF stands the Library Task Force (LTF): an elite squad consisting of only the most exceptional fighters.

As a high schooler, Iku Kasahara experienced the terror of censorship first-hand when she refused to surrender the newest volume of her favorite series to MBC agents. She only came out unscathed thanks to a lone member of the LDF, who protected her and her beloved book. Now in her 20s and still unable to forget the man who saved her, Kasahara joins the LDF in the hope of becoming just like her prince.

But LDF training turns out to be far more rigorous than she could have imagined, and her instructor, LTF member Atsushi Doujou, seems fixated on making her life a living hell. Given her struggles, Kasahara is shocked when she is selected as one of the two new LTF recruits as a result of Doujou's recommendation. As Kasahara does all she can to become worthy of the LTF and unravel her enigmatic superior's motivations, she wages war—both on the battlefield and in her personal life.
anime.consensus_summary: Toshokan Sensou is an enjoyable but flawed anime with an interesting premise and likeable characters, but suffers from shallow social commentary and an unlikeable main character. The series attempts to blend multiple genres but doesn't fully succeed in any. While some find the art style unique, others find it inconsistent and distracting. Overall, the anime is a fun watch, but not a memorable one.
pros: Interesting premise reminiscent of Fahrenheit 451.
Well-developed characters, especially Iku, with realistic emotional outbursts.
Good balance of action, comedy, and romance.
The art style is unique.
Sound is good overall.
cons: Uninspired and shallow social commentary; lacks bite or purpose.
Unlikeable main character who is incompetent and emotionally fragile.
The series tries to be too many things at once and fails to do any of them particularly well.
The art style is inconsistent, with noticeable black borders and wonky character models.
Lack of compelling villains.

anime.title: Ryoko's Case File
anime.synopsis:
Based on a series of light novels written by Tanaka Yoshiki and illustrated by Kakinouchi Narumi.

The story revolves around Ryouko Yakushiji, a 27-year-old multilingual investigator that graduated from Tokyo University's elite Department of Law, and the bizarre cases she faces while working for the Tokyo Metropolitan Police. Yakushiji not only has to deal with supernatural beings in her line of work, but also her rival Yukiko Muromachi, another equally talented and beautiful police investigator.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some praising the engaging mysteries and stylish animation. However, the show is criticized for its shallow characters and unresolved plot points, leading to a lukewarm reception overall. Many feel the anime serves more as an advertisement for the light novels.
pros: Well-realized titular character Ryoko Yakushiji.
Stylish animation with a Baccano! feel.
Engaging episodic mysteries that contribute to an overarching plot.
cons: One-dimensional characters with little development.
Unanswered questions and a lopsided storyline.
Repetitive plot elements.

anime.title: Neo Angelique Abyss
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Josei, Reverse Harem, Romance
anime.synopsis: While the young Angelique lives out her days peacefully in her school, attacks from the monstrous Thanatos has been increasing everywhere else. Two Purifiers show up one day, men with the power to exterminate the Thanatos. One of them, Nyx, attempts to convince Angelique to join them in their work, as she has the power to be the only female Purifier. As Angelique hesitates, a Thanatos shows up in their school. Nyx and the other Purifier, Rayne, fight a losing battle. With her classmates falling prey to the Thanatos, and the Purifiers beaten to submission, Angelique's desire to save everyone awakens. She became the only female Purifier in their land of Arcadia, the one known as the "Queen's Egg".
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Neo Angelique Abyss is mixed. While some viewers, especially fans of reverse harem and shoujo anime, find it enjoyable as a lighthearted and entertaining series, many criticize its predictable plot, shallow romance, and lack of significant character development. The series is often seen as a 'guilty pleasure' rather than a standout anime.
pros: Appealing to fans of the reverse harem genre.
Some found the character designs unique and enjoyable.
The VA casting was well-received by some viewers.
The series can be enjoyable as a 'guilty pleasure' due to its lighthearted and fun nature.
cons: Predictable plot and unoriginal story.
Shallow romance and lack of character development.
Boring action sequences and weak antagonists.
Overly cute and sugary tone may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Kamen no Maid Guy
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Fujiwara Naeka is a typical 17-year-old high school student. Or so we thought. She's really one of two surviving heirs of a tycoon who has the right to inherit his mass fortune when she turns 18 in half a year. Fubuki, a young and beautiful maid, and Kogarashi, a big burly maid guy with a mask, have been assigned to keep Naeka and her brother Kousuke safe from those who would plot their demise, and to steal the fortune she would inherit.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on 'Kamen no Maid Guy.' While some appreciate the ecchi humor and the character of Maid Guy, many find the plot weak, the character development lacking, and the humor repetitive. There's a sense that the show had potential but failed to deliver due to poor writing and an over-reliance on fan service. Ultimately, it's seen as a passable time-waster but not a standout anime.
pros: Kogarashi/Maid Guy is a highlight, providing most of the laughs and making a strong impression.
The OP/ED themes are catchy and well-received, adding to the enjoyment.
The concept of bodyguards disguised as maids is initially interesting.
cons: The plot is weak, generic, and often abandoned in favor of ecchi and repetitive jokes.
Character development is lacking, with promising characters becoming shallow or forgotten.
Humor relies heavily on boob jokes and perverted antics, which can become tiresome.
The story feels incomplete and rushed, with a disappointing ending and unresolved plot points.

anime.title: D.C.II S.S.: Da Capo II Second Season
anime.romaji_title: D.C.II S.S.: Da Capo II Second Season
anime.synopsis: The story continues where it left off at season 1, but now we start to get to know the people we already know a little more in detail.
anime.consensus_summary: D.C.II S.S. is seen as an improvement over previous Da Capo installments, particularly in its emotional depth and character focus on the Asakura sisters. However, the series suffers from a slow start and a somewhat predictable, rushed ending. While some viewers appreciate the heightened drama and improved animation, others find the sidelined characters and unresolved plot points disappointing.
pros: Story builds up well towards the end, creating emotional investment.
Characters, especially Otome and Yume, receive good development.
Animation is improved compared to the original Da Capo series.
Music effectively enhances emotional scenes.
cons: Slow start with initial episodes lacking plot development.
Some plot holes and unresolved elements remain unsatisfying.
Other characters from previous seasons are sidelined.
Ending is considered cliched and rushed by some viewers.

anime.title: Adventure Hero Pluster World
anime.synopsis:
According to the legend, the once peaceful "Pluster World" plunged into chaos and darkness due to the manifestation of the evil MINASUTA. At that time, selected Plusters were combined with humans, and successfully sealed away the evil MINASUTA. It was then believed that the peace which had returned would continue forever. Greenery and trees filled the land, flowers bloomed everywhere, living creatures soar in the blue sky, run on the land, and swim in the seas.

However, this peacefulness was once again lost due to reappearance of the MINASUTA... Now, the fusion of Plusters and Humans once again opens the door for a hot adventure!
anime.consensus_summary: Bouken Yuuki Pluster World is viewed as a simple, childish adventure anime with some enjoyable characters and exciting moments, but suffers from a weak soundtrack, inconsistent animation, and a loosely structured plot. It is recommended for those already familiar with the monster-battling genre, particularly fans of Digimon-style anime, and those tolerant of filler content. The series is easily accessible due to its simple language.
pros: Lovable, interesting, and unique characters.
Enjoyable art style of early 2000s anime.
Exciting episodes outside of filler content.
cons: Loosely connected story arcs with irrelevant episodes.
Absence of good songs and generic background music.
Animation quality is inconsistent.

anime.title: Kaiketsu Zorori
anime.synopsis: Adapted from the popular storybooks of the same name by Yutaka Hara, Kaiketsu Zorori follows the adventures of a scheming fox named Zorori, who is determined to become the King of Mischief with his very own castle and beautiful bride.  Although Zorori is notorious for his pranks and tricks, his conniving plots often backfire and end up helping his targets, and despite appearing to be villainous and immoral, he is actually caring and sentimental.  Nevertheless, Zorori has the wits, intelligence, and dexterity to always find a solution out of the most hopeless of situations.  Travelling with a pair of twin boar bandits, Ishishi and Noshishi, he continues on his journey to make his deceased mother proud.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Kaiketsu Zorori as a lighthearted and fun anime, especially for children.  The simple story and characters are appreciated for their humor and charm, though some find the simplicity a drawback.  Overall, it's seen as a relaxing and enjoyable watch, with a few minor criticisms about character development and target audience.
pros: Fun and silly story execution.
Good art with vivid colors and fitting backgrounds.
Funny sound effects and enjoyable music.
Interesting character depth and development for Zorori.
Enjoyable and relaxing to watch.
cons: Simple story may not appeal to all viewers.
Noshishi and Ishishi lack character development.
May be too childish for some older viewers.

anime.title: Naisho no Tsubomi
anime.synopsis: Tsubomi Tachibana is a fifth grader dealing with rather sensitive issues such as her mother's pregnancy, her first period and the strange feelings she has started to get when she has been around boys.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed due to the show's sensitive themes. Some appreciate the anime's cuteness, relatability, and portrayal of puberty, particularly from a female perspective. However, others find the subject matter controversial and the execution flawed, especially the focus on sex education for young children. Ultimately, reception hinges on individual tolerance for the show's themes.
pros: Cute animation style that is different from modern anime.
Relatable story for those who have gone through similar experiences.
Well-done portrayal of characters and their reactions to puberty.
cons: Subject matter (sex education for fifth graders) is controversial and potentially inappropriate.
Lack of background music.
Incomplete character development due to the small number of episodes.

anime.title: Glass Rabbit
anime.synopsis: Toshiko Ei and her family are residents of Tokyo. Her father is a respected and skilled glass craftsmen so the family makes a good living. However, the Ei family soon finds itself having to suffer through many tragic hardships as a result of World War II.
