Enjoyable for fans of the harem/ecchi genre; humorous and entertaining.
cons: Poor storyline; mostly filler episodes with little connection to the manga.
Heavy censorship of fan service in broadcast episodes.
Lack of character development; characters remain largely unchanged from the first season.

anime.title: Toradora!
anime.synopsis:
Ryuuji Takasu is a gentle high school student with a love for housework; but in contrast to his kind nature, he has an intimidating face that often gets him labeled as a delinquent. On the other hand is Taiga Aisaka, a small, doll-like student, who is anything but a cute and fragile girl. Equipped with a wooden katana and feisty personality, Taiga is known throughout the school as the "Palmtop Tiger."

One day, an embarrassing mistake causes the two students to cross paths. Ryuuji discovers that Taiga actually has a sweet side: she has a crush on the popular vice president, Yuusaku Kitamura, who happens to be his best friend. But things only get crazier when Ryuuji reveals that he has a crush on Minori Kushieda—Taiga's best friend!

Toradora! is a romantic comedy that follows this odd duo as they embark on a quest to help each other with their respective crushes, forming an unlikely alliance in the process.
anime.consensus_summary: Toradora! is a polarizing romantic comedy. Many viewers praise its character development, emotional depth, and avoidance of cliches, while others criticize its predictable plot, inconsistent characters, and unsatisfying ending. Despite mixed opinions, the series is generally considered enjoyable and impactful for its exploration of relationships and emotional resonance, making it a memorable entry in the romance genre for many but a frustrating experience for others.
pros: Unique and relatable characters with realistic insecurities.
Unpredictable story that avoids common romantic cliches.
Excellent soundtrack that enhances emotional scenes.
Strong character development and exploration of complex relationships.
Balanced mix of comedy and drama, with emotional depth.
cons: Predictable overall plot and reliance on common romance tropes.
Inconsistent character behavior, especially in the second half.
Anti-climatic and unsatisfying ending for some viewers.
Overuse of tsundere archetype, leading to unlikable characters.
Forced and melodramatic drama elements.
Rushed character development for side characters.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam MS IGLOO 2: Gravity of the Battlefront
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam MS IGLOO 2: Juuryoku Sensen
anime.synopsis: MS igLoo 2 goes back to the first MS igLoo and tells the story of the Federation soldiers side that has to fight against the monstrous Zakus. Each episode tells a story of a different federation soldier that is cursed by a Death God that came down to earth with the Zakus and shows the desperate struggle against mobile suits with only conventional weapons such as tanks and missiles. Each soldier, fueled with revenge, and a Death God looming over their backs, fights against the odds that is the terrible might of a Zaku.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience appreciates the series for its realistic portrayal of war and the focus on ordinary soldiers facing overwhelming odds. The CGI animation is generally praised for its technical achievements, but some find the character animation unconvincing. Some viewers find the 'death god' theme detracts from the story, but overall the series is well-received for its unique perspective and engaging characters.
pros: Realistic depiction of war from the perspective of common soldiers.
Strong character development within a short timeframe.
Impressive CGI animation, especially in depicting mecha and explosions.
Unique storytelling approach with each episode focusing on different characters and weapons.
cons: Characterization can be weak, with exaggerated facial expressions in CGI.
The 'death god' theme feels misplaced or unnecessary to some viewers.
Voice acting is inconsistent and doesn't always match character personalities.

anime.title: Eureka Seven - good night, sleep tight, young lovers
anime.romaji_title: Koukyoushihen Eureka Seven: Pocket ga Niji de Ippai
anime.synopsis: Renton, son of scientists, and Eureka, a girl who can't live under the sun, are raised together when very young and become very attached to each other. One day, Eureka is taken away. Powerless at the time, Renton vows to rescue her. He enters the military and is soon is assigned to the Independent Youths Unit 303 of the First Mobile Forces thanks to his exceptional performance alongside his Nirvash, a bio-mechanical armor/control system. Unknown to Renton, lies a plot to extinguish the alien invasion that is currently happening involving not only him, but Eureka too.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is sharply divided, with a significant portion of viewers expressing strong disappointment due to the movie's departure from the original series' plot and characters, and its heavy reliance on recycled animation. Conversely, a smaller but vocal group found merit in its standalone narrative, altered character dynamics, and high-quality production values, appreciating it as a different take on the Eureka Seven universe.
pros: High-quality animation and special effects, as expected from BONES
The character designs are the same as the original series, with good detail in the surroundings
Soundtrack and ending song are praised
The portrayal of Renton and Eureka's relationship is more openly expressed
Some reviewers appreciated the fresh take on characters and their altered roles
The movie offers a self-contained story that doesn't require prior knowledge of the TV series
cons: Story is confusing, rushed, and significantly deviates from the original series, alienating fans
Heavy reliance on re-used animation and scenes from the original series, impacting originality and artistic merit
Characterizations are altered in ways that many fans found detrimental or nonsensical
The plot is difficult to follow and poorly thought out for some
Some reviewers found the plot to be derivative and unoriginal
Certain character portrayals and plot points were seen as offensive or poorly conceived, including a thinly veiled 'rape' scene

anime.title: Ultraviolet: Code 044
anime.synopsis: 044 becomes the strongest female soldier excelling in combat through gene manipulation using a virus. However, in exchange for her abilities, her days become numbered. The next mission of the government is to destroy a bloodthirsty squad, Phage, and its leader King. In her battle, she encounters a Phage soldier, Luka, and finds herself unable to kill him. She wonders why, but as a result, Daxus Jr., the leader of the government group, regards her as a traitor. She is targeted by both Phage and the government, and she runs away with the injured Luka.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response to Ultraviolet: Code 044 is mixed. While praised for its visual style, action sequences, and character designs, the plot's pacing and engagement are criticized. It's considered a decent anime for entertainment but not a standout work, especially compared to the director's other series.
pros: Stylish visuals and experimental techniques (split screens, triple takes)
Solid and simple plot that balances action, character development, and story
Good art, sound, and character designs
cons: Story dynamicity decreases as the plot evolves
Plot can be difficult to engage with
Ending feels rushed and not grandiose

anime.title: The Garden of Sinners Chapter 4: The Hollow Shrine
anime.romaji_title: Kara no Kyoukai Movie 4: Garan no Dou
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Mystery, Suspense, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Following the events of Satsujin Kousatsu (Zen), Shiki Ryougi has been in a coma for two years due to a traffic accident. When she finally awakens, she has no memories of her past and is plagued by a profound loneliness. Even stranger, she notices dark lines encompassing the things around her, and if she touches them she can disassemble the object—something which completely terrifies her. Her friend, Mikiya Kokutou, enlists the help of Touko Aozaki, a mage who can help Shiki understand what her eyes—the "Mystic Eyes of Death Perception"—are truly capable of and how to use them properly.
anime.consensus_summary: The fourth installment of Kara no Kyoukai is well-received for its focus on character development and introspective themes, particularly exploring Shiki's identity. While some viewers missed the action of previous movies, most appreciated the beautiful animation, atmospheric music, and the way it filled in narrative gaps. The movie is considered a strong entry in the series, deepening the understanding of the main characters.
pros: Excellent character development, especially for Shiki and Touko
Visually stunning animation and artwork by Ufotable
Atmospheric background music that enhances the mood
Intriguing story that fills in the gaps from previous movies
cons: Lack of action compared to previous installments
Predictable plot for some viewers
Non-chronological order can be confusing
Some may find the serious scenes unintentionally funny

anime.title: The Garden of Sinners Chapter 5: Paradox Spiral
anime.romaji_title: Kara no Kyoukai Movie 5: Mujun Rasen
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Suspense, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
In November 1998, a double homicide occurs at the newly constructed Ogawa apartment complex in the heart of Mifune City. The murderer, Tomoe Enjou, has fled in a panic. To his astonishment, he is not pursued by the police and news of the incident has not been reported through media outlets. After Shiki Ryougi defends Tomoe from a group of thugs, she allows him to use her residence as a hideout. However, a few days later, Tomoe is shaken to discover that his mother is alive, even though he is convinced that he killed her.
 
Coincidentally, Mikiya Kokutou is investigating a tip that his associate Touko Aozaki receives regarding the murder at the unique apartment complex. As he uncovers more information about the incident, Mikiya takes a particular interest in Tomoe. Deciding to investigate him further, Mikiya soon discovers the disturbing truth of the foreboding Ogawa complex.

The fifth installment of the Kara no Kyoukai film series, Mujun Rasen combines an intricately constructed mystery with established themes and characters to produce a dark, thought-provoking story.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are largely positive, praising the film's complex narrative and high production values. Some find the plot confusing and the pacing uneven. While some consider this the best in the series, others find it overrated, leading to a somewhat divided, but overall appreciative reception.
pros: Complex and thought-provoking story with unique twists.
Excellent animation quality and detailed visuals.
Strong soundtrack and effective sound design.
cons: Confusing, non-linear storytelling can be difficult to follow.
Pacing issues with repetitive scenes.
Some plot elements feel underdeveloped or pulled out of nowhere.

anime.title: Bonobono
anime.synopsis: A sea otter and his friends, a raccoon and squirrel, live and play together in the forest.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly praises Bonobono for its unique blend of gentle humor and profound philosophical undertones. Viewers appreciate its ability to engage both children and adults with thoughtful, subtle storytelling. It is considered a high-quality slice-of-life series with broad appeal.
pros: Deeply philosophical themes handled subtly and thoughtfully
Appeals to both children and adults without being overwhelming or condescending
Masterful balance between subtlety and meaning
High quality slice-of-life presentation, comparable to other acclaimed shows
cons: None explicitly mentioned in the provided review.

anime.title: Fist of the North Star: The Legend of Toki
anime.synopsis: The fourth part of the new Hokuto no Ken pentalogy (3 movies, 2 OVAs).
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience views 'Hokuto no Ken: Toki-den' as a worthwhile addition to the franchise, especially when compared to other OVAs like Yuria's. While it has some shortcomings in art style and voice acting, the additions to the original story and the character of Sara are generally well-received. Most fans suggest that while it's enjoyable, viewers shouldn't expect it to surpass the original series.
pros: Better than Yuria's OVA.
Adds nicely to the original story.
Sara's character fits well.
cons: Lacks the style of the original.
Raoh's voice actor is not liked.
Art style is not completely sold on.

anime.title: Lupin III: Green vs. Red
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Yasuo works at a ramen restaurant and is dating the pretty news reporter Yukiko. However, things aren't going well for him financially and after a customer leaves a green jacket behind, Yasuo starts adding to his income by walking the crowded streets of the Tokyo metroplex and stealing people's wallets. With this, he's able to buy his girlfriend a nice ring even though she says he didn't need to buy this for her.
Over time, Yasuo becomes obsessed with becoming Lupin to the point that he reads and watches everything regarding him, he even works with Jigen for a time.

However, when Yasuo learns of the Ice Cube diamond, he knows that if he can steal this, he will be the real Lupin.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reaction is highly polarized. Some appreciate the artistic animation and references to Lupin's history, viewing it as a thought-provoking tribute. However, many find the plot incoherent, the characters underdeveloped, and the overall experience confusing and unsatisfying, with some considering it the worst Lupin film ever. The film's confusing narrative and lack of resolution frustrate many viewers.
pros: Interesting concept of multiple Lupins.
Animation is well done and smooth in places.
Celebrates the 40th anniversary of Lupin with nods to the past.
Soundtrack is far superior to anything else to be found in this dreck.
Use of different styles, artistically is a nice touch.
cons: Incoherent and confusing plot.
Poorly utilized supporting characters.
Unresolved storylines and lack of resolution.
Social commentary is jaded and clumsy.
Narrative is not linear.
Movie takes itself too seriously.

anime.title: Heroman
anime.synopsis:
In California's Center City, shy but kindhearted Joseph Carter "Joey" Jones lives with his grandmother, working in a coffee shop. Though his family is financially burdened and he is bullied at school, he remains cheerful. A robotics enthusiast, he wants a top-of-the-line toy robot called a Heybo more than anything.

One day Joey and his friend Simon "Psy" Kaina come across a destroyed Heybo discarded by a group of rich kids. He takes it home and repairs it himself, excitedly naming it Heroman. However, one night Heroman is struck by lightning and comes to life, growing several times its size in the process.

That same night Center City is attacked by aliens called Skrugg whose attention was brought to Earth after Joey's acquaintance Professor Matthew Denton made attempts to contact them. Along with Joey, Heroman quickly heads to the scene of the attack, where he finds people in trouble, including his friend Lina Davis and her father. Using an arm-mounted controller, Joey is able to command Heroman to use superpowers to fight off the Skrugg and rescue civilians. As the aliens continue their invasion of Earth, the duo are the only ones separating humanity and destruction.
anime.consensus_summary: Heroman receives mixed reviews. While some appreciate its classic superhero themes, fluid animation, and exciting action sequences, others find the plot simplistic, the characters generic, and the humor lacking. The ending is often cited as a high point, but the journey to get there is considered uneven.
pros: Good old-fashioned American style superhero show
Fluid and detailed visuals
Enjoyable fight sequences
Plot twists keep the show interesting
cons: Plot requires minimal internalization
Logic is often left out
Characters are generic
Humor misses the mark
Bad progression of the story

anime.title: Fireball
anime.synopsis: Fireball takes place during the war between humans and robots. There is no real story, just individual episode skits.
anime.consensus_summary: Fireball is a short, enjoyable CGI anime praised for its humor, unique animation style, and quirky characters. While the story is almost non-existent, the fast-paced jokes and short episode length make it a worthwhile watch.  The English dub is also considered well-done, adding to the overall enjoyment of the series.
pros: Great animation for its time
Goofy and funny characters
Good English dub
Unique stop-motion animation style
cons: Story is non-existent or minimal
Animation can be stiff (though sometimes intentional)

anime.title: The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya (2009)
anime.synopsis:
Kyon has found himself dragged through many adventures as of late—all because of the SOS Brigade club and its excitable leader, Haruhi Suzumiya. He has stopped believing in the supernatural long ago, but after being forced to join this club based solely on that, he has seen things that cannot be explained logically. 

Joining Kyon on his various misadventures is the shy and soft-spoken Mikuru Asahina, the bookish Yuki Nagato, and the ever-cheerful Itsuki Koizumi. Whether it is summer vacation or a school festival, things involving their club and Haruhi herself always end up becoming strange.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, primarily due to the Endless Eight arc, which many viewers found tedious and detrimental to the series. While some appreciate the artistic intent or found enjoyment in the animation details, most were frustrated by the repetition. The other arcs received more positive feedback, but the overall negative impact of Endless Eight overshadows them in the general perception of the season.
pros: High-quality animation and art style, especially in non-Endless Eight episodes.
Strong voice acting and sound design.
Exploration of character depth, particularly Haruhi and Yuki.
Experimentation with narrative structure (though polarizing).
cons: The Endless Eight arc is overwhelmingly repetitive and boring.
Pacing issues due to the length of Endless Eight.
Some find Haruhi's character unlikeable or poorly developed in this season.
Animation style changes (influenced by K-ON!) are seen as a downgrade by some.

anime.title: Sands of Destruction
anime.romaji_title: World Destruction: Sekai Bokumetsu no Rokunin
anime.synopsis:
Spinoff based on the Nintendo DS RPG game by SEGA, released in Japan July, 2008. 

In a world where humans serve as livestock for the ruling beastman, and where sand fills the roles of water and fire. Kyrie is recruited by the "World Destruction Committee" to assist in putting an end to their world. Kyrie alone holds the power needed to do it.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "World Destruction" is considered a watchable but unremarkable anime. Many find the initial episodes slow and generic, but some appreciate the characters and the eventual plot twists. The series is viewed as a fairly standard RPG adaptation with limited character development and a predictable storyline. There's a split between those who found it enjoyable despite its flaws and those who were left underwhelmed by its generic nature.
pros: Enjoyable characters, particularly the main trio, with their interactions providing comic relief.
Some found the action entertaining and the series watchable, especially towards the end.
The English dub is well-received.
cons: Generic storyline and world-building, with reliance on RPG stereotypes and uninspired character designs (especially beastmen).
Pacing issues, with many episodes contributing little to the overall plot, especially in the first half.
Underdeveloped characters with little depth or backstory for many of them.
Inconsistent music and art with cheap animation.

anime.title: King of Braves GaoGaiGar Final Grand Glorious Gathering
anime.romaji_title: Yuusha-Ou GaoGaiGar Final Grand Glorious Gathering
anime.synopsis: Following Gutsy Galaxy Guard's victory over the Zonder Empire and the 31 Primevals, a new threat makes their appearance on Earth. GGG - with Guy Shishio and the newly-constructed GaoFighGar - team up with their French counterpart Chasseur to battle the evil organization BioNet. Among Chasseur's ranks is Renais Cardiff Shishioh - a former BioNet cyborg with the relentless pursuit of destroying those who took away her humanity. But as GGG and Chasseur fight the BioNet, GGG's bases around the world are suddenly attacked, and the recently-discovered "Q-Parts" and the original Gao Machines are stolen by Mamoru Amami, who has been abducted and cloned by an even greater threat known as the "Eleven Kings of Sol." Evicted from Earth by the United Nations, GGG must now travel to the far reaches of the galaxy to battle the Eleven Kings of Sol and save Mamoru before it's too late.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience feels this remake is largely unnecessary. It offers very little new content and arguably diminishes the quality of the original, particularly in action sequences. Fans of the original characters may find some enjoyment, but the overall sentiment suggests viewers should stick with the original series.
pros: Great characters (if you like the original)
cons: Unnecessary remake
Downgraded action scenes compared to original
Adds fluff without expanding characters or plot
Wastes time with no substantial improvements

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie 2: Bonds
anime.synopsis:
Unleashing a devastating surprise attack, flying ninjas from the Land of Sky are seeking revenge against their old enemy Konohagakure. Despite his eagerness to join the fight, Naruto Uzumaki is held up by Shinnou, a mysterious doctor who requires his assistance to save an injured person. While delivering the wounded man to the hospital, Naruto has an unexpected encounter with Amaru—a stormy youngster from a neighboring village desperately looking for Shinnou's help.

Meanwhile, as the invaders withdraw to restore their forces, Tsunade seizes the opportunity to dispatch a small team including Sai, Shikamaru Nara, and Kakashi Hatake to strike down their base. Simultaneously, she commissions Naruto, Sakura Haruno, and Hinata Hyuuga to accompany Shinnou and Amaru on their journey. During this time, however, Orochimaru has his own schemes: he orders Sasuke Uchiha to bring him the doctor who specializes in the reincarnation technique.

As the escort group accidentally uncovers the sinister truth behind the attacks, tumultuous plans are set in motion. But even when confronted with an unforeseen reunion, Naruto does not waver in his endeavor to end the warfare and its disastrous effects.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many find the plot weak and characters underdeveloped, especially feeling that Sasuke's advertised role is misleading. However, some enjoy the action sequences and character interactions, particularly between Naruto and Sasuke, leading to a generally passable but flawed experience. The movie is seen as a decent time-waster for Naruto fans but ultimately unfulfilling.
pros: Well-animated fight scenes, a step up from the TV series.
Enjoyable character interactions, especially between Naruto and Sasuke.
Some found the plot twists surprising and the movie entertaining despite flaws.
cons: Messy, cliched, and weak plot with events coming out of nowhere.
Underdeveloped or pointless movie-only characters.
Inconsistent power levels and illogical plot elements.
Sasuke's inclusion feels forced and his role is minimal.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 12: Full Score of Fear
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 12: Senritsu no Full Score
anime.synopsis: Serial murders involving all kinds have happened. All the victims are from a Music School led by a famous pianist. Conan and company have been invited to a opening concert of the Music Hall built by the pianist. The biggest attraction of this concert is the world famous violin called "Stradivarius" and a special appearance of a singer who has perfect pitch.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Fans of classical music and character-driven stories tend to enjoy the movie, praising the soundtrack and the introduction of Akiba Reiko. However, others find the pacing slow and the mystery uninspired, especially if they are not fond of classical music. The movie is considered a decent but not outstanding entry in the Detective Conan franchise.
pros: Beautiful classical music soundtrack.
Interesting original character (Akiba Reiko) with good rapport with Conan.
Improved animation quality.
Smooth pacing.
cons: Slow pacing and can be boring for those who dislike classical music.
Case lacks cleverness.
Story potential not fully realized.
May feel like sensory overload from the music.
Deviation from the usual Conan series feel.

anime.title: Chrono Crusade: Azmaria's Lessons
anime.romaji_title: Chrno Crusade: Az demo Wakaru Chrno Crusade Kouza
anime.synopsis:
Azmaria Hendrick gives some background information on characters and the setting, with flashback scenes from the Chrno Crusade series itself.

Released with DVD volumes 2-12.
anime.consensus_summary: The "Chrno Crusade: Az demo Wakaru Chrno Crusade Kouza" specials are generally well-received as supplementary material for fans of the original series. They offer valuable insights into the historical and religious context, as well as character details, enhancing the viewing experience. However, the recycled animation and potential issues with Azmaria's voice acting are minor drawbacks. Overall, viewers find it a worthwhile addition, particularly for those seeking a deeper understanding of the Chrno Crusade universe.
pros: Provides background information on characters, setting, and religious themes.
Useful for viewers who may not understand the historical and religious context of the series.
Explains character traits and tools related to the series.
cons: Recycled animation clips from the original series.
Azmaria's voice acting may not appeal to all viewers.
Some explanations may be confusing or incomplete.

anime.title: .hack//G.U. Trilogy: Parody Mode
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Parody, Sci-Fi, Video Game
anime.synopsis: A special bonus Parody Mode added to the extras of the .hack//G.U. Trilogy
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the parody mode funny and enjoyable due to its humor and short length. However, the poor animation quality is a significant drawback, negatively impacting the overall experience. Despite this flaw, the mode is recommended for a good laugh.
pros: Enjoyable humor
Hilarious jokes and language
Short length prevents boredom
cons: Awful 3D CG animation
Mouth movements not synced to voice acting
Odd and unnatural movements

anime.title: Lucky☆Star OVA
anime.romaji_title: Lucky☆Star: Original na Visual to Animation
anime.synopsis: The OVA features six separate stories revolving around the cast, some of which border on the bizarre; one of which is an MMORPG environment being played by Konata, Kagami, Tsukasa, and Nanako Kuroi, and another in which Kagami has a "suggestive" dream about Konata.
anime.consensus_summary: The Lucky Star OVA is a mixed bag for fans of the series. While many appreciate its faithfulness to the original characters and humor, some find the lack of a strong plot and the inconsistent quality of the mini-episodes disappointing. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile watch for dedicated fans but may not appeal to newcomers or those seeking a more substantial narrative.
pros: Faithful to the original series' atmosphere and characters
Experimentation with different animation styles, like 3D CG for the MMORPG segment
Humorous references and parodies of anime, otaku, and game culture
cons: Lack of a coherent overarching plot; episodic nature may not appeal to all viewers
Uneven quality across mini-episodes; some segments are considered boring or confusing
Some felt that it lacked the charm of the original series, feeling like leftover scenes
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Parody, Otaku Culture

anime.title: The Old Crocodile
anime.synopsis:
A very old crocodile, so old that he had witnessed the building of the pyramids, was suffering from rheumatism, and no longer able to catch his food. In desperation, he decided to eat his great grand son. Although his thousands of years of longevity entitled him to much respect, the family decided he would have to be put down. 

Unable to bear the disrespect of his family, the old crocodile said goodbye to the Nile. One day the old crocodile met an octopus. The octopus treated her new friend to a variety of fish that she caught just for him. When the night fell, he couldn’t restrain himself from eating one of the octopus’s legs. Since then, the old crocodile began to help himself to the octopus’ leg every night…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating its fable-like quality and vocal performance, while others find it slow, confusing, and unsure of its target audience. The narrative lacks a clear moral and the art style isn't universally praised. Overall, it's considered a curiosity rather than a compelling work.
pros: Excellent English voicing, reminiscent of classic children's narration.
Potentially appealing to children due to its strangeness and fantastical elements.
Some find charm in the simple and childlike art style.
cons: Moral ambiguity may leave viewers confused.
Slow pacing and a linear narrative.
Unclear target audience.
Art style described as crude and not exceptional.

anime.title: Saiyuki Interactive
anime.synopsis: A mysterious light falls from the Heavens. It's the Pearl Jade. It can grant any wish. Dr. Ni tells Gyokumen Koushu about it. Lirin overhears and tells Kougaiji. Then Kanzeon Bosatsu (The Merciful Goddess) requests "orders" Sanzo and company to go and find and seal it before it falls into the wrong hands.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is considered a decent addition to the Saiyuuki series, exploring themes of redemption and consequences through a new character's backstory. While some appreciate the emotional depth and familiar dynamics, others find the plot predictable and repetitive. Overall, it's a recommended watch for fans of the series, though not a masterpiece.
pros: Interesting backstory of the girl with the pearl.
Touches on the theme of acceptance and consequences.
cons: Repetitive plot elements found in the original series.
Predictable outcome with a dying girl and Goku's sadness.

anime.title: Nodame Cantabile: Paris-hen
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Josei, Music, Performing Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Shinichi Chiaki conquers his fear of flying, and Megumi "Nodame" Noda's exceptional performance at a piano competition earns her an invitation to study at the prestigious Conservatoire de Paris. The pair go to Paris together to take the next step in their careers: Chiaki as a new rising conductor under the wing of the great maestro Franz von Stresemann, and Nodame as a pupil of the esteemed piano professor Charles Auclair.

But, of course, the music world is much bigger than the two of them could have ever imagined. Chiaki and Nodame, alongside old friends and new rivals, must fight and persevere to reach the dazzling musical heights that await them while never losing sight of what matters most.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the Paris chapter, praising the continued character development and music. However, many felt that the shorter length hampered the story and character development, especially for new characters. The inconsistent CGI and some plot choices were also points of criticism, resulting in a good, but not exceptional, sequel.
pros: Continues the character development from the first season, especially for Nodame and Chiaki.
Strong voice acting and excellent classical music selection.
Beautiful depiction of Paris and captures the atmosphere of the city.
cons: Feels rushed and compressed due to the shorter length (11 episodes).
New secondary characters are not as engaging or memorable as those from the first season.
Inconsistent CGI animation during musical performances.
Lack of romance between leads

anime.title: Someday's Dreamers II: Sora
anime.romaji_title: Mahoutsukai ni Taisetsu na Koto: Natsu no Sora
anime.genres: Fantasy, Iyashikei, Shounen, Slice of Life, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Get ready for a second magical journey to the world of Someday's Dreamers, where spellcasting is a profession that requires both the proper training AND a license. It's to get that license and fulfill a promise made to her late father that young Sora Suzuki has made the long journey from her distant home in the countryside town of Biei to the big city of Tokyo. It's a daunting challenge, but she's got a little bit of talent, a charming personality and, most important of all, the promise of an internship! What she ISN'T expecting, though, is how different life in the city will be, especially the people themselves. While she gets along with the confident Asagi, Kuroda and the gentle Hiyori, she's completely confused with the mysterious boy Gouta. And yet, as a result of their internships they keep ending up in the same situations and slowly learning to understand more about each other than they ever imagined possible!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many appreciate the show's gentle nature, beautiful visuals, and heartwarming story, finding it a pleasant slice-of-life experience. However, others are critical of the inconsistent animation, simplistic plot, and underdeveloped characters, resulting in a somewhat divisive reception. The ending is also a point of contention, with some finding it emotionally resonant and others considering it unnecessarily sad.
pros: Beautiful background art with a blend of realism and animation.
Soothing and well-integrated music.
Heartwarming and emotional story with relatable characters.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and use of recycled CG.
Simplistic and sometimes boring storyline.
Poorly developed supporting characters and rushed ending.

anime.title: Shenmue: The Movie
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis: Using scenes from the original SEGA Dreamcast game plus some extra made for the movie, Shenmue: the Movie details the events of the first game. After Ryo's father is murdered and a mysterious mirror taken, Ryo sets himself on a quest for revenge.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie serves as a condensed version of the first game's events, primarily appealing to newcomers as an introduction. Fans of the game may find it a nostalgic recap but not essential viewing. The impressive soundtrack and character design are highlights, though emotional expression is limited.
pros: Good overview for beginners of the game.
Soundtrack underlines the story well.
Character design is amazing (for its time).
cons: Not a must-see for those who've played the game.
Characters don't show their emotions as real people normally do.

anime.title: Brave of the Sun Fighbird
anime.synopsis:
An evil alien life form, Dryus, assaulted the Earth. The leader of Space Patrol, Fighbird, pursed Dryus to the Earth. Fighbird combined with an android that Dr. Amano was developing. Fighbird named Hidori Ryutaro and fight against Dryus to protect the peace of the Earth. 

At first look, he was a normal person, but because he was an alien, Fibird, his acts were a bit away from the normal persons'. Usually, he worked for Dr. Amano as an assistant. He looked uncouth always wearing while coat and glasses. However, once enemy appears, his personality changed dramatically.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally regards Taiyou no Yuusha Fighbird as an excellent entry in the Brave series, praised for its creative transformations, strong character development across a wide cast, and impactful music. While it doesn't quite reach the heights of its predecessor due to an unresolved narrative element, it's still seen as a high-quality show.
pros: Creative and unexpected transformation sequences ('man burning his skin off revealing a metal man')
Strong character development beyond just the main robot and boy, including family, a curious cop, and a nurse interested in the protagonist
Well-developed villains with a human/alien combination
Memorable and grand opening and ending themes, with an exceptional OST orchestration for the finisher
cons: Does not surpass previous series (Exkaiser) due to an unfulfilled narrative tease

anime.title: Candy Boy: Nonchalant Talk of the Certain Twin Sisters in Daily Life
anime.romaji_title: Candy Boy: Nonchalant Talk of the Certain Twin Sisters in Daily Life
anime.synopsis: Yukino and Kanade Sakurai are twin sisters that live together in a high school dorm. Although they are twins, they tend to act romantic toward each other, holding hands and going on dates. One day, Kanade sees Yukino hanging out with a new girl, Sakuya Kamiyama. Realizing how much time these two spend together, Kanade assumes they are dating, and she begins to distance herself from her sister. Yukino promptly notices and pleads with Kanade not to leave. In reality, Sakuya has only been asking for advice about Kanade, revealing her obsessive love. How will this love triangle play out?
anime.consensus_summary: Candy Boy is generally well-received as a cute and innocent slice-of-life anime with a yuri romance. While some find the plot lacking and the relationship unrealistic, most appreciate the sweet and heartwarming portrayal of the characters and their bond. The series is recommended for fans of yuri and slice-of-life genres who are not bothered by the incestuous theme.
pros: Innocent and heartwarming portrayal of a yuri relationship
Well-developed and likeable characters, especially the main twins
Visually appealing art and animation, with attention to detail
cons: The plot can be slow-paced and uneventful
Some find the lack of explicit romance disappointing
Repetitive still-pictures and animation inconsistencies

anime.title: Yozakura Quartet
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Mythology, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
The world of Yozakura Quartet is actually not one, but two worlds: one of humans, and one of youkai. Despite appearing mostly human, youkai may have animal like physical traits, along with a number of special abilities. Normally youkai are confined to their world, but some have found their way into the realm of humanity. As a symbol of peace, and a bridge between the two realms, a city was constructed within the protective barrier of seven magical trees, otherwise known as the Seven Pillars. This city of Sakurashin is home to both humans and youkai, with the peace between them maintained by the Hizumi Life Counseling Office.

The director of this office is Akina Hiizumi, a teenager with the inherited family ability to perform “tuning,” which can send harmful youkai back to their world permanently. He is aided by a group of girls, including the town’s 16 year old youkai mayor, Hime Yarizakura, their town’s announcer and resident telepath, Ao Nanami, and Kotoha Isone, a half-youkai who can summon objects just by stating the object’s name.

As new residents enter and mysterious events begin to take place, this quartet of protectors and their closest friends must continue to guard the city of Sakurashin, and maintain the fragile balance of peace between humans and youkai.
anime.consensus_summary: The general sentiment is disappointment due to unrealized potential. Reviewers highlight strong initial promise that quickly fades due to poor storytelling, underdeveloped characters, and a rushed plot. While the animation and sound receive praise, these elements are not enough to compensate for the narrative shortcomings, leading to a generally negative reception.
pros: Good animation quality, especially during fight scenes.
Impressive sound design and voice acting.
Interesting character designs.
cons: Poorly explained plot with disjointed storytelling.
Underdeveloped characters with little to no growth.
Inconsistent pacing and rushed plot development.
Unresolved plot lines and unsatisfying ending.

anime.title: Legends of the Dark King: A Fist of the North Star Story
anime.romaji_title: Hokuto no Ken: Raoh Gaiden Ten no Haoh
anime.synopsis: In the wastelands following the great nuclear war, a legend grew of a man.  “Hokuto No Ken.”  The Fist of the North Star.  Master of a legendary fighting technique.  A man of impossible strength and endurance.  Yet before Ken claimed the title of the Fist, there was another master, trained in the art of Hokuto Shinken, the King of the Fist, the Divine Fist of Heaven.  Raoh: the ultimate assassin, the ultimate warrior.  This is the story of the world before Fist of the North Star, and how one man took the future of a savage world into his deadly hands and reshaped its destiny.  Not as a hero but as a conqueror.  For in the mind of the man called Raoh, the only way to save Mankind is to grind it under his giant heel!  The greatest battle is about to begin in Legends of the Dark King ~ Fist of the North Star!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about 'Hokuto no Ken: Raoh Gaiden Ten no Haoh.' While some appreciate the focus on Raoh's backstory and the strong soundtrack, others are disappointed by the subpar animation, repetitive scenes, and attempts to make Raoh more likable. Prior knowledge of the main series is recommended before watching this prequel. Overall, it's considered a decent but not exceptional addition to the Hokuto no Ken franchise.
pros: Enjoyable story focused on Raoh's rise to power.
Strong and grandiose soundtrack.
Nice voice acting, especially Raoh's voice.
cons: Subpar animation quality and basic character designs.
Repetitive scenes and predictable plot.
Over-the-top glorification of Raoh, making him less nuanced.

anime.title: Hyakko
anime.synopsis: On their first day of high school shy Ayumi Nonomura and taciturn Tatsuki Iizuka become lost on the immense campus of Kamizono Academy. An irresistible force of nature named Torako Kageyama accompanied by her best friend Suzume Saotome appears in front of them. Led, sometimes pushed, by Torako, the girls and their classmates work through problems of school, home and adolescence.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Hyakko are mixed. While some appreciate the character-driven comedy and touching moments, others find the plot lacking and the humor generic. The show is considered a decent slice-of-life anime with a strong cast, but it ultimately fails to stand out due to its inconsistent execution and missed potential.
pros: Well-developed and diverse cast of characters with distinct personalities
Situational comedy derived from mundane situations
Occasional touching moments and character development, especially in later episodes
Good use of classical music as background music
cons: Inconsistent animation quality with shortcuts
Weak or forgettable soundtrack
Plot is lacking or non-existent, episodes can blend together
Comedy can be generic or fall flat; show tries too hard to be funny at times
Uneven pacing; slow start and rushed ending
Missed potential for meaningful drama
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, School Comedy, Character-Driven

anime.title: Earl and Fairy
anime.genres: Adventure, Historical, Mythology, Romance, Shoujo, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: In the nineteenth century, we find Lydia Carlton living in Scotland, making a living as a fairy doctor. She is one of those rare humans who can see and communicate with fairies. But no one believes her. However, Edgar is in need of someone with a vast knowledge of fairy lore, and Lydia is just that person. After rescuing her, he becomes her employer, but there are many secrets and emotions that seem to follow Edgar, who claims to be the Blue Knight's Earl.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with viewers appreciating the unique Victorian fairy tale setting and likeable protagonist, but criticizing the incomplete plot, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent animation. While some found the series charming and enjoyable, others were left disappointed by the lack of resolution and shallow romance. Overall, the anime is considered a passable shoujo fantasy but requires additional content from the manga or light novels for a complete experience.
pros: Charming and unique fairy tale setting in Victorian England.
Likeable protagonist in Lydia, who isn't a typical shoujo heroine.
Beautiful art style and character designs.
Interesting story with action/adventure, romance and fantasy elements.
Music complements the time period and enhances suspenseful scenes.
cons: Incomplete or rushed plot, leaving many questions unanswered.
Underdeveloped or generic supporting characters.
Inconsistent animation quality and overuse of pan-and-scan techniques.
Romance progresses slowly, lacking real chemistry or satisfying resolution.
Stereotypical shoujo elements may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Bakukyuu Hit! Crash B-Daman
anime.synopsis:
Hitto Tamaga living on his own after his father had gone missing, receives a Crash B-Daman, his first B-Daman, as his birthday present from his missing father.

"Crash your adversity!"

Holding this message from his father in his heart, Hitto makes up his mind to participate in B-Daman battle tournament called "B-1 Crash Cup."
Through the battles, Hitto encounters a lot of rivals and sometimes develops friendships with them.
After the tournament, he comes to know about a secret society of rascal B-ders who find reason for living only in crashing. What is their true purpose? And what secret is there behind Hitto's B-Daman?
Go! Fight, Hitto! Crash the evils and grab your future in your own hand!
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is considered childish with some inconsistent plot elements. While Hitto's journey and the challenges he faces provide some entertainment, the story suffers from plot holes and mediocre animation. The overall reception is lukewarm, with reviewers pointing out inconsistencies and a lack of resolution for key plot points.
pros: Hitto faces challenges that make the show interesting.
cons: Mediocre art and animation quality.
Inconsistencies and plot holes in the story, such as the 7 B-Daman warriors and Teruma's character shift.
Lack of focus on tournaments after a while.
Unresolved plot points, like Hitto's dream and the role of JBA.

anime.title: Gurren Lagann The Movie: The Lights in the Sky are Stars
anime.romaji_title: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann Movie 2: Lagann-hen
anime.synopsis:
Humans have enjoyed their lavish, peaceful, and prosperous lives for seven years since the day the almighty Spiral King was defeated—the day they reclaimed their homeland, Earth. However, the boon of this lifestyle leaves them unprepared when an unknown, hostile threat arises due to the ever-growing human population. This calamity is the Anti-Spiral—a fearsome enemy with unparalleled power. 
 
As the Spiral King's prognosis postulating the destruction of "The Spiral's World" begins to come true, the pieces are in place, and Team Dai-Gurren is ready. With his late brother's hope to see a better future for mankind, Simon—along with Nia Teppelin and the rest of the team—is determined to overthrow the mighty Anti-Spiral in order to revive humanity's lost hope.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally praises the movie for its improved ending and updated visuals, considering it a worthwhile addition to the series. However, some viewers criticize the condensed storytelling, inconsistent music, and fan service elements. While some find the changes enhance the story, others feel they detract from the original's emotional impact and character development, but overall the movie is well-received.
pros: Spectacular and improved final battle with updated visuals and animation.
Satisfying conclusion and character treatment, addressing pacing issues of the original series.
Addition of new scenes and alterations enhance the story, depth, and character development for a better experience compared to the anime.
cons: Condensed storytelling leads to loss of important subplots and character development from the original series.
Inconsistent music timing and low volume diminish the emotional impact compared to the series.
Reliance on fan service elements, like excessive nudity, detracts from the story's emotional resonance.

anime.title: Corpse Princess: Aka
anime.synopsis:
Living at a shrine with other orphans, Ouri Kagami is no stranger to corpses. But when he sees the patron of his orphanage, Keisei Tagami, seemingly revive the scarred corpse of schoolgirl Makina Hoshimura, he cannot help but feel incredibly shocked.

Intrigued by the mysterious circumstances surrounding Makina, he learns that she is a Shikabane Hime—an undead being tasked with eliminating others like her who pose a threat to society. As Ouri goes about his daily life, his inexplicable run-ins with her are shrouded in abnormality. But as each encounter grows more intense, the two are brought closer together, and it may be their intertwining fates that hold the key to unveiling the secrets behind the world of Shikabanes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the series enjoyable for its action, characters, and exploration of deeper themes, while others criticize its slow start, uneven pacing, and reliance on familiar tropes. The series improves significantly in its second half, but its initial episodes may deter some viewers. Overall, it's considered a decent but not exceptional anime with potential that isn't fully realized.
pros: Well-developed main characters with depth.
Fluid and stylish action scenes.
Interesting premise exploring themes of death, regret, and humanity.
Engaging plot development, especially in the second half.
Exploration of complex relationships between Shikabane Himes and their monks.
cons: Uneven pacing with a slow start and rushed ending.
Inconsistent animation quality with some sloppy scenes.
Underdeveloped side characters.
Generic or cliché story elements.
Over-reliance on fan service and skimpy outfits.

anime.title: I love BuBu ChaCha
anime.synopsis: The anime talks about a little boy, Randy, whose dog, Chacha, died in an accident and was reincarnated into a living toy car. Each episode is told like the chapter of a storybook, where Randy learns a valuable thing in life with his cartoonish and goofy friend Chacha. Randy meets several friends in his neighbourhood, such as Catherine, the tall blonde girl in red long socks who rides a bicycle, or Mary, a little hot-tempered brunette girl dressed as a maid and who carries around a mop.
anime.consensus_summary: Daisuki! BuBu ChaCha evokes strong feelings of nostalgia and warmth, particularly for viewers who grew up watching it. The simple, heartwarming stories are seen as suitable for family viewing. While the animation may appear dated to modern audiences, the show's emotional core continues to resonate with many.
pros: Simple yet touching stories
Good for family viewing
Nostalgic value for those who watched it as children
cons: Visually dated
Simple plot may not appeal to older viewers

anime.title: Yoiko
anime.synopsis: Her name is Esumi Fuuka. Standing tall at 163 cm with a slender bodyline, she must be a university undergraduate; however, in reality, she is only an elementary school student. With a body figure of an adult and the mentality of a small child, she creates many misunderstandings around her.
anime.consensus_summary: Yoiko is a divisive ecchi comedy due to its lewd scenes involving an elementary school student. While some find the premise and characters funny, others criticize the poorly timed comedy, bland characters, and tonal inconsistencies. The basic art and animation also detract from the experience, making it a difficult recommendation despite its potentially humorous premise.
pros: Funny situations due to misunderstandings
Characters are crazy and entertaining
Naive soul and unusual ideas contribute to comedy
cons: Comedy is poorly timed and jokes are flat
Characters are bland
Tonal whiplash between ecchi and grade-school comedy
Art and animation are basic and lack style

anime.title: Ride Back
anime.synopsis: In the future, an organization called the GGP has taken control of the world. Rin Ogata was a promising up-and-coming ballet dancer, but suffered a serious injury while dancing and decided to quit. Years later in college, she comes across a club building and soon finds herself intrigued by a transforming motorcycle-like robotic vehicle called a "Rideback". She soon finds that her unique ballet skills with balance and finesse make her a born natural on a Rideback. However, those same skills also get her into serious trouble with the government.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards RideBack is divided. While many praise the animation, sound, and initial character focus, a significant portion feels let down by the shift in plot and lack of character development. The series is seen as having great potential that was ultimately squandered due to pacing issues and unresolved storylines, leading to both strong praise and bitter disappointment.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation quality, particularly the fluid CG animation of the Ridebacks.
Well-coordinated music and sound design enhances emotional impact and action sequences.
Compelling exploration of the main character Rin's development and struggles.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and abrupt shift in focus from character-driven narrative to military conflict.
Underdeveloped secondary characters and lack of depth in the political/terrorist conflict.
Unresolved plot points and rushed ending leave a feeling of incompleteness.

anime.title: Cobra The Animation: The Psycho-Gun
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Adventure, Mecha, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Space
anime.synopsis: When Utopia More discovers an ancient record that holds the key to unlocking the secrets of the universe, she becomes the target of the ruthless Gypsy Doc of the Pirate Guild. Utopia finds herself saved by the easy-going yet legendary space pirate, Cobra, whose custom made Psychogun makes him a force to be reckoned with. Together, the two of them attempt to stop Gypsy Doc (along with Cobra's revived arch-nemesis, Crystal Boy) and his efforts to steal the record and use its secrets to rule the universe.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Fans of the original Cobra series appreciate the return of the character and the nostalgic elements, but are critical of the animation inconsistencies and weaker storyline. New viewers may find it appealing as an introduction to the Cobra universe, while others find the story unengaging and the animation outdated. Overall, the Psycho-Gun OVA is a decent but flawed revival of the Cobra franchise.
pros: Faithful to the original Cobra character and universe.
Gorgeous animation and cinematic storytelling.
Nostalgic appeal with original voice actors returning.
cons: Inconsistent CGI quality.
Subtle and less impactful soundtrack compared to the original anime.
Anti-climactic final battle and lack of villain depth.
Flabby direction and uninteresting story.
anime.thematic_vibe: Retro-Pulp Adventure, Space Opera, Chivalrous Heroism

anime.title: A Certain Magical Index
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Academy City, Japan, is at the forefront of science. Besides being 30 years ahead of the world technologically, more than three-fourths of this peculiar city's population consists of students developing their psychic abilities as espers in various institutions. Among these students is Touma Kamijou, a high school boy with the lowest psychic rank of zero, but with a mysterious power no scientist can understand: "Imagine Breaker," which allows him to negate other supernatural abilities.
 
This, however, doesn't affect Kamijou's life in the least as he plays his role as a regular teenager; that is, until he meets the strange Index Librorum Prohibitorum, a young girl who has memorized the entirety of the forbidden grimoires, and now a dangerous organization is hunting Index down. With several magicians looking to harm the girl, Kamijou will defend his new companion at all costs as he discovers a strange new realm of the supernatural.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, appreciating the initial concept and some character-focused arcs, while criticizing the disjointed plot and shallow character development. The series is considered entertaining but falls short of its potential due to inconsistent storytelling. Many feel the anime requires a sequel to tie up loose ends and provide a more cohesive narrative.
pros: Interesting concept of science vs. magic.
Enjoyable mini-arcs with character development.
Good animation and art style.
cons: Episodic plot with lack of a main antagonist.
Poor story execution and pacing issues.
Underdeveloped and two-dimensional characters.

anime.title: Arad Senki: Slap Up Party
anime.synopsis: The anime will follow the adventures of Baron, a man living on continent of Arad in the year 981 after "the cursed light of Kazan" has fallen across the land. Thanks to the curse, one of his arms has become possessed. After finding a sword that has been possessed by the spirit Roxy, he embarks on a quest to unravel the secret of the curse and meets various people who also join his party.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many acknowledging the show's flaws but still finding it enjoyable due to its humor and characters. Fans of the original DFO game are more likely to appreciate the anime despite its shortcomings. The show's simplicity and lighthearted tone appeal to some, while others find the plot and character development lacking.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions and comedy
Faithful to the source material (Dungeon Fighter Online)
Unique 'Party Call' humor
cons: Generic and poorly developed plot
Inconsistent character development
Stiff animation and average art quality

anime.title: Neo Angelique Abyss: Second Age
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Josei, Reverse Harem, Romance
anime.synopsis: Continuing where the first season left off, the sudden increase of Thanatos with the disappearance of the Aube Hunters has now left Arcadia in ruin. Desperation reigns high as the Religious Organization fights to battle the Thanatos. Six months had already past since Hidamari mansion burned to ashes, the Aube Hunters, once hailed as heroes, is now blamed for the appearance of Thanatos. Nevertheless, hope still exists for the reappearance of the Queen's Egg one day, who will become the savior of Arcadia. Unknown to many however, the Aube Hunters have actually been silently waiting for the awakening of Angelique, who has been asleep the entire time.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed Neo Angelique Abyss: Second Age, especially if they were fans of the first season. Many viewers found the story engaging and the characters well-developed. However, some felt the plot was predictable and wished for more significant character development.
pros: Story and plot are well written
Interesting scenes that keep you wanting more
Soundtrack and music are top quality
cons: Episodes are predictable
Heroine doesn't improve much
Some dullness carries over from the first season

anime.title: Battle B-Daman: Fire Spirits!
anime.synopsis:
It is not uncommon to wish upon shooting stars. But for B-DaPlayers all around the world, what they seek is not for their wishes to be granted. Gazing upon what many would assume are just rocks shrunk to the size of a pebble by atmospheric entry and fallen to the earth, the fated ones see instead what are known as Strike Shots—powerful marbles originating from the vast and mystical outer space. 

After achieving triumph in the war against his ultimate foes, Yamato Daiwa continues his journey as a rising B-DaPlayer, looking to obtain a new power worthy of his improved battle gear.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys B-Daman Fire Spirits, considering it a step up from the first season. Viewers appreciate the improved sound and character designs. While some find the story predictable, the exciting battles and friendship themes provide an enjoyable experience, especially for those who enjoyed the original B-Daman series and similar shows.
pros: Improved sound design compared to the first season.
Returning characters with design changes that fit their personalities.
Exciting battles and interesting concept of Strike Shots.
cons: Art style is not super but not bad either, somewhere in between old school and modern.
The story can be predictable at times.

anime.title: Ghost in the Shell 2.0
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Detective, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Set in the year 2029 and following World Wars III and IV, a Japanese-led Asian block dominates world affairs. The alliance maintains its international supremacy through its elite security force whose cybernetically enhanced operatives tackle an array of hi-tech terrorists and other threats to international security. These augmented agents can "ghost hack" (i.e., download their consciousness) via the now omnipresent internet into other machines and human/machine cross breeds.

Major Motoko Kusanagi, a cybernetically augmented female agent, has been tracking a virtual entity known as the Puppet Master with her crack squad of security agents. The shape-shifting Puppet Master, a rogue creation of a rival agency of the security apparatus, has concluded that it is a life form in its own right, "born in sea of information," and requested political asylum and true physical existence in defiance of its creators.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling the 2.0 version diminishes the original's impact. The improved audio is a noted positive, but the jarring CGI integration and unnecessary alterations are major points of criticism. Most reviewers suggest sticking with the original 1995 version for the best experience.
pros: Improved audio quality enhances the viewing experience.
Faithful to the original story with minor tweaks.
Digitally cleaned film with enhanced visuals (in some areas).
cons: Inconsistent integration of 3D CGI with original 2D animation creates a jarring experience.
Unnecessary changes, like the orange/red color tinting, detract from the original's aesthetic.
Re-edited scenes with minor trims that add nothing to the experience.
CGI replacements of iconic animated scenes are considered sacrilegious by some fans.

anime.title: Scarecrowman
anime.synopsis: A regular old scarecrow has stood in a field for twenty years when one day, after a lightning storm, he comes to life. He becomes friends with the daughter of a scarecrow shop owner.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime "Scarecrowman" is viewed as a wholesome and unique children's show, praised for its positive themes and interesting premise. However, the unusual animation style and lack of a clear plot might not appeal to all viewers. Its obscurity and difficulty in finding it online also pose a challenge for potential audiences.
pros: Wholesome and positive experience
Unique premise of a sentient scarecrow
Enjoyable for those who like slice-of-life style shows
cons: Odd 3D CGI animation style
Lack of a specific plot or end goal
Difficult to find online

anime.title: Takane's Bicycle
anime.synopsis: An 11-year-old boy, Takasumi Takane, will be given a new bicycle if his exam results are in the top 100, but his results put him in 112th place. He tells his mother a lie that he placed 92nd, and he tears the answer sheets apart. On his way home from cram school, he accidently breaks the old bicycle that he is supposed to hand down to his little sister, Tamaki. This angers Tamaki. Furthermore, Tamaki accuses him of telling a lie, and he begins to think of her as a nuisance. One night, when he goes to a shrine to look for his missing dog, Chris, he encounters a young man named Yoyogi. Somehow, Yoyogi has the answer sheet marked as “92nd." Yoyogi proposes a trade, but threatens to return the answer sheet to its original owner unless he is given something Takane doesn't need. Takane offers him his sister, Tamaki. At that very moment, Tamaki arrives, searching for Takane and Chris. Yoyogi turns Tamaki into a shining object and swallows her. Takane decides that he was wrong and wants to save her. Yoyogi agrees to restore Tamaki to her original form if Takane wins a race against him, with his broken bicycle. Can Takane win the race rescue Tamaki?
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is appreciated for its original story and voice acting, but suffers from weak character development typical of single-episode OVAs and inconsistent production quality. Viewers find the supernatural elements intriguing, but the emotional impact is lessened by the technical flaws. Overall, it's a decent effort given its origin as a scriptwriting competition winner, but not without its shortcomings.
pros: Original plot with otherworldly elements.
Strong voice acting, especially Sakamoto Maaya as Takane.
cons: Weak character development due to the single-episode OVA format.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Music and sound effects are sometimes out of sync and do not reflect the scene's mood.

anime.title: White Album
anime.synopsis:
Can a relationship between a regular college student and an idol singer survive? That is the question that White Album tries to answer. Touya Fujii is a normal college student with normal worries—namely balancing his classes and his job he works to pay for school. He is also concerned about the amount of time he has to spend with Yuki Morikawa, or rather, the lack of it.

Being an up and coming idol singer, Yuki has concerns of her own. Even though she's not yet as popular as experienced veteran Rina Ogata, Yuki is turning heads and landing interviews on television. This should be a good thing, but not everyone is happy about the attention she receives from the media and from Rina. The idol industry is surprisingly cutthroat, and rival singers have their eyes on Yuki.

While it may seem exciting to watch your girlfriend on television, how does Touya really feel about all this? Between the challenges associated with Yuki's career and other people that Touya meets at his university, their relationship may not last…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on White Album are divided, with some praising its realistic portrayal of complex relationships and flawed characters, while others criticize its slow pacing, unlikable protagonist, and frustrating narrative choices. Some appreciate the emotional depth and unique storytelling, while others find it to be a tedious and unfulfilling experience. The series is considered underrated by some, while others find its low rating justified.
pros: Realistic portrayal of relationship struggles and infidelity.
Well-developed characters with flaws and relatable emotions.
Excellent music and voice acting, enhancing emotional impact.
Unique storytelling approach with inner thoughts displayed on screen.
Art style that adapts to the scene's mood, including pastel and caricatures.
cons: Slow pacing and lack of suspense can make the story feel uneventful.
Protagonist is often seen as weak and unlikable.
Multiple subplots detract from the main storyline.
Inconsistent character development.
Ambiguous ending leaving viewers without closure

anime.title: Skip Beat!
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, Shoujo, Showbiz
anime.synopsis:
Day in and day out, Kyouko Mogami works multiple jobs to support her childhood friend, Shoutarou "Shou" Fuwa, in his rise to stardom as an idol. She never complains about her way of life, as she is deeply infatuated with Shou and would go to the ends of the world for him. However, her heart is broken when she overhears Shou talk about how he views her as nothing more than a maid he cares little for. 

Angered over being used, Kyouko flies into a rage and swears to get revenge on her former crush by entering the world of showbiz to surpass him. Joining the relentless and unforgiving entertainment industry proves to be a challenge, as she continuously meets people who force her out of her comfort zone. But for the sake of vengeance, Kyouko is determined to push herself and rise to the top.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Skip Beat! is well-received, particularly for its strong female lead and engaging storyline that blends comedy and drama. However, the anime's incomplete ending and animation quality are points of criticism. The audience generally enjoys the character development and humor, making it a recommended watch despite its flaws.
pros: Strong female lead with unique and expressive character design.
Well-balanced comedy and drama with engaging plot.
Excellent voice acting and fitting soundtrack.
Focus on character growth and development.
cons: Incomplete story with a cliffhanger ending.
Poor animation quality with low frame rates and overuse of chibi.
Pacing issues with lingering on unimportant events.
Art style can be off-putting.

anime.title: Ga-Rei-Zero
anime.genres: Action, Gore, Shounen, Super Power, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
In Japan, there exists a government agency known as the Supernatural Disaster Countermeasures Division (SDCD), whose duty is to protect the citizens from creatures unseen. They are able to dispatch these monsters swiftly and without alerting the general public. But currently, they face a different challenge: the betrayal of one of their own.

After the death of her mother several years ago, Kagura Tsuchimiya has been fostered by the Isayama family and forms a close sister-like bond with their daughter Yomi. The two become inseparable, and together they work for the SDCD as highly skilled exorcists. However, as the stress and consequences of their sacred duty weigh on them both, and family politics come into play, Kagura and Yomi begin to slowly drift apart. One of them grows earnestly into her role as an exorcist, and the other heads down a dark path from which there may be no redemption.
anime.consensus_summary: Ga-Rei: Zero is highly praised for its compelling story, emotional depth, and character development, particularly the tragic relationship between the two leads. While some criticize the initial episodes and CGI quality, the overall consensus is that the series is a must-watch for fans of action and drama. The show's ability to evoke strong emotions and deliver unexpected plot twists contributes to its positive reception.
pros: Strong character development, especially between Kagura and Yomi.
Well-written plot with surprising twists and turns.
Excellent soundtrack and sound design that enhances the emotional impact.
cons: Mediocre CGI, particularly in early episodes.
Underdeveloped supporting characters.
Initial episodes can be misleading or confusing.

anime.title: Tower of Druaga: The Sword of Uruk
anime.romaji_title: Druaga no Tou: The Sword of Uruk
anime.synopsis:
With broken spirits and enigmatic questions that hold no answers lingering, Jil is still trying to figure everything out. Then, a mysterious girl named Kai appears before him and says: "Take me to the top of the tower."

Kai's request shrouded in ambiguity, Jil will have another chance to work towards completing his destiny and ascend the Tower. With his hopes and aspirations seemingly slipping out of his hands, Jil must rise to the challenge once again on this never-ending adventure.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the series enjoyable due to character development and adventure, while others criticize the predictable story, weak characters, and poor animation quality. Many feel the second season fails to live up to the potential set by the first, with plot holes and a lack of satisfying resolutions. There's a general sense of disappointment in the writing and execution, though some appreciate the music and certain character designs.
pros: Addition of new characters and expansion of previous ones adds depth.
Enjoyable and easily watchable adventure with a nice atmosphere.
Good opening and ending songs that draw you into the world.
cons: Predictable story with a simplistic and happy-go-lucky ending.
Characters are weak and not fleshed out, making it hard to care for them.
Excessive use of CGI and bad animated faces detract from the art quality.
Unimaginative fights lacking animational potency.
The main character is insufferably stupid and naive on occasion

anime.title: Eagle Talon
anime.synopsis: Eagle Talon is a secret society based in Kojimachi, Tokyo. With plans for world domination, their attempts are continually foiled by Deluxe Fighter, the superhero who always manages to save the day. This comedy of their frivolous lives is definitely not to be missed!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the show's absurd humor and unique animation style, drawing comparisons to Aqua Teen Hunger Force.  The low budget, one-man production is seen as part of its charm. While not for everyone, those who appreciate absurdist comedy will likely find it entertaining. The show has a niche following but doesn't seem to generate significant controversy.
pros: Humorous take on world domination plots.
Unique and recognizable art style.
One-man production creates a distinct feel.
Appeals to fans of Aqua Teen Hunger Force
cons: Crude animation style may not appeal to all viewers.
Humor may be too absurd for some audiences.

anime.title: Let's Dance with Papa
anime.synopsis: Imagine two irresponsible siblings (Fuko and Yoshiharu) living under the care of an equally or more irresponsible father (Amachi). Then add some bizarre stuff, like cobras, bad jokes, adult videos, seductive grannies, farting, stupid remarks and insults, terribly foul language, and a nonsensical plethora of strange happenings...
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally find "Papa to Odorou" to be a stupid, nonsensical comedy with a lot of black humor and foul language. Some viewers find the crude humor and over-the-top characters hilarious, especially when enhanced by dubbing in their language. While not for everyone, those who enjoy this type of comedy tend to enjoy it a lot.
pros: The comedy is sensational and makes the reviewer laugh a lot.
The characters are idiotic and funny.
cons: The anime is extremely stupid and full of black humor (though some find this funny).
The anime is full of swear words (though some find this funnier).

anime.title: The Hill Dyed Rose Madder
anime.synopsis:
Yuuhi Katagiri is not your average girl – she's the treasured daughter of the Katagiri family. She's generally kept under strict supervision, but one day ends up walking home from school on her own. This proves to be instant trouble when a group of boys start harassing her. Junichi Nagase, who was on his way home from a convenience store, sees the troubled Yuuhi and comes to her rescue. One of the boys recognized Junichi as the famed "Geno Killer" and they dash off. Yuuhi thanks Junichi and when she asked for his name, he just waves and leaves. Of course, he regrets trying to act cool in front of the beautiful girl right away, wishing he asked her name.

The following day, a transfer student joins Junichi's class – it's Yuuhi! She calls Junichi out as the "Geno Killer", the only name she remembers him by, and rumors about the two spread quickly. Matters are made worse when Junichi kisses Yuuhi due to a misunderstanding. And on top of all that, it turns out that Junichi is Yuuhi's fiancé!

Yuuhi doesn't see Junichi as someone worthy. But, she could not go against her father's wishes. The only thing that Yuuhi can do is live with Junichi in the house he shares with his little sister Minato, and prove that Junichi is not worthy to be her husband. Will she succeed in proving his unworthiness, or will she fall in love on the way?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in the familiar tropes and high production values. However, many are critical of the clichéd storyline, weak character development, and the controversial incestuous elements. The ending is particularly divisive, praised by some for its unexpectedness but criticized by others for feeling rushed and unsatisfying.
pros: Good voice acting and music, especially the ending themes.
Attractive character designs and animation quality.
Unexpected ending that deviates from typical romance tropes (though polarizing).
cons: Clichéd and predictable plot elements, especially in filler episodes.
Inconsistent character development and unlikable characters.
Controversial incestuous undertones and a rushed, unsatisfying ending.

anime.title: Vampire Knight Guilty
anime.genres: Drama, Love Polygon, Mystery, Romance, Shoujo, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
When the missing Zero Kiryuu returns to Cross Academy, Yuuki Cross is relieved to see him safe, but finds that Zero has changed in more ways than one. As a result of choices he made, Zero is plagued by visions, and he seeks to uncover the reason behind them—unaware that the answers may be much closer than he thinks.

Soon Yuuki also begins to be tormented by ghastly hallucinations, and she seeks an explanation about her shrouded past from the only one who can provide clarity: Pureblood vampire Kaname Kuran, who is closest to her heart. But what will happen when the truth is finally revealed?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with Vampire Knight Guilty, finding the plot convoluted, the characters irritating, and the ending unsatisfying. Many feel the series failed to live up to the potential of the first season. While some appreciate the soundtrack and certain character developments, the prevailing sentiment is negative, criticizing the overused tropes and lack of narrative depth.
pros: Soundtrack is excellent and fitting.
Some compelling character depth for Kaname, Zero, and Ichirou.
Build-up to the final events is better than season 1.
Art style is decent and consistent.
cons: Storyline is boring, repetitive, and confusing.
Yuki is an unbearable, weak, and annoying character.
Love triangle is poorly developed and angsty.
Ending is rushed, disappointing, and doesn't follow the manga well.
Villain is underdeveloped and easily defeated.
Plot relies on incestuous relationships.

anime.title: Aria the Origination Episode 5.5: That Little Secret Place…
anime.romaji_title: Aria the Origination: Sono Choppiri Himitsu no Basho ni...
anime.synopsis: With Aria Company closed for the day and her friends attending to other matters, Akari Mizunashi seizes this rare opportunity to go on a casual outing around Neo-Venezia with President Aria Pokoteng. Although her Prima Undine gondola training has taken her to many remarkable tourist spots, Akari finds greater exhilaration reveling in the ordinary sights and sounds of the town. As Akari and President Aria stroll through Neo-Venezia on their own exciting itinerary, some familiar faces are not far behind. Drawn into their private tour, they too may discover a new perspective of the city.
