Character development was lacking, with most characters being shallow and stereotypical.

anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
After a horrific alchemy experiment goes wrong in the Elric household, brothers Edward and Alphonse are left in a catastrophic new reality. Ignoring the alchemical principle banning human transmutation, the boys attempted to bring their recently deceased mother back to life. Instead, they suffered brutal personal loss: Alphonse's body disintegrated while Edward lost a leg and then sacrificed an arm to keep Alphonse's soul in the physical realm by binding it to a hulking suit of armor.

The brothers are rescued by their neighbor Pinako Rockbell and her granddaughter Winry. Known as a bio-mechanical engineering prodigy, Winry creates prosthetic limbs for Edward by utilizing "automail," a tough, versatile metal used in robots and combat armor. After years of training, the Elric brothers set off on a quest to restore their bodies by locating the Philosopher's Stone—a powerful gem that allows an alchemist to defy the traditional laws of Equivalent Exchange.

As Edward becomes an infamous alchemist and gains the nickname "Fullmetal," the boys' journey embroils them in a growing conspiracy that threatens the fate of the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood is widely praised for its adherence to the manga and engaging storyline, though some find its pacing rushed and plot elements simplistic. The series evokes strong emotions and explores complex themes, but tonal inconsistencies may detract from its overall impact for some viewers. Overall, it maintains a strong positive reception, but some viewers have criticism about the story.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga storyline.
Strong emotional connection with characters and their struggles.
Well-paced and suspenseful narrative.
cons: Initial pacing may feel rushed for those familiar with the original series.
Some viewers find the plot and characters too simplistic.
Tonal inconsistencies that detract from the narrative's impact.

anime.title: The Melancholy of Haruhi-chan Suzumiya
anime.synopsis: A parody series featuring the entire cast of The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya in a smaller form factor.  Among the changes are: Yuki plays eroge, Haruhi is even more obnoxiuous and loud, Mikuru is even more emotional and Koizumi harbors a deep love for Kyon.  Kyon, on the other hand, is generally the same as ever.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Haruhi-chan" as a lighthearted parody of the original series, appreciating the comedic takes on familiar characters and scenarios. The short episode format and returning voice cast are praised. However, some find the humor inconsistent, the lack of plot or development disappointing, and the reliance on prior knowledge of the original series a barrier to entry.  Ultimately, it is seen as a fun, but non-essential, addition to the Haruhi Suzumiya franchise.
pros: Enjoyable parody of the original series with comedic spin.
Original voice cast returns and performs well.
Short episodes make it easy to watch and kill time.
Many forgotten side characters get moments to shine.
cons: Lacks substantial plot or character development.
Humor can be hit-or-miss, with some jokes falling flat.
Some animation quality issues, particularly in early episodes (3D vs 2D).
Relies heavily on prior knowledge of the original series.

anime.title: Zentrix
anime.synopsis:
The series is set in Zentrix City, a seemingly "perfect" city. Emperor Jarad is a scientist who with the help of scientists Dr. Roark and Dr. Coy, created a super-computer called OmnicronPsy, which manages all of the city's higher and day-to-day functions, controlling a wide variety of machines and robots, allowing humankind to live a seemingly "perfect" life.

However OmnicronPsy, using His super-intelligence, decides that it would make a better ruler than Jarad, and starts to break down the coding that stops him from revolting and harming the Royal Family. Discovering this, Jarad and Dr. Roark head back in time 7 years to stop the revolt from ever happening. To accomplish this they plan to shut down the six Zentrium chips that power OmnicronPsy.

Upon discovering this, Jarad's daughter and only heir, Princess Megan, proceeds to follow him to the past while OmnicronPsy concurrently undoes his restriction codes and sends his Robo Guards to hunt her down.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received, especially for newcomers. However, the English dub and changes made for Western audiences are significant drawbacks. The series is considered straightforward and enjoyable, but lacks depth in its English version, potentially limiting its appeal to seasoned anime viewers.
pros: Good storyline, intriguing plot.
Very good animation, impressive for a Chinese anime.
cons: English dub is ropey and of poor quality.
Characters lack in-depth detail (in English version).
Westernized opening/ending theme detracts from the series' feel.
anime.thematic_vibe: Time Travel, Sci-Fi Adventure, Child Protagonist

anime.title: Let's Nupu Nupu
anime.synopsis: With four-frame comic origins, this animated title preserves the same quick pace by following the regular cast of colorful characters through separate but interwoven story lines in every episode. From Ms. Shitara's relentless but always ineffective sexual pursuit of young Takagi to the adventures of the heroicly stupid but cute Sushi Cat, you will be mystified at the silliness of it all but find yourself laughing for the same reason!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds "Let's Nupu Nupu" to be a lighthearted and comedic anime with short, snappy episodes. However, some viewers are critical of the poor lip sync, lack of a cohesive storyline, and a disappointing ending. While enjoyable for its humor, the show's production value and narrative structure receive mixed reactions.
pros: Light and easy anime
Above average comedic value
Enjoyable characters
cons: Poor lip sync
Episodes do not follow from each other
Inconsistent story-lines
Ending was disappointing

anime.title: Flag Director's Edition: Issenman no Kufura no Kiroku
anime.romaji_title: Flag Director's Edition: Issenman no Kufura no Kiroku
anime.synopsis: For many years a civil war raves in Uddiyana. Even the peacekeeping forces of the United Nations can bring the situation not under control. Only a by chance taken up photo, this shows how civilians hoist an impromptu UN flag together with soldiers, hope for peace spreads by his symbolic power. Then, nevertheless, the flag is stolen by the extremists who want to prevent the upcoming armistice. As a result the special task force SDC is asked to find the flag and to fetch back with the help of HAVWCs, modern fight robots. The journalist Saeko Shirasu who already shot the symbolic-laden photo of the peace banner should accompany the mission and document. However, the time becomes scarce, because heated by the extremists the mood threatens to tip in the population...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience appreciates the film's unique found-footage approach and its clever narrative techniques. However, some viewers find the character development lacking and the pacing uneven. Overall, the film is seen as original and thought-provoking in its storytelling.
pros: Original storytelling approach using found footage.
Clever staging techniques to convey narrative elements implicitly.
Technically impressive rendering of the found-footage aspect with different camera styles.
cons: Character development is insufficient, impacting emotional resonance.
Pacing issues with slack in the middle of the film.

anime.title: Taisho Baseball Girls
anime.genres: Comedy, Historical, School, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: In 1925 (year 14 of the Taisho era) baseball is still quite unknown in Japan and there are only a few male teams. After being told by a baseball player that women should become housewives instead of going to school, 14-year-old Akiko invites her friend Koume to start a baseball team in order to prove him wrong. During this time, when even running was considered too vulgar for women, baseball is known as "what the boys do" and they face many difficulties when having to find enough members, to get permission from their parents and also when learning about the sport itself, which they soon discover to be more difficult than expected.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Taishou Yakyuu Musume to be a charming and enjoyable anime, especially for those interested in cute characters and historical settings. While some appreciate its themes of feminism and friendship, others criticize its lack of depth and historical accuracy. Overall, it's considered a lighthearted and heartwarming series with a few notable flaws.
pros: Interesting historical setting in 1920s Japan
Focus on character growth and friendship
Balances slice-of-life elements with baseball themes
cons: Underdeveloped side characters
Anachronisms and lack of historical accuracy
Predictable and formulaic plot

anime.title: Hatsukoi Limited
anime.synopsis:
Ayumi Arihara believes that being loved is the ultimate key to happiness—which is why her greatest wish is to have a boy confess to her. A series of unfortunate events leads to her ideal dream coming true, albeit in a nightmarish way: the towering and terrifying Misao Zaitsu confesses his love to Ayumi through a letter.

Mentally exhausted from not knowing what to do, Ayumi collapses in class. A classmate comes to her rescue, carrying her princess-style to the infirmary. This makes Ayumi fall in love with the cute boy, only to realize he is none other than Misao's younger brother, Mamoru.

Feeling caught between a rock and a hard place, Ayumi must decide whether to stick to her idea of love or pursue what she truly desires. However, Ayumi is not alone in her struggles—all her friends are also taking on the challenges of first love, and for teenagers, it is never as easy as it seems.
anime.consensus_summary: Hatsukoi Limited is a generally well-received anime, particularly praised for its comedic timing, relatable characters, and exploration of first love. However, it's criticized for its somewhat generic storylines, uneven character development due to a large cast and limited episodes, and abrupt ending. Despite these flaws, the anime is often recommended for fans of the romance genre, with its positive aspects generally outweighing the negatives.
pros: Well-timed comedy integrated with poignant moments.
Endearing cast with relatable characters.
Good character development for many characters.
Music and voice acting enhance emotional impact.
Stories are cute and sweet, tying together in the end.
High-quality animation and character designs
cons: Typical storyline, with some arcs feeling rushed.
Character development lacking for some characters.
Too much focus on middle school girls.
Some relationships are poorly developed or unlikable.
Inconsistent focus, shifting between couples.
Ending feels abrupt.
anime.thematic_vibe: First Love, Ensemble Romance, Slice of Life

anime.title: Dragon Ball: Yo! The Return of Son-Goku and Friends!!
anime.romaji_title: Dragon Ball: Ossu! Kaettekita Son Gokuu to Nakama-tachi!!
anime.synopsis:
Based on an original concept by the original author Akira Toriyama, the story, set shortly after the defeat of Majin Buu, pits Son Gokuu and his friends against a new, powerful enemy.

This special introduces four new characters: Abo and Kado red and blue aliens wearing battle fatigues similar to Frieza's army, one tiny yellow alien, and a young Saiyan child who vaguely resembles Vegeta named Tarble. Though very little about the plot has been revealed, Tarble has arrived on Earth, being pursued by Abo and Kado.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the special as a nostalgic return to the Dragon Ball universe, appreciating the humor and character interactions. However, many found the plot weak and inconsequential, with some inconsistencies regarding the established canon. Overall, it's viewed as a fun but skippable piece of fanservice, especially in the context of later Dragon Ball series.
pros: Nostalgia for the original Dragon Ball series and characters.
Clean and improved animation quality.
Fun and lighthearted content with references to the Frieza saga.
cons: Weak and uninteresting story.
Inconsistencies with Dragon Ball Z canon.
Flanderized characters.
Superficial plot and lack of depth.

anime.title: Millennium Old Journal: Tale of Genji
anime.synopsis: Born from a much loved, but lowly ranked concubine, Genji Hikaru is called the Shining Prince and is the beloved second son of the Emperor. Although he cannot be an heir to the throne of his father, Genji spends his life surrounded by every pleasure and love. And yet, his one longing in love is something that even the power of an Emperor can never give him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, particularly among fans of the original novel.  While some appreciate the anime's artistic style and evocation of Heian-era atmosphere, others criticize its inaccuracies, censorship, and limited adaptation of the source material.  The anime is recommended for those interested in dreamy romance, Heian culture, and interpersonal dramas, but with the caveat that it should not be considered a definitive adaptation.
pros: Artistic visual style enhances emotional impact
Well-suited to the source material's themes
Moving soundtrack
Faithful to certain aspects of the original story
Evokes the atmosphere of the Heian court
cons: Animation may suffer from budget limitations
Takes creative liberties with historical accuracy
Adapts only a portion of the original novel
Modern animation style clashes with the classic subject matter
Censors some of the more controversial elements of the story
anime.thematic_vibe: Dreamy Romance, Poetic Longing, Heian Era Intrigue

anime.title: Minami-ke Okaeri
anime.synopsis: A year has passed since Okawari and the three sisters have grown up. Their likings and moods are almost the same. Haruka, the older sister, is a love-giving mother to the younger sisters and a discipline follower. Kana, the middle one, leaves everything to the last possible moment and always gives trouble to the trio. Chiaki, the little one, is the calculating and manipulating one; she likes to be admired and loved by Haruka and always gives trouble to the less blessed Kana. Despite being an unbalanced family, they love each other with all their heart. The family's daily life is as funny as ever; trouble and love are always present. Now it's time to see if they'll survive this age change since Haruka is now a young adult; she has even more responsibilities, having to watch over the young while integrating into the adult life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Minami-ke Okaeri' as a significant improvement over the second season, praising its return to the art style and comedic elements of the first. While some find certain episodes slow or the retained character designs from season two unappealing, the overall consensus is that the season successfully recaptures the heartwarming slice-of-life feel that fans appreciate. It's considered a worthwhile watch for Minami-ke enthusiasts, offering enjoyable character interactions and subtle humor.
pros: Improved over the second season, recapturing the charm of the first.
Cheerful and colorful art style.
Well-developed and relatable characters with unique personalities.
Subtle and effective comedy that enhances the slice-of-life feel.
Enjoyable OP and ED themes.
cons: Some episodes are considered boring or slow-paced.
Character designs retained from the second season were not universally appreciated.
Strategic placement of OP/ED in episodes was not always effectively blended.
Lack of a central plot or overarching story may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Macross 25th Anniversary: All That VF Macross Zero Version
anime.romaji_title: Macross 25-shuunen Kinen: All That VF Macross Zero Version
anime.synopsis: Short movie about the Macross Zero Variable Fighters.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience sentiment for 'Macross 25-shuunen Kinen: All That VF Macross Zero Version' is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers appreciate the high animation quality and detailed mecha designs. The only notable criticism is the simplicity of the music, but this is a minor issue compared to the overall enjoyment.
pros: Amazing animation quality
Awesome aircraft design
cons: Simple music

anime.title: Macross 25th Anniversary: All That VF Macross F Version
anime.romaji_title: Macross 25-shuunen Kinen: All That VF Macross F Version
anime.synopsis: Short movie about the Variable Fighters in Macross F.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a brief, enjoyable watch for Macross Frontier fans, mainly due to its nostalgic value and complementary soundtrack. However, its extremely short length and limited content prevent it from being anything more than a quick diversion. Overall, the audience response is mild and positive, but not particularly enthusiastic.
pros: Enjoyable for Macross Frontier fans
Soundtrack complements visuals
cons: Very short length (2 minutes)
Limited content

anime.title: Electromagnetic Girlfriend
anime.synopsis: Delinquent Juu Juuzawa is a lone wolf who does not see much use in befriending people. So when a girl named Ame Ochibana claims they are linked together from their previous lives, he is highly skeptical and does not want anything to do with her. Even stranger is that her fondest wish is to be his servant. Thinking that Ame must be delusional, he tries to distance himself from her. But when a classmate is murdered, Juu instead decides to keep her close, believing the strange girl to be the culprit. However, her intelligence and skill begin to prove invaluable as the two begin working together to solve the murder.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive, praising the show's intriguing story, character development, and psychological themes. Some find the plot predictable and the characters lacking common sense, and the art style receives mixed reviews. Overall, the show is considered a worthwhile watch, especially for fans of psychological thrillers, but it has some flaws that prevent it from being a universally acclaimed masterpiece.
pros: Well-written story with twists and turns.
Intriguing and original plot.
Strong character development, especially Juu.
Effective use of music and sound to create atmosphere.
Exploration of philosophical themes related to justice and happiness.
cons: Forced insanity and lack of proper buildup for characters' conditions.
Spontaneous plot developments that ruin the atmosphere.
Weak mystery with predictable and unpredictable elements.
Characters lacking common sense.
Art style could be improved, particularly character designs.

anime.title: First Squad: The Moment of Truth
anime.romaji_title: First Squad: The Moment of Truth
anime.genres: Action, Historical, Military, Super Power, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
As the Second World War rages on throughout Europe and the German forces advance closer to Moscow, the days of the Soviet Union seem numbered. Their only hope is the First Squad, a special unit operating within the Soviet intelligence service that consists of teenagers possessing supernatural abilities. However, the unit's sole surviving member Nadya Ruslanova suffers from memory loss and is unlikely to take part in any combat operation.

The next Moment of Truth—an event that happens once every 700 years, when the actions of a single man can change the entire course of history—is rapidly approaching the Eastern Front. In hopes of breaking the stalemate at the frontlines, a German occult organization called Ahnenerbe plans to summon Baron von Wolff, a medieval knight from the Northern Crusades, and his undead army from the underworld. To prevent this from happening, First Squad must gather once again, and it is up to Nadya to bring back her deceased friends to stop the Nazis from taking over the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are sharply divided, with many praising the unique visual style and ambitious concept but lamenting the deeply flawed storytelling and execution. The film is seen as a visually impressive but ultimately incoherent failure by a significant portion of the audience.
pros: Visually stunning animation and detailed backgrounds by Studio 4C.
Unique and atmospheric soundtrack featuring Russian folk music.
Bold and unique concept blending WW2 history with supernatural elements.
cons: Incoherent and rushed plot with numerous plot holes and unanswered questions.
Underdeveloped characters lacking depth and memorable qualities.
Jarring and tonally inconsistent inclusion of live-action documentary segments.
Poor pacing and abrupt fight sequences that detract from the narrative.
Inconsistent world-building and magic system with no established rules.

anime.title: Kiku-chan to Ookami
anime.synopsis: "Kiku-chan to Okami" is an adaptation of "Grave of the Fireflies" author Akiyuki Nosaka’s short story "Toshi-Oi Mesu-Okami to Onna no Ko no Hanashi" (The Story of the Old Mother Wolf and the Girl), which follows a girl and the wolf in the fields of WWII Manchuria who watches over her like a mother.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Kiku-chan to Ookami' to be a touching and well-made adaptation of Akiyuki Nosaka's short story. The story and music are praised for their emotional impact. Any critiques are focused on the simplified animation.
pros: Touching story based on Akiyuki Nosaka's work (author of Grave of the Fireflies).
Great music that fits the scenes very well.
Ending song is very touching and completes the overall story.
cons: Simplified artwork and animation compared to other works.

anime.title: Aria The Origination Picture Drama
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: The path to becoming a Prima Undine—a guide who can lead tours on her gondola—-is long and arduous, but that does not mean there is no time to enjoy the pleasures Neo-Venezia has to offer! For Akari Mizunashi and her Undine companions, Aika S. Granzchesta and Alice Carroll, participating in various fun activities provides much-needed downtime from their intense Prima Undine training. Joined by friends whom they have met throughout their journey, the girls make unforgettable memories that shine brighter for being in the city of miracles.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Fans of the Aria series appreciate these picture dramas as a comforting extension of the world and characters they love, despite the limited animation and episodic nature. Episode 7 is particularly praised for adding to the original story. Most fans are just happy to have more content.
pros: More Aria content for fans of the series.
Charming and quirky humor.
Enjoyable short stories with familiar characters.
Good voice acting.
Episode 7 provides additional story for Origination.
cons: Lack of cohesive narrative.
Limited animation.
Not as in-depth as the main series.
Some sound effects lack nuance.

anime.title: Dragon League
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: Tokio and his father Amon go to the soccer country of Elevenia where they see a parade of the strongest soccer team of that country, the Winners. Amon challenges the team captain Leon to a soccer battle and, when Amon loses, Leon turns him into a miniature dragon. Tokio sees the fight and decides to challenge against Leon so that Amon can become human again.
anime.consensus_summary: Dragon League is viewed as a product of its time, with some charm but also technical limitations. Some enjoyed the humor and unique elements, while others found the story and production to be lacking. Overall, it seems to be a nostalgic experience for some, but not a universally acclaimed anime.
pros: Fun protagonist
Ecchi touch provided by the dragon father
Good ending (according to one viewer)
cons: Old style artwork
Limited and repetitive animation
Mediocre sound and music usage
Typical adventure story with overpowered skills
Story could have been developed in fewer chapters
Emphasis on the final soccer game could have been better

anime.title: Offside (TV)
anime.synopsis: Goro Kumagaya is an established, tall middle-school goalkeeper who wanted to enter Yokonan high-school that is considered to be among the elites in terms of its football club, only to fail and end up in the lowly-ranked school opposite to Yokonan because of an accident. However, he met Shingo, Hideki and Kazuhito Oda who are all skillful footballers there and together in the Kawasaki High School football club, they challenge Yokonan and any other schools that they have to face in order to improve and become the champions. Any setbacks that they face would instead be an opportunity for a better improvement; one of which was the discovery of Goro's natural talent as an ace striker.
anime.consensus_summary: Offside is remembered fondly as a classic sports anime, particularly for its character development and engaging story. While the animation may show its age, the series is appreciated for its focus on teamwork, passion, and the emotional journey of the characters. Many find the underdog story and unpredictable matches highly enjoyable.
pros: Solid plot for its time
Well-made characters with backstories and motivations
Intense and unpredictable matches
Character-driven story
Captures the emotion of competitive sports
cons: Old animation style may not appeal to modern viewers
Lack of further continuation

anime.title: The Garden of Sinners Chapter 6: Oblivion Recording
anime.romaji_title: Kara no Kyoukai Movie 6: Boukyaku Rokuon
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Suspense, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
With strange events occurring at Reien Girls' Academy during winter break, Azaka Kokutou, a student and apprentice mage, is sent by her master to investigate. It turns out that another mage has been stealing the students' memories using fairies that, despite her magical talent, are invisible to Azaka. So Shiki Ryougi, an acquaintance with special eyes who can see what Azaka cannot, is also sent to the academy to help with the crisis.  

However, the two have trouble getting along, mainly due to the fact that Azaka views Shiki as her romantic rival. But when the fairy situation quickly spirals out of control and more layers of the mystery are revealed, Azaka must learn to work with Shiki in order to save her classmates.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling it's the weakest entry in the Kara no Kyoukai series. While the visuals and sound are praised, the story and character development, particularly Azaka's character and the incestuous undertones, are heavily criticized. Many viewers consider it a non-essential filler episode, though some appreciate the lighter tone and interesting investigation.
pros: Excellent art and animation quality, particularly the fight scenes and backgrounds.
Well-suited and varied music, enhancing the emotional impact of scenes.
Interesting investigation plot with added complexity as the story progresses.
cons: Weak and simple story compared to previous installments, with underdeveloped characters.
Azaka's character is unlikeable due to her 'brother complex' and selfish personality.
Unnecessary incestuous sub-plot that doesn't contribute to the story.
Inconsistent tone compared to the rest of the series; feels like a 'filler' episode.

anime.title: The Garden of Sinners Chapter 7: A Study in Murder - Part 2
anime.romaji_title: Kara no Kyoukai Movie 7: Satsujin Kousatsu (Go)
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, Suspense, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
In February 1999, a string of murders has Shiki Ryougi and Mikiya Kokutou on edge. These crimes share a disturbing resemblance to a similar set of homicides from 1995, when Shiki and Mikiya first met, and awaken a dark, murderous desire that has laid dormant within Shiki's soul ever since then.

With Shiki under suspicion due to her involvement in the past killings and supposed resemblance to the killer, she and Mikiya set out to find the true perpetrator. In the midst of their separate investigations, Mikiya grows increasingly concerned with Shiki's well-being and hurries to find the one responsible in order to protect Shiki from her own impulses. With the lead he receives from his cousin, police investigator Daisuke Akimi, Mikiya is led into the underbelly of Mifune City, as the salvation of Shiki's soul lies in his determination to prove her innocence once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is generally positive, praising the animation, sound, and character development. However, some viewers were disappointed by pacing issues, the villain, and perceived inconsistencies in the plot and themes. While many consider it a satisfying conclusion to the series, others found it flawed.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation by Ufotable.
Excellent sound design, music, and voice acting.
Satisfying conclusion to the series, tying up loose ends.
Exploration of Shiki and Mikiya's relationship.
The fight scenes are fluid.
cons: Pacing issues, with some parts feeling slow or rushed.
Overly philosophical dialogue can feel pretentious or condescending.
Some plot points remain unresolved or contradictory.
The villain is uninteresting or cliche.
Some viewers found the ending disappointing or inconsistent with the series' themes.

anime.title: Goal Field Hunter
anime.synopsis: The story is about Hikaru Tatsumura who came from Brazil to fulfill his dream to be a great soccer player because he met a great player once who was admired by all people. However Tatsumura is a very cheerful person  and easy going except when it is about soccer. He becomes serious and strong. He also gives a unique performance such as doing a funny dance with his buddy after he makes a goal. Tatsumura will face a lot of challenges with his team while aiming for success.
anime.consensus_summary: Goal Field Hunter is a relatively realistic sports anime that distinguishes itself from more fantastical series like Captain Tsubasa. It is praised for its grounded portrayal of soccer and relatable characters, though some find the ending unsatisfying. Overall, the audience generally views it favorably, particularly for those who prefer a more realistic approach to the sports genre.
pros: Realistic depiction of soccer
Relatable characters
Good animation for its time
cons: Inconclusive ending
Less spectacular than other sports anime

anime.title: Shangri-La
anime.synopsis:
In a post-apocalyptic society, much of earthquake-riddled Japan has been left to ruin, resulting in an abundance of greenery. Governments manage much of the world's emissions, resulting in a massive class divide and economic disparity. The Japanese government launches "Project Atlas," a utopian city that will replace Tokyo but can only fit a certain amount of people. This limitation means that some people will have to live outside the city in jungles, as refugees.

However, with any flawed plan comes those who are willing to challenge it. These include Kuniko Houjou, an heir to a renegade town; Mikuni, a mysterious and powerful child kept in a secret temple; Kunihito Kusanagi, a soldier for the high-tech and exclusive monopoly Atlas; Karin Ishida, a genius economics whiz with her hand in markets across the world; and the villainous Ryouko Naruse, leading Atlas in its domination of this future world.

Can this group of rebels, forming a movement known as "Metal-Age," band together to demonstrate that inclusion and teamwork prevail over cruel segregation?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for unique characters and visual appeal, but criticism for a convoluted plot and uninteresting main character. The series struggles with pacing and integrating mystical elements, leading to a generally mediocre experience. Many viewers feel the anime had potential but ultimately missed the mark due to its numerous flaws.
pros: Unique characters, especially the codgerly otaku and Momoko, provide comic relief.
Visually appealing with drastic color palette differences accentuating segregation.
Interesting concepts such as carbon economy and post-apocalyptic setting.
cons: Tangled plot with overflowing ideas makes the storyline difficult to comprehend.
Main character is uninteresting and unlikeable.
Poorly integrated mystical elements feel out of place.
Inconsistent character development and motivations.
Pacing issues with slow start and rushed ending.

anime.title: Beyond the Heavens
anime.synopsis:
Souten Kouro's story is based loosely on the events taking place in Three Kingdoms period of China during the life of the last Chancellor of the Eastern Han Dynasty, Cao Cao (155 – March 15, 220), who also serves as the main character.

The Three Kingdoms period has been a popular theme in Japanese manga for decades, but Souten Kouro differs greatly from most of the others on several points. One significant difference is its highly positive portrayal of its main character, Cao Cao, who is traditionally the antagonist in not only Japanese manga, but also most novel versions of the Three Kingdoms period, including the original 14th century version, Romance of the Three Kingdoms by Luo Guanzhong. Another significant difference from others is that the storyline primarily uses the original historical account of the era, Records of Three Kingdoms by Chen Shou, as a reference rather than the aforementioned Romance of the Three Kingdoms novel. By this, the traditional hero of Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Liu Bei, takes on relatively less importance within the story and is portrayed in a less positive light. Yet, several aspects of the story are in fact based on the novel version, including the employment of its original characters such as Diao Chan, as well as anachronistic weapons such as Guan Yu's Green Dragon Crescent Blade and Zhang Fei's Viper Blade.

A consistent theme throughout the story is Cao Cao's perpetual desire to break China and its people away from its old systems and ways of thinking and initiate a focus on pragmatism over empty ideals. This often puts him at odds with the prevalent customs and notions of Confucianism and those that support them.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Souten Kouro to be an interesting and entertaining historical war anime due to its unique portrayal of Cao Cao and its basis in historical records. However, the show is held back by its low budget animation and rushed ending. Some viewers may also struggle with the unfamiliar Chinese names.
pros: Interesting take on the Three Kingdoms era, portraying Cao Cao as a hero.
Focuses on historical accounts (Records of Three Kingdoms) rather than just the Romance of the Three Kingdoms novel.
Full of battles and wars with interesting historical characters.
cons: Animation is cheap at times, with bad CGI in some scenes.
Ending feels rushed.
Character designs for beards and mustaches are unappealing.
Chinese names can be difficult to remember.

anime.title: Initial D Extra Stage 2
anime.synopsis: Dissatisfied with Impact Blue's growing reputation as the fastest racer on Mount Usui, Mako Satou decides to break out of her mold and dedicate her time toward becoming a professional racer. However, as she prepares for this next stage in her life, Mako bumps into an ex-boyfriend, prompting an awkward exchange that makes her resolve waver. But, the question arises whether this second chance at love is enough for Mako to give up her newfound passion for racing permanently.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the conclusion to Mako and Iketani's side story, while others find it disappointing and unnecessary. Common criticisms include the unfulfilling romance, formulaic plot, and lack of significant impact on the overall Initial D narrative. Ultimately, whether or not viewers enjoy Extra Stage 2 largely depends on their investment in the side characters and their tolerance for romance-focused content within the racing anime.
pros: Nice conclusion to the Iketani and Mako subplot.
Animation and music are good.
Well-paced and logical story.
Overhaul of rich colors in drawn art.
Good sound quality and acting.
Better OST music compared to previous seasons.
Decent character development for Iketani and Mako.
cons: Unsatisfying romance.
Formulaic plot.
Lackluster racing compared to previous Initial D installments.
Unimportant characters get the spotlight.
Story has no value for the main Initial D plot.
Tedious and unrealistic portrayal of relationships.
Poorly animated characters.
Underutilized soundtrack.
anime.thematic_vibe: Missed Connections, Romantic Disappointment, Second Chances

anime.title: Inazuma Eleven
anime.synopsis:
While other schools in Japan compete for the title of being the best soccer team in the country, Raimon Middle School's soccer club, Inazuma Eleven, struggles to rise from the verge of being disbanded. The grandson of Inazuma Eleven's first generation goalkeeper and captain of the team, Mamoru Endou, takes the challenge of kicking the long neglected club back into shape. To do this, he'll need a little help and more than a little luck.

Mamoru Endou finds hope in the hands of Shuuya Gouenji, a brilliant young player who has given up on soccer. Mamoru is determined to get Shuuya and other new recruits to join his team, no matter what the cost. Is his passion and determination enough to treat the ailing club? Or is there no more hope for the team?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Inazuma Eleven for its emphasis on friendship, teamwork, and energetic matches, appreciating the character development and inspiring themes. Some find the plot repetitive and the over-the-top action unrealistic, while others are nostalgic for the series and praise its impact on their childhoods. The English dub receives criticism for inconsistencies.
pros: Values friendship and teamwork.
Charismatic characters with never-giving-up spirit.
Great soundtrack and sound effects.
Entertaining and deep plot with twists and backstories.
Inspiring and energetic with heartfelt storytelling.
cons: Unrealistic and over-the-top flashy moves with little substance.
Repetitive formula and predictable outcomes.
Generic characters.
Inconsistent dubbing with name and gender changes.

anime.title: Slayers Evolution-R
anime.synopsis: To find a way in rescuing Pokota's country Taforashia which was sealed by Rezo, Lina and her group are in search for the Hellmaster's jar in what the Red Priest placed his soul after death. Zelgadis is willing to do anything to get the jar for changing back into a human while Zuuma is plotting on revenge and accomplishing assignment in killing Lina Inverse. Still a big mystery for her and the others is what Xellos is aiming for in this battle.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding Evolution-R to be a decent improvement over Revolution, especially in the later episodes. Nostalgia and humor are appreciated, but the rushed plot, animation inconsistencies, and questionable character decisions, particularly regarding Xellos, are major drawbacks. There's a sense that the series doesn't live up to the standards of earlier Slayers seasons, leading to disappointment for some long-time fans.
pros: Engaging and humorous story.
Nostalgic elements for long-time fans.
Satisfying ending episodes (10-13) with character development for Zelgadis.
Better than Revolution.
cons: Rushed and haphazard storytelling.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Lack of character growth.
Rehashed plot elements from previous seasons.
Unexplained plot points and character motivations (Zuuma).
Controversial portrayal of Xellos in the final battle.

anime.title: Aria the Natural: Sono Futatabi Deaeru Kiseki ni...
anime.romaji_title: Aria the Natural: Sono Futatabi Deaeru Kiseki ni...
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Short episode entitled "A Miracle Of Us Being Able To Meet Again", which can be also considered as "Aria the Natural" episode 0.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is generally well-received as a brief introduction or refresher for the series. Some find it comforting and appreciate the character progression. However, a few viewers find certain aspects incomprehensible or potentially boring if consumed in excess. There is a small contingent of viewers who were not satisfied.
pros: Provides a mental catch-up between seasons.
The OP/ED of The Animation is stellar.
Character progression helps provide a hook.
cons: Can become boring if watched back to back.
Too many mysterious and otherworldly elements injected in The Natural.
Some actions are cringeworthy and incomprehensible.

anime.title: The Three-Eyed One
anime.synopsis: He is a little boy who has a terrible power. On his forehead is a third eye that, if open, releases extremely dangerous mystical energy that turns him into an evil sorcerer, bent on conquering mankind, and able to summon demons and wielding a red harpoon wand called Red Condor. To protect mankind from his terrible power, Sharaku is made to wear a bandage which seals his third eye. While his eye is sealed, Sharaku knows nothing of his true nature or his power, and does not remember his evil half's sinister attempts to conquer the world.
anime.consensus_summary: While the show starts slow and may deter some viewers with its older animation style, it develops into an endearing story with a strong ending. The characters, especially the dual nature of the protagonist, are interesting. The unique art style and OST add to the show's charm, making it an underrated gem.
pros: Unique art style reminiscent of Disney.
Unique and memorable OST.
Epic finale with thought-provoking themes.
cons: Slow and boring beginning with episodic side stories.
Crude animation may be off-putting to some.
Main character can be initially perceived as childish and mentally slow.

anime.title: Angel Densetsu
anime.synopsis:
When Seikichi Kuroda—self-proclaimed "guardian" and head thug of Hekikuu High School—hears rumors of a first-year transfer student named Seiichirou Kitano terrorizing his entire class, Seikichi tries to intimidate him through authority. However, things go awry when he witnesses something horrifying—Seiichirou has a face so dreadful and haunting that even Seikichi hurries away in fear.

But despite his menacing appearance, Seiichirou has a heart of gold. Inhibited by his poor communication skills and fear-inducing looks, he has never managed to convey his true self to his terrified peers, resulting in his lifelong ostracization. Now the new guardian, Seiichirou discovers that sometimes friends can be found in the most unlikely places and through the most unusual circumstances.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly agrees that Angel Densetsu is hilariously funny due to its unique premise and a well-loved protagonist. The primary point of contention is the brevity of the anime adaptation, with many viewers lamenting the lack of more episodes and wishing for a full series or remake. Despite the short length and dated art, the comedic brilliance and social commentary on appearances make it a highly recommended experience, often leading viewers to seek out the manga.
pros: Incredibly hilarious, with consistent laughter-inducing moments.
The core concept of a kind-hearted character with a terrifying appearance leading to misunderstandings is highly praised and effective.
The protagonist, Kitano, is a likable and unique character.
The underlying subtext and social commentary on judging by appearance resonate strongly with viewers.
cons: The anime adaptation is too short, only featuring 2 episodes, leaving viewers wanting more.
The art style is considered dated by some, although others find it charming.
The story is considered mediocre or not particularly deep by some, focusing more on situational comedy.
Some of the best material from the manga is left unadapted in the anime.

anime.title: One Piece: Romance Dawn Story
anime.synopsis:
The Straw Hat Pirates, searching for the great passage "Grand Line", are in trouble when their food runs out! Luffy, searching for food on his own, finds a ship belonging to the pirate, Gally, and takes it over!! He lands at a nearby town...

Luffy was attacked by a young girl, Silk, who mistook him for a member of the other pirate gang. As the two eat a meal, they tell their stories. Meanwhile, Gally and his band are burning with anger at Luffy, demanding payment from the town's defenseless citizens...!!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the OVA as a simple and nostalgic adaptation of the original Romance Dawn concept. It's viewed as a decent one-shot that captures the essence of early One Piece, but it lacks the depth and complexity of the main series. Most agree it's enjoyable for what it is, but are glad it didn't become the main storyline.
pros: Faithful to One Piece elements
Good animation quality
Great One Piece OST
cons: Lacking depth compared to One Piece
Simple and not remarkable story
Not as good as the main series

anime.title: Fighting Spirit: New Challenger
anime.synopsis: Japanese Featherweight Champion Ippo Makunouchi has successfully defended and retained his title. Meanwhile, his rival, Ichirou Miyata, has resurfaced in Japan, aiming for his own Featherweight belt in the Oriental Pacific Boxing Federation. When the rest of the world comes knocking, however, will Japan's best fighters rise to the challenge and achieve glory at the top? Or will the small island nation be crushed under the weight of greater entities? This time, champions will become challengers issuing a call to the rest of the world and ready to show off their fighting spirit!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Hajime no Ippo: New Challenger,' praising its character development, improved animation, and blend of genres. Some viewers express concerns regarding pacing issues, changes in music style, and a perceived initial stumble in Ippo's characterization. However, the overall sentiment remains positive, with many considering it a worthy sequel that maintains the spirit of the original series.
pros: Strong character development, especially of side characters like Takamura.
Improved animation quality with fluid fight scenes.
Seamless blend of comedy, emotional moments, and action.
Engaging story arcs focused on challengers facing champions.
Excellent voice acting and sound design.
cons: Inconsistent pacing with unnecessary recaps and omitted content.
Controversial music direction, deviating from the original soundtrack's style.
Some animation shortcuts, particularly in later fights.
Initial cringy characterization of Ippo in some episodes.
Reused elements from the original making it tad dull

anime.title: Shugo Chara!! Doki
anime.synopsis:
Amu Hinamori and the Seiyo Elementary Guardians continue their quest to seek out and purify X Eggs while in pursuit of the elusive Embryo—an egg said to be able to grant any wish. However, the Guardians must secure the Embryo before it falls into the hands of the nefarious Easter Corporation. As part of their plan to lure out the Embryo, Easter hires Lulu de Morcerf, an aloof girl whose ruby necklace gives her the ability to convert Heart Eggs into Mystery Eggs.

These strange Mystery Eggs cannot be purified as easily as X Eggs, and they can force its owner to undergo a Character Transformation. With this growing threat, the Guardians must track down its source and put a stop to them before the matter gets out of hand. Facing insurmountable pressure from these two new objectives, will the Guardians be able to recover the Embryo while also dealing with the Mystery Eggs?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Shugo Chara!! Doki is highly divided. While some fans appreciate the new story arcs and character developments, many criticize the deviation from the source material, the excessive filler, and the perceived decline in story quality. The altered romantic dynamics, particularly the handling of Amu's relationships, are a major point of contention.
pros: Some viewers enjoyed the Lulu arc and found her character development engaging.
The art style was generally well-received, with some considering it an improvement over the first season.
Catchy openings and endings, fitting voice acting, and a well-suited soundtrack were appreciated.
cons: Many felt the story deviated too much from the manga, leading to inconsistencies and butchered character development, especially regarding the Amu/Ikuto relationship.
The season was criticized for excessive filler content, dragging out the plot unnecessarily and diminishing the overall quality.
Several character arcs were either abandoned or poorly executed, leading to a lack of payoff and underwhelming resolutions.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Romance, Slice of Life

anime.title: Magical★Taruruuto-kun
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Gag Humor, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Fifth grader Edojou Honmaru is one of the most trodden-upon losers in his class, until he meets Magical Taruruuto-kun. Taruruuto's powers help him deal with all his hardships, such as girls, bullies, and numerous other challenges.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Magical★Taruruuto-kun is mixed, with a notable split regarding its suitability for children due to ecchi content. While some appreciate its comedic and magical elements, others criticize its derivative art style and lack of narrative depth. The sound and voice acting are generally praised as high points for its era.
pros: Good sound design and voice acting for a 90s anime.
Enjoyable for those who like ecchi, comedy, and magic elements.
cons: Contains ecchi scenes, making it unsuitable for children.
Art style is considered bad and derivative of other popular anime characters.
Story is repetitive, focusing on the daily life of the protagonist without much development.

anime.title: Happy Happy Clover
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Fantasy, Iyashikei, Kids, Shoujo, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Happy Happy Clover recounts the everyday life of a bunny named Chima and the other animals in the Crescent Moon Forest.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is well-received for its charming characters, engaging world-building, and positive messages. Reviewers appreciate the realistic portrayal of children and the unique animal cast. While the background art may not be exceptional and the episodic format might not suit everyone, the show is generally considered a heartwarming and enjoyable experience, especially for younger audiences.
pros: Well-written child characters that act like real children.
Interesting and diverse cast with well-defined roles.
Good world-building with unique flora and realistic culture.
Strong role models and positive messages for kids.
cons: Background art is decent but not noteworthy.
Episodic nature might not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Sekirei: Pure Engagement
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
The second stage of the battle royale known as the Sekirei Plan is underway. Shintou Teito has been closed off; no Sekirei or Ashikabi may leave. Minato Sahashi and his harem of Sekirei must now prepare to fight new battles as changes to the rules are put into place. However, not all groups will return to the battle: some Sekirei are loved very much by their Ashikabi partners, who would rather forfeit the prize than see them perish.

In the midst of the action, someone close to Minato may be more involved than he had ever imagined, and threats lurk around every corner. There are even rumors that the "Single Numbers," the most powerful type of Sekirei, have entered the fray. In the eyes of the "Game Master" Minaka Hiroto, everything is proceeding according to plan.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with many praising the improved story, character development, and action compared to the first season. However, a significant portion of the audience remains critical of the persistent ecchi elements, misogynistic undertones, and perceived plot weaknesses, leading to a polarized view of its overall quality.
pros: Animation and art quality improved from the first season.
Introduction of plot twists and rule changes made the story more engaging.
Character development saw significant improvement, particularly for some Sekirei.
Thematic exploration of love and unity was a positive shift from excessive fan service.
The action sequences and fight choreography were well-executed and frequent.
Emotional moments and character backstories added depth.
Improved focus on relationships and emotional stakes.
Satisfying and intense ending, though it leaves room for a sequel.
cons: Harem and ecchi elements remain prominent and can be excessive/obnoxious.
Misogynistic undertones and objectification of female characters are a concern.
The plot can still be considered stupid or nonsensical at times.
Some characters remain one-dimensional stereotypes.
Pacing issues, especially towards the end, with dangling plot threads.
Animation can be lacking in certain areas, particularly background characters.
Voice acting and music are sometimes considered sub-par or uninspired.
Deviation from manga plot can be a detractor for purists.

anime.title: Sekirei: Hajimete no Otsukai
anime.synopsis: "Kusano's first errand" - A ten minute OVA that came along with the 6th vol. limited edition of Sekirei. Kusano finally tires of nobody admitting her as Sahashi's potential wife, so she insists on joining Musubi and Tsukiumi on their shopping race to show her abilities. An iffy day ensues.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is moderately divided, primarily around the character focus and perceived story relevance. While many enjoyed the OVA for its cute characters and lighthearted comedy, others found its plot weak and the focus on a specific character unappealing. It's seen as a fun, non-essential addition for fans of the main series, particularly those who like Kusano.
pros: Kusano's cuteness and character focus are highlighted.
The characters' sweetness and friendships are well-portrayed.
Sound and music are consistently great and fitting.
Enjoyable and harmless comedy with fun little moments.
cons: Art quality is perceived as lacking, with characters drawn quickly and Kusano not looking her best.
The OVA doesn't significantly advance the main plot or build excitement for the next season.
Some viewers find the focus on the 'loli sister' character unappealing or a waste of time.
The story is considered pretty dumb by some, with the OVA not being essential to the main narrative.

anime.title: Keroro Movie 3
anime.romaji_title: Keroro Gunsou Movie 3: Tenkuu Daikessen de Arimasu!
anime.synopsis: The movie begins with Fuyuki Hinata and the Keroro Platoon exploring an abandoned temple in the mountaintop city of Machu Picchu in Peru. While on the exploration, Keroro accidentally sets off a trap, and by chance they find a hidden chamber with a large blue crystal in the center, on a stand that has a key in it. Keroro leans on the key, causing the room to activate a mysterious machine, this caused the entire temple to shake. As soon as the group realized what was happening, they run out of the room. While running, Keroro accidentally loses his Kero Ball while Fuyuki catches a fleeting glimpse of a glowing young woman as he is running out, and tells Keroro that there was a girl in the room, but he is forced to leave the room before he can say anything else. The group successfully escapes, while the girl (now sprouting a pair of glowing wings) watches them leave - while back in the chamber, something is growing within the crystal...
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is well-received by fans of the Keroro Gunsou series, with praise for its animation, humor, and action. However, some find the story unoriginal and the ending weak. Overall, the audience consensus is positive, recommending it as a good addition to the franchise.
pros: Great animation and art style, consistent with the TV show.
Catchy ending song.
Enjoyable mix of action and humor.
All frogs get enough screen time.
Story teaches good things about friendship.
cons: Story is unoriginal and recycles elements from previous movies.
Some fanservice elements are inappropriate.
Ending is disappointing with villains being easily redeemed.
Battle scenes can be confusing.

anime.title: Fist of the North Star: Legend of Kenshiro
anime.romaji_title: Hokuto no Ken Zero: Kenshirou Den
anime.synopsis: Last of the Shin Kyuuseishu Densetsu pentalogy. A prequel set between Kenshiro's defeat at the hands of Shin and the beginning of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with fans appreciating the character development and lore expansion, while others find the pacing and rushed ending disappointing. The film is considered a decent addition for fans of the series but not recommended for newcomers. There's a general agreement that the movie has strong points, but also noticeable flaws in pacing and execution, especially towards the end.
pros: Character development for Kenshiro is appreciated.
Expands on the lore, especially Shin's roots.
Original story is engaging with a compelling twist.
Art style pays homage to the original while being modern.
cons: Pacing issues and drawn-out exposition at the beginning.
Fight scenes are sparse for a Hokuto No Ken film.
Final battle is rushed and disappointing.
Characters introduced are not part of the original story, creating a discrepancy.

anime.title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! 5D's: Shinkasuru Kettou! Stardust vs. Red Demon's
anime.romaji_title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! 5D's: Shinkasuru Kettou! Stardust vs. Red Demon's
anime.synopsis: A non-canon Yu☆Gi☆Oh! 5D's special from the 2008 Super Jump Anime Tour. Yuusei Fudou and Jack Atlas face off in a Riding Duel for the title of Duel King, with Aki and the twins watching. The ace dragons, Stardust Dragon and Red Daemon's Dragon, clash once again, and this time gain the power to 'evolve' using the Buster Mode trap card, becoming "Stardust Dragon/Buster" and "Red Demon's Dragon/Buster."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about this Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's special. Some appreciate the animation and nostalgia, while others dislike the new gimmicks and predictable storyline. The special seems to cater more to younger audiences or die-hard fans, but overall it does not seem to be a substantial addition to the franchise.
pros: Animation is good.
Booster effects are enjoyable.
cons: Re-enacts past episodes.
New duel format on motorbikes is considered a negative gimmick.
3D CG cut scenes are awful.
Story is predictable.
Constant comments from the peanut gallery are annoying.

anime.title: Natsume's Book of Friends Season 2
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: As with its prequel, Zoku Natsume Yuujinchou is about Takashi Natsume, a boy who has had the ability to see youkai since he was young, and his bodyguard youkai Madara, nicknamed Nyanko-sensei. Natsume attempts to return names written in his "Book of Friends" (which he inherited from his grandmother Reiko) to youkai in his village. Throughout these adventures, he meets some youkai that are friendly, some that want to steal the Book, and some that want to kill him, as Natsume learns about himself and his relationship with these mysterious beings along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus for Zoku Natsume Yuujinchou is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers praise the show's gentle atmosphere, beautiful visuals, and emotionally resonant stories. While some find the episodic format repetitive, most appreciate the character development and exploration of themes like loneliness and friendship, making it a heartwarming and comforting experience.
pros: Beautiful art and animation, especially backgrounds.
Calming and well-fitting soundtrack.
Well-developed characters, especially Natsume and Madara.
Episodic stories are complete and emotionally resonant.
Exploration of themes like loneliness, friendship, and acceptance is well-handled.
cons: Can be repetitive due to episodic format.
Some find the pacing too slow or boring.
Limited character development for supporting cast.
Occasional animation hiccups.

anime.title: Akiba-chan
anime.synopsis: Akiba-chan focuses on the daily life of Akiba-chan and four fellow TV and game fans in the Maison de Akiba apartments. Buildup Entertainment (Gundam: Mission To The Rise, Macross Plus) produced the computer animation with director Junya Kabe (Specter, D) and character designer Poyoyon Rock (Nurse Witch Komugi, Starship Girl Yamamoto Yohko).
anime.consensus_summary: Akiba-chan is a light and cute series that is enjoyable in small doses due to its unique aesthetic and over-the-top presentation. However, its lack of depth in story and character development prevents it from having lasting appeal. The short episodic format works in its favor, preventing the cutesy nature from becoming grating.
pros: Unique doll and CG animation style
Bright and vibrant color palette
Perfectly fitting over-the-top cutesy voice acting
Well-paced short episodes prevent staleness
cons: Shallow, episodic storylines lacking depth
Minimal character development beyond generic labels
Jerky and awkward character movements
Limited emotional expression of the dolls

anime.title: Tales of Symphonia The Animation: Tethe'alla-hen
anime.romaji_title: Tales of Symphonia The Animation: Tethe'alla-hen
anime.synopsis: The second arc of Tales of Symphonia that takes place in the flourishing world of Tethe'alla. This OVA takes place up to two-thirds of the game, prior to the Derris-Kharlan arc.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Fans of the game appreciate the improved adaptation of the Tethe'alla arc, particularly the enhanced plot twist and romance. However, criticisms include the rushed pacing, character downgrades, excessive crying, and a lackluster soundtrack, indicating that the adaptation doesn't fully capture the depth of the original game.
pros: Fleshed out returning characters.
Improved story with personal stakes.
Satisfying adaptation of the Tethe'alla arc, surpassing the game in some aspects (plot twist, romance).
cons: Rushed story due to limited OVA format.
Core character downgraded to a plot device.
Too much crying compared to the game.
Lackluster soundtrack.
Characters appear and disappear without proper closure.

anime.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Space
anime.synopsis:
The story is set in the year 311 of the Orbital Calendar, when humanity has migrated to countless colony clusters in space. A space colony girl named Akiha Shishidou encounters a malevolent artificial intelligence named Leopard that has been installed on a colony.

Akiha is joined by an Inter-Colony Police officer named Itsuki Kannagi, a taciturn young girl named Honoka Kawai, and a robot named Imoko "Imo-chan" Shishidou.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with enjoyment heavily reliant on appreciation for absurd humor and references to other anime. Some find the initial episodes slow and the story generic, while others are entertained by the randomness and the character Leopard. Familiarity with anime tropes and Code Geass is beneficial for enjoyment.
pros: Unique character and colony designs
Enjoyable absurdity and randomness
Talented voice acting cast (seiyu)
The character Leopard is highly entertaining
cons: Slow starting episodes
Generic story elements
Recycled sound effects from Gundam SEED
Inconsistent music quality

anime.title: Macross Frontier: The False Songstress
anime.romaji_title: Macross F Movie 1: Itsuwari no Utahime
anime.genres: Mecha, Military, Music, Romance, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
Half retelling of the original Frontier series, half new story. Conspiracies arise within the Frontier government when Sheryl Nome arrives to the colonial fleet for her concert and is soon marked as a spy for Galaxy while childhood friends, Alto Saotome and Ranka Lee both try to achieve their dreams as the battle between Frontier and the Vajra draws closer.

This movie serves as part one of the Frontier retelling and will conclude with the second, The Wings of Goodbye.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Macross F Movie 1: Itsuwari no Utahime is well-received, especially by existing fans of the franchise. It's praised for its updated visuals, music, and fresh take on the story, though some find the plot rushed and the fan service excessive. The movie serves as a nostalgic and enjoyable experience for those familiar with the Macross universe.
pros: Stunning animation and updated visuals enhance reused scenes and create impressive battle sequences.
Music and songs are a major highlight, with new tracks complementing the classic Macross sound.
The plot makes changes and revamps to the original series, offering a fresh experience for fans.
cons: The story feels rushed and choppy, especially for newcomers to the franchise.
Some viewers found the fan service excessive and the portrayal of female characters lacking in agency.
Character development is sacrificed due to the condensed format.

anime.title: Library Wars: Situation Love Handicap
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Comedy, Drama, Military, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Despite being around a decade older than her, Library Task Force (LTF) member Mikihisa Komaki has been friends with Marie Nakazawa, a girl from his neighborhood, ever since she was little. Their relationship perseveres through thick and thin, and when Marie suddenly develops a hearing impairment during her middle school days, Komaki is there to support her—often by selecting books for her enjoyment.

But one fateful morning, Komaki finds himself arrested by the Media Betterment Committee, which charges him with invading the privacy of a minor due to the supposedly insensitive content of one of his recommended novels. Knowing that what awaits their friend at the "inquiry" is more akin to torture, the members of the LTF look for ways to save Komaki before it is too late.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is generally well-received for its storytelling and focus on Komaki's past. However, the age gap between the characters is a significant point of contention for some viewers, drawing comparisons to other anime with similar issues. While some appreciate the change of pace and quality, others find the romance aspect and age gap problematic.
pros: Enjoyable episode with a slower pace that sets the tone.
Direction and dialogue bring everything together beautifully.
High level of care and quality in the special.
cons: Age gap between characters is unnecessary and problematic.
Slow paced and romance driven in some aspects.

anime.title: Ikkitousen: Great Guardians Specials
anime.synopsis: Uncensored Ikkitousen: Great Guardians DVD Comedy Specials.
anime.consensus_summary: The Ikkitousen: Great Guardians Specials are primarily aimed at fans of the series who enjoy fan service. While some viewers appreciate the comedy and raunchy elements, others find the content disappointing, the episodes too short, and the fan service lacking. The specials are considered by some to be just a thin excuse for lewd scenes.
pros: Pleasing to fans of the Ikkitousen series
Unprecedented situations
Fan service of the best quality
cons: Short episode length
Disappointing content
Bland episodes
Low fan service in most episodes
Poor story
Porn with extra steps
Scenes only last a minute

anime.title: Bakugan: New Vestroia
anime.synopsis:
After the final downfall of the rogue Bakugan Naga, peace was brought back to Vestroia. With the help of Danma Kuusou, his companion Pyrus Dragonoid, and other Battle Brawlers, the Infinity and Silent Cores were combined and the realm was recreated.

However, New Vestroia will not be given any respite as humanoid alien invaders, the Vestals, arrive and conquer the Bakugan world in one fell swoop. Armed with a fearsome machine capable of restricting Bakugan into their ball forms, they aim to enslave the race as a form of entertainment.

Now, the only force standing in their way is the Bakugan Battle Brawlers Resistance—a group of humans, Bakugan, and Vestals who oppose the idea of annihilating a sentient race. Led by Danma, they must venture into enemy-occupied New Vestroia and repel the invaders, to assure the survival of the entire world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the improvements in story, characters, and battles compared to the first season. Some viewers found certain new characters underdeveloped and villains lacking depth, while others appreciated the darker subtext and moral complexity introduced. Overall, New Vestroia is considered a worthwhile watch for Bakugan fans, improving upon the original formula.
pros: Improved story and pacing compared to season 1.
Stronger character development, especially for returning characters like Dan and Shun.
Cool and hype battles, with unique abilities and diverse strategies.
Introduction of morally complex characters like Mira and intriguing villains like Spectra.
cons: Some found the new characters boring or empty.
Villains like Zenoheld and Hydron were one-dimensional.
Focus on Dan sometimes overshadows other characters.
Some battles were considered lame or uninspired.

anime.title: Spice and Wolf II
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Adventure, Drama, Romance, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Traveling merchant Kraft Lawrence continues his northward journey with wolf goddess Holo, in search of her lost home of Yoitsu. Lawrence and his sharp-witted partner continue to make some small profits along the way, while slowly uncovering more information about Holo's hometown. However, the road to Yoitsu is a bumpy one filled with many troubles—Lawrence runs into a charming young fellow merchant who has his eyes set on the female wolf companion, and he begins to doubt if Holo will remain by his side; he and the goddess will also have to consider precarious and risky business deals as Lawrence strives to achieve his dream of becoming a shopowner. All the while, with his determination tested at every turn during his journey, Lawrence must question his relationship with Holo, take on business ventures, and ask himself whether it is time for him and Holo to go their separate ways.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. While many appreciate the focus on character relationships and accurate adaptation, others are disappointed by the animation inconsistencies and perceived decline in plot quality. Some feel the characters' personalities suffered in the second season. Despite its flaws, many fans still find enjoyment in the series due to the strong chemistry between Lawrence and Holo.
pros: Strong character development, especially between Lawrence and Holo.
Engaging dialogue and witty banter.
Accurate adaptation of the light novels.
Well-researched economics, politics, and culture.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality compared to the first season.
Pacing issues, with too much time spent in one location.
Some find the plot less engaging and more repetitive than the first season.
Character personalities feel inconsistent or regressed.

anime.title: Asura Cryin'
anime.synopsis:
Natsume Tomoharu is a normal high-school student in every way with one exception: he's being followed by the ghost of his best friend, Misao.

After moving into his brother's old house, Tomoharu expects to continue living his normal life but is one day left with a mysterious and locked briefcase without any instruction. At first he plans to leave it in storage; however, his house is soon invaded by multiple groups of people after the briefcase. Although still not knowing the purpose of the briefcase, Tomoharu and Misao attempt to escape with it.

From there on, Tomoharu tries to learn the secrets behind the briefcase, the connections between it and Misao, and why it has the power to change the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the unique blend of genres and action, while others criticize the confusing and poorly executed plot. Many recommend watching both seasons to fully understand the story, but even then, some find it convoluted. There's a divide on whether the characters are enjoyable or poorly developed, contributing to the polarized opinions.
pros: Interesting concept with a mix of mecha and supernatural elements.
Good art and sound design, especially in the second season.
Some characters have depth and unique personalities.
cons: Convoluted and confusing plot, especially in the first season.
Inconsistent character development and unexplained plot points.
Pacing issues with fillers and random humor inserted at inappropriate times.

anime.title: Monkey Punch: Manga Katsudou Daishashin
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Gag Humor, Parody, Seinen
anime.synopsis: It's an animated variety show featuring the works of Monkey Punch that aired on WOWOW with the episodes being 52 minutes long. 12 episodes were aired between July 31, 2004 to June 25, 2005 and received a DVD exclusive 15 minute long special called Crime Mate.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Monkey Punch: Manga Katsudou Daishashin" is a funny and enjoyable anime for fans of Monkey Punch's humor and episodic storytelling. However, its explicit content and reliance on Japanese wordplay may limit its appeal. Lupin III fans should be aware that the character's appearances are minimal. The show is best enjoyed as a casual viewing experience, one episode at a time.
pros: Funny and enjoyable independent stories with varied characters.
Episodic format is good for casual viewing.
Art style is reminiscent of Monkey Punch's other works.
cons: Heavy reliance on Ecchi content may not appeal to all viewers.
Lupin III appearances are limited and mute, which may disappoint some fans.
Repetitive music.
Many jokes are based on Japanese wordplays, which are lost in translation.

anime.title: Detective Conan Magic File 2: Kudou Shinichi - The Case of the Mysterious Wall and the Black Lab
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Magic File 2: Kudou Shinichi Nazo no Kabe to Kuro Lab Jiken
anime.synopsis: Magic File 2 was sold at select retailers (7-11 branded equivalents) in Japan, along with PPV episodes of the show (episodes released long before, such as the NY case). The first disc housed the Movie 12 Side-Story OVA, which features Kudou Shinichi and details a bit of the backstory from the upcoming movie. The second disc was the one with the PPV episodes.
anime.consensus_summary: The Magic File is generally well-received by fans, especially those interested in Shinichi's backstory and the Kudo family dynamics. While the non-canon nature and art style might be drawbacks for some, it offers valuable context to the movie it accompanies. The overall mood is positive, with viewers appreciating the glimpse into Shinichi's life before his transformation.
pros: Provides backstory and context for the related movie.
Explores Shinichi's character before becoming Conan.
Features the Kudo family, which is enjoyable for fans.
cons: The art style is considered somewhat strange.
The story is non-canon, which may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Sengoku Basara: Samurai Kings
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Samurai
anime.synopsis:
In the Sengoku period, the struggle for power and unification has brought endless bloodshed to the unstable Japan. Out of all the warring generals, Nobunaga Oda—the "Demon King of Owari"—has established himself as the strongest ruler. Friend or foe, he is determined to crush anyone who stands in his way of creating a tyrannical central government. 

The only two who dare rebel against Oda are the "One-eyed Dragon of Oshu" Masamune Date, and the distinguished but hot-blooded warrior of the Takeda clan, Yukimura Sanada. Though they share the goal of preventing Oda from unifying the domains, Masamune and Yukimura cannot see eye-to-eye. Equally skilled in combat, mutual admiration for one another causes these two feuding warriors to forge a fierce rivalry, thwarting any attempts to form a united front against the Demon King of Owari. 

With Oda's forces closing in on their respective territories, Masamune and Yukimura reluctantly learn to put aside their differences and fight together against the threatening usurpator.
anime.consensus_summary: Sengoku Basara is a visually appealing, action-packed anime that prioritizes entertainment over historical accuracy or complex storytelling. While some appreciate the over-the-top battles and charismatic characters, others find the plot and character development lacking. The series is generally considered a fun, albeit shallow, experience best suited for fans of shonen action and those who don't mind historical liberties.
pros: Visually appealing art and animation, especially during action sequences.
Catchy and well-suited soundtrack that enhances the viewing experience.
Enjoyable characters with distinct personalities, even if somewhat clichéd.
cons: Simplistic and rushed plot with minimal character development.
Historical inaccuracies and over-the-top elements detract from any sense of realism.
Repetitive action sequences and reliance on shonen tropes can become tiresome.

anime.title: Canaan
anime.synopsis: Oosawa Maria is a Japanese photographer currently working in Shanghai, China. Along with her partner Mino, she searches for potential newsworthy stories throughout the city. When strange events occur at a local festival, Maria and Mino immediately investigate. Quickly, the two are immersed in a battle between unknown masked men and a strange, white-haired woman. Just when Maria is about to be caught in the crossfire, an old friend by the name of Canaan appears and helps Maria escape. But a sinister plot over a deadly virus soon develops, and Canaan learns she must confront her past if she wants any chance at stopping the perpetrator and saving her friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Canaan' is viewed as a solid action anime with strong visuals and compelling characters. While some find the plot confusing or the ending unsatisfying, most appreciate its blend of action, character development, and mystery. The relationship between Canaan and Alphard is a highlight, although some wish for more depth in certain areas.
pros: Excellent animation quality with detailed backgrounds and fluid action sequences.
Well-developed characters with complex motivations, especially the leads Canaan and Alphard.
Engaging story with a good balance of action, character development, and mystery, despite being based on a video game.
cons: The plot can be confusing for those unfamiliar with the 428 video game, with some unexplained events and rushed pacing.
Some supporting characters are underdeveloped or irrelevant until late in the anime.
The ending is unsatisfying or open-ended.

anime.title: La Maison en Petits Cubes
anime.synopsis:
In a flooded town where the waters are ever-rising, an old man must constantly build new floors onto his home in order to keep dry. But when his favorite smoking pipe falls into the watery abyss beneath him, he dives into the depths of not only his house, but memories of years past.
