Tsumiki no Ie is a short film about the everlasting effect of time on one's life—how it can swallow the past entirely, and how one must learn to continue moving forward despite what has already happened.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience mood is overwhelmingly positive, with many viewers finding the short film deeply moving and thought-provoking.  The film's ability to convey complex emotions without dialogue is widely praised.  However, a small minority find the film pretentious or lacking in substance, but this is a minority opinion. Most find it a concise masterpiece.
pros: Powerful storytelling through visuals and symbolism.
Excellent use of music to enhance emotions.
Profound exploration of memory, loss, and aging in a short time.
cons: Art style may not appeal to all anime fans.
Lack of dialogue may not resonate with all viewers.
Metaphorical nature can be predictable for some.

anime.title: Musashi: The Dream of the Last Samurai
anime.romaji_title: Miyamoto Musashi: Souken ni Haseru Yume
anime.synopsis: Musashi Miyamoto is known as a great swordsman of the 17th century. However, while tales of his legendary life loom large, it can be difficult to separate fact from fiction and understand who the man really was. To this end, researcher Kiichi Inukai attempts to investigate and shed light on the subject. From his time as an ordinary soldier, to the development of his unique two-sword style, to his writing of the seminal Book of Five Rings, Miyamoto's life is explored, revealing a picture of the man behind the myth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the informative and experimental nature, while others are put off by the inconsistent animation, documentary style, and perceived historical inaccuracies. The film is recommended primarily for those interested in Japanese history or Miyamoto Musashi specifically. Overall, the documentary is considered interesting and unique, but with significant flaws that hinder broader appeal.
pros: Informative content about Miyamoto Musashi
Unique blend of animation styles and live-action footage
Attempts to separate fact from fiction regarding Musashi's life
Good action choreography in battle sequences
cons: Inconsistent and sometimes jarring animation styles
Documentary format may not appeal to all anime fans
Narrator and assistant's antics deemed superfluous by some
Occasional deviations from the main topic
Questionable historical accuracy and potential for propaganda
Mediocre music and sound design

anime.title: Usavich III
anime.synopsis: The adventures of Putin and Kirenenko continue after they escaped from jail.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the development of character backgrounds and the innovative episode structure in Usavich III. However, some are disappointed with the ending, feeling it lacks closure and forward momentum. Lingering questions about the characters' past contribute to a sense of incompleteness, tempering overall satisfaction.
pros: Major character background explored.
Episode countdown provides balance and allows viewers to catch up.
Story related well to the settings.
cons: Ending not quite pleasing; didn't seem to set up future progress.
Unresolved questions remain regarding imprisonment and character history.

anime.title: Paniponi Dash!: Danjite Okonaeba Kishin mo Kore wo Saku
anime.romaji_title: Paniponi Dash!: Danjite Okonaeba Kishin mo Kore wo Saku
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Paniponi Dash! special included in the DVD-Box.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is well-received by fans of the series and parody anime in general. Its humor and references cater to an audience familiar with recent anime trends. While the increased fanservice and occasionally inconsistent art style might not appeal to everyone, the episode is a solid choice for those already invested in the Pani Poni Dash! universe.
pros: References to other anime series add value for dedicated fans.
Appearance of all main characters and fresh use of series' themes and jokes.
The episode stands alone well enough, but if you’re paying attention, you’ll get a bit more value out of your time.
cons: May not be accessible to viewers unfamiliar with recent anime.
Fanservice level has increased.
Art quality changes at random and mixes real life pictures.

anime.title: The Beast Player Erin
anime.synopsis:
In the land of Ryoza, the neighboring provinces of Shin-Ou and Tai-Kou have been at peace. Queen Shinou is the ruler of Ryoza and her greatest general, Grand Duke Taikou, defends the kingdom with his army of powerful war-lizards known as the "Touda." Although the two regions have enjoyed a long-standing alliance, mounting tensions threaten to spark a fierce civil war.

Within Ake, a village in Tai-Kou tasked with raising the Grand Duke's army, lives Erin, a bright girl who spends her days watching the work of her mother Soyon, the village's head Touda doctor. But while under Soyon's care, a disastrous incident befalls the Grand Duke's strongest Touda, and the peace that Erin and her mother had been enjoying vanishes as Soyon is punished severely. In a desperate attempt to save her mother, Erin ends up falling in a river and is swept towards Shin-Ou.

Unable to return home, Erin must learn to lead a new life with completely different people, all while hunting for the truth of both beasts and humanity itself, with tensions between the two regions constantly escalating.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Kemono no Souja Erin" is viewed as a mature and thought-provoking series, praised for its strong character development and detailed world-building, with few considering it controversial. However, some find the slow pacing and frequent flashbacks detrimental to the viewing experience. It is considered a hidden gem for those who appreciate character-driven narratives and complex themes, while others find it falls short due to production flaws.
pros: Well-developed characters, especially Erin, with significant emotional growth.
Intricate world-building with detailed cultural, historical, and political nuances.
Meaningful exploration of complex themes like morality, racism, and the impact of war.
cons: Slow pacing and excessive use of flashbacks can make the series feel dragged out.
Inconsistent animation quality and budget limitations are noticeable in some scenes.
Comic relief characters are often poorly integrated and detract from the story's impact.
Repetitive music
Predictable plot

anime.title: The Brave of Gold Goldran
anime.synopsis: Goldran follows the adventures of three young boys who are tasked with finding alien robot fighters, or Braves, that are sleeping in the form of crystals. Their major antagonist is the flamboyant and thoroughly incompetent Walter, and the villains that follow him are often similarly humorous.
anime.consensus_summary: Goldran is a lighthearted and charming mecha anime that prioritizes fun, camaraderie, and a sense of wonder. While its childish tone might not appeal to all viewers, its impressive robot combinations, wholesome characters, and themes of teamwork make it a worthwhile watch for those seeking a lighthearted adventure. The series evolves into a heartfelt exploration of loyalty and friendship in its second half.
pros: Impressive robot combinations
Wholesome, heroic spirit of the robots
Visual treat with creativity and flair
Exploration of loyalty, trust, and teamwork
growing connections and the strength to fight together
cons: Childish tone may not appeal to all mecha fans
Not a serious mecha fight anime

anime.title: Chibi Kero: Secret of the Kero Ball!?
anime.synopsis:
A young Keroro tries to impress Pururu by showing off the Kero Ball, a ball borrowed by Giroro from his brother Garuru. While testing the buttons, he accidentally transports the 4 tadpoles inside the ball. To get out, they must win the pinball maze. In the outside world, a young blue tadpole Kururu picks up the ball and hears the cries of help. He makes a deal to free those trapped inside if he gets a plate of curry rice. A deal is a deal and with the Kero Ball, a plate of curry rice is produced for Kururu. Unfortunately, the plate grows bigger and bigger and bigger. It got so big, that Kururu was immersed in the curry. The yellow curry slowly transforms the blue Kururu into the "yellow devil" and as the film is about to fade into black, "Kukuku" is heard.

(Summary found on Veoh.com)
anime.consensus_summary: The general sentiment is overwhelmingly negative. The short film is criticized for its poor animation quality, weak story, and lack of the humor and depth found in the original series. While the voice acting is appreciated, it is not enough to redeem the production.
pros: Voices are great
Characters act natural
cons: Boring
Cheap 3D animation
Disgrace to cel-shading
Sucks at animation
No impressive movements
Characters move like robots
Weak story
Childish
No innuendo
No suggestive themes
No language
No cartoon violence
No otaku jokes
No pop culture references
No smooth animation
Background music is annoying

anime.title: Modern Magic Made Simple
anime.synopsis:
Life hasn't been fair to Koyomi Morishita. Even though she's in high school, she's so short that everyone assumes she's still in grade school. The boys and girls in her school tease her mercilessly, and she's not exactly graceful either. On the other hand, she's still better off than Yumiko, who has a magician trying to kill her. Or at least Koyomi was until their paths crossed!

Fortunately, salvation arrives in the form of master mage and graduate student Misa Anehara, who agrees to take Koyomi under her wing in learning the new style of magic, which breaks enchantment down into sequences of code. That'll be quite a task, given that so far Koyomi's talent seems to consist of making washbasins randomly fall out of the sky. But if it was easy, it wouldn't be magic, would it?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with initial interest in the unique premise quickly fading due to poor execution. Reviewers generally find the story and character development lacking, resulting in a mediocre experience. While some enjoy the art style and music, the overall consensus points to wasted potential.
pros: Unique concept of modern magic using code is initially captivating.
Enjoyable and catchy opening and ending themes.
Some viewers appreciate the art style and character designs.
cons: Poor story development and a plain, uninspired plot.
Characters lack depth and development, remaining as 'moe puppets'.
Over-reliance on generic anime stereotypes and tropes.
Inconsistent and confusing plot progression with a weak ending.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 13: The Raven Chaser
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 13: Shikkoku no Chaser
anime.synopsis: Kudou Shinichi is living his life as Edogawa Conan, but those days seem like they might end pretty soon. The Black Syndicate is coming dangerously close to learning the truth about Shinichi having survived. Conan and everybody around him may end up dead if he doesn't manage to find Irish—a member of the Black Organization who has infiltrated the police forces, currently investigating a big serial murder case.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Meitantei Conan Movie 13: Shikkoku no Chaser" is well-received, particularly by long-time fans, for its integration of the Black Organization and suspenseful mystery. While some found issues with the case's resolution and certain character portrayals, the movie is generally praised for its engaging story, well-utilized cast, and exciting action. The movie is considered a strong entry in the Conan film series, though not without minor flaws.
pros: Strong Black Organization presence and integration into the plot.
Well-constructed mystery case with intriguing layers and clues.
Engaging use of a large cast of characters, each with a purpose.
Exciting action sequences and suspenseful moments.
Celebrates the series with references to past plots and characters, rewarding long-time fans.
The movie establishes a dark, gritty tone
cons: Some found the resolution of the main murder case abrupt or silly.
The motivation of the culprit was considered a stretch by some.
The Black Organization's ending felt unsatisfying to some viewers.
Music was forgettable and did not enhance bigger scenes
Ran's character being damselled towards the end

anime.title: Gozonji! Gekkou Kamen-kun
anime.synopsis: Gekkou Kamen is retired on the moon, so his trusty motorbike returns to Earth to find a new hero to take over the job of defending the Earth from alien invaders.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a well-received homage to a classic superhero series, blending humor and poignant storytelling. The animation and music are praised for their quality and faithfulness to the original's spirit. The main drawback is its lack of a DVD release, limiting its accessibility for modern audiences.
pros: Wonderfully funny and thoughtfully poignant re-telling of the old super-hero tale.
Relaxed and straightforward animation design.
Background animations capture the feel of small Tokyo neighborhoods accurately.
Music is subtly updated from the rousing original theme.
cons: Never been released on DVD.

anime.title: Mazinger Edition Z: The Impact!
anime.synopsis:
Set in the near future, humanity enters another energy revolution following the discovery of Photon Power. Derived from the ore discovered under the foothills of Mt. Fuji, its intended use was to solve the world's energy problems with its unimaginable power. Seeking this energy is Dr. Hell, a madman craving world domination who with his subordinates Baron Ashura, Count Brocken and Viscount Pygman, commands an army of mechanical beasts excavated from the ruins of ancient Greece to seize the Photon Power Lab for himself. Meeting the attack head on is the hot-blooded teenager Kabuto Kouji, who pilots the Photon Powered robot built by his grandfather, Mazinger Z. But in this battle between Dr. Hell and the Kabuto family, many legends surrounding the Mycenaean Civilization and Bardos Island, as well as the secrets of Mazinger Z remain shrouded in mystery.

A new series based on the mecha show that started it all, Mazinger Z. Shin Mazinger Shougeki! Z-Hen starts over from the beginning with a new cast, to tell a new story unrelated to the original show.
anime.consensus_summary: Shin Mazinger Shougeki! Z-hen is a love letter to the original Mazinger Z, praised for its old-school aesthetic and incorporation of Go Nagai's broader works. However, the show suffers from a convoluted and sometimes confusing plot, uneven animation, and an abrupt, unsatisfying conclusion. While fans of the original may appreciate the homage, others may find the narrative flaws and lack of closure disappointing.
pros: Faithful tribute to classic Mazinger Z with modern production values.
Excellent music and voice acting.
Interesting character designs and personalities, particularly Ashura.
Incorporates elements from across Go Nagai's works.
cons: Confusing and convoluted storytelling.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Underdeveloped side characters.
Abrupt ending due to cancellation.
anime.thematic_vibe: Old School Homage, Dark Undertones, Convoluted Plot

anime.title: Before Green Gables
anime.synopsis: The story of what happened to Anne Shirley before she was adopted.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Konnichiwa Anne: Before Green Gables' for its emotional depth, character interactions, and family-friendly themes. While the animation quality and deviation from the original novel are noted as weaknesses, the show's focus on emotional processing and relatable characters resonates positively with viewers. Overall, the audience consensus leans towards a favorable view of the anime as a lighthearted and meaningful drama.
pros: Strong character chemistry and interactions
Meaningful dialogues that explore life lessons
Varied and engaging episodes with relatable characters
Anne's optimistic perspective contrasts with adult pessimism
Simple, family-friendly narrative suitable for a wide audience
cons: Animation quality is rough
Some character arcs can be boring
Lack of respect/adaptation of the original novel

anime.title: Storm Rider: Clash of the Evils
anime.synopsis: This is a sequel to the story featuring two legendary and adventurous characters, Wind & Cloud. The Sword Worship Villa, the world's top sword maker, witnessed the bloody execution of its people due to allegations of conspiring to start a rebellion. The young master of the villa, Ao Jue, is the only survivor of the execution. In order to complete the “Jue” Sword, forged by generations of his family, Ao Jue swears to attack Tin Ha Wui and battle with Wind & Cloud in order to obtain the blood of the Flame Kylin which can unleash the power of the sword. With Wind's blood containing the blood of the Flame Kylin, he becomes the prime target in Ao Jue's plan of completing the sword.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response to Feng Yun Jue is mixed. While praised for its visual appeal and fight choreography, the film is criticized for a confusing and rushed plot, inconsistent character designs, and weak romantic elements. Overall, viewers found it to be an enjoyable watch for martial arts fans but not particularly memorable or impactful.
pros: Beautifully choreographed fight scenes
Visually stunning and detailed art style
Enjoyable for fans of martial arts and supernatural abilities
cons: Confusing plot and rushed storytelling
Inconsistent character designs and same-face syndrome
Weak romance and underdeveloped relationships

anime.title: Gun x Sword-san
anime.synopsis:
These are a series of 13 omake episodes of Gun x Sword, tied in very loosely to the plot, with the characters as chibi puppets. The main characters are Wendy and her turtle, Kameo, who is the size of a human in this series and is able to talk. All the episodes seem to center around analyzing various events in Gun x Sword and mocking the themes displayed.

They are included on the DVDs.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Gun x Sword-san are highly divided. Some viewers find the absurdist humor and meta commentary to be a refreshing and hilarious take on the original series and anime culture in general, while others consider it a poorly executed and unfunny waste of time that diminishes the reputation of the original Gun x Sword. The low production quality and repetitive jokes are frequent points of criticism.
pros: Good for a laugh
Subversive and hilarious critiques of anime culture
Charming meta humor reminiscent of early Gintama
VA's do God's work bringing these weird looking shapes into life
cons: Poor art and animation quality
Repetitive and unfunny jokes
Waste of time, especially for fans of the original series

anime.title: Polyphonica Crimson S
anime.synopsis: The new series will again focus on Corticarte, but it will tie into Ichiro Sakaki and Noboru Kannatsuki's Shinkyoku Sōkai Polyphonica crimson S light novel adaptation, which are set during the Academy years of the storyline.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the prequel's improved art and sound. However, many find fault with inconsistencies in the plot and character development compared to the original series, leading to a less cohesive viewing experience. Some viewers appreciate the attempt to add depth to the characters, while others find the changes jarring.
pros: Good art and animation, especially compared to the original series.
Excellent sound design, including music and voice acting.
Characters are well-developed in this prequel.
cons: Inconsistencies with the original series' plot and character portrayals.
Repetitive music and sound.
Uneven pacing, with boring moments interspersed with good ones.
Simplified or childlike depictions in the animation.

anime.title: Viper's Creed
anime.synopsis: The story revolves around the members of a private military company (PMC), and the uneasy tension between them and the regular military after a war that caused massive environmental destruction.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Viper's Creed are divided, with some praising its character development, action, and thematic depth, while others criticize its generic story, inconsistent CGI, and pacing. Some viewers found the anime enjoyable and recommend it, while others consider it a disappointment due to underdeveloped plot points and uninspired elements. The series elicits mixed feelings, resulting in a polarized reception.
pros: Great character development, with each character getting their moment to shine.
Intense and well-done action scenes, particularly the animation of the mechs and battles.
Exploration of human interactions, racial tensions, and immigration challenges adds depth to the narrative.
cons: The story can be generic and predictable, with a reliance on common tropes.
Inconsistent CGI in weaponry and fight scenes detracts from the visual experience.
Pacing issues with the story being too short to allow for deeper exploration, and tonal inconsistencies.

anime.title: Valkyria Chronicles
anime.synopsis:
In its expansion west to gain resources, the Europan Imperial Alliance invades the neutral Principality of Gallia, seeking to take control of its vast Ragnite deposits. Their strategic advantage, technological superiority, and military might make opposition nonexistent, so they steamroll through the border of the sleepy principality with ease.

As Imperial forces run through his quiet hometown, Welkin Gunther and his younger sister Isara jump into action, banding with the leader of the local militia to push the occupational forces out of the village. Quickly retreating to the Gallian capital, they are organized into a unit with the remnants of the militia, tasked with assisting in repelling the Imperial presence from the country.

Though unfamiliar with war, the newly formed Squad Seven must defend their country from annexation. But as the battle rages on through the streets of Gallia, ancient secrets will bring the team closer than they'd ever anticipated.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Valkyria Chronicles are divided. Some viewers appreciate the character development, unique setting, and overall story, especially those unfamiliar with the game. However, others criticize the inconsistent pacing, deviation from the source material, and reliance on anime cliches. This leads to a polarized reception, with some considering it a hidden gem and others finding it bland and disappointing.
pros: Well-developed characters with unique personalities and backstories.
Engaging blend of fantasy and WWII-inspired elements creates a unique setting.
High-quality artwork and animation, with a distinctive pencil-drawn style.
Strong musical score, including memorable opening and ending themes.
cons: Inconsistent pacing, with slow starts and filler episodes.
Uneven tone, struggling to balance comedy and drama effectively.
Story deviates significantly from the source material (the game), disappointing some fans.
Reliance on overused anime archetypes and cliches.
Poorly executed love triangle that detracts from the main plot and character development.

anime.title: Hayate no Gotoku!!: Atsu ga Natsuize - Mizugi-hen!
anime.romaji_title: Hayate no Gotoku!!: Atsu ga Natsuize - Mizugi-hen!
anime.synopsis: To encourage Nagi to swim and enjoy summer, Maria invites various friends to their Sanzenin family's private beach. While everyone is having fun, Nagi hesitates to wear swimsuits and come out because of her small breasts, and refuses to join...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys this OVA as a light-hearted fanservice episode with good comedy. It serves as a bridge between seasons and a re-introduction to beloved characters. While some may find the character design changes and lack of substantial story bothersome, the overall consensus is positive, especially for fans of the series and its humor.
pros: Great comedy and funny moments.
Enjoyable re-introduction of characters.
Good voice acting, especially Kugimiya Rie and Wakamoto Norio.
Successful parody of common anime tropes.
cons: Character design changes might bother some fans.
Lack of character development.
Thin story, typical of a fanservice OVA.

anime.title: 07-Ghost
anime.synopsis:
Barsburg Empire's Military Academy is known for training elites who bring victory to the empire. Students of the academy freely utilize an ability called "Zaiphon" to fight, while the types of Zaiphon usable depends on the nature of the soldier.

Teito Klein, a student at the academy, is one of the most promising soldiers produced. Although ridiculed by everyone for being a sklave (German for slave) with no memories of his past, he is befriended by a fellow student called Mikage. While preparing for the final exam, Teito uncovers a dark secret related to his past. When an attempt to assassinate Ayanami, a high-ranking official who killed his father, fails, Teito is locked away awaiting punishment.

Only wanting the best for Teito, Mikage helps him escape. Teito ends up at the 7th District Church where he is taken in by the bishops. It is here that Teito attempts to evade the grasp of Ayanami and the Military, so he can rediscover his memories and learn why he is the person that can change the fate of the world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on 07-Ghost. Many appreciate the beautiful art, sound, and character designs, as well as the unique blend of religious and military themes. However, the slow pacing, lack of a conclusive ending, and frustrating main character are significant detractors. Some viewers find the shounen-ai undertones enjoyable, while others consider them a detraction or a poorly executed element.
pros: Stunning art and animation quality, especially backgrounds and character designs.
Excellent soundtrack and fitting musical scores that enhance the emotional impact.
Interesting character development, particularly for Teito, with unique backstories for many characters.
Engaging and original story concept blending military and religious elements.
cons: Slow-paced story progression with repetitive elements and lack of a satisfying conclusion.
Underdeveloped female characters and over-reliance on male characters.
Inconsistent action scenes and underwhelming battle choreography.
Mediocre main character who is often indecisive and frustrating to watch.

anime.title: Pokémon: Pikachu's Summer Vacation
anime.synopsis:
Satoshi, Kasumi, and Takeshi surprise their Pokémon with a summertime retreat at a resort called Pokémon Plaza, where Pokémon of all types can relax and have fun outside their Poké Balls.

In the midst of so many boisterous Pokémon, Pikachu, Fushigidane, and Zenigame take turns soothing Kasumi's distressed Togepy and trying to lull it to sleep. But when an especially rowdy quartet consisting of Raichu, Bulu, Maril, and Karakara appears and causes Togepy to awaken, Pikachu's relaxing vacation is put in jeopardy.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly views this short as a fun, nostalgic trip back to the early days of Pokémon. While acknowledging its simple plot and occasional nonsensical moments, the charm, humor, and effective visual storytelling leave viewers with a positive and warm sentiment, especially those with childhood memories of the franchise.
pros: Successfully and humorously captures the essence of Gen I Pokémon.
The visual storytelling is effective due to strong character expressions and actions, making it easy to follow without dialogue.
The animation is lovely for its time and effectively conveys Pokémon emotions.
The atmospheric quality of the early Pokémon shorts is noted as particularly well-captured.
The character dynamics and interactions between Pokémon are enjoyable.
cons: The rules and physics within the short often don't make sense, even within the Pokémon universe.
Can be overshadowed by more significant entries in the franchise.
Some inconsistencies in Pokémon abilities and strength are present.

anime.title: Pokémon: Gotta Dance!
anime.synopsis: Jesse, James and Meowth have just completed building a giant new Team Rocket headquarters, and will soon be hosting a grand gala to show it to the boss. Several Whismur Pokemon (with maracas in hand) have been enslaved to provide the entertainment of the evening, much to their dismay. However, when Pikachu, Torchic, Mudkip and the rest of the gang find their way into the base and to the jail cell of the Whismur, they know they need to free their comrades from captivity. During the impending escape attempt, both friend and foe alike can't help but break out in group dances galore.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the short for its creative character use, catchy music, and well-executed dance sequences. Some find the plot simple and repetitive, while others appreciate the darker themes explored. Overall, the short is considered enjoyable, particularly for fans of Meowth and Team Rocket.
pros: Creative use of characters.
Catchy music.
Good animation with bright and cheery colors.
Well-choreographed dances.
Enjoyable and fun.
cons: Simple story.
Repetitive music might be irritating.
Dark themes of forced dancing may be disturbing for some.

anime.title: Pandora Hearts
anime.synopsis:
To young Oz Vessalius, heir to the Vessalius Duke House, the perilous world called the Abyss is nothing more than a folktale used to scare misbehaving children. However, when Oz's coming-of-age ceremony is interrupted by the malicious Baskerville Clan intent on banishing him into the depths of the Abyss, the Vessalius heir realizes that his peaceful life of luxury is at its end. Now, he must confront the world of the Abyss and its dwellers, the monstrous "Chains," which are both not quite as fake as he once believed.

Based on the supernatural fantasy manga of the same name, Pandora Hearts tells the story of fifteen-year-old Oz's journey to discover the meaning behind the strange events that have overtaken his life. Assisted by a mysterious Chain named Alice, whose nickname is "Bloodstained Black Rabbit," and members of a clandestine organization known as "Pandora," Oz begins to realize his existence may have more meaning than he could have ever imagined.
anime.consensus_summary: Pandora Hearts starts with a promising premise and intriguing characters, drawing inspiration from Alice in Wonderland. However, the anime suffers from poor animation, pacing issues, and a weak, anime-only ending that fails to resolve key plot points and character arcs. While the music and some character designs are praised, the overall consensus is that the anime fails to live up to its potential, leading to disappointment among viewers.
pros: Well-developed and original characters, particularly Alice, Gilbert and Break
Intriguing and detailed 'Alice in Wonderland'-themed world-building
Memorable soundtrack by Yuki Kajiura
Early episodes are compelling with dark themes and mysteries
cons: Poor animation quality with frequent errors and lack of detail
Weak and disappointing anime-only ending that leaves many story threads unresolved
Inconsistent pacing, including filler episodes and rushed plot points
Oz's character is often ineffectual, apathetic, and annoying
Plot inconsistencies and abandoned storylines.
Unsuccessful attempts at comedy undermine serious themes

anime.title: Sonic Night of the Werehog
anime.synopsis:
Published on SEGA's website in November of 2008, Sonic: Night of the Werehog is an ONA made to promote the release of Sonic World Adventure, also known as Sonic Unleashed in North America and Europe. 

Sonic and Chip venture to an abandoned haunted house on a rainy night, soon to be caught up in the antics of two mischievous ghosts, who scare any of the house's visitors in order to take their picture and impress the ghost girl who lives there with them. Though they succeed in scaring Chip out of his wits, the two can't seem to make Sonic bat an eye at them. Furious, the two band together in order to get the best of Sonic; will he be able to put a stop to the duo with a little help from the full moon?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Sonic: Night of the WereHog' is viewed as a visually impressive and entertaining short, particularly for Sonic fans. While the story is simplistic and may not resonate with all viewers, the animation, sound, and character expressions are generally praised. Most find it a fun, albeit not particularly deep, experience.
pros: Visually stunning animation and detailed artwork
Effective use of non-verbal storytelling and character expressions
Enjoyable and well-fitting soundtrack
cons: Weak or non-existent story for those unfamiliar with the game
Lack of dialogue may not appeal to all viewers
Limited character development and reliance on slapstick comedy

anime.title: Dogs: Bullets & Carnage
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Drama, Gore, Organized Crime, Sci-Fi, Seinen
anime.synopsis: It is sometime in the future, where a certain European city extends far underground, even secret, dark levels that have the key to the past. Ex-assassin Mihai has returned and is living with Kiri, who now runs a restaurant. Sword-wielding Naoto, Haine (white hair), a mysterious product of genetic engineering and his sometime partner Badou (eyepatch).
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is moderately divided, largely due to the OVA's perceived failure as an adaptation of the manga. While the unique character concepts and action are appreciated by some, many critics point to significant flaws in animation, storytelling, and overall execution that leave the series feeling incomplete and lacking the charm of its source material.
pros: Unique and interesting character concepts
Action sequences are entertaining and fun to watch (despite animation flaws)
Distinct personalities and appearances of characters
Good pacing for short episodes, never feels rushed
Voice acting (specifically Akira Ishida as Badou) is a highlight
cons: Animation quality is low, especially in long/mid-range shots and facial expressions
Story feels disjointed and lacks depth, often feeling like an introduction to something more
Humor and character charm from the manga are lost in translation to anime
Action scenes lack visual impact and can be unrealistic/unimpressive compared to the manga
Sound design issues like audio delay and unbalanced volumes
Overall feeling of incompleteness and lack of substance as a standalone series

anime.title: Summer Storm!
anime.genres: Comedy, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
In modern-day Japan, 13-year-old Hajime Yasaka moves to the countryside to stay with his grandfather. On the way to his new home, a lost Hajime finds himself in a cafe called Ark, where he immediately falls in love with one of the waitresses: the gorgeous Sayoko "Arashi" Arashiyama. While Arashi is initially unconcerned with the boy, her attitude quickly changes after she grasps Hajime's hand, leading her to believe they are "connected."

As it turns out, Arashi is anything but a regular teenager—in reality, she is the ghost of a girl who perished in World War II. By touching a man she connects with, she gains the ability to travel back in time. Delighted to have found someone who can unlock her powers, Arashi asks Hajime to help with her mission: to save civilians from the carnage of the war that claimed her life. Smitten with Arashi, Hajime readily agrees. But as the two get further involved with Arashi's past, they soon discover that she is not the only one able to transcend time.
anime.consensus_summary: Natsu no Arashi! is a unique and quirky anime that blends time travel, comedy, and historical elements. While some viewers find the tonal shifts jarring and the plot confusing, others appreciate the well-developed characters, creative art style, and excellent music. Overall, the series is considered underrated and enjoyable, especially for those who appreciate SHAFT's distinctive style.
pros: Unique blend of genres (comedy, romance, sci-fi, historical elements).
Well-developed and likeable characters with distinct personalities.
Excellent music, including opening and ending themes with a retro vibe.
Creative art style and animation, with SHAFT's signature visual flair.
cons: Tonally inconsistent, with zany comedy clashing with serious themes.
Plot can be confusing and disjointed, especially in the first half.
Repetitive jokes and running gags may become tiresome for some viewers.
Directing choices might not fully complement the art style.

anime.title: Resident Evil 4D Executor
anime.synopsis:
Biohazard 4D Executor was a 20 minute CG movie that people in Japan could see in a special theater. 

Though the CG was primitive, (the rendering and models aren’t much better than that seen in Resident Evil 2, it’s certainly not on par with Resident Evil 3) it told the story enough. Below is a summary of the events within the 20 minute movie. 

The story focuses on an elite unit of 5 UBCS members, sent into Raccoon City to try and rescue Dr. Cameron. An Umbrella scientist lost in all the confusion. The UBCS team, consisting of members Rodrigo, Roger, Klaus, Ed and Norman, have a GPS device used to track down Dr. Cameron’s last known location, which is near a large food factory. 

Upon entering the factory they are attacked by a large creature, a sort of hybrid between a Tyrant and the more evolved forms of Nemesis.
anime.consensus_summary: Biohazard 4D-Executer is largely considered a relic of early CG filmmaking, appealing primarily to hardcore Resident Evil fans for nostalgic reasons. Its simple story and dated graphics are major drawbacks. While some appreciate its connection to the franchise's roots and find humor in its flaws, most viewers find it unentertaining and skippable unless they have a strong attachment to Resident Evil.
pros: Appeals to die-hard Resident Evil fans due to its connection to the original story and creatures.
Some find the ridiculous scenes amusing and entertaining.
Sound and visuals are decent for the time it was made.
cons: Primitive CG and outdated graphics.
Mundane and basic storyline.
Poor voice acting and sound quality.
Over-reliance on shock factor leads to disgust rather than fear.
Predictable and overused cliches.

anime.title: Eden of The East
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Award Winning, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
On November 22, 2010, Japan was hit by missile strikes, a terrorist act that fortunately did not harm anyone, becoming known as "Careless Monday." Quickly forgotten, society goes on about their lives as normal.
 
During her graduation trip to America three months later, friendly college student Saki Morimi's life is forever changed when she finds herself saved from unexpected trouble by Akira Takizawa. Takizawa is cheerful, but odd in many ways—he is stark naked and suffers from amnesia, believing himself to be a terrorist. In addition, he possesses a strange cell phone loaded with 8.2 billion yen in digital cash.

Despite Takizawa's suspicious traits, Saki quickly befriends the enigmatic young man. However, unbeknownst to her, this is the beginning of a thrilling death game involving money, cell phones, and the salvation of the world. Higashi no Eden chronicles Saki's struggle to unravel the mysteries behind her savior, while Takizawa himself battles other individuals armed with similar cell phones and returning memories which reveal his possible connection to the event from months ago.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with many praising the show's initial premise, animation, and main character, but criticizing the incomplete ending and underdeveloped plot threads. Some found the story thought-provoking and suspenseful, while others felt it failed to deliver on its initial potential, with logical inconsistencies and shallow character development. The series is considered enjoyable but flawed, leaving viewers wanting more closure and depth.
pros: Intriguing plot with mystery and suspense
Unique premise exploring societal issues
Well-developed main character (Akira Takizawa)
Excellent animation and art style
Catchy opening and ending themes
Interesting themes regarding money and power
Good pacing that reveals plot points without rushing or overwhelming the viewer
cons: Incomplete ending without movies
Underdeveloped supporting characters (Saki)
Plot holes and logical inconsistencies
Overpowered 'Juiz' and nonsensical use of abilities
Underused "Save Japan" concept
Inconsistent pacing with confusing genre shifts
Contrived plot twists
Female lead written to be passive

anime.title: Doukyuusei 2 Special: Sotsugyousei
anime.synopsis: Based on the game by ELF.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience feels the OVA had potential but ultimately failed to deliver a satisfying story. The plot is vague, characters are underdeveloped, and the story feels incomplete. The inconsistent censorship also detracts from the experience, leaving viewers disappointed.
cons: Plot is vague and not well-explained.
Too many characters with underdeveloped plots.
Censorship is inconsistent and distracting.
Potential for a better story was wasted.
anime.thematic_vibe: Unresolved Romance, Vague Storytelling, Unexplored Characters

anime.title: To LOVE-Ru OVA
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Episode 01: Rito becomes a Woman
Lala invents a gizmo to make her bust bigger. However, this invention of hers accidentally turns Rito into a woman.

Episode 02: Rito and Mikan
Feeling lonely because Rito is always spending time with Lala, Mikan storms out of the house. While Rito and Lala are out looking for her a few flashbacks from the past, showing Rito and Mikan as kids, are shown.

Episode 03: Welcome to the Southern Resort!!
Haruna wins an island resort trip for ten females. Rito gets turned into a dog by one of Lala's inventions and somehow ends up on the island as well.

Episode 04: Trouble Quest
Rito and the girls become trapped inside an RPG game where the objective is to save Lala and defeat the evil witch Kyouko.

Episode 05: Nana and Momo
Lala's sisters cause mischief for Rito and his harem at a cherry blossom viewing.

Episode 06: Draft, Metamorphose, Hand & Tail
Yami and Yui confront with a senior, causing Yui to lose her panties.

Mikan finds Peke taking snapshots of new clothing while shopping. Suddenly, a stranger steals her bag.

As Rito tries to explore Lala's cleaned-up bedroom, he accidentally activates one of Lala's invention, fusing his hand to Lala's tail.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received by fans of the To Love-Ru series, particularly those who enjoy ecchi content. While some episodes are criticized for being filler or prioritizing fanservice over plot, the overall consensus is that the OVA is an improvement over the first anime season due to its more faithful adaptation of the manga. Many viewers found the characters entertaining and the situations amusing, making it an enjoyable experience despite its shortcomings.
pros: More ecchi content than the TV series.
Faithful adaptation of manga chapters (mostly).
Enjoyable characters and situations.
cons: Some episodes are considered filler and lack plot.
Heavy focus on fanservice overshadows the story.
Episode 3 is notably weak and lacks a conclusion.

anime.title: GA: Geijutsuka Art Design Class
anime.genres: CGDCT, School, Slice of Life, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis: The Ayanoi High School features the Geijutsuka Art Design Class (GA) that focuses on the arts. Five close friends — the energetic "hime"-prankster Noda Miki; the level-headed, cynical Nozaki Namiko; the intelligent, observant, and kind Oomichi Miyabi; the lively and mischievous tomboy Tomokane; and the curious, innocent, glasses-wearing Yamaguchi Kisaragi — attend this class with great enthusiasm, learning about the many art techniques. Every day seems to pose a new and interesting challenge, be it struggling with the latest assignment or when dealing with the daily strangeness of school life.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences find 'GA: Geijutsuka Art Design Class' to be an enjoyable and informative slice-of-life anime, especially for those interested in art. The humor is consistent, and the art-based jokes are unique. However, some viewers find the characters predictable and the art style too cutesy. The show is not particularly controversial, appealing mainly to fans of the slice-of-life genre.
pros: Informative about art and design
Consistent humor
Unique art-based humor
Good visuals and sounds
cons: Predictable characters and situations
Too cutesy art style
Lacks depth of character
Story goes nowhere

anime.title: Saki
anime.genres: School, Seinen, Slice of Life, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
Due to childhood circumstances, first-year high school student Saki Miyanaga hates anything related to mahjong. When she does play the game, she keeps a low profile to avoid standing out. One day, her friend Kyoutarou Suga drags her along to the school's mahjong club. There, she meets Nodoka Haramura, the champion of the previous year's national middle school mahjong championship, and Yuuki Kataoka, a fellow club member.

As the club play a few rounds, Saki attempts to hide her talent. However, the club president, Hisa Takei, notices Saki's unusual playstyle. Realizing her potential, she puts Saki's real ability to the test—proving her to be more talented than expected. This revelation damages Nodoka's pride, and their relationship gets off to a rocky start.

Saki ends up joining the club, and after clearing up the misunderstandings between her and Nodoka, friendship blooms between them. As Saki slowly warms up to mahjong once again, she and the rest of her club only have one goal—to win nationals!
anime.consensus_summary: Saki is a generally well-received anime that injects energy and excitement into the game of Mahjong. While the over-the-top action and character abilities are enjoyable, some viewers find the plot and character development lacking. The yuri undertones and open ending are divisive, but overall, the show is considered fun and entertaining, especially for those who enjoy moe and sports anime.
pros: Exciting and dramatic mahjong matches with well-thought-out strategies.
Cute character designs and generally good art quality.
Enjoyable and addictive, easy to marathon.
cons: The plot can derail and contains too much filler and fan service.
Character development is lacking, especially in the supporting cast.
Unresolved plot lines and an open ending can be unsatisfying.

anime.title: Basquash!
anime.synopsis: On the planet Earthdash, its inhabitants gaze on its moon and the technologically advanced lunar city of Mooneyes with awe. Dan JD, a boy living in Rollingtown on Earthdash's surface, gets caught up in Bigfoot Basketball—a fast-paced sport played with giant Bigfoot robots.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Basquash! is mixed. Viewers appreciate the initial novelty, music, and art style, but the general consensus is that the show declines significantly in its second half. The shift in narrative focus, inconsistent animation, and rushed ending led to disappointment for many, resulting in a polarizing viewing experience.
pros: Catchy music and engaging sound design, particularly in the first half.
Visually appealing art style, especially in the early episodes.
Unique blend of sports and mecha elements offers a fresh take on both genres.
Likeable characters and humorous moments create an enjoyable viewing experience.
cons: Story becomes convoluted and loses focus in the latter half, shifting from sports to saving the world.
Inconsistent animation quality, with a noticeable decline after the initial episodes.
Shallow character development and forced romantic subplots.
Rushed and unsatisfying ending that leaves many questions unanswered.

anime.title: Kobato.
anime.synopsis:
The friendly and sincere Kobato Hanato has a wish to go to a particular place no matter what. To fulfill this desire, she is tasked with helping people in their times of distress. For each mended broken heart, a small candy-like fragment is produced and fills a special bottle. Once the bottle is full, her wish will be granted.

As Kobato carries out her mission alongside her stuffed toy companion, Ioryogi, she encounters various people troubled by their different situations. From a child struggling with his parents, a high school girl troubled about romance, and everything in between, Kobato's naturally sweet smile and outgoing personality are ready to brighten their day!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Kobato. is overwhelmingly positive, with many praising its heartwarming story, lovable characters, and beautiful art style. While some find the pacing slow or the main character's naivety irritating, the overall consensus is that it is a feel-good anime that explores themes of empathy and selflessness. Most viewers find it to be a soothing and emotionally resonant experience.
pros: Heartwarming and emotionally resonant story
Lovable and well-developed characters
Beautiful artwork and soothing soundtrack
Exploration of empathy and selflessness
cons: Repetitive episodic format in the first half
Slow pacing and occasional fillers
Naivety of the main character can be off-putting to some
Ending may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: K-ON!
anime.synopsis:
A fresh high school year always means much to come, and one of those things is joining a club. Being in a dilemma about which club to join, Yui Hirasawa stumbles upon and applies for the Light Music Club, which she misinterprets to be about playing simple instruments, such as castanets. Unable to play an instrument, she decides to visit to apologize and quit.

Meanwhile, the Light Music Club faces disbandment due to a lack of members. This causes the club members to offer anything, from food to slacking off during club time, in order to convince Yui to join. Despite their efforts, Yui insists on leaving due to her lack of musical experience. As a last resort, they play a piece for Yui, which sparks her fiery passion and finally convinces her to join the club.

From then onward, it is just plain messing around with bits and pieces of practice. The members of the Light Music Club are ready to make their time together a delightful one!
anime.consensus_summary: K-On! is a polarizing anime. Some viewers find it to be a delightful and heartwarming slice-of-life show with cute characters and catchy music. Others criticize it for its lack of substantial plot, overabundance of 'moe', and failure to deliver on its musical premise. Ultimately, enjoyment of K-On! depends on individual preferences for lighthearted, character-driven content.
pros: Catchy music and enjoyable insert songs.
Adorable and loveable character designs.
Positive energy and feel-good atmosphere.
Detailed portrayal of musical instruments.
cons: Lack of a strong or original story.
Repetitive themes and cliche scenarios.
Overreliance on 'moe' elements that can be annoying to some viewers.
Underdeveloped characters with superficial traits.
False advertising due to little focus on actual music.
Lazy animation and some mediocre art quality.

anime.title: Summer Wars
anime.synopsis:
OZ, a virtual world connected to the internet, has become extremely popular worldwide as a spot for people to engage in a large variety of activities, such as playing sports or shopping, through avatars created and customized by the user. OZ also possesses a near impenetrable security due to its strong encryption, ensuring that any personal data transmitted through the networks will be kept safe in order to protect those who use it. Because of its convenient applications, the majority of society has become highly dependent on the simulated reality, even going as far as entrusting the system with bringing back the unmanned asteroid explorer, Arawashi.
 
Kenji Koiso is a 17-year-old math genius and part-time OZ moderator who is invited by his crush Natsuki Shinohara on a summer trip. But unbeknownst to him, this adventure requires him to act as her fiancé. Shortly after arriving at Natsuki's family's estate, which is preparing for her great-grandmother's 90th birthday, he receives a strange, coded message on his cell phone from an unknown sender who challenges him to solve it. Kenji is able to crack the code, but little does he know that his math expertise has just put Earth in great danger.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Summer Wars" is a visually appealing and heartwarming anime film that celebrates the importance of family and human connection in the digital age. While some find the plot predictable and the characters underdeveloped, the film's emotional impact, stunning animation, and excellent music leave a positive impression on most viewers. Despite its flaws, it's considered an enjoyable and memorable experience for those who appreciate feel-good stories and vibrant animation.
pros: Visually stunning animation with a unique blend of CGI and traditional cel-shading, creating vibrant and detailed environments.
Well-developed and relatable characters, each with unique personalities and flaws that contribute to the ensemble cast's dynamic.
The soundtrack is outstanding and adds emotional depth to key scenes, enhancing the viewing experience.
The story explores themes of family, unity, and the importance of human connection in an increasingly digital world.
cons: The plot can be predictable and formulaic, with some elements feeling like a rehash of previous works by the director, particularly 'Digimon: The Movie'.
Some characters are one-dimensional, lacking depth and development beyond their initial introduction.
The blend of genres (sci-fi, family drama, romance) can feel unfocused, with none of the elements being particularly well-executed.
The resolution of the conflict relies on convenient plot devices and the power of friendship, diminishing the impact of the climax.

anime.title: Phantom: Requiem for the Phantom
anime.synopsis:
Mafia is rife in America where assassinations are a regular occurrence on the streets. Inferno, a mysterious company, is behind most of these dealings through the use of their near-invincible human weapon, "Phantom."

One day, a Japanese tourist accidentally witnesses Phantom's latest murder. Desperate to escape, the tourist hides in a secluded building. However, Phantom, revealed to be a young woman named Ein, and the leader of Inferno "Scythe Master" captures the tourist and brainwashes him.

Given the name "Zwei," this once peaceful tourist is now a puppet of Inferno with no memories. Drawn into a world of lies, deceit, and violence, Zwei must fight to survive, hopefully to one day regain his memories and escape from this world where he is constantly on the brink of death.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Many appreciate the initial intrigue, character development, and complex relationships, finding it a compelling psychological thriller with strong emotional impact. However, a significant portion is critical of plot inconsistencies, rushed pacing in the latter half, and character derailment, leading to disappointment with the overall execution and ending.
pros: Dynamic and meaningful character development, especially for the main characters.
Intriguing and complex relationships between characters, adding depth to the narrative.
The first half of the series is praised for its pacing, atmosphere, and engagement.
cons: Plot holes, inconsistencies, and rushed pacing, particularly in the second half of the series.
Questionable character motivations and illogical decisions that contradict earlier established traits.
Some viewers find the ending unsatisfying, contrived, or inconsistent with the overall themes.

anime.title: Fresh Precure!
anime.synopsis: Love Momozono is a 14-year-old student at Yotsuba Junior Highschool that tends to care more for others than for herself. One day she visits a show of the famous dance unit "Trinity" and decides to become a dancer, too. On the same event, subordinates of the Labyrinth Kingdom show up who want to collect the unhappiness of the audience. Love gets the power to change into Cure Peach and fights them. Soon after, she is joined by her good friends Miki, who is Cure Berry, and Inori, who becomes Cure Pine.
anime.consensus_summary: Fresh Precure is generally well-received, praised for its strong characters, engaging storylines, and emotional depth. The series explores themes of friendship and individuality effectively. While some find the animation inconsistent and some episodes repetitive, the overall sentiment is positive, with many considering it a highlight in the Precure franchise.
pros: Strong character development, especially the villains' arcs.
Good blend of comedy and emotional moments.
Exploration of themes like conformity vs. individuality.
Memorable and lovable characters with strong relationships.
Well-executed use of familiar Pretty Cure formula.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality.
Predictable or boring episodes in the middle.
CGI animation in endings is outdated.
Rushed redemption arc for one of the characters.
Soundtrack is forgettable.

anime.title: Nodame Cantabile Finale
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Josei, Music, Performing Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Shinichi Chiaki is quickly making a name for himself as the principal conductor of the revitalized Roux-Marlet Orchestra, and Megumi "Nodame" Noda has made leaps and bounds as a pianist at the Conservatoire de Paris. However, tensions mount between the two as Nodame feels left behind by Chiaki's growing success and his close friendship with legendary piano prodigy Rui Son. Disregarding her teacher Professor Charles Auclair's advice, Nodame enters another piano competition in an attempt to jumpstart her own performance career. 

Meanwhile, those around Chiaki and Nodame are at their own crossroads. Rui begins to doubt herself after hearing Nodame's playing and being denied tutelage from Auclair; Maestro Franz von Stresemann faces the reality of his mortality; pianists Yunlong Li and Tatiana Vishneva feverishly prepare for a competition, while the latter also struggles with her growing feelings for oboist and fellow student Yasunori Kuroki. 

As Chiaki, Nodame, and their friends continue on their respective journeys, they must not only strive to stay true to themselves, but also remember where it all started.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is generally positive, highlighting the beautiful music, realistic romance, and character development. However, some find the ending rushed and unsatisfying, with inconsistent character intentions causing frustration. Despite flaws, the series is praised for its mature themes and engaging storyline, making it a memorable anime experience.
pros: Beautiful classical music that enhances the storyline.
Realistic portrayal of love and relationships, showing growth and maturity.
Well-developed characters with depth and relatable struggles.
Enjoyable and engaging storyline with a mature vibe and trademark comedy.
cons: Rushed and unsatisfying ending.
Inconsistent character intentions and lack of relationship progress.
Muddy character intentions and constant flip-flopping of feelings.
Felt a drop in quality compared to previous seasons.
anime.thematic_vibe: Realistic Romance, Musical Struggle, Personal Growth

anime.title: Flame of Recca: Final Burning
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Martial Arts, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: This episode explains why the title of the series is "Flame of Recca". The things that happened in this short OAV was in the last volume, volume 33, of the tankoubon of Flame of Recca.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a disappointing conclusion to the series for many viewers, especially those unfamiliar with the manga. While some appreciate the attempt to adapt the ending, the rushed plot, poor art quality, and confusing narrative make it a letdown. It primarily serves as nostalgia for manga readers rather than a satisfying standalone anime.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga ending (for those who read it).
Well-produced music, art, and sounds.
cons: Poor art quality, even worse than the original TV series.
Rushed plot, confusing for viewers who haven't read the manga.
Poor character depictions compared to the anime.
Unintelligible story and characters without manga context.

anime.title: Sora wo Miageru Shoujo no Hitomi ni Utsuru Sekai
anime.romaji_title: Sora wo Miageru Shoujo no Hitomi ni Utsuru Sekai
anime.synopsis: To save both the Magical Kingdom and the Heavens and restore the flow of akuto, the flow of energy of everything, the Magical King Munto must follow a vision and find the girl Yumemi in the normal world. Yumemi herself is just a normal girl except that she is the only one who can see the islands of the Heavens floating above. When Munto appears before her she starts thinking about hers and others responsibility to the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the blend of genres, Yumemi's character arc, and the improved music, others are critical of the inconsistent animation, confusing plot, and underdeveloped characters. The reuse of older animation and lack of clear explanations are common points of concern. Ultimately, it's considered an enjoyable but flawed fantasy anime.
pros: Good music and voice acting contribute to the enjoyment.
Fluid animation, especially in the newer episodes, and detailed backgrounds enhance the visuals.
Yumemi's character development is praised as she becomes a stronger, more confident heroine.
The series offers an original fantasy experience, blending action, romance, and slice-of-life elements.
cons: The plot suffers from inconsistencies, leaving key elements unexplained.
Story jumps around too much, leading to confusion.
The series reuses animation from older OVAs, resulting in inconsistent art quality.
Many characters are underdeveloped and forgettable.

anime.title: Keroro Gunsou Movie 4: Gekishin Dragon Warriors de Arimasu!
anime.romaji_title: Keroro Gunsou Movie 4: Gekishin Dragon Warriors de Arimasu!
anime.synopsis: Mysterious giant beings called "Ryū no Shippo" (Dragon Tails) appeared across the world. Due to the danger it could bring, the Keroro Platoon did a worldwide research on the Dragon Tails, but Tamama suddenly disappeared during the research. Because of this, the whole platoon started their search for Tamama and ended up in Mont-Saint-Michel, France where they met mysterious girl named Sion, who holds the mysterious Ryū no Hon (Dragon Book). But little they know about the secrets about her and the worldwide calamity that would destroy the entire world, as they know it...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the movie enjoyable and well-animated, appreciating its accessible storyline and relaxing nature. However, others criticized the portrayal of the characters, finding their transformations jarring and inconsistent with the established tone of the series. This leads to a polarized view, with opinions varying based on expectations and familiarity with the franchise.
pros: Enjoyable and relaxing to watch.
Well-animated with fluid fight scenes.
Doesn't require prior knowledge of the series.
cons: Dragon forms feel abrupt and out-of-character.
Inconsistent with the usual adorable personalities of the Keroro Platoon.
Some character designs are considered ugly.

anime.title: Moomin: Season 2
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Kids, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: In the remote and mysterious Moomin Valley live the Moomin trolls, gentle and peaceful creatures. Young Moomin and his family experience many strange adventures, both magical and mundane. Based on the children's stories by Tove Jansson.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is widely considered unnecessary and inferior to the first. It deviates from the original stories and characterizations, resulting in a jarring experience for many viewers. While the sound design receives some praise, the art style and narrative choices are heavily criticized, leading to a divided opinion on its overall value.
pros: Sound department stands out with fine voice acting
Some story arcs are decent
cons: Art style is horrible and doesn't fit the format, animation is lackluster
Characters are not like their first season counterparts
Stories feel unnatural and do not feel like Moomins anymore
Out of place sound effects and music pacing

anime.title: Kiniro no Corda: Secondo Passo
anime.genres: Josei, Music, Reverse Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis: The story continues after the intraschool music competition of the first game and anime series. The budding music student Kahoko meets the brusque boy Etō, the new youthful school board director Akihiko Kira, and the mysterious transfer student Aoi Kaji.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Kiniro no Corda: Secondo Passo is mixed, with significant disappointment stemming from its brevity and perceived redundancy. While some appreciate the updated visuals and music, many feel the new characters overshadow the old, and the plot retreads familiar ground. The short length prevents meaningful character development or romantic resolution, leaving fans wanting more.
pros: Beautiful scores and soundtracks, particularly 'You're in my heart'.
Appreciation for the updated animation style and visually appealing scenery.
Some enjoyment derived from seeing more of the existing characters from the first series.
cons: Disappointment with the short length (only 2 episodes).
Frustration with the introduction of new characters at the expense of established ones.
Repetitive plot mirroring elements from the first season, specifically character redemption through music.
Lack of resolution regarding the romantic interests of the main character.
Underdeveloped new characters, making it difficult to connect with them.
anime.thematic_vibe: Musical Inspiration, Unresolved Romance, Character Focus

anime.title: Tayutama: Kiss on My Deity
anime.synopsis: Yuuri Mito is a typical, normal Japanese teenager.  He goes to school, works on people's motorcycles and performs exorcisms.  Okay, that last part's a little bit unusual, but his family lives in a shrine and they do that sort of thing.  Still, you would think he'd know enough to be careful with an ancient relic he finds in the woods, especially when a mysterious goddess appears and tells him to leave it alone.  Unfortunately, despite Mito's best efforts, the seal gets broken anyway and a number of dangerous "tayuti" that it held in stasis get loose.  This is bad.  Mito also ends up with a beautiful goddess girl who decides that she's going to marry him.  This might not be so bad. if he wasn't already caught up in the middle of a war between the entities he's released.  The flesh may be weak but the spirit's more than willing to compensate.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are mixed, with some finding it a cute and enjoyable romance anime, while others criticize its lack of depth, unoriginal story, and weak character development. Many feel it had potential but failed to fully deliver. It's generally considered a pleasant but not particularly memorable series, best suited for fans of the harem/romance genre.
pros: Cute and heartwarming art style.
Enjoyable and upbeat music.
Pleasant and relaxing to watch.
cons: Simplistic and unoriginal story.
Weak character development.
Lacks depth and contrast.
Underdeveloped villains.

anime.title: The Prince of Tennis: Another Story - Messages From Past and Future
anime.romaji_title: Tennis no Oujisama: Another Story - Kako to Mirai no Message
anime.synopsis:
1. Naniwa no Oujisama: Zenpen
2. Fuun Shounen Atobe
3. Naniwa no Oujisama: Kouhen
4. Rikkai Retsuden: Ouja ni Idomu Hangyakuji
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the OVAs for their character development and humorous moments, particularly the Osaka-based episodes. However, there are concerns about the franchise's continued reliance on shallow characterizations and prioritizing visuals over compelling narratives. Some find the backstories interesting, while others criticize the character flaws.
pros: Provides background history on important characters
Funny and enjoyable side stories
cons: Character development issues persist
Prioritizes visuals over comprehensible stories

anime.title: Precure All Stars Movie DX: Minna Tomodachi☆Kiseki no Zenin Daishuugou!
anime.romaji_title: Precure All Stars Movie DX: Minna Tomodachi☆Kiseki no Zenin Daishuugou!
anime.synopsis: Love, Miki and Inori are on their way to a dance contest, but get lost on their way to Minato Mirai. Still looking for their way, they are attacked by a monster. When the three Fresh Precure girls start to fight it, other Precures show up to support them. They all have to combine their powers to win against this mighty enemy.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a well-received crossover event, mainly praised for its exciting team-ups and fight choreography. However, it's criticized for lacking deeper individual character interactions and uneven focus on certain teams. Overall, fans appreciate the movie as a celebration of the Precure franchise.
pros: Exciting crossover with all Precure teams.
Well-choreographed fight scenes with distinct combat styles.
Characters are entertaining and none overshadow another.
cons: Lacks individual interaction between characters.
Splash Star squad not given a special treat.
Some characters overshadowed in dialogue (Luminous).

anime.title: The Familiar of Zero: Rondo of the Princesses OVA
anime.romaji_title: Zero no Tsukaima: Princesses no Rondo - Yuuwaku no Sunahama
anime.synopsis: DVD beach episode of Zero no Tsukaima: Princesses no Rondo. Also known as episode #6.5.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is mixed. While some viewers found the episode hilarious and enjoyable due to its fan service and comedic elements, others criticized its lack of story and excessive pervy scenes. It's primarily recommended for existing fans of the series who enjoy ecchi anime, while others may find it skippable or a waste of time.
pros: Hilarious comedy
Enjoyable for fans of the series
Good art and sound quality
cons: Lack of story
Pervy scenes
Unnecessary fan service

anime.title: Tenchi Muyo! War on Geminar
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Mecha, School
anime.synopsis:
Kenshi Masaki has been kidnapped and brought to the world of Geminar by a mysterious group. To get back home, he agrees to help them assassinate the newly crowned empress of the Shtrayu Empire, Lashara Aasu XXVIII, using a giant robot called a Sacred Mechanoid.
 
As her army fights them off, Lashara takes note of Kenshi's abilities and demands that her attacker be captured alive, only to find out that the pilot is male which is extremely rare on Geminar. Believing it to be a waste to kill him, she makes Kenshi her attendant.
 
As the empress' new servant, Kenshi is required to accompany Lashara to the Holy Land, an academy where Sacred Mechanoid pilots hone their skills. His arrival attracts attention, but Kenshi is unaware that something sinister is brewing within the academy and it could plunge the entire world into war.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers enjoying the series for its action, comedy, and likeable characters, particularly Kenshi. However, many find the plot generic, the characters underdeveloped, and the harem elements overbearing. The series struggles to balance its various themes, resulting in an inconsistent and often frustrating viewing experience.
pros: Well-animated fight scenes and mech designs
Likeable main character (Kenshi) and diverse female cast
Enjoyable blend of action, comedy, and school life
cons: Generic or predictable storyline with harem elements overshadowing plot
Shallow character development and one-dimensional female characters
Inconsistent tone with forced fanservice and humor, weak romance

anime.title: Fantascope: Tylostoma
anime.synopsis:
A man who appears every 700 years.
Stretching before the man's eyes the world rusted away to monochrome and gray.
Once before the town flourished that is now in ruins.
The man now, has a chance meeting with a person, a prositute.
A story of passion curling like smoke....Tairosu Tomah's story has begun.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed but generally appreciative of the show's artistic and experimental nature. Some find the visual style and pacing unconventional, while others are drawn to its unique atmosphere and storytelling approach. The show is considered a heartfelt artistic creation, particularly for fans of Yoshitaka Amano's work.
pros: Unique visual style with monochrome paintings and flowy lines that fit the setting.
Interesting narrative device of 'Story within a story'.
Voice acting feels bare and like real people talking, adding to the mystery.
cons: May be perceived as 'boring' or 'weird' by modern viewers used to fluid movement and colorful palettes.
Not every character action and not every thought is clear.

anime.title: Bird's Song
anime.synopsis:
A boy is walking home through the city where he finds a new path that he follows. It starts to rain and he seeks shelter with the aid of a girl. He falls in love with the girl. He gets a feather, and if he always carries it, they will meet again. He returns to his home following the path, but the next day he cant find it again. Time progresses and he forgets the girl. 50 years later he returns to the same city and he dreams of the girl. He is still dutifully carrying the feather. 

Written, drawn, and directed by famed illustrator Yoshitaka Amano.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds 'Tori no Uta' to be a unique and enchanting experience, largely due to its surreal atmosphere, beautiful art, and amazing music. While the plot may be confusing and the animation is lacking, the OVA is still considered enjoyable and thought-provoking. It is recommended for viewers who appreciate experimental and unconventional anime.
pros: Incredible OST that compensates for art problems
Enjoyable and entertaining due to music and dream factor
Beautiful, intricate and expressive art by Yoshitaka Amano
Surreal and dreamlike experience with room for personal interpretation
Insightful exploration of characters' dreams and psyches
cons: Plot doesn't make much sense
Art consists of a succession of images that change slowly
Lack of animation may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Hanasakeru Seishonen
anime.synopsis:
Kajika Louisa Kugami Burnsworth is the only daughter of Harry Burnsworth, an influential and respected industrialist who has the power to move the world. There was a threat on Kajika’s life when she was just two years old, and her mother died protecting her. After this tragic incident, Harry sent his only child to an isolated island, Giviolle, where she was raised by the island’s native, Maria. Kajika’s companions during her time there include a white leopard named Mustafa and a boy named Li Ren Fang, who visited her two or three times a year.

Kajika, now fourteen, returns to her father's side, only to be told to begin a game to find her future husband. Harry makes sure that Kajika willingly participates in this game by telling her that she needs to face the harshness of her fate along with the man she chooses to be her husband. She needs to decide among the three candidates that Harry has personally chosen, but it won’t be easy. Kajika must figure out who they are and where they are without any information to go on except that they all possess an irresistible brilliance and charm. All the while, the men aren't even aware that they are the chosen ones. Kajika must also choose wisely, as her partner has to willingly accept her to be his bride.

Hansakeru Seishounen revolves around endearing love, intense passion, noble friendship, undying loyalty, family relations, and political intrigue. The heaviness of Kajika’s fate is real, the threat on Kajika’s life is inevitable, and the husband game is more than just a mere game. Harry needs to find a suitable partner to protect his daughter before someone discovers Kajika’s deep secret—a secret even she is unaware of.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Hanasakeru Seishounen is viewed positively for its strong characters, unique plot that goes beyond typical reverse harem tropes, and mature storytelling. While some find the political aspects or art style less appealing, the majority appreciate the depth and complexity of the story. The series is often described as underrated and a hidden gem within the shoujo genre.
pros: Strong female lead who defies typical reverse harem stereotypes
Intriguing plot that blends romance with political drama and mystery
Well-developed and unique characters with depth and compelling backstories
Mature and sophisticated storytelling
Good pacing and satisfying resolution
cons: Some find the political elements uninteresting or confusing
The art style may not appeal to all viewers, with some finding it old-fashioned or inconsistent
Some viewers found the ending anticlimactic or overly dramatic
The female lead can come across as unrealistically mature, and perfect to some

anime.title: Pokémon: Pikachu's Summer Festival!
anime.synopsis: Summer has arrived, and many Pokemon have set up shops for a summer festival on the beach. Soon the gang will be blessed by a special performance from the pop idol Azumarill, but upon her arrival, she's kidnapped by the flying Pokemon Skarmory! Pikachu, along with Plusle, Minun, Meowth, Wobbuffet and a number of other Pokemon must now track down the singing beauty; the show must go on!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience found the special to be a simple and enjoyable adventure, although the quality of art and sound was not up to par with the main series. The use of human voices for Pokemon was a significant detractor for some viewers. Overall, it seems to be a lighthearted side-story, not a major point of contention for the fanbase.
pros: Brings the story to life nicely (despite limitations).
cons: Voices of Pokémon spoken by humans are not well-received.
Art and sound are not at the same level as the TV show or movies.

anime.title: Cinnamoroll: The Movie
anime.synopsis: Mocha, Chiffon, Cappuccino, Espresso, and Milk go with Cinnamoroll in this adventure of a lifetime. Join them in their quest, meeting new friends like Anna (the girl who found Cinnamoroll/Cinnamon) and discovering new places like the Forest of Pastries and Bread and the Coffee Waterfalls.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, particularly among those who appreciate cute and lighthearted content. However, many find the plot simplistic and underdeveloped, with weak character development and reliance on tired tropes. While enjoyable for children, it lacks depth and substance for older viewers, resulting in a mixed reception overall.
pros: Visually appealing animation style, especially for those who like cute aesthetics.
Characters have unique personalities, promoting the value of friendship despite differences.
Some viewers found the story sweet and emotionally resonant, particularly towards the end.
cons: Shallow and trite plot that rehashes the "save the female character" trope.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of character development, with characters often acting as archetypes.
Weak villain development and themes not fully explored.
