Plot relies on leaps in logic and deus ex machina to progress.
Some voice acting choices were considered annoying or not fitting.

anime.title: Legend of the Condor Hero III
anime.romaji_title: Shin Chou Kyou Ryo: Condor Hero III
anime.synopsis: Sequel to Shin Chou Kyou Ryo: Condor Hero II.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is overwhelmingly positive about Shin Chou Kyou Ryo: Condor Hero III, praising its engaging story, well-developed characters, and emotional depth. Despite some technical shortcomings in animation and sound, the strong narrative and character arcs compensate, leaving viewers highly satisfied. The season is considered a rewarding conclusion to the series, with fans expressing a desire for more content.
pros: Strong character development, particularly for Yang Gou and Huang Rong
Engaging plot twists and a compelling storyline
Introduction of diverse and enjoyable new characters
Well-handled character motivations and consequences
Satisfying character arcs, such as Li Muchou's redemption
Xiao, Lung Nu's disappearance provides a strong motivation for the main character
Xangier's growth into a likable character
cons: Poor animation quality, especially in lower resolution formats
Subpar sound quality
Disliked character: Lu Fou
anime.thematic_vibe: Character Development, Martial Arts, Emotional Journey

anime.title: Nanaka the Distraction
anime.synopsis: Unaired series episode included in the DVD release.
anime.consensus_summary: The Nanaka 6/17 Special is a lighthearted bonus episode primarily aimed at fans of the Yuriko X Nenji pairing. The episode focuses on comedic situations arising from Yuriko's attempts to avoid being seen with Nenji. Viewers who enjoy the characters and light humor will likely find it enjoyable, while others may find it skippable. The content doesn't seem to generate strong opinions, leading to a low controversy score.
pros: Humorous situations and character interactions
Bonus content for fans of specific character pairings
cons: Episode relies heavily on a specific character pairing (Yuriko X Nenji)
Plot is simple and primarily for comedic effect
May not appeal to viewers not interested in the featured characters or humor

anime.title: Examurai Sengoku
anime.synopsis: The Examurai Sengoku anime production depicts the members of the EXILE group as futuristic samurai that are transported back in time to Japan’s sengoku (warring states) period. The anime character renditions of the EXILE members were designed by manga creator Hiroshi Takahashi (Crows, Worst).
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response to Examurai Sengoku is lukewarm. While the character designs, attributed to Hiroshi Takahashi, are a significant draw, the shallow story and ordinary animation prevent it from being truly exceptional. The anime primarily appeals to fans of samurai themes and Takahashi's previous works, but doesn't seem to generate strong opinions beyond that niche.
pros: Character designs are vivid and ostentatious, resembling a mix of samurai and gangster aesthetics.
The character designs are done by Hiroshi Takahashi (Crows/Worst).
cons: The story is shallow and mediocre.
The anime is not particularly outstanding or groundbreaking.
Animation is decent but ordinary.

anime.title: Student Council's Discretion
anime.synopsis:
Imagine living life as the vice president of the student council, passing the days eating snacks, playing games, and bonding with a harem of beautiful girls. This is exactly the kind of life that high school student Ken Sugisaki leads, or so he thinks!

Usually, the officers of Hekiyou Academy's student council are elected by popular vote, but an additional position is granted to the student who scores the highest on the exams. Ken, who historically has had below average grades, worked hard to improve them to be accepted into the student council, with the ultimate goal of surrounding himself with girls who fawn over him.

Unfortunately for the vice president, things do not go quite as planned. Not only do the ladies of the council continually rebuff his advances, they also prefer to focus on more important and "boring" activities, such as organizing school events and managing the other clubs. But a few minor hurdles like these won't stop Ken from chasing after his dreams, even if they seem a bit ridiculous.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers praising the anime's humor and parody elements, while others find it repetitive and lacking in substance. The show's reliance on anime references can be alienating to those unfamiliar with the source material. While the characters are generally well-liked, the lack of a compelling plot and the limited setting detract from the overall experience.
pros: Creative parodies and references to other anime.
Strong and distinct character designs.
Catchy opening theme and varied ending themes.
Good voice acting, especially considering the cast included rookies.
cons: Lack of a strong overarching plot.
Over-reliance on parodies that may not be understood by all viewers.
Claustrophobic setting primarily confined to the student council room.
Inconsistent humor, with some jokes falling flat or being too forced.
Underdeveloped side characters.

anime.title: Kanamemo
anime.synopsis:
Middle schooler Kana Nakamachi's life drastically changes when her grandmother passes away. Leaving behind an empty house, Kana learns that no one can provide her lodging due to her young age. Eventually, she stumbles upon the Fuhshin Gazette, a local newspaper delivery business who is able to provide her with a place to stay if she works for them in return.

The small store is staffed by several unique people: the sweets-loving Yume Kitaoka and her girlfriend Yuuki Minami; the frugal Hinata Azuma; the alcoholic Haruka Nishida; and the young but mature Saki Amano. It is not all fun and games at the Fuhshin Gazette, though, as Kana must deal with long working hours, energetic dogs guarding mailboxes, and confusing delivery routes. Add in a small rivalry with Mika Kujiin, a girl from a competing store, and Kana will have more than enough to keep her hands full!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the show to be a charming and sentimental slice-of-life anime with likeable characters. Others were turned off by the weak story, annoying voice acting, and poorly executed ecchi elements. There is significant division over the humor and character archetypes.
pros: Heartwarming Feel
Likeable Characters
Episodic Format Works for Comedy
cons: Annoying Voice Acting
Lack of Character Depth
Poorly Executed Ecchi Elements
Weak Story

anime.title: The Sacred Blacksmith
anime.synopsis:
Forty-four years ago, the surviving nations of the Valbanil War declared peace and forbade the use of the devastating demon contracts that ravaged the land. Now, inexperienced knight Cecily Cambell is eager to follow the example of her family and protect the people of the city using the sword she inherited from her father.

Her first challenge arises in the market. A crazed swordsman wreaks havoc upon civilians and Cecily jumps into action to restore order. Overwhelmed, her weapon shatters, but a skilled stranger wielding a strange-looking sword intervenes. With the situation diffused, Cecily heads to a local blacksmith in an effort to restore her family heirloom. However, she finds out that her savior—the blacksmith Luke Ainsworth—may be the only person capable of such intricate repairs. Determined to have her treasured sword repaired, she seeks out the man who rescued her.

However, a group of bandits suddenly attack a convoy headed for the city. The assailants look inhuman, and an ice demon appears. Luke suspects the use of a demon contract and calls upon a sacred power to defeat them. Meanwhile, a shadowy hooded figure lurks, watching from a distance. Who is this mysterious evildoer, and what does his appearance mean for the pair?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding the anime mediocre due to its unoriginal plot, annoying protagonist, and rushed pacing. Some viewers appreciate the good production values, enjoyable supporting characters, and moments of character development. However, the negative aspects often outweigh the positives, leading to overall disappointment.
pros: Excellent production value and animation quality.
Interesting and likeable supporting characters.
Good BGM and fitting opening/ending themes.
Some character development, particularly for Cecily.
cons: Clichéd and unoriginal plot.
Annoying protagonist (Cecily) with illogical behavior.
Rushed pacing and disjointed storytelling.
Unnecessary fanservice and boob jokes.
Weak or non-existent villain.
Inconsistent tone, mixing light-heartedness with dark themes.

anime.title: Cross Game
anime.genres: Drama, Romance, School, Shounen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis:
Kou Kitamura and Aoba Tsukishima are often at odds—even though their families happen to be close friends and business partners. Although the only child of a sports shop owner, Kou has never been interested in playing baseball. Despite this, he possesses an impressive batting ability honed by frequent visits to the local baseball batting center run by the Tsukishima family. On the other hand, Aoba loves to play baseball and is a star player with exceptional pitching form.

However, these two seemingly complete opposites share something very important to them—Wakaba Tsukishima, Aoba's older sister and Kou's destined sweetheart. Admired by the quarrelsome duo, Wakaba often finds herself the catalyst to their never-ending rivalry. But whether or not they realize that they have more in common than either would care to admit, only time will tell. The game of baseball may just be what the pair needs to ultimately overcome their own personal struggles.
anime.consensus_summary: Cross Game is a character-driven anime praised for its emotional depth, well-developed relationships, and surprising story twists. While some find the slow pacing and repetitive elements to be drawbacks, most appreciate the series' ability to blend drama and comedy effectively. The anime is considered a heartwarming and nostalgic experience that explores themes of loss, growth, and the importance of human connections.
pros: Strong character development and relationships
Beautiful blending of drama and comedy
Unpredictable and surprising story twists
Heartwarming and heart-wrenching narrative
Good pacing and flow of the story
Meaningful exploration of themes like loss and growth
cons: Slow pacing may frustrate some viewers
Repetitive elements
Animation quality dips at times
Overly optimistic tone can be unrealistic
Skipped-over baseball game details

anime.title: Element Hunters
anime.synopsis: In 2029, a large scale ground sinkage occurred in the Mediterranean Sea. Chemical elements such as oxygen, carbon, gold, molybdenum, and cobalt disappeared from the earth's crust suddenly. The human population was decreased by 90% in sixty years. Researchers found out that the disappeared elements were drained into a planet "Nega Earth", located in another dimension. To save the Earth, a special team called the "Element Hunters" is organized. All of the members are under 13 years old, because young and flexible brains are needed to access "Nega Earth".
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the unique concept and educational value, while others find the pacing slow and the execution mediocre. The show seems to appeal more to younger viewers or those seeking a light-hearted, nostalgic experience. The series is not particularly controversial but rather elicits varying degrees of engagement and enjoyment.
pros: Unique concept of element dematerialization and Nega-Earth is engaging.
Appeals to younger audiences and can spark interest in science, particularly chemistry.
Some viewers found it enjoyable as a light-hearted show with a compelling goal.
Original world-building and focus on political drama are appreciated by some.
cons: Slow pacing and lack of initial interest are common complaints.
Can be boring or mediocre, especially as the storyline progresses.
Inconsistent target audience, feeling too childish for some while conversations are too complicated for others.
Artwork and animation quality could be improved.

anime.title: Gurren Lagann: Viral's Sweet Dream
anime.romaji_title: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann Movie Zenyasai: Viral no Amai Yume
anime.synopsis: Viral tries to get some sleep, but keeps on having terrifying nightmares.  Can't anyone save him from his plight?
anime.consensus_summary: The special is a short, comedic side piece focusing on Viral's nightmares. It's well-received by fans of the series' humor and Viral's character. The main drawback is its short length and limited availability, but overall, it's considered a worthwhile and funny experience for fans.
pros: Funny situations and entertaining antics.
Good for fans of Viral and Gurren Lagann's humor.
Short and doesn't overstay its welcome.
cons: Difficult to find.
Very short, meager development.
Primarily jokes, may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: A Certain Magical Index: Specials
anime.synopsis: A series of shorts featuring Index-tan.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly enjoys these shorts, finding them far more entertaining and funnier than the original series. They are praised for their sharp comedic writing, numerous references, and excellent execution as a gag special, making them highly recommended even for those who didn't enjoy the main anime.
pros: Humorous and exaggerated imitation of the original anime
Numerous references and parodies of the original series, other anime, and voice actors
Effectively uses sound effects and over-the-top voice acting for comedic effect
Solid animation, sound, and voice acting, arguably better than the original
Excellent execution of gag special format, avoiding common pitfalls like overplayed jokes or poor art
cons: No actual plot, solely focused on comedy

anime.title: Nyoron! Churuya-san
anime.synopsis:
An anime adaptation of the 4-panel strip manga release: Nyoron Churuya-san. Based on Suzumiya Haruhi's energetic and 'always up to go' character, Tsuruya.

Churuya is a girl with a strong passion for smoked cheese. But Kyon and the rest of the crew know this, and they make use of the weakness. They make her do all kinds of things with smoked cheese as a possible reward. But Churuya isn't aware of this evil plot, thus she maintains the effort for the sake of cheese. Each day is a struggle to get the beloved smoked cheese, but it's much harder than she could ever imagine!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the show's absurd humor and randomness hilarious and enjoyable, while others criticize its simplistic plot, repetitive gags, and perceived laziness in art style. Many see it as a harmless, short diversion for fans of the Haruhi Suzumiya series, while others find it to be a waste of time due to its lack of substance and inconsistent character portrayals. The humor seems to be a major dividing factor, with some appreciating the bizarre and nonsensical elements and others finding them uninspired and repetitive.
pros: Unique and bizarre humor provides a refreshing experience.
Voice acting praised when consistent with the original series.
Enjoyable for fans of the original Haruhi Suzumiya series seeking more content.
cons: Art style is often criticized as lazy and poorly drawn.
Humor relies heavily on repetitive gags that can become tiresome.
Characters may not act consistently with their original portrayals, disappointing some viewers.
Plot is extremely minimal and may not appeal to those seeking substance.
anime.thematic_vibe: Absurdist Comedy, Parody, Slice of Life

anime.title: Heaven's Lost Property
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ever since he was a child, Tomoki Sakurai has always woke up with tears after a dream of an angel. His childhood friend Sohara Mitsuki worries about this and decides to seek the help of Eishirou Sugata, an eccentric sky maniac. He concludes that Tomoki's dream is undoubtedly connected to what is known as the New World, a floating anomaly that scientists have failed to understand.
 
Recruiting the New World Discovery Club's first members, Eishirou schedules a time to meet up in order to observe the mystery in the sky. That day, Tomoki's peaceful life is changed forever when a strange girl falls from the sky and begins to call him master.
 
Sora no Otoshimono follows the daily activities of the New World Discovery Club as they begin to learn more about the Angeloids that have arrived on Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is significantly divided, largely polarized by the show's heavy reliance on perverted humor and ecchi elements. While many praise the high production quality, unique soundtrack, and surprising emotional depth that emerges later in the series, detractors find the humor repetitive and the protagonist unlikable. The show is recommended for those who appreciate ecchi comedy and can look past its more divisive aspects to find its underlying strengths.
pros: Exceptional animation quality with smooth fluidity, great scene transitions, and high production values.
Memorable and unique soundtrack, with distinct ending themes for each episode that often include epilogues.
Talented voice acting that brings characters to life and enhances the comedic aspects.
Surprising depth and emotional weight in later parts of the series, elevating it beyond a simple ecchi comedy.
Creative and often hilarious use of chibi characters for comedic effect.
Strong character development for the main characters, particularly Tomoki and Ikaros, adding depth and making them relatable.
cons: Humor, particularly the perverted jokes, becomes repetitive and can fall flat for some viewers.
The plot can feel shallow and underdeveloped, often serving merely as a premise for ecchi or comedic situations.
The 'ecchi' elements are described as mindless and lacking situational depth by some, reducing their appeal.
The protagonist, Tomoki, is intensely disliked by some viewers due to his perverted nature and perceived lack of meaningful contribution.
Inconsistency in how angeloids function and the plot can be riddled with holes, potentially due to over-reliance on fanservice.

anime.title: Beyblade: Metal Fusion
anime.synopsis: A new cast of characters take on the continued battle between good and evil. Ginga, our hero, and his group of loyal friends take on a dangerous group called the Dark Nebula. The Dark Nebula’s sole mission is to take over the world and unleash their evil upon it; but before they can do so, they must destroy Ginga as he is the only person that’s strong enough to stand in their way. The plot thickens as friends become enemies and enemies become allies. Everything starts and ends with Ginga as he struggles to find the strength to defend his world and the honor of Beyblade.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has a strong nostalgic connection to Metal Fight Beyblade, particularly those who watched it during their childhood. While some recognize its flaws as an anime from an adult perspective, they still appreciate it for its engaging characters, exciting battles, and positive themes. Overall, the audience sentiment is positive, with many considering it a significant part of their childhood.
pros: Memorable characters and engaging story, especially for younger audiences.
Exciting action sequences and special moves.
Teaches the value of friendship and teamwork.
cons: May not appeal to adult audiences due to simplistic plot and dialogue.
Animation and writing quality might not hold up well over time.
Can be repetitive or formulaic.

anime.title: Ristorante Paradiso
anime.synopsis: When Nicoletta was a little girl, her mother, Olga, abandoned her and ran off to Rome to remarry. Now, 15 years later and a young woman, she travels to Rome with the intention of ruining her mother's life. She tracks Olga down to a restaurant called Casetta dell'Orso, but the second Nicoletta steps through its door, everything changes. It's a peculiar place staffed entirely by mature gentlemen wearing spectacles, and like their clientele, she is helpless against their wise smiles and warm voices. Before Nicoletta realizes it, her plans for vengeance start to fade, and she's swept up in the sweet romance of everyday Italian life.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience has a positive sentiment towards Ristorante Paradiso, praising its relaxing atmosphere, well-developed characters, and unique setting. While some find the slow pacing and lack of a strong central plot to be drawbacks, the majority appreciates it as a character-driven slice-of-life anime. The series is considered a hidden gem for those who enjoy mature themes and subtle storytelling.
pros: Well-developed and endearing characters with unique backstories
Beautiful and relaxing art style, capturing the atmosphere of Rome
Soothing and well-fitting soundtrack
Subtle and enjoyable drama
Good insight of complex familial relationships
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers
Plot can be predictable and lacking major events
Underdeveloped main plotline
Inconsistent animation quality
Not enough emphasis on food, considering the restaurant setting
Some find the romance unconvincing

anime.title: Oblivion Island: Haruka and the Magic Mirror
anime.romaji_title: Hottarake no Shima: Haruka to Mahou no Kagami
anime.synopsis: Your favourite teddy bear. That model kit that took so long to complete. The picture book you used to read over and over again. The shining stone you found that day in the park. Where do all your childhood's treasures go when you grow up? In this story, we meet fantastic creatures that gather all these little objects that fall into oblivion as they are forgotten by their owners when they step into adulthood. These creatures sneak into our world from a different dimension, and unseen by humans, they take all the ditched and forgotten "treasures" into their world. Here, they use their booty to build their own city, a fairy tale-like place called... Oblivion Island!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Oblivion Island" is well-received for its stunning visuals, imaginative story, and heartwarming characters, making it a recommended watch for animation fans, especially families. While the plot may be predictable and the villain weak, the film's strengths outweigh its flaws. The film evokes a sense of nostalgia and wonder, reminding viewers of the importance of cherishing memories and the objects that hold them.
pros: Visually stunning 3D animation, pushing the boundaries of the medium.
Creative and original story concept exploring the theme of forgotten objects.
Charming and heartwarming character development, especially between Haruka and Teo.
Excellent voice acting and well-integrated music.
cons: Predictable plot elements and a somewhat shallow storyline.
Weak and uninteresting villain.
Some plot holes and unoriginal story aspects.
Mediocre secondary characters.

anime.title: Spice and Wolf II: The Wolf and the Amber Melancholy
anime.romaji_title: Ookami to Koushinryou II: Ookami to Kohakuiro no Yuuutsu
anime.synopsis:
Traveling merchant Kraft Lawrence and wolf deity Holo sit down to have dinner with Norah Arendt, a young shepherdess who helped them smuggle gold. Holo's dislike of Norah—due to both the latter's profession and her closeness with Lawrence—prevents her from enjoying her meal.

When Holo falls ill from fatigue, she is cared for by Lawrence, who frets over the health of his dear companion. As she regains her strength, Holo reminisces about the adventures they had together.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the OVA, particularly the character interactions and focus on Holo. While some viewers were disappointed with the change in animation style and character portrayals compared to the first season, most found it to be a worthwhile addition to the series. The OVA serves as a pleasant re-introduction and foreshadows more romance elements.
pros: Well-made re-introduction to the main characters.
Explores 'inner' character development through dreams and flashbacks.
Maintains the music from the first season.
Holo's character is condensed effectively into the OVA format, highlighting her appealing traits.
Enjoyable interactions between characters.
Exploration of historical concepts.
cons: Animation and character design are different from the first season, with some preferring the original style.
Characters sometimes act out of character, with Lawrence and Holo feeling slightly off.
Plot is minimal and can be omitted without losing sight of the overall story.

anime.title: Jewelpet
anime.synopsis:
When what looks to be a cluster of shooting stars appear in the sky, Rinko Kougyoku and her friend Minami each make a wish.

What the girls truly saw were not stars, but 'Jewel Charms' falling to the Earth. These charms were created by three magicians in a magical world names Jewel Land, each housing one of its many native Jewelpets. Although these creatures are free to roam the world in their original form, the magicians sometimes turn them into charms so that they can be carried around with great ease. Most Jewelpets don't find this troublesome, but once a mischievous bunny by the name of Ruby feels overly claustrophobic, she devises her escape.

One day, the magicians decide to move the Jewelpets, and task a pelican with delivering them to the Dream Forest. All is well until a strong gust of wind disorients the bird, who then drops all of the charms that he was carrying. Instead of heading towards the Dream Forest, all the Jewelpets but Ruby fall to Rinko's home city on Earth. Someone must go and retrieve them all, and as Ruby was the worst-behaved of the bunch, she is given the task of going to Earth.

When Ruby reaches Earth in the form of a red Jewel Charm, she falls into Rinko's water glass, and thus begins a rather unexpected adventure. Rinko, Minami, and Ruby form an alliance to search and gather all of the fallen charms, encountering strange creatures and tons of helpful allies along the way. Will they be able to succesfully bring the Jewelpets home safely, or is Earth full of more danger than they had expected?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Jewelpet are mixed. Some find it enjoyable as a typical magical girl anime, especially appreciating the focus on the mascot characters. However, others criticize its generic storylines, unappealing character designs, and the problematic adult fanbase, leading to a polarizing experience.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of magical girl anime.
Mascot characters get significant development and screentime.
Decent story, suitable for kids.
cons: Generic and predictable stories similar to other magical girl shows.
Unappealing character designs, particularly the human characters.
Overly colorful and visually jarring backgrounds.
Questionable adult fanbase due to the show's target demographic being young girls.

anime.title: Haruka Nogizaka's Secret Purezza
anime.synopsis: Haruka's manga and anime hobby is still concealed by her dear friend Yuuto, but Yuuto's other female friend starts to feel affection and attraction towards him, so a feelings war begins among their circle of friends. Meanwhile Yuuto tries to make Haruka happy doing what she likes the most: drawing manga, watching anime, and attending special anime events.
anime.consensus_summary: The general sentiment is disappointment due to the perceived decline in quality compared to the first season. Reviewers criticize the shift towards excessive fanservice, the lack of plot progression, and the regression of the main characters. While some appreciate the animation and voice acting, the consensus is that 'Purezza' fails to deliver a satisfying romance or engaging storyline, leaving many viewers feeling frustrated and let down.
pros: Animation quality is generally consistent and appealing.
Some find the opening and ending themes catchy and enjoyable.
Voice acting is generally well-regarded, with talented voice actors involved.
cons: Significant drop in plot quality compared to the first season, with many considering it filler.
Character regression, especially for the main couple, who become more timid and indecisive.
Overabundance of fanservice overshadows the original story and character development.
Lack of progress in the central romance is frustrating for viewers.

anime.title: Chi's New Address
anime.synopsis: The Yamadas and Chi move to a new apartment house, where keeping a pet is allowed.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find the anime cute, relaxing, and heartwarming, making it a good choice for those seeking lighthearted content. While some acknowledge its simplicity and childish themes, the overall sentiment is one of enjoyment and appreciation for its ability to bring joy and comfort.
pros: Cute and relaxing
Likable characters
Manageable length per episode
Heartwarming story
cons: Simple art style
Not deep plot
Childish themes
Recycled animation frames

anime.title: Needless
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
At the onset of World War III, nobody could have predicted the effect it would have on Japan. While it had officially ended fifty years ago in 2150, its battles still persist. Large, mysterious areas known as "Blackspots" appeared across the country, filled with the contaminated ruins of cities and countrysides. Those inside were trapped to halt the spread of contamination, and their powers began to mutate—be they shapeshifters, pyromancers, or controllers of gravity itself—they all became known as the Needless.

Adam Blade is one such Needless, possessing remarkable regenerative abilities and incredible strength. In order to restore peace to a war-torn Japan, he and his allies must fight together to rise against a heinous research group by the name of Simeon.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Needless. Many appreciate its over-the-top action, humor, and self-aware parody of shonen anime tropes. However, the weak storyline, pacing issues, and reliance on fanservice are significant drawbacks for some viewers, resulting in a polarizing experience where enjoyment depends on embracing the show's chaotic and absurd nature.
pros: Enjoyable mix of action and comedy.
Memorable and quirky characters, especially Eve.
Excellent and well-fitting soundtrack.
Over-the-top and exaggerated art style that fits the parody theme.
cons: Storyline is derivative and weak.
Pacing issues, especially in the middle of the series.
Inconsistent use of powers and abilities.
Excessive fanservice can be off-putting.
Characters lack depth beyond their core traits.
Ending deviates from the manga and feels rushed.

anime.title: Dragon Ball Z Kai
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Five years after the events of Dragon Ball, martial arts expert Gokuu is now a grown man married to his wife Chi-Chi, with a four-year old son named Gohan. While attending a reunion on Turtle Island with his old friends Master Roshi, Krillin, Bulma and others, the festivities are interrupted when a humanoid alien named Raditz not only reveals the truth behind Gokuu's past, but kidnaps Gohan as well.

With Raditz displaying power beyond anything Gokuu has seen before, he is forced to team up with his old nemesis, Piccolo, in order to rescue his son. But when Gokuu and Piccolo reveal the secret of the seven mystical wish-granting Dragon Balls to Raditz, he informs the duo that there is more of his race, the Saiyans, and they won’t pass up an opportunity to seize the power of the Dragon Balls for themselves.

These events begin the saga of Dragon Ball Kai, a story that finds Gokuu and his friends and family constantly defending the galaxy from increasingly more powerful threats. Bizarre, comical, heartwarming and threatening characters come together in a series of battles that push the powers and abilities of Gokuu and his friends beyond anything they have ever experienced.
anime.consensus_summary: Dragon Ball Kai is generally well-received for its streamlined storytelling and improved pacing compared to the original Dragon Ball Z. The removal of filler is a significant pro for many, allowing for a more faithful adaptation of the manga. However, some viewers miss the added depth and character development that the filler provided, leading to mixed feelings depending on individual preferences for pacing and content.
pros: Faster pacing compared to the original DBZ
Removal of filler content improves the viewing experience
Closer adherence to the original manga storyline
Improved animation quality
cons: Some may miss the filler content that added depth to characters and world
Omission of certain scenes and character development may disappoint some viewers
Lack of new animation for the entire show may deter some
The original soundtrack that Funimation produced is missing.

anime.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
anime.synopsis:
Known for her semblance to the Sadako character of The Ring series, Sawako Kuronuma is given the nickname "Sadako" and misunderstood to be frightening and malicious like her fictional counterpart, despite having a timid and sweet nature. Longing to make friends and live a normal life, Sawako is naturally drawn to the cheerful and friendly Shouta Kazehaya, the most popular boy in her class. From their first meeting, Sawako has admired Kazehaya's ability to be the center of attention and aspires to be like him.

When Kazehaya organizes a test of courage for the entire class and encourages her to attend, Sawako sees this as an opportunity to get along with her classmates, starting with Ayane Yano and Chizuru Yoshida. Through each new encounter and emotion she experiences, Sawako believes that meeting Kazehaya has changed her for the better. Little does Sawako know, her presence has also changed Kazehaya.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Some find it to be a heartwarming and unique romance that stands out in the shoujo genre, praising its characters and emotional depth. Others are critical of its slow pacing, repetitive plot, and unrealistic elements, leading to frustration and disappointment. While many appreciate the initial premise, the series' execution and ending leave some viewers unsatisfied.
pros: Unique and refreshing take on shoujo romance stereotypes.
Well-developed characters with realistic emotions and struggles.
Heartwarming story about friendship, love, and self-discovery.
cons: Slow pacing, especially after the first few episodes.
Repetitive plot elements and overused crying.
Unrealistic character behaviors and situations.
Incomplete or unsatisfying ending that leaves viewers wanting more.

anime.title: Tales of Vesperia ~The First Strike~
anime.romaji_title: Tales of Vesperia: The First Strike
anime.synopsis:
Ten years after the Great War against the demon-beasts, the empire rules over the world and prosperity relies on the massive use of aer.

Yuri Lowell and Flynn Scifo are two young men who have just enrolled the ranks of the prestigious Imperial Knights. One day, they are sent to the town of Ceazontania, where abnormal aer activity has reportedly caused the proliferation of horribly mutated beasts, with serious threat for the whole region.

Meanwhile, the Knights Supreme Commander Alexei Denoia and the naive Princess Estellise are involved in a behind-the-curtains struggle for power in the capital. The situation in Ceazontania deteriorates as the garrison of Imperial Knights finds that they cannot expect any immediate support from the capital.

Then, Niren Fedrok, commander of the Imperial Knights in Ceazontania, takes an unexpected decision that is going to change Yuri and Flynn's destiny forever.

What are the secrets behind the extraordinary events that are happening around Yuri and Flynn? Will they be able to defend the innocent people of Ceazontania and stay true to their beliefs?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences familiar with the Tales of Vesperia game appreciate the movie as a prequel that expands on the backstories of key characters and strengthens their emotional connection to the game's world. Some find inconsistencies and pacing issues, but the strong visuals, character development, and fight choreography provide a positive experience, especially for fans.  The movie is considered a good but not exceptional addition to the Tales of Vesperia universe.
pros: Strong connection to the game's lore and characters for fans.
Visually appealing animation and well-choreographed fight scenes.
Effective character development, particularly regarding the Yuri/Flynn dynamic.
cons: Pacing issues, with some reviewers finding the story slow.
Inconsistencies with established lore from the game.
Underdeveloped side characters and a somewhat predictable plot.

anime.title: Mahou Sensei Negima!: Mou Hitotsu no Sekai
anime.romaji_title: Mahou Sensei Negima!: Mou Hitotsu no Sekai
anime.synopsis: This is a series of OVAs covering some of the Magic World manga arc by Ken Akamatsu, starting with chapters 184 through 188.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVAs are praised for their faithful adaptation of the manga and high-quality animation, making them a must-watch for manga readers. However, they are not recommended for newcomers due to the assumption of prior knowledge. The fast-paced storytelling and occasional omissions may also detract from the viewing experience for some.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga's Magic World arc.
Top-notch animation quality, especially during battle scenes.
Return of the original voice actors, with standout performances.
cons: Assumes prior knowledge of the manga, making it inaccessible to new viewers.
Jumps between chapters omit interesting parts of the story.
Some opening images are misleading as they won't be adapted.

anime.title: Higurashi: When They Cry – Kai Specials
anime.romaji_title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kai Specials
anime.synopsis: Specials that come with the DVDs.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views these specials as supplementary material for existing fans of the Higurashi franchise. While they offer humor and familiar elements for those who have seen the main series, they are considered largely incomprehensible and not recommended for newcomers. The shorts are seen as enjoyable lighthearted content for completionists but lack significant narrative depth or standalone appeal.
pros: Humorous jokes and gags that land well for fans of the series.
Animation and audio quality are consistent with the main series.
Provides extra content for dedicated fans and completionists.
Animators clearly had fun creating these shorts.
cons: Content is largely incomprehensible without prior knowledge of the main Higurashi series.
Jokes and parodies often fall flat or are not understood by those unfamiliar with the source material.
Specials offer little to no intrinsic value or new narrative progression.
Some jokes are not universally funny or landing for all viewers.

anime.title: Gregory Horror Show
anime.synopsis: The first series is a set of 25 stories about a male businessman arriving at the hotel after taking a train home from work. He encounters the mysterious owner of the hotel, an old mouse known as Gregory, who suggests that he stay a while. Soon, the man becomes drawn into a bizarre series of events taking place within Gregory House as he tries desperately to escape from this bizarre purgatory.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some find the show's bizarre nature and psychological elements intriguing, praising the unique characters, sound design, and intricate plot. However, others are disappointed by the lack of scares, poor humor timing, lackluster animation, and a dull, over-explained plot, with the English dub being a particular point of criticism.
pros: Unique character personalities
Narrator's identity is a wonderful concept
Sound and voice effects match the mood and are timed perfectly
Thick plot with clever traps
Art is relevant to the plot
cons: Spooks fall flat and humor is badly timed
English dub is painful
Plot is dull and over-explained
Animation is lackluster

anime.title: At The Mercy of The Sky
anime.synopsis: Saku Ooyagi returns to his hometown after seven years and is soon reacquainted with his childhood friend, Mihoshi Akeno. The reunion is far from merry since the last memory they have of each other is of her falling off a tree and him saving her. In any case, Mihoshi is determined to improve their relationship and forces Saku to join the astronomy club she founded.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Sora no Manimani' as a relaxing and educational anime, particularly praising its beautiful visuals and incorporation of astronomy. While some find the romance lacking and the plot somewhat simple, the overall sentiment is positive. Many viewers appreciate the feel-good atmosphere and likable characters, making it a worthwhile watch for those interested in slice-of-life anime with an astronomical twist.
pros: Beautiful and accurate depiction of stars and constellations.
Relaxing and feel-good atmosphere.
Enjoyable comedy and likable characters.
Good blend of astronomy facts within the story.
cons: Romance elements are not very strong.
Some characters are not fully developed.
Story can be a bit cliche.
Lacks depth in certain areas, particularly character backstory.

anime.title: Shin Koihime†Musou
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis:
Following the battle for Touka Village and clearing the area of bandits, Unchou Kan'u, Chouhi Yokutoku, and Shokatsuryou Koumei prepare for the next step of their journey. They encounter someone surprising—a young woman claiming to be Gentoku Ryuubi! After being framed for various crimes, Ryuubi is on a mission to reclaim her family heirloom, the sword of Chuuzan Seiou, and clear her name from the evil deeds she allegedly committed.

For Ryuubi's own safety, the four girls join forces and pursue the sword as it repeatedly changes hands, but they are never quite able to catch up to the current owner. During the adventure, Kan'u and the others meet several familiar faces who happily do what they can to assist in the hunt. Meanwhile, Kan'u and Chouhi continue to learn that there is more to family than blood relations.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers enjoying the show for its ecchi content, cute characters, and comedic elements. However, many criticize the weak plot, lack of character development, and repetitive nature of the jokes and fan service. The series is generally considered average, suitable for killing time but not particularly memorable or special.
pros: Appealing character designs and art style, particularly for the female characters
Catchy and enjoyable music, including opening and ending themes
Some find the humor and far-fetched situations entertaining
cons: Weak or non-existent plot, with repetitive and uninspired storylines
Over-reliance on ecchi content that becomes boring and unoriginal
Lack of character development and depth, with static personalities
Inconsistent historical accuracy and inclusion of anachronistic elements

anime.title: Rainbow
anime.synopsis:
Japan, 1955: Mario Minakami has just arrived at Shounan Special Reform School along with five other teenagers who have been arrested on serious criminal charges. All assigned to the same cell, they meet older inmate Rokurouta Sakuragi—a former boxer—with whom they establish a close bond. Under his guidance, and with the promise that they will meet again on the outside after serving their sentences, the delinquents begin to view their hopeless situation in a better light.

The seven cellmates struggle together against the brutal suffering and humiliation inflicted upon them by Ishihara, a sadistic guard with a grudge on Rokurouta, and Gisuke Sasaki, a doctor who takes pleasure in violating boys. Facing such hellish conditions, the seven inmates must scrape together all the strength they have to survive until their sentences are up; but even if they do, just what kind of lives are waiting for them on the other side?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with many praising the anime's strong themes of friendship and survival amidst brutal conditions, while others criticize its inconsistent plot, shallow characters, and over-reliance on shock value. Some viewers found it emotionally gripping and well-executed, while others felt it failed to live up to its potential due to underdeveloped elements.
pros: Excellent portrayal of friendship and brotherhood under extreme conditions.
Brutal and emotionally engaging story that keeps viewers hooked.
Strong character development, particularly for the main seven inmates.
cons: Inconsistent and illogical plot points.
Shallow characters with weak development.
Overreliance on shock value and explicit content.

anime.title: Lupin III vs. Detective Conan
anime.synopsis: In a country called Vesparand, a new mineral with super stealth properties has been discovered which attracts Lupin's attention. At the same time the untimely deaths of Queen Sakura and her son, Prince Gill, leave Princess Mira next in succession to the throne. During a trip to Japan, Princess Mira finds her double in Ran and takes the opportunity to trade places, which ends with Ran being spirited away to Vesparand with Conan, Zenigata, Kogoro Mouri, Lupin and Fujiko in tow. There they meet a waiting Jigen and solve the mystery of the deaths of the Queen and Prince.
anime.consensus_summary: The crossover is generally well-received, with fans appreciating the integration of characters and humor. While some find the art styles clash and certain characters are underutilized, the overall consensus is that it's a fun and enjoyable anime adventure for fans of both Lupin III and Detective Conan. The plot is engaging, and the collaboration between the two casts is a highlight.
pros: Successfully integrates characters from both franchises.
Story is well-developed with surprises and humor.
Good mix of energetic tunes and smooth jazz soundtrack.
Enjoyable to see characters from different series work together.
cons: Differences in character designs are noticeable and don't blend perfectly.
Goemon's screen time is limited.
Some aspects of the story are predictable.

anime.title: The Best!! Extremely Cool Student Council President
anime.synopsis: Mimi Kitagami is a kind, level-headed girl who aims to be the best, coolest student council president of her high school class. However, three trouble-making boys are always causing her grief — and she has a one-sided crush on one of the boys, Ushio Toujou.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is considered poorly produced with bad animation and voice acting. However, some find its flaws hilarious and enjoyable, making it 'so bad it's good'. The characters are found to be lovable and the plot interesting despite its shortcomings.
pros: Lovable characters
Easy to watch
Characters don't become useless
cons: Horrible 3D animation
Characters lack emotion
Poor voice acting
Badly written
anime.thematic_vibe: High School Life, Romantic Comedy, Slice of Life

anime.title: Toradora! SOS! Hurray for Foodies
anime.synopsis: Toradora DVD shorts featuring the miniature forms of the Toradora characters talking about, and eating, food.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Toradora!: SOS! is sharply divided. While some fans appreciate the return of beloved characters in a lighthearted, gag-filled format and find the food-centric premise unique, many others are deeply disappointed. Critics often cite the vastly inferior animation quality, simplified characterizations, and repetitive plot as major drawbacks, viewing it as a shallow imitation of the original series.
pros: Cute character designs with animal ears/tails (though some find this unnecessary)
Maintains the personalities of the original Toradora! characters (albeit simplified)
Voice acting is the same as the original series and is well-executed
Can be enjoyable for die-hard fans of Toradora! who want more character interaction
Refreshing and lighthearted, can put viewers in a good mood
The food competition/discussion aspect is unique and somewhat educational
cons: The art and animation quality is significantly lower than the original series
Lacks the depth, drama, and complex characterization of the parent series
Repetitive plot structure across episodes
Dialogue can be monotonous, especially Ryuji's lectures on food history
Some feel the chibi art style and animal ears/tails are unnecessary or detract from the characters
The use of emotionally significant music from the original series for comedic effect is seen as disrespectful
Can be boring and a waste of time for those not deeply invested in Toradora!

anime.title: Umi Monogatari
anime.romaji_title: Umi Monogatari: Anata ga Ite Kureta Koto
anime.synopsis:
Marin and her younger sister Urin are seafolk who happen upon something quite strange: a beautiful silver ring lost beneath the waves. The kind-hearted Marin, intent on returning it to its owner, drags a reluctant Urin along with her to the sky world despite reminders of a turtle elder who left for the surface and never returned. After locating the ring's owner, Kanon Miyamori, they learn that Kanon had tossed it into the sea after her boyfriend dumped her earlier that day.

Though Marin insists that such a lovely item should not be thrown away, Kanon discards it once again. As they search for the ring, Urin becomes separated from the other two and accidently breaks the seal on a stone coffin, releasing an evil being known as Sedna. Sensing Sedna's release, the formerly missing turtle elder, Matsumoto, reveals himself to Kanon and her companions, naming Marin as the Priestess of the Sea. Together with the Priestess of the Sky, she has the power to seal Sedna away again. And as luck would have it, during an encounter with one of Sedna's minions, Kanon discovers that she is the Priestess of the Sky. Though Kanon is hesitant, she and Marin decide to work together to save the world from the evil that threatens it.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience mood is generally positive, praising the visuals, character development, and focused storyline. However, some find the pacing slow and certain characters or plot elements irritating. The series is appreciated for its emotional depth and avoidance of genre cliches, but criticized for repetitive themes and a weak romantic subplot.
pros: Beautiful visuals and animation, particularly the backgrounds and magical effects.
Strong character development, especially for Kanon, with believable motivations.
Well-paced story that avoids filler episodes and stays focused on the main plot.
Intriguing villain with relatable motivations.
cons: Relaxing music that is anti-climatic
Urin is an annoying character.
Repetitive themes and angst, especially regarding light vs. darkness.
Tedious romantic subplot with bland characters.
Unexplained plot elements and background characters.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Light vs Darkness, Emotional Drama

anime.title: Charady no Joke na Mainichi
anime.synopsis: A gravure idol, Asada Misako, plays the main character Charady. Other characters are played by the students of Kyoto University of Art and Design Department of Character Designing. It is a short comedy animation about jokes from all parts of the world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds "Charady no Joke na Mainichi" to be a unique and enjoyable, albeit flawed, short comedy anime. The constantly changing animation styles and variety of jokes are appreciated, though some find the humor corny and the art inconsistent. It's recommended for viewers specifically seeking a goofy and unconventional experience, but not for those expecting a deep or complex narrative.
pros: Unique and refreshing concept
Interesting variety in animation styles per episode
Catchy ending song
Enjoyable despite flaws
cons: Art quality is inconsistent (hit or miss)
Some find the main character Charady annoying
Show is corny and sometimes cringey
No overarching story or deep characters

anime.title: Yurumates
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: After graduating high school, Yurume Aida joins the ranks of "ronin," students taking an extra year to prepare for college entrance exams. She decides to move from her rural hometown to Tokyo, hoping to take advantage of the cram schools and get a taste of city life. However, the country girl is shocked to learn that her boarding house, the Maison du Wish, is much less glamorous than she had imagined. As Yurume joins her neighbors and fellow ronin in scraping by with their meager funds, she finds a place in her community—even if she rarely ends up studying.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Yurumates' to be a cute and fun, albeit simple, slice-of-life anime. The chibi style and lighthearted humor appeal to fans of the genre, though some find the humor dry or unoriginal. Its low production quality is noted but often forgiven due to its charming nature and focus on friendship and relaxation.
pros: Chibi animation style is considered adorable and enjoyable.
Simple character archetypes are well-loved.
Catchy songs and excellent voice acting enhance the experience.
cons: Humor can be dry and not universally appealing, especially to Western audiences.
Storylines and jokes are familiar and lack originality.
Animation quality is low and may not appeal to viewers seeking visual masterpieces.

anime.title: Little Miss Maruko
anime.synopsis: Momoko Sakura is an elementary school student who likes popular idol Momoe Yamaguchi and mangas. She is often called "Chibi Maruko-chan" due to her young age and small size. She lives together with her parents, her grandparents and her elder sister in a little town. In school, she has many friends with whom she studies and plays together everyday, including her close pal, Tama-chan; the student committee members, Maruo-kun and Migiwa-san; and the B-class trio: 'little master' Hanawa-kun, Hamaji-Bu Taro and Sekiguchi-kun. This is a fun-loving and enjoyable anime that portrays the simple things in life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly appreciates Chibi Maruko-chan for its nostalgic charm and simple, relatable portrayal of everyday life. While it's recognized that the show doesn't offer complex narratives or profound messages, its enduring appeal lies in its comforting slice-of-life approach and well-defined characters that resonate with viewers across generations.
pros: Charming art style with a distinct 70s vibe.
Relatable and memorable characters with distinct personalities.
Simple yet effective storylines that capture everyday life.
Appeals to both children and adults, offering a comforting and nostalgic experience.
cons: Lacks a grand plan or end goal, which might not appeal to viewers seeking complex narratives.
Does not aim to change viewers' perspectives or leave a profound mark.

anime.title: Saint Seiya: Summary
anime.synopsis: A summary of the 114 episodes of the TV series Saint Seiya.
anime.consensus_summary: The Saint Seiya Recap OVA is not well-received. It is seen as a rushed and inadequate summary of the original series, primarily aimed at preparing viewers for the Hades saga. The main criticisms are its poor pacing, the narrator's biased portrayal of Seiya, and the rehashed animation. Most recommend watching the original series instead.
pros: Informs newcomers about the plot before the Hades saga.
cons: Poorly summarizes 100 episodes in 24 minutes.
Narrator implies Seiya did all the work.
Recycles animation and music from the classic series.

anime.title: Black Butler: The Story Thus Far
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Historical, Mystery, Mythology, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: A recap episode of the first half of Kuroshituji told by Tanaka-san, aka episode 13.5. Including this recap episode, the series is 25 episodes long.
anime.consensus_summary: The recap episode is primarily for refreshing memories or completionists. It's not essential viewing but offers a brief overview of the first half of the season. Fans may find Tanaka's hints about the ending intriguing, despite the recap's limited scope.
pros: Enjoyable characters
Great story (though ending may be rushed)
Good art
cons: Recap is skippable
Recap doesn't cover all episodes
Ending feels rushed

anime.title: Sweet Blue Flowers
anime.synopsis:
Shy and soft-spoken Fumi Manjoume and upfront and caring Akira Okudaira were best friends in elementary school, but this changed when Fumi and her family moved away. Years later, Fumi moves back to her hometown after being accepted at Matsuoka Girls’ High School. She finally reunites with Akira, who is going to attend Fujigatani Girls’ Academy. Despite their reunion, their relationship isn't the same as it was years ago.

As soon as Fumi starts attending school, popular senior Yasuko Sugimoto takes notice of her and flatters her more than any other underclassmen. After running to Akira for help so many times before, Fumi must figure out who she is as a person instead of standing in someone else’s shadow.  However, that doesn’t stop Akira from wanting her friendship with Fumi to be as it once was. Will the girls be able to conquer the high school stage of growing up before it pulls them apart?
anime.consensus_summary: Aoi Hana is appreciated for its gentle and realistic portrayal of teenage girls navigating friendship, love, and self-discovery. While some find the pacing slow and the ending unresolved, most viewers praise the series for its character-driven narrative and mature handling of sensitive themes. The anime is considered a thoughtful and heartfelt exploration of relationships, standing out in the yuri genre for its lack of fanservice and genuine emotional depth.
pros: Realistic portrayal of teenage relationships and emotions
Focus on character development and friendships
Tasteful and subtle approach to same-sex relationships
cons: Slow pacing and open ending
Some characters lack depth or development
Art style may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: White Album Season 2
anime.synopsis: The second season of White Album, also known as episodes 14-26.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the deeper exploration of characters and the unique 80s setting, many are turned off by the protagonist's flaws and the slow pacing. The ending is a point of contention, with some finding it conclusive and others feeling it was rushed or unearned. Despite improvements over the first season, the show remains divisive.
pros: Improved character development compared to season 1, with deeper exploration of secondary characters.
The setting in the 1980s is unique and well-integrated into the storyline, enhancing the social dynamics and communication challenges.
Soundtrack and music, especially the idol songs, are highly praised.
cons: Protagonist Touya is widely considered unlikeable, indecisive, and prone to making poor decisions, making it difficult to sympathize with him.
Slow pacing and convoluted plot can make the series feel dragged out.
Ending is divisive, with some finding it rushed or unsatisfying, and a 'twist' that feels out of place.

anime.title: Cat Planet Cuties
anime.synopsis:
High school student Kio Kakazu leads an ordinary life in Okinawa. When attending his grandfather's commemoration, a chance encounter with an eccentric girl named Eris—whose body features resemble a cat—makes him pass out. After finally waking up, Kio is surprised to discover a half-naked Eris right next to him! She explains that she is from a planet called Catia, and her duty is to research Earth and expand her kind's social network.

Due to the warm welcome she received from his family, Eris decides to live in Kio's house. However, the pair's idyllic situation is threatened when people from secret organizations—including his own childhood friend, Manami Kinjou—all aim to seize Eris. If Kio wants to leave a positive impression of Earth on Eris, he has to protect her at all costs and convince everyone that she is not a threat to the planet.
anime.consensus_summary: Asobi ni Iku yo! is a visually appealing but ultimately shallow ecchi harem anime with a weak story and stereotypical characters. While some viewers enjoy the fan service and action, others find the plot lacking and the characters underdeveloped. The series is considered a light-hearted but forgettable watch, with a tendency to prioritize fan service over substance.
pros: Visually appealing art and animation, especially the ecchi scenes.
Enjoyable action sequences and parodies.
Catchy opening theme and decent voice acting.
Assistroids add humor and entertainment.
cons: Weak and clichéd story with plot holes and rushed ending.
Underdeveloped and stereotypical characters.
Over-reliance on fan service at the expense of plot and character development.
Low comedic value and minimal character development.

anime.title: Tenjoubito to Akutobito Saigo no Tatakai
anime.romaji_title: Tenjoubito to Akutobito Saigo no Tatakai
anime.synopsis: A movie finale to Munto, a director's cut of the climactic scenes with new footage.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the attempt to provide closure and romantic elements, while others criticize the inconsistent character development, pacing issues, and unnecessary plot extensions. The revisionist nature of the movie, with added or altered scenes, also causes debate, with some welcoming the changes and others finding them detrimental. Overall, the finale seems to divide viewers based on their expectations and investment in the original series.
pros: Improved animation quality in later installments.
Calming and synchronizing opening and ending themes.
Addresses previous story threads and offers closure.
cons: Unnecessary piling up of content for the sake of continuing the story.
Inconsistencies in character personalities between installments.
Uneven pacing with awkward shifts between heavy drama and light-hearted jokes.
Questionable changes in art style, including disproportionate character designs.
Silent moments where background music could have enhanced the emotion.

anime.title: Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas
anime.romaji_title: Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas - Meiou Shinwa
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Mythology, Shounen
anime.synopsis: A Holy War, from ancient mythology, where the Goddess Athena and Hades have fought against each other while defending the earth repeatedly over the span of 200 years. The story takes place in 18th century Europe, 243 years prior to the original "Saint Seiya" Three small children, Tenma, Alone, and Sasha have all shared a very happy childhood together. Tenma who is quite aggressive but upstanding has moved to Sanctuary to become a saint. It is there that he is reunited with Sasha who is the sister of Alone and learns that she is the reincarnation of Goddess Athena. Alone, who is kind, gentle and loves painting was chosen for the body of enemy King Hades. Tenma eventually becomes a saint of Pegasus and engages in a fierce battle with his best friend Alone, the King of Hades. Pegasus Tenma, King Hades, and the Goddess Athena and through the twist of their 3 fates merge together which unfolds a prologue to the original Saint Seiya.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas" is well-received, especially by fans of the original series, with praise for its art, animation, and character development. Some find the story and characters bleak and the plot unoriginal, while others consider it a masterpiece that surpasses the original in some aspects. The series benefits from a strong emotional core and a well-executed narrative, though prior knowledge of the Saint Seiya universe is helpful.
pros: Excellent animation and art style, particularly the character designs.
Well-paced storytelling that elaborates on the original series' lore.
Strong character development, even for minor characters.
Engaging and emotional narrative with dramatic moments and meaningful deaths.
Good sound design and fitting background music.
cons: Some fighting scenes feel awkward.
The opening song is not well-received by some viewers.
The plot relies on familiar tropes, such as the 'friends turned enemies' dynamic.
Some viewers find the characters and story bleak, with events happening without sufficient explanation.
Relies on knowledge of the original Saint Seiya series for full appreciation; newcomers may be lost.

anime.title: Professor Layton and the Eternal Diva
anime.romaji_title: Layton Kyouju to Eien no Utahime
anime.synopsis:
Professor Hershel Layton—renowned archaeologist, puzzle-solver, and extraordinary gentleman—and his young aspiring apprentice Luke Triton receive a mysterious letter from his former student Janice Quatlane containing tickets to an opera at the Crown Petone. They soon discover that it is no ordinary opera, but rather a devious game for the legendary Fountain of Youth—the giver of eternal life. However, this only scratches the surface of an unfolding mystery that the pair must solve together in order to survive.
 
Despite being faced with complex puzzles and fervent competition, Professor Layton and his trusted assistant Luke never forget to uphold the standards of true gentlemen... And a true gentleman never leaves a puzzle unsolved.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves 'Professor Layton and the Eternal Diva' for its faithfulness to the source material, original story, and engaging mystery. Some find the plot simplistic and the puzzles easy, but appreciate the nostalgic atmosphere and well-developed characters. Overall, the film is seen as a successful video game adaptation that captures the essence of the Layton universe.
pros: Original story that expands the Layton universe
Faithful adaptation of the game's art style and music
Engaging puzzles integrated well into the plot
Well-developed characters with defined personalities
cons: Simplistic and predictable plot elements
Some character actions can be ludicrous
Ending can leave some unanswered questions
Descole was a weak antagonist

anime.title: Pokémon: Arceus and the Jewel of Life
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 12: Arceus Choukoku no Jikuu e
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Kids
anime.synopsis:
In ages long forgotten, when Earth found itself on a collision course with a meteor, Legendary Pokémon Arceus used its power to avert the danger. However, this feat caused the 16 Plates surrounding it to scatter across the world. Without the Plates providing Arceus with life energy, it began to die. A human named Damon managed to find one of the Plates and returned it to the moribund Pokémon, helping it recover. As a reward, Arceus created the Jewel of Life and gave it to the people of Michina Town, stipulating that it must be returned, but the humans refused, hogging the Jewel to themselves. In the battle that ensued, Damon was killed and Arceus went into slumber, vowing to punish humanity upon its return.

Satoshi and his companions arrive in Michina Town where they come across Sheena, a descendant of Damon, who claims to be in possession of the Jewel of Life and intends on giving it back to Arceus when it awakens.

The situation takes an unexpected turn when Arceus, despite Sheena's best intentions, remains unsatisfied. Satoshi must now prevent the destruction of the entire human race, as Arceus' fury causes distortions in the fabric of the universe, enraging the Legendary trio—Dialga, Palkia, and Giratina—and disturbing the world's balance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is split, with some praising the epic scale and visual quality while others find the plot derivative and characters underdeveloped. While many acknowledge it as a decent entry, it fails to reach the heights of the franchise's best for a significant portion of the fanbase.
pros: Visually appealing animation and background art
Epic scale plot with legendary Pokemon battles
Engaging storyline with elements of time travel
Good pacing, gets into the story quickly
cons: Story feels repetitive and unoriginal compared to earlier films
New characters are underdeveloped and uninteresting
Dub voice acting lacks emotion
Characters from the main series are sidelined
Obvious and sometimes eye-rolling CGI

anime.title: Maihime
anime.synopsis:
A lonely exchange student meets and falls in passionate love with a dancer. A girl who falls into madness when she learns her lover is going home to make his life.

The wanderings of youth on the stage of 19th century Berlin. The legendary novel of Meiji writer Mori Ogai, "Maihime (dancing girl)," adapted by Ga-nime "School Girl" producer Oku Shutaro who shows us his illustration talent and appoints Ms FURUYA Akisa for the booklets, slide shows, and animation of this Ga-nime. Over the background of a foreign country, we discover all the pathetic, poetic feelings of this elegant story as the wind of fresh artistic images brings it to life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Maihime' for its concise and emotionally resonant storytelling. The unique 'ga-anime' style, while potentially off-putting to some, is acknowledged as an artistic choice. The short format and impactful narrative are seen as strengths, resulting in a positive, albeit somewhat subdued, reception.
pros: Short and impactful storytelling
Engaging soundtrack and atmosphere
Effective portrayal of emotions
cons: Ga-anime style may not appeal to all viewers
Static art style

anime.title: Nodame Cantabile OVA
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Josei, Music, Performing Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: Yukihisa Matsuda, principal conductor of the Rising Star Orchestra, arrives in Paris to perform Wagner's Tannhäuser Overture as a guest conductor for the Recyl Symphony Orchestra. When Matsuda overhears the orchestra members praising Shinichi Chiaki, the budding Japanese conductor of the Roux-Marlet Orchestra, he can barely contain his contempt at there being another "Black-Haired Noble" in the same city. Freshly dumped by his mistress following the performance, Matsuda catches Chiaki and takes him out to drink under the pretense of discussing career. But much to Chiaki's chagrin, the subject soon turns to Chiaki's own special someone.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a decent side story that maintains the humor of the Nodame Cantabile series. However, the focus on a new, less engaging character leads to emotional detachment. Most viewers would have preferred a side story centered on the main cast instead.
pros: Entertaining side story.
Retains the quirky humor of the series.
cons: Focuses on a new character who is not as charming as the main cast.
Emotional detachment due to the new character.
Not as good as other potential side stories with established characters.

anime.title: Princess Lover!
anime.synopsis: Following an automobile accident that claims the life of his parents, Teppei Arima is taken in by his grandfather and introduced to the world of the rich and the elite. Compared to his humble upbringing, Isshin Arima's lavish lifestyle surprises and stuns the young teenager. In return for the gracious hospitality, Teppei is expected to continue the family business by replacing his grandfather as the head of Arima Financial Combine, and to prepare him for these responsibilities, he is enrolled into an esteemed high school. Along with his recently acquired celebrity status and affluence, Teppei is informed of an arranged marriage with the equally prosperous Sylvia van Hossen, thus, beginning the thrilling escapades of his new life!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is sharply divided, with many praising the initial premise, art, and production values, while a significant portion criticizes the drastic decline in story quality during the second half. The show is seen as having a strong start but ultimately failing to deliver on its potential, leading to a polarizing reception.
pros: Pleasing visuals that match the theme and setting
Nice balance between comedy and drama
Unique setting (harem in a rich setting)
Characters have depth
Art style and animation have a unique vibrancy
High production values
Fanservice is tastefully added
cons: Girls are a bit clichéd
Story is mediocre and becomes garbage in the second half
Supporting cast is weak
Music is not memorable
Jarring simulated camera panning/rotation
Out of proportion bust sizes
Villains are the worst ever constructed
Story becomes irredeemable halfway through
Annoying 'Passing the Club' arc
Harem is not satisfying

anime.title: Whispered Words
anime.synopsis: Murasame Sumika is popular in the high school for her excellence in the marks and sports. However, she has a secret: she is in love with her classmate Kazama Ushio. Ushio also has a liking to the love between girls, but she hasn't noticed Sumika's feelings and has always been refused by other girls.
anime.consensus_summary: Sasameki Koto is a generally well-received shoujo-ai anime praised for its relatable characters and blend of comedy and drama. However, it is criticized for its incomplete ending and some pacing issues. The series is considered a good introduction to the yuri genre, though some find the ending unsatisfying and recommend reading the manga for a complete story.
pros: Well-developed and relatable characters
Good blend of comedy and drama
Realistic portrayal of emotions
Excellent art and animation
Good voice acting
cons: Incomplete story/abrupt ending
Some characters are dropped or underdeveloped
Pacing issues
Repetitive soundtrack
Some jokes are in bad taste
Abuse of art style changes for comedic effect

anime.title: Kämpfer
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Magical Sex Shift, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Waking up transformed into a beautiful girl might be the stuff of some guys' fantasies, but when the suddenly effeminatized Natsuru is informed by a stuffed tiger that he's now a Kampfer, a mystical fighter who has to fight other Kampfers in female form, his life becomes a living nightmare!

Putting aside the obvious "plumbing" issues, Natsuru's best childhood friend turns out to swing the other way and SHE has a crush on his new female body. Not complex enough? Natsuru's school has separate sections for boys and girls, so he and she are now double enrolled. The rumor-mill has it that he's dating herself. And there are other Kampfers attending the school who want to take her out, and he's not sure which ones mean "on a date" and which ones mean "permanently." Oh, and did we mention that some Kampfers use swords and guns?! Hormones, fists, and other body parts will fly as the daring, new gender-bender defender must become a contender or die!
anime.consensus_summary: Kämpfer is a polarizing anime that delivers on its premise of gender-bending action and ecchi comedy, but consistently falls short in plot execution and meaningful character development. While the art and voice acting are praised, the shallow story, weak ending, and uninspired protagonist leave many viewers disappointed, creating a clear divide between those who enjoyed its lighthearted, fanservice-driven nature and those who found it an unfulfilling experience.
pros: Outstanding art and animation quality with detailed character designs.
The "Entrails Animals" voice acting is a highlight, providing genuine humor.
Some characters, particularly Shizuku and Akane, are well-developed and likable.
The gender-bending premise offers unique comedic and sometimes intriguing scenarios.
cons: The plot is considered non-existent, shallow, or poorly executed, often serving only as an excuse for fanservice.
The ending is widely described as pathetic, lame, unoriginal, and a major disappointment that fails to resolve plot points.
Lack of substantial action despite the premise; fights are often short-lived and lack impact.
Main protagonist Natsuru is frequently criticized as being clueless, stupid, uninteresting, and lacking personality.
Ecchi/fanservice is often described as inadequate, tame, or pedestrian by current standards.
Many characters are cliché, unoriginal, and poorly developed, failing to leave a lasting impression.

anime.title: Tokyo Magnitude 8.0
anime.synopsis:
Middle school student Mirai Onozawa is dissatisfied with her family circumstances and, in a moment of frustration, wishes to tear everything apart. Unfortunately, these destructive thoughts seem to come true in the form of a magnitude 8.0 earthquake just a few moments later.

When summer vacation begins, Mirai reluctantly takes her younger brother Yuuki to Odaiba, where a robot exhibition that he wanted to go to is being held. However, while they are in the exhibition center, the fury of a major earthquake shakes the Kanto region; helpless, both kids witness the devastating power of this natural disaster as it brings the city to its knees.

In its aftermath, they stumble upon Mari Kusakabe, a motorcyclist and single mother who decides to help the young siblings. Aiming to return to their homes and reunite with their families, the group sets off on a long and hard journey through the decimated city.
anime.consensus_summary: Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 is generally well-received for its emotional depth and realistic portrayal of a disaster's aftermath. The character development, particularly Mirai's, is praised. However, some viewers find the animation inconsistent and the pacing slow, with the later episodes diverging from the established tone. Overall, it's considered a moving and thought-provoking series.
pros: Realistically portrays the aftermath of a natural disaster.
Character growth and development are well-executed, especially Mirai's transformation.
The story emphasizes human connections, family bonds, and the will to survive.
Detailed backgrounds and art capture the devastation of Tokyo.
Voice acting effectively conveys the characters' emotions.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality.
Slow pacing in the initial episodes.
Music is not particularly memorable.
Some unrealistic character reactions to the earthquake.
Ending feels disjointed from the rest of the series.

anime.title: A Certain Scientific Railgun
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
The student-filled Academy City is at the forefront of scientific advancement and home to the esper development program. The seven "Level 5" espers are the most powerful in Academy City, and ranked third among them is middle schooler Mikoto Misaka, an electricity manipulator known as "The Railgun."
 
When strange incidents begin occurring throughout the city, she finds each crime to be connected to the elusive "Level Upper," a legendary device that allegedly increases the esper level of its user. As the situation escalates, it becomes apparent that there is more to the Level Upper than meets the eye, and that Academy City may be a far more twisted place than the glamorous utopia it appears to be.

Toaru Kagaku no Railgun focuses on Mikoto and her friends—and the dangerous situations they find themselves in—as they get caught up in the matter of the Level Upper. As Mikoto says, "There's never a dull moment in this city."
