anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While many viewers appreciate the likable characters and engaging interactions, some find the plot unoriginal and the world-building lacking. It's considered an enjoyable popcorn fare anime, but not without its flaws, especially when compared to its parent series, A Certain Magical Index.
pros: Engaging character interactions, especially the dynamic between the main characters.
Well-connected storyline that rewards attentive viewing.
The scientific aspect of the world is easier to follow compared to the magic side in the parent series.
cons: The story can be unoriginal and predictable.
World-building and the explanation of the 'Level' system feel incomplete.
Some find the abilities granted to characters random and illogical.

anime.title: Rainbow Fireflies
anime.synopsis:
Yuuta was 12-year-old boy, who had lost his father in the traffic accident one year ago. In the summer vacation, he visited a deserted dam deep in the mountains, where he had a good time with his father before. 

Suddenly a thunder storm occurred and he slipped on the ground. He lost consciousness and woke up to find a girl and an unfamiliar village. He time-traveled 30 years and reached a village, which sank at the bottom of the dam. 

This is Yuuta's precious memory of "another" summer vacation.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with viewers appreciating the story's initial sweetness and nostalgic elements, but criticizing the confusing plot, inconsistent art style, and unsatisfactory ending. While some find the characters likable and the atmosphere magical, others feel the latter half of the movie is disjointed and poorly explained. The ending, in particular, is a point of contention, with some finding it uncalled for and confusing.
pros: Beautiful story and nostalgic atmosphere
Likable characters that grow on the viewer
cons: Confusing plot and uncalled-for ending
Inconsistent art style with excessive computer animation
Poorly explained time skip

anime.title: True Tears: Mini Chara 4-koma Gekijou
anime.synopsis: 30-second sketches/omakes based around the events of the TV series with little twists.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds these mini-episodes humorous and enjoyable, especially if they have watched the main series. Some viewers feel they are better than the main series. However, they are considered very short and may not be worthwhile for those unfamiliar with the original show.
pros: Short and fun
Lighthearted
Better than the main series
cons: Requires knowledge of the main series
Very short episodes
Unnecessary to watch

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam 00 The Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam 00 Movie: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2314 AD, the world is at peace. Thanks to the sacrifices of Celestial Being and its mobile suit pilots, the people of Earth experience a time of prosperity and unity, enjoying tranquil lives once thought impossible. Celestial Being, an organization once painted as villains by the Earth Sphere Federation, now exists in public perception as a group of heroes, celebrated in film and culture.

When an extraterrestrial threat arrives on Earth, threatening the newly acquired calm stasis, Celestial Being springs back into action. Led by ace pilot Setsuna F. Seiei, the Gundam Meisters of the group battle the hostile alien forces, teaming up with old rivals to protect the human race from certain doom.
anime.consensus_summary: The film is highly divisive, with a strong split between those who appreciate the action and spectacle and those who are deeply disappointed by its narrative shortcomings. While the mecha battles and animation are generally praised, the story, character development, and departure from traditional Gundam themes are heavily criticized, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: High-quality animation, especially during action sequences.
Fast-paced and intense mecha battles that are entertaining.
Unique and interesting mecha designs.
Pleasing soundtrack and sound design, with good voice acting.
Redemption of Graham Aker's character arc.
cons: Story is generic, underdeveloped, and lacks originality, deviating from traditional Gundam themes.
Character development is minimal for both returning and new characters; many new characters are superfluous.
The introduction of aliens as antagonists is seen as a departure from Gundam's core human-vs-human conflict and less engaging.
Pacing issues and inconsistent tone, with the story feeling divided into parts.
The ending and certain plot resolutions are considered nonsensical, rushed, or unsatisfying.
Over-reliance on 'understanding' as a solution feels preachy and naive.
Visuals, while good, are not a significant improvement over the TV series.
Subplots are unnecessarily misleading or forgotten.

anime.title: Kinnikuman II Sei: Second Generations
anime.synopsis: While the New Generation Choujins are taking part in Fan Appreciation Day, The Cyborg arrives, takes Meat hostage, and challenges Mantarou to a fight inside Tokyo Tower.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a simple, action-oriented side story that doesn't require prior knowledge of the Kinnikuman series. While enjoyable for newcomers and those who appreciate basic fighting shonen, it lacks the strategic depth of the original. The humor may not appeal to all audiences.
pros: Simple plot with a decent message.
Impressive fights by fighting shonen standards.
Good introduction for non-Kinnikuman fans.
cons: Fights feel basic compared to the main story.
Missing unique strategies from the original series.
Toilet humor might bother some viewers.

anime.title: You're Under Arrest: Full Throttle Special
anime.romaji_title: Taiho Shichau zo: Full Throttle - Watashitachi no Iru Basho
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Comedy, Seinen, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Rounding off season 3, Natsumi and Miyuki reminiscince about their lives at Bokuto station while hearing from people they've met through work. (This is limited to characters they've met in season 3.)

We are also introduced to Bokuto Station's two new recruits; Kaori Takano and Sakura Fujieda. Starting off their duty, they are taken on a field trip by Miyuki and Natsumi and quickly find out what will be expected of them as police officers.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the series but notes a decline in character development and animation quality compared to previous seasons. The introduction of new characters is seen as a positive aspect, though some feel the episode has a sense of finality. Overall, it's recommended as a lighthearted and entertaining watch.
pros: Entertaining and makes you want to watch more.
Introduces new characters with potential.
Good option for viewers looking for a fun time.
cons: Character development is below previous seasons.
Animation is below previous seasons.
Felt like a dismissal episode at times.

anime.title: Omamori Himari
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Mythology, Romance, School, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
After the death of his parents, Yuuto Amakawa lives a pretty ordinary life in the city. The only problem he has to worry about while attending school alongside Rinko, his next-door neighbor, is his cat allergies. That all changes on his sixteenth birthday, when an Ayakashi—a supernatural creature—attacks him for the sins of his ancestors. Luckily, he is saved by Himari, a mysterious cat-woman with a sword, who explains that Yuuto is the scion of a family of demon-slayers, and she is there to protect him now that the charm that kept him hidden from the supernatural forces of the world has lost its power.

Omamori Himari chronicles Yuuto's dealings with the various forces of the supernatural world, as well as the growing number of women that show up on his doorstep, each with their own dark desires. Will Yuuto be able to adjust to his new "exciting" environment? Or will the ghost of his (ancestor's) past catch up with him?
anime.consensus_summary: Omamori Himari is a divisive ecchi harem anime. Some viewers enjoy the fan service and superficial plot, while others find the story and characters lacking depth and originality. The show is generally considered average, with criticisms focusing on its over-reliance on tropes and weak protagonist.
pros: Some viewers appreciate the fan service and ecchi elements.
A few viewers found the story enjoyable, especially compared to other shows in the same genre.
The art style was seen as a positive aspect by some viewers.
cons: Many viewers found the plot lacking depth and originality.
Several reviews criticized the characters as being shallow, stereotypical, and unmotivated.
The show is seen as heavily reliant on fan service at the expense of a compelling narrative.
The main character is often perceived as weak and unlikeable.
Some felt the story didn't live up to its potential.

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie 3: The Will of Fire
anime.romaji_title: Naruto: Shippuuden Movie 3 - Hi no Ishi wo Tsugu Mono
anime.synopsis:
After being sent to investigate the alarming disappearance of four bloodline limit-wielding ninjas from different countries, Kakashi Hatake, Naruto Uzumaki, Sakura Haruno, and Sai successfully discover their whereabouts and inform the Hokage. Unexpectedly, Tsunade's further arrangements fall apart when Hiruko—the mastermind behind the incident and also a former Konohagakure ninja obsessed with power—appears to announce that he has absorbed the missing ninjas' unique abilities. On the verge of becoming invincible, he seeks one more bloodline limit before starting an all-out war to take over the world.

As Konohagakure's past connections with Hiruko raise suspicions among the nations about its involvement in the affair, Tsunade receives an ultimatum to solve the crisis. Left with no other choice, she decides to follow Kakashi's lead after he presents a daring yet salutary scheme—a proposal that could send him to certain death. However, Naruto opposes such a plan! Despite the Hokage's decision, he is determined to save his teacher's life, even if it means fighting friend and foe alike.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While many appreciate the improved animation, action sequences, and the inclusion of the Konoha 11, the unoriginal story and underdeveloped characters are significant drawbacks. The film is generally considered enjoyable for Naruto fans but may not appeal to a broader audience or those seeking a compelling narrative. Ultimately, it's viewed as a decent Naruto movie, but far from a cinematic masterpiece.
pros: Good animation quality, especially in fight scenes.
Inclusion of many characters from the Konoha 11, allowing for diverse jutsu combinations and teamwork.
Exploration of moral and ethical dilemmas, such as sacrificing one person for the village's welfare.
cons: Lousy and unoriginal plot, borrowing elements from previous villains and storylines.
Poor character development, with villains being one-dimensional and underdeveloped.
Plot holes and inconsistencies, making the story feel rushed and forced.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn
anime.synopsis:
In the year Universal Century 0096, three years after Char Aznable's failed attempt to force human migration into space, life continues in the colonies orbiting Earth. One such colony, at Side 4, is home to Banagher Links, a 16-year-old who lives a quiet life among his classmates.

Audrey Burne, the last descendant of a great tyrannical family, takes it upon herself to steal the key to a mysterious device known as "Laplace's Box." It is said that the Box has the power to shape the course of the universe, and Audrey travels to Side 4 in an attempt to take it from its current holder and keep it from the Sleeves, the surviving remnant of Char Aznable's  Neo-Zeon. In her search, she stumbles across Banagher and changes his life forever.

When Side 4 comes under the attack of the Sleeves and its prolific fighters Marida Cruz and Full Frontal, Banagher takes control of the newly built Gundam Unicorn to defend his friends and protect the fate of humankind.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with strong praise for the visuals and its place in the UC timeline. However, some criticize the story, characters, and accessibility for new viewers. Many suggest prior knowledge of the UC timeline is crucial for full enjoyment.
pros: High production values and animation quality.
Epic scope and serves as a conclusion to the Universal Century timeline.
Cool Mobile Suit designs.
cons: Story can be confusing for newcomers to the Universal Century timeline.
Some find the main characters and story elements rehashed or lacking in substance.
Pacing can be slow, especially in early episodes.
Character development is lacking.

anime.title: Baka & Test: Summon the Beasts
anime.synopsis:
Fumizuki Academy is not a typical Japanese high school. This unique institution has implemented a new and innovative system to sort its students. At the end of their freshman year, students take a test that divides up the student body. The highest scorers are placed into A class, all the way down until F class, for the lowest of the low.

Unfortunately for Akihisa Yoshii, his supposedly "great" intellect was not quite enough for such a test, and he is now stuck at the bottom of F class. Naturally, F class has the worst facilities: not only rotten tatami mats and broken tables, but also outdated equipment and worn out furniture. On the bright side, his friend Yuuji Sakamoto is in the same class, and to everyone's surprise, the genius girl Mizuki Himeji has also ended up in the same class due to an unforeseen fever on the day of the test.

Unsatisfied with their perquisites, F class rallies behind Yuuji, determined to take on the higher-tiered classes in order to seize their perks by using the school's Examinations Summon Battle system. The participants can summon fantasy characters—whose power levels are equal to their student's test scores—in an all-out battle. Will F class be able to rise to the top, or will they live up to everyone's expectations and fail?
anime.consensus_summary: Baka to Test is a polarizing comedy anime. While many find the show hilarious due to its random humor, over-the-top characters, and parody of anime clichés, others criticize its weak plot, repetitive jokes, and reliance on stereotypes. Overall, the show's success hinges on individual taste for nonsensical, slapstick comedy.
pros: Hilarious and random comedy
Enjoyable characters with recognizable tropes
Refreshing art style and animation
Creative concept with summoned battles
cons: Weak or non-existent overarching plot
Overreliance on clichés and stereotypes
Repetitive jokes that can become irritating
Limited character development
Juvenile humor not for everyone

anime.title: Clannad: After Story - Another World, Kyou Chapter
anime.romaji_title: Clannad: After Story - Mou Hitotsu no Sekai, Kyou-hen
anime.synopsis:
On a rainy day, Ryou Fujibayashi musters up the courage to confess her feelings to Tomoya Okazaki. Despite not knowing each other for long, the two start dating and develop a harmonious relationship. However, tensions begin to rise when a rumor surrounding Tomoya and Ryou's older sister Kyou spreads around school.

Navigating through a web of emotions, Tomoya and the Fujibayashi twins determine where their love truly lies—even if it means standing in the downpour of the heartbreaking truth.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the Kyou Chapter OVA is a well-received addition to the Clannad universe, particularly for fans of Kyou and Ryou. While some feel the episode is rushed and lacks depth due to time constraints, most appreciate the animation, music, and character development. It serves as a touching 'what if' scenario that enriches the overall Clannad experience, though some find the romantic resolution unconvincing.
pros: Faithful adaptation of Kyou's story arc from the visual novel.
Beautiful art and animation quality consistent with the Clannad series.
Excellent soundtrack and voice acting enhances emotional impact.
Provides deeper character development for Kyou and Ryou.
Offers a satisfying 'what if' scenario for fans of Kyou.
cons: Rushed pacing due to condensing a large amount of content into a single episode.
Lack of time to fully explain character motivations and inner thoughts.
Some character development feels rushed and less believable.
May not fully satisfy viewers unfamiliar with the source material.
Some viewers may dislike Kyou's character or the romantic outcome.

anime.title: Marie & Gali Episode Zero
anime.synopsis: This episode aired prior to the original series and introduces the main characters.
anime.consensus_summary: The pilot episode introduces the characters well, but suffers from a lack of clear context and confusing narrative. The low-quality animation and potential translation issues detract from the viewing experience. Overall, the episode leaves the audience unsure of the show's direction and unsure if it will be enjoyable.
pros: Well-documented characters
Sound quality is good
cons: Unclear context
Poor translation
Cheap animation
Vague background art
Confusing narrative

anime.title: Legend of Regios
anime.synopsis:
Legend of Regios was originally the English speaking cut-scenes on TV, that the characters in the Chrome Shelled Regios series were watching.

This special (which has been included with the DVD release of Chrome Shelled Regios) has reorganized the scenes, extended some, and has been re-dubbed completely in Japanese.  It's a side story within the Chrome Shelled Regios series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the 'Legend of Regios' side story. They praise its unique film noir style, beautiful visuals, and engaging characters. Some find the art style less polished, but overall, the audience enjoys this addition to the 'Chrome Shelled Regios' series.
pros: Good addition to change up the series
Beautiful visuals
Interesting characters
Unique story elements
cons: Art style less carefully done

anime.title: Eden of The East the Movie I: The King of Eden
anime.romaji_title: Higashi no Eden Movie I: The King of Eden
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
After preventing Japan's destruction, Akira Takizawa made one final request to become the "King of Japan," before he erased his memories once again and disappeared. Leaving Saki Morimi with his cellphone, the only clue she has in regards to Akira's whereabouts is the message, "I'll be waiting where our journey started."

Six months later, rumors have spread about Akira, and Saki's search leads her to New York City. However, Saki is not the only person who goes to investigate—with several billion yen burning a hole in their pockets and a challenge to "save Japan," the remaining Seleção are not far behind. Some are willing to help Akira achieve his goals, but a few are making dangerous moves in order to eliminate him and achieve their own picture of a better Japan. With rising stakes and new revelations, the game is still on.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Higashi no Eden Movie I: The King of Eden' is mixed, with many feeling it doesn't live up to the original series. While the art and sound quality are praised, the slow pacing, repetitive plot elements, and lack of meaningful progress leave viewers disappointed. The movie is largely seen as a setup for the sequel, leaving a sense of incompleteness and frustration among fans.
pros: High art quality, consistent with the TV series, with detailed backgrounds and vibrant visuals.
Enjoyable soundtrack and voice acting that complements the story.
Continuation of beloved characters and exploration of their relationships.
cons: Stretched and slow-paced plot with unnecessary scenes and monologues.
Amnesia plot device feels repetitive and hinders plot progression.
Lack of meaningful character development for side characters.
New plot points introduced without resolution or purpose.
Incomplete feeling, acting as a setup for the next movie without a satisfying conclusion.

anime.title: Zan Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Nozomu Itoshiki is still the bizarre teacher of the even stranger Class 2-F. He attempts to teach his students the negative aspects of the world and society, only to have each circumstance thrown at his face whenever he tries. With more students and friends than before, Zetsubo-sensei's life becomes harder and crazier than ever before.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is generally positive, particularly for fans of the manga and previous seasons. However, some viewers are disappointed by the lack of originality in the anime adaptation and the underdeveloped new characters. There's a slight divide regarding the art style, with some praising the improvements and others criticizing the lack of distinct SHAFT stylization.
pros: Enjoyable and funny for fans of the franchise.
Faithful adaptation of the manga.
Improved art and animation quality compared to previous seasons (in some opinions).
Catchy opening and ending themes.
Effective use of short story format.
cons: Lack of original material and creativity from SHAFT.
Overly loyal adaptation to the manga, feeling traced at times.
Underdeveloped new characters.
Unfinished story due to not adapting the entire manga.
Characters are defined by a single trait.

anime.title: Birdy the Mighty: Decode OVA
anime.synopsis:
Birdy uses her pin-up alter ego to help Tsutomu make a love connection with Sayaka, but everything goes horribly wrong when a Federation marionette is added to the equation!

(Source: FUNimation)

This OVA connects the first and second Birdy the Mighty Decode seasons.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA serves as a connective episode between the first and second seasons, offering some enjoyable moments but lacking significant substance on its own. It is primarily recommended for dedicated fans of the series seeking additional context for season 2. Some viewers found it irrelevant and skippable, while others appreciated its role in bridging the narrative.
pros: Connects first and second seasons, providing context for season 2.
Contains sweet moments and occasional comedy, maintaining the series' charm.
Good animation quality and enjoyable opening/ending songs.
cons: Story lacks real substance and feels like a filler episode.
Plot may be confusing for viewers who haven't seen the first season.
Action elements are not as strong as in the main series.

anime.title: Strike Witches 2
anime.synopsis:
Six months have passed since the victorious Battle of Britannia and the reclamation of Gallia from Neuroi invaders. Yoshika Miyafuji, member of the famed 501st Joint Fighter Wing, has come back home to Fuso and graduated from middle school.

However, her fight is far from over. She receives a letter supposedly sent by her long-deceased father, containing blueprints of a state-of-the-art Striker Unit he had been working on before his death. The Unit, designed specifically for Yoshika, might be capable of harnessing her extraordinary magical powers.

Meanwhile, a new threat in Europe is rising. A Neuroi nest of an unprecedented size and might has appeared over Venezia, wiping out local Witch forces and instantly swallowing the northern part of the country. To make matters worse, a newly spotted humanoid type of Neuroi is attempting to come into contact with humans.

Yoshika, incapable of abandoning her friends on the front lines, must once again venture to the war-torn continent.
anime.consensus_summary: Strike Witches 2 is a fun but flawed series that relies heavily on its established characters and ecchi elements. While the visuals and music are praised, the weak plot and excessive fanservice detract from the overall experience. Fans of the first season will likely enjoy the sequel, but newcomers may find it repetitive and uninspired. The audience generally enjoys the character interactions and the lighthearted nature of the show, despite its shortcomings.
pros: Strong character interactions and development, especially for side characters.
Visually stunning art and animation, with detailed backgrounds and authentic feel to military elements.
Catchy and upbeat music that enhances the tone of each episode.
cons: Weak and formulaic plot that rehashes the first season's structure.
Excessive and gratuitous fanservice that overshadows the story.
Rushed and poorly executed climax.

anime.title: Pokémon: Slowking's Day
anime.synopsis: It consists of nothing but Pokémon-speak--similar to the mini-movies that air with each theatrical movie. It's a short special based on life of the Pokémon Slowking.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally dislikes 'Slowking's Day,' finding it boring and irritating due to the repetitive narration and annoying children's voices. Some appreciate the short length and acceptable art quality, but these positives are overshadowed by the film's drawbacks. The special is considered a low point in the Pokémon franchise.
pros: Short runtime is good for the limited story.
Art is pretty good, especially the sunset scene.
Slowking's character is consistent with the movie.
cons: Lacks plot and meaningful characters.
High-pitched, nasal voices of children are annoying and incessant.
Constant yelling of what Slowking is doing detracts from enjoyment.

anime.title: "Bungaku Shoujo" Movie
anime.synopsis:
The protagonist of the story, Konoha Inoue, is a seemingly normal senior high 2nd year student. His high school life, other than a hinted incident 2 years ago, can be summed up as normal- if one can dismiss the secret fact that he used to be a female bestselling romance author. Due to that incident, however, he has now vowed never to write again.

This continued on until he was forced to join the literary club by the literary club president, the 3rd year female student Amano Tooko, a beautiful girl who has a taste for eating literary works. Now he has been tasked with writing her snack every day after school.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers appreciating the exploration of complex emotions and unique premise, while others find the plot confusing, the characters unlikeable, and the pacing rushed. The film's focus on psychological themes and melodrama polarizes viewers. Many suggest familiarity with the light novels is needed to fully appreciate the movie.
pros: Visually appealing art style.
Explores complex emotional themes like jealousy, depression, and regret.
The concept of a 'Literature Girl' who eats books is unique and intriguing.
cons: The plot is confusing and directionless for viewers unfamiliar with the source material.
The story focuses on unlikeable characters, particularly an 'insane, egoistic' character, making it difficult to connect with them.
The movie is rushed and would benefit from a longer format to develop the story and characters more fully.
Art style is inconsistent, with triangle faced characters whose eyes may or may not pop out of their heads depending on the moment.

anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood OVA Collection
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
1. Moumoku no Renkinjutsushi (The Blind Alchemist)
2. Simple na Hitobito (Simple People)
3. Sensei Monogatari (The Tale of Teacher)
4. Sore mo mata Kare no Senjou (Yet Another Man's Battlefield)
anime.consensus_summary: The Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Specials are generally well-received, offering additional insights into characters and expanding the FMA universe with standalone stories. While some episodes are highly praised for their emotional depth and character development, others are considered less engaging. Overall, the specials are recommended for fans seeking more content after finishing the main series.
pros: Explores consequences of human transmutation effectively.
Provides additional background on side characters.
High production quality consistent with the main series.
cons: Some episodes are considered boring or skippable.
Story quality is inconsistent across all four episodes.
Not as intriguing or interesting as expected.

anime.title: Weiß Survive
anime.synopsis:
Takeshi was just an ordinary guy until a perfectly innocent study session with Michi - the most beautiful girl in the school - ended up with him being mysteriously transported into the strange dimension known as the Weiss Schwarz Battle Space. Once there, a crazy but enthusiastic old man informs him that he is the chosen warrior and must win a succession of card battles to get back home. 

The only problem: he doesn't know how to play! However, with the expert Michi ready to teach him the ins and outs of this bizarre and improbably slapstick card game, Takeshi will learn the ropes and get ready for the card battle of a lifetime. Assuming he survives the training...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some finding the show to be a hilarious and enjoyable parody, while others criticize its short length, poor explanation of the card game, and cheap animation. The humor and characters are highlights for some, but the lack of substance and confusing plot detract from the experience for others. Overall, it's considered a time-killer with limited appeal.
pros: Funny characters, especially the old man
Good animation style for a concise comedy
Parody of card game anime
cons: Extremely short episodes with little substance
Poorly explained and nonsensical card game rules
Cheap animation with repeated shots
Weak or absent soundtrack

anime.title: Detective Conan OVA 09: The Stranger in 10 Years...
anime.synopsis: This OVA takes place ten years in the future and chronicles the possible events if Conan Edogawa and Ai Haibara do not take the antidote to APTX 4869 and grow up alongside their friends Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi, while still maintaining their detective endeavors.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is viewed as an interesting 'what-if' scenario, particularly for dedicated fans of the characters. However, it's criticized for its weak plot, lack of significant character development, and wasted potential. The audience is mildly interested but ultimately underwhelmed due to the inconsequential nature of the story.
pros: Interesting character designs for the older versions.
Intriguing concept of a 'what-if' scenario.
cons: Lack of a compelling mystery or story.
Characters feel too similar to their younger selves despite the time skip.
OVA feels pointless and lacking in development.
Pacing issues, with too much time spent on setup.

anime.title: Tegami Bachi: Letter Bee
anime.synopsis:
Gauche Suede is highly respected among the Letter Bees—a government organization that delivers written messages to even the most remote locations. However, the Amberground, the land Gauche must traverse, is blanketed in a constant twilight and home to monsters known as Gaichuu. On one precarious journey, Gauche meets Lag Seeing, a troubled young boy who has himself been sent as a letter.

Five years later, Lag joins the Letter Bee as well, inspired by his journey with Gauche. As he strives to become like his hero, Lag discovers the conflict and complexity at the heart of his world.
anime.consensus_summary: Tegami Bachi is a visually appealing and emotionally driven anime with a unique premise. However, the slow pace, episodic structure, and overuse of emotional cues like the main character's constant crying detract from the overall experience. The series is appreciated for its heartwarming stories and interesting world but criticized for its pacing and filler.
pros: Unique and interesting world setting.
Heartwarming and emotional stories.
Beautiful animation and art style.
cons: Slow pacing and episodic nature.
Too much filler content.
Inconsistent character development.
Repetitive emotional cues (Lag crying frequently).

anime.title: The Day I Bought a Star
anime.synopsis: A young boy, tired of the city, escapes into the country. When trying to bring vegetables to the market to sell, his cart breaks down and he exchanges the vegetables for a mystical seed. Returning home he plants the seed in a normal pot—only to find it growing into a planet.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is appreciative of the film's visuals and creative story. However, the limited accessibility due to the language barrier hinders full enjoyment and understanding. There is a desire for wider release with subtitles to fully appreciate the narrative.
pros: Impressive visual art and animation quality.
Creative world-building with sci-fi elements.
Character designs reminiscent of classic Ghibli films.
cons: Lack of accessibility due to language barrier (Japanese only, no subtitles).
Limited world exploration, with focus on a small setting.
Story comprehension limited by lack of subtitles.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 14: The Lost Ship in the Sky
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 14: Tenkuu no Lost Ship
anime.synopsis:
One night, the Tokyo National Institute of Microorganisms is attacked by a mysterious organization calling themselves the "Red Siamese Cats." The group causes the explosion of a high-security lab storing a virus—said to have a mortality rate of 80% with no known cure. This act of terror dominates the headlines, overshadowing the unveiling of the world's biggest airship developed under Jirokichi Suzuki. Peculiarly, the unveiling has a note attached for Kaito "Kaitou Kid" Kuroba, challenging him to steal the jewel on display—the illustrious Lady Sky.

Conan Edogawa is permitted to board the airship along with Kogorou Mouri, Ran Mouri, Sonoko Suzuki, Professor Agasa, and the Detective Boys. However, their fun comes to a halt when an unknown caller contacts Jirokichi and declares that they have released a certain virus in the smoking room. Soon after, symptoms begin to appear among the passengers and chaos ensues. Seizing the opportunity, the Red Siamese Cats suddenly appear and hijack the airship! 

To stop the assailants, Conan and Kaitou Kid, along with their allies, must work together to decipher the clues and discover the Red Siamese Cats' real objective before time runs out.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some fans appreciate the departure from the series' usual murder mystery formula, enjoying the action and the Conan/Kid team-up. Others find the plot predictable and the mystery lacking, with concerns about character inconsistencies and over-the-top scenarios. Despite the criticisms, many still find the movie entertaining, especially those who are already fans of the franchise.
pros: Departure from typical murder mystery plots
Conan and Kid partnership is entertaining
Exciting action sequences
cons: Predictable plot
Mystery is not complex
Inconsistent character portrayal of Kaito Kid (goofy)
Absurd plot elements that stretch believability
Average Music

anime.title: Scary High School Rumors
anime.romaji_title: Gakkou no Kowai Uwasa: Hanako-san ga Kita!!
anime.synopsis: Based on the short story "Ghost Toilet" from Toru Tsunemitsu's urban myth collection "School Ghost Stories." This was adapted into the children's book "Hanako in the Toilet: Scary Stories of Your School" (1993). Several artists then adapted this into the "Here Comes Hanako" manga; most of them also wrote the anime version, which was aired as a segment of the TV series "Ponkikki Kids." Episodes, introduced by Hanako, included "The Haunted Cinema" and "The Cursed Promise Ring."
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received for its blend of humor and mild scares, appealing to viewers looking for something funny yet slightly spooky. While the art style might be a point of contention for some initially, the overall experience is described as enjoyable and unique, with specific elements like Hanako-san's design being a highlight.
pros: Enjoyable despite initial impressions of the art style
Funny with a touch of scariness
Creative elements like Hanako-san's tulip resembling a Sailor Moon stick
cons: Art style can be off-putting initially

anime.title: The Familiar of Zero: Rondo of Princesses Picture Drama
anime.romaji_title: Zero no Tsukaima: Princesses no Rondo Picture Drama
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Picture Drama episodes included in each DVD volumes of Zero no Tsukaima: Princesses no Rondo.

Episode Titles:
vol.1 「Maid's Afternoon: Whip of Love」(メイドの午後　愛のムチ編)
vol.2 「Maid's Afternoon: Afternoon for Two」(メイドの午後　二人きりの昼下がり編)
vol.3 「Maid's Afternoon: The Last Night」 (メイドの午後　最後の夜編)
vol.4 「Countess Butterfly's Graceful Day」 Prologue (バタフライ伯爵夫人の優雅な一日 序章)
vol.5 「Countess Butterfly's Graceful Day」 Chapter 1 (バタフライ伯爵夫人の優雅な一日 第1章)
vol.6 「Countess Butterfly's Graceful Day」 Chapter 2 (バタフライ伯爵夫人の優雅な一日 第2章)
vol.7 「Countess Butterfly's Graceful Day」 The Last Chapter (バタフライ伯爵夫人の優雅な一日 最終章)
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the picture drama enjoyable due to its character interactions and theatrical setting, especially compared to later seasons of the main series. However, others criticize it for its weak story, heavy fan service, and limited animation quality. The picture drama seems to be appreciated by fans of the main characters who are willing to overlook the plot deficiencies.
pros: Improved character consistency compared to the main series (Season 3)
Enjoyable character interactions, especially between Louise and Saito
Theatrical theme provides an interesting twist on their usual roles
Nice art style for a picture drama
cons: Weak or non-existent story in some episodes, especially early ones
Heavy reliance on fan service at the expense of plot
Inconsistent availability and order of subbed episodes
Limited animation typical of picture dramas
Questionable canonicity

anime.title: There She Is!!
anime.synopsis: The plot revolves around Doki, a female rabbit, meeting, falling in love with, and chasing Nabi, a male cat, in a world where love between the two species is socially unacceptable. The theme of the short is that all love can be accepted and has a chance. Nabi attempts to cure Doki's infatuation for him, but after seeing the extent of her love, he gives in and finds something he can appreciate in her.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly appreciates 'Tteotda Keunyeo!!' for its poignant storytelling, impactful message of acceptance, and effective use of music and animation. Despite some minor critiques regarding the lack of depth in certain areas, viewers are deeply moved by the characters and the themes explored. The series is considered a gem within the flash animation medium, with many recommending it as a must-watch for its emotional resonance and social commentary.
pros: Powerful storytelling without dialogue
Effective use of music to convey emotions and narrative
Simple yet expressive animation style enhances the message
Addresses social issues like prejudice and acceptance in a relatable way
Strong character development despite the short runtime
cons: Lack of detailed explanation for the societal taboos presented
Limited character development for side characters
Short length leaves some wanting more depth and exploration
Flash animation may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Beast Wars Neo
anime.romaji_title: Chou Seimeitai Transformers Beast Wars Neo
anime.synopsis:
Beast Wars Neo was a television series that aired in Japan in 1999, in support of the toyline of the same name. It directly follows Beast Wars II.

The show follows the adventures of a crew of Maximals, commanded by Big Convoy, as they compete with Magmatron's evil Predacons to collect the Angolmois energy capsules, scattered at the end of Beast Wars II.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Beast Wars Neo is a decent entry in the Transformers franchise, particularly enjoyable for existing Beast Wars fans. While the plot and animation have flaws, the characters, especially the Predacons, and voice acting are highlights. The show serves as a satisfying sequel to Beast Wars II, though familiarity with the franchise is recommended for maximum enjoyment.
pros: Enjoyable characters, especially the Predacons
Voice acting is well-done
Transformation sequences are a delight
Expands on the Beast Wars universe
Good opening and ending themes
cons: Plot can be repetitive and formulaic
Animation errors and inconsistent art
Maximal characters are less compelling than Predacons
Relies on familiarity with the Transformers franchise
Sound design not significantly improved from previous installments

anime.title: Nyan Koi!
anime.synopsis:
Junpei Kousaka is a second-year high school student who has an allergy for cats—a predicament that has made him hate cats and everything related to them. Unfortunately for him, though, he is surrounded by cat lovers: his family, his estranged childhood friend, and even his crush Kaede Mizuno.

One day, while returning home from school, Junpei nonchalantly attempts to kick an empty can into the trash, but miserably misses. Instead of making it to the garbage, the can ends up breaking off the head of a cat deity statue. That fateful day, he is cursed with the ability to understand cat speech. However, he must keep his curse a secret from everyone else, because anyone who finds out will become more accident-prone and share the same fate as him.

With the guidance of his cat Nyamsus and with no other choice left, Junpei now has to do a hundred good deeds for cats to lift the curse. If he is unable to complete this task, he will turn into a cat, and considering his allergy, that would be a death sentence for him!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Nyan Koi!" is seen as a lighthearted and amusing harem anime with a unique cat-related premise that provides some novelty. However, it suffers from common harem tropes, and the plot often deviates from its initial concept. While enjoyable for fans of the genre, it may not appeal to those seeking depth or originality.
pros: Humorous and enjoyable, especially for cat lovers.
Unique premise of helping cats to lift a curse adds novelty to the harem genre.
Well-executed voice acting and fitting music enhance the comedic moments.
Colorful and appealing art style.
cons: Generic harem elements and predictable characters.
Plot deviates from the main storyline of the curse, becoming a typical harem/romance.
Inconsistent plot development, with the cat-related aspects sometimes feeling like a gimmick.
Lack of character development for supporting characters.
anime.thematic_vibe: Harem Comedy, Cat Theme, Slice of Life

anime.title: Tamagotchi: The Movie
anime.romaji_title: Eiga de Toujou! Tamagotchi Dokidoki! Uchuu no Maigotchi!?
anime.synopsis: See all your Tamagotchi friends in their first feature-length film! On Tamagotchi planet, Mametchi, an illustrious inventor, has just finished his new creation a Forwarding Machine. But on its first trial run, the mischievous Kuchipatchi somehow manages to throw the machine s aim off course, which results in a child from Earth, Tanpopo, being transported to the Tamagotchi Planet. While the little girl is thrilled to see her favorite Tamagotchis in person, she soon realizes that she can't get home. Mametchi's mum and dad assure her that they will be able to invent a rocket which will take her back to the exact time she left and so, relieved, Tanpopo manages to enjoy the time she will spend living with Mametchi on Tamagotchi Planet until she can return home. But as a series of strange events threaten the planet, Tanpopo and her friends find themselves responsible for much more than her return to Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, particularly among viewers who understand the target demographic (children). Reviewers highlight the surprisingly good writing, charming characters, and adorable world-building. The movie's educational value, teaching kids about emotions and apologies, is also appreciated.
pros: Surprisingly good writing for a kids' movie
Charming characters
Silly and adorable world-building
Teaches kids to express their feelings and apologize

anime.title: Porong Porong Pororo
anime.synopsis:
The curious penguin Pororo is out exploring one day when he stumbles upon a mysterious egg. Planning on eating it, Pororo decides to take it home. However, the egg hatches in front of his eyes, and to his surprise a dinosaur emerges, staring him in the face. Though terrified at first, Pororo soon befriends the lovable pint-sized creature and the two go on many adventures with the rest of their friends.

Within this gang of friends, there is the dinosaur Crong, a playful troublemaker; the fox Eddy, a trickster and inventor; the beaver Loopy, an artistic baker; and the polar bear Poby, a photographer and fisherman with a generous heart. When all these friends get together, they are sure to get into mischief.

Porong Porong Pororo follows Pororo and his friends as they venture through their daily lives. Confronting every new adventure and challenge, Pororo and the gang will learn courage, compassion, and what it truly means to be a good friend.
anime.consensus_summary: Pororo is overwhelmingly seen as a positive and educational show for very young children. Its simple stories and focus on friendship resonate well with its target demographic. While not engaging for older viewers, it evokes nostalgia in those who grew up with it.
pros: Teaches children valuable morals, such as friendship and respect.
Educational content includes basic concepts like colors and language.
Characters have unique and identifiable characteristics.
Good animation for young children (ages 4-8).
cons: Not suitable for older audiences.
Background of characters is not well-developed.

anime.title: Peeping Life: The Perfect Edition
anime.synopsis: Slice of life comedy about pitfalls of Japanese society.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is appreciated for its ability to capture the essence of Japanese culture and human interaction through simple, short episodes. While some find the situations or characters inane, the animation style is effective.  Overall, it's a worthwhile watch for those interested in observational comedy and cultural nuances.
pros: Captures nuances of Japanese culture and speech
Simple and short episodes
Effective use of CG animation to portray human interaction
cons: Situations and characters can be inane
May take time to understand the context due to in medias res openings

anime.title: Angel Beats!
anime.synopsis:
Death is one of many mysteries that has left humanity in the dark since the dawn of time. However, the burning question of what happens to the soul after one dies is soon answered to 17-year-old Yuzuru Otonashi. Waking up with no previous memories in a dimension between life and death, he discovers the unsettling truth of the afterlife.  

Taking the form of a high school, this bizarre dimension is designated to shelter those who died unwanted deaths. Feeling wronged by God during their earthly lives, the school's residents have decided to form the Afterlife Battlefront—a rebellious faction determined to oppose their god-like student council president, Kanade "Angel" Tachibana. The group's leader, Yuri Nakamura, recruits Otonashi in their fight against Angel in order to take control of their own lives. However, questioning the morality behind their actions, Otonashi takes a step behind the enemy lines to understand the opposing side of their common fate.
anime.consensus_summary: Angel Beats! evokes strong, polarized opinions, with some viewers praising its emotional depth, humor, and visual appeal, while others criticize its rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, and reliance on familiar tropes. The series' high production value and engaging soundtrack are generally acknowledged, but its narrative execution divides audiences. Many feel it had great potential but ultimately fell short due to pacing issues and a lack of originality.
pros: Visually appealing animation and captivating audio.
Unique mix of school life and supernatural elements.
Well-timed comedy and humorous moments.
cons: Rushed plot and underdeveloped characters due to the limited number of episodes.
Formulaic storytelling and lack of originality.
Inconsistent character motivations and shallow story.

anime.title: Kawa no Hikari
anime.genres: Adventure, Anthropomorphic, Iyashikei, Kids, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: A story of a rat family who have to leave their home because humans start a construction site. Now the rats are searching for a place to stay.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience mood is overwhelmingly positive, particularly among those who appreciate thoughtful storytelling and relatable themes. The reviewer was deeply touched by the movie's ability to convey meaningful messages about life, family, and the search for home. There may be some aversion to the simple animation style.
pros: The story is relevant to some kind of reflection upon life.
It works as a metaphor or analogy of many ideas.
The screenplay is well-written, possibly influenced by the author's background in French Literature.
cons: May not appeal to those requiring highly realistic stories.
The reviewer expresses some skepticism and cynicism regarding some movies.

anime.title: Popee the Clown
anime.synopsis: Somewhere in the desert lies the Wolf Zirkus: a strange circus where Popee, a clown in a pink rabbit jumpsuit, shares the stage with Kedamono, a purple creature who wears a mask. Together, they juggle the whims of performing, practicing their acts, and poking fun at each other. In a world where anything seems possible, there is no telling what will happen next during this eccentric spectacle.
anime.consensus_summary: Popee the Performer evokes strong, mixed reactions. While some appreciate its bizarre, surreal humor and unique aesthetic, others are put off by the crude animation, repetitive gags, and violent content. The show's cult following celebrates its weirdness, but its unconventional nature makes it divisive for general audiences. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on one's tolerance for the absurd and unsettling.
pros: Unique and bizarre art style that enhances the surreal comedy-horror.
Memorable character designs, especially Kedamono.
Effective use of limited animation to create absurd and funny moments.
Catchy and well-utilized sound design despite the limited number of tracks.
cons: Crude CGI animation style may be off-putting to some viewers.
Repetitive humor and music can become stale if watched in large doses.
Lack of a coherent plot or story may not appeal to all viewers.
Disturbing and violent content may not be suitable for all audiences.

anime.title: It's a Rumic World: 50th Anniversary Weekly★Shonen Sunday
anime.romaji_title: It's a Rumic World: 50th Anniversary Weekly★Shonen Sunday
anime.synopsis: The characters from Ranma 1/2, Urusei Yatsura, and Inuyasha all gather together in a short crossover to introduce the 50th Anniversary Weekly Shonen Sunday "Rumic World" Museum opening, celebrating Rumiko Takahashi's manga work.
anime.consensus_summary: The short crossover is well-received as a nostalgic and humorous fanservice piece for Rumiko Takahashi's works. The animation and voice acting are praised for staying true to the original series. The main criticism is its short length and the absence of some beloved characters, leaving fans wanting more.
pros: Great animation staying true to Takahashi's style
Original voice actors deliver expectedly great performances
Characters act as expected and interact humorously
cons: Very short length leaves viewers wanting more
Absence of certain characters like Akane and Kyoko is disappointing

anime.title: Urusei Yatsura: The Shougaibutsu Suieitaikai
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: On a very hot summer day in Tomobiki town, Lum, Ataru, and the rest of the gang are looking forward to using the school's pool. But the teachers have other plans: setting a ludicrous obstacle course between the students in their swimsuits and the pool... naturally this ends in complete chaos.
anime.consensus_summary: The Urusei Yatsura special is a lighthearted and chaotic return to form for the series, primarily appealing to existing fans. The animation and story-boarding are well-executed, providing visual comedy and highlighting familiar character dynamics. However, the special doesn't offer much in terms of originality or narrative depth, functioning mostly as a nostalgic revisit for longtime viewers.
pros: Dynamic story-boarding
Good and generally fluid animation
Humorous twists on high school sports
Features each character's unique comedic bits
cons: Relies heavily on established characters and tropes
Story is not particularly special or innovative
Modern digital animation style is just a nod to fans
Lacks depth beyond fan service

anime.title: Shakugan no Shana S: OVA Series
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Find out what happens when Yuji accidentally triggers a found Treasure Tool while it's pointed at Shana! Then, Yuji teams up with Wilhelmina to stalk their fiery friend—whose secrecy has become unsettling. Finally, in a two-part special, Shana tracks a Denizen's trail by sorting through a Torch's memories for clues. Her sleuth skills reveal a teenage girl's heartwarming last days and a predator with a serious identity crisis!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Shakugan no Shana S' for its lighthearted and emotional episodes that provide a break from the main series. Many viewers find the exploration of Shana's past and the comedic moments enjoyable and heartwarming. While some consider the initial episodes as filler, the overall sentiment is positive, with many considering it a valuable addition to the franchise.
pros: Lighthearted and funny episodes provide a break from the main series' heavy content.
The OVA delves into Shana's past, offering emotional depth and character development.
Well-executed comedic moments with heartwarming conclusions.
cons: First two episodes can feel like filler.
Some viewers may prefer a full season instead of OVAs.

anime.title: Darker than Black: Gemini of the Meteor
anime.romaji_title: Darker than Black: Ryuusei no Gemini
anime.synopsis:
One night, as meteors streak across the star-studded sky, Shion Pavlichenko becomes a Contractor. Despite her brother's transformation, Shion's twin sister Suou continues to live a fairly ordinary life, attending middle school with her friends and getting caught up in the awkwardness of growing up. However, everything changes when her home is invaded by a masked man cloaked in black, destroying any sense of normality she once had. Revealed to possess latent Contractor abilities of her own, Suou is caught between family, friends, and her own sense of purpose as she ventures into the ruthless world of cutthroats and espionage that Contractors call home.

Meanwhile in Tokyo, investigation surrounding Hell's Gate's sudden collapse is underway, and prophetic signs of doom point in the direction of a silver-haired doll.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is largely negative, especially when compared to the first season. Reviewers criticize the confusing plot, inconsistent characterizations, and tonal shifts. While some appreciate the action and new characters, the disappointment in failing to live up to its predecessor is a recurring theme.
pros: Good action sequences
Interesting storyline independent of the first season
Good artwork and sound design
Enjoyable new characters (excluding Hei)
Unique contractor abilities
cons: Characters are poorly written or inconsistent with the original series
Plot is confusing, aimless, and poorly explained
Unsatisfactory ending with many unanswered questions
Significant shift in tone, moving away from noir to action with forced comedy
Art and animation are stagnant

anime.title: Hanamaru Kindergarten
anime.synopsis: Anzu goes to a kindergarten with her friends, the shy Koume and the eccentric Hiiragi. Together they try to make their caretaker, Tsuchida Naozumi, fall in love with Anzu. However, he is clearly more interested in the pretty Yamamoto Nanako, a fellow kindergarten teacher who supervises the class next door. Even though Anzu tries to convince Tsuchida to marry her when she grows up by using various methods. Tsuchida, on the other hand, hopes to get a chance to date Yamamoto, and, if not, to marry her.
anime.consensus_summary: Hanamaru Youchien is generally seen as a cute and heartwarming slice-of-life anime, praised for its animation and voice acting. However, the central plot involving a kindergartner's crush on her teacher sparks controversy and discomfort among some viewers. While some find it innocent and comical, others view it as morally ambiguous and inappropriate.
pros: The animation is cute and suits the light-hearted feel of the show.
Each episode contains well-planned sub-episodes with subtle undertones.
The voice acting for the kindergarten kids is particularly well done.
cons: The relationship between Anzu and Tsuchida is considered creepy by some viewers.
The story is cliche-driven and lacks depth.
Some storylines feel random and unnecessary, lacking realism.

anime.title: Sengoku Basara: Setonai no Gekitotsu! Hi wo Fuku Umi no Daiyousai - Fugaku!!
anime.romaji_title: Sengoku Basara: Setonai no Gekitotsu! Hi wo Fuku Umi no Daiyousai - Fugaku!!
anime.synopsis: Maeda Toshiie and Matsu visit Chousokabe Motochika, who governs Shikoku. They tell Motochika unreasonable demands from Nobunaga. Motochika rejects them and urges Maeda to betray Nobunaga. Meanwhile Keiji tries to convince Mouri Motonari to join the fight against Nobunaga, and is imprisoned as a result. Motochika and Motonari move against each other.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is generally seen as an enjoyable side story, particularly highlighting the interactions between Motochika and Motonari and the humor of Keiji. However, it's considered somewhat rushed and not essential to the main narrative. Some viewers feel that certain character actions are not properly addressed, reducing its overall impact.
pros: Enjoyable interaction between Motochika and Motonari
Amusing actions of Keiji
cons: Low rewatch value
Feels rushed and like a side story
Motonari gets too much of a pass for reprehensible behavior
Friendship speech from Keiji is too much talk-no-jutsu

anime.title: Tentai Senshi Sunred 2nd Season
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: The second season of Tentai Senshi Sunred.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Tentai Senshi Sunred is well-received for its humor, writing, and characters. Reviewers appreciate the show's parody elements and the progression from the first season. The only notable drawback is the animation quality, which is considered dated.
pros: Good writing
Fast-paced gags that are actually funny
Charming and useful side characters
Continuity from the first season with new characters and scenarios
cons: Animation not up to today's standards

anime.title: Yume-iro Pâtissière
anime.synopsis:
Aside from her deep passion for eating cakes, the clumsy Ichigo Amano has never been successful at anything.  After an encounter with Henri Lucas, a famous patissier, Ichigo's amazing tasting abilities—although unbeknownst to her—are discovered.  Recognizing her talent, Henri offers her the chance to attend St. Marie Academy, a prestigious culinary school which specializes in desserts.

In spite of the fact that she is a beginner lacking skills, thanks to Henri's recommendation, Ichigo is placed in the topmost group with the "Sweets Princes." The princes, famous throughout the school for their magical treats, are Sennosuke Andou, an expert in traditional Japanese sweets; Satsuki Hanabusa, with a flair for candied flowers; and Makoto Kashino, a gifted chocolatier. Ichigo and the Sweets Princes, each accompanied by their "Sweets Spirits"—fairies who make patissiers' dreams come true—all work towards their goals in the competitive world of sweets.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received, especially among younger audiences, for its focus on dreams, friendship, and appealing visuals of sweets. However, some find the storyline unoriginal, the main character annoying, and the plot unrealistic. Despite its flaws, many find it enjoyable and even rewatch it, appreciating its themes and cute elements.
pros: Enjoyable and addictive, especially during competitions.
Focuses on friendship, hard work, and pursuing dreams.
Visually appealing sweets and character designs.
cons: Unoriginal storyline and clichéd plot elements.
Annoying main character and unrealistic skill progression.
Excessive filler episodes.
Targeted at a younger audience, which may not appeal to adults.

anime.title: Samurai X DVD-BOX Special Ending
anime.synopsis: The last scene of the 10 Years Special DVD BOX released in Japan in 2007. Follows the manga's ending.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience generally appreciates this short special as a more faithful and satisfying conclusion to Rurouni Kenshin, especially for those who disliked the Seisouhen OVAs. While some find it too short and uneventful, it's largely seen as a worthwhile addition for fans of the series, providing a glimpse of the happy ending from the manga. The special mainly serves as a nostalgic and emotionally resonant epilogue for dedicated fans.
pros: Provides a manga-based ending for those dissatisfied with the anime's conclusion.
Offers a coherent and satisfying closure to the story.
Faithful to the original manga's spirit.
The animation is slightly better than the original anime series.
The music is nostalgic and recognizable.
Portrays the Himura family as a happy, functional unit.
cons: It is a very short scene, lasting only three minutes.
Some consider it uneventful and lacking in grandiosity.
The narration is perceived as trying too hard to be profound and failing.
Relies on implication and suggestion rather than substantial content.

anime.title: Katanagatari
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis:
In an Edo-era Japan lush with a variety of sword-fighting styles, Shichika Yasuri practices the most unique one: Kyotouryuu, a technique in which the user's own body is wielded as a blade. The enigmatic seventh head of the Kyotouryuu school, Shichika lives quietly in exile with his sister Nanami until one day—the wildly ambitious strategist Togame barges into their lives.

Togame brazenly requests that Shichika help in her mission to collect twelve unique swords, known as the "Deviant Blades," for the shogunate. Shichika accepts, interested in the girl herself rather than petty politics, and thus sets out on a journey. Standing in their way are the fierce wielders of these legendary weapons as well as other power-hungry entities who seek to thwart Togame's objective. In order to prevail against their enemies, the duo must become an unbreakable team as they forge ahead on a path of uncertainty and peril.
anime.consensus_summary: Katanagatari is a unique series praised for its character development, dialogue, and pacing, though some find the plot predictable and the reliance on dialogue excessive. The anime is well-regarded but not universally loved, leading to a moderate level of audience polarization. Despite some criticisms, it's considered a worthwhile watch for those seeking something different from typical shounen anime.
pros: Unique characters and world-building
Well-paced storytelling
Eloquent dialogue and character interactions
cons: Formulaic episode structure
Predictable plot elements
Overreliance on dialogue, potentially boring for some viewers

anime.title: Kuruneko
anime.synopsis: Based on a manga about cats and their sake loving owner.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find the show cute, addicting, and relatable, especially enjoying the characters and the simple art style. Even dog people can enjoy this show about cats.
pros: Addicting and enjoyable characters
Relatable tales about cats
Minimal art style is a joy
cons: One-note characters

anime.title: Pucca (TV)
anime.synopsis: Pucca is the young daughter of a Chinese noodle house owner and she is hopelessly in love with the ninja Garu. He tries desperately to avoid Pucca's advances and usually does not return her affection. This results in many comical situations as Pucca goes to great lengths just to steal a kiss from Garu. Expect to see lots of "funny love" antics involving everything from noodles to deadly ninjas.
anime.consensus_summary: Pucca is a well-received, uncomplicated comedy focused on visual gags and lighthearted romance. The humor is accessible and the animation style complements the comedic tone. While lacking a complex plot or character development, its simplicity and consistent humor make it a worthwhile short watch for those seeking a quick laugh.
pros: Visual comedy is excellent and Pythonesque.
Catchy music and eccentric take on romance.
Characters are designed in a cartoony manner, enhancing the humor.
cons: No real plot beyond Pucca's pursuit of Garu.
No character development.

anime.title: King of Thorn
anime.genres: Action, Gore, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
When a deadly virus known as Medousa sweeps across the globe, turning people to stone with no chance of recovery, humanity finds itself on the verge of destruction. The only hope is the Venus Gate Corporation's shocking new plan: to put 160 people in cold sleep for up to one hundred years, or until a treatment is developed. Kasumi Ishiki is one of the fortunate to be selected, and though she fears being separated from her twin sister, Shizuku, the girls hope that they can be reunited in the future.

When Kasumi awakens, however, the world is not what she expected. The cold sleep facility is covered in thorns, and strange monsters start attacking them. Although most of those who have woken up die in the immediate confusion, Kasumi and a small group of survivors begin to investigate the maze-like facility and unravel the secrets of Medousa, as well as the true intentions of the Venus Gate Corporation.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Ibara no Ou is deeply divided, with strong opinions on both its potential and its execution. While many praise the atmospheric visuals, intriguing premise, and compelling soundtrack, a significant portion criticizes the convoluted plot, jarring CGI, and ultimately unsatisfying conclusion, especially when compared to the manga.
pros: Atmospheric and visually impressive scenery, with a good blend of 2D and 3D animation.
The soundtrack is atmospheric and effectively builds tension, enhancing the horror and thriller influences.
The initial mystery and intrigue of the plot are well-executed and engaging.
Some reviewers appreciated the psychological depth and philosophical undertones, particularly the "Sleeping Beauty" parallels.
cons: The plot becomes convoluted and confusing, especially in the latter half, with too many twists and unresolved plot points.
The heavy reliance on jarring and poorly integrated 3D CGI animation, particularly for monsters and characters, detracts significantly from the visual experience.
Many critics felt the story's potential was squandered due to poor pacing, rushed development, and a disappointing, unsatisfying ending.
Significant deviations from the source manga, including character backstories and the antagonist, were a major point of contention for fans of the original work.

anime.title: The Garden of Sinners Remix: Gate of Seventh Heaven
anime.romaji_title: Kara no Kyoukai Remix: Gate of Seventh Heaven
anime.synopsis: In August of 1995, Mikiya Kokutou meets a young kimono-clad woman named Shiki Ryougi. When he finds out that they go to the same school, he attempts to befriend her. Though her upbringing is unconventional and she herself is strange, Mikiya is not deterred, and Shiki gradually opens up to him. But Mikiya's life will be changed forever by this simple meeting, and in ways that he never imagined, as he begins to see a deadly side to his new friend...
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Kara no Kyoukai Remix: Gate of Seventh Heaven' is a well-made recap movie that effectively summarizes the first six installments. It is praised for its chronological presentation, new scenes, and visual/audio quality. However, some find it unnecessary due to the lack of new story content and reliance on existing material, making it more suitable for existing fans than new viewers.
pros: Excellent recap of the series.
Organized chronological order.
New scenes provide more insight.
Beautiful animation and soundtracks.
Good introduction to the world of Kara no Kyoukai.
cons: Little to no new story development.
Art is mostly recycled from previous movies.
May not be understandable for newcomers.

anime.title: Dengeki Bunko 2007 Movie Festival Special
anime.synopsis: Played at Dengeki Bunko's Movie Festival on 21 April 2007 before the Shakugan no Shana, Inukami! and Kino no Tabi movies. It was later released on DVD and sold at Dengeki's 15th Anniversary event.
anime.consensus_summary: This short special primarily caters to fans of Shakugan no Shana and Inukami!, offering fan service and light-hearted antics. However, it disappoints viewers of Kino's Journey due to the limited screen time and lack of meaningful interaction for its characters. The special is perceived as more of a marketing tool than a substantial story, with unequal focus across the represented franchises. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on familiarity with the featured series.
pros: Fan service for Shakugan no Shana and Inukami! fans.
Opportunity to see SD (Super Deformed) versions of characters.
cons: Unequal screen time for characters from different series.
Kino's Journey characters sidelined and underutilized.
Story lacks substance and feels like marketing.
May not be enjoyable for viewers unfamiliar with all the featured series.

anime.title: Queen's Blade: Inheritor of the Throne
anime.romaji_title: Queen's Blade: Gyokuza wo Tsugu Mono
anime.synopsis:
After experiencing the numerous trials encountered on her journey, Reina has grown as a warrior. Determined to take part in the Queen's Blade tournament, she arrives at the capital city Gainos, where Queen Aldora awaits. There gathers a number of beautiful warriors who, like Reina, are there for the Queen's Blade.

Amongst them is Reina's sister, Claudette, determined to restore the glory of House Vance; Tomoe and Shizuka, who are both fighting for their homeland of Hinomoto; Nanael who has been ordered to participate by the Archangel; and the subordinates of the Marshland Witch.

All these beautiful fighters who gather in Gainos have been one objective, to win through the Queen's Blade, the tournament to select the strongest, most beautiful queen. Who would ascend to that glorious throne? That can only be determined via battle.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally agrees that 'Queen's Blade: Gyokuza wo Tsugu Mono' is a significant improvement over the first season.  While the excessive fanservice remains a prominent element, the improved storyline, character development, and enhanced production values have garnered positive reception.  Viewers appreciate the engaging battles and the emotional depth added to the characters, making it a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre.
pros: Improved storyline compared to the first season, with a solid plot progression.
Character development and maturity, especially for Reina and other main characters.
Great voice acting and soundtrack that enhances emotional impact.
Fights begin to matter and have real stakes
Meaningful character pairings that play into their strengths
cons: Excessive fanservice that might distract some viewers.
Choppy animation at times
Forgotten plot threads
Some new characters are underdeveloped

anime.title: Sengoku Basara: Samurai Kings 2
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Samurai
anime.synopsis:
The deadly confrontation with the Devil King, Oda Nobunaga is over, but the struggle for supremacy continues in Warring Countries-era Japan, as the armies of Takeda Shingen and Uesugi Kenshin repeatedly engage battle at Kawanakajima.

Meanwhile, on the easternmost side of the battlefield, two outstanding characters bound by destiny—one clad in azure and the other in crimson—are about to clash in a long-awaited, decisive duel.

Then a sudden dispatch informs that a huge army has surrounded the forces of Takeda, Uesugi and Date at Kakanakajima. Their leader is Toyotomi Hideyoshi, the man who inherited Nobunaga's dreams and ambitions, and who is now going to bring havoc over Japan once again!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Sengoku Basara Ni, praising its action sequences, character development, and improved storyline compared to the first season. Some find the influx of new characters and locations overwhelming. Overall, the series is well-received for its entertainment value and artistic merit.
pros: Improved fight scenes compared to the first series.
More focused story than the first series.
Characters stand out more.
Great art, especially the armor and battle scenes.
cons: Too many new names and places to memorize.
Story can be repetitive (territory war against one another again).

anime.title: Eden of The East the Movie II: Paradise Lost
anime.romaji_title: Higashi no Eden Movie II: Paradise Lost
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
As one of the 12 Seleção that needs to save the country in order to win a game, Akira Takizawa decided to become the "King of Japan." With that in mind, after his return from the U.S.A., the remaining Seleção will also need to follow up on their own plans as they strive to outdo each other.

Saki Morimi and the other members of the "Eden of the East" are under suspicion of being terrorists, but they still do everything they can to help Takizawa reach his goal and unravel the secrets of his past, as the last fight between the Seleção begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Higashi no Eden Movie II: Paradise Lost' is mixed. Some viewers found the ending appropriate and appreciated the resolution of certain plot points, while others were disappointed by the unclear narrative, unsatisfying conclusion, and perceived decline in plot quality compared to the original series. The film is considered controversial due to unresolved issues and an unfulfilling ending.
pros: Answers questions about the EotE universe.
Ending appropriately considers the story as it was.
Great music and refined art style.
Ties up loose ends
cons: Underwhelming compared to the TV series.
Ending is unclear and unsatisfying.
Plot degrades into just politics.
Character motivations unclear.
Lazy writing with lack of foundation.
Repetitive memory erasing plot device.
Feels incomplete and rushed.

anime.title: High School Girls Specials
anime.synopsis: Bonus episodes on the DVDs featuring the girls on a field trip to Chichibu.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience found the special episodes to be a disappointing addition to the main series. The plot is uninspired, and the humor relies on characters being overly stupid. Overall, the special is considered tiresome and unnecessary, failing to add anything meaningful to the viewing experience.
cons: Unremarkable plot
Characters portrayed as overly stupid
Tiresome and adds little to the main series experience
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, School Life

anime.title: Redline
anime.synopsis:
Every five years, an exhilarating race called Redline is held, and the universe's most anticipated competition has only one rule: that there are none. Racers are pushed to their absolute limit—a feeling that daredevil driver JP knows all too well. Having just qualified to participate in Redline, he is eager to battle against the other highly skilled drivers, particularly the beautiful rising star and the only other human that qualified, Sonoshee McLaren.

But this year's Redline may be far more dangerous than usual—it has been announced to take place on the planet Roboworld with its trigger-happy military and criminals who look to turn the race to their own advantage. However, the potential danger doesn't stop the racers; in fact, it only adds to the thrill. Relying solely on his vehicle's speed, JP prepares for the event to come, aiming to take first place in the biggest race of his life.
anime.consensus_summary: Redline is overwhelmingly praised for its breathtaking visuals and high-energy action, making it a visually stunning experience. However, many critics point out that the plot and character development are weak, resulting in a style-over-substance film. While some viewers find the simple story sufficient, others feel it detracts from the overall enjoyment. Ultimately, Redline is best appreciated for its artistic and technical achievements rather than its narrative depth.
pros: Visually stunning animation with unique and detailed art style.
Exhilarating and fast-paced action sequences.
Excellent soundtrack that complements the visuals.
Memorable and quirky character designs.
The movie's dedication to hand-drawn animation is a significant achievement.
cons: Plot is simple, clichéd, and sometimes convoluted.
Character development is lacking, and characters can be forgettable.
Too many subplots that don't contribute meaningfully to the main story.
Overreliance on spectacle overshadows the narrative.

anime.title: Asura Cryin' 2
anime.synopsis: Following the first season, Tomoharu is now faced with a dilemma: if he doesn't form a contract with an "akuma," he risks losing his dear friend Takatsuki. However, doing so would compromise his own existence as it would result in him and his ghost friend Misao becoming an Asura Cryin'—mankind's biggest threat, according to their school's presidents. To make the decision even harder, Tomoharu and Misao have recovered some of their past memories—memories of a world that they didn't even know existed.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, with many viewers finding the second season to be a significant improvement over the first. The story is praised for its twists and conclusive ending, but some find the plot overly complex and confusing. While some found the sound design to be lacking, the characters and their development were generally well-received, resulting in an enjoyable viewing experience for many.
pros: Improved plot and storytelling compared to the first season, with more twists and turns.
Conclusive ending that resolves many plot threads.
Explanation of confusing elements from the first season.
Well-developed characters and their relationships.
cons: Complex and convoluted plot with potential plot holes.
May require watching the first season to understand the second.
Inconsistent sound design, with some finding the music unmemorable.
Some contradictory information throughout the series.

anime.title: 11eyes
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Harem, Super Power, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
