When the sky turns red, the moon turns black, and monsters begin roaming the streets, Satsuki Kakeru is at a loss for what to do. Along with his best friend Yuka, they try to decipher why they have been sent to this strange world, which is seemingly empty aside from themselves.

However, when the "Red Night" ends, Kakeru and Yuka believe it was all a dream—until it happens again, and they are left in a dangerous situation. They meet four others in the same predicament: Kusakabe Misuzu, an expert swordswoman; Tachibana Kukuri, a strange mute girl who looks uncannily like Kakeru's deceased sister; Hirohara Yukiko, a lively young girl whose personality reverts to that of a cold killer when her glasses are removed; and Tajima Takahisa, a young pyrokineticist.

As the six of them band together to survive and discover what this mysterious world is, things take a turn for the worse as six shadows appear before them...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response to 11eyes is largely negative. Many viewers were initially intrigued by the premise but were ultimately disappointed by the poor execution of the plot, the annoying characters, and the excessive fan service. While some appreciate the art and sound design, the general consensus is that the anime fails to deliver on its potential and is not worth watching.
pros: Good sound design and music, especially the opening and ending themes.
Visually appealing art style, with clean and attractive animation.
cons: Poorly executed plot with many plot holes and rushed pacing.
Underdeveloped and annoying characters with illogical behavior.
Excessive and poorly timed fan service that detracts from the story.
Generic story elements.

anime.title: Batain Lai!! Minami no Shima no Mizu Monogatari
anime.romaji_title: Batain Lai!! Minami no Shima no Mizu Monogatari
anime.synopsis: The year is 1917, and under Japanese occupation, Taiwan suffers from terrible drought and famine. Residents of the Chianan Plain live in squalor, their lives defined by the daily struggle of carting water home. When Yoichi Hatta, a Japanese civil engineer, arrives with a plan to reshape the area's irrigation dramatically, the local residents are quick to call him a liar. Xu Yingzhe, the son of a poor farmer, takes issue with the outright rejection of Hatta's plan and tries to reason and grasp the situation. Hatta's scheme may seem crazy, but it could be the very thing that improves the strenuous lives of the Taiwanese people.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience acknowledges the film's historical significance and good intentions in portraying Yoichi Hatta's contributions. However, technical aspects like animation and music are considered weak, potentially limiting its appeal. Despite these shortcomings, the film is seen as a decent effort, particularly for those interested in historical dramas with a focus on engineering achievements and cultural impact.
pros: The story is based on a true historical event, highlighting the impact of Yoichi Hatta's engineering on Taiwan.
The narrative provides a slice-of-life perspective by focusing on the experiences of two young friends during the canal's construction.
The ending is emotionally resonant, showing the lasting impact and remembrance of Hatta and his wife in Taiwan.
cons: The animation quality is mediocre and may not appeal to a wide audience.
The music is unremarkable and does not enhance the viewing experience.
The plot execution might feel dull or boring to some, lacking the realism expected in live-action historical dramas.

anime.title: Hammerboy
anime.synopsis:
The story is about a boy named Mangchi. He is small, but he possesses a magical hammer that helps him get around all his problems. Mangchi lives on a small distant island called Candlestick because everywhere else has turned into a wasteland because of some big catastrophe. When Princess Poplar from the kingdom of Jemius is being pursued by henchmen of the conspirator Moonk, Hammerboy sides with her, ready to unleash all his latent powers in order to save humankind. 

The movie premiered at the Big Apple Anime Fest on August 30 2003, and went into wide release in South Korea on August 6, 2004.
anime.consensus_summary: The reviewer has nostalgic feelings for the movie but acknowledges its flaws, particularly the directing and generic storyline. The music and animation are seen as highlights, but overall the movie is considered mediocre. It might be enjoyable for younger audiences or those with similar nostalgic connections.
pros: Solid art and animation for its time.
Music is really solid and lived up to expectations.
Poltapo had some character development and was charming.
cons: Pacing issues make the story feel slow or rushed.
Writing is generic and lacks depth.
Directing is the worst part of the movie, shots are boring, transitions are off-putting, and action feels stiff.
Villain is one-dimensional.

anime.title: Fairy Tail
anime.synopsis:
In the enchanted Kingdom of Fiore, the lively Lucy Heartfilia has one wish: to join the renowned Fairy Tail—one of the many magical wizard guilds scattered around the continent. Luckily, a chance encounter with Natsu Dragneel, the "Salamander" of Fairy Tail, whisks her into the legendary guild.

From Natsu's rivalrous antics with ice wizard Gray Fullbuster to the frightening presence of the unmatched combat goddess Erza Scarlet, Fairy Tail's powerful mages have a slight penchant for trouble. Through all the lucrative odd jobs and adventures to save the world from destruction lies an absolute and unyielding trust stronger than family that has formed between each guild member.

Teaming up with Natsu, Gray, and Erza, Lucy finds herself amidst the guild's most misfit wizards. But as they constantly stand in the eye of every danger, there is one name that never ceases to resurface: Zeref, the feared master of dark magic.
anime.consensus_summary: Fairy Tail is a divisive anime. While some viewers appreciate its focus on friendship, humor, and adventure, others criticize its repetitive plot, predictable outcomes, and reliance on shonen cliches. Many find it enjoyable despite its flaws, while others consider it a waste of time.
pros: Enjoyable characters
Great gateway anime
Good humor
Consistent arcs
cons: Repetitive plot
Predictable story
Poor character development
Overused tropes
Unnecessary fanservice

anime.title: Tayutayu: Pure My Heart
anime.synopsis: Special Tayutama -Kiss on my Deity- episodes added to DVDs and Blu-rays.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the show enjoyable in isolation due to its humor and character interactions but notes its significant deviation from the original series. The lack of a cohesive plot and random nature are major drawbacks. It is recommended only for fans of the original series who are looking for lighthearted, unrelated content.
pros: Funny moments
Enjoyable music
Good character execution within short stories
cons: Random and disconnected stories
Lack of overall plot
Inconsistent character portrayals in some episodes
Doesn't resemble the original series

anime.title: Black Butler II
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Historical, Mythology, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
The stage of Kuroshitsuji II opens on the life of Alois Trancy, the young heir to the Trancy earldom. Though he is privileged now, such was not always the case for the hot-tempered boy. Kidnapped and forced into slavery at a young age, he was eventually rescued and returned home, only to have his beloved father pass away soon after.

However, there are certain individuals who doubt Alois' story and legitimacy. And rightfully so, because things in the Trancy household are not as they appear, starting with Alois' black-clad butler with supernatural abilities, Claude Faustus. Who exactly is the mysterious Claude, and what connection does he have with Alois?

Amid the web of lies and deceit running rampant in the mansion, the bond between Alois and Claude will be tested as hell itself arrives at their doorstep.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Kuroshitsuji II is considered a disappointing sequel that fails to live up to the standards of the first season. Many viewers criticize the convoluted plot, inconsistent character development, and reliance on fanservice over substance. While the animation and sound design are generally praised, the negative aspects outweigh the positives, leading to a largely negative reception and strong division among fans.
pros: Beautiful art and animation
Good sound design and voice acting
Interesting new characters (initially)
cons: Poorly written plot and storyline
Unnecessary sequel that contradicts the first season
Inconsistent character development and out-of-character moments
Excessive and poorly executed fanservice
Disappointing and nonsensical ending

anime.title: Ai Yori Aoshi: Speaking of Dreams
anime.synopsis: Kaoru and the girls have a picnic in Spring and talk about their dreams for the future.
anime.consensus_summary: The special episode is primarily aimed at existing fans of 'Ai Yori Aoshi' who appreciate seeing familiar characters and themes revisited. However, it offers little in the way of new content or plot progression, making it skippable for newcomers or those seeking a fresh narrative. The episode serves as a nostalgic trip down memory lane for devoted followers of the series.
pros: Faithful to the source material
Pleasing art style
Enjoyable for fans of the series
cons: Lack of new plot development
Repetitive of the original series
Unnecessary for viewers unfamiliar with the original series

anime.title: Summer Storm! Open for Business
anime.genres: Comedy, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: The summer of a man's boyhood memories continue. Still on the cusp between childhood and being a man, he has linked with the ghost of a young woman from the World War 2 era. She, and the ghosts of other young ladies from that time, continue adventures alongside their linked partners, learning more about each other and travelling through time via their supernatural connection. While he struggles to see his crush on her come to fruition, meanwhile his friend—a girl his age, pretending to be a boy—seeks his attention as well.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Natsu no Arashi! Akinaichuu, particularly its comedic elements and character interactions. However, the lack of a strong central plot and inconsistent humor are points of criticism. Some viewers are also put off by the fan service and age gap issues, but overall, those who enjoyed the first season are likely to find this one enjoyable as well.
pros: Strong character dynamics and interactions.
Unique blend of comedy, romance, and historical elements.
Visually appealing art style (though opinions vary).
Enjoyable episodic format for refreshing content.
cons: Lack of an overarching plot can make the series feel aimless.
Inconsistent humor, with some jokes falling flat or relying on references.
Questionable age gap in romantic elements.
Fan service detracts from the overall quality for some viewers.

anime.title: Ankoku Cat
anime.synopsis: Dark Side Cat, a mysterious stray cat, dashes throughout the night city in punk clothing and plays pranks on humans he dislikes. He plays a game of cat and mouse with the city council, known as the "Stray Cat Hunt."
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Ankoku Cat' is viewed as a lighthearted and amusing series of shorts, but its lack of focus and inconsistent execution prevent it from being truly outstanding. Viewers appreciate the unique art style and comedic moments, but criticize the underdeveloped characters and occasionally weak storylines. The audience generally finds the show enjoyable for its short length and easy-to-watch format, without significant polarization.
pros: Fast-paced and enjoyable short episodes.
Catchy music that sets the mood.
Unique and stylized art style reminiscent of western animation.
Enjoyable comedic moments.
cons: Inconsistent story focus and wasted time in some episodes.
Underdeveloped characters and wafer-thin backstory.
Generic and uninspired action shots.
Questionable animation quality.

anime.title: Mouryou no Hako: Chuuzenji Atsuko no Jikenbo - Hako no Yurei no Koto
anime.romaji_title: Mouryou no Hako: Chuuzenji Atsuko no Jikenbo - Hako no Yurei no Koto
anime.synopsis: A side story that reveals the investigative notes that Atsuko, the younger sister of the main character Akihiko Chuzenji, wrote about the brutal dismembering incidents in the main story.
anime.consensus_summary: The special episode aims to clarify the complex narrative of the main series by offering a recap through Atsuko's perspective. While some appreciate its nostalgic elements and integration within the main story's timeline, others find it insufficient in resolving comprehension issues and criticize its disjointed presentation and brevity. Ultimately, its helpfulness appears limited for those already struggling with the original series.
pros: Provides a summary of the main series from a different perspective.
Reuses characters and soundtracks, creating a nostalgic feel.
Integrates into the timeline of the main story, enhancing realism.
cons: May not significantly improve understanding of the original series.
Feels disjointed and 'all over the place'.
Short length may limit its effectiveness.

anime.title: Durarara!!
anime.synopsis:
In Tokyo's downtown district of Ikebukuro, amidst many strange rumors and warnings of anonymous gangs and dangerous occupants, one urban legend stands out above the rest—the existence of a headless "Black Rider" who is said to be seen driving a jet-black motorcycle through the city streets.

Mikado Ryuugamine has always longed for the excitement of the city life, and an invitation from a childhood friend convinces him to move to Tokyo. Witnessing the Black Rider on his first day in the city, his wishes already seem to have been granted. But as supernatural events begin to occur, ordinary citizens like himself, along with Ikebukuro's most colorful inhabitants, are mixed up in the commotion breaking out in their city.
anime.consensus_summary: Durarara!! is a mixed bag for viewers. Some appreciate its unique blend of genres, complex plot, and well-developed world, finding it refreshing and captivating. However, others criticize its slow pacing, weak character development, and subpar animation, making it a frustrating watch for some.
pros: Unique and refreshing with distinct personalities
Well-developed, complex, and mature plot that keeps your attention
Captures the chaos and mystery of the city
cons: Pacing issues, slow starts, and hard-to-follow flashbacks
Nonexistent character development and bland introductions
Dialogue is unsubtle, anvilicious, and pretentious
Animation quality is lacking with dull colors and expressionless faces
anime.thematic_vibe: Urban Fantasy, Gang Warfare, Supernatural Mystery

anime.title: Dance in the Vampire Bund
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Romance, Seinen, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
On live television, Mina Tepes, the ruler of all vampires, reveals the existence of her species to the world and states her plan to build a sanctuary in Japan for vampires, called the Vampire Bund. Using her family's wealth to pay off the nation's debt, they have agreed to let her build this safe-haven for her fellow creatures of the night. But not everyone is so easily swayed by Mina's influence, as her announcement brings about conflict with humans who believe that the queen's quest for peace is a façade.

Akira Kaburagi does not believe in vampires and gets uneasy whenever they are brought up, although he has yet to realize why. Apart from suffering a head injury a year ago, he lives on blissfully until he meets Mina. She triggers within him memories of a life he had long forgotten, and he soon begins protecting her without understanding why. But Akira's secret is far stranger than he could have ever thought possible—he discovers that he is a werewolf, sworn from birth to protect the vampire queen, even if it costs him his life. Now, as these two dance a rondo of death in the Vampire Bund, Mina and Akira find out just how deep their bond goes.
anime.consensus_summary: Dance in the Vampire Bund receives mixed reactions, with some viewers praising its unique take on vampire lore, art style, and character development. However, many criticize its disjointed story, poor adaptation of the manga, and uncomfortable content. The anime is considered divisive with a clear split between those who enjoyed it and those who found it to be a disappointment.
pros: Unique vampire lore utilization.
Visually appealing art and animation, especially in the Blu-ray version.
Well-developed characters with complex relationships.
Interesting story and world-building.
cons: Choppy and disjointed storyline with plot holes.
Poor adaptation of the manga.
Uncomfortable sexualization of a childlike character.
Forgettable soundtrack.
Rushed pacing and incomplete ending.

anime.title: Armed Librarians: The Book of Bantorra
anime.romaji_title: Tatakau Shisho: The Book of Bantorra
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Fantasy, Super Power
anime.synopsis: In a world where dead people turn into books and are stored in the Bantorra Library where anyone who reads a book can learn their past, Bantorra Library is maintained by Armed Librarians who wield psychic powers and their enemy is a religious society known as Sindeki Kyoudan.
anime.consensus_summary: Tatakau Shisho: The Book of Bantorra is a unique anime with a complex story and intriguing characters, but suffers from a messy narrative and underwhelming conclusion. While some appreciate its originality and philosophical themes, others find it confusing and frustrating. Overall, it is a decent watch, but not without its flaws.
pros: Original story and unique world-building.
Complex characters with detailed backgrounds and motivations.
Intriguing plot twists and unpredictable narrative.
Well-executed animation and fight scenes.
Enjoyable OST and fitting background music.
cons: Confusing and directionless story at times.
Messy narrative structure with unresolved plot lines.
Underwhelming conclusion and reliance on deus ex machina.
Generic and uninteresting characters (except for a few exceptions).
Inconsistent character development.

anime.title: Broken Blade
anime.romaji_title: Break Blade Movie 1: Kakusei no Toki
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Fantasy, Mecha, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Rygart Arrow is different compared to the other people in the continent of Cruzon: he is unable to control quartz, branded an "un-sorcerer." Despite this, he still befriends the future king and queen of Krisna—Hodr and Sigyn—as well as Zess, the younger brother of the Athens Commonwealth's Secretary of War.

Several years later, Rygart discovers that there is a war brewing between Krisna and Athens. While visiting Binonten, the capital city of Krisna, he learns that his misfortune as an un-sorcerer enables him to pilot an ancient Golem, a unique ability that quartz-wielding users lack.

As Zess leads one of the Athenian strikes upon the capital, Rygart joins the battle with his newfound power in hopes of mending the schism between the two nations.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews for 'Break Blade Movie 1: Kakusei no Toki' are mixed. Many appreciate the high-quality animation and action sequences, but some find the story generic and the character development slow. There is also some disappointment due to the lack of emotional connection and rushed plot.
pros: Detailed and fluid animation, especially in battle scenes.
Well-implemented action/military themes with good character development.
High production value with great sound and voice acting.
cons: Generic story with common mecha anime cliches.
Slow character development.
Lack of emotional investment due to numerous, impersonal character deaths.

anime.title: Shakugan no Shana: Season III
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Yuji disappeared the fateful night he was supposed to choose between a life combating evil by Shana's side or as a normal teenager. He returns from near-death to lead the Crimson Denizens in a dubious plot to bring peace to the universe, but Shana isn't fooled. In an explosive reunion, the fiery warrior faces her unlikeliest of foes while Flame Hazes from across the world join forces to ignite a war that will determine the fate of all supernatural kind.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Shakugan no Shana III (Final) is highly divided. While some appreciate the faithfulness to the light novel, strong character development, and exciting plot twists, others criticize the rushed pacing, abundance of new characters, and convoluted storyline. The final season marks a significant departure from the tone and style of the previous seasons, leading to disappointment among some fans.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the light novel series.
Strong character development for Shana and Yuji.
Excellent sound direction, including OP/ED themes and BGM.
Satisfying conclusion to the series.
Unexpected plot twists that keep the story engaging.
cons: Sudden plot twists and character changes that feel unearned.
Pacing issues, with the final season feeling rushed compared to previous seasons.
Overabundance of new characters with little to no backstory.
Too many generic fight scenes with nameless characters.
Decline in romance and slice-of-life elements that were prominent in earlier seasons.
Story becomes convoluted and confusing.

anime.title: Welcome to Irabu's Office
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Avant Garde, Drama, Medical, Psychological
anime.synopsis:
The world of psychology is far from strange to the unusual Dr. Ichirou Irabu, a resident psychiatrist of Irabu General Hospital. He and his charming nurse Mayumi run through several patients, each suffering from a mental illness that harms their everyday life. 

Patients should be wary of the seductive Mayumi, with her spellbinding looks and devilishly short pink nurse uniform. On the other hand, the doctor seems to have three separate personalities: a child with an oversized lab coat; an intelligent, youthful man with feminine traits; and a selfish, outgoing green bear. While curing his patients in questionable ways, Dr. Irabu often tries to gain something from them outside of his profession—and in doing so, occasionally forgets his role as a doctor.

As each patient struggles to face the nature of their distress, an obvious yet invisible thread ties their paths together.
anime.consensus_summary: Kuuchuu Buranko is a polarizing but ultimately appreciated anime due to its distinct visual style and exploration of mental health. While some find the art style off-putting, others praise its uniqueness and how it enhances the show's themes. The episodic nature and comedic elements are also points of contention, but overall, the series is seen as a thought-provoking and worthwhile experience for those open to its unconventional approach.
pros: Unique and experimental art style enhances the show's themes.
Well-developed characters and relatable psychological issues.
Thought-provoking exploration of mental health with an uplifting tone.
cons: Bizarre and unconventional art style may be off-putting to some viewers.
Episodic format can feel repetitive.
Comedy may not appeal to everyone.

anime.title: Black Butler Special
anime.synopsis:
Earl Ciel Phantomhive's Funtom Corporation is sponsoring a charity performance of Hamlet to be shown to a group of poor children as a celebration of its third anniversary. However, when the theater company hired for the stage play is suddenly delayed and won't make it in time for the scheduled performance, the company is faced with a dilemma. With the promise of plenty of press coverage, Ciel must find a way to rectify the situation and commands his butler, Sebastian Michaelis, to ensure the success of the play.

But with a haphazard ensemble of amateur actors—including Ciel, his fiancée Elizabeth Midford, his servants, and many others—how can they possibly put on the show in time?
anime.consensus_summary: The Kuroshitsuji OVA 'Sono Shitsuji, Kougyou' is well-received as a lighthearted and entertaining side story that provides additional screen time for beloved characters. Fans appreciate the humor, character development, and art quality. While it doesn't significantly advance the main plot, it serves as a pleasant and enjoyable addition to the Kuroshitsuji series.
pros: Entertaining side story with comic relief.
Good character development, especially for Ciel and Sebastian.
Gorgeous art and costumes.
Enjoyable and well-done adaptation of 'Hamlet' within the Kuroshitsuji universe.
The OVA retains the humor and atmosphere of the original series.
Offers light fanservice and familiar character interactions.
cons: The plot is simple and mainly focuses on humor rather than drama.
Some characters don't match their roles well.
The music is forgettable.
Doesn’t bring much new in terms of character development or narrative impact.

anime.title: Sound of the Sky
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, Military, Music, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
On the outskirts of the country of Helvetia rests the tranquil town of Seize. Upon its cobbled streets, citizens go about their daily lives, undisturbed by the increasingly tense military relations between Helvetia and the neighboring Roman Empire.

It is under these circumstances that the 1121st platoon of the Helvetian army, stationed at the Clocktower Fortress in Seize, receives a new recruit in the young and spirited Kanata Sorami. Having joined the military to fulfill her dream of learning to play the bugle, she excitedly accepts the tutelage of the Sergeant Major, Rio Kazumiya, who happens to be a skilled trumpeter. Working alongside them are the aloof mechanic, Noël Kannagi, the feisty gunner, Kureha Suminoya, and the compassionate Captain Felicia Heideman; together, they experience the beauty of life in Seize and the lasting joy of a community that has persevered in spite of the crumbling world around them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising its art, character development, and emotional depth, while others criticize its inconsistency, slow pacing, and mishmash of genres.  The 'cute girls in military' theme is divisive, leading to comparisons to other anime like K-On and Girls' Last Tour, but it does not neatly fit in any genre.  Overall, the show has a core of dedicated fans who appreciate its hidden gem status.
pros: Beautiful art and sound design, especially backgrounds.
Well-developed and believable characters.
The story is a slow-burn that is captivating as it progresses from a slice of life into an entity of sadness.
cons: Inconsistency in theme, setting, and plot.
Story takes a long time to develop into anything with real plot substance
Fails to fully commit to slice-of-life or drama elements, ending up as a jumbled mess of ideas

anime.title: Toshi Densetsu Monogatari Hikiko
anime.synopsis:
Story: 3D CG-animated movie about Hikiko, who is a character of a Japanese urban legend. She was violently treated all the time by her parents and classmates at the elementary school and she's extremely ugly due to the constant violence. To revenge, she caught students from elementary school and drag them on the floor until they're badly mutilated.

When Revsersing Hikiko's full name 森妃姫子(Mori Hikiko) gives 引き籠もり(hikikomori), which means Social Withdrawal.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding it a creepy and enjoyable horror anime due to its suspenseful story and atmospheric visuals, while others are critical of the dated CGI, generic characters, and confusing plot. The film effectively uses horror tropes and sound design to create a chilling experience for some, but the technical shortcomings and narrative inconsistencies detract from the overall impact. It evokes a sense of nostalgia for older horror games for some viewers.
pros: Suspenseful storytelling with elements of mystery and horror.
Effective use of sound effects and obscurity to create a dark atmosphere.
Twist ending that some viewers found surprising and well-executed.
Good pacing that balances intense moments with psychological exploration.
cons: Dated CGI animation that resembles older video game graphics.
Generic characters and reliance on common horror tropes.
Inconsistent voice acting with monotone delivery in some scenes.
Story can be confusing, with a nonsensical ending that lacks depth for some viewers.

anime.title: InuYasha: The Final Act
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Love Polygon, Mythology, Romance, Shounen, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Thwarted again by Naraku, Inuyasha, Kagome Higurashi, and their friends must continue their hunt for the few remaining Shikon Jewel shards, lest they fully form into a corrupted jewel at the hands of Naraku. But Naraku has plans of his own to acquire them, and will destroy anyone and anything standing in his way—even his own underlings.

The persistent, unyielding danger posed by Naraku forces Sango and Miroku to decide what is most important to them—each other or their duty in battle. Meanwhile, Inuyasha must decide whether his heart lies with Kikyou or Kagome, before fate decides for him. Amid the race to find the shards, Inuyasha and his brother Sesshoumaru must also resolve their feud and cooperate for their final confrontation with Naraku, as it is a battle they must win in order to put a stop to his evil and cruelty once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience is highly satisfied with InuYasha: Kanketsu-hen, praising its resolution of the original series and improved production quality. Some criticism is directed towards pacing issues and plot complications. However, the emotional resonance and character arcs are generally well-received, leading to a positive consensus.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to the original series.
Improved animation and art style.
Focus on main plot with minimal filler.
Emotional depth and character development (especially Kagome).
Strong voice acting and dubbing.
cons: Rushed pacing in some parts, cutting out key scenes.
Some character deaths lack emotional impact due to pacing.
Plot becomes convoluted towards the end.
Uneven character development, some characters sidelined.
Voice actor changes in the English dub.

anime.title: K-ON! Live House!
anime.synopsis:
It is almost the end of the year, and Houkago Tea Time has been invited to participate in a live house on New Year's Eve! The iconic band members are Yui Hirasawa, the carefree guitarist who is enthusiastic to play music; Mio Akiyama, the shy bassist who gets embarrassed easily; Tsumugi Kotobuki, the gentle and sweet keyboardist who finds joy in normal activities; Ritsu Tainaka, the extroverted drummer who likes to tease Mio; and Azusa Nakano, the rhythm guitarist who is one year younger than the rest but slightly more mature.

Performing in the set gives the girls the rare opportunity to meet various people from different bands, including the one that invited them, Love Crysis. Will Houkago Tea Time be able to delight their audiences successfully?
anime.consensus_summary: The "K-On!: Live House!" OVA is generally well-received as a lighthearted and enjoyable extension of the first season. Fans appreciate seeing the band perform outside of school and the continuation of the series' signature humor and charm. However, some find it lacking in substantial plot development and consider it more of a standard episode rather than a special.
pros: Enjoyable episode that expands beyond the school setting.
Highlights the band's progress since the beginning of the series.
Captures the charm and humor of the original series.
cons: Lacks significant plot or character development.
Some viewers may find it similar to a regular episode rather than a special OVA.
Pacing may feel rushed.

anime.title: xxxHOLiC Rou
anime.synopsis:
Ten years after the events of xxxHOLiC Shunmuki, a melancholic Kimihiro Watanuki has taken over the shop formerly run by the mysterious Yuuko due to a promise he made to her. His companions Maru, Moro, and Mokona live together with him in relative contentment, and some familiar faces arrive every now and then: former rival turned-steadfast friend Shizuka Doumeki, and the former psychic prodigy Kohane Tsuyuri. While Kohane studies folklore under Doumeki at university, they encounter a case that is perfect for the master of the shop.

Eventually, Watanuki receives a visit from Doumeki's grandfather, Haruka. He requests that Watanuki investigates his grandson's dreams. While inside the dream world, he discovers how their past adventures played out from Doumeki's perspective of view, leading Watanuki to discover truths from 10 years ago and secrets about the ties that bind their friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the OVA for its poignant exploration of love, loss, and the passage of time. The melancholic atmosphere and beautiful visuals are well-received, though some find the side story nature and potential spoilers to be minor drawbacks. The overall sentiment is one of quiet admiration for the OVA's emotional depth and artistic presentation.
pros: Captures a lifetime of waiting and devotion in a short time.
Beautiful animation and fitting subdued palette.
Explores themes of memory, loss, and enduring love.
cons: Story is a side story and not part of the main manga storyline.
Yuuko's disappearance can feel like Ghibli-evil-assimilation.
May contain spoilers.

anime.title: Halo Legends
anime.synopsis:
Halo Legends features seven different stories set in the Halo universe, each made by a different studio.

The Babysitter follows the Helljumpers, Orbital Drop Shock Troopers who are sent behind enemy lines to perform an assassination.

The Duel features the tale of an ancient Arbiter who refused to bow down to the Covenant religion. Branded a heretic, he must now face the consequences of his actions.

The Package depicts a group of Spartans, including the Master Chief, who are deployed to infiltrate a Covenant flagship and retrieve a “package” in a secret operation.

Origins shows Master Chief and Cortana stranded following the events of Halo 3, with Cortana summarizing the fall of the Forerunners, the defeat of the Flood, and the rise of humanity as well as the events of the Human-Covenant War.

Homecoming centers on the Spartan Daisy, who reminisces on her past, and the SPARTAN-II project while evacuating UNSC soldiers pinned down by Covenant forces.

Prototype is viewed from the perspective of Marine Sergeant Ghost, who is determined to fight for all he is worth in order to make up for past grievances.

Odd One Out is a non-canon parody of Halo featuring Spartan 1337, who suffers from extremely bad luck.
anime.consensus_summary: Halo Legends receives mixed reviews, with many viewers' enjoyment heavily influenced by their pre-existing appreciation for the Halo franchise. While some episodes are praised for their unique art styles, compelling stories, and expansion of the Halo lore, others are criticized for poor writing, inconsistent animation quality and straying from established canon. Ultimately, Halo Legends seems best suited for dedicated Halo fans seeking to explore the universe further, but may not appeal to newcomers or those critical of deviations from the core game series.
pros: Expands the Halo universe and lore, providing deeper insights into the history and characters.
Offers diverse animation styles and storytelling approaches across different episodes.
Some episodes are praised for their action sequences, emotional depth, and unique artistic vision (e.g., 'Prototype', 'The Babysitter').
cons: Inconsistent quality across episodes, with some considered poorly written, visually unappealing, or non-canon.
Some animation styles (e.g., CGI in 'The Package', watercolor in 'The Duel') are criticized.
Character development is limited due to the short episode lengths.

anime.title: Iron Man
anime.synopsis:
Tony Stark, CEO of a large weapons manufacturer, physicist, engineer, and brilliant inventor, is wounded by shrapnel from one of his own weapons. While held captive by terrorists, he develops the Iron Man Suit  and escapes. From that day on, he vows not to waste his second chance at life and to change the world for the better. For that purpose, he comes to Japan.

In Lab 23 in Japan, great strides have been taken to develop, and build, a unique power station which does not run on fossil fuels, the Arc Station. Stark intends to join this project, and, for that, he is ready to announce his retirement as Iron Man. At the same time, he will also announce the Mass-produced Iron Men, to which he will pass on his duties. However, during the ceremonies, Stark is suddenly attacked by combat mecha belonging to an organization known as Zodiac.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some viewers found the anime entertaining and appreciated the attempt to merge Iron Man with Japanese anime aesthetics, the majority express disappointment. Criticisms target the weak storyline, poor character development of Tony Stark, mediocre animation, and uninspired villains.  Ultimately, the anime fails to impress as a unique or compelling addition to the Iron Man franchise.
pros: Entertaining despite flaws, watchable for Iron Man fans.
Some found the storyline and overall art style enjoyable.
Music and sound are decent enough.
cons: Weak, unoriginal story with predictable plot twists.
Poor character development; Tony Stark is unlikable and inconsistent.
Awkward pacing, convenient solutions, and abrupt scene transitions.
Mediocre animation, especially the 3D models of Iron Man.
Uninspired villains and a nonsensical romantic subplot.
Forced romantic interest and annoying cliches.
Taking place in Japan doesn't make sense.
anime.thematic_vibe: Technological Dystopia, East-Meets-West Disappointment, Unfulfilled Potential

anime.title: Usavich Specials
anime.synopsis: Usavich (ウサビッチ) (from Japanese うさぎ "usagi", rabbit, with "vich" giving it faux Russian flavor) is a series of animated short films being produced for MTV Japan by Kanaban Graphics. It's about an odd couple of rabbits imprisoned in a Russian prison. While the first season (1-13 eps) shows the absurd everyday occurrences of the two rabbits' prison life, the second season (14-26 eps) tells the adventures of their escape and life on the run.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally disappointed. The special episodes fail to connect with the main storyline, leading to confusion. The element of surprise is appreciated initially, but the payoff lacks logical consistency, resulting in an unsatisfying experience.
pros: Surprise element in the show's unfolding.
cons: Lack of connection to the main episodes.
Simple conclusion after the reveal of each element.
Illogical character decisions.
Confusion instead of amusement.

anime.title: Deadman Wonderland
anime.genres: Action, Gore, High Stakes Game, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Supernatural, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
It looked like it would be a normal day for Ganta Igarashi and his classmates—they were preparing to go on a class field trip to a certain prison amusement park called Deadman Wonderland, where the convicts perform dangerous acts for the onlookers' amusement. However, Ganta's life is quickly turned upside down when his whole class gets massacred by a mysterious man in red. Framed for the incident and sentenced to death, Ganta is sent to the very jail he was supposed to visit. 

But Ganta's nightmare is only just beginning. 

The young protagonist is thrown into a world of sadistic inmates and enigmatic powers, to live in constant fear of the lethal collar placed around his neck that is slowed only by winning in the prison's deathly games. Ganta must bet his life to survive in a ruthless place where it isn't always easy to tell friend from foe, all while trying to find the mysterious "Red Man" and clear his name, in Deadman Wonderland.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, acknowledging the anime's intriguing premise and visual style. However, many find the execution flawed due to underdeveloped characters, a rushed narrative, and excessive gore. The incomplete adaptation of the manga is a significant point of criticism, leaving viewers unsatisfied with the ending.
pros: Interesting concept with shock value.
Dark and gruesome artwork reflecting the story's tone.
Potential for a compelling story hinted at in early episodes.
cons: Poor character development, especially the protagonist.
Story feels rushed and incomplete due to adaptation of only a portion of the manga.
Over-reliance on gore and violence overshadows proper storytelling.

anime.title: Spice and Wolf II Specials
anime.romaji_title: Ookami to Koushinryou II: Holo no Short Anime
anime.synopsis: Extra short anime featuring Holo from BD volumes 1 and 2.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the short anime to be cute and enjoyable as a brief, lighthearted watch, mainly driven by the appeal of seeing Holo again. However, it's also viewed as inconsequential fluff with no significant narrative depth or contribution to the overall story. Most viewers don't see any reason to strongly recommend or condemn the shorts.
pros: Nice to see Holo again
Good way to spend about 10 minutes
Art style similar to the main show
cons: Useless fluff
No real story
Doesn't add anything important

anime.title: Ontama!
anime.synopsis: Ichigo is a little girl who is distressed by the failing relationship between her mother and father (who is actually her step-father). After school one day she meets a driver of a magical bus and finds herself taking a ride in the bus. The bus transports her to the past to shortly after her mother and real father met. Perhaps she is meant to do something that will help her parents stay together and love one another further into the future.
anime.consensus_summary: Ontama! is a decent, cute anime with a time-travel plot and zany comedy. However, the story feels rushed, and the plot twist is predictable, limiting emotional investment. While the characters are generally charming, only a few stand out. Ultimately, it's a watchable but not particularly memorable experience.
pros: Cute art style and animation.
Charming characters, especially Ichigo and Yuuji.
Zany comedy with some genuinely funny moments.
cons: Rushed story development, particularly the romance.
Predictable plot twist.
Comedy takes away from the plot, hindering emotional investment.
Forgettable characters (aside from Ichigo and Yuuji).

anime.title: Hakuoki ~Demon of the Fleeting Blossom~
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Historical, Josei, Samurai, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
In 1864 Japan, a young woman named Chizuru Yukimura is searching for her missing father, Koudou, a doctor by trade whose work often takes him far from home. But with no word from him in months, Chizuru disguises herself as a man and heads to Kyoto in search of him. Attracting the attention of ronin, she tries to hide and ends up witnessing a horrifying sight: the ronin being brutally murdered by crazed white-haired men. In a startling turn of events, members of the Shinsengumi arrive to dispatch the creatures. But Chizuru's safety doesn't last long, as this group of men tie her up and take her back to their headquarters, unsure of whether to let her live or silence her permanently.

However, once she reveals the name of her father, the Shinsengumi decide to keep her safe, as they too have been searching for him. But Koudou is more connected to the Shinsengumi than they let on, and soon Chizuru finds herself embroiled in a conflict between the Shinsengumi and their enemies, as well as political tension in Kyoto.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the blend of historical fiction, supernatural elements, and romance, praising the art and action. Others criticize the weak female lead, underdeveloped plotlines, and the potentially overwhelming historical detail.
pros: Interesting historical setting with supernatural elements
Beautiful art and character design
Enjoyable fight scenes
Good integration of romance and historical elements
cons: Weak and passive female protagonist (Chizuru)
Story feels incomplete or rushed
Plotlines not fully developed
Too much focus on historical detail for some viewers

anime.title: Pandora Hearts Omake
anime.synopsis: Pandora Hearts DVD shorts.  Episode list
anime.consensus_summary: The Pandora Hearts Omake is primarily a fan service addition that evokes nostalgia and provides light-hearted comedy for existing fans. It doesn't contribute to the main storyline, and its appeal is limited to those already familiar with the series. While enjoyable for fans seeking more content, it might not impress new viewers or those looking for substantial plot development.
pros: Brings back familiar characters and feelings for fans of the original series.
Provides additional content for fans craving more Pandora Hearts material.
Offers comedic relief and entertainment, contrasting with the main series' drama.
cons: Doesn't add to the main storyline, serving primarily as fan service.
May not appeal to viewers who haven't seen the original series.
Relies on nostalgia and may not hold up for viewers revisiting after a long time.

anime.title: Battle Spirits: Shounen Gekiha Dan
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Isekai, Military, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
Dan Bashin is a spirited teenager known for his aggressive playstyle in the card game Battle Spirits, earning him the title of "Clash King." One day, a mysterious green-haired girl transports him to the otherworldly land of "Grand Rolo," where disputes are settled by card duels.

Upon his arrival, Dan is immediately thrust into a conflict between the kingdom's imperial army and its oppressed natives. There, he learns that he is a prophetic warrior known as a "bearer of cores' light," chosen to save the land from its evil king. Accompanied by a young boy named Zungurii and the eccentric witch Magisa, Dan travels across Grand Rolo and encounters the other chosen warriors through card battles. 

With the name of the Clash King gaining fame throughout Grand Rolo, secrets that lurk within the shadows of the kingdom's colonial past begin to surface. Only time will tell if Dan's campaign will affect the world on a scale much larger than he ever could have imagined.
anime.consensus_summary: Battle Spirits: Shounen Gekiha Dan is viewed positively as a card game anime with surprisingly deep themes. The series is praised for its characters and story, though some find the initial episodes confusing and the CGI dated. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre.
pros: Engaging characters, especially the protagonist Dan
Unique blend of card game mechanics with a deeper narrative.
Thematic exploration of colonialism and oppression in an Isekai setting.
cons: Dated CGI and inconsistent video quality
Potentially confusing initial episodes

anime.title: The Legend of the Strongest General: Romance of the Three Kingdoms
anime.synopsis:
Chinese-Japanese anime adaptation of the "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" classic novel.

Lui Bei embarks on a journey to quell the chaos that plagues his homeland, bringing with him his sworn brothers, Zhang Fei and Guan Yu. With only a small army and no land Lui Bei is forced to take a subservient role to other Generals, in order to keep him safe from those who continually come after his life.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a faithful adaptation of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, appreciated for covering the entire story. However, it suffers from a rushed narrative and limited availability. The audience is generally positive but laments the difficulty in accessing the series.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms novel.
Covers the entire story to the end.
Good animation and sound quality.
cons: Story feels rushed.
Difficult to find and not available for purchase on DVD.

anime.title: Jungle Emperor Leo
anime.romaji_title: Jungle Taitei: Yuuki ga Mirai wo Kaeru
anime.synopsis:
Earth, sometime in the 21st century. Because of non-stop environmental destruction, the United Nations commissions a private company, "Eternal Earth," to create an artificial jungle, to be a nature preserve and to protect animals. All wild animals are forced to live in it.

The animals that live in this "neo-jungle" have an easy life. Leo, son of Panja, is born in this artificial world. Because of the unrealistic nature of the neo-jungle, Leo lives his life like he hasn't a care in the world. But Leo is ridiculed by the other animals; they call him a coward—he is not like his father, the great Jungle Emperor, but Leo vows that some day he will be.

Kenichi, son of the Eternal Earth company's CEO, has no doubt about the great success of the neo-jungle. The story starts when Leo and Kenichi meet. Kenichi has the special ability to understand what the animals are saying.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is seen as a decent homage to the original series, updating the story with modern environmental themes.  The animation is praised, while the story is considered somewhat underdeveloped, especially in terms of character arcs. Overall, the reception is mildly positive, primarily driven by nostalgia and appreciation for the updated themes.
pros: Enjoyable comedy and drama moments.
Good relationship between Leo and Kenichi.
Great animation art.
cons: Story could have been better with more character development on leading characters (Leo and Kenichi).

anime.title: Wolverine
anime.synopsis: Logan learns that his girlfriend, Mariko Yashida, who disappeared a year ago, has been taken to Tokyo by her father Shingen, who is the head of a Japanese crime syndicate and a supplier of AIM. He then decides to head to Japan to find her and take her back, no matter what.
anime.consensus_summary: The Wolverine anime adaptation is largely viewed as a disappointment, failing to capture the essence of the character and delivering a predictable and uninspired story. While the animation has some merits, the poor character development, weak plot, and forgettable soundtrack contribute to a generally negative reception. Fans of Wolverine may find some novelty in seeing him in anime form, but most agree that it doesn't live up to the source material.
pros: Visually appealing animation style.
Some fight scenes are decent and worth watching.
Inclusion of characters like Omega Red is appreciated by some fans.
cons: Story is predictable and lacks surprises.
Wolverine's character is poorly portrayed and lacks his signature traits.
Romance angle feels forced and unconvincing.
Female characters are underdeveloped and stereotypical.
Soundtrack is uninspired and repetitive.
Action scenes are average and lack impact.
Fails to capture the essence of Wolverine's character and world.
Animation shortcuts and cheap tricks are noticeable.
anime.thematic_vibe: Superhero Romance, Japanese Crime, Damsel Rescue

anime.title: X-Men
anime.synopsis: The X-Men are reunited following the death of a teammate, and are summoned by Charles Xavier to Japan following the abduction of Hisako Ichiki (Armor). There, they confront the U-Men, a lunatic cult that steals and transplants mutant organs to further strengthen their own army, and the battle for justice is on.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some enjoying the animation and character designs, especially for longtime X-Men fans. However, many find the story weak, characters underdeveloped, and the plot melodramatic. The series is considered a decent but flawed adaptation, not living up to its potential.
pros: Faithful character designs to comics and movies
Fluid and exciting animation, especially in fight scenes
Strong voice acting, particularly for Wolverine and Beast
cons: Weak or rushed plot
Underdeveloped characters, especially villains
Inconsistent character power levels
Poor integration of Dark Phoenix Saga
Generic or cliche music
Melodramatic plot

anime.title: Blade
anime.synopsis: The story revolves around Blade, a "Daywalker" vampire hunter who was born with vampire and human blood after a vampire attacked his mother. While visiting Japan on a mission, Blade tracks down Deacon Frost, the vampire who killed his mother. Blade confronts "Existence," a mysterious organization composed of vampires modified by Frost.
anime.consensus_summary: The Blade anime adaptation receives mixed reviews. While the animation and character designs are praised, the repetitive plot, weak action sequences, and inconsistent character motivations disappoint many viewers. The series is considered a mediocre attempt to translate the Blade universe into anime, lacking the depth and excitement of the source material.
pros: Good art style and animation quality by Madhouse.
Action is high-octane, and some episodes are graced with the return of Logan and Kikyo
Some depth to main characters like Blade, Makoto and Noah Van Helsing
cons: Repetitive plot structure with Blade chasing Frost in various locations.
Inconsistent character motivations, particularly Frost's.
Weak action scenes and uninspired fight choreography.
Generic rock music theme that doesn't fit the tone.
Many elements from the show feel cliched and over-the-top

anime.title: Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works
anime.romaji_title: Fate/stay night Movie: Unlimited Blade Works
anime.synopsis:
In Fuyuki City, the Fifth Holy Grail War is about to commence a lengthy battle of blood, death, and misery. High school student Rin Toosaka has trained her entire life for this moment—to become a magus capable of being a Master in the war. Summoning her Servant known as Archer, Rin finally sets foot into the battle.

Discovering that one of her acquaintances, Shirou Emiya, is drawn into the war as well, Rin offers to form an alliance for the time being. And as the two of them grow closer, Rin begins to learn more about Shirou's fate and ideals. Nevertheless, her goal remains the same: to win the all-powerful relic that can fulfill the wishes of those who are victorious after the war—the Holy Grail.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Unlimited Blade Works' movie is largely considered a failure, especially by fans of the Fate/Stay Night franchise. Critics generally agree that the movie tries to cram too much content into a short runtime, resulting in a confusing and poorly developed narrative. While the animation in fight scenes is a highlight, this is overshadowed by the film's other shortcomings, leading to widespread disappointment.
pros: Spectacular fight scene animation and effects.
Voice acting is generally well-received.
Faithful to the visual novel's events in some respects.
cons: Narrative is almost non-existent; plot makes little sense.
Poor character development; characters feel random.
Story is rushed and assumes prior knowledge of the franchise.
Significant cuts to plot and context due to time constraints.
Inconsistent animation quality; poor production values.
Fails to adapt the story effectively, resulting in a confusing and disjointed experience.

anime.title: Eden of The East Compilation: Air Communication; Higashi no Eden Recap
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis: A re-editing of the 11 television episodes of Higashi no Eden.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the 'Air Communication' recap for clarifying details and offering additional insights into the original series. However, some find certain character behaviors unexplained and some commentary disjointed. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile addition for those seeking deeper understanding, despite a few drawbacks.
pros: Provides extra information and answers questions about the original series.
Explains details and complex aspects of the series.
Offers insight into the characters' emotions and thoughts.
Reveals the reasons behind the Seleçãos' actions and motives.
cons: Takizawa's actions remain unexplained and confusing.
Satoshi's character is annoying and detracts from the experience.
Some commentary doesn't align with scenes shown.
Ending is disappointing.

anime.title: Kemono to Chat
anime.synopsis: Chacha Kenomoto wants nothing more than to be an ordinary high schooler, but she is hiding a secret—she can speak to cats. Often crass and rude, the cats around the neighborhood enjoy disrupting Chacha's day by following her everywhere she goes. While Chacha struggles to dodge the community cats' never-ending antics, her best friend Mito Azuma struggles to understand why Chacha believes her gift is more of a curse.
anime.consensus_summary: Kemono to Chat is a short OVA that relies heavily on crude humor and chaotic situations involving cats. While some appreciate the voice acting, animation, and character designs, the repetitive nature of the skits and the underutilization of certain plot points leave much to be desired. Overall, it is considered an okay watch, but may not appeal to those seeking a cute or wholesome cat-themed anime.
pros: Voice acting
Wacky animation style
Character designs
cons: Repetitive skits
Crude humor may not appeal to all cat lovers
Underutilized potential with big cats

anime.title: Toriko: Jump Super Anime Tour 2009 Special
anime.romaji_title: Toriko: Jump Super Anime Tour 2009 Special
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Gourmet, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Special shown at the Jump Super Anime Tour in 2009.

In a world where the taste and texture of food is extremely important, there exist individuals known as Bishoku-ya (luxury food providers) who specialize in the acquisition of rare ingredients and animals. Toriko is one of these hunters and it is his dream to find the most precious foods in the world and create the ultimate dinner course. As one of the most skilled hunters in the world he is regularly hired by restaurants and the rich to seek out new ingredients and rare animals.

A man with inhuman ability, he utilizes his incredible strength and knowledge of the animal kingdom to capture ferocious, evasive and rare beasts to further his final goal, the ultimate dinner course composed of the most delicious food in the world. He is currently accompanied by a weak and timid chef who, inspired by Toriko's ambition, travels with him to improve his culinary skills and find rare ingredients.
anime.consensus_summary: The Toriko pilot is generally well-received as a good introduction to the world and characters of the manga.  Viewers appreciated the unique premise, art style, and voice acting. Some criticism is directed towards the pilot's limited explanation for new viewers and some annoyance towards a side character. Overall, the pilot successfully generates interest in the Toriko series, although the later anime adaptation deviates from the tone of the pilot.
pros: Original concept of hunting monsters for food is appealing.
Art and animation are well-done, especially the coloring and details.
Voice acting and music effectively capture the mood of the scenes.
Toriko is a likable and courageous protagonist.
cons: Pilot episode may not fully explain the premise for newcomers.
Some find the sidekick character, Komatsu, annoying initially.
Pilot was made in 2009, while the anime series was not released till 2011, thus being 3 years.
The pilot is viewed as a rough draft with differences in the final product.

anime.title: Gintama: Jump Festa 2008 Special
anime.synopsis:
According to Aniplex, a 10min short anime of Gintama "Shiroyasha Koutan" will be released on September 30th. It was shown at Jump Super Anime Tour 2008 and had never been released as a DVD.

It's a trailer of an imaginary Gintama movie. Gintama OVA shown at Jump Anime Tour '05 is also included in the DVD.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, especially among existing Gintama fans who appreciate the show's trademark humor and self-awareness. While some viewers may be disappointed by the trolling aspect and lack of substantial backstory, most find the short to be an entertaining and well-executed addition to the Gintama series. The high production value and effective use of music are also frequently praised.
pros: Excellent animation quality, especially in the 'Shiroyasha' segment.
Successfully captures both the serious and comedic aspects of Gintama.
Effective use of music, particularly the 'Donten' opening theme.
cons: The short is essentially a troll, which may disappoint viewers expecting a serious backstory.
Relies heavily on pre-existing knowledge of Gintama, making it less accessible to newcomers.
The abrupt shift from serious to comedic can be jarring for some viewers.

anime.title: Bakemonogatari Recap
anime.synopsis: Koyomi Araragi started to be drawn to others with supernatural difficulties some time after his fateful encounter with a vampire. Reflecting on his first encounters with Hitagi Senjougahara and Mayoi Hachikuji, Araragi appreciates the journey he has taken to arrive where he is, and the relationships he has formed along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The Bakemonogatari recap is well-received, especially for its artistic style and character depth. While some find the dialogue and pacing challenging, the recap effectively highlights key plot points and serves as a good introduction or refresher for the series. The voice acting and incorporation of supernatural elements are also appreciated.
pros: Artistic and unique visual presentation
Deep character personalities and development
Well-done script writing and dialogue
cons: Dialogue-heavy, potentially bloated conversations
Trippy style can be drawn out and weird
Music not particularly memorable

anime.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 3D: Bonds Beyond Time
anime.romaji_title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! Movie: Chou Yuugou! Toki wo Koeta Kizuna
anime.genres: Adventure, Shounen, Strategy Game, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
While riding with Jack Atlas and Crow Hogan, Yuusei Fudou's Stardust Dragon is captured by Paradox, a mysterious Turbo Duelist from the future, during a Turbo Duel and turned into a Sin Monster. With the help of the Crimson Dragon, Yuusei chases after Paradox as he enters a time slip, ending up in the past. During this time, Paradox duels against Jaden Yuki, who is still able to use the powers of Yubel and The Supreme King. However, by this time Paradox had also captured Cyber End Dragon and Rainbow Dragon and overwhelms Jaden. He is saved thanks to Yuusei and the Crimson Dragon. Jaden informs Yuusei of Paradox's true intentions. By stealing various monsters from across time and turning them dark, he plans to kill Maximillion Pegasus, the creator of Duel Monsters, preventing the game from being created and causing the events of all three series to never happen.

Yuusei and Jaden agree to pursue Paradox, which leads them to the past and causes a meeting with the King of Games, Yuugi Mutou. However, by the time Yuusei and Jaden arrive, Paradox had already attacked his time, supposedly killing both Pegasus and Yuugi's grandpa, and had also managed to steal Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Red-Eyes Black Dragon. After explaining everything to Yuugi, he agrees to fight with Yuusei and Jaden against Paradox in the ultimate three-on-one duel to free the trapped monsters and save both the world and time itself before it's too late.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is split on this Yu-Gi-Oh! movie, with dedicated fans appreciating the much-hyped crossover of the three main protagonists and the nostalgic elements. However, critics widely pan the nonsensical, rushed plot and underdeveloped characters, particularly the villain, despite acknowledging the improved animation and art style.
pros: The crossover nature of bringing together the three main protagonists (Yugi, Jaden, Yusei) is a major draw for fans and is considered entertaining.
The animation and art style are generally praised, with vibrant colors and well-animated monsters and effects, often seen as a step up from previous movies.
The inclusion of iconic monsters and themes from each series, along with the original voice actors, appeals to nostalgic fans.
For dedicated fans, the movie provides an enjoyable experience, especially the final duel and the concept of the heroes teaming up.
cons: The plot is widely criticized as nonsensical, illogical, filled with plot holes, and poorly handled, particularly regarding time travel mechanics.
The pacing is described as rushed, with the movie being too short (under an hour) and ending abruptly, leaving many plot points underdeveloped, especially the villain's backstory.

Characterization is weak, with protagonists remaining one-note and barely interacting, negating the point of the crossover, and the villain (Paradox) is considered dull, one-dimensional, and having a ridiculous/retarded motivation.
Dialogue is described as stilted and bad.
The duel itself, while featuring popular monsters, is seen as bland, uninteresting, predictable, and more of a card showcase than a strategic battle.

anime.title: The Garden of Sinners Chapter 8: Epilogue
anime.synopsis: While walking home, Mikiya Kokutou comes across a familiar sight: Shiki Ryougi standing by a railing amidst the falling snow, just as when he first met her four years ago. While the two talk of their past and shared experiences, Mikiya realizes that something is strange about Shiki; rather, this is not the woman he has come to know, but an entirely different entity that dwells within Shiki's body...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on the epilogue. Some appreciate the philosophical depth and closure it provides to the series, while others find it pretentious, confusing, and lacking in plot. The beautiful animation is generally praised, but the heavy reliance on dialogue is a point of contention.
pros: Beautiful animation, especially the snow.
Provides closure to the series and expands on Shiki's character.
Strong emotional impact through slow dynamism and music.
cons: Overly verbose and repetitive dialogue.
Confusing and raises more questions than it answers.
Lacks plot and feels pointless.

anime.title: Wagnaria!!
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, Seinen, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Due to his love for small, cute things, Souta Takanashi cannot turn childlike Popura Taneshima down when she recruits him to work for Wagnaria, a family restaurant located in Hokkaido. Takanashi takes particular joy in doting on the older Popura, which only fuels her complex over how young she looks. He also quickly learns he must stay on his toes once he meets the rest of his colleagues, including the katana-wielding floor chief Yachiyo Todoroki, the intimidating head chef Jun Satou, the dangerously well-informed and subtly sadistic sous chef Hiroomi Souma, the adamantly lazy manager Kyouko Shirafuji, and the waitress Mahiru Inami who has a "painful" fear of men.

Powered by an eccentric cast, Working!! is a unique workplace comedy that follows the never-dull happenings within the walls of Wagnaria as Takanashi and his co-workers' quirky personalities combine to create non-stop antics, shenanigans, and hilarity.
anime.consensus_summary: Working!! is a lighthearted workplace comedy with a focus on quirky characters and their interactions. While some find the lack of a strong plot and repetitive gags to be a drawback, others appreciate its relatable and humorous portrayal of everyday working life. The show's success largely depends on the viewer's tolerance for episodic content and eccentric character dynamics.
pros: Unique and well-developed characters enhance the show's appeal.
The show's humor and running gags are enjoyable.
The show provides lighthearted and relatable content.
cons: Lack of a strong central plot makes the show feel episodic and uninspired.
Repetitive character interactions and gags can become annoying.
Some characters' behaviors can be frustrating or problematic.
anime.thematic_vibe: Workplace Comedy, Slice of Life, Eccentric Characters

anime.title: Night Raid 1931
anime.synopsis: The year is 1931. The city is Shanghai. Ten years before America will enter World War II, the hydra's teeth planted by the first great global conflict are beginning to germinate. Hatching like spiders, they weave the complex web of plots and conspiracies destined to inevitably draw entire nations to the brink of destruction. Caught in the heart of these webs, desperately seeking to separate lies from truth, is "Sakurai Kikan," an ultra-secret intelligence agency staffed by extraordinarily talented individuals with abilities far beyond those of normal humans. Their duty: to stop the darkest plots and eliminate the greatest threats. But in a city built on intrigue, can even a team of clairvoyants, telepaths and espers stand against the ultimate forces of destiny?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many appreciate the unique historical setting, the blend of espionage and supernatural elements, and the engaging action. However, some find the plot loses its way towards the end, characters lack depth, and the series contains potentially problematic elements. Overall, a flawed but enjoyable watch.
pros: Unique and interesting historical setting (1930s Manchuria).
Good blend of action and intrigue.
Respectful portrayal of historical content, despite fictionalization.
Amazing soundtrack and animation.
cons: Plot becomes shaky and unsatisfying towards the end.
Characters can be clichéd.
Some may find it racist with portrayal of Chinese characters.
Inclusion of long pre-episode history lessons disrupts pacing.

anime.title: Occult Academy
anime.genres: Comedy, Mystery, School, Sci-Fi, Supernatural, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
The story revolves around Maya, the daughter of the former Headmaster of Waldstein Academy, and a time traveling agent Fumiaki Uchida. In the year 2012, the world had been invaded by aliens and time travelers were sent back to the year 1999 in order to find and destroy the Nostradamus Key, which Nostradamus Prophecy foretold as what would bring about the apocalypse. The series then turns to the year 1999, where Maya returns to the Academy with the intention of destroying the Academy by superseding her late father's position as the principal. Her plan was interrupted when she meets Fumiaki and learns of the forthcoming destruction. Despite being distrusting towards Fumiaki, they form a pact to look for the Nostradamus Key.

In order to find the Nostradamus Key, time agents were provided with specially created cell phones. When a user finds an object of interest, by thinking of destroying it and taking a photo, and if the resulting image is that of a peaceful world, then the subject is the Nostradamus Key. Conversely, if the subject is not the Nostradamus Key, then the photo displays destruction. By using the phone, Maya and Fumiaki investigates occult occurrences as they occur in the town.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some enjoyed the art style and initial premise, but many were disappointed by the rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, and weak ending. The series is seen as having potential that was ultimately squandered due to poor execution and pacing. Some viewers found enjoyment in the character interactions and episodic adventures, while others were left unsatisfied by the lack of a coherent and well-developed story.
pros: Unique and detailed art style with expressive characters.
Interesting premise with potential for exploration of occult themes.
Enjoyable character dynamics, particularly between the main characters Maya and Fumiaki.
cons: Rushed plot with too many elements crammed into a short series, leading to underdeveloped storylines.
Inconsistent pacing with filler episodes that detract from the main plot.
Shallow side characters with little to no development.
Ending feels rushed and poorly executed, leaving plot holes and unresolved issues.

anime.title: Blessing of the Campanella
anime.synopsis: The story takes place in a trading city Ert'Aria. Leicester Maycraft is an item engineer belonging to an adventurer guild "Oasis." One night, he is at a party with his friends to see a meteor stream on the rooftop of a chapel. One meteor grazes them and hits the steeple of the chapel. There he finds a secret room and a sleeping girl. The girl wakes up and says "You must be my father!" The encounter with the mysterious girl brings an unexpected adventure to Leicester.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Shukufuku no Campanella" is considered a mediocre and forgettable anime. While the art style and some characters are appreciated, the story is bland, the pacing is slow, and the characters lack depth. Many feel the anime had potential but ultimately failed to deliver a compelling narrative.
pros: Visually appealing art style with soft colors and detailed backgrounds.
Likeable characters, especially Leicester, Carina and the twins (Ritos and Salsa).
Relaxing and calming slice-of-life feel in a fantasy setting.
cons: Bland and unoriginal story with a predictable plot.
Slow pacing with little to no plot development in the first half.
Weak character development for most characters.
Mediocre music and sound.
Rushed ending with unresolved plot points.
anime.thematic_vibe: Generic Fantasy, Slice of Life, Harem

anime.title: Kaidan Restaurant
anime.synopsis: TV Asahi announced a new kids anime "Kaidan Restaurant (Thriller Restaurant)" based on a picture book. Each episode will consist of three stories or "dishes": the appetizer, the main dish, and dessert. The first two "dishes" will deal with an ordinary sixth-grade schoolgirl named Ako Ozara and the bizarre occurrences that befall her classmates. The third "dish" will be a standalone short ghost story told by Ako and her friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive. Reviewers appreciate the show's faithful adaptation of horror stories and its ability to create a creepy atmosphere, especially its use of folklore from around the world. Some find the stories simplistic or unfinished, but the series is generally considered enjoyable for its genre.
pros: Good translation of original material to animation
Variety of stories including Japanese and European folklore
Builds tension effectively without relying on jump scares
Stories have unnerving and emotional moments
Inclusion of folktales and traditional ghost stories
cons: Simplistic stories and one-dimensional characters
Stories can feel unfinished due to time constraints
Visuals may appear dated
Some annoying stereotypical characters

anime.title: Hidamari Sketch x 365 Specials
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Slice of Life, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis: Special episodes of Hidamari Sketch x 365.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience enjoys the continuation of the show's gentle and heartwarming nature. The return of beloved characters and the inclusion of visually appealing dream sequences are particularly appreciated. There is a strong sense of satisfaction and enjoyment among viewers.
pros: Continuation of established softness
Favorite characters return
Nicely drawn dream sequence
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Comedy, Cute Girls Doing Cute Things

anime.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Great Battle of the Mermaid KIng
anime.romaji_title: Doraemon Movie 30: Nobita no Ningyo Daikaisen
anime.synopsis: Nobita asks Doraemon to take him somewhere they can dive and as a result the robot-cat uses several gadgets to make it possible for both to able to swim on an imaginary ocean above sea level. Inadvertently a mermaid ends up on Nobita's backyard when they turn off the illusion. Her name is Sophia and she is a princess of an ancient underwater civilization. Doraemon, Nobita, Shizuka, Jyaian, and Suneo quickly become her friends and are invited to visit her homeland. While heading towards the underwater kingdom they find themselves amid a conflict between the mermaids and an opposing tribe that has driven them away from their home planet thousands of years ago. Doraemon, Nobita, and their friends must then aid Sophia find a legendary sword that might bring peace once again to the seas.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is criticized for having a confusing and convoluted plot, introducing too many underdeveloped concepts without proper explanation. Reviewers felt that the film superficially touched upon various themes like environmentalism and leadership without delving into them deeply. Overall, the film seems to lack depth and coherence, leading to a less engaging experience.
cons: Confusing plot with too many concepts.
Shallow exploration of themes.
Poorly explained gadgets and events.
Weak antagonist motivation.
Underdeveloped character conflict.

anime.title: The Prince of Tennis: Another Story - Messages From Past and Future OVA Bonus
anime.romaji_title: Tennis no Oujisama: Another Story - Kako to Mirai no Message Specials
anime.synopsis:
Aru Hi no Oshitari
Hyoutei Academy's Yuushi Oshitari is fed up with being the unfunny one in his daily life. He sets out to rectify this by getting himself into an idiotic situation, but his tennis club teammates do not seem to understand what he is doing.

Aru Hi no Oshitari 2
Even though he is supposed to be the humorous one, Kenya Oshitari is concerned that his recent "manzai" jokes have not been landing. Luckily for him, his teammate from the Shitenhouji Middle School tennis team, Hikaru Zaizen, has come to save the day by replacing him as the laughing stock in the jokes.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the comedic and character-focused stories.  The chibi art style and background information on characters were appreciated. Some viewers noted potential confusion regarding different versions of the show and possible issues with understanding the humor due to translation.
pros: Enjoyable comedy with chibi action.
Provides great background history on some main characters.
Entertaining actions that make up for lost jokes through translation.
cons: Some may not understand the Manzai comedy.
Possible confusion with similar titles.
Some jokes or puns might be lost through translation.

anime.title: Buddha: The Great Departure
anime.romaji_title: Tezuka Osamu no Buddha: Akai Sabaku yo! Utsukushiku
anime.synopsis:
In the ancient Shakya Kingdom, King Suddhodhana learns that his wife, Maya, has a curious dream. A white elephant with six tusks enters her body—a sign that their future child, Siddhartha Gautama, is blessed. The wise prophet Master Asita sees the child and foretells that he will become "chakravartin," the ruler of the world.

Meanwhile, young Chapra suffers the injustice of the rigid caste system. When Kosala army marches on Kapilavastu, Shakya's capital, Chapra plays a part in forcing them to retreat. But to escape the life of slavery and give his mother a better life, Chapra joins the Kosala army and swears to rise in the ranks.

As the young Siddhartha grows, he is taught everything he needs to know to inherit the throne. However, Siddhartha has no interest in martial arts or running a kingdom. What he seeks are the truths of the world and the meaning of life itself. Although Kosala's ever-expanding power threatens Shakya, Siddhartha abandons the royal life and ventures into the world to find the enlightenment he desires.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed.
