The plot flows well enough for a Pokemon movie, with a straightforward but effective approach.
The presence of Legendary Beasts (Raikou, Entei, Suicune) is a strong point.
The art design is nice to look at.
Good family movie offering mindless fun.
The titular star, Zoroark, is a strong presence and nice to watch.
Zorua and Zoroark are consistently well-written and animated, saving the film.
Moderately fun battles are present.
cons: The movie is seen as a blatant commercial advertisement with little substance.
Character design is generic and childish.
The soundtrack is uninspired.
Characters fail to evoke empathy or hate.
The villain is a one-dimensional character.
Ash and his companions are reduced to pawns with little agency.
The film feels uninspired and could have been much more.
The main plot is weak and hinges on character personalities.
The location of the final showdown is underwhelming.
The plot is too bland with lame plot twists.
Pokemon battles are boring.
New characters are boring and underdeveloped.
The story is dreadful, underdeveloped, and not well explained.
No character development is made.
Action scenes lack actual action.
It does not leave a feeling of nostalgia.

anime.title: The Secret World of Arrietty
anime.synopsis:
While spending the summer at his aunt's house, the young but sickly Shou makes an amazing discovery: after following the house cat into the bushes, he gets a glimpse of a miniature girl about the size of his finger! Calling her kind "Borrowers," as they survive on tiny bits of human possessions, the girl introduces herself as Arrietty. As he discovers that she lives in the house basement with her parents, Pod and Homily, Shou becomes imaginably excited at the idea of such unique neighbors.

However, he fails to understand the adversities they face on a daily basis. In addition to keeping their existence hidden, they must also embark on perilous adventures into human territory, from the house to the outdoors, in order to make a living. Despite her parents' warnings, Arrietty befriends Shou, stirring up unexpected events that may change their lives forever.

Delighting the eye and conquering the heart, the breath-taking story of a friendship transcending the tensions between two different human kinds begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is largely positive, praising the film's visual beauty, heartwarming story, and charming portrayal of the borrowers. Some viewers find the story simple and slow-paced, wishing for more thrilling elements. Despite minor criticisms, the film is generally well-received as a classic Ghibli offering, emphasizing emotional connection and imaginative world-building.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style, characteristic of Studio Ghibli
Charming attention to detail in portraying the lives of tiny people
Touching story about friendship and understanding between different worlds
cons: Story may lack sufficient thrills or adventure for some viewers
Pacing may be slow for those seeking action-packed narratives
Narrative can feel underdeveloped, with plot threads left unresolved

anime.title: Big Windup! 2
anime.synopsis: Picking up where the original series left off, Ren Mihashi, the ace pitcher of the newly-formed Nishiura High School baseball team, and his teammates face the Sakitama High School team in the next round of the High School Baseball Invitational Tournament as they aim to play in the finals at legendary Hanshin Koushien Stadium.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Ookiku Furikabutte is well-received, particularly for its character development and ability to engage viewers even without prior interest in baseball. While some find the animation lacking and the ending unsatisfying due to its open nature, the series is generally praised for its realistic portrayal of teamwork and the personal growth of its characters. The audience consensus points towards a heartwarming and engaging sports anime experience.
pros: Engaging and involving even for non-baseball fans.
Meticulous character development making characters feel real and authentic.
Good balance of seriousness and comedy.
Improved animation compared to the first season.
cons: May not appeal to those who dislike baseball-focused content.
Animation may be considered jank at times.
The ending feels incomplete due to the limited number of adapted chapters.
Protagonist Mihashi remains too introverted.
anime.thematic_vibe: Teamwork, Character Development, Realistic portrayal of sports

anime.title: Hipira-kun
anime.synopsis: In the city of Salta, a place where the sun never shines, a community of vampires lives. Hipira is a little vampire who lives the life of a typical boy, attending school and dealing with bullies along the way. However, he also has a soft spot for exploring, playing pranks on others and having grand adventures! Whether he's befriending a human soul, scaring his neighbours by pretending day has come or encountering giant frogs and aliens, Hipira is always getting himself into and out of trouble.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Hipira-kun for its charming and nostalgic feel. The series excels in its visual presentation and simple, engaging stories that evoke a sense of childhood innocence. Its main drawbacks are its brevity and limited number of episodes, leaving viewers wanting more.
pros: Visually stunning backgrounds with detailed art and animation.
Unique and subtle use of CG animation for characters, allowing for fluid movement.
Refreshingly simple yet unique story centered around childhood adventures.
Memorable voice acting, especially for Hipira.
cons: Very short episodes (5 minutes each).
Background music is practically nonexistent (though some see this as a pro).
Limited number of episodes.

anime.title: Shiki
anime.genres: Gore, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Shounen, Supernatural, Suspense, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Life is idyllic and unassuming in the small town of Sotoba, a simple place where everyone knows everyone. However, tragedy strikes when Megumi Shimizu, a young girl with high aspirations, unexpectedly passes away from an unnamed illness. Over the torrid summer months, as more unexplained deaths crop up around the village, the town's doctor—Toshio Ozaki—begins to suspect that something more sinister than a mere disease is at play. 

Toshio teams up with Natsuno Yuuki, an apathetic and aloof teenager, and siblings Kaori and Akira Tanaka, two of Megumi's friends, to unravel the dark mystery behind the deaths in Sotoba. With their combined efforts, the investigation leads them toward an eerie secret pertaining to the new family in the Kanemasa mansion.
anime.consensus_summary: Shiki is a divisive anime with a unique premise that explores morality through a vampire narrative. While some appreciate its dark atmosphere and traditional vampire portrayal, others are turned off by the slow pacing, unlikeable characters, and bizarre art style. The show sparks debate about whether it succeeds in its social commentary and thematic depth.
pros: Unique take on vampire lore, avoiding romanticization.
Exploration of human morality and societal breakdown.
Atmospheric setting with detailed world-building.
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the first half.
Unlikable or underdeveloped characters.
Art style may be off-putting to some viewers.

anime.title: Hellsing: Psalm of the Darkness
anime.synopsis: Promotional video for the TV anime. Adapts content from parts of the manga that was not later included in the TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Hellsing: Psalm of Darkness' serves primarily as a promotional piece rather than a standalone work. While some appreciate it as a trailer and a refresher for the original series, many find it disjointed, poorly produced, and ultimately a waste of time. It's mostly seen as a curiosity for existing fans rather than a valuable addition to the Hellsing franchise.
pros: Effective marketing tool for the Hellsing franchise.
Gives a glimpse into what the original series offers without heavy spoilers.
cons: Poor sound design with random noises and disjointed voice acting.
Flashy transitions and poor context blur the already limited animation quality.
Feels like a low-quality AMV with no clear purpose.

anime.title: Detective Opera Milky Holmes
anime.genres: Comedy, Detective, Mystery, Parody, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
"Toys" are powers bestowed upon those chosen to wield them, each having qualities that are unique to their users. Some of these individuals are born pure, using their powers to become detectives. Others bloom laced with poison and choose to become phantom thieves. These two opposing factions caused the formation of various detective academies around the globe—training detectives to fight and catch the phantom thieves.

Sherlock Shellingford, Nero Yuzurizaki, Hercule Burton, and Cordelia Glauca form "Milky Holmes", a group recognized as the cream of the crop in the Yokohama-based Holmes Detective Academy. However, in a skirmish against the phantom thief Arsene, their Toys suddenly disappear, deeming them unfit to continue as detectives. Stripped of their prestigious life and thrown into a rundown attic, they face expulsion if they fail to regain their powers within the next three months.

Tantei Opera Milky Holmes tells the story of a once-legendary group in their journey to recover their Toys, as well as attempting to continue their line of work without the powers that once defined their career.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the show hilarious and enjoyable due to its randomness and parody elements, while others criticize its generic story, mediocre production quality, and inconsistent tone. The show's humor is a major dividing point, with some appreciating the absurd situations and character interactions, while others find it repetitive and uninspired. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on the viewer's tolerance for nonsensical comedy and willingness to overlook the show's flaws.
pros: Unique and hilarious if expectations are discarded.
Enjoyable character interactions and over-the-top scenarios.
Catchy opening song and fun visuals.
cons: Generic story with no real twists or character development.
Mediocre art and animation quality.
Forgettable soundtrack and bland opening/ending themes.
Repetitive humor that may not appeal to everyone.
Inconsistent tone with serious moments clashing with comedic elements.

anime.title: Okami-San and Her Seven Companions
anime.synopsis:
Tomboy Ryouko Ookami is a fierce boxer and the assigned bruiser of her club. Of course, no normal high school club needs a bruiser, but the Otogi Bank operates more akin to an actual bank. Here, the students can ask for favors from the club as long as they promise to return the favor in the future. Sixteen-year-old Ryoushi Morino is a shy boy, a far cry from the Otogi Bank members. To his biggest surprise, after unsuccessfully confessing to Ryouko, he inadvertently finds himself joining the club! 

Ookami-san to Shichinin no Nakama-tachi follows the everyday lives of the Otogi Bank members as they tackle favors that range from the mundane to the dangerous. However, since Ryoushi's sole motivation is to win Ryouko over, she doubts he will be able to have her back in a fight, especially when he can't even stand having people look at him—much less fight anyone!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience finds "Ookami-san to Shichinin no Nakama-tachi" to be a decent but unexceptional anime. While the animation, voice acting, and parody elements are appreciated, the shallow story, underdeveloped characters, and weak ending leave much to be desired. Many feel the series had potential but failed to fully capitalize on its premise and fairy tale references.
pros: Good animation and art style, especially character designs.
Enjoyable and catchy opening and ending themes.
Strong voice acting, particularly the narrator and Ryouko's voice actress.
Parody of tsundere anime tropes is well-executed and humorous.
Warm and innocent tone
cons: Story lacks depth and innovation, relying heavily on clichés.
Narrator can be overbearing and distracting.
Episodic nature prevents deeper character development and plot progression.
Ending is unsatisfying and lacks resolution.
Fairy tale elements are superficial and underutilized.
Rushed plot
Weak drama

anime.title: Futatsu no Kurumi
anime.synopsis: Futatsu no Kurumi is a short story following 12-year-old Ayaka as she is teleported back in time to the fire bombing of Tokyo in 1945 and covers her experiences in this very different and unfamiliar environment.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is deeply moved by 'Futatsu no Kurumi,' praising its powerful depiction of wartime tragedy and its ability to evoke strong emotions. Despite the animation's limitations, viewers find the story incredibly impactful and recommend it to those interested in historical anime. The ending is particularly praised for its bittersweet quality.
pros: Impactful storytelling
Effectively conveys the horrors of war
Bittersweet ending
cons: Low-budget animation

anime.title: Gothicmade: Hana no Utame
anime.synopsis:
On a tiny colony world named Carmine, young women known as Songstresses inherit the generation memories  of those who came before them, using their knowledge to help a populace that suffers under the harsh policies of the ruling interplanetary league.

Newly reborn as a Songstress, 16-year-old Bellin Ajelli sets off a holy pilgrimage across the planet. Rumors of a possible terrorist attack result in Prince Truhallon of the militant Donau Empire being sent in to protect her, but his very presence is the antithesis of everything Bellin stands for. The two are as different as night and day, but they're stuck together until they reach the capital.
anime.consensus_summary: Gothicmade: Hana no Utame is a hard to find and unusual film, connected to the larger Five Star Stories universe. Viewers find it difficult to describe, with a slow plot but unique visual style. The film's inaccessibility has led to inflated scores online from those who haven't seen it.
pros: Connected to The Five Star Stories (for fans)
Unique visual and animation style
cons: Limited availability/screening locations
Plot is slow-paced and 'not much actually happens'
Difficult to describe and articulate the movie's essence

anime.title: The Tatami Galaxy
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Award Winning, Comedy, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Suspense, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
One autumn evening at a mysterious ramen stand behind the Shimogamo Shrine, a lonely third-year college student bumps into a man with an eggplant-shaped head who calls himself a god of matrimony. Meeting this man causes the student to reflect upon his past two years at college—two years bitterly spent trying to break up couples on campus with his only friend Ozu, a ghoulish-looking man seemingly set on making his life as miserable as possible. Resolving to make the most out of the rest of his college life, the student attempts to ask out the unsociable but kind-hearted underclassman Akashi, yet fails to follow through, prompting him to regret not living out his college life differently. As soon as this thought passes through his head, however, he is hurtled through time and space to the beginning of his years at college and given another chance to live his life.

Surreal, artistic, and mind-bending, Yojouhan Shinwa Taikei chronicles the misadventures of a young man on a journey to make friends, find love, and experience the rose-colored campus life he always dreamed of.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Yojouhan Shinwa Taikei. Some viewers praise its unique storytelling, artistic style, and exploration of deep themes like choices and self-discovery, considering it a masterpiece. However, others criticize its repetitive nature, fast-paced dialogue, and perceived pretentiousness, finding it lacking in substance and difficult to follow.
pros: Unique storytelling and art style.
Exploration of choices and self-discovery.
Masterful execution of a realistic story.
cons: Repetitive and predictable plot.
Fast-paced and verbose dialogue.
Obnoxious visuals and vapid story (subjective).

anime.title: K-ON! Season 2
anime.genres: Award Winning, CGDCT, Comedy, Music, School
anime.synopsis:
It is the new year, which means that the senior members of the Light Music Club are now third-years, with Azusa Nakano being the only second-year. The seniors soon realize that Azusa will be the only member left once they graduate and decide to recruit new members. Despite trying many methods of attracting underclassmen—handing out fliers, bringing people into the clubroom, and performing at the welcoming ceremony—there are no signs of anyone that plans to join.

While heading to the clubroom, Azusa overhears Yui Hirasawa say that the club is fine with only five people and that they can do many fun things together. Changing her mind, she decides that they do not need to recruit any members for the time being. 

K-On!! revolves around the members of the Light Music Club as they experience their daily high school life. From rehearsing for concerts to just messing around, they are ready to make their last year together an exciting one!
anime.consensus_summary: K-On!! is a polarizing slice-of-life anime, celebrated for its cute characters, high production values, and heartwarming portrayal of friendship. Some viewers find it emotionally resonant and relatable, while others criticize its simple plot, overemphasis on 'moe', and lack of substantial musical content. Despite mixed opinions, it remains an influential series in the 'cute girls doing cute things' subgenre.
pros: Characters are charismatic and friendly, showcasing true friendship.
Delivers a satisfying emotional experience with lighthearted humor.
High production quality, especially animation by Kyoto Animation.
Exploration of character development is thorough.
Relatable story about high school experiences and growing up.
cons: Plot can be perceived as simple or non-existent.
Focus shifts away from music in the second season.
Overreliance on 'moe' elements may not appeal to all viewers.
Some find it repetitive, with similar episodes and interactions.
Lack of substantial music content given the initial premise.

anime.title: Ring ni Kakero 1: Shadow-hen
anime.synopsis: After defeating Black Shaft's makeshift Team America, the Golden Japan Jr. team returns to training for the World Tournament that will be held in Tokyo. But during training the Shadow Clan, which uses boxing as an assassination technique, kidnaps Kiku in order to lure Ryuji and the others into a fight to see who's truly the better representatives of Japan's junior boxers.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds Ring ni Kakero 1: Shadow-hen to be a decent, albeit generic, shonen anime.  The sound design is a highlight, but the story and characters are considered stereotypical. Overall, it's seen as a good way to pass the time, especially for fans of classic shonen anime.
pros: Enjoyable despite being generic
Great sound design, especially fight themes
cons: Generic shonen story
Stereotypical characters

anime.title: Baka & Test: Christmas Special
anime.romaji_title: Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu: Mondai - Christmas ni Tsuite Kotae Nasai
anime.synopsis: The cast of Baka to Test all get together and tell us what Christmas means to them. Joy!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience found this short uninspired and repetitive, with most reviewers agreeing that it was a dull watch. While it offers a brief glimpse of familiar characters, the lack of original content and identical dialogue patterns for many participants led to a generally negative reception. It's only recommended for the most dedicated fans of the series willing to overlook its significant flaws for a quick dose of the characters.
pros: It's a short watch, only four minutes.
Features characters from the main anime series.
cons: Repetitive dialogue and actions for most characters.
Animation quality is noted as not being as good.
Lacks substance, feeling more like a series of clips than a developed episode.
The premise and execution are described as 'dull' and 'odd'.

anime.title: Yamada's First Time: B Gata H Kei
anime.synopsis:
Most people, including the girl herself, would say that first year high school student Yamada is beautiful and perfect. Despite this, she is working towards a peculiar goal: to have sex with one hundred men by the end of high school.

Trying to put some sense into her head, Yamada's best friend, Miharu Takeshita, points out a major flaw in that plan—she is completely inexperienced with men. However, the reason behind this is that Yamada thinks her lady parts look strange and believes others will judge her for it. As a result, Yamada decides that her first time must be with a fellow virgin, since they will not hurt or scare her. After a fateful encounter, she sets her sights on the shy and average Takashi Kosuda, an aspiring photographer with a heart of gold. 

With contending rivals for his affection and her own raging hormones, Yamada must find ways to seduce Kosuda and take his cherry. However, as she gets closer to Kosuda, she finds herself increasingly enjoying their time spent together.
anime.consensus_summary: B-gata H-kei garners a divided audience, with many praising its unique comedic premise centered around a female-led sexual pursuit and its surprisingly heartwarming romantic undertones. However, a significant portion of viewers find the protagonist unlikeable and the humor overly crass or repetitive, leading to strong opinions both for and against the series.
pros: Unique premise with a female-driven sexual pursuit
Humor derived from awkwardness, misunderstandings, and character interactions
Strong, memorable female protagonist (Yamada)
Surprisingly heartwarming or romantic undertones for an ecchi show
Relatable portrayal of teenage awkwardness and first experiences
Good voice acting, particularly in the Japanese dub
Art style is generally well-done and fits the comedic tone
Can be very funny and entertaining, especially for ecchi/comedy fans
cons: Yamada can be perceived as unlikeable, rude, or bitchy
The plot can be repetitive or predictable, relying heavily on gags
Supporting characters are often underdeveloped or stereotypical
The 'ecchi' elements can be considered gratuitous or distasteful by some
The show's premise, while unique, can lead to shallow or superficial storytelling
Some viewers find the humor crass or overly reliant on sex jokes
The ending and overall character development can be seen as disappointing or unresolved
Censorship can be an issue for some viewers

anime.title: Heaven's Lost Property OVA
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
The gang goes to an indoor swimming pool for some fun in the sun.  As expected, all hell breaks loose when Tomoki goes on one of his perverted missions.

Meanwhile, Nymph is having some issues with the loss of her master and considers asking Tomoki to be her replacement master.

This episode was not aired on TV because it was deemed too dangerous...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception indicates this OVA is a fun, light-hearted addition for existing fans, maintaining the series' comedic ecchi elements. While praised for its consistent production values in art and sound, its narrative depth is questioned, with some feeling it relies too heavily on recycled material. Overall, it's seen as enjoyable bonus content that doesn't break new ground but adds to the fan experience.
pros: Excellent artwork, character art, scenery, and FX, tying in well with the show.
Good sound design, SFX, and voice acting, with specific praise for Brittney Karbowski.
Maintains the series' signature funny and awkward moments.
Good edition to the series, not complete filler, with an enjoyable ending touch.
Fun and light-hearted ecchi-comedy that adds to the overall enjoyment of the show.
cons: Lacks a strong, original storyline, relying heavily on established character dynamics.
The plot for Nymph's arc, while emotionally resonant for one reviewer, is described as having 'not much of a storyline' overall.
Criticized for feeling like a rehash of old clips with minor additions rather than a truly unique OVA experience.
Some viewers might feel it's a waste of time if they are looking for substantial new content.

anime.title: Transformers: Robot Masters
anime.synopsis: In 2004, Optimus Prime is alerted to a disturbance at the gates of Autobot City; a force of Decepticons led by a vicious new enemy, a Tyrannosaurus rex calling himself Megatron!! Autobots and Decepticons from across the eras have converged on this time to clash over the newly-discovered energy source solitarium!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Transformers: Robot Masters' for its action and the novelty of seeing different generations of Transformers characters interacting. The short runtime is seen as a limitation, but the positive aspects outweigh this con for most viewers. The series is considered a fun, quick watch for Transformers fans.
pros: Creative transformation sequences
Exciting team-up attacks
Nostalgic crossover appeal
cons: Short runtime limits depth
Simple plot

anime.title: Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu Specials
anime.romaji_title: Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu Specials
anime.synopsis: The candid shots of Muttsurini's female and male classmates that fund his surveillance habits.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys these specials as short, entertaining clips that capture the essence of the original series. They are best suited for fans already familiar with the characters and running gags. Some find the content repetitive or inconsequential, but overall, the specials are seen as a pleasant addition for those who appreciate the humor and style of 'Baka and Test'.
pros: Fun little clips and tidbits
Same animation style, jokes, and charm as the original anime series
Good way to get a bit of extra content if you like the anime
cons: May not be enjoyable if you haven't seen the series
Characters mostly remain stagnant

anime.title: My Sister Momoko
anime.romaji_title: Momoko, Kaeru no Uta ga Kikoeru yo.
anime.synopsis:
Momoko, who attends a special school, is both mentally and physically disabled. Every morning she becomes peevish because she can't go to the ordinary school with her twin brother Riki. Her family soothes Momoko by singing her favorite song "The Song of Frogs."

One day, Momoko shouts encouragement to Riki who's playing dodgeball at an open classroom day and Riki's team wins the game. Ryuji, whose team lost the game, is not impressed and demands that Riki stop bringing his 'idiot sister' to school. Riki totally loses control and hits Ryuji with all his might.

The following year, an experiment in integrated education is implemented and Momoko begins to attend Riki's school. Unfortunately, her physical condition takes a turn for the worse and she's sent to a hospital. Riki and all her classmates want to cheer her up and they set a goal of winning a relay race so that they would be able to tell Momoko the good news. Meanwhile, the fastest sprinter, Ryuichi, insists that he won't be taking part in the race.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is overwhelmingly positive, finding the film to be a deeply moving and heartwarming portrayal of a disabled girl and her relationships. Despite criticisms regarding dated animation and occasional pacing issues, viewers are deeply touched by the film's emotional core, realistic characters, and its strong themes of acceptance and perseverance. Many reviewers highlight the film's tear-jerking qualities and its ability to promote empathy and understanding.
pros: The movie effectively portrays the struggles and triumphs of a disabled child and those around her.
Characters are well-developed and realistic, showing growth and depth.
The story promotes themes of acceptance, tolerance, and the importance of friendship.
cons: Animation quality is dated and may appear cheap or inconsistent at times.
Voice acting can be uneven, with some characters being stilted or unconvincing.
Pacing issues and forced drama elements are present, disrupting the flow of the story.

anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood 4-koma Theater
anime.synopsis: Short specials from the DVDs/BDs.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys the 4-koma theater as a lighthearted and funny addition to the Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood series, especially for fans who miss the characters. However, some find certain jokes and the animation style to be lacking, and a few are critical of the inappropriate humor that does not align with the original series. It is recommended for those who have already experienced the main series due to spoilers.
pros: Nice to see the characters again in a lighthearted way.
Humorous parodies of significant events.
Helps with the sadness after finishing the main series.
Entertaining and worthwhile for what it is.
Good for filling the void after finishing the main series.
cons: Some jokes don't hit.
Animation is simple and doesn't put much effort.
Recurring sexual assault gag is inappropriate and doesn't match the tone of the original series.
Contains spoilers for those who haven't watched/read the main series.

anime.title: Pachislo Kizoku Gin
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, High Stakes Game, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Ginya Otonashi is a college dropout who works part-time for a pachislot publishing company while aspiring to become a novelist. One day, Ginya comes across a secret organization and gets pulled into a competition to become #1 in "Pachi Battle," which is all a part of the Slotseum, a pachislot competition.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds 'Pachislo Kizoku Gin' to be a surprisingly engaging and unique anime, despite its low production quality and questionable themes. It's appreciated for its creative premise and adherence to classic shonen tropes, but criticized for its poor pacing and potential glorification of gambling. Overall, viewers are more intrigued than disappointed, charmed by its obscurity and oddness.
pros: Unique premise makes pachislot engaging.
Story maintains consistent quality and hits classic sports anime tropes.
Charming characters and everyday slice-of-life situations.
cons: Thinly veiled glorification of gambling addiction.
Strange, uncharacteristically convenient character motivations.
Busted plot pacing.

anime.title: Chi's Sweet Home: Chi to Kocchi, Deau.
anime.romaji_title: Chi's Sweet Home: Chi to Kocchi, Deau.
anime.synopsis: Chi meets someone new at the park and tries to befriend him.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the show incredibly cute and wholesome, appreciating Chi's personality and her interactions with a new kitten. There's a slight concern for the new kitten's well-being. The short episode length is a minor drawback.
pros: Incredibly cute and wholesome.
Chi's naive and sweet personality is consistent.
The interaction between Chi and the new kitten is fun.
cons: The reviewer expresses concern over the new kitten likely being without a home.
The episode is only 13 minutes long.

anime.title: The Laws of the Sun
anime.romaji_title: Taiyou no Hou: El Cantare e no Michi
anime.synopsis: The second title in the series of anime films by the Happy Science religion.
anime.consensus_summary: The film is appreciated for its technical aspects like visuals and voice acting, but heavily criticized for its nonsensical and confusing narrative rooted in the Happy Science religion's beliefs. It's seen as an entertaining, albeit bizarre, experience best enjoyed for its absurdity rather than its storytelling quality. Viewers recommend it for those seeking a 'so bad it's good' movie, but caution against expecting a logical or coherent plot.
pros: Surprisingly good art and effects
Good, fitting music
Amazing voice acting, especially Takehito Koyasu
cons: Illogical and confusing story
Poorly developed characters
Not story-driven

anime.title: Armored Trooper Votoms: Phantom Arc
anime.synopsis: For their silver anniversary, Vanilla and Coconna return to Uoodo along with Gotho in the hopes of reuniting with Chirico. Once there they find a red shouldered AT at the Battling arena.
anime.consensus_summary: The Phantom Arc is a nostalgic trip down memory lane for Votoms fans, but it struggles to deliver a compelling narrative. While the return to familiar locations and characters is appreciated, the plot feels derivative and may disappoint those seeking a fresh story. The ending is particularly divisive, potentially harming the legacy of the original series.
pros: Nostalgia for the original series is well-executed.
Revisiting familiar locations evokes positive memories of the original Votoms.
Catching up with old characters is enjoyable for long-time fans.
cons: The plot feels like a rehash of previous events, lacking originality.
Some character arcs are undone or negatively impacted.
The ending may be disappointing or confusing, potentially undermining the original's conclusion.

anime.title: A Certain Scientific Railgun Specials
anime.romaji_title: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun: Motto Marutto Railgun
anime.synopsis: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun specials that were released on the 1st and 5th Blu-ray and DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment for these specials is overwhelmingly positive, with reviewers finding them far more enjoyable and funnier than the main series. While noted as having no bearing on the main plot and being quite random, their parodic nature and humor are highly praised.
pros: Highly enjoyable and superior to the original series in terms of comedy.
Excellent use of references and parodies, including other anime and voice actors.
Funny character interactions and poking fun at character traits.
cons: Has nothing to do with the main storyline.
Content is crazily random and characters' dialogue can seem high.

anime.title: Super Street Fighter IV
anime.synopsis: This OVA will reveal the truth about Juri's evil eye and feature plenty of Cammy and the Dolls.
anime.consensus_summary: The Super Street Fighter IV OVA is visually appealing with well-animated fight scenes, but it suffers from a weak and underdeveloped story. Many feel the plot is stretched thin and lacks substance, making it uninteresting despite its aesthetic qualities. Overall, viewers seem underwhelmed by the narrative but appreciate the animation and sound.
pros: Beautiful and fluid animation
Exciting fight scenes
Good sound and music
cons: Lacking story development
Feels stretched out
Uninteresting plot

anime.title: Nodame Cantabile: Finale - Mine to Kiyora no Saikai
anime.romaji_title: Nodame Cantabile: Finale - Mine to Kiyora no Saikai
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Josei, Music, Performing Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: Violinist Kiyora Miki meets with Shinichi Chiaki, Megumi "Nodame" Noda, and their two friends to visit world-class conductor Franz von Stresemann; upon arriving at his residence in Vienna, they discover that the maestro has escaped to Japan. As they make the most of their wasted trip by visiting important landmarks in the historical capital of classical music, Kiyora has a confession to make: she has not seen her boyfriend Ryuutarou Mine for an entire year and is still busy preparing for an international competition in Paris. Chiaki and Nodame promise to attend the final round, but when the two are back in Paris, they receive an unexpected guest...
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is well-received as a funny and important addition to the overall story. It focuses on character reunions and sets the stage for the final season. The audience enjoys the comedic elements and the progression of the relationships.
pros: Funny episode
Adds to the story

anime.title: Shin Koihime†Musou: Otome Tairan
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis:
The third season of Koihime Musou.

Han's high court general Kashin (何進) was forced to swallow a cursed pill from Chou Jou. The effect is slowly turning her into a cat, which she dislikes. Chou Jou also made use of the emperor's name to dispose her from the Han court as a traitor.

She met Kada during her escape while Kada brought her to the Touka village, whom he believes they would help her.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the series for its lighthearted nature, cute characters, and satisfying ending. However, some criticize its shallow plot, excessive fanservice, and historical inaccuracies. Overall, it's viewed as a fun and entertaining show to pass the time, but not one to be taken seriously.
pros: Story is light and fluffy, easy to watch.
Catchy ending song.
Large cast of cute anime girls.
Satisfying conclusion with everyone living happily ever after.
cons: Too many characters, making it difficult to distinguish them.
Plot is mild and not intellectually stimulating.
Unrealistic portrayal of historical events.
Overreliance on fanservice and male characters being abused for comedic effect.

anime.title: Mai-HiME: Kuro no Mai/Saigo no Bansan
anime.romaji_title: Mai-HiME: Kuro no Mai/Saigo no Bansan
anime.synopsis: Mai invites Reito to go with her to the beach and also says that she prefers him over Tate. But little does he know, that this is actually part of a plan for revenge.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is well-received by fans of the franchise due to its nostalgic and humorous elements. However, it is not recommended for newcomers as prior knowledge of the series is required. The art and animation are praised, but some find the focus solely on humor and the lack of character development disappointing.
pros: Entertaining for fans of the franchise
Beautiful art and smooth animation
Funny and humorous, sort of a parody
cons: Requires prior knowledge of Mai-HiME to understand
Some characters don't have lines
The special is only about the humor

anime.title: Sekaiichi Hatsukoi OVA
anime.synopsis:
Two OVA episodes featuring additional stories. 

Episode 0: Ritsu and Takano used to date back in high school, but broke up due to a misunderstanding. This is that story. 

Episode 12.5: Hatori and Chiaki go to visit the latter's family. It's really awkward in many, many ways.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is considered underwhelming compared to the movie. The first episode's flashback is enjoyed, while the second is seen as mediocre. Overall, the stories feel incomplete and leave the audience wanting more.
pros: The first OVA episode, focusing on the high school days of Ritsu and Takano, is adorable and sweet.
The high school flashback scenes are fantastic.
cons: The stories feel incomplete and lacking.
The second OVA episode is mediocre, not boring but not interesting either.
The OVA format doesn't allow for a successful back-and-forth between timelines.

anime.title: High School of the Dead
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Gore, Horror, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
It happened suddenly: The dead began to rise and Japan was thrown into total chaos. As these monsters begin terrorizing a high school, Takashi Kimuro is forced to kill his best friend when he gets bitten and joins the ranks of the walking dead. Vowing to protect Rei Miyamoto, the girlfriend of the man he just executed, they narrowly escape their death trap of a school, only to be greeted with a society that has already fallen.

Soon, Takashi and Rei band together with other students on a journey to find their family members and uncover what caused this overwhelming pandemic. Joining them is Saeko Busujima, the beautiful president of the Kendo Club; Kouta Hirano, an otaku with a fetish for firearms; Saya Takagi, the daughter of an influential politician; and Shizuka Marikawa, their hot school nurse. But will the combined strength of these individuals be enough to conquer this undead apocalypse?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is heavily divided on Highschool of the Dead. Some viewers find the anime entertaining due to its action and over-the-top nature. However, many are critical of its excessive fanservice, shallow characters, and generic plot, deeming it a poorly executed and misogynistic show. The anime's high production value is often overshadowed by its exploitative content.
pros: Good animation quality, especially action scenes.
Catchy opening theme and generally well-fitting soundtrack.
Some find the over-the-top nature entertaining.
cons: Excessive and gratuitous fanservice detracts from the story and action.
Characters are shallow, unlikable, and stereotypical.
Plot is generic, predictable, and full of holes.
Inconsistent logic and world-building.

anime.title: The Story of Mr. Sorry
anime.synopsis: An unprecedented media show is on air at a TV broadcasting studio. The show is asking people whether a spider that drove an assemblyman crazy should be publicly executed or not. The spider in question is Je Bul-chal(meaning 'my mistake'), a hardworking young individual who became 'an ear cleaner' because of a precious memory he holds concerning his sister. In order to take a poll about his execution, the story of how Mr. Sorry became a spider is gradually revealed.
anime.consensus_summary: The show presents a dark and surreal story with social commentary that may not appeal to all viewers. Some find the premise intriguing and the satire effective, while others are put off by the pacing, animation style, and underdeveloped characters. Overall, the audience response is mixed, with the show being described as a unique but uneven experience.
pros: Intriguing premise with a bizarre game show setup.
Effective use of flashbacks to reveal the character's backstory.
Social commentary on human desires and darker aspects of society.
The art, colors and character designs successfully create a freaky atmosphere.
cons: Pacing issues and a feeling of being rushed.
Simple characters with underdeveloped desires.
Uneven animation and intentionally ugly character designs may not appeal to everyone.
May disappoint viewers seeking comedy or fantasy.

anime.title: The Legend of the Legendary Heroes
anime.synopsis:
"Alpha Stigma" are known to be eyes that can analyze all types of magic. However, they are more infamously known as cursed eyes that can only bring destruction and death to others.

Ryner Lute, a talented mage and also an Alpha Stigma bearer, was once a student of the Roland Empire's Magician Academy, an elite school dedicated to training magicians for military purposes. However, after many of his classmates died in a war, he makes an oath to make the nation a more orderly and peaceful place, with fellow survivor and best friend, Sion Astal.

Now that Sion is the king of Roland, he orders Ryner to search for useful relics that will aid the nation. Together with Ferris Eris, a beautiful and highly skilled swordswoman, Ryner goes on a journey to search for relics of legendary heroes from the past, and also uncover the secrets behind his cursed eyes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some find the initial episodes slow and misleading, while others appreciate the deeper themes and character development that emerge later. The pacing and disjointed storytelling are common criticisms, but the blend of fantasy elements and political intrigue appeals to some viewers.
pros: Interesting premise blending familiar fantasy elements with a unique mission.
Backstory adds depth and connection to characters.
Humor provides enjoyable moments.
cons: Poor pacing, especially in the first half, can be slow and repetitive.
Story flow is disjointed, jumping between plot points without clear transitions.
Title and initial episodes can be misleading and off-putting.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fantasy Adventure, Political Intrigue, Dark Fantasy

anime.title: Lupin III: The Last Job
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Lupin III aims to steal a Japanese cultural treasure "Jigoku Nyorai Zo," which is found in the recreation facilities of Nazi Germany. However, this valuable object is also targeted by Morgana, a mysterious figure who leads a ninja thief gang.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is that 'The Last Job' is an enjoyable, action-packed Lupin special, but it falls short in terms of plot, character utilization, and emotional depth compared to other entries in the series. Viewers find it fun and absurd, but the nonsensical plot and underutilized characters are notable weaknesses. The film seems to be inoffensive, but not particularly remarkable.
pros: Enjoyable and fun Lupin action.
Very fast-paced with nonstop action.
cons: Lacking cleverness and thoughtful writing compared to other specials.
Underutilization of legendary classic characters.
Nonsensical plot, especially the climax.
Lacking memorable dialogue and cool character interaction.
Poor execution of an apparent death scene, lacking emotional impact.

anime.title: Fafner: Heaven and Earth
anime.romaji_title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Heaven and Earth
anime.synopsis: The year is 2148. Two years after the end of the original Fafner in the Azure TV series, Tatsumiya Island and its surviving residents have returned to some semblance of recovery. However, things have become desperate for our hero, Kazuki; nearly blind now, and partially crippled from his battles with the Festum two years earlier, he clings to the promise his fallen friend Soushi made to him to return to the island and set things right again. Kazuki's hopes flare when a lifeform is detected within an unmanned submarine that comes floating into Tatsumiya Bay one night, but the person aboard isn't Soushi; it is a mysterious "boy" named Misao Kurusu who may not be entirely human, and who claims to have been sent by Sōshi. With Misao's arrival, hostilities break out anew between the Human Army and the Festum, and the Fafner pilots are thrown into the most desperate battle of their lives - this time, with the fate of TWO races riding on their shoulders.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely positive, especially for fans of the original series. The film is praised for its improved animation, thematic depth, and contribution to the overall Fafner narrative. However, it's not recommended for newcomers due to its complex plot and lack of introductory content.
pros: Stronger thematic structure and more focused plot compared to the original series.
Massive improvement in animation quality, with dynamic and fluid fight scenes.
Further development of familiar characters and exploration of Festum and Mir lore.
cons: Overdosed plot with too many concepts, potentially overwhelming viewers.
Doesn't reintroduce returning characters or re-explain core concepts, making it inaccessible to newcomers.

anime.title: Mardock Scramble: The First Compression
anime.synopsis:
Rune Balot is a down-and-out teen prostitute in Mardock City. One day, she's picked up by an ambitious casino manager named Shell who gives her everything she could want. Renewed by a false innocence, a false past, and now the false life Shell has given her, Balot feels grateful. However, she can't help but be curious about why he's done so much for her, so she does some research about his past on a computer. This turns out to be a mistake which will change her life greatly. When Shell finds out what she's done, he attempts to burn her to death by blowing up her car.

Due to the high crime rate in Mardock, a new law called "Scramble 09" has given police carte blanche to take extreme and otherwise illegal measures to revive crime witnesses. With this in mind, they allow a professor to bring Balot back from the brink of death by reassembling her entire body with reinforced synthetic fiber. When she finally wakes up, her confused mental state eventually turns toward revenge as Shell is revealed as her killer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is sharply divided due to the anime's extreme content and narrative ambition. While praised for its visually stunning animation and philosophical depth, many viewers find its pacing uneven, plot confusing, and excessive depictions of violence and sexual themes to be gratuitous or off-putting. This polarization makes it a love-it-or-hate-it experience.
pros: Stunning and highly detailed animation, especially in action sequences.
Compelling and unique character dynamics, particularly between Rune Balot and Oeufcoque.
Interesting and philosophical themes explored, such as memory, regret, and rebirth.
Original and ambitious storytelling with a strong cyberpunk setting.
cons: Significant pacing issues, often described as too fast, vague, or uneven.
Plot can be confusing and underdeveloped, with many unexplained elements and plot holes.
Inconsistent tone, with moments of unintentional humor and jarring shifts.
Characters, other than the main duo, are often underdeveloped and boring.
Excessive and sometimes gratuitous depiction of violence, sexual assault, and taboo themes, which some find unnecessary or exploitative.
Overuse of 3D CGI that can detract from the overall art style.
The ending of the first movie is abrupt and leaves many questions unanswered.

anime.title: Hamtaro: The Mysterious Ogre's Picture Book Tower
anime.romaji_title: Tottoko Hamtarou Movie 4: Hamtarou to Fushigi no Oni no Emon Tou
anime.synopsis: Ayayam is a pretty hamster who excelled at everything–as a child-prodigy in school, sports and even drawing and writing. One day, however, she overhears her friends making fun of a picture book she loved and had given to one of them. She is so devastated that she decides she doesn’t need friends anymore, locks herself into the library and hasn’t taken a single step outside ever since. The God of Books sympathizes with her and gives her a Magic Quill with which she can effortlessly draw any picture and write any story she wants. Meanwhile, Hamtaro learns that Laura and her fellow students will put on "Sunflower Taro" as their next school play. Hamtaro and friends decide that they, too, want to try their hand at acting and prepare their own version of "Sunflower Taro". In the course of preparing for the play, they are suddenly sucked into a strange Picture Book Tower, where Ayayam tells them that they will be characters in her new book – a new and exciting version of the well-known fairy tale "Sunflower Taro". You can tell that things are getting off to an interesting start – as they always do when the Ham-Hams are involved!!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the movie's imaginative and fast-paced story. The animation and Hamtaro's character are praised, but some feel the supporting characters could be more developed. Overall, it's considered a fun and engaging experience, especially for fans of the franchise.
pros: Fast-paced and non-sensical plot keeps the viewer engaged
Animation is stellar and makes everything feel big and grand
Hamtaro is consistently enjoyable
The movie is a joyful and dorky experience
New characters are fun and engaging
cons: The plot is too fast-paced and random at times
Other main characters, besides Hamtaro, could have had better developed personalities.

anime.title: Welcome to THE SPACE SHOW
anime.synopsis:
Five elementary school children are spending their summer break camping at a remote mountain village. While on a hunt for their missing rabbit, Pyon-kichi, they find an injured dog in a field with crop circles. After nursing the dog back to health, they are shocked when he suddenly speaks and introduces himself as Pochi Rickman—an alien researcher who has been on Earth researching its plant life.

As thanks for saving his life, Pochi offers to take the children to the moon on a sightseeing trip. When they arrive, the group quickly discovers that the moon hides a vast alien metropolis which they begin to gleefully explore. Unfortunately, after hearing that Pochi was severely injured on his mission, the government of the moon issues a travel sanction on Earth, preventing the children from returning home. 

Left with no other choice, the group journeys around the galaxy in search of a way to safely return to Earth. Amidst their adventure, they are pursued by aliens affiliated with "The Space Show," the universe's most-watched production shrouded in mystery.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Uchuu Show e Youkoso' for its visual appeal, imaginative story, and family-friendly nature. However, some find the plot simplistic, the length excessive, and the characters somewhat clichéd. Despite its flaws, many appreciate the film's whimsical and adventurous spirit, making it a worthwhile watch for those seeking lighthearted entertainment.
pros: Visually spectacular with bright colors and fun designs.
Enjoyable and fun story, especially for kids and families.
Great animation and character designs.
The story is full of imagination.
cons: Story can be simple and nonsensical at times.
The movie is too long, especially the second half.
Characterizations are a little cliche.

anime.title: Cooking Papa
anime.synopsis: The story of Mr. Araiwa and his family. He is a model employee in a large enterprise, but becomes a completely different character at home. He is very keen on cooking and lets pass no occasion to cook delicious dishes for his wife, who is frequently occupied by her work as a journalist, or his young son.
anime.consensus_summary: Cooking Papa is a well-received anime, particularly for its humor and family-friendly content.  Viewers find the characters cute and hilarious, making it an enjoyable experience for both adults and children. The anime is recommended for a fun evening with family.
pros: Hilarious and cute characters
Enjoyable humor
Good music
Suitable for family viewing

anime.title: Princess Jellyfish
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Crossdressing, Josei, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis:
Ever since her late mother took her to an aquarium when she was young, Tsukimi Kurashita has been obsessed with jellyfish, comparing their flowing tentacles to a princess's white dress. Now living with five other unemployed otaku women, 19-year-old Tsukimi spends her days as a social outcast dreaming of becoming an illustrator.

However, her life changes forever when one day, a beautiful woman unexpectedly helps her save a jellyfish in a local pet store. From then on, the stranger—confident, fashionable, and the complete opposite of Tsukimi and her roommates—begins to regularly visit the girls' building. This trendy hipster, though appearing shallow at first, harbors some secrets of her own, starting with the fact that "she" isn't really a girl at all, but a wealthy male college student named Kuranosuke Koibuchi!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many appreciating the show's unique characters, humor, and themes of self-acceptance. However, the unfulfilling ending, potentially offensive content, and underdeveloped storylines are major points of criticism. While enjoyable for its lightheartedness and originality, viewers are often left wanting more resolution and depth.
pros: Endearing characters and relatable themes of social awkwardness and passion for hobbies.
Colorful art style that effectively portrays the contrast between the 'stylish' and 'otaku' worlds.
Energetic pacing and engaging interactions between characters, creating a lighthearted and enjoyable experience.
cons: Incomplete ending that leaves storylines unresolved, particularly regarding romantic relationships.
Characters that are perceived as unlikable.
Controversial and potentially triggering anti-queer messages in early episodes.

anime.title: Precure All Stars Movie DX2: Kibou no Hikari☆Rainbow Jewel wo Mamore!
anime.romaji_title: Precure All Stars Movie DX2: Kibou no Hikari☆Rainbow Jewel wo Mamore!
anime.synopsis: Tsubomi Hanasaki is woken by her best friend Erika Kurumi only to find out that their two fairies, Coffret and Shypre, have left just leaving a note explaining where to find them. Fairy Park is not only the destination of both girls, it is also the meeting point of all other Precures who planned to spend this special day together. This magical theme park holds the Rainbow Jewel, a special gem that represents all of the hopes and dreams of the world. Such a powerful stone is the object of desire of a malefic entity named Bottom who has waited one thousand years for the opportunity to possess it.
anime.consensus_summary: The film is a fun crossover event for Precure fans, especially those who enjoy seeing many characters from the franchise together. While the movie delivers on action and heartwarming moments, some viewers found the animation style inconsistent and the plot somewhat dragged out. Overall, it's considered an enjoyable, but not mind-blowing, addition to the Precure All Stars series.
pros: Exciting crossover with a large cast of characters from the franchise.
Good action sequences and heartwarming moments.
Enjoyable for Precure fans.
cons: Drawing style mismatches Heartcatch characters, can be jarring.
Characters weren't as expressive.
The final showdown was dragged out and thus became boring to watch.
Too Tsubomi and Erika-centric.

anime.title: Keroro Gunso the Super Movie: Creation! Ultimate Keroro, Wonder Space-Time Island!!
anime.romaji_title: Keroro Gunsou Movie 5: Tanjou! Kyuukyoku Keroro, Kiseki no Jikuu-jima, de Arimasu!!
anime.synopsis: One day, a stone carving bearing an uncanny likeness to Keroro  arrives at Fuyumi's place. To solve this mystery, the Keroro Squad travels to the isolated and mysterious Easter Island. There, they meet harmless spirits known as Mana, and the odd twins Io and Rana. Lastly, there is Akuaku, a legendary evil spirit recently awoken from its long sleep.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is intrigued by the mysterious artifact and the premonition of a chaotic future. The dream sequence, particularly Keroro's obliteration, elicits a strong emotional response. Overall, the audience seems captivated by the blend of mystery and potential danger.
cons: The world will fall into chaos
Keroro is completely obliterated.

anime.title: Colorful: The Motion Picture
anime.synopsis:
Upon arriving at the train station of death, an impure soul is granted a second chance at life against his will. Reincarnating into the body of Makoto Kobayashi, a 14-year-old boy who recently committed suicide, the soul is tasked to identify the boy's greatest sin in life within a time limit of six months. Although it remains reluctant toward continuing life as Makoto, the soul soon begins to notice the complexities of people's emotions and actions.

Deconstructing the ideas of fractured families and suicide, Colorful explores the intricacies of the daily struggles humans face but are too abashed to confront.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Colorful" is a thought-provoking and emotionally resonant film that explores themes of redemption and the value of life. Some find the pacing slow or the main character unlikeable, but many appreciate its depth and impact. The film's ability to connect with viewers on a personal level is a strong point.
pros: The story explores complex themes of sin, redemption, and the value of life.
The characters are well-developed and relatable, with their own flaws and secrets.
The animation is visually appealing, with bright colors and beautiful still art.
The soundtrack enhances the emotional impact of the film.
cons: The pacing can be slow and drag in the first half.
Some viewers may find the main character unlikeable at times.
The film can be depressing and emotionally heavy.
The story touches upon many characters but doesn't delve into them deeply.

anime.title: One Piece: Romance Dawn Story - Recapping the TV Series So Far
anime.synopsis: A recap OVA summarizing the ten-year TV series up to the Impel Down arc.
anime.consensus_summary: The One Piece Recap OVA is viewed as a highly condensed summary, only suitable for viewers already familiar with the source material who need a quick refresher. The lack of new content and subpar video quality make it unappealing for newcomers or those seeking an enhanced viewing experience. Ultimately, its value is limited to completionists or those with specific memory-refreshing needs.
cons: Lacks extra content
Poor video quality compared to TV episodes
Not suitable as a replacement for watching the original episodes
Only useful for those already familiar with the story

anime.title: Nodame Cantabile Finale OVA
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Josei, Performing Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: Despite the uncertainty surrounding Shinichi Chiaki's relationship with eccentric pianist Megumi "Nodame" Noda, most would assume it is a romantic one—especially Nodame herself, who has professed her love for Chiaki on many occasions. But when a petty quarrel over soy sauce leads Nodame to gratuitously accept a date invitation from Lucas Beaudry, a young French piano prodigy, the highly acclaimed conductor Chiaki experiences true jealousy for the first time in his life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed this short OVA as a lighthearted epilogue to the main series. It provides a humorous glimpse into Chiaki and Nodame's relationship. While some wished for more substantial character development, the overall reception is positive.
pros: Funny spin-off continuing the series
Well-executed within a short timeframe
Good soundtrack and ending
cons: Limited character development
Very short addition

anime.title: Sound of the Sky Specials
anime.romaji_title: So Ra No Wo To Specials
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, Military, Music, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Two extra episodes included in the Blu-ray and DVD volumes 4 and 7 of "Sora no Woto".

The first, episode 7.5, takes place during the series. Felicia proposes a mock battle between the maidens after Kanata sees Rio opening the door to the distillery. If Kanata can win, they'll tell her the truth about the secret room. However, things get out of hand when alcohol gets involved!

The second, episode 13, takes place after the series ends. One of the local children asks Kanata what her dream is. Unable to answer, Kanata talks to the other characters about their dreams and goals.
anime.consensus_summary: The specials are viewed with mixed feelings. Some appreciate the character development and humor, particularly in contrast to the main series. Others find the specials exacerbate the flaws of the main series, offering little additional value. The general sentiment leans toward a mild appreciation for the light-heartedness and epilogue offered by the specials.
pros: Episode 13 provides a satisfying epilogue, enhancing appreciation of characters and world.
Specials deepen appreciation for the show, unlike typical off-topic plots.
Episode 7.5 offers comedic relief, with humor exceeding that of the main series.
Episode 13 showcases character development, particularly for Kanata.
cons: Specials extend undesirable characteristics of the main series, adding nothing to the story.
Episode 7.5 is centered around drunk moe characters.
Poor Pacing
Weak Plot

anime.title: Spellbound! Magical Princess Lilpri
anime.romaji_title: Hime Chen! Otogi Chikku Idol Lilpri
anime.synopsis: The Fairytale World is in trouble. Its princesses and their respective worlds are disappearing, causing a ripple effect in the human world where their stories are popular. In order to save the Fairytale World, the Queen sends three magic animals, Sei, Dai, and Ryoku, to the human world with magic gems to find three girls who can become the "Super Miracle Idols," the princesses Snow White, Cinderella, and Kaguya-hime. Those "princesses" end up being three little girls: Yukimori Ringo, Takashiro Layla, and Sasahara Natsuki. But the gems transform them into older singing superstars, and after their accidental debut at the singer Wish's concert, they become known as "Little Princesses," or "LilPri." Now they must collect Happiness Tones from humans in order to restore the Fairytale World.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally viewed as adorable and enjoyable, especially for those who appreciate magical girl and fairy tale themes. While the animation during transformations and the childish nature of the plot may be drawbacks for some, the cute art style and catchy songs are generally well-received. Overall, the audience sentiment is positive, with a focus on the show's charm and appeal to younger viewers.
pros: Chibi cute art style in regular form
Enjoyable fairy tale storyline
Catchy songs
cons: Kidish themes may not appeal to all viewers
Annoying animation during Lilpri transformations

anime.title: Aa Harimanada
anime.synopsis:
When Harimanada makes his grand entrance into the world of Sumo, he causes complete uproar throughout the entire arena. The novelty headmask is clearly not a good idea but not content with just ruffling the feathers of all the spectators, he sends the the entire Sumo Association into a frenzy when he arrogantly declares that he will surpass the legendary Futabayama's consecutive run of 69 victories. Should he fail to achieve such a feat, he will immediately retire all together.

Harimanada's impudent remarks cause a huge backlash as every high-ranking Yokuzuna wants the chance to knock him down and humiliate him for showing such arrogance.

Thus begins Harimanada's journey to the top as he battles to topple the entire Sumo hierarchy!
anime.consensus_summary: Aa Harimanada receives mixed reviews, with many finding the plot simplistic and the characters underdeveloped. While the fight scenes and character designs are appreciated, the repetitive animation and unlikable protagonist detract from the overall experience. Some viewers may find enjoyment in the straightforward action, but those seeking depth and complexity will likely be disappointed.
pros: Good background music and voice acting
Fight scenes are entertaining and intense
Interesting character designs for the Sumo wrestlers
cons: Simplistic and predictable storyline
One-dimensional characters with poorly explained motivations
Repetitive animation and lack of dynamic fights
Main character is unlikable and does not progress

anime.title: Jewelpet Twinkle☆
anime.synopsis: In Jewel Land, Jewelpets, creatures who has the natural ability to use magic lived in harmony with the Witches, attending the School of Witchcraft and Wizardry to learn to use magic with their Jewel Eyes. However for Ruby, a white Japanese Hare whose magic sometimes fail, is appointed to go to the Human World to search for her partner. But when she used the card the magicians gave her, she was sent to the Human World by accident. In the Human World, A girl named Akari Sakura met her on the beach on her way to school. At first, Akari can't understand her due to her Jewel Land Language until Ruby took a special candy so she could speak and understand human language. As the day passes, Ruby knew about her problems and later apologized. A Jewel Charm appeared on Akari's hand and she realized it that she's chosen by Ruby to be her partner. After that, she decided to enter the Jewel Star Grand Prix, on the prize is that any wish that they wanted will be granted. Will she be the Next Jewel Star and her wish be granted in the end? Or It'll just end in one big disaster...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Jewelpet Twinkle☆, particularly praising its characters and story development. Some find the initial episodes weak and note the presence of clichés. However, the overall sentiment is positive, with many recommending it to fans of the magical girl genre.
pros: Well-developed characters
Engaging story progression
Enjoyable magical girl theme
cons: Cliches and overused tropes
Slow start with bad opening episodes

anime.title: Baby Felix
anime.synopsis: A young Felix the Cat and his baby pals find fun and mischief along their travels.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Baby Felix is minimal, with interest largely confined to animation production enthusiasts and deep fans of the Felix the Cat IP. The show is seen as a standard children's offering with little to engage a broader audience, and its primary 'interesting' qualities lie in its production history rather than its narrative or emotional impact.
pros: Animation by Radix studio, known for other notable works, adds an interesting production element.
cons: Recycled animation and musical numbers in the US version detract from the viewing experience.
Inconsistent animation quality, with some episodes being noticeably 'off-model and wonky'.

anime.title: Rio - Rainbow Gate!: Reshuffle
anime.synopsis:
The "Howard Resort Hotel" is an entertainment destination where people gather from around the world to grab huge fortunes. In the casino is a beautiful female dealer named Rio Rollins, known far and wide as the "Goddess of Victory".

In order to approach closer to her mother, one of history's greatest dealers, she does battle to gather up the legendary cards called "gates". Those who gather all 13 gate cards are presented with the title MVCD (Most Valuable Casino Dealer), proof that they are a top dealer.

Set in a vast resort, an exciting battle begins with rival dealers that'll take your breath away! Throw in some "supreme comedy" and a story that makes you cry when you least expect it, these cute and sexy girls will explode off your screen! With everyone's cheer of "Leave it to Rio!", Lady Luck'll be with you, too!
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is visually appealing and can be enjoyable for viewers seeking lighthearted fan service and casino themes. However, the plot is widely criticized for being nonsensical, and the characters lack depth. Many find the story directionless and the later episodes deviate significantly from the initial premise, leading to disappointment.
pros: Appealing and well-drawn art style with bright colors.
Enjoyable and easygoing for casual viewing.
Good voice acting performances.
cons: Dreadfully terrible and nonsensical plot.
Silly and stupid Gate Battles with ridiculous superpowers.
Forgettable and one-dimensional characters.
Lackluster and directionless storytelling.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fan Service, Gambling, Slice of Life

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie 4: The Lost Tower
anime.romaji_title: Naruto: Shippuuden Movie 4 - The Lost Tower
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Shounen, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Led by Yamato, Naruto Uzumaki, Sakura Haruno, and Sai are assigned to capture Mukade, a rogue ninja who is pursuing the ancient chakra Ryuumyaku located underneath the Rouran ruins. While the Ryuumyaku has been sealed by the Fourth Hokage, the group fails to prevent Mukade from releasing its power. Consequently, a strong energy burst engulfs both Naruto and Yamato before they can escape.

As he awakens in a magnificent yet hostile kingdom, Naruto meets its young queen Saara and three Konohagakure ninjas on a top-secret mission. They reveal to him that he has time-traveled to Rouran 20 years into the past! To make matters worse, Mukade has already infiltrated the royal court, becoming the naive queen's most trusted minister under the alias Anrokuzan.

Joining forces with the three ninjas, Naruto must protect Saara's life without fail to stop the villain's plans and return to the present.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the time travel concept and the appearance of Minato are appreciated, many find the plot nonsensical and the character interactions disappointing. Some feel the movie is a waste of time, while others find it enjoyable as a time-killer, with the overall sentiment leaning towards disappointment due to unmet expectations, particularly regarding the Naruto-Minato dynamic.
pros: The concept of time travel is interesting.
Seeing Minato, the Fourth Hokage, is a highlight for many viewers.
cons: Plot makes little sense and serves little purpose.
Naruto's character is portrayed as oblivious and slow to understand obvious connections.
The minimal interaction between Naruto and Minato is a major disappointment.
Storyline does not compare to the manga.
Villain is forgettable and uninspired.
anime.thematic_vibe: Time Travel, Father-Son Dynamic, Political Intrigue

anime.title: Bleach the Movie: Hell Verse
anime.synopsis:
When a soul has committed irredeemable sins, it is removed from the cycle of reincarnation monitored by the Soul Society, and the gates of Hell open to condemn the soul to eternal damnation. From this place from where no one has ever come back, three tormented souls who refer to themselves as Sinners of Hell burst in Karakura Town, where a ruthless fight involving them against the substitute Soul Reaper Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends ensues. In the aftermath of the fight, Ichigo's sisters are abducted, with the aforementioned group's leader Shuren hoping to lure Ichigo to be finally freed from the chains of Hell.

Helped by a Sinner named Kokutou, Ichigo and his friends head to Hell for a rescue mission. However, the Soul Society opposes the journey, in fear of threatening the balance between worlds. As the lines between friends and foes get blurred, Ichigo will have to face his most challenging dilemma yet—a decision that may well engulf the three worlds into chaos.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the action and visuals, while others criticize the predictable plot and lack of originality. The movie offers good animation and fight sequences but suffers from a repetitive storyline. Overall, fans are split between enjoying the spectacle and being disappointed by the narrative's shortcomings.
pros: Exciting fight scenes and improved animation quality.
Exploration of Hell provides a unique setting within the Bleach universe.
Some found the story engaging and enjoyable despite its simplicity.
cons: Plot is repetitive and predictable, following the typical 'kidnapping rescue' arc.
Story lacks depth and originality; some consider it a rehash of previous themes.
Inconsistencies and additions to the lore may conflict with the established Bleach universe.

anime.title: Armored Trooper Votoms: Case; Irvine
anime.synopsis: Irvine Lester is an AT repairman. In order to make a living with his sister, he is secretly fighting in AT gambling matches and intentionally losing the games for money. But the other fighters find out about his excellent AT maneuvering skills and demand a real match.
anime.consensus_summary: Case;Irvine is a decent, self-contained Votoms story that benefits from strong action animation. While the plot is simple and lacks originality, it effectively uses the established Votoms universe. The audience generally appreciates it as a solid, if not groundbreaking, addition to the franchise.
pros: Self-contained plot within the Votoms universe
Good animation quality, especially for the AT action
Leverages established Votoms lore effectively
cons: Lacks depth and originality in the story
Story is simple and straightforward

anime.title: SD Gundam Sangokuden Brave Battle Warriors
anime.romaji_title: SD Gundam Sangokuden Brave Battle Warriors
anime.synopsis: A Romance of the Three Kingdoms retelling using SD Gundams.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience seems pleasantly surprised by SD Gundam Sangokuden Brave Battle Warriors, particularly its characters and story.  Some viewers note pacing issues due to the short episode format and changes made from the original Romance of the Three Kingdoms. The series is considered a worthwhile and enjoyable adaptation despite its flaws.
pros: Amazing characters, especially Lu Bu
Fascinating story based on a classic Chinese novel
Pleasantly surprised by the series
cons: Pacing issues due to short episode length
Ending could have been better
Changes to source material may bother purists

anime.title: Magic Kaito
anime.synopsis:
Magic is not real—everyone knows that. When performed by a true expert, however, magic possesses the ability to amaze and wonder its audience. Kaito Kuroba, son of world-famous stage magician Touichi Kuroba, is no stranger to this fact. Well-versed in the arts of deception and misdirection, Kaito frequently disrupts the lives of those around him with flashy tricks and pranks. But when Kaito accidentally stumbles upon a hidden passage in his home, he discovers a secret that may well have been the cause of his father's death eight years ago—the dove-white outfit of Kid the Phantom Thief. Wanting to find out more about his father, Kaito dons the outfit and searches for the Pandora Gem that is said to grant immortality. However, he is not the only one after the gem—the organization responsible for his father's death is also hot on his tail!

Magic Kaito follows the rebirth of Kaitou Kid, phantom thief of the night. Utilizing his dummies, disguises, and signature card gun, Kaito sets out to steal the world's most precious jewels, uncovering the truth behind his father's death and the rumored Pandora Gem along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Magic Kaito for its stylish heists, charismatic protagonist, and entertaining plot. Some viewers find the over-the-top fantasy elements and plot changes detract from the experience. Overall, the show is well-received as a fun and engaging heist series.
pros: Glamorous heists and brilliant escapes.
Stylish animation and entertaining plot changes.
Charismatic protagonist with flair.
cons: Over-the-top fantasy elements that defy logic.
Supporting characters lose importance after introduction.
Minor plot changes may not appeal to all manga fans.

anime.title: Tegami Bachi: Letter Bee Reverse
anime.synopsis: After Niche carries the wounded and stunned Lag back to the Bee Hive, the Letter Bee finally begins to piece the puzzle together. Now he knows what's happened to Gauche, why the Marauders are so focused on stealing mail and the actual intent of the group controlling both, Reverse. However, when he's forbidden to reveal the truth, Lag is soon forced out of the artificial sunlight and back into the world of perpetual night. And soon Reverse's plot to take down the Letter Bees and overthrow the Amberground government begins to accelerate. If things weren't already bad enough, the giant insect creatures called gaichuu are apparently evolving into something new; there may be traitors working within the Hive; and Niche's sister, who's definitely not human friendly, shows up to turn family drama into a full-scale siege! It all spells serious trouble for the Letter Bees, but if anyone can weather the storms and gloom of night, Lag and his team are the ones who'll deliver.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the series' strong artistic and musical qualities, as well as its interesting world and characters.  However, some find the protagonist's emotional displays excessive and the plot's loose ends frustrating. Overall, the series evokes a bittersweet and thoughtful experience.
pros: Beautiful art and animation.
Excellent music that fits the scenes well.
Interesting world and setting with a unique atmosphere.
Well-developed and original characters.
cons: Lag's crying can be excessive.
Some plot points and character motivations are not fully explained (plot holes).
The ending may not satisfy those who prefer a fully resolved conclusion.

anime.title: Detective Conan Magic File 4: Osaka Okonomiyaki Odyssey
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Magic File 4: Osaka Okonomiyaki Odyssey
