anime.synopsis: Another special to accompany the release of the 14th feature film, The Lost Ship in the Sky. Along with a number of previous episodes, the original episode contained within will take place after the events of the film.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the Magic File to be a light and humorous side story, particularly enjoying the interactions between Conan and Heiji. However, some viewers feel the pacing is slow and the stories are uninteresting, with riddles that are too difficult for the average viewer. Overall, it's considered a pleasant but not particularly memorable addition to the Conan universe.
pros: Funny interactions between Conan and Heiji
Lighthearted side story
Good Kazuha and Heiji moment
cons: Slow pacing
Uninteresting stories
Riddles are too difficult and Japan-centric

anime.title: Crayon Shin-chan Movie 08: Arashi wo Yobu Jungle
anime.romaji_title: Crayon Shin-chan Movie 08: Arashi wo Yobu Jungle
anime.synopsis: An adventure set in a south island. Shinnosuke with his parents and friends joined a tour with the preview of Action Kamen's new movie 'South Sea Millennium Wars' on a luxury liner, but a funky guy who names himself Paradise King and his slave gang of gibbon monkeys took away all the adults to a south island. Gotaro Go, an actor playing the role of Action Kamen, with Shinnosuke, fights a martial-arts battle and air battle against Paradise King.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Arashi wo Yobu Jungle' is viewed as an enjoyable and humorous adventure film for families, though some viewers have raised concerns about potentially outdated or insensitive cultural depictions. The incoherent nature of some reviews makes it difficult to fully gauge audience reception. Nevertheless, the general sentiment seems to lean towards positive entertainment value.
pros: Entertaining action sequences.
Humorous and light-hearted adventure.
Positive portrayal of family and friendship.
cons: Potentially dated or insensitive cultural portrayals (implied by 'racism' comment).
Incoherent review fragments suggest possible writing or translation issues affecting comprehension.

anime.title: Crayon Shin-chan Movie 18: Chou Jikuu! Arashi wo Yobu Ora no Hanayome
anime.romaji_title: Crayon Shin-chan Movie 18: Chou Jikuu! Arashi wo Yobu Ora no Hanayome
anime.synopsis: Comical action adventure film set in the future world, like a dystopian science fiction. Shinnosuke's future fiancee, Tamiko Kaneari comes from the future via the time machine. She says her father Masuzo Kaneari captures adult Shinnosuke in the future world and they needs the power of Shinnosuke at age 5 to rescue him. She takes Shinnosuke and Kasukabe Defense Forces members to the future big city Neotokio, which is the world ruled by Masuzo Kaneari, the president of the electric power company Kaneari Electric.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is positive, particularly among Crayon Shin-chan fans. Viewers find the movie entertaining and appreciate the glimpse into the characters' potential futures. The film is considered a worthwhile watch.
pros: Entertaining
Worth your time for Crayon Shin-chan lovers
Interesting future setting and character designs

anime.title: Heaven's Lost Property Forte
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Sakurai Tomoki has settled into his life with the two angeloids, Ikaros and Nymph, and is enjoying himself immensely.  However, he keeps having weird dreams and asks all of his friends to help him investigate the cause.

Nymph conjures up a device that enables people, but not angeloids, to enter other people's dreams.  The device malfunctions at first but eventually they get to what was supposed to be Tomoki's dream but discover that something is very wrong with it.

Later, a meteor comes crashing down from the skies at the site of the large cherry blossom tree where Tomoki first discovered Ikaros.  An extremely well endowed blonde angeloid with a huge sword emerges from the meteor and sets off in search of Tomoki!
anime.consensus_summary: Sora no Otoshimono Forte is a polarizing ecchi comedy that deeply divides its audience. While many praise its exceptional humor, high production values, and endearing characters, a significant portion criticizes its excessive ecchi content and underdeveloped plot. Viewers either find the blend of comedy and fan service brilliant or find it an overused detriment to storytelling.
pros: The comedy is consistently praised as hilarious, witty, and a primary strength of the series, often attributed to creative writing and character interactions.
Production quality, including art, animation, and voice acting, is frequently highlighted as outstanding and a significant contributor to the show's enjoyment.
The unique and creative use of multiple ending themes, with each episode having a different one, is a notable positive aspect.
Character dynamics and introductions, particularly the development of angeloids' emotions and their interactions with the protagonist, are seen as endearing and engaging.
cons: The heavy reliance on ecchi and perverted humor is a major point of contention, with some viewers finding it overused, unpleasant, and detrimental to the plot.
The plot is often criticized for being weak, inconsistent, and overshadowed by filler episodes and fan service, leading to a lack of meaningful development in certain arcs.
The extensive use of chibi animation, while sometimes effective for comedy, is seen as overused by some, to the point of detracting from character consistency.
Several plot points and world-building elements (e.g., Synapse, the 'New World', angeloid origins) are left unexplained or are quickly forgotten, leading to frustration.

anime.title: Durarara!! Specials
anime.synopsis:
Celty Sturluson is tasked to deliver a suspicious red handbag as part of her courier duties—the problem is: it is being sought by several organizations. As she makes her way through Ikebukuro toward the place the bag is supposed to be brought to, she is chased by mysterious men speaking a foreign language, and her package ends up dragging many of the city's residents into the conflict.

Subsequently, famous actor Yuuhei Hanejima has just arrived in Ikebukuro as part of a special TV program, searching for the best couple to give them a chance to appear in one of his movies. However, Yuuhei Hanejima is actually a stage name for Kasuka Heiwajima, Shizuo's younger brother, and when an anonymous internet user threatens to kill the superstar, this user learns the weight of what that relationship means. Moreover, Shizuo discovers that the one responsible for the attempted attack is the meddlesome pest that he loathes with a burning passion.
anime.consensus_summary: The Durarara!! Specials are generally well-received as fun, lighthearted additions to the series that offer more of the beloved characters and their interactions. While they don't significantly advance the main plot, they provide comedic relief and deeper insights into the characters. Most fans find them enjoyable, though some may find them unnecessary or confusing if watched out of order.
pros: Provides more content with beloved characters.
Light-hearted and comedic relief from the main series.
Offers deeper insights into character interactions.
Fun and entertaining in their own way.
cons: Does not contribute significantly to the main plot.
Story can be lacking compared to the main series.
May not be essential viewing for all viewers.
Can be confusing if viewed out of order.

anime.title: Beyblade: Metal Masters
anime.synopsis:
Ginga Hagane and his crew of Bladers are back and ready to take on new challenges. The World Championship beckons, and Ginga is more than prepared, now equipped with a new Beyblade, the Galaxy Pegasus W105R2F. And he will be battling with a tag-partner from the USA, Masamune Kadoya. However, Masamune has also set his eyes on the championship, and plans to defeat Gingka.

Masamune may be not the only threat to Ginga's path to victory. The world's top Blader Kyoya was chosen alongside Ginga, Masamune, Tsubasa, and Yu to represent Japan, but instead decides to join the African team. Together with his teammate Benkei, he wishes to take down Ginga and the Japanese team. The stage is now set for one of the most dramatic showdowns in Metal Fight Beyblade: Baku.
anime.consensus_summary: Metal Fight Beyblade: Baku is viewed as a fun, action-packed kids show with exciting battles and a strong nostalgia factor. While the plot and characters are simple and sometimes repetitive, the engaging visuals and the high stakes tournament format are appreciated. However, some find the plot predictable and the characters to be boring.
pros: Exciting battles and visuals
Memorable characters and voice acting (especially subbed)
Addresses stakes with a world tournament
Fun and sometimes hilarious episodes
Nostalgia factor enhances enjoyment
cons: Simple, repetitive plot (Ginga beating everyone)
Stereotypical characters with little depth
Inconsistent fight quality; some wins feel arbitrary
Villain overuse and lack of depth (except Argo)
Boring main cast
Final fight not exciting

anime.title: Rainbow Samurai
anime.synopsis:
In the middle of the 19th century, Japan was still closed off from the outside world. There were just the beginning signs of reformation in the long regime of Shogun Tokugawa.

In the remote countryside, on the island of Shikoko, a young boy named Ryoma is growing up in a lower-class Samurai family. A decade later, he is to become on of the leading figures to topple the Shogun's reign and open Japan to the western world.

Our story begins with Ryoma, a dreaming kid of seven years. Ryoma is an honest and tenderd-hearted boy who hates any sort of violence and brutality. He is so sensitive, and a bit naive, that he often cries from pity when he sees even the simples act of violence such as another kid trampling a tiny insect. The kids and even his family call him a "cry baby". However, he is not a coward -- not a "chicken" at all. His distress comes from a desire to prevent unreasonable acts and the wrong doings in life.

His older sister is the only person who understands his depth. She recognizes that her brother is gifted with a special talent and she does her best to protect him and cheer him up.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is well-regarded for its historical accuracy and portrayal of Sakamoto Ryouma's life, making it an excellent starting point for understanding the Bakumatsu Period. The emotional depth and character development are praised, particularly the relationship between Ryouma and his sister. However, the lack of subtitles is a significant barrier for non-Japanese speakers, and the childlike presentation may not appeal to all audiences.
pros: Accurate depiction of historical events and figures
Authentic and relatable characters, especially Ryouma and his sister
Detailed research and excellent biography of Sakamoto Ryouma
cons: Lack of English subtitles limits accessibility
Childlike presentation might not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: MM!
anime.synopsis:
Taro Sado is a high school student who lives his day to day life with a big secret—he's a masochist! Encouraged by his cross-dressing best friend Tatsukichi Hayama, Taro asks the Second Voluntary Club for help with his problem and ends up joining the club after they vow to "fix" him.

However, it turns out that all of the members of the club have some serious issues. The club leader Mio Isurugi is a self-designated god who is afraid of cats, Arashiko Yuuno has a severe fear of men, and the club advisor Michiru Onigawara is a sadist who enjoys making people cosplay. 

Together with other wacky characters such as Yumi Mamiya, a talented masseuse and Yuuno's best friend, and Noa Hiiragi, the president of the invention club, they all learn about the importance of acceptance and kindness.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the anime is a lighthearted comedy that relies heavily on its characters' quirks and over-the-top situations. While some find the humor repetitive and the plot weak, others appreciate its parody elements and character interactions. The show is generally seen as entertaining, but not particularly deep or meaningful.
pros: Funny and entertaining with over-the-top characters.
Good character development, especially between some characters.
Enjoyable parody elements and references to other anime.
cons: Weak or non-existent plot, with episodic nature and lack of progression.
Humor can be repetitive and cross the line into distasteful.
Ending feels abrupt and disappointing.

anime.title: Gosick
anime.synopsis:
Kazuya Kujou is a foreign student at Saint Marguerite Academy, a luxurious boarding school in the Southern European country of Sauville. Originally from Japan, his jet-black hair and dark brown eyes cause his peers to shun him and give him the nickname "Black Reaper," based on a popular urban legend about the traveler who brings death in the spring.

On a day like any other, Kujou visits the school's extravagant library in search of ghost stories. However, his focus soon changes as he becomes curious about a golden strand of hair on the stairs. The steps lead him to a large garden and a beautiful doll-like girl known as Victorique de Blois, whose complex and imaginative foresight allows her to predict their futures, now intertwined.

With more mysteries quickly developing—including the appearance of a ghost ship and an alchemist with the power of transmutation—Victorique and Kujou, bound by fate and their unique skills, have no choice but to rely on each other.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the blend of mystery, romance, and historical elements, along with character development, others are critical of the weak mysteries and frustrating character tropes. The series is praised for its strong ending, but early episodes may deter some viewers.
pros: Interesting historical macro-plot intertwined with fictional mysteries
Well-developed relationship between the main characters adds depth
Strong ending that ties together seemingly pointless arcs
cons: Mediocre and easily solvable mini-mysteries in the beginning
Main character's deductions sometimes feel illogical and contrived
Irritating tsundere loli character archetype

anime.title: Wandering Son
anime.synopsis:
Effeminate fifth grader Shuuichi Nitori is considered by most to be one of the prettiest girls in school, but much to her dismay, she is actually biologically male. Fortunately, Shuuichi has a childhood friend who has similar feelings of discomfort related to gender identity: the lanky tomboy Yoshino Takatsuki, who, though biologically female, does not identify as a girl. These two friends share a similar secret and find solace in one another; however, their lives become even more complicated when they must tread the unfamiliar waters of a new school, attempt to make new friends, and struggle to maintain old ones. Faced with nearly insurmountable odds, they must learn to deal with the harsh realities of growing up, being transgender, relationships, and acceptance.

Lauded as a decidedly serious take on gender identity and LGBT struggles, Takako Shimura's Hourou Musuko is about Shuuichi and Yoshino's attempts to discover their true selves as they enter puberty, make friends, fall in love, and face some very real and difficult choices.
anime.consensus_summary: Hourou Musuko is appreciated for its serious and sensitive approach to transgender issues and the struggles of growing up. However, some viewers find the story slow-paced and feel that the anime doesn't delve deep enough into the complexities of gender identity. There's a general agreement on the beautiful art style and music, contributing to the anime's overall emotional impact.
pros: Sensitive and tactful handling of gender identity issues.
Realistic portrayal of puberty and growing up.
Beautiful art style and fitting music.
cons: Story can feel slow or aimless at times.
Themes sometimes feel superficial or not fully explored.
Beginning of the anime can be confusing for those unfamiliar with the manga.

anime.title: Black Lagoon Omake
anime.synopsis: Special omake episodes from the Blu-Ray releases, showing the heroines and foes in funny, uncommon situations.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion on Black Lagoon Omake is highly divided. Fans appreciate the comedic shift and seeing characters in absurd situations, while detractors find the departure from the main series jarring and the humor nonsensical. It's viewed as a non-essential, albeit potentially amusing, diversion for existing fans.
pros: Spectacular artwork and comedy that hilariously subverts character expectations
Funny to see characters act in awkward, childish ways, a good change of pace from the main series
Short episodes are easy to watch and don't require much time investment
Expressive animation and creative art style
cons: Radical departure from the original series' tone and characters, can be jarring
Nonsensical skits that don't add to the Black Lagoon universe
Heavy reliance on slapstick and random humor that can be hit or miss
Art style described as 'childish' or 'bland' by some

anime.title: Queen's Blade: Beautiful Warriors
anime.synopsis: Queen's Blade OVA. Contains short stories from the lives of the warriors after the Queen's Blade competition.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is primarily aimed at existing Queen's Blade fans seeking more content featuring their favorite characters. The anthology format leads to variable quality, with some episodes offering deeper character development while others rely heavily on fan service and ecchi elements. Audience enjoyment largely depends on their investment in specific characters and tolerance for the series' prevalent tropes.
pros: Provides updates on characters after the main series.
Some episodes expand on character relationships, offering new perspectives.
Recommended for fans who enjoyed the previous seasons and are interested in specific characters.
cons: Inconsistent quality across episodes due to the anthology format.
Plot may not be compelling and focuses more on fan service.
Some characters are annoying or unlikable to some viewers.
Ecchi content may be excessive for some viewers.

anime.title: Yozakura Quartet: Hoshi no Umi
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Mythology, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
An OVA based on the Hoshi no Umi arc of the manga spanning chapters 26-34. 

This arc focuses on Rin Azuma, a Jiang-Shi yokai resident of Sakurashin adjusting to her new life in the city and working for a ramen shop. One day her former friend Zakuro Kurumaki invades Sakurashin to capture Rin and convince her to join her in destroying the city with the other yokai hunters as well as Enjin Hiizumi, the main antagonist of the series. Akina Hiizumi and the other members of the Hiizumi Life Counseling Office take action to save Rin, 'tune' the yokai controlling Zakuro and protect the city.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a decent addition for fans of the series, particularly when viewed in conjunction with Hana no Uta. However, it may not be accessible to newcomers due to the lack of character development. The art style is appreciated.
pros: Good timing to watch between episodes 8 and 9 of Hana no Uta.
Appealing art style.
cons: Hard to grasp characters without watching Hana no Uta first.
Brief explanation of characters.

anime.title: The Future Diary OVA
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Shounen, Supernatural, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis: A short OVA that was bundled with the limited edition of the eleventh volume of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The Mirai Nikki OVA is largely viewed as a promotional trailer rather than a substantial addition to the series. While some appreciate it as a preview and a faithful adaptation of the manga scenes, many find it too rushed and confusing for those unfamiliar with the source material. Ultimately, it's considered inessential viewing, mainly serving as a taster for the main TV series.
pros: Faithful adaptation of manga scenes.
Good animation quality, on par with other popular series.
Serves as a useful preview for those unfamiliar with the series.
cons: Rushed pacing and lack of context make it confusing for newcomers.
More of a trailer than a standalone OVA.
Doesn't add anything new to the story for existing fans.
Some found the voices and music unfitting.

anime.title: Demon King Daimao Specials
anime.synopsis: DVD/BD specials of Ichiban Ushiro no Daimaou.
anime.consensus_summary: The specials are a collection of very short, comedic, and ecchi-filled episodes that primarily offer fan service. While some viewers find them funny and enjoyable if they like the main anime or ecchi content, others are disappointed by the lack of story, plot continuation, and overall substance, viewing them as simply titillation.
pros: Fan service
Comedy
cons: No story
Very short episodes
Lacks plot
Disappointing continuation

anime.title: Zakuro
anime.genres: Historical, Military, Mythology, Romance, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Second Lieutenant Kei Agemaki, the son of a famous general, has hidden his extreme fear of paranormal beings all his life. However, when he and two others are reassigned to live and work with youkai in the Ministry of Spirit Affairs, he is brought face-to-face with his worst nightmare. Now with the help of the fox spirit Kushimatsu, he and his fellow officers must learn to work alongside youkai maidens—Zakuro, Susukihotaru, Hoozuki, and Bonbori—to solve paranormal cases.

Set in the midst of an alternate version of Japanese Westernization, Otome Youkai Zakuro explores the clashes and unions that can occur when east meets west, local meets foreign, and women meet men. The unusual alliance of the youkai maidens and human officers must learn to work together in a world that is changing around them.
anime.consensus_summary: Otome Youkai Zakuro is a visually appealing anime with a charming setting and focus on character relationships, though some find the plot predictable and the character development lacking. The series provides enjoyable, stress-free entertainment with heartwarming moments, despite some pacing issues. Overall, the audience consensus is positive, praising the art style and character interactions, but acknowledging the story's shortcomings.
pros: Unique setting in Meiji era Japan with Westernization themes.
Beautiful and vivid art style, especially during fight scenes.
Enjoyable character interactions and relationships, leading to heartwarming moments.
cons: Predictable plot elements and character archetypes.
Slow beginning and pacing issues, with rushed ending.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of significant character growth.

anime.title: Hetalia World Series
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody
anime.synopsis: The pasta-loving North Italy, stalwart Germany, and timid Japan continue their misadventures through history as they reenact various events leading up to and during the Second World War. This includes the turbulent relationship between Hungary and Prussia, the War of Austrian Succession, Lithuania's early days, and the Invasion of Poland. During such tumultuous times, how will these personified nations work their way through the conflicts?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is split; some appreciate the comedic and stereotypical portrayal of countries and the implied relationships between them, while others criticize the show for its lack of historical accuracy, shallow plot, and reliance on cheap humor and fanservice. There's acknowledgement of squandered potential to educate through entertainment.
pros: Good-looking lads embody the stereotypes of their countries.
Highlights the feelings between nations and opens up possibilities into what they feel.
cons: Massive waste of potential to teach history.
100% slapstick, fanservice for the girls, and cheap ethnic stereotypes.
No real plot or even a sense of direction for a main plot.

anime.title: "Bungaku Shoujo" Memoire
anime.synopsis: Episodes which depict the background stories of "Bungaku Shoujo" Movie's main heroines.
anime.consensus_summary: The "Bungaku Shoujo" Memoire OVAs are generally viewed positively for their character development and exploration of platonic love. Some technical issues and inconsistencies exist. The series is somewhat obscure, with concerns about it being forgotten by newer anime fans, yet it is recommended for those seeking healthier depictions of relationships.
pros: Characters convey their feelings effectively.
Soundtrack is calm and varied.
cons: Inconsistent character designs.
Delayed subtitles in some episodes.
Movie pales in comparison to the prequels.

anime.title: Digimon Adventure 3D: Digimon Grand Prix!
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Kids, Parody, Racing, Sports
anime.synopsis: Digimon special, Mario Kart style racing.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, though seemingly hyperbolic and lacking in detailed analysis. There's a sense of enjoyment for Digimon fans but the review lacks a critical eye. The simplistic nature of the special doesn't seem to generate much discussion or controversy.
pros: Visually stunning.
Enjoyable for fans of Digimon.
cons: Simplistic plot.
Repetitive praise lacking specifics.

anime.title: Fushigi Mahou Fun Fun Pharmacy
anime.synopsis: In a small town, there is a small pharmacy called Fun Fun Pharmacy. Popuri, a girl who recently moved in downtown, discovers this pharmacy and meets Miss Fukiko, who is actually a witch. Miss Fukiko gives Popuri a mysterious bottle that can create magic spirits.
anime.consensus_summary: Fushigi Mahou Fun Fun Pharmacy is a heartwarming and cleverly written anime reminiscent of classic children's literature. It focuses on character interactions and the town's atmosphere more than typical magical girl tropes. The show's simple animation and emotionally resonant storytelling make it a forgotten masterpiece for those who enjoy old-school anime for kids.
pros: Characterization of the townspeople is deep and memorable.
Smart, sedate, and emotionally addictive storytelling akin to children's literature.
Pantheistic connection to nature and Japanese culture.
Simple yet expressive animation, particularly Potpourri's face.
cons: Requires suspension of disbelief due to wacky elements.
May be too childish for some adult viewers.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Magical Girl, Supernatural

anime.title: Broken Blade 2
anime.romaji_title: Break Blade Movie 2: Ketsubetsu no Michi
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Fantasy, Mecha, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Second Break Blade movie.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some appreciate the action, character development, and animation quality, finding the story engaging and well-executed. Others are critical of the slow pace, melodrama, and occasional animation flaws. The consensus is mildly positive, with many viewers finding enough redeeming qualities to enjoy the film.
pros: Good animation and art.
Characters are further developed.
Story is brilliant and well-executed.
Sound and art are fantastic.
Flashbacks are well put and necessary.
cons: Some weird movements in animation.
Story can be typical at times.
Nothing happens and too much melodrama.

anime.title: Baka & Test – Summon the Beasts 2
anime.romaji_title: Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu Ni!
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
The blockheads of Class F return with more misadventures! Rather than desperately competing against the elite students in Class A for better facilities, they have other problems at hand. While the girls are constantly vying for the boys' attention, Akihisa Yoshii and Yuuji Sakamoto are being blackmailed by a stalker who threatens to reveal their most embarrassing secrets to the whole school. Moreover,  everyone's avatar starts to behave strangely. 

Filled with more nosebleeds and eye-pokes, the boys of Class F must work together to discover the stalker's identity and deal with the misfortunes that come with love among fools.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is a mixed bag. Some viewers find it hilarious and appreciate the character development, while others criticize it for lacking a strong plot and relying too heavily on generic rom-com tropes. The humor and animation are generally well-received, but the overall consensus is that it doesn't live up to the first season for many viewers.
pros: Hilarious and entertaining with unique battle system and amazing cast of characters.
Good character development, especially regarding backstories.
Animation retains manga feel with whacky expressions.
cons: Story-less, plot-less, one-dimensional harem with unoriginal rom-com elements.
Too many shots of female characters' bodies.
Lacks cohesive plot; feels like a filler season.
Overuse of nosebleeds.
The arc centered around peeping on the girls lasted way too long.

anime.title: Mai-Otome Special: Otome no Inori
anime.synopsis:
Picture Drama included in the Blu-Ray release.

Arika and Eristin have just transferred to a new school. On their way home they found a wounded lost cat and they decided to look for its owner.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is considered a sweet and enjoyable addition to the Mai Hime universe, appreciated for its cute narrative and the hinted connection between the Hime and Otome worlds. The primary critique is the desire for it to have been a fully animated episode. Overall, the audience mood is positive and appreciative.
pros: Sweet and cute episode.
Implies a link between Hime and Otome worlds.
Enjoyable follow-up to Mai Hime.
cons: Not regularly animated.

anime.title: The World God Only Knows
anime.genres: Comedy, Harem, Otaku Culture, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Keima Katsuragi, known online as the legendary "God of Conquest," can conquer any girl's heart—in dating sim games, at least. In reality, he opts for the two-dimensional world of gaming over real life because he is an unhealthily obsessed otaku of galge games (a type of Japanese video game centered on interactions with attractive girls).

When he arrogantly accepts an anonymous offer to prove his supremacy at dating sim games, Keima is misled into aiding a naive and impish demon from hell named Elucia "Elsie" de Lute Ima with her mission: retrieving runaway evil spirits who have escaped from hell and scattered themselves throughout the human world. Keima discovers that the only way to capture these spirits is to conquer what he hates the most: the unpredictable hearts of three-dimensional girls! Shackled to Elsie via a deadly collar, Keima now has his title of "God of Conquest" put to the ultimate test as he is forced to navigate through the hearts of a multitude of real-life girls.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the show's unique premise and comedic elements, while others find it repetitive, boring, and a poor adaptation of the manga. The series is divisive due to its reliance on otaku culture and dating sim tropes, which appeal to some but alienate others.
pros: Unique premise blends dating sim tropes with supernatural elements.
The main character's analytical approach to real-life relationships is entertaining.
The series offers a parody/deconstruction of harem anime conventions.
cons: The story can become repetitive and boring after the initial novelty wears off.
Some viewers find the premise silly and unbelievable.
The anime adaptation is considered a disgrace to the manga by some fans.

anime.title: Fortune Arterial: Akai Yakusoku
anime.synopsis: Fortune Arterial's story revolves around the male protagonist Kohei Hasekura, who transfers into a prestigious public school in the style of an English six-year school encompassing junior-high and high school students. The school is on an island named Tamatsu Island off-shore from mainland Japan, and the only way to get there is by boat. Soon after transferring, he discovers that one of the student in the class next door to his, Sendo Erika, is in fact a type of vampire.
anime.consensus_summary: Fortune Arterial: Akai Yakusoku is a divisive anime. Many viewers found it generic, predictable, and lacking in originality, particularly criticizing the plot, character development, and pacing. However, some viewers enjoyed the characters, especially Erika, and found the overall experience enjoyable, appreciating the romance elements and the world-building despite its flaws.
pros: Enjoyable characters, especially Erika
Decent protagonist who knows how to get things done
Good last episode for some viewers
Some found the unraveling world and character interactions enjoyable
cons: Generic and predictable plot
Lack of originality
Poor plot development and pacing
Characters lacking development, especially the protagonist
Unresolved plot points and rushed ending
Mediocre dialogue
anime.thematic_vibe: Harem, Vampire Romance, Slice of Life

anime.title: The Squid Girl
anime.synopsis:
Humans have been polluting the ocean for a long time, carelessly pouring their garbage and desecrating the waters that many creatures call home. The denizens of the sea have suffered at their poisoning hands. Finally, one certain squid has had enough and vows to punish the humans' selfish actions.

Possessing all the fearsome abilities of a squid such as powerful hair-tentacles, the ability to spit ink, and even use bioluminescence at will, Ika Musume takes it upon herself to rise from the depths of the ocean and exact revenge upon humanity! She surfaces at a certain Lemon Beach House, a restaurant managed by the sisters Eiko and Chizuru Aizawa. Thinking them to be an easy first step toward world domination, she immediately declares war against them, only to find out that she is, quite literally, a fish out of water! To make things worse, she destroys a part of a wall of the beach house in an attempt to flaunt her squiddy superiority and is consequently forced into becoming a waitress to pay the repair costs. Beached for the time being after tasting a thorough defeat at the hands of the Aizawa sisters, Ika Musume is forced to put her plans for world domination on hold.

Despite these setbacks, Ika Musume soon finds herself right at home in her unexpected position as Lemon Beach House's newest employee. Wacky and hilarious, Shinryaku! Ika Musume follows her brand new life on the surface as she makes precious memories and meet lots of new people. With her newfound acquaintances, Ika Musume is looking to take the world by storm, one squid ink spaghetti at a time!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Shinryaku! Ika Musume is well-received for its light-hearted comedy, cute characters, and unique premise. Many find it enjoyable and memorable, although some critiques include that the story is not deep, it can be repetitive, and that it is similar to other shows like Keroro Gunso. It's generally considered a feel-good anime perfect for those seeking lighthearted entertainment.
pros: Creative and original premise with a refreshing take on slice-of-life comedy.
Endearing characters, especially Ika Musume, who is considered adorable and funny.
Well-executed comedy with natural humor arising from situations rather than relying on random pop culture references.
Catchy and fitting soundtrack that enhances the overall experience.
cons: Story is not very deep and lacks significant plot buildup or focus.
Episodic nature might not appeal to viewers seeking a strong overarching plot.
Some jokes may be repetitive.
Premise is similar to Keroro Gunsou.

anime.title: Today We Start Our Love
anime.synopsis:
Hibino Tsubaki is a shy, kind, and slightly old-fashioned girl who has always been the top student in her class. She always did everything her parents wanted her to do. She loved to do other girls' hair in trendy and cute styles, despite always wearing plain braids herself.

On her first day of high school at the opening ceremony, she is astonished to see that the top student giving the opening speech is not only somebody else, but also the rudest boy she has ever seen. This delinquent turns out to be her new classmate, Kyouta Tsubaki. Kyouta teases Hibino, drawing attention to their similar last names. The two are both top of their class, but are different in every other way. Even though it seems that they cannot stand each other, fate has something else in store for them…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, largely depending on whether the viewer has read the manga. Manga readers found some enjoyment in seeing the story adapted, though they acknowledge the rushed pace and missing content.  Those unfamiliar with the manga found the anime confusing and underdeveloped, criticizing its pacing and lack of character depth.
pros: Faithful to the manga (in later parts)
Sweet storyline
Beautiful still animation scenes
Engaging development of relationship in a short time
cons: Rushed storyline; skips important plot points from the manga
Poor animation quality and fluidity
Lack of character development
Confusing for viewers who haven't read the manga
Low production values

anime.title: Mayoi Neko Overrun! Specials
anime.synopsis: Mayoi Neko Overrun! Extra.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is primarily aimed at existing fans of 'Mayoi Neko Overrun!' who are interested in fanservice and lighthearted comedy. It offers little in terms of substantial plot or character development, making it skippable for those seeking a more engaging narrative experience. The special is considered enjoyable for fans of the original series, but not recommended for newcomers or viewers looking for quality writing.
pros: Fan service for existing fans of the series.
cons: Stupid comedy.
Simple animation, especially in the opening.
Unimportant or forgettable BGM beyond the opening theme.
Lack of character development, except potentially Daigorou.
Not recommended for those seeking a high-quality or substantial story.

anime.title: Detective Conan OVA 10: Kid in Trap Island
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan OVA 10: Kid in Trap Island
anime.synopsis: In this entirely new story produced specifically for the DVD, Conan leads a group of young detectives against the phantom thief Kaitou Kid, who has his eyes set on a jewel at a hotel on an isolated island.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted, enjoyable watch for Kaito Kid fans due to his interactions with the Detective Boys. However, the plot is weak, lacking a compelling mystery and a satisfying resolution. The presence of the Detective Boys feels forced and detracts from the overall narrative quality.
pros: Kaito Kid interacting with the Detective Boys while disguised as Shinichi provides a unique and enjoyable dynamic.
The premise of mistaken identity is intriguing for fans of Kaito Kid.
cons: The plot lacks a substantial mystery or heist.
The Detective Boys' presence in the story feels arbitrary and unexplained.
The resolution of the conflict is anticlimactic.

anime.title: Digimon Fusion
anime.synopsis:
The Digital World is in a state of war, with the evil Bagra Army attempting to collect fragments of the Code Crown. Whoever manages to collect all 108 fragments will become king of the Digital World. An evil group of Digimon, known as the Bagra Army, are determined to get their hands on the Code Crown.

Digimon Xros Wars features Taiki Kudou, a soccer-loving middle schooler who will always go out of his way to help people in need. When out with his friends Akari Hinomoto and Zenjirou Tsurugi one day, he hears a voice calling out for help. Investigating the situation, he meets a Digimon named Shoutmon who has been severely wounded in a nearby alley. Using the power of a strange device called a Xros Loader, Taiki manages to save Shoutmon's life, but is pulled into the Digital World alongside Akari and Zenjirou.

Determined not to let the evil Bagra have their way, Taiki and his friends join with Shoutmon and other local Digimon to form their own army known as Xros Heart. Now Xros Heart must fight their way across the Digital World to collect Code Crown fragments and defeat the Bagra Army, but Taiki and his friends are not the only humans caught up in this war of monsters…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the fresh take with the DigiXros mechanic and enjoyable characters, particularly Mikey, while others criticize the lack of traditional Digimon evolution and the robotic designs of the combinations. Many feel the story is generic and uninspired, and aimed at too young of an audience.
pros: Enjoyable characters, especially the Digimon
Unique DigiXros mechanic is interesting
Some emotional moments, such as Baalmon's story
The main character Mikey is responsible and thinks things through
cons: DigiXros combinations look robotic and don't resemble combined Digimon
Lack of traditional digivolutions
Story and plot are uninspired and generic
Character designs are unoriginal and uninspired
Shallow and aimed at young children, lacking maturity

anime.title: Aria the Scarlet Ammo
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis: In response to the worsening crime rate, Japan creates Tokyo Butei High, an elite academy where "Butei" or armed detectives hone their deadly skills in hopes of becoming mercenary-like agents of justice. One particular Butei is Kinji Tooyama, an anti-social and curt sophomore dropout who was once a student of the combat-centric Assault Division. Kinji now lives a life of leisure studying logistics in order to cover up his powerful but embarrassing special ability. However, his peaceful days soon come to an end when he becomes the target of the infamous "Butei Killer," and runs into an emotional hurricane and outspoken prodigy of the highest rank, Aria Holmes Kanzaki, who saves Kinji's life and demands that he become her partner after seeing what he is truly capable of.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Hidan no Aria is highly polarized, with many viewers finding it to be a nonsensical, clichéd, and poorly written harem series. However, a segment of the audience acknowledges its action sequences, comedic moments, and Rie Kugimiya's performance as saving factors. Despite significant flaws, it's sometimes viewed as an enjoyable, if not deep, distraction.
pros: The action sequences and fight choreography are often described as exciting and well-animated.
The balance between action and comedy is noted as a positive by some viewers.
Rie Kugimiya's voice acting for Aria is frequently praised, even by critics who dislike the character, highlighting her iconic performance.
The art and sound design are generally considered decent to good, with some reviewers specifically mentioning good BGM and character fit.
cons: The plot is frequently criticized as nonsensical, directionless, overly clichéd, and containing illogical plot twists and character motivations.
The reliance on historical and fictional character names (Sherlock Holmes, Dracula, etc.) as descendants is seen as absurd, forced, and insulting.

The characterization is often called generic, with the male protagonist being a weak, perverted trope and the female characters falling into tired archetypes (especially Aria as an annoying tsundere).
The "Hysteria Mode" is widely seen as a stupid and lazy plot device for fan service, triggered by sexual arousal.
Animation issues such as stiff movements, characters being off-model, and bizarre hair physics are noted.
The humor is described as repetitive, falling flat, or relying too heavily on established gags.

anime.title: A Sumo Wrestler's Tail
anime.synopsis: Once upon a time, there lived an old man and his wife in a mountain. One night, he found a bunch of mice heading to somewhere. He followed them and saw the mice playing Sumo. The man and his wife happened to know the mice living in their house always lose the matches, and they gave them some foods to support the team.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find 'Chuuzumou' to be a charming, simple, and comforting short film. The film's delightful visual storytelling and accurate portrayal of sumo wrestling contribute to its broad appeal and make it a must-see at the Ghibli Museum.
pros: Delightful visual storytelling
Accurate portrayal of sumo
Suitable for all ages
Comforting and soothing vibe

anime.title: Shin Koihime†Musou: Live Revolution
anime.synopsis: Shin Koihime†Musou characters sing theme songs on stage at a live event.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience appreciates the musical aspect, particularly the opening and ending themes from the original anime. However, the overall execution is seen as lacking substance and genuine engagement. The covers are criticized for lowering the quality, and the format is deemed better executed in other similar productions.
pros: Enjoyable opening and ending songs from the anime series.
Successful emulation of a J-pop concert setting.
cons: Covers lower the quality of the songs.
Lacks substance and engagement beyond passively watching.
Better examples of this type of content can be found elsewhere.
anime.thematic_vibe: J-Pop Concert, Fan Service, Musical Performance

anime.title: Mazinkaiser SKL
anime.synopsis:
Prior to the events of the anime, three factions—the Garan Army, the Kiba Army, and the Aira Army, battle for total dominance of Machine Island. The island is basically a prison, isolated from the rest of the world. The island contains a vast amount of resources, allowing the three factions to create an infinite supply of giant robots for their respective armies.

The world government learns that the island's power reactor has become unstable and will explode within 66 hours, destroying all of life and Earth itself. The government sends the Death Caprice squad, composed of mercenaries Ken Kaido and Ryo Magami to solve the issue, along with their giant robot Mazinkaiser, but was that a good idea?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Mazinkaiser SKL for its over-the-top action, heavy metal soundtrack, and badass aesthetic. Most viewers acknowledge the weak plot and lack of character development but consider it a worthwhile trade-off for pure entertainment value. The show is appreciated for its fun and straightforward approach, appealing to fans of classic super robot anime with a modern twist.
pros: Visually stunning animation.
High-octane action sequences.
Badass characters and robot designs.
Amazing metal soundtrack.
Fun and entertaining, doesn't take itself too seriously.
cons: Weak or non-existent plot.
Lack of character development.
Repetitive setting.
Simple and stupid story
Relies heavily on violence and fan service.

anime.title: Student Council Staff Members
anime.synopsis:
On his first day of high school at the formerly all-girl's Ousai Private Academy, Takatoshi Tsuda is called out for his untidy uniform by the student council president Shino Amakusa. In apology for delaying Takatoshi for his first class—and stating that the group needs a male point of view to accommodate the arrival of boys at the school—Shino offers him the position of vice president of the student council. Though unwilling, Takatoshi finds himself appointed as the newest member of the student council having yet to even step foot inside the school building.

Takatoshi soon realizes that the other student council members who are more than a little strange: President Shino, who is studious and serious in appearance, but actually a huge pervert, fascinated with the erotic and constantly making lewd jokes; the secretary Aria Shichijou, who may seem like a typical sheltered rich girl, but is just as risque as the president, if not more so; and finally, the treasurer Suzu Hagimura, who may act fairly normal, but has the body of an elementary school student and is extremely self-conscious of it. Surrounded by these colorful characters, the new vice president must now work through a nonstop assault of sexual humor and insanity.
anime.consensus_summary: Seitokai Yakuindomo is a comedy anime that heavily relies on sexual humor. While some appreciate its clever wordplay and unique approach to the genre, others find the jokes repetitive and the lack of a central plot unengaging. The show's polarizing humor makes it a hit or miss for viewers.
pros: Clever wordplay and writing elevate the sex jokes beyond crassness.
The show has a quick, smooth pace with random humor that keeps it funny.
Unique comedy sets it apart from typical romcom/harem anime.
cons: The humor is heavily reliant on sex jokes, which may not appeal to everyone.
The show lacks a strong central plot, with each episode being self-contained.
Some find the repetitive nature of the jokes tiresome.

anime.title: Amagami SS
anime.synopsis: Two years ago, Junichi Tachibana had a date on Christmas Eve but was stood up instead. Since then, he has had a hard time showing others his true feelings in fear of being rejected again. However, as luck would have it, Junichi may have a second chance at love when he meets several girls whom he becomes romantically interested in: Haruka Morishima, the energetic and popular upperclassman with a love for cute things; Kaoru Tanamachi, his childhood friend who harbors secret feelings for him; Sae Nakata, the timid transfer student who is shy around men; Ai Nanasaki, a girl on the swim team who has a bad first impression of Junichi; Rihoko Sakurai, a childhood friend with a love for sweets; and Tsukasa Ayatsuji, a seemingly perfect class representative who has a hidden dark side. As Christmas Eve approaches, Junichi can only hope that this will be the year he will finally spend the holidays with the one he truly loves.
anime.consensus_summary: Amagami SS is a lighthearted romance anime praised for its unique omnibus format, which allows for in-depth exploration of individual heroines and their relationships with the protagonist. However, the constant resets and limited arc length prevent lasting emotional investment and character development. Despite some criticisms regarding art and sound, the series is generally considered an enjoyable adaptation of a dating sim.
pros: Unique omnibus format allows focus on individual heroines.
Each arc offers a different storyline and character dynamic.
Faithful adaptation of dating sim elements.
Well-developed characters within their respective arcs.
Enjoyable and avoids typical harem tropes.
cons: The reset after each arc undermines the emotional investment in relationships.
Limited character development due to short arc length.
Repetitive beginning of each arc.
Art style is standard and not particularly memorable.
Sound design is forgettable.

anime.title: Doraemon (2005)
anime.synopsis:
Doraemon (2005) is the most recent anime series based on Fujiko Fujio's manga of the same name.

It is the 2005 version of 1979 series.  This "remake" features upgrades to production staff, voice actors, character design, and sound.

Doraemon is a cat-like robot from the 22nd Century who appears in the present to steer Nobita/Noby, a dumb clumsy boy, onto the right path in order to secure a better future. Nobita's love interest is Shizuka Minamoto/Sue, his frenemies are Takeshi "Gian" Goda/Big G and Suneo/Sneech.  Each episode features Doraemon showing Nobita a cool gadget from the 22nd Century to help him overcome the main conflict in the episode.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Doraemon (2005) is overwhelmingly positive, particularly among families and those nostalgic for the original. While minor criticisms exist regarding pacing and animation choppiness, these are generally outweighed by the show's charm, humor, and heartwarming appeal. The remake successfully updates the classic formula, earning it a place as a beloved family show.
pros: Improved production values (character design, sound, cinematography) compared to the original series.
Engaging and heartwarming for children and families, fostering strong positive emotions.
Charming and simple art style that stays true to the original manga.
Catchy soundtracks and memorable songs, with "Friend of the Heart" highlighted as a favorite.
Well-developed characters that resonate with viewers.
cons: Pacing can be slow at times.
Animation can occasionally be choppy.
Story structure is repetitive, with Nobita often failing despite Doraemon's help.
Characters, while simple, may not feel unique to some viewers.

anime.title: And Yet the Town Moves
anime.synopsis:
Seaside Cafe is hardly what comes to mind when one thinks of a maid cafe. Hastily rebranded to jump in on the maid trend, Seaside Cafe carries no tea, offers very little in the way of service, and only gets customers from the local shopping district. Despite the cafe's humble offerings, this is where Hotori Arashiyama chooses to secretly work after school.

Balancing high school, work, family, and a love life can be difficult, and Hotori manages to stumble through without the slightest bit of grace. With the help of her friends and family, she tries to navigate her way through the wild world of adolescence where barely anything normal occurs.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Soredemo Machi wa Mawatteiru' is a well-regarded slice-of-life comedy appreciated for its unique atmosphere and quirky characters. While some find the humor and lack of a strong plot divisive, many celebrate its heartwarming moments and creative direction from Studio SHAFT. The show is seen as a hidden gem within the genre, offering a blend of mundane and surreal elements that resonate with fans of character-driven stories.
pros: Unique and immersive setting with interconnected characters.
Skilled and creative direction by SHAFT, enhancing the source material.
Well-integrated blend of comedy, slice-of-life, and occasional surreal elements.
Strong voice acting, particularly Omigawa Chiaki as Hotori.
cons: Episodic nature and lack of overarching plot can lead to pacing issues.
Humor relies heavily on Japanese wordplay and cultural references, potentially lost on non-Japanese speakers.
Some find the main characters, Hotori and Sanada, unlikable or annoying.
Inconsistent animation quality.

anime.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - A Miraculous Birthday
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch - Kiseki no Birthday
anime.synopsis:
On a lively December day at Ashford Academy, the students are joyously preparing for tomorrow’s school festival. However, the celebrations come to an abrupt halt when terrorists strike the academy. The students are taken hostage and put under lockdown as militant remnants of the Neo-Chinese Federation seize control of the school.

Little do the aggressors realize that among the student body are those with extraordinary powers, including the Geass-wielding Lelouch Lamperouge and Britannian soldier Suzaku Kururugi. To protect their school and restore the peace, Lelouch and the student council must band together again to bring about one last miracle.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Kiseki no Birthday' Picture Drama is a mixed bag for Code Geass fans. Some find it to be a fun and entertaining, especially if they are deeply invested in the characters. However, others criticize the nonsensical plot, poorly written dialogue, and unfunny humor, finding it a dramaturgical disaster saved only by the nostalgic ending.
pros: Entertaining story for Code Geass fans
Good music and voice acting
Nostalgic connection to the original series
cons: Plot makes little sense without prior knowledge of the series
Poorly constructed dialogue
Characters do not resemble the real ones from the original series
Humor isn't very funny
Dramaturgically a disaster

anime.title: One Piece Film: Strong World Episode 0
anime.romaji_title: One Piece Film: Strong World Episode 0
anime.synopsis: Set over 20 years prior to the main One Piece story, this limited release OVA chronicles the confrontation between Gold Lion Shiki and Gold Roger as well as other events around the world around the time of the Pirate King's execution.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received, providing a helpful backstory and recap of events related to Shiki and Roger. Some viewers may want to skip the beginning to avoid spoilers for the Strong World movie. Overall, the OVA increases curiosity and sets the stage for the movie.
pros: Provides backstory for Shiki.
Recaps events related to Roger and Shiki.
Features glimpses of various characters.
cons: Contains spoilers for the Strong World movie.
Brief moments, does not delve deeply into the story.

anime.title: Memory (ONA)
anime.synopsis:
Set in a post-apocalyptic world destroyed by nuclear war, it tells the story of a damaged robot found by futuristic soldiers investigating a devastated area.

The humanoid appeared to be household robot, reminiscent of Asimov, and when the soldiers booted it up, they were able to see what was left of videos recorded inside its memory as seen by the robot throughout the years.

In just under seven minutes and with no dialogue, the film poignantly reminds us that all our experiences, the things that we hold dear in our lives, are in constant threat.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the film's emotional impact and storytelling efficiency despite its technical shortcomings. Many viewers found the film deeply moving and recommended it widely. The short runtime is seen as a major advantage, making it easily accessible.
pros: Poignant storytelling despite lack of dialogue
Emotionally impactful in a short timeframe
cons: Animation quality appears dated

anime.title: Futarigurashi
anime.synopsis: Futarigurashi follows an aspiring erotic mangaka named Kenji Aoyama. In order to pay rent his friend's younger brother, Hikari Satou, offers to become his roommate. However it turns out that "he" in almost every way is a girl! The series revolves around Kenji and Hikari getting involved with various women.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Futarigurashi appears to be largely negative, with critics pointing to extremely poor animation and repetitive, uninspired comedic elements. While the presence of a continuous plot is noted as a minor positive, it doesn't redeem the series for most viewers. The show is considered a product of its time, and not in a good way.
pros: Has a continuous plot, unlike similar series.
The attempts at comedy, while not always successful, are present throughout.
cons: Animation quality is described as "impressively bad".
Relies heavily on predictable comedy clichés and "otokonoko" teasing.
Pacing issues with repetitive "should I tap it? but it's a dude" scenarios.
Lacks the charm and cuteness of comparable series like Stop!! Hibari-kun.

anime.title: Hiyokoi
anime.synopsis:
After recovering from an accident, shy and small 15-year-old Hiyori Nishiyama is finally able to attend school again after a year. While trying to introduce herself in front of her class, she is interrupted by the tall and outgoing Yuushin Hirose. To make matters worse, their stark difference in height and personality starts to attract unwanted attention to Hiyori.

Despite her unpleasant first impression of Yuushin, Hiyori becomes curious about his radiance. As the two set aside their differences, they quickly grow closer, encouraging Hiyori to break out of her shell.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly agrees that Hiyokoi is a charming and cute OVA, particularly for fans of the shojo genre. The main point of contention is its extreme brevity, with nearly every reviewer expressing a desire for a full series adaptation. While praised for its art and character dynamics, its short length prevents it from being a truly standout experience.
pros: Cute and enjoyable watch, especially for fans of the shojo genre.
Charming character designs and generally good animation quality.
Well-developed main characters for the short runtime.
Captivating story with tender moments that evoke shyness and warmth.
cons: Significantly too short; leaves viewers wanting more and feels rushed.
Generic storyline that's been seen in similar, more fleshed-out series.
Hiyori's timidness can be perceived as annoying or a flat personality trait.
Other characters, besides the main duo, are not very relevant.
Animation, while nice, is not groundbreaking.

anime.title: OreImo
anime.romaji_title: Ore no Imouto ga Konnani Kawaii Wake ga Nai
anime.synopsis:
Kirino Kousaka embodies the ideal student with equally entrancing looks. Her grades are near perfect, and to cover her personal expenses, she works as a professional model alongside her best friend Ayase Aragaki, who abhors liars and all things otaku. But what Ayase doesn't know is that Kirino harbors a deep, entrenched secret that will soon be brought to light.

At home one day, Kyousuke, Kirino's perfectly average brother, stumbles upon an erotic game that belongs to none other than his seemingly flawless little sister. With her reputation at stake, Kirino places a gag order on her sibling while simultaneously introducing him to the world of eroge and anime. Through Kirino, Kyousuke encounters the gothic lolita Ruri Gokou and the bespectacled otaku Saori Makishima, thus jump-starting an entirely new lifestyle. But as he becomes more and more involved in his little sister's secret life, it becomes that much harder to keep under wraps.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Oreimo' are divided. Some viewers appreciate the show's exploration of sibling relationships and otaku culture, praising its humor and animation. However, others criticize its incestuous undertones, stereotypical plot, and unlikeable characters, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Interesting take on bro-sis relationship.
Funny, heartwarming, and fun.
Great animation and voice acting.
Complex characters.
Explores otaku culture.
cons: Incestuous themes make viewers uncomfortable.
Storyline is stereotypical and predictable.
Kirino's character is selfish and insensitive.
Main characters don't have enough time in the limelight.
anime.thematic_vibe: Otaku Culture, Sibling Relationship, Secret Hobby

anime.title: Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Gag Humor, Parody
anime.synopsis:
The "Anarchy Sisters," Panty and Stocking, have been kicked out of Heaven for, to put it mildly, misbehaving. Led by a priest named Garterbelt, these angels must buy their way back by exterminating ghosts in Daten City. But this task requires unconventional weapons for these unorthodox angels—they transform their lingerie into weapons to dispatch the spirits. Unfortunately, neither of them take their duties seriously, as they rather spend their time in pursuit of other "hobbies": Panty prefers to sleep with anything that walks, and Stocking favors stuffing her face with sweets than hunting ghosts.

Follow these two unruly angels as they battle ghosts, an overflow of bodily fluids, and their own tendency to get side-tracked in Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt.
anime.consensus_summary: Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt is a highly divisive anime known for its crude humor, over-the-top style, and parodies of Western animation. While some viewers find its vulgarity hilarious and its unique aesthetic appealing, others are turned off by the lack of depth and reliance on shock value. The show's controversial nature has resulted in a sharply polarized audience.
pros: Unique art style and animation.
Fast-paced and energetic delivery.
Parody of Western animation tropes.
Over-the-top and unconventional.
cons: Crude humor can be offensive or off-putting.
Lack of deep story or character development.
Episodic nature can become repetitive.
Relies heavily on shock value.

anime.title: Night Raid 1931 Specials
anime.synopsis: Three un-aired episodes included on the BD/DVD volumes. See More Info for an episode list.
anime.consensus_summary: The specials are a mixed bag. Some episodes provide valuable closure and historical context, while others suffer from weak plots and confusing narratives. The episode focusing on opium dens is particularly noteworthy for its dark and unflinching portrayal, but the overall viewing experience is inconsistent.
pros: Provides closure to unresolved plot points.
Doesn't candy-coat history, offering a realistic portrayal.
cons: First special episode is confusing and not particularly special.
Plot in the second special is weak and almost non-existent.
Characters are passive observers in the second special.

anime.title: Gundam Neo Experience 0087: Green Divers
anime.synopsis: During the closing days of the Gryps conflict of Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam, two siblings—Asagi and Takuya—ride aboard a civilian transport bound for Earth. Caught in a battle between the Titans and AEUG, they must somehow guide their ship through atmospheric entry. Luckily, they're not completely alone, as they find aid from a custom-painted Zeta Gundam, whose pilot sounds a lot like One Year War ace Amuro Ray.
anime.consensus_summary: The short film is a decent, though unremarkable, addition to the Gundam universe. Its focus on realism and the inclusion of a recognizable cameo are highlights, but the forgettable characters, uninspired story, and dated animation prevent it from being truly special. The unusual dual-screen format is ultimately unnecessary.
pros: Attention to realism in space and orbital mechanics.
Enjoyable to see a 'lost' piece of Gundam media released.
Voice-only cameo at the end is appreciated by seasoned viewers.
cons: Characters are forgettable.
Story is nothing special.
Animation quality is lacking (2D interiors and CG exteriors).
Dual-screen format doesn't enhance the story.

anime.title: Night Raid 1931: The Prophecy
anime.synopsis: A recap of Senkou no Night Raid up to the 6th episode, aired on TV instead of the real episode 7 which was broadcast online.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is viewed as a useful recap that clarifies character motivations by providing missing story details. However, the inclusion of scenes from earlier episodes makes it somewhat tedious. Overall, it is considered a helpful but not entirely engaging addition to the series.
pros: Fills in necessary story bits.
Helps understand character motivations.
cons: Includes chunks lifted straight from previous episodes.
Requires careful attention to discern new information.

anime.title: Is This a Zombie?
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Ayumu Aikawa is a 16-year-old high school student who is tragically murdered while investigating a suspicious house. However, he soon awakens next to a strange armored girl called Eucliwood Hellscythe. She reveals herself to be a necromancer who has revived Ayumu, consequently turning him into a zombie! 

Now immortal, Ayumu sets out to hunt down his killer. One day, while searching in a cemetery, he encounters a boisterous young girl named Haruna, who is fighting a bear with a chainsaw while dressed as a magical girl. After she kills the beast, Haruna attempts to erase Ayumu's memories of her, but he instead absorbs her magic for himself. Stripped of her powers, Haruna now orders Ayumu to take up her role of hunting strange creatures known as "Megalo," monsters that roam the human world and terrorize the population.

Kore wa Zombie Desu ka? follows the daily antics of the human-turned-zombie Ayumu as he begins his new, ludicrous life where the supernatural becomes the norm.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a mixed bag. Many find it funny and entertaining due to its absurd humor and unique premise of a zombie magical girl. However, others criticize it for its weak story, overuse of fan service, and reliance on tired harem tropes, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Unique premise with zombie main character
Good comedy and enjoyable moments
Fun and entertaining to watch
Decent plot with unexpected events
cons: Story is weak and cliche
Overuse of fan service and harem tropes
Inconsistent and sometimes uncomfortable
Humor can be repetitive
Characters are invincible

anime.title: Nichijou - My Ordinary Life Episode 0
anime.synopsis: While the title suggests a story of simple, everyday school life, the contents are more the opposite. The setting is a strange school where you may see the principal wrestle a deer or a robot's arm hide a rollcake. However there are still normal stories, like making a card castle or taking a test you didn't study for.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Nichijou: Nichijou no 0-wa' is mixed. Some viewers appreciate it as additional content with the series' core spirit, while others find it slow-paced, less energetic, and potentially skippable. It is considered inessential for understanding the main series and may feel like a trial run or a 'light' version of Nichijou.
pros: Captures the spirit of the characters well.
Offers more Nichijou content for fans.
Gorgeous and adorable art style, animation, and voice acting.
cons: Slower pace and less energy compared to the main series.
May feel boring to some viewers.
Dissimilar to the main series and potentially confusing.
Not essential to watch; can skip and go to episodes 1-26.

anime.title: Code Geass: Akito the Exiled - The Wyvern Arrives
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Boukoku no Akito 1 - Yokuryuu wa Maiorita
anime.synopsis:
It is the year 2017, and Europe is being invaded by the forces of the Holy Britannian Empire. In an attempt to combat the opposition's overwhelming pressure and put an end to the massive casualties, the army forms a special unit called Wyvern, or W-0, composed of former Japanese citizens referred to as "Elevens." Recruited from ghettos, these young men and women pilot Knightmare frames—humanoid war machines—into dangerous operations where death awaits, hoping to make a name for themselves.

When a European regiment attempting to recapture a crucial city is pinned down by the enemy, it's up to W-0 to bail them out. Among those selected for the rescue operation is Lieutenant Akito Hyuuga, known as "Hannibal's Ghost" due to his prowess on the battlefield. However, the supposed rescue mission becomes suicidal when, in an attempt to take out as many Britannians as possible, the commanding officer initiates the Knightmare's self-destruct sequence. In its aftermath, Akito finds that he is the last one standing…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many enjoying the visual presentation and faithful adaptation of the Code Geass universe. However, some find the story lacking depth, with too many characters and forced plot elements. There's anticipation for future installments to address these shortcomings.
pros: Stunning animation and CGI, particularly in mech battles.
Engaging plot with seamless character introductions.
Faithful to the original Code Geass style and feel.
cons: Story feels incomplete and too strongly linked to the next episode.
Too many characters introduced, some feeling like throwaways.
EU depicted as a weak clone of Britannia, with forced elements.
Lacks ambition compared to the original series.

anime.title: Tales of Symphonia The Animation: Tethe'alla-hen Specials
anime.romaji_title: Tales of Symphonia The Animation: Tethe'alla-hen Specials
anime.synopsis: Specials that came with the DVDs of Tethe'alla Hen. The characters gather and talk about different things. How they are going to save the day, become the main love interest of the ladies, have increased screen-time, etc...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the Tales of Symphonia The Animation: Tethe'alla-hen Specials, finding it a pleasurable continuation of the series.  New characters and a more complex plot are highlights.  The animation quality is consistent, which some may see as a missed opportunity for improvement.
pros: Evolving plot becomes more complex and captivating.
Intense battles maintain suspense.
New characters bring a new dynamic to the story.
cons: Animation and character design remain the same (potentially indicating a lack of improvement).

anime.title: The Mystic Archives of Dantalian
anime.synopsis:
Six months ago, Lord Hugh Anthony Disward, also known as Huey, lost his eccentric grandfather, Sir Wesley Disward, who was a renowned collector of rare books. His grandfather's will states that, in order to inherit his manor and everything inside it, he must take guardianship over the Bibliotheca Mystica de Dantalian—an archive that contains forbidden knowledge—and also  take care of a mysterious girl called Dalian. 

As Huey settles into the manor, an old rival of his grandfather's arranges a meeting with him. Dalian, knowing the rival to be Wesley's killer, tags along and discovers that the murderer is in possession of a Phantom Book—a cursed tome that Wesley tried to seal away. When the book puts the two in danger, Huey discovers that the Bibliotheca Mystica de Dantalian and Dalian are one and the same, and she entrusts Huey with the key to unlocking the knowledge stored within her. Together, Dalian and Huey seal the book away, and thus begins an unlikely partnership as they solve mysteries caused by other Phantom Books.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Dantalian no Shoka. While many appreciate the show's aesthetic qualities, including its art, music, and gothic atmosphere, they are critical of its weak plot, underdeveloped characters, and confusing narrative. The episodic nature and lack of a strong overarching storyline leave viewers feeling unsatisfied, resulting in a mediocre overall reception.
pros: Beautiful and detailed art style with realistic backgrounds
Well-fitting classical themed soundtrack and opening
Interesting episodic mysteries involving magical books and forbidden knowledge
cons: Episodic format leads to disjointed narrative and lack of overall plot development
Main characters are bland and lack significant development
Unexplained concepts and plot holes leave viewers confused
Ending feels rushed and unsatisfying, failing to tie up loose ends

anime.title: Bodacious Space Pirates
anime.synopsis:
Far in the future, where interstellar travel is considered commonplace, high school student Marika Katou balances her duties in the space yacht club and her job as a restaurant waitress. Following a chance encounter with a peculiar pair of customers, Marika meets them again and learns that her absent father has passed away.

During his life, he was known as the legendary pirate "Gonzaemon." He has left behind his infamous ship Bentenmaru and its crew exclusively for Marika to inherit. With one of the few remaining Letters of Marque that permit legal piracy, Marika must choose whether to stay as a regular student or take up a second life as a high-octane space pirate.

As Marika ponders her decision, the delicate situation attracts the eyes of various government agencies and the mysterious transfer student Chiaki Kurihara, all eager to see if the upcoming captain lives up to her father's reputation. If the crew of the Bentenmaru want to maintain their status, they will need to set sail into the vast expanse of space and once again become a name to be feared.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Mouretsu Pirates are somewhat mixed.  While praised for its likable characters, unique premise, and fun adventures, some viewers found the pacing slow and the story disjointed. The show's blend of genres seems to divide viewers, with some appreciating the mix and others finding it uneven.
pros: Likeable characters with good development.
Unique blend of space opera and slice-of-life elements.
Engaging and strategic plot lines, especially in the second half.
Good world-building with historical elements like the Letter of Marque.
Fun and light-hearted tone.
cons: Inconsistent pacing, especially in the beginning.
Disjointed story arcs that don't always tie together well.
Too much unnecessary technical dialogue.
Unclear genre identity and shifts between space combat and slice-of-life.
Slow pacing may deter some viewers.

anime.title: Visions of Frank
anime.romaji_title: Visions of Frank: Short Films by Japan's Most Audacious Animators
anime.synopsis: A series of 9 animated shorts based on the Frank comics by Jim Woodring, featuring computer/CGI, traditional cel, stop-motion, and even sand painting techniques.  Contributing animators and musicians include COCOA, Eri Yoshimura, Naomi Nagata, TAMAPRO/DROP, Taruto Fuyama, Masaki Maito, Kanako Kawagushi, Masaya Sakaue, Bill Frisell, Dame Darcy, and Woodring himself.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views "Visions of Frank" as a visually impressive and unique collection of animated shorts. The experimental nature and diverse art styles are praised for keeping the experience fresh and engaging. While one episode is considered weaker, the overall consensus leans heavily towards the positive, particularly for fans of alternative and independent animation.
pros: Visually striking and bold animation
Consistently fresh and engaging due to contrasting art styles and tones
Captivating and mesmerizing surreal episodes
cons: One episode considered kind of bad

anime.title: Star Driver
anime.synopsis:
Deep beneath the surface of Southern Cross Isle, a mysterious organization known as the Glittering Crux Brigade frequently gathers in their underground fortress. The group is particularly interested in "Cybodies," stone giants which can transform into massive fighting humanoids but only in a realm known as "Zero Time." By finding and shattering the seals of the island's four seal maidens, Glittering Crux hopes to break free of Zero Time and use the Cybodies anywhere they please.

One night, a young man named Takuto Tsunashi washes up on the island's shore and is rescued by Sugata Shindou and his fiancée Wako Agemaki, one of the island's seal maidens. After he awakens, Takuto quickly befriends the two and proceeds to enroll at the local academy, where many of his fellow students are secretly members of Glittering Crux. However, Takuto holds a secret: when in Zero Time, he can utilize a Cybody of his own—the Tauburn. In the forthcoming battle, Takuto and the Tauburn will be the key to preventing Glittering Crux from shattering Wako's seal and realizing its nefarious ambitions.
anime.consensus_summary: Star Driver is a visually appealing mecha anime with a repetitive plot and shallow characters. While some find its over-the-top nature enjoyable, others criticize its lack of depth and unresolved storylines. The series is polarizing, with opinions varying on its overall quality and entertainment value.
pros: Visually appealing animation style with bright and colorful designs.
Enjoyable and fun to watch, embracing its own flaws and over-the-top nature.
Likable and interesting characters.
cons: Repetitive plot structure with a 'villain of the week' format.
Lack of character development for many characters.
Unsatisfying ending with many unresolved plot points.
Inconsistent tone and confused storytelling

anime.title: Hot-blooded Alien
anime.synopsis: A short in which a student named Ai meets an alien with a time machine. Ai also appears in the short Kobe to Watashi.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds "Nekketsu Uchuujin" to be a silly and humorous short animation. It's appreciated for its surprising detail and funny moments, but criticized for its abrupt ending and unfulfilled potential. Overall, viewers find it an amusing, though inconsequential, experience.
pros: Detailed art and animation for a short ONA
Funny visuals and line delivery
