Promising start with interesting themes
cons: Story ends too quickly
Not high-end art quality
Plot feels unfinished

anime.title: Melody
anime.synopsis: A short in which a young anthropomorphic rabbit tries to overcome the loss of his mother.
anime.consensus_summary: The short evokes a sense of melancholy through its visuals and themes of loss, with some viewers appreciating the nostalgic aesthetic and use of memory projection. However, the lack of a unique narrative and uninspired music leaves others feeling unmoved. The audience consensus suggests that while the short has potential, it falls short of being truly impactful.
pros: Effective use of projection to represent memories.
Appreciation for the old film aesthetic and grainy visuals.
Nice artwork.
cons: Story lacks unique storytelling.
Music fails to inspire or evoke strong emotions.
Pacing issues, feeling drawn out.

anime.title: A Certain Magical Index II
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
As tensions between the world of magic and Academy City continues to rise, Touma Kamijou and his hand of negation must face off against both esper and magician in order to protect the lives of those around him. Of course, he is not alone in his fight; whether by his side or out of sight, allies and enemies both old and new will enter the fray to help him.

Toaru Majutsu no Index II continues the story of action and comedy, as the scale of Touma and his allies' battle grows ever larger. A conflict is slowly brewing on the horizon, and magic and science will cross paths once again in the war to come.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the improved character motivations and action, many are frustrated by the repetitive plot, annoying characters, and lack of overall plot progression. The series has potential but doesn't fully capitalize on it, leading to disappointment for some viewers.
pros: Improved character motivations compared to the first season.
Good action sequences and visually appealing animation.
Interesting science vs. religion theme.
cons: Repetitive story arcs with a predictable formula.
Inconsistent pacing and plot development.
Annoying characters that detract from the experience.
Arcs don't connect and often feel separated.

anime.title: Hamtaro: Ham-Ham Games
anime.romaji_title: Tottoko Hamtarou OVA 4: Hamuchanzu no Mezase! Hamuhamu Kin Medal - Hashire! Hashire! Daisakusen
anime.synopsis: Considered the prequel to the fourth Hamtaro game (fifth in Japan). In this tribute to the 2004 Olympics, Hamtaro and the Ham-Hams are tasked by Prince Bo with lighting the everlasting torch to Hamcropolis. However, the Rainbow Girls will not allow this and pursue the Ham-Hams.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is largely considered a shallow promotional piece for the video game, lacking a compelling narrative. It is seen as uninteresting and skippable unless one is deeply invested in the Hamtaro TV show. There's a general sense of disappointment, with viewers finding it unworthy of their time.
cons: Uninteresting story
Poor excuse to promote the video game
Unfulfilling narrative

anime.title: The Tatami Galaxy Specials
anime.synopsis: A college student and his friends—Seitarou Higuchi, Akashi, Ozu, and Ryouko Hanuki—share various stories about a submarine that can travel through land, each one trying to outdo the others in terms of creativity. Ranging from a journey to stop the melting of the ice caps, to a quest to stop perverts from spying on girls, and to a fishing trip, no topic is off-limits.
anime.consensus_summary: The specials are divisive, with some viewers appreciating the continuation of the original's style and humor, while others find them to be pointless, nonsensical, and a waste of time. The lack of a cohesive plot and the rushed animation are common criticisms. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on one's tolerance for absurdist humor and disconnected narratives.
pros: Maintains the art style of the original series.
Offers unique character interactions not seen in the main series.
cons: Stories are nonsensical and lack plot relevance to the main series.
Feels rushed and poorly animated at times.
Characters lack depth and liveliness.

anime.title: Tales of Symphonia The Animation: The United World Episode
anime.romaji_title: Tales of Symphonia The Animation: Sekai Tougou-hen
anime.synopsis: The third and final OVA series concluding the story of Tales of Symphonia: The Animation.
anime.consensus_summary: The final OVA series provides a satisfying conclusion to the Tales of Symphonia animation, resolving the overarching story with a focus on prejudice and the importance of unity. The animation and soundtrack remain consistent, with intense battles and emotional moments adding depth. While some characters may disappear quickly, the series is generally well-received as a fitting end to the saga.
pros: Satisfying end to the series
Characters come full circle
Soundtrack is consistently good
Battles are fierce and intense
cons: Houdini characters (appear then disappear)

anime.title: The Princess and the Pilot
anime.synopsis: The war between the Levamme Empire and the Amatsukami Imperium has been raging for years. In the midst of this struggle, the prince of the Levamme Empire declares his love for Juana del Moral and vows to end the war in one year, as part of his marriage proposal. When the Amatsukami catch wind of this, they assault the del Moral residence, targeting Juana's life. As a last ditch effort to bring the prince his bride, the San Maltilia Airforce hires a mercenary of mixed blood—a bestado—to fly Juana to the Levamme capital in secret. The pilot, Charles, accepts the mission...but traversing an ocean alone, into enemy territory, proves a much more dangerous ordeal than anyone could have anticipated.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many viewers appreciated the beautiful animation, well-developed characters, and the exploration of forbidden love within a war setting. However, a significant number were disappointed by the unresolved ending, clichéd plot elements, and pacing issues, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Well-paced story with detailed character growth.
Gorgeous dogfights and beautiful animation, especially the scenery.
Excellent character design with great emotional expression, creating viewer connection.
The film explores themes of love and overcoming prejudice effectively.
Soundtrack complements the scenes and adds to the emotional impact.
cons: Unresolved ending; the story feels incomplete.
Plot contains too many cliches and predictable elements.
Mediocre animation and voice acting.
Pacing issues with too much screen time spent in the air or on the water.
Ending may disappoint those looking for a traditional romance, lacking a satisfying resolution.

anime.title: True Tears: Raigomaru to Jibeta no Monogatari
anime.romaji_title: True Tears: Raigomaru to Jibeta no Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Full version of the story featured in the TV series. Released as a special.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds value in this special as a resolution to plot points introduced in the main series, specifically the ending of Shinichiro's book. The absence of music is a noticeable drawback. Overall, it provides a comforting conclusion for invested viewers.
pros: Provides resolution to the story within the main series.
Answers questions about Shinichiro's book's ending.
cons: Lack of music diminishes the viewing experience.
Short length limits depth.

anime.title: Edokko Boy: Gatten Tasuke
anime.synopsis: Tasuke, a student in a police academy, wanted to be the manager of the academy and arrest all criminals in Edo city. Tasuke is still eleven years old, but, he really wanted to get rid of criminals so the world will be a better place to stay in. Tasuke have three other friends; Omon and the other two. With them, they work together and that is the start of a funny and sometimes serious adventure.
anime.consensus_summary: Edokko Boy: Gatten Tasuke is a generally well-received comedic anime that blends historical Japan with science fiction elements. While the show has its flaws, such as pacing issues in early episodes and abrupt ending, it is still considered enjoyable for those who appreciate old-school anime and the unique setting. The voice acting, music, and visual style are praised, contributing to its overall positive reception.
pros: Catchy opening song and appropriate music/sound effects.
Well-done voice acting.
Nicely looking anime for its period, improving visually in later episodes.
Creative mix of old Japan and science fiction elements.
cons: Early episodes can be slow paced with boring camera angles and static scenes.
Humor relies on old Japanese words and juvenile slapstick, potentially difficult to understand.
Show ends abruptly at 22 episodes, leaving many topics unexplored.
Simplification of character details in some scenes (e.g., Tasuke's feet).

anime.title: Inazuma Eleven: Saikyou Gundan Ogre Shuurai
anime.romaji_title: Inazuma Eleven: Saikyou Gundan Ogre Shuurai
anime.synopsis: An organization in the future sends the specially trained Team Ogre to defeat Endou Mamoru and his team, to prevent him from influencing the world with his soccer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with strong appreciation for the visual spectacle and emotional payoff for dedicated fans, countered by significant criticism of the plot's originality and pacing. While the action and music are praised, the reliance on recap and weak narrative structure leave some viewers feeling it's mediocre filler.
pros: Visually stunning animation, especially for the Hissatsu techniques.
Great music and voice acting that fits the characters well.
The climax is intense and satisfying for fans.
The ending montage celebrating the journey is emotionally resonant.
cons: The plot is weak, repetitive, and unoriginal, relying heavily on recapped content.
Character development is lacking, with many new characters being unappealing or one-note.
Power scaling is inconsistent and illogical, with techniques appearing prematurely or being overpowered.
The pacing is poor, with events happening arbitrarily rather than organically.

anime.title: Infinite Stratos
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
An exoskeleton weapon engineered by Japan, Infinite Stratos (IS) can be piloted only by women. Its power and combat prowess are so immense that an international treaty has been signed banning its use as a military asset. 

When it is discovered that 15-year-old Ichika Orimura is the only male capable of steering an IS, he is forcibly enrolled in the Infinite Stratos Academy: an all-female boarding school, the students of which graduate to become IS pilots. At this training school, Ichika is reunited with two of his childhood friends, Houki Shinonono and Lingyin Huang, and befriends Cecilia Alcott, an IS representative from the United Kingdom.

Guided by the legendary pilot Chifuyu Orimura—their strict homeroom teacher and Ichika's older sister—Ichika and the girls will need to use everything at their disposal to defend themselves and their academy against the dangers that will arise during the course of their thrilling school life.
anime.consensus_summary: Infinite Stratos is largely seen as a disappointing harem anime with a weak plot and underdeveloped characters, despite its initially promising premise and visually appealing design. While some viewers find it entertaining as mindless fun due to its comedic elements and character interactions, the overall consensus is that it fails to deliver a compelling or original story. The series is considered a prime example of the issues plaguing the harem genre.
pros: Catchy opening theme and decent voice acting
Visually appealing character and mecha designs
Some entertaining character interactions despite cliches
cons: Weak, generic, and predictable plot
Poor character development and unlikeable main character
Overused stereotypes and fan service
Inconsistent power levels and unexplained plot elements

anime.title: A Certain Scientific Railgun OVA: Since Misaka-san is the Center of Attention Right Now...
anime.romaji_title: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun: Misaka-san wa Ima Chuumoku no Mato desu kara
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Continuing after the Level Upper incident, another phenomenon torments Misaka. A phenomenon called "Someone's Watching," its effect feels like the electricity in one's body flow backwards. With the help of her friends, Misaka fights against the unknown enemy.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is well-received by fans of the Railgun series. It successfully captures the essence of the show, highlighting character interactions and the mystery surrounding esper powers. The animation quality is praised, and the story is engaging despite its short length, though some viewers may desire more action.
pros: Well-directed story with good pacing for a short OVA.
High-quality animation and detailed art by J.C. Staff.
Excellent character interactions and focus on the friendship between the main characters.
Successfully incorporates comedy elements without feeling cliche.
New thriller touch that felt like a nice new experience in the ToAru Universe.
cons: Some viewers may be disappointed by the lack of action.
The ending might feel conjured or rushed.

anime.title: Tamayura
anime.synopsis:
As a child, Fuu "Potte" Sawatari and her late father would often visit his hometown of Takehara and take pictures of the surroundings together. Now, five years since their last visit, Fuu and her family have moved to the town so that she can start attending high school. Although her father has been deceased for some time, Fuu carries on his legacy through her love of photography and the pictures she takes with his old camera.

Believing that photographs have the power to turn the ordinary into something wonderful, Fuu and her friends grab every opportunity they can to capture the magic of everyday life on film and bring happiness to someone in the world who might need it.
anime.consensus_summary: Tamayura is generally well-received as a gentle and heartwarming slice-of-life anime, praised for its soothing atmosphere and relatable characters. However, some viewers find the slow pace and lack of a strong plot to be drawbacks. Overall, it is appreciated for its nostalgic and sentimental qualities, creating a cozy viewing experience.
pros: Heartwarming and soothing atmosphere.
Beautifully captures the simple joys of everyday life.
Likeable and relatable characters with pleasant interactions.
Evokes a sense of nostalgia and warmth.
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers.
Limited story or plot development.
Some find the characters or setting unengaging.
Lacks action or high stakes drama.

anime.title: Angel Beats! Specials
anime.synopsis: As the Shinda Sekai Sensen (SSS) continue their vindictive rebellion against God, their leader, Yuri Nakamura, comes up with an ingenious plan to escape the afterlife. Her subordinates prepare to carry out "Operation High Tension Syndrome" to deceive Kanade Tachibana, student council president and alleged associate of God, into thinking that they are ready to pass on. With a week's worth of food on the line and with Heaven as the ultimate prize, will the SSS members be able to fool the inscrutable Kanade?
anime.consensus_summary: The Angel Beats! Specials are generally well-received as lighthearted, comedic extensions of the original series.  Most viewers appreciate the adherence to the established characters and art style.  While some find the humor excessive or one episode poorly written, the overall sentiment is positive for fans seeking more content in the Angel Beats universe, with the specials considered a worthwhile, albeit less impactful, addition.
pros: Fits seamlessly into the existing Angel Beats universe, maintaining character consistency and charm.
Successfully expands on the series' humor, offering light-hearted and enjoyable content.
High-quality animation and soundtrack consistent with the original series.
cons: Some found the humor too chaotic or overwhelming.
A minority felt that one of the OVA episodes was poorly executed and out of character.
Lacks the emotional depth and impact of the main series.

anime.title: A Certain Scientific Railgun: Being a Photo Shoot Model Under the Blazing Sun Isn't Easy, Is It?
anime.romaji_title: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun: Entenka no Satsuei Model mo Raku Ja Arimasen wa ne.
anime.synopsis: Special beach episode bundled with the official visual book.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views this OVA as a lighthearted, short comedic fan service piece that stays true to the characters of the original anime. While it doesn't offer plot development or significant humor, its charm lies in familiar character interactions and enjoyable production values for existing fans.
pros: Characters behave consistently with the original anime.
Well-done sound design.
Enjoyable even with less fan service towards the end.
Funny, especially with Kuroko's typical behavior.
cons: Lacks a substantial story or plot.
Not particularly funny or ecchi as intended.
Doesn't contribute to the To-Aru storyline or universe.

anime.title: Hakuoki: Demon of the Fleeting Blossom - Record of the Jade Blood
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Historical, Josei, Samurai, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
After the conclusion of Hakuouki, Chizuru Yukimura and the Shinsengumi are forced to flee Kyoto and set sail for Edo. In their commander Isami Kondou's absence, vice-commander Toshizou Hijikata steps in as acting commander. However, Hijikata is not only struggling with the extra leadership duties—which worries everyone around him—but also a newfound uncontrollable bloodlust. To make matters worse, the urge does not affect him alone, and it is even beginning to drive some of his subordinates mad.

Finally, Kondou returns with orders from the emperor to defend the castle, and a new name for their squad: the Kouyou Chinbutai. But in war, the balance of power can shift suddenly and allegiances can waver. In Hakuouki Hekketsuroku, Chizuru follows the Shinsengumi into the heart of war and continues the search for her missing father, all while the bond between her and Hijikata grows ever stronger.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some praising the anime's historical accuracy, action, and emotional depth, while others criticize the weak female lead, lack of romance, and overly tragic storyline. Fans of historical dramas and character-driven narratives tend to appreciate the series, while those seeking a strong romance or more lighthearted fare may be disappointed. Despite criticisms, the anime is generally considered to be well-made and engaging for its target audience.
pros: Strong focus on historical events and characters.
Well-developed characters with realistic motivations.
Excellent action sequences and fight choreography.
Good sound and music that fits the era.
Emotional depth and impactful scenes.
cons: Female lead (Chizuru) is often seen as weak and underdeveloped.
Romance is minimal and not a primary focus.
Story can be overly sad and tragic.
Some plot elements are rushed or illogical.
Too many plot elements detract from a structured progression.

anime.title: Arakawa Under the Bridge x Bridge
anime.romaji_title: Arakawa Under the Bridge x Bridge
anime.synopsis: On the beautiful banks of the Arakawa River, it is lively as ever. Now known as "Recruit," Kou Ichinomiya has adjusted to the troubles his unconventional neighbors brew daily. However, the atypical scene is about to get even rowdier when their community adds a couple of oddball enthusiasts: a tall, muscular woman calling herself Amazoness, followed by her loyal Tengu henchmen; and Captain, self-proclaimed Commander of Earth's Defense Force against Venusians. In spite of all the commotion, Recruit gradually learns more about his lover Nino and the story that shaped her.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the consistent humor and character interactions, finding it a worthy continuation of the first season. Others are disappointed by the lack of plot progression, unresolved storylines, and repetitive jokes. The consensus suggests enjoyment hinges on expectations regarding plot development versus comedic entertainment.
pros: Consistent with the first season's quality.
Strong character interactions and focus on relationships.
Good balance of comedy and parody with serious moments.
Introduces new, entertaining characters that fit well into the existing cast.
cons: Lacks overall plot direction and significant character development.
Unresolved plot threads and unanswered questions from the first season.
Some gags are unfunny and overstay their welcome.
Fails to deepen the relationship between the main characters or resolve ongoing issues.

anime.title: Saiyuuki Gaiden
anime.synopsis: In their former lives, 500 years before Genjyo Sanzo and his crew of misfits began their journey west, they were gods, but being godly didn't make them act any more divine. When Goku flies into a murderous rage after seeing his best friend die, Heaven's had enough and wants him dead! But Konzen Douji, Field Marshal Tenpou, and General Kenren are willing to do anything to protect Goku, even if it means turning all of Heaven against them.
anime.consensus_summary: Saiyuki Gaiden is highly praised for its emotional depth, tragic storyline, and well-developed characters, making it a favorite among Saiyuki fans. While the anime adaptation is considered good, the manga version is preferred. Viewers recommend watching episodes 40 and 41 of the original series for context, though the OVA stands alone.
pros: Touching and heartbreaking character relationships.
Amazing story and well-developed characters.
Strong emotional impact that lingers after watching.
cons: Anime adaptation not as good as the manga.
Pacing is fast and can be chaotic, especially for those not concentrated.
Can be confusing to newcomers without prior knowledge of the Saiyuki series.

anime.title: Hamos: The Green Chariot
anime.synopsis: The Planet Terra, once called a morning star in galactic system, was so beautiful. However, Terra is now under crisis that it may disappear with big explosion in universe due to the pollution and warfare. Dr. Chaco is the only one who knows the key of saving the planet Terra. The only way to save Terra is to make rainbow system work with seven mysterious crystals. To find 7 crystals, Dr. Chaco holds a race to achieve his plot to build his own universal dynasty with the power of the crystals. Riding Hamos Rick joins the race not knowing Dr. Chaco''s plot. Rick comes to know the secret of the crystals on the way of the race, tries to revive the planet Terra. This causes a war between Dr. Chaco and Rick to get the 7 crystals and rainbow system.
anime.consensus_summary: The reviewer expresses immense nostalgia and appreciation for 'Nogsaegjeoncha Hamos,' highlighting its surprisingly dark yet hopeful story, fantastic art and animation, and memorable characters. They emphasize the show's impact and express bewilderment at its lack of wider recognition. The review is overwhelmingly positive, suggesting a strong emotional connection and a belief in the show's high quality and underappreciated status.
pros: Fantastic art style with diverse landscapes and distinctive character designs.
Highly detailed and expressive animation, especially in action scenes.
Memorable music, particularly the original Korean opening theme.
Characters are fun, human, and well-developed.
cons: Some parts of the story are cheesy.

anime.title: Pokémon: Black & White
anime.synopsis: When Satoshi and his mother accompany Professor Ookido to the distant Isshu region, Satoshi discovers Pokémon that he’s never seen before… and that he can’t wait to catch! He may have Pikachu at his side together with new friends Iris and Dent, but he’ll still need plenty of new Pokémon on his team if he wants to challenge Isshu's expert Gym Leaders. His quest to become a Pokémon Master just got even tougher!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is polarized, with some appreciating the fresh start and updated visuals, while others criticize the regression of Ash's character and the repetitive plot. Nostalgia plays a big role, with some viewers blinded and others feeling betrayed because of it. The season is divisive, making it one of the weakest Pokemon generations for some, while still enjoyable for newcomers.
pros: Good for newcomers due to soft reboot
Updated character designs and animation quality
Many Pokemon catches and battles
cons: Ash's regression in skill and knowledge
Repetitive storytelling and predictable plot
Inconsistent character development
Fillers are boring

anime.title: Amagami SS Short Animations
anime.synopsis: According to the official website, two-volume OVA of Amagami SS will be distributed to those who purchase all the volumes of the DVD/Blu-rays of the TV series. The first volume will carry three short episodes of Haruka, Kaoru and Sae. The second volume will contain Ai, Rihoko and Tsukasa’s episodes.
anime.consensus_summary: The Amagami SS OVA is well-received by fans of the original series as a fun and enjoyable addition to each girl's story arc. Viewers appreciate the consistent character portrayals and humorous content, though the OVAs are brief. Prior knowledge of the main series is essential to fully appreciate these add-ons.
pros: Provides closure or additional scenes for each main female character's arc.
Maintains consistent character personalities from the original series.
Humorous and engaging despite the short length of each OVA.
cons: The OVAs are very short (around 5 minutes each).
Understanding requires prior knowledge of the main series.

anime.title: Beelzebub: Hirotta Akachan wa Daimaou!?
anime.genres: Action, Childcare, Comedy, Delinquents, Mythology, School, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
The delinquents of Ishiyama High School either fear Tatsumi Oga or wish to defeat him, but the young fighter finds himself preoccupied with other matters—like tending to baby Kaiser de Emperana "Beel" Beelzebub IV, the son of the Demon Lord.

Baby Beel's maid, Hildegard "Hilda," informs Oga that the infant has latched onto him due to the former's immense strength. In turn, Oga must take responsibility and raise the Demon Lord's son, or face Hilda's blade—that is, unless he can find someone stronger than him to appeal to Beel. Perhaps Oga can convince one of the Tohoshinki, composed of the four strongest fighters of Ishiyama High, to take Beel off his hands!
anime.consensus_summary: The special episode is generally not recommended for new viewers as it spoils the initial plot points and character introductions of the anime. It is considered a better experience to watch it after completing the first 20 episodes or the entire series. The episode is only useful for those familiar with the manga.
pros: Good summary of the initial plot for manga readers.
cons: Spoils the plot and character introductions.
Ruins the surprise and excitement of the initial episodes.
Not worth watching before the main anime.

anime.title: Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas 2
anime.romaji_title: Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas - Meiou Shinwa 2
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Mythology, Shounen
anime.synopsis: The sequel to Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas - Meiou Shinwa.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas receives mixed reactions. While many praise its animation, character development of the Gold Saints, and faithfulness to the manga, others criticize its rushed plot, simplistic characters, and overuse of plot armor. The audience is divided, with some considering it a superior Saint Seiya adaptation and others finding it disappointing.
pros: High graphic quality and animation
Well-developed Gold Saints with interesting backstories
Faithful adaptation of the manga with narrative additions
Exciting and progressively darker plot
cons: Bleak characters and simplistic story in some opinions
Rushed plot development and character progression
Overuse of plot armor
Excessive sentimentalism

anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Sacred Star of Milos
anime.romaji_title: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Sacred Star of Milos
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Chasing a runaway alchemist with strange powers, brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric stumble into the squalid valley of the Milos. The Milosians are an oppressed group that seek to reclaim their holy land from Creta: a militaristic country that forcefully annexed their nation. In the eye of the political storm is a girl named Julia Crichton, who emphatically wishes for the Milos to regain their strength and return to being a nation of peace.

Befriending the girl, Edward and Alphonse find themselves in the midst of a rising resistance that involves the use of the very object they have been seeking all along—the Philosopher's Stone. However, their past experiences with the stone cause them reservation, and the brothers are unwilling to help.

But as they discover the secrets behind Creta's intentions and questionable history, the brothers are drawn into the battle between the rebellious Milos, who desire their liberty, and the Cretan military, who seek absolute power.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some fans appreciating the action and new setting, while others find the plot generic and the writing sloppy. Many feel it doesn't live up to the standards of the original series or Brotherhood. The movie is generally considered a decent but unremarkable addition to the Fullmetal Alchemist franchise.
pros: Exciting action sequences.
Good voice acting (especially original cast).
Energetic background music.
A new story in a different part of Amestris.
Thematic relevance to real-world conflicts.
cons: Generic and uninspired plot.
Filler and uninspired scenario.
Forgettable guest characters.
Sloppy writing with hasty character introductions.
Predictable mysteries and idealism.
Inconsistencies with established lore.
Too much focus on new characters, not enough on iconic ones.

anime.title: Black Butler II Specials
anime.synopsis:
According to the Kuroshitsuji website, there are 6 OVAs included in the DVD releases.

DVD 2: Ciel in Wonderland (Part 1)
This re-imagines the cast of Kuroshitsuji II as characters in Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland story.

DVD 3: Welcome to the Phantomhive's
This is meant to be like a simulation game. Elizabeth invites a lady (perhaps the viewer) to join her at a ball held at the Phantomhive mansion.

DVD 5: The Making of Kuroshitsuji II
This is a Hollywood style documentary with behind the scenes interviews with Sebastian, Ciel, Claude and Alois etc.

DVD 6: Ciel in Wonderland (Part 2)
This re-imagines the cast of Kuroshitsuji II as characters in Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland story.

DVD 8: The Tale of William the Shinigami
William and Grell have to train new shinigami and reminisce about when they were training partners.

DVD 9: The Spider's Intention
The life in Trancy household and how those work under Alois is caring for him.
anime.consensus_summary: The Kuroshitsuji II Specials are a mixed bag, generally enjoyed more by fans of the series who appreciate the humor and character exploration. While some episodes are praised for their comedic value and deeper character insights, others are criticized for weak plots and excessive silliness. The specials offer a lighthearted departure from the main series' dark tone, but their quality varies.
pros: Humorous and lighthearted contrast to the main series.
Provides deeper character insights, especially for side characters and backstories.
Offers a unique twist on familiar stories (Alice in Wonderland) and formats (documentary).
cons: Inconsistent quality across episodes.
Some find the humor and silliness to be excessive or cringeworthy.
Plots in some episodes are weak and uninspired.

anime.title: Kaibutsu Oujo (OVA)
anime.synopsis:
Based on a manga by Mitsunaga Yasunori, serialised in Monthly Shounen Sirius.

Hiyorimi Hiro moves to a new city to live with his older sister, but dies before he can find her. He then awakens to a new life as a servant of a Princess of the Monster Realm, who just happens to be employing his sister. Monsters soon appear to attack or pester the princess since she is in line for the royal throne, and Hiro must protect her with his life (and repeated deaths).
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is viewed as a remake with some improvements over the original anime, mainly a greater focus on the princess and added content. However, the episodic nature and lack of narrative cohesion are criticized, alongside some aspects of the artwork. Overall, the audience seems mildly appreciative, favoring the OVA over the parent anime for its added elements, but acknowledging its shortcomings.
pros: OVA has more focus on Hime and her siblings.
Includes content not present in the parent anime (panty scenes).
Maintains horror, comedy, action, and supernatural elements.
cons: Random episodic stories lack connection.
Monsters appear and disappear without consequence.
Artwork may not be up to par with the main anime (character faces appear longer).
Hiro's lack of impactful power diminishes the story.

anime.title: Motto To LOVE Ru
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Rito Yuuki never gets a break—he's always finding himself in lewd accidents with girls around him. Although his heart still yearns for Haruna, his childhood love, Rito can't help but question his feelings for Lala, the alien princess who appeared in front of him and declared she would marry him. But now, it's not just Lala he has to deal with: her younger twin sisters, Momo and Nana, have also traveled to Earth, wanting to meet their older sister's fiancé, and just as luck would have it, they end up staying at Rito's home.

Meanwhile, amidst the bustle of his new family members, Yami, the human weapon girl, begins her pursuit for Rito. It's not an easy life for Rito as he deals with uncertain love, punishment for being a pervert, and a girl dead set on murdering him.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Motto To LOVE-Ru is well-received as a fun and entertaining ecchi comedy. The improved art, faster pacing, and increased focus on comedic elements are praised, while some find the lack of a strong overarching plot and reliance on perverted situations to be drawbacks. The show is recommended for fans of the genre who are looking for lighthearted entertainment.
pros: Improved art style and animation compared to the first season.
More focused on comedy and ecchi aspects.
Episodes are split into shorter segments, allowing for more content and faster pacing.
Follows the manga more closely than the first season.
Characters are well-developed and have unique personalities.
cons: Story is often secondary to comedy and ecchi, with many episodes being stand-alone.
Plot holes and lack of explanation for certain character introductions.
Some viewers may find the excessive perverted situations repetitive or uninteresting.
May not appeal to viewers who prefer a stronger overarching plot.

anime.title: K-ON!!: Ura-On!!
anime.synopsis: Extra short anime "Ura-On!!" included in the limited edition of the K-ON!! Blu-ray.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally view Ura-On!! as a light-hearted, silly comedy special that provides enjoyable, low-stakes humor for fans of K-On!. While the art style and lack of a cohesive plot are noted drawbacks, the overall sentiment is that it succeeds in its goal of being a funny, brain-off experience for existing fans.
pros: Light-hearted and funny, providing a cure for sadness after watching K-On!
Packed with silly and funny moments that make viewers feel better
Good for a laugh, with enjoyable episodes even with a weird art style
The 'What If' scenarios and imagination elements are engaging
Characters' personalities are well-represented and recognizable
cons: MS Paint-like art style is very simple and can be perceived as 'retarded' or badly drawn
No real storyline, just random themes per episode
Comedy relies heavily on 'broken humor' and might not be universally funny
Voice acting and audio sound unpolished
Animation is basic with minimal movement

anime.title: Heart and Yummie
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Anthropomorphic, Childcare, Fantasy, Kids
anime.synopsis:
By a twist of fate, a herbivorous dinosaur finds a lost egg and brings it back to her nest. When the egg hatches, however, a carnivorous dinosaur emerges. Unable to abandon the child, she names him "Heart" and raises him in exile alongside her own child. As Heart comes of age, he struggles to eat the same food as his family and runs away in disgrace when he learns that he cannot live properly without meat. 

Years later, the now feared predator Heart encounters a situation similar to his past—he spots a dinosaur egg opposite his kind. As it emerges, Heart remarks that the newborn is delicious-looking. The newborn herbivore thinks that Heart is his father and takes delicious-looking, or "Umasou," as his name. Unable to eat a newborn who loves him, Heart reluctantly decides to raise Umasou as his own. As he nurtures a forbidden child like his mother before him, Heart struggles to deal with an unforgiving world and the true natures of predator and prey.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Reviewers found 'Omae Umasou da na' to be a surprisingly heartwarming and enjoyable movie with lovable characters and a well-written story. Despite some minor critiques regarding the art style and occasional plot inconsistencies, the movie is generally praised for its emotional depth and ability to appeal to a wide audience.
pros: Lovable and believable characters
Well-written story with emotional depth
Surprisingly well-animated, especially fight scenes
Unique and enjoyable art style
Good music
cons: Art may not be the highest budget or most up-to-date
Some parts of the story don't make much sense

anime.title: Kowarekake no Orgel
anime.synopsis:
In 2039, helper androids are widespread as general purpose electronics.

Keiichiro lost his family in a traffic accident and retired from his band. One day, he finds an android of an old model in a garbage dump. He takes her home, but after taking her to a repair shop he was told that she couldn't be repaired, so he plans to throw her away. The next day, Keiichiro finds her making breakfast for him. Thus begin the summer days of an android with no memories and a dreamless boy.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Kowarekake no Orgel' positively as a touching and visually appealing short anime. Its emotional narrative and well-crafted characters resonate with many viewers, creating a heartwarming experience.  However, some find its brevity and reliance on familiar tropes to be limitations, but overall it's considered a worthwhile watch for its emotional impact and artistic merit.
pros: Beautiful animation and detailed backgrounds enhance emotional impact.
Well-developed characters foster strong emotional connection in a short time.
The story explores themes of loss, healing, and finding purpose effectively.
cons: Short length limits depth of plot and character development.
Predictable plot elements and cliches may detract from originality.
Some viewers may find the pacing too slow or the emotions forced.

anime.title: Occult Academy Specials
anime.synopsis: Short spin-off episodes included in Blu-ray/DVD volumes of the main series.
anime.consensus_summary: The specials are a lighthearted and cute addition to the main series, focusing on younger versions of the characters. They lack the intensity of the original show but serve as a pleasant way to ease out of the completion of the series. Most viewers find them enjoyable as a short, optional watch.
pros: Light and fun spin-off.
Eases the feeling of finishing the main series.
cons: Void of the intensity of the main show.
Not a must-see.

anime.title: Super Robot Wars OG: The Inspector
anime.romaji_title: Super Robot Taisen OG: The Inspector
anime.synopsis: With many of its central personnel lost in the war, the Earth Federation Government is forced to rebuild, and Brian Midcrid, president of the Unified Colonies, takes the position of its president. During an emergency session of the Federation Diet, he publicly acknowledges the existence of extraterrestrials, and reveals the events of the L5 campaign to the masses in what will later come to be called the "Tokyo Declaration." He goes on to state that these aliens pose a serious threat to humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is divided. Fans of the Super Robot Wars game series tend to enjoy 'The Inspectors' due to their familiarity with the characters and lore. However, newcomers or those unfamiliar with the games may find the anime confusing and lacking a cohesive narrative, resulting in a less satisfying viewing experience.
cons: Lack of overarching plot
Too many characters
Plot holes and lack of character development for non-game players
Difficult to understand without prior knowledge of the games

anime.title: Broken Blade 3
anime.romaji_title: Break Blade Movie 3: Kyoujin no Ato
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Fantasy, Mecha, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Third Break Blade movie.
anime.consensus_summary: The third Break Blade movie is praised for its high production values, particularly the art, animation, and sound. The story delves into the impact of war and character development, though some aspects are considered unconvincing or lacking. Overall, audience sentiment is positive, appreciating the continuation of the narrative.
pros: Outstanding art and animation quality.
Realistic and high-quality sound design.
Good character development, especially Rygart's transformation.
Story explores the causes and effects of war effectively.
cons: Some character development feels out of context (e.g., Cleo).
Certain plot points or character actions may seem unbelievable or embarrassing to some viewers.
Pacing or focus on specific aspects (school, geography) could be improved.

anime.title: Steins;Gate
anime.genres: Drama, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Eccentric scientist Rintarou Okabe has a never-ending thirst for scientific exploration. Together with his ditzy but well-meaning friend Mayuri Shiina and his roommate Itaru Hashida, Okabe founds the Future Gadget Laboratory in the hopes of creating technological innovations that baffle the human psyche. Despite claims of grandeur, the only notable "gadget" the trio have created is a microwave that has the mystifying power to turn bananas into green goo.

However, when Okabe attends a conference on time travel, he experiences a series of strange events that lead him to believe that there is more to the "Phone Microwave" gadget than meets the eye. Apparently able to send text messages into the past using the microwave, Okabe dabbles further with the "time machine," attracting the ire and attention of the mysterious organization SERN.

Due to the novel discovery, Okabe and his friends find themselves in an ever-present danger. As he works to mitigate the damage his invention has caused to the timeline, Okabe fights a battle to not only save his loved ones but also to preserve his degrading sanity.
anime.consensus_summary: Steins;Gate is a highly praised anime centered around time travel, with a complex and intriguing storyline that captivates many viewers. However, it receives criticism for a slow start and potentially overhyped status. While many consider it a masterpiece, some find the characters stereotypical and the plot confusing, leading to a somewhat polarized reception.
pros: Unique and complex time travel story.
Intriguing plot with unexpected twists.
Powerful and almost flawless ending.
Explores time travel concepts well (time paradox, butterfly effect).
cons: Slow and boring start (first 12 episodes).
Overhyped and doesn't live up to expectations for some.
Characters can be seen as stereotypical and one-dimensional.
Plot can be confusing or messy for some viewers.

anime.title: Kizumonogatari Part 1: Iron-Blooded
anime.synopsis:
During Koyomi Araragi's second year at Naoetsu Private High School, he has a chance encounter with Tsubasa Hanekawa, the top honor student in his class. When they strike up a conversation, Hanekawa mentions a shocking rumor: a vampire with beautiful blonde hair and freezing cold eyes has been seen lurking around town.

Happy to have made a new friend, Araragi writes off the rumor and goes about the rest of his evening in a carefree manner. However, on his way home, he stumbles across splatters of blood leading down the stairs to the subway. His curiosity pushes him to investigate further, so he follows the gruesome pools into the depths of the station. 

When he arrives at the source of the blood, he is terrified by what he sees—the rumored blonde vampire herself, completely dismembered. After she calls for his help, Araragi must make a decision, one which carries the potential to change his life forever.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided. Some viewers praise the film's stunning visuals, masterful direction, and faithfulness to the source material. However, others criticize the slow pacing, overuse of CGI, and alterations to character portrayals, leading to disappointment for long-time fans of the Monogatari series.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style, particularly the character art and unique camera angles.
Excellent music and voice acting that enhance the overall atmosphere.
Faithful adaptation of the source material, capturing the ideological perspectives of the main character.
cons: Pacing issues with too much time spent on drawn-out scenes and minimal plot progression.
Inconsistent animation quality with overuse of CGI that clashes with the 2D animation.
Character portrayals that deviate from the established personalities in the series, particularly Araragi.

anime.title: Heartcatch Precure! Movie: Hana no Miyako de Fashion Show... desu ka!?
anime.romaji_title: Heartcatch Precure! Movie: Hana no Miyako de Fashion Show... desu ka!?
anime.synopsis: Sakura Kurumi, Erika's mother, is preparing for a fashion show in Paris. The girls of the school's fashion club are going to model there, including some high school students. While in Paris, they meet a mysterious boy named Oliver. However, Baron Salamander of the Desert Apostles appears, and the girls transform into Pretty Cures to defend Paris.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a well-received addition to the Heartcatch Precure series, enhancing the overall experience. It features emotional moments and great interactions between characters. The visuals are also noted to be appealing.
pros: Touching story
Great character interactions
Visually appealing

anime.title: Hanasaku Iroha: Blossoms for Tomorrow
anime.synopsis: Ohana Matsumae is an energetic and wild teenager residing in Tokyo with her carefree single mother. Abruptly, her mother decides to run away with her new boyfriend from debt collectors, forcing the young girl to fend for herself—as per her mother's "rely only on yourself" philosophy—in rural Japan, where her cold grandmother runs a small inn. Driven to adapt to the tranquil lifestyle of the countryside, Ohana experiences and deals with the challenges of working as a maid, as well as meeting and making friends with enthralling people at her new school and the inn.
anime.consensus_summary: Hanasaku Iroha is a visually appealing and heartwarming slice of life anime that focuses on character development and workplace dynamics. While some viewers find the story engaging and relaxing, others criticize its lack of direction, melodramatic elements, and unresolved plot points. Overall, the series is generally well-received for its animation and characters, but its pacing and drama are points of contention.
pros: Beautiful animation and scenery
Relaxing and heartwarming story
Well-developed characters
Good balance of comedy and drama
cons: Story can feel directionless or boring in the middle
Some find the drama to be melodramatic or forced
Romance is slow-paced and may not satisfy all viewers
Plot can be jumbled and unresolved

anime.title: Fractale
anime.synopsis:
The world has been at peace since the establishment of the Fractale system. Sustained by the Fractale terminals implanted in their bodies, people live in isolation, free to focus on their own interests. Clain Necran spends his days collecting technological relics from the time before the Fractale's introduction. The only company he keeps is his parents' Doppels, or advanced holographic clones.

Clain soon meets Phryne—the first human girl he has ever met—and he instantly finds her fascinating. However, Phryne is being pursued by the anti-Fractale group known as The Lost Millenium, and she leaves a strange artifact in Clain's care before disappearing. Deciding that he needs to rescue Phryne and return her belongings, Clain sets out to find her. His journey takes him deep into the heart of the Fractale system, where learning the truth behind it poses more danger to him than he could possibly imagine.
anime.consensus_summary: Fractale is a visually appealing anime with an interesting premise, but it suffers from poor execution, underdeveloped characters, and a convoluted plot. Many viewers found the story fragmented and confusing, with unanswered questions and unsatisfying resolutions. While some appreciated the themes explored and the Miyazaki-esque art style, the overall reception is mixed, with many considering it a disappointing missed opportunity.
pros: Interesting concept and setting with pre-industrial age technology meets young man's adventure.
Well-written characters who act believably to every situation.
Beautiful art style reminiscent of Hayao Miyazaki films, with bright watercolor visuals.
Fantastic orchestral scores that complement both action and quiet moments.
Raises interesting questions about the relationship between man and technology.
cons: Poor execution and underdeveloped characters.
Too little revealed about the Fractale system, leaving too many unanswered questions.
Clain is constantly being led by the nose, and his actions are always a result of how the story drives him.
Unsatisfying animation that fails to deliver spectacular backgrounds or smooth animating.
Plot finishes up on a revelation that God is not 16 years old, but actually 10 and therefore pure.

anime.title: Dragon Crisis!
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: A normal high school boy Kisaragi Ryuji's peaceful life is turned into an adventure by the return of his second cousin Eriko. Ryuji and Eriko seize a relic box from a black broker. In the box, they find a red dragon girl Rose. In order to protect Rose from the black organization, Ryuji decides to fight using his power as a relic handler.
anime.consensus_summary: Dragon Crisis! is viewed as a fairly generic and uninspired harem anime with a predictable plot and shallow characters. While some appreciate its lighthearted nature, catchy music, and appealing art, most find it unremarkable and lacking in originality. The series doesn't elicit strong negative reactions but is generally considered a mediocre and forgettable addition to the genre.
pros: Catchy opening theme (Immoralist by Horie Yui)
Appealing art style and animation quality
Enjoyable and fun characters (Ai and Eriko are often highlighted)
cons: Unoriginal and generic story
Poorly explained plot elements and world-building
Lack of character depth and development
Overreliance on harem cliches

anime.title: Dream Eater Merry
anime.synopsis:
High school student Yumeji Fujiwara has the ability to see people's dreams. Despite the visions never appearing clear or concrete, he is able to predict them by sensing the person's "aura." Normally, this skill is a fun trick to play on his classmates, but Yumeji only ever sees himself having the same nightmare every night.

To his surprise, the nightmare continues in the middle of the day even before Yumeji has fallen asleep. The unexpected event was triggered by a dream demon—an inhabitant of the world of dreams who wants to use Yumeji's body as a vessel to fully enter the real world. However, Yumeji is saved by the timely arrival of Merry Nightmare, another dream demon who can somehow physically manifest without a host and is instead trying to return to her own realm.

As more dream demons continue to push into reality, it is up to Yumeji and Merry to fight back against the invasion before everyone's nightmares materialize.
anime.consensus_summary: Yumekui Merry presents an intriguing concept with a unique visual style, but suffers from poor execution. Many viewers feel the anime squanders its potential through inconsistent quality, underdeveloped storylines, and rushed pacing. While some praise the character designs and music, the consensus is that the anime fails to deliver a satisfying conclusion or fully explore its promising premise.
pros: Interesting premise exploring the concept of dreams and their connection to reality.
Unique and imaginative dream world designs.
Catchy opening and ending themes, and generally well-executed sound design.
Likeable characters
cons: Inconsistent art quality and animation, particularly during fight scenes.
Rushed pacing and underdeveloped plot points, with several plot threads being introduced and then abandoned.
Poor character development, especially for side characters, and illogical character behaviors.
The ending feels rushed and unsatisfying.

anime.title: .hack//Quantum
anime.synopsis: Tobias, Mary, and Sakuya challenge the impregnable "The One Sin", but they lose their way in the maze and unintentionally trap other guild members. A mysterious cat is watching their blunder. Is it another player character or NPC?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some find it a good entry point to the .hack series with enjoyable characters and action, while others criticize its confusing plot and rushed ending. Long-time fans may find it doesn't measure up to previous installments, but newcomers may appreciate its accessibility and animation quality.
pros: Accessible to newcomers to the .hack franchise.
High production values and animation quality.
Likable and funny characters.
Well-choreographed action scenes.
cons: Storytelling can be confusing and nonsensical.
Ending feels rushed and incomplete.
May not stand up to other entries in the series for long-time fans.
Unexplained game mechanics can be confusing for newcomers.

anime.title: Coicent
anime.synopsis: Five hundred years in the future, Shinichi Kakimoto is on a class trip to the ancient Japanese capital of Nara, now represented by an AI recreation of Himiko, the first documented leader of Japan. In the chaos of trying to avoid the hungry deer, Shinichi gets separated from his peers and runs into Toto, a strange girl who claims she has never been outside before. As the two explore the city, they develop a bond that will be tested when aggressive pursuers come after Toto.
anime.consensus_summary: Koi☆Sento is a short, visually distinct anime with a simple romance plot. Viewers appreciate the unique blend of sci-fi and Buddhism, but find the story rushed and the 3D animation style off-putting. The short length leaves little room for character development or deeper themes, resulting in a fleeting but not particularly memorable experience.
pros: Unique art style (though divisive)
Sweet romance despite short runtime
Good English dub acting
cons: Rushed story and underdeveloped characters
Unusual 3D animation style that can be jarring
Superficial plot with little depth
anime.thematic_vibe: Sci-Fi Romance, Futuristic Buddhism, Quick Romance

anime.title: Megane na Kanojo
anime.synopsis: For most people, wearing glasses is a necessity for clear sight, but for four young girls, their spectacles mean so much more. From a teenage girl wearing her glasses with pride and a top idol who uses hers to disguise herself as a regular person, to a couple whose bent frames bring them closer together, a good pair of glasses can not only open your eyes, but also open your heart.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Megane na Kanojo" for its sweet and heartwarming romance stories, praising its lighthearted nature and relatable characters. The main criticism is its short length, with viewers wishing for more episodes. While some find the concept simple and not particularly deep, the overall consensus is positive, especially for those seeking a quick and enjoyable romance anime.
pros: Each episode is a self-contained, heartwarming romance story.
The characters are quirky and relatable.
The anime is a quick and enjoyable watch.
Pacing is great, delivering complete stories in a short time.
Relatable and realistic characters enhance the viewing experience.
cons: The anime is very short (only 4 episodes).
The stories are simple and not deeply complex.
Male character designs could be more creative.
Some find the focus on glasses as a central theme forced or generic.
Lacks strong comedic elements and can be dull at times.

anime.title: Cheburashka
anime.synopsis: The stop-motion animated film based on Russia's Cheburashka character.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Reviewers praise the film's heartwarming nature, its beautiful stop-motion animation, and its faithfulness to the original Cheburashka stories. It's considered a nostalgic and enjoyable experience for both children and adults.
pros: Visually beautiful stop motion animation.
Respectful to the original Cheburashka story and character designs.
Simple, warm, and touching story suitable for children and adults.
Good soundtrack and memorable songs.

anime.title: Battle Spirits: Brave
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Military, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
Two years ago, the world was saved by Dan Bashin and the other light bearers of the cores. Having once risked his life in Grand Rolo's strife, Dan no longer finds passion in the mundanity of everyday card battles. When Dan desires to clash against stronger opponents, he is approached by Mai Shinomiya. She offers to bring him to the future, the stage of a new conflict where Dan's strength is needed.

The two arrive in the year 2650, where civilization has been ravaged by the struggle for power between mankind and an otherworldly race known as "Mazoku." As humanity begins to crumble under the dominance of the Mazoku, the hardened light bearers are destined to cross paths once more. Armed with new cards from the future, Dan and the other warriors must yet again bear the fate of humanity on their shoulders.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Battle Spirits Brave, particularly praising its engaging plot and strong characters. However, some viewers suggest watching the prequel for a better understanding. The series is considered a good card game anime with mecha elements.
pros: Engaging plot with character relationships.
Strong start with sustained momentum.
cons: May require knowledge of the prequel (Dan).
Setting feels held back.

anime.title: D.C. I&II P.S.P. Re-Animated
anime.synopsis: An OVA bundled with a PSP game Da Capo: D.C. I & II P.S.P. It features animated confession scenes for the four main heroines of the two games, Nemu, Kotori, Yume, and Otome.
anime.consensus_summary: The general mood is mixed, leaning towards positive for existing fans of the Da Capo games due to the visual representation of the confessions. However, the strong incestuous themes and reliance on familiarity with the games make it less appealing to a broader audience. The animation quality is a consistent highlight, but the short confession scenes and potentially off-putting themes limit its overall appeal.
pros: Great animation quality.
Satisfying for fans of the Da Capo games.
Visual representation of love confessions from the game.
cons: Heavily reliant on prior knowledge of the games.
May not be enjoyable for those unfamiliar with the source material.
Incestuous themes may be off-putting to some viewers.
Confessions are brief and potentially lacking in depth (5 minutes each).

anime.title: Sekirei: Pure Engagement Episode 0
anime.synopsis: Episode 0, consisting of two subepisodes: "Sekirei Shindan" (鶺鴒診断) and "Sekirei Yoka" (鶺鴒余暇), of Sekirei: Pure Engagement included on the first DVD/BD volume.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely agrees that this episode is primarily a fanservice-heavy "fun" watch with enjoyable visuals and voice acting, but it offers little in terms of plot or character development for the main series. Opinions are split between those who appreciate the ecchi content as its main draw and those who find its lack of narrative substance disappointing.
pros: Visually stunning fanservice
Enjoyable characters
Good voice acting (both Japanese and English)
Fun and hilarious
cons: Lacks significant story progression
Minimal character development
Content heavily focuses on ecchi/fanservice at the expense of plot

anime.title: Maid Sama!: It's an Extra!
anime.romaji_title: Kaichou wa Maid-sama!: Omake da yo!
anime.synopsis: Upon returning home from her part-time job, Misaki Ayuzawa asks her mother to mend her maid uniform, which she accidentally tore while moving potted plants at Maid Latte. However, Misaki's younger sister, Suzuna, volunteers to fix the uniform instead. After quickly repairing the damage, Suzuna shows interest in trying on the maid attire, greatly alarming Misaki. As she attempts to prevent the embarrassing situation from escalating, Misaki must also tend to unexpected guests in her house!
anime.consensus_summary: The special episode is a lighthearted addition that caters to fans wanting more of the characters and world. However, it's largely considered non-essential, lacking a compelling plot or meaningful contribution to the main story. Many viewers found it underwhelming and wished for a more substantial and purposeful special episode.
pros: Provides more content for fans of the series.
Offers a cute and fun, albeit short, extra episode.
Maintains the art and sound quality consistent with the main series.
cons: Lacks a significant plot or contribution to the overall storyline.
Felt like a tacked-on bonus rather than an essential addition.
Failed to resolve unanswered questions from the main series.
Disappointing for viewers expecting a more substantial special episode (e.g., date scenario).
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Romantic Comedy, Fan Service

anime.title: Freezing
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Military, Romance, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Decades into the future, humanity is under siege by an alien race known as the Novas. These inhuman beings leave devastation in their wake whenever they appear, with the efforts to stave them off becoming known as Nova Clashes. Young women known as "Pandoras" and young men known as "Limiters" are implanted with stigmata to give them superhuman powers and are trained in military academies, where they must learn to work together if humanity is to have a chance of surviving.

Freezing tells the story of Kazuya Aoi as he sets out for his first day at the West Genetics military academy, right when a battle royale is being undertaken by the Pandoras. It is here that he mistakes Satellizer el Bridget—a powerful Pandora known as the "Untouchable Queen"—as his deceased sister and embraces her. Though he costs her the match, she finds that his touch doesn't drive her away and decides to take him as her Limiter. The only question is whether or not their partnership can survive the machinations of their upperclassmen and the impending battle with the Novas…
anime.consensus_summary: Freezing is a deeply divisive series, praised for its action, art, and Satellizer's character development, but heavily criticized for its overwhelming and often gratuitous fan service, weak plot, and underdeveloped supporting cast. While some appreciate its faithful adaptation and potential, many find the excessive ecchi elements detract significantly from the narrative, creating a polarizing viewing experience.
pros: Faithful adaptation of manga material, covering a significant portion of the available content.
Decent animation and sound design, with well-choreographed action sequences and fitting soundtracks.
The core premise of aliens invading Earth and genetically modified soldiers fighting back has potential and is occasionally compelling.
Satellizer el Bridget is a well-developed protagonist with a sympathetic backstory and compelling character arc.
cons: Excessive and gratuitous fan service, often overshadowing the plot and character development.
Incoherent and poorly explained plot, with confusing terminology and a slow pace that leaves many questions unanswered.
Weak characterization for most of the cast, with too many underdeveloped characters and unoriginal archetypes.
Inconsistent writing and pacing, with plot points rushed or neglected, and an unresolved ending suggesting a lack of planning.

anime.title: Ground Control to Psychoelectric Girl
anime.synopsis:
Makoto Niwa meticulously tallies the amount of positive and negative youthful experiences he engages in as if to grade his own life. When his parents go overseas, he moves to a new town to live with his aunt, welcoming the change and ready for a fresh start. However, as ordinary as he had imagined his adolescence to be, he could never have taken the existence of an enigmatic long-lost cousin into account.

Upon moving into his aunt's house, he discovers the cousin he never knew about: Erio Touwa. Despite being Makoto's age, she couldn't be more different: Erio chooses to wrap herself in a futon all day rather than to go to school. She even claims to be an alien, and with a speech pattern and personality to back it up, any chance of Makoto's dreamt-of normal life is instantly tossed out the window.

As he meets a string of other eccentric girls in town, Makoto must face the possibility of seeing his youth points in the red. However, he might be surprised by how thrilling an abnormal youth can be.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating the show's unique art style and quirky characters, while others find the plot lacking and the eccentricities overbearing. The show's handling of supernatural elements is a point of contention. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on appreciation for the show's unconventional approach and character-driven narrative.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation, especially from Studio Shaft.
Unique and quirky characters contribute to the show's charm.
Enjoyable blend of comedy and exploration of deeper themes like trauma and personal growth.
cons: Plot can feel unfocused and lacking a clear direction.
Reliance on eccentricities can overshadow the story.
The supernatural elements are not well-integrated and can feel ridiculous.

anime.title: Miyanishi Tatsuya Gekijou: Omae Umasou da na
anime.romaji_title: Miyanishi Tatsuya Gekijou: Omae Umasou da na
anime.synopsis: A Tyrannosaurus called Heart was raised by a herbivorous dinosaur. As he grew up, he was scared by other dinosaurs. One day, Heart meets a baby Ankylosaurus and he names the baby "Umasou (looks delicious)". Umasou started to be attached to Heart and a strange family love develops between the two.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is appreciated for its heartwarming story and character depth, making it enjoyable for a wide audience. The primary critique is the simplicity of its artwork. Overall, it is positively received as a classic and touching tale.
pros: Well-written and appeals to all ages
Classic story about warmth shared by Umasou and his family
Character depth and story
cons: Lacks in artwork

anime.title: Mitsudomoe: Oppai Ippai Mama Genki
anime.synopsis: Hitoha, the youngest of the Marui triplets, frequently gets into trouble with her sister Futaba, who likes the sensation of playing with her soft cheeks. Hitoha's predicament worsens when a pimple resembling a breast appears on her cheek, and she begins attracting unwanted attention at school. Meanwhile, the oldest sister, Mitsuba, messes with sports equipment, putting herself in tough situations. No matter the circumstances, the sisters' time together never grows dull.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is positive for fans of the Mitsudomoe series. This special provides more of the same humor and style. The reliance on 'oppai' jokes is the primary focus, so those not keen on that may not enjoy it as much.
pros: Consistent with the main series' humor and style.
Offers more of what fans of Mitsudomoe enjoy.
cons: Relies heavily on 'oppai' jokes, which may become repetitive.
Skits may feel disjointed.
anime.thematic_vibe: Crude Humor, Raunchy, Slice of Life

anime.title: Yume-iro Pâtissière SP Professional
anime.synopsis:
Upon her return to Japan after a two year study break in Paris, Ichigo Amano is met with news of Team Ichigo's separation, as each of the Sweets Princes takes a different path toward their dream. Now in her first year of high school, Henri Lucas has a project in store for her, enlisting the help of Ichigo, Makoto Kashino, and new members Lemon Yamagishi and Johnny McBeal to give rise to a new Team Ichigo. As the four work together on this project, Ichigo and Makoto continue to grow closer, though Johnny and the unrelenting Miya Koshiro will not idly sit by; with Johnny's eye on Ichigo and Miya still after Makoto, it definitely seems like love won't come easily.

With Ichigo's time at St. Marie Academy, she is now ever closer to her dream of starting her very own pâtisserie. However, she will soon realize that it takes more than just making delicious sweets to open up a shop.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided, with many feeling that Yumeiro Patissiere SP Professional doesn't live up to the first season. While some appreciate the focus on romance and character development, others find the plot rushed, boring, and lacking in the baking inspiration that defined the original series. The ending is considered unsatisfying, and the overall consensus is that the season is a disappointment compared to its predecessor.
pros: Kashino x Ichigo relationship development
Characters look more mature
cons: Rushed storyline
Not as memorable as the first season
Boring plot
Too much focus on romance, not enough on baking
Unsatisfying ending
Incomplete character arcs

anime.title: Baka & Test - Summon the Beasts OVA
anime.romaji_title: Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu: Matsuri
anime.synopsis: OVA of Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu which was announced to be released before the start of the second series.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Matsuri' OVA is a lighthearted extension of the first season, delivering more of the same humor and antics.  While fans of the series will likely enjoy it, the OVA doesn't offer anything new and may feel repetitive. It's considered a fun but ultimately inessential addition to the Baka to Test franchise.
pros: Faithful to the series' humor and characters.
Animation and sound quality are consistent with the first season.
cons: Recycled jokes and plot format.
Lack of character development.
Story can be nonsensical and relies heavily on existing knowledge of the series.

anime.title: Coppelion
anime.synopsis:
At first glance, Ibara Naruse and her friends Aoi Fukasaku and Taeko Nomura look like average, carefree high school students. But the streets they walk on, their destination, and their surroundings are anything but normal. As they continue forward, the trio find themselves stepping deeper into an uninhabitable version of Tokyo, one that has been ravaged by a nuclear disaster 20 years ago.

As part of the Dispatch 3rd Special Force Coppelion, known as the Health Care team, Ibara, Aoi, and Taeko are supported by the Japanese Ground Self-Defense Force (JGSDF) and Colonel Onihei Mishima as they scour the eerily silent streets for survivors. Finding the last remaining humans and having them evacuated by the JGSDF's helicopters is a daily occurrence for the girls. But as their work progresses, Ibara and her friends start to question their own humanity—namely, how they themselves are able to survive in Tokyo without any protective gear.
anime.consensus_summary: Coppelion is largely considered a disappointment, with initial promise squandered by poor writing and character development. While praised for its visual aesthetics and soundtrack, the repetitive plot, melodramatic characters, and logical inconsistencies ultimately detract from the overall experience. Many feel the series failed to deliver on its potential, resulting in a frustrating and unfulfilling viewing experience.
pros: Visually appealing backgrounds and scenery.
Good opening and ending themes.
Intriguing premise of genetically engineered humans in a post-apocalyptic setting.
cons: Weak and inconsistent writing with plot holes and illogical scenarios.
Underdeveloped and unlikable characters with poor motivations.
Repetitive story arcs with little character development.
Overreliance on melodrama and crying, hindering emotional connection.
Inconsistent character design that clashes with the post-apocalyptic setting.
anime.thematic_vibe: Post-Apocalyptic Melodrama, Environmental Disaster, Genetically Modified

anime.title: Cencoroll Connect
anime.synopsis: The sequel to Cencoroll.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Cencoroll Connect is seen as a visually appealing and intriguing continuation of the original. While some viewers found the repetition of the first film and certain characters problematic, many appreciated the unique art style, animation, and world-building. There is anticipation for the third installment and the potential expansion of the series.
pros: Unique art style and animation.
Interesting world and creature designs (Cencorolls).
Enjoyable and intriguing plot, especially for a one-man animation project.
cons: The first 25 minutes of Cencoroll Connect are a repeat of the first Cencoroll.
Some find the character Yuki frustrating and dislikable.

anime.title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Arcadian Memory
anime.romaji_title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Arcadian Memory
anime.synopsis: Two OVA that summarize the series.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is well-received by existing fans as a nostalgic recap, triggering emotional memories of the series. It's appreciated for its soundtrack and concise storytelling. However, it's acknowledged that the recap is not a substitute for watching the full series and may not be as impactful for newcomers.
pros: Beautiful soundtrack
Concise recap of the series
Triggers emotional response
cons: Better appreciation with full series viewing
Only serves as a summary
May not be satisfying for new viewers

anime.title: Mitsudomoe Zouryouchuu!
anime.synopsis: Satoshi Yabe has grown accustomed to being class 6-3's homeroom teacher. Since his assignment, the Marui triplets have used countless antics to play around with him. As a result, however, Yabe and the sisters learn more about each other. Continuing their last year in elementary school alongside Yabe, the triplets and their classmates never fail to stir up trouble and play pranks on one another.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's humor and characters. Some viewers take issue with the oversexualization of the children and joke about morality and the show's short run. Ultimately, most viewers enjoyed the series as a lighthearted, comedic escape.
pros: Hilarious gags and comedic timing.
Unique and well-developed characters.
Enjoyable and heartwarming moments despite oversexualized jokes.
cons: Lack of a strong central story.
Repetitive humor, not much difference from the previous season.
Over-sexualized jokes that may not appeal to all viewers.
Very short season length.
anime.thematic_vibe: Crude Humor, Family, Slice of Life

anime.title: Beelzebub
anime.genres: Action, Childcare, Comedy, Delinquents, Mythology, School, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ishiyama High is a school populated entirely by delinquents, where nonstop violence and lawlessness are the norm. However, there is one universally acknowledged rule—don't cross first year student Tatsumi Oga, Ishiyama's most vicious fighter.

One day, Oga is by a riverbed when he encounters a man floating down the river. After being retrieved by Oga, the man splits down the middle to reveal a baby, which crawls onto Oga's back and immediately forms an attachment to him. Though he doesn't know it yet, this baby is named Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV, or "Baby Beel" for short—the son of the Demon Lord!

As if finding the future Lord of the Underworld isn't enough, Oga is also confronted by Hildegard, Beel's demon maid. Together they attempt to raise Baby Beel—although surrounded by juvenile delinquents and demonic powers, the two of them may be in for more of a challenge than they can imagine.
anime.consensus_summary: Beelzebub is largely well-received for its humor and unique premise of a delinquent raising a demon baby. While the comedy is a strong point, some find the plot weak and the later episodes less focused. Despite some criticisms, it's generally recommended for those looking for a lighthearted and funny anime.
pros: Genuinely funny with laugh-out-loud moments.
Unique and original plot centered around a delinquent raising a demon baby.
Likable characters with decent development, especially the main duo Oga and Beel.
Excellent voice acting enhances the comedic delivery.
Good blend of comedy and action, although comedy is the stronger element.
cons: Storyline is weak and can become monotonous, especially in later episodes.
Show becomes unfocused, shifting from demons to action, losing some comedic charm.
Humor can be hit or miss, with some episodes feeling stretched and cringy.
Ending leaves viewers unsatisfied; pacing issues and toning problems.
Some dated elements, such as over-the-top stereotyped characters.

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard
anime.synopsis:
Taking the world by storm, the card game Cardfight Vanguard has influenced many to integrate card games into their everyday lives. Players of the popular game are called "cardfighters," and they frequently battle each other in card shops. The game has inspired many people, one of which is the quiet and timid Aichi Sendou who is often ridiculed and bullied by his peers. Whenever he feels down, he takes a glance at Blaster Blade—a legendary rare card given to him when he was young—and gains the motivation to move on with his life. 

However, one day, school bully Katsumi Morikawa notices Aichi's treasure and snatches the card away from him. After a turn of events, Aichi soon discovers that the card is now in the hands of Toshiki Kai, a cardfighter who has become the strongest in town despite having only recently arrived. To make matters worse, Kai refuses to return the card unless Aichi defeats him in a cardfight. 

Much to everyone's surprise, Aichi rises up to the occasion. As he musters up his courage and pictures himself winning this decisive battle, Aichi begins to find his way into the adventurous world of Cardfight Vanguard.
