Background music effectively complements the scenes despite not being typical One Piece OST.
cons: The 3D animation style is jarring for some viewers, resembling a video game cutscene rather than the anime.
The 3D animation can be disorienting and detract from the impact of comedic or action moments.
The art style is not well-suited for One Piece's character designs, leading to awkward facial expressions.
The short runtime (30 minutes) leaves viewers wishing for more content.

anime.title: Tetsujin 28-gou: Hakuchuu no Zangetsu
anime.synopsis:
This theatrical version based on the manga by Yokoyama Mitsuteru, deals with the genius boy detective Kaneda Shotaro and his giant robot, Tetsujin 28, set in Tokyo ten years after the end of the Second World War.

Shotaro's missing brother appears as a a new character who was trained as a pilot of the soldier robot Tetsujin which Japan had created for the Second World War. However, with the end of the war, there was nothing left for him but a peaceful Japan. In the meantime, "Destruction Bombs" are found in many places in Tokyo. The bombs were developed by Professor Kaneda, the creator of Tetsujin 28 and Shotaro's father, as the ultimate weapons to protect the mainland. If the bombs explode, Tokyo will be reduced to ashes.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the consensus is that this movie is a disappointing departure from the original series. Many viewers feel it doesn't live up to the established standards, with character inconsistencies and a trivialized plot being major drawbacks. While the animation and music maintain a certain quality, the film ultimately fails to capture the depth and impact of its predecessor.
pros: Music and animation are as good as in the show.
Visual presentation of the finale will be extremely familiar to you if you've seen Giant Robo.
cons: Movie doesn't live up to the standard set by its predecessor.
Characters are just completely out of character.
Tetsujin itself was treated as a character with its own arc and themes in the series, and yet, it's just a plot device here.
Antagonists' motivations range from shallow to a tad incomprehensible, and some of them are just trivialized versions of the same antagonists from the series.
The short length prevents both the impact and depth it presented.

anime.title: Carnival Phantasm
anime.synopsis:
The Carnival Moment is a time when several narratives from Type-Moon's famous works intersect. It happens every decade in an entirely new dimension, and those who have never run into each other can meet. And what's more, all individuals involved gain the opportunity to fulfill any of their wishes! However, they will have to come a long way, as they will need to partake in contests.

In Carnival Phantasm, various characters are put into situations that ridicule their own worlds. Nevertheless, they all have the same objective: to win the contests by any means necessary!
anime.consensus_summary: Carnival Phantasm is overwhelmingly beloved by Type-Moon fans as a hilarious and creative parody of the franchise. Its reliance on inside jokes makes it less accessible to newcomers, but for those familiar with the Nasuverse, it's considered a must-watch. The series prioritizes comedy and fan service over a serious plot, resulting in a lighthearted and enjoyable experience.
pros: Excellent parody of Type-Moon works
Hilarious and creative
Enjoyable for Type-Moon fans
cons: Requires extensive knowledge of the Nasuverse to fully appreciate
Simplistic art style may not appeal to everyone
Lacks a serious plot

anime.title: Shouwa Monogatari (Movie)
anime.synopsis: Dramatic story of the Yamazaki family during the year Showa 39 (1964), the year that Tokyo hosted the Summer Olympics.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Shouwa Monogatari as a simple and heartwarming slice-of-life movie, highlighting family bonds and character development. Some find the plot too straightforward and lacking in significant events, while others enjoy its nostalgic portrayal of a typical family during a significant year for Japan.
pros: Character development of the Yamazaki family
Emphasizes the bond between a loving family
Father gets decent screen time and development
cons: Too plain and straightforward
Nothing grand or remarkable happens

anime.title: Shouwa Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Dramatic story of the Yamazaki family during the year Showa 39 (1964), the year that Tokyo hosted the Summer Olympics.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response to Shouwa Monogatari is mixed, with some finding it a nostalgic and immersive slice-of-life experience, while others find it too mundane and lacking in engaging elements for a broader audience. The show's success hinges on the viewer's connection to the specific sense of nostalgia it cultivates. Production values are generally adequate but not exceptional, with voice acting being a notable weakness.
pros: Believably depicts cultural norms, technologies, major events and trends of 1960s Japan.
Evokes a general atmosphere of 'the good days gone by'.
Music and visuals do a good job in giving it that hazy nostalgic feel.
Use of period music and commercial jingles feels authentic.
Post-credits scene showcases real-life locations and includes old photographs.
cons: Lacks a major hook to engage wider audiences.
Too mundane with its tone.
Voice acting is often stiff, sometimes bad enough to break immersion.
Animation wasn't the highest priority.

anime.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
anime.synopsis:
In the bustling and futuristic city of Heartland, a young boy named Yuuma Tsukumo has a dream that everyone his age wants to achieve—earning the title of the greatest duelist! Sadly, due to his lackluster dueling skills, this dream is far from achievable. But when the school bully, Ryouga "Shark" Kamishiro, splits the key given to him by his father into two pieces, he inadvertently sets Yuuma on a collision course with his dream.

Retaining one half of the key, Yuuma begins a duel with Shark, but soon realizes that his inexperienced skills are no match for him. In a sudden turn of events, Yuuma's key repairs itself, and the "Door of Destiny'' appears before him. Using the key to open it, Yuuma is greeted by an alien by the name of Astral—a being only he can see. 

The bewildered Yuuma soon learns that his memories have been divided into 100 "Number Cards," all of which he must retrieve. However, he is also not the only one looking for them. Bombarded by these revelations, Yuuma, alongside Astral, must defend the world from the upcoming threats that loom over Heartland City—regardless of any divine intervention that may occur.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Yu☆Gi☆Oh! Zexal is divided, with many finding the initial episodes slow, childish, and uninspired. However, a significant portion of viewers find the later story arcs, character development, and soundtrack to be redeeming qualities. There is a strong suggestion to persevere past the initial episodes to experience the more rewarding aspects of the series, particularly Zexal II.
pros: Soundtrack is excellent and fits the mood well.
Some character designs are memorable and unique.
Later episodes become engrossing and fascinating.
Character development is surprisingly deep, especially for Yuma, Shark and Kaito.
Story becomes more focused and serious as it progresses.
cons: Slow start with many filler episodes.
Yuma's companions, aside from a few, lack development and are unlikable.
Childish tone and simplistic plot can be off-putting.
Inconsistent animation quality, with some episodes appearing lazy.
Repetitive 'villain of the week' format in the first season.

anime.title: Dragon Ball Z: Plan to Eradicate the Super Saiyans
anime.romaji_title: Dragon Ball: Super Saiya-jin Zetsumetsu Keikaku
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Remake of Dragon Ball Z: Plan to Destroy the Saiyajin. Extra on Dragonball Raging Blast 2 game on X360/PS3.
anime.consensus_summary: The remake is a visually updated version of the original OVA but suffers from a rushed plot and a lack of depth. While some appreciate the improved animation, the consensus leans towards disappointment due to the weak storytelling and uninspired atmosphere. The inclusion of characters from other films is a potentially positive element, but not enough to redeem the overall negative impression.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to Dragon Ball Z Kai.
Inclusion of characters from other films is a potentially positive element.
cons: Rushed plot and lack of depth compared to the original OVA.
Failure to create an intriguing atmosphere or build tension.
Weak villain introduction and uninspired story.
Questionable animation style that may not appeal to all fans.

anime.title: OreImo Specials
anime.romaji_title: Ore no Imouto ga Konnani Kawaii Wake ga Nai Specials
anime.synopsis: The true end arc of Ore no Imouto. These four episodes branch out after the 11th episode of the main TV series and present an alternative version to the end of the TV series. These episodes contrast with the good end arc of the TV series, which was an original ending written for the anime, and instead closely follows the original story from the light novels.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Ore no Imouto' Specials are generally well-received as a more faithful and character-driven conclusion to the first season, particularly praised for its focus on Kuroneko.  However, opinions are divided on the handling of Kirino and the overall impact on the original anime's ending. The specials are considered essential viewing for fans wanting a complete narrative experience, especially before watching Season 2.
pros: Provides a 'true' ending to the first season, more faithful to the light novels.
Expands on side characters, especially Kuroneko, offering satisfying development.
Introduces new, enjoyable characters that enrich the dynamic.
cons: Some find the initial episode redundant, rehashing content from the original series.
Kirino's presence or lack thereof is a point of contention for some viewers.
Certain character arcs, like Manami's, feel underdeveloped and unsatisfying.
anime.thematic_vibe: RomCom, Slice of Life, Otaku Culture

anime.title: From Up on Poppy Hill
anime.genres: Award Winning, Historical, Romance, School, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
Atop a hill overlooking a seaside port sits a boarding house named Coquelicot Manor. Since the building is run by her family, Umi Matsuzaki carries out many of the duties involved in managing the small establishment, such as preparing meals for her fellow boarders. When she isn't at home, she is a student at the local high school—one that is currently dealing with a small crisis.

In anticipation of the upcoming Olympic Games, a beloved old clubhouse is set to be demolished to make way for a modern building. As a result, a large part of the student body has banded together, working tirelessly to prevent this from happening. Umi finds herself helping the newspaper club to spread information about this cause where she befriends Shun Kazama, whom she gradually begins to fall in love with. But Shun is an orphan who doesn't know much about his origins, and when the two begin searching for clues to the boy's past, they discover that they may have a lot more in common than either of them could have thought.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some finding the film a charming and heartwarming story with beautiful animation, while others consider it a simplistic and somewhat flawed addition to the Ghibli catalog. The film's lack of depth and inconsistencies in the narrative are common points of criticism, while its nostalgic atmosphere and likeable characters are praised. Ultimately, reception seems to depend on individual expectations of a Ghibli film.
pros: Beautiful animation and detailed backgrounds create a magical atmosphere.
Charming and likeable characters, especially the supporting cast.
Heart-warming story with themes of family, change, and embracing the past.
The music effectively encapsulates the energy of youth.
cons: Story can feel simplistic and lack depth compared to other Ghibli films.
Characters may not be particularly in-depth or rich.
Some inconsistencies and plot holes in the narrative.
May lack the magical or fantastical elements expected from Ghibli.

anime.title: Bakuman. Season 2
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Otaku Culture, Romance, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
With the serialization of their new manga, "Detective Trap," the writer-artist team, Akito Takagi and Moritaka Mashiro, better known by their pseudonym Muto Ashirogi, are one step closer to becoming world-renowned mangaka. For Mashiro, however, serialization is just the first step. Having promised to marry his childhood sweetheart and aspiring voice actress, Azuki Miho, once his manga gets an anime adaptation, Mashiro must continue his to popularize Ashirogi's work. A tremendously competitive cast of ambitious mangaka—including the wild genius, Eiji Niizuma; the elegant student, Yuriko Aoki, and her older admirer and partner, Takurou Nakai; the lazy prodigy, Kazuya Hiramaru; and the abrasive artist, Shinta Fukuda—both support and compete against Muto Ashirogi in creating the next big hit.

As they adjust to their young and seemingly untested new editor, the dynamic duo struggle to maintain their current serialization, secure the top spot in Shounen Jack, and ultimately, achieve an anime adaptation of their manga. With new rivals and friends, Bakuman. 2nd Season continues Takagi and Mashiro's inspiring story of hard work and young love.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers find the second season to be a compelling and realistic portrayal of the manga industry, highlighting the drama and character development. However, others criticize the season for its sexist depictions, repetitive storylines, and inconsistent writing, leading to a divided reception.
pros: Realistic portrayal of the manga industry.
Intense drama and romance.
Motivational story.
cons: Sexist portrayal of female characters.
Repetitive plot elements.
Inconsistent character development.

anime.title: Toriko
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Gourmet, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Hamburgers that grow out of the ground like four-leaf clovers, mountain ranges carved out of ice cream, and warm servings of mac and cheese that stew deep within the stomachs of volcanoes fill the landscape. This world of delectable natural wonders has reached a prime age of exploration—the Gourmet Age! Citizens and chefs alike aspire to taste and prepare the finest dishes, while adventurers called "Gourmet Hunters" seek out delicious rare ingredients.

Possessing a unique set of skills, the wild and passionate Gourmet Hunter Toriko is infamous for discovering 2% of all known ingredients. Together with his friend Komatsu—a highly skilled chef working at a five-star hotel—Toriko strives to complete his Full Course Menu of Life. But it isn’t going to be easy; in order to obtain the most delicious ingredients, Toriko must battle against obstacles like deadly monsters, evil organizations, and food itself!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Toriko are mixed. Some appreciate its unique concept, action, and world-building, particularly in the manga. However, others are critical of the anime adaptation's censorship and deviations from the source material, as well as the seemingly shallow premise, leading to a divisive reception.
pros: Unique concept and setting within the battle shonen genre.
World-building is detailed and imaginative, creating a vibrant and expansive gourmet world.
Action sequences are engaging and brutal.
Strong pacing, avoiding common pitfalls of drawn-out arcs.
cons: The anime adaptation suffers from censorship, removing the brutality present in the manga.
The anime has a non-canon ending and includes filler content.
The story's premise might seem silly or lacking in serious stakes to some viewers.
Some find Komatsu to be an incompetent or uninteresting character.

anime.title: Please Save My Earth: The Passing of the Golden Age
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Chikyuu wo Mamotte: Kiniro no Toki Nagarete
anime.synopsis:
Please Save My Earth Music Image Video: The Passing of the Golden Age contains six music videos with footage not seen in the OVA and scenes taken from the manga, as well as a slightly different version of the OVA ending sequence, and the ending credits for the image videos.

(Source: Wikipedia)

See more info for additional information about these music videos.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Boku no Chikyuu wo Mamotte: Kiniro no Toki Nagarete' music video special is primarily a treat for existing fans of the series, particularly those who have read the manga. Its strong point is the music and visuals, evoking a sense of nostalgia and sentimentality. However, it lacks substance for newcomers and doesn't offer a conclusive narrative, functioning more as an extended music video with scenes from the manga.
pros: Great music, typical of PSME, some new songs too
Includes scenes from the manga about Mokuren's and Enju's pasts
Features the important scene from the manga happening on Tokyo Tower
Enjoyable for fans of the music and art style
cons: Incomprehensible if you didn't pay attention to the OVA or read the manga
No conclusive ending, no secrets revealed
Anime-only viewers won't understand the plot or Rin's overall plan
Feels like an AMV
Serves primarily as fanservice

anime.title: Nura: Rise of the Yokai Clan - Demon Capital
anime.synopsis:
Long before Rikuo Nura was born, the legendary youkai Nurarihyon, leader of a "Night Parade of One Hundred Demons," fell in love with a human woman. Though the two would initially find happiness, a threat from the terrifying fox-demon Hagoromo Gitsune would get in the way of their relationship. 

In the present, Rikuo has taken his rightful place as the heir to the Nura Clan. While he has accepted his youkai side, he must continue to maintain the secret of youkai, a difficult task when faced with the Keikain onmyouji clan and his youkai-obsessed friend, Kiyotsugu. Even so, Rikuo will do what he must to protect those important to him.

The reappearance of the sinister Hagoromo Gitsune marks the start of Rikuo's most fearsome trial yet. The frightening creature bears a personal vendetta against his family and will stop at nothing to see her dream come to fruition. The world stands at a precipice, an all-out war that will drag Rikuo centerstage.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is generally considered a significant improvement over the first, with more action and a better-developed story.  Viewers appreciate the deeper character development and engaging battles, though some find the ending rushed and the plot somewhat generic. There is a strong desire for a third season, indicating overall positive reception, though a few find the shift in tone from the first season disappointing.
pros: Story is more consolidated and better explained than season 1.
More action, stronger villains, and exciting battles compared to season 1.
Characters are deep, interesting, and engaging.
cons: Ending feels rushed and abrupt.
Some viewers may find the story generic (good vs. evil).
Romance aspect is diminished compared to the first season.
Some filler episodes detract from the main plot.

anime.title: Angel Beats! Another Epilogue
anime.synopsis: Disillusioned with the afterlife, a new student causes a scene during a classroom test and expresses his doubts about whether getting good grades can really lead to escaping the school and ascending to Heaven. Afterwards,  he is confronted by the new student council president—a familiar face whose past experiences give him powerful insight into the true nature of the school and first-hand knowledge regarding the futility of rebellion.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Another Epilogue' elicits mixed reactions, with some appreciating its exploration of Otonashi's potential fate and its resolution of unresolved plot points. However, others find it undermines the original ending or offers little narrative value. The episode's melancholic tone resonates with some, while others are left feeling conflicted or disappointed.
pros: Provides closure and explains unanswered questions from the main series.
Offers an alternate ending that some viewers prefer.
Maintains the art style and sound quality of the original series.
Explores the potential consequences of Otonashi's choice to stay in the afterlife.
cons: May ruin the original ending for some viewers.
The short length leaves the new character underdeveloped.
Some viewers find it unnecessary or confusing.
The plot is minimal and may not appeal to those seeking a substantial story.

anime.title: The Qwaser of Stigmata II
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, School, Seinen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Sasha is partnered with Hana as his new Maria. They infiltrate an all-girls academy, forcing Sasha to crossdress, in search of a Qwaser-related artifact called the Magdalena of Thunder which has appeared in one of the students. However, they have some competition in their search of it.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Seikon no Qwaser is largely considered a disappointment due to its weak plot and excessive fan service. While some viewers enjoyed the comedic aspects and art style, the majority found the lack of character development and meaningful story progression to be detrimental. The series is heavily criticized for prioritizing ecchi elements over narrative quality, resulting in a disjointed and unsatisfying experience for those seeking a compelling story.
pros: Good art style, especially for character design and ecchi elements.
Enjoyable opening and ending themes.
Some find the comedic elements and lightheartedness amusing.
cons: Significant drop in plot quality compared to the first season.
Excessive fan service overshadows the storyline.
Character development is stagnant.
Many episodes feel like filler.
Inconsistent pacing and poorly explained plot points.
Censorship issues detract from the experience for some viewers.
anime.thematic_vibe: Ecchi Comedy, Fan Service, Weak Plot

anime.title: Naruto x UT
anime.synopsis: All-new animation offered throughout UNIQLO clothing stores in Japan on January 1, 2011. The DVD contains an exclusive version of Mayonaka Orchestra, by the Japanese rock band Aqua Timez. A limited number of the DVDs was offered as presents to people who bought UNIQLO's Naruto graphic T-shirts online or in their stores.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with Naruto fans appreciating the animation and nostalgic value, while others find it shallow and commercial. Some see the short as a glimpse of what Naruto could have been without filler. Ultimately, enjoyment heavily depends on one's existing investment in the Naruto franchise.
pros: High-quality animation, potentially better than the main series.
Intense fight scenes with minimal filler.
Evokes nostalgia for the Naruto series.
cons: Lacks narrative depth; just a compilation of clips.
Feels like a commercial or an average AMV.
May be cringy or uninteresting for those not already invested in Naruto.

anime.title: The Prince and the Coral Sea
anime.synopsis: On the island of Okinawa, driven by his kindhearted nature, a boy named Ray determines to stop the destruction of the island's natural forests and coral reef, no matter what he has to give. What will he give to stop a tidal wave from killing the island's people?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Sango no Umi to Ouji' to be a cute and endearing historical anime with a strong, likable main character. However, some felt the pacing was rushed and the mermaid character was over-emphasized. Overall, it is considered an enjoyable watch, especially for those who appreciate stories with a strong moral compass.
pros: The main character Ray is likable and selfless.
The story is cute and endearing with a good message.
Music sets the tone and indicates historical setting.
cons: Parts of the story felt rushed.
The mermaid character feels more important than she is.
Re-watch value is questionable.

anime.title: A Bridge to the Starry Skies
anime.synopsis:
Kazuma Hoshino is preparing himself for a new stage of his life as a teenager. Because of his brother Ayumu's weaker than average health, their parents thought it best for the family to move out from the city to a more rural environment. Now the two brothers are off to the Yorozuyo Inn where they’ll be staying until their parents can settle affairs back in the city and set up their new home.

Their arrival to the inn doesn't go as planned though when they catch the wrong bus, wind up in the middle of nowhere, Ayumu gets his hat stolen by a wild monkey, and Kazuma gets lost in the woods trying to track the animal down. It all leads to a chance encounter with a spirited young girl named Ui, who Kazuma ends up accidentally falling onto and kissing while she tries leading him back to the bus stop. This hardly sits well with Ui’s friend Ibuki who swiftly kicks Kazuma and sends him on his way. Much to Kazuma's continued horror, his bad luck is perpetuated at the inn thanks to its landlady Senka and her slightly perverted sense of humor, and then finding out that two of his classmates are the girls he embarrassed himself in front of back in the woods!

Hoshizora e Kakaru Hashi finds Kazuma adapting to his new school, dealing with the multiple women who have entered his life, providing emotional support for his younger brother, and coping with living with his new landlady. However, for some reason, something about this place is bringing whispers of the past into Kazuma's mind. Small flashes back to a more innocent time and a friendship long forgotten. What could this déjà vu mean?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many find it to be a generic but enjoyable harem anime due to its comedy and art. However, others criticize it for its lack of originality, shallow characters, and slow-paced story. It's seen as a lighthearted and easy watch, but not a standout in the genre.
pros: Beautiful art and scenery
Enjoyable comedy, especially the slapstick
Satisfying ending compared to other harems
cons: Generic and unoriginal story
One-dimensional and cliche characters
Slow pacing and lack of a strong plot
Ecchi moments feel out of place

anime.title: The World God Only Knows II
anime.romaji_title: Kami nomi zo Shiru Sekai II
anime.genres: Comedy, Harem, Otaku Culture, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Keima Katsuragi, the "God of Conquest," returns to his quest of expelling runaway spirits that have possessed the hearts of women. Still stuck in his contract with the demon Elsie, he must continue to utilize the knowledge he has gained from mastering multitudes of dating simulators and chase out the phantoms that reside within by capturing the hearts of that which he hates most: three-dimensional girls.

However, the God of Conquest has his work cut out for him. From exorcising karate practitioners and student teachers to the arrival of Elsie's best friend from Hell, he is up against a wide array of girls that will test his wit and may even take him by surprise. Though he would much rather stick to the world of 2D, he is trapped in lousy reality, and so Keima must trudge forward in his conquest of love.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of 'The World God Only Knows' is generally well-received, maintaining the charm and humor of the first season while introducing new characters and arcs. Some viewers find it repetitive or lacking a strong overarching plot, but the improved animation, character development, and balanced storytelling contribute to a positive viewing experience overall. Most fans find that while perhaps not as strong as season 1 it is still worth watching to continue the series.
pros: Good humor and comedic timing
Strong main character with good development
Improved animation and character design
Engaging story arcs with romance and supernatural elements
Well-balanced mix of comedy and drama
cons: Lack of overarching plot
Some incoherent arcs
Repetitive settings and formulaic structure
Uneven character development
Not as popular as the first season for some viewers

anime.title: Shiki Specials
anime.genres: Gore, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Shounen, Supernatural, Suspense, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
As the epidemic terrorizes the quiet secluded village of Sotoba, three women have found themselves amidst the escalating crisis. Nao Yasumori is tormented by visions of the deceased; Kanami Yano must keep a secret at risk of losing a loved one; and Motoko Maeda goes through insurmountable grief as the mysterious illness spreads throughout her family. 

With rising tensions testing the limits of family relationships, even the smallest of mistakes can easily sever the ties that bind .
anime.consensus_summary: The Shiki Specials are generally well-received as important supplemental episodes that enrich the viewing experience of the main series. They provide deeper insight into the characters' motivations and the overall chaos of the village, and most viewers recommend watching them in chronological order within the main series. The specials are appreciated for adding emotional and narrative weight, although some find the art style or pacing of the second episode to be less impactful.
pros: Adds depth to the main story by exploring the perspectives of side characters.
Enhances understanding of villagers' mentalities and motivations.
Showcases the chaos and moral ambiguity within the village.
Offers compelling characterization, particularly of Nao.
cons: Some viewers may find the art style awkward.
The second episode is considered less developed compared to the first.
Requires prior viewing of the main Shiki series to understand the plot.

anime.title: Fate/Zero
anime.synopsis:
With the promise of granting any wish, the omnipotent Holy Grail triggered three wars in the past, each too cruel and fierce to leave a victor. In spite of that, the wealthy Einzbern family is confident that the Fourth Holy Grail War will be different; namely, with a vessel of the Holy Grail now in their grasp. Solely for this reason, the much hated "Magus Killer" Kiritsugu Emiya is hired by the Einzberns, with marriage to their only daughter Irisviel as binding contract.

Kiritsugu now stands at the center of a cutthroat game of survival, facing off against six other participants, each armed with an ancient familiar, and fueled by unique desires and ideals. Accompanied by his own familiar, Saber, the notorious mercenary soon finds his greatest opponent in Kirei Kotomine, a priest who seeks salvation from the emptiness within himself in pursuit of Kiritsugu.

Based on the light novel written by Gen Urobuchi, Fate/Zero depicts the events of the Fourth Holy Grail War—10 years prior to Fate/stay night. Witness a battle royale in which no one is guaranteed to survive.
anime.consensus_summary: Fate/Zero is lauded for its high production values and mature storytelling, but some find it slow-paced and overly reliant on dialogue. While praised for its complex characters and philosophical themes, others criticize the archetypal character designs and grim ending. Overall, it's a well-regarded prequel, though divisive among viewers.
pros: High production quality by Ufotable (animation, art, sound)
Intriguing story with complex characters and mature themes
Well-realized fight scenes and strategic battles
cons: Pacing issues, especially in the early episodes
Dialogue-heavy, can be slow and uneventful
Characters sometimes fall into generic archetypes
Some find the ending grim and cynical

anime.title: Broken Blade 6
anime.romaji_title: Break Blade Movie 6: Doukoku no Toride
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Fantasy, Mecha, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Sixth and final Break Blade movie.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some find the mecha action and overall storyline enjoyable, others criticize the predictable plot, subpar premise, and underdeveloped characters. The final movie specifically receives criticism for not providing a satisfying conclusion to the series' established plot threads, leading to a somewhat divisive reception.
pros: Enjoyable mecha action
Interesting storyline despite being clichéd
cons: Subpar premise and story
Characters feel like filler
Predictable plot twists
Final movie doesn't wrap up plot threads satisfactorily

anime.title: Kobato.: Hajimete no Kobato.
anime.synopsis: Mini Flash anime from the limited-edition DVDs volumes (episodes 1-6) and Blu-ray Box (episodes 1-8, of which 7 and 8 were new additions to the Blu-ray box).
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the mini flash anime enjoyable as a lighthearted addition to the main Kobato. series. While they are short and not particularly deep, they offer a fun and cheerful experience, particularly for those already familiar with the main storyline. Ioryogi's humor is a highlight.
pros: Fun to watch
Good addition to the main story
Cheering
cons: Short stories, not much depth
Requires familiarity with the main story

anime.title: Oreimo Animated Commentary
anime.romaji_title: Ore no Imouto ga Konnani Kawaii Wake ga Nai: SD Chara ni Yoru Character Commentary
anime.synopsis: Special episodes from the BD/DVDs.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the special video commentaries, finding them humorous and entertaining. The chibi skits and character interactions are a highlight. The series itself is well-received, with particular praise for its ability to maintain audience interest despite a simple plot.
pros: Funny chibi skits offer entertainment beyond typical commentary.
Character expressions are amazing.
The story is a simple plot, but somehow continues to interest the audience so well.

anime.title: Softenni! the Animation
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, School, Shounen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: The tennis comedy centers around the members of a female middle school soft tennis team and the twists and turns that their lives take as they aim for the nationals.
anime.consensus_summary: Softenni is a lighthearted ecchi comedy that is best enjoyed if viewers are looking for a silly and fun time. While the plot is thin and the humor can be inconsistent, the characters are likeable, and the series has a certain warmth and charm. It is not a sports anime in the traditional sense but uses soft tennis as a backdrop for comedic and sometimes outrageous situations.
pros: Good running gags and callbacks.
Likeable and quirky characters with distinct personalities.
Decent animation and voice acting.
Warm and fun story about friendship and chasing dreams.
cons: Plot is weak and unfocused.
Comedy can be hit or miss, with some jokes falling flat.
Excessive fanservice and nudity may not appeal to all viewers.
Some characters are underdeveloped.
anime.thematic_vibe: Ecchi Comedy, Slice of Life, Sports (Soft Tennis)

anime.title: Mayo Chiki!
anime.genres: Comedy, Crossdressing, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Due to his mother and sister, who both love professional wrestling, Kinjirou Sakamachi developed a resilient body that could take hard punches, aggressive kicks, and even deadly vehicle bumps, in order to survive their various grappling positions and locks. However, he also developed gynophobia, an abnormal fear of women. With just one touch from a girl, his nose bleeds uncontrollably, he sweats excessively, and in rare cases, faints abruptly.

His life changes for the worse because of a fated meeting in the restroom. While trying to escape from a girl, he discovers that the most popular student in their school, Subaru Konoe—the butler of the headmaster’s daughter, Kanade Suzutsuki—is actually female! Surprised, Subaru violently assaults Kinjirou, dealing significant damage and knocking him unconscious. When he comes to, he meets Kanade. In exchange for his silence, she promises to help cure his phobia.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is moderately divided on Mayo Chiki!, with many enjoying its comedic moments and visual presentation but lamenting its underdeveloped romance and reliance on genre tropes. While some viewers found it a fun and enjoyable experience, a significant portion felt it lacked depth and a satisfying conclusion.
pros: Character designs are well-done and animation is fluid and colorful.
Voice acting is strong, with specific praise for the lead actors' ability to convey personality.
The comedic elements, particularly the misunderstandings and the protagonist's gynophobia, are frequently cited as enjoyable.
cons: The romance aspect is often considered lacking or underdeveloped, with many feeling the series doesn't fully resolve the romantic tension.
The plot is frequently criticized for being uninspired, relying heavily on harem clichés, and often lacking direction or meaningful progression.
Several reviews mention a disappointing or abrupt ending, with a feeling of wanting more or that the final episodes were filler.

anime.title: Alexander's Decision
anime.synopsis: King Alexander of Macedonia and his troops are at war with the armies of Persia. When he suddenly falls ill, Alexander is faced with a decision: to trust his life-long Persian friend Philip and accept his help or treat him as an enemy because he is Persian.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the OVA to be a decent but not exceptional historical piece. The moral dilemma and historical context are appreciated, but the animation and simple plot are drawbacks. It's mainly recommended for viewers with an existing interest in history, otherwise it may not be particularly engaging.
pros: Interesting moral dilemma presented
Provides a history lesson
References historical context (Greco-Buddhist influence on Japan)
Highlights Alexander's early life and Aristotle's influence
cons: Story is not very deep or complex
Animation is considered creepy and weird
May not be interesting to those without a passion for history

anime.title: Friends: Naki of Monster Island
anime.synopsis: On an island, legend has it that monsters have lived there since ancient times. Because of this, the residents have named the island “Monster Island.” In actuality, the monsters living on the island are friendly, but live in fear of humans. A child named Kotake wanders onto the island. A grumpy red ogre named Naki ends up taking care of the child. What strange things might this encounter cause?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers describe the movie as a heartwarming and emotional experience with well-developed characters and excellent production values. Many were surprised by how much they enjoyed the film, praising its ability to evoke feelings of nostalgia and leave a lasting impression.
pros: Well-written characters
Fantastic animation
Flawless OST and voice acting
cons: Lack of awareness in the anime community

anime.title: Seitokai Yakuindomo OVA
anime.synopsis: It is the start of Takatoshi Tsuda's second year as the put-upon vice president of the student council and his sister Kotomi is entering school as a first year. New friends and double entendres are made.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is well-received as a direct continuation of the first season, offering more of the same humor and characters fans enjoyed. While some jokes might not land for all viewers due to cultural nuances or repetitive elements, the overall consensus is that it's a worthwhile addition for fans of the series. It successfully maintains the established tone and comedic style.
pros: Continues the humor and style of the original series seamlessly.
Improved joke execution with faster pacing and better setups.
More focused on the main characters and their gags.
cons: Recurring segments can become repetitive and less funny.
Animation and art quality may drop in later episodes.
Relies heavily on Japanese puns and innuendos that may be lost in translation.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sexual Comedy, Slice of Life, High School

anime.title: Manga Hajimete Omoshiro Juku
anime.synopsis:

anime.consensus_summary: The available review is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's art and animation. The lack of a synopsis and limited reviews makes it difficult to gauge overall audience reception but indicates that this show is potentially well-received, at least by the reviewer.
pros: Beautiful animation
Unique art style
cons: No plot synopsis available

anime.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You - Unrequited Love
anime.synopsis: The Kimi ni Todoke story so far, from Kurumi's point of view.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally lukewarm, seeing the episode as a recap from Kurumi's perspective. It serves as a decent refresher or a way to enjoy the music, but it's not considered essential viewing before watching the second season. Some viewers felt that Kurumi's perspective could have been explored in more depth.
pros: Good refresher for the first season.
Enjoyable OP and ED music.
Provides Kurumi's perspective.
cons: Not essential to watch before season 2.
Recap may not offer enough new content.
Kurumi's perspective could have been explored more deeply.

anime.title: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha: The Movie 2nd A's
anime.romaji_title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha: The Movie 2nd A's
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Mahou Shoujo, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Several months have passed since the Jewel Seed incident, and Nanoha Takamachi is getting ready to welcome Fate Testarossa back from her trial with the Administrative Bureau. Having received conditional clemency for her role in preventing the crisis, Fate has been allowed to attend school with Nanoha. However, before the two girls can settle into their daily lives together, a group of dark mages suddenly descend upon them. Overpowered by their unknown assailants, Nanoha and Fate have their mana absorbed by an ominous grimoire, and both Raising Heart and Bardiche are damaged in the process.

The ones behind this ambush are known as the Wolkenritter, and its four members—Vita, Signum, Shamal, and the familiar Zafila—were summoned by the Book of Darkness to carry out its malignant bidding. The book's current owner is the young girl Hayate Yagami, oblivious to its true nature while the Wolkenritter, charging its power with the forcibly stolen mana, is duty-bound to seek the tome's completion.

Left drained and weaponless, Nanoha and Fate must race against time to recover their strength and confront the Wolkenritter, with the aim of preventing the quartet from finishing the Book of Darkness and unleashing its devastating magic upon the world.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is generally well-received as a visually stunning and action-packed retelling of the 'A's' season. Some fans appreciate the tighter narrative and improved animation, while others lament the removal of certain plot elements and characters. The movie successfully captures the emotional core of the story, but some feel the pacing is rushed due to the condensed format.
pros: Improved animation and visuals compared to the original series.
Tighter pacing and a more focused narrative by trimming unnecessary elements.
Deeper exploration of antagonists and their motivations.
cons: Removal of key plot points and characters from the original series.
Pacing issues due to compressing 13 episodes into a movie format.
Potential loss of character development and world-building.

anime.title: Dog Days
anime.synopsis:
Dog Days takes place in the world of Flonyard, an alternate Earth inhabited by beings who resemble humans, but also have the ears and tails of specific animals. The Republic of Biscotti, a union of dog-like citizens, has come under attack by the feline forces of the Galette Leo Knights. In an effort to save Biscotti, Princess Millhiore summons a champion from another world in order to defend her people. That champion is Cinque Izumi, a normal junior high student from Earth.

Agreeing to assist Biscotti, Cinque retrieves a sacred weapon called the Palladion and prepares for war. In Flonyard, wars are fought with no casualties and are more akin to sports competitions with the goal of raising money for the participating kingdoms. Cinque is successful in his role as Biscotti’s champion, but learns that a summoned champion cannot be returned to their home world. The scientists of Biscotti will endeavor to find a way for Cinque to return home, but until they figure something out, he must serve Princess Millhiore by continuing to fight as Biscotti’s hero.
anime.consensus_summary: Dog Days is a lighthearted and enjoyable anime with a unique premise, but it suffers from a thin plot, generic characters, and excessive fan service. Despite its flaws, many viewers find it to be a fun and entertaining watch, especially for those who enjoy simple and non-serious anime. The series has a dedicated fanbase, but it doesn't reach the level of being a masterpiece.
pros: Enjoyable and fun due to its light-hearted nature
Good pacing with well-developed story arcs
Lovable characters with a good voice actor line-up
Visually appealing animation with vibrant colors and detailed art
Unique premise that turns war into a sport
Well done action scenes.
cons: Thin and shallow plot with predictable story elements
Overly simplistic and sappy storyline
Mediocre character development with generic archetypes
Excessive and unnecessary fan service
Inconsistent animation quality
Music is forgettable

anime.title: Sacred Seven
anime.synopsis:
Alma Tandoji lives a lonely life. One day, Ruri Alba, a girl accompanied by her butler and maids, visits him. Knowing the power of Sacred Seven is latent within Alma, she asks him to lend her his powers. However, he refuses and drives her away since he injured many with his unusual strength in the past.

Meanwhile, a fiendish Dark Stone creature suddenly appears in this peaceful town in the Kanto region. Only Alma's power of Sacred Seven can fight against it. But Alma just lets his power run amuck and things begin to get worse. Ruri raised her gemstone in order to release his true abilities, My Soul I give to you.

With Ruri's wishes engraved in it, will Alma be able to defeat the Dark Stone?
anime.consensus_summary: Sacred Seven is a visually appealing but ultimately generic action anime. While the fight scenes and character designs are praised, the plot and characters are criticized for being uninspired and cliche. The series is considered a passable but forgettable experience, with some viewers finding it enjoyable as mindless entertainment, while others are disappointed by its lack of depth and originality.
pros: Visually appealing animation, especially in fight scenes.
Character designs are well-realized and interesting.
Music is well-suited and choreographed to the on-screen action; the OP and ED themes are catchy.
cons: Rushed and predictable plot with cliche elements.
Shallow and uninspired characters with little development.
Lazy writing and bad pacing in fight scenes.
Over-reliance on stereotypes and tropes.

anime.title: No. 6
anime.synopsis:
Many years ago, after the end of a bloody world war, mankind took shelter in six city-states that were peaceful and perfect... at least on the surface. However, Shion—an elite resident of the city-state No. 6—gained a new perspective on the world he lives in, thanks to a chance encounter with a mysterious boy, Nezumi. Nezumi turned out to be just one of many who lived in the desolate wasteland beyond the walls of the supposed utopia. But despite knowing that the other boy was a fugitive, Shion decided to take him in for the night and protect him, which resulted in drastic consequences: because of his actions, Shion and his mother lost their status as elites and were relocated elsewhere, and the darker side of the city began to make itself known. 

Now, a long time after their life-altering first meeting, Shion and Nezumi are finally brought together once again—the former elite and the boy on the run are about to embark on an adventure that will, in time, reveal the shattering secrets of No. 6.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the characters, world-building and initial plot but criticism toward the rushed ending, underdeveloped themes, and pacing issues. Some viewers appreciate the dystopian elements and character dynamics, while others find the plot convoluted and the ending unsatisfying. The series garners both strong admiration and disappointment, creating a somewhat divided audience.
pros: Compelling characters and their complex relationships
Intriguing dystopian setting with dark secrets
Thought-provoking themes about humanity and society
cons: Rushed plot and underdeveloped story arcs, especially towards the end
Lack of action in certain episodes
Unsatisfying or confusing ending

anime.title: Bunny Drop
anime.genres: Childcare, Iyashikei, Josei, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Daikichi Kawachi is a 30-year-old bachelor working a respectable job but otherwise wandering aimlessly through life. When his grandfather suddenly passes away, he returns to the family home to pay his respects. Upon arriving at the house, he meets a mysterious young girl named Rin who, to Daikichi’s astonishment, is his grandfather's illegitimate daughter!
 
The shy and unapproachable girl is deemed an embarrassment to the family, and finds herself ostracized by her father's relatives, all of them refusing to take care of her in the wake of his death. Daikichi, angered by their coldness toward Rin, announces that he will take her in—despite the fact that he is a young, single man with no prior childcare experience.

Usagi Drop is the story of Daikichi's journey through fatherhood as he raises Rin with his gentle and affectionate nature, as well as an exploration of the warmth and interdependence that are at the heart of a happy, close-knit family.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally find Usagi Drop to be a heartwarming and positive experience. The show's strength lies in its realistic and gentle portrayal of parenthood and family bonds. While some find the plot lacking in conflict, most appreciate its slice-of-life approach and charming art style.
pros: Realistic and relatable depiction of parenthood
Gentle and affectionate portrayal of family bonds
Unique and charming art style
Well-developed and endearing characters
The voice-acting in this is spot-on for Rin, the voice-actor in the Japanese Dub did a fantastic job in capturing the lovable innocence whilst also not giving her that annoying vocal pitch
cons: Plot can feel aimless or uneventful at times
Some viewers may find the lack of conflict unengaging
The plot shows random stuff happening within the span of a year without much cohesion

anime.title: [C] CONTROL - The Money and Soul of Possibility
anime.romaji_title: C: The Money of Soul and Possibility Control
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Mystery, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Money is power, and without it, life is meaningless. In a country whose economy is in shambles, second-year economics university student Kimimaro Yoga understands this fact all too well, as he is surrounded by the relatively luxurious lives of his peers and struggling to make ends meet. However, his world is turned on its head when a stranger in a top hat arrives one late night at his door.

Going by the name Masakaki, the visitor petitions Yoga to come to the Eastern Financial District, a place where money flows in abundance if one offers their "future" as collateral. Although reluctant, greed triumphs reason and Yoga accepts the offer, thus taking on the mantle of an Entre. But unbeknownst to him, the land of wealth he has entered is an alternate realm built in the likeness of his own, where Entres are forced to participate in weekly duels called Deals, with their collateral at stake. Pitted against his countrymen and fate, Yoga must quickly adapt in this new world if he hopes to protect his fortune and future—and discover just how much money is truly worth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the original concept and art style, but criticism for the confusing plot, pacing, and underdeveloped characters. Some appreciate the philosophical themes, while others find them contrived. Ultimately, the show's execution fails to live up to its promising premise, leading to a divided response.
pros: Original story and concept
Interesting plot
Great animation and art quality
cons: Confusing plot, especially near the end
Pacing issues (too fast or awkward cuts)
Underdeveloped characters
Excessive drama and random side stories
Lack of a straightforward plot
Choppy editing and animation issues
Poor execution of economic concepts

anime.title: Nichijou - My Ordinary Life
anime.synopsis: Nichijou primarily focuses on the daily antics of a trio of childhood friends—high school girls Mio Naganohara, Yuuko Aioi and Mai Minakami—whose stories soon intertwine with the young genius Hakase Shinonome, her robot caretaker Nano, and their talking cat Sakamoto. With every passing day, the lives of these six, as well as of the many people around them, experience both the calms of normal life and the insanity of the absurd. Walking to school, being bitten by a talking crow, spending time with friends, and watching the principal suplex a deer: they are all in a day's work in the extraordinary everyday lives of those in Nichijou.
anime.consensus_summary: Nichijou divides viewers with its absurdist humor and lack of traditional plot. While some praise its unique comedic style, stunning animation, and endearing characters, others find it too random, obnoxious, and lacking in substance. The show's success heavily relies on individual preferences for slice-of-life and sketch comedy.
pros: Stunning animation and art style enhance the comedic effect.
Unique and bizarre situations elevate the 'everyday' to the extraordinary.
Likable and hilarious characters create a heartwarming experience.
cons: Humor relies too heavily on randomness, lacking cleverness or punchlines.
Absence of a strong plot or storyline may not appeal to all viewers.
Over-the-top characters can become obnoxious and detract from the humor.

anime.title: DD Fist of the North Star
anime.synopsis:
Super-deformed version of Hokuto no Ken, Buronson & Hara Tetsuo's post-apocalyptic fighting manga.

Note: The "DD" stands for "Design Deformation," since the characters are only "two-heads-tall."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is that 'DD Hokuto no Ken' is a lighthearted and silly parody that provides a refreshing break from the serious and violent nature of the original series. It's primarily aimed at existing fans who can appreciate the self-deprecating humor and chibi art style. However, some jokes may be considered distasteful, and those unfamiliar with 'Hokuto no Ken' may not find it as enjoyable.
pros: Refreshing change from the serious tone of the original series
Harmless and dumb fun for fans of the original
Short episodes make it a quick watch
cons: Jokes can be in poor taste, especially those concerning Souther
May not be enjoyable for those unfamiliar with the original Hokuto no Ken

anime.title: Otona Joshi no Anime Time
anime.synopsis:
Kawamo wo Suberu Kaze
Returning to Japan to visit her parents after five years abroad, Noriko does not know what to expect. While some things in Kanazawa have changed and some things have stayed the same, Noriko cannot help but dredge up memories of her youth and secrets she thought she had left behind.

Yuuge
Trapped in a loveless marriage, Mimi has little excitement in her life until a rendezvous with the local garbage man, Kou, turns into something more. Now living with Kou—but still married to someone else—Mimi reflects on the decisions that brought her to this point and whether she should prioritize appearances or her happiness.

Jinsei Best Ten
Hatoko Nikawa has a habit of reflecting on her "best ten," the most memorable moments of her life, but is somewhat dismayed that, despite her 39 years on Earth, her best ten moments all occurred before her 18th birthday. Hearing that her middle school reunion is coming up, Hatoko hopes to reunite with her first love without knowing how much he has changed or whether he can live up to her expectations.

Dokoka Dewanai Koko
With an adult son who sleeps all day, a daughter who barely returns home, and a husband who lost his job, Maho Katou bears a lot of stress. Working nights at a local store to support her family, she has little time for sleep or pleasure. With Maho constantly overexerting herself, it may only be a matter of time until she collapses under pressure.
anime.consensus_summary: Otona Joshi no Anime Time is a unique and mature series that explores the lives of adult women with relatable stories and a distinct visual style. While the slow pacing and occasional plot issues may not appeal to everyone, the show's thoughtful exploration of adult themes and relatable characters has resonated with many viewers, particularly older female audiences. The series evokes feelings of nostalgia, happiness, and a hint of fear about the future.
pros: Relatable female characters and stories
Unique blend of animation and live-action visuals
Thought-provoking exploration of adult themes
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers
Some episodes have weak or unsatisfying endings
Animation quality can be inconsistent

anime.title: Otome Youkai Zakuro Picture Drama
anime.synopsis: Picture dramas included with the first and third limited edition DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The picture drama is considered supplementary content, mainly enjoyable for existing fans of 'Otome Youkai Zakuro.' Episode 1 is slow and uninteresting, while episode 2 is slightly better due to focusing on the main characters and incorporating some familiar tropes.  Overall, it doesn't offer much substance beyond what's already in the anime series.
pros: Good art in episode 2 featuring Zakuro and the girls.
Entertaining tropes in episode 2.
cons: Episode 1 was boring with mostly commentary from minor characters.
The picture drama format consists of still images.
Nothing relevant or essential to the main series occurs.
Only enjoyable for those who already liked the series.

anime.title: HenSemi (TV)
anime.synopsis: Matsutaka Nanako is a normal university student, who happened to enroll in an Abnormal Physiology seminar. She tries to keep her mental state sound, but other abnormal classmates start to influence her personality...
anime.consensus_summary: HenSemi is a polarizing anime that delves into the realm of sexual deviancy and abnormal psychology with a comedic twist. While some appreciate its intelligent exploration of fetishes and well-developed characters, others find the humor disgusting and the story rushed. The series sparks discussions about the nature of perversion and societal norms, making it a noteworthy yet potentially controversial watch.
pros: Intelligent exploration of fetishes and sexual psychology.
Well-developed and interesting characters with distinct perversions.
Presents uncomfortable subjects in a light and almost innocent way.
cons: Humor can be disgusting and not for everyone.
Story execution feels rushed and bounces around too much.
Potential clamped by focusing on male gaze and heteronormative interactions.

anime.title: Nyanpire The Animation
anime.synopsis: When a handsome vampire finds a kitten on the verge of death, he cannot help but take pity on the poor creature and save its life the only way he knows how: by offering it some of his blood and granting it eternal life as a vampire cat. The kitten—now known as Nyanpire—does his best to acquire blood and other red substances for his consumption. At the same time, he must also manage the difficulties of being a household pet and keeping up with the other strange cats around the neighborhood.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely positive, emphasizing the show's cuteness and simplicity. Some find it lacks depth, but overall it's seen as a fun, short, and relaxing watch. The show is appreciated for its ability to deliver a feel-good experience without requiring significant time investment.
pros: Cute and relaxing entertainment.
Simple premise executed well.
Enjoyable music and sound effects.
Kid-friendly gothic atmosphere.
cons: Lacks intellectual depth.
Simplistic art style.
Archetypal characters.
No overarching storyline.

anime.title: Is This a Zombie? OVA
anime.romaji_title: Kore wa Zombie desu ka? OVA
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Two OVAs released with the 8th and 10th volumes of the original novel. They fall chronologically between the first and second seasons.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is moderately divided, primarily due to the OVA's heavy reliance on fan service which some find enjoyable and others find excessive and off-putting. While some appreciate the continuation of the series' humor and character interactions, many feel the OVA's content is largely skippable and lacks narrative significance.
pros: Consistent and good art quality
Maintains character personalities from the series
Good voice acting, consistent with the first season
Provides background for some characters and situations
Humorous moments and fan service can be enjoyable for fans
cons: Excessive ecchi/fan service, bordering on uncomfortable for some
Plot feels largely unnecessary and disconnected from the main series
Focus shifts away from main characters to less relevant side characters
Some character voice acting was awkward (Hellscythe mentioned)
Repetitive art and sound from the main series, lacking innovation

anime.title: Majikoi: Oh! Samurai Girls
anime.romaji_title: Maji de Watashi ni Koi Shinasai!
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Martial Arts, Romance, School, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
The samurai are a very important part of Japan's history, and to be related to them in any way is probably one of the most inspiring things that a young high school student could hope for.

Kawakami City is well-known for having many samurai ancestors among its citizens, and is generally surrounded by an atmosphere of fighting spirit, loyalty, and dedication to work. In Maji de Watashi ni Koi Shinasai!, the students of Kawakami Academy use this knowledge on a daily basis, whether they are studying for exams, competing in sports competitions, or making sure that they take very good care of their traditions. Yamato Naoe is one such student, and his six closest friends (three boys and three girls) make up the perfect team for friendship, rivalry, and motivation. However, even samurai have weaknesses.

Although the balance and long friendship of their group has been undisturbed for a long time, when two new girls enter the group, things start to get a lot more interesting. Not only must they maintain what they think is the samurai tradition, but they must now also do it with a lot of "distractions."
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Maji de Watashi ni Koi Shinasai! is a divisive topic. Many viewers who haven't experienced the visual novel find it to be a reasonably entertaining, if shallow, ecchi comedy with enjoyable characters. However, fans of the source material tend to heavily criticize the anime for its poor adaptation, butchered characters, and weak plot. The show's value largely depends on whether the viewer is able to separate it from its source and appreciate it for its comedic and action elements alone.
pros: Enjoyable characters with unique personalities, deviating from typical harem archetypes.
Good comedy and funny scenarios, especially for those with a crude sense of humor.
Catchy opening theme and generally well-fitting soundtrack.
cons: Weak or non-existent storyline; feels like a collection of loosely connected events.
Over-reliance on fan service and censored ecchi content that can be irritating.
Poor adaptation of the source material (visual novel), with character personalities and plot points being significantly altered or butchered.
anime.thematic_vibe: Ecchi Comedy, Harem Antics, Action Parody

anime.title: You're Being Summoned, Azazel
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Mythology, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Akutabe is a detective who summons devils to solve the troubles of his clients. One day, a low class devil Azazel Atsushi is summoned by Akutabe and is used harshly by him and his assistant Rinko.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a very funny, albeit crude, comedy that relies heavily on offensive humor and parody. While the characters are well-loved and the voice acting is praised, the random story and short episode length are noted as weaknesses.  Viewers who enjoy dark and irreverent humor will likely enjoy it, but those sensitive to such content should avoid it.
pros: Hilarious and outrageously absurd humor.
Unique and lovable characters.
Excellent voice acting.
Memorable music
cons: Story is random and episodic.
Short episodes.
Crude and offensive humor may not appeal to everyone.
Ending lacks conclusion.

anime.title: Twin Angel: Twinkle Paradise
anime.romaji_title: Kaitou Tenshi Twin Angel: Kyunkyun☆Tokimeki Paradise!!
anime.synopsis:
Haruka Minazuki and Aoi Kannazuki are two students at St. Cherine academy. Haruka is always filled with bubbly energy while Aoi is more mature and a top student in all her classes - but despite their differences the two are the best of friends. The two girls look like any other girls, attending the academy, but the truth is they are hiding a little secret, that they can't let anybody know about...

During the day they really are just students at St. Cherine academy, but they can also become the Twin Angel duo, and fight against the evils of the town!

The lovely Angels are back, and it's time for them to get ready for some action!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some appreciate the show's lighthearted parody of the magical girl genre and find it funny and entertaining. Others criticize its simplistic animation, weak story, and reliance on sexualized tropes, deeming it a superficial and forgettable experience. The show seems to appeal to a niche audience interested in ecchi parodies, while others find it falls short compared to similar shows like Sailor Moon.
pros: Funny and entertaining with a satisfying spectacle of humor and emotions.
Plays the magical girl genre straight and has some fun.
Invested in the characters.
Escalates rapidly into a satisfying spectacle of humor and emotions
cons: Simplistic character figures with lots of deformity and jerky movements.
Ridiculous jpop soundtrack and high-pitched voice acting.
Story and characters are barely there.
Superficial rip-offs from Sailor Moon.
Aimless goofball softporn.
Ecchi is basic, the story is a joke, the characters are cardboards

anime.title: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc I - The Egg of the King
anime.romaji_title: Berserk: Ougon Jidai-hen I - Haou no Tamago
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Military, Psychological, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
In the Kingdom of Midland, a mercenary named Guts wanders the land, preferring a life of conflict over a life of peace. Despite the odds never being in his favor, he is an unstoppable force that overcomes every opponent, wielding a massive sword larger than himself.

One day, Griffith, the mysterious leader of the mercenary group Band of the Hawk, witnesses the warrior's battle prowess and invites the wandering swordsman to join his squadron. Rejecting the offer, Guts challenges Griffith to a duel—and, much to the former's surprise, is subsequently defeated and forced to join.

Now, Guts must fight alongside Griffith and his crew to help Midland defeat the Empire of Chuder. However, Griffith seems to harbor ulterior motives, desiring something much larger than just settling the war...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While many appreciate the new animation and faithful adaptation of the Golden Age arc, others are critical of the pacing, poor CGI, and cut content. Some familiar with the source material enjoyed the updated visuals, while newcomers may find the character development rushed.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the Golden Age arc.
New animation is a significant improvement over the original series.
The story is compelling and captures the mind and soul in a visceral way.
cons: Pacing issues due to compressing too much content into a short timeframe.
Poor 3D graphics and character models, especially for a 2012 release.
Cut content affects character development and thematic depth.

anime.title: Tamayura: Hitotose
anime.synopsis:
In her last year of middle school, Fuu Sawatari had trouble dealing with her emotions following the sudden death of her father. Through the help of her brother and childhood friend, she rediscovered her love for photography, an activity she and her father often did together. In addition, she decided to attend high school in Takehara, her father's hometown and a place they often visited when she was younger.

It has been one month now since Fuu moved to Takehara and became close with her current group of friends: carefree Kaoru Hanawa, excitable Norie Okazaki, and quiet Maon Sakurada. Together with them and several acquaintances around town and abroad, Fuu continues her mission of capturing the joys of everyday life using her father's camera, while also helping her friends discover their own passions.
anime.consensus_summary: Tamayura: Hitotose is a heartwarming and healing slice-of-life anime that focuses on the joys of everyday life and chasing small dreams. Viewers find the story emotionally resonant and the characters endearing, though some find the plot too simple or the moe elements distracting. The anime's strengths lie in its ability to evoke feelings of warmth and happiness.
pros: The anime is heartwarming and brings joy to the viewer.
The story progresses at a nice pace, the soundtrack matches well, and the art is beautiful.
The characters are distinct and memorable.
cons: The story is simple and may not appeal to those looking for complexity.
The moe aspects can undermine character growth, making characters feel one-dimensional.
Slow pace is not for everyone.

anime.title: Pretty Rhythm: Aurora Dream
anime.synopsis:
Aira Harune, a clumsy yet happy-go-lucky girl, is suddenly dragged into the popular world of Prism Shows—an idol show based on figure skating, where performers called "Prism Stars" wear outfits encased in Prism Stones and perform stylistic Prism Jumps. Captivated by the dazzling fashion and gorgeous Prism Jumps, Aira decides to become a Prism Star herself.  

She soon encounters the hot-headed Rizumu "Rhythm" Amamiya, who desires to perform the legendary Prism Jump “Aurora Rising”; as well as the prideful Mion Takamine, who dreams of becoming the brightest Prism Star above the rest. The journey of these girls is marked by friendship, growth, and unexpected encounters. Can they perform Prism Jumps high enough to reach their dreams and become the next Prism Queens?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Pretty Rhythm: Aurora Dream, particularly its themes of friendship and pursuing dreams. While some find the initial episodes slow and the art style dated, the overall consensus is that the series improves significantly, offering heartwarming and memorable experiences. Many viewers express a strong connection to the characters and music, indicating a positive emotional response.
pros: Catchy music and Prism Shows are enjoyable
Character development is present, especially for the main trio
Story improves as the series progresses and becomes emotionally resonant
cons: Initial art quality is lacking and the 3D animation is dated
Beginning episodes and story are repetitive and slow to start
Some character actions and plot points can be frustrating

anime.title: Big Fish & Begonia
anime.synopsis:
In an old mythical world, there reside spirit-like beings who oversee the natural order of the mortal realm. One of them, a young girl named Chun, has just come of age and must undergo her rite of passage by experiencing the human world for herself. While there, she gets caught in a fishing net during a storm and is rescued by a human boy.

However, the boy ends up drowning during the incident, and Chun returns to her realm full of guilt. Afterwards, she meets the Soul Keeper and decides to revive the boy in exchange for a part of her lifespan. Little does she know, meddling with the natural order of the world has severe consequences.

Da Yu Hai Tang is a story about sacrifice and redemption as Chun comes to terms with the limitations of her powers and deals with death, love, and her own emotions. She must decide if she will sacrifice everything to save the human boy or forsake her moral obligation for the order of the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Da Yu Hai Tang is visually stunning and boasts a captivating soundtrack, but the narrative execution falls short. Many viewers praise the art and animation quality, drawing comparisons to Studio Ghibli. However, the story is often criticized for being rushed, confusing, and lacking character development, leading to a polarized audience experience.
pros: Stunning visuals and art style, with vibrant colors and detailed animation.
Excellent soundtrack and sound design that complements the visuals.
Unique and original story with mythological themes.
cons: Weak or rushed story with poor pacing and underdeveloped characters.
Convoluted plot with unexplained events and illogical elements.
Inconsistent use of CGI that detracts from the overall visual experience.

anime.title: Kaiji: Against All Rules
anime.genres: Adult Cast, High Stakes Game, Psychological, Seinen, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Owing to an increasing debt, Kaiji Itou ends up resuming his old lifestyle. One day, while walking on the street, he stumbles upon Yuuji Endou, who is hunting Kaiji due to the money he owes to the Teiai Group. Unaware of this, Kaiji eagerly follows Endou, hoping for a chance to participate in another gamble, but soon finds out the loan shark's real intentions when he is kidnapped.

Given that Kaiji is unable to pay off his huge debt, the Teiai Group instead sends him to work in an underground labor camp. He is told that he will have to live in this hell for 15 years, alongside other debtors, until he can earn his freedom. His only hope to put an early end to this nightmare is by saving enough money to be able to go back to the surface for a single day. Once he is there, he plans to obtain the remaining money needed to settle his account by making a high-stakes wager. However, as many temptations threaten his scarce income, Kaiji may have to resort to gambling sooner than he had expected.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Kaiji is considered suspenseful and engaging, particularly the initial arc, but many find it inferior to the first season. Criticisms focus on the prolonged pachinko arc ('The Bog'), a shift away from psychological strategy towards reliance on luck and cheating, and pacing issues. While the character of Kaiji remains compelling, the overall narrative quality is debated, leading to a somewhat polarized reception.
pros: Suspenseful and keeps you on the edge of your seat.
Explores themes of desperation, cunning, and human nature under pressure.
The stakes are high, and the characters' reactions feel human.
Stronger motivations for Kaiji in this season compared to Season 1.
Showcases Kaiji's intellect and leadership qualities.
cons: The 'Bog' arc (pachinko game) drags on and becomes irritating.
Season 2 leans more towards cheating than actual strategy.
Lacks the psychological depth and philosophical elements of the first season.
Pacing issues, especially in the second half of the season.
Can become repetitive and predictable.

anime.title: THE IDOLM@STER
anime.synopsis:
765 Production Studio manages the unique talents of 13 professional idols as they slowly make their way to the top and become country-wide celebrities. But the girls' journey is far from just fun and games: hard work, sweat, and tears are some of the prerequisites needed to flourish in this industry—and for 765 Pro in particular, a watchful eye out for their rival, the infamous 961 Production.

As the girls' fame grows, however, their time together as a family diminishes, and now the very popularity they sought is threatening to tear them apart. A difficult balance of work and bonding must be achieved, or they risk everyone going their separate ways. The personal and professional ordeals of these idols can not be conquered alone, but with each other's loving support, any obstacle or hardship can be overcome!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers find the series enjoyable due to its character-focused episodes, appealing aesthetics, and heartwarming portrayal of teamwork. However, others are critical of the lack of a strong overarching plot, the sometimes irritating characters, and the potential for the series to stray from a realistic portrayal of the idol industry.
pros: Character development and individual spotlights for each idol.
Appealing animation, art, and music.
Focus on teamwork and the challenges of the idol industry.
cons: Episodic nature with a lack of impactful or serious plot development.
Characters can be annoying or childish.
Potential for the series to diverge from realism.
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture, Personal Growth, Ensemble Cast

anime.title: Towanoquon: The Ephemeral Petals
anime.romaji_title: Towa no Quon 1: Utakata no Kaben
anime.synopsis:
Living amongst the rest of humanity, there is a small number of people known as "Attractors" that possess strange powers. Fearful of these dangerous mutations, a highly secretive organization named Custos uses cyborgs from a group called WTOC to exterminate Attractors before they can injure anyone or disrupt the social order.

Conversely, inside the theme park Fantasium Garden, there is a hidden group of Attractors who want to save their people from being eradicated by Custos. Led by the ever-optimistic Quon Mitsuchi, the Attractors take on intense fights against Custos's WTOC in the hopes of protecting the existence of their kind.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While praised for its animation and action, the series is heavily criticized for its lack of originality, generic characters, and derivative plot. Some find it enjoyable despite its flaws, while others consider it boring and forgettable.
pros: High production values, especially animation and action sequences.
Exciting fights and easy-to-follow story.
Good character design.
cons: Unoriginal plot, derivative of X-Men and other superhero stories.
Generic characters and shallow characterization.
Pacing issues, with excessive exposition and slow development.

anime.title: Maid Sama! Play with Your Husband ♥
anime.romaji_title: Kaichou wa Maid-sama!: Goshujinsama to Asonjao♥
anime.synopsis: As she strives to be an upstanding student council president, Misaki Ayuzawa maintains the same dedication to her secret part-time job at a maid cafe. As if Misaki's everyday life is not busy enough, the people around her only make it more hectic. Each colorful member of the cast has a story to tell, expressing their personalities further by putting their own twist on familiar scenes.
