anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a short, comedic special primarily designed for existing fans of 'Kaichou wa Maid-sama!'. It focuses on self-introductions and humorous takes on familiar scenes. While lacking a strong narrative, it provides lighthearted entertainment and relies on the viewer's familiarity with the characters and previous episodes for maximum enjoyment.
pros: Funny
Enjoyable for fans of the series
cons: Lacks a substantial story
Relies on prior knowledge of the series for full enjoyment

anime.title: Rio: Rainbow Gate! Special
anime.synopsis: With the goal of making Mint's birthday unforgettable, Choco sets out on a heartfelt journey to buy the perfect present.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is surprisingly well-animated, especially given its nature as a pack-in. However, the story is basic and odd. Overall, it is a decent addition for fans of the series.
pros: Well animated, especially considering it was a pack-in.
Voice acting is good.
cons: Basic story, odd plot.

anime.title: Battle Girls: Time Paradox
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Historical, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Yoshino Hide is an average girl who always seems to find trouble wherever she goes. One day Yoshino visits a local shrine to pray in order to pass her upcoming test. However, Yoshino sees a blue light coming from inside the Shrine and looks inside to find a mysterious person performing a magic spell. In a stroke of bad luck, Yoshino trips on a small bell and crashes into the shrine, prompting the stranger to catch her. Upon Yoshino's capture, the magic spell spirals out of control and sends Yoshino back in time to the Sengoku Era.

Yoshino then encounters Akechi Mitsuhide and Oda Nobunaga. But unlike what really happened during the era, Hideyoshino realizes that everyone in the world is female. She then decides to help Oda Nobunaga find the Crimson Armor which is said to allow the person wearing the armor to conquer all of Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Sengoku Otome: Momoiro Paradox is viewed as a decent and enjoyable anime, especially for viewers seeking a lighthearted take on the Sengoku period. While some find the main character annoying and the plot predictable, others appreciate the likeable characters and fun comedic elements. The show is not considered a masterpiece but is generally regarded as a good way to kill boredom.
pros: Likeable characters, especially Nobunaga
Fun and relaxing to watch
Good blend of comedy and action
Unique take on Sengoku era with gender-reversed characters
cons: Weak or annoying protagonist (Hideyoshi)
Story can be predictable
Inconsistent art style and animation
Overreliance on fan service
Simplistic plot

anime.title: Uta no Prince Sama
anime.genres: Comedy, Idols (Male), Josei, Music, Reverse Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Haruka Nanami, an aspiring composer from the countryside, longs to write music for her beloved idol, Hayato Ichinose. Determined to accomplish this goal, she enrolls into Saotome Academy, a highly regarded vocational school for the performing arts.

Upon her arrival, Haruka soon learns that everyone on staff, including the headmaster, is either an idol, a composer, or a poet. To top it all off, she is surrounded by incredibly talented future idols and composers, and the competition among the students is fierce; with the possibility of recruitment by the Shining Agency upon graduation, the stakes are incredibly high. As she strives to reach her dream at the academy, one fateful night, a series of events lead Haruka to a mysterious man standing in the moonlight, and he seems a bit familiar...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers enjoying the anime for its catchy music, attractive visuals, and bishonen characters, while others criticize it for its weak plot, shallow characters, and reliance on clichés. The main character is often seen as bland and uninspiring, detracting from the overall experience. Despite its flaws, some find it enjoyable as a light-hearted and entertaining watch, especially for fans of reverse harem and idol anime.
pros: Catchy and enjoyable music, especially the ending theme 'Maji Love 1000%'
Visually appealing art style with bright colors and attractive character designs
Distinct personalities for the male characters, catering to a diverse audience
cons: Weak and unoriginal plot with a typical reverse harem setup
Shallow and underdeveloped main character (Haruka) who lacks personality and impact
Over-reliance on tropes and cliches, with a lack of depth in character development and storytelling
Unrealistic scenarios and forced romantic interests, creating a plastic and artificial feel

anime.title: Bakugan: Mechtanium Surge
anime.synopsis:
After returning from the feuding realms of Gundalia and Neathia, Danma Kuusou and his companions continue their lives on Earth. Now, a year later, the virtual reality world of Bakugan Interspace has finally recovered from the alien invasion and has once again become a place for brawlers to gather and challenge themselves.

It turns out, however, that whenever Danma's Bakugan, Pyrus Dragonoid, unleashes his might in battle, the Interspace experiences new disruptions. Unable to harness the incredible powers granted to him by Code Eve—the Bakugan Mother spirit—he struggles to maintain control over the Mechtogan contained within him. When it goes out of control, the mysterious mechanical entity wreaks havoc on the battlefield, attacking friends and foes alike.

To make matters worse, Bakugan Interspace is at risk of being infiltrated again. An unknown mastermind is sending mutated Chaos Bakugan into the system in order to brainwash brawlers and take control of the virtual realm. In anticipation of the inevitable confrontation, Danma must find a way to keep the Mechtogan's destructive force at bay and rally the Battle Brawlers once again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Mechtanium Surge is divided, with strong praise for its improved animation and action sequences. However, significant criticisms point to a predictable and dragged-out story, inconsistent animation quality, and a perceived focus on merchandise over narrative substance, leading to a polarized view of its overall quality.
pros: Outstanding 3D/CGI animation for Bakugan and Mechtogan, with metallic body parts enhancing designs.
Updated character outfits making them look like modern teenagers.
Return of fan-favorite characters and introduction of new ones.
The story is awesome and engaging, with improvements over previous seasons.
cons: Sound design remains unchanged from previous seasons and is a significant downside.
Some new characters, particularly Team Sellon and Razenoid, are described as annoying.
The story can be predictable and drags out unnecessarily.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with Mechtogans looking terrible and battle scenes being hit-or-miss.
Numerous plot holes exist, such as unexplained changes in Bakugan partners.
The season feels like a cash grab with an excessive number of new Bakugan variants and accessories.

anime.title: Last Exile: Fam, the Silver Wing
anime.synopsis:
"I've made up my mind! I'm going to steal that ship!"

All source of life originates from the Grand Lake.

At this very sacred lake, the battle between the Ades Federation and the Turan Kingdom has just begun. The Ades Federation, armed with massive battleships and its sights set on conquering the world, declares war on the Turan Kingdom. With the Federation's troops encroaching on their beloved country, Turan now lies on the brink of collapse. As this is happening, the princesses of Turan look on as a small vanship named Vespa cruises above their heads.

"We shall now commandeer your flagship and take her from this battlefield. The choice is yours. Die here, or survive with us Sky Pirates!"

The Vespa continues to weave through the barrage of bombs, while the fleets of the Federation close in on Turan.

What are the motives of Luscinia, the man leading the Ades Federation into the war? And what is the secret behind "Exile"?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many feeling disappointed, especially compared to the original Last Exile. While the animation and some political elements are praised, the weak main character and flawed storytelling are major drawbacks.  Many feel the sequel fails to capture the magic of the original and ultimately falls short as both a standalone adventure and a continuation of the series.
pros: Excellent animation and visual quality, especially the CGI for battleships and aerial sequences.
Intriguing political elements with nations having understandable reasons for conflict and peace.
Some antagonist characters are well-developed with understandable motives.
cons: Weak and unlikeable main character (Fam) with little to no character development and an unrealistic, naive idealism.
Poor storytelling with rushed plot points, inconsistent pacing, and a confusing narrative.
Underdeveloped or pointless cameos of characters from the original Last Exile, feeling like fan service.
Inconsistent world-building and shallow exploration of complex themes.

anime.title: Honto ni Atta! Reibai Sensei
anime.synopsis: The story revolves around Kibayashi, a teacher whose hobby is speaking with the dead and whose special talent is exorcism. She seems to know everything about the other world, yet nothing about our own.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed Honto ni Atta! Reibai Sensei as a short, comedic anime with supernatural elements. While some found the plot lacking and the animation simplistic, others appreciated the humor, character designs, and the unexpected ending. The series is considered a lighthearted and enjoyable watch, especially for those who like random humor and slice-of-life stories with a touch of the occult.
pros: Unexpected and different ending
Strong character presence and added value to the story
Random jokes and touching stories (Gintama vibes)
Cute character designs (Kibayashi, cats)
Catchy ending themes
cons: Lack of plot or story
Uninteresting art style, looks like flash animation (except last episode)
Repetitive jokes and cliched settings
Not much character development
Art style doesn't match a 2012 anime

anime.title: Happy Kappy
anime.synopsis: The story revolves around Kinoshita Suguri, a nine-year-old third-grade girl who loves animals and making fashion accessories. One day, while Suguri is out buying materials for accessories, she comes across an unusual rock. Thinking it would look cute on a bracelet, she goes to pick up the rock and discovers a creature named Kappy. Kappy happens to be the three-year-old prince of Kapimeshia.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds "Happy Kappy" to be a lighthearted and simple show aimed at children. While charming and visually appealing, it lacks complexity and depth, making it predictable.  It's considered a 'fluff' anime with minimal controversy, mainly enjoyed for its cute premise and magical elements.
pros: Bright colors
Simple and easy to watch
Cute premise with a magical pet
cons: Predictable plot
No strong conflict
Lacks depth and groundbreaking elements

anime.title: Fireball Charming
anime.synopsis: A 3D computer animation about a female robot duchess named Drossel von Flügel and her guardian servant robot Gedächtnis.
anime.consensus_summary: Fireball Charming is generally well-received for its unique humor, charming characters, and visual appeal. While the humor might not resonate with everyone and the plot is initially sparse, the short episodes and witty dialogue create an enjoyable experience. Many appreciate the blend of intelligent comedy with absurd situations, making it a worthwhile watch, especially when viewed in the recommended order with the subsequent series.
pros: Excellent wordplay and intellectual comedy.
Charming and memorable characters, especially the dynamic between Drossel and Gedächtnis.
Visually appealing CGI animation with attention to detail.
Fast-paced and well-executed comedic skits.
Unique blend of deep themes and superficial comedy.
cons: Humor may not be for everyone, especially if puns and wordplay are lost in translation.
Lack of a strong overarching plot in the initial series.
Some may find the rapid-fire dialogue overwhelming.
Limited backstory for characters.
Inconsistent episode introductions (according to one review).

anime.title: Hakuoki: Demon of the Fleeting Blossom - A Memory of Snow Flowers
anime.synopsis:
Rumors about a potential plot to dismantle the Shinsengumi by setting fire to their headquarters have spread amok. As most of the talk stems from an inn in Shimabara, the Shinsengumi place trust in Chizuru Yukimura for help with the investigation. Disguised as a geisha, Chizuru infiltrates the inn to provide intel for the Shinsengumi but quickly finds that the operation is more intricate than they could ever imagine.

At the same time, each member of the Shinsengumi has their own reservations and concerns about using their sole female colleague to gather intelligence. Knowing what dangers await her, they all resolve to protect her at any cost.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received by fans as a valuable addition to the Hakuouki series, offering deeper character exploration and lighter moments. However, some criticize the female protagonist's role and question the necessity of the OVA beyond fan service. Overall, it is considered a worthwhile watch for fans of the series.
pros: Expands on character relationships and backstories.
Provides lighthearted moments contrasting the main series' tragedy.
Rounds off the main series, providing a satisfying conclusion.
cons: The female protagonist, Chizuru, is considered useless by some viewers.
Some view it as fan service.

anime.title: Humanity Has Declined
anime.synopsis:
Because of the constantly declining birth rates over many decades, human civilization is all but extinct. With only a few humans remaining, they survive in this post-apocalyptic world with what was left behind by the previous generations. Earth is now dominated by fairies, tiny creatures with extremely advanced technology, an obsession with candy, and a complete disregard for human safety. 

A young girl who has just finished her studies returns to her hometown and is designated as an official United Nations arbitrator. Her duty is to serve as a link between mankind and fairies, reassuring each side that both races can live together peacefully. She imagines this task will be easy enough, but controlling the disasters created by the oblivious fairies in their pursuit of candy will require a lot more effort than she initially believes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many praising the show's originality, satire, and thought-provoking themes. However, some find the non-linear storytelling, bizarre humor, and lack of character development off-putting. The show's unique and unconventional nature makes it a love-it-or-hate-it experience.
pros: Original and thought-provoking concept.
Clever satire and social commentary.
Unique non-linear storytelling.
Observant and cynical protagonist (Watashi).
Visually appealing art style.
cons: Episodic nature can feel undeveloped.
Humor may not appeal to everyone.
Plot can be confusing and bizarre.
Lack of character development for supporting characters.

anime.title: Beyblade: Metal Fury
anime.synopsis:
In the Cosmos, an unusual event has occurred.

Taking a break from their latest triumph over Faust and the Spiral Core, Ginga and Co find themselves saving a boy named Yuki from a mysterious youth named Johannes. Although Yuki is a boy genius and an astronomer, he is a Blader who owns “Anubius”.

Yuki says that he has come to tell Ginga and his friends about the voice of the Star Fragment. He witnessed the Star Fragment (a meteor) fall from the sky one day. That single light dwells within Anubius and he says that he heard the voice of the Star Fragment that evening. A great evil is trying to revive the “Black Sun” and "Nemesis", the god of destruction, by using the unknown power of the Star Fragment and destroy the world.

Ginga and his friends must fight again, just as soon as they get the hang of their new 4D system beys!

The episode numbers continue from 103. Episodes 103 to 128 are half-hour long episodes, while 129 to 154 are quarter-hour long. The latter episodes are shown in English as 13 half-hour long episodes (two Japanese episodes combined into one English episode).
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Metal Fight Beyblade 4D for its characters, exciting battles, and inspirational themes, particularly its messages about friendship and never giving up. Despite some criticism regarding the writing quality and toy promotion aspect, the show is considered a nostalgic and enjoyable experience for many, especially those who grew up with the series. A common theme among reviewers is it holding a 'special place in my heart'.
pros: Memorable fights and hype moments.
Inspirational main character (Gingka).
Enjoyable side characters (Benkei, Kenta, Kyoya).
Ryuuga is a great character.
cons: Not as popular as it used to be.
Main purpose is to promote toys.
Not well-written.

anime.title: Kamisama Dolls
anime.synopsis: When Kyouhei moves to Tokyo, he thinks he's left his old life behind. But when he discovers a bloody corpse, he also discovers that the past isn't easily left behind, especially when the past is as unusual as Kyouhei's. You see, back in his home town, Kyouhei was a "seki," an individual able to control "kakashi," ancient wooden "gods" capable of incredible feats, with his mind. Now there's a kakashi loose in Tokyo, and it just may be up to Kyouhei to stop it AND its seki in Kamisama Dolls!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Kamisama Dolls are mixed. While some appreciate the unique story, character depth, and balance of genres, others are critical of the predictable plot, abrupt ending, and average animation. Many feel the anime is underrated, though it suffers from pacing issues. Ultimately, the series is considered enjoyable for those who can overlook its flaws and appreciate its unique elements.
pros: Interesting characters with depth and development.
Unique and engaging story, though it takes time to develop.
Good balance of drama, comedy, and action.
The soundtrack and sound effects are well done, with unique themes for each doll.
The opening animation is symbolic and punchy.
cons: The plot can be predictable and relies heavily on flashbacks.
The ending feels abrupt and leaves many unresolved plot points.
The animation quality is average, with some inconsistencies.
The main character can be bland and uninteresting.
Some comedic moments feel out of place.

anime.title: The Squid Girl 2
anime.synopsis:
After regaining her squid-like abilities, Ika Musume plans to resume her self-appointed mission to destroy all of humanity. However, her carefree job as a waitress in the Lemon beach house meant she cannot help but laze around during her spare time! On top of that, she is saddled with many problems, such as being pursued by a group of alien-obsessed individuals and catching the interest of a crazy girl. 

Picking up after the conclusion of the first season, Shinryaku!? Ika Musume follows the hilarious life of Ika Musume as she plots her next invasion of the surface world.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Shinryaku!? Ika Musume is largely seen as more of the same, offering familiar lighthearted comedy and cute characters. While fans of the first season may enjoy it, some find it repetitive and lacking in new content. Certain characters and segments are criticized, but overall, it provides easy-to-watch, mind-numbing entertainment.
pros: Humorous and lighthearted entertainment.
Cute and endearing characters.
Familiar and comfortable viewing experience for fans of the first season.
cons: Repetitive and lacking in novelty compared to the first season.
Mini-Ika segments feel out of place.
Some characters, like the Three Stooges, are disliked and detract from the show's quality.

anime.title: Natsume's Book of Friends Season 3
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Natsume Yuujinchou San follows Takashi Natsume, a boy who is able to see youkai. Natsume and his bodyguard Madara, nicknamed Nyanko-sensei, continue on their quest to release youkai from their contracts in the "Book of Friends."

Natsume comes to terms with his ability to see youkai and stops thinking of it as a curse. As he spends more time with his human and youkai friends, he realizes how much he values them both and decides he doesn't have to choose between the spirit and human worlds to be happy.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Natsume Yuujinchou San' to be a heartwarming and gentle anime, with a focus on character development and exploration of themes like acceptance and friendship. While some find the episodic nature and repetitive situations to be a drawback, most appreciate the show's relaxing and engaging qualities. The series is considered a beloved installment, with viewers praising its emotional depth and character-driven narratives.
pros: Heartwarming and touching stories with character growth.
Exploration of Natsume's past and development.
Realistic and heartfelt characters.
cons: Episodic nature with lack of overarching plot development.
Repetitive situations.
Simplicity may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: A Letter to Momo
anime.synopsis:
After the unexpected death of her father, 11-year-old Momo Miyaura leaves Tokyo with her mother and moves to an old remote island in Seto Inland Sea. The only memento she has from her father is an unfinished letter with only two words inside: "Dear Momo"—along with her heart's unrest from it.
 
In the new and unfamiliar small town, Momo reluctantly tries to adjust to the outmoded wooden buildings, silent crop fields, and mysterious isolated shrines. One day, while exploring the attic of her new home, she finds a worn out picture book about youkai. Following this discovery, strange things begin to happen around town, and Momo is greeted by the arrival of three troublesome youkai.
 
Momo e no Tegami tells the story of a young girl as she struggles to adapt to her bizarre new life and ultimately come to terms with her father's mysterious letter.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with praise for the film's visuals, emotional depth, and character development. However, some viewers found the story predictable and the comedic elements off-putting. While many appreciate the Ghibli-esque feel, others feel it falls short of its predecessors.
pros: Stunning animation and art style reminiscent of Studio Ghibli, with great attention to detail in visuals and character expressions.
Touching and heartwarming storyline that explores themes of grief, loss, and adaptation.
Well-developed protagonist that the audience can relate to, undergoing a significant journey of self-discovery and healing.
cons: Story feels clichéd and predictable, with familiar tropes and a lack of originality.
Some viewers found the comedic elements and the youkai characters to be irritating and unfunny.
Pacing can be slow, especially in the beginning, and the climax feels rushed and shoe-horned in.

anime.title: Ben-To
anime.synopsis:
The supermarket is an important building in any city, for they provide a convenient way to purchase a variety of food in a family-friendly, safe environment. However, these stores changes in the blink of an eye once the unsold bento boxes go on their nightly half-off sales! War breaks out and friends become foes as each person fights for honor, pride, and dinner. There are no longer any people in these supermarkets, only Wolves and Dogs⁠—winners and losers.

High schooler You Satou is painfully introduced to these battles after unknowingly stumbling into the war zone, but instead of choosing to avoid these nightly fights, he wants to join in. After seeing Satou's lack of fighting skills, upperclassman and Wolf Sen Yarizui invites him and Hana Oshiroi, a girl who enjoys spectating the brawls, to join her Half-Priced Food Lovers Club to show them the distinction between the Dogs and the Wolves. Together, they learn what it truly means to fight for your food.
anime.consensus_summary: Ben-To is a light-hearted and entertaining anime with a unique premise that is generally well-received for its comedic action and over-the-top characters. However, some viewers are turned off by the excessive fanservice, shallow plot, and reliance on genre tropes. While not a deep or thought-provoking show, it provides a fun and enjoyable experience for those looking for mindless entertainment.
pros: Unique and comedic premise of fighting for discounted bentos
Well-choreographed and animated fight scenes
Enjoyable and over-the-top characters with distinct personalities
Upbeat and fitting opening theme song
cons: Story can be repetitive and predictable, lacking depth
Excessive fanservice that detracts from the action
One-dimensional characters with minimal development
Overreliance on genre cliches and stereotypes

anime.title: Mashiroiro Symphony: The Color of Lovers
anime.romaji_title: Mashiro-iro Symphony: The Color of Lovers
anime.synopsis:
When boys suddenly get into places where they've never been allowed before, some girls tend to get upset. So when the decision is made to merge the elite Yuihime Girls' Private Academy and the coeducational Kagamidai Private Academy, everyone wants to take extra care in avoiding trouble while bringing the two Privates together. Therefore, rather than just bringing the Kagamidai boys into the Yuihime girls' school all at once, a plan is concocted in which a group of test males will be inserted into the Girls' Private Academy first.

Thus, poor young Shingo finds himself being thrown as a sacrificial lamb to the lionesses of Yuihime, who aren't exactly waiting for him with open arms. Will Shingo manage to survive the estrogen soaked death pit that is Yuihime? Can the girls learn to be more receptive to the boys? And just how long until something involving panties will cause emotions to flare, sparks to fly and the battle of the sexes to explode?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience sentiment towards 'Mashiro-iro Symphony' is mixed. While many appreciate the refreshing protagonist, good art, and conclusive ending, others are critical of the disjointed plot, underdeveloped characters, and lack of depth. The anime is generally considered an enjoyable but not exceptional entry in the harem genre, with a notable shift in focus that can be polarizing.
pros: Likeable, non-perverted protagonist is a refreshing change from typical harem anime.
Well-developed characters with unique personalities and backstories.
Excellent artwork and character design.
Enjoyable music that complements the mood of the series.
A conclusive ending where the protagonist chooses one of the female characters, which is rare in harem anime.
cons: Sudden shifts in the plot focus from one female character to another can feel disjointed and unresolved.
Some characters are underdeveloped or fall into generic archetypes.
The story lacks depth and can be predictable.
The ending may feel rushed or unsatisfying for viewers who preferred a different romantic pairing.
The initial premise of merging two schools is eventually forgotten.

anime.title: Into the Forest of Fireflies' Light
anime.genres: Award Winning, Drama, Romance, Shoujo, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
During a summer vacation at her grandfather’s house, six-year-old Hotaru Takegawa gets lost in a forest rumored to be inhabited by spirits. While crying out in desperation, Hotaru is approached by Gin—a mysterious boy wearing a mask—who offers to help her.

Overjoyed at the sight of another person, Hotaru runs to Gin with open arms only to be rudely fended off. However, she quickly learns the grave reason behind his behavior: a dreadful curse has been cast upon Gin. Should he ever be touched by a human being, he will disappear forever.

Though Gin urges her to never return, Hotaru does the exact opposite, and before too long, the two become close friends despite his delicate situation. Nonetheless, as years pass and their mutual feelings grow stronger, Hotaru and Gin start struggling with the boundaries that destiny has set between them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the movie's emotional impact, art, and music, and the pureness of the central relationship. However, a significant minority is disturbed by the age difference between the characters, viewing it as an inappropriate romanticization of a relationship with a minor. Some find the plot too simplistic or the character development lacking.
pros: Beautiful art style and animation
Evocative and fitting music
Pure and innocent love story
Effective storytelling despite short runtime
Emotionally resonant and impactful
cons: Questionable age gap between characters (perceived pedophilia/grooming)
Lack of character depth
Story is too simple
Ending is disappointing

anime.title: GYO: Tokyo Fish Attack!
anime.genres: Drama, Gore, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Though her trip to Okinawa was supposed to be a lovely excursion to the seaside, college student Kaori Sawahara finds that it is anything but when a horrifying menace emerges from the watery depths. A strange mechanism has taken control of the sea creatures, granting them legs and sending them on land to attack anything in their way. Kaori and her friends—the lustful Erika and the reserved Aki—find themselves caught up in this onslaught, made worse by the creatures' rotting stench of death.

Surviving the first assault, Kaori tries to contact her fiancé Tadashi in Tokyo. However, the call is cut short in what sounds like another fish attack. Fearing for his safety, Kaori leaves for Tokyo. With Erika and Aki contending with the attacks in Okinawa, Kaori rushes to find Tadashi, unaware that the crisis has only just begun.
anime.consensus_summary: Gyo is a deeply divisive anime, often praised for its unique and bizarre premise and sometimes for its unintentional comedy, making it a "so bad it's good" experience for some. However, the overwhelming majority of criticism points to an incomprehensible plot, shallow characters, and gratuitous fan service, leading to a strong polarization between those who find it hilariously bad and those who simply find it bad.
pros: Decent 3D animation, especially for its time
Some viewers found the sheer absurdity and "so bad it's good" quality enjoyable
Character designs were noted as visually appealing by some
The premise is uniquely bizarre
cons: Incredibly convoluted and nonsensical plot with frequent, unexplained shifts and plot conveniences
Character development is minimal, with protagonists being bland and often unrealistically invincible
The story often prioritizes gratuitous nudity and fan service over coherent storytelling
Voice acting is frequently described as apathetic and bland
The attempt at horror often falls into unintentional comedy, failing to deliver genuine scares
The animation quality is inconsistent, with jarring transitions between 2D and CGI
The sound design and OST are largely forgettable or unfitting

anime.title: Deadman Wonderland: The Red Knife Wielder
anime.synopsis:
Two years after the catastrophic tidal wave that swept over Japan, police officer Kiyomasa Senji is trying to make the world a safer place. Using his Branch of Sin powers, he stops criminals in whatever ways he can. After rescuing a boy named Izuru Tsukiyoshi from a gang called Goreless Peace, the conflict between Kiyomasa and his adversaries heats up rapidly, to the point of being explosive.

Offering a glimpse into the past of the future Deadman, the story follows Senji, helping to further develop the reasoning that drives his actions later in life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion on this OVA is split, with many appreciating the deep dive into Senji's backstory and finding it more engaging than the main series. However, a significant portion views it as underdeveloped filler that fails to address the main series' unresolved plot issues and introduces weak original characters.
pros: Provides valuable backstory for the popular character Senji/Crow, explaining his motivations and personality.
The story and character development for Senji are considered strong for an OVA, with some viewers finding it more compelling than the main series.
Visually appealing animation and sound design, particularly the retention of original music and improved voice acting for Senji.
Offers an enjoyable standalone experience for fans of the main series or manga, providing extra narrative depth.
cons: Fails to resolve overarching plot points from the main series or significantly tie up loose ends, serving primarily as filler.
Some original characters introduced in the OVA lack depth and do not significantly contribute to the plot or Senji's development.
The antagonist and plot are considered weak and repetitive by some, not living up to the potential of the premise.
Derivative of the main series' style and themes, and its connection to the original anime is crucial for full understanding, making it less of a standalone piece than intended.

anime.title: Digimon Fusion
anime.romaji_title: Digimon Xros Wars: Aku no Death General to Nanatsu no Oukoku
anime.synopsis: Returning to the Digital World, Taiki and Shoutmon learn that the Bagra Army has taken it over and reformatted the world to have Seven Kingdoms, each ruled by a general.
anime.consensus_summary: The arc continues the story of Xros Wars with a focus on fast-paced action and strategic battles against the Death Generals. While the plot progresses quickly, it suffers from a reliance on established Digimon designs and a decline in animation quality. Understanding the first part of the series is essential for enjoyment.
pros: Story moves at a fast pace, focusing on main plot points.
Battles are decided through strategy and different Digimon combinations.
cons: Requires watching the first part to understand the story.
Relies on old Digimon designs; lacks creativity.
Animation quality gets worse.

anime.title: Aquarion Evol
anime.synopsis: 12,000 years after the events in Genesis Aquarion, humans live on the star Vega under constant threat of trans-dimensional beings called Abductors. These enemies originate from Vega’s sister star Altair and raid Vega for human life. As a countermeasure, an organization known as Neo-DEAVA formed to combat the Abductors. They pilot advanced mecha suits called Aquaria and are strictly separated by gender. Boys and girls are not allowed contact; they are even restrained from fighting on the same battlefield. However, events take a shocking turn when an advanced Abductor mecha suit joins the fray. Two teenagers, Mikono and Amata, are dragged into the conflict. Unknowingly, Amata performs a taboo when he summons an Aquaria and initializes what is called the Forbidden Union between male and female Aquaria. Neo-DEAVA is shocked, and the repercussions of Amata’s actions are much farther reaching than he realizes. How was he able to summon an Aquaria? Where did he learn to form a Forbidden Union? And why was Mikono also able to pilot the mecha suit?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Aquarion Evol are divided. While the series is praised for its visuals, character designs, and initial story, many find the plot inconsistent and the romance/fanservice excessive. Some viewers appreciate the lighthearted approach, while others are disappointed by the lack of depth and unresolved plot points.
pros: Visually stunning artwork and animation.
Appealing character designs and development.
Enjoyable mix of genres (action, comedy, romance, sci-fi).
cons: Inconsistent story quality, especially in the later episodes.
Overreliance on fanservice and cheesy romance.
Lack of deeper explanations and plot holes.

anime.title: Horizon in the Middle of Nowhere
anime.synopsis:
In the far future, humans abandon a devastated Earth and traveled to outer space. However, due to unknown phenomenon that prevents them from traveling into space, humanity returns to Earth only to find it inhospitable except for Japan.

To accommodate the entire human population, pocket dimensions are created around Japan to house in the populace. In order to find a way to return to outer space, the humans began reenacting human history according to the Holy book Testament. But in the year 1413 of the Testament Era, the nations of the pocket dimensions invade and conquer Japan, dividing the territory into feudal fiefdoms and forcing the original inhabitants of Japan to leave.

It is now the year 1648 of the Testament Era, the refugees of Japan now live in the city ship Musashi, where it constantly travels around Japan while being watched by the Testament Union, the authority that runs the re-enactment of history. However, rumors of an apocalypse and war begin to spread when the Testament stops revealing what happens next after 1648.

Taking advantage of this situation, Toori Aoi, head of Musashi Ariadust Academy's Supreme Federation and President of the student council, leads his fellow classmates to use this opportunity to regain their homeland.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with many praising the unique world, action, and characters. However, the complex and confusing plot is a significant barrier to entry. While some find the fan service and humor enjoyable, others find it detracts from the overall experience. Overall, the anime has a niche appeal with strong positives and negatives.
pros: Unique and creative world-building and premise.
Interesting and diverse cast of characters with unique personalities.
Excellent animation, art style, and soundtrack, especially during battles.
cons: Overly complex and confusing plot, requiring outside research to understand.
Inconsistent pacing, especially in the early episodes.
Character designs can be overly exaggerated and contribute to unnecessary fanservice.
Some characters are annoying or one-dimensional.

anime.title: Poo-Neko
anime.synopsis: Based on a four-panel manga, Puu-Neko is about "jobless (puu)" cats and Momoyama Momoko, who can talk with them. According to the author, 98% of cats are jobless.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a collection of short, humorous stories about cats that will likely appeal to cat lovers. Its rapid-fire pace and random nature may be distracting for some viewers. The limited availability of subtitled episodes is a downside.
pros: Funny short stories
Appeals to cat lovers
Very short episodes
cons: Distracting randomness
Sparse animation
Loosely connected stories
Limited subtitled episodes

anime.title: You and Me.
anime.genres: Iyashikei, School, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Four childhood friends are in their second year at Homare High School: kind and cheerful Shun Matsuoka, hot-tempered Kaname Tsukahara, and the Asaba twins, gentle Yuuta and lazy Yuuki. When a dynamic transfer student, Chizuru Tachibana, joins their group, the friends get caught up in his creative yet troublesome ideas that end up bringing excitement to their everyday lives. With new encounters and experiences, they begin to learn more about each other and themselves.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences find 'Kimi to Boku' to be a heartwarming and relaxing slice-of-life anime with relatable characters and simple, pleasant stories. While some appreciate its simplicity and comedic moments, others find the lack of a strong plot and potentially mundane episodes to be a drawback. The show is generally well-received, with minimal controversy.
pros: Simple and pleasant story with natural events.
Likeable characters with unique personalities and relationships.
Relaxing and heartwarming with relatable themes.
Humorous without being silly.
cons: Lacks a strong central plot; can feel uneventful or boring.
Some episodes are forgettable and deal with mundane activities.
Simplicity might not appeal to viewers seeking more mature themes or complex narratives.

anime.title: Student Council's Discretion Level 2
anime.synopsis: Sugisaki Ken, through diligence and academic excellence, had successfully entered the paradise that is the Hekiyou Private Academy's Student Council. There, he boldly embarks on his plan to create his personal harem with the 4 girls who are the other council members, namely: The incredibly youthful president Sakurano Kurimu; The cool and kindly yet super-sadistic secretary Akaba Chizuru; Tomboyish and hot-blooded vice-president Shiina Minatsu; and The ephemerally beautiful yet complicated treasurer Shiina Mafuyu. While every day since then has been non-stop fun, Graduation Day now looms near. Could this spell the end of their carefree days?
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is generally well-received, especially by fans of the first season. The strong characters and comedic elements are praised, although some feel the jokes and storyline are not as strong as in the original. There is a slight shift towards more romance, with deeper moments for the characters.
pros: Diverse and likeable characters.
Heart-warming moments.
Improved animation compared to the first season.
Strong character development.
cons: Weaker jokes compared to the first season.
Lack of a strong overarching storyline.
Some humor relies on references that may not be understood by all viewers.

anime.title: Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei Special
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Mystery, Parody, Shounen
anime.synopsis: A new special episode that was distributed to those who purchase all three Blu-ray box sets of Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei series on January 31, 2012.
anime.consensus_summary: The Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei Special is well-received, especially for its Sherlock Holmes parody and high-quality animation.  Fans of the manga and Shaft studio appreciate its humor and creative storytelling. The special is considered easily accessible compared to the main series, making it enjoyable for a broad audience.
pros: Brilliant Sherlock Holmes parody within the Sayonara Zetsubou Sensei universe
Excellent animation quality by Shaft studio
Easy-to-understand comedy compared to other parts of the franchise
Creative storytelling with numerous twists
Highlights the best qualities of both the manga and Shaft's work
Good voice acting
cons: Ending may leave fans in 'despair' due to the anime ending

anime.title: Sengoku Basara Ni: Ryuko, Itadaki no Chikai! Atsuki Mirai e Kakeru Tamashii!!
anime.romaji_title: Sengoku Basara Ni: Ryuko, Itadaki no Chikai! Atsuki Mirai e Kakeru Tamashii!!
anime.synopsis: An extra episode included on the 7th DVD.
anime.consensus_summary: The special episode is well-received by fans, providing humor and highlighting character relationships. While its tone differs from the main series' ending, it's considered a worthwhile addition for those who enjoy the franchise's signature over-the-top style and character dynamics. The episode is a lighthearted departure that doesn't detract from the overall series.
pros: Highlights the relationship between Yukimura and his retainers
Good for a great laugh for fans of Sengoku Basara
Showcases Sasuke's ninja antics
cons: Humorous nature doesn't fit the feel of the end of the first season

anime.title: Blood-C
anime.genres: Action, Gore, Horror, Mystery, School, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Peaceful schoolgirl by day, fearsome monster slayer by night, Saya Kisaragi is leading a split life. Equipped with a ceremonial sword given to her by her father for sacred tasks, she vanquishes every monster who dares threaten her quiet little village. But all too soon, Saya's reality and everything she believes to be true is tested, when she overhears the monsters speak of a broken covenant—something she knows nothing about. And then, unexpectedly, a strange dog appears; it asks her to whom she promised to protect the village, curious as to what would happen if she were to break that promise. Tormented by unexplainable visions and her world unraveling around her, we travel with Saya through her struggle to find a way to the truth in a village where nothing is as it seems.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, with many criticizing the slow plot, weak characters, and excessive gore, while some appreciate the unique atmosphere, fight choreography, and art style. The series is considered a disappointment by many fans of the Blood franchise due to its poor story execution and lack of connection to previous installments. However, some viewers found enjoyment in the mystery and shocking twists that occur towards the end, redeeming the series to some extent.
pros: Well-animated and choreographed fight scenes, especially in the first episode.
Creative and gruesome action scenes.
Intriguing mystery and suspenseful atmosphere, particularly in the latter half.
Visually appealing character designs by CLAMP and high production value from Production I.G.
cons: Weak and slow-paced story with little plot progression in the initial episodes.
Repetitive monster-of-the-week format with boring dialogue.
Poorly developed and uninteresting characters with little to no personality.
Excessive and comical gore that goes over the top.
Lazy plot twists and farfetched explanations.
Inconsistent animation quality with noticeable drops in later episodes.
Heavy censorship of gore in some versions, diminishing the viewing experience.
Lack of connection to previous Blood series, disappointing long-time fans.

anime.title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kira
anime.romaji_title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kira
anime.synopsis:
1. Batsukoishi-hen
2. Ayakashisenshi-hen
3. Musubienishi-hen
4. Yumeutsushi-hen
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is sharply divided, largely based on expectations. Many fans feel the first episode is a complete failure due to excessive fanservice and a departure from the series' horror roots. However, those who appreciate the character-driven aspects and accept the OVA's comedic and lighter tone often find the later episodes, particularly 3 and 4, to be emotionally resonant and a fitting, albeit different, conclusion.
pros: Episodes 3 and 4 are highly praised for their emotional depth and satisfying conclusions.
The art and animation quality are considered improved and fitting for the lighter tone.
The soundtrack and voice acting remain strong and appropriate for the series.
Offers a lighthearted break and a different perspective on the characters.
cons: Episode 1 is widely criticized as 'garbage' and a 'disgrace' due to excessive, purposeless fanservice.
The OVA is seen by many as lacking the plot, mystery, and horror elements that define the original series.
Characterizations in the first episode are considered out of character and a 'destruction' of established personalities.
The shift to comedy and fanservice is a major disappointment for fans expecting the original series' tone.

anime.title: YuruYuri: Happy Go Lily
anime.genres: Award Winning, CGDCT, Comedy, Gag Humor, Girls Love, School
anime.synopsis:
After a year in grade school without her childhood friends, first year student Akari Akaza is finally reunited with second years Yui Funami and Kyouko Toshinou at their all-girls' middle school. During the duo's first year, Yui and Kyouko formed the "Amusement Club" which occupies the now nonexistent Tea Club's room. Shortly after Akari joins, one of her fellow classmates, Chinatsu Yoshikawa, pays the trio a visit under the impression that they are the Tea Club; it is only once the three girls explain that the Tea Club has been disbanded that they can convince Chinatsu to join the Amusement Club—a group with no purpose other than to provide entertainment for its members.

Based on the slice-of-life manga by Namori, Yuru Yuri is an eccentric comedy about a group of girls who spend their spare time drinking tea and fawning over each other, all while completely failing to even notice the supposed main character Akari amongst them.
anime.consensus_summary: Yuru Yuri is a divisive slice-of-life comedy with yuri elements. While some find the characters endearing, the humor light-hearted, and the overall experience relaxing, others criticize it for bland characters, a boring plot, and reliance on fan service. The show's use of suggestive themes involving young characters also draws strong criticism from some viewers.
pros: Endearing and enjoyable characters with unique personalities.
Funny and light-hearted slice-of-life comedy.
Catchy soundtrack and fitting animation style.
Relaxing and joyful to watch.
cons: Bland and uninteresting characters (excluding Kyouko).
Boring and uneventful plot.
Overuse of moe and fan-service elements.
Questionable suggestive content involving young characters.

anime.title: Ojiisan no Lamp
anime.synopsis:
When a young boy named Tooichi stumbles upon an old lamp in his grandfather's shed, he mistakes it for a toy and takes it outside to play. When his grandfather discovers this, he reprimands the boy and begins recounting the story behind the artifact—of how a small, traditional Japanese town became Westernized. 

In his youth, Tooichi's grandfather, Minosuke, made a living by doing errands and chores for the townspeople. After one errand takes him to a nearby town, he witnesses Western lamps—a technology unfamiliar to him—light up the streets, igniting a spark in the young boy. From that moment on, lamps became Minosuke's passion and profession, changing his and the townspeople's lives forever.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Ojiisan no Lamp' for its heartwarming story, realistic characters, and effective portrayal of emotions surrounding technological advancement. Some find the narrative simplistic or overly sentimental, but most agree it's a touching and visually pleasing short film. The film evokes a sense of nostalgia and reflection on the impact of change.
pros: Simple yet heartwarming story
Realistic and relatable characters
Effective portrayal of emotions
Beautiful and fitting art style
cons: Simplistic art may not appeal to all
Some find the story overly sentimental or cheesy
Framing device (grandfather telling story) feels unnecessary to some
Story lacks depth and exploration for some viewers

anime.title: Inazuma Eleven Go
anime.synopsis:
Tenma Matsukaze is a new student at Raimon Junior High. Due to his love for soccer, he decides to join the school soccer team, which gained its reputation after the amazing performance shown ten years earlier in the Football Frontier International, a tournament that hosts the best youth teams the world has to offer. Unfortunately, the once renowned school doesn't have the soccer spirit it once enjoyed.

This is primarily due to the fact that soccer in Japan is now controlled by a dark entity known as the "Fifth Sector." They alone decide the fate of every match, instructing teams to either win or lose. The actions of the Fifth Sector have beaten down the country’s soccer teams, who no longer have a love for the game.

Tenma and his teammates will look to shift this paradigm and fight back against their evil oppressors. Thankfully, they will not be alone in this battle, as they will get help from a group known as the "Resistance." Cheer on the boys of Inazuma Eleven Go as they fight the good fight!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Inazuma Eleven Go for its continuation of the original series' themes and execution of 'power of friendship'. However, some find the plot elements, such as the avatars and the Fifth Sector, less engaging. The beginning is considered slow and irritating by some, while others appreciate the overall experience.
pros: Good-naturedly silly and tries very hard.
Power of friendship done right.
Exciting sequel that lives up to the hype.
cons: Avatars are not as fun as hissatsu techniques.
Conflict left open.
Obnoxious start with a lot of whining.
Dumb premise with Fifth Sector controlling soccer.
Plot can be easily exhausted.

anime.title: Usavich IV
anime.synopsis: The fourth season of Usavich.
anime.consensus_summary: The season is viewed positively for its unexpected story developments and the introduction of a compelling new character. The musical elements are a point of interest, with some viewers appreciating them. Overall, the season is enjoyed for its absurdist humor and character-driven narrative, despite lacking depth in character backgrounds.
pros: New character is a star and capable of plenty of fun.
Story surprises and offers more than initially expected.
cons: Little focus on vocals.
Character background not explored in depth.

anime.title: Wagnaria!!2
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, Seinen, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
The exciting antics of Wagnaria return as more ridiculous incidents occur, friendships are deepened, and new feelings are discovered. In addition to Souta Takanashi and his wacky co-workers, more eccentric personalities join the family restaurant: Haruna, Hyougo Otoo's missing wife, who has a habit of getting hopelessly lost through the sewer system; Kirio Yamada, Aoi's older brother, who is able to withstand Mahiru Inami's deadly punches; and twins Youhei and Mitsuki Mashiba, Kyouko Shirafuji's juniors who do not get along.

Absurdity, romance, and hilarity are all on the menu for the Wagnaria family restaurant!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Working'!! as a lighthearted and funny slice-of-life anime. Many find it to be an improvement over the first season, with better comedy and character interactions. However, some viewers are critical of the lack of a strong plot and static character development.
pros: Improved comedy and character development compared to the first season.
Enjoyable and relaxing with a focus on character interactions.
New characters add to the dynamic and humor.
cons: Lacks a strong, overarching plot or goal.
Character development can be static and relationships don't progress significantly.
Some jokes may become repetitive or tiresome.

anime.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Steel Troops - The New Age
anime.romaji_title: Doraemon Movie 31: Shin Nobita to Tetsujin Heidan - Habatake Tenshi-tachi
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Kids, Mecha, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Jealous of Suneo's new robot toy, Nobita asks Doraemon to build him an even better one. Doraemon initially refuses, until Nobita accidentally discovers pieces of a mysterious robot that falls from the sky. After gathering all the robot parts and assembled them together, the giant robot, Zanda Claus, is soon completed. The duo soon learn that the robot is not a mere toy, but a powerful weapon in the fight against the coming Robot Army that is going to attack Earth and enslave the human inhabitants of it. An invasion is near, as a mysterious girl Riruru (リルル, Alternative spelling: Lilulu, Lillele [Doko Demo Doa Scanlations]) shows up, looking for the robot.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is overwhelmingly praised as one of the best Doraemon movies, particularly for its emotional depth, improved remake quality, and engaging story. While primarily aimed at children, it offers surprising complexity and addresses deeper themes, making it enjoyable for a wide audience. Some find certain elements, like the time travel aspect, less satisfying, but overall, the reception is highly positive.
pros: Great characters and antagonist
Good comedy
Excellent soundtracks and animation
Heartwarming story
Improved upon the original movie
Addresses deep themes and questions
Well-established story with few plot holes
cons: Treatment of time travel isn't satisfying
May not deeply challenge older viewers
Relies on familiar tropes

anime.title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You Season 2 - Mini Theater
anime.romaji_title: Kimi ni Todoke 2nd Season: Minitodo Gekijou
anime.synopsis:
DVD and BD-Box original animation shorts. 

Episodes 1 and 2 (DVD and BD) are short fairy tales of Cinderella and Snow White from Kurumi's telling, respectively.

Episode 3 (BD only) is a stage performance of Romeo and Juliet by Kazehaya and Sawako with Chizuru, Ayane, Ryuu in the backstage and Miura as the announcer.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the first two episodes of the minisodes, finding them funny and adorable. However, the 3rd episode, which uses 3D animation, is highly divisive. Some viewers find it endearing, while others feel it detracts from the overall charm and quality, creating a split in opinion.
pros: The first two episodes are adorable and funny.
The love rivals' interactions are enjoyable (boke and tsukkomi).
The '7 ossans' (dwarves/gnomes) are entertaining.
cons: The 3rd episode's 3D animation is jarring and negatively impacts the 'cute' feeling.
The 3rd episode feels less well-planned and plotted compared to the first two.
The 3rd episode feels like a 'sore thumb'.

anime.title: Heaven's Memo Pad
anime.synopsis:
Narumi Fujishima may seem like a normal high school student at first glance, but in reality he is a pessimistic outsider. Due to his father's work, he had to constantly transfer schools, and thus he has never managed to become a part of society. When he is forced to join the gardening club by his cheerful classmate Ayaka Shinozaki, Narumi encounters the genius hacker Alice, who lives in isolation above Hanamaru, the ramen shop where Ayaka works part-time. He then discovers that Alice is running a special private detective agency, and that all her professional associates refer to themselves as "NEET"s: Not in Education, Employment, or Training.

Joining the NEET detective agency due to his personal connection with a criminal case, Narumi finds himself entangled in a world of dangerous investigations conducted by the ill-assorted group of detectives, all the while trying to track down the crime syndicate which seems to have mysterious ties to Alice.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences found Kamisama no Memochou to be an engaging mystery anime with endearing characters and well-developed plots, though the initial episodes were slow and some cases were simpler than expected. The series effectively blends detective elements with character-driven drama. Despite some flaws, many viewers found it to be a must-see anime with a satisfying ending.
pros: Endearing characters with good development
Engrossing and exciting mystery plots
Strong character development throughout the series
Well-thought-out story with a good mystery-solving format
Intense writing with plot twists and tragedies
cons: Slow and cliche start
Simple cases that can seem dull at times
Some episodes feel like a waste of time
Animation quality is not outstanding
No central conflict

anime.title: The Prince of Tennis OVA Another Story II
anime.romaji_title: Tennis no Oujisama: Another Story II - Ano Toki no Bokura
anime.synopsis:
1. Tanjou! Buchou Shiraishi Kuranosuke
2. Seishun Gakuen Nanafushigi
3. Kyuushuu Nitsubasa
4. Jirou no Mezame
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys this series as a lighthearted addition to the original 'Prince of Tennis', appreciating the focus on character development and humor. However, some find it non-essential and too short to create significant excitement. It's recommended for fans of the original who want more background on specific characters.
pros: Expands on character traits and backstories
Enjoyable for fans of the original series
Humorous and entertaining episodes
cons: Short length limits excitement and build-up
Not essential to the main storyline
May feel like just add-ons to the original series

anime.title: C³ - CubexCursedxCurious
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: From the light novel series written by Minase Hazuki, comes a story of love, action, and comedy. Yachi Haruaki is a high school boy who is naturally resistant to curses. After his father sends him a mysterious black cube, Haruaki awakes to find a nude girl named Fear standing in his kitchen. She’s the human form of the cursed black cube – and an instrument of torture! Utilizing her special abilities, Fear fights alongside Haruaki to defeat other cursed instruments and their owners.
anime.consensus_summary: C³ is largely viewed as a flawed anime with a weak story and overabundance of fan service. While some appreciate the initial concepts and animation, the execution falls short due to rushed pacing and shallow characters. Many find the series unsatisfying and ultimately a waste of time, with a consensus that it could have been better with stronger writing and focus.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation in fight scenes.
Enjoyable voice acting and some well-received opening/ending themes.
Interesting initial concepts for characters and world-building.
cons: Rushed and inconsistent storyline with multiple poorly connected arcs.
Underdeveloped characters with minimal depth and reliance on tropes.
Excessive fan service detracts from the plot and overall quality.
Poor pacing and difficulty balancing different genres.
Misleading first episode sets wrong expectations for the series

anime.title: Persona 4 the Animation
anime.genres: Action, Mystery, School, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Serial murders have recently plagued Inaba, with the police struggling to find any leads. Despite this, due to his parents going abroad for work, Yuu Narukami moves to the small town to live with his uncle for a year. He enrolls at Yasogami High School, where he meets and befriends Yousuke Hanamura, Chie Satonaka, and Yukiko Amagi.

While hanging out together after school, the group fills Yuu in on the urban legend known as the "Midnight Channel"—a mysterious TV channel that only appears at midnight on rainy days while the viewer is alone. Curious about the claim, Yuu decides to tune in that night, only to see the next victim of the serial murders appear on the screen instead. He also finds himself being drawn into the TV, which intrigues his newfound friends enough to want to investigate.

Yuu ends up falling into the world within the TV, which is blanketed by a thick fog and swarming with hostile creatures known as "Shadows." Realizing that this world is somehow connected to the murders, the Investigation Team forms with the goal of uncovering the mystery behind the incidents.
anime.consensus_summary: The Persona 4 anime adaptation is generally well-received, especially by fans of the original game, due to its faithfulness and use of familiar elements. However, some find the pacing rushed and the story less impactful compared to the game, making it potentially less enjoyable for newcomers. While praised for its adaptation, some critics argue it doesn't reach the same level of quality as the source material.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material (Persona 4 game).
Uses the same music and voice actors from the game.
Enjoyable for both newcomers and fans of the game.
cons: Pacing issues due to condensing a long game into a limited number of episodes.
Story feels rushed and jumps around, lacking depth for those unfamiliar with the game.
Video game adaptations tend to be lower quality than the source

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie 5: Blood Prison
anime.synopsis:
During their discussion of a sensitive investigation A, the Fourth Raikage, and his subordinates are ambushed by a cloaked intruder. As the Kumogakure leader repels the assault, he is shocked to discover that the culprit is Naruto Uzumaki! 

However, the assassination attempt is not the only crime attributed to the young ninja, who vigorously denies the accusations. To avoid a diplomatic conflict, Tsunade forcibly sends him to Kusagakure's Houzuki Castle—a maximum-security penitentiary dedicated to ninja criminals—until the situation is resolved.

Despite his powers being immediately suppressed by Mui, the prison's warden who possesses the ability to seal chakra, Naruto recklessly engages in futile escape attempts. But with the help of two fellow inmates, he realizes that there is more to this legendary detention facility than meets the eye. Uncovering a terrible secret, the trio embarks on a dangerous operation that may be Naruto's only chance to break free and prove his innocence.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. While some appreciate the engaging action and surprising plot twists, others find the story predictable and the beginning slow. Criticism centers on plot holes and character inconsistencies, creating mixed feelings overall.
pros: Exciting fight scenes and animation.
Interesting new characters add depth to the Naruto universe.
Plot twists and surprising moments enhance enjoyment.
cons: Predictable plot with familiar Naruto tropes.
Slow beginning with excessive talking/exposition.
Weaknesses in the storyline, such as Naruto's initial capture and the Leaf Village's decisions.

anime.title: VitaminX Addiction
anime.synopsis: The story is set at Seitei Gakuen, an elite private academy that teaches every level from kindergarten until college in Tokyo. A new female teacher named Minami Yuuri is starting her second year of teaching here, and she is now moving up from teaching middle school students to the assignment she had sought after: grammar for high school students. Unfortunately, she gets assigned to class 3-E. The class, called "Class X," is an infamous group of seniors who lack study skills; it is said that all of their previous teachers have retired due to ulcers or neurosis. Minami must try to reach out to these students, including the six leaders of the class "B6" (Baka 6), and get them into college.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is widely criticized for its poor plot, humor, and character development. The reverse harem aspect fails due to unappealing and unintelligent male characters. Overall, viewers found the show to be of low quality and difficult to enjoy.
cons: Boring scenario
Failed humor
Annoying characters
Dumb characters
Bad character design

anime.title: Aria the Scarlet Ammo Special
anime.romaji_title: Hidan no Aria: Butei ga Kitarite Onsen Kenshuu
anime.synopsis: The story takes place in Tokyo Butei High School, a special school where armed detectives—"Butei"—are trained to use weapons. Kinji Tooyama is a second-year-student who has a special ability, but he keeps it a secret to maintain an ordinary, peaceful life; however, when he gets caught in a bombing on the way to school, he encounters H. Aria Kanzaki, the most powerful S-Rank Butei student in Assault Studies.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are somewhat split, with some finding it a fun, well-developed OVA episode that retains the charm of the main series. Others feel it's disappointing, lacking a proper conclusion and failing to capitalize on its premise, making it feel random and 'meh' despite fan service elements.
pros: Same great art and sound as the anime
Characters retain their established personalities
Flows nicely and has development for an OVA
Provides a nice side of Kinji and shows the girls being girls
cons: Lacks a clear conclusion and feels random
Doesn't explore the 'why' or 'what' of the plot
Should have been more exciting, disappointing for fans expecting more
Doesn't feature 'hysteria mode' activation
Some ecchi scenes are between girls in the onsen

anime.title: Rerere no Tensai Bakabon
anime.synopsis: This story contains a lot of humor and edgy jokes that attract an audience ranging from toddlers to adults. Bakabon and his father turn common sense on its head. After all, common sense, that we take for granted, is frequently nonsensical, but comical. Bakabon's father has his own philosophy and he leaves no stone unturned in his quest for answers. Bakabon joins him in his philosophical quests which drive the people in their town crazy.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally agrees that Rerere no Tensai Bakabon is a funny and competent anime, though its simple and repetitive humor may not resonate with all viewers. While production values are considered good for its era and the characters are enjoyable, its appeal is somewhat niche due to the specific comedic style.
pros: Competent and stylish digital artwork for its time.
Animation is dynamic and holds up reasonably well.
The cast is fun and flows well together.
Simple, stylish, and competent humor.
cons: Comedy is simple and relies heavily on repetition.
Humor may not appeal to everyone.

anime.title: R-15
anime.synopsis: R-15 is about a boy, Taketo Akutagawa, who attends a school for geniuses: Inspiration Academy Private High School. Taketo is a genius novelist and writes erotica. Despite negative perceptions many people have of him, he aims to be at the top of his class and be recognized as the world's greatest writer.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience sentiment towards R-15 is mixed. While some appreciate the art style, music, and eccentric characters, many find the story weak, the fan service excessive, and the humor repetitive. The main character is often criticized, and the show is generally considered average, suitable for casual viewing but lacking depth or originality. Some viewers enjoyed it as a lighthearted ecchi comedy, while others found it boring and uninspired.
pros: Unique and eccentric characters
Appealing art style and fluid animation
Enjoyable music, especially the opening, ending, and certain insert songs
cons: Poor or unoriginal story
Overused ecchi elements and fan service with heavy censorship in some versions
Boring or unlikeable main character
Redundant jokes and predictable scenes

anime.title: The Future Diary
anime.genres: Action, Gore, High Stakes Game, Psychological, Shounen, Supernatural, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Yukiteru Amano is a shy middle schooler who regularly keeps track of what he does in his daily life by writing down all of his activities on his phone—a digital diary. Despite having no friends at school, Yukiteru is frequently seen talking to his supposedly imaginary friends Deus Ex Machina, the god of time and space; and Deus' servant, Mur Mur.

One day, Yukiteru wakes up and discovers that certain events of his day are preemptively displayed on his cellphone. While initially dismissing it as a coincidence, he slowly realizes that the incidents written in his phone actually take place in the near future. After spending the day benefiting from this new asset, Yukiteru learns that his classmate Yuno Gasai possesses a similar diary.

As the two team up to defeat an odd pursuer and head back to their respective homes, Deus Ex Machina explains that they—alongside 10 other contestants—have been drawn into a survival game whose victor will become the deity's successor. With no other options, Yukiteru and Yuno must use their cellphones—now called "Future Diaries"—to survive this unforgiving battle royale.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are sharply divided on Mirai Nikki. While some appreciate the thrilling premise and Yuno's character, many find the plot convoluted, the characters illogical, and the overall execution disappointing. The series is considered either a guilty pleasure or a frustrating waste of time, generating strong reactions on both sides.
pros: Interesting premise of future diaries and a battle royale.
Great music and opening themes.
Action-packed and engaging at times.
cons: Inconsistent plot and illogical character behavior.
Forced plot advancements and random plot twists.
Poorly executed story with many contradictions.
Protagonist is unlikable and frustrating.
anime.thematic_vibe: Psychological Thriller, Survival Game, Romantic Obsession

anime.title: Mardock Scramble: The Second Combustion
anime.synopsis: Rune Balot is weeping and trying to save both herself and a severely injured Oeufcoque from Shell's assassin Boiled. Luckily for her, Doctor Easter finally shows up in the Humpty Dumpty – a special militarized vehicle made for protecting those in Welfare cases if their lives are threatened. From there they go to Paradise, where the Scramble 09 technology (and Boiled's rebirth) was developed. All of the secrets of the past of Mardock City (and possibly its future) are revealed in this riveting second part of the Mardock Scramble series, upping the stakes and making Balot choose between justice for herself or peace within Paradise instead.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the film's ambition to delve deeper into the characters and expand the world, finding the story intriguing. However, many are left confused by the convoluted plot and random elements, criticizing the lack of coherence and meaningful symbolism.
pros: The story is intriguing and exciting.
The film attempts to give more depth to the first movie and explore characters in further detail.
cons: The plot is confusing and difficult to understand.
The author puts random, incoherent scenes together without creating a coherent screenplay.
The film has a problem with symbolism, exemplified by the egg-themed character names.

anime.title: The Tibetan Dog
anime.synopsis: After the death of his mother, Tenzin decided to leave town to live with his father in the Tibetan grasslands. Life is tough at first, until one day the young man witnesses a fight between Tibetan guard dogs and a dog with golden hairs outside the pack.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the film's visual beauty and heartwarming story of a boy and his dog in Tibet. However, some find the plot predictable and the ending overly fantastical. Character development and narrative depth are areas where the film could have been stronger.
pros: Beautiful animation of Tibetan landscapes
Engaging plot about a boy and his dog
Insightful portrayal of Tibetan life
Good sound
cons: Climax becomes ridiculous with supernatural elements
Obvious story arc for adults
Evil character lacks purpose
Unresolved plot points and unexplored relationships
Underdeveloped characters

anime.title: Ground Control to Psychoelectric Girl Special
anime.romaji_title: Denpa Onna to Seishun Otoko: Mayonaka no Taiyou
anime.synopsis: Makoto goes to the summer festival with Ryuuko. Afterwards, as promised, he meets up with Erio in an old temple to look at the stars. As they watch the Perseid meteor shower, Yashiro appears to declare that she will leave but not before showing her esper powers. She tells Makoto to step back, and shortly afterwards a meteorite falls in the exact spot where he was previously standing, destroying the torii. He is left with just a small injury and becomes bewildered wondering if Yashiro was actually an esper and/or an alien and that he can't say for sure that aliens and espers are unreal.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to this special is divided, with many praising its high production values and satisfying conclusion, while others are frustrated by its ambiguous narrative and lack of answers. It's seen as a visually appealing epilogue that leaves viewers wanting more but ultimately contributes little to plot resolution, dividing opinions on its overall success.
pros: SHAFT's signature high-quality art and animation are consistently praised.
The voice acting is noted as being good.
The ending provides a satisfying conclusion and a new outlook on the series' events.
The special successfully serves as marketing for the original light novel source by increasing interest.
cons: The special raises more questions than it answers, leading to confusion.
The narrative is described as a 'mishmash of ideas' that doesn't feel cohesive.
The plot feels underdeveloped and lacks meaningful progression, especially in relation to character development.
The comedy elements present in the main series are noted as being less prevalent or absent in the special.

anime.title: Gintama: Dai Hanseikai
anime.synopsis: Some of the characters get together and talk about "regrets" they have after 4 years of anime Gintama. Soon they fight over who gets more screen time. Special animation shown at the Gintama Haru Matsuri 2010 live event.
anime.consensus_summary: This special is primarily aimed at dedicated Gintama fans who appreciate meta-humor and behind-the-scenes content. However, the heavy reliance on reused footage and a lack of substantial new material makes it less appealing to a wider audience. The live voice actor performances are a highlight, but not enough to redeem the episode for some viewers.
pros: Enjoyable for hardcore Gintama fans
Features the voice actors performing live
cons: Mostly reused animation and flashbacks
Low rating compared to other Gintama specials
May not be appealing to casual viewers

anime.title: Blue Exorcist: Ura Eku
anime.synopsis: Ura Ex, extra short anime included in Blu-ray and the DVD releases of Ao no Exorcist.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views these specials as light and enjoyable but ultimately non-essential. They are appreciated by those who love the characters and want more content, but they lack a strong story and do not add anything significant to the overall narrative. The consensus is that they are a fun addition for fans but not a must-watch.
pros: Entertaining if you enjoy the characters
Good for killing time
Prolongs the enjoyment of the main anime series
cons: Weak story
Not essential to the main plot
Lacks depth and complexity

anime.title: Naruto: The Magic Genie and the Three Wishes
anime.romaji_title: Naruto Soyokazeden Movie: Naruto to Mashin to Mitsu no Onegai Dattebayo!!
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
While enjoying a barbecue alongside team members and peers, Naruto Uzumaki stumbles upon a strange old bottle that houses a genie! The mythical being is willing to grant three wishes, but in a flurry of excitement, Naruto ends up wasting the first two. Outraged, Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno start fighting with him over the last remaining chance.

As the other ninjas join the dispute, the whole matter—before they know it—turns into an all-out brawl for the precious container.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is overwhelmingly positive, with fans finding the special humorous and entertaining. While the story is acknowledged as simple or not particularly deep, its comedic value and character interactions are highly praised. It's seen as a fun, low-stakes addition for existing Naruto fans.
pros: The animation is very good, showing slight improvements over the original series with well-done jutsus.
The story is humorous and relaxed, fulfilling its purpose of making the viewer laugh.
Character interactions and group dynamics are fun to watch, with refreshing playful and hesitant portrayals.
The genie concept is humorous and provides a nice ring to the special.
It's recommended for Naruto fans and doesn't require prior knowledge of Shippuden.
cons: The story is not that great or is relatively simple.
There is virtually no music in this short, with a very short opening and ending.
The special's continuity with the series is questionable due to character designs (e.g., Ino's long hair, Sakura's short hair).
Subtitles were poorly edited or horrible, which some reviewers felt enhanced the humor.

anime.title: Morita-san wa Mukuchi.
anime.synopsis: Morita Mayu, a high school girl. She is extremely reticent and her silence and habit of looking at people's eyes straightly sometimes cause misunderstanding. The reason behind it is not because she doesn’t like to talk nor because she has nothing to say.
