The reason she rarely speaks is due to the fact she thinks too much before speaking, thus losing the timing to speak altogether. But she lives a happy school life with her classmates.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Morita-san wa Mukuchi' for its short, comedic episodes that are easy to consume. While some find the lack of depth and generic characters to be a drawback, most appreciate it as a lighthearted and quickly accessible form of entertainment. It's seen as a good option for those seeking a brief and simple anime to fill short periods of free time.
pros: Quick and easy to watch, fitting into busy schedules.
Humorous and lighthearted, providing a brief mood boost.
Characters are simple yet work well together to create funny scenes.
cons: Lacks substantial story and character development.
Can feel underwhelming due to its brevity and lack of depth.
Generic characters, with the exception of Morita.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Cute Comedy, Short Form

anime.title: Blood-C: The Last Dark
anime.synopsis:
Having escaped the many horrors of her village, Saya Kisaragi vows to hunt down the monster responsible and make him pay with his life. As she tears through flesh and bone for her vendetta, she encounters SIRRUT, a group of ingenious hackers, who enlist Saya to help them defeat a common enemy—someone she knows all too well.

Unfortunately, the path she follows is paved with tragedy, as once again, Saya faces betrayal at the hands of those she has come to trust. With her back against the wall, the fearsome monster slayer must fight with all her strength and skill if she is to overcome this final mission and exact vengeance.
anime.consensus_summary: While the film is widely praised for its exceptional art and animation, and is seen as an improvement over the Blood-C series, the narrative quality remains a point of contention. Many viewers found the plot underdeveloped and the ending anticlimactic, despite acknowledging its closure to Saya's story.
pros: Stunning art and animation quality, with beautiful colors and detailed choreography, often surpassing other high-quality anime.
Improved pacing and storytelling compared to the preceding TV series, providing a more cohesive narrative experience.
Satisfying conclusion that ties up loose ends from the anime, offering closure to Saya's arc.
cons: Plot inconsistencies and a lack of clear explanations for world-building elements and character motivations.
Underdeveloped secondary characters and a rushed narrative, making some plot points feel like filler or unnecessary.
Disappointing and anti-climactic ending that relies on shock value and predictable twists, failing to provide a truly impactful conclusion.

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden: Chunin Exam on Fire! Naruto vs. Konohamaru!
anime.romaji_title: Naruto: Honoo no Chuunin Shiken! Naruto vs. Konohamaru!!
anime.synopsis: As the Fourth Great Ninja War quickly approaches, Sunagakure hosts a special Chunin exam to strengthen the troops of the Allied Shinobi Forces. Among the participants are Konohamaru Sarutobi, an ambitious rookie, and Naruto Uzumaki, who has become a renowned ninja. Despite the significant disparity in skill, Konohamaru is excited at the prospect of proving himself in a competition against Naruto—the one person he both admires and sees as his rival.
anime.consensus_summary: While the special is praised for its attempt to focus on the serious nature of the Chunin exams and the compelling mentor-rival dynamic between Naruto and Konohamaru, the narrative quality is significantly hampered by a nonsensical and anticlimactic ending rule. This divisive element leads to strong polarization among viewers, with some appreciating the setup and others finding the conclusion to be a pointless cash grab that undermines the established stakes.
pros: Focus on the Chunin exams as a serious theme, rather than pure comedy.
Interesting dynamic between Naruto as mentor/rival and Konohamaru's ambition.
Good animation quality, including jutsu execution and destruction effects.
Satisfying ending with continued story during the credits.
The idea of Naruto and Konohamaru facing each other in a Chunin exam is compelling.
cons: The rule about Sage Mode being banned and Konohamaru winning is nonsensical and ruins the fight's credibility.
The fight itself is anticlimactic, with Naruto defeating Konohamaru too easily initially.
Lack of focus on other interesting participants in the Chunin exam.
Abrupt start with no explanation for Konohamaru and friends' initial situation.
Washed-out and unattractive colors, with bland character designs.
The presence of all important characters watching a Chunin exam right before a war is questionable.

anime.title: Muybridge's Strings
anime.synopsis: The destiny of photographer Eadweard Muybridge and that of a Japanese mother clash poetically in this exploration of the irrepressible human desire to make time stand still.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the animation's artistic merit and its creative approach to intertwining Muybridge's story with a mother-child relationship. The animation is seen as a beautiful tribute to Muybridge's contributions to motion pictures. Some viewers might find the historical subject matter less engaging.
pros: Yamamura's artistic direction and visual storytelling are prominent.
Unique and beautiful animation style resembling paintings in motion.
Effective intertwining of Muybridge's life with a mother-child relationship.
Harmonious use of piano music to add nuances.
cons: The subject matter (Muybridge's life) could be perceived as dry or boring.

anime.title: Magic Tree House
anime.synopsis:
Jack and Annie are siblings who live in the small American town of Frog Creek. The two of them could not be more different, as Jack reads all the books he can get his hands on, while Annie charges headfirst into adventure, even if it means getting up close and personal with a muddy frog. When the two kids happen upon a treehouse full of books in the woods, they are shocked when Jack's offhanded comment about wanting to visit the land of dinosaurs—depicted in one of the books they find—ends up transporting both them and the treehouse millions of years into the past!

While Annie is excited to explore their new surroundings, Jack is more concerned about getting home in one piece. However, when he finds a strange medallion that clearly was made by other humans, Jack's find soon kicks off an adventure that will take the siblings across ages and continents.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the adaptation as a nostalgic trip and a charming children's movie. While some find the plot simplistic and the art style unappealing, others praise the animation and the engaging mini-adventures. The adaptation is viewed as enjoyable for its target audience, despite some deviations from the source material.
pros: Charming and nostalgic adaptation for fans of the book series.
Visually appealing art style and animation.
Engaging mini-adventures and plot progression.
cons: Story can be too straightforward and lack compelling climaxes.
Some find the art style too 'Americanish' for anime.
Unnecessary B-plots and deviations from the original book material.
Inconsistent time control mechanics.
Characters can be simplistic
anime.thematic_vibe: Childhood Adventure, Historical Fantasy, Sibling Bonds

anime.title: Plastic Neesan
anime.synopsis:
Iroe Genma is a third-year high school student often referred to as "Elder Sister" despite her short height. This troublemaking teenager is the president of her school's Model Club, which is dedicated to building plastic models of various objects and structures, such as cars, boats, and even robots.

Joined by her two underclassmen, the violent Hazuki "Okappa" Okamoto and the rational Makina "Makimaki" Sakamaki, the small group aims to carry out their club duties but are often sidetracked by a myriad of distractions. From battles between club members to lessons on how to confess to your crush, these three schoolgirls get caught up in all sorts of wacky, and downright outrageous situations!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Plastic Nee-san for its short, fast-paced, and absurdist comedy. The characters are considered memorable and the voice acting is well-received. However, some find the lack of story and reliance on ecchi humor to be drawbacks, while others may not appreciate the animation style, but overall is a fun short anime.
pros: Excellent chemistry between characters.
Fast-paced humor and quick punchlines.
Unique and memorable characters.
Good voice acting.
cons: Lack of overarching story.
Humor may not appeal to everyone.
Ecchi content may be off-putting.
Animation can be inconsistent.

anime.title: Towanoquon: Dancing Orchid in Chaos
anime.romaji_title: Towa no Quon 2: Konton no Ranbu
anime.synopsis: After surviving their most recent battle, the Attractors based at Fantasium Garden work to integrate their new members. It is not long, however, before both the Attractors and the Custos notice a mysterious string of murders that all share a connection with flowers. Realizing that the culprit must be an Attractor, the Custos move in to eliminate their target while Quon Mitsuchi plans to save them. Will Quon be able to save an Attractor that is also a serial murderer, or will he ultimately waver in his values?
anime.consensus_summary: The second installment has interesting ideas but execution is lacking, with plot holes and underdeveloped detective elements. While some appreciate the action and villain portrayal, the story's coherence is a major issue for viewers. Overall, the episode doesn't fully capitalize on its potential.
pros: Fighting scenes are good, especially in the first part.
Portrays villains as normal people too.
cons: Story doesn't check out; characters know things they shouldn't know.
Detective aspects were short lived and never fully realized due to the shortness of the episode.

anime.title: Towanoquon: The Complicity of Dreams
anime.romaji_title: Towa no Quon 3: Mugen no Renza
anime.synopsis: While out on a mission, Attractor Tei Ryuumonji and WTOC cyborg Epsilon become psychically linked and trapped in a coma. As the rival Attractors and Custos factions try to wake their respective peers, Custos realizes that they may be able to trace the link and pinpoint their target's hideout. Desperately wanting to keep everyone safe, Quon Mitsuchi follows Tei into the mental realm in order to intervene from the inside. As Quon investigates the link, seemingly impossible truths about his past are revealed.
anime.consensus_summary: The third installment is considered the strongest so far, with emotional depth and exploration of characters' motivations. Viewers appreciate the balance between series continuity and stand-alone merit. Some concern about the pacing and balancing act between continuity and independence are present.
pros: Strongest episode of the series
Emotional depth and exploration of characters' pasts
Understanding the motivations of main characters
Good balance between continuity and standalone movie
cons: Balancing continuity vs stand-alone movie
Pacing of each episode

anime.title: Towanoquon: The Roaring Anxiety
anime.romaji_title: Towa no Quon 4: Guren no Shoushin
anime.synopsis: After a series of shocking revelations, Shun Kazami—more commonly known as the WTOC cyborg Epsilon—ends up in the care of Quon Mitsuchi and the rest of the Fantasium Gardens Attractors. While most of the Attractors are hostile toward the man who, until recently, had been violently hunting them, Quon insists that they must protect Shun. Furthermore, the advanced computers embedded in Shun's body mean that regardless of his feelings on the matter, it will not be long before Custos knows exactly where he is.
anime.consensus_summary: The fourth installment, Guren no Shoushin, is a significant improvement in the Towa no Quon series, offering a more mature and thrilling experience. It delves into themes of forgiveness and culpability amidst the ongoing battle between Attractors and Custos. The audience generally appreciates the improved storytelling, though some naive elements remain.
pros: Improved storytelling and character development compared to previous installments.
Exploration of complex themes like forgiveness and culpability.
Thrilling action sequences combined with philosophical depth.
cons: Naive aspects that may detract from the overall maturity of the story.

anime.title: Towanoquon: The Return of the Invincible
anime.romaji_title: Towa no Quon 5: Souzetsu no Raifuku
anime.synopsis: With the safety of Fantasium Gardens compromised and Quon Mitsuchi missing, the future of the Attractors has never been more uncertain. As they desperately flee from members of Custos, they wonder what lies ahead and whether the sacrifices they had made to get this far were even worth it. Meanwhile, the revelation that the Tears of Time are hidden under Fantasium Gardens changes everyone's understanding of the status quo.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is directed by someone notable in the anime industry, unfortunately who passed away before it was released. It has unique human beings who have awakened distinct powers are being hunted by a secret organization named Custos.
pros: The film series is directed by Umanosuke Iida
cons: Unfortunately, before the movies were released, he passed away of lung cancer at the age of 49 in 2010

anime.title: Towanoquon: Eternal Quon
anime.romaji_title: Towa no Quon 6: Towa no Quon
anime.synopsis: When Genji Kamishiro, the leader of Custos, tricks several Attractors into entering his custody, the conflict between Custos and the Attractors reaches a boiling point. Willing to take risks they would not dare otherwise, a few Attractors break into the Custos headquarters in hopes of rescuing their companions. Elsewhere, Quon Mitsuchi discovers the true nature of Kamishiro's plans and how his long-lost brother came to be encased in the crystal known as the Tears of Time. As their struggle reaches its apex, it remains unclear whether the future will be one of peace or destruction.
anime.consensus_summary: Towa no Quon 6 delivers a climactic conclusion to the series, exploring themes of prejudice and the struggle for survival amidst complex moral dilemmas. While the plot might be convoluted for some, the series offers an intriguing narrative, although inconsistently executed. The series is appreciated for its themes more than its execution.
pros: Addresses complex themes of discrimination and prejudice.
Explores moral ambiguities and the consequences of power.
Presents characters with difficult choices and conflicting loyalties.
cons: The plot can be convoluted and difficult to follow.
The animation quality is inconsistent.
The emotional impact is lessened by the episodic nature of the series.

anime.title: Haganai: I don't have many friends
anime.synopsis:
When Kodaka Hasegawa finds out that he will be transferring to a new school, he is determined to make a positive impression, and maybe even some friends. However, Kodaka discovers he is out of luck when he immediately gets labeled as a violent delinquent due to his blond hair and intimidating expression. Although a month has passed, Kodaka is still alone thanks to his notorious reputation. However, his life begins to change when he finds fellow loner Yozora Mikazuki talking to her imaginary friend in an empty classroom.

After sharing stories of their lonely high school life, Kodaka and Yozora decide to overcome the difficulties of making friends together by starting the Neighbor's Club. Created for people who don't have friends, daily activities involve learning social skills and how to fit in, which will hopefully allow them to make friends. Joined by the eroge-loving Sena Kashiwazaki, and other eccentric outcasts, Kodaka may finally have managed to find people he can call friends, in this club filled with hilarious oddballs.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai. Some find it a hilarious and enjoyable harem anime with well-designed characters and funny situations, while others criticize its shallow story, overreliance on fan service, and generic character tropes. Some viewers also found humor in a variety of fan service and perverted jokes. The show is best enjoyed as a lighthearted comedy, but may not appeal to those seeking depth or originality.
pros: Well-drawn and animated characters with appealing designs.
Hilarious and entertaining, with lots of parodies, references, and sexual innuendos.
Characters are unique, with amazing relationships between each other
cons: Story is generic and lacks depth, relying heavily on fan service.
Characters are unpopular for no reason
Some jokes and fan service are offensive.
anime.thematic_vibe: Harem Comedy, Friendship, Slice of Life

anime.title: Penguindrum
anime.genres: Avant Garde, Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
For the Takakura family, destiny is an ever-spinning wheel, pointing passionately in their direction with equal tides of joy and sorrow before ticking on to the next wishmaker. With their parents gone, twin brothers Kanba and Shouma live alone with their beloved little sister Himari, whose poor health cannot decline any further.

On the day Himari is given permission to temporarily leave the hospital, her brothers take her out to the aquarium to celebrate, where the family's supposed fate is brought forth with her sudden collapse. However, when Himari is inexplicably revived by a penguin hat from the aquarium's souvenir shop, the hand of fate continues to tick faithfully forward.

With her miraculous recovery, though, comes a cost: there is a new entity within her body, whose condition for keeping her fate at bay sends the boys on a wild goose chase for the mysterious "Penguin Drum." In their search, the boys will have to follow the threads of fate leading from their own shocking past and into the lives of other wishmakers vying for the Penguin Drum, all hoping to land upon their chosen destiny.
anime.consensus_summary: Mawaru Penguindrum is a highly symbolic and thought-provoking anime that explores themes of fate, love, and death. While praised for its unique narrative and artistic style, some viewers find the plot convoluted and confusing. The show evokes strong emotions and leaves a lasting impression, but its complexity can be divisive.
pros: Intelligent symbolism and heavy themes
Unique plot line and music that wrenches at your gut
Audacious and thought-provoking, defying convention
cons: Convoluted and confusing plot
Overuse of drama
Wonky character development

anime.title: Green Days: Dinosaur and I
anime.synopsis:
Not wanting to lose, Yi-rang orchestrates a collapse in the middle of a relay race even though she's on the verge of giving up her dream of becoming an athlete. At the same time, Soo-min transfers in from Seoul and Cheol-soo, who dreams of becoming a scientist, come into her life. They are all immature but they are in the midst of youthful aspiration.

With this warm-hearted animation, Han Hye-jin-I and Ahn Jae-hoon encourage Yi-rang's dreams and portray the fantasy and flutter of adolescence through encounters with good people. Set in the '80s and '90s, an old umbrella and a railroad crossing the downtown in the film is the stuff that reminds us of our lost past, evoking a reminiscence in the audience of that which is vanished.

It is a way of evoking the real "dreams" that we have lost in this modern society where a rapid capitalization is progressing.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Sojunghan Nal-ui Kkum' to be a cute and comfy film with emotional depth, reminiscent of subdued Ghibli films. The animation style and attention to detail in portraying 1970s/80s Korea are praised. However, some viewers note plot holes and a lack of closure in certain storylines, which detract from the overall experience.
pros: Detailed and realistic animation style capturing the atmosphere of 1970s/80s Korea.
Evokes reminiscence and portrays the fantasy of adolescence.
Explores emotional depth and relatable characters.
Incorporates cultural aspects and references of the era.
cons: Random plot holes and lack of closure in some storylines.
Relevance of some characters is unclear.

anime.title: Tennis no Oujisama Movie 2: Eikokushiki Teikyuu Shiro Kessen!
anime.romaji_title: Tennis no Oujisama Movie 2: Eikokushiki Teikyuu Shiro Kessen!
anime.synopsis:
Following the Nationals, Seishun Academy receives an invitation to participate in a junior tennis tournament at Wimbledon. In England, Ryouma Echizen and his teammates are joined by their rivals from Hyoutei Academy, Shitenhouji Middle School, and Rikkai University-Affiliated Middle School, who have also been invited to this special event. One evening before the start of the tournament, some of the players are attacked by a group of thugs, leaving them hospitalized with injuries. The only evidence distinguishing the assailants is a silver ring that each member wears on their hand and that their leader's name is Keith.

In an effort to stop the gang, the middle school students convene to discuss their options but are interrupted by Ling Xiu, the person who saved Ryouma the night before. Xiu identifies himself as a former member of Clack—a band of tennis players banned from official competition due to their violent playstyles and conduct. The students are warned to stay out of the affairs of Clack as they cannot hope to win against their tennis style.

Frustrated by the situation, Ryouma sneaks out with Xiu to confront Keith and the other members of Clack with the intent to take them down single-handedly. Knowing Xiu's true objective, Ryouma is now more determined than ever to defeat Keith to save the latter from himself.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a treat for fans due to the gathering of favorite characters in a common fight. However, the plot is simple and rushed, and the new characters lack emotional depth. The soundtrack and animation quality are also considered inferior to the original series, though the teamwork aspect is appreciated.
pros: Uniting of characters from different schools.
Teamwork to overcome a common obstacle.
cons: Rushed story.
Lack of emotional connection to new characters.
Simple and predictable plot.
Plain soundtrack compared to the original series.
Artwork inferior to the National Championship animation.

anime.title: Planetes Picture Drama
anime.synopsis: Planetes picture drama.
anime.consensus_summary: The Planetes Picture Drama is a supplementary series that enhances the original. Fans of the original series will enjoy the additional character development and comedic moments. However, its storyboard format and short episodes mean it's not essential viewing. Overall, it's a lighthearted and enjoyable addition for dedicated fans.
pros: Fleshes out characters
Comedic moments
Insightful background stories
cons: Storyboards instead of animation
Not essential to the main series
Short episodes

anime.title: Precure kara Minna e no Ouen Movie
anime.romaji_title: Precure kara Minna e no Ouen Movie
anime.synopsis: Support video for the victims and sufferers of the 2011 Japanese earthquake and tsunami featuring all the Precure girls.
anime.consensus_summary: The short film is appreciated for its intent to support victims of the 2011 earthquake, but it is criticized for its cheap CGI and unoriginal, repetitive message. The message, while positive, lacks special meaning in the context of a real-world issue, making it forgettable. Overall, the effort is acknowledged, but the execution falls short.
pros: Good intentions to support victims
Features all Precure girls up to Suite Precure
cons: Cheap CGI
Lack of original story
Repetitive message with no special meaning

anime.title: A-Channel: +A-Channel
anime.synopsis: Extra specials from the DVD/BDs.
anime.consensus_summary: Viewers generally enjoy +A-Channel as a cute and humorous extension of the A-Channel series, especially if they appreciate slice-of-life anime. The short episode length is both a pro and a con, providing quick entertainment but potentially feeling too brief. Familiarity with the main series enhances the viewing experience, but the shorts can still be enjoyable on their own for fans of the genre.
pros: Short episodes are good for a quick laugh.
Faithful adaptation of manga strips.
Consistent with the comedic themes of the A-Channel series.
cons: Episodes are very short, can feel incomplete.
Relies on familiarity with the main A-Channel series.
May not appeal to those who dislike slice-of-life anime.

anime.title: Panty & Stocking in Sanitarybox
anime.genres: Action, Avant Garde, Comedy, Ecchi, Parody, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: A special short included with the 5th DVD/BD release.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to this OVA is mixed, with strong fans of the original series likely to find some enjoyment in its random humor and familiar art style. However, many critics feel it's a disappointing collection of disjointed shorts that lack the substance and consistent humor of the main show, often crossing into uncomfortable territory.
pros: Retains the "Panty and Stocking feel" to some extent
High rewatch value for fans
Some individual skits are highly entertaining and "stupid fun"
Appeals to fans of Garterbelt due to specific skits
Art style is consistently praised as unique and appealing
cons: Disappointing as a "full short" due to segmented nature
Many segments are random to the point of making no sense
Less entertaining and funny than the main series
Some jokes cross the line into disturbing or uncomfortable, with "overkill"
Lacks a real plot or substantial content
Overall experience can be described as a "stroke" or less entertaining than a lumbar puncture

anime.title: Pokémon the Movie: Black - Victini and Reshiram
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 14 Black: Victini to Shiroki Eiyuu Reshiram
anime.synopsis:
In ages past, the Kingdom of the Vale, a mighty and flourishing realm, fell into turmoil. The ruler's two sons turned against each other, unleashing the powers of their Legendary familiars—Reshiram and Zekrom—and disturbing the Dragon Force that supplied the kingdom with energy. With the help of the Mythical Pokémon Victini, balance was restored and the Dragon Force was bound by the Sword of the Vale. Should the Sword be moved, devastation will loom again.

Damon, a descendant of the now scattered People of the Vale, is attempting to restore his people's kingdom to its former glory. He manages to summon Legendary Pokémon Zekrom, with the aim of lifting the Sword of the Vale and harnessing the power of the Dragon Force himself.

Meanwhile, Satoshi and his companions visit Eindoak Town, located at the foot of the Sword of the Vale. Confronted with Damon's scheme, they lend a hand to Victini, guardian of the Vale, in stopping the plan from coming to fruition and preventing a repeat of the tragedy that occurred a millennium ago.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is significantly divided on this Pokémon movie, with strong opinions on both sides. While many acknowledge the visual appeal of the Legendary Pokémon and the consistent quality of the music and art, a substantial portion of the audience finds the plot to be shallow, unoriginal, and poorly executed, leading to disappointment.
pros: Visually appealing Legendary Pokémon (Reshiram and Zekrom)
Cute and well-handled Victini
High-quality animation and art (mentioned in R3 & R4)
Good music (mentioned in R3)
Enjoyable relationship between Ash and Pokémon
cons: Shallow and predictable plot with loose ends
Lack of originality, with many recycled plot points from previous films
Underdeveloped Legendary Pokémon themes and significance
Disappointing action sequences
Useless and underdeveloped supporting cast
Overused and manipulative fake death trope for Victini

anime.title: Is This a Zombie? of the Dead
anime.romaji_title: Kore wa Zombie desu ka? of the Dead
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Urban Fantasy, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Aikawa Ayumu was revived as a zombie by the cute necromancer Eucliwood Hellscythe. After the zany, madcap adventures in the first season of Is This a Zombie? ended, Ayumu thought his life might finally get back to normal, or as normal as it can be for a zombie. However, destiny has other plans for him. Some guys just can't catch a break.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience sentiment leans towards enjoying 'Kore wa Zombie Desu ka? of the Dead' as a comedy, with the humor and characters being its strongest assets. However, many find the plot lacking and the fan service excessive. The second season is generally considered enjoyable if viewers are not expecting a deep or well-developed story, serving more as a lighthearted extension of the first season.
pros: Strong comedy and humor, with many reviewers finding the show consistently funny.
Memorable characters and character interactions.
Good voice acting and fitting background music.
Enjoyable and easy to watch as a light-hearted break.
cons: Weak or nonexistent overarching plot; many episodes feel like filler.
Lack of character development compared to the first season.
Overreliance on fan service that sometimes feels unnecessary.
Pacing issues and unresolved plot points.
Jokes can become stale or repetitive.

anime.title: Guilty Crown
anime.synopsis:
On December 24, 2029—the day colloquially known as the "Lost Christmas"—the Apocalypse Virus spread across Japan, bringing death to its citizens and plunging the country into utter chaos. In an effort to establish order, the United Nations sends the GHQ to assist with the crisis by containing the outbreak while removing all political autonomy in the process. A decade later, the country still lives under their control, unable to break free from their draconian rule.

Frustrated with the state of the nation, a resistance group named the Funeral Parlor aims to liberate Japan from the GHQ. Led by the charismatic Gai Tsutsugami, the group plots to steal a vial containing the "Void Genome" to further their goals. The vial falls into the hands of internet vocalist Inori Yuzuriha, who ends up being hunted by the GHQ's Anti-Bodies forces. Having nowhere to go, she seeks refuge in a warehouse where she meets Shuu Ouma—a socially awkward high school student who is a huge fan of her music.

Shuu gets dragged into the conflict the moment he rescues Inori, and the Void Genome shatters in his hand, granting him the "Power of the Kings." While learning how to control his grand new ability, Shuu must now fight to liberate Japan from its cruel oppressors.
anime.consensus_summary: Guilty Crown is a visually impressive anime with a great soundtrack, but it suffers from a derivative and poorly executed plot. Many viewers found the characters unlikeable and the story riddled with clichés. The series is highly divisive, with some praising its aesthetics while others criticize its narrative failures.
pros: Visually stunning animation by Production I.G.
Excellent soundtrack and opening/ending themes.
Appealing character designs.
cons: Overreliance on anime clichés and tropes.
Poorly written and unoriginal plot.
One-dimensional and unlikeable characters.
Haphazard writing and overly hammy direction.
Story is a mash-up of other anime (Code Geass, Evangelion)
Inori is an awful character and has no personality
Awful fan service

anime.title: Infinite Stratos Encore: A Sextet Yearning for Love
anime.romaji_title: IS: Infinite Stratos Encore - Koi ni Kogareru Rokujuusou
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: On a hot day of summer vacation, Charlotte's plan to spend time alone with Ichika at his house is somewhat ruined when Cecilia gets the same idea, later followed by Houki, Lingyin and Laura. The next day, Houki helps out at a summer festival being held at her family's shrine and is surprised when Ichika shows up.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for IS: Infinite Stratos Encore is generally positive, with many fans appreciating the return to slice-of-life and romantic elements. While some critics felt the plot was underdeveloped and the titular mecha were underutilized, the strong character interactions and improved focus on specific relationships, especially between Ichika and Houki, were widely praised.
pros: Above average and visually attractive art style, with crisp and clean character designs.
High-quality voice acting, with specific praise for Kana Hanazawa's performance.
Enjoyable character interactions and witty banter, showcasing the bonds between the girls.
Focus on character development, particularly Houki's overcoming her fears and confessing her feelings.
cons: Story feels like it ends too quickly, leaving viewers wanting more.
The OVA is primarily slice-of-life with little significant plot progression or action.
The titular mecha/weapons ('IS') make very little appearance, feeling secondary to the character interactions.

anime.title: Un-Go
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Detective, Mystery, Sci-Fi, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: In a dystopian future, detective Shinjuurou Yuuki—known by some as the "Defeated Detective"—solves mysteries throughout Tokyo. Aided by his odd associate Inga, Shinjuurou's insight and ingenuity in cracking cases, particularly homicides, lead to numerous mysteries solved and culprits caught. However, his partner seems to have some other, more sinister intentions for the people they catch, and the truth of the assistant's identity and motivation is shrouded in secrecy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Un-Go are mixed. While some appreciate the show's unique storytelling, thematic depth, and integration of setting and characters, others criticize it for being a mediocre detective story with poor character development and pacing in the early episodes. The show's short length and repetitive plot elements also detract from the experience for some viewers.
pros: Unique storytelling and interesting characters.
Thematic depth exploring truth vs. lies in a sci-fi setting.
Well-paced episodes that become increasingly complex and engaging.
Integration of setting, characters, and plot creating intrigue.
cons: Mediocre as a pure detective story with genre staples and predictable cases.
Poor character development and pacing in early episodes.
Repetitive plot elements.
Incomplete feeling due to the show's short length and missing backstory.

anime.title: Chihayafuru
anime.genres: Drama, Josei, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Sports, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
As a child, Chihaya Ayase had only one dream: to see her elder sister Chitose become Japan's most successful model. However, upon defending her ostracised classmate Arata Wataya from his bully—Chihaya's childhood friend Taichi Mashima—she discovers the world of competitive karuta and soon becomes enamoured with the sport.

Based on the Ogura Hundred Poets anthology, this card game where poems are studied requires excellent memory, agility, and a tremendous endurance from the players. Full of hope, Chihaya joins the Shiranami Society together with the newly reconciled Arata and Taichi, embarking on an exciting journey for the title awarded to the top-ranked female player—Queen of Karuta.

Since middle school, Chihaya grew distant from a dispassionate Taichi and separated from Arata. However, in order to improve her skills, Chihaya decides to create a karuta club in her high school. With the help of Taichi, another veteran player, and a few spirited newcomers, Chihaya's new-founded Mizusawa Karuta Club aims for victory in the Omi Shrine's national championship.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is overwhelmingly positive, praising Chihayafuru for its passionate portrayal of karuta and its compelling characters. While some find the love triangle and story predictable, the series is generally considered a captivating and enjoyable sports anime.  Viewers appreciate the beautiful animation and the ability of the show to make a niche subject exciting.
pros: Exciting depiction of karuta, making it engaging even for unfamiliar viewers.
Strong character development, showcasing growth and realistic motivations.
Beautiful animation and art style.
cons: Love triangle is underdeveloped and treated as background.
Story execution can be predictable, following typical sports anime tropes.

anime.title: Croisée in a Foreign Labyrinth The Animation: Concert
anime.romaji_title: Ikoku Meiro no Croisée The Animation: Ongakkai "Récital"
anime.genres: Historical, Iyashikei, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: According to the official website, episode 4.5 of of Ikoku Meiro no Croisée will be included in the third volume of the Blu-ray & DVD. The episode streamed for a limited time on ShowTime, the official online streaming site for Ikoku Meiro no Croisée.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the special episode, finding it consistent with the quality of the main series. It is a pleasant addition for fans, offering more insight into characters and their past. However, it doesn't introduce significant changes or new elements, appealing mainly to existing viewers.
pros: Detailed art style and animation quality.
Enjoyable music and sound design, enhances emotional impact.
Expands on character backstories and relationships.
cons: Episode is very similar to the main series, offering little new content.
The special episode's story does not differ much from the main anime

anime.title: The World God Only Knows: Four Girls and an Idol
anime.romaji_title: Kami nomi zo Shiru Sekai: 4-nin to Idol
anime.synopsis: Eli, Chihiro, and Miyako try to form a band but end up looking to Katsuragi for help. In the process they meet Kanon and become friends/ rivals.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received, especially by fans of both 'The World God Only Knows' and 'K-ON!'. Viewers appreciate the focus on previously captured girls and the musical elements. Some wish for more Keima and a longer runtime, but overall, it's considered a fun and decent watch.
pros: Enjoyable K-ON! spoof with familiar characters.
Good interaction between Keima and the conquered girls.
Kanon's opening theme is well-received.
cons: Keima's appearance is limited.
Some viewers may find the OVA too short.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam AGE
anime.synopsis:
In A.G. 101 (the 101st year of the Advanced Generation calendar) a mysterious entity known only as "UE", or "unknown enemy", attacks and destroys the space colony Angel. This brutal attack becomes infamous as the "The Day the Angel Fell", and marks the beginning of humanity's war for survival. 

The series begins in A.G. 108 when the UE attack the space colony Ovan, where Flit Asuno lives with his mother. Flit's mother is killed by the UE, and in her belongings (in an object called a "AGE Device") he discovers the blueprints for a powerful weapon from the past - the ancient messiah named "Gundam." 

From these blueprints, Flit spends the next several years studying engineering at an Earth Federation base on the Nora space colony and designing the AGE-1 Gundam. Seven years later, in A.G. 115, Flit completes the Gundam, just as the UE attack Nora. Flit and his lineage's battle piloting the AGE-1 to protect mankind is about to begin.
anime.consensus_summary: Gundam AGE is a divisive entry in the franchise, praised for its ambitious generational narrative and unique AGE system, but criticized for uneven plot development, weak characters, and a simplistic approach to complex themes. Many feel the concept had potential but was poorly executed, leading to a mixed reception from both Gundam fans and general anime viewers. Some defend it, citing the overblown hate, while others consider it the worst Gundam series.
pros: Unique generational story spanning 100 years.
AGE system providing Gundam upgrades is a brilliant concept.
Enjoyable second generation arc with a badass Flit.
cons: Inconsistent plot quality across generations.
Underdeveloped characters due to time constraints.
Simplistic black-and-white morality in the first arc.
Mobile suit designs lack creativity.
Ending is weak and unsatisfying.

anime.title: Double-J
anime.synopsis: In a school where after school activities are mandatory among all students, Hajime and her friend Sayo come across a new club that they have never seen before. The club is called "The Cultural Activity Preservation Club." The two enter the room to find all kinds of analog jobs and activities, such as handcrafting mats and toothpicks. This is a unique cultural anime mixed with comedy so as not to bore you, this is Double J!
anime.consensus_summary: Double-J is generally seen as a lighthearted and amusing mini-series, though it may not appeal to everyone. The show's humor is well-received, however, the show's simple animation style and thin plot can be off-putting to some viewers. Overall, the audience finds it to be a quick and enjoyable watch for those seeking a short, comedic distraction.
pros: Catchy and energetic ending theme enhances the comedic timing.
Unique blend of flash animation with live-action backgrounds creates a distinctive visual style.
Enjoyable characters who are well-delivered comedic timing and emotive voice acting.
cons: Mini-series format results in a lack of substantial story development.
Flash-based animation is perceived as rushed and under-budget.
Characters are considered flat, acting more as placeholders for situational comedy.
anime.thematic_vibe: Absurdist Humor, Cultural Preservation, Slice of Life

anime.title: Sorette♡Dakara ne!
anime.synopsis: Anime featuring the idol group AGC38. It is set in the classes of the Musashi Asahigaoka Girls' Academy that the girls attend.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers praise the show's art style, emotional depth, and concise storytelling. The only major complaint is the desire for more episodes, indicating high satisfaction with the existing content.
pros: Expresses characters' emotions with precision
Conclusive ending
Good art style
Perfect shortening to avoid boredom
cons: Not enough content (only short episodes)

anime.title: Tennis no Oujisama: Pair Prince
anime.synopsis:
Tezuka × Atobe ÷ Koharu
Fudomine Middle School's tennis captain, Kippei Tachibana, asks rival school captains Kunimitsu Tezuka, Keigo Atobe, and Kuranosuke Shiraishi to assist him with his team's practice. Shiraishi's teammate, Koharu Konjiki, decides to tag along in hopes of being able to see his crush. Instead, Konjiki ends up becoming infatuated with both Tezuka and Atobe and struggles to pick between the two.

Fuji Kyoudai no Houkago (Fuji Brothers After School)
Seishun's Shuusuke Fuji asks his younger brother Yuuta to go shopping with him to pick out a present for their older sister's birthday. As they proceed with their plans, Yuuta's teammates from the St. Rudolph Academy tennis team catch a glimpse of the two brothers and initially think nothing of it. However, St. Rudolph's manager, Hajime Mizuki, misinterprets the situation and believes Shuusuke is trying to get Yuuta to transfer back to Seishun. In an effort to stop his plans, Hajime forces the team to secretly follow the brothers around.

Initial A
Rikkai University-Affiliated Middle School's Akaya Kirihara always seems to get himself into sticky situations. Out on a shopping trip with Bunta Marui and Jackal Kuwahara, Kirihara bumps into Seishun's Takashi Kawamura, causing a stuffed toy Kawamura was carrying to go flying into a nearby dog's mouth. The two begin to chase the dog in order to get the toy back. Kawamura later recounts the story to Yamabuki Middle School's Jin Akutsu, who seems less than enthused about the ordeal.

Kai☆Para
Seishun's Eiji Kikumaru shows up to morning tennis practice tired after staying up late at night to play Kai☆Para, a new online game. Vice-captain Shuichirou Oishi seems perplexed by the concept of an online game, which shocks his teammates. Eiji convinces his doubles partner to log onto the game later that night but fails to tell him the full name of the game, causing Oishi to play a different game instead that uses the same moniker.

Nagisa no Motemote Watching (Beachside's Popular Watching)
Rokkaku Middle School's tennis captain, Kentarou Aoi, is jealous of his teammate Kojirou Saeki and Yamabuki's Kiyosumi Sengoku, both of whom can effortlessly attract women. Overhearing his troubles, Shitenhouji's Konjiki decides to tell him the secrets to winning over a woman's heart.

Omae no Kimochi ga Wakaranai (I Don't Understand Your Feelings!)
After coming to afternoon practice late, Hyoutei Academy's Choutarou Ootori accidentally overhears the team's third years discussing who will become the captain once they graduate. Ootori's doubles partner, Ryou Shishido, states that between him and Wakashi Hiyoshi, he would choose Hiyoshi to lead Hyoutei. This upsets Ootori greatly and the two end up fighting during practice. In an effort to cool down, Shishido sets out to train on his own but runs into Seishun's Kaoru Kaidou, who offers his two cents on his situation.

Docchi no Megane Show (Whose Glasses Are These?)
After knocking over a display stand, Higa Middle School's Yuujirou Kai bumps into Hyoutei's Hiyoshi, knocking his contact right out of his eye. As Hiyoshi searches for his missing contact, his teammate Yuushi Oshitari and Seishun's Sadaharu Inui begin to argue over what type of glasses would best suit him.

Unabara-matsu! (The Ocean Festival)
Seishun's Ryouma Echizen and Takeshi Momoshiro are invited by Rikkai's Genichirou Sanada to their school's Ocean Festival. The tennis team is putting on a "Cinderella" play for the festival with Kirihara playing the main role, though the second-year ace is reluctant to be wearing a frilly pink dress for the part.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the stories interesting but is distracted by the poor animation quality, specifically the lack of mouth movement during dialogue. The short stories offer a different perspective on the characters but are not essential viewing for the main series.
pros: Showcases different sides of various characters
Interesting short stories.
cons: Mouths don't move during dialogue, resembling a comic strip
Animation quality is far from the original anime

anime.title: Steins;Gate: Egoistic Poriomania
anime.synopsis: A few months after the events of Steins;Gate, Rintarou Okabe and his group of friends are invited to tag along with their acquaintance Faris NyanNyan, who is participating in a Rai-Net battle event in the United States. There, they meet up with an old colleague: Kurisu Makise, who has been recalling fragmented memories of events that happened in the other world lines in the form of dreams. She confronts Okabe, questioning him as to whether these events—particularly the incidents between the two of them—did indeed happen.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted epilogue that offers a comforting reunion with the beloved characters of Steins;Gate. While fans appreciate the continuation of character dynamics and humor, some find the plot unnecessary and lacking in the series' signature sci-fi elements. It serves primarily as fan service, offering a glimpse into the characters' lives after the main story's conclusion.
pros: Satisfying reunion with characters
Continuation of character dynamics and chemistry
Humorous plot points and funny acts
cons: Unnecessary addition with little plot
Lacking in Sci-Fi elements
Weak English voice acting

anime.title: Scan2Go
anime.genres: Kids, Racing, Sci-Fi, Space, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
Sometime in the near future, in an age in which we have established contact and communications with planets outside our galaxy, Scan2Go has become a huge phenomenon throughout all of outer space. Giant races are held at every locality, with each racer gunning for the title of the universe's number one racer!

The main character in the series, Kazuya, possesses the power of the eagle, performed well with his blazing, innate power commanding his falconine beast spirit. He competes in a tournament, the "Pro-Racer Exhibition Race.", but was no match for the other teams that had won their way through the competitive Space Preliminaries.

Realizing the difficult obstacles that lie before them, Kazuya and his friends leave the small Earth behind and set off on a universe-wide quest to hone their skills as warriors!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is generally negative. Reviewers find the anime to be unoriginal and uninspired, with underdeveloped characters. While the sound is considered decent and the show is easy to watch, it's ultimately not worth the time investment.
pros: Good sound themes during races
Easy to watch
cons: Typical anime storyline
Underdeveloped characters
Not very enjoyable

anime.title: Saki Episode of Side A
anime.genres: School, Slice of Life, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
The Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara once defeated regional mahjong powerhouse Bansei High School. It advanced into the national team semifinals but lost to the eventual champion, and the mahjong club was later disbanded.

Six years later, elementary school student Shizuno Takakamo befriends transfer student Nodoka Haramura. The two eventually enter Achiga Girls', but Nodoka transfers out of the school in the second year.

When Shizuno sees Nodoka on television the following year as the national middle school individual mahjong champion, she decides to revive Achiga's mahjong club.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers find it enjoyable and unique with exciting mahjong battles and compelling characters, while others criticize the rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and excessive flashbacks. Many feel it does not live up to the original Saki, but that it is still a fun watch if you like the original or Mahjong.
pros: Enjoyable mahjong battles with twists and turns.
Compelling reasons for the main characters to win.
Unique superpower elements add excitement to the game.
Better pacing compared to the original Saki in some aspects.
cons: Rushed pacing in the first half of the series.
Characters are not as thoroughly explored as in the original Saki.
Excessive flashbacks bog down the pacing.
Relies heavily on the viewer knowing Mahjong
Some viewers found the characters boring.

anime.title: Haganai: Black Hotpot Gives Girls a Bad Smell
anime.romaji_title: Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai: Yaminabe wa Bishoujo ga Zannen na Nioi
anime.synopsis:
Hasegawa Kodaka has transferred schools, and he's having a hard time making friends. It doesn't help that his blond hair tends to make people think he's a delinquent. One day, he runs into his bad-tempered solitary classmate Yozora while she's talking animatedly to her imaginary friend Tomo. Realizing that neither of them have any actual friends, they decide that the best way to alter this situation is to form a club and start recruiting.
That is how "Rinjinbu", The Neighbours' Club, was formed, a club specifically designed for people who don't have very many friends. As other lonely classmates slowly join their little club, they'll try to learn how to build friendships through cooking together, playing games, and other group activities. But will this group of relationship-challenged misfits really be able to get along?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai, with many praising its character designs, animation, and humor. However, significant criticism exists regarding its weak plot, shallow characters, and the inclusion of disturbing thematic elements that detract from the overall experience for some viewers.
pros: Exceptional character designs
Appealing art style with bright and colorful visuals
Entertaining and humorous banter between main characters
Solid voice acting and upbeat, catchy music
cons: Weak or non-existent plot, especially in promotional material
Characters are described as cardboard cut-outs lacking depth
Art style, while visually appealing, can feel too light and happy, not matching darker themes
Questionable or offensive thematic elements and dialogue (e.g., references to rape)
Voice acting for some characters may not match descriptions (Yozora's voice too mature)

anime.title: Haruka Nogizaka's Secret Finale
anime.synopsis: Yuuto and Haruka are looking forward to spending time together on a school trip. However, Shina finally works up the nerve to tell Yuuto she has feelings for him. This event drives a wedge between Haruka and Yuuto and forces them to confront how they feel.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed regarding the 'Nogizaka Haruka no Himitsu Finale ♪'. While some appreciate the closure and romantic resolution, others find the plot predictable and the characters bland. The series relies heavily on clichés, leading to a polarized viewing experience, with some viewers ultimately considering it a disappointing end.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to plot points.
Characters end up together.
Nostalgic return to old locations.
cons: Cliche story.
Predictable plot.
Dragged out romance.
Bland characters.

anime.title: Wandering Son Specials
anime.synopsis: The full versions of episodes 10 and 11 that were previously edited together into episode 10 of the TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: The Hourou Musuko Specials are appreciated for providing a more complete and satisfying ending to the series by expanding the penultimate episodes. However, the emotional impact is lessened when viewed in isolation from the main series, as the character growth and struggles are not fully appreciated. Overall, fans seem to view it as a positive addition for those familiar with the original anime.
pros: More characterization and development
Satisfying and conclusive ending
cons: Episodes are isolated from the rest of the series
Not as emotionally affecting and powerful cut off from the rest of the series

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Origin
anime.synopsis:
In the year 0068 of the Universal Century, Casval Rem Deikun's life is thrown into chaotic disarray after the assassination of his father, a prolific figure in the crusade towards civil rights for people who live away from the Earth's surface. Casval and his sister Artesia receive aid from soldiers who were loyal to their father, and the siblings are whisked away from their home, separated, and thrown into a twisted fate that sees them come into their own as soldiers and adults.

Years before stealing the name Char Aznable or his "Red Comet" moniker, Casval must contend with the rise of a militarized version of his father's ideology and his own vengeful nature as intergalactic war molds him into a legendary mobile suit pilot.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Gundam: The Origin' is well-received as a strong prequel that enhances the original series. It offers deep character development and explores the political complexities of the Universal Century timeline. While praised for its animation and mature storytelling, some viewers find inconsistencies in tone and pacing, along with an over-reliance on CGI.
pros: Excellent animation and CGI (mostly)
Deep character development, especially the Zabi family and Char Aznable
Faithful adaptation of the manga, expanding the UC timeline
Mature and realistic depiction of war and politics
Amazing action set pieces
Good introduction to Gundam for newcomers
cons: Overreliance on CGI can be off-putting at times
Pacing issues, especially at the beginning
Some find it overrated
Animation quality is inconsistent, fluctuating between 'cheap' and 'above average'
Inconsistent Tone with original Gundam
Faithful adaptation of the manga

anime.title: High Score
anime.synopsis: A school comedy with violent and blue jokes. Fujiwara Megumi is a beautiful high school girl but has a selfish and violent character. She has a boyfriend named Matsumoto Masamune, but she often goes around with other boys, who end up as victims due to her selfish behavior.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the show's unique humor and voice acting, while others find the animation and plot lacking. The short episodes are seen as a positive for viewers with limited time, but overall the show's quality is debated.
pros: Good voice acting enhances the comedy
Unique art style is appreciated by some
Short episodes are good for short attention spans
cons: Poor animation quality and clunky frame rate
Weak plot and lacking comedy
Visuals are terrible

anime.title: Stray Sheep: Poe no Chicchana Daibouken
anime.romaji_title: Stray Sheep: Poe no Chicchana Daibouken
anime.synopsis: Stray Sheep is based on the tales of Poe, a naive, independent and curious ram who finds himself sleepwalking into the most unpredictable situations on his path to reuniting with his herd and finding the "ewe" of his dreams.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime evokes strong nostalgic feelings, particularly for its unique visual style and unsettling atmosphere, appealing to viewers who appreciate darker themes in children's media. Some find the lack of character development a drawback, and the show's darker elements may not be suitable for all young audiences. Overall, it is remembered fondly for its distinctiveness compared to other anime of its time.
pros: Unique storybook-like visuals
Creepy and effective background music
Memorable and disturbing ending song
cons: Limited character growth
Potentially disturbing content for young viewers
Weak character development

anime.title: Fujilog 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: More about the hapless life of Osamu Fujiyama, 33 years old and NEET (Not in Education, Employment or Training).
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Reviewers praise the show's heartwarming story, original art style, immersive soundtrack, and relatable characters. The only minor criticism is that the art style may take some time to get used to, but even that grows on viewers.
pros: Story is heart warming and original
Art style has originality and charm
Immersive soundtrack that draws you into the world
Characters feel like real people
Witty and enjoyable characters
Every scene is a masterpiece
cons: Art style takes a while to get used to

anime.title: Inazuma Eleven GO: The Ultimate Bond Griffon
anime.romaji_title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Kyuukyoku no Kizuna Gryphon
anime.genres: Sci-Fi, Sports, Super Power, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: The Raimon team has been invited by Fifth Sector strangely to a soccer camp. When they agree, things go out of hand since it was revealed that Fifth Sector wants to eliminate them once and for all on the island called God Eden. Now, the Raimon team needs to train harder to be able to show that they have the strength to fight back and prove Fifth Sector's doings wrong.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the movie for its themes of friendship and hard work, as well as the return of familiar characters. Some viewers may find the plot confusing without prior knowledge of the series. The animation is praised for its polished look, although the CGI is occasionally mentioned as a minor distraction.
pros: Focus on friendship and hard work resonates well with viewers.
The return of characters from previous installments is a welcome addition.
The animation is polished and visually appealing.
cons: Understanding the plot requires prior knowledge of the Inazuma Eleven Go series.
The plot references events from later seasons, which may confuse new viewers.
The CGI can be distracting, although it doesn't significantly impact the movie.

anime.title: Library Wars: The Wings of Revolution
anime.synopsis:
Following a terror attack in which a helicopter crashed into a nuclear power plant, the Japanese government passes a law expanding the powers of the Media Betterment Committee (MBC). Knowing that the MBC will target author Kurato Touma due to the similarities between one of his novels and the terrorists' actions, journalist Maki Orikuchi asks the Library Defense Force (LDF) to act as his bodyguards.

Meanwhile, the higher-ups of the LDF prepare to indict the MBC on the grounds that parts of its new authority are unconstitutional. With the very existence of the Media Betterment Act coming under scrutiny, the members of the Library Task Force must navigate both their blossoming relationships and the precarious political situation they find themselves in.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie provides a satisfying conclusion to the series, especially regarding character relationships and romantic development.  While some find the plot predictable or feel it lacks the scale of a true movie, the emotional ending and improved action are generally well-received.  Familiarity with the original series is recommended to fully appreciate the context and character dynamics.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to character arcs.
Improved action sequences and plot drama.
Emotional and satisfying ending.
Addresses issues relevant to contemporary society.
cons: Movie can feel like a long episode rather than a true cinematic experience.
Some find the plot predictable.
Relies on familiarity with the original series for full impact.
Ridiculous action sequences.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Development, Political Intrigue, Protection of Free Speech

anime.title: Pokémon 4D: Pikachu's Ocean Adventure
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon 3D Adventure 2: Pikachu no Kaitei Daibouken
anime.synopsis: When Pikachu and friends decide to stop by a tropical island for some rest and relaxation, they got more than they had bargained for after Chatot discovers a Treasure Map! They follow the map to Wailord’s Tear, a mysterious place located in a sunken pirate ship. Will Pikachu and friends find the treasure? What mysteries and dangers are in store? Will our pals return safely? Find out in Pikachu’s Ocean Adventure!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is overwhelmingly positive, praising the storyline, art style, sound design, and character development. The reviewer expresses a strong desire for more content, indicating high satisfaction. There is no evidence of controversy or negative sentiment in the provided review.
pros: Enjoyable series
Immaculate story
Amazing sound
Insane character development
cons: Need more content (season 2)
No cons mentioned; reviewer only expresses positive sentiments

anime.title: Inu X Boku Secret Service
anime.synopsis:
Ririchiyo Shirakiin is the sheltered daughter of a renowned family. With her petite build and wealthy status, Ririchiyo has been a protected and dependent girl her entire life, but now she has decided to change all that. However, there is just one problem—the young girl has a sharp tongue she can't control, and terrible communication skills.

With some help from a childhood friend, Ririchiyo takes up residence in Maison de Ayakashi, a secluded high-security apartment complex that, as the unsociable 15-year-old soon discovers, is home to a host of bizarre individuals. Furthermore, their quirky personalities are not the strangest things about them: each inhabitant of the Maison de Ayakashi, including Ririchiyo, is actually half-human, half-youkai.

But Ririchiyo's troubles have only just begun. As a requirement of staying in her new home, she must be accompanied by a Secret Service agent. Ririchiyo's new partner, Soushi Miketsukami, is handsome, quiet... but ridiculously clingy and creepily submissive. With Soushi, her new supernatural neighbors, and the beginning of high school, Ririchiyo definitely seems to have a difficult path ahead of her.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Inu x Boku SS are mixed. Some viewers found it to be a sweet and enjoyable rom-com with well-developed characters and a unique art style. However, others criticized its weak plot, inconsistent tone, and potentially problematic age gap between the main characters, leading to a somewhat polarized reception.
pros: Great character development
Beautiful art style with bright colors and unique character designs
Enjoyable mix of comedy, romance, and supernatural elements
cons: Weak or underdeveloped overarching plot
Inconsistent tone, shifting between comedy and more serious themes
Repetitive episodic structure with little progression in early episodes
Uncomfortable age gap between the main characters

anime.title: Battle Spirits: Heroes
anime.synopsis:
Like every card game enthusiast, Hajime Hinobori has always wanted to see the Spirits from his cards come to life and witness them in real combat. This dream is successfully realized by Hajime's scientist parents, who develop an augmented reality system that revolutionizes the competitive scene of Battle Spirits. Curious players from across the globe travel to partake in this innovative battle system.

With his sight set on becoming the champion of this new form of Battle Spirits, Hajime encounters many colorful and quirky rivals, including eccentric diva Kimari Tatsumi and arrogant prodigy Tegamaru Tanashi. Along this journey of self-discovery and card-gaming shenanigans, there are no ordinary days in the lives of young heroes striving to take the crown!
anime.consensus_summary: Battle Spirits: Heroes is a lighthearted and comedic take on the card game anime genre, focusing on a tournament arc with enjoyable characters. While the story is basic and aimed at a younger audience, the unique sports anime approach and engaging card game sequences are appreciated. The show serves as a relaxing watch compared to other entries in the Battle Spirits series.
pros: Enjoyable card game sequences
Unique sports anime approach within the Battle Spirits franchise
Well-developed rival character (Tegamaru)
cons: Basic tournament-style story with detours
Gimmicky characters (at times)
Appeals to kids
Serviceable art and sound

anime.title: Muv-Luv Alternative: Total Eclipse
anime.synopsis:
In 1973, following the ruthless six-year-long Lunar War, the hostile alien species known as the BETA—Beings of Extra Terrestrial origin which are Adversary of the human race—invaded Earth, killing billions and decimating Eurasia. While BETA can be destroyed with conventional weapons, their laser-class is able to wipe out entire aircraft fleets, forcing mankind to develop giant combat suits called Tactical Surface Fighters (TSF) to combat them.
    
When the BETA reach Japan in 1998, military school student and TSF pilot—or eishi—Yui Takamura is ordered to defend Kyoto's last line of defense with her fellow classmates. At the cost of countless human lives and the sacrifice of Yui's friends, the Japanese Imperial Army manages to repel the invaders, leaving destruction in its wake. However, this encounter leaves Yui determined to never again allow something like this to occur.
    
Three years later, now a lieutenant, Yui joins the XFJ project, an Alaska-based Japan-American TSF development program. In an international team composed of the uncooperative Japanese-American test pilot Yuuya Bridges and various eishi from countries lost to the BETA, Yui's task is to help develop the new Japanese TSF Shiranui. Amidst political tensions inherited from the Cold War, Muv-Luv Alternative: Total Eclipse follows Yui's delicate mission and Yuuya's journey to overcome the demons of the past that still haunt him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, acknowledging strong initial impressions and well-animated action, but criticizing the inconsistent tone, forced fan service, and generic characters. Many feel it deviates from its initial dark premise, becoming a less compelling harem anime with political elements. While some enjoy the character development and mecha battles, others find the plot disjointed and the ending unsatisfying.
pros: Character development is well-handled, with viewers invested in the characters' lives.
The initial dark and emotional tone is compelling.
Action scenes are beautifully animated, especially the mecha battles.
Good opening theme that captures the intense action and sudden changes.
cons: Inconsistent tone and plot, fluctuating between dark war drama, fan service, and romance.
Fan service and harem elements feel forced and detract from the main story.
Characters can be generic and stereotypical.
The BETA aliens don't receive enough focus, making them feel like an afterthought.
The story feels rushed in the beginning
Minimal differences from robots country to country.

anime.title: Doraemon Movie 32: Nobita to Kiseki no Shima - Animal Adventure
anime.romaji_title: Doraemon Movie 32: Nobita to Kiseki no Shima - Animal Adventure
anime.synopsis: Nobita and his dad buy a big rhinoceros beetle, which he promises to his dad to take good care of it. Later, Doraemon's group finds a strange island where a tribe co-exists with prehistoric creatures long believed to extinct yet preserved by a mythical beetle spirit named Golden Hercules. However, the group has to deal with a group of criminals from the future who intend to capture Golden Hercules for a profit.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie has a promising premise but fails to fully capitalize on its potential. The inclusion of certain characters feels forced, and opportunities for deeper emotional connections are missed. While there are some redeeming moments, the overall execution leaves much to be desired.
pros: Cool concept of preserving extinct animals.
Suneo gets a cool heroic moment.
cons: Guest character 'Dakke' feels unnecessary and doesn't get a significant moment.
Missed opportunity to develop the father-son relationship and tie it to 'Dakke'.
Shizuka lacks moments to shine.

anime.title: Hunter x Hunter
anime.synopsis:
Hunters devote themselves to accomplishing hazardous tasks, all from traversing the world's uncharted territories to locating rare items and monsters. Before becoming a Hunter, one must pass the Hunter Examination—a high-risk selection process in which most applicants end up handicapped or worse, deceased.

Ambitious participants who challenge the notorious exam carry their own reason. What drives 12-year-old Gon Freecss is finding Ging, his father and a Hunter himself. Believing that he will meet his father by becoming a Hunter, Gon takes the first step to walk the same path.

During the Hunter Examination, Gon befriends the medical student Leorio Paladiknight, the vindictive Kurapika, and ex-assassin Killua Zoldyck. While their motives vastly differ from each other, they band together for a common goal and begin to venture into a perilous world.
anime.consensus_summary: Hunter x Hunter (2011) is largely praised for its complex characters, engaging storyline, and mature themes that subvert typical shonen tropes. Some find the initial episodes childish or the later pacing inconsistent, while others consider it overrated, leading to mixed opinions. The fanbase is devided, with some considering it one of the best shonen animes and others considering it overrated.
pros: Well-developed characters with complex motivations.
Engaging storyline that evolves and avoids common shonen tropes.
Excellent pacing and animation quality, particularly in earlier episodes.
Exploration of mature themes and moral ambiguities.
balances fighting and story
cons: Initial episodes might appear childish or bland to some viewers.
Character designs can be off-putting to some.
Pacing issues in later arcs, with some feeling stretched out.
Overrated by some fans, leading to unrealistic expectations.
Inconsistent art quality, with later episodes showing a decline.
Predictable and boring abilities of main character

anime.title: Hellsing: The Dawn
anime.genres: Action, Gore, Horror, Seinen, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis: During the height of World War II, Nazi Germany seeks to strengthen their soldiers with technology crafted under the influence of vampiric biology. Out of fear of this technology turning the tide of war in the Axis's favor, Sir Arthur Hellsing enlists his butler and soldier Walter C. Dornez and vampire Alucard to put a stop to the German plot, sending the two men into a conflict that will scar them both forever.
anime.consensus_summary: Hellsing: The Dawn is visually appealing but ultimately disappointing. Fans appreciate seeing Walter in action, but criticize the short episodes, abrupt ending, and excessive filler content, particularly the Drifters trailer. It serves to fill in some backstory but doesn't live up to the quality of Hellsing Ultimate.
pros: Gorgeous animation, especially in action scenes
Excellent character models and realistic blood
Covers plot holes in Hellsing's story
Walter in action is a sight to behold
cons: Alucard has limited screen time
Story is short and rapidly paced
Ending is abrupt and unsatisfying
Unnecessary humor sequences
Episode 3 is mostly a trailer for another anime (Drifters)

anime.title: Kill Me Baby
anime.synopsis:
Kill Me Baby is the touching story of Yasuna, a normal (?) high school girl, and Sonya, her best friend who happens to be an assassin. Unfortunately, little Sonya's trained assassin instincts often work against her and others in her daily high school life, as Yasuna's often-broken wrist can attest to. She just wanted a hug, but she ended up with a broken neck. Isn't it sad? No, it's hilarious.

Not even Yasuna's intense ninja training can prepare her for the exciting adventures in this explosive 4-panel manga adaptation.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some find the show hilarious and enjoyable due to its randomness and quirky characters, while others criticize it for repetitive jokes, lack of plot, and simple art style. The show's success depends on individual preferences for absurdist humor.
pros: Random humor is enjoyable for some.
Characters are quirky and absurd.
Good, light, and fun comedy to follow.
cons: Repetitive jokes and formulaic scenarios.
Lacking plot and character development.
Art style is lacking and simple.

anime.title: Another
anime.synopsis:
In class 3-3 of Yomiyama North Junior High, transfer student Kouichi Sakakibara makes his return after taking a sick leave for the first month of school. Among his new classmates, he is inexplicably drawn toward Mei Misaki—a reserved girl with an eyepatch whom he met in the hospital during his absence. But none of his classmates acknowledge her existence; they warn him not to acquaint himself with things that do not exist. Against their words of caution, Kouichi befriends Mei—soon learning of the sinister truth behind his friends' apprehension.

The ominous rumors revolve around a former student of the class 3-3. However, no one will share the full details of the grim event with Kouichi. Engrossed in the curse that plagues his class, Kouichi sets out to discover its connection to his new friend. As a series of tragedies arise around them, it is now up to Kouichi, Mei, and their classmates to unravel the eerie mystery—but doing so will come at a hefty price.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on 'Another'. While some praise its suspenseful atmosphere, animation, and initial mystery, others criticize its predictable plot, clichéd horror elements, and unresolved story. The ending is particularly contentious, with some finding it satisfying and others considering it a letdown.
pros: Suspenseful and gripping cliffhangers
Strong opening episodes and finale
Top-notch character design and animation
Engaging mystery with slow reveal of information
cons: Predictable plot twists and nonsensical elements
Weak attempt at horror with clichéd imagery
Unresolved plot points and lazy writing
Story falls apart halfway through

anime.title: Bunny Drop Specials
anime.genres: Childcare, Iyashikei, Josei, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Happa no Suizokukan
One morning, Daikichi Kawachi finds Rin Kaga eagerly crafting fish out of autumn leaves. Wanting to spur her newfound interest, Daikichi helps Rin learn more about the beautiful and diverse animals that live under the sea.

Santa-san e
Spending their first Christmas together, Daikichi and Rin prepare to welcome Santa Claus and his reindeer.

Osora ni Mankai
With the cherry blossoms in full bloom, Rin wants to go flower watching the next day with Daikichi alongside Kouki and Yukari Nitani. However, the forecast of a spring storm may dampen their plans.

Kaeri Michi
After their visit to a summer festival, Kouki is still energetic and wishes to look around more. Daikichi decides to take the group on a quick detour before heading home.
anime.consensus_summary: The Usagi Drop Specials are well-received as cute and heartwarming extensions of the original series. Viewers appreciate the consistent art style, sound, and character relationships. The short length is noted as both a positive (for being easily digestible) and a negative (for lacking depth), but overall the specials are considered a pleasant addition for fans of Usagi Drop.
pros: Cute and heartwarming stories.
Faithful to the tone and style of the parent anime.
Beautiful visuals and sound design.
Nice extension of the main series' narratives.
Effective use of seasonal shifts to mark time progression.
cons: Short length limits in-depth story development.
Lacks the more investing aspects of the main series.
Some episodes can be bog standard.

anime.title: Sekai Ichi Hatsukoi - World's Greatest First Love 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Boys Love, Otaku Culture, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
First loves are messy. While settling in as a shoujo manga editor at the famous Marukawa Publishing House, Ritsu Onodera is quite troubled. Working under the stern and superb Masamune Takano is hard enough as it is. However, Masamune is not only Ritsu's first love from middle school but he also suddenly declares that he will make Ritsu fall for him again.

Unknown to them, another editor in the department, Yoshiyuki Katori, is in a relationship with the popular manga artist Chiaki Yoshino. The carefree Chiaki fails to notice, however, that his high school friend—Yuu Yanase—thinks of him as more than a friend. The stoic but caring Hatori will not surrender his love so easily.

Falling in love for the first time when you are 30 is certainly troublesome. Shouta Kisa, yet another editor, is going out with 21-year-old Kou Yukina, an art student. Despite Yukina's assurances, Kisa cannot help but doubt whether someone like himself is truly worthy of his younger, "sparkling" boyfriend.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with some praising the improved character development, engaging plot, and emotional depth. However, others critique the show for perpetuating toxic relationship dynamics and problematic depictions of intimacy. Despite mixed opinions, the series maintains a dedicated fanbase due to its focus on romance and character relationships.
pros: Improved character development and believable interactions compared to the first season.
Engaging plot twists and dramatic storylines, particularly Kisa's story.
Appealing to female audiences with its cute and romance-filled scenarios.
cons: The series contains elements of sexual harassment and toxic relationships.
Some viewers found the character designs too similar, leading to confusion.
The structure of the series, jumping between past and present, can feel messy and disjointed.

anime.title: Hybrid Child
anime.synopsis:
The skilled craftsman Kuroda created artificial humans called Hybrid Child—creatures who are neither machines nor dolls, but rather a reflection of the love shown to them. While they can feel human emotions and have their own consciousness, they are not real humans and require love to grow.
