pros: The protagonist, Ryosuke Kaga, is frequently praised as a standout character for his unique blend of perversion and kindness, which is seen as a strong point for the ecchi-harem genre.
The art and character designs are often noted as being good to very good, with some reviewers specifically highlighting Lisara's design.
The second half of the series is frequently cited as a significant improvement in plot and enjoyment over the first half.
The romance and character interactions between Ryosuke and Lisara are highlighted as a positive aspect, with their developing relationship being a draw for some viewers.
The humor, often stemming from the protagonist's antics and the show's premise, is a recurring positive point.
cons: The first six episodes are widely criticized for being plotless, overly reliant on generic ecchi/hentai-like content, and a waste of time.
The plot is frequently described as weak, predictable, cliched, and containing numerous plot holes, especially in the latter half of the series.
Many secondary characters are considered shallow, underdeveloped, and serve primarily as fan service.
The soundtrack and BGM are often described as unremarkable, forgettable, or repetitive.
The show's heavy reliance on fan service and explicit nudity is a significant drawback for many, with some feeling it overshadows any potential for a compelling story.

anime.title: Fate/Prototype
anime.synopsis: Coming from a renowned magus family, Ayaka Sajou is much expected to partake in the Holy Grail War. But ever since her father and sister's demise in the previous battle, she has grown gloomy and unwilling to involve herself in the matters that killed her loved ones. Soon, she finds herself in grave danger at the hands of a knight and ends up summoning her own Servant named Saber. With him by her side, Ayaka ultimately becomes an official participant in the war she initially wanted to avoid so much.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment leans heavily towards appreciation for the animation, soundtrack, and epic fight scenes, viewing Fate/Prototype as a strong "what if" scenario. However, there's significant frustration over its brevity and the lack of a full series adaptation, coupled with criticism of the protagonist's underdeveloped character.
pros: Animation is fantastic/top-notch/outstanding
Soundtrack is good/fitting/exciting
Fight scenes are epic/great/lovely
Character designs are nice/unique
Interesting concept/potential
Good voice acting
cons: Confusing to watch due to quick flashes and lack of explanation
Main character is generic/lacking distinguished personality/annoying
OVA is too short/wishes it was a full series
Not enough character development/explanation

anime.title: Sengoku Collection
anime.synopsis: Sengoku Collection revolves around many samurai who are accidentally removed from a parallel universe inhabited by well-known historic characters. Unlike the historical war period known to us, all inhabitants in this unique world look like high school girls. Coming from the medieval era and finding themselves totally amazed by everything they encounter in modern day Tokyo, the girls become best friends through their adventures.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many find the show mediocre due to its lack of a strong central plot, inconsistent animation, and reliance on niche parodies. However, some appreciate the episodic slice-of-life format and the diverse cast of characters, finding enjoyment in specific episodes and the voice acting performances.
pros: Some episodes are considered jewels with good creativity.
Music is diverse and fitting to different episodes and parodies.
Voice acting is praised, especially for certain characters like Oda Nobunaga, Masamune Date, and Mitsuhide Akechi.
cons: Inconsistent and low-tier animation quality, with character designs clashing with backgrounds.
Episodic nature leads to a lack of overarching plot and shallow character development for many characters.
Parodies are often Japanese-related, making them inaccessible to the average English viewer.
Inconsistent episode quality, with some episodes being boring or awful.
Weak execution of the premise, failing to fully explore the potential of Sengoku girls in the modern day.

anime.title: LBX: Little Battlers eXperience Season 2
anime.synopsis: One year after the fight with the Innovators, a new terrorist organization called the Detectors threatens the world using LBXs. Ban joins up with new and old friends to stop the Detectors.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Danball Senki W. Some appreciate the characters' growth and action, while others feel the series suffers from an overabundance of characters, underutilized potential, and an over-reliance on spectacle at the expense of the original's charm. The focus shifts from strategic battles to overpowered abilities, diminishing the appeal for some viewers.
pros: Characters are more grown up and less annoying.
cons: Too many characters are introduced but not properly utilized.
Coolest characters are reduced to supporting roles and lose their identity.
The 'Rule of Cool' overshadows the original charm of LBXs with weaknesses and strengths.
Over-reliance on super-powered LBXs that can fly and destroy environments.

anime.title: Pokémon the Movie: Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Kids
anime.synopsis:
Mythical Pokémon Keldeo wishes to join the Swords of Justice, a group of Pokémon traveling around the world, helping out those in need. To do so he must first harness the power of his horn and learn the move Sacred Sword, and he decides to challenge Kyurem, a Legendary Dragon residing in an abandoned mine located within an icy crater. Confident as he is at first, it soon occurs to Keldeo that he is not yet ready for the fight.

Meanwhile, as Satoshi and his friends travel across the Unova region, they stumble across an injured Keldeo. At the same time, Kyurem goes on a rampage, drawing energy from other Legendary Pokémon and disturbing the balance of power in the entire region.

Now backed by his new friends, Keldeo must overcome his weaknesses and face Kyurem once again, now with the fate of the world at stake.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is moderately divided, with many appreciating the film's focus on Keldeo's character arc and its subversion of typical Pokemon movie plots. However, significant criticisms exist regarding animation quality, particularly human character designs, and the perceived lack of originality and development in the plot and main characters.
pros: Keldeo is the sole focus, providing a well-developed character arc without Ash overshadowing him.
Subverts traditional Pokemon movie tropes by not focusing on saving the world.
Explores themes of growing up, confronting fear, and overcoming mistakes.
Visually appealing background animation, lighting, and almost medieval/fantasy atmosphere.
English voice acting is praised.
Team Rocket's absence allows for a more balanced and focused story.
cons: Animation issues with distorted human faces, particularly Iris.
Intrusive use of CG.
Story is derivative and clichéd despite subverting other Pokemon movie tropes.
The 'Swords of Justice' name is considered redundant and poorly conceived.
Keldeo is described as insufferable, egoistical, rash, and cowardly, with unconvincing character development.
Supporting Pokemon characters act as stereotypes and primarily deliver exposition.
Kyurem's connection to other legendaries feels arbitrary.
Plot has continuity errors and nonsensical character actions without repercussions.
Some dialogue is generic and contains plot holes.

anime.title: Papa no Iukoto wo Kikinasai!: Pokkapoka
anime.romaji_title: Papa no Iukoto wo Kikinasai!: Pokkapoka
anime.synopsis: Unaired episode included in the fifth Blu-ray and fourth DVD volume.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for this OVA special is generally positive, with many enjoying the fun, summer-themed slice-of-life elements and heartwarming conclusion. However, there's a recognition that its heavy reliance on fan service, while appealing to some, may detract from the overall narrative quality for others. The production values and character consistency are seen as average but not detrimental to the viewing experience.
pros: Heartwarming ending that provides closure
Charming appeal and enjoyable summer fun atmosphere
Good soundtrack and enjoyable OP/ED themes
Satisfying fan service for viewers who enjoy it
cons: Relies heavily on fan service, which can detract from the mood
Art style is considered average and characters are not exceptionally drawn
Character development is minimal as the cast remains the same
The plot is thin, focusing more on enjoyment than story progression

anime.title: Ozma
anime.synopsis: In the far future, the elevated irradiation from the sun has destroyed the environment of the earth and the birthrate of humans has drastically decreased. The government controls society with an army of cloned soldiers called "Ideal Children (IC)". Sam Coyne is a trader in a desert. One day, he saves a beautiful woman Maya, who has been chased by Theseus, a corps of IC. He shelters her in his trade ship, but the destroyers of Theseus surround Sam and Maya.
anime.consensus_summary: The general sentiment is that Ozma had potential but was ultimately disappointing due to its short length and rushed execution. Viewers appreciate the unique art style and engaging battles, but criticize the underdeveloped plot, shallow characters, and unsatisfying ending. Many feel the series could have been much better with more episodes to flesh out the story and world-building.
pros: Unique character designs reminiscent of older anime styles.
Engaging submarine-like battles in the desert setting.
Opening theme is well-received and sets the mood.
cons: Rushed plot and underdeveloped story due to the short length.
Lack of character development and shallow relationships.
Underwhelming ending that fails to provide satisfactory closure.
Missed opportunities to explore the post-apocalyptic world and culture.

anime.title: Joshiraku
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, Performing Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Joshiraku follows the conversations of five rakugo storyteller girls relating the odd things that happen to them each day. Their comedic and satirical chatting covers all kinds of topics, from pointless observations of everyday life, to politics, manga, and more. Each girl has something new to add to the discussion, and the discourse never ends in the same place it began.

Each of the rakugo girls has their own unique personality, with the energetic but immature Marii Buratei; the seemingly cute Kigurumi Haroukitei; the inherently lucky and carefree Tetora Bouhatei; the calm and violent Gankyou Kuurubiyuutei; and the pessimistic and unstable Kukuru Anrakutei. These girls—and their mysterious friend in a wrestling mask—give their observations to the audience, either backstage at the rakugo theater or in various famous locations around Tokyo.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers praising the show's unique humor and satirical elements. However, many find the heavy reliance on Japanese cultural references and puns inaccessible. The show is appreciated for its cleverness and comedic moments, but it may not appeal to all viewers due to its niche humor.
pros: Unique blend of humor and cultural references.
Strong comedic timing and delivery.
Clever writing with parodies and fourth-wall breaks.
cons: Humor heavily reliant on Japanese cultural knowledge.
Pacing can feel sluggish at times.
Skits may feel drawn out or repetitive.

anime.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - Nunnally in Wonderland
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch - Nunnally in Wonderland
anime.synopsis:
On a bright, peaceful day, siblings Nunnally and Lelouch Lamperouge take a moment to relax under a tree. When Nunnally asks him to tell her a story, Lelouch, who is unflinchingly resolute in doing his utmost for his sister, makes unique use of his Geass ability, breaking barriers to tell the most entertaining story he can.

Awakening alone under the tree, the previously blind Nunnally finds that she can see again and immediately spots a strange rabbit that resembles Anya Alstreim, the Knight of Six. The sight of this rabbit sends Nunnally falling down a hole, leading her to a colorful wonderland. Narrated by Lelouch himself, Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch - Nunnally in Wonderland follows the lost Nunnally as she searches for a way back home, meeting a slew of colorful, familiar characters along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is sharply divided, largely due to the extreme lack of animation, which many fans see as lazy and disappointing, while others appreciate the comedic writing and fan service. Those who enjoyed it often did so as a lighthearted, self-aware parody that rewards existing fans, whereas detractors felt it was a low-effort cash grab lacking substance.
pros: The comedy is well-thought-out and funny, with many references that reward fans of the series.
The writers clearly cared for their fans by incorporating major characters in fitting roles.
The voice acting is excellent, with original actors reprising their roles and delivering strong performances.
The use of original series music enhances the familiar atmosphere.
The characters largely remain in-character despite the absurd situations, which fans of the original series will appreciate.
cons: The animation is virtually non-existent, relying heavily on still frames, which many viewers found disappointing and indicative of low production values.
The special lacks the depth, drama, and coherent plot lines of the main Code Geass series, which disappoints viewers looking for those elements.
The plot is simple and derivative, essentially an abridged version of Alice in Wonderland with Code Geass characters, feeling low-effort and overused.
The characterization is minimal, relying on pre-existing knowledge of the characters rather than developing them.
Some viewers found the fanservice to be excessive and distracting.
The special is considered by some to be a blatant attempt to monetize the franchise with minimal effort.

anime.title: Tight-rope
anime.synopsis: Naoki Satoya has been Ryuunosuke "Ryu" Oohara's best friend and closest confidant ever since they were young, even though most of their peers fear Ryu's family, the powerful Oohara yakuza clan. Now, mere months before Ryu is set to inherit his father's position, he declares that he instead wants to be a train conductor and live a quiet life with Naoki. Unwilling to let their legacy fizzle out, the Oohara clan enlists Naoki to persuade Ryu to change his mind. But when Ryu is resistant even to the words of his favorite person, Naoki wonders if there is a deeper reason behind Ryu's refusal.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Tight-rope" for its cute romance and engaging storyline, especially within the yaoi genre. However, many find it too short and wish for more depth and intimacy. Despite its flaws, it's considered a good introduction to BL anime.
pros: Sweet and funny story with good character relationships.
Enjoyable even for those new to the yaoi genre.
Good art and voice acting.
Adorable and playful relationship between main characters.
Well-written plot despite being a short OVA.
cons: Too short, lacks build-up and intimacy.
Feels rushed and unresolved.
Skipped a lot from the manga, not as fleshed out.
May not appeal to those seeking explicit content.

anime.title: Tales of Gekijou
anime.synopsis:
Tales of Gekijou is the pre-order bonus for Tales of the Heroes: Twin Brave. It is a series of five short animations produced by Sunrise. 
 
Episodes 1 and 2 were aired in BS-TBS's New Year Special. The other 3 episodes will be available in the pre-order bonus via a download code along with the first two.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, driven by nostalgia and fondness for the 'Tales of' series. The chibi art style and lighthearted missions are well-received, making it a delightful bonus for fans. The series is considered a cute and enjoyable addition to the 'Tales of' universe.
pros: Features chibi-like versions of Tales characters
Adorable little missions
Appeals to fans of the Tales series

anime.title: Uta no Prince Sama 2
anime.genres: Comedy, Idols (Male), Josei, Music, Reverse Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Entering her Master's course, Nanami Haruka is facing an even more difficult time. And she isn't the only one. The main six members of Starish are assigned new seniors to watch over them! But the seniors aren't having the best attitudes about it. 

Watch Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Maji Love 2000% and find yourself completely engaged in a whole new adventure mixed in with comedy and romance!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some finding the show entertaining and addictive despite its flaws, while others criticize it for being boring, cheesy, and lacking a compelling plot or romance. The music and art are generally praised, but the overall narrative and character development receive mixed reviews. Many viewers find it enjoyable for its comedic and lighthearted aspects, while acknowledging its shortcomings.
pros: Beautiful art style and vibrant colors.
Catchy and enjoyable music.
Improved character interactions and development compared to the first season.
cons: Naive and cheesy plot.
Weak or nonexistent romantic development, especially for a reverse harem.
Lack of plot fluidity and meaningful storylines.

anime.title: Initial D: Project D to the Next Stage - Project D e Mukete
anime.romaji_title: Initial D: Project D to the Next Stage - Project D e Mukete
anime.synopsis: A special that comes with the Fourth Stage DVD-BOX. It is comprised of a recap from First Stage to Third Stage, along with staff commentary and sneak preview of the making of the Fourth Stage.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Reviewers find the special boring and unnecessary, especially for long time fans of the show. The lack of emotional weight and non-canon nature make it skippable.
cons: Boring races with no emotional weight
Non-canon events with no weight
Terrible story

anime.title: Thermae Romae
anime.synopsis:
Bonus episodes included with the BD/DVD.

The first episode consists of "Miwaku no Farosu" (Alluring Pharos) and "Sanshimai OL Terumae Satsujin Jiken" (The Three Sisters of Thermae Romae Murder Case).

The second episode consists of "Subesube ni Naritai" (I Want to Have Smooth Skin) and "Hitasura Suberitai" (I Just Want to Slip).
anime.consensus_summary: Thermae Romae Specials is a lighthearted and comedic anime that blends time travel with cultural appreciation for bathing. Its humor is described as 'dumb' and 'weird', making it appealing to audiences who enjoy unconventional and quirky content. While some may find the jokes and animation style off-putting, others will appreciate its unique charm.
pros: Hilarious and up-to-date jokes (dub)
Weird and unique animation style
cons: Dumb humor may not appeal to everyone
Dirty jokes and excessive phallic imagery
anime.thematic_vibe: Dumb Humor, Time Travel, Bath Culture

anime.title: High School DxD OVA
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Mythology, Romance, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
#1: Oppai, Minorimasu! (Episode 13)
A rumor is going about the school about how girls are disappearing and coming back ill and with their breast size decreased.

#2: Oppai, Motomemasu! (Episode 14)
While observing how the others do their jobs so they can do theirs better, Issei and Asia go with Rias to see if a coffin is cursed. During the investigation Issei is possessed by an Egyptian magician named Unas, It just so happens that Unas is just as perverted as Issei. Unas will only leave Issei's body if they can release Unas from the curse placed on him by a devil that Unas tried to make his bride.
anime.consensus_summary: The High School DxD OVA is primarily aimed at fans of the original series who enjoy its fanservice elements. Reviews suggest that the OVA offers more of the same, with minimal plot and maximum titillation. General reviews are positive, with the understanding that the OVA is primarily fanservice oriented.
pros: Animation quality is on par with the main show.
Fun distraction for fans of the main show.
cons: Minimal plot advancement.
Excessive fanservice over substance.

anime.title: Phi-Brain ~ Puzzle of God: The Orpheus Order
anime.romaji_title: Phi Brain: Kami no Puzzle - Orpheus Order-hen
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Mystery, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis: The puzzles get tougher and even more deadly as Kaito Daimon continues his battle against the power hungry Givers of the POG. And with one team member already switching sides, will Kaito have what it takes to keep solving the deadly puzzle traps put before him and reach the fabled Puzzle of God? More importantly, will he be able to solve the puzzles AND maintain his sanity?
anime.consensus_summary: The second season improves upon the first with a better villain and more character development. However, the dependence on puzzles remains a central issue, potentially overshadowing the narrative. Overall, the audience seems mildly positive, acknowledging improvements while pointing out the series' core weakness.
pros: Better villain
Epic and badass moments
Better character development
cons: Too reliant on puzzles; the story suffers without them

anime.title: Heaven's Lost Property: My Eternal Master
anime.romaji_title: Sora no Otoshimono Final: Eternal My Master
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: The second movie of Sora no Otoshimono that concludes the anime series.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Sora no Otoshimono Final: Eternal My Master is overwhelmingly negative, with widespread disappointment regarding its rushed pacing, incomplete story, and unsatisfying conclusion. While the production quality, art, and sound are acknowledged as decent, these positives are overshadowed by the severe narrative shortcomings that leave most viewers feeling betrayed and confused, especially those who followed the anime series.
pros: The art quality and animation are consistently praised as good, carrying over from the series.
The voice acting and sound design, including the music and ending songs, are generally considered good.
The established characters remain likable and entertaining, with some development noted for Ikaros.
cons: The pacing is overwhelmingly criticized as rushed, with significant plot points and entire arcs skipped or poorly transitioned.
The story is described as messy, incomplete, and confusing, particularly for viewers who have not read the manga.
The ending is widely regarded as unsatisfying, anticlimactic, and failing to provide closure for the series.
The film's attempt to balance comedic filler with serious plot points is seen as detrimental to the narrative and emotional impact.

anime.title: Polar Bear Cafe
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Iyashikei, Josei, Slice of Life, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Situated near the local zoo and owned by the charismatic polar bear Shirokuma, Shirokuma Cafe is a popular spot for animals and humans alike, allowing them to sit back and relax after a hard day of work. Whether it's a cold beverage or the latest item on his menu, Shirokuma finds joy in being able to serve his customers, often striking up conversations about various subjects.

Together with the sarcastic Penguin and the clumsy Panda, they form an odd trio who get themselves caught up in all sorts of misadventures with their other friends such as Grizzly, a bar owner, and Sasako, a human who works at the cafe. From dealing with unrequited love, outdoor camping trips, karaoke sessions, and even the secret to brewing delicious coffee, there's always something bound to be happening in Shirokuma Cafe!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's charm, humor, and relaxing nature. Many appreciate the unique premise of animals and humans coexisting. While some note the simplicity of the plot, most find it to be a strength that contributes to the show's overall appeal as a comforting and enjoyable slice-of-life anime.
pros: Charming and adorable characters make the series enjoyable.
The show offers a unique and refreshing take on the slice-of-life genre with its animal characters and pun-filled humor.
The anime provides a relaxing and stress-free viewing experience.
cons: The episodic nature and simple storylines may not appeal to viewers seeking complex narratives.
Some viewers might find the humor childish at times.
The visuals are generally simplistic.

anime.title: Star Driver the Movie
anime.synopsis: Star Driver takes place on the fictional Southern Cross Isle. One night, a boy named Takuto washes up on shore swimming from the mainland. He later enrolls in Southern Cross High School as a freshman and makes new friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The Star Driver movie is a disappointment for many fans of the series. While it starts with intriguing new animation, it quickly devolves into a condensed and confusing recap of the original anime. The misleading trailer and lack of context make it a poor substitute for the series.
pros: Glossed over repetitive cybody battles from the series.
Some new animation at the beginning that intrigues viewers.
Highlights the story of Star Driver, focusing on the shrine maidens.
cons: Movie is just a recut of the series, lacking context.
New footage in the trailer is misleading as it's not a significant part of the movie.
Character development is cut out, making it difficult for new viewers to understand.

anime.title: One Piece Film: Z
anime.synopsis:
The Straw Hat Pirates enter the rough seas of the New World in search of the hidden treasures of the Pirate King, Gol D. Roger－One Piece. On their voyage, the pirates come across a terrifying, powerful man, former Marine Admiral Z.

Z is accused of having stolen the "Dyna Stones", weapons believed to have the power to shake up the New World. The Marine Headquarters believes Z is about to use it to end the pirate era, and with it, the lives of many innocent people. In fear of such a phenomenal event, marines start to take action against the former admiral.

Even if it means stumbling upon marines and the navy, the Straw Hat Pirates decided to chase after Z and stop him from causing havoc. As they continue to embark on their ventures, the pirates bump into new and familiar acquaintances.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, One Piece Film Z is well-received, particularly for its animation, sound, and the depth of its antagonist. While some find the story predictable and the humor uneven, most fans consider it an enjoyable addition to the One Piece universe. The film is praised for expanding on marine lore and providing a compelling backstory for Z.
pros: Great animation, especially in fight scenes.
Well-developed antagonist with a tragic backstory.
Strong music and sound design.
Engaging story that expands on One Piece lore.
cons: Story follows a predictable shonen formula.
Some CGI is unappealing.
Pacing issues with some scenes.
Humor doesn't always land.

anime.title: Pretty Rhythm: Dear My Future
anime.synopsis:
It is three years after the legendary Prism Queen Cup, and Aira Harune, Rizumu Amamiya, and Mion Takamine have become famed Prism Stars, spreading the glamor and radiance of Prism Shows wherever they perform. However, they encounter an unexpected challenge from a passionate and lively girl, Mia Ageha, who has publicly declared her intent to defeat Aira and become the greatest Prism Star.

Sensing her potential, the Prism Show agency Pretty Top recruits Mia alongside three other aspiring Prism Stars—Karin Shijimi, Reina Miyama, and Ayami Ooruri—to form an idol group, Prizmmy. But the road to stardom is not easy: Mia has to deal with an old friend's unexpected appearance, this time as her rival, as well as navigate her way through the alluring yet conniving world of Prism Shows. Nevertheless, with her friends and team by her side, Mia is all the more fired up to march forward and carve the future for herself.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Pretty Rhythm: Dear My Future', particularly its emphasis on friendship, character development, and music. While some find the storyline weaker than previous iterations, the show's positive themes and engaging characters resonate well, especially upon rewatching. There's a gentle skew towards enjoyment and nostalgia.
pros: Rewatching as an adult enhances the experience.
Positive themes of future, friendship, and love.
Each character gets their own spotlight.
Top-tier songs.
Fun characters with unique traits.
cons: Story is weaker compared to the previous season.
Requires watching the first season to fully understand the plot.
OPs are skippable.

anime.title: Victory Kickoff!!
anime.synopsis: The story follows a boy who was in a soccer team, but it was disbanded due to not enough players. However, after the boy meets a female professional soccer player, he aims to bring his soccer team back.
anime.consensus_summary: Ginga e Kickoff!! is a highly underappreciated sports anime that delivers a heartwarming and inspirational story about teamwork and personal growth. While some viewers find the character power levels and plot progression unrealistic, the show is generally praised for its well-developed characters, positive representation, and focus on the joys of soccer. The audience consensus leans towards recommending this hidden gem, especially for those who enjoy character-driven narratives and lighthearted sports stories.
pros: Well-developed characters with individual growth.
Positive representation of diversity (gender, culture, disability).
Down-to-earth story with realistic portrayal of children's issues.
Fluid animation and pleasing character design.
Focus on teamwork and friendship over individual achievements.
cons: Unrealistic power levels of some characters.
Rushed ending and underdeveloped plot points.
Repetitive dialogue and potentially annoying phrases.
Mediocre soundtrack and opening theme.
Inconsistent art quality, especially in early episodes.

anime.title: Tsuritama
anime.synopsis:
Saving the world... by fishing?

Yuki Sanada has always felt like a fish out of water. Socially awkward and anxious, he struggles to fit in with his surroundings and moves from town to town with his grandma. As he and his grandma settle into the charming seaside town of Enoshima, Yuki hopes for a fresh start. However, his reputation at school is jeopardized by the arrival of fellow transfer student Haru. The eccentric Haru immediately makes a splash, wildly claiming to be an alien and declaring that Yuki is his friend. Pairing the reluctant Yuki with their classmate and fishing talent, Natsuki Usami, he tasks both of them with the absurd mission of saving the world from a mysterious threat in the ocean. Mischief and hijinks ensue, as these three embark on a whimsical adventure filled with laughs, heart, and self-discovery!
anime.consensus_summary: Tsuritama is a heartwarming and visually appealing anime that focuses on friendship and personal growth. While the story starts slow and its mix of genres may not appeal to everyone, the unique charm, memorable characters, and satisfying conclusion make it a worthwhile watch for many. Overall audience sentiment is positive, with many praising its ability to evoke joy and emotional connection.
pros: Heartwarming story about friendship and personal growth.
Unique and charming blend of genres (slice of life, supernatural, fishing).
Vibrant and visually appealing art style.
Memorable and hilarious characters.
Satisfying and well-concluded ending.
cons: Slow start, with the story not fully taking off until later episodes.
Absurdity of the plot may detract from serious moments for some viewers.
Characters can be annoying for some
The series may have trouble knowing what it wants to be, with a mix of dramatic and quirky elements that don't always blend seamlessly.

anime.title: Dynamic Super Robots Soushingekki
anime.synopsis: The Aphrodite A is in trouble. The Mazinger Z, Great Mazinger, Getter Robo G and many other Dynamic Robots must rescue her.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the visual aspects and continuation of the storyline positive. However, the lack of a strong, unique narrative and character development is a significant drawback. The absence of a clear, scripted plot and the cliffhanger ending contribute to a somewhat underwhelming experience.
pros: Continued the story from the last installment
Action-packed introduction
Visually appealing with smooth transitions
cons: Lacks uniqueness due to too many robot shows
Cliffhanger ending
No character background
Absence of scripted plot

anime.title: Daily Lives of High School Boys Specials
anime.synopsis: The clueless boys of Sanada North High School never lack a new topic to dissect. Questions about girls are endless, the true meaning of being a man could be hidden in questionable chivalry, and there might be a moral side to silly pranks. With a different predicament always ongoing, the daily lives of high school boys are anything but boring.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the 'Danshi Koukousei no Nichijou Specials' as a light and funny extension of the original series. While some find the short skits less impactful or repetitive, most appreciate its feel-good nature and casual humor. It's considered a worthwhile watch for fans of the original anime looking for a quick dose of comedy.
pros: Funny and reminiscent of the original series.
Casual and doesn't take itself too seriously.
Feel-good and puts a smile on your face.
cons: Short skits may not be as funny for some.
Some skits might feel like repeats.
Lacks a strong overarching story.

anime.title: Daisy: A Hen into the Wild
anime.synopsis: A Korean animation about a hen named Leafie who lives and works on an egg farm who dreams of freedom outside her cage. One day she fakes her own death to escape the farm.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Madang-eul Naon Amtalg' for its heartwarming story and beautiful animation, particularly its themes of motherhood and freedom. While the story may tread familiar ground, the emotional impact and character development resonate with viewers. Some critics point out minor flaws in animation quality, but the film is largely well-received.
pros: Touching story about animal hardships and motherhood.
Beautiful animation and background art.
Engaging drama and heartwarming characters.
cons: Choppy animation in places.
Storyline treads familiar ground.

anime.title: Saint Seiya Omega
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
The god of war and guardian of his namesake planet, Mars, was once sealed away by Seiya, but time has passed and his revival is at hand. Meanwhile, Saori Kido (Athena) is raising the boy Kouga, whose life Seiya saved, and he's been training every day to become a Saint in order to prepare for the coming crisis... 

Unaware of his destiny, when Kouga awakens to the power of his Cosmo hidden inside him, the curtain will rise upon the legend of a new Saint.
anime.consensus_summary: Saint Seiya Omega is a divisive entry in the franchise, with many fans of the original series expressing disappointment in its plot, art style, and character development. While some appreciate the attempt to introduce new elements and focus on character emotions, the overall consensus leans towards Omega being a weaker and unnecessary addition. It suffers from comparisons to the original and fails to capture the essence that made the original Saint Seiya beloved.
pros: Some found the updated art style appealing and a welcome change.
The music and sound design were generally well-received.
Some appreciated the focus on character development and exploration of emotions compared to the original series.
The second saga was seen as an improvement over the first by some viewers.
Some viewers valued the new elements introduced, like the elemental powers.
cons: Many criticized the plot for being unoriginal, repetitive, and inferior to the original Saint Seiya.
The new character designs were widely disliked, with many feeling they looked worse than the original and too much like plastic or nylon.
The animation quality was inconsistent and often static, even worse than the original series.
Characters were seen as archetypal, lacking depth and development, with some being blatant copies of older characters.
The story was considered childish, with the introduction of elements like schools and power of friendship being criticized.
The villains were considered weak and uninteresting.
The use of Greek mythology was seen as nonsensical and poorly implemented.

anime.title: Jewelpet Kira☆Deco!
anime.synopsis: In the Legends of Jewel Land, the Jewelpets were born from the love and caring of their queen, Jewelina. However a strange meteor crashes into the Mirror Ball, destroying it into a million pieces and its fragments called "Deco Stones" were all scattered in Jewel Land. In the present time, Ruby, a dimwitted Rabbit Jewelpet and owner of the Kira Kira Shop, has a thing on sparkly decorations and loves to collect anything that sparkles and shines. However, when she and the others learn about the legend of the Mirror Ball and the Deco Stones, they all decided to go and search for them, until they all meet 5 strange individuals called the KiraDeco 5. The group also has the same goal on wanting to collect the Deco Stones and they befriended the Jewelpets, especially to one of their members: Pink Oomiya. Now, the group need to gather all the Deco Stones and stop the Eternal Darkness from taking over the human world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally perceives Jewelpet Kira☆Deco! as a surprisingly enjoyable surrealist comedy disguised as a children's show. While the main plot is simplistic, the characters are memorable and the humor is well-executed. The show maintains consistent production quality throughout its run.
pros: Competent art, music, and pacing throughout the 52 episodes.
Memorable characters with catchphrases and clearly delineated personality traits.
Humor grows on you and works you into increasingly ridiculous situations.
cons: Simplistic main plot solved very late.
May not pack a punch due to the number of episodes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Surrealist Comedy, Magical Girl, Super Sentai

anime.title: La storia della Arcana Famiglia
anime.synopsis:
​On the island of Regalo, a group of supernaturally powered mafia-like protectors called the Arcana Famiglia safeguard the people from any who would harm them. The members of their organization, having made contracts with tarot cards, each possess different abilities, such as overwhelming strength, invisibility, or the power to see into someone's heart. 

Mondo, their leader and the "Papa" of their family, announces at his birthday party that he will be retiring soon. He plans to hold the Arcana Duello, a competition that, if won, will grant the winner the title of Papa and any wish they desire. But there is more at stake than just a title: Mondo also decides that the winner will marry his daughter, Felicità. Enraged by this, the strong-willed Felicità decides to enter the competition herself, in order to make her own way in the world. As Felicità battles for her freedom, her competitors battle for her heart.
anime.consensus_summary: Arcana Famiglia is widely considered a disappointing anime adaptation that failed to live up to its initial potential. Reviewers consistently criticize the weak plot, underdeveloped characters, and lack of action despite a promising premise. The series is often described as a waste of time, with many feeling that it squandered its potential by focusing on filler content rather than developing a compelling storyline or exploring the characters in depth.
pros: Good character designs and initial concepts.
Enjoyable music, especially the opening theme.
Colorful and aesthetically pleasing art style, creating an Italian-like atmosphere.
cons: Weak and undeveloped main character (Felicita).
Poorly executed story with minimal plot progression.
Lack of action and poorly animated fight scenes.
Unsatisfying and rushed ending, especially the Arcana Duello.
Too many filler episodes and wasted potential for character exploration.
Failed to deliver on promised themes (mafia, action, romance).

anime.title: Naruto Spin-Off: Rock Lee & His Ninja Pals
anime.romaji_title: Naruto SD: Rock Lee no Seishun Full-Power Ninden
anime.synopsis: The competitive shinobi world has proven to be challenging for Rock Lee, who lacks the typically required abilities. To compensate for this handicap, the young ninja tenaciously endures severe training to hone his hand-to-hand combat skills. Whenever necessary, he also resorts to creative fighting techniques. With the constant support of his teammates Neji Hyuuga and Tenten, Lee readily embraces daring adventures as opportunities to advance on his path toward excellence.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Naruto SD: Rock Lee no Seishun Full-Power Ninden' is a lighthearted, comedic spin-off best enjoyed by Naruto fans who appreciate parody and don't mind a lack of serious plot. While many find it hilarious and heartwarming, some find the humor repetitive or the character deviations unappealing. The show is primarily seen as a fun, casual watch rather than a groundbreaking anime experience.
pros: Funny and enjoyable for Naruto fans.
Good for casual watching with no overarching plot.
Creative and humorous takes on Naruto characters and situations.
Highlights side characters, offering more screen time and development.
Soundtrack is well-received, especially the opening and ending themes.
cons: Lacks a stable or meaningful plot.
Relies on repetitive jokes and storylines (Orochimaru trying to destroy Konoha).
Humor may not appeal to everyone; some find it unfunny.
Character portrayals may deviate too much from the main series.
Can become uninteresting after watching several episodes.

anime.title: One Stormy Night: Secret Friends
anime.romaji_title: Arashi no Yoru ni: Himitsu no Tomodachi
anime.synopsis: A new anime adaptation by Sparky Animation, Duckbill Entertainment, Baku Enterprise and Bandai Visual of the book Arashi no Yoru ni (One Stormy Night...) by Kimura Yuuichi.
anime.consensus_summary: The TV series adaptation of 'Arashi no Yoru ni' is appreciated for its deeper exploration of character relationships compared to the movie. However, the incomplete ending and perceived lack of quality compared to the movie are drawbacks. The audience seems mildly disappointed but generally appreciative of the added depth in character development.
pros: Explores the bond between characters in depth.
More time is given to develop the relationship.
cons: Incomplete ending.
Series lacks in many ways to the movie.

anime.title: Sankarea OVA
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Horror, Love Polygon, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Two OVA episodes are bundled as DVDs with each of volumes 6 and 7 of the manga.

The first OVA is a prequel story written by the manga's author. Before the beginning of the main story, Rea and Chihiro have already met at a certain place: an outdoor hot-spring bath.

The second OVA takes place after the series (effectively episode 14). The Furuya family finds a mysterious young girl hiding under the household temple.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for the Sankarea OVAs is moderately divided, largely due to the significant difference in quality and narrative contribution between the two episodes. While the first OVA is praised as a strong prequel that enhances the main series, the second is seen as confusing and underdeveloped, failing to leave a lasting impact.
pros: Well-animated and cute scenes, capturing the essence of the TV series.
First OVA serves as a well-done prequel, providing backstory and clarifying plot points for the main series.
Good voice acting, particularly from Kimura Ryouhei.
cons: Second OVA is confusing, weakly connected to the main story, and feels like an average or bland episode.
Pacing issues and lack of solid plot lines in the OVAs, making them drag.
Character development is uninteresting, and the connection between main characters in a romance anime is not felt.
Art style is not universally favored, with some disliking the dark and grungy aspects.

anime.title: The Prince of Tennis OVA Another Story II Bonus
anime.romaji_title: Tennis no Oujisama: Another Story II - Ano Toki no Bokura Specials
anime.synopsis:
Bunta no Mezame
After a spontaneous call from someone anonymous, Bunta Marui sets off on his own to meet up with them. Curious about the person on the other side of the phone, his Rikkai University-Affiliated Middle School Tennis Club teammates, Renji Yanagi and Hiroshi Yagyuu, secretly tail him.

Toukou Tamashii
A video of Shitenhouji Middle School's Kenya Oshitari doing pen spinning tricks suddenly goes viral. Soon, this prompts a competition to see who can upload an even more bizarre video.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative. The special is considered a short, inconsequential side story, primarily appealing to fans of the chibi art style. It is generally agreed that it is not essential viewing for progressing through the main Prince of Tennis storyline.
cons: Pointless plot
Very short episodes
Chibi style may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Mysterious Girlfriend X: A Mysterious Summer Festival
anime.romaji_title: Nazo no Kanojo X: Nazo no Natsu Matsuri
anime.synopsis:
OVA released with the 9th volume of the manga. 

The day when Tsubaki goes to the summer festival with Ueno, Oka, and Urabe.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is seen as a generally satisfying, if unexceptional, continuation for fans of the original series, offering more of the unique romance and mystery. While some praise its faithfulness to the source and nostalgic feel, others find the supernatural elements and the series' signature 'drool' aspect to be off-putting and the plot progression to be minimal.
pros: Maintains the unique charm and intriguing storyline of the main series.
Art style and animation stay true to the original, with a distinct, somewhat nostalgic feel.
Characters remain well-developed, and their interactions are authentic and engaging.
Provides additional depth to the characters' relationship.
Satisfying epilogue for fans of the original series.
Cameo from another series (Discommunication - Spirit World) was interesting and appreciated.
Fanservice was not excessive and did not distract from the story.
cons: Lacks flavor and adds nothing new, just a typical and cliched summer festival episode.
Relationship progression seems to be going nowhere.
The supernatural phenomenon felt slightly out of place and goes beyond the strange nature of the drool.
The relationship pay-off in the OVA didn't seem as important as others in the show.
The drool/saliva swapping aspect is off-putting and makes the series disgusting for some viewers.
Urabe's voice acting lacked a certain teenage girl quality for some viewers.

anime.title: Hakuoki: Demon of the Fleeting Blossom - Dawn of the Shinsengumi
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Historical, Josei, Samurai, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Beaten and left to perish, Ryuunosuke Ibuki is robbed of everything to his name. Seeing him in such a pitiful state, a man named Kamo Serizawa gives him a second chance and offers him to become his personal assistant. Ibuki seems to be spared by grief, but this new lifestyle only makes him nothing more than a dog to one of the most influential men in all of Kyoto.

Meanwhile, with the rise of ronin attacks on the general population, the shogunate sends the Roshigumi to Kyoto to strike for peace. Led by the honorable yet soft-spoken Isami Kondou, the Roshigumi is composed of strong and skilled samurai but lacks any meaningful political connections to gain footing in the city plagued by crime. Having no other choice, Kondou allies with the arrogant Serizawa and his connections in exchange for their combative strength.

Despite hating everything the samurai stand for, Ibuki finds himself tangled in the business of the Roshigumi. However, as he interacts with the members under Kondou's leadership, Ibuki slowly realizes that not all samurai are as cruel and dishonorable as he once thought. Hakuouki Reimeiroku explores the early days leading up to the formation of the Shinsengumi while the political tension in Kyoto gives rise to instability and uncertainty.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the historical context and character development, while others criticize the weak male lead and confusing placement within the Hakuouki series.  The absence of Chizuru is a notable positive for some viewers. Overall, it seems enjoyable for fans of the franchise but has some flaws.
pros: Beautiful art and sword fighting.
Interesting to see the origins of the Shinsengumi.
Enjoyable without the Chizuru character.
cons: The male lead is helpless and a coward.
Prequel placement in the series is confusing.
Inaccurate historical representation

anime.title: Hakuoki ~Demon of the Fleeting Blossom~ Wild Dance of Kyoto
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Historical, Josei, Samurai, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Disguised as a boy, young Chizuru Yukimura leaves her quiet home and heads to Kyoto in search of her missing father—a medical doctor by the name of Koudou. She soon learns that the volatile capital city is a dangerous place to be in as she is ambushed by a pair of ronin while in the streets. Much to her horror, the ronin are slain right in front of her eyes by white-haired, red-eyed samurai, only to be quickly disposed of by three men from the Shinsengumi—a special police force who serve the shogun.

After the incident, Chizuru finds herself being taken into custody by the Shinsengumi for further questioning. Upon learning that her missing father is also the same man they are searching for, the chief allows her to stay in their care while they look for his whereabouts. While working as an assistant for second-in-command Toshizou Hijikata, Chizuru slowly discovers just how connected the troubling political environment of Kyoto and the demonic-looking white-haired samurai are to her.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the movie a refreshing take on the Hakuouki story due to its improved pacing and portrayal of the main character. However, others felt it lacked depth and was difficult to follow without prior knowledge of the anime series. Fans of the source material are more likely to appreciate the movie, while newcomers may find it underwhelming.
pros: Improved pacing compared to the anime series.
More resourceful and proactive portrayal of Chizuru.
Excellent sword fighting scenes.
Sticks closely to the otome game plot (for those familiar).
Satisfying ending compared to the anime series.
cons: Less character development due to condensed storyline.
Loss of humor from the original series.
May not be easily understood without prior knowledge of the series.
Chizuru's character can be perceived as whiny.

anime.title: From the New World
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2011, a small percentage of humans began manifesting psychokinetic abilities known as "Cantus." Over a millennium later, in the small town of Kamisu 66, Saki Watanabe is the last of her friends to awaken her powers and join the Sage Academy, a school for psychics like her. Although everyone at the institution has Cantus, they are not all equal; shortly after Saki enrolls, one of her classmates who is regarded as being weaker than the others suddenly disappears.

Walking home one day with her friends—the determined Maria Akizuki, the intelligent Shun Aonuma, the observant Satoru Asahina, and the timid Mamoru Itou—she comes across two unfamiliar creatures known as "Monster Rats." These beings resemble moles and worship those with Cantus as gods. As a result, when Saki uses her abilities to save one from trouble, she is met with exceptional gratitude.

Now unsure about the Monster Rats' place in society, Saki and her friends find out about another disappearance. As time passes, they slowly look for answers to the mysteries that surround them and begin to realize that this seemingly "perfect" new world masks humanity's dark past.
anime.consensus_summary: Shinsekai Yori is a well-regarded anime praised for its complex narrative, thought-provoking themes, and unique world-building, though its slow pacing, demanding nature, and unresolved plot points may not appeal to all viewers. The story follows a group of children as they mature and uncover the dark secrets of their seemingly utopian society, blending elements of dystopia, psychological thriller, and coming-of-age drama. Overall, the series is considered a hidden gem that rewards patient and attentive viewing.
pros: Intriguing world-building and unique premise.
Complex characters with believable growth.
Thought-provoking themes and moral questions.
High artistic quality that blends story, art, and sound effectively.
cons: Pacing issues and disjointed storytelling in certain episodes.
Requires active engagement and analysis, which might deter casual viewers.
Some plot points are left unresolved, leading to frustration.
Can be emotionally draining due to its dark and serious nature.

anime.title: Gakkatsu!
anime.synopsis:
In a fictional school, "Tender Tank" Rareko is constantly opening absurd yet strangely enthusiastic debates, this way creating a lively classroom life. Bringing up tremendous themes, she and her classmates exchange words like sword-strokes, and here and there even a profound remark is slipped in. 

A fun and informative debate comedy, packed into only five minutes each time.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is well-received for its unique premise, engaging characters, and humorous yet insightful discussions. The main critique is its short length, leaving viewers wanting more. Overall, the audience enjoys the show's lighthearted and thought-provoking approach to everyday life.
pros: Unique premise with engaging discussions
Characters with distinct charisma
Hilarious and thought-provoking conclusions
cons: Too short

anime.title: Shiba Inuko-san
anime.synopsis:
Chako Ishibashi is a normal middle schooler at a normal school having normal school days. However, there is one oddity in Chako's everyday life—the student sitting at the desk next to her, Shibainuko-san. What is it about her that Chako finds strange? The answer is simple: Shibainuko-san doesn't look like a human at all. Instead, she looks just like a Shiba Inu!

Polite, well-meaning, and with the mannerisms of both a dog and a human, Shibainuko-san is loved by all. However, Chako notices that her classmates seem oblivious to Shibainuko-san's physical appearance. Can a dog go to school and be a normal student? 

Join Chako and her best friend Naho on bite-sized misadventures with their unusual classmate, who may or may not actually be a dog.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Shiba Inuko-san' to be a cute and enjoyable, albeit brief, experience. The main draw is the absurd premise and the likeable characters. However, the extremely short episode length is a common point of criticism, with some viewers wishing for a longer or more developed series.
pros: Entertaining despite short episodes
Cute and fun
Well-done art style and animation
Likeable characters
cons: Very short episodes limit content
Not very memorable
Lacks a strong story

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Asia Circuit
anime.synopsis:
Following their intense battle in the national tournament, Team Q4 disbands, with everyone returning to their regular lives. While paying a visit to Card Capital, Aichi Sendou notices an unfamiliar customer in the shop. After teaching the secretive boy about Cardfight Vanguard, he realizes that his usual deck has become entirely different. 

Although it contains a variety of units Aichi has never seen before, everyone insists that the cards are the same ones that he has always been using. Moreover, the strange boy disappears without a trace, leaving Aichi further puzzled. As Aichi gets accustomed to the new bizarre deck, he aims to unravel the mystery behind the incident and the peculiar boy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative, particularly concerning Aichi's character and the plot's predictability. Some appreciate Ren's comedic relief, but overall, the season is considered a step down from the first. Reviewers highlight issues with forced plot progression, unlikeable new characters, and a repetitive storyline.
pros: Enjoyable tourist attraction portrayal.
Ren's character development and goofy personality.
cons: Aichi's character regresses and becomes a 'goody-goody' with no development.
Fights feel forced and rely on luck rather than tactics.
New characters are unlikeable and arrogant.
Story repeats the 'jobbing' trope from the first season.

anime.title: Here Comes the Black Witch!!
anime.synopsis:
Kurotori Chiyoko, a 5th-grader in elementary school, loves the occult. One day, a friend requests her to do a love fortune-telling. Chiyoko tries to summon Cupid, but thanks to a stuffy nose, accidentally summons a witch named Gyubid instead!

From that day on, Chiyoko starts learning witchcraft from Gyubid, the self-proclaimed hottest instructor of the magic world. The training regimen is tough, and punishment for slacking is harsh. Fortunately, Chiyoko is able to keep her extra-curricular studies secret, aided by the fact that no one else can see Gyubid.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is generally well-received as a lighthearted and humorous anime suitable for both children and adults. The short episode length is a plus for some but a drawback for others. Overall, the audience mood is positive, focusing on the comedic aspects of the show.
pros: Funny and enjoyable despite being aimed at children.
Short episode length makes it easy to watch.
cons: Episodes are very short.
May lack a strong overarching story.

anime.title: Aesthetica of a Rogue Hero
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Since the discovery of Samon Syndrome 30 years ago, thousands of young people have traveled to fantasy worlds, the few returnees managing to keep the special abilities they acquired in those parallel universes.

Akatsuki Ousawa, known as the "Rogue Hero," discards his peaceful life in the fantasy world Alayzard to face new challenges upon returning to Earth. He comes back with Miu, the daughter of the Demon King he defeated, and is now forced to hide her true identity by having her pose as his little sister. The two soon join Babel, a special school designed for those who have acquired special abilities and magical powers through their journey to a fantasy world.

Babel was seemingly founded to train young interdimensional travelers and "guide them to the right path for the sake of humanity and themselves," but its true purpose remains unclear to the pseudo-siblings. Will Akatsuki and Miu be able to overcome the hostile, powerful student council and uncover the forces at play behind the scenes?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with Hagure Yuusha no Aesthetica. While some appreciate the unique protagonist and action elements, the overwhelming consensus points to a poorly executed story, excessive fan service, and underdeveloped characters. The abrupt ending and lack of a satisfying resolution further contribute to the negative reception.
pros: Some viewers enjoyed the overpowered main character and his unconventional personality.
The initial premise of a hero returning from a fantasy world was seen as refreshing by some.
Some viewers found the animation and sound to be decent.
cons: Many reviewers criticized the weak plot, excessive fanservice, and shallow characters.
The series is seen as generic and failing to capitalize on its initial potential.
The abrupt ending and lack of a second season are sources of frustration.

anime.title: Buta
anime.synopsis:
A few days before Fox officially inherits the treasured heirloom in his family—a mysterious map, the Tufugu Pirates storm into his house and kidnap him, taking the strange map with them.

Buta, a powerful mercenary, is hired by shady characters to help them seek the treasure. In a stroke of great luck, Buta and Fox meet in the underbelly of a pirate ship. Will Fox be able to convince Buta to save him, or will the fabled treasure fall into the hands of crooks?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found the short film enjoyable for its animation and potential, while others felt the story was rushed and the characters underdeveloped. The use of anthropomorphic characters was a point of contention.
pros: Enjoyable animation and design.
Potential for a compelling story, despite the short length.
cons: Characters are cliche and underdeveloped.
Story feels rushed and lacks depth.
Anthropomorphism feels unnecessary and distancing.

anime.title: Pukapuka Juju
anime.synopsis:
Mika dreams of the day when she can visit the beach with her father. Already overburdened by his day-to-day responsibilities, it seems like her father gets called in to do last-minute work every weekend. Even if he somehow manages a break, his crippling fear of the ocean would prevent him from truly enjoying the beach with his daughter.

After yet another postponement, Mika plays in a kiddie pool alone, with only Juju, an inflatable dugong, to keep her company. But things take a turn for the bizarre when Juju comes to life and tells Mika that he will take her to the ocean in her father's place. As Mika hangs on to Juju for dear life, she wonders if her trip is more than what she bargained for.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds "Pukapuka Juju" to be a heartwarming and visually appealing short film, praising its simple yet effective story about family, imagination, and overcoming fears. While some note the fast pacing and minor sound design issues, the overall consensus is positive, with viewers appreciating the emotional depth and animation quality.
pros: Beautifully animated fantasy sequences.
Heartwarming story with simple but effective themes.
Strong use of visuals to convey emotions and story beats.
cons: Fast-paced story.
Some sound design flaws, particularly dialog volume.

anime.title: Shiranpuri (Special)
anime.synopsis: When a young boy witnesses Yaragase and his gang bully his classmate Don, he becomes incredibly uncomfortable. Unable to intervene out of fear of becoming their next target, the young boy decides to mind his own business. As Yaragase's tormenting becomes increasingly worse, the boy's sense of guilt continues to grow. After he talks to an oden stand owner who believes that people who watch and do nothing are just as bad as those bullying, will the young boy be able to end his classmate's misery?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the short film's message about bullying and the bystander effect, praising its unique animation and effective storytelling for a single episode. However, some find the narrative too simple and the animation unappealing, feeling that it doesn't delve deep enough into the subject matter. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile watch with a clear message, despite its shortcomings.
pros: Realistic approach to bullying
Unique and well-made animation style
Good voice acting
Effective message about the consequences of inaction
cons: Simple and straightforward narrative that doesn't explore deeper themes
Animation style may not appeal to all viewers
Message is presented in a simplistic manner
Feels like an infomercial.

anime.title: Monsuno: World Master
anime.synopsis: Chase Suno and his friends, Jinja and Bren, are on a search for Chase's father, Jeredy Suno. However, they soon become involved in something else upon reaching their father's lab and becoming involved with an organism known as Monsuno. Chase, choosing to side with his father's work, denies S.T.O.R.M. access to the Monsuno and escapes. They are now on the run from the military organization, S.T.O.R.M., while still looking for Chase's father. However, a mysterious organization also has his eyes set on Chase and the group's Monsuno.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience seems to have a positive view of 'Juusen Battle Monsuno,' particularly the first season. While later seasons face criticism for feeling rushed and having inconsistent animation, the series is still appreciated for its engaging fights and enjoyable characters. There is a shared sense of nostalgia and enjoyment associated with the show.
pros: Engaging fights that resemble kaiju battles
Characters and sound design are highly rated
The reviewer enjoyed the story and overall experience
cons: Later seasons feel rushed due to low viewership
Animation quality can be inconsistent due to budget constraints

anime.title: Monster Rancher (2000)
anime.romaji_title: Monster Farm: Legend e no Michi
anime.synopsis:
Genki is a boy who loves playing video games. One day he's zapped into the world of Monster Rancher and meets the girl Holly and the monsters Mochi, Suezo, Golem, Tiger and Hare.

Continuing from where the original story left off, Genki and friends journey to conquer the legend cup in hopes of freeing Holly's father from the mystery disc.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with strong criticisms of the show's originality and character development. Some viewers appreciate the nostalgic charm and tournament arc of the second season, while others find it derivative and annoying. The English dub and certain character names are frequent points of ridicule, leading to a generally negative sentiment despite some redeeming qualities.
pros: Some found the second season more enjoyable due to its sports/tournament-style format.
The show provides a satisfying ending that resolves story points from the first season and brings back older characters.
The comedic elements in the Legend Cup season are more sophisticated.
cons: Many find the show generic and unoriginal, heavily borrowing from other monster-collecting anime like Digimon and Pokémon.
The main character, Genki, is often described as annoying and stereotypical.
The English dubbing, particularly the voice acting and the opening song, is heavily criticized.
The villain's name, Moo, is considered silly and unthreatening.

anime.title: Beyblade: Shogun Steel
anime.synopsis: Seven years after the Nemesis Crisis, much of the world has been devastated and ruined after the tragic fighting.  As a result, most people lost faith and interest in Beyblading.  Otori Tsubasa, who became leader of the WBBA, made it his life goal to ensure humanity could restore itself, as well as restore the popularity of Beyblading.  He created the Zero-G battling style as a result, and hopes a new generation of bladers will rise up to accept the sport once again.  One of these is a teenager named Zero Kurogane, who aims to become the top blader after having a destined encounter with the hero of the Nemesis Crisis, Ginga Hagane.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views Metal Fight Beyblade Zero G positively, praising its innovative synchrom combinations and balanced character representation. There's a desire for a remake with an extended storyline to explore global competitions and further develop the characters. While appreciated, the limited episode count and the subsequent treatment of female bladers in later series are points of criticism.
pros: Synchrom combination is a great addition and has competitive potential.
Fair gender distribution with competitive female bladers.
Decent fanservice appeals to a wider audience (kids, teens, and adults).
Avatars have solid themes based on mythology.
Considered an inspiration and pioneer for later series.
cons: Series ended in 38 episodes, limiting elaboration on metal design and variations.
Female bladers weren't treated competitively in the following series after this one.
Storyline could be extended to include global competition for increased tension and interest.

anime.title: Lupin III: Lupin Ikka Seizoroi
anime.synopsis:
Special included with the Lupin 40th anniversary Blu-ray set.

Lupin has invited all of his friends to a villa on a private island. It's the first time they've seen each other for the past five years. Lupin is planning a big surprise while they are all at the villa except Fujiko, Goemon and Jigen find Lupin's behavior to be unusual. They are also curious about who the man in the iron mask is, who is chained up to a wall for the reasons they are about to find out.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is well-received as a charming and exciting tribute to the Lupin franchise, particularly appreciated by longtime fans for its nostalgia and classic elements. The only drawback is its short length and limited availability. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile addition for Lupin enthusiasts.
pros: Enjoyable and endearing, especially for long-time Lupin fans.
Great voice cast and updated animation style.
Classic Lupin plot twists and excitement packed into a short format.
cons: Minimal story due to the short length.
Hard to come by as it was part of a limited release.

anime.title: Kid Icarus: Uprising
anime.romaji_title: Shin Hikari Shinwa: Palutena no Kagami
anime.synopsis:
Anime shorts of the 3DS game "Kid Icarus: Uprising", known as "Shin Hikari Shinwa: Palutena no Kagami" in Japan.

Episode 1 - Thanatos Rising
Animation: Production I.G
Director: Junichi Fujisaku

Episode 2 - Medusa's Revenge
Animation: Studio 4°C
Director: Kazuto Nakazawa

Episode 3 - Palutena's Revolting Dinner
Animation: SHAFT
Director: Akiyuki Shinbou
anime.consensus_summary: The Shin Hikari Shinwa: Palutena no Kagami ONA is a mixed bag, with animation quality varying across episodes. While it caters to fans of Kid Icarus: Uprising, newcomers may find it less engaging. The first episode is considered the weakest due to its bland visuals and awkward pacing, while the other episodes offer some appeal with unique animation styles.
pros: Varied animation styles offering different visual experiences.
Faithful to the source material (Kid Icarus: Uprising).
Good voice acting (general consensus).
cons: Weakest episode (Thanatos Rising) suffers from bland colors and expressionless characters.
Awkward delivery with pauses and silence in the first episode.
May not be enjoyable for those unfamiliar with the Kid Icarus: Uprising game.

anime.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Chrono Stones
anime.genres: Sports, Super Power, Team Sports, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Inazuma Eleven Go: Chrono Stone is set after the Holy Road Soccer Tournament. The hero of of the moment, Tenma Matsukaze, traveled all over Japan to teach soccer to kids.

He returns to Raimon Junior High School after completing his mission, but to his surprise, it's no longer the same Raimon Junior High that he remembers. The soccer club is non-existent, and the members of the champion team in the Holy Road Soccer Tournament have no recollection of taking part in the tournament. They neither remember Tenma nor the game of soccer they loved. As Tenma is baffled by this twist, Alpha, the leader of the Route Agents and captain of Protocol Omega team, suddenly appears before him. Alpha declares that he and his team are responsible for wiping out passion for soccer in Raimon along with the memories of the soccer club members: and Tenma himself is next.

That's when a strange boy named Fei Rune appears just in time to save him. Just who is Fei, and why does Alpha want to eliminate soccer for good? Tenma knows that he needs to do everything in his power to emerge victorious. It's a battle that could seal the fate of soccer forever.
anime.consensus_summary: The Inazuma Eleven Go: Chrono Stone series introduces a unique time-traveling storyline that differentiates itself from previous installments. While praised for its originality, plot twists, and character development, some find the complex narrative difficult to follow. There are concerns about the diminished quality of the matches and inconsistencies in character portrayals, leading to mixed reactions from the audience.
pros: Original story with time-travel elements
Plot twists
Good character and story development
cons: Story can be hard to follow for younger audiences
Unexplained characters
Matches are worse due to lore focus
Inconsistent character and match quality

anime.title: The Squid Girl OVA
anime.synopsis: Original anime DVD bundled with the 12th, 14th, and 17th volumes of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the comedic and slice-of-life aspects of Shinryaku!! Ika Musume, appreciating the established characters and their quirks. However, some find the lack of plot and repetitive jokes to be a drawback. The ending, in particular, is criticized for feeling like more filler and lacking a lasting impression.
pros: Consistent comedic quality
Enjoyable character interactions
cons: Lack of overarching plot
Repetitive jokes
Forgettable filler content
Unsatisfying send-off

anime.title: Hunter x Hunter: Phantom Rouge
anime.romaji_title: Hunter x Hunter Movie 1: Phantom Rouge
anime.synopsis:
After completing their work at Yorknew City, Leorio Paladiknight and Kurapika investigate the rumored sightings of a boy with scarlet red eyes, as they believe this person to be a member of the now non-existent Kurta Clan. Kurapika hopes to find another survivor of the clan besides himself, but instead ends up losing both his eyes after an attack from someone who seems to be his childhood friend. 

Leorio tends to Kurapika's wounds, and then sends for both Gon Freecss and Killua Zoldyck to help retrieve Kurapika's eyeballs. However, their search brings them face-to-face with the infamous group of thieves known as Phantom Troupe—the same people who massacred the entire Kurta Clan five years ago for their scarlet eyes, which change color during moments of rage. 

Hunter x Hunter Movie 1: Phantom Rouge follows the boys' quest to locate their friend's eyes and catch the thief, causing them to delve deep into Phantom Troupe's past. And in doing so, they encounter a mysterious girl who appears to be linked to it all…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is significantly divided, with strong praise for Kurapika's storyline and the animation, but harsh criticism for the deviation from established characterizations and the weak, plot-driven narrative. Many fans feel the movie fails to capture the essence of Hunter x Hunter's intricate writing and strategic battles.
pros: Kurapika's backstory and characterization are well-executed and compelling.
The animation is fluid and visually appealing, maintaining the series' aesthetic.
The use of existing soundtracks from the anime enhances the viewing experience.
cons: Characterization is inconsistent, with many characters acting out of character compared to the main series.
The plot relies heavily on coincidences and convenient plot devices, lacking the strategic depth of the anime.
New characters (Omokage and Retz) are underdeveloped and underwhelming.
The Phantom Troupe and Hisoka are reduced to mere plot devices.
The movie deviates significantly from established lore and character motivations.

anime.title: Jormungand Season 2: Perfect Order
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Military, Organized Crime, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Still in pursuit of her ambitious goal, ingenious arms dealer Koko Hekmatyar, inexpressive child soldier Jonathan “Jonah” Mar, and the rest of their squad continue their mercenary activities. From professional assassins to private militaries, the group's work constantly puts them in the face of danger. 

But internal conflicts soon arise after Renato "R" Socci, one of Koko's bodyguards, is revealed to be an undercover agent for "Operation Undershaft"—a plan devised by the CIA to infiltrate HCLI and exploit Koko as a tool. Shocked by his betrayal, Koko's leadership is needed now more than ever to rally her squad and rebuild their foundation of trust before they are torn apart.

Jormungand: Perfect Order follows Koko and the rest of her crew as they take on persistent adversaries, overcome internal struggles, and make Koko's vision of world peace a reality—where everything is in perfect order.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are polarized, with praise for the action, characters, and thematic depth being countered by criticism of the ending, plot holes, and inconsistent character development. Many find the ending unsatisfying and the master plan illogical. Some appreciate the exploration of morality and the anti-war message, while others are critical of the unrealistic elements and perceived lack of stakes.
pros: Fascinating characters with unique backstories
Action-packed episodes with gun fights
Exploration of necessary evil for world peace
cons: Underwhelming and unsatisfying ending
Illogical master plan with too many drawbacks
Inconsistent character development, especially Jonah
Unrealistic gunfights and combat scenes
Questionable relationship between Koko and Jonah

anime.title: Tari Tari
anime.genres: Music, Performing Arts, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
At Shirahamazaka High School, a special recital is held every year in which music students are able to showcase their talents in front of professionals and other prestigious guests. Third-year Konatsu Miyamoto desperately wants to sing in her last high school recital, but because she screwed up the year before, the vice principal has barred her from participating.

That's when Konatsu comes up with a new plan to get involved; instead of joining the official choir, she'll form her own singing club with her friends! Unfortunately this proves to be harder than she imagined. Her friend Wakana Sakai has given up on singing, for one, and Konatsu needs more than just two members. With only a month left until the recital, will Konatsu be able to find enough members for her club and actually be ready to sing at one of the most important events of the school year and graduate without regrets?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Tari Tari is viewed as a heartwarming and enjoyable slice-of-life anime with a focus on music and character growth. While some find the plot predictable and the character development uneven, most appreciate the relatable characters, beautiful animation, and uplifting musical themes. The series is considered a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre, despite its flaws.
pros: Heartwarming and relatable characters facing realistic problems.
Excellent music that enhances the emotional impact of the story.
Beautiful and detailed art and animation by P.A. Works.
Well-developed side characters, including the antagonists.
cons: Predictable plot with reliance on common tropes.
Uneven character development, with male characters being underdeveloped.
Some storylines feel rushed or trivial.
Overly dramatic at times, forcing emotions instead of subtly evoking them.

anime.title: Fusé: Memoirs of a Huntress
anime.synopsis:
