Following her grandfather's recent death, Hamaji Ooyama lives out her days on an isolated mountain hunting for food and caring for herself. One day, Hamaji's brother, an aspiring samurai living in Edo, sends her an invitational letter to end her solitary life and join him in the city. When she arrives, however, she is met with a grisly sight—the heads of six dogs displayed for all to see. These heads belong to the Fuse, a group of eight human-dog hybrids that have been terrorizing the people of Edo.

Hamaji assists a strange man escape a group of assailants and makes it to her brother's house, where he asks that she help him collect the heads of the remaining two Fuse, as well as the Shogunate-sponsored bounty. But it is easier said than done—as the Fuse can blend into human society almost seamlessly—and the kind man Hamaji had just helped showed the Fuse's telltale signs.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the visuals and setting but criticism for the story and character development. Some viewers found the romance unconvincing and the ending confusing, while others appreciated the film's themes and emotional moments. The movie is considered enjoyable for its art and atmosphere, but falls short in narrative complexity and character depth.
pros: Beautiful art style and animation.
Engaging world-building, especially the depiction of Edo.
Memorable and fitting music.
cons: Simplistic or underdeveloped plot and character relationships.
Forced romance with little development.
Confusing or unsatisfying ending.
Lack of moral gray area or depth in the conflict between humans and Fuse.

anime.title: Utakoi
anime.synopsis: Uta Koi tells the "super-liberal interpretation" of the Hyakuninisshu anthology compiled during Japan's Heian period of 100 romantic poems from 100 different poets such as The Tale of Genji's Murasaki Shikibu.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Uta Koi for its artistic style and historical setting, finding it both educational and entertaining. The anime successfully captures the spirit of Heian-era poetry and courtly love, though some find the episodic format and deviations from historical accuracy to be drawbacks. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile anime that offers food for thought.
pros: Intelligent script and narration provides historical context with humor.
Beautiful art style with vibrant colors effectively portrays the Heian period.
Characters are based on real people and offer diverse perspectives.
cons: Episodic nature can feel repetitive, lacking genre variety.
Art style may not appeal to everyone.
Story sometimes strays from historical accuracy.

anime.title: High School DxD Specials
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Mythology, Romance, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
A series of 3-5 minute specials that were bundled with the HighSchool DxD DVD and Blu-rays. They are a stand alone set of episodes that are not a part of any story line in particular.

Special 1: Going Sunbathing! - The Occult Research Club goes on a beach outing.

Special 2: Issei's Private Training! - Issei is being given lessons in magic by Akeno.

Special 3: A Little Bold, Koneko-Chan... Nyan! - Koneko accidentally has her personality reversed magically, making her incredibly sexually active and reversing her sexual preference.

Special 4: The Untold Story of The Dress Break's Birth! - A few flashbacks of how Issei first found out and eventually perfected his special move, Dress Break.

Special 5: Making Udon! - As part of a penalty for losing a bet, Sona and Tsubaki make udon for the Occult Research Club but the udon comes to life in a peculiar way...

Special 6: Asia Transforms! - Asia wants to prove she is just as bad as any demon by using ideas found in Issei's magazines, going as far as dressing up like a harlot and seducing him.
anime.consensus_summary: The High School DxD Specials are primarily appreciated for their ecchi and fanservice content, offering humorous and visually appealing shorts for fans of the main series. However, they are criticized for lacking a substantial story and depth beyond the fanservice elements. The audience consensus is that these specials are enjoyable for those seeking lighthearted entertainment and explicit content, but not for viewers interested in a compelling narrative.
pros: Humorous and entertaining.
High-quality animation and sound.
Satisfying for fans of the main series.
cons: Almost nonexistent story.
Over-reliance on fanservice.
Lacks depth and character development.

anime.title: Recorder and Randsell Re
anime.synopsis: Second season.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the anime quick and initially interesting, but the repetitive jokes and reliance on height difference humor become tiresome. The episodic nature of the anime also contributes to a lack of engagement. Overall, it's considered a somewhat flawed but watchable short series.
pros: Quick to watch
Interesting plot (initially)
cons: Repetitive jokes
Height difference humor gets old
Episodic format lacks continuity

anime.title: Expelled from Paradise
anime.synopsis:
In a future where a massive disaster has devastated Earth, most of humanity has abandoned their physical bodies and relocated in digital form to DEVA, an advanced space station orbiting the ravaged planet. Free from the limitations of traditional existence, such as death and hunger, the inhabitants of this virtual reality reside in relative peace until Frontier Setter, a skilled hacker, infiltrates the system and spreads subversive messages to the populace.

Labeled a threat to security by authorities, Frontier Setter is pursued by Angela Balzac, a dedicated member of DEVA's law enforcement. When the hacker's signal is traced to Earth, Angela takes on physical form, transferring her consciousness to a clone body and traveling to the world below in order to deal with the menace. On Earth, she is assisted by Dingo, a charismatic agent, and during her journey to uncover the mystery behind Frontier Setter, she gradually discovers startling realities about the wasteland some of humanity still refers to as home, as well as the paradise above.
anime.consensus_summary: Rakuen Tsuihou evokes mixed reactions. Some appreciate its philosophical themes, visuals, and action. Others criticize its predictable plot, uninspired characters, and heavy-handed dialogue, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Interesting exploration of humanity and reality
Great fight scenes and soundtrack
Visually appealing art style and environments
cons: Predictable plot and underwhelming story
Characters are generic and unlikeable
Dialogue can be overwhelming and preachy
Inconsistent character animation

anime.title: Inu X Boku Secret Service Episode 13
anime.romaji_title: Inu x Boku SS: Miketsukami-kun Henka/Switch/Omamagoto
anime.synopsis: Unaired episode released with the seventh volume of the Blu-ray & DVD. It consists of three short episodes newly written by the manga author Fujiwara Cocoa. Fujiwara also designed a new character called Hana-chan for the episode.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed this special episode, praising its humor and lightheartedness. Fans of the original series found it a delightful addition, particularly appreciating the comedic interactions between the characters. The special is considered a fun and entertaining experience, though it might not significantly change the opinion of those who disliked the main series.
pros: Hilarious and well-put comedy.
Creative and fun stories.
Enjoyable for fans of the series.
cons: May not appeal to those who didn't enjoy the original series.
Focuses more on jocular aspects, potentially lacking depth for some viewers.

anime.title: Moyashimon Returns
anime.synopsis: In the second season the story continues exactly where it left off previously. Professor Itsuki's Fermentation Cellar and laboratory is ready for operation and with Sawaki Tadayasu's unique gift to see and communicate with microbes to help, Itsuki's motley group of students begin to process different fermented products like soy sauce and sake.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Moyashimon Returns' is mixed, with many feeling it doesn't live up to the original. While some appreciate the continued focus on agriculture and character development, others found the humor lacking and the plot less engaging. The shift in focus away from the main character and the addition of serious drama elements were also points of contention.
pros: Consistent art style maintained from the first season.
Enjoyable opening and ending themes.
Microbe-focused exposition remains fun and informative.
Character development focused on Hazuki and Haruka was a welcome addition.
cons: Humor diminished compared to the first season.
Sawaki's role and focus were reduced.
Story felt rushed and less original.
Serious drama elements clashed with the comedic tone.

anime.title: Guilty Crown: Lost Christmas
anime.romaji_title: Guilty Crown: Lost Christmas - An Episode of Port Town
anime.synopsis: In 2029, Scrooge escapes from a research facility where he had been confined as an experimental subject. His body was remodeled by genetic manipulations and he uses his psychic power to kill the chasers. One day, he meets another experimental subject called Carol. When three psychic chasers hunt down the two, Carol asks Scrooge to use his right arm to extract a weapon from her body.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is split on whether this OVA is a redeeming factor for the Guilty Crown franchise or a confusing, albeit visually appealing, tease. While many praise its improved character dynamics and soundtrack over the original series, its extreme brevity and lack of narrative resolution are significant drawbacks for a large portion of viewers.
pros: Superior characterization and lead personalities compared to the original Guilty Crown series.
Compelling soundtrack, evoking nostalgia and enhancing key scenes.
Visually impressive animation and art style, especially in action sequences.
Offers a more focused and satisfying narrative experience despite its short length.
cons: Extremely short runtime (10-15 minutes) leaves many plot threads unresolved and characters underdeveloped.
Confusing narrative that offers little explanation and raises more questions than it answers.
Artwork is perceived by some as slightly downgraded or inconsistent compared to the main series.
The connection to the main Guilty Crown series is tenuous, leading to confusion for those expecting a direct prequel.

anime.title: PES: Peace Eco Smiles
anime.genres: Racing, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life, Space
anime.synopsis:
A collaborative effort between the Japanese automaker and Japanese anime company Studio 4°C, PES: Peace Eco Smile is a new web promotional anime series that centers around PES, a traveller from space, and NaSuBi, a mysterious life-form who is enamored by the charm of Earth. The car of choice for these strangers in a new world? The Prius, particularly the Prius Liftback and Prius C hatchback. These two hybrids seem to be as much a part of this series as the two main characters are. A Lexus LFA (likely the ride of the antagonist) and the Toyota Camry hybrid also have a role to play.

Each anime short in the campaign will be three to four minutes long and will be posted on Toyota's specially-dedicated website.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative. While the animation and music are appreciated, the heavy-handed advertising and weak narrative overshadow any potential enjoyment. Many viewers feel it's a poorly disguised commercial with little substance.
pros: Visually appealing animation style.
Catchy music and well-implemented sound effects.
cons: Poorly written story with nonsensical plot points.
Overbearing advertising for Toyota vehicles.
Lack of engaging characters and meaningful content.
Unclear target audience (not appealing to adults or children).

anime.title: Patema Inverted: Beginning of the Day
anime.romaji_title: Sakasama no Patema: Beginning of the Day
anime.synopsis:
Despite leading a peaceful life as the princess of a subterraneous colony, teenage Patema longs to escape her cramped industrial confines and experience someplace different. While satiating her curiosity by exploring a region known as the "danger zone," she is startled by a cloaked figure and falls into the darkness of an abyss.

Awakening with the sky below her feet and the ground hanging above, Patema finds herself clinging to a fence at the mercy of a seemingly reversed gravity. Although a nearby student named Age is able to rescue her, they are left wondering which of the two is actually upside down.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Sakasama no Patema: Beginning of the Day' is skippable if you plan to watch or have already watched the full movie, as it only covers the initial scenes. It serves as a brief introduction but offers little value on its own due to its abrupt ending. Viewers are advised to proceed directly to the full-length movie for a complete experience.
pros: Introduction to the main characters and concept.
cons: The OVA is essentially just the first 20 minutes of the full movie.
Abrupt ending leaves the viewer hanging.
Unnecessary to watch if you've seen the movie.

anime.title: Zumomo to Nupepe
anime.synopsis:
No synopsis has been added for this series yet.

Click here to update this information.
anime.consensus_summary: The reviewer expresses extreme enthusiasm and credits the anime with significant positive personal changes. They describe the anime as a life-changing, immersive adventure with an incredible audio-visual experience. The review is overwhelmingly positive and lacks any critical feedback.
pros: Life-changing experience
Engaging and immersive adventure
Incredible audio-visual experience

anime.title: Hyouka: What Should Be Had
anime.synopsis:
It's another regular day, with Houtarou Oreki sitting at home as usual; that is until his sister Tomoe ropes him into working as a lifeguard at the local swimming pool. Upon reaching the pool, Oreki coincidentally meets the other members of the Classics Club. Eru Chitanda notices that a white object that was on a woman's ear a while ago suddenly disappeared, which leaves her curious about the mystery behind it.

Hyouka: Motsubeki Mono wa features Oreki and the rest of the Classics Club as they have fun at the pool and solve the mystery that has piqued Chitanda's curiosity.
anime.consensus_summary: The Hyouka OVA is a lighthearted, fanservice-oriented episode that fits within the established world. While some appreciate it as a fun side story with familiar elements, others find the mystery weak and the fanservice forced, detracting from the series' overall quality. The reception is mixed, with enjoyment largely dependent on tolerance for fanservice and expectations for narrative depth.
pros: Fits seamlessly with the main series in terms of animation, sound, and character interaction.
Enjoyable for those who liked the original Hyouka.
Good for a lighthearted break and offers some comedic moments.
cons: The mystery is weak and obvious compared to the main series.
Feels like a forced fanservice episode with clichéd writing and unmotivated male gaze.
Characters may seem like caricatures of themselves.
May not add anything substantial to the overall Hyouka experience.

anime.title: Tumulus Gal Coffy
anime.synopsis: The TV adaptation of the ONA series. Unlike the ONA, which has 10 episodes, this series has 11 episodes.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves 'Cofun Gal no Coffy' for its thought-provoking story and suspenseful plot, praising the intellectual characters and unique themes. However, some find the second arc less compelling and the music unmemorable. The series is highly recommended for those who enjoy anime that challenges morals and carves suspense.
pros: Unique and compelling story.
Challenges viewers' morals.
Suspenseful plot with cat and mouse dynamic.
Interesting and intellectual characters.
Endearing art style that enhances the atmosphere.
cons: Second arc is weaker and feels unnecessary.
Music is generic and unmemorable.

anime.title: Organic
anime.synopsis: A small flower gives birth to an unknown creature with an unexpected urge to eat, but it will soon end where it started off.
anime.consensus_summary: The short art film 'Organic' is appreciated for its simple yet profound message about life, death, and recycling. However, the artistic choices, particularly the jittery animation and sparse backgrounds, detract from the overall experience for some viewers. Despite technical shortcomings, the film's thematic resonance leaves a positive impression.
pros: Powerful message about recycling and balance in life
Simple storytelling effectively conveys its message
cons: Jittery art style can be visually unpleasant or a health hazard
Lack of detail and color in background depiction
Occasional skipping or echoing in background music

anime.title: Good Luck Girl!
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ichiko Sakura lives life on easy mode. Blessed with good fortune, she has everything she has ever wanted, including beauty, intelligence, and wealth. Momiji Binboda is a goddess of poverty. In stark contrast to Ichiko, she is cursed with misfortune, such as a perpetual cast on her arm, a flat chest, and a box under a bridge for a home.

Their lives collide when Momiji lives up to her title and delivers some unfortunate news to Ichiko: her large amount of luck is due to her subconsciously draining the luck from those around her! Momiji has been tasked with stealing back Ichiko's fortune before she leaves everyone without enough luck to even survive. But Ichiko, with the help of the wandering monk Bobby Statice, manages to fight off the poverty goddess. This defeat forces the goddess to enlist reinforcements in the form of Kumagai, her teddy bear familiar, and the masochistic dog god, Momoo Inugami.

Insanity ensues as Ichiko's quiet life is replaced with daily battles for her fortune. To survive the chaos, Ichiko will need all the luck she can get in Binbougami ga!!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Binbougami ga! is well-received for its comedic and parody elements, providing plenty of laughs and entertainment. While some find the humor predictable and the story weak, many appreciate its unique premise, life lessons, and references to other anime.  The series is seen as a lighthearted and enjoyable watch, especially for fans of comedy and supernatural themes.
pros: Hilarious and full of puns, making viewers laugh
Teaches life lessons about sharing and caring
Unique premise with well-rounded characters and good cohesion
Refreshing take on deities with lightheartedness and fourth-wall breaks
Great visual jokes and references that land well with anime fans
cons: Humor can be trite and predictable for some
Dramatic aspects are weak and mediocre
Story forgets premise and heroine's powers
Over the top voice acting and character depictions can be off-putting initially

anime.title: Guilty Crown: 4-koma Gekijou
anime.synopsis: Animated four-panel manga that comes as extra on the DVDs and Blu-rays.
anime.consensus_summary: The 4-koma Gekijou is a lighthearted chibi parody of Guilty Crown that prioritizes humor over plot. Fans of the original series may enjoy it for its comedic references and character interactions, but viewers seeking plot progression or high-quality animation will likely be disappointed. The series uses more vulgar language than the original.
pros: Enjoyable character banter
Humorous references to other anime
cons: Lack of plot progression
Minimal animation movement
Crude language

anime.title: Natsuyuki Rendezvous
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Josei, Romance, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ryousuke Hazuki is a young man whose heart has been stolen away, stopping by the local floral shop daily in order to catch a glimpse of the beautiful Rokka Shimao, the shop's owner. In hopes of getting close to her, he decides to get a part-time job at the shop, but before he is able to make his move, he runs into a major roadblock: in her apartment dwells a ghost who claims to be Rokka's deceased husband.

Atsushi Shimao has quietly watched over his widowed wife ever since he passed three years ago. However, Hazuki is the first person to ever notice him, and the two quickly find themselves at odds: the jealous Shimao attempts to thwart the suitor's advances and possess his body, while Hazuki simply wants the ghost to pass on for good, allowing Rokka to move on from the past and him to be with the one he loves. As both men refuse to let go of their desires, an unusual relationship forms between a troubled woman, an unrelenting ghost, and a stubborn man in love.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is appreciated for its artistic presentation and exploration of mature themes like grief and moving on. However, many find the pacing too slow and the plot somewhat muddled, especially due to the extensive use of flashbacks. While the characters are generally well-received, some viewers find them frustrating or lacking in development, leading to a mixed but overall positive reception.
pros: Beautiful and expressive art style
Well-developed characters with relatable struggles
Excellent voice acting and fitting music
cons: Slow pacing that may not appeal to all viewers
Overuse of flashbacks detracts from present-day relationship development
Story loses focus and becomes convoluted in the latter half

anime.title: Persona 4 the Animation: No One is Alone
anime.romaji_title: Persona 4 the Animation: No One is Alone
anime.genres: Adventure, Mystery, School, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: New episode included with the 10th blu-ray volume. The episode will adapt the true ending from the original PS2 game.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode serves as a satisfying conclusion to the series, resolving outstanding plot points and delving into the protagonist's psyche. However, some viewers were underwhelmed by the episode's short runtime and perceived shortcomings in animation quality. Despite these criticisms, the episode is generally viewed positively as a fitting end to the Persona 4 narrative.
pros: True ending adaptation
Exploration of protagonist's inner self
Resolution of loose ends
cons: Short length
Disappointing animation quality

anime.title: Robotics;Notes
anime.synopsis:
It has always been the aspiration of the Central Tanegashima High School Robotics Research Club to complete the GunPro1, a fully functioning giant robot. For years, the members of the club have contributed to its progress and it is now Akiho Senomiya's goal to finally make the dream of all the past club members become a reality. However, things are not as easy as they seem as the club lacks the funding for such a huge endeavor. Aside from that, the only other club member, Kaito Yashio, shows no interest in assisting his childhood friend and instead indulges in playing mecha-fighting games on his "PokeCom." 

As Kaito is in the middle of wasting his days, he receives an indecipherable message and hears a voice that seems to be drowned out by the noise of static. He searches for the source, only to realize that it came from Airi Yukifune, an AI which only exists within the augmented reality system accessible via the PokeCom. Robotic;Notes follows the story of Kaito as he discovers a peculiar report in Airi's database, one that would have disastrous consequences in the future.
anime.consensus_summary: Robotics;Notes is a mixed bag. While some find it enjoyable with interesting characters, many are disappointed by its shallow plot, pacing issues, and unfulfilled potential, especially when compared to Steins;Gate. The series is considered underrated by some, but overall, it receives mixed reviews due to its structural flaws and trying to accomplish too much.
pros: Interesting characters
Good artwork and sound
Enjoyable and quirky
cons: Shallow plot compared to Steins;Gate
Poor pacing, especially in the beginning
Plot holes and unresolved character conflicts
Story tries to do too much
False advertising - not enough mecha

anime.title: Psycho-Pass
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Detective, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Justice, and the enforcement of it, has changed. In the 22nd century, Japan enforces the Sibyl System, an objective means of determining the threat level of each citizen by examining their mental state for signs of criminal intent, known as their Psycho-Pass. Inspectors uphold the law by subjugating, often with lethal force, anyone harboring the slightest ill-will; alongside them are Enforcers, citizens that have become latent criminals, granted relative freedom in exchange for carrying out the Inspectors' dirty work.

Into this world steps Akane Tsunemori, a young woman with an honest desire to uphold justice. However, as she works alongside veteran Enforcer Shinya Kougami, she soon learns that the Sibyl System's judgments are not as perfect as her fellow Inspectors assume. With everything she has known turned on its head, Akane wrestles with the question of what justice truly is, and whether it can be upheld through the use of a system that may already be corrupt.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Psycho-Pass are divided. Some praise its philosophical depth, cyberpunk setting, and exploration of complex themes. Others criticize its flawed world-building, uneven pacing, and pretentious writing, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Exploration of complex philosophical questions about justice, morality, and societal control.
Intriguing premise with potential for thought-provoking scenarios.
Dark and edgy narrative with a focus on character development.
cons: Flawed logic and broken foundations of the depicted society.
Uneven pacing and lackluster conclusion.
Generic dystopian setting and art style.
Pretentious writing and convoluted plot.

anime.title: Pendulum
anime.synopsis: Furiko, meaning "pendulum," shows the highs and lows of a family of two—a high schooler, and his future wife, whom he rescues from delinquents. From the brilliant mind of comedian Tekken, comes a heartwarming story of a couple overcoming their differences even as they struggle through life. Not a moment goes by without meaning or expression in these four and a half minutes.
anime.consensus_summary: Furiko is a well-received short film that effectively conveys a touching story about life, love, and loss. Its simple animation and poignant music create a strong emotional impact on viewers. While some find the story clichéd or overly sentimental, the majority appreciate its ability to evoke deep feelings in a short amount of time.
pros: Evokes strong emotions in a short time.
Simple animation style complements the story.
Effective use of music to enhance emotional impact.
cons: Story may feel cliche to some.
Simplistic narrative might lack depth for some viewers.
Can be perceived as manipulative or overly sentimental.

anime.title: Little Busters!
anime.synopsis:
As a child, Riki Naoe shut himself from the world, thanks to a diagnosis of narcolepsy following the tragic deaths of his parents. However, Riki is saved when, one fateful day, a boy named Kyousuke recruits him into a team who call themselves the Little Busters. Accompanied by Masato, Kengo, and Rin, these misfits spend their childhood fighting evil and enjoying their youth.

Years pass, and even in high school, the well-knit teammates remain together. Kyousuke decides to re-ignite the Little Busters by forming a baseball team as it will be his last school year with them. They have a problem though: there aren't enough members! The tables have turned, for it is now Riki's turn to reach out and recruit new friends into the Little Busters, just like Kyousuke had once done for him.
Then, an omen surfaces—Rin finds a strange letter attached to her cat, assigning them the duty of uncovering the "secret of this world" by completing specific tasks. Just what is this secret, and why is it being hidden? It's up to the Little Busters to find out!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found the series to be emotionally engaging and appreciated the focus on friendship, while others were disappointed by the pacing, inconsistent story elements, and animation quality. Many reviews compare it unfavorably to other Key visual novel adaptations, particularly Clannad.
pros: Well-developed characters with unique personalities.
Emotional and engaging subplots.
Strong focus on friendship and relationships.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and filler moments.
Supernatural elements feel out of place.
Animation quality not as high as other Key adaptations.
Story can be confusing for viewers unfamiliar with the visual novel.

anime.title: OreImo 2
anime.romaji_title: Ore no Imouto ga Konnani Kawaii Wake ga Nai.
anime.synopsis:
The diehard otaku Kirino Kousaka has returned and settled back into life in Japan with her friends and family. Despite what her older brother Kyousuke has previously done for her, Kirino continues to give him the cold shoulder, much to his frustration. He is worried that his persuasion for Kirino to drop her track and field training in America and return home may have severely strained his relationship with her. On top of that, Kyousuke now also has to decode a bold and cryptic message from Ruri "Kuroneko" Gokou, his junior at school as well as Kirino's friend.

As the ties between the two siblings and their friends deepen, Kirino and Kyousuke will soon have to figure out how they want to deal with these relationships, helping each other realize their own feelings in the process. In spite of that, Kirino still manages to find time to satisfy her otaku needs with the company of her brother.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is highly polarized regarding Oreimo, particularly the second season. Some appreciate the exploration of otaku culture, character development for specific characters like Kuroneko, and the overall relatability of the series. However, many are critical of the incestuous themes, the decline in writing quality in the second season, and the shift towards a generic harem, leading to significant disappointment and anger among viewers.
pros: Exploration of otaku culture and its perception in society (Season 1)
Character development for Kuroneko and Saori
Visually impressive animation quality
Relatable exploration of everyday life and friendships
Some emotional scenes are touching
cons: Incestuous themes and relationships are a major point of contention
Season 2 is a decline in quality, lacks social commentary, and believable characters
Characters become stereotypes (Ayase)
Forced and superficial feelings
Ending leaves many scratching their heads
Unrealistic and over-the-top drama
Kirino's character is annoying and bipolar
Plot becomes a generic harem with fan service
Inconclusive ending and reliance on OVAs for resolution
Side characters are neglected
Story steers itself back into its predictable plot line even after a twist has occurred.
Lack of focus
Many found the ending dissapointing.
anime.thematic_vibe: Otaku Culture, Sibling Relationship, Romantic Comedy

anime.title: To LOVE Ru Darkness
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: As close encounters of the twisted kind between the residents of the planet Deviluke (represented primarily by the female members of the royal family) and the inhabitants of Earth (represented mainly by one very exhausted Rito Yuuki) continue to escalate, the situation spirals even further out of control. When junior princesses Nana and Momo transferred into Earth School where big sister Lala can (theoretically) keep an eye on them, things SHOULD be smooth sailing. But when Momo decides she'd like to "supplement" Rito's relationship with Lala with a little "sisterly love," you know Lala's not going to waste any time splitting harems. Unfortunately, it's just about that point that Yami, the Golden Darkness, enters the scene with all the subtleness of a supernova, along with an army of possessed high school students! All of which is certain to make Rito's life suck more than a black hole at the family picnic. Unless, of course, a certain semi-demonic princess can apply a little of her Devilukean Whoop Ass to exactly that portion of certain other heavenly bodies!
anime.consensus_summary: To LOVE-Ru Darkness is generally well-received by fans of the ecchi harem genre, particularly for its improved plot and character development compared to earlier seasons. However, the heavy focus on fanservice and the questionable direction of the storyline with Momo's harem plan may deter some viewers. Despite the controversy, many find it to be an enjoyable and humorous anime.
pros: Improved plot and character development compared to previous seasons.
Unique and entertaining characters.
Humorous and engaging scenarios.
cons: Excessive fanservice can overshadow the plot for some viewers.
Plot development may not be serious enough for some viewers.
Rito's role as the main character is diminished.

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie 6: Road to Ninja
anime.romaji_title: Naruto: Shippuuden Movie 6 - Road to Ninja
anime.synopsis:
Returning home to Konohagakure, the young ninja celebrate defeating a group of supposed Akatsuki members. Naruto Uzumaki and Sakura Haruno, however, feel differently. Naruto is jealous of his comrades' congratulatory families, wishing for the presence of his own parents. Sakura, on the other hand, is angry at her embarrassing parents, and wishes for no parents at all. The two clash over their opposing ideals, but are faced with a more pressing matter when the masked Madara Uchiha suddenly appears and transports them to an alternate world.

In this world, Sakura's parents are considered heroes—for they gave their lives to protect Konohagakure from the Nine-Tailed Fox attack 10 years ago. Consequently, Naruto's parents, Minato Namikaze and Kushina Uzumaki, are alive and well. Unable to return home or find the masked Madara, Naruto and Sakura stay in this new world and enjoy the changes they have always longed for. All seems well for the two ninja, until an unexpected threat emerges that pushes Naruto and Sakura to not only fight for the Konohagakure of the alternate world, but also to find a way back to their own.
anime.consensus_summary: Road to Ninja is generally viewed as one of the better Naruto movies, particularly praised for its unique plot that diverges from the usual formula. The emotional depth, especially concerning Naruto's desire for family, resonates with many viewers. However, some critics point out pacing issues, underdeveloped alternate characters, and plot holes, which temper the overall positive reception.
pros: Unique plot compared to previous Naruto movies
Good story with deep thoughts
Interesting to see alternate versions of characters
Emotional exploration of Naruto's desire for family
Humor and fun interactions between characters
cons: Pacing issues
Timeline inconsistencies
Poor use of alternate characters, especially in fight scenes
Lack of depth in exploring alternate world and its rules
Some plot holes and unexplained elements

anime.title: Afro Samurai the Movie
anime.synopsis: A movie adaptation of the TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is moderately divided, with strong appreciation for the film's stylish action, unique art, and RZA's soundtrack. However, critiques often point to a shallow protagonist and a predictable revenge plot, creating a split between those who value the style and atmosphere over substance and those who desire more robust character development and narrative depth.
pros: Visually striking art style with a dark, moody color palette
Well-animated and fluid action sequences with interesting camera angles
Compelling soundtrack by RZA that enhances the futuristic vibe
Strong voice acting, particularly from Samuel L. Jackson
Unexpected depth in themes of revenge, burden, and loss
Vibrant and individually distinct characters, especially Ninja Ninja
Confident and focused execution that avoids wasting time
cons: Art style can be unappealing to some viewers
Protagonist is too flat and monosyllabic, with limited character development
Lack of genuine threat or tension due to the protagonist easily defeating enemies
Bland and cliché plot centered around revenge
Repetitive enemy characters
Inconsistent quality of voice acting in the dub, aside from Samuel L. Jackson

anime.title: Mashiroiro Symphony Picture Drama
anime.romaji_title: Mashiro-iro Symphony: The Color of Lovers Picture Drama
anime.synopsis: DVD/BD specials of Mashiroiro Symphony: The Color of Lovers.
anime.consensus_summary: The picture drama is a short, humorous side story that complements the main series. While the art is intentionally bad and the content isn't essential, it provides a lighthearted experience for fans. It's a simple, enjoyable addition that doesn't significantly impact the overall narrative.
pros: Humorous quips
Easy to follow
Simple thing to give a smile
cons: Purposely bad-looking anime element (art)
Short, not much to say
Not essential to the overall story
Simple sound

anime.title: The Pet Girl of Sakurasou
anime.synopsis:
At Suimei High, the Sakura-sou dormitory is infamous for housing the school's most notorious delinquents. Thus, when the relatively tame Sorata Kanda is transferred to the dorm, escaping this insane asylum becomes his foremost goal. Trapped there for the time being, he must learn how to deal with his fellow residents, including bubbly animator Misaki Kamiigusa, charming playboy writer Jin Mitaka, and the ever-reclusive Ryuunosuke Akasaka. Surrounded by weirdness, Sorata frequently finds respite in his interactions with his one "normal" friend, aspiring voice actress Nanami Aoyama.

When Mashiro Shiina—a new foreign exchange student—joins the dormitory, Sorata is instantly enraptured by her beauty. Underneath her otherworldly appearance, Mashiro is an autistic savant, capable of world-renowned brilliance in her art, yet unable to perform simple daily tasks. After Sorata ends up in charge of taking care of Mashiro, the two inevitably grow closer, with Sorata's initial desire to escape the dormitory becoming a forgotten goal.

Despite their eccentricities, every resident is incredible in their own field, leaving Sorata to contend with his own lack of any particular skill. With brilliance all around him, he thus strives to become an equal to their talent. Revolving around the hardships and joys of its colorful cast, Sakura-sou no Pet na Kanojo is a heartwarming coming-of-age tale of friendship, love, ambition, and heartbreak—through the lens of an ordinary person surrounded by the extraordinary.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is somewhat mixed. While many appreciate the character-driven narrative and heartwarming themes, others find it generic or are turned off by initial fan-service elements. Some viewers also criticize the male lead's lack of significant progress, contributing to a divided opinion on the overall quality and impact of the anime.
pros: Strong character dynamics and development among the ensemble cast.
Exploration of themes like friendship, love, ambition, and dealing with failure.
The story goes beyond generic rom-com tropes.
cons: Initial impression might be of a generic or fan-service heavy anime.
Some find the male lead, Sorata, to be unadmirable or stagnant in his development.
The plot can be predictable, and some arcs may feel slow-paced.
anime.thematic_vibe: Coming-of-Age, Romantic Comedy, Slice of Life

anime.title: Junjou Romantica OVA
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Boys Love, Comedy, Drama
anime.synopsis: OVAs that come with the limited premium edition of volumes 16 and 20 of the manga series.
anime.consensus_summary: The Junjou Romantica OVA is generally well-received as a good example of the yaoi genre. Viewers find it lighthearted and enjoyable, providing a comforting escape. Some critique its unrealistic portrayal of internalized homophobia but this point does not generate intense disagreement.
pros: Enjoyable romantic relationships
Light-hearted and comforting
Good example of the Yaoi genre
cons: Unrealistic homophobia within the gay community
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Comedy, Yaoi, Slice of Life

anime.title: Corpse Party: Missing Footage
anime.synopsis:
Someday a group of classmates will perform a charm at night after school—the Happy Sachiko charm. This paper doll ritual is meant to make them stay friends forever, but performing it incorrectly will lead them to be dragged down into a dilapidated phantom of Tenjin Elementary School, which had been torn down years ago. Trapped until they can reunite and perform the charm correctly, the students will have to solve the mystery of the haunted school in order to make it out alive.

Before that ill-fated event, however, the friends led ordinary lives. Corpse Party: Missing Footage reveals an insight into the students' lives on the day before they were thrust into a waking nightmare.
anime.consensus_summary: Corpse Party: Missing Footage is a divisive prequel OVA, primarily appealing to existing fans of the game series. While praised for its sound design and ability to offer a glimpse into character relationships, it's heavily criticized for its underdeveloped plot, poor characterization, and unnecessary inclusion of fanservice. The OVA's effectiveness is largely dependent on the viewer's prior knowledge of the Corpse Party franchise.
pros: Excellent sound effects that enhance the horror and cringeworthy atmosphere.
Good voice acting, especially when using original voice actors from the games.
Provides insight into character relationships that are not explicit in the games.
Art style is decent and consistent with the main anime.
Effectively serves as a prequel and introduction to the main series for fans.
cons: Lack of character development due to the short runtime.
Stilted and unrealistic dialogue that hinders character connection.
Plot is considered unnecessary and adds little to the overall narrative.
Some scenes rely too heavily on fanservice or are not well-integrated.
Animation quality can be inconsistent and detract from the experience.

anime.title: Nagareboshi Lens
anime.synopsis: Risa Hanakago has always thought that falling in love makes the whole world sparkle. Although she longs to experience this herself, it seems futile without romantic prospects of her own. However, a chance encounter lands her in the sights of Touga Yuugure, a popular boy in her school. Charmed by each other, Risa and Touga quickly become a couple, but it remains unclear whether a relationship between a plain girl and a well-liked boy can last.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with the 'Nagareboshi Lens' OVA due to its rushed pacing and poor adaptation of the manga. While some appreciate the cute animation and lighthearted feel, the consensus is that the OVA fails to capture the depth and charm of the original story. Many recommend reading the manga instead.
pros: Cute animation style.
Enjoyable for fans of the shoujo genre.
Light and fluffy, heartwarming feelings.
cons: Rushed pacing and incomplete story in the OVA.
Cliched and predictable plot.
Mediocre art quality compared to the manga.
Lack of character development.
Poor adaptation of the manga, skipping important scenes.

anime.title: Wild Adapter
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Josei, Mystery, Organized Crime
anime.synopsis: Makoto Kubota wandered through life, not taking things too seriously or looking too deep within himself. His job as the head of the Izumo Group's youth gang kept him pleasantly occupied with yakuza wars, mahjong and assassinations... Until the day he stumbled upon a strange drug called Wild Adapter that produces bizarre side-effects—including death. Forever changed, Kubota becomes entangled with a drifter named Minoru Tokito, and the two form an unlikely companionship that draws them deeper into the mystery of Wild Adapter...
anime.consensus_summary: The Wild Adapter OVA adaptation is a disappointment for fans of the manga. While the animation style and voice acting are appreciated, the OVAs fail to capture the emotional depth, philosophical nuances, and overall gritty atmosphere of the source material. The condensed format is seen as a major contributing factor to these shortcomings.
pros: Faithful character designs
Good voice acting
cons: Lacks emotional and psychological depth
Fails to convey the philosophical edge
Poor adaptation of the manga's gritty world

anime.title: To LOVE-Ru Darkness OVA
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the 5th, 6th, 8th, 9th, 12th and 13th limited-edition volumes of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is polarized due to the OVA's extreme focus on ecchi and fan-service, which overshadows any narrative or character development for many. While fans of the genre find it highly enjoyable and visually appealing, critics point to a near-nonexistent plot and shallow characters, making it a divisive entry that strongly appeals to its niche audience but fails to impress others.
pros: Exceptional animation and character art, aesthetically pleasing and inspiring.
Momo's 'Harem Plan' and her active role are highlighted as enjoyable plot elements.
High level of fan-service and uncensored nudity are appreciated by the target audience.
Enjoyable comedy and funny/awkward scenes.
cons: Story is often considered pathetic, senseless, or non-existent, serving mainly as a vehicle for fan-service.
Pacing issues due to long waiting periods between OVAs.
Sound and art are described as mediocre or indifferent by some reviewers.
Character development is minimal, with characters often feeling one-dimensional or repetitive.

anime.title: Accel World EX
anime.genres: Action, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
Reverberation
A mysterious avatar has hijacked the Umesato Junior High Local Network, trapping students and stripping them of their clothes and belongings. After learning that other schools are facing a similar problem, Kuroyukihime gathers Haruyuki Arita and the other members of Nega Nebulus—one of the Seven Great Legions—to solve the mystery.

Vacation
Haruyuki is due for a physical re-examination in two weeks. If he fails, he will not be allowed to participate in any more territory battles with Nega Nebulus. To ensure that their legion does not lose their "Silver Crow," Chiyuri Kurashima takes it upon herself to help Haruyuki get into shape before his examination.
anime.consensus_summary: Accel World EX is seen as a mediocre addition primarily for existing fans, offering little new or compelling for newcomers. While it maintains the established production quality and provides some fan service and action, it is widely criticized for its convoluted plot, underdeveloped characters, and lack of overall impact. It's considered a fillerish experience rather than a significant expansion of the Accel World universe.
pros: Retains the visual and auditory quality of the main series.
Provides additional content for existing fans of the Accel World franchise.
Offers some amusing moments and entertaining action sequences.
cons: The plot is convoluted, poorly explained, and lacks a strong narrative thrust.
Characters are unremarkable with little personality or development.
Episodes are standalone and largely forgettable, with the second episode leaning heavily into fan service.
Some character interactions and relationship developments feel forced and weak.

anime.title: Haganai: A Round-Robin Story's Ending Is Way Extreme
anime.romaji_title: Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai: Relay Shousetsu wa Ketsumatsu ga Hanpanai
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Love Polygon, Romance, School
anime.synopsis: When the Neighbor's Club struggles to find an activity to do, Kodaka Hasegawa suggests they pass the time by writing a round-robin story—a narrative where everyone takes turns writing a section. But as they begin the project, chaos ensues as every member writes the story according to their personal preferences while trying to outdo each other. At this rate, will the story ever reach a fitting conclusion?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is split between those who appreciate the continuation of the series' comedic style and character dynamics for lighthearted entertainment, and those who find it to be mere fan service with no substantial narrative value. While praised for its humor, its lack of plot progression and reliance on existing fan attachment makes it divisive.
pros: Maintains the series' signature humor and character interactions.
Provides enjoyable comedic situations and gags for existing fans.
Artwork and sound quality are consistent with the main series.
cons: Offers no significant plot advancement or character development.
Primarily serves as fan service, potentially alienating those not deeply attached to the characters.
The story is cohesive and contributes little to the overall narrative.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Fan Service

anime.title: Mangirl!
anime.synopsis:
"We're going to launch a manga magazine!" 

A team of girls with zero experience in manga editing are off and running toward their dream of creating the biggest manga magazine in Japan! They seem to do nothing but run into problems and failures... But still they're working hard every day!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Mangirl!" is seen as a lighthearted and cute anime that is best enjoyed without high expectations. The short episodes and simple plot make it suitable for casual viewing, but the lack of depth and rushed pacing are common criticisms. While some appreciate its comedic elements and adorable art style, others find it predictable and lacking substance.
pros: Catchy opening song
Adorable art style fitting for the anime's tone
Characters are easy to understand and laugh at
cons: Poor plot with little development and feels rushed
Characters are stereotypical and lack depth
Episodes are too short, hindering story and character development

anime.title: Blast of Tempest
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Psychological, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Yoshino Takigawa, an ordinary teenager, is secretly dating his best friend Mahiro Fuwa's younger sister, Aika. But when Aika mysteriously dies, Mahiro disappears, vowing to find the one responsible and make them pay for murdering his beloved sister. Yoshino continues his life as usual and has not heard from Mahiro in a month—until he is confronted by a strange girl who holds him at gunpoint, and his best friend arrives in the nick of time to save him.

Yoshino learns that Mahiro has enlisted the help of a witch named Hakaze Kusaribe to find Aika's killer. However, the witch has been banished to a deserted island due to infighting within her clan. Hakaze's brother, Samon, selfishly desires to make use of the Tree of Exodus' power, in spite of both his sister's opposition and the impending peril to the world. With Hakaze out of the picture, it is now up to Yoshino and Mahiro to help her save the world, all while inching ever closer to the truth behind Aika's death.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some praise the show's complex plot, beautiful animation, and incorporation of Shakespearean themes, considering it one of the best anime they've seen. Others criticize its pacing, pretentious writing, and convoluted plot, finding it ultimately disappointing and unfulfilling. The series sparks strong reactions, indicating a significant level of polarization among viewers.
pros: Intriguing plot with many twists and turns.
High-quality art and animation by Studio Bones.
Complex characters with emotional depth.
Great blend of story, dialogue, and action.
References to Shakespeare add depth and complexity.
cons: Pacing issues, particularly in the second half.
Some find the Shakespearean references pretentious.
Plot can become convoluted and nonsensical.
Characters can be underdeveloped and uninteresting.
Ending may leave viewers with unfulfilled expectations.

anime.title: Pokémon: Black & White: Rival Destinies
anime.synopsis: Satoshi, Iris and Dent continue their travels through the Isshu region. After successfully winning his eighth Gym Badge against Homika in Tachiwaki City, Shirona invites everyone to stay at her villa in east Isshu, where old friend Hikari is also staying, and participate in the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup before Satoshi participates in the Isshu League. Team Rocket, meanwhile, initiate their final plan for the Isshu region. What is the purpose of their desire for the legendary Pokémon Meloetta?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed for Pokemon Best Wishes! Season 2. While some appreciate the improved animation and specific arcs like the Meloetta storyline, many are disappointed with the lack of character development, repetitive plot elements, and underwhelming Unova League. There's a sense that the season fails to capture the magic of earlier Pokemon iterations, leading to overall dissatisfaction.
pros: Art style improvements and animation quality.
Some episodes focusing on side characters are interesting.
Meloetta arc is well-written and fun (English version ending).
cons: Inconsistent character development and annoying character traits (Iris, Cilan).
Team Rocket's storyline lacks meaningful development.
Ash's trainer skills remain stagnant.
Unova League is poorly executed, especially the Ash vs. Trip battle and the introduction of new, overpowered characters.
Lack of originality and creativity in the plot.

anime.title: Girls und Panzer
anime.synopsis:
"Senshadou" is a traditional sport using World War II era tanks in elimination-based matches. Widely practiced by women and girls alike, it's advertised as a form of art geared towards making ladies more prominent in culture and appealing to men. Becoming a worldwide phenomenon over time, the influence of senshadou leads to the creation of a world championship which will soon be held in Japan.

Miho Nishizumi, who comes from a lineage of well-respected senshadou specialists, is at odds with the sport after a traumatic event led to her retirement and eventually a rift to form between her and her family. To steer clear of the practice as much as possible, she transfers to Ooarai Girls Academy where the senshadou program has been abolished. However, with the news of the upcoming championships, the school revives their tankery program, and Miho is pushed into joining.

Now, with the aid of some new friends, she must overcome her past and once again take command of a squadron of tanks in an effort to save her school from closure, all while proving to her family that the Nishizumi-style of senshadou is not solely about victory.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a surprisingly entertaining take on the 'cute girls doing cute things' genre, elevated by its unique premise and well-executed tank battles. While the overall story is predictable, the attention to detail and engaging action make it a worthwhile watch for fans of military themes and character-driven narratives. The show's blend of action and lightheartedness results in a satisfying experience, particularly for those open to its unconventional premise.
pros: Entertaining and well-executed story with good pacing and satisfying ending.
Unique premise of girls driving tanks is surprisingly enjoyable.
Well-researched and realistic depiction of tanks and tank warfare.
cons: The premise may be off-putting to some viewers.
Predictable sports story arc.
Some viewers may find the slice-of-life elements pale in comparison to the tank battles.

anime.title: Hanasaku Iroha the Movie: Home Sweet Home
anime.romaji_title: Hanasaku Iroha Movie: Home Sweet Home
anime.synopsis:
Ohana Matsumae has been working at Kissui Inn as a waitress for a while now. However, she realizes that she is starting to lose her desire to sparkle, having grown accustomed to the routines of her job. As this was a desire she had when she first moved to the inn, the realization bothers her. While having Yuina Wakura—Ohana's classmate, friend, and the daughter of rival Fukuya Inn's owner—under her as an apprentice, Ohana stumbles upon some old archives that mention her mother, Satsuki. Ohana does not know much about her mother, but these archives could shed some light on her past.

Besides learning more about her mother, it is business as usual at Kissui Inn—though with a couple of challenges to test Ohana and the staff of the inn.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a welcome addition to the Hanasaku Iroha series, especially for fans of the original anime. It delves into the past of Ohana's mother and provides further character development. Although some feel that its short length prevents it from reaching its full potential, it's generally considered a heartwarming and visually appealing side story.
pros: Expands on the background of Ohana's mother and father.
Good fan-service that adds to the experience of the show.
Stunning art and sound as usual, further character development despite being a side story.
Animation art direction captures the good scenes from Yunosagi.
cons: Movie is short and feels more like an OVA.
Story wasn't a simple continuation from the last episode of the TV series.
An hour isn't enough time to fit everything in.

anime.title: Dusk Maiden of Amnesia: Ghost Girl
anime.romaji_title: Tasogare Otome x Amnesia: Taima Otome
anime.genres: Horror, Mystery, Romance, School, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Tired of Yuuko's antics for causing more ghost stories to be spread amongst the students, Kirie challenges her to a series of games which if Yuuko loses, she must behave.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally seen as a lighthearted and comedic epilogue to the main series, offering fans one last chance to enjoy the characters. However, some find the story pointless and lacking in substance. It's best enjoyed after completing the original series for a final, less serious adventure.
pros: Provides closure and a final opportunity to engage with the characters.
Light-hearted and comedic, offering a different tone from the main series.
Focus on Kirie provides a fresh perspective.
cons: Story is often pointless and lacking substance.
Humor may not appeal to all viewers.
Characters are not further developed beyond their initial archetypes.

anime.title: OniAi
anime.romaji_title: Oniichan dakedo Ai sae Areba Kankeinai yo ne!
anime.synopsis:
After their parents' deaths, brother and sister Akito and Akiko Himenokouji were forced to live with separate families for six years. But now they have finally reunited and begin to live together. It quickly becomes apparent that Akiko harbors romantic feelings for her brother; however, Akito only sees her as a sibling.

When three more girls—Anastasia Nasuhara, Arashi Nikaidou, and Ginbei Haruomi Sawatari—move into their apartment, Akiko's hopes of living alone with her brother vanish. Moreover, these girls also like Akito in one way or another, making it even more difficult for Akiko to gain her brother's undivided attention. As the girls fight over who should take care of Akito, they display various eroticisms that may be a little too much for a normal man to handle.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the series entertaining due to its comedy and fan service, while others criticize it for being generic, unoriginal, and relying too heavily on ecchi elements. The incestuous themes are a point of contention, with some viewers enjoying them and others finding them off-putting. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on individual preferences for the harem and ecchi genres.
pros: Enjoyable for viewers who like ecchi harem comedies.
Some found the characters lovable and funny, particularly Akiko.
The opening song and voice acting were praised by several reviewers.
Visually appealing art style and animation.
cons: Generic plot and characters.
Over-reliance on fan service and cliches.
Story lacks originality.
Poor adaptation of the light novel.
The incestuous themes may be off-putting to some viewers.

anime.title: My Little Monster
anime.synopsis:
Shizuku Mizutani is apathetic toward her classmates, only caring about her grades. However, her cold view of life begins to change when she meets Haru Yoshida, a violent troublemaker who stopped attending class after getting into a fight early in the school year. He is not much different from her, though—he too understands little about human nature and does not have any friends. Much to Shizuku's surprise, he proclaims that she will be his friend and immediately confesses his feelings toward her upon meeting her.
 
Because of her lack of friends and social interaction, Shizuku has a hard time understanding her relationship with Haru. But slowly, their friendship begins to progress, and she discovers that there is more to Haru than violence. She begins to  develop feelings for him, but is unsure what kind of emotions she is experiencing. Together, Shizuku and Haru explore the true nature of their relationship and emotions.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. While some enjoyed the show's unique characters, comedy, and initial premise, many were disappointed by the underdeveloped plot, pacing issues, and perceived problematic relationship dynamics. The series is considered a flawed romantic comedy with wasted potential, with some viewers even describing elements of domestic abuse.
pros: Interesting characters with potential
Enjoyable comedy
Unique premise
cons: Underdeveloped plot
Pacing issues
Inconsistent character development
Potential depiction of abusive relationship dynamics
Unresolved plot threads and rushed ending

anime.title: Busou Shinki: Armored War Goddess
anime.synopsis:
The slice-of-life battle story is set in a future that has neither World War III nor an alien invasion—just an ordinary future set after our current age. In this world, robots are part of everyday life, and they contribute in various aspects of society. "Shinki" are 15-centimeter-tall (about 6-inch-tall) cute partners made to assist humans. Equipped with intelligence and emotions, they devote themselves to serving their "Masters."

These Shinki can even be equipped with weapons and armor to fight each other. Such Shinki are named "Busou Shinki" (literally, "armed divine princesses"). In particular, the Shinki Ann (Arnval), Aines (Altines), and Lene (Altlene) serve a high school freshman named Masato. Things change when a new Shinki, the bellicose Strarf, joins them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some finding it an enjoyable and cute slice-of-life anime with creative elements, while others criticize its lack of plot, shallow characters, and reliance on fan service. The show is considered a light and casual watch, but not a must-see. Some viewers appreciate the unexpected depth in later episodes, while others find the initial lack of direction and character development a significant drawback.
pros: Enjoyable slice of life with comedy elements.
Creative scenarios and conflicts.
Good art and sound quality in some instances.
cons: Lack of a defined plot or overarching story.
Characters are standard and lack depth.
Overuse of fan service and potential for sleazy themes.
Inconsistent character development.
Predictable climax and lack of serious battles.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Cute Robots, Lighthearted

anime.title: Chitose Get You!!
anime.synopsis: Chitose is an 11-year-old girl who is madly in love with an older guy named Hiroshi. He works at the town hall right next to the school and Chitose spends every day relentlessly pursuing him. Can Chitose ever convince Hiroshi to go out with her?
anime.consensus_summary: Chitose Get You!! is a harmless, short series that's easy to watch. The art is minimal and the characters are bland. Overall, it's a forgettable experience that is good for killing time.
pros: Short and easy to watch
Quick gags and gaffs
Fun end slate song
cons: Minimal art style
Bland characters
Not memorable
Teacher is physically violent

anime.title: Vividred Operation
anime.synopsis:
Situated on Blue Island, the Manifestation Engine has been the answer to the world's energy problem for five years. On the neighboring island of Izu Ooshima reside the cheerful Akane Isshiki, her dependable little sister Momo, and her grandfather Kenjirou, one of the inventors of the Manifestation Engine.

As they live peacefully alongside the powerful creation, it all seems like a dream until mysterious entities known as the "Alone" appear seeking to destroy it. With military forces failing to repel the invaders, Kenjirou grants Akane a special key containing the "Vivid System"—empowering her to fight the Alone.

Joined by Aoi Futaba, Wakaba Saegusa, and Himawari Shinomiya, Akane and her friends stand together in the battle against the unforeseen enemy as the last hope for humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: Vividred Operation is a visually appealing anime that relies heavily on fanservice and cute characters. While some enjoy the lighthearted action and animation, many find the story unoriginal, the characters underdeveloped, and the plot riddled with inconsistencies. The excessive fanservice is a major point of contention, with some viewers finding it distracting and unnecessary.
pros: Visually appealing animation and character designs.
Well-choreographed fight scenes.
Upbeat music that fits the mood.
cons: Unoriginal and clichéd story.
Stock characters with minimal development.
Gratuitous and distracting fanservice.
Illogical plot elements and continuity glitches.

anime.title: Say "I Love You."
anime.synopsis:
Friends will only let you down—that is the sad truth Mei Tachibana lives with, ever since she was wrongfully blamed for the death of a class pet by her so-called friends in grade school. Since then, she has stayed away from people in order to avoid ever being hurt again. However, Mei's life begins to change drastically when a misunderstanding in high school causes her to encounter popular student Yamato Kurosawa.

Yamato finds her intriguing and insists on being her friend, even though Mei wants nothing to do with him. But when a dangerous situation ends with Yamato kissing Mei to save her from the unwanted attention of a stalker, Mei begins to develop feelings for him. On the heels of her discovery that their feelings are mutual, they start dating and she gains not only a boyfriend, but friends as well. Mei, however, finds it very hard to adapt to this new lifestyle, especially in expressing her true feelings towards Yamato.

Throughout misunderstandings of their new relationship, each other, and the attentions of other girls, Mei and Yamato slowly grow closer and learn the true meaning of those three little words: "I love you."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on 'Suki tte Ii na yo'. Some appreciate the relatable characters, touching romance, and good art, while others criticize the generic story, cliched tropes, and shallow conflicts. The anime's strengths and weaknesses evoke mixed reactions, resulting in a polarized audience sentiment.
pros: Interesting characters with relatable pain and loneliness.
Touching love story with heavy chemistry between the leads.
Good art and animation with sharp lines and detailed backgrounds.
Soundtrack matches the feel of the anime well.
cons: Generic and monotonous story with a predictable plot.
Simplistic and cliched tropes, including the loser heroine and popular boy dynamic.
Shallow conflicts that are easily resolved.
Lack of character development, particularly for the supporting cast.

anime.title: Psychic School Wars
anime.synopsis:
Very little changes in Kenji Seki's daily routine. Every morning, he takes his dog to the beach in the hopes of catching a glimpse of his classmate, Kahori Harukawa, while she surfs. Afterward, he meets up with his neighbor and childhood friend, Natsuki Suzuura, and they walk to school. In essence, he lives an idyllic life where the only thing he has to worry about is how to finally confess his feelings to Kahori. 

The routineness of Kenji's life is interrupted by the arrival of a mysterious transfer student. Ryouichi Kyougoku, who claims to be a psychic, has both the charisma and popularity that Kenji has always dreamed of. Before long, Kahori begins to show feelings for Ryouichi, and Natsuki becomes distant whenever Kenji tries to talk about his feelings.

As Kenji's life is thrown into disarray, how will Ryouichi's arrival impact those around him? Nerawareta Gakuen follows these formerly typical high schoolers as they become involved with the supernatural.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences are significantly divided on Nerawareta Gakuen, with a strong appreciation for its breathtaking visuals and emotional character moments clashing with widespread confusion and criticism regarding its convoluted plot and underdeveloped narrative. While some viewers found profound thematic depth and a unique experience, others were left frustrated by its incoherence and unanswered questions, leading to a polarizing reception.
pros: Stunning and vibrant art direction with gorgeous color palettes and fluid animation.
Beautiful and immersive backgrounds that are highly detailed and visually impressive.
Soothing and fitting soundtrack with well-executed sound design.
The film effectively portrays the emotional depth of its characters and their relationships.
Thematic exploration of connection, loneliness, and individuality is profound for some viewers.
The ending, while potentially confusing, offers a surprising and non-clichéd conclusion for some.
cons: Convoluted and confusing plot that is poorly explained and hard to follow.
Numerous plot holes and unanswered questions, particularly regarding time travel and psychic powers.
Inconsistent and underdeveloped characters who often rely on stereotypes.
Awkward pacing and a lack of meaningful resolution for many plot points.
Overuse of visual effects like lens flares and excessive cherry blossoms can be distracting.
Dialogue and exposition are sometimes unnatural, and mouth synchronization can be off.

anime.title: Computer Kakumei: Saikyou x Saisoku no Zunou Tanjou
anime.romaji_title: Computer Kakumei: Saikyou x Saisoku no Zunou Tanjou
anime.synopsis: The anime short Computer Kakumei was aired by the Japanese public broadcaster NHK as part of a TV special. The near-future anime was conceived by Parasite Eve author Hideaki Sena, and it depicts how ubiquitous computers have transformed life's various aspects in 2020 Tokyo. The story is told through the eyes of a high school senior named Mako.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is positive, praising the world-building and premise established in this short OVA.  Viewers are intrigued by the futuristic setting and the potential romance between the protagonist and a robot.  The main criticism is its brevity and the cliffhanger ending, leaving viewers wanting more.
pros: Great world-building for a short OVA.
Cute character design.
Interesting premise with potential for a complete series.
cons: Episode is too short (only 10 minutes).
Ends on a cliffhanger.

anime.title: Tanken Driland
anime.synopsis: Due to the influence of someone who visited her town when she was a child, Princess Mikoto of Elua decides to become a hunter and search for treasure all over the land of Driland. She sets out on her journey with her personal assistant Wallens, but they are soon joined by Pollon, a hunter who dreams of being a hero, and Paan, a wandering knight. As they continue their exploration they begin to sense great danger drawing near.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is seen as a lighthearted, wholesome adventure, but is criticized for its simple and repetitive plot, lack of character depth and poor world-building. Despite its flaws, some viewers still find it enjoyable due to the engaging adventures and positive characters. Most audience sentiment seems appreciative of the show's simple entertainment value.
pros: Wholesome characters
Interesting adventures
cons: Simple story lacking depth and tension
Repetitive character arcs
One-dimensional personalities
Lack of world-building
Poor character development

anime.title: BTOOOM!
anime.genres: Action, Gore, High Stakes Game, Psychological, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Ryouta Sakamoto is unemployed and lives with his mother, his only real achievement being that he is Japan's top player of the popular online video game Btooom! However, his peaceful life is about to change when he finds himself stranded on an island in the middle of nowhere, with a small green crystal embedded in his left hand and no memory of how he got there. To his shock, someone has decided to recreate the game he is so fond of in real life, with the stakes being life or death.

Armed with a bag full of unique bombs known as "BIM," the players are tasked with killing seven of their fellow participants and taking their green crystals in order to return home. Initially condemning any form of violence, Ryouta is forced to fight when he realizes that many of the other players are not as welcoming as they may seem. Teaming up with Himiko, a fellow Btooom! player, they attempt to get off of the island together, coming closer and closer to the truth behind this contest of death.
anime.consensus_summary: Btooom! receives mixed reactions from its audience. While some appreciate the action, psychological elements, and character exploration, others are critical of the unrealistic scenarios, inconsistent character behavior, and reliance on fan service. The unfinished ending and unresolved plot threads also contribute to the polarized opinions.
pros: Well-choreographed fight scenes utilizing the bombs effectively.
Exploration of psychological elements and character backstories.
The series has a unique fighting style and exceptional character.
cons: Inconsistent physics and improbable scenarios undermine the sense of realism.
Characters act inconsistently and the script is weak.
Needless fan service and attempted rape scenes are poorly handled and aggravating.
The series has an incomplete ending and cliffhangers leaving plotlines unresolved.

anime.title: Little Witch Academia
anime.synopsis:
For young witches everywhere, the world-renowned witch Shiny Chariot reigns as the most revered and celebrated role model. But as the girls age, so do their opinions of her—now just the mention of Chariot would get a witch labeled a child. However, undeterred in her blind admiration for Chariot, ordinary girl Atsuko Kagari enrolls into Luna Nova Magical Academy, hoping to someday become just as mesmerizing as her idol.

However, the witch academy isn't all the fun and games Atsuko thought it would be: boring lectures, strict teachers, and students who mock Chariot plague the campus. Coupled with her own ineptness in magic, she's seen as little more than a rebel student. But when a chance finally presents itself to prove herself to her peers and teachers, she takes it, and now it's up to her to stop a rampaging dragon before it flattens the entire academy.
anime.consensus_summary: Little Witch Academia is generally well-received for its stunning animation, charming characters, and lighthearted, family-friendly appeal. While some find the plot and characters lacking depth due to the short runtime, the overall consensus is that it's an enjoyable and visually impressive experience. The series evokes a sense of childlike wonder and excitement, making it a worthwhile watch for many.
pros: Visually stunning animation, smooth and consistent.
Charming and unique characters, avoiding typical archetypes.
Enjoyable and family-friendly, providing 'bang for your buck'.
Well-paced and engaging story, despite the short runtime.
cons: Story and characters lack depth due to time constraints.
Derivative world-building, uninspired in some aspects.
Plot can be barren or simple.
Some find the characters flat and annoying.

anime.title: Death Billiards
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Fantasy, High Stakes Game, Psychological, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Two men have just arrived at a location known as Quindecim and are unable to remember how they got there. They are immediately greeted by a young woman who escorts them to a small bar, where a bartender awaits them. They are told that they will have to participate in a game, randomly chosen by roulette, and will be unable to leave until its completion; if they refuse, the consequences will be dire. In addition to the rules of the game, the two men are told to play as if their lives are at stake.
 
The game that has been chosen is billiards. But there's more to it than just pocketing pool balls, as the two are about to find out the outcome could mean life or death.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Death Billiards' for its ambition and effective storytelling within a limited timeframe, highlighting its visuals and emotional depth. However, some find flaws in character development and the open ending. It is considered a thought-provoking short, with more praise than strong criticism.
pros: Visually appealing animation and detailed backgrounds
Successfully conveys emotions and backstories in a short timeframe
Intriguing premise with well-built tension
cons: Some find the young man's character overly hysterical and unrealistic
The ending can feel unresolved or 'open' without satisfying resolution
The story's simplicity may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Encouragement of Climb
anime.genres: Adventure, CGDCT, Iyashikei, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
As a child, Aoi Yukimura adored mountains and was passionate about climbing. However, a playground accident has since left her afraid of heights, turning her toward indoor hobbies. Unfortunately, now a shy and timid first-year high school student, Aoi has become so absorbed in these pastimes that she can barely socialize with others, leaving her practically friendless. It is only when she runs into the lively Hinata Kuraue, an old friend from her climbing days, that things start to change. 

Impulsive and high-spirited, Hinata insists on having Aoi join her in all sorts of climbing activities. Though reluctant at first, Aoi quickly finds that her time with Hinata brings back fond memories of their childhood and soon decides to start climbing again. As the return to her past hobby starts to bring her out of her shell, Aoi finds herself gaining close friends, taking on new challenges, and continuing to find her own encouragement to climb.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally feels that Yama no Susume is a heartwarming and encouraging series about friendship and overcoming fears, particularly well-suited for slice-of-life and moe enthusiasts. The show's character development and beautiful art style are frequently praised. Some viewers find the short episode length or simple story to be drawbacks, but overall the series is positively received for its ability to tell a complete and uplifting story in a concise format.
pros: Character development, especially Aoi's growth in confidence.
Positive portrayal of friendship and overcoming fears.
Beautiful art style and scenery capture the essence of mountain climbing.
Informative about mountain climbing basics.
Well-executed storytelling despite the short episode format.
cons: Short episode length may not appeal to all viewers.
