Simple story may lack depth for some.
Music and sound design are unremarkable.
Occasional moe elements may deter some viewers.
Some find the focus on buying things in some episodes boring.

anime.title: Chihayafuru 2
anime.genres: Drama, Josei, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Sports, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis: Chihaya Ayase is obsessed with developing her school's competitive karuta club, nursing daunting ambitions like winning the national team championship at the Omi Jingu and becoming the Queen, the best female karuta player in Japan—and in extension, the world. As their second year of high school rolls around, Chihaya and her fellow teammates must recruit new members, train their minds and bodies alike, and battle the formidable opponents that stand in their way to the championship title. Meanwhile, Chihaya's childhood friend, Arata Wataya, the prodigy who introduced her to karuta, rediscovers his lost love for the old card game.
anime.consensus_summary: Chihayafuru 2 is well-received for its engaging karuta matches, strong character development, and emotional depth. While some find the pacing slow and romance minimal, the series excels in capturing the passion of the characters and their journey of self-improvement. Overall, the audience consensus is positive, appreciating the blend of sports and character-driven drama.
pros: Exciting karuta matches with intense drama and emotion.
Strong character development and interactions.
Successfully combines sports and Shoujo elements with friendship bonds.
Excellent animation captures the passion of the characters.
The story emphasizes personal and team growth.
cons: Pacing issues can make the season feel slow at times.
Some matches feel repetitive.
Romance elements are minimal.
Excessive inner monologues can be distracting.

anime.title: Persona 3 the Movie: #1 Spring of Birth
anime.romaji_title: Persona 3 the Movie 1: Spring of Birth
anime.synopsis:
At the stroke of midnight, the Dark Hour appears—a secret hour which most are unaware of. Those not trapped in coffins during this time, unfortunate enough to find themselves conscious, are met by dangerous creatures known as Shadows. A select few, however, possess the potential to wield Persona: a special power used to defeat these beings. This secret group is called SEES (Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad), and their mission is to uncover the reason behind the Dark Hour's appearance.

Only a short while after transfer student Makoto Yuuki begins his residency at Iwatodai Dorm, his Persona awakens after an attack by a strong Shadow. Now recruited into the ranks of SEES, he begins fighting alongside his comrades, as only they can protect humanity from Shadows and prevent the anomaly that is the Dark Hour.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with fans of the Persona 3 game appreciating the faithful adaptation and stunning visuals, while newcomers may find the pacing rushed and the story disjointed. Some reviewers felt the movie stayed too close to the source material without adding anything new, and that several elements did not translate well to the movie format. Overall, a visually appealing but potentially flawed experience depending on prior knowledge of the Persona universe.
pros: Beautiful animation, especially the Dark Hour.
Faithful adaptation of the game's story, hitting major plot points.
Good character development, especially Makoto's emotional growth.
Excellent art style that aligns with the game's aesthetics.
Mystery, suspense and action
Modern/decent artworks
cons: Fast pacing due to movie format, causing some side characters to be underdeveloped.
Skipped scenes detract from the movie.
Awkward integration of game elements like the calendar.
Soundtrack relies heavily on the game's OST, lacks originality at times.
May not be enjoyable for those unfamiliar with the Persona 3 game.
Poor adaptation, with animation that feels 'pathetic' and unsuited to the format.

anime.title: K
anime.synopsis:
"Kings" are individuals who have been bestowed with incredible supernatural powers and granted the ability to recruit others into their clans. Protecting the lives and honor of their clansmen is an integral part of the Kings' duties. After a video depicting the heinous murder of a Red Clansman spreads virally, the unassuming student Yashiro Isana is accused of homicide. Now, a manhunt is underway for his head, bringing him into contact with the infamous "Black Dog" Kurou Yatogami—a skilled swordsman and martial artist determined to follow the wishes of his late master, the Seventh King.

Meanwhile, the current Red King, Mikoto Suou, faces his own imminent demise as the search for Yashiro narrows. But during Yashiro's struggle to prove his innocence, a greater conspiracy is unraveling behind the scenes; clouds begin to appear in his memory, and close friends start to question his very existence. What began as a simple murder is now leading towards a full blown war between Kings with the very fate of the world at stake.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on K are divided. While praised for its stunning visuals and music, the series is heavily criticized for its convoluted and rushed plot, as well as underdeveloped characters. Many feel the anime prioritizes aesthetics over a coherent narrative, resulting in a disappointing experience despite its initial promise.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style.
Catchy and versatile soundtrack that enhances emotional scenes.
Intriguing initial mystery surrounding the protagonist's identity.
cons: Incoherent and rushed plot with many unanswered questions.
Weak character development and lack of depth.
Over-reliance on style over substance; beautiful visuals cannot compensate for poor storytelling.

anime.title: Minami-ke Tadaima
anime.synopsis: The everyday lives of the Minami sisters continue. Chiaki, the youngest, continues to call people idiots while worshipping her eldest sister. Kana, the middle, still can't figure out that Fujioka's feelings for her are a crush, not a grudge. Haruka, the eldest, still unknowingly avoids Hosaka's advances to invite her to the volleyball team, and after a long day of excitement, the sisters enjoy sitting at the table at their home.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many find it a relaxing and enjoyable slice-of-life anime with charming characters and solid visuals. However, some find the humor stale, the storylines uninspired, and the character development lacking. Overall, it's considered a decent show for fans of the genre, but not a standout title.
pros: Charming characters with good interactions.
Solid visuals and animation, especially in later seasons.
Relaxing and easy to watch.
Humorous elements.
cons: Stale or repetitive humor.
Lack of significant character development.
Bland or uninspired storylines.
Over-reliance on clichés and recycled gags.
Uneven character focus with some characters being bland or underutilized.

anime.title: Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic
anime.synopsis:
A Magi is a magician whose inclination toward magic is so immense that they can be said to shape the world. With their significant influence, each Magi chooses a worthy candidate to become a king, then helps them conquer strange labyrinths called "Dungeons" and acquire the power of mythical djinns within. Above all else, the Magi supervises their elected representative as they build a country that might one day bring the world to its knees.

Aladdin is a young Magi wandering the world in search of his true self. However, his journey is not a lonely one, as he is accompanied by his friend and mentor Ugo—a djinn he summons using his flute. In his travels, Aladdin also befriends Alibaba Saluja and guides him to a nearby Dungeon. With this newfound friendship, they begin an epic adventure across the world, witnessing various irregularities that seem more frequent than ever.
anime.consensus_summary: Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic is a generally enjoyable shonen anime with a unique setting and interesting political elements. However, it suffers from inconsistent pacing and tone, as well as shallow characters. While some find the story engaging and the adventure exciting, others find it predictable and uninspired, leading to a mixed reception.
pros: Unique setting based on Arabian Nights provides a refreshing take on the shonen genre.
Well-orchestrated focus on the main protagonists allows for a gripping narrative.
Political aspects are believable and add depth to the story.
cons: Pacing and tone are inconsistent, leading to jarring shifts.
Characters can be shallow and one-dimensional.
Story can be predictable.
anime.thematic_vibe: Adventure, Political Intrigue, Arabian Nights Fantasy

anime.title: Sasami-san@Ganbaranai
anime.synopsis: The Japanese call them hikikomori—people who've become so withdrawn socially that they refuse to leave their homes for weeks and even months at a time. For Sasami Tsukuyomi, who's attempting to pass her first year of high school despite being a shut in, it's more than just a word. Fortunately though, she lives with her older brother Kamiomi, who just happens to be a teacher at the school Sasami is supposed to attend. Not to mention, her "Brother Surveillance Tool" which lets her view the outside world via her computer and will, theoretically, allow her to readjust to interfacing with people again. What it mainly does, however, is let her view her brother's interactions with the three very odd Yagami sisters, who inexplicably seem to have had their ages reversed and have various types of "interest" in Kamiomi. And then things start to get really weird... Magical powers? Everything turning into chocolate? Is life via the web warping Sasami's brain, or is it the universe that's going crazy?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Sasami-san@Ganbaranai are divided. Some appreciate the show's unique art style, quirky characters, and comedic elements, while others are put off by its confusing plot, inconsistent tone, and lack of character development. The series' heavy reliance on weirdness and unexplained elements polarizes viewers, leading to a mixed reception.
pros: Unique and creative art style, often compared to a watercolor aesthetic.
Enjoyable and quirky characters, despite some lacking depth.
Initially confusing, but the story eventually becomes coherent and engaging for some viewers.
Strong comedic elements, particularly through character interactions.
cons: Inconsistent plot that can feel aimless and directionless.
Lack of character development for some characters.
Sudden shifts in tone and genre, leading to an identity crisis.
Reliance on deus ex machina plot devices and unexplained elements.
Overabundance of weirdness and fanservice that overshadows deeper themes.

anime.title: Medaka Box Abnormal
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Martial Arts, School, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
After the defeat of Myouri Unzen at the hands of Medaka Kurokami and her Student Council, peace has returned to Hakoniwa Academy—at least, for a short while. Soon, Medaka, Zenkichi Hitoyoshi, Kouki  Akune, and Mogana Kikaijima find themselves wrapped up in another sinister scheme, known as the "Flask Plan," led by the school's principal himself.

However, the council's first problem is to deal with a whole new group of superhuman students calling themselves the "Thirteen Party," led by the egotistical but powerful Oudo Miyakonojou. With the mysterious Flask Plan, Oudo's tyranny, and the resurfacing of an old enemy, the state of Hakoniwa Academy is far from tranquil, and Medaka and her companions have their hands full as things only get a lot more abnormal.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Medaka Box Abnormal are divided. Some appreciate the shift to a more action-oriented battle shounen format with deeper character exploration. However, others find the story inconsistent, the pacing slow, and the explanations for abilities unconvincing, leading to disappointment compared to the first season.
pros: Improved action and fight sequences compared to the first season.
Exploration of character backstories and motivations, adding depth.
Unique character abilities and creative fight strategies.
cons: Story deviates significantly from the first season, alienating some viewers.
Pacing issues, with some battles feeling slow or drawn out.
Inconsistent character behavior and irrational character design.
Pseudoscience explanations for abilities detract from the experience.

anime.title: Maji de Otaku na English! Ribbon-chan: Eigo de Tatakau Mahou Shoujo
anime.romaji_title: Maji de Otaku na English! Ribbon-chan: Eigo de Tatakau Mahou Shoujo
anime.synopsis: Original anime that aims to teach English with cute girl characters.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's effectiveness as an English learning tool and its high production quality, particularly the use of native English speakers. The show is considered underrated and deserving of a wider audience. There are no significant criticisms mentioned in the provided review.
pros: Effective English learning tool
Native English speakers (allegedly)
Underrated
cons: No significant negative feedback mentioned in the provided review

anime.title: Minami-ke Omatase
anime.synopsis: Minami-ke OVA bundled with the 10th volume of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the OVA for its comedic and slice-of-life elements, particularly praising the characters and animation. However, some viewers found the music distracting and were disappointed by the lack of a conclusive ending. Overall, the reception is positive but tempered by these issues.
pros: Good comedy
Enjoyable characters
Good animation
cons: Music sometimes distracting
Unsatisfying ending

anime.title: Lagrange: The Flower of Rin-ne Specials
anime.synopsis: Rinne no Lagrange short specials included in the Rinne no Lagrange Blu-rays and DVDs.
anime.consensus_summary: The Rinne no Lagrange Specials are well-received by fans of the original series who enjoy the characters and their interactions. The specials offer a lighthearted and comedic break from the main show's plot, focusing on slice-of-life scenarios. While some may find the lack of significant fanservice disappointing, the specials generally deliver on providing more of the cute and homey atmosphere that viewers appreciated in Rinne no Lagrange.
pros: Continues the homey atmosphere of the main show
Features all important characters from the main show
Funny and cute situations
cons: Poster has more fanservice than the show itself
May be disappointing for those expecting ecchi content
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Comedy, Cute Girls Doing Cute Things

anime.title: Sword of the Stranger Pilot
anime.synopsis: Young Nanashi is a drifting samurai under the service of an enigmatic monk who teaches the ways of life. In search for the meaning of life, Nanashi is forced to partake in certain horrendous acts to overcome the corrupt governments of China and Japan. The mysterious and observant samurai is forced to show a dark side to accomplish his goals and rescue society.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is highly impressed with the movie's direction, animation, and action. Reviewers highlight the well-developed characters and complex storytelling as major strengths. There are no significant criticisms, suggesting a strong positive consensus.
pros: Amazing direction and storytelling
Breathtaking action choreography
Well-developed characters with compelling motives
Powerful atmosphere maintained throughout the movie
Excellent art style, soundtrack, and animation

anime.title: Hiiro no Kakera: The Tamayori Princess Saga Season 2
anime.synopsis:
After battling dangerous creatures once existing only in legend,​ Princess Tamaki begins to deal with her uncertain future as the new Tamayori Princess.​ Once she claims her rightful place as the protector of the universe,​ high school will seem like a breeze - but whether she lives to accept that future is another matter altogether.​

Her five guardians - handsome,​ powerful young men of great power and undeniable loyalty - have vowed to sacrifice everything to protect her.​ But are any of them able to deal with a traitor in their midst?​ And how can anyone deal with such important issues while still maintaining a high GPA?​
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Hiiro no Kakera 2nd Season. While some appreciate the beautiful art, soothing music, and character development (especially in the second season), others find the pacing slow, the protagonist weak, and the plot predictable. The second season is generally considered better than the first, but still suffers from issues like rushed endings and uneven character arcs, resulting in a mild positive sentiment overall.
pros: Beautiful art and animation, especially backgrounds and character designs.
Soothing and well-fitting opening and ending songs, with talented Japanese voice acting.
Satisfying character development, particularly in the second season, with deeper exploration of certain characters' backstories and motivations.
The second season is faster-paced with more plot development and action compared to the first season.
The romance aspects are heightened and delightful in the second season.
The story builds gradually and rewards patience, with a satisfying resolution.
The soundtrack is emotionally impactful.
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the first season, which can be tedious for some viewers.
The female protagonist is often perceived as useless or weak until the very end.
Uneven character development, with some characters being underdeveloped or lacking depth.
Predictable plot twists and a generally simple story, lacking complexity.
Rushed ending with not enough episodes to properly conclude the story arcs.
Inconsistent character behavior and questionable decisions that detract from the overall plot.
Filler episodes in the second season that stall the plot's progress.

anime.title: Hayate the Combat Butler: Can't Take My Eyes Off You
anime.romaji_title: Hayate no Gotoku! Can't Take My Eyes Off You
anime.synopsis:
Taking place one month after the events that occurred in the movie Heaven is a Place on Earth. Living at the Sanzenin Mansion once again, Nagi returns to her old ways of life, until she receives word from American authorities informing her that she has a week to pick up her late father's belongings that was indefinitely delayed due to various circumstances. After receiving news of her father whom she doesn't remember, Nagi then meets a mysterious girl (with a hidden agenda) claiming to be Nagi's little sister.

The series tells a new story that is original to the anime and not directly based on the manga. The main author of the original series Kenjiro Hata personally created the original concept for the story of this anime.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative, with disappointment stemming from a perceived decline in art quality, a weaker storyline, and less effective humor compared to previous seasons. While some appreciated the attempt at a more plot-driven narrative and enjoyed the music, the prevailing view is that this season fails to capture the charm and quality of the original series. Many fans felt it was a cynical cash grab that damaged the overall franchise.
pros: Soundtrack and opening/ending themes are well-received and fit the series.
Some viewers enjoyed the plot twists and unveiling of past events.
Character personalities are retained from previous seasons.
cons: Many found the story poorly executed and rushed, with an overstuffed plot.
The new character, Tsugumi, was generally seen as annoying and forgettable.
The art style was widely criticized for being a downgrade from previous seasons, with poor character designs.
Comedy felt forced and less effective compared to earlier installments.

anime.title: Aura: Koga Maryuin's Last War
anime.romaji_title: Aura: Maryuuin Kouga Saigo no Tatakai
anime.synopsis:
Ichirou Satou is an ordinary high school student who pretended that he was a hero by the name of "Maryuuin Kouga" back in middle school, which led to others frequently bullying him. Now that he has left this embarrassing phase behind, he does his best to avoid standing out and live a peaceful life, although he feels the world has become quite dull. But when he makes his way back to school one night to grab a textbook he left in class, he runs into a strange girl wearing a costume.

This girl, Ryouko Satou, happens to be his classmate and is affected by the exact same condition that he once had, holding on to a delusion that she is someone else and dressing up to reflect this. The very next day, Ichirou is asked by his teacher to become friends with Ryouko, to which he adamantly refuses, unwilling to be reminded of his own history. When he sees that she is being bullied just as he once was, however, the boy makes it his responsibility to take care of her and break her free from that which what once plagued him—the perfect job for Maryuuin Kouga.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the film's realistic and dramatic take on chuunibyou and bullying. Some find the story relatable and impactful, while others criticize the generic art, forced emotional moments, and one-dimensional characters. The film is considered more dramatic than comedic, with a focus on character development and a message of self-acceptance.
pros: Realistic portrayal of chuunibyou and its impact.
Well-paced direction and focused storytelling.
Relatable characters with good development.
cons: Generic art style.
Forced emotional moments and melodrama.
Unrealistic or one-dimensional antagonists in bullying scenes.

anime.title: Onegai☆Teacher: Reminiscence Disc
anime.synopsis: An hour long OVA summarizing the plot of the original Onegai Teacher series. Also bundled with the BD box release of Onegai Teacher.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is primarily aimed at existing fans of Onegai Teacher who want a quick recap of the main couple's story and key moments. It's not recommended for newcomers due to its disjointed plot and lack of explanation. Fans appreciate it for the nostalgia and revisiting the familiar story, but some may be disappointed by the exclusion of certain subplots.
pros: Recaps impactful and dramatic moments.
Good for re-experiencing the anime.
Includes sexy scenes without searching through the whole series.
cons: No new scenes or songs.
Plot looks disjointed and confusing for newcomers.
Mini arcs (like Lemon's) are not shown.

anime.title: Kamisama Kiss
anime.synopsis:
High schooler Nanami Momozono has quite a few problems of late, beginning with her absentee father being in such extreme debt that they lose everything. Downtrodden and homeless, she runs into a man being harassed by a dog. After helping him, she explains her situation, and to her surprise, he offers her his home in gratitude. But when she discovers that said home is a rundown shrine, she tries to leave; however, she is caught by two shrine spirits and a fox familiar named Tomoe. They mistake her for the man Nanami rescued—the land god of the shrine, Mikage. Realizing that Mikage must have sent her there as a replacement god, Tomoe leaves abruptly, refusing to serve a human.

Rather than going back to being homeless, Nanami immerses herself in her divine duties. But if she must keep things running smoothly, she will need the help of a certain hot-headed fox. In her fumbling attempt to seek out Tomoe, she lands in trouble and ends up sealing a contract with him. Now the two must traverse the path of godhood together as god and familiar; but it will not be easy, for new threats arise in the form of a youkai who wants to devour the girl, a snake that wants to marry her, and Nanami's own unexpected feelings for her new familiar.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is largely positive, appreciating the show's lighthearted and romantic nature. While some find the plot predictable or the heroine flawed, the engaging characters and enjoyable blend of genres make it a favorite for many, especially fans of shoujo anime. The series is considered a comfort watch with a satisfying, albeit somewhat rushed, ending.
pros: Appealing characters with good development.
Enjoyable blend of comedy, romance, and supernatural elements.
Pleasant soundtrack and art style.
cons: Story can be basic and predictable.
Pacing issues due to limited episodes.
Nanami's character development can be inconsistent, sometimes portrayed as overly reliant.

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (2012)
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Historical, Shounen, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
The year is 1868; English nobleman George Joestar and his son Jonathan become indebted to Dario Brando after being rescued from a carriage incident. What the Joestars don't realize, however, is that Dario had no intention of helping them; he believed they were dead and was trying to ransack their belongings. After Dario's death 12 years later, George—hoping to repay his debt—adopts his son, Dio. 

While he publicly fawns over his new father, Dio secretly plans to steal the Joestar fortune. His first step is to create a divide between George and Jonathan. By constantly outdoing his foster brother, Dio firmly makes his place in the Joestar family. But when Dio pushes Jonathan too far, Jonathan defeats him in a brawl. 

Years later, the two appear to be close friends to the outside world. But trouble brews again when George falls ill, as Jonathan suspects that Dio is somehow behind the incident—and it appears he has more tricks up his sleeve.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views JoJo's Bizarre Adventure favorably, praising its unique style and unconventional approach to the shonen genre. While some find the initial part slow or the over-the-top elements off-putting, the majority appreciates the series' distinctive qualities and memorable characters. The show has garnered a dedicated fanbase that appreciates its artistic flair and exciting battles.
pros: Unique and stylish art style that captures the essence of the manga.
Engaging and unconventional shonen with a blend of dark, comical, and serious tones.
Memorable characters and over-the-top action sequences.
Good music and voice acting performances.
cons: The first part (Phantom Blood) can be slow and less engaging compared to later parts.
Simplistic story in each arc with exposition.
Over-the-top manliness and 80's cheese may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 17: Private Eye in the Distant Sea
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 17: Zekkai no Private Eye
anime.synopsis:
The warship Aegis Destroyer is conducting public exercises in Maizuru Bay where, coincidentally, a suspicious foreign ship was recently spotted. Conan Edogawa, Ran Mouri, Kogorou Mouri, Sonoko Suzuki, and the Detective Boys all receive a ticket to attend this event. However, while the ongoing military operations are underway, one of the crew members comes across a lieutenant's severed left arm. Conan later discovers that a foreign spy may have infiltrated the warship to obtain classified information by any means necessary. If the information were to leak, Japan's line of defense would be exposed, leaving the country unprotected from hostile attack.

With the help of the police at sea while other friends and allies investigate on the mainland, Conan must now prevent this national crisis and identify the spy for the sake of Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some praising the exciting plot, integration of military elements, and character interactions. However, others criticize the film for being propaganda, having a weaker mystery, and reducing some characters to annoying stereotypes. Despite mixed reactions, the film is seen as a thrilling watch for fans of the Detective Conan series.
pros: Exciting plot with real-life details of the Japanese Self-Defense Force and Aegis system.
Good integration of different groups (police, marine force, detective boys) working together.
Accurate depiction of the destroyer and military elements.
Strong character interactions and moments for many characters to shine.
cons: The mystery aspect is weaker compared to the action.
Feels like propaganda for the JMSDF.
Some characters are reduced to being deadweight and crybabies.
Slow pacing and lack of memorable scenes in some parts.

anime.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!
anime.synopsis:
Everybody has had that stage in their life where they have thought themselves to be special, different from the masses of ordinary humans. They might go as far as seeing themselves capable of wielding mystical powers, or maybe even believe themselves to have descended from a fantasy realm. This "disease" is known as "chuunibyou" and is often the source of some of the most embarrassing moments of a person's life.

For Yuuta Togashi, the scars that his chuunibyou has left behind are still fresh. Having posed as the "Dark Flame Master" during his middle school years, he looks back at those times with extreme embarrassment, so much so that he decides to attend a high school far away where nobody will recognize him. Putting his dark history behind him, he longs to live a normal high school life.

Unfortunately, he hasn't escaped his past yet: enter Rikka Takanashi, Yuuta's new classmate and self-declared vessel of the "Wicked Eye." As this eccentric young girl crashes into Yuuta's life, his dream of an ordinary, chuunibyou-free life quickly crumbles away. In this hilarious and heartwarming story of a boy who just wants to leave his embarrassing memories behind, the delusions of old are far from a thing of the past.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience feels positively about 'Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai!', praising its blend of comedy and drama, beautiful animation, and relatable themes of adolescence and self-acceptance. Some critics find the plot clichéd and certain characters underdeveloped, but the series is generally considered a heartwarming and enjoyable experience.  The show resonates with viewers who appreciate a nostalgic exploration of growing up and embracing one's unique identity.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style by Kyoto Animation.
Well-blended comedy and drama with emotional depth.
Relatable exploration of adolescence and self-acceptance.
cons: Plot can be cliché and predictable at times.
Some episodes feel meaningless or poorly paced.
Other characters besides Rikka may be forgettable.

anime.title: Oreshura
anime.romaji_title: Ore no Kanojo to Osananajimi ga Shuraba Sugiru
anime.synopsis:
The infidelity of Eita Kidou's parents not only made his family fall apart, but also made him skeptic of love. Having no intention to delve into romance, Eita devotes his entire high school life to his studies in order to become a doctor.

It did not take long for the beautiful and popular Masuzu Natsukawa to notice Eita's apathy. Tired of being the object of people's affection, she asks him to pretend to be her boyfriend, as she too feels disgusted at the notion of love. Eita, however, refuses—yet Masuzu has one trick left up her sleeve: Eita’s journal and threatening to post the embarrassing content online if he does not comply.

Now entangled in a fake romance with the most desired girl at school, Eita's life is turned upside down. Whether envied by his peers or receiving a confession, he must cope with his newfound relationship and all the troubles that come along with it.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences found 'Oreshura' to be a fairly generic but enjoyable harem anime. Many appreciated its lighthearted tone, colorful art style, and some of the character designs. However, the unoriginal plot, clichéd characters, and disappointing ending were common points of criticism, leading to a somewhat mixed but generally positive reception.
pros: Enjoyable and funny with a lighthearted tone.
Bright and colorful art style that suits the comedic and romantic elements.
Likeable characters with unique backgrounds and solid reasons for their affections, even side characters.
cons: Generic harem elements and clichéd character archetypes.
Unoriginal plot with predictable developments and reliance on overused tropes.
Some character backstories feel rushed, making it difficult to sympathize with them.
Ending is disappointing and doesn't provide a satisfying resolution.

anime.title: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Crystal
anime.synopsis:
Though a little clumsy and easily brought to tears, Usagi Tsukino is a typical 14-year-old girl in her second year of junior high. However, all of that changes when an encounter with Luna, a mysterious talking black cat, whose head bears the mark of a crescent moon, results in the animal bestowing a magical brooch upon her. Now Usagi can transform into Sailor Moon, a magical girl in a sailor uniform who protects love and peace!

Usagi is appointed as a guardian of justice and is tasked with the search for the legendary Silver Crystal, a magical artifact that holds immense power, as well as finding the other Sailor Guardians and the lost princess of Luna's home, the Moon Kingdom. Her mission isn't without opposition, however; Queen Beryl, ruler of the Dark Kingdom, wants to claim the Silver Crystal and take its power for her own.

Though she still has to worry about her school, family, and love life, it is up to Sailor Moon and the other Sailor Guardians to save the day!
anime.consensus_summary: Sailor Moon Crystal is a divisive reboot, with some fans appreciating its faithfulness to the original manga and others criticizing its animation, pacing, and character development. Many viewers find the CGI transformations off-putting, and some feel that the series prioritizes plot over character depth. Nostalgia for the original anime heavily influences opinions, leading to strong positive and negative reactions.
pros: More faithful adaptation to the manga.
Story is more concise, removing unnecessary filler.
Some viewers appreciate the updated art style and character designs.
Follows manga scene for scene and word for word
cons: Animation quality is inconsistent and sometimes poor, with frequent complaints about the CGI transformations.
Character development is lacking for characters other than Usagi and Mamoru.
Pacing feels rushed, potentially sacrificing depth in character relationships.
The story is more adult and relies more on drama than humor
The art tries to emulate the manga style somewhat, but lacking the charm
Faces just can't stay consistent.

anime.title: Hori and Miyamura
anime.synopsis:
Within everyone there exists a side preferably kept hidden, even from close friends. For the smart and popular Kyouko Hori, it's the fact that she has to do all the housework and care for her little brother, Souta, because of her parents' busy work schedules. For the gentle Izumi Miyamura, whom everybody sees as an otaku, it's his nine hidden piercings and large body tattoo.

So what happens when they accidentally discover each other's hidden sides? Sharing parts of themselves that they couldn't with anyone else, strong bonds of friendship soon begin to form between Miyamura and Hori, as well as those around them. As their hidden personas start to dissipate, they slowly learn how to open up to others.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Hori-san to Miyamura-kun' to be a sweet and charming short series, best enjoyed as a relaxing break. While the simple animation and short runtime are drawbacks for some, the focus on character development and the faithful adaptation of the webcomic are appreciated. Most viewers recommend it as a complement to the main Horimiya series.
pros: Charming story with focus on characters.
Simple and relaxing to watch.
Faithful to the original webcomic.
cons: Animation quality is not great and may be off-putting.
Short runtime limits character development and plot depth.
May not appeal to those seeking complex plots.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sweet Romance, Simple Story, Character Development

anime.title: Ixion Saga DT
anime.synopsis: One day as Kon Hokaze is playing an MMORPG, he receives a request from a female character in the game. He thinks that he has lucked out and found a girlfriend online, but suddenly he finds himself transported into the world of Mira where he accidentally saves a young princess by landing on her attacker with his swivel chair. With no idea how he got there nor how to get back to his own world, Kon tags along with the princess as part of her honor guard while a militant faction of the princess's own country seeks to capture her before she can complete her arranged marriage.
anime.consensus_summary: Ixion Saga DT is generally well-received as a comedic isekai anime, praised for its humor and characters. However, some find the plot lacking depth and the humor inconsistent. Ultimately, it's considered a fun and enjoyable watch for those seeking lighthearted entertainment, especially if one appreciates parodies.
pros: Humor is well-placed and executed.
Likable characters that become increasingly endearing.
Good for casual viewing and light-hearted entertainment.
cons: Thin and simplistic story.
Inconsistent humor.
Lacks depth beyond comedic elements.

anime.title: The Garden of Sinners: Future Gospel
anime.romaji_title: Kara no Kyoukai Movie: Mirai Fukuin
anime.synopsis:
​Shiki Ryougi, Mikiya Kokutou, and Touko Aozaki begin investigating a bomber after they witness a nearby explosion. That same night, Shiki catches a glimpse of the bomber, and as a result, he becomes fixated on her. To get rid of her, the madman plays a game of cat and mouse in attempts to lure her to an empty parking garage. And bombs are not the only thing he has in his arsenal: he also possesses the ability to see the future, and he intends to bring an end to Shiki.

Elsewhere a few days prior, a student at Reien Girls' Academy, Shizune Seo, plans to head home for the summer. However, while exiting a bus, she has a vision of the future involving a nearby stranger's death. While trying to warn the stranger, she meets Mikiya—who succeeds in utilizing Shizune's information effectively.

Subsequently, an employee is sent on a job with his employer's 10-year-old daughter in tow. However, the subject of his investigation turns out to be a ghost from both of their pasts.

Mirai Fukuin tells the stories set during the main timeline of the Kara no Kyoukai films, as well as one set in the future.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the philosophical themes and visual presentation, considering it a satisfying end to the series. However, others criticize the confusing plot structure, pacing issues, and uninspired new characters, leading to a less favorable experience.
pros: Great animation and art style by Ufotable.
Explores interesting philosophical themes about the future and perception.
Satisfying conclusion to the Kara no Kyoukai franchise for some viewers.
Good soundtrack and background music.
cons: Achronological storytelling can be confusing.
Some viewers found the plot convoluted or poorly planned.
New characters are bland or feel like rip-offs.
Pacing issues, with some parts feeling slow or rushed.
Side stories detract from the main plot.

anime.title: GJ Club
anime.synopsis:
School clubs usually advertise their activities, but the goings-on of the GJ Club are a mystery. Kyouya "Kyoro" Shinomiya recently joined and became the sole male member of the five-person club.

Besides Kyoro, there is Mao Amatsuka, the club president who has a tendency to bite Kyoro when she gets mad or bashful; Megumi Amatsuka, Mao's composed younger sister who always makes tea and desserts for the club's members; Shion Sumeragi, a demure chess prodigy; and Kirara Bernstein, a meat lover with a strong feline personality. All four girls have some form of interest in Kyoro.

With the girls' idiosyncratic and cute personalities, Kyoro's time in GJ-bu will never be a dull one, for better or for worse.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion on GJ-bu is mixed, with some finding it a cute and relaxing slice-of-life anime with lovable characters. However, others criticize its lack of plot, reliance on stereotypes, and repetitive humor. While enjoyable for casual viewing, it may not appeal to those seeking depth or originality.
pros: Lovable and well-defined characters with unique personalities
Catchy and upbeat opening song, along with enjoyable ending themes
The show has great balance when it comes to sentimental and comedy which is nice
cons: Lacks a significant plot or overarching story
Relies heavily on character stereotypes
The jokes are overused and rely heavily on the stereotypes of each character

anime.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU
anime.romaji_title: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru.
anime.synopsis:
Hachiman Hikigaya is an apathetic high school student with narcissistic and semi-nihilistic tendencies. He firmly believes that joyful youth is nothing but a farce, and everyone who says otherwise is just lying to themselves. 

In a novel punishment for writing an essay mocking modern social relationships, Hachiman's teacher forces him to join the Volunteer Service Club, a club that aims to extend a helping hand to any student who seeks their support in achieving their goals. With the only other club member being the beautiful ice queen Yukino Yukinoshita, Hachiman finds himself on the front line of other people's problems—a place he never dreamed he would be. As Hachiman and Yukino use their wits to solve many students' problems, will Hachiman's rotten view of society prove to be a hindrance or a tool he can use to his advantage?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers appreciate the anime's realistic portrayal of social isolation and its departure from typical romance tropes, finding it relatable and insightful. Others criticize the lack of character development, slow plot progression, and repetitive interactions, deeming it monotonous and unfunny. The main character's personality appears to be a point of contention, with some identifying with him and others finding him off-putting.
pros: Relatable portrayal of social outcasts and realistic high school experiences.
Unique perspective on romance, avoids typical rom-com cliches.
Deadpan writing and insightful monologues.
cons: Lack of significant character development.
Slow or stagnant plot progression.
Repetitive character interactions and limited comedic elements.

anime.title: D.C.III: Da Capo III
anime.synopsis:
On the island of Hatsunejima, where spring is eternal, grows a particular large cherry blossom tree. This cherry blossom tree never withers, and is said to be able to fulfill any wish.

However, one day, this tree had become a normal cherry blossom tree...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely negative due to the perceived lack of plot, excessive fan service, and uninspired characters compared to earlier entries in the Da Capo series. While some appreciate the improved animation and music, most feel the series fails to deliver a compelling narrative or meaningful character development. Many consider it a disappointing addition to the franchise.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to previous Da Capo series.
Enjoyable soundtrack with well-fitting music for different scenarios.
Varied and enjoyable characters, with some returning from previous installments.
cons: Lack of substantial plot and character development.
Heavy reliance on fan service overshadows the story.
Protagonist is a dense and unlikeable character.
Inconsistent story progression, with standalone episodes that do not contribute to the main plot.

anime.title: Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya
anime.synopsis: Mage's Association members Rin Toosaka and Luviagelita "Luvia" Edelfelt are tasked with finding and retrieving seven Class Cards, medieval artifacts containing the life essence of legendary Heroic Spirits. To aid them in their mission, they are granted the power of Ruby and Sapphire, two sentient Kaleidosticks that would enable them to transform themselves into magical girls and drastically increase their abilities. However, the two mages are on anything but good terms, prompting the Kaleidosticks to abandon them in search for new masters. They stumble upon two young schoolgirls—Illyasviel von Einzbern and Miyu—and quickly convince them to form a contract. With their new powers and responsibilities, Illya and Miyu set forth to collect all the Class Cards.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with many appreciating the action, humor, and animation while criticizing the fan service and tonal inconsistencies. Some viewers found it a fun spin-off that blends the Fate universe with magical girl tropes, while others were put off by the exploitative elements and shallow character development.  The series is appreciated more by those familiar with the Fate franchise but even then, opinions remain mixed.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material.
Well-choreographed and fluid action sequences.
Good animation quality with bright and colorful visuals.
Enjoyable mix of Fate lore and magical girl elements.
Strong comedic moments.
cons: Over-sexualization of underaged characters leading to uncomfortable fan service.
Inconsistent tone, rapidly shifting between comedy, fan service, and serious action.
Weak character development for many characters, relying on stereotypes.
Plot holes and unexplained power-ups.
Story can be unoriginal, predictable, or rely too heavily on Fate series knowledge.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Fate Series Spin-off, Action Comedy

anime.title: Maoyu
anime.synopsis:
Fifteen years have passed since the war between humans and demons began. Dissatisfied with their slow advance into the Demon Realm, the Hero abandons his companions to quickly forge ahead towards the Demon Queen's castle. Upon his arrival at the royal abode, the Hero makes a startling discovery: not only is the Demon Queen a woman of unparalleled beauty, but she also seeks the Hero's help. Confused by this unexpected turn of events, the Hero refuses to ally himself with his enemy, claiming that the war the demons have waged is tearing the Southern Nations apart.

However, the Demon Queen rebuts, arguing that the war has not only united humanity but has also brought them wealth and prosperity, providing evidence to support her claims. Furthermore, she explains that if the war were to end, the supplies sent by the Central Nations in aid to the Southern Nations would cease, leaving hundreds of thousands to starve. Fortunately, she offers the Hero a way to end the war while bringing hope not only to the Southern Nations, but also to the rest of the world, though she will need his assistance to make this a reality.

Finally convinced, the Hero agrees to join his now former enemy in her quest. Vowing to stay together through sickness and health, they set off for the human world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While many appreciate the unique premise of blending fantasy with economics and the engaging characters, the execution is often criticized. Common complaints include a rushed plot, underdeveloped romance, inconsistent animation, and an unsatisfying ending, with the series failing to live up to its potential.
pros: Interesting concept blending fantasy with economics and politics.
Engaging characters, particularly the Demon Queen.
Refreshing take on the isekai genre with world-building themes.
Good art style and animation, especially in the earlier episodes.
Soundtrack and voice acting are well-received.
cons: Rushed plot and underdeveloped romance.
Inconsistent character development due to time skips.
Filler episodes and misused content detract from the main story.
Overly simplistic and sometimes illogical economic and political arguments.
Inconsistent animation quality in later episodes.
Ending feels incomplete and unsatisfying.
Fan service feels out of place and unnecessary.

anime.title: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods
anime.romaji_title: Dragon Ball Z Movie 14: Kami to Kami
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Following the defeat of a great adversary, Gokuu Son and his friends live peaceful lives on Earth. Meanwhile, in space, Beerus the God of Destruction awakens from his long slumber, having dreamed of an entity known as a Super Saiyan God. With the help of his assistant, Whis, Beerus looks for this powerful being, as he wishes to fight a worthy opponent. After discovering that the Saiyan home planet was destroyed, he tracks down the remaining Saiyans on Earth, looking for Gokuu specifically.

Having only heard of the Super Saiyan God in legends, Gokuu and his comrades summon Shen Long the Eternal Dragon, who they find out is afraid of Beerus. After learning the secret of the Super Saiyan God, an intense battle between Gokuu and Beerus commences, the immense power of which puts the Earth in terrible danger.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, especially among long-time fans who appreciate the animation, the introduction of new characters like Beerus, and the blend of comedy and action. However, there's a notable split regarding the story's quality and pacing, with some finding it weak and rushed, while others are more forgiving due to the overall entertainment value and nostalgic appeal.
pros: The animation and art style are frequently praised, with many noting it as a significant upgrade and visually stunning, even for a 2D animated film.
The introduction of new characters, particularly Beerus and Whis, is seen as a major strength, bringing fresh designs and personalities to the franchise.
The blend of humor with intense action is highlighted as a successful combination, recapturing the spirit of the original Dragon Ball series while maintaining DBZ's action.
The film's canonicity and its narrative contribution to the Dragon Ball universe are appreciated, especially by long-time fans.
Voice acting, particularly for returning characters and the new antagonist Beerus, receives high marks for performance and capturing the essence of the roles.
cons: The story and plot are criticized by some for being weak, poorly executed, rushed, or nonsensical, with a lack of depth and an over-reliance on humor.
The pacing is mentioned as an issue, with some parts feeling like a drag or too tedious, while the Super Saiyan God transformation and climax can feel rushed.
The inclusion of certain comedic elements, like the pudding dispute or Pilaf's subplot, is seen by some as unnecessary, distracting, or detracting from the tension.
The design of the Super Saiyan God form itself is criticized by a few as uninspired or too similar to other forms.
Some viewers expressed disappointment with the lack of traditional DBZ struggles and overwhelming odds, feeling the film was too 'kiddy' or lacked tension.

anime.title: Possessions
anime.synopsis: One night during the 18th century, deep in the mountains, a man loses his way and comes across a small shrine. As he enters, the space transforms into a room of a different world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally appreciate 'Tsukumo' for its stunning visuals, unique animation style, and heartwarming message about kindness and redemption. The short's blend of traditional Japanese folklore with modern animation techniques has been praised. Some viewers express a desire for a longer format to further explore the story and characters, but overall, the reception is overwhelmingly positive.
pros: Beautiful visuals and inventive scenarios.
Great message on kindness and helping the unfortunate.
Superior CG animation.
Imaginative spirit designs.
Unique animation style that blends 3D and traditional techniques effectively.
cons: The intro might not be entirely related to the main short.
Some may find the digital animation style less appealing than traditional animation.
The story could be expanded into a longer mini-series to develop the ideas and characters further.

anime.title: So, I Can't Play H! Episode 13
anime.romaji_title: Dakara Boku wa, H ga Dekinai. Mie Sugi! Mizugi Contest
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: With their school's pool opening the next day, Iria schemes up the idea to hold a swimsuit contest. With Lisara, Mina, Quele, and Iria herself all participating in the event.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience fully understands and accepts this OVA for what it is: a dedicated fan-service episode with minimal plot. Viewers who enjoy this type of content find it highly satisfying, while those expecting more substance are left wanting. It successfully delivers on its niche appeal.
pros: Excellent art quality, particularly for fan-service elements.
High-quality sound design and music, including original series intro/outro.
Characters remain consistent with the original series.
High enjoyment for viewers seeking fan-service.
cons: Negligible contribution to the original series' story.
Story is extremely thin and serves only as a vehicle for fan-service.

anime.title: Battle Spirits: Sword Eyes
anime.synopsis:
Many years ago, the death of the emperor sparked riots and civil wars that ravaged Atlantia. Upon the throning of the young king Yaiba, treacherous rebels were executed to restore the peace the country once had. However, tainted by this radical act of governance, Atlantia continues to be enveloped under the shadow of oppressive rule.

Tsurugi Tatewaki is a spunky teenager who grew up in the rural countryside with little memory of his birth parents. One day in his home, he stumbles upon a mysterious sword that transforms into a Battle Spirits card. When armed forces from Atlantia confront Tsurugi with their sights set on procuring his card, the secrets behind Tsurugi's past seemingly begin to unravel.

Accompanied by a droid named Bringer, Tsurugi makes his way to the capital of Atlantia and encounters supposed warriors who wield similar swords. As his world is slowly turned upside down by the gradual appearance of greater mysteries, Tsurugi may have to question everything he knows, including his very own judgment on what separates good from evil.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is plot-focused and has a well-established world, but it may suffer from a lack of strong characters and relies heavily on card battling elements. The absence of an opening song and a shift in focus towards conclusion in the second part are also points of criticism. Overall, the audience seems mildly positive, with some reservations about character depth and the latter part of the story.
pros: Plot focused with a good story.
Well established world and conflict.
cons: Second part focuses more on conclusion rather than introducing new ideas.
Few strong characters besides Yaiba.
No opening song.

anime.title: Red Data Girl
anime.synopsis:
Fifteen-year-old Izumiko Suzuhara just wants to be a normal girl, but that is easier said than done. Raised in a shrine deep in the mountains, she grew up extremely sheltered and painfully shy. She also has the unfortunate tendency to destroy any electronic device simply by touching it.

Despite this, she still wants to try and change her life. To mark her determination to follow through on this transformation, Izumiko begins by cutting her bangs, which shocks both her classmates and protectors. And that's only the start! Her guardian, Yukimasa Sagara, forces his son, Miyuki, to come to the mountain shrine and become Izumiko's lifelong servant and protector. Too bad Izumiko and Miyuki cannot stand each other. They have known each other since they were children, and Miyuki bullied her terribly. He simply does not understand what is so special about Izumiko. His father calls Izumiko a goddess, but that cannot be true…can it? Will Izumiko and Miyuki work past their differences? Is she actually a literal goddess? Find out in RDG: Red Data Girl!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided on RDG: Red Data Girl. Some appreciate its artistic merit, unique setting, and focus on character growth, while others are frustrated by its convoluted plot, underdeveloped characters, and rushed pacing. The series is recommended for viewers interested in Japanese culture and mythology, but not for those seeking a straightforward narrative.
pros: Visually appealing animation, especially backgrounds and scenery.
Excellent soundtrack and voice acting.
Interesting concept based on Japanese culture and mythology.
cons: Confusing and rushed plot with many unresolved points.
Underdeveloped characters with cliche tropes.
Pacing issues due to trying to fit too much into a short series.

anime.title: AKB0048: Next Stage
anime.synopsis: In the year since the 77th generation understudies joined AKB0048, the Deep Galactic Trade Organization [DGTO] and DES have stepped up their attacks on entertainment. In response, AKB0048 brings back the general elections and the center nova position. The understudies are now thrusted into a new competition directly against the successors. But as AKB0048 brings back policies not seen since Acchan's disappearance, a new more powerful enemy is quietly moving behind the scenes.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience is generally positive towards AKB0048: Next Stage, praising its characters, music, and emotional impact. However, some critics point out flaws in the plot, balance between silliness and awesomeness, and excessive fan service. The show appears to resonate strongly with fans of idol culture and those who enjoyed the first season, while others may find the story and fan service off-putting.
pros: Lovable and well-developed characters with unique personalities.
Excellent music and soundtrack, featuring AKB48 songs.
Visually appealing art style with improved animation and well-integrated CG during performances.
Emotional and suspenseful storytelling, creating a highly engaging experience.
cons: Far-fetched and sometimes muddled story, especially regarding character representation and succession.
Inconsistent balance between silly/naive plot elements and awesome moments.
Over-reliance on fan service (photo shoots) in the second season.
Repetitive use of songs from the first season.

anime.title: Haganai: I don't have many friends NEXT
anime.romaji_title: Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai Next
anime.synopsis:
The Neighbor's Club—a club founded for the purpose of making friends, where misfortunate boys and girls with few friends live out their regrettable lives.

Although Yozora Mikazuki faced a certain incident at the end of summer, the daily life of the Neighbor's Club goes on as usual. A strange nun, members of the student council and other new faces make an appearance, causing Kodaka Hasegawa's life to grow even busier.

While they all enjoy going to the amusement park, playing games, celebrating birthdays, and challenging the "school festival"—a symbol of the school life normal people live—the relations amongst the members slowly begins to change...

Let the next stage begin, on this unfortunate coming-of-age love comedy!!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the comedic elements and character interactions, especially the improvements made since the first season. However, many are frustrated by the lack of character development, the oblivious main character, and the unresolved ending. Some viewers found the humor repetitive or the plot stagnant, but overall the series is seen as a lighthearted and enjoyable watch for fans of the harem comedy genre.
pros: Enjoyable characters with distinct personalities.
Humorous and well-timed jokes.
Improved character development from season one.
Appealing art style and vibrant colors.
cons: Repetitive comedic tropes (e.g., misunderstood mumbling).
Frustratingly oblivious main character.
Lack of significant plot progression.
Open or cliffhanger ending without resolution.
Some found the humor trashy or overly sexual.
anime.thematic_vibe: Harem Comedy, Slice of Life, Romantic Frustration

anime.title: Corpse Party: Tortured Souls
anime.romaji_title: Corpse Party: Tortured Souls - Bougyakusareta Tamashii no Jukyou
anime.synopsis:
Nine students gather in their high school at night to bid farewell to a friend. As is customary among many high school students, they perform a sort of ritual for them to remain friends forever, using small paper charms shaped like dolls.

However, the students do not realize that these charms are connected to Heavenly Host Academy—an elementary school that was destroyed years ago after a series of gruesome murders took place, a school that rests under the foundation of their very own Kisaragi Academy. Now, trapped in an alternate dimension with vengeful ghosts of the past, the students must work together to escape—or join the spirits of the damned forever.

A feast for mystery fanatics, gore-hounds, and horror fans alike, Corpse Party: Tortured Souls - Bougyakusareta Tamashii no Jukyou shows a sobering look at redemption, sacrifice, and how the past is always right behind, sometimes a little too close for comfort.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Corpse Party: Tortured Souls is highly polarized. While many praise its extreme gore and disturbing atmosphere as a success for the horror genre, others find the plot rushed and the characters underdeveloped. The show's reliance on shock value over nuanced storytelling creates a divisive viewing experience.
pros: The extreme gore and disturbing visuals are highly effective for fans of the genre.
The sound design, including music and voice acting, effectively creates a horrifying atmosphere.
The ending provides a sense of conclusion rather than a cliffhanger, which was appreciated by some viewers.
The OVA's short length makes it a quick watch, which is a positive for those who don't enjoy it.
cons: The plot is rushed, confusing, and riddled with holes due to the short episode count.
Characters are underdeveloped, generic, and forgettable, making it hard for viewers to care about their fates.
The excessive gore, while praised by some, becomes numbing and even comical for others.
Some viewers found the animation style too colorful for the intended horror atmosphere.
Unnecessary fan service is included and detracts from the horror.
The horror relies heavily on shock value and gore rather than subtle scares.

anime.title: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day The Movie
anime.romaji_title: Ano Hi Mita Hana no Namae wo Bokutachi wa Mada Shiranai. Movie
anime.synopsis:
A year after their deceased friend Honma Meiko appeared to them, Jinta Yadomi and the other members of the Super Peace Busters decide to write letters in her memory. Attempting to enjoy their summer together, they reminisce about their time together before and after her death.

AnoHana. Movie retells the main events of the parent story in the perspective of each member of the Super Peace Busters.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a recap of the original AnoHana series that offers a different perspective through the characters' letters and feelings. While some appreciate the nostalgic return and emotional insights, others find it repetitive and lacking in substantial new content. The movie is best enjoyed by those seeking a refresher or a different angle on the original story, but may disappoint viewers expecting significant additions or developments.
pros: The movie offers a different perspective on the original series, revealing characters' feelings and changes since Menma's appearance.
It provides a recap of the main story, which can be enjoyable for those who want a refresher or a more concise version.
The new footage and insights into the characters' thoughts enhance the emotional impact of the story.
cons: The movie is largely a recap of the original series, with limited new content.
Some viewers may find the retelling repetitive and unnecessary, especially if they have recently watched the anime.
The movie may not add significant depth or development to the characters, potentially disappointing viewers seeking substantial new material.

anime.title: Haitai Nanafa
anime.synopsis:
Nanafa Kyan lives in Okinawa with her grandmother who runs the "Kame Soba" soba shop, her beautiful older sister Nao who is in high school, and her younger sister Kokona, who is in elementary school and has a strong ability to sense the supernatural.

One day, Nanafa witnesses a seal fall off of a Chinese banyan tree, and three spirits who live in that tree are unleashed. These spirits include Niina and Raana, who are "jimunaa" spirits. The third spirit is Iina, who is an incarnation of an Okinawan lion statue. As spirits start appearing one after another, the peaceful life of Nanafa and her family begins to change.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Haitai Nanafa for its cute animation and lighthearted, entertaining content. However, some find the episodes too short and criticize the forced drama and rushed ending. Overall, it's considered a simple and enjoyable way to spend a few minutes.
pros: Lively and cute animation style.
Entertaining and provides a warm feeling of joy.
Fun for the whole family.
Colorful animation.
cons: Episodes are too short.
Forced drama introduced near the end.
Predictable conclusion.
Rushed climax in the last few episodes.

anime.title: Lychee Light Club
anime.synopsis:
Litchi DE Hikari Club takes place in an alternate reality where the Hikari Club does not fall into disarray after the completion of Litchi, the intelligent humanlike robot the club invented to kidnap girls.

The cult-like Hikari Club has had its ups and downs. Led by the enigmatic, beauty-obsessed Hiroyuki "Zera" Tsunekawa, the club has finally succeeded in using their fruit-powered robot, Litchi, to kidnap the beautiful Kanon. After accomplishing their goals, the Hikari Club has little to do other than delight in their newfound lives. From selling the technology that allows Litchi to run on lychee fruit, to modifying the robot to perform different tasks, there's no telling what antics the Hikari Club will get up to next!
anime.consensus_summary: The "Litchi DE Hikari Club" anime adaptation is divisive. Fans of the original manga are largely disappointed by its transformation into a comedic spoof, citing a failure to capture the source material's dark essence and complex narrative. While some find the humor enjoyable as a standalone comedy sketch, many feel it disrespects the original work and is inaccessible to newcomers. The anime's production quality and disjointed narrative further contribute to the mixed reception.
pros: Appeals to existing fans of the manga who enjoy spoofs.
Some viewers found it funny and entertaining as a comedy sketch series.
The anime can stand on its own if the viewer is up for goofy black humor.
cons: Fails to capture the dark atmosphere and complexity of the original manga.
Superficial humor disrespects the original work.
Animation is awkward and lacks finesse, feeling rushed and disinterested.
The disjointed approach may alienate fans and confuse new viewers.
Difficult to follow for those unfamiliar with the manga's inside jokes.
The anime is a pale and distorted representation of the manga

anime.title: Love Live! School Idol Project
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Otonokizaka High School is in a crisis! With the number of enrolling students dropping lower and lower every year, the school is set to shut down after its current first years graduate. However, second year Honoka Kousaka refuses to let it go without a fight. Searching for a solution, she comes across popular school idol group A-RISE and sets out to create a school idol group of her own. With the help of her childhood friends Umi Sonoda and Kotori Minami, Honoka forms μ's (pronounced "muse") to boost awareness and popularity of her school.

Unfortunately, it's all easier said than done. Student council president Eri Ayase vehemently opposes the establishment of a school idol group and will do anything in her power to prevent its creation. Moreover, Honoka and her friends have trouble attracting any additional members. But the Love Live, a competition to determine the best and most beloved school idol groups in Japan, can help them gain the attention they desperately need. With the contest fast approaching, Honoka must act quickly and diligently to try and bring together a school idol group and win the Love Live in order to save Otonokizaka High School.
anime.consensus_summary: Love Live! School Idol Project is generally well-received as an enjoyable and uplifting anime, particularly praised for its music, animation, and charming characters. While the storyline is simple and predictable, the positive aspects outweigh the negatives for most viewers. Some criticism is directed towards the overuse of CG and lack of character depth, but the overall sentiment is positive and heartwarming.
pros: Catchy and memorable music with amazing opening and ending themes.
Unique and likable characters with distinct personalities.
Visually appealing art style with fluid animation, especially during performances.
cons: Predictable and simple storyline with a lack of depth.
Over-reliance on CG during musical performances can be jarring.
Some characters are underdeveloped and two-dimensional.

anime.title: Initial D Fifth Stage
anime.synopsis:
After earning a series of difficult victories in the prefectures of Tochigi, Saitama, and Ibaraki, the drivers of Project D—an amateur street driving group led by ex-street driver and expert tactician Ryousuke Takahashi—Takumi Fujiwara and Keisuke Takahashi now have to take Project D to the next level: the Kanagawa prefecture, commonly known as the holy land of street racing. Their opponents, members of the three best street racing teams of Kanagawa, design an elaborate strategy called the "Four Lines of Defense" to put a definitive end to the ambitions of Project D.

Meanwhile, Takumi feels he needs to refine his driving skills to overcome the last victory against Toshiya Joushima that he only just managed to snatch. The moment of truth has now come for Project D, which carries with it the hopes of the Gunma Prefecture; will they manage to thwart the surprising tactics of the skilled street racers of Kanagawa?
anime.consensus_summary: Fifth Stage is a divisive entry in the Initial D series. While some appreciate the improved visuals and stronger narrative arcs, many feel it lacks the excitement, technical depth, and character development that made the earlier seasons great. The shift away from engaging races and towards melodrama has disappointed a significant portion of the audience.
pros: Improved CGI and art (cars specifically)
Stronger story arcs compared to Fourth Stage
Good character development for Keisuke
Interesting exploration of Ryosuke's character
cons: Races are less exciting and engaging than previous seasons
Character designs are inconsistent and sometimes worse than previous seasons
Overreliance on dialogue instead of showing the races
Eurobeat music is a downgrade in quality
Lost the underdog feel and technical explanations of racing
Predictable plot and uninspired writing
Unnecessary or poorly integrated romance
Important characters from earlier seasons are sidelined

anime.title: Aikatsu!
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
An idol's brilliance illuminates the dreams of humanity. Starlight Academy, a holy ground for celebrities in training, seeks to realize this belief. Behind its rigorous entrance requirements lie not only the top young stars in the entertainment business, but some of the best memories these students will ever have.

Or so Aoi Kiriya believes. Alongside her best friend Ichigo, Aoi decides to apply for the prestigious private school in hopes of living up to the praise of the biggest idol in the world: Mizuki Kanzaki. As they journey through the numerous laughs, friendships, and heartbreaks that await them, can the two girls light up the lives of others as Mizuki has done for them?

Whether it be chopping down Christmas trees, traversing obstacle courses, or even rock climbing, there's always a playful new adventure to be found in the world of Aikatsu!.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Aikatsu! is well-received as an entertaining and optimistic idol anime, especially among younger audiences and those seeking a lighthearted series. While the characters are well-developed and the music is enjoyable, some viewers find the plot repetitive and the characters somewhat idealized. The show is noted for its positive messages and focus on hard work, though the rapid success of the characters may stretch believability.
pros: Characters are well-developed with dedicated episodes showcasing growth.
Music is enjoyable with no disliked songs.
The series provides a variety of idol-related activities beyond concerts.
The anime is revitalizing, and optimistic, entertaining people of all ages.
The story is well done and reaches a proper end
cons: Some support characters feel one-note.
The plot can feel repetitive.
Early dance scenes are poorly animated.
Characters can be considered Mary Sues, never losing.
The fast track to fame for young characters is unrealistic.

anime.title: Tabisuru Nuigurumi: Traveling Daru
anime.synopsis: Daru, a cherished handmade stuffed toy, gets lost and separated from its owner one day when at the airport. Determined to find her again, Daru sets out on a journey around the world in search of her. As time passes, the girl begins to forget about Daru. Will Daru be able to find and see his beloved owner again?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Tabisuru Nuigurumi: Traveling Daru' to be a heartwarming and visually appealing short film. The lack of dialogue is appreciated by some for its unique storytelling approach. While the story is simple and may not deeply resonate with all viewers, its short length makes it an easily accessible and enjoyable experience.
pros: Charming art style with detailed backgrounds
Engaging story told without dialogue
Symbolic storytelling enhances the narrative
cons: Simple plot may not appeal to all viewers
Minimal sound design
Story is not unique

anime.title: Amnesia
anime.genres: Fantasy, Josei, Mystery, Reverse Harem, Romance
anime.synopsis:
After fainting at work, a young lady awakens in the back room of the café she works at with no memory of her life or those around her. Two of her friends, whom she soon learns are named Shin and Toma, are called to help her get home safely. Once she is alone, she meets a spectral boy named Orion that only she can see and hear. He explains that she lost her memories because of his chance visit to her world, so he vows to help her remember who she is.

However, regaining her departed memories without worrying those around her may be more difficult than she realizes. In addition to the gloomy Shin and the protective Toma, she must be wary of arousing the suspicions of the captivating Ikki, the quick-witted Kent, and a mysterious man who lurks in the distance. As her amnesia entangles her in the lives of each of these men, her fragmented memories return piece by piece, and the mysteries of her circumstances slowly come to light.
anime.consensus_summary: Amnesia is a visually appealing anime with a promising premise that ultimately fails to deliver due to its weak plot, underdeveloped characters, and lack of emotional engagement. Many viewers find the female lead frustratingly passive and the overall story confusing and unsatisfying. While some appreciate the art and music, the consensus leans towards disappointment with the anime's execution.
pros: Visually appealing art style, especially the character designs and eyes
Catchy opening and ending themes
Intriguing mystery element that initially draws viewers in
cons: Weak, confusing, and rushed plot with many unresolved plot points
Poor character development, especially the passive and unlikeable female lead
Lack of emotional depth and unsatisfying romantic relationships
Repetitive story structure with little progress in memory recovery

anime.title: Cuticle Detective Inaba
anime.genres: Comedy, Detective, Fantasy, Gag Humor, Mystery, Organized Crime, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: In a world where half-human, half-animal chimeras live and work alongside normal people, there are sure to be a few bad apples in the bunch. Unfortunately, half-human criminals means non-human clues that often leave the police stumped. That's where lone wolf detectives like Hiroshi Inaba come in. He's literally part wolf and has the amazing ability to extract critical information just by examining or tasting a sample of someone's hair! Of course, that ability has also resulted in Inaba having a little bit of a hair fetish, but that doesn't seem to be a problem for his two assistants. (Well, at least the cross-dressing one isn't complaining much.) And it's nothing compared to the strange tastes of Inaba's nemesis, the omnivorous (and half goat) crime boss Don Valentino, who has an appetite for green legal tender instead of tender young greens! Inaba's sworn to cut Valentino out of the criminal flock before the Don can wolf down more ill-gotten dough, but he's going to have to chew his way through a lot of evidence to get his goat. Can sheer dogged detective work put the baaaaad guys behind bars?
anime.consensus_summary: Cuticle Tantei Inaba is a comedy anime that revels in its silliness, featuring a unique premise and flamboyant characters. Viewers appreciate the balance between comedy and action, but some find the plot lacking and the humor occasionally forced. Overall, it's a lighthearted and enjoyable experience for those who appreciate absurdist humor.
pros: Unique and creative character designs that reflect personalities.
Fast-paced comedy with some seriousness added to the mix.
Enjoyable art style with cute animals and chibi moments.
Good balance between serious and wacky elements.
Refreshing and heartwarming laughter.
Characters are lovable, and their enemies are funny
cons: Story is nonsensical and sometimes stupid.
Pacing may be too fast.
Lacks concrete story or character development.
Gags may be too forced or boring for some viewers.

anime.title: The World God Only Knows: Tenri Arc
anime.romaji_title: Kami nomi zo Shiru Sekai: Tenri-hen
anime.synopsis: It is summer break and Keima intends to spend all his time on video games. An old acquaintance, the timid girl Tenri, comes back into the neighborhood—and apparently has a lost soul inside her. It is up to Keima and Elysia to unravel the secrets of her heart.
anime.consensus_summary: The Tenri Arc OVA is seen as a supplemental addition to the series, primarily serving as a bridge between seasons and introducing characters for future storylines. While some appreciate the new character and setup, others find it lacking in plot progression and detail compared to the manga. Overall, it's considered an average addition that is not particularly polarizing.
pros: Introduction of new characters relevant to future arcs.
Cute and mysterious new girl character.
Serves as a transition to Season 3, providing context for later events.
cons: Missing small details compared to the manga storyline.
Plot progression is minimal; feels like expansion episodes.
Average quality, with no significant changes in characters or relationships.

anime.title: Teekyu
anime.synopsis:
