Teekyuu is all about the wacky antics of four schoolgirls—Kanae Shinjou gets bored easily and often breaks the laws of physics to get what she wants; Nasuno Takamiya is incredibly rich and knows how to make things go her way; Marimo Bandou would probably get arrested from her actions like eating panties or kidnapping children; and Yuri Oshimoto, their ordinary junior, rounds out the eccentric bunch that forms the sole members of their school's tennis club. 

Despite their interest in learning the sport, the older girls prefer messing around, while Yuri, being the only one who actually knows how to play and the most mature in spite of being younger, has to deal with her seniors' out of control behavior. 

When these four girls come together, insanity ensues in this lightning-paced comedy about a tennis club that doesn't really play tennis.
anime.consensus_summary: Teekyuu is a polarizing, fast-paced comedy that is either loved or hated. Its unique, absurdist humor and short episodes appeal to some, while its low budget animation and overwhelming speed deter others. The show is appreciated for its creativity and dynamic character interactions, but criticized for its lack of plot and sometimes grating elements. Overall, it's a niche anime best enjoyed in moderation.
pros: Unique, fast-paced comedy that utilizes short episodes effectively.
Refreshingly bizarre and creative, with absurd scenarios.
Despite simple character archetypes, the interactions are dynamic and unforgettable.
cons: Low budget animation and mediocre sound quality.
Extremely fast pace can be overwhelming and hard to follow.
Comedy may not appeal to everyone; jokes can be hit-or-miss.

anime.title: World War Blue
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Parody, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Segua Kingdom has been losing the war against Ninterdo Empire but the tables are turned by the appearance of a boy called Gear. All the characters are parodies of Nintendo or Sega games such as Sonic the Hedgehog, Super Mario Bros., The Legend of Zelda etc.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is highly polarized regarding Aoi Sekai no Chuushin de. While some appreciate its unique premise and gaming references, a significant majority find the execution deeply flawed, citing weak characters, a poor plot, and misplaced fanservice. The show's potential is widely seen as squandered due to poor writing and a tone that fails to land effectively.
pros: Unique premise based on the Nintendo vs. Sega console war
Some interesting gaming references that can be hilarious and mind-blowing
Decent art and sound quality in some aspects
cons: Extremely weak and underdeveloped characters with little to no relatability
Plot is cliche, predictable, and lacks depth, especially given the short runtime
Heavy reliance on fanservice that is often off-putting and out of place
Inconsistent pacing and a rushed narrative due to the short episode count
The parody aspect is often heavy-handed and lacks subtlety
The show attempts a serious tone that does not suit its parody nature

anime.title: Hetalia: The Beautiful World
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody
anime.synopsis: Few people wonder what occurs between warring nations when they are not fighting each other. In Hetalia, the countries find themselves outside of their usual setting: working together in a school newspaper club, reminiscing about former historical figures, and searching for Santa Claus? With the potential for comedic calamity always around the corner, there is no predicting what exactly these adventures entail!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Hetalia: The Beautiful World' enjoyable for its comedic and lighthearted take on historical and cultural elements, despite its lack of a strong plot and potentially offensive character portrayals. The improved animation and updated art style are appreciated. Some viewers feel the show has shifted its focus from historical parody to character-driven slice-of-life moments.
pros: Enjoyable despite being brainless
Improved animation and art style compared to previous seasons
Good for easy rewatch and entertainment
New episode format benefits the storytelling
cons: Offensive and two-dimensional characters
Lacks a strong plot or sequential narrative
Background art is dull
Historical facts are lessened
anime.thematic_vibe: Historical Parody, Cultural Humor, Slice of Life

anime.title: Code Geass: Akito the Exiled - The Wyvern Divided
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Boukoku no Akito 2 - Hikisakareshi Yokuryuu
anime.synopsis:
With her previous triumphs under her belt, Leila Malcal has now been promoted to Lieutenant Colonel and commanding officer of W-0. After having foiled an attempt to kidnap the General of the European army, she recruits the three perpetrators in order to make up for the lack of W-0's pilots. Ayano Kosaka, Yukiya Naruse, and ringleader Ryou Sayama accept, in hopes of finding a place to belong. When they are ordered to perform a commando raid by dropping into enemy lines, Leila decides to join them to prevent unnecessary casualties.

As the unit rushes into the fight, Akito finds himself possessed by an uncontrollable lust for violence, slaughtering anyone that gets in his way. Little does he know, he is soon to come face to face with the one responsible for placing the bloodthirsty curse upon him, someone he is far too familiar with...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the visuals and action, but criticism towards the story's lack of depth. Some feel it expands the Code Geass universe well, while others find it a weak addition. The quality is perceived as inconsistent, with the story and character development not matching the animation quality.
pros: Expands on Akito's character and relationships.
Stellar animation and soundtrack.
Exciting action sequences.
cons: Story feels lacking and underdeveloped.
Voice acting is inconsistent and awkward.
Relies heavily on prior knowledge of the Code Geass universe.
Feels like setup for future installments.

anime.title: Code Geass: Akito the Exiled - The Brightness Falls
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Boukoku no Akito 3 - Kagayaku Mono Ten yori Otsu
anime.synopsis:
After discovering the face of their true enemy—someone who is related to Akito and responsible for the Geass placed upon him—W-0 attempts to return to their base at Castle Weisswolf. However, stranded in Warsaw due to a complication involving their military identification, they are forced to accept the help of local gypsies, allowing the squad to take some time to deepen their bonds.

Meanwhile, Britannian advisor Julius Kingsley and his guard Suzaku Kururugi begin working together with the Knights of St. Michael in order to crush the European resistance once and for all, armed with the destructive power of a giant weapon known as the Ark Fleet.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is sharply divided on this installment, with strong opinions on both ends of the spectrum. While some praise its continued exploration of the Code Geass lore and improved production values, others find the plot nonsensical, the pacing terrible, and the characterizations weak, especially regarding the portrayal of Julius Kingsley. This film seems to be a transitional piece that fails to satisfy many long-time fans while offering little new to those seeking a coherent narrative.
pros: Visuals are a massive step up from previous movies, with improved CGI and character animation.
The inclusion of Lelouch and Suzaku, even in altered roles, is a positive for long-time fans.
Character development for some of the W-0 squad members is noted as positive, providing a break from constant action.
The series continues to explore the mystery of Geass, which is a compelling aspect for fans of the franchise.
Action choreography and mecha battles, particularly the Suzaku showdown, are praised for their quality and intensity.
cons: The plot is often nonsensical, with rushed backstories and poor pacing that prevents elements from breathing.
Many characters, including the protagonists, are described as dull, bland, or reduced to caricatures of their former selves.
The gypsy sub-plot is widely criticized as pointless, a waste of time, and poorly written.
Julius Kingsley's portrayal as a parody of Lelouch and his motivations are seen as pathetic and illogical.
The use of Geass is criticized for being convoluted, vague, and less strategically interesting than in the original series.

anime.title: Code Geass: Akito the Exiled - Memories of Hatred
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Boukoku no Akito 4 - Nikushimi no Kioku kara
anime.synopsis:
While W-0 is away, Leila and the remaining crew at base find themselves surrounded by Britannian Knightmares. Piloting the Vercingetorix, Shin Hyuuga leads the enemy charge, having usurped the position of Grand Master in the Knights of St. Michael. With her core members unavailable, it's up to Leila to protect her comrades, but this may be much tougher than she realizes: a spy lurking among them is finally ready to reveal himself.

Left with no choice but to surrender, Leila arranges a meeting with Shin in order to ensure the safety of her squad. But as negotiations begin to fall apart, Akito and an unexpected ally return in the nick of time to turn things around.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is sharply divided, with some praising the improved visuals and soundtrack while others find the plot convoluted and the characters underdeveloped. While there's an appreciation for moments of good direction and character development, significant criticism is levied against the narrative's integrity and consistency, leading to a polarized view on its overall quality within the franchise.
pros: Improved CGI and animation quality, especially in mech designs and fight sequences.
The soundtrack and OST are praised for their quality and emotional impact.
Some character development, particularly for Leila, is noted positively.
The plot twists and hints are appreciated by some viewers.
Less fanservice compared to previous installments.
cons: Convoluted and contrived plot, deemed by some as damaging to the Code Geass franchise integrity.
Generic and poorly written characters with underdeveloped backstories or contradictory traits.
Inconsistent or nonsensical plot points and character motivations (e.g., Ashley's revenge, Lelouch/Suzaku's capture).
Action direction can be incomprehensible at times.
Excessive plot armor for characters on the protagonists' side.
Pacing issues due to a heavy focus on dialogue and politics over action in some parts.

anime.title: The "Hentai" Prince and the Stony Cat.
anime.synopsis:
Youto Yokodera wants to be seen in a way different from most men: as a pervert. However, his lewd actions are often misinterpreted as good intentions, and people cannot see his true nature. Upon hearing rumors of a cat statue that can banish an unwanted trait, he searches for it and prays for his façade to be removed. But each wish comes at a price: those unwelcomed traits are transferred to someone else who desires them!

After realizing that vocalizing his dirty thoughts is not the best thing, Youto decides to regain his lost traits by seeking out the person who received them. Unfortunately, he was not alone in praying to the cat statue, and now he must not only fix his life, but the lives of others as well.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some praising the show's unique characters, imaginative story, and heartfelt moments. Others criticize the confusing plot, overuse of tropes, and inconsistent tone. The show is generally considered an enjoyable, albeit flawed, romantic comedy with harem elements.
pros: Strong, well-developed characters that defy harem archetypes.
Unique and imaginative storyline with bizarre plot twists.
Genuine and fun tone with heartfelt moments.
Good voice acting and enjoyable opening/ending themes.
cons: Fast-paced and confusing plot with plotholes.
Overuse of tropes and generic character archetypes.
Inconsistent tone, shifting between comedy, harem, and serious drama.
Random events and lack of focus make the story feel disjointed.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Comedy, Slice of Life, Harem

anime.title: In This Corner of the World
anime.synopsis:
Suzu Urano is a pure and kindhearted girl who loves to draw and keep her head in the clouds. Growing up in the outskirts of Hiroshima with her family, she is more than happy to help with her grandmother's nori business.

However, when she becomes of age, Suzu leaves her beloved home to marry Shuusaku Houjou, a man she barely knows. As she integrates into her new husband's household, the homesick bride struggles to adjust to the unfamiliar environment as the war effort extends far beyond its point of no return. When the war reaches Suzu's own backyard and peace gives way to brutality, how will she support herself and those she comes to love along the way?

Kono Sekai no Katasumi ni paints a colorful yet haunting depiction of everyday life in the years before and after World War II, showcasing the perseverance and fortitude of ordinary Japanese during one of the darkest periods of modern history.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the film's portrayal of life during wartime through the eyes of an ordinary woman. Suzu's character is widely praised for her charm and resilience. However, some viewers find the film disjointed and the animation style simplistic.
pros: Beautifully depicts everyday life during wartime.
Suzu is a charming and relatable protagonist.
Effectively portrays the emotional impact of war on ordinary people.
cons: The film can feel disjointed with abrupt scene cuts.
Simplistic animation style may be off-putting to some.
Some events can feel surreal or dreamlike, causing confusion.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, War Drama, Resilience

anime.title: Kirakira 5th Anniversary Live Anime: Kick Start Generation
anime.romaji_title: Kirakira 5th Anniversary Live Anime: Kick Start Generation
anime.synopsis:
Based on the visual novel by Overdrive. 

The what-if story reunites the Second Literature Club Band members Kirari, Chie, Shikanosuke, and Sarina, several months after the concert in the d2b vs Deardrops ~Cross the Future~ fan disk.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is that this live anime is primarily for fans of the original visual novels and their music. It serves as a nostalgic reunion with beloved characters through concert performances. However, it's not a standalone anime and may disappoint viewers expecting new content or high-quality animation.
pros: Revisits favorite characters from the visual novels
Good sound quality, especially for fans of the games' music
cons: Not an anime, but a series of concerts
Repetitive animation with little new content
Art style differs slightly from the visual novels
No new songs included

anime.title: Smile Precure! Movie: Ehon no Naka wa Minna Chiguhagu!
anime.romaji_title: Smile Precure! Movie: Ehon no Naka wa Minna Chiguhagu!
anime.synopsis: The movie transports the Precure into a world inside a picture book, where they are guided by Nico, a mysterious inhabitant of the picture book world.
anime.consensus_summary: The Smile Precure movie is an enjoyable, albeit flawed, fairy tale adventure.  The emotional connection between Miyuki and Nico is a highlight, although some plot elements feel contrived.  Overall, the movie offers heartwarming moments but lacks depth in certain areas.
pros: Enjoyable fairy tale adaptation.
Strong emotional value in Miyuki and Nico's bond.
Moments deserving of some tears.
cons: Nico isn't that developed as a character.
The plot feels contrived.
Some mythological and fairytale references might not be well-known.

anime.title: Wooser's Hand-to-Mouth Life
anime.synopsis: Lovely, but with a dark heart. The hand-to-mouth life of a strange yellow and black creature named "Wooser". Lovely but with a dark heart, the new hero (?) from the depths of the internet is appearing on TV and Nico Nico Video! "My favorite things are meat and money and girls," he says, but what are his cute, round eyes staring at? (* Probably meat, money, or girls) The strange hand-to-mouth life of this strange creature is now being animated by Sanzigen, famous for their 3D CG animations! Do note that the dot in the middle is supposedly a mouth, not a nose.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding it humorous and good for killing time, while others criticize its lack of plot, one-dimensional characters, and poor animation. The humor is considered hit-or-miss, and the overall experience is seen as mediocre to irritating. There is a clear divide between those who appreciate the absurdist nature and those who find it nonsensical and poorly executed.
pros: Some find it funny and a nice way to kill time.
Catchy opening and ending themes.
Miyano Mamoru's voice acting is a highlight for some.
cons: Lacks a coherent storyline.
Characters are one-dimensional and unlikeable.
Humor is often perverted or random and falls short.
Art style is basic and animation quality is poor.
Performances are stale and lack emotional depth.

anime.title: Problem Children Are Coming from Another World, Aren't They?
anime.romaji_title: Mondaiji-tachi ga Isekai kara Kuru Sou desu yo?
anime.synopsis:
Izayoi Sakamaki, Asuka Kudou, and You Kasukabe are extraordinary teenagers who are blessed with psychic powers but completely fed up with their disproportionately mundane lives—until, unexpectedly, each of them receives a strange envelope containing an invitation to a mysterious place known as Little Garden. 

Inexplicably dropped into a vast new world, the trio is greeted by Kurousagi, who explains that they have been given a once-in-a-lifetime chance to participate in special high-stakes games using their abilities. In order to take part, however, they must first join a community. Learning that Kurousagi's community "No Names" has lost its official status and bountiful land due to their defeat at the hands of a demon lord, the group sets off to help reclaim their new home's dignity, eager to protect its residents and explore the excitement that Little Garden has to offer.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Mondaiji-tachi. Many appreciate its fast-paced action, striking visuals, and the overpowered protagonist. However, others find the plot and characters underdeveloped due to the short length, leading to a sense of unrealized potential and a desire for a second season to fully explore the world and characters.
pros: Visually appealing animation and art style.
Enjoyable and catchy opening theme.
Unique and intriguing character personalities.
cons: Rushed and underdeveloped story.
Lack of character development.
Overpowered main character diminishes tension.
Incomplete or unsatisfying ending.

anime.title: One Piece: Episode of Nami - Tears of a Navigator and the Bonds of Friends
anime.romaji_title: One Piece: Episode of Nami - Koukaishi no Namida to Nakama no Kizuna
anime.synopsis: Nami betrays the Straw Hat crew and steals their ship and treasures, escaping to Arlong Park. Luffy and his crew follow her, only to come face to face with the infamous pirate Arlong, a ruthless fish-man who has taken over Nami's home island with force and Naval bribes. As opinions clash and the Straw Hats attempt to convince Nami to rejoin the team, her true motivation behind the deception will be revealed at last.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Episode of Nami' special is a well-received recap of the Arlong Park arc, praised for its updated animation and mostly faithful adaptation. While some viewers find the abridged format sacrifices emotional depth and tension, others appreciate its concise storytelling and re-watch value. It is generally recommended for those already familiar with the original arc, not as a substitute for a first-time viewing.
pros: Excellent re-animation enhances visuals.
Well-paced and avoids feeling overly rushed (compared to other recaps).
Successfully condenses the arc while retaining emotional core.
Faithful to the original story.
cons: Shorter length diminishes emotional impact compared to original series.
Some cuts weaken tension and character development.
Fast pacing may not be suitable for first-time viewers.
Recap at the beginning feels like a waste of time

anime.title: Gintama: The Movie: The Final Chapter: Be Forever Yorozuya
anime.romaji_title: Gintama Movie 2: Kanketsu-hen - Yorozuya yo Eien Nare
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
When Gintoki apprehends a movie pirate at a premiere, he checks the camera's footage and finds himself transported to a bleak, post-apocalyptic version of Edo, where a mysterious epidemic called the "White Plague" has ravished the world's population. It turns out that the movie pirate wasn't a pirate after all—it was an android time machine, and Gintoki has been hurtled five years into the future! Shinpachi and Kagura, his Yorozuya cohorts, have had a falling out and are now battle-hardened solo vigilantes and he himself has been missing for years, disappearing without a trace after scribbling a strange message in his journal.

Setting out in the disguise given to him by the android time machine, Gintoki haphazardly reunites the Yorozuya team to investigate the White Plague, and soon discovers that the key to saving the future lies in the darkness of his own past. Determined to confront a powerful foe, he makes an important discovery—with a ragtag band of friends and allies at his side, he doesn't have to fight alone.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is overwhelmingly praised for its ability to blend humor and drama, deliver exciting action, and provide satisfying character development. While some find the time travel aspects confusing or the plot somewhat convoluted, the general consensus is that it's a must-watch for Gintama fans and a strong addition to the franchise. Many appreciate the original story and emotional impact.
pros: Great blend of comedy and serious themes.
Excellent character designs, especially future versions.
Original and cohesive plot that ties into the series.
Amazing soundtrack and music choices.
Balances humor with darker elements effectively.
cons: Time travel elements can be confusing.
Some find it convoluted or that it devolves into fan pandering.
May not appeal to newcomers without series knowledge.
Story is not always canon.

anime.title: Samurai Bride
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Samurai, School
anime.synopsis: Second season of Hyakka Ryoran: Samurai Girls.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Hyakka Ryouran: Samurai Bride is mixed, with many acknowledging its reliance on fanservice and a weak plot. While some appreciate the unique art style and light-hearted humor, others find the story unoriginal and the comedy repetitive. The series is primarily recommended for those who enjoyed the first season and are not seeking a complex or engaging narrative.
pros: Unique and appealing art style resembling ink painting.
Enjoyable for fans of the first season and those seeking lighthearted entertainment.
Good voice acting, with notable performances from voice actors like Kugiyama Rie and Aoi Yuuki.
cons: Generic and predictable storyline with minimal character development.
Over-reliance on fanservice with recycled plot elements from the first season.
Inconsistent comedy, with many jokes falling flat and repetitive gags.

anime.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura
anime.synopsis:
Since childhood, Haruka Kotoura's classmates have seen her as a creepy and monstrous person. This is due to her ability to read other people's minds—the same ability that drove her parents away, leaving her alone with her grandfather. As a result, she has grown accustomed to the bitter treatment by the people around her, becoming completely cold and unsociable to others.

However, everything starts to change when Haruka transfers to a new school. While most are off put by her as usual, she meets Yoshihisa Manabe, who finds her power astonishing. Yoshihisa then proceeds to befriend Haruka, promising to never leave her no matter what happens.

Haruka's new experiences of social belonging thus begin, meeting new friends and learning to open herself along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling the show squanders its initial promise. While some appreciate the emotional moments and character development, the consensus is that the execution is flawed. The constant tonal shifts, reliance on perverted humor, and often nonsensical plot points detract from the overall experience.
pros: Initial drama is compelling and emotionally resonant.
Some viewers appreciate the blend of comedy and drama.
Character development of Kotoura is seen as a positive aspect by some.
cons: Abrupt shifts between heavy drama and light comedy are jarring.
Comedy relies heavily on repetitive perverted humor.
Writing is often unsubtle, forced, and melodramatic.
Character motivations and actions are sometimes illogical or inconsistent.
Lost potential due to poor execution of promising premise.

anime.title: Gintama: Enchousen
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
While Gintoki Sakata was away, the Yorozuya found themselves a new leader: Kintoki, Gintoki's golden-haired doppelganger. In order to regain his former position, Gintoki will need the help of those around him, a troubling feat when no one can remember him! Between Kintoki and Gintoki, who will claim the throne as the main character?

In addition, Yorozuya make a trip back down to red-light district of Yoshiwara to aid an elderly courtesan in her search for her long-lost lover. Although the district is no longer in chains beneath the earth's surface, the trio soon learn of the tragic backstories of Yoshiwara's inhabitants that still haunt them. With flashback after flashback, this quest has Yorozuya witnessing everlasting love and protecting it as best they can with their hearts and souls.
anime.consensus_summary: Gintama': Enchousen is highly praised for its blend of humor, action, and emotional depth. While some find the shift towards more serious storylines a drawback, most agree that it is an excellent addition to the Gintama series. The character development and well-crafted arcs contribute to a positive viewing experience.
pros: Excellent balance of comedy, drama, and action.
Character development is remarkably well done.
The arcs are well-developed and meaningful.
cons: Comedy takes a bit of a backseat compared to previous seasons.
Some characters disappear for several episodes.
The shift towards more serious storylines may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Is This a Zombie? Of the Dead OVA
anime.romaji_title: Kore wa Zombie desu ka? of the Dead: Hai, Minotake ni Attemasu
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Urban Fantasy, Vampire
anime.synopsis: An unaired OVA episode of Kore wa Zombie Desu ka? of the Dead. It is the 11th episode and was bundled with the sixth volume of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received by fans of the series for its comedy and familiar characters. However, it is criticized for not adding anything meaningful to the overall story or providing closure. It's seen as a fun but ultimately inconsequential addition to the franchise.
pros: Great comedy, art, sound, and animation.
Enjoyable return of familiar characters and humor.
Lewdness and nudity add to the enjoyment for some viewers.
cons: Does not contribute to the plot or offer closure.
Lacks story progression compared to previous OVA.
Chris's presence is minimal despite being featured in the poster.

anime.title: This Boy Caught A Merman
anime.synopsis: Shima Kawauchi was taken in by his kind grandfather following the divorce of his unloving parents. His grandfather passes away in due time, leaving Shima all alone. Consumed by grief, he cries by the oceanside at night when an accident causes him to fall into the water. Unable to swim, Shima nearly drowns but is saved by an incredibly handsome merman. Seeing Shima's emotional state, the merman—who Shima names Isaki—insists that Shima take him home until he fully recovers. However, as they settle into their space together, the two start to form a bond that transcends both species and gender.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely in agreement that the anime's standout feature is its breathtaking and unique art style. While many found the emotional core and portrayal of loneliness touching, a significant portion of viewers felt the story and character development were rushed due to the short format of the OVA. Opinions are mildly divided on whether the emotional impact and visual beauty outweigh the narrative shortcomings.
pros: Stunning and unique art style with vibrant colors and detailed textures.
Emotional resonance and touching portrayal of loneliness and connection.
Well-developed main character (Shima) with relatable struggles.
Charming and innocent depiction of developing love, avoiding overly explicit content.
cons: Rushed pacing and underdeveloped plot for a short OVA.
Underdeveloped secondary character (Isaki) and a rushed relationship progression.
Clichéd plot elements common in the shounen-ai genre.
Inconsistent animation quality, with jarring shifts in art style (e.g., chibi moments).

anime.title: High School DxD New
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Mythology, Romance, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
The misadventures of Issei Hyoudou, high school pervert and aspiring Harem King, continue on in High School DxD New. As the members of the Occult Research Club carry out their regular activities, it becomes increasingly obvious that there is something wrong with their Knight, the usually composed and alert Yuuto Kiba. Soon, Issei learns of Kiba's dark, bloody past and its connection to the mysterious Holy Swords. Once the subject of a cruel experiment, Kiba now seeks revenge on all those who wronged him.

With the return of an old enemy, as well as the appearance of two new, Holy Sword-wielding beauties, it isn't long before Issei and his Devil comrades are plunged into a twisted plot once more.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys High School DxD New for its blend of action, comedy, and fan service, though some find the latter excessive. Many appreciate the surprisingly engaging plot and character development, especially compared to other ecchi anime. However, criticisms include predictability and a perceived shallowness in the story for some viewers.
pros: Enjoyable mix of action, comedy, and supernatural elements.
Character development, particularly for Kiba and Akeno.
Engaging plot with surprising twists despite the ecchi focus.
cons: Overabundance of fan service and ecchi content may deter some viewers.
Plot can be predictable at times.
Some may find the story weak or poorly executed.

anime.title: Hey Yo Yorang
anime.synopsis: Yorang, a fox who lives in heaven and has important responsibilities, would rather play tricks on others and seek fun all day. One day, heaven holds a festival for the completion of the "Book of Wishes," a prestigious work that can help remove the black fox's seal. During this festival, Yo-rang, who is very mischievous, throws away the valuable book. Heaven is threatened by the black fox's bad magic. Yo-rang, responsible for the debacle, searches for the book and meets a boy named "Kang-hyun," who loses his mother at an early age and moves to the Fox Village from Seoul, with his father. Kang-hyun and Yo-rang look for the book together. But the black fox tries to ruin their plan, and Kang-hyun and Yo-rang encounter all kinds of hardship. In the end, they develop a strong friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Reviewers cite a nonsensical and poorly paced story, unmemorable characters, and a terrible English dub as major flaws. The rushed ending further exacerbates the negative perception. Overall, the show appears to be widely disliked.
cons: Poor story pacing
Unmemorable characters
Terrible English dub with repetitive sound effects
Rushed and unsatisfactory ending

anime.title: Kuroko's Basketball Specials
anime.genres: Comedy, School, Shounen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: Animated bloopers, based on the extra section of the original manga series, included with the BD/DVD series for Kuroko no Basket (both limited and normal editions).
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the 'Kuroko no Basket NG-shuu' as a lighthearted and funny collection of bloopers. It's seen as a fun way to revisit beloved characters and scenes without requiring a full rewatch of the series. While lacking substantial plot or character development, the shorts are considered a worthwhile addition for fans of the original anime.
pros: Funny and enjoyable bloopers
Good way to revisit characters without rewatching the entire series
Lightens up intense moments of the original anime
Offers new content and parodies of familiar scenes
cons: Lacks character development and plot
Some skits are better than others
Setup for jokes can sometimes be too long
Doesn't expand on the characters

anime.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal II
anime.synopsis:
After defeating a mysterious enemy, Yuuma Tsukumo, along with the help of Kaito Tenjou and Ryouga "Shark" Kamishiro, has thwarted the Barians' plans. However, Yuuma is still on a quest to retrieve the Number Cards to restore Astral's memories. The Seven Barian Emperors catch wind of Yuuma and Astral's endeavors and begin to collect the cards themselves to achieve their ultimate goal: destroying Astral's world in exchange for saving their own.

Though only five of the emperors are present, they unanimously decide on annihilating Astral and Yuuma once and for all. Elsewhere, with their newfound powers of ZEXAL, Astral and Yuuma work to eliminate the enemy force that threatens Earth and the rest of the universe.

Yu☆Gi☆Oh! Zexal Second unveils the mysteries and unpleasant surprises that lie in the wake of Yuuma's adversities. As Astral struggles to accept his past and the consequences it may have brought, will the gods continue to shower their fortune upon Yuuma on yet another perilous adventure?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some find the series childish and poorly written, especially in the early episodes, while others praise the engaging story, morally complex villains, and the character development, particularly Yuma's unwavering optimism. The second season is generally considered an improvement over the first, but overall the series remains divisive among Yu-Gi-Oh! fans.
pros: Engaging story with intriguing plot twists.
Lovable main cast with progressive attachment.
Morally grey villains with understandable backstories.
Yuma's optimism and never-give-up attitude is inspiring.
cons: Pacing and execution issues in the story.
Initial episodes can be cringeworthy.
Kid-friendly nature may not appeal to all viewers.
Stereotyped characters and lame character designs early on.
Forced morals and character traits.

anime.title: Shinkai Densetsu Meremanoid
anime.synopsis: The story takes place in the underwater world of Mer. The army of the kingdom of Bars, until recently peaceful, begins a terrible war against its neighbors: the principality of Moslem and the ancient and glorious kingdom of Agadia. No one can explain how the small kingdom of Bars has reached such a power. In a short time, it manages to challenge much larger and more powerful realms. Meanwhile, two young 'spiritual knights' (Jo and Oz) make a living by killing marine monsters. The population, however, is not very tolerant towards the duo. People fear their powers, seeing them as a potential threat. The pair will unwillingly find themselves fighting the army of Bars, and the forces of darkness that have taken its head...
anime.consensus_summary: Shinkai Densetsu Meremanoid is a visually and aurally appealing anime with a melancholic atmosphere. While the plot and animation quality may be lacking, the strong audio design, voice acting, and dreamy aesthetic create a unique and captivating experience. It is recommended for fans of anime like Wolf's Rain or Devilman Lady who appreciate a more atmospheric and less action-oriented approach.
pros: Superb voice acting, especially Rusmira
Dreamy feel with ethereal colors and hypnotic music
Excellent soundtrack and audio design reminiscent of Demon's Souls OST
cons: Plot is nothing special
Battles are low budget and static
The whole anime is static

anime.title: Date A Live
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Thirty years ago, the Eurasian continent was devastated by a supermassive "spatial quake"—a phenomenon involving space vibrations of unknown origin—resulting in the deaths of over 150 million people. Since then, these quakes have been plaguing the world intermittently, albeit on a lighter scale.

Shidou Itsuka is a seemingly average high school student who lives with his younger sister, Kotori. When an imminent spatial quake threatens the safety of Tengu City, he rushes to save her, only to be caught in the resulting eruption. He discovers a mysterious girl at its source, who is revealed to be a "Spirit," an otherworldly entity whose appearance triggers a spatial quake. Soon after, he becomes embroiled in a skirmish between the girl and the Anti-Spirit Team, a ruthless strike force with the goal of annihilating Spirits.

However, there is a third party that  believes in saving the spirits: "Ratatoskr," which surprisingly is commanded by Shidou's little sister!  Kotori forcibly recruits Shidou after the clash, presenting to him an alternative method of dealing with the danger posed by the Spirits—make them fall in love with him. Now, the fate of the world rests on his dating prowess, as he seeks out Spirits in order to charm them.
anime.consensus_summary: Date A Live is a polarizing anime with some viewers appreciating its unique take on the harem genre and comedic elements, while others criticize it for its reliance on fan service, shallow plot, and lack of character development. The series receives mixed reviews, with some considering it enjoyable and others deeming it a waste of time. Many feel the show has potential but falls short due to its execution.
pros: Intriguing plot despite fan service elements.
Good balance of comedy and plot.
Unique twist on harem/dating theme.
cons: Poor writing and reliance on cheap entertainment.
Unanswered questions and lack of character depth.
Overabundance of fan service overshadowing the story.

anime.title: Brothers Conflict
anime.synopsis:
Ema Hinata is a sweet girl with only her father to call family. One day, she learns that he will be remarrying Miwa Asahina, a wealthy fashion designer. Though she's glad she has a new place to call home, the family she gains is greater than she could ever imagine—Ema now has 13 step-brothers!

Wishing to give her father space, she moves into the Sunrise Residence where her brothers live. As she settles in, Ema realizes she may not experience the loving kinship of a family that she has always longed for, as many of her new brothers exhibit feelings toward Ema that aren't just familial.

With each brother desiring Ema's attention in his own way, will she be able to work toward a happy ending for all, or will she choose one brother that has stolen her heart?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely negative, citing a shallow story, weak characters, and forced romance. Some find it enjoyable as a guilty pleasure due to the attractive art and character designs, but most agree that the plot is unrealistic and the protagonist is bland. The series is considered a typical reverse harem that doesn't offer much beyond superficial entertainment, resulting in a polarizing viewing experience.
pros: Appealing art style and character designs.
Enjoyable as a 'junk food' anime or guilty pleasure.
Distinct personalities of the brothers.
cons: Shallow and unrealistic story.
Weak or non-existent character development, especially for the protagonist.
Protagonist lacks personality and is passive.
Forced and unconvincing romantic development.
Repetitive and predictable plot.
Music is forgettable or cringeworthy.
Too many characters to develop properly in a short series.
anime.thematic_vibe: Reverse Harem, Sibling Rivalry, Unrealistic Romance

anime.title: Kono Naka ni Hitori, Imouto ga Iru!: Ani, Imouto, Koibito
anime.romaji_title: Kono Naka ni Hitori, Imouto ga Iru!: Ani, Imouto, Koibito
anime.synopsis: Unaired 13th episode of the TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views this unaired episode as a step up from the main series, offering some light entertainment and character moments. However, many find it ultimately unnecessary, boring, and lacking in coherent storytelling or proper closure, leaving a sense of disappointment despite its minor improvements.
pros: Works better than the main anime series.
Characters stand on their own.
Art and character designs are decent/above average.
A bit more coherent than the main series.
cons: Lacks continuity and makes little sense.
Very boring, tedious, and annoying to watch.
Unnecessary and feels like filler.
The ending was half acceptable at best.
Plot points and character motivations are nonsensical.
Art is badly lit and aged.
Sound is forgettable.
Story development is weak and rushed.
Does not provide proper closure.

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Link Joker
anime.synopsis:
Several months after the thrilling conclusion of the Asia Circuit Cardfight Vanguard tournament, Aichi Sendou's passion for the popular card game is stronger than ever. However, upon starting high school at the prestigious Miyaji Academy, a private institution that champions academics and sports, he feels disheartened when his classmates dismiss his favorite hobby as immature.

Despite his schoolmates' cold reception—and the student council's unwavering opposition—Aichi finds the resolve to start a cardfight club, creating a safe haven for other cardfighters on campus while fulfilling the academy's extracurricular requirement. Recruiting friends new and old, Aichi and his fellow club members face a series of challenges while striving to have their club recognized by the school.
anime.consensus_summary: The Link Joker season is praised for its character development and darker theme, which enhances the overall viewing experience. Fans appreciate the focus on Aichi's friends and the intense card fights. The season also serves as a decent introduction to the card game mechanics, although it doesn't explicitly guide the viewer through every detail.
pros: Diverse and well-developed cast of characters
Enhanced plot with focus on Aichi's friends
Memorable and intense card fights
New card mechanic introduced
Teaches game rules in early episodes
cons: Anime will not hold your hand in teaching the game

anime.title: Hakkenden -Eight Dogs of the East-
anime.synopsis:
The village of Ootsuka—home to Shino Inuzuka, Sousuke Inukawa, and Hamaji—was lit on fire under the preconception that a virus had seen all of its life eradicated. Now surrounded by flames and on the verge of death, the three were approached by a strange man holding a sword. He tells them that they must reach a decision if they want to live. That night changed everything for these children.

Five years later, the family of three now lives under the watchful eye of the small Imperial Church in a nearby village. All is fine and dandy until the Church attempts to reclaim the demonic sword of Murasame. To accomplish this, they kidnap Hamaji to lure Shino, now a bearer of Murasame's soul, and Sousuke, who possesses the ability to transform into a dog. The brothers must put their differences aside to rescue their beloved sister from the Church in the Imperial Capital, signalling the beginning of a very difficult journey.
anime.consensus_summary: Hakkenden is visually appealing with interesting characters, but its convoluted and slow-moving plot divides viewers. Some appreciate the character-driven narratives and the mix of genres, while others find the lack of a clear central plot and the shounen-ai undertones off-putting. The series requires patience, as it takes several episodes to become engaging.
pros: Beautiful and distinctive art style.
Intriguing character backstories.
Good balance of magical elements, emotional moments, and comedy.
cons: Straying or disconnected central plot.
Slow plot progression, especially in the first season.
Unclear plot elements and confusing curse explanations.
Presence of shounen-ai themes may deter some viewers.

anime.title: Phi Brain: Puzzle of God 3
anime.romaji_title: Phi Brain: Kami no Puzzle - Shukuteki! Rätsel-hen
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Mystery, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
"Are puzzles really necessary in this world?"

In order to restore Jin's memory, Kaito and his friends go on a puzzle-viewing journey to England. As they're walking through the underground maze beneath the church, where young Kaito and Rook first met Jin, a mysterious girl appears in front of them.

Jin calls the girl by the name "Raetsel". It seems they know each other. However, she suddenly disappears and takes Jin with her. What's more, the traps in the underground maze are activated and start coming after Kaito and his friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience enjoys the puzzle-solving aspect and the increasing difficulty of the challenges. The story's twists and turns are appreciated. Overall, the sentiment leans towards positive with no signs of controversy.
pros: Story gets renewed with twists.
Plot things get leveled up.
Adversaries are different.

anime.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!: Chuni-Shorts
anime.romaji_title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Lite
anime.synopsis: Short episodes aired on KyoAni's official YouTube channel.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly views Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Lite as a highly entertaining and hilarious bonus for fans of the main series. While it offers little in terms of plot, its comedic timing, charming characters, and signature Kyoto Animation art style are consistently praised, making it a delightful, albeit non-essential, watch.
pros: Hilarious and entertaining comedy that exceeds the main series for some.
Glorious animation and art style characteristic of Kyoto Animation.
Characters are enjoyable and well-portrayed, offering fun interactions.
Short, bite-sized episodes are perfect for quick entertainment.
Provides a delightful 'cherry on top' for fans of the main series.
cons: Minimal story or plot progression.
Best enjoyed after watching the main series; difficult to enjoy standalone.
Can be 'cringy' at times.
Episodes are not connected, making random viewing possible but potentially less impactful.

anime.title: Nekomonogatari Black
anime.synopsis:
After surviving a vampire attack, Koyomi Araragi notices that his friend and savior, Tsubasa Hanekawa, has been acting strange. When he happens to cross paths with her on his way to a bookstore and sees she has a bandage on her face, he knows something must definitely be wrong. Araragi wants to help her, but Hanekawa assures him that her wound is just something she received at home and that he should not concern himself with it. But when a white cat with no tail is hit and killed by a car, the pair bury the creature and the real trouble begins.

When Araragi later pays a visit to his friend Meme Oshino and recounts the day's events, he is informed what they have buried is actually an apparition, one perfect for Hanekawa in her current state. Tasked with finding his friend to confirm her safety, he discovers that she has attacked her parents, possessed by the "Sawari Neko." Now, it is up to Araragi to help Hanekawa as she once helped him.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed Nekomonogatari: Kuro as a prequel that deepens Hanekawa's character.  Fans of the Monogatari series appreciated its art, sound, and story, while some found the fan service and comedy to be hit or miss. Most agree that while not essential to the main storyline, it is a worthwhile addition for series enthusiasts.
pros: Detailed exploration of Tsubasa Hanekawa's character and backstory.
Strong art style and sound design, consistent with the Monogatari series.
Well-paced and enjoyable story that enhances the overall Monogatari experience.
cons: Some viewers found the fanservice excessive or unnecessary.
The comedy is sometimes minimal or cheesy.
The storyline isn't strictly necessary to understand the main series.

anime.title: Nyaruko: Crawling With Love! Second Season
anime.synopsis: Nyaruko still wants Mahiro, as does Hasuta. Kūko wants Nyaruko, but believes both Nyaruko's and Mahiro's "first time" belongs to her. Yoriko puts up with all of it and cheerfully runs the house where they all live. Mahiro just wants some sanity. He doesn't want to be the love toy of a Nyarlathotepan, Cthughan, or a shots-like Hasturan. He may or may not hold out.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers find the show hilarious and entertaining due to its parodies, references, and absurd comedy, while others are bored or annoyed by the lack of plot, overused tropes, and minimal character development. The show is best enjoyed if viewers are familiar with anime and pop culture references and don't expect a serious or original story.
pros: Entertaining and fun if you don't expect a serious plot.
Humorous references and parodies of other anime and pop culture.
Fast-paced slapstick comedy delivered expressively.
Nyaruko's over-the-top personality is enjoyable for many.
cons: Lacks a meaningful or well-developed plot.
Relies heavily on harem and ecchi tropes.
Character development is minimal.
Humor can be repetitive or fall flat.
Mahiro is irritable and rude.

anime.title: Nagareboshi Lens Specials
anime.synopsis: Three episodes aired on TV as part of the Ribon x Oha Suta specials.
anime.consensus_summary: The Nagareboshi Lens Specials are considered a poor adaptation and primarily serve as an advertisement for the manga. Viewers found the lack of animation and the uninteresting portrayal of characters disappointing. Only dedicated fans of the series might find some enjoyment, while others are advised to avoid it.
pros: Nice artwork
cons: Feels like screenshots.
No movement in scenes, only transitions.
Boring and uninteresting characters.
Just a recap with no added value.
Waste of time for non-fans.

anime.title: Aesthetica of a Rogue Hero Specials
anime.romaji_title: Hagure Yuusha no Aesthetica: Hajirai Ippai
anime.synopsis: DVD/BD Specials
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is split, with a clear division between those who appreciate the unashamedly explicit fanservice and high production values, and those who find the complete lack of story and character development to be a fatal flaw. While the ecchi elements are acknowledged as well-executed, the overall package is seen as a shallow, albeit visually appealing, experience.
pros: High-quality visuals (9/10)
Strong voice acting performances across the board (9/10)
Self-aware acknowledgment of its own absurdity
cons: No discernible story or character development
Relies solely on fanservice, leading to mediocrity
Short episode length feels cheap

anime.title: Tamayura: More Aggressive
anime.synopsis:
The second season of Tamayura: Hitotose.

It's the beginning of a new school year for Fuu and friends. With a new year comes new challenges as Fuu tries to open a photography club at her school.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Tamayura: More Aggressive' for its continuation of the heartwarming story and character development. While some find the pacing slow, the overall sentiment is positive, appreciating the 'fuwa fuwa' feeling and exploration of themes like friendship and coming to terms with loss. The introduction of new characters and the focus on Potte's growth are well-received.
pros: Consistent character development from the first season.
Engaging episodic storytelling with character growth.
Heartwarming and feel-good atmosphere ("fuwa fuwa")
cons: Inconsistent character development (contradictory review).
Languid pacing might not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Senyuu.
anime.synopsis:
Once upon a time, the demon lord Rchimedes spread terror throughout the world, until he was eventually sealed away by the legendary hero Creasion. Since then, a thousand years have passed peacefully. However, a mysterious hole has opened up between the demon and human spheres, and countless demons have surged into the human realm once more. Coming to the conclusion that Rchimedes would soon return to wreak havoc, a human king summons the possible descendants of the legendary hero—all 75 of them. Unfortunately, after so long, it was too difficult to pinpoint his true descendants. 

Among the lionhearted prospects is the amateur adventurer Alba Frühling. His skills may not be top-notch, but he is accompanied by the talented soldier Ross, who helps the young hero whenever he is in a pinch...or at least, he is supposed to. Though undoubtedly a skilled warrior, Ross is actually both sarcastic and sadistic, and hence revels in Alba's suffering. 

Senyuu. is a comedic adventure following the unlikely duo as they struggle in their endeavor to defeat the demon lord, meeting various eccentrics along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Senyuu for its short, comedic episodes and unique characters, particularly praising the humor and parody elements. The main criticisms revolve around the brevity of the episodes and the lack of deep story development. Most agree it's a fun, lighthearted watch, especially for fans of parody and RPG-themed content.
pros: Unique and funny characters with great chemistry.
Fast-paced, witty humor and parodies.
Creative use of art and animation to enhance comedy.
Enjoyable and catchy opening sequences.
cons: Very short episodes with significant time taken up by opening and ending credits.
Lack of significant story development.
Some generic or unoriginal elements.
Inconsistent or unmemorable background music.

anime.title: Saint☆Young Men (Movie)
anime.synopsis: After thousands of years of hard work, Jesus Christ and Gautama Buddha decide that they have earned a vacation and descend from the heavens to rent a small apartment in Tokyo, Japan. As the pair struggles to live incognito, they enjoy the luxuries of modern society, such as amusement parks, and limited-time store sales. Jesus and Buddha take the time to celebrate each other's holidays, watch the changing of the seasons, and explore their new surroundings.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys the light-hearted and wholesome nature of Saint☆Oniisan. The unique concept of Jesus and Buddha vacationing in Japan is praised for its charm and ability to bring different faiths together. While some find the humor and plot lacking, the movie is generally considered an enjoyable and heartwarming experience.
pros: Unique and charming concept
Good-natured humor and heartwarming
Art style and animation are unique and lively
Brings people of different faiths together in a positive way
cons: Story can be fragmented and lacking a clear plot
Comedy can be hit or miss, with some jokes falling flat
Some viewers found it slow-paced or boring
Potential for humor not fully realized

anime.title: Saint☆Young Men
anime.synopsis: Jesus Christ and Gautama Buddha, the founders of Christianity and Buddhism, are living together as roommates in a Tokyo apartment while taking a vacation on Earth. The comedy often involves jokes about Christianity, Buddhism, and all things related, as well as the main characters' attempts to hide their identities and understand modern society in Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive due to the show's unique and lighthearted premise. Some find the comedy hit-or-miss, and the short length is a common criticism. However, many appreciate the wholesome nature and clever use of religious themes.
pros: Unique and hilarious concept of Jesus and Buddha as roommates.
Wholesome and enjoyable, suitable for family viewing.
Good art style, colorful and whimsical.
Excellent sound design, upbeat soundtrack, and voice acting.
Clever use of religious jokes and their divine abilities in modern setting.
cons: Comedy can fall flat for some viewers.
Jokes can become stale and predictable.
Show may be too short to be truly memorable.
Some religious references may be missed by some viewers.

anime.title: Puchimas!: Petit iDOLM@STER Episode 0
anime.synopsis: Episode 0 of the anime adaptation of Puchimas! -Petit iDOLM@STER- manga, bundled with the December 2012 issue of Dengeki Maou magazine.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is generally perceived as a cute and quick introduction to the chibi versions of the characters. While considered fluff content, the short runtime and anticipated slapstick comedy make it an easy watch for fans of the iDOLM@STER series. There's little controversy surrounding it, with most acknowledging its purpose as a lighthearted spinoff.
pros: Introduction of chibi characters is engaging.
Quick and easy to watch.
Anticipation of slapstick comedy.
cons: Extra fluff content with no ties to the main series.
May be skipped by most people.

anime.title: Symphogear G
anime.synopsis:
Three months after a Lunar Attack which nearly caused Earth's destruction, Hibiki Tachibana, Tsubasa Kazanari, and Chris Yukine continue to fight the Noise—a mysterious alien threat—using powerful armor known as Symphogear. After defending an American convoy from a Noise attack, Hibiki and Chris race toward the Queens of Music concert hall to attend one of Tsubasa's concerts.  

Meanwhile, Tsubasa and rising international superstar Maria Cadenzavna Eve deliver an amazing performance that is broadcast throughout the entire world. Just as the concert is about to conclude, a group of Noise suddenly appear, plunging the hall into chaos. Amidst the panic, Maria declares war against the world as the successor of Finé—Chris' former mistress—and her allies Kirika Akatsuki and Shirabe Tsukuyomi reveal Symphogear powers of their own. After initiating a skirmish with Tsubasa and her teammates, they retreat mysteriously, leaving the three friends bewildered as to what their true intentions could be.
anime.consensus_summary: Symphogear G is a significant improvement over the first season, with better animation, music, and a more focused plot. While the story can still be absurd and illogical, the show's strengths lie in its high-energy action sequences and memorable characters. The audience generally enjoys the show for its entertainment value, despite its flaws.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to the first season.
Catchy and well-integrated music.
More streamlined and engaging plot than the first season.
Compelling new characters and villains.
cons: Plot can still be confusing and reliant on deus ex machina.
World-building and explanations are lacking.
Some find the story nonsensical and over-the-top.

anime.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer!
anime.synopsis:
Striking fear into the hearts of mortals, the Demon Lord Satan begins to conquer the land of Ente Isla with his vast demon armies. However, while embarking on this brutal quest to take over the continent, his efforts are foiled by the hero Emilia, forcing Satan to make his swift retreat through a dimensional portal only to land in the human world. Along with his loyal general Alsiel, the demon finds himself stranded in modern-day Tokyo and vows to return and complete his subjugation of Ente Isla—that is, if they can find a way back!

Powerless in a world without magic, Satan assumes the guise of a human named Sadao Maou and begins working at MgRonald's—a local fast-food restaurant—to make ends meet. He soon realizes that his goal of conquering Ente Isla is just not enough as he grows determined to climb the corporate ladder and become the ruler of Earth, one satisfied customer at a time!

Whether it's part-time work, household chores, or simply trying to pay the rent on time, Hataraku Maou-sama! presents a hilarious view of the most mundane aspects of everyday life, all through the eyes of a hapless demon lord.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Hataraku Maou-sama!' for its unique premise and comedic execution, finding it a delightful and light-hearted watch. However, some viewers criticize the show for its inconsistent plot, pacing issues, and a lack of balance between comedy and action. Despite its flaws, the series is mostly well-received for its humor and characters.
pros: Unique premise of a demon lord working in a fast-food restaurant.
Well-executed comedic timing and humorous situations.
Likeable characters with good screen time.
Enjoyable and light-hearted.
cons: Inconsistent plot and pacing.
Missed opportunities for comedy and action balance.
Unresolved plot elements.

anime.title: Girls und Panzer OVA
anime.synopsis: Mini episodes bundled with Blu-rays and DVDs.
anime.consensus_summary: The Girls und Panzer Specials are generally considered enjoyable for fans of the main series, offering lighthearted side stories and additional content. However, many viewers find the specials to be of lower quality than the main show, with an overabundance of fan service. Some episodes are praised for providing interesting background information, while others are dismissed as filler.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the main series
Offers side stories and expansions on the main storyline
Some episodes provide interesting background information
cons: Specials are not as good as the main show
Overreliance on fan service
Some episodes are unremarkable or filler
anime.thematic_vibe: Fan Service, Slice of Life, Military

anime.title: Magical Sisters Yoyo & Nene
anime.romaji_title: Majokko Shimai no Yoyo to Nene
anime.synopsis:
Based on a manga "Noroiya Shimai" written by Hirarin and serialized in Monthly Comic Ryuu. 

It is a story about a pair of sisters who work as "noroiya" (cursers) using magic in a fantasy world. One day a big tree suddenly appears in a forest, and tall buildings that look like they are from our world can be seen entangled in it. The two sisters go there to investigate and get ported to our world. They then encounter two children who are startled by the sisters' sudden appearance and rush back home but at home they see their parents turned into monsters...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive towards 'Majokko Shimai no Yoyo to Nene,' praising its visuals and characters. However, some find the story predictable and the character development lacking depth. Overall, it's considered an enjoyable magical adventure, especially for those seeking a lighthearted anime film.
pros: Visually appealing animation with rich colors and fluid movements.
Unique and likeable characters with strong teamwork.
Enjoyable and compelling story with moments of tension and lightheartedness.
cons: Story can be predictable with deus ex machina elements.
Relationships between characters can feel shallow and forced.
Discrepancies between the synopsis and the actual plot.

anime.title: Majestic Prince
anime.synopsis: In the latter half of 21st century, humans leave the Earth and begin to live in space. In order to adapt to the environment in space and deal with the hostile aliens in Jupiter, genetically engineered children called "Princes" are artificially raised and trained to be pilots of armed robots "AHSMB (Advanced High Standard Multipurpose Battle Device). This is a story about one of the teenage "Princes," Hitachi O Izuru, who studies in an academic city Grandzehle.
anime.consensus_summary: Majestic Prince is a visually appealing mecha anime that delivers on action but suffers from a generic plot and underdeveloped characters. While some appreciate its straightforward approach and cool mecha designs, others find it predictable and lacking in depth. The series improves in later episodes but fails to leave a lasting impression for many viewers.
pros: Cool mecha designs and action sequences.
Decent story progression with some emotional stakes later on.
Enjoyable for those seeking straightforward mecha action without excessive emotional depth.
cons: Generic and predictable plot with stereotypical characters.
Slow start with lack of action in early episodes.
Limited character development, especially for the main cast.
Wonky science and plot holes.

anime.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions! Depth of Field: Love and Hate Theater
anime.romaji_title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Depth of Field: Ai to Nikushimi Gekijou
anime.synopsis: Specials bundled with the first season's BD/DVD volumes that displays a mech fight between Rikka Takanashi and Sanae Dekomori.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed these specials as a bonus for existing fans, particularly praising the high-quality animation and the creative blend of genres. However, the pacing and structure, with repetitive introductions and outros across short segments, were noted as drawbacks that detracted from the overall experience for some viewers.
pros: Stunning animation and fluid mecha movements, characteristic of KyoAni's high production values.
The blend of mecha fantasy with the familiar Slice of Life/School Life style was appreciated.
Enjoyable for existing fans of the main Chuunibyou series.
cons: The segmented format with repetitive intros/outros felt like unnecessary padding.
The story itself was considered fine but not particularly special.
Might not be as enjoyable for viewers unfamiliar with the main series.

anime.title: Fantasista Doll
anime.synopsis: Uzume Uno is a young student and former champion of a trading card game competition. She is trusted with a special device containing five powerful Fantasista Dolls. These dolls are sentient virtual beings who reside in cards which are now controlled by their new master, Uzume.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some viewers find the anime enjoyable due to its cute aesthetics, focus on friendship, and touching moments, while others criticize its predictable plot, inconsistent animation, and poorly explained battle system. The show seems to appeal more to fans of the shoujo, moe, and magical girl genres, while others may find it generic or uninspired.
pros: Cute art style and character designs
Enjoyable music and voice acting
Touching moments and focus on friendship
cons: Predictable and cliché plot
Inconsistent animation quality
Poorly explained battle system
Uncanny valley between tragedy and light drama

anime.title: Zekkyou Gakkyuu
anime.synopsis: Three episodes aired on TV as part of the Ribon x Oha Suta specials.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the anime interesting and spooky, but feels like it's ultimately an advertisement for the manga due to its short length and rushed pacing. The art and sound design are considered basic and could be improved. Overall, viewers are left wanting a full adaptation of the manga.
pros: Interesting horror themed stories
Effective at generating interest in the manga
Fun ideas and story concepts
cons: Feels like an advertisement for the manga
Rushed pacing robs stories of full potential
Basic sound design
Art is flat and could be darker

anime.title: Yuyushiki
anime.synopsis:
Yui Ichii, Yuzuko Nonohara, and Yukari Hinata form a peculiar friend group; even though each girl is eccentric in their own way, they get along. Now entering high school, the friends are looking forward to the next few years together while also wanting to be a part of something bigger. When they stumble across the data processing club without any members and in danger of disbanding, they immediately decide to join it.

As the club's newest members, Yui, Yuzuko, and Yukari spend their time doing wordplays, teasing each other, and using computers to search for topics to have amusing conversations about. The girls' daily lives never get dull as they enjoy their time at school to the fullest.
anime.consensus_summary: Yuyushiki is a feel-good slice-of-life anime that prioritizes character interactions and comedic moments over a complex plot. While some find the premise unoriginal and the jokes occasionally miss the mark, many appreciate the show's ability to create a relaxing and enjoyable experience through its characters' quirky charm and contagious laughter. It's a show that doesn't take itself seriously, aiming to bring simple joy to its viewers.
pros: Good character dynamics and interactions
Contagious laughter and fun
Relaxing and enjoyable to watch
Unique individuality of characters despite common archetypes
cons: Premise and jokes can be unfunny and unoriginal
Plot is simple and sometimes non-existent
Repetitive nature of the show with little environmental variation
Overused character types

anime.title: Magical Hat
anime.synopsis: The series stars Hat, the descendant of a hero who fought an evil king and sealed Devildom. Hat falls into Devildom and finds he has to defeat the evil king.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a fun, lighthearted adventure aimed at kids, with silly humor and memorable moments. While the animation and music are dated, the core story and comedic elements are enjoyable. The show is generally positively received as a good after-school program for children.
pros: Good laugh with some memorable moments
Fun items get summoned or transformed
Funny looking animallike creatures and kidfriendly monsters
Villains outwitted in funny ways
cons: Animation could be better; some segments look cheaper and duller
Music sounds like a very cheap early 80's cave recordings
Singing sounded mediocre
Parents of Hat disappear and are never seen again

anime.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's SEcret Gadget Meseum
anime.romaji_title: Doraemon Movie 33: Nobita no Himitsu Dougu Museum
anime.synopsis: On a normal afternoon, Doraemon's bell was stolen by Kaito Deluxe, a thief from the 22nd Century. Determined to get it back, Nobita and co. decides to pursue him and take back the bell that is hidden inside the 22nd Century's Secret Gadget Museum.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience seems to have a positive reception to the movie. The mystery aspect and character dynamics are well-received, with some minor criticisms regarding initial story development and music. The film successfully blends adventure with heartwarming moments, making it enjoyable for a wide audience.
pros: Good animation style with detailed backgrounds.
Enjoyable mystery-themed storyline with fun moments.
Well-written characters and effective use of gadgets.
Uplifting vibe and comical elements.
cons: Story wasn't that special initially.
Some parts were confusing for those unfamiliar with the original series.
Music was ok but forgettable.

anime.title: Carnival Phantasm: HibiChika Special
anime.synopsis: A new episode of Carnival Phantasm released on the Type-moon Fes - 10th Anniversary Event - Blu-ray.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Carnival Phantasm: HibiChika Special' is well-received, particularly for the addition of new characters and an alternate storyline. Some familiarity with the source material is helpful, but the special is generally enjoyable. The audience consensus is positive, deeming it a worthwhile addition to the Carnival Phantasm series.
pros: Inclusion of Hibiki and Chikagi adds a new dynamic
Second half of the episode showing the other route for the original finale was better than the original
Enjoyable and worth watching
cons: Familiarity with Type-Moon visual novels recommended to understand all references

anime.title: Nurarihyon no Mago OVA
anime.synopsis: The story begins at about 100 years after the disappearance of Otome Yamabuki, Rihan Nura's first wife. Rihan has finally pulled himself together and his life returns to normal. As the head of the Nura Clan, he's busy working on building a harmonious world for humans and youkais. One day, he sees Setsura being upset so he decides to cheer her up by taking the clan to go enjoy the hot spring where Setsura makes up her mind to tell Rihan that she met Otome once after she left him about 100 years ago. She tells him the message that Otome left for him and the truth is...?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the OVA for its exploration of the past, the balance of emotional and comedic elements, and fan-service. Viewers appreciate the glimpse into Rihan's history and relationships. The light-hearted and nostalgic feel of the OVA is well-received.
pros: Explores the past of a main character, Rihan Nura, adding depth to his story.
Balances sadness and comedy effectively.
Features fan-service elements like the onsen scene.

anime.title: Kokoro Connect OVA
anime.synopsis: Not long after putting the previous supernatural incident behind them, the members of Yamaboshi Academy's Student Cultural Society (StuCS) must deal with Fuusenkazura's newest trial—emotion transmission. This phenomenon allows the club members to hear each others' true thoughts, but with one catch: the timing, sender, and recipient are all completely random. To make matters worse, the club's supervisor, Ryuuzen Gotou, may have to step down due to his responsibilities for the upcoming school year. With emotions running high and Valentine's Day around the corner, the seemingly close bonds of the StuCS will be tested when their true feelings for each other are laid bare.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on *Kokoro Connect: Michi Random* are divided. Some viewers appreciate the emotional depth and character development, finding the conclusion satisfying and the exploration of themes like identity and friendship compelling. However, others criticize the forced drama, repetitive plot, and lack of resolution, resulting in a polarized reception with many considering it a mediocre or even disappointing addition to the series.
pros: Emotionally developed characters
Exploration of complex themes like identity and connection
Satisfying closure to the series
Focus on character flaws and overcoming them
Good life lessons
cons: Forced drama
Repetitive plot structure focusing on Iori's problems
Melodramatic and unrealistic conflicts
Lack of character development for some
Unresolved plot points
anime.thematic_vibe: Emotional Turmoil, Identity Crisis, Friendship Bonds

anime.title: Unlimited Psychic Squad
anime.romaji_title: Zettai Karen Children: The Unlimited - Hyoubu Kyousuke
anime.synopsis: Kyousuke Hyoubu, an ESPer who was betrayed many years ago, is now one of the most powerful ESPers—and also a fugitive. However, behind that glare lies a kind heart. His main mission is to save ESPers who are mistreated by humans, even if that be by force. Through his methods, he has saved many ESPer lives and gained the loyalty of those he has saved. The name of his group: P.A.N.D.R.A.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is generally well-received as a darker and more mature spin-off of Zettai Karen Children, with praise for its animation, music, and the complex character of Hyoubu Kyousuke. Some criticism is directed toward pacing issues, underdeveloped side characters, and a rushed ending. Overall, viewers appreciate the morally grey narrative and action-packed sequences, making it a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre.
pros: Strong animation and visual style, particularly during esper power displays.
Well-executed music and voice acting, enhancing the series' atmosphere.
Intriguing story exploring the conflict between espers and humans with morally grey characters.
Hyoubu Kyousuke is a compelling anti-hero protagonist with a mysterious past.
cons: Pacing issues, especially with flashbacks interrupting the main storyline.
Underdeveloped supporting characters.
Ending felt rushed and somewhat unsatisfying.
Humor and some script elements are too reliant on manga-logic.

anime.title: Sunday Without God
anime.synopsis:
God has abandoned the world. As a result, life cannot end nor can new life be born, and the "dead" walk restlessly among the living. Granting one last miracle before turning away forever, God created "gravekeepers," mystical beings capable of putting the dead to rest through a proper burial. Ai, a cheerful but naïve young girl, serves as her village's gravekeeper in place of her late mother.

One day, a man known as Hampnie Hambart, who is supposedly Ai's father, arrives and kills all the people in her village. Having lost her village and with no plans for the future, Ai decides to accompany the mysterious man on his journey. As she travels the land, the young gravekeeper strives to fulfill her duties, granting peace to the dead and assisting the living, while at the same time learning more about the world that God left in this tragic state.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally appreciative of the anime's artistic and auditory qualities, as well as its engaging characters and emotional depth. However, many reviewers express disappointment with the rushed pacing, underdeveloped plot lines, and inconsistencies in the story. While the premise is intriguing, the execution leaves much to be desired, resulting in a somewhat unsatisfying experience for a significant portion of viewers.
pros: Beautiful and consistent art style enhances the emotional impact.
Excellent soundtrack and voice acting create a strong atmosphere.
Compelling and diverse characters with unique ideologies.
Well-executed emotional scenes and moments.
Interesting premise exploring themes of death, purpose, and faith in a world abandoned by God.
cons: Rushed pacing leads to underdeveloped characters and plot lines.
Multiple story arcs crammed into a short timeframe result in superficial exploration of themes.
Inconsistencies and plot holes detract from the story's coherence.
Uneven character development, with some characters discarded too quickly.
Over-reliance on plot convenience and Deus Ex Machina.
Series tries to jam too much into a short timeframe.
The ending leaves many questions unanswered and feels unsatisfying for some viewers.

anime.title: Tokyo Ravens
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Onmyoudou magic was once a powerful technique used by the Japanese during the second World War in order for them to gain the upper hand and establish their nation as a formidable force. But Japan was quickly defeated after the revered onmyouji Yakou Tsuchimikado caused the "Great Spiritual Disaster," an event which plagues Tokyo to this very day. As a result of this mishap, the Onmyou Agency was established in order to exorcise further spiritual disasters and combat the demons that would make their way into the world.

Now, Onmyoudou has become far more modern, simplified, and refined for use in a wide variety of applications such as medicine and technology. However, not everyone is able to utilize the magic, as is the case with Harutora, a member of the Tsuchimikado's branch family. Despite an old promise to protect Natsume, the heir of the Tsuchimikado's main family and Yakou's supposed reincarnation, as her familiar, Harutora has no talent and chooses to live a normal life instead.
