But when a prominent member of the Onmyou Agency attempts to recreate the same experiment which led to Japan's downfall, he decides to make good on his word and fight by Natsume's side.
anime.consensus_summary: Tokyo Ravens is a generally enjoyable but not groundbreaking anime. Many find the initial episodes generic, but the plot picks up in the second half with more action and engaging twists. While the story has flaws, the pacing, lore, and mix of genres provide enough entertainment to make it worth watching for fans of the genre.
pros: Solid pacing and well-realized background/lore.
Enjoyable mix of magic, fantasy, and action with plot twists.
Story becomes deeper and more unique after a slow start, with engaging twists.
cons: Generic premise and predictable plot twists.
Story can be halfheartedly explained, leaving plot holes and overcomplicating events.
Initial lack of originality in character and story; some characters remain stagnant.
First half is slow and school-life trope heavy.

anime.title: Greek Roman Sinhwa: Olympus Guardian
anime.synopsis: The animated form of the Korean manhwa.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the anime as an introductory educational tool for Greek mythology, especially for younger viewers. While the art style and simplified storytelling are noted as drawbacks, the familiar characters and accessible narrative are appreciated. The lack of controversial or polarized opinions suggests a generally positive, albeit mild, reception.
pros: Good introduction to Greek mythology for a younger audience
Characters are well known and engaging
Enjoyable and informative
cons: Art style is not the best
Watered down version of the myths
Omission of darker aspects of Greek mythology

anime.title: Karneval
anime.synopsis:
While in search of his precious friend, a young boy named Nai falls captive to a beautiful woman, whose looks are matched only by her taste for human flesh. Meanwhile Gareki, a clever thief, is in the midst of robbing her luxurious home. After causing a distraction, Gareki agrees to help Nai escape, but they are discovered upon the woman's return. As she transforms into a ghoulish monster, the boys flee.

On the run, Nai and Gareki are found by "Circus," a government defense agency that deals with criminal activity too difficult for the police to handle and protects civilians from "varuga"—terrible monsters that devour humans for sustenance. In the hope that it will lead Nai to his missing friend, he and Gareki decide to join Circus. On their perilous journey, they face dangerous varuga and begin to uncover the secrets behind a shadowy organization known as Kafka.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. Many appreciate the show's unique visuals, animation, and character designs, while others are frustrated by the confusing and unresolved plot. The series is seen as having potential but ultimately fails to deliver a satisfying story, leaving viewers wanting more.
pros: Visually stunning and unique art style.
Well-developed characters with solid interactions.
Beautiful animation with bright colors and a distinct look.
cons: Plot is confusing and lacks resolution.
Story feels incomplete and leaves many questions unanswered.
Inconsistent and unsatisfying exposition.

anime.title: A Certain Scientific Railgun S
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Mikoto Misaka and her friends are back, investigating rumors across Academy City. Soon, Mikoto discovers something terrifying: horrific experiments are taking place throughout the city, involving the murder of thousands of espers. Moreover, these espers are far from just ordinary people: they are clones of Mikoto herself. Feeling responsible for their treatment, she sets off to put an end to the experiments; however, the forces opposing her are much more dangerous than she anticipated, and Mikoto finds herself up against some of the most powerful espers imaginable.

Toaru Kagaku no Railgun S continues the story of the Railgun as she desperately fights to put an end to the inhuman experiments that she believes she helped cause, her life dragged deep into despair in the process. There's never a dull moment in Academy City, but no one ever said all of them would be pleasant.
anime.consensus_summary: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun S is well-received, particularly for its darker and more emotional Sisters arc, which many consider a significant improvement over the first season. While some criticize the pacing and filler, the exploration of ethical themes and character development are generally praised. The audience consensus points towards a strong, engaging narrative that deepens the lore.
pros: Intensely gripping plotline, especially the Sisters arc
Significant improvement in quality compared to the first season
Exploration of human values and ethical dilemmas
Excellent storytelling and character development, particularly Misaka's
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the Sisters arc adaptation
Instances of trite and dull filler scenes
Uneven quality between the Sisters arc and the Silent Party arc
Occasional annoying fanservice

anime.title: A Lull in the Sea
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Love Polygon, Romance, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Long ago, all humans lived beneath the sea. However, some people preferred the surface and abandoned living underwater permanently. As a consequence, they were stripped of their god-given protection called "Ena" which allowed them to breathe underwater. Over time, the rift between the denizens of the sea and of the surface widened, although contact between the two peoples still existed.

Nagi no Asu kara follows the story of Hikari Sakishima and Manaka Mukaido, along with their childhood friends Chisaki Hiradaira and Kaname Isaki, who are forced to leave the sea and attend a school on the surface. There, the group also meets Tsumugu Kihara, a fellow student and fisherman who loves the sea.

Hikari and his friends' lives are bound to change as they have to deal with the deep-seated hatred and discrimination between the people of sea and of the surface, the storms in their personal lives, as well as an impending tempest which may spell doom for all who dwell on the surface.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is strongly divided. Many viewers praise the show's beautiful art, music, and initial slice-of-life charm, while others criticize its contrived romantic drama, nonsensical plot developments, and unlikeable characters. The latter half of the series seems to be particularly divisive, with some finding it traumatizing and a departure from the earlier positive aspects.
pros: Beautiful and unique art style with vibrant colors, especially the turquoise color scheme for sea characters.
Well-paced character and plot development.
Compelling drama stemming from the unique setting and characters.
Excellent soundtrack with memorable openings and endings.
cons: Romantic drama is overdone.
Plot is nonsensical, skipping over important world-building elements and failing to explore the setting.
Characters are unrealistic and unlikeable, especially the overly dramatic teenagers.
Ending devolves into degeneracy, including time skips, kids, and incestuous themes.
Series becomes traumatizing and horrendous towards the end.
Unexplained mechanics of the sea village.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Drama, Slice of Life, Fantasy

anime.title: Sword Art Offline
anime.romaji_title: Sword Art Online: Sword Art Offline
anime.synopsis: BD/DVD specials.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided, with many finding Sword Art Offline to be an uninspired and repetitive filler that fails to entertain. However, a segment of dedicated fans appreciates the self-aware humor and trivia, finding it a lighthearted bonus to the main series, though even they acknowledge its dispensable nature.
pros: The trivia sections and occasional bits of foreshadowing for future content offer some value to dedicated fans.
The voice acting is praised for bringing life to the episodes and sometimes salvaging weak jokes.
The chibi art style, while not universally liked, is considered cute and fits the bonus content nature.
Some viewers found it more enjoyable than the original anime due to its self-aware humor.
cons: The humor is largely considered unfunny, repetitive, and overly reliant on romance and harem tropes.
The show offers no new material or substantial plot development, functioning primarily as a recap or filler.
The chibi art style and limited emotional range of characters are criticized.
The format can become tiring and predictable, with many viewers finding it dispensable and a waste of time.

anime.title: Saki: The Nationals
anime.genres: School, Seinen, Slice of Life, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis: Saki Miyanaga, along with the rest of Kiyosumi High School's mahjong team, proceeds to the national level of the Interhigh Mahjong Championship. However, reaching the top will prove difficult as she faces opponents on par with and, quite possibly, exceeding her skills. Even so, she refuses to back down, vowing to stop at nothing to fulfill her goal: to see her sister face-to-face once more.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While many appreciate the improved visuals, intense matches, and character backstories, there's disappointment over the lack of focus on the main characters and incomplete ending. Some viewers also find the assumption of prior mahjong knowledge a barrier to entry. Overall, fans of the first season are likely to enjoy it, but newcomers may struggle to connect with the story.
pros: Improved visuals and character designs compared to the prequel.
Intense mahjong matches with creative strategies and unpredictable outcomes.
Well-developed backstories for supporting characters, adding emotional depth.
Successfully captures the energy and anticipation of high-stakes competition.
cons: Lack of focus on the main characters, hindering their growth and development.
Assumes prior knowledge of mahjong rules, potentially alienating new viewers.
Overuse of flashbacks detracts from mahjong gameplay footage.
Ending feels incomplete, teasing a continuation that may never happen.

anime.title: Hyperdimension Neptunia
anime.synopsis:
After years of fruitless war between the four realms of Gamindustri (Planeptune, Lastation, Lowee and Leanbox) over Share energy, the source of their strength based on how much their people have faith in their goddesses, the four CPUs that rule over them have finally signed a friendship treaty. The treaty bans any attempt at claiming Share energy through military force, in hopes of bringing peace and prosperity to their worlds. Yet, a month after the treaty, Neptune, the CPU Goddess of Planeptune, spends her time goofing off and playing games rather than doing her job, leaving her land's Shares plummeting.

Choujigen Game Neptune The Animation follows Neptune and her friends' attempts at raising Shares, while dealing with an external threat that could spell the end of both the Goddesses and Gamindustri itself...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided based on familiarity with the Hyperdimension Neptunia game series. Fans of the games generally enjoy the anime for its faithful character portrayals and comedic moments, while newcomers may find the story rushed, confusing, and reliant on fan service. The anime's light-hearted tone and parody elements are appreciated by some, but others criticize its lack of depth and originality.
pros: Faithful character portrayals to the games.
Good comedic moments and light-hearted aesthetic.
Catchy opening and ending songs.
Enjoyable for fans of the video game series.
cons: Rushed story that combines multiple game plots, leading to a watered-down experience.
Uneven pacing and inconsistent tone, jumping between serious and silly moments.
Neglect of side characters in favor of popular ones.
Over-reliance on fan service and moe tropes may alienate some viewers.
Lack of depth and originality, with clichéd characters and plot points.
Inaccessibility for newcomers, as it assumes prior knowledge of the games.

anime.title: Ai-Mai-Mi
anime.synopsis: Eccentric high school manga club members Ai, Mai, and Mii all share the same dream: to become brilliant artists. Despite wanting to improve their drawing skills, the girls are often derailed by absurd situations involving intricate jokes, animals, and supernatural encounters. Joined by their upperclassman Ponoka, the girls fill their days with hijinks and never suffer a dull moment.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the show hilarious and enjoyable due to its randomness and parody elements, while others are turned off by the lack of plot and inconsistent animation. The humor is a major point of contention, with some appreciating its absurdity and others finding it nonsensical. Overall, it's seen as a short, lighthearted watch that's not meant to be taken seriously.
pros: Unique and varied art style enhances the comedic effect.
Catchy and enjoyable ending credit song.
Successfully delivers humor through unexpected and bizarre situations.
cons: Inconsistent or non-existent plot makes it hard to follow.
Animation quality is often poor and inconsistent.
Humor is very hit-or-miss and may not appeal to everyone.
Characters lack depth and development.

anime.title: Flowers of Evil
anime.genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, School, Shounen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Takao Kasuga, a high school student fascinated by poetry, reveres Charles Baudelaire and even decorates his room with the poet's portrait. On a normal day, Takao forgets his copy of The Flowers of Evil in the classroom. When returning to retrieve it, he steals the sports garments of Nanako Saeki—a model student who Takao calls his muse and a femme fatale.

Deeply ashamed of his act which he sees as a sin and what others see as a crime, Takao realizes with horror that Sawa Nakamura, his classmate and social outcast, knows about his theft. Blackmailed by her, Takao is now forced to partake in Sawa's disturbing fantasies, lest she reveals his deeds to everyone. Caught in a negative spiral of increasingly traumatic experiences, will Takao be able to break free from Sawa's thorns and atone for his sins?
anime.consensus_summary: Aku no Hana is a highly divisive anime due to its rotoscoping animation style, which some find immersive and others find off-putting. While the story is praised for its dark themes and psychological depth, the slow pacing and unlikable characters are major points of criticism. The series explores themes of isolation and rebellion, but its controversial execution has polarized viewers.
pros: Unique rotoscoping animation style enhances immersion and realism for some viewers.
Compelling and disturbing storyline that captivates and disturbs, exploring dark themes.
Effective portrayal of teenage angst, isolation, and the struggles of adolescence.
The soundtrack and sound design enhances the unsettling atmosphere
cons: Rotoscoping animation is heavily criticized for its unnatural look and poor lip-syncing.
Pacing is slow, with scenes often drawn out and uneventful.
Unlikable characters make it difficult to connect with the story.
Lack of emotional expression from characters detracts from the psychological impact for some viewers.

anime.title: Bakumatsu Gijinden Roman
anime.synopsis: The stage is the close of the Edo period, an age when, not unlike our own time, both natural and man-made disasters left chaos in their wake. Manjiro makes a living helping the people of the troubled capital city, but behind the scenes, he also works in secret to take back precious belongings stolen from the people by unjust political powers and conspiratorial menaces. The people call him "Get-backer Roman."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in the show's comedic and character-driven aspects, while others criticize its unoriginal story and poor execution. The Lupin III-esque style is a draw for some, but the pachinko game origins create initial skepticism. Ultimately, it doesn't elicit strong polarizing opinions.
pros: Distinct and exaggerated characters that are endearing
Comedic tone with underlying darker themes
Art style reminiscent of Lupin III, appealing to fans of Monkey Punch
cons: Unoriginal story, derivative of other shows like Lupin III
Poor execution of plot, particularly after the initial episodes
Based on a pachinko game, lowering initial expectations

anime.title: Yowai Mushi
anime.synopsis: Another clip from Tekken, denouncing the intimidation experienced by certain Japanese.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is split, with some deeply moved by the short's emotional impact and message of empathy in the face of bullying and hardship. Others find the animation unappealing and the narrative too simplistic, even labeling it a waste of time. However, the overall consensus leans towards the short film being a potent, albeit potentially disturbing, exploration of human weakness and the cycle of abuse.
pros: Meaningful message about overcoming adversity.
Powerful emotional impact and tear-inducing storytelling.
Relaxing and appropriate music.
Simple but beautiful message.
cons: Animation style might not appeal to everyone.
Story is not particularly original.
May be an awful waste of time

anime.title: One Piece: Episode of Luffy - Adventure on Hand Island
anime.romaji_title: One Piece: Episode of Luffy - Hand Island no Bouken
anime.synopsis: The story of the Hand Island no Bouken special is set a little before the events of One Piece Film Z and depicts a major "Hand Island" incident during the New World storyline. The story is set at "Cannon Town" where a parent and a child work as craftspeople. The incident revolves around them and a commodore of a marine base. The special will also have a flashback scene to the story in the first chapter of the manga, but with new animation.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed "One Piece: Episode of Luffy - Hand Island no Bouken," particularly the amusing plot, enjoyable flashbacks, and familiar characters. Some found the story basic and the art quality inconsistent compared to the main anime series. Overall, it's seen as a worthwhile addition for fans of One Piece, especially for the nostalgia and insights into Luffy's past.
pros: Enjoyable episode with the Straw Hats.
Amusing plot from beginning to end.
Flashbacks are enjoyable and provide new insights.
Soundtrack is amazing as usual.
Characters are funny and the same as always.
cons: Story is a little basic.
Art is not as good as in the anime, characters sometimes look flat and weird.
A few useless characters in the special.

anime.title: You're Being Summoned, Azazel Z
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Mythology, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: The second season of Yondemasu yo, Azazel-san.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Yondemasu yo, Azazel-san. Z delivers more of the same vulgar and comedic antics as the first season, but with increased intensity. Some viewers appreciate the upgraded humor and unexpected twists, while others find the content offensive or feel it falls short of the original. Audience reception is somewhat divided due to the show's crass nature.
pros: More antics and problems needed to be solved.
Sudden twists in events.
Upgraded vulgarity and crass compared to the first season.
cons: Some may find the content offensive due to casual rape mentions, gore, and other mature themes.
The second season fell short compared to the first season for some viewers.

anime.title: Acchi Kocchi: Place=Princess
anime.synopsis: Episode 13 of Acchi Kocchi that was included in Vol.6.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Acchi Kocchi: Place=Princess' enjoyable if they liked the main anime, appreciating its cuteness and lightheartedness. However, some find it lacking in depth, substance, and originality, with predictable humor and unremarkable characters. The episode seems to be a bonus for existing fans rather than a strong standalone piece.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the main anime series.
Cute and heartwarming moments.
cons: Lacks depth and personality in characters.
Predictable and tired humor.
Story lacks substance.
Art, Sound, and Story are not the best, focus is on cuteness.

anime.title: Ishida and Asakura
anime.synopsis: High School isn't easy, especially for Asakura, who is struggling to graduate. Luckily for him, he has lots of friends who are willing to go the extra mile. Asakura is obsessed with female anatomy, which frustrates his other classmates! One classmate wants them to run a flower shop together, while another one wants to run a bookstore with him! With everyone vying for his complete attention, will Asakura ever graduate!?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the show's absurdist humor and self-aware parody enjoyable, while others find it to be lowbrow and lacking substance. Some appreciate its consistency for a short comedy, but others are turned off by the bland characters and random plot. Overall, it's a polarizing show that depends on individual preferences for over-the-top, nonsensical comedy.
pros: Quick and easy to watch
Consistent plot for a short comedy anime
Self-aware and parodies anime tropes
Outrageous and funny
cons: Lowbrow humor may not appeal to everyone
Characters feel empty and bland
Parody isn't always effective
Random and weird, lacking a cohesive story

anime.title: Usavich V
anime.synopsis: The fifth season of Usavich.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience expresses boredom and disappointment with Usavich V.  Viewers find the plot shallow and the ending unsatisfying. The lack of meaningful moral lessons further diminishes the experience, resulting in a generally negative reception.
cons: Boredom due to repetitive battles.
Lack of plot depth compared to other anime.
Unsatisfying ending with no clear resolution.
Weak or absent moral lessons.

anime.title: Love Lab
anime.synopsis:
At Fujisaki Girls Academy, student council president Natsuo Maki is the epitome of grace and perfection, admired by all the young girls who attend the school. One day, Riko Kurahashi walks into the student council room on an errand, only to discover Natsuo practicing her kissing techniques on a pillow, an act that is neither graceful nor elegant. Riko soon discovers that Natsuo desires more romance in her life, leading her to practice "romantic situations" in secret.

Sympathizing with her, Riko agrees to help Natsuo with her love research. Named "Love Lab," the project practices the essentials of love and romance, such as bumping into each other "accidentally" and holding hands. Soon, the entire student council joins in on the fun in the Love Lab too! Through their research and real life encounters, what will they learn about romance?

Weaving together funny characters and comedic situations, Love Lab builds a story of friendship and romance, while never missing a beat with the laughter.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Love Lab' is well-received as a funny and heartwarming slice-of-life anime, mainly focusing on friendship. While some find the occasional drama out of place, the consensus is that the show excels in its comedic timing and character interactions. Most viewers recommend it for its lighthearted nature and positive messages, specifically highlighting that it is not a yuri.
pros: Well-executed comedic timing and gags.
Strong emphasis on the value of friendship and positive relationships.
Characters are unique, likable, and well-developed, making them relatable.
Story has a satisfying ending.
Good mix of episodic and story arcs.
Excellent voice acting enhances the comedy.
The show is not yuri.
cons: Drama feels forced and unnecessary at times, conflicting with the comedic focus.
Some characters are underutilized or fall into typical anime archetypes.
Occasional animation quality dips and generic art style.
Story can be predictable and lacks significant depth.
Soundtrack is largely forgettable.

anime.title: The Severing Crime Edge
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Gore, High Stakes Game, Romance, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Kiri Haimura has an obsession with beautiful hair—specifically, cutting it. This bizarre trait is what leads him to seek out a rumored long-haired ghost who lives in an abandoned house on a hill. However, he finds not a ghost, but a beautiful girl with long flowing hair named Iwai Mushanokouji, the "Hair Queen," whose hair cannot be cut due to a family curse.

Iwai explains that there is a death game surrounding her, and that if she is killed by a cursed object, aptly named a "Killing Good," the wielder gets their wish granted. After protecting Iwai from "Authors"—Killing Goods users—he learns there is in fact a Killing Good passed down in his own family: a pair of scissors used by his ancestor to commit murders. Naming the scissors "The Severing Crime Edge," he finds that he is able to cut Iwai's cursed hair with them, setting her free to live a normal life. However, many Authors seek to kill the Hair Queen, and Kiri will have to protect her in this lethal game of fate.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some enjoyed the unique concept, gothic atmosphere, and entertaining fight scenes. However, many found the plot poorly executed, the characters underdeveloped, and the overuse of fan service detracted from the overall experience. The series is considered a flawed but potentially enjoyable watch for those who can tolerate its issues.
pros: Interesting concept and original story
Some found the art style, animation, and music created a great atmosphere
Enjoyable fight scenes
cons: Poorly executed plot with rushed and vague points
Inconsistent tone, switching between dark and light
Overuse of fan service and sexual innuendos
Underdeveloped and unlikable characters

anime.title: Dog Days''
anime.synopsis:
Cinque Izumi, Nanami Takatsuki, and Rebecca Anderson must once again embark on a journey to the continent of Flonyard and participate in the friendly war games of the three allied nations: Biscotti Republic, Galette, and Pastilage. Cinque is Biscotti’s hero, who also happens to be the cousin of Galette’s hero Nanami. Rebecca is Pastillage’s hero and a dear friend of Cinque.

Dog Days'' begins in the human world. Rebecca prepares her things for her journey back to Pastilage from Japan. Meanwhile, Cinque and Nanami set out to travel to Biscotti and Galette, respectively, all the way from England, when suddenly, a freakish streak of bad luck—in the form of lightning, of course—sends them off course. They soon find themselves in the great Dragon Forest, protected by a Dragon Priestess named Sharu. The Dragon Priestess informs them that demons threaten to invade the forest, as well as the whole continent of Flonyard!

It looks like a real war is about to begin in Dog Days''. Can these three heroes save the whole continent from these evil beings?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Dog Days'' is mixed. While the series maintains its visually appealing world and easy-to-watch format, many feel the plot is rushed and lacks depth compared to the first season. Character development is minimal, and the addition of new characters sometimes detracts from the established cast, leaving some fans disappointed with the overall narrative quality.
pros: Visually appealing world of Flonyard
Enjoyable and easy to watch
Good music and sound design in some instances
cons: Plot feels rushed and lacks depth
Characters show minimal development
Inconsistent storytelling with episodic elements that fall flat
Over-reliance on fan service
New characters not well-integrated, diluting the importance of existing ones

anime.title: SKET Dance: Imouto no Nayami ni Nayamu Ani ni Nayamu Imouto to Sono Nakama-tachi
anime.romaji_title: SKET Dance: Imouto no Nayami ni Nayamu Ani ni Nayamu Imouto to Sono Nakama-tachi
anime.synopsis:
An OVA of SKET Dance bundled with the 29th volume of the manga, covering chapters 198, 199, and 200.

This is a conclusion of some of the events shown in the last episode of the anime series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the OVA, especially those familiar with the original manga and anime series. It's seen as a fun and lighthearted return to the characters and their problem-solving antics, despite some criticism regarding the episode's plot and overly long title. The emotional signature is positive, driven by the comedic and heartwarming elements.
pros: Entertaining
Faithful to the original manga
Fun
cons: Title is too long
Case lacks a real basis

anime.title: Photo Kano
anime.synopsis:
High school student Kazuya Maeda finds his daily life dull and meaningless. This changes right before the end of his summer break when he receives an old camera from his father. Initially hesitant, Kazuya decides to experiment with photography and starts looking for potential models for his pictures.

Kazuya is approached by various girls willing to model for him: Haruka Niimi, his popular childhood friend; Nonoka Masaki, the athletic ace pitcher of the softball club; Aki Muroto, the Student Council president; Hikari Sanehara, a fellow photography enthusiast; Tomoe Misumi, his timid classmate; Rina Yunoki, the only member of the Cooking Research Society; and Mai Sakura, a friend of his sister.

As he pursues his new hobby, Kazuya feels like every day becomes more vibrant and meaningful. However, his continued interactions with the girls lead him to wonder if they want to be involved in other areas of his life besides his photography.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many criticizing the rushed pacing and shallow character development due to the omnibus format. While some appreciate the happy endings and character designs, the consensus is that the anime fails to deliver a compelling romance due to its weak plot and overuse of fan service. The series is generally considered average, with wasted potential.
pros: Omnibus format allows for multiple romantic developments without disputes.
Some viewers found the character designs cute and appealing.
The music and opening theme were considered suitable and enjoyable by some.
The photography element, although underutilized, provided a unique angle.
Provides happy endings for all the heroines.
cons: The omnibus format leads to rushed and underdeveloped character arcs.
Many found the plot dry, predictable, and lacking in depth.
Characters were often seen as generic, stereotypical, and lacking substance.
Fan service elements were excessive and distracting for some viewers.
The art and animation were considered lackluster and inconsistent by some.
Uneven allocation of episode to different heroines.

anime.title: Boku no Imouto wa "Osaka Okan"
anime.synopsis: Kyousuke Ishihara is an average high school student residing in Tokyo. Recently, his younger sister, Namika, has moved back home after living in Osaka for 10 years. As Kyousuke tries to understand his sister's peculiar behavior and dialect, the two bond over their differences and the difficulties that come with change.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception is mixed. Viewers appreciate the show's humor and insight into Osaka culture, but are significantly let down by the poor animation quality and lack of story depth. It's considered a light and enjoyable short series if one can overlook its flaws, particularly the animation.
pros: Humorous exploration of Osaka stereotypes
Likable characters, especially the sister
Good for quick, lighthearted viewing
Educational about Osaka culture
cons: Poor animation quality
Repetitive intro sequence
Weak or nonexistent story
Underdeveloped characters
Jokes may not land for non-Japanese viewers
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Cultural Stereotypes

anime.title: Tamako Market
anime.synopsis:
Inside the Usagiyama Shopping District lies an eccentric but close-knit community of business owners. Tamako Kitashirakawa, a clumsy though adorable teenage girl, belongs to a family of mochi bakers who own a quaint shop called Tama-ya. One day, Tamako stumbles upon a talking bird that presents himself as royalty from a distant land. Dera Mochimazzi, as he calls himself, states that he’s seeking a bride for his country’s prince. Intent on his mission, Dera follows Tamako home and develops an addiction to mochi, becoming painfully overweight and subsequently unable to fly back to his homeland; thus, he takes up residence with Tamako's family and becomes the community’s beloved mascot.

Meanwhile, Tamako's friend, Mochizou Ooji, continues to hide his true feelings for her. Their fathers are fierce mochi rivals, but will it be enough to drive a wedge between Tamako and Mochizou? And just what will happen to Dera's task of finding his prince’s destined bride?
anime.consensus_summary: Tamako Market is generally viewed as a pleasant and visually appealing slice-of-life anime, praised for its cute characters and cozy atmosphere. However, many find the series lacking in substantial plot and character development, leading to a somewhat shallow experience. The reliance on 'cuteness' is a point of contention, with some appreciating it and others finding it insufficient to compensate for the lack of depth.
pros: High production quality and animation by Kyoto Animation.
Charming and warm atmosphere.
Likable and wholesome characters.
cons: Weak or non-existent plot and character development.
Bland dialogue and jokes.
Overreliance on cuteness can overshadow substance.

anime.title: Glitter Force Doki Doki
anime.synopsis:
Middle schooler Mana Aida is known for her vivid passion and kind-hearted disposition, especially by her friends Rikka Hishikawa and Alice Yotsuba. While the girls are on a school field trip, otherworldly villains from the "Trump Kingdom" appear and create giant monsters from the civilians' selfish desires to cause havoc. 

In the midst of finding a way to stop the destruction, Mana encounters "Cure Sword," a mysterious Precure warrior. As Cure Sword engages in combat with the monsters, Mana meets Cure Sword's fairy allies, who tell her that she also has the ability to transform into a warrior herself. When Trump Kingdom's invaders begin to outnumber Cure Sword, Mana takes to the battleground with resolve. She partners with Sharuru, one of the fairies, and transforms into "Cure Heart"—the Precure of Love. 

In her attempts to ally with Cure Sword, Mana ends up pulling Rikka and Alice into the fray, whom each partner with a fairy ally to transform into "Cure Diamond" and "Cure Rosetta," respectively. Together, they battle against the Trump Kingdom invaders to protect the love in the world from being destroyed.
anime.consensus_summary: DokiDoki! Precure is a divisive season. While some appreciate its plot-focused approach, relevant themes, and likeable moments, many criticize its poorly developed characters, especially the overpowered main character, and its weak animation and plot holes. The introduction of new characters mid-season and the overall lack of character development are major points of contention, leading to a polarized audience sentiment.
pros: Plot has twists and turns.
Exploration of relevant themes like selfishness, conflicting friendships, separation, and brainwashing.
Some characters are likeable and interact perfectly with one another.
High-quality artwork and animation.
Effective use of music.
Good general soundtrack.
Villains are well handled, not being portrayed as outright evil but more as inconsiderate jerks
Story advances in a quick pace
cons: Poorly developed characters, especially Cure Sword, Diamond, and Rosetta.
Main character (Mana/Cure Heart) is an overpowered Mary Sue with no flaws or growth.
Random introduction of new characters (Regina, Cure Ace) with poor integration into the plot.
Weak fighting animation quality.
Bland stock footage and transformations.
Plot holes and unexplained elements.
Filler episodes towards the end that are annoying and focus on the worst character (Ai).
Repetitive and forgettable OST.
Lack of creativity, resorting to clichés and repetitiveness.
Uneven animation budget

anime.title: Precure All Stars Movie New Stage 2: Kokoro no Tomodachi
anime.romaji_title: Precure All Stars Movie New Stage 2: Kokoro no Tomodachi
anime.synopsis: One day, the Pretty Cures receive an invitation to a party in their honor. Everyone is heading to the party venue, the school of fairies, but awaits a mysterious shadow. The shadow steals transformation objects! What can they do? If the Cures can not be converted are in big trouble! If this continues, the school, our world and everything else will deborado by that shadow! The 32 Pretty Cures will fight to protect everyone!
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is viewed as a decent attempt to introduce new elements and depth to the Precure All Stars formula, although its reliance on certain cliches and deviations from action-oriented plots might not appeal to all fans. The focus on fairy characters and the exploration of themes such as friendship and self-discovery are seen as positive aspects.
pros: Focus on fairy characters provides a unique perspective.
The villain's motivations are well-developed and relatable.
Movie attempts to add substance beyond typical action sequences.
cons: Cliche plot devices, such as 'Stupid Kid Syndrome'.
The All-Stars format can overshadow the core story.
Some viewers may dislike the shift away from epic fights.

anime.title: Problem Children Are Coming from Another World, Aren't They? OVA
anime.romaji_title: Mondaiji-tachi ga Isekai kara Kuru Sou desu yo?: Onsen Manyuuki
anime.synopsis:
Izayoi, Asuka, and You have been invited to participate in a Gift-Game at a hot spring village to help the small community there find a new water source.

OVA bundled with the eighth volume of the light novel.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding the OVA to be a dispensable fan service vehicle rather than a narrative-driven episode. While some appreciate it as a lighthearted extra that showcases character personalities and retains the main series' charm, others are disappointed by the overwhelming focus on fan service at the expense of plot and the overall tone, feeling it strays too far from the original premise.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the main series looking for lighthearted content.
Highlights character quirks and personalities.
Retains the charm of the main series' opening and ending themes.
Provides a fun, albeit brief, continuation for fans of the characters.
cons: Overreliance on fan service detracts from narrative and plot.
Lacks the suspenseful, comedic feel of the main series.
Contains absurd and out-of-place perverted scenes.
Stock villains and static animation are noticeable, suggesting budget issues.
New characters are forgettable.
Story and plot are weak and lack objectives.
Deviates significantly from the main anime's premise.

anime.title: Attack on Titan
anime.genres: Action, Award Winning, Drama, Gore, Military, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Centuries ago, mankind was slaughtered to near extinction by monstrous humanoid creatures called Titans, forcing humans to hide in fear behind enormous concentric walls. What makes these giants truly terrifying is that their taste for human flesh is not born out of hunger but what appears to be out of pleasure. To ensure their survival, the remnants of humanity began living within defensive barriers, resulting in one hundred years without a single titan encounter. However, that fragile calm is soon shattered when a colossal Titan manages to breach the supposedly impregnable outer wall, reigniting the fight for survival against the man-eating abominations.

After witnessing a horrific personal loss at the hands of the invading creatures, Eren Yeager dedicates his life to their eradication by enlisting into the Survey Corps, an elite military unit that combats the merciless humanoids outside the protection of the walls. Eren, his adopted sister Mikasa Ackerman, and his childhood friend Armin Arlert join the brutal war against the Titans and race to discover a way of defeating them before the last walls are breached.
anime.consensus_summary: Shingeki no Kyojin is widely praised for its gripping story, intense action, and unique premise, making it a gateway anime for many. However, some find the plot predictable and the pacing uneven, with underdeveloped themes and questionable character decisions detracting from the overall experience. Despite criticisms, the series remains highly popular and influential within the anime community.
pros: Captivating story with high stakes
Intense and gripping action sequences
Unique premise and world-building
Strong character development
Emotional and dramatic depth
cons: Pacing issues in some episodes
Predictable plot developments
Unexplored themes and underdeveloped setting
Overreliance on coincidences
Questionable character decisions affecting story credibility

anime.title: Ebiten: Kouritsu Ebisugawa Koukou Tenmonbu Specials
anime.romaji_title: Ebiten: Kouritsu Ebisugawa Koukou Tenmonbu Specials
anime.synopsis: BD/DVD specials.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, largely dependent on tolerance for and appreciation of heavy fanservice. Some find the characters and humor enjoyable, while others are critical of the over-the-top ecchi content. Familiarity with the original series may enhance the viewing experience, but is not necessarily required for entertainment.
pros: Characters are funny and entertaining.
Appeals to viewers who enjoy ecchi content.
cons: Excessive fanservice may be off-putting to some viewers.
Story quality is questionable, especially for those unfamiliar with the original series.
Content approaches hentai-levels of exposure.

anime.title: Devil Survivor 2 The Animation
anime.synopsis:
The countdown to extinction begins on Sunday with the arrival of the Septentriones, otherworldly invaders set on the eradication of mankind. Caught in the crossfire, Hibiki Kuze and his friends join in the war for humanity's survival by signing contracts with demons to become "Devil Summoners." Soon, their abilities attract the attention of JP's, an underground agency led by Yamato Houtsuin. Once recruited into JP's, Hibiki and his friends fight and bond alongside other ordinary citizens who are Devil Summoners. 

However, with each new day, another Septentrione appears to wreak havoc upon Japan. Even if many lives are lost in the process, before that night ends, the young summoners must defeat the invaders at all costs.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception is mixed to negative, with many criticizing the rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and generic plot. While some appreciated the art style and soundtrack, the majority found the anime to be a disappointing adaptation that failed to capture the essence of the original game. The series is often described as bland, uninspired, and ultimately forgettable.
pros: Appealing art style and animation quality.
Enjoyable soundtrack with catchy opening and ending themes.
Some found the initial premise and setup intriguing.
Yamato's character is well-developed and interesting.
cons: Rushed pacing and weak narrative structure.
Underdeveloped and bland characters with little to no emotional investment.
Generic and clichéd plot elements, borrowing heavily from other series.
Poor world-building and lack of explanation for key plot points.
Disappointing adaptation of the source material, failing to capture the depth and strategy of the game.

anime.title: Arata: The Legend
anime.synopsis:
As a young boy from a noble family in Amawakuni, Arata has always expected to make life his own—until word of the princess growing weak reaches his city. Unbeknown to him, his grandmother had claimed him to be female at birth, and now, with no other girls to succeed the princess from the matriarchal Hime clan, he is next in line for the throne! Disguised as a woman awaiting a replacement to be found, Arata witnesses an assassination attempt on the princess by none other than her own guard, the 12 Shinsho. The crime is pinned on his head, forcing Arata to escape to the Kando forest, where it is said that no one comes out the same.

Meanwhile, in modern-day Japan, Arata Hinohara longs for escape from the cruelty of his classmates. Hearing his name called from an alley, he wanders from his path and unwittingly switches universes with Arata from Amawakuni. With his own power as a newly awakened "Sho"—a warrior able to wield Hayagami, weapons with the power of the gods—and the help of his companions he meets along his journey, Hinohara sets out to restore order to this new world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some viewers appreciate the unique concept, character interactions, and enjoyability, many are critical of the forced conflicts, weak character motivations, and poor adaptation. The anime is considered a disappointment by those who have read the manga, and the animation quality declines in later episodes.
pros: Unique premise of two people switching worlds.
Good character development for some characters.
Enjoyable character interactions and relationships.
Some found the fantasy elements and world-building believable.
cons: Forced conflicts and unrealistic character reactions.
Slow story progression and dull fight scenes.
Generic art style and lacking animation quality.
Underdeveloped or annoying main characters.
Weak villain motivation and execution.
Poor adaptation of the manga, cutting out important plot points and characters.
Pacing issues; the anime tries to cram too much content in limited episodes.

anime.title: Gargantia on the Verdurous Planet
anime.synopsis:
In the distant future, a majority of humans have left the Earth, and the Galactic Alliance of Humanity is founded to guide exploration and ensure the prosperity of mankind. However, a significant threat arises in the form of strange creatures called Hideauze, resulting in an interstellar war to prevent humanity's extinction. Armed with Chamber, an autonomous robot, 16-year-old lieutenant Ledo of the Galactic Alliance joins the battle against the monsters. In an unfortunate turn of events, Ledo loses control during the battle and is cast out to the far reaches of space, crash-landing on a waterlogged Earth.

On the blue planet, Gargantia—a large fleet of scavenger ships—comes across Chamber and retrieves it from the ocean, thinking they have salvaged something of value. Mistaking their actions for hostility, Ledo sneaks aboard and takes a young messenger girl named Amy hostage, only to realize that the residents of Gargantia are not as dangerous as he had believed. Faced with uncertainty, and unable to communicate with his comrades in space, Ledo attempts to get his bearings and acclimate to a new lifestyle. But his peaceful days are about to be short-lived, as there is more to this ocean-covered planet than meets the eye.
anime.consensus_summary: Suisei no Gargantia starts with a promising premise, beautiful visuals, and an optimistic tone, but ultimately fails to deliver on its potential due to inconsistent characterization, plot development, and forced darker elements. The audience is polarized, with some appreciating the initial uplifting themes and others criticizing the poor execution and wasted potential. While not a complete failure, the show is seen as a disappointment by many.
pros: Beautiful visuals and animation by Production I.G.
Interesting premise with thought-provoking concepts.
Uplifting and optimistic tone, especially in the first half.
cons: Inconsistent characterization and plot development.
Second half introduces darker elements in a clunky and forceful manner.
Fails to live up to its potential, becoming a meandering ordeal.
Bad writing and awkward, fickle characters.
Relies on fanservice, filler, shock factor, and deus ex machinas.
Potential is squandered.

anime.title: Hal
anime.synopsis:
Kurumi is a beautiful young woman whose beloved boyfriend, Hal, died in a sudden airplane accident. Left heartbroken and gloomy, she isolates herself in a small house. But this soon comes to change when her grandfather requests the help of a humanoid robot named Q01.

Taking on the appearance of Hal, Q01 is sent to Kurumi's house in order to save her from her state of despair. As Hal returns day after day and increases his efforts, Kurumi, despite her initial reluctance, slowly begins to open up to him and break free from her depression. But there is more to Hal than meets the eye, and these two will soon learn an unexpected truth about this relationship between a human and an android.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Hal' are mixed. While some praise its beautiful visuals, emotional depth, and exploration of grief and recovery, others criticize its rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and questionable plot twists. The film is considered a decent watch, but not without its flaws, leading to a moderately polarized response.
pros: Beautiful art and animation, especially the scenery and character design.
Touching story with emotional depth, exploring themes of loss and healing.
Well-chosen voice actors that effectively convey the characters' feelings.
cons: Rushed pacing that fails to develop characters and emotions adequately.
Plot twists that detract from the story and character development.
Inaccurate cubing scenes that trigger cubers.

anime.title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! Zexal Second: Midokoro Tenkomori Special
anime.romaji_title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! Zexal Second: Midokoro Tenkomori Special
anime.synopsis: Recap of first 8 episodes of the second season, narrated by Yuma and Astral.
anime.consensus_summary: The reviewer expresses strong disappointment with the show, particularly criticizing the character and plot development. They make unfavorable comparisons to previous series, indicating a negative reception to this installment. Overall, the review suggests a sense of betrayal of the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise.
cons: Poor character building
Poor plot development
Bad battle monsters

anime.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
anime.romaji_title: Danganronpa: Kibou no Gakuen to Zetsubou no Koukousei The Animation
anime.genres: High Stakes Game, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, School, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Makoto Naegi, a teenager with no remarkable talent, is surprised to learn that he has been accepted into Hope's Peak Private Academy: an elite school that gathers the best students from various fields. Despite believing his admission was just a fluke, Naegi is delighted to attend an institution known for ensuring success to those who graduate. Determined, he enters the front doors of the prestigious academy.

However, after losing consciousness inside, Naegi wakes up in a seemingly abandoned classroom. Failing to comprehend how he got there, Naegi begins to explore, and to his surprise, finds his classmates assembled in the gym. While everyone is trying to figure out what happened, they are confronted by the school principal—Monokuma, a robotic teddy bear. The mysterious toy explains that the freshmen are trapped inside the school with only one means of escape—kill a classmate without being discovered.

Tension fills the air as Naegi and his classmates realize that they are faced with two choices: participate in Monokuma's killing game, or reside together in the school for the rest of their lives.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Danganronpa is a divisive topic. While some appreciate the unique character designs, soundtrack, and intriguing premise, many find the rushed pacing and lack of character development detrimental to the overall experience. Fans of the game are often disappointed, while newcomers may find it a mediocre murder mystery. The consensus leans towards the anime being a flawed adaptation that fails to capture the depth and impact of the original game.
pros: Unique character designs that reflect their talents.
Catchy and mood-setting soundtrack, especially during key revelations.
Well-done voice acting, particularly Monokuma's.
cons: Rushed pacing due to trying to fit too much content into too few episodes.
Lack of character development, making it difficult to connect with characters and diminishing the impact of deaths.
Subpar animation quality with noticeable stills and inconsistent quality.
Overuse of 'despair' dialogue.

anime.title: The Wind Rises
anime.synopsis:
Although Jirou Horikoshi's nearsightedness prevents him from ever becoming a pilot, he leaves his hometown to study aeronautical engineering at Tokyo Imperial University for one simple purpose: to design and build planes just like his hero, Italian aircraft pioneer Giovanni Battista Caproni. His arrival in the capital coincides with the Great Kanto Earthquake of 1923, during which he saves a maid serving the family of a young girl named Naoko Satomi; this disastrous event marks the beginning of over two decades of social unrest and malaise leading up to Japan's eventual surrender in World War II.

For Jirou, the years leading up to the production of his infamous Mitsubishi A6M Zero fighter aircraft will test every fiber of his being. His many travels and life experiences only urge him onward⁠—even as he realizes both the role of his creations in the war and the harsh realities of his personal life. As time marches on, he must confront an impossible question: at what cost does he chase his beautiful dream?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is mixed, with many appreciating the film's artistic merit and emotional depth, while others find it unfocused and thematically problematic. Some appreciate the mature themes, while others see it as romanticizing a controversial historical period. The film is considered a beautiful but flawed swan song for Miyazaki.
pros: Stunning animation and detailed scenery, characteristic of Studio Ghibli.
Engaging story that blends historical elements with imaginative storytelling.
Beautiful music score that enhances the emotional impact.
cons: Pacing issues due to trying to cover too much of the protagonist's life in a limited time.
Lack of focus, with the movie trying to balance too many aspects (childhood, earthquake, career, love life).
Underdeveloped secondary characters, such as the wife, making it difficult to connect with them emotionally.

anime.title: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
anime.synopsis:
Deep in the countryside, a man named Okina works as a bamboo cutter in a forest, chopping away at the hollow plants day after day. One day, he discovers a small baby inside a glowing shoot. He immediately takes her home, convinced that she is a princess sent to Earth as a divine blessing from heaven. Okina and his wife Ouna take it upon themselves to raise the infant as their own, watching over her as she quickly grows into an energetic young girl. Given the name Kaguya, she fits right in with the village she has come to call home, going on adventures with the other children and enjoying what youth has to offer.

But when Okina finds a large fortune of gold and treasure in the forest, Kaguya's life is completely changed. Believing this to be yet another gift from heaven, he takes it upon himself to turn his daughter into a real princess using the wealth he has just obtained, relocating the family to a mansion in the capital. As she leaves her friends behind to enter into an unwanted life of royalty, Kaguya's origins and purpose slowly come to light.
anime.consensus_summary: "The Tale of the Princess Kaguya" is largely praised for its stunning visuals, emotional depth, and faithfulness to the source material. While some find the pacing slow or the art style unusual, the majority of viewers appreciate the film's artistic merit and poignant exploration of its themes. The film is considered a beautiful and thought-provoking adaptation of a classic Japanese folktale.
pros: Visually stunning watercolor-like animation style.
Immersive music and sound design that transports viewers to 10th century Japan.
Faithful adaptation of the folktale with expanded, subtly dramatic elements.
Emotionally resonant portrayal of characters, especially Kaguya's internal struggles.
Thought-provoking social commentary on tradition and female independence.
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers.
Art style may be off-putting to some.
Some found the ending unsatisfying or confusing.
Pointless love interest weakens Kaguya's character.
Overly sentimental or melodramatic at times.

anime.title: Valvrave the Liberator
anime.synopsis:
In the 71st year of the True Era, humans have successfully expanded into space and have started living in independent galactic colonies. The world itself is split between two major nations: the Atlantic Rim United States (ARUS) and the Dorssia Military Pact Federation (Dorssia)—superpowers that wage war against each other on Earth and far into outer space. In this war-torn era, a third faction comprised of Japan and Islands of the Oceanian Republic (JIOR), reside peacefully and prosper economically, maintaining neutrality between themselves and their militant neighbors.

Kakumeiki Valvrave commences in an outer space JIOR colony, where 17-year-old Haruto Tokishima's peaceful life is turned upside down as a sudden Dorssian fleet breaches the neutral colony. Their objective is to seize the Valvraves: powerful, but rumored mechanized weapons hidden deep within Haruto's school, Sakimori Academy. In the ensuing chaos, Haruto stumbles upon one of the targeted Valvraves. With his friends' lives in peril, Haruto enters the mecha and seals a contract for its power in exchange for his humanity. With the aid of L-elf—an enigmatic Dorssian agent and gifted strategist—Haruto and the Valvrave initiate a revolution to liberate the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided. While some appreciate the show's over-the-top nature and visual appeal, many criticize it for its generic story, shallow characters, and reliance on shock value over substance. The series is often described as 'so bad it's good', but this sentiment is not universally shared.
pros: Visually appealing mecha designs and animation quality.
Enjoyable action sequences.
Unpredictable and surprising plot twists (for some).
cons: Generic storyline and characters.
Poorly executed plot twists and inconsistencies.
Overreliance on shock value and cliches.
Inconsistent pacing and shallow dialogue.

anime.title: Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 16: Shinsoku no Genosect - Mewtwo Kakusei
anime.synopsis:
The homeland of the Genesect exists no more. After three hundred million years, the snowy mountains where the Paleozoic Pokémon once lived are no longer habitable—but not all of the race are actually extinct. Several specimens are still alive and desperate to find a new place to call home. Led by a Shiny Genesect and accompanied by the Legendary Pokémon Mewtwo, the vagabond creatures arrive in New Tork City.

Perceiving the city skyline as similar to their initial habitat, the Genesect take over the city center, driving out other Pokémon and threatening the existence of the local populace. On top of that, the Genesect leader confronts Mewtwo in a cunning, fast-paced duel that is bound to destroy the entire city—and it's up to Satoshi and his companions to save the city and reconcile the feuding Pokémon.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with this installment, primarily due to significant continuity errors and a rushed, cliché plot. While the core themes of home and belonging are appreciated, and the visuals are deemed acceptable, the film's writing, particularly the handling of Mewtwo's character and her relationship with Ash, has generated considerable frustration among long-time fans.
pros: The core theme of 'home' and belonging is touching and relatable.
Visually appealing art style compared to the TV counterpart.
Improved over previous 'Best Wishes' movies.
cons: Significant plot holes and retcons, particularly regarding Mewtwo's continuity and memory of Ash.
Repetitive and uninspired fight sequences.
Underdeveloped characters and dialogue, with Ash often rendered as useless or preachy.
Jarring CGI and poor textures.
The execution lacks sharpness and the plot feels rushed and cliché.

anime.title: My Life
anime.synopsis: A high school girl, while pondering her future, sees it flash before her eyes.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the short animation for its heartwarming and reflective portrayal of life's journey. Some find it relatable and smile-inducing. However, others critique the lack of a clear message and the superficial engagement with life's complexities.
pros: Shows the entirety of a human life in a short time.
Relatable experience of pondering life's moments.
Gives a smile.
cons: Unclear message or purpose.
Plot lacks involvement and depth.

anime.title: Sankarea: I, Too, Am... A Zombie...
anime.romaji_title: Sankarea: Wagahai mo... Zombie de Aru...
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Horror, Love Polygon, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Extra episode included on BD/DVD vol. 6; effectively episode 13. 

Despite their decaying bodies, Rea’s zombie power comes in handy both at school and at home, and Babu gets interested in another cat—although this particular feline is one of the living.
anime.consensus_summary: This OVA episode is generally seen as a cute and enjoyable, albeit non-essential, addition to the Sankarea series. While many appreciate the unique narration and heartwarming moments, a notable portion of the audience finds the romantic development unconvincing and the plot progression minimal. It serves as a pleasant, if slight, continuation that leaves fans hoping for more.
pros: The narration by Baabu (the zombie cat) is a unique and enjoyable touch.
The episode provides a cute, wholesome, and feel-good continuation of the main series.
The ending is touching and adds impact, making viewers think about zombies differently.
The voice acting for Furuya is praised.
It offers a slightly new perspective that enhances the overall impact.
cons: The romantic chemistry between the main characters is perceived as lacking.
The plot feels like filler and doesn't significantly advance the story.
The implication of future seasons or further complications is not well-received by some.
The episode might feel strange to viewers who have forgotten the main plot points.

anime.title: Higurashi: When They Cry - Outbreak
anime.romaji_title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kaku: Outbreak
anime.synopsis:
It is 1983, and Hinamizawa is under quarantine. A mysterious and deadly virus has been discovered within the small village, and its residents—such as teenager Keiichi Maebara and his friends Mion Sonozaki and Rena Ryuuguu—are left confused and frightened by the situation.

As the villagers begin to search for a way to stop the affliction from spreading, some make drastic plans, which leaves Keiichi and his friends looking for a way to escape the village. But when tensions reach an all-time high, some of his group may not make it out unscathed as they fight for their lives against enemies both seen and unseen.
anime.consensus_summary: Fans are divided on whether Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kaku: Outbreak successfully captures the essence of the original series. While some appreciate the return to darker themes and improved animation, others criticize its rushed pacing, inconsistent character portrayals, and diminished suspense, finding it more action-oriented than the psychological horror they expected.
pros: Strong visuals and animation, especially in action sequences.
Maintains the dark and violent 'vibe' of the original series.
Excellent soundtrack, including familiar and new pieces.
Provides a satisfying, albeit brief, continuation for long-time fans.
Familiar characters and setting are well-executed.
cons: Lacks the suspense and intrigue of previous Higurashi installments, feeling more action-oriented.
Character actions and emotional responses can feel disconnected and unrealistic given the dire circumstances.
The plot feels rushed and lacks a proper beginning, development, or conclusion, sometimes feeling like a setup for something more.
Some characters' personalities are altered or underdeveloped compared to the source material.
The overarching mystery element is diminished.

anime.title: The World God Only Knows: Goddesses
anime.romaji_title: Kami nomi zo Shiru Sekai: Megami-hen
anime.genres: Comedy, Harem, Otaku Culture, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Having freed a myriad of women from the runaway spirits possessing their hearts, the "God of Conquest" Keima Katsuragi is confronted with a new task: find the Jupiter Sisters, the goddesses that sealed Old Hell in the past. Diana, the goddess that resides inside his childhood friend Tenri Ayukawa, explains that they have taken shelter in the hearts of the girls he had assisted previously. Moreover, once Diana and her sisters are reunited, their power can seal the runaway spirits away for good and relieve Keima of his exorcising duties. Though he is initially reluctant to get involved in yet another chore, everything changes when tragedy befalls one of the hosts.

Discovering that the goddesses are being targeted by a mysterious organization known as Vintage, Keima is caught in a race against time to reunite the sisters and rescue the girl who has already fallen prey. With deeper resolve than ever before, Keima works together with demons Elsie and Haqua to recapture the hearts of the girls he had charmed in the past. However, the road ahead is a difficult one, as he is soon met with the consequences of his previous conquests.
anime.consensus_summary: The third season, while deviating from the manga, is generally considered the best of the series due to its emotional depth, character development, and strong visuals. However, the skipped content and confusing plot points have divided some viewers. Despite some flaws, the season successfully elevates the harem genre and provides a satisfying ending for many fans.
pros: Meaningful love stories
Intelligent comedic writing
Great emotion and touching scenes
Amazing art and visuals
Character development for Keima
cons: Skipped manga content leads to confusion
Underdeveloped antagonists
Plot can be confusing and doesn't always make sense
Elsie was totally left out

anime.title: KINMOZA!
anime.genres: CGDCT, School, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Shinobu Oomiya once left Japan to participate in a homestay in England. During her time there, she became close friends with Alice Cartelet, the daughter of the family she was living with. However, when it was time for Shinobu to return to Japan, the two were able to express their sorrow despite the language barrier between them.

Five years later, now a first year student in high school, Shinobu receives a letter by air mail in a language she does not understand. This letter is penned by none other than Alice, detailing her own homestay in Japan. In fact, Alice will be attending Shinobu's high school and living with her! Alongside their friends Youko Inokuma, Aya Komichi, and Karen Kujou, the five girls attend school together and learn about what their different cultures have to offer, day after day.
anime.consensus_summary: Kiniro Mosaic is a generally well-received, cute slice-of-life anime, but some viewers find its humor repetitive and its plot lacking. The show's strength lies in its charming characters and light-hearted atmosphere, but it may not appeal to those seeking depth or complexity. The implied yuri elements are a point of contention, with some viewers enjoying the teasing while others find it frustrating.
pros: Charming and light-hearted humor.
Cute and appealing art style.
Enjoyable music and voice acting.
Well-executed comedic timing and character interactions.
cons: Repetitive jokes and gags.
Lack of significant plot or character development.
Superficial exploration of cultural differences.
Questionable English pronunciation by voice actors.
Over-reliance on moe stereotypes.
Unresolved yuri undertones that tease but never materialize.

anime.title: WataMote: No Matter How I Look At It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!
anime.romaji_title: Watashi ga Motenai no wa Dou Kangaetemo Omaera ga Warui!
anime.synopsis:
After living 50 simulated high school lives and dating over 100 virtual boys, Tomoko Kuroki believes that she is ready to conquer her first year of high school. Little does she know that she is much less prepared than she would like to think. In reality, Tomoko is an introverted and awkward young girl, and she herself is the only one who doesn't realize it! With the help of her best friend, Yuu Naruse, and the support and love of her brother Tomoki, Tomoko attempts to brave the new world of high school life.

Watashi ga Motenai no wa Dou Kangaetemo Omaera ga Warui! chronicles the life of a socially awkward and relatively friendless high school otaku as she attempts to overcome her personal barriers in order to live a fulfilling life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are strongly divided based on their ability to relate to the main character's social anxiety. Some find the show to be a painfully accurate and darkly comedic portrayal of social ineptitude, while others find it repetitive, depressing, and difficult to watch. The lack of character development and an overarching plot is a common point of criticism, while the voice acting and unique approach are often praised.
pros: Relatable main character for those with social anxiety.
Accurate depiction of social awkwardness and anxiety.
Unique and daring approach to high school life.
Excellent voice acting, especially for Tomoko.
Creative and well-directed visual tricks.
cons: Repetitive humor that can become stale.
Lack of character development and overarching plot.
Uncomfortable and depressing scenes.
Mediocre animation in some instances.
Over-reliance on inner monologues.
anime.thematic_vibe: Cringe Comedy, Social Anxiety, Dark Humor

anime.title: Kuiba: Shiwanhuoji
anime.synopsis: Every 333 years the ultimate universal devil known as "Kuiba" is reborn. With each rebirth, Kuiba brings absolute destruction. In order to battle Kuiba, Deities and people team up and assassinate him just before his revival. In 1664, the year of Kuiba's rebirth, the assassination attempt failed. Kuiba managed to slip into the young body of Manji. As the child grew older, Manji grew a strong desire to become the greatest warrior. When Manji hears the armies of Earth are recruiting to battle Kuiba, Manji and his master enlists to find and fight Kuiba. What he doesn't know is the one he is aiming to destroy is himself. How will he face his fate and accept his destiny?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience interest is middling. The film shows potential with its Dragonball-esque story and the central conflict, but struggles with uninspired sound design and confusing character development. The art style is derivative, contributing to a mixed reception.
pros: Interesting concept reminiscent of Dragonball.
Intriguing premise of a character unknowingly destined to be a destructive force.
cons: Soundtrack is unexciting and forgettable.
Character development, particularly Manji's awareness of his powers, is problematic.
Artwork is decent but lacks uniqueness, drawing heavy inspiration from Dragonball.

anime.title: The Future Diary: Redial
anime.synopsis:
Yuno Gasai lives a normal life as a first-year in high school. She gets along well with her parents and even has a small circle of friends. However, she cannot help but feel as if someone is missing from her life, someone so important to her that it was as if she had lived another life trying desperately to stay with them.

After a class trip to the beach, Yuno returns home; but in the middle of the night, she receives strange messages from a voice only she can hear. The voice informs her of the person she is desperate to meet and that she must find him. Soon, she finds herself in a mysterious realm, her only goal being reunited with the person she cannot remember. Though obstacles stand in her way, Yuno will stop at nothing to meet her beloved once again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers appreciating the closure and happy ending provided by the OVA, while others feel it undermines the original series' themes and intensity. Many find the OVA to be a fan service that sacrifices depth for a lighter, rushed conclusion. While some enjoy seeing the characters in a more peaceful setting, others find the departure from the original's darker tone disappointing.
pros: Provides closure and a happy ending for fans who were unsatisfied with the original series' conclusion.
Showcases a more peaceful and emotionally healthy version of the characters.
Beautiful visuals, well-choreographed action scenes, and fitting music enhance the viewing experience.
Offers additional character development, particularly for Yuno, providing a better understanding of her motivations.
cons: Feels rushed and doesn't capture the same intensity or depth as the original series.
Sacrifices the tragedy and melancholy that defined the original anime for a lighter, more comedic tone.
May contradict or undermine the original series' ending and themes.
Relies heavily on fan service and can feel like a filler episode with unnecessary plot elements.
The happy ending feels forced and may not resonate with viewers who appreciated the original series' darker tone.

anime.title: Inferno Cop
anime.synopsis:
Jack Knife Edge Town is as edgy as it sounds, and it's up to Inferno Cop to stop that edge from tearing his city apart. He's both law and outlaw, dispensing ungodly justice to evildoers like a candy machine. Lowlifes, gangsters, and even hellspawn all infest Inferno Cop's hunting ground, but that's the good news. The bad news? Prior to the story, his family was brutally murdered by Southern Cross, a shady organization that made the worst mistake imaginable by doing so. Now, Inferno Cop's limiters have been removed and his mercy rung more dry than the entrails of his victims. 

Something is welling up in Inferno Cop's city, however, and soon he'll face the most daunting gauntlet of his life involving him literally falling into and escaping from Hell. A flaming head won't be enough to ward off the true evil that's rapidly approaching—Inferno Cop must call upon all his allies and his own wacky antics to conquer the trials that await him.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely divided on Inferno Cop's merits, with strong opinions on both sides. While many praise its unique brand of chaotic, low-budget satire and dark humor, others are put off by its intentionally simplistic and often nonsensical animation and narrative. It's a show that fully embraces its "so bad it's good" aesthetic, leading to a polarizing but memorable viewing experience.
pros: Hilariously awful exaggeration of cyberpunk cop bullshit, brilliantly satirical and genre-destroying.
Genuinely funny with bizarre, dark humor and sharp, merciless parody of various media.
Unique visual style perfectly complements the jokes and humor, with surprisingly good SFX/VFX for the budget.
Fast-paced, quick-hitting humor that doesn't allow the viewer to breathe.
Originality that steamrolls through repetitive anime tropes.
cons: Minimalistic animation with characters often appearing as static images with little to no movement.
Extremely low production values, with cheap animation, voice acting, and music.
Plot is nonsensical, bizarre, and lacks coherence, making it difficult to follow.
Female voice acting is particularly terrible.
Some critics found the writing to be mediocre and the plot to be a weak point, despite the comedy.

anime.title: The Garden of Words
anime.genres: Award Winning, Drama, Romance, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis: On a rainy morning in Tokyo, Takao Akizuki, an aspiring shoemaker, decides to skip class to sketch designs in a beautiful garden. This is where he meets Yukari Yukino, a beautiful yet mysterious woman, for the very first time. Offering to make her new shoes, Takao continues to meet with Yukari throughout the rainy season, and without even realizing it, the two are able to alleviate the worries hidden in their hearts just by being with each other. However, their personal struggles have not disappeared completely, and as the end of the rainy season approaches, their relationship will be put to the test.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with strong praise for the animation and visuals contrasted by criticism of the shallow story and controversial age gap. Some viewers found the film emotionally resonant and beautiful, while others were left feeling disappointed by the lack of depth and questionable themes. Ultimately, the film's appeal hinges on individual preferences for visual storytelling over narrative substance and the ability to reconcile with the central relationship.
pros: Breathtaking visuals and animation quality.
Effective use of symbolism and subtle storytelling.
Evokes a sense of peace and emotional resonance for some viewers.
cons: Story and characters lack depth and complexity.
Problematic age gap between the main characters raises ethical concerns.
Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers.
Some found the symbolism forced and underdeveloped.

anime.title: My Little Monster OVA
anime.romaji_title: Tonari no Kaibutsu-kun: Tonari no Gokudou-kun
anime.synopsis:
Long before modern times, sweets-loving Princess Chizuru Ooshima painstakingly studies to pass her English proficiency exam. To keep Her Highness focused, Lord Shogun bans all sweets in the town of Edo. Meanwhile, tensions arise between two powerful factions: the Mizutani group, led by the respected Shizuku "Ane-san" Mizutani; and the Yoshida group, under the leadership of the capricious Haru "Harunosuke" Yoshida. 

Ane-san tirelessly tries to make contact with Harunosuke to deliver the news of the founding of a new temple school. But soon after she meets him by chance, romance blooms between the two. However, not everyone approves of this development—and they might stop at nothing to prevent their happiness.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for this OVA is decidedly mixed. While some found its quirky, random nature and initial premise fun and humorous, a significant portion of viewers felt the plot was weak, overly reliant on contrivances, and ultimately disappointing. The disconnect from the main series and a perceived forced comedy further contribute to the division.
pros: The art and sound are really good.
The randomness and quirky outcomes can be humorous.
The initial setup and execution of the premise are enjoyable.
cons: The plot is weak and relies on Deus ex Machina resolutions.
The OVA is disconnected from the main series and feels like filler.
The ending is strange, disappointing, and poorly executed.
The comedy feels forced and detracts from the story.

anime.title: Say "I Love You." OVA
anime.romaji_title: Suki tte Ii na yo. Dareka ga
anime.synopsis: Mei, Aiko, Asami, and Nagi are making cookies at Mei's house. Knowing that the process could take a while, Nagi chases Yamato out of the house. He receives a text from Kai, who asks him if he wants to meet up at the park. When Yamato arrives, it is revealed that the rundown park was where the two of them first talked and bonded for the first time.
