After bantering a bit, Kai asks Yamato why he, who had always seemed to be having fun with a large crowd around him, was always the first one at the park after school. Yamato admits that he used to feel like he was a chameleon; someone who didn't have his own personality and just changed himself to please others. Kai tells Yamato that he used to hate the town, but thanks to Yamato, he now finds it to be beautiful. Kai reassures him that he is his own person, and Yamato confesses that after he met Mei, he realized just how lonely he was. Kai later runs into Megumi at the bus stop. They start talking, and Kai tells her that he thinks she's cool for staying true to herself while modelling. Megumi snaps back at him, and Kai, offended, leaves. When Momo comes, Megumi regrets lashing out on Kai and later becomes embarrassed when Momo suggests that Megumi likes him. At Mei's house, the cookies are done and turn out to be delicious. Mei's mom shoos Mei and Yamato out of the house. Yamato hugs Mei and tells her he's glad she's with him. They watch the sunset together before continuing their walk, holding hands.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience highly enjoyed this OVA, appreciating its continuation of the series' established art style and sound design. It effectively provides more character development and heartwarming moments for fans of the original show, though it is not recommended for newcomers due to its reliance on existing plotlines.
pros: Superb art
Good sound design that suits the moments
Enjoyable episode that serves as a good extension of the series
Provides enjoyable character moments and development
cons: The episode is not a standalone story and relies heavily on prior knowledge of the series

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden the Movie 7: The Last
anime.synopsis:
Two years have passed since the end of the Fourth Great Ninja War. Konohagakure has remained in a state of peace and harmony—until Sixth Hokage Kakashi Hatake notices the moon is dangerously approaching the Earth, posing the threat of planetary ruin.

Amidst the grave ordeal, Konoha is invaded by a new evil, Toneri Oosutuski, who suddenly abducts Hinata Hyuuga's little sister Hanabi. Kakashi dispatches a skilled ninja team comprised of Naruto Uzumaki, Sakura Haruno, Shikamaru Nara, Sai, and Hinata in an effort to rescue Hanabi from the diabolical clutches of Toneri. However, during their mission, the team faces several obstacles that challenge them, foiling their efforts.

With her abduction, the relationships the team share with one another are tested, and with the world reaching the brink of destruction, they must race against time to ensure the safety of their planet. Meanwhile, as the battle ensues, Naruto is driven to fight for something greater than he has ever imagined—love.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a mixed bag for fans. Many appreciate the focus on romance and the resolution of Naruto and Hinata's relationship, while others criticize the weak plot, villain, and underutilization of key characters. It serves as a decent send-off for the series but falls short for some due to its deviations from core Naruto elements.
pros: Beautiful animation and music.
Satisfying conclusion to Naruto and Hinata's relationship.
Nostalgic feels for long-time Naruto fans.
cons: Weak plot and villain.
Forced romance and character development.
Underutilization of main characters, especially Sasuke.

anime.title: Devils and Realist
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Josei, Mystery, Mythology, School
anime.synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old William Twining takes pride in his lineage as well as his devotion to modern science. When he learns that his family has gone bankrupt, the pompous noble is faced with the reality that he can no longer afford his tuition or the lifestyle he is accustomed to. In a desperate search for valuables in his manor, William discovers a hidden room and accidentally summons the arrogant demon Dantalion, the Grand Duke of Hell.
 
Apparently, Lucifer—the ruler of Hell—has fallen into a deep slumber. In his absence, only the human "Elector" has power to select a temporary successor, which is the cause of tension among demonkind. Although told that he is the direct descendant of King Solomon and has unshakable authority in the underworld, William refuses to believe it. While denying the existence of magic and the supernatural altogether, the defiant realist fails to recognize that he is at the center of the ongoing battle between Heaven and Hell.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many find the plot intriguing and the characters enjoyable, particularly highlighting the blend of comedy and supernatural elements. However, the inconsistent art quality, slow pacing, and rushed ending are common criticisms. Some viewers appreciate the shounen-ai elements, while others find them off-putting.
pros: Unique plot with curious elements mixing demons, angels, and a realist protagonist.
Characters are captivating, well-designed and contribute to the plot.
Good sound quality, fitting music, and well-synced voice acting.
Enjoyable mix of comedy, drama, and action.
cons: Inconsistent art quality, with some episodes having poor animation and repeated scenes.
Slow pacing with filler episodes that stray from the main plot.
Rushed ending with unanswered questions and incomplete character development.
Shounen-ai undertones may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Kuroko's Basketball 2
anime.synopsis:
With the Interhigh Championship finally over, Seirin's basketball team refocuses their efforts, training harder than ever to get the chance to participate in the Winter Cup. Both Tetsuya Kuroko and Taiga Kagami see old friends walk back into their lives, providing a challenge both on and off the court.

As new skills are developed and new alliances created, enemies from various teams—giants of high school basketball such as Yousen, Shuutoku, and Touou—stand in the way of Seirin's steadfast attempts to get to the top. All of these schools prove to be formidable foes whose abilities progress exponentially, while Kuroko struggles to find a balance between his resolve to play as part of a team and his desire to win. 

With old wounds reopening, new challenges to face on the court, and a new set of foes—the "Uncrowned Kings"—vowing to defeat the new hopefuls, will Seirin ever be able to achieve their dream of beating the Generation of Miracles?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the second season, praising the intense basketball matches, improved animation, and character development. Some viewers found the plot predictable and felt the focus shifted away from the title character, Kuroko. However, the season is considered a solid continuation of the first, with many finding it exciting and addicting.
pros: The games are insanely intense and well-developed.
The animation is high quality, especially during matches.
Characters are interesting and diverse.
cons: The story is somewhat cliche and predictable.
Focus shifted from Kuroko to Kagami.
Some shounen elements can be overwhelming.

anime.title: K: Missing Kings
anime.synopsis:
It's been a year since the disappearance of Shiro, the Silver King; Kurou Yatogami and Neko have been diligent in their search, but to no end. Their investigation leads to a run-in with members of the now disbanded Red Clan HOMRA—Rikio Kamamoto and Anna Kushina—being pursued by the Green Clan, who desire Anna's powers for their own ends.

Now, the members of Scepter 4 are called upon alongside Kurou and Neko in order to rescue Anna, the mascot, and only female member of the ruined Red Clan, from the enemy's clutches and hopefully find Shiro using the young girl's powers. Amidst crisis, the group is forced into a power struggle when the Green Clan threatens to overtake the Gold King's domain.

The second step in the K Project series, K: Missing Kings, continues the story of a young boy caught up in a psychic war between seven kings, and showcases each character's struggles after the losses of their respective Kings.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the movie as a visually stunning and narratively necessary bridge between the first season and 'Return of Kings'. While some find the plot lacking independent substance and at times confusing, most agree it successfully sets the stage for the sequel by addressing questions and introducing new conflicts. The movie is particularly praised for its animation, art style and sound design.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style, particularly in fight scenes and with the use of color.
Satisfactory continuation of the story, answering questions from the first season and setting up the sequel.
Strong sound design and music that enhances emotional scenes.
cons: Story feels like a bridge or filler between seasons, lacking a unique purpose.
Plot can be confusing at times.
Some feel character personalities remained static.

anime.title: Line Offline: Salaryman
anime.synopsis: The anime shorts are set in the fictional Line Corporation with a motley crew of idiosyncratic workers. There is the narcissistic section head and president's son James, the subsection head Moon (who is always gone somewhere but somehow gets his work done), the quiet but kindhearted subsection head Brown, and the subordinate Connie who is in an endless loop of yo-yo diets and weight gains.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the anime's simplicity and office humor. However, some feel the episodes are too short and the art style is too simplistic. Overall, it's a lighthearted and easily digestible slice-of-life show.
pros: Simple and easy to follow plots
Office humor
Appeals to simple tastes
cons: Episodes are too short
Simplistic art style
anime.thematic_vibe: Office Humor, Slice of Life, Simple

anime.title: Muromi-san
anime.synopsis:
The docks provide a look into the very essence of ocean life—the calm, rhythmic sounds of the waves, the small bugs skittering across the pier, and—mermaids!? Takurou Mukoujima's quiet days spent fishing are no more when he reels in the energetic mermaid Muromi-san, who proceeds to entertain herself around her newfound friend, even if he is obviously disinterested.

Now with a talkative and reckless companion always by his side, Takurou struggles to avoid getting caught up in Muromi-san's pace as she starts to invite her deep-sea friends, making the dock a popular gathering place for mythological creatures. Every day might be new and exciting, but all Takurou really wants is to fish in peace!
anime.consensus_summary: Namiuchigiwa no Muromi-san is a short, comedic anime that offers amusing and absurd entertainment. Viewers appreciate its unique art style, energetic pacing, and some genuinely funny moments, but the lack of a substantial plot and inconsistent humor can be a drawback. While many find it enjoyable for a quick laugh, the reliance on ecchi elements and animation flaws are frequently cited as detractors, leading to a somewhat mixed but generally positive reception.
pros: Unique and charming art style, reminiscent of 90s anime.
Catchy opening theme and good voice acting.
Consistently amusing, with some incredibly funny moments.
Fast-paced and concise, perfect for the humor used.
cons: Lacks a strong overarching story; episodic nature may not appeal to all.
Animation quality is low, with repeated frames.
Humor may not resonate with all viewers; can be hit-or-miss.
Overly ecchi content detracts from the overall quality for some viewers.
Inconsistent quality, with the second half of the series not living up to the first.
anime.thematic_vibe: Absurdist, Slice of Life, Ecchi Comedy

anime.title: Kuroko's Basketball: Tip Off
anime.synopsis:
Episode 22.5 bundled with BD/DVD volume 8.

The episode covers Kuroko's past, when he was part of the "Generation of Miracles."
anime.consensus_summary: The special episode 'Tip Off' is well-received as it provides valuable backstory on the Generation of Miracles, particularly focusing on the relationship between Kise and Kuroko. Fans appreciate the insights into the characters' past and motivations. While some wish for a deeper exploration of the entire team's dynamics, the episode is generally considered a worthwhile addition to the series, deepening the audience's connection with the characters.
pros: Insightful backstory into the Generation of Miracles.
Focus on Kise and Kuroko's early relationship is engaging.
The episode enhances the understanding of the characters and their motivations.
Offers a glimpse into the dynamics of the Generation of Miracles before their separation.
Kise is used effectively as a storytelling device.
cons: Disappointing because it doesn't fully explore the Generation of Miracles' chemistry.
Some viewers might find the focus on Kise and Kuroko's relationship less compelling than seeing the entire team dynamic.

anime.title: Silver Spoon
anime.synopsis:
Yuugo Hachiken is studious, hard-working, and tired of trying to live up to expectations he just cannot meet. With the ushering in of a brand new school year, he decides to enroll in Ooezo Agricultural High School, a boarding school located in the Hokkaido countryside, as a means to escape from the stress brought upon by his parents.
 
Initially convinced that he would do well at this institution, Hachiken is quickly proven wrong by his talented classmates, individuals who have been living on farms their entire lives and know just about everything when it comes to food, vegetables, and even the physiology of livestock! Whether it be waking up at five in the morning for strenuous labor or to take care of farm animals, Hachiken is a complete amateur when it comes to the harsh agricultural life.
 
Gin no Saji follows the comedic story of a young student as he tries to fit into a completely new environment, meeting many unique people along the way. As he struggles to appreciate his surroundings, Hachiken hopes to discover his dreams, so that he may lead a fulfilling life on his own terms.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Gin no Saji for its unique premise, well-developed characters, and balance of humor and serious themes. It offers a thought-provoking look at agriculture and life choices, though some thematic elements may be challenging for certain viewers. The show is considered a hidden gem, exceeding initial expectations.
pros: Unique setting in an agricultural school provides a fresh perspective.
Well-developed characters with realistic struggles and interactions.
Balances comedy with thoughtful exploration of morality and life choices.
cons: Thematic elements related to the treatment of animals may be difficult for some viewers.
Initial skepticism due to the seemingly niche subject matter.

anime.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!: Sparkling... Slapstick Noel
anime.romaji_title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Kirameki no... Slapstick Noel
anime.synopsis:
Although Yuuta Togashi and Rikka Takanashi have just started dating, they do not know how to progress their young relationship. Due to both of them being shy, neither of them are capable of making the first move. Rikka decides to ask her class representative Shinka Nibutani for some love advice, and she advises Rikka get closer to Yuuta during the Christmas season. Following the suggestion of Yuuta's friend, Makoto Isshiki, they hold a Christmas party at Sanae Dekomori’s place.

During the party, Yuuta notices Rikka has gone missing and searches for her. When he finds Rikka, he notices that she is acting strange and quickly figures out that she and Sanae are both drunk! How will this Christmas party turn out for the budding couple?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed this extra episode, seeing it as a fun and lighthearted return to the series' characters and humor. It's appreciated for its focus on the romantic development between Rikka and Yuuta, something many felt was lacking in the first season. However, some find the episode non-essential, with minimal plot or character advancement, and some found the music unappealing.
pros: Enjoyable return to the characters and world.
Focuses on the romance that the main series lacked.
Funny interactions between the characters.
Good appetizer for the second season.
cons: Story progresses only a tad further than the original season.
Character development is minimal.
Music is forgettable and potentially dizzying.
Feels like a filler episode, not essential to the overall plot.

anime.title: Hayate the Combat Butler! Cuties
anime.synopsis: Taking place after the events that occurred in Hayate no Gotoku! Can't Take My Eyes off You. Hayate, Nagi and Maria return to their daily lives at the Sanzenin Mansion and the Violet Mansion.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with disappointment stemming from the lack of a cohesive narrative and deviation from the manga's storyline. While some appreciate the character-focused arcs and comedic elements, the overall consensus points to a decline in quality compared to previous seasons. The show is viewed as a collection of random events rather than a continuation of the established plot.
pros: Character interactions and arcs provide enjoyable change of scenery.
Soundtrack and opening theme praised.
cons: Lack of overarching story and focus on random events.
Fails to continue the plot from the manga.
Disappointing compared to previous seasons.

anime.title: The Tender March
anime.synopsis: This is a humorous animated work in which a young girl walks through a mysterious town with both tranquil fields and buildings, followed by various monsters. The thoughts and feelings of the young girl as she daydreams are visualized on a monitor screen or by being likened to the forms of the monsters; the closed inner world of a young girl is depicted incisively, against a soundtrack of up-tempo music. The light shades and the lines drawn with a delicate touch and strong sense of design create a unique world view and transparency.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Yasashii March' for its artistic visuals and catchy music. Viewers find the plot to be open to interpretation, with some enjoying the ambiguity and others finding it confusing. There's a slight awareness of darker undertones, but the overall mood is positive and appreciative of the work's unique qualities.
pros: Visually stunning and unique art style
Catchy and well-suited soundtrack
Intriguing and open to interpretation narrative
cons: Plot can be ambiguous and difficult to fully understand
Dark undertones may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Monogatari Series: Second Season
anime.synopsis:
Apparitions, oddities, and gods continue to manifest around Koyomi Araragi and his close-knit group of friends: Tsubasa Hanekawa, the group's modest genius; Shinobu Oshino, the resident doughnut-loving vampire; athletic deviant Suruga Kanbaru; bite-happy spirit Mayoi Hachikuji; Koyomi's cute admirer Nadeko Sengoku; and Hitagi Senjougahara, Koyomi's eclectic girlfriend.

A new semester has begun and with graduation looming over Koyomi, he must quickly decide the paths he will walk, as well as the relationships he will form and friends that he will save. But as strange events begin to unfold, Koyomi is nowhere to be found, and a vicious tiger apparition has appeared in his absence. Hanekawa has become its target, and she quickly finds she must fend for herself.
anime.consensus_summary: The Monogatari Series: Second Season is praised for its unique storytelling, character depth, and philosophical themes, though its heavy reliance on dialogue and fan service divides audiences. Many appreciate its creative exploration of the human psyche and consider it a high point in the series. However, some find the non-chronological narrative and ecchi content to be drawbacks.
pros: Unique storytelling and dialogue-driven narrative.
Well-developed characters with depth and complexity.
Creative plot and exploration of the human mind.
cons: Heavy reliance on dialogue may not appeal to all viewers.
Ecchi content and fan service can be off-putting.
Non-chronological order of arcs can be confusing.

anime.title: Fafner Exodus
anime.romaji_title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Exodus
anime.synopsis: 2150 AD. The battle against the silicon-based Festums from outer space reaches a new phase. Fragments of the North Pole Mir were scattered throughout the world. Eventually, they began to act on their own as independent Mirs. Most hated humanity and attacked them, but some chose to coexist with mankind. Some with the same way of thinking existed within the human race, as well: those who were both human and Festum. They added to the chaos of the battle and brought about even more hatred.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Exodus, particularly for its continuation of the saga and exploration of complex themes. While some find the art style and pacing to be lacking, the strong characters and soundtrack are praised. The show is best enjoyed by those familiar with the previous Fafner installments.
pros: Strong continuation of the Fafner saga.
Enjoyable combat and designs.
Explores themes of hate, body horror, sacrifice, war, guilt and some light existentialism.
Great soundtrack.
Enhances the show and the range of perspectives it's able to explore.
cons: Mediocre art style.
The start-up of the show is kind of slow.
New characters pale in comparison.

anime.title: Aiura
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
As spring vacation comes to a close, a new school semester approaches. Deciding to make the most of the remaining holiday, Ayuko Uehara takes a stroll into her neighborhood and stops by a small cafe. However, her peaceful day is abruptly disturbed when a girl clumsily bumps into her. Left puzzled by the encounter, Ayuko is even more surprised when she meets them again as freshmen at the same high school she attends. Recognizing her from the store, the girls introduce themselves as Kanaka Amaya and Saki Iwasawa, and the three quickly become friends.

As they go through their daily lives as high school girls, the trio's distinct personalities—Kanaka's happy-go-lucky attitude, Saki's tomboyish behavior, and Ayuko's easygoingness—are sure to make every mundane school day filled with silly and fun interactions.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences find 'Aiura' to be a cute and relaxing slice-of-life anime, praising its charming characters, appealing art style, and witty humor. The primary criticism centers on the show's extremely short episodes, which limit plot development and character exploration. While some find the lack of a substantial story disappointing, most appreciate it as a lighthearted and enjoyable experience.
pros: Charming and well-defined characters with natural interactions
Aesthetically pleasing art style with smooth animation and detailed backgrounds
Enjoyable and catchy opening and closing themes
Well-executed humor that is witty and sarcastic
cons: Very short episodes limit story development and character depth
Some side characters are underdeveloped and uninteresting
Lack of substantial plot or meaningful progression
Repetitive use of opening and ending themes reduces actual content time

anime.title: Pokémon: Black & White: Adventures in Unova
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Best Wishes! Season 2: Episode N
anime.synopsis: Following the Isshu League Higaki Tournament, Satoshi and friends set out on a new journey towards the 'White Ruins' discovered by Professor Araragi's father, a place connected to Reshiram, a Pokémon called legendary. There, they meet the mysterious youth N, who claims he can understand what Pokémon are saying. And then the group gets involved in an ominous experiment on Pokémon conducted by the Plasma Gang! Through the works of the mysterious scientist Achroma, even Pikachu and Kibago become hostile towards Satoshi and friends!? What are the true ambitions of the Plasma Gang's leader Ghetsis, who reveals the gang has been searching for N!? And then, the Rocket Gang trio makes their return to the Isshu Region!! Their current mission puts them at odds with the Plasma Gang... how will the resulting battle turn out!?
anime.consensus_summary: The "Episode N" arc is met with mixed feelings. While some appreciate the exploration of deeper themes and the introduction of key characters like N and Team Plasma, many feel the storyline is rushed, underdeveloped, and fails to capture the essence of the source material from the games. The consensus leans toward disappointment, particularly with the handling of Team Plasma and N's character, with many viewers feeling that the anime missed an opportunity to adapt a compelling storyline effectively.
pros: Ash shows experience.
Episode N is interesting and addresses the morality of capturing Pokémon.
Team Plasma storyline finally showcased.
N character finally shows up.
cons: Storyline feels rushed and underdeveloped.
N's character is boring compared to the game version.
Team Plasma's goals are a reiteration of previous villains.
The anime did not live up to the game or its sequels.
Fillers overshadow N-related episodes.

anime.title: Someone's Gaze
anime.synopsis: In near-future Japan, Aya Okamura lives alone in an apartment away from her parents. Her mother has worked overseas ever since her childhood, so her aging father Kouji and their cat Mii-san are the only ones left in their family home. After a tiring day, Aya declines her father's invitation for dinner by lying that she is still at work. Yet that very night, she receives another call with sudden news that may bring this separated family closer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment overwhelmingly praises Dareka no Manazashi for its beautiful animation, emotional resonance, and powerful, relatable message about family. While most viewers found the short film deeply moving and artistically impressive, a minority noted that the story's brevity led to pacing issues and underdevelopment of its themes and characters.
pros: Stunning and marvelous art/animation with vibrant colors and skilled use of lighting.
The soundtrack and music are fitting, soulful, and emotionally resonant, enhancing the story.
The film effectively conveys a heartfelt and realistic message about family bonds and unconditional love.
Characters, despite limited screen time, are relatable and human, evoking empathy.
The story, though short, is powerful and touching, often bringing viewers to tears.
cons: The story's execution and pacing can feel rushed or disjointed at times.
The near-future setting adds no discernible value to the plot.
Underdevelopment of plot points and characters due to the short runtime, preventing deeper connection.
The narrator's constant presence can detract from emotional moments and dialogue.
Visual similarity to 'The Garden of Words' might suggest a lack of originality in art style.

anime.title: Straight Title Robot Anime
anime.romaji_title: Chokkyuu Hyoudai Robot Anime: Straight Title
anime.synopsis: The story of the anime is set in the year Mobile Century 8013. It has been over seven millennia since humanity was wiped out on Earth, but the surviving military robots continue to wage war with no end in sight. The war has embroiled the Rebellion Federation that controls Europe and the Principality of Shin centered in Asia. Three young robots stand up to put an end to this futile war.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally amused and intrigued by 'Straight Title,' recognizing its comedic intent and unique execution. While some are initially misled by its appearance, most appreciate the show's lighthearted and satirical nature. The use of MMD animation and reliance on Japanese humor may not appeal to everyone, but the show is seen as a worthwhile and unusual experience.
pros: Unique premise and execution
Educational about Japanese comedy
Seiyuu seem to enjoy themselves
Clever analysis of humor
Good physical comedy
cons: Animation quality (MMD) can be off-putting
Humor may not translate well to all audiences
Story is secondary to comedy
Can be mistaken for a serious mecha anime

anime.title: Ghost in the Shell: Arise - Border 1: Ghost Pain
anime.romaji_title: Koukaku Kidoutai Arise: Ghost in the Shell - Border:1 Ghost Pain
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Detective, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
The anime's story is set in 2027, one year after the end of the fourth non-nuclear war. New Port City is still reeling from the war's aftermath when it suffers a bombing caused by a self-propelled mine. Then, a military member implicated in arms-dealing bribes is gunned down.

During the investigation, Public Security Section's Daisuke Aramaki encounters Motoko Kusanagi, the cyborg wizard-level hacker assigned to the military's 501st Secret Unit. Batou, a man with the "eye that does not sleep," suspects that Kusanagi is the one behind the bombing. The Niihama Prefectural Police detective Togusa is pursuing his own dual cases of the shooting death and a prostitute's murder. Motoko herself is being watched by the 501st Secret Unit's head Kurutsu and cyborg agents.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the exploration of Motoko's origins and the action, others find the story less engaging than previous installments and dislike the changes in art style and voice acting. Many feel it doesn't live up to the high standards set by Stand Alone Complex and the original film.
pros: Exploration of Motoko's backstory and early relationships.
Nice action scenes and fights.
Faithful to the original film's characters and voice actors (where possible).
cons: Story not as engaging as earlier Ghost in the Shell installments.
Feels like a re-imagining rather than a faithful prequel.
New voice cast isn't as good as the original.

anime.title: Unbreakable Machine-Doll
anime.synopsis:
The Walpurgis Royal Academy of Machinart was founded alongside the development of "Machinart," machine magic capable of giving life and intelligence to mechanical dolls subsequently called as "automaton." Its aim: train skilled puppeteers to control the automatons, as militaries across the globe have begun incorporating Machinart into their armies.

After miserably failing the academy's entrance exams, Raishin Akabane and his humanoid automaton Yaya must defeat one of the top one hundred students to earn the right to take part in the Evening Party, a fight for supremacy between puppeteers using their automatons. The last one standing is bestowed the title of "Wiseman" and granted access to the powerful forbidden arts.

Thus, Raishin challenges Charlotte Belew and her automaton Sigmund to a duel, but before they even begin, Sigmund is attacked by other students. After saving his opponents from their assaulters, Raishin cancels the duel but is forced to search for a new way to gain access to the Party. Driven by the tragedies of his past, Raishin fights alongside Yaya to rise to the top and claim the title of Wiseman.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Machine-Doll wa Kizutsukanai are mixed. While some appreciate the action, art style, and character interactions, others are critical of the plot holes, generic harem elements, and inconsistent CGI. The story's potential is undermined by a weak main character and poorly explained plot points, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Enticing story with consistent character goals and well-done fight scenes.
Appealing art style, with refined visuals and good color usage.
Memorable and well-developed characters, especially the interactions between Raishin and Yaya.
Steampunk setting is unique.
cons: Plot holes and confusing arcs that lack sufficient explanation.
Pacing issues that make the timeline unclear.
Generic harem elements and a weak or unlikeable main character.
Inconsistent CGI usage during action scenes.
Villains that are poorly written.

anime.title: Pretty Rhythm: Rainbow Live
anime.synopsis: Naru Ayase is an 8th grader who can see the colors of music when she listens to it. For Naru, who is extremely good at decorating, becoming the owner of a shop like Dear Crown was her dream. One day, she finds out that the manager of a newly-opened shop is recruiting middle school girls who can do Prism Dance, and immediately applies. Naru begins to Prism Dance at the audition, and an aura she's never experienced spreads out in front of her. At that moment, a mysterious girl named Rinne asks her if she can see "rainbow music."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves Pretty Rhythm: Rainbow Live for its heartwarming story, well-developed characters, and touching themes. While some find certain episodes disappointing or the initial story cheesy, the overall consensus is that the show is a worthwhile and enjoyable experience, even surpassing previous seasons. Its focus on friendship, family, and romance resonates well with viewers.
pros: Sophisticated story with well-developed characters and subplots.
Addresses sensitive topics despite being a kids anime.
Performances are outstanding and surpass previous seasons.
Characters are unique, with backstories that evoke empathy.
cons: Some episodes can be disappointing.
The story can start off cheesy and tacky.
Music variety may be limited due to character-specific songs.

anime.title: Kuroko's Basketball Special
anime.synopsis: Special included on Kuroko no Basket Fan Disc 1: Owara nai Natsu.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience views 'Oshaberi Shiyokka' as a nine-minute filler special that's fun for fans seeking lighthearted humor and character interactions. While some appreciate its comedic value and meta-commentary, others criticize its lack of substance, budget animation, and failure as a recap, deeming it skippable even for completionists.
pros: Funny character interactions and humor despite its filler nature
Provides a lighthearted break with comedic side activities for characters
Appreciated for original content, even if non-canonical
cons: Obvious filler episode with little narrative substance
Significant budget-saving measures evident in animation, relying on stills and dialogue
Fails as a comprehensive recap, only covering a fraction of season one
Jokes and character humor have been done before
Poor taste to make fans something so lame, even for completionists

anime.title: Log Horizon
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Fantasy, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
In the blink of an eye, thirty thousand bewildered Japanese gamers are whisked from their everyday lives into the world of the popular MMORPG, Elder Tale, after the game's latest update—unable to log out. Among them is the socially awkward college student Shiroe, whose confusion and shock lasts only a moment as, a veteran of the game, he immediately sets out to explore the limits of his new reality.

Shiroe must learn to live in this new world, leading others and negotiating with the NPC "natives" in order to bring stability to the virtual city of Akihabara. He is joined by his unfortunate friend Naotsugu, having logged in for the first time in years only to find himself trapped, and Akatsuki, a petite but fierce assassin who labels Shiroe as her master. A tale of fantasy, adventure, and politics, Log Horizon explores the elements of gaming through the eyes of a master strategist who attempts to make the best of a puzzling situation.
anime.consensus_summary: Log Horizon is generally well-received, particularly for its strategic gameplay and world-building, setting it apart from similar anime like Sword Art Online. Some find its slower pace and focus on world management less engaging, while others appreciate its depth and unique take on the trapped-in-a-game premise. The series fosters thoughtful discussions about society and player dynamics within a virtual world.
pros: Intelligent and mature storytelling with strategic elements.
Well-developed world and engaging MMO mechanics.
Unique plot that doesn't have a predictable ending.
cons: Slow pacing and dialogue-heavy, which may not appeal to all viewers.
Initial setup similar to Sword Art Online may deter some viewers.
Some find the plot abstract and lacking depth, without a clear objective.

anime.title: Futari wa Milky Holmes
anime.genres: Comedy, Detective, Mystery, Parody, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Fans of the Milky Holmes detectives, Kazumi and Alice, decide to form their own detective unit, calling themselves "Feathers."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative, particularly among fans of the original Milky Holmes series. The new characters are considered bland and the plot is weak, lacking the charm and humor of its predecessors. While some appreciate the villain designs and the chemistry between the protagonists, the consensus is that the show fails to live up to the standards of the Milky Holmes franchise.
pros: Chemistry between the main characters (Kazumi and Alice) is decent.
Color the Phantom villains are well-designed and carry the plot.
Initial episodes have a sweet and cheesy feeling, reminiscent of Disney movies.
cons: Main characters (Kazumi and Alice) are bland and lack meaningful development.
Story is stretched out, repetitive, and cliched.
Plot and character arcs are rushed and nonsensical.
Lost the original charm and humor of the Milky Holmes franchise.
Forced drama and compulsive cuteness are ineffective.

anime.title: Space Pirate Captain Harlock
anime.synopsis:
After conquering the galaxy, mankind has reached its apex and is now on a steady decline. The resources of the universe are diminishing, and around 500 billion humans begin to return home to Earth. Thus begins a war between the various factions of humans for control of the planet. Eventually, an authoritarian government known as the Gaia Sanction prevents the re-population of Earth.

Captain Herlock was one of the Elite Wing who was tasked by the Gaia Sanction to defend the Earth. His fleet of ships was unstoppable under his command. However, the Gaia Sanction allows a diplomatic elite to immigrate to Earth, which angers Herlock. He goes rogue and fires upon the diplomats and the rest of his fleet. He decides to unleash dark matter on the planet to make it uninhabitable, but also becomes engulfed in it which immortalizes him.

One hundred years have passed, and the legendary Captain Herlock is still at large, with only the Arcadia under his control. The Gaia Sanction continues with their plans for control over the Earth, while hiding its true state. But Captain Herlock is preparing for one final showdown with them, which will determine the fate of the world!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is sharply divided, with near-universal praise for the film's stunning CGI and action sequences, balanced by widespread criticism of its convoluted plot and underdeveloped characters. While the visuals are hailed as a masterpiece, the narrative struggles to connect, leading to a polarizing experience where some found it a visually spectacular, albeit flawed, space opera, and others felt the substance failed to match the style.
pros: Stunning CGI and animation that creates an 'eyegasmic joy' and 'beautiful action scenes'.
Visually impressive production values with intricate detail.
The action sequences are well-executed, exciting, and gorgeously animated.
Faithful to the spirit of the original Captain Harlock franchise.
The film successfully conveys grand themes and a sense of epic scale.
cons: The plot is often described as convoluted, messy, and lacking substance.
Characters, particularly Yama and Ezra, are frequently criticized as unlikeable, underdeveloped, and lacking motivation.
Pacing issues are noted, with slow stretches followed by rushed action, and a general lack of emotional connection.
The character designs and mechanical designs (especially the Arcadia) are criticized by some as being unfaithful to or less appealing than the originals.
The dialogue and lip-sync are sometimes out of sync, and the emotional beats do not always land effectively.
Some reviewers feel Harlock's characterization has strayed from his original romantic hero persona into something more nihilistic or selfish.

anime.title: Jinzou Konchuu Kabutoborg VxV
anime.synopsis: BorgBattles between KabutoBorgs have become popular enough to hold world tournaments. The main character Ryuusei is an enthusiast of these battles. Along with his friends Katsuji and Ken, he continues fighting against new enemies day after day.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, albeit with a strong understanding that the show's appeal lies in its absurdity and lack of traditional narrative structure. Viewers appreciate the show for its unique and enjoyable experience, urging others to embrace the nonsensical nature of the show and 'become a Borger'. The show isn't for everyone, particularly those seeking a logically consistent plot.
pros: Unique and enjoyable experience
Masterpiece quality
Don't think, feel
cons: Lack of understandable rules or continuity
May not appeal to those seeking logical narratives
Requires suspension of disbelief

anime.title: Kingdom Season 2
anime.synopsis:
A year after the devastating battle against the formidable Zhao, the State of Qin has returned its focus to pursuing King Ying Zheng's ambition of conquering the other six states and unifying China. Their next target is Wei, a smaller state which stands as a geographic stepping stone for the sake of conquest.

Xin, now a three hundred man commander of the swiftly rising Fei Xin Unit, continues to seek out lofty achievements in order to garner recognition for himself and his soldiers, motivated by those previously lost in battle. In the preliminary battles ahead of Qin's invasion of Wei, Xin finds competition in other young commanders who are of a higher social status than him. Back in Qin, the royal palace faces turmoil as opposing factions begin to make their move against Ying Zheng's regime.

With their hands full both abroad and at home, Zheng and Xin must lead the way in this era of unending war, resolved to etch their names in history by creating a unified China.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Kingdom is generally seen as an improvement over the first, particularly in animation quality and plot development. Viewers praise the intricate war strategies and character development but note some shortcomings in fighting animation and character consistency. While the show is appreciated for its unique story and political intrigue, some find the reliance on shonen tropes and inconsistent characterization to be detrimental.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to Season 1, with more 2D art and less CG.
Intriguing war strategies and tactics are well-formulated and executed.
Good character development for many characters, fostering rivalry and friendship.
Engaging plot with interesting political power struggles in addition to physical warfare.
cons: Fighting animation is sometimes poor, lacking intensity and impact.
Some viewers find the main character, Xin, to be lacking in intelligence and overly reliant on plot armor.
Pacing issues in action scenes, with slow dialogue interrupting the flow.
Inconsistent characterization compared to the manga, with some characters becoming one-dimensional and annoying.
anime.thematic_vibe: Warring States Period, Political Intrigue, Character Development

anime.title: Hino Hideshi Toukaidou Yotsuya Kaidan
anime.synopsis: Based on Kaidan Yotsuya (Classic Japanese ghost story).
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is appreciated for its adherence to the classic Yotsuya Kaidan story and the strength of its voice acting. However, the limited animation and slow pacing detract from the viewing experience. Prior knowledge of the story is recommended to fully appreciate the plot. It is considered a simple, but effective, adaptation for those familiar with the source material.
pros: Effective storytelling through imagery despite lack of animation.
Stellar voice acting performance, especially for Oiwa.
Faithful to the original Yotsuya Kaidan story.
cons: Lack of animation makes it less engaging.
Pacing can be slow with lingering images.
Requires prior knowledge of the story to fully understand.
Visually inferior compared to other adaptations, such as the 80s version.

anime.title: Say "I Love You".: Mei and Marshmallow Meow
anime.romaji_title: Suki tte Ii na yo.: Mei and Marshmallow
anime.synopsis: Specials released with the anime BD/DVD.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience response to these specials is largely negative, with many finding them boring, pointless, and a disappointment compared to the main series. While some appreciate the cute art and voice acting, the overwhelming sentiment is that the shorts lack substance and humor, making them a "waste of time" for most.
pros: Cute art style that blends Chibi and minimalist 3D.
Great voice acting, particularly from Mei's VA and Marshmallow's VA (Sakurai Takahiro).
Nostalgic appeal for fans of the main series.
Marshmallow's voice actor is praised.
Cute cat meowing a song.
cons: Extremely short episodes with very little substance or plot.
Lack of humor, despite attempts to be funny.
Boring and tasteless content that fails to supplement the main series.
Inconsistent and minimalistic animation that can appear awkward.
Disappointing compared to the quality of the main series.
Waste of time for viewers not expecting pure fluff.

anime.title: Mushiking: The King of Beetles the movie "The Road to the Greatest Champion"
anime.romaji_title: Kouchuu Ouja Mushiking: Greatest Champion e no Michi
anime.synopsis:
The ultimate Beetle Battle unreels!

The King of Beetles, Mushiking is a beetle battle game of the 21st Century that is causing a whirlpool of sensational excitement among children. Its popularity has transcended the world of arcade games! The total number of cards issued has exceeded 420 million. Mushiking is not only one of the most popular in arcade games, but is also creating a buzz in various fields such as game boy advance, TV animations. and etc.

Kent Mirai is a passionate youth. His dream is to become the greatest Mushiking champion in the world. He is spending his time beetle battling with the King of Beetles, Mushiking everyday. One day, a mysterious boy named Shiro Mizorogi appears before Kent. This boy is so strong that the beetle battlers are ruthlessly defeated one after the other. The beetle that Shiro manipulates is a beetle that has never been seen before, called Dark Side Neptune Beetle. It is enveloped with an evil aura and its eyes glow eerily red. Shiro acquires the power of the dark side through Dr. Black, who stops at nothing in order to win the mushiking battle! The blazing battle between Kent and the King of Beetles, Mushiking vs. Dark Side and Neptune Beetle is launched!!
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is primarily a promotional piece for the Mushiking arcade game and appeals mostly to children. While the animation and battle sequences are well-executed and enjoyable, the story and characters are generic and lack depth. Ultimately, it's only recommended for die-hard Mushiking fans seeking nostalgia.
pros: Fluid and natural animation, especially in beetle fights.
Sound works well with the hot-blooded theme.
Battles are extremely well-done and detailed.
cons: Basic and typical Shonen story with little depth.
Bland characters that don't stand out.
Story disregards both reality and gameplay-wise.
Movie's purpose is primarily to sell game cards for a dead game.

anime.title: Diabolik Lovers
anime.genres: Drama, Josei, Reverse Harem, School, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis: At the behest of her father, Yui Komori goes to live in a secluded mansion, home to the six Sakamaki brothers—Shuu, Reiji, Ayato, Kanato, Laito, and Subaru—a family of vampires. Though at first the siblings are confused as to why the girl has arrived, they soon realize that she is to be their new "sacrificial bride," not to mention their other, more carnal intentions for her. After meeting the brothers, Yui quickly begins to question why her father would have sent her here and why she feels a strange, new pain in her chest. With each brother more sadistic than the last, Yui's life as a captive takes a harrowing turn in her new home. As her days turn into endless nights, and each brother vows to make her his own, Yui falls deeper and deeper into madness and ecstasy.
anime.consensus_summary: Diabolik Lovers is overwhelmingly criticized for its problematic themes, including sexualized violence and the normalization of abuse. Reviewers describe the female lead as weak and the plot as nonsensical, ultimately condemning the series for its poor writing and disturbing content. While some viewers find the show unintentionally humorous or appreciate the art style, the general consensus is one of strong disapproval.
pros: Visually appealing character designs and art style.
Some voice acting is commendable, capturing the intended tones of the characters.
The show can be unintentionally funny due to its outlandish and bizarre nature.
cons: Rape-like scenarios and sexualized violence are off-putting and disturbing.
The female lead is portrayed as weak, helpless, and lacking agency.
The plot is nonsensical, underdeveloped, and full of holes.
Characters are poorly developed and lack depth.
The story romanticizes abuse and normalizes unhealthy relationships.

anime.title: Fairy Tail the Movie: The Phoenix Priestess - The First Morning
anime.romaji_title: Fairy Tail Movie 1: Houou no Miko - Hajimari no Asa
anime.synopsis: Under the scorching desert sun, a lonely girl called Éclair wanders, faithfully protecting the relic "Phoenix Stone" entrusted to her. Even though she hates magic, the power of the Stone brings her handcrafted plush toy to life. Finally graced with the warmth of friendship, Éclair names it Momon, and together, they commence their journey across Fiore, guided by the Stone.
anime.consensus_summary: The prologue aims to build emotional investment in the character Éclair, but some viewers find the amnesia plot unengaging. Others appreciate the backstory and character development it provides before watching the movie, enhancing their understanding of Éclair and Momon's bond. The episode is considered a worthwhile addition for those seeking a deeper connection to the film's characters.
pros: Expands on important side character.
Provides backstory and context for the movie.
Good introduction to Eclair and Momon's relationship.
cons: Amnesia as a narrative device is poorly executed.
Difficult to connect with the main character due to amnesia.
Character may not be brought up again.
Boring

anime.title: Non Non Biyori
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Hotaru Ichijou's lifestyle completely changes when she leaves Tokyo and moves with her family to the isolated Asahigaoka village. Her new school has only five students including herself, all sharing a single classroom regardless of grade level. There are no convenience stores in the area, and it can take up to two hours for a bus to arrive.

Nevertheless, Hotaru finds herself captivated by the countryside's charm thanks to her four unique schoolmates with whom she quickly forms a genuine bond. The most colorful of them is Renge Miyauchi, a first-grader who is often perceptive despite her age. However, no less intriguing are the three Koshigaya siblings: the quiet oldest brother Suguru, the petite older sister Komari, and the prankish youngest sister Natsumi.

Having someone from the city join their cheerful little group enlivens the ordinary days in Asahigaoka. Not only does Hotaru bring firsthand knowledge from the alluring outside world, but her fresh outlook on life welcomes a blossom of change to their usual routine.
anime.consensus_summary: Non Non Biyori is overwhelmingly praised as a relaxing and heartwarming slice-of-life anime with beautiful visuals and well-developed characters. The lack of a complex plot is a minor drawback for some viewers, but the show's strength lies in its ability to create a soothing and nostalgic atmosphere. It's widely considered a standout title within the slice-of-life genre.
pros: Beautiful scenery and art style create a pleasant atmosphere
Relaxing and heartwarming slice of life content
Well-developed characters with realistic interactions
cons: Lack of a complex or overarching plot may not appeal to all viewers
Some find the characters too simplistic or unrealistic

anime.title: Uchuu Kyoudai: Itten no Hikari
anime.synopsis: The anime's original story features Mutta and Hibito during one summer when they were children. During the summer when Mutta and Hibito made their promise to go to space, they met a young girl who also had a wish.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some fans of the original series find the episode inspiring and enjoyable, particularly due to its connection to space exploration and planetariums. However, others criticize it for excessive recap, lack of substantive new content, and underdeveloped characters. The special is not recommended for newcomers due to spoilers.
pros: Phenomenal piece of media for fans of the series.
Inspiring and on brand, especially for planetarium screenings.
Enjoyable experience and homage to space media.
cons: Large portions of recap.
New parts didn't add anything substantive to the series.
Main cast (including Hikari) aren't developed.
Spoils some events in the TV series.
anime.thematic_vibe: Inspirational, Homage to Space, Childhood Promise

anime.title: Date A Live: Date to Date
anime.romaji_title: Date A Live: Date to Date
anime.synopsis: When Origami Tobiichi asks Shidou Itsuka out on a date, Shidou considers this his best opportunity to set the record straight and end their relationship. However, even with the help of the Ratatoskr crew, his attempts to break up with her fail; in fact, Origami gladly tolerates Shidou's humiliating requests and blunt comments! Shidou's unconventional mission incidentally complicates his relationship with Tooka Yatogami, and it seems that easing the tension is only possible by going on another date.
anime.consensus_summary: The Date A Live OVA is primarily aimed at fans of the series, offering humorous and enjoyable character interactions. However, it lacks a substantial plot and relies heavily on fan service, potentially alienating viewers seeking a more meaningful story. Audience opinions are mixed, with some appreciating the lighthearted fun and others criticizing the lack of depth.
pros: Consistent art style with the series.
Funny and amusing for fans of the show.
Enjoyable character interactions.
cons: Lacks a significant plot or story.
Relies heavily on fan service and shock humor.
Characters may seem static or underdeveloped.
May not appeal to viewers who dislike the main series.

anime.title: Little Busters!: I Will Protect the World of Saitou!
anime.romaji_title: Little Busters! Sekai no Saitou wa Ore ga Mamoru!
anime.synopsis: A special unaired episode of Little Busters! sent to those who bought all 9 BD/DVD volumes of the anime. This episode includes the story about "Mask the Saitou."
anime.consensus_summary: The Little Busters! OVA is well-received as a fun and lighthearted side story that offers a break from the main series' emotional intensity. Fans appreciate the comedic elements and the focus on character interactions. While the fanservice may not be for everyone, the overall consensus is positive, with viewers enjoying the refreshing change of pace.
pros: Refreshing and different aspect of Little Busters
Funny and lighthearted breather episode
Great art and animation quality
cons: Story may be less impactful than the main series
Focus on fanservice may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Day Break Illusion
anime.synopsis:
Akari Taiyou is an apprentice fortune teller living with her aunt, uncle, and their daughter Fuyuna. Having lost her mother at a young age, the only thing Akari has left of her is a deck of tarot cards and a dream to follow in her footsteps as a fortune teller.

One night, Akari has a dream of being attacked by a plant monster and witnesses a stronger version of herself defeat it. When she awakens, she discovers to her horror that the monster was actually Fuyuna. But mysteriously, Akari and her relatives soon forget Fuyuna ever existed. After another close encounter with a similar monster, she is rescued by three magical girls: Ginka Shirokane, Seira Hoshikawa, and Luna Tsukuyomi. They explain that they are from the Sefiro Fiore organization, which uses Elemental Tarot power to fight the evil creatures known as "Daemonia."
 
Akari discovers she too is a magical girl and has inherited her mother's power of The Sun card. However, she comes to realize Daemonia are actually people who have been possessed, and she must decide whether to try to save what is left of their humanity or to wipe them from existence. As Akari comes to terms with her grim duty of protecting the world from Daemonia, the bonds of the organization and that of their team will soon be strained when they deal with grave threats from the outside and from within.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the dark magical girl theme and tarot card concept, many find the show derivative, rushed, and with underdeveloped characters. The pacing issues and unresolved plot points contribute to a sense of unfulfilled potential, leading to a somewhat disappointing experience for many viewers.
pros: Good soundtrack and opening/ending themes.
Visually appealing fight scenes and animation.
Interesting concept with the tarot card theme.
cons: Rushed pacing and unresolved plot points.
Shallow characters and stereotypical personalities.
Poorly executed dark elements and philosophical insights.
Derivative of Madoka Magica with less impactful story.

anime.title: Gunnm 3D Special
anime.synopsis: A 3 minute 3D-CGI rendered movie clip included with volume 6 of the Gunnm: Complete Edition manga reprint. It showcases Alita in a Third League motorball race with players from two of her races such as "Armor" Togo, Degchalev, and Valdicci, and depicts events from both of those races.
anime.consensus_summary: The short 3D clip evoked strong nostalgia and excitement for fans of the original Gunnm OVA and manga. The visuals and soundtrack were praised, but the brevity and lack of continuation left viewers wanting more. There's a clear desire for a full revival of the series.
pros: Great 3D CGI for its time.
Faithful visual representation of Alita and the motorball race.
Awesome dance techno soundtrack.
cons: Extremely short runtime.
Lack of dialogue or voice-over.
Frustration due to the lack of continuation of the OVA series.

anime.title: Leviathan: The Last Defense
anime.synopsis: The story is set in Aquafall, a fantasy world abound with water and greenery, and populated by dragons and fairies. Meteorites suddenly bring forth evil creatures that threaten all living things on the planet. The fairy Syrup assembles the Aquafall Defense Force, with three girls of the dragon clans as recruits. The story follows Syrup and the dragon girls Leviathan, Bahamut, and Jörmungandr as they work together to battle enemies and grow up.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally lukewarm. Many find it a passable, lighthearted show to switch your brain off, but are ultimately uninspired. The characters are cute and serve their roles well, but the plot and narrative leave a lot to be desired.
pros: Enjoyable for light-hearted viewing
Some found the character designs appealing
Decent voice acting with famous seiyuu
Effective comedic moments for some viewers
cons: Weak, cliche story with slow development
Generic and bland art style, uninspired character and background designs
Poorly integrated CGI for dragons and Lucasites
Underdeveloped and archetypal characters, some found them annoying
Overuse of fan-service elements
Mediocre and predictable plot
Inconsistent animation quality

anime.title: DD Fist of the North Star
anime.synopsis: In this universe, the apocalypse never happened and the character's of Hokuto no Ken have to survive in modern day Japan by working together.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a parody of Hokuto no Ken set in modern Japan. While the animation and voice acting are acceptable, the humor is geared towards a Japanese audience and falls flat for others. It's recommended only for hardcore fans of the series, especially those from Japan.
pros: Animation is alright.
Voice acting is fine.
Updated intro song is cool.
cons: Humor is not that great.
Humour is mainly suited for the original Japanese audience.
Funny scenes are few and far between.
The anime a chore to watch.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team - A Battle with the Third Dimension
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Dai 08 MS Shoutai - Sanjigen to no Tatakai
anime.synopsis:
Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team - Battle in Three Dimensions is a short film bundled with Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team Blu-ray Memorial Box-set.

The 08th M.S. Team travels through the jungle while on a mission, Shiro Amada checks his map and stops when he spots a long bridge up ahead that spans a wide river, when they are attacked by a group of Zeon..
anime.consensus_summary: The short film is well-received as a bonus feature for fans of the original OVA series. Viewers praise the animation and action, while some wish it were longer. There is a slight preference for the original animation style among some viewers.
pros: Beautiful animation quality.
Faithful to the original OVA series.
Exciting and well-choreographed mobile suit battle.
cons: Very short runtime.
Some may prefer the older animation style.

anime.title: Haitai Nanafa 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Continuation of the first season.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is appreciated for its comedy and chibi style, but the lack of subtitles is a major drawback, hindering full comprehension and enjoyment for non-Japanese speakers. Despite this, the series is considered a 'little gem' for those who enjoy absurd humor. The audience sentiment is positive, albeit limited by accessibility.
pros: Charismatic characters
Enjoyable comedy
Good art style
cons: Lack of subtitles
Story not fully understood due to language barrier

anime.title: The Fruit of Grisaia
anime.genres: Drama, Harem, Psychological, Romance, School, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Yuuji Kazami is a transfer student who has just been admitted into Mihama Academy. He wants to live an ordinary high school life, but this dream of his may not come true any time soon as Mihama Academy is quite the opposite. Consisting of only the principal and five other students, all of whom are girls, Yuuji becomes acquainted with each of them, discovering more about their personalities as socialization is inevitable. Slowly, he begins to learn about the truth behind the small group of students occupying the academy—they each have their own share of traumatic experiences which are tucked away from the world.

Mihama Academy acts as a home for these girls, they are the "fruit" which fell from their trees and have begun to decay. It is up to Yuuji to become the catalyst to save them from themselves, but how can he save another when he cannot even save himself?
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Grisaia no Kajitsu is highly divisive. While some appreciate its attempt to tackle psychological themes and enjoy the character interactions, many criticize it for failing to capture the depth and complexity of the visual novel. Common complaints include rushed pacing, incomplete characterization, and a poorly executed storyline, leading to a disappointing experience for fans of the source material.
pros: Unique theme exploring psychological issues.
Engaging characters with tragic backstories (in the source material).
Some viewers found it highly addictive and enjoyable despite flaws.
cons: Rushed pacing and incomplete characterization due to adaptation constraints.
Failure to adapt the source material's depth and complexity.
Unfocused storyline and poor execution.
Inconsistent tone and unnecessary fan service.
Plot holes and convenient plot devices.

anime.title: Ketsuekigata-kun!
anime.synopsis: Are all A Types kind yet indecisive? Does being a B Type imply the opposite? Are O Types more passionate and childish than others? How would one even get along with AB Types? Ketsuekigata-kun! explores Japanese and Korean cultural stereotypes associated with blood types in romantic and leisurely situations.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Ketsuekigata-kun! to be a light and amusing, albeit stereotypical, show. The voice acting and character designs are praised, but the short episodes and reliance on blood type stereotypes are points of criticism. Most viewers understand it is not meant to be taken seriously and appreciate it as a fun, short comedy.
pros: Great voice acting/casting (seiyuus)
Characters are designed adorably
Comedy is recognizable and fun to watch
cons: Short duration leads to rushed conversations
Personalities presented aren't very accurate
Relies on stereotypes which can be off-putting

anime.title: Dibetagurashi: Ahiru no Seikatsu
anime.synopsis: The story follows the daily life of a group of birds, including a duck, an old nihilistic great grey owl, and a gluttonous Caique parrot.
anime.consensus_summary: The reviewer expresses a profound connection with the anime, particularly with the duck protagonist's hardships. The show appears to be emotionally moving and thought-provoking, inspiring viewers to reflect on the meaning of life and empathize with the protagonist's experiences. It is perceived as a masterpiece that elicits strong emotional responses.
pros: The show evokes a sense of empathy for the main character's struggles.
It inspires a deeper reflection on life's meaning.

anime.title: Hidamari Sketch: Sae & Hiro Graduation
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Slice of Life, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis: The day has come for Sae and Hiro to graduate, who are now in their last days as High School students. The first episode centers on the final exams and the university entrance tests, while the second episode centers on the graduation of Sae and Hiro.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience feels this OVA is a perfect and satisfying end to the series. They appreciate the emotional depth and the way it handles the graduation of key characters. Overall, viewers find it heartwarming and wholesome, providing a sense of closure and joy.
pros: The series is calming and relaxing to watch.
Characters are loveable and feel like a family.
The animation quality improves as the series progresses.
The ending provides a sense of completeness and unity.
cons: Some find the earlier seasons slow-paced.

anime.title: A Town Where You Live
anime.synopsis:
Haruto Kirishima lived a calm life out in the countryside, away from the fast-paced life of the city. Then Yuzuki Eba appeared in his life out of nowhere, having come from Tokyo to briefly live with her family. Their time together left him enamored with the memories of that short period before she just as abruptly disappeared from his life, and left him full of questions.

Kimi no Iru Machi begins some time later, after Haruto moves to Tokyo to live with his sister, in order to pursue a career as a cook. In reality though he wishes to be with Yuzuki. Things don't start good though. When he arrives he is mistaken for a burglar and attacked by his sister's neighbour Mishima Asuka. After the misunderstanding is cleared his feelings begin to waver though. Is Eba, who keeps avoiding him for seemingly no reason, the one for him or is it Asuka?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative due to the anime's poor adaptation of the manga, resulting in a rushed and disjointed story with unlikable characters. Many feel the anime fails to capture the depth and complexity of the source material, leading to frustration and disappointment. While some appreciate the relatable themes and initial animation quality, these aspects are overshadowed by the numerous flaws in pacing, character development, and overall execution.
pros: Relatable relationship situations
Voice acting with varied accents
Animation is visually appealing and colorful (initially)
cons: Rushed and incomplete story adaptation from the manga
Inconsistent art and animation quality, especially in later episodes
Indecisive and unlikable main characters who make frustrating decisions
Generic and forgettable music
Overuse of flashbacks and skipping important character development
Poor pacing that negatively impacts character development and plot progression

anime.title: Recently, my sister is unusual.
anime.romaji_title: Saikin, Imouto no Yousu ga Chotto Okashiinda ga.
anime.synopsis:
Saikin, Imouto no Yousu ga Chotto Okashiinda ga. follows a family just starting to rebuild. When they marry, Mr. and Mrs. Kanzaki bring a teenage son and daughter along for the ride. But high school freshman Mitsuki Kanzaki is less than thrilled. Stinging from a history of absent and abusive father figures, she is slow to accept her stepfather and stepbrother.

But after an accident lands Mitsuki in the hospital, she finds herself possessed by the ghost of Hiyori Kotobuki, a girl her age who was deeply in love with Mitsuki's stepbrother Yuuya. Hiyori cannot pass on to her final reward because of her unrequited love for Yuuya, meaning she's got to consummate it... in Mitsuki's body?!

Now, Mitsuki's life depends on getting Hiyori to Heaven. But will she get used to sharing herself with a pushy, amorous ghost? Can she overcome her distrust of her new family? Can she bring herself to fulfill Hiyori's feelings for Yuuya? And might she be hiding some feelings of her own?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception to 'Saikin, Imouto no Yousu ga Chotto Okashiinda ga' is mixed to negative. While a few viewers found enjoyment in the humor and ecchi elements, the majority criticized the weak story, generic characters, and poor execution. The excessive censorship and disturbing themes further contributed to the negative sentiment, resulting in a polarized audience with strong opinions on both sides.
pros: Some found the premise unique with a twist on the incest genre.
Several reviewers enjoyed the humor and found themselves laughing.
Some appreciated the art style and character designs, finding them cute and appealing.
The OP and ED music were considered catchy and memorable by some.
cons: Many found the story weak, generic, and filled with plot holes.
Characters were criticized as being stereotypical, bland, and lacking development.
The excessive censorship was a major turn-off for many viewers.
The ecchi elements were seen as poorly executed and relying on tired tropes.
Some reviewers were disturbed by the implied sexual assault and non-consensual elements.

anime.title: Stella Women's Academy, High School Division Class C³
anime.synopsis:
Command, control, and communication: the three pillars to successfully execute missions in modern military combat. They are also the source of inspiration behind Stella Women's Academy airsoft club, aptly named the C3 Club. Due to the club's nature, the members have trouble finding newcomers, but, as the school year starts, they hope to find their next sharpshooter among a new crop of students.

Yura Yamato is a freshman at Stella; she sports an unassertive personality that makes it difficult to make friends. She soon discovers her absent roommate owns a massive collection of military memorabilia and movies, including a replica Desert Eagle. When one of the C3 Club's members catches Yura re-enacting an action movie, she drags her into the Club's airsoft practice match. Despite being on the losing side, Yura is unexpectedly drawn to the excitement of the game.

Upon her return, Yura's roommate—Sonora Kashima—reveals herself to be the C3 Club's president and invites her to join. Now with Sonora by her side, one more exhilarating match convinces Yura to sign up. Thanks to her new teammates, Yura discovers a hidden side to herself and an unexpected love for airsoft. However, as her dedication to the game slowly takes over her life, Yura finds herself on the path of great change and success—one that may easily lead to self-destruction.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some appreciating the character development and unique blend of genres, while others criticize the inconsistent animation, underdeveloped side characters, and disjointed plot. The show starts off well but goes in too many directions, with the ending being a point of contention. Overall, viewers seem to acknowledge the show's potential but are divided on its execution.
pros: Strong character development of Yura
Jazz soundtrack enhances airsoft scenes
Meaningful exploration of competition and fun
cons: Inconsistent animation quality
Underdeveloped side characters
Disjointed plot with poorly integrated supernatural elements
Ending suffers from extreme convenience and WTFery

anime.title: A Good Librarian Like a Good Shepherd
anime.synopsis:
"The Shepherd," an urban legend of Shiomi Academy, is said to appear before hardworking students to grant them a wish. 

While engrossed in a book inside the school's renowned Great Library, Kyoutarou Kakei, a second year student and the Library Club's de facto president, receives an email from the Shepherd foretelling an event that will change his fate. Worried by the message, Kyoutarou rushes over to a nearby train station and encounters fellow student Tsugumi Shirasaki, whom he saves from being hit by a derailing train. Grateful for his heroic actions, Tsugumi joins the Library Club and invites Kyoutarou to participate in her mysterious "Shiomi Happy Project." Together with other new members of the club, they strive to make the academy a better place and uncover the identity of the enigmatic Shepherd.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, viewers found 'Daitoshokan no Hitsujikai' to be a generally pleasant and inoffensive watch, especially for fans of the slice-of-life genre. However, many felt the story and characters were generic and underdeveloped, preventing it from being truly memorable. The series is appreciated for its lighthearted atmosphere, but criticized for its lack of depth and rushed plot development.
pros: Comforting and relaxing slice-of-life feel.
Enjoyable character interactions and chemistry.
Smooth story pacing.
cons: Generic and uninspired story and characters.
Underdeveloped plot elements and rushed ending.
Mediocre art and animation quality.

anime.title: Dog & Scissors
anime.synopsis: A nonsense comical mystery. Harumi Kazuhito is a high school boy who loves books and is a fan of novelist Natsuno Kirihime. One day, he finds Kirihime writing at a cafe, about to be shot by a robber. He protects her from the attack but is killed instead. Through the supernatural power of a book-worm, he is reincarnated as a dachshund dog. Kazuhito (as a dog) writhes in a painful bookless life, when a sadistic woman carrying a pair of scissors offers him help. She is Kirihime herself.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards 'Inu to Hasami wa Tsukaiyou' is largely negative. Many find the show's humor repetitive, the plot weak, and the characters underdeveloped and annoying. While some appreciate the initial novelty and unique premise, the overall consensus is that the anime fails to deliver a compelling or enjoyable experience due to its reliance on tired tropes and questionable content.
pros: Unique and strange premise that can be enjoyable for those who appreciate the absurd.
Some reviewers liked the art style and character designs, finding them colorful and vivid.
Some found the voice acting to be well-suited to the characters.
cons: Repetitive jokes and gags that quickly become stale and annoying.
Weak or nonexistent plot with little to no meaningful story progression.
Poor character development, with characters often defined by a single, exaggerated trait.
Questionable and potentially offensive content, including borderline animal abuse, incestuous themes, and objectification of women.
Inconsistent art style, with drastic changes during battle scenes that can be jarring.
Uninspired and forgettable soundtrack.

anime.title: Sparrow's Hotel
anime.synopsis: The comedy revolves around Sayuri Satou, the new front desk worker at the Sparrow's Hotel—"the closest hotel to Heaven". Her special features are her large breasts and her skills of assassination. She takes down people who cause trouble in the business hotel with those skills, but she is in fact very unskilled when talking to the male hotel manager, and often bites her tongue.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some find the show's absurd humor and fast pace enjoyable, while others are turned off by the poor production quality and repetitive jokes. The abrupt art style change mid-series is a major point of contention. Ultimately, the show is seen as a short, inoffensive diversion that may appeal to those with a specific taste for absurdist comedy.
pros: Fast-paced and absurd humor reminiscent of Adult Swim.
Strong premise with potential for iterative storytelling.
Unique and quirky characters with good chemistry, especially Tamaki Shiokawa and Misono.
cons: Poor art quality and animation, particularly in the first half.
Humor relies heavily on a single joke that becomes repetitive.
Characters are one-dimensional and lack development.
Abrupt change in art style mid-series is distracting and unsettling.

anime.title: Pokémon: Black & White: Adventures in Unova and Beyond
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Best Wishes! Season 2: Decolora Adventure
anime.synopsis: After their encounter with Team Plasma, Satoshi, Iris and Dent start a new journey in the Decolora Islands.
anime.consensus_summary: The Decolora Adventure arc is largely considered a low point in the Pokemon series, with many viewers finding it to be a collection of uninspired filler episodes. While some appreciated the foreshadowing of the Kalos region and the theme music, the overwhelming sentiment is one of disappointment due to inconsistent pacing, lack of character development, and a weak overall plot. Many feel that the series peaked before this arc, and that it ultimately detracts from the Pokemon legacy.
pros: Good theme songs
Better region portrayal than previous generations (except Johto)
Tasteful inclusion of Alexa foreshadowing the Kalos region
cons: Inconsistent pacing with many filler episodes
Ash's character is one-dimensional and regresses
Lack of character development for Iris and Cilan
Unmemorable gym battles and a pathetic league
Team Rocket's character shift is a mess
Team Plasma's potential is wasted
Predictable and boring plot

anime.title: Papa no Iukoto wo Kikinasai! OVA
anime.romaji_title: Papa no Iukoto wo Kikinasai! OVA
anime.synopsis: Limited edition episodes included with pre-orders for the 13th and 18th light novel volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVAs are generally well-received for providing closure and emotional moments for fans of the series. However, the second OVA is controversial due to its incestuous themes, and some viewers feel it is poorly executed. There are also criticisms regarding pacing and plot inconsistencies.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to the series with a look into the characters' future.
Emotional and heartwarming moments, especially regarding family bonds.
