Characters are considered cute and their personalities are well-loved.
cons: Some find the second OVA disgusting due to incestuous themes.
Pacing issues with the story feeling rushed in the second OVA.
Unanswered questions and plot holes regarding the characters' living situation.
Filler content and fan service in the first OVA.

anime.title: Golden Time
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Love Polygon, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Due to a tragic accident, Banri Tada is struck with amnesia, dissolving the memories of his hometown and past. However, after befriending Mitsuo Yanagisawa, he decides to move on and begin a new life at law school in Tokyo. But just as he is beginning to adjust to his college life, the beautiful Kouko Kaga dramatically barges into Banri's life, and their chance meeting marks the beginning of an unforgettable year. 

After having a glimpse of college life, Banri learns that he is in a new place and a new world—a place where he can be reborn, have new friends, fall in love, make mistakes, and grow. And as he begins to discover who he was, the path he has chosen leads him towards a blindingly bright life that he will never want to forget.
anime.consensus_summary: Golden Time is a polarizing romantic anime set in a unique college environment. While some appreciate its realistic portrayal of relationships and well-developed characters, others are critical of its wonky amnesia plotline, pacing issues, and frustrating character behaviors. The series' ending and integration of supernatural elements also receive mixed reviews, contributing to its controversial status.
pros: Unique college setting differentiates it from typical high school romances.
Exploration of realistic relationship dynamics and challenges.
Well-developed characters with nuanced portrayals (for some viewers).
cons: Amnesia plotline is wonky and contrived for some viewers.
Pacing issues with slow development in the beginning episodes.
Characters can be overdramatic, invasive, clingy, or annoying.
Ending is underwhelming and unsatisfying for some viewers.
Supernatural elements are poorly integrated and implemented.

anime.title: The Eccentric Family
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Award Winning, Drama, Mythology, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Kyoto has been populated by groups of tanuki and tengu for years, living alongside humans who are oblivious to the existence of these creatures. Yasaburou Shimogamo is the third son of an influential tanuki family who spends his carefree days taking care of an old tengu, observing humans through his ability to shapeshift, and dealing with the mysterious woman named Benten.

Behind the peace and tranquility, however, is a painful memory from long ago as Yasaburou's father, head of the tanuki community, was killed and eaten by a group of humans known as the Friday Fellows. Uchouten Kazoku follows the trials and tribulations of the Shimogamo brothers as they struggle to avoid their own grisly demise while coming ever closer to unraveling the truth behind their father's death.
anime.consensus_summary: Uchouten Kazoku is a unique and visually appealing anime with a strong focus on family and Japanese folklore. While praised for its originality, animation, and character relationships, some viewers found the pacing slow, the romance awkward, and the ending unsatisfying. The audience is moderately divided, with some considering it a masterpiece and others finding it boring or incomplete.
pros: Unique and original story
Beautiful animation and music
Well-developed characters and relationships
Intriguing setting of Kyoto with Tanuki, Tengu, and humans
cons: Slow-paced story
Uncomfortable romance elements
Disappointing payoff or resolution
Thin or unexplained characters

anime.title: Danball Senki Wars
anime.synopsis: Year 2055, four years after the events in Danball Senki W. LBXs have become the world’s largest hobby, big enough for pro leagues to be established, and people to make their entire living off being an LBX player. 14-year-old Arata is a new transfer student at Kamui Daimon Integrated Academy on Kamui Island, near Japan. Known to be the most prestigious institution in the world for raising LBX players and mechanics, entrance to the academy requires an extremely competitive hurdle of being the champion of at least three official tournaments. Along with other members of his platoon, they face rivals and delve into the secrets lurking within the academy.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views Danball Senki Wars as a surprisingly engaging anime despite being targeted towards children. It features a well-structured story with serious undertones and explores themes of war within a school setting. While the school-life setting is considered typical, the overall narrative is well-paced and captivating.
pros: Well-written storyboard
Serious and intense themes
Better pacing compared to previous installments
cons: Usual school-life settings

anime.title: Wish Upon the Pleiades
anime.synopsis:
The sky is the limit in Houkago no Pleiades. With telescope in hand, Subaru is set to go to the observation room of her school in order to get a view of that night's meteor shower. What she least expects is that behind the observatory door was not the starry skies, but a lavish garden, complete with a resplendent fountain and a mysterious young boy with long red hair.

But the garden soon disappeared, as if Subaru was only imagining things. All that remains of that brilliant sight is an odd, bouncing blob creature that leads her to another magical door, occupied by other girls in magical witch-like costumes. Revelations start hitting Subaru one after the other: one of the girls in the room is her childhood friend Aoi, the little blob is actually an alien of a species called the Pleiadians trying to return home, and Subaru has been selected by him to become the newest member of their group!

Now Subaru's dreams of the stars have come true in the wildest way, as she and her friends attempt to gather pieces of the Pleiadian spacecraft engine to return the being to his home. But they're not the only ones after the engine parts, and they have no idea why!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some viewers appreciate the show's beautiful visuals, enjoyable music, and heartwarming themes of friendship, finding it a refreshing take on the magical girl genre. However, many are critical of the confusing and poorly explained plot, underdeveloped characters, and a disappointing ending, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Visually appealing animation, especially space scenes
Catchy and well-fitting soundtrack
Unique blend of magical girl elements with science fiction concepts
Enjoyable and heartwarming, with a pure and positive tone
cons: Confusing and convoluted plot, especially in the later episodes
Weak or underdeveloped characters, lacking depth and complexity
Formulaic and repetitive story structure in the first half
Poorly explained concepts and inconsistencies in the world-building
Ending may not make sense or provide satisfactory closure

anime.title: Freezing Vibration
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Ecchi, Harem, Military, Romance, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Ever since the 10th NOVA clash, the Chevalier had concluded that the NOVA have been appearing at a steadier rate and they are losing more Pandoras than they can produce. Their solution is the E-Pandora Project which involves normal humans being given the power to become Pandoras. Inviting Pandora from around the world to their Alaskan base witness the unveiling of their new project, Satellizer, Kazuya and Rana are among those who have been summoned. However, as time goes the E-Pandora Project starts to become fishier and the Pandoras start to grow more and more concerned...
anime.consensus_summary: Freezing Vibration is largely considered a disappointing sequel. Reviewers found the plot to be weak and rushed, the new characters uninteresting, and the fan service forced. While the art and music received praise, the overall consensus is that the series fails to live up to the first season and is not a worthwhile watch unless one has already invested heavily in the franchise.
pros: Good art style, consistent with the first season; detailed character and background art.
Excellent soundtrack, particularly the opening theme and battle music.
The series attempts to explore deeper themes like the consequences of human experimentation and social inequality.
cons: Poor story with rushed pacing and a weak plot compared to the first season.
Forced and unnecessary fanservice that detracts from the story.
Underdeveloped and uninteresting new characters, with a lack of character development for returning characters.
Inconsistent tone, mixing ecchi elements with darker themes like torture and death.
The main character Kazuya is reduced to a supporting role and lacks development.
Censoring of fan service scenes

anime.title: Rozen Maiden: Zurückspulen
anime.synopsis:
During the events of the original Rozen Maiden, after circling "yes" on a paper and agreeing to wind an unknown  "something," a traumatized Jun Sakurada fights alongside the lifelike dolls known as the Rozen Maidens. But what would have happened if Jun had circled "no"?

Jun, having gotten over his school trauma from his younger days, spends his time attending college and working in a bookstore. However, he does not feel as though he belongs anywhere. One day, he finds a book containing instructions on how to make a Rozen Maiden. Mysteriously, when he arrives home that night, the second volume in the book series has been delivered to his house, along with some pieces of a doll. But as suddenly as they started arriving, the books stop coming, and Jun gets a notice that says that the books have ceased being published. With an incomplete doll in hand, and a message from his other self in another world, this Jun also finds his way into the world of the Rozen Maidens.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While praised for its art style, mature themes, and character development, many are disappointed by the rushed introduction, incomplete story, and uneven pacing. Some viewers felt alienated by the focus on Jun and the lack of development for other dolls. Ultimately, the series is recommended mainly for die-hard Rozen Maiden fans who are already familiar with the franchise.
pros: Beautiful and unique art style with watercolor backgrounds
Exploration of mature themes such as regret, redemption, and social anxiety
Well-developed characters, particularly Jun, Shinku, and Suigintou
cons: Rushed first episode that assumes prior knowledge of the franchise
Incomplete story with a cliffhanger ending and unresolved plot threads
Uneven pacing, with a slow first half and a rushed second half
Underdeveloped antagonist (Kirakishou) with little depth
Too much focus on Jun, alienating fans who prefer the dolls

anime.title: Koi to Senkyo to Chocolate: Koi Imouto!
anime.romaji_title: Koi to Senkyo to Chocolate: Koi Imouto!
anime.synopsis: Unaired 13th episode released on the 7th DVD/BD.
anime.consensus_summary: This special episode offers a relaxing slice-of-life experience with a focus on comedy and romance, contrasting with the original series' drama. While the art and new character introductions are praised, the lack of familiar characters and plot intensity may be a drawback for some viewers.
pros: Appealing and lively art style with cute character designs.
Good introduction to new characters with distinct personalities.
Focus on foodservice and cooking elements provides a pleasant viewing experience.
cons: Lacks serious drama or decisive plot twists compared to the original series.
Absence of important original characters may disappoint some fans.

anime.title: Hakkenden -Eight Dogs of the East- Season 2
anime.synopsis: The journey to find all eight sacred gems continues, as Sousuke and Shino travel in search of the remaining gem holders. From the shadows the Imperial Church continues to scheme, and a mysterious woman seeks to fulfill a sinister plot with the gem holders at its heart. As the origin of the gems comes to light, so does the truth behind Sousuke's doppelganger, Ao, as he resurfaces with his own goal—one involving Sousuke and his gem!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with appreciation for character development and emotional moments, but criticism towards rushed plot elements. Many fans are hoping for a continuation, demonstrating continued interest despite perceived flaws. The story's ending felt hasty to some, leaving a desire for more resolution.
pros: Focus on characters and their development.
Emotional depth and impactful moments.
Intriguing plot elements and unexpected twists.
cons: Rushed plot and pacing issues.
Inconsistent episode quality.
Side-plots that detract from the main story.

anime.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Galaxy
anime.genres: Space, Sports, Super Power, Team Sports
anime.synopsis:
After fighting to free the game of soccer in Japan from the Fifth Sector, the country's soccer squads can once again look forward to stepping onto the field. However, a new challenge will emerge for Japanese players in the form of the Football Frontier International Vision 2, a new tournament that will bring together the best teams each country can assemble.

Tenma Matsukaze and his Raimon teammates, Takuto Shindou and Kyousuke Tsurugi, are once again part of the action as they have been selected to play for the Japanese representative, Inazuma Japan. Much to their surprise, the coach selects eight other players that have no previous experience playing soccer!

Team Inazuma Japan will have a huge mountain to climb, building chemistry and skills as they go along. What they don’t know is that the tournament will set the stage for something much bigger, something out of this world in Inazuma Eleven Go: Galaxy!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Inazuma Eleven Go: Galaxy is well-received, especially for its new characters and unexpected plot twists. While some find the plot predictable at times and critique the underdeveloped backstories of certain characters, the captivating music, improved visuals, and adventurous storyline contribute to a positive viewing experience. The show is generally considered enjoyable for both children and older fans of the franchise.
pros: Well-developed new characters with meaningful backstories.
Captivating musical score and effective sound design.
Improved CGI integration compared to previous seasons.
Unexpected plot twist involving aliens creates a sense of adventure.
cons: Underdeveloped backstories for returning characters and aliens.
Predictable plot in the first half.
Bright colors can be visually tiring.
Some may find the art style cringeworthy at times.

anime.title: Recorder and Randsell Mi
anime.synopsis: Third season of Recorder to Randoseru.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed due to a noticeable decline in animation quality, although some appreciate the introduction of new characters and the shift in comedic focus. The plot still revolves around the height differences of the main characters. Some viewers found the new comedic elements and character dynamics enjoyable, while others disliked the change in animation and humor.
pros: Addition of new characters provides fresh humor and situations.
Storyline improvements, particularly on the relationship front.
cons: Significant drop in visual quality and animation compared to previous seasons.
Simpler shading and less detailed backgrounds.
Over-reliance on loli jokes polarizing viewers.

anime.title: Magi: The Kingdom of Magic
anime.synopsis:
After celebrating their victory against Al-Thamen, Aladdin and his friends depart the land of Sindria. With the end of the battle, however, comes the time for each of them to go their separate ways. Hakuryuu and Kougyoku are ordered to go back to their home country, the Kou Empire. Meanwhile Aladdin announces he needs to head for Magnostadt—a mysterious country ruled by magicians—to investigate the mysterious events occurring in this new kingdom and become more proficient in magic. For their part, encouraged by Aladdin's words, Alibaba and Morgiana also set off in pursuit of their own goals: training and going to her homeland, respectively.

Magi: The Kingdom of Magic follows these friends as they all go about their separate adventures, each facing their own challenges. However, a new threat begins to rise as a great war looms over the horizon...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience is positive about Magi: The Kingdom of Magic. They praise its engaging story, beautiful animation, and well-developed characters. However, some criticize the pacing, inconsistent plot direction, and unconcluded story elements, but the positive aspects outweigh the negatives for most viewers.
pros: Great story with emotional depth.
Amazing art and animation.
Well-developed and interesting characters.
Exploration of deeper themes like social hierarchy and morality.
cons: Slow pacing in the initial episodes.
Unconcluded plot points and lack of explanations.
Inconsistent story direction with unrelated arcs.
Action scenes taking a backseat to dialogue.

anime.title: Servant x Service
anime.synopsis:
Frustrating, insufficient, and irritating is how most citizens would describe civil servants. However, three new employees are about to discover what really happens behind the scenes. Lucy Yamagami, bent on revenge against the civil servant who allowed her comically long name to be put on her birth certificate; Yutaka Hasebe, an easygoing guy always on the lookout for a place to slack off; and Saya Miyoshi, a nervous first-time worker, are about to experience the underwhelming satisfaction of being government employees. 

They are supposed to be trained by Taishi Ichimiya, but he has no idea how to do so, even though he has worked there for eight years. With an incompetent senior colleague and unfavorable confrontations with clients, the trio starts to lose faith in their chosen occupation but encourage each other to do their best.
anime.consensus_summary: Servant x Service is a lighthearted office comedy with a slice-of-life feel. While many find it enjoyable due to its quirky characters and consistent humor, some criticize its lack of plot development and repetitive jokes. The series is generally seen as a pleasant and easy watch, though not particularly groundbreaking.
pros: Enjoyable characters with unique quirks.
Consistent comedy throughout the series.
Relatable office environment.
Lighthearted and easy to watch.
cons: Lack of significant plot progression.
Repetitive humor.
Episodic nature can make it feel directionless.
Some jokes rely on tired tropes (e.g., breast size humor).
Romance plot is considered weak and underdeveloped by some.
anime.thematic_vibe: Office Comedy, Slice of Life, Romantic Undertones

anime.title: Teekyu 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Teekyu series.
anime.consensus_summary: Teekyuu 2 is a very fast-paced and absurd comedy that may not appeal to everyone. Some viewers appreciate its chaotic energy and as a break from more serious anime, while others find it too difficult to follow and lacking in substance. The improved animation is a plus, but the stagnant characters and nonsensical plot are consistent criticisms. Overall, audience appreciation seems to rely on one's tolerance for extremely rapid-fire, referential humor.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to the first season.
Some find the show enjoyable as a break from darker, plot-heavy shows.
The show provides a hurricane of energy
Unique, fast-paced comedy that flows like a normal anime.
cons: Extremely fast-paced, making it difficult to follow the plot and jokes.
Stagnant characters with no character development.
The plot is nonsensical and quickly forgotten.
Some find it hard to laugh, or they miss content if they do.
Plot can be a complete mess.

anime.title: Train Heroes
anime.synopsis:
2100A.D. The world has entered a new age of super high-speed railways. The World Railway Conference has introduced the Laser Rail, a whole new form of travel in which trains are no longer confined to the ground.

To operate on the Laser Rail, the Train Base is established. Here, trains from across the globe, installed with artificial intelligences and robot bodies. Thus the Train Heroes are born.

Within the Train Base, these Train Heroes undergo strict training sessions. On occasion, they are called upon to assist in disaster rescue and relief.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience deeply connects with the characters and themes of belonging and acceptance presented in Train Heroes. The show's art style and sound design are highly praised. The show fosters a sense of self-discovery and personal transformation within the viewer, leading to a strong, positive emotional response.
pros: Characters mesh perfectly with the story.
Art style is incredible and beautiful.
Sound effects fit in at perfect times.

anime.title: Tonari no Seki-kun: The Master of Killing Time
anime.synopsis: All Rumi Yokoi wants to do is focus during school, but she is constantly distracted by Toshinari Seki, her neighboring classmate. Paying attention during class is the least of Seki's worries, as he obsesses over intricate setups created using an assortment of items, from an elaborate domino course on his desk to a treacherous war played out with shogi pieces. Yokoi desperately attempts to focus in class, only to be repeatedly sucked into his intriguing eccentricities; however, they always seem to end up with her getting in trouble with their teacher. Fortunately, lessons will never be dull with Seki's antics around!
anime.consensus_summary: The show is well-received for its creative and amusing scenarios, perfect for short viewing sessions. However, its formulaic nature and simple plot can lead to repetitiveness and a lack of depth for some viewers. The humor is generally appreciated, though it may not always be laugh-out-loud funny.
pros: Creative and inventive scenarios.
Charming and likable characters.
Well-implemented animation conveys personality.
Perfect for short viewing sessions.
cons: Formulaic structure can become repetitive.
Simple plot may not appeal to all viewers.
Humor may not always elicit strong laughter.
Relies heavily on a single joke/premise.

anime.title: Beyond the Boundary
anime.synopsis:
Mirai Kuriyama is the sole survivor of a clan of Spirit World warriors with the power to employ their blood as weapons. As such, Mirai is tasked with hunting down and killing "youmu"—creatures said to be the manifestation of negative human emotions. One day, while deep in thought on the school roof, Mirai comes across Akihito Kanbara, a rare half-breed of youmu in human form. In a panicked state, she plunges her blood saber into him only to realize that he's an immortal being. From then on, the two form an impromptu friendship that revolves around Mirai constantly trying to kill Akihito, in an effort to boost her own wavering confidence as a Spirit World warrior. Eventually, Akihito also manages to convince her to join the Literary Club, which houses two other powerful Spirit World warriors, Hiroomi and Mitsuki Nase.

As the group's bond strengthens, however, so does the tenacity of the youmu around them. Their misadventures will soon turn into a fight for survival as the inevitable release of the most powerful youmu, Beyond the Boundary, approaches.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While praised for its stunning visuals and entertaining elements, many find the plot convoluted and the characters underdeveloped. The ending is considered rushed and forced by some, leading to a sense of unfulfilled potential despite its enjoyable aspects.
pros: Gorgeous animation and art style, especially action scenes.
Enjoyable and entertaining ride with a blend of action and comedy.
Interesting premise with potential for deeper exploration.
cons: Poorly explained plot and setup with plot holes.
Generic story with unoriginal elements.
Forced and unnatural ending.
Character development is lacking.

anime.title: Yowamushi Pedal
anime.synopsis:
Sakamichi Onoda is a cheerful otaku looking to join his new school's anime club, eager to finally make some friends. Unfortunately, the club has been disbanded and he takes it upon himself to revive it by finding students who are willing to join. Without much luck, Onoda decides to make a round trip to Akihabara on his old, bulky city bicycle, a weekly 90-kilometer ride he has been completing since fourth grade.
 
This is when he meets fellow first year student, Shunsuke Imaizumi, a determined cyclist who is using the school's steep incline for practice. Surprised by Onoda's ability to climb the hill with his specific type of bicycle, Imaizumi challenges him to a race, with the proposition of joining the anime club should Onoda win. And thus begins the young boy's first foray into the world of high school bicycle racing!
anime.consensus_summary: Yowamushi Pedal is a generally well-received sports anime, praised for its character development and focus on friendship. However, some viewers find the storyline predictable and the portrayal of cycling unrealistic. Despite its flaws, many enjoy the show for its entertainment value and the passion it conveys.
pros: Character development is amazing and diverse, making them seem real and lovable.
The anime provides a new perspective on cycling, highlighting the fun behind it.
The story is simple and easy to follow, with exciting competitions.
cons: The story can be predictable and clichéd, following standard shounen tropes.
Some find the portrayal of cycling unrealistic, lacking real-world logic and strategy.
The series relies heavily on sports anime cliches.

anime.title: Little Busters! ~Refrain~
anime.synopsis:
Following the Little Busters after they lost their first baseball game, the team decides to have a pancake party. It has been almost one semester since the return of Kyousuke Natsume. As usual, Riki Naoe continues to help the Little Busters' members—both old and new—with confronting their inner struggles. However, strange happenings begin to occur, leading Rin Natsume and Riki closer to unraveling the truth behind the "secret of this world."

Little do Rin and Rikki know, their discovery will end up changing the peaceful everyday lives created by the Little Busters once and for all. Little Busters!: Refrain brings a conclusion to the colorful stories of its ensemble cast—forged with the weight of emotions and strengthened with the bond of friendship—as they come to terms with their regrets and weaknesses.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with many viewers praising 'Little Busters! Refrain' as a significant improvement over its first season. The show is lauded for its emotional depth, character development, and exploration of meaningful themes. While some reviewers point out flaws in the plot and pacing, the overall sentiment is that 'Refrain' is a compelling and emotionally resonant anime that effectively concludes the 'Little Busters!' story.
pros: Significant improvement over the first season in terms of story, animation, and emotional impact.
Strong character development, particularly for Riki, Rin, and Kyousuke.
Effective use of foreshadowing and plot twists.
Meaningful exploration of themes like friendship, loss, and growing up.
Impactful soundtrack that enhances the emotional scenes.
cons: Some plot elements feel rushed or poorly explained, especially the supernatural aspects.
Pacing issues and confusing transitions in the later episodes.
Uneven character arcs, with some characters being underdeveloped or sidelined.
Reliance on melodrama can feel artificial or forced at times.
May not appeal to viewers who dislike tearjerkers or prefer more subtle storytelling.

anime.title: World Fool News
anime.synopsis: Normally, becoming the anchor of a nightly news program would be a huge opportunity. However, Ichitarou Takahashi will be anchoring World Fool News, a program infamous for its low ratings and bizarre staff. As he settles into his new department, he finds that his coworkers are just as strange as the rumors claimed. But as he continues to work alongside them, Takahashi starts to realize that he might have found a place where he can truly belong.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the show, highlighting its unique art style, comedic elements, and jazzy soundtrack. A minor disappointment is the absence of an official soundtrack release. The show does not appear to be controversial, fostering a positive reception.
pros: Unique and colorful art style
Enjoyable story and comedy
Wonderful jazzy soundtrack
cons: No original soundtrack release

anime.title: Gatchaman Crowds
anime.synopsis: Hajime Ichinose's ordinary life is in for a change when a transcendent being named J.J Robinson hands her a small book called NOTE—a device which transforms her into one of the Gatchaman, the legendary protectors of Tachikawa City. Stressing that the existence of their group must remain a secret, fellow Gatchaman Sugane Tachibana takes Hajime to their base of operations, where Paiman, the panda-like alien leader of the Gatchaman, reveals their purpose: to eliminate aliens that pose a danger to humanity. These existential threats, called MESS, are becoming increasingly dangerous, destroying everything they touch. Now it's up to the Gatchaman and their new recruit to stop them before the world is engulfed in chaos.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Many appreciate the show's unique art style, soundtrack, and exploration of social themes, finding it thought-provoking and visually appealing. However, others are critical of the inconsistent story, underdeveloped characters, and especially the rushed and confusing ending. The main character, Hajime, is a particularly polarizing figure, with some finding her endearing and others incredibly annoying.
pros: Unique and vibrant art style with well-animated action sequences.
Thought-provoking exploration of social networking and its impact on society.
Memorable and fitting soundtrack blending various genres.
Engaging main character (for some viewers) who challenges traditional superhero tropes.
cons: Inconsistent and rushed story, particularly towards the ending.
Underdeveloped secondary characters.
Annoying or unlikable main character (for some viewers).
Unexplained plot points and unresolved conflicts.

anime.title: White Album 2
anime.synopsis:
Haruki Kitahara's light music club is on the verge of disbanding. At this rate, the third year's dream of performing at the school festival would never be realized. However, as his exhausted fingers drift through the chords of "White Album," the first song he would ever play, an angelic voice and mysterious piano begin harmonizing with his lonely guitar. It is a momentous performance that marks the beginning of everything for Haruki.
 
White Album 2 orchestrates Haruki's final semester with complex romance and exhilarating music, as the curtains of the stage he so desired begin to open...
anime.consensus_summary: White Album 2 is a romance anime that elicits strong emotional responses. While praised for its realistic portrayal of relationships and excellent music, some viewers find the characters flawed and the ending unsatisfactory. The series is a faithful adaptation of the visual novel, but its mature themes and complex characters may not appeal to all audiences.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the visual novel.
Realistic and mature portrayal of love and relationships.
Excellent music and voice acting.
Well-paced and engaging story.
cons: Some find the characters unlikable or frustrating.
The ending is disappointing to some viewers.
The animation quality can be inconsistent.
Later part of anime fails to live up to the initial promise.

anime.title: Infinite Stratos 2
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: Second season of Infinite Stratos.
anime.consensus_summary: Infinite Stratos 2 is largely considered a disappointing sequel that doubles down on the negative aspects of the first season. Critics cite a weak, fan-service-heavy plot, poor character development, and an unlikeable protagonist. While some appreciate the animation and occasional comedic moments, the overall sentiment is that the series fails to deliver a compelling narrative or meaningful character arcs, resulting in a generally negative reception.
pros: Good animation quality, especially in mecha fight scenes.
Some viewers found the scenarios enjoyable despite cliches due to their execution.
The art style is well-drawn and detailed.
cons: Poorly written story with little plot and muddled serious drama.
Over-reliance on fan service at the expense of plot development.
Ichika is an insipid and dense protagonist, lacking character development.
Female characters are poorly developed and reduced to harem tropes.
Comedy is haphazard and relies on tired gags.
New characters are poorly integrated and lack depth.
Plot execution is flawed, with forced and unnecessary cut scenes.

anime.title: Strike the Blood
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, School, Urban Fantasy, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Kojou Akatsuki's days as an ordinary high school student in the Demon District of Itogami Island come to an abrupt end after a fateful encounter leaves him with the remarkable abilities of a vampire.

It isn't long before he is thrust into the center of attention when it is discovered that he is the fourth primogenitor, an immensely powerful vampire whom most consider to be merely a legend. Fearing Kojou's destructive potential, the Lion King Organization sends in an apprentice sword-shaman, Yukina Himeragi, to monitor, and should he become a threat, kill the boy deemed the world's most powerful vampire. Forced together by circumstance, the two form an unlikely alliance as Kojou comes to terms with his abilities and they both struggle to protect the city from various emerging chaotic forces.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided; some find it an entertaining action-harem anime with good art and fun characters, while others criticize its unoriginal plot, excessive fan service, and underdeveloped main character. Many feel the story becomes repetitive, and the lack of plot progression is a major drawback. The action is generally appreciated, but the overabundance of ecchi elements can be off-putting.
pros: Good action sequences and magic effects.
Enjoyable characters with varying personalities.
Smooth storyline with well-defined character relationships.
Art style is appealing, especially the character designs.
cons: Simplistic and predictable story arcs.
Main character's potential is not fully realized; lacks solo victories.
Over-reliance on fan service and ecchi elements.
Plot holes and unanswered questions regarding the main character's origins.
Repetitive dialogue and predictable misunderstandings.

anime.title: Valvrave the Liberator 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Haruto and his comrades continue to fight against the forces of Dorssia. However, many things remain unanswered in the midst of battle, including the past of L-Elf and his fellow soldier's past, the destiny of the mysterious girl Liselotte, and the feelings of Haruto, Shouko, and Saki. The relationships and loyalty of each and every member of each army will be tested as the clash of ideals and power reaches its climax.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed, with some finding the second season to be an amazing and intense ride, while others criticize the rushed ending and shallow writing. Some appreciate the political intrigue and character development, but others find the plot convoluted and hard to follow. Ultimately, the enjoyment of the series depends on individual tolerance for plot inconsistencies and a willingness to embrace the tragic elements.
pros: Exciting plot twists and surprises.
Good use of supporting characters and their deaths to impact the story.
The story capitalizes on political backstory to create an interesting premise.
cons: Unstable story pacing, with a rushed ending.
Some scenes feel predictable due to being told out of order.
The plot is jumbled, with irrelevant details and shallow characters.
Some plot points don't go anywhere, and the writing is generally shallow.

anime.title: Mini Van
anime.synopsis: An animated flash series of the manga Mini Vanguard.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Mini Van' series is a lighthearted and comedic take on the original Cardfight Vanguard, appealing to fans who enjoy seeing the characters in a slice-of-life setting. While the story is minimal, the humor and character interactions are well-received.  Viewers generally find it enjoyable, especially if they are already familiar with the first season of Cardfight Vanguard.
pros: Hilarious characters
Short and easy to watch
Enjoyable for fans of the original series
cons: Non-existent story
Requires knowledge of the first season

anime.title: Fairy Tail x Rave
anime.synopsis:
While on a mission to find and defeat a troublesome mage, several members of the Fairy Tail guild are split up in an unfamiliar town. At the same time, Haru, Elie, and the rest of their group are also separated. In a fortunate turn of events, Elie runs into Lucy and Happy, who are looking for Natsu. Meanwhile, Haru stumbles upon Natsu, who is struggling with motion sickness. Although she seems friendly, Elie matches the description of the troublemaker that the Fairy Tail members were assigned to locate. To make matters worse, Natsu learns of Haru's relationship with her and suspects them to be accomplices.

In this crossover between two popular series, Fairy Tail x Rave follows the two groups as they discover their similarities with each other. As the miscommunications add up, they are pitted against one another in a heated clash of powers, but will have to work together against a common foe.
anime.consensus_summary: This crossover OVA is a highly enjoyable experience for fans of either Fairy Tail or Rave Master, praised for its character interactions, animation, and music. However, critics point to a weak, generic plot and excessive, often pointless, fan service as significant drawbacks, suggesting it prioritizes these elements over narrative depth or originality.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions and team-ups between Fairy Tail and Rave characters.
High-quality animation and art style, potentially an improvement over regular Fairy Tail.
Excellent integration of music and voice acting from both series.
Humorous moments and lighthearted tone make it fun.
Appeals strongly to fans of both franchises.
cons: Plot is considered bland, typical, and uninspired, especially for long-time shonen fans.
Relies heavily on fan service, with some deeming it pointless and excessive.
Character recycling and lack of creative originality from the author are noted.
The narrative tone is inconsistent, attempting tension but not taking itself seriously.
Some characters from Rave may not be recognizable to those who only watched the anime.

anime.title: Attack on Titan OAD
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Ilse no Techou: Aru Chousa Heidanin no Shuki
During the Survey Corps' 49th recon mission, Hange Zoë is determined to capture a titan specimen. Despite not receiving clearance from Commander Erwin Smith, when a titan is spotted in nearby forestland, Hange rides out alone to meet it. Recklessly luring it out, she asks the titan numerous questions and puts her life on the line for the sake of her research. However, the behavior of this particular titan is far from normal. It quickly turns back and enters the wood once again, leading Hange to somewhere specific. What Hange finds is the legacy of former scout Ilse Langnar. In spite of her death, she provides a valuable piece of information that may serve to turn the tide for titan research—a diary documenting her last moments.

Totsuzen no Raihousha: Sainamareru Seishun no Noroi
Jean Kirstein would do anything to escape his boring home life and overbearing mother. After enlisting in the military, it became his ultimate goal to join the Military Police regiment and live out in peace and luxury. However, during his time with the 104th Training Corps, things never really go the way Jean wants them to. Eventually, the stolen glory and condescending banter of his comrades become too much—and Jean challenges fellow cadet Sasha Blouse to a battle, in order to determine which of them is strongest—but who will come out on top?

Konnan
The 104th Training Corps' most recent mission is a trek on horseback into the forest. Although a test of their ability to stay alert even in non-threatening situations, the task is boring and can lead to in-fighting. This is especially true for one of the groups, lead by Marco Bott. Some want to stay true to the mission they have been tasked with, and the rest would rather slack off, occupying themselves with more exciting activities. But when trouble strikes, they are completely unprepared.
anime.consensus_summary: The Shingeki no Kyojin OVAs are a mixed bag, with some episodes being well-received for their world-building and character focus, while others are criticized for being filler or poorly executed. The first OVA, focusing on Ilse's notebook, is generally considered the strongest. Overall, the OVAs are recommended for fans wanting more content but with tempered expectations.
pros: The first OVA (Ilse's Notebook) adds valuable information to the world and lore.
Focuses on interesting characters like Hange, Levi, Jean and Sasha, providing more depth.
Some find the character interactions and 'dicking around' enjoyable and appealing.
High-quality animation and sound, consistent with the main series.
cons: Some episodes are considered filler and unnecessary, with little impact on the main story.
Episode 2 is criticized for weak humor and ruining Jean's character.
Episode 3 is considered the worst, lacking titans and feeling disconnected from the main series.
Some viewers find certain character gags (e.g., Aluo biting his tongue) annoying.

anime.title: Gingitsune: Messenger Fox of the Gods
anime.genres: Mythology, Seinen, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Gintarou is a fox spirit that has been protecting the small Inari temple since the Edo era. Saeki Makoto's family possesses the power to see the gods' agent, but the ability is limited to one living relative at a time. When Makoto's mother passed away while she was still young, Makoto inherited the ability as the sole remaining family member. With the help of fox spirit's power, Makoto and Gintarou help the people of their community, in spite of their many differences.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Gingitsune' to be a heartwarming and relaxing slice-of-life anime with meaningful character relationships and beautiful visuals. Some appreciate its subtle storytelling and focus on everyday life, while others criticize its slow pace and lack of a strong central plot. Overall, it's considered a pleasant and wholesome show, though not particularly groundbreaking.
pros: Meaningful and authentic character relationships
Relaxing and heartwarming atmosphere
Beautiful visuals and scenery
Subtle and refined presentation of values
Well-developed minor characters
cons: Slow pacing
Episodic with no central story
Lack of plot development
Simplistic and not particularly original
Can be uneventful for those seeking strong plot

anime.title: Lupin III vs. Detective Conan: The Movie
anime.romaji_title: Lupin III vs. Meitantei Conan: The Movie
anime.synopsis: It is a cross over between the series Lupin III and Detective Conan and takes place after the television special Lupin the 3rd vs Detective Conan. The plot follows Conan Edogawa who sets out to apprehend Arsène Lupin III, the suspect of stealing a jewel called Cherry Sapphire.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some viewers enjoyed the crossover elements, clever references, and thrilling moments, others found the plot bland, poorly executed, and lacking payoff. There's a sentiment that the movie favors Detective Conan over Lupin III, potentially alienating some Lupin fans.
pros: Fun crossover appealing to fans of both series.
Clever references and mock opening sequences.
Good voice acting in some scenes.
Thrilling plot and execution.
cons: Poorly executed story with a bland plot.
Lack of payoff for multiple subplots.
Lupin's limited screen time.
Unresolved storylines.

anime.title: Blood Lad OVA
anime.romaji_title: Blood Lad: Wagahai wa Neko de wa Nai
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Delinquents, Fantasy, Mythology, Seinen, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the tenth limited-edition volume of Blood Lad manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a mixed bag for fans. While some appreciate the continuation of the story and the introduction of new elements, others find it disjointed, generic, and unsatisfying as a conclusion to the series. The lack of resolution and the rushed feeling contribute to a polarized reception.
pros: Continuation of the story from where the TV series left off.
Colorful and fun art style consistent with the original series.
Introduction of new characters with unique powers and characteristics.
Adapts the manga storyline well.
cons: The ending is vague and does not provide a satisfying conclusion.
Feels rushed and does not give the story a fair shot.
Detached from the actual anime with little bearing on the overall story.
Offensively generic plot that feels cheap and soulless.

anime.title: Genshiken Second Season
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Otaku Culture, Parody, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Another college semester begins and the returning members of Genshiken attempt to recruit new club members. Three new members join the club, attracted by Ogiue's BL drawings. She welcomes the new members but fears the club will become a "fujoshi" haven for yaoi fans and is getting a bit too far removed from its original purpose.
anime.consensus_summary: Genshiken Nidaime is a divisive installment in the franchise. While some appreciate its exploration of new themes and characters, particularly those related to gender identity and shifting otaku culture, others criticize its over-reliance on BL tropes and the diminished presence of beloved original characters. This shift in focus led to a polarized reception among viewers, with some feeling alienated by the changes.
pros: Exploration of new characters and perspectives, particularly Hato's character arc.
Continues the established slice-of-life and otaku culture themes of the original series.
Addresses changing demographics within otaku communities.
cons: Over-emphasis on BL (Boys' Love) and transgender themes alienates some viewers.
Neglect of original characters and storylines disappoints long-time fans.
Humor and character dynamics are considered less engaging compared to previous seasons.
anime.thematic_vibe: Otaku Culture, Gender Identity, Shifting Demographics

anime.title: Chronicles of the Going Home Club
anime.synopsis: When a friend asks Natsuki what high school club she's going to join, she cheerfully responds "the go-home club" (meaning, she's not going to join any of them). However, she soon realizes that this club actually exists at her high school, and she's just expressed interest in joining it! Before she knows it, she ends up as one of the two new members of "the go-home club," which is a small group of eccentric school girls. One of the girls likes fighting bears, while another is ridiculously rich. But what exactly constitutes the activities of "the go-home club"?
anime.consensus_summary: Kitaku-bu Katsudou Kiroku is a comedic anime that is appreciated for its absurdist humor and fourth-wall breaking. While some find the pacing slow and references obscure, others enjoy the lightheartedness and unique characters. The series is generally considered a fun, easy-going watch for those who enjoy gag anime.
pros: Strong comedic timing and use of meta-humor/fourth-wall breaks
Catchy soundtrack and well-fitting OP/ED themes
Enjoyable characters and voice acting, particularly Sakura's voice actress
cons: Slow pacing and reliance on niche references that some viewers may not understand
Lack of significant plot or character development
Simple art style that may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Yozakura Quartet: Hana no Uta
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Mythology, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Hundreds of years ago, the borders between the worlds of humans and youkai temporarily overlapped, resulting in many residents of both crossing over to the other side. In the years since this event, the city of Sakurashin has become a central hub for all inter-dimensional affairs—a result of both the sacred Seven Pillars around the city serving as a beacon for the youkai, and the efforts of the Hiizumi Life Counseling Office in keeping the townsfolk happy. This office is composed of Hime Yarizakura, the young mayor of the city; satori Ao Nanami, who can read people's minds; half-youkai Kotoha Isone, who can summon anything by speaking a word; oni siblings, Kyousuke and Touka Kishi; and the office director Akina Hiizumi, who inherited his family's ability to force youkai back to their world.

Besides volunteer and arbitration work, the Life Counseling Office also suppresses any Strikes: rare occurrences where humans are suddenly infused with youkai powers and go on a rampage. But the appearance of a sinister man signals trouble as Strikes become increasingly common, political rivals make their moves, and malicious individuals descend upon the city. As the self-appointed defenders of Sakurashin, it's up to the Life Counseling Office to protect the idyllic city they call home!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many appreciate the visual appeal, action, and characters, but are disappointed by the story's lack of depth and pacing issues. Some find the fan service distracting, while others enjoy the blend of genres, leading to a somewhat polarized viewing experience.
pros: Fluid animation and vibrant art style.
Diverse and likeable characters.
Engaging action sequences.
cons: Rushed and underdeveloped story.
Unnecessary fan service.
Inconsistent tone and pacing.

anime.title: Yozakura Quartet: Tsuki ni Naku
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Mythology, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
"Tsuki ni Naku" will take the story content from volume 11 of the manga, which features a visit to a onsen by the members of the Hiizumi Life Councelling Office, while the town's police force have to deal with a new youkai-hunter threat.

This OVA is bundled with the limited edition of the manga (14th, 15th, and 16th).
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received, particularly for its character work and action sequences, although some viewers found its placement within the broader series confusing. The strong technical aspects, like sound design, are a plus. There is minor criticism regarding fan service in the initial chapter and a perceived weaker narrative compared to earlier arcs.
pros: Excellent use of secondary characters
Impressive sound design enhancing action scenes
Pleasant narrative rhythm
cons: Awkward placement in the overall series chronology
The final youkai hunter confrontation felt less grand compared to previous ones
First chapter primarily justification for fan service

anime.title: Free! - Iwatobi Swim Club
anime.synopsis:
Haruka Nanase has a love for water and a passion for swimming. In elementary school, he competed in and won a relay race with his three friends Rin Matsuoka, Nagisa Hazuki, and Makoto Tachibana. After claiming victory at the tournament, the four friends went their separate ways. Years later, they reunite as high school students; however, Rin couldn't care less about returning to the way things used to be. Not only does he attend a different school, but the sole thing important to him is proving that he is a better swimmer than Haruka.

After the bitter reunion, Haruka, Nagisa, and Makoto decide to form the Iwatobi High School Swim Club, but they will need a fourth member if they hope to take part in the upcoming tournament. Enter Rei Ryuugazaki, a former member of the track team whom Nagisa recruits. As the time to compete draws near, the four develop a close bond while training intensely to come out on top and settle things between Haruka and Rin once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Free!' are mixed. While many praise the stunning visuals and character interactions, others criticize the weak plot, excessive fanservice, and shallow character development. The show is considered enjoyable for those seeking lighthearted entertainment, but falls short for viewers desiring depth and originality.
pros: Beautiful art and animation, especially the water.
Well-written characters with believable chemistry.
Enjoyable and lighthearted slice-of-life elements.
cons: Weak and unoriginal story with a lack of depth.
Overreliance on fanservice that overshadows the plot.
Stereotypical and shallow characters with little development.
Unnecessary melodrama and contrived conflicts.

anime.title: Senyuu. 2
anime.synopsis:
When a hole opened up in the world and monsters flooded out, humanity prepared for the demon lord Rukimedes' rise once again. However, even the gravity of this situation cannot impede the antics of straight man hero Alba Frühling and sadist soldier Ross.

Ross, trapped within a plane between two worlds due to Januar Ein's magic, encounters the demon lord taking a nap and looking far too comfortable in his confinement. Simultaneously, Alba, once again in prison, has been sidelined in favor of his eccentric companion's hijinks.

Although separated, Ross and Alba continue their attempts to prevent the demon lord's resurgence, but unbeknownst to them, a ghost from Ross' past may just threaten their quest's success.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience generally enjoys Senyuu. 2 for its humor and short, easily digestible format. However, some viewers felt that it didn't live up to the first season, citing a weaker story and less funny moments. The cliffhanger ending and the exclusion of certain characters were also points of concern for fans.
pros: Hilarious and easy to watch due to its short length.
Well-adapted anime with recognizable humor.
Characters are a delight, fun and entertaining.
Good opening and ending themes, especially the ending song by Alba.
Actual storyline and characterization for a short anime.
The story is amazing, it takes you inside their world
cons: Sacrificed some of the wacky humor from the first season.
Some new characters lack flavor compared to the old ones.
Art and animation were less noticeable compared to the first season.
Cliffhanger ending with no news of a third season.
Cut out important characters from the web manga, impacting later storylines.
Ross lost their defining characteristics due to the plot line

anime.title: Chocotan!
anime.synopsis:
After eating a strange flower, Chocotan the mini dachshund gains the ability to talk! Since then, the eager pup has been able to provide her young owner, Nao Hatori, with earnest support.

The two often walk to the park in hopes of running into Hatori's crush, Yamato Arima, and his dachshund Happy. During one encounter, Arima is interrupted by his female classmates, distancing Hatori from their conversation. To make matters worse, Chocotan loses her ability to speak and is unable to console her now devastated owner. Despite these setbacks, Chocotan's steadfast love for her human companion motivates Hatori to muster the courage to realize her genuine feelings.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are mixed. Some find the show cute and heartwarming, especially for younger viewers. Others criticize it for being predictable, overly fluffy, and having weak character development and unsettling animation. The short length and simple plot are also points of contention.
pros: Heartwarming ending with conflict resolution.
Enjoyable characters and dog interactions.
Voice acting is well-received
cons: Predictable and shallow plot.
Weak character introduction and development.
Unsettling animation with rigid movements and unnatural character designs.
Overly fluffy and stereotypical characters.
Poor world building

anime.title: Girls und Panzer der Film
anime.genres: Action, Award Winning, CGDCT, Military, School
anime.synopsis:
Having won the 63rd National Sensha-dou tournament, the girls from Ooarai Girls Academy managed to prevent their school from closure by the Japanese Ministry of Education. However, new troubles loom on the horizon: a ministry official argues that the deal was not legally binding and that the Ooarai school carrier is to be decommissioned. Students and their families are frustrated with this injustice and overwhelmed with despair; it seems little can be done to save the school.

Their last glimmer of hope is a proposed match against the All-Stars University Sensha-dou team, consisting of the most talented students from all over the country. Despite Ooarai being severely outnumbered and clearly outclassed, they accept the challenge.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience consensus for 'Girls & Panzer Movie' is positive. Viewers appreciate the thrilling tank battles, well-paced action, and entertaining characters. The story is considered simple and predictable, but this doesn't detract significantly from the enjoyment, which is why most people rate it as a masterpiece.
pros: Exciting and thrilling tank battles
Well-paced with little dull moments
Entertaining characters and character interactions
Good animation and sound effects
The movie is fun and enjoyable
cons: Story is not deep and recycles the first season's plot
Too many characters, hard to grow on them
Predictable outcomes
Not much emotional moments
Tanks in chaos and hard to follow

anime.title: Girls und Panzer: This is the Real Anzio Battle!
anime.romaji_title: Girls & Panzer: Kore ga Hontou no Anzio-sen desu!
anime.synopsis:
After a brilliant victory over Saunders University High School, girls from Ooarai Girls Academy now have to face Italian-themed Anzio Girls High School in the second round of the 63rd National High School Sensha-Dou Tournament. The high-spirited girls from Anzio, led by the charismatic Chiyomi Anzai, advance toward the battle equipped with baffling tactics and a secret weapon.

Ooarai will soon find out that what seemed to be a mere formality might take an unexpected and possibly disastrous turn. Whether they will win the match, or lose and doom their school to a closure, is still on a knife-edge.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the OVA, viewing it as a fun and worthwhile addition to the main series that fleshes out the Anzio battle. Many feel that it should have been integrated into the original series. The humor and characters are praised, though some find parts predictable or less impactful.
pros: Faithful to the original series in terms of humor and characters.
The OVA fills in a missing piece of the main story, showing the Anzio battle.
Introduces the Anzio characters and their Italian-themed tanks.
cons: Feels like it should have been part of the main series, not a separate OVA.
The outcome of the battle is already known, reducing suspense.
Some viewers may find the 'old friends' subplot involving Caesar uninteresting.
Can feel like a character introduction, not a pivotal standalone episode.

anime.title: Lagrange: The Flower of Rin-ne Season 2 Specials
anime.synopsis: Rinne no Lagrange short specials included in the Rinne no Lagrange Season 2 Blu-rays and DVDs.
anime.consensus_summary: The Rinne no Lagrange Season 2 Specials are well-received by fans as a lighthearted and enjoyable addition to the series. The focus on slice-of-life stories and cute characters is appreciated, offering a pleasant contrast to the more complex plot of the main season. It's considered a nice bonus for dedicated fans of the Jersey Club.
pros: Enjoyable slice of life stories.
Nice flashbacks.
Good use of cute girl elements.
cons: Limited fanservice
Convoluted plot of Season 2 referenced negatively.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Cuteness, Fan Service

anime.title: Kamisama Kiss OVA
anime.synopsis:
Kamisama, Suterareru
Riding the high of a heartfelt kiss she shared with her familiar Tomoe, Nanami Momozono seems like nothing can bring her down. However, that changes when she witnesses Tomoe receive a mysterious black box and claim that possessing it, he no longer needs Nanami. By creating the perfect diversion, Nanami is determined to find out what this box contains.

Kamisama, Onsen ni Iku
After Nanami overhears her familiar Mizuki talk about her possibly being too spoiled by Tomoe, she becomes hell-bent on proving her capability to be independent. During her trip with Tomoe to a hot spring hotel, Nanami learns about a stone that allegedly grants a lifetime of happiness to couples who touch it together. However, the long path to the stone may prove a bit overwhelming as long as Nanami refuses Tomoe's help.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVAs are considered a lighthearted addition to the series, offering sweet moments between the main characters. However, they are criticized for having a generic story and lacking the quality of the main anime series. Some viewers might find enjoyment in the character interactions and music, while others may find it boring and unnecessary.
pros: Nice to see the relationship between Tomoe and Nanami develop.
Music is blissful and adds to the atmosphere.
cons: Story is generic and uninteresting.
OVAs can be dismissed as generic.
Sound quality might be bad.

anime.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!: Heart Throb
anime.romaji_title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Ren
anime.synopsis:
The awkward lovebirds, Yuuta Togashi and Rikka Takanashi are now living together as they enter a new school year, but their adorable relationship remains stagnant. Yuuta struggles to adapt to having a chuuni girlfriend while the gang—Sanae Dekomori, Shinka Nibutani and Kumin Tsuyuri—are still keeping up with their quirks despite having advanced a grade. Making matters worse, another chuuni girl from Yuuta's middle school, Satone Shichimiya, appears...

With the various events revolving around Yuuta, will he be able to develop his relationship with Rikka?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with 'Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Ren,' considering it a significant drop in quality compared to the first season. Reviewers criticize the weak plot, stagnant character development, and forced romance, with some even denying its existence as a sequel. While the animation quality is praised, the overall sentiment is negative, suggesting the series fails to capture the charm and depth of its predecessor, feeling like a cash grab.
pros: Animation quality is consistently high
Some found the focus on other characters besides Yuuta and Rikka enjoyable
The series retains the humorous style of the first season
cons: Plot is weak and feels unnecessary; many episodes are filler
Character development is stagnant or regressive
Romance feels forced and lacks meaningful progression
Comedy is weaker compared to the first season
New characters are poorly integrated and serve little purpose
Story lacks pacing and cohesion, jumping between lighthearted and melodramatic elements without proper buildup

anime.title: I Couldn't Become a Hero, So I Reluctantly Decided to Get a Job
anime.romaji_title: Yuusha ni Narenakatta Ore wa Shibushibu Shuushoku wo Ketsui Shimashita.
anime.synopsis:
Dreaming of becoming a hero and vanquishing the Demon King, Raul Chaser enters the Hero Training Program in pursuit of his ambition. However, when the Demon King is defeated and peace returns to the world, the Hero Training Program is suspended indefinitely, making it impossible for anyone to become a hero.

Two years later, Raul reluctantly works at a small electronics store called Magic Shop Leon. Though the former hero-in-training is plagued by the mundanity of working in retail, everything changes with the arrival of a new hire. Appearing at first to be just a boy with good looks, "he" turns out to be a female demon by the name of Fino Bloodstone. She is not just any old demon either—Raul's new coworker is in fact the daughter of the late Demon King! Handed the responsibility of training this eccentric new employee, Raul soon finds his life becoming livelier than it ever was before.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, primarily due to the heavy reliance on fan service which is either embraced or strongly disliked. While many find Fino to be a charming comedic lead and appreciate the unique slice-of-life premise, a significant portion of viewers are disappointed by the weak and clichéd plot, underdeveloped characters, and the overwhelming ecchi elements.
pros: Fino's character is a major source of comedy and charm, carrying the show for many viewers.
The premise of a post-hero world and working in a magic shop is unique and offers relatable slice-of-life elements.
The animation and art style are generally considered good, with particular attention paid to character designs and fan service.
Some viewers found the music, especially the OP and ED, to be catchy and enjoyable.
cons: The show is heavily criticized for its excessive and often poorly integrated fan service, which alienates many viewers.
The plot is considered weak, predictable, generic, and at times nonsensical, especially in the latter half.
Character development beyond Fino and Raul is minimal, with many supporting characters feeling underdeveloped or serving only as plot devices.
Comparisons to 'The Devil is a Part-Timer!' often highlight this show's shortcomings in humor and engaging storytelling.

anime.title: Kill la Kill
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
After the murder of her father, Ryuuko Matoi has been wandering the land in search of his killer. Following her only lead—the missing half of his invention, the Scissor Blade—she arrives at the prestigious Honnouji Academy, a high school unlike any other. The academy is ruled by the imposing and cold-hearted student council president Satsuki Kiryuuin alongside her powerful underlings, the Elite Four. In the school's brutally competitive hierarchy, Satsuki bestows upon those at the top special clothes called "Goku Uniforms," which grant the wearer unique superhuman abilities. 

Thoroughly beaten in a fight against one of the students in uniform, Ryuuko retreats to her razed home where she stumbles across Senketsu, a rare and sentient "Kamui," or God Clothes. After coming into contact with Ryuuko's blood, Senketsu awakens, latching onto her and providing her with immense power. Now, armed with Senketsu and the Scissor Blade, Ryuuko makes a stand against the Elite Four, hoping to reach Satsuki and uncover the culprit behind her father's murder once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Kill la Kill polarizes viewers with its over-the-top style and heavy use of fanservice. While some find it to be a refreshing and entertaining satire of action anime, others find it to be shallow, ridiculous, and poorly written. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on one's tolerance for the show's over-the-top nature and willingness to overlook its flaws.
pros: Unique and energetic animation style
Exaggerated and entertaining fight scenes
Creative and absurd premise
A fun, engaging experience.
cons: Repetitive plot elements
Overreliance on fan service
Underdeveloped characters
Incoherent or bizarre plot points

anime.title: Ace of Diamond
anime.synopsis:
With a stray pitch that completely missed the batter, Eijun Sawamura loses his final middle school baseball game. Frustrated by this defeat, Eijun and his teammates vow to reach the national tournament once they are in high school. But everything changes when a scout unexpectedly invites him to Tokyo's prestigious Seidou High School after seeing the potential in his unusual pitching style. Encouraged by his teammates, Eijun accepts the offer, ready to improve his skills and play at a much more competitive level of baseball.

However, now surrounded by a large number of skilled players, Eijun struggles to find his place on the team. He declares that he will one day become the team's ace, but that's only if fellow first year Satoru Furuya doesn't take the title first, with his breakneck fastballs that earn him a coveted spot on the starting roster. With the addition of these talented new players to an already powerful lineup, the Seidou baseball team aims to become the best in Japan, facing off against a number of formidable foes that stand in their way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive towards Diamond no Ace, praising its character development, realistic portrayal of baseball, and exciting matches. Some viewers find the pacing slow and the plot predictable, while others appreciate the show's emotional depth and underdog themes. The series successfully captures the essence of sports anime, although it might not appeal to all viewers due to its length and occasional flaws.
pros: Strong character development, especially of the main character and side characters.
Realistic portrayal of high school baseball and the journey to improve skills.
Exciting and well-developed tournaments.
Excellent sound design and music that enhances emotional scenes.
cons: Slow pacing, particularly in the early episodes.
Predictable plot elements and reliance on sports anime cliches.
Flawed logic and manufactured drama in certain plot points.
Inconsistent animation quality.

anime.title: Chihayafuru 2 OVA
anime.romaji_title: Chihayafuru 2: Waga Miyo ni Furu Nagame Shima ni
anime.synopsis: The cultural festival is one of the most important events on the academic calendar. Just like all other clubs, Mizusawa's Karuta Club is preparing to participate as well. Due to previous circumstances, Team Captain Chihaya Ayase is temporarily absent during the team planning. First year student Sumire Hanano is intent on taking advantage of this occasion to fulfill her dream and finally make her teammate, Taichi Mashima, fall in love with her. A play based on Genji Monogatari might be just the thing she needs to enact her plan.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely views this OVA as a fun, comedic, and romantic side-story that deviates from the main series' focus on Karuta. While praised for its humor, art, and character interactions outside of tense matches, it's also noted for its lack of plot progression and underdeveloped central romance, making it enjoyable as a filler but not essential viewing for series plot advancement.
pros: Good touch of comedy
Beautiful art
Hilarious ending
Fun to watch characters joke around
Humor is very Chihayafuru
Nice character developments for Taichi regarding Chihaya and Hanano
Lean into its SoL side
cons: Didn't live up to expectations
Almost no screentime for Chihaya
No Karuta played
Very few OVAs actually have a real plot, this is not one of them
Adds nothing to the actual plot
Quality isn't as high-caliber as the main series
Sumire's romantic drive towards Taichi is still underdeveloped
Doesn't keep my interest
Payoff feels on brand for this series, even if it's not the most fulfilling way to end it

anime.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU OVA
anime.romaji_title: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru. OVA
anime.synopsis: One morning, Hachiman Hikigaya contemplates the superfluous nature of marriage and its misleading image of happiness. However, he is forced into confronting his skepticism when the Volunteer Service Club is tasked with assisting a local municipal magazine advertise the allure of marriage to younger people. Unfortunately, neither the club's advisor, Shizuka Hiratsuka, nor the other club members have any firsthand experience with the subject. With only one week until the deadline, the group must quickly learn about the intricacies behind the special ceremony, even if they have to resort to more creative means!
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received by fans of the first season as a lighthearted and humorous side story. Viewers appreciate the familiar character interactions and comedy, though some find the plot inconsequential. It serves as enjoyable fan service, but may not appeal to those seeking a deeper narrative.
pros: Humorous character interactions and dialogues, especially between Hachiman and Yukino.
Enjoyable side story with callbacks to jokes from the first season.
Entertaining and lighthearted, providing a fun viewing experience for fans of the series.
cons: Story is non-canon and doesn't add anything significant to the main storyline.
Plot is simple and may feel like a throwaway episode for some viewers.
Animation and character design may appear slightly outdated compared to more recent anime.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Fan Service

anime.title: BlazBlue: Alter Memory
anime.synopsis: The story is set in December of 2199, when the streets are full of anticipation for the end of the year and the start of the new one. Amid the celebrations, word spreads that Ragna the Bloodedge, an SS-class rebel with the highest ever bounty on his head, has appeared in the 13th Hierarchical City of Kagutsuchi. The apparent aim of Ragna or the "Grim Reaper" is the destruction of the system controlling the world. To collect the bounty, a motley array of unrivaled fighters converge on Kagutsuchi.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, BlazBlue: Alter Memory is a disappointing adaptation, particularly for those unfamiliar with the source material. Fans of the BlazBlue games may find some enjoyment in seeing the characters and world animated, but the convoluted plot, rushed pacing, and underdeveloped characters make it difficult for newcomers to understand or appreciate. The poor animation quality and filler episodes further detract from the experience, resulting in a largely negative reception.
pros: Faithful to the game's characters' personalities
Good voice acting
Enjoyable fighting scenes (for fans)
cons: Convoluted and confusing story for newcomers
Poor pacing and time management
Underdeveloped characters and relationships
Mediocre animation and art quality
Filler episodes detract from the main plot

anime.title: Gifuu Doudou!!: Kanetsugu to Keiji
anime.genres: Action, Historical, Martial Arts, Samurai, Seinen
anime.synopsis: The Sengoku era gave birth to many historical legends. One of them is Naoe Kanetsugu, the brilliant military general of the Uesugi family. Together with Maeda Keiji, a legendary warrior on the battlefield, who become lifelong friends with each other, they carve out a piece of history in the most dangerous and volatile time in Japan's history. The two men recall their beginnings and the journey they took to get to the accomplished position they now sit at.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive but tempered, appreciating the show's unique take on historical fiction with its 'manly' themes and strategic elements. However, many find the pacing slow and the second half disappointing due to a shift in focus and character dynamics. While the soundtrack and overall style are praised, the show's flaws prevent it from being a universally acclaimed masterpiece.
pros: Well-written with great art and a strong plot.
Exaggerated, uplifting, masculine charm.
Soundtrack is great, from relaxing to epic battle music.
cons: Pace is slow with more talk than action.
Second half discards brotherhood aspect and introduces less compelling side-characters.
Some episodes filled with less impressive or interesting activity, testing viewers' patience.

anime.title: Natsume’s Book of Friends: Nyanko-Sensei and the First Errand
anime.romaji_title: Natsume Yuujinchou: Nyanko-sensei to Hajimete no Otsukai
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Madara, nicknamed "Nyanko-sensei," runs into two young children when he gets separated from his temporary owner Takashi Natsume. Unequipped to handle kids, Nyanko-sensei tries to wriggle his way out; but fearing for their safety around the ravenous forest youkai, he decides to escort the siblings to safety. However, even for an all-powerful youkai such as Nyanko-sensei, dealing with the playful and overly curious nature of children can prove to be an exhausting challenge.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding the children annoying and the episode lacking the charm of the main series. While some appreciate the cute moments and Nyanko-sensei's softer side, others found it repetitive, childish, and a significant drop in quality. The OVA is considered skippable by some, while others see it as a lighthearted diversion.
pros: Cute animations and interactions with familiar characters.
Showcases Nyanko-sensei's caring side despite his gruff exterior.
cons: Annoying and irritating children characters.
Repetitive humor and reused animation.
Lacks the melancholic beauty and depth of the main series.
Feels stretched out and aimed at a younger audience.
Poorly told fable with little teaching or characteristic Natsume elements.

anime.title: Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya: Dance at the Sports Festival!
anime.romaji_title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya: Undoukai de Dance!
anime.synopsis:
Tatsuko of class 5-1 is really excited about the upcoming school sports festival, her proposal for a new "Eel Scooping" event is less than enthusiastically received though, especially by Suzuka. Illya mentions the main event dance to Miyu, and as teacher Taiga Fujimura points out, it entails a huge reward, but will require quite a bit of practice.

And so the close friends: sarcastic Nanaki, level-headed Suzuka, excitable Tatsuko, energetic Illya, shy Mimi, and reserved but athletic Miyu are off to win the dance event for the honour of their class and for Fujimura, who seems to have some saucy bet going on that she most definitely needs to win, or so the girls misunderstand.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally agrees that the production quality (art and sound) is good, and there's some minor character development. However, the narrative is considered weak and unengaging, with too much filler despite the slice-of-life and sports themes.
pros: Art and sound were great as always
Nice but small amount of character development for Miyu
cons: Story doesn't really matter
Spent runtime on meaningless chatter
Not as entertaining as it should have been
Unengaging

anime.title: OreImo 2 Specials
anime.romaji_title: Ore no Imouto ga Konnani Kawaii Wake ga Nai. Specials
anime.synopsis: Episodes 14–16 of OreImo 2 which finish adapting the OreImo novels.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is highly polarized regarding the finale. While some praise its boldness in addressing taboo themes and providing a definitive ending, a significant majority are deeply dissatisfied with the abrupt and arguably nonsensical conclusion that undermines character development and narrative build-up.
pros: Consistent art and sound quality across seasons
Voice acting for Kuroneko and Kirino praised
Explores themes of social taboo and personal choices
Provides a definitive conclusion to the light novel story
cons: Abrupt and unsatisfying ending that negates previous character development
