Poor execution of romantic relationships, feeling rushed and superficial
Characters, particularly Manami, are drastically altered or ruined
Narrative derails itself in the final moments, rendering prior efforts pointless

anime.title: Arpeggio of Blue Steel -Ars Nova-
anime.romaji_title: Aoki Hagane no Arpeggio: Ars Nova
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2039, the drastic effects of global warming have caused sea levels to rise, resulting in major loss of land. To ensure humanity learns its lesson, a fleet of powerful warships equipped with advanced weaponry emerges, causing overwhelming defeat for naval forces throughout the world. Calling themselves the Fleet of Fog, each ship has a "Mental Model," a humanoid avatar which represents the ship's heart, its "Union Core." Each model has a different personality but all follow an unknown authority known as the Admiralty Code, who have implemented a blockade to prevent humans from traveling across the sea.
 
Seventeen years after the blockade, Gunzou Chihaya, a National Marine Academy alumnus, stumbles upon I-401 and its Mental Model, Iona, who sides with mankind for unknown reasons. Utilizing this newfound hope of achieving peace for humanity, Gunzou and his friends form a group of privateers, known as the Blue Steel, as they set out on a dangerous journey.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some praising the unique story, action, and ship designs, while others criticize the CGI animation, undeveloped characters, and confusing plot. Some viewers found the series engaging and thought-provoking, while others viewed it as a poorly executed self-insert fantasy. The series' unconventional approach and reliance on CGI contribute to the mixed reception.
pros: Unique premise with interesting characters and moral lessons.
Good art and animation, especially for underwater naval battles and ship designs.
Engaging story with warm-hearted scenes and well-developed villains.
cons: CGI animation can be jarring and not blend well with the anime.
Characters can be one-dimensional and undeveloped, especially the human cast.
Plot can be confusing and filled with complicated words, overwhelming some viewers.
Some viewers found the series to be a pathetic, delusional self-insert fantasy.
anime.thematic_vibe: Military Sci-Fi, Naval Combat, Existential AI

anime.title: Nisekoi: False Love
anime.synopsis:
Raku Ichijou, a first-year student at Bonyari High School, is the sole heir to an intimidating yakuza family. Ten years ago, Raku made a promise to his childhood friend. Now, all he has to go on is a pendant with a lock, which can only be unlocked with the key which the girl took with her when they parted.

Now, years later, Raku has grown into a typical teenager, and all he wants is to remain as uninvolved in his yakuza background as possible while spending his school days alongside his middle school crush Kosaki Onodera. However, when the American Bee Hive Gang invades his family's turf, Raku's idyllic romantic dreams are sent for a toss as he is dragged into a frustrating conflict: Raku is to pretend that he is in a romantic relationship with Chitoge Kirisaki, the beautiful daughter of the Bee Hive's chief, so as to reduce the friction between the two groups. Unfortunately, reality could not be farther from this whopping lie—Raku and Chitoge fall in hate at first sight, as the girl is convinced he is a pathetic pushover, and in Raku's eyes, Chitoge is about as attractive as a savage gorilla. 

Nisekoi follows the daily antics of this mismatched couple who have been forced to get along for the sake of maintaining the city's peace. With many more girls popping up his life, all involved with Raku's past somehow, his search for the girl who holds his heart and his promise leads him in more unexpected directions than he expects.
anime.consensus_summary: Nisekoi is a visually appealing but ultimately generic romantic comedy that relies heavily on established tropes. While some find the humor and cute moments enjoyable, others criticize its predictable plot and lack of character depth. The series is considered a decent watch for fans of the genre, but its unoriginality prevents it from standing out.
pros: Visually appealing art style, especially Shaft's unique direction.
Enjoyable and re-watchable for fans of shounen comedies and tsundere characters.
Cute and funny moments throughout the series.
cons: Generic and clichéd story elements, lacking originality.
Dense main character and weak character development for supporting cast.
Storyline can drag on with episodes not contributing to the main plot.

anime.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!: Rikka Version
anime.romaji_title: Takanashi Rikka Kai: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Movie
anime.synopsis: Summary of the first season of the show, as seen from Rikka's perspective with new elements.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience widely agrees that this movie is primarily a recap of the first season and is largely unnecessary for those who have already seen it. While praised for its high production quality and nostalgic value for existing fans, it is criticized for its lack of new content and failure to serve as a proper introduction for newcomers.
pros: High-quality animation and production values, characteristic of Kyoto Animation
Enjoyable new opening and ending sequences
Provides a nostalgic refresher for fans of the first season
Satisfying character interactions and "unneedingly epic" moments that define the series
cons: Primarily a recap of the first season with minimal new plot content
Does not work as a standalone product or entry point for new viewers
Lacks the depth and charm of the original series
The "Rikka's perspective" framing is not effectively realized

anime.title: Wake Up, Girls!
anime.synopsis:
The gateway to Idol stardom might have opened for the newly formed singing group Wake Up, Girls, but the path to fame is full of perils and pitfalls. And for Mayu, Airi, Minami, Yoshino, Nanami, Kaya and Miyu, it's going to be especially difficult knowing who to trust, as their manager Matsuda's lack of experience could give other, less scrupulous, individuals a chance to take advantage.

That's a situation that quickly comes to a head when Green Leaves' president suddenly disappears with most of the money, and things only get worse when the replacement producer seems more interested in getting the girls into revealing swimsuits than promoting their music.

As malicious gossip begins to surface regarding Mayu's past membership in a rival group, and internal tensions begin to tear the team apart, they'll need more than just ambition to survive. Singing may be a business, but friendship and a love of music is what will keep everything together.
anime.consensus_summary: Wake Up, Girls! is generally well-received for its realistic depiction of the idol industry and strong character development, though it suffers from inconsistent animation and some clichéd plot elements. Viewers appreciate the show's ability to evoke emotions and create a connection with the characters as they struggle to achieve their dreams. While not as polished as some other idol anime, its focus on realism and relatable struggles makes it a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre.
pros: Realistic portrayal of the idol industry
Strong character development, especially Mayu
Catchy and enjoyable music
Suspenseful story with good pacing
Addresses the hardships faced by idols
cons: Inconsistent animation quality
Characters sometimes look too similar
Cliched story elements
Underdeveloped side characters
Mediocre dance animations

anime.title: Future Card Buddyfight
anime.synopsis:
An adaptation of the Future Card Buddyfight card game.

Future Card Buddyfight takes place in a more futuristic version of today. The card game connects to a parallel universe through special cards (Buddy Rare Cards) that act as portals. They bring monsters to Earth in order for them to become buddies with humans. Through friendship and courage, they take on and fight challenges, known as Buddyfights, where people of all ages have friendly non-hurtful competitions. The main character, Gaou Mikado has just started Buddyfighting. As the story progresses, Buddyfights are seeming to become a little too real...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Future Card Buddyfight for its lighthearted and fun approach to the card game genre. While the show is not groundbreaking, it provides an enjoyable experience, especially for younger viewers. Some find the repetitive elements and lack of depth to be drawbacks, but overall it is seen as an underrated and enjoyable anime.
pros: Enjoyable for its lighthearted and fun nature.
Good world-building and complex card-based power system.
Decent character development for some characters.
cons: Lacks depth, plot twists, or philosophical ideas.
Villains are not unique and have standard motivations.
Can be cheesy with repetitive use of the word 'buddy'.

anime.title: Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya Shorts
anime.synopsis: Specials bundled with each of all five Blu-ray/DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to the Prisma Illya Specials is moderately divided, with some finding them enjoyable bonus content that retains the main series' quality, while others view them as largely forgettable fanservice vehicles with occasional misses.
pros: Specials retain the production quality of the main series.
Specials are well-directed and deliver punchlines effectively.
Specials include subtle references to the Fate universe.
Specials are generally more enjoyable than the main season.
cons: Some specials should have been discarded at the drawing board.
Specials do not bring anything new to the table.
Specials are not for everyone, focusing heavily on fanservice and ecchi elements.

anime.title: Love Live! School Idol Project 2
anime.romaji_title: Love Live! School Idol Project 2nd Season
anime.genres: Award Winning, Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Otonokizaka High School has been saved! Despite having to withdraw from the Love Live!, the efforts of μ's were able to garner enough interest in their school to prevent it from being shut down. What more, following the conclusion of the first, a second Love Live! is announced, this time on an even larger stage than before. Given a chance for redemption, the nine girls come together once more to sing their hearts out and claim victory.
 
However, with the end of the school year approaching, the graduation of the third years draws near. As they attempt to reach the top of the Love Live!, they must also consider their future and choose what path the group will take. Though the question of whether to continue without the third years or disband weighs heavily on the minds of its members, μ's must quickly come to an answer with graduation right around the corner.
 
Love Live! School Idol Project 2nd Season continues the story of the girls as they laugh, cry, sing, and dance in their journey to determine the future of their group and conquer the Love Live! in their last chance to win with all nine girls together.
anime.consensus_summary: Love Live! School Idol Project 2nd Season is generally well-received, with many considering it an improvement over the first season. Viewers appreciate the character development, music, and inspiring story of the girls striving for their goals. While some find the plot predictable or the CG animation distracting, the overall consensus is positive, highlighting its emotional impact and entertainment value.
pros: Character development is strong, with each character having their own story and problems.
The balance between the main story and character backstories is well-executed.
The animation is clear and beautiful, and the songs are wonderful.
It's a feel good series that can make you smile.
cons: The second season's plot felt forced.
Some found that story lacked originality.
Use of CG during dancing/stage performances can be jarring.

anime.title: The Pilot's Love Song
anime.synopsis: In order to uncover the "end of the sky," as spoken of in ancient mythology, Kal-el Albus is sent to Isla, an island in the sky. There he attends Cadoques High's Aerial Division, where he enjoys a carefree life with his schoolmates. That is...until a surprise attack by the air tribe drags Isla into a bloody war.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some viewers found the anime to be a touching and enjoyable experience, praising its character development and engaging story. However, others were critical of its predictable plot, pacing issues, and rushed romances. While some appreciated the balance of action, drama, and romance, others felt that it failed to fully deliver on its potential.
pros: Well-developed characters with interesting backstories.
Engaging story with a good balance of action, drama, and romance.
Visually appealing art style with detailed aircraft battles.
Lovely orchestral music that fits well with the scenes.
cons: Rushed or cheesy romances.
Predictable plot twists and character deaths.
Inconsistencies in the story and unexplained phenomena.
Pacing issues, with slow starts and rushed endings.
Mediocre sound design, with repetitive music.

anime.title: One Piece: Episode of Merry - The Tale of One More Friend
anime.romaji_title: One Piece: Episode of Merry - Mou Hitori no Nakama no Monogatari
anime.synopsis: After Brook questions the origin of the Mini Merry name, Usopp and Chopper Tony Tony recall the adventures of the Straw Hat Crew's beloved ship, friend, and crew member—the Going Merry. Usopp abandons the crew for a fight over the Going Merry while Robin Nico leaves with the government's top assassin group, CP9. In order to bring the crew back together, Monkey D. Luffy and the remaining Straw Hats follow Robin to rescue her from the claws of the World Government.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely positive, particularly for fans of the original series. Many viewers found the recap of the Enies Lobby arc and the focus on the Going Merry to be emotionally resonant. However, some felt that the special was rushed and didn't do full justice to the source material, with the pacing feeling disjointed at times.
pros: Re-animated old scenes from East Blue arc is great.
The 'We Are' theme song always hit me in the feels.
Animation was greatly done.
cons: The part with Merry was rushed.
Feels like the special focuses more on Enies Lobby than the Going Merry.
Story feels chopped.

anime.title: Walkure Romanze
anime.synopsis:
Taking place at Winford Academy located in an old town called Helen's Hill, the story is all about knights and the sport of jousting. At this school, students learn how to become knights, ride horses and joust properly. The main character is a young man named Takahiro Mizuno who was training to become a knight and jouster but after suffering an injury he dropped out of the knight program and joined the begleiter (assistant) program instead. Due to his animal handling skills and former experience as a jouster, this makes him a hot commodity. Multiple beautiful girls in the school want him to become their personal begleiter, though Takahiro always refuses their offers.

One day a bizarre accident causes his friend, Mio Kisaski, to be challenged to a jousting duel despite her not actually being a knight. Takahiro agrees to become her temporary begleiter, but that ends up only being the beginning of their partnership as she enrolls in the annual tournament.
anime.consensus_summary: Walkure Romanze is a visually appealing anime with a unique jousting theme, but it suffers from shallow characters and a predictable plot.  Many viewers find it enjoyable as a casual watch, but are disappointed by the excessive fan service and lack of depth. The series has potential but fails to fully deliver on its premise. The lack of romance was also criticized.
pros: Unique setting combining jousting with high school anime.
Visually appealing art style with detailed backgrounds.
Enjoyable as a casual, light-hearted watch.
cons: Weak character development with reliance on tropes.
Predictable and clichéd storyline.
Excessive fan service detracts from the plot.

anime.title: Yo-kai Watch
anime.synopsis:
Primary school student Keita Amano's curiosity is as innocent as any other child's his age. But when one day he decides to venture deeper into the forest, he encounters a small and mysterious capsule. Out from its depths comes Whisper. After 190 years of imprisonment, this ghost-like creature is glad that someone has been kind enough to set him free. He decides to reward Keita by becoming his guardian against supernatural forces. Whisper is one of many Youkai that exist in the world, and provides Keita with a special Youkai Watch, which enables him to see and interact with all the other Youkai.

Youkai Watch follows Keita, Whisper and the cat spirit Jibanyan as they encounter Youkai, befriend them, fix all the trouble that they so often cause, and, with the help of the watch, use the powers of previously encountered Youkai to aid them. Young Keita may have been just an ordinary primary school student when he first encountered the Youkai, but the many adventures that follow his discovery provide him with invaluable experiences and precious life lessons that help him grow.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Yo-Kai Watch for its humor, likable characters, and surprisingly good animation quality, especially considering it is targeted towards children. The show's monster-of-the-week format and simple plots are seen as both a strength and a weakness.  The dub and music are considered high quality, adding to the overall positive experience. Some humor might not be for everyone.
pros: Likable characters with well-defined personalities.
High-quality animation, especially for a kids' show.
Catchy music and a well-done English dub.
Snappy, character-based comedy.
Good use of 'boke and tsukkomi' comedy routine.
cons: The setting is boring and fueled by a gimmick.
The plot is functionally non-existent and is more monster of the day.
Some humor can delve into toilet humor.

anime.title: Genshiken Nidaime OVA
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Otaku Culture, Parody, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the limited edition of the 15th volume of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a fun, lighthearted special that focuses on the Genshiken club's New Year celebration. It offers humorous moments and touches upon themes of unrequited love and romance. The overall reception appears positive, with viewers appreciating the comedic elements and relatable relationship dynamics.
pros: Fun and enjoyable
Punchlines that make you crack a smile
Bitterness of unrequited love and romance
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Romantic Subplots, Humorous

anime.title: Date A Live II
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Spirits are otherworldly entities with immense power, capable of creating spatial quakes whenever they appear. One way of dealing with them is through brute force and killing them... or making them fall in love and sealing their powers. 

Having sealed three Spirits, Shidou Itsuka continues his mission with Ratatoskr in locating more spirits and dating them, to ensure the world's safety from further destruction. However, this time around, their problems will not be limited to Spirits as a more imposing threat seems to have noticed their activities.
anime.consensus_summary: Date A Live II is considered a disappointing sequel by many fans. It suffers from rushed pacing, inconsistent animation, and a repetitive storyline. While some appreciate the enjoyable characters and sound design, the prevalent negative feedback points to a significant drop in quality compared to the first season, resulting in a polarized reception.
pros: Enjoyable characters with unique personalities, particularly the new spirits.
The music and sound design are well-executed, enhancing the viewing experience.
The story introduces interesting mystery elements that add depth beyond typical harem tropes.
cons: Rushed pacing due to the shortened season length (10 episodes), leading to underdeveloped plot points and character arcs.
Inconsistent animation quality, with noticeable dips in art style and animation during less important scenes.
Over-reliance on fan service and recycled jokes from the first season.
The story feels like a rehash of the first season, failing to explore new mysteries or character developments in a meaningful way.
Poorly explained villains with shallow motives.
anime.thematic_vibe: Harem Antics, Supernatural Battles, Romantic Comedy

anime.title: Ghost in the Shell: Arise - Border 2: Ghost Whispers
anime.romaji_title: Koukaku Kidoutai Arise: Ghost in the Shell - Border:2 Ghost Whispers
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Detective, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Second movie of Ghost in the Shell: Arise.

Freed of her responsibilities with the 501 Organization, Motoko Kusanagi must now learn how to take orders from Aramaki. Someone hacks the Logicomas, and Batou enlists the help of former army intelligence officer Ishikawa and former air artillery expert Borma. Kusanagi also seeks to enlist ace sniper Saito and undercover cop Paz into the new Public Security Section 9. The two groups rival each other in a case involving a man who receives false memories of a refugee transport operation.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is mixed. While praised for its action sequences and visuals, 'Ghost Whispers' is criticized for its simplistic plot, shallow characters, and controversial political themes. Some find it a step up from the first Arise episode, while others feel it lacks the depth and atmosphere of earlier Ghost in the Shell installments.
pros: Excellent action choreography and animation.
Visually impressive art style and camerawork.
Story is easier to follow than Border 1 and sets up the series well.
cons: Plot feels stagnant and lacks the depth of previous Ghost in the Shell entries.
Characters are shallow and underdeveloped.
World design is generic and lacks the dystopian feel of the franchise.
Overt warcrimes erasure/apologist political angle.

anime.title: Ghost in the Shell: Arise - Border 3: Ghost Tears
anime.romaji_title: Koukaku Kidoutai Arise: Ghost in the Shell - Border:3 Ghost Tears
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Detective, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Third movie of Ghost in the Shell: Arise.

Motoko and Batou work to try to stop a terrorist organization whose symbol is the Scylla. Meanwhile, Togusa investigates a murder of a man who possessed a prosthetic leg manufactured by the Mermaid's Leg corporation.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion on Ghost Tears is significantly divided, primarily due to the controversial depiction of Motoko's romantic subplot, which some find a compelling exploration of character and others deem out-of-character and poorly executed. While the narrative and thematic depth are praised by some, others criticize its pacing, plot coherence, and the inconsistency in animation and music.
pros: Explores interesting themes about identity, humanity, and the nature of consciousness.
Motoko's character development, particularly her exploration of romance and emotion, is seen as a unique and engaging aspect.
The integration of Section 9 members and giving them more spotlight is appreciated.
The plot is considered intricate and better than previous Arise installments, with good character moments and plot twists.
Visually strong with atmospheric cityscapes and improved nighttime aesthetics.
cons: The portrayal of Motoko's romance is divisive, with some finding it out of character, poorly executed, or too cliché.
Pacing issues, including slow development, underwhelming mysteries, and rushed resolutions, are noted.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with some scenes featuring flawed or shaky illustrations of characters.
The music is described as underwhelming and unmemorable, failing to stick with the audience.
The plot can be obtuse and difficult to follow due to too many factions and arbitrary relations.

anime.title: Ghost in the Shell: Arise - Border 4: Ghost Stands Alone
anime.romaji_title: Koukaku Kidoutai Arise: Ghost in the Shell - Border:4 Ghost Stands Alone
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Detective, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis: The story of this fourth installment takes place amidst signs of postwar reconstruction in the winter of 2028. Tensions are rising in New Port City as demonstrations are held concerning the interests of foreign cartels. This leads to a shooting incident involving riot police. It all started with a cyberbrain infection released by the terrorist "Fire Starter." An independent offensive unit led by Motoko Kusanagi entrusts the suppression of the situation to their ghosts and aims for their own justice. Below the surface of the incident, lies the "tin girl" Emma and the "scarecrow man" Burinda Junior. As Kusanagi deals with the incident, she draws near to what those two ghosts were seeking.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the franchise's history and cyberpunk themes, while others find the plot rushed, confusing, and underdeveloped. The short runtime and vague character motivations are major points of criticism.
pros: Longstanding and respected franchise with maintained quality.
Mystical cyberpunk world of police and mysterious crime
cons: Rushed and underdeveloped plot due to short runtime.
Confusing and chaotic plot with vague character motivations.
Plot is an egregiously strung together series of dumb events

anime.title: Gargantia on the Verdurous Planet Specials
anime.synopsis: Episodes 14 and 15, released with the first and third BD/DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The Suisei no Gargantia Specials are a mixed bag. Some viewers appreciate the backstory and character exploration provided, particularly the Ledo x Amy moments. However, many find the specials to be forgettable, poorly paced, and ultimately unnecessary additions that do not significantly enhance the overall story.
pros: Provides backstory for Ridget and Kugel
Ledo x Amy moments in Episode 14 are enjoyable
Gorgeous animation
cons: Pacing issues in the main series remain unaddressed
Episode 14 is forgettable and lacks substance
Episode 15 feels emotionless and silly
Character development is often weak or illogical
Specials disrupt the narrative flow if watched at the wrong time

anime.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy
anime.romaji_title: Ore no Nounai Sentakushi ga, Gakuen Love Comedy wo Zenryoku de Jama Shiteiru
anime.synopsis:
For Kanade Amakusa, life as a high schooler should have been normal, and it would have been—if he wasn't living with the most ridiculous curse imaginable. "Absolute Choice," a system forced upon him by a self-proclaimed god, randomly presents a mental selection of actions that he must act out based on his choice. To add to his dilemma, it tends to occur in the most public of places, and his options never seem to deviate from the rude and crude in nature.

As a result, the helpless boy stresses through each day, fumbling to repair his already tarnished reputation while desperately praying to avoid the next spontaneous episode of Absolute Choice. To his dismay, the one in charge is always one step ahead of him and proceeds to not-so-subtly "choice" him into the lives of several girls at his school. Just when Kanade's school life can't seem to be doomed any further, a decision that he reluctantly selects on the way home sends a beautiful girl crashing down from the sky, along with the promise of more hysterically hellish choices.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on "Noucome". Some appreciate its absurd comedy and unique premise, while others find it repetitive, shallow, and overly reliant on fanservice. It's generally seen as a lighthearted, brainless comedy, but its overall quality and lasting impact are debated.
pros: Unique premise with the 'Absolute Choice' curse.
Good for viewers who enjoy laid-back, nonsensical humor.
Catchy opening and ending themes.
cons: Repetitive scenarios and over-reliance on fanservice.
Weak character development.
Plot lacks depth and substantial remembrance.
Pacing feels rushed; story feels crammed into too few episodes.

anime.title: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Maji Love 2000%: Shining Star Xmas
anime.romaji_title: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Maji Love 2000%: Shining Star Xmas
anime.genres: Comedy, Idols (Male), Josei, Music, Reverse Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Unaired episode included in the seventh Blu-ray and DVD volumes.

Haruka is busy working at the agency so she can't help the idols with the preparations for the Christmas Party held by Shining Agency. A lot of memories and information are revealed while Starish is preparing for the party.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the episode as a comforting and heartwarming addition to the series. While not essential to the plot, it provides enjoyable character moments and showcases the series' strengths in music, art, and visual presentation. The episode is considered a pleasant bonus for fans of the series.
pros: Character development for new and established characters.
Entrancing music.
Beautiful art and character designs.
Excellent use of lighting, especially for a Christmas episode.
cons: The episode is not essential to the overall storyline.

anime.title: Megane-bu!
anime.synopsis: At Himaraya Third Technical School, five bespectacled members of the Glasses club are crazy about eyewear. Their leader, Akira Souma, founded the club to develop the X-ray glasses of his dreams, but their research has been slow in between getting into quirky escapades and fighting off student body president William Satou's attempts to further cut their tight club funding. With unbounded youthful passion, these friends set their minds on making their project a resounding success.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Meganebu! for its lighthearted and humorous take on the slice of life genre, appreciating its colorful art style and the endearing characters. However, some find the plot simplistic and wish for more in-depth character development. The anime is considered a fun and easy watch, though not particularly groundbreaking.
pros: Bright and colorful art style
Enjoyable and funny characters with strong friendships
Catchy and upbeat soundtrack
cons: Simple and somewhat superficial story
Underdeveloped characters with untapped potential
Inconsistent music that sometimes doesn't match the scene

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Since That Day
anime.romaji_title: Shingeki no Kyojin: Ano Hi Kara
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Recap of the events in Shingeki no Kyojin that happened prior to episode 14.
anime.consensus_summary: The consensus is overwhelmingly negative, with viewers expressing disappointment and frustration over the recap episode. It is seen as a redundant and unnecessary addition to the series, offering nothing new to those who have already watched the initial episodes. The recycled animation and poor pacing further contribute to the negative reception.
pros: Brief retelling of the first part of season 1.
Refreshes memory before watching season 2.
May help viewers who watch episodes sporadically.
cons: Unnecessary recap for those who watched the original episodes.
Recycled animation and sound.
Poor pacing and lack of creativity.
Fails to entice new viewers.
Waste of time.

anime.title: Pokémon the Series: XY
anime.synopsis:
Satoshi and Pikachu have arrived in Lumiose City of the illustrious Kalos region to capture more Pokémon and continue their journey toward becoming the very best. Meanwhile, a genius inventor named Citron and his little sister Eureka wander the city when they run into Satoshi who quickly challenges them to a battle. However, they are soon caught up in a dangerous incident when Team Rocket, following Satoshi into Kalos, cause a Gaburias to rampage through the city.

Far away in the quiet Vaniville Town, a young girl named Serena slogs through daily Sihorn riding practice at the behest of her mother, a professional Sihorn racer. After practice, she sees the events unfolding in Miare City on television where she recognizes a boy from her childhood. Having left a significant impact on her life, the sight of him stirs in her a desire to meet him again; and so, Serena sets off to Miare City, determined to find the boy from her past.

Pokemon XY follows the group as they travel throughout Kalos in pursuit of their ambitions—Satoshi challenging Pokémon gyms, Citron learning from Satoshi, and Serena searching for what exactly her dream is. Along the way, they meet new friends, face new rivals, and continue to thwart Team Rocket's schemes, all the while discovering a little about the mysteries of mega evolution.
anime.consensus_summary: Pokemon XY is generally well-received for its improved animation, character development, and exciting battles, especially compared to previous seasons. While the story may be repetitive and Ash's performance is sometimes debated, viewers praise it as one of the best in the Pokemon anime series. A significant portion of the audience is disappointed by the lack of depth in certain plot elements and how Serena’s goals were handled.
pros: Improved animation and art style compared to previous seasons.
Stronger character development, particularly for Ash and Serena.
Exciting battles and the introduction of Mega Evolution.
The series balances lighthearted camaraderie with high-stakes conflicts.
cons: Repetitive formulaic plot structure, especially with Team Rocket encounters.
Inconsistent pacing and underdeveloped plot points.
Ash's maturity feels out of character in some instances.
The series takes too long to develop Serena's goal.

anime.title: Pupa
anime.synopsis:
Abandoned by their abusive parents and with only each other to depend on, siblings Utsutsu and Yume Hasegawa find themselves led astray by beautiful red butterflies that have appeared in their world. Unbeknownst to them, these crimson winged heralds trumpet the beginning of a cannibalistic nightmare—a mysterious virus known as Pupa is about to hatch.
 
After succumbing to the full effects of Pupa, Yume undergoes a grotesque metamorphosis into a monstrous creature with an insatiable desire for flesh; Utsutsu, on the other hand, is only partially affected, gaining remarkable regenerative powers instead. Reaffirming the resolve to keep the promise he made to himself years ago, Utsutsu is willing to sacrifice everything in order to always be there for his precious little sister.

Pupa tells the story of a loving brother's desperate struggles to save his sister while protecting the world from her uncontrollable hunger.
anime.consensus_summary: Pupa is overwhelmingly criticized for its rushed story, excessive censorship, and disturbing content. Many find it to be one of the worst anime they have ever seen, citing poor character development and low production quality. A small minority attempts to find deeper meaning in its themes, but the overall consensus is extremely negative, with viewers expressing confusion and disgust.
pros: Some appreciate the symbolic representation of taboo love and psychological themes.
A few find the art style interesting or unique.
cons: Rushed and incomprehensible story due to extremely short episodes.
Excessive and inconsistent censorship ruins the horror atmosphere.
Poor character development and unlikeable characters.
Awkward and disturbing incestuous undertones.
Low budget animation and technical issues.

anime.title: Gundam Build Fighters
anime.synopsis:
Though Gundam Plastic Models, better known as Gunpla, exploded in popularity with the release of the anime series Mobile Suit Gundam, their presence faded before resurging with a new purpose. Through the power of Plavsky particles, fans are now able to pit their Gunpla against others in a virtual reality-style battle with the best competing at the annual Gunpla World Tournament. 

Sei Iori, whose father was a once finalist in the competition, dreams of one day conquering the contest himself. However, while Sei is an expert Gunpla builder, he lacks the prowess to effectively fight his creations during actual battle. In comes Reiji, a mysterious boy who is curiously ignorant of society but quickly demonstrates to Sei tremendous ability in Gunpla battles. The two boys decide to combine their strengths in order to sweep the Gunpla World Tournament and take the Gunpla world by storm.
anime.consensus_summary: Gundam Build Fighters is generally well-received as a fun and unique entry in the Gundam franchise. Its focus on Gunpla battles and tournament arcs appeals to a broad audience, especially those with nostalgia for model building. While some find the premise or plot simplistic, the excellent animation, music, and engaging characters contribute to a positive overall experience.
pros: Unique take on the Gundam franchise with a focus on Gunpla battles.
Beautiful animation and detailed art style, especially during fight scenes.
Catchy and varied OST that enhances the viewing experience.
Fun and entertaining series with well-developed characters.
Nods to the Real Robot genre.
cons: Premise of Gunpla battles may seem unattractive to some.
Storyline can be simple and uninspired at times.
Relies on plot devices (Plavsky particles) that are not fully explained.
Some female characters are poorly written.

anime.title: Nijiiro☆Prism Girl
anime.synopsis:
The beautiful and tall Kohinata Nijika, a 6th grade kid who doesn't look her age and daughter of an office chief of a TV station, avoids the entertainment world since her mom, a legendary actress, died from a sickness. Hiding the truth about her family, Nijika keeps another secret. The fact that she's living with the prince-like actor, Ichinose Touya, may create a ruckus if it is discovered.

Running for another errand, Nijika, together with her pet Kapitama-kun, coincidentally run into a drama set that's lacking an actress due to food poisoning. She volunteers for the role and...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers find the story thrilling and catchy, appreciating the characters and fast-paced plot. However, others criticize the generic art style, weak comedy, and the rushed adaptation that omits content from the manga, resulting in a polarized reception.
pros: Catchy and thrilling story with unexpected events.
Good character improvisation and actions.
Quick backstory for each character keeps you 'in the moment'.
Awesome plot overall.
cons: Comedy falls flat.
Art style is simple and generic, with disproportionately large eyes.
Anime is too fast-paced and cuts off content from the manga.
Main character uses deceitful behavior.
OVA episodes are too short.

anime.title: Silver Spoon 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Now accustomed to his life at Ooezo Agricultural High School, Yuugo Hachiken explores the deeper aspects of what school life really means. As Hachiken learns more about himself and earns the skills necessary for his everyday tasks, he is even offered the position of the Equestrian Club's vice-president. The new semester brings a variety of agricultural dilemmas and personal conflicts, but, nevertheless, Hachiken perseveres in order to discover his dream and continue working together with his friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is highly positive, praising the show's character development, exploration of agricultural themes, and relatable storytelling. While some missed the humor of the first season or desired more content, the overall sentiment is that the second season is a strong and meaningful continuation of the story. Many viewers found the show emotionally resonant and appreciated its valuable life lessons.
pros: Strong character development, especially Hachiken, Mikage and Komaba.
Meaningful exploration of agricultural life and its challenges.
Relatable and genuine portrayal of personal dilemmas and dreams.
Effective blend of humor and serious themes.
High-quality animation and art style.
cons: Some found the OP/ED themes less catchy than the first season.
A few reviewers felt the second season wasn't as good as the first, desiring more closure.

anime.title: Samurai Flamenco
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Comedy, Parody, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
"A hero will never give up, never hide, never be defeated and never accept evil!"

Firmly believing these words, Masayoshi Hazama has been obsessed with superhero shows since childhood. By day, he earns his living as a famous model, and by night, he becomes the gallant hero Samurai Flamenco. Armed with only his superhero costume, he seeks to bring justice to the city and faces anybody who tries to break the law—even rebellious juveniles and people who litter on the street.

Masayoshi's heroic antics later catch the attention of the public, leading to the fateful discovery of his identity by policeman Hidenori Gotou. Although initially telling Masayoshi to leave the crime-busting activities to the police, Gotou ends up joining him in his antics. However, things soon escalate from preventing littering and petty thefts to bizarre adventures that involve even the fate of the world. Together with their newfound comrades, Masayoshi and Gotou embark on a battle with the world and themselves in order to find the true meaning of being a hero—with or without superpowers.
anime.consensus_summary: Samurai Flamenco is a highly divisive anime due to its drastic tonal shifts and unconventional plot progression. Some viewers appreciate its deconstruction and parody of the superhero genre, while others find it disjointed and nonsensical. The strong character interactions and development are often praised, but the inconsistent animation and pacing are common criticisms. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on the viewer's tolerance for the show's unpredictable nature.
pros: Strong character interactions and development, particularly Masayoshi and Gotou
Enjoyable parody of superhero tropes, especially in the early episodes
Catchy opening songs and fitting soundtrack
cons: Abrupt and jarring genre/tone shifts, especially after episode 7
Inconsistent plot and pacing, with many plot points appearing and disappearing
Inconsistent or awkward animation quality

anime.title: Galilei Donna: Storia di tre sorelle a caccia di un mistero
anime.synopsis: Three sisters, Hozuki, Kazuki, and Hazuki, are descendants of Galileo and have completely different personalities and tastes; they never meet eye-to-eye. One day, the girls are suddenly attacked by a mysterious organization. The organization was after the "Galileo Tesoro" which Galileo Galilei was said to have discovered. Still unaware of what was going on, the sisters escape on the airship they built after the sudden attack. But it won't be so easy for these three sisters to help each other out in a pinch when they're constantly at odds with each other. What is the Tesoro, and what is the organization after? And what about the relationship between the sisters? It's a threesome of cute girls, action, and mystery!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many feeling the show had potential but failed to deliver due to poor writing and underdeveloped characters. While some appreciate the animation and unique premise, the consensus leans towards disappointment. The ending is particularly criticized for being rushed and unsatisfying.
pros: Visually appealing animation, especially backgrounds and mecha sequences.
Catchy opening and ending themes.
Unique character designs.
cons: Poorly written story with plot holes and reliance on deus ex machina.
Underdeveloped characters, especially the older sisters.
Inconsistent tone and pacing issues.
Repetitive plot structure.

anime.title: Outbreak Company
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Otaku Culture, Parody
anime.synopsis:
Shinichi Kanou is a shut-in otaku with a vast knowledge of anime, manga, and video games. One day, after applying for a job in hopes of escaping his secluded lifestyle, he is kidnapped and transported to the Eldant Empire—a fantasy world filled with elves, dragons, and dwarves. Trapped in this strange land, Shinichi is given an unlikely task by the Japanese government: to spread otaku culture across the realm by becoming an "Otaku Missionary."

To accomplish his mission, Shinichi has the full support of the Japanese government, as well as the half-elf maid Myucel and Princess Petralka of the Eldant Empire. Together with this ragtag bunch, he will overcome the obstacles of politics, social classes, and ethnic discrimination to promote the ways of the otaku in this holy land.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Outbreak Company enjoyable and funny, particularly praising its concept and art style. However, many criticize the pacing issues towards the end and the generic harem elements, with some feeling it lacks depth and character development. Overall, it's considered a fun but flawed anime.
pros: Enjoyable and funny, good for relaxing.
Original concept of exporting otaku culture.
Good art and character designs.
cons: Pacing issues, especially in the last few episodes.
Generic harem elements.
Lack of character development for supporting cast.
Story lacks a linear plot line

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai
anime.synopsis:
The mysterious, yellow-masked Storyteller is a man whose true name and origin are both unknown. He appears at dusk where children gather and recites sinister tales based on Japanese urban legends, to which his young audience eerily intakes. However, the Storyteller is no ordinary teller of tales. He incorporates a kamishibai, a traditional paper-scrolling device, to add visuals to his already demented narration.

A series of short horror stories, Yami Shibai begins with a bachelor who, after moving into a new apartment, immediately starts sensing a malevolent glare being pressed into him. A single talisman rests on his ceiling, but he has no way of knowing it is one of the few safeguards that separate him from a bottomless pit of suffering. Each story is more terrifying, more appalling, and more sickening than the last as the Storyteller's audience find themselves being sucked into the vicious world of his words.
anime.consensus_summary: Yami Shibai is a collection of short, creepy horror stories that effectively use atmosphere and a unique art style to create a sense of unease. While some find the stories predictable and the characters underdeveloped, the short episode length and focus on Japanese folklore make it an enjoyable watch for horror fans. The audience generally appreciates the show's commitment to creating a chilling experience despite its limitations.
pros: Effective use of atmosphere and sound to create tension.
Unique art style inspired by kamishibai enhances the horror.
Short episode length keeps the pace quick and engaging.
cons: Stories can be predictable and rely on horror cliches.
Limited character development due to short episode length.
Inconsistent story quality with some episodes being uninteresting.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Chibi Theater - Fly, Cadets, Fly!
anime.synopsis: Shingeki no Kyojin Picture Drama  is a series of Flash animated gag shorts included with the Blu-ray Disc/DVD releases, featuring the characters in chibi form. Consisting of nine episodes, this series takes a light hearted and comedic take on the the SNK series with many memorable scenes and dialogues from the original series presented in humorous way. Each episodes depicts 2-3 days in the training of the 104th Trainee Corps as they train to become the hope for mankind in the war against the Titans.
anime.consensus_summary: The Shingeki no Kyojin Picture Drama is widely seen as a light-hearted, cute spin-off designed for dedicated fans seeking a break from the main series' grim tone. While its chibi art and character interactions are often praised, many find the humor repetitive and the lack of a substantial story disappointing. It's a polarizing release primarily due to its niche appeal and the feeling that it doesn't add significant value beyond fan service.
pros: Extremely cute chibi art style that fans appreciate.
Provides a light-hearted break from the main series' dark tone.
Entertaining for dedicated fans who want more character interactions.
Voice acting is often praised for its cuteness and enthusiasm.
Nostalgic element of seeing characters in a pre-tragedy state.
cons: Humor gets old quickly and becomes repetitive.
Some characters act out of character for comedic effect.
Lacks any deep story or significant plot development.
Animation quality and sound effects are considered average or not noteworthy.
The 'characters getting eaten' gag becomes boring.
Seen as a time/resource waste by some for the little content provided.

anime.title: Zettai Bouei Leviathan: Mini Takibi Gekijou
anime.romaji_title: Zettai Bouei Leviathan: Mini Takibi Gekijou
anime.synopsis: A new special mini corner airing after the rebroadcast version of TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: The mini-episodes are generally considered more enjoyable than the main series due to improved character interactions and charming dialogue. The simple animation and setting are minor drawbacks. Overall, the audience finds it a delightful addition to the franchise.
pros: Better character development than the main show
Enjoyable banter and dialogue
More adorable than the main show
cons: Simple animation
Repetitive setting (campfire)

anime.title: Riddle Story of Devil
anime.genres: Action, Girls Love, High Stakes Game, School, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Tokaku Azuma has just transferred to the elite Myoujou Academy, a private girls' boarding school. But there is a catch: she, along with 11 of her fellow students in Class Black, is an assassin taking part in the challenge to kill their sweet-natured classmate, Haru Ichinose. Whoever succeeds will be granted their deepest desire, no matter the difficulty or cost. However, each assassin only gets one chance; if they fail to kill her, they will be expelled.

Despite the extraordinary reward, Tokaku decides to take a different course of action. Though Haru is her target, the young assassin soon finds herself drawn to the very girl she is supposed to kill. With the entire class out for Haru, Tokaku refuses to let her friend die, vowing to protect her from a growing bloodlust.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding the premise intriguing but the execution flawed. The episodic nature and lack of character depth are frequently criticized, as is the weak and unsatisfying ending. While some appreciate the action and unique character designs, the overall consensus points to unrealized potential.
pros: Unique EDs for each character added spice to the show.
Character designs were distinct and visually appealing.
The opening theme was engaging and fast-paced.
cons: Predictable episodic format with little lasting impact from individual assassins.
Underdeveloped characters with shallow motivations and backstories.
Poorly executed plot with numerous inconsistencies and unresolved plot holes.
Weak ending that fails to provide a satisfying conclusion.

anime.title: Saiki Kusuo no Ψ-nan (ONA)
anime.synopsis: Anime adaptation of the Saiki Kusuo no Ψ-nan manga by Asou Shuichi, telling the story about a male high school student named Kusuo Saiki. He possesses supernatural powers that cause unfortunate events in his everyday life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is largely split, with a strong consensus that the humor and premise are excellent, but the animation and production quality are abysmal. Many viewers acknowledge the comedic potential and character capture but find the technical aspects detrimental, often recommending the later 2016 adaptation as a superior experience.
pros: The humor is effective and captures the essence of the work, with genuinely funny moments.
The voice acting, particularly for Nendou, is praised for being hilarious and contributing to the comedy.
The story premise is refreshing and engaging, focusing on a boy with supernatural abilities wanting a normal life.
The characters are captured almost perfectly, and the comedic moments are well-executed.
cons: The art and animation are consistently criticized as terrible, primitive, crude, and among the worst seen.
The pacing feels odd and rushed, sacrificing in-depth character development and joke impact.
The sound is hard to hear, and background music is not well-picked up.
The content is not exclusive, as the 2016 anime adaptation covers the same material but does it better.

anime.title: Little Witch Academia: The Enchanted Parade
anime.romaji_title: Little Witch Academia: Mahoujikake no Parade
anime.synopsis: You can tell witch training is not going swimmingly for the young sorceresses Akko, Lotte, and Sucy—they face expulsion for screwing up one class too many, and their only way out is if they successfully organize their academy's annual parade through a nearby town. But when they stumble upon the momentous discovery that the objective of the parade is to humiliate witches and commemorate their past subjugation, Akko decides it is time for a change: It is time to show the world how fantastic modern witches truly are! However, with the other girls struggling to keep up with Akko's grandiose ambitions, and everything from mischievous boys to slumbering giants getting in their way, maybe pulling it off will require not only all the magical prowess the pupils of Luna Nova Magical Academy can muster, but also a miracle.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely agrees that 'The Enchanted Parade' is a visually stunning and charming film with excellent animation and heartwarming moments, reminiscent of classic Disney. However, some critics find the story derivative and certain character portrayals, particularly Akko's, to be annoying or underdeveloped, leading to mild disagreement on core narrative elements.
pros: Stunning and fluid animation, comparable to Disney traditional animation, with vibrant colors and energetic character movements.
Charmingly endearing and heartwarming story that appeals to a sense of childhood wonder and imagination.
Excellent pacing with no filler scenes, allowing for a full and satisfying story arc within its runtime.
Masterful comedic timing and execution of jokes.
Strong character animation that effectively conveys personality and emotion.
Creative and fun magic sequences.
cons: The story, while well-executed, can be derivative and predictable, lacking significant originality.
Some characters, particularly Akko, are criticized for being annoying, selfish, or overly impulsive.
New characters are introduced but not well-developed, serving primarily as plot devices.
Certain thematic elements, like the bullying storyline and its resolution, are poorly handled and convey questionable morals.
The move from the school setting to the town detracted from some of the 'mystique' and 'magic'.
Dub voice acting is considered subpar by some, with a recommendation to watch subbed.

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden: Sunny Side Battle
anime.synopsis: Back at their childhood home, siblings Itachi and Sasuke Uchiha experience an unusual morning together when Itachi becomes obsessed with cooking the perfect fried egg for Sasuke. Despite being completely focused on the task, he continuously fails to achieve the desired result. As Sasuke marvels at his brother's seemingly unnecessary behavior, he comes to realize that there is more than meets the eye to Itachi's efforts.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Sunny Side Battle' OVA is a bizarre yet visually appealing side story that polarizes viewers with its absurd premise of Itachi obsessively cooking an egg for Sasuke. Some appreciate the detailed animation and suspenseful soundtrack, while others find the humor awkward and the plot nonsensical. Overall, it's a strange but short diversion from the main Naruto storyline.
pros: High-quality visual production, especially close-up details
Suspenseful soundtrack enhances key moments
Decent voice acting
cons: Background visuals become poor when out of focus
Humor is too subtle and sometimes inappropriate
Weird and unnecessary plot
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Absurdist Humor, Brotherly Bond

anime.title: Initial D Legend 1 Awakening
anime.romaji_title: New Initial D Movie: Legend 1 - Kakusei
anime.synopsis:
One foggy morning, a black and white Toyota AE86 flies past Keisuke Takahashi's Mazda RX7 on Mount Akina, making him believe he has seen the ghost of a racer who died on the mountain. Resolving to defeat this phantom, Keisuke mobilizes the Akagi Red Suns to take on the local Akina Speed Stars racing team in an exchange race. He anticipates that the competition will lure the elusive "Ghost of Akina" out into the open and give him the opportunity to exact revenge for his previous defeat. 

While his friend Itsuki Takeuchi is obsessed with cars and racing, Takumi Fujiwara is not. He fails to understand the "rush" that racers experience and any talk of cars reminds him of the tofu deliveries he makes for his father in an old AE86. His early morning routine takes him up and down Mount Akina, where he has memorized every hairpin, brake point, and turn better than anyone else. 

When the Akagi team appears one night to challenge the Speed Stars to an exchange race, they accept the challenge only to find out that they are completely outclassed. The only way the Speed Stars can stand a chance against them is if they can get the panda-colored AE86 to join their team. With a bit of coercion, Takumi takes the wheel of the AE86 and heads off to Mount Akina to defend the pride of all racers in Akina.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'New Initial D Movie: Legend 1 - Kakusei' is a visually updated retelling of the classic series, but it divides audiences. While some appreciate the improved animation and accessibility for new viewers, many fans are disappointed by the absence of Eurobeat music, the rushed pacing, and changes to characterizations. The movie is seen as a decent modernization, but it fails to capture the spirit and excitement of the original for a significant portion of its fanbase.
pros: Improved animation and art style compared to the original First Stage.
Faithful retelling of the initial story arc for newcomers.
More dramatic and fluid racing scenes due to drawn artwork instead of CGI.
cons: Absence of Eurobeat music detracts from the racing experience for long-time fans.
Pacing feels rushed, leading to a lack of character development and emotional impact.
Changes to the voice cast and character personalities disappoint some viewers.
Some find the updated graphics inferior to the original's aesthetic.

anime.title: Fighting Spirit: Rising
anime.synopsis:
Japanese Featherweight Champion Makunouchi Ippo has defended his title belt once more with the help of his devastating signature move: the Dempsey Roll. However, new challengers are rising up left and right, claiming to have an answer for the move responsible for crushing his opponents. Will Ippo be able to step up to the challenge, or will the weight of his pride destroy him before he finds out just what it means to be strong? Meanwhile, fellow Kamogawa Gym mate Aoki Masaru is just a hop, skip, and a Frog Punch away from claiming his own belt, ready to take on the Japanese Lightweight Champion!

Hajime no Ippo: Rising continues Ippo's quest to become stronger, featuring the same cast of loveable dimwits from Kamogawa Gym, as they put their bodies and hearts on the line to make their way in the harsh world of professional boxing. With a will of iron, Ippo steps into the ring once again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the character development, storytelling, and soundtrack. Some fans were disappointed by the skipped manga content and reduced focus on Ippo. Overall, the season is considered a worthwhile addition to the franchise, though not without its flaws.
pros: Excellent character development, especially for the main cast.
Amazing storytelling with a lot of heart.
Brilliant soundtrack that fits the scenes perfectly.
Exciting fights and character arcs.
Exploration of character dynamics.
cons: Skipped important parts from the manga, omitting character development details.
Repetitive plot elements and a lack of creativity.
Ippo screentime was lacking.
Animation quality slightly inferior compared to previous seasons.

anime.title: Neppuu Kairiku Bushi Road
anime.synopsis: The story takes place in a time when the world is in the pits of despair after being ravaged by a poison called "shinobi" that came to earth via an asteroid. The people run away to the place called "Kairiku," a place that used to be the bottom of the ocean. Here, the people try and protect themselves against the effects of the poison. In such a world, there was a single light of hope. The "Holy Weapon Giga Road" and the legendary warrior "Yagyuu" are needed in order to counter the effects of the poison. In order to save the world, Ame, a princess of a fallen nation, stands up in order to save the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the unique premise and visuals, while others criticize the rushed pacing and lack of depth. Many feel the potential was wasted due to the short runtime. Overall, the show is considered mediocre with a few redeeming qualities.
pros: Intriguing plot with a unique poison-based threat.
Visually appealing art and animation.
Satisfying ending for some viewers.
cons: Rushed pacing and underdeveloped story.
Lack of character development and weak motivations.
Flashbacks that add nothing to the story.
Useless side characters.
Generic and unoriginal elements.

anime.title: Kuroko's Basketball OVA
anime.romaji_title: Kuroko no Basket: Baka ja Katenai no yo!
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the 25th volume of Kuroko no Basket manga. The anime based on the Baka Ja Katenai no yo (バカじゃ勝てないのよ) story that was featured in the manga's fifth volume.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted, comedic episode focusing on the Seirin team helping Kagami with his studies. While some find it enjoyable and funny, others view it as a weak comedy that doesn't add much to the overall storyline. The episode's placement within the series' timeline is also a point of contention.
pros: Enjoyable and simple episode.
Funny character interactions and gags.
Showcases the team's dedication and camaraderie.
cons: Poor comedy for some viewers.
Story takes place earlier in the chronology.
Doesn't significantly advance the main plot.

anime.title: Free!: FrFr - Short Movie
anime.synopsis: Specials bundled with the DVD/BDs.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys these mini-episodes as lighthearted and entertaining additions to the main series. They appreciate the humor and heartwarming moments, particularly Haru's laughter. While the episodes are short and lack substantial development, they are seen as a fun bonus for fans.
pros: High-quality music and art, consistent with the main series.
Funny and cute stories featuring the main characters.
Some episodes add small details to the overall story and connect to Drama CDs.
cons: Lack of significant character or plot development due to the short format.
Episodes are very short (around 2.5 minutes).

anime.title: If Her Flag Breaks
anime.synopsis:
In visual novels, an imaginary flag is defined as an event that serves as a turning point for the whole story. A player triggering the romance flag for a heroine will proceed to her route, or a death flag will signify that a certain character will die afterwards.

High school student Souta Hatate can see these flags above a person's head, and has the ability to bring them down to stop certain events from happening. Using this power, he has prevented other people's deaths. But, after a past accident with him as a sole survivor, he ended up believing that only misfortune will befall those who are near him, and has refrained from making friends or having relationships ever since.

However, everything starts to change after transferring to a new school. After toppling another death flag, his classmate Nanami Knight Bladefield notices his powers and tries to learn more about him, promising that she will remain at his side no matter what may happen. Thus begins Souta's journey as he meets new friends and acquaintances while uncovering the mysteries of his ability—which might run deeper than what anyone expects.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with some appreciating the unique premise and comedic elements, while others criticize the poor execution, overwhelming harem, and confusing plot twists. Many feel the series had potential but ultimately failed to deliver a cohesive and satisfying experience. The ending, in particular, drew criticism for being rushed and nonsensical.
pros: Unique concept with the flags
Catchy opening and ending themes
Some viewers found the blend of genres enjoyable
Interesting underlying plot for some viewers
cons: Poorly executed plot with confusing twists and lack of explanation
Overabundance of underdeveloped and stereotypical harem characters
Inconsistent tone, switching abruptly between comedy and seriousness
Rushed and unsatisfying ending
Art style may not appeal to all viewers, described as 'babyfaces'

anime.title: A Certain Scientific Railgun S Specials
anime.romaji_title: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun S: Motto Marutto Railgun
anime.synopsis: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun S specials that were released on Blu-ray and DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the 'Motto Marutto Railgun' specials as lighthearted parodies of the main series. The humor is well-received by those familiar with similar styles like Gintama or YouTube abridged content. The short and random nature of the specials may not appeal to all viewers, but overall, the reception is positive.
pros: Humorous parodies of the original series.
Strong fourth-wall breaking elements.
Similar humor to Gintama and YouTube abridged series.
cons: Humor may be too random or obscure for some viewers.
The specials are very short.

anime.title: Kyousougiga
anime.synopsis:
Long ago, there was a monk named Myoue who could bring anything he drew to life. He quietly lived with his wife Koto—a black rabbit in human form—and their three children: Yakushimaru, Kurama, and Yase. One day, the high priest of the land concluded that Myoue's drawings caused too many problems for the locals and ordered him to find a solution. In response, the family secretly fled to an alternate world of Myoue's own creation—the Looking Glass City.

Everything was peaceful until Myoue and Koto suddenly vanished. Their three children are left to take care of the city, and Yakushimaru inherits Myoue's name and duties. Stranded in this alternate world, their problems only get worse when a young girl—also named Koto—crashes down from the sky and declares that she is also looking for the older Myoue and Koto. Armed with a giant hammer and two rowdy familiars, Koto just might be the key to releasing everyone from the eternal paper city.
anime.consensus_summary: Kyousou Giga is a visually stunning and emotionally rich anime that explores themes of family and identity. While some viewers may find the plot confusing or the narrative structure unconventional, most appreciate its unique charm and heartwarming story. The series is praised for its well-developed characters and its ability to blend lighthearted moments with deeper, more meaningful themes.
pros: Unique visual style and animation.
Intricate and emotionally resonant story about family bonds.
Well-developed characters with depth and internal conflicts.
cons: Unexplained motivations and plot points can lead to confusion.
Fast-paced beginning can be overwhelming.
Some viewers may find the narrative structure unconventional or convoluted.

anime.title: Assassination Classroom: Jump Festa 2013 Special
anime.synopsis: Class 3-E is getting ready for their class trip to Kyoto, and Koro-sensei is as excited as ever! Nagisa is in a group with Kaede, Karma, Tomohito, Manami, and the class idol Yukiko Kanzaki. The students are aware of the fact that this is a great opportunity to assassinate Koro-sensei, but they cannot help having great time with him. However, the trip becomes even more exciting and dangerous when they get attacked by a bunch of delinquents who kidnap the girls. As if that is not enough, there is a hired sniper named Red Eye lurking around, ready to be the one who would assassinate Koro-sensei and claim the prize. Can the students of Class 3-E rely on Koro-sensei even now?
anime.consensus_summary: The Jump Festa special is a mixed bag. Fans familiar with the anime series may find it redundant and of lower quality, particularly in animation. However, newcomers might enjoy it as an introduction to the series' humor and characters, while manga readers appreciate its faithfulness.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material.
Enjoyable for those new to the series.
Captures the humor and positive themes of the manga.
cons: Inferior animation quality compared to the main series.
Redundant for viewers who have already seen the anime adaptation of the arc.
Sound quality and voice acting choices are questionable.

anime.title: Magical Warfare
anime.synopsis:
The world as we know it is actually just half the story, as Takeshi Nanase finds out abruptly one summer morning. On his way to kendo practice, Takeshi comes across an unconscious girl in a uniform he doesn't recognize. Takeshi does the decent thing and saves her, and in return the girl wakes up and accidentally turns him into a magic-user.

As Takeshi finds out, there is the world he lives in and the world of magic users. Most magic users just want to peacefully coexist with non-magicians, but there are some with bigger ambitions. Mui Aiba is a magician enrolled in the Subaru Magic Academy, where magic users can learn to control and channel their powers and how to live in peace with regular humans. After his fateful encounter with Mui, Takeshi and his newly magician friends Kurumi Isoshima and Kazumi Ida decide to enroll in the Magic Academy as well.

All three friends have different reasons for fighting on, whether they're fighting to escape the past or catch up to the future. They wield different kinds of powers, which they must learn to harness in order to fight off the Ghost Trailers, a group of magicians who are willing to use violence to assert their superiority over humans.

Pursued by the Ghost Trailers, Takeshi and his friends must train to become stronger, face the leader of the Trailers, and prevent the beginning of the Second Great Magic War.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Reviewers express disappointment with the anime's poor execution of its initial premise, citing issues with pacing, character development, and overall plot coherence. Many feel the ending is abrupt and unsatisfying, leaving numerous unanswered questions and a sense of wasted potential.
pros: Some found the initial premise interesting.
The opening and ending themes were well-received.
Some found the character designs initially appealing.
cons: Rushed and incoherent plot development with many unanswered questions.
Generic and unoriginal characters with little to no development.
Poor pacing and significant time skips contribute to a confusing narrative.
Mediocre art and animation with inconsistencies.
Unnecessary and poorly integrated romance aspects.
Dissatisfying cliffhanger ending with no resolution.

anime.title: Knights of Sidonia
anime.synopsis:
After destroying Earth many years ago, the alien race Gauna has been pursuing the remnants of humanity—which, having narrowly escaped, fled across the galaxy in a number of giant seed ships. In the year 3394, Nagate Tanikaze surfaces from his lifelong seclusion deep beneath the seed ship Sidonia in search of food on the upper levels, only to find himself dragged into events unfolding without his knowledge.

When the Gauna begin their assault on Sidonia, it's up to Tanikaze—with the help of his fellow soldiers and friends Shizuka Hoshijiro, Izana Shinatose, and Yuhata Midorikawa—to defend humanity's last hope for survival, and defeat their alien foes. Sidonia no Kishi follows Tanikaze as he discovers the world that has been above him his entire life, and becomes the hero Sidonia needs.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Sidonia no Kishi are mixed. Some viewers praise the exciting story, unique world, and competent main character, while others are critical of the CGI animation, confusing plot, and bland characters. The series generates moderate controversy due to its divisive elements.
pros: Exciting and thrilling story with edge-of-your-seat action.
Thoughtful and well-realized sci-fi world with intriguing mystery.
Unique storytelling that doesn't pander to fans with flashy battles.
Atmospheric music and appropriate sound design enhance the experience.
Main character is competent and avoids annoying tropes.
cons: CGI animation may be off-putting and choppy.
Story can be confusing initially and may lack narrative depth.
Harem elements feel generic and detract from the main plot.
Bland characters hinder the overall success of the series.
Some find the plot elements overused and unoriginal.

anime.title: No Game, No Life
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Isekai, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
Sixteen sentient races inhabit Disboard, a world overseen by Tet, the One True God. The lowest of the sixteen—Imanity—consists of humans, a race with no affinity for magic. In a place where everything is decided through simple games, humankind seems to have no way out of their predicament—but the arrival of two outsiders poses a change.

On Earth, stepsiblings Sora and Shiro are two inseparable shut-ins who dominate various online games under the username "Blank." While notorious on the internet, the pair believe that life is merely another dull game. However, after responding to a message from an unknown user, they are suddenly transported to Disboard. The mysterious sender turns out to be Tet, who informs them about the world's absolute rules. After Tet leaves, Sora and Shiro begin their search for more information and a place to stay, taking them to Elkia—Imanity's only remaining kingdom.

There, the duo encounters Stephanie Dola, an emotional girl vying for the kingdom's sovereignty. In desperation, she attempts to regain her father's throne, but her foolhardiness makes her goal unachievable. Inspired by the girl's motivation and passion, Sora and Shiro decide to aid Stephanie in getting Elkia back on its feet, ultimately aiming to become the new rulers of the enigmatic realm.
anime.consensus_summary: No Game No Life is a visually stunning anime with an initially intriguing premise centered around games and isekai themes. However, the series is polarizing, with many viewers criticizing its reliance on fan service, shallow plot, and unlikable characters. While some appreciate the unique art style and dynamic between the protagonists, others find it to be overhyped and ultimately disappointing.
pros: Unique premise with interesting games and tactics.
Visually appealing art style with bright colors and fluid animation.
Engaging characters and the dynamic between Sora and Shiro.
cons: Overreliance on fan service and pandering to the audience.
Plot can be shallow and predictable, relying on recycled tropes.
Characters can be reduced to caricatures to elevate the protagonist.
Tactics within the games do not always make sense

anime.title: Saikyou Ginga Ultimate Zero: Battle Spirits
anime.romaji_title: Saikyou Ginga Ultimate Zero: Battle Spirits
anime.synopsis:
In the new, whimsical era of Battle Spirits, cards have become scattered across a colorful galaxy, enticing all "card questers" to duke it out in search of the strongest cards. Rei is a flamboyant wanderer who is obsessed with being on top. Accompanied by a small dragon named Mugen and a talking robot named Salt, the self-proclaimed "Number One Star" regularly engages in card-gaming mischief through flashy battles. 

One day, Rei meets Raira and Rikuto April, both of whom seem to have clues on the whereabouts of the "ultimate" Battle Spirits card. Together, they embark on a quest to search for the card, clashing with many vibrant personalities along the way. Soon, their adventure catches the attention of the Guild, wily villains who are also set on obtaining the Ultimate Battle Spirits. In contending against the Guild, Rei's status as number one is put to the test—an endeavor that will slowly unveil secrets regarding the fate of the universe.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's stunning visuals, engaging card game mechanics, and unique characters. Reviewers highlight the show's ability to capture a childlike sense of wonder and fun. There are no significant criticisms or controversies mentioned.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style
Engaging and well-designed card game mechanics
Unique and likable main character with memorable sidekicks
cons: N/A - No significant cons in provided reviews.

anime.title: Super Seisyun Brothers
anime.synopsis: The story involves two pairs of teenage elder sister and younger brother, the Shinmoto's who are a bit narcissistic and the Saitou's who look a bit mysterious. It follows their everyday life in school and at home.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Super Seisyun Brothers' for its cute art style, relatable characters, and humorous, slice-of-life content. The short episode length is a common point of frustration, as viewers are left wanting more. The lack of a strong plot is a minor drawback for some, but overall, the series is well-received as a lighthearted and enjoyable watch.
pros: Unique and appealing art style with bright colors
Realistic and relatable characters with distinct personalities
Enjoyable and light-hearted with humorous moments
Good voice acting that complements the characters
Character development
cons: Very short episodes (4 minutes) leave the viewer wanting more
Lack of a strong overarching plot, more episodic
Some found the music average
Themes not well developed

anime.title: Nobunagun
anime.synopsis: Shio Ogura is a Japanese high school student, who is visiting Taiwan on a school trip when she is suddenly attacked by monsters. Agents known as "E-Gene Holders" from the government agency DOGOO also arrive, who wield weapons infused with the spirits of historical figures. Shio is revealed to also be an E-Gene Holder when the soul of Oda Nobunaga awakens after she tries to rescue a friend.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the action, unique premise, and engaging OST, many find the characters bland, the plot generic, and the animation lacking. The show is considered a fun but ultimately forgettable experience, with wasted potential due to uninspired character development and a predictable storyline. Most agree the show had potential that it didn't quite reach.
pros: Engaging OST and unique art style.
Interesting premise of historical figures as power sources.
Action-packed with well-placed comedic relief.
cons: Bland and generic characters with little development.
