Mediocre animation and inconsistent art quality.
Basic plot with a predictable 'aliens vs. teenagers' theme.

anime.title: Tesagure! Bukatsumono
anime.synopsis: Now that she has entered high school, Koharu Tanaka begins searching for a club to join. But the last thing she expects is to be roped into the activities of the so-called "Groping Club." Despite its name, the club is surprisingly ordinary—their goal is to "grope" for new ideas, and new types of clubs and club activities that they could engage with, even if the end result is often outlandish. While the months go by, and different ideas are entertained, Koharu stumbles upon the most important thing clubs can provide—lifelong friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Tesagure! Bukatsumono for its meta-humor and unique production style, despite the low-quality animation. The improvised dialogue and self-aware parodies are highlighted as key strengths. While the visual presentation is a common point of criticism, the overall sentiment is positive, with viewers finding the show to be a refreshing and entertaining take on the slice-of-life genre.
pros: Self-aware and parodies anime tropes effectively.
Improvised dialogue and voice acting create realistic character interactions.
Unique and entertaining due to its innovative approach and humor.
cons: Crude CG animation using MikuMikuDance.
Humor may not appeal to all viewers, especially those unfamiliar with anime tropes.
Visually unappealing due to the low-budget production.

anime.title: Hunter x Hunter: The Last Mission
anime.romaji_title: Hunter x Hunter Movie 2: The Last Mission
anime.synopsis:
Nen: the hidden source of energy and potential that runs through everyone, and gives those that master it a source of great power. Inside Nen is the potential for limitless light and limitless darkness. The Hunter Association has arisen to control access to it. Hunters come in many shapes and forms, and with many different appetites - but all of them have learned to master Nen, and use it to chase wealth, power, and their dreams.

The greatest and most powerful Hunter is Isaac Netero, chairman of the Hunter Association. Decades ago he sealed away Jed, a Hunter who had mastered the use of On, the dark "shadow" of Nen. Now On users have reappeared at the Heaven's Arena "Battle Olympia" tournament. For Netero, this is the last mission: to protect the Association and the world from a threat driven by hatred and the thirst for revenge. And he's going to need all the help he can get in order to succeed.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding the movie disappointing due to its cliche plot and weak character development. Some enjoyed the nostalgia of seeing familiar characters and the good animation, but overall, the film is considered non-canon and forgettable. The 'power of friendship' theme felt forced and overused, contributing to the negative sentiment.
pros: Nostalgia factor with returning characters (Zushi, Bisky, Wing)
Good animation and soundtrack quality
Enjoyable fight scenes
cons: Cliche and predictable plot centered around 'power of friendship'
Poor character development and weak villains
Story feels forced and half-assed with many plot holes
Outdated power scaling compared to later arcs in the series
Characters acting out of character

anime.title: Sword Art Online: Extra Edition
anime.synopsis: Kazuto "Kirito" Kirigaya and his sister Suguha meet up with Asuna Yuuki, Rika "Lisbeth" Shinozaki, and Keiko "Silica" Ayano at the SAO Survivor School. Kirito then attends emergency counseling, while the girls go for a swim at the pool. It turns out that said "emergency counseling" is a subterfuge set up by Seijirou Kikuoka, who aims to rehash the incident of Sword Art Online in hopes of determining Akihiko Kayaba's motives. What will the girls get up to in the pool, and what awaits Kirito and his "counseling"?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Sword Art Online: Extra Edition is highly divided, primarily due to its extensive recap content. While some fans appreciate the nostalgic refresher and the brief new material, a significant portion of viewers found the special to be a disappointing and prolonged waste of time, heavily diluted by repetitive flashbacks and excessive fanservice.
pros: Animation and art quality remain consistent with the original series.
Soundtrack, including reused and new songs, is generally well-received.
Provides a nostalgic refresher for long-time fans.
Offers some character interactions outside of the main game setting.
The new footage, though brief, is sometimes described as inspiring or a pleasant diversion.
cons: The overwhelming majority of the runtime is a recap of the first season, with very little new content.
The new plot elements are often considered weak, anticlimactic, or rushed.
Significant reliance on fanservice, particularly with the female characters in swimsuits.
The framing device for the recap (interviews/discussions) is seen as boring or redundant by many.
The narrative quality and plot depth are considered shallow and not thought-provoking by some.
Character development is minimal to non-existent in the new content.

anime.title: D-Frag!
anime.synopsis:
The Kazama Family—a gang of three wannabe delinquents and close friends, spearheaded by Kenji Kazama, is trying to make a name for themselves at Fujou Academy. On the first day of the term, the gang finds themselves putting out a fire in the Game Development Club. Instead of thanking them, the eccentric club members attack and knock out Kenji's two friends, forcing Kenji to fight for his life. Failing to escape, the gang leader is coerced into joining the Game Development Club.

As he settles in, Kenji gets to know the four girls responsible for his provisional membership—student council president and general tyrant Chitose Karasuyama, spirited tomboy Sakura Mizukami, negligent club advisor Minami Oosawa, and the school's infamous shadow leader Roka Shibasaki. Throughout the Game Development Club's constant shenanigans and his desperate attempts to leave the club, Kenji begins to realize that he may be actually enjoying himself.
anime.consensus_summary: D-Frag! is overwhelmingly praised for its comedic value and memorable characters, making it a highly enjoyable watch for fans of the comedy genre. While some reviewers note the weak plot and average animation, the consensus is that the humor and character interactions are strong enough to make up for these shortcomings. The anime is considered a fun and lighthearted experience, best enjoyed without expecting a deep or complex narrative.
pros: Unique and hilarious characters with distinct personalities.
Effective manzai-style comedy with unpredictable punchlines.
Energetic and fitting voice acting and opening theme.
cons: Lacking a meaningful or cohesive overarching story.
Generic or average animation quality.
Character development is minimal.

anime.title: Miss Monochrome The Animation
anime.synopsis: Miss Monochrome is an android powered by a single AA battery. She lives with her only friend, a robot vacuum named Ruu-chan. With hopes of one day meeting the idol Kikuko, whom she has bizarre recurring dreams about, Miss Monochrome sets foot on the path to stardom. However, she experiences difficulties and struggles to make her own debut as an idol. Though Miss Monochrome's methods seem bizarre, such as recruiting her manager from a convenience store, somehow her dedication always results in her standing out from the crowd and shining in the spotlight.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys "Miss Monochrome The Animation" for its short, comedic episodes and charming characters, particularly Miss Monochrome herself. The series is praised for its lightheartedness and ability to provide quick entertainment. However, some viewers find the lack of a substantial plot and the reliance on random humor to be drawbacks, but the series' strengths are still generally well-received.
pros: Unique and charming characters, especially Miss Monochrome and Ruu-chan.
Catchy ending theme and good voice acting.
Enjoyable and funny despite the short episode length.
Creative and unexpected comedic situations.
Wholesome and lighthearted feel.
cons: Weak or non-existent overarching plot due to the short episode format.
Repetitive or one-dimensional character interactions.
Generic art style.
Reliance on randomness that may not appeal to all viewers.
Inconsistencies and plot elements introduced without proper explanation.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Idol Culture, Slice of Life

anime.title: Kill Me Baby: Butsuzou Kegatte Nise Halloween
anime.romaji_title: Kill Me Baby: Butsuzou Kegatte Nise Halloween
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the franchise's Kill Me Baby Super Best Album CD (キルミーベイベー・スーパー). OAD adapted eight previously unanimated story episodes from Kazuho's original manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA largely maintains the comedic style of the original series. While some find the familiar format and lack of plot disappointing, others appreciate the faster pace and enhanced humor. Overall, it's considered a decent comedy anime, particularly praised for its voice acting.
pros: Faster pace compared to the original series
Witty and aggressive humor
Excellent voice acting that enhances the characters' wacky nature
cons: Lack of plot
Similar format to the original series, which some found disappointing
Relies heavily on slapstick

anime.title: IS: Infinite Stratos 2 - Hitonatsu no Omoide
anime.romaji_title: IS: Infinite Stratos 2 - Hitonatsu no Omoide
anime.synopsis: An extended version of the second season's first episode, which is under the same title.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views this as a fan service-focused episode with no significant plot or character development. While some appreciate the fan service and cute moments, others find it to be filler content that could have been omitted. It's considered skippable unless one is specifically looking for lighthearted, character-focused interactions.
pros: Offers fan service for those who enjoy it
Features cute shy moments from heroines
cons: No plot development
Minor character development, mostly girls fawning over protagonist
Essentially filler content

anime.title: Sakura Trick
anime.synopsis:
Having been best friends since middle school, Haruka Takayama and Yuu Sonoda plan to attend Misato West High School together. However, despite being assigned to the same class, a cruel twist of fate has them seated on the opposite ends of their classroom! To make matters worse, their school will shut down in three years, making them the final intake of first-year students. Undeterred by this chain of unfortunate events, Haruka is set on sticking with Yuu, striving to create many wonderful memories with her.

Much to Haruka's jealousy however, Yuu's easygoing demeanor quickly attracts the attention of their female classmates. Sympathizing with her friend's growing insecurity, Yuu ends up sharing a deep, affectionate kiss with her in an empty classroom. The act intensifies their bond as "special friends," gradually revealing a different aspect to their unique friendship while also inviting new conflicts.
anime.consensus_summary: Sakura Trick is a polarizing yuri anime. While some find it cute, heartwarming, and enjoyable for its romantic elements and unique animation, others criticize its lack of plot progression, dull characters, and overemphasis on kissing scenes.  The series is further marred by the inclusion of an inappropriate relationship between cousins, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Heartwarming and cute interactions between characters, especially Haruka and Yuu.
Well-placed romantic scenes that enhance the story.
Unique animation style reminiscent of Shaft.
Good balance of comedy and romance.
cons: Story lacks progression and feels episodic.
Characters, especially side characters, are dull and lack complexity.
Excessive kissing scenes become repetitive and meaningless.
Inappropriate inclusion of a romantic relationship between cousins.

anime.title: Wizard Barristers
anime.synopsis: The story takes place in Tokyo in 2018, where normal humans and those who can use magic coexist. As a result, there are laws against using magic, and a "magic courtroom" exists to preside over lawsuits regarding magic use. In these cases, "Benmashi" or wizard barristers defend those who use magic. The anime follows Cecil, the youngest Benmashi in history, and her associates as they defend clients in these cases.
anime.consensus_summary: Wizard Barristers had a promising concept but suffers from poor execution. Viewers are generally disappointed by the rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, and tonal inconsistencies. While some appreciate the action and unique premise, the overall consensus is that the anime fails to live up to its potential, resulting in a mediocre experience.
pros: Unique premise blending law and magic.
Well-animated fight sequences and detailed scenery.
Enjoyable opening and ending themes, fitting background music.
cons: Rushed storyline with plot holes and underdeveloped characters.
Inconsistent animation quality, especially in later episodes.
Awkward comedy and ecchi elements that feel out of place.
Shift in focus in the second half, abandoning world exploration.
Weak central plot and flawed motives behind characters' actions.

anime.title: Space Dandy
anime.synopsis:
Dandy is a groovy, pompadour-wearing man who explores the stars in search of strange aliens for money, desiring to visit his favorite place: BooBies, the best diner in all the cosmos. Traversing the galaxies in his trusty ship, the Aloha Oe, Dandy is accompanied by his two equally unique friends: QT, the vacuum cleaner robot; and Meow, an alien with a cat-like appearance. 

Although exciting, Dandy's job is never simple, and each new day promises a completely different, thrilling adventure. Together, Dandy and his crew get dragged into perilous journeys, misadventures in romance, and out of this world scenarios—all whilst steering clear of the evil scientist, Dr. Gel of the Gogol Empire.
anime.consensus_summary: Space Dandy is a visually stunning and often funny anime that prioritizes style and creativity over substance. While praised for its unique episodic adventures and animation, it's criticized for its inconsistent humor, lack of plot, and immature content.  The audience is divided, with some finding it a refreshing parody and others considering it a waste of potential.
pros: Fantastic animation and art style, with each episode offering a unique visual experience.
Great soundtrack that complements the show's tone.
Episodic format allows for creative and diverse storylines, parodying various sci-fi tropes.
cons: Inconsistent humor, with many jokes falling flat or being too juvenile.
Lack of an overarching plot or character development makes the series feel disjointed.
Overuse of fanservice and immature content detracts from the overall quality.

anime.title: Obocchama-kun
anime.synopsis: Based on the children's award winning manga by Kobayashi Yoshinori, serialized  in Shogakukan's CoroCoro Comic.
anime.consensus_summary: Obocchama-kun is widely recognized as a children's anime with simple, episodic content. While it effectively entertains its target demographic, older viewers are likely to find it too simplistic and lacking in plot progression, suggesting a clear consensus on its intended audience and limitations.
pros: Enjoyable for children in the target age range (4-13 y/o)
Lighthearted and suitable for casual viewing ('just to kill time and in leisure')
cons: Lacks plot development, making it potentially boring for older audiences
Can be repetitive and simplistic for viewers seeking more complex narratives
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Children's Anime

anime.title: Pokémon: Origins
anime.synopsis:
Pokémon are marvelous creatures that come in a variety of types and sizes, with abilities, powers, and personalities as diverse as they are numerous. Doctor Yukinari Ookido has dedicated his life to studying these fascinating beings, that can be caught, trained, traded, and battled against each other. There's only so much he can do from his lab though. With this in mind, Ookido entrusts two young boys with a Pokémon of their own and a computerized encyclopedia to catalog them. One of them, Green, is brash, passionate, slightly arrogant, and Doctor Ookido's own nephew. The other boy, Red, is equally passionate, and filled with a wide-eyed, mildly naive sense of wonder.

Pokémon: The Origin follows Red in his journey through the region of Kanto in his attempt to complete his "Pokédex" by capturing and cataloging all the Pokémon that exist. Along the way he'll discover there's more to himself and his goals than he originally thought. Red will have to put both himself and his Pokémon to the test in special Gyms whose leaders are steps along the way to the Pokémon League, in order to challenge the Elite Four and become a Pokémon League Champion.

Aside from his goals to become a Champion, Red has other problems brewing. There are others who capture and train Pokémon for more sinister reasons, with the infamous criminal organization Team Rocket being one of them. If Red can defeat them, fellow trainers, his rival Green, and wild Pokémon all through Kanto, he just may fulfill his own dream, and Doctor Ookido's as well.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive towards Pokemon: The Origin, praising its faithfulness to the original games and nostalgic appeal. However, many feel that the limited number of episodes resulted in a rushed story and underdeveloped characters. Despite its flaws, it's considered a worthwhile experience for Pokemon fans, especially those who grew up with the original games.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the original Pokemon Red/Green games.
Nostalgic experience for fans of the original games.
Red is portrayed as a competent trainer who achieves his goals.
Music is orchestrated versions of classic game tracks.
cons: Story feels rushed due to the limited number of episodes.
Character development feels forced.
Skipped many gyms and locations from the game.
Lacks depth and exploration of the journey aspect.

anime.title: Boku no Boukuugou
anime.synopsis: The fourth film in Shin-Ei's series of annual WWII themed anime television movies for children Sensou Douwa (war story).
anime.consensus_summary: The audience feels sympathetic towards the protagonist's coping mechanism of denying reality after experiencing loss. The film's simplicity and realism are appreciated. However, some find the plot predictable due to its adherence to war anime clichés. Overall, the film evokes a sense of sadness and admiration for the character's resilience.
pros: Simplicity and realistic approach to grief.
Relatable portrayal of a child's coping mechanism.
cons: Clichéd war anime trope of a character's death.
Potentially weak plot due to over-reliance on denial.

anime.title: Wooser's Hand-to-Mouth Life: Awakening Arc
anime.synopsis: Second season of Wooser no Sono Higurashi.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is pleasantly surprised by the show's unexpected depth and charm. Wooser's personality and the relationships between characters are highlighted as strengths. The addition of Darth Wooser and the voice acting are also well-received.
pros: Wooser's charming personality and interactions with other characters.
The deep relationship between Wooser, Ren, and Rin.
Darth Wooser's character and voice acting by Kamiya Hiroshi.

anime.title: Koroshiya-san: The Hired Gun
anime.synopsis: The comedy story follows the title character, who is regarded by himself and others as the best hit man in Japan. He goes by the motto, "If I have an assignment, I will kill anything." However, his "killing" assignments have expanded to include everything from summer vacation homework to housekeeping. "The hit man never fails to kill the target. Though he does not aim to, he also never misses the laughter."
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received as a lighthearted comedy that offers a change of pace. Viewers appreciate its humorous elements and find it enjoyable. However, some find the plot lacking depth and the content somewhat random due to the short episodes.
pros: Great change of pace
Enjoyable comedy
Recommend this anime
cons: Nothing serious
Not much is going on
Random stuff happening
Short footage

anime.title: Sekaiichi Hatsukoi Movie: Yokozawa Takafumi no Baai
anime.romaji_title: Sekaiichi Hatsukoi Movie: Yokozawa Takafumi no Baai
anime.genres: Boys Love, Childcare, Comedy, Drama, Workplace
anime.synopsis: Movie adaptation of the Sekaiichi Hatsukoi: Yokozawa Takafumi no Baai BL light novel.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is generally well-received, especially by fans of the series, as it provides a satisfying conclusion for Yokozawa's character. While the plot is predictable and somewhat rushed, the positive portrayal of relationships and Yokozawa's redemption arc outweigh the negatives for most viewers. The movie's greatest strength lies in character development and providing closure.
pros: Yokozawa's character arc is compelling and makes him more likeable.
The movie provides closure for characters after the anime's ending.
The depiction of same-sex relationships is handled well, particularly the child's acceptance.
cons: The story feels rushed due to the movie's length.
The plot is predictable and lacks significant conflict.
Some find the story cliche and unoriginal.

anime.title: Hozuki's Coolheadedness
anime.synopsis:
Hell is a bureaucracy, and business is running smoother than ever thanks to the demonic efficiency of Hoozuki, chief deputy to Lord Enma, the King of Hell. Whether offering counsel to the Momotarou of Japanese folklore or receiving diplomatic missions from the Judeo-Christian Hell, the demon who runs the show from behind the king's imposing shadow is ready to beat down any challenges coming his way into a bloody pulp. Metaphorically, of course...

The poster boy for micromanagement and armed with negotiation skills worthy of Wall Street, Hoozuki no Reitetsu follows the sadistic and level-headed Hoozuki as he spends his days troubleshooting hell. With an abundance of familiar faces from popular Japanese legends and East Asian mythology working middle management positions, this referential and anachronistic dark comedy brings new meaning to the phrase "employer liability." Just how hard could it be to manage employees from hell, anyway?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Hoozuki no Reitetsu for its unique comedic take on Hell and Japanese mythology, praising its art style, music, and characters. However, some find the humor too dry or culturally specific, and the episodic nature and lack of overarching plot may not appeal to all. Despite these criticisms, the show is largely considered a refreshing and enjoyable comedy anime.
pros: Original and fresh comedy, especially in the anime genre.
Unique art style incorporating classic Japanese art.
Catchy and well-timed music and sound effects.
Interesting and memorable characters.
Educational about Japanese and East Asian mythology.
cons: Episodic format with no overarching story may not appeal to all viewers.
Jokes heavily reliant on knowledge of Japanese culture and mythology, potentially confusing for some Western viewers.
Some viewers find the humor dry or boring.
Lack of character development may be a drawback for some.
Casual attitude towards death
anime.thematic_vibe: Dark Comedy, Japanese Mythology, Slice of Life

anime.title: WataMote: No Matter How I Look At It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular! OVA
anime.romaji_title: Watashi ga Motenai no wa Dou Kangaetemo Omaera ga Warui!: Motenaishi, Nazomeite Miru
anime.synopsis:
Aomatsu is just an ordinary otaku leading an uneventful life in middle school. In an attempt to spice things up, he decides to visit the roof of the school, and it is there that he sees a mysterious young maiden with pitch-black hair. Unbeknownst to him, her name is Tomoko Kuroki, and she is infamous for her bizarre behavior.

The conversation that ensues from the meeting leaves a lasting impression on Aomatsu, compelling him to return day after day just to see Tomoko again. Tomoko's view of their meetings, however, is quite different from that of Aomatsu, leading to the two having significantly different memories of a particular event.
anime.consensus_summary: The Watamote OVA is a mixed bag for viewers. While some appreciate its unique perspective and relatable humor, others find it boring or contradictory to the main series themes. Many viewers enjoyed seeing Tomoko's character explored in a different light, but the short length left some wanting more.
pros: Accurate portrayal of social anxiety.
Humorous and relatable for viewers who have experienced social awkwardness.
Interesting perspective shift showing how Tomoko is perceived by others.
cons: Some found the OVA boring or confusing.
Felt thematically contradictory to the main series for some viewers.
Story felt too short to be satisfying.

anime.title: Inari Kon Kon
anime.genres: Comedy, Mythology, Romance, School, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Frazzle-haired middle schooler Inari Fushimi is less than average; she's painfully shy and horribly clumsy, but despite all this, she is undeniably kind. Running about the winding streets of her hometown, she takes a shortcut through the local shrine and stumbles upon a small fox pup in a river. After rescuing him, she continues on, but from this moment on, her life takes a drastic turn.

Grateful for rescuing the pup, the shrine goddess Uka-no-Mitama-no-Kami, "Uka-sama," grants Inari a fragment of her power. Now, Inari has the ability to transform into anyone by shouting the magical phrase "Inari, konkon." Could this power also grant her the courage to convey her feelings to her crush, Kouji Tanbabashi? With her new heavenly ability and the fox spirit Kon, Inari forms a sincere friendship with Uka-sama, encounters more of the supernatural world, and learns that true love knows no bounds.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences found 'Inari, Konkon, Koi Iroha' to be a pleasant and heartwarming anime with a strong emphasis on friendship and character development, particularly Inari's journey of self-discovery. While the artwork is praised, some felt the romance was underdeveloped, the plot tried to include too many themes for the short episode count, and the ending was unsatisfying. Despite its flaws, it is generally considered an enjoyable and easy watch, especially for those interested in Japanese mythology and feel-good stories.
pros: Character development is remarkable, especially for Inari.
Explores various human emotions, making it relatable.
Beautiful artwork and animation, especially the shrine work and landscapes.
Strong focus on friendship and relationships beyond romance.
Presents moral lessons and explores deity concepts interestingly.
cons: Romance elements are lacking and not the main focus.
Story tries to include too many themes without fully developing them.
Ending felt rushed and unsatisfying.
Some characters are generic and forgettable.
Plot can be weak and generic with some missing elements.

anime.title: Himeyuri
anime.synopsis:
The 30-minute film centers around a group of high school nurses called Himeyuri who served during the Battle of Okinawa during World War II.

The Himeyuri Alumnae Incorporated Foundation, which runs the Himeyuri Peace Museum in Okinawa, produced the film with the aim to convey the experiences of those high school nurses, many of whom lost their lives during the battle, to children.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience recognizes the film's aim to depict the tragic experiences of high school nurses during World War II. The film highlights the civilian suffering of war. Some reviews imply it may not reach the depth and realism of other iconic war stories.
pros: Aims to convey the experiences of high school nurses during the Battle of Okinawa.
Highlights the suffering of civilians during wartime.
cons: Reviewer indicates the anime adds a layer of interest, but may not reach the level of realism found in other works.

anime.title: Teekyu 3
anime.synopsis: Third season of Teekyuu series.
anime.consensus_summary: Teekyuu 3 is a divisive anime due to its extremely fast pacing and nonsensical humor. While some appreciate its parody and absurdity, many find it overwhelming and lacking in substance. Character development is minimal, and the animation quality is subpar, though improving. The show is best suited for those who enjoy 'crack' anime and parodies and are willing to overlook its flaws.
pros: Catchy theme song
Voice acting is decent
Art is steadily improving
cons: Pacing is too fast and overwhelming
Animation is mediocre with limited budget
Characters lack depth and development
Humor is inoffensive but not consistently funny
No overarching storyline

anime.title: Everlasting Heart
anime.synopsis: Kimi to Boku (You and I) is the story of an aspiring mangaka and his cat, told from the cat's perspective. It follows the friendship between the cat and the young man from when they first meet up to when they must part.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds 'Kimi to Boku' to be a sentimental and introspective piece, particularly resonating with cat owners. While it's praised for its depth and complete narrative, some find the dialogue repetitive and certain segments detract from the overall story. The animation, though simple, effectively conveys the intended emotions, making it a worthwhile short watch for those who appreciate slice-of-life stories.
pros: Deeply explores its subject matter.
Forms a cohesive and complete story.
Speaks intimately to the viewer's heart.
Resonates with cat owners.
cons: Dialogue can become repetitive.
Animation can drag on near the end.
Orihime and Hikoboshi tale detracts from the narrative.
Music is slow and not very special.

anime.title: Noragami
anime.synopsis:
In times of need, if you look in the right place, you just may see a strange telephone number scrawled in red. If you call this number, you will hear a young man introduce himself as the Yato God.

Yato is a minor deity and a self-proclaimed "Delivery God," who dreams of having millions of worshippers. Without a single shrine dedicated to his name, however, his goals are far from being realized. He spends his days doing odd jobs for five yen apiece, until his weapon partner becomes fed up with her useless master and deserts him.

Just as things seem to be looking grim for the god, his fortune changes when a middle school girl, Hiyori Iki, supposedly saves Yato from a car accident, taking the hit for him. Remarkably, she survives, but the event has caused her soul to become loose and hence able to leave her body. Hiyori demands that Yato return her to normal, but upon learning that he needs a new partner to do so, reluctantly agrees to help him find one. And with Hiyori's help, Yato's luck may finally be turning around.
anime.consensus_summary: Noragami is a generally well-received anime, praised for its characters, humor, and blend of action and slice-of-life elements. Some find the plot unoriginal or simplistic, with unnecessary drama, while others appreciate the unique story and character development. The audience generally enjoys the series, but some find it lacking in depth.
pros: Relatable and well-written characters
Unique story with blended character developments
Good balance between serious scenes and funny moments
Likable characters that are pretty believable
cons: Lacks detail and sophistication
Unnecessary drama
Simplistic approach to concepts explored
Plot is not very original

anime.title: Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya 2Wei!
anime.synopsis:
Another lovely summer goes by for Illyasviel von Einzbern. Taking a break from her magical girl duties, she enjoys her time off after collecting the Class Cards with her best friend Miyu Edelfelt. 

However, her break comes to an abrupt end when she and Miyu are abducted by Rin Toosaka and Luviagelita Edelfelt, while out with her friends. The magical girls learn that their work is far from over, as Clock Tower informs them that the out of control mana thought to have been sealed continues to be dispersing throughout Fuyuki City. After heading to the origin point of the out of control mana, Illya and Miyu are tasked with solving the anomaly. 

But after casting their spell, Illyasviel discovers that she's split into two people! As this mysterious new form darts off, she can only wonder: what is to come from the existence of her dopplegänger, running amok in the unsuspecting town?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views *Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya 2wei!* as a step up from the first season, praising the improved character development and integration of Fate lore. While some find the pacing slow and the fan service lacking, the action sequences and soundtrack are well-received. Overall, the season balances cute slice-of-life elements with more serious themes, making it an enjoyable watch for fans of the franchise.
pros: Improved character development for Illya, Miyu, and Kuro.
Integration of Fate elements into the plot is more serious and engaging.
Action sequences and soundtrack are praised.
Balances cute slice-of-life elements with more serious Fate themes.
cons: Early episodes are slow and lack action.
Some find the kissing sound effects gross/cringeworthy.
Fan service may be lacking for some viewers.
Plot can feel repetitive or rehashed from previous seasons.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Fate Lore, Yuri Undertones

anime.title: Little Busters! EX
anime.synopsis:
The main additions in "Little Busters! Ecstasy" are 3 heroine routes involving the characters Futaki Kanata, Sasasegawa Sasami and Tokido Saya.

The 3 EX heroines' routes take place of the following:

Saya's route - Before the events of Refrain.
Sasami's route - After the events of Refrain.
Kanata's route - First half of her story is before Refrain and second half is after Refrain.

The episodes will be bundled with the BD/DVD releases of Little Busters!: Refrain.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with appreciation for expanding character stories but criticism for plot issues. Fans value the emotional core but note inconsistencies. The adaptation of individual character routes varies in quality.
pros: Expands on supporting characters from the original series.
Maintains the core emotional feel and signature narration of Little Busters!
Offers a blend of genres, including action, emotion, and darker themes.
cons: Script writing issues and convoluted plotlines, especially with supernatural elements.
Uneven pacing and rushed development of relationships, particularly in Saya's arc.
Inconsistent chronological placement of routes, leading to confusion.
Adaptation quality varies significantly between routes, with some considered poorly adapted.

anime.title: Z/X: Ignition
anime.synopsis: The story is set in the not-so-distant future. Five "Black Points" suddenly appeared around the world as portals to parallel worlds. Immediately after, strange creatures began their invasion from these portals. These creatures are the inhabitants of five worlds—the same worlds in different timeframes. In order to ensure their own future timeframe survives, each of the five invasion forces battle to wipe the other future timeframes out. The key is one card-shaped device.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the animation, voice acting, and initial story concept, finding the characters enjoyable. However, many are critical of the rushed pacing, underdeveloped plot, lack of character backgrounds, and unresolved story threads, leading to an ultimately unsatisfying experience. This creates a divide between those who see potential and those who are disappointed by the execution.
pros: Good animation and fight scenes
Enjoyable characters and voice acting
Interesting story concept/potential
cons: Rushed pacing and underdeveloped plot
Lack of background information for characters
Unresolved plot points and unsatisfying ending
Too many characters introduced with no background.

anime.title: The Nameko Families
anime.synopsis: It will be about the daily life of a big family of mushrooms living together.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the show cute and a good representation of daily family life. The lack of dialogue and initial confusion regarding character introductions are minor drawbacks. Overall, it's a lighthearted and enjoyable slice-of-life anime.
pros: Cute and short format
Good representation of daily life
Each character gets featured time
cons: Lack of dialogue
Confusion due to character introductions separated from episodes
Very little explanation

anime.title: Engaged to the Unidentified
anime.synopsis:
Just an ordinary teenager, Kobeni Yonomori receives quite the surprise on her 16th birthday—a fiancé and a sister-in-law she never even knew she had. As a result of an arrangement that her late grandfather made, Hakuya Mitsumine and his younger sister Mashiro have moved from their countryside home to the Yonomori household in order to deepen their relationship with their new family members.

Mikakunin de Shinkoukei follows Kobeni's "love life" with Hakuya as she tries her best to adjust to the abrupt changes forced upon her. However, as some extraordinary secrets regarding the siblings come to light, Kobeni will find her life changed forever.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences found 'Mikakunin de Shinkoukei' to be a cute and enjoyable, albeit somewhat generic, slice-of-life romantic comedy. While the plot may lack originality, the strength lies in its charming characters and lighthearted humor. Some viewers found the pacing uneven and certain characters annoying, but the positive aspects generally outweighed the negatives. It's considered a pleasant watch for fans of the genre.
pros: Charming characters with amusing dynamics.
Catchy and enjoyable opening and ending themes.
Pleasant and well-executed art style.
cons: Generic and unoriginal plot.
Underdeveloped main characters compared to supporting cast.
Inconsistent pacing, especially in the first half.
Unnecessary or poorly executed plot devices.

anime.title: Bayonetta: Bloody Fate
anime.synopsis:
Driven to recover her memories after waking in a coffin at the bottom of a lake 20 years ago, Bayonetta hunts down the forces of Heaven day and night in search of clues to her forgotten past, and to uphold her pact with the demonic forces she draws her powers from as an Umbra Witch. She is armed and guided by the mysterious bartender and weapon-smith, Rodin, and following her every footstep is the intrepid journalist, Luka Redgrave, who believes that she has something to do with the death of his father and will stop at nothing to get the truth. Her quest takes a promising turn when she encounters a little girl named Cereza, but standing in her way is a rival Umbra Witch named Jeanne, who works for the very forces that she should be opposing.

Bayonetta: Bloody Fate is an action-packed anime film that explores the connection between all of characters and works to unravel just how they are seemingly entwined in a conspiracy that eclipses them all.
anime.consensus_summary: Bayonetta: Bloody Fate is a polarizing film, largely dependent on the viewer's familiarity with the source material. While fans of the game appreciate its faithful adaptation of characters, action, and art style, newcomers often find the narrative rushed, lacking emotional depth, and failing to justify the on-screen events.
pros: Faithful adaptation of game characters and atmosphere
Strong visual representation of game aesthetics and action
Excellent voice acting, particularly the English dub
Enjoyable for fans of the original game
cons: Narrative is rushed and convoluted due to condensing a long game
Lacks emotional investment and meaningful character development for newcomers
Action scenes can be animated poorly at times, and CG integration is sometimes jarring
Soundtrack doesn't always match the quality or impact of the game's score

anime.title: Soni-Ani: Super Sonico The Animation
anime.synopsis: Super Sonico is a clutzy, adorable, and well-endowed 18-year old girl. She's a complete sucker for anything cute, especially stray cats, all of which she giddily adopts. However, though Sonico should be enjoying a carefree and simple lifestyle as a young college student, her life is really anything but easy: she must balance being a professional model, working part-time at her grandmother's restaurant, and practicing guitar and performing concerts with her friends Suzu Fujimi and Fuuri Watanuki in their band, First Astronomical Velocity—all while attending college. SoniAni: Super Sonico the Animation follows Sonico as she faces daunting challenges in her search for her place in the world, even when her days are brimming with love and happiness.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many criticizing the shallow plot and character development, particularly of Super Sonico herself. Some appreciate the music and bright visuals, but overall, the show is largely considered a fanservice-driven marketing vehicle lacking substance. While some find it enjoyable as a casual watch, others deem it a waste of time due to its lack of depth and inconsistent tone.
pros: The music, including the opening, ending themes, and insert songs, is a highlight and often praised for being catchy and well-orchestrated.
Some reviewers appreciated the visuals and bright color scheme, noting the animation quality was decent, especially in non-CG scenes.
A few reviewers found the supporting characters engaging and the episodic subplots well-executed.
cons: Many found the main character, Sonico, to be bland, lacking depth, and failing to carry the show effectively.
The plot is often described as weak, simplistic, episodic, and lacking overall direction or meaningful story progression.
Several reviewers criticized the show as being primarily a marketing ploy, with excessive fanservice overshadowing character development and narrative quality.
Inconsistent tone, with poorly integrated elements of slice-of-life, fanservice, music, and even horror, create a disjointed viewing experience.

anime.title: Haikyu!!
anime.synopsis:
Ever since having witnessed the "Little Giant" and his astonishing skills on the volleyball court, Shouyou Hinata has been bewitched by the dynamic nature of the sport. Even though his attempt to make his debut as a volleyball regular during a middle school tournament went up in flames, he longs to prove that his less-than-impressive height ceases to be a hindrance in the face of his sheer will and perseverance.

When Hinata enrolls in Karasuno High School, the Little Giant's alma mater, he believes that he is one step closer to his goal of becoming a professional volleyball player. Although the school only retains a shadow of its former glory, Hinata's conviction isn't shaken until he learns that Tobio Kageyama—the prodigy who humiliated Hinata's middle school volleyball team in a crushing defeat—is now his teammate.

To fulfill his desire of leaving a mark on the realm of volleyball—so often regarded as the domain of the tall and the strong—Hinata must smooth out his differences with Kageyama. Only when Hinata learns what it takes to be a part of a team will he be able to join the race to the top in earnest.
anime.consensus_summary: Haikyuu!! is overwhelmingly praised for its strong character development, inspiring themes, and exciting depiction of volleyball. While some find the story predictable, the majority of viewers appreciate the realistic portrayal of teamwork and perseverance. The anime's ability to engage even non-sports fans contributes to its widespread appeal.
pros: Well-developed characters with realistic relationships and dynamics.
Inspiring and encouraging, motivating viewers to pursue their own goals.
Exciting and engaging portrayal of volleyball, even for non-sports fans.
cons: Predictable plot and storyline.
Lack of surprising or unique elements.
Some repetitive animation sequences.

anime.title: Natsume’s Book of Friends: On a Certain Snowy Day
anime.romaji_title: Natsume Yuujinchou: Itsuka Yuki no Hi ni
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: As the first delicate snowflake touches the cold ground, Nyanko-sensei dozes on his hot-water bottle next to Takashi Natsume. While his aunt prepares a warm dinner, Natsume takes a walk, welcoming the snow and the chilly weather. However, his peaceful promenade is disturbed by a white, fluffy snowman yokai with perturbing black eyes, searching for something warm and sparkly. With no further information, Natsume sets off to help find what the spirit desires.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the OVA to be a pleasant and comforting addition to the Natsume Yuujinchou series. It successfully captures the show's familiar tone and themes, particularly those of nostalgia and the search for something lost. While some feel it lacks depth and significant impact, the overall reception is positive due to its heartwarming nature and faithful portrayal of the characters and world.
pros: Faithful to the original anime series in tone and mood.
Heartwarming and calming.
Effectively explores themes of loss and nostalgia through a fantastical lens.
cons: Lacks significant character development.
Story is episodic and doesn't carry much weight on its own.

anime.title: The Portrait Studio
anime.synopsis:
The story takes place before WWII at a photo studio on top of a hill. Many people visit this studio to have their photos taken. One day, a couple comes, but the wife is so shy that she always lowers her head. The owner of the studio tries all kinds of tricks to get her to smile and eventually succeeds.

One year later, the couple comes again, but this time they bring their daughter along. She always looks grumpy, and again, the owner has to try everything to get her to smile. Thus starts a long-running relationship between the girl and the owner, and time passes to years and then decades...
anime.consensus_summary: Shashinkan is overwhelmingly praised for its emotional depth, beautiful visuals, and evocative soundtrack, particularly considering its short length. While some find the narrative somewhat underdeveloped due to time constraints, the majority are deeply moved by the film's ability to convey profound emotions through visual storytelling and music. The short is generally considered a heartwarming and memorable experience.
pros: Powerful emotional appeal achieved through visual and auditory harmony.
Unique and stylistic visual expression with soft colors and detailed backgrounds.
Magnificent and well-fitting classical music soundtrack.
Effective storytelling without dialogue, relying on visual and musical cues.
cons: Short runtime leads to underdeveloped story and characters.
Sub-themes of war and loss feel rushed and lack emotional impact.
Art style may be initially off-putting to some viewers.

anime.title: Hamatora The Animation
anime.synopsis:
The ability to create miracles is not just a supernatural phenomenon; it is a gift which manifests in a limited number of human beings. "Minimum," or small miracles, are special powers that only selected people called "Minimum Holders" possess. The detective agency Yokohama Troubleshooting, or Hamatora for short, is composed of the "Minimum Holder PI Duo," Nice and Murasaki. Their office is a lone table at Cafe Nowhere, where the pair and their coworkers await new clients.

Suddenly, the jobs that they begin to receive seem to have strange connections to the serial killer whom their friend Art, a police officer, is searching for. The murder victims share a single similarity: they are all Minimum Holders. Nice and Murasaki, as holders themselves, are drawn to the case—but what exactly is the link between Nice and the one who orchestrates it all?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers enjoyed the unique art style, action sequences, and initial premise, while others were disappointed by the weak plot, shallow characters, and excessive filler. The ending was particularly divisive, leaving many viewers unsatisfied and hoping for a more conclusive second season. Overall, Hamatora had potential but failed to deliver a consistently engaging experience.
pros: Colorful and flashy art style, especially during Minimum activation sequences.
Interesting and unique character designs.
Engaging soundtrack that complements the mood of the scenes.
cons: Inconsistent pacing due to filler episodes that detract from the main plot.
Weak character development, with many characters lacking depth and backstory.
Underwhelming and confusing plot with a disappointing conclusion.
Low budget animation issues, especially noticeable in filler episodes.

anime.title: Sabagebu! -Survival Game Club!-
anime.synopsis:
On a train to her new middle school, Momoka Sonokawa is preyed upon by a molester, only to be rescued by a girl wielding dual pistols. The girl turns out to be Miou Ootori, Momoka's upperclassman and president of the Aogiri Academy's Survival Game Club, called Sabage-bu for short. Noticing Momoka's aptitude with a pistol, Miou takes a liking to her and tries to persuade her to join the club. In spite of her steadfast refusal, Momoka inexplicably finds herself a member of Sabage-bu.

Sabage-bu is anything but a typical middle-school club. Its members' socially awkward behaviors scare Momoka. Their personalities range from the fanatical to the completely delusional. They do not hold back from walking around public areas wearing ghillie suits or even bungee jumping from the school building. Thrown together with this collection of survival game maniacs, the zealously ordinary Momoka must somehow adjust to her unexpectedly wild school life.
anime.consensus_summary: Sabagebu! is a well-received comedy anime known for its absurd humor and unique characters. Viewers appreciate its self-aware style and episodic format, which delivers constant laughs. While some find the plot lacking and the soundtrack repetitive, the overall consensus is that it's a fun and entertaining show for those seeking lighthearted comedy.
pros: Hilarious and unexpected comedy
Great cast of characters with unique personalities
Self-aware humor and fourth-wall breaks
Enjoyable episodic format with creative scenarios
cons: Plotless and repetitive after the first few episodes
Small and repetitive soundtrack
Lacks depth and complex messages
Animation not aged well

anime.title: Pig Sale
anime.synopsis:
This short film was inspired by the story told in the prose written by Jia Pingwa to memorialize his father in 1989. Set on the North Shannxi Loess Plateau, the story tells about two boys trying to sell a pig, the only valuable property of the poor family, for food. However, things go wrong. The film was artistically designed to present the spectacular and broad scenery of the Loess Plateau as well as the simple life of the people.

This is a black humor about the difficult years in the northwest of China in 1970s.
anime.consensus_summary: The film is a simple, visually appealing story about life's hardships in rural China. While the artistic presentation is praised, the plot is considered predictable and lacking suspense. The film's value lies in its reminder that others face challenges with resilience.
pros: Good art design, especially the blend of realistic and cartoonish styles.
Each character, including the pig, had their story told effectively.
The film reminds viewers that others face harder aspects in life and can still find a way to smile.
cons: The plot is predictable with only one major twist.
Lacks suspense due to the plot's simplicity.

anime.title: Love Live! School Idol Project OVA
anime.romaji_title: Love Live! School Idol Project OVA
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the sixth single of the anime's μ's idol group.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is seen as a confusing and nonsensical "descent into madness" by many, primarily serving as a vehicle for a music video. While fans appreciate the familiar quality of the animation and music, and find some cute moments, the bizarre dream narrative is a significant detractor. It's largely recommended only for die-hard fans of the Love Live! franchise.
pros: High quality music and animation typical of the franchise
Cute moments and character interactions for fans
The music video segment is well-executed and enjoyable for fans
cons: The plot is nonsensical and confusing, with unexplained dream sequences
The surreal and magical realism elements do not fit well with the franchise's usual tone
Pacing issues, particularly with repetitive running scenes and an awkward build-up to the music video

anime.title: Noragami OVA
anime.synopsis:
Kamigakari, Kamitatari
Hiyori Iki is excited to start high school alongside her two middle school friends, but "Delivery God" Yato seems to have other plans for the day. Will Hiyori be able to make a good impression on her first day? Or will Yato cost her a happy high school life?

Haru no Hi no Yakusoku
On another day, Hiyori decides to take advantage of the beautiful weather and invites a number of people to gaze at the cherry blossoms, including the fearsome combat god, Bishamon. But how long will their blissful day last when Yato and his old rival Bishamon start to drink together?
anime.consensus_summary: The Noragami OVAs are a mixed bag for fans. While many appreciate the additional character interactions and lighthearted moments, some find them skippable due to their non-canon nature and potential spoilers. The second episode is generally considered stronger due to its character development elements.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions and humor.
Provides more screen time for beloved characters, especially Yato.
The second episode offers some character development and insight.
cons: Some viewers consider the OVAs non-canon or filler.
The first episode's plot is weak and inconsequential.
The art quality is a step down from the main series.
The second episode spoils events from the second season.

anime.title: The Irregular at Magic High School
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
In the dawn of the 21st century, magic, long thought to be folklore and fairy tales, has become a systematized technology and is taught as a technical skill. In First High School, the institution for magicians, students are segregated into two groups based on their entrance exam scores: "Blooms," those who receive high scores, are assigned to the First Course, while "Weeds" are reserve students assigned to the Second Course.

Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei follows the siblings, Tatsuya and Miyuki Shiba, who are enrolled in First High School. Upon taking the exam, the prodigious Miyuki is placed in the First Course, while Tatsuya is relegated to the Second Course. Though his practical test scores and status as a "Weed" show him to be magically inept, he possesses extraordinary technical knowledge, physical combat capabilities, and unique magic techniques—making Tatsuya the irregular at a magical high school.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is heavily divided. Some viewers enjoy the overpowered protagonist and unique magic system, while others find the plot boring, characters flat, and the lack of challenges for the main character to be major drawbacks. The series is considered highly controversial, ranging from 'best anime ever' to 'complete BS'.
pros: Art and music are high quality.
Interesting world-building with futuristic magic.
Enjoyable for those who like overpowered main characters.
cons: Story lacks depth and progression.
Main character is excessively overpowered and faces no challenges.
Plot is boring and repetitive.
Characters are flat and emotionless.
Incestuous undertones with sibling relationship.
Dialogue can be annoying
anime.thematic_vibe: Overpowered Protagonist, Sci-Fi Magic, Sibling Relationship

anime.title: Black Bullet
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2021, a parasitic virus known as "Gastrea" infects humans and turns them into monsters. What is left of mankind now lives within the Monolith walls, walls that are made of Varanium, the only material that can hurt Gastrea.

To counter the threat that the Gastrea pose, "Cursed Children"—female children whose bodies contain trace amounts of the virus which grant them superhuman abilities—officially called Initiators by the Tendo Civil Security, are given partners called Promoters, people who work to guide and protect the young Initiators. These teams of two are sent out on missions to fight the monsters created by the Gastrea virus and keep them at bay. 

Black Bullet revolves around the team of Enju Aihara, an Initiator, and Satomi Rentaro, a Promoter, as they go on missions to fight the growing threat of Gastrea in their hometown of Tokyo.
anime.consensus_summary: Black Bullet is largely considered a flawed adaptation with significant pacing and tonal issues. While some viewers found enjoyment in the action and soundtrack, the overwhelming consensus points to a rushed plot, weak characters, and an inappropriate emphasis on loli fanservice that detracts from the story's darker themes. The series is viewed as a missed opportunity, failing to live up to its potential due to poor execution and a lack of focus.
pros: Good action sequences with an epic soundtrack.
Some enjoy the character interactions, particularly Rentaro's compassion.
The art style is generally appealing, especially the action animation.
cons: Rushed and incoherent plot with pacing issues.
Poor character development; characters are bland and unlikeable.
Inconsistent tone; jarring shifts between serious drama and comedic/fanservice elements.
Overuse of loli fanservice is off-putting and tonally inappropriate.
The story is unoriginal, clichéd, and borrows heavily from other series like Attack on Titan.
Many plot points are introduced and then dropped or left unresolved.
The world-building is inconsistent, failing to convey the sense of a post-apocalyptic setting.
Emotional impact is undermined by superficial character deaths and a lack of meaningful sacrifice.

anime.title: Sekaiichi Hatsukoi: Valentine-hen
anime.synopsis: Animated short with an original story that was screened alongside "Sekaiichi Hatsukoi Movie: Yokozawa Takafumi no Baai."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the Valentine-hen special to be a cute and charming addition to the Sekaiichi Hatsukoi universe. While not particularly innovative, it successfully captures the essence of the characters and their relationships within a Valentine's Day theme. The short is considered wholesome and enjoyable for fans of the series.
pros: Theme-focused narrative including all couples.
Characters acting true to themselves.
Creative and funny storylines (Ritsu and Chiaki).
cons: Not groundbreaking or amazing.
Predictable character actions.

anime.title: Joshikousei Nobunaga-chan!!
anime.synopsis: The 16th-century shogun Oda Nobunaga wakes up in a high school girl's body.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is overwhelmingly panned as terrible. Reviewers describe the plot as ridiculous and unenjoyable, with poor voice acting. The only slightly positive aspect mentioned is the art, but overall, it's considered a painful and atrocious experience.
cons: Terrible plot
Terrible voice acting
Unenjoyable
Ridiculous plot

anime.title: Student Council Staff Members Season 2
anime.synopsis:
They say that the more things change, the more they stay the same, and those words could not be more true for the student council of Ousai Private Academy. Though an entire year has passed—bringing the senior members to their final year of high school—not much has changed. President Shino Amakusa is just as perverted as ever, Secretary Aria Shichijou still refuses to put on a pair of panties, Treasurer Suzu Hagimura has yet to grow an inch, and Vice President Takatoshi Tsuda is still stuck as the straight man to their crazy antics.
 
Of course, limiting the fun to a four-way might get a little stale; although the group still messes around with the Judo Club and the Newspaper Club, more girls have come to get in on the excitement. Takatoshi's sister Kotomi, a new student at Ousai, is as perverse as the president, while Uomi, the aloof student council president of the nearby Eiryou High School, fits right in with the insanity at Ousai. With loads of absurdity and sexual humor that keeps on coming, Takatoshi needs to harden up if he is going to keep up with all the madness around him.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences generally enjoy Seitokai Yakuindomo* for its consistent humor and well-defined characters. However, some find the jokes repetitive and the lack of plot progression disappointing. The improved animation in the second season is a plus, but the reliance on the same comedic formula can lead to diminishing returns for some viewers. Despite this, the show remains a popular choice for those seeking lighthearted, lewd comedy.
pros: Consistent humor and jokes throughout the series.
Strong and likeable characters with great interactions.
Improved animation quality in the second season.
Enjoyable voice acting and sound design.
cons: Repetitive jokes and lack of creative variation.
Minimal plot progression or character development.
Over-reliance on sexual humor may become tiresome.
Some viewers found the second season less enjoyable than the first due to recycled jokes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Lewd Comedy, Slice of Life, School Life

anime.title: Chaika: The Coffin Princess
anime.synopsis:
For 500 years, the Taboo Emperor, Arthur Gaz, ruled the Gaz Empire with an iron fist and conducted inhumane experiments on his own people. But his reign came to an end five years ago, when mighty warriors—later known as the Eight Heroes—defeated him in a battle for the capital. His death ended the 300-yearlong war between the Gaz Empire and the alliance of six nations.

In the present day, Tooru Acura is a former saboteur from the war who has difficulty settling into the peaceful world, as he cannot find a job where he can put his fighting skills to use. An opportunity appears before him, however, when he meets a white-haired Wizard named Chaika Trabant. With a coffin on her back, she is searching for the scattered remains of her father in order to give him a proper burial, and she hires Tooru and his adoptive sister Akari to help her. However, the six nations alliance, which have now formed the Council of Six Nations, dispatches Albéric Gillette and his men from the Kleeman Agency to pursue and apprehend the late Emperor Gaz's daughter—Chaika.

With the shocking revelation of Chaika's identity, the Acura siblings must choose between helping her gather the remains of the tyrannical emperor and upholding the peace the continent strives to maintain.
anime.consensus_summary: Hitsugi no Chaika is a generally well-received adventure anime, praised for its engaging story, well-animated action, and unique premise. Some viewers find the art style and characters to be lacking, and Chaika's speech is a point of contention. Overall, it is considered an underrated and enjoyable series, with a simple but effective narrative.
pros: Engaging story with twists and turns, avoiding excessive complexity.
Well-animated fight scenes with characters actively maneuvering.
Unique premise and plotline that stands out from typical adventure shows.
cons: Art style may not appeal to everyone.
Characters are nice, though flat.
Chaika's speech pattern is annoying to some viewers.

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders
anime.romaji_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 3: Stardust Crusaders
anime.synopsis:
Years after an ancient evil was salvaged from the depths of the sea, Joutarou Kuujou sits peacefully within a Japanese jail cell. He's committed no crime yet demands he not be released, believing he's been possessed by an evil spirit capable of harming those around him. Concerned for her son, Holy Kuujou asks her father, Joseph Joestar, to convince Joutarou to leave the prison. Joseph informs his grandson that the "evil spirit" is in fact something called a "Stand," the physical manifestation of one's fighting spirit which can adopt a variety of deadly forms. After a fiery brawl with Joseph's friend Muhammad Avdol, Joutarou is forced out of his cell and begins learning how to control the power of his Stand.

However, when a Stand awakens within Holy and threatens to consume her in 50 days, Joutarou, his grandfather, and their allies must seek out and destroy the immortal vampire responsible for her condition. They must travel halfway across the world to Cairo, Egypt and along the way, do battle with ferocious Stand users set on thwarting them. If Joutarou and his allies fail in their mission, humanity is destined for a grim fate.
anime.consensus_summary: Stardust Crusaders is a beloved, albeit flawed, entry in the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series. While some find the episodic nature and repetitive fights tiresome, others appreciate the unique battles, memorable characters, and over-the-top style. The journey to defeat DIO is ultimately seen as a worthwhile and enjoyable adventure.
pros: Unique and creative Stand battles offer variety.
Memorable characters and their interactions are a highlight.
Over-the-top style and humor provide a fun viewing experience.
cons: Episodic monster-of-the-week format can become repetitive.
Story can feel secondary to the battles.
Some character deaths feel rushed and unimpactful.

anime.title: Harmonie
anime.synopsis:
Akio Honjou is a high school student with a special gift for music. He can perfectly recall any piece of music that he has heard only once. One day, as he tries to reproduce a particularly soothing piano melody, he unexpectedly meets Juri Makina—the girl whose cell phone had spontaneously played the tune earlier in class.

If art is the only way to truly know what landscapes populate others' inner worlds, then can this particular tune pave the way for Akio to begin to understand the more intellectual and emotional aspects of his captivating classmate, Juri?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment leans strongly positive, with widespread appreciation for the thoughtful themes, beautiful animation, and evocative music. While the short format limits deeper character development, the core message of individuality and connection resonates deeply with most viewers. Minor disagreements exist regarding the intentional ambiguity of the ending and genre classification, but these do not significantly detract from the overall positive reception.
pros: The animation is consistently praised as fluid, realistic, and visually pleasing, particularly in dream sequences.
The soundtrack and music are highlighted as fitting, enhancing the atmosphere, and memorable.
The story's exploration of themes like individuality, conformity, dreams, and connection is seen as deep, thought-provoking, and effectively conveyed despite the short runtime.
The voice acting is generally considered good, effectively conveying character emotions.
cons: The short runtime limits character development, making it difficult for viewers to form lasting emotional attachments.
The plot can be perceived as underdeveloped or relying on minor teenage drama by some viewers.
Some find the 'magical' or 'supernatural' elements to be vaguely explained or confusing, or miscategorized in genre tags.
The ending is intentionally ambiguous, which some viewers appreciate while others desired more closure or resolution.

anime.title: The Big First-Grader and the Small Second-Grader
anime.synopsis:
Timid Masaya relies on his friend, second-grader Akiyo, to help him manage walking to school. Despite his tall stature, the path through a shadowy grove of trees is too frightening for him to enter alone.

When a flower Akiyo is holding falls apart, Masaya wants to do something to cheer her up. Unfortunately, the only place that he can get bellflowers is a faraway field in the shadows of a lone pine tree—and getting there will be a far more frightening journey than his already difficult daily commute.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a cute, feel-good story about friendship and overcoming fears.  The animation style is memorable and the character movements are natural.  However, the story and characters are simple, and the adult characters serve only as plot devices.
pros: Cute and fun story.
Memorable pastel style.
Naturalistic character movement.
cons: Lack of character development.
Jarring editing.
Adult characters are archetypical plot devices.

anime.title: Oneechan ga Kita
anime.synopsis: The story revolves around Tomoya Mizuhara, a 13-year-old boy who suddenly gains a big sister when his father remarries. 17-year-old Ichika is a little strange, and her affection for Tomoya is rather overwhelming, if not scary. On top of things, Ichika's friend Ruri is the ultimate sadist. Then there is Ichika's big-breasted quarter-Japanese friend Marina.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Oneechan ga Kita. Some viewers find it a hilarious and quick source of entertainment, appreciating its lighthearted nature and unique characters despite the potentially questionable premise. However, others criticize its weak story, shallow characters, and subpar production quality, deeming it a forgettable and sometimes annoying experience.
pros: Funny and enjoyable for a quick watch
Some find the art style cute and unique
Characters are well-developed for a short anime
Good for lightening the mood
cons: Story is weak and repetitive
Lacks emotional depth and meaningful plot
Animation quality is often subpar or generic
Humor can be annoying and over the top
Characters can be bland and unrelatable
Premise is potentially creepy or incestuous

anime.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy OVA
anime.romaji_title: Ore no Nounai Sentakushi ga, Gakuen Love Comedy wo Zenryoku de Jama Shiteiru OVA
anime.synopsis: Unaired TV episode bundled with the light novel's volume eight.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted, sexually charged parody that expands on the original series' premise. Fans of the show's humor and concept will likely enjoy it, but those sensitive to excessive sexual content or who prefer the main series' tone may want to avoid it. It's generally considered a fun extra for existing fans rather than a standalone experience.
pros: Fun extension of the original series concept
Imaginative take on the multiple-choice premise
Appeals to fans of the series
cons: Overly sexual content may not appeal to all viewers
Characters may not feel true to their original portrayals
May not fit well within the main series' continuity

anime.title: Eon Kid
anime.synopsis: In a futuristic world, young Marty stumbles upon a bionic arm which endows him with superhuman powers and put him at the centre of a centuries-old struggle between good and evil. His teenager heart will now begin a long-way training together with two loyal friends: Buttons, his robo-puppy, and the brave Ally.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience mood is overwhelmingly positive and nostalgic, with many remembering the show fondly from their childhood. While some acknowledge its flaws in animation and writing, the strong storytelling and character development outweigh these issues for most viewers. The show is recommended for those seeking a fun, nostalgic experience rather than a critically analyzed viewing.
pros: Well-written story with quick world-building
Good character development, especially for Marty and Ally
Enjoyable fight scenes, particularly in the later half
cons: Animation quality is dated and not impressive
Dubbing may feel off due to voice matching issues
Plot can be simplistic with deus ex machina elements

anime.title: Paroru's Future Island
anime.synopsis:
Rikotto, Zuzu, and Paroru are intelligent furry creatures who believe more than anything that the world outside their island is too dangerous to explore. Despite this, Rikotto and Zuzu long to see the world that produces the mysterious objects that wash up on their shores. After a particularly exciting find, Rikotto convinces Zuzu to build a boat, and they set sail across the sea with their reluctant friend Paroru in tow.

At first, the trio finds the foreign land beautiful and exciting, but they are overwhelmed when they come across a bustling city of humans. When Rikotto and Zuzu get captured by a circus ringleader who intends to put them on display, Paroru has to decide what fears he is willing to face for his friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the short film for its visual style and animation quality, comparing it favorably to Studio Ghibli. The story is considered simple but cute, with room for multiple interpretations. There is little controversy, with the main point of feedback being the simplicity of the narrative.
pros: Amazing art style and fluid animation.
Charming and evocative of Ghibli movies.
Open to interpretation with multiple possible morals.
cons: Simple narrative, not expecting complex plot

anime.title: La corda d'oro: Blue♪Sky
anime.genres: Josei, Music, Reverse Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis: Soon after transferring to Seisou Gakuin, Kanade finds the orchestra club in the middle of preparing for the National concur. Teaming up with the other members, she will improve her skills, meet new rivals and create memories for what will become an unforgettable summer...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the continuation of the series, the focus on hard work and musical development, and the consistent art style. There is not evidence to suggest that audience response is controversial, and general sentiment skews toward positive appreciation.
pros: Continuation of a familiar universe with consistent art style.
Focus on character's hard work and skill development is relatable.
Enjoyable musical arrangements of classic pieces.

anime.title: World Conquest Zvezda Plot
anime.synopsis:
Asuta Jimon, a runaway, is wandering the streets at night when he has a chance encounter with a young girl collapsed beside her tricycle. After he offers her some food, she is moved by his kindness and asks him to join her organization, offering him a face mask and a sweet bun. In need of a place to stay, Asuta decides to play along and accepts her offer, adopting the nickname "Dva." 

Little does Dva know, this cute girl is Kate Hoshimiya, the leader of Zvezda, a secret organization bent on world conquest. However, he soon realizes the true weight of her words as peculiar happenings rope him deeper into Zvezda and its eccentric members—the samurai-like vanguard Itsuka Shikabane, tech-genius Natalia "Natasha" Vasylchenko, troublesome Yasubee "Yasu" Morozumi, ex-gangster Gorou Shikabane, and multi-purpose robot Roboko Tsujii. 

With "White Light," a powerful organization of justice, and the entire Japanese government against them, can Zvezda really dominate all humanity and let their light shine throughout the world?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some find the show to be a fun, quirky, and enjoyable ride due to its unique characters and comedic elements. However, others criticize its weak plot, inconsistent pacing, and lack of character development, resulting in a polarizing viewing experience.
pros: Unique and original premise
Colorful and varied characters with fun interactions
Good animation and art style
Enjoyable and comedic
cons: Plot is weak, generic, or nonsensical
Inconsistent or rushed pacing
Lack of character development
Ending is underwhelming and leaves plot threads unresolved
Relies too much on fan service

anime.title: Tonari no Seki-kun OVA
anime.synopsis: OVA of Tonari no Seki-kun bundled with the fifth manga volume.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the humor and Seki's antics, finding Yokoi's reactions a highlight. However, there's a consensus that the plot and character development are minimal, which might be a drawback for some viewers. Despite these points, it's seen as a fun and lighthearted watch.
pros: Seki's antics are unpredictable and hilarious.
Yokoi's over-the-top reactions are a significant source of enjoyment.
The art and sound quality are good.
The premise is established well, even in short formats.
cons: Characterization of Yokoi's relationship with Seki is underdeveloped.
The narrative is practically non-existent, with little development outside of Yokoi reacting to Seki.

anime.title: Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers
anime.synopsis: The story will revolve around how the Avengers—Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, and the Hulk together with the help of Spider-Man and a group of teens—will harness their respective fighting skills and superhuman powers to foil Loki's scheme to take over the world. Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers will target boys in the 6-12 age group.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is primarily targeted towards a younger audience and is enjoyable if viewed with that expectation. While some appreciate the unique take on Marvel characters and the engaging action, others find the plot too simplistic and the inclusion of child characters unappealing. Overall, it's considered a decent show for kids but may not satisfy older Marvel fans looking for depth.
pros: Good art and well animated fighting scenes.
Nice effect sounds and well placed music.
Wide choice of well known Marvel characters.
Original story with Marvel characters.
Fun to watch
cons: Story is too childish and simplistic.
Intense coloring can be disturbing.
Some villains look stupid.
Kids characters are uninteresting and unnecessary.
Hulk's behavior is a bit different.
anime.thematic_vibe: Marvel meets Pokemon, Kid-friendly action, Teamwork

anime.title: Precure All Stars Movie New Stage 3: Eien no Tomodachi
anime.romaji_title: Precure All Stars Movie New Stage 3: Eien no Tomodachi
anime.synopsis: Pretty Cure All Stars New Stage 3: Eien no Tomodachi is the sixth of the Pretty Cure All Stars crossover movie series featuring all current Pretty Cure characters and the last of the "New Stage" film, including the 16th movie of all Pretty Cure movie series.
anime.consensus_summary: The film is a generally enjoyable, albeit formulaic, entry in the All Stars series. While the combat and character interactions are appreciated, the repetitive pacing and unthreatening villains detract from the overall experience. It serves as a decent introduction to new characters and offers a visually pleasing 3D sequence.
pros: Enjoyable combat scenes
Older Cures get speaking lines
Good introduction to Happiness Charge characters
Pleasing 3D ending
cons: Pacing issues (repetitive 'defeat monster, power up' cycle)
Villains (Nightmares) not scary or serious
Standard All Stars movie formula

anime.title: Dragonar Academy
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Learning to ride and tame dragons comes easy to most students at Ansarivan Dragonar Academy—except for first-year student Ash Blake, who is known by his fellow classmates as the "number one problem child."
