anime.consensus_summary: Usagi no Mofy is viewed as a heartwarming and comforting show that effectively deals with simple life lessons and emotions. Its gentle and positive nature is widely appreciated, especially for its ability to provide a sense of peace and well-being. The show's simplicity is seen as both a strength and a potential drawback, depending on individual preferences.
pros: Deals with universal human emotions and experiences
Simple and straightforward delivery resonates deeply
Positive message suitable for both children and adults
cons: Simple characters may not appeal to all viewers
Lack of overarching plot may not hold attention for some

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Legion Mate
anime.synopsis:
In the wake of Aichi Sendou's heroic defeat of Link Joker, Toshiki Kai believes the world has returned to normal. However, during a routine visit to Card Capital, Kai discovers that everyone else has completely forgotten who Aichi is. Compelled to solve the mystery behind his friend's disappearance, Kai sets out to look for clues.

While searching Aichi's high school, Kai sees a vision of Blaster Blade, Aichi's favorite Cardfight Vanguard unit. Suddenly, a stack of cards materializes in his hand: Aichi's Royal Paladin deck. Using these familiar cards, Kai challenges Aichi's companions to duels that help them recall their dear friend's impact on their lives. After regaining their memories, they join forces with Kai to find Aichi-—and to bring him home at any cost.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative due to perceived plot holes, weak character development, and inconsistent worldbuilding. Many feel the season undermines previous character arcs and introduces irritating elements. While some accept the inconsistencies as part of the series' established flaws, the overall reception is disappointment.
cons: Incoherent worldbuilding and plot inconsistencies.
Characters' development is disregarded.
Annoying new characters and voice acting.
Predictable fights lacking excitement.
Characters jobbing, diminishing their strength.

anime.title: Laughing Under the Clouds
anime.synopsis:
In the 11th year of the Meiji Era, the end of the samurai shogunate and the prohibition of swords has left Japan with lasting scars. Displeased by these recent changes, many former samurai plot against the new government, inciting a wave of bloodshed. To counter this movement, the government constructs a colossal prison in the middle of Lake Biwa. 

Unofficially assigned to help the police arrest criminals, Tenka Kumou also serves as a ferryman to the Lake Biwa prison with the help of his two younger siblings: the ambitious Soramaru and the enthusiastic Chuutarou. Together with the former Fuma ninja Shirasu Kinjou, the Kumou brothers live a frugal and joyful life mostly dedicated to studying and training.

However, behind this relatively uneventful daily routine, the specter of the "Orochi" curse is starting to spread its shadow over the city of Oumi. According to legend, every three hundred years, Orochi reincarnates in a human vessel—and it is believed that this is the harbinger of an imminent catastrophe. As various groups clash in search of Orochi's vessel, some aim to seal the curse, while others have darker plans in motion.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While many appreciate the strong focus on character development, brotherly bonds, and surprising plot twists, others criticize the rushed pacing, predictable elements, and occasional mediocre animation. The series seems to resonate more with viewers who prioritize character-driven narratives over intricate plot details.
pros: Well-developed characters, especially the three brothers.
Unique and interesting story with plot twists.
Good art and animation, visually appealing.
cons: Rushed plot development, particularly towards the end.
Mediocre animation in some parts, jarring transitions.
Predictable elements and overused tropes.

anime.title: The Prince of Tennis II vs Genius10
anime.romaji_title: Shin Tennis no Oujisama vs. Genius 10
anime.synopsis:
After a month abroad, the Foreign Expedition Team has returned to the Japan U-17 training camp. The group consists of 20 players, each with strength and technique that far surpasses those who occupy the camp's top court. In anticipation of the team's arrival, the coaches announce that 20 of the best players would be selected for further training. Tension begins to rise when only high school students are chosen to participate, but the middle school students challenge the players who possess the 11th to 20th positions to steal their places.

With the delayed appearance of the "Genius 10," the middle school students begin scheming among themselves to claim those spots as well. Unlikely pairings start to work together, combining their efforts to defeat the top 10 players of the country. It is a battle of wits, deception, and skill—all for the privilege of representing Japan at the U-17 World Cup.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While fans of the original may appreciate the continuation, many find the series deviates too far from realistic tennis, with underwhelming matches and poor adaptation of the source material. The Genius 10 arc specifically suffers from rushed character development.
cons: Tennis is unrealistic and violent.
Skipped and altered scenes from the manga.
Abrupt story rhythm and underdeveloped characters, particularly the Genius 10.
Mediocre and forgettable matches.
anime.thematic_vibe: Over-the-Top Action, Competitive Spirit, National Pride

anime.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!: Heart Throb Lite Shorts
anime.romaji_title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Ren Lite
anime.synopsis: Short episodes aired on KyoAni's official YouTube channel.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys these short episodes as a lighthearted extension of the main series. They appreciate the focus on character interactions and the continuation of the established world. However, some viewers might find the lack of a significant storyline a drawback.
pros: Cute and Fluffy
Brief and Entertaining
Character Focused
cons: Lack of Substantial Plot

anime.title: Daimidaler: Prince vs. Penguin Empire
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Mecha, Parody, Sci-Fi, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Battles continue between "Penguin Empire", the mysterious life form which arrived on earth all of a sudden, and "Beauty Salon Prince", the secret anti-Penguin organization. In order to fight Penguin Empire's gigantic "Penguin Robot", Beauty Salon Prince has developed their ultimate weapon, "Daimidaler", and is now looking for the pilot. They choose Koichi Madanbashi, a hot-blooded high school boy who is mad about big boobs, because he is the factor of "Hi-ERo particles", the source of unknown energy.
anime.consensus_summary: Kenzen Robo Daimidaler is a polarizing parody anime that heavily relies on ecchi and absurd humor. While some viewers found it hilarious and appreciated its self-awareness, others criticized its weak plot, repetitive jokes, and reliance on fan service. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on individual tolerance for the show's over-the-top and often crude humor.
pros: The show is a self-aware parody of mecha and anime tropes, providing humor for those familiar with the genre.
Many found the show funny and enjoyable, particularly the antics of the main characters and the Penguin Empire.
The opening soundtrack is catchy and energetic, fitting the show's tone.
cons: The plot is weak and nonsensical, often relying on repetitive jokes and fan service.
Some viewers found the characters annoying, particularly the second pair of Daimidaler pilots.
The show's humor may not appeal to everyone, especially those unfamiliar with anime tropes or who dislike ecchi content.

anime.title: Dai-Shogun: Great Revolution
anime.synopsis: In the late Edo period, Japan had experienced an unprecedented crisis by Kurofune (Black Ships), the ships from foreign countries. But a giant robot called Onigami, which has existed since ancient time, dispelled the Kurofune ships and the exclusion of foreigners was accomplished. The story begins in Japan where Meiji restoration in 1868 didn't happen. The tagline says, "I can be the greatest man in the world, because I am a virgin!!"
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with Fuuun Ishin Dai☆Shougun. While some appreciate the character and mecha designs, the poor animation, chaotic plot, and reliance on fanservice outweigh the positives. Many feel the series fails to deliver on its initial premise and squanders its potential, resulting in a largely forgettable experience.
pros: Character designs are great.
Solid voice acting.
Interesting premise blending history and mecha.
Some mecha designs are outstanding.
cons: Unfocused and chaotic story.
Poor animation quality with limited movement.
Excessive and poorly executed fanservice.
Underdeveloped characters and motivations.
Plot points are introduced poorly and forgotten.

anime.title: Majin Bone
anime.synopsis:
Anime adaptation of Majin Bone, a digital card game project.

Majin, the creator of the Universe, has been resurrected in the present day. Shougo Ryuujin, an ordinary high school student who transforms into the Bone Fighter Dragonbone with the Bone Card in order to save Earth. Together, with the other White Bone warriors take a stand against the Dark Bone, a foe that has appeared from darkness to devastate Earth. However, "could the true enemy be ourselves?"
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the story has some interesting elements and the animation is well-executed, the show suffers from pacing issues, uninspired plot elements, and an initially weak protagonist. Despite its flaws, the series manages to provide an overall acceptable experience.
pros: Well-paced story with a sense of discovery.
Good animation, especially the combination of 2D and 3D styles.
Thematic ideas, while somewhat common, expand to encompass the protection of the whole universe.
cons: Story isn't groundbreaking.
3D animation could be more interactive.
Recap episodes detract from the story's flow.
Protagonist is initially indecisive.
anime.thematic_vibe: Coming of Age, Card Game Adaptation, Elemental Powers

anime.title: Rage of Bahamut: Genesis
anime.synopsis:
Thousands of years ago, the ancient dragon Bahamut wrought havoc upon the land of Mistarcia, a world where both gods and demons live amongst mankind. Working together to prevent the world's destruction, the rival deities barely managed to seal Bahamut, agreeing to split the key between them so that the dragon would remain eternally imprisoned.

With the world safe from the destruction of Bahamut, it is business as usual for bounty hunters like Favaro Leone. Living a laid-back, self-serving lifestyle, the amoral Favaro goes about his work while on the run from fellow bounty hunter Kaisar Lidfard, a righteous man who swears vengeance upon Favaro. However, Favaro's carefree life is thrown into chaos when he meets Amira, a mysterious woman who holds half of the key to the world's fragile peace.

Shingeki no Bahamut: Genesis tells the story of a group of unlikely heroes who find themselves caught in the middle of an epic clash between gods and demons, forced to carve their own path in the face of the imminent storm.
anime.consensus_summary: Shingeki no Bahamut: Genesis is generally well-received for its outstanding animation, enjoyable characters, and adventurous spirit. While some find the story somewhat generic or lacking in depth, the overall consensus is that the show is a fun and visually impressive experience. The show's technical merits and engaging presentation compensate for its narrative shortcomings, making it a pleasant surprise for many viewers.
pros: Stunning animation and art style
Engaging and well-executed adventure-fantasy vibe
Well-written and dynamic characters
Epic soundtrack and sound design
cons: Generic or clichéd story elements
Pacing issues, particularly in the middle episodes
Underdeveloped character emotions

anime.title: In Search of the Lost Future
anime.genres: Drama, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Kaori Sasaki—a member of Uchihama Academy's Astronomy Club—confesses to Sou Akiyama, but later that evening, she dies in a tragic road accident. Her friends and fellow club members mourn her death in a local hospital. Yet she shows up to school the following day, and no one senses anything amiss.

The day finishes without any unusual incidents, and the group of friends plans for the upcoming cultural festival. Suddenly, the room is shaken by an unnatural earthquake. Everyone splits up to investigate—except for Nagisa Hanamiya, who stays behind. As everyone leaves, Nagisa notices that the odd relic-like cube that she was toying with starts emitting a strange blue light. Meanwhile, Sou stumbles upon an unconscious, naked girl lying in a pool of water.

Ushinawareta Mirai wo Motomete follows the Astronomy Club's increasingly bizarre adventures—from dealing with ghosts to quelling unrests between student clubs. All the while, they unravel the circumstances behind the sudden appearance of a new transfer student.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the time travel elements and the satisfying ending, acknowledging that the series requires patience. However, many are critical of the slow pacing, mediocre animation, and underdeveloped characters, which detract from the overall experience. The series is considered flawed but has enjoyable aspects.
pros: Interesting time travel concepts are explored.
Satisfying payoff in the later episodes.
Unique storytelling that makes sense when everything is revealed.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and outdated visuals.
Pacing issues with slow slice-of-life segments that bore viewers.
Underdeveloped characters and unfulfilled potential for depth.

anime.title: Hanamonogatari
anime.synopsis:
Now that Koyomi Araragi and Hitagi Senjougahara have graduated, very few familiar faces remain at Naoetsu Private High School. One of these is Suruga Kanbaru, holder of the Monkey's Paw. When she begins to hear talk of a mysterious being known as the "Devil" who will magically solve any problem, Kanbaru immediately thinks these rumors are about her and decides to investigate.

She discovers the Devil is actually Rouka Numachi, a former basketball rival from junior high who is no longer able to play due to a leg injury. Rouka provides free advice to those who seek her out. Acting as a collector of misfortune, she enjoys relieving the stress of her clients by providing them with the false hope of having their problems solved. Although Kanbaru sees no real harm being done, she reprimands Rouka for lying and heads home, relieved she is not the cause of the rumors. But she may have a reason to worry after all: she finds that her left hand has reverted back to its human form.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Hanamonogatari is mixed. While some appreciate the focus on character development and the signature Monogatari dialogue, others find it slow-paced and less engaging compared to other arcs. The lack of action and the focus on Kanbaru and Numachi are points of contention for some viewers.
pros: Clever dialogue and writing style characteristic of NisiOisin.
In-depth exploration of Kanbaru Suruga's character and past.
Captivating and compelling story that leaves the viewer wanting more.
cons: Lacking in action and variety compared to other Monogatari arcs.
Heavy reliance on dialogue may not appeal to all viewers.
Some found the story and characters, particularly Numachi, unengaging.

anime.title: Airy Me
anime.genres: Avant Garde, Award Winning, Drama, Horror, Music
anime.synopsis: A test subject is administered daily medication by a nurse in a ward where mysterious medical experiments take place. One day, when the nurse presses the switch of the test subject, it successfully transforms into a chimera. When the test subject continues to hold human desires to take on non-human forms, what spectacle will arise as a result? And what effect will this have on the subject's relationship with the nurse?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment leans positive, praising the unique animation and its synergy with the music. Some find the plot confusing or dislike the chaotic visuals and music style. The music video leaves a lasting impression, though its disturbing elements may not appeal to all viewers.
pros: Visually distinctive and memorable animation style.
Music and animation complement each other, enhancing the overall experience.
Artistically done with a unique and fluid animation style.
cons: Plot may be hard to decipher and not particularly interesting.
Some found the visuals became too chaotic and nonsensical towards the end.
Music may not be to everyone's taste.

anime.title: The Comic Artist and His Assistants
anime.romaji_title: Mangaka-san to Assistant-san to The Animation
anime.synopsis:
Yuuki Aito is a perverted manga artist who appreciates panties, wishing to draw as many as he can. Being surrounded by numerous female assistants, he is constantly asking to use them as references for the manga he draws.
 
Although Aito has an extremely degenerate mind, he can also be a very kind, generous, and helpful person. The duality of his behavior confuses his assistants—do they love the considerate side of him that he rarely displays, or do they hate him for the perverted thoughts he has most of the time?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Mangaka-san to Assistant-san to The Animation" as a lighthearted, funny ecchi comedy.  Viewers appreciate the likeable characters and voice acting but find the plot lacking and the humor repetitive. While some find the short episodes refreshing, others desire more depth and character development.
pros: Funny and likeable characters
Good voice acting
Well-done exaggerations and facial expressions
Enjoyable blend of comedy and ecchi without overdoing it
Consistent theme and execution
cons: Weak or non-existent story/plot
Repetitive humor
Lack of character development
Generic character tropes
Short episode length
anime.thematic_vibe: Ecchi Comedy, Slice of Life, Harem

anime.title: The Disappearance of Conan Edogawa: The Worst Two Days in History
anime.romaji_title: Edogawa Conan Shissou Jiken: Shijou Saiaku no Futsukakan
anime.synopsis: The anime special celebrates the 20th anniversary of Gosho Aoyama's original manga, and it recounts a previously untold story from Conan's past.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the special, praising the plot, characters, art, and music. The new characters and focus on deduction were highlighted as strengths. There is little indication of significant negative sentiment or controversy.
pros: Good plot with interesting new characters.
Twists keep the audience wanting more.
Progress depends on deductions, plans, and tricks.
Pleasing character design and scenery.
Enjoyable ending OST.

anime.title: Hi Score Girl
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Seinen, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
The year is 1991, and arcade video games are the latest craze. Becoming a professional gamer is a far-fetched dream in an industry that has yet to spread its influence. Yet, that is the path sixth-grader Haruo Yaguchi wants to pursue. His aptitude for video games has earned him respect in local arcades and bestowed him with confidence and pride, both of which are shattered when fellow classmate Akira Oono easily defeats him in Street Fighter 2.

Akira is rich, pretty, and smart—as close as can be to a perfect girl. But Haruo had never cared about these things as, despite his multiple shortcomings as a person, his supremacy in video games was, in his mind, undisputed. So, now that someone has appeared who can rival him, part of Haruo cannot help but loathe her. Another part, however, itches for somebody who can compete with him on equal terms, and Akira is more than capable.
anime.consensus_summary: High Score Girl is generally well-received for its nostalgic portrayal of 90s gaming and heartwarming character interactions. While the CGI animation is a common point of criticism, many viewers appreciate the show's unique blend of romance, comedy, and slice-of-life elements. The series evokes a strong sense of nostalgia and emotional connection, although some find the plot slow-paced and the characters somewhat clichéd.
pros: Strong nostalgic appeal for 90s gaming culture.
Well-developed characters with relatable growth and synergy.
Effective integration of video game references to enhance the narrative.
Soundtrack evokes strong emotions and compliments the story.
Unique premise blending romance, comedy, and slice-of-life elements.
cons: CGI animation can be jarring and unappealing to some viewers.
Over-reliance on anime cliches and stereotypes.
Slow pacing and lack of significant plot development.
One-dimensional side characters.
Underdeveloped romance with oblivious main character.

anime.title: Sword Art Offline: Extra Edition
anime.romaji_title: Sword Art Online: Sword Art Offline - Extra Edition
anime.synopsis: Extra episode of Sword Art Offline included in the Sword Art Online: Extra Edition Blu-ray and DVD.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience sentiment for Sword Art Offline - Extra Edition is overwhelmingly negative. Reviewers universally pan the special as unnecessary, unfunny, and a waste of time, even for dedicated fans. The humor, animation, and overall content are deemed weak, poorly executed, and lacking any redeeming qualities.
pros: Trivia segment is mildly interesting (Review 3)
cons: Extremely weak and unfunny humor based on basic dialogue and repetitive situations (Review 1, Review 2, Review 3)
Poor animation quality with limited movements and a cheap, uninspired presentation (Review 2, Review 3)
Lacks visual polish and inspired direction (Review 2)
Completely dispensable content that adds nothing to the main story, character development, or universe (Review 2)
Tiring, monotonous, and boring from beginning to end (Review 2)
Dialogue is very basic and humor is almost non-existent (Review 1)
Presented as a recap of a recap, making it redundant (Review 1)
Chibi character design and execution are not appealing (Review 2, Review 3)

anime.title: Sword Art Online II
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Romance, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
A year after escaping Sword Art Online, Kazuto Kirigaya has been settling back into the real world. However, his peace is short-lived as a new incident occurs in a game called Gun Gale Online, where a player by the name of Death Gun appears to be killing people in the real world by shooting them in-game. Approached by officials to assist in investigating the murders, Kazuto assumes his persona of Kirito once again and logs into Gun Gale Online, intent on stopping the killer.

Once inside, Kirito meets Sinon, a highly skilled sniper afflicted by a traumatic past. She is soon dragged in his chase after Death Gun, and together they enter the Bullet of Bullets, a tournament where their target is sure to appear. Uncertain of Death Gun's real powers, Kirito and Sinon race to stop him before he has the chance to claim another life. Not everything goes smoothly, however, as scars from the past impede their progress. In a high-stakes game where the next victim could easily be one of them, Kirito puts his life on the line in the virtual world once more.
anime.consensus_summary: Sword Art Online II is a divisive anime, praised for its visual and auditory presentation but criticized for its flawed storytelling, character development, and reliance on tired tropes. While some viewers appreciate the emotional moments and new characters introduced, others find the plot contrived and the characters one-dimensional. The series struggles to escape the shadow of its predecessor, repeating many of the same mistakes while failing to capitalize on its potential.
pros: Visually appealing animation and art style.
Engaging soundtrack that complements the mood of each scene.
Some arcs, like Mother's Rosario, offer emotional depth and character development.
cons: Inconsistent pacing across different story arcs.
Repetitive plot elements and reliance on 'Kirito saves the day' trope.
Weak villains with poorly explained motivations.
Overuse of fan service elements that detract from the seriousness of the plot.
Illogical plot points and lack of realism in scenarios.

anime.title: Gintama: Yorinuki Gintama-san on Theater 2D
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Demonic Vice-Commander of the Shinsengumi, Toushirou Hijikata, acquires a cursed sword—one which completely rewrites his personality, morphing him from a hard-boiled, no-nonsense cop into a hopeless otaku. As he struggles to break the curse, an ambitious new member of the police force, Itou Kamotarou, seizes the opportunity to depose Hijikata in his bid for power within the organization. However, Itou's scheme is revealed to be more devious than anyone imagined, and the very existence of the Shinsengumi is thrown into peril.

In another time and place, the Yorozuya squad is suddenly greeted by a potential new recruit. Before them is a mysterious young woman named Pirako Doromizu who hides a penchant for extreme violence behind her smiling, enthusiastic exterior. However, unbeknownst to Gintoki and the others, Pirako has strong ties to one of the ruling figures of the Kabuki district of Edo, and her arrival sets off a chain reaction that throws the inhabitants of the district into a civil war.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a recap of the best arcs from the first two seasons of Gintama, but it doesn't add anything new and is of lower quality than the original airing. While the arcs themselves are good, it's generally considered a waste of time to watch the recap. The high rating is attributed to the quality of the original arcs, not the recap itself.
pros: Covers the most important arcs of the first two seasons.
The arcs themselves are good.
cons: Recaps don't add anything of value.
Lower quality than the original airing.
Shinsengumi rebellion arc has aged poorly.
Waste of time to rewatch arcs in recap format.

anime.title: Mushi-shi: Next Passage Part 1
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Adventure, Historical, Iyashikei, Mystery, Seinen, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Perceived as strange and feared by man, over time the misshapen ones came to be known as Mushi. Although they harbor no ill intentions towards humans, many suffer from the side effects of their existence and strange nature; exploiting the Mushi without understanding them, even unintentionally, can lead to disaster and strife for any involved. Mushishi Zoku Shou continues the story of Mushishi Ginko on his journey to help the visible world to coexist with the Mushi.

During his travels, Ginko discovers various gifted individuals—those cursed by circumstance and those maintaining a fragile symbiosis with the Mushi—inevitably confronting the question of whether humanity, talented and tortured alike, can manage the responsibility of the unseen. Moreover, as a Mushishi, Ginko must learn more about these strange beings and decide if he has the right to interfere with the complex relationships between Mushi and mankind.
anime.consensus_summary: Mushishi Zoku Shou is largely praised for its beautiful visuals, engaging episodic stories, and atmospheric presentation. While some find the formulaic nature repetitive and desire more plot progression, the majority appreciate its ability to maintain the spirit of the original series. Most agree that it's a relaxing and thought-provoking experience.
pros: Beautiful artwork and natural landscapes create an authentic and engaging atmosphere.
Episodic format allows for diverse and relatable stories.
Maintains the spirit and quality of the original series.
Stories are metaphors for people dealing with their own lives.
cons: Episodic nature leads to a lack of overall plot progression.
Some find the show repetitive due to its formulaic structure.
Main character Ginko has less screen time in some episodes.
The evil side of mushi is not explored as much as in the first season.

anime.title: Blue Spring Ride
anime.synopsis:
While most young girls make an effort to show off their feminine charms, Futaba Yoshioka deliberately behaves like she wants to repel anyone who might be attracted to her. Ostracized by her female classmates in middle school for being a little too popular with the boys, she desperately strives to avoid a similar situation in high school by being unnecessarily noisy and graceless.

Nevertheless, scattered among Futaba's unpleasant memories are the treasured moments with the boy she had a crush on, Kou Tanaka. Unfortunately, that spell abruptly ended on a sour note when he suddenly stopped attending school and never came back. When Futaba finds out that Kou has returned—with a different last name this time—she can already feel the butterflies in her stomach. However, Kou Mabuchi is not the warm boy that she remembers from her days in middle school; he is now taller, more charismatic and withdrawn—making him far less approachable.

Futaba believes that if she returns to her former self, Kou will begin to take notice of her again. But is she prepared to sacrifice her bubble of normalcy and risk losing her friends in the process?
anime.consensus_summary: Ao Haru Ride is a shoujo anime that polarizes viewers due to its blend of classic romance tropes and frustrating plot choices. While praised for relatable characters, art style, and emotional depth, it is criticized for generic plotlines, unresolved romantic tension, and annoying side characters. The audience is split between those who appreciate its charm and those who are disappointed by its lack of resolution.
pros: Relatable characters with unique development.
Beautiful and unique art style and music.
Honest and dramatic portrayal of shoujo themes.
cons: Generic and predictable plot elements.
Annoying side characters and love triangles.
Lack of closure and romantic ending.

anime.title: Fairy Tail Series 2
anime.synopsis:
The Grand Magic Games reaches its climax following Natsu Dragneel and Gajeel Redfox's stunning victory over Sting Eucliffe and Rogue Cheney of the Sabertooth guild. This success pushes the Fairy Tail guild closer to being crowned the overall champions, but obtaining victory is not the only challenge they face. A mystery still surrounds a hooded stranger and the ominous Eclipse Gate, leaving more questions than answers.

More crazy adventures are on the horizon for Fairy Tail as their destructive antics and joyful rowdiness continue unabated. Their greatest trial is quickly approaching, but united as a family, the guild will always be ready to face any threat that comes their way.
anime.consensus_summary: Fairy Tail (2014) is a polarizing anime, loved by many for its focus on friendship, family, and exciting shonen action. However, it's also criticized for its reliance on tropes, inconsistent animation, and disappointing filler arcs. While some find it a source of comfort and escapism, others consider it mediocre and a waste of time.
pros: Likeable characters and strong bonds between them
Enjoyable arcs with good action and entertainment
Improved animation and soundtrack compared to the first season
cons: Overreliance on 'power of friendship' cliche
Inconsistent animation quality, especially in later arcs
Filler arcs that drag on and are not very good

anime.title: Gakkou no Kaidan (OVA)
anime.synopsis: OVAs included in the August and September issues of Comic Bun Bun between 2005 and 2009. In 2005 and 2006, the anime came on VHS tapes. It switched to DVD in 2007.
anime.consensus_summary: The Gakkou no Kaidan OVAs are a collection of short, spooky Japanese stories that are generally entertaining, though potentially obscure for viewers unfamiliar with Japanese folklore. The animation and character designs are appreciated, but the image quality is lacking. The opening theme is a standout, while the ending theme is considered generic. The planned sequel is mourned by the reviewer.
pros: Good character designs, especially the restyling of Kinjiro.
OP song ('すぐそばに～another world～' by Lisa Takahashi) is excellent and fits the tone well.
Stories are entertaining and short.
cons: Low image quality due to the age and format of the releases.
Some voice acting can be grating.
ED song is generic and doesn't fit the horror theme.
Stories are very Japanese-centric and may be difficult to understand without cultural knowledge.

anime.title: Inari Kon Kon OVA
anime.romaji_title: Inari, Konkon, Koi Iroha. Inari, Konkon, Semishigure.
anime.synopsis:
Unaired OVA bundled with limited edition eighth volume of the manga.

The episode centers around the actions of Inari and Kon.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally seen as enjoyable for fans of the original series, evoking nostalgia and warmth. However, some viewers found the lack of plot progression and the inclusion of an annoying child character to be drawbacks. The episode doesn't add anything new but serves as a reminder of why people liked the series in the first place.
pros: Heartwarming scenes
Relaxing music
Enjoyable despite lack of plot advancement
cons: Lack of plot development
Unnecessary focus on a child character
Annoying child character
No romance development

anime.title: Engaged to the Unidentified Special
anime.romaji_title: Mikakunin de Shinkoukei: Mite. Are ga Watashitachi no Tomatteiru Ryokan yo.
anime.synopsis:
After participating in a lucky draw, Hakuya Mitsumine wins first prize: tickets for a trip to a hot spring of his choice. Hakuya's sister, Mashiro, wishes to visit a specific hot spring in a village surrounded by intriguing rumors about alleged sightings of mysterious creatures in its area. Supportive of his sister's pick, Hakuya, along with Mashiro and a few friends, heads to the village. 

When the group ventures into a dark forest determined to catch a glimpse of the creatures, their pursuit is instead hindered by multiple uncanny mishaps. Strayed from what was supposed to be a simple goal, the group is determined to find the creatures or else they will return home with their curiosity dissatisfied.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely agrees that this special episode, while relying heavily on familiar tropes and simple writing, succeeds due to its strong character interactions and well-integrated humor. It's seen as a cute, funny, and enjoyable slice-of-life/supernatural comedy that captures a nostalgic anime vibe, even if it's not particularly groundbreaking or memorable.
pros: Character interactions and exaggerated reactions drive entertainment.
Humor is well-integrated with a laid-back vibe, featuring plenty of jokes and silly moments.
Embraces the fun, everyday nature of situations rather than making them epic.
Captures a classic anime special episode atmosphere, evoking nostalgia and highlighting character chemistry.
Genuinely cute and funny reactions and situations stemming from character personalities.
cons: Relies on familiar tropes (test of courage, ghost stories) without groundbreaking innovation.
Premise is simple and follows a common formula.
Script is straightforward.
Haunted-house mystery isn't particularly fascinating.
Succeeds more due to cast interactions than the actual unfolding events.
Not a particularly memorable episode or a series highlight.

anime.title: Magi: Adventure of Sinbad
anime.synopsis:
Not so long ago, mysterious structures called Dungeons began appearing all over the world. No one knows what they are or how they came to be, but adventurers and armies around the world instantly took interest in them. Thousands set out to explore the Dungeons, but so far, not a single person has returned.
 
In a Parthevian port, a young boy is about to make a name for himself. Sinbad is good-natured, strong, and craving adventure. A kind deed leads to his meeting with Yunan, an enigmatic traveler who is far more powerful than his frivolous personality lets on. Yunan instructs Sinbad to attain the "power of the king" and change the world—by conquering a Dungeon. The eager boy readily accepts, setting out on the grand adventure he so craved.

Taking place 15 years before the events of the original series, Magi: Sinbad no Bouken chronicles Sinbad's youth as a Dungeon conqueror. Along the way, the budding adventurer and merchant will have to face many obstacles, but anything is possible with the power of a king.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences appreciate the visually stunning art and action sequences, which are consistent with the main Magi series. However, there's a noticeable division regarding the narrative quality, with many finding the early plotlines to be clichéd and lacking in character depth, despite the third OVA showing improvement.
pros: Consistent and amazing art style that matches the main series
Detailed character designs
Enjoyable action sequences
Easy to understand plot, suitable for relaxed viewing
cons: Repetitive and clichéd storytelling, especially in early OVAs
Lack of depth in characterization beyond Sinbad
Reliance on 'destiny' and convenient plot devices (deus ex machina)
Inconsistent application of physics and reality

anime.title: The World is Still Beautiful
anime.synopsis:
In the Sun Kingdom, sunshine is part of its citizens' everyday lives, and rain is something that they have never even heard of. However, in a faraway land called the Rain Dukedom, the weather is reversed, and everybody has the power to create rain with their voices.

Livius Orvinus Ifrikia has conquered the entire world and expanded the Sun Kingdom's influence in the three short years since he was crowned king. Upon learning about the powers to create rain, Livius decides to marry Nike Remercier, one of the princesses of the Rain Dukedom. However, those outside the Sun Kingdom have spread a rumor that Livius is a cruel, ruthless, and tyrannical ruler, and as word reaches the princess, she begins to prepare herself for the worst. But when she finally meets her fiancé, Nike discovers that he is an entirely different person from what she originally expected.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers find the story enchanting, with great character development and appealing art and music. However, others criticize the inconsistent tone, predictable plot, and questionable themes. The series' quality is debatable.
pros: Great character building between protagonists with gradual changes.
Colorful and balanced art style.
Good music, especially the rain summoning song.
Each episode is interesting with its climax.
cons: Inconsistent story and tone, flipping between silly and dark.
Artificial suspense and predictable drama.
Stockholm Syndrome theme.
Fast-paced in the first half.

anime.title: Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san
anime.synopsis:
Yachiyo Inugami, a cat-loving extrovert, and Suzu Nekoyama, a dog-loving introvert, are unexpectedly cast into a relationship on a day like any other. The pair find themselves drawn together through an inexplicable attraction of their opposite personalities. As they quickly begin to understand one another, Inugami's hardened resolve to gain Nekoyama's favor only leads to frenzied responses. Soon after their momentous union, the two begin to spend more time with one another, growing closer all the while.
 
Their combined antics gain the attention of the mousy Mikine Nezu, a classmate of Inugami, and soon they join the "biology" club. There, they meet Ushikawa Ukiji, a passive, cow-like upperclassmen. Nezu and Nekoyama soon begin to build upon their relationship and a game of cat and mouse soon begins.
 
Wild, explosive, and vibrant, Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san tells the comedic tale of two high school girls and their less-than-normal relationship.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed but leans positive, particularly among yuri fans. Many find the show cute, funny, and a good way to kill time, but acknowledge the short episodes limit depth. Criticisms focus on unoriginality, inconsistent art, and the lack of substantial plot or character development. The show is generally seen as lighthearted entertainment, but not something particularly memorable or groundbreaking.
pros: Cute and charming characters
Enjoyable, lighthearted comedy
Catchy ending theme
Quick and easy to watch
Good voice acting
cons: Short episodes limit story and character development
Unoriginal or stereotypical characters
Repetitive jokes
Inconsistent art style
Pacing too fast
Lack of plot
Some uncomfortable or cringy scenes

anime.title: Kuroko's Basketball: Let's Do That Again
anime.romaji_title: Kuroko no Basket: Mou Ikkai Yarimasen ka
anime.genres: Comedy, School, Shounen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the 6 Blu-ray/DVD. It will adapt the 124th chapter of the manga, which depicts when Kuroko and Aomine first met.
anime.consensus_summary: Fans highly appreciate this OVA for its deep dive into the foundational relationship between Kuroko and Aomine, offering much-needed backstory and emotional depth. While some viewers noted the repetition of scenes already present in the main series, the overall sentiment is that this expansion enriches the viewing experience for dedicated fans by providing crucial character context.
pros: Provides significant backstory and context for key characters (Kuroko and Aomine)
Expands on an important and frequently referenced friendship within the series
Offers a deeper appreciation for character relationships and development
Beautifully depicts the growth of Kuroko and Aomine's friendship
Highlights the contrast between past camaraderie and present dynamics
Detailed animation of basketball plays and character expressions
Voice acting perfectly matches the characters
cons: Some scenes are repetitive or have been shown in other parts of the series (flashbacks in season 3)
Does not introduce significant new plot points or character facts beyond appreciation
Animation and music quality are the same as the main series, offering no new production advancements
The episode's chronological placement can be confusing or lead to repeated content

anime.title: Ping Pong the Animation
anime.synopsis:
Despite being polar opposites, Makoto "Smile" Tsukimoto and Yutaka "Peco" Hoshino have been best friends since childhood. Although the overly confident Peco strives to be the best ping-pong player in the world, he often skips practice, earning the ire of his fellow teammates on the Katase High School ping-pong team. Meanwhile, Smile—in spite of his innate talent for the sport—cannot help but hold back his full strength when playing against others. Through their mutual love for ping-pong, the two have developed a bond that is seemingly unbreakable.

When Peco hears that an ex-national team player from China is coming to Japan, he drags Smile over to rival Tsujido High School to observe them. The subsequent trip leads to a clash between Peco and Kong Wenge, who overwhelmingly defeats the former in one game. Stunned by such a comprehensive loss, Peco finds himself questioning why he plays to begin with. Seeing his potential as a player, Katase's coach begins to train Smile to overcome his hesitation, but he is reluctant to play if it is not for enjoyment.

As the two struggle to find meaning in the sport, a plethora of stronger players—each with their own internal strifes—await them at the inter-high tournament, where only the very best can persevere. But when these young athletes let their unbridled ambition go unchecked, the hardships they face paint a somber reality as they pursue glory.
anime.consensus_summary: Ping Pong the Animation is a unique and thought-provoking series that focuses on character development and emotional growth rather than traditional sports tropes. While its unconventional art style may deter some viewers, the show's profound narrative and pacing have garnered high praise. The series is cherished for its philosophical depth and its ability to explore complex themes within a short, impactful run.
pros: Beautifully crafted and unconventional storytelling
Excellent character development and emotional growth
Unique art style and animation
Pacing perfection in just 11 episodes
Profound narrative with philosophical depth
cons: Unconventional art style can be unappealing
Slow pacing in the beginning
Inconsistencies in character storytelling
Weird incest romance subplot
Repetitive remarks from side characters

anime.title: Black Butler: Book of Circus
anime.genres: Action, Historical, Mystery, Mythology, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Full of wonder and excitement, the Noah's Arc Circus troupe has captured audiences with their dazzling performances. Yet these fantastic acts do not come without a price. Children have mysteriously gone missing around London, correlating to that of the group's movements. Unsettled by these kidnappings, Queen Victoria sends in her notorious guard dog, Ciel Phantomhive; and his ever-faithful demon butler, Sebastian Michaelis, on an undercover mission to find these missing children.

Trying to balance their new circus acts with their covert investigation under the big top, however, proves to be quite a challenge. With the other performers growing suspicious and the threat of the circus' mysterious benefactor looming overhead, what the two discover will shake Ciel to his very core.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, appreciating the faithfulness to the manga and the darker, more emotional storyline. While some find the limited episode count a detriment to character development and emotional impact, the arc is generally considered a strong improvement over previous anime-original seasons. The show's thematic darkness and mature content are appreciated by some but off-putting to others.
pros: Faithful to the manga, providing a more complete and satisfying story.
Excellent character designs and animation quality.
Engaging and well-paced plot, despite being only 10 episodes long.
Explores Ciel's past, adding depth to his character.
cons: Some find the story execution rushed due to the limited number of episodes, hindering emotional connection.
The heavy themes and sensitive subject matter may not appeal to all viewers; some reviews note the presence of shotacon themes.
Character development is limited for new characters due to the short length of the arc.

anime.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
anime.synopsis:
Seiya Kanie, a smart and extremely narcissistic high school student, believes that the beautiful but reserved Isuzu Sento has invited him on a date at an amusement park called Amagi Brilliant Park. Much to his chagrin, not only is the location a run-down facility, the supposed date is merely a recruitment tour where Sento and Princess Latifa Fleuranza, the owner of the theme park, ask him to become the park's new manager. Their cause for desperation? As stipulated in a land-use contract, Amagi has less than three months to meet a quota of 500,000 guests, or the park will be closed for good and the land redeveloped by a greedy real-estate company.

Seiya is won over by the revelation that Amagi is no ordinary amusement park; many of its employees are Maple Landers—mysterious magical beings who live in the human world and are nourished by the energy created by people having fun. Entrusted with the hopes and dreams of this far-off enchanted land, Seiya must now use his many skills to bring Amagi back on its feet, or watch it crumble before his eyes.
anime.consensus_summary: Amagi Brilliant Park is a well-received anime, praised for its unique concept, lovable characters, and high production quality, though it does have a slow start. While many find it humorous and entertaining, some criticisms are directed at the story and some character development. Overall, the series is considered enjoyable and worth watching.
pros: Unique and interesting premise.
Well-developed and lovable characters.
Spectacular animation and sound quality.
Humorous and entertaining plot.
cons: Slow start with a weak first episode.
Incomplete character development in some instances.
Generic character design.
Characters that are written as being 'stupid'

anime.title: Locodol
anime.synopsis: Nanako Usami, a high school girl living in the small rural city of Nagarekawa, is asked by her uncle, who works at city hall, to take part in a stage show at the local zoo to help promote the town. There, she meets her senpai from high school, Yukari Kohinata, who is also scheduled to perform. With Yukari's advice, Nanako successfully completes the show. This experience leads them to form the "Nagarekawa Girls," a local idol duo created to promote Nagarekawa.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Locodol for its wholesome and relaxing slice-of-life story about local idols. While some find the plot simple and the music unremarkable, the cute characters and heartwarming interactions are consistently praised. Many appreciate its unique take on the idol genre, focusing on community engagement rather than stardom.
pros: Relaxing and heartwarming story
Cute and relatable characters
Unique concept of local idols
Good voice acting
Appealing art style with pleasant scenery
cons: Simple and somewhat predictable plot
Lack of standout music
Comedy may not appeal to everyone
Pacing can be slow at times
May lack depth compared to other idol anime

anime.title: Akame ga Kill!
anime.synopsis:
Night Raid is the covert assassination branch of the Revolutionary Army, an uprising assembled to overthrow Prime Minister Honest, whose avarice and greed for power has led him to take advantage of the child emperor's inexperience. Without a strong and benevolent leader, the rest of the nation is left to drown in poverty, strife, and ruin. Though the Night Raid members are all experienced killers, they understand that taking lives is far from commendable and that they will likely face retribution as they mercilessly eliminate anyone who stands in the revolution's way.

This merry band of assassins' newest member is Tatsumi, a naïve boy from a remote village who had embarked on a journey to help his impoverished hometown and was won over by not only Night Raid's ideals, but also their resolve. Akame ga Kill! follows Tatsumi as he fights the Empire and comes face-to-face with powerful weapons, enemy assassins, challenges to his own morals and values, and ultimately, what it truly means to be an assassin with a cause.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Akame ga Kill! is highly polarized. While some appreciate its action and subversion of tropes through character deaths, many criticize its tonal inconsistencies, generic plot, and poor adaptation of the manga. The show's attempt to blend dark themes with comedy and fanservice is a significant point of contention.
pros: Steady pacing with complicated twists.
Realistic portrayal of character deaths, subverting anime tropes.
Initial episodes establish an interesting world.
cons: Inconsistent tone, mixing dark themes with lighthearted comedy and fanservice.
Generic story with underdeveloped characters.
Deviates from the manga, angering original fans.
Sensationalized death scenes that feel gratuitous.

anime.title: Pretty Rhythm: All Star Selection
anime.synopsis: This is the fourth anime series of Pretty Rhythm. The story features a girl named Laala Manaka, who desires to become an Idol. To further her debut the best, the three main protagonists from the previous Pretty Rhythm series Aira, Mia, and Naru give her lessons about how to be the best Idol. In addition to the lessons she's learning, the series also retells the events of the previous Pretty Rhythm series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is that this series is primarily a recap of previous Pretty Rhythm series. It's beneficial for newcomers but offers nothing new for established fans. The lack of new content is a major drawback for returning viewers.
pros: Good for viewers new to the Pretty Rhythm series.
cons: Repetitive content for existing fans.
No new scenes or stories.

anime.title: Free! Eternal Summer
anime.synopsis:
Even though it has been a year since the Iwatobi High School Swim Club has been created, new members have yet to join the club. Now that Haruka Nanase and Makoto Tachibana are senior students, along with their younger friends Nagisa Hazuki and Rei Ryuugazaki, they have to find a way to attract new members. If not, the club will be forced to close the following year due to a lack of membership.

Meanwhile, with impending graduation, it is also time for the seniors to decide their plans for the future. Unlike their friend Rin Matsuoka, the new captain of Samezuka Academy Swim Club who is determined to fulfill his dream of being a professional swimmer, Haruka and Makoto are unsure about what career path they want to take.

Further problems arise when an old friend of Rin's, Sousuke Yamazaki, comes to the city to study at Samezuka Academy; the recently scouted swimmer's arrival causes tension in the relationship among him, Rin, and Haruka.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Free! Eternal Summer' is well-received as a solid continuation of the first season, particularly praised for its focus on character development and the emotional bonds between the characters. While some criticize the fan service and perceived shift in focus, many find the themes of friendship and pursuing dreams compelling. The series is generally considered enjoyable, especially for fans of the genre, with its high-quality animation and soundtrack adding to the positive reception.
pros: Character development is well-executed, showing growth and personal struggles.
Strong emphasis on teamwork, friendship, and camaraderie resonates with viewers.
High-quality animation, especially the water visuals, and a memorable soundtrack enhance the experience.
cons: Some find the plot simple or repetitive compared to the first season.
The fan service elements distract from the competitive swimming aspect for some viewers.
Cheesy moments and perceived homoerotic undertones bothered some viewers.

anime.title: selector infected WIXOSS
anime.genres: High Stakes Game, Psychological, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Things are not always what they seem. This is especially true for Ruuko Kominato, when she receives a deck of cards for the popular card game WIXOSS, only to find a girl trapped inside her LRIG, or avatar card. Upon meeting others in the same situation, Ruuko discovers that she has now become a "Selector," a player in a special version of WIXOSS where girls can battle each other for a chance to have their deepest desires come true. However, there is a catch. In contrast to the glory that awaits them after their victories, there is a cruel fate: if they lose three times, their lives will be destroyed.

In an ominous game filled with lies and deceit, Ruuko and her newfound friends must uncover the secrets behind WIXOSS and realize what is truly most important to them before it is too late.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Selector Infected WIXOSS. Some appreciate its dark themes, psychological depth, and subversion of the card game genre. Others find it unoriginal due to its similarities to Madoka Magica and criticize its slow start and poorly explained card game mechanics.
pros: Intriguing deconstruction of the card game genre.
Explores complex themes of desires, consequences, and personal identity.
Well-paced story with increasing tension and chaos.
cons: Slow start that may deter some viewers.
Similarities to Madoka Magica may lead to accusations of unoriginality.
Card game rules are not well explained, which may frustrate some viewers.

anime.title: Fate/stay night [Unlimited Blade Works]
anime.synopsis:
The Holy Grail War is a battle royale among seven magi who serve as Masters. Masters, through the use of the command seals they are given when they enter the war, command Heroic Spirits known as Servants to fight for them in battle. In the Fifth Holy Grail War, Rin Toosaka is among the magi entering the competition. With her Servant, Archer, she hopes to obtain the ultimate prize—the Holy Grail, a magical artifact capable of granting its wielder any wish.
 
One of Rin's classmates, Shirou Emiya, accidentally enters the competition and ends up commanding a Servant of his own known as Saber. As they find themselves facing mutual enemies, Rin and Shirou decide to form a temporary alliance as they challenge their opponents in the Holy Grail War.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. While praised for its stunning visuals and faithful adaptation by Ufotable, some find the story generic and pacing slow. The character development, especially of Shirou, is criticized, leading to disappointment for some viewers familiar with the Fate/Zero canon. The series' value depends on one's appreciation for visual fidelity and adherence to the source material.
pros: Stunning animation and visuals by Ufotable.
Faithful adaptation of the Unlimited Blade Works route from the visual novel.
Interesting premise with complex heroes and servant interactions.
cons: Story can be generic with typical shounen tropes.
Slow pacing and dull scenes, especially in the first season.
Lack of character development, particularly for Shirou.

anime.title: Tokyo Ghoul
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Psychological, Seinen, Suspense, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
A sinister threat is invading Tokyo: flesh-eating "ghouls" who appear identical to humans and blend into their population. Reserved college student Ken Kaneki buries his nose in books and avoids the news of the growing crisis. However, the appearance of an attractive woman named Rize Kamishiro shatters his solitude when she forwardly asks him on a date.

While walking Rize home, Kaneki discovers she isn't as kind as she first appeared, and she has led him on with sinister intent. After a tragic struggle, he later awakens in a hospital to learn his life was saved by transplanting the now deceased Rize's organs into his own body.

Kaneki's body begins to change in horrifying ways, and he transforms into a human-ghoul hybrid. As he embarks on his new dreadful journey, Kaneki clings to his humanity in the evolving bloody conflict between society's new monsters and the government agents who hunt them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Tokyo Ghoul are divided, with many feeling the anime adaptation fails to capture the depth and complexity of the manga. While some praise the premise, action, and exploration of morality, others criticize the rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and unsatisfying ending. Many viewers express disappointment with the adaptation and suggest reading the manga for a more complete experience.
pros: Intriguing premise of ghouls living among humans.
Good action sequences and fight choreography.
Exploration of morality and perspectives on good and evil.
Excellent animation and character design in some instances.
Soundtrack and opening theme are well-received.
cons: Poor adaptation of the manga, with rushed pacing and crammed content.
Underdeveloped characters and wasted potential.
Incomplete and unsatisfying ending with unresolved plot points.
Inconsistent storytelling and world-building.
Excessive censorship.
Overhyped and doesn't live up to expectations.

anime.title: The Prince and the White Horse
anime.synopsis: Bataar, a young Mongolian boy, wishes to cure his father's leg that was injured during a war with a neighboring tribe. One day, a white horse suddenly appears before him and Bataar starts a magical journey through time to rewrite history and to prevent the war from ever happening!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds "Daisougen to Hakuba" to be a largely unengaging experience due to its slow plot, underdeveloped characters, and lackluster story. While some appreciate the period music, the overall sentiment leans heavily towards disappointment. The poor dubbing further detracts from the experience, making it difficult for viewers to maintain interest.
pros: Beautiful period music in the background
cons: Boring and slow-moving plot
Cardboard and generic characters with no distinguishing features
Poor voice acting in the dub
Lack of a well-built story

anime.title: Teekyu 3 Specials
anime.synopsis: Short specials included in the BD release.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Teekyuu 3 Specials' are generally well-received, with viewers noting improvements in story, art, and voice acting. While the characters remain stereotypical, the specials are appreciated for their random and comical nature. The audience consensus is positive, particularly among fans of crack fiction and absurd humor.
pros: Story is more coherent and enjoyable
Art and animation quality are improving
Voice acting is becoming more tolerable
cons: Characters remain flat stereotypes
Fast-paced delivery can be hard to follow

anime.title: Funny Pets 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: The story continues where it was left off from in the first season as Crescent and Corona continue bickering over Funny.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally perceives season 2 as a significant improvement over season 1, particularly in character development and narrative depth. The show is easily accessible, with each episode being enjoyable on its own, making it easy for new viewers to jump in. Overall the audience sentiment is positive with a very low controversy score.
pros: Characters are explored in-depth.
Characters have motivations.
Ongoing story where every episode can stand by itself.
cons: Characters in season 1 were shallow and exploited.
Simple formulaic episodes in season 1.

anime.title: Ronja the Robber's Daughter
anime.synopsis: The story is about a girl named Ronja who is the daughter of a chief from a tribe of bandits, she lives in a huge castle inside the forest with the bandits. The story follows Ronja as she encounters mystical creatures, making friends with another young child such as herself and experiencing what it is like to live in the forest.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences find 'Sanzoku no Musume Ronja' to be a heartwarming and enjoyable adaptation of Astrid Lindgren's book, praising its engaging story and beautiful depiction of nature. However, some viewers are put off by the slow pacing and CGI animation, particularly in the initial episodes. Despite these criticisms, the series is generally well-received, especially by those familiar with the source material.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the book
Beautiful backgrounds capturing Swedish nature
Engaging story and characters
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the beginning
CGI animation may be off-putting for some viewers
Repetitive character emotes (e.g., laughing) can be annoying

anime.title: Nandaka Velonica
anime.synopsis:
Velonica has crossed the entire galaxy from the distant planet of Metrotopia and landed on Earth. Her mission is simple: to meet with Earth's leader and complete a contract that will allow them to install a giant antenna and connect Earth to the Galaxy Network.

Soon upon her arrival, Velonica discovers that Earth does not have a single leader, and its inhabitants are preoccupied with strange, illogical activities. But before her father—the President of the Galaxy Network—intervenes, Velonica must find a way to make sense of this backwater planet.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, particularly among viewers who appreciate cute characters and unique art styles. The show is considered a hidden gem for those seeking lighthearted entertainment. However, it may not appeal to viewers seeking complex plots or character development.
pros: Cute and appealing art style
Velonica is a likeable and cute character
Lighthearted and not serious tone
cons: Lacks a typical anime structure
May not appeal to viewers seeking plot or character development

anime.title: Broken Blade
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Fantasy, Mecha, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis: In the continent of Cruzon, an impending war between the Kingdom of Krisna and the nation of Athens is brimming. The people of this land are able to use quartz for whatever purpose they desire. Yet one person, Rygart Arrow, is not. He is an "un-sorcerer," a person unable to use quartz. But this characteristic will enable him to pilot an ancient Golem, one strong enough to put up a fight against the invading army of Athens.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many appreciate the high-quality animation and mecha battles, but are disappointed by the rushed story and underdeveloped characters. The series is seen as having great potential that was not fully realized due to its short length and adaptation choices, leading to a somewhat frustrating but still enjoyable experience for mecha fans.
pros: Fantastic art and animation, especially the hand-drawn mecha
Intense and exciting mecha battles
Enjoyable for fans of the mecha genre
cons: Underdeveloped story and characters due to the short length (12 episodes)
Rushed adaptation of the manga, with changes and unanswered questions
Plot progression can be slow and tiring
Lacks a detailed explanation of the world and its mechanics

anime.title: Shin Kidou Senki Gundam Wing: Frozen Teardrop Picture Drama - Aratanaru Tatakai
anime.romaji_title: Shin Kidou Senki Gundam Wing: Frozen Teardrop Picture Drama - Aratanaru Tatakai
anime.synopsis: Special included in the second of two remastered Gundam Wing Blu-ray boxes based on the novel series Gundam Wing Frozen Teardrop
anime.consensus_summary: The picture drama offers an interesting, albeit incomplete, glimpse into the Frozen Teardrop storyline. While the unique presentation with stills and strong audio elements is appreciated, viewers are left wanting a full-fledged animated adaptation. The production is seen as a possible test for a full series that never materialized.
pros: Strong voice acting
Fitting music and sound effects
Interesting presentation of the story through stills
cons: Not fully animated
Hard to follow at times
Leaves the viewer wanting more

anime.title: Hello Kitty: Apple Forest and Parallel Town
anime.romaji_title: Hello Kitty: Ringo no Mori to Parallel Town
anime.synopsis: Kitty and Mimmy fall through a hole and end up in a parallel world. It's identical to the one the sisters live in but it's inhabited by humans with transparent wings and pointy ears. Kitty becomes friends with Emily, a supermodel in this parallel world, and together they try to rescue Mimmy who has disappeared. Their search is hampered by Akuro--a black cat who has a mean streak.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is considered a simple and childish Isekai story within the Hello Kitty franchise. It's primarily targeted towards children, featuring a basic plot with repetitive elements. The plot twist regarding Akuro is a highlight for some, but overall the series is not likely to appeal to a broad audience due to its simplicity.
pros: Plot twist with Akuro's identity adds surprise.
Suitable for children.
cons: Simple and repetitive plot.
Extremely childish.
Formulaic episode structure.

anime.title: Initial D Final Stage
anime.synopsis:
In the final match against the Kanagawa street racing team Sidewinder, Project D street racer Takumi Fujiwara is faced with a surprising challenger: Shinji Inui, a 17-year-old high school student. Beginning to drive at a very young age, Shinji is not only familiar with the mountain pass where the race is taking place, but he also drives a Toyota AE86—the same car model Takumi uses.

Initially reluctant to participate due to a lack of enthusiasm, Shinji becomes motivated after witnessing the fiery battle between Keisuke Takahashi and Gou Houjou. Undefeated in his home course known as the Tsubaki Line, Shinji might prove to be Takumi's most formidable opponent yet.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, viewers found 'Initial D Final Stage' to be a satisfying conclusion to the series, praising the suspenseful final race and Takumi's character growth. Some criticisms include the dated art style and lackluster character development in areas outside of racing. The ending is generally well-received, providing a sense of closure for long-time fans.
pros: Satisfying closure to the series and Project D.
Suspenseful and unpredictable final race.
Highlights Takumi's growth as a racer and person.
Emotional ups and downs during the final race are well-portrayed.
cons: Dated art style compared to modern anime.
Character development, especially regarding romance, feels lacking.
Some find the introduction of Shinji as a mirror to Takumi cliche.
Over half the season was some Karen trying to justify their whiny teenager's driving style that ironically lacks any, after his balls suddenly dropped looking at some legs.

anime.title: Parasyte: The Maxim
anime.genres: Action, Gore, Horror, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
All of a sudden, they arrived: parasitic aliens that descended upon Earth and quickly infiltrated humanity by burrowing into the brains of vulnerable targets. These insatiable beings acquire full control of their host and are able to morph into a variety of forms in order to feed on unsuspecting prey.
 
Sixteen-year-old high school student Shinichi Izumi falls victim to one of these parasites, but it fails to take over his brain, ending up in his right hand instead. Unable to relocate, the parasite, now named Migi, has no choice but to rely on Shinichi in order to stay alive. Thus, the pair is forced into an uneasy coexistence and must defend themselves from hostile parasites that hope to eradicate this new threat to their species.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Parasyte for its engaging story, well-developed main character, and philosophical themes. However, some find the supporting characters lacking and the philosophical elements overbearing. There are also criticisms about the sound design and pacing, which creates a mixed but overall positive reception.
pros: Engaging premise and story
Well-developed main character
Exploration of humanity and morality
cons: Underdeveloped supporting characters
Inconsistent sound design and soundtrack
Heavy-handed philosophical monologues

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai 2
anime.synopsis:
For the second time, the masked storyteller returns to tell children tales and legends of horror and woe, such as the tale of a ventriloquist's dummy, a locker that grants wishes, a capsule toy machine that returns lost possessions, and a strange food called Ominie-san.

Building on the foundation that was laid by the first, Yami Shibai 2 is a collection of Japanese scary stories of the unknown and the occult that are truly terrifying, narrated in a style of art that mimics kamishibai storytelling.
anime.consensus_summary: Yami Shibai 2 is generally considered a step down from the first season, with less impactful horror and predictable stories. While the art style and sound design are still appreciated, many find the season less scary and more reliant on jump scares. The short format keeps it from being a complete loss, but it's mostly recommended for those who enjoyed the first season and want more of the same, albeit at a lower quality.
pros: Creepy atmosphere and unnerving sound design
Interesting art style reminiscent of kamishibai storytelling
Rapid-fire format makes it a quick watch
cons: Stories are generally less scary and predictable compared to the first season
Obvious morals and poorly executed plot in some episodes
Overuse of jump scares and reliance on scare factor rather than psychological creepiness
Characters are not as interesting or well-developed as in the first season
anime.thematic_vibe: Japanese Folklore, Psychological Horror, Urban Legends

anime.title: Blade & Soul
anime.synopsis: Alka is an assassin for the Clan of the Sword. She's on a journey to find the woman Jin Valel, who killed her master Hon without feeling—not unlike how Alka has learned to kill in her work as an assassin. On her journey, Alka encounters three strange women, each a great warrior in her own right and grapples with her slain master's wish that she leaves the life of an assassin behind.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed to negative. While some appreciate the animation and character design, most find the plot weak, the characters shallow, and the story disjointed. There's a general disappointment with the lack of depth and originality, with many feeling it doesn't live up to its potential. The excessive fanservice is also a point of contention.
pros: Good animation and fight scenes.
Some character development, especially towards the end.
Visually appealing female character designs.
cons: Weak and disjointed plot with little connection between episodes.
Shallow and bland characters, especially the protagonist.
Excessive fanservice and focus on female characters' appearances.
Poor pacing and lack of emotional depth.
Story deviates from the source material and lacks originality.

anime.title: Virtual Star 2000
anime.synopsis:
Meet mysterious Miharu, awesome Aya, ruthless Ryoko, mind-blowing Misty, youthful Yukari and heavenly Hikary in a stunning series of computer-generated femininity.

In Super Sonic Jet Girl, you'll enter a hellish nightclub where lingerie-clad Miharu defends herself in a most personal fashion. Chat places the longingly lovely Aya on the streets of your dreams. In Run & Run, Yukari breathes hard and races fast - to nowhere. A Jellyfish Day finds the blonde bombshell Hikary starring in a music video about her private passions. Ryoko inhabits Yamag's Garage, an arena of "Pure Mind," "Love," and a very "Beautiful Face." And Misty mesmerizes in a music video in which she brags: "I'm your magnet of love, and I'm here to serve you."
anime.consensus_summary: Reception is mixed, with some viewers appreciating the nostalgic charm and technological achievement of early 3D animation. Others find the visuals dated and flawed, creating an uncanny and unsettling experience. The series evokes a sense of early internet optimism tinged with modern anxiety about technological advancement.
pros: Showcases early 3D animation capabilities
Characters possess a robotic and uncanny charm, aesthetically pleasing
Ethereal touch reflecting internet optimism of the 2000s
cons: Animation errors and jankiness are apparent
Characters have dead-eyes and look fake
Graphics have not aged well compared to modern standards
anime.thematic_vibe: Techno-Optimism, Uncanny Valley, Early Internet Aesthetics

anime.title: Space Brothers #0
anime.synopsis: Prequel to the TV anime series revolving around the "origin of the dream."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is positive, especially for fans of the original series. The movie is praised for its emotional depth and exploration of the brothers' past. Some viewers find the plot uneven and the CGI distracting, but overall it's considered a worthwhile addition to the Space Brothers universe.
pros: Expands on the backstory of Mutta and Hibito.
Smooth animation compared to the anime series.
Sound design is solid and fits the mood.
cons: Uneven plot focus, with Hibito's plotline cut short.
CGI breaks immersion for some viewers.
Better enjoyed after watching the original anime to avoid spoilers and maximize enjoyment of character cameos.

anime.title: World Break: Aria of Curse for a Holy Swordsman
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Reincarnation, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Seiken Tsukai no World Break takes place at Akane Private Academy where students who possess memories of their previous lives are being trained to use Ancestral Arts so that they can serve as defenders against monsters, called Metaphysicals, who randomly attack. Known as saviors, the students are broken up into two categories: the kurogane who are able to use their prana to summon offensive weapons and the kuroma who are able to use magic.

The story begins six months prior to the major climax of the series during the opening ceremonies on the first day of the school year. After the ceremony is over, the main character, Moroha Haimura, meets a girl named Satsuki Ranjou who reveals that she was Moroha's little sister in a past life where Moroha was a heroic prince capable of slaying entire armies with his sword skills. Soon afterwards he meets another girl, Shizuno Urushibara, who eventually reveals that she also knew Moroha in an entirely different past life where he was a dark lord capable of using destructive magic but saved her from a life of slavery. Can those whose minds live in both the present and the past truly reach a bright future? Delve into the complex world of Seiken Tsukai no World Break to find out!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in the premise and music, while many criticize the generic characters, rushed plot, and poor animation. The overabundance of fanservice and reliance on convenient plot devices further diminishes the show's overall appeal. While some appreciate the initial concept, the execution falls short, leading to a largely negative reception.
pros: Interesting premise involving reincarnation and past lives.
Enjoyable music and sound design, enhancing emotional scenes.
Appealing art style and character designs (though inconsistent).
cons: Generic characters and lack of character development.
Inconsistent and rushed plot with many loopholes.
Over-reliance on plot devices like 'I remember' to resolve conflicts.
Poor animation quality with choppy movements and inconsistent art.
Excessive and unnecessary fanservice detracts from the story.

anime.title: Kuroko no Basket 2nd Season NG-shuu
anime.synopsis: Animated bloopers, based on the extra section of the original manga series, included with the BD/DVD series for Kuroko no Basket Second Season (both limited and normal editions).
anime.consensus_summary: The audience enjoys the 'Kuroko no Basket 2nd Season NG-shuu' as a light and humorous addition to the main series. It's appreciated for providing a way to revisit favorite characters and scenes with new, funny twists. The bloopers are seen as a fun and enjoyable way to let go of the intensity of the original series.
pros: Provides a fun and lighthearted way to revisit the series and characters.
Offers original content and unexpected jokes.
Redrawn scenes and added content show appreciated effort.
cons: Lacks character development or story progression.

anime.title: Appleseed Alpha
anime.synopsis:
Set in a different series of events, this story does not follow the previous Appleseed movie canon (despite being directed by the same director of the previous movies); it is an alternate story to their beginnings. Briareos is already a cyborg and did not become separated from Deunan to be later reunited in Olympus to join ESWAT.

Appleseed Alpha depicts the early days of Deunan Knute and Briareos in the 22nd century, as they embark on a journey throughout dystopic ruins of New York in search of the city of Olympus. They are hired by Two Horns, the warlord of the ruined city, to eliminate bipedal combat machines. During the fight, they encounter Iris and Olson, both on a mission. Deunan and Briareos befriend them and decide to join their mission.

Iris is tasked with preventing the malevolent cyborg Talos from capturing a secret weapon humans were building. Talos uses Iris to activate the gigantic war machine.
