However, after getting forcefully dragged into a dangerous Rhyme match and hearing rumors about disappearing Rib players, all of Aoba's hopes of living a normal life are completely abolished.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of DRAMAtical Murder is largely considered a disappointment, especially by fans of the original visual novel. Common complaints include a rushed and underdeveloped story, poor animation quality, and the removal of key BL elements. While some appreciate the voice acting and soundtrack, the overall consensus is that the anime fails to capture the depth and emotional connection of the source material.
pros: Voice acting for Aoba is well done, especially his 'dark' side
Some find the futuristic setting and technology interesting
Soundtrack has some good rock tracks that enhance climactic scenes
cons: Rushed and poorly developed story due to adaptation of a longer visual novel into a short anime series
Animation quality is low, with awkward expressions and rushed scenes
Lack of character development and emotional connection with characters
Absence of romance (BL elements) that were central to the original visual novel
Plot holes and predictable, generic story elements

anime.title: Minarai Diva
anime.synopsis: The story follows two aspiring divas who hope to become famous through a unique brand of music.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime 'Minarai Diva' is overwhelmingly considered a failure due to its poor production, uninteresting content, and technical issues stemming from its live, unscripted format. The experiment of audience-influenced content falls flat, resulting in a product with virtually no redeeming qualities.  Viewers are strongly advised to avoid this show.
cons: Poor production quality
Pointless and distracting dialogue
Technical difficulties during live airing
Dreadful song quality

anime.title: D-Frag!*
anime.synopsis: After Sakura Mizukami shows up at the Kazama household to ask for a favor, Kenji Kazama and his sister Noe end up unwillingly participating in a footrace at the local shrine. Intent on winning the prize—spring water that only appears once per year—Sakura recruited the Kazama siblings to guarantee her victory. But when Sakura's clubmates, Chitose Karasuyama and Roka Shibasaki, enter the race as well, the girls' competitive energy is unleashed and the contest immediately develops into an all out battle where no victor is certain. What's more, Noe, fed up with Sakura's constant teasing, has no interest in helping her win, and the battle rages not only on the field, but between the divided team members.
anime.consensus_summary: The D-Frag! OVA is generally well-received for its focus on side characters and self-contained stories, offering a refreshing change from the main series. Viewers appreciate the spotlight on characters like Sakura and Noe. However, some criticize the voice acting and lack of plot development, suggesting it relies too heavily on familiar tropes.
pros: OVA focuses on side characters like Sakura and Noe, providing a refreshing change from the main series.
The OVA format allows for self-contained, enjoyable stories that don't require overarching plot development.
The OVA shines a light on previously minor characters, highlighting their unique quirks and personalities.
cons: Some voice acting sounds too mature for the characters.
The story is mediocre and plotless, relying heavily on the male character, Kazama.
Kazama's voice actor sounds too old for a 17-year-old character.

anime.title: Beyond the Boundary: Daybreak
anime.synopsis: Taking place three years before the TV series, episode zero follows Hiroomi Nase's mission to subdue the infamous half-human, half-youmu Akihito Kanbara. Curious about the mission, Hiroomi's little sister, Mitsuki, tags along with him, and the siblings meet Akihito for the first time. However, they soon discover that they aren't the only ones seeking out Akihito, and thus begins the story of Kyoukai no Kanata.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is well-received for expanding on the characters' backstories and seamlessly integrating into the main narrative of Kyoukai no Kanata. Viewers appreciate the added depth to the relationships and origins of key plot points. It's recommended to watch the main series first to fully appreciate the OVA's context and avoid potential spoilers.
pros: Provides backstory for Akihito and the Nase siblings.
Explains the origins of Hiroomi's scars.
Feels like a natural extension of the main series.
Captivating art style consistent with Kyoto Animation's quality.
cons: Title 'Shinonome' feels odd compared to the main series' titles.
May contain spoilers for the main series.
Some may consider the fanservice unneeded.

anime.title: Re: Hamatora: Season 2
anime.synopsis: It has been three months since the incident at Yokohama. Things have been settling down at Cafe Nowhere. Murasaki and Hajime have teamed up and started investigating again. After an unforeseen reunion, Art holds Nice at gunpoint. What are his real intentions? What will become of the connection between Art and Hamatora?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with some viewers finding Re:_Hamatora a significant improvement over the first season, praising its tighter plot, character development, and emotional depth. Others criticize it for plot holes, cliche elements, less vibrant animation, and a rushed pace towards the end. Overall, it seems that opinions are mixed, with the sequel both satisfying some and disappointing others.
pros: Story is more focused and tighter than the first season.
Character backstories are revealed, adding depth.
The plot balances comedy, action and mystery, making it engaging.
The ending is satisfying.
cons: The story contains plot holes.
Some find the villain dull and uninspired.
The plot can be cliche and predictable.
The animation is less colorful compared to the first season.

anime.title: Shin Strange+
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Crossdressing, Josei, Parody
anime.synopsis: Second season of Strange+.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Shin Strange+ for its absurd humor and random comedic moments, despite its lack of a coherent story or significant character development. The show doesn't take itself seriously, and viewers appreciate it for its over-the-top antics and lighthearted entertainment. While some may find the lack of plot and character depth off-putting, the overall sentiment is positive due to the show's ability to deliver consistent hilarity.
pros: Hilarity and comedic interactions between characters.
Catchy outro music.
cons: Lack of a coherent story or plot.
Minimal character development.
Relies heavily on randomness and absurdity.

anime.title: Passage of Time: Tokyo Station
anime.synopsis: Misaki, a 25-year-old woman who is soon to be married, finds an old photo taken at Tokyo Station and an old, broken pocket watch from her late father. Her father worked at Tokyo Station during his life and was a very strict man in her memory, but she saw his smile from the old photo that she's never seen before. Misaki, in attempt to have the old pocket watch repaired, discovers that a watch store existed in Tokyo Station in the past.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the short film for its beautiful visuals, sound, and heartwarming story, especially considering the limited runtime. While some acknowledge the simplicity and cliches, the emotional impact and effective storytelling are appreciated. It's considered a sweet and satisfying experience.
pros: Stunning art and sound design
Effective storytelling within a short timeframe
Emotionally resonant despite cliche elements
cons: Story is simple and short
Cliche story elements

anime.title: Waiting in the Summer: In Our Last Summer of High School, We Await That Summer
anime.romaji_title: Ano Natsu de Matteru: Bokutachi wa Koukou Saigo no Natsu wo Sugoshinagara, Ano Natsu de Matteiru.
anime.synopsis: Special episode included in the Blu-ray Box of Ano Natsu de Matteru.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a nostalgic trip for fans of 'Ano Natsu de Matteru,' but it largely rehashes familiar content and offers little new substance. Many viewers find the limited roles of key characters and the reliance on old jokes disappointing. The episode primarily serves as a sentimental reminder of the original series, rather than a meaningful addition to the narrative.
pros: Provides a glimpse into events before the anime's ending.
Offers a reminiscent experience for fans of the original series.
cons: Doesn't add significant new content to the original series.
Relies heavily on rehashed jokes and fanservice scenes.
Ichika and Lemon's limited presence disappoints some viewers.
Plot feels disjointed and unnecessary

anime.title: Gakumon!: Ookami Shoujo wa Kujikenai
anime.synopsis:
”Wereman" Shushu's life is turned upside down when her father tells her that despite what she was told her entire life, she is in fact a female, and cannot become a wereman. To be certified as a wereman so she can become a public servant and let her father retire, she enrolls in Monster Academy. There, she meets Juzu, the son of the monster king who founded the school. Although he is feared by everyone due to his status, when her secret is exposed to the monster prince, she finds out that Juzu is in fact stupid, but is kind and just wanted a friend. With all the eyes of the students on Shushu and Juzu, the inconspicuous life Shushu so direly desired goes down the drain.

Note: The third episode will begin streaming on December 4, 2014 to celebrate the release of the manga's first compiled book volume, which will ship in Japan the same day.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime has a charming and humorous premise reminiscent of "She's the Man", but set in an RPG fantasy world. It centers on a wolfgirl who disguises herself as a boy and befriends the son of the demon king. The series is considered obscure but enjoyable.
pros: Charming premise
Good sense of humor

anime.title: Ai-Mai-Mi Mousou Catastrophe
anime.romaji_title: Choboraunyopomi Gekijou Dai Ni Maku Ai Mai Mii: Mousou Catastrophe
anime.synopsis: Manga club members Ai, Mai, and Mii continue their everyday absurd antics as they progress through high school alongside their upperclassman Ponoka. Whether the girls are drawing manga, joking around, or discovering odd creatures, they never run out of new ways to have fun together and grow closer as friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Ai Mai Mii maintains the comedic and absurd nature of the first but with mixed results. While some appreciate the humor and high-quality sound, others find the lack of story, inconsistent art, and occasional pacing issues to be drawbacks. Overall, it's an enjoyable short series for fans of the genre but may not appeal to everyone.
pros: Good comedy with lots of it
High-quality sound
Beautiful backgrounds
cons: Inconsistent art style
Story is nonexistent
Comedy sometimes misses the mark compared to the first season
Inconsistent pacing, some moments feel like nothing happens

anime.title: THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS
anime.synopsis:
Uzuki Shimamura is an aspiring student who dreams of being an idol. After failing her first audition, a producer from 346 Productions tells Uzuki that she has been chosen for the "Cinderella Project," a new idol group. The project, however, still lacks two other members, so the producer needs to scout suitable candidates.

The producer's eyes fall upon Rin Shibuya, who is in the midst of an incident with an upset crowd. As the imposing producer defends her, the two of them are taken in for interrogation by the police, and released after some explanation. Taking this opportunity, he scouts Rin for the Cinderella Project, only to be rejected. Will the producer be able to find two more members for his idol group?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers appreciating the character-driven stories and accurate portrayal of the idol world, while others criticize the large cast, generic music, and shallow narrative. The series is often compared unfavorably to the original iDOLM@STER, lacking its unique charm and realistic storytelling. Overall, it's considered a decent entry in the idol genre but falls short of being exceptional.
pros: Well-animated performances and costumes.
Accurate depiction of the performance atmosphere and performer emotions.
Exploration of a wide variety of characters and their issues.
cons: Too many characters with uneven development.
Unmemorable and one-dimensional characters.
Generic idol music.
Lack of a resonant or realistic story compared to the original iDOLM@STER.
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture, Character Growth, Backstage Drama

anime.title: Non Non Biyori Repeat
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Far from the hustle and bustle of urban life, and with only a single candy store and bus route to its name, the rural Asahigaoka is certainly not a place for everyone. Nevertheless, the village's children still manage to cheerfully spend their days exploring and having fun in the wilderness around them. One such child, Renge Miyauchi, the youngest of the group, looks forward to the entrance ceremony of the upcoming school year, signalling her entry into first grade and the beginning of her elementary school life. Attending the only school in town, Renge and her friends, seventh grader Natsumi Koshigaya and her eighth grade sister Komari, make the most out of their rural lifestyle, playing and studying everyday.

Meanwhile, fifth grader Hotaru Ichijou has just moved to Asahigaoka from Tokyo, unaware of the numerous adventures and memories that await her.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find 'Non Non Biyori Repeat' to be a heartwarming and relaxing anime that effectively captures the essence of rural life and childhood nostalgia. Many appreciate the beautiful art and the strong connection they feel with the characters, though some note the lack of a strong plot is the biggest con.
pros: Excellent at capturing the beauty and joy of simple, mundane life.
Stunning art, especially the backgrounds, enhances the atmosphere.
Creates a strong bond between characters and audience.
cons: Lacks a significant overarching plot, typical for slice-of-life, but may not appeal to all.
The 'Repeat' concept might be confusing for some viewers.
Some minimal details that I've missed in this new season are the funny quotes like the first season and a faster pace.

anime.title: Wolf Girl & Black Prince
anime.synopsis:
Erika Shinohara has taken to lying about her romantic exploits to earn the respect of her new friends. So when they ask for a picture of her "boyfriend," she hastily snaps a photo of a handsome stranger, whom her friends recognize as the popular and kind-hearted Kyouya Sata.

Trapped in her own web of lies and desperately trying to avoid humiliation, Erika explains her predicament to Kyouya, hoping he will pretend to be her boyfriend. But Kyouya is not the angel he appears to be: he is actually a mean-spirited sadist who forces Erika to become his "dog" in exchange for keeping her secret.

Begrudgingly accepting his deal, Erika soon begins to see glimpses of the real Kyouya beneath the multiple layers of his outer persona. As she finds herself falling for him, she can't help but question if he will ever feel the same way about her. Will Kyouya finally make an honest woman out of Erika, or is she destined to be a "wolf girl" forever?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly negative due to the portrayal of an abusive relationship disguised as romance. Viewers criticize the unlikeable characters, weak plot, and the normalization of harmful dynamics. While some appreciate the art style and comedic aspects, the overwhelming sentiment is that the show is problematic and not worth watching.
pros: Some viewers found the premise unique for a shoujo series.
The art and animation quality were appreciated by some viewers.
Some found the show comedically amusing, especially when accepting the characters' sado-masochistic relationship.
The opening and ending themes were catchy and fitting for some viewers.
cons: The characters, especially Erika and Kyouya, are widely considered annoying and unlikeable.
The show normalizes and romanticizes abusive relationships, raising concerns about its message.
The plot is generic, predictable, and relies on tired shoujo tropes.
The story lacks depth and has pacing issues, with episodes skipping significant amounts of time.
The male lead is a cruel and sadistic character who abuses the female lead, which many found disturbing and unfunny.
The female lead is weak-willed and allows herself to be mistreated, which some viewers found pathetic and frustrating.
anime.thematic_vibe: Abusive Relationship, High School, Stockholm Syndrome

anime.title: The Garden of Sinners: Manner Movies
anime.synopsis: Seven cinema intros that were shown with the seven movies of Kara no Kyoukai and included as a bonus with the Blu-ray/DVD release.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds these manner movies surprisingly enjoyable and charming, defying the typical boring nature of the genre. The stop-motion animation, humor, and character appeal are highlighted as major strengths. While some find the sound work lacking, the overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, leading to a call for a more favorable perception of these shorts.
pros: Adorable characters
Funny and engaging
Creative stop-motion animation
Actual action scenes
cons: Sound work could be better

anime.title: Toradora! Recap
anime.synopsis: Recap OVA of the Toradora series included as a bonus with limited edition of Choudokyuu Premium Box release of PSP game Toradora! Portable.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views Toradora! Recap as a purely functional bonus feature that successfully summarizes the original series for viewers needing a refresher. However, it is widely considered dispensable and unnecessary for those already familiar with the story, as it offers no new content or significant new perspectives.
pros: Serves as a functional recap of the original series, covering important events.
Pacing is generally good, focusing on essential plot points.
cons: Lacks new content or significant additions for those who have already seen the series.
Suffers from a lack of English subtitles, making it inaccessible to a wider audience.
Does not add new perspectives or character development, making it dispensable.

anime.title: Strike Witches: Operation Victory Arrow
anime.synopsis: Operation Victory Arrow is set in the period between the end of Operation Mars in the second television series and the 2012 Strike Witches movie. The three 30-minute short stories depict the lives of the members who returned to their respective homes.
anime.consensus_summary: The Operation Victory Arrow OVA is a welcome addition for fans of the Strike Witches series, offering a glimpse into the lives of various characters between the second season and the movie. While the animation maintains the series' style, some inconsistencies are noted. The focus on character moments and smaller skirmishes provides a more relaxed viewing experience compared to the main series.
pros: Good to see characters that aren't always focused on.
Links directly after season 2 and before the movie, creating a cohesive narrative.
Consistent art style with vibrant scenery and nice sky scenes.
cons: Background art is inconsistent in quality.
Many Witches aren't featured in the OVA.
Peaceful exposition may not appeal to those seeking action.

anime.title: The Seven Deadly Sins
anime.synopsis:
In a world similar to the European Middle Ages, the feared yet revered Holy Knights of Britannia use immensely powerful magic to protect the region of Britannia and its kingdoms. However, a small subset of the Knights supposedly betrayed their homeland and turned their blades against their comrades in an attempt to overthrow the ruler of Liones. They were defeated by the Holy Knights, but rumors continued to persist that these legendary knights, called the "Seven Deadly Sins," were still alive. Ten years later, the Holy Knights themselves staged a coup d’état, and thus became the new, tyrannical rulers of the Kingdom of Liones.

Based on the best-selling manga series of the same name, Nanatsu no Taizai follows the adventures of Elizabeth, the third princess of the Kingdom of Liones, and her search for the Seven Deadly Sins. With their help, she endeavors to not only take back her kingdom from the Holy Knights, but to also seek justice in an unjust world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed, with some praising the characters, adventure, and fight scenes, while others criticize the generic story, excessive fanservice, and animation quality. There is a divide on whether the series successfully breaks the shonen mold or falls victim to its cliches. The main character's perverted behavior is a common point of contention.
pros: Enjoyable and easy to follow story.
Interesting characters with unique personalities.
Action-packed battles with a sense of balance between overpowered characters.
cons: Generic shonen story with cliches.
Mediocre and linear plot.
Pointless fanservice and cringe dialogue.
Poor animation and character design.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Crimson Bow and Arrow
anime.romaji_title: Shingeki no Kyojin Movie 1: Guren no Yumiya
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Recap of episodes 1-13.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is split regarding the film's value as a recap. While the animation and music are consistently praised, many feel that crucial character development and narrative depth were sacrificed due to excessive scene-cutting and rushed pacing. Existing fans might enjoy it as a refresher, but newcomers are likely to be left with more questions than answers.
pros: Exceptional animation and art quality, consistent with the anime series.
Compelling and epic music that enhances the viewing experience.
Provides a good, albeit fast-paced, overview of the story for existing fans.
Satisfying action sequences that retain the show's excitement.
cons: Significant cuts to character development and important backstory scenes, making it difficult for newcomers to follow.
Pacing is too rushed, leading to a lack of emotional weight and abrupt transitions.
Feels like a cash grab for fans rather than a standalone piece of cinema.
The movie relies heavily on recycled clips from the anime, lacking original animation.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Wings of Freedom
anime.romaji_title: Shingeki no Kyojin Movie 2: Jiyuu no Tsubasa
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Recap of episodes 14-25.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is seen as a rushed and emotionally underwhelming recap of the original series. While some appreciate the animation and nostalgia, most viewers find it inferior to watching the show itself. The pacing is criticized for not allowing emotional weight to settle, making key moments feel insignificant.
pros: Good animation quality.
Nostalgic soundtrack for fans of season one.
Serves as a quick recap of the second half of the first season.
cons: Poor pacing due to cramming many episodes into a short time frame.
Important narrative moments and intense scenes lack emotional impact.
Recycled content from the original show.
Unnecessary as it's better to watch the actual show.
Story beats are practically nonexistent.

anime.title: Hi☆sCoool! SeHa Girls
anime.synopsis: The story of the anime will revolve around Dreamcast, Sega Saturn, and Mega Drive, who have just enrolled in SeHaGaga Academy at Tokyo's Haneda Ōtorii station. They are given an assignment needed to graduate by a suspicious teacher, and to clear this assignment, the girls need to enter the world of Sega games. The girls must try their best to graduate without incident.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is mixed. Sega fans appreciate the nostalgic references and cute character designs, finding it a lighthearted and enjoyable experience. However, others find the show's low budget animation, repetitive humor, and reliance on niche knowledge to be detrimental. The show is ultimately seen as a niche product for die-hard Sega enthusiasts.
pros: Nostalgic references to classic Sega games and hardware.
Cute character designs based on Sega consoles.
Lighthearted and entertaining for Sega fans.
cons: Low budget animation and simplistic art style.
Repetitive humor and one-dimensional characters.
Reliance on niche Sega knowledge alienates wider audiences.
Blatant product placement for modern Sega games disrupts the nostalgic theme.

anime.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO!
anime.romaji_title: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru. Zoku
anime.synopsis:
With the Volunteer Service Club now firmly established, it is receiving more requests from students in search of solutions to their various issues. However, the club members often struggle to see eye to eye when it comes to their problem-solving ideals. The suggestions that Hachiman Hikigaya recommends frequently clash with those of Yukino Yukinoshita, fracturing the relationships within the club. 

Despite their differences, with the trio constantly trying to find common ground, they may soon reach a point where they discover something genuine.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is heavily divided regarding the second season. Some appreciate the deeper exploration of character flaws and social commentary, while others find it a disappointing departure from the first season's comedic and lighthearted tone. The change in studio and art style is a point of contention, with many feeling the second season lacks the charm of the original.
pros: Balances drama, comedy, and romance effectively.
Social commentary and analysis provide unique dynamics.
Relatable characters with flaws and redeeming qualities.
cons: Significant drop in comedy compared to the first season.
Plot moves at a slow pace with little progression.
Characters, especially Yui and Yukino, lack development.
Vague writing and underdeveloped love interests.
Change in art style to more generic aesthetic.
anime.thematic_vibe: Deconstruction of RomCom, Social Commentary, Emotional Melodrama

anime.title: Magimoji Rurumo
anime.synopsis:
After an unfortunate accident, completely normal heterosexual high school student Kouta Shibaki is branded as the school pervert. With girls avoiding Kouta like the plague, truly the young man's worst nightmare has come to fruition! One day in the school library, he stumbles upon a peculiar book said to possess the power to summon witches. Partly out of desperation, partly out of boredom, Kouta decides to play along with the joke of a book, until an apprentice witch going by the name of Rurumo Maji Mojiruka appears before him. In an unusual turn of events, Kouta ends up helping Rurumo with some general witchery tasks in exchange for his soul being spared.

Majimoji Rurumo follows the misadventures of Rurumo as she attempts to persuade Kouta to use 666 magical wish-granting tickets in her efforts to become a fully-fledged witch, unaware that every time she grants a wish, Kouta's life is shortened. Aided by Rurumo's familiar Chiro, Kouta must decide between helping Rurumo or saving his own life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is that Majimoji Rurumo is a generally enjoyable, albeit flawed, anime. It's praised for its cute and funny moments, particularly the relationship between the main characters. However, it is criticized for its weak plot, reliance on tropes, and mediocre production quality, resulting in a fairly average experience.
pros: Character development between Kouta and Rurumo is endearing.
Enjoyable and relaxing series with a soft tone.
Music is soothing and creates a good atmosphere.
cons: Weak plot with a lack of defined objective.
Pacing issues and forgettable characters.
Overused perverted tropes and cliche scenarios.
Mediocre art and animation quality.
Inconsistent character depth beyond main duo.

anime.title: Lance N' Masques
anime.synopsis:
Eight words describe the feelings of Youtarou Hanabusa: "I just want to live a normal life." Unfortunately for him, as a member of the Knights of the World, his training in this ancient and international order has left him with a condition he calls "White Knight Syndrome." This condition causes Youtarou to instinctively act heroically and chivalrously whenever he encounters someone in danger.

To protect his identity in such embarrassing moments, he carries a mask with him at all times. Then one day, he saves the life of Makio Kidouin, the young daughter of an elite and affluent family. Little does he know that this singular act of heroism will change his life forever. Soon, he is simultaneously blessed with a life in the lap of luxury and cursed with one of abnormality, for his new friend Makio lives a life far removed from the everyday.

Between coping with the hijinks of six-year-old Makio, and dealing with a cast of odd friends and scheming enemies, Youtarou must protect his new friend while keeping his identity hidden as the masked hero Knight Lancer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Lance N' Masques is largely negative, with many criticizing the weak plot, poor character development, and unusual art style. Some viewers found enjoyment in the characters and music, appreciating it as light entertainment. However, the repetitive plot and underdeveloped characters were significant detractors for most, resulting in a generally unfavorable consensus.
pros: Some found the characters charming and enjoyable.
Music, particularly the opening and ending themes, was a highlight for some viewers.
A few viewers appreciated it as light entertainment suitable for a younger audience or those with a childlike sensibility.
cons: Plot is weak, repetitive, and often nonsensical with frequent kidnapping scenarios.
Character development is lacking, with characters being cookie-cutter and underdeveloped.
Art style is unusual and can be off-putting, especially the character designs (wide faces, odd noses).
Many found the story simplistic, uninteresting, and lacking an overarching goal.
Pacing is jumbled, with fights poorly directed and interrupted by boring conversations.

anime.title: Shijou Saikyou no Deshi Kenichi Specials
anime.romaji_title: Shijou Saikyou no Deshi Kenichi Specials
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Martial Arts, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
A brief summary of Kenichi's new life at Ryouzanpaku. 

Included as a bonus on the DVD volumes of the Shijou Saikyou no Deshi Kenichi OVA.
anime.consensus_summary: The Shijou Saikyou no Deshi Kenichi Specials are considered bonus content of low value. The content is repetitive, with uneven character focus and an irrelevant episode. Overall, it is recommended only for die-hard fans with low expectations.
cons: Repetitive content
Uneven character focus
Irrelevant episode unrelated to main story
anime.thematic_vibe: Fan Service, Bonus Content, Irrelevant Content

anime.title: Denki-gai
anime.synopsis: Umio is a shy kid who just started his part time job at a manga store smack dab in the middle of the city. But his lifestyle isn't as glamorous as the neon lights that illuminate the city. Umio's closest friends are his co-workers who are all unique characters, to say the least, and although they're nice people, they have their quirks. They are a tight knit group of friends, have nicknames for each other and spend their weekends inside, sheltered from the extravagant scene happening on the outside.
anime.consensus_summary: Denki-gai no Honya-san is a lighthearted and humorous slice-of-life anime that is enjoyed by fans of otaku culture. While the show lacks a strong central plot, its strength lies in its quirky and relatable characters and their everyday interactions. The series is praised for its easy-to-watch format and relaxing comedy, but some viewers were left wanting more in terms of plot development and romantic resolutions.
pros: Enjoyable and relatable characters with unique personalities.
Lighthearted humor suitable for relaxation.
Colorful and lively animation style.
Episodic format makes it easy to watch without needing to recall previous events.
cons: Lack of a strong overarching plot.
Repetitive jokes in some instances.
Unresolved romantic tensions and lack of character pairing.
Superficial character development.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Comedy, Otaku Culture

anime.title: selector spread WIXOSS
anime.genres: High Stakes Game, Psychological, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
The unforeseen outcome of Iona Urazoe's fan gathering continues to weigh heavily on Ruuko Kominato. Having uncovered the truth behind being a Selector, Ruuko and her friends Yuzuki Kurebayashi and Hitoe Uemura hesitate to partake in the battles that may ruin the lives they have come to cherish. The same cannot be said for Chiyori, a fellow Selector who remains oblivious to the consequences of losing despite all warnings. As she tries to convince Chiyori out of her cruel fate, Ruuko learns more about a WIXOSS novel—which may reveal the secrets of LRIGs and the Selector battles' very existence.

Meanwhile, Akira Aoi and her model career have rebounded thanks to Iona, who is now possessed by Ulith. With her life back on track, Akira pledges to assist Ulith in any way she can. Unbeknownst to her, Ulith is scheming to utilize a familiar LRIG to not only torment Ruuko but also prevent the latter's wish from ever being fulfilled.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the improved storytelling and deeper themes compared to the first season. However, criticisms include similarities to other anime, inconsistent character development and plot holes. While some find it thought-provoking, others feel it deviates too much from the card game aspect.
pros: Improved storytelling compared to the first season.
Deeper exploration of characters and the world of WIXOSS.
Thought-provoking themes and commentary on the genre.
cons: Strong similarities to Madoka Magica.
Inconsistent character development.
Some plot elements violate established ghost story rules.
anime.thematic_vibe: Psychological, Dark Fantasy, Card Game Deconstruction

anime.title: gdgd Fairies Movie: tte Iu Eiga wa Dou kana...?
anime.romaji_title: gdgd Fairies Movie: tte Iu Eiga wa Dou kana...?
anime.synopsis: Movie of gdgd Fairies.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is appreciated by fans of the TV series for its humor and references. It expands on the established lore in an ambitious way, though some may find the absurdity difficult to follow. The CGI is a notable drawback.
pros: Combines the best of both seasons of the TV series.
Smart and witty humor.
Numerous pop culture references.
Ambitious use of lore in a high fantasy setting.
cons: Absurdity can be difficult to follow (even for the translator).
Dreadful CGI

anime.title: Persona 4 the Golden Animation
anime.genres: Adventure, Mystery, School, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Spring. Far from the city, time flows peacefully in this rural town. As the cherry blossoms scatter in the wind, a young man named Yu Narukami steps off the train at Yasoinaba Station. Yu has come to this town, where his uncle lives, for family reasons; he will be transferring into the local high school, Yasogami High. And so begins his school life... The shopping mall after school. A series of murders taking place in town. The Midnight Channel, airing late at night.... What lies in store for Yu and his friends ‘this time around?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with strong opinions on both sides. Fans of the Persona 4 game and original anime who appreciate extra content and Marie's story tend to enjoy it. However, many find the adaptation unnecessary, poorly paced, and confusing, especially if they are not already familiar with the source material. Marie's character is a particularly divisive element.
pros: Faithful recreation of key scenes from the game.
Addition of Adachi's backstory is well-received.
Enjoyable for fans of the game and original anime as extra content.
Visually appealing animation style.
Humor is well translated from the source material.
cons: Poor pacing and rushed development due to trying to fit too much content.
Unnecessary unless the viewer is familiar with the game and original anime.
Over-emphasis on Marie at the expense of other characters.
Marie's character is often considered unlikable or poorly executed.
Assumes prior knowledge of the Persona 4 world, leading to confusion for newcomers.
Inconsistent art and animation quality.
Story feels disjointed and not well explained.
Feels like a cash-grab or overmilking of the Persona 4 franchise.

anime.title: Going Wild
anime.synopsis: Three monkey brothers from the from an urban city go to live in the countryside. There's no convenience store nor arcades there; truly bare-bones. The story follows their daily lives trying to make friends and have fun amongst the villagers.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Patta Potta Monta' with fondness, often recalling childhood memories. Its unique characters, quirky plots, and subtle moral lessons are appreciated, though it is clearly targeted toward a younger audience. The show's charm and the brotherly dynamic between the main characters contribute to its enduring appeal.
pros: Unique characters
Interesting music
Subtle moral messages
Charming brotherly relationship
cons: Target demographic is clearly children

anime.title: Hashi no Mukou
anime.synopsis: There are old stories of children disappearing by the river's edge. This has haunted Otoha ever since her friend Jiro disappeared  when she was seven years old and now she is back in her hometown covering the war between the government and the dissidents. When she gets separated from the squad, Otoha thinks someone seems to be leading her deeper into the back alleys of the town.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime has a strong ending but suffers from a confusing plot structure, particularly with its handling of character backstories. The visual presentation is marred by distracting artistic choices. Overall, the reviewer found the anime to be average.
pros: Killer ending
Good audio quality
cons: Confusing plot with back-and-forth timelines
Rushed backstory for the main character
Limited and/or confusing backstories for other characters
Obstructive multicolored fog in the art

anime.title: Anti-Magic Academy: The 35th Test Platoon
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Military, Romance, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
In a world plagued by magical dangers and threats, there exist special warriors—known as Inquisitors—who are tasked with non-violently preventing these threats and nefarious actions. The Anti-Magic Academy is a specialized school built to educate and train these Inquisitors, which splits its students into small squads in order to train them to work together. Among these talented squads is the 35th Test Platoon, also known as the "Small Fry Platoon" due to its low ranking and incompetent members. 

However, everything changes when Ouka Ootori, a powerful yet rebellious former Inquisitor, is forced into joining due to her tendency to break rules and committing a serious violation: the killing of a witch. Tempers flare upon her arrival, as she clashes with their clumsy captain Takeru Kusanagi and argues with the rest of the squad over her views on witches. This eclectic group has a long way to go if they wish to succeed and climb the ranks at the Anti-Magic Academy: they must first set aside their differences and come to work together as a team.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative, citing a rushed and poorly executed adaptation of the light novels. While some viewers found the initial premise and character designs appealing, the pervasive harem tropes, weak character development, and generic animation led to overall disappointment. Many felt the series failed to live up to its potential and became just another forgettable entry in the action-harem genre.
pros: Some found the initial premise interesting.
A few reviewers enjoyed the character designs and personalities despite the cliches.
The opening and ending themes were considered catchy by some.
cons: Rushed pacing and poor adaptation of the light novel content.
Weak character development and shallow storytelling.
Overused harem tropes and forced fan service.
Generic and uninspired animation, particularly the CGI.

anime.title: Nobunaga Concerto
anime.genres: Comedy, Historical, Romance, Shounen, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
"Who cares about what happened in Japan's past? It has nothing to do with my life."

With these words, carefree high school student Saburou finds himself unceremoniously thrown back in time to the Sengoku Era, landing directly in front of the legendary general Nobunaga Oda. Nobunaga, on the run from his retainers and wishing to rest due to his frailty, beseeches Saburou to take his place, as the two bear an uncanny resemblance. Although Saburou is still confused by his surroundings, Nobunaga hurriedly provides the boy with the necessary items to prove that he is the bona fide feudal lord and makes a hasty getaway.

Now a stand-in for someone he doesn't even know all that much about—though his modern experiences and knowledge are sure to help him—Saburou begins his unexpected quest to pose as the man who attempted to unite all of Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, with many praising the unique story and characters, but some are turned off by the animation style. Despite initial reservations, viewers often find themselves engrossed in the plot and emotionally invested. There's a strong desire for a second season to complete the narrative.
pros: Unique take on historical events with a time-traveling protagonist.
Well-developed characters that viewers grow to care about.
Excellent storytelling that blends comedy and drama effectively.
Faithful to historical facts with interesting depiction of war tactics.
Amazing and beautiful sound directions.
cons: The animation style (CGI) is initially off-putting to many viewers.
Limited action sequences may disappoint viewers seeking intense battles.
Incomplete story due to the lack of a second season.
Focuses less on battle strategies, which history buffs may want to see more.
May not be as historically accurate or in-depth as some viewers expect.

anime.title: Blue Spring Ride OVA
anime.synopsis:
Unwritten
Junior high student Futaba Yoshioka has always despised boys—she thinks they are all way too rowdy and annoying. The only exception is a boy in the class next to hers, Kou Tanaka, who seems different from the others. Through frequent encounters, Futaba and Kou exchange shy glances and awkward words with one another. Having had no experience in romance prior, Futaba has no idea what her growing feelings for Kou are supposed to imply.

Page.13
During their second year of high school, Futaba and her friends go to a summer festival together. While the other girls decide not to wear yukatas, Yuuri Makita does as she is determined to get closer to Kou. Caught off guard, Futaba can only watch from afar as Yuuri and Kou seem to grow more and more intimate. At this rate, will Futaba be able to make progress with Kou?
anime.consensus_summary: The Ao Haru Ride OVA is generally well-received as a supplement to the main series. It provides some closure but also introduces new cliffhangers, potentially frustrating viewers hoping for a complete resolution. Most appreciate the consistent animation and sound design.
pros: Wraps up the main story well
Faithful to the original series in animation and sound
Answers questions left from season 1
cons: Plot goes in circles
Doesn't provide a satisfying conclusion
Ends with a cliffhanger

anime.title: Mushibugyou OVA
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Samurai, Shounen
anime.synopsis: OVAs bundled with the 15-17th volumes of the Mushibugyou manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The Mushibugyou OVA is generally considered boring and uninspired. Viewers find the side stories uneventful and the humor repetitive. The overall experience lacks the excitement and adventure expected from the series.
cons: Boring side stories with no progress.
Unoriginal and tiresome pervert humor.
Lack of excitement and adventure.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fan Service, Slice of Life, Humor

anime.title: Merman in my Tub
anime.synopsis:
On his way home from school, Tatsumi sees a man collapsed near a lake. When he approaches him, Tatsumi notices something strange: the person in need of help is actually a beautiful merman named Wakasa! Because Wakasa's home has become too polluted to live in, Tatsumi graciously offers his bathtub as a refuge.

With a boisterous merman as his new roommate, Tatsumi's normal life won't be returning anytime soon, not to mention Wakasa's aquatic friends—Takasu, Mikuni, and Maki—often show up uninvited, making them all quite a handful for the high school student. As he humors their curiosity for human life, Tatsumi sometimes finds himself enjoying their childish antics, but he will have to keep his cool if he intends to keep up with his daily life and newfound friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Orenchi no Furo Jijou' is well-received as a short and sweet anime with charming characters and light-hearted humor. The unique premise and execution of the short episode format are praised. However, the simple story and alleged queerbaiting leave some viewers wanting more depth and resolution.
pros: Charming and unique characters with great voice acting.
Well-executed short episode format, maximizing enjoyment.
Wholesome and sweet interactions between characters.
Art style suits the light-hearted theme.
cons: Story is simple and not plot-intensive.
Some repetitive elements in later episodes.
Queerbaiting allegations due to the lack of romantic development despite suggestive content.
Ugly opening song

anime.title: Nisekoi OVA
anime.synopsis:
1. Funshitsu / Miko-san
2. Oshigoto / Henbou
3. Sentou / Service
anime.consensus_summary: The Nisekoi OVA is generally well-received by fans of the series, especially those who enjoy the romantic comedy and harem elements. While some appreciate the character development and art details, others find it lacking in story progression and overly reliant on fan service. The ending of the series appears controversial, leading some viewers to abandon it altogether.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the series
Focuses on character development
Good art details

Fan-service heavy

anime.title: Chaika -The Coffin Princess- Avenging Battle
anime.synopsis: The search for the remains of Emperor Gaz continues. Chaika still in search of knowing who she really is and what her purpose is. Similarly, the Red Chaika continues the search for the rest of Emperor Gaz's remains. The Gillette corporation continues the mission to catch every last Chaika. In their adventure they give a revealing account kept secret by the Emperor, which Chaika, Fredrica, Toru, and Akari decide to uncover.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Hitsugi no Chaika is a mixed bag, with some viewers appreciating the resolution of mysteries and exciting action sequences. However, many felt the plot was rushed due to the limited number of episodes, leading to underdeveloped characters and plot holes. Despite its flaws, many viewers found the season enjoyable, especially if they were invested in the characters and world from the first season.

anime.title: Chaika: The Coffin Princess OVA
anime.romaji_title: Hitsugi no Chaika: Nerawareta Hitsugi/Yomigaeru Iseki
anime.synopsis: Unaired anime-original OVA bundled with 12th volume of the Hitsugi no Chaika novel.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted and humorous addition to the series, reminiscent of the first season's tone. While enjoyable for fans seeking more character interactions and comedy, it lacks a substantial plot and feels disconnected from the main storyline. Overall, it serves as a pleasant, albeit inconsequential, epilogue.
pros: Faithful to the spirit of Season 1.
Humorous and fun character interactions.
Provides closure and a lighthearted epilogue to the series.
cons: Lacks a meaningful story or plot relevance.
Feels half-hearted and unnecessary.
OVA story is not fleshed out.

anime.title: Yowamushi Pedal: Grande Road
anime.synopsis: Second season of the Yowamushi Pedal series.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the show's ability to make cycling exciting and its focus on character development and themes of perseverance. However, some find the show repetitive with excessive flashbacks and overdramatization. There is disagreement on the quality compared to the first season, resulting in a moderate level of polarization.
pros: Well-developed characters that viewers care about.
Exciting racing scenes and plot twists.
Inspiring themes of perseverance and teamwork.
Successfully makes cycling exciting to watch.
cons: Excessive flashbacks that slow down the story.
Repetitive elements and lack of character development in some opinions.
Overdramatization of racing aspects.
Repetitive music tracks.

anime.title: Inazuma Eleven: Chou Jigen Dream Match
anime.romaji_title: Inazuma Eleven: Chou Jigen Dream Match
anime.synopsis: A new movie featuring a match between fan-voted members of the Inazuma Best Eleven team and the special Battle Eleven team.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, leaning towards negative. Die-hard fans who appreciate fan service and character interactions may find some enjoyment, but most viewers are disappointed by the weak plot, poor animation, and lack of narrative depth. The film fails to live up to expectations as a commemorative piece for the series.
pros: Enjoyable for hardcore fans of specific characters.
Appreciation of favorite characters' special techniques.
Nostalgia for OG Raimon and Royal teams.
cons: Poor plot and writing, lacking a coherent story.
Lazy animation and average art quality.
Unexplained character appearances from various timelines.
Disappointing as a 5th-anniversary celebration.

anime.title: Tonari no Seki-kun Specials
anime.synopsis:
Two unaired episodes included in the DVD Set release of Tonari no Seki-kun series.

#1. Field Trip (Rinkan Gakkou) (first volume)
#2. Snow Playing (Yuki Asobi) (second volume)
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Tonari no Seki-kun Specials' are generally well-received, with viewers appreciating the extended episode length and deeper character interactions. While some find the humor repetitive, the specials are considered a high point of the series, offering more story and development. The audience generally enjoys the dynamic between Yokoi and Seki, especially when Yokoi opposes Seki's antics.
pros: Exploration of character dynamics between Yokoi and Seki-kun.
Specials provide more story and depth compared to regular episodes.
Humorous situations and jokes, especially in the 'Snow Playing' episode.
cons: Humor can get old or repetitive at times.
First episode (Field Trip) is considered weaker than the second.
Jokes aren't consistently funny.

anime.title: World Trigger
anime.synopsis:
When a gate to another world suddenly opens on Earth, Mikado City is invaded by strange creatures known as "Neighbors," malicious beings impervious to traditional weaponry. In response to their arrival, an organization called the Border Defense Agency has been established to combat the Neighbor menace through special weapons called "Triggers." Even though several years have passed after the gate first opened, Neighbors are still a threat and members of Border remain on guard to ensure the safety of the planet.

Despite this delicate situation, members-in-training, such as Osamu Mikumo, are not permitted to use their Triggers outside of headquarters. But when the mysterious new student in his class is dragged into a forbidden area by bullies, they are attacked by Neighbors, and Osamu has no choice but to do what he believes is right. Much to his surprise, however, the transfer student Yuuma Kuga makes short work of the aliens, revealing that he is a humanoid Neighbor in disguise.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. While some appreciate the strategic depth, world-building, and unique power system, others are critical of the animation quality, inconsistent plot elements, and slow pacing.  There's a sense that the series has unrealized potential, leading to both strong praise and disappointment.
pros: Well-developed world and power system (Triggers)
Focus on strategy over brute force in battles
Interesting and lovable characters
Realistic and believable progression
cons: Inconsistent world logic and plot
Mediocre animation, especially in the first season
Slow pacing, story stretched thin
Protagonist's slow progress can be frustrating

anime.title: Kuroko's Basketball 3
anime.synopsis:
Seirin prepares to face major obstacles on their path to winning the Winter Cup, including the teams each possessing a member of the Generation of Miracles. Kuroko goes head-to-head with his old teammates once more as he attempts to show them that individual skill is not the only way to play basketball. His firm belief that his form of basketball, team play, is the right way to play the sport will clash with the talents of a perfect copy and an absolute authority.

While Kuroko tries to prove that his basketball is "right," he and the rest of Seirin High ultimately have one goal: to win the Winter Cup and overcome the strength of the Generation of Miracles, who have long dominated the scene of middle and high school basketball.
anime.consensus_summary: The final season of Kuroko no Basket is a mixed bag for viewers. Many fans enjoy the exciting matches, character development, and high-quality animation and sound, but some find the plot predictable and repetitive, with overpowered abilities that detract from the realism. While the ending is satisfying for some, others feel it was rushed, leading to a moderately polarized audience.
pros: Exciting matches with satisfying conclusions
Character development, especially Akashi's backstory
Amazing visuals and animation, particularly during games
Soundtrack and voice acting enhance the intensity and emotions
cons: Predictable plot and repetitive game structure
Overpowered abilities and unrealistic basketball depictions
Inconsistent character development in season 3
Ending felt rushed or unsatisfying for some viewers

anime.title: Blood Blockade Battlefront
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Shounen, Super Power, Urban Fantasy, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Supersonic monkeys, vampires, talking fishmen, and all sorts of different supernatural monsters living alongside humans—this has been part of daily life in Hellsalem's Lot, formerly known as New York City, for some time now. When a gateway between Earth and the Beyond opened three years ago, New Yorkers and creatures from the other dimension alike were trapped in an impenetrable bubble and were forced to live together. Libra is a secret organization composed of eccentrics and superhumans, tasked with keeping order in the city and making sure that chaos doesn't spread to the rest of the world.

Pursuing photography as a hobby, Leonardo Watch is living a normal life with his parents and sister. But when he obtains the "All-seeing Eyes of the Gods" at the expense of his sister's eyesight, he goes to Hellsalem's Lot in order to help her by finding answers about the mysterious powers he received. He soon runs into Libra, and when Leo unexpectedly joins their ranks, he gets more than what he bargained for. Kekkai Sensen follows Leo's misadventures in the strangest place on Earth with his equally strange comrades—as the ordinary boy unwittingly sees his life take a turn for the extraordinary.
anime.consensus_summary: Kekkai Sensen is visually impressive and features a unique world and engaging characters, but the confusing plot and episodic structure divide audiences. Some find the lack of a strong central narrative frustrating, while others appreciate the fun, chaotic energy. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on prioritizing style and world-building over a coherent story.
pros: Visually stunning animation by Studio Bones
Unique and creative world-building
Memorable and quirky characters
Catchy and well-produced soundtrack
Fast-paced and dynamic direction
cons: Inconsistent and confusing plot
Episodic format with weak overarching narrative
Underdeveloped main character
Lack of clear explanations for powers and world mechanics
Pacing issues, especially in later episodes

anime.title: Lord Marksman and Vanadis
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Military
anime.synopsis:
In a fantasy version of Europe, a war between enemy countries is brewing. One of these countries, Zhcted, has its seven regions ruled by War Maidens, known as Vanadis. Equipped with powerful dragon-carved weapons, Eleonora "Elen" Viltaria, one of the Vanadis, launches an invasion against their neighboring rival country of Brune. Eventually, Tigrevurmud "Tigre" Vorn, a young archer and an earl for Brune's region of Alsace, has his entire army decimated at Elen's hands. In a strange twist of events, Elen spares Tigre, and gives him the order, "Become mine!" What could be the meaning behind this new alliance?

Adapted from the light novel written by Tsukasa Kawaguchi, Madan no Ou to Vanadis is an epic adventure filled with complex war tactics and beautiful women. Trapped in a multinational conflict, Tigre and Elen are swept up in a war filled with dark secrets, conspiracies, and corruption.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided, with some appreciating the action and fantasy elements while others criticize the rushed plot and shallow characters. Many light novel readers were disappointed by the anime adaptation. The series is seen as a passable but ultimately unremarkable entry in the medieval fantasy genre.
pros: Good art style and animation quality.
Enjoyable for fans of strategy and medieval war settings.
Archer protagonist is a refreshing change.
cons: Rushed adaptation from the light novels, leading to a lack of depth.
Generic and predictable storyline.
Poor world-building and lack of character development.
Ecchi/harem elements feel tacked on and detract from the story.

anime.title: Tales of Zestiria: Dawn of the Shepherd
anime.romaji_title: Tales of Zestiria: Doushi no Yoake
anime.synopsis: TV anime special of Bandai Namco Games' Tales of Zestiria role-playing game.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the visual presentation and its effectiveness as a primer for the Tales of Zestiria game. However, some find the story lacking substance and feeling incomplete without the context of the game. The series successfully introduces the world and characters, generating interest for the game.
pros: Appealing backdrops and well-drawn characters (Ufotable art style).
Good introduction to the world and characters of the Tales of Zestiria game.
Successfully generates interest in the main characters and setting.
cons: Story feels incomplete as a standalone episode.
Not much happens within the episode's timeframe.
Relies heavily on prior knowledge of the game.

anime.title: Buddy Complex: Into the Skies of Tomorrow
anime.romaji_title: Buddy Complex: Kanketsu-hen - Ano Sora ni Kaeru Mirai de
anime.synopsis: The two part finale of Buddy Complex television series deals with the final battle between the Free Treaty Alliance and the space division of Zogiria, lead by an elderly Bizon, as Earth and time itself hang in the balance.
anime.consensus_summary: The finale attempts to resolve the initial series' plotlines but suffers from rushed pacing and underdeveloped elements. While some appreciate the thematic depth and mecha action, others find the plot convoluted and emotionally lacking. The ending is generally considered a mixed bag, leaving viewers with unresolved feelings about the execution.
pros: Ties up some unanswered questions from the first series.
The series introduces intriguing technologies.
Good if you like quantum physics and the space-time continuum.
cons: The story is rushed.
Pacing issues, new elements introduced too quickly.
New technologies introduced feel like deus ex machina.
Too many character deaths without enough emotional weight given to it.
Generic elements overshadow unique ideas.

anime.title: The Comic Artist and His Assistants Specials
anime.romaji_title: Mangaka-san to Assistant-san to The Animation Specials
anime.synopsis: Specials released with the Blu-ray/DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is positive, especially for fans of the original series. Viewers appreciate the continuation of the humor and characters, although some note the lack of significant story development. The specials are recommended for those seeking short, lighthearted entertainment.
pros: Continuation of the original show's humor and feel.
Focus on other characters besides Aito.
Enjoyable and funny despite the short episode length.
cons: No significant story development or overarching plot.
Episodes are very short (6-12 minutes).
Relies heavily on the viewer's enjoyment of the original series.

anime.title: Persona 3 the Movie: #3 Falling Down
anime.synopsis:
As the fall season nears its end, Chidori Yoshino, a member of Strega, abducts Junpei Iori. Meanwhile, Makoto Yuuki and the Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad (SEES) annihilate the Arcana Hanged Man. Soon after, a mysterious playboy named Ryouji Mochizuki transfers into Gekkoukan High School's Class 2-F.

Supposedly having achieved their goal, the members of SEES believe they are free from the battle that has ruthlessly stolen away the lives of their loved ones. And yet, Tartarus and the Dark Hour continue to exist, undeterred by the extermination of the twelfth Shadow. Distraught by their apparent failure, SEES must cope with their personal struggles and discover whose sake they fight for. As Makoto and Junpei's journeys of self-discovery progress, Ryouji's identity and the reason behind Aegis's hate for him become clear.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the movie's thematic depth and character exploration, others are disappointed by the rushed storytelling, pacing issues, and changes from the game. There's a sense that the movie captures the essence of Persona 3 but falls short in execution for some viewers.
pros: Faithful exploration of Makoto's character and internal struggles.
Captures the essence of the game's resonating themes.
Effective portrayal of Makoto's depression and the significance of bonds.
Good development of the love relationship between Chidori and Junpei.
cons: Storytelling feels rushed and disjointed, making it hard to follow.
Key character moments are delayed, diminishing their impact.
Some changes from the game are disappointing to fans.
Pacing issues with jarring transitions between scenes.

anime.title: Yo-kai Watch the Movie: It's the Secret of Birth, Meow!
anime.romaji_title: Youkai Watch Movie 1: Tanjou no Himitsu da Nyan!
anime.synopsis: The movie will feature special guests such as popular familiar characters from the TV anime series and the latest Youkai from the upcoming Youkai Watch 2 sequel games.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the movie, especially fans of the Yo-Kai Watch franchise. It's praised for its animation, story, and humor, appealing to both children and adults. Some viewers may see it as derivative, but overall, the movie is considered a fun and engaging experience.
pros: Great animation
Good story with a new spin on familiar ideas
Enjoyable for both younger and older audiences
cons: Perceived as a Pokemon imitator
May not be taken seriously due to its target audience

anime.title: Gundam Build Fighters Try
anime.synopsis: The story of Gundam Build Fighters Try is set 7 years after the end of the 1st series. Now Seiho Academy's Gunpla Battle Club has only one member, Hoshino Fumina, who is a third grade student in junior high. As the president of the club, she needs two more members to participate in the upcoming All-Japan Gunpla Battle Championships. One day she encounters a transfer student named Kamiki Sekai, who has traveled around for Kenpo training with his master. Then joining by a young Gunpla builder Kousaka Yuuma, their challenge to the Gunpla Battle begins....
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many feeling it doesn't live up to the original Gundam Build Fighters. While some find it enjoyable as a standalone anime with good action and character development, others criticize its lack of originality and simplified story. Nostalgia for the original series heavily influences the opinions.
pros: Good animation and character design.
Enjoyable for those new to the Gundam franchise.
Satisfying character rivalries and development.
cons: Story is very similar to the first season and lacks originality.
Writing is less sophisticated than the original.
Pacing can be slow in the first half of the series.

anime.title: Yamada-kun and the Seven Witches OVA
anime.romaji_title: Yamada-kun to 7-nin no Majo: Mou Hitotsu no Suzaku-sai
anime.synopsis: Shiraishi Urara is the top student in her school. One day, due to an accidental kiss, Urara finds herself in the body of the school delinquent, Yamada Ryuu! In trying to switch back to their own bodies, Urara and Ryuu discover that kissing causes them to switch bodies, which leads to their discovery that there are 7 witches in their school. They soon try to uncover the identities of the 7 witches...
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted addition to the series that provides more screen time for the characters. However, it doesn't add much to the main plot and is best enjoyed after watching the full TV series. It is a funny good bye to the viewers.
pros: Funny and soft way to see more of the characters.
Includes both major and minor characters in a canon story.
cons: Doesn't build onto the main plot or expand on the characters much.
Second episode focuses on tracking people down instead of developing them.
Requires watching the full TV series first to understand the characters and context.
Doesn't put an end to the anime's ending, acts as something cool added to give more screen time to characters.

anime.title: Gourmet Girl Graffiti
anime.genres: CGDCT, Gourmet, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
The path to becoming a fine wife begins with being an accomplished cook—at least, that is what Ryou Machiko's late grandmother had led her to believe. For a middle schooler, Ryou's cooking skills are incomparable; but recently, though Ryou's food looks appetizing and smells inviting, the taste has not been delicious. Just when the dejected art student comes to terms with the possibility that she might continue living alone for the rest of her life, her aunt tells her that Kirin Morino—Ryou's second cousin—will begin staying with her every weekend since the younger girl has joined a cram school in Tokyo and aims to attend the same school as Ryou.

Surprisingly, with her cousin's arrival, Ryou finds that her cooking has vastly improved—apparently, it is not her prowess in the kitchen, but the sharing of the experience with those closest to her that seems to make the flavors shine.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers find Koufuku Graffiti to be a relaxing and visually appealing slice-of-life anime with a unique focus on food and heartwarming relationships. However, others criticize its shallow plot, repetitive nature, and the sometimes uncomfortable hyper-sexualization of food consumption. The show's appeal heavily depends on individual tolerance for the 'cute girls doing cute things' genre and its particular brand of fan service.
pros: Gorgeous backgrounds and food art.
Heartwarming trio dynamic.
Enjoyable opening and ending soundtracks.
Unique fan service focusing on sensual eating.
Wholesome and relaxing vibe.
cons: Simplistic and predictable plot.
Hyper-sexualized foodgasms can be off-putting.
Repetitive episodes.
Weak character development, especially for the main character Ryou.
Overreliance on food with little else of substance.
Poorly rendered CGI food.

anime.title: Date A Live Movie: Mayuri Judgement
anime.romaji_title: Date A Live Movie: Mayuri Judgment
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Sci-Fi, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
War(Date), resumes.
The peaceful days of Itsuka Shidou returned without having to save the Spirits from the relentless battle days. But, the peaceful days were interrupted by the emergence of a mysterious sphere emitting spiritual wave――as well as a mysterious girl who showed herself at the same time. What is her purpose of keeping an eye on Shidou……? The mission that had been entrusted to Shidou under the tense situation was, 

“Date all of the Spirits, and make them fall in love?!”

――With the fate of humanity at stake, the war(date) resumes!
anime.consensus_summary: Fans of the Date A Live series generally found the movie to be a satisfying, albeit flawed, addition, particularly for its fan service and character moments. However, critics pointed to a weak and repetitive plot, rushed pacing, and underdeveloped new characters as significant drawbacks. While enjoyable for existing fans, it struggled to provide a compelling narrative for newcomers.
pros: High quality art and animation, particularly from Production IMS.
Excellent soundtrack and voice acting, with some specific praise for the reuse of Season 1's opening song.
Provides enjoyable "fan service" and moments for established characters, satisfying long-time fans.
The dates offer character moments and refreshers for the returning cast.
The climactic battle is described as glorious and well-animated.
cons: The plot is often described as recycled or formulaic, relying too heavily on dates.
The pacing is criticized, with early dates feeling unnecessary and the latter half feeling rushed.
The introduction and development of the new character, Mayuri, is poorly handled, with inconsistent appearances and a lack of meaningful impact.
The climax and plot resolution are considered messy and poorly explained, with unanswered questions.
Character development for established characters is minimal, as the dates have lost their earlier significance.

anime.title: Mushi-shi Path of Thorns
anime.romaji_title: Mushishi Zoku Shou: Odoro no Michi
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Adventure, Historical, Iyashikei, Mystery, Seinen, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Mysterious, unknowable creatures alien to the laws of nature—known only to some and feared by others—"Mushi" lie behind many of life's strange phenomena.

Long ago, a Mushi of terrifying power threatened to extinguish all life. The Minai clan of Mushishi were born from those who stopped this malevolent force, their members bound by duty to serve as retainers to the Karibusa family, within whom the Mushi remains sealed. The Mushishi Ginko is given a job request from Tanyuu Karibusa: oversee the work of the head of the Minai clan, Kumado Minai, in investigating an abandoned village where dead wood and even houses spring back to life as flourishing plants.

Though the Minai clan are oddly ruthless among Mushishi, even more peculiar is their widespread dull character, with little appreciation for beauty or sentiment. Tanyuu believes there is more to this trend than meets the eye. Ginko aims to answer her curiosity as he follows Kumado into a "Path of Thorns," a place where Mushi flow from their own strange sources into the world of the living. Rare and deadly varieties of Mushi lurk in these depths, along with the secret nature of the Minai clan's resolve to their ancient task.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the special episode for its art, sound, and storytelling, which are consistent with the Mushishi series. While some find the plot less crucial to the overall story, the consensus is that fans of the series will enjoy it, especially for its contemplative and serene atmosphere. The episode provides a deeper look into the world of Mushishi, though some viewers are left wanting more answers regarding the 'Forbidden Mushi'.
pros: Excellent art and animation enhances the atmosphere.
Soundtrack is beautiful and adds to the viewing experience.
Writing is crafted with high-quality storytelling.
Explores the Mushishi profession and provides continuity.
cons: Some may find the pace slow or uneventful.
The episode raises tension but doesn't reveal much about the Forbidden Mushi.
The plot might not be essential for the overall series.

anime.title: Brynhildr in the Darkness Special
anime.synopsis: Unaired episode 11.5 included with the second Blu-ray/DVD volume.
anime.consensus_summary: This unaired OVA is widely considered disappointing by fans expecting plot continuation or deeper character development. It serves primarily as a lighthearted, ecchi-focused side episode that fails to engage with the original series' themes or narrative.
pros: Intro song is good
cons: No plot relevance to the original series
Story is weak and undeveloped, focusing on forced ecchi moments
Characters are poorly developed in this episode
Disappointing as an OVA, does not contribute to plot or season 2
Higher ecchi content than the original anime

anime.title: Ai Tenchi Muyou!
anime.synopsis:
The franchise is celebrating its 20th anniversary with this new project.

Note: The recap episodes are not included in the main episode count and are now included here.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Ai Tenchi Muyo!' is viewed as a disappointing anniversary project that fails to live up to the legacy of the original series. Many fans feel the plot is disjointed, the characters are poorly developed, and the reliance on fan service is excessive. While some appreciate the nostalgic callbacks and voice acting, the general consensus is that the series is a weak addition to the franchise and a disservice to long-time fans.
pros: Nostalgic callbacks to the original Tenchi Muyo series are appreciated.
Some viewers enjoyed the new characters, such as Yuki and Rui.
The voice cast, especially the return of original voice actors, added to the presentation for some viewers.
cons: The story structure is a mess, with disjointed time jumps and incoherent connections.
The plot feels like a promotion for Takahashi, Okayama, rather than a meaningful addition to the Tenchi Muyo universe.
Many found the new characters uninteresting and underdeveloped.
The series relies too heavily on tired tropes and fan service.
Original characters are underutilized or bastardized, particularly Tenchi himself.

anime.title: Mushi-shi: Next Passage Part 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Adventure, Historical, Iyashikei, Mystery, Seinen, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ghostly, primordial beings known as Mushi continue to cause mysterious changes in the lives of humans. The travelling Mushishi, Ginko, persists in trying to set right the strange and unsettling situations he encounters. Time loops, living shadows, and telepathy are among the overt effects of interference from Mushi, but more subtle symptoms that take years to be noticed also rouse Ginko's concern as he passes from village to village.

Through circumstance, Ginko has become an arbiter, determining which Mushi are blessings and which are curses. But the lines that he seeks to draw are subjective. Some of his patients would rather exercise their new powers until they are utterly consumed by them; others desperately strive to rid themselves of afflictions which are in fact protecting their lives from devastation. Those who cross paths with Mushi must learn to accept seemingly impossible consequences for their actions, and heal wounds they did not know they had. Otherwise, they risk meeting with fates beyond their comprehension.
anime.consensus_summary: Mushishi Zoku Shou 2nd Season is widely praised for its atmospheric storytelling, philosophical themes, and high production quality. While some find its slow pace and episodic nature to be drawbacks, the majority appreciate its unique approach and the emotional depth of its narratives. It's considered a work of art, best suited for patient viewers seeking a thoughtful and calming experience.
pros: Episodic format allows for diverse and compelling stories.
High-quality art and stellar soundtracks enhance the viewing experience.
Thoughtful exploration of human nature and the relationship with nature.
Unpredictable narratives with unique and impactful episodes.
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers.
Episodic structure lacks an overarching plot, which some may find unsatisfying.
Character design, particularly for side characters, is sometimes lacking.
Some viewers may find the series less fresh compared to the first season.

anime.title: High School DxD BorN
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Mythology, Romance, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
The Red Dragon Emperor, Issei Hyoudou, and the Occult Research Club are back in action as summer break comes for the students of Kuoh Academy. After their fight with Issei’s sworn enemy, Vali and the Chaos Brigade, it is clear just how inexperienced Rias Gremory's team is. As a result, she and Azazel lead the club on an intense training regime in the Underworld to prepare them for the challenges that lie ahead.

While they slowly mature as a team, Issei will once again find himself in intimate situations with the girls of the Occult Research Club. Meanwhile, their adversaries grow stronger and more numerous as they rally their forces. And with the sudden appearance of Loki, the Evil God of Norse Mythology, the stage is set for epic fights and wickedly powerful devils in High School DxD BorN!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with fans appreciating the character development and action, while criticizing the rushed pacing and inconsistent art. Many feel the season deviates from the source material and prioritizes fan service over a coherent plot, leading to disappointment. However, some viewers still found it enjoyable for its humor and ecchi elements, if those elements are what they were looking for.
pros: Character development, especially for Issei and Koneko.
Good mix of comedy, action, and fan service.
Interesting story line with suspenseful battles.
cons: Rushed pacing and incomplete explanations, especially in the second half.
Inconsistent art quality with noticeable animation errors.
Over-reliance on fan service at the expense of plot development.
Characters sometimes behave in ways that are a dichotomy to their overall character, for example, the MC wanting to be a Harem King while in love with one person.

anime.title: Gonna be the Twin-Tail!!
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Magical Sex Shift, Parody, Romance, School, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Twintails: the glory of all mankind—or at least that is what first-year high school student Souji Mitsuka believes. At school, Souji spends most of his time daydreaming and rating girls' twintails, even going as far as creating a club dedicated to the hairstyle.
