His obsession does not go unnoticed, however; when monsters from outer space attack Earth and claim the world's twintails for themselves, a strange woman named Twoearle enlists Souji to fight back using twintails of his own!

By transforming into the twin-tailed warrior Tail Red, Souji combats the vicious alien organization known as Ultimegil, whose main goal is to colonize Earth and steal everyone's spiritual energy, or "attribute power." Alongside fellow twin-tailed fighters Aika Tsube and Erina Shindou, Souji must find a way to defeat the invading army and defend the twintails he holds so dear.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the anime hilarious and enjoyable for its absurdist humor and parody of anime tropes, while others criticize it for its repetitive plot, weak characters, and over-reliance on fan service. The show's central theme revolves around fetishes, which is a major point of contention. While some appreciate the show's message about embracing one's passions, others find it awkward and off-putting.
pros: Creative and unique premise parodies anime tropes.
Catchy opening and ending themes enhance enjoyment.
Some found it genuinely funny and relatable due to the characters' passionate dedication to their interests.
The show's self-awareness and sarcasm contributed to its entertainment value.
cons: Repetitive plot structure with monster-of-the-week format.
Weak character development beyond surface-level traits and fetishes.
Inconsistent animation quality, especially in later episodes.
Over-reliance on sexual innuendo and fan service may alienate some viewers.
The plot is often predictable and lacks depth.

anime.title: School-Live!
anime.genres: Horror, Mystery, Psychological, School, Slice of Life, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Carefree high school senior Yuki Takeya every day looks forward to the School Living Club. Consisting of the president Yuuri Wakasa, the athletic Kurumi Ebisuzawa, the mature Miki Naoki, the supervising teacher Megumi Sakura, and club dog Taroumaru, the club prides itself on making the most of life at school. There is only one rule the club members have to follow: all members must live their entire lives within school grounds.

Gakkougurashi! follows the adventures of the School Living Club as they promote independence and self-determination through their lively time residing at Megurigaoka Private High School.
anime.consensus_summary: Gakkougurashi! polarizes viewers with its jarring contrast between cute aesthetics and dark themes. While some praise its unique premise and surprising twists, others criticize its shallow characters, inconsistent tone, and failure to fully explore its potentially impactful themes. The initial shock value hooks many, but the execution leaves a significant portion of the audience disappointed.
pros: Unique blend of slice-of-life and horror elements.
Unpredictable plot twists, especially in the first episode.
Exploration of trauma, loss, and mental health.
cons: Inconsistent tone shifts and pacing issues.
Characters are generic and underdeveloped.
Lack of depth in exploring serious themes.
Contradicts its own message

anime.title: Alice in Borderland
anime.genres: Action, Gore, High Stakes Game, Psychological, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Ryouhei Arisu is a high school student with no ambitions and just wants to escape from what he feels is a meaningless reality. One night when he is with his two friends Daikichi Karube and Chouta Segawa, they see an abnormally large firework shoot into the sky, an event which signals a permanent change in their lives.

Blinded by the incredibly bright explosion, the three find themselves transported to what is known as the Borderland. The only inhabitants of this world are participants of a deadly game where specific tasks must be accomplished if they wish to survive. As the three begin playing to determine how they can get back home, Ryouhei finds himself feeling alive for the very first time in his life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is generally positive, praising the suspenseful plot and well-developed protagonist. However, many feel the limited number of episodes leads to a rushed and incomplete story, leaving them wanting more. The lack of depth in strategic puzzles and underdeveloped supporting characters are also common criticisms.
pros: Engaging and suspenseful plot.
Well-developed protagonist with relatable internal conflict.
Good sound design and character design.
Strong emotional impact and connection to characters.
cons: Rushed pacing and incomplete story due to limited episodes.
Lack of in-depth strategic puzzle solving.
Underdeveloped supporting characters.
Missing ending and lack of explanation about the world.

anime.title: Isshuukan Friends. Specials
anime.synopsis: Specials included in the Blu-ray/DVD releases.
anime.consensus_summary: The specials are seen as a sweet but ultimately shallow addition to the main series. Viewers appreciate the deeper look into the characters' minds and the calming atmosphere. However, many feel that the specials lack a cohesive narrative, omit crucial emotional moments, and fail to provide meaningful closure. The fragmented presentation is also a point of criticism.
pros: Provides deeper insight into the characters' thoughts.
Calm and soothing atmosphere enhanced by music.
Sweet addition that complements the main story.
cons: Lacks a real story; relies on flashbacks.
Omits key emotionally impactful moments.
Does not provide closure to the story as a whole.
Fragmented format disrupts emotional flow.

anime.title: Assassination Classroom
anime.synopsis:
Tucked in the mountains near the elite Kunugigaoka Middle School lies a small derelict building that houses the delinquents and dropouts of Class 3-E. Looked down upon by their peers, the students in this class appear to have little hope in advancing their academic careers. That is, until the national government tasks them with eliminating the greatest threat to their planet: their new teacher. 

Having already destroyed the moon, the octopus-like professor—dubbed "Koro-sensei"—has now threatened to destroy the Earth by March of the following year. In light of their mission, the students have found that killing him is easier said than done. Not only can Koro-sensei move at speeds of up to Mach 20, but he can also resist almost every earthly weapon. Ironically, he also proves to be one of the best teachers Class 3-E has ever had. Training the class to excel in both their studies as students and skills as assassins, Koro-sensei is confident that his students' ingenuity and indomitable will could return them to the main campus. 

Through trial and error, Nagisa Shiota, as well as the other students of Class 3-E, must figure out Koro-sensei's weaknesses—and fast, for the very fate of the world depends upon it.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Assassination Classroom for its unique premise, blend of action and comedy, and character development. Some find the plot predictable and repetitive, while others appreciate the humor and lightheartedness. Overall, the series is well-received for its entertainment value despite some shortcomings in plot and character development.
pros: Unique and interesting premise.
Good character development for main characters.
Enjoyable mix of action and comedy.
Art is splendid, jokes/comedy moments softened the serious moments.
cons: Assassination attempts become predictable.
Some characters lack development.
Comedy can be repetitive.
Plot can be uneven, with hit-or-miss episodes.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam-san
anime.synopsis: Anime adaptation of the 4-koma manga Mobile Suit Gundam-san.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily dependent on prior Gundam knowledge. Fans of the original series appreciate the parody and humor, while those unfamiliar with Gundam are likely to be lost and unimpressed. Some find the humor crude and offensive, while others enjoy its irreverent nature. Overall, it's a niche show with a dedicated, but limited, audience.
pros: Hilarious for Gundam fans
Effective use of original Gundam soundtrack
Voice actors capture the original feel
Absurd and vulgar gags can be amusing
cons: Crude art style
Minimal animation
Story is unimportant
Humor relies heavily on knowledge of the original Gundam
Awkward and unfunny moments
Potentially offensive humor (perverted, vulgar)

anime.title: Girl Friend Beta
anime.synopsis:
A TV anime adaptation of the Girlfriend (Kari) a mobile game where players can have girlfriends through playing the game. 

Shiina Kokomi is a hard working but even tempered high school girl who is the lead performer in her school's rhythmic gymnastics club. The story follows her and her growing circle of friends as they support each other through the various trials and situations that comprise high school life.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Girlfriend (Kari)" is viewed as a generic and unremarkable slice-of-life anime. While some appreciate its cute character designs and relaxing atmosphere, many find it boring due to the lack of story, character development, and engaging content. The anime is primarily targeted towards moe enthusiasts, but is unlikely to leave a lasting impression on other viewers.
pros: Cute character designs
Relaxing and heartwarming atmosphere
Varied cast of characters with some unique traits
cons: Lack of overarching story or plot progression
Episodic format prevents character development
Bland and uninspired animation
Generic and forgettable music
Boring and uneventful
Too many characters to keep track of

anime.title: Unlimited Fafnir
anime.synopsis:
Midgar, all-girl academy, would have been notable just for the action of accepting its first and only male student, Yuu Mononobe. But Midgar stands out for much more than that: it's a school exclusive to a group of girls known as D's. Each of them have extremely powerful abilities in generating dark matter and manipulating it into powerful weaponry.

The D's didn't exist twenty-five years ago, and only appeared after a number of mysterious, destructive monsters known as "Dragons" started appearing around the world. Strangely, just as suddenly as they appeared, they vanished. In their destructive wake, some girls started being born with symbols on their bodies and powers similar in nature to those wielded by the Dragons themselves.

Now the D's attend this school, hoping to harness and utilize their powers against the Dragons. Yuu is their latest member and is extraordinary for being the only known male D in existence. Now he must forge relationships with the girls around him, including his long separated sister who attends the school as well, and work with them to investigate and eliminate the threat of the powerful Dragons.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Juuou Mujin no Fafnir is received poorly, with most reviewers finding it to be a generic and uninspired addition to the harem genre. Common complaints include a predictable story, weak characters, and subpar animation. While some enjoyed aspects of the music and art, the general consensus is that the series fails to deliver a compelling or memorable experience, making it easily forgettable.
pros: Some found the opening and ending themes catchy and enjoyable.
A few appreciated the art style, describing it as pleasing to the eyes with cool background designs.
A couple of reviewers noted that the series had potential due to the backstory and powers but ultimately didn't capitalize on it.
cons: The story is highly unoriginal, predictable, and overused with typical harem elements.
Characters are poorly developed, with many being forgettable or fitting into standard harem archetypes.
The plot is often incoherent, lacks depth, and introduces plot points that are never fully explored or resolved.
The art and animation quality is considered outdated, with poorly executed CGI for the dragons.
The series suffers from a lack of emotional impact, making it difficult to connect with the characters or story.
anime.thematic_vibe: Generic Harem, Uninspired Fantasy, Clichéd Action

anime.title: Knights of Sidonia: Battle for Planet Nine
anime.romaji_title: Sidonia no Kishi: Daikyuu Wakusei Seneki
anime.synopsis:
After barely escaping a collision with a gigantic Gauna at the cost of many human lives, Kobayashi—the captain of the spaceship Sidonia—is prompted to change her political paradigm. Once she seizes full power, Kobayashi aims to eradicate the Gaunas from the Lem system where former Sidonians have recently established a colony. Her ambition is justified by two breakthroughs: the development of highly effective, long-range anti-Gauna weapons, and the creation of Tsumugi Shiraui—the first human-Gauna chimera possessing great destructive power.

Facing hostility toward chimeras and her uncertain large-scale military expedition, Kobayashi enlists the help of the new elite pilot Nagate Tanikaze. Due to his personal experiences with Shizuka Hoshijiro and Benisuzume's placenta, Tanikaze soon develops a close bond with Tsumugi. As the final battle against humanity's most formidable opponent approaches, Tanikaze tries to enjoy the last days of peace with his friend Izana Shinatose—all while Kobayashi secretly pursues the development of an experimental weapon that could very well lead to the complete destruction of Sidonia.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Sidonia no Kishi is a visually stunning and action-packed continuation of the story, although its shift in tone towards slice-of-life elements and romance has divided audiences. Some appreciate the added character development and plot twists, while others feel it detracts from the darker, more serious atmosphere of the first season. Overall, the season is considered a worthwhile watch but doesn't quite live up to the expectations set by its predecessor for some viewers.
pros: Excellent sound direction and realistic sound effects.
Beautiful visuals and well-done CGI, particularly in battle scenes.
Intense and engaging storyline with character development.
Addresses unanswered questions and plot twists from the first season.
cons: Shift in tone towards slice-of-life and romance elements may disappoint fans of the darker first season.
Some find the love triangle/harem aspects to be childish and detracting from the plot.
The CGI style may be off-putting to some viewers.
Unexplored character stories mentioned, such as Kunato and Ochiai.

anime.title: JOKER
anime.synopsis:
Under the veil of the shining night, the mysterious phantom thief Joker performs daring heists on one valuable treasure to the next. Although often backed into a corner by persistent police investigator Dokusaburou Oniyama, the self-proclaimed "Miracle Maker" uses his arsenal of flashy tricks to escape, straddling the line between science and magic. 

In the middle of a heist to steal the "Dragon Gem" from the mansion of a haughty multimillionaire, Joker meets Hachi, a clumsy but earnest ninja. Hachi is after the same treasure but idolizes Joker, who in return merely sees him as a nuisance. Still, the two are able to work together to perform a successful heist. Seeing Hachi's wit and courage, as well as his convenient ability to perform housework, Joker reluctantly accepts him as a disciple.

As they set off with their eyes set on the next prize, Joker and Hachi butt heads with other phantom thieves. Facing both old friends and new foes alike, Joker competes to become the best "magician" of the shining night.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Kaitou Joker as a lighthearted and entertaining show, especially for younger viewers. Its creative heists, appealing art style, and balance of comedy and adventure are well-received. However, some find the plot inconsistent, tricks predictable, and humor geared towards children.
pros: Creative heists and tricks
Appealing art style, especially for children
Enjoyable episodic format with some story progression
Good balance of comedy and serious moments
cons: Inconsistent plot and filler episodes in some seasons
Predictable tricks and storylines at times
Humor primarily suited for children
Occasional plot holes and logic issues

anime.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior OVA: First Time
anime.romaji_title: Bokura wa Minna Kawai-sou: Hajimete no
anime.genres: Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Unaired episode included in the 7th Blu-ray/DVD volume of Bokura wa Minna Kawaisou anime.
anime.consensus_summary: The special episode is well-received by fans of the original series. It maintains the established tone and humor while offering a subtle progression in the relationship between the main characters. The episode is considered a worthwhile addition for those who enjoyed the first season.
pros: Stays true to the original series' tone and humor.
Subtly deepens the romance between Usa and Kawai.
Delivers warmth, humor, and heart.
cons: Not a full continuation of the main series.
Romance doesn't go full force.

anime.title: Aoki Hagane no Arpeggio: Ars Nova Movie 1 - DC
anime.romaji_title: Aoki Hagane no Arpeggio: Ars Nova Movie 1 - DC
anime.synopsis:
Humanity finds itself in a struggle when the sea level begins to rise to an unprecedented level in the year 2039. To make matters worse, powerful enemies resembling old wartime vessels called the Fleet of Fog roam the waters, severing communication and transit to various regions.

Any attempt at retaliation ends in failure with humanity's current weaponry. Only Gunzou Chihaya stands a chance against the Fleet of Fog as captain of the friendly Fog I-401 submarine Iona. As a result, Gunzou and his crew, known as Blue Steel, are tasked with a critical delivery mission by the Japanese government: they must deliver humanity's last hope against the Fleet of Fog, the Vibration Torpedo Warhead, through hostile waters to the United States for mass production.

Though involved in the unsavory conflict, Blue Steel strives for nothing more than a peaceful resolution to it. As Iona undertakes the current mission and tasks beyond it, the crew upholds their values even in the face of harsh situations.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is primarily intended as a recap for fans of the 'Aoki Hagane no Arpeggio: Ars Nova' series, serving as a refresher before watching the sequel movie. While it provides additional content and ties up loose ends, it is not recommended for newcomers due to its underdeveloped story and reliance on prior knowledge from the series. The audience generally appreciates the new content and animation quality but acknowledges its inaccessibility to new viewers.
pros: Awesome art and animation
Ties up loose ends from the series, giving a more complete feeling
Includes an extra 45 minutes of new content
Introduces new ship designs
Good recap for those who watched the series
cons: Story is underdeveloped as a stand-alone movie
Viewer comprehension and world-building are lacking for new viewers
Many interactions and their significance are reduced compared to the series
Not suitable for anyone who hasn't seen the series

anime.title: Aoki Hagane no Arpeggio: Ars Nova Movie 2 - Cadenza
anime.romaji_title: Aoki Hagane no Arpeggio: Ars Nova Movie 2 - Cadenza
anime.synopsis:
The group of privateers known as the Blue Steel continues their mission to deliver blueprints of the Vibration Warhead Torpedo—a weapon that may turn the tides of war in their favor—to the United States. However, a new threat arises from their enemy, the overwhelming Fleet of Fog in the form of "The Student Council.," This is a group of warships composed of the remaining Mental Models—the ships' humanoid avatars—who have yet to face the unpredictable captain of the Blue Steel, Gunzou Chihaya.

As the Blue Steel gets closer to understanding the origins of the authority controlling the enemy, Iona's past starts to reveal why the war began and her reason for siding with humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, praising the film's spectacular action, high-quality CGI, and emotional conclusion. However, a notable portion of the audience expresses dissatisfaction with its divergence from the original manga, with some finding the pacing rushed and character development uneven. Despite these criticisms, the film is generally seen as a satisfying, albeit bittersweet, end to the animated series.
pros: Stunning naval warfare and action sequences, particularly in the latter half.
High-quality CGI animation, with many noting it's some of the best in the medium and often unnoticeable.
Excellent soundtrack that complements the action without being distracting.
Satisfying emotional conclusion that provides closure to the series.
Strong character development for key figures like Musashi and Yamato, and well-realized new antagonists.
Engaging and touching storyline that blends friendship, intense battles, and romance.
cons: Deviation from the manga's storyline is a significant point of contention for some viewers.
Pacing can feel rushed, especially in trying to conclude the series and develop numerous characters.
Some plot points and character motivations remain unexplained or underdeveloped due to time constraints.
The anime-original ending can be divisive and may leave fans of the manga dissatisfied.
Overabundance of characters and busy battle scenes can sometimes hinder readability and tactical feel.

anime.title: No Game, No Life Specials
anime.synopsis: Picture drama specials included on the Blu-ray/DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided, with many finding the specials to be pointless, lazy fanservice that detracts from the original series. However, a smaller segment appreciates them as short, brainless, comedic diversions specifically for existing fans, acknowledging their low-stakes, bonus content nature.
pros: Animation maintains the bright and colourful style of the anime.
Sound effects and music connect to the dialogue ably.
Short episode length prevents them from dragging on.
Maintains the series' over-the-top comedy and character personalities.
Serves its purpose as bonus content for existing fans.
cons: Animation is lazy with mostly still frames and less movement/camera changes.
Body-shaming jokes, particularly in one episode.
Storyless silliness and fanservice that can be unenjoyable and pointless.
Does not contribute to the plot or characters, potentially degrading the overall opinion of the franchise.
Art is inconsistent, mixing fine art with real photos.
Characters don't develop, only personality traits are emphasized.
Extremely forgettable content that doesn't change perspective on characters or setting.

anime.title: Love Live! The School Idol Movie
anime.romaji_title: Love Live! The School Idol Movie
anime.genres: Award Winning, Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Hot on the heels of the third year students' graduation, μ's is invited to New York in hopes of spreading the joy of school idols to other parts of the world. Due to the events of the recent Love Live!, μ's has reached eminent stardom which results in crowds swarming them whenever they appear in public. With the increased attention, however, comes a difficult choice.

Having yet to publicly announce the decision they came to regarding their future, the young members of μ's are pushed to continue performing by rival group A-RISE, Otonokizaka High School, and even Love Live! itself. As leader, Honoka Kousaka is left wondering if the path they have chosen is truly for the best, as μ's must re-evaluate their choices and come to a final decision on what they want for the future.

Love Live! The School Idol Movie depicts the final chapter in μ's story as the girls explore just what being an idol means to them as well as the bond that connects the nine of them together.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Love Live! The School Idol Movie' serves as a satisfying and emotional conclusion to the series, celebrating the bonds of friendship and the journey of self-discovery. While praised for its music, animation, and emotional resonance, some critics find the plot simplistic and dependent on familiarity with the preceding series. Overall, the movie is well-received by fans as a fitting send-off to the beloved idol group, μ's.
pros: Celebrates the essence of the school idol project.
Music is catchy and enjoyable.
Art and animation are outstanding, especially the dance sequences and New York City settings.
cons: Story is simple and lacks complexity.
Pacing issues and abrupt transitions between scenes.
Relies heavily on the viewer's prior knowledge of the series.

anime.title: Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya 2Wei! Shorts
anime.synopsis: Short specials included with the Blu-ray/DVD releases of the TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to these specials is mixed, leaning towards those who appreciate fan service and lighthearted slice-of-life content. While some find them enjoyable and insightful into character desires, others view them as superficial and lacking substance beyond their fan service elements.
pros: Positively contributes to understanding protagonists' desires, worries, insecurities, and self-images.
Provides enjoyable short episodes for fans of the slice of life aspect.
cons: Primarily consists of fan service (loli/yuri or ecchi interactions).
Offers nothing worth noticing beyond character screen time for slice of life fans.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Fan Service

anime.title: Yona of the Dawn
anime.synopsis:
The kingdom of Kouka is blessed with a beautiful princess whose childlike innocence charms all who come across her. Named Yona, she has grown up sheltered in the royal palace, shielded from any danger that may befall her. However, all good things must come to an end.

Yona's perfect world comes crashing down when a heinous act of treason threatens to erase all that she holds dear, including her birthright as the princess of Kouka. Left with no one to trust but her childhood friend and loyal bodyguard Son Hak, she is forced to flee the palace. Faced with the perils of surviving in the wild with a target on her back, Yona realizes that her kingdom is no longer the safe haven it once was.

Free from the shackles of naivety, Yona vows to do everything in her power to become strong enough to crush her enemies. With Hak by her side, she must piece together the remains of an ancient legend that might be the key to reclaiming her kingdom from those who conspired to steal it from her.
anime.consensus_summary: Akatsuki no Yona is generally well-received for its engaging story, character development, and blend of genres. While some find aspects cliché or slow-paced, many viewers are deeply moved by Yona's journey and the supporting cast.  The series is considered a worthwhile watch, with many hoping for a second season.
pros: Well-developed characters, especially Yona's transformation.
Compelling storyline with a mix of action, comedy, and romance.
Good pacing and emotional impact.
cons: Slow pacing during the dragon-finding arc.
Some consider it a reverse-harem cliche.

anime.title: Beyond the Boundary: I'll Be Here - Past
anime.romaji_title: Kyoukai no Kanata Movie 1: I'll Be Here - Kako-hen
anime.synopsis:
The first part of a two-part movie. The story is a recap of the TV series.

Mirai Kuriyama is the sole survivor of a clan of Spirit World warriors with the power to employ their blood as weapons. As such, Mirai is tasked with hunting down and killing "youmu"—creatures said to be the manifestation of negative human emotions. One day, while deep in thought on the school roof, Mirai comes across Akihito Kanbara, a rare half-breed of youmu in human form. In a panicked state, she plunges her blood saber into him only to realize that he's an immortal being. From then on, the two form an impromptu friendship that revolves around Mirai constantly trying to kill Akihito, in an effort to boost her own wavering confidence as a Spirit World warrior. Eventually, Akihito also manages to convince her to join the Literary Club, which houses two other powerful Spirit World warriors, Hiroomi and Mitsuki Nase.

As the group's bond strengthens, however, so does the tenacity of the youmu around them. Their misadventures will soon turn into a fight for survival as the inevitable release of the most powerful youmu, Beyond the Boundary, approaches.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided. Fans of the original series find it a passable recap but criticize its poor compression and lack of new content. Newcomers are strongly discouraged from watching, as it fails to provide sufficient context. Many feel it's a pointless rehash that doesn't justify its existence.
pros: Good recap for those who have seen the original series.
Same high-quality animation and sound as the original series.
Focuses on the core relationship between Akihito and Mirai.
cons: Poorly compresses the 12-episode series into a movie, omitting key details and character development.
Unsuitable for newcomers; incomprehensible without prior knowledge of the original anime.
Feels like a literal edit of the series with little to no new animation.
Unnecessary and serves as a rehash of existing material.

anime.title: Shomin Sample
anime.romaji_title: Ore ga Ojousama Gakkou ni "Shomin Sample" Toshite Gets♥Sareta Ken
anime.synopsis:
Kimito Kagurazaka is a commoner with a fetish for men's muscles—or at least that's the lie he must keep telling if he wants to keep himself out of trouble at the elite all-girls school, Seikain Academy. Kidnapped by the school under the assumption that he prefers men, Kimito is made to be their "commoner sample," exposing the girls to both commoner and man so that the transition to the world after school is not jarring. Threatened with castration should his sexual preferences not match the school's assumptions, Kimito keeps up the facade to protect his manhood.

But there are eccentric individuals around every corner who begin to make Kimito's life even more difficult. Among them are Aika Tenkuubashi, a social outcast who blurts out whatever comes to mind; Hakua Shiodome, a young genius; Karen Jinryou, the daughter of samurai who is obsessed with defeating Kimito; and Reiko Arisugawa, the perfect student who has delusions of marrying Kimito. Along with the commoner himself, these four girls make up the Commoner Club, which attempts to teach the girls more about life outside the school, while Kimito gradually learns about the odd girls surrounding him.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Shomin Sample' is seen as an enjoyable and funny anime with a unique premise and likable characters, although some find the humor repetitive.  The series' episodic nature and lack of substantial plot or character development are drawbacks. Many viewers highlight the refreshing take on the harem genre while also acknowledging its reliance on ecchi elements and fan service.
pros: Original and refreshing ecchi harem setting.
Likable protagonist with a good sense of humor.
Tastefully executed ecchi elements that stem from the characters' personalities.
Well-developed characters with differing personalities.
Catchy opening and ending themes.
Hilarious jokes and references.
cons: Repetitive episodic structure and pacing issues.
Unnecessary and pointless fan service.
Shallow exploration of dramatic elements.
Lack of character development for some of the main characters.
Unrealistic premise.
Some humor may not resonate with Western audiences.

anime.title: Trinity Seven
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
One day, the bright red sun stopped shining, causing the "Breakdown Phenomenon"—the destruction of Arata Kasuga's town and the disappearance of the people inhabiting it. All, however, is not yet lost; by utilizing the magical grimoire given to him by his childhood friend and cousin Hijiri Kasuga, Arata's world gets artificially reconstructed.

In order to investigate the phenomenon, Lilith Asami appears before Arata, whose artificial world suddenly disintegrates. He is given two choices: hand over the book, or die. However, Arata chooses the third option—enrolling in the top-secret magic school Royal Biblia Academy, where six other magical users await him. Together with Lilith, these six form the Trinity Seven, the elite of the school who each bolster their own power and skill.

With the ambition to save Hijiri and the help of his newfound friends, Arata stops at nothing to prevent the destruction of his beloved hometown and to bring his best friend back.
anime.consensus_summary: Trinity Seven is a decent ecchi harem anime with a likeable main character and an intriguing, albeit messy, plot. While the fan service is excessive and character development is lacking, the unique magic system and overall enjoyability make it worth a watch for fans of the genre. However, those sensitive to fan service should avoid this anime.
pros: Likeable main character (Arata) who isn't dense and is often funny.
Intriguing plot that makes you want to keep watching.
Unique magic system and interesting world details.
Good art style and animation.
cons: Messy and horrible plot development.
Excessive fan service.
Poor character development with little explanation.
Story leaves out information and requires piecing things together.
Inconsistent pacing.

anime.title: When Supernatural Battles Became Commonplace
anime.romaji_title: Inou-Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de
anime.synopsis:
During a Literature Club meeting, the four club members—along with their faculty adviser's niece—suddenly find themselves with supernatural powers. Now capable of fabricating black flames, resident chuunibyou Jurai Andou is the most ecstatic about their new abilities; unfortunately, his own is only for show and unable to accomplish anything of substance. Moreover, he is completely outclassed by those around him: fellow club member Tomoyo Kanzaki manipulates time, Jurai's childhood friend Hatoko Kushikawa wields control over the five elements, club president Sayumi Takanashi can repair both inanimate objects and living things, and their adviser's niece Chifuyu Himeki is able to create objects out of thin air.

However, while the mystery of why they received these powers looms overhead, very little has changed for the Literature Club. The everyday lives of these five superpowered students continue on, albeit now tinged with the supernatural.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Many feel misled by the title, expecting action but finding a slice-of-life rom-com. While some appreciate the characters and comedy, others criticize the lack of focus on the supernatural elements and the generic harem aspects. The show's unique spin on the genre is either a hit or miss, leading to polarized opinions.
pros: Unique and enjoyable take on the harem genre with a refreshing story.
Pleasant art style reminiscent of TTGL and Kill La Kill.
Good comedic timing and voice acting.
cons: Misleading title and synopsis; minimal supernatural battles.
Generic harem elements and underdeveloped romance.
Abrupt transitions between comedy and drama.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Romantic Comedy, Supernatural

anime.title: One Piece 3D2Y: Overcoming Ace's Death! Luffy's Pledge to His Friends
anime.romaji_title: One Piece 3D2Y: Ace no Shi wo Koete! Luffy Nakama to no Chikai
anime.synopsis:
After suffering great personal loss during the battle of Marineford, Monkey D. Luffy finds himself stranded on Rusukaina, a treacherous island crawling with huge and dangerous creatures. There, he has committed himself to a two-year stretch of training to learn "Haki," the energy that combatants can use to grant themselves a variety of abilities in battle.

Luffy is jerked away from his otherwise peaceful training by the abduction of Sandersonia and Marigold, sisters of his friend and ally Boa Hancock. With Boa's aid, Luffy seeks to track down the infamous pirate responsible for the kidnapping, a man whose recent prison break is the result of Luffy's own reckless actions. Luffy must use his developing grasp of Haki to defeat this new foe while coming to terms with his overbearing grief in the process.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is generally well-received by One Piece fans, particularly for its action, animation, and focus on friendship. Some viewers found the flashbacks and simple plot to be drawbacks. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile addition to the One Piece universe, especially for those interested in Luffy's training period.
pros: Engaging side story for One Piece fans.
Good team dynamic between Luffy and Boa Hancock.
Epic fight scenes and impressive animation.
Story fits well within the One Piece timeline during the time-skip.
Satisfying ending.
cons: Unnecessary rehashing of previous events through flashbacks.
Plot is fairly straightforward and simple.
Villains are not the most threatening or memorable.
Beginning is rushed and simultaneously feels too slow due to flashbacks.
Dialogue can be one-dimensional and plain.
Soundtrack is unremarkable and repetitive at times.

anime.title: Gangsta.
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Drama, Organized Crime, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Nicholas Brown and Worick Arcangelo, known in the city of Ergastalum as the "Handymen," are mercenaries for hire who take on jobs no one else can handle. Contracted by powerful mob syndicates and police alike, the Handymen have to be ready and willing for anything. After completing the order of killing a local pimp, the Handymen add Alex Benedetto—a prostitute also designated for elimination—to their ranks to protect her from forces that want her gone from the decrepit hellhole of a city she has come to call home. However, this criminal’s paradise is undergoing a profound period of change that threatens to corrode the delicate balance of power.

Ergastalum was once a safe haven for "Twilights," super-human beings born as the result of a special drug but are now being hunted down by a fierce underground organization. This new threat is rising up to challenge everything the city stands for, and the Handymen will not be able to avoid this coming war.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many viewers were initially drawn in by the mature themes, interesting characters, and unique setting. However, the rushed and incomplete ending, coupled with uneven production quality, left many feeling disappointed and frustrated. Some appreciate the ambition and potential of the series, while others criticize its lack of resolution and shallow plot development.
pros: Interesting and well-developed main characters with compelling backstories.
Unique setting and premise with potential for deep exploration of social issues.
Strong voice acting and character designs.
cons: Inconclusive ending due to production issues, leaving many plot threads unresolved.
Pacing problems, with too many characters and subplots introduced without proper development.
Inconsistent animation quality and overuse of exposition and flashbacks.

anime.title: AkaKill! Theater
anime.synopsis: Short specials that aired on the official website.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is split, with fans of the original Akame ga Kill! series finding some enjoyment in the comedic shorts and the emotional closure offered by the final episodes. However, many critics find the humor to be weak and repetitive, and the character portrayals to be disappointing, leading to a general consensus that the specials are largely forgettable and non-essential.
pros: Provides closure and good feelings for fans of the main series, especially the last two episodes.
Offers a lighter, comedic tone and unserious skits that contrast with the original show's darkness.
Chibi art style and exaggerated expressions are suitable for the comedic nature and fulfill their function.
cons: Humor is often described as dry, basic, crude, and repetitive, relying heavily on fan affection rather than genuinely witty writing.
Characterizations in the shorts are a letdown compared to the original, with some characters (like Lubbock and Leone) being subjected to unnecessary abuse or being reduced to fan service.
The specials are largely forgettable and non-essential, offering little to no new information or plot development, making them optional viewing that adds nothing substantial.

anime.title: Sky Wizards Academy
anime.synopsis:
Years ago, humanity almost got wiped out by huge magical armored insects that had become too strong and aggressive to handle. Because of these giant bugs, humans do not live on the earth anymore, but in floating cities instead. However, this does not mean that everything is lost, because the wizards from prestigious floating wizard academies are fighting these monsters.

Kanata Age is a young man now labelled as a traitor even though he was once praised as the "Black Master Swordsman." He gets a chance to repair his reputation by instructing the team E601, which seems to be facing some difficulties. It consists of three girls, Misora Whitale, Lecty Eisenach, and Rico Flamel, each with problems of their own. It appears that Kanata will get in deep waters more than once because of them...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for 'Kuusen Madoushi Kouhosei no Kyoukan' is overwhelmingly negative. Many viewers found the story disjointed, the animation low-quality, and the characters uninspired. A small minority found some enjoyment in the character interactions or art style, but overall, the anime is considered a significant disappointment due to poor execution of a potentially interesting premise.
pros: Some found the art style and character designs appealing.
The voice acting and sound effects were considered decent by some.
A few viewers enjoyed the characters and their interactions despite flaws.
cons: Incoherent and messy plot with unresolved storylines.
Poor animation quality, especially in action scenes.
Generic and unoriginal characters with little depth.
Lack of world-building and explanations for key elements.
Rushed pacing and poorly executed subplots.
Annoying or unlikeable antagonist.

anime.title: Haikyu!!: Lev Appears!
anime.synopsis:
Nekoma High School's volleyball team recruits a new member: the half-Japanese, half-Russian Lev Haiba. Though the self-proclaimed ace is blessed with great height, he lacks basic volleyball techniques. This gives the team's setter, Kenma Kozume, a hard time when matching up with him.
 
To everyone's surprise, Nekoma's coach suggests that Lev play in the Kunihira Senior High School's practice match, leaving Kenma no choice but to cooperate with the tall player. Will Kenma be able to overcome this new challenge?
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is well-received, especially for its focus on Nekoma High and the character development between Lev and Kenma. Viewers enjoyed the comedic aspects and insight into Nekoma's team dynamics. Some found the second OVA repetitive, but overall, the reception is positive.
pros: Character development between Kenma and Lev.
Focus on Nekoma's team dynamics and struggles.
Humorous and natural comedy.
Good art style and voice acting.
cons: The second OVA retells an episode from the second season, which can be repetitive.
Some reviewers found the sound unremarkable.

anime.title: Gintama': Futon ni Haitte kara Buki Nokoshi ni Kizuite Neru ni Nerenai Toki mo Aru
anime.romaji_title: Gintama': Futon ni Haitte kara Buki Nokoshi ni Kizuite Neru ni Nerenai Toki mo Aru
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Bundled with limited edition of the 58th Gintama manga volume.

The tagline for the bundled anime reads, "It's time for all the Yorozuya members ...to wake up just one more time."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the Gintama OVA, appreciating its return to classic humor, character interactions, and fourth-wall breaks. Some find certain jokes overdone or the ending song unpleasant, but overall, it's considered a worthwhile addition for fans of the series. The episode serves as a good taster of what Gintama has to offer.
pros: Classic Gintama humor and style.
Enjoyable character interactions and cameos.
Episode captures the essence of Gintama.
Good jokes
cons: Some jokes are overdone or fall flat.
The ending song may be considered atrocious by some.
Initial part of the episode wasn't the best.
Music becomes noticeable after many episodes.

anime.title: Ace of Diamond OVA
anime.synopsis:
One hundred boys, each of them in love with baseball, represent the Seidou High School baseball team. On any team, the Ace is the star of the game. Besides the main heroes, others are striving to attain this position, and each of them has their strengths, weaknesses, and emotional journeys that they have to undertake to become the best that they can be.

Ryousuke Kominato is known in Seidou not only for his impressive fielding skills but also as an intimidating presence despite his small stature. While together with his partner, Youichi Kuramochi, they are the cornerstones of the team's defense on the field.  Youichi is shadowed by his younger brother, Haruichi, whose admiration for Ryousuke is only matched by his own skills at the sport. Together with Yoichi's roommate, Eijun Sawamura, the players reminisce about their path to Seidou High.
anime.consensus_summary: The Diamond no Ace OVA is viewed as mostly unnecessary filler. The episode focusing on Kuramochi's backstory is seen as the highlight. The other episodes, particularly those focusing on the Kominato brothers and Kawakami, are considered less engaging and retread old ground.
pros: The second episode about Kuramochi's backstory is entertaining and funny.
cons: The OVA is considered filler with retreaded stories.
The episodes about the Kominato brothers and Kawakami are boring.
The Kawakami episode highlights a character that some viewers find uninteresting.

anime.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Space Heroes
anime.romaji_title: Doraemon Movie 35: Nobita no Space Heroes
anime.synopsis: Nobita wishes to be a real hero. Doraemon uses his gadget, the Burger Director to make them a real movie superhero. Aron saw the five powers and abilities and asks them to help him save his planet, the planet Pokkuru. After their journey to the planet, the gang thought it was only Burger's doing but realizing that it is not a movie and they are actually fighting bad guys.
anime.consensus_summary: The film is seen as bland and predictable, lacking risks and feeling somewhat cliché. The guest character is underdeveloped, and the antagonists' motivations are weak. Overall, the movie fails to leave a strong impression.
cons: Bland storyline with predictable and cliché elements
Underdeveloped guest character (Aron) with unclear motivations
Weak antagonist motivations related to diamonds

anime.title: Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection 'F'
anime.romaji_title: Dragon Ball Z Movie 15: Fukkatsu no "F"
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Earth is finally peaceful again, but this calm is short-lived. The remnants of Frieza's army, led by Sorbet and his right hand Tagoma, arrive on Earth in order to summon Shen Long with the goal of resurrecting their old master. To do so, they threaten Emperor Pilaf, Shuu, and Mai for the Dragon Balls in their possession.

Once successfully revived, Frieza—who had been stoking his hatred for Gokuu Son and Future Trunks in Hell—proclaims that he will not be content until they are dead by his hand. Sorbet informs him that Future Trunks has not been heard of in years, and Gokuu's power has far surpassed even that of the mighty Majin Buu. Unfazed, Frieza responds that he only requires a few months of training before being capable of defeating Gokuu.

Will Frieza be able to exact revenge upon his nemesis, or will Gokuu, Vegeta, and their friends prevail against adversity, saving Earth once more?
anime.consensus_summary: Fans are largely divided on "Fukkatsu no F," with many praising its spectacular animation, action, humor, and the triumphant return of Frieza. However, a significant portion of the audience expresses frustration with the numerous plot inconsistencies, nonsensical power scaling, and the underutilization of certain characters, leading to a polarized reception regarding its narrative quality.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style, often cited as the best in the Dragon Ball movie franchise.
Exciting and well-choreographed action sequences and fight scenes.
Nostalgic return of Frieza and the focus on classic character rivalries.
Strong comedic elements that are well-integrated and land effectively.
Excellent voice acting, particularly for iconic characters like Goku and Frieza.
Good pacing that keeps the movie engaging without excessive filler.
Inclusion of new characters like Jaco adds fresh dynamic and humor.
cons: Significant plot holes and continuity errors that undermine the established Dragon Ball lore.
The power scaling and Frieza's rapid increase in strength are often seen as unbelievable or 'BS'.
Many beloved supporting characters are sidelined or have their roles diminished.
The plot is overly simple and a rehash of familiar themes, lacking originality.
Some CGI elements are noticeable and detract from the otherwise excellent animation.
The ending is abrupt and some plot resolutions feel rushed or unsatisfying.
The narrative doesn't always feel 'earned,' with new transformations and power-ups appearing without sufficient buildup.

anime.title: Absolute Duo
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Individuals who can materialize weapons from their soul are called "Blazers," and they attend Kouryou Academy High School in order to harness their abilities. Each student is required to partner with another, in the hopes that one day, the pair can attain the power of Absolute Duo.

Tooru Kokonoe hopes to attend this academy in order to gain power after his sister and friends were slain by a mysterious man. However, at the opening ceremony, he is forced to duel against the person sitting next to him, with the loser being expelled. As Tooru prepares to give the match his all, it is not a weapon that manifests from his soul, but a shield, an irregularity which catches the attention of a foreign student named Julie Sigtuna.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative.  'Absolute Duo' is seen as a generic and uninspired harem anime that fails to deliver on its initial premise.  Viewers criticize its reliance on clichés, poor character development, and excessive fanservice, ultimately deeming it a waste of time for those seeking a compelling story or unique characters.
pros: Good voice acting
Decent art style and animation in some scenes
Catchy opening theme
cons: Unoriginal and clichéd story
Bland and uninspired characters
Excessive and unnecessary fanservice
Poorly explained plot points and world-building
Rushed and unsatisfying fight scenes
Lack of character development
Inconsistent animation quality
Forced and unconvincing romance

anime.title: Isuca
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Mythology, Romance, School, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Poor Shinichirou Asano has the worst of luck. His parents abandoned him and ran off to Europe. If that isn't bad enough on its own, they barely left him any money to take care of himself. In order to pay rent and keep a roof over his head, he has to work. Unfortunately, he was just fired from his last job and as a high school student, he doesn't have many other prospects.

One evening, he's attacked by a centipede monster on his way home. Shinichirou is saved by a mysterious girl with a bow and arrow, who he later discovers is Sakuya Shimazu, a beautiful student who attends his school. But when he later helps an injured girl, he discovers two things. First, the injured girl isn't human at all but rather a nekomata, a two-tailed demon cat. And second, Sakuya comes from a family of exorcists, who've protected humanity from rogue monsters and spirits for generations. Because Shinichirou was responsible for releasing the nekomata, Sakuya enlists his help in recapturing the demon, but that's just the beginning of Shinichirou's relationship with Sakuya. It turns out the Shimazu family needs a housekeeper and it just so happens that Shinichirou excels at cooking and likes to clean! It may not be his dream job, but if it pays the rent and puts food on the table...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Isuca" is poorly received as a generic and poorly executed ecchi anime. Critics highlight the unoriginal story, unlikeable characters, excessive fan service, and subpar production values. While some viewers found it mildly entertaining or appreciated certain aspects like the artwork, the overwhelming consensus is that the anime is a disappointment and a waste of time.
pros: Some found the storyline intriguing despite its flaws.
A few reviewers appreciated the artwork's vibrancy and motifs.
One reviewer noted the world-building of east vs. west magic as a potentially interesting aspect.
cons: Many found the story generic, predictable, and poorly executed.
Several reviewers criticized the excessive and poorly implemented fan service and censorship.
Characters were described as generic, underdeveloped, and unlikeable, particularly the tsundere heroine.
The animation was deemed subpar with awkward CGI, and the soundtrack forgettable.
The series was considered too short to adequately develop the story and characters, leaving many loose ends.

anime.title: Marvel Avengers Confidential: Black Widow & Punisher
anime.romaji_title: Avengers Confidential: Black Widow to Punisher
anime.synopsis:
After interfering with a top secret mission, the Punisher is taken into custody by S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent and Avenger, Black Widow. At the orders of Director Nick Fury, Punisher and Black Widow are sent on a mission to stop Leviathan, a global terrorist organization that plans to sell stolen S.H.I.E.L.D. technology to the highest bidder. Now, the vigilante and spy must work together to prevent this technology from falling into the wrong hands. The fate of the world, and of the Avengers, hangs in the balance. 

The Japan Blu-ray/DVD release date is September 3rd, 2014.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciated the depth, character portrayals, and action, while others disliked the romantic element and Black Widow's portrayal. The film sparked discussion about the perspectives of justice.
pros: Good blend of art style to the movie and Marvel characters.
Story stays true to each character's persona.
The pairing of Punisher and Black Widow is ideal.
The story has depth and keeps the viewer guessing.
The message revolves around perspective.
cons: Unnecessary romantic element felt flat.
Black Widow's portrayal was not well-received.

anime.title: Magic Kaito 1412
anime.synopsis:
Eight years after the mysterious death of his father, Kaito Kuroba, a slightly mischievous but otherwise ordinary teenager, discovers a shocking secret: the Phantom Thief Kaito Kid—also known as "The Magician Under the Moonlight"—was none other than his own father. The former thief was murdered by a criminal organization seeking a mythical stone called the Pandora Gem, said to shed a tear with the passing of the Valley Comet that comes every ten thousand years. When the tear is consumed, the gem supposedly grants immortality.

Vowing to bring those responsible for his father's death to justice, Kaito dons the Phantom Thief's disguise, stealing priceless jewels night after night to find the Pandora Gem before his enemies can use the power for themselves.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Magic Kaito 1412 as a lighthearted and entertaining series, particularly praising its connection to Detective Conan and the engaging magic tricks. However, some find the episodic format repetitive and the plot simplistic, lacking depth in character development. Overall, it's seen as a fun and visually appealing show, but not one that reaches high standards in terms of narrative complexity.
pros: Entertaining and enjoyable, especially for fans of magic and heists.
Appealing art style, often compared favorably to Detective Conan.
Engaging magic tricks and clever plots, offering a sense of wonder.
Enjoyable for fans of Detective Conan and Kaito Kid.
cons: Episodic format can become repetitive and formulaic.
Simplistic plots with a lack of substantial character development.
Unrealistic scenarios and reliance on suspension of disbelief.
Some CGI elements appear out of place.

anime.title: Yuki Yuna is a Hero
anime.romaji_title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru
anime.synopsis:
In her everyday life, Yuuna Yuuki is a hero. As proof, she is in her middle school's Hero Club, where she does her best to help others and bring a smile to everyone's face.

But Yuuna, always up to any task, is about to become an even bigger hero. Mysterious destructive forces called Vertexes begin threatening the world she loves, and the Hero Club is called upon by a strange phone app to save it. Along with her best friend Mimori Tougou, as well as sisters Fuu and Itsuki Inubouzaki, they must transform into magical girls in order to battle the Vertexes.

In between studying and putting on shows for kids, Yuuna and the Hero Club must fight for the very existence of their world and face the harsh truths behind their own powers, all the while discovering what it truly means to be a hero.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with some praising the show's emotional depth, music, and character development, while others criticize its pacing, lack of subtlety, and perceived similarities to Madoka Magica. Some find the initial slice-of-life elements misleading, while others appreciate the blend of genres. The show evokes strong emotional reactions, with many viewers reporting tearful experiences.
pros: Strong emotional impact and tear-jerking scenes.
Excellent soundtrack and immersive atmosphere.
Characters are well-developed and relatable.
cons: Initial slice-of-life elements may mislead viewers about the darker themes.
Inconsistent pacing and lack of subtlety in the drama.
Some viewers find the protagonist, Yuuki Yuuna, to be one-dimensional and uninteresting.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Slice of Life, Dark Fantasy

anime.title: Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel - I. Presage Flower
anime.romaji_title: Fate/stay night Movie: Heaven's Feel - I. Presage Flower
anime.synopsis:
The Holy Grail War: a violent battle between mages in which seven masters and their summoned servants fight for the Holy Grail, a magical artifact that can grant the victor any wish. Nearly 10 years ago, the final battle of the Fourth Holy Grail War wreaked havoc on Fuyuki City and took over 500 lives, leaving the city devastated. 

Shirou Emiya, a survivor of this tragedy, aspires to become a hero of justice like his rescuer and adoptive father, Kiritsugu Emiya. Despite only being a student, Shirou is thrown into the Fifth Holy Grail War when he accidentally sees a battle between servants at school and summons his own servant, Saber. 

When a mysterious shadow begins a murderous spree in Fuyuki City, Shirou aligns himself with Rin Toosaka, a fellow participant in the Holy Grail War, in order to stop the deaths of countless people. However, Shirou's feelings for his close friend Sakura Matou lead him deeper into the dark secrets surrounding the war and the feuding families involved.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided, with fans of the Fate series praising the visual quality and darker themes, while newcomers find the plot incomprehensible and the pacing rushed. Many feel prior knowledge is essential to enjoy the film. Some hardcore fans consider it a masterpiece, while others deem it a waste of time.
pros: Visually stunning animation and detailed art style
Engaging tonal and narrative contrast to previous Fate series
Explores themes of childhood trauma and abuse
cons: Incomprehensible plot for newcomers, requires prior knowledge of the Fate series
Rushed pacing and disjointed storytelling
Lacks a clear beginning, middle, and end, functions more as a side story OVA

anime.title: Sabage-bu! Specials
anime.synopsis: Short specials bundled with the volumes 1 to 6 of the Blu-ray releases of Sabagebu!
anime.consensus_summary: The Sabage-bu! Specials are a pleasant surprise, delivering quality comedy and action in short, well-crafted episodes. Viewers appreciate the originality of the jokes and the effort put into the bonus material. The overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive.
pros: Delivers well on both comedy and action.
Each episode is different and manages to pack a lot of jokes into a short time.
Unique and original jokes.
Creators put proper effort into bonus material.

anime.title: Junjo Romantica 3
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Boys Love, Comedy, Drama
anime.synopsis:
After living together for three years, Misaki Takahashi and Akihiko "Usagi" Usami's relationship has been progressing smoothly. However, all great relationships have problems, and theirs is just beginning. With a new rival on the horizon, Usagi worries about Misaki's feelings towards him. 

Meanwhile, Ryuuichirou Isaka has always loved to intrude on Misaki and Usagi's love life, but his own love life hasn't been all smooth sailing—Isaka and his secretary Kaoru Asahina have been dating for a few years; however, Asahina prefers to keep their professional and private lives separate, often leading to troubled waters between them.

As for Nowaki Kusama and Hiroki Kamijou, now that their careers are finally taking off, they hardly see each other anymore. With the time they spend together lessening, doubts and insecurities threaten to creep in between them. On the other hand, the 17-year age gap between Shinobu Takatsuki and You Miyagi has been a constant barrier in their relationship, but as they learn more about each other, their self-consciousness continues to fade.

The beloved couples of Junjou Romantica, Junjou Egoist, and Junjou Terrorist are back again, this time with a new addition: Junjou Mistake!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many appreciate the improved visuals and lighthearted romance, but some find the repetitive plot and slow character development frustrating. While enjoyable for fans of the genre, the lack of significant progress in the relationships is a common point of criticism.
pros: Improved art style and animation compared to previous seasons.
Enjoyable and lighthearted romance.
Good for yaoi genre enthusiasts.
cons: Slow character development, especially for Misaki.
Repetitive plot structure with recurring problems.
Fast-paced storytelling in Season 3 may feel rushed.

anime.title: Kamisama Kiss Season 2
anime.synopsis:
Nanami Momozono and her familiars Tomoe and Mizuki have survived quite a few challenges since Nanami took up the mantle of Mikage Shrine's patron god. Naturally, the wind god Otohiko comes to invite Nanami to the Divine Assembly in Izumo, the home of the gods, and Nanami chooses to take Mizuki with her, leaving Tomoe to pose as her at school. However, she has an ulterior motive for attending the Divine Assembly: to discover the whereabouts of the missing Lord Mikage, the former god of the shrine. 

After her adventures in Izumo, Nanami meets Botanmaru, a tengu child looking for someone she knows all too well—tengu turned goth idol Shinjirou Kurama. Botanmaru needs Shinjirou, their prince, to return home to Mount Kurama and stop the tyranny of Jirou, who has taken over the rule of their hometown. However, Nanami soon discovers a force much darker than Jirou is at work on the mountain.

As a fledgling god becoming more accustomed to divinity, Nanami finds herself dealing with a tengu rebellion, her blooming feelings for Tomoe, and a strange man with ties to both Tomoe's past and Nanami's future.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience consensus is highly positive. Viewers praise the second season for its character development, engaging storyline, and balance of romance, comedy, and supernatural elements. The main criticism revolves around the ending, with many hoping for a third season to resolve lingering plot points.
pros: Strong character development, especially Nanami's growth as a God and Tomoe's emotional arc.
Excellent blend of romance, comedy, and supernatural elements creates a comforting and engaging experience.
Art style is considered visually appealing and more mature compared to the first season by some viewers.
cons: Some viewers found the ending unsatisfying and wished for a continuation or more resolution.
A few viewers found the initial premise (reverse harem) off-putting.

anime.title: Digimon Adventure tri. Reunion
anime.synopsis:
The gate to the Digital World has been closed for three years. Taichi Yagami and his friends have since moved on, and now that he is in his second year of high school, it is time for him to grow up. While everyone else knows what they want to do with their lives, Taichi remains unsure. Meanwhile, the group drifts further apart as they follow their own paths.

One day, a rogue insectoid Digimon called Kuwagamon materializes and disrupts electronics all over the city. Taichi recklessly chases after it and ends up cornered by the attacking Digimon. Suddenly, the Digivice that he still carries—a digital device that serves various purposes including helping one's Digimon partner to evolve—glows, and Agumon appears. The two are able to defeat Kuwagamon, but why did the Digimon cross over to this world in the first place? What is happening in the Digital World, and how exactly does this involve Meiko Mochizuki, the new transfer student in Taichi's class?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is sharply divided, largely between those who cherish the nostalgia and character focus, and those severely disappointed by the technical execution and pacing. While the return of beloved characters and familiar music is a strong draw, the animation quality and a perceived lack of plot progression in this first installment are significant detractors for a large segment of the fanbase.
pros: The return of the original characters and their established personalities, despite their age, is a strong point for fans.
The soundtrack, including remixed versions of classic songs, effectively evokes nostalgia and enhances the viewing experience.
The premise of adulting and dealing with the consequences of past actions, particularly Taichi's internal conflict, is seen as a mature and interesting development.
The renewed focus on character relationships and the exploration of potential romantic subplots are appreciated by some viewers.
cons: The animation quality is frequently criticized as being poor, with excessive use of still frames, panning, and inconsistent character models.
The omission of animated Digimon evolutions beyond the Champion level, especially during key battles, is a significant disappointment for many.
The pacing is described as slow and uneventful, with a lack of clear plot progression in this introductory installment.
The character development of the new additions, particularly Meiko, is considered lacking, and their roles feel underdeveloped.
Inconsistencies with established lore from previous seasons regarding public awareness of Digimon are noted as poor writing.

anime.title: Tamayura: Sotsugyou Shashin Part 1 - Kizashi
anime.synopsis: The first movie of a four-part finale of Tamayura.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, emphasizing the show's relaxing and heart-warming qualities. Viewers appreciate the easy-to-follow narrative and the improved art. It's considered a good choice for those seeking a calming and uplifting experience.
pros: Relaxing and healing atmosphere
Easy to follow story with meaningful moments
Improved art quality

anime.title: Cross Ange: Rondo of Angel and Dragon
anime.romaji_title: Cross Ange: Tenshi to Ryuu no Rondo
anime.synopsis:
Angelise Ikaruga Misurugi is the first princess of the noble Misurugi Empire. The kingdom has seen great power and prosperity due to the advancement of the revolutionary technology known as "Mana," an abstract bending of light that has reduced the world's problems of war and pollution to a timeless peace. 

However, not all are blessed with the ability to wield Mana. Those who cannot are labeled "Norma," outcasts of society who are considered a threat to civilization and live under constant persecution, and Angelise herself is one of many who want the Norma exterminated. But as Angelise's sixteenth birthday commences, it is discovered in a shocking revelation that she is actually a Norma. Chaos ensues, the public is outraged, and the once adored princess is exiled to Arzenal: a remote military base where Normas are forced into conscription.

Now, the former royal must adapt to a harsh and vastly different lifestyle; piloting mechanical robots known as "Paramail" to fend off large, devastating beasts referred to as DRAGONs. However, a sinister truth about these savage creatures threatens to change everything.
anime.consensus_summary: Cross Ange is a highly divisive series. Some find it to be a trashy yet compelling story with well-developed characters, while others are turned off by its excessive fanservice, plot holes, and inconsistent production values. Despite its flaws, the series offers a unique storyline and explores themes of discrimination and individuality, leading to a satisfying conclusion for many viewers.
pros: Compelling story develops after initial episodes
Well-developed characters with unique personalities
Good action and graphics
cons: Over-the-top fanservice and shock value
Contrived motivations and weak villain
Inconsistent animation quality

anime.title: Yowapeda Re:RIDE
anime.synopsis: A retelling of the first season, taking place at Toudou's family inn where he, Makishima, and Onoda reflect on the events.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is positive, especially for fans of the series. Viewers appreciate the recap's ability to capture the essence of the original season while adding new, engaging content. The movie serves as a good refresher for the series.
pros: Successfully summarizes the first season.
Includes key scenes and iconic moments.
Adds movie-exclusive scenes that enhance character relationships.

anime.title: Attack on Titan Season 2
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Military, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
For centuries, humanity has been hunted by giant, mysterious predators known as the Titans. Three mighty walls—Wall Maria, Rose, and Sheena—provided peace and protection for humanity for over a hundred years. That peace, however, was shattered when the Colossal Titan and Armored Titan appeared and destroyed the outermost wall, Wall Maria. Forced to retreat behind Wall Rose, humanity waited with bated breath for the Titans to reappear and destroy their safe haven once more.

In Shingeki no Kyojin Season 2, Eren Yeager and others of the 104th Training Corps have just begun to become full members of the Survey Corps. As they ready themselves to face the Titans once again, their preparations are interrupted by the invasion of Wall Rose—but all is not as it seems as more mysteries are unraveled. As the Survey Corps races to save the wall, they uncover more about the invading Titans and the dark secrets of their own members.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 of Shingeki no Kyojin is a somewhat divisive entry. While some viewers appreciated the intensified plot and deeper mysteries, others were disappointed by perceived pacing problems, character development, or the quality of plot twists. However, the majority agrees that Season 2 moves beyond the initial action-oriented premise into a more complex narrative.
pros: Improved narrative direction and purpose compared to Season 1.
Fast-paced and engaging plot that doesn't rely on recaps.
Significant reveals and plot twists that deepen the story.
cons: Pacing issues, with some feeling it was too slow or rushed.
Character development felt lacking for some viewers, especially for minor characters.
Some plot twists felt forced or poorly executed.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: No Regrets
anime.synopsis:
Many years before becoming the famed captain of the Survey Corps, a young Levi struggles to survive in the capital's garbage dump, the Underground. As the boss of his own criminal operation, Levi attempts to get by with meager earnings while aided by fellow criminals, Isabel Magnolia and Farlan Church. With little hope for the future, Levi accepts a deal from the anti-expedition faction leader Nicholas Lobov, who promises the trio citizenship aboveground if they are able to successfully assassinate Erwin Smith, a squad leader of the Survey Corps.

As Levi and Erwin cross paths, Erwin acknowledges Levi's agility and skill and gives him the option to either become part of the expedition team, or be turned over to the Military Police, to atone for his crimes. Now closer to the man they are tasked to kill, the group plans to complete their mission and save themselves from a grim demise in the dim recesses of their past home. However, they are about to learn that the surface world is not as liberating as they had thought and that sometimes, freedom can come at a heavy price.

Based on the popular spin-off manga of the same name, Shingeki no Kyojin: Kuinaki Sentaku illustrates the encounter between two of Shingeki no Kyojin's pivotal characters, as well as the events of the 23rd expedition beyond the walls.
anime.consensus_summary: Most viewers find 'No Regrets' to be a worthwhile and emotionally resonant addition to the Attack on Titan universe, deepening the understanding of Levi's character and his relationship with Erwin. While some criticize the underdeveloped side characters and pacing issues, the overall consensus is positive, highlighting the excellent animation and impactful narrative. It is considered one of the best OVAs in the franchise.
pros: Excellent character development for Levi and Erwin.
High-quality animation, especially the 3D maneuver gear.
Emotional and impactful story that adds depth to the main series.
cons: New characters (Isabel and Farlan) are generic and predictable.
Story feels rushed or glossed over in some areas.
Some argue the story isn't essential to the main plot.

anime.title: Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu: Yotarou Hourou-hen
anime.romaji_title: Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu: Yotarou Hourou-hen
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Josei, Love Polygon, Performing Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Bundled with the special editions of the manga's 7th and 8th volumes.

When a certain man is released from prison, he knows exactly where he's heading first. After falling in love with a traditional comic storyteller's rendition of the story called "Shinigami," he is determined to become his apprentice. The performer, Yakumo, has never taken an apprentice before, but to everyone's surprise, he accepts the eager ex-prisoner, nicknaming him "Yotaro."

As Yotaro happily begins his new life, he meets others in Yakumo's life, including Yakumo's ward Konatsu. Konatsu was the daughter of a famous storyteller, and Yakumo took her in after her father's tragic death. Konatsu loved her father's storytelling, and would love to become a performer in her own right—but that path is not available for women.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is lukewarm due to the OVA being a rehash of the series' initial episodes with inferior quality. Viewers familiar with the 2016 series find it skippable and disappointing, while newcomers might not get the best impression of the overall narrative. It suffers from being an unnecessary and weaker version of existing content.
cons: Redundant content for viewers of the 2016 series
Lower video quality compared to the 2016 series
The first arc is considered the weakest part of the series.

anime.title: Pokémon the Movie: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 18: Ring no Choumajin Hoopa
anime.synopsis:
A century ago, the power of a mighty creature known as Hoopa, who is capable of single-handedly defeating legendary Pokémon, was captured in a bottle by a lone traveler. The bottle was then hidden deep inside a cave in the desert, in the hopes that the darkness sealed within it would never see the light of day again.

Years later, a young man finds the bottle and breaks the curses surrounding it, releasing the power confined within it. Its contents take the form of Hoopa's shadow, and it uses its unbound power to shatter the bottle and prevent anyone from capturing it again. The shadow then goes on a rampage and attacks the original Hoopa, while both Pokémon summon other legendary creatures to aid them in their brawl. Satoshi—a budding Pokémon trainer from the Kanto region—and his friends are caught up in the crossfire, and must now work to stop the ravaging Pokémon, or face a devastating clash of legends.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative, with critics finding the movie formulaic, boring, and overly reliant on legendary cameos as a blatant advertisement. While a few recall a sense of genuine danger and appreciate the visuals, the overwhelming critique points to a decline in quality and originality within the Pokemon movie franchise, making it difficult to recommend even for children.
pros: Beautiful visuals (despite some iffy CG)
Felt like lives were in genuine danger, unlike typical Pokemon fare
cons: Formulaic and derivative of previous movies
Music is forgettable
Team Rocket is used exceptionally badly
Lack of continuity makes legendary cameos feel wasted
Animation budget appears spread too thin, resulting in repetitive flying animations
Battle sequences are unimpressive and boring
Inconsistent handling of city population during battle scenes
Disconnect between events and stakes due to lack of human-legendary interaction
Plot is bare-bones and feels like an advertisement for games (Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire)
Characters (Hoopa, Baraz, Meray) are bland or irritating
Ash and friends have little to do with the plot
Movie is too long and boring, especially the first half
Cash-grabby sentiment due to excessive legendary cameos

anime.title: Shirobako
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Award Winning, Comedy, Drama, Otaku Culture, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
It all started in Kaminoyama High School, when five best friends—Aoi Miyamori, Ema Yasuhara, Midori Imai, Shizuka Sakaki, and Misa Toudou—discovered their collective love for all things anime and formed the animation club. After making their first amateur anime together and showcasing it at the culture festival, the group vows to pursue careers in the industry, aiming to one day work together and create their own mainstream show.

Two and a half years later, Aoi and Ema have managed to land jobs at the illustrious Musashino Animation production company. The others, however, are finding it difficult to get their dream jobs. Shizuka is feeling the weight of not being recognized as a capable voice actor, Misa has a secure yet unsatisfying career designing 3D models for a car company, and Midori is a university student intent on pursuing her dream as a story writer. These five girls will learn that the path to success is one with many diversions, but dreams can still be achieved through perseverance and a touch of eccentric creativity.
