New viewers may find the content confusing and nonsensical, as it relies heavily on familiarity with the original series. Overall, the audience response is mild, with little controversy.
pros: Improvisational humor
Focus on voice actress interactions
Lighthearted and nonsensical
cons: Requires familiarity with the original series
Content may be difficult to understand for new viewers
Plot is mostly non-existent.

anime.title: Wake Up, Girls! Shadow of Youth
anime.romaji_title: Wake Up, Girls! Seishun no Kage
anime.synopsis: Movie sequel of Wake Up, Girls!, announced at Wake Up, Girls! Festa.2014 Winter.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is praised for its realistic depiction of the idol industry and the struggles of a newly debuted pop group. The story is engaging despite lacking intense drama or action, focusing on the characters' adjustment to the major label environment.  The audience generally appreciates the natural flow of the narrative.
pros: Realistic portrayal of the idol industry
Natural story flow
Engaging despite lack of action

anime.title: A Silent Voice
anime.synopsis:
As a wild youth, elementary school student Shouya Ishida sought to beat boredom in the cruelest ways. When the deaf Shouko Nishimiya transfers into his class, Shouya and the rest of his class thoughtlessly bully her for fun. However, when her mother notifies the school, he is singled out and blamed for everything done to her. With Shouko transferring out of the school, Shouya is left at the mercy of his classmates. He is heartlessly ostracized all throughout elementary and middle school, while teachers turn a blind eye.

Now in his third year of high school, Shouya is still plagued by his wrongdoings as a young boy. Sincerely regretting his past actions, he sets out on a journey of redemption: to meet Shouko once more and make amends.

Koe no Katachi tells the heartwarming tale of Shouya's reunion with Shouko and his honest attempts to redeem himself, all while being continually haunted by the shadows of his past.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Koe no Katachi' are divided. Some praise the film's beautiful animation, emotional depth, and courageous exploration of bullying and redemption, while others criticize its rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, and superficial treatment of complex themes.  The adaptation from the manga is a major point of contention, with many feeling that crucial plot points and character development were omitted, resulting in a less impactful narrative.
pros: Beautiful animation by Kyoto Animation.
Creative use of sound and music to enhance emotional impact.
Addresses complex issues like bullying and forgiveness.
Emotionally engaging and can evoke tears, sadness, anger, happiness, and laughs.
cons: Story feels rushed, with plot holes and cut sub-plots.
Side characters lack depth due to severe cuts to their stories.
Thematic elements such as ableism and trauma are not fully explored.
Character development feels incomplete and rushed.

anime.title: Pikachu and the Pokemon Music Squad
anime.synopsis: Pikachu and the rest of the group practice singing and dancing, as well as rehearsing their segments, until they realize Luchabull (Hawlucha) can't sing! Now it's up to Pikachu and everybody else to encourage Luchabull into getting back on cue before they have to do the show for real! Will they succeed?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative, viewing the special as annoying despite the appealing animation and cute characters. The repetitive singing and weak drama contribute to a generally unfavorable experience. While some viewers appreciate the cuteness, the overall sentiment leans towards disappointment.
pros: Animation is great
Pokemon are cute
cons: Annoying special
Singing pokemon are annoying
Drama is just okay

anime.title: Takamiya Nasuno desu! Teekyuu Spin-off
anime.synopsis: A spin-off from Teekyuu which centers on the daily life of Nasuno Takamiya, the "exceedingly airheaded" school tennis club member in Teekyuu, and her friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the show's continuation of Teekyuu's absurd humor and the voice acting, while others find it repetitive, lacking the charm of the ensemble cast, and ultimately unnecessary. The spin-off struggles to justify its existence, especially without significant changes from the original series. It mainly appeals to hardcore fans of the original series.
pros: Good voice acting enhances the characters' personalities.
The show retains some of the qualities of Teekyuu that fans might still enjoy.
Fun and unexpected elements contribute to the anime's enjoyment.
cons: The spin-off feels redundant and doesn't offer anything new compared to the original Teekyuu.
The absence of other characters makes the show less entertaining, with Nasuno's shtick becoming repetitive.
The plot is too random and lacks resolution, making it boring for some viewers.

anime.title: JOKER 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
Second season in the Kaitou Joker anime series.

The thief Mysterious Joker doesn't just steal things. An audacious and elusive miracle-maker, he travels the world searching for treasure with his partner and cook Hachi. As they circle the globe, they must avoid traps set by the police and compete in various competitions to reach their final goal, the Timeslip Treasure.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season expands upon the characters' backstories, particularly focusing on Professor Clover's manipulative nature. The audience appreciates the development of the plot and villain, though some find Queen's role less significant. Overall, the season is viewed positively for its character depth and engaging narrative.
pros: Character background stories are explored deeply.
The plotline advances heavily, providing awesome episodes.
Professor Clover is a compelling and menacing villain.
cons: Queen is the weakest Kaitou and doesn't steal often.

anime.title: Initial D Legend 2 Racer
anime.romaji_title: New Initial D Movie: Legend 2 - Tousou
anime.synopsis:
After witnessing the race between Takumi Fujiwara's Toyota AE86 and Keisuke Takahashi's Mazda RX7, Takeshi Nakazato from the Myougi Night Kids sends out a challenge to defeat the AE86 in a downhill battle. Despite his Nissan Skyline GT-R completely outclassing the AE86, Nakazato is told that he will never beat Takumi—a statement that enrages him. Believing that grip racing is far superior to flashy drift racing, Nakazato is dead set on defeating the AE86 to prove that he is the better racer.

Thanks to Itsuki Takeuchi's hasty acceptance of the match on his behalf, Takumi is reluctant to get involved with the challenge and chooses not to race, stating that he is not a racer by any means. Overseeing the dilemma, Takumi's employer goads him into accepting. However, when Takumi returns home to get the AE86, he finds that his father has taken the car out for himself. As he waits for his father's return, Takumi begins to feel his itch to race grow ever more.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience appreciates the visual upgrades and character development compared to previous installments. The lack of Eurobeat music and the use of CG animation are points of contention for some viewers, but overall the movie is seen as a worthwhile continuation for fans of Initial D. The audience has a moderately positive consensus.
pros: Improved Visuals
Better Character Depth
cons: Lack of Eurobeat
CG Animation

anime.title: Aria the Scarlet Ammo AA
anime.synopsis:
Akari Mamiya, a first-year student from Tokyo Butei High, idolizes the S-rank Butei Aria Holmes Kanzaki and wishes to follow in her footsteps. Despite only being an inept E-rank Butei, Akari's resolve to improve remains strong. After the idea of having an Amica contract (a senior-student mentorship program) with Aria is brought up, Akari submits a request form attempting to establish said contract. Her classmates and friends do not expect Aria to accept Akari's request, mainly because of the girl's strict selection process, but to everyone's surprise, Aria gives Akari a chance through a test, which Akari miraculously passes! However, Aria will not officially make Akari her Amica until Akari meets her standards.

Training under Aria will be no easy feat, as she has to concurrently manage her relationships with her friends. Will Akari have what it takes to walk down the same path as her idol?
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Hidan no Aria AA' is a disappointing spin-off that doesn't live up to the original. While some viewers enjoy the cute art style and relaxing slice-of-life elements, most find the plot weak, the characters underdeveloped, and the action underwhelming. The focus on Yuri fan service is a divisive element, with some appreciating it and others finding it tedious.
pros: Excellent art and animation, characters look cute.
Enjoyable and pleasant to watch, relaxing and warm.
The opening theme is awesome and the OST suits the series.
cons: Weak and predictable plot, often episodic with minimal story progression.
Characters are flat, lack development and the focus shifts away from the main character.
Mediocre fight scenes that are uninspired.
Over-reliance on Yuri fan service.

anime.title: Haikyu!! 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
Following their participation at the Inter-High, the Karasuno High School volleyball team attempts to refocus their efforts, aiming to conquer the Spring tournament instead. 

When they receive an invitation from long-standing rival Nekoma High, Karasuno agrees to take part in a large training camp alongside many notable volleyball teams in Tokyo and even some national level players. By playing with some of the toughest teams in Japan, they hope not only to sharpen their skills, but also come up with new attacks that would strengthen them. Moreover, Hinata and Kageyama attempt to devise a more powerful weapon, one that could possibly break the sturdiest of blocks. 

Facing what may be their last chance at victory before the senior players graduate, the members of Karasuno's volleyball team must learn to settle their differences and train harder than ever if they hope to overcome formidable opponents old and new—including their archrival Aoba Jousai and its world-class setter Tooru Oikawa.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves Haikyuu!! Second Season, praising its character development, motivating themes, and well-paced storytelling. Some find the plot simple and reliant on genre tropes, but this does not detract significantly from the overall positive reception. Many viewers found the anime inspiring, creating a deep connection and emotional investment.
pros: Excellent character development, even for secondary characters.
Motivating and inspirational, impacting viewers beyond entertainment.
Well-paced storytelling with a good balance of training and matches.
cons: Simple story, lacking complex plots or twists.
First half pacing can be slow as the story develops all characters
Relies on common shounen tropes.

anime.title: GATE
anime.romaji_title: Gate: Jieitai Kanochi nite, Kaku Tatakaeri
anime.synopsis:
Off-duty Japan Self-Defense Forces (JSDF) officer and otaku Youji Itami is on his way to attend a doujin convention in Ginza, Tokyo when a mysterious portal in the shape of a large gate suddenly appears. From this gate, supernatural creatures and warriors clad in medieval armor emerge, charging through the city, killing and destroying everything in their path. With swift actions, Youji saves as many lives as he can while the rest of the JSDF direct their efforts toward stopping the invasion.

Three months after the attack, Youji has been tasked with leading a special recon team, as part of a JSDF task force, that will be sent to the world beyond the gate—now being referred to as the "Special Region." They must travel into this unknown world in order to learn more about what they are dealing with and attempt to befriend the locals in hopes of creating peaceful ties with the ruling empire. But if they fail, they face the consequence of participating in a devastating war that will engulf both sides of the gate.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some appreciate the unique premise and military details, while others criticize the nationalistic themes and shallow plot. The harem elements and perceived propaganda are major points of contention, leading to a polarized reception. Ultimately, the execution fails to live up to the initial potential.
pros: Unique premise of modern military vs. fantasy world.
Detailed depiction of military tactics and equipment.
Engaging blend of fantasy and realism.
cons: Overly nationalistic and pro-military propaganda.
Generic harem elements detract from the main plot.
Underdeveloped plot with unanswered questions and inconsistencies.

anime.title: Seraph of the End: Battle in Nagoya
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Military, Shounen, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Yuuichirou Hyakuya is finally reunited with his childhood friend Mikaela Hyakuya, whom he had long presumed to be dead. Upon their reunion, however, he discovers that Mikaela has been turned into a vampire. Determined to help his friend, Yuuichirou vows to get stronger so that he can protect Mikaela as well as the comrades in the Moon Demon Company.
 
Kureto Hiiragi receives information that a large group of vampires will be gathering in Nagoya, preparing for their assault on the Imperial Demon Army's main forces in Tokyo. Led by Guren Ichinose, Yuuichirou's team is one of many selected to intercept and eliminate the vampire nobles.
 
With the Nagoya mission quickly approaching, the members of Shinoa squad continue to work towards fully mastering their weapons, while learning how to improve their teamwork. Yuuichirou must gain the power he needs to slay the nobles and save his best friend, before he succumbs to the demon of the Cursed Gear.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some appreciate the action, character development, and emotional depth, while others criticize the generic elements, pacing issues, shallow plot, and poor writing. There is a split between those who find it enjoyable and those who consider it mediocre or disappointing.
pros: Exciting action sequences and battles
Faithful adaptation of the manga (for some parts)
Good animation and art style
Well-developed characters, particularly Yuuichirou and Mikaela
Strong emotional drama and exploration of interpersonal relationships
Soundtrack by Hiroyuki Sawano is praised
Intriguing plot twists and turns
cons: Generic shounen elements and reliance on tropes
Inconsistent pacing, with some episodes feeling rushed or dragged out
Repetitive emphasis on 'family' bonds
Shallow or underdeveloped characters
Predictable plot developments and deus ex machina moments
Convoluted storyline with poorly developed agendas and unanswered questions
Mediocre dialogue and writing
Incomplete or unsatisfying ending
Poor adaptation from manga source
Rushed plot developments
Superficial story.

anime.title: Vampire Holmes
anime.synopsis:
The great detective Holmes does not solve mysteries or use deductive reasoning. He does, however, hunt vampires. Using three-minute episodes, Vampire Holmes retells the story of the great Holmes and his assistant. What begins as an ordinary detective agency takes a turn for the occult when the Metropolitan Police of London secretly hire Holmes and Hudson to investigate vampires.

Or at least that's what Holmes would tell anyone who asks. In reality, he and Hudson spend most of their time sitting around arguing, and failing to solve any cases. Joined by the not-so-black, demon cat Kira, and their terrifying rent-hungry landlady, this is the story of the man who was most definitely not London's greatest detective.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely negative towards Vampire Holmes, citing its abysmal animation, nonsensical plot, and unfunny humor. However, a small subset of viewers find the show enjoyable precisely because of its flaws, embracing it as a 'so bad it's good' experience. The short episode length is appreciated by some, while others find the constant product placement irritating.
pros: Opening theme is catchy and surprisingly good.
So bad it's funny; enjoyable as a train wreck.
Short episodes don't overstay its welcome.
cons: Terrible animation and art quality.
Poorly written with unfunny jokes and nonsensical plot.
Synopsis is misleading and unrelated to the actual story.
Characters are flat, underdeveloped, and unlikeable.
Obnoxious product placement.

anime.title: Mushi-Shi: The Next Chapter - Drops of Bells
anime.romaji_title: Mushishi Zoku Shou: Suzu no Shizuku
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Adventure, Historical, Iyashikei, Mystery, Seinen, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
On a warm summer day, a boy heard the sound of bells ringing, as if in celebration, in the mountain near his home. Several years later in that same mountain, the mushishi Ginko encounters a strange girl with weeds growing out of her body. Soon after, Ginko coincidentally runs into the now grown-up boy Yoshiro on his way off the mountain. With Yoshiro's help, Ginko soon begins to uncover who this mysterious girl is and what happened to her.

An adaptation of the last arc in the manga, Mushishi Zoku Shou: Suzu no Shizuku follows Ginko's peculiar journey amidst the occult to unravel the mystery behind the enigmatic girl called Kaya and the mountain that has become her home.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely appreciates 'Mushishi Zoku Shou: Suzu no Shizuku' as a fitting end to the series, praising its art, sound, and thematic depth. While some desired a more definitive conclusion or found certain characters less engaging, the overall sentiment is positive.  It is viewed as a thoughtful and beautiful exploration of nature and humanity's place within it.
pros: Beautiful art and animation that captures nature
Excellent sound design and fitting OST
Exploration of deep themes like interconnectedness and humanity's relationship with nature
cons: Some find the characters in the special less charismatic than in previous episodes
Some viewers were disappointed it didn't provide a more conclusive ending for Ginko

anime.title: Gintama Season 4
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Gintoki, Shinpachi, and Kagura return as the fun-loving but broke members of the Yorozuya team! Living in an alternate-reality Edo, where swords are prohibited and alien overlords have conquered Japan, they try to thrive on doing whatever work they can get their hands on. However, Shinpachi and Kagura still haven't been paid... Does Gin-chan really spend all that cash playing pachinko?

Meanwhile, when Gintoki drunkenly staggers home one night, an alien spaceship crashes nearby. A fatally injured crew member emerges from the ship and gives Gintoki a strange, clock-shaped device, warning him that it is incredibly powerful and must be safeguarded. Mistaking it for his alarm clock, Gintoki proceeds to smash the device the next morning and suddenly discovers that the world outside his apartment has come to a standstill. With Kagura and Shinpachi at his side, he sets off to get the device fixed; though, as usual, nothing is ever that simple for the Yorozuya team.

Filled with tongue-in-cheek humor and moments of heartfelt emotion, Gintama's fourth season finds Gintoki and his friends facing both their most hilarious misadventures and most dangerous crises yet.
anime.consensus_summary: Gintama° receives high praise for its blend of comedy and serious storylines, expanding upon the setting and characters established in previous seasons. While some viewers found the plot complicated or the characters unusual, the majority appreciates the emotional depth and humor. The series maintains its quality, offering a satisfying viewing experience, though some note a slight dip in comedy towards the end.
pros: Great variety in comedy and serious arcs
Expands greatly upon the setting and characters
Fights are great
Riveting, engaging, emotional arcs
Characters make you laugh and cry
cons: Comedy is affected in the last third of the season
Too complicated plot with unexpected twists
Characters are too unusual and weird
Plot was too complicated

anime.title: To LOVE Ru Darkness 2
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
The dispassionate, transforming assassin Golden Darkness returns to peer deeper into the mysteries surrounding her new life, while a sinister Nemesis manipulates her younger sister Mea from the shadows. Along with their newly discovered mother, Tearju, this previously estranged family quickly becomes the center of everyone's attention. On the other hand, Princess Momo's Harem Plan stands on shaky ground amidst Rito's inability to confess to his longtime crush Haruna, who has grown feelings of her own.

But things aren't as peaceful as they seem; an evil force looms amidst the innocuous commotion, threatening to eclipse the love, happiness, and friendship of Rito and his harem. Only the light of love can hope to banish the shadow.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many appreciating the improved animation, character development, and plot progression compared to previous seasons. However, some find the excessive and repetitive ecchi elements tiresome, and are disappointed by the sidelining of original heroines. While some appreciate the shift in focus to the 'Darkness' characters, others feel it detracts from the original love triangle.
pros: Improved animation and art style compared to earlier seasons.
Character development for side characters like Momo, Nana, Mea, and Yami.
Engaging story with a good balance of comedy, ecchi, and plot progression, especially in the later episodes.
Enjoyable fan service that enhances the comedy without overshadowing the story.
cons: Repetitive ecchi scenes and Rito's constant accidental groping can become tiresome.
Main characters like Lala and Haruna are sidelined, with focus shifting to new harem members.
Lack of significant romantic progress between Rito and the main heroines.
The plot and character development sometimes take a backseat to fan service, making it feel pointless.

anime.title: Rainy Cocoa
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Slice of Life, Workplace
anime.synopsis: Aoi Tokura is a server at Rainy Color, a cozy and diverse cafe known for its hot cocoa. Along with barista Shion Koga, Aoi serves a small crowd of regulars who are attracted by his girlish good looks. When two handsome college students start frequenting the cafe as well, Aoi cannot help but be drawn into their lives.
anime.consensus_summary: Ame-iro Cocoa is a very short slice-of-life anime that fails to deliver a compelling story or develop its characters. While some appreciate its relaxing atmosphere and cute aesthetic, most find it boring and forgettable. The extremely short episodes and lack of substance make it a disappointing experience for many viewers.
pros: Relaxing atmosphere
Catchy opening song
Good voice acting
cons: Nonexistent story
Flat characters
Generic art style
Very short episodes
Lack of character development

anime.title: Charlotte
anime.synopsis:
If not for his ability to take over people's mind and body, Yuu Otosaka would be an ordinary high school student. Though it only lasts for five seconds at a time, Yuu's mysterious power allowed him to cheat his way to the top of his class and  enter a prestigious high school, where he continues his dishonest acts.

His shenanigans are eventually stopped by Nao Tomori—the headstrong student council president from Hoshinoumi Academy—who sees through his deceit. Through coercion, Nao convinces Yuu to transfer to Hoshinoumi and join the student council. Hoshinoumi Academy is secretly an institution created for adolescents who possess supernatural abilities—with the student council serving as a means of locating those who abuse their powers.

With Yuu begrudgingly assisting in council affairs, the group sets out to find and protect new ability users from harm. However, as they further investigate the abilities, their findings entangle them in far more complicated matters than they could ever imagine.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Charlotte are highly divided. Some praise the emotional story, character development, and art, considering it a masterpiece. However, many criticize the rushed plot, inconsistencies, and underdeveloped characters, leading to disappointment and a sense of wasted potential.
pros: Appealing art style and animation.
Characters changing positively.
Surprising plots.
cons: Rushed and inconsistent story.
Poor pacing and filler content.
Underdeveloped characters.
Plot holes and lack of believability.
Inherent lack of confidence in having compelling characters and telling an interesting story.

anime.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil OVA
anime.romaji_title: Shinmai Maou no Testament: Toujou Basara no Hard Sweet na Nichijou
anime.synopsis:
OVA episode of Shinmai Maou no Testament, sold with the eight volume of the light novel of the same property.

Part A: Maria is up to her ususal hijinx using a new prototype succubus video camera she tries to record one of Mio's erotic dreams.

Part B: Basara is invited by Hasegawa Sensei to her apartment for dinner. He gets more hospitality than he ever would have expected!
anime.consensus_summary: This OVA is overwhelmingly viewed as pure fanservice with minimal plot, making it a polarizing watch. While fans of extreme ecchi find it highly enjoyable and even superior to other entries in the genre, those seeking narrative depth or character development will be deeply disappointed. Its appeal is strictly limited to a niche audience that prioritizes explicit content over story.
pros: Exceptional fanservice that surpasses other ecchi titles
Uncensored art quality provides a superior viewing experience
Well-executed ecchi scenarios and scenarios
Satisfying voice acting, particularly for the nurse character
Focus on slice-of-life and consensual tension is more enjoyable than the main plot

Characters and their motivations make little sense within the OVA's structure
Dialogue can be dragged out and serves only to set up ecchi moments
Can be considered softcore hentai with little artistic merit beyond fanservice

anime.title: I Can't Understand What My Husband Is Saying: 2nd Thread
anime.romaji_title: Danna ga Nani wo Itteiru ka Wakaranai Ken 2 Sure-me
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Otaku Culture, Romance
anime.synopsis:
The Tsunashi couple is as lively and offbeat as ever. Hardcore otaku shut-in Hajime and workaholic office lady Kaoru still get themselves into hilarious situations thanks to both their own eccentric natures and the bizarre group of friends surrounding them.

After learning about Kaoru's pregnancy, Hajime works harder than ever to become a good husband and a worthy father. Meanwhile, Kaoru reflects on their relationship and remembers all of the trials and tribulations that brought them closer. The two of them continue to put their best foot forward in their lives and their marriage—all for the sake of long-lasting, selfless love.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is generally well-received by fans of the first, praising its heartwarming portrayal of married life and humor. Some find the short episode length limiting, and the later episodes' shift in tone is criticized. Overall, it's considered a cute and enjoyable series, especially for those seeking a lighthearted, easy-to-watch anime.
pros: Heartwarming and feel-good relationship dynamics.
Humorous portrayal of otaku culture and married life.
Short format makes it easy and quick to watch.
cons: Short episodes limit plot depth and character development.
Repetitive humor may become stale.
Later episodes deviate from established tone confusingly.

anime.title: The Labyrinth of Grisaia: The Cocoon of Caprice 0
anime.romaji_title: Grisaia no Meikyuu: Caprice no Mayu 0
anime.synopsis:
Having attended Mihama Academy for about a year, Yuuji Kazami has seemingly found his place within the school, but he suddenly decides to pursue a promotion in CIRS. After consulting JB about his intentions, they both thoroughly examine Yuuji's documents and dissect the events of his upbringing to determine if the job is fit for him.

Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the two, the girls of Mihama uncover some torn documents in Yuuji's room. After restoring the papers, they discover the story that has formed—or perhaps broken—Yuuji into the man he is today. However, what was thought to be history has haunted him to the present, and the chains of the past begin to drag him back into the darkness...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the deeper understanding of Yuuji's past and the engaging storytelling, others find the tragic elements excessive and manipulative. The prequel is considered essential for understanding the second season, but its dark themes and rushed adaptation have generated controversy.
pros: Good character development for Yuuji and Kazuki.
The story provides context and understanding for Yuuji's behavior in the main series.
Well-paced and emotionally engaging flashback story.
cons: The story can be overly manipulative and gratuitously tragic.
Some found the incestuous elements disturbing.
Rushed pacing in the adaptation diminishes the impact of character deaths and events.

anime.title: The Eden of Grisaia
anime.synopsis:
Grisaia no Rakuen begins right at the end of the previous installment, Grisaia no Meikyuu. Kazami Yuuji is arrested under suspicion for terrorism. A video showing apparently concrete proof that Yuuji committed these acts, and he is held in custody by Ichigaya.

Ichigaya knows full well that Yuuji didn't commit the crimes he has been accused of. But he did fail to assassinate Heath Oslo, who is the leader of the terrorist organization with an extremely devastating weapon in their possession. In fact, Ichigaya have their own plans for Yuuji... 

But all may not be lost for Yuuji. The girls of the Mihama Academy are not about to let Yuuji be used for political gain, and neither may the mysterious new figure which appears before them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed but leans positive. Many appreciate the improved character development, particularly focusing on Yuuji's past, and the more faithful adaptation compared to the first season. However, concerns exist regarding rushed pacing towards the end and the inclusion of certain controversial elements from the source material.  Some found these elements detracted from their enjoyment.
pros: Character development is well-executed and in-depth, especially for Yuuji.
Pacing is solid and the story is easier to follow than the first season.
Faithful adaptation of the visual novel with little noteworthy content left out.
Action scenes are well-done and the animation is impressive.
cons: The ending feels rushed and crammed, potentially due to time constraints.
Some viewers found certain sexual relationships in Yuuji's backstory unnecessary and immersion-breaking.
Pacing issues in the prequel OVA, with too much exposition and lurid scenes.

anime.title: Grisaia no Kajitsu Specials
anime.synopsis: Short specials added to Blu-ray/DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The Grisaia no Kajitsu Specials are primarily focused on fanservice and feature highly sexualized content. While some viewers appreciate this aspect, particularly fans of specific characters, others find it excessive and lacking in plot. The overall reception is mixed, with some considering it enjoyable and others finding it awkward or even disgusting.
pros: Satisfies inappropriate thoughts
Focuses on different girls in each episode
Enjoyable for fans of specific characters
cons: Excessively sexualized content
Lack of plot
Borderline hentai scenarios
Some episodes considered awkward or disgusting

anime.title: Seiyu's Life!
anime.synopsis:
Dreaming of becoming a top-tier professional in the fast-paced, competitive world of voice acting, rookie Futaba Ichinose frantically scurries around, searching for auditions and performance sessions. Rubbing elbows with some of the biggest names in the industry, she tries to find her own unique voice and style.
 
Along the way, she befriends two important allies: Ichigo Moesaki, an aspiring idol who claims to be a princess from another planet, and Rin Kohana, a cheerful child actress who tries her best to balance her career and school at the same time. Together, the girls brave the ups and downs of the entertainment industry—but as for Futaba, whose performance assessment at her agency is just around the corner, her career might be over sooner than expected! Sore ga Seiyuu! is a humorous and sincere celebration of the industry that gives anime its voice.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Sore ga Seiyuu!' is well-received for its informative and realistic portrayal of the voice acting industry.  Viewers appreciate the relatable characters and the inspirational message about pursuing one's dreams.  However, some find the animation and story pacing to be lacking, and the focus on idol aspects may not appeal to everyone. It's considered a hidden gem for those interested in the inner workings of the seiyuu world.
pros: Informative about the voice acting industry.
Relatable characters striving for their dreams.
Realistic portrayal of the challenges faced by voice actors.
Features cameos by famous voice actors.
Calm and relaxing vibe.
cons: Animation is simple and sometimes inconsistent.
Story can be slow-paced.
Focuses on the idol aspect which may not appeal to all viewers.
Superficial exploration of some topics.
Characters can be stock or stereotypical.

anime.title: Saekano: Fan Service of Love and Youth
anime.romaji_title: Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata: Ai to Seishun no Service-kai
anime.synopsis: The latest game by Blessing Software needs one final push to make it over the finish line. To help with this, the team ventures out to the Japanese countryside for location scouting. Illustrator Eriri Spencer Sawamura and model Megumi Kato busy themselves with work. However, scriptwriter Utaha Kasumigaoka and music producer Michiru Hyoudou have other plans with their teammate Tomoya Aki. With the four girls all fighting for his attention, Tomoya finds himself in increasingly risqué situations.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the parody and character introductions while others find the fanservice excessive and the plot lacking. The OVA is seen as skippable for those not interested in fanservice, and its placement in the overall series timeline is confusing for some viewers. Overall, enjoyment depends heavily on pre-existing knowledge of the source material and tolerance for the harem genre.
pros: The OVA portrays the characters' feelings well.
Good character introductions, keeping it light-weight.
The art is very Saekano-like.
cons: Skippable unless you're into fanservice.
Pretends to parody excessive fanservice and harem tropes as an excuse to regurgitate the same.
Fanservice-filled with no real plot or story introduced.
Plot development is lacking.
Biggest turn off was the rape

anime.title: Ghost in the Shell: Arise - Alternative Architecture
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Detective, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
A TV anime version of Ghost in the Shell: Arise. The first eight episodes are an edited version of the four movies while the last two features a new arc called "Pyrophoric Cult."

The plot involves the "Fire Starter" virus explored previously, and introduces the new character Pyromania. The episode will have ties to the upcoming film.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Fans of Ghost in the Shell appreciate the action, visuals, and philosophical elements, but are critical of the convoluted plot, the re-edited story order, and the writing quality, particularly in the later episodes. Some find the series a worthwhile addition to the franchise if viewed in the correct order, while others find it pretentiously dumb and filled with plot holes.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style
Fantastic soundtrack and sound quality
Fun interactions between characters and support bots
Exploration of cyberterrorism and government corruption
cons: Convoluted and hard-to-follow plot in some episodes (especially 7 and 8)
Bizarre re-ordering of the story that spoils the original Arise films
Questionable writing in later episodes, with antagonists succeeding via plot contrivances
Dubbing with different voice actors can be jarring

anime.title: Aki no Kanade
anime.genres: Music, Performing Arts, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Aki Miyagawa has loved the sound of traditional Japanese drums ever since she first heard them in her youth. Now a professional drummer in Tokyo, she struggles to keep her passion alive while also having to work a second job to make ends meet. When she gets a call from Michio Yoshioka, the teacher who introduced her to drums, Aki has a chance to return to her hometown and reflect on the path she took to reach where she is now, reigniting her passion in the process.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the short film's positive message and appealing aesthetics. However, the consensus is that the limited runtime hinders deeper story and character development. Many feel the ending is rushed and leaves several plot threads unresolved, resulting in a somewhat unsatisfying experience.
pros: Charming and comfy, worth the short watch time
Beautiful art and animation, reminiscent of 'Your Lie in April'
Positive message about following your dreams
cons: Story feels rushed and underdeveloped due to the short length
Unresolved plot points and character relationships
Ending feels abrupt and lacks satisfying resolution

anime.title: Kuroko no Basket: Oshaberi Demo Shimasen ka
anime.romaji_title: Kuroko no Basket: Oshaberi Demo Shimasen ka
anime.genres: Comedy, School, Shounen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: Special included on Kuroko no Basket Fan Disc 2: Hikari Sasu Basho e.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the episode as a lighthearted and comedic recap, appreciating the character interactions and jokes. However, some find the recap format repetitive and feel it doesn't contribute meaningfully to the overall narrative. The episode is primarily fan service, and its reception depends on the viewer's tolerance for meta-commentary and recaps.
pros: Funny banter and jokes from the characters
Interesting to see characters discuss events they wouldn't normally
Original animations and conversations are enjoyable
cons: Recap episode format is repetitive
Episode doesn't add anything to the main story
Too much reliance on meta humor

anime.title: Ultimate Otaku Teacher
anime.genres: Comedy, Otaku Culture, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Junichirou Kagami is a young published physicist, a genius, and a hopeless otaku. At the mercy of YD, a self-diagnosed illness which causes him to only be able to do what he "Yearns to Do," Junichirou foregoes his scientific career to maintain and improve his anime blog. However, when he gets hired as a high school physics teacher; his sister Suzune, no longer willing to tolerate his NEET lifestyle, forces him to take the position. 

Despite the fact that Junichirou has no motivation to teach the standard curriculum, he may still have something of value to teach his students outside of academics. With his class in tow, Junichirou embarks on an unlikely journey filled with life lessons such as acceptance of others, how to make lasting friends, and what it means to live a better life by doing what you yearn to do.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding enjoyment in the otaku-themed humor and unconventional teaching methods, while others criticize the repetitive plot, weak character development, and inconsistent production quality. The show's episodic nature and reliance on otaku culture may appeal to some but alienate others. Overall, Denpa Kyoushi is considered a mediocre anime with some redeeming qualities, but ultimately falls short of its potential.
pros: Unique and amusing character interactions, especially between Junichirou and Suzune.
Creative use of otaku interests to solve student problems offers a fresh take on the 'teacher' genre.
Some found the humor to be well-executed and genuinely funny, especially in later episodes.
cons: Repetitive episodic format with little overarching plot, leading to tedium.
Inconsistent art quality and animation, often described as bland and generic.
Shallow character development for supporting cast, who often disappear after their initial arc.
Unrealistic and forced solutions to student problems, stretching the limits of believability.
Soundtrack is generic and forgettable, with some voice acting choices being criticized.
anime.thematic_vibe: Otaku Culture, Unconventional Teaching, Episodic Comedy

anime.title: Haikyu!! the Movie: The End and the Beginning
anime.synopsis:
After watching a volleyball match on TV where the "Little Giant" of Karasuno High School helps his team secure a hard-fought victory, young and impressionable Shouyou Hinata begins to play the sport in hopes that he too can soar high one day. Now enrolled at the same school as his idol, he attempts to join the volleyball team despite his short stature. Unfortunately, upon his arrival, Hinata locks eyes with "King of the Court" Tobio Kageyama—a genius setter whom he had once suffered a bitter defeat to in middle school.

Their unfriendly introduction and subsequent rivalry forces the rest of the Karasuno team to bar both of them from joining the club until they can learn to work together as teammates. Though reluctant to cooperate, their desire to play volleyball causes them to return with a proposal that will show the other members that they are capable of teamwork. As the two freshmen form an odd setter-and-ace relationship, an old rival school invites Karasuno for practice matches, reigniting competition between the two schools once more.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a decent recap of the first half of the first season, especially helpful for viewers who need a refresher. However, it's not recommended for those who recently watched the first season due to its lack of new content. The movie successfully captures the original anime's art style and sound, but suffers from a compressed narrative and occasional animation flaws.
pros: Good recap for those who forgot the first season.
Art and sound are consistent with the anime.
Refreshes memory of key plot points.
Music brings hype to the scenes.
cons: Recap movies don't offer new content.
Story feels compressed due to the recap format.
Unnecessary for those who just finished the first season.
Animation quality dips when paused.

anime.title: Taboo Tattoo
anime.synopsis: By all accounts, middle schooler Seigi is pretty unremarkable except for his martial arts prowess and a desire to protect the weak. But when his good intentions are put to the test by saving an old homeless man from some street thugs, the mysterious man shows his gratitude by...burning a tattoo onto Seigi's palm?! It turns out, the tattoo is a powerful secret weapon that everyone--including a formidable girl with a tattoo of her own--is after. With his life on the line and his martial arts skills alone no match against super-powered foes, will Seigi be able to unlock the latent potential of his tattoo and live to fight another day?!
anime.consensus_summary: Taboo Tattoo is largely considered a disappointment due to its rushed plot, poorly developed characters, and excessive fanservice. While some viewers found the action and animation enjoyable, the majority felt that the series failed to live up to its potential. The consensus is that the show suffers from inconsistent tone, illogical plot developments, and a lack of meaningful character arcs, resulting in an overall negative viewing experience.
pros: Good animation and fight scenes, especially early on.
Catchy opening theme.
Some found the action and supernatural elements enjoyable for killing time.
cons: Rushed and confusing plot with illogical character motivations.
Excessive and misplaced fanservice detracts from the story.
Characters are underdeveloped, cliche, and poorly managed.
Inconsistent tone and jarring shifts between serious and comedic moments.
Weak ending and unsatisfying resolution to the story.

anime.title: Actually, I am...
anime.genres: Comedy, Harem, Romance, School, Shounen, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
One day after school, Asahi Kuromine stumbles upon the truth that Youko Shiragami, the girl he has a crush on, is actually a vampire. According to her father's rules, Youko must now quit school in order to keep her family safe. However, Asahi does not want her to go and promises that he will keep her true nature secret. Unfortunately, this turns out to be easier said than done, as Asahi is a man who is easy to read and is unable to keep any secrets to himself.

And this is only the beginning of his troubles—more supernatural beings enter his life, and he is forced to protect all of their identities or face the consequences. Jitsu wa Watashi wa follows Asahi as he deals with his new friends and the unique challenges they bring, struggles to keep his mouth shut, and desperately tries to win Youko's heart in the process.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Viewers generally find 'Jitsu wa Watashi wa' enjoyable as a lighthearted, funny series, praising its comedic timing and character expressions. However, many find the characters generic, the plot predictable and the story ultimately unfulfilling due to a lack of development and unresolved plot points. Despite its flaws, the anime is considered a decent watch for those seeking a relaxing and humorous experience.
pros: Genuine comedy primarily from character face expressions and dialogues.
Catchy opening theme and enjoyable voice acting.
The lightheartedness is refreshing and relaxing.
cons: Generic characters and predictable plot with little progress.
Uneven pacing, episodic nature with little connection between episodes.
Inconsistent tone; comedy overshadows potential drama and character development.
Ending left room for improvement and didn't resolve plot points.

anime.title: SHIMONETA: A Boring World Where the Concept of Dirty Jokes Doesn't Exist
anime.romaji_title: Shimoneta to Iu Gainen ga Sonzai Shinai Taikutsu na Sekai
anime.synopsis:
With the introduction of strict new morality laws, Japan has become a nation cleansed of all that is obscene and impure. By monitoring citizens using special devices worn around their necks, authorities have taken extreme measures to ensure that society remains chaste. 

In this world of sexual suppression, Tanukichi Okuma—son of an infamous terrorist who opposed the chastity laws—has just entered high school, offering his help to the student council in order to get close to president Anna Nishikinomiya, his childhood friend and crush. Little does he know that the vice president Ayame Kajou has a secret identity: Blue Snow, a masked criminal dedicated to spreading lewd material amongst the sheltered public—and Tanukichi has caught the girl's interest due to his father's notoriety.

Soon, Tanukichi is dragged into joining her organization called SOX, where he is forced to spread obscene propaganda, helping to launch an assault against the government's oppressive rule. With their school set as the first point of attack, Tanukichi will have to do the unthinkable when he realizes that their primary target is the person he admires most.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed, with some praising the show's outrageous humor and satirical elements, while others criticize its excessive focus on crude jokes and lack of meaningful character development. The show's premise of a dystopian society where sexual expression is suppressed is seen as both thought-provoking and offensive, leading to a polarized reception. Ultimately, the enjoyment of 'Shimoneta' depends on one's tolerance for lewd humor and willingness to overlook its narrative shortcomings.
pros: Unique and creative premise with over-the-top humor.
Memorable and energetic cast of characters.
Effective satire of censorship and political correctness.
cons: Overreliance on crude and repetitive sexual jokes.
Poor character development and one-dimensional personalities.
Inconsistent story with underdeveloped conflicts.

anime.title: Is the Order a Rabbit??
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, Slice of Life, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
With a new year comes new adventures, especially at the Rabbit House! Since her arrival at the café, Kokoa Hoto has become accustomed to her new life as a waitress even though the Rabbit House isn't the rabbit paradise she initially envisioned it to be. Life is pleasant, and she enjoys spending time both working and playing with her friends and fellow waitresses Chino Kafuu, a cute middle school student with a fuzzy bunny companion named Tippy, and Rize Tedeza, the pig-tailed daughter of a soldier who is readily armed for any scenario.

Together with Chiya Ujimatsu and Sharo Kirima, who also work at neighboring cafés in town, the Rabbit House crew gets involved in all sorts of crazy adventures. Throughout these adventures, the girls encounter troubled novelists, rival cafes, secret treasure, and... alcoholic chocolates?
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's ability to deliver a heartwarming and stress-free viewing experience through its cute characters and charming slice-of-life scenarios. While some reviewers note the lack of a strong plot and occasional reliance on tropes, the overall sentiment is that the show excels in its niche and provides a comforting and enjoyable escape. The high-quality art, voice acting, and soundtrack are frequently highlighted as contributing factors to the show's appeal.
pros: Endearing and entertaining characters with varied interactions.
High-quality background art with detailed and vibrant scenery.
Excellent voice acting performances.
Heartwarming and stress-relieving.
Catchy and pleasing soundtrack that fits each scene well.
cons: Lack of overarching story or significant plot development.
Characters may lack depth and rely on archetypes.
Repetitive comedic elements and predictable character interactions.
Underwhelming or non-existent character development for some characters.
Some supporting characters are not well-integrated or serve a clear purpose.
anime.thematic_vibe: Moe, Slice of Life, Cuteness Overload

anime.title: Overlord
anime.synopsis:
The final hour of the popular virtual reality game Yggdrasil has come. However, Momonga, a powerful wizard and master of the dark guild Ainz Ooal Gown, decides to spend his last few moments in the game as the servers begin to shut down. To his surprise, despite the clock having struck midnight, Momonga is still fully conscious as his character and, moreover, the non-player characters appear to have developed personalities of their own!

Confronted with this abnormal situation, Momonga commands his loyal servants to help him investigate and take control of this new world, with the hopes of figuring out what has caused this development and if there may be others in the same predicament.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Overlord are mixed. Some viewers enjoyed the series' unique take on the 'stuck in a game' trope, praising the protagonist's role as an antagonist and the cool character designs. However, others criticized the generic storyline, weak plot, and poor writing, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Interesting premise of a protagonist as an antagonist.
Cool character designs and world-building.
Enjoyable action sequences and overall entertainment value.
cons: Generic 'stuck in a game' storyline.
Weak or non-existent plot with poor pacing.
Mediocre writing and soulless characters.
Gratuitous CG animation.

anime.title: Tamayura: Sotsugyou Shashin Part 2 - Hibiki
anime.synopsis: The second movie of a four-part finale of Tamayura.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the film's heartwarming atmosphere, character development, and gentle art style. Some found a particular character's reaction somewhat contrived, but overall, viewers found the installment to be a great addition to the franchise and a moving experience.
pros: Heartwarming and relaxing atmosphere
Substantial and realistic character development
Great pacing
Gentle art style with soft colors
Thoughtful exploration of human relationships
cons: Norie's reaction to her brother's comments felt contrived and melodramatic

anime.title: Tamayura: Sotsugyou Shashin Part 4 - Ashita
anime.synopsis: The final movie of a four-part finale of Tamayura.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers found the ending fulfilling and the series to be a masterpiece of the slice of life genre. The series provides a heartwarming and relaxing experience with well-developed characters and a beautiful story.
pros: Beautiful and relatable story
Well-developed characters
Relaxing musical composition and beautiful backgrounds
A proper ending
cons: Character animations aren't very notable

anime.title: Ushio & Tora (2015)
anime.synopsis:
Ushio Aotsuki is a stubborn middle school student and son of an eccentric temple priest who goes about life without care for his father's claims regarding otherworldly monsters known as youkai. However, as he is tending to the temple while his father is away on work, his chores lead him to a shocking discovery: in the basement he finds a menacing youkai impaled by the fabled Beast Spear.

The beast in question is Tora, infamous for his destructive power, who tries to coerce Ushio into releasing him from his five hundred year seal. Ushio puts no trust in his words and refuses to set him free. But when a sudden youkai outbreak puts his friends and home in danger, he is left with no choice but to rely on Tora, his only insurance being the ancient spear if he gets out of hand.

Ushio and Tora's meeting is only the beginning of the unlikely duo's journey into the depths of the spiritual realm. With the legendary Beast Spear in his hands, Ushio will find out just how real and threatening the world of the supernatural can be.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the old-school charm, action, and eventual plot payoff, others find the initial repetitive format, generic story, and underdeveloped characters to be significant drawbacks. The series' reliance on shounen tropes also divides viewers.
pros: Nostalgic old-school shounen feel with charm.
Good action sequences and animation, especially emotional expressions.
Gradual plot progression that pays off in the second season.
cons: Repetitive monster-of-the-week format in the early episodes.
Generic story elements and underdeveloped characters.
Overly moralistic main character can be off-putting.

anime.title: Go! Princess Precure Movie: Go! Go!! Gouka 3-bondate!!!
anime.romaji_title: Go! Princess Precure Movie: Go! Go!! Gouka 3-bondate!!!
anime.synopsis:
Part 1, Cure Flora to Itazura Kagami, is a dialogue-less story featuring Cure Flora and a mischievous ghost in a mirror.

Part 2, Pumpkin Oukoku no Takaramono, features the four Precure girls from Go! Princess Precure trying to rescue a princess who is held captive.

Part 3, Precure to Refi no Wonder Night!, is set when the Night Kingdom lost its daytime. The Precure team fight to take the daytime back alongside the princess Refi.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about the movie, with praise for the animation and cuteness of parts 1 and 3, but criticism for the generic story and filler-like quality of part 2. Many feel the multi-part format doesn't quite work. Overall, it's seen as an enjoyable but skippable entry for those not particularly invested in the franchise.
pros: Part 1 is a cute, dialogue-less story with nice animation.
Part 3 has a fantastic and unique 3D animation style with sweet action scenes.
The movie is enjoyable and worth a try if you like Cure Flora or the TV series.
cons: Part 2 feels like a filler episode with a generic story and uninspired villain.
The movie's multi-part format doesn't work well, especially with the inclusion of Miracle Lights.
The story and characters are not particularly special.

anime.title: Aria the Avvenire
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Now that Akari Mizunashi is a Prima Undine and head of the Aria Company with her own apprentice, Ai Aino, she cannot help but reminisce about her time as a Single. She has new responsibilities and much less time on her hands, but these changes bring with them new forms of miracles that Neo Venezia can give. Growing up into new roles is hard, but Akari can always count on the friends she has made on Aqua in times of need.
anime.consensus_summary: Aria the Avvenire is a generally well-received continuation of the Aria series, praised for its healing atmosphere and nostalgic return to Neo Venezia. However, some find the story lacking and the characters emotionally muted. The beautiful setting and music remain highlights, but character design is criticized for being less detailed than the backgrounds.
pros: Beautiful setting and relaxing music create a healing atmosphere.
The original staff and voice actors returned, preserving the magic of the series.
Continues the gentle and miraculous lives of the Undines.
cons: Story aspect is a bit disappointing.
Characters can be muted and emotionless.
Character art is plain compared to the detailed scenery.

anime.title: Million Doll
anime.synopsis: Million Doll revolves around Suuko, an idol-loving hikikomori (shut-in) who has one ability: To make any idol popular through the power of blogging. She puts her sights on the Fukuoka idol Itorio and tries to make her sell more, but she is impeded by the charismatic idol Ryuu-san and the underground idol Mariko.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience is largely disappointed with Million Doll. While the anime had an interesting premise of exploring idol fan culture and its negative aspects, the execution suffered from poor character development, cheap animation, and a rushed, unresolved plot. The short episode length was cited as a major hindrance to the show's potential.
pros: Unique focus on idol fan culture rather than the idols themselves.
Exploration of the drawbacks of fame.
Interesting concept despite execution.
cons: Poor character development due to short episode length.
Unresolved plot and abrupt ending.
Mediocre animation quality, especially the 3D elements.
Annoying voices
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture Critique, Satire, Underdog Story

anime.title: Diabolik Lovers II: More,Blood
anime.genres: Drama, Josei, Reverse Harem, School, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Yui Komori, still held captive by the Sakamaki brothers—pureblood vampires after her blood—experiences yet more bizarre twists to her life following her stay at their household. Though haunted by enigmatic dreams, Yui soon deciphers their meaning when caught in a car crash, which subsequently leads to meeting four new vampires: the Mukami brothers, Ruki, Azusa, Kou, and Yuuma, who themselves capture the bewildered girl.

Yui later awakens in the Mukami mansion, where the brothers reveal their plans for her: she is their "Eve," and her blood will find the "Adam" among them; together, they will have the power to rule the world. However, with the Sakamaki brothers hot on their heels, things might not go quite as smoothly as they had imagined.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Most viewers find the anime's plot and characters poorly developed, repetitive, and problematic due to its themes of abuse and misogyny. While some appreciate the art style and character designs, these aspects are not enough to redeem the show's significant flaws, leaving many frustrated and disappointed.
pros: Some viewers appreciate the character designs and art style.
A few reviewers enjoyed certain aspects of the new Mukami brothers and their interactions with each other.
cons: The plot is repetitive, poorly explained, and lacks depth.
The main character, Yui, is considered weak, useless, and lacks agency.
The series is criticized for its misogynistic themes and sexual assault.
Many find the characters one-dimensional and unlikeable.

anime.title: Gunslinger Stratos
anime.synopsis: Animated movie of the popular online multi-player double gun action game Gunslinger Stratos 2 which was streamed on the official YouTube channel of Square Enix.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is overwhelmingly criticized for its weak plot and character development. While the animation and sound are seen as passable, these aspects do not compensate for the fundamental flaws in the narrative. The general sentiment is one of regret for having invested time in watching the show.
pros: Animation isn't bad
Sound isn't bad
cons: Plot is childish and unappealing
Characters lack development
Storytelling is poor
Overall enjoyment is very low

anime.title: Dance with Devils
anime.genres: Mythology, Reverse Harem, Romance, School, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Ritsuka Tachibana has always been a good student, so she is completely shocked when she is suddenly summoned by the student council for breaking school rules. Led by Rem Kaginuki, the student council—also consisting of Urie Sogami, Shiki Natsumezaka, and Mage Nanashiro—tries to interrogate her, but it soon becomes clear that they have ulterior motives. However, this is only the beginning of Ritsuka's misfortune. When her mother gets kidnapped, her life is turned upside down, and Ritsuka gets drawn into a battle for supremacy between vampires and devils. Both groups are searching for the "Grimoire," a forbidden item that allows its owner to rule the world, and Ritsuka is somehow connected to this strange artifact.

The return of Ritsuka's protective brother Lindo from overseas gives her hope that life could return to normal. But even her sibling is harboring his own dark secrets. Ritsuka begins to question whom she can trust, and if she can ignore her growing attraction toward the devilishly handsome student council members.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some praising the show's unique musical approach and strong female lead, while others criticize the animation, rushed plot, and sometimes awkward execution. The reverse harem aspects are generally well-received compared to other shows in the genre. Overall, enjoyment depends on tolerance for the show's eccentricities and appreciation for its efforts to subvert genre norms.
pros: Unique musical elements enhance emotional expression and storytelling.
Strong female lead with defined character avoids typical reverse harem pitfalls.
Engaging plot that balances romance with a central storyline.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, particularly during action sequences.
Rushed plot development and underdeveloped character backstories.
Cringeworthy or awkward musical numbers may detract from enjoyment.

anime.title: Petting a Dog
anime.synopsis: A man and his dog share an intimate moment.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely considers 'Petting a Dog' to be a masterpiece, praising its ability to evoke deep emotions and convey profound meaning within a mere 16 seconds. While some find its simplicity underwhelming, the overwhelming consensus is that it's a heartwarming and unforgettable experience. Many reviewers express that this simple animation has fundamentally changed their perspective for the better.
pros: Captures the simple joy of connection in a profound way.
Evokes strong emotional responses with minimal elements.
Animation style and sound design are perfectly synchronized to create a warm and comforting experience.
cons: The animation is too short
Some viewers may find it boring or uneventful due to its brevity and simplicity.

anime.title: Momokuri
anime.synopsis:
After taking one hundred secret photos and observing him from afar for months, second-year high schooler Yuki Kurihara has finally mustered up the courage to ask out her first-year crush Shinya "Momo" Momotsuki. Although taken by surprise, the bashful Momo accepts; however, he does not know the profoundly abnormal truth. As her strait-laced friend, Norika Mizuyama, has observed, Yuki has developed some unnerving—but nonetheless sincere—habits: taking pictures of Momo in secret, doing extensive research into his personal life, collecting his used straws, and even going "Momo watching."

Though Momo remains blissfully unaware of his new girlfriend's peculiar habits, he does notice some oddities in their daily conversations. Still unsure and nervous about his first relationship, Momo finds himself regularly getting into awkward interactions due to his inexperience, but nevertheless resolves to make his new girlfriend happy.

Momokuri follows Yuki and Momo as they shyly explore their newfound love, and also deal with the problems that arise from it.
anime.consensus_summary: Momokuri elicits divided reactions, primarily due to its unique blend of 'cute stalker' romance and its perceived lack of substantial plot. While many appreciate its lighthearted tone, adorable art, and sweet character interactions, a significant portion of the audience finds the core premise creepy, the comedy weak, and the overall narrative too shallow. It's a show that strongly appeals to those seeking pure 'moe' and romance, but alienates those looking for more depth or conventional storytelling.
pros: Cute and adorable art style, bright and cheerful colors.
Well-executed character designs, especially the main couple.
Good voice acting, particularly for the female protagonist.
Catchy opening theme song.
Deals with obsession in a generally lighthearted and positive way.
Pacing is handled well for an adaptation, making filler sections interesting.
Focuses on relationship development rather than the journey to becoming a couple.
Satisfying depiction of how love and expression can differ but still be strong.
cons: Lack of strong plot or intricate story.
Comedy can feel forced and not consistently funny.
Pacing can feel slow and dragging, with insufficient content between important moments.
Animation quality is sometimes weak, especially background settings.
Soundtrack is average and can be overshadowed.
Yuki's obsessive behavior, though played for laughs, can be borderline creepy and uncomfortable for some.
Male protagonist can be too oblivious or dense at times.
Characters sometimes act too childish for their high school age.
The show lacks depth and can feel repetitive with the same gags.

anime.title: ReLIFE
anime.synopsis:
Dismissed as a hopeless loser by those around him, 27-year-old Arata Kaizaki bounces around from one job to another after quitting his first company. His unremarkable existence takes a sharp turn when he meets Ryou Yoake, a member of the ReLife Research Institute, who offers Arata the opportunity to change his life for the better with the help of a mysterious pill. Taking it without a second thought, Arata awakens the next day to find that his appearance has reverted to that of a 17-year-old.

Arata soon learns that he is now the subject of a unique experiment and must attend high school as a transfer student for one year. Though he initially believes it will be a cinch due to his superior life experience, Arata is proven horribly wrong on his first day: he flunks all his tests, is completely out of shape, and can't keep up with the new school policies that have cropped up in the last 10 years. Furthermore, Ryou has been assigned to observe him, bringing Arata endless annoyance. ReLIFE follows Arata's struggle to adjust to his hectic new lifestyle and avoid repeating his past mistakes, all while slowly discovering more about his fellow classmates.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed ReLIFE, praising its relatable characters, humorous moments, and inspiring story. Some critics felt the narrative was unoriginal and the animation was mediocre. Overall, the series is viewed as a satisfying and emotionally engaging slice-of-life anime.
pros: Relatable characters and situations.
Inspiring and humorous story.
Enjoyable pacing.
cons: Unoriginal narrative.
Slow story progression.
Mediocre animation.

anime.title: Nanbaka
anime.synopsis:
Nanba is the world's most formidable prison, built to incarcerate criminals who are too slippery to stay in ordinary confinement. The four inmates who occupy Cell 13 are particularly cunning on that behalf, having escaped every other prison with a perfect success rate. There is Juugo, a specialist in locks who has spent the majority of his life in prison; Uno, a gambler with great intuition; Nico, an otaku whose body reacts strangely to drugs; and Rock, a bruiser with a love for food. The daily shenanigans of the four prisoners always cause trouble for the building supervisor, Hajime Sugoroku, who desperately tries to prevent them from breaking out of Nanba.

Nanbaka follows the comedic, sparkle-filled exploits of these prisoners and their guards. From three square meals a day to sports festivals, prison life in Nanba isn't actually that bad—and it is the closest these four have to a home.
anime.consensus_summary: Nanbaka starts strong as a comedic prison anime with a unique visual style and entertaining characters. However, the show struggles with tonal inconsistency, shifting between lighthearted comedy and serious drama, which ultimately detracts from the overall experience.  Many viewers feel the plot loses focus and the characters become less engaging as the series progresses.
pros: Entertaining and funny, especially in the earlier episodes.
Unique and colorful art style.
Enjoyable characters and group dynamic.
cons: Tonal shifts from comedy to serious action/drama are jarring and inconsistent.
Story becomes unfocused and loses its way.
Characters can feel bland and one-dimensional due to over-reliance on comic relief.

anime.title: Jewelpet Magical Change
anime.synopsis: The story follows the adventures of rabbit-shaped Jewelpet Ruby, her long-best human friend Airi Kirara and the other Jewelpets on their mission to restore the Jewel Castle, which had fallen from the skies into the middle of the town because of humanity's lack of faith in magic. To restore people's belief in magic, Jewelpets transform into humans to study more about them.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Reviewers highlight the strong character development, particularly for the protagonist Ruby and Airi. The show's ability to create engaging storylines and emotional depth is also praised.
pros: Character development is well-executed, particularly for Ruby and Airi.
Background characters feel like they have their own stories.
The show manages to pack a significant emotional punch despite its premise.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Friendship, Slice of Life

anime.title: Future Card Buddyfight Hundred
anime.synopsis: While Tasuku is off training and getting rest in the world of the monsters, the Buddy Police sees the need to deputize some of the champions to help protect the Earth. Gao, Tetsuya, and Zanya Kisaragi are among those deputized, and it's just in time. A new enemy arrives, Ikazuchi, with the deadly 100 demons, all rogue monsters. Now the new trainees and the Great 8 monsters must fight to protect Earth from being consumed by these new rogues.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive for those who enjoyed the first season. The character development of Tasuku and Gao is highlighted as a strength. However, the series is criticized for a simple plot and a decline in quality in subsequent seasons.
pros: Character development for Tasuku and Gao.
Good soundtrack and fitting opening theme.
Decently animated fight scenes.
cons: Later seasons are considered low quality.
Plot is simplistic (finding and recruiting demon lords).

anime.title: Hong Ling Jin Xia
anime.synopsis: Short Chinese animation.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views 'Hong Ling Jin Xia' as an artful action drama that explores deeper themes.  The storytelling is praised for its visual approach. There is little controversy surrounding the show, indicating a generally positive or neutral reception.
pros: Art film quality
Story uses 'show, don't tell'

anime.title: RYOTEI-NO-AJI
anime.synopsis: Short stories capturing the bittersweet and tender moments of everyday family life, made for Marukome Co., Ltd. a miso soup paste manufacturer.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers are pleasantly surprised by the high quality of the animation and the heartwarming nature of the stories, especially considering their origin as commercials. The minimal focus on the product being advertised further enhances the viewing experience, leaving viewers with a positive impression.
pros: Beautiful animation
Heartwarming stories
Minimal focus on the advertised product
Evokes a positive emotional response

anime.title: Chaos Dragon
anime.synopsis:
In 3015, the year of Huanli, two countries, Donatia and Kouran, are embroiled in a war of supremacy that is tearing the world around them apart. The small island Nil Kamui has suffered exceptionally from the war, with lands conquered in the name of each kingdom and stolen away from the people. To make matters worse, their deity, the Red Dragon, has gone mad, rampaging about Nil Kamui burning villages and killing people indiscriminately.

Ibuki, a descendant of Nil Kamui's royal family, resides at an orphanage and refuses to take on the role of king. Abhorring conflict, Ibuki desires a peaceful resolution, however the chaotic world will not allow for such pacifism when it is being torn asunder by war. Despite his reluctance, Ibuki is drawn deep into this conflict. Can he rise to the occasion and save his country?
anime.consensus_summary: Chaos Dragon is overwhelmingly viewed as a major disappointment, especially given the involvement of well-known creators.  Viewers criticize the weak plot, irritating characters, and subpar animation. While a few elements are appreciated, the general consensus is that the anime fails to deliver on its initial potential, resulting in a generic and unmemorable experience.
pros: Some find the initial concept interesting.
A few characters are considered well-designed or interesting (e.g., Lou, Swallow).
The opening theme and animation are occasionally praised.
Some reviewers appreciate the unique character designs due to multiple authors being involved.
cons: Poor character development, especially for the main character Ibuki, who is often described as whiny and annoying.
Inconsistent and confusing plot with too many characters and poorly explained concepts.
Underwhelming animation, particularly the CGI dragons.
Generic story with shallow world-building and uninspired dialogue.
Many viewers found the ending unsatisfying.
Characters make illogical decisions, sacrificing themselves without proper motivation.

anime.title: Snow White with the Red Hair
anime.synopsis:
Although her name means "snow white," Shirayuki is a cheerful, red-haired girl living in the country of Tanbarun who works diligently as an apothecary at her herbal shop. Her life changes drastically when she is noticed by the silly prince of Tanbarun, Prince Raji, who then tries to force her to become his concubine. Unwilling to give up her freedom, Shirayuki cuts her long red hair and escapes into the forest, where she is rescued from Raji by Zen Wistalia, the second prince of a neighboring country, and his two aides. Hoping to repay her debt to the trio someday, Shirayuki sets her sights on pursuing a career as the court herbalist in Zen's country, Clarines.

Akagami no Shirayuki-hime depicts Shirayuki's journey toward a new life at the royal palace of Clarines, as well as Zen's endeavor to become a prince worthy of his title. As loyal friendships are forged and deadly enemies formed, Shirayuki and Zen slowly learn to support each other as they walk their own paths.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are split. Some find it a sweet and charming romance that subverts shoujo tropes. However, others find it bland, predictable, and populated with flat characters and plot holes, with a Mary Sue protagonist.
pros: Charming and soothing feel
Tries to break or subvert shoujo tropes
Relaxed and innocent nature
Good art
cons: Bland, boring, cliched protagonist (Mary Sue)
Story is generic and predictable
Characters are flat and underdeveloped
Plot holes and contrived situations

anime.title: Danchigai
anime.synopsis:
Haruki Nakano lives an average high school life, except for the fact that his mother is overseas and he shares an apartment with his four sisters. There's the oldest, Mutsuki, who has a bad habit of falling asleep in his bed, the junior high school student Yayoi, who hits him whenever something happens, and then the grade school twins, Uzuki and Satsuki, who love to play pranks on their older brother.

Stuck in a house with four girls, Haruki has to deal with all sorts of trials. From going grocery shopping, watching scary movies, to kissing practice, life is never boring in Danchigai!
anime.consensus_summary: Danchigai is a divisive short-form anime. Some viewers find it to be a cute and relaxing slice-of-life comedy about sibling relationships, while others are put off by the inappropriate and incestuous themes. The lack of substantial plot and character development further detracts from its appeal for many, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Cute and Cozy feel
Enjoyable and humorous sibling interactions
Easy to watch and unwind with
Well-done art style with bright colors
cons: Inappropriate and incestuous themes
Lack of character development
Weak or non-existent story
Repetitive and forgettable mini-stories
Stereotypical characters
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Inappropriate Comedy, Short-Form

anime.title: Hoshi no Kirby:  Taose!! Koukaku Majuu Ebizou
anime.romaji_title: Hoshi no Kirby:  Taose!! Koukaku Majuu Ebizou
anime.synopsis: Special 3-D animated short based on Kirby: Right Back at Ya!. It was released on the Wii channel in Japan. It features the never-before-seen monster named Lobzilla. Fire Kirby makes a special appearance, as does a new Kirby ability exclusive to the short called Kabuki. Seeing that Nightmare Enterprises is active and Dedede's transporter is operative, this episode may have taken place before episodes 96-100.
anime.consensus_summary: The special starts with promise, building anticipation through its introduction and establishing a clear premise. However, the execution falters with inconsistent art style, illogical character actions, and a departure from established abilities. The reviewer also critiques the lack of positive morals and economic themes, leading to an overall disappointing experience.
pros: Great anticipation built by countdown introduction.
Good premise of the story's plot.
Clear indication of enemies' reasons for ending Kirby.
cons: Artwork/story becomes tailored to a personal fashion.
Color style is inconsistent.
