Character reasoning is illogical and inconsistent with established abilities.
Doesn't present good morals for kids.
Economic themes are absent.

anime.title: Beautiful Bones -Sakurako's Investigation-
anime.romaji_title: Sakurako-san no Ashimoto ni wa Shitai ga Umatteiru
anime.synopsis:
When Shoutarou Tatewaki first meets Sakurako Kujou, he knows his life will never be the same. Initially believing her to be responsible for a disappearance in the neighborhood, he later learns of her true talent: analyzing bone specimens. Sakurako has quite the collection of reconstructed animal bones, but she wishes she had more of the human variety, much to the chagrin of those around her.

Soon, Shoutarou begins accompanying the eccentric osteologist on the many different unsolved cases she comes across—usually in the form of decomposing bodies. But with so many incidents happening around them, could there be a larger mystery at work in their lives?

Sakurako-san no Ashimoto ni wa Shitai ga Umatteiru is a story of two unlikely partners, each showing in their own way that bones can tell how one died, but only people can tell how they lived.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are mixed, with some praising the show's visuals and premise, while others criticize its rushed pacing, weak mysteries, and underdeveloped characters. Many find Sakurako's character unrealistic due to her all-encompassing knowledge, detracting from the mystery elements. The episodic format is also a point of contention, with some finding it enjoyable and others considering it a detriment to plot development.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation.
Interesting premise with potential for compelling mysteries.
Some found the episodic nature enjoyable and easy to follow.
Good voice acting and fitting music.
cons: Rushed pacing that undermines the mystery elements.
Simplistic and uninteresting mysteries.
Sakurako's overpowered intellect and knowledge that makes her unrealistic.
Weak character development, especially for Shoutarou.
Episodic format prevents the development of an overarching plot.

anime.title: Durarara!! x2 Shou: My Heart Is in the Pattern of a Hot Pot
anime.romaji_title: Durarara!!x2 Shou: Watashi no Kokoro wa Nabe Moyou
anime.synopsis:
One night, Mikado Ryuugamine accepts an invitation to Shinra Kishitani's apartment, eager to talk to Celty as quite some time has passed since the two last spoke. But, much to his astonishment, he finds that a large group of Ikebukuro's finest has gathered there for a hot pot party.
 
Already confused with the current situation, Mikado is further surprised to see that his friend and fellow Raira Academy student Anri Sonohara is there as well. As the two decide to take a seat together, a few members of the group begin reminiscing over events from days past: Mikado recalls an adventure from his childhood with Masaomi Kida, Anri explains how she came to be friends with Mika Harima, and Shizuo Heiwajima tells of his first meeting with Tom Tanaka.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is a well-received addition for fans of Durarara!!, offering enjoyable character backstory and interactions. While not essential to the main plot, it's considered a fun and worthwhile watch for those invested in the characters. Viewers appreciate the nostalgic feel and the focus on character development.
pros: Highlights the characters that make Durarara so great
Enjoyable backstory exploration of several characters
Fun watch, even though not essential to the main plot
cons: Not needed to progress the story
Can be skipped without missing anything important

anime.title: The Dearest
anime.synopsis: In-hye and Sun-mi visit their hometown, a small and quiet village in the countryside, after a long time only to face unexpected news: their old friend Eun-sil died while giving birth. The town is left in an uproar because of the baby, whose father is unknown, and it is neglected, protected by no one. While In-hye and Sun-mi try to save the baby with the help of Ji-young, their friend who has stayed in town, they find out that Eun-sil, who was mentally retarded, was a plaything of the village. In-hye and Sun-mi are troubled with the rage they feel against the village people and the guilty conscience they feel towards Eun-sil. Although they abandoned Eun-sil in the past, will they be able to protect her baby until the end?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus suggests discomfort with the film's handling of serious topics, with critiques focusing on a perceived lack of effective execution and a flawed premise. The film raises awareness of social issues but fails to deliver a satisfying narrative. There is no mass outrage, though the film does seem to inspire conversation.
cons: Uncomfortable topics are not well-executed.
Premise is lacking.

anime.title: Aoharu x Machinegun
anime.synopsis:
Hotaru Tachibana has a strong sense of justice and just cannot help confronting those who choose to perform malicious acts. Furthermore, Hotaru is actually a girl who likes to disguise herself as a boy. After hearing rumors that her best friend was tricked by the popular host of a local club, Hotaru seeks to punish the evildoer. Upon arriving at the club, however, she is challenged to a so-called "survival game" by the host Masamune Matsuoka, where the first person hit by the bullet of a toy gun will lose.

After a destructive fight which results in Hotaru's loss, Masamune forces the young "boy" to join his survival game team named Toy Gun Gun, in order to repay the cost of the damages that "he" has caused inside the club. Although she is initially unhappy with this turn of events, Hotaru quickly begins to enjoy what survival games have to offer and is determined to pay off her debt, much to the dismay of Tooru Yukimura, the other member of Toy Gun Gun. As time goes on, Hotaru begins to develop a close friendship with the rest of the team and hopes to take part in realizing their dream of winning the Top Combat Game (TCG), a tournament to decide the best survival game team in Japan.

Although Hotaru tries her best, there are just two little problems: she is absolutely terrible at the game, and Toy Gun Gun doesn't allow female members on their team!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Aoharu x Kikanjuu. Some appreciate the art, animation, and soundtrack, and find the characters entertaining despite their flaws. However, many are critical of the disorganized plot, weak character development, and overuse of dramatic elements.  The series is seen as having wasted potential and failing to fully explore its themes.
pros: Appealing art style and animation, particularly in action scenes.
Enjoyable soundtrack with a catchy opening theme.
Likeable and entertaining characters, despite flaws, with some potential for deeper development.
The concept of survival games/airsoft is refreshing.
cons: Inconsistent and disorganized plot with many plot holes.
Weak character development, making characters feel shallow and one-dimensional.
Forced drama and predictable storylines.
Overuse of monologues and flashbacks.
Inconsistent pacing.
Unresolved plot points.

anime.title: Amagi Brilliant Park: No Time to Take It Easy!
anime.romaji_title: Amagi Brilliant Park: Nonbirishiteiru Hima ga Nai!
anime.synopsis: Amagi Brilliant Park is a place where everyone takes on the role that is perfect for them. But every once in a while, situations arise that will force staff members to step out of their comfort zone and take on a new role. The goofball employees are soon to realize just how difficult this can be.
anime.consensus_summary: Fans of the main series will likely enjoy this OVA, praising its return to the anime's charming elements, excellent animation, and humor. However, some viewers found the plot convoluted and certain jokes to be inconsistent, with the episode offering little in terms of plot progression.
pros: Captures the charming aspects of the anime
Great animation and character designs (KyoAni)
Funny and entertaining with laugh-out-loud moments
Catchy and upbeat music
cons: Plot can be convoluted with too many characters and subplots
Some jokes can be hit-or-miss
Little to no plot continuation from the main series
Disturbing-looking characters (kindergarten kids)

anime.title: Ace of Diamond: Second Season
anime.synopsis:
After the National Tournament, the Seidou High baseball team moves forward with uncertainty as the Fall season quickly approaches. In an attempt to build a stronger team centered around their new captain, fresh faces join the starting roster for the very first time. Previous losses weigh heavily on the minds of the veteran players as they continue their rigorous training, preparing for what will inevitably be their toughest season yet.
 
Rivals both new and old stand in their path as Seidou once again climbs their way toward the top, one game at a time. Needed now more than ever before, Furuya and Eijun must be determined to pitch with all their skill and strength in order to lead their team to victory. And this time, one of these young pitchers may finally claim that coveted title: "The Ace of Seidou."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Diamond no Ace: Second Season' for its engaging character development, thrilling baseball moments, and improved animation. While some find the story predictable, the strong focus on teamwork and individual growth resonates well. The series successfully balances sports action with slice-of-life elements, creating a satisfying viewing experience for most fans.
pros: Character development is a strong suit, especially focusing on non-first string players.
Music effectively enhances the plot and emotional impact.
Story pacing is well-managed, balancing slice-of-life elements with thrilling moments.
Animation quality and art style are visually appealing and improved from the first season.
cons: Some viewers find the story somewhat clichéd and predictable, following typical sports anime tropes.
One reviewer noted potential encouragement of violence in a specific episode.
Some consider the opening and ending themes to be a weak point in the sound design.

anime.title: Prison School
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Gag Humor, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Located on the outskirts of Tokyo, Hachimitsu Private Academy is a prestigious all-girls boarding school, famous for its high-quality education and disciplined students. However, this is all about to change due to the revision of the school's most iconic policy, as boys are now able to enroll as well.
 
At the start of the first semester under this new decree, a mere five boys have been accepted, effectively splitting the student body into a ratio of two hundred girls to one boy. Kiyoshi, Gakuto, Shingo, Andre, and Jo are quickly cast away without having a chance to make any kind of a first impression. Unable to communicate with their fellow female students, the eager boys set their sights on a far more dangerous task: peeping into the girls' bath!
 
It is only after their plan is thoroughly decimated by the infamous Underground Student Council that the motley crew find their freedom abruptly taken from them, as they are thrown into the school's prison with the sentence of an entire month as punishment. Thus begins the tale of the boys' harsh lives in Prison School, a righteous struggle that will ultimately test the bonds of friendship and perverted brotherhood.
anime.consensus_summary: Prison School is a highly divisive show, praised for its unique and hilarious comedy, memorable characters, and bold satirical take on ecchi tropes. However, it is also heavily criticized for its crude and repetitive humor, excessive objectification of women, and pacing issues stemming from its adaptation. Audience reception is sharply split between those who find its absurdity and audacity genius, and those who are repulsed by its content.
pros: Hilarious and unique comedy that often stems from absurd situations and exaggerated characters.
Strong, memorable, and unique character designs and personalities, particularly among the main cast and the Underground Student Council.
Excellent animation and art style that effectively captures the exaggerated and comedic tone.
Engaging blend of suspense, drama, action, and ecchi elements that creates a captivating "mess".
Satirical commentary on fan service and ecchi tropes, making the genre self-aware and humorous.
cons: Pacing issues due to the rapid adaptation of a large manga portion, leading to rushed transitions and jokes not landing properly.
Heavy reliance on crude, inappropriate, and sometimes repetitive humor that can be off-putting or overstay its welcome.
Significant and often criticized objectification of women, which some viewers find offensive or gratuitous.
Inconsistent quality in humor and plot progression, especially in later episodes, leading to a decline in comedic impact.
Some characters are underdeveloped or forgettable, detracting from the overall impact of the cast.

anime.title: Venus Project: Climax
anime.synopsis: In the near future, Japan has developed sophisticated digital and image technology. People are enthusiastic for a new type of entertainment called "FORMULA VENUS." Abbreviated as "F-V," it is a sorted live battle of the top idol performances based on the idols' power, techniques, and developed experience. The story is about the drama that happens among the girls in VENUS PROJECT as they aim for the top by concentrating on difficult battles, passion, and friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the show's character-driven narrative and mature themes, finding the short length beneficial. However, many are critical of the weak animation, generic music, and nonsensical plot elements. The show's world-building and character designs have also been points of contention.
pros: Compelling characters with clear motivations.
Mature themes beyond typical idol anime tropes.
Brisk pacing avoids filler and maintains engagement.
Unexpected ending subverts expectations.
cons: Subpar animation and poor dance choreography.
Generic and forgettable music.
Questionable mechanics of the Venus battle system.
Problematic and lazy world-building (e.g., Pooristan).

anime.title: One-Punch Man
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Comedy, Parody, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
The seemingly unimpressive Saitama has a rather unique hobby: being a hero. In order to pursue his childhood dream, Saitama relentlessly trained for three years, losing all of his hair in the process. Now, Saitama is so powerful, he can defeat any enemy with just one punch. However, having no one capable of matching his strength has led Saitama to an unexpected problem—he is no longer able to enjoy the thrill of battling and has become quite bored.

One day, Saitama catches the attention of 19-year-old cyborg Genos, who witnesses his power and wishes to become Saitama's disciple. Genos proposes that the two join the Hero Association in order to become certified heroes that will be recognized for their positive contributions to society. Saitama, who is shocked that no one knows who he is, quickly agrees. Meeting new allies and taking on new foes, Saitama embarks on a new journey as a member of the Hero Association to experience the excitement of battle he once felt.
anime.consensus_summary: One Punch Man polarizes viewers; some find its over-the-top action and parody of superhero tropes highly entertaining, while others find its simplicity and repetitive humor dull. It excels in animation and action sequences, but the story and characters receive mixed reviews. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on appreciating its comedic subversion of the shonen genre.
pros: Fantastic animation and action sequences
Humorous and entertaining, especially for those familiar with shonen tropes
Catchy opening theme and well-placed background music
cons: Repetitive humor that can become boring
Simple and predictable story
Characters can be bland and underdeveloped

anime.title: Yuru Yuri San☆Hai!
anime.genres: CGDCT, Comedy, Gag Humor, Girls Love, School
anime.synopsis:
The members of the Amusement Club are back with more of Kyouko Toshinou's antics, Chinatsu Yoshikawa's schemes, Yui Funami's retorts, and Akari Akaza's small social presence as they strive to make each day as fun as the last! Whether the activity is an arm wrestling contest or making pancakes together, the group of entertainment-seekers are sure to give it their all.

The club members are often joined by their friends in the Student Council, who know how to have a good time as well. While it can get a little chaotic when all eight girls get together, it sure doesn't stop them from meeting up and having fun!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the increased yuri content and character development, while others miss the original's chaotic comedy and iconic gags. The change in studio and art style also divided viewers. Overall, while not considered a complete failure, it didn't fully live up to the expectations set by previous seasons for a portion of the audience.
pros: Increased focus on yuri (shoujo ai) elements is appreciated by many.
Some found the new art style more detailed and mature.
Characters who previously had less screen time are now more developed.
Retained voice actors and generally good sound design.
Focus on character development and relationship progression.
More realistic and intimate character interactions in San Hai.
cons: Change in studio led to a different feel, with less of the original's wacky humor and chaotic energy.
Some iconic gags and running jokes were removed or watered down.
The art style, while appreciated by some, was considered duller and less colorful by others.
Some side characters were underutilized or absent.
Some found the shift in focus detrimental to certain characters whose humor was a major component of their role.
Chinatsu's character became annoying due to excessive fangirling over Yui.
anime.thematic_vibe: Shoujo Ai, Slice of Life, Comedy

anime.title: Chivalry of a Failed Knight
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
There exist few humans in this world with the ability to manipulate their souls to form powerful weapons. Dubbed "Blazers," these people study and train at the prestigious Hagun Academy to become Mage-Knights; among the students is so-called failure Ikki Kurogane, the sole F-rated Blazer. However, when the worst student in the academy sees Stella Vermillion, an A-ranked Blazer who also happens to be a princess, naked, she challenges him to a duel with dire stakes—the loser becomes the slave of the winner. There's no possible way that Stella can lose, right?

As he tries to prove his strength to a world that believes him to be the weakest, Ikki gains new friends, wisdom, and experience.
anime.consensus_summary: Rakudai Kishi no Cavalry receives mixed reviews. While praised for its animation quality, especially in fight scenes, and its refreshing take on romance within the genre, it's criticized for its reliance on generic tropes, weak plot, and inconsistent character development. Some viewers found the series enjoyable despite its flaws, while others were disappointed by its uninspired writing and unnecessary fan service.
pros: Well-animated fight scenes, especially for its budget.
Refreshing take on romance subgenre with a functioning relationship between the leads.
Likeable and respectable main character.
Some found the series self-aware and willing to challenge its cliches.
cons: Generic story and characters; falls into typical light novel adaptation tropes.
Weak plot with superficial elements and uninspired writing.
Inconsistent character development and questionable motivations.
Over-reliance on ecchi fanservice.
Other female characters are extraneous to the central romance.

anime.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life with Monster Girls
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, Seinen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
With his parents abroad, Kimihito Kurusu lived a quiet, unremarkable life alone until monster girls came crowding in! This alternate reality presents cutting-edge Japan, the first country to promote the integration of non-human species into society. After the incompetence of interspecies exchange coordinator Agent Smith leaves Kimihito as the homestay caretaker of a Lamia named Miia, the newly-minted "Darling" quickly attracts girls of various breeds, resulting in an ever-growing harem flush with eroticism and attraction.

Unfortunately for him and the ladies, sexual interactions between species is forbidden by the Interspecies Exchange Act! The only loophole is through an experimental marriage provision. Kimihito's life becomes fraught with an abundance of creature-specific caveats and sensitive interspecies law as the passionate, affectionate, and lusty women hound his every move, seeking his romantic and sexual affections. With new species often appearing and events materializing out of thin air, where Kimihito and his harem go is anyone's guess!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with some appreciating the unique monster girl concept and comedic elements, while others find the plot and characters generic. The show is primarily enjoyed for its ecchi fanservice and lighthearted humor, but criticized for its lack of depth and meaningful story.  Overall, the show's appeal hinges on one's tolerance for the harem and ecchi genres.
pros: Unique monster girl concept provides fresh take on harem genre.
Creative fanservice due to diverse monster species.
Some found the characters enjoyable despite the tropes.
cons: Story and plot are generic and uninspired.
Relies heavily on ecchi content, which may not appeal to all viewers.
Characters lack depth and development beyond their monster traits.

anime.title: Kuroko no Basket 3rd Season NG-shuu
anime.synopsis: Animated bloopers included with the Blu-ray/DVD releases of the Kuroko no Basket 3rd Season.
anime.consensus_summary: The "Kuroko no Basket 3rd Season NG-shuu" is generally well-received as a lighthearted and humorous addition to the series, offering enjoyable moments with familiar characters. While some find this season less funny than previous installments and desire more content, the bloopers are appreciated for their subtle humor and ability to fit within the established narrative. Overall, it serves as a fun way to revisit the series without committing to a full rewatch.
pros: Funny and enjoyable
Helps to let go of the series after finishing it
Allows revisiting characters without rewatching the entire series
Shows unseen aspects of characters (e.g., Kuroko laughing)
Jokes are subtle and in character
Could fit into the main story
cons: Lacks character development or story benefits
This season's bloopers are less funny than previous ones
Limited content; more episodes would be appreciated

anime.title: Strike the Blood: Kingdom of the Valkyria
anime.romaji_title: Strike the Blood: Valkyria no Oukoku-hen
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, School, Urban Fantasy, Vampire
anime.synopsis: It was officially announced at the Dengeki Game Festival 2015 event that Strike the Blood will be getting a two-episode OVA series to be released at the end of 2015. The OVA will be an original story written by Gakuto Mikumo.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally found the OVA to be a decent, albeit non-essential, addition to the Strike the Blood franchise. While the animation and character interactions are praised, the main criticisms revolve around the disconnected plot, predictable climax, and a perceived decline in the protagonist's characterization. Expectations were likely a factor, with many feeling it didn't live up to the potential of the parent series.
pros: Animation quality is pretty good and similar to the parent show.
Character interactions remain fun, particularly with Yukina's affections and La Folia's family dynamics.
The OVA is a fairly entertaining watch with good rising action and decent progression.
cons: The OVA arc is offset from the main plot and doesn't contribute much.
Kojou's personality and character feel diminished and not like his usual self.
The climax is cliche and predictable, and the antagonists are pitiful and undeveloped.

anime.title: Dokuro the Ghost
anime.synopsis: Back alley of candy shop which everybody has called it "Alley of ghosts." Gacharico the Ghost lives there, but it's a secret that only little Miku, from the family candy shop, knows. The content of the capsules appear to be ordinary toys, but inside Gacharico the Ghost, live an abundant of other ghosts, each with their own personality. Even today, the ghosts are using all their powers to try to inspire awe and feelings in the children around them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is currently difficult to gauge due to limited review data. The show seems to attract viewers interested in the director's previous works. The content is likely geared towards children, featuring ghosts and a whimsical setting.
pros: Director Michiya Katou's involvement is a draw due to his previous popular works (Bihada Ichizoku, Oden-kun, Osu no Buu-chan).
cons: Reviewer initially mistook the show for a movie, indicating potential confusion about the format or accessibility.
The review lacks specific critiques about the production or writing, focusing more on the director's past work and a search mishap.

anime.title: THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS 2nd SEASON
anime.synopsis: Second season of The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls is largely considered a disappointment due to its weak storyline, forced drama, and underdeveloped characters. While some appreciate the music and voice acting, the majority find the plot rushed and unsatisfying, especially when compared to the first season or the original IDOLM@STER series.  The introduction of numerous characters without proper development further detracts from the overall experience, leaving viewers feeling underwhelmed.
pros: Strong voice acting, particularly for Uzuki.
Pleasant music and sound design.
Solid art and animation quality.
Some viewers enjoy the drama and emotional conveyance.
cons: Poorly written story with a rushed and unsatisfying plot.
Forced and embarrassing dialogue.
Weak character development, especially for side characters.
Unnecessary and poorly executed drama.
Overabundance of characters overshadowing the main cast.
Villain character is poorly written
Failure to live up to the original Idolm@ster series
Feels like a promotion for the mobile rhythm game.

anime.title: Doukyusei: Classmates
anime.synopsis:
Hikaru Kusakabe is a normal, carefree boy in a rock band who is always focused on the present. During the summer, his entire class is forced to participate in an upcoming chorus festival. By coincidence, he discovers his classmate Rihito Sajou—known for being an honor student with excellent grades—practicing his singing alone. Sajou just cannot seem to get their class' song right, and Kusakabe, delighted at seeing a new side of his straight-laced classmate, offers to help him prepare for the event.

Although their lives and personalities are total opposites, they begin to grow closer as time progresses. But with the pressure of an unknown future, what will become of them and their growing relationship?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is generally positive, appreciating the film's cuteness, art style, and music. However, some find the plot too simple, the pacing uneven, and the character development lacking. The movie is considered a light and enjoyable watch for those seeking a simple romance, although it may not appeal to viewers looking for a more complex or realistic story.
pros: Unique and pleasing art style.
Gentle music and sound design enhances emotions.
Cute and relatable character interactions.
cons: Pacing issues, sometimes too fast or too slow.
Plot is simple and can feel predictable.
Some viewers found the characters frustrating due to communication issues.
Some felt that the romance was underdeveloped.

anime.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Ban's Side Story OVA
anime.synopsis:
OVA bundled with the 15th and 16th volume of the manga.

15th volume DVD will feature the sin of greed as the central character.

16th volume DVD will feature side stories of the main characters in omnibus format.
anime.consensus_summary: The Nanatsu no Taizai OVA is generally well-received, particularly for Ban's backstory which is considered a highlight. The OVA is informative, filling in gaps from the main series, though the comedic shorts are less impactful. Overall, it's a worthwhile watch for fans, but not exceptional.
pros: Ban's backstory is well-received and adds depth to his character.
The OVA fills in gaps in the main storyline and provides additional context.
The comedic shorts in the second episode are entertaining for fans of the series.
cons: The comedic shorts in the second episode are not always engaging and do not progress the storyline.
The overall quality is not spectacular, especially for those who have seen the main series.
Some viewers may find the later developments of the series disappointing, diminishing the impact of early stories like Ban's backstory.

anime.title: Wakaba Girl
anime.synopsis:
Wakaba Kohashi, a sheltered rich girl, dreams of becoming a fashionable and trendy gyaru because she admires their outgoing and carefree nature. With this goal in mind, Wakaba begins the school year hoping to make her high school debut as a gyaru. On the first day of class, she meets the pure Moeko Tokita, the serious Nao Mashiba, and the eccentric Mao Kurokawa, and the four of them quickly become friends as they learn about and imitate each other's lifestyles.

Wakaba*Girl follows the adventures of these four friends while they experience events like school festivals, waterpark trips, and gym class tests. Along the way, Wakaba discovers what it is like to live as a regular student while Nao, Moeka, and Mao catch a glimpse into the life of a rich family. With never a dull moment in their lives, the four girls make sure to live each day to the fullest.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is that Wakaba*Girl is a cute and enjoyable, but ultimately simple and inoffensive slice-of-life anime. Many appreciate it for its relaxing nature, adorable characters, and humor, though some find the lack of a substantial plot and the short episode length to be drawbacks. Overall, it's considered a pleasant, easy watch for fans of the CGDCT genre.
pros: Enjoyable and relaxing to watch.
Cute character designs and animation.
Likeable and funny characters.
Catchy OP and good voice acting.
cons: Lack of a complex or engaging story.
Short episode length.
Cliche characters and situations.
Humor can be hit or miss.
Animation is average.

anime.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil: Burst
anime.synopsis:
Basara Toujou has a hard life. He is the older step-brother to two demonic sisters, Mio and Maria Naruse, whom he protects from entitled demons looking to claim Mio's power for themselves. On top of that, rising political tension within the demon realm only makes his job more difficult.

When a messenger arrives with summons for Mio to the demon realm, she and her friends go in spite of the danger. Now on the enemy's turf, Basara will have to grow stronger through erotic pleasure in order to do the impossible and protect everyone.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in the ecchi and action elements, while others criticize the weak plot, underdeveloped characters, and excessive fan service. Many feel the second season fails to live up to the potential of the first, with a rushed storyline and overreliance on tropes. The show is seen as a decent watch for fans of the genre but ultimately falls short due to its lack of originality and depth.
pros: Good animation and art style, especially for character design.
Enjoyable action scenes and well-integrated fan service.
Some find it fun and entertaining despite flaws.
cons: Weak, rushed, and incomprehensible plot with many missing points.
Underdeveloped and uninteresting characters with forced motivations.
Over-the-top and tasteless ecchi scenes that feel like softcore porn.
Recycled plot elements and clichéd tournament arc.
Lack of character development and a shift to a more serious, less comedic tone.

anime.title: Haikyuu!! the Movie: The Winner and the Loser
anime.synopsis:
The Inter-High has finally arrived for Karasuno High School's volleyball team. Their opponent at the tournament is Date Tech High School—the team that crushed Karasuno the year prior. The loss brings back anxiety and fear for the team's second- and third-years as they were unable to overcome Date's "read block." With the dynamic freshmen duo Shouyou Hinata and Tobio Kageyama on their side, will Karasuno be able to overcome their past and break through the iron wall?

Awaiting Karasuno in the next round is the elite Aoba Jousai High School, led by the cunning captain Tooru Oikawa. Coming from the same middle school as Kageyama, Oikawa is a talented and unpredictable setter with a grudge against his former teammate. It is a battle between genius setters to decide who will continue on in the Inter-High.
anime.consensus_summary: The recap movie serves as a decent refresher for those familiar with the first season of Haikyuu!! It effectively highlights key moments and evokes nostalgia, but it sacrifices detail and depth due to its condensed format. Newcomers are better off watching the original series instead.
pros: Good for refreshing memory of first season
Highlights key moments effectively
Faithful to the original art and sound
cons: Lacks detail compared to the original series
Rushed pacing
Not suitable for newcomers to the series

anime.title: Yona of the Dawn OVA
anime.synopsis:
Sono Se ni wa
At a remote hot springs lodge, Yona and the team rest. The boys are taking a bath with the exception of Ki-ja, who looks troubled. Jae-ha takes this chance to tease him, unwittingly finding a mark linked to the previous White Dragon—whom coincidentally is also Ki-ja's father—prompting Ki-ja to recall their complicated relationship.

Kou Ryuu Zeno Kako-hen
In another time and place, Son Hak and the dragons banter as they hold a drinking contest. As they start to doze off one-by-one, Zeno dreams of his past, where his abilities and experiences, both as a person and as the Yellow Dragon, are revealed.
anime.consensus_summary: The Akatsuki no Yona OVA is overwhelmingly praised for its expansion of character backstories, particularly for Zeno and the original dragons, addressing plot gaps from the first season. While the first episode is considered a lighthearted bonus, the following episodes are regarded as essential to understanding the characters and lore, leaving the audience deeply moved. The OVA serves as a satisfying, albeit bittersweet, continuation of the story in animated form.
pros: Provides crucial backstory for Zeno and the original dragons.
Fleshes out characters and deepens understanding of their origins.
Maintains the series' humor and writing quality.
cons: First episode is considered filler/fanservice.
OVA format limits the exploration of the story compared to a full season.
Some manga content was left out or reordered, disappointing some fans.

anime.title: Starmyu
anime.genres: Music, Performing Arts, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Yuuta Hoshitani enrolls in the prestigious Ayanagi Academy in hopes of finding the high school student who inspired him. The academy is well-known for producing exceptional musical talent, but students must first compete for acceptance into the Musical Department. At the top of the department is the Kao Council—a group of third-year students who possess a great deal of influence over the school and admission into the department. The fastest route to entering the department for Hoshitani is to find a way into a Star Team, which would allow him to be taught by a member of the Kao Council.

After catching the eyes of Itsuki Ootori, Hoshitani finds himself under the tutelage of the Kao Council's most eccentric member. Alongside him on Team Ootori is his roommate, Tooru Nayuki, fledgling Kabuki actor Kakeru Tengenji, the quiet Shuu Kuga, and Kaito Tsukigami, the younger brother of famous Ayanagi alumni Haruto.

As Hoshitani struggles with his lack of talent, his teammates must also overcome their shortcomings. Facing opposition from other talented Star Teams, including the other four members of the Kao Council, Team Ootori must carve their own path as they aim to perform in the Ayanagi Festival.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed but generally positive. Many find the story simple yet enjoyable, praising the music and characters. However, criticisms are leveled at the generic plot, animation quality, and overused tropes. Despite its flaws, Starmyu is considered a fun and lighthearted musical anime.
pros: Enjoyable and easy to follow story with lighthearted moments.
Good music and singing, especially character songs and soundtracks.
Characters are likeable with distinct personalities, even if somewhat generic.
cons: Generic and predictable plot.
Inconsistent and sometimes low-budget animation quality.
Over-reliance on tropes and cliches, lacking originality.

anime.title: Genesis of Aquarion Evol
anime.synopsis:
Sousei no Aquarion Evol is set in the spring of 1966. Shin Tsukishima, who is travelling to get a crystal radio, meets Yuno Kawazu, a girl crying on a beach in Izu. Shin and Yuno are guided by the Book of Genesis and meet each other halfway. The boundaries between three worlds begin to distort.

(Source: ANN)

Original episode that will be screened at Project Aquarion's 10th Anniversary event scheduled to be held on June 28, 2015.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is split on the quality of the ONA. While some enjoyed seeing the old characters and liked the music, many criticized the poor and rushed story, inconsistencies with previous events, and underutilization of certain characters. There is a sense of nostalgia mixed with disappointment regarding the plot.
pros: Good to see old characters again.
Music is still enjoyable.
Enjoyable when favorite characters are talking
cons: Story is poor and rushed.
Characters seem to have no knowledge of past events.
Some characters are rarely seen or heard from.
Pacing issues, would have been better as a movie.

anime.title: Aquarion Logos
anime.synopsis:
For thousands of years after its development, mankind used the written word for communication between people and generations. As millenia passed and technology became more prevalent, writing - and thus, communication as a whole - diminished, until it could only be found on cell phones and computer screens. Seeing an opportunity, the sorcerer Sogan Kenzaki starts infecting words with the Nesta Virus, which brings them to life and turns them into monsters called MJBK (Menace of Japanese with Biological Kinetic energy).

To counter this attack against humanity, an organization known as DEAVA (Division of EArth Verbalism Ability) assembles a group of youths with the ability of "Verbalism". They have to pilot the vector machines, which are used to form the mechas dubbed "Aquarions". The one wild card in the situation is the self-dubbed "savior", a young man who is the direct relative of a famous calligrapher, named Akira Kaibuki.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating its unique approach and focus on language, while others are disappointed by the deviation from previous Aquarion series and plot inconsistencies. Some find the characters enjoyable and the soundtrack impressive, but others criticize the character designs and filler episodes. Overall, it's a divisive entry in the Aquarion franchise.
pros: Unique and unpredictable plot
Enjoyable characters with distinct quirks
Soundtrack is great, especially during fight scenes
Explores the power and impact of language
cons: Plot holes and unexplained elements
Character designs are weird and unappealing to some
Filler episodes that are unnecessary
Story deviates from previous Aquarion series, disappointing some fans

anime.title: Classroom☆Crisis
anime.synopsis:
In Martian colony Fourth Tokyo lies a classroom of Kirishina Corporation's brightest minds spearheading aerospace development: A-TEC, led by genius engineer Kaito Sera, eagerly anticipating the arrival of their newest member. It soon becomes clear, however, that the transfer student is hardly ordinary—Nagisa Kiryuu, newly appointed chief of A-TEC and the younger brother of the corporation's CEO, is sent to shut the program down. To keep the classroom alive, Kaito and his students desperately work to develop a successor to their most powerful rocket, the X-2; meanwhile, Nagisa climbs the corporate ladder in pursuit of his own mission. In spite of this, their separate battles soon reveal that much more is going on in Kirishina Corporation than meets the eye.
 
Classroom☆Crisis follows Kaito and Nagisa, as well as Kaito's younger sister Mizuki and A-TEC's test pilot Iris Shirasaki, in a story of intrigue, political warfare, and, against all odds, romance. As Nagisa and A-TEC are dragged further and further into Kirishina Corporation's conspiracies, friendships grow and pasts are unveiled as they fight to avert their classroom crisis.
anime.consensus_summary: Classroom☆Crisis receives mixed reviews, with some praising its later plot twists, character development, and political intrigue, while others criticize its slow start, contrived romance, and underdeveloped supporting characters. The anime is noted for its good art and sound, but its complex narrative and initial lack of focus divide viewers. Overall, while the show has potential, it struggles to fully deliver on its initial premise, resulting in a polarizing experience for the audience.
pros: Intriguing plot twists and action.
Well-developed protagonists with interesting revelations and changes in attitude.
Good art style and animation.
Excellent pacing and exciting plot
Catchy opening and ending themes.
Satisfying story in 13 episodes
cons: Slow and generic start.
Contrived romance that devalues characters.
Underdeveloped supporting characters.
Political and business aspects can be confusing.
Too many conflicts and plotlines.
Some characters have interesting backstories but didn't really affect the character itself

anime.title: Miss Monochrome The Animation 2
anime.synopsis: The Ultra Super Pictures Special Stage event announced at AnimeJapan 2015 on Saturday that the Miss Monochrome television anime series will receive a second season. The season will run within the 30-minute Ultra Super Anime Time block beginning on July 3, 2015.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Miss Monochrome The Animation 2 is mixed, with some finding it an improvement over the first season due to its longer episodes and improved humor, while others feel it loses the charm and simplicity of the original. The addition of new characters and a more plot-driven approach are seen as both a positive and a negative. Overall, it's considered a lighthearted and enjoyable watch, but not without its flaws.
pros: Improved pacing and longer episodes compared to season one.
Humor is improved with better references and absurd scenarios.
The focus on the business side of becoming an idol is interesting.
cons: Humor can be repetitive and jokes are often overused.
New characters are generic and underdeveloped.
The story lacks substance and feels diluted compared to season one.
anime.thematic_vibe: Lighthearted Comedy, Idol Culture, Absurdist Humor

anime.title: Pikaia!
anime.synopsis: The story begins in the future when Earth itself is no longer inhabitable by living creatures. Humans began their interstellar migration with space colonies. Vince and Hana work as researchers in the Cambrian Project. Together with the creature Pikaia, they seek the Lost Code, the key to restoring Earth, and aim to return to Cambrian-era Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: Pikaia! is a well-received educational anime, particularly for children, that manages to blend entertainment with factual information about prehistoric life. While some find the pacing slow, the show is generally appreciated for its ability to maintain interest and balance educational content with engaging storytelling. The integration of futuristic elements and historical settings is a unique draw.
pros: Balances entertainment and educational aspects well.
Interesting fusion of futuristic elements and Cambrian era.
Successfully piques interest for the educational follow-up segment.
cons: Pacing of the show can be slow.
Animation style changes noticeably between segments.

anime.title: Yowamushi Pedal Movie
anime.synopsis: With the Inter-high over and as the end of summer approaches, Sakamichi trains intensely with Imaizumi Shunsuke and Naruko Shoukichi so he can carry on Team Sohoku’s spirit of supporting each other entrusted to him by Kinjou Shingo, Makishima Yusuke, and Tadokoro Jin, the third years who will be graduating before long. One day, Team Sohoku receives an invitation to the Kumamoto Fire Country Mountain Race, an invitational race for teams that performed well at the Inter-high, and their captain Kinjou decides their core Inter-high team will attend.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the movie's focus on racing action and visuals, many find it rushed and lacking the character development and emotional depth of the TV series.  The movie is seen as filler by some, diminishing the sendoff for older characters and creating plot inconsistencies, leading to a less satisfying experience overall.
pros: Fast-paced plot with less chit-chat and more focus on the race action.
Art and animation are just as good as the anime series, with nice colors and environments.
Sound and music effectively build the atmosphere, including detailed bicycle sounds.
cons: Rushed pacing, lacking the momentum and anticipation of the cycling race compared to the anime series.
Character development is lacking, especially for new characters.
The movie feels like filler and hurts the overall story by replacing the sendoff for the third years.
Plot holes and inconsistencies make it difficult to follow the race events.

anime.title: Free! Starting Days
anime.synopsis:
Haruka Nanase and Makoto Tachibana have started middle school and must adjust to the changes that come along with growing up. While Makoto fits in with his classmates and remains positive about swimming, Haruka struggles to befriend others or join his school's swim club, as his previous issues with swimming trouble him. Distancing himself from his lively classmates and the swimming club, he has difficulty deciding which club to join instead. The rest of his classmates, including Makoto, are also hesitant as to which clubs to participate in. After an argument leads them to join the swimming club anyway, the boys strive to hone their skills, harmonize their swimming styles, and refine their conflicting feelings toward swimming and each other.

As determination and talent run high, Haruka and Makoto—along with their classmates—discover themselves and improve their talents during their starting days.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely appreciates 'High☆Speed!: Free! Starting Days' for its stunning animation, character development, and emotional depth, particularly regarding the Haruka-Makoto relationship. While some viewers find the story repetitive and the ending abrupt, the overall sentiment is positive, especially among fans of the franchise who value its core themes of friendship and overcoming personal struggles.
pros: Outstanding and detailed art style, especially backgrounds and water animation.
Strong character development for both new and familiar characters, making them relatable and emotionally invested.
Excellent portrayal and development of the central friendship between Haruka and Makoto.
High-quality animation and fluid character movements.
Engaging and emotional story that effectively explores themes of friendship, self-acceptance, and overcoming challenges.
Stellar soundtrack and music that complements the emotional tone of the film.
cons: The story can feel repetitive, following a predictable 'new beginning, hardship, resolution' formula seen in previous installments.
Some plot points feel awkward or shoehorned in.
The ending felt abrupt to some viewers.
Voice acting for younger characters sometimes sounded unrealistic due to deep tones.
Some viewers felt the movie didn't add much new context to the overall franchise.
The pacing starts slow and can be boring at times.

anime.title: Wake Up, Girls! Beyond the Bottom
anime.romaji_title: Wake Up, Girls! Beyond the Bottom
anime.synopsis: Second movie sequel of Wake Up, Girls!.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the anime's realism and music, while others criticize its disjointed plot, rushed pacing, and bland characters. The film is considered a lackluster conclusion to the series by some, but the music receives almost universal praise.
pros: Portrays the rock-bottom and eventual highlights of the idol industry.
Music, especially the song 'Beyond the Bottom', is highly praised.
Attempts to break the common tropes of idol anime.
cons: Felt horribly disjointed from the tone and atmosphere of previous entries.
Plot is predictable with no real drama.
Characters are bland and lack individual distinction.
Rushed and unsatisfying movie that crammed too much content into one movie.
Lost all the positive aspects that the previous entries had.

anime.title: Wakakozake
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Gourmet, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Murasaki Wakako, who is 26 years old, loves going out alone to enjoy eating and drinking, especially when something unpleasant happens at work. This anime follows Wakako through many solitary outings, where she enjoys different combinations of food and drink!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find Wakako-zake to be a comforting, relaxing, and enjoyable short anime, perfect for unwinding and learning about Japanese food culture. While some note the lack of plot and repetitive nature, the overall experience is considered heartwarming and satisfying, with particular praise for the voice acting and food depiction.
pros: Relaxing and soothing experience.
Unique and endearing character design.
Excellent voice acting, especially Miyuki Sawashiro as Wakako.
Mouth-watering depiction of food.
Catchy opening theme.
Show introduces niche Japanese dishes
Simple story executed nearly perfectly
cons: Very short episodes.
Minimal plot or character development.
Repetitive nature might not be suitable for binging.
Art style might not appeal to everyone.
Excessive focus on alcohol consumption.

anime.title: KanColle Season 2: Let's Meet at Sea
anime.synopsis:
The dawn of a decisive battle nears in Leyte Gulf against the Abyssal Fleet, the mysterious enemies that occupy the sea. As the only ones capable of fighting them, Kanmusu—young girls possessing the souls of warships—reorganize in preparation. The Shiratsuyu-class destroyer Shigure is assigned to the First Striking Force, Third Section—also known as 1YB3H.

Unfortunately for Shigure, 1YB3H consists of the remaining few Kanmusu and serves as a diversionary fleet. Needing to confront the Abyssal Fleet head-on, it may well be their first and final mission together. Even so, Shigure refuses to let the enemy take another comrade from her. As they advance toward Leyte Gulf during this suicidal mission, the members of 1YB3H must support each other and persevere to prove their worth as competent ships.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided, with many feeling alienated by the darker tone and reliance on prior knowledge of the game. Some appreciate the more mature and historically grounded approach, while others find it boring and inaccessible. The show's production quality is generally praised, but the narrative choices are highly polarizing, leading to a significant discrepancy between enjoyment and expectations.
pros: Visually impressive animation, especially in early episodes.
Faithful adaptation of game mechanics and specific events.
Shigure's portrayal aligns well with the show's tone and historical context.
More serious and mature tone compared to the first season.
cons: Assumes extensive knowledge of the game, making it inaccessible to newcomers.
Pacing feels rushed and padded.
Story and characters may be boring or unlikeable to some viewers.
Significant departure from the tone and style of the original anime.
Ending lacks a satisfying conclusion.
Relies heavily on nostalgia and 'memberberries'.

anime.title: Tokyo Ghoul: Jack
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Psychological, School, Seinen, Suspense, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Former baseball player turned delinquent Taishi Fura accidentally witnesses the man-eating "ghoul" known as Lantern injuring his old friend and murdering another. Before the situation gets any worse, Fura's classmate Kishou Arima arrives―as he is actually an undercover investigator for the Commission of Counter Ghoul (CCG)―and forces the ghoul to flee.

Seeking revenge for his friends, Fura joins forces with Arima to hunt down ghouls in the 13th Ward—ultimately aiming to bring down Lantern. 

Tokyo Ghoul: "Jack" unveils snippets of life in the past for the CCG's fearsome "Reaper," Arima, giving insight into how he spent his high school days.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates "Tokyo Ghoul: Jack" for its visual quality, engaging backstory for Arima, and the sympathetic portrayal of its characters. However, many critiques point to the OVA's short runtime as a significant limitation, leading to underdeveloped plot points and underwhelming action sequences. Despite these drawbacks, it's often seen as a strong, albeit brief, addition to the Tokyo Ghoul universe, particularly for fans seeking more lore.
pros: Solid artwork and animation quality, with vivid colors and detailed character designs.
Engaging character development for Fura, showing a transformation from delinquent to investigator.
Appreciated insight into Arima's backstory and past, adding depth to a key character.
Well-crafted OST that fits the atmosphere and enhances scenes.
Good chemistry between the main characters, making them feel like potential protagonists for a longer series.
Offers a sympathetic portrayal of delinquents, paralleling their treatment with ghouls.
cons: Action scenes and fight choreography are considered mediocre, lacking the fast-paced excitement expected from Tokyo Ghoul.
Insufficient character development for some characters, leading to a lack of emotional investment in their fates.
Plot feels rushed and incomplete due to the short runtime, with unresolved questions and abrupt endings.
Arima's overpowered nature at a young age is questioned.
Some characters' motivations and actions are perceived as unrealistic or inconsistent (e.g., Lantern's desire for human life vs. her actions, Minami's sudden emotional shifts).
Foreshadowing of certain reveals is too heavy-handed.

anime.title: Horror News
anime.synopsis: Rei Kigata is a first year middle schooler at Ishido Middle School. He is not a believer of any paranormal phenomena such as existence of ghosts or spirits in any kind, but one day at midnight, while he is sleeping, a mysterious newspaper called "Horror News" is delivered to his room. The newspaper tells a story in which one of his teachers at the school will get killed in a car accident the following morning and Kigata will be a witness of the accident. The story turns into a fact in the following day and since then, the mysterious newspaper is delivered everyday. He realizes he is haunted by this newspaper and that his life span would be shortened in 100 days every time he reads it.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the anime's exploration of supernatural themes grounded in real-world events and mysteries, others are critical of its poor art style, episodic format, and excessive exposition. The anime's pacing and infodumps detract from the story for viewers familiar with the subject matter.
pros: Stories are close to reality despite supernatural phenomena.
Exposes viewers to strange and mysterious real-world events.
cons: Awful art style.
Standalone episodes do not meaningfully contribute to the plot.
Heavy infodumping, especially on paranormal topics.
Long-winded exposition overshadows the actual story.

anime.title: Steins;Gate 0
anime.synopsis:
The eccentric, self-proclaimed mad scientist Rintarou Okabe has become a shell of his former self. Depressed and traumatized after failing to rescue his friend Makise Kurisu, he has decided to forsake his mad scientist alter ego and live as an ordinary college student. Surrounded by friends who know little of his time travel experiences, Okabe spends his days trying to forget the horrors of his adventures alone. 

While working as a receptionist at a college technology forum, Okabe meets the short, spunky Maho Hiyajo, who 
later turns out to be the interpreter at the forum's presentation, conducted by Professor Alexis Leskinen. In front of a stunned crowd, Alexis and Maho unveil Amadeus—a revolutionary AI capable of storing a person's memories and creating a perfect simulation of that person complete with their personality and quirks. Meeting with Maho and Alexis after the presentation, Okabe learns that the two were Kurisu's colleagues in university, and that they have simulated her in Amadeus. Hired by Alexis to research the simulation's behavior, Okabe is given the chance to interact with the shadow of a long-lost dear friend. Dangerously tangled in the past, Okabe must face the harsh reality and carefully maneuver around the disastrous consequences that come with disturbing the natural flow of time.
anime.consensus_summary: Steins;Gate 0 is generally well-received as a worthy addition to the franchise, effectively exploring a darker timeline. While some find it difficult to follow or not as impactful as the original, many appreciate its emotional depth and character development. The story enriches the overall Steins;Gate experience.
pros: Compelling narrative that expands on the original Steins;Gate.
Well-developed characters, both returning and new.
Successfully captures the emotional weight of Okabe's failure and depression.
cons: May not surpass the original Steins;Gate in quality.
Some find the plot messy or confusing due to the non-linear source material.
Action scenes are a weak point in the animation.

anime.title: ChäoS;Child
anime.genres: Gore, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
A series of gruesome murders dubbed "New Generation Madness" once induced mass hysteria in Shibuya. At its peak during a frenzied riot, a sudden earthquake reduced the district into nothing but rubble, while leaving surrounding wards strangely intact.

Six years later, in a newly rebuilt Shibuya, mysterious deaths begin to crop up again. It is not long before third-year student Takuru Miyashiro realizes a connection: the dates of the recent murders match those of the New Generation Madness incidents. He, along with several members of his school's newspaper club, decide to delve deeper into the mystery, only to find themselves stranded in the middle of a new crime scene themselves...
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Chaos;Child is highly divisive, particularly among those familiar with the visual novel. Many feel it fails to capture the story's essence due to its rushed pacing and poor character development.  While some viewers unfamiliar with the source material may find it an enjoyable psychological thriller, the consensus is that it is a flawed and disappointing adaptation with a convoluted plot.
pros: Interesting and thrilling story (for those unfamiliar with the source material).
Well-conceived resolution.
Improved characters compared to its predecessor (Chaos;Head).
cons: Rushed adaptation that fails to capture the depth of the visual novel.
Poor character development and motivations.
Plot twists feel contrived and ridiculous.
Incomplete or confusing plot for anime-only viewers.
Art and animation are weak, especially compared to the visual novel.

anime.title: Noragami Aragoto
anime.synopsis:
Yato and Yukine have finally mended their relationship as god and Regalia. As a minor and unknown deity, Yato continues to take odd jobs for five yen apiece in hopes of one day having millions of worshippers and his own grand shrine. He has yet to fix Hiyori Iki's loose soul, but she cheerily prepares for high school nonetheless.

While things are seemingly back to normal, the complicated history between Yato and Bishamon—goddess of war and warriors—resurfaces. Bishamon holds a mysterious old grudge against Yato, which results in violent clashes between them. To further complicate matters, Bishamon's most trusted Regalia, Kazuma, is indebted to Yato. When lives are on the line, unraveling these secrets is possibly the only way to correct mistakes of the past.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Noragami is generally well-received, with improvements in story and character development. However, some viewers felt the later part of the season was rushed and had plot inconsistencies. Overall, the audience is enthusiastic and hopeful for a third season.
pros: Improved story and character development compared to the first season.
Excellent art and animation quality.
Captivating and emotional OST.
cons: Rushed storyline in the later part of the season.
Some plot holes and inconsistencies in the use of gods' powers.
Overreliance on Yukine's character in the first season and reduced focus on world-building elements from the first season.

anime.title: Balala the Fairies: Rainbow Heart Stone
anime.romaji_title: Balala Xiao Mo Xian: Caihong Xin Shi
anime.synopsis: After the fairies defeated Gunala, the Evil Goddess, another crisis hit the Fairy Castle!! The magical energy of the world has been devoured by the evil wizards. The Rainbow Flower, the source of the magic power, is soon to wither, and this will destroy the world of Fairy Castle. Only finding the legendary Rainbow Heart Stone and letting it recollect all the essential energy can save the world. To solve this biggest crisis in the history of the Fairy Castle, Prince YouLe, Sally, and their new friend XiaoQian, have to go back to the human world and reunite with Maggie and Michelle to fight the evil again.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Balala Xiao Mo Xian: Caihong Xin Shi' as a light and enjoyable magical girl series. It continues the themes of friendship and adventure, but its simple, monster-of-the-week structure may not appeal to all viewers. There is little controversy surrounding the show, with most criticism focused on its simplistic plot.
pros: Lighthearted and fun storyline.
Continuation of the Balala the Fairies universe.
cons: Repetitive monster-of-the-week format.
Simple plot, even for the magical girl genre.

anime.title: Kagewani
anime.synopsis:
A video blogger attempts to fake cryptid sightings to boost his views, but gets more than he bargained for when his crew is slaughtered by a real monster. Elsewhere, students find themselves preyed upon by a sandworm-like beast, initiating a desperate struggle for survival on their own school grounds.

With more of these attacks from mysterious creatures occurring, researcher Sousuke Banba tasks himself with delving into the mystery. With nothing but the keyword "Kagewani" to lead him, he scours the sites of recent attacks in hopes of finding a lead to eradicating the creatures for good. However, Sousuke finds that these threats to humanity are even closer to home when the pharmaceutical company, Sarugaku, starts to encroach on his investigation.
anime.consensus_summary: Kagewani is a unique horror anime with a distinctive art style and interesting monster designs, though the animation and overarching plot are criticized. The short episode format and monster-of-the-week structure provide decent entertainment, but the series ends up feeling incomplete. Audience opinions are mixed, with some appreciating its novelty and others finding it flawed due to its production and rushed storytelling.
pros: Unique art style akin to cardboard cutout paper-mache collages enhances the ominous vibe.
Effective use of horror tropes and monster designs, blending European fairy tales and Japanese Kaiju.
Well-mastered pacing within the short episode format, building tension effectively.
Sound design and ambient noises create a suspenseful atmosphere.
cons: Janky and awkward animation, with characters moving unnaturally.
Incomplete overarching plot with unanswered questions and rushed ending.
Lack of character development due to the episodic format.
Limited or lacking background music, failing to fully enhance the creep factor.
Story can be predictable
anime.thematic_vibe: Occult Mystery, Monster of the Week, Ancient Horror

anime.title: Gakuen Handsome The Animation
anime.synopsis: The school love story is set at Baramon High School, a private boys' school for the prefecture's most elite. The protagonist is a seventeen year old boy who transfers into the school and meets various major players on campus, such as the outlaw teacher, the soccer captain, and a childhood friend whom the protagonist has not seen for seven years. The school presents opportunities for friendship, love and conflict, and changes are now bound to happen in the main character's life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Gakuen Handsome The Animation' as a self-aware parody of the BL genre, finding humor in its exaggerated art style and absurd situations. While the plot is essentially non-existent and the humor can be crude, viewers appreciate its commitment to satirizing BL tropes. The overall mood is positive, with many familiar with the source material or similar parodies expressing delight.
pros: Successfully parodies Boy's Love tropes.
Exaggerated art style and ridiculous situations enhance the comedic effect.
References to the source material and other parodies are well-received.
cons: Non-existent plot.
Crude humor (references to poop).

anime.title: Tiger & Bunny: Too Many Cooks Spoil the Broth.
anime.romaji_title: Tiger & Bunny: Too Many Cooks Spoil the Broth.
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Comedy, Mystery, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
The official website for the Tiger & Bunny anime announced on Friday that the Pacifico Yokohama's National Convention Hall of Yokohama would host special Tiger & Bunny concerts September 19th and 20th. The franchise's composer Yoshihiro Ike is personally conducting the "Sternbild Orchestra & Band" for live performances of music from the television series and two films.

"Tiger & Bunny: Too Many Cooks Spoil the Broth" is an 18 minute episode that was released with the BD of the concert, "The Sound of Tiger & Bunny". It features the Heroes of the series being assigned to form a band to play a single performance.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is not well-received overall, especially by those expecting the typical Tiger & Bunny experience. However, dedicated fans who enjoy seeing the characters in a relaxed, slice-of-life setting may find some value in it. The lack of English subtitles initially contributed to its limited viewership and mixed reception.
pros: Provides more character development.
Offers a lighthearted and relaxing viewing experience for fans.
cons: Lacks the action, mystery, and drama typical of the series.
Story is considered weak and unnecessary.
Production quality is not high.

anime.title: The Asterisk War
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
In the previous century, an unprecedented disaster known as the Invertia drastically reformed the world. The powers of existing nations declined significantly, paving the way for a conglomerate called the Integrated Empire Foundation to assume control. But more importantly, the Invertia led to the emergence of a new species of humans who are born with phenomenal physical capabilities—the Genestella. Its elite are hand-picked across the globe to attend the top six schools, and they duel amongst themselves in entertainment battles called Festas.

Ayato Amagiri is a scholarship transfer student at the prestigious Seidoukan Academy, which has recently been suffering from declining performances. Through a series of events, he accidentally sees the popular Witch of Resplendent Flames, Julis-Alexia von Riessfeld, half-dressed! Enraged, Julis challenges him to a duel for intruding on her privacy. After said duel is voided by the student council president, Ayato reveals that he has no interest in Festas. Instead, he has enrolled in the academy to investigate the whereabouts of his missing elder sister. But when a more devious plot unravels, Ayato sets out to achieve victory, while being surrounded by some of the most talented Genestella on the planet.
anime.consensus_summary: The Gakusen Toshi Asterisk is largely considered a generic and uninspired anime, criticized for its derivative plot, weak characters, and excessive fanservice. Some viewers find it mildly enjoyable due to its fight scenes and music, or due to nostalgia. Overall, the series is seen as mediocre and not worth the time investment.
pros: Decent fight scenes and special effects.
Enjoyable opening and ending themes.
Some viewers have nostalgic attachment due to it being one of their first anime.
cons: Generic plot and characters with many overused tropes.
Weak world-building and inconsistent rules.
Forced and unnecessary fanservice.
Poorly written characters and dialogue.
Underwhelming action choreography.
Bad voice acting.

anime.title: Touhou Niji Sousaku Doujin Anime: Musou Kakyou Special
anime.romaji_title: Touhou Niji Sousaku Doujin Anime: Musou Kakyou Special
anime.synopsis: After finding Alice Margatroid's doll in the Scarlet Devil Mansion, Marisa Kirisame obliges herself to give it back to its rightful owner. However, in her search for Alice, she stumbles upon Hakugyokurou's gardener Youmu Konpaku and Eientei's moon rabbit Reisen Udongein Inaba fighting over a single watermelon.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is well-received, especially compared to previous ones. The animation and music are praised, and the humor is a highlight. It ends with a cliffhanger, leaving the audience wanting more.
pros: Lovely animation
Great music
Funny and amusing

anime.title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Exodus Part 2
anime.romaji_title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Exodus Part 2
anime.synopsis: Continuation of Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Exodus.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience displays strong positive sentiment towards Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Exodus Part 2, praising its emotional depth, enhanced visuals, and impactful soundtrack. While some find the plot complex and world-building weak, the series is generally considered a worthwhile continuation for existing fans. The audience isn't polarized, indicating general satisfaction.
pros: Complex and well-organized plot with emotional impact.
Enhanced art style with seamless integration of 3D and 2D, especially in mech and scenery design.
Brilliant soundtrack that amplifies emotional engagement.
cons: Story can be difficult to follow without prior knowledge of the series.
World-building outside the island can feel flimsy.
Some character developments, like Nishio Rina's, are confusing.

anime.title: Teekyu 5
anime.synopsis: Fifth season of Teekyuu series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is that 'Teekyuu 5' delivers more of the same rapid-fire, random humor that defines the series. Fans of previous seasons will likely enjoy it, while newcomers may find it overwhelming and nonsensical. There is minimal controversy as expectations are well-established, and the show caters to a niche audience that appreciates its specific brand of comedy.
pros: Consistent with previous seasons
Improved art and animation
Clearer sound
New Opening
cons: No story
Still completely unrelated to Tennis
Overwhelming randomness
Hard to follow subtitles and words

anime.title: Shin Atashin'chi
anime.synopsis: Outrageous misadventures of an almost normal family with a housewife, her husband, and their two kids Yuusuke and Mikan. Wacky humor about this weird family's daily life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the show's slice-of-life portrayal of a quirky family's daily routines. The focus on different family members and the exploration of simple situations are highlighted as strengths. While the minimalistic art style may not be for everyone, the show is generally well-received for its comedic and relatable content.
pros: Highlights the complexity in simple situations.
Refreshing change with focus on different family members.
cons: Minimalistic art style may not appeal to all.

anime.title: Lovely Muuuuuuuco!
anime.synopsis: Muco is the sweetest, most lovable dog in the neighborhood. This sparkly-nosed Shiba Inu lives with her owner and best friend, Komatsu, a glassblower who lives in the mountains. These two companions have wonderful adventures, from going on walks to playing in the pond in front of their house. No matter where they go or what they do, Muco will always love her best friend Komatsu!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find Itoshi no Muco to be a charming and heartwarming show, perfect for relaxation and guaranteed to bring a smile. Despite minor technical flaws, the lovable characters and lighthearted nature make it a worthwhile watch.
pros: Adorable characters, especially Muco
Easy to watch and undemanding
Upbeat soundtrack
Short episodes
Humorous and fun
cons: Animation may be low-grade
Repetitive elements
Framerate issues in some 3D shots

anime.title: Long Riders!
anime.synopsis: Falling in love at first sight with a collapsible bicycle outside the station, Ami Kurata, first-year university student empties her account without a second thought and buys the bicycle. Now she enjoys weekend cycling trips with Aoi, her childhood friend, and Hinako, a senior at her university. "Owning a road bike may change your view of the world completely." Prompted by the comment, Ami purchased a road bike, and she is really impressed with the traveling performance. As soon as she places her feet on the pedals and presses down, everything about riding a road bicycle—the lightness of the pedal, the speed, the acceleration—is nothing like she has ever experienced. Ami's cycle life gets going with the new road cycle as her partner!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Long Riders!' to be a relaxing and informative anime about cycling, appreciating its accurate portrayal of the sport and beautiful scenery. However, many feel the supporting characters are underdeveloped, the animation quality is inconsistent, and the pacing is slow. While enjoyable for cycling enthusiasts, it may not appeal to those seeking strong character development or a complex plot.
pros: Accurate depiction of cycling and related emotions
Beautiful backgrounds and scenery of Japan
Ami's character development and enthusiasm for cycling
Informative about cycling technicalities and maintenance
cons: Weak and bland supporting characters with minimal development
Dodgy animation quality and poor CGI implementation
Slow pacing that can be sleep-inducing
Lack of a compelling or complex plot

anime.title: Assassination Classroom Second Season
anime.synopsis:
Returning from their summer vacation, the students of Class 3-E at the prestigious Kunugigaoka Middle School find themselves up against unbeatable odds. Faced with the possibility of world annihilation, the students must come up with increasingly elaborate and creative ways to kill their teacher, the cunning yet optimistic and helpful Koro-sensei.
 
However, eliminating Koro-sensei is not the only objective the students need to worry about. Gakuhou Asano, the academy's merciless and cruel principal, seeks to prevent Class 3-E's success by brainwashing his other hard-working pupils into ruthlessly competitive studying machines. Hostility begins to linger in the air as traitors and killers alike attempt to claim the bounty on Koro-sensei's head for themselves.
 
Nagisa Shiota, one of Class 3-E's most skilled assassins, finds himself in the middle of the conflict. While he works to maintain his academic standing and prevent the end of the world, domestic affairs jeopardize his place in Class 3-E. Together with his dedicated classmates, he must now face the threats head-on.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Assassination Classroom is overwhelmingly praised for its emotional depth, character development, and satisfying resolution.  Viewers appreciate the blend of humor and serious themes, along with the valuable life lessons imparted by Koro-sensei. While some find minor flaws in pacing or tone, the overall sentiment is one of deep appreciation and emotional connection to the story and characters.
pros: Character development is excellent, especially Koro-sensei's backstory.
The mix of comedy and serious moments is well-balanced.
The anime provides valuable life lessons applicable to real-world situations.
Season 2 answers questions and plot points raised in Season 1.
cons: Some find the premise of assassination glorified and unrealistic.
A few viewers felt the later serious tone was not well-handled.
Some episodes felt like filler, detracting from the main story.

anime.title: Dragon Ball Super
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Seven years after the defeat of Majin Buu, Earth is at peace, and its people live free from any dangers lurking in the universe. However, this peace is short-lived; a sleeping threat awakens in the dark reaches of the galaxy: Beerus, the ruthless God of Destruction.

Disturbed by a prophecy that he will be defeated by a "Super Saiyan God," Beerus and his angelic attendant Whis search the universe for this mysterious being. Before long, they reach Earth and encounter Gokuu Son, one of the planet's mightiest warriors, and his powerful friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Dragon Ball Super is a highly divisive series, especially when compared to its predecessor, Dragon Ball Z. While some appreciate the new elements, character development, and comedic aspects, many find the animation, story, and power scaling to be significant flaws.  The series is criticized for not living up to the legacy of DBZ and for a perceived decline in quality.
pros: Character development (improvement over Z)
Humorous elements
New characters and elements (Gods, Universes)
cons: Poor animation quality (especially early episodes)
Inconsistent power scaling
Weak story / plot holes / retcons
Recycled movie arcs (inferior versions)
Character regression (characters becoming shallow)
Censorship (lack of blood)
Lazy designs of new transformations

anime.title: makuranodanshi
anime.synopsis:
