Whispering sweet lullabies into the ears of the viewers, Makura no Danshi presents the watcher with an experience of comfort. Each short episode features a different boy who will listen to the audience and hold them when they need it.

There are boys to suit all tastes: Merry is a gentle brown-haired boy; Sousuke Tanaka is a mature working man; Kanade Hanamine is a high school student who acts tough, but is frightened by mere spiders; Eiji Kijinami is a sore loser who looks like a punk, but has a tender heart; the shy Ryuushi Theodore Emori loves stargazing; Yuu Maiki is a freshman with delusions of grandeur; Haruto Enokawa is an energetic 5-year-old who refuses to sleep without a bedtime story; Nao Sasayama is a hip college student that is addicted to his smartphone; Shirusu Mochizuki is a librarian that treasures both books and book lovers; Yonaga and Yayoi Chigiri are siblings who are learning flower arrangement; and Yuuichirou Iida is a humorous old man who runs an oden stall.

Though the watchers may be troubled with various issues in life, these boys will softly talk about themselves and coax the audience members into revealing their problems. All the boys have kind hearts and will make the viewers feel special and loved.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some viewers appreciate the show's relaxing voices, diverse characters, and unique concept as a sleep aid or otome experience. However, many find it cringeworthy, creepy, and poorly executed, criticizing the lack of plot, poor animation, and questionable character choices. The show elicits strong negative reactions from a significant portion of the audience.
pros: Relaxing voices
Unique concept
Diverse characters
Some find it funny due to its cringe factor
Appeals to otome fans
cons: Creepy and unsettling
Lack of plot and story
Poor animation and art quality in some episodes
Absence of background music and sound effects
Repetitive and boring episodes
Stereotypical characters with no development
Inappropriate characterization (e.g., a 'hot' 5-year-old)
Forced and predictable dialogue

anime.title: Kamisama Hajimemashita: Kako-hen
anime.genres: Comedy, Mythology, Romance, Shoujo, Supernatural, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
While playing in the snow one day at her shrine, the land god Nanami Momozono witnesses her familiar—the fox youkai Tomoe—collapse, with dark markings appearing on his body. Tomoe's former master, Lord Mikage, appears after his long absence and places Tomoe into a magical pocket mirror in order to stave off his ailment.

Mikage explains that long ago, before he and Tomoe had met, the fox youkai was in love with a human woman. Seeking to live as a human with his beloved, he made a deal with a fallen god, but he only ended up cursed and dying. When Mikage discovered Tomoe, the god made the youkai forget his human love as a quick solution. However, something has changed recently to reactivate the curse; Tomoe has fallen in love with his new human master, Nanami. Since there is no way to stop the curse, Nanami wants to stop Tomoe from getting cursed in the first place by traveling back through time, even if it means they may never meet. As Nanami travels back hundreds of years to save her precious familiar, she discovers that she is far more closely bonded to Tomoe than she previously thought.
anime.consensus_summary: The Kamisama Hajimemashita OVA is generally well-received, especially for its romantic storyline and expansion of Tomoe's past. While some viewers find the adaptation lacking compared to the manga and identify plot inconsistencies, many appreciate the emotional depth and art style. A notable controversy exists regarding a scene interpreted as romanticizing abusive behavior, creating a polarized viewpoint for certain viewers.
pros: The OVA beautifully expands on the love story between Tomoe and Nanami, providing depth and emotional resonance.
The art style remains consistent and visually appealing, enhancing the viewing experience.
The time-travel element is generally well-executed, adding intrigue without being overly complicated.
cons: The anime adaptation doesn't fully capture the depth and intensity of the manga, leading to disappointment for manga readers.
Some plot points and character development feel rushed, especially in the final OVA episode.
The series contains a time paradox that some viewers find difficult to overlook.
One review expresses concern about the romanticization of potentially abusive behavior.

anime.title: Code Geass: Akito the Exiled - To Beloved Ones
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Boukoku no Akito 5 - Itoshiki Mono-tachi e
anime.synopsis:
The Ark Fleet has been destroyed, and a significant number of the enemy's troops have been wiped out due to its crash landing. As the remaining forces of the Knights of St. Michael regroup in order to launch a final assault on Castle Weisswolf, the W-0, along with their new ally Ashley Ashra, stand ready to intercept them.

Meanwhile, with his Geass out of control, Shin moves to erase his younger brother's existence once and for all. But Akito, having promised Leila that he will come back alive, refuses to accept such a fate, and the two clash in their final battle.
anime.consensus_summary: The final installment of Akito the Exiled is largely considered a disappointment, especially by fans of the original Code Geass series. Reviewers criticize the rushed plot, poor character development, and nonsensical story elements, with some even calling it an insult to the franchise. While some appreciate the animation and sound design, the overall consensus is that the ending is a confusing and unsatisfying conclusion to the OVA series.
pros: Good mecha animation and sound design.
Characters fleshed out, motivations explored.
Entertaining base defense scenario.
cons: Rushed and confusing plot, especially the ending.
Poor character development for secondary characters.
Inconsistent Geass mechanics compared to the main series.
Overblown action with zero casualties for the protagonists.
Poor translation and confusing concepts.
Clichéd story elements and happy ending.

anime.title: Seraph of the Endless
anime.synopsis: Specials included in the Blu-ray and DVD releases.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views these specials as enjoyable, light-hearted comedic extras that effectively poke fun at the main series. While production quality is acknowledged as cheap, the humor and character interactions largely compensate for this. Disagreement is mild, primarily revolving around the consistent quality of the individual shorts.
pros: Hilarious and provides a light-hearted feel
Good character designs and appreciation for the characters
Enjoyable and fun to watch, even if short
Refreshing to see the show poke fun at itself
cons: Cheaply made with reused shots and minimal unique art
Some omakes are stupid and not particularly funny
Character reactions can be overbearing or unrealistic at times
Art could have more depth, with unclear facial features

anime.title: Hackadoll The Animation
anime.synopsis:
Hacka Dolls are AI that scan a person in order to tailor news recommendations and information to their users. These widespread, personalized robots have served many citizens, from government officials to professional sports players.

A severe drop in quality leads to the production of three substandard Hacka Dolls. Due to their personality defects, they are sent to Earth, tasked with advancing humanity in whatever way they can. Whether it be encouraging a fujoshi to sell a doujinshi at Comiket or performing in an idol group, the three dolls will complete any task as long as it abides by their moral compass. Despite their shortcomings, they take their mission very seriously and always try their best to assist everyone with incredible enthusiasm.
anime.consensus_summary: Hacka Doll The Animation is a short, comedic series that heavily relies on parody and references to otaku culture. While some viewers find the humor and fast-paced format enjoyable, others criticize its lack of plot coherence, underdeveloped characters, and reliance on overused tropes. The series is generally considered a light-hearted and fun watch, but its appeal is limited to those familiar with the anime it parodies.
pros: Effective parody of anime tropes and specific series (Evangelion, Dragonball Z, Shirobako)
Enjoyable short-form content with a fast pace
Good voice acting that suits the eccentric theme
Catchy OP & ED themes
cons: Plot derails and feels like an eccentric slice-of-life comedy rather than exploring the initial premise
Characters are fairly cardboard with little development
Animation is inconsistent and sometimes lazy, with cost-cutting techniques like digital zooms
Relies on overused otaku comedy tropes and jokes, leading to a sense of deja vu

anime.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend .flat
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Otaku Culture, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
After finally completing the first route of his visual novel, Blessing Software's producer Tomoya Aki is optimistic about the future of his team and achieving their goal of creating the best game of the season.

However, they still have a long way to go. For one, Megumi Katou still has an incredibly flat personality and is unable to fit the role of Tomoya's ideal heroine. The other members of Blessing Software, Eriri Spencer Sawamura, Utaha Kasumigaoka, and Michiru Hyoudou, often forget she is even there due to her lack of presence and character. 

Throughout the development of their game, Blessing Software learns the struggles of working in an industry where deadlines must be met and edits are made constantly, and the hardships of working in a group setting.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Saekano is a mixed bag for viewers. While many appreciate the character development and exploration of creative struggles, others are disappointed by the main character's flaws, excessive fan service, and drawn-out drama. The season's departure from the first season's tone also contributed to polarized opinions, creating a somewhat divisive reception among fans.
pros: Strong character development, especially for Utaha and Eriri.
Exploration of the struggles and challenges of creative work.
Amazing art and animation quality.
cons: Some find the main character, Tomoya, to be weak and unlikable.
Disappointment in the lack of character development for some characters.
Fan service can be excessive and distracting for some viewers.
Some viewers found the drama dragged on for too long, making the season feel like a chore to watch.
anime.thematic_vibe: Character Development, Creative Process, Harem Dynamics

anime.title: Rage of Bahamut: Virgin Soul
anime.synopsis:
A decade ago, humans, gods, and demons joined forces to stand against the threat of the colossal dragon, Bahamut.

Now, in the present, humans living in the capital city of Anatae have been enjoying lavish and prosperous lives. Their progress is largely due to the administration of the newly appointed king, Charioce XVII, who has stolen a power from the gods and allowed for the abuse and slavery of the demon race in the capital. As humans continue to immorally exploit demons, a sense of hostility against humans begins to build up within demon communities, threatening a revolt. Meanwhile, an atmosphere of uneasiness is spreading among the gods, as they scramble to regain their lost power.

Amidst it all, Nina Drango, a cheerful young bounty hunter, has arrived at the Royal Capital with hopes of settling down and earning a living. However, her peaceful life in the capital is quickly thrown into chaos when she crosses paths with the ominous Rag Demon who is determined to seek revenge against humans, and Kaisar Lidfard, a noble knight battling an internal moral conflict.

Shingeki no Bahamut: Virgin Soul continues the tale of the social and moral conflict between humans, gods, and demons, and their struggle for survival and dominance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is strongly divided. Many feel the sequel failed to live up to the original, citing a poorly written romance, nonsensical plot twists, and character assassination. While some appreciate the art, animation, and soundtrack, the majority express disappointment with the second half and especially the ending. A subset of viewers enjoyed the series as a romance, irrespective of the plot.
pros: Excellent art and animation, a step up from the first season.
Soundtrack effectively sets the atmosphere and enhances emotional moments.
Well-developed world-building that feels alive and breathing.
Complex characters with deep bonds and meaningful interactions in the first half.
cons: Story quality declines in the second half, especially the ending, which many found nonsensical and rushed.
The central romance is poorly executed, with Nina's infatuation with the villain undermining her character and the plot.
Plot twists are often illogical and undermine the credibility of the storyline.
Inconsistent character behavior and motivations, particularly regarding the main characters.

anime.title: Young Black Jack
anime.synopsis:
In the 1960s, a gifted young medical student tries to make a name for himself. Kuroo Hazama is a reserved young man with unusual black-and-white hair, a body covered with scars, and a dark past. Despite only being a medical student, his surgical brilliance starts to attract attention after he completes a seemingly impossible operation. Together with the spirited and honest intern Maiko Okamoto and Yabu, a close friend with a troubled life, Hazama devotes himself to the world of medicine. 

However, his path to becoming a respectable surgeon is a difficult one as student riots, war, and corruption are consuming Japan. Hazama quickly finds himself caught up in a series of nefarious circumstances that challenge his integrity as a person and his path towards becoming a surgeon. Young Black Jack chronicles the story of a man capable of performing unthinkable feats of medicine, and the journey that leads him to become the legend known as Black Jack.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the anime's exploration of Hazama's origins and its engagement with historical context, specifically the Vietnam War era. However, the episodic nature, underdeveloped supporting characters, and pacing issues are noted as drawbacks. While some find the medical drama compelling, others feel it lacks the depth and emotional impact of the original Black Jack series.
pros: Interesting historical setting with real-world events like the Vietnam War and student protests.
Exploration of medical ethics and moral dilemmas faced by doctors.
Well-developed main character in Hazama, portraying his journey to becoming Black Jack.
Good animation quality and fitting art style for the 1960s setting.
Engaging plot with well-written short stories and a good medical drama
cons: Inconsistent pacing and episodic nature with lack of connection between some episodes.
Underdeveloped supporting characters and lack of depth in their backstories.
Fan service that is unnecessary and distracting.
Overdramatic at times.

anime.title: Magical Somera-chan
anime.synopsis: The story follows the everyday life of Somera Nonomoto who can use the strongest kenpo, Nonomoto Mahou-ken, which is inherited from her mother with her younger sister Kukuru.
anime.consensus_summary: Fushigi na Somera-chan is generally well-received as a short, comedic anime that embraces its absurdity. Viewers appreciate its fast-paced humor and unique style, despite the lack of a complex plot. The show is recommended for those looking for a quick and lighthearted experience, though some find the humor inconsistent.
pros: Unique and bizarre humor.
Short format makes it easy to watch.
Good animation and energetic art style for the genre.
cons: Lacks a strong plot or character development.
Humor can be hit or miss.
Art style may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Undefeated Bahamut Chronicle
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School
anime.synopsis: Lux, a former prince of an empire named Arcadia that was overthrown via a rebellion five years earlier, accidentally trespasses in a female dormitory's bathing area, sees the kingdom's new princess Lisesharte naked, incurring her wrath. Lisesharte then challenges Lux to a Drag-Ride duel. Drag-Rides are ancient armored mechanical weapons that have been excavated from ruins all around the world. Lux used to be called the strongest Drag-Knight, but now he's known as the "undefeated weakest" Drag-Knight because he will absolutely not attack in battle. After his duel with Lisesharte, Lux ends up attending the female-only academy that trains royals to be Drag-Knights.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative due to the show's unoriginality and reliance on tired harem tropes. Some viewers found it enjoyable on a superficial level or as a 'guilty pleasure' due to its sheer absurdity.  However, most were disappointed by the weak story, underdeveloped characters, and generic execution, leading to an overall mediocre reception.
pros: Decent art style and animation quality.
Some enjoyable action scenes with well-done sound effects.
A few found the show 'so bad it's good' due to its over-the-top cliches.
cons: Generic and predictable story with little originality.
Poorly explained plot points and world-building.
Weak character development and reliance on harem tropes.
Overuse of CGI in mech battles.

anime.title: Usavich Zero
anime.synopsis: Prequel to the first Usavich season.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds "Usavich Zero" confusing and disjointed, with a nonsensical plot. While some appreciate the humor and exploration of character origins, the lack of narrative coherence and character development is a significant drawback. The series seems more like a collection of loosely connected, chaotic events.
pros: Quick entertainment.
Potential for humor.
Explores character origins.
cons: Confusing and disorganized plot.
Weak narrative structure.
Lack of character background.
Cartoon garble voices

anime.title: Fairy Tail the Movie 2: Dragon Cry
anime.synopsis: Dragon Cry is a magical artifact of deadly power, formed into a staff by the fury and despair of dragons long gone. Now, this power has been stolen from the hands of the Fiore kingdom by the nefarious traitor Zash Caine, who flees with it to the small island nation of Stella. Frightened that the power has fallen into the wrong hands, the King of Fiore hastily sends Fairy Tail to retrieve the staff. But this task proves frightening as a shadowy secret lies in the heart of the kingdom of Stella. Dragon Cry follows their story as they muster up all their strength to recover the stolen staff and save both kingdoms.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is highly divided. While some fans appreciated the animation and action, many were disappointed by the movie's rushed plot, excessive fan service, and inconsistencies with the established canon. There is a general feeling that the movie prioritizes spectacle over substance, resulting in a disjointed and unsatisfying experience for many viewers.
pros: Animation quality is better than the series.
Some viewers enjoyed the initial scenes and action sequences.
cons: Plot is rushed and full of holes.
Excessive fan service detracts from the story.
Characters are inconsistent and underdeveloped.
Story doesn't follow up on what it introduces
Inconsistencies and contradictions
anime.thematic_vibe: Fan Service, Rushed Pacing, Canon Ambiguity

anime.title: Bakuon!!
anime.synopsis:
Every day Hane Sakura makes the arduous trip to school, cycling up a large hill on her bicycle. After encountering the motorcycle enthusiast Onsa Amano one morning, she is introduced to the motorcycle club, led by the ever-silent Raimu Kawasaki. New to motorcycles, Sakura experiences firsthand the difficulty of learning to ride again. However, through this, she hopes to once again recreate her first biking experience, which was filled with both horror and exhilaration.

Alongside Baita, the talking motorcycle; Rin Suzunoki, a Suzuki model enthusiast; Hijiri Minowa, a wealthy girl who dreams of being a thug; and professional racer Chisame Nakano, Sakura strives toward getting her bike license and experiencing the joys and hardships of motorcycles.
anime.consensus_summary: Bakuon!! is a niche anime that caters to motorcycle enthusiasts with its detailed references and jokes. However, its reliance on fan service, weak story, and derivative character designs make it a less appealing watch for general audiences. While some appreciate its lighthearted comedy and faithfulness to the manga, others find it boring and uninspired.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga.
Informed humor and factual information about motorcycles appeals to enthusiasts.
Good use of motorcycle branding and references.
cons: Unnecessary fan service.
Weak or unoriginal character design, heavily inspired by K-On!
Lackluster story with episodic plots and minimal character development.
Inconsistent animation quality.

anime.title: Schwarzes Marken
anime.synopsis:
The year is 1983. The Cold War is in full effect, and humanity is under attack. Strange aliens, given the name "BETA," have descended to Earth with the goal of destroying all life. Soldiers have been tasked with piloting large combat suits called Tactical Surface Fighters (TSF) to repel the alien invaders, but the front line is slowly being pushed back towards the surviving cities.

Schwarzesmarken follows the story of Second Lieutenant Theodor Eberbach and the other members of the 666th TSF squadron, a ruthless unit that values a mission's completion over human life. Stationed in East Germany and led by war hero Captain Irisdina Bernhard, the unit specializes in counterassault attacks on laser-class BETA. But the 666th squadron finds itself with more enemies than just the alien forces when optimistic rookie Katia Waldheim joins the squadron, drawing the attention of East Germany's secret police, the Stasi.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some viewers find the anime to be an underrated gem with an engaging story and well-developed characters. Others criticize it for its mediocre production values, shallow characterizations, and rushed plot. Overall, it's seen as a decent but flawed series with potential that wasn't fully realized due to constraints.
pros: Intriguing political drama set in an alternate Cold War era.
Good action sequences and mecha battles.
Characters have detailed backstories and emotional growth.
Explores themes of human rivalry and political tension amid war.
cons: Inconsistent character development, with some characters lacking depth.
Mediocre animation quality, particularly the CGI for mechs and aliens.
Rushed storytelling due to the limited number of episodes.
Predictable plot points and weakly timed emotional moments.

anime.title: Ghost Stories: The Headless Horsemen!! Curse of Death
anime.romaji_title: Gakkou no Kaidan: Kubinashi Rider!! Shi no Noroi
anime.synopsis:
A TV special of Gakkou no Kaidan that aired almost 5 months after the original anime. However, this event takes place before the Finale episode of the TV series.

The story focuses on a headless motorcycle rider.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the episode amusing despite its weak plot. The humor and memorable lines are the highlights, outweighing the nonsensical storyline. It's appreciated more for its comedic value than its narrative coherence.
pros: Funny dialogue
Memorable one-liners
cons: Incoherent plot

anime.title: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!
anime.romaji_title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!
anime.synopsis:
After dying a laughable and pathetic death on his way back from buying a game, high school student and recluse Kazuma Satou finds himself sitting before a beautiful but obnoxious goddess named Aqua. She provides the NEET with two options: continue on to heaven or reincarnate in every gamer's dream—a real fantasy world! Choosing to start a new life, Kazuma is quickly tasked with defeating a Demon King who is terrorizing villages. But before he goes, he can choose one item of any kind to aid him in his quest, and the future hero selects Aqua. But Kazuma has made a grave mistake—Aqua is completely useless!

Unfortunately, their troubles don't end here; it turns out that living in such a world is far different from how it plays out in a game. Instead of going on a thrilling adventure, the duo must first work to pay for their living expenses. Indeed, their misfortunes have only just begun!
anime.consensus_summary: KonoSuba divides audiences with its reliance on comedy. While some appreciate its lighthearted and genuinely funny approach that parodies the RPG genre, others find the humor repetitive and the story lacking substance. The show is generally considered enjoyable if the viewer connects with its comedic style, but may fall flat otherwise.
pros: Genuinely hilarious and funny dialogues.
Parody of the RPG/Fantasy genre with unique elements.
Light-hearted and easy to watch, providing pure entertainment.
cons: Repetitive comedy that can become tiresome.
Lack of a strong story backbone, relying on episodic events.
Generic fantasy setting, tracing elements from other anime.

anime.title: Noragami Aragoto OVA
anime.synopsis:
Yoru to Shinrenzoku Satsujin Jiken: Noragami Suspense Gekijou
Hiyori Iki goes on a skiing trip with her parents and happens to bump into Yato and Yukine. After a short while, they find the other gods who are there for a company vacation. But amidst all the fun, someone is plotting a heinous crime, and Yato is the primary target.

Issho ni Shashin wo
On a different day, Yato’s been able to make a small fortune from his last job and decides to take Hiyori and Yukine to Capyper Land. Although she agrees without knowing the destination, will Hiyori actually enjoy the day considering what happened on her last visit?
anime.consensus_summary: The OVAs are overwhelmingly well-received, particularly the second OVA episode set in Capyper Land. Viewers appreciate the humor, character interactions, and overall lightheartedness.  It's considered a must-watch for fans of the series seeking more of the characters and their relationships, though some find the plot predictable.
pros: Humor is a highlight, especially in the second OVA.
Character relationships are well-developed, particularly Yato, Yukine, and Hiyori's bond.
The art and sound quality are on par with the main series, maintaining consistency.
Second OVA is considered a must-watch and feels like a sequel, developing characters.
cons: Some plot twists are predictable.
The first OVA doesn't contribute significantly to the main storyline.
Some found the enjoyment relies heavily on pre-existing appreciation for the characters.

anime.title: Haruchika: Haruta & Chika
anime.romaji_title: HaruChika: Haruta to Chika wa Seishun suru
anime.genres: Music, Mystery, Performing Arts, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Chika Homura begins her high school career with a goal: to develop a "cute girl" persona. After quitting the volleyball team despite her all-star status, Chika decides to join her school's underrated Wind Instrument Club and play the flute, believing it to be the most delicate and feminine instrument. For the first time in nine years, Chika reunites with her childhood friend and total opposite, Haruta Kamijou. Unfortunately for Chika, Haruta is not fooled by her efforts to become more endearing. But this does not deter Chika, and she develops a crush on the band instructor, Shinjirou Kusakabe—but so does Haruta!

However, Chika's high school life just won't go according to plan, as mysteries begin appearing around her and her friends. The club members must work together to solve the mysteries plaguing the school, all while trying to find more members to compete in musical competitions.
anime.consensus_summary: HaruChika is a visually appealing anime that attempts to blend mystery and music but ultimately falls short. Many find the mysteries weak and the characters either annoying or underdeveloped, although some appreciate Chika's growth. Despite tackling mature themes, the series suffers from a lack of focus and inconsistent pacing, leading to a generally lukewarm reception.
pros: Interesting mysteries that delve into serious topics.
Good character interaction and development, especially Chika's organic growth.
Beautiful artwork and animation, particularly the character's eyes and instrument detail.
The anime doesn't shy away from real-life issues.
cons: The combination of mystery and music genres is poorly executed.
Mysteries are often simplistic, predictable, and rely on obscure knowledge.
Characters, especially Haruta, can be annoying or unlikeable.
The music aspect is underdeveloped and feels secondary to the mysteries.
Episodic nature leads to a lack of overall plot progression and character development.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Underdeveloped plotlines.

anime.title: Love Live! School Idol Project: μ's →NEXT LoveLive! 2014 - Endless Parade Encore Animation
anime.romaji_title: Love Live! School Idol Project: μ's →NEXT LoveLive! 2014 - Endless Parade Encore Animation
anime.synopsis: Another short bonus included in a Blu-ray/DVD disc of μ's live concert that took place in Saitama Super Arena on February 8th and 9th, 2014.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with fans appreciating the short video as a bonus treat that aligns with the established aesthetics and character interactions of the Love Live! series. The lack of a significant narrative is acknowledged but not considered a major drawback, as the primary appeal lies in the enjoyable moments with the characters.
pros: Enjoyable for fans
Consistent with the series' art style and sound
Provides a small treat for purchasing the Blu-ray
cons: Lacks a substantial story
Short and simple content

anime.title: Utawarerumono: The False Faces
anime.synopsis:
Waking up cold and alone in the woods, a nameless man is surrounded by unfamiliar scenes. Without any memories, he is utterly lost until he stumbles upon Kuon—a young girl with animal ears and a tail. She saves him, leading him back to her town while protecting them both from "boro-gigiri"—giant centipede-like creatures—and a mysterious red slime. After they arrive, she names him Haku after a prominent historical figure from the area. He quickly realizes he is one of a kind—the only one without animal ears and a tail. The two journey to the capital of Yamato, the country in which Kuon lives, meeting more people and making new friends, all the while unknowingly delving deeper into the politics and inner conflicts of Yamato...

Utawarerumono: Itsuwari no Kamen follows Haku as he slowly uncovers the secrets of this alien world. He works to solve the mysteries surrounding the red slimes, as well as to stop war from erupting among the nearby countries.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with some appreciating the art style, world-building, and character interactions, especially in the initial episodes. However, many are disappointed by the slow pacing, tonal shift, and rushed plot development in the latter half, which ultimately fails to live up to the original Utawarerumono. The series is seen as a weaker successor that doesn't fully deliver on its potential.
pros: Good art style and animation quality.
Expands on the world and lore of the original Utawarerumono.
Enjoyable character interactions and development in the first half for some viewers.
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the first half, with little plot progression.
Significant shift in tone from the original, with more slice-of-life elements and fan service that may disappoint fans of the first season.
Rushed plot development in the second half, leading to unresolved plot points and a weak ending.
Characters lack depth compared to the original, and their relationships feel underdeveloped.
Fails to capture the narrative quality of the first season, with plot holes and unexplained elements.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Fantasy, Political Intrigue

anime.title: Yuru Yuri Nachuyachumi!+
anime.genres: CGDCT, Comedy, Gag Humor, Girls Love
anime.synopsis:
Extra episodes of Yuru Yuri Nachuyachumi!

Summer vacation is drawing to a close, but the Amusement Club members make the most of the last days. Between outdoor activities in the sun, reminiscing on their recent camping trip, and a sleepover, the members of the Amusement Club, and their classmates in the student council, continue to make summer memories.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, viewers found 'Yuru Yuri Nachuyachumi!+' to be a pleasant but not particularly outstanding addition to the series. It offers more of the same lighthearted fun and cute interactions that fans enjoy, but some felt it lacked the narrative strength and comedic punch of earlier seasons. The episodes are generally well-received as extra content but don't significantly elevate the Yuru Yuri experience.
pros: Enjoyable continuation of the Yuru Yuri series.
Good animation quality, consistent with the OVA.
OSTs evoke pleasant memories, especially related to the summer camp.
Easy to understand Japanese, making it suitable for language learners.
cons: Story is not as strong or innovative compared to previous installments.
Comedy is lacking compared to the second season.
Some find the video game parody inaccurate and not well-executed.
Relies heavily on established tropes; lacks significant new elements.
anime.thematic_vibe: Cute Girls Doing Cute Things, Slice of Life, Summer Memories

anime.title: Tales of Zestiria the X
anime.synopsis:
The Celestial Records speak of the existence of the "Seraphim," a race of divine beings who give blessings to humanity and are offered prayers by them in return. Those who are anointed with the ability to interact with these spirits are known as "Shepherds." Hailed as heroes for their prompt appearances in times of crisis, while also being feared for their power, the Shepherds are imprinted in common folklore along with the Seraphim.

Sorey is a young human who has spent his entire life living in harmony alongside the Seraphim in the village of Elysia. Fascinated by the myths of the Celestial Records, he explores some nearby ruins with Mikleo—his childhood Seraphim companion—hoping to enlighten himself about the Seraphims' history with mankind.

Unfortunately, they become trapped in the depths of the historical site during their investigation. While searching for an exit, they come across a mysterious girl who desperately seeks the help of a Shepherd to save the world, which is on the brink of being consumed by darkness. Despite Mikleo's warning about making contact with other humans, Sorey decides to help the stranger, which unknowingly leads him closer to the dream of peaceful coexistence between man and Seraphim.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Tales of Zestiria the Cross' are divided. While the animation and soundtrack receive high praise, many find the story generic, the characters underdeveloped, and the pacing inconsistent.  The inclusion of 'Tales of Berseria' content is seen as disruptive, and overall, the anime fails to live up to its potential despite its visual strengths.
pros: Visually stunning animation by Ufotable, with impressive CGI and action sequences.
Faithful adaptation of the game's world, with detailed environments and character designs.
Soundtrack and OST are well-integrated and enhance the viewing experience.
The anime fleshes out some characters like Alisha, giving them more depth compared to the game.
cons: Generic and predictable storyline with a lack of originality.
Poor pacing, with the story feeling rushed or slow at times.
Underdeveloped and shallow characters with forced interactions.
Unnecessary and disruptive inclusion of 'Tales of Berseria' episodes.
Weak plot with a collection of random quests and lack of clear direction.
anime.thematic_vibe: Classic Fantasy, Good vs Evil, Journey

anime.title: Sora no Method: Aru Shoujo no Kyuujitsu★
anime.romaji_title: Sora no Method: Aru Shoujo no Kyuujitsu★
anime.synopsis: Original short anime bundled with the seventh Blu-ray and DVD volume of Sora no Method.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Aru Shoujo no Kyuujitsu' is a brief, lighthearted addition to the Sora no Method universe. It's considered worthwhile for fans of the original series seeking a small epilogue, but unlikely to appeal to those who disliked the main show. Its short length is both a pro and a con, offering easy viewing but limited substance.
pros: Provides a small continuation of the story after the main series.
Short and easy to watch.
cons: Very short, may not be satisfying for those seeking significant resolution.
Likely won't change the mind of viewers who disliked the original series.

anime.title: Utopa
anime.synopsis: Hundreds of years after the 20th century, nature and the ecosystem have been devastated due to use of nuclear and biological weapons. Most of the Earth has been contaminated and is collapsing into ruin, and a great majority of plants and animals are now extinct. The world heads to the "Big Six," the sixth mass extinction event. Humanity built cities in the sky, migrating the endangered species of animals and plants there. Over many years, the animals evolved in these isolated cities. With artificial genetic crossbreeding, they acquire language, bipedality, and build a life and civilization for themselves free from want. No one thinks of the world below any longer. One day, a single plant seed wanders into one of the sky cities, and the children Kui, Hiruma, and Root discover it. Unable to resist the temptation to look into the world outside, they decide to undertake an adventure to the outside world, unknowing that once they set foot on the ground, they will never be able to return.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is intrigued by the unique world-building and sense of scale, but ultimately disappointed by the short length and lack of closure. The OVA's strength lies in its ability to evoke a sense of wonder and mystery. However, it fails to deliver a satisfying narrative experience due to its brevity.
pros: Creates a vast and intriguing universe without over-explanation.
Effectively conveys the insignificance of the characters within the larger world.
cons: Story feels rushed and incomplete due to the short runtime.
Abrupt ending leaves many questions unanswered and no resolution.

anime.title: Kurayami Santa
anime.synopsis:
In the midst of Shouwa era Japan, greed runs rampant through the bustling cities and communities of the nation. King of Hell Enma Daiou summons an envoy into his office in the form of a small boy named Kurayami Santa. Through Enma's debriefing, Santa learns that the amount of greed and selfish behavior produced by humans will soon create an enormous wave of souls entering into Hell simultaneously, which would be catastrophic for Hell itself. 

Santa is given one mission: do something about it. With neither guidelines nor rules, Santa is tasked to handle the situation as he sees fit. In the human world, a rampaging thunderstorm strikes a nearby cemetery with a bolt of lightning, and the envoy of Hell appears. 

Teleported into the human world, Santa quickly realizes that humans are just as wicked as Enma had described. Without upsetting the balance between light and dark, Santa begins his quest to complete the mission from Hell and restore order to the human world.
anime.consensus_summary: The series presents a unique concept with a blend of retro animation and real-life elements, but the execution falls short. Viewers appreciate the moral themes and the main character's approach to dealing with human wrongdoings. However, the story's weak execution and tonal inconsistency hinder overall enjoyment, leading to a mixed reception.
pros: Cool concept with retro animation and artistic approach.
Fusion of real-life videos and animation is well done.
Morally upstanding hellish being as the main character is interesting.
cons: Story wasn't well executed.
Dialogues and fight scenes were mediocre.
Indecision on whether it wants to be wacky or educative and serious.

anime.title: Kowabon
anime.synopsis: In today's world full of wondrous technological innovation, the unnatural and mysterious sometimes appear even more horrifying than usual. But despite how far society has advanced, the fear of the unknown always remains. The unfortunate participants in Kowabon find themselves in such a predicament, experiencing the supernatural through their everyday technology. From a frightening sight caught on a parking garage camera to a video chat that takes an unexpected turn, the victims struggle to escape that which haunts them. However, what awaits these doomed souls may be a fate even worse than death...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the unique animation and quick format for delivering spooky scenarios related to technology. However, many find the plot lacking, the horror elements ineffective, and the repetitive nature of the episodes disappointing. While some enjoyed it as a short, easily digestible horror experience, others felt it was a waste of time.
pros: Unique rotoscoping animation style
Short episodes make it easy to watch
Compelling story with well-built tension despite being fleeting
cons: Lack of plot and character development
Repetitive and predictable scenarios
Not very scary or original
Poor art due to rotoscoping limitations
Ending theme ruins the horror mood for some viewers

anime.title: Initial D Legend 3: Dream
anime.romaji_title: New Initial D Movie: Legend 3 - Mugen
anime.synopsis:
After spending his summer racing against some of the best racers in Gunma, Takumi Fujiwara receives a formal challenge from the leader of the Akagi Red Suns, Ryousuke Takahashi. Despite his initial reluctance to get into the hobby, Takumi cannot help but feel excited to go up against the former "White Comet of Akagi." In preparation for the battle, Ryousuke downgrades his car, putting his pride and racing career at stake. 

With the title of the fastest racer in all of Gunma on the line, will Takumi and his panda-colored Toyota AE86 be able to defeat Ryousuke's Mazda RX-7 FC?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some appreciate the updated visuals and adherence to the manga, while others are disappointed by the missing Eurobeat soundtrack and perceived cuts to the original storyline and character development. The film's attempt to modernize the series is divisive, resulting in a polarized reception from long-time fans.
pros: Improved visuals and animation compared to the original series.
Faithful adaptation of the manga's visual style.
Enhanced sound design for cars, especially engines and tires.
cons: Lack of Eurobeat music significantly detracts from the Initial D feel.
Significant portions of the original First Stage story are cut, impacting narrative depth.
Character development feels lacking, particularly for Takumi.
Animation quality inconsistent, with soulless backgrounds and empty roads.

anime.title: Locodol OVA
anime.romaji_title: Futsuu no Joshikousei ga "Locodol" Yattemita. OVA
anime.synopsis: Episodes 14 and 15 of Futsuu no Joshikousei ga [Locodol] Yatte Mita.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA specials are well-received as a continuation of the main series, successfully delivering warmth and charm while promoting the town of Nagarekawa. Fans of the original series will likely enjoy these episodes, which focus on slice-of-life scenarios and showcase the characters' efforts to boost the town's popularity. The specials are considered simple but effective in achieving their goals.
pros: Warmth and charm of the characters and setting
Continuation of the enjoyable slice-of-life story
Effective spotlighting of the town's attractions
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Cute Girls Doing Cute Things, Town Promotion

anime.title: Himouto! Umaru-chan OVA
anime.synopsis: Episodes included in the manga's seventh and tenth volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views this OVA as a pleasant, albeit unoriginal, extension of the main series, offering more of the familiar comedy and slice-of-life elements. While some find it a relaxing and enjoyable watch, others note its lack of new content and repetitive nature, making it enjoyable for existing fans but not groundbreaking.
pros: Maintains the pure comedy and slice-of-life charm of the original series.
Art and animation remain consistent with the first season.
Sound quality is good and consistent.
Characters are consistent with the first season, providing enjoyable interactions.
cons: Lacks significant plot development or new elements, feeling like an extension of previous episodes.
Some comedic timing can be off.
The second episode feels very similar to episode 12 of the main series.
Story pacing is slow and uneventful due to the short format.

anime.title: DD Fist of the North Star 2: Strawberry Flavor Plus
anime.romaji_title: DD Hokuto no Ken 2 Ichigo Aji+
anime.synopsis:
In the 21st century, the characters of Fist of the North Star are living in peaceful Japan. In particular, Kenshirou is a convenience store worker, Raoh works at a factory, and wracked by illness, Toki is looking for work. The legend of the Fighting NEET (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) North Star begins in the modern day.

(Source: Crunchyroll)


Note: Short stories adapting Hokuto no Ken: Ichigo Aji manga are included at the end of each episode.

Serving as a spinoff gag manga of the original Hokuto no Ken series, the story is a parody of Fist of the North Star by Buronson and Tetsuo Hara. It consists of page-long gags centered mainly on Souther, both within his final battle with Kenshiro and inserting himself into other parts of the series where he doesn't belong. One recurring gag involves the kid with a turban repeatedly stabbing Souther in the leg every time he climbs the pyramid's staircase, and another involves Rei suddenly transforming into Souther in his iconic moments.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with a preference for the 'Strawberry Flavor' shorts featuring Souther. The main 'DD Hokuto no Ken 2' segments are criticized for being a weak parody that strays too far from the source material and delivers jokes poorly. While some find the series entertaining as a one-time watch, it's generally recommended only for dedicated fans of the original 'Fist of the North Star'.
pros: Strawberry Flavor (Souther shorts) are well-received and funnier than the main DD Hokuto no Ken 2 segments.
Embraces absurdity more than the previous DD Hokuto no Ken series.
Some episodes are entertaining and even comfy/enjoyable for fans of the original.
cons: DD Hokuto no Ken 2 segments are considered a parody of a parody and distant from the original series.
Humor is often over-the-top, silly, and sometimes dumb, relying on in-jokes.
Jokes are delivered too fast or lack substance in DD Hokuto no Ken 2.
Strawberry Flavor segments are not consistently funny for all viewers.

anime.title: Inferno Cop Specials
anime.synopsis: Three special episodes of Inferno Cop. The first features cameos of characters from Little Witch Academia. The third episode involves Inferno Cop traveling to New Jersey, where he comes across Donald Trump.
anime.consensus_summary: The Inferno Cop Specials are enjoyable, especially for those who appreciate the series' humor and the crossover with Little Witch Academia. While not as strong as the main series, it's still considered amazing by fans. The limited availability is a significant drawback, but the humor and voice acting are highlights.
pros: Hilarious and strange story
Good quality art
Perfect voice acting
cons: Not as funny as the main series
Hard to watch unless you were at AX

anime.title: Erased
anime.genres: Mystery, Psychological, Seinen, Suspense, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
When tragedy is about to strike, Satoru Fujinuma finds himself sent back several minutes before the accident occurs. The detached, 29-year-old manga artist has taken advantage of this powerful yet mysterious phenomenon, which he calls "Revival," to save many lives.
 
However, when he is wrongfully accused of murdering someone close to him, Satoru is sent back to the past once again, but this time to 1988, 18 years in the past. Soon, he realizes that the murder may be connected to the abduction and killing of one of his classmates, the solitary and mysterious Kayo Hinazuki, that took place when he was a child. This is his chance to make things right.
 
Boku dake ga Inai Machi follows Satoru in his mission to uncover what truly transpired 18 years ago and prevent the death of his classmate while protecting those he cares about in the present.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, with some praising the initial mystery, emotional connections, and art style. However, many criticize the predictable plot, poorly developed characters, inconsistent time travel mechanics, and reliance on shock value. The ending is often cited as rushed and unsatisfying, leading to significant disappointment and claims of being overrated.
pros: Engaging initial mystery and suspenseful buildup.
Strong emotional connections with certain characters.
Visually appealing art style and cinematic atmosphere.
Memorable opening and ending themes.
cons: Predictable mystery with an obvious killer.
Inconsistent and illogical time travel mechanics.
Poorly developed characters and forced drama.
Rushed pacing and unsatisfying ending.
Overreliance on shock value and emotional manipulation.
Pedophilic undertones

anime.title: Beyblade Burst
anime.synopsis: The story revolves around Valt Aoi and Shu Kurenai as well as their teammates, Rantaro Kiyama, Daina Kurogami and Wakiya Komurasaki at the Beigoma Academy school in Japan. When not studying, the close friends are obsessed with their Beyblade, creating a school bey club later in the season and challenging each other to battles at their Bey Stadium. The friends eventually become friendly rivals as they compete against each other in a competition to claim the title of Japan’s top Blader.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the focus on character development, animation, and soundtrack, considering it one of the best Beyblade generations. Others criticize the predictable plot, weak main characters, and reliance on luck over skill. While enjoyable for some, especially those new to the series, it doesn't reach the heights of previous Beyblade iterations for others.
pros: Good animation, especially in battles
Memorable and impactful soundtrack
Unique and well-developed new cast of characters
Focus on character interactions and development
Dubbed versions are well-done with funny jokes
cons: Repetitive and predictable story
Main characters are unlikeable or underdeveloped
Battles can be short and lack intensity
Over-reliance on luck and 'power of friendship' over skill
Inconsistent character backstories and development
Wrong story direction and lack of understanding of the audience.

anime.title: Cyborg 009 VS Devilman
anime.genres: Action, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Super Power, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: After discovering the existence of demons in Tokyo, the original Cyborg crew led by Dr. Gilmore find themselves in conflict with Devilman, a strong demon believed to be in league with the war-profiteering terrorist organisation, Black Ghost. Meanwhile, a bigger threat emerges when Dr. Adams, a Black Ghost scientist unleashes his new line of high teen Cyborg models against 009 and his friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Fans of both series appreciate the crossover and updated visuals, while others find the plot forced, the characters underdeveloped, and the integration of the two universes awkward. Prior knowledge of both Cyborg 009 and Devilman is recommended, but the OVA is accessible for newcomers to some extent.
pros: Crisp and clear art and animation with quality moments.
Successful integration of original story into both manga's canon.
Accessible for viewers unfamiliar with both franchises.
Beautiful environments and character designs.
cons: Art styles clash and don't quite go together.
Characters lack development and feel like nostalgia bait.
Forced and predictable plot with an underwhelming ending.
Requires intimate knowledge of both series to fully appreciate.
Devilman sidelined after the first part, feels more like a 009 story.

anime.title: Kuroko’s Basketball: It is the Best Present
anime.romaji_title: Kuroko no Basket: Saikou no Present desu
anime.synopsis:
It is Tetsuya Kuroko's birthday. In celebration, Satsuki Momoi has invited the other members of the Generation of Miracles to play basketball together and rekindle the memories from their nostalgic middle school days. Meanwhile, Taiga Kagami and his fellow teammates of Seirin High are doing their best to prepare for Kuroko's birthday party.

Sometimes, the best gift one can receive is not a material one but, rather, the feeling of having fun with everyone!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with fans praising the OVA for its heartwarming reunion of characters and satisfying fan service. Viewers appreciate the light-hearted nature and the focus on friendship, making it a must-watch for fans of the series. Some note the simplicity of the plot and the average animation, but these are minor concerns compared to the overall enjoyment of the episode.
pros: Satisfying fan service that brings closure to the Generation of Miracles.
Enjoyable character interactions and a focus on friendship.
Provides a heartwarming wrap-up and nostalgic feeling for long-time fans.
cons: The story is simple and predictable, primarily serving as fan service.
Animation quality is decent but not outstanding.

anime.title: Letchu, Getchu, Saru Getchu
anime.synopsis: The monkeys are up to no good again, but this time they're on the "heroes" side. Performing no good magic shows, cloning themselves with a ninja Jutsu and filling UFO catchers with themselves are just a few of the tricks they're pulling, while at the same time trying to adapt themselves to the human lifestyle.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views 'Letchu, Getchu, Saru Getchu' as a simple, comedic show geared towards children, evoking nostalgia for older 3D anime-like games. However, the lack of plot, sluggish animation, and uninspired music are significant drawbacks. The characters are seen as archetypal and predictable, making the show's appeal limited to those seeking undemanding, lighthearted entertainment.
pros: Nostalgic appeal reminiscent of PlayStation 1 games
Funny faces and comedic random events
Simple humor suitable for children
cons: Absence of plot
Sluggish animation
Woeful opening and background music
Archetypal and predictable characters

anime.title: Tobidasu PriPara: Mi~nna de Mezase! Idol☆Grand Prix
anime.romaji_title: Tobidasu PriPara: Mi~nna de Mezase! Idol☆Grand Prix
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: The 2nd PriPara film, unlike the first this shown in stereoscopic 3D.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience sentiment leans towards disappointment due to the lack of original content and storyline. While the songs and chibi designs are appreciated, the extensive recycling of stage scenes and the inconclusive ending detract from the overall experience. Many feel it's more of a song compilation than a proper movie.
pros: Chibi characters are cute
Songs are amazing
cons: Recycled stage scenes
Not much storyline
Bad ending (no winner picked)
Feels like a collection of songs rather than a movie
anime.thematic_vibe: Enjoyable songs, Recycled content, Lack of storyline

anime.title: Spellbound! Magical Princess Lilpri
anime.romaji_title: Hime Chen! Otogi Chikku Idol Lilpri (2011)
anime.synopsis: Short episodes of Hime Chen! Otogi Chikku Idol Lilpri that aired as part of TV Tokyo's morning program block for children, Norinori♪Norisuta (のりのり♪のりスタ).
anime.consensus_summary: The show is geared towards a very young audience (elementary school aged girls) and focuses on typical magical girl tropes, such as transforming idols. While harmless and cute, it is unlikely to appeal to older viewers. The show seems to be largely overlooked, likely due to its niche target demographic.
pros: Innocent themes suitable for young children
Cute and entertaining for its target demographic
cons: Potentially boring for older viewers
Limited appeal due to young target audience
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Slice of Life, Children's

anime.title: Anne-Happy
anime.synopsis:
Tennomifune Academy is an elite institution for the best and the brightest, with the exception of Class 1-7, the so-called "Happiness Class." Each member of the classroom copes with personal misfortunes, and the special class is geared to help them move past their issues and find true happiness. 

After being accepted into the academy, An Hanakoizumi, Ruri Hibarigaoka, and Botan Kumegawa find themselves placed into the Happiness Class, plagued by dreadful luck, love problems, and bad health respectively. Alongside their classmates, they do their best to overcome the difficulties they are faced with in pursuit of a life filled with joy.
anime.consensus_summary: Anne Happy♪ is a lighthearted and cute anime that offers a pleasant viewing experience for fans of the Slice of Life genre. While the show's premise is unique, the execution falls into familiar tropes, and the humor can be repetitive. The bright animation and endearing characters contribute to its charm, but the lack of substantial story or character development may not appeal to all viewers.
pros: Unique premise within the Slice of Life genre.
Bright and colorful animation enhances the show's atmosphere.
Humorous and heartwarming moments provide an enjoyable experience.
cons: Repetitive jokes and running gags can become tiresome.
The story lacks depth and relies on generic Slice of Life tropes.
Character development is minimal, with characters remaining static.

anime.title: Komori-san Can't Decline!
anime.synopsis:
Fifteen-year-old Komori Shuri is a junior high school girl who is too nice to decline requests. Constantly doing favors for other people has given her incredible strength?! But even so, she is also an adolescent junior high school girl.

An anime overflowing with the ups and downs of everyday life!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception is mixed. Many appreciate the show's simplicity and easy-to-watch format as a short comedy, but find its limited runtime a major drawback. Common criticisms target the underdeveloped characters, repetitive humor, and unremarkable art, leading to a generally average, easily forgettable experience for most viewers.
pros: The show is a quick and easy watch due to its short episode length.
The main character's kindness and willingness to help others is appreciated.
Some reviewers enjoyed the simple and wholesome nature of the anime.
cons: The extremely short episode length hinders character development and plot progression.
The characters are often seen as bland and stereotypical.
Some viewers found the humor repetitive and the jokes predictable.
The art and animation are considered mediocre.

anime.title: Ushio & Tora (2016)
anime.synopsis: Continuation of Ushio to Tora TV series.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the character development, emotional depth, and animation style. However, some find the protagonist simplistic and the story predictable, while others heavily criticize the second season for rushed pacing, plot holes, and inconsistent character behavior, leading to a polarized experience depending on their expectations and investment in the series.
pros: Great character development, especially for Tora and side characters.
Well-paced story with a satisfying conclusion.
Excellent soundtrack that enhances emotional moments.
Good balance of darkness and comedy.
Amazing oldschool animation style.
cons: Ushio is a one-note protagonist.
Some arcs are too long and boring with 'monster of the week' episodes.
Story can be predictable and rely on shonen tropes.
Rushed pacing and plot holes in the second season.
Characters act inconsistently in the second season.

anime.title: First Love Monster
anime.synopsis:
Freshman Kaho Nikaidou is from an influential family, and as such, no one has ever said anything even remotely mean to her, for fear of incurring her household's wrath. Wishing to be around people who will not treat her as special because of her background, she leaves home to live at a dormitory for her new school year. Shortly after arriving, Kaho accidentally wanders into traffic and is saved by a tall, handsome stranger. When she asks for his name, he tells her she is weird and walks away. Having finally met the only person to ever say an unkind word to her, Kaho falls head over heels for her savior.

After meeting her rescuer yet again and discovering that his name is Kanade Takahashi, she confesses her love to him. Kanade says he would like for them to be a couple, but that Kaho may not want to date him after she finds out his secret. To her shock, Kaho discovers the startling truth: Kanade is a fifth grader!

Deciding that she can't date a fifth grader, Kaho intends to break up with him. But as she spends more time with Kanade, she begins to care for him even more and continues dating him. Hatsukoi Monster follows Kaho's first steps into love with Kanade, her immature, yet kind, fifth grade boyfriend.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely repulsed by Hatsukoi Monster, citing its ridiculous plot, unlikeable characters, and reliance on inappropriate humor. Many find the anime cringeworthy and even disturbing due to its themes of pedophilia and generally immoral behavior. While a few viewers found some amusement in its absurdity, the overwhelming sentiment is negative, with many regretting having watched the series.
pros: Some voice acting is well done and helps bring the characters to life.
The art style is colorful and has a childish look, which fits the theme.
The premise is unique and can be amusing initially.
cons: The plot is ridiculous, immature, and goes nowhere.
Characters are intolerable, lack depth, and rely on amplified tropes.
The humor relies on sexual innuendos involving children and other depraved themes.
Art and animation quality are subpar and inconsistent.
The series normalizes degeneracy and inappropriate behavior.
Many reviewers express strong dislike and regret watching the anime.

anime.title: Monster Musume: Almost Daily ◯◯! Sort of Live Video
anime.romaji_title: Monster Musume no Iru Nichijou: Hobo Mainichi ◯◯! Namappoi Douga
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Comedy, Fantasy, Seinen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Anime shorts that offer a secret candid look at the daily lives of Monster Musume. The shorts will update almost every weekday, but each short will be available for 24 hours only. The weekends will have a digest version summarizing the week's videos.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience sees these shorts as disposable bonus content primarily for dedicated fans of the main series. While they offer brief glimpses into character lives and occasional humor, they lack substance, development, and memorable moments, leading to a generally lukewarm reception.
pros: Offers more details and insight into monster girls' traits, feelings, and actions, making the main series more worthwhile for dedicated fans.
Charming animation and art at times, providing brief, lighthearted scenes and occasional humor.
Fulfills its purpose as bonus content for existing fans, offering additional screen time for popular characters.
cons: Animation is limited and inconsistent, with some episodes featuring only a single frame of background and sound.
Many episodes feel pointless or lack substance, serving little more than a quick visual gag or occasional fanservice.
Does not offer character development, an overarching story, or significant expansion of the main series' universe.
Not memorable and fails to add anything relevant or retain viewer interest beyond a few laughs.

anime.title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha ViVid: Special Program
anime.romaji_title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha ViVid: Special Program
anime.synopsis: Recap of the Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha ViVid TV anime.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Special Program' is largely viewed as a disappointing recap episode. Reviewers find it to be a repetitive and uninspired rehash of previous content. The absence of new insights or character development, particularly the missed opportunity to explore Einhart's backstory, makes it a chore to sit through.
cons: Pointless recap
Repetitive content
Lacking new insights
Missed opportunity for character development

anime.title: Overlord: Ple Ple Pleiades
anime.synopsis: Specials bundled with the Blu-ray and DVD volumes of Overlord featuring simplified character animations.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally agrees that Ple Ple Pleiades is a fun, comedic side-story that successfully develops the Pleiades maids and offers lighthearted entertainment. While its lack of a serious plot and chibi art style might not appeal to everyone, fans of Overlord who enjoy comedy are highly recommended to watch it.
pros: Provides enjoyable comedic value and character development for secondary characters not featured in the main series.
Seiyuu performances are excellent, elevating the material.
Cute and silly art style (chibi/deformed) is fitting for the comedic tone.
Offers a lighthearted and funny side story for fans of the main Overlord series.
cons: Has no significant story or plot, serving solely as an excuse for comedy and character introductions.
May not appeal to those who dislike comedy, hyper-kawaii scenarios, or chibi art styles.
Short episode length can make it feel like episodes end before they begin.

anime.title: Rainy Cocoa, Welcome to Rainy Color
anime.romaji_title: Ame-iro Cocoa: Rainy Color e Youkoso!
anime.synopsis: Life at the Rainy Color café can never be described as boring. The arrival of the Koga brothers from England—Noel, always brimming with curiosity, and Nicola, somewhat shy and conservative—ensures that their sibling, café manager Shion, is kept on his toes. There's also another newcomer, cameraman/photographer Jun Arisawa, who holds a mysterious connection to café owner Koji Amami. Last but not least, there's a special photograph that incites all kinds of heartfelt and comedic reactions from the Rainy Color crew!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally dislikes the second season of Ame-iro Cocoa, citing underdeveloped characters, annoying tropes, and a weak storyline. While some found the voice actor segments enjoyable, the consensus is that the show fails to deliver a satisfying narrative. The introduction of new characters at the expense of existing ones further detracts from the viewing experience.
pros: Some viewers enjoyed the voice actor segments at the end of the episodes.
cons: Underdeveloped characters and relationships.
Annoying new characters with obnoxious tropes.
Inconsistent character development.
Mishmash of snippets lacking a cohesive story.
Episodes are too short.
Unenjoyable opening after repeated listens.

anime.title: Hakone-chan
anime.synopsis: After many years of dormant rest, a hot springs fairy awakens in modern-day Japan. However, while she slept, she took on the appearance of a young girl. She decides to cooperate with the locals whilst trying to regain her powers.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, viewers find 'Onsen Yousei Hakone-chan' to be a cute and enjoyable short anime, especially praising its story and character designs. However, the rushed pacing and animation quality are noted as drawbacks. Most agree that the show could have benefited from a longer format to fully develop its potential, but it is still worth a watch for a quick and lighthearted experience.
pros: Interesting story and worldbuilding for a short anime
Cute character designs
Decent soundtrack
Effective at showcasing the town of Hakone
Enjoyable physical comedy
cons: Rushed pacing due to short episode length
Animation quality is lacking
Characters feel somewhat shallow
Serious moments can feel jarring
Some jokes don't land well

anime.title: Concrete Revolutio
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Mystery, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
On a sunny July day in the 41st year of the Shinka Era, Jirou Hitoyoshi is tasked with covertly listening in on a secret meeting between a top government scientist and an industrial spy. However, his cover is blown, and the spy reveals himself to be an alien in disguise. Amidst the ensuing chaos, Jirou enlists the aid of cafe waitress and magical girl Kikko Hoshino, one of many "superhumans" who blend into society and secretly protect humanity from extraterrestrial threats. As a member of the government agency known as the Super Population Research Laboratory, Jirou has the dual task of protecting superhumans that defend humanity and disposing of any deemed too dangerous to live. Having proven herself a worthy ally, Kikko is invited to join the agency as its newest recruit.

Fast forward five years: disapproval and distaste for superhumans are now commonplace in Tokyo. From government corruption and conflicting ideas of justice, to the morality of superhuman rights, the relationship between humans and the supernatural minority balances precariously in a world pervaded by whispers of unrest and unease. Under mysterious circumstances, Jirou has betrayed the agency, and is now a fugitive on the run. As he skulks through the rainy back alleys of Shinjuku, he is pursued by the very same superhumans that he himself once recruited.
anime.consensus_summary: Concrete Revolutio is a visually striking anime with ambitious themes that often struggles with its complex narrative structure. While some appreciate its unique approach and thought-provoking questions, others find the disjointed storytelling and lack of focus frustrating. The show is polarizing, with strong opinions on both sides regarding its overall quality and execution, resulting in an underated ranking.
pros: Unique and vibrant art style with comic book influences.
Ambitious exploration of complex themes like justice, morality, and discrimination.
Engaging story with unexpected twists and turns that challenges the viewer's perspective.
Strong character designs and animation quality, with fluid and dynamic action sequences.
cons: Disjointed narrative structure with frequent time skips that can be confusing.
Pacing issues and rushed storytelling.
Episodic format that can feel disconnected.
Failure to fully explore or resolve many of the themes it introduces.
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Allegory, Superhero Deconstruction, Moral Ambiguity

anime.title: Persona 3 the Movie: #4 Winter of Rebirth
anime.romaji_title: Persona 3 the Movie 4: Winter of Rebirth
anime.synopsis:
"The time of destruction is coming ever closer without a doubt. It cannot be stopped."
To know death, to gaze at death, to face death.

Makoto and his allies have grown through the many meetings and partings they have experienced.

Their fight might not be for the sake of the world, but for themselves. Even so, they have continued to fight, believing that there are peaceful days waiting at the end of the battle.

However, a boy says that destruction is the fate that humanity must shoulder. The boy they believed to be their friend tells them the truth of the situation without an emotion on his face.

The season changes to winter. Makoto makes a decision in order to greet the spring that is waiting beyond...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, praising the film's character development, animation, and emotional depth. However, some viewers found the ending rushed and criticized the use of convenient plot devices. While fans of the Persona series appreciate the adaptation, newcomers may find it less accessible without prior knowledge of the game.
pros: Excellent character development, especially for Makoto and the SEES team.
Improved and expanded upon the original game's story.
High-quality animation, particularly in fight scenes and evoking a bleak atmosphere.
Effective use of music to enhance emotional impact.
Faithful adaptation of the source material.
cons: Rushed resolutions to character arcs.
Rushed social links
Over-reliance on deus ex machina events.
Inconsistent pacing.
Awkward integration of CGI.

anime.title: ClassicaLoid
anime.synopsis:
Ever since her father used up the last of the family fortune and skipped town, Kanae Otowa has lived in her family's ancestral mansion, Otowakan. With no way to pay off her father's debts, Otowakan is being foreclosed and Kanae must oust the remaining residents—her friend Sousuke Kagura, and two strange people who claim to be her father's acquaintances, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Ludwig van Beethoven. After somehow being resurrected, Mozart and Beethoven have started going by "Motes" and "Beethes" respectively, and begun to indulge in a variety of idiotic, non-musical pursuits.

While stubbornly refusing to leave Otowakan, Beethes unlocks the hidden power of Musik, saving Otowakan from demolition and delaying his eviction. With this discovery, other Musik users are drawn to Otowakan, including Frédéric Chopin, Franz Liszt, and Franz Schubert. However, not all Musik users have innocent desires. Across the city, the enigmatic Johann Sebastian Bach sits atop a tall building, plotting how to use his Musik.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some viewers found the show hilarious, colorful, and musically creative, others were put off by the weak plot, repetitive jokes, and shallow characters. The show's reliance on absurdity makes it divisive, with enjoyment heavily dependent on individual tolerance for its specific brand of humor.
pros: Colorful and unique art style
Creative remixes of classical music
Enjoyable and ridiculous comedy
cons: Weak or non-existent overarching plot
Repetitive comedic antics
Underdeveloped characters

anime.title: Dimension W
anime.synopsis:
In the near future, humans have discovered a fourth dimension, Dimension W, and a supposedly infinite source of energy within. In order to harness this profound new energy, mankind develops advanced "coils," devices that link to and use the power of Dimension W. However, by year 2071, the New Tesla Energy corporation has monopolized the energy industry with coils, soon leading to the illegal distribution of unofficial coils that begin flooding the markets.

Kyouma Mabuchi is an ex-soldier who is wary of all coil-based technology to the extent that he still drives a gas-powered car. Kyouma is a "Collector," individuals with the sole duty of hunting down illegal coils in exchange for money. What started out as just any other mission is turned on its head when he bumps into Mira Yurizaki, an android with a connection to the "father" of coils. When a series of strange events begin to take place, these two unlikely allies band together to uncover the mysteries of Dimension W.
anime.consensus_summary: Dimension W presents an original sci-fi world with engaging action and mystery elements that appeal to many viewers. However, the show suffers from a convoluted plot and inconsistent character development, leading to mixed opinions. While the premise and visuals are praised, the execution falters, leaving some viewers feeling underwhelmed by the latter half of the series.
pros: Original premise sidesteps common anime tropes.
Fluid animation and stylized CG enhance action sequences.
Intriguing world-building with consistent rules and visually stunning environments.
cons: Plot can be convoluted and lose focus in the later episodes.
Character development for some characters is lacking depth.
Initial episodes can be weak, and pacing can feel rushed.

anime.title: Snow White with the Red Hair 2
anime.synopsis:
Shirayuki and Zen Wistalia have finally confirmed their romantic feelings for each other, and everyone has resumed their daily lives. Shirayuki remains an apprentice court herbalist at the royal palace of Clarines, and Zen continues his duties alongside his aides.

However, their daily routines are disrupted when Crown Prince Izana, Zen’s older brother, receives an invitation from Raji Shenazard, the prince of Tanbarun. The herbalist finds herself ordered to go to Tanbarun for seven days, to build a new friendship with the formerly selfish and haughty ruler who once ordered Shirayuki to become his concubine. Along the way, Shirayuki is bound to run into trouble once again, as she is sought by a mysterious boy named Kazuki, someone she has never met.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is a mixed bag for viewers. While the series maintains its charming art style and likeable characters, some find the plot lacking in excitement and Shirayuki's character arc disappointing. However, many appreciate the show's focus on character development and healthy relationships, resulting in a generally positive, but not overwhelmingly enthusiastic, reception.
pros: Healthy dynamic between Shirayuki and Zen, prioritizing individual growth.
Likeable supporting cast with interesting side stories.
Calming and enjoyable to watch, with phenomenal art and sound.
cons: Story lacks significant events and can be monotonous.
Shirayuki's character devolves into a damsel-in-distress.
The plot feels incomplete, lacking a satisfying resolution to the main relationship.

anime.title: Mr. Osomatsu
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody
anime.synopsis:
The majority of the Matsuno household is comprised of six identical siblings: self-centered leader Osomatsu, manly Karamatsu, voice of reason Choromatsu, cynical Ichimatsu, hyperactive Juushimatsu, and lovable Todomatsu. Despite each one of them being over the age of 20, they are incredibly lazy and have absolutely no motivation to get a job, choosing to live as NEETs instead. In the rare occurrence that they try to look for employment and are somehow able to land an interview, their unique personalities generally lead to their swift rejection.

From trying to pick up girlfriends to finding the perfect job, the daily activities of the Matsuno brothers are never dull as they go on all sorts of crazy, and often downright bizarre, adventures. Though they desperately search for a way to improve their social standing, it won't be possible if they can't survive the various challenges that come with being sextuplets!
anime.consensus_summary: Osomatsu-san is a divisive comedy anime. While many appreciate its unique and crude humor, parodies, and absurd situations, others find it difficult to connect with due to its strong Japanese cultural references and lack of a serious plot. Some find the characters unlikeable or the jokes repetitive, leading to a polarized viewing experience.
pros: Unique and refreshing comedy style.
Enjoyable for those tired of typical anime tropes.
Strong voice acting and sound design.
Retro art style is appealing and easy to animate.
cons: Crude humor may be off-putting to some viewers.
Humor may not translate well to international audiences.
Lack of overarching plot can be a drawback for some.
Repetitive jokes.
Unlikable characters.
