Jokes can be dragged on for too long.

anime.title: Uta no Prince Sama Legend Star
anime.romaji_title: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Maji Love Legend Star
anime.genres: Comedy, Idols (Male), Josei, Music, Reverse Harem, Romance
anime.synopsis: The anime's story will start where the third season left off, at the competition for who will open the Triple S international sporting event. Raging Entertainment's HE★VENS idol group had hijacked the competition between QUARTET NIGHT and ST☆RISH, causing chaos. However, after the QUARTET NIGHT members suggest a certain idea, the three groups aim toward a new stage, with HE★VENS swearing to get their revenge on the other two groups.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response to Uta no Prince-sama♪ Maji Love Legend Star is positive, with many considering it an improvement over previous seasons. Viewers appreciate the focus on character development and the quality of the music. However, some are critical of the animation inconsistencies and the large cast of characters. The season is generally seen as enjoyable for fans of the series, despite its flaws.
pros: Improved character development and backstories for STARISH members and some HEAVENS members.
High-quality music and sound production, with engaging opening and ending themes.
Enjoyable bonding moments between the groups and a good balance of humor and deeper themes.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, particularly with CGI dance sequences and occasional proportion issues.
Too many characters to keep track of, leading to rushed development for some.
Lack of significant romance and a plot that may feel repetitive or shallow to some viewers.
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture, Character Development, Musical Performance

anime.title: Owarimonogatari
anime.synopsis:
A peculiar transfer student named Ougi Oshino has just arrived at Naoetsu Private High School. She is quickly introduced to senior student Koyomi Araragi by their mutual friend Kanbaru Suruga, in hopes of obtaining advice regarding a strange discovery she has made. After taking a look at the school's layout, Ougi notices that a classroom has appeared in an otherwise empty area—a place that should not exist. 

Unsure if this is the work of an apparition, Araragi and Ougi attempt to unravel the truth behind this enigma. But Araragi soon discovers, after finding himself locked in with Ougi, that the room holds the memory of an event he had long since forgotten.
anime.consensus_summary: Owarimonogatari is a polarizing entry in the Monogatari series, praised for its unique storytelling, character development, and artistic style. However, it is also criticized for its slow pacing, excessive dialogue, and occasional questionable content. Despite its flaws, many fans consider it a worthwhile addition to the franchise, while others find it disappointing.
pros: Intriguing dialogues and unique storytelling.
Avant-garde artwork by Studio Shaft.
Well-developed characters, especially Ougi and Sodachi.
Mature tone and compelling music.
Exploration of repressed memories and personal identity.
cons: Slow pacing in certain arcs.
Excessive dialogue and flashbacks.
Occasional obnoxious panty shots and traces of pedophilia.
Inconsistent quality across different arcs.
Filler content that doesn't contribute meaningfully to the plot.

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard G GIRS Crisis
anime.synopsis: The first half of the second season of Cardfight!! Vanguard G series.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the return of familiar elements and character development for certain characters, many criticize the predictable plot, perceived lack of challenge for the main character, and reliance on plot armor. The season is seen as a partial improvement over its predecessor but still falls short of expectations.
pros: Return of original cast is well-received.
Improved fight choreography compared to previous season.
Shion's character development is a highlight.
cons: Story feels predictable and relies on plot armor.
Main character (Chrono) is perceived as overpowered and lacking in development.
Subplots are insufficient to elevate the overall narrative.
anime.thematic_vibe: Tournament Arc, Character Growth, Intergenerational Conflict

anime.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita and the Birth of Japan 2016
anime.romaji_title: Doraemon Movie 36: Shin Nobita no Nippon Tanjou
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Kids, Shounen, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Doraemon and friends run away from their home and travel back in time to the 70,000 years ago where nobody existed to build their ideal private paradise. After they fully relished the freedom in the era, Doraemon and friends bid farewell to their paradise and come back to the present day. However, a few days after they came back home, Doraemon and friends bump into a caveman called "Kukul" in the current era. They find out that the caveman Kukul was accidentally transported forward to the present, and that his tribe called Hikari tribe was attacked and abducted by Giga Zombie and Kurayami tribe after Doraemon and friends left the primitive age.

Doraemon and friends decide to go back to the primitive age to save Hikari tribe from the villain.

They dive into a grand adventure during their first and the furthest runaway.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, driven by nostalgia and appreciation for the updated animation and heartwarming story.  Viewers who grew up with Doraemon find the remake to be a delightful and emotional experience, effectively rekindling childhood memories. There is little to no controversy surrounding the film.
pros: Better animation and art style compared to the original.
Emotional story that resonates with childhood memories.
Good opening and ending themes that enhance the viewing experience.

anime.title: Tantei Team KZ Jiken Note
anime.synopsis: Tantei Team KZ Jiken Note centers on sixth grader Aya Tachibana who worries about friends, family, grades, and more. One day, she joins the Detective Team KZ with four very unique boys that she met in cram school: Kazuomi Wakatake, Takakazu Kuroki, Kazunori Uesagi, and Kazuhiko Kozuka.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the show's focus on realistic, age-appropriate mysteries and relatable characters. The main character's sense of isolation and the development of friendships resonate with viewers. However, some find the mystery solutions to be unrealistic and the mysteries themselves to be weak points of the series.
pros: Refreshing to see grounded mysteries appropriate for middle schoolers.
Well-developed characters with realistic problems, especially the main character's sense of isolation.
The series creates a strong sense of attachment to the characters.
cons: Mysteries are often solved absurdly, with the children having access to unrealistic information.
The mysteries themselves aren't particularly strong.

anime.title: Phantasy Star Online 2 The Animation
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2027, the video game Phantasy Star Online 2 is all the rage at Seiga Academy. Every student is on board the fad—except for Itsuki Tachibana, a well-rounded student who doesn't play video games. Due to its popularity, the game is currently under review at Seiga Academy to see if it has a negative impact on the students. Consequently, this causes Itsuki to catch the attention of Rina Izumi, the perfectionist student council president who aims to prove that the game is not to blame. 

To accomplish her objective, Rina recruits Itsuki as the student council vice president and tasks him with learning to play the game while keeping his grades up. Now obliged to report his daily findings of the game to Rina and analyze its merits, Itsuki carries the fate of Phantasy Star Online 2 in his hands.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many viewing the anime as a mediocre adaptation that primarily serves as advertising for the PSO2 game. Fans of the game may find some enjoyment in its references and additional context, but the anime suffers from a generic plot, poor animation, and tonal inconsistencies. It fails to appeal to a broader audience due to its over-reliance on clichés and weak character development.
pros: Faithful representation of PSO2 game elements and sound effects.
Enjoyable for fans of the game who want additional context.
Presents a meta-narrative on video games and online culture with some humor.
cons: Weak plot and character development; generic and predictable story.
Poor animation quality, inconsistent CGI, and choppy fight scenes.
Feels like an extended advertisement with forced product placement and MMO education.
Tonal inconsistency; struggles to balance slice-of-life with serious plot elements.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, MMORPG, High School

anime.title: The File of Young Kindaichi Returns 2nd Season
anime.romaji_title: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo Returns 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Hajime Kindaichi once again becomes embroiled in solving baffling cases and deciphering puzzling crimes that would confound the most seasoned of detectives. Whether it's a gruesome murder and shady circumstances surrounding the Japanese board game Go; a perplexing and macabre case involving a mysterious character, "Rosenkreutz," and blue roses; or blood curdling crimes associated with an urban legend at a winter ski resort – Hajime is out to crack them all!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo Returns 2nd Season. Fans appreciate the engaging mysteries and faithful adaptation, while some manga readers note that the anime sometimes omits key clues and subtleties present in the original source material. The show is considered a good entry point for newcomers to the franchise.
pros: Fun, exciting, and easy to follow stories.
Faithful adaptation to the manga.
Good introduction to the Kindaichi experience.
Difficult to guess the perpetrator, keeps you engaged.
cons: Some key clues are left out, making it harder to solve the mystery compared to the manga.
Anime lags behind in hinting the killer compared to the manga.

anime.title: Servamp
anime.synopsis:
Mahiru Shirota firmly believes that simple is best and troublesome things should be avoided at all costs. It is troublesome to do nothing and regret it later—and this ideology has led the 15-year-old to pick up a stray cat on his way home from school. As he affectionately names the feline Kuro, little does he know that this chance meeting will spark an extraordinary change in his everyday life.

One day, Mahiru returns home to find something quite strange: a mysterious young man he has never seen before. His subsequent panic results in the uninvited guest being exposed to sunlight and—much to Mahiru's shock—transforming into Kuro! Upon revealing himself as a mere lazy shut-in vampire, Kuro promises to leave once night falls. However, one disaster after another leads to Mahiru accidentally forming a contract with his new freeloader, dragging him into a life-threatening battle of supernatural servants and bloodthirsty beings that is anything but simple.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers appreciating the art style, opening theme, and initial concept. However, many criticize the rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, and unsatisfying ending. The series is considered entertaining but ultimately falls short of its potential, with several reviewers suggesting the manga offers a more complete and satisfying experience.
pros: Bright and colorful art style with distinctive character designs.
Enjoyable opening theme music that suits the anime's theme.
Interesting concept of Servamps and Eves with potential for deeper exploration.
Some viewers found the characters relatable, particularly Mahiru.
The action sequences were considered a plus for the show.
cons: Story feels rushed and fails to fully explore character backstories and motivations.
Too many characters introduced without proper development, leading to a lack of presence.
Plot becomes convoluted with multiple subplots and unresolved storylines.
Ending feels incomplete and unsatisfying, leaving many questions unanswered.
Inconsistent tone and misplaced music detract from the overall experience.

anime.title: Pokémon the Movie: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel
anime.romaji_title: Pokemon Movie 19: Volcanion to Karakuri no Magearna
anime.synopsis: In this latest cinematic adventure, Satoshi meets the Mythical Pokémon Volcanion when it crashes down from the sky, creating a cloud of dust—and a mysterious force binds the two of them together! Volcanion despises humans and tries to get away, but it’s forced to drag Satoshi along as it continues its rescue mission. They arrive in a city of cogs and gears, where a corrupt minister has stolen the ultimate invention: the Artificial Pokémon Magearna, created 500 years ago. He plans to use its mysterious power to take control of this mechanical kingdom! Can Satoshi and Volcanion work together to rescue Magearna? One of the greatest battles in Pokémon history is about to unfold!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on the narrative quality of Volcanion to Karakuri no Magearna, with strong praise for its animation, music, and character of Volcanion, but significant criticism for a generic and underdeveloped plot. While many found it enjoyable and visually impressive, a notable portion felt it failed to live up to its thematic potential and relied too heavily on established Pokémon movie tropes.
pros: Stunning animation and art, with incredibly fluid movement and no noticeable still shots.
Excellent sound design and music, with voice acting conveying Pokémon emotions and fitting insert/theme songs.
Memorable characters, each with distinct personalities and significant roles, including Pokémon.
Volcanion is a standout character who largely carries the film and makes it engaging.
cons: The plot is generic and repetitive, featuring a standard 'bad guy steals invention' trope.
The movie fails to explore its potentially interesting themes of the difference between machines and living creatures, or the concept of a soul-heart.
Underutilization of the forced mega-evolution plotline and its potential connection to Pokémon abandonment and distrust.
Some awkward animation moments, particularly with character clothing changes.
Ash's characterization is criticized for being self-righteous and preachy.
Repetitive settings and plot elements found in many previous Pokémon movies.

anime.title: Himouto! Umaru-chanS
anime.synopsis: These shorts, included in the Blu-ray and DVD releases, take place in a timeline with multiple Umaru-chans.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience generally finds the shorts to be a fun and entertaining addition, especially for fans of the original series. While the short format and comedy are praised, some minor criticisms are directed at the art style and character consistency.
pros: Highly enjoyable and entertaining in short, digestible episodes.
Excellent sound design and voice acting.
Pacing is good, doesn't drag on.
Manages to tell a story effectively within the short format.
cons: Art style could be improved.
Characters (specifically Umaru) don't always balance well or feel consistent with their main series counterparts.
Some characters feel dull or out of place in the shorts.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Fan Service

anime.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Isekai, Psychological, Suspense, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
When Subaru Natsuki leaves the convenience store, the last thing he expects is to be wrenched from his everyday life and dropped into a fantasy world. Things are not looking good for the bewildered teenager; however, not long after his arrival, he is attacked by some thugs. Armed with only a bag of groceries and a now useless cell phone, he is quickly beaten to a pulp. Fortunately, a mysterious beauty named Satella, in hot pursuit after the one who stole her insignia, happens upon Subaru and saves him. In order to thank the honest and kindhearted girl, Subaru offers to help in her search, and later that night, he even finds the whereabouts of that which she seeks. But unbeknownst to them, a much darker force stalks the pair from the shadows, and just minutes after locating the insignia, Subaru and Satella are brutally murdered.

However, Subaru immediately reawakens to a familiar scene—confronted by the same group of thugs, meeting Satella all over again—the enigma deepens as history inexplicably repeats itself.
anime.consensus_summary: Re:Zero is a polarizing anime praised for its dark take on the isekai genre, character growth through suffering, and unique time loop mechanic. However, it's criticized for its frustrating main character, uneven pacing, and reliance on shock value over substance. While some find it a masterpiece, others consider it an overhyped and unremarkable show.
pros: Realistic portrayal of character growth through suffering.
Unique twist on the isekai genre.
Compelling drama, loss, and friendship elements.
Excellent art, soundtrack, and voice acting.
Exploration of mental breakdown and redemption.
cons: Subaru's character can be over-stupid and frustrating.
Story lacks proper prologue and ending for certain plot points.
Relies on shocking gore and theatrics instead of meaningful storytelling.
Uneven pacing, with some arcs being depressing and disgusting.
Inconsistent character development for Emilia.
anime.thematic_vibe: Dark Fantasy, Time Loop, Psychological Thriller

anime.title: I've Always Liked You
anime.romaji_title: Zutto Mae kara Suki deshita. Kokuhaku Jikkou Iinkai
anime.synopsis:
Love is blooming at Sakuragaoka High School. Natsuki Enomoto has finally mustered the courage to confess to her childhood friend, Yuu Setoguchi. However, in the final moments of her confession, an embarrassed Natsuki passes it off as a "practice confession." Oblivious to her true feelings and struggling with his own, Yuu promises to support Natsuki in her quest for love. While Natsuki deals with her failed confession, fellow classmate Koyuki Ayase struggles with his own feelings for Natsuki. Despite his timidness, he is determined to win over her heart.

Zutto Mae Kara Suki deshita.: Kokuhaku Jikkou Iinkai follows Natsuki as she dreams of one day ending her practices and genuinely confessing to Yuu. Meanwhile, close friends also find themselves entangled in their own webs of unrequited love and unspoken affections.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found the movie to be a sweet and enjoyable high school romance with appealing visuals and music, especially if they were already fans of HoneyWorks. However, others criticized it for being generic, rushed, and lacking depth, with too many characters and unresolved storylines.
pros: Cute art style and animation.
Enjoyable music and sound design.
Likable characters (for some viewers).
Heartwarming and fluffy romance.
Faithful adaptation of HoneyWorks songs (for fans).
cons: Generic and unoriginal story.
Rushed plot and character development.
Too many characters and storylines crammed into a short movie.
Cliffhanger ending.
Shallow and meaningless (according to some viewers).
anime.thematic_vibe: Sweet Romance, High School, Unrequited Love

anime.title: Mix Master: Final Force
anime.synopsis: Mix Masters Final Force is the second season of the original mix masters show. In this story, Ditt forgets that he was a mix master. But when the time comes to save the world once again, he finds new friends to help him in his battle against Eva and Babel, the two new antagonists.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is well-received by its target demographic of young children and those who enjoy simpler storylines and action. While older viewers may find it childish, it's praised for its engaging characters and exciting battles, similar to Pokemon. The main critique revolves around missing characters from the first season.
pros: Enjoyable for younger audiences
Good story (specifically mentions Dit and Moreen)
Well-designed characters
Awesome opening theme
cons: Too childish for older audiences (above 15)
Older characters from season 1 are missed

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Tekketsu no Orphans
anime.synopsis:
Over three hundred years have passed since the Calamity War, the great conflict between Earth and its outer space colonies. Now Earth is ruled over by four economic blocs, and the military organization Gjallarhorn is responsible for keeping the peace. Mars, on the other hand, depends heavily on Earth's economy.

Horrified by the appalling living conditions that Mars' inhabitants have to bear, Kudelia Aina Bernstein, a young aristocrat from the Chryse Autonomous Region, gets involved in the Red Planet's independence movement. She hires the services of a local company, Chryse Guard Security (CGS), to escort her on the journey to Earth to negotiate economic conditions with the earthly bloc that controls the region. The Third Army Division—consisting of Mikazuki Augus, Orga Itsuka, and many other child soldiers—are chosen to protect her.

When Gjallarhorn attacks the CGS facilities to assassinate the young revolutionary threatening their interests, Orga and his comrades must not let the attackers accomplish their goal—in fact, Gjallarhorn's actions might turn out to be the unintentional catalyst that leads the children to be the forgers of their own destiny.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Some viewers praise the series for its emotional depth, character-driven narrative, and exploration of mature themes within the Gundam universe. Others criticize the show for plot inconsistencies, rushed pacing, and underwhelming character development, particularly in the second season.
pros: Compelling characters and their relationships
Emotional and thought-provoking exploration of war and survival
Well-executed mecha action sequences
Unique and interesting story, especially in the first season
cons: Rushed or confusing plot development, especially in later episodes
Inconsistent character development
Predictable story elements, such as death flags
Dialogue and translation issues

anime.title: Selector Destructed WIXOSS Movie
anime.genres: High Stakes Game, Psychological, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis: This movie is a retelling/summary of Selector Infected and Spread, with extra scenes interspersed such as the characters in childhood. Despite mostly being previously used scenes, they were cut and altered to make a high intensity and fast paced story, highlighting the moments of slow silence and reflection. Some changes were made such as the true origin of Tama's name, the significance of Sachi and Rumi, and the relationship between your name and being alone.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is mainly for those who watched the series. It offers a more satisfying ending with a few new scenes, but is largely a recap. Those new to the series should watch the original seasons first.
pros: Provides a more complete ending than the second season.
New scenes in the beginning and end offer valuable context and closure.
Good for viewers who felt incomplete after the series.
cons: Heavily reliant on prior knowledge of the Infected and Spread series.
Overuse of recap scenes detracts from enjoyment.
New content is minimal compared to recap content.

anime.title: One Piece: Episode of Sabo - Bond of Three Brothers, A Miraculous Reunion and an Inherited Will
anime.romaji_title: One Piece: Episode of Sabo - 3 Kyoudai no Kizuna Kiseki no Saikai to Uketsugareru Ishi
anime.synopsis: The special will revisit the childhood past of the three sworn brothers Luffy, Ace, and Sabo, when they all dreamed of becoming pirates. In addition, it will depict how Sabo originally came into the kingdom of Dressrosa (which was not depicted in Eiichiro Oda's original manga or the television anime), as well as his reunion with Luffy from his point of view.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is a mixed bag, praised for its animation updates but criticized for its heavy reliance on recycled content and lack of substantial new material focusing on Sabo. Many felt it was a missed opportunity to explore Sabo's character and his interactions with other revolutionaries. The pacing issues and the rehashed Dressrosa arc were also major points of disappointment for viewers seeking fresh content.
pros: Updated animation on Dressrosa scenes is well-done.
Good for catching up with the story.
cons: Too much recycled content.
Not enough new Sabo content.
Pacing is too fast and feels like padding.
Animation and art quality are inconsistent.
Storyline feels like a 'cop out' with the amnesia plot.

anime.title: Tokyo Ghoul: Pinto
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Psychological, Seinen, Suspense, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Shuu Tsukiyama is a "ghoul": a creature who eats human flesh, and he likes to enjoy his meals to the fullest. One night, while relishing in the premeditated murder of his dinner, Shuu's much anticipated first bite is disturbed by a sudden flash of light.

The flash turns out to be from the camera of high schooler Chie Hori, who presents Shuu with the perfect picture capturing his true nature; the extremely clear shot of a bloody corpse and an overly excited Shuu threatens to expose his ghoul identity, thus Shuu needs to sort out this situation quickly.

After Shuu discovers that Chie attends the same high school as him and is even in the same class, the reason behind his feelings of obsession changes from self-preservation to morbid curiosity. As he grows closer to the absent-minded and extremely odd photographer, he challenges them both to learn more about each other's conflicting worlds; Shuu promises that Chie will come out of this experience with a photograph superior to the one she already has.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally found 'Pinto' to be an enjoyable and well-crafted OVA, particularly for its exploration of Shuu Tsukiyama's character and his relationship with Chie Hori. While the overarching story and character dynamics were praised, some viewers found the graphic hospital scenes to be jarring and off-putting, leading to a moderate level of audience division.
pros: Compelling exploration of Shuu Tsukiyama's character and his 'gourmet' nature.
Interesting dynamic and interactions between Tsukiyama and Chie Hori.
Atmospheric settings and immersive environments.
High-quality voice acting, particularly for Tsukiyama.
Well-crafted side story that fits within the broader Tokyo Ghoul universe.
cons: Art and character development are considered unremarkable by some.
The hospital scenes are too graphic and disturbing for some viewers.
Interactions between the main characters can feel boring or lack connection to some.
Sound design is largely forgettable for some critics.

anime.title: Comet Lucifer
anime.synopsis:
In the world of Gift, the bowels of the planet hide a highly sought after crystalline substance known as Giftium. A young boy on Gift named Sougo Amagi inherited his interest in Giftium from his mother, a researcher. As an inhabitant of Garden Indigo, a small and prosperous miner's town, Sougo has many opportunities to forage and collect rare crystals that can only be found there.

However, the most exciting treasure that Sougo discovers is not a crystal, but a person. After being pulled into a school quarrel, he plummets into the deep caverns of an old mine. There, in the abysmal depths of the earth, Felia—an enigmatic girl with red eyes and blue hair—emerges from a large crystal. Through this strange first encounter, bonds of friendship are formed between Felia and Sougo. But Felia is being pursued by a secret organization that aims to use her powers for their own benefit, and Sougo and his friends must help her, all while discovering the true nature of this girl from the crystal.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally dislikes Comet Lucifer. Reviewers criticize the uninspired story, generic characters, and poor pacing. While the visuals are praised, they are not enough to compensate for the weak narrative and lack of character development, leading to an overall disappointing experience.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation, especially the backgrounds and mecha designs.
Some initial curiosity sparked by the world-building and sci-fi elements.
Well-choreographed mecha fight scenes.
cons: Generic and uninspired characters with little to no development.
Lackluster and predictable plot with too many subplots and unexplained elements.
Poor pacing and inconsistent tone, switching between slice-of-life and action without proper integration.
Weak character motivations and nonsensical story developments.

anime.title: Grisaia no Meikyuu: Caprice no Mayu 0 - Takizono Basketball Club no Nama Cream Party!
anime.romaji_title: Grisaia no Meikyuu: Caprice no Mayu 0 - Takizono Basketball Club no Nama Cream Party!
anime.synopsis: Special bundled with the Blu-ray/DVD volume of Grisaia no Meikyuu.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on the special's use of ecchi. While some appreciate it as a light-hearted departure and a core part of the franchise, others find the sexualization of problematic themes, particularly the sibling relationship, to be deeply uncomfortable and exploitative, overshadowing any positive aspects.
pros: Provides a light-hearted breather from the series' usual darker themes.
Animation is good and production delivers on its goals.
Fanservice is acknowledged as a core part of the franchise's identity.
cons: Sexualization of problematic themes, specifically a sibling relationship, is uncomfortable and exploitative rather than narrative.
Heavy focus on ecchi overshadows other aspects of the special.
The execution of sexualizing traumatic situations is considered a poor choice.

anime.title: High School DxD BorN Specials
anime.romaji_title: High School DxD BorN: Ishibumi Ichiei Kanzen Kanshuu! Mousou Bakuyou Kaijo Original Video
anime.synopsis:
Specials included with the Blu-ray/DVD volumes.

 "Rias and Akeno's Womanly Battle!?" - Rias and Akeno compete to see whose sexy roleplay has greater appeal for Issei. (3:18)
"The Church Trio's Underwear, Amen!" - Irina, Xenovia, and Asia compare their "battle underwear". (3:11)
"Koneko's Healing Sage Arts, Meow" - Koneko has a healing technique, but does Issei have the wrong idea? (3:44)
"Levia and So" - Tsubaki can't decide between two magical girl costumes and convinces a reluctant Sona to try one one. (3:29)
"Steamy Grayfia" - Grayfia isn't quite herself when she and Issei accidentally encounter each other in the bath. (3:24)
"Rossweisse's True Teaching Story" - When Rossweisse helps Issei study for a test, it proves difficult to avoid inappropriately distracting him. (3:07)
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is appreciated for its return to the series' roots in humor and fan service, particularly reminiscent of Season 1. However, it is criticized for its lack of plot and over-reliance on fan service, making it a collection of short, disconnected scenes. The technical aspects, such as animation, are generally praised, while the soundtrack receives little attention.
pros: Revival of Season 1's humor and fan service.
High-quality animation with focus on skin tones.
cons: Lack of a significant plot or overarching story.
Heavy reliance on fan service over substance.
Soundtrack is unremarkable and unmemorable.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fan Service, Humor, Slice of Life

anime.title: Food Wars! OVA
anime.synopsis:
Takumi no Shitamachi Kassen
Following the end of the exhausting training camp, brothers Takumi and Isami Aldini spend their holiday sightseeing Tokyo Tower and its surroundings. While learning about the local culture and tasting various dishes, the two encounter Megumi Tadokoro, Ryouko Sakaki, and Yuuki Yoshino, who all happened to be touring the area as well. The group decides to have lunch together at a traditional Japanese restaurant—where an unexpected food duel is set to take place.

Natsuyasumi no Erina
Tootsuki students are hard at work experimenting with dishes for the Autumn Elections during the summer break; but for Erina Nakiri, her preparations for the event are already complete. Just as she dwells on what to do with her free time, she receives an invitation to the public pool from her cousin Alice. Despite her initial hesitation, Erina takes the opportunity to broaden her horizons and explore what this seemingly ordinary summer activity has to offer. Meanwhile, the members of the Polar Star Dormitory kick off a small party at a nearby lake to cool off and enjoy themselves before the Autumn Elections.
anime.consensus_summary: The Shokugeki no Souma OVA is generally well-received by fans, particularly for its focus on side characters like the Aldini brothers and Erina. While the OVA doesn't contribute significantly to the main plot, it offers enjoyable slice-of-life content and character development. The production quality remains consistent with the main series, making it a worthwhile watch for fans seeking more of the Shokugeki no Souma world.
pros: Good fun and character development for side characters.
Faithful to the series, enjoyable for fans of the Aldini brothers and Erina.
Consistent art style, voice acting, and music with the main anime.
cons: Non-essential to the plot; can be skipped without missing crucial information.
Stories are not as interesting/exciting as the main storyline.
OVA doesn't add anything new to the character portion of the show for some viewers.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Fan Service, Character Focus

anime.title: Hundred
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
When an extraterrestrial organism known as "Savage" attacks mankind, the only technology capable of combating the enemy is a weapon known as “Hundred.” A survivor of a Savage attack, Hayato Kisaragi is a teenager boasting the highest compatibility level with the aforementioned technology and as a result, is invited to master his skills at Little Garden, a prestigious military academy aboard a battleship.

Over the course of his intense training for the battle ahead, he immediately attracts the interest of multiple female peers and gets drawn into a number of incidents as he tries to fight against the creatures that now inhabit Earth and threaten its safety.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience reception to 'Hundred' is largely negative due to its reliance on tired harem tropes and lack of originality. While some viewers appreciated the action and romance, the majority found the story predictable and the characters bland. The series is considered a generic addition to the harem/ecchi genre, with few elements that allow it to stand out.
pros: Good action sequences and animation quality.
Some viewers enjoyed the romance elements and character interactions.
The MC actually makes a choice regarding the love interests, which is atypical for the genre.
cons: Generic and unoriginal plot with overused tropes.
Forgettable and clichéd characters with poor development.
Weak story developments and predictable plot.
Inconsistent animation quality and noticeable errors.

anime.title: Drifters
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Gore, Historical, Isekai, Military, Samurai, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
At the Battle of Sekigahara in 1600, Toyohisa Shimazu is the rearguard for his retreating troops, and is critically wounded when he suddenly finds himself in a modern, gleaming white hallway. Faced with only a stoic man named Murasaki and hundreds of doors on both sides, Toyohisa is pulled into the nearest door and into a world completely unlike his own.

The strange land is populated by all manner of fantastical creatures, as well as warriors from different eras of Toyohisa's world who were thought to be dead. Quickly befriending the infamous warlord Nobunaga Oda and the ancient archer Yoichi Suketaka Nasu, Toyohisa learns of the political unrest tearing through the continent. Furthermore, they have been summoned as "Drifters" to fight against the "Ends," people who are responsible for the creation of the Orte Empire and are trying to annihilate the Drifters. As the Ends grow more powerful, so does the Empire's persecution of elves and other demihumans. It is up to Toyohisa and his group of unconventional heroes to battle in a brand-new world war to help the Empire's subjects, while challenging the Ends protecting the land to claim it for themselves.
anime.consensus_summary: Drifters is a visually appealing anime with an intriguing premise that brings together historical figures in a fantasy world. While many enjoy the action and character interactions, some find the plot lacking in depth and the art style inconsistent. The show is generally considered entertaining, but not a masterpiece.
pros: Unique premise with historical figures from different eras
Visually stunning art and fluid combat animation
Characters are well-developed and stay true to their historical counterparts
cons: Story lacks depth and can be confusing for those unfamiliar with historical figures
Some find the art style unappealing or inconsistent
Plot feels underdeveloped and relies on common tropes

anime.title: Grisaia no Rakuen Specials
anime.synopsis: Short specials included in the Blu-ray and DVD releases.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on the purpose and value of these specials. While fans of ecchi and Grisaia characters appreciate the abundant fan service and suggestive humor, those seeking plot progression or thematic depth found them lacking and a departure from the main series' tone. They are viewed primarily as supplementary content for a specific niche audience.
pros: Delivers abundant ecchi and fan service for fans of the genre and characters.
Satisfying for viewers specifically seeking fan service and suggestive situations.
Genuinely funny moments due to exaggerated situations.
cons: Does not advance the main plot or provide essential information to the universe.
Lacks the tragic, dramatic, or character trauma elements associated with the main Grisaia series.
Can be disorienting for viewers expecting more plot and character development.

anime.title: Tonkatsu DJ Agetarou
anime.synopsis:
Tonkatsu chef by day, professional DJ by night—this is the aspiration of Agetarou Katsumata, whose family owns a small tonkatsu shop in Shibuya.
 
One night, Agetarou delivers an order to a staff member at a nightclub and gets invited inside as a token of thanks. Although nervous at first, he soon finds himself absorbed by the atmosphere, falling in love with the dancing girls, flashing lights, and groovy music. Agetarou starts visiting the club regularly until a certain night leads him to a chance encounter with a legendary American DJ: Big Master Fly. Putting on a spectacular show, the DJ sparks an epiphany in Agetarou—the groove of mixing music appears to be strikingly similar to the rhythm of preparing tonkatsu. Thenceforth Agetarou sets his sights on becoming a master of both disciplines.
 
With the help of his neighborhood friends and his mentor DJ Oily, Agetarou pursues his dream all the while dealing with familial problems, love issues, and many other kinds of trouble. Tonkatsu DJ Agetarou is a hilarious tale about an impulsive young boy trying to find his own path in life, while still fulfilling his familial and social responsibilities.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys "Tonkatsu DJ Agetarou" for its fresh concept, positive vibes, and unique blend of music and cooking. While some find the animation and music repetitive, the likeable characters and the show's upbeat nature contribute to an enjoyable experience. The series is considered a hidden gem that may have flown under the radar due to its unconventional style.
pros: Unique premise blending tonkatsu cooking and DJing.
Positive and upbeat tone with little drama.
Likeable characters and their supportive relationships.
Educational aspects about DJing and tonkatsu preparation.
Catchy music and enjoyable atmosphere.
cons: Inconsistent or 'Sasuga DEEN™' level art and animation quality.
Repetitive music.
Story may feel incomplete due to the short episode format.
Pace changes per episode.
Potential for more creative and visually engaging absurdity.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Junior High
anime.synopsis:
On his first day of junior high, Eren Yeager comes face-to-face with a titan—and has his lunch stolen! From that day on, he holds a grudge against titans for taking his favorite food from him, a cheeseburger, vowing to eliminate their kind once and for all. Along with his adoptive sister Mikasa Ackerman and their friend Armin Arlert, the trio traverse the halls of Titan Junior High, encountering familiar faces and participating in various extracurricular activities as part of the Wall Cleanup Club.

A parody of the immensely popular parent series, Shingeki! Kyojin Chuugakkou places beloved characters as junior high school students, fighting to protect their lunches from gluttonous titans.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed but leans positive, with many finding the show a hilarious and enjoyable parody of Attack on Titan. Fans of the original series appreciate the references, character exaggerations, and comedic takes on serious moments. However, some criticize it as a shallow cash grab that relies too heavily on prior knowledge and repetitive humor, potentially alienating new viewers or those seeking deeper narratives.
pros: Effective parody of the original Attack on Titan, with references well-integrated.
Characters are exaggerated versions of themselves, enhancing the comedic effect.
Original voice actors reprise their roles, adding to the authenticity and humor.
Soundtrack and opening theme are well-received and contribute to the overall enjoyment.
cons: Relies heavily on knowledge of the original series; may not be enjoyable for newcomers.
Some find the humor repetitive or the characters one-dimensional.
The story is often inconsequential, serving mainly as a vehicle for comedic situations.
Some consider it a cash grab that milks the franchise without adding significant value.

anime.title: Flying Witch
anime.genres: Fantasy, Iyashikei, Shounen, Slice of Life, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
In the witches' tradition, when a practitioner turns 15, they must become independent and leave their home to study witchcraft. Makoto Kowata is one such apprentice witch who leaves her parents' home in Yokohama in pursuit of knowledge and training. Along with her companion Chito, a black cat familiar, they embark on a journey to Aomori, a region favored by witches due to its abundance of nature and affinity with magic. They begin their new life by living with Makoto's second cousins, Kei Kuramoto and his little sister Chinatsu.

While Makoto may seem to be attending high school like any other teenager, her whimsical and eccentric involvement with witchcraft sets her apart from others her age. From her encounter with an anthropomorphic dog fortune teller to the peculiar magic training she receives from her older sister Akane, Makoto's peaceful everyday life is filled with the idiosyncrasies of witchcraft that she shares with her friends and family.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that Flying Witch is a relaxing and enjoyable slice-of-life anime with a unique blend of fantasy and charming characters. Its soothing atmosphere, beautiful scenery, and calming music create a healing experience for viewers. However, some find the lack of plot and conflict to be a drawback, making it dull for those seeking more excitement.
pros: Relaxing and tranquil atmosphere
Charming characters and their interactions
Beautiful scenery and calming music
Unique blend of slice of life and fantasy
Subtle message about humans and nature
Ghibli-esque imaginative world
cons: Lack of significant plot or conflict
Uneventful situations that may bore some viewers
Characters may not be particularly original or deep
Repetitive episodic format

anime.title: Seraph of the End: Vampire Shahar
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Military, Shounen, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
The story is set before the main story's "Battle in Nagoya" arc.

The Shinoa Squad receives another mission from Guren; to rescue a human girl named Riko from a mysterious vampire, Shahar, and bring her back to her family. However, Ferid and Crowley also appear when they find Shahar. Can Yuuichirou save the girl?
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is well-received as a good addition to the Owari no Seraph story, offering more action and a self-contained narrative.  While a few minor inconsistencies in character portrayals are noted, the overall production quality and integration into the existing storyline are praised. The audience generally considers it a worthwhile watch for fans of the series.
pros: Good mini-story with action.
Fits well between the two seasons.
Sound and music are on par with the main story.
cons: Minor inconsistencies with character personalities.

anime.title: To LOVE-Ru Darkness 2nd OVA
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: A scan of Jump SQ's September issue, to be released on August 4, revealed that the fifteenth volume of To LOVE-Ru Darkness will bundle a new OVA, which will be released on January 4. Consisting of two episodes, the OVA will run for a total of 25 minutes. One episode, titled Ghost Story Kowai no wa Ikaga (How about something scary?), will adapt a side-story from volume nine. The second episode, titled Clinic Sunao ni Narenakute (Without becoming obedient), will adapt chapter 38.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA continues the established formula of the To Love-Ru franchise, delivering familiar harem, romance, and comedy elements. While some appreciate the consistent art style and fan service, others find the story mediocre and the main character annoying. Overall, it seems to satisfy existing fans without significantly expanding the audience.
pros: Great Art (boobs, panties, asses, camel toe)
cons: Rito is indecisive and annoying
Mediocre story

anime.title: Aru Hi Inu no Kuni kara Tegami ga Kite
anime.romaji_title: Aru Hi Inu no Kuni kara Tegami ga Kite
anime.synopsis: The original novel and manga adaptation focus on letters sent from deceased dogs to their former owners. The anime adaptation stars P-chan, a dog whose owner abandoned him.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime OVA 'Aru Hi Inu no Kuni kara Tegami ga Kite' is well-received for its heartwarming and charming portrayal of the bond between humans and dogs. While it lacks depth due to its short runtime, its simple storytelling and emotional message resonate positively with viewers. The audience consensus suggests a generally positive and touched sentiment towards the anime.
pros: Simple but effective storytelling
Focus on the bond between humans and dogs
Enjoyable and adorable within a short timeframe
cons: Lacks depth in character development
Lacks depth in setting
Lacks depth in story progression
Lacks extravagant themes

anime.title: Fate/stay night [Unlimited Blade Works] Season 2: Sunny Day
anime.romaji_title: Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works 2nd Season - Sunny Day
anime.synopsis:
As the Fifth Holy Grail War reaches its conclusion, Saber repeats her final duty from the previous war in order to end the vicious cycle once and for all. With the decisive blow draining her remaining mana reserves, Saber's body begins to dissipate. She utters a tearful farewell—but Rin Toosaka reaches out to her at the last moment. 

The future has been changed, and a new beginning awaits.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views this OVA as a positive, albeit non-canonical, epilogue that offers a heartwarming conclusion for Saber fans. While some acknowledge its narrative inconsistencies and lack of new plot, its high production quality and emotional payoff for devoted viewers are widely appreciated.
pros: Excellent animation and art quality, consistent with the main series.
Heartwarming atmosphere providing a satisfying emotional conclusion for fans.
Faithful adaptation of the visual novel's 'Good Ending', appreciated by source material fans.
The music complements the emotional tone effectively.
cons: Illogical narrative elements due to its nature as a 'what if' or alternative ending.
Minimal new content; primarily serves as fan service for Saber fans.
Does not significantly impact the overall anime narrative or introduce new plot points.

anime.title: And you thought there is never a girl online?
anime.romaji_title: Netoge no Yome wa Onnanoko ja Nai to Omotta?
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, School, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
After mustering up the courage to propose to a girl in an online game, naive otaku Hideki "Rusian" Nishimura is devastated when she flat-out rejects him. To make matters worse, the girl reveals that she is actually an older man in real life. With his dreams crushed and his heart broken, Rusian comes to an abrupt decision in the midst of his raging fit: he will never trust another girl in an online game again.

Years later, Rusian is now in a guild with three other players, one of whom possesses a female avatar by the name of Ako. Ako is deeply in love with Rusian and wants to marry him. Although he entertains the possibility that she might be a guy, Rusian accepts her proposal, claiming that her gender does not matter as long as she is cute in-game. However, after a discussion between the guild members that led to all of them having an offline meeting, Rusian finds out that Ako, along with the other members, is not just a girl but also his schoolmate.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in its lightheartedness, relatable gaming references, and cute characters, while others criticize its weak plot, overused tropes, and annoying characters. The show is considered a decent time-killer for fans of the genre, but not particularly memorable or impactful. There's a divide between those who appreciate the nostalgia and those who find the show's flaws too glaring to ignore.
pros: Enjoyable characters with relatable qualities, especially for gamers.
Nostalgic feel reminiscent of mid-2010s anime.
Good animation and sound design enhance the experience.
cons: Weak or non-existent plot with dropped plot points.
Over-reliance on harem and ecchi tropes.
Inconsistent character development and irrational character behavior (e.g., Ako).

anime.title: Joker Game
anime.synopsis:
With World War II right around the corner, intelligence on other countries' social and economic situation has become a valuable asset. As a result, Japan has established a new spy organization known as the "D Agency" to obtain this weapon.

Under the command of Lieutenant Colonel Yuuki, eight agents have been assigned to infiltrate and observe some of the most powerful countries, reporting on any developments associated with the war. In order to carry out these dangerous tasks, these men have trained their bodies to survive in extreme conditions and studied numerous fields such as communications and languages. However, their greatest strength lies in their ability to manipulate people in order to obtain the information necessary to give their nation the upper hand.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers appreciating the show's unique approach to the spy genre and historical setting. However, many are critical of the episodic format, lack of character development, and confusing character designs. The show is praised for its atmosphere and some clever storytelling, but ultimately fails to create a compelling narrative for many viewers.
pros: Intriguing plot with dramatic tension in each episode.
Well-researched historical settings and details.
Voice acting is well-done, especially the English pronunciation.
cons: Episodic structure prevents investment in characters or overarching plot.
Characters look too similar, making it difficult to distinguish them.
Storytelling relies too much on 'tell, not show' which hurts the mystery.

anime.title: Rainbow Days
anime.synopsis:
Nijiiro Days follows the colorful lives and romantic relationships of four high school boys—Natsuki Hashiba, a dreamer with delusions of love; Tomoya Matsunaga, a narcissistic playboy who has multiple girlfriends; Keiichi Katakura, a kinky sadist who always carries a whip; and Tsuyoshi Naoe, an otaku who has a cosplaying girlfriend.

When his girlfriend unceremoniously dumps him on Christmas Eve, Natsuki breaks down in tears in the middle of the street and is offered tissues by a girl in a Santa Claus suit. He instantly falls in love with this girl, Anna Kobayakawa, who fortunately attends the same school as him. Natsuki's pursuit of Anna should have been simple and uneventful; however, much to his dismay, his nosy friends constantly meddle in his relationship, as they strive to succeed in their own endeavors of love.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Nijiiro Days for its lighthearted and fun portrayal of high school romance and friendship. While the characters are considered likeable and the chemistry between them is appreciated, some viewers find the plot lacking depth and the ending unsatisfying. The series is seen as a simple and comforting watch, but not particularly groundbreaking.
pros: Enjoyable and relaxing to watch.
Good portrayal of friendship dynamics.
Characters are likeable and relatable.
cons: Storylines can feel rushed and unresolved.
Ending may be disappointing or lacking closure.
Some characters may be considered bland or stereotypical.

anime.title: Cute High Earth Defense Club LOVE! LOVE!
anime.romaji_title: Binan Koukou Chikyuu Bouei-bu Love! Love!
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Parody, School, Super Power
anime.synopsis: After pulling the plug on the space reality TV show "Can I Destroy the Earth? 2," the Defense Club and the Conquest Club return to their peaceful high school lives. Time has passed since that fearsome battle, and it's now autumn. The five Defense Club members have stopped serving as the Battle Lovers, and are enjoying a soak in the Kurotama Bath like always, when the Conquest Club broaches a subject that will change a great deal about events to come...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience generally enjoyed the second season of Binan Koukou Chikyuu Bouei-bu Love! Love!, praising its humor, music, and improved storyline compared to the first season. However, some viewers found the plot and fight scenes to be lacking, and others felt that the focus on certain characters detracted from the experience. The show's thematic exploration of idol culture and parody of magical girl tropes resonated well, although the pacing and handling of multiple themes were criticized.
pros: Catchy music and enjoyable songs, especially the VEPPer's theme.
Bright and pleasing art style with easily distinguishable characters.
Improved storyline with more complex plots and flashbacks compared to season 1.
Effective parody of magical girl tropes and innuendo-filled humor.
cons: Repetitive elements can become tiring.
Plot can be half-assed, especially fight scenes.
Over-reliance on Yumoto's character, making him less likable.
Pacing issues due to attempts to address too many themes, leading to a less impactful finale.

anime.title: Minami Kamakura High School Girls Cycling Club
anime.synopsis:
Maiharu Hiromi has moved from Nagasaki to Kamakura. She begins her new life in Kamakura and her first day in Minami Kamakura High School by cycling to her school, but she has not ridden a bicycle in many years. On the way to the first day ceremony she almost crashes into Akizuki Tomoe. Obviously Hiromi needs a lot more practice, so Tomoe decides to help Hiromi train to become better at riding a bicycle, and they become good friends.

When they discover that the school used to have a bicycle club, the girls, together with Kamikura Fuyune and Higa Natsumi, resurrect the club naming it the Minami Kamakura High School Girls Bicycle Club.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Minami Kamakura Koukou Joshi Jitensha-bu' to be a pleasant and visually appealing slice-of-life anime focused on cycling. However, some viewers find the plot predictable, the characters simplistic, and the conflicts childish. While praised for its art and informative segments, it may not appeal to those seeking complex narratives or intense sports action.
pros: Beautiful art design and background details, especially the Kamakura scenery.
Enjoyable slice-of-life charm and focus on the fun aspects of cycling.
Informative segments about bicycle maintenance and cycling tips.
Well-cast English speakers for foreign characters, adding authenticity.
cons: Predictable plot and somewhat childish conflicts.
Characters lack complexity and deep backstories.
Story and characters are similar to other anime in the genre, lacking originality.
The main character can be perceived as annoyingly nice or brain-dead.
CGI is noticeable and not well-integrated.

anime.title: Terra Formars: Revenge
anime.genres: Action, Gore, Horror, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Space, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis: In Terra Formars Revenge, the crew members of the Annex I continue to fight against Terraformars—the large humanoid cockroaches that evolved from the ones sent to Mars centuries ago. However, far from discovering the cure for the lethal Alien Engine Virus that has been plaguing Earth, the Annex I team have learned that some squadrons have agendas from their own countries. Now, the squadrons must not only fight against the Terraformars for their survival, but also each other in the never-ending battle for international dominance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Terra Formars: Revenge is divided, with many feeling it fails to live up to the first season's potential.  Common complaints include a shift in tone, weaker plot, and less compelling characters.  While some appreciate the added human drama and action, the general sentiment leans towards disappointment due to the perceived loss of the original's grim and gritty atmosphere.
pros: Some enjoyed the addition of human drama and betrayal plots.
A few reviewers praised the animation quality and detailed backgrounds.
Several reviewers appreciated the unique personalities of the characters and their backstories.
cons: Many felt the show lost its dark atmosphere and became more generic.
Several criticized the toned-down violence and shift to a more shounen-like style.
A common complaint was the overuse of flashbacks and fake-outs.
Some disliked the changes in art style and character designs.
Several reviewers found the plot and characters boring and shallow.

anime.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These
anime.romaji_title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Kaikou
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
For over a century and a half, two interstellar states have wrested for control of the Milky Way. The Galactic Empire, an absolute monarchy ruled by Kaiser Friedrich IV and an entrenched nobility, seeks to suppress the rebels daring to oppose the inviolable crown. The Free Planets Alliance, a representative democracy led by a corrupt High Council, degenerates as its elected leaders⁠ use war and conflict as a way to win popular support.

But this long-standing stalemate between the Empire and the Alliance ends with the rise of two opposing military geniuses. Reinhard von Lohengramm, a minor noble and High Admiral of the Empire through his strategic brilliance and his sister's position as the favored concubine of the Kaiser, dreams of conquering the galaxy and uniting mankind under his iron fist. Meanwhile, Yang Wen-li of the Alliance, an avid historian and reluctant commodore hailed as the Hero of El Facil, uses his tactical prowess to navigate around his leaders' incompetence—and to carve the path to lasting peace. As the war rages on, Reinhard and Yang each strive for their ideals and to secure their place among the stars as the leaders of a new era of galactic heroes.
anime.consensus_summary: Die Neue These is a divisive remake. While some appreciate its faithfulness to the novels and updated visuals, others find its character designs and music lacking compared to the original OVA. The series has garnered both warm reception from new fans and harsh criticism from long-time fans, leading to a polarized audience sentiment.
pros: Faithful to the source material (novels).
Updated visuals and animation.
Well-paced and engaging for new viewers.
cons: Character designs are not faithful to the original OVA and are considered generic by some.
Music score is inferior to the original OVA's classical score.
Pacing may feel rushed compared to the original OVA.
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Space Opera, War Drama

anime.title: Wagamama High Spec
anime.synopsis:
The adorable girls of Ousui Academy's student council love to spend time with their crush, Kouki Narumi. But what happens when he isn't around? 

For the student council, consisting of otaku president Kaoruko Rokuonji; headstrong Ashe Rufflette Sakuragi; quiet computer programmer Toa Narumi; and Toa's best friend, the impish Mihiro Miyase, it means they will have to keep themselves entertained. Wagamama High Spec offers a glimpse into the girls' lives as they get into amusing—and sometimes risqué—hijinks at their school and around town.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Wagamama High Spec' is a short, simple anime primarily serving as an advertisement. Viewers find it passable as a brief, lighthearted experience if expectations are managed, but criticize its lack of substance and reliance on promotional tactics. The humor and cute character interactions are appreciated, but the minimal plot and forced ecchi are detractors.
pros: The comedy lands well due to quirky punchlines and character chemistry.
Voice acting is energetic and matches the characters.
The ending theme is notably good with creative visuals.
cons: The anime is primarily an advertisement for the visual novel or mobile game.
The story is very thin, episodic, and lacks depth.
The male protagonist is absent, undermining the synopsis.
Ecchi content feels forced and random.
anime.thematic_vibe: Cute Girls Doing Cute Things, Slice of Life, Promotional

anime.title: Teekyu 6
anime.synopsis: Sixth season of the Teekyuu series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the continued randomness and fast pace of Teekyuu 6, assuming they are already fans of the series. Paying close attention is crucial to understanding and enjoying the humor. The show's core appeal remains its absurdity, but this can also be a point of criticism for new viewers.
pros: Genius stupid jokes
Enjoyable if you pay attention
cons: Can be confusing if you don't pay attention
Overly random

anime.title: Myriad Colors Phantom World
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Phantoms: supernatural entities such as ghosts or youkai that, until recently, were thought to be superstition. However, when a virus that infects the brain spreads throughout society, people's perception of the world changes as the mythical beings are revealed to have been living alongside humanity the entire time. This virus has also affected those of the next generation significantly, allowing them to develop special abilities that they can use to fight against dangerous phantoms.

Haruhiko Ichijou and Mai Kawakami are two of those that were granted such power—Haruhiko wields the ability to summon and seal phantoms through drawings, while Mai imbues the power of the elements into martial arts. Together, along with the friendly phantom Ruru, they form Team E of Hosea Academy, which is dedicated to dealing with these often mischievous beings. In a world where the real and surreal intertwine, they handle the everyday troubles caused by phantoms.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is significantly divided, with strong praise for the animation and character designs clashing with widespread criticism of a weak, episodic plot and generic character writing. While some viewers found it an enjoyable, visually pleasing experience, others felt it was a vapid and uninspired production that wasted its potential.
pros: Stunning and high-quality animation and art style
Catchy opening theme and good soundtrack
Entertaining action sequences
Adorable and likable characters (waifus)
Fun and enjoyable moments despite plot issues
cons: Lack of coherent plot and underdeveloped story
Generic and repetitive tropes
Boring and underdeveloped main protagonist
Excessive and sometimes nonsensical fanservice
Characters are often one-dimensional or archetypal

anime.title: Norn9
anime.synopsis:
In a futuristic era, "The World" is a peace-bringing entity. Though no one knows its location, it has watched over Earth for so long that war has become merely a fable. The airship Norn's task is to deliver nine ability users to The World.

After collecting the last person, Norn takes off. Included onboard are eight men and three women—Koharu, who has finally escaped her loneliness and detests her destructive power; Mikoto Kuga, born to a noble family, who uses her barrier skill to protect the Norn and those it carries; and Nanami Shiranui, whose ability only brings pain, and who wishes to die for a past sin she has committed. While en route, suspicions arise amongst the passengers when they realize there are too many people onboard.

As they try to determine who has snuck aboard, the ship is attacked by an unknown assailant aiming to stop the Norn's progress at all costs. From this chaos arises questions: why were they granted powers, and what must they do once they reach The World?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with Norn9, citing issues with pacing, character development, and a convoluted plot. While the art and music receive praise, these elements are not enough to salvage the show for many viewers. Some enjoy it as a simple romance, but most feel it fails to live up to its initial potential due to poor execution.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation.
Enjoyable soundtrack that enhances emotional scenes.
Interesting concept with potential for deeper exploration.
cons: Poor pacing with rushed plot development, especially in the later episodes.
Weak character development, with many characters being generic or underdeveloped.
Confusing and illogical storyline with plot holes and inconsistencies.
Misleading synopsis that doesn't accurately represent the actual story.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sci-Fi Romance, Supernatural Powers, Time Travel

anime.title: Code:Realize ~Guardian of Rebirth~
anime.genres: Fantasy, Historical, Josei, Reverse Harem, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Within Cardia Beckford's hazy memories, she can recall her father Isaac and the home where she lives alone, feared as a monster by the townsfolk—for in her body, she carries a deadly substance. Embedded in her chest by her father, the eternally beating heart—also known as Horologium—has the capability to produce infinite power. However, it also makes her skin destroy anything it touches.

Many in London seek the Horologium, including the terrorist organization Twilight, with whom Isaac is rumored to have close ties. To obtain the Horologium's power, the British military forces Cardia to leave her home as their prisoner. But on the road, she is whisked away by the gentleman thief Arsène Lupin, who says he will steal her heart. Joining Lupin and his companions, Cardia begins a journey to discover the truth behind Isaac's connection with Twilight, her missing memories, and the Horologium within her chest.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some viewers enjoy the steampunk setting, the characters, and the overall story, many are disappointed by the rushed pacing, lack of character development, and inconsistent animation quality. Fans of the original otome game are particularly critical, noting significant omissions and alterations that detract from the source material's depth. Many reviewers recommend playing the game instead of watching the anime.
pros: Unique steampunk setting in Victorian London complements the mystery.
Cardia is a likeable and kind heroine, with a heartwarming development.
The English dub is well-executed.
cons: Rushed and unclear story due to the 12-episode limit, leading to a lack of depth and character development.
Many plot points are glossed over, with poor explanation or missing backstory for several characters.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with some scenes appearing lazy or poorly executed.

anime.title: Bungo Stray Dogs
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Detective, Mystery, Organized Crime, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
For weeks, Atsushi Nakajima's orphanage has been plagued by a mystical tiger that only he seems to be unaware of. Suspected to be behind the strange incidents, the 18-year-old is abruptly kicked out of the orphanage and left hungry, homeless, and wandering through the city.

While starving on a riverbank, Atsushi saves a rather eccentric man named Osamu Dazai from drowning. Whimsical suicide enthusiast and supernatural detective, Dazai has been investigating the same tiger that has been terrorizing the boy. Together with Dazai's partner Doppo Kunikida, they solve the mystery, but its resolution leaves Atsushi in a tight spot. As various odd events take place, Atsushi is coerced into joining their firm of supernatural investigators, taking on unusual cases the police cannot handle, alongside his numerous enigmatic co-workers.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some find the show entertaining and unique, praising the engaging story and supernatural elements. Others criticize the inconsistent tone, weak plot, forced humor, and uninspired characters. The show's attempt to blend genres doesn't work for everyone, leading to a polarizing reception.
pros: Engaging story
Unique premise with literary figures and their abilities
Good production values (art and animation)
Entertaining mix of mystery, suspense, and humor for some viewers
cons: Inconsistent tone and poor balance between comedy, drama, and action
Weak or formulaic plot, predictable arcs
Comedy feels forced or poorly timed
Characters are generic or annoying
Main character's backstory overplayed and melodramatic
Overreliance on common anime tropes
Villains are weak
Inability to make plausible plot with understandable or compelling villains

anime.title: Snow White with the Red Hair OVA
anime.romaji_title: Akagami no Shirayuki-hime: Nandemonai Takaramono, Kono Page
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the limited edition 15th volume of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is considered a sweet but shallow addition to the main series, primarily enjoyable for those already familiar with the characters and world. While the technical aspects are competent, they are not particularly noteworthy, leaving the overall impression as adequate but unexceptional.  It relies heavily on the audience's pre-existing investment in the series.
pros: OVA is sweet.
Sound design is competent.
cons: Art isn't outstanding.
OVA is shallow without context from the main show.
Sound design doesn't stand out.

anime.title: Aikatsu Stars! Movie
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: The film's plot is set in a southern island, where a Legendary Dress Audition is taking place. Nijino Yume and the others must find secret dresses said to be hidden somewhere in the island.
anime.consensus_summary: The Aikatsu Stars! Movie is well-received, especially by fans of the series. It offers fun entertainment and introduces more serious themes. While the plot isn't revolutionary, it fits the Aikatsu world and provides an enjoyable viewing experience.
pros: Fun and entertaining
Interesting discussions between characters, adding depth compared to previous Aikatsu series
Story fits the series theme well
cons: Story starts off common before finding its unique elements
Plot isn't groundbreaking

anime.title: Tantei Opera Milky Holmes the Movie: Milky Holmes' Counterattack
anime.romaji_title: Tantei Opera Milky Holmes Movie: Gyakushuu no Milky Holmes
anime.genres: Comedy, Detective, Mystery, Parody, Super Power
anime.synopsis: The four members of Milky Holmes are going on a study tour. While soaking in the hot springs among snow monkeys, alarms interrupt the relaxing environment! It was the work of the Thief Empire. A fierce battle between Milky Holmes and the Thief Empire begins, with both sides using their Toys (special powers). Furthermore, with the arrival of the Genius 4, a three-way fight occurs! In the midst of battle, a violent lightning strikes from the sky. Struck by the lightning, the four Milky Holmes girls lose their abilities.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely positive, particularly among fans of the first two seasons. The movie is viewed as a return to the original style and humor of the Milky Holmes series, with the main characters taking center stage again. While the plot is simple, the overall experience is enjoyable for those who appreciate the earlier seasons.
pros: Returns to the style and humor of the first two seasons.
Main characters (Shery, Nero, Herc, and Cordelia) are the primary focus.
Comedy is back in full swing.
cons: Plot is relatively straightforward.

anime.title: One Piece Film: Gold
anime.synopsis:
Monkey D. Luffy and his Straw Hat Crew have finally arrived on Gran Tesoro, a ship carrying the largest entertainment city in the world. Drawn in by the chances of hitting the jackpot, the crew immediately head to the casino. There, they quickly find themselves on a winning streak, playing with what seems to be endless luck.

When offered a special gamble by Gild Tesoro—the master of the city himself—the crew agrees, choosing to believe in their captain's luck. However, when they find themselves victims of a despicable scam, the crew quickly realize that there is something darker happening beneath the city's surface.

Left penniless and beaten down, the Straw Hat Crew are forced to rely on another gamble of a plan. With the help of a new friend or two, the group must work to reclaim what they've lost before time, and what remains of their luck, runs out.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed, with many praising the film's visuals, music, and heist elements. However, criticisms frequently target the predictable story, weak villains, and uneven pacing. While some consider it one of the best One Piece movies, others find it boring and a waste of potential.
pros: Visually stunning animation and character designs
Memorable film-exclusive character with a compelling dynamic with Nami
Enjoyable blend of heist elements with the One Piece universe
Fantastic music and sound design
cons: Generic and predictable story arc
Poorly developed and uninteresting new characters/villains
Uneven pacing with rushed and dragging parts
Overuse of CGI in backgrounds and scenery
Lack of meaningful roles for all Straw Hat crew members

anime.title: Pan de Peace!
anime.synopsis: For the airheaded Minami Tani, there is nothing more delightful than delicious bread for breakfast. Bonding over a mutual love for the food, Minami meets the dignified Yuu Aizawa and the upbeat Fuyumi Fukagawa. Joining them is Noa Sakura, a pint-sized girl who sees bread as the ultimate weapon of self-defense. Together, the girls strengthen their bonds of friendship, while striving to sample every kind of bread this world has to offer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some viewers find it to be a cute, relaxing, and enjoyable short anime, while others consider it bland, boring, and lacking in substance. The show's simplicity and focus on bread are major points of contention, with some appreciating the lightheartedness and others finding it repetitive and uninspired.
pros: Cute art style and character designs.
Relaxing and light-hearted.
Short episodes make it easy to watch.
Some found the story to have deeper interpretations.
Catchy opening theme.
cons: Generic and bland characters.
Simple plot solely focused on eating bread.
Lacks depth and character development.
Repetitive and boring.
Poor animation quality in some instances.

anime.title: High School Fleet
anime.synopsis:
A hundred years after catastrophic shifts in tectonic plates caused most of its area to submerge, Japan now thrives as a maritime nation. High functioning cities line the coasts of Japan, and well developed sea routes are defended by specialized naval ships. The marine industry is flourishing, and young girls are eager to join the Blue Mermaids—highly skilled women who devote their lives to protecting the seas.
 
After some time apart, childhood friends Akeno Misaki and Moeka China are reunited at Yokosuka Girls' Marine High School. Here they are joined by others who share their dream of becoming Blue Mermaids. Soon, training exercises commence, with Akeno and Moeka being put in charge of their own ships and crew. Everything is progressing smoothly for Akeno as she settles into her role as captain and builds camaraderie between her fellow crew members aboard the Harekaze, a destroyer ship. However, unexpected engine and navigation failures soon leave their ship stranded and the crew in danger.
 
High School Fleet follows the Harekaze's valiant crew as they navigate treacherous waters and other obstacles on their quest to become fully fledged Blue Mermaids.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mostly positive. Many viewers appreciate the show's blend of cute characters with naval warfare and a surprisingly engaging plot. However, some find the story inconsistent, the ending weak, and the large cast of characters detrimental to individual development.
pros: Engaging story with unexpected twists.
Appealing character designs and animation.
Good balance between cute moments and serious situations.
Focus on teamwork and character relationships.
cons: Plot inconsistencies and conveniences.
Too many characters, hindering individual development.
Weak or disappointing ending.
Unexplained or illogical story elements (e.g., high schoolers commanding ships).

anime.title: Anime de Training! Ex
anime.synopsis: "Move your soul and body!" Each episode contains a variety of routines, such as push-ups, sit-ups, spine twists, dance, yoga, stretches, trunk training, and taichi. Five girls aiming to become idols will exercise with you, and that troubling body fat percentage will go down by 1000%...!?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reaction is mixed, with some finding it a humorous and potentially helpful introduction to exercise, while others criticize its lack of plot, annoying characters, and questionable fanservice. Many see it primarily as a source of fan service, and its value as a genuine workout program is debated. The show's appeal largely depends on the viewer's expectations and willingness to overlook its flaws for comedic or ecchi elements.
pros: Potentially good start for beginners to exercise.
Catchy opening theme song.
Some found it funny and enjoyable as a joke.
cons: No plot or story.
Characters are annoying and useless.
Exercises are insufficient and sometimes unhealthy.
Confused about intended audience; may be awkward due to fanservice and character ages.
