anime.title: Ushinawareta Mirai wo Motomete: Ushinawareta Natsuyasumi wo Motomete
anime.romaji_title: Ushinawareta Mirai wo Motomete: Ushinawareta Natsuyasumi wo Motomete
anime.synopsis:
Upon regaining her senses, Yui Furukawa discovers that the current day is July 13—a starting point that she has never experienced prior. However, despite the unfamiliar circumstances, she resolves to spend her summer vacation with the other members of the Astronomy Club at Nagisa Hanamiya's family villa. The house and its surrounding area have a rich history; a renowned scientist, Nagisa's great-grandmother researched and developed technology at the nearby military manufacturing plant.

While the Astronomy Club is having fun at the beach, a sudden storm stops their plans short. Left with no other choice, the group takes shelter at the abandoned factory, eventually leading them to explore a hidden underground bunker. What they encounter there may reveal an unprecedented connection to a lost future.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is largely fan-service with a flimsy plot involving time travel and spooky elements. It explores a 'what-if' scenario but fails to impress due to unoriginality and weak writing. The audience isn't particularly polarized, with most finding it uninspired.
cons: Unoriginal
Poorly written
Uninspired

anime.title: Larva
anime.synopsis: Daily live of two larvae.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds "Larva" to be a humorous and lighthearted show, appreciating its slapstick comedy and short episodes. Some viewers find the toilet humor off-putting, while others enjoy the show's simplicity and lack of a complex plot. The show's humor is seen as reminiscent of classic cartoons like Tom and Jerry.
pros: Classic cartoonish humor reminiscent of Tom and Jerry.
Short episodes make it easy to watch.
Easy to laugh at.
cons: Toilet humor may not appeal to everyone.
Lack of a complex plot.

anime.title: Mysteria Friends
anime.genres: Fantasy, Iyashikei, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Mysteria Academy is a prestigious magic school that teaches magic without discrimination to the three factions (men, gods, demons), who usually are engaged in battle with each other. Two of the academy's students are Anne, a princess and honor student, and Grea, a princess born from a dragon and a human.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, appreciating the show's aesthetic qualities, relaxing atmosphere, and the central relationship between Anne and Grea. However, many find the plot lacking substance and wish for a more explicit romantic development between the main characters. The series is viewed as a pleasant, low-key watch, but some feel it could have been more.
pros: Beautiful art and animation quality
Relaxing and enjoyable music score
Charming and well-developed main characters (Anne and Grea)
Comforting and wholesome atmosphere
Good gacha adaption
cons: Lack of a strong central plot or story
Shallow character development for side characters
Relationship between main characters remains ambiguous (teasing without commitment)
Short episode length limits depth and exploration
Too simple story.

anime.title: Sekko Boys
anime.synopsis:
As luck would have it, on her first day at Holbein Entertainment Co., Miki Ishimoto is tasked with managing a brand new idol group! A recent college graduate, Ishimoto is eager to begin her career in the industry. However, her department's responsibility is...statues?!

The statues in question are the Sekkou Boys, or "The Rockies," a boy band comprised of four Greco-Roman sculptures: St. George, Mars, Hermes, and Medici. These four busts are new to the entertainment scene, and it is up to Miki to ensure the Rockies' prosperity in the idol world. But will they be a stone-cold success? Or will Miki's management prove to be a rocky start to stardom?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Sekkou Boys to be a funny and enjoyable short anime due to its absurd premise and satirical humor. While the animation and story depth are lacking, the show's unique take on the idol genre and catchy ending theme make it a worthwhile watch for those seeking a lighthearted comedy. Some viewers are turned off by the dated meme humor, but overall, the show is well-received for its comedic value and short episode length.
pros: Unique and refreshing premise deconstructing the idol genre.
Well-scripted with clever jokes and historical references.
Memorable characters despite their limited expressions.
Catchy ending song.
cons: Mediocre animation quality.
Dated meme humor that feels cringeworthy.
Repetitive gags that can become stale.
Story lacks depth and character development.

anime.title: Durarara!!x2 Ten Episode 13.5
anime.synopsis:
In spite of the mayhem that has been taking place in Ikebukuro, Shinra Kishitani and Celty Sturluson have decided to go on a short trip. Excited to finally be going out with the one he loves, the underground doctor makes it his priority to give Celty his undivided attention, even if it means rejecting phone calls from his good friend Izaya Orihara.

However, despite his hopes of having a peaceful holiday, Ikebukuro's various residents continue trying to reach him. Furthermore, just as Shinra begins to enjoy reminiscing about old memories on a carriage ride together with his beloved, Celty starts to notice a strange presence...
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted and enjoyable side story focusing on Celty and Shinra's date. Viewers appreciate the humor and the added backstory. However, it is crucial to watch it after specific episodes of the main series to avoid spoilers.
pros: Funny and entertaining story
Provides interesting backstory and information
Focuses on Celty and Shinra's relationship
cons: Should be watched in a specific order relative to the main series to avoid spoilers

anime.title: Charlotte: The Strong Ones
anime.synopsis: Takehito Kumagami's clairvoyance leads his group of friends to another child with supernatural powers: Iori Sekiguchi, a mind reader. However, as they try to approach her, they realize her power makes her nearly impossible to pin down. Having been chosen by the club to handle this case, Nao Tomori and Yuu Otosaka must find a way to get around the child's unique ability before it is too late.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a pleasant but ultimately unnecessary addition to the Charlotte universe. It recaptures the feel of the earlier, more episodic portion of the series, providing enjoyable character interactions and a lighthearted story. However, it fails to address any of the plot threads left dangling by the main series' ending, leaving some fans disappointed, and does not contribute to the overarching narrative.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions, particularly between Yuu and Nao
Mirrors the enjoyable early episodic format of the main series
Good art and sound quality consistent with the original series
cons: Adds nothing to the overall story arc of Charlotte
Uneven balance between comedy and drama
Inconsistent with the ending of the main series
Tomori's character can be annoying

anime.title: Prince of Stride: Alternative
anime.synopsis:
"Stride"—an extreme sport that combines parkour, free running, relay, and sprinting—is what made first year high school student Nana Sakurai enroll in Honan Academy, after being captivated by the school's stride team. Sharing the mutual intention of joining the team is fellow first year and stride maniac, Takeru Fujiwara, and together they request to join. Much to their dismay, however, the stride club is no longer active due to lack of members, and they are now operating under the shogi club.

In order to revive the stride club, Nana and Takeru recruit first year Riku Yagami—a fast runner who is interested in almost every sport. With this new team, the club now aims high at a new goal: to win the prestigious End of Summer competition, and bring the Honan stride team back to their prime.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience sentiment is mixed. While many appreciate the show's aesthetics and unique sport concept, the lackluster story, shallow characters, and poor explanation of the stride rules left many disappointed. The series is considered a light-hearted watch, but ultimately falls short of being a memorable sports anime.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation, especially during stride sequences.
Enjoyable soundtrack with catchy OP and ED themes.
Unique and interesting concept for the sport of stride.
cons: Weak character development and lack of depth for many characters.
Predictable plot and uninspired story structure.
Poor explanation of the rules and mechanics of the stride sport.
Over-reliance on tropes and cliches common in sports anime.

anime.title: Miss Monochrome The Animation 3
anime.synopsis: Third season of Miss Monochrome: The Animation.
anime.consensus_summary: The third season of Miss Monochrome is generally well-received as a fun continuation of the series. While some find it repetitive or dislike certain character choices, others appreciate the improved narrative and humor. The season serves as a satisfying conclusion to Miss Monochrome's story for most viewers.
pros: Narrative is the best in the series, plot progresses quickly.
Creative ideas in the story improve enjoyment factor.
Funny jokes and 4th wall breaks work well.
cons: Repetitive episode setup.
New characters weren't used a lot.
Using the same opening and ending from the second season for most of the season.
anime.thematic_vibe: Over-the-top Comedy, Character's Journey, Slice of Life

anime.title: Three Leaves, Three Colors
anime.synopsis:
Having gone from pampered to poor after the bankruptcy of her father's company, Youko Nishikawa struggles to drop her princess-like persona and make friends at her all-girls high school. One day, while eating alone in a nearby forest, she has a chance encounter with Futaba Odagiri, the super-energetic transfer student, and Teru Hayama, an innocent-looking girl with a surprisingly direct and sometimes mean personality. Despite their differing personalities, the three girls who all have the kanji for "leaf" in their name begin an unlikely friendship as they try to navigate through an amusing and spontaneous adventure known as high school life.

Sansha Sanyou is a cheerful, cute series revolving around three close but very different friends as they try to balance the everyday challenges that school and adolescence have to offer.
anime.consensus_summary: Sansha Sanyou is a lighthearted and enjoyable slice-of-life anime with cute characters and funny moments. While it may not be particularly innovative or memorable, it provides pleasant entertainment for fans of the genre. The series excels in character interactions and comedic timing, making it a worthwhile watch despite its lack of a strong overarching plot.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions
Charming and funny characters
Good art and animation
cons: Generic premise
Lacks a strong plot
Can be repetitive

anime.title: Brave Beats
anime.synopsis: Hibiki Kazaguruma, a sixth grader, meets an amusing little robot named Bureikin while coming home from school one day. Bureikin, a dancer from an alternate-dimension dance world, challenged the dance king for the throne and lost. He has been deprived of Dance Stones (the stones of dance power) and sent to the human world. To restore his power, Bureikin must collect all the Dance Stones scattered around Earth.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Brave Beats' to be a simple and fun anime, particularly appealing to those who enjoy dance or lighthearted humor. While the story and characters lack depth, the dance sequences and villain backstories offer some entertainment value. However, its generic plot may lead to viewer fatigue.
pros: Entertaining dance sequences
Interesting villain backstories
Appeals to fans of dance or funny anime
cons: Generic story
Simple plot
Lacks complexity and character development
Can become repetitive

anime.title: JK-MESHI!
anime.synopsis: Three high school girls have mastered the art of cooking simple, B-class dishes called JK meshi. The three girls — Reina, Ryouka, and Ruriko — are all classmates in their second year of high school. They often get distracted when studying for tests, and when they do, they cook JK meshi.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, acknowledging the show's self-aware humor and simple food ideas, but heavily criticizing the extremely low production quality and animation. Some find it enjoyable despite its flaws, particularly for its voice acting and lightheartedness. However, many others consider it boring, uninspired, and visually unappealing, questioning its purpose and target demographic.
pros: Enjoyable despite low budget
Creative, simple food ideas
Good voice acting
Show is self-aware and pokes fun at itself
Conversations feel natural and humorous
cons: Extremely poor animation quality
Boring and uninteresting story
Characters are bland and one-dimensional
Serves no entertainment value
Animation looks outdated

anime.title: Ajin: Demi-Human
anime.genres: Action, Gore, Horror, Mystery, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Mysterious immortal humans known as "Ajin" first appeared 17 years ago in Africa. Upon their discovery, they were labeled as a threat to mankind, as they might use their powers for evil and were incapable of being destroyed. Since then, whenever an Ajin is found within society, they are to be arrested and taken into custody immediately.

Studying hard to become a doctor, Kei Nagai is a high schooler who knows very little about Ajin, only having seen them appear in the news every now and then. Students are taught that these creatures are not considered to be human, but Kei doesn't pay much attention in class. As a result, his perilously little grasp on this subject proves to be completely irrelevant when he survives an accident that was supposed to claim his life, signaling his rebirth as an Ajin and the start of his days of torment. However, as he finds himself alone on the run from the entire world, Kei soon realizes that more of his species may be a lot closer than he thinks.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Ajin is divided. While the story, characters, and themes are appreciated, the poor CGI animation is a major detractor for many viewers. Some find the animation style acceptable or even realistic, while others consider it unwatchable, leading to a polarized reception of the anime.
pros: Intriguing plot with twists and turns
Well-developed characters, especially the antagonist
Thought-provoking themes of discrimination, terrorism, and human nature
Excellent sound design and voice acting
cons: Poor CGI animation quality with low frame rates
Inconsistent character development
Mediocre plot execution

anime.title: Tsuritama: Harikitte Contest
anime.synopsis: Haru, Yuki, and the boys participate in a competition to decide who will be the next "Prince of the Sea from Endoshima." They just need to show their talents and impress the jury, but everything went in a wrong direction.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys this special as a light-hearted and cute addition to the main series, providing a chance to see the characters interacting again. The lack of animation is noted, but generally accepted as a characteristic of the picture drama format. Overall, it's a well-received piece for fans of Tsuritama.
pros: Nice to see the characters together again.
Light-hearted and cute.
A nice little addition for fans of Tsuritama.
cons: No real animation, just pictures (picture drama).
Nothing too elaborate.

anime.title: All Out!!
anime.synopsis:
Rugby is a sport where anybody can be a star when they hold the ball. The rules are simple: one player has to carry the ball past the goalposts across the field while avoiding the other team, who are allowed to use all their force to knock the enemy down. However, the player can pass to a teammate behind them or kick the ball before they are tackled. Unlike other sports, the game continues even when the person holding the ball is taken down.

Kenji Gion is a short but feisty high school freshman at Kanagawa High School. Right after the school's opening ceremony, he meets the tall and timid Sumiaki Iwashimizu, and the two of them get an invitation to observe the rugby club. 

When Gion watches the match, he realizes that even though big and tall guys have an advantage, there are positions for people of all shapes and sizes. Immediately convinced that he has found a sport he can excel at despite his short stature, he signs up, though Iwashimizu declines. Gion is unable to accept Iwashimizu's excuses and drags him back into the sport. Their training becomes intense as they aim to become the champions of Hanazono, the national high school rugby championships.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the realistic depiction of rugby, character development, and team dynamics, finding it an enjoyable and educational sports anime. However, others criticize the generic storyline, inconsistent animation, pacing issues, and uneven character focus, which makes it a mediocre entry in the genre. The show is considered decent, but lacks the elements to make it a standout.
pros: Good explanation of rugby rules and strategies.
Realistic portrayal of the sport; gritty and brutal without outlandish special moves.
Strong team dynamics and camaraderie.
Unique art style with emphasis on muscular characters.
Focus on individual character development within the team.
cons: Generic story and mediocre execution.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Pacing issues; narrative can be slow and include irrelevant flashbacks.
Uneven character focus; main character Gion is sidelined for other characters' backstories.
Lack of character development in the plot.

anime.title: Pokémon the Series: XYZ
anime.synopsis:
The journey of Satoshi and his friends through the Kalos region continues! After Satoshi obtains his seventh gym badge, the group is moving toward the next town when Eureka discovers a mysterious Pokémon resting in her pochette. Soon given the name Puni-chan, it is one that even Satoshi and Serena's new Pokémon Zukan cannot identify. However, it quickly becomes apparent that Puni-chan is the target of a mysterious group clad in bright red suits known as Team Flare, aiming to capture the new Pokémon to further their agenda. But when Satoshi and the gang realize that the enigmatic organization has no intention of treating Puni-chan with any decency, they take a stand in opposition to Team Flare's plans, daring to fight back.

With Gojika's predictions looming above them, Satoshi aims for his final gym badge while Serena contests for her last Princess Key in order to be able to compete at the TriPokalon Master Class. But as Team Flare begins to move in search of the mysterious Z, the stories of Pokemon XY and Pokemon XY: Mega Evolution cross paths as Satoshi and his friends, along with Team Rocket, get caught up in a scheme that could put Kalos in great danger.
anime.consensus_summary: Pokemon XY&Z is generally well-regarded as one of the best arcs in the Pokemon anime series due to its improved animation, engaging story, and character development. However, some viewers found the pacing rushed and the ending unsatisfying. While praised for its emotional moments, the season's reliance on familiar tropes generated mixed reactions.
pros: Improved animation and art style compared to previous seasons.
Compelling character development, especially for Ash.
Engaging and well-woven story with high stakes.
Memorable music and soundtracks.
cons: Rushed pacing in certain arcs, particularly the Team Flare takeover.
Inconsistent quality of filler episodes.
Underwhelming payoff for certain character arcs.
Predictable and repetitive story formula.

anime.title: RIN-NE Season 2
anime.synopsis:
High school student Sakura Mamiya and impoverished death god Rinne Rokudou continue to confront the supernatural. Pulled into the problems of their quirky acquaintances, the pair again find themselves immersed in trouble.

Ageha's black cat Oboro seeks revenge for alleged mistreatment and demands Ageha to nullify their contract. When she refuses to do so, a bitter quarrel breaks out between them. Meanwhile, the scheming Damashigami Company shows no sign of halting its wrongdoings, and the bat-like demon Masato continues to commit devious acts to pursue his long-awaited revenge on Rinne.

For Sakura and Rinne, these paranormal complications never seem to end. As their saga continues to unfold, they must cope with these unusual circumstances as they appear, all while facing problems of their own.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Kyoukai no Rinne offers more of the same episodic comedic adventures, failing to provide significant story development. While some viewers may enjoy the lighthearted humor, others find the repetitive nature tiresome. The consensus is that it largely mirrors the first season with minimal progress.
cons: Lack of story development.
Repetitive episodic structure.

anime.title: Landlord is in Puberty!
anime.synopsis:
Maeda has just moved into his new apartment to live by himself. While unpacking, a cute middle school student named Chie Satonaka suddenly appears in his room. She introduces herself as his new landlord, which pleasantly surprises him as he has never seen a landlord so young. His excitement is boosted further when the gorgeous Reiko Shirai, who lives directly next to him, also introduces herself as his new neighbor.

Ooyasan wa Shishunki! follows the everyday lives of Maeda and his newfound acquaintances, where each day presents itself as an opportunity for new events to unfold and new bonds to be forged.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding it a cute and quick way to pass the time, while others are put off by the shallow story and potentially problematic humor. The short episode length is both a pro and a con, making it easy to finish but also limiting its potential. Overall, it's considered a lighthearted but unremarkable series.
pros: Quick and easy to watch.
Decent animation for a short series.
Some jokes are well-placed and funny.
cons: Story is very short and lacks depth.
Characters have little development.
Some jokes rely on potentially uncomfortable themes.
Pacing is too fast, making it hard to follow.

anime.title: Granblue Fantasy: The Animation
anime.synopsis: This is a world of the skies, where many islands drift in the sky. A boy named Gran and a talking winged lizard named Vyrn lived in Zinkenstill, an island which yields mysteries. One day, they come across a girl named Lyria. Lyria had escaped from the Erste Empire, a military government that is trying to rule over this world using powerful military prowess. In order to escape from the Empire, Gran and Lyria head out into the vast skies, holding the letter Gran's father left behind—which said, "I will be waiting at Estalucia, Island of Stars."
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience finds "Granblue Fantasy The Animation" to be a decent, though unexceptional, fantasy anime. Fans of the original game and those seeking a lighthearted, classic JRPG-style adventure may find it enjoyable. However, many criticize the generic plot, shallow characters, and lack of depth, resulting in a somewhat mediocre experience.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material (game)
Visually appealing art style with distinct character designs and beautiful backgrounds
Enjoyable and relaxing adventure with a sense of nostalgia for classic JRPGs
Good action sequences and animation, especially during summon battles
Soundtrack complements the fantasy setting well
cons: Generic and predictable story with a linear, episodic structure
One-dimensional and underdeveloped characters with stereotypical personalities
Lacking tension, depth, and meaningful plot twists
Quest-giver characters and villains are stock and uninspired
Inconsistent pacing with long exposition dumps

anime.title: Ace Attorney
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Detective, Drama, Mystery, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Since he was a child, Ryuuichi Naruhodou's dream was to become a defense attorney, protecting the innocent when no one else would. However, when the rookie lawyer finally takes on his first case under the guidance of his mentor Chihiro Ayasato, he realizes that the courtroom is a battlefield. In these fast paced trials, Ryuuichi is forced to think outside the box to uncover the truth of the crimes that have taken place in order to prove the innocence of his clients.

Gyakuten Saiban: Sono "Shinjitsu", Igi Ari! follows Ryuuichi as he tackles cases to absolve the falsely accused of the charges they face. It will not be easy—standing in his path is the ruthless Reiji Mitsurugi, a prosecutor who will stop at nothing to hand out guilty verdicts. With his back against the wall, the defense attorney must carefully examine both evidence and witness testimony, sifting through lies to solve the mystery behind each case. With a shout of "objection!," the battle in the courtroom begins!
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Ace Attorney is a mixed bag for audiences. While fans of the games appreciate the familiar plot and music, many find the rushed pacing, poor animation, and weak character development disappointing. The series struggles to capture the charm and depth of the source material, resulting in a somewhat controversial adaptation that appeals more to existing fans willing to overlook its flaws.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the game's plot in many respects.
Enjoyable for fans of the Ace Attorney game series; evokes nostalgia.
The soundtrack incorporates music from the original games effectively.
Some anime-original content enriches character dynamics.
cons: Rushed pacing and condensed storytelling lead to loss of character development and plot details.
Dialogue is significantly cut down, impacting characterization and charm.
Art and animation quality is subpar, with frequent errors and awkward character designs.
Cases are predictable and mysteries are simplified, reducing tension and satisfaction.
Inconsistent tone, with humor that feels misplaced at times.
Weak character development for main characters

anime.title: Monster Hunter Stories: Ride On
anime.synopsis:
This is a world where both men and monsters exist. Those who hunt the monsters are called Hunters. But in a small corner of the Hunter's world, there are those called Riders who bond with and coexist with monsters. With their Kizuna Ishi (Bonding Stones) that allow them to awaken the hidden power inside monsters, Riders live in secrecy together with their Otomon, the monsters they formed a connection with.
Ryuto, a young boy living in the Rider village of Hakum, dreams of becoming the world's best Rider. Having just turned 12, he sets out to find his own Otomon for himself before the ceremony where he is given his own Kizuna Ishi. Together with his kind-hearted childhood friend Cheval, his inquisitive childhood friend Lilia, and his partner Naville, he sets out deep into the forest, and has a miraculous encounter with a Rathalos.
anime.consensus_summary: The first part of 'Monster Hunter Stories: Ride On' is appreciated for its child-friendly themes of friendship and dealing with loss. However, the overall presentation is weak, and later episodes decline in quality. The show primarily appeals to a younger audience, which may alienate some older fans of the Monster Hunter franchise.
pros: Part 1 (first 48 episodes) has nuanced content suitable for children.
Explores themes of loss and dealing with grief in a way appropriate for children.
cons: Poor CG and overall presentation quality.
Later episodes (beyond the initial 48) are of lower quality.
Targeted primarily at children, which may not appeal to all Monster Hunter fans.

anime.title: Sushi Police
anime.synopsis:
Honda, Kawasaki, and Suzuki all comprise the elite ninth unit of the Sushi Police—a task force with the sole objective of sniffing out restaurants serving illicit or non-traditional sushi and eradicating them, no matter how insignificant their offense may be. The Sushi Police travel freely around the world in pursuit of these vile criminals day or night, with their strong sense of justice and the World Food-Culture Conservation Organization backing them. No offenders of Japan's traditional cuisine can escape their wrath!

During one of their purification missions, the Sushi Police encounter Sara—a hot, young, television reporter out to expose them and the World Food-Culture Conservation Organization for corruption. They interrogate her, but her wiles, skills, and charms allow her to easily escape from their grasp, setting off a chain of events that will lead to the true purpose of the Sushi Police being revealed.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Sushi Police' as a satirical parody that fails to fully capitalize on its premise. While some appreciate the sight gags and short format, many find the jokes repetitive, the characters bland, and the animation unappealing. The show's attempt at social commentary is undermined by stereotypical portrayals, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Good sight gags utilize the 3D medium effectively.
Short episode length prevents the concept from becoming too tiresome.
Fun sushi facts in the credits are genuinely interesting.
cons: Thin premise stretched too far, leading to repetitive jokes.
Characters are bland stereotypes with little development.
Stereotypical portrayal of other countries, bordering on offensive in some instances.
Animation style is not pleasing, with off-putting character designs and textures.

anime.title: Dagashi Kashi
anime.synopsis:
Out in the countryside stands a sweet shop run by the Shikada family for nine generations: Shikada Dagashi, a small business selling traditional Japanese candy. However, despite his father's pleas, Kokonotsu Shikada, an aspiring manga artist, adamantly refuses to inherit the family business.

However, this may start to change with the arrival of the eccentric Hotaru Shidare. Hotaru is in search of Kokonotsu's father, with the goal of bringing him back to work for her family's company, Shidare Corporation, a world famous sweets manufacturer. Although the senior Shikada initially refuses, he states that he will change his mind on one condition: if Hotaru can convince Kokonotsu to take over the family shop. And so begins Hotaru's mission to enlighten the boy on the true joy of delicious and nostalgic dagashi!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys Dagashi Kashi for its lighthearted comedy, nostalgic themes, and unique focus on Japanese candy. While the show lacks a strong plot and some jokes may not resonate with all viewers, the enjoyable characters and informative content make it a pleasant watch. Many appreciate the show's ability to evoke childhood memories and offer a glimpse into Japanese culture through its candy.
pros: Enjoyable characters with humorous interactions
Catchy opening and ending themes
Unique and interesting character designs
Informative and nostalgic look at Japanese candy culture
Good art and animation quality
cons: Lack of a strong or compelling plot
Repetitive formula in each episode
Jokes may not land well with non-Japanese viewers
Limited character development
Ending lacks closure

anime.title: GATE Part 2
anime.romaji_title: Gate: Jieitai Kanochi nite, Kaku Tatakaeri Part 2
anime.synopsis:
Several months have passed since the infamous Ginza Incident, with tensions between the Empire and JSDF escalating in the vast and mysterious "Special Region" over peace negotiations. The greed and curiosity of the global powers have also begun to grow, as reports about the technological limitations of the magical realm's archaic civilizations come to light. 

Meanwhile, Lieutenant Youji Itami and his merry band of female admirers struggle to navigate the complex political intrigue that plagues the Empire's court. Despite her best efforts, Princess Piña Co Lada faces difficulties attempting to convince her father that the JSDF has no intention of conquering their kingdom. Pressured from both sides of the Gate, Itami must consider even more drastic measures to fulfill his mission.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with some viewers enjoying the action, world-building, and political intrigue, while others are critical of the nationalistic themes and perceived propaganda. There are also complaints about pacing and character development. Overall, the season is seen as entertaining but flawed, with a strong emphasis on military themes and fan service.
pros: Impressive world-building with detailed environments and character designs.
Enjoyable action scenes with well-placed SFX for guns and explosions.
Intriguing political elements added depth to the story.
cons: Pacing issues, with rushed arcs and potential plot holes.
Controversial nationalistic themes and JSDF propaganda.
Superficial character development in some cases.

anime.title: Persona 5 the Animation -THE DAY BREAKERS-
anime.romaji_title: Persona 5 the Animation: The Day Breakers
anime.synopsis:
There is a new urban legend circulating Tokyo. It claims that if you make a request in the Ask-a-Thief Channel, the Phantom Thieves of Hearts will show up and bring justice by stealing a corrupt person's heart and making them regret all their wrongdoings. As strange and inexplicable events continue to happen all around town, more people submit their requests in hope that the mysterious vigilante group will help.

Kazuya Makigami is a burglar by night, but has started to have second thoughts about his crimes and those who help him commit them. Unable to stand up to his comrades himself, Kazuya submits a request to the Ask-a-Thief Channel.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, particularly among fans of the Persona series, who praise the music and stylish animation as excellent hype-builders for the game. However, there's a notable division regarding the narrative quality, with many acknowledging its purpose as a promotional tool but criticizing the lack of depth in story and character for those seeking a standalone experience.
pros: Fantastic music with a unique jazzy, fashionable, and fitting style that enhances the mood, even in gloomy portions.
Visually stylish with a beautiful color palette and excellent character designs, often described as gloriously animated with a standout fight scene.
Effectively serves as a hype-builder and introduction to the Persona 5 game, giving a glimpse of its world, mechanics, and tone.
Accurate representation of the game's aesthetic and mechanics like the Baton Pass, making it a delight for fans of the source material.
cons: Plot and story are considered barebones, predictable, or throwaway, serving more as a teaser than a substantial narrative.
Character development is lacking due to the short runtime, with characters often feeling like one-note archetypes.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with some scenes being well-animated and others being poor or janky, lessening the impact of certain moments.
As a standalone product, it fails to provide a deep narrative and requires prior knowledge of the game for full understanding.

anime.title: March Comes In Like a Lion
anime.synopsis:
Having reached professional status in middle school, Rei Kiriyama is one of the few elite in the world of shogi. Due to this, he faces an enormous amount of pressure, both from the shogi community and his adoptive family. Seeking independence from his tense home life, he moves into an apartment in Tokyo. As a 17-year-old living on his own, Rei tends to take poor care of himself, and his reclusive personality ostracizes him from his peers in school and at the shogi hall.

However, not long after his arrival in Tokyo, Rei meets Akari, Hinata, and Momo Kawamoto, a trio of sisters living with their grandfather who owns a traditional wagashi shop. Akari, the oldest of the three girls, is determined to combat Rei's loneliness and poorly sustained lifestyle with motherly hospitality. The Kawamoto sisters, coping with past tragedies, also share with Rei a unique familial bond that he has lacked for most of his life. As he struggles to maintain himself physically and mentally through his shogi career, Rei must learn how to interact with others and understand his own complex emotions.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, praising the show's emotional depth, artistic merit, and relatable themes of personal growth. Some viewers find the slow pace and protagonist's initial passivity frustrating, while others appreciate the nuanced exploration of complex emotions and relationships. Despite some criticisms, the series is generally well-regarded for its unique blend of slice-of-life and character-driven storytelling.
pros: Beautiful and unique art style enhances emotional impact.
Masterful handling of serious topics and character development.
Relatable exploration of personal growth, relationships, and overcoming obstacles.
cons: Slow pacing can be frustrating for some viewers.
Protagonist's initial lack of personality can be off-putting.
Some find the focus on shogi gameplay excessive and detracting from character development.

anime.title: Kuroko's Basketball the Movie: Last Game
anime.romaji_title: Kuroko no Basket Movie 4: Last Game
anime.synopsis:
Hailing from America, Jabberwock—a street basketball team with skills comparable to those of the NBA—has come to Japan to play an exhibition match against Strky, a team of former third-year students who once played in the Interhigh and Winter Cup. However, due to the vast difference in skill, Jabberwock easily wins. Their captain, Nash Gold Jr., mocks the basketball style of all players in Japan by comparing them to monkeys.
 
Infuriated by the nasty comment, Kagetora Aida challenges them to a revenge match. Because of pride and the belief that the results will be no different, Nash accepts the challenge. Kagetora then assembles Vorpal Swords, a team composed of the Generation of Miracles, including Kuroko Tetsuya and Kagami Taiga, for they are the only ones who stand a chance against a foe that seems unbeatable from every angle.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Fans appreciate seeing the Generation of Miracles united and the nostalgic callbacks to the series. However, some criticize the predictable plot, weak villains, and changes in art style, leading to a somewhat divisive response.
pros: Seeing the Generation of Miracles together and as more mature characters was refreshing.
The movie sticks to the manga material and connects well to previous seasons.
The soundtrack and voice acting are well-received, enhancing the experience.
cons: The villains are poorly written and uninteresting.
The story is predictable and shallow, lacking depth compared to the series.
Some find the art style different and less appealing than the anime.
Unrealistic elements can be off-putting for some viewers

anime.title: Sound! Euphonium Episode 14 – Ready, Set, Monaka
anime.synopsis:
After the Kitauji High School concert band's auditions for club member participation in the Kyoto Prefectural Concert Band competition, 10 members fail to pass the strict evaluation. Despite being unable to play with the rest of the wind ensemble, the group—who decide to name themselves Team Monaka—is determined to support their peers in any way possible until the day of the competition.

From carrying supplies to creating monaka-shaped good-luck charms, Team Monaka's efforts prove to be pivotal for the unforgettable, bittersweet summer in the concert band's journey toward nationals.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views this OVA as a strong, emotionally resonant addition to the Hibike! Euphonium series, especially for fans invested in the characters. While praised for its signature animation quality and character depth, some minor criticisms exist regarding its reliance on prior knowledge and perceived rushed animation in certain moments. Overall, it's seen as a worthwhile, non-filler episode that nicely rounds out the narrative.
pros: Exceptional animation quality and attention to detail, characteristic of Kyoto Animation.
Deep emotional resonance and character development, particularly for Hazuki.
Effective use of subtle visual storytelling and framing to convey character relationships and emotions.
Provides valuable insights and fills narrative gaps for fans of the main series.
Strong musical score that complements the emotional scenes.
cons: Animation and art style perceived as rushed or less polished in some instances.
Relies heavily on prior knowledge of the main series, making it less accessible to newcomers.
Some reused music and backgrounds from the main series.
The plot offers limited new developments beyond character interactions and emotional exploration.

anime.title: JOKER 3rd Season
anime.synopsis:
Third season in the Kaitou Joker anime series.

The thief Mysterious Joker doesn't just steal things. An audacious and elusive miracle-maker, he travels the world searching for treasure with his partner and cook Hachi. As they circle the globe, they must avoid traps set by the police and compete in various competitions to reach their final goal, the Timeslip Treasure.
anime.consensus_summary: The third season introduces a compelling new villain in President D, giving Joker a dedicated archenemy and raising the stakes of his heists. The dynamic between Joker and his rivals, along with his signature trickery, continues to entertain. Overall the audience seems to be appreciative of the show.
pros: Introduction of a true archenemy for Joker in President D.
More formidable opponents and dangerous scenarios for Joker's heists.
Joker's trolling and trickery remain a highlight.

anime.title: Persona 2: Another Self
anime.synopsis: Animated promotional trailer for the Persona 2: Innocent Sin, a game for PlayStation. Included as a bonus on the Persona 2: Eternal Punishment Bonus Disc.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience expresses disappointment and longing for what could have been, mourning the unfulfilled potential of a Persona 2 anime adaptation hinted at by the trailer. There's a strong sense of nostalgia and frustration that Atlus never pursued the project, especially given the success of Persona 3 and 4 anime adaptations. The trailer itself is seen as a promising glimpse into a road not taken.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the game's story and characters in trailer form
Successfully establishes the central mysteries and antagonists
Captures the essence of Persona 2 in a short format
cons: Animation quality is poor and generic
Trailer never led to a full anime adaptation
Unfulfilled promise of a Persona 2 anime adaptation

anime.title: Dragon Nest: Throne of Elves
anime.synopsis: Dragon Nest Movie 2: Throne of Elves will be released in Summer 2016.  The movie is a sequel to Mili Pictures' hugely successful Dragon Nest: Warriors' Dawn.  It will take the story of the land of Altera deep into the territory of the Elves in an action-packed adventure with more of the drama, comedy, and excitement. The film is directed by Soong Yuefeng, acclaimed director of the first Dragon Nest movie.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience finds 'Long Zhi Gu: Jingling Wangzuo' enjoyable, especially for younger viewers and fans of the genre. While the story is predictable and relies on familiar tropes, the animation and character development are praised. The film successfully creates an exciting and engaging experience, leading to a positive, if not overwhelmingly enthusiastic, reception.
pros: Appealing animation style, reminiscent of Thinkerbell movies.
Character development is well-executed, allowing for meaningful interactions.
Exciting and engaging, keeping the audience invested throughout.
cons: Story is somewhat clichéd and relies on overused tropes.
Predictable plot elements, such as allies' disagreements due to misunderstandings.
Lacks originality in its narrative structure.

anime.title: Super Lovers
anime.synopsis:
Upon hearing news that his mother was on verge of death, Haru Kaidou—the eldest son of the family—flies all the way to Canada. The moment he arrives, he learns that not only did his mother fool him, but he is also supposed to take care of his adoptive brother, Ren Kaidou, an antisocial kid who feels more comfortable around dogs than people.

Due to his new brother's distrustful nature, Haru initially has a hard time reaching out to Ren but their relationship eventually grows. He makes a promise to Ren: they will live together in Japan after Haru graduates from high school. However, due to an unfortunate accident, Haru loses all memories of the summer they spent together, including the promise he made. Five years later, expecting Haru to keep his promise, Ren arrives in Tokyo; but to Haru, Ren is just a random boy claiming to be his brother.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized. Some viewers find the anime enjoyable due to its shounen-ai elements and character designs, while others are deeply disturbed by the age gap, incestuous themes, and what they perceive as the normalization of grooming. Many find the relationship between Haru and Ren to be inappropriate and unsettling, leading to significant controversy surrounding the series.
pros: Appealing art style and animation quality.
Enjoyable music, including opening and ending themes.
Character designs are likeable and visually pleasing.
cons: Disturbing themes of grooming and potential pedophilia due to the age gap between the main characters.
Incestuous undertones are off-putting to many viewers.
Questionable portrayal of relationships and normalization of toxic dynamics.
Weak plot development and rushed storyline.

anime.title: Witch Village Story
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is deeply divided by "Witch Village Story." Some find its bizarre and potentially offensive content to be a profound and satirical exploration of life's meaning, praising its unconventional themes and unique portrayal of relationships. Others are repulsed by its extreme themes and crude depiction of sensitive topics. This divide leads to a highly polarized viewing experience.
pros: Profound exploration of life's meaning
Unconventional and thought-provoking themes
Unique depiction of relationships
cons: Potentially offensive or disturbing content
Extreme and potentially triggering themes
Crude or bizarre portrayal of sensitive topics

anime.title: One Punch Man: Road to Hero
anime.romaji_title: One Punch Man: Road to Hero
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Parody, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Before Saitama became the man he is today, he trained and fought endlessly to become a hero. While every scuffle leaves his tracksuit uniform in tatters, he always has it mended for free thanks to his local tailor. One day, however, the tailor informs him that he must close up shop due to pressure from a local gang. Saitama decides to help him out—and gains something irreplaceable in the process.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally agree that 'Road to Hero' is a decent, enjoyable OVA for dedicated fans seeking more One-Punch Man content and backstory. However, many feel it lacks the excitement and plot significance of the main series, with some considering it a skippable filler episode.
pros: Consistent art and sound quality mirroring the main series
Offers useful backstory and insight into Saitama's origins and suit
Maintains the core humor and atmosphere of the One-Punch Man universe
cons: Lacks the high-octane action and 'one-punch KO' moments of the main series
Story is considered basic, mundane, and not essential to the main plot
Some viewers found the humor less impactful and the overall experience 'meh' or forgettable

anime.title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya 3rei!!
anime.synopsis:
Waking up to find herself in a parallel version of Fuyuki City, Illyasviel "Illya" von Einzbern is lost and alone. She discovers her home in ruins, with a massive crater lying in the center of her hometown. With snow falling in the middle of summer, confusion consumes the young elementary schooler, who has no knowledge of where her friends or her wand Ruby may be.

Making it to the remains of her house, she is suddenly tackled by an amnesiac girl. Wearing a gym uniform as the icy temperature sets in, the mysterious girl has no idea of where she is or why she showed up. However, this stranger, known as Tanaka, apparently has information about the location of Rin Toosaka, Miyu Edelfelt, and the rest of Illya's missing friends. 

Fleeing from agents of the Ainsworth family⁠—those in control of this parallel realm—where will these two end up, and how will Illya restore the present back to the world she once knew?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for improved animation and action sequences but criticism for plot inconsistencies, cliffhanger endings, and reliance on prior Fate knowledge. Some find the show enjoyable despite its illogical elements, while others are frustrated by the lack of resolution and character issues. The series is appreciated for its evolution but also faces scrutiny for its adherence to fan service tropes.
pros: Animation quality improves over previous seasons, especially during action sequences.
Story improves and moves away from primarily yuri loli to a more mature action focus.
The season starts with plot and avoids filler episodes.
cons: Some find the show illogical and nonsensical, especially without prior knowledge of the Fate series.
The show ends on a cliffhanger without clear indication of a future release.
Inconsistencies in character design, such as the anatomically implausible portrayal of nudity, and the use of existing characters in a parallel world setting.

anime.title: Divine Gate
anime.synopsis:
The legend of the Divine Gate is a story told to young children that depicts the merging of the living world, the heavens, and the underworld. "Adapters"—people born with unique elemental abilities gifted to them from the union of these worlds—formed the World Council, an organization which controls the chaos of the Gate by portraying its legend as nothing more than a myth. These Adapters train in a special academy owned by the World Council that allows the students to hone their skills.

Aoto, a teenage boy with exceptional water powers and a tragic past, rejects the offer to join the academy numerous times—until he is successfully pressured by the energetic wind user Midori and stubborn fire user Akane. Together, with the World Council and their mysterious leader Arthur, they seek out the Gate in the hopes of uncovering the truth. But in order to reach their goals, they must unite and overcome their own despair while dealing with behind the scene mischief.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative, with many viewers finding the anime's story confusing, characters underdeveloped, and ending unsatisfying. While some appreciate the art style and opening theme, the overall experience is considered a disappointment due to poor writing and execution. There are a few viewers who praise the show's originality and incorporation of themes, but they are in the minority.
pros: Catchy opening theme
Visually appealing art style and character designs in some scenes
cons: Convoluted and confusing plot with unexplained elements
Poorly developed and unmemorable characters with weak motivations
Inconsistent character behavior
Rushed and unsatisfying ending
Obnoxious narrator
Poor use of flashbacks

anime.title: To LOVE Ru Darkness 2 Specials
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Extra episodes of To LOVE-Ru Darkness 2nd bundled with the seventh Blu-ray and DVD volume.
anime.consensus_summary: The special episodes provide a more conclusive ending to To LOVE-Ru Darkness 2nd, resolving some plot points and showcasing impressive animation, particularly Yami's new appearance. However, some viewers found the story elements, especially Nemesis's motivations, uninspired. Overall, the specials are seen as a positive addition for fans of the series, despite minor criticisms.
pros: Satisfying ending compared to the cliffhanger of the main series.
Yami's transformed appearance and expressions are well-drawn.
Action sequences are animated exceptionally well.
Strong voice acting, especially Yami's voice actor.
cons: Nemesis's goal is uninspired and unclear.
BGM is not memorable.
The 'specials' are essentially the final episodes of the season, causing frustration for viewers who had to wait.
Story elements might be shallow, relying on typical To LOVE-Ru tropes.

anime.title: Working!!! Lord of the Takanashi
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, Seinen, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
The light-hearted Working!! franchise comes to a close in this final episode of the concluding season. Will Aoi Yamada get the closure she so desperately needs with her distant mother? Will the relationship between Yachiyo Todoroki and Jun Satou continue to remain stagnant and awkward? Perhaps even Souta Takanashi and Mahiru Inami will take a step forward in deepening their eccentric friendship. And in the end, Wagnaria Restaurant might finally get a new chief!

Beautifully connected, all these events intertwine to give these characters a final ending to their stories.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Working!!! Lord of the Takanashi' special is overwhelmingly well-received as a fitting and heartwarming conclusion to the series. Fans appreciate the closure provided for long-running plotlines and character arcs. Some find the pacing a bit slow or the production unremarkable, but the overall sentiment is highly positive and nostalgic.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to long-running plot threads.
Character growth and resolution of relationships.
Nostalgic feeling for long-time viewers.
cons: Pacing issues, plot starts late in the special.
Relies heavily on previous seasons, not newcomer-friendly.
Animation and sound are not particularly special.

anime.title: Rewrite
anime.synopsis:
Kazamatsuri, a modern, well-developed city renowned for its burgeoning greenery and rich Japanese culture, is home to Kotarou Tennouji, a high schooler least privy to the place's shared values. Content to fill his pockets with frivolity, the proud and nosey boy whiles away his time pestering the self-proclaimed delinquent Haruhiko, and indulging in his amorous feelings toward the oddball Kotori.

Equipped with the superhuman ability to permanently rewrite any part of his body to multiply his strength or speed, Kotarou is naturally drawn to the supernatural. One special meeting with the lone member and president of the Occult Research Club, the "Witch" Akane Senri, leads to Kotarou reviving the Occult Club by recruiting Kotori and three other members: the clumsy transfer student Chihaya, the strict class representative Lucia, and the unassuming Shizuru. As Kotarou unveils hidden secrets of each member of the Occult Club through their shared adventures, he will inevitably encounter a fate that only he might be able to rewrite.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response to Rewrite is overwhelmingly negative. Many viewers familiar with the visual novel express disappointment with the anime's poor adaptation, rushed pacing, and underdeveloped characters. Anime-only viewers are often confused by the disjointed plot and lack of explanation. While a few appreciate certain aspects like the music, the consensus is that Rewrite fails to capture the essence of the source material and is not a worthwhile watch.
pros: Some enjoy the music taken directly from the visual novel.
A few found the initial episodes enjoyable for their school life characterization.
Some appreciate the unique characteristics and personalities of the characters, despite initial generic impressions.
cons: Many feel the anime is a poor adaptation of the visual novel, with a rushed and incomprehensible storyline.
The pacing is frequently criticized for being too fast, leading to a confusing and disjointed narrative.
Several reviewers found the characters to be underdeveloped and lacking emotional depth, making it difficult to connect with them.
The animation and art quality are often described as poor, especially the use of CGI.
The anime original content is largely criticized for not making sense without prior knowledge of the source material.

anime.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Signs of Holy War
anime.romaji_title: Nanatsu no Taizai: Seisen no Shirushi
anime.synopsis: The Seven Deadly Sins, along with Elizabeth Liones and Hawk, have won the Kingdom of Leones back from the Holy Knights. At long last, it's their time to indulge in the peaceful lives they fought for. From inedible meat pies, overdue battles, unexpected stalkers, and the butterflies of first love, the Sins are accompanied by their friends in their carefree, fun-filled time together. However, the calm is broken with the premonition of a new threat, bringing upon the signs of Holy War and threatening to shatter the peace of the Sins' easygoing days.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided on 'Nanatsu no Taizai: Seisen no Shirushi'. While some appreciate the lighthearted character interactions and consider it a pleasant interlude between seasons, many find the series disappointing due to its misleading title, lack of substantial plot, and filler content. The series is generally considered skippable, with only minor plot developments occurring at the end of episodes.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions and development
Continuation of the original's fun and cheerful atmosphere
Good visuals, sound effects, and music, consistent with the original
cons: Misleading title and lack of significant plot progression
Filler content and inconsequential side stories
Rushed pacing and lack of creativity in fights
Inconsistencies in character personalities

anime.title: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Crystal Season III
anime.romaji_title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Crystal Season III
anime.synopsis:
Usagi Tsukino is still struggling to balance her home life with the duties of being Sailor Moon, the guardian of love and justice. Along with the other Sailor Guardians and her boyfriend Mamoru Chiba, they begin investigating cases of students from Mugen Academy, a school for the most elite students, who are being transformed into monsters. During the investigation, they meet three strange individuals: Haruka Tenou, a handsome racecar driver; Michiru Kaiou, a talented violinist; and Hotaru Tomoe, a mysterious girl with a weak constitution.

As more incidents occur, the Sailor Guardians are met with another surprise—the appearance of two new planetary protectors with motives of their own. Despite the newcomers' questionable allegiance to Usagi and her comrades, they all face a threat from a common enemy: an evil entity who calls himself Pharaoh 90.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment toward Sailor Moon Crystal Season III is mixed but leans positive. Many viewers appreciate the improved visuals and more faithful adaptation of the manga, particularly the Infinity Arc. However, some criticisms remain regarding the rushed pacing, plot inconsistencies, and some animation flaws, creating a mildly polarized response overall.
pros: Improved art and animation compared to previous seasons.
Faithful adaptation of the manga's Infinity Arc.
Better characterization, with more personality for the characters.
Enjoyable portrayal of the Outer Senshi (Uranus, Neptune, Saturn).
cons: Rushed pacing due to the limited number of episodes.
Plot holes and unresolved events from previous seasons.
Some animation inconsistencies and occasional choppiness.
Opening sequence copied from other anime.

anime.title: The Asterisk War Season 2
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Gakusen Toshi Asterisk 2nd Season continues the story of Genestella students Ayato Amagiri and Julis-Alexia von Riessfeld, who have progressed to the next round of the Phoenix Festa after a long and strenuous battle with sisters Irene and Priscilla Urzaiz.

Despite Julis and Ayato's best attempts, the fact that Ayato's powers have been sealed is no longer a secret. Now at a major disadvantage, the duo must come up with a plan if they are to have any hope of winning the Phoenix Festa. Only one thing is for sure: the troubles heading their way are only going to get more insurmountable from here on.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Gakusen Toshi Asterisk 2nd Season. Some find it enjoyable despite its generic nature, praising the action, art, and music. However, many criticize the unoriginal story, weak characters, and slow pacing, leading to disappointment and frustration.
pros: Good art and animation quality.
Enjoyable music and sound design.
Action/battle scenes are well-executed.
cons: Unoriginal and generic storyline.
Weak character development.
Rushed introduction of new support characters.
Slow pacing.

anime.title: Magi: Adventure of Sinbad
anime.synopsis:
In the small, impoverished Tison Village of the Parthevia Empire, a boy, Sinbad, is born to the jaded ex-soldier Badr and his kind-hearted wife Esra. His birth creates a radiant surge throughout the rukh, a declaration of a singularity to those who stand at the pinnacle of magical might: the "Child of Destiny" is here. Despite his country being plagued by economic instability and the repercussions of war, Sinbad leads a cheerful life—until a stranger's arrival shatters his peaceful world, and tragedy soon befalls him.

Years later, mysterious edifices called "dungeons" have been erected all over the world. Rumored to contain great power and treasures, these dungeons piqued the interest of adventurers and armies alike; though to this day, none have returned therefrom. Sinbad, now 14, has grown into a charming and talented young boy. Inspired by the shocking events of his childhood and by his father's words, he yearns to begin exploring the world beyond his village. As though orchestrated by fate, Sinbad meets an enigmatic traveler named Yunan. Stirred by Sinbad's story and ambitions, Yunan directs him to a dungeon which he claims holds the power Sinbad needs to achieve his goals—the "power of a king."

Magi: Sinbad no Bouken tells the epic saga of Sinbad's early life as he travels the world, honing his skill and influence, while gathering allies and power to become the High King of the Seven Seas.
anime.consensus_summary: Magi: Adventure of Sinbad is a generally well-received prequel that explores the origins of the popular character Sinbad. While many appreciate the engaging storyline, faithful adaptation, and overall fun experience, some find the series lacking in depth, with pacing issues and an overpowered main character. The show is divisive, particularly among fans who prefer the original Magi series' richer themes.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga with great art style.
Engaging story of Sinbad's origins and rise to power.
Well-balanced mix of action, adventure, comedy, and fantasy.
Soundtrack enhances the excitement of the scenes.
Sinbad is a compelling and lovable character.
cons: Pacing can feel rushed at times.
Some arcs are formulaic.
Sinbad is portrayed as overly powerful and faces few consequences.
Other characters are underdeveloped.
Lacks the depth and thematic exploration of the original Magi series.
Repetitive content from the OVA series.

anime.title: Seraph of the End: The Beginning of the End
anime.romaji_title: Owari no Seraph: The Beginning of the End
anime.synopsis: Recap of 1st Season Aired Before Nagoya Kessen-hen.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views this as a straightforward recap episode, primarily useful for remembering plot points and getting hyped for the next season. While it serves its purpose, viewers acknowledge that it offers little new content for those who have already seen the first season.
pros: Good for refreshing memory and hyping up for the next season
Features main cast talking over recap in character
cons: May have less enjoyment as it's a recap of already seen events

anime.title: Kizumonogatari Part 2: Hot-Blooded
anime.synopsis:
No longer truly human, Koyomi Araragi decides to retrieve Kiss-shot Acerola-orion Heart-under-blade's severed body parts that were stolen by three powerful vampire hunters. Awaiting him are Dramaturgie, a vampire hunter who is a vampire himself; Episode, a half-vampire with the ability to transform into mist; and Guillotinecutter, a human priest who is the most dangerous of them all.

Unbeknownst to Araragi, each minute he spends trying to retrieve Kiss-shot's limbs makes him less of a human and more of a vampire. Will he be able to keep his wish of becoming human once again by the end of his battles?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Many praise the stunning visuals, action sequences, and overall artistic presentation, considering it a peak Monogatari experience. However, a significant portion criticizes the weak story, poorly developed characters, and questionable adaptation choices, finding it a disappointing and soulless experience compared to the source material.
pros: Amazing animation and art style, especially the use of 3D rendered settings.
Well-choreographed fight scenes with physics-defying action and gore.
Excellent voice acting and soundtrack.
Creative cinematography and visual techniques.
cons: Poorly written story with underdeveloped antagonists and weak motivations.
Changes, deviations, and omissions from the novel, lacking context and explanation.
Over-the-top fight scenes and excessive animation bloat.
Lack of a clear premise or theme, resulting in a lackluster experience.
Pacing issues, with key moments feeling rushed or skipped over.

anime.title: Kizumonogatari Part 3: Cold-Blooded
anime.synopsis:
After helping revive the legendary vampire Kiss-shot Acerola-orion Heart-under-blade, Koyomi Araragi has become a vampire himself and her servant. Kiss-shot is certain she can turn him back into a human, but only once regaining her full power. 

Araragi has hunted down the three vampire hunters that defeated Kiss-shot and retrieved her limbs to return her to full strength. However, now that Araragi has almost accomplished what he’s been fighting for this whole time, he has to consider if this is what he really wants. Once he revives this powerful immortal vampire, there is no telling what she might do, and there would be no way of stopping her.

But there is more to the story that Araragi doesn’t understand. If a newborn vampire like him could defeat the hunters, how did they overpower Kiss-shot? Can he trust her to turn him back to a human? And how is that even possible in the first place?

Araragi is at his limit but he must come to a decision, and it may not be possible to resolve this situation without doing something he’ll regret…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, with many praising the animation, sound, and emotional depth. However, some find the animation style off-putting, the fights anticlimactic, and the plot dragged out. The film's avant-garde style can be polarizing, but fans of the Monogatari series generally appreciate it.
pros: Excellent sound direction and animation.
The story is well-written.
Perfect balance of action and emotion.
cons: Animation looks really weird.
Fights are random and anticlimactic.
The series feels really dragged already.

anime.title: Accel World: Infinite∞Burst
anime.genres: Action, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
Some time after the events involving Burst Linker Dusk Taker, Kuroyukihime recalls recruiting Haruyuki Arita to the "Brain Burst" program—an application that allows players to accelerate their cognitive functions until time seems to stop. Since his arrival, Haruyuki has risen to fame among the other Burst Linkers and has been helping Kuroyukihime achieve her goal of reaching the highest level in the game.

During a territorial battle with their legion, Nega Nebulus, Haruyuki and his friends are kicked out of the program after a destructive storm in-game. All over Tokyo, security cameras are malfunctioning, which Kuroyukihime deduces is related to the Brain Burst glitch. Determined to fix the problem, Nega Nebulus must recruit the other legions to find the source of the issue and restore the acceleration ability.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is heavily divided, with strong disappointment from anime-only viewers due to the incomprehensible reliance on light novel lore and a poorly executed recap. While the animation and action sequences are praised, they fail to salvage a narrative that is widely considered rushed and inaccessible to those unfamiliar with the source material.
pros: Impressive and well-animated battle sequences, especially the thrilling fights and large-scale enemy encounters.
High-quality animation and visual presentation, with Sunrise delivering expected excellent production values.
Engaging soundtrack that contributes to the immersive experience of the action sequences.
cons: The extensive 40-minute recap is poorly paced, boring, and fails to adequately explain crucial plot points or character introductions for anime-only viewers.
The narrative relies heavily on prior knowledge of the light novels, leaving viewers who only watched the anime confused about character motivations, new alliances, and game mechanics.
The plot and new character development are rushed, with insufficient screen time for new characters and underdeveloped story arcs.
The movie feels like an advertisement for the light novels rather than a self-contained or coherent film.

anime.title: Alderamin on the Sky
anime.romaji_title: Nejimaki Seirei Senki: Tenkyou no Alderamin
anime.synopsis:
Ikta Solork is a carefree young man who only wants two things in life: a woman on his arm and a place to nap. Unfortunately, his peaceful life is destroyed when war breaks out between the Katjvarna Empire and the neighboring Republic of Kioka. Ikta and his childhood friend, Yatorishino Igsem, join the army as military officers, where they meet the infantryman Matthew Tetojirichi, the sniper Torway Remion, and the medic Haroma Becker on a boat heading for the military exam site.

However, after a rogue storm sinks their vessel, the five of them end up in enemy territory near a military outpost. There, they discover that the heir to the Katjvarnan throne, Princess Chamille Kitora Katjvanmaninik, has been taken hostage. The five are able to rescue her, and as a reward, each one of them is granted the title of Imperial Knight—one of the highest honors a soldier can receive. It seems that Ikta will have to put his dream of tranquility on hold, as he must now become the hero he never wanted to be.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed with praise for its tactical warfare and character dynamics, but also criticism for a slow start, incomplete narrative, and reliance on familiar tropes. The series has good potential and is enjoyable, though its execution has flaws. While praised for its focus on war themes and interesting characters, the anime is criticized for its pacing, incomplete story, and somewhat generic setting.
pros: Interesting characters with good development, especially Ikta and Yatorishino.
Well-executed war themes and religious elements.
Good use of strategies and meaningful battles.
Balanced romance, action, and tactical battle sequences.
Strong animation and character designs.
cons: Slow start taking three episodes to get going.
Generic Empire vs Republic setting.
Questionable pacing at times.
Incomplete story with an open ending and unlikely second season.
Use of 'spirits' feels out of place.
MC acting in a way that makes no sense mid season
anime.thematic_vibe: Tactical Warfare, Political Intrigue, Unlikely Hero

anime.title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Ordinal Scale
anime.romaji_title: Sword Art Online Movie: Ordinal Scale
anime.synopsis:
In 2026, four years after the infamous Sword Art Online incident, a revolutionary new form of technology has emerged: the Augma, a device that utilizes an Augmented Reality system. Unlike the Virtual Reality of the NerveGear and the Amusphere, it is perfectly safe and allows players to use it while they are conscious, creating an instant hit on the market. The most popular application for the Augma is the game Ordinal Scale, which immerses players in a fantasy role-playing game with player rankings and rewards.

Following the new craze, Kirito's friends dive into the game, and despite his reservations about the system, Kirito eventually joins them. While at first it appears to be just fun and games, they soon find out that the game is not all that it seems...
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is generally well-received, especially by existing SAO fans, with praise for its visuals, action, and nostalgic elements. Some find the plot predictable and the characters cliched, but the overall experience is considered enjoyable and a worthwhile addition to the SAO franchise. There is also a sense of resolution of previous writing issues.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation quality.
Exciting and well-choreographed action sequences.
Nostalgic callbacks to previous SAO seasons.
cons: Predictable plot and cliche villains.
Soundtrack not as memorable as the original SAO.
Simplistic story with a lack of coherent story.

anime.title: Amanchu!
anime.genres: Iyashikei, School, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Originally from a big city, Futaba Ooki spends most days cataloguing her life through pictures on her phone. Upon moving to a seaside town, she gazes out over the vast expanse of sea and quickly becomes captivated by its endless possibilities. Unbeknownst to Futaba, her quiet contemplation catches the attention of local diving enthusiast Hikari Kohinata. Finding herself in the same class as Futaba the next day, Hikari is drawn to her quiet and shy demeanor and affectionately nicknames her Teko, sparking a tender friendship. 

Struggling to adapt to the change of pace in her life, Futaba finds herself strung along by Hikari's vast energy and passion for diving. Together, they join the school diving club, led by their homeroom teacher Mato Katori. With Hikari by her side, Futaba works to earn her diving certification while experiencing new friendships and possibilities.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Amanchu!' as a relaxing and visually appealing slice-of-life anime.  Viewers appreciate the character development and positive themes, but some find the pacing slow and the comedic facial expressions overused. While not groundbreaking, it's considered a pleasant and heartwarming experience, especially for fans of the iyashikei subgenre.
pros: Beautiful art and animation, especially the water and backgrounds.
Relaxing and lighthearted atmosphere with well-timed comedy.
Strong character development, particularly Teko's journey of overcoming shyness.
Excellent voice acting and fitting soundtrack.
Positive messages about friendship and enjoying life's simple moments.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and scene transitions.
Repetitive themes and messages.
Overused and distracting chibi facial expressions.
Lack of focus on scuba diving despite being a central theme.
Underdeveloped side characters.

anime.title: One Punch Man Specials
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Comedy, Parody, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Specials included in the Blu-ray and DVD releases of One Punch Man.
anime.consensus_summary: The One Punch Man Specials are generally considered a fun and lighthearted addition to the franchise, offering more insight into the side characters and world. While they lack the action and significant plot of the main series, the humor and consistent quality make them worth watching for fans. However, some find the stories insignificant and the comedy less effective.
pros: Expands on side characters and world-building.
Consistent art and sound quality with the main series.
Humor is as good as, or even better than, the main series for some viewers.
cons: Stories are not significant or relevant enough for the main series.
Lacks the action and excitement of the main series.
Comedy can be drab or uninspired for some viewers.
Animation is downgraded compared to the main series, especially in action scenes.

anime.title: Neko nanka Yondemo Konai.
anime.synopsis: The series focuses on a professional boxer who chooses to become a manga artist after sustaining an injury. The man takes in two cats: Kuro, who is very timid, and her younger sister Chin.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, especially among cat lovers. Viewers appreciate the anime's charming and relatable portrayal of owning cats and its heartwarming story about finding new purpose. Despite some criticisms regarding the animation quality, the overall sentiment is that it's a sweet and enjoyable watch.
pros: Charming and relatable depiction of life with cats
Simple, sweet, and easily digestible episodes
Heartwarming story about finding new meaning in life
cons: Amateurish art style and animation
Short episodes leave the viewer wanting more
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Heartwarming, Cat Appreciation

anime.title: Yowamushi Pedal: New Generation
anime.synopsis:
Third season of the Yowamushi Pedal series.

With the team's combined strength, the Sohoku High bicycle racing club beat reigning champions Hakone Academy at the Interhigh national race and achieved an impressive overall victory. Now that their hot summer has ended and third-years Kinjou, Makishima, and Tadokoro have retired from the team, first-year participants in the Interhigh Onoda Sakamichi, Imaizumi Shunsuke, and Naruko Shoukichi, along with their new captain second-year Teshima Junta and vice-captain Aoyagi Hajime begin preparing as a "new team" for their second consecutive championship at the next Interhigh. In order to retake their throne, their rivals Hakone Academy have also incorporated new members and begun training as a new team. Kyoto Fushimi High is lead by the monstrous racer Midousuji Akira. The nation's top schools are all honing their skills to reach the top of the Interhigh.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling that 'New Generation' doesn't live up to the previous seasons. While some appreciate the improved animation and character development of side characters, others find the plot repetitive, the pacing slow, and new characters uninteresting or even annoying. There is a general sentiment that the season relies too heavily on the formula of the first season, lacking originality.
pros: Improved animation quality with less CGI.
Development of previously underdeveloped characters like Teshima and Aoyagi.
Faithful continuation of the established Yowamushi Pedal formula.
cons: Repetitive plot structure similar to season 1.
Pacing issues, particularly in the first half.
Exaggerated shonen elements that feel out of place.
Uninteresting or annoying new characters.
Weak character development for the protagonist, Onoda.

anime.title: Active Raid
anime.romaji_title: Active Raid: Kidou Kyoushuushitsu Dai Hachi Gakari
anime.synopsis:
