In a futuristic, post-disaster Tokyo, the "Special Public Security Fifth Division Third Mobile Assault Eighth Unit," or "Unit Eight," is a police unit specializing in handling criminals who wield dangerous wearable technology called "Willwear." Equipped with Willwear of their own, the squadron is often criticized by the public for their carelessness and disregard for protocol.

Sent in by the government as an undercover agent with special instructions from the higher-ups, Asami Kazari is Unit Eight's newest member. Determined to straighten out what she expects to be a group of incompetent fools, she instead finds a team of well-intentioned experts who use very effective—albeit unorthodox—methods, hindered by strict regulations. With their newest member by their side, Unit Eight fights crime and overcomes unexpected adversaries in Active Raid: Kidou Kyoushuushitsu Dai Hachi Gakari.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in its cheesy, episodic nature and well-choreographed fights, while others criticize the weak story, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent quality. The show is seen as a blend of various tropes and influences, appealing to those who enjoy lighthearted, formulaic series. However, it fails to deliver a compelling narrative or memorable characters for many viewers, resulting in a mediocre overall impression.
pros: Diverse and interesting cast of characters
Well-choreographed fights
Good CGI blend for action sequences
cons: Weak story with a lack of focus
Underdeveloped main characters
Episodic format fails to create tension
Shameless amount of fanservice
Inconsistent animation quality

anime.title: Mahou Shoujo Nante Mouiidesukara
anime.romaji_title: Mahou Shoujo Nante Mou Ii desu kara.
anime.synopsis:
Yuzuka Hanami is a young, carefree girl who lives the most ordinary life imaginable. Although her father works around the clock and her mother is rarely home, she still enjoys herself and strives to be an excellent student.

Miton, on the other hand, is an alien life-form with the ability to transform his master into a magical girl, a warrior who fights evil wherever it may appear. However, there are not as many enemies as there used to be, so Miton has been out of work for a while. Starving and homeless, he has taken up residence in a pile of garbage.

As Yuzuka walks past him one day, Miton seizes the opportunity to offer his services to the young girl. Yuzuka reluctantly agrees, but when she transforms into a magical girl and discovers that her outfit is a swimsuit, she begins to have second thoughts about what she has gotten herself into!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the show's lighthearted humor and art style, while others find it boring, pointless, and reliant on uncomfortable fanservice. Many feel it fails as both a parody and a slice-of-life anime due to its weak plot and stereotypical characters. The short episode length is a common point of criticism.
pros: The art style is cute and well-done for a short anime.
Some found the comedy enjoyable and the series a quick, laid-back watch.
The series is self-aware of its fanservice.
cons: The series lacks a meaningful plot and relies heavily on tired tropes.
The humor is often weak and repetitive.
The short episode length interrupts the flow and prevents deeper engagement.
The characters are bland and stereotypical.
The fanservice is awkward and inappropriate due to the characters' ages.
It fails as a magical girl anime due to the absence of battles

anime.title: Kiznaiver
anime.synopsis:
Katsuhira Agata is a quiet and reserved teenage boy whose sense of pain has all but vanished. His friend, Chidori Takashiro, can only faintly remember the days before Katsuhira had undergone this profound change. Now, his muffled and complacent demeanor make Katsuhira a constant target for bullies, who exploit him for egregious sums of money. But their fists only just manage to make him blink, as even emotions are far from his grasp.

However, one day Katsuhira, Chidori, and four other teenagers are abducted and forced to join the Kizuna System as official "Kiznaivers." Those taking part are connected through pain: if one member is injured, the others will feel an equal amount of agony. These individuals must become the lab rats and scapegoats of an incomplete system designed with world peace in mind. With their fates literally intertwined, the Kiznaivers must expose their true selves to each other, or risk failing much more than just the Kizuna System.
anime.consensus_summary: Kiznaiver presents an interesting premise with visually appealing art, but ultimately fails to deliver on its potential due to forced drama and weak narrative execution. While some appreciate the exploration of human connection through shared pain, others find the characters and plot unconvincing. The show is divisive, with opinions ranging from enjoyable to disappointing.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation by Studio Trigger.
Unique premise with potential for exploring human connection.
Strong character design and distinct personalities.
Intriguing concept of sharing pain to foster understanding.
cons: Forced drama and weak narrative execution.
Characters sometimes feel like plot devices rather than realistic individuals.
Inconsistent tone, with comedy clashing with serious scenes.
Unnecessary and forced romantic pairings.
Pacing issues, with some episodes feeling like filler.

anime.title: Black Butler: Book of the Atlantic
anime.romaji_title: Kuroshitsuji Movie: Book of the Atlantic
anime.genres: Action, Historical, Mystery, Mythology, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
The young Earl Ciel Phantomhive—the Queen's Guard Dog—is once again called to investigate seemingly supernatural phenomena when news of miraculous resurrections begins to surface in Victorian London. Along with Sebastian Michaelis, his demon butler, they board the luxury cruise liner Campania to investigate rumors of the Aurora Society—a medical organization suspected of experimenting on the dead.

Grim reapers begin to appear on the ship, and it becomes apparent that the ship is about to be overrun with the undead as a devious plan is put into motion. Ciel and Sebastian must now uncover the secrets that lie behind the Aurora Society's phoenix symbol, and with the help of some old acquaintances, return the undead to their coffins or share a watery grave.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with fans of the series appreciating the character development and faithfulness to the manga, while others criticize the animation quality and rushed pacing. Some find the plot engaging and emotionally resonant, while others view it as a setup for future arcs. Overall, the movie is considered a worthwhile addition for existing fans, but less appealing to newcomers.
pros: Good character development, especially for Lizzie and Ciel.
Faithful adaptation of the manga.
Humor is well-balanced with the dark themes.
Voice acting is well done.
cons: Noticeable CGI animation that is distracting.
Rushed pacing and cuts from the manga, affecting story and character development.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Plot is more of a setup for future arcs, rather than a self-contained story.

anime.title: This Boy is a Professional Wizard
anime.romaji_title: Kono Danshi, Mahou ga Oshigoto desu.
anime.synopsis: Chiharu Kashima, captain of the Wizard Bureau's Crisis Countermeasures Division, is among a handful of people who can use magic. While frequenting his favorite bar, he is approached by a friendly man named Toyohi Utsumi. Having always dreamt of being a wizard, Toyohi is enthralled by the idea of meeting one. Much to the young Captain's surprise, Toyohi confesses that he has fallen in love with Kashima. While little time has passed, the two begin to spend more time together. Not all is well, however, as Kashima fears that magic is all that he has and Toyohi is only in love with Kashima the Wizard.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Kono Danshi, Mahou ga Oshigoto desu." for its beautiful art style and simple, heartwarming story. While some find the animation limited and the plot rushed, the overall sentiment is positive, particularly among fans of the shounen ai genre. The series is seen as a sweet and visually pleasing experience, albeit not particularly groundbreaking.
pros: Visually stunning art style, especially backgrounds and colors
Charming and endearing characters with clear personalities
Well-executed, concise story suitable for its short length
cons: Limited animation and character movement
Rushed pacing due to the short episode count
Generic or cliche character archetypes

anime.title: The Heroic Legend of Arslan: Dust Storm Dance
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Military, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Continuing on his quest to retake Ecbatana, Prince Arslan and his company march toward the city. But upon receiving news that the neighboring Kingdom of Turan is launching an assault on the Parsian stronghold at Peshawar Citadel, the prince is forced to turn back in order to defend the fortress. Amid holding off the invading forces, the Parsian army is met by an unexpected visitor.

As Arslan returns to Peshawar, Prince Hermes takes a slight detour from his clash against his cousin to search for the legendary sword Rukhnabad, which would grant him the right to rule and take back what he believes is rightfully his. However, after unearthing the lost artifact, the blade is stolen by the Temple Knights of Lusitania, prompting the masked warrior to give chase. Meanwhile in Ecbatana, the captive King Andragoras III finds an opportunity to strike and begins to make his move.

As the separate sides of the Parsian royal conflict clash, Arslan's right to the throne falls under attack. But no matter the obstacles in their way, the young prince and his loyal band of warriors charge forward to restore Pars to its former glory.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Arslan Senki: Fuujin Ranbu is a mixed bag for fans. While it retains some of the strategic action and world-building of the first season, the short episode count leads to a rushed and incomplete narrative. Many viewers were disappointed by the lack of character development and unsatisfying ending, leaving them wanting more and questioning the overall direction of the story.
pros: Exciting action and strategies are preserved from the first season.
The show explores a diverse cultural world and the journey of the titular character, Arslan.
The series draws similarity to strategy games, making it interesting for fans of the genre.
cons: The second season is only 8 episodes long, leading to a rushed plot and an unsatisfying ending.
Character development is limited, with many characters becoming flat and Arslan remaining static.
The narrative shifts too much, making the story hard to follow and lacking resolution.
Overly equipped party, lack of stakes.
anime.thematic_vibe: War Drama, Political Intrigue, Historical Fantasy

anime.title: Way of Choices
anime.synopsis:
At the beginning of time, a mystical meteor came crashing down from outer space and scattered all over the world. A piece of it landed in the Eastern Continent. 

There were mysterious totems carved upon the meteor, and people gathered around it wanting to discover its usage. They discovered the Way, and established The Tradition.

Several thousand years later, the fourteen years old orphan Chen Chang Shang left his master to cure his illness and change his fate. He brought a piece of marriage vow with him to the capital, thus began the journey of a rising hero.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed but leans positive, appreciating the story's depth and character development while acknowledging flaws in animation and pacing. The adaptation is seen as an improvement over previous versions, although some changes are noted. Overall, viewers find it enjoyable for those interested in fantasy and drama.
pros: Interesting story with a focus on character development.
Well-done character design and backgrounds.
Good OST that evokes classic Chinese fantasy films.
Improved pacing compared to original and live action adaptations.
cons: Slow initial pacing that may deter some viewers.
Animation quality can be lacking, especially in early action scenes.
Adaptational changes might not appeal to all fans of the original work.
The initial season covers only the beginning arcs, leaving much of the story untold.

anime.title: Hybrid x Heart Magias Academy Ataraxia
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Hida Kizuna possesses the HHG (Heart Hybrid Gear) ability, but it is not strong enough to make him particularly important. His older sister calls him to transfer to a strategic defense school, where many of the students (many of which are large-breasted girls) use their HHG abilities to fight invaders from another world while wearing extremely skimpy pilot outfits. Kizuna's fighting ability doesn't measure up, but his sister has another plan—apparently having erotic experiences with Kizuna will allow the girls to replenish their energy or power-up. It looks like his new school life is going to be full of embarrassment.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Masou Gakuen HxH is sharply divided, with a significant portion of viewers finding the anime to be dreadful and gratuitous due to its weak plot and uninspired, albeit explicit, fanservice. However, a niche audience appreciates it as a guilty pleasure or a 'masterpiece' for its dedicated ecchi content and uncensored material, finding enjoyment despite its numerous flaws.
pros: The premise of 'Heart x Hybrid' power-ups based on arousal and danger has a unique, albeit controversial, theoretical grounding.
The MC, Kizuna, is occasionally praised for not being a typical perverted harem protagonist, exhibiting composure and diligence.
Some reviews note that the uncensored version provides explicit content that aligns with what viewers seeking hentai-like experiences might expect.
cons: Animation quality is frequently criticized as stiff, inconsistent, and utilizing dated CGI, with many instances of derpy facial expressions and janky movement.
Characters are overwhelmingly described as shallow, one-dimensional stereotypes, lacking depth, agency, or compelling development.
The plot is generally considered generic, poorly explained, and serves merely as a thin veneer for the extensive, often forced, fanservice and explicit scenes.
The 'ecchi' and 'pornographic' elements are often described as repetitive, uninspired, and gratuitous, lacking genuine seductiveness or creativity.
Designs, particularly the character designs and mecha suits, are often deemed generic or even aesthetically unappealing.

anime.title: Ojisan and Marshmallow
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Habahiro Hige is a simple-minded older man who works an office job and is an enthusiast of Tabekko Marshmallows. His days often consist of being teased by his 24-year-old colleague Iori Wakabayashi, who uses his obsession to her advantage: from eating them in front of his face, to buying out his favorite brand from the convenience store, and even embarrassing him in front of their boss. Although her friends cannot fathom what she sees in him, she just cannot get over his marshmallow-like, fluffy frame. No matter the lengths it takes, Iori will find a way to get his attention.

Little does Habahiro know that she is trying to seduce him into a romantic relationship with her. The way to a man's heart is through his stomach, right? At least this is what Iori would honestly like to believe. With a bag in hand, Iori continues to make him chase after her day after day, hoping that he will finally see through her attempts. Will he ever realize that their relationship can become s'more?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences find 'Ojisan to Marshmallow' to be a sweet and funny short anime, praising its lighthearted humor and charming characters. However, some find the repetitive nature and lack of depth disappointing. The show's brevity is both a strength and a weakness, offering quick enjoyment but limiting substantial development.
pros: Hilarious and heartwarming short episodes.
Charming characters and enjoyable interactions.
Unique premise with relatable and comedic circumstances.
cons: Repetitive jokes and predictable scenarios.
Lack of significant character development.
Unresolved ending and unnecessary love triangle.

anime.title: Grimgar: Ashes and Illusions
anime.synopsis:
Fear, survival, instinct. Thrown into a foreign land with nothing but hazy memories and the knowledge of their name, they can feel only these three emotions resonating deep within their souls. A group of strangers is given no other choice than to accept the only paying job in this game-like world—the role of a soldier in the Reserve Army—and eliminate anything that threatens the peace in their new world, Grimgar.

When all of the stronger candidates join together, those left behind must create a party together to survive: Manato, a charismatic leader and priest; Haruhiro, a nervous thief; Yume, a cheerful hunter; Shihoru, a shy mage; Moguzo, a kind warrior; and Ranta, a rowdy dark knight. Despite its resemblance to one, this is no game—there are no redos or respawns; it is kill or be killed. 

It is now up to this ragtag group of unlikely fighters to survive together in a world where life and death are separated only by a fine line.
anime.consensus_summary: Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash is a character-driven anime that emphasizes realism and survival in a fantasy world. While praised for its character development and unique approach to the genre, its slow pacing and lack of action may deter some viewers. The series elicits strong emotions, with some viewers finding it profound and others finding it dull, indicating a moderate level of polarization.
pros: Exceptional character development and interactions
Unique take on the 'trapped in a fantasy world' genre with a dark and realistic approach
Beautiful art and landscapes that enhance the immersive experience
cons: Slow pacing that may bore some viewers
Initial episodes may feel slow or uneventful
Limited action and focus on character development may not appeal to all audiences

anime.title: Witchy Pretty Cure!
anime.synopsis:
In the human realm, witches and wizards seem to be mere creations of fantasy. Ever the adventurous teenager, Mirai Asahina sets out to disprove this notion by following the tracks of a peculiar shooting star that had fallen the night before. Sure enough, Mirai soon has a chance encounter with Liko—a clumsy witch apprentice who hails from the Magic World, a colorful realm inhabited by magicians.

As if by fate, the appearance of strange villains forces Mirai and Liko to join hands. In doing so, they unleash their strength as a pair of legendary magicians—the "Maho Girls Precure!" Now gifted with unbelievable power, the unlikely duo embarks on an adventure filled with magical spells and powerful gemstones. Along the way, the two girls discover the hidden marvels that tie their individual worlds together.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, appreciating the characters, world-building, and heartwarming themes. However, some find the story inconsistent, particularly the second half, and criticize repetitive elements and occasionally lacking animation quality. There are a few complaints about the shift in the main characters dynamic.
pros: Charming characters with strong relationships.
Creative and unique magical world-building.
Heartwarming themes of friendship and growth.
Visually appealing art style with colorful and detailed designs.
cons: Inconsistent story quality, particularly in the latter half.
Repetitive transformation sequences.
Slow pacing at times.
Lacking in impactful combat and animation quality compared to other seasons.

anime.title: Nurse Witch Komugi R
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, Idols (Female), Mahou Shoujo, Medical, Parody
anime.synopsis:
The new "slapstick" story will depict Komugi-chan and her rivals as they juggle their daily lives as students, idols, and magical girls "with laughter and tears."

Komugi Yoshida is a somewhat clumsy second-year middle-school student whose strong point is her spiritedness. She performs as an idol like Kokona Saionji (her classmate and close friend) and Tsubasa Kisaragi (an idol who dresses in male clothing). However, unlike Kokona whose popularity is skyrocketing and Tsubasa with her charisma in male attire, Komugi's only gigs are low-end ones like those at the local shopping district. Still, Komugi has her "dream" as she lives her dual lives as a idol and a middle school girl.

One day, a mysterious injured creature named Usa-P appears before Komugi. Komugi gives Usa-P medical treatment, and Usa-P, in consideration of Komugi's kindness, asks if she wants to be a Legendary Girl who can use magical powers.

Having become a reluctant Legendary Girl, Komugi battles strange masked figures who suddenly appear! As a newly deemed Magical Nurse, she fights still more waves of masked figures. Meanwhile, a Magical Maid, a Magical Sister, and more also appear to make it a three-way battle!? Can Komugi handle the three roles of middle school girl, idol, and Magical Nurse? And, what lies ahead in these battles and her "dream"...?!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the show's comedic and lighthearted nature as a magical girl parody. However, others find the story weak, the magical girl elements underdeveloped, and the plot unfocused. The show is generally considered fun but inessential, primarily appealing to fans of the magical girl genre who don't mind a lack of seriousness.
pros: Pleasantly straightforward characters with unique personalities.
Excellent voice acting, especially for Komugi.
Great art and sharp animations.
Excellent 3D idol performance scenes.
Entertaining episodes.
cons: Magical girl aspect doesn't go too far; lacks depth.
Magical girl transformation sequences could be better.
Thin story with pointless and unexplained elements.
Komugi feels like a side character in her own show.

anime.title: Big Order (TV)
anime.synopsis:
Ten years ago, a fairy by the name of Daisy appeared and asked the child Eiji Hoshimiya what his one and only wish was. Although his wish remains a mystery, the consequences were catastrophic. In an event called the "Great Destruction," the world started to fall apart as everything collapsed and countless people died.

Now, Eiji is a high school student whose only concern is his sick sister. He does not remember what he wished for; all that he remembers is that his wish caused the Great Destruction. In the years since that event, thousands of other people have also received abilities to make their heart's desire come true. These people called "Orders" are believed to be evil and are hated by the general public. However, some of these Orders are after Eiji's life in vengeance for those that he killed. Will Eiji be able to survive the numerous assassination attempts? And the biggest mystery of all: what did he wish for, and what were his intentions in wishing for something that caused so much desolation?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is highly polarized, with many finding 'Big Order' to be an utter disaster in terms of plot, characters, and production quality. However, a subset of viewers find its sheer absurdity and 'so bad it's good' qualities to be highly entertaining. The show is generally considered a mess, but some appreciate it for its unintentional humor and trainwreck-like nature.
pros: Funky music that creates unintentional humor
So bad it's good due to absurd plot and dialogue
Enjoyable for those seeking a laughably bad experience
cons: Incoherent and nonsensical plot
Poorly developed, unlikable characters
Rushed pacing and weak world-building
Inconsistent story-line
Atrocious animation and use of CGI
Mismatched music choices

anime.title: Wakaba Girl Special
anime.synopsis: Extra episode bundled with the second Blu-ray and DVD volume of Wakaba*Girl.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the special episode for its humor and character interactions. It's a lighthearted and fun addition to the series, with the only drawbacks being the short length and lack of an ending theme. Overall, it's considered a pleasant experience for fans of Wakaba*Girl.
pros: Charming and humorous scenarios.
Good voice acting and returning cast.
cons: No ending theme.
Limited story due to short runtime.

anime.title: Girls Beyond the Wasteland
anime.synopsis:
Shoujo-tachi wa Kouya wo Mezasu is a series all about finding oneself and a direction in life... no matter how far off the beaten path it might be. 

Buntarou Hojo is a high school student who has a talent for writing, but no real direction in life or any plans for the future. His classmate, Sayuki Kuroda notices his talent, decides to help him find a way to use it properly by enlisting him in her bishoujo game development group.

When Buntarou is cornered in the men's bathroom at school by Sayuki, he is surprised when he is asked out on what he thinks is a date, and even further surprised when he finds out that it's not a date, but a job interview. Reluctantly agreeing, the two start recruiting other members for their team but will they learn more about game creation, or life itself along the way?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception to Shoujo-tachi wa Kouya wo Mezasu is mixed to negative. Many found the series uninspired, predictable, and lacking depth in both plot and character development. While some appreciated the focus on game development and relatable characters, the prevailing sentiment is one of disappointment, with comparisons to similar shows like Saekano highlighting its shortcomings.
pros: Some viewers appreciated the focus on the game development process itself.
A few reviewers found the characters relatable, despite their archetypes.
The opening and ending themes were considered a highlight by some.
cons: Many reviewers found the plot predictable, clichéd, and lacking in tension.
Characters were often described as one-dimensional, archetypal, and underdeveloped.
The show's attempts at comedy were considered unfunny and the drama forced and repetitive.
Several reviews criticized the animation quality, citing inconsistencies and a lack of detail.

anime.title: Seraph of the Endless: Battle in Nagoya
anime.synopsis: Specials included in the Blu-ray and DVD releases.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience seems to appreciate the comedic relief provided by these specials, finding them a fun and enjoyable addition that breaks up the darkness of the main series. While the shorts themselves are noted as being somewhat cheaply produced and not groundbreaking in their humor, they successfully leverage the established quality of the main anime's visuals and voice acting to deliver a light-hearted experience.
pros: The comedic shorts provide a refreshing light-hearted contrast to the dark and gritty main series.
The visual quality of the original Battle in Nagoya is high, which carries over to the shorts.
Features performances from talented and enjoyable voice actors.
cons: The shorts are cheaply made and reuse animation shots from the main series.
The comedic gags are considered just 'good enough' and not particularly memorable.

anime.title: Full Metal Panic! Invisible Victory
anime.synopsis:
The boisterous student Kaname Chidori and soldier Sousuke Sagara are enjoying a blissful high school life. However, their peaceful days are disrupted by the threatening terrorist organization Amalgam. Leonard Testarossa, a member of the organization who possesses "Whispered," seeks to procure Kaname and her knowledge. 

Kaname and Sousuke's battle against Amalgam starts right in their own neighborhood, which eventually takes them on a hunt around the world. From the exotic lands of Laos to the barren Mexican coast, Sousuke must gather intelligence to bring down Amalgam. Meanwhile, Kaname's abilities grow, but so does her frustration as her resolve withers. Caught up in an intense game of hide and seek, as well as strategic plots, the pair try to connect and push beyond their own limits.
anime.consensus_summary: Full Metal Panic! Invisible Victory received a mixed reception. While long-time fans appreciated the continuation of the story and darker tone faithful to the light novels, many were disappointed by the perceived decline in production quality, pacing issues, and the shift away from the series' comedic elements. The season's serious tone, a stark contrast to the humor of previous installments, divided the audience.
pros: Nostalgia factor is strong for long-time fans.
Direct continuation of Second Raid without excessive recaps.
Action sequences and darker tone align with later light novel content.
cons: Significant shift in tone from comedic to serious alienated some viewers.
Production quality (art, animation, CGI) was often criticized.
Pacing issues and uninspired plot developments were noted.
Many familiar characters were absent for extended periods.

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable
anime.romaji_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 4: Diamond wa Kudakenai
anime.synopsis:
The year is 1999. Morioh, a normally quiet and peaceful town, has recently become a hotbed of strange activity. Joutarou Kuujou, now a marine biologist, heads to the mysterious town to meet Jousuke Higashikata. While the two may seem like strangers at first, Jousuke is actually the illegitimate child of Joutarou's grandfather, Joseph Joestar. When they meet, Joutarou realizes that he may have more in common with Jousuke than just a blood relation.

Along with the mild-mannered Kouichi Hirose and the boisterous Okuyasu Nijimura, the group dedicates themselves to investigating recent disappearances and other suspicious occurrences within Morioh. Aided by the power of Stands, the four men will encounter danger at every street corner, as it is up to them to unravel the town's secrets, before another occurs.
anime.consensus_summary: Diamond is Unbreakable is a beloved part of the JoJo franchise, praised for its unique blend of bizarre adventures, slice-of-life elements, and well-developed characters. While it has some pacing and consistency issues, the overall experience is considered highly enjoyable and addictive by many fans. Some find the change of pace jarring compared to earlier, grander arcs.
pros: Unique and inventive Stands and battles
Well-developed and likeable characters
Engaging blend of action and slice-of-life elements
Strong art style and animation (in some episodes)
Memorable humor and references
cons: Slow start with early episodes
Inconsistent animation quality
Story loses focus at times
Some characters feel underdeveloped or irrelevant after initial arcs
Villains can be unmemorable

anime.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
anime.romaji_title: Kono Bijutsu-bu ni wa Mondai ga Aru!
anime.genres: Comedy, Romance, School, Seinen, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis:
Mizuki Usami is a passionate member of her school's art club, but the club has a problem—Usami is the only member who takes her craft seriously! The lazy club president constantly sleeps through activities and Collette has not regularly attended club activities in quite some time. Subaru Uchimaki, despite being an exceptional artist who could win an award if he tried, is obsessed with drawing the perfect 2D wife.

As Usami struggles to do art club-like activities, she is often obstructed by her motley crew of good-for-nothings and her distracting crush on Subaru.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Kono Bijutsu-bu ni wa Mondai ga Aru! for its lighthearted comedy and relatable characters, particularly the endearing Usami. The show's fresh take on the rom-com genre and visually appealing art style are also well-received. However, some find the lack of plot progression and repetitive jokes to be a drawback, and wish for more development of the side characters. Overall, it is considered a pleasant and enjoyable watch for those seeking a relaxing and humorous anime.
pros: Charming and relatable characters, particularly Usami and her unrequited crush.
Unique and refreshing comedic style that doesn't rely on typical tropes.
Vibrant and visually appealing art style with well-executed animation.
cons: Lack of significant plot progression or character development.
Repetitive comedic gags that can become stale over time.
Underdeveloped side characters.

anime.title: New Game!
anime.genres: Adult Cast, CGDCT, Comedy, Otaku Culture
anime.synopsis:
Since childhood, Aoba Suzukaze has loved the Fairies Story game series, particularly the character designs. So when she graduates from high school, it is no surprise that she applies to work at Eagle Jump, the company responsible for making her favorite video game. On her first day, she is excited to learn that she will be working on a new installment to the series: Fairies Story 3—and even more so under Kou Yagami, the lead character designer.

In their department are people who share the same passion for games. There is Yun Iijima, whose specialty is designing monsters; the shy Hifumi Takimoto, who prefers to communicate through instant messaging; Hajime Shinoda, an animation team member with an impressive figurine collection; Rin Tooyama, the orderly art director; Shizuku Hazuki, the game director who brings her cat to work; and Umiko Ahagon, the short-tempered head programmer.

New Game! follows Aoba and the others on their adventure through the ups and downs of game making, from making the perfect character design to fixing all the errors that will inevitably accumulate in the process.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys New Game! as a cute and heartwarming slice-of-life anime set in a unique game development environment. Viewers appreciate the relatable characters and the joyful atmosphere, finding it refreshing compared to typical school-based moe shows. However, some critique the lack of depth in the story, the unrealistic depiction of the workplace, and the detours from the main plot.
pros: Heartwarming and joyful to watch, providing a cure after a long day.
Refreshing environment of a game development studio instead of the usual school setting.
Relatable characters and emotions despite not experiencing the situations firsthand.
cons: Story lacks depth and focuses too much on daily life outside of work.
Unrealistic work environment with no office politics and overly pleasant interactions.
Plot detoured by unnecessary subplots, hindering consistent storytelling.

anime.title: My Hero Academia
anime.synopsis:
The appearance of "quirks," newly discovered super powers, has been steadily increasing over the years, with 80 percent of humanity possessing various abilities from manipulation of elements to shapeshifting. This leaves the remainder of the world completely powerless, and Izuku Midoriya is one such individual.

Since he was a child, the ambitious middle schooler has wanted nothing more than to be a hero. Izuku's unfair fate leaves him admiring heroes and taking notes on them whenever he can. But it seems that his persistence has borne some fruit: Izuku meets the number one hero and his personal idol, All Might. All Might's quirk is a unique ability that can be inherited, and he has chosen Izuku to be his successor!

Enduring many months of grueling training, Izuku enrolls in UA High, a prestigious high school famous for its excellent hero training program, and this year's freshmen look especially promising. With his bizarre but talented classmates and the looming threat of a villainous organization, Izuku will soon learn what it really means to be a hero.
anime.consensus_summary: Boku no Hero Academia is a hyped shounen anime that many viewers find enjoyable and uplifting, praising its animation, characters and unique quirks. However, some find the story generic and overrated, with cliches and a childish tone, and incomplete due to the limited episode count. Opinions are divided, with some viewers strongly disliking the show while others enjoy it as a classic shounen.
pros: Unique and interesting character quirks.
Great art and animation quality.
Uplifting and endearing story of a young boy pursuing his dreams.
cons: Story is considered generic and cliche by some.
Overrated and childish to some viewers.
Incomplete story due to limited episode count in the first season.
Characters are considered to be copy-pasted from other shounen

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Thunderbolt
anime.genres: Drama, Mecha, Military, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Space
anime.synopsis:
In Universal Century 0079, forces of the Earth Federation and Principality of Zeon engage in a battle within the Thunderbolt Sector during the One Year War. This section of space—known for its constant strikes of electricity—proves to be a deadly battlefield, as Federation pilot Io Fleming leads a charge against Zeon's ace Daryl Lorenz and his squad of snipers. With the fighters on both sides proving to be formidable soldiers, neither side is willing to back down, fighting strategically amongst the remnants of colonies.

But when Io gets a hold of a prototype Gundam, Daryl will have to make a sacrifice in order to obtain enough power to crush his enemy and ensure that Zeon is victorious, or watch as his comrades are slaughtered by a single man.
anime.consensus_summary: Gundam Thunderbolt is praised for its visual spectacle and gritty depiction of war, offering a more intimate and emotional experience compared to other Gundam series. However, some find the characters underdeveloped, the narrative simplistic, and the prevalent use of jazz music overwhelming. Despite these criticisms, the series is generally well-received for its action and focus on the personal struggles of soldiers on both sides of the conflict.
pros: Visually stunning mecha battles with excellent animation.
Compelling portrayal of the horrors and brutality of war.
Strong focus on the personal conflict between the two main pilots.
Excellent sound design, particularly the use of jazz music.
cons: Characters can lack depth and development.
Narrative may be too simplistic, lacking deeper themes.
Jazz soundtrack can be overbearing and dictate emotions.
Story expects familiarity with the UC timeline.

anime.title: My Wife is the Student Council President OVA
anime.romaji_title: Okusama ga Seitokaichou! Seitokaichou to Ofuro Asobi
anime.synopsis: The student council president, Ui Wakana, organizes a campaign encouraging the act of holding hands. While Ui hangs up posters, her husband and vice president, Hayato Izumi, injures his hand when he tries to save her from falling. Feeling guilty and wanting to make up for the incident, Ui assists Izumi with bathing—even when he insists that he does not need help.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment for this OVA is split, primarily along the lines of whether one appreciates its direct and unashamed focus on ecchi content. Viewers who are fans of the genre find it competent and enjoyable, while those seeking plot or character development are left disappointed. The production quality, particularly animation, is generally praised as suitable for its aims.
pros: Art and sound quality are good and meet expectations for the genre.
The animation is competent and enhances the ecchi scenes.
The OVA successfully delivers on its promise of ecchi and fanservice.
The narrative, while simple, is straightforward and fits the genre's aims.
cons: The story is extremely shallow and lacks development, serving primarily as a vehicle for fanservice.
The protagonist is perceived as a 'bad guy' by some viewers.
The OVA offers little to no plot progression or new narrative elements for fans of the main series.

anime.title: Sound! Euphonium 2
anime.synopsis:
Following their success in the qualifying round for the Kansai regional competition, the members of the Kitauji High School concert band set their sights on the next upcoming performance. Utilizing their summer break to the utmost, the band participates in a camp where they are instructed by their band advisor Noboru Taki and his friends who make their living as professional musicians.

Kumiko Oumae and her friends remain determined to attain gold at the Kansai competition, but trouble arises when a student who once quit the band shows interest in rejoining and sparks unpleasant memories for the second-year members. Kumiko also learns about her teacher's surprising past and the motivation behind his desire to lead the band to victory. Reaching nationals will require hard work, and the adamant conviction in each student's commitment to the band will be put to the test.
anime.consensus_summary: Hibike! Euphonium 2 is praised for its strong character development and beautiful animation, continuing the story of the Kitauji High School concert band as they strive for Nationals. However, some viewers were critical of the drama and the handling of romantic relationships, which they felt detracted from the overall experience. While the series is appreciated for its realistic portrayal of school band life, opinions are divided on whether it lives up to the high standards set by the first season.
pros: Excellent character development, especially for previously underdeveloped characters.
High-quality animation and attention to detail by Kyoto Animation.
Realistic portrayal of the challenges and rewards of being in a school band.
Exploration of complex themes like competition, commitment, and personal growth.
cons: Some viewers found the drama to be excessive or contrived.
The handling of romantic relationships, particularly the 'yuri bait', was divisive and seen as cringeworthy by some.
The second season did not surpass the first in terms of overall quality for some viewers.
Focus on character development overshadowed band performances for some.

anime.title: Sound! Euphonium the Movie: Welcome to the Kitauji High School Concert Band
anime.romaji_title: Hibike! Euphonium Movie 1: Kitauji Koukou Suisougaku-bu e Youkoso
anime.synopsis:
After swearing off music due to an incident at the middle school regional concert band competition, euphonist Kumiko Oumae enters high school hoping for a fresh start. As fate would have it, she ends up being surrounded by people with an interest in the high school brass band. Kumiko finds the motivation she needs to make music once more with the help of her bandmates, some of whom are new like novice tubist Hazuki Katou; veteran contrabassist Sapphire Kawashima; and band vice president and fellow euphonist Asuka Tanaka. Others are old friends, like Kumiko's childhood friend and hornist-turned-trombonist Shuuichi Tsukamoto, and trumpeter and bandmate from middle school, Reina Kousaka.

However, in the band itself, chaos reigns supreme. Despite their intention to qualify for the national band competition, as they currently are, just competing in the local festival will be a challenge—unless the new band advisor Noboru Taki does something about it.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is largely seen as a recap of the first season, making it a useful refresher for those preparing to watch season 2. However, it's not recommended for new viewers as it misses key details. Fans of the first season appreciate the visuals and character portrayals, but some are disappointed by the lack of new content and specific character focus.
pros: Good refresher before season 2
Enjoyable characters, especially Taki-sensei
Faithful recap of season 1 plot points
Stunning animation/visuals
cons: Mostly recap, very little new content
Skips many details from season 1, not good for newcomers
Lack of Asuka is frustrating for some fans

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai 3
anime.synopsis:
A young boy silently sketches out the forms of the horrors that dwell in his mind. During this adventure into the occult and mysterious, he tells tales that involve dreams of a person with a muscular arm that you must not look at, a hospital with a room that holds a grim secret, and a visit to an eerily silent taxidermy museum.

These tales and more are compiled in Yami Shibai 3. Presented in an art style similar to kamishibai storytelling, this horror series stays true to the gruesome and creepy trend that is prominent in Yami Shibai and Yami Shibai 2nd Season.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Yami Shibai 3 is mixed, with many feeling it doesn't live up to the standards set by the first season. While the improved art and sound are appreciated, the stories themselves are often considered weak, bland, and not particularly scary. However, the final episode is frequently praised for its surprising twist and ability to improve the overall impression of the season.
pros: Improved art style compared to previous seasons (more polished, aesthetically pleasing)
Effective sound design and music contribute to the creepy atmosphere
Final episode provides a satisfying conclusion and recontextualizes earlier episodes
Ending theme is catchy and unsettling
cons: Stories are generally weaker and less scary than in previous seasons
Characters are often bland and underdeveloped
Some monster designs are considered goofy rather than frightening
Narrator from previous seasons is missed
Over-reliance on body horror is less effective than psychological horror for some viewers
anime.thematic_vibe: Body Horror, Japanese Folklore, Psychological Thriller

anime.title: Hetalia: The World Twinkle Extra Disc
anime.romaji_title: Hetalia: The World Twinkle Extra Disc
anime.synopsis: It's Halloween, and America decides to invite all the other countries to his party. Since there is a costume contest, the countries show up in a wide array of outfits, although it quickly becomes clear that some among them may have taken the competition a bit too seriously. But soon, the guests begin to wonder why America hasn't shown off his own costume. What could be the reason?
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is criticized for prioritizing fan service over a faithful adaptation of the source material, resulting in a simplified plot and diminished roles for beloved characters like Prussia and Canada. The changes disappointed viewers who valued the original manga's story and character interactions. The focus on superficial elements detracted from the narrative quality.
cons: Omission of key scenes and dialogues from the original manga.
Character degradation, specifically Prussia and Canada.
Focus on fan service over plot accuracy.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 20: The Darkest Nightmare
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 20: Junkoku no Nightmare
anime.synopsis:
On a dark night, the Japanese police is raided by a spy. Different countries' intelligence agencies—such as England's MI6, Germany's BND, and America's CIA—as well as the FBI's secret files are going to be taken, but public safety officers lead by Tooru Amuro arrive just in time. The spy steals a car and escapes. The spy and Amuro are then locked in a dead heat on the highway, and just as it is about to cause an accident with multiple cars, the spy's car is hit by FBI agent Shuichi Akai's rifle bullet and falls of the roadway.
The next day, Conan and his friends go to a newly-remodeled aquarium in Tokyo. Under the main attraction, a Ferris wheel, Conan finds an attractive woman alone and injured. Her left and right eyes are different colors.

But the woman is in a state of amnesia where she doesn't even remember her own name, and the cellphone she's carrying is broken. Conan and his friends promise to help her regain her memory, so they stay with her.

Throughout all this, Vermouth is watching behind the scenes. Afterwards, she pulls out a silencer and speaks into an attached intercom, "It's as planned, Gin."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are divided. Some viewers enjoyed the action, new characters, and Black Organization focus, deeming it a great anniversary movie. However, others criticized the lack of mystery, illogical plot points, and character issues, considering it one of the worst in the franchise, leading to significant polarization among fans.
pros: Exciting action sequences and animation, especially the opening car chase.
Enjoyable focus on the Black Organization with new character introduction.
Soundtrack and voice acting praised for being unique and amazing.
cons: Lack of mystery elements typical of Detective Conan.
Ridiculous and illogical scenes, undermining the seriousness of the plot.
Character interactions feel artificial and contrived.
The story feels predictable and cliche.

anime.title: Please tell me! Galko-chan
anime.synopsis:
At first glance, Galko, Otako, and Ojou are three high school girls who seem like they wouldn’t have anything to do with each other. Galko is a social butterfly with a reputation for being a party animal, even though she is actually innocent and good-hearted despite her appearance. Otako is a plain-looking girl with a sarcastic personality and a rabid love of manga. And Ojou is a wealthy young lady with excellent social graces, though she can be a bit absent-minded at times. Despite their differences, the three are best friends, and together they love to talk about various myths and ask candid questions about the female body.
 
Oshiete! Galko-chan is a lighthearted and humorous look at three very different girls and their frank conversations about themselves and everyday life. No topic is too safe or too sensitive for them to joke about—even though every so often, Galko seems to get a bit embarrassed by their discussions!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Oshiete! Galko-chan" is well-received as a lighthearted and humorous slice-of-life anime that addresses relatable topics with surprising depth. While some viewers may find the lack of a strong plot and the focus on fan service to be drawbacks, the show's strengths lie in its engaging characters and witty dialogue. Many consider it a hidden gem worth watching for its refreshing take on high school life and frank discussions.
pros: The characters are well-developed and defy stereotypes, feeling like real people with unique quirks and backgrounds.
The show features frank and honest discussions about sensitive topics, addressing them with humor and sincerity.
The short episode length makes it easy to watch and keeps the content engaging without becoming boring.
The art style is fresh, colorful, and eye-catching.
cons: The anime has no overarching plot or story, focusing instead on episodic daily life events.
Some find the fan service excessive and unnecessary, detracting from the overall experience.
The soundtrack is unremarkable and lacks memorable music.
The short episode duration limits character development and exploration of deeper themes.

anime.title: Ajin OVA
anime.synopsis: New episodes bundled with the limited edition eighth and ninth manga volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The Ajin OVA series provides additional content for fans of the series, with some episodes being more compelling than others. The first and third episodes are generally well-received for their tragic and backstory elements, while the second episode is considered weaker and less serious. Overall, the OVAs are seen as an OK watch, but not essential viewing.
pros: Stronger characterization due to shorter runtime
Enjoyable comedic scenarios with serious characters
Interesting backstory of Satou
cons: Animation is sub-par
Some content is repetitive for manga readers
Second episode is worse than the first one
Unconvincing portrayal of Tanaka in the second episode

anime.title: BBK/BRNK
anime.synopsis:
Away from home for 10 years, Azuma Kazuki had no idea what was awaiting him upon his return. He certainly did not expect to be attacked by dozens of heavily armed people and taken as their prisoner. Fortunately, Azuma's stay in captivity is short. Wielding a strange sentient weapon—known as "Bubuki"—upon her right arm, his childhood friend, Kogane Asabuki, rescues him.

After escaping, Azuma learns that he too has the power to control Bubuki. Together with his new companions, he must revive the Buranki titan named Oubu, that sleeps somewhere deep underground. With this knowledge and purpose, a new path to unearth the truths behind the Buranki opens before Azuma.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Bubuki Buranki are mixed. While some appreciate the unique animation and action, many are critical of the confusing plot and underdeveloped characters. The show is seen as having potential but falls short in execution, leading to a somewhat divisive reception.
pros: Unique CGI animation style that is visually appealing and allows for creative action scenes.
Enjoyable action sequences and mech fights.
Interesting and stylized character designs.
cons: Confusing and unfinished plot with pacing issues.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of emotional depth.
Over-reliance on action at the expense of story and character development.

anime.title: KADO: The Right Answer
anime.synopsis:
Cool-headed and rational, Koujirou Shindou is a government official and master negotiator with a well-earned reputation. While departing on a business trip, a giant cube materializes and his plane is taken undamaged into the mysterious, indestructible structure.

As Japanese authorities attempt to identify the cube's properties and origins, Shindou encounters an otherworldly entity known as Yaha-kui zaShunina, who materializes in the form of a human man. He assures Shindou that the passengers are not in any danger and requests help in negotiations with the human world.

Hailing from a higher dimensional universe known as Novo, Yaha-kui zaShunina is able to transfer information between Novo and Shindou's universe through a cube called Kado. Despite having these unfathomable abilities, he does not appear hostile. Instead, he announces that he has come to this world with only one intention: to "advance" humanity—starting with Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: Initial intrigue and strong premise were betrayed by a disappointing second half and ending. Many viewers felt the show devolved into a generic romance/drama, squandering its potential for mature sci-fi exploration. While some praised the art, music, and realistic depiction of diplomatic interactions, the overwhelming sentiment is one of disappointment and unrealized potential.
pros: Intriguing premise with exploration of complex topics like ethics and technological advancement.
Realistic portrayal of humanity's response to first contact.
High-quality art and music, particularly the blend of 2D/3D animation and the score's enhancement of key moments.
cons: Poor ending that betrays the initial setup with forced romance and deux ex machina.
Unexplored potential of its premise, only scratching the surface of the effects of new technologies on humanity.
Inconsistent character development with 1-dimensional characters and nonsensical dynamics.

anime.title: Show By Rock!! 2
anime.synopsis:
Metropolis of music, MIDICITY. A kitty girl wearing gothic lolita clothing named Cyan is scouted by Maple Arisugawa, the president of a music agency. From there, she meets Chuchu (a pun off of the sound that rabbits make) the honor student rabbit girl, a net geek dog girl named Retoree (from "Retriever"), and an alien sheep (?) girl named Moa. Together, they form the band named "Plasmagica," and aim for the top of the world.

However, the path there is long and tough, and keeping in high spirits is important. By battling against other strange bands, Plasmagica slowly grows toward a top-grade band. In the end, they'll be a band that becomes the driving force of MIDICITY's music industry... Maybe?

Gonna be a music millionaire!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the improvements made compared to the first season, particularly regarding character development and backstories. However, others found the plot disjointed and predictable, leading to disappointment. The season seemingly suffers from common sequel issues.
pros: Improved on the first season
Nice backstories
cons: Plot all over the place
Story is disappointing compared to the first season
Predictable finale

anime.title: One Piece: Adventure of Nebulandia
anime.synopsis: This special will have the Straw Hats fight Foxy again in the New World on Nebulandia, an island that nullifies Devil Fruit powers.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is split, with some praising the special for Foxy's improved characterization and the introduction of a strong new villain. However, significant criticism exists regarding plot inconsistencies, particularly concerning Devil Fruit power rules, and a deviation from the advertised premise, leading to disappointment for many.
pros: Foxy's redemption and improved characterization as a dependable ally.
Introduction of a compelling new antagonist, Komei, with a clear motive and unique utilization.
Signature One Piece comedy and satisfying final fight.
Some viewers found the plot twist intriguing and the reunion of the Straw Hat and Foxy pirates enjoyable.
Good visual production quality, better than average weekly releases.
cons: Significant inconsistencies in the depiction of Devil Fruit user weaknesses, particularly regarding seawater and fog.
The story deviated from the synopsis, failing to deliver a rematch between Luffy and Foxy or focus on an island that nullifies Devil Fruit powers.
The plot felt predictable and uninspired, with some characters acting out of character (e.g., Zoro and Sanji rendered helpless).
Animation was described as stiff and lacking fluidity.
The special felt like filler, lacking the creative and interesting art style variation often seen in One Piece films.

anime.title: Kimi no Sumu Machi
anime.synopsis: Original short animation that aired as part of promotion for the event "Bunkyo+Waseda Bungo Week". The video aims to convey the appeal of Bunkyo and Waseda area in Tokyo.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find the animation adorable, charming, and relaxing, praising the art style, music, and voice acting. The short length and simple story are seen as strengths, making it a delightful and easily accessible experience.
pros: Well-made details in art
Good choice of music
Adorable story despite short length
Detailed background art
Amazing voice acting (CVs)
cons: Lack of English subtitles

anime.title: Gantz:O
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, High Stakes Game, Horror, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Death does not have to be the end; one can live again, but only through beating the game posed by the black ball called Gantz.
 
On his way home to celebrate his younger brother's birthday, brave and kind-hearted student named Masaru Katou is stabbed to death. He awakes in a small room with a cityscape view in the heart of Tokyo—and he is not alone. To his surprise, it is not the afterlife, but the waiting room for a high stakes game with their lives on the line. Before he has the chance to process the situation, Masaru is handed a gun and teleported into the center of Osaka to carry out one simple task: eliminate any alien on sight.
 
Accompanied by the aged Yoshikazu Suzuki, the stunning idol Reika Shimohira, and the cold but experienced Jouichirou Nishi, Masaru must overcome his fears in order to survive the game and return home to his waiting brother.
anime.consensus_summary: Gantz:O is a visually impressive and action-packed CGI movie that adapts the Osaka Arc of the manga. While the visuals and fight scenes are praised, the story can be confusing for newcomers, and changes from the manga may disappoint fans. Some viewers found the characters lacking depth and the plot unremarkable.
pros: Visually stunning CGI and animation.
Exciting and well-choreographed fight sequences.
Faithful adaptation of the Osaka Arc (to a certain extent).
Good entry point for newcomers to the Gantz franchise.
cons: Story can be confusing for those unfamiliar with Gantz.
Changes from the original manga may disappoint some fans.
Characters lack depth and can be forgettable.
Plot takes a backseat to action, making it unremarkable.
Generic and predictable tropes.

anime.title: Luck & Logic
anime.synopsis:
"Logic" is the concept that governs emotions, abilities, ideals, memories, and all other abstract properties that make up life in various worlds. With its power, however, alien "Foreigners" are able to pass through portals imbued with their respective world's Logic and pose a threat to other worlds. To counter this problem, the Another Logic Counter Agency (ALCA) from the human world of Septpia employs "Logicalists," people with the power to form bonds with the Foreigners who seek peace and share their Logic, tasked with dealing with all possible dangers.

After overloading his powers two years prior, Yoshichika Tsurugi has lost the ability to use Logic in combat, making him no different from a regular citizen. However, his life soon returns to the battlefield when he meets Athena, a Foreigner goddess from the world of Tetra-Heaven. She brings Yoshichika his missing Logic Card, allowing him to become a Logicalist once again. Soon after, Yoshichika forms a contract with Athena and joins ALCA. There, he meets other Logicalists, and only by working with them can he hope to bring an end to the threats once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Luck & Logic" is viewed as an uninspired and generic anime, primarily seen as a vehicle to promote a card game. While some appreciate the animation and music, the prevailing sentiment is negative due to the clichéd story, underdeveloped characters, and poor execution.  Most agree it is a mediocre show, not terrible but not worth recommending when many better anime exist.
pros: Decent animation and character designs in 2D scenes.
Soundtrack and OP/ED themes are generally well-received and fitting.
Some found the simple, easy-to-follow plot enjoyable as a quick anime fix.
cons: Story is heavily cliched with poor execution and lacks explanation of key concepts.
Characters are generic, one-dimensional, and underdeveloped, particularly the protagonist.
Heavy use of 3D animation in action scenes is jarring and inconsistent.
Plot is predictable and repetitive ('monster of the week' format).
World-building is lacking; the relationships between humans and gods are not explored sufficiently.

anime.title: Watashitachi, Luck Logic-bu!
anime.synopsis: The comedy shorts follow four girls who are members of the Luck Logic Club, whose activity is playing the Luck & Logic card game. Watashitachi, Luck Logic-bu! will air approximately one minute before each episode of the main series.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that "Watashitachi, Luck Logic-bu!" is a very short and ultimately unfulfilling anime. It serves as a brief complement to the main series, but its lack of substance and reliance on cheap gags make it skippable for most viewers. Only dedicated fans of the card game or those particularly drawn to Ado's voice acting may find some enjoyment.
pros: Ado's unique voice acting is a highlight for some viewers.
It's a complement to the main Luck & Logic anime.
cons: Extremely short episodes lack substance.
Relies on quick gags for cheap laughs.
Boring and skippable for most viewers not deeply invested in the card game.
anime.thematic_vibe: Card Games, Slice of Life, Comedy

anime.title: Blame!: The Movie
anime.genres: Drama, Mecha, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
A young girl named Zuru sets out on an expedition through a post-apocalyptic city controlled by machines in a desperate hunt for food. Things go awry when her team accidently triggers the city's AI defense program called the Safeguard. Attacked by the machines, her companions are on the verge of being annihilated when a mysterious man named Killy arrives and exterminates the hostile units.

Despite his heroic intervention, Zuru is hesitant to trust Killy and questions his motives. He reveals to have come from thousands of levels below the city in order to find humans possessing the Net Terminal Genes—a trait that would allow humans to regain control of their civilization and shut down the Safeguard. After hearing his story, Zuru and the rest of her team join Killy and embark on a journey in search of the Genes that could prove to be mankind's last hope of survival.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the film as a visually impressive introduction to the Blame! universe, praising its atmosphere and sound. However, many criticize its rushed story, underdeveloped characters, and deviations from the manga, finding it a disappointing adaptation that lacks the depth and complexity of the original work.
pros: Spectacular visuals and sound design, fitting the Blame! universe.
Good starting point for newcomers, introducing key themes and characters.
Captures the feeling of isolation and danger present in the manga's world.
Background art is excellent, resembling colored manga panels.
cons: Story feels rushed, characters lack development, and plot ends too soon.
Characters can be underwhelming and inexpressive.
Doesn't fully explain the concepts of the world or delve into its complexities.
Killy is reduced to an uninspired robot, lacking his manga counterpart's depth.
Significant changes from the manga dilute the original's unique tone.

anime.title: Tanaka-kun is Always Listless
anime.synopsis: For high school student Tanaka, the act of being listless is a way of life. Known for his inattentiveness and ability to fall asleep anywhere, Tanaka prays that each day will be as uneventful as the last, seeking to preserve his lazy lifestyle however he can by avoiding situations that require him to exert himself. Along with his dependable friend Oota who helps him with tasks he is unable to accomplish, the lethargic teenager constantly deals with events that prevent him from experiencing the quiet and peaceful days he longs for.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Tanaka-kun wa Itsumo Kedaruge for its relaxing atmosphere, unique characters, and comedic timing. While some find the lack of plot and repetitive nature to be a drawback, the series is mostly appreciated as a calming and relatable slice-of-life anime. Its focus on character interactions and lighthearted humor makes it a pleasant watch for those seeking a low-stakes and entertaining experience.
pros: Relaxing and calming atmosphere
Unique and likeable characters with great interactions
Good use of comedic timing and situational humor
Soothing art style and fitting music
Relatable theme of listlessness
cons: Lack of a strong central plot or overarching story
Repetitive episodic nature can become boring
Some find the humor predictable or dull
Reliance on slice-of-life clichés
Limited character development

anime.title: Reikenzan: Hoshikuzu-tachi no Utage
anime.synopsis:
Long ago in the nine provinces of Kyushu, a calamitous event was prophesied to take place: falling comets would exhaust the spiritual energies of both the heavens and the lands and thus bring about an age of chaos upon the world. But contrary to the prophecy, the comets passed by with no calamity taking place. At the same time, as if touched by the phenomenon, a boy was born in a remote village of the Sokei region by the name of Ouriku.

Twelve years later, as the memories of the event have faded from people's minds, the Reikenzan clan—one of the five supreme sects of the nine provinces—decides to hold an examination in order to gather the most talented individuals fit to become disciples and eventually sages. Hearing about this news, Ouriku and his servant Ouchou head toward the site, unaware that the organizer Oubu, despite her elegant appearance, is infamous for being extremely irresponsible and carefree; hence, making the trials in the examination unpredictable.

Reikenzan: Hoshikuzu-tachi no Utage follows the story of Ouriku as he journeys through these trials to become a powerful sage.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some enjoying the comedic and xianxia elements while others find the story lacking in depth and character development. Many feel the anime suffers from pacing issues and a reliance on tired tropes. It appeals more to those familiar with Chinese cultivation themes, but may disappoint those seeking a well-developed plot and consistent characters.
pros: Enjoyable comedic elements and lighthearted tone.
Story is heavily focused on tactics and planning.
Faithful to Chinese Taoist cultivation themes and wuxia plotlines.
cons: Inconsistent character development and flat personalities.
Story lacks direction, conflict, and resolution, with underdeveloped parts and random plot elements.
Rushed plot progression, time skips, and unexplained elements.

anime.title: Twin Star Exorcists
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Mythology, Romance, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Magano, a parallel realm filled with monsters known as "Kegare," is a place where exorcists deal with all impurities. Benio Adashino is a prodigy exorcist who is recognized for her strength and is summoned to Tokyo by the Exorcist Union. On her way, she plummets into the arms of Rokuro Enmadou, a young exorcist with a troubled past.

But the impurities of Magano do not rest. When these two exorcists witness a couple of children stolen by a Kegare, Benio rushes to save them, dragging Rokuro along with her into Magano. Engaged in a fight she is on the verge of being defeated in, Benio is saved by Rokuro, revealing himself capable of being her rival in talent.

Sousei no Onmyouji tells the story of two talented exorcists who are destined to become the "Twin Star Exorcists" and the prophesised parents of the Miko—the reincarnation of Abe no Seimei—who will cleanse the world of all impurities.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Sousei no Onmyouji are divided. Some viewers enjoyed the character development and emotional aspects, while others criticized the deviation from the manga, inconsistent pacing, and animation quality. The anime has a mix of positive and negative feedback, resulting in a somewhat controversial reception.
pros: Character growth and development, particularly the main characters' relationship from rivals to lovers, is heartwarming.
The world-building of Magano is visually striking with eerie landscapes.
Some found the anime emotionally resonant, with tears shed during viewing.
cons: The story deviates from the manga, leading to plot inconsistencies and filler.
Pacing is often slow with boring episodes, and some plot twists are random and poorly executed.
Animation quality can be inconsistent, especially during fight scenes.

anime.title: Digimon Adventure tri. Determination
anime.synopsis:
Infected Digimon—digital monsters who have begun acting in a berserk manner and experiencing a bizarre increase in power—are invading the real world. While Maki Himekawa and Daigo Nishijima, agents of the mysterious Incorporated Administrative Agency, attempt to learn more about these disruptive appearances, most of the Chosen Children are busy preparing for Tsukishima General High School's summer festival.

Mimi Tachikawa, having recently returned to Japan after living in the United States for years, struggles to find her footing among her classmates and fellow Chosen Children. Meanwhile, by throwing himself into his studies, Jou Kido has been deliberately avoiding all issues related to Digimon, causing his partner Gomamon to run away. Mimi and Jou's individual actions cause friction within the group even as the threat of infected Digimon still looms over them. Will the two resolve their personal conflicts in time to help their friends fight off the latest threat?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the focus on character development and mature themes, considering it a natural evolution of the series. Others find the slow pacing and lack of action disappointing, wishing for a stronger plot and more exciting Digimon battles. Nostalgia plays a significant role, but some feel the execution falls short of expectations.
pros: Strong character development, particularly for Joe and Mimi.
Addresses mature themes and realistic issues faced by teenagers.
Nostalgia factor and callbacks to the original series are appreciated by fans.
cons: Slow pacing and slice-of-life focus may disappoint viewers seeking action and adventure.
The main plot progresses slowly with little significant development for a good portion of the movie.
Some feel the animation style is not an improvement over the original series.
Sound mixing issues (volume inconsistencies).

anime.title: Gintama°: Umai-mono wa Atomawashi ni Suru to Yokodorisareru kara Yappari Saki ni Kue
anime.romaji_title: Gintama°: Umai-mono wa Atomawashi ni Suru to Yokodorisareru kara Yappari Saki ni Kue
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Shounen
anime.synopsis: After overcoming monumental obstacles in their previous adventures, Gintoki Sakata, Shinpachi Shimura, and Kagura gather at the Yorozuya office to discuss important matters. The trio, accompanied by their hilarious and eccentric friends, reveals a long-awaited notice: the biggest Gintama arc is coming to the big screens!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the short clip for its comedic elements and effective parody. However, it's primarily viewed as a promotional piece for the larger Shogun Assassination arc. The animation quality and music are praised, making it a worthwhile watch for Gintama fans seeking a quick dose of humor.
pros: Funny dialogue and parody of Food Wars!
Good sandbox for comedic characters.
Well-made trailer that creates hype.
cons: Largely a promotion for the SA arc.
Short clip with limited content.

anime.title: Boro the Caterpillar
anime.synopsis: To humans, Boro the caterpillar's world is small; but as he takes his first steps in life, the trials he comes to face are enormous. From hungry predators to unforgiving weather, he must overcome these obstacles by himself on his great journey through the untamed wilderness of suburban Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates "Kemushi no Boro" for its stunning visuals and comedic elements. It is a unique short film that offers a fresh perspective on the natural world. The main criticism is the lack of human characters, which was a deliberate creative choice by Miyazaki.
pros: Visually stunning animation showcasing the world from a caterpillar's perspective.
Comedic use of human-made sound effects for the soundtrack.
cons: Absence of human characters may limit appeal for some audiences.

anime.title: Precure All Stars Movie: Minna de Utau♪ - Kiseki no Mahou
anime.romaji_title: Precure All Stars Movie: Minna de Utau♪ - Kiseki no Mahou
anime.synopsis: Mirai and Rico come to the human world to play, but are separated when the witch Sorciere and her servant Torauuma suddenly appear. Their aim is to acquire the tears of the 44 Precure girls, using them for her "Most Evil Magic." Only the friendship of all 44 Precure girls will allow them to protect the world.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie's animation is visually appealing, but the story is simplistic and fails to engage. The large cast of Precure characters are underutilized, and the villain lacks depth. Overall, the movie fails to deliver a compelling narrative despite its visual strengths.
pros: Colorful and visually appealing animation with good special effects.
Comedy elements suitable for young children.
cons: Simplistic and unattractive story.
Underdeveloped villain with no clear motive.
Poor utilization of a potentially interesting theme (magic, witches).
Overcrowded cast with many Precure characters being underutilized and not interacting meaningfully.
Protagonist is plain and lacks personality.

anime.title: Ange Vierge
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, School, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Five separate worlds—Black, White, Green, Red, and Blue—are linked by the "Halo" and exist in a harmonious balance. However, the Halo suddenly opens in an event known as the World Connect, threatening to destroy the universe. Coming under attack by Ouroboros, an alien species that wishes to accelerate the universe's end, the five worlds recruit girls with special abilities called Exceed to defend against them.

Saya Sougetsu, a young girl from the Blue World of Earth, is one such individual able to wield Exceed power. Believing this to be her chance to make a difference, Saya eagerly joins the defense force. There, she meets Amane Ayashiro, another girl from Earth, as well as a selection of fighters from the other worlds. Faced with a formidable foe, the girls must prove that their newfound bonds are strong enough to save the future.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many criticizing the shallow plot, excessive fanservice, and underdeveloped characters. While some viewers found enjoyment in the cute character designs and heartwarming interactions, the overall consensus leans towards disappointment due to the wasted potential and poor execution. The show is seen as a generic magical girl anime with little substance beyond its visual appeal.
pros: Cute character designs and art style.
Enjoyable character interactions and heartwarming moments.
Some found the music and voice acting to be good.
The premise of girls from different worlds uniting is interesting to some.
Well done character development
cons: Rushed and predictable story with a shallow plot.
Excessive and poorly censored fanservice that detracts from the story.
Underdeveloped characters with repetitive arcs.
Poor explanations of the world's lore and enemies.
Inconsistent animation quality and questionable sound design choices (e.g., Stella's race car sound).
Plot holes and nonsensical elements.

anime.title: THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS: Anytime, Anywhere with Cinderella.
anime.romaji_title: The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls: Anytime, Anywhere with Cinderella.
anime.synopsis: The unaired 26th episode bundled with the ninth Blu-ray and DVD volume of The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted, comedic break from the series' melodrama, focusing on slice-of-life moments with the idols. While enjoyable for existing fans familiar with the large cast, newcomers may find it difficult to appreciate fully. The comedy is predictable but provides character depth.
pros: Comedic moments give depth to characters.
Absence of melodrama is a plus.
cons: Esoteric nature makes it hard to recommend to newcomers.
Assumes familiarity with a large cast of idols.
Predictable comedic moments
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Antics, Slice of Life, Comedic

anime.title: Shonen Maid
anime.synopsis:
After the sudden death of his mother, elementary school student Chihiro Komiya is left with no home and no family. But this changes when he encounters a rich and frivolous stranger who turns out to be his long-lost uncle, Madoka Takatori. Madoka offers to take Chihiro in, but upon arriving at his uncle's high-class mansion, the young boy is greeted by a plethora of dust and garbage. As Chihiro's neatfreak instincts kick in, he sets about cleaning the entire residence.
