Shounen Maid is a lighthearted comedy that follows Chihiro as he finds himself dressed in a frilly uniform (handmade by his uncle), receiving a salary, and working as maid of the house.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Shounen Maid' to be a heartwarming and comforting slice-of-life anime that balances comedy with emotional depth. Some viewers are initially hesitant due to the premise, fearing inappropriate content, but most find the relationship between the characters to be wholesome and familial. While some critique the humor and art style, the overall consensus is that it's an underrated and enjoyable series.
pros: Balances comedy with emotional depth.
Calming and beautiful story with likeable characters.
Wholesome and comforting, with minimal conflict.
cons: Premise can be off-putting due to potential shota-con misinterpretations.
Excessive use of typical crude Japanese humor.
Art style is nothing special and character designs are not particularly appealing.

anime.title: Mob Psycho 100
anime.synopsis:
Eighth-grader Shigeo "Mob" Kageyama has tapped into his inner wellspring of psychic prowess at a young age. But the power quickly proves to be a liability when he realizes the potential danger in his skills. Choosing to suppress his power, Mob's only present use for his ability is to impress his longtime crush, Tsubomi, who soon grows bored of the same tricks.

In order to effectuate control on his skills, Mob enlists himself under the wing of Arataka Reigen, a con artist claiming to be a psychic, who exploits Mob's powers for pocket change. Now, exorcising evil spirits on command has become a part of Mob's daily, monotonous life. However, the psychic energy he exerts is barely the tip of the iceberg; if his vast potential and unrestrained emotions run berserk, a cataclysmic event that would render him completely unrecognizable will be triggered. The progression toward Mob's explosion is rising and attempting to stop it is futile.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Mob Psycho 100' is highly praised for its unique art style, well-developed characters, and effective blend of comedy and serious themes. While some find the beginning slow, the series evolves into a thought-provoking narrative about self-improvement and emotional expression. The audience generally agrees that the animation is superb and the characters are well-written and likable, making it a standout anime.
pros: Unique art style and fluid animation, especially during action sequences, praised for its faithfulness to the source material while elevating it.
Well-developed characters with meaningful arcs, exploring themes of self-improvement, identity, and emotional expression.
Effective blend of comedy and serious themes, creating a balanced and thought-provoking narrative.
cons: Story can be slow to start, with the main plot not fully developing until the second half of the season.
Some found the initial episodes similar to One Punch Man, leading to unfair comparisons.
Pacing issues in the middle of the series.

anime.title: Steins;Gate: Open the Missing Link - Divide By Zero
anime.romaji_title: Steins;Gate: Kyoukaimenjou no Missing Link - Divide By Zero
anime.synopsis:
Having reached his emotional breaking point, Rintarou Okabe refuses to continue aiding time traveler Suzuha Amane in her mission to prevent World War III, believing any further efforts to save Makise Kurisu will be in vain. Shortly after, Okabe abandons his mad scientist persona and becomes a seemingly regular university student. 

Okabe's close friend Mayuri Shiina perceives him to be recovering from his trauma and is visibly happy. However, something still seems to be bothering Okabe. Steins;Gate: Kyoukaimenjou no Missing Link - Divide By Zero marks the beginning of a critical divergence—a timeline in which the burden of fate escalates beyond one's limits.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, appreciating the episode's role in setting up Steins;Gate 0 and exploring a darker timeline, but also criticizing its reliance on recycled content and the uncharacteristic portrayal of Okabe. Many viewers found the ending depressing, though acknowledging its narrative purpose. The episode's value is largely tied to its connection with Steins;Gate 0, making it essential for understanding the expanded story.
pros: Serves as a good setup for Steins;Gate 0
Explores the consequences of Okabe's failure and his emotional state
Provides an alternate perspective on the characters and their choices
Maintains the original art style and sound design
cons: Significant portion is recycled from episode 23
Ending may be unsatisfying for those seeking a happy resolution
Some find Okabe's character inconsistent with his previous determination
Fails to fully explain the transition to Steins;Gate 0
Mayuri's character is undermined.

anime.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School - Future Arc
anime.romaji_title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Kibougamine Gakuen - Mirai-hen
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
After Makoto Naegi and his fellow survivors escaped Hope's Peak Academy to the world beyond, they soon join the Future Foundation, an organization dedicated to combating despair. Just when all seems to be looking up, Naegi is arrested and tried for betrayal due to defending a malicious group of Remnants of Despair. Standing before all of the Future Foundation executives, he finds himself, along with Kyouko Kirigiri and Aoi Asahina, facing an unknown fate.

The matter at hand only escalates when the organization's supposedly impenetrable security is hacked into by a familiar face: Monokuma. Much to Naegi's horror, the mechanical bear immediately announces the beginning of a new killing game, as moments later, the first victim appears as a signal for despair to resume its brutal conquest.

Naegi, the Super High School-Level Lucky Student, must once again unravel the mystery as his colleagues and friends begin falling around him. However, there are no more class trials; among the 16 desperate participants, there is only one killer—and their death means the end of this infernal game.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is sharply divided. Some Danganronpa fans appreciated the darker tone, new characters, and attempts to tie up loose ends from the games. However, a significant portion of viewers found the plot predictable, the characters underdeveloped, and the overall execution disappointing, ultimately feeling that it detracts from the series.
pros: Some found the plot twists engaging and unexpected.
Several reviewers praised the darker, more mature tone and art style compared to previous installments.
Many enjoyed the new characters, particularly Munakata, and their development.
cons: Many found the plot predictable, boring, and reliant on overused tropes.
Several critics disliked the new characters, finding them unlikable, underdeveloped, or simply there to die.
Some felt the series added nothing new to the Danganronpa canon and even contradicted established lore.
Pacing issues were a recurring complaint, with many episodes feeling like filler.
The ending was criticized for being too optimistic and for undoing potentially impactful tragic moments.

anime.title: Ensemble Stars!
anime.synopsis:
Yumenosaki Academy has been home to the best boy idols of different generations. Holding immense influence over the school, its student council maintains the status quo by enforcing old traditions with an iron fist. Transfer student Anzu winds up attending as the very first member in the production course, making her the sole female student in the entire school. There, she meets Subaru Akehoshi, Hokuto Hidaka, Mao Isara, and Makoto Yuuki—her classmates and members of the idol unit "Trickstar." 

The academy holds Dream Idol Festivals—stage battles that put its students' singing and dancing skills against each other, with the audience voting on the winner. Winning these "DreFes" guarantees the members of the idol unit various privileges and prestige. However, with the student council intervening and punishing everyone involved in an unsanctioned DreFes, the members of Trickstar find that they can no longer sit around and let it continue. Alongside Anzu as their producer, they plot to become the revolutionaries of the academy.
anime.consensus_summary: The "Ensemble Stars!" anime adaptation is a mixed bag, particularly for those unfamiliar with the game. While fans of the franchise appreciate seeing their favorite characters animated, newcomers may find the story rushed and the characters poorly developed. The anime is best enjoyed as a supplement to the game rather than a standalone series.
pros: Enjoyable for existing fans of the franchise
Characters are likeable and cute
Soundtrack is amazing
Motivating to read the rest of the stories in the game
cons: Rushed ending and pacing
Poorly explains the characters
Not a good entry point for newcomers
Fails to capture the depth of the true plot
Animation during performances is not as good as the anime graphic

anime.title: Pandora in the Crimson Shell
anime.synopsis:
Onboard a cruise ship heading to the scenic Cenancle Island, the full-body cyborg Nene Nanakorobi, a bubbly young girl who dreams of world peace, meets inventor Uzal Delilah. The two become fast friends along with Uzal's pet cyborg Clarion, a cat-like combat android. Soon after parting ways, a terrorist attack on the island threatens to shatter the pair's new friendship. In a bid to save her new friend, Uzal gives Nene the ability to use the Pandora Device found in Clarion's body before seemingly dying. With this power, Nene can temporarily master abilities and skills never seen before in the advancing world.

Working together, the two unlikely companions go on various missions—from saving children in shopping mall fires to fighting reckless thieves—all in the name of world peace. But to achieve this goal is not easy. B.U.E.R, a sentient laser in the form of a misshapen teddy bear, threatens to wreck their happy lives with his perverted nature and uncontrollable power. And to make matters worse, Nene's guardian, as well as genius inventor, Takumi Korobase has an undying interest in B.U.E.R.

Burdened with saving the world and keeping B.U.E.R from the hands of evil, Nene and Clarion's desire for world peace seems like a pipe dream. With this monumental goal, could the weight of it all destroy the pair's friendship completely?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the show's lightheartedness, cute characters, and unique blend of sci-fi and yuri elements, finding it enjoyable despite its flaws. However, others are critical of the weak plot, low production values, and excessive fan service, deeming it a skippable or disappointing experience. The show seems to cater to a specific audience who enjoys cute cyborg-girls and doesn't mind a nonsensical story.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions, particularly between Nene and Clarion.
Unique and creative artistic vision, standing out from generic anime.
Catchy opening and ending themes, along with generally good sound design in some reviews.
cons: Incoherent plot or a story that doesn't stand out.
Low production quality, including animation and CGI use.
Over-reliance on fan service and ecchi elements that detract from the story.

anime.title: High School DxD Born OVA
anime.romaji_title: High School DxD BorN: Yomigaeranai Fushichou
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Mythology, Romance, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Unaired anime episode bundled with the limited edition of High School DxD DX.2.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely agrees that this OVA offers a refreshing departure from the typical High School DxD formula, focusing on a more coherent story and character development, especially for Riser. While praised for its humor and improved narrative, minor criticisms regarding animation fluidity and the inherent fanservice remain, though these are generally seen as secondary to the overall positive experience.
pros: Actual tangible story and plot progression that deviates from excessive fanservice.
Strong character development, particularly for Riser, who is recontextualized effectively.
Good voice acting and sound design that aligns with the series' established quality.
Humorous character interactions and dialogue that leverage the established cast well.
cons: Animation frame rate drops and occasional lack of fluidity detract from the viewing experience.
Fanservice, while reduced compared to the main series, is still present and may alienate some viewers.
Art style is considered standard for the franchise and not particularly innovative.

anime.title: Youkai Watch Movie 3: Soratobu Kujira to Double Sekai no Daibouken da Nyan!
anime.romaji_title: Youkai Watch Movie 3: Soratobu Kujira to Double Sekai no Daibouken da Nyan!
anime.synopsis: When a giant flying whale suddenly appears over Sakura New Town and its sound is heard the Yo-Kai undergo a transformation. The characters soon realize that as a result they have become corporeal and exist in a material world. This is the third film in the Yok-Kai Watch series based on the hit game.
anime.consensus_summary: The film is a creative and enjoyable blend of live-action and anime, catering primarily to fans of the Yokai Watch series. While praised for its originality and fan service, the film suffers from inconsistencies in its world-building and some questionable live-action character designs. Overall, it's a fun but not the strongest entry in the Yokai Watch film franchise.
pros: Creative blend of live-action and anime.
Original story that complements the Yokai Watch series.
Entertaining for fans of the franchise.
cons: Inconsistencies in world-building when combining Yokai Watch elements with real-world locations.
Some live-action character designs may be off-putting (e.g., Jinmenken).
Not as good as the first two films in the series.

anime.title: Teekyu 7
anime.synopsis: Seventh season of the Teekyuu series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Teekyuu 7 for its random and fast-paced humor, particularly if they are already fans of the series. Some find it difficult to follow or find the humor inconsistent, but this season is considered one of the most consistently enjoyable. The art and music are appreciated, though the show bears little resemblance to tennis.
pros: Consistent enjoyment across episodes
Improved art style compared to earlier seasons
Good OP and music
cons: Difficult to follow due to speed
Fluctuating humor quality
Pointless and random nature may not appeal to everyone
Deviates from the tennis theme

anime.title: Journey to the West: Legends of the Monkey King
anime.synopsis: Sun Wukong, who was born from a magic stone, has been imprisoned underneath a mountain for five centuries for his mischief in the heavens. One day, the Diety Guanyin told Wukong that the Monk Tangsen will set him free, and Wukong will join him on a pilgrimage from China to India. The next day, Xuanzang came and set him free, and the two started their Journey to the west. Along the way, they meet two new friends, Zhu Bajie and the Hermit Sha Wujing who joins them on the journey; together, they face many dangers and evil creatures and sorcerers and learn to get along.
anime.consensus_summary: The animated adaptation of "Xi You Ji" is widely praised for its faithfulness to the original story, engaging characters, and dynamic animation, making it a beloved classic, especially for those who grew up with it. While some find the episodic nature and simple storylines repetitive, the overall consensus is that it's a charming and enjoyable series. The Mandarin voice acting and creative fight sequences are frequently highlighted as key strengths.
pros: Faithful adaptation of classic Chinese literature, making it accessible to a younger audience.
Excellent voice acting, particularly in the Mandarin version.
Dynamic animation, especially in fight scenes, capturing the characters' personalities.
Engaging characters with unique abilities and personalities, making them memorable and enjoyable.
Charming humor and creative fight sequences, setting it apart from typical action-adventure shows.
cons: Episodic nature can lead to repetitive storylines and a lack of an overarching plot.
Simple story structure may not appeal to older audiences seeking intellectual substance or complex character development.
Animation quality, while impressive for its time, may not compare to current animation standards.

anime.title: Kuromukuro
anime.synopsis:
During the dawn of the 21st century, the United Nations Kurobe Research Institute was established in Japan to investigate an ancient artifact, which was discovered during the construction of the Kurobe Dam. Scientists from around the world have gathered in the facility to study the object, while their children enjoy their everyday lives attending Mt. Tate International Senior High School.

Yukina Shirahane, a reserved high school girl, is the daughter of the facility's head scientist. While visiting her mother at the facility, Yukina manages to solve part of the artifact's puzzle. To her surprise, what appears before her is Kennosuke Tokisada Ouma, a young samurai from the Sengoku era.

As a threat approaches from outer space, Yukina, along with Kennosuke, finds herself defending Earth against the invading forces. Along the way, she discovers the mystery behind Kennosuke and the reason he is determined to protect her.
anime.consensus_summary: Kuromukuro is a surprisingly enjoyable anime that blends samurai and mecha elements effectively. While some find the CGI and certain character tropes off-putting, many appreciate the well-paced plot, character development, and unique combination of genres. The series is generally well-received, especially by those new to the mecha genre, with only minor criticisms regarding specific plot points and character writing.
pros: Unique blend of samurai and mecha elements.
Intriguing characters with noticeable development.
Well-paced plot with unexpected twists and turns.
Good fight scenes and cool soundtracks.
Addresses themes of identity and purpose.
Refreshing main character who is not interested in school and a passion for structures.
The interactions between characters are sufficiently designed.
cons: CGI animation can be distracting.
Some characters are stereotypical and annoying.
Story relies on some clichéd elements like aliens trying to take over the world.
Ending didn't meet all viewers' expectations.

anime.title: Love Tyrant
anime.synopsis:
When a strange girl named Guri comes knocking at Seiji Aino's door, he quickly finds himself thrust into a world of romantic troubles. Claiming that she will die if he does not kiss someone within 24 hours, Guri's pleas of desperation are misunderstood as pleas for love, leading Seiji to kiss the cute stranger that came barging into his house. In actuality, it turns out that this cosplaying cupid is the wielder of a Kiss Note, in which any pairing of names she writes will kiss and become a couple. Guri explains that she misspelt and accidentally wrote Seiji's name while indulging in her yaoi fantasies, but because she had yet to pair him with anyone, their kiss was meaningless. Even worse, Guri reveals that if Seiji is not coupled with anyone soon, not only will she die, but Seiji will remain a virgin for eternity!

Eager to escape his fate, Seiji sets his sights on the beautiful and popular Akane Hiyama. But after Akane hears that he kissed Guri, she reveals the obsessive and psychopathic feelings that she holds for the unfortunate boy and proceeds to viciously attack them. In the ensuing confusion, Guri is able to pair Seiji with Akane in the Kiss Note, temporarily saving Seiji from any further bodily harm. But to complicate matters, Guri's newfound feelings lead her to also pair the two of them with herself. Just when the situation could not get any more convoluted, this new coupling with Guri has turned Seiji and Akane into temporary angels, forcing them into assisting the cupid with her work of pairing humans, lest they be cast into hell. With all semblance of normality snatched from his life, Seiji gets to work at matchmaking with these eccentric girls by his side.
anime.consensus_summary: Renai Boukun is a divisive show; some find it hilarious and enjoyable as a parody, while others criticize it for its rushed story, repetitive humor, and shallow characters. The initial concept and comedic elements are well-received, but the series struggles to maintain quality throughout. Ultimately, it's considered a 'junk food' anime: enjoyable for light entertainment but lacking depth.
pros: Unique and funny characters with great interactions
Excellent parody of rom-com and Death Note tropes
Catchy opening theme and well-suited art style for comedic moments
cons: Rushed story and pacing, especially in later episodes
Inconsistent comedy, with repetitive gags and forced jokes
Underdeveloped plot elements and contrived character development

anime.title: Koyomimonogatari
anime.synopsis: Whether it is investigating stone shrines, tracking rumors, or simply playing hide and seek, Koyomi Araragi is always there to fulfill the requests of his friends from both the human and supernatural worlds. In this series of short stories, Koyomi helps each of the girls in his cohort solve a mystery or kill some time, all while slowly unraveling the truth about his town and its many supernatural occurrences.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with long-time fans more likely to enjoy the character interactions and slice-of-life elements. Some find the side stories uninteresting and the production quality lacking, while others appreciate the setup for future plot developments. It is generally agreed that newcomers should not start with this series.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions and witty dialogue.
Some episodes provide thought-provoking puzzles.
The ending sets up future installments well.
cons: Many stories are irrelevant to the main plot.
Underwhelming or predictable resolutions.
Lower production budget compared to previous seasons.

anime.title: Dies irae
anime.synopsis:
Ren Fujii is a normal student who just had a fistfight with his former best friend, leading him to break off their friendship. But with the help of his childhood friend, Kasumi Ayase, and upperclassman, Rea Himuro, he's gradually returning to his normal school life.

Then a series of brutal murders in which the victims are decapitated begins to strike their city. Strangely, at the same time, Ren starts to have terrifying nightmares of being beheaded by a guillotine. But these are just a prelude to the painful and terrifying battles to come.
anime.consensus_summary: Dies Irae is a highly divisive anime adaptation of a visual novel, praised for its unique thematic blend and soundtrack but heavily criticized for its confusing plot, poor animation, and underdeveloped characters. Many viewers find the story difficult to follow and the characters unengaging, while others appreciate its dark atmosphere and potential. The series suffers from incomplete storytelling and requires significant patience to potentially enjoy.
pros: Unique story combining history, philosophy, and mythology.
Engaging soundtrack with German classical music and opera.
Interesting character designs reminiscent of Kouta Hirano (Hellsing).
Enjoyable action sequences with decent animation (especially after episode 7).
cons: Confusing and complex plot with many unexplained elements.
Uneven pacing and incoherent storytelling.
Characters are often generic and lack development.
Poor animation quality and inconsistent art style.
Over-reliance on exposition and pseudo-philosophical monologues.

anime.title: Your Name.
anime.synopsis:
Mitsuha Miyamizu, a high school girl, yearns to live the life of a boy in the bustling city of Tokyo—a dream that stands in stark contrast to her present life in the countryside. Meanwhile in the city, Taki Tachibana lives a busy life as a high school student while juggling his part-time job and hopes for a future in architecture.

One day, Mitsuha awakens in a room that is not her own and suddenly finds herself living the dream life in Tokyo—but in Taki's body! Elsewhere, Taki finds himself living Mitsuha's life in the humble countryside. In pursuit of an answer to this strange phenomenon, they begin to search for one another.

Kimi no Na wa. revolves around Mitsuha and Taki's actions, which begin to have a dramatic impact on each other's lives, weaving them into a fabric held together by fate and circumstance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, praising the film's stunning animation, emotional depth, and immersive experience. However, some critics point out flaws in the plot, character development, and reliance on familiar tropes. There is a clear divide between viewers deeply moved by the film and those who find it shallow or predictable.
pros: Spectacular animation and visuals, especially the use of vibrant colors and dynamic crowds.
Compelling and emotional story, despite some predictable elements.
Effective use of music and sound design to enhance the emotional impact.
cons: Plot holes and contrived plot developments, especially in the second half.
Lack of character depth and development.
Over-reliance on Shinkai's typical romantic drama tropes.
Predictable plot and lack of originality.

anime.title: Food Wars! The Second Plate
anime.romaji_title: Shokugeki no Souma: Ni no Sara
anime.synopsis: The qualifiers of the Autumn Elections are now over, and only eight talented chefs remain. Now, they face off in one-on-one food wars, each with their own unique themes. Met with both new judges and new opponents all with their own specialties, Souma must stay on his toes if he hopes to make it to the top of both the Autumn Elections and Tootsuki Culinary Academy.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is generally well-received, maintaining the entertainment value of the first. However, some viewers found the pacing rushed and the story less compelling. The series continues to be praised for its animation and character development, although the ecchi elements remain a point of contention for some.
pros: Consistent entertainment and hype
Great animation and detailed food visuals
Strong character development, especially for Souma
cons: Fast pacing and skipped content from the manga
Inconsistent story quality compared to the first season
Overreliance on ecchi elements ('foodgasms') for some viewers

anime.title: Active Raid Second
anime.romaji_title: Active Raid: Kidou Kyoushuushitsu Dai Hachi Gakari 2nd
anime.synopsis: Set in a part of Tokyo that has descended into a quagmire, the story follows Unit 8 of the 5th Special Public Security Section's 3rd Mobile Assault Division, popularly called "The Eighth," who don powered armor "Willwear" exoskeletons to counter the rise in crime.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response is mixed. While some appreciate the attempts at social commentary and the visual/audio aspects, many feel the writing and character development are weak. The series struggles to establish a unique identity, resulting in a generally lukewarm reception. It is considered functional but unremarkable.
pros: Good art and animation, especially in the final episode.
Enjoyable music, including opening and ending themes.
Introduction of interesting social and political commentary.
cons: Relegating a main character (Asami) to a secondary role was a poor move.
Writing isn't great and fails to explore complex social issues with sufficient depth.
Series lacks a strong identity, feeling like a collection of elements without a cohesive whole.
Over-reliance on 3D models makes the CG look cheap.

anime.title: Tabimachi Lateshow
anime.synopsis:
Departures are moments that evoke both hope and melancholy. Tabi Machi Late Show examines how these ambivalent emotions continue to persist long beyond that singular moment of parting. Azuma reminisces about her mentor as she sees off her own student; Kumeno recalls her short, turbulent friendship with Koizumi; Yukari meets an old friend during the Lantern Festival; and Sakurada fondly remembers the numerous students she has met during her teaching career.

Structured around a theme of goodbyes and journeys, Tabi Machi Late Show is composed of four intimate, slice-of-life vignettes that wistfully examine the lasting impressions people leave on one another.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many appreciating the show's emotional core and exploration of goodbyes despite its technical shortcomings. The short format is both a strength, allowing for concise storytelling, and a weakness, leading to underdeveloped characters and minimal animation. While some found the experience moving and worthwhile, others were left unimpressed by the lack of investment and slow pacing. Overall, it's considered a decent short anime if you're in the right mood.
pros: Effective emotional storytelling despite short runtime
Stories explore universal feelings of goodbyes and journeys
Deliberate pacing and visual storytelling enhance emotional impact
Fitting art style evokes nostalgic feeling
cons: Minimal animation, resembling a slideshow
Slow dialogue and unnecessary pauses
Inconsistent episode quality due to time constraints
Underdeveloped characters hinder investment
Repetitive background music

anime.title: Concrete Revolutio The Last Song
anime.romaji_title: Concrete Revolutio: Choujin Gensou - The Last Song
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Mystery, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Titans from outer space, life forms from a mystical world, phantoms and goblins from ancient times, cyborgs created by scientists, relics that rose out of the ruins of ancient civilizations. In another Japan, it's not just a question of "what if"—it's a reality. Some of the superhumans choose to keep their identities a secret, while others bask in their superhuman fame. Jiro Hitoyoshi, member of the Superhuman Bureau, keeps track of their doings.
anime.consensus_summary: Concrete Revolutio: Choujin Gensou - The Last Song is a thought-provoking and ambitious anime that deconstructs the superhero genre. While praised for its complex characters, ethical dilemmas, and social commentary, some find the non-linear storytelling confusing and the second season not as strong as the first. Overall, the series is considered underrated but is definitely not for everyone.
pros: Unique take on the superhero genre, questioning justice and morality.
Complex characters with conflicting beliefs that challenge the viewer.
Ambitious storytelling that tackles complex themes.
Historical Japanese metaphors provide depth.
cons: Non-linear storytelling can be confusing.
Early episodes of the first season may not impress.
Second season arguably forgets what made the first season great.
anime.thematic_vibe: Social Commentary, Ethical Dilemmas, Superhero Deconstruction

anime.title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha: The Movie 2nd A's Mini Picture Drama
anime.romaji_title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha: The Movie 2nd A's Mini Picture Drama
anime.synopsis: Short picture drama specials included with the BD release of the film.
anime.consensus_summary: The mini picture drama offers comedic relief but suffers from being disconnected from the main narrative and lack of accessibility due to the absence of subtitles. The introduction of new characters is a minor positive, but a controversial scene involving a child character significantly detracts from the overall experience. The audience is likely polarized due to the inappropriate content, overshadowing any potential enjoyment.
pros: Humorous scenarios.
Introduces new characters.
cons: Unsubtitled and hard to find.
Not related to the main movie plot.
Inappropriate depiction of a child character.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Fan Service

anime.title: Cupid's Chocolate
anime.synopsis: Jiang Hao Yi, a normal, high school student who is extremely scared of getting into trouble suddenly becomes the Harem King of his school and gets confessed to by a bunch of beautiful girls! The worst thing is, Jiang hao doesn't know any of the girls who confessed to him! What on earth is happening?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Aishen Qiaokeli-ing... is mixed, with a significant portion appreciating its high-quality art, fast-paced comedy, and surprisingly well-developed characters within the harem genre. However, many also point out flaws in storytelling, with some finding the plot choppy and the attempts at drama to be poor.
pros: High-quality art and animation, described as smooth, bright, cute, and emotive.
Engaging and fast-paced plot that keeps viewers from getting bored.
Likeable and well-developed characters with unique backstories and desires.
Humor is often genuinely funny and goes beyond situational gags.
The Chinese production offers a novel experience for many viewers.
Male protagonist is not a typical clueless or overly reactive harem lead.
cons: Plot progression can feel forced, disjointed, or choppy, especially compared to the source material.
Some viewers find the story concept bland or lacking in proper execution.
Voice acting is sometimes described as awkward or strange, particularly the main female lead.
Art quality can be inconsistent, with low-budget backgrounds and effects.
Contains cringe-worthy "comedic" harem events and absurdity.
Attempts at drama are often described as awful or despicable.

anime.title: celebration and chorale
anime.synopsis: Yukie Nakauchi's musical work using principal percussionist Niel DePonte's "Celebration and Chorale". Yuuki Matsumura was the arranger for the piece.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience mood is overwhelmingly positive, with viewers captivated by the unique fusion of music and animation in 'Celebration and Chorale.' The anime is praised as a masterful tribute to Niel DePonte's musical composition and a mesmerizing showcase of musical talent. The narrative, centered around a young percussionist's journey, resonates with viewers.
pros: Unique blend of music and animation
Masterful tribute to the musical composition
Mesmerizing showcase of musical talent and visual artistry
anime.thematic_vibe: Musical Tribute, Artistic Expression, Transformative Power

anime.title: Bono Bono
anime.synopsis:
Based on the original comic BONO BONO by Mikio Igarashi that has seen over 9,000,000 total copies printed, this is the definitive animated version of the emotionally soothing character-driven series that will make you ask yourself the philosophical question, "What are living things?" while laughing at heartwarming gags and being entertained by the interactions of amusing forest friends Bonobono the young sea otter, Chipmunk, Fishing Cat, and more.

Enjoy the easygoing days and minor misadventures of Bonobono and his friends!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment for Bonobono (2016) is largely positive, with viewers appreciating its uniquely relaxing, heartwarming, and philosophical slice-of-life approach. While the charming characters and gentle pacing are widely praised, some find the humor repetitive and certain character gags overused, especially when viewing episodes back-to-back.
pros: Consistently mellow pacing and relaxed mood
Charming and unique character interactions
Simple yet fitting art style and sound design
Heartwarming and emotionally soothing atmosphere
cons: Repetitive humor, particularly toilet humor, can become tiresome
Certain character catchphrases are overused ('Are you going to bully me?')
The tsukkomi (comedic foil) character's shtick can get old
Visuals can be odd, with characters switching between mouth flaps and Pingu-like mouths

anime.title: Qualidea Code
anime.synopsis:
On a quiet and peaceful day, the skies split open and extradimensional beings, designated as the Unknown, launch a swift and brutal attack against humanity. To protect the future of the country, all of Japan's children are cryogenically frozen until the end of the war to keep them out of harm's way.

Several years pass, and humanity has established a foothold in a corner of Japan, which now serves as the frontline of the war. No longer facing humanity's extinction, the children are awakened from their slumber. It is then discovered that, while in cryogenesis, the children had developed Worlds, supernatural powers unique to each person. The six most powerful children are given command of the reclaimed cities, using their powers to defend the strongholds against the continuing invasion. Childhood friends Ichiya Suzaku and Canaria Utara lead Tokyo, siblings Kasumi and Asuha Chigusa manage Chiba, and Maihime Tenkawa and Hotaru Rindou oversee Kanagawa.

Over time, the almost routine attacks from the Unknown and the clashing personalities of the city heads and subheads cultivate petty rivalries, leading to constant arguments between the three cities. With the Unknown suddenly increasing the pressure of their attacks, the three cities' leaders must learn how to work together or risk losing the last line of defense against humanity's extinction.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many criticizing the poor animation and generic plot elements. However, some find the plot twist and character interactions enjoyable enough to warrant a watch. The music is generally well-received, but the overall execution leaves much to be desired, leading to disappointment for many viewers. Some people thought it was much better than the ratings suggested.
pros: Interesting plot twist that changes the story significantly.
Good music, including OPs and EDs by known artists (LiSA, ClariS, GARNiDELiA).
Enjoyable character interactions and some character development, particularly after the plot twist.
cons: Poor and inconsistent animation quality, especially in action scenes and character designs.
Generic and uninspired initial plot with many cliches.
Rushed storytelling and underdeveloped world-building, leaving many plot holes and unanswered questions.
Unlikable or bland main characters with weak backstories.

anime.title: Boruto: Naruto the Movie - The Day Naruto Became Hokage
anime.romaji_title: Boruto: Naruto the Movie - Naruto ga Hokage ni Natta Hi
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the limited edition of Blu-ray/DVD of Boruto: Naruto the Movie.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While many fans enjoyed the nostalgic and light-hearted portrayal of Naruto's family life and his achievement of becoming Hokage, a significant portion expressed disappointment that the moment was treated comedically rather than with the gravitas it deserved. Some feel it diminished Naruto's journey and character, especially for long-time fans.
pros: Nostalgic value for long-time Naruto fans.
Warm and sweet depiction of Naruto's family life.
Enjoyable and funny moments.
cons: Disappointment that Naruto's Hokage inauguration was played for laughs instead of with emotional weight.
Frustration over the focus on comedy overshadowing the significance of Naruto's achievement.
Criticism that Himawari's Byakugan awakening was poorly timed and detracted from Naruto's moment.

anime.title: Gintama: Love Incense Arc
anime.synopsis:
The red-light district, Yoshiwara, is suddenly taken over by "Aizen Kou," an incense that has the ability to make anyone fall in love with the first person they see. Having been outlawed for its strong potency, the love drug was thought to have disappeared from the red-light district for good; however, it seems to have found its way back inside Yoshiwara's walls and now has the entire district under its influence.

Of those affected is the cold-hearted Hyakka captain, Tsukuyo, and the first person she sees after inhaling the smoke is none other than the brazen Yorozuya leader, Gintoki Sakata. Unbeknownst to everyone else though, she was already attracted to Gintoki. With those hidden feelings now intensified, Tsukuyo must overcome her afflictions and work with the Yorozuya to return everyone back to normal.
anime.consensus_summary: The Aizome Kaori-hen arc is generally seen as a humorous and entertaining side story within Gintama. While the comedy is well-received, the antagonist's story and overall plot are considered weak and underdeveloped. Many find the arc skippable but enjoyable for its comedic value and subversion of the love potion trope.
pros: Hilarious situations and over-the-top comedy
Subversion of love potion trope
Entertaining and unique situations
cons: Weak or underdeveloped antagonist story
Plotline could have been used better
Story lacks value and can be skipped

anime.title: D.Gray-man HALLOW
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Despite the recent Akuma attack, the members of the Black Order are in high spirits as they set about moving to a new base. Immediately upon his arrival, however, Allen Walker is suddenly called by the Central Agency and has his arm forcefully sealed by the Order. He is then led to a surprising meeting with his master, General Cross Marian, who reveals staggering secrets surrounding the enigmatic 14th Noah.

A phantom thief incident, the arrival of a mysterious group of Exorcists, the death of an important comrade, and an all-out battle against the Noah Family—just what does this mean for Allen, Yuu Kanda, and the rest of the Order? This is but the beginning of a series of strange, seemingly unconnected events that lead to something far greater.
anime.consensus_summary: D.Gray-man Hallow is a divisive sequel. Fans are split between those who appreciate the return to the manga storyline and improved visuals, and those who are disappointed by the rushed pacing, inconsistent animation, and changes to character designs. The series is seen as a letdown for some due to its failure to capture the essence of the original anime.
pros: Faithful to the manga storyline.
Improved animation quality.
Good replacement Japanese voice cast.
cons: Rushed pacing; skips important content from the manga.
Inconsistent animation quality within episodes.
Unnecessary character design changes.
Weak English dub; some voice acting is emotionless or grating.

anime.title: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo Returns 2nd Season: Akechi Keibu no Jikenbo
anime.romaji_title: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo Returns 2nd Season: Akechi Keibu no Jikenbo
anime.synopsis: The official website of the The File of Young Kindaichi Returns anime announced that a one-hour special television episode of the anime titled "The File of Inspector Akechi" (Akechi Keibu no Jikenbo) will air on December 26. The site streamed a trailer on Sunday, which previews the episode and its story. The video also reveals that Yudai Chiba will play Ryūtaro Kobayashi, a junior detective under detective Kengo Akechi.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience strongly appreciates the Akechi-centric episode for its compelling narrative, particularly the themes of justice and redemption. The emotional impact is heightened by the OST, making it a memorable and satisfying viewing experience. The lack of negative critiques suggests a generally positive reception.
pros: Well-developed case with Akechi Kengo
Moving OST that enhances emotional impact
Satisfying resolution with justice for the wronged

anime.title: Berserk (2016)
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Military, Psychological, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Now branded for death and destined to be hunted by demons until the day he dies, Guts embarks on a journey to defy such a gruesome fate, as waves of beasts relentlessly pursue him. Steeling his resolve, he takes up the monstrous blade Dragonslayer and vows to exact vengeance on the one responsible, hunting down the very man he once looked up to and considered a friend.

Along the way, he encounters some unlikely allies, such as a small elf named Puck, and Isidro, a young thief looking to learn swordsmanship from the former mercenary. As the ragtag group slowly comes together after having decided to join Guts in his quest, they will face incredible danger unlike anything they have ever experienced before.
anime.consensus_summary: The Berserk 2016 adaptation is highly controversial due to its significant departure in animation style, opting for poorly executed CGI that clashes with the source material's dark aesthetic. While some appreciate the attempt to adapt the Conviction arc and praise the soundtrack, the overwhelming consensus is disappointment. Many fans feel the adaptation fails to capture the essence of Berserk, due to poor visuals, cut content, and weak character development.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the Conviction arc story
Good characterization true to the manga
Amazing soundtrack and sound design
Retains the dark and raw atmosphere of Berserk
cons: Awful CGI animation, stiff and unnatural movement
Poor directing and inconsistent pacing
Skipped crucial backstory and character development (Black Swordsman arc, Lost Children arc)
Inconsistent tone, jarring shifts between serious and comedic moments
Censorship of gore and nudity, undermining the gritty feel
Uninspired and generic soundtrack compared to previous adaptations

anime.title: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! - God's Blessing on This Wonderful Choker!
anime.romaji_title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!: Kono Subarashii Choker ni Shukufuku wo!
anime.synopsis: While exploring Wiz's magic shop with his party, Kazuma Satou finds a magical wish-granting choker and decides to try it on. Only then does Wiz tell him that the choker strangles its wearer to death in four days unless their desires are fulfilled. This wouldn't be a problem if Kazuma knew what his wish was. Fearing for Kazuma's life, Aqua, Megumin, and Lalatina Ford "Darkness" Dustiness all agree to do his bidding in order to satisfy his desires and hopefully grant his wish, no matter what he asks for.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many enjoying the continuation of the series' humor and character interactions. However, a significant number of viewers found the OVA to be an excessive and detrimental use of fanservice, with some disliking the deviation in Kazuma's character. The episode is generally recommended for fans of the first season who don't mind ecchi content, but is seen as skippable for others.
pros: Consistent with the humor of the first season.
Expressive animation and top-notch voice acting.
Successfully encapsulates the charm of the series.
Good comedy that is familiar from season 1.
Character driven show
cons: Overreliance on fanservice detracts from the story.
Plot is weak and not particularly creative.
Kazuma's characterization is inconsistent and unlikeable.
Mediocre story
Crude humor

anime.title: Animated Journey Through Saga Prefecture
anime.synopsis:
Shorts set in Saga prefecture, and are highlighting the prefecture's culture. 

"Yakusoku no Utsuwa - Arita no Hatsukoi" will be set in the town of Arita, and will be a youth story highlighting the scenery of Arita.

"Fuyu no Chikai, Natsu no Matsuri - Takeoshi no Dai-Kusunoki" is set in the city of Takeoshi, and will center on two characters, a boy and a girl, who grow up watched over by a large camphor tree that endures the time and seasons.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience appreciates the beautiful scenery and cultural focus of Saga prefecture presented in these short films. The primary drawback is the limited amount of content available, leaving some viewers wanting more. Overall, the shorts are seen as a pleasant and easily accessible way to experience the region.
pros: Visually appealing scenery of Saga prefecture.
Short format makes it easily accessible.
Availability with English subtitles increases global reach.
cons: Limited content (only two short films).
Lack of extensive plot or character development due to short format.

anime.title: KochinPa!
anime.synopsis: Anime adaptation of pachinko and slot machine parlor Island's "Aira Project" commercials. It follows three mascot characters: Aira, Hana, and Shima.
anime.consensus_summary: KochinPa! is a series of extremely short, gag-based episodes. The audience finds it a cute and novel experience, but acknowledges its limitations in animation and joke quality. It's seen as a lighthearted, quick watch that doesn't leave a lasting impression, mostly appreciated for its uniqueness and brevity.
pros: Short and easy to watch
Some jokes are decent and funny
Unique and novel concept
Cute visuals and bright colors
cons: Extremely short episodes offer little substance
Animation is almost nonexistent
Repetitive setting and limited motion
Jokes are hit-or-miss

anime.title: Clockwork Planet
anime.synopsis:
Legend tells that when the Earth was destroyed, the great clockmaker Y made a replacement from cogs and gears. Naoto Miura is a young boy who aspires to be a great clockmaker. However, despite his unique talent—sensitive hearing that can immediately understand clockwork mechanics from noise alone—he has made little progress. But this changes when a coffin falls from the sky into his apartment, revealing RyuZU, a female automaton forged by Y himself.

News of RyuZU's arrival brings Marie Bell Breguet, the gifted heir of a distinguished line of clockmakers, and her cyborg bodyguard Vainney Halter into Naoto's life as well. When she and Naoto both become embroiled in an action-packed battle for their lives, they discover an uncomfortable truth: the clockwork planet that humanity has lived on for over a millennium is beginning to break down—a secret that many people will kill to protect.
anime.consensus_summary: Clockwork Planet is seen as a series with an intriguing concept and some entertaining characters, but it ultimately fails due to a weak and confusing story, poorly developed villains, and inconsistent characterization. Many viewers felt that the series had wasted potential and suffered from poor execution. While some enjoyed the comedic elements and the unique world-building, the overall consensus leans towards disappointment.
pros: Interesting world and premise
Entertaining main characters
Good use of sound and music
cons: Confusing and weak story
Poorly defined villains and motivations
Inconsistent characterization
Awkward fanservice
Mediocre animation

anime.title: The Lost Village
anime.genres: Drama, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
A bus full of eccentric individuals is headed toward the urban legend known as Nanaki Village, a place where one can supposedly start over and live a perfect life. While many have different ideas of why the village cannot be found on any map, or why even the police cannot pinpoint its location, they each look forward to their new lives and just what awaits them once they reach their destination.

After a few mishaps, they successfully arrive at Nanaki Village only to find it completely abandoned. Judging from the state of disrepair, it has been vacant for at least a year. However, secrets are soon revealed as some of the group begin to go missing while exploring the village and amidst the confusion, they find bloody claw marks in a forest. As mistrust and in-fighting break out, will they ever be able to figure out the truth behind this lost village?
anime.consensus_summary: Mayoiga is a highly divisive anime with a unique premise but flawed execution. Many find it to be a poorly written mystery with underdeveloped characters and a nonsensical plot, resulting in unintentional comedy. However, some viewers appreciate its absurdity and enjoy it as a 'so bad it's good' experience, praising its soundtrack and unique elements.
pros: Unique storyline and plot
Interesting concept
Good art and animation
Great soundtrack
Some characters have unique and crazy personalities
So bad it's funny
cons: Too many characters with little to no development
Poor pacing
Illogical character interaction
Muddled narrative
Crappy half-assed explanations
Annoying and bland characters
Mediocre and pretentious
Waste of time
Unintentionally funny due to poor execution
Story is bland and flow is horrible

anime.title: Nora, Princess, and Stray Cat
anime.romaji_title: Nora to Oujo to Noraneko Heart
anime.synopsis:
Nora Handa is a boy who lives with Shachi Yuuri, who was adopted by his mother. With everyone supporting, the two of them grew up healthily even after their parents passed away. Shachi, who likes Nora the most, wakes him up every morning.

Nora spends his happy student life with Michi Kuroki, who is a disciplinary committee, honor student at school and childhood friend of the main character, Yuuki Asuhara, who is a gal but is very bright and can talk his worries to, and more friends at school.

One day, Nora meets a girl who calls herself Patricia at the park on the way to the school. Patricia is a queen at hell, and claims to come here to destroy the life on land. However, she is damaged heavily because she touched the life for the first time. The energy was stronger than her, so Nora needed to tend her. Patricia asked him to tell her about the mysteries of life, and he had to even explain the ero book that he found at the park...?!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some find the anime's absurdist humor and random skits hilarious and enjoyable, praising its variety and comedic timing. However, many others criticize its nonsensical plot, poor animation, and lack of character development, deeming it a chaotic mess that fails to adapt the visual novel effectively. Episode 6 is particularly infamous for its bizarre content.
pros: Variety of comedic ideas and surprises
Memorable and funny skits
Wild voice work and enjoyable characters (for some)
Good art direction
cons: Incoherent plot and random events
Poor animation quality and low budget feel
Weak character development
Unrelated to the synopsis
Inaccessible to viewers unfamiliar with the source material

anime.title: Usakame
anime.synopsis: Although Ayako Suzuki, Kinako Tanaka, Nishi Nishiaraidaishi, and Kurumi Satou are each eccentric in their own way, they have something in common: they all belong to the tennis club of Usakame High School. While the girls spend their days hanging out together and diligently practicing the sport, they end up in all kinds of amusing situations.
anime.consensus_summary: Usakame is seen as a slower, more relaxing spin-off of Teekyuu. While some appreciate its cute art style and likeable characters, others find the pacing too slow and the humor less impactful. Overall, it's considered a pleasant and enjoyable short anime series, but not as outstanding as its predecessor.
pros: Enjoyable and relaxing to watch.
Art style is appealing and unique.
Characters are likeable and well-refined.
cons: Pacing is slow and can be tiring.
Humor is not as strong or wacky as Teekyuu.
Voice acting can be flat at times.

anime.title: Gekidol
anime.genres: Drama, Idols (Female), Music, Performing Arts, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Five years ago, a mysterious phenomenon known as the Global Synchronic Urban Disappearance caused a large chunk of Ikebukuro to disappear overnight. Following the catastrophe, the inhabitants found themselves thrown into a state of disorder, and unexplained electromagnetic anomalies called "Auroras" began to be sighted.

Awed by the performance of idol Izumi Hinazaki at a play utilizing the "Super Material Theater," a stage designed to revitalize Ikebukuro through hologram-enhanced plays, high school student Seria Morino is inspired to become an idol. Shortly afterward, she is scouted by a young woman named Kaoru Sakakibara, who turns out to be the director of Alice in Theater—the troupe that Izumi used to be a part of.

Aiming to pursue her dreams, Seria decides to follow Kaoru and joins Alice in Theater. Upon arriving at their establishment, she is cordially welcomed by a group of young and friendly girls who are all very passionate about acting. However, something seems to be amiss.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the show's ambition and unique blend of genres, while others criticize its convoluted plot, pacing issues, and inconsistent production quality. The show's attempt to subvert idol tropes is noted, but its execution is seen as flawed. Ultimately, the show has wasted potential with a weak story.
pros: Interesting and bold attempt to blend idol genre with sci-fi elements.
Music and stage performances are enjoyable and well-executed.
Characters have potential for depth and surprising decisions.
cons: Story is convoluted and rushed, especially with multiple plotlines.
Pacing issues with slow burn and late reveals.
Inconsistent art and animation quality.
Failure to properly integrate idol elements.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sci-fi Mystery, Idol Drama, Stage Performance

anime.title: Pigtails
anime.synopsis:
A lone house stands amidst a barren landscape. Here lives a petite pigtailed girl, unfettered by her loneliness. There is rarely anyone for her to meet and interact with, save for the occasional masked visitors from a place unknown. Her only company is the inanimate objects present around her. They tell tales about themselves, the girl, and the unchanging surroundings they view day in and day out—all the while, she remains oblivious to their sentience.

One day, the monotony is broken when the girl meets someone who offers her a choice capable of altering many fates, including her own.
anime.consensus_summary: The short film 'Mitsuami no Kamisama' evokes a melancholic yet heartwarming feeling. It explores philosophical themes about life, death, and purpose, leaving viewers to ponder its meaning. While the animation is adequate, the narrative and music contribute to an overall positive experience.
pros: Unconventional narrative style
Soothing and strong background music
Interesting themes about life and death
cons: Short film, not much to say without spoilers
Animation is alright, but nothing special

anime.title: Cheer Boys!!
anime.synopsis: After suffering from a shoulder injury, shy first-year university student Haruki Bandou gladly takes the opportunity to give up judo, failing to find happiness in the sport regardless of his family owning a dojo. He did not expect, however, that his best friend Kazuma Hashimoto would also decide to leave their university's judo club at the same time as him. Despite Haruki's protests, Kazuma already has plans for a new and revolutionary activity: a cheerleading team made up of only men. Although heavily reluctant, Haruki ends up helping his friend set up the team. Through sheer determination, and with support from their newfound club members, Haruki and Kazuma persist in founding the Breakers, the first ever all-male cheerleading team of Meishiin University, slowly making history in spite of the feminine tag attached to the sport of cheerleading and the prejudices, physical challenges, and self-doubts that inevitably follow.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While praised for its heartwarming themes, character development, and unique premise, the series is criticized for rushed pacing, inconsistent animation quality, and a lack of sports anime intensity. Viewers generally appreciate the character interactions and overall message, but find the execution flawed.
pros: Meaningful relationships and teamwork that avoids friendship stereotypes.
Good character development with distinct personalities and backstories.
Unique and heartwarming premise about breaking stereotypes.
The opening song is literally OP (over-powerful) as the characters start something new into their life as well as changing their lives one by one
Show break down toxic masculinity and shows that boys can do something that is more "feminine" presenting.
From a technical aspect, the cheers and routines and realities of the cheerleading were completely spot on.
cons: Rushed pacing and too many characters introduced at once.
Lack of tension or competition typical of sports anime.
Inconsistent animation quality, particularly in later episodes.
Lacks story development with themes felt rushed and provided no background info
Painfully obvious that they don't have enough budget in making this anime
Some a little generic

anime.title: Prison School: Mad Wax
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Gag Humor, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Hachimitsu Private Academy's five male students have been released from their oppressive prison captors, allowing them to return to their ideal school lives surrounded by short-skirted girls.

With their freedom restored, things could not be going better for the gang. Kiyoshi Fujino and Shingo Wakamoto have formed close bonds with their female classmates; Reiji Andou is the center of attention due to his masochistic quirks; and even Takehito "Gakuto" Morokuzu—notorious for defecating himself during class—befriends the klutzy yet like-minded Mitsuko Yokoyama. 

However, in contrast to his fellow ex-convicts, Jouji "Joe" Nezu struggles to readjust to student life, and the unlikely romantic success of his friend Gakuto pushes him to his wit's end. Feeling ostracized, he begins to wonder if life was better behind bars.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the OVA as a funny and satisfying continuation of the series, particularly praising the art and character development. However, some find it pointless and lacking the compelling conflict of the main series, resulting in a less engaging experience. Despite mixed feelings, the OVA is often seen as a worthwhile addition for fans of Prison School.
pros: Great art style and expressive animation enhances the comedy.
OVA provides closure and further develops a forgotten character.
Humorous and enjoyable continuation of the series.
cons: OVA feels pointless and boring after the main series resolves the central conflict.
Lack of adversity and clear goals makes the characters less interesting.
Killing off the girls in charge
anime.thematic_vibe: Exaggerated Comedy, Pervy Humor, Character Development

anime.title: She and Her Cat: Everything Flows
anime.romaji_title: Kanojo to Kanojo no Neko: Everything Flows
anime.synopsis:
For the longest time, it's just been the two of them. "Kanojo" and her cat Daru are inseparable, having grown up together. Now a junior in college, Tomoka—her roommate of a year and a half—moves out of their shared apartment, and in order to keep her living space, Kanojo must find a job. Day by day, Daru watches her continued efforts from a cat's-eye view, eagerly awaiting his owner's return. When she gets back, once again, it's just she and her cat.

Kanojo to Kanojo no Neko: Everything Flows is a charming short series about the bond between a pet and his owner.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a well-received, emotionally resonant short series that explores the bond between a cat and its owner. The narrative is simple but effective, with many viewers praising its ability to evoke strong feelings in a short amount of time. While some find it lacking in depth, the majority appreciate its heartwarming and realistic portrayal of life's struggles and the comfort found in companionship.
pros: Nuanced portrayal of the bond between pet and owner
Evokes strong emotional responses with a simple story
Unique narrative perspective from the cat
Beautiful animation and fitting soundtrack
Well-paced and impactful despite short episodes
cons: Simplicity may not appeal to all viewers
Some find the story lacking in depth or complexity
Potential for confusion with subtitles; dub recommended by some
Relatively basic drawing style at times

anime.title: Days
anime.synopsis: The series is about two boys named Tsukushi and Jin. Tsukushi is a boy with no special talent or traits while Jin is considered a soccer genius. On one stormy night, Jin meets Tsukushi, and they get dragged into the world of soccer.
anime.consensus_summary: Days is a competent sports anime that emphasizes character development and teamwork. While some find the main character's initial weakness frustrating, others appreciate his growth and the series' inspirational message. The series follows a familiar formula, but is still enjoyable for fans of the genre.
pros: Focuses on character development and team dynamics rather than just the sport itself.
The main character's growth and hard work are emphasized, making the story relatable and inspiring.
Good production values with nice art and music.
cons: Slow character development may deter some viewers.
The main character can be annoying and frustrating at times.
Story relies on familiar sports anime tropes.
Animation occasionally shifts to noticeable 3D/CGI.

anime.title: Kemeko Deluxe!: Izumi-chan, Fukenkou yo! (Kari)
anime.synopsis: Short special bundled with Blu-ray/DVD volume 1.
anime.consensus_summary: This short special is considered standard fan service content, offering little to no narrative value. Its primary focus is on visual appeal, with one reviewer noting a disliked shaky camera effect. The overall impression is that it's easily skippable without impacting the main series experience.
cons: Lack of narrative contribution
Shaky camera effect

anime.title: Love Live! Sunshine!!
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Chika Takami, a self-proclaimed normal girl, has never been involved in any clubs and lacked any notable talents. However, after a visit to Tokyo, she discovers a stage where even an ordinary girl like her could shine—the world of school idols. Inspired by the former superstar school idol group μ's, Chika is determined to start her own school idol club in her seaside hometown at Uranohoshi Girl's High School. But even before gathering any students to join the group, the aspiring school idol finds her greatest obstacle to be student council president Dia Kurosawa who stands firmly against the creation of the club.

Just when it seems there is no hope, Chika meets Riko Sakurauchi, a transfer student from Otonokizaka High School, home of μ's. Somewhat shy but a talented piano player, Chika believes her to be a promising recruit, though convincing her to join is easier said than done. In spite of that, Chika chooses to charge forward and overcome the obstacles keeping her from forming a school idol group that shines as bright as the nine that came before her.
anime.consensus_summary: Love Live! Sunshine!! receives mixed reviews, with some viewers finding it an enjoyable and inspirational successor to the original series, while others criticize its heavy reliance on the original's plot and underdeveloped characters. The animation and music are generally praised, but the overall consensus suggests it falls short of its predecessor for some viewers, while surpassing it for others. Despite its flaws, many find the show charming and appreciate its positive message of pursuing dreams.
pros: Enjoyable characters with charm and quirkiness.
Inspirational themes of perseverance and achieving dreams.
High-quality animation and music production.
Some argue that Sunshine surpasses the original Love Live in certain aspects.
The story has unique strengths and depth, especially in character development and dilemmas.
Positive impact on viewers' attitudes and outlook on life.
cons: Story heavily borrows from the original Love Live!, leading to predictability.
Characters feel underdeveloped due to the large cast size.
Forced member recruitment.
Dialogue can be poorly written and rely on memes.
Inconsistent pacing with slow moments and rushed important events.

anime.title: Haven't You Heard? I'm Sakamoto
anime.synopsis: Sophisticated, suave, sublime; all words which describe the exceedingly handsome and patently perfect Sakamoto. Though it is only his first day in high school, his attractiveness, intelligence, and charm already has the girls swooning and the guys fuming with jealousy. No one seems able to derail him, as all attempts at tripping him up are quickly foiled. His sangfroid is indomitable, his wits peerless. Will any of Sakamoto's classmates, or even teachers, be able to reach his level of excellence? Probably not, but they just might learn a thing or two trying...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on 'Sakamoto desu ga?'. Some find the show's unique and stylish humor to be consistently entertaining and a clever parody of anime tropes. However, others find the humor to be repetitive and the lack of character development and plot to make the show boring after a few episodes, resulting in a polarized reception.
pros: Unique and creative humor
Parody of anime tropes
Stylish visuals and fitting soundtrack
cons: Repetitive humor
Lack of character development
Thin plot
Becomes boring quickly

anime.title: Non Non Biyori Repeat: Hotaru Had Fun
anime.romaji_title: Non Non Biyori Repeat: Hotaru ga Tanoshinda
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Life in rural Asahigaoka moves at its own pace. Devoid of the pleasures and worries of a bustling metropolis, this small village might seem painfully dull at first glance. However, despite living this far from her hometown of Tokyo, Hotaru Ichijou manages to find a group of friends whom she can spend quality time with. No matter whether it is winter, spring, summer, or fall, they make full use of everything the nature around them has to offer.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience expresses strong affection and nostalgia for Non Non Biyori Repeat, particularly enjoying the return to the series' familiar charm and the focus on Hotaru's character. The OVA is perceived as a welcome continuation, maintaining the original's art style and lighthearted narrative.
pros: Art style remains consistent and appealing
Simple, heartwarming story focusing on Hotaru
Characters are consistently cute and enjoyable

anime.title: Digimon Adventure tri. Confession
anime.synopsis:
The Chosen Children are in shock after the betrayal of Meicoomon, the digital monster who had recently joined their group alongside her human partner, Meiko Mochizuki. Koushirou Izumi is determined to diagnose the infection that took control of Meicoomon. Meanwhile, Takeru Takaishi realizes that his own partner, Patamon, is starting to exhibit alarming symptoms similar to those of other infected Digimon, like Meicoomon.

Just then, the Chosen Children receive a message from the mysterious entity Homeostasis, who informs them that their world is in danger of total destruction—and the Digital World, the home of the Digimon, is too. Homeostasis plans to enact a "Reboot," which will reset all the data that makes up the Digital World and eradicate the infection. However, the Reboot will also erase the memories of all Digimon, including the Children's partners. Can the Chosen Children stop Meicoomon before the Reboot becomes necessary, or is this the end of their time together with their Digimon?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While praised for its emotional depth and plot progression, it is criticized for pacing issues, uneven character focus, and animation concerns. The film appears to be a turning point in the series, shifting towards a more mature tone but stumbling in its execution.
pros: Emotional depth and impact
Advancement of the overall plot compared to previous installments
Good character development, particularly in a subversive way for some characters
cons: Pacing issues, with the movie feeling slow until the final act
Uneven character focus, with some characters not getting enough screen time
Animation quality concerns and overuse of CGI

anime.title: Nisekoi: OVA
anime.synopsis:
Shinkon
Finally working in his ideal career as a public servant, Raku Ichijou is able to return home to his loving wife and whisk his worries away. Between freshly prepared meals and his wife's endless affection, Ichijou can think of little else to wish for—but such a seemingly perfect reality may be misleading.

Magical Patissiere Kosaki-chan!!
Dr. Maiko's presence causes peace in Boyari City to remain elusive, but justice is not far away. Learning from their recent efforts, the Magical Princess, ruler of the Land of Magic, tasks Magical Patissiere Kosaki, Magical Police Marika, and Magical Gorilla Chitoge to finish Dr. Maiko for good. However, in order to avoid a repeat of their previous battle, the trio must formulate a brand new strategy to defeat the brazen villain.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience acknowledges the OVA's competent animation and its appeal as a lighthearted treat for existing fans. However, there's significant disappointment regarding the weak scriptwriting, repetitive and shallow plotlines, and the lack of any meaningful contribution to the main series. While some find nostalgia and character charm sufficient, many feel it's a forgettable and dry addition.
pros: Animation is fluid and well-done, consistent with the series' standard.
The OVA provides a lighthearted dose of fan service for existing fans.
Some viewers find the character interactions nostalgic and pleasant.
The magical girl segment's animation and music, particularly the transformation sequence, were occasionally enjoyable.
cons: The scriptwriting is dry and humor falls flat.
Plots are repetitive, shallow, and jump around without proper resolution.
The OVA adds nothing significant to the main plot or character development.
The 'Honeymoon' segments are too short, uninteresting, and lack satisfaction.
The magical girl adventure is empty, relying on transformations and bad comedy.
Characterization remains stagnant, with no change from the main series.
There's a lack of meaningful content and payoff in both segments.

anime.title: Magic of Stella
anime.synopsis: Upon enrolling in high school, Tamaki Honda joins a club for making doujin games known as the SNS Club. Joined by programmer Shiina, writer Ayame, and composer Kayo, Tamaki begins working as an illustrator for the club's next game.
anime.consensus_summary: Stella no Mahou is a typical 'cute girls doing cute things' anime that provides a relaxing and enjoyable experience for fans of the slice-of-life genre. However, it suffers from a generic premise, superficial plot, and underdeveloped characters. While the art style and moe elements are appealing, the lack of depth and inconsistent comedy may not satisfy viewers seeking more substantial content.
pros: Relaxing and easygoing story
Cute character designs and vibrant art style
Enjoyable for fans of the slice-of-life genre
cons: Generic and frivolous premise
Superficial plot with little depth
Underdeveloped characters with limited screen time
Comedy is compulsory and not consistently funny

anime.title: Grimgar: Staking Our Youths on the Bath Wall - One More Centimeter
anime.romaji_title: Hai to Gensou no Grimgar: Furoagari no Kabe ni Kaketa Seishun - One More Centimeter
anime.synopsis: Special episode that will expand on the ending of episode 2 where the boys try to spy on the girls bathing.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is sharply divided, with a significant portion viewing this special as a shallow, unnecessary fan service episode that detracts from the main series. Others, however, find profound philosophical depth and thematic resonance beneath the surface, interpreting it as a crucial exploration of humanity and desire within the context of the original anime.
pros: Deep philosophical undertones and meditations on humanity and desire beneath a surface layer of fan service.
Subtle character moments and thematic density that rewards careful viewing.
Highlights the core themes of reality, consequence, and the fragility of life present in the main series.
Can be a lighthearted comedic extra offering a respite from the main anime's darker tone.
Exceptional attention to detail in art, sound design, and direction that elevates the experience.
cons: Perceived as gratuitous fan service with no contribution to the main story or character development.
Awkward, juvenile, or pointless dialogues that detract from the viewing experience.
Animation and music are considered average, annoying, or bearable at best.
Characters acting out of character, making the episode feel forced and inconsistent with the main series.
A complete waste of time that detracts from the overall quality of the series.

anime.title: Noblesse: Pamyeol-ui Sijak
anime.synopsis:
Humans live their lives driven by ambition and greed, prepared to kill their own kind with no hesitation. Since the beginning of humanity, wars have raged on throughout the human world, with the other races watching on.

A victim of one war and orphaned, Ashleen was saved by the lord of the werewolves, Muzaka. Muzaka had abandoned his duties as lord and left the werewolf clan, travelling with Ashleen to secure her happiness. However, during his absence, members of Muzaka's species began orchestrating further wars on humans, disgusted by Muzaka's compassion. A secret and powerful organization established itself in the human realm, intending to manipulate Muzaka. When he is misinformed by the Union, Muzaka starts directing his rage toward the humans. Can his only friend, Cadis Etrama Di Raizel, the Noblesse, stop Muzuka's madness?

Set 820 years before the events of Noblesse, Noblesse: Pamyeol-ui Sija depicts the tragic history of Muzaka, and how it led to the Noblesse's indefinite slumber.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus suggests Noblesse: Pamyeol-ui Sijak serves as a valuable, albeit brief, prequel for existing fans, offering crucial backstory and character insights. However, its heavy reliance on prior knowledge and the limitations of a single episode make it less accessible and impactful for newcomers, leading to a generally positive but not overwhelmingly enthusiastic reception.
pros: Provides essential backstory for the main Noblesse series, clarifying plot points and character motivations.
Strong character designs, particularly for Raizel and Muzaka, are consistently praised.
Soundtrack and background music effectively enhance emotional scenes and action sequences.
Establishes character relationships clearly, even for viewers unfamiliar with the source material.
cons: Relies heavily on prior knowledge of the Noblesse manhwa, making it difficult for newcomers to fully grasp.
The single-episode format limits emotional connection and character development.
Animation quality is considered decent but not exceptional, with some noting it as 'shaky' or 'not of Production I.G's caliber'.
Villainous side characters are perceived as generic and underdeveloped.

anime.title: Blood Blockade Battlefront OVA
anime.romaji_title: Kekkai Sensen: Ousama no Restaurant no Ousama
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Shounen, Super Power, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
For a rare occasion, the members of Libra have come out of the shadows to dine with an important guest: a royal next in line for the crown of his country. To show their visitor the finest that Hellsalem's Lot has to offer, the group decides to dine at Molzzogazza, the cream of the crop as far as restaurants go in the city.

As the success of this dinner may prove to be beneficial to Libra, Steven A. Starphase mounts the pressure on the team to be on its best behavior and avoid screw-ups. However, Steven has made one oversight. Molzzogazza, famous for its cuisine's indescribable and transcendent flavors, serves food so good that most people lose their minds eating it.
