Zonmi-chan is a clumsy, careless, but cute girl. Sometimes she takes a bite out of the guy she likes. Oh, that's right, Zonmi-chan is a zombie girl.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is that Zonmi-chan is a short, lighthearted anime suitable for Halloween or a quick dose of spooky fun. Viewers find it enjoyable for its brief duration and fun interactions, but acknowledge it is not particularly remarkable or high-quality. Overall, it's a low-stakes watch with limited potential for strong reactions.
pros: Fun interactions
Good for a quick, spooky dose
Low time commitment
cons: Nothing special
Expectations should not be too high
anime.thematic_vibe: Splatter Comedy, Zombie Romance, Short Form

anime.title: Haikyu!! 3rd Season
anime.romaji_title: Haikyuu!! Karasuno Koukou vs. Shiratorizawa Gakuen Koukou
anime.synopsis:
After the victory against Aoba Jousai High, Karasuno High School, once called “a fallen powerhouse, a crow that can’t fly,” has finally reached the climax of the heated Spring tournament. Now, to advance to nationals, the Karasuno team has to defeat the powerhouse Shiratorizawa Academy. Karasuno’s greatest hurdle is their adversary’s ace, Wakatoshi Ushijima, the number one player in the Miyagi Prefecture, and one of the country’s top three aces.

Only the strongest team will make it to the national tournament. Since this match is the third-year players’ last chance to qualify for nationals, Karasuno has to use everything they learned during the training camp and prior matches to attain victory. Filled with restlessness and excitement, both teams are determined to come out on top in the third season of Haikyuu!!.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed Haikyuu!! Karasuno Koukou vs. Shiratorizawa Gakuen Koukou, praising its animation, soundtrack, and character development. However, some felt the pacing was slow due to the focus on a single match, and others found the series relied too heavily on shonen tropes. Despite these criticisms, the season is largely viewed as a worthy continuation of the Haikyuu!! franchise.
pros: Excellent animation quality, especially during action scenes
Inspiring and positive soundtrack that enhances emotional impact
Strong character development, focusing on both Karasuno and Shiratorizawa
Faithful adaptation of the manga's storyline
cons: Pacing issues, particularly the length of a single match stretched over multiple episodes
Repetitive or predictable shonen tropes
Potential disappointment for viewers expecting more story depth beyond the central match
Over-reliance on flashbacks to justify in-game moments

anime.title: The Silver Guardian
anime.synopsis:
High school student and gamer Suigin Riku attends the prestigious Shinryou Private Academy, a school for the elite and the children of the wealthy. But rich or wealthy are not words that describe Suigin; in fact, he is dirt poor and must work many part time jobs to pay for his tuition. During one such job, he dives into a pool to save his pet cat, fully aware that he cannot swim. Luckily, he is saved by Rei Riku, the beautiful and popular daughter of a game developer, and he falls in love with her.

He is also drawn to another girl: a new friend he meets in Dungeon Century, his favorite online RPG. But when the game is scheduled to shut down, he knows his adventures with her will soon end. However, the day after the game is shut down, he finds out that Rei and the online girl are one and the same. Soon after, Rei gives Suigin a new game meant to replace Dungeon Century—a tomb raiding game called Grave Buster. But when Rei is suddenly kidnapped, Suigin is pulled inside Grave Buster to save her.

Gin no Guardian follows Suigin as he plays through Grave Buster to save Rei, while uncovering the secrets hidden within the game.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative. While some appreciate the art, animation, and music, the majority find the story rushed, generic, and full of plot holes. The short episode length is a frequent point of criticism, and the characters are considered underdeveloped and basic. Many feel the series had potential but ultimately failed to deliver a satisfying experience.
pros: Good art and animation in some scenes
Enjoyable outro song
Addictive for casual watchers
cons: Rushed and incomplete experience due to short episodes
Poor story with many plot holes and loose ends
Underdeveloped and basic characters
Generic plot resembling Sword Art Online
Incoherent fight scenes
Lack of character development

anime.title: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! 2
anime.romaji_title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! 2
anime.synopsis:
When Kazuma Satou died, he was given two choices: pass on to heaven or be revived in a fantasy world. After choosing the new world, the goddess Aqua tasked him with defeating the Demon King, and let him choose any weapon to aid him. Unfortunately, Kazuma chose to bring Aqua herself and has regretted the decision ever since then.

Not only is he stuck with a useless deity turned party archpriest, the pair also has to make enough money for living expenses. To add to their problems, their group continued to grow as more problematic adventurers joined their ranks. Their token spellcaster, Megumin, is an explosion magic specialist who can only cast one spell once per day and refuses to learn anything else. There is also their stalwart crusader, Lalatina Ford "Darkness" Dustiness, a helpless masochist who makes Kazuma look pure in comparison.

Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! 2 continues to follow Kazuma and the rest of his party through countless more adventures as they struggle to earn money and have to deal with one another's problematic personalities. However, things rarely go as planned, and they are often sidetracked by their own idiotic tendencies.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on KonoSuba 2. Some viewers find it hilarious and enjoy the characters' antics, while others are disappointed by the repetitive jokes, lack of story progression, and inconsistent art quality. The show's comedic and parodic nature is a major draw for some but a turn-off for others.
pros: Strong character interactions and dynamics.
Consistent and well-done comedy that satirizes the Isekai genre.
Bright and colorful animation that complements the humor.
cons: Repetitive jokes and lack of story progression.
Art quality is inconsistent or a letdown compared to the previous season.
Characters can be unlikable or annoying to some viewers.

anime.title: Battery
anime.synopsis:
At only 12 years old, Takumi Harada is already hailed as a prodigious baseball pitcher. But when his family moves to the backwater town of Nitta, Takumi has no choice but to join his new school's unskilled baseball team. This development has little effect on the boy, as he believes it is more interesting if this no-name club becomes a powerhouse due to his presence. However, due to his overwhelming talent, Takumi is in need of a catcher able to keep up with his pitches.

His worries are soon put to rest after meeting Gou Nagakura. As his fan and fellow student, Gou is eager to prove that he is not a simple braggart, but rather a player skillful enough to catch Takumi's pitches. Amid struggling to form a battery with Gou, Takumi comes into conflict with his new teammates due to his irreverent personality but grapples to find the true joy of the sport under his grandfather's guidance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Some appreciate the show's focus on character drama, realistic tone, and art style, finding it a refreshing take on the sports genre. However, many are disappointed by the slow pace, lack of plot development, unlikeable protagonist, and minimal focus on baseball, leading to a polarized response.
pros: Realistic portrayal of characters and relationships
Beautiful art style with a soft color palette
Well-composed soundtrack and fitting OP/ED themes
cons: Lack of significant plot or character development
Pacing issues and slow progression
Main character's personality can be unlikeable or annoying
Underutilization of the baseball aspect

anime.title: The Great Passage
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Award Winning, Drama, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Kouhei Araki, a veteran editor of the dictionary editorial division at Genbu Publishing, plans to retire in order to better care for his ailing wife. However, before retiring, he must find a replacement to complete his latest project: a new dictionary called The Great Passage. But no matter where he looks, he cannot find anyone suitable, as making a dictionary requires a wealth of patience, time, and dedication.

Mitsuya Majime works in Genbu Publishing's sales division, yet he has poor social skills and an inability to read the mood in most situations. In spite of this, he excels at having an enthusiasm for words thanks to his love of reading and careful personality. It is these skills that draw Araki to him and prompt him to offer Majime a position in the dictionary editorial department. As Majime accepts his new position, he finds himself unsure of his abilities and questioning whether he will fit in with his new co-workers. Yet amid the vast sea of words, The Great Passage will bring them together.
anime.consensus_summary: Fune wo Amu is a heartwarming slice-of-life anime that explores the dedication and passion required to create a dictionary. Viewers appreciate its realistic characters, thoughtful storytelling, and focus on the importance of communication. While the premise may seem mundane to some, the series offers a unique and engaging experience that resonates with those who appreciate character-driven narratives.
pros: Realistic and relatable characters with depth and flaws.
Unique and engaging premise centered around dictionary creation.
Beautifully directed with a focus on character interactions and subtle storytelling.
Highlights the importance of words, communication, and relationships.
Heartfelt and sweet
cons: May seem dull to viewers seeking action or excitement.
The story is very niche and might not appeal to everyone.
Some viewers may find the premise boring initially.

anime.title: Scum's Wish
anime.genres: Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
To the outside world, Hanabi Yasuraoka and Mugi Awaya are the perfect couple. But in reality, they just share the same secret pain: they are both in love with other people they cannot be with. 

Hanabi has loved her childhood friend and neighbor Narumi Kanai for as long as she can remember, so she is elated to discover that he is her new homeroom teacher. However, Narumi is soon noticed by the music teacher, Akane Minagawa, and a relationship begins to blossom between them, much to Hanabi's dismay. 

Mugi was tutored by Akane in middle school, and has been in love with her since then. Through a chance meeting in the hallway, he encounters Hanabi. As these two lonely souls spend more time together, they decide to use each other as a substitute for the one they truly love, sharing physical intimacy with one another in order to stave off their loneliness.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions to Kuzu no Honkai are highly polarized. Some viewers praise its realistic and unflinching portrayal of unrequited love and sexual exploration among teenagers, while others criticize its unlikeable characters, excessive drama, and questionable morals. The show's willingness to tackle taboo subjects divides viewers, with some finding it thought-provoking and others considering it trashy and exploitative. Ultimately, Kuzu no Honkai is a controversial anime that elicits strong emotional responses.
pros: Explores the darker, more complex aspects of love and lust, going beyond typical romance anime tropes.
Characters are flawed and make questionable decisions, leading to compelling drama.
The series delves into the inner monologues of the characters, revealing their boundaries, expectations, and desires.
cons: Characters are often unlikable and make irrational decisions driven by lust and hormones.
Some find the story to be overly dramatic, cringey, and lacking in decency.
Internal monologues can be repetitive and abstract, hindering character development.
The series can be uncomfortable to watch due to its explicit content and exploration of controversial themes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Unrequited Love, Sexual Desperation, Emotional Turmoil

anime.title: Akashic Records of Bastard Magic Instructor
anime.romaji_title: Rokudenashi Majutsu Koushi to Akashic Records
anime.synopsis:
The Alzano Empire is home to one of the most distinguished magic schools in the world: the Alzano Imperial Magic Academy. Here, ambitious young students undergo training to become competent magicians. Sistine Fibel—a stern noble girl—and her bright-eyed best friend Rumia Tingel attend the Academy, determined to cultivate their magical skills.

However, their world is thrown for a loop when their favorite teacher suddenly retires and the enigmatic Glenn Radars replaces him. His lazy and indifferent attitude toward life and magic quickly puts him at odds with his class. What's more, nefarious forces hidden within the empire's walls start to become active, and Sistine, Rumia, and Glenn find themselves caught up in their schemes.

Rokudenashi Majutsu Koushi to Akashic Records follows Sistine, who is captivated by a mysterious floating Sky Castle; Rumia, who is haunted by a troubled past; and Glenn, who may be more than meets the eye. Though completely different on the surface, they are inexplicably bound together by a thread of fate.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the show entertaining due to its comedic elements and the unique protagonist, Glenn. However, many were disappointed by the generic plot, weak characters, and the unfulfilled potential of the initial premise. The series is seen as an average entry in the magic school/harem genre, failing to stand out significantly.
pros: Interesting magic system with well-designed spells and theory.
Glenn Radars is a likable and unique protagonist, especially compared to typical harem MCs; his trollish personality and unorthodox methods are entertaining.
Some found the comedy refreshing and unexpected, especially the interactions between Glenn and Sistine.
cons: Generic and predictable storyline, especially after the first few episodes.
Weak and underdeveloped characters, particularly the female leads who often fall into stereotypical archetypes.
Pacing issues with rushed plot developments and shallow world-building.

anime.title: Regalia: The Three Sacred Stars
anime.synopsis:
In the kingdom of Rimgarde, two mysterious giant robots begin a duel that erases nearly all human life before they disappear. Twelve years later, the young empress of Enastoria, Yuinshiel Asteria, works tirelessly to maintain both her authority and the support of her citizens. But the peace of Enastoria is threatened when survivors of Rimgarde arrive. Armed with giant robots called Regalia Gear, they look for Yuinshiel's adopted sister, Rena. The latter is forced to reveal herself as not just a Regalia Gear wielder, but a real "Regalia"—a human capable of transforming into a giant robot—and the culprit behind the fall of Rimgarde.

Suddenly caught up in an international dispute, Yuinshiel must preserve the security of her country while also protecting Rena from those who wish to abuse her powers. However, by fighting for her sister, Yuinshiel risks triggering the same calamity that once destroyed Rimgarde. Amid such a precarious situation, the two girls push their bond to its limits as they fight not only for themselves but for the world's safety as well.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is largely considered a failure due to its nonsensical plot and underdeveloped characters, despite some redeeming qualities in its music and animation. The initial episodes showed promise, but the story quickly devolved into incoherence. Many viewers found the plot to be a mess, with unexplained motivations and cliche tropes. While some enjoyed the cute character designs, this wasn't enough to save the show from its narrative shortcomings.
pros: Good OP, ED, and some OST tracks.
Animation and visual effects are fine.
Talented voice acting cast.
cons: Poorly written, incoherent story with plot holes and unexplained motivations.
Underdeveloped characters with little impact.
Generic mecha anime with cliches and uninspired battles.
Rushed character arcs and unsatisfying resolutions.
Vague world-building.

anime.title: Occultic;Nine
anime.synopsis:
A blog disproving the supernatural, co-run by NEET teenager Yuuta Gamon and his enthusiastic best friend Ryouka Narusawa, becomes the catalyst that would bring together a group of people who supposedly have nothing to do with each other.

These individuals include high school fortune teller Miyuu Aikawa, who joins Yuuta to work on the blog; realist Sarai Hashigami, who is stunned when tragedy strikes his family; doujin artist Ririka Nishizono, who has an uncanny ability to predict the future with her art; black magic practitioner and local curse expert Aria Kurenaino and her ghostly friend; Shun Moritsuka, a seemingly childish otaku detective; and reporter Touko Sumikaze.

As this unlikely group, bound only by the strings of fate, find their way to each other, they are confronted with murder and other events that are shrouded by the presence of the supernatural. They must band together to solve the mysteries interlacing the city and their lives.
anime.consensus_summary: Occultic;Nine is a divisive anime praised for its unique story, mysterious atmosphere, and intriguing plot twists, but heavily criticized for its breakneck pacing, underdeveloped characters, and confusing narrative. Some viewers found the fast dialogue and complex plot engaging, while others found it overwhelming and difficult to follow. The series is considered a mixed bag with wasted potential due to execution issues.
pros: Unique storytelling style with interconnected plotlines.
Engaging mystery elements and plot twists.
Great soundtrack and fitting sound design.
Interesting character designs and unique art style.
Addresses science in an innovative way.
cons: Extremely fast-paced dialogue makes it hard to follow.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of screentime.
Plot holes and rushed ending.
Inconsistent tone and overcomplicated plot.
Animation is not on par with the studio's other works.
Information dumping with little breathing room.

anime.title: Aggretsuko
anime.synopsis: Whether it be facing misogynistic remarks from her boss or being pressured by condescending co-workers, stress is just another part of the job for 25-year-old red panda Retsuko. Despite being one of the most diligent workers at her office, her diminutiveness and modesty often lead her to be exploited by her colleagues. However, when her irritation hits the limit, Retsuko brings forth her unique brand of letting off steam: aggressive death metal karaoke bashing the idiocy and hypocrisy of her co-workers' actions and work life. Although this venting only takes place in her mind, it gives her an outlet to counter her frustration in a world where hierarchy and appearances reign supreme.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Aggressive Retsuko for its relatable themes and comical portrayal of office life. Viewers find the main character endearing and appreciate the short episode format for providing quick entertainment. While some find the plot simplistic and the art style basic, the show's relatability and humor outweigh these criticisms for most.
pros: Relatable characters and situations
Funny and enjoyable, provides quick laughs
Simple but charming character designs
Good representation of office dynamics
Catchy music
cons: Simple story may not appeal to all
Art and animation are not the best
Some characters may lack depth
Repetitive nature of the show
Lacks emotional impact for some viewers

anime.title: Flip Flappers
anime.synopsis:
Cocona is an average middle schooler living with her grandmother. And she who has yet to decide a goal to strive for, soon met a strange girl named Papika who invites her to an organization called Flip Flap.

Dragged along by the energetic stranger, Cocona finds herself in the world of Pure Illusion—a bizarre alternate dimension—helping Papika look for crystal shards. Upon completing their mission, Papika and Cocona are sent to yet another world in Pure Illusion. As a dangerous creature besets them, the girls use their crystals to transform into magical girls: Cocona into Pure Blade, and Papika into Pure Barrier. But as they try to defeat the creature before them, three others with powers from a rival organization enter the fray and slay the creature, taking with them a fragment left behind from its body. Afterward, the girls realize that to stand a chance against their rivals and the creatures in Pure Illusion, they must learn to work together and synchronize their feelings in order to transform more effectively.
anime.consensus_summary: Flip Flappers is a visually stunning and imaginative anime praised for its creativity and unique storytelling. However, its confusing plot, fan service, and rushed ending divide audiences. While many appreciate its originality and emotional depth, others find the story incoherent and predictable, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Beautiful and unique visuals with sharp storytelling.
Engaging characters and refreshing plot.
Excellent animation and memorable musical scores.
Creative and expressive ideas, drawing from fairy tales.
Exploration of diverse worlds with fun and originality.
cons: Confusing and strange story that can be hit or miss.
Overuse of fan service that detracts from the story.
Predictable plot developments and character arcs.
Inconsistent plot with a rushed ending.
Dialogue can be insufferable with characters constantly screaming each other's names.

anime.title: Hand Shakers
anime.synopsis:
Those who receive the Revelation of Babel must overcome many battles and trials. By grasping the hand of their special partner, these "Hand Shakers" transport themselves to the realm of Ziggurat, an alternate dimension where time no longer exists. Each pair of Hand Shakers must battle it out for the right to meet with God, who will reward them by granting them a single wish.

Tazuna Takatsuki, a high school student with a penchant for fixing things, is one of these Hand Shakers. After receiving a request for repairs from Professor Makihara of a nearby university, Tazuna stumbles upon Koyori Akutagawa, a bedridden girl that reminds him of his deceased sister Musubu. Remembering her dying wish to never let go of her hand, Tazuna grasps Koyori's hand and awakens his power as a Hand Shaker. However, Koyori's life is directly tied to her status as a Hand Shaker, meaning if Tazuna was to ever let go of her hand she would die. With meeting God being their only hope for saving her, the duo must find a way to make their unique powers mesh together, overcome the opposing Hand Shakers, and make their wish come true.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime 'Hand Shakers' is overwhelmingly criticized for its poor execution, despite some potentially interesting concepts. Reviewers consistently highlight the headache-inducing visuals, choppy animation, and nonsensical plot as major drawbacks. While a few viewers appreciate the unique art style and soundtrack, the vast majority express strong disappointment and consider it one of the worst anime they have ever seen, resulting in a highly polarized reception.
pros: Unique art style is appreciated by some viewers.
The soundtrack and opening theme are considered highlights.
Some enjoyed the underlying concepts, such as the bonds between characters and their motivations.
cons: Overly flashy and seizure-inducing visuals cause headaches and disorientation.
Inconsistent animation quality, with choppy movement and jarring CGI.
Poorly written plot with a lack of clear goals or character development.
Forced drama and cliche backstories, leading to a lack of emotional investment.
Inconsistent plot and nonsensical narrative
Overuse of camera techniques like tilting and panning.
Many consider it the worst anime ever due to the numerous flaws.

anime.title: Natsume's Book of Friends Season 5
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Blessed with eyes that are able to perceive the otherwise invisible youkai, Takashi Natsume hides his ability from his newfound family and friends to protect everyone's peaceful daily life. Nonetheless, Natsume never fails to show the same kindness to the benevolent youkai and happily returns their names by using the infamous Book of Friends he inherited from his late grandmother, Reiko.

Meanwhile, the exorcist clan Matoba still wishes for Natsume to join their ranks due to his overwhelming gift. However, Natsume firmly rejects the clan's invitation since not all exorcists are as reasonable as his friend Shuuichi Natori, and many improperly and indiscriminately seal away every youkai in their way. Unsatisfied with Natsume's answer, Seiji Matoba blackmails Natsume into attending a grand gathering of powerful exorcist families. Natsume soon finds himself in the company of dangerous people and youkai alike. But even then, he continues to defy the exorcists' hard-handed methods and believes that peace between both worlds is possible.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's heartwarming stories, beautiful art, and well-developed characters. Viewers appreciate the emotional depth and the iyashikei (healing) atmosphere. Some viewers express a desire for a more significant overarching plot, but overall, the season is well-received as a continuation of the beloved series.
pros: Heartwarming and fluffy stories.
Beautiful art and animation.
Well-developed characters and backstories.
Emotional and thought-provoking episodic format.
cons: Lack of overarching story development.
Repetitive episodic format may become predictable for some viewers.

anime.title: Yuri!!! On Ice
anime.synopsis:
Reeling from his crushing defeat at the Grand Prix Finale, Yuuri Katsuki, once Japan's most promising figure skater, returns to his family home to assess his options for the future. At age 23, Yuuri's window for success in skating is closing rapidly, and his love of pork cutlets and aptitude for gaining weight are not helping either.

However, Yuuri finds himself in the spotlight when a video of him performing a routine previously executed by five-time world champion, Victor Nikiforov, suddenly goes viral. In fact, Victor himself abruptly appears at Yuuri's house and offers to be his mentor. As one of his biggest fans, Yuuri eagerly accepts, kicking off his journey to make it back onto the world stage. But the competition is fierce, as the rising star from Russia, Yuri Plisetsky, is relentlessly determined to defeat Yuuri and win back Victor's tutelage.
anime.consensus_summary: Yuri!!! on Ice is a polarizing anime, praised for its representation and character development, yet criticized for animation flaws and perceived queerbaiting. Some viewers found it deeply moving and inspirational, while others felt it was overhyped and lacking in substance. The series sparks debate about its portrayal of LGBTQ+ themes and its impact on the sports anime genre.
pros: Positive representation of LGBTQ+ themes and relationships.
Well-developed and relatable characters.
Exploration of anxiety, depression, and personal struggles.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, especially during skating sequences.
Overhyped status leading to disappointment for some viewers.
Ambiguity in the romantic relationship, with some labeling it as queerbaiting.

anime.title: 91 Days
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Drama, Historical, Organized Crime, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
As a child living in the town of Lawless, Angelo Lagusa has witnessed a tragedy: his parents and younger brother have been mercilessly slaughtered by the Vanetti mafia family. Losing everything he holds dear, he leaves both his name and hometown behind, adopting the new identity of Avilio Bruno.

Seven years later, Avilio finally has his chance for revenge when he receives a mysterious letter prompting him to return to Lawless. Obliging, he soon encounters the Vanetti don's son, Nero, and seeks to befriend him using the skills he has quietly honed for years.

Set during the Prohibition era, 91 Days tells the story of Avilio's dark, bloodstained path to vengeance, as he slowly ends each of the men involved in the killing of his family.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on '91 Days.' Some appreciate the dark, grounded revenge story set in the Prohibition era, while others criticize the inconsistent animation, shallow characters, and nonsensical plot developments. Ultimately, the show's quality seems to decline in the latter half, leading to disappointment for some viewers.
pros: Intense and well-executed story
Compelling characters
Unique setting and lack of anime tropes
cons: Inconsistent animation quality
One-dimensional supporting characters
Plot becomes absurd and illogical in later episodes

anime.title: Magical Girl Raising Project
anime.genres: Action, Gore, High Stakes Game, Mahou Shoujo, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
For many girls in N-City, playing the popular social role-playing game Magical Girl Raising Project is as close as they could come to being a real magical girl. However, for some rare players, that dream can become a reality. One such girl is Koyuki Himekawa, who receives a notification one night that she has been selected to become a magical girl, her in-game avatar Snow White.

As Koyuki and other chosen players in the city begin helping those in need, they all receive yet another notification: the admins have decided that they want to reduce the number of magical girls. Whoever collects the least amount of Magical Candies—which are awarded for their magical girl activities—in their competition each week will lose their powers. But when a real-world tragedy happens to the first player that drops out, they are shown the repercussions of losing their abilities. As more participants inevitably lose the competition and more twisted rules are added, the girls soon realize that their "contest" is actually a desperate fight for survival.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience mood is divided. Some viewers appreciate the dark twist on the magical girl genre and the battle royale concept, finding it entertaining despite its flaws. However, many criticize the show for its shallow characters, reliance on shock value, and underdeveloped plot, ultimately deeming it a disappointment with wasted potential.
pros: Unique character designs and abilities for some characters.
Good art and animation quality.
Some plot twists make the show enjoyable.
cons: Excessive number of characters in a short series, leading to underdeveloped backstories and emotional impact.
Story relies on shock value and cliches, lacking deeper moral messages or overarching reasons for events.
Feels like a Puella Madoka Magica ripoff.
Ending is bland and unsatisfying.

anime.title: Tanaka is Listless Today Too
anime.synopsis: A series of shorts featuring the characters from Tanaka-kun wa Itsumo Kedaruge in chibi form.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the mini-series as a lighthearted and fun continuation of the main anime, praising the characters and art style. However, some find the story simple and the main character's laziness potentially off-putting. Overall, it's recommended for fans of the original series looking for a quick and entertaining watch.
pros: Characters are fun and well-developed.
Mini-series expands on characters beyond the main character.
Art style is cute and simplistic.
cons: Story can be plain, simple, and boring.
Main character's actions can be pointless and foolish.
May induce feelings of tiredness due to the main character's demeanor.

anime.title: FLCL Progressive
anime.genres: Avant Garde, Comedy, Mecha, Parody, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Hidomi Hibajiri is a disillusioned young girl who never takes off her headphones. Her whole life consists of going to school, helping out at her mother's cafe, and listening to music. And with nothing else to break the crippling monotony, she keeps her headphones on at all times. That is, until she is run over by a mysterious guitar-wielding woman.

That same night, a robot barges into Hidomi’s room along with a boy from her class, Ko Ide, and the kids are chased around town together. They're saved by the guitar-wielding woman from before, but now Hidomi's got a horn growing from her forehead? Who knows where these robots are coming from, what kind of vespa woman this weird guitar woman is warning her about, or what this thing on her forehead is, but it doesn't look like Hidomi is going to be able to ignore all this with headphones!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily polarized, with many feeling the sequel fails to capture the magic and essence of the original FLCL. While some appreciate the continuation of the lore and certain creative animation choices, a significant portion views it as a creatively bankrupt imitation that sacrifices the original's unique spirit for fanservice and a hollow narrative.
pros: The return of The Pillows for the soundtrack is consistently praised.
Some viewers found the animation creative, particularly in dream sequences.
The voice acting for the main protagonist, Hidomi, is noted as talented.
Certain characters, like Fuyumi, are highlighted as interesting.
The sequel attempts to build upon the established lore of the original FLCL.
cons: The sequel is frequently criticized for lacking the charm, originality, and thematic depth of the original.
The writing is described as nonsensical, with plot points feeling forced or amateurish.
Character development is inconsistent, with main characters often perceived as flat, empty, or lacking agency.
The animation quality is inconsistent, with some episodes or sequences being praised while others are deemed average or poor.
The use of callbacks and music from the original is often seen as a crutch or a misused attempt at nostalgia.

anime.title: Island
anime.synopsis:
On a remote island far from the mainland named Urashima, a man washes ashore, with no recollection of his name or homeland. What he does recall, however, is that he is a time traveler with a mission: to save a certain girl from harm. As nightfall arrives, he meets Rinne Ohara, a girl who sings a tune that reminds him of a specific name—Setsuna—and decides to use it as his own.

Knowing another "Setsuna" herself, Rinne takes him to her household as a servant, hoping that he is the same one she remembers. On the other hand, Setsuna continues to learn more about Urashima, desiring to identify his lost past. He comes to know about the island's folklore, its three great families, and the endemic disease that prevents anyone afflicted from stepping out into the daylight. 

As the mysteries of his missing memories and Urashima itself unfold, Setsuna must remember his purpose and fulfill his mission as soon as possible. But, as he witnesses the myriad of troubles plaguing the island, Setsuna begins to question—is his temporal displacement merely an effort to change a single girl's fate?
anime.consensus_summary: The anime 'Island' receives mixed to negative reviews. Many find the plot convoluted, rushed, and poorly explained, with underdeveloped characters and questionable content. While some appreciate the initial concept and art style, the overwhelming consensus points to a disappointing adaptation with significant flaws in its narrative and execution, resulting in a polarized audience.
pros: Interesting story concept with potential twists.
Appealing art style and character designs to some viewers.
Atmospheric music and well-fitting OST.
cons: Rushed and confusing plot with pacing issues.
Poor character development and generic personalities.
Unnecessary fanservice and questionable content.
Incoherent time travel mechanics and plot holes.
Weak adaptation of the visual novel.

anime.title: Katsugeki Touken Ranbu
anime.synopsis:
In 1863, Izuminokami Kanesada and his partner, Horikawa Kunihiro, arrive in the streets of Edo from the future to investigate their master's reports of an upcoming enemy invasion. As humanoid manifestations of the famous Toshizou Hijikata's swords, they have been tasked with protecting history from the Retrograde Army that seeks to alter it. Soon enlisting the help of other sword warriors, they continuously battle the mysterious army throughout the Bakumatsu period.

However, their journey will not be an easy one. Fraught with blood and betrayal in the chaotic era closest to their hearts, the duo will be forced to make difficult decisions with everything they care about on the line.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with strong appreciation for the visual and auditory aspects, but criticism for a weak and confusing plot. The anime is primarily enjoyed by existing fans of the game, while newcomers find it difficult to engage with due to a lack of context and character depth. Many feel the series prioritizes aesthetics over substance, ultimately serving as an advertisement for the game.
pros: Stunning animation and visuals by Ufotable, especially the backgrounds and action sequences.
Well-suited and evocative soundtrack, enhancing the historical setting and action.
Enjoyable for fans of the Touken Ranbu franchise due to the animated portrayal of the characters.
cons: Weak plot and lack of clear direction, with a repetitive 'preserve history' theme.
Underdeveloped characters, with many feeling bland or inconsistent, hindering emotional investment.
Assumes prior knowledge of the Touken Ranbu game, making it difficult for newcomers to understand the story and characters.
Generic and predictable story elements, failing to offer anything new or groundbreaking.

anime.title: Reikenzan: Eichi e no Shikaku
anime.synopsis: After two years of studying within the Reiken clan, Ouriku and other inexperienced disciples are ordered to descend to the temporal world for further studies, and Ouriku embarks the journey back to his birthplace.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, particularly regarding the second season. Some appreciate the spiritual themes, protagonist, and adventure elements. However, many find the second season weaker, with a confusing and rushed storyline, different character designs, and unnecessary plot elements. There is a noticeable split between those who enjoyed the tonal shift and those who preferred the first season's lighter approach.
pros: Ideal Protagonist
Playful protagonist with fun interactions
Concepts on getting strong/powerful
Beautiful background environmental art (Season 2)
cons: Weaker than the first season, different feel
Unexplained character relationship changes and departure from Oriku's typical behavior
Storyline in season 2 is unnecessarily confusing and rushed
Character designs changed a lot in Season 2
Unnecessary adulterated jokes and Yaoi references

anime.title: Ragnastrike Angels
anime.synopsis: In the near future, massive hostile beings called "Fiarem" are waging war on Earth. To defend the world from this alien threat, Japan unleashes a special team known as "Ragna Strikers"—six young women wielding advanced weaponry and the ability to grow to gigantic sizes. Ragnastrike Angels follows Ayano Anemori and her friends as they live their daily lives and battle the violent Fiarem.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is that Ragnastrike Angels is essentially a very short advertisement for a mobile game. While some appreciate its brevity and art style, most find it lacking in plot, character development, and overall substance. It's considered harmless due to its short length but ultimately forgettable.
pros: Short episodes make it easy to watch.
Nice art and cute character designs.
cons: No plot or character development.
Feels like a glorified advertisement for a mobile game.
Unresolved ending.

anime.title: Touken Ranbu - Hanamaru
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2205, a special sage known as Saniwa has the ability to breathe life into inanimate objects. At the same time, dark forces have initiated a plot to travel back in time and change the course of history—and the only ones capable of stopping them are the Saniwa and their strongest animations: historical Japanese swords, in the form of handsome young men.

Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru opens on the life of Yamatonokami Yasusada, Souji Okita's beloved uchigatana, as he begins his first day at the Saniwa's citadel. Soon reuniting with his old friend, Kashuu Kiyomitsu, the two are caught up in the daily antics of their fellow sword warriors. They never miss an opportunity to have fun, whether it be through wild snowball fights or introducing their newest comrades to the citadel. Of course, when the government calls, the swords are always ready to fulfill their mission of protecting history.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided based on familiarity with the Touken Ranbu game. Fans of the game find it a heartwarming and enjoyable addition to the franchise, appreciating the character interactions and lighthearted nature.  However, those unfamiliar with the game find the plot weak, character overload overwhelming, and overall experience boring. The anime is primarily seen as fanservice.
pros: Heartwarming and relaxing.
Characters have unique personalities and interactions.
Visually pleasing art style.
cons: Story is almost non-existent.
Relies heavily on prior knowledge of the game.
Character development is limited due to the large cast.

anime.title: Majestic Prince The Movie: Genetic Awakening
anime.romaji_title: Ginga Kikoutai Majestic Prince Movie: Kakusei no Idenshi
anime.synopsis:
The alien Wulgaru's last assault against humanity was foiled by the heroic actions of the genetically enhanced humans known as the Evolved Children in their advanced AHSMB battle armor, but now a new attack has been launched against Earth under an even deadlier champion, Diorna, created from the fusion of DNA from two Wulgaru Royals.

Unfortunately, Izuru Hitachi, the leader of Team Rabbits who defeated the Wulgaru Royal Jiart, is still out of action and recovering, so the task of marshalling the Majestic Princes and stopping Diorna falls upon the unready shoulders of Toshikazu Asagi. Together with the remaining members of Team Rabbits and the recently created Team Fawn, it’s up to Asagi to hold the line against the most ruthless adversary yet.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie provides more of the same mecha action and humor from the original series, focusing on Asagi's role. However, it fails to address unresolved plot threads and doesn't introduce any new thematic elements. The film is enjoyable on its own but feels unnecessary within the broader context of the Majestic Prince storyline.
pros: More mecha action
Humor is still there
Asagi gets the spotlight
cons: Plot threads from the anime are not elaborated
Doesn't question, reinforce or say anything new about instincts vs altruism
Has no reason to exist in the context of the series
anime.thematic_vibe: Mecha Action, Instinct vs Altruism, Teamwork

anime.title: Time Bokan 24
anime.synopsis: Tokio is a junior high student living in the present time who is recruited to be a member of the 24th century's Space-Time Administration Bureau. Together with his partner Calen, their mission is to uncover the "True History", the part of history that the textbooks doesn't tell. But in their way is the Akudama Trio that intends to prevent the True History from being revealed for their own personal gains.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some appreciate the show's humor, creative mecha designs, and the appeal of the villains, while others find the plot nonsensical, the puns terrible, and the show morally questionable for children. The series is considered a fun, albeit flawed, entry in the superhero comedy genre, but it does not reach the quality of previous Time Bokan iterations.
pros: Creative and ridiculous episodic formula.
Excellent mecha designs.
Humorous and well-developed villains (Akudarma Gang).
Serves as an exposure to the Time Bokan series for new audiences.
cons: Plotline makes no sense and is not entertaining.
Bad puns and humor.
Questionable morals for a kids' series (distrust of textbooks).
Inconsistent quality between episodes; fails to reach the heights of its predecessor.

anime.title: Infini-T Force
anime.synopsis: Emi is a seventeen-year-old girl living in Shibuya. Her father is always away with work and she's grown listless. Suddenly, a twist of fate involving a certain magical item changes everything. A mysterious pencil, of all things, is linked to the appearance of heroes from another world! Could this be the start to the excitement she's so desperately craving, or is there something more?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the animation and plot, many find the dialogue and character development lacking. Emi's character arc is a highlight for some, but overall the show fails to fully utilize its crossover potential and suffers from poor writing. The show doesn't do a good job representing or explaining those characters to a new audience.
pros: Fluid and amazing 3D animation, especially for mechanical objects.
Interesting plot with mystery elements.
Emi's character arc is likeable and understandable.
cons: Poor dialogue, possibly due to translation or intentional corniness.
Uneven character development, with focus primarily on Ken and Emi.
Villains are cliche and uninteresting.
Fights sequences are largely forgettable.

anime.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School - Despair Arc
anime.romaji_title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Kibougamine Gakuen - Zetsubou-hen
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, School, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Hope's Peak Academy's unconventional class 77-B is about to have an even more eccentric addition: Chisa Yukizome, an alumna with the title of Super High School-Level Housekeeper—and their new homeroom teacher. Cheerful, passionate, and capable, Chisa immediately sets about correcting the students' problematic behavior and strengthening their relationships. It may not be easy dealing with diverse pupils ranging from princesses and nurses to yakuza and impossibly lucky students, but anything is possible with the power of hope.

Meanwhile, Hajime Hinata, an unremarkable boy from the school's Reserve Course, longs for a talent. One day, he has an unexpected meeting with class 77-B's Super High School-Level Gamer Chiaki Nanami, who presents to him a new, hope-filled outlook on life. However, unbeknownst to him, the school's upper echelon is about to execute a sinister project centered around Hajime that will bring Hope's Peak—and the rest of the world—to its knees.

Zetsubou-hen chronicles the daily lives carried out at the talent-cultivating academy, and the darkness that lurks beneath. As despair slowly infects hope, plans are put into motion to start the Biggest, Most Awful, Most Tragic Event in Human History, and the end begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Danganronpa 3: Despair Arc is a divisive entry in the series. While some appreciate the expansion of the lore and character backstories, many find the plot predictable, rushed, and contradictory to the established canon. It's considered essential to have played the previous games to understand the anime, but even then, enjoyment varies widely.
pros: Expands on the backstory of Danganronpa 2 characters.
Provides context for the events leading up to 'The Tragedy'.
The art style maintains the vibrant colors of the series.
cons: Plot holes and inconsistencies contradict established lore.
Rushed pacing and lack of character development.
Predictable storyline due to its prequel nature.

anime.title: Scorching Ping Pong Girls
anime.synopsis:
In the world of Japanese ping pong, a mighty king has fallen. An underdog team suddenly breaks the indomitable Oudou Academy's nine year winning streak, creating a power vacuum as players everywhere are given hope that they too can reach the national tournament.

Suzumegahara Middle School is home to a small-time team: Hanabi Tenka, who has a rapid attack style; Hokuto Itsumo, who can predict the ball's most likely path; Agari Kamiya, famous for her signature backhand smash; vice-captain Mune Oomune, who has an aggressive playstyle; and team captain Kiruka Ushirode, who possesses an impenetrable defense. Despite their skill at ping pong, the team has never made it further than the local city tournaments.

But everything changes when transfer student Koyori Tsumujikaze arrives in town. Filled with an intense love of the game, she quickly makes a name for herself as another top player on the team. Koyori's positive attitude towards ping pong lights a fire in each of the girls' competitive hearts, and together they embark on a mission to win the national tournament.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences found 'Shakunetsu no Takkyuu Musume' to be a pleasant and enjoyable, albeit not particularly deep, sports anime. The cute art style and upbeat soundtrack were praised, but the simplistic plot and generic characters were points of criticism. Some viewers found the excessive moe elements off-putting, while others appreciated the lighthearted and feel-good nature of the show.
pros: Enjoyable and upbeat OST that enhances the intensity of matches.
Cute and charming art style that complements the enthusiastic characters.
Likeable characters with unique quirks that make them fun to watch.
cons: Generic and clichéd characters with little development.
Simplistic and predictable story with an underwhelming ending.
Overreliance on blushing and moe elements that can feel awkward and forced.

anime.title: Drifters: Special Edition
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Gore, Historical, Isekai, Military, Samurai, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the fifth manga volume.
anime.consensus_summary: The special edition is considered a pointless compilation of the first two episodes. Viewers felt it offered nothing new and was redundant for those already familiar with the series. The overall sentiment is negative, with many suggesting to simply watch the original episodes instead.
cons: Pointless compilation
No new content or edits
Redundant if you've seen the first two episodes

anime.title: Kinmoza! Pretty Days
anime.genres: CGDCT, School, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: The episode is set during a school festival where Shinobu is assigned to write a script and make outfits for her class play. Youko and Alice notice that Shinobu is sleepy every morning and are worried that she might be getting tired of all the work. Will Shinobu be able to successfully complete all her tasks in time?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the movie for its heartwarming portrayal of friendship and character development, particularly the focus on Aya's backstory. While some find the story lacks significant progress and relies on familiar elements, the overall sentiment is positive, praising the art style and music. The movie is considered a pleasant addition to the Kiniro Mosaic series for fans of the slice-of-life genre.
pros: Focuses on character backstories and development, particularly Aya's.
Maintains the art style and charm of the original series.
Excellent music that enhances emotional impact.
cons: Story may not provide significant progress beyond the original series.
Relies on familiar comedic scenarios and may feel repetitive.
Animation color can be off at times.

anime.title: Yuyushiki: Komarasetari, Komarasaretari
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Fans of the original Yuyushiki series appreciate this OVA for delivering more of the same charming humor and character interactions they enjoy. Some acknowledge the lack of plot but consider it a minor issue in the context of the show's strengths.
pros: Unique and random comedy
Natural character interactions
Faithful to the original series
cons: Plotless formula

anime.title: The Moment You Fall in Love
anime.romaji_title: Suki ni Naru Sono Shunkan wo. Kokuhaku Jikkou Iinkai
anime.synopsis:
Following Natsuki Enomoto's confession rehearsals with Yuu Setoguchi, their younger siblings Kotarou and Hina struggle to confess their own love. Despite a disastrous first meeting in middle school with her upperclassman Koyuki Ayase, Hina’s heart is captured by his warm smile. Initially confused by these newfound feelings, Hina soon realizes that she has fallen in love for the very first time.

Chasing after her brother Yuu and her crush Koyuki, Hina also enrolls in Sakuragaoka High School; but the threads of love are far-reaching, and they entangle Hina and her friends. Boisterous but sensitive, Hina hopes to confess her feelings to the tender-hearted Koyuki. Meanwhile, Kotarou, oblivious to his own feelings for her, is determined to always keep Hina smiling.

Suki ni Naru Sono Shunkan wo.: Kokuhaku Jikkou linkai follows Hina, Kotarou, and Koyuki in high school. Their youthful love forges new relationships, but also threatens to break others.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the movie cute, enjoyable, and relatable, particularly praising the art and music. However, many were disappointed by the weak ending, cliche story, and underdeveloped characters, resulting in a generally lukewarm response.
pros: Appealing art style and animation quality.
Enjoyable music and original soundtrack.
Decent characters with individual characteristics.
cons: Weak or disappointing ending, lacks closure.
Cliche story and predictable plot elements.
Rushed pacing and insufficient character development.
Nonsensical romance and terrible writing
anime.thematic_vibe: Youthful Romance, Unrequited Love, High School Drama

anime.title: TSUKIUTA. The Animation
anime.synopsis: Tsukino Talent Productions is home to two up-and-coming idol units named Six Gravity and Procellarum. The units all live together in the same dormitory and try to juggle their budding careers and daily lives. At their joint handshake event, unit leaders Hajime Mutsuki and Shun Shimotsuki announce the "Full Moon Festival"—a collaboration concert in a few months. Excited about the upcoming event, these 12 male idols must learn to collaborate with each other in order to pull it off successfully.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is positive, especially among fans of the music and characters. Viewers appreciate the relaxing and relatable slice-of-life aspects of the series, although some find the lack of a strong plot and rushed character development to be drawbacks. The music and seiyuu performances are generally praised, contributing to the overall enjoyment of the anime.
pros: Soothing soundtrack, especially character songs.
Relatable experiences of idols and their daily lives.
Enjoyable and relaxing to watch, good for taking a break from more intense series.
cons: Lack of overarching plot, more episodic.
Character development is rushed or not fully explored in the anime alone.
Some viewers may find the CGI during performances awkward or not the best quality.

anime.title: BBK/BRNK: The Gentle Giants of the Galaxy
anime.synopsis: Sequel of Bubuki Buranki.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response is mixed. While some appreciate the improved animation and sound design, the majority find the story weak, the characters underdeveloped, and the overall experience disappointing. Many feel the series had potential but ultimately falls short.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to the first season.
Unique character designs.
Amazing soundtrack and sound design, especially during action scenes.
cons: Story lacks engagement, action, and intensity.
Dialogue between characters feels dull.
CGI is still a work in progress with sloppy and incomplete scenes.
Character development feels rushed and inconsistent.
Lack of interactive environments and interesting narrative.

anime.title: B-Project: Kodou*Ambitious
anime.synopsis: The anime's story follows Tsubasa, a new hire in the A&R department of the major recording company Gandala Music. Tsubasa is immediately assigned to oversee the idol unit "B-PROJECT," which is made up of three idol groups: Kitakore, THRIVE, and MooNs. This is Tsubasa's first job, and she gets involved in various incidents and accidents as she deals with this group of young men who each have their own differing personalities.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While the music and character designs are appreciated, the show is heavily criticized for its inconsistent animation, rushed and confusing plot, and weak character development, especially towards the ending. Many feel the anime fails to live up to its potential, especially for fans of the B-Project franchise and idol anime in general.
pros: Catchy and enjoyable music with good voice acting.
Some likable characters with unique designs.
Enjoyable and entertaining episodes in the first half.
cons: Inconsistent and sometimes bad animation quality.
Rushed and confusing ending with plot holes.
Weak character development for many of the idols.
Poorly executed plot twists and nonsensical story elements.

anime.title: Fate/Extra: Last Encore
anime.synopsis:
A technological hell masquerading as paradise, Tsukimihara Academy is an artificial high school that serves as the setting for the next Holy Grail War. Created by the Moon Cell computer, the school is inhabited by Earth-projected souls who have even the slightest aptitude for being a "Master." Of these 256 souls, 128 will be chosen for the main tournament and granted a Servant. With all of the Masters selected, the Academy activates a purge, targeting the remaining lifeforms for elimination.

Awakening in a pool of his own blood, Hakuno Kishinami refuses to die. Fueled by unknown feelings of hatred, he vows to fight for survival. As he struggles to escape from a relentless pursuer, he finds a crimson blade plunged into the ground; and by pulling it out, Hakuno summons his own Servant, Saber, who instantly destroys his pursuer in a flurry of rose petals. With his newfound power, Hakuno must now begin his journey to Moon Cell's core, the Angelica Cage. There, he will unveil the reason for this artificial world and the secrets of his own blood-soaked past.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with some praising the show's philosophical depth, unique visuals, and main characters, while others criticize its convoluted story, underdeveloped side characters, and Shaft's unconventional art style. Many viewers find the plot confusing and hard to follow, and the fan service elements are a point of contention. Despite its flaws, some appreciate the show's distinct take on the Fate franchise and its exploration of psychological themes.
pros: Interesting philosophical dialogues between characters.
Unique and creative animation style by Studio Shaft.
Catchy opening theme song.
Well-developed main characters (Hakuno and Nero).
Visually stunning scenery and directing that conveys a sense of dread.
cons: Convoluted and confusing story that is not well-explained.
Underdeveloped side characters and rushed resolutions.
Inconsistent pacing and excessive flashbacks.
Shaft's art style may not appeal to all viewers, especially those expecting Ufotable-like animation.
Overreliance on fan service and sexualization of characters.

anime.title: Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel - II. Lost Butterfly
anime.romaji_title: Fate/stay night Movie: Heaven's Feel - II. Lost Butterfly
anime.synopsis:
The Fifth Holy Grail War continues, and the ensuing chaos results in higher stakes for all participants. Shirou Emiya continues to participate in the war, aspiring to be a hero of justice who saves everyone. He sets out in search of the truth behind a mysterious dark shadow and its murder spree, determined to defeat it.

Meanwhile, Shinji Matou sets his own plans into motion, threatening Shirou through his sister Sakura Matou. Shirou and Rin Toosaka battle Shinji, hoping to relieve Sakura from the abuses of her brother. But the ugly truth of the Matou siblings begins to surface, and many dark secrets are exposed.

Fate/stay night Movie: Heaven's Feel - II. Lost Butterfly continues to focus on the remaining Masters and Servants as they fight each other in the hopes of obtaining the Holy Grail. However, as darkness arises within Fuyuki City, even the state of their sacred war could be in danger.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized. Some praise the movie for its stunning visuals, mature themes, and character development, particularly Sakura. Others criticize it for its fast pacing, mature themes, and perceived hyper-sexualization, leading to a divisive viewing experience.
pros: Stunning animation and visual arts by Ufotable.
Strong character development, especially for Sakura and Shirou.
The film offers a darker and more mature take on the Fate/Stay Night story.
Fast-paced and engaging plot with constant twists and turns.
cons: Pacing may be too fast for some viewers unfamiliar with the source material.
The film contains mature themes, including sexual abuse, which may be off-putting to some viewers.
Some argue that the hyper-sexualization of characters does not add to the plot.
Compressed adaptation leads to some plot points feeling rushed or underdeveloped.

anime.title: Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel - III. Spring Song
anime.romaji_title: Fate/stay night Movie: Heaven's Feel - III. Spring Song
anime.synopsis:
The Fifth Holy Grail War in Fuyuki City has reached a turning point in which the lives of all participants are threatened as the hidden enemy finally reveals itself. As Shirou Emiya, Rin Toosaka, and Illyasviel von Einzbern discover the true, corruptive nature of the shadow that has been rampaging throughout the city, they realize just how dire the situation is. In order to protect their beloved ones, the group must hold their own against the seemingly insurmountable enemy force—even if some of those foes were once their allies, or perhaps, something more intimate.

As the final act of this chaotic war commences, the ideals Shirou believes will soon be challenged by an excruciating dilemma: is it really possible to save a world where everything seems to have gone wrong?
anime.consensus_summary: The final installment of the Heaven's Feel trilogy is a visually stunning and emotionally resonant experience, particularly for fans of the visual novel. However, some viewers may find the plot confusing or the ending rushed if they are not familiar with the source material. While the animation and action sequences are widely praised, the adaptation's faithfulness to the original story is a point of contention.
pros: Stunning animation and fight choreography by Ufotable.
Satisfying conclusion to the Heaven's Feel trilogy for VN fans.
Great soundtrack and sound design enhances emotional scenes.
Well-developed characters and emotional depth.
cons: May be confusing for viewers unfamiliar with the visual novel.
Plot and character motivations can be inconsistent.
Ending may feel rushed or unsatisfying.
Adaptation leaves out important details from the source material.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans 2nd Season
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Tekketsu no Orphans 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
Tekkadan has now become a direct affiliate of Teiwaz after procuring a new trade agreement with Arbrau. With its newfound funds and prestige, Tekkadan finds both its list of allies and enemies growing. Meanwhile, the flames of the Gjallarhorn power struggle continue to rage in full force. As a part of her efforts to make Mars financially independent from Earth, Kudelia Aina Bernstein founds the Admoss Company and enlists Tekkadan as her business partner. 

The stakes are getting higher as the Tekkadan family continues to grow. Will Orga, Mikazuki, and the rest of the Tekkadan faction be able to keep up, or will Kudelia's dream of Martian independence die out?
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Iron-Blooded Orphans is a divisive entry in the Gundam franchise. While praised for its unique elements, soundtrack, and action, it's also criticized for a convoluted plot and unsatisfying character arcs. The ending is described as bittersweet, leaving a lasting impact despite its flaws.
pros: Excellent soundtrack and sound design that evoke strong emotions.
Brutal and emotionally gripping fight scenes.
Unique mecha designs, particularly the Gundam Barbatos.
cons: Story becomes clustered and unfocused with too many half-baked subplots.
Inconsistent pacing, especially in the latter half of the season where character deaths feel rushed.
Romance elements feel awkward and forced.

anime.title: Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 2202
anime.romaji_title: Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2202: Ai no Senshi-tachi
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Drama, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
Three years since the return of the legendary Space Battleship Yamato, Earth has begun rebuilding itself and has made peace with the Gamilans. However, this recovery comes at the cost of utilizing the forbidden Wave Motion technology. 

Meanwhile, the notorious former crew members of the Yamato, who have each gone their separate ways, receive a psychic message from the mysterious Goddess Teresa. She urges them to return to their beloved ship and travel to the distant planet Terezart. They are promised a revolutionary power to combat the unprecedented threat of the relentless Gatlantis Empire, who are approaching Earth with all but innocent intentions.

Unable to resist her plea, the crew reassembles and sets sail on another perilous intergalactic voyage, one that will test their sheer courage and versatility in the face of an even greater foe.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Some viewers appreciate the emotional depth, space battles, and thematic exploration, while others critique the plot inconsistencies, reliance on mystical elements, and weak antagonists.  The series is considered a letdown compared to its predecessor, 2199, creating a polarized fanbase.
pros: Spectacular space battles
Great soundtrack
Meaningful character development
cons: Inconsistent plot
Mystical elements detract from the story
Faceless enemy
Copy-and-paste space fights

anime.title: Bungo Stray Dogs 2 - Walking Alone
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Detective, Mystery, Organized Crime, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Armed Detective Agency members discuss the most suitable candidate for the second-in-command. Doppo Kunikida is carrying out official errands as planned in his diary as usual. Unexpectedly, a bomb-related incident occurs, challenging the ideals he has always upheld. When weighing one life over hundreds, how will he proceed?
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is well-received, particularly by fans of Kunikida, as it provides a deeper understanding of his character and ideals. While some find the plot rushed or unnecessary, most appreciate the focus on Kunikida and its seamless integration into the series. The episode is considered a worthwhile bonus for fans.
pros: Great character exploration of Kunikida.
Fits seamlessly into the Bungou Stray Dogs universe.
Highlights Kunikida's ideals and vulnerabilities.
cons: Narrative relies on convenience and rushed plot devices.
Some consider it redundant character exploration.
Villain is not particularly compelling.

anime.title: Brotherhood: Final Fantasy XV
anime.synopsis:
Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Lucis, Noctis Lucis Caelum, sets out on a journey to Caem. His purpose is to meet with Lunafreya Nox Fleuret, an oracle and Noctis' childhood friend, in order to marry her. A strong and silent type, Noctis is accompanied by his friends and Royal Guard Gladiolus, Prompto, and Ignis. The four young men set out on a road trip across the continent in the king's personal convertible, the Regalia. Along the journey, each of them experience various situations which allow them to reflect on their past together, and strengthen their bonds for the future.

A prequel to the 2016 video game Final Fantasy XV, Brotherhood: Final Fantasy XV explores the relationships of its four main protagonists and the challenges awaiting them.
anime.consensus_summary: Brotherhood: Final Fantasy XV is generally well-received as a prequel that enhances the viewer's understanding and appreciation of the main characters. While some find the story and art lacking, the focus on character relationships and backstory is praised. It is considered a worthwhile watch, especially for those planning to play the game.
pros: Character-driven exploration of the main cast's relationships.
Provides valuable backstory and context for the game Final Fantasy XV.
Enhances appreciation for the characters and their dynamics.
cons: The story can feel cliché.
Some found the characters one-note and lacking depth.
The art style is not high-end and looks like a cheap tie-in.

anime.title: Kingsglaive: Final Fantasy XV
anime.synopsis:
For years, the Niflheim Empire and the kingdom of Lucis have been at war. The empire, having dominated most of the world of Eos, covets the power of the last known Crystal, which is held in Lucis' capital city, Insomnia.

In order to protect his people from these advancing forces, King Regis Lucis Caelum CXIII used the power of the Crystal to surround Insomnia with a magical wall. Along with this barrier, Regis assembled an elite military task force known as the Kingsglaive. By drawing their power from the king, the Kingsglaive protect Lucis' borders from the onslaught of the empire and other forces that would do them harm.

One such member of the Kingsglaive is Nyx, a man nicknamed "The Hero" by his fellow warriors due to his arrogance and desire to save everyone. However, his pride gets the better of him, causing him to disobey his captain's orders, resulting in a demotion. Now, Nyx spends his days guarding the city gates, but things begin to change once word gets out that Regis plans to sign a peace treaty with their sworn enemies.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed, with praise for the visuals but criticism of the story. Many feel it serves primarily as a visually impressive prequel to the game, and is not particularly strong as a standalone film. While FF fans tend to enjoy it more, newcomers may find the narrative confusing or underwhelming.
pros: Visually stunning CGI and animation, often described as breathtaking and realistic.
Exciting and frequent action sequences.
Adds lore and backstory to Final Fantasy XV, enhancing the game experience for fans.
cons: Story is often criticized as basic, shallow, or lacking depth.
Fast-paced camera work during action scenes can be disorienting.
Prequel status makes it less compelling as a standalone movie; requires prior knowledge of the Final Fantasy XV universe.
Plot can be convoluted or confusing, especially for those unfamiliar with the source material.

anime.title: Kemono Friends
anime.genres: Adventure, Anthropomorphic, Award Winning, Comedy, Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Japari Park is an untamed paradise where many humanoid animals, known as "Friends," live their everyday lives in all corners of the natural environmental park.

One lazy afternoon in the savannah area, the energetic Serval encounters a peculiar new Friend. Curious, she swiftly takes down the Friend, named Kaban, to try and discover what species she is. To Serval's disappointment, not even Kaban herself knows the answer.

The two become friends and set out on a grand adventure through the many habitats, landmarks, and attractions of Japari Park. Their destination is the park library, where they hope to shed some light on Kaban’s identity. Along the way, they meet many other Friends, looking into their lives and helping them out. However, they soon begin to uncover the sinister reality behind the park and their own existence.
anime.consensus_summary: Kemono Friends is a surprisingly heartwarming and thought-provoking anime despite its low-budget appearance. Many viewers found its focus on friendship, self-discovery, and charming world to be exceptionally well-executed. While the animation quality is a common point of criticism, the series' emotional depth and creative storytelling have garnered a dedicated fanbase.
pros: Charming world-building and setting.
Endearing characters and focus on friendship.
Unexpected depth and emotional resonance.
Unique and creative storytelling.
Inspiring message of self-discovery.
cons: Low-budget CGI animation can be jarring.
Slow start, requires patience.
Story may seem simple or childish to some.
Repetitive episodic format.
Voice acting can be shoddy in places.

anime.title: Planetarian: The Reverie of a Little Planet
anime.synopsis: It is thirty years after the failure of the Space Colonization Program. Humanity is nearly extinct. A perpetual and deadly Rain falls on the Earth. Men known as "Junkers" plunder goods and artifacts from the ruins of civilization. One such Junker sneaks alone into the most dangerous of all ruins—a "Sarcophagus City." In the center of this dead city, he discovers a pre-War planetarium. And as he enters he is greeted by Hoshino Yumemi, a companion robot. Without a single shred of doubt, she assumes he is the first customer she's had in 30 years. She attempts to show him the stars at once, but the planetarium projector is broken. Unable to make heads or tails of her conversation, he ends up agreeing to try and repair the projector...
anime.consensus_summary: Planetarian is a short, emotionally resonant anime that has charmed many viewers with its simple story and endearing characters. The anime stands out for its ability to evoke strong feelings in a brief period. Some find the narrative too simplistic or the emotional delivery too forced.
pros: Emotional impact and tear-jerking story
Character chemistry between the Junker and Yumemi
Beautiful art direction, especially the starry sky
Well-paced character development within a short series
cons: Simplistic plot and underdeveloped characters
Heavy-handed emotional delivery
Annoying characteristics of Yumemi
Mediocre Sound Design

anime.title: WWW.WAGNARIA!!
anime.synopsis: Daisuke Higashida is a serious first-year student at Higashizaka High School. He lives a peaceful everyday life even though he is not satisfied with the family who doesn't laugh at all and makes him tired. However, his father's company goes bankrupt one day, and he can no longer afford allowances, cellphone bills, and commuter tickets. When his father orders him to take up a part-time job, Daisuke decides to work at a nearby family restaurant in order to avoid traveling 15 kilometers to school by bicycle.
anime.consensus_summary: WWW.Working!! is viewed as an enjoyable spin-off to the original Working!! series, with new characters and a similar lighthearted feel. While some appreciate the show's cute and heartwarming nature with the romantic development, others find the reliance on repeated gags and less dynamic character interactions to be a drawback. The series is generally well-received by fans of the franchise looking for more content, but it may not stand as strongly on its own.
pros: New characters are unique and likeable.
The series is cute and heartwarming, helping to relieve stress.
Satisfactory development of romantic relationships.
The series retains the warmth and feeling of the original Working!! series.
Good animation, especially in the later episodes.
cons: Relies too heavily on reusing gags.
Some characters are underutilized.
The plot can feel forced at times to advance relationships.
Repetition of jokes can become tiring.
Characters feel mutually exclusive, lacking the dynamic interactions of the original.

anime.title: Descending Stories: Showa Genroku Rakugo Shinju
anime.romaji_title: Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu: Sukeroku Futatabi-hen
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Historical, Josei, Love Polygon, Performing Arts
anime.synopsis:
Even after having risen to the utmost rank of shin'uchi, Yotarou struggles to find his own identity in the world of rakugo. Caught between his master's teachings and the late Sukeroku's unique style, his performance lacks an important ingredient—ego. And while his popularity packs the theaters, he is but one of the few; rakugo is under threat of being eclipsed.

Meanwhile Yakumo, regarded by many as the last bastion of preserving the popularity of rakugo, struggles to cope with his elderly state. Even though his performances are still stellar, he fears that he is nearing his limits. His doubts grow stronger as an old friend creeps ever closer. Konatsu, for her part, attempts to raise her son as a single mother, which Yotarou is heavily opposed to. Instead, he seeks to persuade her to marry him and in turn raise her son as his own.

In Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu: Sukeroku Futatabi-hen, the curtains fall on Yotarou and Yakumo's story, tasked with restoring the near-obsolete art form as well as overcoming their internal conflicts.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Shouwa Genroku Rakugo Shinjuu is largely praised as a well-crafted conclusion to the story, with strong emotional impact and excellent storytelling. While some viewers found it didn't quite live up to the first season, the majority consensus is that it's a moving and worthwhile experience. The series excels in its portrayal of characters, the art of rakugo, and the themes of legacy and tradition.
pros: Masterful storytelling and narration
Complex and interesting plot
Well-developed characters with emotional depth
Excellent voice acting and sound design
Cinematography and direction stand out
cons: Pacing issues in the middle of the season
Some plot elements introduced but not fully developed
Second season doesn't quite reach the heights of the first for some viewers

anime.title: Scared Rider Xechs
anime.synopsis: The Blue World, which symbolizes reason, is under constant attack by the creatures called the Nightfly O'Note originating from the Red World, symbolizing instinct. Akira Asagi, the 17-year-old protagonist who is a researcher at Blue World, is nominated to lead the war at Ryuukyuu LAG, a proud defense facility on the islands of Ishigaki and Iriomote. She meets the sixth combat unit "IS," which was formed four years after a fierce battle that annihilated the fifth unit. Akari must lead these six riders, also called the Scared Rider Xechs, to fight against the other world while at the same time deepening the relationship among them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely negative, citing poor writing, bland characters, and a confused plot. Some appreciate the proactive female lead and voice acting.  The attempt to blend slice-of-life elements with dramatic mecha action falls flat, resulting in a disjointed experience that fails to satisfy fans of either genre.
pros: Good voice acting cast
Proactive female character
Unique blend of action and sci-fi for a female audience
cons: Bland, one-dimensional characters
Generic art style
Mismatched plot elements
Poor character development
Predictable and overused storyline
Mediocre world-building
Lack of romance despite genre tag
