Characters lack distinction and development
anime.thematic_vibe: Teen Romance, Awkwardness, Slice of Life

anime.title: Kabukibu!
anime.synopsis: Kurogu had a love of kabuki theater instilled in him from a very young age thanks to his grandfather. Now, as a high school student, he desires to create his own kabuki club in order to bring an appreciation of kabuki to a wider audience. He'll find, though, that with the weight of hundreds of years of strict tradition, it's not so easy to get high schoolers interested. A rough start is not enough to deter Kurogu, and he'll work hard to inspire in others the same burning passion he feels, until the day he can put on his own performance!
anime.consensus_summary: Kabuki-bu! is a generally enjoyable and relaxing anime that effectively introduces viewers to the art of kabuki. While praised for its character interactions, well-paced story, and passion for the cultural art form, it suffers from generic elements, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent animation. Despite its flaws, many viewers consider it a hidden gem deserving of more recognition.
pros: Well-executed portrayal of kabuki with passion and realistic elements.
Dynamic characters with good development and interactions.
Relaxing and well-paced story with relatable themes.
Introduces and explains kabuki in an accessible way.
Addresses real-life struggles without being overly dramatic.
cons: Generic story and character archetypes.
Underdeveloped supporting characters and unresolved subplots.
Voice acting issues, especially with Hanamichi's character.
Rushed handling of serious issues and character development.
Inconsistent animation quality and limited kabuki performances.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Cultural Appreciation, Perseverance

anime.title: Free! The Movie -Timeless Medley- the Bond
anime.synopsis:
Haruka Nanase has reconciled with his rival Rin Matsuoka, and they have re-established their friendship, determined to race each other again. Now Haruka, along with Makoto Tachibana, Rei Ryuugazaki, and Nagisa Hazuki, prepare for their upcoming tournaments, determined to compete wholeheartedly and achieve victory as a team. At Samezuka Academy, Rin resolves to do the same.

Further, the seniors near graduation, and Rin has decided his future plans. However, Haruka and Makoto remain uncertain, and they begin to feel the pressure of having to choose their own paths.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with fans appreciating the new scenes and the core story's quality. However, many are disappointed by the heavy reliance on reused content and the skipping of the first season, making it potentially confusing for newcomers. The film serves more as a recap with minor additions rather than a significant new entry in the series.
pros: New scenes and Easter eggs provide additional content for fans.
The story is considered outstanding.
Warm and fuzzy feeling, complete story.
New songs are well-received.
cons: Movie heavily reuses scenes from the second season with little new content.
Skips over the first season of the anime, potentially confusing new viewers.
Recap format may not be effective for refreshing memories of the series.
New content is not essential to the main story.

anime.title: Libra of Nil Admirari
anime.genres: Historical, Josei, Reverse Harem, Romance, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: The Taishou era didn't end in 15 years, but went on for another 25. In order to protect her waning family, a girl resolves to marry a man she doesn't even know the name of. However, just before the marriage was to take place, the girl's younger brother mysteriously committed suicide by self-immolation and was found holding an old book in his hands. Appearing before the bewildered young girl was the "Imperial Library Intelligence Asset Management Bureau," more commonly referred to as "Fukurou." According to these men, there exists "Maremono," which are books that greatly affect their readers. On top of that, ever since the incident involving the girl's younger brother, she unwittingly gains the ability to see "Auras" (the sentiments of the Maremono which manifest as bright lights and are usually invisible to humans). It was as though fate were trying to drag the young girl in its flames. And then, even though apprehensive, the girl chooses to venture outside her bird cage. Jealousy, hatred, scorn, compassion, and love. What awaited the girl was the darkness of betrayal that had already begun to bewitchingly inlay the imperial capital. Toyed by and swayed within that darkness, will the young girl finally reach the truth after her struggles, or...?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some appreciating the art style and historical setting, while others criticize the plot's execution and character development. Many feel the anime had potential but ultimately fell short. There's a divide between those who enjoy it as a passable reverse harem and those who are disappointed by its unfulfilled promise.
pros: Gorgeous art and character designs with distinct features.
Interesting premise with potential for a deeper plot.
Well-rounded characters with backstories and depth.
cons: Mediocre and clichéd story with predictable plot points.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of focus on romance.
Poor execution of the premise with boring side quests.
Rushed and patchworky ending with too many twists.

anime.title: Dances with the Dragons
anime.romaji_title: Saredo Tsumibito wa Ryuu to Odoru
anime.synopsis: It is a world replete with dragons and Jushiki sorcerers. Jushiki is a devastatingly powerful formula that can alter the laws of physics, capable of creating enormous TNT explosives or poisonous gas through plasma and nuclear fusion. A down-on-his-luck sorcerer named Gayus joins forces with the beautiful but cruel Jushiki practitioner, Gigina, as bounty hunters pursuing dragons. Then one day, they are presented with an odd request: to serve as security guards for a grand festival put on by Mouldeen, the ruler of their kingdom. It is then that a mysterious serial killing of Jushiki sorcerers begins.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of "Saredo Tsumibito wa Ryuu to Odoru" is largely considered mediocre and fails to live up to its potential. The plot suffers from poor pacing and multiple unresolved storylines, while the setting lacks sufficient exposition. Characters are underdeveloped, and fight scenes are uninspired, leading to a generally unengaging experience. It is recommended only to fans of the original light novel or manga adaptation.
pros: Character designs are appealing.
Music is passable and the opening theme has a nice vocal flourish.
cons: Plot is confusing with multiple unresolved plotlines and awkward pacing.
Setting lacks exposition, making the world hard to understand.
Fight scenes lack motion, and dark scenes are too dark.
Characters are underdeveloped with little chemistry.
Story feels mediocre.

anime.title: IDOLiSH7
anime.synopsis:
On her first day of work at her father's small production agency, Tsumugi Takanashi was not expecting to be made the manager of the agency's new male idol group. Though shocked that her father is trusting her with such a major project so soon, Tsumugi vows to do everything she can to support the seven young boys. After seeing how well the boys work as a team, Tsumugi meets with her father and learns that her first job as manager will be to cut four boys from the group. This is because her father believes seven idols are too much to manage, and the current top group, TRIGGER, only has three members.

After holding an impromptu audition, Tsumugi returns to her father and boldly declares that she refuses to cut anyone from the group, as each member has a unique allure which collectively enhances the group's appeal. She returns to the boys and they are thrilled that none of them will get to miss out on their dreams. Together they become IDOLiSH7, and prepare to take on the fiercely competitive world of idols.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience is pleasantly surprised by IDOLiSH7, finding it to be more than just a typical idol anime. Many appreciate the realistic portrayal of the idol industry, the well-developed characters, and the balance of emotional moments. While some critique the pacing and CGI, the general sentiment is positive, with viewers finding the series engaging and heartwarming.
pros: Realistic portrayal of the idol industry
Well-developed characters with depth
Good balance between tragedy and heartwarming moments
Engaging story that explores struggles and relationships
cons: Uneven pacing in the storyline
Lack of individual character background
CGI in performances
Story could be more interesting

anime.title: The King's Avatar
anime.synopsis:
Widely regarded as a trailblazer and top-tier professional player in the online multiplayer game Glory, Ye Xiu is dubbed the "Battle God" for his skills and contributions to the game over the years. However, when forced to retire from the team and to leave his gaming career behind, he finds work at a nearby internet café. There, when Glory launches its tenth server, he throws himself into the game once more using a new character named "Lord Grim."

Ye Xiu's early achievements on the new server immediately catch the attention of many players, as well as the big guilds, leaving them to wonder about the identity of this exceptional player. However, while he possesses ten years of experience and in-depth knowledge, starting afresh with neither sponsors nor a team in a game that has changed over the years presents numerous challenges. Along with talented new comrades, Ye Xiu once again dedicates himself to traversing the path to Glory's summit!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many viewers enjoy the anime for its unique focus on esports and impressive animation. However, some criticize the story's simplicity, the number of characters, and the lack of depth.
pros: Original concept focusing on professional gaming rather than getting trapped in a game.
High-quality animation and battle scenes.
Characters have individual goals and reasons for being there.
cons: Story can feel linear and slow-paced.
Too many characters, leading to underdeveloped relationships.
Some find the main character overpowered with little explanation.
Lack of real conflict and shallow story.

anime.title: My Hero Academia: Rescue! Rescue Training
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Hero Academia: Sukue! Kyuujo Kunren!
anime.synopsis:
UA High School must regain the public's confidence after the surprise villain attack during class 1-A's training session. Although some of the teachers were gravely injured in the attack, Izuku "Deku" Midoriya and his classmates must continue to learn and train, and utilize their quirks in varying environments and circumstances. 

Boku no Hero Academia: Sukue! Kyuujo Kunren! follows class 1-A as they attempt to finally complete their training. However, there's a masked figure roaming around the training center. Have the villains responsible for the previous incident returned to finish the job? If so, are the students ready to fight back?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is split, with some viewing the OVA as a fun, essential piece of context for rescue training and more content, while others find it to be largely unnecessary filler with diminished production quality and character depth compared to the main series. While generally enjoyed by fans for providing more of what they like, it doesn't significantly advance the narrative or impress with its technical execution.
pros: Provides much-needed rescue training context that felt missing after Season 1.
Fun and lighthearted, offering a welcome break and more content for fans.
Some viewers noted specific intelligent plans and character insights (e.g., Bakugo's reasoning, Mineta's usefulness).
Includes enjoyable fanservice and references to Anime Fest 2016.
cons: Art and sound quality are noticeably lower than the main series.
Character personality and liveliness are diminished, feeling 'dumbed down'.
Does not significantly further character or plot development.
Feels like filler or unnecessary content to some, not adding much new.
Potential for lower-quality versions due to distribution or source issues.

anime.title: Hinako Note
anime.genres: CGDCT, Performing Arts, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Born and raised in the countryside of Japan, Hinako "Hina" Sakuragi gets anxious easily when she talks to new people—so much so that she resembles a stiff scarecrow. To overcome this, Hina hopes to get involved in theater, inspired by a play she saw during her school's field trip. So, Hina moves into the Hitotose Manor in the bustling city of Tokyo to study at Fujiyama High School, aspiring to join the school's renowned theater club.

But to Hina's dismay, she learns that Fujiyama High's theater club has been on a lengthy hiatus. Having already come to Tokyo and enrolled in the school, Hina is at a loss for what to do next. Sensing her disappointment and eagerness to learn theater, Chiaki Hagino, the landlady of Hitotose Manor, encourages Hina to create a troupe with the residents of Hitotose Manor as its members.

Hinako Note follows Hina as she begins a new life in Tokyo attending Fujiyama High while learning the ropes of theater with the support of her friends along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Hinako Note is a light-hearted and relaxing anime about cute girls doing cute things. While it offers enjoyable character development and beautiful animation, some viewers find the story generic and lacking depth. Overall, the audience enjoys it as a stress-relieving show.
pros: Relaxing and uplifting
Cute and funny characters
Enjoyable character development
Beautiful animation with seamless transitions between styles
cons: Generic story with overused tropes
Excessive focus on cuteness and erotic shots
Lacking depth and meaningful conflict
Occasional direction feels lost

anime.title: Black Clover: Jump Festa 2016 Special
anime.synopsis: An OVA episode bundled with the 11th manga volume.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided, with fans of the Black Clover manga generally enjoying the OVA as supplementary content. However, newcomers and those critical of the series find its animation, art style, and Asta's characterization to be significant drawbacks, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Entertaining story for fans of the original manga.
Decent soundtrack and some good voice acting performances.
Introduces the setting and characters effectively for newcomers.
Provides fun character interactions and extra content for existing fans.
cons: Sloppy and uninspired character designs with awkward animation.
Voice actors don't always fit the characters.
Repetitive elements that felt like a worse version of earlier anime episodes.
Asta's constant shouting is annoying and makes scenes exhausting.
Visually simple and unimpressive animation that doesn't live up to the universe's potential.
CGI parts are horrible, and the art style feels conflicted.

anime.title: 100 Sleeping Princes and the Kingdom of Dreams
anime.romaji_title: Yume Oukoku to Nemureru 100-nin no Oujisama
anime.synopsis: The heroine is a normal girl, until one day she is invited to another world and becomes the princess of the dream world, where people use dreams as the energy to live. One day, the dream world is being attacked by something called "yumekui" ("dream eater"), and many princes are being attacked by it. The heroine must wake them up to save the dream world, as the princes are unable to wake up due to having their dreams stolen.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of 'Yume Oukoku to Nemureru 100-nin no Oujisama' is largely considered a failure. Reviewers find the plot uninspired and boring, the characters one-dimensional, and the animation of poor quality. While some appreciate the opening and ending themes, the overall consensus is that the anime fails to capture the potential of its source material and is not worth watching unless deeply invested in the game.
pros: Decent opening and ending theme songs.
cons: Boring, personality-less protagonist.
Inconsistent and nonsensical plot.
Poor animation quality with off-model character designs.
Weak world-building and lack of explanation for key plot elements.
Uneven sound quality with distracting microphone issues.
Cliched character archetypes.

anime.title: Girls und Panzer das Finale – Part 1
anime.synopsis:
Rumor has it that Momo Kawashima, former student council member at Ooarai Girls Academy, is bound to repeat a year. Having failed her university entry exams, she is far from spending another year at Ooarai, but her plight is unenviable nevertheless.

The only way for her to gain admission into a university is to be granted an athletic scholarship. With the Winter Continuous Track Cup rapidly approaching, Momo becomes the commander of Ooarai's tankery team, so as to demonstrate her sport skills and wipe away the stain on her honor.

Their first opponent—French-themed BC Freedom High School—is split into two factions that are constantly at odds with each other. Despite this seemingly fortuitous match against a disorganized rival, Ooarai might soon find itself taking one step too far.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 1 for its fun characters, exciting tank battles, and humor. While the story is not a strong point for some, the overall experience is positive, particularly for fans of the series. The main criticism is the slow pacing and cliffhanger endings.
pros: Enjoyable characters and their interactions
Exciting and well-animated tank battles
Humorous and lighthearted tone
Good production values
cons: Story can be dull and predictable
Emotional scenes sometimes lack impact
Viewing format can be frustrating due to cliffhangers
Not as grand as "Der Film"

anime.title: The Glass Mask Year 3 Class D
anime.synopsis: The series re-imagines the Glass Mask manga and its characters in a school gag comedy focused on satirizing modern society.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily dependent on familiarity with the original 'Glass Mask' series. Fans of the original may find the parody funny, while those unfamiliar are likely to dislike it. The low production quality and simplistic humor are common complaints, leading to a polarized, but overall negative, audience experience for newcomers.
pros: Funny for viewers familiar with the original Glass Mask manga/anime.
Short episodes make it easy to watch.
cons: Poor animation quality, including cruddy CG.
Humor doesn't land for viewers unfamiliar with the source material.
Weak or non-existent plot.
Childish comedy.

anime.title: Onihei
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Drama, Historical, Samurai
anime.synopsis: The blade arts of the "Devil" tasked with striking down evils threatening a peaceful Edo! Heizou Hasegawa, upholding the role of chief officer protecting against crime and arson! In 1783, the heart of the Tenmei era, Hasegawa held the office of chief director of the department charged with sustaining safety in the region, suppressing the most vile of thieves and criminals, an individual largely feared, renowned as Devil Heizou...
anime.consensus_summary: Onihei is a visually appealing historical crime drama with a unique blend of samurai and noir elements. While the main character is praised for his depth and the show explores interesting social themes, the episodic nature, repetitive plots, and inconsistent animation quality have left some viewers feeling underwhelmed. Overall, the audience appreciates the show's distinct style and moral complexity, but acknowledges its shortcomings in terms of character development and narrative coherence.
pros: Unique art style and historical setting
Episodic stories with moral messages and life lessons
Well-developed main character (Heizo) with a multi-faceted personality
Excellent voice acting and jazz-infused soundtrack
Exploration of social themes and moral grey areas
cons: Repetitive episodic formula with a 'criminal-of-the-week' format
Underdeveloped and unmemorable supporting characters
Inconsistent animation quality, with noticeable CGI and janky fight scenes
Predictable plot twists and lack of an overarching narrative
Some episodes are boring and uninspired

anime.title: Bloodivores
anime.synopsis: 60 years ago, a strange case of insomnia struck the population, forcing them to stay awake for more than a full week. The victims, completely sleep deprived, all went mad. To cure this illness, a new medicine was produced, but the side effects turned the patients into vampires. Humanity went to war against this new species and triumphed, but some of the vampires managed to survive. Born from a Human and a Vampire, the main character Mi Liu, "The Child of Hope," is to represent the new hope that will connect the two species. Ringleader of a bank robbery, Mi Liu is arrested and transferred to a special prison of the National Defense Agency that monitors Vampires. Trying to break free with Anji, Mi Liu is attacked by strange monsters and he finds out that the prison location corresponds to the birthplace of Vampires, the old capital "Blue Town." Why are Vampires trapped in Blue Town? What are those strange monsters attacking them? Our heroes must fight to solve those mysteries.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Viewers found the plot incomprehensible, the characters underdeveloped and unlikeable, and the animation inconsistent. While a few found some enjoyment in its sheer awfulness, most felt it was a waste of time with squandered potential.
pros: Some reviewers liked the art style and background details.
The initial premise had potential.
A few viewers found it enjoyably bad.
cons: Incoherent and confusing plot with many unexplained elements.
Poor character development and unlikeable personalities.
Animation inconsistencies and lazy execution.
Generic and uninspired story elements.
Unnecessary and annoying characters.
Ending on a cliffhanger without resolving plot points.

anime.title: Interviews With Monster Girls
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Mythology, School, Seinen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
High school biology teacher Tetsuo Takahashi may look like your average everyday instructor, but beneath his gentle appearance lies something less ordinary: his fascination for the "Ajin," more commonly known as "Demi." Although these half-human, half-monster beings have integrated into human society, Takahashi believes that much about them will remain unknown unless he interacts with them firsthand.

Demi-chan wa Kataritai follows Takahashi's daily life in Shibasaki High School together with his three Demi students—Hikari Takanashi, an energetic vampire; Kyouko Machi, a gentle dullahan; and Yuki Kusakabe, the shy snow woman. Along the way, Takahashi also meets fellow teacher Sakie Satou, a succubus with an aversion towards men. To fulfill his goal of learning more about the Demi, Takahashi decides to conduct casual interviews with the girls to learn more about their abilities, psyche, and interaction with human society. As Takahashi strengthens his bond with his students, he soon discovers that the Demi are not as unusual as he initially believed.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views "Demi-chan wa Kataritai" as a heartwarming and enjoyable slice-of-life anime with unique characters and social commentary. While some find the plot lacking and the ending unsatisfying, the show's charm and feel-good nature are widely appreciated. It's considered a mature and thoughtful take on the genre.
pros: Likable characters with unique traits and charm.
The show offers a great and mature social commentary.
Heartfelt and surprisingly deep comedy.
The anime adaptation captures the magic and feel of the original manga.
cons: The story lacks a solid plot.
Some may find the series mediocre and boring as it progresses.
The show does not have a proper ending.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Social Commentary, Feel-Good

anime.title: Days OVA
anime.synopsis: Bundled with limited editions of the 21st and 22nd volumes of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The Days OVA is well-received as a lighthearted departure from the main series. It focuses on character interactions and comedic scenarios, offering a different viewing experience for fans. The lack of focus on football might disappoint some viewers, but the overall consensus points towards it being an enjoyable and entertaining addition to the series.
pros: Comedy
Character Development
cons: Limited Football Content
Fan Service

anime.title: To Be Hero
anime.synopsis:
For Uncle, a lecherous but handsome toilet designer, it is just an ordinary day of neglecting his duties as a single parent to hit on women and talk about his "superpower": his ability to tell a lady's hip size at a glance. But when he is sucked down into a toilet, the Space Peace Republic Alliance Hero Committee gives him real superpowers, and he becomes the hero of Earth. There is only one problem—he has become an ugly, unrecognizable fatty who is unable to reveal his real identity.

Uncle's beloved daughter Min-chan does not believe that such a vulgar fatty could be her father, and casts him out of his own home. Distraught and homeless, he joins up with his perverted neighbor Yamada-san, a small man with a fondness for streaking, and sets out to convince Min-chan that he is her father.

Full of sexual innuendo and slapstick humor, To Be Hero follows Uncle as he befriends bizarre allies and combats even more bizarre foes, fighting for the future of earth against aliens and—more importantly—his future with his daughter.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'To Be Hero' are divided, with many appreciating its unique humor, animation, and surprising emotional depth, while others are turned off by its crude content and confusing plot. Some find the ending disappointing, while others enjoy the overall experience despite its flaws. The series is considered a hidden gem by some, while others view it as a forgettable gag anime.
pros: Unique and funny characters with even short screen times
Great animation and art style, especially for a gag anime
Catchy ending theme song
Surprising plot twists and emotional moments add depth
cons: Crude and vulgar humor may not appeal to everyone
Confusing ending for some viewers
Abrupt shift to serious tone in later episodes alienated some viewers
Fast-paced dialogue and subtitles can be difficult to follow
Inconsistent art style in some episodes

anime.title: Restaurant to Another World
anime.genres: Fantasy, Gourmet, Isekai, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Western Restaurant Nekoya is a popular eatery located on a street corner in a Tokyo shopping district. Serving both traditional Japanese fare as well as Western dishes, this eating establishment is popular among Tokyo's residents. But this seemingly ordinary restaurant is also popular with another type of clientele...

While the restaurant is thought to be closed on Saturdays, the truth is that on this special day each week, its doors are instead opened to the inhabitants of other worlds. From dragons and elves to fairies and mages, this restaurant has no shortage of strange customers. Nevertheless, the enigmatic chef known only as "Master" will be waiting to serve up their favorite dishes with a kind smile and keep them coming back for many more Saturdays to come.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Isekai Shokudou' to be a relaxing and enjoyable show, praising its unique premise and world-building. However, some viewers criticize the lack of a strong plot and character development, noting that the episodic nature can become repetitive. Despite these shortcomings, the anime is generally well-received as a feel-good, easy-to-watch series.
pros: Unique and creative concept within the Isekai genre.
Excellent world-building with diverse characters and cultures.
Visually appealing food and environments.
cons: Lack of significant plot development.
Repetitive formula in each episode.
Underdeveloped main characters.

anime.title: Hagane Orchestra
anime.synopsis: A group of young girls make a living by running an armored vehicle customization workshop in a desert town. They discuss different ways of promoting their business every day.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Hagane Orchestra' as a surprisingly funny and self-aware short anime series. Despite being an advertisement for a mobile game, it's praised for its humor, characters, and unique approach. Some viewers find the lack of a substantial story and the short episode length to be drawbacks, but overall, the series is well-received for its comedic value and meta-commentary.
pros: Hilarious and enjoyable despite being a mobile game advertisement.
Unique and interesting art style.
Characters are well-developed and interact well.
Clever use of fourth-wall breaks.
References to other anime and Japanese culture add to the humor.
cons: Lack of a strong overarching story.
Sound design is unremarkable.
Short episodes may not appeal to all viewers.
Mobile game tie-in may be off-putting to some.

anime.title: Tsugumomo
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Mythology, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
In Japanese folklore, a "tsukumogami" is an object that has gained a soul, becoming alive and self-aware. There are two types of tsukumogami: the mature "tsugumomo," who have developed through long years of harmony with their owners, and the aberrant "amasogi," premature spirits that are only born to grant the destructive wishes of certain people.

Kazuya Kagami has never gone without his mother's obi after her death. Be it at home or school, he keeps it safe with him at all times. One day, he nearly loses his life when a wig amasogi attacks him. When all seems to be over, his treasured obi defends him, transforming into a beautiful girl. She introduces herself as Kiriha, a tsugumomo owned by Kazuya's mother. 

With Kiriha's arrival, Kazuya enters a reality he has never seen before, a world with gods and tsukumogami.
anime.consensus_summary: Tsugumomo is a fun and entertaining anime that combines ecchi comedy with supernatural action, drawing upon Japanese folklore for its premise. While the story and characters can be generic at times, the show offers unexpected humor and enjoyable interactions. Most viewers find it a worthwhile watch if you're looking for something lighthearted and not overly serious, with some finding the ecchi elements more humorous than offensive.
pros: Unique premise involving tsukumogami and malison cleansing.
Explicit but not visually graphic ecchi scenes are funny and surprising.
Enjoyable character interactions, especially between Kazuya and Kiriha.
Solid animation, particularly during action sequences.
Interesting use of Japanese popular beliefs and Shinto lore.
Good pacing and enjoyable episodes
catchy opening song
cons: Generic main character (Kazuya) and harem setup.
Story is basic and not particularly innovative.
Ecchi content can be excessive and forced at times.
Characters can be bland with little development.
Some plot points are not fully explained.
Inconsistent animation quality in some scenes.
Relies on some cliche tropes and predictable situations.
anime.thematic_vibe: Ecchi Comedy, Supernatural Action, Japanese Folklore

anime.title: Idol Incidents
anime.synopsis:
Increasing income divide, creeping environmental pollution, unsolvable waste issues, childcare waiting lists being discussed without those concerned, repeated corruption… The government, smeared by vested interests, can't do a thing against the many problems and sources of discontent. It's in this situation, with Japan cornered with no way out, that idols rise up to save the day!

The Heroine Party, Sunlight Party, Starlight Party, Bishoujo Party, Wakaba Party, Subculture New Party, and SOS Party. From these seven idol political parties, the idols who have become National Diet members and representatives for each prefecture will smash through the sense of stagnation covering Japan using the power of song and dance! They'll bring back the smiling faces of the people, and wrap Japan in a glittering aura!!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the concept entertaining and appreciated the lighthearted feel, while others criticized the weak plot, shallow characters, and poorly executed political themes. The music and art style were generally praised, but the overall consensus leans towards wasted potential due to poor writing and inconsistent execution. The show is seen as a fun, but ultimately flawed, attempt to blend idol culture with political satire.
pros: Unique premise of idol politicians is initially engaging and humorous.
Some found the show entertaining, sweet, and heartwarming, especially during difficult times.
The art style is generally considered cute and colorful, with individualistic fashion.
Music, particularly that produced by Tsunku, is seen as a highlight, diverging from generic anime songs.
cons: The political aspects are poorly executed and unrealistic.
Storyline is typical, predictable, and lacks substance.
Too many characters with little to no development.
Villains are weak and easily swayed.
The plot becomes tiresome, with an underbaked story and too much icing (art).
Inconsistent tone, shifting from feel-good to heavy plot without proper build-up.
CGI animation is poorly implemented.

anime.title: King of Prism: Pride the Hero
anime.romaji_title: King of Prism: Pride the Hero
anime.consensus_summary: King of Prism: Pride the Hero is a polarizing film. Some find it to be a hilarious, self-aware parody with surprising depth beneath the surface. Others find the plot rushed and the animation/CG quality lacking, but still appreciate the over-the-top fanservice.
pros: Mix of crazy, ridiculous, gay, and shining epicness
Rewatch value; Discovering new things on repeat viewings
cons: Rushed story
Lukewarm plot
Animation and CG are bad

anime.title: Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Kids, School, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
After his mother wins a free trip to the islands, Pokémon trainer Satoshi and his partner Pikachu head for Melemele Island of the beautiful Alola region, which is filled with lots of new Pokémon and even variations of familiar faces. Eager to explore the island, Satoshi and Pikachu run wild with excitement, quickly losing their way while chasing after a Pokémon. The pair eventually stumbles upon the Pokémon School, an institution where students come to learn more about these fascinating creatures.

At the school, when he and one of the students—the no-nonsense Kaki—have a run-in with the nefarious thugs of Team Skull, Satoshi discovers the overwhelming might of the Z-Moves, powerful attacks originating from the Alola region that require the trainer and Pokémon to be in sync. Later that night, he and Pikachu have an encounter with the guardian deity Pokémon of Melemele Island, the mysterious Kapu Kokeko. The Pokémon of legend bestows upon them a Z-Ring, a necessary tool in using the Z-Moves. Dazzled by their earlier battle and now in possession of a Z-Ring, Satoshi and Pikachu decide to stay behind in the Alola Region to learn and master the strength of these powerful new attacks.

Enrolling in the Pokémon School, Satoshi is joined by classmates such as Lillie, who loves Pokémon but cannot bring herself to touch them, Kaki, and many others. Between attending classes, fending off the pesky Team Rocket—who themselves have arrived in Alola to pave the way for their organization's future plans—and taking on the Island Challenge that is necessary to master the Z-Moves, Satoshi and Pikachu are in for an exciting new adventure.
anime.consensus_summary: Pokemon Sun & Moon is a divisive series within the Pokemon fandom due to its significant departure from previous installments, particularly in its art style and episodic, slice-of-life format. While some appreciate the focus on character development and the relaxed atmosphere, others find the lack of a compelling plot and the inconsistent pacing to be detrimental. The show's unique approach has created a clear divide between those who embrace the change and those who prefer the traditional Pokemon formula.
pros: Refreshing animation style and new character designs.
Well-written characters with individual personalities and growth.
Different format from previous seasons, breaking away from the repetitive formula.
cons: Inconsistent pacing with slow or rushed episodes.
Lack of a strong overarching plot and too many filler episodes.
Art style is jarring to some viewers, especially with older characters.

anime.title: Detective Conan: Episode One - The Great Detective Turned Small
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan: Episode One - Chiisaku Natta Meitantei
anime.synopsis: The "real" episode 1 of Meitantei Conan written by the Mangaka Gosho Aoyama.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is a treat for long-time fans, offering a fresh perspective and deeper insights into the series' beginnings. However, it's not recommended for newcomers due to spoilers and may feel disjointed for those unfamiliar with the extensive lore. The added details and character moments are appreciated, but some find the pacing and inclusion of irrelevant plot threads to be drawbacks.
pros: Adds interesting details and deepens events.
Refreshes memory of the beginning of the story.
Sweet character moments between Shinichi and Ran.
cons: Unnecessary details and plot threads with no conclusion.
Not suitable for new viewers, contains major spoilers.
Abrupt narrative pacing.

anime.title: Akiba's Trip The Animation
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Otaku Culture, Parody, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Otaku siblings Tamotsu and Niwaka Denkigai are shopping in Akihabara when it is overrun by vampiric cosplaying monsters! These creatures, known as "Bugged Ones," can possess anyone they bite and soon they begin causing mayhem across the city. As Tamotsu finds himself at the mercy of one of these creatures, he is rescued by the mysterious baseball bat-wielding Matome Mayonaka. Together, they fight through several more encounters with the Bugged Ones, but before long, Tamotsu is fatally wounded protecting Matome. With no other choice, she revives him as a high level Bugged One—just like her! 

Tamotsu and Matome, along with excitable otaku cosplayer Arisa Ahokainen, make up the group "The Electric Mayonnaise" and they begin dispatching the Bugged Ones in the only way they know how: by ripping off their clothes and exposing them to sunlight!
anime.consensus_summary: Akiba's Trip The Animation is a fun and comedic series that celebrates otaku culture with a self-aware approach. While it has some flaws in plot and character development, its energetic characters and humorous takes on various fandoms make it enjoyable for those who appreciate parodies and fanservice. The show is divisive; some find it hilarious and charming, while others criticize its shallowness and repetitive formula.
pros: Strong comedic elements and self-aware humor.
Energetic and enthusiastic characters.
Celebration of Akihabara and otaku culture.
Good music and sound direction.
cons: Episodic nature can feel repetitive.
Shallow character development.
Inconsistent art and animation quality.
Simplistic or weak plot.

anime.title: 100% Teacher Pascal
anime.synopsis: The story centers around an elementary school teacher who is so stupid that he cannot even write his own name. He does whatever he likes in his classroom. Plus, by all appearances, he is not human.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is visually appealing but lacks substance for adult viewers. Its humor is geared towards young children, making it a potentially cheap source of laughs for those not seeking depth. Characters, while having unique attributes, are simple.
pros: Vibrant art style
Fluid animation
cons: No story
One-note characters
Shorts often make no sense
Aimed at a very young audience

anime.title: Berserk: Season II
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Military, Psychological, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Demons have now become commonplace around the kingdom of Midland, which has fallen into chaos. The swordsman Guts still cannot stay in one place for long due to his demonic brand. He could always manage to protect himself when he was alone, but now he has the added challenge of protecting former Commander Casca, a shell of her former self who neither remembers nor trusts him. They never have a moment's rest with the constant threat of demons, and they need a place where Casca will be safe till they find a way to heal her. Their elf ally, Puck, tells of the mystical land of Elfhelm, which is supposed to be a safe haven from the demons that ravage the lands. Tired and with only a vague hope, they struggle on to find a place to live—and they still need to find those responsible for the madness they are forced to endure.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is heavily divided on Berserk 2nd Season. While the storyline and characters are praised for their faithfulness to the manga, the overwhelmingly negative reaction to the CGI animation significantly detracts from the viewing experience. Many viewers find it difficult to look past the animation issues, even if they appreciate the underlying story. The season is generally considered a disappointment, especially compared to the source material.
pros: Faithful story adaptation from the manga
Character development is solid, especially within Guts's party
Soundtrack and voice acting are generally well-received
cons: Poor CGI animation quality, often worse than the previous season
Stiff character movements and lack of emotional expression in animation
Inconsistent pacing and inclusion of unnecessary content (e.g., Bonebeard)
Sound design issues, particularly with sword sound effects

anime.title: The Eccentric Family 2
anime.synopsis:
After uncovering the truth behind their father's untimely death, life for the four Shimogamo brothers returns to relative peace with each trying to live up to their father's greatness in their own way. For the eldest, Yaichirou, who aims to become the next Trick Magister and leader of the tanuki society, it starts with reinstating the popular shogi tournament. For Yajirou, it is restoring his former shapeshifting abilities, whilst little Yashirou is content with continuing his work at the family’s factory. But for the third son, Yasaburou, it simply means embracing the "fool's blood" he inherited from his father and living a carefree but interesting life. This, of course, includes hunting for the mysterious and elusive snake-like creature known as a tsuchinoko, and causing ripples of trouble at every turn.

However, these ripples threaten to turn into waves with the return of Nidaime, the estranged son of the brothers' tengu teacher, Professor Akadama. Nidaime bears a grudge against not only his father, but his father's apprentice Benten as well. His loyalties suddenly brought into question, Yasaburou must use his tanuki wit to appease all sides without getting caught in the crossfire, before the delicate balance between human, tengu, and tanuki is overthrown and all hell breaks loose.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed Uchouten Kazoku 2, praising its heartwarming story, unique art style, and well-developed characters. Some viewers felt the story was repetitive compared to the first season, and that some secondary characters lacked sufficient development. Overall, the season was considered a welcomed continuation of the series.
pros: Sincere and authentic storytelling with a unique narrative flow.
Beautiful and calming art style with great attention to detail.
Well-developed characters, both old and new, with intriguing relationships.
Excellent OP and ED themes, and well-placed soundtrack.
cons: Story can feel repetitive, replaying similar beats from the first season.
Some secondary characters are underdeveloped, lacking explanation and backstory.
Pacing issues in certain parts of the story.

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard G Next
anime.synopsis: Third season of Cardfight!! Vanguard G series.
anime.consensus_summary: The reviewer expresses disappointment with Cardfight!! Vanguard G Next, citing a repetitive plot structure and excessive filler. They feel the series deviates from previous storylines, leading to boredom and annoyance. Ultimately, the reviewer finds the season fails to meet expectations.
cons: Repetitive plot structure
Filler content
Loss of historical continuity
Boring and annoying moments
Unfulfilled expectations

anime.title: Tales of Zestiria the X Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Tales of Zestiria the Cross 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: The second season of Tales of Zestiria the Cross.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Tales of Zestiria the Cross receives mixed reactions. While praised for its stunning visuals and some character development, it's criticized for a generic story, rushed pacing, and inconsistencies with the game. The ending is considered a high point for some, but overall, the series struggles to overcome its narrative weaknesses.
pros: Visually stunning animation by Ufotable
Improved character development compared to the game, especially Alisha and Rose
Satisfying ending for some viewers
Focus on character's motive
cons: Generic and convoluted story
Rushed pacing and anticlimactic moments
Poor character development for some characters
Inconsistencies with the game's plot
Lack of emotional connection between characters

anime.title: Chiruran 1/2
anime.synopsis: Strong, intense, and cute! The most laid-back Shinsengumi in history arrives!! An official spinoff series by Hashimoto Eiji (manga) and Umemura Shinya (story) of Chiruran Shinsengumi Requiem. Here's the laid-back everyday life of the Shinsengumi warriors.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Chiruran: Nibun no Ichi" as a light and amusing comedy series, particularly if they have some familiarity with the Shinsengumi. The short episode format is seen as both a strength and a weakness. Its simplicity and cuteness make it an endearing, easy watch.
pros: Cute animation style
Enjoyable comedy for short skits
Appealing to those familiar with Shinsengumi history
cons: Limited depth due to short episode length
Requires prior knowledge of Shinsengumi to fully appreciate

anime.title: Gintama Season 5
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
After joining the resistance against the bakufu, Gintoki and the gang are in hiding, along with Katsura and his Joui rebels. The Yorozuya is soon approached by Nobume Imai and two members of the Kiheitai, who explain that the Harusame pirates have turned against 7th Division Captain Kamui and their former ally Takasugi. The Kiheitai present Gintoki with a job: find Takasugi, who has been missing since his ship was ambushed in a Harusame raid. Nobume also makes a stunning revelation regarding the Tendoushuu, a secret organization pulling the strings of numerous factions, and their leader Utsuro, the shadowy figure with an uncanny resemblance to Gintoki's former teacher.

Hitching a ride on Sakamoto's space ship, the Yorozuya and Katsura set out for Rakuyou, Kagura's home planet, where the various factions have gathered and tensions are brewing. Long-held grudges, political infighting, and the Tendoushuu's sinister overarching plan finally culminate into a massive, decisive battle on Rakuyou.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with some praising the character development, action and exploration of deeper themes. Others find the reduced comedy and rapid pacing disappointing, missing the unique blend of humor and story from earlier seasons. The shift in tone polarizes viewers, creating mixed reactions to the anime's evolution.
pros: Character development is well-executed and meaningful.
Story explores deeper themes of strength and bushido.
Backstory development enhances characters.
cons: Comedy is diminished and less frequent.
Story arcs are shorter, leading to a faster pace and reliance on narration.
The shift towards a serious tone may disappoint fans of the comedic elements.

anime.title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya: Vow in the Snow
anime.romaji_title: Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya Movie: Sekka no Chikai
anime.synopsis:
After succumbing to an unenviable fate, Kiritsugu Emiya has left Shirou Emiya the duty to save mankind in his place. The world is dying and time is ticking, but when the salvation Shirou seeks is at the cost of his only family left—his younger sister—will he still have the heart to pursue this duty?

Shirou is now pressed with the choice to continue being a hero of justice—or become the very evil his ideal has vowed to vanquish. The orphan is alone once again, yet his body is still made of swords. The Fifth Holy Grail War now begins with his oath under snow.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Fans of the Fate series, especially those familiar with Prisma Illya, generally enjoyed the movie for its exploration of Shirou and Miyu's backstory and darker tone. However, some viewers found the animation inconsistent, the pacing uneven, and the plot too reliant on prior knowledge of the Fate universe, while others dislike how it sets up the Prisma Illya series.
pros: Strong Shirou character development.
Emotional backstory for Miyu.
Action sequences are decent.
cons: Animation quality decreases in the second half.
Pacing issues, movie feels rushed and dragged out.
Requires extensive knowledge of the Fate series to fully appreciate.

anime.title: Sagrada Reset
anime.genres: Drama, Mystery, School, Super Power, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Kei Asai lives in the oceanside city of Sakurada—a town where the inhabitants are born with strange abilities. On the school rooftop one day, he meets Misora Haruki, an apathetic girl with the power to reset anything around her up to three days prior. While no one knows when she has reset, not even Haruki, Kei can retain everything before the reset thanks to his own ability: photographic memory. After they successfully help someone by combining their powers, they join the Service Club to aid others in their town.

However, their club becomes involved with and begins completing missions for the mysterious Administration Bureau—an organization that focuses on managing the abilities in Sakurada and manipulating the town's events for their own ends. They may find out that there are more things at work in Sakurada than the machinations of the uncanny organization.
anime.consensus_summary: Sakurada Reset is a polarizing anime. Many find the slow pace and initially unemotional characters off-putting, leading to early drop-offs. However, those who persevere are often rewarded with a unique, thought-provoking story, clever use of abilities, and satisfying character development, ultimately considering it a hidden gem despite its flaws.
pros: Unique and clever story with well-defined rules for abilities.
Thought-provoking dialogues and exploration of philosophical themes.
Realistic characters with subtle expressions and human-like interactions.
Satisfying character development, especially in the later arcs.
The anime carefully explains every detail until the end.
cons: Slow pacing, especially in the first half, can be boring for some viewers.
Characters may appear emotionless and monotonous early on.
Inconsistent art quality and bland visuals.
Dialogue can be convoluted, unnatural, and full of unnecessary silence.
Some secondary characters are underdeveloped or feel useless.

anime.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School - Hope Arc
anime.romaji_title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Kibougamine Gakuen - Kibou-hen
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
The Future Foundation is in shambles after the Final Killing Game and the revelation of the true culprit. As a desperate plot arises from one of the survivors to rid the world of despair once and for all, the remaining Future Foundation members must band together to stop this atrocity from taking place. Fortunately, they find themselves with help from a group of unlikely allies as they race against the clock to stop their world from being changed.

In this finale to the Hope's Peak storyline of the Danganronpa series, the players in this neverending death game begin to understand the true meaning behind despair, hope, and atonement.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is heavily divided on 'Danganronpa 3: The End of Kibougamine Gakuen - Kibou-hen.' Some viewers found it to be a satisfying and hopeful conclusion that provided closure and fan service, particularly enjoying the return of the DR2 cast. However, a significant portion of the audience criticized the episode for its poor writing, plot holes, and undermining of previous storylines, resulting in many feeling that the ending was unearned and diminished the overall impact of the series.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to the Hope's Peak storyline.
Seeing DR2 cast back in action and interacting with DR1 cast.
Explanation of lingering plot points from previous episodes.
cons: Poor writing quality and reliance on deus ex machina.
Undermining of previous games' storylines, especially Danganronpa 2.
Overly hopeful conclusion that negates previous struggles and sacrifices.
Plot holes and inconsistencies.

anime.title: Knight's & Magic
anime.synopsis:
Having died in a car accident, Tsubasa Kurata—an otaku from modern Japan—is reborn in the Fremmevilla Kingdom, a medieval world where powerful mechs called Silhouette Knights are used to fight horrific demonic beasts.

Born into a noble family under the name of Ernesti Echevarria and bestowed with prodigious magical abilities, he enrolls into Royal Laihaila Academy. This school of magic trains young men and women on how to pilot the Silhouette Knights, prepping them to protect the kingdom from threats, both demonic and human. Ernesti teams up with the twins named Adeltrud and Archid Olter with the goal to create his own Silhouette Knight one day, a feat unheard of for several centuries.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with mecha fans finding enjoyment in the detailed robot designs and action sequences. However, many find the story rushed, the characters underdeveloped, and the isekai elements generic. The series is considered a fun but ultimately shallow experience, best suited for those primarily interested in mecha action over a compelling narrative. Some viewers also criticize the adaptation for cutting content and rushing the plot.
pros: Enjoyable for mecha fans due to detailed mech designs and battles.
Unique blend of fantasy and mecha genres.
The main character's enthusiasm for mechs is infectious and fun to watch.
cons: Rushed storytelling and pacing issues.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of emotional depth.
Generic isekai elements overshadow the mecha aspects.
Poor adaptation of the source material with significant plot and character development cuts.
anime.thematic_vibe: Mecha Focus, Isekai Elements, Technical Innovation

anime.title: RIN-NE Season 3
anime.synopsis: The third season of Kyoukai no Rinne.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in the series' comedic and episodic nature, while others criticize its lack of plot progression and character development. The show's repetitive gags and reliance on established tropes are seen as both a strength (for Rumic fans) and a weakness (for those seeking more serious storytelling). Overall, the audience is divided on whether the series maintains its charm or falls into stagnation.
pros: Takahashi's art style shines through and feels like a mix of new and old.
Refreshing color choices.
Good for simple comedy.
cons: Stagnation of plot and character development.
Characters reduced to one-note archetypes.
Recycling jokes and tropes to the point of being trite.
Filler episodes with repetitive storylines.
anime.thematic_vibe: Gag Comedy, Slice of Life, Supernatural

anime.title: High School Fleet OVA
anime.synopsis:
The mutinous Musashi has been defeated, and the girls from Yokosuka Girls' Marine High School are safely back home. However, the Harekaze sustained critical damage during its final encounter with the Musashi and may not be able to sail again. Moreover, rumors spread that the Harekaze-class will be dissolved due to it lacking a ship. 

Other classes' attempts to scout members from the Harekaze's crew only make the situation even more uncertain. The answer to this dire problem may be found in the sealed orders that the secretary of the Harekaze, Kouko Nosa, is to deliver to its crewmembers. But time is running short...
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is considered entertaining and light-hearted, successfully continuing the tone of the original series. While the story isn't particularly groundbreaking, it provides a satisfying resolution to the challenges faced by the Harekaze crew. The audience generally enjoys the continuation of the characters and their interactions.
pros: Entertaining narrative
Well-executed plot elements
cons: Story isn't anything special

anime.title: Rewrite: Moon and Terra
anime.synopsis: The second season of the Rewrite series which adapts Moon and Terra routes.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 is a mixed bag, with some viewers appreciating the darker tone and character development, while others criticize the confusing plot, rushed ending, and poor adaptation of the source material.  The season's quality is considered an improvement over the first, but still falls short due to narrative incoherence and unsatisfying resolution.  Overall, audience opinions are polarized, with strong positive and negative reactions.
pros: Significant improvement over season 1
Character development of Kotarou is well-done
Attempts to explain fragmented world-building from Season 1
cons: Story feels compressed and abstract
Ending feels rushed and forced
Protagonist's behavior is unlikable (screaming, crying, edgy)
Confusing theories require VN knowledge
Poor adaptation of the source material; rushed plot
Inconsistent animation quality; some CGI monsters look out of place
Ending is unsatisfying and poorly executed

anime.title: One-Punch Man Season 2
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Comedy, Parody, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
In the wake of defeating Boros and his mighty army, Saitama has returned to his unremarkable everyday life in Z-City. However, unbeknownst to him, the number of monsters appearing is still continuously on the rise, putting a strain on the Hero Association's resources. Their top executives decide on the bold move of recruiting hoodlums in order to help in their battle. But during the first meeting with these potential newcomers, a mysterious man calling himself Garou makes his appearance. Claiming to be a monster, he starts mercilessly attacking the crowd.

The mysterious Garou continues his rampage against the Hero Association, crushing every hero he encounters. He turns out to be the legendary martial artist Silverfang's best former disciple and seems driven by unknown motives. Regardless, this beast of a man seems unstoppable. Intrigued by this puzzling new foe and with an insatiable thirst for money, Saitama decides to seize the opportunity and joins the interesting martial arts competition.

As the tournament commences and Garou continues his rampage, a new great menace reveals itself, threatening the entire human world. Could this finally be the earth-shattering catastrophe predicted by the great seer Madame Shibabawa?
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of One Punch Man is largely considered a disappointment due to a significant drop in animation quality and changes in directorial vision. While some appreciate the story's direction and the introduction of new characters like Garou, the consensus is that it fails to live up to the standards set by the first season. Many feel that the production quality and comedic timing diminish the overall experience.
pros: Some viewers found the story to be of higher quality than season 1.
Garou is a compelling character that has potential to be the main character.
cons: Significant downgrade in animation quality compared to the first season, with poor art, dull color palettes, and messy shading.
Direction and comedic timing are lacking, failing to capture the heart and soul of the franchise.
Over-reliance on still sequences and cheap effects in action scenes.
Story and characters feel half-baked and lackluster.
Sound design and effects are inadequate, particularly in action sequences.
Feels less like a satire and more like a conventional shonen format.

anime.title: Orange: Mirai
anime.genres: Drama, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shoujo, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Twenty-six-year-old Hiroto Suwa; his wife, Naho; and their old high school classmates—Takako Chino, Azusa Murasaka, and Saku Hagita—visit Mt. Koubou to view the cherry blossoms together. While watching the setting sun, they reminisce about Kakeru Naruse, their friend who died 10 years ago. Mourning for him, they decide to visit Kakeru's old home, where they learn the secret of his death from his grandmother.

Filled with regret, Suwa and his friends decide to write letters to their 16-year-old past selves to set their hearts at rest. With the knowledge contained in the letter from his future self, 16-year-old Suwa has the chance to rewrite the future. What choices will he make? What will happen in this new future?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on 'Orange: Mirai.' Some appreciate the additional perspective and resolution, while others are disappointed by the excessive recap, character inconsistencies, and the undermining of the anime's ending.  The film is criticized for making Suwa's fate unhappy in both timelines and for not adding enough new or meaningful content.
pros: Offers a different perspective, especially Suwa's.
Concludes the story and answers unanswered questions from the series.
Higher animation quality than the anime series.
cons: Excessive recap of the anime series consumes a large portion of the movie.
New content is limited and doesn't add much to the overall story.
Character portrayals are inconsistent, with Suwa appearing self-centered and Naho being oblivious.
The film undermines the ending of the original anime and creates a sense of unhappiness for Suwa in both timelines.
Deals with depression in an oversimplified way.

anime.title: Nyanko Days
anime.synopsis:
Average high school student Yuuko Konagai tends to be rather shy and socially awkward. Due to this, besides earning rather mediocre grades, she barely has friends inside her class. However, after a monotonous day at school, she returns to her long-awaited haven—home with her cats Maa, Shi, and Ro! With their unique personalities, the three possess bodies similar to those of humans, retaining the ability to speak and communicate. Every day, the adorable bunch awaits their owner's return to shower her with much-needed companionship.

Nyanko Days highlights the life of Yuuko and her cats as they brighten up each moment and make new friends in the passing days.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Nyanko Days to be a cute and relaxing show, perfect for a quick mood boost. However, its extremely short episodes and lack of substantial plot or character development are significant drawbacks for some viewers. While appreciated for its 'kawaii' factor, it's not considered a must-watch anime due to its shallowness.
pros: Characters are cute and memorable.
Voice acting is top notch.
The show is a quick and easy way to relax and feel good.
The opening theme is catchy and enjoyable.
cons: Episodes are too short.
Characters are underdeveloped and cliche.
Plot is non-existent or weak.
Humor is lacking for some viewers.

anime.title: Super Danganronpa 2.5: Nagito Komaeda and the Destroyer of the World
anime.romaji_title: Super Danganronpa 2.5: Komaeda Nagito to Sekai no Hakaisha
anime.synopsis:
At Hope's Peak Academy, a school full of extraordinarily talented individuals, Nagito Komaeda is an ordinary boy with no special traits or interesting skills to speak of—except for his incredible unluckiness. Just walking to school in the morning leads to a number of unfortunate accidents, which only escalate as the day goes on. Despite this, Komaeda leads a relatively normal life and is satisfied with his modest slice of happiness.

But everything changes when a mysterious boy who declares himself the "Destroyer of the World" arrives to shatter this hopeless paradise.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some appreciate the OVA for providing closure and character insight, especially regarding Komaeda. However, many criticize the weak story, inconsistent character behavior, and its failure to add meaningful depth to the overall Danganronpa narrative.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to character arcs
Insight into Komaeda's true nature
Plausible explanation for events after Danganronpa 2
cons: Poorly written and nonsensical plot
Characters acting out of character
Fails to strengthen bonds between DR2 and DR3
Too short to fully explore the premise

anime.title: Overlord: The Undead King
anime.synopsis: First Overlord recap film.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is largely considered a recap of the first half of the anime's first season, offering little new content or improvement. It may serve as a refresher for those who have already watched the anime, but it's generally not recommended for newcomers due to its rushed pacing and lack of detailed explanations. Most viewers find it unnecessary if they're familiar with the original series.
pros: Helps refresh memory of the first season.
Good for those waiting for the second season.
Condenses the story for a quick re-watch.
cons: Adds nothing new to the original anime.
Animation and CG fights are the same as the anime.
Leaves out too much initial story building.
Feels rushed and doesn't properly introduce new viewers to the series.
Useless if you have already watched season 1.

anime.title: Cocolors
anime.synopsis: There is a world in which an endless rain of dark ash fills the sky, and covers the earth. Humanity, fearing the ash that burns and melts away human flesh, had no choice but to cover themselves in protective suits, and their faces with gigantic masks. Bundled up in their suits and hidden away behind their masks, the people have fled deep within the underground. This is the story of the children growing up in this fearful world.
anime.consensus_summary: Cocolors evokes mixed reactions. Some appreciate its artistic style, immersive atmosphere, and exploration of hope in a dystopian setting. Others find the plot underdeveloped, the characters lacking depth, and the story reliant on overused tropes, ultimately leading to a mediocre experience.
pros: Unique art style that complements the atmosphere
Immersive world-building through visuals and sound
Exploration of hope and the human spirit in dire circumstances
cons: Underdeveloped characters and motivations
Thin plot with minimal explanation
Relies on overused tropes

anime.title: Grimoire of Zero
anime.romaji_title: Zero kara Hajimeru Mahou no Sho
anime.synopsis:
In a world of constant war between humans and witches, there exist the "beastfallen"—cursed humans born with the appearance and strength of an animal. Their physical prowess and bestial nature cause them to be feared and shunned by both humans and witches. As a result, many beastfallen become sellswords, making their living through hunting witches.
 
Despite the enmity between the races, a lighthearted witch named Zero enlists a beastfallen whom she refers to as "Mercenary" to act as her protector. He travels with Zero and Albus, a young magician, on their search for the Grimoire of Zero: a powerful spell book that could be extremely dangerous in the wrong hands. During their journey, his inner kindness is revealed as he starts to show compassion and sympathy towards humans and witches alike, and the unlikely companions grow together.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with many finding the anime enjoyable despite its flaws. While the simple plot and character interactions are appreciated, the predictable storyline and inconsistent writing are frequently criticized. The series is considered a decent watch for fans of the fantasy genre, but not a masterpiece.
pros: Well-paced story that isn't too rushed or boring, making every moment engaging.
Good character chemistry, especially between Zero and Mercenary, making their relationship development fun to watch.
Satisfying ending that wraps up the main arc nicely.
Artwork is visually appealing and fits well with a fantasy mindset.
cons: Predictable plot with many mysteries easily solved, lacking a big reveal or surprise.
Inconsistent writing with character traits appearing only when needed by the plot.
Uneven character development, particularly with Mercenary, with more focus on witch characters.
World-building and magic system not explained in sufficient depth.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fantasy Adventure, Simple Good vs Evil, Character Chemistry

anime.title: Angel's 3Piece!
anime.synopsis:
Since entering high school, Kyou Nukui has not attended a single class. Instead, he spends his days locked in his bedroom composing music and posting it on the internet accompanied by his only friend's drawings, an artist with the pseudonym "Kiriyume." One day, Kyou hesitantly uploads his newest composition, and first departure from his typical style, TR03. Additionally, he does not upload under his usual handle "HibikiP," but simply under the name "me," and without a drawing from his mysterious friend.

Shortly after, Kyou receives a very polite email, not only praising his music but also somehow discerning that he is, in fact, the composer behind TR03. The e-mail also asks for a meetup in a nearby park, to which he cautiously decides to go. To his surprise, however, he finds three elementary school girls at the meeting place! Suddenly, Jun Gotou, Nozomi Momijidani, and Sora Kaneshiro ask for his help to hold a concert in their home, an old church now used as an orphanage. And though Kyou is reluctant at first, after seeing their musical abilities, he eventually decides to accept their proposal.

Based on the light novel of the same name by the award-winning Sagu Aoyama, Tenshi no 3P! follows Kyou as these three angels change his life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, primarily due to the show's focus on young girls and associated fan service. While some appreciate the cute characters, heartwarming moments, and music, others are critical of the weak plot and potentially exploitative elements. This split results in a polarized viewing experience, with enjoyment heavily dependent on individual tolerance for the show's specific themes.
pros: The music is generally well-received, with catchy and enjoyable songs.
Many find the characters cute, adorable, and likeable, especially the main trio.
Some viewers appreciate the heartwarming and relaxing atmosphere of the show.
cons: The series has significant 'loli' elements, which some viewers find uncomfortable or inappropriate.
The plot is often considered weak, predictable, and formulaic.
Character development is seen as lacking, with characters remaining static throughout the series.

anime.title: Meiji Tokyo Renka
anime.genres: Historical, Josei, Reverse Harem, Romance, Supernatural, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Mei Ayazuki is just your ordinary, everyday high-school girl. That is until one night, when the moon is full and red, she’s transported through time to the Meiji Period by Charlie, a self-proclaimed magician.

She ends up in a strange, Meiji-era ‘Tokyo’ where the existence of ghosts is accepted. Led by Charlie, she finally arrives at the Rokumeikan. There, waiting for her to arrive, are the historical figures Ougai Mori, Shunsou Hishida, Otojirou Kawakami, Kyouka Izumi, Gorou Fujita, Yakumo Koizumi, and Tousuke Iwasaki.

Whilst interacting with these men, she discovers she is a Tamayori - someone who can see ghosts - a skill that is highly valued in the Meiji Period. Due to these powers, her relationship with the men begins to change… As she gets to know these handsome men in a new era she just can’t get used to, a love begins to grow within her.

Will Mei be able to return to her time? What will become of her love - a love that crosses the boundaries of time and space?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many viewers finding the anime enjoyable for its reverse harem elements and attractive art style, while also criticizing it for its shallow plot, underdeveloped characters, and disappointing ending. The ending is a major point of contention, with some appreciating its uniqueness and others feeling betrayed by the protagonist's final decision. Ultimately, the anime is seen as a lighthearted but forgettable experience.
pros: Enjoyable characters with fun interactions.
Beautiful art and detailed backgrounds.
The protagonist has actual character development.
The ending stands out from typical happy endings, offering a fresh perspective.
cons: Flat characters with little development beyond their initial problem.
Basic and predictable story with plot holes.
Underdeveloped premise with poorly explained concepts and wasted potential.
Disappointing ending that undermines the character's decisions and emotional investment.
Generic visual style
anime.thematic_vibe: Reverse Harem, Time Travel, Historical Romance

anime.title: Tawawa on Monday
anime.synopsis:
Oniisan, a typical salaryman, has the weekly duty of protecting high school student Ai-chan from gropers by escorting her during their Monday morning train commutes. Despite the short time Oniisan and Ai-chan spend together, they manage to bond and learn more about each other's lives. To help Oniisan get through his Monday blues, Ai-chan gives him small presents as motivation.

Ai-chan and many other girls—who all share a certain attractive trait—lighten up the Mondays of their male friends and colleagues for the long week ahead.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion on Getsuyoubi no Tawawa is split between those who appreciate its lighthearted, escapist "healing" nature and its charming art/sound, and those who are put off by its heavy reliance on exaggerated fanservice and a perceived lack of plot or character depth. While many find its short format and comforting themes enjoyable, others view the excessive focus on physical attributes as detracting from any potential for meaningful storytelling or character development.
pros: The animation quality is consistently praised as good, with attention to detail in character movements and expressions.
The art style is described as clean, calm, and cozy, contributing positively to the overall mood.
The soundtrack and voice acting, particularly for Ai-chan, are noted as fitting and enhancing the heartwarming atmosphere.
The show's ability to provide comfort and a brief escape from the mundane realities of adult life is a significant positive.
The relatable characters and situations, even with the fanservice elements, are seen as a strength.
The show is appreciated for its unique episodic structure and focus on short, digestible content.
cons: The heavy reliance on fanservice, specifically the exaggerated breasts, is a major point of contention and distracts from potential narrative depth.
The plot is considered minimal or non-existent, leading to a lack of substance for some viewers.
The characters, especially the male protagonists, are often described as bland, underdeveloped, or mere self-insert canvases.
The portrayal of a high school girl in romantic/sexualized situations with older men is uncomfortable for some.
The show's short episode length, while a pro for some, limits development and can feel disjointed.
Some viewers find the 'wish fulfillment' aspect to be problematic or unrealistic, especially in conjunction with the fanservice.

anime.title: Forest Fairy Five
anime.synopsis: A beautiful nation, prospering since ancient times, Japan is now known as the Anime Kingdom. There are more than just humans living there; animes truly do exist in Japan. Past the Fairy Ring, to the world of fairies, live anime-chans. There's a Fairy Ring in your town, too. Here. And there. Even in Harajuku. Maybe even in the Ashigara mountains. By some chance, we'll open that door. And we might get to meet the anime-chans. This is the land where you get to meet anime-chans.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Reviewers describe the show as visually offensive, poorly produced, and lacking any coherent plot or character development. While some find humor in its awfulness, most agree that it's not worth watching, even for fans of 'bad anime'. The show is largely considered a waste of time and a low point in anime production.
pros: The opening theme song is not too bad.
Can be funny if watched with friends due to how bad it is.
The series improves technically as it progresses.
cons: Abysmal plot with no clear direction.
Terrible animation with glitchy loops and excessive bloom, making it visually painful.
Poor sound quality, inconsistent voice acting, and distracting microphone issues.
Characters are underdeveloped and unlikeable.
Show is boring and not even fun to watch as a 'so bad it's good' anime.

anime.title: Osomatsu-san: An Anecdote with Horses
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody, Racing, Sports
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Osomatsu-san, released as a collaboration with the Japan Racing Association (JRA). The episode consists of multiple short skits surrounding horse racing.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some find the episode enjoyable, especially if they are interested in horse racing, while others find the jokes to be weak and the animation stiff. The special may appeal to dedicated fans of Osomatsu-san, but it is not recommended for casual viewers or those unfamiliar with horse racing.
pros: Comedy is still just as good as the show's to me.
Worth watching if you like horses or horse racing and horse racing bets.
cons: Most jokes didn't stick.
Art is noticeably stiffer than in the original series.
A lot more gross-out humor than in the actual series.
Writers seemed to be beating a dead horse (bad pun definitely intended).

anime.title: Shelter
anime.synopsis: Day 2539: Rin wakes up alone again with blurred memories and still no contact from any other human. She is not bored, however, because in her arms lies a tablet capable of creating any world her heart desires. Day after day, Rin crafts a wonderful reality—one utopia at a time—to shelter her from loneliness, hoping to one day reveal the truth behind her very existence.
anime.consensus_summary: Shelter is a visually impressive and emotionally resonant short film that has garnered both praise and criticism. While many appreciate its beautiful animation, touching story, and effective use of music to amplify emotional impact, some find the narrative predictable and emotionally manipulative. The short length is a point of contention, with some considering it a strength and others wishing for a more elaborate story.
pros: Visually stunning animation with vivid colors and detailed scenery.
