Powerful and touching story despite its short length, effectively conveying complex emotions.
Music complements the animation and enhances the emotional impact.
cons: Story may be considered clichéd or predictable by some viewers.
Relies heavily on emotional manipulation and tear-jerking tropes.
Short length may leave viewers wanting more character development and plot elaboration.

anime.title: Aqua Kids
anime.synopsis: The polar ice caps have melted due to global warming. The human race has been stuck on one island as the marine life begins to evolve. Kids use a submarine and the help of their robot companions to explore the depths and come upon an ancient secret underwater civilization with treasure. It's a new hope for the human race to live under water but a money hungry real-estate tycoon stands in their way of peace.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience displays strong nostalgic love for 'Aqua Kids', often comparing it favorably to other anime giants and creating elaborate personal narratives around it. However, there's a notable level of absurdism and in-fighting within the fanbase, with some reviews devolving into bizarre religious claims and arguments. This makes assessing genuine critique difficult, but the core positive sentiment revolves around strong character development and engaging themes
pros: Character development is phenomenal.
The animation is a large step above what I've seen before.
Music is so good to the point your headset breaks because it can't handle the type of quality.
cons: There are only 26 episodes.
Plot has betrayals and backstabbing.
Some reviews are incoherent and nonsensical.

anime.title: THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS Theater
anime.synopsis:
The girls of 346 Productions are back in this bite-sized look at their personal lives! Follow the idols of the Cinderella Project as they take a break from their hectic routine and instead go on vacations, eat at restaurants, and partake in other cheerful activities. Whether their faithful producer is along for the ride or just their fellow idols, everyone knows how to make the most of their days off.

Departing from its regular format, Cinderella Girls Gekijou is composed of several skits packed into shorter three-minute episodes, focusing on one or more characters at a time.
anime.consensus_summary: Cinderella Girls Gekijou is a lighthearted and comedic short series that caters specifically to fans of the Cinderella Girls franchise. Its references to the source material provide additional context and enjoyment for dedicated followers. However, its reliance on franchise knowledge may limit its appeal to casual viewers.
pros: Snappy comedy due to short runtime.
Homage to the original source material, referencing card scenes and mobile game content.
Showcases the daily lives of Cinderella Girls idols.
cons: Comedy relies heavily on knowledge of the Cinderella Girls franchise, potentially alienating casual fans.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Comedy, Idol Culture

anime.title: The Royal Tutor
anime.synopsis:
Equally charming and stern, Heine Wittgenstein is a brilliant man who commands respect, despite his short, childlike stature. Thus, the king of Grannzreich has called upon Heine to undertake a daunting task that has driven away many before him—become the new royal tutor to four princes who are in line for the throne.

The four heirs each have very distinct and troublesome personalities: Licht, the flirtatious youngest prince; his immature older brother, Leonhard; Bruno, the studious third prince; and Kai, the oldest of the four and the most reserved. Hilarity ensues as Heine attempts to connect with each of the princes in order to groom them for the throne. However, Heine's mysterious past and dark undercurrents in the present may threaten the harmony within the kingdom.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Oushitsu Kyoushi Heine' for its heartwarming story, well-developed characters, and pleasing art style. While some find the plot simple and predictable, the focus on character growth and the relationships between the princes and Heine is widely appreciated. The show is considered enjoyable and easy to watch, with a good balance of humor and serious moments.
pros: Well-developed and likeable characters with distinct personalities
Heartwarming and enjoyable plot with a good balance of humor and serious moments
Pleasing art style and animation
cons: Simple and predictable plot
Occasional over-reliance on chibi art style
Bland dialogue
Simplistic and illogical conclusions to plot points

anime.title: Record of Grancrest War
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Military, Romance
anime.synopsis:
The continent of Atlatan once again finds itself devoured by the flames of war after a horrific event known as the Great Hall Tragedy. What was supposed to be a joyful occasion that would establish peace between the Fantasia Union and the Factory Alliance, the marriage of Sir Alexis Douse and Lady Marrine Kreische, was instead a tragedy. As the bride and groom walked down the aisle, the ceremony was suddenly interrupted by a powerful convergence of "Chaos," a dark energy from another dimension that corrupts the land and brings forth monsters and demons into the world. From within that energy appeared the Demon Lord of Diabolos, an evil being who instantly murdered the archdukes of both factions, shattering any hope for peace between them.
 
Having failed to prevent this disaster, Siluca Meletes, an Alliance mage, is traveling through the Chaos-infested countryside to study under a master magician. When she is intercepted by a group of soldiers working with the Federation, Siluca is rescued by Theo Cornaro, a young warrior carrying a mysterious "Crest," a magical symbol that gives its wielder the ability to banish Chaos. Bearing no allegiance to a specific domain, Theo hopes to attain the rank of Lord so that he can liberate his home town of Sistina from its tyrannical ruler and the Chaos spreading within it. Impressed by his noble goal, Siluca enters into a magical contract with Theo, and the two embark on a journey to restore balance to their war-torn land.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some found the show to be a fun and engaging fantasy action-adventure with political intrigue and romance, while others criticized it for its pacing issues, generic plot, and underdeveloped characters. The show's ambition may have exceeded its execution, resulting in a somewhat divisive reception.
pros: Well-crafted fantasy world and setting.
Engaging political intrigue and strategic battles.
Satisfying blend of action, magic, and romance for some viewers.
Some viewers appreciated the character interactions and development.
Director's visual storytelling is appreciated.
cons: Pacing issues, particularly in the first half.
Generic plot elements and cliches.
Underdeveloped characters, especially side characters.
Weak or confusing story for some viewers.
Inconsistent art quality and animation issues.

anime.title: Gamers!
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Polygon, Otaku Culture, Romance, School, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
Keita Amano is a typical high school gamer living out an average student's life. One day, however, he has an unexpected meeting with the cutest girl in school that makes him want to disappear without a trace! 

This girl, Karen Tendou, is an exemplary student who is proclaimed to be the school's idol. She discovers that Amano is a gamer, and this newfound knowledge incites a passionate desire within her to recruit him into the game club. Upon visiting the club, Amano is forcefully made aware of a side to gaming wildly different than the one he loves so dearly. 

Tendou's interest in Amano begins shaking up what was once an uneventful life, filling it with spontaneity, awkwardness, and a little bit of mayhem. As a result, every day becomes a comical battle for Amano's sanity as he tries to adapt to these wild, unexpected changes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Gamers!' are divided. Some find the anime's self-aware humor and relatable characters enjoyable, while others are frustrated by the repetitive misunderstandings and shallow plot. The show is seen as a decent RomCom with gaming elements that ultimately fails to deliver on its initial premise, leading to disappointment for some viewers.
pros: Humorous and self-aware, poking fun at common anime clichés.
Relatable characters with interesting personalities and good chemistry.
Catchy opening and ending themes with bright visuals.
cons: Overreliance on misunderstandings as the primary plot device, becoming repetitive and frustrating.
Characters often act irrationally, leading to contrived situations.
The gaming aspect feels tacked on and not well-integrated into the story.

anime.title: Yuki Yuna is a Hero: The Washio Sumi Chapter
anime.romaji_title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Washio Sumi no Shou
anime.synopsis:
Three girls have been chosen by the great Shinju-sama to be heroes and fight against the destructive beings known as Vertexes—enemies that threaten the harmony and safety of the world.

Unsure of when they would be called to duty, Sumi Washio, Sonoko Nogi, and Gin Minowa spent their time idly. However, with the sudden appearance of a Vertex, they realize they have no idea how to fight together as magical girls when they are nearly bested. They manage to defeat their enemy by sheer determination, but in the aftermath of the battle, the three decide to fix their teamwork issues and improve their combat capabilities.

But as more enemies appear—and requiring even more power to defeat their nemeses—the girls may find themselves irreversibly changed by the use of their magic. What price will they have to pay to ensure victory, and is it one worth paying if humanity will be saved?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, appreciating the exploration of Tougou's past and the relationships between the characters. However, some find the prequel format predictable and unnecessary. The series evokes strong emotions, particularly regarding character fates, and is recommended for fans of the original Yuuki Yuuna series.
pros: Expands on Mimori/Tougou's backstory, adding depth to her character.
The prequel format creates dramatic irony, enhancing emotional impact.
Strong focus on character development and bonds between the main trio (Sumi, Sonoko, and Gin).
cons: The story's ending is predictable due to its prequel nature, lessening the surprise.
Some viewers find the animation during transformations excessive.
Some viewers feel the story is unnecessary, as the original hinted at the backstory adequately.

anime.title: Schoolgirl Strikers: Animation Channel
anime.synopsis:
It's the near future. The newly established girls' private school Goryoukan Academy has another face. This school has a special unit, Fifth force, who is assembled and selected from the school's student body in order to fight an enemy called O'bli.

This is a story about love, courage and friendship about the girls called Strikers.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception is mixed with many finding the anime generic and uninspired, particularly in its story and characters. Some viewers enjoyed it as a lighthearted, cute-girls-doing-things show with decent voice acting and occasional moments of fun. However, the lack of depth, uninspired action, and reliance on typical anime tropes made it difficult to recommend widely.
pros: Enjoyable voice acting, especially Kana Hanazawa and Miyuki Sawashiro.
Decent fight scenes with dynamic camera movement.
Some found it enjoyable as a laid-back comedy.
High-tier art with plentiful visual quality and fluid movements
cons: Generic and uninspired story and characters.
Weak plot with underdeveloped characters.
Bland and cookie-cutter villains.
Over-reliance on slice-of-life elements with little character development.
Uninspired action scenes and cheap animation at times.

anime.title: Kirakira Pretty Cure A La Mode
anime.synopsis:
Cheerful teenager Ichika Usami has a passion for sweets that is inspired by her mother's baking. In celebration of her mother's return from overseas, she tries her hand at making a cake herself. She is interrupted when a dog-like fairy named Pekorin crashes into her kitchen. With Pekorin's help, Ichika successfully bakes her cake. Only then enters an imp named Gummy who bursts in and attempt to steal the cake's "kirakiraru", a magical power that gives sweets the ability to bring happiness.

Though Ichika initially offers her cake to Gummy in order to protect Pekorin, the fairy helps her realize how important the treat is and the love it represents. As the kirakiraru within Ichika's cake grows, it changes into a set of trinkets that transforms her into Cure Whip, a hero known as a Pretty Cure. Using her newfound powers, she goes on to battle kirakiraru thieves whenever they appear. Ichika fights to protect Ichigozaka's sweets and finds colorful new allies along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Kirakira Precure A La Mode are divided. Some appreciate its unique aesthetic, character designs, and wholesome themes. However, others criticize its inconsistent plot, forced character dynamics, and dated visuals, resulting in a polarized reception.
pros: Unique aesthetic combining desserts and animals.
Memorable character designs and transformation sequences.
Enjoyable and complex villains.
Wholesome and cheerful themes that can uplift viewers.
Some well-written character arcs, like Himari's, with neurodivergent representation.
cons: Plot inconsistencies and lack of direction.
Forced friendship dynamics between the Precures.
Dated visuals and unpolished animation for a 2017 anime.
Mix of unrelated themes (cakes/sweets and animals) that don't blend well.
Uneven story quality, with a weaker first half.
Potential for the series to become depressing, clashing with initial lighthearted expectations.

anime.title: Kamigami no Ki
anime.synopsis: Set during 3000 BCE in the Nile region of Egypt, Kamigami no Ki ("Chronicles of the Gods") will depict the comical misadventures of Bastet, Anubis, Ra, and the mysterious ghost Medjedo as well as their caretakers, Iabi and Ahkeu.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience enjoys the show's humorous and educational approach to Egyptian mythology, particularly highlighting Toshiyuki Morikawa's voice acting. The short episode length is the only significant drawback mentioned. Overall, the audience seems to appreciate the lighthearted nature of the series.
pros: Unique voice acting performance by Toshiyuki Morikawa
Humorous take on Egyptian mythology
cons: Very short episodes (two-minute shorts)

anime.title: Digimon Adventure tri. Loss
anime.synopsis:
The Chosen Children have been reunited with their Digimon partners, who no longer remember them due to the effects of a digital reset. While everyone tries to reconnect with their digital monsters, Sora Takenouchi encounters resistance from Piyomon, who stubbornly refuses to speak to her. Suddenly, an attack by a hostile Digimon separates the group, scattering them and their Digimon across the Digital World.

Back in the human world, Daigo Nishijima of the Incorporated Administrative Agency receives a warning that a new entity is in pursuit of "Libra," which he believes to be an alias for Meicoomon. For some reason, Meicoomon retains all of her memories and therefore still recalls her partner Meiko Mochizuki, who has come alone to the Digital World to find her. If they hope to identify what other forces have been driving the incidents thus far, the Chosen Children must survive the obstacles of the recreated Digital World and make their way back home.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed to negative, with many feeling disappointed by inconsistencies, poor pacing, and questionable plot decisions. While some appreciate the nostalgia and character focus, the overall consensus is that the film fails to live up to expectations. The animation and story are criticized, leading to a polarized reception among Digimon fans.
pros: Nostalgia is strong, especially towards the end.
Focus on Sora and Piyomon's relationship is a highlight.
Comedy is superior to previous installments.
cons: Inconsistencies and plot contrivances are abundant.
Animation quality is often static and below film caliber.
New characters and backstory feel forced and poorly integrated.
Pacing issues persist due to the episodic format.

anime.title: Full-Time Magister
anime.synopsis:
The aloof high schooler Mo Fan has found himself in a universe similar yet distinctly different from his own mundane one; it is a place where magic has replaced the essence of science. Here, the most capable students are taught to master the wonders of spellworking to fend off large devastating beasts that lurk in the forests surrounding the city. 

Like his previous life, Mo Fan remains the son of a poor laborer and the older step-brother to a crippled sister. Despite these disadvantages, he dreams of attending a magic school to become a magician—a highly respected and lucrative trade—in order to repay his father for his hard work. 

Mo Fan is accepted into a renowned magic institution. However, rumors spread about his poverty and lack of magical ability, labeling him as the laughing stock of the school. Nonetheless, Mo Fan manages to harness not only the powerful fire element, but also the rare lightning element! Now armed with dual abilities, what dangerous encounters will the versatile mage face?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is sharply divided. While some viewers find enjoyment in the simple power fantasy and protagonist, a significant majority criticize the show's extremely poor production quality, dated animation, and nonsensical, poorly paced storytelling. It's seen by many as a "Chineses Harry Potter" with a low-budget execution, appealing only to a very patient and tolerant audience.
pros: Main character is cool, OP, and not stupid like other MCs; he has a proper goal and shows deep emotions by playing things off for a deeper purpose.

The story can be enjoyable in one go by ignoring plot questions and getting swept along in the pace of 'introduce setting, introduce characters, fight here, fight here, fight here, and finale fight here'.
The main protagonist is strong but underestimated, which is appealing to some viewers.
cons: Animation quality is sub-par, dated, and feels budget; characters are static, art is lazy, choppy, and inconsistent.
Storytelling and pacing are horrible, with too much exposition, random jumps, skipped plot points, and a lack of narrative arc or tension.
Characters are bland, non-descript, vapid, and underdeveloped, with only the main character receiving focus.
Voice acting is poor, awkward, and unnatural, with sound effects often being misplaced or of low quality.
The plot is overly simplistic, predictable, and sometimes nonsensical, with underdeveloped world-building and dropped plot threads.

anime.title: Precure Dream Stars! Movie
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is enjoyable, especially for younger viewers and those who appreciate character interactions. While the story isn't particularly innovative and the 3D animation might not appeal to everyone, the movie shines in its character development and engaging pacing. The film offers a fun crossover experience, particularly highlighting character growth for Ichika and Sakura.
pros: Good character interactions
Engaging story and pacing
Mature portrayal of characters like Ichika
Well-developed character of Sakura
cons: May not appeal to all viewers due to its focus on younger audiences.
Use of 3D animation may be off-putting to some.
The story isn't ground-breaking

anime.title: Nananin no Ayakashi: Chimi Chimi Mouryou!! Gendai Monogatari
anime.romaji_title: Nananin no Ayakashi: Chimi Chimi Mouryou!! Gendai Monogatari
anime.synopsis: This show consists of shorts starring 7 characters created and voiced by the voice actors of the variety show "Seiyuu Danshi desu ga...?". The anime will be a slapstick comedy that follows seven spirits that come to the modern world.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is primarily aimed at fans of the voice actors from 'Seiyuu Danshi desu ga...?' and those who enjoy chibi-style slapstick comedy. Reviews indicate it's a lighthearted and silly series featuring characters created and voiced by the seiyuus themselves. Its appeal is likely narrow, as enjoyment depends on prior knowledge of the variety show and appreciation for the specific humor style. It does not appear controversial, with its reception largely tied to individual preferences for the genre and voice actors involved.
pros: The show is funny and features silly games.
Appeals to fans of the voice actors (seiyuus) and their created characters.
Characters are colorful and have distinct personalities.
cons: The show's appeal is likely limited to those familiar with the 'Seiyuu Danshi desu ga...?' variety show.
The humor might not resonate with those who dislike chibi-style animation or slapstick comedy.
The short format of the anime may not provide sufficient depth for some viewers.

anime.title: Fate/Grand Order -First Order-
anime.synopsis:
In 2015, the Chaldea Security Organization draws on experts of both the magical and mundane fields to observe the future of mankind for possible extinction events. Humanity's survival seems assured for the next century—until the verdict suddenly changes, and now eradication of the species awaits at the end of 2016. The cause is unknown, but appears to be linked with the Japanese town of Fuyuki and the events of 2004 during the Fifth Holy Grail War.

In response, Chaldea harnesses an experimental means of time travel, the Rayshift technology. With it, Ritsuka Fujimaru, a young man newly recruited to the organization, and the mysterious girl Mash Kyrielight, can travel back to 2004 and discover how to save humanity. A grand order to fight fate has been declared—an order to change the past and restore the future.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely polarized, with many viewers finding the plot holes, weak character development, and rushed pacing to be significant detriments. However, some appreciate the action sequences and acknowledge its role as an advertisement for the game.
pros: Decent animation and art, especially in battle scenes.
Engaging action sequences and servant fights.
Soundtrack complements action sequences well.
cons: Significant plot holes and underdeveloped time travel mechanics.
Weak characterization and lack of emotional investment in main characters.
Rushed pacing and excessive exposition, making it difficult for newcomers.
Felt more like an advertisement for the game than a standalone story.

anime.title: Hulaing Babies
anime.synopsis: The anime will center on a group of young girls and their struggle as they aim to become Hula Girls.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Hulaing Babies for its fun, wacky, and aesthetically dreamlike qualities. While the narrative is simple and animation frame rate is low, the vibrant color palette, high-energy editing, and character-driven comedy compensate for these shortcomings. The ending theme, although humorously dark, is considered a positive and a good way to wind down after each episode.
pros: High-energy editing keeps things moving and entertaining.
Character designs work in perfect synergy with one another.
Comedy is character-driven and visually spastic.
cons: Narratively there isn't much going on.
Animation lacks in terms of frames.

anime.title: Ikemen Sengoku: Bromances Across Time
anime.romaji_title: Ikemen Sengoku: Toki wo Kakeru ga Koi wa Hajimaranai
anime.synopsis: "Sasuke Sarutobi" is an average college student at Kyoto University studying time slips as a hobby until the day he falls into a time slip himself, transporting him to the Sengoku Period. Upon arrival, Sasuke encounters several warlords he could only ever dream of meeting: Toyotomi Hideyoshi, Tokugawa Ieyasu, and the famous "Demon King of the Sixth Heaven" Oda Nobunaga, who takes him in as a vassal. Introducing several modern concepts to the warlords varying from playing tennis to sending chain letters, Sasuke finds his place in an old but utterly new world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely positive, especially among fans of the Ikemen Sengoku otome game. Viewers appreciate the comedic, chibi-style adaptation and find it a delightful, short-form entertainment. Those unfamiliar with the game may not fully appreciate the humor, but overall, it's seen as a fun and lighthearted series for fans.
pros: Faithful character representation in chibi form
Humorous and enjoyable for fans of the game
Excellent voice acting matching the game
cons: Very short episodes (3-4 minutes)
May not appeal to those unfamiliar with the Ikemen Sengoku game
Lack of plot for those seeking a serious story

anime.title: Lost Song
anime.synopsis:
Lost Song tells the stories of the cheerful Rin and the reserved Finis, two songstresses who are capable of performing magical songs. Rin grew up in a remote village with her family and was taught to keep her power secret, while Finis lives and performs in the royal palace.

Rin's happy and peaceful life is shattered after she saves an injured knight named Henry Leobort with her song of healing. She was seen by soldiers who proceeded to attack her village in hopes of capturing her. With nowhere else to go, she and her inventor brother Al begin a journey to the capital.

Finis finds herself falling in love with Henry and, knowing that the greedy and spiteful Prince Lood Bernstein IV desires her, must hide their relationship. She wants to help people with her songs, but with war on the horizon, she worries that Lood will order her to cast her magic in the battlefield. Only time will tell how her destiny and Rin's will intersect, as the two of them struggle to find their paths.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers were pleasantly surprised by the plot twists and enjoyed the music, while others found the story generic and the characters uninspired. The plot twist is regarded as either one of the best ever seen or confusing. Overall, the anime has some strong points but is let down by inconsistencies and reliance on tropes.
pros: Surprising and unpredictable plot twists, especially in the latter half.
Enchanting music and vocals that are well-integrated into the story.
Well-crafted story with good songs.
Unique enough that it stands out
cons: Generic and predictable story elements, especially in the first half.
Poorly configured story with tropes that don't work together seamlessly.
Inconsistencies in animation and character design.
Lackluster songs.
Rushed plot twist that could have been handled better
Naivete in the beginning

anime.title: Pig: The Dam Keeper Poems
anime.romaji_title: Pig: Oka no Ue no Dam Keeper
anime.synopsis: Pig lives at the top of a hill in a town surrounded by a destructive, dark cloud. Before Pig's father leaves to find a solution to the cloud, he builds Pig a small wooden dam to protect him and the town. The dam's windmill keeps the cloud at bay, and Pig now has the responsibility to care for the dam. Young and alone, Pig finds love and family through his friendship with Fox, and continues to care for the townsfolk in a variety of ways. However, Pig struggles with the absence of his father, and his desire to search for his father competes with his need to keep the town safe.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds Pig: Oka no Ue no Dam Keeper to be a charming and visually appealing show with a heartwarming story about growing up. The animation style and sound design are praised for creating a unique atmosphere. The show's use of symbolism and anthropomorphism is also appreciated, contributing to a thought-provoking experience.  Overall, the show is highly recommended for viewers who enjoy introspective and emotionally resonant stories.
pros: Colourful world brim with symbolism and creative morphing of the function of things.
Beautiful sound effects and extraordinary arrangements of classical instruments.
Simplistic and fluid animation contributing to a children's book/fairy tale atmosphere.
Charming characters through gestures and details.

anime.title: Ace of Diamond: Second Season OVA
anime.romaji_title: Diamond no Ace: Second Season OVA
anime.synopsis:
OVAs bundled with 4th and 5th manga volumes of Diamond no Ace Act II.

An epilogue of the Diamond no Ace series.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is well-received for showing a side of the characters and their lives not explored in the main series, particularly focusing on character development and off-season activities. The first episode is considered a strong epilogue, while the second is seen as less impactful. Overall, it provides a nice addition to the Diamond no Ace narrative.
pros: Showcases off-season activities and character development not seen in the main series.
Provides an epilogue feel, especially in the first episode.
Explores Miyuki's character post-injury.
cons: The second episode is considered less impactful than the first.
anime.thematic_vibe: Character Development, Slice of Life, Post-Tournament

anime.title: Alice & Zoroku
anime.synopsis:
Sana is not an ordinary little girl; she possesses a special ability known as "Alice's Dream." Due to her power, which allows her to create anything from her imagination, all that she knows is the laboratory where she is a test subject. Wishing to experience the outside world, she escapes and meets a stubborn old florist named Zouroku Kashimura in a convenience store. All too soon, her pursuers catch up and Zouroku is roped into Sana's troubles.

However, far from trying to distance himself, Zouroku extends a hand to help Sana. Following his values and sense of justice, he even gives the pursuers a piece of his mind! Zouroku then offers Sana a place to stay, beginning the daily life and struggles of the unlikely duo.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some finding the series heartwarming and enjoyable due to the characters and their interactions. However, others were disappointed by the uneven pacing, lack of a strong plot, and rushed ending. The show's attempt to blend slice-of-life elements with supernatural themes resulted in a somewhat disjointed experience for many viewers.
pros: Interesting premise with unique powers and abilities.
The relationship between Sana and Zouroku is heartwarming and engaging.
Some reviewers appreciated the blend of action and family moments.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and lack of a solid, well-defined plot.
The story shifts between slice of life and more serious themes, causing tonal inconsistencies.
Ending felt rushed and left some questions unresolved.

anime.title: Vatican Miracle Examiner
anime.synopsis: Fathers Josef Kou Hiraga and Roberto Nicholas are Vatican Miracle Examiners who investigate the authenticity of miraculous phenomena reported from all over the world. In every seemingly sacred event lies horrors of hidden conspiracies, mysterious murders, and devil worship. In this battle of good and evil, Hiraga, a scientific and mathematical genius, and Roberto, a polymath in linguistics and classics, must work together to bring the truth to light. Will their friendship and faith endure the evils in their journey to find a true miracle?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Vatican Kiseki Chousakan are divided. While some appreciate its unique premise, likeable characters, and campy charm, others are critical of its fast pacing, absurd plots, and inconsistent production quality. The show is seen as a 'guilty pleasure' or 'so bad it's good' by some, while others find it to be a disappointing waste of potential. Despite its flaws, the anime has moments of enjoyment, particularly in its exploration of religious themes and mysteries.
pros: Unique premise exploring religious mysteries with a blend of science and faith.
Likeable main characters with a strong, appreciable bond.
Enjoyable for its over-the-top plots and unexpected twists.
cons: Fast pacing that makes it hard to follow the story and character development.
Absurd plots and convoluted explanations that often feel like ass-pulls.
Inconsistent animation quality, overuse of Dutch angles, and cheap animation tricks.

anime.title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Washio Sumi no Shou 1 - Tomodachi
anime.romaji_title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Washio Sumi no Shou 1 - Tomodachi
anime.synopsis: The first movie in the Washio Sumi no Shou trilogy.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the character development and production quality, but some feel the first movie's ending is incomplete. The backstory of Washio/Tougou's nationalism sparks curiosity. The film effectively sets the stage for the prequel trilogy, highlighting the bonds of friendship amid a looming tragedy.
pros: Character development, especially for Washio/Tougou.
Visuals and sound benefit from being a film.
The opening theme song foreshadows events.
cons: The ending of the first part leaves the viewer wanting more.
The story might be slow-paced for those familiar with the overall narrative.

anime.title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Washio Sumi no Shou 2 - Tamashii
anime.romaji_title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Washio Sumi no Shou 2 - Tamashii
anime.synopsis: The second movie in the Washio Sumi no Shou trilogy.
anime.consensus_summary: The second movie focuses on character development and the bonds between the heroines, setting the stage for a tragic turn of events. While some appreciate the focus on character building and emotional depth, others may miss the action from the first movie or find the slice-of-life segments distracting. Overall, the audience appreciates the solid entry in the YuYuYu series, acknowledging its effective storytelling.
pros: Strong character development, especially for Gin.
Exploration of bonds between the main characters.
Effective juxtaposition of slice-of-life and impending conflict.
cons: Minimal action scenes compared to the first movie.
Use of omake-styled skits may not appeal to all viewers.
Fanservice elements may be off-putting.

anime.title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Washio Sumi no Shou 3 - Yakusoku
anime.romaji_title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Washio Sumi no Shou 3 - Yakusoku
anime.synopsis: The third and final movie in the Washio Sumi no Shou trilogy.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience deeply appreciates the emotional resonance and improved adaptation of the source material. While some pacing and content cuts are noted, the overall consensus is overwhelmingly positive, highlighting the impactful scenes, strong character bonds, and the tragic yet epic nature of the story.
pros: Emotional connection to characters
Improved adaptation from source material
Impactful scenes enhanced by art and music
Epic and tragic climax
Exploration of the Hero System's moral implications
Strong bonds between the heroes
cons: Some parts were rushed
Some content was cut from the light novel

anime.title: Citrus
anime.synopsis:
During the summer of her freshman year of high school, Yuzu Aihara's mother remarried, forcing her to transfer to a new school. To a fashionable socialite like Yuzu, this inconvenient event is just another opportunity to make new friends, fall in love, and finally experience a first kiss. Unfortunately, Yuzu's dreams and style do not conform with her new ultrastrict, all-girls school, filled with obedient shut-ins and overachieving grade-skippers. Her gaudy appearance manages to grab the attention of Mei Aihara, the beautiful and imposing student council president, who immediately proceeds to sensually caress Yuzu's body in an effort to confiscate her cellphone.

Thoroughly exhausted from her first day, Yuzu arrives home and discovers a shocking truth—Mei is actually her new step-sister! Though Yuzu initially tries to be friendly with her, Mei's cold shoulder routine forces Yuzu to begin teasing her. But before Yuzu can finish her sentence, Mei forces her to the ground and kisses her, with Yuzu desperately trying to break free. Once done, Mei storms out of the room, leaving Yuzu to ponder the true nature of her first kiss, and the secrets behind the tortured expression in the eyes of her new sister.
anime.consensus_summary: Citrus is highly divisive. Many find the show problematic due to its depiction of sexual assault, incest, and unhealthy relationships. Others criticize the weak plot and poor character development, while a minority appreciates the visuals and exploration of complex themes, though these positives are often overshadowed by the show's numerous flaws.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation.
Some viewers appreciate the exploration of complex emotions and insecurities.
Voice acting is well-done.
cons: Romanticizes or normalizes sexual assault and abuse.
Characters are poorly developed and unlikeable.
Story is unrealistic, nonsensical, and reliant on tired tropes.
Plot is confusing and disjointed.
Harmful LGBTQ+ stereotypes.

anime.title: Koro Sensei Quest!
anime.synopsis:
One day, class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Magic School receives a special mission: to kill their homeroom teacher, the Demon King Koro-sensei. To increase their chances of succeeding, the class searches for the three most powerful warriors—Karma Akabane, Itona Horibe, and Ritsu—who later join their company. Even with their help, accomplishing the mission becomes an insurmountable task as they are not the only ones after the Demon King's life.
 
Koro-sensei Quest! tells the comedic adventures of Nagisa Shiota and class 3-E as chibi magical students. Trained by none other than their very target, the students encounter challenging, yet hilarious situations all through the perilous mission of defeating the Demon King.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Koro-sensei Quest! is a well-received parody and fun diversion for fans of Assassination Classroom. While it doesn't offer much in terms of original story or depth, its humor and lightheartedness make it an enjoyable watch. Some find the humor repetitive or simplistic, but most agree it's a worthwhile spin-off.
pros: Funny and lighthearted take on the original Assassination Classroom story.
Enjoyable for fans of the original series looking for more content.
Chibi art style and comedic situations are well-executed.
cons: May not appeal to those unfamiliar with Assassination Classroom.
Relies heavily on parody and may feel repetitive.
Some humor may be considered lowbrow or fan service-oriented.
Story is simplistic and lacks depth compared to the original.

anime.title: One Room
anime.synopsis:
Having just moved into a new apartment building, Yui Hanasaka makes a customary visit to greet her neighbor. When she learns that he is an upperclassman at the university she aspires to attend, she asks for his help to pass her entrance exams. Meanwhile, Natsuki Momohara decides to visit her older brother, who lives alone in an apartment in Tokyo. Elsewhere, aspiring singer Moka Aoshima reunites with her childhood friend, who is a hopeful novelist. 

Three stories, although seemingly unrelated, contain the same essence: strings of fate will bind together those who share the same destiny, and one needs to look no further than a single apartment room.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions to "One Room" are highly polarized. Some viewers find the show relaxing and enjoy the cute character designs and first-person perspective. However, many others criticize its lack of originality, forced self-insertion, shallow characters, and disturbing elements, leading to a generally negative consensus. Some view it as harmless escapism while others consider it creepy and harmful.
pros: Cute character designs and art style (Kantoku's influence)
Relaxing and comfy vibe for some viewers
Unique first-person perspective is novel for some
cons: Lack of originality and creativity in plot and characters
Shallow and forced character interactions
Over-reliance on fanservice and suggestive camera angles
Silent protagonist leads to awkward dialogue and forced self-insertion
Exploitative and harmful escapism
Short episode length hinders development
Creepy and disturbing elements

anime.title: Room Mate
anime.synopsis: Another One Room series telling "another story" featuring male characters.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in the fanservice and character interactions despite the weak plot and shallow character development.  Many critique the lack of a compelling narrative and inconsistent production quality. The reverse harem concept appeals to some viewers, while others find it poorly executed. Ultimately, the show is seen as a guilty pleasure with significant flaws.
pros: Enjoyable despite flaws
Unique character dynamics for a POV anime
Visually appealing character art
cons: Lack of a cohesive story
Stereotypical and underdeveloped characters
Inconsistent art quality and amateurish visual effects
Awkward camera work in a POV format
gratuitous fanservice without substance

anime.title: Love Rice
anime.synopsis: The project anthropomorphizes rice (kome in Japanese) into schoolboys. At the Kokuritsu Inaho Academy ("Rice Ear Academy," a wordplay on national schools), five new rice-inspired students attempt to supplant bread as the popular grain at the school. The new students form the "Love Rice" unit and challenge themselves to perform at the "Harvest Show" to show the delicious appeal of rice grains. The "heartwarming 'kome'dy with laughs and passion" promises to let audiences rediscover the virtues of rice ("Japan's soul food").
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the show's absurdity and puns hilarious, especially when enjoyed ironically with friends. Others criticize the low production quality, weak plot, and repetitive humor. While some appreciate the show's charm and heart, many find it to be a poorly executed attempt to capitalize on the male idol genre, ultimately polarizing the audience.
pros: The show's absurdity and reliance on rice puns can be genuinely funny, especially when viewed ironically.
The short episode length makes it easy to watch.
Some viewers found the show to be a bonding experience when watched with friends.
cons: The show's premise is bizarre and may not appeal to everyone.
The production quality is low, with uninspired visuals and bland songs.
The plot is weak and relies heavily on clichés.
The humor is repetitive and relies heavily on rice puns.
The ending feels rushed.

anime.title: Taishou Mebiusline: Chicchai-san
anime.synopsis: Hiiragi Kyoichiro, the eldest son of a wealthy family, has left behind his home in Momoki Village to attend the prestigious Imperial University in Tokyo.  He carries with him his family's heirloom katana as well as a rather disturbing secret: he can see the spirits of the dead.  Even so, he remains optomistic of the future that lies ahead, musing on how less scary the spirits would be if only they were less frightening in appearance.  When he awakes, he realizes that he may have gotten his half-hearted wish..in part as he finds he's the one that has become significantly smaller and decidely cuter.  As if that's not enough to throw his world into chaos, Kyoichiro soon finds himself swept up into a supernatural dispute between factions of the Imperial Japanese Army intent on creating an army of undead soldiers, a mysterious stranger with vague intentions, and a seemingly anti-government group known as the Five Katana.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Taishou Mebiusline: Chicchai-san is largely considered a failure due to censorship, poor pacing, and uninspired execution. Reviewers note the potential in the original concept and praise the opening theme, but ultimately find the show incoherent and unfulfilling. The lack of BL content, combined with the extremely short episode length, leads to a disjointed and unsatisfying narrative experience.
pros: Opening theme song is amazing.
Some ending themes are decent.
The core concept has potential.
cons: Censorship of BL content makes the plot nonsensical.
Extremely short episodes prevent proper plot and character development.
Mediocre art and bad visual effects.
Characters are uninspired and cliché.
Tone is inconsistent, switching between comedy and seriousness abruptly.
The reason for characters being child-sized is unclear and unimportant.

anime.title: Nanbaka Season 2
anime.synopsis: The second part of Nanbaka. The prisoners and their guards continue their comfortable lives at Nanba Prison. However, from the shadows emerges a new threat: Enki Gokuu, a person from Samon's past, who has mysterious goals of his own.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized. Many feel betrayed by the shift from gag comedy to serious action, criticizing the weak plot and rushed ending. Others appreciate the character development and expanded world-building, though acknowledge the pacing issues and tonal inconsistencies. While some enjoy the series, many former fans were left disappointed.
pros: Colorful and distinctive art style
Expands on character backstories and world-building
Enjoyable character dynamics and interactions
cons: Significant shift in tone from comedy to serious action
Storyline feels rushed, unresolved, or poorly written
Inconsistent pacing and drawn-out battle sequences
Over-reliance on shounen cliches
Repetitive comedic elements

anime.title: Isekai Izakaya: Japanese Food From Another World
anime.romaji_title: Isekai Izakaya: Koto Aitheria no Izakaya Nobu
anime.synopsis:
Experienced head chef Nobuyuki Yazawa and friendly waitress Shinobu Senke run a traditional Japanese izakaya called Nobu—a bar known for serving a tasty array of food and drink. Welcoming any and all customers, the pair strive to showcase Nobu's exclusive menu and provide the best possible experience.

However, despite its ordinary appearance, the establishment opens to the heart of Aitheria, a city from a parallel universe. As news of the restaurant's exquisite dishes spreads throughout the lands, Aitherian citizens from various social backgrounds travel to Nobu in search of new and delicious cuisine, bringing with them an empty stomach and riveting stories to tell.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Isekai Izakaya' to be a pleasant and relaxing show, appreciating its focus on Japanese cuisine and the calming atmosphere. However, some find the plot weak and repetitive, with comparisons to similar anime highlighting its shortcomings. While enjoyable for its food presentation and easy-going nature, it may not appeal to those seeking a strong narrative.
pros: Appetizing food animation and detailed presentation of Japanese cuisine.
Relaxed tone with conflicts that aren't overly serious, making for easy viewing.
Repeat characters and more interaction between them.
Informative live-action segments on cooking and restaurants in Japan.
cons: Weak or nonexistent plot with episodic format.
Comparisons to 'Isekai Shokudou' highlight perceived shortcomings in storytelling and production quality.
Repetitive nature, focusing on food and customer reactions.
Potential over-reliance on advertising Japanese culinary arts, detracting from the story.

anime.title: Frame Arms Girl
anime.synopsis:
Ao Gennai is a completely average first-year high school student—that is, until a mysterious package is delivered to her home one day. Inside she finds Gourai, a tiny humanoid robot capable of movement and combat known as a Frame Arms Girl. Gourai is the first of her kind, possessing an extremely advanced AI that allows her to form a personality, learn, and grow, much like the human mind.

Following Gourai's activation, Ao is thrust headfirst into the world of Frame Arms Girls as more and more of the intelligent robots are delivered straight to her front door. With a rather hefty cash incentive pushing her forward, Ao is committed to collecting as much data about the Frame Arms Girls and their combat as possible, all while they learn what it means to be human.
anime.consensus_summary: Frame Arms Girl is viewed as a lighthearted and fun anime, primarily serving as an advertisement for the model kit line. While some appreciate the unique blend of slice-of-life and mecha elements, along with the CGI animation style, others criticize the shallow plot, characters, and blatant commercialism. The anime is generally seen as enjoyable for casual viewing, but not a groundbreaking or must-watch series.
pros: Fun and unconventional skits.
Relatable main character (Ao).
Good mix of mech battles and slice-of-life.
Unique use of CGI to represent the characters as plastic model kits.
Upbeat and happy OP/ED that matches the tone of the show.
cons: Thin and simple story.
Characters lack depth beyond initial traits.
Inconsistent animation quality, relying heavily on CGI.
Abrupt tonal shift towards seriousness with the introduction of a 'villain'.
Overuse of fan service.
Obvious advertisement for the Frame Arms Girl model kits.

anime.title: Overlord: The Dark Hero
anime.synopsis: Second Overlord recap film.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is primarily a recap of the second half of the first season, offering a condensed version with a few added scenes. It's suitable for re-watchers or those needing a quick overview, but not essential for viewers familiar with the original content. It sacrifices some world-building and character development for a more action-packed experience.
pros: Good recap for those short on time or wanting a rewatch.
Extended scenes and added content clarify plot points.
Focuses on highlights from the second half of the first season.
cons: Not much reason to watch if you've already seen the first season.
Cuts out narrative worldbuilding and character interactions.
Discards elements involving the adventurer's guild and Nazarick politics.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 21: The Crimson Love Letter
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 21: Karakurenai no Love Letter
anime.genres: Action, Detective, Drama, Historical, Mystery, Romance
anime.synopsis:
A bombing case at Nichiuri TV in autumn. The Satsuki Cup, which crowns the winner of Japan's Hyakunin Isshu, is currently being filmed inside the facility. The incident results in a big commotion and, while the building is burning to ashes, the only people left inside are Heiji and Kazuha. They get rescued just in time by Conan, who rushes to the scene. Both the identity and purposes of the bomber are unknown.

While confusion takes over due to the explosion, Conan meets a mysterious beautiful girl who claims she is "Heiji's fiancée". Her name is Momiji Ooka and she is the Kyoto High School champion of the Karuta game. As fate would have it, Kazuha is going to face Momiji in the Hyakunin Isshu, so she begins to train with the help of Heiji's mother, Shizuka, who is a skilled Karuta player.

At the same time, in a Japanese house in Arashiyama, Kyoto's outskirts, the reigning Satsuki Cup champion is murdered. Pictures of the crime scene reveal Momji's presence. Additionally, several Karuta cards were spread around the victim.

Conan and Heiji, along with the Osaka and Kyoto police departments, begin their investigation on the Satsuki Cup and the related murder case. As the inquiry goes on, they come across a secret connected with the Hyakunin Isshu.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the interesting case, action, and art, while others criticize the overemphasis on romance, predictable mystery, and uninteresting characters. Some find the focus on Karuta unique, while others consider it a drawback. Overall, opinions are divided, resulting in a moderate controversy score.
pros: Interesting case with Karuta cards.
Great art and sound, outstanding OSTs.
Enjoyable to watch and root for Kazuha.
Fast-paced mystery and romantic intrigue.
Spectacular action sequences
cons: Romance aspect is overemphasized and boring.
Mystery is uninteresting and predictable.
Unnecessary focus on Heiji and Kazuha's romance.
Sub-par animation compared to other movies.
Karuta subject matter may not be of interest to everyone.
Movie-original characters are forgettable.
Less detective work than usual

anime.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection
anime.genres: Drama, Mecha, Military, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Since the demise of the man believed to be Britannia's most wicked emperor one year ago, the world has enjoyed an unprecedented peace under the guidance of the United Federation of Nations. However, this fragile calm is shattered when armed militants successfully kidnap former princess Nunnally vi Britannia and Suzaku Kururugi, the chief advisor of the Black Knights, sparking an international crisis.

The powerful and untrustworthy Kingdom of Zilkhstan is accused of orchestrating their capture. To investigate, world authorities send Kallen Stadtfeld and her associates on a covert operation into the country. There, they encounter the immortal witch C.C., who is on a mission to complete the resurrection of the man responsible for the greatest revolution in history—a legend who will rise up, take command, and save the world from peril once again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some fans enjoyed seeing the characters again and appreciated the expansion of the universe, while others felt the movie undermined the original series' ending and served as unnecessary fan service. Many felt the plot was contrived, and the characters acted inconsistently.
pros: Good animation quality.
Enjoyable to see the characters again.
Expands on the original mythos.
cons: Unnecessary sequel.
Disregards the original ending's impact.
Feels like fan service.
Contrived plot elements and character motivations.
Inconsistent with established character arcs.

anime.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion I - Initiation
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch I - Koudou
anime.genres: Mecha, Military, School, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
The Holy Britannian Empire is a powerful nation that uses its military strength to expand its rule, and the small island nation of Japan is yet another victim. During a worldwide conflict in 2010 known as the Second Pacific War, the once-proud country was reduced to rubble and mockingly renamed to Area 11. 

However, one student plans to free Japan from Britannia's control through an extraordinary rebellion. His name is Lelouch Lamperouge, and he is fueled with hatred for the Empire, plotting to wipe its accursed name off the face of the planet. Lelouch's malicious plans are unexpectedly accelerated upon meeting the mysterious woman C.C., who grants him a supernatural ability known as Geass that makes anyone Lelouch commands unable to defy his will. 

Now armed with a devastating power, Lelouch assumes the persona of Zero, a revolutionary figure who carries the hopes and dreams of the oppressed around the world. He vows to restore the glorious nation of Japan and deliver divine retribution to Britannia.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the renewed focus and animation quality, particularly for returning fans. However, many feel the movie rushes the plot, cuts crucial character development, and ultimately fails to capture the essence of the original series, making it a disappointing experience for both newcomers and long-time viewers.
pros: Recaptures character drama with renewed depth and focus.
Animation is amazing and seems to be from the ground up.
Lelouch's emotions are captured even better than in the series.
cons: Fails to capture the original feeling of the anime, everything felt rushed.
Important relationships are cut or minimized, such as those with Shirley and Euphemia.
The pacing is too fast, overwhelming new viewers and disappointing previous fans.
Cutting almost all school scenes is a mistake.

anime.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion II - Transgression
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch II - Handou
anime.genres: Mecha, Military, School, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Having achieved miraculous victories in a series of battles against the Britannian Army, Lelouch Lamperouge has brought the Black Knights, his paramilitary organization, to a more powerful state than ever before. Nothing seems impossible for him when he utilizes his military strength, intellect, and Geass power of absolute obedience. 

However, obstacles in the face of the uprising never cease, putting Lelouch in a difficult predicament. Most worryingly, Suzaku Kururugi's combat prowess and the appearance of a mysterious child named V.V. threaten to put an end to Lelouch's great rebellion.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the refreshed animation, music, and emotional moments, many find the film suffers from rushed storytelling, weakened character development, and plot inconsistencies due to its recap structure. The changes made to the original story detract from the emotional impact and overall narrative quality for some viewers.
pros: Smooth and fresh animation.
Outstanding music.
Breathes new life into familiar events.
Enjoyable fight scenes
cons: Rushed storytelling and compressed narrative.
Weakened character development.
Inconsistent plot and chronology.
Significant plot holes and asspulls due to cuts.

anime.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion III - Glorification
anime.romaji_title: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch III - Oudou
anime.genres: Mecha, Military, School, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Lelouch Lamperouge's dreams of destroying the Holy Britannian Empire are slowly crumbling. His sister, Nunnally, has been kidnapped by Schneizel el Britannia, and Suzaku Kururugi is ignoring his desperate pleas for assistance. The Black Knights are slowly losing faith in Lelouch as their leader, and the United Federation of Nations has declared global war on Britannia.

Having suffered numerous betrayals, a significant loss of power, and an ever-growing resentment towards Emperor Charles zi Britannia, the crippled Lelouch makes a final decision: if he can't destroy the Empire from the outside, he will take it for himself from within.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some appreciating the improved pacing and new content in this installment of the movie trilogy. However, many feel the film suffers from being a rushed adaptation of the original series, leading to plot holes and a loss of emotional impact. The changes in music and the cutting of key scenes are also points of contention.
pros: The pacing of this film is arguably the best of the trilogy, allowing more time for new scenes and alterations.
Some tertiary characters got more screen time, and the student council side characters had wonderful new scenes.
cons: The movie felt rushed and like a bunch of scenes stitched together due to time constraints.
The music was changed in some scenes, and the original music direction was better.
Important scenes were cut, leading to plot holes and a story that felt shallow.

anime.title: Baki
anime.synopsis:
After emerging victorious from a brutal underground tournament, Baki Hanma continues on his path to defeat his father, Yuujirou, the strongest man in the world. However, he gets no time to rest when the tournament runner, Tokugawa Mitsunari, visits him at school. He reveals to Baki that five incredibly dangerous death row inmates from around the world—all skilled in martial arts—have simultaneously escaped confinement and are heading to Tokyo, each wishing to finally know the taste of defeat. Tokugawa warns that, due to his well-known strength, Baki is bound to encounter them sooner or later, and he will not be their only target.

Adapting the first saga of the second manga series, Baki centers on the all-out war between the esteemed martial artists of Japan and those of the dark underground world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Baki are divided. While some appreciate the over-the-top violence and unique fight choreography, many criticize the weak plot, inconsistent animation, and shallow characters. The show is best enjoyed by those seeking pure action and absurdity, and not a compelling narrative or polished production.
pros: Unique fight choreography
Enjoyable for fans of pure action and violence
Some find the absurdity entertaining
cons: Weak or nonsensical plot
Inconsistent character design and animation quality, including poor CGI
Shallow character development
Poor dialogue and pacing

anime.title: Yuki Yuna is a Hero: The Hero Chapter
anime.romaji_title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Yuusha no Shou
anime.synopsis:
Having fulfilled their destiny during the events of  Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru, Sanshu Middle School's Hero Club—consisting of Yuuna Yuuki, Karin Miyoshi, and siblings Fuu and Itsuki Inubouzaki—is back in full swing, helping out those in need wherever they can. They have also gained a new member, a hero from the past named Sonoko Nogi. But eventually they notice that someone who should be among them, Mimori Tougou, is missing; any trace of her existence is completely gone, save for the girls' memories.

With no leads on Tougou's whereabouts, the girls regain the ability to transform and begin the desperate search for their lost friend. But what they find is more shocking than any of them could ever have imagined, and the consequences of their actions begin to change life as they know it.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive, particularly towards character development, visuals and music. Some find the plot and pacing uneven, while others appreciate the emotional depth. The series has some controversy comparing to other similar genre shows.
pros: Strong focus on character development, particularly for Yuuna.
Beautiful art and spectacular OST.
Emotional and impactful storytelling, with both joyful and sad moments.
cons: Pacing issues, with some finding the initial episodes slow or the plot convoluted.
Repetitive tropes and reliance on friendship as a solution can feel predictable to some viewers.
Some find the dark elements and character sacrifices overly harsh or unnecessary.

anime.title: The Reflection
anime.synopsis: After the Reflection, some of the people in all parts of the world are discovered with super powers. Some become heroes, and others villains. How did the Reflection happen? What was the cause of it? With many unsolved mysteries, the world is led into turmoil.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is largely negative. Many find the story and characters uninspired and generic, with poor animation quality being a major detractor. While some appreciate the unique art style and soundtrack, the overwhelming sentiment is disappointment due to unfulfilled potential.
pros: Some likable characters (X-on, I-guy, Lisa, Eleanor)
Unique art style with comic book vibe
Memorable soundtrack (OP, Sky Show, Reflection theme)
cons: Poor animation quality, stiff movements
Inconsistent pacing, plot contrivances
Generic characters and uninspired story
Underdeveloped villains
Lazy animation, still shots
Meaningless characters
Lack of creativity
Awkward pacing

anime.title: Blood Blockade Battlefront & Beyond
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Shounen, Super Power, Urban Fantasy, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Three years ago, a gateway between Earth and the Beyond opened in New York City, trapping extradimensional creatures and humans alike in an impermeable bubble. After the city's restoration, monsters, magic, and madness are common findings in the area now known as Hellsalem's Lot. Leonardo Watch, a young photographer who unwillingly obtained the "All-seeing Eyes of the Gods" in exchange for his sister's eyesight, came to this paranormal city to find answers to the mysterious power that he possesses. He later finds his life drastically changed when he joins Libra, a secret organization of people with supernatural abilities dedicated to maintaining order in the everyday chaos of Hellsalem's Lot. 

However, this is only the beginning of Leonardo's unexpected journey ahead. Regardless of the constant threat of otherworldly enemies, he is determined to uncover the secrets of his power and find a way to restore his sister's eyesight. Kekkai Sensen & Beyond follows Leonardo as he sets off on more crazy adventures with his comrades, fighting to ensure peace and order.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many appreciating the stylish action, character interactions, and world-building. However, the shift towards a more episodic format and the perceived lack of a strong overarching plotline disappointed some viewers. While some enjoyed the character-focused approach, others felt it led to uneven development and underutilization of certain characters.
pros: Great animation and art style, especially the fight scenes.
Good selection of BGM and OP/ED that reflect the mood of the anime.
Character-focused narrative that explores the daily lives of Libra members.
cons: Episodic nature with a lack of overarching plot, especially compared to the first season.
Some episodes feel like filler or are rushed.
Uneven character development, with some Libra members feeling underdeveloped.

anime.title: Blue Exorcist: Kyoto Saga OVA
anime.romaji_title: Ao no Exorcist: Kyoto Fujouou-hen OVA
anime.synopsis:
Bundled with the 19th and 20th volumes of the Ao no Exorcist manga.

The first episode is based on the second chapter of the second Ao no Exorcist novel Home Sweet Home.

The second episode is based on the title chapter from the Ao no Exorcist: Spy Game novel.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience appears to be highly satisfied with this OVA set, appreciating its ability to deepen character understanding and provide entertaining content. The high production quality and effective blend of drama and comedy contribute to a positive reception, with minor criticisms focused on the tangential nature of one of the stories.
pros: Develops character backstories effectively, providing deeper insight into motivations and past struggles.
Maintains high-quality art and music consistent with the established series.
The second OVA offers significant comedic relief and laughs, balancing the more serious tone of the first.
cons: The second OVA's plot is not heavily tied to the main storyline, functioning more as standalone comedic vignettes.
Some plot points, like the marriage proposal scene, are adapted rather than entirely new, potentially feeling repetitive to some viewers.

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai 4
anime.synopsis:
Excited children gather around the enigmatic masked Storyteller once more. His unique kamishibai storytelling draws them into tales of fear and dread. These are dark and foreboding stories, which could happen to anyone...
 
This season has tales of a salaryman who buries a dead cat, only to be haunted soon after; a college student and her cheap new apartment that hides a ghastly secret; boys exploring an abandoned haunted house before coming across a strange fish tank; a man who finds himself on the wrong bus, and in more danger than he thought possible; and a young couple's visit to an amusement park, which suddenly takes a dark turn. All these stories and more await in Yami Shibai 4.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Season 4 is considered a significant drop in quality compared to previous seasons, with criticism aimed at the new narrator, weak stories, poor art style, and unfitting sound design. While some appreciate the Yami Shibai art style, the season is largely seen as a disappointment and a chore to watch.
pros: Yami Shibai art style is still appreciated by some.
Some live-action aspects were considered creepy and added to the enjoyment for some viewers.
A few episodes were seen as complete mysteries and liked for it.
cons: The narrator is awful, with changes in voice and excessive narration ruining tension.
The stories have no buildup and feel shallow, with unfinished or confusing plots.
Art style changes are disappointing, with poorer animation quality and jarring live-action cuts.
The ending song is inappropriate and doesn't fit the horror theme.

anime.title: Yo-kai Watch Shadowside: The Return of the Oni King
anime.romaji_title: Youkai Watch Movie 4: Shadow Side - Oni-ou no Fukkatsu
anime.synopsis: Taking place 30 years after the events of the original Youkai Watch TV series. There was once a 11 year old boy named Keita Amano who held a wristwatch that could command Youkai, he would make friends with the Youkai and fulfill a great many deeds. But when the boy grew up, he lost his ability to see Youkai. And as for the wristwatch that could control Youkai, its existence threatened to disturb the balance between human and Youkai worlds, so it was cast away into oblivion beyond time and space. Soon ... the story of the Youkai controlling wristwatch became but a legend. But then, something took place after many, many years had passed ... an epidemic Youkai virus known as Onimaro started affecting people with malevolent intentions and is spreading indefinitely, turning them into Kaodeka Oni and causing chaos throughout the city. With the end near, only the ones chosen by a new Youkai Watch can stand up against the upcoming threat and would save both Youkai and humans from certain destruction.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is polarized. Some appreciate the darker tone and updated art style, viewing it as a successful evolution of the franchise. However, others criticize the confusing plot, weak characters, and unnecessary retcons, deeming it a failure and a disservice to the original series. This creates a split in audience satisfaction.
pros: Updated art style (for some characters)
Fantasy elements
Major roles for yokai from the main series
cons: Confusing and meaningless story
Unnecessary retcons
Boring characters, especially the protagonist
Poorly used villain
Fails to be competent

anime.title: Tsukipro The Animation
anime.synopsis:
At the Budokan, an annual event known as the Tsukino Concert puts Tsukino Entertainment Production's best and brightest idol units on the stage. The leaders of idol groups SolidS, SOARA, QUELL, and Growth must compose four unique and distinctive songs for their respective units, which they will perform on the second day of the festival.

Composing four new songs proves to be a difficult task for SolidS's leader, Shiki Takamura, as he struggles to find inspiration. Sora Oohara must learn to overcome past mistakes while propelling his unit, SOARA, to the top. Wanting to escape his past stardom, Shuu Izumi is determined to push his unit, QUELL, up to the level of popularity that his previous one had. Growth finds themselves working together with a rival group, ZIX, prior to their debut—something that leader Kouki Etou is reluctant to do.

Tsukipro The Animation tells the stories of these four units simultaneously as they go through their daily lives while preparing for the Tsukino Concert.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is positive for existing fans of the Tsukipro franchise, praising the music and character interactions. However, the anime is not newcomer-friendly due to its reliance on prior knowledge and thin plot. While the music and visuals receive acclaim, the lack of substantial story or character development is a common criticism. Most fans are satisfied, but acknowledge its shortcomings for a broader audience.
pros: Excellent music that showcases each group's unique style.
Likeable characters, even if built on familiar tropes.
Visually appealing backgrounds and ending cards.
cons: Plot is weak and fragmented, requires prior knowledge of the franchise.
Character development is sacrificed for slice-of-life content.
Animation quality is uneven, with more focus on main songs.
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture, Music Focus, Slice of Life

anime.title: Food Wars! The Second Plate OVA
anime.romaji_title: Shokugeki no Souma: Ni no Sara OVA
anime.synopsis:
Having completed their Stagiaire assignments, the residents of Polar Star Dormitory and their friends visit a hot springs inn. Though they planned on relaxing, these young chefs step up to the plate when the inn's entire kitchen staff suffer accidents. Unbeknownst to them, they will not be cooking for any ordinary patrons.

Sometime after this trip, Souma Yukihira's desire for worthy opponents is stoked when he, Megumi Tadokoro, and the other Autumn Election quarter-finalists are invited to the annual Autumn Leaves Viewing event. The eight Tootsuki freshmen have a special opportunity to enjoy tea with the Elite Ten Council—including the Tenth Seat Erina Nakiri, who participates alongside her first-year classmates. Though it is framed as a friendly introduction between nine promising underclassmen and nine prestigious upperclassmen, Director Senzaemon Nakiri sees this meeting for what it is: a first encounter between the current reigning elite and their eventual usurpers.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus strongly recommends watching these OVAs, particularly the second episode, due to their critical importance in bridging Season 2 and Season 3. While the first OVA is seen as lighter fare, the second is lauded for its role in introducing the Elite Ten and setting up future plot points. Minor criticisms revolve around the placement of essential plot material in an OVA format and the overall significance of the first episode.
pros: Essential watch for understanding the transition to Season 3 and character motivations.
Provides crucial context for the introduction of the Elite Ten.
Well-paced introduction of the Elite Ten, offering more depth than the main season.
Art, animation, and sound are consistent with the quality of the main anime series.
Characters remain well-rounded and faithful to their established personalities.
Offers enjoyable comedy and character moments, especially in the first OVA.
The second episode's plot relevance makes it a must-watch for continuity.
cons: The first OVA episode is considered a standard, less impactful hot springs episode.
The placement of an important plot episode within an OVA is criticized.
A specific post-credits scene in the first episode had questionable animation quality.
The first episode's story is not considered amazing, only interesting enough for its genre.

anime.title: Sakura Quest
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Slice of Life, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Tired of her rural home, recent college graduate Yoshino Koharu is desperate to lead a more exciting life in Tokyo. After a fruitless job hunt, she finally receives a part-time offer as queen of the bizarre "Kingdom of Chupakabura," a rundown mini-attraction in the small agricultural town of Manoyama. However, Yoshino discovers upon her arrival in Manoyama that she was mistaken for a celebrity and the job offer was a mistake. Left with no other options, Yoshino reluctantly agrees to take on the role and aid the Board of Tourism in their efforts to revitalize Manoyama. Determined to bring excitement to the dying town with the help of local residents, the queen enacts a series of projects to highlight the beauty and charm of Manoyama's culture.

Sakura Quest delves into the story of a tight-knit community that is struggling to balance change while also maintaining the rich traditions and bonds which define their identity.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience has a positive sentiment towards Sakura Quest, praising its relatable characters, heartwarming themes, and exploration of social issues. Some find the pacing slow and the plot lacking at times, but the show is generally appreciated for its slice-of-life elements and messages about community and personal growth. The anime is often considered an underrated gem that offers a relaxing and enjoyable viewing experience.
pros: Relatable characters with well-portrayed personalities and growth.
Exploration of social issues with realism, making it easy to connect with characters' struggles.
Beautiful background art and character designs.
Heartwarming and motivational themes of perseverance and innovation.
cons: Some sub-plots feel lacking and could use improvement.
Pacing can be slow at times, with anticlimactic resolutions.
Some episodes feel like filler, stalling the plot's progress.
Fails to truly capture the immersive feel of a small decaying town.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Community, Economic Revitalization

anime.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
anime.romaji_title: Death March kara Hajimaru Isekai Kyousoukyoku
anime.synopsis:
Ichirou Suzuki, a programmer nearing his thirties, is drowning in work. Worn out, he eventually has a chance to catch up on sleep, only to wake up and discover himself in a fantasy RPG world, which is mashed together from the games he was debugging in reality. In this new place, he realizes that not only has his appearance changed to a younger version of himself, but his name has also changed to Satou, a nickname he used while running beta tests on games. 

However, before Satou can fully grasp his situation, an army of lizardmen launch an assault on him. Forced to cast a powerful spell in retaliation, Satou wipes them out completely and his level is boosted to 310, effectively maximizing his stats. Now, as a high-leveled adventurer armed with a plethora of skills and no way to return to reality, Satou sets out to explore this magical new world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is heavily divided. Some viewers find it enjoyable as a relaxing, mindless isekai with a strong protagonist, while others criticize it for its generic plot, uninspired world-building, and problematic themes. The lack of character development and repetitive nature of the story are also common complaints. Some have extreme negative reactions to the inclusion of slavery.
pros: Relaxing and easy to watch, good for casual viewing.
Some found the early focus on the protagonist's work life relatable.
The protagonist is not as annoying as some other Isekai MCs.
cons: Generic plot and uninspired world-building.
Overpowered protagonist with little to no character development.
Problematic slavery themes are not addressed well.
Repetitive formulaic plot
Poor pacing and lack of story progression

anime.title: Fireworks
anime.romaji_title: Uchiage Hanabi, Shita kara Miru ka? Yoko kara Miru ka?
anime.synopsis: One summer, Norimichi Shimada and his friends want to know if fireworks look round or flat from the side. They forge a plan to find the answer at Moshimo Festival's fireworks display. However, Norimichi finds himself conflicted when his classmate, Nazuna Oikawa, plans to run away from home and wants Norimichi to join her. When things go awry in their attempt to escape, a strange orb in Nazuna's possession gives them another chance at staying together.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is sharply divided on 'Uchiage Hanabi'. While many praise its stunning visuals and atmospheric soundtrack, a significant portion finds the plot confusing, the characters underdeveloped, and the ending unsatisfying. The film's thought-provoking themes are often overshadowed by its narrative shortcomings, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation, especially Shaft's signature style.
Amazing soundtrack and BGM that enhances the dramatic atmosphere.
Thought-provoking themes about 'what if' scenarios and moving forward.
The animation and scenery were magnificent and detailed.
The ending song was very good.
