cons: Confusing and nonsensical plot that is difficult to follow.
Abrupt and unsatisfying ending that feels unfinished.
Inconsistent use of CGI, particularly jarring transitions.
Underdeveloped characters with unclear motivations.
Some scenes and plot points were uncomfortable or unnecessary (e.g., teacher's chest discussion).

anime.title: Kenka Bancho Otome -Girl Beats Boys-
anime.romaji_title: Kenka Banchou Otome: Girl Beats Boys
anime.genres: Action, Crossdressing, Delinquents, Martial Arts, School
anime.synopsis:
Kenka Banchou Otome - Girl Beats Boys, Hinako Nakayama has spent all of her life being raised in state-run orphanages, without ever knowing her family. As she's about to enter high school, Hinako is approached by Hikaru, a boy who claims to be her twin brother.
 
According to Hikaru, Hikaru and Hinako are the children of the head of the powerful Onigashima yakuza family, and Hikaru wants Hinako to switches places with him at Shishiku Academy, an all-boys school overrun with the nation's toughest delinquents. Can Hinako save her brother, find romance, and become the new boss of the school?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with many finding the anime entertaining and enjoyable for casual viewing, while also acknowledging its flaws. The short episode length and rushed plot are commonly criticized, leading to underdeveloped characters and a lack of depth. Despite its shortcomings, fans of the reverse harem genre may find it worth watching for its humor and strong female lead.
pros: Strong female lead who doesn't need saving.
Unique and catchy opening and ending music.
Entertaining and humorous, easy to watch.
cons: Rushed plot and underdeveloped characters due to short episode length.
Story can be predictable and lacking in depth.
Inconsistent plot points and confusing narrative at times.
anime.thematic_vibe: Reverse Harem, School Life, Action Comedy

anime.title: Inazma Delivery
anime.synopsis: Inazma Delivery is set in the town of Babiden City, where everything runs on electricity. Hemingway is an earnest young man who works at the delivery company Inazma, which promises to deliver any package to its proper destination. One day, an extraterrestrial lost child in a shark costume named Bytheway appears and asks to be delivered to its home planet, and soon Hemingway and Bytheway are embroiled in all sorts of adventures.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is generally seen as a lighthearted and visually appealing adventure, suitable for casual viewing. While the story may lack depth and dialogue, the animation and energetic delivery make it an enjoyable experience for audiences seeking simple entertainment. The later season is considered an improvement.
pros: Above average animation quality
Decent narrative structure
Good choice when you don't want to think
cons: Scatterbrained story
No real spoken dialogue

anime.title: KochinPa! Dainiki
anime.synopsis: The second season of KochinPa!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'KochinPa! Dainiki' for its meta-humor, cute characters, and surprising level of effort put into a promotional anime. While not groundbreaking, it's considered a fun and entertaining short-form series. There is little controversy, as viewers understand its purpose and appreciate its execution.
pros: Meta and funny jokes
Cute characters with chibi design
Good continuity of jokes
Visibly done with a lot of care for a commercial anime
Good energy and entertaining
cons: Not life-changing
Not exceptional

anime.title: Seitokai Yakuindomo Movie
anime.synopsis: Ousai Academy was originally an all-girls high school. Due to the declining birth rates in recent years, it was converted into a co-ed school. The first year male students would find themselves surrounded by girls and unfortunately, Tsuda Takatoshi is one of them. What's worse, he gets scolded on his first day by the student council president Shino Amakusa, which did not give a good first impression of him. Tsuda also meets the other student council members while getting scolded, and in the end, he gets late for class. As an apology for ruining his morning, Shino lets him join the student council for various of "reasons" and he accepts it, or rather, he's forced to accept. Thus begins his days as Tsuda soon realizes that he's the only normal student in Ousai Academy...
anime.consensus_summary: The Seitokai Yakuindomo Movie is well-received by fans of the series, delivering the same raunchy humor and familiar characters they enjoy. The high production quality and consistent comedic timing are praised, but some viewers find the episodic nature and lack of character progression to be drawbacks. Overall, the movie is considered a successful extension of the series, particularly for those already familiar with the franchise.
pros: Consistent humor and comedic timing
High production quality (animation, art, and sound)
Enjoyable character interactions and dynamics
Faithful to the source material and previous seasons
cons: Episodic and somewhat disjointed storyline
Repetitive nature of jokes may wear thin for some viewers
Limited character progression
Suzu Hagimura's screen time is limited.
anime.thematic_vibe: Raunchy Comedy, School Life, Slice of Life

anime.title: Pokémon Generations
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Kids, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis: Pokémon Generations revisits each generation of the Pokémon video game series to shed new light on some timeless moments. From the earliest days in the Kanto region to the splendor of the Kalos region, go behind the scenes and witness Pokémon history with new eyes!
anime.consensus_summary: Pokemon Generations is a well-received short series that effectively captures the nostalgic essence of the Pokemon video games. Fans appreciate the improved animation and faithful adaptations of iconic moments. While the disjointed nature of the episodes is a minor drawback, the series is generally considered a delightful tribute to the franchise.
pros: Faithful adaptation of key video game moments.
Improved animation quality compared to the main series.
Good voice acting, especially in the English dub.
Successfully evokes nostalgia for older fans.
cons: Episodes are disjointed and lack overall narrative cohesion.
Pacing issues, particularly in the early episodes.
May not be as enjoyable for those unfamiliar with the core games.

anime.title: Wake Up, Girls! New Chapter
anime.synopsis:
"Wake Up, Girls!" is the story of growth and friendship of seven girls living in Sendai, Miyagi who form the idol group "Wake Up, Girls! (WUG)" and work together to become top idols.

Operating under a small production company in Sendai known as "Green Leaves Entertainment," WUG overcame countless obstacles to beat national idol group "I-1 club" at the Idol Festival and win the event. They had suddenly become top idols... but with an idol recession going on, things weren't so easy. The days of steady and honest idol work continued for the girls.

Meanwhile, Sendai-based middle school trio Hayashi Ayumi, Morishima Otome, and Atsugi Itsuka have developed an increasing desire to become idols...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the story and themes related to idol culture and camaraderie, the overwhelming consensus is that the animation quality is severely lacking and detracts significantly from the experience. Some viewers also found the story and character development weaker compared to previous installments, while others appreciated the ending and overall message, resulting in a polarized viewing experience.
pros: Interesting interplay between different idol groups.
Good message about idols supporting each other.
Satisfying ending.
cons: Bad animation quality with frequent shortcuts.
Story feels lacking compared to previous seasons.
Poor character development.
Overused songs.
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture Critique, Industry Realism, Underdog Story

anime.title: A Centaur's Life
anime.genres: Fantasy, School, Seinen, Slice of Life, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Himeno is a sweet, shy little centaur girl. In her world, everyone seems to be a supernatural creature, and all her classmates have some kind of horns, wings, tails, halos, or other visible supernatural body part. Despite their supernatural elements, Himeno and her best friends, Nozomi and Kyouko, have a fun and mostly normal daily school life!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating the show's unique premise and social commentary. However, the inconsistent tone, underdeveloped characters, and questionable fan service detract from the experience for some viewers. There is also criticism of the animation quality and the show's tendency to introduce dark themes without fully exploring them.
pros: Unique premise with diverse characters and races.
Thought-provoking social commentary on racism and equality.
Exploration of serious themes within a seemingly lighthearted setting.
cons: Inconsistent tone with jarring juxtaposition of slice-of-life and dark themes.
Underdeveloped characters and loose plot.
Questionable fan service elements that detract from the overall message.
Inconsistent animation quality.
anime.thematic_vibe: Social Commentary, Slice of Life, Unease

anime.title: Natsume's Book of Friends Season 5 Specials
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
One Night Sake Cup 
On his way back home from an errand, Takashi Natsume gets lost in the forest. Luckily, he is rescued by a traveling youkai couple who make sake cups for a living. Taking a sip of water from one, Natsume feels a surge of energy rush throughout his body, thanks to the "One Night Cup." It is a special cup that makes every drink delicious, but unfortunately, its effects last only for one night. The following day, Natsume attends the youkai banquet with his loyal protector, the sake-loving chubby cat Madara, and gets the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to learn how to make sake cups.

Party of Fun & Games
Natsume is filled with regret after hastily declining a rare invitation to a banquet from Madara. Curious, he chases after the cat to an old, run-down mansion but soon enough feels the uncanny presence of numerous youkai nearby. When he runs into the seductive youkai Hinoe, she explains that the empty estate serves as a hide-and-seek playground where the winning spirit acquires authority over a valley. With still no trace of Madara, Natsume starts having eerie dreams of the mansion, but this time as the game's participant.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates these specials for maintaining the series' heartwarming tone and exploring familiar themes. The episodes offer comforting stories about the relationships between humans and youkai, with a touch of melancholy. Viewers enjoy the continuation of Natsume's journey and the series' established narrative style.
pros: Heartwarming stories.
Exploration of youkai-human relationships.
Continuation of established themes from the series.
cons: Episodic nature might not appeal to all viewers.
Some may find the pacing slow.

anime.title: Koi Suru Shirokuma
anime.synopsis: A polar bear falls in love with an earless seal, and he wants nothing else except to protect him, even though the seal constantly thinks the bear will eat him.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, emphasizing the cuteness and adorableness of the anime. Viewers appreciate the characters and voice acting, despite the short episode length. The unusual prey/predator relationship is seen as a fun and enjoyable concept within the anime context.
pros: Extremely cute and fun
Good voice acting, especially for the polar bear and seal
Easy to watch due to short episode length
cons: Very short episodes
Simple art style

anime.title: Night Is Short, Walk on Girl
anime.synopsis:
On a mysterious night that seems to last for a year, an ordinary college student continues to chase one of his underclassmen, a girl with black hair—the girl of his dreams. Up until now, he has been relying on a simple plan, which is to calculatingly bump into her every day while making it seem like a meaningful coincidence. However, his efforts remain futile as their relationship is not progressing at all.

Meanwhile, the black-haired girl believes that everything is connected by fate and endeavors to experience as many new things as possible, leaving it all for destiny to decide. While strolling along the lively streets of Kyoto, she discovers that the very beginning of her fateful journey—a book she had as a child—is currently being sold in a second-hand bookstore. Upon knowing this, the college student eyes another opportunity to run into her "by chance": this time, he hopes to get the book before she does and finally grasp the thread of fate that could connect their hearts.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally adores "Yoru wa Mijikashi Arukeyo Otome" for its unique visuals, fast-paced storytelling, and optimistic themes. While some find it chaotic or confusing, especially if they are not familiar with Masaaki Yuasa's style or the Tatami Galaxy universe, most appreciate its energy and celebration of life. The film is seen as a triumphant and awe-inspiring experience, rewarding those who embrace its unconventional nature.
pros: Imaginative and reality-bending visuals
Fast-paced and engaging narrative
Celebration of enjoying life and embracing the present
cons: Can feel like a 'beautiful mess' or sugar rush
May not appeal to viewers unfamiliar with Yuasa's style or the Tatami Galaxy universe
Story structure eschews traditional elements which may confuse some

anime.title: Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!
anime.synopsis:
When Satoshi oversleeps on his 10th birthday, he ends up with a stubborn Pikachu instead of the first partner Pokémon he wanted! But after a rocky start, Satoshi and Pikachu become close friends and true partners—and when they catch a rare glimpse of the Legendary Pokémon Houou in flight, they make plans to seek it out together, guided by the Rainbow Wing it leaves behind.

Trainers Makoto and Souji join Satoshi on his journey. Along the way, Satoshi catches an abandoned Hitokage, raises a Pokémon from Caterpie to Butterfree and then releases it to follow its heart, and meets the mysterious Mythical Pokémon Marshadow. When they near their goal, the arrogant Cross—Hitokage’s former Trainer—stands in their way! Can Satoshi and Pikachu defeat this powerful Trainer and reach Houou as they promised, or will their journey end here?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with many appreciating the nostalgic visuals and the attempt to weave a new story with beloved old elements. However, significant criticism exists regarding rushed plot development, underdeveloped new characters, and a controversial, contrivance-filled ending, leading to a polarized view of its overall success.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation, with excellent use of color and detail in backgrounds and environments.
The art style is a welcome return to a more classic aesthetic, appreciated by long-time fans.
The film successfully blends nostalgic elements from the original series with a new plotline, offering a fresh experience for fans.
Emotional moments, particularly the strengthening bond between Ash and Pikachu, are well-executed.
The focus on Ho-Oh and its mythical vibe appeals to fans who enjoy the more mysterious aspects of Pokémon.
cons: Character development for new companions (Verity and Sorrel) and the rival (Cross) is underdeveloped and superficial.
The plot feels rushed and inconsistent, trying to balance too many new and old elements without proper integration.
The inclusion of Team Rocket is often seen as pointless filler, with no real plot relevance or interaction.
The dub's voice acting is heavily criticized as poor and underwhelming, with some characters being particularly bad.
The ending, especially Ash's revival, is seen as a major plot contrivance (Deus ex Machina) that undermines emotional investment.

anime.title: Mary and the Witch's Flower
anime.synopsis:
Mary Smith is a clumsy girl with wild red hair who can't seem to do anything right. After moving in with her Great Aunt Charlotte, Mary finds herself lonely and bored, until one day she spies a cat which seems to keep changing color every time she sees it. Curiosity gets the better of her and she follows it into nearby woods. Deep in the forest, the cat takes her to a clearing with dead trees and brown grass, where the only sign of life is a cluster of mysterious blue flowers that Mary has never seen before. The gardener of the estate later tells her that the rare species is called "Fly-by-Night," and is said to be sought by witches for its incredible magical power.

When the strange cat returns to her one night, Mary is led once again into the woods, but this time to an old broomstick hidden by a gnarled tree. After she clumsily squashes some Fly-by-Night against the broomstick, it begins to glow, whisking her off into the sky. Her wayward journey ends at the Endor College for Witches, where she is mistaken for a new student. And so, Mary must learn to look after herself in this marvelous new world of magic, where things are not always as they seem.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally agrees that Mary and the Witch's Flower is a visually stunning film with a strong protagonist, but opinions diverge significantly on its narrative coherence and character development. While some praise its magical charm and Ghibli-esque qualities, others are disappointed by plot inconsistencies and underdeveloped supporting elements.
pros: Exceptional animation quality and visual artistry, reminiscent of Studio Ghibli.
Compelling character development for the protagonist, Mary, and her journey of self-discovery.
Engaging soundtrack that enhances the magical atmosphere.
Strong sense of wonder and magic, particularly in the latter half of the film.
cons: Inconsistent and poorly explained magic system, leading to plot holes.
Underdeveloped supporting characters who lack depth and memorable qualities.
A rushed and anti-climactic third act that leaves plot threads unresolved.
Predictable plot with some awkward pacing and exposition dumps.
The magical school setting, while visually impressive, feels largely irrelevant to the main plot.

anime.title: Inuyashiki: Last Hero
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Ichirou Inuyashiki is a 58-year-old family man who is going through a difficult time in his life. Though his frequent back problems are painful, nothing hurts quite as much as the indifference and distaste that his wife and children have for him. Despite this, Ichirou still manages to find solace in Hanako, an abandoned Shiba Inu that he adopts into his home. However, his life takes a turn for the worse when a follow-up physical examination reveals that Ichirou has stomach cancer and only three months to live; though he tries to be strong, his family's disinterest causes an emotional breakdown. Running off into a nearby field, Ichirou embraces his dog and weeps—until he notices a strange figure standing before him.

Suddenly, a bright light appears and Ichirou is enveloped by smoke and dust. When he comes to, he discovers something is amiss—he has been reborn as a mechanized weapon wearing the skin of his former self. Though initially shocked, the compassionate Ichirou immediately uses his newfound powers to save a life, an act of kindness that fills him with happiness and newfound hope.

However, the origins of these strange powers remain unclear. Who was the mysterious figure at the site of the explosion, and are they as kind as Ichirou when it comes to using this dangerous gift?
anime.consensus_summary: Inuyashiki presents a compelling premise that explores morality, but is ultimately held back by inconsistent animation, underdeveloped characters, and a rushed ending. The audience is polarized, with some appreciating the initial concept and themes, while others criticize the execution and plot development. Despite its potential, the series fails to fully deliver on its promises, resulting in a mixed reception.
pros: Interesting premise with an older main character
Exploration of morality and humanity
Good tension building and pacing
cons: Inconsistent animation quality (CGI)
Underdeveloped characters, especially the villain
Plot conveniences and asspulls
Rushed ending
Questionable writing and pacing

anime.title: DIVE!!
anime.synopsis: The series revolves around the Mizuki Diving Club (MDC), which is on the verge of closing down after having financial troubles. The club's new coach persuades the club's parent company to stay open on one condition: that the club sends one of its members to next year's Olympics as part of Japan's Olympic team.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the character development and realistic portrayal of the sport, while others find it lacking in energy, explanation, and overall excitement. Many feel the series doesn't fully capitalize on its potential. While not overtly disliked, it fails to stand out in the sports anime genre, leaving a generally lukewarm impression.
pros: Character-driven narrative focusing on personal growth.
Realistic portrayal of the diving industry and athlete struggles.
Good aesthetic design and diving animations.
cons: Lack of energy and adrenaline in portraying the sport.
Insufficient explanation of diving techniques and scoring system.
Underdeveloped secondary characters and plot elements.
Generic or contrived moments, with little character development.

anime.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress: The Battle of Unato
anime.romaji_title: Koutetsujou no Kabaneri Movie 3: Unato Kessen
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Gore, Historical, Horror, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Half a year has passed. Arriving in the Iron Fortress, Ikoma and Mumei set foot in Unato: another ravaged zone that fell into the grip of the deadly Kabane.

In this war-torn zone, the group fends off more dangerous Kabane that are attacking with patterns they had never seen before. The Iron Fortress crew eventually meet up with a survival group which requests their aid in reclaiming the zone. The newly forged alliance ventures deeper into the area of the castle and investigates the peculiar case of these new Kabane. But their search for answers unearths truths that are far more horrifying than they imagined. Forced to confront the reality behind the Kabane, Ikoma, Mumei, and their allies come to realize the despair buried within Unato.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the visual and auditory aspects but criticism for the story and characters. Some feel it's a worthy addition to the series, while others find it disappointing. The movie's high production value is generally acknowledged, but the narrative and character issues divide viewers.
pros: Impressive art and animation quality, particularly during action sequences.
Strong soundtrack that enhances the viewing experience.
Focuses on character development, especially Ikoma and Mumei.
Fast-paced and entertaining, offering a satisfying viewing experience.
Good for viewers new to the series
Refreshing take on the anime scene
cons: Plot is considered unoriginal and predictable by some.
Character development feels rushed or inconsistent.
The storyline felt like a filler arc
Comparisons to Attack on Titan lead to negative perceptions.
Some characters are considered unlikeable or poorly written.

anime.title: Altair: A Record of Battles
anime.synopsis:
Mahmut Tuğrul is the youngest Pasha in the Türkiye Stratocracy, a title granted to members of the Divan—the council that governs the nation. Haunted by witnessing the loss of his mother and village during the war 12 years ago, he has dedicated his life to serving his country and preventing further bloodshed.

Years after the devastating clash between the aggressive Balt-Rhein Empire and Türkiye, tensions flare once more. Political unrest brews along the border of the two countries as rival factions and skirmishes push both nations closer to all-out conflict, threatening their fragile peace.

As turmoil grows, Mahmut's idealism and inexperience as a leader is called into question and he is stripped of his rank. However, this setback brings about unexpected allies in the fight against the Empire. As war looms over the continent, Mahmut must navigate a web of political intrigue and dangerous battles, fighting to protect the peace he holds dear and prove himself a capable leader.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers praising the show's intricate plot, well-developed characters, and realistic portrayal of political intrigue and war tactics. However, others criticize the pacing, large cast, and confusing details. Despite the criticisms, many viewers believe the show is underrated and deserves a higher score.
pros: Intricate political dynamics and world-building
Well-developed characters with compelling motivations
Realistic portrayal of war and its consequences
Focus on strategy and tactics, not just action
Story tackles mature themes of leadership and peace
Plot twists and unexpected turns
cons: Pacing issues, can feel rushed at times
Large cast of characters can be confusing
Details can get lost in the complex plot
Ending may feel indecisive or incomplete
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Historical Fantasy, War Tactics

anime.title: The Laughing Salesman
anime.synopsis: Each episode follows Fukuzou Moguro, a traveling salesman, and his current customer. Moguro deals in things that give his customers their heart's desire, and once his deals are made and their unhealthy desires are satisfied, Moguro's customers are often left with terrible repercussions, especially if they break the rules of his deals...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some appreciating the dark humor, social commentary, and karmic justice themes. However, many find the show repetitive, formulaic, and predictable due to its episodic nature. The quality of the episodes varies, leading to an inconsistent viewing experience, and the old style shounen art may not appeal to everyone.
pros: Interesting premise with karmic retribution.
Memorable main character, Moguro, is entertaining to watch.
Accurate depiction of marketing tactics.
cons: Highly formulaic and predictable episodic structure.
Repetitive dialogue and situations.
Inconsistent quality across episodes; some feel rushed or forced.
Art style can be distracting, with inconsistent character proportions.
anime.thematic_vibe: Dark Comedy, Morality Tale, Social Commentary

anime.title: Dream Festival! R
anime.consensus_summary: The second season shows marginal improvements in visual aspects and magical elements but fails to address core issues, particularly the weak characterization of the main protagonist. The audience seems mildly disappointed that fundamental flaws persist despite advancements in secondary areas. Overall, there's a sense of unfulfilled potential.
pros: Improved animation and character expressiveness
Better utilization and integration of the 'Dorika' element
cons: Main protagonist, Amamiya Kanade, remains underdeveloped and bland
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture, Music Performance, Positive Energy

anime.title: Re:CREATORS
anime.synopsis:
Humans have designed countless worlds—each one born from the unique imagination of its creator. Souta Mizushino is a high school student who aspires to be such a creator by writing and illustrating his own light novel. One day, while watching anime for inspiration, he is briefly transported into a fierce fight scene. When he returns to the real world, he realizes something is amiss: the anime's headstrong heroine, Selesia Yupitilia, has somehow returned with him.

Before long, other fictional characters appear in the world, carrying the hopes and scars of their home. A princely knight, a magical girl, a ruthless brawler, and many others now crowd the streets of Japan. However, the most mysterious one is a woman in full military regalia, dubbed "Gunpuku no Himegimi," who knows far more than she should about the creators' world. Despite this, no one knows her true name or the world she is from.

Meanwhile, Souta and Selesia work together with Meteora Österreich, a calm and composed librarian NPC, to uncover the meaning behind these unnatural events. With powerful forces at play, the once clear line between reality and imagination continues to blur, leading to a fateful meeting between creators and those they created.
anime.consensus_summary: Re:Creators presents a fascinating concept but suffers from poor execution, leading to a divided audience. Some appreciate its creative premise and exploration of the creator-creation dynamic, while others criticize its heavy exposition, bland characters, and inconsistent pacing. The series is ultimately seen as a missed opportunity with a great idea.
pros: Creative concept of reverse isekai with characters entering the real world.
Unique blend of genres.
Exploration of the relationship between creators and their creations.
Fascinating premise with potential for intelligent character writing and world-building.
Fights and character designs
cons: Poor execution of the interesting concept.
Overabundance of exposition and dialogue instead of creative storytelling.
Bland characters with questionable motivations.
Dragged plot with inconsistent pacing.
Lazy animation and backgrounds.
Series is actively aware of its own mistakes in storytelling.
Forgets about characters

anime.title: Chronos Ruler
anime.synopsis:
​Like many in her class, Koyuki Honda looks forward to her graduation ceremony. However, while her peers have family to attend, Koyuki has no one, as her only family—her brother—died years ago. While visiting his grave, she meets two brothers named Kiri and Victor Putin chasing a strange creature. They try to assure her that they are just actors shooting a movie; Victor, however, piques Koyuki's curiosity about the old legend of the clock tower at the cemetery: if you make a wish under the clock tower at midnight during a full moon, time will turn back, allowing someone to reclaim what they have lost.

Deciding to make her wish, Koyuki learns the horrifying truth: the legend is a ruse for time demons called "Horologues" to steal humans' time. As they are drawn to regrets, Victor uses Koyuki as bait to lure a demon there. Kiri and Victor explain that they are Chronos Rulers, warriors who fight against the Horologues using the "Oath of Time"—an item allowing them to speed up or slow down time.

With the demon destroyed and the crisis averted, Koyuki is able to go on her way free from regrets. However, she is not the only human with sorrows. The two boys must continue to hunt down Horologues in order to keep humanity safe.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is visually appealing with a great soundtrack, but the story and characters are poorly developed, leading to a disappointing experience for many viewers. Some enjoyed the emotional moments, but the prevalent issues overshadowed the positives. The show had potential but failed to deliver a cohesive and well-written narrative.
pros: Good art style and animation quality.
Enjoyable soundtrack with jazzy and snazzy music.
Some touching emotional moments and exploration of regret.
cons: Poorly written story with plot holes and logic issues.
Rushed pacing that fails to develop characters or resolve plot points.
Forced comedy and jarring tone shifts.
Generic characters with lack of depth and development.
Uninspired and lifeless execution of a used concept.

anime.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Following the successful end of the Fourth Shinobi World War, Konohagakure has been enjoying a period of peace, prosperity, and extraordinary technological advancement. This is all due to the efforts of the Allied Shinobi Forces and the village's Seventh Hokage, Naruto Uzumaki. Now resembling a modern metropolis, Konohagakure has changed, particularly the life of a shinobi. Under the watchful eye of Naruto and his old comrades, a new generation of shinobi has stepped up to learn the ways of the ninja.

Boruto Uzumaki is often the center of attention as the son of the Seventh Hokage. Despite having inherited Naruto's boisterous and stubborn demeanor, Boruto is considered a prodigy and is able to unleash his potential with the help of supportive friends and family. Unfortunately, this has only worsened his arrogance and his desire to surpass Naruto which, along with his father's busy lifestyle, has strained their relationship. However, a sinister force brewing within the village may threaten Boruto's carefree life.

New friends and familiar faces join Boruto as a new story begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, with many criticizing the series for its excessive filler, inconsistent quality, and perceived mishandling of legacy characters. Some viewers appreciate the exploration of new themes and character development, particularly when focusing on manga canon material. The series is often compared unfavorably to its predecessor, Naruto, leading to disappointment among some fans, while others find it a worthwhile continuation if approached with different expectations.
pros: Exploration of a ninja world adapting to modernization and peace.
Meaningful character development, especially Boruto and Kawaki.
High-quality animation in major fights.
Good voice acting and OSTs.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, particularly in filler episodes.
Over-reliance on filler content.
Perceived power scaling issues with older characters.
Repetitive musical score.
Uneven pacing, especially in early arcs.

anime.title: Black Clover
anime.synopsis:
Asta and Yuno were abandoned at the same church on the same day. Raised together as children, they came to know of the "Wizard King"—a title given to the strongest mage in the kingdom—and promised that they would compete against each other for the position of the next Wizard King. However, as they grew up, the stark difference between them became evident. While Yuno is able to wield magic with amazing power and control, Asta cannot use magic at all and desperately tries to awaken his powers by training physically.

When they reach the age of 15, Yuno is bestowed a spectacular Grimoire with a four-leaf clover, while Asta receives nothing. However, soon after, Yuno is attacked by a person named Lebuty, whose main purpose is to obtain Yuno's Grimoire. Asta tries to fight Lebuty, but he is outmatched. Though without hope and on the brink of defeat, he finds the strength to continue when he hears Yuno's voice. Unleashing his inner emotions in a rage, Asta receives a five-leaf clover Grimoire, a "Black Clover" giving him enough power to defeat Lebuty. A few days later, the two friends head out into the world, both seeking the same goal—to become the Wizard King!
anime.consensus_summary: Black Clover is a divisive shonen anime. Some viewers appreciate the underdog story and improvements in production quality, while others criticize its reliance on generic tropes, weak initial episodes, and shallow characters. The series evokes both strong loyalty and harsh criticism, resulting in a polarized reception.
pros: Satisfying character development, especially Asta's journey from underdog to savior.
Noticeable improvement in animation and production quality over time.
Positive themes of trust, hope, and perseverance resonate with viewers.
cons: Generic shonen tropes and cliches.
Weak initial episodes with poor voice acting and animation.
Repetitive dialogue and predictable character actions.
Inconsistent character writing and shallow characterizations.

anime.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Revival of the Commandments
anime.romaji_title: Nanatsu no Taizai: Imashime no Fukkatsu
anime.synopsis:
The fierce battle between Meliodas, the captain of the Seven Deadly Sins, and the Great Holy Knight Hendrickson has devastating consequences. Armed with the fragments necessary for the revival of the Demon Clan, Hendrickson breaks the seal, allowing the Commandments to escape, all of whom are mighty warriors working directly under the Demon King himself. Through a mysterious connection, Meliodas instantly identifies them; likewise, the 10 Commandments, too, seem to sense his presence.

As the demons leave a path of destruction in their wake, the Seven Deadly Sins must find a way to stop them before the Demon Clan drowns Britannia in blood and terror.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers enjoyed the character development, fight scenes, and emotional backstories, considering it a highlight of the series. However, many found the plot predictable, the characters inconsistent, and the power scaling illogical, leading to disappointment. This season is considered by some as the last good one in the series.
pros: Good character development for some characters (e.g., Escanor, Ban)
Amazing fight scenes
Interesting backstories revealed, adding emotional depth
cons: Predictable plot and generic storyline
Poor character development for others (e.g., Elizabeth, Diane)
Inconsistent power scaling and convenient plot devices
Rushed introductions and outros for some characters

anime.title: Fastest Finger First
anime.synopsis: As soon as he entered high school, the first year student Koshiyama Shiki was invited to the mysterious Quiz Study Group led by his senpai. What will Shiki run into when being dragged along by his class mate Mari into the dazzling world of competitive quizzes?!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the anime to be a unique and engaging take on competitive quizzing, highlighting character development and intense quiz scenes. Others felt it was lackluster due to rushed character development, mediocre production quality, and unresolved storylines. There's a niche appeal for those interested in quiz bowl, but it may not resonate with a broader audience.
pros: Unique concept of competitive quiz bowl
Appealing character development, especially Koshiyama's growth
Engaging quiz scenes that create a participatory experience for viewers
Nostalgic feelings for those who participated in academic competitions
cons: Rushed character development due to the short length.
Mediocre art and animation quality.
Unremarkable or generic soundtrack.
Some found the voice acting for Fukami Mari to be off-putting or unemotional.
Storylines left unresolved.

anime.title: Natsume's Book of Friends Season 6
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Takashi Natsume has grown accustomed to his encounters with youkai through the Book of Friends, which contains the names of youkai whom his grandmother, Reiko Natsume, has sealed in contracts. These encounters allow Natsume to better understand the youkai, Reiko, and himself. 

The Book of Friends is a powerful tool that can be used to control youkai; it is sought after by both youkai and exorcists alike. Natsume just wants to live out his daily life in peace but is constantly disrupted by these experiences. If he is to end this torment, Natsume must explore more about the book and the world of exorcism, as well as begin to open his heart to those who can help him.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus for Natsume Yuujinchou Roku is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers praise its consistent quality, heartwarming themes, and relaxing atmosphere. The show is seen as a beautiful and emotionally resonant experience, with particular appreciation for its character development and exploration of Japanese spiritual beliefs.
pros: Consistent high quality across seasons
Relaxing and calming atmosphere
Meaningful exploration of relationships and character growth
Beautiful animation and soundtrack
Well-scripted and cohesive storytelling
cons: Episodic nature can feel repetitive to some viewers

anime.title: Made in Abyss
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Gore, Mystery, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
The Abyss—a gaping chasm stretching down into the depths of the earth, filled with mysterious creatures and relics from a time long past. How did it come to be? What lies at the bottom? Countless brave individuals, known as Divers, have sought to solve these mysteries of the Abyss, fearlessly descending into its darkest realms. The best and bravest of the Divers, the White Whistles, are hailed as legends by those who remain on the surface.

Riko, daughter of the missing White Whistle Lyza the Annihilator, aspires to become like her mother and explore the furthest reaches of the Abyss. However, just a novice Red Whistle herself, she is only permitted to roam its most upper layer. Even so, Riko has a chance encounter with a mysterious robot with the appearance of an ordinary young boy. She comes to name him Reg, and he has no recollection of the events preceding his discovery. Certain that the technology to create Reg must come from deep within the Abyss, the two decide to venture forth into the chasm to recover his memories and see the bottom of the great pit with their own eyes. However, they know not of the harsh reality that is the true existence of the Abyss.
anime.consensus_summary: Made in Abyss is a visually stunning and captivating adventure anime with a dark underbelly. While praised for its world-building and emotional depth, it is also criticized for its pacing, potentially disturbing content, and character development. The series evokes strong reactions, making it a polarizing but memorable experience for viewers.
pros: Excellent world-building and setting.
Beautiful background art and soundtrack.
Compelling sense of mystery and adventure.
cons: Pacing issues with slow progression in some episodes.
Controversial content, including loli content and potentially disturbing scenes.
Characters may be bland or annoying to some viewers.

anime.title: Lostorage Conflated WIXOSS
anime.genres: High Stakes Game, Psychological, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Tensions from the Selector battles have seemingly vanished, and the remaining participants have quickly put the entire ordeal behind them. However, Kiyoi Mizushima feels that the conflict has yet to end. Despite Kou Satomi's defeat, his supporters are already attempting to revive his plans in the background.

It does not take long for Mizushima's suspicions to be confirmed true. Not only does the Selector battle system reemerge, but also a new mechanic has been implemented. Players receive a special key card that will unlock with gold coins, releasing a hidden power. Aware of the formidable foes that lie ahead, Mizushima begins to seek out skilled allies in her endeavor to finally break the cycle of darkness.
anime.consensus_summary: Lostorage Conflated WIXOSS receives mixed reactions, with praise for its character development and conclusive storyline, but criticism for its convoluted plot and inconsistent card game mechanics. Many viewers appreciated the integration of characters from previous seasons and the resolution of long-standing plot threads. However, some found the new rules and focus on certain characters less appealing, resulting in a somewhat divided audience.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to the Wixoss storyline, tying up loose ends from previous seasons.
Strong character development, particularly for Kiyoi Mizushima, who becomes a central figure.
Integration of characters from both Selector Infected WIXOSS and Lostorage Incited WIXOSS, creating interesting interactions and resolving character arcs.
cons: Complex rules and plot points that can be confusing for viewers.
Inconsistent game mechanics and perceived cheating within the card battles.
Some characters, particularly from Season 3 (Lostorage Incited), are considered less interesting or poorly utilized.
anime.thematic_vibe: Card Battle, Character Development, Series Conclusion

anime.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. 2
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, School, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: The disastrous life of the gifted psychic Kusuo Saiki continues, despite his utmost effort to live an ordinary life. Although he has certainly grown accustomed to dealing with his troublesome friends—who are his biggest hurdle to achieving a peaceful life—he still has a long way to go. Also joining the usual oddballs are a few new faces whose shenanigans add to Saiki's misery, making his dreams of a hassle-free life a distant fantasy.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Saiki Kusuo no Ψ-nan is generally well-received, with many viewers finding it just as enjoyable, if not more so, than the first season.  The humor remains a strong point, and new characters are seen as a positive addition. Some viewers felt a slight dip in quality compared to the first season, particularly with the pacing of longer story arcs, but overall the audience consensus is positive.
pros: New characters add spice to the comedy and lead to fun interactions.
The art took an upgrade that makes the series better looking.
The series refines what it already did well and enriches the narrative.
cons: The show becomes slightly weaker compared to the 1st season.
Animation quality dropped slightly.
Multi-episode mini arcs lack the pace of short stories and feel less entertaining.
anime.thematic_vibe: Gag Comedy, Slice of Life, Parody

anime.title: BLEND-S
anime.synopsis:
Wishing to be independent, 16-year-old Maika Sakuranomiya is desperate to nail down a part-time job so that she can afford to study abroad. Unfortunately, her applications are constantly rejected due to the menacing look she unintentionally makes whenever she smiles, despite her otherwise cheerful disposition.

After yet another failed interview, she chances upon Café Stile, a coffee shop where the servers interact with the customers while roleplaying distinctive characteristics. The Italian store manager, Dino, becomes infatuated with Maika's cuteness at first sight, and offers her a job as a waitress with a sadistic nature. Coupled with her inherent clumsiness, she successfully manages to serve a pair of masochistic customers in accordance with her new, ruthless persona. Alongside Kaho Hinata as the tsundere and Mafuyu Hoshikawa as the younger sister, Maika decides to make the most out of her unique quirk and cements her position in the cafe with merciless cruelty!
anime.consensus_summary: Blend S is a generally well-received, lighthearted comedy anime appreciated for its cute characters and light-hearted humor. While it doesn't break new ground narratively and some jokes may become repetitive, the show is considered enjoyable for casual viewing. The potential romantic element between the manager and the main character is a point of contention for some viewers, however.
pros: Charming and endearing cast with good character chemistry.
Catchy opening theme and enjoyable voice acting.
Bright and vibrant art style with expressive character designs.
Consistent animation quality.
cons: Lack of a strong overarching plot and repetitive episodic structure.
Humor relies heavily on visual gags and can become predictable.
Some characters are one-dimensional with minimal development.
Problematic age gap between characters leading to uncomfortable romantic undertones.

anime.title: YU-NO: A Girl Who Chants Love at the Bound of This World
anime.romaji_title: Kono Yo no Hate de Koi wo Utau Shoujo YU-NO
anime.synopsis: Takuya Arima is a young student whose father, a historian who has conducted various researches, disappeared recently. During a summer vacation Takuya receives a peculiar package from his missing father, along with a letter containing information about the existence of various parallel worlds. At first Takuya doesn't take it seriously, but soon he realizes that he possesses a device that allows him to travel to alternate dimensions. Is his father alive, after all? If so, where is he?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the complex story, time travel elements, and unique protagonist. However, many find the pacing rushed, the characters underdeveloped, and the plot riddled with holes, especially towards the ending. The series suffers from poor adaptation, failing to capture the essence of the original visual novel.
pros: Intriguing time travel and parallel world concepts
Complex plot with interconnected storylines
Unique and well-defined main character (Takuya)
Nostalgic value for fans of the original visual novel
Satisfying ending for some viewers
cons: Pacing issues, especially in the final arc
Incomplete world building and poorly explained sci-fi concepts
Superficial and unlikeable secondary characters
Unnecessary ecchi scenes and perverted humor
Plot holes and unanswered questions
Rushed and unsatisfying conclusion
anime.thematic_vibe: Sci-Fi Mystery, Time Travel, Complex Plot

anime.title: Bakuon!! no Kobeya
anime.synopsis: Short specials included with the Bakuon!! BD/DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the special enjoyable due to its energetic characters and chibi art style. However, it is criticized for its lack of a substantial story and uneven character development. The return of the voice actors is appreciated, but the absence of a proper opening and the instrumental ending are noted.
pros: Bright and energetic main character (Hane)
Good chibi art style
Voice actors reprise their roles
cons: No significant story
Limited character development for some characters (Ramiu)
Lack of opening theme and only instrumental ending theme

anime.title: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! 2 - God's Blessing on This Wonderful Art!
anime.romaji_title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! 2: Kono Subarashii Geijutsu ni Shukufuku wo!
anime.synopsis:
On one noteworthy day in the Adventurer's Guild, Kazuma Satou encounters someone unexpected—a fan of his named Ran. Surprised that he even has a fan, Kazuma attempts to play it cool to impress her. Unfortunately for him, the guild's receptionist arrives with a request to defeat a giant golem guarding some ancient ruins, and Kazuma accepts only to keep Ran's admiration.

Upon Kazuma and his party's successful return from the ruins, Kazuma continues to shamelessly brag to Ran. Capitalizing on his desperation, the receptionist approaches him with another quest that requires him to return to the same ruins. Hoping to find valuable treasures, Kazuma once again convinces his party to join him—but this time, he may be biting off more than he can chew.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received by Konosuba fans for its humor and familiar characters, fitting seamlessly into the series. However, some find it repetitive and lacking in substance compared to the main seasons. The animation quality receives mixed reviews, with some appreciating improvements and others noticing inconsistencies.
pros: Humorous and comedic with typical Konosuba hilarity.
Enjoyable for fans of the series; delivers what's expected.
Improved animation quality compared to the first season, more in line with season 2.
cons: Story and jokes are repetitive and re-used.
Lacks depth; geared towards pure enjoyment rather than a compelling narrative.
Animation quality can be inconsistent with badly keyframed scenes.
OVA felt lackluster and toned down compared to other Konosuba episodes.

anime.title: Welcome to the Ballroom
anime.synopsis:
Tatara Fujita is a shy middle schooler who has no particular plan for the future. He has gotten through life by avoiding any kind of confrontation and blending in with the crowd. But blending in isn't enough to get out of trouble, as some bullies harass him for money. Luckily, he is saved by a man named Kaname Sengoku.

Kaname invites Tatara to his dance studio. Although he would normally never set foot in such a place, Tatara is captivated by Sengoku's commanding presence. Granted an opportunity to dance with fellow classmate Shizuku Hanaoka—who often practices at the studio—Tatara realizes there's something about the idea of being put in the limelight and dancing where people will see him that keeps him coming back. With an earnest, passionate drive to improve, Tatara begins his journey into the world of competitive dance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found Ballroom e Youkoso to be an inspiring and aesthetically pleasing sports anime with strong character development and exciting dance sequences. However, many were disappointed by the inconsistent animation, repetitive plot, and underdevelopment of side characters. The second half's new character dynamics were also a point of contention, leading to a polarized viewing experience.
pros: Compelling character development, especially Tatara's growth.
Dynamic and well-choreographed dance scenes.
Detailed attention to the technical aspects of ballroom dancing.
Excellent direction and emotional intensity in each episode.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with frequent use of stills and CGI.
Repetitive plot elements and predictable story arcs.
Underdeveloped side characters and lack of screen time for some.
Annoying tsundere character dynamics in the second cour.
Inadequate music that fails to enhance dance scenes.

anime.title: Rage of Bahamut: Genesis - Short Story
anime.romaji_title: Shingeki no Bahamut: Genesis - Short Story
anime.synopsis:
The first short story focuses on Favaro and Kaiser between the events of the first and second series as they visit Favaro's home village. 

The second short story shows Kaiser as a knight commander sparring with Jeanne, and sharing the reasons they remained as Orleans Knights in the aftermath of the final battle against Bahamut.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the short stories, praising the character development and animation quality. They feel the episodes add value to the main series by providing closure and exploring character backstories. Some viewers noted that it doesn't quite match the quality of the first season's beginning and that some plot inconsistencies remain.
pros: Excellent character development
High-quality animation on par with the main series
Adds depth and context to the main story
Enjoyable and well-crafted short stories
Wraps up loose ends from season 1
cons: Doesn't quite reach the same quality as the start of season 1
Some plot holes remain from the main series

anime.title: Fafner The Beyond
anime.romaji_title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - The Beyond
anime.consensus_summary: The audience feels a strong emotional connection to the series, praising its continued development of characters and themes. While some find the plot dense and requiring prior knowledge, the overall sentiment is positive, appreciating the conclusion to the franchise. Most fans agree that it successfully concludes the Fafner franchise.
pros: Characters have grown and aged realistically.
Dense plot with attention to detail.
Good character work with real motives and development.
Addresses the Festum and Mir in a direct way, exploring coexistence.
cons: Requires prior knowledge of the franchise.
Some may find the story obtuse.
Fights lack the imagination and panache of previous seasons; settling for scale.

anime.title: Nekopara OVA
anime.synopsis:
Despite being the proud owner of six catgirls alongside his sister Shigure, Kashou Minazuki moves away from home to open his patisserie La Soleil. While unpacking, he makes a startling discovery: two of his catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, have stowed away in his luggage! Although the twins desperately want to stay by their master's side, Kashou has no idea if he can manage both his new shop and the two catgirls. But what if having more hands on deck is exactly what he needs?

With the support of his caring sister and loyal catgirls, Kashou puts all his heart into making his dream a reality!
anime.consensus_summary: The Nekopara OVA is a divisive production, largely appealing to existing fans of the visual novel who appreciate the faithful character designs and lighthearted 'catgirl' antics. However, critics frequently point to significant pacing issues, a lack of narrative depth, and animation stutters, making it a polarizing experience for those unfamiliar with the source material or expecting a more developed story.
pros: Captures the essence and appeal of the catgirls well, providing fan service for existing fans.
Art and character designs are generally praised for their quality and faithfulness to the source material.
Provides a fun, lighthearted, and 'turn off your brain' experience.
Sound design and voice acting are professional and well-done.
Some viewers found the emotional moments effective, despite the overall simplicity of the plot.
cons: Pacing is a significant issue, with rushed scenes and illogical transitions due to cramming a large visual novel into a short OVA.
The plot lacks depth and direction, feeling disjointed and hard to follow for newcomers.
Character development is minimal, with many characters being described as one-dimensional or relying on tropes.
Cinematography and animation quality have notable flaws, including jittery pans and static scenes.
Significant deviations from the visual novel, particularly the removal of romantic and adult elements, disappointed long-time fans.

anime.title: Fate/Apocrypha
anime.synopsis:
The Holy Grail is a powerful, ancient relic capable of granting any wish the beholder desires. In order to obtain this power, various magi known as "masters" summon legendary Heroic Spirits called "servants" to fight for them in a destructive battle royale—the Holy Grail War. Only the last master-servant pair standing may claim the Grail for themselves. Yet, the third war ended inconclusively, as the Grail mysteriously disappeared following the conflict.

Many years later, the magi clan Yggdmillennia announces its possession of the Holy Grail, and intends to leave the Mage's Association. In response, the Association sends 50 elite magi to retrieve the Grail; however, all but one are killed by an unknown servant. The lone survivor is used as a messenger to convey Yggdmillennia's declaration of war on the Association.

As there are only two parties involved in the conflict, the Holy Grail War takes on an unusual form. Yggdmillennia and the Mage's Association will each deploy seven master-servant pairs, and the side that loses all its combatants first will forfeit the artifact. As the 14 masters summon their servants and assemble on the battlefield, the magical world shivers in anticipation with the rise of the Great Holy Grail War.
anime.consensus_summary: Fate/Apocrypha is largely considered a disappointing entry in the Fate franchise due to its poor writing, overabundance of characters, and inconsistent production quality. While some appreciate the soundtrack and unique premise, the majority feel the show fails to deliver compelling characters, a coherent plot, and satisfying animation. The series is heavily criticized for its reliance on fan service and generic tropes, resulting in a forgettable and frustrating viewing experience.
pros: Good soundtrack and opening themes.
Some enjoyed the large-scale battles and unique premise.
Some characters were well-designed and enjoyable, with potential for great character development, backstories and interesting dynamics.
Faithful adaptation of the light novels (according to some).
cons: Poor writing quality with a draining info-dump start.
Too many characters with not enough development, making it hard to care.
Generic or unlikeable main character (Sieg).
Rushed backstories and lack of emotional connection.
Lazy animation and inconsistent art quality.
Poorly explained mechanics and logical errors.
Overreliance on fan service and otaku pandering (e.g., loli Jack the Ripper, trap Astolfo).
Shallow plot and themes.
Inconsistent character motivations
Poor sound mixing

anime.title: Children of the Whales
anime.romaji_title: Kujira no Kora wa Sajou ni Utau
anime.synopsis:
In a world covered by an endless sea of sand, there sails an island known as the Mud Whale. In its interior lies an ancient town, where the majority of its inhabitants are said to be "Marked," a double-edged trait that grants them supernatural abilities at the cost of an untimely death. Chakuro is the village archivist; young and curious, he spends his time documenting the discovery of newfound islands. But each one is like the rest—abandoned save for the remnants of those who lived there long ago. 

For the first time in six months, another island crosses the horizon, so Chakuro and his friends join the scouting group. During the expedition, they find vestiges of an archaic civilization. And inside one of its crumbling remains, Chakuro discovers a girl who will change his destiny and the world inside the Mud Whale as he knows it.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. While many praise the show's unique world, stunning visuals, and impactful soundtrack, the majority are critical of its underdeveloped characters, inconsistent pacing, and weak plot. The ending feels rushed and incomplete. Ultimately, the anime is seen as a missed opportunity with great potential.
pros: Beautiful art style and backgrounds, particularly the watercolor aesthetic.
Interesting and unique world-building with a well-developed setting.
Memorable music and sound design that enhances emotional scenes.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and rushed storytelling, particularly in the later episodes.
Underdeveloped characters with shallow motivations and little screen time.
Poor writing with plot holes, excessive exposition, and melodramatic scenes.

anime.title: Minami Kamakura High School Girls Cycling Club: We're In Taiwan!!
anime.romaji_title: Minami Kamakura Koukou Joshi Jitensha-bu: Kita yo, Taiwan!
anime.synopsis:
Unaired episode included with the special edition BD release.

The girls hear from school principal Ryuko that the school is considering Taiwan as the destination for the school trip. Since Taiwan is one of only a few advance cycling nations, she instructs the cycling club to go to Taiwan as part of a preliminary inspection for the school trip. But as soon as they arrive in Taiwan, Hiromi and Sandy become separated...
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is a lighthearted and enjoyable side story focused on the characters' trip to Taiwan. The audience generally appreciates the familiar elements and positive vibes, but some feel the plot is too simple. It's a pleasant addition for fans of the series.
pros: Enjoyable travel aspect.
Returning voice actresses and familiar music.
Cheerful and positive characters.
cons: Simple plot.

anime.title: SENGOKUCHOJYUGIGA 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Sengoku Choujuu Giga.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a niche historical comedy that is cleverly written with an enjoyable art style. Appreciation is heavily dependent on the viewer's familiarity with the Sengoku period. While enjoyable for its target audience, it may not appeal to a broader audience due to its specific humor.
pros: Cleverly written episodes.
Enjoyable original songs.
Unique and appealing art style.
Good voice acting.
Creative concept of historical figures as animals.
cons: Historical references may be lost on those unfamiliar with the Sengoku period.
Humor is very particular and may not appeal to everyone.
Requires prior knowledge from Season 1.

anime.title: Magical Circle
anime.synopsis:
Nike was a simple boy from Boering Village, and the last thing he ever wanted was to become a hero. But when a sign appears from the king of Ainshent Castle Town recruiting heroes to slay the Demon Lord Giri, Nike's father enthusiastically forces him out the door. Along with Kukuri, a member of the Migu Migu Clan, Nike sets out on an adventure to become the legendary hero that the world needs.

As Nike and Kukuri travel across different continents, they attempt to learn the secrets of Guru Guru Magic, a strange but powerful type of magic used to seal Demon Lord Giri's power. While reluctantly taking on their assigned quest, the duo does not fail to acquire new comrades and have fun along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The 2017 remake of Mahoujin Guruguru is well-received as a comedic parody of classic JRPGs. While some find the pacing rushed and the humor occasionally inconsistent, most viewers praise its lightheartedness, charming characters, and effective use of RPG tropes. The show's overall positive reception suggests a niche but dedicated audience.
pros: Consistently funny with varied comedic styles (visual gags, wordplay, character reactions).
Charming characters that subvert RPG tropes.
Enjoyable action sequences interspersed with comedy.
Successfully parodies JRPG tropes without sacrificing plot.
cons: Fast pacing at the beginning may not appeal to all viewers, as character development takes time.
Some jokes may not land depending on individual tastes.
The plot can be considered simplistic or cliched, relying heavily on RPG tropes.
Character development is uneven, with Kukuri receiving more attention than Nike.

anime.title: ChäoS;Child Episode 0
anime.synopsis: A recap of ChäoS;HEAd that aired along with episode 1 of ChäoS;Child as part of a one-hour special.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers find the recap helpful as a refresher before watching Chaos;Child, appreciating the updated visuals and atmosphere. However, many criticize the rushed pacing, incomplete storytelling, and resulting confusion, especially for those unfamiliar with the original Chaos;Head series. The recap is generally considered insufficient as a standalone experience.
pros: Helpful refresher for Chaos;Head events before watching Chaos;Child.
Good atmosphere and new animation style for Chaos;Head characters.
Music and sound are great.
cons: Too fast-paced and condensed, leaving out important details and characters.
Incomplete recap, cuts off before the ending of Chaos;Head, requiring viewers to re-watch the original.
Confusing for newcomers who haven't seen Chaos;Head.
Character portrayals feel like shells of their former selves, lacking depth.

anime.title: Kuma no Gakkou: Patissier Jackie to Ohisama no Sweets
anime.romaji_title: Kuma no Gakkou: Patissier Jackie to Ohisama no Sweets
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, emphasizing the cuteness and wholesome nature of the anime. Viewers appreciate the focus on sweets and baking, making it particularly appealing to young children. The short runtime is a minor drawback, but overall the anime is well-received for its aesthetic qualities and thematic content.
pros: Cute and colorful animation style.
Appeals to those who enjoy sweets and baking.
Suitable for young children.
cons: Short runtime (30 minutes) may not be fulfilling for all viewers.

anime.title: Dynamic Chord
anime.synopsis:
Dynamic Chord is a record company and music agency representing the hottest artists right now with, in particular, four of the country's most popular bands.

They are rêve parfait with its own unique world view and progressive sound, Liar-S, an emo rock band, KYOSO, a group of highly-polished performers, and apple-polisher, which fuses dance with rock and roll. Against the backdrop of Japan's four seasons, comes a realistically depicted documentary movie about the encounters, breakups and trajectory of these 16 band members as they vie for musical preeminence.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely critical of Dynamic Chord, citing poor animation, a messy story, and bland characters as major flaws. Some viewers found the music enjoyable and appreciated the unique focus on the agency, as well as some of the character development. The show's poor execution is somewhat offset by the unintentional humor and potential for interactive viewing experiences on platforms like NicoNico, making it so bad it's good for some.
pros: Enjoyable music/soundtrack
Unique concept focusing on the agency rather than just the idols
Character development
Full circle ending
cons: Poor animation quality
Messy and confusing story
Flat, uninteresting, and look-alike characters
Boring and slow pacing
Awkward animations and out-of-place shots
anime.thematic_vibe: Boy-band drama, Musical preeminence, Character Development

anime.title: 91 Days: Shoal of Time/All Our Yesterdays/Tomorrow and Tomorrow
anime.romaji_title: 91 Days: Toki no Asase/Subete no Kinou/Ashita, Mata Ashita
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Historical, Organized Crime, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Toki no Asase (Shoal of Time)
Rather than attending Sunday mass, a young Nero Vanetti and Vanno Clemente convince Nero's younger brother Frate to join in their mischievous plan to visit the ongoing circus in Lawless. Despite the inevitable trouble they will find themselves in later, the three sneak out in hopes of having some fun.

Subete no Kinou (All Our Yesterdays)
At a bar in Lawless, Ganzo Alary meets Vincent Vanetti, a recent Italian immigrant in search of a job. Intrigued by Vincent's resolve to eventually become a don of his own family, Ganzo invites him to meet some members of the Morenos the next day—an encounter that will soon shape the future of Lawless and its mafia families.

Ashita, Mata Ashita (Tomorrow and Tomorrow)
After defeating the assassin in the small town of Khota, Angelo Lagusa and Nero head back to Lawless. However, Nero has come down with a fever and begins to experience vivid dreams of the past. Meanwhile, Angelo does his best to help him recover with a special remedy.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views this special as a pleasant, albeit non-essential, addition for existing fans of 91 Days. While it offers enjoyable backstory and character moments that enhance the main series, many reviewers feel it doesn't contribute anything crucial to the plot and could have been omitted without significant loss.
pros: Provides additional backstory and character motivations, enriching the main series.
Animation and art style maintain the quality of the parent series, with some reviewers noting improved vibrancy.
Offers more content for fans who are attached to the characters and the universe of 91 Days.
cons: Adds practically nothing new or essential to the main plot, making it feel dispensable.
The sequence of the segments is criticized for not following the chronological order of events.
Fails to significantly expand on character depth or develop underdeveloped subplots, a missed opportunity.

anime.title: Kuroko no Basket: Oshaberi Shiyou ka
anime.romaji_title: Kuroko no Basket: Oshaberi Shiyou ka
anime.genres: Comedy, School, Shounen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: Special included on Kuroko no Basket Fan Disc 3: Korekara Nandodemo.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Oshaberi Shiyou ka' special is a lighthearted comedic recap that offers enjoyable character interactions and sweet moments for fans of Kuroko no Basket. However, some viewers may find the format repetitive and stale, especially with the recurring recaps. Overall, it's a relaxed and fun segment that allows fans to enjoy the characters together.
pros: Unique character interactions
Sweet character moments
Funny bits
cons: Repetitive
Stale
Excessive recaps

anime.title: Idol Time PriPara
anime.synopsis: The story focuses on Yui, a girl who lives in the town of Paparajuku, and who dreams of being an idol, even if she realizes that being an idol is next to impossible for her. Her friends often remark on how much she dreams about it. But then, the PriPara idol theme park opens in her town, and that an idol named Laala is coming to town from Parajuku, which only makes Yui dream even bigger. The new PriPara theme park has been updated with new concepts. However, due to a system error, Laala is no longer able to PriPara Change.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Idol Time PriPara, particularly the new protagonist and the music. The returning characters and more compelling story are also seen as positives. However, some viewers find the filler content unnecessary, but overall the show is well-received, especially by its target audience.
pros: Adorable new protagonist (Yui)
Compelling story
Great songs and opening/ending themes
Returning characters from previous Pripara series
cons: Unnecessary filler content

anime.title: Lu Over the Wall
anime.synopsis:
In the seaside village of Hinashi Town, Kai Ashimoto's grandfather is one of the locals who reinforces the legend that mermaids lurk near Merfolk Island and consume humans. Due to allegedly attracting merfolk and subsequently causing the death of the elder's mother, music is seldom discussed in the Ashimoto household. Even so, Kai finds solace in making looped beats on his laptop and uploading them to the internet.

Despite his reserved and glum demeanor, Kai is approached by Kunio and Yuuho Ebina, two cheerful classmates that happened upon one of his videos. The pair ask him to join their rock band but are met with apathy. Nevertheless, Kai agrees to accompany them in a practice session on Merfolk Island, where he soon witnesses something that he cannot explain.

Later that night, Kai is composing music in his room when he attracts a familiar entity—a mermaid. As she twirls and grins to the sound of his stereo, Kai discovers a number of aspects about the being who introduces herself as Lu: she possesses incredible water manipulation powers; she buds a pair of functioning legs with the sound of music; but most notably, she is a truly benevolent creature who simply wants people to like her. Fostering a dynamic friendship, Kai and Lu gradually come to express their genuine selves, testing the long-standing boundaries that have deafened the resounding harmony among the people of Hinashi Town.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences are largely charmed by the film's spectacular visuals and uplifting musical numbers, finding it a pure joy to watch. However, a significant portion of viewers feel the narrative is too predictable and underdeveloped, leading to a moderate split in overall reception.
pros: Visually stunning with unique and vibrant animation, especially in its depiction of water.
Excellent and memorable soundtrack that greatly enhances the film's atmosphere and emotional impact.
Captures a sense of pure joy and wonder, making it an enjoyable and uplifting watch.
Characters, particularly Lu, are charming and likable, bringing infectious energy.
cons: The story is considered predictable, generic, and lacking in depth by some viewers.
Pacing issues, with some sections feeling rushed or meandering.
Character development, especially for the protagonist Kai, can feel underdeveloped or inconsistent.
The mixed animation styles, while unique, were jarring for some viewers.

anime.title: Laid-Back Camp
anime.synopsis:
While the perfect getaway for most girls her age might be a fancy vacation with their loved ones, Rin Shima's ideal way of spending her days off is camping alone at the base of Mount Fuji. From pitching her tent to gathering firewood, she has always done everything by herself, and has no plans of leaving her little solitary world.

However, what starts off as one of Rin's usual camping sessions somehow ends up as a surprise get-together for two when the lost Nadeshiko Kagamihara is forced to take refuge at her campsite. Originally intending to see the picturesque view of Mount Fuji for herself, Nadeshiko's plans are disrupted when she ends up falling asleep partway to her destination. Alone and with no other choice, she seeks help from the only other person nearby. Despite their hasty introductions, the two girls nevertheless enjoy the chilly night together, eating ramen and conversing while the campfire keeps them warm. And even after Nadeshiko's sister finally picks her up later that night, both girls silently ponder the possibility of another camping trip together.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find the show to be a relaxing and wholesome experience that promotes stress relief. The show's simple premise and focus on the joys of camping create a cozy atmosphere.
pros: The show is relaxing and makes you forget about your worries.
The art and music are beautiful and calming.
The show provides knowledge about camping.
cons: The plot is simple and there is not much story progression.
Some viewers felt it focused too much on consumerism and not enough on the outdoors.
May be too slow for some viewers.

anime.title: Action Heroine Cheer Fruits
anime.synopsis:
Several years ago, local heroines—superhero characters who represent towns and perform stage shows in order to raise their town's acclaim—had a boom in popularity. The most famous of these local heroines, Kamidaio, is scheduled to perform in the small town of Hinano, much to the excitement of Mikan Kise's little sister Yuzu. Unfortunately, when Mikan takes Yuzu to the show, she finds out that it has been canceled. She promises her distraught sister that she'll make sure she can see the show. Desperate not to let her down, Mikan asks her classmate, the local heroine fanatic An Akagi, for help.

Mikan and Ann put on their own Kamidaio performance clad in homemade costumes, which the kids in the audience love despite its lack of production value. The show is recorded by the student council president Misaki Shirogane, who posts it online to garner attention. Misaki is from a family of politicians and has taken it upon herself to revitalize Hinano. Impressed by their show, she recruits Mikan and An to become the official local heroines of their town. As the group works to improve their shows, they enlist the help of a variety of colorful individuals.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a heartwarming and unique take on the 'cute girls doing cute things' genre, with a focus on local heroines. While the animation and some character development are lacking, the overall experience is enjoyable. The audience appreciates the show's fresh premise and the characters' dedication to their community.
pros: Unique premise focusing on local heroines rather than idols.
Characters are diverse, distinct, and memorable.
Enjoyable blend of action and slice-of-life elements.
The show incorporates local events and culture effectively.
Whimsical world-building elements
cons: Animation quality is lackluster at times.
Character development uneven, some characters underdeveloped.
Plot can be predictable.

anime.title: ViVid Strike! Specials
anime.synopsis: Episodes 5.5, 5.75, and 13 bundled with the second, third, and fourth Blu-ray volumes of ViVid Strike!
anime.consensus_summary: The Vivid Strike! Specials offer additional character insights and wrap up loose ends from the main series, though they don't significantly impact the overall narrative. Viewers appreciate the extra time with the characters and the closure provided. They're generally considered a mildly entertaining addition for fans of the show, but not essential viewing.
pros: Provides more detailed analysis of relationships.
Gives closure to unresolved plot points.
Explains certain plot elements not obvious at first.
cons: Doesn't add much to the main story.
Skippable without missing much.
The specials are not groundbreaking.
anime.thematic_vibe: Character Development, Slice of Life, Action

anime.title: Mazinger Z Movie: Infinity
anime.genres: Comedy, Mecha, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
