Ten years ago, the villainous scientist Dr. Hell led his wicked followers, known as the Underground Empire, in a struggle to destroy all of humanity. It was against these forces that the young hero Kouji Kabuto fought, piloting the legendary super robot "Mazinger Z." Kouji's victory stopped Dr. Hell's evil plan and returned peace to the Earth.

Now Kouji has left the pilot seat behind and become a scientist in his own right, following in his father's and grandfather's footsteps. Yet an unexpected encounter deep under Mt. Fuji triggers an even greater threat to mankind than ever before and alters Kouji's destiny forever. With humanity's fate in their hands, Kouji and Mazinger Z face a choice between good... and evil.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie serves as a decent conclusion to the franchise, taking creative liberties with the story. However, the CGI and the introduction of a new character are points of criticism. Fans suggest watching Shin Mazinger Z before viewing this movie for a better experience.
pros: Creative liberties taken with the story paid off.
Good anniversary anime.
Characters and action are well done.
cons: CGI robots are not well-received.
New character is not a good fit.
Shin Mazinger Z is better.

anime.title: Tsukigakirei
anime.synopsis:
With a new school year comes a new crowd of classmates, and for their final year of junior high, aspiring writer Kotarou Azumi and track team member Akane Mizuno end up in the same class. Though initially complete strangers, a few chance encounters stir an innocent desire within their hearts. A yearning gaze, a fluttering heart—the hallmarks of young love slip into their lives as fate brings their paths to a cross.

However, though love is patient and love is kind, Kotarou and Akane discover it is not always straightforward. Despite the comfort they find in each other's company, heartache and anxiety come hand in hand with pursuing the feelings in their hearts. With the uncertainty of how the other truly feels as well as the competing affections of those around them, the road ahead is unclear. Even so, under the shining light of a beautiful full moon, Kotarou gathers his courage to ask Akane a single question, one that forever changes their quiet relationship.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers praising the show's realistic and heartfelt portrayal of young love, relatable characters, and slow-burn romance. However, others criticize the show for its slow pacing, lack of character chemistry, and overall boring and shallow interactions. The emotional impact varies greatly, with some finding it deeply touching and others feeling completely detached.
pros: Realistic portrayal of middle school romance and awkwardness.
Good character development at a reasonable pace.
Excellent pacing of the story.
Relatable themes of insecurity, desire, and dreams of teenagers.
Emotionally resonant and touching story.
cons: Main characters lack chemistry.
Boring and shallow interactions between the main couple.
Slow pacing with minimal excitement.
Some CGI issues and animation inconsistencies.
anime.thematic_vibe: Realistic Romance, Coming-of-Age, Slice of Life

anime.title: Clean Freak! Aoyama-kun
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, School, Seinen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis:
He is charming, cool, athletic, a good cook, but more importantly, he's a clean freak. Aoyama is idolized and respected by everyone, but they can only admire him from afar due to his mysophobia. Despite that, he plays soccer—a rather dirty sport!

As the playmaker for Fujimi High School's soccer club, Aoyama avoids physical contact at all cost and cleanly dribbles toward victory. However, the path to Nationals will not be easy for Fujimi's underdog team. But alongside striker Kaoru Zaizen, Aoyama will show everyone that even as a clean freak, there are things he's willing to get dirty for.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Keppeki Danshi! Aoyama-kun. Many appreciate its comedic elements, appealing art, and lighthearted nature, finding it an easy and enjoyable watch. However, some are disappointed by the lack of a strong plot, underdeveloped characters, and its failure to deliver on serious sports themes, leading to a lukewarm reception overall.
pros: Unique comedic premise with Aoyama's germophobia
Appealing art style and clean animation
Enjoyable, catchy opening and ending themes
Well-differentiated and likeable side characters
cons: Plot lacks a clear overarching goal or serious sports focus
Aoyama's character is one-dimensional and lacks development
Comedy can be repetitive and jokes overused
Sports elements feel secondary and underdeveloped
Some found the series forgettable or underwhelming

anime.title: Hina Logic – from Luck & Logic
anime.synopsis: Liones Yelistratova, a pure princess from a small country, enters a school in Hokkaido on a spring day. The school is a specialized educational institution operated by ALCA to train Logicalists, who maintain world peace. Liones enters class S, where she meets many classmates with unique personalities, like Nina. A lively and cute everyday life begins now.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is that 'Hina Logi' is a cute and enjoyable CGDCT anime with charming characters and fun interactions. While the story is often considered weak and the characters sometimes lack depth, the show excels at providing lighthearted entertainment. Most viewers agree it's a hidden gem for fans of the genre, despite its flaws.
pros: Charming character interactions and chemistry.
High-quality animation and art style, especially character designs.
Enjoyable and catchy opening theme.
Unique blend of CGDCT with mahou shoujo elements.
Heartwarming and fun to watch.
cons: Mediocre or weak overarching story.
Characters can be stereotypical or lack depth.
Plot can be confusing at times.
Inconsistent tone; attempts at serious themes sometimes clash with the CGDCT genre.

anime.title: Sanrio Boys
anime.genres: Otaku Culture, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Kouta Hasegawa is a completely normal high school student who likes his Pompompurin stuffed animal, a Sanrio character modelled after a Golden Retriever, which his grandmother gave him when he was young. However, an incident in which other kids accused him of being girly for liking Sanrio characters made him ashamed of his attachment to Pompompurin. 

Through a series of unexpected events, Kouta ends up meeting others at school who also like Sanrio characters—Yuu Mizuno, a flashy boy who is popular with girls; Shunsuke Yoshino, a member of the soccer team; Ryou Nishimiya, an underclassman who is a library assistant; and Seiichirou Minamoto, the student council president.

Through his new friends, Kouta learns that there is no need to be embarrassed for liking Sanrio characters; and together, they aim to create a play for the cultural festival in order to transform his normal school life into a sparkly one.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with viewers appreciating the show's heartwarming message about friendship and self-acceptance. However, many find the plot generic and criticize the excessive product placement and mediocre production quality. While some viewers relate to the characters' struggles, others find them unoriginal and the storyline predictable, resulting in an overall lukewarm reception.
pros: Relatable characters and conflicts, especially regarding societal expectations and personal interests.
Positive message about embracing individuality and overcoming societal pressures.
Appreciation for the unique premise of boys liking Sanrio characters.
Well-handled emotional moments and dramatic voice acting.
cons: Generic plot and characters, lacking originality.
Overuse of Sanrio product placement and advertising.
Repetitive soundtrack and mediocre animation quality.
Inconsistent character development, particularly with the main character Kouta.
Melodramatic and cringeworthy moments.

anime.title: Pikaia!!
anime.synopsis: Second season of Pikaia!.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Pikaia!! offers some improvements over the first, particularly in its darker and more engaging storyline focused on the Paleozoic era. However, the show retains a predictable structure, which may be seen as both a strength (for consistency) and a weakness (for repetitiveness). Overall, the audience seems mildly positive due to the educational content and improved narrative.
pros: Improved story compared to season 1
Exploration of Paleozoic world
Informative trivia segments
cons: Formulaic episode structure (recap, main episode, trivia)
Repetitive format from season 1
Limited Cambrian species to cover

anime.title: Gabriel DropOut Specials
anime.genres: CGDCT, Comedy, Mythology, School, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Specials included with the Blu-ray/DVD release of Gabriel DropOut.
anime.consensus_summary: The Gabriel DropOut Specials are a mixed bag. The first special leans heavily into fanservice, while the second attempts a dramatic storyline which polarized the audience.  While some viewers appreciated the emotional depth and character development in the second special, others found it jarring and out of sync with the series' comedic tone.
pros: Faithful to the original series in terms of comedy and character interaction in Special #1.
Special #2 offers a surprising and welcome shift to drama, showcasing the characters' softer sides.
Creative censorship in the first episode adds to the humor.
Well-developed characters placed in unfamiliar situations, highlighting new aspects of their personalities.
High entertainment value for fans of the main series, with some considering Special #2 to be a standout episode.
cons: Special #1 is considered overly lewd and fanservice-y by some, with weak comedy.
The dramatic shift in Special #2 feels forced and out of place for some viewers.
Satania's character and jokes are repetitive and predictable.
Story in both OVAs are not particularly unique or memorable.

anime.title: Touken Ranbu - Hanamaru 2
anime.synopsis: Sequel of Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Hanamaru is generally well-received by fans of the game and previous anime adaptation.  Viewers appreciate the focus on character interactions and lighthearted stories, even if the production values are not exceptionally high.  While not groundbreaking, it provides a wholesome and enjoyable experience for its target audience. Most critiques were very mild.
pros: Improved character focus and daily activities compared to the previous season
Enjoyable action scenes despite animation limitations
Faithful to the source material
Likable characters
cons: Generic art style and unmemorable music
Animation quality is on the cheaper side
Singing scenes felt unnecessary
Not complex, primarily aimed at existing fans

anime.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
The world of Duel Monsters is once again evolving with the development of a network called Link Vrains and a new summoning mechanic introduced as Link Summoning. By using this cyberspace, duelists can now create their own avatars and duel their way to glory within a virtual reality.

However, much like the real world, the digital world is not free from war, conflict, and mysteries. Years ago, a hacker organization known as the Knights of Hanoi unleashed an attack on Link Vrains. Led by the anonymous Revolver, their aim was to annihilate the artificial intelligence program known as the Cyberse. After a failed attempt, one of their targets, Ignis, managed to escape and hide the Cyberse somewhere in the network.

Five years later, high school student Yuusaku Fujiki encounters a strange artificial intelligence program while dueling in Link Vrains. Under the guise of his avatar named Playmaker, Yuusaku and his partner in crime, Shouichi Kusanagi, decide to join forces with the peculiar existence. As he seeks the truth behind a mysterious incident of the past, Yuusaku battles against the Knights of Hanoi and SOL Technologies in a race that might alter the fate of the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! VRAINS is a divisive entry in the franchise. Some appreciate its unique themes, pacing, and character motivations, while others criticize its filler episodes, rushed ending, and character portrayals. While not the best in the series, many found it enjoyable and emotionally impactful.
pros: Distinct art style and character designs
Believable character motivations influenced by the past and future
Fast pacing with story arcs that matter
cons: Filler episodes that feel like a waste of time
Unfair portrayal of a specific character
Rushed storytelling near the end
Some warped art and characters looking unlike themselves

anime.title: AHO-GIRL
anime.synopsis:
Yoshiko Hanabatake is an idiot beyond all belief. Somehow managing to consistently score zeroes on all of her tests and consumed by an absurd obsession with bananas, her senseless acts have caused even her own mother to lose all hope. Only one person is up to the task of keeping her insanity in check: childhood friend Akuru "A-kun" Akutsu.
 
Though he bemoans the ridiculous behavior he has to endure, the studious but terrifying A-kun is always ready to put an end to any stupidity Yoshiko gets up to, with no qualms about using physical force. Unfortunately, no matter how many times he attempts to knock some sense into her, the girl bounces right back to her usual shenanigans, even dragging in some other eccentrics along for the ride. Try as he might to rein in her nonsense, every moment is unpredictable with Yoshiko and her profound idiocy on the loose.
anime.consensus_summary: Aho Girl is a divisive comedy that relies heavily on slapstick and absurd humor. While some find it hilarious and enjoyable due to its energetic delivery and parodies, others find it repetitive, annoying, and lacking in substance. The show's simple premise and short episodes make it a quick watch, but its humor may not appeal to everyone.
pros: Excellent voice acting, especially for Yoshiko
Fast-paced and energetic comedy
Parodies various anime genres effectively
The short episode format makes it easy to watch
cons: Repetitive jokes and gags
Lack of a coherent story or plot
Characters can be annoying and unlikeable
Some find the physical violence unsettling

anime.title: Beyblade Burst Evolution
anime.synopsis: Valt Aoi, who participated in the Japanese Championship, was scouted for the prestigious Spanish team BC Sol and heads out to Spain. With their sights set on the world, Valt and his friends begin their challenge for the World League! However, in order to qualify for the World League, they must first win the European League. Will Valt be able to take BC Sol to the World League? And can he defeat the world's strongest Bladers?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers find the series enjoyable and praise its character development and engaging storyline, particularly for newcomers to anime. However, others are critical of the series' lack of female representation in competitive blading and what they perceive as a focus on toy sales over substantive storytelling. The show seems to be well-received by younger audiences and those new to anime, while more critical viewers express disappointment in its perceived shortcomings.
pros: Character development is excellent, especially Valt's.
The story is engaging and fun to watch.
The series can be a great introduction to anime.
cons: Lack of competitive female bladers is a recurring issue.
The series seems to prioritize toy sales over story development.
Character development and setting are compromised to promote merchandise.

anime.title: Tsuredure Children
anime.synopsis:
Young love—it takes many unique and fascinating forms that flourish as children begin to mature into adults. From being unable to confess to not knowing what real love actually feels like, various obstacles can arise when learning about romantic attraction for the first time. But underneath all that, young love is something truly beautiful to behold, leading to brand new experiences for those young and in love.

Tsurezure Children depicts various scenarios of young love coming to fruition, along with the struggles and joys that it entails.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Tsurezure Children for its cute and relatable portrayal of high school romance. Its short, episodic format and diverse cast are seen as strengths, offering something for everyone. However, some viewers find the limited screen time and lack of in-depth character development to be drawbacks. Overall, it's considered a lighthearted and enjoyable series.
pros: Diverse cast of characters and relationships offer something for everyone.
Short episode format avoids drawn-out tropes and delivers quick, satisfying romantic moments.
Realistic portrayals of first-time relationships with relatable awkwardness and humor.
cons: Short episodes and large cast limit character development and screen time for favorite couples.
Some character pairings feel underdeveloped or disappear entirely.
Storytelling can feel disjointed or repetitive due to the short format.

anime.title: RoboMasters the Animated Series
anime.synopsis: The series will depict college students as they prepare and participate in a RoboMasters tournament.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the show's realism and educational value regarding robotics and the RoboMasters competition. Others find it bland, unoriginal, and too much like an advertisement. The show seems to appeal mainly to those already interested in robots and engineering.
pros: Realistic portrayal of robotics design competition
Educational regarding robotics engineering
Unique experience compared to typical anime
cons: Feels like an advertisement
Unmemorable characters
Unoriginal story

anime.title: New Game!!
anime.genres: Adult Cast, CGDCT, Comedy, Otaku Culture
anime.synopsis:
​It has been a year since Aoba Suzukaze started working at the Eagle Jump game company. In that time, she and her eccentric coworkers in the character design department have worked hard to release the company's newest game: Fairies Story 3. With their latest title now complete, a new project must begin—starting with a contest to decide the character designs for the upcoming game. Through hard work, dedication, and some guidance from the previous character designer, Kou Yagami, Aoba wins the contest and begins her new role as lead character designer.

However, her new job is not an easy one. In addition to having extra work and longer hours, Aoba questions whether she is the right fit for the job. As she overcomes her inexperience with the help of her friends and coworkers, Aoba is willing to face any challenge to make Eagle Jump's newest creation, a cutesy game called Peco.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is split on New Game!!. Some viewers found the second season a solid improvement, praising the balance of humor and work-related seriousness, as well as the lovable characters and their development. However, others were disappointed by the introduction of new characters, the shift towards needless melodrama, and the perceived 'yuri bait' elements, which detracted from the original's charm.
pros: Balances cute/funny with serious work moments
Likeable characters with balanced screen time
Strong character development
Charming character design and colorful art
cons: New characters feel irrelevant and disrupt dynamics
Becomes more serious and dramatic, losing lightheartedness
Subtly designed yuri bait

anime.title: THE IDOLM@STER SideM
anime.synopsis: A newly created entertainment agency, 315 Production, specializes in scouting prospective idols who previously held other jobs. Whether they were a former lawyer, surgeon, or pilot, they had a place at the agency. As they grow to understand their new positions, they'll aim to achieve their dreams of becoming top idols!
anime.consensus_summary: The iDOLM@STER SideM is generally well-received as a fun and lighthearted male idol anime, particularly praised for its characters, music, and animation. However, some find the plot lacking and the pacing inconsistent due to the large cast and limited episode count. While it may not be groundbreaking, it offers an enjoyable experience for fans of the genre.
pros: Well-developed characters with unique backstories, especially for a large cast
Catchy and diverse music, with each unit having a distinct sound
Excellent voice acting, with many seiyuu being cast for their singing ability
Visually appealing animation, with effective use of 3D in performance sequences
cons: Lack of a strong overarching plot, with the series feeling more like a slice-of-life than a compelling narrative
Inconsistent pacing and underdeveloped backstories for some characters due to the large cast size and limited episodes
Missed opportunities for spectacular performance scenes, with frequent cutaways and uninspired choreography
The story plays it too safe and becomes boring

anime.title: Kakegurui
anime.genres: Drama, High Stakes Game, Mystery, Psychological, School, Shounen, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Unlike many schools, attending Hyakkaou Private Academy prepares students for their time in the real world. Since many of the students are the children of the richest people in the world, the academy has its quirks that separate it from all the others. By day, it is a normal school, educating its pupils in history, languages, and the like. But at night, it turns into a gambling den, educating them in the art of dealing with money and manipulating people. Money is power; those who come out on top in the games stand at the top of the school.

Yumeko Jabami, a seemingly naive and beautiful transfer student, is ready to try her hand at Hyakkaou's special curriculum. Unlike the rest, she doesn't play to win, but for the thrill of the gamble, and her borderline insane way of gambling might just bring too many new cards to the table.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers find Kakegurui visually stunning and enjoy the thrilling, albeit exaggerated, gambling scenarios. However, many are critical of the repetitive plot, shallow characters, and reliance on shock value over substance, ultimately questioning the show's narrative depth and overall purpose.
pros: Stunning art and animation, particularly facial expressions.
Engaging and unique gambling games.
Excellent voice acting and soundtrack enhances the atmosphere.
cons: Repetitive and predictable plot structure.
Shallow character development and lack of backstory.
Over-reliance on shock value and sexualization.
Inconsistencies and plot holes regarding the school setting and rules.

anime.title: Love and Lies
anime.synopsis:
In a futuristic society, Japan has implemented a complex system referred to as "The Red Threads of Science" to encourage successful marriages and combat increasingly low birthrates. Based on a compatibility calculation, young people at the age of 16 are assigned marriage partners by the government, with severe repercussions awaiting those who disobey the arrangement. For Yukari Nejima, a teen that considers himself average in every way, this system might be his best shot at living a fulfilling life.

However, spurred by his infatuation for his classmate and long-time crush, Misaki Takasaki, Yukari defies the system and confesses his love. After some initial reluctance, Misaki reciprocates his feelings in a moment of passion. Unfortunately, before the two can further their relationship, Yukari receives his marriage notice. He is then thrown into a confusing web of love and lies when his less-than-thrilled assigned partner, Ririna Sanada, becomes fascinated with his illicit romance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative due to poor execution of an interesting premise, resulting in a generic and frustrating romance anime. Common complaints include a weak protagonist, plot inconsistencies, and an unsatisfying ending. While some viewers enjoyed the drama and relatable characters, the majority found the show disappointing and a waste of potential.
pros: Interesting premise with potential for exploring complex themes.
Some viewers found the characters relatable and the drama engaging.
Good soundtrack and voice acting were appreciated by some.
cons: Poorly executed plot with many plotholes and inconsistencies.
Weak and uninteresting main character (Nejima).
Unsatisfying and unresolved ending that feels like an advertisement for the manga.
Generic and predictable love triangle/harem elements.
Shallow exploration of the premise and societal implications.
Inconsistent character development and rushed romantic relationships.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Drama, Societal Critique, Love Triangle

anime.title: Bungo Stray Dogs: Dead Apple
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Detective, Mystery, Organized Crime, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
A large-scale catastrophe is occurring across the planet. Ability users are discovered after the appearance of a mysterious fog, apparently having committed suicide, so the Armed Detective Agency sets out to investigate these mysterious deaths. The case seems to involve an unknown ability user referred to as "Collector," a man who could be the mastermind behind the incident.

Trust and courage are put to the test in order to save the city of Yokohama and ability users across the world from the grip of Collector where the Armed Detective Agency forms an unlikely partnership with the dangerous Port Mafia.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While praised for its animation, music, and initial premise, many found the plot confusing and convoluted, with weak character motivations and excessive fan service. Some fans enjoyed it as a side story, while others considered it a waste of time and a narrative failure.
pros: Stunning animation and visuals, especially in action sequences.
Engaging soundtrack and voice acting.
Interesting premise of ability users fighting their own abilities.
cons: Confusing and convoluted plot with plot holes and weak explanations.
Unnecessary scenes and character regression, particularly Atsushi's anxiety.
Weak villain motivation and unclear character motivations.
Over-reliance on fan service and yaoi pandering.

anime.title: Digimon Adventure tri. Coexistence
anime.synopsis:
Much to the horror of Meiko Mochizuki, her Digimon partner Meicoomon is forced to evolve into Meicrackmon and falls under an evil influence in the process. As Meicrackmon disappears to wreak havoc elsewhere, it seems that the Digital World itself starts to reject the presence of Meiko and the other Chosen Children. While evading various enemies who come after them, the group attempts to find their way back home.

In the human world, a messenger from the mysterious entity Homeostasis visits both Meiko's father and Daigo Nishijima of the Incorporated Administrative Agency to discuss Meicoomon's origins. The messenger informs the two that Homeostasis plans to eliminate the digital monster. By doing so, they hope to prevent further Digimon from materializing in the human realm—regardless of the Chosen Children's feelings on the matter.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, with a significant portion expressing deep disappointment in the writing, pacing, and animation quality. While a minority appreciate certain elements like the music or specific character interactions, the overarching sentiment is that the series fails to deliver on its potential and exploits fan loyalty with a subpar product. The focus on new characters at the expense of established ones and a convoluted plot are major points of contention.
pros: Some praise for the sound design and music.
Animation is generally considered decent, with some exceptions.
The concept of Homeostasis and its plans are intriguing to some.
Specific moments of action and character interaction were enjoyed by a few.
The character development of some of the original Digidestined is appreciated.
cons: Extremely poor pacing, with large portions of repetitive or unnecessary dialogue and still frames.
Weak and convoluted plot, with numerous unresolved plot threads and unanswered questions.
Meiko and Meicoomon are seen as detrimental to the story and character dynamics.
The complete neglect of the Digimon 02 cast is a major point of criticism.
Writing quality is consistently described as poor, with misplaced scenes and illogical character decisions.
Animation is criticized for being subpar and relying too heavily on still frames and dialogue.
The series is perceived as a cash grab, exploiting fan loyalty with a drawn-out, low-quality product.
The ending is considered rushed and unsatisfying by many.

anime.title: Killing Bites
anime.genres: Action, Anthropomorphic, Ecchi, Gore, Sci-Fi, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
After unknowingly participating in a kidnapping, college student Yuuya Nomoto finds his friends brutally murdered by Hitomi Uzaki, the high school girl they attempted to abduct. Forced to drive her to an undisclosed location, he finds himself being wagered as the prize for a death match between two Therianthropes, superpowered human-animal hybrids created through advanced gene therapy. As one of these hybrids, Hitomi uses the speed and fearlessness she gained from her ratel genes to viciously dispatch her foe and save Yuuya from certain death.

Waking up hours later hoping the whole event was only a nightmare, Yuuya realizes that he has become embroiled in a secret proxy war between four large Japanese business conglomerates, with the winner taking control of the economy. As her sole albeit unwilling investor, his life is now directly linked to Hitomi's ability to participate in underground bloodsport matches known only as Killing Bites.
anime.consensus_summary: Killing Bites is a polarizing anime with well-animated fights and engaging action, but is weighed down by a weak plot and excessive fan service. Some find it enjoyable for its violent schlock, while others are turned off by the attempted rape and shallow characters. The ending leaves viewers wanting more, but the overall quality is inconsistent.
pros: Well-animated fights that are interesting and unpredictable.
Music is fitting, with heavy metal tunes and catchy opening/ending themes.
Some characters are well-designed, with fitting personalities and backstories.
cons: Story is unimportant and serves as a framework for action and eroticism.
Excessive fanservice, including attempted rape and aggressive molestation, which can be off-putting.
Shallow character development, with the main male protagonist often being useless.
Mediocre or atrocious character design in some instances

anime.title: Hell Girl: Fourth Twilight
anime.synopsis:
If you have a grudge against someone, you can access the Hell Correspondence website at the stroke of midnight, type in your grudge's name, and the Hell Girl, Ai Enma, will appear to grant your wish. However, the price for ridding yourself of such a burden is a steep one: in return for condemning the soul of your tormentor to Hell, your soul will also face eternal damnation. In her long vigil as the Hell Girl, Ai has met many willing to pay such a cost.

In Jigoku Shoujo: Yoi no Togi, Ai and her enigmatic companions continue to carry out their work, ferrying soul after suffering soul into the depths of Hell. However, as of late, a mysterious girl has been following them. This strange child, unable to even remember her own identity, questions Ai about her duty as the Hell Girl. Who is this girl, and what connection does she have to Ai?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Jigoku Shoujo: Yoi no Togi is largely negative, especially concerning the fourth season. Many feel it's a significant drop in quality compared to previous seasons, citing poor writing, a lack of originality, and reliance on recap episodes. While some appreciate the animation, music, and Ai Enma's consistent character, the overwhelming consensus is that this season is a disappointment and not worth watching.
pros: Ai Enma maintains her strong character.
Animation and OST are great.
The series builds tension well and tells engaging stories (in earlier seasons).
Some found the reasons for revenge justified and the adult involvement refreshing.
cons: Season 4 is a waste of time with poor writing and lack of originality.
Recap episodes are a waste of time.
The horror atmosphere was ruined and turned into an edgy comedy.
Stories were rushed, and the central plot was underdeveloped.
The new character, Michiru, felt unnecessary and underdeveloped.
Inconsistencies and plot holes plague the season.
Characters, especially in the new episodes, are profoundly idiotic and nonsensical.
Recycled content from previous seasons.

anime.title: Love Live! Sunshine!! Season 2
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Having decided to walk down a path separate from their inspirations as idols, the girls of Aqours are more determined than ever to shine brilliantly as school idols. With their previous performance marginally increasing the number of prospective students for their endangered school, they look to carry the momentum of their small step forward into the school's upcoming open house and the next Love Live competition. Hoping to use these events to bring more attention to their school, the nine girls look to give their best performances yet.

Unfortunately, these small steps forward are not enough to convince Mari Ohara's father from changing his plans. Undeterred by Mari's pleas for reconsideration, the decision to close down the school is made official, putting an end to Uranohoshi Girls' High School's student recruitment, including the open house. Though all hope seems to be lost, the school idols refuse to give up. Faced with impossible odds, Aqours sings, dances, and shines in the hopes of bringing about a miracle.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found the second season heartwarming, charming, and a satisfying continuation of Aqours' journey, praising the music and character development. However, others were disappointed, criticizing the repetitive plot, simplistic characters, and lack of originality compared to the original Love Live! series.
pros: Strong character development, especially for previously underdeveloped characters.
Outstanding soundtrack and insert songs.
Improved animation quality, particularly in the 3D dance sequences.
cons: Storyline feels repetitive and similar to the original Love Live! series.
Some find the plot and characters simplistic and one-dimensional.
The second half of the season feels disjointed and lacks clear direction.

anime.title: Marvel Future Avengers
anime.synopsis: The Avengers rescue a trio of children (Makoto, Adi, and Chloe) who were granted superhuman powers from a nefarious experiment by the evil organization, Hydra. The superhero team decides to take the youngsters under their wing, training them to be a new generation of heroes while foiling the schemes of villains.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, acknowledging its appeal to both younger viewers and adults. Critics appreciate the show's surprising elements and MCU influences. While some point out pacing issues and obvious tropes, the consensus is that it's an enjoyable watch, especially for those seeking lighthearted superhero content.
pros: Entertaining for both kids and adults.
Surprising plot twists and intriguing mysteries.
Marvel Cinematic Universe influence in character designs.
Avoids overly simplistic writing often found in children's cartoons.
cons: Inconsistent pacing in some areas.
Targeted primarily at younger audiences.
Obvious tropes.

anime.title: Ninja Girl & Samurai Master 2nd
anime.synopsis:
A skilled, deadly ninja on the clock and an adorable, naïve girl off it, Chidori continues to pave the way forward for her master, Nobunaga Oda, in his conquest of the Land of the Rising Sun.

Though Nobunaga has made great progress in his quest, uniting a nation has not become any easier. Between vindictive former enemies and powerful new rivals, his stubborn adversaries have taken up arms to stamp out the warlord's ambitions. However, standing beside the ambitious general are his many close friends and supporters, including one loyal, capable shinobi. Ready to serve in whatever way she can, Chidori gathers key allies, infiltrates enemy castles, and duels against skilled warriors in the name of realizing her lord's dream: establishing a unified Japan.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Nobunaga no Shinobi offers more of the same blend of comedy and historical events, which pleases returning fans. However, the reliance on repetitive jokes and gags from the first season becomes a notable drawback. While the story progresses and introduces new characters, the humor's repetitiveness is a common point of criticism.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the first season.
Effectively balances comedy with serious historical events.
Introduces new historical characters, adding to the narrative.
cons: Relies on repetitive jokes from the previous season.
Character design is only decent.
Humor becomes repetitive, with Nobunaga's character reduced to a one-note gag.

anime.title: After the Rain
anime.romaji_title: Koi wa Ameagari no You ni
anime.synopsis:
Akira Tachibana, a reserved high school student and former track runner, has not been able to race the same as she used to since she experienced a severe foot injury. And although she is regarded as attractive by her classmates, she is not interested in the boys around school.

While working part-time at the Garden Cafe, Akira begins to develop feelings for the manager—a 45-year-old man named Masami Kondou—despite the large age gap. Kondou shows genuine concern and kindness toward the customers of his restaurant, which, while viewed by others as soft or weak, draws Akira to him. Spending time together at the restaurant, they grow closer, which only strengthens her feelings. Weighed down by these uncertain emotions, Akira finally resolves to confess, but what will be the result?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some viewers praising the anime's beautiful visuals, sensitive handling of complex themes, and character development. Others criticize the slow pace, underdeveloped supporting characters, and lack of a satisfying plot progression, considering the source material. While controversial due to its premise, the anime avoids explicit content, but the premise is not done well.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style, especially the use of rain imagery and detailed backgrounds.
Thoughtful exploration of complex emotions and personal struggles of the main characters.
Sensitive and respectful handling of a potentially controversial age-gap relationship, focusing on emotional depth rather than explicit romance.
Well-developed characters with relatable motivations and flaws.
Excellent music and sound design that enhance the emotional impact of the story.
cons: Slow pacing and lack of significant plot progression.
Underdeveloped or uninteresting supporting characters who detract from the main storyline.
Female lead is bland and unlikeable
Story felt pointless, with no goal
The premise had more potential, it was wasted on awkwardness

anime.title: Kiitarou Shounen no Youkai Enikki: Jonan no Saijitsu
anime.romaji_title: Kiitarou Shounen no Youkai Enikki: Jonan no Saijitsu
anime.synopsis: An unaired episode 13 of Kiitarou Shounen no Youkai Enikki included on the DVD/BD release. Kiitarou runs into typical ecchi manga tropes due to Lucky Eros albeit he doesn't feel "lucky" and tries to avoid everything happening between him and the female youkai.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is a typical fan service episode that was likely unaired due to its content. It maintains the same art and sound quality as the TV series, but the story is minimal. While not explicitly adult, the fan service elements might be considered inappropriate for younger viewers.
pros: Looks like the TV series.
cons: Not much story.
Fan service might be inappropriate.

anime.title: To LOVE-Ru: Multiplication - Mae kara Ushiro kara
anime.romaji_title: To LOVE-Ru: Multiplication - Mae kara Ushiro kara
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
On what would typically be another ordinary day, Lala Satalin Deviluke takes one of her recent inventions—a robotic cat with cloning powers—to school for a chance to show it to Rito Yuuki. Upon accidentally touching the gadget, Rito begins repeatedly duplicating himself, and the school is soon entirely overrun by a horde of his clones.

The only way to deactivate the cat is to hold its tail; however, its agility makes this a challenge. Will Rito's army of himself be able to catch it, or will the Earth be flooded by an unstoppable wave of duplicates?
anime.consensus_summary: Fans of the To Love Ru series generally found this OVA to be an enjoyable, albeit short, continuation of the comedic ecchi formula, appreciating the consistent art and character portrayals. However, a significant portion of the audience felt the plot was pathetic and devolved into excessive, uncomfortable fanservice and depictions of sexual violation, leading to a strong negative reaction regarding the writing and characterizations.
pros: Matches the art style of To Love Ru Darkness OVAs, consistent with the series.
Voice acting is adequate, even with multiple Rito voices.
Characters act consistently with their established personalities, leading to comedic moments.
Artwork is generally good and consistent with the series.
Story is easy to follow despite its simplicity.
cons: The plot is considered pathetic and overly reliant on the premise.
Depicts sexual violation and molestation of female characters by clones.
Overuse of fanservice, particularly 'white panties'.
Voice actors sound too mature for their teenage roles.
The episode is too short.
Rito's character is described as obnoxiously stupid.
Lala's character is perceived as annoying.
Momo's character is seen as having regressed.
The plot is described as 'fucked up' and secondary to the perversion.

anime.title: Take My Brother Away
anime.romaji_title: Ani ni Tsukeru Kusuri wa Nai!
anime.synopsis: Shi Miao simply cannot stand her lazy, stupid, and unreliable elder brother Shi Fen, who is one year above her at the same high school. Though the two siblings can only depend on each other, Shi Miao's violent tendencies combined with Shi Fen's knack for causing trouble cause them to fight constantly. And so, Shi Miao can only hope that someone might take her brother away—even though, when push comes to shove, Shi Fen always tries to do what he believes is best for his cute younger sister.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is generally well-received as a lighthearted comedy about sibling relationships. Viewers appreciate the relatable dynamics and humor, though some find the animation simplistic and the lack of a strong plot a drawback. The series is considered a 'hidden gem' by many, offering a quick and enjoyable viewing experience.
pros: Relatable sibling dynamics without romantic undertones
Good comedic timing and funny character interactions
Enjoyable and short episodes, easy to watch
cons: Simple animation style, may look like flash-animation
Lack of a significant plot
Some find the violence overboard and the brother's character unredeeming
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Sibling Antics

anime.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Mythology, Romance, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Chise Hatori, a 15-year-old Japanese girl, was sold for five million pounds at an auction to a tall masked gentleman. Abandoned at a young age and ridiculed by her peers for her unconventional behavior, she was ready to give herself to any buyer if it meant having a place to go home to. In chains and on her way to an unknown fate, she hears whispers from robed men along her path, gossiping and complaining that such a buyer got his hands on a rare Sleigh Beggy.

Ignoring the murmurs, the mysterious man leads the girl to a study, where he reveals himself to be Elias Ainsworth—a magus. After a brief confrontation and a bit of teleportation magic, the two open their eyes to Elias' picturesque cottage in rural England. Greeted by fairies and surrounded by weird and wonderful beings upon her arrival, these events mark the beginning of Chise's story as the apprentice and supposed bride of the ancient magus.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with praise for its artistry and thematic depth contrasted by criticism of its pacing, character development, and potentially problematic relationship dynamics. Some viewers found the series magical and emotionally resonant, while others were alienated by the slow plot and controversial elements. The high production value is consistently noted, but its impact is debated.
pros: Beautiful visuals and soundtrack create a magical atmosphere.
Explores themes of overcoming emotional damage and finding meaning in life.
Unique blend of genres creates a wholesome and artistic experience.
cons: Slow pacing and lack of subtlety can make the story feel dull.
Characters can be bland and uninteresting, hindering emotional investment.
The relationship between Chise and Elias is problematic due to human trafficking and potential abuse themes.

anime.title: Mr. Osomatsu 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody
anime.synopsis: Second season of Osomatsu-san.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Osomatsu-san 2nd Season is mixed. While some appreciate the continued humor, character development, and upgraded animation, others find the season suffers from joke repetition, inconsistent quality, and excessive vulgar humor. This leads to a feeling that the second season doesn't quite capture the magic of the first.
pros: Continued creativity in stories and gags.
More character development, especially for characters like Karamatsu.
Improved animation quality.
Professional voice acting that enhances the comedy.
Enjoyable opening and ending themes.
cons: Overuse of jokes leads to diminishing returns.
Shift to longer, episode-length scenarios makes flaws in writing more evident.
Inconsistent quality compared to the first season, with some gags being considered the 'worst'.
Excessive or uncomfortable sex/scat humor in early episodes.
Loss of the 'essence' from the first season.

anime.title: The World YAMIZUKAN
anime.synopsis:
Tucked away in the darkest depths of this world, tales of the bizarre and the supernatural quietly unfold. These inexplicable stories are chronicled throughout the pages of a certain strange encyclopedia, sheltered within a crumbling, decrepit building. Do you dare to open its cover and experience the horrors firsthand?

Each of the macabre tales held within the book's pages details some unusual, surreal experiences that often come to a gruesome end. A man searches for his adulterous wife, only to find himself at the mercy of otherworldly visitors; a boy befriends a snowman who harbors a sinister secret; crop circles suddenly form on a family farm, created by some unexpected visitors; hidden in plain sight, menacing mechanical beings continue on undetected. In all of these horrifying stories, nothing is as simple as it seems, revealing a terrifying darkness that perhaps might have been best left alone.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the anime's retro horror style and short, digestible format, while others are turned off by the limited animation, predictable stories, and lack of genuine scares. Many feel it succeeds in evoking a specific era of pulp horror, but falls short as a compelling modern horror anime. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on expectations and appreciation for campy, informative horror rather than intense thrills.
pros: Unique art style that varies episode to episode
Short episode length makes it easy to binge
Stories are reminiscent of old horror flicks and folk tales
Effective at creating a retro horror atmosphere
cons: Stories are often predictable and hokey
Animation is limited and often relies on slideshow-style presentation
Voice acting can be subpar
Not particularly scary or thrilling for those seeking intense horror
Inconsistent quality across episodes

anime.title: Overlord II
anime.synopsis:
Ainz Ooal Gown, the undead sorcerer formerly known as Momonga, has accepted his place in this new world. Though it bears similarities to his beloved virtual reality game Yggdrasil, it still holds many mysteries which he intends to uncover, by utilizing his power as ruler of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. However, ever since the disastrous brainwashing of one of his subordinates, Ainz has become wary of the impending dangers of the Slane Theocracy, as well as the possible existence of other former Yggdrasil players. Meanwhile, Albedo, Demiurge and the rest of Ainz's loyal guardians set out to prepare for the next step in their campaign: Nazarick's first war…

Overlord II picks up immediately after its prequel, continuing the story of Ainz Ooal Gown, his eclectic army of human-hating guardians, and the many hapless humans affected by the Overlord's arrival.
anime.consensus_summary: Overlord II receives mixed reviews, with some praising its world-building and character development of side characters, while others criticize its pacing and focus on less compelling characters. The season's slower start and deviation from the main character, Ainz, are points of contention. Overall, the audience is divided on whether Overlord II lives up to the standards set by the first season.
pros: World-building and character development of side characters are well-received.
Ainz's complex role as overlord and salaryman is compelling.
The series offers a unique perspective within the Isekai genre.
cons: Pacing issues, especially in the early arcs, can make the season feel slow.
Focus on less interesting characters (e.g., Climb and Tuare) detracts from the overall enjoyment.
Some viewers find the story generic and lacking depth.

anime.title: Hozuki's Coolheadedness 2
anime.synopsis: Just as in this life, the afterlife needs a calm troubleshooter to deal with the bureaucratic headaches that come from keeping things in order. Enter Hozuki: a cool and collected demon who’s badly in need of a vacation.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is generally liked for its relaxing nature, comedic take on mythology, and unique art style. However, some viewers found the plot uneventful and felt that the animation quality wasn't as consistent. Overall, the show is well-received as a lighthearted introduction to Japanese folklore and mythology.
pros: Relaxing and enjoyable
Teaches about mythology in a funny way
Unique art style combining traditional and modern elements
Faithful to the original folktales and mythical stories
Introduces various mythologies beyond Japanese folklore
cons: Uneventful at times, story feels prolonged
Retelling of character pasts lacks punch
Noticeable cost-cutting in animation
3D graphics occasionally noticeable
anime.thematic_vibe: Japanese Mythology, Comedy, Slice of Life

anime.title: Juni Taisen: Zodiac War
anime.genres: Action, Gore, High Stakes Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Every 12 years, mercenaries who possess the highest caliber of brute strength, cunning wit, and deadly precision gather to participate in the Zodiac Tournament. Each warrior bears the name and attributes of one of the 12 animals of the Chinese zodiac. With their pride and lives on the line, they engage in vicious combat until only the victor remains.

The 12th Zodiac Tournament begins in a desolate city, devoid of any evidence of the half million people who recently lived there. To raise the stakes, each warrior ingests a poisonous gem, thus setting a time limit on the tournament—and on their life. With one wish for the victor up for grabs, the Zodiac Warriors start their cutthroat battle for survival.
anime.consensus_summary: Juuni Taisen receives mixed reviews. While appreciated for its unique premise, character designs, and occasional fight scenes, the show is heavily criticized for its predictable plot, overuse of flashbacks, and inconsistent animation. Many feel the show had potential but failed to fully capitalize on it, resulting in a disappointing experience for some viewers. Ultimately, audience enjoyment hinges on overlooking these flaws and embracing the show's darker elements.
pros: Diverse and interesting character designs, making them visually appealing and fun to watch.
Well-choreographed fight scenes with fluid action and attention to detail in character designs.
Intriguing premise blending action, strategy, and character exploration.
cons: Predictable plot and character deaths due to the show's adherence to the Chinese Zodiac order.
Overuse of long flashbacks that take up too much screen time and hinder character development.
Inconsistent animation quality, with some episodes having wonky art and sluggish animation.

anime.title: Mitsuboshi Colors
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Residing within Tokyo's district of Ueno are the Colors, three individuals who protect their city by performing good deeds and aiding their community. Or, at the very least, they pretend to be the city's defenders. In reality, the Colors are just three young girls: the shy Yui Akamatsu, the noisy Sacchan, and the video game-loving Kotoha, who spend their time playing make-believe and exploring the city. The Colors' activities are facilitated by the grandfatherly Daigorou "Pops" Kujiraoka, who uses his store's inventory of knick-knacks to entertain the rambunctious trio.

Not everyone is a fan of the Colors though. The local policeman Saitou just wants to deal with his regular duties, but he often finds himself the target of the Colors' attention, having been made the villain in most of their fantasies. But despite his personal feelings, Saitou always finds the time to go along with the three girls' games. Even though the Colors do not actually defend Ueno, they definitely help brighten everyone's day.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views Mitsuboshi Colors as a heartwarming and enjoyable series that effectively captures the essence of childhood innocence and fun. While some find the plot simplistic and the animation lacking, most appreciate the characters' charm and the show's ability to evoke nostalgic feelings. It's a lighthearted comedy best suited for those seeking a relaxing and feel-good experience.
pros: Accurately portrays the behavior and mindset of young children.
The characters are charismatic and cheerful, with great chemistry.
A feel-good anime that relieves stress and invokes childhood nostalgia.
cons: Story is simple and episodic, offering little depth or development.
Animation quality is inconsistent and lacks budget in some scenes.
Humor can be repetitive and rely on childish gags that may not appeal to everyone.

anime.title: Kino's Journey -the Beautiful World- the Animated Series
anime.romaji_title: Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World - The Animated Series
anime.synopsis:
When 15-year-old Kino is feeling weighed down by heavy thoughts, one thing always manages to cheer her up: traveling. Nothing fills her heart with joy like exploring the beautiful, wonderful world around her and the fascinating ways people find to live. However, Kino is not as helpless as her cute appearance and courteous demeanor suggest. Armed with "Cannon" and "Woodsman," her trusted handguns, Kino is not afraid to kill anyone who would dare to get in her way. Always by her side is her best friend and loyal companion Hermes, a sentient motorcycle, who supports Kino through the sorrows and hardships of their journey. Together, they travel the vast countryside with the shared goal of always moving forward, and a single rule: never stay in one country for more than three days.

As Kino and Hermes encounter new people and learn the rules of their civilizations, they grow and find out more about their own values and virtues. But as Kino slowly discovers the world around her, she also finds herself facing dangers that linger within the vast unknown.
anime.consensus_summary: The 2017 remake of Kino's Journey is highly divisive, with many viewers comparing it unfavorably to the original 2003 series. While some appreciate the updated visuals and episodic storytelling, many criticize it for lacking depth, subtlety, and the philosophical richness of its predecessor. The remake is seen by some as a hollow imitation that fails to capture the essence of Kino's journey.
pros: The series explores unique ideologies and cultures through the eyes of a neutral traveler.
Some episodes leave a good impression and explore a variety of themes and morals.
The improved animation and scenery in the remake are captivating.
cons: The remake lacks the subtlety and nuances of the original, with more blatant moral explorations.
Some stories feel rushed, reducing the impact of the visited country's true side being revealed.
The characters feel emptied, and episodes rely on uninteresting plot twists.
The remake is a disappointment and lacks the magic of the original.

anime.title: Sound! Euphonium the Movie: May the Melody Reach You!
anime.synopsis:
Following their success in the qualifying round for the Kansai regional competition, the members of the Kitauji High School concert band set their sights on the next upcoming performance. Utilizing their summer break to the utmost, the band participates in a camp where they are instructed by their band advisor Noboru Taki and his friends who make their living as professional musicians.

Kumiko Oumae and her friends remain determined to attain gold at the Kansai competition, but trouble arises when a student who once quit the band shows interest in rejoining and sparks unpleasant memories for the second-year members. Kumiko also learns about her teacher's surprising past and the motivation behind his desire to lead the band to victory. Reaching nationals will require hard work, and the adamant conviction in each student's commitment to the band will be put to the test.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a decent recap of the series but cuts too much content to stand on its own. Fans of the series may appreciate it, but it's not recommended as a substitute for watching the original anime. The musical aspects are well-represented, but the overall experience is diminished by the omitted plotlines.
pros: Solid movie in itself, coherent story.
Appreciable representation of marching band/wind ensemble experience.
Visually and aurally similar to the original series.
cons: Plot lines cut, reduced content compared to the series.
Offers little over the original show.
Not a replacement for the series; content and characters are missed.
New content is difficult to identify and appreciate.

anime.title: Haikyu!! The Movie: Talent and Sense
anime.synopsis:
Following the events of the Inter-High, the Karasuno High School volleyball team decides to regroup by attending an intensive boot camp organized by Nekoma High School in Tokyo. At the camp, the team continues to suffer loss upon loss to the other schools in attendance. Reaching an impasse, the players each struggle to break out of their routine to hone their skills. 

For the team's setter-and-ace duo Shouyou Hinata and Tobio Kageyama, the frustrations cause them to falter more than anyone else. While Hinata develops his own playstyle, his recklessness leads him to fall out of sync with Kageyama's sets and earns his partner's ire instead. As they search for an answer to their woes, the two find what they are lacking from two unlikely people. Will it be enough for the team to overcome their rut?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the additional scenes that provide closure for the rival team, Seijoh. However, the recap format is criticized for skipping details and showing only clips of previous scenes, resulting in a less detailed art style. Overall, it's considered a decent recap for those wanting to revisit the main plot points.
pros: Additional scenes focusing on Seijoh and their emotional state after the match provide a proper closure.
Recaps the major points of the second season efficiently.
Highlights the close bond between Oikawa and Iwaizumi.
cons: Recap format misses many matches and only shows clips of previous scenes, skipping details.
The art style is slightly less detailed and reuses some scenes, feeling a little lazy at times.

anime.title: Haikyu!! The Movie: Battle of Concepts
anime.synopsis:
The long-awaited finals of the Spring Tournament have arrived for Karasuno High School's volleyball team. The winner of the match will go on to represent all of Miyagi Prefecture at the National Tournament. However, the last challenge Karasuno must overcome is to win against Shiratorizawa Academy, the school that houses Wakatoshi Ushijima, one of Japan's top three aces. Shiratorizawa is the reigning Miyagi champion for the past three years, and Karasuno seems to have little chance at dethroning them. 

When the other school's captain Ushijima insults Karasuno to their faces, freshmen duo Shouyou Hinata and Tobio Kageyama swear to defeat them and steal their spot in the nationals. Against a roster full of nationally-ranked players, the former flightless crows will have to use everything in their arsenal if they want to represent Miyagi.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is well-received as a recap of the Karasuno vs. Shiratorizawa match. Viewers appreciate the additional scenes focusing on Shiratorizawa and the consistent quality of animation and sound. It serves as a good way to revisit key moments from the third season, though it offers nothing new to the existing storyline.
pros: Additional scenes from Shiratorizawa's perspective enhance the story.
The recap movie format effectively captures the essence of the third season.
High-quality art and sound design maintain the series' standard.
cons: It's a recap, so it doesn't offer new story content for those familiar with the series.
Some may find the recap format less engaging than the original season.

anime.title: Lights of the Clione
anime.synopsis: The story centers around an illness-stricken, constantly bullied orphan girl named Minori. After one rainy day, she doesn't turn up at school, having been admitted into a hospital in a distant town. Two months pass, and the girl's two school friends, Takashi and Kyouko, receive a mysterious email with no sender listed. The email reveals a summer festival taking place at a nearby town...
anime.consensus_summary: Clione no Akari is largely viewed as a poorly executed and unoriginal anime. While some appreciate its attempt to address bullying and find some merit in its art and music, the overwhelming consensus is that the story is clichéd, the characters are underdeveloped, and the animation is subpar. Many feel the short episode length prevents any meaningful emotional investment or plot progression, leading to a generally negative reception.
pros: Some appreciate the focus on bullying and its effects.
The art style is considered nice and soft by some, especially the lighting in certain scenes.
The opening and ending themes are praised for complementing the show's mood.
cons: The story is considered clichéd and unoriginal.
The characters are often seen as bland, one-dimensional, and poorly developed.
The animation quality is inconsistent, with wonky character designs and reused animations.
The short episode length hinders plot development and emotional impact.
The ending feels rushed and unsatisfying.

anime.title: Devilman: Crybaby
anime.genres: Action, Avant Garde, Gore, Horror, Mythology, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Devils cannot take form without a living host. However, if the will of an individual is strong enough, they can overcome the demon and make its power their own, becoming a Devilman.

Weak and unassuming, Akira Fudou has always had a bleeding heart. So when his childhood friend Ryou Asuka asks for his help in uncovering devils, Akira accepts without hesitation. However, to Akira's surprise, the place they go to is Sabbath: an immoral party of debauchery and degeneracy. Amidst bloodshed and death, demons possess the partiers, turning their bodies into grotesque monsters, and begin wreaking havoc. In a reckless attempt to save his best friend, Akira unwittingly merges with the devil Amon and becomes a Devilman, gaining the power to defeat the remaining demons.

Though it grants him great power, this new partnership awakens an insatiable and primeval part of Akira. Having the body of a devil but the same crybaby heart, Akira works alongside Ryou, destroying those that harm humanity and his loved ones.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is significantly divided. Some praise the anime for its faithfulness to the original manga, its unique art style, and thought-provoking themes. Others criticize it for its rushed story, excessive use of sex and gore, and inconsistent character development, with some feeling the art style detracts from the experience.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga's core story and themes
Unique and visually striking art style (for some)
Remarkable OST
Exploration of humanity and morality
cons: Rushed and weak story
Over-reliance on sex and gore
Inconsistent character development
Unnecessary English dialogue
Questionable art style (for some)

anime.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Something
anime.synopsis: Specials included with the BD/DVD release of Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys these short specials as a lighthearted addition to the main series, providing more of the characters they love in amusing situations. While not essential viewing, fans appreciate the quick, comedic content. The reliance on established character traits may be a drawback for some, but the overall sentiment is positive for those seeking more Dragon Maid.
pros: More content featuring beloved characters.
Quick and easy to watch, ideal for short entertainment.
Humorous situations and character-focused comedy.
cons: Some scenarios may not appeal to all viewers.
Relies heavily on character stereotypes.
Not essential to the main story.

anime.title: March Comes In Like a Lion 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
Now in his second year of high school, Rei Kiriyama continues pushing through his struggles in the professional shogi world as well as his personal life. Surrounded by vibrant personalities at the shogi hall, the school club, and in the local community, his solitary shell slowly begins to crack. Among them are the three Kawamoto sisters—Akari, Hinata, and Momo—who forge an affectionate and familial bond with Rei. Through these ties, he realizes that everyone is burdened by their own emotional hardships and begins learning how to rely on others while supporting them in return. 

Nonetheless, the life of a professional is not easy. Between tournaments, championships, and title matches, the pressure mounts as Rei advances through the ranks and encounters incredibly skilled opponents. As he manages his relationships with those who have grown close to him, the shogi player continues to search for the reason he plays the game that defines his career.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of 3-gatsu no Lion is largely praised for its emotional depth, character development, and artistic presentation. While some viewers find the pacing slow or feel that certain plot points are neglected, the overall consensus is that it's a powerful and moving anime. The show excels at exploring themes of depression, bullying, and personal growth, resonating deeply with many viewers.
pros: Strong emotional impact and exploration of complex themes.
Masterful storytelling with nuanced character development.
Beautiful art style and fitting music enhance emotional scenes.
cons: Pacing can feel slow at times.
Some plot threads from season 1 are not fully resolved.
Over-reliance on side characters in season 2 may detract from the main character's journey.

anime.title: Gurazeni: Money Pitch
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Seinen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: This is the story of Natsunosuke Honda, a pro baseball player—a relief pitcher who has been playing pro in a team called Spiders for 8 years. The team operates as a highly-stratified society, where the player's performance determines his annual salary. Natsunosuke is one of the highest paid players in the game. He measures how good players are by how much money they make, and he intends to be on top and stay there, and as such is always looking for players to challenge and does everything to insure that he is better than they are.
anime.consensus_summary: Gurazeni offers a refreshing, realistic look at professional baseball, focusing on the financial and personal struggles of players rather than dramatic victories. While praised for its unique premise and relatable characters, the show is criticized for its mediocre animation, episodic format, and slow pacing, which may not appeal to all viewers. Overall, it's a niche sports anime appreciated for its grounded approach.
pros: Unique take on sports anime, focusing on the business and livelihood aspects of professional baseball.
Realistic portrayal of characters and their struggles, avoiding typical sports anime tropes.
Interesting exploration of the lives of fringe players and the challenges they face.
Informative about the Nippon Professional League and its nuances.
cons: Mediocre animation quality, especially the use of CGI during pitching scenes.
Episodic nature can lead to fragmented storytelling and lack of overall plot progression.
Some find the show slow-paced and potentially boring.
Female lead introduced late and underdeveloped.

anime.title: Free! The Movie -Timeless Medley- the Promise
anime.synopsis: Rin Matsuoka’s childhood friend, Sousuke Yamazaki, has recently transferred to Samezuka Academy. Upon their reunion, the two reminisce about their childhood days and reaffirm their wish to swim together. Now with Rin, Sousuke, Captain Mikoshiba’s younger brother Momotarou Mikoshiba, and hard-working Aiichirou Nitori, the Samezuka relay team is formed, and their friendship deepens. However, as tournaments, races, and training go on, the reason for Sousuke’s sudden return begins to trouble him and affect his swimming. Noticing Sousuke’s change, Rin pushes to uncover what is holding him back.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, particularly among Rin fans. The movie's focus on Rin's backstory and the Samezuka team, coupled with new scenes that add depth to the narrative, is well-received. While some find the movie skippable due to its compilation nature, the added content and fresh perspective make it a worthwhile watch for many.
pros: New Style Five music.
Good art and story.
Focuses on Rin and the Samezuka swim team.
Added scenes provide more insight into Rin's past and motivations.
Foreshadowing and closure that the 2nd season lacked.
cons: Compilation of Free!: Eternal Summer.
Some scenes are skippable for those familiar with the anime.

anime.title: Free! Take Your Marks
anime.synopsis:
Taking place between the events of Free!: Eternal Summer and Free!: Dive to the Future, Free!: Take Your Marks plays out the graduated seniors' last summer through four different stories before they set sail for the future.

Unmei no Choice! (Destined Choice!) follows Haruka Nanase and Makoto Tachibana searching for a new apartment for Haruka as he settles into Tokyo. 

Hitou no Cooling Down! (Cooling Down at the Secret Hot Spring!) sees Aiichiro Nitori choose a graduation gift for Rin Matsuoka and Sousuke Yamazaki, while Momotaro Mikoshiba wins tickets to the Anago Hot Springs. Hoping for a trip together, Aiichiro and Momotaro invite Rin and Sousuke. 

Kessoku no Batafurai! (United Butterfly!) shows Rei Ryugazaki, Nagisa Hazuki, and Gou Matsuoka creating a recruitment video to attract new club members for the next school year. 

Tabidachi no Etanaru Buru! (Departing Eternal Blue!) looks into the Iwatobi and Samezuka swim teams' plans for Rin's surprise going-away party, as he will be departing for Australia soon.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Free! Take Your Marks' as a fun and heartwarming interlude between seasons, focusing on character interactions and setting up future storylines. Some find the plotlines uninteresting and the film's purpose primarily promotional, but the overall sentiment is positive, especially among fans of the series. The movie is appreciated for its humor and exploration of friendships.
pros: Character growth and development
Humorous and entertaining
Nice lead-in to the next season
Explores characters' pasts and motivations
cons: Stories are not particularly interesting
Movie feels like a lead-in to the next season
Lacks a specific plot

anime.title: In Another World With My Smartphone
anime.romaji_title: Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Romance
anime.synopsis:
In a thoughtless blunder, God accidentally strikes down Touya Mochizuki with a stray bolt of lightning! As an apology, God offers him one wish and the chance to live again in a magical fantasy world. Touya happily accepts the offer and, for his one wish, asks only to keep his smartphone with him as he begins his journey into this mysterious world.

Starting over in this new world, Touya finds it is filled with magic—which he has an affinity for—and cute girls vying for his attention. These girls—the twins Linze and Elze Silhoueska, Yumina Urnea Belfast, Leen, and Yae Kokonoe—provide Touya with no end of romantic frustrations, but also companionship as he discovers the secrets of this new world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely critical of 'Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.', citing its generic plot, uninspired characters, and mediocre production values. Some viewers find enjoyment in its comedic aspects or as a lighthearted isekai, but the prevailing sentiment is disappointment due to its failure to innovate or provide a compelling narrative. The show is seen as a prime example of wish-fulfillment isekai that lacks depth and originality.
pros: Enjoyable for viewers who like Isekai and are not anime snobs
Some found it to be a good ironic parody of terrible anime cliches
The show excels on what it intended to do, i.e. entertainment, humor, and sending a message.
cons: Generic and unoriginal isekai tropes
Weak character development and shallow personalities
Mediocre art and animation quality
Overpowered main character with no real struggles
Lack of tension or drama due to the MC's overpowered abilities
Poor use of the smartphone concept

anime.title: The King of Fighters: Destiny
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: CG anime adaptation of The King of Fighters fighting game franchise.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience found the show to be a lighthearted and comedic adaptation of the King of Fighters franchise. While the story may be cliche, viewers appreciated the silly and entertaining moments. The show seems to have resonated positively, particularly with those who enjoy lighthearted action.
pros: Lighthearted and funny
Silly and entertaining moments
cons: Cliche story

anime.title: Man Tou Riji
anime.synopsis: Sweet and innocent orphan Man Tou, while optimistic and tough in his own way, often feels lonely deep inside. Without the care of parents, he longs for love more than anyone else. Being ridiculed and bullied by others as the parentless child, he longs for a genuine friendship that is yet to come. Though uncertain where his future lies, Man Tou has faith that keeps on working hard and never stops giving love will find him that place he can call home.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is overwhelmingly positive about 'Man Tou Riji'.  Viewers find the show emotionally resonant and heartwarming, praising its effective storytelling despite the short episodes. The unique art style and strong voice acting are also highlighted as contributing to the show's overall appeal.
pros: Compelling storytelling despite short episode length
Emotional impact: heartwarming and deeply sad
Good characters, especially Man Tou
Unique and cute art style enhancing emotional storytelling
Good voice acting, pleasant and accessible

anime.title: Elegant Yokai Apartment Life
anime.romaji_title: Youkai Apartment no Yuuga na Nichijou
anime.genres: Mythology, School, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Inaba Yuushi's parents died in his first year of middle school, and he moved in with his relatives. Though they did care for him, he could tell he was a burden. After he graduated, he happily prepared to move to a high school with a dormitory. Unfortunately, the dormitory burned to the ground before he could move in! Yuushi doesn't want to live with his grudging relatives, but it's rough finding lodging as an orphaned student with little money. He finally finds a room in a nice old building which seems too good to be true.

The catch is that it is a Monster House, a place where humans and supernatural creatures—ghosts, mononoke, etc.—live together. Another high schooler lives there, a cute girl named Akine, and she's completely unfazed by the monsters. In fact, she can even exorcise evil spirits! Yuushi's high school life just got much stranger than he ever bargained for!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found 'Youkai Apartment' to be a relaxing and enjoyable slice-of-life anime with heartwarming characters and a unique premise. However, others criticized its unfocused plot, weak character development, and a disappointing shift away from the supernatural elements, leading to a sense of wasted potential.
pros: Relaxing and easy to watch with comedic elements.
Enjoyable characters with a family-like dynamic in the apartment.
Some found the series to be refreshing, especially the early episodes and character chemistry.
cons: Incoherent plot with a lack of focus on the youkai, despite the title.
Weak character development and unmemorable side characters.
Repetitive story structure and forced life lessons.
Second half deviates from the supernatural elements, focusing on less interesting school life.
Pacing issues with tedious filler and lack of emotional resonance.

anime.title: School Babysitters
anime.genres: Childcare, Iyashikei, School, Shoujo, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
After losing both parents in a fatal plane crash, teenager Ryuuichi Kashima must adjust to his new life as the guardian of his younger brother Kotarou. Although Ryuuichi is able to maintain a friendly and kindhearted demeanor, Kotarou is a reserved toddler still too young to understand the reality of the situation. At their parents' funeral, they are approached by Youko Morinomiya, the stern chairman of an elite academy, who decides to take them under her care.
 
However, there is one condition Ryuuichi must fulfill in exchange for a roof over their heads and enrolment in the school—he must become the school's babysitter.
