In an effort to support the female teachers at the academy, a babysitter's club was established to look after their infant children; unfortunately, the club is severely short-staffed, so now not only is Ryuuichi responsible for his little brother, but also a handful of toddlers who possess dynamic personalities.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Gakuen Babysitters is well-received as a heartwarming and wholesome anime that provides a comforting viewing experience. The audience generally appreciates its focus on family, responsibility, and the endearing portrayal of children. While some find the story and characters clichéd, the majority find it to be a delightful and uplifting series.
pros: Accurate portrayal of toddler behavior and Japanese daycare setting.
Refreshing take on the slice of life genre with a focus on responsibility and caretaking.
Endearing characters with unique personalities.
A mix of cute, funny, and emotional moments that warm the heart.
cons: Story can be clichéd and predictable.
Some episodes feel disjointed and lack connection.
Character designs can be too similar.
Superficial and cutesy without real substance for some viewers.
Soundtrack is unremarkable.

anime.title: Haikara-san: Here Comes Miss Modern Part 2
anime.romaji_title: Haikara-san ga Tooru Movie 2: Hana no Tokyo Dai Roman
anime.synopsis: In turn of the 20th Century Japan, a period characterized by widespread innovation and social restructuring, Benio Hanamura endeavors to take modernization to new heights. With a tomboy nature, Benio rails against traditional ideas that women should take care of the home—serving their husbands rather than pursuing their own dreams. Her values as a modern woman come under fire as the one man who supports her independence, Lieutenant Shinobu Ijuin, goes missing in action. Resurfacing back in Japan, Shinobu has lost all memory of his true identity. In this stunning sequel, will Benio be able to reconnect with Shinobu before she is married off to a new man?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the film's adherence to romantic tropes and character development, many find the plot predictable, the pacing slow, and the characters' actions frustrating. The passivity of the main love interest and the use of death as a plot device are major points of criticism, leading to a sense of a 'cheap' or unearned ending for some viewers.
pros: Well-balanced portrayal of Benio's personality and struggles.
Faithful to classical love story tropes.
Initially engaging plot and proactive protagonist.
cons: Predictable plot developments.
Slow pacing in the middle portion.
Passive behavior of the main love interest (Shinobu).
Inconvenient plot advancement through death.
Character agency is diminished.

anime.title: Princess Principal
anime.synopsis:
In the early 20th century, the discovery of the substance Cavorite allowed the production of advanced military technology and steered the country toward conflict. London is now divided by a wall, and the Kingdom and the Commonwealth of Albion battle a silent war where espionage is the only weapon that can destabilize the enemy. A group of girls from the prestigious Queen's Mayfaire school work as undercover spies for the Commonwealth.  

Led by Dorothy, an experienced driver with a striking personality, their group includes the talents of Ange le Carré, a cold-blooded liar and expert sharpshooter; Chise, a proficient samurai; and Beatrice, a voice-mimicking specialist. They use their unique individual skills for the Commonwealth to survive in a dark world filled with conspiracy, mystery, and infiltration. In the shadow of the war, they have only one goal in mind: completing their mission.
anime.consensus_summary: Princess Principal is a unique anime that blends cute girls with a serious spy thriller setting. While praised for its creative plot, interesting characters, and thrilling action, some viewers found the non-chronological storytelling confusing and the episodic nature lacking a strong overarching plot. Despite mixed opinions, the anime is considered an underrated gem with a distinct steampunk aesthetic.
pros: Creative plot with impressive storytelling.
Unusual premise that blends cute girls with serious spy thriller elements.
Interesting characters with distinct personalities.
Action-packed with thrilling moments.
Unique non-linear story structure that adds intrigue.
cons: Non-chronological order of episodes can be confusing.
Episodic nature may lack a strong overarching plot.
Combination of moe elements and mature themes may not appeal to all viewers.
Some found the show disappointing, feeling it didn't fully utilize its potential.
Story can be muddled at times.

anime.title: Konohana Kitan
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, CGDCT, Fantasy, Girls Love, Iyashikei, Mythology, Seinen, Slice of Life, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
In a bustling village of spirits, Yuzu, a cheerful fox girl, starts her first job as an attendant at the traditional hot springs inn Konohanatei. Though Yuzu has no experience working at such a high-class establishment, Kiri, the affable and reliable head attendant, immediately puts her to work learning the basics.

While Yuzu's eagerness initially proves to be more of a hindrance than a blessing, her playful nature brings a unique charm to the inn, as both customers and her fellow workers quickly warm up to her clumsy yet well-meaning mistakes. Under the guidance of the other foxes—the rigid Satsuki, the carefree Natsume, the critical Ren, and the quiet Sakura—Yuzu steadily learns the trade of an inn attendant while learning to love the magical world surrounding her.

Konohana Kitan presents the heartwarming tale of a simple fox girl forging bonds with others and finding a home amidst the mysterious, beautiful world of spirits.
anime.consensus_summary: Konohana Kitan is a well-received, heartwarming slice-of-life anime celebrated for its charming atmosphere, cute characters, and incorporation of Japanese folklore. While some find the plot simplistic, the emotional depth and beautiful art style contribute to a relaxing and enjoyable viewing experience. The anime is considered a hidden gem, particularly for fans of the genre.
pros: Charming and relaxing atmosphere
Well-developed characters with distinct personalities
Beautiful art style and animation
Excellent blend of cute moments with emotional depth
Interesting incorporation of Japanese mythology
Addresses themes of finding home and forming bonds
cons: Story can be predictable and simple
Some may find the 'cute girls doing cute things' trope repetitive
Light shoujo-ai elements may not appeal to all viewers
Opening and ending themes might not be favored by everyone
anime.thematic_vibe: Heartwarming, Slice of Life, Japanese Folklore

anime.title: Owarimonogatari Second Season
anime.synopsis:
Following an encounter with oddity specialist Izuko Gaen, third-year high school student Koyomi Araragi wakes up in a strange, deserted void only to be greeted by a joyfully familiar face in an alarmingly unfamiliar place.  

Araragi, with the help of his girlfriend Hitagi Senjougahara, maneuvers through the webs of his past and the perplexities of the present in search of answers. However, fate once again delivers him to the eccentric transfer student Ougi Oshino, who brings forth an unexpected proposal that may unearth the very foundation to which he is anchored. As Araragi peels back the layers of mystery surrounding an apparition, he discovers a truth not meant to be revealed.
anime.consensus_summary: Owarimonogatari 2nd Season is largely praised as a worthy conclusion to the Monogatari series, celebrated for its character development and satisfying resolutions. However, some find the verbose dialogue and pacing issues to be drawbacks, while others criticize the fan service elements. Overall, the audience sentiment leans towards positive, appreciating the series' unique storytelling and artistic style.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to the main storyline.
Excellent character development and relationship building.
Visually stunning and creative animation style.
Great soundtracks and voice acting.
cons: Overly verbose dialogue and exposition.
Pacing issues with excessive talking and limited action.
Potential for fan service to detract from the narrative.
Some may find the plot convoluted and hard to follow without prior knowledge of the series.

anime.title: 18if
anime.synopsis:
Waking up in a strange bedroom in a dream world, teenager Haruto Tsukishiro finds a strange app on his phone. When he activates the program, an odd woman appears and tries to drag him to her realm. Luckily, a mysterious, white-haired girl severs their connection and helps him escape, revealing that the woman is a witch; however, their conversation is cut short. As Haruto enters the realm again, he meets an anthropomorphic, talking cat named Katsumi Kanzaki. While the witch's minions pursue them, the white-haired girl opens a door for them to escape.

After their ordeal, Haruto describes their savior—which only he can see—and Katsumi, the leading authority on dream world research, realizes that she must be "Lily," a being that resurfaces repeatedly across multiple dreamscapes. Hoping to leave the dream world through a blue door, they enter the witch's realm once again. Finding themselves in peril, Lily reveals the truth to Haruto: witches suffer from "Sleeping Beauty Syndrome," a coma-like sleep state induced by torment in their real world lives. Thus, they cannot wake until they are defeated in the dream world.

After finally defeating the witch and locating the blue door, Haruto and Katsumi say their farewells, promising to meet up in the real world. However, when Haruto exits through the door, he awakens in the dream world bedroom once more. Seeking answers, Haruto and Katsumi try to uncover the mysteries of the witches, Lily, and Haruto's own inability to leave the dream world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, praising the show's creative art styles, music, and unique episodic format, but criticizing its inconsistent animation, confusing plot, and lack of character development. Many find the series disjointed, with high and low points throughout its run. While some appreciate its attempt at philosophical and psychological themes, others find it falls short of its potential.
pros: Unique episodic format with different directors per episode creates varied and interesting stories.
Strong and fitting soundtracks, especially the opening and varying ending themes.
Creative art styles that match the dreamlike nature of the show, with some episodes being visually stunning.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with some episodes suffering from noticeable flaws.
Episodic nature leads to a disjointed plot and lack of character development until the final episodes.
Confusing and sometimes nonsensical plot that can be difficult to follow, especially with the varying episode quality.

anime.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby
anime.synopsis:
Famous racehorses that have left behind worthy legacies, unique as they can be, are reincarnated as horse girls in a parallel world. In this life, they start their journey anew as they continue to race and perhaps relive the success they once lived through.

Aspiring to become the best racehorse in Japan, a horse girl named Special Week moves to Tokyo to enroll in the Tracen Academy—an institution that nurtures horse girls like her to become better racers. There, Special Week witnesses the sophisticated running style of Silence Suzuka and is inspired to become a racer like her. Shortly after, Special Week finds herself recruited into Silence Suzuka's team, Spica. From there, she begins her path to the top—one lap at a time.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Uma Musume: Pretty Derby is a surprisingly enjoyable anime that combines sports and idol themes. While the premise is unconventional, the series is praised for its heartwarming story, well-developed characters based on real-life racehorses, and exciting races. Some viewers find the concept strange or the plot lacking, but it generally exceeded expectations.
pros: Characters are based on real racehorses, adding depth and interest.
The series is heartwarming with themes of friendship and achieving goals.
Well-animated races and exciting moments
cons: The premise of horse girls racing and becoming idols can be off-putting or seem weird.
Some found the first season lacking in compelling plot and stakes.
The idol aspect feels like an afterthought.

anime.title: Urahara
anime.synopsis:
Rito Sudou, Kotoko Watatsumugi, and Mari Shirako share the same dream: they want their creations to be loved around the world. By combining their different skills, the girls run a small apparel shop named Park in Harajuku. As their fame starts to spread, their lives seem to be going in the right direction.

However, their business becomes endangered when aliens dubbed as Scoopers show up on Earth. Due to their lack of creativity, the Scoopers travel around the universe to harvest inventions from other civilizations. As the creatures descend on Harajuku, a young girl named Misa Maruno appears. Claiming she has escaped from the aliens, Misa gives each of the girls a strange device called Amatsumara, which allows its user to create anything they imagine. With the world's artistic future at stake, Rito, Kotoko, and Mari must now defeat the Scoopers with all their imaginative abilities.
anime.consensus_summary: Urahara is a visually striking anime that explores themes of creativity and self-expression, but it suffers from inconsistent execution. While praised for its unique art style and relatable characters, the series is criticized for its pacing issues, clichéd elements, and preachy messages. Overall, audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating its ambition and others finding it flawed.
pros: Unique and colorful art style that complements the themes.
Exploration of the creative process and anxieties faced by artists.
Charming and relatable characters with individual struggles.
Ambitious and experimental approach to storytelling.
Plot twists that challenge initial expectations.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with moments of laziness.
Pacing issues, feeling rushed or dragging at times.
Characters can be clichéd and not deeply explored.
Unrealistic and preachy messages about creativity.
Voice acting can be grating at times.

anime.title: Sengoku Night Blood
anime.genres: Fantasy, Isekai, Josei, Reverse Harem, Romance, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
After a blinding light emanates from her phone, soft-spoken Yuzuki is suddenly transported to an alternate world known as Shinga. The strange place resembles the Sengoku period—a turbulent time in Japanese history known for long civil wars that ravaged the country.

Here, the Gekkazoku, tribes of non-human creatures like vampires and werewolves, live in harmony with humans. This harmony was maintained under the governance of Himemiko, a woman with the power to protect Shinga. However, due to her mysterious disappearance, the world has fallen into disarray. Now, Yuzuki must find Himemiko in order to go back home; but, the ongoing feud between the warlords only impedes her progress.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely considered a disappointing adaptation of the otome game, suffering from poor animation, a weak protagonist, and a convoluted plot. While some viewers find enjoyment in the character interactions and romantic elements, the overall consensus is that the show fails to live up to its potential and feels like a blatant advertisement for the source material. Many feel the reverse harem theme is poorly executed, and the historical fantasy elements are underdeveloped.
pros: Some enjoyable character interactions.
Opening theme song and voice acting are decent.
Lighting effects enhance romantic scenes at times.
cons: Poor animation quality with distorted characters and lazy fight scenes.
Weak, passive, and useless main character.
Incoherent plot with underdeveloped characters and unclear motivations.
Story feels like a shallow commercial for the game.
anime.thematic_vibe: Reverse Harem, Historical Fantasy, Uninspired Adaptation

anime.title: Hatena Illusion
anime.synopsis:
Years ago, many magical "Artifacts" were stolen and scattered throughout the world. They fell into the hands of people who were not supposed to know of their existence, causing misfortune to those who abused their power. The Hoshisato family of magicians has special access to the Artifacts, and they take it upon themselves to return them to their rightful place.

Despite her inexperience, Kana "Hatena" Hoshisato wishes to aid her parents Mamoru and Maeve in their quest, doing her best to improve. Meanwhile, her childhood friend Makoto Shiranui has come to their mansion to study magic under her father's tutelage as part of a promise they made years ago. Hatena is excited to see her friend again, only to be utterly disappointed when the person she thought to be a girl all these years turns out to be a boy, leading to a bitter reunion.

Before long, Makoto comes to know of the Artifacts and the true identities of the magicians he admires. Unfazed, he continues to strive to fulfill his promises and stay true to why he learns magic—to ease the sadness of people around him and, most importantly, to become a person worthy of being Hatena's partner.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime 'Hatena Illusion' is largely considered a disappointment due to a weak story, poor pacing, and underdeveloped characters. Many feel the series failed to capitalize on its premise and suffered from production issues and censorship. While some viewers found mild entertainment or appreciated certain character designs, the overall consensus is negative, with the unfinished ending being a major point of frustration.
pros: Some viewers appreciated the initial nostalgia and mix of magical girl and magician themes.
Certain characters, like Yumemi and Guagua, were considered likable.
Some enjoyed the character designs.
cons: The story is criticized for being simple-minded, boring, and lacking depth.
Pacing issues and random filler disrupt the plot.
Many felt the anime was unfinished with an unsatisfying ending.
Characters were described as one-note, annoying, or underdeveloped.
The animation quality was criticized, with issues like unsynchronized mouth flaps.
Excessive censorship and dumbing down of content were noted, leading to a soulless feel.

anime.title: My Hero Academia: Hero Notebook
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Hero Academia: Hero Note
anime.synopsis: Recap of Boku no Hero Academia that aired a week before the second season.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive but with the caveat that it is a recap episode. Most agree it serves its purpose well as a refresher and a hype-builder for the next season, especially with the inclusion of new animated elements and Izuku's journals. However, it's generally seen as skippable for those who don't need a memory jog or are purists about original content.
pros: Effectively summarizes Season 1 events.
Builds hype for Season 2.
Includes new animation and details, elevating it beyond a standard recap.
Thoughtful transitions, flow, and narration.
Features Izuku's hero journals with new content.
Appeals to fans needing a memory refresher.
Repeats best moments from previous episodes.
cons: Essentially a recap episode with little new content.
Not recommended for viewers skipping Season 1.
Can be boring for those who have already seen Season 1.
Minimal character or plot development due to its nature.
Lack of new music or significant sound design.

anime.title: Ms. Koizumi Loves Ramen Noodles
anime.synopsis: From standing in the sun for hours to traveling miles away from home, gorgeous high school student Koizumi stops at nothing to fulfill her desire for ramen. But these previously solo trips soon change when Koizumi's classmate Yuu Oosawa develops an infatuation with her, and begins to join Koizumi uninvitedly on her adventures. As Yuu continues to be shocked by Koizumi's enormous appetite, she learns about the endless variety of ramen from, arguably, its greatest connoisseur ever!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the detailed ramen visuals and informative content, but criticism for the repetitive plot, shallow characters, and lack of meaningful story. Many find the show enjoyable as a light, visually appealing food anime, while others find it boring and lacking substance. The character Yuu's behavior is a point of contention for some viewers.
pros: Detailed and appealing animation of ramen dishes, creating a 'foodgasm' effect.
Informative content about various types of ramen and ramen culture.
Catchy and memorable opening theme and jingles.
cons: Repetitive plot with little to no overarching story arc.
One-dimensional and underdeveloped characters with limited depth.
Over-reliance on ramen as the sole focus, neglecting character interactions and world-building.
Annoying and potentially disturbing stalker-like behavior of one character (Yuu).
anime.thematic_vibe: Food Porn, Slice of Life, Comedy

anime.title: Kemono Friends 2
anime.synopsis: Serval and Caracal find a "human" child in the forest. As they travel with the child, they meet new Friends, uncover the secrets of Japari Park, and become involved in an event that will "shake the earth."
anime.consensus_summary: Kemono Friends 2 is largely considered a disappointing sequel that fails to capture the magic of the original. Fans express strong disappointment with the derivative plot, weak characters, and the loss of the original's deeper themes. The controversy surrounding the removal of the original director further fuels the negative reception, although some appreciate the improved animation.
pros: Improved animation and character models compared to the first season.
The music, largely reused from the first season, is still enjoyable.
Some find the new characters charming, despite their weak arcs.
cons: Story heavily copies the original season, lacking originality and impact.
Characters, especially Kyururu, are bland and underdeveloped compared to Kaban.
Loss of mystery and darker themes, replaced with a simplistic, childish tone.
Poor character writing, including Serval's character being mishandled.
Plot holes and unanswered questions make the story unsatisfying.
Many feel the series was made without the original team's heart and vision.

anime.title: Armed Girl's Machiavellism OVA
anime.romaji_title: Busou Shoujo Machiavellianism: Doki! "Goken-darake" no Ian Ryokou
anime.synopsis: After the fierce battle with Kirukiru Amou, the school's strongest students, the Supreme Five Swords, are prepared to take the blame for the conflict. To their surprise, instead of condemning anyone, the principal abruptly assigns the group to a recreational trip to a hot spring! Moreover, they are allowed to take the infamous transfer student Fudou Nomura with them—so long as he passes his supplementary exams first. With the girls of the Swords helping him, Fudou must earn the right to unwind from his busy school life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views this OVA as a standard, uninspired fanservice episode that offers little beyond what fans of the original series expect. While some acknowledge its purpose as bonus content, the general sentiment is that it's boring, lacks substance, and fails to provide anything memorable or particularly entertaining, with criticisms focusing on its generic nature and pacing.
pros: Satisfied fans of the original series looking for more content with established characters.
cons: Lacks substance and originality, serving primarily as a fanservice episode.
Boring and unentertaining with predictable plot elements and dialogue.
Pacing issues, particularly during the study segment.
Mediocre animation, background settings, and character designs compared to the main series.
No character development or new backstory is offered.

anime.title: Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card Prologue – Sakura and the Two Bears
anime.romaji_title: Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card-hen Prologue - Sakura to Futatsu no Kuma
anime.synopsis: After the conclusion of the Sakura Card Arc, life is going back to normal. There are no more mysteries, no more disturbances of evil, no more tests of strength. Everyone is moving on with their lives and Sakura feels a sadness in her heart. Even through the goodbyes, Sakura perseveres to keep everyone and a special someone, dear to her heart.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a mixed bag for audiences. While many appreciate its faithfulness to the manga and nostalgic elements, others criticize its animation and art style. Some viewers find it a necessary bridge to the Clear Card arc, while others feel it is an unnecessary retelling of familiar events, leaving the overall audience reaction split between satisfied nostalgia and disappointed critique.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga ending.
Nostalgic return of the original voice actors and soundtrack.
Sets up the Clear Card arc well.
cons: Stiff animation and character designs compared to the original series.
Over-reliance on chibi characters and flowery overlays.
Pacing and direction may feel jarring to anime-only viewers.

anime.title: Hiyoko no Basket Movie: Last Game 0401
anime.romaji_title: Hiyoko no Basket Movie: Last Game 0401
anime.synopsis: 2017 April Fools' Day event where the Kuroko's Basketball bird mascots fill in for the characters in a trailer for the Last Game movie.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Hiyoko no Basket' short is a light and humorous April Fools' gag. Viewers found the bird versions of the characters cute and amusing, though the physics defied logic. The main criticism is its short length, but overall it was well-received as a fun, non-serious diversion.
pros: Cute character designs
Novelty of the concept
cons: Brief duration
Questionable physics
Simplistic premise

anime.title: Pop Team Epic
anime.synopsis: Poputepipikku turns absurdist comedy up to eleven with its pop culture references and surreal hilarity. With two bonafide high school girl protagonists—the short and exceptionally quick to anger Popuko, and the tall and unshakably calm Pipimi—they throw genres against the wall and don't wait to see what sticks. Parody is interlaced with drama, action, crudeness, and the show's overarching goal—to become a real anime.
anime.consensus_summary: Pop Team Epic is a highly divisive anime, celebrated for its absurdist humor, innovative format, and diverse animation styles, while also criticized for its inconsistent jokes, repetitive segments, and over-reliance on pop culture references. Some viewers find it to be a brilliant parody and a celebration of anime culture, while others find it to be a nonsensical and irritating waste of time. The show's experimental nature makes it a love-it-or-hate-it experience.
pros: Innovative and experimental format
Diverse animation styles and high production quality in segments
Excellent voice acting and sound design, including catchy opening theme
cons: Inconsistent humor; some jokes fall flat or are too obscure
Repetitive segments and padding of runtime with filler content
Relies heavily on pop culture references, which may not resonate with all viewers

anime.title: The Outcast Season 2
anime.synopsis: Chou Soran must participate in the Raten Taishou to uncover his grandfather's secrets and the key to Fou Houhou's past. Though Houhou trains Soran, will that be enough to defeat powerful enemies who all seem out to get him while they struggle for power and victory in the tournament?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some viewers find the show enjoyable, praising its humor and underlying story, others criticize the slow pacing, lack of character development, and disjointed adaptation from the manga. The season is seen by some as a time-killer, but ultimately lacking in substantial plot advancement.
pros: Enjoyable humor.
Interesting core story (based on manga source).
cons: Pacing issues, feels slow at times.
Lack of character development in main characters.
Anime adaptation feels disjointed and rushed.
Season lacks significant plot progression.

anime.title: ClassicaLoid 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of ClassicaLoid.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the second season of ClassicaLoid as a light comedy with engaging characters. The addition of new characters and a less episodic plot are seen as improvements over the first season. It is recommended to watch the first season to understand the character relationships.
pros: New characters add fun and expand the plot.
Less episodic structure provides a more solid base than the first season.
anime.thematic_vibe: Light Comedy, Musical, Slice of Life

anime.title: Musasi-no
anime.synopsis: Sequel series to Urawa no Usagi-chan.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Viewers found the anime to be poorly animated, with a nonsensical and uninteresting plot. Many felt it was a blatant commercial with little entertainment value, and some derived ironic enjoyment from its awfulness.
pros: It can be good for a laugh.
The show may inspire viewers to visit the advertised city.
Watching with friends can be sadistically fun.
cons: Poor animation quality, including frame rate issues and bad CGI.
Weak and uninteresting storyline with nonsensical plot elements.
Feels like a low-effort commercial rather than an engaging anime.
Characters are forgettable and lack depth.
Repetitive soundtrack.

anime.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend .flat - Fan Service of Love and Pure heart
anime.romaji_title: Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata ♭: Koi to Junjou no Service-kai
anime.synopsis: For the production of their game's poolside scene, Blessing Software's illustrator Eriri Spencer Sawamura wants Megumi Katou to model in a swimsuit for her sketches of the game's heroine. However, Megumi refuses to wear such attire unless everyone else agrees to do the same. To ensure the development of their game continues smoothly, the team follows her request as they conduct their fruitful research at a luxury hotel.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with appreciation for the visuals but criticism for excessive fan service. The plot is considered secondary to the fanservice elements, leading to disappointment for some viewers. There are polarized viewpoints regarding the quality and direction of the series.
pros: Beautiful artwork and character design by A1.
Showcases teamwork within the doujin circle.
cons: Overreliance on fan service detracts from plot.
Protagonist perceived as dense and unlikable.
Plot is minimal and unmotivating.
Recap of season one, nor is it a plot-heavy prelude to the upcoming second season.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fan Service, Romance, Slice of Life

anime.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Valentine's, and Then Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)
anime.romaji_title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon: Valentine, Soshite Onsen! - Amari Kitai Shinaide Kudasai
anime.synopsis:
Wanting to take her affection for Kobayashi a step further, dragon maid Tooru is confident in her latest creation: a love potion! With Valentine's Day just around the corner, Tooru decides there is no better way to use the potion than in homemade chocolates. However, on the special holiday, Tooru's plan is quickly foiled after Kobayashi sees through her heartfelt yet deceptive gift. 

Despite the unsuccessful attempt, many opportunities still await. Between the lively atmosphere and a trip to the hot springs, Kobayashi and the dragons indulge themselves in the sweet festivities.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally enjoyed by fans of the series for its lightheartedness and continuation of the original vibe. However, a significant point of contention is the excessive and sometimes uncomfortable fanservice, particularly concerning the character Kanna. This detracts from the overall experience for some viewers, overshadowing the positive aspects of the animation and character interactions.
pros: Keeps the spirit of the main anime
Enjoyable and feels like an actual episode
Art and animation are well done
cons: Questionable fanservice, especially involving Kanna
Some uncomfortable or inappropriate scenes
Story doesn't utilize its characters in an appropriate way

anime.title: Teekyu 9
anime.synopsis: Ninth season of the Teekyuu anime series.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception is mixed with some finding it a return to form. A common criticism is the slower pacing compared to previous seasons, with some feeling it relies too heavily on running gags. Despite the criticisms, many fans of the series still find enjoyment in it, though it may not measure up to earlier seasons for some.
pros: Return to form after weaker previous seasons
Introduction of new characters that are developed
Continues to excel at frantic pacing and machinegun jokes
cons: Noticeably slower pacing compared to previous seasons
Mediocre ED
Over-reliance on running gags
Some jokes didn’t benefit from the slower pacing

anime.title: Himouto! Umaru-chan R
anime.synopsis:
Umaru Doma is a model student who has a hidden side: when she gets home each day, she puts on her hamster hoodie and turns into a sluggish otaku fond of junk food. As Umaru continues these daily antics, the friendship between her and her classmates—Nana Ebina, Kirie Motoba, and Sylphinford Tachibana—deepens, and more and more interesting events begin to unfold.

Of course, these events give rise to numerous questions. What did Nana ask of Umaru's brother Taihei? Who is the mysterious girl with the diamond hairpin? And most important of all: why does this girl seem to know Umaru? These questions and more will be answered in Himouto! Umaru-chan R!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Himouto! Umaru-chan R is mixed, with some finding it a refreshing and enjoyable comedy that improves upon the first season due to its focus on character development and emotional moments. However, others criticize it for a weak or repetitive plot, unsatisfying emotional arcs, and humor that doesn't always land. While some viewers found Umaru more relatable, others still found her annoying, contributing to a moderate level of polarization.
pros: Character development, especially regarding friendships and backstories, is a highlight.
The second season balances humor with emotional moments, creating a more rewarding experience.
Some found Umaru less annoying and more relatable in the second season.
cons: The plot is often repetitive or nonexistent, with events feeling loosely connected.
Some found the emotional moments unsatisfying or generic, lacking meaningful conclusions.
The humor may not appeal to everyone, and Umaru's character can be irritating to some viewers.

anime.title: Yuri!!! On ICE: Yuri Plisetsky GPF in Barcelona EX "Welcome to The Madness"
anime.romaji_title: Yuri!!! on Ice: Yuri Plisetsky GPF in Barcelona EX - Welcome to The Madness
anime.synopsis: In his exhibition performance for the Grand Prix of Figure Skating Final in Barcelona, 15-year-old Yuri Plisetsky seeks to defy his "Russian Fairy" nickname by showing off wild new choreography, the likes of which have never been seen from him on the ice before.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response to "Yuri!!! on Ice: Yuri Plisetsky GPF in Barcelona EX - Welcome to The Madness" is positive, with many praising its stunning animation, intense choreography, and satisfying fanservice. Some find the short length and heavy reliance on fanservice to be drawbacks. However, the general consensus is that it is a worthwhile experience for fans of the series, particularly those who enjoy Yuri Plisetsky's character and his relationship with Otabek.
pros: High-quality animation and visuals, considered by some to be better than the original series.
Exciting and captivating choreography that effectively showcases Yuri Plisetsky's character and skill.
The music choice ('Welcome to The Madness') is well-suited to the routine and enhances the overall experience.
Satisfying fanservice, particularly for those who appreciate the relationship between Yuri and Otabek.
cons: The short length leaves viewers wanting more and may feel insubstantial to some.
Relies heavily on fanservice, which may not appeal to all viewers or those seeking substantial plot development.
Some reviewers found the content to be overtly sexualized or exploitative.

anime.title: Forest Fairy Five ~Fairy Tale~
anime.synopsis: A direct sequel to Forest Fairy Five.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is cautiously optimistic. While the show still has its flaws, there is a noted improvement from its previous season, particularly in its production quality and creative storytelling. Some viewers may find it boring, but overall, there is a sense of appreciation for the effort put into improving the series.
pros: Improved production quality compared to the previous season
Creative and amusing retelling of classic folk tales
Noticeable effort to improve the show throughout its run
cons: Still has janky animation and camerawork
May be found boring by some viewers
VA's still have a habit of speaking too close to the microphone

anime.title: A Sister's All You Need
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Ecchi, Otaku Culture, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Itsuki Hashima is a light novelist obsessed with little sisters, strictly focusing on them when he writes his stories. Despite his personality, he is surrounded by a tight circle of friends: Nayuta Kani, a genius yet perverted novelist who is in love with him; Haruto Fuwa, a fellow male author whose work has seen considerable success; Miyako Shirakawa, a good friend that he met in college; and Chihiro, his perfect younger step-brother who takes care of the housework and cooking.
 
Together, they play strange games, go on spontaneous journeys, crack silly jokes, and celebrate each other's successes. However, each individual must also deal with their own issues, whether it is struggling to meet a deadline or coming to terms with traumatic events buried in their past.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers appreciating the character-driven narrative, slice-of-life elements, and humor, while others are turned off by the excessive fan service and misleading initial impressions. The show is praised for its realistic portrayal of the struggles of light novel authors and the depth of its characters, but criticized for its inconsistent pacing and unresolved plot points. Ultimately, whether or not someone enjoys the show depends on their tolerance for ecchi content and their interest in character-focused stories.
pros: Well-developed and quirky characters with believable motivations.
Realistic portrayal of the ups and downs of being a light novel author.
Humor is well-integrated and often self-deprecating.
Insightful moments of self-reflection and emotional honesty.
cons: Excessive and often unnecessary fan service that detracts from the story.
Misleading title and initial scenes can alienate viewers.
Inconsistent pacing and some jokes fall flat.
Ending leaves many issues unresolved, hinting at a second season that may not happen.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Comedy, Writer's Struggle

anime.title: Donten: Laughing Under the Clouds - Gaiden: Chapter 2 - The Tragedy of Fuuma Ninja Tribe
anime.romaji_title: Donten ni Warau Gaiden: Shukumei, Soutou no Fuuma
anime.genres: Action, Historical, Martial Arts, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis: Fuuma ninja clan is a secret ninja tribe that is waiting for the "Orochi" (gigantic snake) to resurrect for generations. Shirasu and his twin brother Ichiu grew up in this viscous environment and this tells how they become the leaders of the clan.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience appreciates the film's focus on Shirasu's perspective and backstory, finding it a valuable addition to the overall narrative. The film successfully evokes a sense of tragedy and bittersweetness, deepening the understanding of his character. There is a consensus that the film enriches the original material by providing additional context and emotional depth.
pros: Provides deeper insight into Shirasu's character and motivations.
Expands on the manga by showing details not present in the original work.
Effectively portrays Shirasu's emotional journey and loss.

anime.title: Anime-Gataris
anime.synopsis:
After dreaming about an anime she used to watch as a child, Minoa Asagaya could not forget a particularly memorable scene. However, despite her best efforts, she cannot recall the name of the show. Due to this, Minoa asks for help from her fellow classmates at Sakaneko High School. Her conversation is overheard by Arisu Kamiigusa, the most popular and wealthy girl in class who is also a hardcore otaku. Yet even with her vast knowledge, Arisu does not recognize the show.

After discovering that there isn't an anime club at their school, Minoa and Arisu create the Anime Research Club, as they may obtain the answer to Minoa's mystery if they gather people who share the same interest. Thus, Minoa is exposed to a bizarre new world—the world of anime!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. Some viewers found Animegataris to be a clever and funny parody of anime culture with a unique and enjoyable ending, while others felt the show was inconsistent, with a weak story and annoying characters. The ending, in particular, is a major point of contention, with some praising its creativity and others criticizing its confusing and random nature. Overall, the show seems to appeal most to those who are familiar with anime tropes and enjoy self-aware humor.
pros: Self-aware humor and references to anime culture.
Unique and unafraid ending that embraces stupidity.
Good balance of parody and genuine appreciation for anime.
Catchy opening and ending themes.
Character development of Minoa as she embraces anime.
Creative art style that incorporates different animation techniques.
cons: Inconsistent story quality, with some episodes being dull or plotless.
Repetitive jokes and overused tropes.
Weak character development for supporting characters.
Unnecessary fan service elements.
Abrupt and confusing ending that may alienate some viewers.

anime.title: 10000 Years Later
anime.synopsis: Hundreds of thousands of years after the collapse of civilization, the world is a post-tech wasteland, and is inhabited by humanoid tribes. The Peace held between them is threatened by the return of Wushen, an evil shape-shifting ghost of modern technology. Wushen threatens to enslave the world population. Zhuma, a ten-year-old girl is the heroine of the story, accompanied by Zhanggong, her lion-like Tibetan Mastiff dog. Chosen, and helped by a ethereal goddess she must assemble a band of allies from the surviving tribes to fight Wushen, and stop him from gaining control over an ancient power.
anime.consensus_summary: The show starts slow, potentially deterring viewers, but builds into a symbolic and action-packed story with unexpected twists.  The plot initially appears generic, yet unveils deeper layers related to technology and ancient power as the story progresses. Despite the initial drawbacks, the unique interpretation of classic themes and its later developments earn appreciation from viewers who invest in the full narrative.
pros: Intriguing concept of god and symbolism
Action and unexpected turns
cons: Slow start that doesn't immediately grab the viewer
Typical 'god beats demon' storyline initially
anime.thematic_vibe: Post-apocalyptic, Technological Regression, Chosen One Narrative

anime.title: Convenience Store Boy Friends
anime.synopsis:
The lives of high school freshmen Haruki Mishima and Towa Honda revolve around studying, clubs, and girls. Amid their hectic routines, romance is certainly budding for the two best friends. Since childhood, Haruki has been pining over Miharu Mashiki, and a chance encounter at the convenience store reignites his feelings. As for Towa, the class representative Mami Mihashi has caught his eye; but unfortunately for him, his affections are not reciprocated.

While Haruki's more reserved approach to pursuing Miharu contrasts Towa's persistence with Mami, love seems to be elusive for both. As the months fly by, only time will tell if romance is in the cards for the duo.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception to Konbini Kareshi is lukewarm. While some appreciate the art style and relaxing nature, many find the story and characters bland and underdeveloped. The anime is criticized for its slow pace, lack of focus, and uninspired plot, leading to a generally underwhelming experience.
pros: Appealing art style and character designs
Catchy opening theme song
Some viewers found the characters relatable and the simple story enjoyable
cons: Poor pacing and slow development
Lack of focus on all introduced characters/couples
Weak character development for the main character (Haruki)
Boring and uninspired plot with typical clichés
Animation quality is inconsistent and choppy
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, High School Romance, Mundane

anime.title: My Hero Academia: Training of the Dead
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Hero Academia: Training of the Dead
anime.synopsis:
Returning from their internships, the students of Class 1-A are immediately thrown into more training by their homeroom teacher, Shouta Aizawa. For this exercise, the class will be joining four students from Isamu Academy High School to compete in a survival game. Split up into groups of four, students must either eliminate each other or stay hidden until time runs out to win. 

The training also acts as a reunion between Tsuyu Asui and her friend from middle school, Habuko Mongoose. However, not all the students from Isamu are friendly—Katsuki Bakugou almost instantly picks a fight with Romero Fujimi. The conflict between the two leads Romero to angrily release his Quirk, a gas which zombifies anyone it comes in contact with. How will the remaining students deal with the situation after most of the people around them turn into zombies?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for this OVA is generally positive, with many enjoying its comedic elements, fun action, and focus on Asui's character. However, a significant portion of viewers felt it was ultimately skippable filler with a somewhat forced plot and underdeveloped new characters, leading to mild disagreement on its overall value.
pros: Good animation for action sequences like Bakugo's fight.
Enjoyable humor and comedic timing.
Strong character development for Asui (Tsuyu).
Introduces interesting new quirks and characters.
Maintains character consistency (not OOC).
Offers a fun and lighthearted experience suitable for an OVA.
cons: Story is somewhat unoriginal and predictable.
Plot development is minimal and doesn't significantly impact the main series.
New characters, apart from a few, can feel underdeveloped or derivative (e.g., zombie-quirk guy as a Bakugo copy).
Animation can be choppy or bland in some scenes.
Lack of new music or memorable sound design.
Felt like filler and not essential to the main narrative.
The zombie theme felt somewhat out of place for the MHA universe.
The ending felt rushed.

anime.title: ReLIFE: Final Arc
anime.synopsis:
After reliving the life of a high school student through the ReLIFE experiment, 27-year-old Arata Kaizaki cannot believe how quickly it has changed him. He has begun to see the world through a different perspective that he had completely forgotten as an adult. He has made friends and formed deep relationships with each one of them. However his support, Ryou Yoake, reminds him that the experiment is all an illusion; after his experiment ends, he will be forgotten by all of them.

The experiment of another ReLIFE subject is also coming to an end. After spending two years with ReLIFE, Chizuru Hishiro has developed into a more open, more thoughtful person than she could have ever imagined. She has met people who have changed her life, her perspective, and ultimately her. However, now that their ReLIFE is coming to an end, will they be able to let go of the memories they have made?
anime.consensus_summary: The ending to ReLIFE: Kanketsu-hen is highly divisive among fans. Many who haven't read the manga found it to be an emotional and satisfying conclusion. However, manga readers felt that the adaptation was rushed, omitting crucial plot points and character development, leading to disappointment.
pros: Satisfying conclusion for anime-only watchers.
Characters are loveable and relatable, experiences pull at the heartstrings.
The ending made many viewers feel both sadness and joy.
cons: Rushed pacing due to condensing a large amount of manga content into a few episodes.
Significant plot points and character development from the manga were omitted or glossed over.
Animation quality suffered due to budget constraints, with some scenes being presented as slideshows.
Music choice perceived as poor

anime.title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuushabu Shozoku 3
anime.synopsis:
The story takes place in the era of the gods, year 300. Yuuna Yuuki lives an ordinary life as a second year middle school student, but she's also a member of the "Hero Club," where club activities involve dealing with a mysterious being called "Vertex."

(Source: ANN)

Aired along side Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Washio Sumi no Shou Movie 3 - Yakusoku.
anime.consensus_summary: The Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuushabu Shozoku shorts are considered a lighthearted and fun omake to the main series. While some find the jokes overdone or weak, the shorts are generally entertaining. The tone is a stark contrast to the darker main series, which may be off-putting to some viewers.
pros: Entertaining
Fun
cons: Overdone jokes
Weak jokes
Odd tone compared to main series

anime.title: Love is Like a Cocktail
anime.romaji_title: Osake wa Fuufu ni Natte kara
anime.synopsis: Chisato Mizusawa is a calm and collected assistant office manager who apparently dislikes drinking alcohol. But she actually likes it and has a secret side to her that emerges only when drunk: her cute persona, which she only reveals to her husband, the bartender Sora. Each day when Chisato comes home, Sora takes care of his beloved wife, providing her with a good meal and a fresh drink. These drinks include Plum Splet, Irish Coffee, Orange Breeze, and many more tasty concoctions that she eagerly gulps down. But as much as she likes alcohol, she loves her kindhearted husband more. Together, they share a life that is filled with happiness—and the more-than-occasional cocktail.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many finding the anime cute, relaxing, and wholesome, praising its depiction of a loving couple and the fun cocktail recipes. However, some critique its lack of substantial plot, repetitive nature, and potentially problematic portrayal of alcohol use in relationships. While some view it as a lighthearted and enjoyable short series, others find it unrealistic and lacking depth.
pros: Cute and heartwarming depiction of a married couple.
Simple and enjoyable, easy to watch and relax to.
Showcases affection and care between the couple, promoting relationship goals.
The cocktail recipes are a cute and fun addition to each episode.
Good voice acting, especially Eri Kitamura's drunk vocals.
Pleasantly short episodes make it easy to consume.
cons: Lacks a strong story or character development.
Repetitive format, with each episode following the same pattern.
Questionable portrayal of alcohol use and its role in the relationship.
Unrealistic and idealistic depiction of married life.
Some find the characters shallow and lacking depth.
Animation quality is below average.

anime.title: Revue Starlight
anime.synopsis:
As preparations begin for Seishou Music Academy's yearly Seishou Festival, the girls of the 99th class are gearing up to perform their very own rendition of Starlight, the tragic tale of two goddesses drawn together by the glow of the heavens but destined to be pulled apart, never to meet again. Created to foster the next generation of theatrical talent, this girls' only school works to improve the singing, acting, and dancing skills of its students.

One student is 16-year-old Karen Aijou, an easygoing girl who has dreamed of performing on stage since she was a child. Her love for theater is further invigorated when her childhood friend Hikari Kagura transfers to Seishou Academy. Through her old friend, Karen stumbles upon a secret elevator leading to a massive theater underneath the school. Hosted by a talking giraffe, this arena serves as a battleground where her classmates participate in duels to determine who among them deserves the title of "Top Star," earning them the right to play one of the lead roles in Starlight. Emboldened by the promise she made with Hikari to someday be stars together, Karen enters these mysterious battles in the hopes of making their dream a reality.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the show's unique blend of musical and action elements, its stunning visuals and choreography, and its exploration of theatrical ambition. Some find the story predictable, the symbolism heavy-handed, and the characters underdeveloped, particularly in the latter half. Despite some flaws, many consider it a hidden gem within the music/idol genre.
pros: Excellent choreography and stage animation.
Unique story that takes a different approach to the music/idol genre.
Visually stunning with brilliant direction and excellent soundtrack.
Meaningful symbolism related to the characters, the narrative, and Takarazuka Revue.
Characters are complex and not left in the dust.
Explores themes of ambition, competition, and the cost of fame.
cons: Story can be predictable and simplistic, especially in the latter half.
Relies heavily on symbolism which can feel forced or self-indulgent.
Character development can be rushed or neatly wrapped up within a single episode.
Some found the characters bland or uninteresting.
The story's 'weirdness' and humor are awkward.
Story has plot holes.

anime.title: Classroom of the Elite
anime.romaji_title: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e
anime.synopsis:
On the surface, Koudo Ikusei Senior High School is a utopia. The students enjoy an unparalleled amount of freedom, and it is ranked highly in Japan. However, the reality is less than ideal. Four classes, A through D, are ranked in order of merit, and only the top classes receive favorable treatment.

Kiyotaka Ayanokouji is a student of Class D, where the school dumps its worst. There he meets the unsociable Suzune Horikita, who believes she was placed in Class D by mistake and desires to climb all the way to Class A, and the seemingly amicable class idol Kikyou Kushida, whose aim is to make as many friends as possible.

While class membership is permanent, class rankings are not; students in lower ranked classes can rise in rankings if they score better than those in the top ones. Additionally, in Class D, there are no bars on what methods can be used to get ahead. In this cutthroat school, can they prevail against the odds and reach the top?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are highly divided. Some viewers praise the show's unique premise, interesting characters, and psychological elements. However, many criticize the plot holes, forced situations, the main character's unrealistic abilities, and the excessive fan service, leading to disappointment and frustration for some.
pros: Interesting premise of a school based on merit and competition.
Strong and interesting characters that elevate the plot.
Unique point system introduces essential character development.
Art style is very good
cons: Plot holes and forced situations.
Main character is a self-insert Gary Stu, reducing tension.
Unnecessary fanservice detracts from the story.
Story becomes boring and repetitive, with predictable outcomes.
Confusing story that isn't newbie friendly

anime.title: Stella no Mahou Specials
anime.synopsis:
Kayo Fujikawa has been acting strange recently, leading her clubmates Ayame Seki and Shiina Murakami to worry about her. Moreover, her birthday is just around the corner. To lighten the mood of their precious companion, Ayame and Shiina take it upon themselves to make sure that Kayo enjoys her special day.

Set before the time Tamaki Honda joins the SNS club, this extra chapter of Stella no Mahou follows the club seniors as they develop their friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the Stella no Mahou Specials to be a lighthearted and enjoyable addition to the series, focusing on the friendship between the characters. However, some feel that the plot is too simple and lacks substantial depth, making it a somewhat unremarkable but pleasant watch. The consistent art style and returning voice cast are appreciated.
pros: Good art style, consistent with the anime.
Returning voice actors provide a familiar and enjoyable experience.
cons: The story is simple and lacks depth.
OVA content is basic and revolves around a single event (Kayo's birthday).

anime.title: Slow Start
anime.synopsis:
Hana Ichinose, a 17-year-old high school student who is not only introverted, but also insecure and timid, has just moved and will be attending a new school. To make her situation more difficult,  Hana is a "slow start," which means that she missed a year and worries about attending a class where everyone is younger than her.

During her introduction, the teacher reveals it is Hana's birthday, which gives her the jumping-off point  to meet three of her classmates: Tamate Momochi, a charismatic and extroverted girl; Kanmuri Sengoku, who is shy and small; and the popular and pretty Eiko Tokura. Not wanting to lose the chance to make new friends, Hana's interactions with these three mark the beginning of some beautiful relationships that will change her life.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Slow Start" is seen as a pleasant and enjoyable CGDCT anime, particularly for those who appreciate heartwarming stories and relatable characters. While some find it generic and lacking in originality, others praise its high production quality and the way it handles sensitive themes like anxiety. The show is generally considered a relaxing and fun watch, though some viewers may be turned off by occasional fan service elements.
pros: Relatable characters dealing with anxiety and personal issues in a heartwarming way.
High production quality with smooth animation and attention to detail.
Catchy opening and ending themes and a generally cheerful soundtrack.
cons: Generic plot and character archetypes common in CGDCT anime.
Lack of substantial character development and unresolved plot points.
Occasional suggestive content or loli fanservice that may be off-putting to some viewers.

anime.title: Turning Mecard
anime.genres: Adventure, Kids, Mecha, Racing, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
A Korean/Japanese co-production created by Bakugan and Dragon Ball Super contributor Atsushi Maekawa.

Turning Mecard stars Jason, a grade-schooler who meets a Mecanimal, a transforming minicar from the alternate world of Triforce, named Evan. Jason and Evan are both searching for missing family members, and team up to help each other. Together, they meet more Mecanimals as they battle across dimensions and learn important lessons along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Turning Mecard is a children's show that blends elements from popular franchises like Pokemon and Yu-Gi-Oh. While praised for its unique concept and visuals, the repetitive nature of episodes and uninspired music bring the show down. Overall, the series is considered harmless fun for its target demographic.
pros: Unique blend of monster-collecting and card-battle genres
Appealing visuals with well-done car movements and lighting
Cute and silly tone suitable for younger audiences
cons: Repetitive episode structure
Unmemorable music and sound effects
Voice acting may not suit all characters

anime.title: Land of the Lustrous
anime.genres: Action, Anthropomorphic, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
In the mysterious future, crystalline organisms called Gems inhabit a world that has been destroyed by six meteors. Each Gem is assigned a role in order to fight against the Lunarians, a species who attacks them in order to shatter their bodies and use them as decorations. 

Phosphophyllite, also known as Phos, is a young and fragile Gem who dreams of helping their friends in the war effort. Instead, they are told to compile an encyclopedia because of their delicate condition. After begrudgingly embarking on this task, Phos meets Cinnabar, an intelligent gem who has been relegated to patrolling the isolated island at night because of the corrosive poison their body creates. After seeing how unhappy Cinnabar is, Phos decides to find a role that both of the rejected Gems can enjoy. Houseki no Kuni follows Phos' efforts to be useful and protect their fellow Gems.
anime.consensus_summary: Houseki no Kuni is praised for its innovative CGI animation, unique world-building, and philosophical themes. However, some viewers find the pacing slow and the character development uneven. The lack of a complete anime adaptation is a major source of disappointment, leaving viewers wanting more.
pros: Unique premise with intriguing mysteries.
Stunning CGI animation and visual aesthetics.
Compelling exploration of identity, change, and the human condition.
cons: Pacing issues; starts slowly.
Uneven character development, with focus mainly on Phos.
Incomplete story, needs further seasons.

anime.title: Katana Maidens: Toji no Miko
anime.synopsis:
Throughout history, an elite group of shrine maidens known as "Toji" have saved the world from "Aratama," strange and malevolent beings bent on destroying humanity. In modern times, these warriors have been assigned to a special police squad to exterminate Aratama. The government has also set up five elite schools across the country to provide young girls the necessary sword fighting skills to eradicate these monsters and eventually join their fellow Toji in protecting the world.

A student of one of those five schools, Kanami Etou is chosen to represent Minoseki Academy in a sword fighting tournament, where she meets the mysterious Hiyori Juujou. Although Kanami and Hiyori rise to the top of the tournament, their battle takes an unexpected turn, throwing the world of the Toji into chaos. Likely that the Toji are facing betrayal from within, the two are forced to flee the tournament, clashing with former comrades on the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the show's engaging story, well-developed characters, and exciting action, while others criticize its generic premise, slow pacing, and inconsistent animation. Many viewers found the initial episodes weak but noted improvements in the second half. Despite its flaws, a significant portion of the audience enjoyed the series, particularly those who appreciate action-adventure stories with strong female characters and yuri themes.
pros: Well-handled story and characters.
Intriguing and unpredictable story.
Good pacing that keeps the audience interested.
Likable and well-developed characters, especially Kanami and Hiyori.
Good character interactions and relationships.
Visually appealing character designs.
Strong world-building with unique elements.
Exciting sword fights with fluid animation.
cons: Generic premise and initial episodes.
Slow pacing and confusing story arcs in the first half.
Overabundance of characters, hindering development for some.
Inconsistent animation quality, with noticeable CGI.
Predictable character archetypes.
Some find the plot clichéd.
Moral implications of the story are questionable for some viewers.
Lack of emotional stakes due to the 'utsushi' combat system.

anime.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!: Take On Me
anime.romaji_title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Movie: Take On Me
anime.synopsis:
Although already a third-year high school student, Rikka Takanashi remains a chuunibyou—a "disease" that causes people to fantasize about themselves and their surroundings. Her relationship with Yuuta Togashi has also gone unchanged for the past six months, and with entrance exams right around the corner, both of them strive to enroll at the same college. However, Tooka—Rikka's elder sister—decides to take Rikka to Italy as she has found a stable job there. This unforeseen turn of events causes a commotion between the couple as neither of them want to be separated from each other. Desperate for ideas, they seek assistance from their friends, and after a brief conversation, they come up with a plan—to elope.

Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Movie: Take On Me is a sensational drama featuring the couple—Yuuta and Rikka—as they journey across Japan. The two attempt to prevent Rikka from being taken to Italy, but will they be able to succeed in doing so?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the movie as a satisfying conclusion to the series and a reinforcement of its core themes, while others find it to be a rehash of previous conflicts with little character development. Some feel the plot is unnecessary and that the visuals are subpar for the studio.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to the series, providing closure to the main characters' relationship.
Reinforces the core themes of the series with better writing than the second season.
Expands on the chemistry, humor, and character dynamics from previous seasons.
Visually appealing with great art and location backgrounds.
cons: Plot rehashes the same conflict from the second season, diminishing its impact.
Relies on familiar antics and doesn't offer substantial character growth for Rikka.
Plot is thin and not particularly necessary, feeling like a drawn-out episode.
Visuals are sub-par for Kyoani, suggesting a lack of effort in the production.

anime.title: Just Because!
anime.synopsis:
As another school year begins drawing to a close, the third-year high school students move steadily toward the next milestone of their lives: graduation. Among them are Mio Natsume, a girl burdened with lingering feelings; Hazuki Morikawa, a member of the concert band but distant from the others; and Haruto Souma, an athlete obsessed with baseball. Meanwhile, second-year student Ena Komiya seeks to revive the photography club to its former glory, refusing to let the organization be disbanded. Though this group lacks a strong connection with one another, their lives suddenly cross paths with the arrival of a third-year transfer student.

While a transfer so close to graduation is unusual for most, it is business as usual for Eita Izumi. Due to his father's work, he has never been able to stay in one place for very long. But as luck would have it, their most recent relocation has returned Eita to his hometown for his final semester of high school. For better or worse, it also sparks the rekindling of old relationships left behind in the past.

With graduation already causing its own share of anxieties, Eita's sudden arrival brings these students' carefree days to an abrupt end. Long-forgotten memories, deeply buried emotions, and inspiring new passions—everything is brought to light in their bittersweet final semester.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the anime's realistic portrayal of high school life, relatable characters, and nostalgic atmosphere. Others criticize the slow pacing, predictable plot, and underwhelming character development, particularly regarding the romantic relationships. The ending seems to be a major point of contention, leading to disappointment for viewers who felt certain characters were underserved.
pros: Relatable characters and realistic themes resonate with viewers.
The soundtrack and sound design enhance the atmosphere.
Exploration of adolescence and future aspirations is well-executed.
cons: The plot is slow-paced and sometimes predictable.
Character development feels rushed or incomplete.
The ending is unsatisfying for some viewers, with forced romantic outcomes.

anime.title: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Movie: Maji Love Kingdom
anime.romaji_title: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Movie: Maji Love Kingdom
anime.synopsis: Idol groups ST☆RISH, QUARTET NIGHT, and HE★VENS take to the stage in this feature-length animated concert. The three groups sing, dance, and welcome cheering fans to the Maji Love Kingdom.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is primarily a concert experience with catchy J-Pop music and entertaining character interactions, targeted towards existing fans of the UtaPri franchise. While the lack of a substantial plot and reliance on CGI are drawbacks, fans generally enjoy the film for its music and character dynamics. It's considered a must-see for dedicated fans but unlikely to sway those unfamiliar with the series.
pros: Catchy and high-quality music
Great character interactions faithful to their personalities
Visually pleasing colors and fluid animation
Entertaining concert experience for fans
cons: No significant plot or story
Excessive use of CGI for dance choreography
Songs could have been longer
Limited screen time for Haruka and other side characters
anime.thematic_vibe: Upbeat J-Pop, Extravagant Stage, Fan Service

anime.title: A Portrait of Jianghu: Mourning Toast
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: Years ago, Zong Shuai from the Middle State, Wanyan Zang from the Northern Land, and Wen Taiji from the Southern Territory suffered great loss during their fight for the hegemony of the world. As a result, a 20-year truce was established. Now, with the deal coming to an end, conflicts are brewing in the ostensible peace. In hatred and suspicion, the three families set up their respective Blood Orders, listing the names of the most important people of the hostile families and swearing to hunt them down. A breathtaking war is about to commence.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are polarized. Some viewers praise the animation, fight choreography, and intricate plot. However, others criticize the confusing storyline, lack of focus on the main character, and overall incoherent narrative.
pros: Beautifully-animated characters with realistic facial expressions
Well-paced story with lots of interesting fights
Good story with lots of twists
cons: Storyline is all over the place
Main character is barely shown
Confusing plot

anime.title: Crayon Shin-chan Gaiden: O-o-o no Shinnosuke
anime.romaji_title: Crayon Shin-chan Gaiden: O-o-o no Shinnosuke
anime.synopsis: A small country town. Recently, the town has witnessed many strange incidents. A youkai kindergartner O-o-o no Shinnosuke (an apparent homage to the classic supernatural franchise Gegege no Kitarou) and his youkai father Tamatama Dad arrive in town. They are said to be looking for the yokai Big Butt Mom who has run away from home. When an elementary school girl Fumie Sakura is suddenly attacked by the mysterious Fuzzy Wuzzy, a superfluous-hair youkai, Shinnosuke goes to her aid. Their encounter is the start of the greatest youkai case in the small town's history.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA series is considered decent, with some finding it the best among the Amazon Originals. However, the short episode format and unrealized potential leave viewers wanting more. The series has some moments of laughter and well-written villains but ultimately feels like a missed opportunity for a successful movie.
pros: Well-written villains providing insight into misunderstood monsters.
Appealing 'small town with weird things happening' trope.
References to JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4
cons: Storyline potential not fully realized due to short episode format.
Half-baked moments hinder overall success.
Better suited as a movie than a series of short OVAs.

anime.title: Kuroko no Basket: Last Game NG-shuu
anime.romaji_title: Kuroko no Basket: Last Game NG-shuu
anime.synopsis: Animated bloopers, based on the extra section of the original manga, included with the BD/DVD release of Kuroko no Basket: Last Game.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'NG-shuu' is generally well-received as a lighthearted and funny addition to the Kuroko no Basket series, offering a chance to see the characters in a new light. While some appreciate it as a nostalgic epilogue, others find it inconsequential to the main storyline. There's a consensus that it serves as a fun, lighthearted break rather than a significant narrative extension.
pros: Lighthearted and funny bloopers provide enjoyable content.
Offers a way to revisit characters without rewatching the entire series.
Shows new aspects of characters, like Kuroko laughing.
Lightens intense moments of the anime.
cons: No character development or story benefits.
The movie felt forced and like an oversized OVA episode.
Final opponents were terribly meaningless.

anime.title: Encouragement of Climb Season 3
anime.genres: Adventure, CGDCT, Iyashikei, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
With the conclusion of an unforgettable summer break, Aoi Yukimura remains invigorated to continue pursuing her new hobby in mountaineering. Having braved her fear of heights and fulfilled her childhood promise with Hinata Kuraue, any opportunity to go climbing intrigues the first-year high school student—including a second chance to reach the summit of Mt. Fuji.

Although the formidable yet exciting trip is planned for next summer, Aoi is already preparing as much as she can to guarantee her success this time around. However, as budding expectations blossom with the shift of the seasons, ascending the unexplored peaks of colorful endeavors begins to strain the bond between the two longtime friends and the perspectives they share of the future.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many appreciated the focus on character development and relationships, finding it relatable and heartwarming. However, some viewers were disappointed by the reduced emphasis on mountain climbing and perceived inconsistencies in art quality, leading to a divergence in opinions regarding the season's overall quality.
pros: Focus on character relationships, particularly between Aoi and Hinata, resonated with viewers.
Character development, especially regarding introversion and friendship dynamics, was well-received.
Heartwarming moments and relatable situations enhanced the viewing experience.
cons: Reduced emphasis on mountain climbing disappointed some viewers.
Episodic structure and lack of a defined plot in comparison to previous seasons were criticized.
Art quality in some episodes was perceived as lower than previous seasons.

anime.title: Encouragement of Climb: "Omoide" Present
anime.genres: Adventure, CGDCT, Iyashikei, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
On the final day of summer vacation, Kokona Aoba is ready to spend some long-awaited time with her mother, but these plans are unfortunately canceled due to work. Opting to go outside instead, she takes a stroll down a familiar path—one where fond memories appear at every corner.

Later, in the middle of autumn, Hinata Kuraue and Aoi Yukimura are looking through a scrapbook of their childhood. Snooping around in Aoi's room, Hinata finds that she has kept a strange acorn as a keepsake, but doesn't remember the reason why. As its discovery dwells on her, a wave of old memories comes forth, causing her to reminisce about a forgotten event from her childhood. 

From time spent with loved ones to promises from the past, Yama no Susume: Omoide Present follows the three girls as they cherish old memories while crafting entirely new ones to remember.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Yama no Susume: Omoide Present' to be a sentimental and beautiful OVA that effectively explores themes of memory and growth. While some find the plot meandering, it's generally agreed upon that it serves as a perfect thematic setup for the third season, leaving viewers with a positive outlook.
pros: Beautiful exploration of memory and growth.
Thematically perfect setup for the next season.
cons: Meandering plot without a clear destination.

anime.title: Liz and the Blue Bird
anime.genres: Award Winning, Drama, Music, Performing Arts, School
anime.synopsis:
Liz's days of solitude come to an end when she meets a blue bird in the form of a young girl. Although their relationship blossoms, Liz must make a heart-wrenching decision in order to truly realize her love for Blue Bird.

High school seniors and close friends Mizore Yoroizuka and Nozomi Kasaki are tasked to play the lead instruments in the third movement of Liz and the Blue Bird, a concert band piece inspired by this fairy tale. The introverted and reserved Mizore plays the oboe, representing the kind and gentle Liz. Meanwhile, the radiant and popular Nozomi plays the flute, portraying the cheerful and energetic Blue Bird.

However, as they rehearse, the distance between Mizore and Nozomi seems to grow. Their disjointed duet disappoints the band, and with graduation on the horizon, uncertainty about the future spurs complicated emotions. With little time to improve as their performance draws near, they desperately attempt to connect with their respective characters. But when Mizore and Nozomi consider the story from a brand-new perspective, will the girls find the strength to face harsh realities?

A spin-off film adaptation of the Hibike Euphonium! series, Liz to Aoi Tori dances between the parallels of a charming fairy tale, a moving musical piece, and a delicate high school friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is largely positive, praising the film's artistic merit, emotional depth, and character development. Some viewers found the pacing slow or the story difficult to connect with, but most appreciate it as a beautiful and moving piece. Knowing the source material, Hibike Euphonium, will enhance the viewing experience.
pros: Beautiful art style and animation (typical KyoAni)
Impactful music and sound direction
Subtle and nuanced character development
Emotionally resonant and moving story
Effective symbolism
cons: Slow pacing may bore some viewers
Story might not resonate with all adults
Can be difficult to get into without prior knowledge of Hibike! Euphonium

anime.title: Sound! Euphonium: Our Promise: A Brand New Day
anime.romaji_title: Hibike! Euphonium Movie 3: Chikai no Finale
anime.synopsis:
A new year signifies a new beginning, and that seems to be the case for Kitauji High School’s concert band. Following the graduation of the third-year seniors comes the entrance of the first-year juniors. The band members put in their utmost effort in practicing for their goal—to enter nationals.

The now second-year Kumiko Oumae, along with her friends, is met with the new and quirky batch of first-years, resulting in friction and conflict between the band members. However, as time passes, their inner feelings slowly unravel, but not every conflict is as easy to solve as the other. The trust and bonds between the band members will be challenged as they push forward for their regionals.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with fans appreciating the continuation of the series and its signature aesthetics. However, many feel the movie is rushed and fails to fully develop new characters and conflicts. The condensed format leads to a less satisfying experience compared to the original seasons.
