pros: Amazing soundtrack and animation quality.
Continuation of the series with familiar themes.
Exploration of Kumiko's growth as a senpai.
cons: Rushed plot and underdeveloped new characters due to condensed movie format.
Recycled conflicts and character arcs from previous seasons.
Movie format limits depth and development compared to a full season.

anime.title: My Girlfriend is Shobitch
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Kanojo ga Majimesugiru Sho-bitch na Ken
anime.synopsis:
Haruka Shinozaki has been interested in the class representative, Akiho Kousaka, since his first year in high school. She is attractive, good at sports, and is an all-around model student. Since they are in the same class this year, Shinozaki decides to confess his feelings—and, to his shock, Kousaka agrees to be his girlfriend!

However, he finds that Kousaka is a bit stranger than he first thought: this seemingly perfect girl has never been in a relationship. But even though she is inexperienced, she vows to please Shinozaki in every way she can... such as learning multiple sex positions or his fetishes. Shinozaki tries to assure her that her studies into such subjects aren't necessary, but Kousaka devotes herself to making him happy in more ways than one.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided, with fans appreciating the raw, unfiltered dirty humor and casual enjoyment. However, detractors find the relentless sexual innuendo and crude jokes to be stale, unfunny, and indicative of poor writing and character development, leading to a polarizing viewing experience.
pros: Funny dirty jokes for fans of the genre
Decent art and animation for ecchi anime
Enjoyable and lighthearted for a casual watch
Good re-watch value for fans of the humor
cons: Relies too heavily on sexual innuendo and crude jokes
Weak and underdeveloped characters
Repetitive humor that becomes stale
Lack of a coherent plot or meaningful story
Forced gags and unbelievable scenarios

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai 5
anime.synopsis:
The mysterious masked Storyteller returns to tell more twisted tales of horror. Continuing his particular style of kamishibai inspired storytelling, he now finds that his audience is an eerie crowd of young girls, who eagerly await his devilish stories.

He recounts ghostly legends involving girls of all ages: a housewife who receives a barrage of chilling phone calls; a strange girl whose flower readings are always right; a mother and daughter's ominous meeting with the "crow lady"; and a young girl whose demands from others grow more and more outrageous with each request. Witness once again the Storyteller's haunting and gripping tales, which are sure to leave one with more than just chills...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed but leaning positive. Many viewers appreciate the return to the series' roots and the focus on genuine scares, finding it a refreshing change from previous seasons. However, inconsistencies in production quality and occasional unoriginality hold it back from being universally praised. Overall, the season is viewed as a step in the right direction.
pros: Recaptures the feeling of the first season, focusing on simple ghost stories.
Effective use of atmosphere and jump scares to create genuine fear.
Return to the original storytelling format enhances immersion.
cons: Inconsistent quality in art and animation across episodes.
Voice acting can be uneven, with some performances detracting from the experience.
Plot introductions and some episode conclusions feel unoriginal or out of place.

anime.title: ACCA: 13-ku Kansatsu-ka Specials
anime.synopsis: The Kingdom of Dowa is free at last of political tensions and coup d'état rumors. Jean and Lotta Otus spend their days together with their best friend Niino, enjoying carefree conversations accompanied by alcohol and cigarettes. Although they look out for any potential threat to Dowa, even the administrative leaders of ACCA seem to relax in the long-awaited warmth of peace.
anime.consensus_summary: The ACCA: 13-ku Kansatsu-ka Specials are well-received by fans of the main series. Viewers appreciate the focus on character interactions and the light-hearted, funny content. The only criticism revolves around the short episode length.
pros: Explores the daily lives of characters.
Funny and enjoyable.
Good script and dialogues that deepen love for the series.
Brings more dimension and depth into characters.
Focuses on side characters.
cons: Episodes are super short.
ED takes almost half of the episode.

anime.title: The Irresponsible Galaxy☆Tylor
anime.synopsis: Taking place in a very distant in future, the adventure begins when a boy meets a certain girl. The Pan Galaxy Republic has declined and so have many empires. This resulted to people in the galaxy being scattered. Living in the peaceful side of their world, Banjou, who picks up trashes at the spherical wall met a girl, frozen, in a broken spaceship. There are bad guys who chase her, and thus, the quiet galaxy suddenly became lively. Little did he know that the frozen girl is Goza 168th, the key to decide the destiny of the whole universe. Overcoming hardship, the two embarks on a trip to make the Galaxy Republic alive again. It may be a difficult challenge, but it's alright, let's progress slowly! A comedy of irresponsible galaxy trip begins!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience expresses strong disappointment with Musekinin Galaxy☆Tylor, especially fans of the original series. Reviewers feel the show fails as a revival, criticizing its poor attempts at humor, nonsensical plot, and flanderized characters. Overall, it's viewed as a waste of time and a disservice to the franchise.
pros: The sound department is the least bad aspect.
cons: The anime doesn't understand the structure of a joke; there is no set-up.
The plot is convoluted and makes no sense, filled with errors and plot holes.
Characters are basic shells of their original counterparts, lacking depth.
Abysmal CGI and mediocre art quality.
The soundtrack is unfitting and weak.
Story is a poor shadow of the original.
Random and out-of-place sexualization and homophobia.

anime.title: Pluto
anime.genres: Action, Detective, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Seinen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Gesicht, an android police detective of Europol, is tasked with finding the murderer of Montblanc, a retired war hero robot. Although it appears that only a robot could have committed this crime, the murder of a renowned robot rights activist casts doubts on the criminal's identity. Indeed, outside of an isolated and unexplained incident that occurred eight years ago, robots are programmed to be unable to kill human beings. However, the lack of human evidence on the crime scene and the similarity of modus operandi lead Gesicht to suspect that the two murderers might be the same being—be they man or robot.

Shortly after Montblanc's passing, another retired elite war robot is mysteriously eliminated. Gesicht notices a pattern in the choice of murder victim: both dead robots belonged to a group of the seven most powerful war machines ever designed. Determined to stop the murderer from eliminating the five remaining veterans, Gesicht seeks help from Atom, a cutting-edge android who resembles a human boy. The duo must now hunt down the rogue killer before the series of murders is carried on, lest the very fabric of society suffer irremediable damage.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the story's depth and emotional impact, as well as the quality of the adaptation. However, some viewers find the writing inconsistent, the plot illogical, and the ending unsatisfying. This creates a moderate level of polarization among viewers.
pros: Complex story with well-developed characters and emotional depth.
Excellent adaptation of the source material (Astro Boy arc).
High-quality animation and fitting soundtrack.
cons: Inconsistent writing with plot holes and illogical character decisions.
Overreliance on suspension of disbelief and unwarranted empathy.
Ending feels abrupt and unsatisfying for some viewers.

anime.title: Pikotaro's Lullaby La La By (TV)
anime.synopsis: Piko-tarou will improvise the story of each three-minute episode using an illustration by the anime's director Takashi Taniguchi. He will tell each story in the style of a fairy tale and voice every character, including himself.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding the show to be a comedic masterpiece due to its unique style and creative storytelling. Others find it silly and nonsensical, with the simple animation being a potential drawback. Overall, the show is appreciated for its absurdity and alternative perspective on classic tales, but it's not for everyone.
pros: Unique comedic style
Creative reimaginings of classic stories
Captivating and beautifully made
cons: Can be downright stupid
Minimal music
Animation style may not appeal to everyone

anime.title: Doraemon the Movie 2018: Nobita's Treasure Island
anime.synopsis: Doraemon: Nobita no Takarajima takes the well-known characters to the Caribbean Sea; Nobita is the captain of a ship and fights against his enemies. Shizuka is kidnapped and a storm prevents her persecution. When the adventurers finally find the mysterious Treasure Island, where they have taken Shizuka, they discover that it is something more than a common island.
anime.consensus_summary: The film is visually appealing and offers an adventurous storyline with positive messages about protecting the environment. However, the plot and character development are considered weak, which undermines the emotional impact, especially concerning the theme of familial love. Despite its flaws, it is still considered a worthwhile watch for Doraemon fans.
pros: Good art and visuals
Shizuka gets more screen time
Fun riddles added in
cons: Confusing premise
Superficial characters
Lack of character depth makes familial bonding theme feel superficial

anime.title: Comic Girls
anime.genres: CGDCT, Otaku Culture, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Kaoruko "Chaos" Moeta is a young manga artist who is down on her luck. She wants to draw manga about high school girls, but her storyboards are bland, her art uninspired, and her premises weak. Her concerned, exasperated editor comes up with an idea: push Chaos to be more social. So, by her recommendation, Chaos moves into a dormitory for female manga artists. She soon meets the other residents: Tsubasa Katsuki, a shounen manga artist; Ruki Irokawa, who draws erotic manga popular with women; and Koyume Koizuka, a shoujo artist who, like Chaos, has yet to be serialized. Quickly striking up a friendship with these girls, Chaos finds new inspiration for her manga and continues to grow her creativity.

Comic Girls is a showcase of the daily lives of these manga artists. Will Chaos finally be able to make her debut and become serialized? None of the girls know, but they will all do their best to help each other become the best artists they can be.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Comic Girls as a lighthearted and heartwarming slice-of-life anime. It is praised for its cute characters, relatable themes of artistic struggle, and comedic moments. However, some find the story simple and the characters somewhat stereotypical, leading to minor criticisms.
pros: Lovable and relatable characters
Unique art style and design
Genuine portrayal of creative struggles
Well-timed comedy and emotional scenes
cons: Episodic feel, lacking overarching plot
Characters can be stereotypical and annoying
Story can be simple and generic
anime.thematic_vibe: Cute Girls Doing Cute Things, Slice of Life, Aspiring Artists

anime.title: The Silver Guardian 2
anime.synopsis:
At Shinryou Private Academy—an expensive school for wealthy students—one would never expect to find the poverty-stricken Suigin Riku. When he is not working on one of his many part-time jobs to pay his tuition, he can often be found playing the RPG game Dungeon Century, where he has cultivated a relationship with an online friend. However, when Dungeon Century shuts down, he finds out that his crush, the kind-hearted Rei Riku, and his online friend are the same person. 

But in the aftermath of this revelation, Rei gets kidnapped and taken into Grave Buster, which is a new online game from the creators of Dungeon Century, forcing Suigin to enter the harsh new world of a pay-to-win game in order to save her. Gin no Guardian 2nd Season continues Suigin's quest to rescue Rei, while attempting to solve the mysteries of this strange game.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. Some viewers found Gin no Guardian II enjoyable despite its flaws, particularly praising the action and improved story compared to the first season. However, many were disappointed by the inconsistent plot, shallow characters, and abrupt ending, leading to frustration and a sense of unfulfilled potential. The series suffers from a lack of clear rules and meaningful character development, resulting in a mixed reception.
pros: Decent art and animation in some scenes, particularly fight scenes.
Enjoyable for some viewers despite flaws, especially those who enjoy the genre.
Improved story compared to the first season for some viewers.
cons: Inconsistent plot and world-building, with unexplained rules and plot holes.
Shallow character development and inconsistent character behavior.
Poor pacing and wasted time, with dialogue dragging on and flashbacks that don't add to the story.
Unsatisfying resolutions and reliance on convenient plot devices.
Abrupt ending without a conclusion.

anime.title: Knights of Sidonia: Love Woven in the Stars
anime.romaji_title: Sidonia no Kishi: Ai Tsumugu Hoshi
anime.synopsis:
After the Earth was destroyed by mysterious alien lifeforms known as the Gauna, surviving remnants of the human race escaped to space in the enormous generation ship Sidonia. Having drifted through space for millennia, the Sidonia found itself once more under attack from Gauna for the first time in a century.

Once again facing the threat of extinction, a temporary victory against the Gauna was eked out thanks to the human-Gauna hybrid Tsumugi Shiraui and ace Guardian mech pilot Nagate Tanikaze.

10 years later... The people of Sidonia enjoy a brief respite. Peaceful days pass, during which Tsumugi begins to realize her feelings for Nagate, who is now celebrated as a hero of Sidonia. However, as Captain Kobayashi has always known, as long as the Gauna remain, peace cannot last.

The decision is made: a final battle, upon which rests the fate of humanity's last survivors. As the end approaches, will the crew be able to protect those they love?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on 'Sidonia no Kishi: Ai Tsumugu Hoshi'. While praised for its visual enhancements and action, many find the plot rushed and the character development lacking. Some viewers appreciate the attempt to conclude the story, but others feel it betrays the darker tone of the earlier seasons. Ultimately, the film is seen as a visually impressive but narratively flawed conclusion.
pros: Visually stunning animation and special effects, a significant upgrade from previous seasons.
Strong action sequences and space combat, providing an engaging spectacle.
Satisfying conclusion to certain character arcs and plot elements.
cons: Rushed and glossed-over plot points, leading to a sense of wasted potential.
Underdeveloped character relationships, with a time skip that feels inconsequential.
Weakened sense of tragedy and realistic dread compared to Season 1, resulting in a less impactful narrative.

anime.title: Attack on Titan Season 3
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Military, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Still threatened by the "Titans" that rob them of their freedom, mankind remains caged inside the two remaining walls. Efforts to eradicate these monsters continue; however, threats arise not only from the Titans beyond the walls, but from the humans within them as well.

After being rescued from the Colossal and Armored Titans, Eren Yaeger devotes himself to improving his Titan form. Krista Lenz struggles to accept the loss of her friend, Captain Levi chooses Eren and his friends to form his new personal squad, and Commander Erwin Smith recovers from his injuries. All seems well for the soldiers, until the government suddenly demands custody of Eren and Krista. The Survey Corps' recent successes have drawn attention, and a familiar face from Levi's past is sent to collect the wanted soldiers. Sought after by the government, Levi and his new squad must evade their adversaries in hopes of keeping Eren and Krista safe.

Eren and his fellow soldiers are not only fighting for their survival against the terrifying Titans, but also against the terror of a far more conniving foe: their fellow humans.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Season 3 is notably divided. Some viewers praise the season's complex political narrative, improved animation, and deeper exploration of lore and character backstories. However, others criticize the slow pacing, lack of action, inconsistent character development, and perceived shift away from the core themes of the series, leading to disappointment and accusations of overrated status.
pros: Improved animation quality, particularly in action sequences (Levi vs. Kenny)
Strong world-building and lore expansion
Engaging plot twists and conspiracy elements
Exploration of character backstories (Levi, Eren's father)
cons: Pacing issues, with some plotlines dragging on
Overemphasis on politics at the expense of action for some viewers
Inconsistent character development, with some characters devolving
Anti-climatic villain deaths
Disappointment for viewers seeking more Titan action
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Loss of Innocence, Moral Ambiguity

anime.title: Kingdom Hearts χ Back Cover
anime.synopsis: Long ago, in the "age of fairy tales," the world's light is protected by seven individuals who reside in Daybreak Town and wield unique weapons called "Keyblades": the Master of Masters and his six apprentices. A devastating conflict has been foreseen, and the world's end is imminent. In order to heal it, the Master of Masters gives his disciples unique roles and instructs them to form Unions comprised of other Keyblade wielders. Soon afterwards, the Master vanishes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with strong criticism aimed at its accessibility and production quality. It is generally agreed that prior knowledge of the Kingdom Hearts lore, particularly from the mobile games, is essential to understanding the movie. While some appreciate its contribution to the overall narrative, many find it confusing and poorly executed.
pros: Provides context to the Kingdom Hearts universe for dedicated fans.
Introduces forces and elements of the mobile game.
English dubbing is well-done.
cons: Not outsider-friendly; requires prior knowledge of Kingdom Hearts lore.
Poor direction and static camera angles.
Story doesn't provide meaningful context and has loose threads.
Vocal performances are subpar.

anime.title: Rilakkuma and Kaoru
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Iyashikei, Kids, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Rilakkuma is a soft toy bear who showed up one day to live with a young woman named Kaoru. It spends its days lounging around the apartment. Although there is a zipper on its back, what is inside is a mystery. Rilakkuma loves pancakes, rice omelets, custard pudding and "dango" rice dumplings. Its friends are Kaoru's pet bird Kiiroitori and a small white bear cub named Korilakkuma who also showed up out of the blue.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find the show cute, relaxing, and surprisingly relatable to adults despite its seemingly childish premise. The stop-motion animation is generally praised for its charm, and the show's gentle life lessons resonate with viewers.
pros: Relatable to adults despite being cute
Unique stop-motion animation with charming visuals
Wholesome and relaxing with important life lessons
cons: Stop-motion animation can be initially off-putting to some
Slow-paced nature may not appeal to all viewers
Human character designs are not as strong as the animal designs
anime.thematic_vibe: Mental Hygiene, Slice of Life, Gentle Humor

anime.title: Food Wars! The Third Plate
anime.romaji_title: Shokugeki no Souma: San no Sara
anime.synopsis:
The Moon Festival is Tootsuki Academy's annual gourmet gala, where students compete against each other to earn the most profit through selling their cuisine of choice. But for Souma Yukihira, it is also his first opportunity to challenge the Elite Ten, the supreme council that rules over the academy.  

However, this is only the beginning of Souma's war against the Elite Ten; a nefarious plot is underway that will provide Souma with the challenge he desires but will also shake the very foundations of Tootsuki Academy itself.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed regarding the third season. While some viewers enjoyed the introduction of new characters and higher stakes, others were critical of the rushed pacing, animation quality, and deviation from the source material. The season's shift in tone and increased absurdity also divided viewers, leading to a polarizing reception.
pros: Exciting and intense Shokugekis
Introduction of Elite Ten and deeper Totsuki culture exploration
Unpredictable story with suspenseful food battles
cons: Rushed and misplaced scenes compared to the manga
Inconsistent animation quality and overuse of still images
Repetitive formula with lack of character development
Absurdity of the premise increases, straining believability
anime.thematic_vibe: Culinary Battles, High Stakes, School Rivalry

anime.title: Yowamushi Pedal: Glory Line
anime.synopsis: Fourth season of the Yowamushi Pedal series.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided regarding Yowamushi Pedal: Glory Line. While some appreciate the consistent animation, music, and themes, many feel the season suffers from pacing issues, repetitive storytelling, and uninteresting new characters. Some viewers find the excessive flashbacks and drawn-out sequences detrimental, while others enjoy the comedic charm. Overall, the season fails to live up to the expectations set by earlier seasons.
pros: Consistent music and themes across seasons create emotional resonance.
Well-animated visuals capture the spirit of cycling and racing.
Continuing themes of passing the torch and talent development resonate with viewers.
cons: Pacing issues with excessive flashbacks and drawn-out sequences.
Repetitive storytelling and lack of innovation compared to earlier seasons.
Uninteresting or annoying new characters detract from the overall experience.
Over-reliance on character-centric comedy at the expense of plot progression.

anime.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero
anime.synopsis:
The Four Cardinal Heroes are a group of ordinary men from modern-day Japan summoned to the kingdom of Melromarc to become its saviors. Melromarc is a country plagued by the Waves of Catastrophe that have repeatedly ravaged the land and brought disaster to its citizens for centuries. The four heroes are respectively bestowed a sword, spear, bow, and shield to vanquish these Waves. Naofumi Iwatani, an otaku, becomes cursed with the fate of being the "Shield Hero." Armed with only a measly shield, Naofumi is belittled and ridiculed by his fellow heroes and the kingdom's people due to his weak offensive capabilities and lackluster personality.

When the heroes are provided with resources and comrades to train with, Naofumi sets out with the only person willing to train alongside him, Malty Melromarc. He is soon betrayed by her, however, and becomes falsely accused of taking advantage of her. Naofumi then becomes heavily discriminated against and hated by the people of Melromarc for something he didn't do. With a raging storm of hurt and mistrust in his heart, Naofumi begins his journey of strengthening himself and his reputation. Further along however, the difficulty of being on his own sets in, so Naofumi buys a demi-human slave on the verge of death named Raphtalia to accompany him on his travels.

As the Waves approach the kingdom, Naofumi and Raphtalia must fight for the survival of the kingdom and protect the people of Melromarc from their ill-fated future.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Some viewers appreciate the dark and cynical themes, along with the protagonist's struggle to overcome adversity. Others criticize the show for relying on overused isekai tropes, mishandling sensitive subject matter, and having a decline in quality after the initial episodes, resulting in a generic power fantasy.
pros: Unique premise of a hero starting from rock bottom
Exploration of trust issues and character development
Engaging portrayal of overcoming adversity
cons: Overused isekai tropes
Inconsistent plot and world-building
Questionable handling of sensitive subjects (slavery, accusations)

anime.title: Case Closed Movie 22: Zero the Enforcer
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 22: Zero no Shikkounin
anime.genres: Action, Award Winning, Detective, Drama, Mystery
anime.synopsis: In the film's story, there is a sudden explosion at Tokyo Summit's giant Edge of Ocean facility. The shadow of Tooru Amuro, who works for the National Police Agency Security Bureau as Zero, appears at the site. In addition, the "triple-face" character is known as Rei Furuya as a detective and Kogorou Mouri's apprentice, and he is also known as Bourbon as a Black Organization member. Kogorou is arrested as a suspect in the case of the explosion. Conan conducts an investigation to prove Kogorou's innocence, but Amuro gets in his way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed, with praise for the action and character development, especially concerning Furuya. However, many criticize the unrealistic plot, weak characterization of Ran, and the overall departure from the mystery elements of the series. The film's focus on action and sci-fi elements divides viewers, with some enjoying the thrills while others find it detrimental to the core Conan experience.
pros: Excellent pacing and engaging story.
Dynamic character development, especially for original characters.
Furuya's prominent role is well-received.
cons: Unrealistic action sequences and sci-fi elements clash with the main series.
Weak characterization of Ran and her obsession with Shinichi.
Absurd and illogical plot points, particularly involving the Detective Boys and PSB.

anime.title: Haikyu!!: VS "Failing Marks"
anime.synopsis: Right before the volleyball club's training camp in Tokyo, both Shouyou Hinata and Tobio Kageyama fail a final exam. As the make-up exams and the trip overlap, the boys plead their desperate case to the vice principal to no avail. Since their indispensable teammates are forced to stay behind to study, the club's members find different ways to help them pass and join the camp in time.
anime.consensus_summary: The Haikyuu!! OVA focusing on Hinata and Kageyama's academic struggles is well-received as a humorous and insightful addition to the series. It expands on existing plot points and offers further character development, particularly regarding team dynamics. While some find it inessential, most appreciate the lightheartedness and extra content.
pros: Expands on existing story elements, filling in gaps.
Highlights character development and dynamics.
Humorous and enjoyable, offering lighthearted moments.
cons: May feel inessential if familiar with the main series.
Less volleyball action compared to the main series.
Limited background music in some instances.

anime.title: ERASED Digest
anime.romaji_title: Boku dake ga Inai Machi Recaps
anime.genres: Mystery, Psychological, Seinen, Suspense, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: Recap episodes of Boku dake ga Inai Machi covering episodes 1 to 6 and episodes 7 to 11.
anime.consensus_summary: The recap episodes are generally well-received as a helpful refresher for viewers who may have forgotten details or taken a break from the series. While some find it unnecessary for binge-watchers, others appreciate the fast-paced summary of key plot points and character information. The main criticisms revolve around the speed of the text and potential difficulties for dub watchers.
pros: Effectively refreshes memory of the first episodes.
Highlights important moments and information.
Helpful for viewers who took a break during the series.
Confirms character identities and key plot points.
cons: Unnecessary for binge-watchers.
Fast-paced text can be difficult to read, requiring pausing.
Dub watchers may find it jarring if no dub version is available.
Simultaneous text and dialogue can be confusing for non-Japanese speakers.

anime.title: Chio's School Road
anime.synopsis:
For the average Japanese high school student, walking to school can be a chore, but for first-year Chio Miyamo, it's always an adventure. Constantly running late due to her long night sessions playing video games, she is forced to come up with new routes to make it to Samejima Private Academy on time. 

On her many bizarre journeys to school, Chio contends with obstacles like street-blocking detours, overzealous kabaddi players, and befuddled motorcycle gang leaders. But these minor hindrances are no match for the special ops training that Chio, AKA the legendary assassin "Bloody Butterfly," has received from her extensive gaming obsession. Together with her best friends Manana Nonomura and Yuki Hosokawa, Chio will do whatever it takes to avoid her school's harsh penalties for tardiness.
anime.consensus_summary: Chio-chan no Tsuugakuro is a comedy anime that follows a high school gamer's bizarre journey to school.  While some appreciate the show's unique humor and memorable characters, others are turned off by its pervy elements and over-the-top jokes. Overall, audience reception is mixed depending on sensitivity to ecchi content.
pros: The show's self-awareness and over-the-top situations create a unique and funny experience.
The characters are memorable and well-suited to the anime's comedic style.
The supporting cast is strong and adds to the show's humor.
cons: The show relies on pervy humor and panty shots which can be off-putting to some viewers.
Some jokes can go overboard, resembling mature Western cartoons in toilet humor.
The predatory lesbian character and the sexualization of young girls are gross and uncomfortable.

anime.title: Interviews With Monster Girls: The Demi-chans' Summer Break
anime.romaji_title: Demi-chan wa Kataritai: Demi-chan no Natsuyasumi
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Mythology, School, Seinen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: During summer break, Tetsuo asks Sakie to join him on patrol duty for the local summer festival, which both the demis and Himari and her friends go to. As each group decides to check out a nearby shrine, they get spooked by some strange occurrences, which turn out to be each other. As the next term begins, Tetsuo converses with an invisible woman named Matsuri.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for this OVA is largely positive among existing fans, who appreciate it as a delightful bonus episode that offers more of what they loved about the original series: its characters and their interactions. However, viewers seeking plot development or new thematic explorations will find it lacking, leading to a mild split in opinion based on expectations.
pros: Delivers enjoyable and lighthearted character interactions, which is the main appeal for fans.
Maintains the charm and familiar dynamics of the original series, providing a comfortable viewing experience.
Visually appealing art style, especially during festival scenes like fireworks and lights.
Successfully captures the essence of a summer festival with classic elements.
cons: Lacks significant plot progression or character development, making it feel like a disposable episode for some.
Offers nothing new in terms of animation, art, or sound compared to the original series.
May be a waste of time for viewers looking for depth or psychological aspects similar to the TV series.

anime.title: How to Keep a Mummy
anime.genres: Mythology, Pets, School, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
High school student Sora Kashiwagi is accustomed to receiving bizarre presents from his father, who is on an expedition around the world. Unfortunately, these gifts have been nothing but nightmares. As a result, when his father sends him a huge package from Egypt, Sora prepares himself for the worst, only to be greeted by Mii-kun—a cute, pint-sized mummy! While initially wary, Sora soon learns that Mii-kun is harmless, a delicate creature yearning for attention.

Throughout their amusing day-to-day lives, the unlikely pair meet other people with unique pets, while also strengthening their bond together. Although keeping a pet is a difficult task, Sora is set on caring for the lovable Mii-kun.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with viewers finding the anime incredibly cute, wholesome, and relaxing.  The show's strength lies in its heartwarming relationships and adorable characters, making it a perfect comfort anime.  While some criticize the lack of a strong plot and underdeveloped side characters, the overall sentiment is one of enjoyment and appreciation for the show's ability to evoke feelings of warmth and happiness.
pros: Heartwarming relationships between humans and creatures
Adorable and expressive character designs, especially the creatures
Relaxing and enjoyable slice-of-life format
cons: Lack of a strong overarching plot
Underdeveloped side characters
Some plot points feel rushed or unresolved

anime.title: Angolmois: Record of Mongol Invasion
anime.synopsis: The year is 1274. After conquering most of the known world, the Mongols turn their sights on Japan and their first step on the road to a full invasion of the mainland is taking Tsushima Island. Kuchii Jinzaburou and a group exiles are sent by the Kamakura Shogunate to the island at the request of Princess Teruhi. There they will face overwhelming odds and the fate of Tsushima will be decided!
anime.consensus_summary: Angolmois: Genkou Kassenki receives generally positive feedback for its engaging war story, strategic combat, and historical setting. However, some viewers are critical of the inconsistent animation, underdeveloped antagonists, and weak character development. Despite these flaws, the anime is considered an underrated gem with a satisfying, albeit tragic, ending. The audience appreciates the realistic portrayal of war and the strategic elements, making it an enjoyable watch for fans of historical action.
pros: Compelling war story with realistic portrayal of battles and character deaths.
Strong main character with good strategic thinking and combat skills.
Engaging plot with unexpected twists and betrayals.
Authentic depiction of historical events and weaponry.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and distracting visual filter.
Underdeveloped antagonists and lack of focus on their motivations.
Weak relationship building and forced romantic subplot.
Uneven character development for supporting cast.

anime.title: RErideD: Derrida, who leaps through time
anime.synopsis:
The year is 2050. A young engineer named Derrida Yvain became famous thanks to his contribution to the development of the "Autonomous Machine DZ" at Rebuild, the manufacturing company founded by his father. One day, Derrida and his colleague Nathan discover a flaw in the DZs and try to warn their boss, but are ignored. Although Derrida and Nathan are aware of the danger, they reluctantly decide to put off taking any measures, and instead go to Nathan's daughter Mage's birthday party. The next day, after enjoying a peaceful day, Derrida and Nathan are suddenly attacked by unknown forces. At the end of the escape, Derrida falls into a cold sleep machine and 10 years later, he wakes up to a devastated world in the middle of a war. While Derrida is attacked by a group of out of control DZs, he almost gives up, but he recalls Nathan's last words.

"Take care of Mage."

Despite the harsh fate that has fallen upon him, Derrida sets off to seek Mage.
anime.consensus_summary: RErideD: Tokigoe no Derrida is largely considered a disappointment due to its poorly executed plot, weak characters, and underwhelming animation. While the initial premise and some side stories showed potential, the series failed to deliver a cohesive and engaging narrative. Many viewers found the time travel mechanics illogical and the overall experience mediocre, leading to a generally negative reception.
pros: Interesting initial premise.
Good background art in some scenes.
Satisfactory ending for some viewers.
Some enjoyed the sound effects and ending song.
cons: Poorly executed plot with many contrivances.
Weak and unmemorable characters.
Inconsistent pacing and a messy storyline.
Underwhelming animation and art style.
Poorly explained and illogical time travel mechanics.
Uneven character development; some characters feel irrelevant or wasted.
Questionable writing decisions and plot holes.

anime.title: Girls' Last Tour
anime.genres: Adventure, Iyashikei, Mystery, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Amid the desolate remains of a once-thriving city, only the rumbling of a motorbike breaks the cold winter silence. Its riders, Chito and Yuuri, are the last survivors in the war-torn city. Scavenging old military sites for food and parts, the two girls explore the wastelands and speculate about the old world to pass the time. Chito and Yuuri each occasionally struggle with the looming solitude, but when they have each other, sharing the weight of being two of the last humans becomes a bit more bearable. Between Yuuri's clumsy excitement and Chito's calm composure, their dark days get a little brighter with shooting practice, new books, and snowball fights on the frozen battlefield. 

Among a scenery of barren landscapes and deserted buildings, Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou tells the uplifting tale of two girls and their quest to find hope in a bleak and dying world.
anime.consensus_summary: Most viewers found Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou to be a deeply moving and thought-provoking anime that explores themes of survival, friendship, and the meaning of life in a post-apocalyptic world. The melancholic atmosphere, beautiful visuals, and strong character dynamics were widely praised. While some found the pacing slow and the themes superficially explored, the majority appreciated the unique and philosophical nature of the story.
pros: Thoughtful exploration of post-apocalyptic themes and the meaning of life.
Beautiful background imagery and world-building.
Strong character dynamics and development of the two main characters.
Unique and unreplicable story with a deeply philosophical message.
Soothing yet melancholic soundtrack enhances the atmosphere.
cons: Pacing can be slow, with some finding it boring due to lack of action.
Superficial exploration of themes for some viewers.
Visual presentation may obscure the deeper, darker meaning for some.
Ending may be perceived as depressing.

anime.title: A Place Further Than The Universe
anime.synopsis:
Filled with an overwhelming sense of wonder for the world around her, Mari Tamaki has always dreamt of what lies beyond the reaches of the universe. However, despite harboring such large aspirations on the inside, her fear of the unknown and anxiety over her own possible limitations have always held her back from chasing them. But now, in her second year of high school, Mari is more determined than ever to not let any more of her youth go to waste. Still, her fear continues to prevent her from taking that ambitious step forward—that is, until she has a chance encounter with a girl who has grand dreams of her own.

Spurred by her mother's disappearance, Shirase Kobuchizawa has been working hard to fund her trip to Antarctica. Despite facing doubt and ridicule from virtually everyone, Shirase is determined to embark on this expedition to search for her mother in a place further than the universe itself. Inspired by Shirase's resolve, Mari jumps at the chance to join her. Soon, their efforts attract the attention of the bubbly Hinata Miyake, who is eager to stand out, and Yuzuki Shiraishi, a polite girl from a high class background. Together, the four spirited girls set sail toward the frozen south, all in search of something great.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves Sora yori mo Tooi Basho for its heartwarming story, well-developed characters, and themes of friendship and adventure. Some find the drama forced and the tone inconsistent, but the overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive. Many viewers were deeply moved by the series.
pros: Well-developed characters with great chemistry
Inspiring and emotional story about youth and self-discovery
Unique plot and setting (Antarctica)
cons: Forced drama and melodrama
Inconsistencies in tone (serious vs. slice-of-life)
Overreliance on cuteness

anime.title: FLCL Alternative
anime.genres: Avant Garde, Comedy, Mecha, Parody, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
Life seems to drift by for Kana Koumoto and her friends in their small Japanese town. Every day is just like the last, and it feels like every new day will be the same. Kana goes to school, hangs out with her friends, and likes to paint her nails and listen to music, but it feels like nothing special is ever going to happen. 

As a change of pace, Kana and her friends decide to design a bottle rocket and launch it into space, even though it might not get there at all. However, just when the rocket is completed, a robot suddenly crashes into and destroys it, shortly followed by a pink-haired woman claiming to be a "Galactic Investigator." Kana's life quickly becomes more exciting than she ever imagined, dealing with new feelings, changing friends, and even boy troubles. It turns out life can go by in the blink of an eye, fast enough to even miss it, so what's with these weird robots that seem to show up at the worst times?!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for FLCL Alternative is notably divided, with many praising its focus on female friendships and improved production values over its predecessor, Progressive. However, a significant portion of viewers feel it fundamentally misses the spirit of the original FLCL, criticizing its writing, pacing, and perceived lack of originality and depth. This polarization stems from differing expectations of what constitutes a true FLCL sequel and how to translate its unique energy to a new cast and narrative.
pros: Strong chemistry and genuine interactions between the main group of teenage girls.
Organic portrayal of teenage culture and relatable character moments.
Haruko's characterization and performance are highlights, serving as a unifying force.
Visually lively and fluid animation, with improved art direction and character designs compared to Progressive.
The OST, particularly The Pillows' music, is well-utilized and nostalgic.
Attempts a fresh angle by focusing on female protagonists' coming-of-age.
Production values are generally praised, with some scenes being well-executed.
Offers a more positive and enjoyable experience than FLCL Progressive for many.
cons: Writing can be too blunt and lacks the subtlety of the original.
Some dramatic scenes feel boilerplate or forced.
Visually varied sequences can drag on and feel awkward.
Lack of narrative escalation or reason to care about the larger plot for a significant portion of the series.
The middle section feels underdeveloped and wasteful.
The reasoning behind the conflict in episode 5 is illogical.
Characters can be generic and uninspired, particularly the protagonist Kana.
Pacing is often described as terrible, disjointed, and poorly structured.
The ending is often perceived as contrived, out-of-left-field, or unsatisfying.
Some find the show generic, boring, and lacking the emotional depth or experimental nature of the original.
The thematic elements, while present, are not handled with the same nuance as the original.
English voice acting is sometimes criticized as monotonous or bland.
The show is seen by some as a downgrade from the original and an unnecessary sequel.
Haruko's role can feel diminished or directionless compared to the original.
Thematic messages are sometimes perceived as overly blunt or simplistic.
Plot elements from the original are sometimes seen as mere retreads without adding depth.

anime.title: Gintama. Slip Arc
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Following the grim events of Iga, Kokujou Island, Rakuyou, and multiple fruitless confrontations with the Tenshouin Naraku and Tendoshuu, Gintama. Porori-hen takes its viewers on a trip down memory lane to when Yorozuya were mostly doing what they did best—odd jobs. The great space hunter Umibouzu has returned to Edo and is livid when he finds out that his daughter Kagura has a boyfriend. He blames Gintoki for being an incompetent guardian, but has the time finally come for him to let go of his daughter?

Back with shameless parodies, risqué humor, and lively camaraderie, Gintoki, Kagura, and Shinpachi are faced with unforeseen situations that manage to be both hilarious and emotionally stirring.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the return to Gintama's comedic roots and enjoy the lighthearted, stand-alone episodes. However, others find the season lacking in depth and story progression compared to previous arcs, ultimately feeling like enjoyable filler.
pros: Return to classic Gintama comedy style
Good for viewers already invested in the series and characters
Stand-alone episodes are easy to watch and enjoy
Improved art and sound quality
cons: Lacks the epicness and depth of plot-centric arcs
Feels like filler and lacks overall story progression
Comedy can be repetitive and not as original as earlier seasons
Arcs may feel forced together
May be jarring for viewers expecting a continuation of serious arcs

anime.title: SSSS.Gridman
anime.synopsis:
Yuuta Hibiki wakes up in the room of Rikka Takarada and notices two things: he has no memories, and he can hear a mysterious voice calling his name from a nearby room. On further inspection, he finds a robot—which introduces itself as Hyper Agent Gridman—behind the screen of an old computer. Much to Yuuta's surprise, Rikka cannot hear Gridman, nor can she see the ominous monsters looming over a thick fog as it envelopes the town outside.

Another giant monster materializes in the city and proceeds to wreak havoc. Amidst the confusion, Yuuta is once again drawn to the old computer and merges with Gridman. Suddenly, he appears in the middle of the battle and is forced to fight the monster. Together with Rikka and fellow classmate Shou Utsumi, Yuuta forms the "Gridman Alliance" to defeat the monsters plaguing the city and find whoever is responsible for their emergence.
anime.consensus_summary: SSSS.Gridman is a mixed bag, with some viewers praising its nostalgic elements and action, while others criticize its slow start, formulaic story, and animation quality. The show is appreciated as a tribute to tokusatsu and mecha genres, but falls short of being a masterpiece for many. Fan service elements and perceived lack of depth also contribute to the divided opinions.
pros: Interesting mix of old and new concepts
Good execution
Enjoyable action scenes
cons: Slow and predictable early episodes
Mediocre CG animation
Formulaic story
Repetitive animation

anime.title: Promare
anime.synopsis:
Thirty years ago, a new race of flame-wielding mutants suddenly appeared, destroying a large portion of humanity. These so-called “Burnish” have continued to appear at random, leaving a trail of death and destruction in their wake.

The autonomous republic of Promepolis is a thriving nation thanks to the incredible efforts of their leader, Kray Foresight, against the Burnish. A team of firefighters known as the Burning Rescue is tasked with stopping these horrifying monsters, using the most performant technology available thanks to their incredible mechanic Lucia Fex. Galo Thymos is an energetic young man, who considers Foresight his hero for saving his life and is the rescue team's most recent recruit. 

A terrorist group calling themselves Mad Burnish has been causing havoc all over the nation. After an encounter with Mad Burnish leader Lio Fotia, Galo sets out on his fated journey to find the truth about these mutants, ultimately leading him to question everything he previously held to be true.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. While praised for its visual flair, energetic action, and soundtrack, many criticize the shallow plot, underdeveloped characters, and rushed pacing. The film is recommended for die-hard Trigger fans who prioritize style over substance, but others may find it disappointing.
pros: Visually stunning with a unique blend of 2D and 3D animation.
Soundtrack is a highlight, perfectly complementing the action.
Energetic and fast-paced, keeping viewers engaged.
cons: Plot is weak, rushed, and lacks depth.
Characters are flat and underdeveloped, resembling archetypes from previous works.
Story feels like a cramfest of exposition, lacking build-up and impact.

anime.title: DARLING in the FRANXX
anime.synopsis:
In the distant future, humanity has been driven to near-extinction by giant beasts known as Klaxosaurs, forcing the surviving humans to take refuge in massive fortress cities called Plantations. Children raised here are trained to pilot giant mechas known as FranXX—the only weapons known to be effective against the Klaxosaurs—in boy-girl pairs. Bred for the sole purpose of piloting these machines, these children know nothing of the outside world and are only able to prove their existence by defending their race.  

Hiro, an aspiring FranXX pilot, has lost his motivation and self-confidence after failing an aptitude test. Skipping out on his class' graduation ceremony, Hiro retreats to a forest lake, where he encounters a mysterious girl with two horns growing out of her head. She introduces herself by her codename Zero Two, which is known to belong to an infamous FranXX pilot known as the "Partner Killer." Before Hiro can digest the encounter, the Plantation is rocked by a sudden Klaxosaur attack. Zero Two engages the creature in her FranXX, but it is heavily damaged in the skirmish and crashes near Hiro. Finding her partner dead, Zero Two invites Hiro to pilot the mecha with her, and the duo easily defeats the Klaxosaur in the ensuing fight. With a new partner by his side, Hiro has been given a chance at redemption for his past failures, but at what cost?
anime.consensus_summary: Darling in the FranXX is a visually appealing anime with a strong initial story that falters significantly in its second half. While praised for its character interactions, sound design, and unique mech designs, it's heavily criticized for its derivative plot, forced romance, and rushed ending. The audience is polarized, with some appreciating the emotional connections and others decrying the messy and uninspired narrative.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation, especially character designs.
Excellent sound design, including opening and ending themes, and impactful OST.
Engaging character interactions and development, focusing on bonds and relationships.
Unique mech designs
cons: Inconsistent and rushed story progression, particularly in the second half.
Derivative plot elements from other mecha anime like Evangelion and Gurren Lagann.
Overreliance on forced romance drama and contrived scenarios.
Poorly developed and underutilized side characters.
Questionable and excessive fan service that detracts from the story.

anime.title: Maquia: When the Promised Flower Blooms
anime.romaji_title: Sayonara no Asa ni Yakusoku no Hana wo Kazarou
anime.synopsis:
Maquia is a member of a special race called the Iorph—mystical beings who can live for hundreds of years and remain separate from the lives and daily troubles of mankind. However, Maquia has always felt lonely despite being surrounded by her people, as she was orphaned from a young age. She daydreams about the outside world, but dares not travel from her home due to the warnings of the clan's chief.

One day however, the outside world finds her, as the power-hungry kingdom of Mezarte invades her homeland. They already have what is left of the giant dragons, the Renato, under their control, and now their king wishes to add the immortality of the Iorph to his bloodline.

The humans and their Renato ravage the Iorph homeland and kill most of its inhabitants. Caught in the midst of the attack, Maquia is carried off by one of the Renato that has gone berserk. It soon dies, and she is left deserted in a forest far from home, now truly alone save for the cries of a single baby off in the distance. Maquia finds the baby in a destroyed village and decides to raise him as her own, naming him Ariel. Although she knows nothing of the human world, how to raise a child that ages much faster than her, or how to live with the smoldering loneliness inside, she is determined to make it all work somehow.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers found 'Sayonara no Asa ni Yakusoku no Hana wo Kazarou' to be a deeply moving masterpiece with stunning visuals and a compelling story of motherhood. Others criticized it for a disjointed plot, inconsistent character development, and an overreliance on emotional manipulation, ultimately finding the film disappointing despite its visual strengths.
pros: Stunning visuals and art style, especially backgrounds and landscapes.
Well-developed world-building that feels natural and lived-in.
Good voice acting.
Compelling exploration of motherhood.
cons: Inconsistent character motivations and development.
Plot is all over the place with time jumps and coincidences.
Pacing issues with slow starts and sudden jumps.
Some find the emotional impact forced or unearned.

anime.title: Lupin the Third Part 5
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Genius thief Arsene Lupin III—along with the usual crew of Goemon Ishikawa XIII, Fujiko Mine, and Daisuke Jigen—finds himself in modern-day France, where he encounters both new and old adversaries, with Inspector Kouichi Zenigata still hot on his trail. As they steal from darker, more sinister entities, they will also have to find a way to deal with the newest technology in their escapades, as well as face the ghosts of their pasts. However, this time, Lupin's choices begin to catch up with him as his pursuers use every tool at their disposal to take him down once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Lupin III: Part 5 is largely positive, praising its modernization of the series and exploration of character relationships. Some viewers found certain plot elements or animation choices inconsistent, but overall, the series is considered a worthwhile addition to the Lupin franchise, particularly for longtime fans. The series successfully blends nostalgia with contemporary themes, although with minor flaws.
pros: Exploration of character relationships, particularly Lupin and Fujiko
Modernization of Lupin with technology and social media
Nostalgic elements and callbacks to previous Lupin series
Well-written stories with a balance of humor, action, and violence
Engaging with contemporary political issues and the impact of technology
cons: Inconsistent animation quality in some episodes
Initial storyline with livestreaming plot seen as corny by some
Some plot elements feel forced or out of character
Art direction less stylized compared to previous parts

anime.title: Teasing Master Takagi-san
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Having a friend that knows you inside out should be a good thing, but in Nishikata's case, the opposite is true.

His classmate Takagi loves to tease him on a daily basis, and she uses her extensive knowledge of his behavior to predict exactly how he will react to her teasing, making it nearly impossible for Nishikata to ever make a successful comeback. Despite this, Nishikata vows to someday give Takagi a taste of her own medicine by making her blush out of embarrassment from his teasing.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers find the anime a cute and wholesome slice-of-life rom-com with refreshing characters and innocent love, while others criticize its repetitive formula, lack of character development, and the potentially problematic dynamic between the main characters. The show's episodic nature and slow pace are also points of contention, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Refreshing and wholesome feel.
Cute art style and decent soundtrack.
Showcases innocent love and tension between characters.
cons: Repetitive formula with little character development.
Story progresses nowhere.
Teasing can be perceived as bullying.
Episodic format gets old.
anime.thematic_vibe: Innocent Love, Slice of Life, School Comedy

anime.title: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger The Animation
anime.synopsis:
Following the Heath Oslo incident, the existence of the US-Japanese anti-terror organization CIRS has become a matter of public knowledge. CIRS has been rebuilt from the ground up, and its most covert functions spun off to a new agency: SORD (Social Ops, Research & Development).

The goal of SORD is to train a new generation of operatives to defend the country against future threats. To that end, the organization has established a series of schools up and down the country. Mihama Academy, more-or-less left to rot after its abrupt closure, has been given new purpose as one such 'specialist training school'.

This new incarnation of Mihama Academy is home to a diverse group of students, who every day work to polish their unusual skills – sometimes on the job. Mihama now entrusts the misfit girls who attend it with guns and live ammunition.

Paying their own safety no heed, these students are again and again plunged into dangerous extrajudicial missions - all for the good of the realm.

"We've been provided with a place in the world. That alone isn't enough - there wouldn't be any meaning in living, if that was all we had... It's not enough just to be made use of by others. I live by my own strength, and I fight to survive. That's the only way those of us who actually make it through can find forgiveness..."

No matter how much life grinds them down, what future awaits these girls, who've themselves chosen the path of the gun?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many fans of the original Grisaia series disliking the new cast and storyline. Some viewers appreciate the new direction and action elements, while others find the story and characters shallow. The production values, particularly the animation, are generally praised, but the writing is often criticized.
pros: New storyline separate from previous series
Good animation quality
Well-designed characters
cons: Unnecessary fan service scenes
Characters are not well-developed
Story feels rushed

anime.title: THE IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls Theater 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: The second season of Cinderella Girls Gekijou.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Cinderella Girls Gekijou 2nd Season as a short, cute, and comedic anime. Fans of the Cinderella Girls franchise and the mobile game Starlight Stage will especially appreciate the references and homages. However, the lack of a strong plot and the very short episode length may not appeal to all viewers, with some finding it mediocre.
pros: Enjoyable short episodes
Beautiful art style
Homage to the Cinderella Girls franchise
Rewards fans of the mobile game Starlight Stage
cons: Not much plot
Episodes are only 3 minutes long
Mediocre anime
Fanboy bias may inflate enjoyment

anime.title: Hakata Tonkotsu Ramens
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Crossdressing, Detective, Mystery, Organized Crime
anime.synopsis:
Although the city of Fukuoka might look relatively peaceful at first glance, in actuality it houses a thriving mixture of dangerous individuals such as killers, detectives, and professional revenge seekers right beneath its surface. Among their number is Zenji Banba, a laidback and observant detective who is investigating the work of other hitmen companies in the area. However, Banba might not be the only one with a bone to pick with these organizations, as Xianming Lin, a crossdressing male hitman in the employ of one such company begins getting fed up with his lack of jobs and pay.

One day, after Lin's current target commits suicide before the hitman could reach him, his company refuses to pay him even half the amount they were originally supposed to for the assassination. Frustrated, Lin requests another mission and is offered the job of taking out Banba, whom his organization believes has been interfering with their business. However, when Banba arrives at his home and finds the hitman inside, Lin surprisingly doesn't even attempt to kill him. Instead, he offers the detective another option: to join him and form a team. With the offer on the table, exactly how will Banba respond, and just what plans does Lin have in store for the underground world of Fukuoka?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some praising the show's unique characters, setting, and action, while others criticize its nonsensical plot, shallow character development, and inconsistent art quality. The show is appreciated for its fun and quirky nature, but criticized for lacking depth and realism. Overall, it's seen as an enjoyable but flawed anime.
pros: Enjoyable and quirky characters with good LGBT representation.
Unique and interesting setting with a fast-paced story.
Well-done action sequences and engaging storyline.
cons: Plot can be nonsensical and improbable with many cliches.
Characters can be shallow with rushed development and overused tropes.
Inconsistent art quality and animation with some low-budget moments.

anime.title: The Ryuo's Work is Never Done!
anime.synopsis:
Shogi, a Japanese game similar to chess, is one of the most popular board games in the country, played by everyone from children to the elderly. Some players are talented enough to take the game to a professional level. The title of Ryuuou, meaning "the dragon king," is only awarded to the person who reaches the pinnacle of competitive shogi.

Yaichi Kuzuryuu has just become the youngest Ryuuou after winning the grand championship. However, the shogi community is unwelcoming to his victory, some even calling him the worst Ryuuou in history. Moreover, he forgets about the agreement he made with Ai Hinatsuru, a little girl he promised to coach if he won. After she shows up at his doorstep, he reluctantly agrees to uphold his promise and makes Ai his disciple.

Together, they aim to improve and exceed the limits of their shogi prowess: Ai, to unlock her hidden talents; Yaichi, to prove to the world that he deserves his accomplishments.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some appreciate the exciting shogi matches and cute characters, while others are critical of the lolicon elements and weak story. The show is seen as a light and enjoyable time-killer, but not a masterpiece. Controversy arises from the uncomfortable implications of underage characters and fan service.
pros: Enjoyable and exciting shogi matches
Cute character designs
Good voice acting
cons: Questionable content due to loli characters in compromising situations
Generic protagonist
Weak story and character development

anime.title: Ame-Con!!
anime.synopsis: The series follows Nozomu Tokura as he tries to get more sales to the cafe he recently opened with the new helpers he met.
anime.consensus_summary: The season is considered more cohesive than previous installments, focusing on a clear goal and minimizing filler. However, the unexplained absence of characters, questionable music choices, and a disappointing ending detract from the overall experience. The audience seems mildly dissatisfied with the ending, but not particularly polarized.
pros: Cohesive Story
Clear Goal
No filler episodes
cons: Unexplained character disappearance
Unfitting opening theme
Grating ending theme
Terrible ending

anime.title: Devils' Line
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Drama, Romance, Seinen, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Vampires walk among society, existing as part of its underbelly. They do not require blood to survive, but extreme emotions can immensely increase their bloodlust, turning them into uncontrollable monsters. Tsukasa Taira, a 22-year-old university student, learns of the existence of vampires when her longtime friend reveals himself to be one of them after a tense confrontation with Yuuki Anzai—a human and vampire hybrid.

Her friend is arrested, and Tsukasa soon finds herself drawn to Anzai, who reluctantly reciprocates her feelings. However, this unconventional romance may prove too difficult to maintain, as Anzai struggles to contain the part of him that wishes to devour Tsukasa.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the anime to be a unique and enjoyable take on the vampire genre, praising the voice acting and exploration of social issues. However, many were disappointed by the rushed storyline, underdeveloped characters, and perceived similarities to other anime, leading to an overall feeling of unfulfilled potential.
pros: Interesting concept of vampires integrated into society.
Strong voice acting and sound design.
Exploration of the challenges faced by vampires and human-vampire relationships.
cons: Rushed storyline and incomplete character development.
Mediocre animation quality and generic character designs.
Forced romantic relationship with lack of chemistry.
Similarities to other vampire anime, like Tokyo Ghoul and Twilight.

anime.title: The Seven Deadly Sins the Movie: Prisoners of the Sky
anime.romaji_title: Nanatsu no Taizai Movie 1: Tenkuu no Torawarebito
anime.synopsis:
In search of a mystical ingredient known as Sky Fish, Meliodas and Hawk stumble upon a spring that suddenly transports them to the Sky Temple: a breathtaking land above the clouds, inhabited by beings called Celestials. Meliodas, however, looks strikingly similar to a local criminal called Solaad, and is imprisoned and shunned as a result. Meanwhile, the kingdom of the Sky Temple prepares to defend the Great Oshiro's seal—said to harbour a three thousand-year-old evil—from the malevolent Six Knights of Black, a group of demons who seek to destroy the seal. However, the Demon Clan is successfully unleashed and terrorizes the land, prompting the remaining Seven Deadly Sins and the Celestials to fight against their wicked foes. 

The battle progresses well, until one of the Six Knights awakens an "Indura of Retribution," an uncontrollable beast from the Demon Realm. With its overwhelming strength and sinister power, the Seven Deadly Sins and Celestial beings must now work together to defeat the creature that threatens their very existence.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to the movie is notably divided, with fans appreciating the visuals, action, and humor, but frequently criticizing the thin plot and confusing timeline. While many agree it's a visually appealing addition with entertaining moments for existing fans, its overall necessity and narrative depth are heavily debated.
pros: Stunning and detailed animation, especially during fight sequences and landscape shots.
Enjoyable soundtrack that enhances the immersive experience of action scenes.
Hawk's comedic moments and humor are frequently highlighted as a strong point.
New characters and villains are often praised for their design and potential, even if underdeveloped.
Provides enjoyable fan service for existing fans of the series.
cons: Story is often described as flat, predictable, and lacking originality, with many plot holes and forced situations.
The placement within the anime's timeline is unclear and confusing for viewers.
Villain power scaling is inconsistent; they are often depicted as weak despite rumors of being comparable to the Ten Commandments.
New characters and plot elements are often underdeveloped or feel like plot devices rather than meaningful additions.
The movie's necessity and relevance to the main series are questioned, with many deeming it skippable.
For newcomers, the movie raises more questions than it answers due to its reliance on existing lore.

anime.title: Basilisk: The Ouka Ninja Scrolls
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Historical, Martial Arts, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
It has been 10 years since the war between the Iga and Kouga ninja clans came to an end. The two groups have since made peace, supposedly dispelling the animosity that once existed between them. Hachirou Kouga and Hibiki Iga, the successors of their respective bloodlines, seem to have the perfect conditions for their love to bloom, but not everyone is satisfied with the results of the age-old battle.

Different tales of the final showdown between Gennosuke Kouga and Oboro Iga have spread, leaving Tadanaga Tokugawa—whom the Kouga represented—dissatisfied. As tension between the two clans rises once again, the brewing political climate threatens to keep the two fated lovers apart, just as it had in the previous generation.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is overwhelmingly negative, with many viewers considering 'Basilisk: Ouka Ninpouchou' a significant disappointment and a poor sequel to the original 'Basilisk'. Common complaints include a nonsensical story, weak characters, uninspired ninjutsu, and a perceived betrayal of the original's themes. While a few appreciated some aspects of the art and music, the overwhelming sentiment is one of disgust and frustration.
pros: Some reviewers appreciated the ninja powers and obscure weapons.
A few found the initial premise of clashing clans and potential alliance interesting.
Some reviewers noted that the art style captured the world well and the music was interesting
cons: Many found the story nonsensical, incoherent, and a disgrace to the original Basilisk.
Characters were described as generic, lacking depth, and having poorly executed backstories.
The plot was criticized for being predictable, slow-paced, and filled with unnecessary filler.
The ninjutsu abilities were considered watered down, uncreative, and uninteresting.
Several reviewers strongly disliked the implied incestuous relationship between the main characters.
The villain was seen as a poor imitation of other anime villains.

anime.title: Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Otaku Culture, Romance, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Having slept through all four of her alarms, the energetic Narumi Momose finds herself running late for her first day of work at a new office. As she races to catch her train, she makes a promise to herself that none of her coworkers will find out about her dark secret: that she is an otaku and a fujoshi. Her plan goes instantly awry, though, when she runs into Hirotaka Nifuji, an old friend from middle school. Although she tries to keep her secret by inviting him out for drinks after work, her cover is blown when he casually asks her whether or not she will be attending the upcoming Summer Comiket. Luckily for her, the only witnesses—Hanako Koyanagi and Tarou Kabakura—are otaku as well.
            
Later that night, the pair go out for drinks so that they can catch up after all the years apart. After Narumi complains about her previous boyfriend breaking up with her because he refused to date a fujoshi, Hirotaka suggests that she try dating a fellow otaku, specifically himself. He makes a solemn promise to always be there for her, to support her, and to help her farm for rare drops in Monster Hunter. Blown away by the proposal, Narumi agrees immediately. Thus the two otaku start dating, and their adorably awkward romance begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers appreciating the relatable otaku culture and adult setting, while others find the romance lacking and the comedy poorly executed. Many find the show enjoyable but not exceptional, praising its feel-good nature but criticizing its lack of depth and slow pacing. The show's appeal seems to largely depend on individual preferences for slice-of-life content and tolerance for a subdued romantic element.
pros: Relatable characters and situations for anime/game lovers.
Refreshing to see a romance with adult characters in a workplace setting.
Addresses the balance between otaku life and work life.
cons: Romance is often subdued or non-existent, with some finding it a low priority.
Comedy can be slow-paced, with timing issues affecting the delivery of jokes.
Story can feel flat and without much payoff, lacking an overarching narrative.
anime.thematic_vibe: Otaku Culture, Workplace Romance, Slice of Life

anime.title: Fairy Tail Final Series
anime.synopsis: Although Fairy Tail has disbanded and its members are now spread far across Fiore, Natsu Dragneel has not given up on reuniting the guild he and others once called home. Along with his companions Happy and Lucy Heartfilia, he will stop at nothing to keep Fairy Tail and its fiery spirit alive even as they face their most difficult trial yet—the invasion of Fiore by the Alvarez Empire's immense army and their all-too-familiar ruler.
anime.consensus_summary: The final season of Fairy Tail is met with mixed reactions. While some appreciate the resolution of character arcs and the nostalgic value, many criticize the overuse of the 'power of friendship' trope, poor animation, and repetitive plot. Some fans found it a satisfying conclusion, while others felt it failed to live up to its potential.
pros: Good character design and world building
Soundtrack is well-made and heart warming
Resolves many character plot threads
cons: Overuse of 'power of friendship' trope
Poor animation quality
Repetitive storytelling and predictable outcomes

anime.title: Harukana Receive
anime.synopsis:
In beach volleyball, there is no room for aces. To achieve victory, each player must find their one, irreplaceable partner that they can rely on in the court of sand. At least, that is what Haruka Oozora learns on her first day in Okinawa after moving in with her grandmother and her cousin Kanata Higa. While touring a nearby beach, Haruka stumbles upon some girls practicing beach volleyball and is quickly invited to join. This friendly practice game suddenly turns into a match when one of the girls, Narumi Tooi, notices Kanata approaching the court.
                
Although the two suffer a devastating defeat, Haruka finally realizes the reason for her cousin’s quiet and distant behavior. Kanata and Narumi used to be an exceptionally talented beach volleyball duo, until Kanata quit due to her short height causing problems for Narumi. Now, with the Junior Tournament just weeks away, Haruka must learn the intricacies of competitive beach volleyball and help Kanata overcome her crippling anxiety towards the sport that she once used to love.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many find it enjoyable for its lightheartedness, attractive art, and fun characters while acknowledging its flaws, such as pacing issues, predictable plot, and overreliance on fan service. Some viewers are turned off by the fan service, but others appreciate the character development and volleyball matches.
pros: Lovable characters with decent development, especially Kanata's overcoming her past.
Vibrant art style capturing Okinawa's summer atmosphere.
Enjoyable mix of comedy, light drama, and competitive beach volleyball.
Well-animated volleyball matches with strategic close-ups.
cons: Pacing issues due to limited episodes, leading to rushed character development and plot progression.
Over-reliance on fan service distracts from serious elements.
Unrealistic skill progression of main characters.
Predictable plot and generic tournament structure.

anime.title: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha: Detonation
anime.synopsis:
During a rash attempt to save her father and her dying home planet of Eltria, Kyrie Florian is betrayed by her childhood friend, Iris. Furthermore, the power Kyrie has gathered from Nanoha Takamachi and the other Earth protectors cannot be used to help her father.

Iris casts the despairing Kyrie aside, having acquired what she desired to exact revenge on Yuri Eberwein, a powerful being who lies dormant on Earth. Left to pick up the pieces, Nanoha and her allies must confront the troublesome Iris to uncover the truth and stop the conflict between her and Yuri.

However, amidst the raging battles, a much more dangerous threat lingers in the shadows. No matter the obstacle, Nanoha remains diligent and does not hesitate to help those in need with her magic.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the visuals and action, while others criticize the nonsensical plot, pacing issues, and weak character development. The shift away from traditional magical girl elements is a point of contention.
pros: Amazing art and soundtrack
Explosive action sequences
cons: Story doesn't make sense
Pacing is off
Lazy writing with reliance on misunderstandings
Villain redemption arc feels cheap
Mahou shoujo elements erased, leaning too heavily into science fiction

anime.title: Damepri Anime Caravan
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Parody, Reverse Harem
anime.synopsis:
Inako is a minor country, enclosed by two superior countries: the militaristic Milidonia, with its goal of conquering as much land as possible, and the monotheiestic Selenfalen, devoted to the deity Saint Philia. Ani Inako is the sole princess of her country, and in order to eliminate hostility between the three countries, she is sent as Inako's representative to a peace treaty signing in Selenfalen. However, Ani's hopes of a smooth ceremony are shattered when she meets the eccentric princes from her rival countries.

With the treaty binding the three countries together, Ani and the princes must learn to overcome their differences. Together, they search for common ground on which to develop their friendship.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Dame x Prince Anime Caravan' for its comedic and parodic elements, particularly its self-aware take on the reverse harem genre. The likeable characters and their exaggerated traits are well-received, along with the down-to-earth heroine. While the plot is not a primary focus, the show delivers a lighthearted and entertaining experience for those who appreciate its humor.
pros: Hilarious and outlandish humor with well-executed running gags.
Likeable characters with development and growth throughout the series.
Strong, self-aware heroine who acts as a 'straight-woman' to the eccentric cast.
Effective parody of reverse harem tropes and character stereotypes.
Lighthearted and fun, providing a refreshing viewing experience.
cons: Plot is not complex or a big deal; secondary to the comedy.
Pacing can be uneven, and some jokes become repetitive.
Some viewers might not enjoy the exaggerated character tropes or reverse harem genre.
