anime.title: Angels of Death
anime.synopsis:
With dead and lifeless eyes, Rachel Gardner wishes only to die. Waking up in the basement of a building, she has no idea how or why she's there. She stumbles across a bandaged murderer named Zack, who is trying to escape. After promising to kill her as soon as he is free, Rachel and Zack set out to ascend through the building floor by floor until they escape.

However, as they progress upward, they meet more twisted people, and all of them seem familiar with Rachel. What is her connection to the building, and why was she placed in it? Facing a new boss on each floor, can Rachel and Zack both achieve their wishes?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Satsuriku no Tenshi. Some appreciate its unique premise, character dynamics, and psychological themes, finding it an underrated gem. However, many criticize the repetitive dialogue, weak plot, and underdeveloped characters, considering it a frustrating and ultimately unsatisfying experience. The series' attempts at horror are generally seen as superficial and ineffective.
pros: Unique premise and setting (mysterious building).
Well-developed relationship between Rachel and Zack (odd couple dynamic).
Good adaptation of the game, capturing the surreal tone.
Enjoyable for those seeking something different from typical anime.
Decent art style, particularly the use of color palette and character design.
cons: Repetitive and boring dialogue, especially the 'kill me' exchange.
Weak character development for most characters, especially the villains.
Confusing and illogical plot with vague and pretentious clues.
Poorly executed horror elements; lacks tension and suspense.
Unsatisfying and often predictable plot twists and ending.
Inconsistent character motivations and actions.

anime.title: Maerchen Maedchen
anime.synopsis:
Hazuki Kagimura is a socially awkward girl with no friends; and having been recently adopted, she struggles to connect with her new family as well. Her only refuge from this painful reality is between the pages of stories where her vivid imagination allows her to live out her dreams of friendship and adventure. However, one day, an old and mysterious text appears in her book bag. On her way back to the library to return it, Hazuki sees a familiar girl who is seemingly invisible to everyone but her. Deciding to follow her, Hazuki is led a hidden library where a world she thought only existed in her dreams awaits her. 

Märchen Mädchen tells the story of Hazuki's meeting with Shizuka Tsuchimikado, her very first friend, and discovering she has been chosen by the original print of Cinderella to become a powerful mage known as an Origin Master. Hazuki enrolls at Kuzunoha Girl's Magic Academy where she learns to conquer her fears and believe in her ability to create her own amazing story.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with initial charm undermined by production issues and a rushed ending. Some viewers appreciated the cute characters and magical premise, while others were disappointed by the declining animation quality and generic plot. The anime had potential but ultimately failed to deliver a satisfying conclusion, leading to a somewhat polarized response.
pros: Charming characters and interactions
Creative magic system based on storybooks
Enjoyable and lighthearted fun
cons: Rushed and incomplete ending
Animation quality nosedived significantly
Generic and bland story with a weak plot

anime.title: Between the Sky and Sea
anime.synopsis: In the future in Onomichi, Hiroshima fish disappear from the sea around the world and only whales live in the ocean. The Ministry of Fishery decides to set up giant experimental Universe Fish Tanks in space. The Onomichi Universe Fishery Union is established and begins to train space fishermen. Female fishermen are in demand due to the strengthening of an equal employment law for men and women. Six new female space fishermen are selected, and the story centers on supporting their growth.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Sora to Umi no Aida' are divided. While some appreciate the character development, humor, and unique aspects, others criticize the weak plot, mediocre production values, and reliance on generic tropes. The series sparked controversy due to perceived feminist themes, leading to polarized reactions. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on viewers' tolerance for flawed execution and appreciation for character-driven narratives.
pros: Engaging characters with meaningful relationships and development.
Good comedic timing and humor.
Unconventional voice acting and storyboarding that can be refreshing.
cons: Poor worldbuilding and nonsensical plot elements.
Mediocre art and animation, with reliance on basic animation and mediocre CG.
Generic character tropes and forced dramatic moments.

anime.title: Alice or Alice
anime.synopsis: This story gives a look at the daily life of a pair of Alice twins and their older brother who has a sister complex. Them eating meals, getting into fights, playing with friends... Would you like to peek at the heart-full daily life of the cute Alices?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, with some viewers finding the show cute, harmless, and enjoyable for its short length and simple premise. However, a significant portion of viewers find the show to be a waste of time due to its lack of plot, underdeveloped characters, and annoying sound design. The show's reliance on tropes and fanservice is a major point of contention, with some enjoying it and others finding it excessive and unnecessary.
pros: Cute character designs, especially in chibi style
Harmless and easy to watch without much thought
Catchy opening song for some viewers
cons: Lack of substantial plot or story
Underdeveloped and forgettable characters
Repetitive or annoying music and sound design
Poor pacing and very short episodes
Excessive use of tropes and fanservice without purpose

anime.title: TWOCAR
anime.synopsis: Two Car follows high schoolers Yuri Miyata and Megumi Meguro as they battle six other rival pairs in the sport of motorcycle sidecar racing.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Two Car" is viewed as a disappointing series that fails to deliver on its racing premise. While some appreciate the character interactions and nods to the sport, the unoriginal plot, irritating main characters, and mediocre racing sequences lead to a generally negative reception. Many find the show frustrating due to its repetitive nature and the squandered potential for character development.
pros: Some side characters are enjoyable and provide comedic relief.
The art style is decent and character designs are acceptable.
The show respects the craft of racing and includes clever nods to the sport.
Explores relationships through sidecar racing.
cons: The story is unoriginal, cliché, and riddled with unnecessary drama.
Main characters are annoying, irritating, and immature, hindering enjoyment.
Racing sequences are mediocre and lack intensity.
Character development is often dropped or reset, leading to unsatisfying conclusions.
Plot is formulaic and repetitive.
Ending is a letdown and undermines character progress.
Too many characters with not enough depth.

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard G Z
anime.synopsis: Fourth season of Cardfight!! Vanguard G series.
anime.consensus_summary: The season is seen as a disappointing continuation, failing to live up to the original series. Reviewers criticize the weak plot, rushed character arcs, and the overshadowing of new characters by returning favorites. While maintaining continuity, the season lacks the spark and excitement of previous installments.
pros: Continuity of story.
cons: Poor story.
Boring duels.
Too hasty character development.
Unnecessary inclusion of original series characters overshadowing the new generation.

anime.title: Persona 5 the Animation
anime.synopsis:
Ren Amamiya, a new transfer student at Shujin Academy, is sent to Tokyo to live with his family friend Sojiro Sakura after wrongly being put on probation for defending a woman from sexual assault. While on the way to attend his first day at his new school, Ren notices a strange app has appeared on his phone, transferring him to a world known as the Metaverse, which contains people's "shadows": distorted depictions of their true selves. In the Metaverse, he awakens his Persona, a power from deep within that gives him the strength to fight the shadows. With the help of similarly troubled students, he forms the Phantom Thieves of Hearts, attempting to save people from their sinful desires by "taking their heart," making evildoers regret their actions and turn over a new leaf. The group's reputation continues to grow explosively, bringing along fame both positive and negative.

However, during the peak of their popularity, Ren gets captured and taken into custody. Here, he wakes up to a harsh interrogation, but this is cut short by the arrival of Sae Niijima—a prosecutor seeking answers. Just how will she react to his story, and what will become of the Phantom Thieves?
anime.consensus_summary: Fans of the Persona 5 game are largely disappointed with the anime adaptation due to its rushed pacing, poor animation, and shallow character development. While the soundtrack and voice acting receive praise, the series fails to capture the depth and emotional impact of the source material. Many feel the anime serves only as a poor substitute for the game, and some suggest it's merely a marketing ploy.
pros: Faithful voice acting from the game
Excellent soundtrack carried over from the game
Some anime-original scenes and changes improve upon the game's narrative
Fleshed out Akechi's character, which was later added to Royal
Good opening and ending themes
cons: Rushed pacing ruins story and character development
Poor animation quality, especially in fight scenes
Characters feel like lifeless husks of their game counterparts
Many key story moments are skipped or glossed over
Ending feels unsatisfying and rushed
Inconsistent art style and animation errors
CGI is poorly implemented
Superficial portrayal of social links and relationships

anime.title: King's Game
anime.genres: Drama, Gore, High Stakes Game, Horror, Mystery, School, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
It can be rough transferring to a new school—even more so if you do not want to make any friends, like Nobuaki Kanazawa. But the reason for his antisocial behavior soon becomes clear when his class receives a text from someone called "The King." Included are instructions for the "King's Game," and all class members must participate. Those who refuse to play, quit halfway, or do not follow an order in the allotted time of 24 hours will receive a deadly punishment.

Having played the game before and watched as those around him died, Nobuaki tries to warn his clueless classmates. Unfortunately, they only believe him after the King's Game claims its first casualties. Stuck in a horrific situation with no chance of escape, Nobuaki has a choice: put his own survival above those around him, or do what he could not before and save his classmates.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Many viewers found the anime to be poorly written, animated, and conceptually flawed, with attempts at shock value falling flat. However, a small subset of viewers found the show's absurdity to be unintentionally hilarious, resulting in a so-bad-it's-good experience.
pros: Some viewers found the absurdity of the show entertaining.
The opening and ending songs were appreciated by some.
A few viewers enjoyed the character development
cons: Poor animation quality and art style.
Inconsistent and nonsensical plot with many unanswered questions.
Undeveloped, unlikable, and often stupid characters.
Over-reliance on shock value, gore, and sexual content.
Poor pacing due to excessive flashbacks and broken narrative.
Inconsistent rules of the King's Game
Poorly executed sensitive topics such as rape
Lack of character development

anime.title: Golden Kamuy
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Historical, Military, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
In early 1900s Hokkaido after the Russo-Japanese war, Saichi Sugimoto tirelessly pans for gold. Nicknamed "Sugimoto the Immortal" for his death-defying acts in battle, the ex-soldier seeks fortune in order to fulfill a promise made to his best friend before he was killed in action: to support his family, especially his widow who needs treatment overseas for her deteriorating eyesight. One day, a drunken companion tells Sugimoto the tale of a man who murdered a group of Ainu and stole a fortune in gold. Before his arrest by the police, he hid the gold somewhere in Hokkaido. The only clue to its location is the coded map he tattooed on the bodies of his cellmates in exchange for a share of the treasure, should they manage to escape and find it.

Sugimoto does not think much of the tale until he discovers the drunken man's corpse bearing the same tattoos described in the story. But before he can collect his thoughts, a grizzly bear—the cause of the man's demise—approaches Sugimoto, intent on finishing her meal. He is saved by a young Ainu girl named Asirpa, whose father happened to be one of the murdered Ainu. With Asirpa's hunting skills and Sugimoto's survival instincts, the pair agree to join forces and find the hidden treasure—one to get back what was rightfully her people's, and the other to fulfill his friend's dying wish.
anime.consensus_summary: Golden Kamuy is a unique anime praised for its historical setting, engaging story, and exploration of Ainu culture. While some appreciate the blend of action, humor, and cultural elements, others find the pacing inconsistent and the animation lacking. The initial season receives criticism, but overall the series is considered enjoyable and well-crafted.
pros: Unique setting and time period
Engaging story with action, humor, and compelling characters
Insightful portrayal of Ainu culture
Strong voice acting (especially in the dubbed version)
cons: Inconsistent pacing
Unremarkable animation, particularly the CGI
Combination of too many themes that don't always mesh well
Initial slow start (Season 1)

anime.title: Hakyu Hoshin Engi
anime.synopsis: When his clan is wiped out by a beautiful demon, young Taikobo finds himself in charge of the mysterious Houshin Project. Its mission: find all immortals living in the human world and seal them away forever. But who do you trust—and whose side are you really on—when you've been trained to hunt demons by a demon?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. Some appreciate the world-building and character backstories, particularly those familiar with the source material and willing to overlook initial pacing issues. However, many find the adaptation rushed, poorly animated, and lacking in proper introductions and character development. The fast pacing and perceived lack of depth contribute to a lackluster viewing experience for many.
pros: Fantastic world-building with intricate details
Characters with varied and detailed backstories
Music is pretty decent
cons: Pacing is too fast, especially in the initial episodes
Lack of proper introduction and world-building
Generic fighting tournament shonen anime
Mediocre animation with lifeless character movements
Poor character designs
Series drops plot points and character introductions at random

anime.title: Air: Memories
anime.synopsis: A recap of Air. It was also included on its own DVD release, separate from the original show's DVD/BD releases.
anime.consensus_summary: The "Air Recap" is overwhelmingly viewed as a poor and unnecessary addition to the Air franchise.  Viewers find it to be a shallow and incomplete summary that fails to capture the essence of the original anime. The recap is criticized for its uneven focus on different story arcs and its overall lack of value, leading most to recommend skipping it entirely.
pros: Recaps the story for those who want a refresher.
cons: Lacks depth and understanding compared to the original anime or even a wiki summary.
Focuses primarily on one arc, neglecting others.
Considered a waste of time by viewers.
Poorly executed recap with little value.

anime.title: Senran Kagura: Shinovi Master
anime.romaji_title: Senran Kagura Shinovi Master: Tokyo Youma-hen
anime.synopsis: Girls study at schools for modern shinobi. They dedicate their entire young lives to learning to become true shinobi, battling each other to polish their skills. And then one day, Asuka, whose grandfather is a legendary shinobi, encounters an ancient evil being named a "Youma" in the back alleys of Tokyo at Christmastime. Where there is light, there is shadow. Over 28 of the strongest and most well-endowed ninjas in history, both good and evil, will collide in a battle to determine true justice. And this deadly battle begins... right now.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Senran Kagura Shinovi Master: Tokyo Youma-hen. Many appreciate the improved storyline, deeper characters, and exploration of moral complexities compared to the first season. However, issues with animation quality, pacing, and excessive fanservice detract from the overall experience for some viewers. The series seems to appeal more to fans already invested in the franchise and those who enjoy ecchi content.
pros: Improved story and character depth compared to Season 1.
Introduction of new and interesting characters, particularly from Gessen and Hebijo.
Exploration of complex themes like justice, good vs. evil, and conflicting beliefs.
cons: Erratic pacing issues, with some episodes feeling rushed or too slow.
Inconsistent and subpar animation quality, especially during fight scenes.
Overabundance of fanservice that sometimes feels gratuitous and taxing.

anime.title: Recovery of an MMO Junkie
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Romance, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
For the first time since graduating high school, 30-year-old Moriko Morioka is unemployed—and she couldn't be happier. Having quit her long-standing job of over 11 years, Moriko quickly turns to online games to pass her now-plentiful free time, reinventing herself as the handsome and dashing male hero "Hayashi" in the MMO Fruits de Mer. With the pesky societal obligations of the real world out of the way, she blissfully dives headfirst into the realm of the game, where she promptly meets the kind and adorable healer Lily. Befriending each other almost instantly, the two become inseparable just as Moriko herself becomes more and more engrossed in her new "life" as Hayashi. Eventually, Moriko adopts the reclusive lifestyle in its entirety, venturing out from the safety of her apartment only when absolutely necessary.

Meanwhile, unbeknownst to Moriko, a timid 28-year-old corporate worker named Yuuta Sakurai has also logged onto Fruits de Mer from the other side of town. Coincidentally bumping into each other at the convenience store one night, both write off their meeting as no more than just another awkward encounter with a stranger—however, fate has more in store for them than they think.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found it to be a relatable and enjoyable romance anime with a unique MMO setting, praising its characters and pacing. However, others criticized it for its predictable plot, shallow characters, and unsatisfying ending, finding it generic and unrealistic.
pros: Relatable characters, especially for those familiar with MMOs or feeling burnt out.
Well-paced story progression and character development.
The anime provides a refreshing take on the romance genre by incorporating MMO elements.
cons: Predictable plot with reliance on misunderstandings.
Shallow characters and unrealistic portrayal of NEET lifestyle.
Unsatisfying ending.

anime.title: A.I.C.O. Incarnation
anime.synopsis:
In 2035, an incident known as “The Burst” occurs at a Japanese research facility,  giving birth to the rapidly expanding, consuming, and self-replicating "Matter." Snaking its way through the remains of dams and military facilities in the Kurobe Gorge, the hostile Matter is besieged by task forces trying to prevent it from reaching the ocean and mercenaries seeking the truth behind its existence.

Aiko Tachibana lives under constant medical surveillance after being rescued from the Matter. She spends her days waiting out her recovery by making paper planes. Soon, her daily life at school is disturbed by the arrival of transfer student Yuuya Kanzaki, who proceeds to point out a number of inconsistencies regarding her body. Why is she never injured, and why does she suddenly no longer need her wheelchair? He claims that there is more to her existence than she has been led to believe, and that she alone holds the key to ending The Burst.

With many factions now interested in Aiko, she and Yuuya must gather allies and embark on a dangerous pilgrimage into the heart of the infested gorge before the net can close around them. To escape the conspiracy moving against them, the pair must face off against the Matter—an enemy that flows like water.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for A.I.C.O. Incarnation is significantly divided, primarily along the lines of its impressive visual production versus its weak narrative and character writing. While many praise the animation, art style, and intriguing sci-fi concepts, a substantial portion of viewers found the story convoluted, the characters underdeveloped, and the pacing problematic. This split leads to a polarizing experience, where some found it an enjoyable, albeit flawed, binge-watch, while others were deeply disappointed by its narrative shortcomings.
pros: Visually fantastic with high-quality BONES animation and beautiful character art.
Interesting world-building and technological/biotechnological concepts.
Solid opening and ending themes, with enjoyable soundtracks.
Some neat plot twists and a satisfying conclusion for some viewers.
Very bingeable, making it a good weekend watch.
Features good female characters in non-demeaning roles.
cons: Severely underdeveloped and poorly written characters, especially the main protagonists, leading to a lack of audience investment.
Inconsistent and confusing characterization for the main protagonist.
Pacing issues, with repetitive middle episodes and rushed endings.
Excessive exposition and info-dumping that can be confusing and overwhelming.
Plot elements and character motivations are often unexplained or poorly defined.
Thematic explorations, particularly regarding the morality of synthetic beings, are shallow and unsatisfying.
Storytelling relies on narrative ass-pulls and confusing twists rather than organic development.
The English dub is considered poor by some viewers.
The science and biological logic become murky and unbelievable as the story progresses.

anime.title: Recovery of an MMO Junkie Special
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Romance, Video Game
anime.synopsis: Much to her dismay, Moriko Morioka's computer has broken down. However, not all is lost as she remembers that Yuuta Sakurai is a computer geek, leading Morioka to seek his expertise. But when Sakurai visits to help build her a new computer, hilarity ensues.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, especially for the first half which is praised for its cute romance and comedy. However, there's a notable division regarding the quality of the second half, with some finding it disappointing or unnecessary, leading to mixed feelings about the special's overall value.
pros: Cute comedy and romantic development between the main characters.
Amazing art and character designs, consistent with the main series.
Great use of the original OP and ED, enhancing the viewing experience.
The first half of the special is particularly well-received for its realistic and immersive feel.
Provides enjoyable continuation and closure for fans of the series.
cons: The second half of the special is considered weaker, boring, or an afterthought by some.
Disappointment over the lack of romantic scenes, especially in the second half.
The story is seen as a weak point by some, with a plot that doesn't significantly advance.
Felt like a way to prolong the show without adding significant value for some viewers.
The ending leaves some viewers feeling unresolved or 'hanging'.

anime.title: Dagashi Kashi 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Dagashi Kashi.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers appreciated the improved pacing and character development, while others missed the focus on sweets and the presence of Hotaru. The new characters were generally well-received. The shorter episodes and shift in focus made it more enjoyable for some, but less appealing for others who preferred the original formula.
pros: Improved pacing due to shorter episodes
Addition of new, likeable characters (Hajime)
More focused plot with character development
cons: Reduced focus on dagashi/sweets content
Absence of Hotaru for a significant portion of the season
Inconsistent art style compared to season 1

anime.title: Hakumei and Mikochi
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Fantasy, Iyashikei, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
In a world inhabited by people only a few inches tall, young women Hakumei and Mikochi live together in a house built into a tree. Hakumei is an energetic and tomboyish carpenter, while Mikochi is a feminine and calm tailor. Despite their differences, they get along well and spend their days having fun living their lives in the woods.

The two of them spend their time working, going on sightseeing adventures, and taking shopping trips into Tsumiki Marketplace by the ocean. They make many friends along the way, be they sentient woodland creatures like Iwashi the Weasel or fellow miniature people such as the songstress Konju and the inventor Sen.

Hakumei to Mikochi is a relaxing look into the day-to-day lives of its titular characters as they explore and interact with their tiny world which seems to be straight out of a fairy tale.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's relaxing atmosphere, unique world, and adorable characters. Viewers appreciate its ability to create a warm and comforting experience, making it a highly recommended 'healing' anime. Some find the simple, episodic nature potentially repetitive, but the majority are enchanted by the show's charm and beauty.
pros: Unique and well-developed fantasy setting.
Relaxing and heartwarming atmosphere.
Cute and lovable characters.
Beautiful art style and music.
Good storytelling with a fairy tale vibe.
cons: Episodic format may lack an overarching plot.
Simplicity may not appeal to all viewers.
Some viewers might find it repetitive.

anime.title: I Want To Eat Your Pancreas
anime.synopsis:
The aloof protagonist: a bookworm who is deeply detached from the world he resides in. He has no interest in others and is firmly convinced that nobody has any interest in him either. His story begins when he stumbles across a handwritten book, titled Living with Dying. He soon identifies it as a secret diary belonging to his popular, bubbly classmate Sakura Yamauchi. She then confides in him about the pancreatic disease she is suffering from and that her time left is finite. Only her family knows about her terminal illness; not even her best friends are aware. Despite this revelation, he shows zero sympathy for her plight, but caught in the waves of Sakura's persistent buoyancy, he eventually concedes to accompanying her for her remaining days.

As the pair of polar opposites interact, their connection strengthens, interweaving through their choices made with each passing day. Her apparent nonchalance and unpredictability disrupts the protagonist's impassive flow of life, gradually opening his heart as he discovers and embraces the true meaning of living.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is polarized. Some viewers found the movie deeply moving and appreciated its exploration of life and death, praising the emotional impact and art style. Others criticized it for being generic, predictable, and having superficial characters, ultimately dismissing it as a cheap tearjerker with forced emotionality.
pros: Emotional and moving experience, provokes tears and strong feelings.
Beautiful art style, similar to 'A Silent Voice'.
Explores themes of living life to the fullest and leaving a mark.
Simple and enjoyable story with a strong female lead.
cons: Generic and cliché, doesn't offer anything new to the genre.
Superficial characters, hard to connect with emotionally.
Predictable plot with a plot twist that diminishes the main plot.
Unrealistic dialogue and forced interactions.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Lost Girls
anime.synopsis:
Wall Sina, Goodbye
Annie Leonhart has a job to do—and a resulting absence that must stay off her record at all costs. With no one else to turn to, she asks her comrade Hitch Dreyse to cover for her. She agrees but puts forward a single condition: Annie must solve the fruitless missing person case Hitch was assigned. The case revolves around Carly Stratmann, a university graduate and the daughter of wealthy businessman Elliot Stratmann. With only a single day to solve the case and the underground of the Stohess District crawling with thugs, Annie must put her all into finding this girl. Yet, every answer she uncovers only leads to further questions—how has the illegal drug coderoin found its way to Stohess, what is Elliot hiding, and where has Carly disappeared to?

Lost in the Cruel World
With worry for Eren Yeager gripping her heart, Mikasa Ackerman begins to remember. She remembers her conversations with Armin Arlert, her concern for her friends, and most painfully, the time she had almost lost everything. As fear takes control, she begins to experience an alternate version of her past—some things can be changed, but are there events so inescapable that she cannot even prevent them in her dreams?
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Lost Girls' OVA is generally well-received, particularly for its exploration of Annie's character and the unique detective storyline. While Mikasa's episode receives some criticism, the OVA is viewed as a worthwhile addition to the Attack on Titan universe for fans interested in deeper character development. Most agree that the ending song of the story about Annie is well-received.
pros: Provides deeper insight into Annie and Mikasa's characters.
Annie's detective storyline is engaging and fresh.
The OVA adds to the lore of Attack on Titan.
cons: Pacing feels rushed due to the limited number of episodes.
Mikasa's story is less compelling than Annie's.
Some viewers may find the alternate reality concept unfulfilling.

anime.title: Takunomi
anime.synopsis: 20-year-old Michiru Amatsuki moved to Tokyo after a career change, and now finds herself living in a woman only share house, Stella House Haruno, with a few other women of varying age and occupation. Every night the girls settle down and have a drink or two (or more) as drama ensues.
anime.consensus_summary: Takunomi. is a relaxing and informative anime about girls enjoying alcoholic beverages, primarily aimed at viewers who appreciate the drinking theme and Japanese culture. While some find the story simple and the characters somewhat underdeveloped, many enjoy it as a laid-back show with appealing visuals and interesting details about different drinks. The anime is generally well-received, but it's not for those seeking complex narratives or those who dislike alcohol-related content.
pros: Informative about Japanese drinking culture and beverages
Likable and relatable characters
Relaxing and easy to watch
Appealing animation and character designs, especially the food and drinks
cons: Lacks a complex or extraordinary story
Can feel like an advertisement for alcohol
Personalities of the characters aren't deeply explored
May not appeal to those who don't enjoy drinking or culinary anime

anime.title: Uma no Friends
anime.synopsis: An anime collaboration between Kemono Friends and the Japan Racing Association.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views 'Uma no Friends' as a short, promotional spin-off that doesn't significantly contribute to the main series. The animation quality is lacking due to budget constraints, but the characters remain a strong point. Overall, it's a lighthearted collaboration that is easily overlooked.
pros: Characters are well-received
cons: Low-quality CGI
Minimal animation
Lack of budget is apparent

anime.title: Junji Ito Collection
anime.genres: Drama, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
In the light of day and in the dead of night, mysterious horrors await in the darkest shadows of every corner. They are unexplainable, inescapable, and undefeatable. Be prepared, or you may become their next victim.

Sit back in terror as traumatizing tales of unparalleled terror unfold. Tales, such as that of a cursed jade carving that opens holes all over its victims' bodies; deep nightmares that span decades; an attractive spirit at a misty crossroad that grants cursed advice; and a slug that grows inside a girl's mouth. Tread carefully, for the horrifying supernatural tales of the Itou Junji: Collection are not for the faint of heart.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative, with many criticizing the anime's poor animation quality and failure to capture the essence of Junji Ito's horror. While some appreciate the faithfulness to the source material and found moments of enjoyment, the overall consensus is that the adaptation falls short of expectations. Many feel that the anime does not do justice to Junji Ito's original works.

Some found the Souichi chapters funny and enjoyable
The opening and ending themes capture the tone of Junji Ito's work

cons: Poor animation quality, static shots, and lack of detail compared to the manga
Fails to capture the horror and atmosphere of the original manga
Inconsistent pacing, with stories feeling rushed or incomplete
Weak character development due to the short episode format
Poor adaptation of dramatic framing and tension from the manga

anime.thematic_vibe: Cosmic Horror, Body Horror, Dark Humor

anime.title: GARO -VANISHING LINE-
anime.synopsis:
Corruption looms over the prosperous Russell City, where manifestations of negative emotions called Horrors cause chaos and mayhem. The Makai Order is the last bastion of hope against these unholy creatures. Using several small businesses as fronts, they deploy powerful Makai Knights and magical Makai Alchemists to combat the Horror threat. 

Within this secretive order, the highest rank of Golden Knight has been bestowed upon a large, powerful man named Sword, granting him use of the Garo armor and blade. He alone knows of a plot that threatens the entire Makai Order, with his only hint being the phrase “El Dorado." While fighting a Horror, he encounters Sophia "Sophie" Hennis, a teenage girl whose brother's disappearance years ago is also linked to the same phrase. The two agree to work together to uncover the truth behind "El Dorado" and the disappearance of Sophie's brother.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Garo: Vanishing Line is a fun and stylish action anime that is often overlooked. While praised for its exciting fight scenes, music, and character design, it suffers from a weak and predictable storyline. The episodic nature and animation inconsistencies contribute to a somewhat uneven viewing experience, but the series is still considered enjoyable for fans of the genre.
pros: Exciting action sequences with good animation.
Catchy soundtrack enhances the fight scenes.
Unique and well-designed characters.
Visually appealing art style with a strong color palette.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with dips in the middle.
Weak main story with predictable twists and underdeveloped villains.
Episodic format can feel repetitive and slow-paced.
Some plot holes and convenient resolutions.

anime.title: Wangu Xian Qiong
anime.synopsis:
Heavenly Dao is eternal, however life is limited, making heaven and earth pieces of a chessboard.

Gu Hai from the 21st century was taken onto another world. Gu Hai became a formidable opponent in the area of trade. In the times of war, he comes up with strategies for the Chen Empire against the Song Empire.

A fairy from heaven became interested in him and gave him a mission to complete on his journey. However this may bring turmoil and chaos upon the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some find the show a hilarious and action-packed hidden gem with unique characters, while others criticize its weak storyline, poor translation, and inconsistent character development, particularly the MC's shift from a strategist to a frantic mess. The show is enjoyable if you don't take it too seriously, but be prepared for potential frustration.
pros: Funny and enjoyable dialogues.
Good character development.
Unique characters that refine or shatter tropes.
cons: Inconsistent timeline and weak storyline.
Horrible English subs with nonsensical idioms.
MC becomes weak and reliant on screaming rather than strategy.

anime.title: Keifuku-san
anime.synopsis: Incorporating the earlier two parts and adding additional footage as an epilogue, Keifuku-san features the adventures of a young girl in a railway conductor uniform and a floating manta ray as they explore an otherworldly space. The video features direction by Tatsuki, animation by Hirayasu, and art by Yukko (all members of animation studio irodori), as well as the voice talents of Yumiri Hanamori.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds Keifuku-san to be a short, relaxing experience with intriguing sound design and visuals, despite a somewhat vague narrative. The pleasant auditory experience, particularly the manta ray's voice, stands out. The show is viewed as a potentially promising concept that could be expanded into a longer series.
pros: Pleasing sound direction, especially the manta ray's murmuring.
Decent CG animation with a pleasing color palette.
Intriguing enough to warrant a longer series.
cons: Vague story with not much explanation.
Animation is not particularly impressive.

anime.title: Soulmate Adventure
anime.synopsis: It is rumored in the martial world that a mystery white-haired girl suddenly appeared around the thief Feng Ling Er. She is so powerful that many martial arts masters can't defeat her. The girl's identity, the source of her power and her influence to the world all caused discussion among the public. But Feng Ling Er and the white-haired girl named Bai Yu Xiu never care about it. They travel the world with pleasure, unaware of a great conspiracy coming towards them.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the show for its intricate wuxia story, well-animated fight scenes, and the charming dynamic between the main characters. The story is praised for its depth and foreshadowing, suggesting careful planning by the author. There is minimal controversy, indicating a positive reception overall.
pros: Complex story with subtle foreshadowing and planned plot elements.
Beautifully choreographed and animated fight scenes with dynamic movements.
Great chemistry between the main characters.

anime.title: Lan Mo's Flower
anime.synopsis: Gluttonous and tomboyish, Lan Mo is hardly anyone's ideal girl, but with a magical hair clip from a mysterious trinket shop that disappears the next day, she may be able to become just that. With its power, she can transform into a beautiful and feminine young lady, someone who may finally be able to catch the eye of her childhood friend and crush, Liu Yifeng. However, keeping the clip's secret proves difficult for Lan Mo when faced with Liu Yifeng's admirers and the mysterious stranger Xia An. And to further complicate matters, Lan Mo's possession of the hair clip may turn out to be more than just mere coincidence.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a quick and easy watch with decent animation and alright character development, though the story may feel a bit improvised and the ending rushed. The voice acting is noted as being somewhat odd. Overall, it is a lighthearted anime suitable for a single-sitting viewing experience.
pros: Decent animation
Quick pacing for easy viewing
Alright character development
cons: Odd voice acting
Rushed ending
Story feels made up along the way
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Transformation, Romantic Comedy, Slice of Life

anime.title: Boku wa Sonzai Shiteinakatta
anime.synopsis: Music video included with the first single of the digital idol group 22/7 (Nanabun no Nijuuni).
anime.consensus_summary: The song 'Boku wa Sonzai Shiteinakatta' is well-received for its emotional depth and musical quality. The visuals are acceptable for their time, and the availability of English subtitles broadens its appeal. Overall, the audience consensus is positive, with a focus on the song's soothing and harmonious nature.
pros: Soothing sounds and excellent harmony create emotional resonance.
English subtitles allow broader appreciation of the song's message.
High-quality visuals, especially considering it was an early internet release.
cons: Computer visuals might not appeal to all viewers, despite being good for the time.

anime.title: Starship Troopers: Traitor of Mars
anime.synopsis: After the events of Invasion, Johnny Rico has been demoted to the rank of colonel and relocated to a Martian satellite to train a new batch of troopers. Unfortunately, these troopers are some of the worst low-performing Rico has ever trained as they're Martians and don't take the war seriously. Mars overall has low support for the war as they see their planet unaffected by the bug conflict and even suggested pulling out from the war. Because of their laid back attitude, the denizens of Mars wasn't ready when the bugs attacked. Unknown to everyone, Sky Marshall Amy Snapp executes her plans for power.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is surprisingly decent. While the graphics and story can be predictable, it maintains some of the dark humor and satire of the original movie. The action is better than average.
pros: Decent movie.
Dark humor.
Sarcasm and criticism of the fascist state.
Action is better than average.
cons: Computer graphics look off when focusing on unarmored humans.
Story and characters are quite predictable.

anime.title: Kase-san and Morning Glories
anime.synopsis:
Yui Yamada, a high school girl with a fondness for plants and gardening, starts dating Tomoka Kase, the ace of her school's track team. Yui is shy, girly, and has never been in a relationship. On the other hand, Tomoka is vivacious, tomboyish, and popular among her friends. Despite being different in so many ways, they try to understand and support each other while experiencing the rush of exhilaration that accompanies the magic of first love.

Asagao to Kase-san is a heartwarming tale of two girls dealing with their ever-increasing feelings for each other along with other concerns that plague the hearts of maidens in love.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the beautiful art and heartwarming yuri romance, with many finding the depiction of a lesbian relationship relatable and enjoyable. However, some find the characters shallow, the plot lacking, and the overall experience somewhat superficial. The series is considered a feel-good, fluffy romance, but not without its shortcomings in depth and story.
pros: Beautiful art and animation enhance the emotional impact.
Accurate and relatable depiction of a lesbian relationship, appreciated by lesbian viewers.
The fluff and romance are enjoyable and feel-good.
cons: Shallow characters and underdeveloped relationships.
Lack of a substantial plot or meaningful story progression.
Can feel boring due to excessive focus on cutesy moments without depth.

anime.title: One Piece: Episode of East Blue - Luffy and His Four Crewmates' Great Adventure
anime.romaji_title: One Piece: Episode of East Blue - Luffy to 4-nin no Nakama no Daibouken
anime.synopsis: The words that Gold Roger, the King of the Pirates, uttered just before his death excited the masses and the world has entered a Great Pirate Era! There is a group of young pirates who are about to set sail on the Grand Line. Monkey D. Luffy, a rubber man. Roronoa Zoro aka “Pirate Hunter.” Usopp, a sniper. Sanji, a seafaring cook. And “Cat Burglar” Nami. They, the Straw Hats, all place a foot upon a barrel and make their vows before their next journey across the great ocean. Luffy shouts “In order to be the King of the Pirates!” A decade ago in the Windmill Village... A little boy Luffy was enthralled with a pirate boss Red-Haired Shanks. But a group of mountain bandits shows up and makes fun of the pirates. “Why didn't you fight them?!” Luffy yells out angrily but Shanks says that it's nothing worth getting mad over. At that time, Luffy snatches the Gum-Gum Fruit from a treasure box and eats it and as a result, his entire body becomes rubber and he loses the ability to swim for the rest of his life! A few days later, Luffy is surrounded by the mountain bandits again and Shanks comes to help. “No matter what the reason, anyone who hurts my friends has to pay!!” Shanks and his pirate crew are incredibly strong and they beat down the mountain bandits. Higuma, the head of the mountain bandits, runs away kidnapping Luffy and heads for the sea. However, they encounter a local Sea Monster there and are attacked. Luffy is in a desperate situation... But again, Shanks saves the day. He outstares the Sea Monster and chases it away but in exchange, he loses his left arm... When Shanks leaves the village, he leaves his straw hat with Luffy. “Come bring it back to me someday! Once you've become a great pirate!” 10 years later, Luffy has grown up strong and he sets out for an adventure on a small boat. He again encounters the local Sea Monster for that fateful day. However, Luffy takes it down with a single blow of Gum-Gum Pistol. Luffy’s journey to become the King of the Pirates now begins!
anime.consensus_summary: The special is a well-received nostalgia trip for existing One Piece fans, offering a condensed and visually updated recap of the East Blue arc. However, it's not suitable as an introduction to the series due to its fast pace and assumed prior knowledge. The improved art quality is a highlight, but the condensed storytelling sacrifices depth for newcomers.
pros: Higher art quality compared to the original anime.
Effective recap of the East Blue arc, hitting important plot points.
Emotional and nostalgic experience for long-time fans.
cons: Not recommended for newcomers; lacks complete context.
Stories feel rushed and scattered due to time constraints.
Character development is lacking for those unfamiliar with the series.

anime.title: Our love has always been 10 centimeters apart.
anime.romaji_title: Itsudatte Bokura no Koi wa 10 cm Datta.
anime.synopsis:
Miou Aida and Haruki Serizawa might seem like polar opposites to those around them, but as the two third-years prepare to end their high school experience, they couldn't have been closer. While Miou is a shy and reserved member of the school art club that prefers to stay out of the limelight, Haruki is the boisterous and confident ace of the movie club, already winning awards for his directing prowess. However, after a previous chance encounter during their school entrance ceremony, they quickly become friends despite their stark differences in personality. But although their closeness might be growing, they've never become anything more than just that, much to the bewilderment of their friends.

As their time in high school draws to a close, Miou and Haruki, along with their friends in the art and movie clubs, have just one year left to face their hidden feelings and the daunting task of deciding their future careers. The two might always be only an arm's reach away, but as Haruki chases his dream of becoming a professional movie director and Miou struggles with choosing a path for herself, they'll learn just how hard it is to get past those last 10 centimeters.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is mostly positive, appreciating the anime's art, music, and relatable characters within a concise story. However, some viewers find the characters frustrating and the plot relies too heavily on overused tropes, leading to some disappointment. Overall, it's considered a heartwarming but not exceptionally unique romance.
pros: Beautiful art style and music.
Relatable characters and their interactions.
Good pacing and satisfying conclusion within a short format.
Exploration of themes like self-discovery and pursuing dreams.
cons: Frustrating lack of communication between main characters.
Protagonist is annoying and ruins the story's execution
Romance feels lacking.
Generic anime tropes, potentially predictable.
anime.thematic_vibe: High School Romance, Unrequited Love, Coming-of-Age

anime.title: Kaifeng Strange Tales: This Lord Bao is Not That Great
anime.romaji_title: Kai Feng Qitan: Zhege Baogong Bu Taixing
anime.synopsis: North Song Dynasty in ancient China, a legendary figure emerged in North Song's capital Kai Feng. He is governor Zheng Bao. Peasants call him Bao Gong (Lord Bao). In a corrupted government, he differentiates himself by demonstrating extreme honestly, uprightness, impartiality, and the courage to uphold justice, which, won him the title "Justice Bao". In Chinese folklore, Zheng Bao is the reincarnation of Megrez (Chinese God of Wisdom) and possesses supernatural powers. Kai Feng Story tells the legend of Bao Gong in a brand new type of personality.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience perceives the series as a casual and comedic take on the Bao Gong story. However, the plot development is seen as underdeveloped and hidden behind dense comedic sequences. The series attempts a more serious note at the end, but the story feels largely unresolved.
cons: Underdeveloped story
Awkwardly arranged plot events
Dense comedic sequences hiding plot issues

anime.title: Evil or Live
anime.genres: Gore, Horror, Psychological, School, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Severe internet addiction has become an epidemic infecting the nation's youth, ultimately resulting in their extreme dependence on the world wide web. Those who are too far gone are enrolled at Elite Reeducation Academy in order to help them grow into successful adults. Hibiki is one such teenager who awakens in the facility unaware of how he came to be there. He learns from the head instructor that he was knocked out and brought to the school at his mother's behest, concerned with how belligerent her son was becoming as a result of his internet addiction. 

Stuck in a place more akin to a prison than an academy, and with no escape from the abuses of the instructors, Hibiki decides to end his life by jumping from the roof. But as fate would have it, he meets a mysterious man named Shin who promises to give his life meaning...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some appreciate the unique story and dark themes, praising its originality and message, while others condemn the poor production quality, inconsistent characters, and confusing plot. The show is considered a 'love it or hate it' experience, with strong opinions on both sides.
pros: Unique story concept exploring internet addiction and its consequences.
Some viewers found the show enjoyable despite its flaws, appreciating its dark themes and satisfying ending.
A few reviewers highlighted the anime's attempt to tackle real-life issues and offer a message beyond entertainment.
cons: Poor animation quality, with choppy movements, frame shifts, and real-life images used as props.
Inconsistent and unlikeable characters with illogical behavior and poorly developed backstories.
Confusing plot with many unanswered questions, pacing problems, and a rushed ending.
Bad voice acting, sound effects, and a generally unappealing soundtrack.

anime.title: Pingu in the City
anime.synopsis: Pingu and his family move from their small village to the big city; in which there are many people with many different occupations. The ever-curious Pingu tries to join them at their jobs, but his mischievous side gets the better of him and he ends up messing things up.
anime.consensus_summary: Pingu in the City receives mixed reactions, with many praising its nostalgic charm, simple humor, and universal appeal, particularly for long-time fans of the original series. However, some find the reboot lacking in originality, expressiveness, and depth, citing repetitive storylines and underutilized settings. While enjoyable for children and nostalgic adults, it may not resonate with all viewers or newcomers seeking more complex narratives.
pros: Charming characters and humor.
Universally appealing due to lack of dialogue.
Simple, easy-to-understand themes and lessons.
Faithful to the original claymation concept (or a good adaptation).
Nostalgic experience for those who grew up with Pingu.
cons: Formulaic and repetitive storylines.
Generic city setting not fully utilized.
CG animation lacks the expressiveness of the original claymation.
Music is unnoteworthy.
May not appeal to newcomers who aren't already fans.

anime.title: Magical Girl Site
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Horror, Mahou Shoujo, Psychological, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Every day, Aya Asagiri thinks about killing herself. She is bullied relentlessly at school, and at home, her older brother Kaname physically abuses her to relieve the academic stress put on him by their father.

One night, as she lies awake wishing for death, a mysterious website called Magical Girl Site appears on her laptop, promising to give her magical powers. At first, she dismisses it as a creepy prank, but when she finds a magical gun in her shoe locker the next day, she doesn't know what to believe. Deciding to take it with her, she soon runs into her bullies once again. But this time, desperate for anything to save her, she uses the gun—and her assailants are transported to a nearby railroad crossing, where they are run over. 

Aya's conscience is unable to handle the fact that she murdered two of her classmates with magic, and she desperately tries to understand the situation. However, when she finds herself in trouble again, she is saved by Tsuyuno Yatsumura, a classmate who can use magic to stop time. This duo has a lot to do: not only do they have to fight alongside and against other magical girls, but they also need to uncover the truth behind the website and the apocalyptic event known as "The Tempest" that is soon to occur.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized. Some appreciate the show's dark themes and relatable characters, while others criticize it for being overly edgy, poorly written, and lacking substance. The series elicits strong emotions, both positive and negative, making it a divisive anime within the magical girl genre.
pros: Some viewers found the series relatable and moving, especially those who have experienced similar hardships.
The art style and voice acting were appreciated by some, with the opening theme being a highlight.
The series is self-aware and uses contrasts effectively to explore themes of love and friendship amidst a dark and chaotic world.
cons: The series is often criticized for being overly edgy and relying on shock value without substance.
Many find the plot convoluted, nonsensical, and poorly paced, with unresolved storylines and a disappointing ending.
Characters are often seen as flat, unsympathetic, and acting in ways that are not believable, with forced relationships and erratic behavior.

anime.title: Space Battleship Tiramisu
anime.synopsis:
Subaru Ichinose loves his cockpit as, to him, it's like being in his mother's womb. Whenever he struggles to converse with his fellow pilots, his cockpit is the one place he can be alone. As the ace pilot aboard the Tiramisu, Earth Union's most important battleship, it is his job to defend Mother Earth from the threats that emerge from humanity's extended dominion spreading throughout the vast reaches of the universe.

Armed with his personal mecha Durandal, Subaru must fend off encroaching foreign colonies as he struggles to protect his personal sanctuary from rogue fried pork skewers, suffocating backwards shirts, and unsolicited redecorations. In the year Space Age 0156, the fate of humanity rests entirely in his hands.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Some find the show's absurd humor and meta-commentary brilliant and refreshing, praising the voice acting and unique characters. Others are turned off by the lack of plot, inconsistent humor, and overall nonsensical nature of the show. The initial episode seems to be a major point of contention, with some viewers giving up before the show finds its footing.
pros: Unique and hilarious take on the mecha genre.
Excellent voice acting, especially in the dub.
Memorable and well-defined characters.
cons: Inconsistent humor, with some skits falling flat.
Lack of a coherent plot or meaningful story.
The first episode can be off-putting.

anime.title: Natsume's Book of Friends Season 6 Specials
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Suzunaru no Kirikabu 
On a hot summer day, Takashi Natsume and his feline companion Madara take a walk to buy jelly. Suddenly a truck passes the two, running over an old, masked man who asks Natsume for help. The mysterious individual turns out to be a youkai, the spirit of the Suzunaru tree that was recently hit by lightning and cut down. As the tree withers away, the youkai requests Natsume to fulfill his one final wish: to bring him water every day until he draws his last breath.

Mugen no Kakera 
Tamami, a young schoolgirl, counts her steps through a forest, following instructions on a piece of paper. She stops to take a break and falls asleep but is awakened by an odd talking cat. Through meeting the cat and his human partner, Natsume, she learns that the forest has its own separate world from the contemporary, where one can see things otherwise invisible. Putting her trust in the duo, Tamami tells them about the story of how she helped a white owl that reappeared in her dreams to lead her back inside the bizarre forest.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience feels deeply touched by the specials, praising their ability to evoke strong emotions like melancholy and bittersweetness. The stories effectively explore themes of memory and promises within a short duration. There is a slight sentiment that Natsume's reduced role might be a drawback for some viewers.
pros: Strong emotional impact in a short timeframe
Focus on the fragility of memories
Exploration of promises and their significance
cons: Natsume takes a backseat, potentially disappointing fans who want more focus on him.

anime.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Memory Snow
anime.romaji_title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu - Memory Snow
anime.synopsis:
Subaru Natsuki finally gets to take a breather, but he does not waste any time as he prepares for a date with his beloved Emilia. He scouts the nearby village for the right dating spot, and with the help of the village children, he finds a wonderful location. With that, he is well prepared for his date!

Unfortunately for Subaru, cold weather suddenly sweeps across Roswaal's mansion on his important day, leaving him with no choice but to postpone the date. Overnight, it becomes even colder and unbearable. Subaru must get to the bottom of this because, at this rate, his date will be the least of his worries.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences found 'Memory Snow' to be a pleasant, lighthearted side story that offers a break from the main series' intensity. While some criticize its lack of narrative importance and potential for character flanderization, many appreciate the chance to spend more time with the characters in a relaxed and humorous setting. The OVA is generally considered a worthwhile watch for fans of Re:Zero seeking a low-stakes, slice-of-life experience.
pros: Provides a comedic break from the series' usual dark tone.
Offers more time with beloved characters in a relaxed setting.
Delivers enjoyable character interactions and camaraderie.
cons: Lacks significant plot progression or character development.
May feel like filler or fan service to some viewers.
Some characters may act out of character.

anime.title: Glamorous Heroes
anime.synopsis:
A hot-blooded anime on the topic of e-sports based on the real Chinese online game 300 Da Zuozhan (300 Heroes). 

Former top professional gamer Aoba Kaito returns to the gaming circle to regain his professional qualification which was deprived due to a doping suspicion. He and his friends confront against the conspiracy and rise to the top of the leaderboards.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is highly polarized regarding 'Glamorous Heroes.' Many viewers consider it a poorly executed and generic anime with significant flaws in story, animation, and characters, leading to widespread dropping of the show. However, a subset of viewers find ironic or unironic enjoyment in its absurdity and meta-humor, making it a so-bad-it's-good experience for some, particularly when watched with friends.
pros: Enjoyable with friends due to its absurdity
Some find unironic enjoyment in its simple story and meta-breaking elements
Its short, bite-sized episodes
cons: Boring and generic plot with little connection to the synopsis
Poor animation quality with noticeable inconsistencies
Uninspired and emotionless voice acting, especially for certain characters
Generic and unappealing characters with little personality
Poor pacing, confusing plot points, and unnecessary fan service

anime.title: Xiang Ling Ji
anime.synopsis: The 19-year-old tomboy exorcist Hua Jiu got to know 'evil spirit' Seven Lord and forced him to be her spirit servant when cleansing spirits. Later the human being and the spirit set forth on a journey of ranting each other and cleansing spirits. However, Hua Jiu's enemy started insidious revenge at the same time...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds 'Xiang Ling Ji' enjoyable for casual viewing, with engaging characters and an unexpected ending, though some find character interactions annoying. The show is centered around themes of revenge, exorcism, and tragedy. Production quality is adequate but not exceptional, and the finale is potentially controversial.
pros: Enjoyable characters with tragic backstories.
Unexpected ending.
Good for casual watching.
cons: Annoying character interactions in some episodes.
Not particularly memorable soundtrack.
May not require much focus or thinking for spectators

anime.title: Ling Yu
anime.synopsis: In the world of Ling Yu(Spiritual Field), there is a continent named Chilan(Red Tide), where warriors and their Spirit Weapons are classified into different levels. Families and clans follow a strict hierarchy, too. Under the leadership of the Xuantian Union, human warriors and the Evil Clan have been engaged in brutal fights on Nether Battlefield for hundreds of years. A Soul-devouring Beast sneaked into the Chilan Continent through a crevice on the Nether Battlefield before it ruthlessly slaughtered the Feng Town and the Gao Town. Qin Lie, a young man from the Ling Town, together with Ling Yushi and Gao Yu whom he had grown up with, was commanded to help the Xuantian Union in the conquest of the Soul-devouring Beast. He did not anticipate that he would be swallowed into a great conspiracy. To protect his friends and to rescue the one he loves, the powers hiding in his veins are awakening.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers find the show enjoyable after a slow start, appreciating the cultivation and romance elements. However, many criticize the confusing plot, rushed pacing, weak main character, and unlikeable female lead, leading to disappointment.
pros: The story has potential and gets better after the first few episodes.
Some viewers appreciate the cultivation and romance aspects.
cons: Poorly explained power system and confusing plot.
Rushed pacing and lack of character development due to short episodes.
Many find the female lead toxic and unlikeable.
The main character is weak and doesn't develop as expected.

anime.title: Hinamatsuri
anime.genres: Childcare, Comedy, Organized Crime, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
While reveling in the successful clinching of a prized vase for his collection, Yoshifumi Nitta, a yakuza member, is rudely interrupted when a large, peculiar capsule suddenly materializes and falls on his head. He opens the capsule to reveal a young, blue-haired girl, who doesn't divulge anything about herself but her name—Hina—and the fact that she possesses immense powers. As if things couldn't get any worse, she loses control and unleashes an explosion if her powers remain unused. Faced with no other choice, Nitta finds himself becoming her caregiver. 

To let her use her powers freely, Nitta asks Hina to help out with a construction deal, which goes smoothly. But while this is happening, a rival yakuza group covertly attacks his boss. To Nitta's shock, his colleagues later pin the blame on him! Tasked with attacking the rival group in retaliation, Nitta steels himself and arrives at their hideout. But suddenly, Hina unexpectedly steps in and helps him wipe out the entire group. As it turns out, Hina might just become a valuable asset to Nitta and his yakuza business, provided she does not use her powers on him first! And so the strange life of this unusual duo begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Hinamatsuri is well-received for its unique blend of comedy and heartwarming slice-of-life elements. The characters are charming and the humor is effective, though some find the episodic nature and lack of a conclusive story arc disappointing. Overall, the audience consensus is highly positive, praising its fresh approach to comedy and the emotional depth it achieves.
pros: Unique blend of comedy and heartwarming moments.
Well-developed characters with distinct personalities.
Refreshing take on the comedy genre, avoiding common cliches.
cons: Episodic nature with little overarching plot progression.
Unresolved mysteries and lack of closure regarding the girls' origins.
Ending feels incomplete, leaving viewers wanting more.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Found Family

anime.title: I've Always Liked You: A Friday's Good Morning
anime.romaji_title: Zutto Mae kara Suki deshita. Kokuhaku Jikkou Iinkai: Kinyoubi no Ohayou
anime.synopsis: A picture drama special bundled with the BD/DVD release of the main film. It focuses on the relationship between Sena and Midori.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the short film for its cute and romantic portrayal of young love, typical of Honeyworks' style.  Some find the story and characters unoriginal and cliche, but appreciate the art and music. Overall, it leaves a warm impression, especially for those who enjoy high school romance anime.
pros: Good art style and bright colors capture the spirit of young love.
Music is nice, derived from a series of popular music videos.
Story is beautiful, cute, and surprisingly emotional in a gentle way.
cons: Unoriginal and contains many cliches.
Characters are uninteresting and lack depth.
Some aspects of the animation appear low-effort.

anime.title: Blade Runner: Black Out 2022
anime.synopsis: In 2022, an EMP detonation causes a global blackout that has massive, destructive implications all over the world. Directed by Cowboy Bebop and Samurai Champloo's Shinichiro Watanabe, Blade Runner: Black Out 2022 is an animated short which serves as a prologue for the feature film Blade Runner 2049.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences widely praise Blade Runner: Black Out 2022 for its stunning animation, evocative atmosphere, and stellar soundtrack, which effectively capture the essence of the Blade Runner universe. However, there's a significant split regarding its narrative depth, with many finding the story and character development lacking due to its short runtime, while others appreciate its thematic alignment and world-building contributions.
pros: Incredible animation quality and artistic direction, blending multiple styles effectively.
Stellar direction of action sequences, fluid and mesmerizing.
Soundtrack is noteworthy, complementing the atmosphere with a blend of Blade Runner's eerie melodies and jazz-inspired themes.
Successfully captures the dark, brooding atmosphere and visual style of the original Blade Runner.
Provides essential context and world-building for fans of the franchise.
cons: Narratively underdeveloped with thin character motivations and limited context for events.
Lacks substantial pre- or post-event context, leaving the scenario without strong structural support.
Characters remain largely unexplored, with one character dying without meaningful understanding of the situation.
The plot is serviceable but everything else (characters, action) is mediocre to terrible for some.
The action sequences, while fluid, can feel unbelievable and lack coherence.

anime.title: Butlers x Battlers
anime.synopsis: Butlers: They are guardians that hold a thousand-year history and a certain fate. Jay lived in peace with his little sister Tenna and a fellow Butler named Hayakawa. However, those peaceful days came to a sudden end. Tenna was swallowed up into the void and Jay was sent a hundred years into the future. Jay finds there is now an academy called Koyomi Academy standing in the place where his mansion once stood. Jay took up the name Jinguji Koma and became the student council president of the school as he looks for clues about the past. Jay will eventually find out the truth behind this world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative, citing a confusing and poorly executed storyline. While some viewers were initially intrigued by the premise and character designs, the consensus is that the anime fails to deliver on its potential. Common criticisms include poor pacing, weak animation, and an overabundance of underdeveloped characters, leading to an overall disappointing experience.
pros: Opening and ending themes are well-received.
Some viewers find the initial mystery intriguing.
Character designs are appealing to some viewers.
cons: Storyline is confusing and poorly developed.
Pacing issues, with events feeling rushed or abruptly introduced.
Slapstick comedy is uninspired and repetitive.
Animation quality is lacking, especially in fight scenes.
Too many characters with little impact on the plot.
Weak or nonexistent character development for many characters.
Incestuous undertones are off-putting to some viewers.

anime.title: Seven Senses of the Re'Union
anime.synopsis: Asahi's life in reality ended simultaneously when she died playing Union, a world-renowned online RPG. The members of Subaru went separate ways when Union shut down due to Asahi's death. Six years later, Haruto logs onto a renewed version of Re'Union and reunites with Asahi who had died. Is it really her or just an electronic ghost? The former team members reunite and enter the mysterious and deadly online game to find out.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative due to perceived lack of originality, weak characters, and a poorly executed story. Many feel it relies too heavily on tropes and fails to develop its own identity, resulting in a mediocre and unmemorable experience. However, some viewers found it charming and easy to watch despite its flaws.
pros: Some found the character development, particularly Takanori's, to be a redeeming quality.
A few reviewers appreciated the art and animation quality, finding it visually appealing.
Several viewers found the anime easy and charming to watch, especially as background entertainment.
cons: Many reviewers criticized the story as unoriginal, lazy, and heavily derivative of 'Anohana' and 'Sword Art Online'.
Several reviewers found the characters bland, generic, and lacking depth, often comparing them unfavorably to characters from other anime.
Numerous reviewers pointed out plot inconsistencies, nonsensical gaming elements, and weak world-building.
Several felt that the story was incomplete and rushed, with unresolved plot points and unsatisfying character arcs.

anime.title: Skull-face Bookseller Honda-san
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Otaku Culture, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Honda is a skeleton, but more importantly, they are a bookseller. And they will tell you from firsthand experience that the job of a bookstore employee is more challenging than it may seem to the average customer.

Alongside their equally eccentric coworkers, Honda constantly deals with the stressful requirements of the bookselling industry. From the drama of receiving new titles without their bonus material to the struggle of providing quality service to customers who speak a different language, the work of a skeleton bookseller never ends.

Nevertheless, despite the hardships they face, Honda thoroughly enjoys their job and strives to bring the best book selections and service to their customers.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is well-received as a comedic and insightful slice-of-life anime that offers a glimpse into the daily lives of bookstore employees in Japan. Viewers appreciate the unique character designs, relatable humor, and informative content about the bookselling industry. While some find the humor or art style unappealing, the short episodes and lighthearted tone generally make it an enjoyable experience.
pros: Insightful depiction of the bookselling industry in Japan.
Unique and expressive character designs despite minimalist art style.
Effective comedic timing and relatable workplace humor.
Informative about the book industry.
Lighthearted and easy to digest format due to short episodes.
cons: Comedy may not land for all viewers, some found it bland.
Animation style may not appeal to everyone initially.
Episodic structure may lack an overarching narrative for some viewers.
Short episode length may leave viewers wanting more.
anime.thematic_vibe: Workplace Comedy, Slice of Life, Industry Satire

anime.title: Full-Time Magister 2
anime.synopsis:
After defeating Yu Ang at the cost of revealing his lightning element, Mo Fan has been granted seven days to train in the Underground Holy Spring, where it is said that one can greatly increase their power level.

However, Mo Fan's training is abruptly cut short when fierce monsters mysteriously appear all around Bo City, something which should be impossible given the city's border defenses. An emergency is declared, and Mo Fan is tasked with delivering the Underground Holy Spring—now condensed into a small bottle—to a special refuge zone that is protected from the havoc in the city. 

The path there is long, dangerous, and riddled with bloodthirsty beasts. To worsen matters, the malicious Black Order threatens to halt his advance. How will Mo Fan stop the sacred spring from falling into the wrong hands?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Quanzhi Fashi II is highly polarized. While some viewers found it an entertaining, darker fantasy with improved production, a significant portion felt it was a drastic step down from the first season. Major criticisms include poor writing, character development, voice acting, and a rushed, unsatisfying plot, leading to a strong division between those who enjoyed its bleakness and those who found it a disappointing continuation.
pros: Animation quality improved compared to season 1, with better monster designs and smoother action scenes.
The darker tone and increased brutality provided an apocalyptic feel, which some viewers enjoyed.
The narrative shift to a shorter, more focused event (the Bo City Disaster) was seen as an improvement by some for better flow.
The increased stakes and sense of danger, with characters dying more readily, added a level of engagement for some.
cons: Extremely poor voice acting and bland MC personality, lacking depth and often described as a generic power fantasy.
Animation quality, while improved, is still considered subpar by many, with rushed drawings and stiff character movements.
Sound design is often criticized as cheesy, over-the-top, unnecessary, or generic.
Lack of character development for most characters, leaving them feeling hollow and serving only as plot devices for deaths.
Story pacing and logic issues, including plot holes, characters acting unreasonably, and predictable plot points.
The subtitles were frequently criticized for being unreadable or containing unnecessary, immature comments.
The season's ending was considered abrupt, anticlimactic, and unsatisfying, often leaving plot threads unresolved.
The attempt at a darker tone felt like characters were killed off without emotional impact, and the story progression was criticized as boring and uneventful over 12 episodes.

anime.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Stellar War Part 1
anime.romaji_title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Seiran 1
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
The Free Planets Alliance's invasion of the Galactic Empire has failed after supply mismanagement led to heavy losses. Unwilling to abort the expedition despite being greatly outnumbered, Fleet Admiral Lazar Lobos orders the remaining Alliance fleets to gather in the Amritsar Starzone for a final stand against the incoming counterattack.

Strategic genius Fleet Admiral Reinhard von Lohengramm leads the Imperial forces into this decisive battle with an overwhelming advantage. However, his rival, tactical magician Vice Admiral Yang Wen-li of the Alliance, once again makes up for the incompetence of his superiors and stages a narrow escape for himself and his fellow soldiers. Though both Reinhard and Yang are displeased with the outcome—the former for his imperfect victory and the latter for the tremendous casualties—their attention must turn to the bubbling political unrest on both sides of the galaxy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the adherence to the original story and the exploration of political themes, others are critical of the rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and awkward CGI. The retelling doesn't quite capture the essence of the original, leading to disappointment among some viewers, while others find it a decent, albeit flawed, adaptation.
pros: Faithful to the original story
Sets the stage for future events
Exploration of political philosophy and democracy's weaknesses
cons: Rushed pacing and lack of development
Characters feel flat compared to the original
Awkward 3D action sequences and CGI

anime.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Stellar War Part 2
anime.romaji_title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Seiran 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
Marquis Reinhard von Lohengramm's plot to destabilize the Free Planets Alliance succeeds when the treacherous former Rear Admiral Arthur Lynch instigates a coup on Heinessen. Equipped with a plan crafted by Reinhard himself, Lynch encourages his longtime friend Admiral Dwight Greenhill to supervise the National Salvation Military Council's toppling of the civilian government.
