Seeking to defend democracy and restore the Alliance constitution, Admiral Yang Wen-li faces off against his fellow citizens—and, regrettably, the father of his devoted adjutant Lieutenant Frederica Greenhill.

Now with the Free Planets Alliance thoroughly occupied with their own internal matters, the forces of the Galactic Empire can safely suppress the newly formed Lippstadt League led by Duke Otto von Braunschweig. However, with his friend and loyal subordinate High Admiral Siegfried Kircheis fighting far away in the noble-controlled frontier regions, Reinhard increasingly relies on the advice of the ruthless Vice Admiral Paul von Oberstein, whose influence within the esteemed Lohengramm admiralty steadily grows.

Though bloodshed is inevitable on both sides of the galaxy, Yang Wen-li of the Alliance and Reinhard von Lohengramm of the Empire each ask themselves the same questions: how will history look back on their actions? Will the ends justify the means?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While viewers appreciate the escalating conflict, thematic elements, and musical score, they criticize the lack of depth in political intrigue and the feeling that this season is a setup for future events. The series is viewed as a transitional phase, creating anticipation but also some frustration.
pros: Thematic implementation of utilitarian moral dilemmas.
Escalating conflict and complex war scenarios.
Classical orchestral music enhances the experience.
cons: Political and thematic matters presented aesthetically, lacking depth.
Big events occur rapidly without proper elaboration.
Feels like a transitional phase with anticipation for future events.
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Utilitarian Dilemma, War & Strategy

anime.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Stellar War Part 3
anime.romaji_title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Seiran 3
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
At the behest of Admiral Yang Wen-li, defected intelligence officer Commander Baghdash makes an emergency broadcast announcing that the National Salvation Military Council staged a coup under the direction of the Galactic Empire. Despite the lack of physical evidence, this debilitating declaration inspires former Rear Admiral Andrew Lynch to reveal his own role in sowing discord within the Free Planets Alliance. A fatal shootout between Lynch and Admiral Dwight Greenhill acts as the final death knell to the short-lived period of martial rule.

Within the Galactic Empire, footage of Duke Otto von Braunschweig's nuclear bombing of Westerland results in the dissolution of the Lippstadt League. Marquis Reinhard von Lohengramm's decision to allow the massacre for personal gain creates a rift between him and High Admiral Siegfried Kircheis, souring the taste of their inevitable victory. Now on the cusp of achieving absolute power, Reinhard is embattled by his apparent personal failings and the heavy responsibilities of leadership.

Though the civil wars in both the Alliance and the Empire are coming to a close, neither side can ever regain what is lost. Yang Wen-li and Reinhard von Lohengramm each take bitter solace in the knowledge that just on the other side of the galaxy is a worthy opponent—and a true equal.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the updated visuals and plot developments, while others criticize the changes to political nuance and character portrayals compared to the original OVA. The pacing is generally considered slower and more deliberate, but the lack of relationship progression is a common complaint. Overall, there is a sense that the remake offers both improvements and sacrifices relative to its source material.
pros: Important plot points and dialogue.
Slower pacing that aligns with the source material.
Strong character moments (Oberstein, Reinhard, Lynch).
Improved animation and CGI compared to the first season.
Story about complex human society.
More natural and credible character aesthetics with CGI upgrade.
cons: Political nuance and dialogue butchered compared to the original OVA.
Clear bias in the remake's narrative.
Skips content from the original work.
Limited relationship progression.

anime.title: Wise Man's Grandchild
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Reincarnation, Romance
anime.synopsis:
In the kingdom of Earlshide, Merlin Wolford was once regarded as a national hero, hailed for both his power and achievements. Preferring a quiet life however, he secludes himself deep in the rural woods, dedicating his time to raising an orphan that he saved. This orphan is Shin, a normal salaryman in modern-day Japan who was reincarnated into Merlin's world while still retaining his past memories. As the years pass, Shin displays unparalleled talent in both magic casting and martial arts, much to Merlin's constant amazement.

On his 15th birthday, however, it becomes apparent that Shin only developed his combat skills and nothing else, leaving him with blatant social awkwardness, a lack of common sense, and a middling sense of responsibility. As a result, Shin enrolls in the kingdom's Magic Academy to hone his skills and mature among other teenagers. However, living a normal life is impossible, as he is established as a local celebrity almost as soon as he arrives.

As Shin Wolford adjusts to his high school life in the capital, he makes new friends, learns about the world, and fights off the various forces of evil surrounding him and his city.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience sentiment is largely negative. Many find the series to be a generic and uninspired addition to the isekai genre, criticizing its reliance on overused tropes, bland characters, and predictable plot. Some viewers found it enjoyable as a lighthearted and humorous watch, but the overwhelming consensus is that it fails to bring anything new or interesting to the table.
pros: Enjoyable character chemistry, especially between the main cast.
The show doesn't take itself too seriously, making it easy to watch and relaxing.
Progression of the MC's romance is a welcome change from other anime.
Some found the show funny and lighthearted, a good watch for casual viewing.
cons: The plot is generic and uninspired, with overused isekai tropes.
Characters are bland and lack depth, relying on tired stereotypes.
The MC is overpowered with no real flaws, making the story lack stakes.
The writing is lazy, with cringeworthy dialogue and a predictable storyline.
Animation quality is subpar, and the soundtrack is generic.
anime.thematic_vibe: Isekai Trash, Overpowered MC, Generic Fantasy

anime.title: Yodel no Onna
anime.synopsis: The sound of yodeling will appear when you least expect it.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds 'Yodel no Onna' to be a bizarre and surreal experience, with its core appeal residing in its absurdity and catchy music loop. However, its crude humor and low production values are potential drawbacks. It seems the show's impact is more of a cult following than widespread appeal or controversy.
pros: Unique and bizarre premise
Memorable music (the 'Yodel is fact, yodel is logic' loop)
cons: Crude humor may not appeal to all audiences
Low production quality (likely due to its YouTube origins)

anime.title: One Room: Second Season
anime.synopsis: Second season of One Room.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely critical of One Room: Second Season, citing its awkward POV, shallow characters, and weak plot. Some appreciate the art style and voice acting, but overall, the series is seen as a poorly executed attempt at a self-insert romance. While some find it better than the first season, many view it as unnecessary and forgettable, leading to a polarized response.
pros: Visually appealing art style and animation quality.
Enjoyable voice acting performances.
Attempt to create unique character arcs for each girl.
Better than the first season for some viewers.
cons: Awkward camera angles and inconsistent POV implementation.
Lack of character depth and memorable personalities.
Forced interactions and disconnect with the audience.
Weak or generic story and plot development.
Uncomfortable and 'creepy' portrayal of relationships.
anime.thematic_vibe: Awkward Romance, Escapist Fantasy, First-Person Perspective

anime.title: A Certain Magical Index III
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Touma Kamijou can't catch a break. After the invasion of Academy City, political tensions continue to rise as both the science and magic factions collide head on. It appears that Academy City intends to declare war against the Roman Catholic Church, consequently plunging the whole world into global warfare. Touma soon finds himself on the front lines once again, striving to protect his friends and allies.

Toaru Majutsu no Index III serves as the last installment of the original franchise as Touma, Accelerator, and the true Level 0 Shiage Hamazura continue their separate journeys, leading up to the final act of the original light novel series.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Toaru Majutsu no Index III is highly polarized. Novel readers are overwhelmingly disappointed with the poor adaptation, citing rushed pacing, missing content, and confusing storytelling. Anime-only viewers are more divided, with some finding the action and overall plot enjoyable, while others struggle to follow the convoluted narrative and criticize the inconsistent animation quality.
pros: Enjoyable action sequences and fight choreography for anime-only viewers.
Voice acting is well-done and adds to the characters.
Some viewers found the overarching story gripping and engaging.
cons: Story is rushed and confusing, especially for those unfamiliar with the source material.
Poor adaptation of the light novels, with important plot points and character development omitted.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with noticeable CGI issues and off-model character designs.
Assumes prior knowledge of characters and events from previous seasons/spin-offs, making it difficult for newcomers to follow.

anime.title: My Hero Academia Season 3
anime.synopsis:
As summer arrives for the students at UA Academy, each of these superheroes-in-training puts in their best efforts to become renowned heroes. They head off to a forest training camp run by UA's pro heroes, where the students face one another in battle and go through dangerous tests, improving their abilities and pushing past their limits. However, their school trip is suddenly turned upside down when the League of Villains arrives, invading the camp with a mission to capture one of the students. 

Boku no Hero Academia 3rd Season follows Izuku "Deku" Midoriya, an ambitious student training to achieve his dream of becoming a hero similar to his role model—All Might. Being one of the students caught up amidst the chaos of the villain attack, Deku must take a stand with his classmates and fight for their survival.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers praise the engaging characters, animation, and incorporation of Western superhero elements with the Shonen genre, while others criticize the repetitive plot, rushed storylines, and lack of character development beyond a few main characters. There is a sense that the season peaks midway and then declines in quality.
pros: Engaging animation and purposeful dialog in fight episodes.
Characters are fun, compelling, and well-written with good reasons for their actions.
Season 3 features major plot shifts and character development.
Successfully melds Western superhero culture with shounen elements.
Crisp animation and phenomenal audio work.
cons: Story feels drawn out and repetitive.
Some villains are incompetent and storylines are rushed.
Characters besides Deku, Bakugou, and Todoroki lack development.
Inconsistent animation quality compared to previous seasons.
Overuse of recaps and repetitive information within episodes.

anime.title: LBX Girls
anime.synopsis:
Riko Morisawa, a young girl from Tokorozawa, goes on a trip to Tokyo with her friend Mana. While they roam around the shops of Ikebukuro, Riko spots a billboard about an event related to the Little Battlers eXperience (LBX) line of toys. Mana urges Riko to purchase one, and although initially declining, Riko soon avails a few LBX kits for her father.

Upon opening one of the boxes labeled "LBX Assassin," a temporal rift manifests itself and transports Riko into the sky of an alternate Japan. While she falls at terminal velocity, an exosuit based on the LBX Assassin materializes around her, saving her from the descent. However, on the ground, she encounters the Mimesis, lethal metallic creatures that invade world after world. As she flees away from these monsters, Riko is rescued by four other LBX-equipped girls. After learning about Riko's predicament, the group decides to recruit her into their combat unit—"Soukou Musume."

Soukou Musume Senki narrates how the unit endures the trials and tribulations they face, developing unbreakable bonds along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Soukou Musume Senki is mixed. While some appreciate the CG animation and find the series enjoyable despite its flaws, many criticize the weak storyline, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent tone. The show struggles to balance serious drama with slice-of-life elements, leaving viewers feeling unsatisfied with the overall narrative and abrupt conclusion.
pros: CG animation is surprisingly good.
OP and ED are pretty good.
Some viewers find the rhythm captivating and appreciate the effort put into the series.
cons: Story is slow and boring.
Characters are not very interesting; backstories feel random.
Switches between tense drama and slice-of-life are jarring and poorly executed.
Fails to utilize the LBX concept beyond basic elements.
Sudden ending feels cheated and lacks proper resolution.
Plot holes and unexplained elements, such as ghost-like girls and unused pods.

anime.title: Digimon Adventure tri. Future
anime.romaji_title: Digimon Adventure tri. 6: Bokura no Mirai
anime.synopsis:
The Chosen Children are distraught; believing they have lost one of their friends, the group struggles to find a way to defeat the rampaging Ordinemon. With few options left, they turn to Yamato Ishida for guidance and leadership, but Yamato himself is unsure of what to do.

Determined to save the world despite their tragedy, Yamato and his friends must take on the ferocious digital monster. As some of the children are missing their partners, they are at a significant disadvantage. Nevertheless, the Chosen Children resolve to fight until the end to secure their future and that of their friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Digimon Adventure tri. 6: Bokura no Mirai and the series as a whole, is met with significant disappointment, particularly regarding the narrative and character development. While some appreciate the nostalgia factor and updated animation, the overwhelming sentiment is that the series fails to live up to the original, with a weak plot, poorly written characters, and unresolved storylines leaving many fans dissatisfied. The movie format is also criticized for resulting in rushed pacing and neglected character arcs.
pros: Nostalgia factor for original Digimon Adventure fans.
Some viewers enjoyed the character growth and new animation for evolutions.
Soundtrack was appreciated by some, despite repetition.
cons: Poorly written characters with regression and lack of development.
Weak story with plot holes and rushed pacing due to the movie format.
Disregard for the Digimon Adventure 02 cast and unresolved plot points.
Inconsistent animation quality, especially facial expressions.
Meiko and Meicoomon felt like filler characters with an unsatisfying ending.

anime.title: Tada Never Falls in Love
anime.synopsis:
Love has never really been a concern for Mitsuyoshi Tada, and as the aspiring photographer enters his second year of high school, it truthfully could not be further from his mind. However, things just might change after he meets a bright and bubbly foreigner named Teresa Wagner while he was taking pictures of a cherry blossom tree. Nevertheless, after she asks him to photograph her, the two soon separate, only to meet each other again twice more that same day. Finding Teresa just as she is caught in a sudden downpour, Tada invites her to his family's coffee shop to dry off. There, she explains that she was separated from her traveling companion, a no-nonsense redhead named Alexandra "Alec" Magritte. When Alec reunites with Teresa shortly after, they say their goodbyes, expecting to part ways for good—but the two unexpectedly show up as transfer students in his class the next day.

Teresa and Alec quickly get used to their lives at Koinohoshi High School and decide to join Tada in the photography club, along with his narcissistic friend Kaoru Ijuuin, the idol-obsessed Hajime Sugimoto, the serious class rep Hinako Hasegawa, and the dog-like Kentarou Yamashita. With these two peculiar additions to his equally eccentric group of friends, Tada's second year of high school is about to get even livelier, and he might need to start rethinking his approach to love.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some enjoyed the cute characters, romance, and visuals, while others criticized the generic story, rushed pacing, and shallow character development. The ending was divisive, with some finding it satisfying and others finding it too generic and unresolved.
pros: Likable characters and character chemistry, especially early on.
Visually appealing art style and animation.
Satisfying ending for some viewers.
cons: Generic and clichéd plot elements with a lack of originality.
Poorly written story, shallow character development, and rushed pacing, especially towards the end.
Plot progression delayed until late in the series.

anime.title: Sword Art Online: Alicization
anime.synopsis:
The Soul Translator is a state-of-the-art full-dive interface which interacts with the user's Fluctlight—the technological equivalent of a human soul—and fundamentally differs from the orthodox method of sending signals to the brain. The private institute Rath aims to perfect their creation by enlisting the aid of Sword Art Online survivor Kazuto Kirigaya. He works there as a part-time employee to test the system's capabilities in the Underworld: the fantastical realm generated by the Soul Translator. As per the confidentiality contract, any memories created by the machine in the virtual world are wiped upon returning to the real world. Kazuto can only vaguely recall a single name, Alice, which provokes a sense of unease when mentioned in reality.

When Kazuto escorts Asuna Yuuki home one evening, they chance upon a familiar foe. Kazuto is mortally wounded in the ensuing fight and loses consciousness. When he comes to, he discovers that he has made a full-dive into the Underworld with seemingly no way to escape. He sets off on a quest, seeking a way back to the physical world once again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Sword Art Online: Alicization are highly divided. While some appreciate the improved animation, character development, and mature themes, others criticize the slow pacing, excessive exposition, and departure from the original cast. Many agree that Alicization is a significant departure from previous SAO seasons, for better or worse.
pros: Stunning animation and sound design.
Character development for Kirito and new characters.
Mature themes and ethical questions explored.
Focus on clever tactics over overpowered abilities.
cons: Boring exposition and unnecessary details.
Inconsistent plot and pacing issues.
Deus ex machina moments.
Loss of focus on original SAO characters.

anime.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online
anime.romaji_title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online
anime.synopsis:
Clad in desert pink and the size of a mere child, the infamous "Pink Devil" mercilessly hunts down other players in the firearm-centered world of the virtual reality game Gun Gale Online. But in real life, this feared player killer is not quite who anyone would expect.
 
A shy university student in Tokyo, Karen Kohiruimaki stands in stark contrast to her in-game avatar—in fact, she happens to stand above everyone else too, much to her dismay. Towering above all the people around her, Karen's insecurities over her height reach the point where she turns to the virtual world for an escape. Starting game after game in hopes of manifesting as a cute, short character, she finally obtains her ideal self in the world of Gun Gale Online. Overjoyed by her new persona, she pours her time into the game as LLENN, garnering her reputation as the legendary player killer.
 
However, when one of LLENN's targets gets the best of her, she ends up meeting Pitohui, a skilled yet eccentric woman. Quickly becoming friends with Karen, Pitohui insists that LLENN participates in Squad Jam, a battle royale that pits teams against one another, fighting until only one remains. Thrust into the heated competition, LLENN must fight with all her wit and will if she hopes to shoot her way to the top.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided, with some finding it a fun and engaging action series with relatable characters and better VR gaming mechanics than the original SAO. However, others criticize the show for its predictable plot, shallow characters, and illogical game design. Overall, it's considered an average but enjoyable series, particularly for fans of action and VR gaming, but falls short of being an emotional masterpiece.
pros: Engaging action sequences and gunplay
Interesting exploration of VR gaming mechanics
Relatable characters with personal insecurities and motivations
Better than the original Sword Art Online
Good Sound design
cons: Predictable plot and shallow story
Underdeveloped and unlikeable characters
Inconsistent and illogical game mechanics
Overpowered main character with plot armor
Boring story

anime.title: Drifters
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Gore, Historical, Isekai, Military, Samurai, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Despite the Ends’ attack on Verlina being successfully repelled, the war has not yet ended. With the monster armies regrouping, the Black King tightens his grasp on the already conquered territory. New conflicts erupt all across Orte, as its remaining forces struggle to retain control over long-oppressed demi-human races.

While Ends grow more potent each day, Toyohisa Shimazu remains unconscious after heavy injuries suffered during the Battle of Verlina. Facing enemies on every side, humanity’s fate is still on a knife's edge.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the continuation of the Drifters story and further character development. However, some find the lack of a conclusive ending and tonal inconsistencies disappointing.  The limited presence of the main character in this OVA is also a point of criticism.
pros: Continuation of the Drifters series
Further exploration of characters, especially the main villain
cons: Story abruptly ends without a conclusion
Inclusion of shallow dialogue contrasting with the show's established tone
Limited screen time for the main character, Toyohisa

anime.title: B-Project: Zecchou*Emotion
anime.synopsis: Tsubasa continues her job at the A&R department of the major recording company Gandala Music. The idol group "B-PROJECT" that she has been in charge of, now made up of four idol units instead of three: Kitakore, Thrive, MooNs, and KiLLER KiNG. Tsubasa must deals with not only the various challenges of her job but also a group of young men with different personalities.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative. While the music and art are considered decent by some, the weak story, poor character development, and sloppy production overshadow any positives. Many viewers find the plot confusing and the addition of new characters overwhelming, leading to a generally disappointing experience.
pros: Decent music and songs.
Aesthetically pleasing art style with bright colors.
cons: Weak and confusing story with plot holes and pacing issues.
Poor character development with too many characters to keep track of.
Superficial and shallow new characters.
Dreadful and sloppy art with dull colors and animation.
Cringe-worthy dialogue.

anime.title: Princess Principal Picture Drama
anime.synopsis: Picture dramas bundled with the Blu-ray and DVD volumes.
anime.consensus_summary: The picture dramas offer more of the same character interactions that fans enjoy, albeit in a lower-stakes, slice-of-life format. While the stories are enjoyable, they don't contribute anything new to the overall plot. The slideshow-style animation is a drawback but doesn't detract significantly from the experience for those invested in the characters.
pros: Nice character moments and interactions.
Enjoyable stories and settings despite slideshow style.
cons: Significantly lower stakes compared to the main series.
Nothing new plot-wise.
Slideshow style animation due to cost-saving.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Character Interaction, Low Stakes

anime.title: Fights Break Sphere
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is highly divided, particularly regarding the first season. Many find the initial adaptation to be a poor representation of the source material with issues in story, characterization, and editing. However, later seasons and specials are significantly improved, with engaging stories and compelling visuals, leading to an overall mixed but appreciative reception for the donghua as a whole.
pros: Engaging story with martial arts and fantasy elements
Protagonist evolves with real charisma
Top-tier visuals in later seasons
Detailed world-building with a well-thought-out system
Themes of perseverance, inner strength, and self-discovery
cons: Poor execution in the first season with stale story and bad animation
Messy editing with abrupt cuts that interrupt the flow
Characters act nothing like their source material counterparts
Story can feel slow at times
MC's character was horribly nerfed in the first season

anime.title: Tokyo Ghoul:re
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Psychological, Seinen, Suspense, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Two years have passed since the CCG's raid on Anteiku. Although the atmosphere in Tokyo has changed drastically due to the increased influence of the CCG, ghouls continue to pose a problem as they have begun taking caution, especially the terrorist organization Aogiri Tree, who acknowledge the CCG's growing threat to their existence.

The creation of a special team, known as the Quinx Squad, may provide the CCG with the push they need to exterminate Tokyo's unwanted residents. As humans who have undergone surgery in order to make use of the special abilities of ghouls, they participate in operations to eradicate the dangerous creatures. The leader of this group, Haise Sasaki, is a half-ghoul, half-human who has been trained by famed special class investigator, Kishou Arima. However, there's more to this young man than meets the eye, as unknown memories claw at his mind, slowly reminding him of the person he used to be.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Tokyo Ghoul:re is highly divided, with many manga readers expressing disappointment over the rushed adaptation and poor animation quality. Anime-only viewers often found the story confusing and hard to follow, though some enjoyed the fresh storyline and new characters. Overall, the season is considered a significant step down from the first season, with only the soundtrack receiving consistent praise.
pros: Some viewers appreciated the new characters and their interactions.
The soundtrack was generally well-received, particularly the opening theme.
The shift in perspective to the CCG was a welcome change for some viewers.
cons: Many felt the adaptation rushed the plot and skipped important details from the manga.
The animation quality was considered a significant downgrade from previous seasons.
Several reviewers found the story confusing and difficult to follow, especially anime-only viewers.
The main character, Haise, was criticized for being boring and lacking depth.

anime.title: Yotsuiro Biyori
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Gourmet, Iyashikei, Seinen, Slice of Life, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Kyousui "Sui" Tougoku inherits a traditional Japanese-style cafe called Rokuhoudou from his grandfather, which he manages alongside Gregorio "Gure" Valentino, Tokitaka Nagae, and Tsubaki Nakao. Their hospitality par excellence undoubtedly turns any one-time visitor into a regular. Having gone through their own share of trials and tribulations, the staff at this modest cafe do their best to serve their customers—whether it be through tea, sweets, or even helping with the various troubles one may have.

Although most days pass pleasantly, the small world of Sui and his friends takes an unexpected path when their reputation as a cafe flourishes overnight.
anime.consensus_summary: Rokuhoudou Yotsuiro Biyori is a relaxing and heartwarming slice-of-life anime appreciated for its beautiful visuals, calming atmosphere, and focus on food and relationships. While some find the plot weak and the pace slow, many viewers enjoy it as a comforting and uplifting show. It is best suited for those seeking a low-intensity, feel-good experience.
pros: Beautiful art style and animation
Relaxing and calming atmosphere
Wholesome and heartwarming stories
Likable characters with good chemistry
Delicious-looking food
cons: Plot is weak and lacking
Can be too slow and boring
Episodic nature lacks overall story connection
Humor sometimes misses the mark

anime.title: Beatless
anime.synopsis:
With great advancements in technology, mankind has created hIEs, human-like robots that act as public and personal servants for society. Unlike many others, the kind-hearted high school student Arato Endou treats hIEs as equals, but his financial situation keeps him from ever owning one.

However, his normal life is shattered when an ordinary run to the local grocery store goes horribly awry. Viciously assaulted by a hacked hIE, Arato is on the verge of death; but luckily, he is saved by an abnormal hIE carrying a weaponized coffin. Her name is Lacia, one of five highly advanced hIEs that recently escaped the clutches of the mysterious MemeFrame Corporation.

Faced with a hacked car threatening to run them over, Lacia offers Arato a deal: in exchange for saving his life, he must register as her new owner, thus taking full responsibility for her actions. With little choice, he decides to trust this artificial girl and allows her to live in his home. Though Lacia begins to adapt to her new, peaceful lifestyle, she warns the entranced Arato of one thing—she does not have a soul.
anime.consensus_summary: Beatless is a visually appealing anime with an interesting premise that explores complex themes about AI and humanity. However, it suffers from poor execution, including bad pacing, underdeveloped characters, and a convoluted plot. Many viewers found the numerous recap episodes and slow progression frustrating, resulting in a generally negative reception despite some appreciation for its unique elements.
pros: Unique story concept.
Good animation quality.
Well-designed female characters (waifus).
Soundtracks and voice acting are decent.
Explores themes related to AI, humanity, and societal impact.
cons: Poor pacing due to numerous recap episodes.
Underdeveloped and uninteresting characters, especially the main protagonist.
Inconsistent plot and world-building.
Boring and dull story execution.
Mediocre art and animation at times.
Inability to execute the plot in an understandable way

anime.title: Batman Ninja
anime.genres: Action, Martial Arts, Samurai, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
At Arkham Asylum, Batman clashes with Gorilla Grodd while trying to destroy Grodd's newest invention: the Quake Engine. Amidst the chaos, the engine activates, and the entire asylum suddenly vanishes into thin air—Batman along with it. Once the dust settles, Batman finds himself standing in the middle of an unfamiliar road. He soon realizes that he is no longer in Gotham City—but instead in Feudal Japan!

The amazement quickly fades as samurai descend upon him, seeking to take his life. Later on, Batman's investigation leads him to discover that the one responsible for the kill order is none other than his archnemesis, the Joker. Following an encounter with Catwoman, he learns that the asylum's criminals had teleported there two years earlier—each ruling over a piece of Japan with Joker being the dominant warlord.

In order to return home, Batman must reactivate the Quake Engine, situated in the remnants of the asylum, now known as Arkham Castle. However, there is one problem: aside from his gadget belt, the arsenal that was once at his fingertips is all but gone. Ninja Batman follows the Dark Knight as he traverses a strange new environment, facing off against familiar foes in a bid to return to Gotham in one piece.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is sharply divided, with many praising its unique visual style, over-the-top action, and embrace of anime tropes. However, critics frequently point to a nonsensical plot, inconsistent characters, and poor English sound mixing as significant drawbacks. It's a film that embraces its absurdity, leading to a love-it-or-hate-it reaction.
pros: Stunning visual presentation with a blend of CGI and hand-drawn animation.
Exciting and well-directed action sequences with fluid animation.
Unique and impressive character designs, particularly for Joker and Catwoman.
Fantastic soundtrack and sound mixing in the Japanese version.
Entertaining and over-the-top 'Rule of Cool' narrative that embraces anime tropes.
Strong voice acting, especially for the Joker.
cons: Story is often nonsensical, rushed, and relies heavily on deus ex machina resolutions.
Characterizations and motivations are frequently inconsistent or poorly developed.
Sound mixing in the English version is poor, with voices overpowering other audio elements.
Some plot elements are repetitive or feel like a waste of time.
The CGI can be janky at times, particularly in certain action sequences.
The blend of anime and Batman elements can feel jarring and nonsensical to some viewers.

anime.title: Spiritpact: Bond of the Underworld
anime.synopsis: In this new season, we will discover the backstory of Tanmoki and who will learn through his memories who was his ancestor Rakugetsu.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 of Ling Qi is generally well-received, with viewers appreciating the improved plot, character development, and exploration of the leads' relationship. However, some criticize the overuse of flashbacks and the perceived lack of focus on one of the main characters.  The cliffhanger ending and uncertainty about a third season have also left some viewers disappointed.
pros: Improved plot and pacing compared to season 1.
Well-developed characters with good chemistry.
Meaningful exploration of Duanmu Xi's character and backstory.
Beautiful animation and entrancing opening music.
cons: Heavy reliance on flashbacks.
Some unanswered questions and plot points left unresolved.
Perceived lack of focus on Jing Hua's character development.
Soundtrack could have been used more effectively to enhance tension.

anime.title: Dorei-ku The Animation
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, High Stakes Game, Psychological, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Eager to know why her best friend's boyfriend dumped her for a man, the headstrong Eiya Arakawa suggests a meeting with them. Gathered together at a café, Yuuga Oota agrees to answer Eiya's questions only if she can correctly ascertain the relationship of a couple sitting across from them, which she does on her first attempt. Amazed by her astounding intellect and intuition, he invites her to a private meeting where he introduces her to the concept of Slave Control Method, or SCM, a retainer-like device that has the ability to turn people into slaves.

When two SCM users enter a duel, the devices exert a powerful influence on their brains. Once the duel is over, the SCM amplifies the loser's sense of obligation and forces them to bend to the will of the winner. Wanting desperately to test his own abilities, Yuuga asks Eiya to act as his insurance in the event that he himself becomes a slave. Granted access to 10 million yen, Eiya's job is to convince Yuuga's would-be master to free him from his servitude. Though hesitant at first, Yuuga's words resonate with her personal yearning for something more from her life, and she agrees to his request. However, when a mysterious organization begins rapidly accruing slaves, Eiya becomes entangled in a game far more dangerous than she ever could have imagined.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many criticizing the poor execution of an interesting premise. Common complaints include a convoluted plot, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent production quality. Some viewers found it enjoyable on a superficial level, while others deemed it a waste of time due to its numerous flaws and reliance on shock value.
pros: Interesting and unique concept.
Some characters have interesting motives and backgrounds.
Enjoyable at face value, especially if interested in psychology.
cons: Lackluster plot with many plot holes and contrivances.
Too many characters with little development.
Inconsistent art and animation quality.
Weak music that doesn't match the intensity of scenes.
Forced character evolution and unrealistic decisions.
Games are uninspired and predictable.

anime.title: Bullet Train Transforming Robot Shinkalion The Animation
anime.romaji_title: Shinkansen Henkei Robo Shinkalion The Animation
anime.synopsis:
Hayato Hayasugi (his last name is a pun on the words for "too fast") and other children will serve as conductors to pilot the Shinkalion. The Shinkalion robots are various models of real-life Japanese bullet trains (shinkansen) that transform into robots to fight an unknown evil to protect the safety and peace of Japan.

The children must work together with the adults of the Shinkansen Ultra Evolution Institute (SUEI) to defeat a monster that looks like a jet black bullet train.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Shinkansen Henkei Robo Shinkalion The Animation' as a fun and visually appealing mecha anime, especially for its creative premise and educational elements. Some viewers express minor concerns about the CG animation and writer consistency. The show is considered a good entry point to the mecha genre and a nostalgic experience for fans of trains and robots.
pros: Good visuals and animation, especially during transformations.
Fun and engaging plot, even for older viewers.
Creative combination of Shinkansen (bullet trains) and mecha.
Educational aspect of learning about Japanese trains and railways.
cons: CG battle scenes may not appeal to all viewers.
Wishlist for inclusion of more Shinkansen models.
Concerns about the writer's consistency due to external factors (Toei's influence).

anime.title: Starmyu 3rd Season
anime.genres: Music, Performing Arts, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Following a successful graduation performance, Yuuta Hoshitani and the rest of the second years begin preparations for the upcoming Ayanagi Festival. This year's festival is the first time the students will be without their Kao Council mentors, giving them the creative freedom to do what they want. Hoping to perform alongside each other for once, the second years decide to put on a joint production together. The festival’s opening ceremony will also serve another purpose—to reveal next year's Kao Council candidates. 

The Kao Council announces that Team Hiiragi was selected for the opening ceremony performance, preventing them from participating in the collaboration. This shocks and enrages Hoshitani and the others, driving a rift between them and the Kao Council. In an effort to realize their dreams, the students begin to hatch a plan to ensure that all of the second years can perform together on stage.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Starmyu 3rd Season is mixed and leans towards disappointment. Many feel the plot is recycled and weak, with underdeveloped new characters and less memorable music compared to previous seasons. While some still enjoy the musical aspects and animation, the overall consensus suggests a decline in quality, leaving long-time fans feeling unsatisfied.
pros: Appealing characters (in previous seasons)
Enjoyable musical aspects
Clean animations and nice art
cons: Weak and slow story
Forced and convoluted plot
Underdeveloped new characters overshadowing older ones
Recycled plot from the first season
Antagonists' motives unclear
Less satisfying songs compared to previous seasons

anime.title: Starmyu in Halloween
anime.genres: Music, Performing Arts, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Halloween has arrived at Ayanagi Academy, bringing copious amounts of pumpkins, decorations, and delicious seasonal foods with it. Yuuta Hoshitani and his classmates enjoy preparing for the festivities until Kouki Nanjou tells a creepy ghost story, putting all of them on edge. As night draws closer, the lights in their dormitory go out and ghosts begin to appear, making the group believe that Nanjou's eerie tale is actually rooted in truth! While Hoshitani and a few others cower in fear, the rest of them investigate the supernatural occurrence to find the truth behind what is really going on.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted and fun Halloween-themed story that provides a glimpse into the characters' lives outside of school. The episode is praised for its comedic and slice-of-life elements, as well as its entertaining Halloween musicals. However, it lacks significant character development, but doesn't detract from the overall enjoyment.
pros: Fun story that showcases the characters outside of their school curriculum.
Lightheartedness of the OVA presented the characters with more familiarity.
Halloween themed musicals are entertaining.
cons: No character developments.

anime.title: Natsume's Book of Friends Movie: Ephemeral Bond
anime.romaji_title: Natsume Yuujinchou Movie: Utsusemi ni Musubu
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Takashi Natsume and his spirit companion Madara, nicknamed "Nyanko," continue returning the names of spirits from the Book of Friends given by his late grandmother Reiko Natsume.

On his way back from school one day, Takashi encounters a lurking spirit named Monmonbou, who recalls memories of Takashi's grandmother after hearing his name. Takashi's natural curiosity leads him to explore a mysterious town where his grandmother used to live. Befriending her old acquaintance Yorie Tsumura and Yorie's son Mukuo, Takashi unveils more of his grandmother's past.

In the meantime, Nyanko detours for food and stumbles upon a suspicious "Spirit Seed," which miraculously sprouts into a fruit tree overnight. Giving in to temptation, Nyanko consumes the fruit, splitting him into three. Seeking a solution to Nyanko's predicament, Takashi and his friends lend a hand, unexpectedly uncovering more secrets the town holds in the process.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is generally well-received by fans of the Natsume Yuujinchou series, providing a familiar and calming experience. While praised for its improved visuals and adherence to the series' themes, some find the plot predictable and the pacing slow. It's considered a pleasant addition for existing fans but may not offer significant novelty.
pros: Improved art and animation compared to the series.
Faithful to the Natsume Yuujinchou vibe and characters.
Well-executed story with intertwining aspects.
cons: Story can feel repetitive and predictable.
Pacing issues; the movie could have been shorter.
Re-establishing the setting feels slow for long-time fans.

anime.title: Kokkoku
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Seinen, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
After presumably failing 19 job interviews in one day, Juri Yukawa's dreams of moving out of her parents' home are utterly dashed. Stuck living with her working mother Nobuko, NEET brother Tsubasa, laid-off father Takafumi, and single-parent sister Sanae, the only hope for this family to raise a decent adult is her little nephew Makoto. However, this struggling family's life takes a turn for the worse when Makoto and Tsubasa are violently kidnapped by a mysterious organization and held for ransom. With only 30 minutes to deliver five million yen to the criminals, Juri's grandfather reveals a dangerously powerful secret to her and Takafumi.

By offering blood to her grandfather's mystical stone, the three enter the world of "Stasis," a version of their world where time stops for everyone but the users. Having arrived at their destination, their rescue efforts go awry when they are assailed by a surprising group of people who are somehow able to move around within Stasis. While all hope seems lost, a monstrous giant known as the Herald appears amidst the chaos, its intent and motivations as cryptic as the very nature of this timeless world.
anime.consensus_summary: Kokkoku starts with an intriguing premise involving a family who can enter a world where time is stopped, but the execution falters significantly. Many reviewers found the plot riddled with inconsistencies and underdeveloped characters. While some appreciated the initial mystery and moral implications, the ending is generally considered rushed and unsatisfying, leading to a polarized but ultimately disappointed audience.
pros: Intriguing concept of stopped time (Stasis) and its moral implications.
Strong female lead character in Juri.
Well-developed family dynamics (at least initially).
Excellent opening and ending themes.
Good world-building initially.
cons: Illogical and underdeveloped story with many plot holes and inconsistencies.
Inconsistent pacing with too much filler and irrelevant backstories.
Weak and poorly fleshed-out antagonist.
Rushed and unsatisfying ending with ex machina elements.
Inconsistent animation and art style.
Characters lacking depth and development beyond initial archetypes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Supernatural Mystery, Dysfunctional Family, Time Stop

anime.title: Megalobox
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Combat Sports, Sci-Fi, Sports
anime.synopsis:
"To be quiet and do as you're told, that's the cowardly choice." These are the words of Junk Dog, an underground fighter of Megalo Box, an evolution of boxing that utilizes mechanical limbs known as Gear to enhance the speed and power of its users. Despite the young man's brimming potential as a boxer, the illegal nature of his participation forces him to make a living off of throwing matches as dictated by his boss Gansaku Nanbu. However, this all changes when the Megalo Box champion Yuuri enters his shabby ring under the guise of just another challenger. Taken out in a single round, Junk Dog is left with a challenge: "If you're serious about fighting me again, then fight your way up to me and my ring."

Filled with overwhelming excitement and backed by the criminal syndicate responsible for his thrown matches, Junk Dog enters Megalonia: a world-spanning tournament that will decide the strongest Megalo Boxer of them all. Having no name of his own, he takes on the moniker of "Joe" as he begins his climb from the very bottom of the ranked list of fighters. With only three months left to qualify, Joe must face off against opponents the likes of which he has never fought in order to meet the challenge of his rival.
anime.consensus_summary: Megalo Box receives praise for its visuals, music, and initial hype, but is criticized for a shallow story, rushed character development, and predictable plot. While many enjoyed it as a tribute to Ashita no Joe, others found it a disappointing imitation. The overall sentiment leans towards a visually appealing but narratively weak experience.
pros: Appealing visual aesthetic reminiscent of older anime.
Catchy and fitting soundtrack.
Exciting and hype-inducing boxing matches.
cons: Story feels rushed and underdeveloped, especially character motivations.
Predictable and generic plot, lacking depth beyond surface level.
Inconsistent power scaling and unrealistic fight sequences.

anime.title: Major 2nd
anime.synopsis:
Daigo, the son of renowned baseball player Gorou Shigeno, believes he has to live up to his father's name by becoming an all-star player himself. With great dreams, as soon as he reaches fourth-grade, he promptly joins the same little league baseball team his dad played on, the Mifune Dolphins. However, things don't go as planned. After only the first couple of practices, Daigo's lack of talent and inherent baseball sense shows, and his confidence is crushed. Unable to bear the pressure of living up to his father, a baseball prodigy, he quits the team in less than a year.

Two years later, now in sixth-grade, a transfer student joins Daigo's class. This student turns out to be Hikaru, the son of Gorou's lifelong friend and fellow baseball star, Toshiya Satou. One day, Daigo's mother receives a call from the Dolphins requesting players for a game, so she forces Daigo to attend. To Daigo's surprise, he finds Hikaru there. Even more shocking is that despite his father's occupation, Hikaru has never played baseball before!

Unlike Daigo, though, Hikaru immediately picks up the game demonstrating excellent performance. Needless to say, Daigo and Hikaru are polar opposites of each other. But this friction will inevitably thrust both of these inexperienced children into the world their fathers cherish—the world of baseball.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, particularly among fans of the original Major series, who appreciate the emotional depth and character development. Some find the plot compromises and animation inconsistencies detract from the experience. The series effectively explores themes of legacy and overcoming expectations, though some miss the strategic baseball elements of the original.
pros: Strong character development, especially focusing on the struggles and growth of the protagonist.
Emotional depth and resonance, evoking feelings similar to the original series.
Exploration of the pressure and expectations faced by children of successful athletes.
Storytelling that resonates with fans of the original Major series while offering a fresh perspective.
cons: Compromises in the storyline to cater to new audiences may detract from the overall quality for long-time fans.
Inconsistent animation quality, with some visual choices (e.g., sparkles during pitching) being criticized.
Pacing issues, with some finding the initial episodes less engaging.
Potential departure from the detailed baseball strategy and character power levels seen in the original series.
anime.thematic_vibe: Overcoming Expectations, Generational Legacy, Character Growth

anime.title: Granblue Fantasy: The Animation Season 2
anime.synopsis:
On the run from the Erste Empire, Gran and the crew of the Grandcypher receive an offer to negotiate a ceasefire. Meeting at the neutral territory of Albion Citadel, they are welcomed and hosted by Vira Lillie: current Lord Commander of Albion and a friend of Katalina Alize from her officer training at Albion. Imperial General Furias grants the Skyfarers an official pardon, but fails to defuse the tense situation.

Given time to unwind, the Skyfarers attend a gala hosted by Vira to celebrate the arrival of the crew. However, tensions run high, as Furias and the Erste delegation remain at Albion even after the negotiations conclude. Learning about the existence of a Primal Beast on the island, the crew is shocked to discover a letter from Katalina announcing her resignation.

While Gran heads off to find their former comrade, Eugen and Rackam decide to investigate the Imperial presence on the island, suspecting a more sinister scheme lying up the Empire's sleeve.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciated the character development, especially Vira's arc, and the improved animation. However, others found the plot inconsistent, the characters unengaging, and the overall story generic and disappointing, especially in the later half of the season.
pros: Improved animation quality by MAPPA.
Interesting character backstories and development, especially Vira.
The story delved a bit into the history of some of the characters.
Music was pretty nice.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and plot development in the later episodes.
Generic and disappointing core conflicts in some arcs.
Characters making stupid and cheesy decisions.
Gran is a boring and useless main character.
Villains are not engaging.

anime.title: Hug tto! Precure
anime.synopsis:
It's her first day at a new school, and the cheerful Hana Nono is ready to make a fresh start, dreaming of becoming mature and reliable—a far cry from her usual childish self. Although she makes a disastrous first impression, Hana soon befriends two of her classmates: the gentle and studious class representative Saaya Yakushiji, and a cool and mysterious girl Homare Kagayaki.

That night, a magical baby falls from the sky right onto Hana's balcony. She is immediately smitten with her and names her Hug-tan. Alongside Hug-tan is a snarky talking hamster, Hariham Harry, who mutters that Hana "isn't the one" before vanishing with the baby.

The next day, Hana believes the encounter to be a dream, until people all over the city begin collapsing and a giant monster appears, feeding on their energy. As Hana escapes, she spots Hug-tan and Harry under attack. Making a stand to protect them, she and Hug-tan suddenly both glow with energy and a heart-shaped gem forms.

With the crystal's power, Hana transforms into a hero called "Cure Yell" and defeats the monster. Surprised at Hana's power, Harry explains that he and Hug-tan came from a future frozen in time by the Criasu Corporation, the same organization that created the monster. Only the Future Crystals, manifestations of one's hopes and dreams, and the Precure they create have a chance at defeating Criasu and saving the future!
anime.consensus_summary: Hugtto! Precure receives mixed reviews, praised for its mature themes, character development, and action. However, it's also criticized for inconsistent writing, reliance on deus ex machina, and uneven character arcs. The series is considered enjoyable by many but falls short of being a consistently great Precure entry.
pros: Lovable and funny character interactions.
Great fight scenes.
Nice drama and character development.
Mature themes that appeal to an older audience.
Unique villain concept and plot.
Each character goes through serious troubles and development.
Friendships seem natural and believable.
The series finale was awesome.
cons: Inconsistency in story and writing quality.
Deus Ex Machina and easy resolutions to plot points.
Some character storylines are poorly developed.
Filler episodes detract from the overall experience.
Annoying baby character (Hug-tan).
First 12 episodes are boring.

anime.title: Mob Psycho 100 Reigen: The Miraculous Unknown Psychic
anime.romaji_title: Mob Psycho 100: Reigen - Shirarezaru Kiseki no Reinouryokusha
anime.synopsis: A summary episode of Mob Psycho 100 which features commentary from Reigen Arataka.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, especially from fans who appreciate the creative and comedic take on a recap episode. However, there's a notable division between those who see it as an innovative and entertaining special and those who view it as an unnecessary, time-wasting recap of already-seen content.
pros: Creative and humorous approach to a recap episode, making it feel like new content.
Excellent animation quality and art style consistent with the main series.
Reigen's characterization and comedic framing are a significant highlight.
Satisfying announcement of the second season.
Provides a good refresher for fans who haven't seen the first season in a while.
cons: Fundamentally a recap episode, which may feel like a waste of time for those who have recently watched the first season.
Relies heavily on reused animation and music from the main series.
The 'gimmick' of Reigen's perspective can become tiresome for some viewers.
Some viewers found it too long for a recap episode.

anime.title: One Hundred Thousand Bad Jokes 2
anime.romaji_title: Shi Wan Ge Leng Xiaohua Movie 2
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely positive, driven by nostalgia and appreciation for the film's parodic humor. Some viewers may be sensitive to the humorous takes on cultural stereotypes, but overall, the film is received in a lighthearted spirit. The humor is subjective and tied to familiarity with the source material being parodied.
pros: Brings back memories
Humorous parodies of various sources
cons: Humor relies on parodies, not objectively ratable
Potential for misinterpretation of humorous intent, especially concerning ethnic stereotypes

anime.title: My Sister, My Writer
anime.romaji_title: Ore ga Suki nano wa Imouto dakedo Imouto ja Nai
anime.synopsis:
Aspiring light novel author Yuu Nagami regularly enters writing competitions but has yet to win a single one. Despite his recurring failures, he remains steadfast in his resolve to become a better writer.

When he takes a look at the list of winning authors in the latest contest he joined, he notices that someone named Chikai Towano dominated the competition. He soon discovers that behind the pen name is his sister Suzuka—the last person he can imagine being an author. Suzuka cannot reveal to anyone that she is Chikai Towano and requests her brother to take her place.

Yuu agrees with one condition: he will continue posing as Chikai Towano for his sister until he publishes his own book. Until that happens, Yuu uses his new identity as an opportunity to improve his writing skills and meet fellow authors and new acquaintances along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely considered a poorly executed and morally questionable production. While some viewers found enjoyment in its absurdity and comedic value, the overwhelming consensus is negative, citing poor animation, uninspired writing, and problematic themes. Production controversies further contribute to the show's negative reception, resulting in a polarized audience, with those who dislike it doing so vehemently.
pros: Some viewers found the show hilarious due to its absurdity and over-the-top nature.
The voice acting was appreciated by some, contributing to the comedic effect.
A few viewers enjoyed the show as 'trash' and found it entertaining despite its flaws.
cons: The animation quality is consistently criticized as being poor, inconsistent, and at times, outright terrible, with characters appearing off-model.
The story and characters are described as clichéd, unoriginal, and poorly developed, relying on tired tropes.
Many reviewers found the premise and themes morally questionable and distasteful, particularly the incestuous elements.
The plot is criticized for being directionless, repetitive, and lacking in substance.
Production issues, including animator mistreatment and late payments, cast a negative shadow over the show.

anime.title: Date A Live III
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Shidou Itsuka carries on with his quest for Ratatoskr in finding Spirits and trying to seal their powers, all while maintaining his relationships with the ones he had already sealed. Moreover, as new Spirits appear, he must undergo more complicated trials—all to put a stop to further disasters as he discovers more about the Spirits' origin.
anime.consensus_summary: Date A Live III is largely viewed as a disappointment due to its subpar animation quality and rushed storytelling. While some viewers appreciated the focus on Origami's character arc and found some enjoyment in the series' familiar harem dynamics, the majority express frustration with the poor adaptation of the source material and the lack of meaningful character development. The season is considered a significant downgrade compared to previous installments.
pros: Origami's arc is a highlight, providing backstory and character development.
Some found the story engaging, with plot twists and interesting character interactions.
The opening theme is considered a standout.
cons: Significant downgrade in animation quality, with stiff movements, still images, and awkward action scenes.
Rushed pacing and poor adaptation of the light novel content, especially in the Natsumi arc and the final episode.
Weak character development, particularly for Natsumi, who is seen as unlikable and lacking a compelling motivation.
Inconsistencies and plot holes introduced by the time travel elements in Origami's arc.
Shido is seen as a static and whiny protagonist.

anime.title: Ankoku Cat VS
anime.synopsis: The sequel to the Ankoku Cat ONA series.
anime.consensus_summary: The Ankoku Cat VS series is a simple and enjoyable sequel to the original ONA, featuring improved animation and a jazzy soundtrack. While the storylines are basic and lack dialogue, the self-explanatory nature and comedic action make it a worthwhile watch for fans of the first series. Audience reception seems generally positive, with little controversy surrounding the production.
pros: Improved animation compared to the first series
Good use of BGM that fits the scenes
Enjoyable despite the lack of dialogue
cons: Simple storylines with little depth
Lack of dialogue may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: The Young Imperial Guards
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Historical, Martial Arts, Mystery, Romance
anime.synopsis:
In Ming dynasty, legend goes that there is an ancient deity's book covering a wide range of technical issues, including the unique method of manufacturing the weapons of deity, which has the power to destroy everything. He who gets that book rules the entire nation. Reportedly, in ancient times, deity made the royal family keep the book, as a sign of acknowledging their ruler-ship.

However, in Yuan dynasty, the Mongolians invaded the central plain and ruled the nation. There was chaos everywhere and the book which was supposed to be enshrined in the Imperial Palace was somehow missing and reappeared in the outlaw societies, luring lots of forces to fight for it.

When Han people regained the ruler-ship in Ming dynasty, though the deity's book was found back and enshrined in the Imperial Palace again, those outlaw forces already knew that the book was more than just a legend! It did exist! So they plotted to steal it out. There are there most famous robbers in the outlaw societies: Hell-fire monk, Hua Daochang the thousand-face fox and Duan Yun in white.

One day, on the ghost festival, they sneaked into the Imperial Palace, trying to steal the most precious treasure, competing for the title of "the most famous robber." At last, the hell-fire monk stole the deity's book.

The emperor founded the Imperial Guards to serve as his personal bodyguards and imperial secret polices and spies, among whom, there was a young and inexperienced guard—Yuan Xiaotang，the hero of this animation. The emperor demanded the Imperial Guards catch the three robbers and find back the book. That's how the story begun!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Shaonian Jinyiwei' for its engaging characters and their realistic relationships, despite some plot inconsistencies, particularly in the second season. The show's cancellation is a major disappointment for viewers. The animation quality is acceptable, but not a major selling point.
pros: Well-written main characters with relatable problems.
Good character chemistry, especially between the main couple.
Enjoyable animation quality.
cons: Season two suffers from a messy plot with unresolved subplots.
Characters sometimes act without clear motivation.
The show was cancelled after two seasons due to the studio's bankruptcy.

anime.title: Banana Fish
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Delinquents, Drama, Organized Crime, Psychological, Shoujo, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Aslan Jade Callenreese, known as Ash Lynx, was a runaway picked off the streets of New York City and raised by the infamous godfather of the mafia, Dino Golzine. Now 17 years old and the boss of his own gang, Ash begins investigating the mysterious "Banana Fish"—the same two words his older brother, Griffin, has muttered since his return from the Iraq War. However, his inquiries are hindered when Dino sends his men after Ash at an underground bar he uses as a hideout.

At the bar, Skip, Ash's friend, introduces him to Shunichi Ibe and his assistant, Eiji Okumura, who are Japanese photographers reporting on American street gangs. However, their conversation is interrupted when Shorter Wong, one of Ash's allies, calls to warn him about Dino. Soon, Dino's men storm the bar, and in the ensuing chaos kidnap Skip and Eiji. Now, Ash must find a way to rescue them and continue his investigation into Banana Fish, but will his history with the mafia prevent him from succeeding?
anime.consensus_summary: Banana Fish evokes strong emotional reactions, with many praising its complex characters, gripping storyline, and exploration of mature themes. However, the show is polarizing, with some criticism directed at its handling of sensitive content, repetitive plot elements, and perceived misrepresentation. Despite the controversy, the series is considered a memorable and impactful experience for many viewers, particularly those who appreciate crime dramas and character-driven narratives.
pros: Great story line with twists
Well-developed characters and relationships
Gritty and atmospheric setting
Exploration of deep themes like friendship, loss, and acceptance
Distinctive and attractive background music
cons: Triggering subject matter and traumatic moments
Repetitive plot elements in later episodes (kidnapping/escape loop)
Weak plot with underdeveloped supporting characters
Some find the ending uninspiring
Stereotypical or problematic depiction of homosexuals (controversial)

anime.title: Forest of Piano
anime.genres: Drama, Music, Performing Arts, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis: A tranquil tale about two boys from very different upbringings. On one hand you have Kai, born as the son of a prostitute, who's been playing the abandoned piano in the forest near his home ever since he was young. And on the other you have Syuhei, practically breast-fed by the piano as the son of a family of prestigious pianists. Yet it is their common bond with the piano that eventually intertwines their paths in life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many appreciate the show's music, inspiring story, and characters. However, technical issues with the animation and pacing, along with a repetitive plot, detract from the overall experience for some viewers.
pros: Beautiful piano pieces and sound design.
Unique blend of 2D and 3D animation (though divisive).
Inspiring story about passion, dedication, and overcoming adversity.
Characters are generally well-developed, especially Kai and Shuhei.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with jarring CGI and awkward 2D.
Pacing issues and repetitive plot points, particularly in later arcs.
Underdeveloped supporting characters.
Story can be predictable and lacking excitement for some viewers.

anime.title: Tsurune: Kazemai High School Kyudo Club
anime.synopsis:
"Tsurune"—It's the sound made by the bowstring when an arrow is released, and the sound that inspired Minato Narumiya to learn kyudo, a modern Japanese martial art focusing on archery. However, an incident during his last middle school tournament caused him to quit the sport.

But soon, many factors conspire to make Minato take up the bow once again: the start of a new kyudo club in his high school, a chance encounter with a mysterious archer, and the support of his childhood friends, Seiya Takehaya and Ryouhei Yamanouchi. Together with his childhood friends and his new teammates, Kaito Onogi and Nanao Kisaragi, Minato rekindles his love for kyudo and works with his team toward their aim of winning the prefectural tournament.
anime.consensus_summary: Tsurune is a character-driven sports anime that prioritizes emotional realism and personal growth over high-octane action. While praised for its beautiful animation, soothing atmosphere, and exploration of friendship, some viewers find the pacing slow and the drama forced. The anime is appreciated for its slice-of-life elements and philosophical themes.
pros: Realistic depiction of sports struggles.
Beautiful animation and art style.
Exploration of friendship and teamwork.
Soothing soundtrack and atmosphere.
Rich in Japanese culture.
cons: Slow pacing.
Lacks excitement for some viewers.
Characters can fall into tropes.
Drama can feel forced or melodramatic.
Not enough focus on the sport itself for some viewers.

anime.title: We Rent Tsukumogami
anime.synopsis:
A pair of adopted siblings run a rental shop in old Edo (Present-day Tokyo) where fire and flooding is prevalent and everyday items are rented out to not impede when they flee. Mixed in the inventory are old objects that have turned into spirits after hundreds of years of existence called, Tsukumogami.

These supernatural creatures listen to conversations around town and spread it as gossip. It is up to the good-hearted siblings to react to these quarrels and resolve the situation using the powers of the Tsukumogami.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds "Tsukumogami Kashimasu" to be a gentle and charming anime with heartwarming relationships and smooth transitions. While the mysteries may not be the highlight, the character development of supporting characters and the connection between the main characters and the tsukumogami are well-received. The show is considered underrated and easy to watch, making it a recommended choice for fans of mystery, history, and slice-of-life genres.
pros: Charming character development of secondary characters.
Heartwarming relationships between main characters and tsukumogami.
Smooth and cool scene transitions, particularly the shop-changing scenes.
The story flows well, connecting early episodes to the main storyline.
cons: The mysteries themselves are not particularly remarkable.
The character development of Seiji is lacking.

anime.title: Fist of the Blue Sky: Regenesis
anime.synopsis: Long before Kenshirou said, "You're already dead," a different Kenshirou walked the violent streets of Shanghai. The city is in constant crisis as two mafia families battle one another for supremacy. In the crossfire, a little girl named Erika is orphaned and soon taken under the wing of martial artist Liu Fei-Yan. Sorrow seems to follow the girl, as every time Fei-Yan attempts to hand her off, her new guardians end up dead. Fei-Yan decides to bring the girl to a man named Guise but instead crosses paths with powerful Kenshirou Kasumi.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided, primarily due to the jarring CGI animation. Nostalgia for the original Hokuto no Ken buoys some viewers' enjoyment, while others find the plot and character writing severely lacking. The consensus leans towards disappointment, especially among manga readers who feel the adaptation betrays the source material.
pros: Faithful to the original Hokuto no Ken art style (despite CG)
Enjoyable for fans of the original Hokuto no Ken series
Good voice acting and sound effects
Opening themes are well-done and hype-inducing
Some found the action and story enjoyable despite flaws
cons: Poor CGI animation with low frame rate and disproportionate characters
Weak and nonsensical plot, especially in the anime-original storylines
Inconsistent tone, oscillating between comedy and seriousness
Poorly written villains and dialogue
Story deviates significantly from the manga, disappointing fans
Excessive use of comedic relief characters that detract from the story

anime.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil Departures
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Shinmai Maou no Testament Departures is notably divided. While the animation quality and action sequences are praised, many viewers, especially novel readers, found the anime-original content to be filler and a significant letdown in terms of fanservice and faithful adaptation. The OVA is seen as a decent setup for future arcs but ultimately falls short of expectations for many.
pros: Visually the best the series has looked, with high-quality animation and art.
Well-choreographed action sequences, particularly the fight against Lars.
Effective setup for future arcs, establishing narrative elements and character motivations.
Some anime-original scenes and character moments were appreciated by fans of the novels.
Strong relationship development between characters.
cons: Anime-original content often felt like filler and lacked the variety/intensity of the novels.
Key plot points and character development from the novels were omitted or ambiguously adapted (e.g., Chisato's onsen trip).
Fanservice and lewd scenes did not meet expectations, feeling like a letdown compared to the novels or promotional hype.
Inconsistent character designs and subpar animation in some segments, feeling cheaper than expected for an OVA.
The overall story felt like a prologue or a "blue balling" experience, failing to deliver on the promised sexual payoff.

anime.title: The Boy and the Heron
anime.genres: Adventure, Anthropomorphic, Award Winning, Drama, Fantasy, Isekai
anime.synopsis:
Three years into the war, Mahito Maki loses his mother in a tragic fire at the hospital. Shortly thereafter, his father marries Natsuko, the younger sister of Mahito's mother. They take Mahito out of Tokyo to seek refuge in his late mother's rural family home. There, Mahito is constantly taunted by a strange gray heron, who seems to have taken an interest in him.

Unable to come to terms with his loss and struggling to adjust to a new life in an unfamiliar place, the boy is shocked to discover that Natsuko is pregnant. To make matters worse, the pesky heron can speak—and claims that Mahito's mother is still alive. Luring him into a mysterious tower near the residence, the heron says that Mahito can save her from death, but the boy is not easily swayed.

When Natsuko disappears one day, however, Mahito watches her walk into the tower and becomes compelled to venture in to rescue her. He soon finds himself falling into another world below his, where life and death seem to be entwined. As he navigates through this foreign realm to find Natsuko, Mahito must understand what it means to live if he wants to safely return home.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily polarized. While praised for its visual artistry and musical score, many find the narrative convoluted, thematically muddled, and emotionally disconnected. Some hardcore Ghibli fans may appreciate it, but many average viewers are left confused and underwhelmed by the lack of a coherent story and clear message.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style, consistent with Ghibli's high standards.
Magical and perfectly complementing musical score by Joe Hisaishi.
The film attempts to grapple with profound themes like grief, loss, and the meaning of life.
cons: Incoherent and nonsensical plot with erratic scene transitions.
Lack of character development and shallow exploration of relationships.
Overstuffed with ideas and symbolism, leading to a rushed and unfocused narrative.
Thematic elements feel like rehashes of previous Miyazaki works, lacking originality.
Obscure messaging that fails to deliver a clear moral or takeaway.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: The Roar of Awakening
anime.romaji_title: Shingeki no Kyojin Season 2 Movie: Kakusei no Houkou
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Eren Yeager and others of the 104th Training Corps have just begun to become full members of the Survey Corps. As they ready themselves to face the Titans once again, their preparations are interrupted by the invasion of Wall Rose—but all is not as it seems as more mysteries are unraveled. As the Survey Corps races to save the wall, they uncover more about the invading Titans and the dark secrets of their own members.
anime.consensus_summary: The consensus is largely positive, with many praising the movie for its streamlined narrative and enhanced animation. The movie is a well-executed recap of the second season, adding new content and improving upon the original material. While some note the film's recap nature, most find it a worthwhile experience, particularly highlighting the animation and music.
pros: Streamlines the original series and makes it worthwhile.
Removes most of the original series filler.
Includes brand new animation to plug gaps and give a glimpse at Season 3 Part 1.
Animation is breathtaking.
Insane camera movements.
New brand new compositions by series composer, Hiroyuki Sawano.
cons: It's essentially a recap of the 2nd Season.
WIT Studio will be sorely missed for The Final Season

anime.title: Free! Dive to the Future
anime.synopsis:
With the seniors having graduated from high school, the determined swimmers eagerly take on their futures with a dream to fulfill. 

Now attending Hidaka University in Tokyo, Haruka Nanase unexpectedly runs into Shiina Asahi, an old teammate and friend from his middle school days. Consequently, the troubling memories regarding his middle school swim team resurface, as it was a time when Haruka's views on swimming became negative and led him to quit the team. Haruka later reconnects with his other middle school classmates; all except for Ikuya Kirishima, who still resents Haruka for quitting the team, resulting in its disbandment. Aware of the issues between them, Haruka resolves to improve his friendship with Ikuya. However, he quickly realizes that making amends with an old friend isn't his only obstacle. 

Facing the reality and challenges of encountering higher calibre swimmers, Haruka must work hard to establish himself if he dreams of competing on an international level.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Free! Dive to the Future' is mixed. While some appreciate the character development and animation quality, many criticize the overabundance of characters, repetitive drama, and slow pacing. The season is seen as a step down from its predecessors, with many feeling the series has lost its original charm and focus.
pros: Beautiful animation, especially the water.
Character growth for Haru.
Enjoyable to see familiar characters return and interact.
Soundtrack enhances the emotional impact.
