cons: Too many characters, leading to underdeveloped storylines.
Repetitive and predictable melodrama.
Slow pacing in the first half of the season.
Lack of focus on swimming competitions compared to previous seasons.
Requires watching previous movies to understand character backgrounds.
Cliffhanger ending without satisfying resolution.

anime.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Once a hot springs inn, now a boarding house with extraordinarily cheap rent, Yuragi-sou is virtually uninhabited save for a few peculiar residents. As rumor has it, it is haunted by a vile ghost which scares away all potential tenants. Therefore, it is the perfect refuge for Fuyuzora Kogarashi—a broke, homeless psychic seeking an affordable roof to stay under and ghosts to exorcise.

Kogarashi prepares for a face-off against the ghost, only to find out it is not as malicious as the rumors made it out to be. Instead, it is the ghost of a beautiful, silver-haired girl whose only recollection of her life before death is her name: Yuuna. Even more baffling is that the other tenants of Yuragi-sou not only are able to see Yuuna as well, but each has their own supernatural ability.

Amidst the chaos caused by his quirky fellow residents, Kogarashi attempts to uncover the regret that keeps Yuuna anchored to the world of the living, lest she become an evil spirit sentenced to spend her afterlife in hell.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many acknowledging the series' heavy focus on fanservice. While some find the humor and characters enjoyable, others criticize the repetitive nature, shallow plot, and lack of meaningful character development.  The series is generally considered a fairly standard ecchi harem anime, best suited for fans of the genre who are not seeking depth or originality.
pros: Some genuinely clever gags and funny moments.
Likeable characters, especially Kogarashi and Yuuna, with good romantic chemistry.
Visually appealing art style with bright colors and attention to detail.
Catchy opening theme and generally good sound design.
cons: Overreliance on the 'lucky pervert' trope, leading to repetitive and predictable fanservice.
Plot is thin and primarily serves as a vehicle for fanservice, lacking depth and progression.
Characters are often stereotypical and lack significant development.
Supernatural elements are underdeveloped and overshadowed by comedy and ecchi aspects.

anime.title: Mameneko
anime.synopsis: The series follows the daily lives of a naughty female cat named Azuki and a quiet male cat named Daizu who live with their owner, a 30 year old office lady, and her extended family, including an otaku elder brother and an adopted shiba inu dog who thinks he's a cat.
anime.consensus_summary: Mameneko is a cute and relaxing short series that captures the essence of living with cats. Viewers appreciate its simplicity and charm, finding it a delightful way to spend a few minutes. However, it may not appeal to everyone and is easily forgettable due to its lack of depth and unique elements.
pros: Charming and simple animation style.
Captures the joys of pet ownership.
Relaxing and easy to watch.
cons: Forgettable and doesn't stand out.
May not appeal to those who don't enjoy cat videos.
Lacks depth and complexity.

anime.title: Qin Shi Mingyue: Tian Xing Jiu Ge
anime.romaji_title: Qin Shi Mingyue: Tian Xing Jiu Ge
anime.synopsis:
Facing the threat of the Qin State, danger seems to lurk within the Han State, which is known as the weakest out of the Seven States. Unknown to the Han Emperor, that very threat is the Great General of Han, Ji Wuye. Working under the Great General are the Four Fearful Warriors of Nightfall.

Each four specialized in military, finance, politics, and espionage. In hopes of creating a new Han State, Quicksand was formed by Han Fei, the ninth prince of the Han. With Wei Zhuang, Zhang Liang, Zinü, and Nong Yu, they support the Prince in realizing the goal of Quicksand while being drawn into a whirlpool of power named “world”.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the prequel's focus on political intrigue and action, especially for fans of the original series.  However, some critique the animation's stylistic choices. Overall, the show successfully expands the Qin's Moon universe with a focus on the Han Kingdom's internal conflicts and the ambitions of its key figures.
pros: Intricate political maneuvering
Action-packed fight sequences
Familiar characters from the original series
cons: Overemphasis on 'sex appeal' in animation style

anime.title: Hunch
anime.synopsis: A musical anime promoting motivation for LGBT teens. The focus of the short is on a young man and his struggling affection towards his male classmates.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the short anime, praising its heartwarming story, catchy music, and simple art style. Some find the story too simple or the length too short, but overall, the consensus is positive. It is seen as a feel-good video promoting LGBT themes.
pros: Heartwarming story
Catchy music
Simple and sweet art style
cons: Simple story might not appeal to everyone
Short length may leave viewers wanting more

anime.title: Kakuriyo -Bed & Breakfast for Spirits-
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Fantasy, Gourmet, Mythology, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Abandoned as a child by her mother, Aoi Tsubaki has always had the ability to see "ayakashi"—spirits from the Hidden Realm. Shirou Tsubaki, her grandfather who shared the same ability, took her under his wing and taught her how to live with the ayakashi in peace. When her grandfather abruptly passes away, the independent Aoi must continue her college career, armed with only her knowledge in cooking as a means of protection against the human-eating spirits. In hopes that the ayakashi will not turn to her or other unknowing humans as a tasty meal, she takes it upon herself to feed the hungry creatures that cross her path.

After giving a mysterious ayakashi her lunch, Aoi is transported to the Hidden Realm, where the ayakashi reveals himself to be an ogre-god known as Oodanna, the "Master Innkeeper." There, she learns that she was used as collateral for her grandfather's debt of one hundred million yen, and that she must pay the price for her grandfather's careless decision by marrying Oodanna. Aoi valiantly refuses and decides to settle things on her own terms: she will pay off the debt herself by opening an eatery at Oodanna's inn.

Kakuriyo no Yadomeshi follows the journey of Aoi as she proceeds to change and touch the lives of the ayakashi through the one weapon she has against them—her delicious cooking.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, some find it a relaxing and heartwarming show with a strong female lead, while others criticize its slow pace, repetitive plot, and lack of romance development. There is disappointment in the unfulfilled potential of the spirit world setting and one-dimensional characters. Overall, it is considered a decent but not outstanding anime.
pros: Relaxing and chill atmosphere
Strong female lead
Charming yokai world
cons: Slow-paced romance
Repetitive plot
Underwhelming climax
Inconsistent animation quality
Shallow characters

anime.title: Working Buddies!
anime.synopsis: The energetic Tapio Chatarozawa and the cool-headed Kuehiko Roshihara are two young cats trying out various part-time jobs. From delivering packages to washing windows on skyscrapers, the pair explore the opportunities that await them out on the recruiting field. As they struggle to learn the ropes, the duo endures the antics of their colorful customers and supervisors while bonding as working buddies.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Hataraku Oniisan!' to be a cute and fun, but ultimately simple and not particularly memorable show. Its episodic nature and charming characters are appreciated for killing time. The humor is hit-or-miss and the overall impact is minimal.
pros: Cute characters and art style
Each episode is self-contained and easy to jump into
Enjoyable character interactions and comedy
cons: Simple and doesn't leave a lasting impression
Some gags are not funny
Can be boring when the wombat doesn't appear

anime.title: Golden Time
anime.synopsis: In Japan's economic bubble years during the 1980s, a long-serving furniture-style television set made in the 1960s is abandoned at a junkyard. It attempts to escape from its new surroundings.
anime.consensus_summary: The short film evokes a touching narrative about finding purpose and friendship in unexpected places, set within a meticulously crafted junkyard world. While praised for its efficient storytelling and character development without dialogue, some viewers find the narrative arc between characters and the concept of sentience inconsistent. Overall, the audience seems receptive to the film's themes and artistic style.
pros: Touching tale of finding new purpose
Tightly-paced story
Effective world-building and character personalities without dialogue
Lush, orchestrated soundtrack that fits the setting
cons: Limited soundtrack variation
Unresolved rift between characters
Inconsistent sentience among objects in the junkyard

anime.title: Ling Yu 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Qin Lie have to guard Tang Siqi, regardless of the differences between them, and Liang Shanyan, while the strange powers coursing through his veins are beginning to slowly awaken. When Qin Lie vows to protect the instrument of sovereign, at the same time, seven Evil Clan's Lords are appearing on the field. While the most powerful secret weapon is emerging from the altar, the enemy intend to seize Qin Lie's life...
anime.consensus_summary: The second season leans heavily into shounen tropes, with increased battles and screaming. Some viewers may find the storytelling confusing and over-the-top, while others might enjoy the intensified action. Overall, it diverges from the first season in tone and may not appeal to all viewers.
cons: Storytelling is confusing and convoluted
Too much screaming
Over the top

anime.title: Eromanga Sensei OVA
anime.synopsis:
Yamada Elf's Love Song

As a novelist with works getting adapted into anime, Elf Yamada holds an event to celebrate her success and to thank everyone who had supported her. With her mother attending, she becomes more excited. However, just as her mother arrives, she tells Elf to go back home so that she can find a suitable husband. Elf, who harbors feelings for Masamune Izumi, chooses to say no…

Cooked Meals of Pure Love

Winter has come, and it's freezing outside. With her brother Masamune catching a cold, Sagiri Izumi decides to nurse her brother into good health by stepping outside the comfort of her room and doing the housework herself.
anime.consensus_summary: The Eromanga-sensei OVA is a mixed bag for audiences. While some appreciate the lighthearted moments and character interactions, particularly in the Sagiri-focused episode, others find the Elf Yamada episode uninspired. The show's controversial themes continue to be a point of contention, and overall enjoyment heavily depends on prior investment in the main series.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions, especially in the Sagiri-focused episode.
High-quality animation and voice acting.
The Elf Yamada episode includes a memorable musical number.
cons: The first OVA episode (Elf Yamada) is considered boring and lacking plot by some viewers.
Some find the premise of the show (incestuous themes) to be problematic.
Inconsistent quality between the two OVA episodes, with the second being generally preferred.
Reliance on familiarity with the main series may make the OVA less accessible to newcomers.

anime.title: Real Girl
anime.synopsis:
For Hikari Tsutsui, life within the two-dimensional realm is much simpler. Socially inept and awkward, he immerses himself in video games and anime, only to be relentlessly ridiculed and ostracized by his classmates. Sharing his misery is Yuuto Itou, his only friend, who wears cat ears and is equally obsessed with the world of games. 

After being forced to clean the pool as punishment for arriving late, Tsutsui meets Iroha Igarashi, but he attempts to steer clear of her, as her notoriety precedes her. Brazenly blunt, loathed by female classmates, and infamous for messing around with boys, Tsutsui believes that getting involved with her would cause nothing but problems. 

3D Kanojo: Real Girl is a story revolving around these two outcasts—a boy full of emotions he has never experienced before, struggling to lay them bare, and a girl who strives to break him out of his shell.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some viewers finding the anime heartwarming and enjoying the character development, while others criticize its reliance on clichés, poor animation, and illogical plot. Many find the main characters frustrating and the story uninspired, while others appreciate the emotional journey and character growth. Overall, the show elicits strong reactions, both positive and negative, making it a somewhat controversial title within the romance anime genre.
pros: Heartwarming romance with great moments.
Characters are relatable and emotionally thought out.
Satisfying character development, especially in the second season.
Realistic conveyance of love with unique personalities and backgrounds.
Good opening and ending themes.
cons: Cliche story with predictable misunderstandings and resolutions.
Poor art quality and animation, especially for a 2018 anime.
Inconsistent character behavior and illogical plot points.
Repetitive story structure.
Uninspired character designs and forgettable soundtrack.

anime.title: gdgd men's Party
anime.synopsis: In the series, Light and Yomi are spending their daily lives happily playing video games. One night when everyone else is asleep, Light receives an invitation from Alpha, a messenger for someone named King. Light and Yomi are then sucked into another world, where they must undertake a quest to rescue Princess Melody from the demon lord. Light thinks this must be his destiny, while Yomi thinks it's kind of annoying. They form a party with Alpha to start their quest. Alpha as it turns out is an AI robot, and he has a program that allows them to raise their levels while slowly continuing their adventure.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling it falls short of the original GdGd Fairies. While some appreciate the parody and pacing, others find the jokes weak and the characters uninteresting. The reliance on random references is a point of contention, with some finding it stale.
pros: Good pacing makes each episode feel short and enjoyable
Harmless and quirky with potential for laughs
Parodies anime archetypes
cons: Relies heavily on random references
Lacks the bizarre atmosphere of the original series
Characters are boring and unrelatable
Jokes often fail to land

anime.title: Amanchu! Advance
anime.genres: Iyashikei, School, Shounen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Second season of Amanchu!.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many finding the second season a disappointment compared to the first. While the characters and art style remain appealing, the shift away from diving, the introduction of poorly integrated supernatural elements, and the addition of underwhelming new characters are major points of criticism.  Some viewers still find enjoyment in the series' relaxing atmosphere and themes of friendship, but the overall consensus is that 'Amanchu! Advance' fails to live up to the standards set by its predecessor.
pros: Characters are likable and relatable.
Art and animation are consistent with the first season, with some added creativity in backgrounds.
Voice acting blends well, with good chemistry among the cast.
cons: Story deviates from the diving aspect of the first season.
New characters are not well-integrated into the story.
Supernatural elements feel out of place and poorly executed.
Inconsistent storytelling, with plot holes and rushed ending.
Music is not as memorable as the first season's OST.

anime.title: Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden
anime.romaji_title: Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden
anime.synopsis:
The Servamps and their pact-bound "Eves" are finally getting back to their normal lives as they recover from their injuries from the previous battles. However, when it starts snowing in the middle of summer, one of the Eves, Mahiru Shirota, suspects vampiric interference. Concerned by the strange phenomenon, he sets out to gather the group once more to try and solve the mystery; however, they suddenly lose contact with Misono Arisuin, the Eve of the Servamp of Lust.

Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden delves into the untold past of Misono and his brother Mikuni Arisuin, as well as the many mysteries of the grand Arisuin Mansion.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is primarily enjoyable for existing Servamp fans due to its focus on Misono's past. However, the plot is considered simple and lacking suspense, potentially boring for those unfamiliar with the series.  While the animation and sound receive praise, the limited character development and story depth are noted as weaknesses.
pros: Animation is consistent and unique character designs.
Sound and ending theme are well-received.
Explores Misono's family situation and Lily's perspective.
cons: Story is not elaborate and lacks suspense.
Mikuni's character development is limited.
Plot may be boring for non-fans.

anime.title: Godzilla: City on the Edge of Battle
anime.synopsis:
After a desperate battle and many losses, humans finally slay Godzilla—the monster that caused humanity to flee Earth 20 thousand years prior. But the creature Haruo Sakaki's troops killed was not alone; there existed another Godzilla on Earth yet to be defeated. Grievously wounded from the first conflict, Sakaki wakes up in the home of a young girl who is a member of the Houtua tribe. Bearing a shocking resemblance to humans, the Houtua have adapted to survive the changed climate of the planet that had long been abandoned.

With most of their resources depleted, the remaining members of Sasaki's special forces struggle with the decision to abandon their mission and their home planet or to fight an improbable battle. Hope is not completely lost however, as the members from the Bilusaludo race of aliens discover remnants of their anti-Godzilla weapon Mechagodzilla. Even with this powerful weapon in their arsenal, victory seems impossible to grasp: Godzilla has spent all this time evolving and preparing to defeat anyone who dares to challenge its superiority.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception indicates a significant improvement over the first film, with many praising the enhanced story, kaiju action, and intriguing concepts. However, the film is divisive regarding its animation quality, character development, and pacing, with some finding it a substantial step up while others criticize its perceived flaws.
pros: Significant improvement over the first film, with a more engaging and well-done story.
Exciting kaiju action, particularly the fight between Mechagodzilla and Godzilla.
Intriguing concepts like Mothra's connection to the Houtua and the evolution of nanometals.
Visually pleasing elements like Mechagodzilla City's construction and arming.
Strong musical score that enhances the emotional impact and builds suspense.
Successfully sets up future installments with anticipation for Ghidorah's return.
cons: Animation quality is criticized as stiff, mechanical, and embarrassing, likened to Berserk 2016.
Pacing issues, with action often delayed until the final act, and a slow, dialogue-heavy start.
Characters remain underdeveloped and one-dimensional, failing to elicit strong emotional investment.
Plot relies heavily on deus ex machina elements like nanometals to solve problems.
Godzilla himself, despite his size, lacks opportunities to truly shine as a destructive force.
The narrative can become confusing towards the end, and some concepts are underdeveloped.

anime.title: Miss Caretaker of Sunohara-sou
anime.synopsis:
Aki Shiina has always been perceived as a girl because of his feminine appearance. Wishing to change himself and forget his past, he moves to a dorm and enrolls in a middle school in Tokyo.

Arriving at his new home, Aki is welcomed warmly by the dorm's caretaker, Ayaka Sunohara, who immediately takes a liking to him. But he soon finds out that all of his new roommates are girls from the student council! The girls often tease Aki, seeing him as very girlish. However, still determined to become more masculine, Aki tries his best to help the people around him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with some appreciating the cute characters and relaxing slice-of-life elements, while others criticize the weak plot, overused ecchi tropes, and potentially disturbing shota themes. The show's appeal heavily relies on one's tolerance for the Onee-san/Shota dynamic. Many feel the show had wasted potential due to these issues.
pros: Cute and lovable characters
Relaxing and heartwarming content
Appealing art style
cons: Repetitive themes and jokes
Lack of a strong storyline
Questionable oversexualization of the main character

anime.title: Caligula
anime.synopsis:
What is happiness? Ever the fan of psychology, questions such as this are ones that high school student Ritsu Shikishima likes to ponder as he spends his peaceful days with his friends. His perfect world, however, begins to unravel when he hears a strange voice obscured by static, pleading for help. This voice belongs to μ, a beloved pop idol, whose singing begins to have an adverse effect on the world. Before Ritsu's very eyes, the faces of his friends and family become distorted by glitches as the sound of μ's voice transforms them into Digiheads: berserk monsters bent on the extermination of all those who begin to awaken to the true nature of their existence.

Realizing that he is trapped in a virtual world created by μ called Mobius, Ritsu must now gather everyone else who has managed to realize the truth before they are all eliminated. Together, they will use their newfound powers and weapons granted by their emotions—known as the Catharsis Effect—to fight off the mysterious group known as The Ostinato Musicians as they struggle to escape.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime explores interesting psychological themes and the desire for escapism but suffers from poor execution. Reviewers often criticize the weak character development, clumsy writing, and inconsistent animation. Despite some redeeming qualities like the soundtrack and relatable character issues, the series is ultimately a mixed bag.
pros: Interesting story with reflections on life.
Soundtrack is magnificent and direction is excellent.
Relatable character issues.
Explores the theme of escaping reality through technology.
cons: Convoluted and questionably executed narrative.
Weak character development.
Clumsy dialogue.
Inconsistent animation.
Poor pacing
Melodramatic and whiny

anime.title: Gintama. Silver Soul Arc
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
After the fierce battle on Rakuyou, the untold past and true goal of the immortal Naraku leader, Utsuro, are finally revealed. By corrupting the Altana reserves of several planets, Utsuro has successfully triggered the intervention of the Tendoshuu’s greatest enemy: the Altana Liberation Army. With Earth as the main battleground in this interplanetary war, Utsuro's master plan to destroy the planet—and himself—is nearly complete. 

An attack on the O-Edo Central Terminal marks the beginning of the final battle to take back the land of the samurai. With the Yorozuya nowhere in sight, the bakufu all but collapsed, and the Shogun missing, the people are left completely helpless as the Liberation Army begins pillaging Edo in the name of freeing them from the Tendoshuu's rule. 

Caught in the crossfire between two equally imposing forces, can Gintoki, Kagura, Shinpachi, and the former students of Shouyou Yoshida put aside their differences and unite their allies to protect what they hold dear?
anime.consensus_summary: The season is a mixed bag, delivering on the action and nostalgic character reunions that fans appreciate, but suffers from pacing problems and a perceived decline in comedic quality. While some viewers enjoyed the blend of comedy and action, others found the serious tone and plot developments less engaging. The return of numerous characters was a highlight for many, but the execution of the story arc was not universally praised.
pros: Brings back a lot of characters from previous seasons, creating a sense of nostalgia and payoff for long-time viewers.
Successfully blends comedy and action, a hallmark of the Gintama franchise.
The plot is more gripping than ever, with long-standing questions being answered and the stakes being higher.
cons: Pacing issues in the middle of the season.
Over-reliance on flashbacks and motivational speeches.
Some find the comedy subpar and repetitive, especially compared to previous seasons.

anime.title: Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul
anime.romaji_title: Made in Abyss Movie 3: Fukaki Tamashii no Reimei
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Gore, Mystery, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
After bonding over a tragic loss, the long-suffering Nanachi joins Riko and Reg on their journey into the depths of the Abyss. Awaiting the children is the Sea of Corpses—the Abyss's fifth layer, and the deepest level from which a traveler can return without losing their human form.

The masked sadist Bondrewd stands between the children and the rest of their adventure. Bondrewd's horrific laboratory serves as a final checkpoint for those wishing to traverse deeper into the Abyss, and the sociopathic scientist has no desire to allow Riko's party to pass through at no cost. Deeply scarred by Bondrewd's impact on their childhood, Nanachi is engulfed in turmoil over his resurgence in their life.

Bondrewd's only apparent weakness is Prushka, a brash child who claims to be his daughter. Riko, Reg, and Nanachi befriend Prushka and work with the girl to overcome her father's machinations and breach the Abyss's sixth layer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some viewers consider it a masterpiece with stunning visuals and a gripping story, while others are disgusted by the graphic content, especially the sexualization and mutilation of children. The movie's tonal dissonance and controversial themes polarize opinions, with some finding the experience traumatizing and others praising its unflinching depiction of the Abyss's horrors.
pros: Stunning art design and animation.
Gripping story and fascinating setting.
Excellent soundtrack that perfectly fits the tone.
cons: Uncomfortable and disturbing scenes, borderline illegal feeling.
Rampant sexualization of child characters.
Pacing issues and cheap plot contrivances.

anime.title: My Sweet Tyrant
anime.synopsis:
Despite his incredible bashfulness, Atsuhiro "Akkun" Kagari has landed the girl of his dreams: the sweet and loveable Non Katagiri. However, his embarrassment for affectionate acts—from giving compliments to exchanging a kiss—causes him to act harsh and downright mean to Katagiri in their day-to-day lives. But Akkun is still very much a boy in love; he shows his admiration for Katagiri in his own way. From tailing her in order to take her picture to eavesdropping in on her conversations, he ends up stalking his own girlfriend. 

Luckily enough, Katagiri finds Akkun's actions cute and endearing, and knows he doesn't really mean any of his insults. Even if their close friend, Masago Matsuo, finds their dynamic a little odd, Katagiri loves her sweet tyrant just the way he is.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the short anime cute and enjoyable for its lighthearted romance and chibi art style. However, many are critical of the potentially abusive relationship dynamics and the limited development due to the short episode format. The humor is divisive, with some finding it repetitive and others finding it endearing, leading to a somewhat polarized view of the show's overall quality.
pros: Charming and simple art style with chibi elements.
Enjoyable for those seeking a short, lighthearted romance.
Some find the supporting characters and their interactions engaging.
cons: The central relationship is considered unhealthy and potentially abusive by some viewers.
The short episode length (3 minutes) limits story and character development.
The humor relies heavily on repetitive gags that can become stale.
Some find the main character's tsundere behavior and obsessive tendencies off-putting and creepy.

anime.title: Back Street Girls: Gokudols
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Gag Humor, Magical Sex Shift, Organized Crime, Seinen, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
After failing their boss for the last time, yakuza members Kentarou, Ryou, and Kazuhiko are faced with one of two choices: have their organs harvested and sold or take a trip to Thailand for sex reassignment surgery and become pop idols. Now, after a year of excruciating training, the three thugs have been reborn as Airi, Chika, and Mari. Debuting as the amateur idol group The Goku Dolls, the three strive towards becoming top idols.

However, despite the hours of feminizing brainwashing they were forced to endure, the three idols have managed to keep the yakuza spirit alive in their hearts. In order to fix this, their yakuza boss hires Mandarin Kinoshita, a legendary manager who has never had an idol group fail under his management. With their lives now on the line, the reluctant yakuza must work with their new manager to unleash their inner cuteness and become the successful idols that their tyrannical boss can truly be proud of.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some viewers find the anime hilarious and entertaining due to its absurd premise and dark humor, while others are offended by its potentially transphobic themes and poor execution. The show's animation quality and repetitive jokes are also criticized, leading to a polarized opinion on its overall value.
pros: Unique and weird premise
Hilarious for those who enjoy dark humor
Good voice acting
cons: Poor animation style
Repetitive and overexaggerated humor
Potentially transphobic and insensitive themes
Weak story and lack of character development

anime.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest
anime.synopsis:
The ordinary life of 17-year-old otaku Hajime Nagumo is disrupted when he and his classmates are summoned to a fantasy world and tasked with saving mankind. While his classmates are gifted with impressive abilities useful in combat, Hajime is belittled for only gaining an inferior transmutation skill that lacks any real offensive power. 

During an expedition in the Great Orcus Labyrinth, Hajime is betrayed by one of his classmates, plummeting him to the bottom of an abyss. Though he survives the fall, Hajime is faced with menacing monsters and misfortunes that send him spiraling into a grim nightmare. Desperate to live and return home one day, he resolves to fight for his survival—only to meet an imprisoned vampire he names Yue, who is also seeking to escape the labyrinth. Taking an interest in him, Yue and a few others along the way accompany Hajime on his journey to find a way back home, while steadily transforming from commonplace to the world's strongest.
anime.consensus_summary: Arifureta is widely considered a poorly executed isekai anime with significant flaws in animation, story, and character development. While a small minority found some enjoyment in it, the overwhelming consensus is negative, with many criticizing its generic tropes, rushed plot, and uncomfortable character dynamics. The series is seen as a major disappointment and a prime example of a poorly produced isekai anime.
pros: Some viewers found the story enjoyable despite its flaws.
Several reviewers appreciated the character designs, especially of the main character.
A few viewers found the show entertaining and better than expected, especially as it progressed.
cons: Many reviewers heavily criticized the animation, especially the use of CGI for monsters.
Numerous reviewers found the story generic, rushed, and full of plot holes.
Several reviewers expressed strong dislike for the characters, particularly the main heroine and the sexualization of a child-like character.
Many critics pointed out the lack of originality, describing it as a poorly executed isekai copy.

anime.title: Dragon Pilot: Hisone and Masotan
anime.genres: Award Winning, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Military
anime.synopsis:
Seeking to find purpose in her life, Hisone Amakasu enlists in the Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF) and is stationed at Gifu Airbase. During a visit to a part of the base she did not know existed, she stumbles upon the JASDF's largest secret: the Organic Transformed Flyer (OTF), a dragon that has the ability to camouflage itself as an aircraft. After being swallowed up and spit out by the OTF, her commanding officers inform her that this encounter means that she has been chosen to be the next in a long line of Dragon Pilots.

Together with her fellow pilot cadets and "Maso-tan," her own OTF, Hisone must overcome her insecurities in order to discover her true potential as a Dragon Pilot and unravel the secrets behind the OTFs.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Hisone to Maso-tan' are divided. Some viewers found the anime to be a charming and unique experience with lovable characters and a heartwarming story. However, others criticized the show for its shallow plot, poor writing, and tonal inconsistencies, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Unique art style and animation
Endearing and relatable protagonist (Hisone)
Inventive premise combining planes, dragons, and robots
cons: Shallow plot and characters
Poor writing and pacing issues, especially in the later episodes
Unsettling fan service and potential sexism
Tonal dissonance between comedic and serious scenes

anime.title: Saekano the Movie: Finale
anime.genres: Comedy, Harem, Otaku Culture, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
With the second Winter Comiket just around the corner, Blessing Software has been vigorously producing its new game, "How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend." Despite Utaha Kasumigaoka and Eriri Spencer Sawamura leaving the circle, Megumi Katou and Tomoya Aki are hopeful that, by sticking to Tomoya's original vision for the game, their upcoming creation will exceed Blessing Software's previous installment.

With the addition of new members Iori and Izumi Hashima, development ensues—but not without its share of setbacks. Things rarely go as planned in the dating sim industry, with numerous obstacles forcing Tomoya to decide between helping his friends or completing the game. 

Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata Fine draws the series to a close as Tomoya selects his final route, both within his personal life and Blessing Software.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed. While many found the movie a satisfying conclusion to the series, praising its focus on romance and high production values, a significant portion criticized the rushed character development, forced romantic developments, and diminished roles for established characters.  The ending, particularly the focus on Megumi, polarized viewers, with some seeing it as a fitting culmination and others as a betrayal of prior character arcs.
pros: Satisfying romantic development between the main characters
High-quality animation and sound design
Well-executed story with a conclusive ending
Emotional and heartwarming scenes
Good after-story showing characters' adult lives
cons: Rushed character development for characters other than the main couple
Limited screen time for previously important characters (e.g., Utaha)
Forced or unrealistic romance between the MC and the 'boring girlfriend'
Plot perceived as mid or generic
Departure from established character dynamics from previous seasons

anime.title: My Hero Academia: Two Heroes
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 1: Futari no Hero
anime.synopsis:
U.A. High School's students of Class 1-A have made it to summer break. Izuku Midoriya accompanies his mentor All Might to a celebratory superhero festival on I-Island, an isolated patch of land dedicated to researching Quirks and everything else associated with the hero business. Midoriya is granted the opportunity to meet All Might's friend Dave and Dave's daughter Melissa, two talented hero equipment engineers. He also encounters his classmates, most of whom have been given the opportunity to spend part of their summer break at the festival.

However, a mysterious squad of villains infiltrates I-Island, and it is up to Midoriya and his friends to confront them, using their developing Quirks to fight off the new enemy and uncover a treacherous plot.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many acknowledging the film's action-packed animation and soundtrack while criticizing its predictable and somewhat shallow plot. While fans of the series generally found it enjoyable, a significant portion felt it was a missed opportunity for deeper character development and a more original story, deeming it a serviceable but ultimately forgettable entry.
pros: Spectacular animation and fight scenes, particularly during key moments like the final battle and flashbacks.
Engaging soundtrack and voice acting that enhance the emotional impact and action sequences.
Provides interesting background and character development for All Might.
Well-executed fan service that respects existing characters and their dynamics.
Good pacing that balances action, character moments, and exposition.
cons: Predictable plot with numerous plot conveniences and easily guessable twists.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with some scenes appearing subpar or like a budget episode.
Introduction of too many side characters from Class 1-A feels unnecessary and detracts from the core narrative.
New characters, while having potential, are underdeveloped and often feel like exposition dumps or bland additions.
The movie feels like a cash grab or filler, lacking significant impact on the main series' narrative.

anime.title: Magical Girl Ore
anime.genres: Comedy, Idols (Female), Magical Sex Shift, Mahou Shoujo, Parody
anime.synopsis:
Saki Uno is an average 15-year-old girl with a side hustle as a member of the exceptionally unpopular idol duo Magical Twins. Despite this, she absolutely loves the time she spends with her best friend Sakuyo Mikage as she strives to become closer with her childhood crush, Sakuyo's brother Mohiro. Her peaceful life, however, unravels when she finds a yakuza-looking thug trying to enter her house. Forced to invite him inside, Saki learns that her mother used to be a demon fighting Magical Girl, and that her brutish guest is actually a mascot named Kokoro-chan looking to recruit a replacement. Dumbfounded and skeptical, Saki is hesitant accept the request until Kokoro-chan reveals that Mohiro is a target of some cute, squirrel-tailed demons.

Rushing to his side, Saki's overwhelming desire to save Mohiro activates her Love Power, and a daring confession awakens her as a Magical Girl. However, because her body is not suitable for combat, Saki's transformation turns her into a muscle-bound man clad in a pretty dress. Now, as a fully-fledged Magical Girl, Saki must team up with Sakuyo to protect the love of her life from the fluffy, demonic menaces that run rampant in her world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed but leans positive. Many found the show funny and enjoyable as a parody of the magical girl genre, praising its self-awareness and absurdity. However, some found the humor inconsistent, the plot weak, and the characters underdeveloped, leading to boredom and disappointment. The show is best suited for those who appreciate Japanese humor and are familiar with magical girl tropes.
pros: Effective parody of magical girl genre and anime tropes.
Funny and self-aware humor with meta-jokes.
Likable characters and solid voice acting.
Creative and surprising subversion of expectations.
cons: Inconsistent humor and pacing issues, especially around the midpoint.
Repetitive jokes that wear off over time.
Weak character development for side characters.
Plot struggles to fill 12 episodes, leading to filler content.
Some jokes are uncomfortable or poorly executed (e.g., rape joke).
Relies heavily on shock value and surrealism.

anime.title: Kengan Ashura
anime.synopsis:
Business deals are usually made through meetings and contracts; but in the world of Kengan Ashura, businesses resort to other means to make their decisions: by hiring gladiators. Yabako Sandrovich's Kengan Ashura depicts a world brimming with action, violence, and martial arts—one where powerful gladiators have fought in grand arenas since the Edo Period to settle the disputes of wealthy businesses and merchants.

Ouma Tokita, who is nicknamed "The Ashura," is a fighter trying to prove himself as the strongest. Hideki Nogi, a member of the Nogi Group, hires Ouma to fight for him and makes Kazuo Yamashita, an average middle-aged man, his manager. The duo is thrown into fights facilitated by the Kengan Association. Their journey will be full of ruthless battles with other fighters aiming for the same goal. Do they have what it takes to be the best?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided due to the CGI animation, with many manga fans disappointed by the adaptation's visual quality and pacing. Some viewers appreciate the core story and fight choreography despite the animation flaws, while others find the CGI too distracting to enjoy the anime. The series is considered a decent martial arts anime for viewers who can overlook the animation.
pros: Exciting fight choreography (especially in the manga)
Engaging plot with vengeance themes
Good sound design enhancing fights
Faithful to the manga's core story (in some opinions)
Enjoyable for fans of the martial arts genre
cons: Poor CGI animation quality
Stiff character models and lack of impact in attacks
Disorienting camera work during fights
Reduced character development compared to the manga
Pacing issues and skipped content from the manga
Art style doesn't capture the manga's detail
anime.thematic_vibe: Martial Arts, Tournament Arc, Corporate Warfare

anime.title: Aggretsuko (ONA)
anime.synopsis:
Some offices have stereotypical dynamics: the chauvinistic pig of a boss who never does any real work; the employees whose goal is to suck up to the boss; the ones whose lives seem perfect; and the individuals who have all the actual work pushed onto them. Retsuko the red panda is in the last group, as she stays late most nights to make up the work her coworkers are too lazy to do themselves.

Her relief from the stress of her everyday life comes in the form of singing death metal at a local karaoke club. Night after night, Retsuko channels her grief into a microphone and considers the place to be her own personal sanctuary. But as she moves further away from her comfort zone and the ideas people have of her, she discovers that letting others into her world of death metal may not be such a bad thing.
anime.consensus_summary: Aggressive Retsuko is a well-received anime praised for its relatable portrayal of workplace struggles and endearing characters. The show's humor and balance of drama resonate with audiences, though some find the humor repetitive.  The series is generally considered a gem, particularly for its mature themes presented in a cute, accessible style.
pros: Relatable characters and situations resonate with viewers.
Humor is grounded and hits the mark.
The show balances goofiness and drama effectively.
The show has great character development and dynamics.
cons: Some viewers find the humor repetitive.
The plot can be simplistic.
Some seasons are weaker than others (Season 4 in particular).
anime.thematic_vibe: Workplace Satire, Relatable Struggles, Cathartic Release

anime.title: Dropkick On My Devil!
anime.synopsis:
The demon Jashin-chan has been summoned to Earth by Yurine Hanazono, a girl with a knack for the occult. Unfortunately, Yurine does not actually know how to send Jashin-chan back to Hell. Now stuck on Earth, she must live at Yurine's apartment as her familiar.

The only way for Jashin-chan to return would be to kill her summoner, but this is easier said than done for the incompetent demon. Since Jashin-chan is immortal and can regenerate her body, Yurine does not hold back in attacking her with a range of weapons, punishing her in gruesome manners for her evil schemes. Jashin-chan is also often visited by her demon friends: the kindhearted Gorgon Medusa and the energetic minotaur Minosu, who seem much more well-behaved in contrast, and disapprove of her plans to kill Yurine.

Jashin-chan Dropkick is a comedy focusing on these two reluctant roommates and their bizarre antics as they get by with their cat-and-mouse relationship.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some find the show hilarious due to its dark humor, slapstick violence, and quirky characters. Others criticize it for its lack of plot, shallow characters, and repetitive jokes, leading to a love-it-or-hate-it reception.
pros: Enjoyable over-the-top violence and gore
Addictive and cute art style
Upbeat and fun opening and ending themes
cons: Weak or non-existent story
Characters lack depth and development
Comedy can get old quickly
Incoherent and weird plot elements

anime.title: Wu Geng Ji: Tianqi
anime.synopsis:
At the end of the Shang dynasty of ancient China, Emperor Shou defied the will of the Gods. He openly declared to lead the people and to resist against the gods.

Zi Shou bravely fought against Tian Kui, but only received laughter from the gods watching from above. He was then killed by Tian (another greater god) and broke the Immortal Phoenix armor.

Wu Geng then woke up in the body of Ah Gou and realized he has now a wife named Bai Cai...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally engaged with the progression of Wu Geng's journey, the introduction of new characters and concepts, and the action sequences. The training arc pacing may be a drawback for some. There is no signal of polarizing sentiment.
pros: Introduction of diverse concepts and lore.
Wu Geng's development and alliances.
Exciting fight sequences, such as Wu Geng vs Shi Xing.
cons: Training arc pacing may be slow for some viewers.

anime.title: Fate/Grand Order: Moonlight/Lostroom
anime.synopsis: Short centering on a "Lost Room" where you can find what was lost—or those who lost. This room, which belongs to no one, lies forgotten in a corner of Chaldea.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is heavily split between those who appreciate its narrative depth as a bridge between game arcs and fanservice, and those who find it incomprehensible and bogged down by exposition. It's clear this is intended solely for dedicated players of the mobile game, alienating a broader anime-only audience.
pros: Beautifully directed and animated character study
Serves as a good wrap-up for previous singularities and a setup for the next arc
Interesting character building for Ritsuka and Olga Marie
cons: Extremely confusing for newcomers or those not up-to-date with the FGO game's story
Heavy exposition dumps with little payoff for those unfamiliar with the lore
Pacing issues due to prolonged exposition scenes

anime.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Revival of The Commandments - Prologue
anime.romaji_title: Nanatsu no Taizai: Imashime no Fukkatsu Joshou
anime.synopsis: An episode recapping Nanatsu no Taizai with additional scenes, aired before the new season in January 2018.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely views this as a functional and well-executed recap episode. While some found it redundant if they recently watched the first season, most agreed it served its purpose effectively as a refresher. The strong production values, particularly the music, were noted as positives that elevated the recap experience.
pros: Useful as a refresher for the first season
Well-made and entertaining for a recap
Strong background music that enhances the experience
cons: May be boring for those who recently watched Season 1
Doesn't highlight enough of the secondary characters
Could have done a better job introducing the new arc

anime.title: Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Kids, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
As Satoshi continues his journey to become a Pokémon Master, he travels to Fura City to attend the annual Wind Festival. Pumped up, Satoshi and Pikachu are determined to win the festival's Get Race. Meanwhile, Kagachi, a show-off and a habitual liar, joins the competition at the request of his niece Lily. Having almost no knowledge about Pokémon, he manages to strike a deal with a socially awkward scientist named Torito in exchange for help with his upcoming speech. Following Kagachi's victory, Satoshi meets Risa, an ex-regional track and field champion looking to catch a Pokémon. However, during Torito's speech, Team Rocket strikes and manages to steal a capsule from his lab.

Tragedy strikes one after another as the Wind Festival's Sacred Flame disappears! As they set off on a journey to find the culprit, Satoshi and the group meet many people on the way—including Zeraora, the Thunderclap Pokémon who was believed to be dead...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, with many praising the film's artistic achievements, character focus, and departure from the typical Pokemon formula. However, a significant portion of viewers found the narrative boring, overstuffed with characters, and lacking a strong central conflict or antagonist. This results in a divided opinion, with strong admiration for its fresh approach clashing with criticisms of its pacing and narrative depth.
pros: Outstanding artwork and animation quality, with backgrounds and wide shots compared to Studio Ghibli, and vibrant, unique character designs.
The film successfully juggles multiple main characters, giving each sufficient screen time and development without losing its way.
The world-building, particularly Fula City, is well-fleshed out and realistic within its fantasy setting.
The narrative shift away from solely Ash's actions provides a unique and appreciated angle for the series.
The music is fitting and enhances key scenes, and the English dub maintained a majority of the original tracks.
Character designs are praised as the best in the franchise to date, with great attention to detail in outfits and appearance.
The directing, camera movement, and framing create standout, memorable moments.
The sound design effectively gives weight to the film's elements.
The film's structure, focusing on character-driven stories and interpersonal connections rather than a singular antagonist, is seen as a refreshing change.
cons: The plot is considered boring and uninspired by some, with predictable character arcs and a lack of engaging conflict.
The movie has too many characters and subplots, spreading the narrative thin and causing many elements to have minor uses.
The film suffers from pacing issues, with some parts feeling like filler, and the main plot only gaining momentum in the second half.
The antagonist is weak or non-existent, leading to a lack of tension and a less compelling narrative drive.
The messaging, while positive (e.g., pro-nature, togetherness), is seen as generic and overly simplistic by some critics.
Some plot points and character motivations are poorly explained or left unanswered, leading to confusion.
The CGI usage in some scenes is criticized as generic and jarring.
Ash's character is often seen as underdeveloped and serves more as a plot device or familiar element rather than having a significant arc.

anime.title: Captain Tsubasa (2018)
anime.synopsis:
Captain Tsubasa is the passionate story of an elementary school student whose thoughts and dreams revolve almost entirely around the love of soccer. 11-year-old Tsubasa Oozora started playing football at a very young age, and while it was mostly just a recreational sport for his friends, for him, it developed into something of an obsession. 

In order to pursue his dream to the best of his elementary school abilities, Tsubasa moves with his mother to Nankatsu city, which is well-known for its excellent elementary school soccer teams. But although he was easily the best in his old town, Nankatsu has a lot more competition, and he will need all of his skill and talent in order to stand out from this new crowd.

He encounters not only rivals, but also new friends like the pretty girl Sanae Nakazawa and the talented goalkeeper, Genzo Wakabayashi, who shares the same passion as Tsubasa, and will prove to be a treasured friend in helping him push towards his dreams. Representing Japan in the FIFA World Cup is Tsubasa’s ultimate dream, but it will take a lot more than talent to reach it.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the reboot of Captain Tsubasa, citing its faithfulness to the original story and exciting soccer matches. Some feel the pacing is slow and the soundtrack is not as strong as previous versions. However, the nostalgia factor and character development contribute to a positive overall reception.
pros: Faithful to the original series with modern animation.
Character development adds emotional depth.
Exciting soccer matches with vibrant animation.
cons: Pacing can be slow.
Soundtrack not as good as previous adaptations.
Some dialogue and scenes were cut to fit the manga content.

anime.title: Mirai
anime.synopsis:
In a quiet corner of the city, four-year-old Kun Oota has lived a spoiled life as an only child with his parents and the family dog, Yukko. But when his new baby sister Mirai is brought home, his simple life is thrown upside-down; suddenly, it isn't all about him anymore. Despite his tantrums and nagging, Mirai is seemingly now the subject of all his parents' love.

To help him adapt to this drastic change, Kun is taken on an extraordinary journey through time, meeting his family's past, present, and future selves, as he learns not only what it means to be a part of a family, but also what it means to be an older brother.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reaction to 'Mirai no Mirai' is mixed. Some appreciate the film's visuals, music, and exploration of family dynamics through a child's eyes. However, others find the story repetitive, the main character irritating, and the overall plot underwhelming, leading to a polarized viewing experience.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style reminiscent of Hosoda's other works.
Soundtrack is beautiful and enhances the emotional impact.
Offers a unique perspective by focusing on a very young child's point of view.
cons: Repetitive story structure and pacing issues.
Protagonist's behavior (Kun) can be annoying and unlikeable.
Character development feels lacking, especially for Kun.
Plot lacks focus and a clear goal.
anime.thematic_vibe: Family Dynamics, Childhood Perspective, Time Travel

anime.title: Love To-LIE-Angle
anime.synopsis:
As Hanabi Natsuno returns home after six years in Tokyo, memories flood into her. As she prepares to start high school, she moves to Tachibanakan, the local dormitory for female students. Upon her arrival, Hanabi stumbles upon a bare naked beauty, and instantly falls head over heels for her. She also reencounters Konomi Fujiwara, her childhood friend who she barely remembers.

Hanabi is introduced to the other residents of the dorm and quickly becomes the center of attention. As the girls instantly take to the newcomer and begin shooting for her affection—subtly or obtrusively—Hanabi realizes that it is certainly going to be an interesting school year.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception to Tachibanakan Triangle is largely negative, with disappointment stemming from the poor adaptation of the source manga. The short episode length, subpar animation, and overreliance on ecchi content were primary concerns. While some found aspects like the character designs or humor enjoyable, the consensus is that the anime fails to deliver a satisfying experience, especially for fans of yuri or comedy.
pros: Some found the character designs cute, especially in chibi form.
A few reviewers appreciated the voice acting.
Some enjoyed the zaniness and humor, finding it entertaining despite flaws.
cons: The short episode length (3 minutes) was a major point of criticism, hindering story and character development.
Many felt the adaptation failed to capture the quality and charm of the manga.
The animation quality was frequently described as poor, lazy, and choppy.
The excessive fanservice, particularly involving high school characters, made some viewers uncomfortable.
Characters were often seen as generic, cliched, and lacking depth.

anime.title: HIMOTE HOUSE: A share house of super psychic girls
anime.synopsis: The comedy anime centers on five girls and one cat all living as housemates in Nakano, Tokyo: the three Himote sisters (Tokiyo, Kinami, and Kokoro) whose family manages the "Himote House," Kokoro's classmates Tae and Minamo, and the cat Enishi. The girls live their daily lives trying to figure out ways to be popular, and they (and the cat) all possess a mysterious secret power...
anime.consensus_summary: Himote House is a divisive show with a focus on absurdist humor and improv. While the low-quality CGI and weak initial premise are major turn-offs for some, others find enjoyment in the unscripted segments, the voice actors' enthusiasm, and the relaxing music. The show's reliance on ad-libbing and character-driven comedy makes it a unique but flawed experience.
pros: Enjoyable improv/ad-lib sections that feel like a podcast
Voice actors having fun and bringing life to the characters, especially in unscripted segments
Unique premise of voice actors ad-libbing in character
Relaxing and enjoyable music, especially the ending theme
cons: Low quality CGI animation that is jarring and unappealing
Weak initial premise and chaotic setup for comedic moments
Some episodes are lacking and boring
Annoying voice acting for one of the characters (Tokiyo)
anime.thematic_vibe: Absurdist Comedy, Improv, Slice of Life

anime.title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Forty-one years ago on Planet Vegeta, home of the infamous Saiyan warrior race, King Vegeta noticed a baby named Broly whose latent power exceeded that of his own son. Believing that Broly's power would one day surpass that of his child, Vegeta, the king sends Broly to the desolate planet Vampa. Broly's father Paragus follows after him, intent on rescuing his son. However, his ship gets damaged, causing the two to spend years trapped on the barren world, unaware of the salvation that would one day come from an unlikely ally.

Years later on Earth, Gokuu Son and Prince Vegeta—believed to be the last survivors of the Saiyan race—are busy training on a remote island. But their sparring is interrupted when the appearance of their old enemy Frieza drives them to search for the last of the wish-granting Dragon Balls on a frozen continent. Once there, Frieza shows off his new allies: Paragus and the now extremely powerful Broly. A legendary battle that shakes the foundation of the world ensues as Gokuu and Vegeta face off against Broly, a warrior without equal whose rage is just waiting to be unleashed.
anime.consensus_summary: Dragon Ball Super: Broly is a visually impressive and action-packed movie that expands on Saiyan lore. While many appreciate the updated animation style and expanded backstory, some feel the plot is formulaic and the film deviates from the original Dragon Ball spirit. Opinions are divided on the canonization of Dragon Ball Minus, contributing to a moderate level of controversy.
pros: Great animation and fight choreography, especially in the latter half of the movie.
Expands the Saiyan history and lore, providing a deeper backstory for Broly and other Saiyan characters.
Good mix of story and action, with effort put into the plot.
The movie is built up better than most popular series movies in the last 3-4 years.
Art style is reminiscent of old school manga and anime colors.
The action is ramped up to the series heights while also providing some solid character work.
cons: Some plot issues and basic structure problems.
The story can feel cliche or formulaic, relying on a simple revenge plot.
Dragon Ball Minus becoming canon is not well-received by some.
Loss of the Dragon Ball spirit, with too much focus on fights and fanservice.
Animation is lazy, the art style is cheap and cost effective rather than detailed and hand drawn.
Character depth is lacking for Broly.

anime.title: Food Wars! The Third Plate: Totsuki Train Arc
anime.romaji_title: Shokugeki no Souma: San no Sara - Tootsuki Ressha-hen
anime.synopsis:
A dark age of cooking befalls Tootsuki Culinary Academy. With the Elite Ten's devastating coup d'état, Azami Nakiri is now the director of the prestigious school. Students must now conform to Azami's ideology of "true gourmet food" and are forbidden to express creativity, or else face expulsion.

However, Souma Yukihira and the members of the Polar Star Dormitory refuse to accept these changes. Aided by other rebellious first-years, including the tenth seat, Erina Nakiri, Souma and his allies band together to fight off supporters of Azami's regime. But corrupt instructors and the menacing Central organization stand in their way, and so they must work together, harder than ever before, to survive every underhanded plot designed to banish them from the school.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the character development and intense battles, while others criticize the rushed pacing, declining animation, and repetitive elements. The plot's stakes and central conflict are seen as far-fetched by some viewers. Overall, the season is considered a step down from previous installments, with the initial excitement waning for some fans.
pros: Character development, especially Erina's growth.
Intense battles and suspenseful storyline.
Comradery and bonds formed between characters.
cons: Rushed pacing, skipping cooking processes.
Animation quality decline.
Repetitive food descriptions and reactions.
Far-fetched plot and stakes (expulsion).

anime.title: Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san OVA
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Bundled with the 11th, 12th, 13th and 24th volumes of the Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san manga. The first episode will adapt the manga's 12th chapter. 

The last OVA will adapt the 99th chapter of the manga, "Noroware no Kogarashi," and the 141st chapter, "Giri Giri!? Onsen Happening."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on this OVA, with strong opinions leaning towards either its dedicated fanservice or its poor narrative quality and animation. While some appreciate the light-hearted comedy and detailed character art in ecchi scenes, others find the plot weak, the animation lacking, and the overall experience crass and uninspired. It's largely seen as a shallow supplement for existing fans rather than an effective introduction.
pros: Art for the girls is nice, cute, and detailed, especially in ecchi shots.
Good adaptation of the fun and wackiness from the manga.
Characters' personalities, gimmicks, and interactions are explored well within the humor style.
Offers light-hearted add-on content that explores the ensemble cast's day-to-day comedy.
cons: Less smooth animation in far shots or scenes with the main male character.
Story is considered pathetic and focuses solely on fanservice.
Plot is barebone and animation quality is poor in medium-distance and close-up shots, making it a turn-off for new viewers.
Loses the mystique of the manga, feeling crass and potentially gross for uninitiated viewers.
Hapless, predictable, and woefully hollow, failing as an introduction to the full-length anime.

anime.title: Yu Yu Hakusho: Ghost Files -  Two Shots / All or Nothing
anime.romaji_title: Yuu☆Yuu☆Hakusho: Two Shots/Noru ka Soru ka
anime.genres: Action, Martial Arts, Mythology, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Special included in the 25th anniversary Blu-ray box set.

The special will cover the "Two Shot" bonus chapter from the manga's seventh volume, which tells the story of how Kurama and Hiei met, as well as the manga's penultimate chapter "All or Nothing." which shows the main characters reuniting to solve a hostage crisis in the spirit world.
anime.consensus_summary: The Yu Yu Hakusho special OVAs are a mixed bag for fans. While the nostalgia and return of beloved characters and voice actors are appreciated, the quality of the two episodes is uneven. 'Two Shots' is often criticized for being a dull prequel, while 'All or Nothing' provides fan service but lacks substantial narrative depth.
pros: Nostalgic return of characters and voice actors.
Faithful adaptation of manga panels in 'All or Nothing'.
Soundtrack from the original anime enhances the experience.
Good animation quality.
cons: First episode ('Two Shots') is considered dull and uninspired by some.
'Two Shots' suffers from typical prequel problems (unnecessary explanations, pointless characters).
Second episode ('All or Nothing') feels like filler.
Story quality is inconsistent across the two episodes.
Some feel that the ending of 'All or Nothing' is too much for the simple plot.

anime.title: Food Wars! The Third Plate OVA - Erina's New Life
anime.romaji_title: Shokugeki no Souma: San no Sara - Kyokuseiryou no Erina
anime.synopsis: Following the sudden changes to Tootsuki Culinary Academy's administration, Erina Nakiri runs away from home to escape the torment of her oppressive father. Taking refuge at Polar Star Dormitory, the chaotic environment she ends up in is a far cry from her usual refined lifestyle. However, with the help of her friends, Erina gradually finds her place among the dormitory's eccentric residents—creating memorable experiences outside the world of cooking along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the OVA enjoyable, particularly Erina's character development and humorous interactions. It's considered a lighthearted and cute side story. However, some viewers may find the lack of plot relevance and focus on fanservice to be a drawback.
pros: Humorous situations with Erina adjusting to new environment.
Humanization of Erina's character.
Cute and entertaining slice-of-life content.
cons: Lack of significant plot progression.
Fanservice elements may detract from the main story.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Fish-out-of-Water, Character Development

anime.title: IDOLiSH7 Vibrato
anime.synopsis:
On a cold night, idol group TRIGGER reunite at a bar to celebrate the anniversary of the day they started working together. Two years prior, Ryuunosuke Tsunashi leaves his Okinawan home and heads to Tokyo, hoping to become an idol and pay off his father's debt. While waiting for the manager, he is instead picked up by Gaku Yaotome—son of Yaotome Productions' CEO and Ryuunosuke's future co-worker—and they go to meet the mysterious Ten Kujou, the last member of the group.

Gaku wants to confront Ten, as he is dubious of Ten's position as the center of the group. Fortunately, with Ryuunosuke's help, the three of them are able to hit it off, and thus TRIGGER is born. However, there still remain obstacles they have to overcome before their rise to fame.

In the present day, their rivals IDOLiSH7 also have their own set of problems. From planning what to do on their free days to resolving a long-lasting dispute, they are ready to work together and face these problems head-on.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, especially among existing fans of the IDOLiSH7 franchise, who appreciate the focus on TRIGGER's backstory and character development. The series is praised for its art and music, continuing the established quality of the main series. Some viewers looking for a more complex plot may find the slice-of-life format less engaging, but overall, Vibrato is well-received as a worthwhile addition to the IDOLiSH7 universe.
pros: Expands on the backstory of TRIGGER, a popular group within the IDOLiSH7 universe.
Maintains the high-quality art and music from the original anime.
Provides a deeper look into the characters and their relationships.
cons: The 'slice-of-life' style may lack a strong overarching plot for some viewers.

anime.title: Lupin the Third: Is Lupin Still Burning?
anime.romaji_title: Lupin III: Lupin wa Ima mo Moete Iru ka?
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Seinen
anime.synopsis: A 50th anniversary project.
anime.consensus_summary: The special is well-received as a nostalgic callback to older Lupin series and a precursor to newer installments. It's considered brilliant and amazing, but viewers are warned that the heavy fanservice might lead to some confusion for new viewers. Overall, the audience mood is positive and appreciative of the special's quality.
pros: Amazing callback to old Lupin.
Brilliant special.
Precursor to the new groove of Lupin.
cons: Heavy fanservice may cause confusion.

anime.title: Cutie Honey Universe
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Romance, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis: The forces of evil are on the rise. When the evil mastermind Sister Jill transforms one of her girls into the bestial Breast Claw and sends her minions out on a mission involving the group Panther Claw and a jewelry store heist, Honey Kisaragi departs from her Catholic girls' school to confront the threat as Cutie Honey. But that's exactly what Sister Jill wants, as she desires Honey's Airborne Element Fixing Device, which allows her to transform into Honey's seven different forms. Meanwhile, Sister Jill is also on the scene in disguise as Inspector Genet, trying to worm her way into Honey's confidence from a different angle.
anime.consensus_summary: Cutie Honey Universe is largely considered a disappointment due to its unfulfilled potential and poor execution, despite some good intentions and faithfulness to the source material. Many reviewers feel the series suffers from bad writing, mediocre visuals, and a tonal imbalance. While some appreciate the character designs and certain aspects of the music, the overall consensus is that it fails to capture the essence and excitement of previous Cutie Honey adaptations, making it a skippable entry for both fans and newcomers.
pros: Respect for Go Nagai's character designs.
Some interesting character development, particularly Natsuko, Jill, and Naoko.
Catchy music, especially Sister Jill's theme.
Faithful to the original source material.
Appreciated depiction of sexuality
cons: Poor pacing and questionable plot points.
Inconsistent character motivations and actions.
Mediocre visuals, jarring 3D animation, and underwhelming battle scenes.
Lackluster art style with glaring colors.
Over-reliance on fan service and poorly executed comedy.
Failure to utilize the original Cutie Honey soundtrack.
Weak story with a monster-of-the-week format and low stakes.
Unexplained gravity tunnels in battles.
Inconsistent power levels of Honey.
Poorly handled dark themes, with jarring comedic insertions.
Subplot with Genet/Sister Jill is nonsensical.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fanservice, Go Nagai Humor, Unfulfilled Potential

anime.title: Mitchiri Neko
anime.synopsis: The cute and mysterious cat-like creatures called Mitchiri Neko that seem to gather around each other if you leave them alone now get their own anime with a glorious voice cast! The free and happy-go-lucky Mitchiri Neko's daily life is filled fluff and surreal laughs! Say it with me, "Mitchiri! Mitchiri!"
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Micchiri Neko' to be a charming and lighthearted anime, particularly appealing to cat lovers and those seeking a brief, enjoyable experience. While some appreciate its cuteness and whimsical nature, others may find it too simplistic or repetitive. The series is not controversial and mostly receives positive feedback from its target audience.
pros: Adorable art style and character designs.
Enjoyable, lighthearted, and easy to watch.
Creative use of puns and Easter eggs for those who understand Japanese.
cons: May become repetitive or tiring for some viewers.
Lacks complexity and depth for viewers seeking intricate plots or character development.
Enjoyment highly dependent on fondness for cats and cute aesthetics.

anime.title: Non Non Biyori Movie: Vacation
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
With summer vacation coming to an end, the girls are having as much fun as they can with their remaining time. However, their daily shenanigans are cut short when Suguru Koshigaya wins the grand prize of a lottery—tickets to Okinawa! After hasty preparations, the Asahigaoka group embarks on a three-day trip for their final summer getaway.

Upon arriving in Okinawa and checking into an inn, the group comes across Aoi Niizato—the young daughter of the inn's hostess. Despite being of similar age, her mature demeanor leaves Natsumi Koshigaya reflecting upon her own childish nature. With the sign of an unexpected friendship blooming on the horizon, the girls waste no time diving into their ambitious sightseeing plans and regional activities!
anime.consensus_summary: The Non Non Biyori movie is a well-received extension of the series, offering a relaxing and heartwarming experience for fans. The movie's simple story is enhanced by its charming characters and beautiful Okinawa setting. While the plot may be light, the overall experience is highly enjoyable for those who appreciate the series' signature slice-of-life style.
pros: Captures the essence of the original series, delivering the same feel-good atmosphere.
Well-paced and uses its runtime to create a satisfying arc, making it more immersive than a typical episode.
New character Aoi adds an interesting dynamic and human drama to the story.
cons: The plot is simple and anecdotal, lacking a strong narrative focus.
Animation quality is comparable to the main series but not particularly outstanding.

anime.title: Lupin III 3DCG
anime.synopsis: Pilot for a hypothetical Lupin 3DCG project included with the 40th anniversary Master File BD/DVD.
anime.consensus_summary: The Lupin III 3DCG short is well-received for its visual style and faithful adaptation of the characters into 3D.  Viewers appreciate the action and nostalgic feel, but are disappointed by its brevity and the fact that it wasn't expanded into a larger project. The overall sentiment leans towards positive, with a strong desire for more content in this style.
pros: Beautiful adaptation of character designs into 3D
Selective realism enhances visuals (e.g., Fujiko's hair)
Effective storytelling without dialogue
cons: Lack of story and character development due to the short length
Disappointment that the short was not developed into a full project

anime.title: Junji Ito: Collection - Tomie
anime.synopsis:
Memories, both good and bad, suffuse the high school experience. Whether it's hanging out with friends or cramming for tests, everyone has something they will remember from that time in their lives. At a certain high school, one class is faced with an event that can cause people to look back on their high school days in sadness: the death of a student.

The deceased is not just any student—she's Tomie Kawakami, a popular girl with an almost otherworldly beauty. Her death was particularly gruesome: her body was dismembered and the pieces scattered. As the class tries to make sense of the situation, they are shocked when a familiar voice calls out to them from the doorway, apologizing for being late.

With raven hair and a beauty mark under her left eye, this girl is the spitting image of their murdered classmate. But she can't actually be Tomie, right?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely disappointed, with many critics agreeing that the adaptation fails to capture the depth and horror of the original manga. While some praise the artwork and premise, the overwhelming consensus points to rushed pacing, poor character development, and confusing storytelling as major detriments. The general recommendation is to read the manga instead.
pros: Commendable artwork and deliberate framing that maximizes disturbing scenes.
Solid premise and unsettling atmosphere.
Voice acting and sound design are adequate/good, helping to elevate tension.
Captures the unsettling essence of Junji Ito's work.
cons: Poor art and animation quality, even by the series' standards.
Rushed pacing and significant cuts from the source material, hindering atmosphere and mood.
Confusing storytelling, especially for newcomers unfamiliar with the manga.
Heavy censorship (black streaks) detracts from the visual horror.
Underdeveloped and generic characters due to the condensed runtime.
The adaptation fails to fully replicate the detail and uncanny nature of Ito's drawings, resulting in less impactful horror.

anime.title: Precure Super Stars! Movie
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a fun crossover event for Precure fans, especially those fond of the featured characters.  The animation is a highlight, and while some characters are underutilized, the overall experience is positive and consistent with the franchise's quality. It's considered a worthwhile watch for existing fans.
pros: Interaction between cures from different seasons is enjoyable.
High-quality animation.
Exciting final fight.
Morals about keeping promises are well-received.
cons: Mahou Girls' screentime is limited.

anime.title: Zoku Owarimonogatari
anime.synopsis:
Graduation day is finally here, marking the end of Koyomi Araragi's eccentric high school life full of peculiar relationships with otherworldly beings.

However, Araragi is unexpectedly absorbed into his own bathroom mirror and trapped inside a bizarre world where everything he knows is completely reversed—the haughty Karen Araragi is shorter than usual, poker-faced Yotsugi Ononoki is brimming with emotion, and cute ghost girl Mayoi Hachikuji is a grown woman! But not everything is as it seems.

Zoku Owarimonogatari details the story of Araragi's endeavors in this new world as he struggles to return to his home and understand the nature of this bizarre dimension.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Zoku Owarimonogatari are divided. Some appreciate it as a fitting epilogue with unique visuals and character development, while others criticize it for being unnecessarily long, lacking the series' signature elements, and feeling like fan service. While fans of the series generally enjoyed it, newcomers or those seeking a substantial addition to the main story may be disappointed.
pros: Unique animation style and visual presentation.
Satisfying character development and exploration of relationships.
Intriguing premise and clever use of the mirror world concept.
Fitting end to the Monogatari series, tying up loose ends.
cons: Unnecessary length with excessive exposition and recaps.
Story feels like fan service and doesn't add much to the main plot.
