Some viewers found the reveals and plot developments boring or nonsensical.
The mystery and puzzle elements that defined the series are missing.

anime.title: Hinomaru Sumo
anime.synopsis:
In professional sumo, there are no weight classes. It's a savage sport where the strongest survive, and anyone willing to test their mettle can step into the ring. There is, however, a minimum size requirement to be a pro sumo wrestler, and young Hinomaru Ushio, incredibly talented and hardworking though he may be, does not meet that requirement. This small boy has big dreams of reaching the highest class of  sumo, Hinoshita Kaisan. The only way he could possibly go pro is if he becomes the High School Yokozuna, a title given to the strongest wrestler in high school tournaments.

Ushio is under a lot of pressure, as well as a time limit. If he can't show off his skills in the high school tournaments, he may lose his chance to go pro permanently, and the odds are stacked against him. Instead of enrolling in Ishigami High, the best school for sumo in Japan, he enrolls in Odachi High and must build a sumo club from the ground up with the one devout member Shinya Ozeki. Odachi High is the true underdog of the sumo world, but Ushio has to push forward with all his strength if he is going to make it professionally.
anime.consensus_summary: Hinomaruzumou is a well-received sports anime, praised for its emotional depth, character development, and respectful portrayal of sumo. While some find the story predictable and the animation inconsistent, the series is generally considered an inspiring underdog story with intense and dramatic matches. Many viewers appreciate the focus on the characters' growth and relationships beyond just the sport itself.
pros: Evokes powerful emotions and suspenseful action.
Well-developed characters with strong focus on human growth and relationships.
Respectful portrayal of Sumo and its traditions.
cons: Animation quality can be inconsistent and sometimes feels static.
Story follows a formulaic sports anime pattern.
Pacing feels rushed, particularly character development in later episodes.

anime.title: Sex: Prologue
anime.synopsis: The anime depicts an original story before Kaho arrives, when Yuki and Natsu have just met in Okinawa.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Sex: Prologue' is a visually appealing but ultimately unsatisfying experience due to its extremely short runtime and confusing narrative. The loud and jarring music is a common point of criticism. Only those already invested in the manga may find some value in it.
pros: Pretty animation
cons: Extremely short runtime
Fast pacing makes the story hard to grasp
Loud and abrasive music
Little substance beyond visuals

anime.title: Layton Mystery Tanteisha: Katri no Nazotoki File
anime.romaji_title: Layton Mystery Tanteisha: Katri no Nazotoki File
anime.synopsis:
The Layton Detective Agency, a business that helps its clients solve unusual mysteries, is run by Katrielle Layton—daughter of the world-renowned archaeology professor Hershel Layton. Together with her assistant Noah Montoir and talking dog Sherl, Katrielle finds herself unraveling cases involving a newly purchased cursed house, a dress imbued with a "demon's curse," and the zombie of a client's deceased spouse, just to name a few. 

Aside from her more quirky cases, Katrielle has been working on another unsolved problem: the disappearance of her father. Founding the agency was only the first step in her attempt to uncover the truth behind his vanishing. As she continues to take on client after client, each with wackier and stranger issues to tackle, Katrielle steadily closes in on the answer to the biggest mystery of her life.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Layton Mystery Tanteisha' anime is generally well-received by fans of the Professor Layton series, particularly for its faithful adaptation of the aesthetic and expansion of the Layton universe. While some appreciate the lighthearted mysteries and Katrielle's personality, others find the characters underdeveloped and the storylines lacking depth. The anime is considered a pleasant, relaxing watch for those already invested in the franchise.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the Layton art style and music.
Enjoyable episodic mysteries, especially anime-original content.
Katrielle's personality is a highlight.
Addresses and expands upon plot points from the game.
cons: Characters can be flat and underdeveloped.
Overreliance on 'friendship makes us strong' trope.
Some find the game-adapted cases weak.
Katrielle's character is not as compelling as Professor Layton.

anime.title: Love Live! Sunshine!! The School Idol Movie: Over the Rainbow
anime.romaji_title: Love Live! Sunshine!! The School Idol Movie: Over the Rainbow
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Following the closure of Uranohoshi Girls' High School, the third-year students—Dia Kurosawa, Kanan Matsuura, and Mari Ohara—have just graduated, leaving Aqours with solely the first and second-years. While searching for a new place the remaining members can use to practice, they decide to visit the new school they will soon enroll in. However, to their surprise, the building seems to be abandoned! It turns out that due to the school board's worries regarding how the freshly transferred Uranohoshi students may burden the clubs, they were instead sent to a branch school. This sets Aqours on a new goal—to prove that Uranohoshi students are serious in their clubs as well. Meanwhile, another problem arises: the third-years have unexpectedly gone missing during their graduation trip! 

Love Live! Sunshine!! The School Idol Movie: Over the Rainbow revolves around the remaining Aqours members as they venture out to search for their missing seniors and, at the same time, try to figure out a way to change the new school's mind.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a mixed bag, praised for its music, art, and character moments, but heavily criticized for its nonsensical plot, overblown drama, and weak writing. While some find it an enjoyable and heartwarming experience, others view it as a mess with incoherent storylines. Ultimately, its appeal seems to depend on one's tolerance for the series' existing tropes and flaws.
pros: Stellar art and music quality.
Characters are at their most extreme, leading to originality.
Resolutions from the anime series are brilliantly addressed.
Enjoyable and heartwarming moments.
cons: Story makes zero sense and is incoherant.
Overblown drama feels out of place.
Plot is a repetitive nature with bland originality.
Characters feel one-dimensional with minimal growth.
Poor writing and absurd plot elements.

anime.title: Today's Menu for the Emiya Family
anime.romaji_title: Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan
anime.synopsis:
With the threat of the Holy Grail War no longer looming over Fuyuki City, its inhabitants can finally enjoy a time of peace. Now that all of the Masters and Servants have adjusted to their new mundane lives, Shirou has taken it upon himself to cook for his household and show Saber the wonders of modern cuisine. Every day, he ventures into the marketplace to see what kind of different meals he can cook up with unique ingredients and a limited budget. However, his legendary skills often attract uninvited guests from all over the city, so there is never a dull moment at dinner with the Emiya family.

As his guests entertain themselves in the living room, Shirou walks through the step-by-step process of creating some of his favorite meals. With delicacies such as his savory New Year soba with shrimp tempura, steamy foil-baked salmon, and cheesy bamboo shoot gratin, everything is up for grabs on his menu. Itadakimasu!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers appreciate the lighthearted take on the Fate universe, finding it a relaxing and enjoyable experience. The show's focus on character interactions and heartwarming moments, combined with its unique art style, makes it a welcome departure from the darker themes of the main series.
pros: Relaxing and heartwarming portrayal of Fate characters in a peaceful setting.
Beautiful animation with a unique watercolor art style.
Enjoyable character interactions and comedic moments.
cons: Pacing can be slow with awkward pauses between dialogue.
Some viewers may find the cooking aspect less interesting than the character interactions.
Possible spoilers for the main Fate series for first-time viewers.

anime.title: Cute High Earth Defense Club HAPPY KISS!
anime.romaji_title: Binan Koukou Chikyuu Bouei-bu Happy Kiss!
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Parody, School, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
In the northern Kanto area in Japan, there is Binan City…

At Binan High School, as per usual, the “Earth Defense Club (lol)” was a club that did nothing. The club members Kyoutarou Shuzenji, Ryouma Kirishima, Nanao Wakura, Taishi Manza, and Ichiro Dogou nonchalantly enjoyed tea while having pointless conversations that amount to nothing.

All of them have now gathered at Kurotama Bath after school. When Ryouma pulls Kyoutarou Shuzenji by his arm out of water that he claims feels too good, together with his towel comes a pretty boy in strange clothing.

These five boys are then dragged into a battle for the heir of the magical kingdom, Honila Land...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, particularly when compared to the original series. Some appreciate the improved visuals and music, along with the character designs, finding it enjoyable as a lighthearted parody. Others criticize the lack of originality in the story and characters, considering them inferior to the original series. Overall, it is seen as a fun but uninspired installment in the franchise.
pros: Colorful and improved art style compared to previous seasons.
Catchy opening and ending themes, enjoyable music.
Characters have distinct personalities and are likeable (bishounen appeal).
cons: Story reuses elements from the original series, lacking originality.
Characters are seen as cheap copies of the original cast.
Some found the main character Kyoutarou's apathy off-putting.

anime.title: Animegataris: Yuku Toshi, Kuru Toshi
anime.synopsis: Special short episode of Animegataris streamed on Niconico-douga.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a recap episode with some comedic elements but ultimately skippable. The art is decent, but the story is uninspired and doesn't add anything significant to the main series. Most viewers find recap episodes unenjoyable.
pros: Art is pretty good.
cons: Recap story.
Not important or life altering.
Too many cut corners.

anime.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil: The Movie
anime.synopsis:
With its armies sweeping across the continent, the Empire seems unstoppable. After securing victory over the remnants of the Republic's army, the Empire's ultimate victory is finally within reach. However, dark clouds are gathering in the East. The communist-led Russy Federation is mustering troops on its western border, preparing to enter the war. Supported by a detachment of Allied volunteer magicians—among whom is Mary Sioux, the daughter of a soldier killed by Tanya von Degurechaff—the Federation is determined to spread the communist creed and bring the Empire to its knees.

Meanwhile, Tanya and her battalion return to the imperial capital from the southern front. Upon their arrival, they are tasked with investigating troop movements on the border with the Federation. Any escalation of violence at this point may lead to new conflicts, plunging the world into a devastating global war.

Will the Empire eventually emerge victorious from its struggle, or will it crumble in the face of superior enemies and radically different ideologies?
anime.consensus_summary: The Youjo Senki Movie is generally well-received, with praise for its animation, sound, and action. However, some viewers found the story lacking substance and criticized certain aspects of the CGI and character development. The film serves as a good continuation of the series, but some feel it mainly sets up for a sequel.
pros: Excellent animation and sound design, especially the battle sequences.
Faithful adaptation of the light novel content.
Engaging action and thrilling fight choreography.
Good character development, particularly for new characters.
The movie successfully continues the story from Season 1 without filler.
cons: Some CGI is inconsistent and of poor quality.
The story felt like a filler or transition period with little plot progression.
The antagonist's motive is considered cliché.
Battles are sometimes short or skipped over, lacking payoff until the final battle.
Character designs are disliked by some viewers.

anime.title: The King's Avatar (2018)
anime.synopsis:
The All-Star Tournament is a three-day event that allows e-sports participants from various professional clubs to display their skills, while also giving casual Glory players the chance to interact with pros in the flesh.

Retired top-tier Glory player Ye Xiu agrees to watch the tournament together with Tang Rou and Chen Guo after the latter manages to get ahold of three tickets. It is a strange sensation for Ye Xiu, as unlike previous occasions, this time he attends the tournament as a spectator, not a participant. However, despite his attempts to keep a low profile, events in the All-Star Tournament may force the former Glory legend back into the limelight.
anime.consensus_summary: The Quanzhi Gaoshou Specials are generally well-received, particularly for improved animation and engaging esports-focused story. Some viewers find inconsistencies in animation quality and feel the story is less accessible without prior knowledge. While the specials are appreciated by fans of the series, some consider them a step down from the first season, especially in terms of art style and music.
pros: Improved animation and direction compared to Season 1
Exciting and well-choreographed fight scenes
Engaging story with likeable characters
Faithful to the source material (novel)
Good pacing and highlights of different character personalities
cons: Animation quality varies between episodes
Story can be confusing for newcomers
Art style may be bland or shiny compared to Season 1
Product placement can be distracting
Some character moments and developments are omitted from the adaptation
OST not as good as Season 1 for some viewers

anime.title: Kakegurui××
anime.genres: Drama, High Stakes Game, Mystery, Psychological, School, Shounen, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
As Yumeko Jabami's fame grows and the reputation of the student council dwindles, Kirari Momobami decides to revolutionize the group. To this end, she announces an election for its next president. The rules are simple: each student in the school receives one chip. Whoever has the most chips by the end of thirty days becomes both the new president and the head of the Momobami clan.

Upon receiving news of this development, the Momobami branch families spring into action. Eleven transfer students arrive at Hyakkao Private Academy, each aiming to lead both the school and the Momobami clan. Equipped with unique talents, they will compete to get as many chips as possible—but their chips are not the only things on the line.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Kakegurui ××. While some appreciate the thrilling gambles, character development, and art style, others find the story repetitive, the antagonists uninteresting, and the stakes lacking. Overall, the season is considered enjoyable but not as great as the first season.
pros: Exciting gambles and mind games.
Well-developed side characters and backstories.
Great voice acting and sound design.
Intense facial expressions and animation.
cons: Story is repetitive and doesn't add anything new.
Uninteresting antagonists and lack of stakes.
Yumeko rarely loses which lowers the tension.
Gambles are unrealistic and complex.
anime.thematic_vibe: Gambling Thrills, Psychological Warfare, Character Obsession

anime.title: Overlord: Ple Ple Pleiades 2
anime.synopsis: Super deformed parody shorts of Overlord II streamed on Kadokawa's official YouTube channel.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views Ple Ple Pleiades 2 as a lighthearted and humorous spin-off that offers fun character moments. While it's considered enjoyable for fans looking for a break from the main series, it's not seen as particularly groundbreaking or essential viewing.
pros: Provides nice little humor
Offers snippets of character personalities
Worth watching for fun
Parodies events from the main series
cons: Not too special
Not as good as the first season

anime.title: Violet Evergarden: The Day You Understand "I Love You" Will Surely Come
anime.romaji_title: Violet Evergarden: Kitto "Ai" wo Shiru Hi ga Kuru no Darou
anime.synopsis:
The CH Postal Company has just received a request to transcribe a love letter from Irma Felice, a famous opera singer. Accepting the task, Violet Evergarden visits Irma to write her letter. However, not only does Irma provide little information, she asks Violet to write based on her own feelings. Despite Violet's numerous attempts, Irma finds every version of the letter inadequate.

Violet consults her colleagues, and they help her out by writing love letters of their own. Yet even those are rejected by the opera singer. As a last resort, Violet asks Irma for her true thoughts and feelings, hoping to find the missing puzzle piece. Will the Auto Memory Doll be able to translate Irma's emotions into words?
anime.consensus_summary: The Violet Evergarden OVA is well-received as a heartwarming and emotionally resonant addition to the series. Most find it seamlessly integrates into the timeline and enhances the overall experience, although some critique its slower pace and slightly weaker emotional impact compared to standout episodes. The consensus leans heavily towards positive, with many appreciating the animation, story, and character development.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style.
Heartwarming and emotional story.
Fits seamlessly into the original series timeline.
Explores the power of words and emotions.
Provides additional character development for supporting characters.
cons: Some find the beginning slow-paced.
Episode lacks the emotional impact of some other episodes.
The resolution doesn't feel as earned compared to other episodes.
Story may feel like an overlap with other episodes.
Reuses soundtrack from another episode which reduces the emotional weight.

anime.title: Danganronpa 3: Monokuma Gekijou
anime.synopsis: Danganronpa 3 skits included in the Blu-ray Box Sets.
anime.consensus_summary: The Monokuma Gekijou skits are generally viewed as fun, goofy parodies of Danganronpa 3.  However, they can be difficult to find and some episodes may not be properly subbed.  Their short length and accessibility online is appreciated by those who do discover them.
pros: Short and easily accessible.
Parodies play with the characters in Danganronpa 3.
cons: Not included in all Blu-ray releases.
Can be difficult to find.
Third episode may not be subbed.

anime.title: Grand Blue Dreaming
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Iori Kitahara moves to the coastal town of Izu for his freshman year at its university, taking residence above Grand Blue, his uncle's scuba diving shop. Iori has high hopes and dreams about having the ideal college experience, but when he enters the shop he is sucked into the alcoholic activities of the carefree members of the Diving Club who frequent the place. Persuaded by upperclassmen Shinji Tokita and Ryuujirou Kotobuki, Iori reluctantly joins their bizarre party. His cousin Chisa Kotegawa later walks in and catches him in the act, earning Iori her utter disdain.

Based on Kenji Inoue and Kimitake Yoshioka's popular comedy manga, Grand Blue follows Iori's misadventures with his eccentric new friends as he strives to realize his ideal college dream, while also learning how to scuba dive.
anime.consensus_summary: Grand Blue is a polarizing comedy anime. While many find it hilarious and relatable due to its over-the-top humor and depiction of college life, others find it repetitive, crude, and lacking in substance. The show's reliance on drinking and nudity, along with its thin plot, contributes to the divided opinions among viewers.
pros: Hilarious and funny, providing consistent laughter.
Enjoyable characters and overall entertainment value.
Relatable to college students, depicting drinking and party culture.
cons: Repetitive jokes that may become tiresome.
Over-the-top humor that feels forced at times.
Crude humor and excessive nudity that may not appeal to all viewers.
Weak or pointless storyline.

anime.title: Voice of Fox
anime.synopsis: The series follows 16-year-old Hu Li, who dreams of becoming a popular singer. However, he has neither good looks nor the financial means to pursue his dream, so Hu Li uploads his singing online using a fox avatar.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many viewers finding the initial concept and art appealing. However, the consensus is that the execution falls short due to a rushed plot, repetitive music, and underdeveloped characters. While some enjoyed it as a light and easy watch, most express disappointment with the unresolved storylines and lack of depth, leading to a polarizing response.
pros: Interesting concept/premise
Good/pleasant art style and character designs
Upbeat and catchy songs (initially)
Voice acting is well-done
cons: Rushed and incomplete story
Repetitive music and limited number of songs
Weak character development and one-dimensional characters
Plot holes and unrealistic scenarios
Disappointing ending and lack of resolution
Excessive use of 'Deus ex machina'

anime.title: Hakumei to Mikochi: Neji to Bed to Irori to Bakuchi
anime.romaji_title: Hakumei to Mikochi: Neji to Bed to Irori to Bakuchi
anime.genres: Fantasy, Iyashikei, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Special episode included in the second Blu-ray/DVD volume.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the episode to be a cozy and calming addition to the series, maintaining its established charm. Viewers appreciate the continuation of the manga's story and the relaxing atmosphere. Some find the first part of the episode less engaging, but overall the episode is well-received as a comfortable and enjoyable experience.
pros: Continuation of the manga story
Relaxing and comfortable atmosphere
Unique art style and soothing soundtrack
cons: First part of the episode is a throwaway story

anime.title: Ninja Girl & Samurai Master: Anegawa and Ishiyama Arc
anime.synopsis: Third season of the Nobunaga no Shinobi series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the anime despite the predictable storyline. The characters' personalities and short episode length are frequently praised. Viewers appreciate the fresh take on a familiar historical narrative.
pros: Characters are more lovable than in other adaptations due to added personality.
Easy to watch due to short episode length.
Engaging even if the viewer knows the historical events.
cons: Story is predictable because it is based on well-known historical events.

anime.title: GeGeGe no Kitaro
anime.synopsis: Nearly twenty years into the 21st century, people have forgotten the existence of youkai. When a number of unexplainable phenomena plague adults of the human world with confusion and chaos, thirteen-year-old Mana writes a letter to the Youkai Post in search of answers, only to be greeted by Gegege no Kitarou...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Gegege no Kitarou (2018) for its engaging stories, exploration of Japanese folklore, and surprising depth in social commentary. While some find the initial episodes childish or the animation inconsistent, the series is praised for its memorable characters and ability to appeal to both younger and older viewers. The show is considered a hidden gem that deserves more attention.
pros: Interesting and engaging stories, even if episodic
Good character development for main cast
Explores deeper subjects relevant to older audiences
High quality writing with social commentary
Introduces yokai lore in an entertaining way
cons: Can be too cartoony for some viewers
Inconsistent artwork and animation quality
Voice acting can be inconsistent
Initially seems geared towards children

anime.title: Cells at Work!
anime.synopsis:
Inside the human body, roughly 37.2 trillion cells work energetically 24 hours a day and 365 days a year. Fresh out of training, the cheerful and somewhat airheaded Sekkekkyuu AE3803 is ready to take on the ever-so-important task of transporting oxygen. As usual, Hakkekkyuu U-1146 is hard at work patrolling and eliminating foreign bacteria seeking to make the body their new lair. Elsewhere, little platelets are lining up for a new construction project. 

Dealing with wounds and allergies, getting lost on the way to the lungs, and bickering with similar cell types, the daily lives of cells are always hectic as they work together to keep the body healthy!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the unique concept and educational value of Hataraku Saibou. However, some find the lack of a strong, continuous story and the simplistic characters to be drawbacks. While many enjoy the blend of comedy and action, others feel it becomes repetitive, resulting in a somewhat polarized, though overall positive, reception.
pros: Unique and innovative concept
Informative and educational about the human body
Good character design and faithful adaptation of human body functions
Entertaining mix of comedy, action, and drama
Visually appealing with detailed backgrounds
cons: Lack of a strong overarching story
Episodic format can feel repetitive
Characters can be one-dimensional and predictable
Animation quality can be inconsistent
Over-reliance on tropes

anime.title: Soul Land
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Reincarnation, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Tang San is one of Tang Sect martial art clan's most prestigious disciples and peerless in the use of hidden weapons. With high expectations, the sect's elders believe his future will be bright; yet Tang chooses to forsake this life at the cost of obtaining the sect's forbidden lore—an action punishable by death. Tang, now content with his ascension of knowledge, sees no reason to keep on living and jumps from Hell's Peak, but little did he know that that would not be the end of his existence. 

In Douluo Continent, the strong prevail and the weak perish. Each person possesses an innate spirit, some of which can be cultivated and strengthened, bestowing its user with various benefits. Those who were born with such spirits can become Spirit Masters, a profession regarded as one of the continent's most noble.

Tang, reincarnated into this strange world, knows only the life of a blacksmith's son. At the age of six, he takes part in the Spirit Master ceremony, and discovers his spirit is Blue Silver Grass—supposedly the world's most useless spirit. In contrast, however, he possesses strong spirit power. Now, aided by the memories of his previous life as well, Tang's future as a Spirit Master is in no way bleak.
anime.consensus_summary: Douluo Dalu receives mixed reactions. Many appreciate the engaging storyline, world-building, and character progression, especially of the main character. However, criticisms include slow pacing, inconsistent animation, excessive product placement, and weak character development beyond the main character, particularly in later seasons, leading to some viewers dropping the series.
pros: Compelling story with interesting world-building.
Satisfying character growth and power progression of the MC.
Exciting and fast-paced fight scenes (after getting used to the animation).
Good chemistry and friendships between characters.
cons: Slow start and repetitive arcs.
Inconsistent animation quality, especially early on.
Excessive product placement and recap/theme song time in episodes.
Weak female characters and lack of depth for most characters.
Translation quality issues.
Story becomes tiring and repetitive later in the series.
Slow character development filled with unnecessary dialogue
Irrelevant scenes that eat up run time.

anime.title: Marvel Future Avengers 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Second season of Marvel Future Avengers.
anime.consensus_summary: The reviewer expresses extreme dislike for the show, stating it's atrocious and caused physical illness. They felt it damaged them psychologically and failed as an adaptation, butchering both cultures and characters. There's no indication of any positive reception or counter-arguments from the provided review.
cons: The show is incredibly bad and causes physical revulsion.
It inflicts long-term psychological damage.
It fails as both anime and adaptation of beloved characters.
It butchers Eastern and Western culture.

anime.title: Grimms Notes The Animation
anime.synopsis:
Within one's Book of Fate is their destiny. Written by the mysterious Story Tellers, these books decide every small detail of one's life. Some Story Tellers, however, choose to interfere with the stories of others rather than write their own. These malevolent beings are known as Chaos Tellers, who seek to ruin stories by overwriting the Books of Fate.

Ex, Reina, Tao, and Shane were born with blank books. Ostracized by society due to this abnormality, they abandon their respective stories in search of better lives. In the vast unknown, they encounter famous fairy tale characters such as Cinderella, Momotarou, and Snow White. All the while, they work to subdue the Chaos Tellers and return peace and order to the stories.
anime.consensus_summary: Grimms Notes The Animation is viewed as a mediocre adaptation of its source material, failing to capitalize on its intriguing premise. While some appreciate the anime-style twist on classic fairy tales and the enjoyable character designs, many criticize its repetitive structure, underdeveloped characters, and weak plot. The series is considered a disappointment with wasted potential, especially for those familiar with the original game.
pros: Adaptation of classic tales with anime flair.
Intriguing premise of characters defying fate.
Enjoyable character designs and voice acting.
Good music and clean art.
cons: Repetitive episodic structure.
Bland and stereotypical characters with little development.
Mediocre fight scenes with uninspired animation.
Weak plot with inconsistencies and plot holes.
Failure to explore the full potential of the premise.
Poor adaptation of the game's storyline and characters.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fairy Tale Deconstruction, Isekai Tropes, Unfulfilled Potential

anime.title: Tales of Demon and God 2nd Season
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: Second season of Yao Shen Ji.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception of Yao Shen Ji Season 2 is mixed. While some appreciate the added content and lighthearted moments, many are critical of the poor CGI animation, plot inconsistencies, and forced fan service. Overall, the season is considered skippable by some, as it adds little to the main storyline and even contradicts later events.
pros: Expands on the source material (manga/novel) by showing new things.
Some viewers find the filler content fun and lighthearted.
cons: CGI animation is of low quality and detracts from the experience.
Plot inconsistencies and contradictions with later seasons.
Side stories feel disconnected and characters are inconsistent.
Excessive fan service feels forced and distracting.
Enemies lack depth and feel childish.

anime.title: Asobi Asobase: Workshop of Fun
anime.synopsis:
During recess, Olivia, a foreign transfer student who doesn't know English, plays a game of "look-the-other-way" with Hanako Honda, a loud-mouthed airhead. Their rowdy behavior spurs the ire of Kasumi Nomura, a deadpan loner constantly teased by her older sister for her tendency to lose games. Not willing to compete, Kasumi declines Olivia's offer to join the fun, but eventually gets involved anyway and dispenses her own brand of mischief. Soon, a strange friendship blossoms between the peculiar trio, and they decide to form the "Pastime Club," where they are free to resume their daily hijinks. 

Whether it be failing to learn English, trying desperately to become popular, or getting caught by teachers at the wrong time, school life will never be boring when the girls of Asobi Asobase are up to their hilarious antics.
anime.consensus_summary: Asobi Asobase is a divisive comedy anime. While many find its over-the-top humor, unexpected twists, and excellent voice acting hilarious, others are turned off by its crude jokes, simple characters, and initial art style. The series subverts expectations by blending cute aesthetics with vulgarity, resulting in a polarizing experience.
pros: Hilarious and over-the-top comedy
Unexpected twists and subversion of expectations
Great voice acting, especially Hanako's seiyuu
Strong comedic timing and gag execution
Unique blend of cuteness and vulgarity
cons: Crude humor may not appeal to everyone
Inconsistent jokes
Simple characters and plot
Initial art style may be off-putting to some
Obnoxiousness

anime.title: Kiratto Pri☆chan
anime.synopsis: First-year middle school girls Mirai Momoyama and Emo Moegi are two aspiring idols who decide to use the "Pri☆Chan System," a system used by famous people and companies to broadcast content. Like many girls starting their own channels and uploading content, the pair decide to become their own producers, starting their own channel in an attempt to become Pri☆Chan idols.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers find the show enjoyable due to its cute themes and idol performances. However, others are critical of the repetitive storylines, shallow characters, and lack of significant character development, leading to a sense of wasted potential.
pros: Enjoyable for those interested in shows for young girls.
Potential for character depth (though not fully realized).
cons: Repetitive storylines and lack of evolution.
Characters often portrayed as silly and lacking depth.
Inconsistent focus on hard work and training.
Annoying catchphrases.

anime.title: The Legend of Jade Sword
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Fate had never been kind to Ji Ning. Wracked by illnesses and infirm his entire life on Earth, Ning knew early on that he would die as a teenager. What he didn’t know was that there really was such a thing as life after death, and that the universe was a far larger place than he thought. A lucky twist of fate (one of the few in Ning’s life) meant that Ning was reborn into a world of Immortals and monsters, of Ki Refiners and powerful Fiendgods, a world where Dynasties lasted for millions of years. A world which is both greater and yet also smaller than he ever could imagine. He would have the opportunity to join them, and in this life, Ning swore to himself, he would never let himself be weak again! The Era he was born into was a Desolate one, but Ning would make it his era.
anime.consensus_summary: The adaptation is considered a poor representation of the source material. Fans of the webnovel are highly critical of the changes made in the adaptation, stating that it barely resembles the original story despite sharing names and a general concept. The recommendation is to read the webnovel instead.
cons: Poor adaptation of source material
Disingenuous to the webnovel

anime.title: Crossing Time
anime.synopsis:
Every day, all kinds of different people stop at railroad crossings on their way to work or school, resulting in all sorts of different conversations. Friends, enemies, acquaintances, and complete strangers—there's always a new encounter to be had.

Fumikiri Jikan documents the discussions that take place at these locations. Whether these are funny or depressing, expected or completely unexpected, they certainly have the potential to be quite interesting.
anime.consensus_summary: Fumikiri Jikan is a charming, short anime that offers glimpses into the lives of people waiting at a railroad crossing. While some episodes are well-executed and enjoyable, others fall short due to inconsistent quality and a lack of depth. Overall, it's a lighthearted watch, but individual enjoyment may vary depending on the episode.
pros: Good use of limited runtime, maximizing content within each episode.
Entertaining interactions between characters, creating engaging slice-of-life scenes.
Voice acting is well-done, enhancing the dialogue-driven nature of the short.
cons: Inconsistent quality between episodes, with some being boring or uncomfortable.
Lack of depth due to the short episode length, preventing exploration beyond the surface.
Some potentially creepy or awkward content, like a guy staring at a girl.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Romantic Comedy, Vignette

anime.title: Radiant
anime.synopsis:
Nemeses—powerful and mysterious demonic entities that fall from the sky and vaporize anything they touch. The only ones who can combat these creatures are Sorcerers, those who have survived an encounter with a Nemesis but were infected in the process.

Seth, a Sorcerer from Pompo Hills, sets out on an adventure to exterminate all these Nemeses. Accompanying him are Doc and Mélie, fellow Sorcerers who share his ideal. Their main objective is to bring about a world where Sorcerers are no longer persecuted for being infected, and to that end, desire to destroy the source of the Nemeses themselves: the mythical Radiant.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Radiant are mixed. Some viewers appreciate the character development, social commentary, and the surprising depth that emerges in the second half. Others are critical of the slow pacing, generic shonen elements, and issues with the adaptation, leading to a polarized response.
pros: Good character building and storytelling, relatable and full of surprises.
Addresses social issues like racism, hate, and PTSD.
Second half is intense and improves the show significantly.
Unique for being an adaptation of a French manga (manfra).
cons: Slow paced, especially in the beginning, with filler content.
Generic shonen premise with a typical loud protagonist.
Comedy is cringy and ruins the pacing in serious situations.
Inconsistent adaptation quality with changes to tone and characters.
Uneven pacing with slow character introductions and rushed impactful scenes.

anime.title: Aikatsu Friends!
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Aine Yuuki, who is a regular student at Star Harmony Academy's normal division, meets Mio Minato from the idol division, who invites her to join Aikatsu to fulfill Aine's goal to make friends. She also befriends Maika Chōno and Ema Hinata who are also idols. Aine and Mio form a pair to become best friends to become the bright "Diamond Friends". Karen Kamishiro and Mirai Asuku are categorized as "Diamond Friends" and are in the Diamond Class!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience appreciates the unique characters and their development throughout the series. The positive energy and focus on friendship are well-received. The only minor critique is about the initial song quality due to the voice actresses also being singers.
pros: Unique characters with realistic arcs
Positive, girl-power competitive energy
Voice and Song actresses are the same people
cons: Earlier songs are a little rough around the edges

anime.title: Anima Yell!
anime.genres: CGDCT, Comedy, Performing Arts, School, Sports
anime.synopsis:
Kohane Hatoya's most lovable trait is also her greatest flaw. She loves to help others no matter how far she has to go in order to get the job done. Her biggest inspiration to do so comes to light when she sees what cheerleading looks like for the first time in middle school. Now a highschooler but as enthusiastic as ever, Kohane wants nothing more than to start her very own cheerleading squad. She is encouraged by her best friend, Uki Sawatari, who often has to help her get out of trouble.

There is just one problem: Kohane does not have any experience in cheerleading. She has absolutely no idea what to do, what to wear, or how to perform. To make matters worse, she has been scared of heights since childhood, and this new sport is full of stunts pulled far from the ground for a girl her size. Enter Hizume Arima, a former cheerleader who wishes to leave her pastime behind. Unfortunately for her, Kohane recognizes Hizume, and will stop at nothing just so she can lead the new squad, even if it means facing her childhood fear.
anime.consensus_summary: Anima Yell! is a feel-good, slice-of-life anime that delivers exactly what it promises: cute girls enthusiastically engaging in cheerleading. While the story and characters may not be groundbreaking, the show's charm and humor make it an enjoyable watch for fans of the CGDCT genre. The series is generally well-received for its lighthearted nature and positive energy.
pros: The show's energy and enthusiasm are infectious, making it fun and cheerful.
The characters are likable, with cute designs and enjoyable interactions.
The series is lighthearted and engaging, striking a good balance with humor.
cons: The plot is basic and doesn't offer much depth or complexity.
Characters fit into common archetypes and lack uniqueness.
The storyline can feel disjointed, with unclear goals at times.

anime.title: The Master of Diabolism
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Mystery, Mythology, Reincarnation
anime.synopsis:
Xian: the state of immortality that all cultivators strive to achieve. However, there is a dark energy that lies underneath—the forbidden Mo Dao, or demonic path. Through an unfortunate series of tragedies, this is the path that cultivator Wei Wuxian experiments with during his teachings. His rise in power is accompanied by chaos and destruction, but his reign of terror comes to an abrupt end when the cultivation clans overpower him and he is killed by his closest ally.

Thirteen years later, Wei Wuxian is reincarnated in the body of a lunatic and reunited with Lan Wangji, a former classmate of his. This marks the beginning of a supernatural mystery that plagues the clans and threatens to disrupt their everyday life.

Mo Dao Zu Shi follows these two men on their mission to unravel the mysteries of the spiritual world. Fighting demons, ghosts, and even other cultivators, the two end up forming a bond that neither of them had ever expected.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely captivated by Mo Dao Zu Shi's stunning visuals, immersive world-building, and well-developed characters. However, some viewers find the initial plot confusing and the pacing slow due to extensive flashbacks. Overall, the series is praised for its artistic portrayal of ancient China and its engaging blend of action, adventure, and fantasy.
pros: Breathtaking visuals and animation quality, especially the backgrounds depicting ancient China.
Well-developed characters with distinguishable personas enhanced by great voice acting.
Engaging plot with action, adventure, and fantasy elements that create an immersive experience.
cons: Confusing initial plot, particularly for viewers unfamiliar with the novel or manhua.
Slow pacing due to extensive flashbacks, which can hinder plot progression.
Some feel the adaptation misses key elements from the source material

anime.title: The Beauty Blogger
anime.synopsis: A beauty blogger has been sent to a VR reality game, where she has to stand firm in a catfight in boudoir. But how so? She is given numerous cosmetic products that she can arm herself up with. Based on the popular online novel published on the famous female-oriented online novel website "Jinjiang", this animation is strongly recommended to those who love all kinds of cosmetics.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys 'Sheng Shi Zhuang Niang' for its romance and makeup content, finding the characters cute and the visuals appealing. However, many are disappointed by the rushed and confusing ending, as well as a decline in plot quality. While some initially found the animation style strange, most grew to appreciate it.
pros: Cute character designs and visually appealing aesthetics.
Informative makeup tips and tutorials integrated into the story.
Wholesome and feel-good romance elements.
cons: Plot quality diminishes towards the end, featuring plot twists and holes.
Rushed and confusing ending with unresolved issues.
Story strays away from the makeup theme in later episodes.

anime.title: How Not to Summon a Demon Lord
anime.romaji_title: Isekai Maou to Shoukan Shoujo no Dorei Majutsu
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Romance
anime.synopsis:
When it comes to the fantasy MMORPG Cross Reverie, none can match the power of the Demon King Diablo. Possessing the game's rarest artifacts and an unrivaled player level, he overpowers all foolish enough to confront him. But despite his fearsome reputation, Diablo's true identity is Takuma Sakamoto, a shut-in gamer devoid of any social skills. Defeating hopeless challengers day by day, Takuma cares about nothing else but his virtual life—that is, until a summoning spell suddenly transports him to another world where he has Diablo's appearance! 

In this new world resembling his favorite game, Takuma is greeted by the two girls who summoned him: Rem Galeu, a petite Pantherian adventurer, and Shera L. Greenwood, a busty Elf summoner. They perform an Enslavement Ritual in an attempt to subjugate him, but the spell backfires and causes them to become his slaves instead. With the situation now becoming more awkward than ever, Takuma decides to accompany the girls in finding a way to unbind their contract while learning to adapt to his new existence as the menacing Demon King.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some enjoying the series as a fun, lighthearted ecchi isekai, while others criticize it for its unoriginal plot, reliance on fan service, and shallow characters. Some appreciate the protagonist's comedic awkwardness, but overall, the show is seen as a generic isekai that doesn't push any boundaries. The series is primarily enjoyed by those who are fans of the ecchi and harem genres and are willing to overlook the story's shortcomings.
pros: Enjoyable mix of comedy, action, and fan service.
Some viewers found the story unpredictable and refreshing compared to other isekai anime.
The protagonist's social awkwardness and attempts to role-play as a demon lord are comedic.
Some of the art and animation are above average.
Some found Diablo's character to be well-written and relatable due to his social awkwardness and inner thoughts.
cons: Heavily reliant on fan service, which some viewers found excessive and detrimental to the story.
Many reviewers consider the plot unoriginal, generic, and filled with clichés common to the isekai genre.
Several reviewers criticized the characters as being one-dimensional, uninspired, and stereotypical.
Some viewers felt the story lacked depth and emotional investment.
Some reviewers found the humor to be unfunny or repetitive.

anime.title: Release the Spyce
anime.synopsis:
Momo Minamoto is a shy teenager who simply wants to do good in the world. Her dream is to follow in her police officer father's footsteps and support law and order. And just like him, she has a very unique ability: her senses are much more refined than those of any average person. A simple lick will enable her to determine what someone is feeling.

One night, as she admires the landscape, Momo sees suspicious shades moving in the distance. After learning that those shades were spies, she is recruited by their captain Yuki Hanzoumon, a senior at her school. The members of their secret agency, called the Tsukikage, also have the power to gain strength after ingesting spices.

Release the Spyce is an action-packed spy series about the Tsukikage's missions as they fight in the shadows to protect the city from crime while keeping up with their high school life.
anime.consensus_summary: Release the Spyce is a spy anime with cute girls that offers an enjoyable viewing experience, despite some predictable plot elements. Viewers appreciate the action scenes, character interactions, and surprising twists, though some find the characters simplistic and the plot inconsistent. The show is considered underrated by some, but is also seen as a fun, light-hearted series.
pros: Enjoyable action scenes and animation.
Interesting and likeable characters.
Surprising twists and emotional moments.
Good pacing with a well-constructed story.
cons: Predictable plot and spy tropes.
Simple characters with single dominant traits.
Lazy animation in later episodes.
Villain with a weak or non-existent motive.
Inconsistent tone.
anime.thematic_vibe: Spy Thriller, Cute Girls Doing Cute Things, Mentor-Pupil

anime.title: Merc Storia: The Apathetic Boy and the Girl in a Bottle
anime.romaji_title: Merc Storia: Mukiryoku no Shounen to Bin no Naka no Shoujo
anime.synopsis: Merc Storia takes places in a world where humans and monsters coexist. The protagonist, Yuu, is a healer apprentice and possesses the ability to tame monsters. In a quest to regain the memories of Merc, a girl confined in a bottle, the pair embarks on a journey.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Merc Storia' to be a relaxing and heartwarming anime with meaningful episodic stories and beautiful art. While some criticize the simple plots, one-dimensional characters, and inconsistent animation, many appreciate its lighthearted nature and the moral lessons it offers. The anime is best enjoyed as a casual and comforting experience, making it easily overlooked for its simple themes.
pros: Calming and relaxing to watch
Meaningful stories with moral lessons
Beautiful backgrounds and music
Enjoyable characters and voice acting
cons: Episodic format may become redundant
Simple plots and one-dimensional characters
Inconsistent animation
Overstuffed episodes with rushed writing

anime.title: Gundam Build Divers
anime.synopsis:
Gunpla Battle Nexus Online (GBN) is a new network game that lets people enjoy a variety of missions using Gunpla in a virtual cyberspace dimension. Middle-school students Riku Mikami and Yukio Hidaka recruit their classmate Momoka Yashiro and dive together into this vast world. Becoming "Divers," or inhabitants of GBN, they meet a mysterious girl named Sarah who has an amazing sensitivity to Gunpla. They begin playing alongside her, but...

There are many other famous Divers, starting with Kyoya Kujo, the champion whom Riku admires. Multiple Divers can join to form a team called a "force." Meanwhile, the game is disrupted by Mass-Divers who use unofficial tools called break decals. Through many encounters and experiences, Riku and his friends will build not only Gunpla, but their own adventures as well!
anime.consensus_summary: Gundam Build Divers receives mixed reactions, praised for its lighthearted take on the franchise, virtual world setting, and references to past Gundam series. However, it's criticized for its weak characters, predictable plot, and lack of narrative tension due to its virtual reality setting. While some find it enjoyable as a casual Gundam experience, others are disappointed by its lack of depth and stakes.
pros: Enjoyable for casual Gundam fans and newcomers.
Interesting concept of a Gundam MMO.
Varied and interesting battles within the game world.
Good character designs and animation quality.
Nostalgic references to past Gundam series.
cons: Weak and generic main characters, especially Riku and Sarah.
Lack of tension and stakes due to the game setting.
Predictable and basic storyline, particularly in the second half.
Inconsistent world-building within the GBN setting.
Over-reliance on plot armor and convenient power-ups.

anime.title: Gundam Build Divers Prologue
anime.synopsis: The Gunpla Force Battle Tournament is a big event held in GBN once per year. Competing in the final round are Avalon, led by the champion Kyoya Kujo, and the elite 7th Panzer Division led by the cunning Rommel. Starting with Kyoya's Gundam AGE II Magnum, a variety of Gunpla take to the field to determine which is the strongest force!
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Gundam Build Divers Prologue' is visually impressive and action-packed but lacks substance. The narrative is weak, and characters are underdeveloped, making it feel more like a tech demo than a meaningful prologue. Overall, it's an inoffensive but ultimately skippable animation showcase.
pros: Impressive visuals and new Gundam designs.
Flashy, destructive, and fun battles with a grander scale.
cons: Weak narrative; feels like a demo or exhibition rather than a prologue.
Underdeveloped characters; fails to explain new elements like anthropomorphized animals.
Unremarkable music; lacks new tracks of note.
Feels pointless to watch.

anime.title: Last Period: The Journey to the End of the Despair
anime.romaji_title: Last Period: Owarinaki Rasen no Monogatari
anime.synopsis: "Period" is how magic users called who beat "Spiral"—monsters that were summoned from isolation. Due to the rise of these beings, 14-year-old apprentice Period Haru, who is a part of the Eighth Arc-end Division, is called to break the cycle and cast himself into the endless battle. However, a mysterious thievery occurred and sank the division into bankruptcy, forcing Haru and his other comrades have to leave their headquarters. To rebuild a branch, they have to overcome quest after quest.
anime.consensus_summary: Last Period is a comedy anime that heavily parodies gacha games and JRPG tropes. While praised for its humor, meta-references, and character designs, it's criticized for its weak plot, inconsistent jokes, and lack of character depth. The audience is divided, with some finding it hilarious and others considering it mediocre or irritating.
pros: Excellent comedy with well-timed jokes and references.
Likeable characters with great character designs.
Strong meta-humor and fourth-wall breaking.
Good use of gacha game mechanics for comedic effect.
Voice acting and character designs are appreciated
cons: Weak or predictable plot.
Inconsistent humor with some jokes missing the mark.
Lack of character depth and development.
Repetitive scenarios and overused gags.
Unresolved plot points and unsatisfying ending.

anime.title: You Don't Know Gunma Yet
anime.romaji_title: Omae wa Mada Gunma wo Shiranai
anime.synopsis:
Nori Kamitsuki has recently moved to the Gunma prefecture from Chiba, following after Otoya Todoroki, a former friend who moved there in elementary school. While on the way there, he receives an ominous text message from Todoroki telling him to turn back and that once someone enters Gunma, they never return.

Ignoring the message, As Kamitsuki goes about his school life and makes new friends. These people make it their mission to prove any negative stereotypes surrounding Gunma wrong and show Kamitsuki all the ways Gunma is different from the rest of Japan—from its local foods and landmarks, the changes to its daily school life, and even the attitude of the people who live there. Gunma is widely regarded as the least popular prefecture in Japan, but they clearly don't know Gunma yet!
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is primarily seen as a promotional piece for Gunma prefecture, with mixed reactions. Some appreciate its informative and humorous approach to showcasing local culture. However, others find it boring, lacking in plot and character development, and too reliant on cultural references. Ultimately, it is considered a forgettable short anime that may only appeal to a niche audience interested in Japanese regional culture.
pros: Informative about Gunma prefecture's culture and local aspects.
Appeals to viewers interested in Japanese local culture.
cons: Lacks a complex plot and character development.
Relies heavily on cultural knowledge, making jokes fall flat for some viewers.
Animation quality is mediocre.
Feels like an advertisement or lecture rather than engaging entertainment.

anime.title: Hanebado!
anime.synopsis:
After her crushing defeat of 21-0 at the National Junior Badminton Tournament, Nagisa Aragaki's love for her sport begins to distort. Unable to deal with the shame of loss, she starts to terrorize the members of her high school badminton club. Her grueling drills bring some to the verge of tears while others quit the club outright. With the team losing members and new prospects being too terrified to join, the future of the badminton club looks exceptionally grim.

That is, until Kentarou Tachibana joins as the new head coach. Not only is he an Olympic-level player, but he also comes bearing a secret weapon: Ayano Hanesaki, the girl who defeated Nagisa six months ago. However, Ayano is not the rival Nagisa remembers, but a girl with conflicted feelings wanting to distance herself from badminton. With her future in sports now on the line, Nagisa must find a way to face her fears of inadequacy, heal her rival's troubled heart, and bring victory to Kitakomachi High School's badminton club.
anime.consensus_summary: Hanebado! is a highly divisive sports anime praised for its animation and realistic badminton play, but heavily criticized for its overly dramatic narrative, inconsistent characters, and deviation from the source material. Many viewers found the characters unlikeable and the plot frustrating, leading to a polarized reception. Some appreciate the exploration of psychological issues, while others find it toxic and melodramatic.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style, particularly during matches.
Realistic portrayal of badminton gameplay compared to other sports anime.
Exploration of psychological consequences and personal issues faced by young athletes.
cons: Overly dramatic and toxic portrayal of sports, deviating from enjoyment and sportsmanship.
Inconsistent character writing and unlikeable characters, especially Ayano and her mother.
Plot issues and failure to develop characters in a meaningful way, particularly side characters.
Adaptation strays too far from the source material.

anime.title: Z/X: Code Reunion
anime.synopsis: The signing of a peace treaty has secured a tenuous ceasefire between mankind and the Zex, beings who emerged from space/time rifts connected to mysterious, distant worlds. Partnered with a Zex named Rigel, Azumi Kakamigahara must shoulder the fate of her own idyllic world. The unlikely pair head to newly established Fujimisaki Academy, where their destinies await.
anime.consensus_summary: Z/X Code Reunion is a typical moe anime that relies on friendship themes and yuri undertones. The retcon of the main character from the previous season is a significant point of contention for viewers. While some appreciate the character designs and voice acting, the lack of character development for the new cast and animation shortcuts are commonly criticized.
pros: Decent character designs.
Voice acting is generally well-received, especially Azumi and Ena.
cons: Retcon of Azumi's character from the first season.
Slim to nil development of new core cast characters.
Animation shortcuts and occasional derps.
Placement of this season in relation to Z/X Ignition is confusing.

anime.title: Beyblade Burst Turbo
anime.synopsis: Two years after the God Blader's Cup, Valt Aoi battles Aiga Akaba, a "wild child" that grew up in nature. After battling, he became inspired to become the No.1 Blader in the world, along with his Beyblade, Z Achilles. He aims to fight strong opponents in an effort to become stronger himself. To defeat Valt Aoi and become the World Champion, Aiga begins his journey.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Beyblade Burst Chouzetsu. Some appreciate the focused narrative on Aiga's development and its adherence to franchise values, praising it as a standout season. However, others criticize the lack of story depth, emotional complexity, and the underrepresentation of female characters, leading to concerns about the series' direction.
pros: Aiga's character development is amazing and his lovable qualities are maintained.
The season is very focused on Aiga and his quest.
Understands the essence and value of the Beyblade franchise.
cons: Lacks story development and emotional complexity.
Beyblade is becoming a boys-only toy, with female characters having minimal presence and storyline impact.
Suffers from pacing and power level issues.
anime.thematic_vibe: Character Development, Rise to Power, Nostalgia

anime.title: Non-Human
anime.synopsis: Jiu Yue is a nine-tailed fox spirit who is more than two centuries old. She faces her hardest challenge yet: trying to adapt to the modern world. Knowing she needs money to survive, she starts working at a company—only to realize her coworkers are just as mythical as her! As Jiu Yue and her new friends attempt to fit in, their non-human sides make even the most trivial situations take a ridiculous turn.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Fei Ren Zai for its creative blend of Chinese mythology and modern slice-of-life humor. Viewers appreciate the show's respectful portrayal of Chinese culture and its engaging characters. Some note the animation style may be limited and cultural context might be lost on some viewers, but overall the show is well-received as a lighthearted and fun experience.
pros: Fun and imaginative take on ancient tales
Smooth animation despite minimalistic style
Respectful and accurate portrayal of Chinese culture and mythology
Enjoyable and well-developed characters
cons: Animation style may seem lacking due to budget constraints
Western viewers may not fully understand cultural context/backstory

anime.title: Kemurikusa (TV)
anime.synopsis:
A few young girls with strange powers and a tree that has grown through a railcar cling onto life in a desolate land, searching for its last reservoirs of water. Their routine struggle to survive is interrupted by the arrival of Wakaba, a boy with no memory beyond his own name. 

The girls and their new companion commit to a perilous journey across seas of burning red fog—all in order to find what they need to sustain themselves on the more distant, dangerous islands swarming with robotic bugs. Their ultimate fate will be decided by their own strength, along with Wakaba's curious ability to understand the Kemurikusa: mysterious glowing leaves with wondrous powers. Besides the girls, Wakaba, and the hordes of ravenous bugs, the Kemurikusa are the last sparks of life surviving in this land. How did things end up this way? Why are there so many empty buildings with no one to live in them? Wakaba and the girls lack the answers to these questions, which means the truth can only be found within the Kemurikusa.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the show is praised for its unique story, world-building, and endearing characters, many are turned off by the low-quality CGI animation and slow start. The overall consensus is that if one can overlook the visual shortcomings, 'Kemurikusa' offers an engaging and ultimately satisfying viewing experience, and that the world details are explained well.
pros: Unique and engrossing story with a satisfying conclusion.
Creative world-building and interesting use of visual medium.
Endearing characters with well-defined relationships, especially the sisters.
The plot has inherent mystery that we unravel along with Wakaba
cons: Visually flawed, with rough CGI animation and noticeable mistakes.
Characters can be trope-y and sometimes annoying.
Slow start; great parts backloaded making it hard to get into initially.
Pacing issues with occasional boredom due to repetitive scenes.

anime.title: K: SEVEN STORIES "SIDE:BLUE - Sirius - "
anime.romaji_title: K: Seven Stories Movie 2 - Side:Blue - Tenrou no Gotoku
anime.synopsis: Gouki Zenjo, former right-hand man to Jin Habari and a survivor of the Kagutsu Incident, returns to work for SCEPTER 4, now under the command of Reisi Munakata, the new Blue King.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie explores the origins of SCEPTER 4 but falls short of the original series' charm and depth. While the art and sound are commendable, the storyline and character development are considered weaker. Overall, it's viewed as a decent anime but not exceptional.
pros: Good art style, consistent with the original series.
Sound and music are on par with the original, with returning tracks.
cons: Story lacks the charm and mystery of the original series.
Story depth is lacking, making tragic moments feel lackluster.
Character arcs are somewhat lame and lack depth.

anime.title: K: SEVEN STORIES "Lost Small World - Outside the Cage - "
anime.romaji_title: K: Seven Stories Movie 4 - Lost Small World - Ori no Mukou ni
anime.synopsis: Misaki Yata is a youth whose reckless and immature attitude has led him to be shunned by his classmates. Saruhiko Fushimi is a loner who views the world in a pessimistic way. Despite being polar opposites, the two become the best of friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, particularly among existing fans of the K franchise. Viewers appreciated the in-depth exploration of Yata and Fushimi's bond, the beautiful animation, and the effective use of music. Some had minor issues with a new character, but overall, the movie is considered a highlight within the K series.
pros: Beautiful animation and soundtrack.
Heartfelt exploration of Yata and Fushimi's relationship.
Well-executed backstory that enhances existing lore.
cons: New character introduced in the movie was not that great.

anime.title: K: SEVEN STORIES "Memory of RED - BURN -"
anime.romaji_title: K: Seven Stories Movie 5 - Memory of Red - Burn
anime.synopsis: It is the beginning of December. Anna Kushina's birthday is coming up, so the boys of HOMRA decide to celebrate by preparing a surprise party for their little princess.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience feels this installment provides the emotional core missing from the original series, particularly regarding Totsuka's death and the bonds within HOMRA. It deepens the viewer's understanding of the characters' motivations and pain, making the revenge plot more impactful. The consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with many expressing strong emotional reactions.
pros: Emotional depth and payoff not present in the original series.
Beautiful and heartfelt depiction of character relationships.
Provides crucial context for the motivations of the HOMRA clan.
cons: The original series started in the wrong place; this movie should have been the beginning.

anime.title: K: SEVEN STORIES "Circle Vision - Nameless Song - "
anime.romaji_title: K: Seven Stories Movie 6 - Circle Vision - Nameless Song
anime.synopsis: Adolf K. Weismann is sharing a peaceful meal with his loved ones, but as the days go by, some begin to realize that this perfect world where everyone is alive and happy seems too good to be true.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience expresses a bittersweet sentiment due to the storyline. It is recommended that the viewer have in depth knowledge of the K universe before viewing. The movie is generally well-received, especially by fans of the Green and Silver clans.
pros: Good for Green and Silver clan fans
Recycled tropes are used in a new way
cons: Requires deep prior knowledge of K universe

anime.title: Youkai Watch: Shadow Side
anime.synopsis: Taking place after the events of the fourth film, the series centers on 11 yr old Keisuke Amano, Natsume's younger brother (both of whom are the children of Keita Amano and Fumika Kodama of the original Youkai Watch anime) who doesn't believe in any supernatural phenomenon around him. But as he notices his sister is frequently comes back home late, he decided to stalk her, only to find out she is doing her duties exorcising evil Youkai alongside her friends Touma and Akinori, and running a Yo-Kai detective agency. With their secret revealed to him, Natsume decided to let him tag along in her activities as they investigate Youkai crimes and take on evil Youkai to maintain peace all over the city.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is considered a strong adaptation of the franchise with well-executed ideas, particularly in the plot-driven episodes. However, it suffers from blandness and irrelevant filler content, leaving viewers feeling that character stories are underdeveloped. It is recommended for existing Yo-Kai Watch fans, though its flaws are noticeable.
pros: Best adaptation of the Yo-Kai Watch franchise concepts.
Excellent execution of ideas.
Good plot chapters.
cons: Feels bland despite good ideas and execution.
Filler chapters are mostly irrelevant.
Character stories feel incomplete.

anime.title: Mr. Tonegawa: Middle Management Blues
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Drama, Parody, Psychological, Seinen, Workplace
anime.synopsis: Chuukan Kanriroku Tonegawa is a spin-off of the Kaiji series, which follows Tonegawa, the right hand man of Kazutaka Hyoudou, the president of the Teiai Corporation and owner of numerous gambling tournaments. After Hyoudou is getting bored with his life, he orders Tonegawa to organize a so called "game of death" as it is his and his subordinate's job to keep the president in a good mood. Tonegawa must cooperate with his subordinates in order to make the president happy and what follows is a humorous story of his interactions with his subordinates and other characters of the Kaiji series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Chuukan Kanriroku Tonegawa as a humorous and creative spin-off that cleverly satirizes the original Kaiji series. While some find certain aspects repetitive or shallow, the overall consensus is positive, praising the show's originality, character development, and engaging stories. It is appreciated as a lighthearted take on the darker themes of Kaiji.
pros: Original and refreshing humor
Well-developed characters, especially Tonegawa
Engaging and creative stories
Good parody of the Kaiji series
cons: Some episodes feel disposable or weaker than others
References Kaiji too much
Narrator can be overbearing
Not fulfilling for those seeking deep exploration of the organization

anime.title: Laid-Back Camp Specials
anime.synopsis:
When Chiaki Oogaki and Aoi Inuyama start the Outdoor Activities Club at their school, it is only the two of them and an array of ambitious plans. Things do not change much even after a new member—Nadeshiko Kagamihara—joins. And yet, the cheerful, cozy atmosphere seems to bring many curious visitors to their small headquarters. 

As the three girls set out on a camping trip to Australia alongside their friends Rin Shima and Ena Saitou, an unexpected incident turns the relaxing event into quite an adventure.
anime.consensus_summary: The Yuru Camp△ Specials are generally well-received as a fun and relaxing addition to the main series. Most viewers find the specials enjoyable due to their cozy atmosphere, cute comedy, and the interactions between the characters. While some episodes are shorter or less impactful, the overall consensus is positive, making it a worthwhile watch for fans of the original anime.
pros: Relaxing atmosphere and joyful feel
Cute comedy and funny jokes
Enjoyable characters and interactions
Good production values and art style similar to the main series
cons: Some episodes are short and don't add much
Pacing can be uneven
Not all jokes land

anime.title: Plunderer
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Fantasy, Military, Romance, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Alcia is a world governed by "Count": numbers engraved on a person's body, representing any number related to their life. These Counts determine a person's social status and power in Alcia. If a Count reaches zero, the person is sent to the Abyss, a place rumored to be worse than death.

Hina, a traveler whose Count is based on the distance she traveled, witnessed her mother get dragged down into the Abyss. Determined to fulfill her mother's last wishes, she sets off on a journey in search of the legendary Aces—heroes of the war that happened three hundred years ago, bearing a white star next to their Count.

While wandering around, Hina encounters Licht Bach, a mysterious masked man with negative Count, and Nana, the owner of a tavern. In the midst of having a good time, Hina is tricked into a battle with a military soldier. However, despite his negative count, Licht rescues Hina and reveals that he has another count, one with a white star, one of a legendary Ace.

Plunderer follows the journey of Hina and other inhabitants of Alcia as they discover the truth about their world, the Abyss, and the legendary Aces.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reaction to Plunderer is highly divided. While some appreciate the initial concept and world-building, many are turned off by the excessive fan service, poor pacing, and weak execution. The show is criticized for failing to live up to its potential, resulting in a generally negative reception, with some viewers finding entertainment in its flaws.
pros: Interesting world concept with the 'Count' system.
Some viewers found the story enjoyable despite its flaws, especially in the second half.
Decent character designs.
cons: Excessive and often inappropriate fan service/sexual harassment.
Poor pacing, especially in the first half, with too much filler.
Underdeveloped characters and plot points.
Inconsistent tone and jarring shifts between serious and comedic moments.
Mediocre animation quality, especially during fight scenes.
Plot holes and illogical story elements.
Uninspired music and voice acting.

anime.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? II
anime.romaji_title: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka II
anime.synopsis:
It is business as usual in the massive city of Orario, where legions of adventurers gather to explore the monster-infested "Dungeon." Among them is the easily flustered yet brave Bell Cranel, the sole member of the Hestia Familia. With the help of his demi-human supporter Liliruca Arde and competent blacksmith Welf Crozzo, Bell has earned the title of Little Rookie by becoming Orario's fastest-growing adventurer thanks to his endeavors within the deeper levels of the Dungeon.

Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka II continues Bell's adventures as he tries to bring glory to his goddess and protect those he cares about. However, various familias and gods across the city begin to take notice of his achievements and attempt to add him to their ranks.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 of DanMachi has divided its audience, with some viewers appreciating the character development and world-building, while others criticize the repetitive story arcs, rushed storytelling, and outdated animation. Many feel the season doesn't live up to the first, with some finding it entertaining and others considering it a disappointment. Ultimately, the season's success seems to depend on individual expectations and tolerance for its flaws.
pros: Solid character development of new and old characters
Growing world-building
Fights are well-animated
Good sound design
cons: Repetitive story arcs
Poor execution of anime tropes
Rushed storytelling
Lackluster conflicts
Outdated animation

anime.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?: Arrow of the Orion
anime.romaji_title: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka Movie: Orion no Ya
anime.synopsis:
Continuing his adventure to get stronger in order to traverse deeper into the "Dungeon," Bell Cranel wanders the Orario city streets with his friends and the goddess Hestia. That evening, the city is filled with stalls and games as it celebrates the Holy Moon Festival.

Hermes, a god, hosts one such activity where participants are asked to pull a spear embedded in a crystal boulder; those who succeed will receive a special gift: a trip around the world and a divine blessing from the gods! Bell and his merry group challenge one another to claim the prize. But behind the facade of an innocent party game lies a preface for a daring quest ahead.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some fans of the DanMachi franchise enjoyed the movie, particularly the introduction of Artemis. However, many found the plot generic, rushed, and nonsensical, with weak character development and uninspired animation. The movie is generally considered a skippable filler, especially for those not already invested in the series.
pros: Animation quality is good with better art.
Soundtrack is high quality.
Some found the story amazing.
cons: Story is unoriginal, predictable and generic
Plot is nonsensical and rushed, with a weak conclusion.
Characters are generic and lack depth; relationships feel shallow.
Pacing issues, with wasted screen time on bloated exposition and languid action sequences.
Fight scenes are not impressive, with uninspired animation and a reliance on CGI.

anime.title: Goblin Slayer
anime.synopsis:
Goblins are known for their ferocity, cunning, and rapid reproduction, but their reputation as the lowliest of monsters causes their threat to be overlooked. Raiding rural civilizations to kidnap females of other species for breeding, these vile creatures are free to continue their onslaught as adventurers turn a blind eye in favor of more rewarding assignments with larger bounties.

To commemorate her first day as a Porcelain-ranked adventurer, the 15-year-old Priestess joins a band of young, enthusiastic rookies to investigate a tribe of goblins responsible for the disappearance of several village women. Unprepared and inexperienced, the group soon faces its inevitable demise from an ambush while exploring a cave. With no one else left standing, the terrified Priestess accepts her fate—until the Goblin Slayer unexpectedly appears to not only rescue her with little effort, but destroy the entire goblin nest. 

As a holder of the prestigious Silver rank, the Goblin Slayer allows her to accompany him as he assists the Adventurer's Guild in all goblin-related matters. Together with the Priestess, High Elf, Dwarf, and Lizardman, the armored warrior will not rest until every single goblin in the frontier lands has been eradicated for good.
anime.consensus_summary: Goblin Slayer is a controversial anime due to its graphic violence, particularly in the first episode, which sparked intense debate. Some viewers appreciate its dark fantasy elements and adherence to D&D tropes, while others criticize its reliance on shock value and uninspired characters. The initial controversy significantly impacted the overall perception of the series.
pros: Unique concept of a character dedicated solely to goblin slaying.
Accurate representation of a D&D campaign.
Action packed.
cons: Horrible CGI.
Bland characters.
Over reliance on shock value.
Initial controversy overshadows the rest of the show.

anime.title: Blood Blockade Battlefront & Beyond OVA
anime.romaji_title: Kekkai Sensen & Beyond: Zapp Renfro Ingaouhouchuu!!/Baccardio no Shizuku
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Shounen, Super Power, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the 5th volume of the Kekkai Sensen: Back 2 Back manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted, comedic side story that doesn't take itself too seriously.
