Unfulfilled potential for a full adaptation
Disappointment of not being a real anime series
Lack of substance for non-fans

anime.title: Free! Movie 1: Timeless Medley - Kizuna - Character Butai Aisatsu
anime.romaji_title: Free! Movie 1: Timeless Medley - Kizuna - Character Butai Aisatsu
anime.synopsis: Character Stage Greeting Manner Special's shown before main movie. Later included on the movie Blu-ray and DVD release.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is that this is a short, lighthearted promotional piece mainly designed for fan service. While it offers new visuals of the characters, it lacks meaningful story or character development. The content is considered more of a 'glorified picture drama' than a substantive addition to the Free! series.
pros: Provides new content featuring popular characters.
Offers visually appealing 'eye candy' with characters in posed photo shoots.
cons: Lacks substantial story or character development.
Content is very brief and primarily promotional.

anime.title: BanG Dream! 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
Kasumi Toyama and the members of Poppin'Party—their high school band—are now second-year students, but with the new school year comes their latest set of challenges: student council duties, cram school, and part-time jobs, among other things. Furthermore, they are now separated into different classes, and as a result, their free time together is shortened. Looking back, their joyful times together seem like nothing more than an unachievable fantasy when their members are too occupied to even gather in Arisa Ichigaya's basement for practice sessions. As the band ponders over the situation, an unfamiliar girl suddenly emerges, unknowingly pulling them into the spotlight once more.

In this rising era of girl bands, Afterglow, Pastel*Palettes, Roselia, and Hello, Happy World! begin to make their appearance as well. Each band, comprised of musicians with their unique personalities, illuminates the stage with its performances. As Poppin'Party returns to the music scene and encounters new friends, the sparkling, heart-pounding music starts to play once again!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to BanG Dream! 2nd Season is mixed, with some praising the improved animation and expanded focus on other bands, while others criticize the disjointed story and reliance on pre-existing knowledge. The season serves as a soft reboot, but new viewers may still feel lost. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on investment in the franchise and its characters.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to Season 1.
Introduction and development of multiple bands beyond Poppin'Party.
Engaging musical performances and songs.
Pacing of the story is fast.
cons: Story feels disjointed and lacks focus.
Requires prior knowledge of the franchise (game/Season 1) to fully appreciate.
Character development for side characters is lacking.
Over-reliance on CGI animation may not appeal to all viewers.
Some plotlines feel unnecessary or contrived.

anime.title: BanG Dream! 3rd Season
anime.synopsis:
As the all-girl band Poppin’Party continues to rise in fame, they find a poster for an event at the legendary Nippon Budoukan. Now determined to participate in the "BanG Dream," Kasumi Toyama and the other members of Poppin’Party aim to reach new heights and prove their worth by performing on that renowned stage.

Meanwhile, rival band RAISE A SUILEN dreams of changing the world with "the strongest music," but finds itself in dire straits without a guitarist. Though dozens of potential candidates audition for the role, band leader CHU² believes them to be amateurs and unsuitable for the band. However, there may be one guitarist that lives up to CHU²’s high standards.

BanG Dream! 3rd Season features multiple all-girl bands, including Poppin’Party, Afterglow, Pastel*Palettes, Roselia, Hello Happy World!, and now RAISE A SUILEN, as they work to astound fans throughout Japan with their spectacular performances. As the BanG Dream competition draws near, the band members are prepared to captivate audiences with their heartfelt music!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally agrees that Season 3 is a substantial improvement over previous seasons, particularly in its storytelling and character development, with a heavy focus on RAISE A SUILEN. While the animation style receives mixed feedback, the overall sentiment is positive, highlighting the series' ability to evoke emotion and inspire viewers. Most fans agree this season is the best of the franchise so far.
pros: Significant improvement in storytelling and animation compared to previous seasons.
Strong focus on character development, particularly for RAISE A SUILEN.
Music and performances are well-presented and enjoyable.
cons: Inconsistent animation style with jarring mixes of 2D and 3D.
Uneven focus on bands, with less spotlight on Afterglow, Pastel Palettes, and Hello Happy World.
Some find the storyline 'over the top'.

anime.title: BanG Dream! Garupa☆Pico
anime.synopsis: Mini anime series featuring the girls from Girls Band Party!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find 'BanG Dream! Garupa☆Pico' to be a hilarious and enjoyable short anime, perfect for a quick mood boost. Its absurdity and lightheartedness are praised, although some wish for longer episodes and more in-depth character development.
pros: Brightens mood with wacky characters and skits
Compact and full of laughs, good for killing time
Quickly introduces a large cast of characters in a fun way
cons: Short episodes leave viewers wanting more
Story is non-canon, so character development is minimal
Relies on references that may not be understood by all viewers

anime.title: Super Dragon Ball Heroes
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Shounen
anime.synopsis: In May 2018, V-Jump announced the promotional anime for Dragon Ball Heroes, a Japanese arcade and trading card game. The video game has been adapted to a Nintendo Switch port for western audiences, whilst the card game is released under the name "Dragon Ball Super TCG" and is combined with the other card game of the same name in japan. The anime is expected to be short and it is not expected to broadcast on TV. It has adapted the game's Prison Planet Arc, as long as the manga original arc "Big Bang Mission" and "Ultra God Misson", also fully detailed in the Heroes manga published in Saikyou Jump, although under 2 separate canons. They have never been published officially in English. The first episode debuted July 1, 2018 at Aeon Lake Town.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, largely dependent on viewer expectations. Those seeking a deep narrative or consistent power scaling are deeply disappointed, viewing it as a shallow, rushed promotional tool. However, hardcore fans who prioritize seeing dream match-ups and desired transformations find enjoyment, viewing it as official fanfiction despite its production flaws.
pros: Visually showcases desired character transformations and fusions that fans have clamored for.
Offers exciting fights and action sequences for those primarily interested in battles.
Appeals to hardcore Dragon Ball fans by bringing official, long-desired 'what if' scenarios to life.
Retains original voice actors, enhancing the authenticity for long-time fans.
cons: Extremely nonsensical and inconsistent power scaling that undermines any sense of stakes.
Shallow and underdeveloped plot that lacks coherent narrative progression.
Extremely short episode runtime (around 9 minutes) leads to rushed pacing and lack of development.
Animation quality can be poor, especially in later episodes or when attempting complex sequences.
Over-reliance on fan service can feel overwhelming and detract from any potential story elements.

anime.title: I'm Joybo OVA
anime.synopsis: Jiang Xiaobai has regained his memories, and Tong Li cannot bring herself to face him. Separately, they confront the truths left unsaid for 10 years—about the band September, to which Jiang Xiaobai and Mu Xiyu dedicated their youth; about the love triangle between Jiang Xiaobai, Mu Xiyu, and Tong Li; and about the painful circumstances that brought the trio together and ultimately led to the terrible tragedy that occurred on the day Tong Li left for America. At the end of it all, can Jiang Xiaobai and Tong Li accept the past and face the future together?
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA provides a satisfactory, albeit bittersweet, closure to the first season, answering key questions. The emotional impact is heightened by well-timed soundtracks.  While the ending leaves some wanting more, anticipation is building for the second season.
pros: Satisfactory and bittersweet ending.
Soundtracks timed perfectly to hit you at the right moment to alleviate the emotional scenes.
Addresses major unanswered questions.
cons: Leaves you wanting a bit more.
Qualms on how they want to take the new season.
Animation quality the same as the series, no surprises there.

anime.title: If My Favorite Pop Idol Made It to the Budokan, I Would Die
anime.genres: Comedy, Idols (Female), Music, Otaku Culture, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
After receiving a flyer from Maina Ichii—a member of the idol group ChamJam—and seeing her perform at a local concert, Eripiyo falls in love with Maina and decides to devote her life to supporting the shy and reserved rising star. Eripiyo's charismatic presence and iconic red tracksuit soon give her recognition as Maina's one and only unrivaled fan. 

Whether it be a performance or a small fan gathering in the middle of nowhere, Eripiyo is guaranteed to be at every event Maina participates in. Not even an injury or Maina's seemingly cold attitude toward her can stop Eripiyo from pursuing her dream of seeing her beloved idol perform at the world-famous arena Budoukan.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some appreciating the unique focus on idol fan culture and the bond between fans and idols, while others are critical of the obsessive behavior and potential glorification of unhealthy parasocial relationships. The show offers an interesting perspective but also raises concerns about its portrayal of otaku culture. Some also find the characters unlikeable and the plot unoriginal.
pros: Unique perspective focusing on the fans rather than the idols themselves.
Explores the bond and devotion between fans and idols.
Insightful look into otaku culture with some frightening realism.
Good art style and enjoyable characters (ChamJam)
Music is appropriate for an Idol genre.
cons: Can glorify the worst aspects of otaku and consumerist culture.
Main characters can be seen as creepy and obsessive.
Some viewers find the portrayal of 'simp' culture disturbing.
Underdeveloped Yuri elements may dissapoint some fans.
anime.thematic_vibe: Otaku Culture, Idol Culture, Parasocial Relationships

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai 6
anime.synopsis:
Late at night, in a clearing within a dark fog-filled forest, there sits a kamishibai storyboard. A visitor approaches, and suddenly, the fog recedes. A shape begins to take form beside the board—this figure is the masked Storyteller, who once again starts to spin tales of horror and despair.

The events described in these macabre tales might happen to anyone, even your neighbors or friends: a group of girls bully one of their members in a cave, only to find themselves the victims of a dark presence; a boy with scopophobia moves to the countryside, but he still cannot escape the eyes of others; a man has a window that won't stay closed, and is the recipient of strange phone calls; and a salaryman steals an umbrella on a rainy day, but this seemingly insignificant act leads to consequences he never expected. Visitors may enjoy the Storyteller's offerings, but they should also be vigilant so that they don't wind up as the subjects of his next story.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience sentiment is positive, especially compared to previous seasons. Reviewers appreciate the shift towards suspense and emotional storytelling, as well as the varied art styles. While the animation remains simplistic, the strong voice acting and engaging narratives compensate for this. There is general agreement that this season is a return to form for the series.
pros: Stories are more emotional and suspenseful, moving away from simple jump scares.
Art style varies per episode, keeping things fresh and fitting the stories.
Voice acting, especially the storyteller, is excellent and spine-chilling.
cons: Animation is simple and basic, resembling a narrated slideshow.
Character development is limited due to the short episode format.
Ending music may not fit the series' overall tone for some viewers.

anime.title: Ling Yu 6th Season
anime.consensus_summary: The season is viewed as a departure from the main storyline, with a focus on previously minor characters. This shift is perceived negatively by some, as it feels like a spin-off or a side story rather than a continuation. The placement of the story before established events further contributes to the feeling of discontinuity.
pros: More spotlight on previously minor characters.
cons: The season feels like a spin-off rather than a continuation.
The story doesn't continue from the previous season, feeling like a separate, possibly imaginary scenario.
Takes place before events established in prior seasons.

anime.title: Godzilla: The Planet Eater
anime.synopsis:
With the defeat of the Bilusaludo's nanometal city, the destruction of humanity seems inevitable. Worse yet, Captain Haruo Sakaki's refusal to sacrifice his humanity has come under fire from the remaining Bilusaludo troops, who blame him for their defeat. In their darkest moment, the few surviving humans turn to the religion of the Exifs, which promises that devotion is the path to salvation from Godzilla.

However, the Exif are not what they seem. As the survivors become more and more zealous in their devotion, Sasaki wonders what exactly the priest Metphies is hiding—especially regarding his relationship with the monster known as Ghidorah.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is highly divided, with strong praise for its philosophical depth, character development, and technical aspects like CGI and music, contrasted by harsh criticism of its pacing, underwhelming monster fights, and a particularly frustrating and nonsensical ending. Many feel it deviates too much from traditional Godzilla fare, while others appreciate its unique, thought-provoking approach.
pros: Beautiful CGI that mimics anime well
Excellent music and sound design, enhancing emotional impact
Character development and exploration of motivations
Engaging philosophical themes about humanity, religion, and technology
cons: Slow and boring first half
Underwhelming and bland monster fights
Awkward and mechanical character animation
Lifeless scenery and textures
Confusing and nonsensical plot resolutions, particularly the protagonist's ending
Protagonist's actions are contradictory and frustrating
Lack of traditional Kaiju action alienates some viewers
Poor English translation on Netflix

anime.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby Specials
anime.romaji_title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - BNW no Chikai
anime.synopsis:
While Team Spica's horse girls have accumulated countless victories and raised their popularity, the popular trio known as BNW has been struggling to produce results lately. Consisting of Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning Ticket, the trio is well-known for their camaraderie during their fierce races, but recently something has distanced them from each other.

When Tracen Academy plans to set up a relay race with each of the BNW members leading a team against each other as part of their fan festival, Team Spica's is saddled with the job to convince the team leaders to participate. Although recruiting each of them proves difficult, Team Spica's horse girls are determined to make sure the trio mends their relationship and that the race will be remembered for years to come.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the special, particularly the plot of Team Spica reuniting BNW and the engaging characters. However, a significant criticism is the lack of background provided for BNW, making their importance feel underdeveloped for new viewers. The special is considered a fun but potentially incomplete experience without prior knowledge of the characters.
pros: Fun plot focusing on Spica helping BNW.
Enjoyable characters with charisma.
Neat race with unique moments.
cons: Insufficient time dedicated to establishing BNW's importance.
BNW feels like a presence you should already be familiar with.

anime.title: How clumsy you are, Miss Ueno.
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
As the head of her middle school's science club, it's only fitting that Ueno is also a brilliant inventor. With devices that can convert any liquid into drinkable water, deodorize the most foul smells, or even generate dark matter to be used as a means of concealment, it seems like nothing is beyond Ueno's capabilities. However, she doesn't invent these devices for the advancement of mankind. Rather, the one force that motivates her is love, the only phenomenon she can't quite figure out.

Ueno is head over heels for Tanaka, her nonchalant fellow club member. Yet, because she is too nervous to confess her love and he is too oblivious to notice her affection, her love life is completely stagnant. In Ueno's mind, if she could just expose him to perverted situations, then surely he'd get flustered and fall for her, right? Assisted by her stone-faced classmate and dedicated wingwoman Yamashita, Ueno employs her many inventions on Tanaka in a lewd manner in hopes that he may one day understand how she feels.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on 'Ueno-san wa Bukiyou.' Some find the humor creative and Ueno's antics adorable, appreciating its lighthearted and short format. However, others are turned off by the crude humor and repetitive nature of the show, finding it unfunny and annoying. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on individual tolerance for lewd jokes and absurdist situations.
pros: Creative and bizarre inventions lead to unique comedic situations.
Ueno's character is genuinely adorable and over-the-top reactions provide entertainment.
The show is concise due to its short episode length.
cons: Crude humor and sexual gags can be off-putting to some viewers.
Repetitive formulaic structure makes the show feel stale after a few episodes.
Tanaka's extreme denseness can be frustrating.
anime.thematic_vibe: Lewd Comedy, Tsundere Romance, Absurdist Humor

anime.title: Take My Brother Away 2
anime.romaji_title: Ani ni Tsukeru Kusuri wa Nai! 2
anime.synopsis: As always, Shi Miao is tired of her brother's ridiculous antics, and Shi Fen can only hope to escape the clutches of his violent sister. With their friends and classmates in tow, the two continue their dysfunctional relationship as reluctant but devoted siblings.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Ani ni Tsukeru Kusuri wa Nai! delivers more of the same humorous sibling antics, but with some noticeable drawbacks. While character development is present, the overall quality and engagement may not reach the heights of the first season.  The opening music is considered a step down, but the core comedic elements remain intact.
pros: Maintains the humor and enjoyable aspects of the first season.
Some character development, particularly for Wan Sui.
Continuation of the dysfunctional yet devoted sibling relationship.
cons: Quality may not be as good as the first season.
Opening music choice is not as memorable or enjoyable as the first season's.
The two-cour format may feel less engaging compared to the first season's one-cour format.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sibling Antics, Chinese Humor, Slice of Life

anime.title: The Ones Within
anime.synopsis:
Iride Akatsuki has unlocked hidden content in the game he's playing, 'Nakanohito Genome,' and it turns out that this content is a real-life game!

He soon wakes up to find that he has been kidnapped and taken to a strange place, along with a number of other teammates. Each of them specializes in a certain sort of game, like cultivation games, fighting games, puzzle games, etc.

A llama-headed 'teacher' gathers them after level 1 is cleared to explain how the game will proceed.

Will this group of gamers succeed, and make it back to their real lives?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about Nakanohito Genome. Many find the characters and their interactions enjoyable, and appreciate the unique gaming-themed challenges. However, criticisms center around a weak and underdeveloped plot, inconsistent tone, and a lack of depth in character backstories, leading to an ultimately unfulfilling experience for some viewers.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions and chemistry
Creative and diverse challenges/games
Refreshing take on the Isekai genre
cons: Inconsistent tone and underdeveloped plot
Lackluster character development and backstories
Unsatisfactory and rushed ending

anime.title: Great King of the Grave: Cold Iron Fight
anime.romaji_title: Mu Wang Zhi Wang: Han Tie Dou
anime.genres: Action, Historical, Martial Arts, Mystery, Romance
anime.synopsis: Following the discovery of Gu Zi's Tomb by Lou Manfeng, Han Qianluo, Lin Shuiyao, Luo Shiqiu, and others in the first season, which resulted in the Tomb Breaking Token being released, the event caused a great uproar in the Tomb Sect's martial arts world. The imperial court also began to stir, and a mysterious rival faction made its appearance, further turbulent and unsettling the entire Tomb Sect's martial arts world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the season decent and enjoyable, particularly for those who have watched the previous season. The continuation of the story and the introduction of political elements are appreciated. However, it doesn't offer anything particularly innovative or groundbreaking.
pros: Direct sequel to season 1
Continuation of the plot from the previous season
Inclusion of a third party (imperial family) adds depth
cons: Nothing ground breaking

anime.title: The King's Avatar 2
anime.synopsis:
The "Unspecialized" character Lord Grim is infamous in the 10th server of the popular online game Glory. His reputation alone is enough to draw many curious players to his newly formed Guild Happy. Other competing guilds have enough to worry about with some of their own members abandoning them for Happy. However, they are also concerned by rumors that the person behind Lord Grim is really the retired professional gamer and "Glory Textbook" Ye Qiu, whom they have little chance of opposing. 

Unsure of the truth, the powerhouse guilds attempt to suppress Lord Grim's growing influence, harboring differing motives for doing so. But regardless of what obstacles he faces, Lord Grim is determined to break into the cross-server of Glory—the Heavenly Domain—where characters, including himself, can reach even greater levels. There, he hopes to round out the team of rookies who will fight alongside him in the Challenger League, which would be only their first step toward the coveted Glory Championship.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Quanzhi Gaoshou 2 is mixed. While some appreciate the improved animation and continuation of the esports narrative, many find the season lacking in story progression and character development. The rushed pacing and inconsistent animation quality are also points of criticism, leading to a less engaging experience compared to previous installments.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to Season 1.
Engaging esports storyline for those interested in the genre.
Well-characterized and interesting characters, with amusing interactions.
cons: Story feels like filler and doesn't advance significantly.
Pacing is rushed, especially compared to the novel; story can be confusing for those unfamiliar with the source material.
Animation quality is inconsistent with noticeable CGI and reused scenes.
Character development is weak, particularly for new characters, making it difficult to connect with them emotionally.

anime.title: Fog Hill of Five Elements
anime.synopsis:
A legend tells that a long time ago, monsters could give the ability to certain elected officials to master the five elements. But for that, you have to go through the dangerous foggy mountains...

We follow the adventures of one of these elected officials.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly praises the animation and fight choreography as being exceptional and visually stunning, setting a new standard. However, some find the story to be average and underdeveloped, with the short length of the series being a common point of critique. Overall, the show is highly recommended for fans of action and animation, with the hope that the story will be further developed in future installments.
pros: Exceptional animation quality and fight choreography
Unique and refreshing art style inspired by traditional Chinese art
Engaging and dynamic action sequences
Interesting character designs
cons: Story is average and underdeveloped
Limited number of episodes
Some inconsistencies between character figures and backgrounds

anime.title: The Wonderland of Ten Thousands
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: Ye Xingyu'’s master Yu Huanxian went and left a giant Tianyuan Shenzong. Ye Xingyun became the new leader of the Tianyuan Shenzong. At the same time, the civet cat exchanged Prince Edward’s method and became a child of a small family, hidden in it, waiting for revenge. Opportunity. Ye Xingyun embarked on a very dangerous road, but with his own strategy, and Tianyuan Shenzong masters of all the help of experts, vertical and horizontal tactics, strategizing, against the huge Grand Dynasty.
anime.consensus_summary: The series revolves around a protagonist who uses cunning and strategic planning to seek revenge against a powerful enemy. While some appreciate the protagonist's scheming nature and the tactical elements of the story, the plot is considered basic.
pros: Main character is cunning and manipulative.
Story involves strategic planning and tactics.
cons: Basic story.

anime.title: Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki
anime.synopsis: After growing up in Tokyo, high school student Jin Kaito moves to Nagoya where he meets Yatogame Monaka, a fellow student who puts her Nagoya dialect on full display. With her cat-like appearance and unvarnished Nagoya dialect, Yatogame won't open up to him at all. This popular local comedy is increasing the status of Nagoya through observation of the adorable Yatogame-chan!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki for its cute characters, humor, and educational content about Nagoya. While some find the short episodes and cultural references challenging, the overall sentiment is positive. Viewers appreciate the show's unique approach to promoting Nagoya through self-deprecating humor and vibrant visuals.
pros: Cute characters and excellent vocal performances.
Hilarious dialogue, especially for those familiar with Nagoya culture.
Educational and provides insight into Nagoya's culture and history.
Strong art style capturing the character of Nagoya.
cons: Short episodes may not allow for in-depth storytelling.
Humor may be lost on viewers unfamiliar with Nagoya culture.
Frantic pacing can make it difficult to follow, requiring pausing to read info cards.

anime.title: Afterlost
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
One day, a city suddenly disappears. Takuya, a professional by-the-contract courier and lone wolf, meets Yuki, the only survivor from the city's extinction. The two rely on a message from Yuki's father, who was heard to be missing, and head toward the disappeared city, Lost. 

However, unexpected obstacles strike before the pair, with the reality especially shocking for Yuki. Before them are the feelings of those left behind, a mysterious group manipulating in the shadows, and unveiling the hidden conspiracy. Takuya and Yuki, who both were initially strangers, would deepen their bond during the journey and unravel the mystery of the Lost city.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Shoumetsu Toshi is highly divided. While some appreciated the initial premise and underlying themes, many were disappointed by the poor execution, particularly the jarring CGI, disjointed storytelling, and underdeveloped characters. The ending was a major point of contention, with several viewers finding it unsatisfying and illogical. Overall, the anime fails to live up to its potential due to significant production and writing flaws.
pros: Interesting premise with underlying themes of coping, loss, understanding, and forgiveness.
Some viewers found the initial episodes captivating with good direction.
The voice acting was generally considered good.
cons: Poor CGI animation, often compared unfavorably to early PS2 graphics.
Storytelling is poorly paced, jumping around and lacking clear transitions.
Characters are bland, one-dimensional, and difficult to connect with; emotional scenes fail to evoke a response.
The plot becomes confusing with the introduction of unexplained powers and a lack of consistent direction.
Many found the ending unsatisfying and predictable.
Excessive use of shaky camera effects and twitching eye animations.

anime.title: Real Girl Season 2
anime.synopsis: Teenage otaku Tsutsui is finally starting to feel comfortable in his relationship with his beautiful classmate Iroha, but the real world continues to make things tough for both of them. With the school cultural festival coming up, Tsutsui gets stuck working on the festival committee while Iroha's classmates pressure her to enter the beauty contest. Meanwhile, Tsutsui's best friend Itou finally works up the courage to confess his feelings to Ayado, but she turns him down. As Itou works to get over this rejection and Tsutsui struggles just to survive the festival, they both decide to do whatever they can to become better people. Will their good intentions pave the way to a happy outcome, or will more hearts be broken along the way?
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of 3D Kanojo: Real Girl is generally well-received as a significant improvement over the first, offering a more complete and emotionally resonant story. Viewers appreciate the character development and faithful adaptation of the manga's ending. However, some criticize the rushed pacing and animation quality, resulting in a mildly polarized audience.
pros: Satisfying character development, especially for supporting characters
Faithful adaptation of the manga source material, providing a true ending
Addresses mature themes and relationship complexities
Emotional and touching storyline with a satisfying resolution
cons: Rushed pacing and occasional clustered storytelling
Animation quality is mediocre, lacking detail and fluidity
Some characters are initially unlikable or annoying
Ending may feel bland or lack curiosity for some viewers

anime.title: The Morose Mononokean II
anime.synopsis:
Despite being burdened with crippling debt to the morose Haruitsuki Abeno, Hanae Ashiya has come to enjoy his job as an exorcist. His ability to communicate with youkai has given him a sense of responsibility regarding the magical creatures, and he continues to work hard to send them to their true home in the Underworld.

As Ashiya’s life finally stabilizes, the youkai threaten to upset it once again. Knowledge of his existence has begun to spread, and not everyone is happy to have a human working for the Mononokean, the interdimensional tea room. But one day, a simple visit to the Underworld draws the attention of those in power, and Ashiya soon learns that not every youkai is willing to go along with Abeno's plans.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Fukigen na Mononokean Tsuzuki is met with mixed reactions, particularly from manga fans. While some viewers may find enjoyment, many are disappointed by changes to the plot and characters. The adaptation's pacing and reduced emotional impact compared to the manga are major points of criticism.
cons: Poor adaptation of manga
Changes to character characteristics
Crucial plot changes
Pacing issues
Emotional impact lessened compared to manga

anime.title: School Babysitters Episode 13
anime.genres: Childcare, Iyashikei, Shoujo, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: With the onset of exams Ryuuichi and Kotaro spend less time together and a special version of Snow White is put on by the cast of Gakuen Babysitters. This special episode is bundled with the 7th Blu-ray volume.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the Gakuen Babysitters Special to be a charming and cute continuation of the main series, perfect for lighthearted relaxation. While universally praised for its comforting atmosphere and effective use of chibi art for children, some viewers might find its simplicity and lack of plot progression to be a drawback.
pros: Successfully conveys a sense of comfort and coziness
Chibi style is effectively used to emphasize the children's innocence and cuteness
Lighthearted and relaxing, perfect for unwinding
Maintains the charm and appeal of the main series
cons: Story progression is minimal
Conflicts are extremely simple
Lacks standout moments
May be perceived as 'too simple' by some viewers

anime.title: IDOLiSH7 Second BEAT!
anime.synopsis:
Following their performance at the Black or White event, the idol group IDOLiSH7 is at the height of its popularity, with offers for various concerts and work coming in every day, much to the joy of the seven boys and their manager. However, as their fame continues to rise, Riku Nanase's health begins worsening due to the heavy workload.

With the gigantic idol duo Re:vale showing interest in the group and the reopening event of the Zero Arena coming up, IDOLiSH7: Second Beat follows IDOLiSH7 as they not only struggle to adapt to the challenges of the idol life but also to face their personal troubles, all while continuously meeting the expectations of their treasured fans.
anime.consensus_summary: IDOLiSH7 Second Beat! is well-received for its strong character development, realistic portrayal of the idol industry, and engaging storylines. While some find the plot cliche or rushed, the overall consensus is that it's a valuable and emotional ride, particularly praising the character interactions and depth added by Re:vale. Most viewers are eagerly anticipating the next season.
pros: Strong character development and exploration of personal struggles.
Realistic portrayal of the entertainment industry's challenges.
Engaging plot twists and drama.
Good balance of comedy, drama, and emotional moments.
Introduction of Re:vale adds depth and comedy.
cons: Story can be cliche at times.
Some plot points feel rushed or not fully developed.
Transitions between character storylines can be confusing.
3DCG during performances is not always well-received.
Art style can be inconsistent at times.

anime.title: Midnight Occult Civil Servants
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Mythology, Shoujo, Supernatural, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
The Nocturnal Community Relations Division is a team of people who specialize in solving cases involving the ominous occult creatures of the night unseen by ordinary humans. Young and unsuspecting Arata Miyako has been assigned to the Shinjuku Ward Office of the division, where he meets his fellow members Theo Himezuka and Kyouichi Sakaki. 

On his first night, Arata finds himself on a mission where he discovers to his surprise that not only does every supernatural creature he once thought to be fictional actually exist, but also that he is the only human who can understand their non-human speech. Arata's surprises do not end there, as later that night, he meets a legendary creature called a Tengu that refers to him as the famous Heian-era exorcist, Abe no Seimei. Unfamiliar with the exorcist, Arata pays no mind and continues to work with his team, utilizing his unique ability to assist in the resolution of their cases. 

Mistaken by many occult creatures as Abe no Seimei and quickly becoming notorious for his special ability during his work, Arata becomes curious of his origins and invests himself more into solving cases regarding occult creatures he encounters once he learns of a certain connection between himself and the exorcist. However, Arata will quickly find that dealing with supernatural creatures is not as simple as he thought, as danger begins to play a fundamental role in his everyday findings and his ability starts to present an unexpected issue.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the unique premise and mature themes, while others find the execution lacking. Common criticisms include inconsistent animation, slow pacing, and underdeveloped characters. There is a general agreement that the series had potential but didn't fully capitalize on it.
pros: Creative use of worldwide mythology beyond just Japanese folklore.
Calm, thoughtful, and steady episodic storytelling with mature themes.
Well-developed characters with natural dynamics and grounded interactions.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, especially in later episodes.
Slow pacing and lack of overarching plot can make the series feel uneventful.
Underdeveloped characters and missed opportunities for deeper exploration.

anime.title: Run with the Wind
anime.synopsis:
Former ace runner of Sendai Josei High School, Kakeru Kurahara is chased away from a convenience store for shoplifting. Shaking off his pursuer, he runs into Haiji Kiyose, another student from his university. Haiji is impressed by Kakeru's agility and persuades him to live in Chikusei-sou, the run-down apartment where Haiji resides along with eight other students. Having lost his entire apartment deposit at a mahjong parlor, Kakeru accepts the offer reluctantly.

However, Haiji reveals a secret during Kakeru's welcoming party: the apartment is actually the dormitory of the Kansei University Track Club. He unveils his ultimate goal of participating in the Hakone Ekiden—one of the most prominent university marathon relay races in Japan. Unfortunately, all the residents apart from Haiji and Kakeru are complete running novices. Worse still, none of the inhabitants are even remotely interested in being involved with Haiji's ridiculous plan! With only months before the deadline, will the fourth-year student be able to convince them otherwise and realize his elusive dream of running in the Hakone Ekiden?
anime.consensus_summary: Viewers are overwhelmingly positive about Kaze ga Tsuyoku Fuiteiru, praising its character development, inspiring story, and mature themes. While some critique the pacing or rushed ending, the general sentiment is that it's a well-crafted sports anime that transcends the genre. The show is viewed as a 'hidden gem'.
pros: Well-developed characters with realistic growth
Relatable and mature portrayal of college students
Inspiring story about chasing dreams and overcoming challenges
Excellent pacing and storytelling with no wasted moments
Amazing soundtrack and gorgeous art style
Meaningful exploration of youth and friendship
Show combines elements of sports and slice-of-life well
cons: Ending felt rushed
Some unrealistic dramatic scenes
Character art for Kakeru is inconsistent
May be slower-paced or boring for some viewers
Synopsis does not accurately represent the anime
Some consider the sport elements unrealistic

anime.title: Kirakira Happy★Hirake! Cocotama
anime.synopsis: A long time ago, Haruka Hoshinogawa made a wish with the town's old cherry blossom tree with her grandfather while receiving a present from him: a cherry blossom ribbon. As she grew up, she treasured the gift that was given to her while starting fifth grade in her school. One day, upon noting that the old cherry blossom tree is wilting, her grandfather decided to leave the shop to explore the world and let Haruka take care of the store in his absence. The next day while sleeping, her treasured ribbon sprouted a strange egg, revealing a Cocotama, a god born from an object that has been cherished with love and care. Haruka woke up and accidentally saw the Cocotama on the table, retreated to her Hiding Egg. As Haruka picked it up, it has changed into a mysterious key. Left with some questions, the Cocotama introduced herself as Ribbon, and Haruka learned about the existence of her kind and the mysteries behind the strange key she had. Ribbon realized that the key is actually the Key of Wonders and that Haruka was chosen by it to be the Legendary Contractor to the Cocotamas. Now, both of them try to run the shop and meet new Cocotama friends, while discovering the mysteries and powers behind the Key of Wonders.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is primarily targeted towards children, offering a lighthearted and cute experience with good moral lessons. While it may not appeal to adults seeking complex narratives, its unique character designs and captivating music contribute to its charm. The audience generally appreciates its wholesome nature, resulting in low polarization.
pros: Unique character designs
Interesting premise
Captivating music
cons: Not engaging for adults
Lacks twists and turns in the story
anime.thematic_vibe: Cuteness, Good Morals, Slice of Life

anime.title: Youkai Watch Movie 5: Forever Friends
anime.synopsis:
1960s --- Tokyo.

Shin is a boy who lived happily despite being poor, loses his mother who is his only family member, and falls into deep misfortune. Itsuki, a boy who saves Shin also lost his older sister. Those two boys are joined by Tae, a girl who can see youkai and together with Shin's guardian spirit Suu-san and new Youkai such as Nekomata, they take on a mysterious incident in order to retrieve the souls of their precious family! And what is the shocking truth that awaits them...!? An origin story for how Lord Enma became the rule of the Yomakai.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some appreciate the initial setup and characters, but the film is ultimately criticized for lacking a clear purpose and falling into familiar, less desirable tropes of the series. The shift towards spectacle and power-scaling, detracts from the initial emotional core.
pros: Likable protagonists
Promising initial plot
cons: Unclear thematic point
Repetitive and derivative plot elements
Over-reliance on 'Enma stuff' (power scaling and cool anime guy tropes)
Plot devolves into spectacle over substance

anime.title: Starlight Promises
anime.synopsis:
"A festival of miracle, where you can meet whoever you want to meet."

Mihara Shoma, a first-year in high school, receives a message from his best friend Atsushi, who he hadn't heard from in ages. "Wanna come to this cool little festival I found? It's been a while, so I'd like to catch up." Unable to sit around after that, Shoma heads to a ghost village in the mountains for the Tanabata Nanayamatsuri. But he doesn't find Atsushi there. Instead, he meets a girl named Shiori, who has someone she wants to meet as well. Will Shoma be able to meet Atsushi once again?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While viewers appreciate the beautiful visuals and emotional concept, many find the story predictable, the pacing rushed, and the action scenes out of place. The film is seen as having potential that was not fully realized due to these shortcomings, leading to a somewhat underwhelming experience.
pros: Beautiful background and character art
Good concept of meeting lost loved ones in a futuristic AR setting
Simple and easily accessible story
cons: Predictable and unoriginal story
Unnecessary and mood-killing fight scenes
Rushed pacing and lack of character depth
Poorly explained plot elements

anime.title: Stars Align
anime.synopsis:
Constantly outperformed by the girls' club, the boys' soft tennis club faces disbandment due to their poor skills and lack of positive results in matches. In desperate need of members, Touma Shinjou is looking to recruit capable players, but he fails to scout anyone. Enter Maki Katsuragi, a new transfer student who demonstrates great reflexes when he catches a stray cat in his classroom, instantly capturing Touma's attention. With his interest piqued, Touma ambitiously asks Maki to join the boys' team but is quickly rejected, as Maki doesn't wish to join any clubs. Touma refuses to back down and ends up persuading Maki—only under the condition that Touma will pay him for his participation and cover other club expenses. 

Maki joins the team, and his incredible form and quick learning allow him to immediately outshine the rest of the team. Although this gives rise to conflict among the boys, Maki challenges and pushes his fellow team members to not only keep up with his seemingly natural talent, but also drive them to devote themselves to the game they once neglected. 

As the members of the boys' soft tennis club discover their own capabilities, they endure personal hardships and deal with the darker side of growing up in middle school.
anime.consensus_summary: Hoshiai no Sora is praised for its mature and realistic portrayal of adolescence, tackling sensitive issues with depth and nuance. However, the abrupt ending and underdeveloped subplots stemming from production issues leave many viewers frustrated. While appreciated for its animation and character development, the series is also criticized for inconsistent pacing and prioritizing drama over the sports aspect, leading to mixed opinions.
pros: Mature exploration of adolescence and real-life issues.
Well-developed characters with unique quirks and personalities.
Excellent animation, cinematography, and soundtrack that amplifies emotions.
Realistic dialogue and portrayal of friendships.
Addresses sensitive topics like abuse and gender identity respectfully.
cons: Abrupt ending due to production constraints and a lack of resolution for many plotlines.
Overabundance of themes and character arcs leads to underdeveloped subplots.
Inconsistent pacing and forced drama can feel overwhelming.
The sport aspect is sometimes secondary to the drama, disappointing some viewers.

anime.title: Forest of Piano Second Season
anime.genres: Drama, Music, Performing Arts, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
With the start of the Chopin piano competition, Kai Ichinose, Shuuhei Amamiya, and many other hopeful musicians from around the world strive to reach the top. The stakes have never been higher, and the judges are rigorous when it comes to selecting the winner out of the plethora of talented pianists. This competition is so harsh that even famous prodigies can be easily eliminated. 

Some play for the money, some play to fulfill their duty to their families, and yet others play for their music to be heard. However, the only one who can reach the top is the one who embodies the spirit of the music Frédéric Chopin crafted for future generations. With the stakes higher than ever before, rivalries, friendships, and family ties will be tested, and each pianist will find their own sound.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the story, character development, and music are praised, the poor animation quality and deviation from the first season's charm are significant drawbacks. Viewers are divided on whether the second season lives up to the potential of the source material, with some finding it a worthwhile continuation and others feeling let down by the production choices.
pros: Strong character development, especially in Season 2.
Well-developed motivations for competing characters.
Excellent classical piano performances.
Exploration of complex relationships (friendship, rivalry, family).
Story resonates with viewers from disadvantaged backgrounds.
cons: Poor animation quality, particularly the CGI during performances.
Excessive use of stills and panning instead of actual animation.
Performances take too long.
Story deviates from the first season's charm and whimsical elements.
Focus shifts to less worthwhile characters.
Repetitive CGI

anime.title: Zombie Land Saga
anime.genres: Award Winning, Comedy, Idols (Female), Music, Parody, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Sakura Minamoto dreams of becoming an idol. Unfortunately, reality hits her like a truck, and she dies in a sudden traffic accident. Ten years later, she wakes up in Saga Prefecture, only to find herself a zombie with no memory of her past. While still coming to terms with her demise, she meets a man named Koutarou Tatsumi, who explains that he has resurrected her and six other zombie girls from different eras for the purpose of economically revitalizing Saga by means of an idol group. Assuming the role of an abrasive manager, Koutarou begins scheduling events; the girls go along with it, eventually deciding to name their idol group Franchouchou.

An absurdly comedic take on the idol genre, Zombieland Saga tells the story of Franchouchou's heartwarming struggle to save Saga Prefecture while hiding their zombie identities and rediscovering their past lives.
anime.consensus_summary: Zombieland Saga is a polarizing yet largely appreciated anime that ingeniously blends the idol and zombie genres. Many viewers found the show to be a refreshing and hilarious parody, praising its unique visuals and charismatic characters. However, some critics point to the series' underdeveloped story arcs and inconsistent pacing, suggesting that the anime failed to fully capitalize on its potential.
pros: Revitalizes the horror genre by subverting zombie cliches with comedy.
Unique and colorful visuals, especially in the opening and ending.
The series is praised for its originality and unconventional approach to the idol genre.
Charismatic characters and intriguing plot twists.
cons: The story suffers from missed potential, and the writing can be inconsistent.
Character arcs and story threads are not fully developed.
The balance between comedy and drama is not always successful, affecting the pacing.
Some viewers found the show to be a generic seasonal anime that is easily forgettable.

anime.title: Magical Girl Spec-Ops Asuka
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Mahou Shoujo, Military, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Three years ago, a bloodthirsty race of interdimensional beings known as the Disas appeared and destroyed everything they could reach on Earth. With regular weapons rendered useless, humanity's only hope of survival relied on humans who became magical girls after forming an alliance with the Spirit Realm, who had followed the Disas to Earth. After a violent conflict, the squad of magical girls emerge victorious, with the survivors now known as the "Magical Five."

Following the war with the Disas, the Magical Five disbands. Kurumi Mugen, Mia Cyrus, Tamara Volkova, and Lau Peipei independently continue their own military services, while their leader, Asuka Ootorii, retires and becomes a high school student. However, Asuka's peace is short-lived, as it seems there were survivors on the enemy's side as well. As magic must be fought with magic, Asuka is dragged back into combat as an even worse battle looms on the horizon.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Mahou Shoujo Tokushusen Asuka' are mixed. While some appreciate its darker take on the magical girl genre and military themes, many are critical of the poor production quality and pacing. The series' attempts to address mature themes like PTSD are undermined by excessive fan service and inconsistent character development, leading to a divisive reception.
pros: The series attempts to deconstruct and subvert magical girl tropes, offering a fresh perspective on the genre.
Some reviewers appreciated the blend of military and magical girl aesthetics, especially in costume design.
The series is praised by some for its research and attention to detail, especially in the scientific explanations of magic.
cons: Many reviewers criticize the poor production values, particularly the animation quality during action scenes.
The plot pacing is criticized for being slow, especially in the early episodes.
Several reviewers found the fan service and sexualization excessive and out of place, detracting from the story's themes.
Some find the story and characters bland and uninspired.

anime.title: Children of the Sea
anime.genres: Award Winning, Drama, Mystery, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ruka Azumi's ordinary summer vacation revolves around spending all her time on the handball court to avoid her only housemate, her alcoholic mother. When an incident at practice leads to Ruka's exclusion from the handball team, she is forced to find other outlets to enjoy herself, eventually winding up at the aquarium where her father works. There, she meets Umi, a mysterious boy raised by dugongs who is being kept at the aquarium in order to research his strange water-dependent body.

Ruka and Umi become fast friends, and the pair is soon joined by Sora, Umi's brother who also has an unusual relationship with the ocean. Together, the trio explore a dazzling undersea world while learning about a peculiar "festival" that all sea creatures around the world are preparing for.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. Many praise the film's stunning visuals, animation, and soundtrack, highlighting its artistic merit and immersive experience. However, a significant portion criticizes the confusing and pretentious storyline, shallow characters, and underdeveloped plot, resulting in a polarized reception based on individual preferences for style over substance.
pros: Breathtaking and seamless animation that translates the manga's art well.
Beautiful art and soundtrack create an immersive aesthetic experience, especially on the big screen.
Explores themes of connection, origin, and the cycle of life in a poetic manner.
Visually stunning with a mix of 2D and 3D animation, creating colorful, expressive, and fluid effects.
Music matches the scenes, such as sea diving or magical experiences, enhancing the story.
cons: Storyline can be incomprehensible and a mess, with vague dialogues and unresolved plotlines.
Narrative devolves into self-indulgent spectacle with shallow musings on life and the universe.
Characters are simple and lack depth, making it difficult to become emotionally invested.
Plot loses focus and becomes disorienting, dissolving into symbolism at the expense of clarity.
Philosophical themes may be too heavy or poorly executed for some viewers.

anime.title: Domestic Girlfriend
anime.genres: Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
In their teenage years, few things can hurt people more than the heartaches that come with unrequited love. Such is the case for Natsuo Fujii, who has found himself entranced by his school's ever-cheerful teacher Hina. Deflated by this unreachable desire, Natsuo humors his friends and attends a mixer. There he meets Rui, a girl whose lack of excitement rivals that of himself. After bonding over their mutual awkwardness, Rui takes Natsuo to her house and asks him to have sex with her, hoping that the experience will stop her friends from treating her like a clueless child. With his hopeless feelings towards Hina still on his mind, Natsuo hesitantly agrees.

Equally unfulfilled by their "first times," the two decide to part ways as strangers. However, before he even has a chance to process this experience, Natsuo's father drops a major bombshell: he is getting remarried, and his new wife Tsukiko Tachibana is coming over now to meet Natsuo. As if that was not enough of a shock, her daughters—and, in turn, Natsuo's new sisters—are Hina and Rui Tachibana, the woman he's in love with and the girl with whom he shared his first night. Now, Natsuo must come to terms with the feelings he has for his step-siblings as his eyes open to a darker side of love.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is heavily divided on Domestic na Kanojo. While some appreciate its attempt to explore unconventional relationships and its strong opening theme, most find the plot contrived and the characters unlikeable due to their questionable actions and lack of development. The anime is often described as a guilty pleasure at best, or a poorly executed melodrama at worst, with many viewers expressing frustration and disgust.
pros: The opening theme song (Kawaki wo Ameku) is highly praised for its emotion and quality.
Some viewers appreciate the anime's attempt to deviate from typical romance cliches and explore complex relationships.
The art style is considered clean and appealing by some.
cons: The plot is heavily reliant on coincidences and dramatic twists that are often seen as forced and unbelievable.
Characters are often criticized for being unfaithful, making poor decisions, and lacking meaningful development.
The anime is criticized for excessive drama, inconsistent pacing, and superficial exploration of serious issues.
Some find the relationships to be disturbing and immoral due to the age gap and step-sibling dynamics.

anime.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Reincarnation
anime.synopsis:
The day is as normal as it can be in high school as the students peacefully go about their everyday activities until an unprecedented catastrophe strikes the school, killing every person in its wake. Guided by what seems to be a miracle, a handful of students are fortunate enough to be reincarnated into another world as nobles, princes, and other kinds of people with prestigious backgrounds.

One girl, however, is not so lucky. Being reborn as a spider of the weakest kind, she immediately experiences the hardships of her dire situation. Even so, she must press on to survive the numerous threats that endanger her life. Discovering that her new world has a system like that of an RPG, she tries her best to hunt prey and defeat monsters to level up and evolve. As she gradually grows stronger, she hopes one day her efforts will be rewarded, and that she will be granted a better life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided. Many appreciate the unique premise and the engaging story of the spider protagonist, praising her personality and voice acting. However, significant criticism is directed towards the poor CGI animation, the less interesting human side story, and confusing pacing, leading to a polarized viewing experience.
pros: Unique premise with reincarnation as a spider
Strong and entertaining protagonist (Kumoko) with excellent voice acting
Engaging story on the spider side
Self-aware and personality-driven narrative
cons: Poor CGI animation, especially in fight scenes
Boring and uninspired human side story
Confusing timeline and pacing issues
Uneven quality between spider and human segments

anime.title: Aggretsuko (ONA) 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
Red panda Retsuko continues to work at her cyclic office job, with the occasional stress-venting via death metal karaoke on the side. With the company of her newfound friends Gori and Washimi, life is more enjoyable than ever before. But some new shake-ups to her status quo threaten to add more stress to her life. At the office, new employee Anai seems like a fine addition to the company. Yet when Retsuko is placed in charge of his training, she finds that beneath his steadfast dedication, he may pose a threat to the stability of the workplace. Meanwhile, at home, Retsuko's mother pays an abrupt visit, fully intent on having her daughter finally settle down and find a man. With this in mind, she sets Retsuko up for various marriage appointments, much to her chagrin.

Now, Retsuko finds all the more reasons to head to the karaoke bar and unleash her furious diatribes. However, knowing that this will not truly solve her problems, she decides to make a more spontaneous choice to avoid her issues. And so, Retsuko finds herself set upon another self-reflecting journey, coming to learn more about herself and love, with the ever cathartic support of death metal karaoke.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Aggretsuko is generally well-received, with many viewers finding it relatable and engaging due to its exploration of personal growth, relationships, and social issues. While some feel it doesn't quite reach the heights of the first season or suffers from pacing issues, the introduction of new characters and deeper focus on Retsuko's life is appreciated. Overall, the audience enjoys the season and hopes for more Aggretsuko in the future.
pros: Relatable characters and situations, especially regarding work and family.
Addresses relevant and serious issues such as workplace harassment and societal expectations regarding marriage.
Introduction of compelling new characters like Tadano and Anai.
Focuses on Retsuko's personal life and relationships, offering a deeper exploration of her character.
Maintains the same atmosphere as the first season while exploring new themes.
cons: Some feel the season is too short and wish for more screen time for the supporting cast.
A few reviewers feel it is a retread of the first season.
Less focus on the death metal karaoke aspect compared to the first season.
anime.thematic_vibe: Relatable Struggles, Romantic Entanglements, Personal Growth

anime.title: Trinity Seven: Heavens Library & Crimson Lord
anime.romaji_title: Trinity Seven Movie 2: Heavens Library to Crimson Lord
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Heavens Library to Crimson Lord brings back Arata, Lilith, and the rest of the Trinity Seven to face off against the greatest enemy in the history of the Trinity Seven; Lilith's own father, who is revealed to be the strongest Demon Lord, challenges Arata who is now a Demon Lord candidate.
anime.consensus_summary: Fans generally enjoyed the movie for its action, character development (especially for Lilith and Akio), and signature ecchi elements. However, a significant portion of the audience found the pacing to be rushed and the antagonist underdeveloped, leading to a somewhat confusing narrative. While it's seen as a competent sequel for existing fans, it doesn't overcome all of the series' established flaws.
pros: Satisfying character development for Lilith and Akio.
Engaging action sequences and fight choreography.
Consistent visual quality and animation throughout most of the film.
Effective use of ecchi elements integrated naturally into humor and character.
Strong voice acting from the main cast.
Enjoyable soundtrack with new and returning tracks.
cons: Pacing issues, particularly a rushed first half and abrupt plot developments.
The antagonist lacks significant backstory and impact.
Inconsistent introduction to plot elements and character powers, leading to confusion.
Underutilization of the wider harem cast in favor of main plot characters.
The plot can feel episodic and disconnected from the main series.
Clichéd "friendship is my power" trope leading to a lackluster climax.

anime.title: Violet Evergarden: The Movie
anime.synopsis:
Several years have passed since the end of The Great War. As the radio tower in Leidenschaftlich continues to be built, telephones will soon become more relevant, leading to a decline in demand for "Auto Memory Dolls." Even so, Violet Evergarden continues to rise in fame after her constant success with writing letters. However, sometimes the one thing you long for is the one thing that does not appear.

Violet Evergarden Movie follows Violet as she continues to comprehend the concept of emotion and the meaning of love. At the same time, she pursues a glimmer of hope that the man who once told her, "I love you," may still be alive even after the many years that have passed.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is strongly divided. While many praise the film's visual and auditory aspects and the emotional impact of the side story, a significant portion criticizes the perceived regression of Violet's character and the narrative's abandonment of previously established themes. This has led to disappointment among viewers who felt the movie undermined Violet's journey and character development.
pros: Breathtaking animation by Kyoto Animation.
Excellent voice acting and soundtrack.
Well-written B-plot (sick boy's story) that evokes strong emotions.
cons: Character regression of Violet, undoing previous development.
Story feels like a step back, focusing too much on Gilbert.
Ending undermines the themes of grief, acceptance, and moving on.

anime.title: Space Battleship Tiramisu Zwei
anime.synopsis: Second season of Uchuu Senkan Tiramisù.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the second season of Uchuu Senkan Tiramisù as a funny and entertaining parody of sci-fi and mecha genres. While the plot may be nonsensical, the series offers consistent art, animation, and enjoyable music. Some find the humor and lack of depth unappealing, but overall, the season is well-received by those who appreciated the first season.
pros: Funny and entertaining.
Consistent art and animation.
Good music, including OP and ED.
cons: Mindless parody with no real purpose.
Minimalistic animation due to short runtime.

anime.title: Golden Kamuy Season 2
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Historical, Military, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
In Hokkaido, it is rumored that there is a stash of hidden gold. This gold was supposedly stolen by a man who killed the original Ainu owners; and before being captured and imprisoned by the police, he hid it in a secret location. In order to relay the gold's location to his comrades on the outside, he tattooed the map on the bodies of his cellmates and promised them a share of the gold—provided they managed to escape and find it.

In Golden Kamuy 2nd Season, First Lieutenant Tokushirou Tsurumi plans to give the 7th Division an advantage in the war for the tattoos by getting a taxidermist to create skins that only he can distinguish as fake. Meanwhile, Saichi "The Immortal" Sugimoto, Asirpa, and their companions continue their hunt for the skins by following a strange rumor: a thief who broke into a home in Yubari found taxidermied human corpses, among which was a torso with strange tattoos.
anime.consensus_summary: Golden Kamuy Season 2 is generally well-received, improving upon the first season with stronger character development and a better balance of comedy and action.  The show's unique blend of genres and historical setting continues to be a highlight. Some viewers find the pacing inconsistent and the increased emphasis on humor detracts from the seriousness of the plot, however the core story and character relationships keep it compelling.
pros: Strong character development, especially of side characters.
Improved balance between comedy and action compared to Season 1.
Unique blend of genres (survival, treasure hunt, comedy) works well.
Engaging story with intrigue, shifting loyalties, and betrayals.
cons: Weak pacing in some episodes.
Excessive focus on humor and homoerotic jokes may not appeal to all viewers.
Monotonous scenes (e.g., repetitive dinner scenes).
Narrative can be confusing at times with a rollercoaster trend.

anime.title: Gurazeni Season 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Seinen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis: Second season of Gurazeni.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Gurazeni Season 2 for its realistic depiction of a baseball player's life, focusing on financial stability and relatable characters. While some find the animation and production quality to be lacking, the engaging slice-of-life narrative and character development outweigh these concerns for most viewers. There's a desire for a third season, indicating overall satisfaction.
pros: Realistic portrayal of professional baseball life.
Relatable characters with everyday struggles.
Good character development, including supporting roles.
Calming animation style.
Story focuses on financial stability rather than glory.
cons: Limited production quality; recycled OP/ED.
Passable but decent animation quality.
Not a source of baseball knowledge or great story for some.
Unrealistic tendencies in the genre are not addressed.

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind
anime.romaji_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 5: Ougon no Kaze
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Organized Crime, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
In the coastal city of Naples, corruption is teeming—the police blatantly conspire with outlaws, drugs run rampant around the youth, and the mafia governs the streets with an iron fist. However, various fateful encounters will soon occur.

Enter Giorno Giovanna, a 15-year-old boy with an eccentric connection to the Joestar family, who makes a living out of part-time jobs and pickpocketing. Furthermore, he is gifted with the unexplained Stand ability to give and create life—growing plants from the ground and turning inanimate objects into live animals, an ability he has dubbed "Gold Experience." Fascinated by the might of local gangsters, Giorno has dreamed of rising up in their ranks and becoming a "Gang-Star," a feat made possible by his encounter with Bruno Bucciarati, a member of the Passione gang with his own sense of justice.

JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Ougon no Kaze follows the endeavors of Giorno after joining Bruno's team while working under Passione, fending off other gangsters and secretly plotting to overthrow their mysterious boss.
anime.consensus_summary: Golden Wind is highly praised for its engaging story, unique Stand battles, and memorable characters. The animation and soundtrack are frequently lauded, contributing to an overall positive viewing experience. While some find the plot simple, the creative fights and character interactions outweigh this concern for most viewers.
pros: Fluid choreography and stylistic action scenes.
Unique Stand abilities and mind games in fights.
Memorable and addictive soundtrack.
Beautifully crafted storytelling and impressive adaptation of the manga.
Strong character development, with the protagonist being the entire crew.
cons: Story can be considered the weakest point, with some areas needing improvement.
Occasional odd art style choices by David Production.
Some consider the plot simple, though well-crafted.

anime.title: Jingai-san no Yome
anime.synopsis: High schooler Tomari Hinowa is called to the principal's office one day to hear some shocking news: he's getting married! A mysterious fluffy creature called Kanenogi has chosen him as their wife, and despite Tomari's initial misgivings, he decides to accept. What follows are a series of delightful tales from this new couple's monstrous married life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some find the anime cute, funny, and a refreshing bit of absurd entertainment, particularly those interested in the specific yaoi subgenre it caters to. However, many are put off by the nonsensical plot, poor production values, and unsettling implications of the story's premise, finding it more disturbing than enjoyable.
pros: Unique and quirky premise.
Cute character designs, especially the creatures.
Lighthearted and simple entertainment.
Enjoyable for fans of yaoi and monster boy relationships.
cons: Poor animation quality.
Weak or nonexistent plot and story.
Unexplained world-building and character motivations.
Potentially disturbing themes of child marriage and bestiality.
Repetitive and uninspired music.

anime.title: B: The Beginning Succession
anime.genres: Action, Detective, Mystery, Psychological, Super Power, Suspense
anime.synopsis: In the first season of B: The Beginning, two men confronted their own past with great sacrifice. Maverick detective Keith Flick fought against his demons and finally exposed the dark secrets behind the Kingdom of Cremona. Mutant wunderkind Koku finally reunited with the most precious memory from his stolen childhood. Several months have passed since then, and the entire world seems to have forgotten the turmoil caused by those events. As Keith returns to the Royal Police to conduct his own investigation, Koku and Yuna try to enjoy an ordinary life in peace. But the consequences of the Jaula Blanca experiments are far from being extinct, as Koku soon discovers when his supposedly dead lab mate Kirisame suddenly shows up.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reaction to B: The Beginning Succession is largely negative, with a significant portion of viewers feeling it was a disappointing sequel that failed to live up to the first season. While some praise for individual characters like Lily and general art quality exists, these are heavily overshadowed by criticism of the incoherent plot, rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and unresolved cliffhanger ending.
pros: Keith's character development, especially his exploration of past feelings, is highlighted as a strong point in one episode.
Lily is consistently praised as a standout character, bringing life and personality to the series.
The art and animation quality are generally seen as improved or maintained from the first season, with fluid fight scenes and good character designs.
The soundtrack and Japanese voice acting are noted as being of high quality and effective.
cons: The story is frequently described as incoherent, illogical, rushed, predictable, and a disappointment compared to the first season.
The sequel is criticized for being a 'bridge season' that sets up future plot points rather than providing a satisfying conclusion.
Character development for many characters is lacking, with protagonists and supporting cast members receiving little attention or making questionable decisions.
The plot suffers from continuity errors, retcons, unexplained plot points, and a lack of clear motivations for new antagonists.
Production values are perceived to have dropped, with increased and poor-quality CGI, inconsistent shadows, and choppy animation.
The short episode count (six episodes) is seen as detrimental to the story's pacing and development.
New characters are generally disliked and poorly written.
The ending is consistently cited as a major disappointment, being a cliffhanger that leaves the story unresolved.

anime.title: Asobi Asobase: Cosplay Contest/To the Future Me
anime.romaji_title: Asobi Asobase: Cosplay Taikai/Otona no Watashi e
anime.synopsis:
After getting permission to show their film at the cultural festival, the Pastime Club fervently discusses what they plan to wear for the big event. The conversation soon takes to the next level, and the three girls begin to put their costume ideas to the test.

The Film Studies Club decides to write letters to their future selves in 15 years on the Macintosh computer donated by Chisato Higuchi's father. Despite setting ambitious goals and promises, reality turns out different than they expected.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received as a fun and fitting end to the Asobi Asobase series. While some find the humor slightly less impactful than the original, the consistent tone, references, and enjoyable characters provide a satisfying experience for fans. The OVA serves as a lighthearted conclusion, celebrating the series' strengths.
pros: Consistent humor with the original series.
Excellent voice acting and sound design.
Enjoyable references and parodies.
Fun and endearing conclusion to the anime.
cons: Sketches not as funny as original series.
No real story progression.
Slightly slacked off art compared to the original.

anime.title: Devils Line: Anytime Anywhere
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Drama, Romance, Seinen, Supernatural, Vampire
anime.synopsis: Bundled with the limited edition of the manga' 12th compiled volume.
anime.consensus_summary: This OVA is primarily aimed at existing fans of 'Devils Line' who want to delve deeper into Anzai's backstory. It's not recommended for newcomers as it relies heavily on prior knowledge of the main series. While it doesn't significantly advance the plot, it offers enjoyable insights into the main character's past, making it a worthwhile addition for dedicated viewers.
pros: Develops Anzai's past
Good for fans of the series
Same quality as the original series
cons: Not a stand-alone episode
Barely develops the plot
Adds almost nothing to the continuation of the story

anime.title: Girly Air Force
anime.synopsis:
Kei Narutani and his childhood friend, Song Minghua, are Chinese refugees who are fleeing from the Zai, a mysterious organization that indiscriminately terrorizes their country and its people. Fortunately, during their escape to Japan, they are saved by a strange red aircraft.

Kei's fascination with this aircraft leads him to meet his savior: a girl who is an "Anima"—the pilot of a unique type of airplane called a "Daughter." The girl goes by Gripen, an adorable JAS-39F fighter aircraft. Kei develops a bond with Gripen and is then recruited by the Japan Self-Defense Force to help Gripen overcome her troubles with flying.

Later joined by Eagle, a carefree F-15J-ANM, and Phantom, a proud RF-4EJ-ANM, the squadron takes up arms, determined to protect humanity. Together, the five individuals battle against the invasive Zai, forming the last line of defense against the threatening alien force.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Girly Air Force' is viewed as a mediocre anime with a weak plot and shallow characters, despite some redeeming qualities in its visuals and action sequences. Many find the storyline unoriginal and the characters underdeveloped, resulting in a generally unmemorable experience. While some viewers enjoyed the dogfights and character interactions, the majority felt the show failed to live up to its potential, leaving them with unfulfilled expectations and unanswered questions.
pros: Enjoyable dogfights with well-done CGI and animation.
Appealing character designs and voice acting.
Some found the interactions between characters endearing.
The opening theme Break the Blue is catchy and great.
cons: Weak and unoriginal plot with many cliches.
Poor character development and shallow backstories.
Slow pacing and incomplete story arcs.
Underwhelming music and OST.
Poor integration of CGI with the rest of the visuals.
Unexplained antagonist.

anime.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War
anime.romaji_title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunousen
anime.synopsis:
At the renowned Shuchiin Academy, Miyuki Shirogane and Kaguya Shinomiya are the student body's top representatives. Ranked the top student in the nation and respected by peers and mentors alike, Miyuki serves as the student council president. Alongside him, the vice president Kaguya—eldest daughter of the wealthy Shinomiya family—excels in every field imaginable. They are the envy of the entire student body, regarded as the perfect couple.

However, despite both having already developed feelings for the other, neither are willing to admit them. The first to confess loses, will be looked down upon, and will be considered the lesser. With their honor and pride at stake, Miyuki and Kaguya are both equally determined to be the one to emerge victorious on the battlefield of love!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Kaguya-sama: Love is War. Some praise its comedic timing, stylish direction, and character synergy, while others criticize its repetitive jokes, shallow characters, and thin plot.
