The show is considered overhyped by some, leading to disappointment despite its initial appeal.
pros: Stylistic direction and audiovisual flair enhance the comedic timing.
Characters have great synergy and chemistry, making the antics enjoyable.
Unconventional approach to the rom-com genre offers a fresh experience.
cons: Repetitive jokes and gags become stale, lacking originality.
Characters are often one-dimensional tropes with little development.
The plot is thin, relying on contrived scenarios and forced drama.
Overhyped by the community, leading to disappointment for some viewers.
Dubbing is poorly done, with excessive explanations that feel like filler.

anime.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
anime.genres: Action, Award Winning, Historical, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ever since the death of his father, the burden of supporting the family has fallen upon Tanjirou Kamado's shoulders. Though living impoverished on a remote mountain, the Kamado family are able to enjoy a relatively peaceful and happy life. One day, Tanjirou decides to go down to the local village to make a little money selling charcoal. On his way back, night falls, forcing Tanjirou to take shelter in the house of a strange man, who warns him of the existence of flesh-eating demons that lurk in the woods at night.

When he finally arrives back home the next day, he is met with a horrifying sight—his whole family has been slaughtered. Worse still, the sole survivor is his sister Nezuko, who has been turned into a bloodthirsty demon. Consumed by rage and hatred, Tanjirou swears to avenge his family and stay by his only remaining sibling. Alongside the mysterious group calling themselves the Demon Slayer Corps, Tanjirou will do whatever it takes to slay the demons and protect the remnants of his beloved sister's humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: Kimetsu no Yaiba is visually stunning, thanks to Ufotable's animation, and provides an entertaining experience for fans of the genre. However, critics find the storyline predictable and the characters underdeveloped, contributing to it being considered overrated by some. While appreciated for its action and faithful manga adaptation, the series struggles with originality and depth.
pros: High-quality animation and visual presentation by Ufotable.
Faithful adaptation of the manga.
Action-packed and entertaining.
cons: Simplistic and predictable plot.
Overused shonen tropes.
Shallow characters with little development.
Repetitive fight sequences.

anime.title: Asobi Asobase Specials
anime.synopsis:
Ototo
On their way home from school, the Pastime Club encounters Hanako Honda's younger brother, Kentarou. The timid yet studious boy introduces himself to Hanako's friends but quickly attempts to leave the awkward situation. However, he is roped into joining the three girls to have some fun at the park.

Amusutorongu
Chisato Higuchi's spontaneous question of which Pastime Club member is the strongest leads to a fierce arm-wrestling contest—spurred further by some underhanded methods.
anime.consensus_summary: The Asobi Asobase Specials are well-received by fans of the original series, delivering more of the same humor and style. While they may not add significant depth or story progression, they offer enjoyable and worthwhile content. The animation and voice acting are praised, although some find the first special weaker and the artwork slightly rushed.
pros: Continues the humor and style of the original series.
Enjoyable and worthwhile content, unlike some specials.
Excellent animation and voice acting.
cons: No real story progression.
The first special isn't as strong as the second.
Artwork might seem rushed compared to the original series.

anime.title: Bungo Stray Dogs 3
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Detective, Mystery, Organized Crime, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Following the conclusion of the three-way organizational war, government bureaucrat Ango Sakaguchi recalls an event that transpired years ago, after the death of the former Port Mafia boss. Osamu Dazai, still a new recruit at the time, was tasked with investigating rumors related to a mysterious explosion that decimated part of the city years ago—and its connection to the alleged reappearance of the former boss.

Due to circumstances out of his control, he is partnered with Chuuya Nakahara, the gifted yet impulsive leader of a rival clan known as the Sheep, to uncover the truth behind the case and shine a light on the myth of Arahabaki—the god of fire who might just lead Dazai to the case's solution.

Meanwhile, in the present day, it is business as usual once again for the Armed Detective Agency. Their peaceful break will not last for long, however, as enemies old and new gather their strength and prepare for another face-off.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Bungou Stray Dogs 3rd Season are divided. While many praise the well-developed characters, exciting plot, and blend of action and comedy, others criticize the inconsistencies in tone and pacing, rushed plot towards the end of the season, and backstories that don't always integrate well into the overarching plot.  The season's quality is seen as a step down from previous installments by some viewers.
pros: Well-developed characters with interesting personalities and abilities.
Exciting plot that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats.
Good blend of action and comedic elements.
Awesome animation quality.
cons: Inconsistencies in tone and pacing.
Rushed plot towards the end of the season.
Backstories that don't always integrate well into the overarching plot.
Uneven animation quality.

anime.title: Strike Witches: 501st JOINT FIGHTER WING Take Off!
anime.synopsis: Yoshika Miyafuji joins the 501st Joint Fighter Wing, a defense unit specializing in taking down alien beings known as the Neuroi. However, in days of no invasion, she and the members of the unit are taking down day to day tasks like cooking and laundry.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Strike Witches: 501 Butai Hasshin Shimasu!' as a comedic spin-off, especially if they are already fans of the original series. While some note the simplistic animation, many find it adds to the charm and humor. It's primarily appreciated for its lighthearted take on familiar characters and situations, though it may not appeal to newcomers seeking a standalone story.
pros: Effective parody of the original Strike Witches series.
Humorous and engaging despite the simple animation style.
The comedic simplicity complements the show's lighthearted nature.
Enjoyable for fans of the original series, offering a different take on familiar characters.
Refreshing and funny, especially for viewers familiar with the Strike Witches universe.
cons: May not appeal to viewers unfamiliar with the original Strike Witches series.
Simple animation style may be a drawback for some viewers.
Lack of a strong overarching story.
Relies heavily on pre-existing knowledge of the characters and setting.

anime.title: Strike Witches: Road to Berlin
anime.synopsis:
Preparations for a new offensive against the Neuroi—a mysterious race of alien invaders—are well underway. The objective is securing Berlin, the capital city of the Empire of Karlsland, which is necessary for wiping out the Neuroi threat from Europe. However, as the enemy is capable of adapting to the battlefield on a daily basis, the allied forces and the current state of Striker technology might not be enough to achieve a victory.

Meanwhile, Yoshika Miyafuji, a Witch from Fuso, continues her medical studies in Lausanne. Having recovered from a recent incident that deprived her of magical power, she is eager to assist in the war effort. The call to arms soon arrives and the scattered witches of the 501st Joint Fighter Wing must be gathered once again for a final push against the enemy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Fans generally appreciate the improved animation and adherence to the Strike Witches formula, but are critical of the repetitive plot, over-reliance on lore, and handling of Yoshika's character. Some viewers find the excessive fanservice distracting, while others enjoy it as part of the series' charm. Overall, the season is seen as enjoyable but lacks significant innovation or standout qualities.
pros: Improved animation quality, especially in action scenes and 3D models.
Faithful continuation of the Strike Witches formula, delivering what fans expect.
Enjoyable character-focused episodes, particularly those spotlighting specific witches.
Strong opening and ending themes.
Accurate portrayal of WWII elements (planes, ships, tanks, sounds).
cons: Repetitive plot elements and story structures within the season.
Over-reliance on established lore at the expense of character drama.
Inconsistent sound effects and music quality compared to previous seasons.
Uninspired script with a lack of emotional impact.
Heavy use of fanservice that overshadows plot progression for some viewers.
The handling of Yoshika's character, including repeatedly nerfing her abilities and a deus ex machina resolution.

anime.title: League of Nations Air Force Aviation Magic Band Luminous Witches
anime.romaji_title: Renmei Kuugun Koukuu Mahou Ongakutai Luminous Witches
anime.synopsis:
As the united world fights for its freedom against the alien forces known as the Neuroi, human girls with magical abilities—called witches—continue to battle. With the persisting conflict affecting morale, Grace Maitland Steward, a retired witch who still serves in the army, presents a plan advocating the power of music as an invaluable support that can change the tides of war.

Unfortunately, her proposal is written off, prompting Grace to find a way to prove the potential of her idea to her superiors. She enlists the help of Aila Paivikki Linnamaa and Eleonore Giovanna Gassion—two witches who have already seen some success as singers—to recruit other witches and form the League of Nations Air Force's Music Squadron.

The campaign manages to produce seven promising candidates. Among them, 14-year-old Virginia Robertson, despite having no military experience whatsoever, seems to possess an ability too significant to ignore.
anime.consensus_summary: Luminous Witches is a divisive show. Some viewers find it to be a heartwarming and emotionally resonant slice-of-life anime with endearing characters and good world-building, while others criticize its incoherent plot, rushed production, and poor visuals. The series' shift towards an idol show format also alienated some long-time fans of the franchise.
pros: Strong emotional impact and heartwarming moments.
Endearing characters with well-developed bonds.
Good world-building that complements the rest of the series.
Music complements the historical era and setting (in some cases).
High quality animation (excluding CG).
cons: Incoherent plot with conflicts that are started and ignored.
Rushed production with missing concert scenes and dialogue dumps.
Terrible backgrounds with perspective issues and low-res assets.
Clunky and jarring CGI.
Pacing issues and a simple, predictable main story.

anime.title: Re:Stage! Dream Days♪
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Mana Shikimiya has just transferred into Marehoshi Academy, a school which requires each of its students to join one of the many sports or cultural clubs. After a quick tour of most of the clubs by the Student Council Vice President Minori Hasegawa, Mana stumbles upon the Lyrical Tradition Dance Club. There she meets its sole members: Mizuha Ichikishima and Sayu Tsukisaka. Drawn to their singing and dancing, Mana joins the club and together they work towards their dream of winning the Prism Stage—a national competition to determine the top idols of the country.

However, before Mana and her new friends can worry about the Prism Stage, there is a more immediate problem at hand: the club is about to be disbanded by the student council! Without enough members or any notable achievements, the club will be shut down and the members' dreams will be over before they've begun to pursue them. It's up to the three of them to find the additional club members they need and become an idol group strong enough to qualify for the Prism Stage and to win it as well.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Re:Stage! Dream Days♪, particularly praising its visuals and music. However, some find the storyline and character development to be unoriginal and formulaic compared to other idol anime. Overall, it's considered a pleasant watch for fans of the genre despite its predictable elements.
pros: Great art style and animation, especially during performances.
Catchy songs and well-designed characters.
Enjoyable for fans of idol anime.
cons: Basic and predictable story.
Standard character development with minimal drama.
Similar to other idol anime, lacking innovation.

anime.title: Beatless Final Stage
anime.synopsis:
Arato Endou and his faithful hIE, Lacia, have come together once again to show the world that artificial intelligence, no matter how brilliant, can be shut down safely.

As they descend into the holding facility to confront Higgins, Lacia's AI creator, the pair must fend off enemies from all fronts. Among them are Snowdrop, a rampant hIE hellbent on devouring Higgins, and Methode, a hIE who seeks vengeance against Lacia. The world's super-intelligent AIs unanimously decide to terminate Lacia, whom they deem a threat to humanity.

With limited time and the odds stacked against them, will Arato and Lacia be able to truly join together in a society where humans and hIEs can coexist peacefully?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with Beatless Final Stage, citing wasted potential due to poor execution despite an interesting premise. Common complaints include underdeveloped characters, mediocre animation, and an overabundance of exposition that bogs down the narrative. While some viewers found enjoyment in the exploration of AI themes, the series ultimately fails to deliver a satisfying conclusion, leading to an overall lukewarm reception.
pros: Unique premise exploring AI integration into society.
Raises questions about the future of humans and AI.
Some viewers appreciated the AI/Machine learning aspects.
cons: Poor execution of interesting premise.
Generic and forgettable characters.
Mediocre animation and inconsistent art quality.
Pacing issues and excessive exposition.
Unsatisfying resolutions and lack of emotional depth.
Contrived plot conveniences and 'deus ex machina' solutions.
Underdeveloped romance.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sci-fi Romance, AI Ethics, Social Commentary

anime.title: Monster Strike the Animation
anime.synopsis: The Angelic Guard, who call the heavens their home, have been tasked with collecting the orbs scattered across the world. Lucifer—a leader of the Angelic Guard with a rebellious streak, said to wield power rivaling the Almighty—carries out her duty along with Uriel, also a leader of the guard. Together, they go about executing their mission, until Holy Magistrate Keter—the one who leads the heavens under the Almighty's will—tells Uriel of Lucifer's planned rebellion. Initially in disbelief, Uriel then learns that the accusations against Lucifer may be connected to an event that once threatened to shatter the heavens.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the series to be a loosely connected continuation of the Monster Strike series, with interesting but theologically inaccurate takes on Christian folklore.  The first arc, focusing on Lucifer, presents a grounded story of corruption and betrayal, but subsequent arcs have bizarre plot elements. Overall, the audience sentiment leans towards mild interest with reservations.
pros: Interesting section telling a pretty grounded and human story about corruption within positions of power and betrayal.
cons: Theologically inaccurate.
Bizarre plot elements.

anime.title: Trouble in Monster Strike
anime.synopsis:
Oragon lived a lonely life all by himself, until one day he was pulled into a mysterious new dimension. There he learns that an incredibly powerful enemy will attack in six months, destroying his beloved Monster Strike forever! Now Oragon must gather allies in the Strike World to save Monster Strike!

It is animated in full CG unlike its predecessor.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is a standalone introduction to a new Monster Strike anime series featuring Oragon. It serves as a framing device, setting up the premise of the new series.  Audience reception is mixed due to timeline ambiguity and heavy product placement.
cons: Unclear timeline placement within the Monster Strike franchise.
Episode primarily serves as a framing device for a new anime series.
Thematic shift from the original anime (friendship) may disappoint some viewers.

anime.title: Free! Dive to the Future Episode 0
anime.romaji_title: Free! Dive to the Future: Soushun no Build-up!
anime.synopsis:
As they adjust to life in Tokyo, Haruka Nanase and Makoto Tachibana prepare for their university's opening ceremony. However, while running some errands, they find themselves representing Iwatobi in a regional mascot wrestling tournament. Unbeknownst to them, the rest of the Iwatobi and Samezuka swim club members are watching the event's live broadcast at a local festival.

While also adapting to the quick change of pace, Ikuya Kirishima and Hiyori Toono discuss what moving from the countryside to the city was like.

Crossing paths with old friends on the bustling streets of Tokyo, the curtain rises on a new chapter in the boys' lives.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the episode as a fun and lighthearted addition to the Free! series, praising its comedic elements and character interactions. Some felt the story was less significant and missed the deeper emotional tones, while others appreciated the fan service and lightheartedness. The episode serves as a pleasant prequel, setting the stage for the next season.
pros: Hilarious and fun episode.
Great animation and art style.
Enjoyable character interactions and new beginnings.
Good music, especially the ending theme.
Satisfying fan service with handsome characters.
The Iwatobi-chan Mascot Sumo sequence.
cons: Story not very important or transcendent.
Character payoff for returning characters is lacking.
Episode feels different, more comedy-focused than drama.
Lack of Rin's presence in the episode.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, Fan Service

anime.title: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! - Legend of Crimson
anime.romaji_title: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Movie: Kurenai Densetsu
anime.synopsis:
It is not strange that the Demon Lord's forces fear the Crimson Demons, the clan from which Megumin and Yunyun originate. Even if the Demon Lord's generals attack their village, the Crimson Demons can just easily brush them off with their supreme mastery of advanced and overpowered magic.

When Yunyun receives a seemingly serious letter regarding a potential disaster coming to her hometown, she immediately informs Kazuma Satou and the rest of his party. After a series of wacky misunderstandings, it turns out to be a mere prank by her fellow demon who wants to be an author. Even so, Megumin becomes worried about her family and sets out toward the Crimson Demons' village with the gang.

There, Kazuma and the others decide to sightsee the wonders of Megumin's birthplace. However, they soon come to realize that the nonsense threat they received might have been more than just a joke.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is well-received by fans of the Konosuba series, offering more of the same humor and character interactions they enjoy. While the story is not particularly strong and the animation quality is inconsistent, the movie is generally considered a fun and satisfying addition to the franchise. Some critics point out the over-reliance on familiar tropes and the lack of significant plot development.
pros: Humor is on point and consistent with the show.
Character interactions are a goldmine of laughs.
Animation and art got an obvious upgrade from a movie budget (compared to the TV series).
The movie balances comedy with serious moments and character development.
cons: Story is simple and not particularly special; relies on familiar Konosuba tropes.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with some scenes looking like the TV show and lacking detail.
Some jokes felt forced or out of place in the later part of the movie.
The resolution of the main villain felt too stupid.
Over-reliance on recycled jokes and character tropes (Darkness's masochism, Kazuma's perversion, Aqua's self-absorption, Megumin's explosions).

anime.title: ENDRO!
anime.synopsis:
In a world of adventurers and magic lies Naral Island. Every generation, a Demon Lord rises to plague the land, and every generation, a Hero is born to subdue him. For countless centuries, the cycle has repeated with no end in sight. The latest Hero, Juulia "Yusha" Charldetto, has almost completed her valiant campaign alongside her party members: responsible priest Seiran "Seira" Élénoir, enigmatic mage Meiza "Mei" Endust, and hyper-energetic warrior Fai Fai.

In the final battle against the Demon Lord, Yusha's party attempt a risky spell to cast their enemy into the drifts of time. But the incantation goes awry, sending Yusha and her friends back to a time before the Demon Lord, before Yusha becomes the Hero, and before the party had even graduated as adventurers. With their memories of the future erased, the four girls restart their ambitions to become the Hero's Party, aspiring to defeat the Demon Lord.

However, in a sudden twist of fate, the Demon Lord was also sent back in time with her memories intact. Reduced to the form of a little girl, the Demon Lord takes the name Mao and infiltrates the adventurers' school as a teacher, planning to stop Yusha before she becomes a hero. Thus begins the story of Yusha and her friends, in their quest to defeat the Demon Lord, not knowing that the one they seek is right by their side.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Endro~! as a comfy and lighthearted CGDCT anime that parodies JRPG elements. While some find the plot weak and characters generic, most appreciate the show's humor, charming characters, and feel-good atmosphere. There is a minority who find the show too simplistic or overly cute, but overall the sentiment is positive.
pros: Charming and likeable characters with good chemistry.
Enjoyable, lighthearted comedy and parodies of JRPG tropes.
Appealing art style resembling a children's book or fairy tale.
Fun and memorable soundtrack.
cons: Generic or clichéd character tropes.
Weak or underdeveloped main plot.
Inconsistent story elements and pacing.
Some viewers found the humor and cuteness to be overdone or annoying.
anime.thematic_vibe: Cute Girls Doing Cute Things, JRPG Parody, Lighthearted Comedy

anime.title: Titipo
anime.synopsis: Say hi to Tayo's new friend - Titipo! Train Center's new born little train Titipo has just passed the driving examination and is prepared to work at the Train Village. Although Titipo dreams of becoming the best train in the world, his curious yet random personality catches him in unforeseen events and troubles everyday. Titipo expands his experience in the greater world and befriends Genie, Diesel, and other little trains. Will Titipo achieve his dream of becoming the best train? Come join the railroad journey and meet Titipo and the little train friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Titipo Titipo' to be a cute and simple show, especially for young children familiar with shows like 'Thomas and Friends'. However, some find the animation and plots to be somewhat lacking. The show's positive messages and focus on friendship are generally well-received, creating a generally positive, albeit not strongly enthusiastic, response.
pros: Cute and cheerful themes
Focus on helping others and proving worth
Colorful CGI animation
cons: Blocky and undefined train designs
Simple plots lacking depth
Generic soft music

anime.title: Zoo: Hidamari no Shi
anime.synopsis: A man makes a robot girl and tries to teach her the aspects of daily life. But what is his real goal?
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience mood is appreciative and touched by 'Zoo: Hidamari no Shi.' Viewers are impressed by the story's emotional depth and unique visual style, especially considering its short runtime and indie production. Any criticisms are focused on technical aspects like art and sound, but these do not detract significantly from the overall positive experience.
pros: Emotionally impactful story despite its short length.
Visually striking and unique aesthetic, especially for its time.
Intriguing narrative with well-hidden clues and a devastating reveal.
cons: Mediocre art, particularly in character designs.
Voice acting and sound design have some noticeable flaws.
Animation quality, while good for its time, may not appeal to modern viewers.

anime.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life
anime.genres: Drama, Music, Performing Arts, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Gen Kudou, a koto maker, believes that his delinquent grandson Chika would never understand the profoundness of the traditional musical instrument. In an attempt to make up for his naivety and understand the words of his late grandfather, Chika tries to join the Tokise High School Koto Club. 

Even though the club is in dire need of members, new club president Takezou Kurata is unwilling to easily accept Chika's application due to his bad reputation. Nonetheless, after seeing Chika's seriousness and enthusiasm, Takezou allows the problem child to join, along with koto prodigy Satowa Houzuki and three of Chika's energetic friends. Kono Oto Tomare! follows the merry band of musicians as they aspire to play at the national competition.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive towards 'Kono Oto Tomare!', praising its engaging story, character development, and introduction to the koto. Some find it generic and criticize pacing and animation inconsistencies. The anime is appreciated for its emotional depth and musical elements, though it doesn't universally achieve masterpiece status.
pros: Engaging storyline with dramatic character backstories.
Introduces viewers to the unique instrument, the koto.
Satisfying character development and teamwork.
Visually appealing art style with attention to detail, especially during musical performances.
Sound design, particularly the OST, enhances the emotional impact.
cons: Some find the plot predictable and similar to other sports/music anime.
Pacing issues, with a slow start and uneven development of certain characters.
Lack of emphasis on koto performances in some instances.
Inconsistent animation quality at times.
Over-reliance on clichés common in the genre.
anime.thematic_vibe: Musical Performance, Character Growth, High School Life

anime.title: Girls und Panzer das Finale – Part 2
anime.synopsis:
Despite having the upper hand, BC Freedom High School suffers a thorough defeat at the hands of Ooarai Girls Academy. Following their victory, the Ooarai girls decide to take a break before the next round. After discovering that Momo Kawashima is taking care of her family while studying for the university entrance exams, the rest of the Ooarai team become more determined to win the Winter Continuous Track Cup for the sake of Momo and her family.

Meanwhile, the second round of the tournament has started, and Ooarai now has to face Chi-Ha-Tan Academy. Having learned from the first round to not underestimate their enemies, Ooarai slowly approaches their opponent on the thick jungle battlefield.

Despite their best attempts to be cautious, Ooarai is immediately put in a difficult situation as Chi-Ha-Tan employs several new strategies devised by Haru Fukuda. Finding themselves between a rock and a hard place, Ooarai must claw their way out to claim another comeback victory and keep their championship hopes alive.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 2, praising its action, art, and sound. The film successfully continues the story with engaging tank battles and character development. Minor criticisms include pacing issues in the middle and repetitive musical cues, but overall, the film is well-received by fans.
pros: Excellent art and sound design, particularly the tank battle sounds
Seamless continuation from the previous installment.
Engaging tank battles with masterful tactics
Good character development, especially for the opponent teams
The storyline is easy to follow despite the fast-paced action
cons: Some found the middle part of the episode to feel rushed.
The Onion March montage was seen as repetitive by some viewers

anime.title: Xuan Yuan Sword Luminary
anime.synopsis: Yin and Ning are two sisters who have been wandering the land together ever since their village was destroyed by the villainous Taibai Empire. Their childhood friend, Zhao, has been enslaved by the Taibai himself, and uses his brilliance at tinkering and inventing to get by as a slave to the Empire's whims. One day, Yin accidentally discovers a legendary sword, which grants her fantastic abilities in combat, and allows her to summon a mystical, mechanical fox spirit named Yun, who is sworn to fight by her side. Meanwhile, Zhao is making fast friends with a mysterious young girl who just may hold a great amount of power within the Taibai Empire. As Zhao and the Fu sisters find themselves increasingly caught up in the Empire's battle for supremacy over the land, it will take all of the magic and might that the budding resistance armies can muster to turn the tide of war once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the unique story and soundtrack, while others criticize the poor execution, underdeveloped characters, and subpar animation. The show has potential but falls short due to various production and writing issues. Many find it to be a mediocre anime, with significant flaws.
pros: Use of real-life Chinese landscapes adds beauty.
Soundtrack is surprisingly entertaining.
Story is fairly unique and sparked interest.
cons: Mediocre execution failing to capitalize on the rich setting.
Underdeveloped side characters with nonsensical motives.
Poor CGI and underwhelming dialogue.
Superficial use of magic and engineering elements.
Disastrous scene changes and slow pacing.

anime.title: Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front - Babylonia
anime.romaji_title: Fate/Grand Order: Zettai Majuu Sensen Babylonia
anime.synopsis:
A.D. 2016, the foundations of humanity have been incinerated by the Mage King Solomon. Chaldea, a secret mages organization with the mission to preserve humanity's future, foresaw mankind's extinction in 2015. Thus commenced the operation to repair the Singularities in history caused by Holy Grails dispersed across time and space—Operation Grand Order. 

Using the Rayshift time travel technology, Chaldea's last master Ritsuka Fujimaru and his demi-servant Mash Kyrielight have traveled to and resolved six Singularities. Now, they depart for their most dangerous destination yet: a civilization in the Age of Gods, B.C. 2655 Mesopotamia. Ritsuka and Mash soon discover that Demonic Beasts roam the land, attacking people and towns. Amidst chaos and terror lies humanity's last defense—Uruk, a fortress city that acts as the frontline for the battle against the beasts. The battlefront is commanded by none other than King Gilgamesh, the King of Heroes, who sought aid from Heroic Spirits and took on the role of a mage to protect his city. 

Along with Gilgamesh and the summoned servants, Ritsuka and Mash must protect Uruk against the magical beasts' onslaught and defeat the Three Goddess Alliance who aims to eradicate humankind; all the while, a greater threat looms over Uruk, preparing for its awakening.
anime.consensus_summary: Fate/Grand Order: Zettai Majuu Sensen Babylonia is a well-received adaptation that captures the epic scale and engaging story of the game. The animation and fight sequences are highlights, though some criticize the CGI and underdeveloped protagonist. While prior knowledge of the Fate series isn't essential, it can enhance the viewing experience.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the game's story.
Visually stunning animation and fight sequences.
Well-developed characters, especially Gilgamesh.
Engaging story that doesn't require prior knowledge of the Fate series (though it helps).
Excellent soundtrack and sound design.
cons: CGI can be jarring and detract from the visuals.
Some plot points may be confusing without background knowledge of the Fate universe.
The protagonist, Ritsuka, is underdeveloped and bland.
The adaptation removes some content from the game.
Mash is kind of useless most of the time.

anime.title: Fate/Grand Order: Divine Realm of the Round Table - Camelot Wandering; Agateram
anime.romaji_title: Fate/Grand Order: Shinsei Entaku Ryouiki Camelot 1 - Wandering; Agateram
anime.synopsis:
The wandering knight, Bedivere, reaches the end of his journey.

The year is A.D. 1273 in Jerusalem.

The Holy Land has been transformed into a massive desert, the people have been forced out of their homes, and three major powers wage war with each other in this wasteland. The Knights of the Round Table come together to protect the Holy City and their Lion King. With the whole of his kingdom summoned into a strange land, Ozymandias, the Sun-King, quietly plots against the tyranny of this bizarre realm.

The mountain people, protectors of those who were stripped of their land, await their chance at rebellion. In order to fulfill his mission, Bedivere heads for the Holy City where the Lion King rules. There he meets humanity’s final Master, Ritsuka Fujimaru, who has come to Jerusalem, accompanied by his Demi-Servant, Mash Kyrielight, in their quest to restore human history.

Bedivere joins with Fujimaru and his companions to undertake this quest.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on this adaptation, with many praising its stunning visuals and music while heavily criticizing its rushed pacing and plot issues. While fans of the game appreciate seeing their favorite characters animated, newcomers often find the story incomprehensible and underdeveloped. The film is seen as a visually impressive but narratively flawed experience.
pros: Visually stunning scenery and art style, with gorgeous environment designs that reflect the people.
Excellent animation quality, especially during Noble Phantasm sequences and character designs.
Strong musical score with well-timed OSTs that enhance the atmosphere and evoke nostalgia.
The voice acting cast is amazing and delivers exceptional performances.
cons: Plot is rushed and lacks proper pacing, with excessive dialogue and underdeveloped character interactions.
Significant plot points, important characters, and major fight scenes were cut from the adaptation.
New characters are generic and not very engaging, with underdeveloped motivations.
The story is not well-explained for new viewers, making it difficult to understand the premise without prior knowledge of the game.
Animation for male servants and some character designs are criticized as being off-model or exaggerated.

anime.title: Fate/Grand Order: Divine Realm of the Round Table - Camelot Paladin; Agateram
anime.romaji_title: Fate/Grand Order: Shinsei Entaku Ryouiki Camelot 2 - Paladin; Agateram
anime.synopsis:
"This time for sure, I will kill my king with my own hands..."

Jerusalem, 1273 A.D. Here, both the wandering knight, Bedivere, and Chaldea’s own expedition find the Sixth Singularity. The residents of this desolate land have been driven from their homes as three opposing powers battle for control of the land.

Bedivere and company seek the help of the Mountain People to rise up against the Lion King and the Knights of the Round Table and combat their slaughter of innocents. After a deadly struggle and the loss of a dear friend, the group approaches Ozymandias, the Sun King, whose incredible power could help them turn the tables. In the halls of this great pharaoh, they desperately seek an alliance. Ozymandias, however, reveals the Lion King’s plans and refuses to assist in foiling them, instead wishing to protect his own people.

Shaken to their core by the revelation of the Lion King’s true intentions, Bedivere and the Chaldean expedition decide to mount an attack on Camelot itself, hoping to put an end to the Lion King’s schemes.

At last, the day of the final battle in the Holy City arrives.

What are the true intentions of the Lion King, who has become so cold-blooded and diabolical?
How can humanity be saved from a world where ruin has been already promised?
What will become of Bedivere after shouldering the burden of a sin that can never be pardoned?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with fans of the source material appreciating the improved story and emotional impact but criticizing the rushed pacing and inconsistent animation. New viewers may find the plot confusing. While the film features impressive animation, several reviewers noted the movie has poor character development.
pros: Impressive animation and OST, especially during fight scenes (sakuga).
Significant improvement in story, character development, and pacing compared to the first movie.
Emotional impact is strong, particularly for those familiar with the game's story.
cons: Pacing is still rushed, with some scenes feeling disjointed or skipped over.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with budget cuts evident in some fight scenes and outsourced animation.
Character interactions are weak, and motivations are not always clear, especially for viewers unfamiliar with the source material.
Adaptation cuts content, diminishing the experience for fans familiar with the game's story

anime.title: Digimon Adventure: Last Evolution Kizuna
anime.synopsis:
As the Chosen Children and their partner Digimon live happily together in the human world, Taichi Yagami and Yamato Ishida, alongside their friends, dedicate themselves to maintaining this hard-earned peace. Though united by this innate responsibility, each one has already started to take their first steps toward a future beyond being a Chosen Child. 

However, this new journey is interrupted by the appearance of Menoa Bellucci, an American professor specializing in Digimon research. She bears news of several Chosen Children from around the world being found comatose, with their partner Digimon nowhere to be found. Menoa's investigations indicate that a new breed of Digimon is behind the alarming phenomenon: Eosmon, who hides within the internet's depths. 

To succeed in this mission, the team must endeavor through the growing distance between them and band together one last time.
anime.consensus_summary: Digimon Adventure: Last Evolution Kizuna deeply resonates with long-time fans due to its nostalgic callbacks and emotional exploration of growing up. While praised for its character designs and animation faithful to the original series, some find the storyline rushed, inconsistent, and overly focused on a few main characters. The controversial ending, which involves parting ways with Digimon partners, polarizes viewers, creating mixed opinions on whether it serves as a worthy conclusion to the franchise.
pros: Beautiful sendoff to the original series and characters
Addresses mature themes of growing up and parting ways
Strong emotional core and nostalgic elements resonate with long-time fans
Character designs and animation stay true to the original series
Music evokes strong nostalgic memories of early 2000s Digimon
cons: Story feels rushed at times with underdeveloped plot points
Focuses mainly on Taichi and Yamato, sidelining other characters
Inconsistencies with established Digimon lore (e.g., Digimon Savers contradicts plot)
Some viewers found the ending depressing or unsatisfying
CG animation in villain appears unpolished toward the end
Plot elements feel derivative of other works (Summer Wars)

anime.title: Welcome, Chitose
anime.synopsis: Chitose-chan is a penguin who lives in Kyoto. Getting in touch with people and getting fed delicious food as she curiously walks around Kyoto streets is her favourite thing to do. The story features popular places in Kyoto like Kiyomizu Temple, Ginkaku Temple, and Gion from the Penguin's point of view. This is a short story about a penguin that is nostalgic and warm, curing and relieving the heart.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, emphasizing the show's cuteness, heartwarming nature, and soothing qualities. Viewers appreciate the expressive main character and the show's ability to evoke nostalgia. The main critiques revolve around the short episode length and the reuse of voice actors, but these are minor issues compared to the overall positive reception.
pros: Adorable and enjoyable series
Expressive and cute main character
Soothing and healing impression
Wholesome and light watch
Nicely done plot for each episode
cons: Episodes are too short
Reuse of voice actors

anime.title: Cinderella Nine
anime.synopsis: Tsubasa Arihara loves baseball so much, she actually started her high school's baseball club! But passion alone won't keep a club alive, so it's up to her to recruit as many all-star players as she can. Some potential recruits have never played before while others have returned to the game thanks to Tsubasa's love for the sport, and together they'll form a team united in love for the game as much as their growing friendship. But whether they win or lose, one thing is for sure: every game they play together is sure to be a home run!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some viewers finding enjoyment in the characters and their interactions, while others criticize the show for its generic plot, poor animation quality, and lack of depth. The show is seen as a typical cute-girls-doing-cute-things sports anime, but fails to stand out due to its numerous flaws. While some appreciate the themes of friendship and teamwork, the overall consensus is that the anime is mediocre and forgettable.
pros: Appealing character designs (when not derpy)
Some character development is decent
Inclusion of diverse characters is appreciated
cons: Generic and clichéd plot
Inconsistent and low-quality animation with frequent derp faces
Weak character development for most of the cast
Boring and predictable story
Overused emotional BGM
Poor lip syncing
Shallow and uninspired writing

anime.title: MIX
anime.genres: Drama, Romance, School, Shounen, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis:
Because of the legend left by Tatsuya Uesugi, Meisei Academy High School was well-known for their strong baseball team. But 26 years after their glory, the team has not been able to keep their record and has since lost their fame.

Two stepbrothers, Souichirou and Touma Tachibana, aim to revive of the once-strong Meisei Academy baseball team and enter the National High School Baseball Championship.

Souichirou and Touma are second years in Meisei Academy Middle School. Both boys are talented baseball players. Souichirou has shown excellent skill as a catcher and batter. Though having an extraordinary skill as a pitcher, Touma no longer pitches due to a certain reason.

Once the two enter high school, they pair as a battery and aim to enter the National High School Baseball Championship!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with nostalgia and solid production values being highlights. However, the storyline is considered bland and the character development weak. Many feel the ending is unsatisfying and that the series doesn't live up to the standards of Adachi Mitsuru's previous works like 'Touch'.
pros: Good animation quality
Nostalgic art style
Enjoyable music
Solid storytelling (referencing Mitsuru Adachi's works)
Well-executed dub on Funimation (though later issues arose)
cons: Storyline can be bland and repetitive
Character development is lacking, characters feel like blank slates
Inconclusive ending with not enough substance
Pacing issues throughout the first season
Audio mixing issues with loud background music in the subbed version
Too few episodes (24)

anime.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets
anime.synopsis:
Fuutarou Uesugi is an ace high school student, but leads an otherwise tough life. His standoffish personality and reclusive nature have left him friendless, and his father is debt-ridden, forcing his family to scrape by.

One day during his lunch break, Uesugi argues with a female transfer student who has claimed "his seat," leading both of them to dislike each other. That same day, he is presented with a golden opportunity to clear his family's debt: a private tutoring gig for a wealthy family's daughter, with a wage of five times the market price. He accepts the proposal, but is horrified to discover that the client, Itsuki Nakano, is the girl he confronted earlier! 

After unsuccessfully trying to get back on Itsuki's good side, Uesugi finds out that his problems don't end there: Itsuki is actually a quintuplet, so in addition to her, he must also tutor her sisters—Miku, Yotsuba, Nino, and Ichika—who, despite the very real threat of flunking, want nothing to do with a tutor. However, his family's livelihood is on the line so Uesugi pushes on, adamant in his resolve to rid the sisters of their detest for studying and successfully lead them to graduation.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers found the series enjoyable due to its cute characters, comedic moments, and mystery. Others criticized it for relying on generic harem tropes, a bland main character, and a predictable storyline, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Cute and lovable characters, each with unique personalities
Engaging comedy moments
Consistent and pleasing art style
Unique premise of quintuplets with different personalities
Mystery element of who the main character will marry
cons: Generic harem tropes and cliches
Bland main character
Predictable storyline
Repetitive or annoying character behaviors
Lack of significant plot progression

anime.title: My Roommate is a Cat
anime.romaji_title: Doukyonin wa Hiza, Tokidoki, Atama no Ue.
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Pets, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Subaru Mikazuki is a 23-year-old mystery novel author, major introvert, and an awkwardly shy person. He would much rather stay home to read a book than go outside and interact with others. Further exacerbating this life of solitude, his parents tragically died in an accident many years ago, leaving him alone in the world. 

One day, while giving offerings at his parents' grave, Subaru runs into a small grey and white cat named Haru, which he ends up taking home with him. Subaru, however, has never taken care of anyone else in his life—can he even take care of a cat? Haru is grateful toward Subaru, as he gives her all the food she wants—a luxury for a cat who is used to a rough life on the streets. But she notices that Subaru can't even seem to take care of himself! Will she be okay with this dunce? 

Doukyonin wa Hiza, Tokidoki, Atama no Ue. tells the story of an unlikely friendship between a human and a cat who try to foster an understanding with each other.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally found 'My Roommate is a Cat' to be a heartwarming and touching anime. Many viewers related to the characters and appreciated the dual perspective storytelling. Some criticisms were focused on repetitive elements and simplistic comedy, but overall, the show is viewed positively as a 'hidden gem' within the slice of life genre.
pros: The dual perspective storytelling (human and cat) provides unique insights.
Characters are well-developed and relatable, especially Subaru's growth.
The show explores themes of loneliness, family, and personal growth effectively.
The anime is a hidden gem with a heartwarming and touching story.
The show is lighthearted, cute, and wholesome.
cons: Some find the flashbacks and sob stories repetitive and annoying.
The comedy relies on basic slapstick, which some find uninspired and detracting.
Side characters are underdeveloped, hindering the show's overall impact.
Animation quality is inconsistent at times.

anime.title: Namuamidabutsu! -Utena-
anime.synopsis: Long before superheroes, there were legends. One of them begins with Shaka Nyorai, whose bravery and enlightenment once saved humanity forever. But forever is fleeting because Mara, the personification of Earthly desires, forges a corrupt coalition with the devil to again visit wrath and vengeance upon humankind. To counter Mara's cruel attack, Taishakuten and Bonten, divine beings, must join forces with the Thirteen Buddhas. Can the allied powers of light defeat the vicious onslaught and save humankind in their darkest hour?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Namu Amida Butsu! Rendai Utena' to be an average, visually pleasing anime with a weak plot and shallow characters. It's appreciated for its comedy and the appeal of its bishounen cast, making it suitable for casual viewing. However, viewers seeking a deep, engaging narrative are likely to be disappointed, as the story and character development lack substance.
pros: Visually appealing characters and aesthetics
Competent voice acting and sound effects
Enjoyable for lighthearted entertainment and male eye candy
cons: Superficial plot and character development
Rushed conflict resolution
Lacking emotional depth and memorable story elements
Budgetary constraints hinder potential

anime.title: Circlet Princess
anime.synopsis:
Virtual Reality and the arrival of Circlet Technology has changed people's lives. A new competitive electronic sport called Circlet Bout emerges, and schools duel to determine the strongest Circlet Bout Club and player. One day, Yuuka Sasaki gets mistaken for a challenger and battles against Chikage Fujimura, the best player in Japan, tying the intense fight despite her inexperience. These events lead to her passion for the sport, deciding to become a Circlet Bout player. 

Two years later, Yuuka moves to Tokyo and enrolls in Union School, a place where she can practice and pursue her dream of fighting Chikage again. After her arrival at the Union School, she discovers the club closed. Now her first goal is to help the athletic Miyuki Kasahara and club manager Ayumu Aizawa reopen Union's Circle Bout Club and return it to its former glory.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely considered below average due to its uninspired plot, weak characters, and low-budget animation. While some find it a decent time-waster with fun moments, the consensus leans towards disappointment. Many highlight the unoriginality and lack of depth in both story and character development.
pros: Decent OP music.
Fun and cute moments.
cons: Weak plot and poor writing.
Uninspired character designs and development.
Mediocre animation and frequent repeated frames.
Poor virtual reality representation.

anime.title: Case File nº221: Kabukicho
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Detective, Drama, Mystery
anime.synopsis:
In Shinjuku ward's east side lies Kabukichou, a vibrant city of chaos that glows brilliantly with neon lights but also hides unseen darkness. Employed at a university hospital on the west side, John H. Watson is looking for someone who can assist him with an odd case. His search leads him to the Pipe Cat, an underground bar that serves as a meetup venue and job board for some of the best detectives in Shinjuku, the most prominent among them being Sherlock Holmes.

Upon finding the bar and meeting the peculiar investigators, John learns that they are pursuing a case involving Jack the Ripper, an infamous serial killer. Due to subsequent events, John ends up driving Sherlock to the crime scene of a murder supposedly carried out by Jack the Ripper. Even though John is only there to enlist Sherlock's help with his case, he witnesses Sherlock brilliantly uncover the truth behind the crime scene. However, he begins to realize that Sherlock is not only a genius detective but also an eccentric character.

As John continues to request Sherlock to assist him with his case, he finds himself spiraling into the detective lifestyle of solving cases beyond the minds of ordinary civilians. Through this work, John begins to see the true colors of the chaotic city that is Kabukichou and starts to unravel the unsettling mystery behind his own case.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is polarized. Some appreciate the show's unique take on Sherlock Holmes, quirky characters, and surprising plot twists, while others find it a fragmented mess with inconsistent tone and disappointing characterization. The first half is slow, but some viewers suggest it develops into a deeper, darker story later on.
pros: Unique and quirky characters with surprising depth.
Twisty plot with unexpected turns and a deeper story than initially perceived.
Good music and art that fit the atmosphere.
cons: Fragmented and messy plot, especially in the second half.
Inconsistent tone that struggles between comedy, mystery, and drama.
Dreadful characterization and deviation from the essence of Sherlock Holmes.
Slow start with uninteresting episodic cases.
Uneven pacing and boring mysteries in the second half.

anime.title: Rinshi!! Ekodachan
anime.synopsis: Ekoda-chan lives much like any other 24-year-old in the neighborhood of Ekoda. Preferring to lounge around naked whenever possible, Ekoda-chan spends her time between temporary jobs fooling around with lizards, men, and anything else that comes her way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the show's experimental nature and relatable protagonist, while others find the lack of narrative and unconventional format off-putting. The behind-the-scenes content is a point of interest for some. Overall, the show seems to have a niche appeal.
pros: Diverse animation styles offer unique visual experiences.
The skits effectively establish Ekoda-chan as a relatable character.
Behind-the-scenes features add an extra layer of interest.
cons: Anthology format lacks narrative cohesion.
The interview portion may not appeal to all viewers.
Unconventional style may alienate some viewers.

anime.title: We Never Learn: BOKUBEN
anime.synopsis:
Nariyuki Yuiga, an impoverished third-year high school student, works tirelessly to receive the VIP nomination, a scholarship that would cover all of his college tuition fees. In recognition of his hard work, the headmaster awards him the renowned scholarship.

However, this scholarship is given under one condition: he must tutor the school's geniuses in their weakest subjects! Joining his new brigade of pupils are the math maestro Rizu Ogata, who wants to study humanities; the literature legend Fumino Furuhashi, who wants to study science; and Yuiga's sports-savvy childhood friend, Uruka Takemoto, who is hopeless at everything else.

Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai follows Yuiga as he tries to teach his three eccentric tutees in a series of strange and comedic antics. But as Ogata's and Furuhashi's ambitions conflict with their talents, will Yuiga be able to help his students achieve their dreams?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on 'Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai'. Some find it an enjoyable and well-executed harem anime with lovable characters and good comedic moments. However, others criticize it for being unoriginal, generic, and predictable, ultimately just serving as an advertisement for the manga. The 'waifu wars' aspect and differing preferences contribute to the polarized reception.
pros: Enjoyable characters with lovable personalities.
Good production value, especially facial expressions.
Equal character development for all the girls, making the 'best girl' choice difficult.
Hilarious story line and well-executed comedic moments.
cons: Story is not original and predictable.
The show is generic and doesn’t offer anything new.
Can be considered as an advertisement for the manga.
Some may find the premise too similar to other harem anime.

anime.title: Sakugan
anime.synopsis:
The "Labyrinth" is an expansive space deep underground where humans live in clusters known as "colonies." Over the years, the surface has become a distant memory—even perhaps only a fantasy to those who have never experienced its wonders.

Making sure humanity survives the harsh conditions of the underground, a colony's citizens can take on a variety of specialized jobs. These include "Workers," who mine precious ore to fuel the colonies, and "Markers," who journey into the Labyrinth's surprisingly lush environment to bring back information that eases navigation. However, humanity also faces a threat to its existence—creatures called "kaijuu" whose sizes range from that of a small child to an enormous building, and are hostile to any human they see. Moreover, kaijuu that are large enough can force their way into the colonies, further increasing their threat level.

Memenpu is a nine-year-old college graduate whose inventions have greatly benefitted the Workers in her local colony. Recently, however, she has been dreaming of a place with a neverending ceiling not bound by bedrock. These aspirations fuel her desire to become a Marker and explore the Labyrinth's vast unknown in search of such a fantastical place. Despite her father Gagumber's vehement disagreement, a certain incident with the kaijuu jumpstarts a dangerous yet exciting adventure that will surely alter humanity's course forever.
anime.consensus_summary: Sakugan had an interesting premise, but ultimately failed to deliver a cohesive and engaging story. Viewers were frustrated by the unlikeable characters, disjointed plot, and lack of resolution. While some appreciated the art style and dialogue, the overall reception was largely negative, with many feeling it wasted its potential and failed to capitalize on its initial promise.
pros: Interesting world-building concept, with potential for depth.
Good character designs and art style in some aspects.
Enjoyable dialogue and character interactions in certain episodes.
cons: Inconsistent and disjointed story with poor pacing.
Underdeveloped and unlikeable characters, especially Memenpu.
Poorly explained world elements and unresolved plot threads.
Meaningless and episodic middle section with little impact on the overall plot.
Weak and generic antagonists.

anime.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Heroes' Frolic
anime.romaji_title: Nanatsu no Taizai: Eiyuu-tachi wa Hashagu
anime.synopsis: OVA bundled with the 34th volume of the manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the OVA enjoyable as a lighthearted side story that offers a glimpse into the past of the Seven Deadly Sins. It's considered a fun watch for fans already invested in the series, providing fan service and nostalgic moments. However, it is acknowledged that the plot is simple and doesn't offer significant depth.
pros: Enjoyable glimpse into the Seven Deadly Sins' past.
Fun to see the early designs of characters like Meliodas.
Meets expectations for a light-hearted OVA.
cons: Story is simple and not very substantial.
Offers little beyond what's expected from an OVA.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Fan Service, Nostalgia

anime.title: Bermuda Triangle: Colorful Pastrale
anime.synopsis:
The glittering spotlights. The sparkling, fluffy, cute outfits. The charming voices while dancing with bright smiles. Under the dazzling lights on the big city stage, these would be the mermaid idols who swim and dance freely underwater.

But far from this big city, the girls once lived in the peaceful village of Parrel. These girls, who would not even imagine such a glittering future for themselves, are instead just raising a fuss over the snack cakes they are eating. This is the story of the cheerful daily life of mermaids who strive their hardest everyday.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers enjoy the show for its cuteness and music, while others find it disappointing due to weak plot, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent animation. The show is considered a 'cute-girls-doing-cute-things' anime with significant flaws that prevent it from being a critical success, resulting in a middling enjoyment.
pros: Enjoyable music and sound design.
Charming and cheerful atmosphere.
Some viewers found the show smile-inducing and enjoyable despite flaws.
cons: Generic and weak storyline with little plot progression.
Underdeveloped characters with minimal backstory and chemistry.
Inconsistent animation quality and rough character designs.
Illogical scenarios and physics-defying situations detract from enjoyment.
Story lacks coherence, with poor character development.

anime.title: Mr. Osomatsu the Movie
anime.synopsis:
After an embarrassing high school class reunion with their successful classmates, who have "proper" jobs, relationships, and even children, the Matsuno sextuplets return home to sulk about their status as NEETs. They spend the night drinking away their sorrows, eventually falling unconscious, until they awaken in a strange world of memories, centered around one of the brothers' biggest high school regret.

As the sextuplets navigate this memory world, they encounter their embarrassing past selves from high school, as well as those of their friends. All the while, they try to uncover whose regret was great enough to trap them in this strange world, so that they can make their way back to reality. However, they're running out of time; this world of memories is unstable, and the sextuplets may lose their chance to make things right if they're too slow....
anime.consensus_summary: The Osomatsu-san movie is well-received by fans, especially those who felt the second season was weaker. It successfully blends comedy with emotional storytelling, focusing on the sibling dynamic and past regrets. The improved animation and nostalgic elements contribute to a positive viewing experience, although the plot is relatively simple.
pros: Movie balances comedy with emotional depth, exploring character relationships.
Improved animation quality and vibrant visuals enhance the viewing experience.
Successfully recaptures the charm and humor of the first season.
cons: Some viewers felt the second season was lacking, and the movie only partially rectifies this.
Plot is simple and predictable, relying on familiar time-travel tropes.

anime.title: THE IDOLM@STER SideM Wakeatte Mini!
anime.romaji_title: The iDOLM@STER SideM: Wake Atte Mini!
anime.consensus_summary: The iDOLM@STER SideM: Wake Atte Mini! is a well-received chibi anime short that expands on the SideM universe. It provides more screentime and focused episodes for a larger cast of characters, making it a pleasant experience for fans. The animation style is consistent with other iDOLM@STER chibi shorts, and the voice work is commendable.
pros: Expands on characters who had cameos in the parent anime.
Gives more screentime to a larger cast of SideM characters.
Enjoyable for fans of SideM, providing fun comedy shorts.
cons: Relies heavily on familiarity with the iDOLM@STER SideM franchise.

anime.title: Amazing Stranger
anime.synopsis: Bouida Haruto, a hardcore otaku with no interest in 3D (real) women, once appreciated figures from afar, accepting that "if you get into them, there's no turning back." However, when Nona, a character he loved from an anime called "Girls→Planetary Investigation" had a figure of her released, he ended up purchasing it. And then that night, the figure of Nona somehow came to life, and a couple-like lifestyle between man and toy began.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the show has some redeeming qualities like its cute concept and occasional humor, it is largely criticized for its weak plot, rushed pacing, and unlikeable characters. The short episode length hinders character development and makes the ending confusing, ultimately leading to an unsatisfying experience for many viewers.
pros: Cute concept
Good comedy occasionally
Entertaining characters
Interesting premise
cons: Pointless and convoluted plot
Uncanny CGI faces
Unlikable main character
Generic harem bullshit
Rushed pacing due to short episode length
Underdeveloped characters
Confusing ending

anime.title: One Piece: Stampede
anime.synopsis:
Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hats arrive aboard the Sunny to the Pirates Festival, the world's largest celebration created by and for pirates. Buena Festa, the festival organizer, invites the Straw Hats and all Worst Generation crews to partake in the festivities. Luring even Shichibukai and Marines to its shores, it seems that no pirate or sailor can resist the enticing secrets that the event hides behind its glamor.

The festival's contest is simple: find one of the treasures Gol D. Roger left behind. As the competition progresses, the various pirate crews fight each other in a free-for-all battle royale—that is, until the sudden appearance of an unexpected pirate drastically changes the game.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed, with long-time fans enjoying the fan service and action, while others criticize the weak plot, overuse of CGI, and poor character development. Some viewers found the movie to be a celebration of One Piece, while others felt it was a poorly made cash grab. Overall, opinions are divided on whether the movie is a worthwhile addition to the franchise.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style, especially in fight scenes.
Nostalgic and exciting for long-time One Piece fans due to the inclusion of many characters.
High-paced and entertaining with constant action and spectacles.
cons: Weak and forgettable plot with many coincidences and abrupt ending.
Poor character development, especially the villain, who lacks depth and motivation.
Overuse of CGI and inconsistent animation quality.
Feels like a commercial or cash grab with excessive fan service over substance.

anime.title: Inazuma Eleven: Orion no Kokuin
anime.synopsis:
The moment of reckoning has arrived as the illustrious Football Frontier International is finally underway. After winning the national Football Frontier, the newly assembled Raimon Junior High School soccer team awaits the announcement of Inazuma Japan—the team of players who will represent Japan at the international tournament. Asuto Inamori, along with the "Demon of the Field" Ryouhei Haizaki and the "Emperor of the Pitch" Yuuma Nosaka, quickly realize that they are up against forces far greater and more powerful than they anticipated.
 
In Inazuma Eleven: Orion no Kokuin, mysterious powers are at play within the tournament that threatens to alter the course of history and the game of soccer itself. With the help of their cunning coach Zhao Jinyun and the inexplicable newcomer Ichihoshi Mitsuru, Inazuma Japan must defend the world of soccer in their most difficult challenge yet.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Inazuma Eleven: Orion no Kokuin is highly polarized. Many long-time fans express disappointment due to a perceived decline in story quality, rushed pacing, and poor character development, especially when compared to earlier installments. However, some viewers appreciate the animation, music, and exciting plot twists, with a few considering it a masterpiece, leading to significant disagreement among the fanbase.
pros: Good animation quality.
Enjoyable OST.
Some found the story exciting and unpredictable.
cons: Rushed story and pacing.
Too many characters with little to no development.
Recycled plot elements and lack of emotional weight.
Inconsistent character development and plot inconsistencies.
Shift from football to psychological warfare is unappealing.
Poorly handled power scaling.

anime.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. Final Arc
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, School, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
The ground shakes, a rumble follows, and before anyone in Japan can prepare themselves, a cataclysmic volcanic eruption engulfs the country in molten lava and suffocating ashes. Of course, high school student Kusou Saiki repeatedly uses his psychic powers to prevent this harrowing catastrophe.

But between restoring the planet and watching his friends discuss their aspirations, Saiki finally resolves to stop the eruption and allow the world to continue spinning. However, this straightforward task is challenging even for the most powerful of psychics, let alone one who must deal with the usual shenanigans his ludicrous friends present.
anime.consensus_summary: The ending to Saiki Kusuo is met with mixed reactions. While some appreciate the character development and humor, many find the conclusion underwhelming with loose ends. The shift in focus towards story elements instead of comedy disappointed some fans, resulting in a somewhat polarized response.
pros: Satisfying character development for Saiki
Humorous and enjoyable, maintaining the series' comedic style
Wholesome undertones enhance the viewing experience
cons: Underwhelming and abrupt ending
Loose ends and unresolved plotlines
Pacing issues and subdued humor compared to previous seasons
Prioritizing story over comedy disappointed some viewers

anime.title: Sono Toki, Kanojo wa.
anime.synopsis: The anime takes place in Fukuoka and follows the love lives of four female protagonists as high school students, college students, and as working adults.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is appreciated for its ability to depict relatable relationship issues in a concise format. However, viewers find the episodes too short and the narrative somewhat disorganized, preventing a deeper connection with the characters and their stories. Despite its limitations, the show's concept and minimalistic style have garnered some positive reception.
pros: Presents relationship issues across different age groups effectively in a short time.
Minimalistic art style is well-executed.
Sound design and background sounds enhance the viewing experience.
cons: Story feels disorganized and lacks detailed development.
Episodes are too short to fully explore the characters and their problems.
Music is underused.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Romance, Relationship Drama

anime.title: I'm glad I could keep running.
anime.synopsis: Minato visits a recitation at an anime event with his friend. He is captivated by the voice actors' performances and decides to enroll in Suidoubashi Animation Academy. There, he meets Chikako, who used to live in the room he is moving into and who left a message in a USB drive. Minato, who aims to be a voice actor but is unable to put himself into the role, and Chikako, who lives with a past trauma, encourage one another and try to improve themselves. With the help of seniors such as Ryouta and Kei watching over them, they try to mature. As they stumble and worry, what lies ahead for them both?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the anime to be a decent, short watch that can be inspiring, especially for those interested in voice acting. The music and animation are praised, but some find the story and character development to be lacking depth. Overall, the audience mood leans towards positive, with a sense of mild enjoyment and appreciation for the show's uplifting themes.
pros: Good music by HoneyWorks
Relatable characters and their struggles
Beautiful animation that complements the atmosphere
Insightful depiction of voice acting world
cons: Bland story
Underdeveloped characters beyond the main leads
Mediocre plot

anime.title: Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story
anime.romaji_title: Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden
anime.synopsis:
Rumor has it that if a young girl strikes a bargain with a white fairy, it will grant any wish her heart desires. However, in exchange, she will become a magical girl and must put her life on the line to slay fearsome and ferocious witches.

Iroha Tamaki, a kind-hearted middle schooler from Takarazaki City, is living proof that these rumors are true. Armed with a magical crossbow and the ability to heal injuries, Iroha seeks out the labyrinths where witches hide and defeats them before they can prey on humans. Yet Iroha has no memory of her wish, and even Kyuubey, the white fairy himself, seems to have no idea what Iroha requested of him.

One day, Iroha hears rumors of a city where "magical girls can be saved," and finds herself on a sunset train to Kamihama City. Unfortunately, she discovers that the witches in Kamihama are far more powerful than usual. After veteran magical girl Yachiyo Nanami is forced to save her, Iroha vows to never return. But when a chance encounter with a tiny Kyuubey seems to trigger distant memories, Iroha is compelled to investigate the mysterious city despite the danger.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While praised for its visuals and expansion of the Madoka Magica universe, many find the story unfocused and the characters underdeveloped. It struggles to escape the perception of being a glorified advertisement for the gacha game, leading to disappointment for those expecting a narrative as strong as the original series.
pros: Visually stunning and creative art style by Shaft.
Well-designed characters, with outfits reflecting their personalities.
Engaging presentation with unique and unsettling visuals, bolstered by strong sound design.
cons: Pacing issues due to too many characters introduced too quickly.
Story lacks focus and feels like a commercial for the mobile game.
Characters are underdeveloped and difficult to care about.

anime.title: Pingu in the City
anime.synopsis: Pingu continues his misadventures in the big city, now with even more different jobs for him to mess up as a result of his adorable clumsiness and affinity for mischief. Join him on his curious capers as he wreaks havoc across the city.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Pingu in the City' (2018) positively, especially noting its improvement over the first season. Reviewers appreciate its wholesome nature, moral lessons, and simple storytelling. Some find the emphasis on the "city" setting to be somewhat disjointed, but overall, the show is considered a charming and educational experience, even if it is underappreciated by a wider audience.
pros: Improved over the first season with a looser approach and more dynamic storytelling.
Strong moral lessons and ethical themes presented in a simple and accessible way.
Good variety of jobs and adventures for Pingu, expanding the world beyond just the city.
The show has a sense of community due to the inclusion of sister Pinga and new friends.
Expressiveness of animation gets closer to the original claymation series.
The new season of Pingu is a decent wholesome fest that doesn't get much recognition
cons: The city setting feels somewhat disconnected from the overall adventures.
The show's short episodes can feel limited in content.
The show is often overlooked and not taken seriously by the general public.

anime.title: Operation Han-Gyaku-Sei Million Arthur 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Second season of Hangyakusei Million Arthur.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Hangyakusei Million Arthur is a mixed bag. While some appreciate its humor and enjoyable characters, others find it a significant drop in quality compared to the first season, criticizing its plot, music, and overall impact. The show is best enjoyed as a lighthearted, mindless comedy, but expectations should be tempered.
pros: Characters are fun and enjoyable, especially the relationships between them.
Show is good for turning off your brain and enjoying something stupid and fun.
The alternate history England setting is pleasing and contributes to the ridiculousness of the show.
cons: Second season is a letdown compared to the first, with a drop in quality.
Music is unsuitable and lacks the feel of the first season's soundtrack.
Plot becomes nonsensical, with gags leading nowhere and a triggering ending.

anime.title: After School Dice Club
anime.genres: CGDCT, Comedy, School, Shounen, Strategy Game
anime.synopsis:
Miki Takekasa is an introverted high schooler who does not socialize with her classmates. However, she wants to know what "fun" really is, waiting for someone who could help her understand its true meaning. One day after school, she crosses paths with her classmate Aya Takayashiki, who takes her on a little adventure. Miki discovers wonders she had never seen before, opening a way to change her withdrawn life.

On their way home, Miki and Aya see their class representative Midori Oono entering Saikoro Club, a store specializing in board games. After trying out a German board game, Miki soon understands the kind of fun she had been looking for: playing various games after school along with the friends and acquaintances she makes from her newfound pleasure.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds "Houkago Saikoro Club" to be a relaxing and enjoyable anime, especially for those familiar with board games. Many appreciate the focus on friendship and personal growth through the hobby. However, some find the plot and characters to be somewhat shallow, with a rushed ending and underwhelming male characters, leading to a niche appeal rather than widespread acclaim.
pros: Accurate representation of board game playing.
Character development tied to the games.
Heartwarming interactions between characters.
Explanations of game rules are well-done and entertaining.
Relatable for board game enthusiasts.
cons: Underdeveloped male characters.
Episodic structure with minimal plot complexity.
Shallow character development for some characters.
Ending feels rushed.
Average art quality that sometimes dips.
anime.thematic_vibe: Heartwarming, Social Connection, Board Game Culture

anime.title: Devidol!
anime.synopsis: Three devil girls Aira, Shima, and Hana live in the human world. Leading a dazzling school life with efforts and friendships, they aim to be idols. It's a heart-bumping anime climbing that stairs... Not! They don't know the answer to "What is Idol?" and weaver in the road to becoming an idol with trials and errors. Rocket-sensei will kindly (and sometimes strictly) lead them to become real idols in an unique way... for sure.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds "Devidol!" to be a hilarious and bizarre hidden gem, best enjoyed with friends. While the show is aware of its chaotic nature and unlikely to receive another season, its unique brand of absurdist comedy and improv-style segments are highly appreciated. The show's unconventional structure and strange humor may not appeal to everyone, but those who appreciate it find it incredibly entertaining.
pros: Hilarious and insane in the best way possible.
Unique and strange hidden gem.
Enjoyable to watch with friends.
cons: Show is a complete mess.
Likely won't get another season.
Structure may not sound exciting when explained.
anime.thematic_vibe: Absurdist Comedy, Slice of Life, Idol

anime.title: MFKZ
anime.synopsis: After a scooter accident provoked by a mysterious woman's vision, Angelino, a deadbeat like thousands of others in Dark Meat City, starts getting violent migraines that are accompanied by strange hallucinations. Along with his good buddy Vinz, he tries to figure out what's happening to him while threatening men in black seem determined to catch him.
