Hikaru and Lala's friendship and development.
Easygoing and heartwarming.
cons: Repetitive combat and monster of the week format.
Some finishers were lame.
Subpar execution of a brilliant idea.
Team dynamics lost its touch in the Twinkle Imagination arc.
Characters don't really have any development during the show at all.
Novelty of them being in space wears out super quick.
Unimaginative storylines.
Too many episodes.

anime.title: Ride Your Wave
anime.synopsis:
Entranced by surfing and the sea, Hinako Mukaimizu is a spirited girl who attends college in a coastal city with no consideration for her future career. Her life takes an unexpected turn when a fireworks mishap sets the apartment building she lives in ablaze, where she is saved by a talented firefighter named Minato Hinageshi. Upon meeting, the two quickly become acquainted with one another—Hinako is instantly enamored by Minato's reliable personality and passion for saving others, while Minato is intrigued by surfing and is eager to learn how. As Hinako begins to teach Minato about surfing, the pair eventually fall in love and begin a gentle and devoted relationship.

However, while surfing may seem fun and carefree, it can still be a dangerous and unpredictable activity. This is what Hinako learns when a surfing incident completely changes her life, leaving her forced to contemplate her undecided future. In search of her own calling, Hinako begins her journey of self-discovery, keeping Minato by her side as she gradually attempts to find her purpose and ride her own wave.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found the story relatable, heartwarming, and visually appealing, praising its themes of love and overcoming loss. Others criticized the rushed pacing, weak character development (especially the female lead), and repetitive messaging, finding the second half disjointed and the ending lackluster.
pros: Great visuals and animation, especially the water and backgrounds.
Music is enjoyable and adds wholesomeness.
Addresses grief and moving on.
cons: Rushed pacing and underdeveloped romance.
Repetitive message about moving on from grief.
Female lead portrayed as helpless and dysfunctional.
Second half has conflicting messages and feels disjointed.
anime.thematic_vibe: Coming of Age, Overcoming Loss, Supernatural Romance

anime.title: Magical Sempai
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Performing Arts, Romance, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Starting his new term at Tanenashi High School, an unmotivated freshman searches for a club that requires minimal participation to suit his needs. He then comes across the magic clubroom, and inside is a cute upperclassman practicing her magic tricks. Suffering from stage fright that causes her to slip up in her acts, she has a tendency to end up in the most embarrassing situations. Despite having little interest in a club run by an incapable magician, the freshman finds himself involved as a new member, experiencing all sorts of awkward moments with his eccentric mentor.
anime.consensus_summary: Tejina-senpai is viewed as a fun, lighthearted ecchi comedy that delivers consistent laughs and appealing fanservice. However, critics note its repetitive nature and lack of narrative depth, leading to a divided opinion on its overall quality.
pros: Hilarious comedy and memorable jokes
Strong voice acting that brings characters to life
Visually appealing art style and character designs
Fanservice is well-executed and integral to the comedy
cons: Repetitive joke structure and predictable punchlines
Lack of substantial plot or character development
Excessive censorship hinders the effectiveness of fanservice
Some characters are one-dimensional and underdeveloped

anime.title: Power Battle Watch Car
anime.synopsis: The series is set in the near future, when an automobile company named JHC Motors is depicted to have created the Watch Cars, which are miniature sentient robotic cars that are supposed to have become good companions to children and adults alike. Watch Cars are depicted to have become a global trend. There is a Battle League where Watch Cars and their trainers battle. Jino, one of the young Watch Car Masters, goes to the Watch Car Battle League with his Watch Car Blue-will, but The Rangers of Darkness an evil force to takeover al the watch cars in The city, Jino and his friends must stop them.
anime.consensus_summary: The provided review uses the show as a jumping-off point for a philosophical discussion about societal rules and leadership. It does not explicitly praise or critique the show's production or writing. The audience engagement seems minimal based on the single review, indicating low polarization.

anime.title: Wasteful Days of High School Girls
anime.synopsis:
As she heads off to her entrance ceremony at Sainotama Girls' High School, Akane Kikuchi muses over her grade school dream of becoming a manga artist and the lack of progress that she has made. When she finally arrives at school, she is surprised to learn that she is once again in the same class as her two best friends: the deadpan and emotionless Shiori Saginomiya and the hyperactive and ridiculous Nozomu Tanaka. Tanaka then comes to the obvious realization that she can't achieve her grade school dream of being popular with the boys and getting a boyfriend by going to an all-girls high school.

In desperation, she begins asking the girls in her class to introduce her to their guy friends. Her classmates, however, are anything but ordinary. From a grandmother-loving loli to a reclusive chuunibyou to an overly analytical stalker, each one is given a fitting nickname by Tanaka to accentuate their weirdness. And so begin the wasteful days of these high school girls, each day kicked off with a simple question: "Hey, wanna hear something amazing?"
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is overwhelmingly praised for its comedic value and relatable characters, drawing comparisons to similar slice-of-life comedies. Viewers appreciate the humor and character interactions, though some find the comedy inconsistent or the story lacking depth. Overall, the series is considered a hidden gem and a highly enjoyable watch.
pros: Hilarious and genuinely funny, with some moments causing tears of laughter.
Excellent character dynamics and chemistry, especially among the main trio.
Relatable and heartwarming, offering comfort and enjoyment.
Unique and quirky humor, reminiscent of 'Nichijou' and 'Asobi Asobase'.
Strong character development and background stories.
cons: Comedy can become repetitive or fall flat as the series progresses.
Some viewers may not find the humor funny enough.
Story is generic and lacks significant depth.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comedy, Slice of Life, School Life

anime.title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly - Skytree Super
anime.romaji_title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly - Skytree Super
anime.synopsis: A special anime featuring Goku and Freeza screened at the Tokyo Skytree.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Skytree Super' show is largely seen as an irrelevant advertisement with poor production quality. While some appreciate the nostalgic throwbacks to older Dragon Ball series, the consensus is that it's skippable, especially for those who didn't experience it live at the Tokyo Skytree. The absence of Broly, despite being an advertisement for his movie, is a significant point of criticism.
pros: Throwbacks to the original Dragonball, Z, Super, and movies are a nice addition.
Audio is fine, especially the use of old opening themes.
cons: Poor character designs, using old Yamamuro designs.
Blank background with no actual location.
Horrendous 3D model for Shenron.
Goku is portrayed as dumb.
Broly doesn't appear, despite being an ad for his movie.
Irrelevant to the story and entertainment.
Forgettable and a waste of time for those not at the event.

anime.title: Darwin's Game
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Mystery, Shounen, Super Power, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
High school student Kaname Sudou receives an invitation from a classmate to play Darwin's Game, a mobile game he has never heard of. However, as soon as he opens the application, a green snake suddenly pops out from his phone screen and bites his neck, leaving him unconscious. Waking up in the infirmary without any signs of a snake bite, he is told by the school to take the rest of the day off. Although he is puzzled by what has happened, he dismisses the surreal experience as a hallucination and boards the train home.

Unfortunately, his curiosity gets the better of him and he uses the application once again. As the application appears to be just like any other battle game, Kaname breathes out a sigh of relief and decides to start his first match. However, the pleasant surprise is short-lived, as his in-game opponent unexpectedly appears right in front of him and attempts to hunt him down with a knife.

As he desperately runs for his life, Kaname puts two and two together and realizes that Darwin's Game is not an ordinary game, but rather, it's a brutal fight for survival.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding Darwin's Game to be a fun and engaging action anime despite its flaws, while others are critical of its plot holes, generic characters, and lack of originality. Many acknowledge the show's issues but still find it entertaining on a superficial level. There's a clear divide between those who can overlook the flaws for the sake of entertainment and those who are significantly bothered by them.
pros: Fast-paced and entertaining with engaging action sequences.
Some found the characters enjoyable despite flaws, particularly the MC's development.
The show can be a fun, easy binge-watch if you don't overthink it.
cons: Plot holes and lack of realism are major issues for many viewers.
Character development is often rushed or inconsistent.
The story relies on generic tropes and clichés.

anime.title: Cautious Hero: The Hero Is Overpowered but Overly Cautious
anime.romaji_title: Shinchou Yuusha: Kono Yuusha ga Ore Tueee Kuse ni Shinchou Sugiru
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Parody
anime.synopsis:
There is a popular saying: "you can never be too careful." It is very important to prepare for every situation you may face, even if it seems like an unnecessary waste of time. Also, in games like RPGs, it is good to exceed the level of your enemies to achieve total victory.

These words describe Seiya Ryuuguuin a little too perfectly. After being summoned by the goddess Ristarte to save the world of Gaeabrande from destruction, the hero prepares himself for his noble journey. While this might be normal, he spends a very long time training himself, despite having overpowered stats. He fights weak enemies using his strongest skills and buys excessive amounts of supplies and potions—all to stay safe.

While his attitude may be a bit annoying, it might just be the saving grace of Gaeabrande, especially considering that it is a world where the forces of evil dominate each and every expectation.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Cautious Hero' for its comedic take on the isekai genre, highlighting the humor derived from the main character's excessive caution and Ristarte's over-the-top reactions. While some find the humor repetitive, the majority appreciates the unexpected plot twists and emotional depth that emerge later in the series. It's considered a refreshing parody, with well-executed art and animation that enhance the comedic effect.
pros: Effective comedic delivery through character interactions and facial expressions, particularly Ristarte's.
Unique twist on the isekai genre by subverting typical tropes and expectations.
Unexpected plot depth and emotional resonance towards the end of the series.
cons: Repetitive comedic gags that may become tiresome for some viewers.
The plot can feel generic and recycled at times.
Over-reliance on Ristarte as the butt of jokes, which may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: FINAL FANTASY XV: EPISODE ARDYN – PROLOGUE
anime.romaji_title: Final Fantasy XV: Episode Ardyn - Prologue
anime.synopsis:
In an age when gods walk alongside mankind, the world of Eos finds itself falling into darkness. Calamity befalls the human race when malevolent creatures known as "daemons" scourge the land and obliterate armies with seemingly unstoppable brute force. In these dire times, nobles of House Caelum rise to prominence. Owing to their god-given healing powers, which allow them to purge the plague spread by the monsters, they earn the people's trust and allegiance.

With no leader to rule the first human kingdom and guide the masses, the gods fervently seek to fill this vacancy—a man of the Caelum bloodline seems to be a desirable choice. The ambitious and charismatic pragmatist, Somnus Lucis Caelum, is pit against his humble and altruistic brother, Ardyn Lucis Caelum, in competition for the throne. As tensions rise between the rivals and anticipations surge, the fate of the world rests upon one of the two's decisive victory.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Episode Ardyn - Prologue' is well-received, especially by those familiar with the game. It enhances the understanding of the DLC and Ardyn's character, making viewers sympathize with the antagonist. The short length and reliance on existing lore are minor drawbacks, but overall it's considered a worthwhile watch for fans.
pros: Provides greater understanding of Episode Ardyn DLC.
Dark tone complements the story.
Good sound effects and music from the game.
cons: May be difficult to understand without prior knowledge of the game's lore.
Short length may not allow for sufficient depth.

anime.title: Dorohedoro
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Hole—a dark, decrepit, and disorderly district where the strong prey on the weak and death is an ordinary occurrence—is all but befitting of the name given to it. A realm separated from law and ethics, it is a testing ground to the magic users who dominate it. As a race occupying the highest rungs of their society, the magic users think of the denizens of Hole as no more than insects. Murdered, mutilated, and made experiments without a second thought, the powerless Hole dwellers litter the halls of Hole's hospital on a daily basis.

Possessing free access to and from the cesspool, and with little challenge to their authority, the magic users appear indomitable to most—aside for a few. Caiman, more reptile than man, is one such individual. He hunts them on a heedless quest for answers with only a trusted pair of bayonets and his immunity to magic. Cursed by his appearance and tormented by nightmares, magic users are his only clue to restoring his life to normal. With his biggest obstacle being his stomach, his female companion Nikaidou, who runs the restaurant Hungry Bug, is his greatest ally.
anime.consensus_summary: Dorohedoro is a highly unique and entertaining anime with a dark and unconventional style. While the CGI animation may not appeal to everyone, the majority of viewers praise the show's original world-building, engaging story, and memorable characters. Some find the plot disjointed or the characters underdeveloped, but overall, the show is well-received for its refreshing take on the anime genre.
pros: Unique and original world-building.
Engaging and unpredictable story.
Well-done CGI that blends with the backgrounds.
Funky and likable characters.
cons: The CGI can be off-putting to some viewers.
Some may find the violence and gore excessive.
Pacing may be dizzying at times.
Lack of character development for some characters (e.g., Nikaido).
The plot may seem aimless for some viewers.

anime.title: Tsukiuta. The Animation 2
anime.synopsis: Six Gravity and Procellarum, Tsukino Talent Productions' best male idol groups, are preparing for this year's edition of the Full Moon Festival. The show's theme is "a new self," which seems to excite all the members. Some of the members from both units struggle to find inspiration for the theme, having matured from their last festival appearance. As they continue their daily lives while juggling their show business responsibilities, each of the Six Gravity and Procellarum members discover the meaning of "a new self."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Tsukiuta. The Animation 2' enjoyable if they are already fans or interested in getting into the Tsukiuta universe. The strength lies in the characters, their relationships, and the music, particularly the ending themes. However, the anime is considered mediocre due to its weak plot and low-budget animation, making it more appealing to fans than newcomers seeking a compelling narrative.
pros: Enjoyable character dynamics, especially pairings.
Experienced and talented voice actors and singers.
Catchy ending songs with varied musical styles (Vocaloid composers).
Appealing character designs.
cons: Episodic format with barely any plot.
Low budget animation with limited movement.

anime.title: Actors: Songs Connection
anime.synopsis:
Tensho School is located in the 7th Ward of Thrive Central, where emphasis is put on extracurricular activities and all clubs participate in an annual fall singing contest. Having to delay the start of his school year due to his older sister's hospitalization, transfer student Saku Otonomiya finds himself struggling to adapt to his hectic new life. Balancing his part-time job and caring for his sister, he finds it difficult to make time to join a school club.

In preparation for the upcoming singing contest, the school's singing club wishes to use Sousuke Kagura's song "Cloudy Days," but Kagura is reluctant to grant his permission. The song requires someone with a three-octave range to sing it and he believes that only a VOCALOID can meet the standards. He allows for the club to use his song on the condition that they can find someone who possesses that vocal range to properly sing it.

While racking his brain over the composition of his next song, Kagura stumbles upon Otonomiya singing "Cloudy Days" perfectly. He invites Otonomiya to form a unit with him for the competition. At the same time, the singing club tries to goad him into joining so they can use Kagura's song. As the contest inches closer, Otonomiya must overcome his uncertainty and decide who to team up with.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are mixed, with some appreciating the unique premise and music, especially the English dub, while others criticize the confusing plot, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent animation. The show is best enjoyed by fans of Vocaloid music who are willing to overlook its flaws. There is a significant twist that divides viewers, with some finding it engaging and others finding it detracting.
pros: Unique premise with a twist
Good English dub with well-sung songs
Enjoyable for fans of Vocaloid music
cons: Messy plot and confusing storytelling
Underdeveloped characters
Inconsistent animation quality

anime.title: Fire Force
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Spontaneous Human Combustion: a chaotic phenomenon that has plagued humanity for years, randomly transforming ordinary people into flaming, violent creatures known as Infernals. While Infernals make up the first-generation accounts of Human Combustion, the second and third generations became known as pyrokinetics—people gifted with the ability to manipulate and control their flames while remaining human. To combat the Infernal threat and discover the cause, the Tokyo Armed Forces, Fire Defense Agency, and Holy Church of Sol produced their answer: the Special Fire Force.

Young and eager third-generation pyrokinetic Shinra Kusakabe, nicknamed Devil's Footprints for his explosive ability to ignite his feet at will, becomes a member of the lively Special Fire Force Company 8. Upholding the brigade's duty to extinguish the blazing Infernals and lay their souls to rest, Shinra is determined to become a hero who will save the lives of those threatened by the flame terror.

However, this is not the hero's game Shinra imagined. The Fire Force is a fractured mess of feuding brigades, abnormal Infernal sightings are increasing all over Tokyo, and a shadowy group is claiming to have answers to the strange fire that caused the death of Shinra's family 12 years ago. Faced with many obstacles within and outside the Fire Force, Shinra fights to uncover the truth behind the burning mysteries that have kept him in the dark.
anime.consensus_summary: Fire Force is a visually impressive anime with a unique premise, but it suffers from poor pacing, shallow characters, and excessive fan service, leading to a divided audience. Some appreciate the action and world-building, while others are disappointed by the story and character development.
pros: Gorgeous animation and amazing sound design.
Unique premise of fighting fire with fire
Exciting action sequences
cons: Excessive and unnecessary fan service.
Rushed or dragged out pacing.
Flat, uninteresting characters.
Predictable or confusing story.

anime.title: Precure Miracle Universe Movie
anime.synopsis:
So many mysteries☆ The grand adventure to the world of glittering stars!!

I'm Hoshina Hikaru! One day, when I was looking at the stars, space just warped before my eyes!? Twincool~☆ Are we really going to the planet that made the Miracle Lights? Wait, what? Huh~!? Suddenly the lights just went out and the stars are being swallowed up by darkness!? If this continues, the world as we know it will become pitch black...that's a huge pinch right there!! But, I definitely won't give up on bringing back the universe's light! So come on everyone, give us your support!
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is carried by the interactions between the cures from different series, which is a common strength in Precure. However, the plot is weak, especially the ending, and the movie-exclusive character is not well-developed. Overall, it is considered one of the weaker Precure crossovers, but still enjoyable for fans of the characters.
pros: Good character interactions between Cures.
Well-animated fight scenes (relative to the series).
cons: Weak or idiotic story moments.
Underdeveloped movie-exclusive character.
Surprise villain with no foreshadowing.
Subpar action in the final quarter.

anime.title: Katana Maidens: Mini Toji
anime.genres: Action, CGDCT, Comedy, Fantasy, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Do the girls' daily lives include fighting and not fighting? All characters from the TV animated series Toji no Miko and smartphone game Toji no Miko: Kizamishi Issen no Tomoshibi are gathered together in smaller form!
anime.consensus_summary: Mini Toji is a comedic anime short that expands on the Toji no Miko world. While the original characters benefit from flanderization, the newer mobile game characters suffer from stereotypical portrayals and limited screentime. Overall, it is an enjoyable series, mainly focuses on comedy and lightheartedness, effectively serving its purpose of providing entertainment.
pros: Comedic take on the Toji no Miko world.
Flanderization gives the characters beyond their initial personalities.
Series can improve one's mood.
Enjoyable and makes down minutes useful.
cons: Mobile game cast gets to be stereotypical.
Difficult to get to know mobile game characters due to limited screentime.
Chibified character designs sometimes made their cheeks look 'stuffed'.
Sound is an average part.

anime.title: Fruits Basket 1st Season
anime.genres: Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Shoujo, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Tooru Honda has always been fascinated by the story of the Chinese zodiac that her beloved mother told her as a child. However, a sudden family tragedy changes her life, and subsequent circumstances leave her all alone. Tooru is now forced to live in a tent, but little does she know that her temporary home resides on the private property of the esteemed Souma family. Stumbling upon their home one day, she encounters Shigure, an older Souma cousin, and Yuki, the "prince" of her school. Tooru explains that she lives nearby, but the Soumas eventually discover her well-kept secret of being homeless when they see her walking back to her tent one night.

Things start to look up for Tooru as they kindly offer to take her in after hearing about her situation. But soon after, she is caught up in a fight between Yuki and his hot-tempered cousin, Kyou. While trying to stop them, she learns that the Souma family has a well-kept secret of their own: whenever they are hugged by a member of the opposite sex, they transform into the animals of the Chinese zodiac.

With this new revelation, Tooru will find that living with the Soumas is an unexpected adventure filled with laughter and romance.
anime.consensus_summary: Fruits Basket 1st Season (2019) is a visually appealing and largely faithful adaptation of the beloved manga, praised for its exploration of complex themes. However, some find the series overly melodramatic and slow-paced, with underdeveloped characters and repetitive sob stories. While nostalgic fans appreciate the updated visuals and commitment to the source material, new viewers may find the emotional tone inconsistent.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga (for the 2019 version)
Enhanced visuals and modern animation quality
Exploration of deep and relatable themes like trauma, belonging, and healing
cons: Repetitive sob stories and excessive melodrama
Slow pacing, especially in the beginning
Characters can be caricatures with underdeveloped backstories

anime.title: Dream Tower
anime.consensus_summary: The show's concept is compelling, but the execution is poor. The main character is widely disliked for being annoying, immature, and inconsistent. This significantly detracts from the overall viewing experience.
cons: Main character is extremely annoying and acts like a child
Inconsistent character behavior (smart then stupid)
Main character is unlikable and whiny

anime.title: Guan Hai Ce
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Military
anime.synopsis: It tells the story of the chivalrous Ling Yao and the young master of a farming family, Ji Kuang, who, entrusted by General Mu Xun of Xugu Pass, break through the encirclement of enemy general Yan Shituo and overcome numerous hardships to reach the Kingdom of Junshan for reinforcements.
anime.consensus_summary: The story revolves around war between two kingdoms and two protagonists' journey to seek reinforcements. It involves political intrigue and adventure elements. There isn't enough information to gauge strong positive or negative reactions, resulting in a low controversy score.

anime.title: Dr. Stone
anime.synopsis:
After five years of harboring unspoken feelings, high-schooler Taiju Ooki is finally ready to confess his love to Yuzuriha Ogawa. Just when Taiju begins his confession however, a blinding green light strikes the Earth and petrifies mankind around the world—turning every single human into stone.

Several millennia later, Taiju awakens to find the modern world completely nonexistent, as nature has flourished in the years humanity stood still. Among a stone world of statues, Taiju encounters one other living human: his science-loving friend Senkuu, who has been active for a few months. Taiju learns that Senkuu has developed a grand scheme—to launch the complete revival of civilization with science. Taiju's brawn and Senkuu's brains combine to forge a formidable partnership, and they soon uncover a method to revive those petrified.

However, Senkuu's master plan is threatened when his ideologies are challenged by those who awaken. All the while, the reason for mankind's petrification remains unknown.
anime.consensus_summary: Dr. Stone features a unique premise that draws in viewers, but its execution is polarizing. While some appreciate its celebration of science and satisfying progress, others find its scientific inaccuracies and exaggerated characters off-putting. The show's early episodes are often criticized for being slow, and its animation quality can be inconsistent, leading to a mixed reception.
pros: Unique premise blending science and adventure
Satisfying progress with smaller goals achieved frequently
Refreshing take on societal rebuilding
Engaging character designs
Celebrates science in an accessible way
cons: Inconsistent scientific accuracy with errors in basic scientific laws
Characters are caricatures with exaggerated personalities
Plot can be illogical and over-the-top
Early episodes are slow and less engaging
Animation quality is inconsistent, relies on cost-saving techniques

anime.title: My Hero Academia: Two Heroes Specials
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 1: Futari no Hero Specials
anime.synopsis:
Episode 1 is based on one-shot manga released in Vol. Origin, it explores the back-story of All Might's past and his journey into becoming the No.1 hero.

Episode 2 is an epilogue picture drama for Boku no Hero Academia the Movie: Futari no Hero.

Short specials included with the Blu-ray/DVD release of Boku no Hero Academia the Movie: Futari no Hero.
anime.consensus_summary: The specials are emotionally resonant, particularly the first episode focusing on All Might's past. While praised for its impact and faithfulness to the source material, the extremely short length leaves viewers wanting more depth and content.  The second episode, a picture drama, is less favored, impacting the overall reception.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material, providing needed depth to All Might's character.
Emotionally impactful, especially the first episode.
Effectively conveys All Might's backstory in a short amount of time.
Captures the essence of My Hero Academia with a mix of heroism, humor, and character chemistry.
cons: Extremely short length, leaving viewers wanting more.
The second episode (picture drama) is not as well-received.
Felt underwhelming due to lack of insight into All Might's past.
The short length of the specials doesn't let you fully appreciate the depth.

anime.title: RobiHachi
anime.synopsis:
Ever since they encountered aliens on the moon, humanity's technology has developed by leaps and bounds. Half a century later, even though most have it easy, Robby Yaji and Hacchi Kita cannot seem to catch a break in this advanced society. Robby—a man perpetually struck by misfortune—owes large sums of money to debt collectors due to his poor investments in shady get-rich-quick schemes, and Hacchi finds it difficult to get over the boredom of his mundane life.

The two end up on an adventure of a lifetime when loan shark boss Yang sends Hacchi to collect the money Robby owes. Rather than pay up, Robby blasts off into space and heads to Isekandar, a planet that supposedly brings happiness to anyone who visits. Seeing a chance for some much needed excitement, Hacchi tags along with Robby on this journey filled with alien encounters, giant robot battles, and all sorts of troublemaking—all the while avoiding Yang and his cronies who are desperately combing the universe to find them.
anime.consensus_summary: RobiHachi is a fun, lighthearted space adventure that doesn't take itself too seriously. While the story is weak and the humor can be hit-or-miss, the characters and music are generally well-received. It's considered an underrated show that's good for casual viewing but not particularly groundbreaking.
pros: Enjoyable and funny characters, especially the main duo and Yang.
Good music, including opening, ending, and background tracks.
Unique art style for each planet visited.
cons: Story is nonsensical and lacks depth.
Humor can be repetitive and childish.
Mediocre plot and CGI.

anime.title: Golden Kamuy 2nd Season OVA
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Historical, Military, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
1. Koi wo Shita kara Datsugoku Suru Koto ni Shita/Kyoufu no Moudoku Dai Shitou! Hokkaido Ouchi ni Kyodai Hebi wa Sonzai Shita! (Love Made Me Escape from Prison/The Terrifying Battle of Deadly Poison! A Massive Snake Deep in the Hokkaido Wilderness!)
2. Monster
3. Shiton Doubutsuki
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the OVAs for their over-the-top humor and raunchiness, which are even more pronounced than in the main series. Fans appreciate the series' ability to balance historical elements with comedic and action-packed scenes. The recommendation is to watch the OVAs in a specific order to enhance the viewing experience.
pros: Balances historical elements with comedy and action.
Characters are well-portrayed.
Hilarious and insane scenes.
Explicit and bizarre content that suits the OVA format.

anime.title: Gundam Reconguista in G I: Go! Core Fighter
anime.romaji_title: Gundam: G no Reconguista Movie I - Ike! Core Fighter
anime.synopsis: The first summary movie of the Gundam: G no Reconguista series.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie aims to fix the pacing issues of the original TV series and presents a more cohesive narrative. However, some find the story condensed and lacking character development. While some viewers recommend it over the TV series, others find it a slog, resulting in mixed reactions.
pros: Improved pacing compared to the TV series
Seamless integration of episodes into a movie format
cons: Lack of character arcs
Story feels condensed and slow
Unclear overall conflict beyond surface level

anime.title: Lupin III: Goodbye Partner
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: The new TV special will be about the battles against Jigen, who aims for Lupin who searches for the treasure. Goemon, who is angry because he cannot forgive betrayal of Jigen, will fight along with Lupin against the strongest enemy in the history.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the character focus and familiar Lupin elements, many are critical of the predictable plot, pacing issues, and forced incorporation of modern tech and political commentary. The abandonment of the Jigen plotline and weak villain are also frequent points of disappointment.
pros: Focus on character development, especially Jigen's human side.
Nostalgic elements like the iconic theme song and familiar character dynamics.
Entertaining and engaging premise of Jigen's betrayal.
cons: Predictable plot.
Unnecessary CGI and modern tech focus detract from the core Lupin experience.
Poor pacing and unresolved plotlines, particularly the Jigen betrayal.
Inconsistent setting and forced political commentary.
Weak villain and nonsensical plot developments in the latter half.

anime.title: Ace of Diamond Act II
anime.synopsis:
The hallowed ground of Koshien Stadium is the "field of dreams," where the ambitions of high school baseball players come true. After emerging victorious in the autumn tournament last year, Seidou High School baseball's team  has finally earned the right to compete there for the first time in seven years.  Beyond the spring tournament looms the battle to decide who is the best team in the nation  — the Summer Koshien.

 With the third-year players due to retire after the summer tournament, the team has to integrate the experience of the seniors and the potential of the newcomers to overcome familiar and new opponents alike and win the coveted national title. 

Meanwhile, pitcher Eijun Sawamura is as determined as ever to earn jersey No. 1  and seize the position of "ace" from his persistent rival, Satoru Furuya.  As the team prepares for their greatest challenge yet, Sawamura and Furuya carry on their struggle to lead their team to glory and become the star of the game: the true "Ace of the Diamond."
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many appreciate the character development, soundtrack, and exciting sports action, finding it a compelling entry in the series. However, others are critical of inconsistent pacing, animation, and perceived mistreatment of the main character, leading to disappointment for some viewers.
pros: Excellent character development, taking time with each character's growth.
High-quality animation and soundtrack enhance emotional impact.
Exciting matches and intense competition.
Realistic portrayal of sports.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality in some episodes.
Pacing issues and rushed storytelling in some parts of the season.
Repetitive flashbacks and recaps reduce new content.
Protagonist is constantly undermined by the author.

anime.title: Cells at Work!: The Common Cold
anime.synopsis: For the regular cells of the human body, life consists of countless repetitive tasks. They spend every day multiplying, leaving little time for other activities. But one day, this monotony is abruptly interrupted by a cell with an odd-looking hat. Tired of unending drudgery, another cell named Ippan Saibou decides to join this quirky stranger for a day of pranks, jokes, and mischief.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Hataraku Saibou: Kaze Shoukougun' for its charming characters, humor, and educational value. The special is praised for maintaining the spirit of the original series and offering a lighthearted take on the common cold. While some find the story somewhat inconsequential, the overall sentiment is positive, appreciating the return of familiar characters and the series' signature blend of silliness and science.
pros: Charming characters and world.
Creative exploration of the human body.
Funny and educational content.
Consistent accuracy with the main series.
cons: Art style may be considered rough.
Story might be too silly or not add much to the overall show.

anime.title: 7 Seeds
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Shoujo, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Imagine this: you are living a normal day in your life. Maybe you are out with friends, eating your family's home-cooked meal or spending time with your girlfriend. When you next wake up, you are suddenly thrust into a strange, new world, surrounded by five strangers on a rapidly sinking boat in the middle of a storm.

For Natsu Iwashimizu, this is her new reality. Humanity has perished, and all that remains of the Japanese population are five groups of men and women who were chosen to be sent to the future in hopes of continuing mankind's existence. While every other person chosen has a useful talent such as martial arts, knowledge, or architecture, Natsu is a shy high school girl who cannot even raise her voice to shout. The new world is dangerous beyond imagination, and although Natsu seems to lack helpful skills, she must go with the others making their way to the "Seven Fuji" in order to survive.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for 7 Seeds is highly polarized, with a significant portion of viewers finding the anime to be a poorly executed adaptation that suffers from rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and an abrupt, unsatisfying ending. Conversely, a smaller group appreciates its mature themes, realistic survival focus, and distinct characters, despite acknowledging production flaws. The common sentiment is that the anime fails to do justice to its source material, leading to considerable disappointment.
pros: Mature story that avoids typical shonen pitfalls with no eccentric characters or villains of the day.
Engaging and realistic take on post-apocalyptic storytelling, focusing on survival and inter-group tension.
Characters, while numerous, are given enough distinct personalities to be relatable and not caricatures.
Artwork is described as 'pretty amazing' by one reviewer, and the OST and sound design are noted as being of good quality.
Deals with heavy topics like murder, abuse, rape, and mass death effectively, suggesting a dark and mature tone.
cons: Animation, pacing, and sound are frequently described as mediocre, bland, average, or even horrendous.
The story and character development are considered rushed and superficial due to condensing a large manga into a short anime.
The ending is consistently criticized as abrupt, open-ended, unfulfilling, and lacking resolution.
Many viewers found the characters irritating, bland, vacuous, cliché, or difficult to differentiate.
Scientific inaccuracies regarding wildlife adaptation and evolution in the post-apocalyptic world are a significant point of criticism.
The plot is seen as illogical, with too many odd events and poorly thought-out character decisions.
The pacing is problematic, with large jumps in time and location that feel unrealistic and unearned.

anime.title: White Snake
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Mythology, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Xiao-Bai, a white snake demon, is sent on a mission to assassinate the Emperor's Taoist advisor, who has been killing snakes en masse in order to achieve immortality and curry the Emperor's favor. Xiao-Bai, however, is attacked by the advisor's lackeys before she can reach him and is subsequently defeated. Luckily, the demonic hairpin she was granted by the Snake Mother is able to save her life at the cost of her memories.

Xiao-Bai awakens in the Snake-catcher village, unaware that she is actually a demon or that she is surrounded by her sworn enemies. She meets Xu Xuan, the man who saved her, and is charmed by him. The two set out on a journey to discover who Xiao-Bai is, and learn the secret of her demonic hairpin. The pair is pursued by Xiao-Qing, Xiao-Bai's sister, who has sworn to the Snake Mother to retrieve Xiao-Bai within three days or die trying. As Taoists, demons, and humans collide, a tale of forbidden romance unfolds.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the movie's stunning visuals and action sequences. However, many find the plot and characters, especially the villains, to be underdeveloped. The romance is also criticized for feeling rushed, leaving viewers wanting a deeper emotional connection. Despite these flaws, most find the movie enjoyable, particularly fans of the Xianxia genre.
pros: Visually stunning animation and backgrounds
Fluid and well-choreographed fight scenes
Faithful adaptation of daoists and demons from Chinese webnovels
Satisfying climax that ties everything together
cons: Villains are flat, one-dimensional, and uninspiring
Romance feels rushed and underdeveloped
Story can be forgettable and lacks a lasting impression
Initial pacing is slow

anime.title: Snow Eagle Lord
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis:
In the Tranquil Sun province of the empire, there exists an unremarkable lordship known as Xue Ying Territory! This is the home of the Dong Bo clan, the clan of our hero Xue Ying!

His father, a commoner turned noble; his mother, a noble who abandoned her clan for love, and his brother, an innocent toddler. But peace cannot last forever, Xue Ying’s peaceful life is shattered, and the only way to reclaim it is through power!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Xue Ying Ling Zhu. Some find the initial episodes slow and confusing, while others appreciate the story and action after the initial hurdle. The slow pacing and lack of clear explanations are common criticisms, but some viewers recommend sticking with it until the later episodes or Season 2.
pros: Enjoyable story after a slow start
Decent fighting animation
Season 2 is much better
cons: Slow-paced and boring early episodes
Poor explanation of lore and cultivation
Inconsistent animation quality
Unnecessary character establishment at the beginning

anime.title: Blade Runner: Black Lotus
anime.synopsis: Los Angeles 2032. A young woman wakes up with no memories and possessing deadly skills. The only clues to her mystery are a locked data device and a tattoo of a black lotus. Putting together the pieces, she must hunt down the people responsible for her brutal and bloody past to find the truth of her lost identity.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the show receives praise for its audio-visual elements and faithfulness to the Blade Runner universe, many find the narrative weak, characters underdeveloped, and animation inconsistent. The series is considered a visually and aurally pleasing experience but ultimately falls short in delivering a compelling story with meaningful emotional depth, leading to disappointment for some viewers.
pros: Visually appealing with great design elements and environmental details.
Sound design and music are well-suited and of high quality, enhancing the atmosphere.
Faithful to the Blade Runner universe in terms of world-building and atmosphere.
cons: Story is generic, predictable, and lacks depth.
Characters are poorly defined, with little emotional connection or development.
Animation is inconsistent, with some scenes appearing stiff and lifeless due to motion capture issues.
Pacing issues, with the plot dragging on and feeling stretched out.

anime.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season
anime.synopsis:
When they were little kids laughing and playing together, Izumi Norimoto and Kazusa Onodera were like siblings. But as their bodies matured into middle school, Kazusa began seeing him as something different; unfortunately for her, so did the other girls. Ostracized, Kazusa had no choice but to distance herself from him going into high school. After joining the literature club, however, she finds friends that keep her mind occupied. Known throughout the school for reading aloud sex scenes in literature novels, the club's reputation has kept all teachers from accepting the task of being their adviser.
    
During a discussion about what they would put on their bucket list, one of the girls says one thing: sex. This single word sends ripples throughout the five girls, as the thought of sex begins taking over their daily lives. And, after walking in on Izumi during a very private moment, Kazusa is sent into a spiral of emotion that forces her to face her true feelings for him. Now, with their hearts racing and the literature club facing immediate disbandment, the five girls must work hard to keep both their sanities and their club alive.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on "Araburu Kisetsu no Otome-domo yo." Some find the series to be a relatable and entertaining exploration of teenage sexuality and emotions, praising its humor and unpredictable plot. However, others criticize the show for its melodrama, unlikeable characters, and attempts to tackle too many themes, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Relatable exploration of teenage emotions and sexuality.
Hilarious and wholesome moments.
Unique and unpredictable plot twists.
Excellent dialogue and execution.
cons: Overdramatic and unrealistic character reactions.
Too many themes crammed into one show.
Forced and shallow subromances.
Unlikeable and cringe-worthy characters.

anime.title: The Helpful Fox Senko-san
anime.synopsis:
Like many hardworking members of the workforce, Kuroto Nakano is perpetually stressed out by his job. Still, since he lives alone, he must carry on to sustain himself. Little do humans like Kuroto know, this stress takes the form of darkness residing within a person's body and will bring one's life to ruin. 

Fox deities can see this darkness and have the duty to save people before it is too late. To help rid Kuroto of his stress,  Senko-san, an eight hundred-year-old foxgirl, volunteers to take care of him, and will do everything she can to ease the tension in his weary soul.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is widely considered a feel-good, relaxing slice-of-life anime that excels at providing a sense of comfort and healing through its cute characters and simple premise. However, its reliance on self-insertion and the problematic nature of the relationship between the protagonist and Senko draw criticism. While some viewers find the show repetitive and shallow, others appreciate its ability to create a soothing and heartwarming experience.
pros: Relaxing and heartwarming slice of life.
Cute and likable characters, especially Senko.
High-quality art and sound create a 'breath of life' atmosphere.
Fulfilling and provides a sense of calmness and nurturing.
cons: Plot is very basic and repetitive; nothing much happens.
Heavily relies on the self-insert concept, which might not appeal to everyone.
Some viewers find the premise problematic due to the loli appearance of Senko and intimate situations with the protagonist.
Minimal plot progression and character development, leading to boredom for some viewers.

anime.title: Case Closed Movie 23: The Fist of Blue Sapphire
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 23: Konjou no Fist
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Detective, Drama, Mystery, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
The world's greatest blue sapphire, the "blue lapis fist", said to have sunk in a pirate ship in the late 19th century, on the coasts of Singapore. A local millionaire plots to retrieve it, and when it's exhibited in an exhibition at the Singaporean Marina Sands hotel, a murder takes place. A bloody Kaitou Kid announcement card is found in the crime scene.

In the meantime, Ran and Sonoko have come to Singapore to see a karate tournament held there. Conan, who doesn't have a passport and can't travel overseas, was supposed to stay at home. But Kid, who wants to make use of him, uses a magical trick to forcibly drag him to Singapore. Conan must obey Kid if he wants to get back to Japan, gets his glasses, wristwatch and clothes, amongst others, all stolen from him and he has to disguise himself.

Ran, who doesn't realize who he is, asks him his name and he improvises the name Arthur Hirai. Kid eventually gets a hold of information about the "fist" being stored in a manor's underground vault. Just when he was thinking that he'd made it inside very easily, he finds a dangerous trap awaiting him. Facing him is the strongest karateka with 400 consecutive victories: Makoto Kyogoku.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some enjoying the film's action and visuals, and the interplay between Conan and Kid. However, many found the mystery lacking, the action overblown, and the plot reliant on tired clichés. There is a common sentiment that the film prioritizes spectacle over substance, alienating some long-time fans of the detective series.
pros: Visually appealing animation and art style, especially the Singapore setting.
Enjoyable character interactions, particularly between Conan and Kaito Kid.
Some found the over-the-top action and 'super powers' fun and lore-friendly.
cons: Weak mystery and predictable culprit.
Overreliance on action at the expense of the detective elements.
Exaggerated physics and super-powered characters felt out of place for some viewers.
Awful Engrish in parts of the movie.

anime.title: Ao-chan Can't Study!
anime.romaji_title: Midara na Ao-chan wa Benkyou ga Dekinai
anime.synopsis:
"Show them your A-O face!" As an innocent child, Ao Horie would unhesitantly proclaim the origins of her name. Now that she is in high school, she is determined to study hard in order to one day escape the influence of her lascivious father, a famous erotic author. However, when the amiable Takumi Kijima confesses to Horie, her mind runs wild with scandalous thoughts.

Moans eager to escape, legs crossing, and a warmth spreading through her body, Horie cannot help but misconstrue Kijima's rather pure motivations. To make things worse, no matter how hard she tries to ward off Kijima, his advances do not stop. Now, if only she could just study!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some finding the anime hilarious and wholesome, while others criticize its repetitive nature, problematic themes, and potentially traumatizing content. The short episode length is generally seen as a positive, but the character development and reliance on ecchi elements are points of contention. While some appreciate the anime as a lighthearted rom-com, others find it problematic and frustrating.
pros: Catchy opening theme and generally good sound design.
Enjoyable and funny, especially due to the short episode length.
Faithful adaptation of the manga, capturing the comedic moments well.
cons: Repetitive plot structure in many episodes.
Questionable character development, especially Ao's dependence on romance.
Overreliance on misunderstandings and potentially traumatizing ecchi themes.

anime.title: Senryu Girl
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
To the students of Karai High School, Nanako Yukishiro is a pretty, calm, and cute 16-year-old. However, Nanako is no ordinary girl, as she cannot speak! Instead, Nanako communicates through senryuu—17-syllable-long poems. 

Sixteen-year-old Eiji Busujima used to be delinquent in his middle school years. However, he has since turned over a new leaf due to his newfound love of senryuu. Despite his menacing looks, Eiji gets along well with Nanako as a fellow member of the Literature Club.

Even though Nanako is mute, the adorable pair have no problem communicating with each other. Senryuu Shoujo is a light and relaxing story of two teenagers' daily lives.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Senryuu Shoujo to be a cute and wholesome short anime. The characters are likable, and the story is simple and enjoyable, making it a relaxing watch. However, some viewers find the animation and story generic, and others wish for more depth in the characters' backgrounds.
pros: Charming characters, especially Nanako and Eiji.
Light and relaxing slice-of-life story.
Good comedy and cute romantic undertones.
Enjoyable and funny storyline.
Simple and sweet.
cons: Animation can be janky and low-budget.
Story can be generic and not very original.
Lack of detail regarding Nanako's mutism.
Some find the comedy underwhelming.

anime.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
anime.romaji_title: Itai no wa Iya nanode Bougyoryoku ni Kyokufuri Shitai to Omoimasu.
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
After an enthusiastic invitation from her friend, Kaede Honjou reluctantly agrees to try New World Online: a very popular VRMMO played by thousands of people across Japan. Naming her in-game character Maple, she sets out on her journey. As a complete novice to such games, she allocates all of her stat points into vitality, desiring to not get hurt. With not a single point in any other stat, Maple has extraordinarily high defense, but she can't move quickly or hit hard.

This does not end badly for her, however. Due to her high defense, Maple acquires overpowered skills such as Total Defense, Poison Immunity, and Devour. These skills, along with the incredibly powerful items she obtains, allow her to obliterate most enemies in a single hit. After only a few days of playing the game, Maple claims third place in a server-wide event, gaining a reputation as a player who is both unkillable and absurdly powerful.

Despite her overpowered character, Kaede has much to learn. As she progresses through the game, she meets new friends and acquaintances, helping her complete new levels and events. Through all of her adventures, she may even pick up some other crazy skills that exceed all expectations.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Bofuri for its lighthearted and cute nature, praising its fun VRMMO concept and adorable main character, Maple. However, some find the overpowered protagonist and simplistic plot to be detrimental, leading to a lack of depth and challenge. Despite these criticisms, the show is largely considered a relaxing and enjoyable slice-of-life anime.
pros: Fun and engaging VRMMO concept.
Charming and adorable main character (Maple).
Colorful and visually appealing art style.
Relaxing and easy to watch with a light tone.
cons: Overpowered main character diminishes challenge and stakes.
Simplistic plot with contrived solutions.
Lack of depth and character development for supporting cast.
Repetitive nature of challenges and resolutions.

anime.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime OAD
anime.romaji_title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken OVA
anime.synopsis: One day, Shuna and Shion are fighting over Rimuru's squishy slime body as usual. Rimuru figures that giving them each a body double of himself would solve the conflict, but when he imagines some of his other friends asking him to do the same for them, he quickly drops that plan. Then he comes up with the idea to make a cushion in the shape of his slime form. He travels around Tempest to see if his friends know of any good materials he can use, and he learns that a special type of sand found along a lake shore in the forest is exactly what he's looking for. So he sets out to collect some sand... but a monster is waiting for him by the lake! What's more, Milim hears about his plan for a picnic and comes racing down from the sky!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the humor, character interactions, and the later 'academy arc' episodes for their contribution to the world and character development, a significant portion criticizes the initial episodes for excessive and irrelevant fan service. This tonal inconsistency leads to a divided overall assessment of the OVA series.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions and spotlight time.
High-quality animation and sound design consistent with the main series.
The final three episodes provide an engaging side story with character development and world-building, fitting seamlessly into the main narrative.
Humorous content and gags that align with the series' tone.
cons: The first two episodes are criticized for being plotless, excessive fanservice with no relevance to the main story.
The shift in tone between the fanservice episodes and the academy arc creates a jarring experience for some viewers.
Some viewers found the initial episodes to be a waste of time and lacking in meaningful content.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Fan Service, Comedy

anime.title: Kiratto Pri☆chan Season 2
anime.synopsis: Mirai Momoyama, Emo Moegi, and Rinka Aoba are 2nd year students at Kirarigaoka Middle School in Kirajuku, and together they form an idol group called "Miracle☆Kiratts"! The popularity of their streaming programs has skyrocketed! One day, a mysterious Pri☆Chan idol named "Dia" appears, and everyone is given a Jewel Pact. Along with that, she announces the opening of the "Jewel Auditions", an event where idols with a jewel-like shine are chosen to become "Jewel Idols". Only those who can pass the audition with a sparkling heart can make their "Kiratto Jewel" shine, allowing them to receive their "Jewel Coord". And out of all of them, only the best "Jewel Idol" can wear the long-admired "Diamond Coord". Who's going to be?!
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 of Kiratto Pri☆chan showed moments of brilliance where it surpassed expectations, transforming from a flawed series into something truly special. However, this high point was not consistent, with many episodes still suffering from the issues that plagued the first season. Despite its inconsistencies, the show has elements to love, particularly its artistic choices and the potential it displays.
pros: Spectacular over-delivery on potential during a specific arc.
Interesting artistic choices.
cons: Mediocrity in many episodes.
Episodes filled with 'bullshit'.

anime.title: Goblin Slayer: Adventure Sheet
anime.romaji_title: Goblin Slayer: Bouken Kiroku Youshi - Adventure Sheet
anime.synopsis: Recap of the first 10 episodes of Goblin Slayer.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on the necessity and execution of this recap episode. While some appreciate it as a refresher or a means to catch up, many find it redundant and poorly paced, especially given its placement within the season. Its primary function as a production delay is acknowledged, but it fails to offer substantial new content or a cohesive narrative arc.
pros: Recap effectively highlights key plot points and character moments for new viewers.
Production value remains consistent with the main series, including artwork and sound design.
Can serve as a useful refresher for long-time fans, sparking anticipation for upcoming arcs.
cons: Largely unnecessary for viewers who have been following the series closely.
Poor transitions and pacing, skipping important character introductions (e.g., Priestess).
Disrupts the narrative flow by ending before the season's concluding events.
Lacks new content, making it feel like a filler episode rather than an enriching addition.

anime.title: Nobunaga Teacher's Young Bride
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: "One day, a girl who loves me will suddenly appear before me"—Middle school teacher Nobunaga has always been dreaming of such a gal game-like situation. However, the one who appeared before him was Kichou, a 14-year-old girl who proclaims herself as his wife. Appearing to have arrived from the Sengoku era, she mistakes Nobunaga as Nobunaga Oda and urges him to conceive a child with her. Thus begins the age-difference love comedy between a gal game-loving teacher and a Sengoku era expert princess.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is highly divided on 'Nobunaga-sensei no Osanazuma.' Some viewers find the show's absurdity and ecchi content funny and entertaining, while others consider it to be a poorly written, degenerate mess with problematic themes. Many feel it fails as both a comedy and a historical narrative, resorting to cheap fanservice instead. The short episode length is seen as both a positive (easy to watch) and a negative (lack of development).
pros: Some viewers find the show funny and entertaining, especially its absurdity.
The short episode length (7 minutes) makes it easy to watch.
Character designs are considered cute by some.
cons: The plot is thin and nonsensical, with little to no story development.
The show relies heavily on fan service, ecchi content, and potentially problematic themes (loli, etc.).
Characters are generic, bland, and lack depth.
Production quality is low, with blurry art and sometimes poor sound mixing.
Some find the show degenerate and bordering on hentai, with uncomfortable and potentially illegal themes.

anime.title: Aggretsuko: We Wish You a Metal Christmas
anime.romaji_title: Aggressive Retsuko: We Wish You a Metal Christmas
anime.synopsis: Red panda Retsuko, worked to the bone, unleashes her frustration in the form of death metal. Lately, though, she's found another joy—getting the most likes possible on her Instagram posts. In fact, it is said that social media attention can release endorphins. As Christmas falls upon the city, Retsuko's hunger for validation only grows, pushing her to find new ways to embellish and sugarcoat her otherwise drab life for the internet to see.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Aggretsuko: We Wish You a Metal Christmas' special is generally well-received, with many finding it heartwarming and enjoyable, especially for fans of the series. However, some find it underwhelming and not particularly special compared to the main series, with a few missing the heavy metal elements. Overall, it's considered a fun and worthwhile watch, particularly for its emotional moments and character interactions.
pros: Heartwarming and cute, especially Retsuko's best wishes scene.
Retains the charm of the cast and their Christmas celebrations.
Addresses a plot point from the end of the first season.
The ending is magnificent and emotionally delightful.
cons: Underwhelming and disappointing, especially for a Christmas special.
Story wasn't too special.
Less heavy metal than normal episodes
anime.thematic_vibe: Christmas Wholesome, Social Media Satire, Unrequited Love

anime.title: Hello World
anime.synopsis:
The year is 2027, and the city of Kyoto has undergone tremendous technological advancement. Within the city live two classmates: Naomi Katagaki, a socially awkward and introverted boy; and Ruri Ichigyou, a girl with a cold personality who is often blunt with people. Despite sharing Ruri's love of reading, Naomi is afraid to approach her due to her unfriendly nature.

One day, while out on a walk, Naomi witnesses a crimson aurora pierce through the sky for a brief moment before vanishing. Shortly after, he encounters a three-legged crow and a mysterious hooded man, who reveals himself to be Naomi from 10 years in the future, explaining that he has come to change an imminent tragic event that happens to Ruri soon after they start dating. Initially taking his words with a grain of salt, present-day Naomi follows his future self's instructions and starts getting closer to Ruri, determined to save her. Will he be able to change the future?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on Hello World. Some praise its interesting story, animation, and music, while others criticize its confusing plot, underdeveloped romance, and jarring shift in tone. The ending is a particularly divisive point, with some finding it deep and others nonsensical. Overall, the film is considered ambitious but flawed.
pros: Interesting story with plot twists.
Well-made CG animation.
Outstanding sound design and music.
Likeable characters.
cons: Confusing and convoluted story, especially the ending.
Plot feels disjointed, shifting from romance to action/sci-fi.
Underdeveloped romance.
Overly complicated scientific explanations.
Characters are bland

anime.title: Baby I Love You Daze
anime.synopsis: An aloof junior high school boy meets a cheerful high school girl inside a Lotte shop where they both reach for the same chocolate bar. Before he can react, she takes a different candy instead and leaves with her purchase. Continuing to dwell on the missed connection, the boy hopes that he can meet the girl again and gift her the sweet she originally wanted—with the addition of his feelings.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Baby I Love You Daze' for its high-quality animation, catchy music, and charming characters, despite recognizing its primary purpose as an advertisement. Viewers found the short film emotionally engaging and visually appealing, with many praising the artistry and musical score. The consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with minor criticism directed towards the simplicity of the plot.
pros: Excellent animation and art style.
Catchy and emotional music by Bump of Chicken.
Well-developed characters and expressions, even in a short time.
cons: Simple story, primarily an advertisement.
Limited plot development.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sweet Romance, Nostalgic, Slice of Life

anime.title: Weathering with You
anime.synopsis:
Tokyo is currently experiencing rain showers that seem to disrupt the usual pace of everyone living there to no end. Amidst this seemingly eternal downpour arrives the runaway high school student Hodaka Morishima, who struggles to financially support himself—ending up with a job at a small-time publisher. At the same time, the orphaned Hina Amano also strives to find work to sustain herself and her younger brother.

Both fates intertwine when Hodaka attempts to rescue Hina from shady men, deciding to run away together. Subsequently, Hodaka discovers that Hina has a strange yet astounding power: the ability to call out the sun whenever she prays for it. With Tokyo's unusual weather in mind, Hodaka sees the potential of this ability. He suggests that Hina should become a "sunshine girl"—someone who will clear the sky for people when they need it the most.

Things begin looking up for them at first. However, it is common knowledge that power always comes with a hefty price...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with some praising the film's visuals and music, while others criticize the weak characters, forced romance, and disjointed plot. Many compare it unfavorably to Shinkai's previous work, 'Your Name,' finding it less impactful.  There is a general sentiment that the film prioritizes style over substance, leading to disappointment for some viewers.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style
Catchy and well-fitting soundtrack
Enjoyable and easy-to-follow story
cons: Weak or rushed character development, especially the leads
Unclear motivations and forced romance
Story elements feel disjointed and contrived
Supernatural elements don't blend well with the romance
Ending feels unsatisfying or misanthropic to some viewers
Plot is predictable and lacks depth

anime.title: The 8th Son? Are You Kidding Me?
anime.romaji_title: Hachi-nan tte, Sore wa Nai deshou!
anime.synopsis: Waking up in a new world, 25-year-old Shingo Ichinomiya realizes that he is in the body of a six-year-old. Retaining memories of his stressful life working at a firm company, Shingo learns that the person he is occupying is Wendelin Von Benno Baumeister, the eighth son of a poor noble family living in the countryside. Awoken to his bizarre situation, Wendelin strives to change his financial and social status for the better. His newly discovered great magical aptitude may prove to be just what he needs to achieve that goal.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Hachi-nan tte, Sore wa Nai deshou!' is largely negative. Reviewers heavily criticize the anime for its unoriginal isekai plot, poor pacing, and generic characters. While some viewers found it mildly entertaining as a brain-off show, the overwhelming consensus is that it is a poorly executed and forgettable addition to the isekai genre.
pros: Some found the story interesting despite being generic.
Character designs are appealing to some viewers.
A few viewers appreciated the character development and relationships.
cons: Generic and unoriginal isekai plot with many clichés.
Poor pacing, rushed plot, and inconsistent storytelling.
Underdeveloped and uncharismatic characters, especially the female cast.
Mediocre animation, cheap CGI, and uninspired music.
Political drama is boring and unengaging.
Main character is unlikable and inconsistent in behavior.

anime.title: Umayon
anime.synopsis: It's a "pop" and cute everyday anime based on the 4-koma manga featuring the characters from Uma Musume: Pretty Derby.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Umayon as a lighthearted and cute spin-off, especially if they are already fans of the Uma Musume franchise. While some find the humor hit-or-miss, the short episodes and focus on character interactions are generally appreciated. It serves as a fun, quick diversion for fans wanting more of the horse girl characters.
pros: Enjoyable jokes and silly scenarios.
Good look into the personalities of various horse girls.
Light and quick to watch.
Fun and well-made shorts.
cons: Humor may not land for everyone.
Some episodes feel too short.
Relies heavily on familiarity with the original Uma Musume series.
Not as witty as it could have been.

anime.title: Shironeko Project ZERO CHRONICLE
anime.synopsis:
The world is divided into two kingdoms: the Kingdom of White, which floats in the heavens and is ruled by their queen Iris, and the Kingdom of Black, which stands upon desolate land below and houses the King of Darkness as its ruler. As of late, forces of evil have amassed great power, posing a threat to the entire world. Being the main representative of the Light, it is Iris' duty to maintain the balance of the world and fight off the darkness in her kingdom.

Meanwhile in the Kingdom of Black, rampaging monsters annihilate a certain boy's village, leaving him the sole survivor. As he grieves in hopelessness, an armored man named Skeer notices the child and comforts him. Soon after, Skeer recognizes the boy's potential to change the kingdom's status quo and makes him his heir before passing away. The boy then vows to become the Prince of Darkness—the one who will replace the King—to bring the world back to its rightful path.

As Iris and Prince of Darkness each challenge the impending doom the world faces in their own respective ways, their destinies will converge with each other, and perhaps, their bond will decide the fate of the world.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is overwhelmingly negative, with many viewers feeling the anime was a waste of time. While a few appreciated the initial setup and some characters, the rushed and nonsensical ending ruined the experience for most. The anime is criticized for its reliance on clichés, poor pacing, and overall lack of depth, making it a disappointing adaptation.
pros: Some viewers enjoyed the initial world-building and character designs.
The opening theme song was well-received by some.
Groza's character was a highlight for some viewers.
cons: The plot is considered generic, overused, and cliché-ridden.
Many found the story and character motivations to be shallow and nonsensical.
The ending is almost universally criticized as rushed, unsatisfying, and nonsensical, retroactively ruining the entire show for many viewers.
The animation quality is lackluster, especially in fight scenes.
Pacing is erratic with random fillers and abrupt shifts in tone.

anime.title: Star☆Twinkle Precure: Hoshi no Uta ni Omoi wo Komete
anime.romaji_title: Star☆Twinkle Precure: Hoshi no Uta ni Omoi wo Komete
anime.synopsis:
When a meteor shower causes a mysterious star-shaped alien to land in Lala Hagoromo and Hikaru Hoshina's home, the girls find themselves having to take care of the mischievous creature whom they name "Yuma." Although their relationship gets off to a rocky start, Lala and Yuma eventually connect through their similar passions for music and exploration. 

However, when strange alien hunters targeting Yuma arrive on Earth, the girls learn that there is more to Yuma than what meets the eye. In protecting Yuma, the Star☆Twinkle Precure find themselves entangled in an astronomical battle where the fate of the galaxy is at stake! Will Yuma feel the Precure's emotions through their melody, and can they make the necessary sacrifices to defend everything they love?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the movie enjoyable due to its themes of exploration and friendship, particularly liking the focus on Lala's alien perspective and the well-animated fight scenes. However, others were bored by the plot, finding it uninspired and failing to justify its existence as a standalone film.
pros: Interesting theme of alien exposed to Earth life.
Well-animated fight scenes.
Focus on Lala's perspective as an alien.
Satisfying and relaxing to watch
World exploration scenes
cons: Boring story.
Not an improvement from the anime in terms of plot.
Movie's plot is not special enough to justify its existence.

anime.title: Virtual-san Looking
anime.synopsis:
Virtual-san wa Miteiru is an anime that brings Virtual YouTubers to life.

The term Virtual YouTuber, or VTuber, refers to a YouTuber who shows themselves as an animated character, hiding their true appearance but still bringing joy to viewers. VTubers featured in Virtual-san wa Miteiru include Hime Tanaka and Hina Suzuki, who together make the rhythmic music duo HimeHina; Siro, the cyber girl, who definitely, certainly, positively has never murdered anyone; the lazy, FPS-loving Hinata Nekomiya; the upbeat Akari Mirai who sexually harasses her juniors; and the lightweight Mito Tsukino, who has a serious superiority complex.

In every episode these VTubers perform nonsense together in skits filled with slapstick, puns and fourth-wall-breaks. From the parody space adventure "Virtual Wars" to the nameless skit about bouncing gorillas, these absurdly funny segments are brimming with excitement. Virtual-san wa Miteiru is a one-of-a-kind comedy certain to bring delight to any fan of Virtual YouTubers!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided, largely based on pre-existing familiarity with VTubers. Fans of VTubers may appreciate the show's faithfulness to the medium, while newcomers are likely to find it confusing and unfunny. Critiques focus on the poor animation, lack of story, and uninspired character portrayals, leading to a generally negative experience for those unfamiliar with the source material.
pros: Faithful to the VTuber medium's loose format and ad-libbing style.
Animation is cleaner and smoother than typical VTuber content due to the Unity engine.
Provides a snapshot of the diverse and growing VTuber cultural phenomenon.
cons: Comedic sketches can be unfunny and feel like low-quality VRchat videos.
The show lacks a cohesive story and feels like a series of rushed, incomplete bits.
Animation quality can be poor, with low frame rates and model clipping issues.
Characters feel uninteresting and lack personality, failing to capture the appeal of the real VTubers they portray.

anime.title: Ex-Arm
anime.synopsis:
After being hit by a truck in the year 2014, Akira Natsume awakes to find himself inside a machine following a 16-year-long coma. As he adjusts to the new interface, he is greeted by police officer Minami Uezono and her android partner Alma. The pair shows Akira that his brain is contained inside a device called an EX-ARM—a weapon of mass destruction. Aboard an enemy smuggler ship, the three must escape using nothing but their ingenuity and combat skills.

While initially reluctant to fight, Akira soon recalls his brother's words from before the accident. The memory inspires him to take action, possessing Alma's body to fight his opponents using martial arts. Once Alma plugs him into one of the ship's ports, he discovers the devastating potential of his EX-ARM by effortlessly hacking and assuming control of the vessel.

Upon safely arriving back on land, Akira meets the other members of the EX-ARM Countermeasure Prevention Team, a police division working to mitigate the effects of EX-ARMs. Witnessing the atrocities committed by those who seek the power of EX-ARMs, he resolves to join the team and put an end to the terror caused by these weapons.
anime.consensus_summary: Ex-Arm is almost universally panned for its atrocious animation quality and uninspired storytelling. While a few viewers appreciate the effort made despite its flaws, the overwhelming consensus is that the anime is a disaster on nearly every level. It is often cited as an example of how not to make an anime, with some finding entertainment value in its sheer awfulness.
pros: Some reviewers appreciate the effort put into the animation despite its flaws.
The story, while not exceptional, has some interesting concepts and mysteries.
Voice acting performances are considered better than the anime deserves by some.
cons: The animation is overwhelmingly criticized for being horrendous, with poor CGI, inconsistent quality, and bizarre visual clashes.
The story is considered uninspired, cookie-cutter, and riddled with tropes.
Characters are seen as flat, one-dimensional, and lacking emotional depth.
Many plot points are left unresolved, and the dialogue and script are poorly written.
The direction and production team lacked experience, leading to a disastrous final product.

anime.title: Neko no Nyagh: Nya Misérables
anime.synopsis:
TV adaptation of Cocone Corporation's mobile puzzle game app.

Discover the adventures of the cat painter, Vincent van Meowogh who lives in a mansion in Paris surrounded by his quirky friends. Let's give him a spark of inspiration for his painting by completing puzzle stages, buy back the furniture and restore his home to its former glory!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive.
