Viewers find the anime to be a cute, wholesome, and relaxing experience, especially those familiar with the original mobile game. The show's charming art style and lighthearted humor contribute to its appeal, with some viewers even appreciating the educational art history elements. The series is generally considered a quick, enjoyable watch suitable for viewers of all ages.
pros: Charming art style
Light and relaxing tone
Educational art history elements
Suitable for all ages
Good for fans of the original game
cons: Streamlined story due to time constraints
May not appeal to those unfamiliar with the game

anime.title: Bakumatsu Crisis
anime.synopsis: The Bakumatsu was an era in which the souls of young men burned with anxiety for their country's future. Takasugi Shinsaku, a soldier of fortune from Choshu, sneaks aboard a government ship with his comrade Katsura Kogorou in search of a mysterious "timepiece" with the power to manipulate time that he fears the government wishes to keep for themselves. Rather than allow such power to fall into the wrong hands, Takasugi plans to destroy the artifact, but having obtained it, the artifact is quickly stolen, forcing the pair to follow the mysterious thief to the seat of government in Kyoto. However, when they arrive in the capital, they discover that the government has been overthrown and the deity Susanoo now reigns in its place. The streets of the city and the people in them are much different than Takasugi and Katsura remembered. The times may have changed but their mission hasn't - Takasugi and Katsura resolve to reset time and save their nation from the nefarious forces trying to hijack it.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative, particularly towards the second season. Reviewers found the plot confusing and nonsensical, with a significant decline in animation quality. While the soundtrack was praised, it wasn't enough to redeem the series, leaving viewers feeling that their time was wasted.
pros: Improved OP and ED songs compared to Season 1.
cons: Poor art and animation quality, described as 'crappy, unfinished, and lazy'.
Confusing and ridiculous storyline in Season 2.
Unnecessary characters with unchanging personalities.
Filler content like 'Petit Clover' segments that detract from the episodes.
Drastic step down in quality from Season 1.

anime.title: Haikyu!! To the Top
anime.synopsis:
After their triumphant victory over Shiratorizawa Academy, the Karasuno High School volleyball team has earned their long-awaited ticket to nationals. As preparations begin, genius setter Tobio Kageyama is invited to the All-Japan Youth Training Camp to play alongside fellow nationally recognized players. Meanwhile, Kei Tsukishima is invited to a special rookie training camp for first-years within the Miyagi Prefecture. Not receiving any invitations himself, the enthusiastic Shouyou Hinata feels left behind.

However, Hinata does not back down. Transforming his frustration into self-motivation, he boldly decides to sneak himself into the same rookie training camp as Tsukishima. Even though Hinata only lands himself a job as the ball boy, he comes to see this as a golden opportunity. He begins to not only reflect on his skills as a volleyball player but also analyze the plethora of information available on the court and how he can apply it.

As the much-anticipated national tournament approaches, the members of Karasuno's volleyball team attempt to overcome their weak points and refine their skills, all while aiming for the top!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, primarily due to changes in art style and animation quality. While many appreciate the character development and adherence to the manga, others find the pacing slow and the humor excessive. The season is seen as a necessary step in the overall storyline, but not as strong as previous installments.
pros: Excellent character development, especially Hinata's growth.
Incredible OST and well-timed music usage heightens emotional impact.
Retains the Haikyuu spirit; still amazing despite changes.
New art style aligns more closely with the manga.
cons: Art style changes are jarring and not universally liked.
Animation quality is perceived as weaker compared to previous seasons.
Pacing issues, particularly with training arcs.
New characters sometimes feel unnatural and overly stereotypical.
Humor is too slapstick and over-the-top.

anime.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life Season 2
anime.genres: Drama, Music, Performing Arts, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
The Tokise High School Koto Club has courageously pushed through their fractured and unsynchronized performance at the Kanto Region Traditional Japanese Music Festival. Club members Chika Kudou, Satowa Houzuki, Takezou Kurata, Hiro Kurusu, Kouta Mizuhara, Saneyasu Adachi, and Michitaka Sakai are devastated to learn the negative results of their performance, leaving them crushed. Nonetheless, the group recognizes their potential and enthusiastically agree to collectively sharpen their skills, improve their flaws, and develop higher caliber playing to succeed in the upcoming national qualifiers in winter.

With the help of their now willing club advisor Suzuka Takinami, the group's goal gradually becomes achievable as they begin to grasp the foundations of good music and refine their koto-playing abilities, with the suggestion of performing more often to gain what they lack most—experience.

However, as their journey to nationals is underway, the koto club members face challenges that obstruct their focus and progress. Not only does the threat of other powerhouse schools and musicians remain, but the high school issues of budding romance and soon-to-be-graduating seniors also begin to push the limits of the determined group of teenagers and the future of the koto club.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves Kono Oto Tomare! Part 2 for its emotional depth, character development, and focus on Koto music. While some critique the pacing and art style, the overall mood is positive, with many viewers eagerly anticipating a third season. The series resonates deeply with those who appreciate character-driven narratives and the beauty of traditional Japanese music.
pros: Excellent character development and interactions
Emotional and touching storytelling
Unique focus on Koto music and its beauty
cons: Fast-paced tempo
Faded art style
Predictable plot

anime.title: Sora no Method: Mou Hitotsu no Negai
anime.romaji_title: Sora no Method: Mou Hitotsu no Negai
anime.synopsis: The official website of Sora no Method (Celestial Method) announced a new episode for the anime series. The episode will feature a new character.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is a welcome continuation for fans of Noel, filling in some gaps left by the original series. However, pacing issues and a lack of originality in the new character design are noted. Overall, the episode seems to be a pleasant, if somewhat rushed, addition to the Sora no Method story.
pros: Continuation of the original story
Focus on Noel's character development
New character blends well with existing cast
cons: Pacing feels rushed due to time constraints
New character is a carbon copy of existing ones

anime.title: Double Decker! Doug & Kirill: Extra
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Comedy, Detective, Mystery, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: During the final episode pre-screening event on Friday, it was announced that Double Decker! Doug & Kirill TV anime will get three extra episodes. Titled Double Decker! Doug & Kirill: Extra, the three episodes will be streamed via Bandai Channel and other streaming websites between February and April 2019. The Blu-ray and DVD for the extra episodes will also be released on May 24, 2019.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Extra' episodes are considered a pleasant, but inessential, addition to the main Double Decker! Doug & Kirill series. They offer fans more of what they enjoyed – character interactions and lighthearted stories – without adding anything critical to the overarching narrative. The general sentiment is positive for those already invested in the characters.
pros: Expands on character interactions and backstories.
Provides a lighthearted epilogue to the main series.
Doesn’t disrupt the viewing experience if watched after the main series.
cons: Plot is not essential to the main story.
Nothing of real importance happens in the episodes.
Relies on investment in the characters from the main series.

anime.title: Infinite Dendrogram
anime.synopsis: In the year 2043, <Infinite Dendrogram>, the world's first successful full-dive VRMMO was released. In addition to its ability to perfectly simulate the five senses, along with its many other amazing features, the game promised to offer players a world full of infinite possibilities. Nearly two years later, soon-to-be college freshman, Reiji Mukudori, is finally able to buy a copy of the game and start playing. With some help from his experienced older brother, Shuu, and his partner Embryo, Reiji embarks on an adventure into the world of <Infinite Dendrogram>. Just what will he discover and encounter in this game world known for its incredible realism and infinite possibilities?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response to Infinite Dendrogram is largely negative, with many finding it a generic and forgettable isekai anime.  The main character is a common point of criticism, while some appreciate the side characters and overall concept.  However, weak world-building, poor animation, and a messy plot contribute to a disappointing viewing experience for most.
pros: Some enjoyed the art style and character designs.
A few found the concept of infinite possibilities intriguing.
Several reviewers appreciated the side characters more than the protagonist.
cons: The main character is considered generic, bland, and underdeveloped.
The plot is criticized for being basic, messy, and lacking a clear objective.
World-building is weak, with essential information omitted in the adaptation.
Animation is often stiff and subpar, with noticeable CGI issues.

anime.title: Battle Spirits: Saga Brave
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Military, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Strategy Game
anime.consensus_summary: The audience sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, particularly among long-time fans of the Battle Spirits series. Viewers appreciate the series as a celebratory send-off and a satisfying conclusion to character arcs. The only notable drawbacks are the short length and the necessity of having seen previous seasons to fully enjoy it.
pros: Excellent fan service and a satisfying continuation of the Dan Saga.
Provides closure for long-time viewers of the Battle Spirits series.
Successfully revisits and showcases the adaptation of characters from previous series.
cons: Plot may feel underdeveloped due to the limited number of episodes.
Relies heavily on prior knowledge of previous Battle Spirits series (Dan and Brave).
Soundtrack doesn't stand out significantly.

anime.title: Psychic Princess
anime.synopsis:
When Qian Yunshang's marriage to Ye Youming is arranged by the emperor, she is terrified that the bad blood between their families will lead to her being treated miserably in the Ye household. Torn between duty and concern for his daughter, Qian Aotian devises a reckless plan. He summons his firstborn daughter—her existence unknown to all but his own family—to be the stand-in for her younger sister.

Due to her unusual powers, Qian Yun Xi was exiled by her family when she was a child. Deprived of filial affection, she made a life of her own amid the wilderness on Mt. Ling Yun. However, everything begins to change when she marries Ye Youming in her sister's stead. 

Harboring immense contempt for the family of Qian, Ye Youming refuses to acknowledge Qian Yun Xi as his wife and treats her coldly, going so far as to banish her from his palace grounds. But he can only resist her childlike charm and boldness for so long...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many find the series enjoyable, especially praising the strong female lead and comedic elements. However, criticisms include a generic plot, underdeveloped characters, and concerns about the male lead's behavior, leading to a somewhat polarized viewing experience.
pros: Strong female lead (Yunxi) who is intelligent, talented, and not a pushover.
Enjoyable and easy to follow plot, good for relaxing.
Humorous interactions between the main characters, particularly the 'enemies to lovers' dynamic.
Unique and charming animation style.
Good balance of action, drama, comedy, and romance.
cons: Generic or simple plot, predictable story.
Lack of depth and detail in the story and character development.
Male lead (Prince Ye) can be heartless and rude, making it hard to root for the romance.
Inconsistent or awkward opening animation and music.
Plot holes and unresolved conflicts.

anime.title: Great Journey of Teenagers
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Historical, Martial Arts, Mystery
anime.synopsis: Wangyou, Master of Hanshui Temple died mysteriously and when the news about a golden coffin spreads throughout the world, it triggered disputes between the World of Martial arts. Join a group of youths, Lei Wujie, Xiao Se, Tang Lian, Sikong Qianluo, Heavenly Maiden Rui in their adventure as the mystery of the golden coffin unravels.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the intricate plot and world-building of Shaonian Ge Xing, finding the unfolding mysteries and character dynamics engaging. Some feel the initial story serves as a setup for a larger narrative, while others are critical of the plot devices that unite the characters.
pros: Fascinating, layered story with a coherent plot.
Well-paced execution and reveal of central mystery.
Rich world-building with vibrant sects.
cons: Story is essentially a prologue.
Characters fates become intertwined due to a rumor.

anime.title: Kochoki
anime.synopsis: The fearsome warlord, the demonic king—Oda Nobunaga! Before he was trying to rule over Japan, he was a teenager who began his path to greatness with his younger brother and faithful followers. Through succession, betrayal, battles, and bonds between one another, the struggles these boys face promise a future where they can blossom into powerful men.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some enjoying the characters and story despite the BL elements and rushed ending. Some viewers appreciate the historical setting and above-average production for Studio Deen, while others are put off by the BL themes and perceived manipulation. Overall, the show seems to have a niche appeal.
pros: Lovable main characters with understandable motivations.
Interesting narration and generally good pacing.
Above average production quality for Studio Deen, particularly the OST.
cons: BL aspect may not appeal to all viewers.
Uncomfortable feelings of manipulation due to BL elements.
Final episode felt rushed.
Overused Sengoku era setting.

anime.title: Tsurune: Kazemai High School Japanese Archery Club - Dangerous Shoot
anime.synopsis: Unaired episode pre-screened at the event and later included with the 5th Blu-ray/DVD release.
anime.consensus_summary: The special episode is generally well-received as a fun and lighthearted addition to the Tsurune series, offering comedic relief and fostering bonds between the Kazemai and Kirisaki teams. While some find the plot lacking and the humor not particularly strong, most viewers appreciate the character interactions and consider it a worthwhile watch before season 2. The episode is not controversial, with the majority expressing positive or neutral sentiments.
pros: Fun character interactions outside of competitions.
Bonding between Kazemai and Kirisaki members.
Comedic relief.
cons: Plot is flat and ridiculous.
Not a particularly good gag episode.
Characters may not be obsession-worthy for some viewers.

anime.title: The Haunted House: The Secret of the Ghost Ball
anime.synopsis: With help from a 102-year-old goblin dwelling beneath their haunted apartment building, two siblings deal with ghosts and take on spooky mysteries.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Sinbi Apartment: Ghost Ball Bimil' for its engaging characters, emotional depth, and blend of humor and sadness. While some find the plot repetitive and the backstories lacking detail, the show is considered a worthwhile watch, particularly for those seeking a lighthearted anime with supernatural elements. Most reviewers highly recommend the show.
pros: Engaging characters with good designs and voice acting.
Mixes humor and sadness effectively.
Heartfelt storytelling and deep lore.
Good animation and voice acting.
cons: Repetitive plot structure in many episodes.
Summarized flashbacks instead of detailed backstories.
Stories are sometimes typical and not very original.

anime.title: Nekopara
anime.synopsis:
The siblings Kashou and Shigure Minazuki enjoy the company of six catgirls. Chocola and Vanilla assist Kashou in his job as a baker at the patisserie La Soleil, while the others—Coconut, Azuki, Cinnamon, and Maple—accompany Shigure in her daily life back at their home.

One afternoon, when Chocola goes out for an errand, she notices a green-haired kitten alone by herself at a park and decides to bring her back to the patisserie. Soon after, the Minazuki household adopts her and gives her a name: Cacao. With a new member in their family, the members of the Minazuki household continue their everyday lives—bound to become livelier than ever.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding it a relaxing and enjoyable slice-of-life anime with cute catgirls, while others criticize it for its weak plot, lack of character development, and potentially uncomfortable fanservice elements. Some viewers familiar with the source material (hentai game) were disappointed with the anime adaptation due to the lack of explicit content and deviation from character personalities. Overall, enjoyment seems highly dependent on individual preferences for the 'cute girls doing cute things' genre and tolerance for fan service.
pros: Relaxing and cozy viewing experience.
Appeals to those who enjoy catgirls and 'cute girls doing cute things'.
Art style is bright and well-done, enhancing the cute feel.
cons: Lacks a strong plot or character development.
Episodic format leads to a lack of overall story progression.
Characters can be one-dimensional and static.
Fanservice can feel out of place due to the childlike presentation of the characters.
Humor can be repetitive and bland.

anime.title: Lord El-Melloi II's Case Files: Rail Zeppelin Grace Note - A Grave Keeper, a Cat, and a Mage
anime.romaji_title: Lord El-Melloi II-sei no Jikenbo: Rail Zeppelin Grace Note - Hakamori to Neko to Majutsushi
anime.synopsis: Years after the Fourth Holy Grail War, Waver Velvet becomes the head of the Modern Magecraft Theories department at the Clock Tower, succeeding the title of Lord El-Melloi II. Waver and his apprentice Gray set out to find the truth behind a mysterious shadow that stalks them, while trouble brews among the mages of the Association.
anime.consensus_summary: The special episode serves as a decent introduction to the series, particularly for Fate/Zero fans. While the storyline of the episode itself isn't exceptional, the visuals and sound are well-received. Most viewers agree that it effectively sets the stage for the main series by showcasing the characters and environment.
pros: Good art and sound design
Well-handled link to Fate/Zero
Nice introduction to the setting and characters
cons: Story in the special episode is not particularly strong
Character development is limited in the special episode
Some fear the plot may become repetitive

anime.title: Cop Craft
anime.genres: Action, Detective, Fantasy, Mystery, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Fifteen years ago, a hyperspace gate appeared in the middle of the Pacific Ocean, connecting Earth to a strange world filled with fairies and monsters. The city of San-Teresa became a home for over two million of these otherworldly visitors. Unfortunately, the population boom also brought its fair share of problems—drugs, prostitution, and trafficking. To combat the rampant crime lurking in the city's shadows, a new department was established in the San-Teresa Metropolitan Police.

Former JSDF soldier Kei Matoba is one of the best cops that the department has to offer, despite his inclination to occasionally bend the rules. After a fairy trafficking case goes wrong, Kei loses Rick Fury, his friend and partner of four years, setting him on a quest for vengeance. To help him with the case, the department pairs him with Tilarna Exedilika, a noble of the Farbani Kingdom. As one of the Knights of Mirvor, her duty is to rescue the noble fairy that Kei encountered during his last case. Despite his distaste for non-humans, he accepts the arrangement at the request of his superiors. Now, the unlikely duo must come together and overcome their differences in order to return the missing fairy to her country and avenge the death of Kei's partner.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Cop Craft are divided. Many appreciate the character dynamics, world-building, and thematic elements, but are significantly let down by the inconsistent animation quality and a perceived decline in story quality as the series progresses. The show's attempt to blend buddy cop tropes with fantasy elements creates a unique experience, but the execution is flawed, leading to a mix of enjoyment and disappointment among viewers.
pros: Strong character chemistry between the leads
Unique world-building blending fantasy and modern elements
Exploration of social issues like racism and xenophobia
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, especially in later episodes
Weak plot structure with episodic and filler content
Underdeveloped side characters and missed potential for deeper exploration of the fantasy world
anime.thematic_vibe: Buddy Cop, Fantasy Blend, Racial Tension

anime.title: Learning with Manga! Fate/Grand Order
anime.synopsis: A short anime based on Manga de Wakaru! Fate/Grand Order by Riyo. Aired during Fate Project Year End 2018, and is also available on YouTube.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Manga de Wakaru! Fate/Grand Order' as a comedic and lighthearted adaptation of the original manga, primarily for fans of the Fate/Grand Order franchise. It's praised for its humor, art style faithful to the source material, and character portrayals, especially Gudako and Astolfo. While the lack of a cohesive plot is noted, it doesn't detract significantly from the enjoyment for its target audience.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the Learning with Manga style
Gudako's voice acting is a highlight
Enjoyable for fans of Fate/Grand Order
Astolfo's character and appeal are well-received
cons: Lack of a coherent story or plot
Animation style may not appeal to everyone
Relies heavily on familiarity with the Fate/Grand Order game

anime.title: Lord El-Melloi II's Case Files: Rail Zeppelin Grace Note
anime.romaji_title: Lord El-Melloi II-sei no Jikenbo: Rail Zeppelin Grace Note
anime.synopsis:
Ten years after facing defeat in the Fourth Holy Grail War, Waver Velvet, now Lord El-Melloi II, teaches classes at the Clock Tower—the center of education for mages. However, his new status as Lord comes with a caveat: obey the orders of Reines, the younger sister of the deceased Kayneth El-Melloi, until she is old enough to rule the House of El-Melloi.

Waver, along with his mysterious apprentice Gray, takes on a series of cases assigned by Reines and the Mages Association. With each case proving to be more complex than the last, could there be more to the Clock Tower than meets the eye, and what secrets does Reines hide?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with Fate franchise fans appreciating the character development and world-building, while newcomers find it inaccessible. Some viewers enjoyed the mystery elements and visual style, others found the story confusing and uninteresting. Waver's character development is a high point.
pros: Well-developed characters, especially Waver and Gray.
High-quality art and animation, particularly the visual and lighting effects.
Interesting story for fans of the Fate franchise, with good pacing.
cons: Requires prior knowledge of the Fate universe; may be confusing for newcomers.
Episodic structure may not appeal to all viewers.
Some reviewers found the mysteries bland and the plot confusing.

anime.title: Ano Hi Mita Hana no Namae wo Bokutachi wa Mada Shiranai.: Menma e no Tegami
anime.romaji_title: Ano Hi Mita Hana no Namae wo Bokutachi wa Mada Shiranai.: Menma e no Tegami
anime.synopsis: Special Picture Drama episode included on the Anohana Fes. Memorial DVD/Blu-ray Box
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates this picture drama as a supplementary piece to the original anime, finding it nostalgic and heartwarming. While it provides additional character insights and emotional closure, some viewers feel it lacks a strong plot and dynamic animation. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile experience for dedicated fans seeking further connection with the characters.
pros: Adds more depth to the characters after the anime's ending.
Satisfying for fans of the original series.
Provides insights into what happened to each character.
Heartwarming and evokes strong emotional responses.
cons: Lacks a substantial plot.
Doesn't address supernatural elements from the anime.
Static images instead of animation.
Content might feel repetitive if watched after the movie.

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind Recaps
anime.romaji_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 5: Ougon no Kaze Recaps
anime.synopsis: Recaps of the JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Ougon no Kaze series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is divided on the value of these recaps. Some find them to be a helpful refresher and enjoyable to watch, especially when following the series weekly. Others view them as skippable filler that detracts from the original experience, mainly suited for those who need a reminder of past events.
pros: Nicely directed recaps that summarize previous episodes cleanly.
Enjoyable to watch as a refresher, especially when following the series weekly.
The third recap functions as a hype-promotional video.
cons: Recaps are generally skippable and unnecessary for binge-watchers.
Recaps compress and drain the pacing and suspense of the original episodes.
Some feel the recaps don't explain events in enough detail.

anime.title: Scumbag System
anime.synopsis:
Shen Yuan has read enough xianxia novels to know that the protagonist will somehow cultivate the demonic path, take revenge on his scumbag master, and gain a massive harem along the way. So when he unexpectedly transmigrates into the world of Proud Immortal Demon Way, he knows exactly how the story is going to proceed. However, he does not get to play the role of the protagonist, but instead he becomes the scumbag master destined to suffer a humiliating defeat.

Shen Yuan, now known as cultivation master Shen Qingqiu, makes it his mission to change his fate so that he does not fall to his disciple, Luo Binghe, the protagonist of the novel. Trying to break away from the cruel personality of the original Shen Qingqiu seems impossible as any uncharacteristic behavior is blocked by a monitoring system meant to keep him from derailing the plot.

Shen Yuan must find a way to befriend Luo Binghe so that he has no reason to seek revenge on his teacher in the future. But with the set series of tragedies meant to befall the protagonist at the hands of Shen Qingqiu, this teacher has his work cut out for him.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed Chuan Shu Zijiu Zhinan, praising its humor, faithful adaptation of the source material, and unique characters. While the 3D animation style received mixed reviews, the overall consensus is positive, with many looking forward to a second season. Some viewers found the plot predictable or the humor not to their taste, but these were minority opinions.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the novel.
Humor is well-executed and hilarious.
Unique and entertaining characters.
Enjoyable story and premise.
Good voice acting.
cons: 3D animation can be jarring or of inconsistent quality.
Pacing issues and abrupt ending to season 1.
Not enough character development for supporting characters.
Some found the story generic or repetitive.
Humor may not appeal to everyone.

anime.title: Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It
anime.romaji_title: Rikei ga Koi ni Ochita no de Shoumei shitemita.
anime.synopsis:
It is widely believed that science can provide rational explanations for the countless phenomena of our universe. However, there are many aspects of our existence that science has not yet found a solution to and cannot decipher with numbers. The most notorious of these is the concept of love. While it may seem impossible to apply scientific theory to such an intricate and complex emotion, a daring pair of quick-witted Saitama University scientists aim to take on the challenge.

One day the bold and beautiful Ayame Himuro outwardly declares that she is in love with Shinya Yukimura, her fellow logical and level-headed scientist. Acknowledging his own lack of experience with romance, Yukimura questions what factors constitute love in the first place and whether he is in love with Himuro or not. Both clueless in the dealings of love, the pair begin to conduct detailed experiments on one another to test the human characteristics that indicate love and discern whether they demonstrate these traits toward each other.

As Himuro and Yukimura begin their intimate analysis, can the two scientists successfully apply scientific theory, with the help of their friends, to quantify the feelings they express for one another?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on 'Rikei ga Koi no Ochita no de Shoumei shitemita.' Some find it a hilarious and charming rom-com with a unique premise, while others criticize it for its repetitive jokes, contrived drama, and weak romantic development. The show's reliance on pseudo-science and stereotypical characters also draws criticism, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Hilarious and funny comedy show.
Charming cast of characters.
Romantic progression is decently fleshed out.
Enjoyable characters and unique premise.
Art is admirable.
cons: Inadequate comedic directing.
Cringey, contrived drama towards the end.
Romantic development is prevented by pointless experiments.
Characters are just robots.
Plot gets old quickly and is one-dimensional.
Too many pseudo-scientific computations and BS.
Samey gags every episode and less than interesting characters.

anime.title: Teasing Master Takagi-san 2
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Even after spending a considerable amount of time with Takagi, Nishikata is still struggling to find a perfect plan to defeat the expert teaser. A battle of wits, a contest of physical prowess, a test of courage—any strategy he employs to expose her weaknesses is to no avail. On the contrary, Nishikata's pitiful attempts only reveal more of his own flaws, which Takagi takes advantage of to become increasingly daring in her teasing attempts. To make things worse for Nishikata, rumors about him and Takagi may have spread in class due to the frequent interactions between them.

However, the optimistic Nishikata believes that wisdom comes with age and that as the days go by, his experience with her constant teasing will eventually bear fruit, leading him to the awaited moment of victory. Thus, Nishikata continues to strive for the seemingly impossible—to outsmart Takagi and make her blush with embarrassment.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san is well-received for its heartwarming portrayal of young love and improved character development. While some find the repetitive nature of the teasing formula monotonous, the majority appreciate the wholesome and cute interactions between Takagi and Nishikata.  The season is praised for its ability to capture the joy and innocence of youth, making it a comforting and enjoyable watch.
pros: Improved characterization and relationship development compared to season 1.
The anime adaptation brings out the best of the manga with passionate execution.
Heartwarming and pure portrayal of young love and friendship.
cons: Repetitive nature of the teasing formula can become monotonous.
Nishikata's obliviousness can be frustrating for some viewers.
Plot progression is minimal, relying on episodic vignettes.

anime.title: Wataten! an Angel Flew Down to Me Episode 13
anime.romaji_title: Watashi ni Tenshi ga Maiorita! Special
anime.synopsis:
Hinata Hoshino, Hana Shirosaki, and Noa Himesaka are off to the countryside for a camping trip. At Hinata's behest, her elder sister, Miyako, reluctantly tags along. Seeing how gloomy Miyako is, the trio do their best to get her to enjoy herself too.

Besides the camping trip, Watashi ni Tenshi ga Maiorita! Special contains three more short stories of the girls. Although their lives seem normal, one thing is certain: there is definitely no shortage of cuteness here!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the special for its continued cuteness and comedic elements, consistent with the original series. However, some viewers found the format of short, disconnected stories and overuse of flashbacks to be a weakness. There's a minor element of disappointment regarding unmet expectations for fan-service content.
pros: Enjoyable day-to-day experiences of the characters.
Creative gags and humor.
Absence of excessive fanservice, despite initial impressions.
cons: Lack of cohesive storyline; feels like compilation of skits.
Overuse of flashbacks.
Disappointment over unfulfilled expectations (e.g., Mya-nee swimsuit).

anime.title: Free! -Road to the World- the Dream
anime.romaji_title: Free! Movie 3: Road to the World - Yume
anime.synopsis: Recap of the Free!: Dive to the Future TV series featuring new scenes.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is well-received, especially for the new scenes and character interactions that were missing from the original series. While it functions as a recap, the added content makes it feel more like a supplementary piece. Some find the rewritten content and reliance on prior knowledge a drawback.
pros: Significant amount of new scenes expanding the story.
Rin and Ikuya finally meet.
Improved OST selection in certain scenes.
cons: Recaps may be hard to understand for those who haven't seen the original season.
Rewrites some of the original story, potentially affecting continuity.

anime.title: In/Spectre
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Mythology, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Hidden in plain sight, spirits known as youkai inhabit the world. While most are benign, a certain subset threatens the tenuous peace between youkai and humanity. Ever since she agreed to become their "God of Wisdom," Kotoko Iwanaga has served as a mediator between the two realms, resolving any supernatural problems that come her way.

At a local hospital, Kotoko approaches Kurou Sakuragawa, a university student whose long-term relationship ended with an unfortunate breakup. Kotoko harbors feelings for him and suspects that something supernatural lurks within his harmless appearance, so she asks Kurou for his assistance in helping out youkai.

Two years later, news of an idol who was accidentally crushed to death by steel beams flooded the press. However, months later, sightings begin to tell of a faceless woman who wields a steel beam. As is the case for any supernatural problem, Kotoko and her partner set out to stop this spirit from wreaking havoc—but this case may prove to be far more sinister and personal than they could have ever thought.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed, praising the show's originality and characters like Kotoko, but criticizing the slow pacing, excessive dialogue, and underdeveloped relationships. Many feel the show drags on, especially during the main arc, and that characters spend too much time talking instead of acting. While the premise is intriguing, the execution leaves much to be desired for a significant portion of viewers.
pros: Unique premise of using lies to solve mysteries.
Interesting characters with good interactions, especially Kotoko.
Good art and animation quality.
Integration of Japanese folklore is well done.
cons: Dialogue-heavy, with excessive talking and repetition.
Pacing issues, particularly in the Steel Lady Nanase arc.
Weak or nonsensical romantic relationships.
Underdeveloped or bland characters (e.g., Kurou).
anime.thematic_vibe: Supernatural Mystery, Logic vs. Fiction, Youkai Lore

anime.title: Martial Universe
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis:
The Great Yan Empire exists in a world where respect can only be earned through strength. Within this Great Yan Empire, the four great clans have always stood above the rest. Among them, a particular incident in the Lin Clan resulted in the banishment of a certain individual who went on to start his own family, in hopes of one day being recognized again by the Lin Clan, and rejoining them…

Hailing from a banished family of the Great Lin Clan, when Lin Dong was very young, he watched, powerless, as his talented father was easily crushed and crippled by the overwhelming genius of the great Lin Clan, Lin Langtian.

With a despairing father, a heartbroken grandfather, and a suffering family, ever since that fateful day, Lin Dong has been driven by a deep purpose; to take revenge on the man who had taken everything and more from his family.

Armed with nothing but willpower and determination, join Lin Dong as he unknowingly discovers a destiny greater than he could ever hope to imagine when he stumbles upon a mysterious stone talisman…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers enjoy the action and adaptation of the source material, while others find the pacing rushed, the characters shallow, and the plot generic. There is a consensus that the first season is weaker, with improvements in later seasons.
pros: Exciting fight scenes and animation quality (especially in later seasons).
Faithful adaptation of the novel with interconnected universe.
Interesting world-building and character development (in later seasons).
cons: Fast pacing and lack of explanation make it difficult to understand without reading the source material.
Shallow characters and generic plot tropes.
Inconsistent translation quality in fansubs.
MC's cultivation rate is ridiculously fast paced and is 100% luck based with no skill.

anime.title: How Heavy Are the Dumbbells You Lift?
anime.synopsis:
During a regular after-school grub crawl, gluttonous high schooler Hibiki Sakura is confronted about her ever-expanding waistline by her best friend, Ayaka Uehara. With her attempts at solitary exercise failing miserably, Hibiki decides to join the newly opened Silverman Gym. At her orientation, Hibiki runs into student council president and school idol Akemi Souryuuin.

However, it soon turns out that Hibiki is in for a lot more than she bargained for. Not only is Silverman Gym full of world-renowned bodybuilders and athletes, but to make matters worse, Akemi turns out to be a total muscle fetishist! Grossed out by the scene unfolding before her eyes, Hibiki begins to leave, only to be stopped by trainer Naruzou Machio. Completely enthralled with her newfound Prince Charming, Hibiki signs up as a gym member. Now, as a result of her spur-of-the-moment decision, Hibiki must adapt to her new lifestyle.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences found 'Dumbbell Nan Kilo Moteru?' to be a surprisingly entertaining and educational anime. While some criticize the redundant comedy and ecchi elements, many appreciate the show's ability to motivate viewers to exercise and provide useful fitness tips in a humorous way. The characters are considered charming and the animation visually appealing.
pros: Motivational and inspiring for viewers to start exercising.
Informative, provides useful knowledge about the human body and working out.
Colorful cast of characters adds flair and humor to the show.
Catchy opening theme song.
Balances informative content with comedy effectively.
cons: Comedy can be redundant and repetitive.
Ecchi elements may overshadow the educational aspects for some viewers.
Fitness advice may be oversimplified or contain bro-science.
Inaccurate form on exercises.
Lacks character development.

anime.title: Kemono Michi: Rise Up
anime.synopsis:
Professional wrestler Genzou Shibata sports the body of a mountain, but beneath his hulking appearance is a man with an extreme affection for animals. Facing off his opponents in the ring as the legendary "Animal Mask," Genzou wins the hearts of crowds everywhere with his iconic tiger persona.

During the bout for the title of World Champion against his greatest rival, the Macadamian Ogre, Genzou is suddenly summoned to a fantasy world by a princess. With her kingdom being threatened by a monster infestation, she pleads the wrestler for assistance—to which he answers by knocking her out with a German suplex! Escaping the castle and finding himself stranded in a mysterious land, Genzou decides to begin his career as a beast hunter to capture and befriend creatures far and wide. Joined by the wolf-girl Shigure, the dragon-girl Hanako, and the vampire Carmilla Vanstein, the professional wrestler pursues all kinds of dangerous requests for the sake of fulfilling his dream as a pet shop owner.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some finding the show hilarious and a unique isekai parody, while others criticize its repetitive humor, shallow characters, and poor adaptation of the manga. The show's initial comedic charm wears off for many viewers as the series progresses. Despite its flaws, some appreciate the show's lightheartedness and wrestling-inspired action.
pros: Unique and humorous premise of a wrestler in an isekai world.
Well-executed physical comedy and running gags.
Enjoyable and entertaining characters with distinct obsessions.
Catchy opening and good background music.
Good fight scene animation.
cons: Repetitive jokes that become tiresome over time.
Lack of character development and depth.
Anime-original content is often considered garbage compared to the manga.
Inconsistent details and plot holes.
Relies heavily on comedy to compensate for weaker story elements.
anime.thematic_vibe: Isekai Parody, Animal Lover, Wrestling Comedy

anime.title: Anon Sentai Ranger 5
anime.synopsis: Anon Pictures' parody of Super Sentai opening sequences.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the video amusing because of its low production quality and parodic nature. It is considered 'so bad it's good,' providing entertainment through its flaws. Overall, the mood is lighthearted and appreciative of the parody, despite the obvious technical shortcomings.
pros: Funny due to its bad quality
Parodies 90s superhero shows well
Entertaining if you switch your brain off
cons: Poor CG quality
Basic music
Disgustingly bad

anime.title: Dropkick on My Devil!! Dash
anime.synopsis:
Jashin-chan is a demon who was summoned by Yurine Hanazono, a gothic looking girl. Unable to return home as the relevant spell was not included in the summoning grimoire, Jashin-chan resorts to violence to liberate herself from her earthly shackles.

However, this is easier said than done, as Yurine is no weakling herself. She in fact possesses formidable physical power and uses it to massacre Jashin-chan in a variety of ways, be it shoving her arm in a blender, spreading her intestines across the room or even cooking her. Though these actions would be fatal to anyone without the ability to regenerate, Jashin-chan isn't exactly undeserving of this treatment. Stuck with each other, Yurine lets Jashin-chan live with her in exchange for work around the apartment, and this cohabitation results in situations where, more often than not, Jashin-chan ends up in pieces.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Jashin-chan Dropkick', especially its dark humor and absurd situations. The second season is considered an improvement over the first, with better humor and character development. While some find the jokes repetitive or the characters underdeveloped, the overall mood is positive, with viewers appreciating the show's unique blend of dark and light-hearted elements.
pros: Improved humor with surreal and abstract jokes.
Well-rounded characters with distinct personalities.
Enjoyable skits and running gags with lasting effects.
Pleasant new characters that bring a different view on scenes.
cons: Some jokes overstay their welcome.
Some supporting characters are underdeveloped.
Relies on violence-centered jokes.

anime.title: Fairy Gone
anime.synopsis:
"Once upon a time, fairies were tools of war."

The story takes place in a world where fairies possess and dwell in animals, giving them mysterious abilities. By removing the organs of a possessed animal and transplanting them into humans, fairies can be summoned as an alter ego and be used as a weapon. Such individuals who used fairies as war tools were called "Fairy Soldiers." Once the war was over and they completed their roles, the soldiers lost their purpose. Some began working for the government, some joined the mafia, and some even became terrorists, as each chose their own way to live.

Nine years have passed since the war. The protagonist Mariya is a new recruit of "Dorothea," an organization which investigates and suppresses fairy-related crimes. Amidst the unstable political situation, criminals with lingering wounds from the war and past conflicts emerge and engage in terrorism as an act of revenge. This is the story of Fairy Soldiers, fighting for their own justice in a chaotic postwar world.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime had an interesting premise and good animation but failed in its execution. Reviewers cited issues with pacing, character development, and a convoluted plot. While some enjoyed aspects of the world-building and music, the consensus is that the show was a disappointing mess due to poor writing and direction.
pros: Interesting premise with potential for a tragic war story.
Good animation quality and character designs (though CGI is criticized).
Great-sounding BGM and OP theme.
Fleshed out world-building, especially the backstory of the war.
cons: Incoherent and messy story presentation with pacing issues.
Oversaturated character cast with weak development of main characters.
Scripted dialogues and uninspiring personalities.
Too many flashbacks and expositions dumps.
Poor integration of CGI, particularly with the fairies.
Lack of clear goal or direction for the plot.
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Post-War Trauma, Fairy Lore

anime.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
anime.synopsis:
After a strange dream of a mysterious ancestor, high school student Yuuko Yoshida wakes to see that she has grown demonic horns and a tail. Dazed and confused, her mother reveals to her a dark family secret: her family is descended from a Dark Clan that was banished to live powerless and destitute by their mortal enemies, the magical girls of the Light Clan. The only way to lift their ancestry's curse is for Yuuko to find a magical girl, murder her, and splatter her blood all over her ancestor's Demon God statue.

Fortunately for "Shadow Mistress Yuuko," a magical girl saves her from being run over by an oncoming truck. Unfortunately, Momo Chiyoda happens to be Yuuko's classmate at Sakuragaoka High and is much stronger than her in both strength and endurance. Taking pity on her wimpy assailant, the magical girl agrees to train Yuuko and help her unlock her dormant powers. Now, Yuuko must rise up and defeat her generous frenemy to save her family from the terrible grip of poverty.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences find 'Machikado Mazoku' to be a cute and enjoyable slice-of-life anime, driven by the charming interactions between its main characters, Yuuko and Momo. While some critique the pacing and originality of the plot, the series is generally praised for its heartwarming vibe and comedic moments. It's considered a pleasant and easy watch, particularly for fans of the genre.
pros: The chemistry between Yuuko (Shamiko) and Momo is a highlight, making the anime funny and cute.
The anime is visually appealing with decent animation, especially considering the studio's previous work.
The series offers a heartwarming and lighthearted viewing experience due to its well-balanced characters and comedic timing.
cons: The direction and pacing can be inconsistent, sometimes too slow and other times too fast.
The story premise is cute but not particularly special, relying on familiar slice-of-life tropes.
Some viewers find the comedy not particularly strong and the characters not very original.

anime.title: Aikatsu Friends!: Kagayaki no Jewel
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: The story takes place two years after Aikatsu Friends! with Aine Yuuki now in high school. One day she has an encounter with the mysterious idol Hibiki Tenshou who wears the shining Jeweling Dress.
anime.consensus_summary: Aikatsu Friends!: Kagayaki no Jewel has likeable characters but a weak story.  The lack of plot and underdevelopment of supporting characters disappointed viewers. While some enjoyed the music and character interactions, the consensus is that the season missed its potential and lacked the excitement of previous Aikatsu entries.
pros: Character personalities are well-developed and surprising.
Original duos grow up in a realistic and relatable way.
Some stages are really beautiful, and the music is enjoyable.
cons: Story isn't executed well; feels like there isn't much going on.
Character development outside of Alicia is lacking.
Dress system felt lackluster.
Songs are re-used a lot.

anime.title: Ling Jian Zun
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: A big dream and a young man determined to change the status quo and work hard to create a new world. The rare and precious treasures, the martial arts, and the lost strong caves, in this era of genius, full of challenges and opportunities. See the adventure of how the Lord lost the mainland and became the supreme Emperor of the storm. The former enemy, now, will never let go! The regret in the dream, now, must make up! When the spirit sword shouts, the heavens and the earth, I am the supreme!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some find the series initially weak but appreciate the later character growth and strategic depth. Others heavily criticize the poor animation, unoriginal plot, and the main character's inconsistent behavior, leading to overall disappointment.
pros: Character growth over a long period
Story gets better in later seasons
Wars have a lot of strategy
Romance is well executed
cons: Animation is very bad
Main character is incompetent
Plot is unoriginal and borrowed
Storyline makes no sense

anime.title: Girls und Panzer das Finale – Part 3
anime.synopsis:
The quarterfinal round of the Winter Continuous Track Cup is in full swing, and each school is going all out. What started as a furious back-and-forth firefight between Ooarai Girls Academy and Chi-Ha-Tan Academy has become a 12-hour jungle slugfest with neither team having the advantage and almost everyone running on fumes. In spite of this, Miho Nishizumi and her teammates continue to fight into the morning, hoping to land a decisive blow before their rivals.

Meanwhile, Kuromorimine Girls Academy—now led by Erika Itsumi—is struggling in its match against Pravda High School. Taking Maho Nishizumi's words of advice to heart, Erika manages to break free of Kuromorimine's rigid, traditional tactics and turn the tide in her favor. At the same time, St. Gloriana Girls College faces off against Anzio High School, while Saunders University High School has a tough fixture with underdog Continuation High School and its mysterious sharpshooter, Jouko. 

With only four semifinal spots up for grabs, the members of each team must give their absolute best performance if they want to survive and successfully make it to the next round!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 3 for its thrilling action, strategic battles, and high production quality. While some viewers find the CG overused and the plot progression slow due to release gaps, the installment is well-received. Most agree it is a worthwhile addition to the Girls & Panzer franchise.
pros: Exciting and intense tank battles with creative strategies.
High production quality with detailed tank animation and sound design.
Character development, especially Erika's growth as a commander.
Engaging story that continues the series' narrative effectively.
cons: Slight overreliance on CG in certain camera shots.
Length of time between parts makes it harder to follow the story.
Farfetched tank maneuvers that stretch reality.

anime.title: Girls und Panzer das Finale – Part 4
anime.synopsis:
The Winter Continuous Track Cup semifinals are underway and Ooarai Girls’ Academy find themselves in deep trouble early in their match against Continuation High School. The Anglerfish Team are knocked out by Continuation's sharpshooter, forcing the rest of the team to use a different game plan. Stepping up in the absence of her star teammates, Azusa Sawa shows her leadership potential by temporarily taking over as Ooarai's commander. However, the match proves that it will take more than a new strategy for Ooarai to survive this time around.

On the other side of the tournament, Kuromorimine Girls' Academy and St. Gloriana Girls' College are locked in a fiery desert battle. Having developed her own unorthodox tactical style, Erika Itsumi rallies Kuromorimine from the brink of defeat into a fierce showdown against their opponent's veteran commander, Darjeeling. But St. Gloriana have bolstered their ranks with a familiar face who recently transferred to their school, hampering Kuromorimine's quest for victory.

The championship round is within striking distance for these four schools, but only two will have what it takes to move on!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the animation, action sequences, and character development. Some viewers found the plot light or confusing at times, but these criticisms are overshadowed by the appreciation for the film's technical achievements and overall entertainment value.  The film is considered a peak in the series, with fans eagerly awaiting the next installment.
pros: Excellent use of 3D camera angles.
Unbelievable tank physics and entertaining fights.
High-quality animation, even with CGI.
Exciting action set pieces with intricate animation and editing.
Strong character identities and interactions.
Spectacular soundtrack that coincides perfectly with the scenes.
cons: Light on story.
Pacing issues.
Too many characters to remember.
Some scenes are confusing and lack orientation.

anime.title: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop
anime.romaji_title: Cider no You ni Kotoba ga Wakiagaru
anime.synopsis:
Yui "Cherry" Sakura expresses himself better through the haiku he writes and posts on the internet, even though no one gives it attention. While preparing for him and his family to relocate in August, he spends the summer working part-time at a welfare facility. Meanwhile, Yuki "Smile" Hoshino is a budding influencer who wants everyone to smile. However, she feels uneasy about the braces on her protruding front teeth and conceals her own smile using a disposable mask.

After an accidental encounter with Cherry, Smile finds herself becoming a part-time worker at the same facility as him. Soon, the two assist a senile man, Fujiyama, in searching for an old vinyl record he owns. Unable to remember its last location, he wishes to listen to it once more before his memories fade for good. Cherry and Smile only have the record's sleeve and the word "yamazakura" as clues, and their hunt in the hazy summer heat begins.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally found "Cider no You ni Kotoba ga Wakiagaru" to be a visually stunning and heartwarming slice-of-life romance with relatable themes. While many praised its unique art style, charming characters, and pleasant soundtrack, a significant portion of viewers felt the narrative lacked depth and was too predictable, with underdeveloped plot points and characters.
pros: Stunning and vibrant visual aesthetic with unique art style and detailed background design.
Heartwarming soundtrack and pleasant music that complements the mood.
Relatable themes of self-expression, self-confidence, and overcoming insecurities.
Charming and endearing main characters with relatable struggles.
cons: Lack of narrative depth and underdeveloped plot, leading to predictable storytelling.
Uneven pacing with some scenes feeling rushed or lingering without substantial progression.
Character arcs and relationships can feel unexplored, with supporting characters being forgettable.
Relies on predictable character tropes and convenience-driven resolutions.

anime.title: Fights Break Sphere Special 2: Song of Desert
anime.romaji_title: Doupo Cangqiong Special 2: Sha Zhi Lan Ge
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: The tale of Ice Emperor and his journey as a mercenary. The story tells a story of twin Queen Medusas and their intervention with the Ice Emperor.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience members generally appreciate the high production quality and engaging story of the special, particularly the character development and action sequences. However, there is a significant divide regarding its non-canon nature, with some viewers concerned about its deviation from the original novel and potential impact on the main storyline, while others appreciate it as a standalone expansion of the Doupo Cangqiong universe.
pros: Improved art and animation quality compared to previous seasons.
Compelling story that expands on existing characters.
Excellent soundtrack that enhances the viewing experience.
cons: Non-canon story that deviates from the original novel.
Potential lack of impact on the main storyline.

anime.title: Super Shiro
anime.synopsis: Spin-off series of Crayon Shin-chan franchise, featuring Shiro.  Commemorates 60th Anniversary of TV Asahi.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views Super Shiro positively, particularly highlighting Masaaki Yuasa's involvement and the show's experimental nature. There is an appreciation for the show's connection to the broader Shin-Chan franchise. It is not a controversial show.
pros: Masaaki Yuasa's best work since Ping Pong
Experimental nature reminiscent of Shin-Chan TV anime and movies

anime.title: A3! Season Spring & Summer
anime.synopsis:
Home to countless street acts and performances, Veludo Way attracts those interested in watching professional actors. After receiving a mysterious letter, Izumi Tachibana arrives at the venue where her father directed a once-popular theater group, Mankai Company, but learns that the building is about to be repurposed due to excessive debt. At the last minute, she convinces the debt collector to give the ensemble one more chance. He is willing to accept but on three conditions: their debut show must be successfully produced by the following month, the four all-male sub-troupes must be reinstated, and the debt must be paid off within a year. To top it off, Izumi herself must become the director.

With no time to lose, Izumi quickly gathers five people for the Spring Troupe: Sakuya Sakuma, an enthusiastic high school student; Masumi Usui, a boy infatuated with Izumi; Tsuzuru Minagi, an aspiring playwright; Itaru Chigasaki, a mature office worker; and Citron, a friendly foreigner. Though they have little or no experience in acting, it's up to Izumi to train and prepare them for a performance that will restore Mankai Company to its former glory.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with appreciation for the characters and their interactions, but disappointment in the animation quality and shallow plot. While fans of the original game find enjoyment in the adaptation, newcomers may find the story and characters somewhat bland. Ultimately, the anime is considered a lighthearted and fun watch, but not particularly memorable or impactful.
pros: Dynamic between troupe members
Faithful to the original game's story
Enjoyable characters with unique quirks
cons: Poor animation quality and stiff movements
Generic or clichéd story elements
Lack of character depth for some members

anime.title: Wan Jie Shen Zhu
anime.synopsis: Ye Chen, an ancient god, who fell from the world of the gods into a heavenly and peaceful world. In this world there are hundreds of countries, surrounded by thousands of states, who are strong and arrogant. Ye Chen has been in this world for hundreds of years and has established great strength, moreover his existence has always been a legend. But the power of the gods' world extends slowly into this world, beginning one of the most cruel and ferocious battles.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Wan Jie Shen Zhu for its unique take on the ancient Chinese fantasy genre, particularly the protagonist's starting point as an ancient god. The storytelling is appreciated, but character development, especially the MC's relationships, is a weak point. The series successfully blends modern elements but not in an head-pounding way, surprising viewers.
pros: Unique premise of a protagonist starting as an ancient god rather than cultivating to godhood.
Good storytelling with plot-driven fight scenes.
Meaningful exploration of important themes.
Surprising integration of modern elements.
cons: Weak character development, particularly superficial relationships of the MC.
Inconsistencies in integrating modern elements.

anime.title: True Cooking Master Boy
anime.synopsis: After passing the Guangzhou Special Chef Trials, Mao decided to travel around China, to learn more about the unique preparation of food. Upon his return, he will learn that the real battle has only just begun. The Underground Cooking Society has already begun to move...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with strong nostalgia for the original series. The reboot is criticized for its generic animation and fast pacing, failing to capture the charm of the original. While some appreciate the focus on Chinese cuisine, others find the plot and villains underwhelming.
pros: Faithful to the source material (manga).
Focus on Chinese cuisine provides distinction.
Character designs are attractive.
cons: Animation quality is generic and lower than the original.
Pacing is too fast.
Story takes itself too seriously; cooking stakes are unbelievable.
Villains are not menacing.

anime.title: Beastars
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Drama, Psychological, School, Shounen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
In a civilized society of anthropomorphic animals, an uneasy tension exists between carnivores and herbivores. At Cherryton Academy, this mutual distrust peaks after a predation incident results in the death of Tem, an alpaca in the school's drama club. Tem's friend Legoshi, a grey wolf in the stage crew, has been an object of fear and suspicion for his whole life. In the immediate aftermath of the tragedy, he continues to lay low and hide his menacing traits, much to the disapproval of Louis, a red deer and the domineering star actor of the drama club.

When Louis sneaks into the auditorium to train Tem's replacement for an upcoming play, he assigns Legoshi to lookout duty. That very night, Legoshi has a fateful encounter with Haru, a white dwarf rabbit scorned by her peers. His growing feelings for Haru, complicated by his predatory instincts, force him to confront his own true nature, the circumstances surrounding the death of his friend, and the undercurrent of violence plaguing the world around him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Beastars are divided. Many appreciate the show's exploration of complex themes, well-developed characters, and unique visual style. However, a significant number of viewers are critical of the illogical plot developments, forced romance, and inconsistent world-building, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Well-developed characters with complex motivations.
Thought-provoking exploration of prejudice and societal issues.
Visually stunning animation, particularly the use of CGI.
Strong and fitting OST enhances the emotional impact.
cons: Inconsistent plot and illogical story developments, especially in the later episodes.
Forced and awkward romantic relationships.
Uneven character development with some characters feeling useless or one-dimensional.
Overreliance on stereotypes and cliches.

anime.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
anime.synopsis:
Fourteen-year-old Iruma Suzuki has been unfortunate all his life, having to work to earn money for his irresponsible parents despite being underage. One day, he finds out that his parents sold him to the demon Sullivan. However, Iruma's worries about what will become of him are soon relieved, for Sullivan merely wants a grandchild, pampering him and making him attend the demon school Babyls. 

At first, Iruma tries to keep a low profile in fear of his peers discovering that he is human. Unfortunately, this ends up being more difficult than he expected. It turns out that Sullivan himself is the chairman of the school, and everyone expects him to become the next Demon King!

Iruma immediately finds himself in an outrageous situation when he has to chant a forbidden spell in front of the entire school. With this, Iruma instantly earns a reputation he does not want. Even so, he is bound to be roped into more bizarre circumstances.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Mairimashita! Iruma-kun" for its humor, lovable characters, and lightheartedness, making it a feel-good anime. Some find the plot repetitive or the jokes predictable over time. Still, many view it as a welcome escape and praise its vibrant art style and engaging character dynamics.
pros: The series has very likeable characters that make every little thing in the story interesting and memorable.
A truly funny and cute anime with very lovable characters and a good chemistry with each other.
Colourful and happy art style. Refreshing change to have something so fun and exciting along with great music, great animation and a really happy atmosphere.
cons: The plot can become repetitive.
The show sometimes takes itself too seriously.
Some jokes got quite diluted and predictable after a while

anime.title: Astra Lost in Space
anime.genres: Adventure, Award Winning, Mystery, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Space, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2063, space travel is feasible and commercially available. As the cheerful Aries Spring arrives at the spaceport to attend a camp on the distant planet McPa, her purse is suddenly snatched by a reckless thief. Luckily, the athletic Kanata Hoshijima is able to retrieve it for her, and Aries soon discovers that he is among the group of teenagers who will be traveling with her on the excursion as team B-5.

Upon arriving at their campsite, the group's trip takes a turn for the worse when a strange sphere of black light sucks them into the vast reaches of outer space. Stranded with seemingly no hope, they find an abandoned ship nearby that provides them with the means to return home. However, they soon discover that they are not as close to their campsite as they initially thought, but are in fact thousands of light-years away from home.

With this realization, the nine members must cautiously manage their resources, maintain their strength, and unite as one to conquer the darkness of space together. While the reason behind their trip's sudden obstruction remains unknown, they nevertheless embark on the treacherous voyage back home aboard their new ship, the Astra.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Kanata no Astra' are mixed. Some viewers praise the show for its engaging plot twists, character development, and satisfying conclusion, while others criticize it for inconsistent writing, a lack of genuine danger, and reliance on generic shounen tropes. Ultimately, the show is considered an enjoyable but flawed sci-fi adventure.
pros: Well-paced plot with satisfying conclusion.
Interesting twists and turns that keep the viewer engaged.
Strong focus on character development and teamwork.
Good balance of humor, mystery, and heart.
cons: Inconsistent writing quality.
Lack of genuine danger or consequences for characters.
Mediocre science fiction with plot flaws and unfinished ideas.
Generic shounen characters and predictable elements.

anime.title: To the Abandoned Sacred Beasts
anime.synopsis:
With the initiation of the Patrian civil war came the creation of half-beast, half-human soldiers—a development of the outnumbered Northerners in a desperate attempt to counter the overwhelming Southern forces. Able to quickly dominate battlefields and achieve victory with ease, the soldiers' godlike abilities earned them the name "Incarnates." However, as the war raged on, the Incarnates encountered a problem involving the beasts inside them that they were unable to rectify by ordinary means. 

Once the war was over, mysteries and accounts of the Incarnates submitting to the misfortune of their war days surfaced. Aware of the horrors they faced during the war, Special Sergeant Major and former captain of the Incarnates Hank Henriette becomes a Beast Hunter—those who take the lives of Incarnates who have succumbed to the issues they experienced on the battlefields. 

After witnessing her father, a former Incarnate soldier, meet his end at the hands of one such Beast Hunter, Nancy Schaal Bancroft resolves to hunt the man who took her father's life. However, Nancy's eye-opening encounter with the Beast Hunter influences her to instead seek the reason behind her father's death and the Incarnates' problematic existence in society.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. The initial concept and setting are praised, but the repetitive plot structure, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent writing lead to disappointment. Schaal's character is a major point of contention for many viewers. Some find enjoyment in the action and themes, but overall the anime fails to live up to its potential.
pros: Interesting premise involving super soldiers dealing with the aftermath of war.
Unique setting inspired by 19th-century America with steampunk elements.
Good action scenes and character designs.
cons: Repetitive 'monster of the week' format becomes boring.
Underdeveloped characters, especially the antagonist and supporting cast.
Inconsistent writing quality, with a decline in the later episodes.
Schaal is an annoying character.

anime.title: Bem
anime.synopsis:
Young detective Sonia Summers has been transferred to the outskirts of the port city Libra after stirring up trouble with her superiors. Libra is separated into two sectors—"the Upper," the center of wealth and politics, and "the Outside." The Outside is home to crime, corruption, and curious incidents involving monstrosities or youkai. Each case that Sonia works on seems to implicate the involvement of these mysterious creatures.

Sonia crosses paths with three peculiar humanoid youkai—Bem, Bela and Belo—who seek to protect humans and fight against the evil youkai that terrorize them. Living as "Youkai-Ningen," they are excluded by other youkai for their human-like lifestyles, and rejected and hurt by humans when they reveal their true forms.

Despite the hardships they face, these three Youkai-Ningen secretly live among humans, continuing to pursue their dreams of one day becoming human as well.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many viewers appreciate the character concepts and music, but the rushed plot, underdeveloped world-building, and shallow social commentary detract from the overall experience.  The ending is particularly criticized for being unsatisfying and failing to resolve key issues.
pros: The opening and ending themes are well-received and contribute to a noir atmosphere.
The main characters are likeable and their desire to be human is relatable.
cons: The story is rushed, underdeveloped, and lacks sufficient world-building.
The plot is inconsistent, with unresolved plot points and a weak final battle.
Many side characters are one-dimensional and lack meaningful development.

anime.title: Ni no Kuni
anime.synopsis:
Best friends Yuu, Haru, and Kotona enjoy a tranquil high school life together. One day, however, a suspicious man pursues and stabs Kotona—a catastrophe that Yuu and Haru fail to prevent. While hastily carrying the girl to the hospital, the two boys are nearly hit by a truck but miraculously remain unharmed. Instead, they find themselves in a fairy-tale-like kingdom with an exotic diversity of people and wonderful creatures.

To their surprise, the boys discover that Yuu, who has been confined to a wheelchair since childhood, can now walk! Yet they have no time to ponder the puzzling situation, as their friend is gone. Setting off to find Kotona, Yuu and Haru stop at a local pub to inquire about her. But upon inspecting a picture of Asha, the kingdom's princess, the two have a shocking revelation.

Narrating an extraordinary adventure in a magical world, Ni no Kuni demonstrates the special connection between two separate yet parallel worlds and its manifestation of the bonds between individuals.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative due to a predictable and poorly written story that fails to live up to its initial potential. While the visuals and music have some redeeming qualities, the underdeveloped characters, weak world-building, and illogical plot decisions lead to significant disappointment. The movie is considered a mediocre addition to the Isekai genre, failing to capture the magic and depth of the Ni no Kuni games.
pros: Visually appealing art style reminiscent of Studio Ghibli, with detailed backgrounds.
Music composed by Joe Hisaishi is a highlight, fitting the atmosphere well.
Some enjoyed the initial premise of parallel lives and its potential for a deeper story.
cons: Generic and predictable storyline with overused tropes and cliches.
Poorly developed characters with illogical motivations and inconsistent behavior.
Weak world-building and lack of exploration of the fantasy setting.
Inconsistent animation quality, with jarring CGI and stiff character movements.
Many plot holes and lack of internal logic within the story.

anime.title: Sword Art Online: Alicization - Recollection
anime.synopsis: Recap of the first 18 episodes of Sword Art Online: Alicization.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience largely views this episode as a completely unnecessary and boring recap that disrupts the flow of the main narrative. While acknowledging the high production values (animation, sound) present in the reused footage, the lack of new content or creative effort leads to widespread disappointment and frustration. The episode is seen as a filler, primarily existing to give the production team more time, which is considered a disservice to the viewers.
pros: Art and sound quality remain good (though reused)
Story in itself is pretty good and more original than the last season
The chronological drive for this episode makes sense from a storytelling perspective
cons: Completely unnecessary recap episode
Painful and boring to watch
Does not add anything new or special
Breaks the rhythm of the work and disrespects weekly viewers
Recycled content thrown in to fill space with no creative effort
Dispensable and can be skipped without missing anything

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Highschool Arc
anime.synopsis: Upon the conclusion of the Vanguard High School Koshien, Kouji Ibuki begins to have new nightmares. Nome Tatsunagi has Suiko summon him to the mansion where they learn he can see a Dark Tower called Sanctuary. Sanctuary is causing the timeline to be altered throughout history, and the only way to correct it is for Kouji to first correct his future mistake. Now Kouji and Suiko must travel the parallel world -if- and watch as Magical Girls Emi Sendou and Shuka summon Vanguard units to help correct history. Sadly the two can't help much as Cardfighting against real monsters doesn't do much good.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with 'Zoku Koukousei-hen,' finding the story weak and the pacing problematic. While some appreciate seeing familiar characters, the lack of compelling cardfights and the feeling that it's a mere attempt to promote the card game leave many underwhelmed. The series is considered entertaining but ultimately unnecessary, failing to deliver a satisfying conclusion for long-time fans.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the first series.
Unique animation style remains watchable.
Kourin's character gets justice in this version.
cons: Lackluster story and weird pacing.
Missing full cardfights, which are a key element.
Plot is wobbly and doesn't contribute anything remarkable
Feels like a cash grab to sell card game.

anime.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid S
anime.romaji_title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S
anime.synopsis:
As Tooru continues on her quest to become the greatest maid and Kanna Kamui fully immerses in her life as an elementary school student, there is not a dull day in the Kobayashi household with mischief being a daily staple. On one such day, however, a massive landslide is spotted on the hill where Kobayashi and Tooru first met—a clear display of a dragon's might. When none of the dragons they know claim responsibility, the perpetrator herself descends from the skies: Ilulu, the radical Chaos Dragon with monstrous power rivaling that of Tooru.

Sickened by Tooru's involvement with humans, Ilulu resorts to the typical dragon method of resolving conflict—a battle to the death. Despite such behavior, she becomes intrigued by Kobayashi's ability to befriend dragons and decides instead to observe just what makes Kobayashi so special. With a new troublesome dragon in town, Kobayashi's eccentric life with a dragon maid is only getting merrier.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S' is well-received, especially for its animation quality and heartwarming story. While some missed the original director's touch and found aspects of the humor or new character design questionable, the majority found it a worthy and emotionally resonant sequel. The show excels in its blend of slice-of-life elements with character growth, making it a standout in the genre.
pros: Beautiful animation by Kyoto Animation
Strong character development, especially for a slice-of-life anime
Engaging mix of comedy, heartwarming moments, and emotional depth
Excellent opening and ending themes that fit the show's tone
Continuity from the first season is well-maintained
Balances fan service with genuine character and plot development
cons: Absence of original director Yasuhiro Takemoto is felt by some viewers
