Some find the humor or fan service to be overdone or strange
Ilulu's character design and introduction were criticized by some
Plot can feel rushed at times
Some find it deviates from the first season's formula

anime.title: Sumikko Gurashi Movie 1: Tobidasu Ehon to Himitsu no Ko
anime.romaji_title: Sumikko Gurashi Movie 1: Tobidasu Ehon to Himitsu no Ko
anime.synopsis:
Sumikko Gurashi debuted in 2012 as slightly negative characters who like to stay in the corner of a room. The characters include "Shirokuma," a polar bear who is sensitive to cold; "Penguin?" (with a question mark in its name), a penguin who is unsure if it is actually a penguin; "Tonkatsu," a piece of pork cutlet that was left uneaten; "Neko," a shy cat; and "Tokage," who hides his nature as one of the last dinosaurs.

The franchise has inspired toys, books, stationery material, video games--and now a feature film.
anime.consensus_summary: The Sumikko Gurashi movie is a heartwarming and cute film that is generally well-received, especially by those familiar with the characters. Its simple story and adorable aesthetic make it suitable for children, while adults with an appreciation for the characters can also find enjoyment. The film's strong points lie in its charming visuals and pleasant music, though its simplicity might not appeal to all viewers.
pros: Cute characters and designs
Enjoyable story for all ages
Great music and sound design
cons: Simplistic story may not appeal to everyone
Requires pre-existing knowledge/appreciation of the characters

anime.title: Big Fish & Chinese Flowering Crabapple
anime.synopsis: In 2004, Liang Xuan produced a flash short film which was the prototype of the animated film Da Yu Hai Tang, which won the DIGIID Award of Intel 2004 China Digital Festival.
anime.consensus_summary: The 2004 short film 'Da Yu Hai Tang' is seen as a visually appealing but ultimately shallow prototype for the later full-length movie. Reviewers found the short lacking in story and character development, with some noting distorted visuals. However, its brevity makes it a worthwhile watch for those interested in the concept's origins.
pros: Pretty visuals
Nice music
cons: Little to no story
No personality to the characters
Characters looked distorted

anime.title: Dragon Quest: Your Story
anime.synopsis: Following in his father's footsteps, Luca must find the hero who wields the zenithian sword to save his mother from Ladja. Based on Dragon Quest V: Hand of the Heavenly Bride game's story.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is highly divided, primarily due to the controversial ending and rushed adaptation of the beloved Dragon Quest V game. While some appreciate the nostalgic elements, visuals, and music, many are disappointed by the pacing, lack of emotional depth, and the divisive plot twist. The movie struggles to satisfy both fans of the game and newcomers, resulting in a polarized reception.
pros: Visually appealing animation and effects.
Classic Dragon Quest music enhances nostalgia.
Faithful adaptation of the game for those familiar with the source material.
cons: Poor pacing and rushed storytelling, skipping important plot points and character development.
Unnecessary and poorly executed plot twist ending.
Characters lack depth and emotional investment due to the condensed narrative.

anime.title: Beyblade Burst Rise
anime.synopsis: Legendary Blader Valt Aoi has been training the next generation of elite Bladers at Spain’s BC Sol. One day, rookie Blader Koryu Drum witnesses Valt unleashing his newly evolved Gachi Bey, Slash Valkyrie. To Drum's surprise, Valkyrie radiates a golden light as it rockets around the stadium. Inspired by the limitless possibilities of this “Gold Turbo” state, Drum seeks to achieve the same bond with his Bey, Dragon. Here begins the story of Dante and Dragon’s rise to the peak of the Blading world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the characters, animation and emotional moments, many find the short episode format, weak villains, and over-promotion of the toy product detract from the overall experience. There's a sense that the series could have been better with more focus on story and character development, and less focus on product promotion.
pros: Strong cast with good bonds between characters.
Protagonist's growth feels realistic and emotional.
Good animation, especially in certain episodes.
cons: Short episode format leads to pacing and story issues.
Villains appear out of nowhere with weak motivations.
Repetitive episodes focusing on a single villain's emotions.
Lack of character development due to short duration.
Overemphasis on promoting the toy aspect of Beyblade.

anime.title: Princess Connect! Re:Dive
anime.synopsis:
In the continent of Astraea, a man falls from the sky, possessing no memories other than his name, Yuuki. An elf named Kokkoro finds him, introducing herself as his guide in the world they are about to traverse. With Kokkoro's guidance, Yuuki is able to learn how this world works, from battling monsters to handling currency.

To earn money for their journey, Yuuki and Kokkoro decide to go to a nearby guild association to accept a simple quest. In their expedition, they meet Pecorine, a somewhat gluttonous but charming girl skilled in battle. The next day, they also meet Karyl, a cat girl specializing in magic.

After some time, a bond of friendship and camaraderie forms between them, and the four decide to create a guild of their own. As they continue their adventures, they explore the world, meet new people, and will perhaps uncover the mysteries behind Yuuki's missing memories.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is positive, praising the show's lighthearted nature, charming characters, and high production values. However, some criticize the weak male protagonist, lack of plot depth, and reliance on simple humor. While most find it enjoyable as a relaxing comedy, a minority considers it poorly written and uninspired.
pros: Charming and lovable characters with colorful personalities.
High-quality animation and art style, with vibrant colors and detailed backgrounds.
Enjoyable and relaxing comedy with running gags and emotive reactions.
Well-executed direction by Takaomi Kanasaki, similar to Konosuba.
Catchy and heartwarming opening song.
Unique world-building and attention to detail.
cons: Weak and uninteresting male protagonist (Yuuki).
Lack of a serious or complex plot, with an ambiguous main purpose.
Over-reliance on simple-minded or clichéd character traits.
Humor may not appeal to all audiences, with some finding it cringe-worthy.
Inconsistent art styles and animation in certain scenes.
Story hard to follow for non-game players

anime.title: If It's for My Daughter, I'd Even Defeat a Demon Lord
anime.romaji_title: Uchi no Ko no Tame naraba, Ore wa Moshikashitara Maou mo Taoseru kamo Shirenai.
anime.synopsis:
Eighteen-year-old Dale Reki is a skilled, kind, and respected traveler, acknowledged as one of the leading adventurers in the city of Kreuz. One day while on the hunt for magical beasts, he comes across a sweet devil girl named Latina. She is alone, dressed in rags, and bears the devils' symbol of a criminal: a broken horn. Concerned for her wellbeing, Dale decides to ensure Latina's safety by bringing her to his home, eventually leading to him adopting her.

Latina is sweet, innocent and compassionate, charming Dale beyond his expectations. He begins to enjoy the life of parenthood— experiencing the trials that come with raising a child and coping with the heartache he feels whenever his busy lifestyle as an adventurer parts him from her.

Although work and life as a new parent become reassuring constants for Dale, the mysteries surrounding the girl remain. Why was Latina alone in the forest, and why does she harbor the symbol of a criminal? At the same time, Latina also begins to learn about the world and herself as she adjusts to her new life with Dale.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is centered around the heartwarming relationship between an adventurer and his adopted demon daughter. While many find the series cute, wholesome, and relaxing, others criticize it for being bland, repetitive, and lacking substantial plot or character depth. The focus on cuteness is a point of contention, with some viewers finding it endearing and others finding it excessive.
pros: Wholesome and heartwarming relationship between Dale and Latina.
Charming and cute character designs, especially Latina.
Relaxing and easy to watch, with a focus on character development.
Good world-building that gradually reveals itself.
cons: Story can be bland and generic, lacking significant plot developments.
Characters can be one-dimensional and forgettable beyond the main duo.
Overemphasis on Latina's cuteness becomes repetitive and annoying.
Worldbuilding is shallow.

anime.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to Fall in Love with a Pervert, as long as she's a Cutie?
anime.romaji_title: Kawaikereba Hentai demo Suki ni Natte Kuremasu ka?
anime.synopsis:
As far as it goes, many boys, especially in their teenage years, want to have a girlfriend. Keiki Kiryuu is no exception. One eventful afternoon, his days of yearning for a lover seem to come to an end when he receives a love letter from an anonymous sender—along with a pair of white panties. 

To determine the identity of his secret admirer, referred to as Cinderella, he proceeds to investigate several possible candidates including his senior Sayuki Tokihara, his underclassman Yuika Koga, and his classmate Mao Nanjou. However, as Keiki seeks to uncover who this mystery girl might be, he comes to know about the perverted fetishes hidden behind each candidate's innocent exteriors...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the show's self-aware humor and unique character quirks, while others find it to be a trashy, tasteless experience. Many feel the show relies too heavily on shock value and lacks meaningful plot or character development.  The protagonist's unusual competence is a plus, but overall the show struggles to rise above its base ecchi harem premise.
pros: Unique female characters with distinct fetishes.
Protagonist is more competent and less generic than typical harem leads, offering witty retorts.
Mystery plot, while predictable, adds an engaging element.
Enjoyable for those who like self-aware harem anime that don't take themselves too seriously.
cons: Relies heavily on shock value and perverted antics, with humor that can be crude and cringe-worthy.
Story is often rushed and lacks substance beyond the central perversion gimmick.
Female characters, aside from their kinks, lack deep personality development.
Animation quality can be inconsistent, sometimes resembling low-budget hentai.
anime.thematic_vibe: Ecchi Comedy, Harem Antics, Perverted Romance

anime.title: Seikai no Senki II Special
anime.synopsis: A recap of Seikai no Senki II included on the "Sekai DVD Box" set.
anime.consensus_summary: The Seikai no Senki II Special is largely seen as a recap with a fast pace and jarring cuts, making it difficult for newcomers to understand the lore. While it includes fan-favorite characters and action, it's primarily recommended for dedicated fans who want a quick refresher before the next installment. Most viewers find the recap format detracts from the overall viewing experience.
pros: Includes fan-favorite characters like Lafiel, Ekurya, Spoor and Lala Shangal
Features shooting and explosions
cons: Fast pace and lack of flow
Weird cuts
Insufficient exposition for newcomers
Not recommended for those who haven't watched the original series
Recap format diminishes enjoyment

anime.title: Beyond Creation
anime.synopsis: Short animation produced and planned by the Live2D Creative Studio design team, starring Natsumi Fujiwara as the drawing boy Louie, and Haruka Tomatsu as the mysterious girl Epsilon.
anime.consensus_summary: The short animation is praised for its art, sound, and thought-provoking themes. However, some viewers note that the story and characters are underdeveloped due to the short format. Overall, the audience is highly appreciative of the animation's ability to blend the real and virtual worlds.
pros: Beautiful art style
Excellent sound design
Thought-provoking concept
cons: Lacking story and character development

anime.title: RADIANT Season 2
anime.synopsis:
After fleeing from Rumble Town, Seth, Doc and Melie are back at the Artemis Institute. Thanks to Alma, Seth learns more about Piodon, his mysterious brother. But the quest for the Nemeses mythical nest Radiant has already waited too long, so the Horned Boy and his friends head to the island-continent of the Wizard Knights.

This location may be a new city for audiences, but it's a decaying world that's falling apart! Not only must Seth deal with these hardships, but he must also face a personal phenomenon where visions are invading his mind a little more each day.
anime.consensus_summary: Radiant Season 2 is generally viewed as an improvement over the first season, with many viewers appreciating the deeper character development and more engaging storylines. While some criticize the pacing and reliance on Shonen tropes, the overall sentiment is positive. The series is considered underrated with potential, but execution sometimes falls short.
pros: Improved character development compared to Season 1
Engaging story arcs, particularly the Caislean Merlin arc
Good animation and sound design
Addresses mature themes like racism and social issues
cons: Uneven pacing, slow character introductions
Over-reliance on Shonen stereotypes
Excessive dialogue over action in some instances
Protagonist can be frustratingly dumb

anime.title: Hey, Your Cat Ears Are Showing! 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Wei, Kanjian Erduo La!.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Wei, Kanjian Erduo La! 2' to be a cute and enjoyable anime, particularly appreciating the characters and relationships. However, it's also recognized that the plot is simple, the characters are somewhat stereotypical, and the episodes are too short to develop much depth. It's considered a lighthearted watch that doesn't require a second viewing.
pros: Cute characters and relationships
Introduction of new couples (boys love and girls love) adds dynamic
cons: Simple plot with little depth
Stereotypical characters
Episodes are too short

anime.title: Midnight Occult Civil Servants: The Blind Alley, the Boy, and I
anime.romaji_title: Mayonaka no Occult Koumuin: Fukurokouji to Ano Ko to Ore to
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Mythology, Shoujo, Supernatural, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Episode 13 was bundled with the limited edition 12th volume of the manga.

Trapped by fox spirits, Reiji and Theo uncover a cursed pot and must purify it to escape.
anime.consensus_summary: The episode is generally viewed as a relaxing side story that offers a glimpse into the characters' personal lives. It is appreciated by fans of the main series but may not appeal to those seeking a more engaging or plot-relevant narrative. The overall reception is positive, with viewers enjoying the calm atmosphere and character interactions.
pros: Art and Sound quality consistent with the main series.
Provides a glimpse into the characters' lives outside of work.
cons: Story lacks excitement and tension.
Does not seem to contribute to the main story's lore or plot.
May not appeal to viewers seeking action or in-depth lore.

anime.title: Asteroid in Love
anime.synopsis:
In a fateful childhood encounter, Mira Kinohata met a stargazing dreamer named Ao Manaka. Though their time together was short, Ao showed Mira the wonders of astronomy, from orbiting planets to distant stars. Before they parted, Mira learned that a star with her name exists, but there are none with Ao's. And so, she forged a promise: one day, she would discover a new asteroid and name it after Ao.

Years later, Mira is still fascinated with astronomy. Now in high school at Hoshizaki Academy, she tries to join the Astronomy Club. Unfortunately, she finds out that the club has been merged with the Geology Club to form a single Earth Sciences Club. She joins this new club and finds a pleasant surprise—she reunites with Ao after years of separation.

Alongside their new clubmates, Mira and Ao begin their journey together to fulfill their promise. How hard could it possibly be to find an asteroid?
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience generally enjoys Koisuru Asteroid for its cute characters, educational content, and wholesome atmosphere. However, some find the plot slow and uninspired, with the characters lacking depth. The series is appreciated more by those interested in astronomy and geology or fans of the CGDCT genre, but less so by those seeking more dynamic stories or complex characters.
pros: Accurate and engaging portrayal of astronomy and geology concepts.
Cute and wholesome character interactions with yuri undertones.
Visually appealing art style and animation by Doga Kobo.
cons: Slow pacing and a plot that lacks significant progression.
Characters are seen as generic and lacking depth by some viewers.
Comedy falls flat and doesn't stand out compared to other CGDCT anime.

anime.title: Granbelm
anime.synopsis:
Long ago, magic was abundant and enriched the lives of all people until its usage in war. To end the chaos, seven of the most powerful mages gave up their lives in order to seal all magic. Now, almost one thousand years later, their magic seal Magiaconatus hosts Granbelm, a monthly series of battles meant to determine who among its participants is worthy of the title of Princeps, the one true mage.

On the night of a full moon, high school student Mangetsu Kohinata is suddenly transported to an illusionary world where six mages are participating in Granbelm. Mistaken for an enemy mage, Mangetsu is attacked by two mages until she is rescued by Shingetsu Ernesta Fukami and her Armanox Viola Katze. However, when Shingetsu is ambushed for protecting her, Magiaconatus grants Mangetsu the Armanox White Lily, allowing her to fight off Shingetsu's assailant. Overwhelmed by the revelations presented to her, Mangetsu decides to help her new friend fight in Granbelm and make her wish come true.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding Granbelm to be a surprisingly deep and emotionally resonant series that effectively blends magical girl and mecha elements. Others are turned off by the slow start, generic designs, and confusing plot elements. The series' strong character development and exploration of complex themes are often cited as its strengths, while inconsistent animation and pacing are common criticisms.
pros: Well-developed characters with compelling backstories.
Unique fusion of magical girl and mecha genres.
Strong emotional core and exploration of complex themes like purpose and sacrifice.
Excellent sound design and impactful music.
Surprising plot twists and turns with effective foreshadowing.
Traditional 2D animation of mecha battles.
cons: Slow pacing and confusing initial episodes.
Uneven animation quality, particularly in early episodes.
Generic character designs.
Reliance on common tropes, making it feel unoriginal at times.
Inconsistent world-building.

anime.title: Jian Wang 3: Xia Gan Yi Dan Shen Jianxin
anime.romaji_title: Jian Wang 3: Xia Gan Yi Dan Shen Jianxin
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Shen Jianxin is a security guard for Rye Scent Village, an average youth determined to become a legendary hero. While paying his respects at the prestigious Pure Yang Palace of Jianghu, he learned the palace’s ancestral secret manuals by accident. However, he was unaware of the power he gained. Thus, he entered Jianghu and gradually matured while experiencing the turmoil of Jianghu during the prosperous Tang Dynasty. An obscure security guard with unparalleled martial arts in Jianghu: who knows what storms are ahead?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the comedic take on the Wuxia genre, appreciating the social commentary and animation quality. Some find the character design and diluted plot points as drawbacks. Overall, it is considered a good watch, especially for those familiar with Wuxia tropes.
pros: Great comedy within the Wuxia genre.
Good animation similar to King's Avatar.
Exposes the funny and ugly side of social psychology and Chinese ethics.
cons: Custom Maid 3D-tier characters are spoiling the fun somewhat.
Peerless technique is not really ever explained.
Tactic of swaying public opinion dilutes in later episodes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Wuxia Comedy, Social Commentary, Martial Arts

anime.title: Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 1 - Fushou Akiyama Yukari no Sensha Kouza
anime.romaji_title: Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 1 - Fushou Akiyama Yukari no Sensha Kouza
anime.synopsis: Akiyama Yukari's Tank Course special "Sensha no Tanjou-hen" (The Birth of Tanks) included on the DVD/BD releases of the Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 1.
anime.consensus_summary: The Akiyama Yukari no Sensha Kouza is a worthwhile addition to the Girls und Panzer series for fans interested in the historical background of the tanks featured. While not exceptional as a standalone animation and containing some questionable humor and minor inaccuracies, it provides valuable context and demonstrates the research behind the anime. The audience generally finds it an informative and enjoyable side piece.
pros: Provides historical context for tanks in the Girls und Panzer series
Shows the depth of research put into the anime's skirmishes
Interesting for history and tank enthusiasts
cons: Not spectacular as a standalone animation
Contains bad jokes
Presents slight misinformation/bias

anime.title: Are You Lost?
anime.synopsis:
After a school trip goes terribly wrong, Homare Onishima, Shion Kujou, Asuka Suzumori, and Mutsu Amatani are left stranded on a deserted island. While Shion, Asuka, and Mutsu are frightened and desperate, Homare seems strangely calm. Fortunately for the group, this isn't the first time she's been stranded! Homare spent her childhood training with her survivalist father all over the world, climbing cliffs, trapping prey, building shelters, and obtaining valuable nutrition from moose testicles. To Homare, surviving on an uninhabited island with a slim chance of rescue is child's play. The only problem is the other three.

As Homare shamelessly guides her classmates through the finer points of survival, including drinking fish blood and eating cicadas, the girls start to realize that being stranded might not be as bad as they had imagined.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response to 'Sounan desu ka?' is mixed. Many appreciate its educational aspect and lighthearted take on survival, finding it entertaining and funny. However, some criticize the generic characters, excessive fan service, and questionable survival advice. While some viewers enjoyed the show and found it informative, others considered it unoriginal and shallow.
pros: Educational content presented entertainingly.
Likeable characters with some development.
Good balance of comedy and plot.
Short episode length helps with pacing.
cons: Generic characters and plot.
Excessive fan service can be distracting.
Inconsistent or lackluster art and animation.
Questionable survival advice.
Lack of depth or conclusive ending.

anime.title: Gleipnir
anime.genres: Action, Ecchi, Mystery, Seinen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Shuuichi Kagaya is what one would consider an average high school student, but sometimes, he turns into a monster. He doesn't know how or why he got his abilities, only that he would prefer no one knows about them. One night, he finds a building ablaze with a girl trapped inside. Deciding to save her, he transforms and carries her to safety, but accidentally drops his phone.

The next day, the girl he saved—Claire Aoki—finds him and confronts him about his monster identity. She even goes so far as to push him off the school roof to prove her theory after Shuuichi denies her allegations. Desperate to save himself, he transforms, and Claire snaps a picture in order to blackmail him into telling her everything he knows about monsters, which, ironically, isn't much.

As it turns out, Claire has a secret of her own: she has been searching for her sister, who also became a monster. She enlists Shuuichi's help to track her down, but they aren't the only ones searching for answers.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Gleipnir are divided. Some viewers appreciate the initial premise, action, and character designs, finding it a unique and enjoyable experience. However, many are critical of the confusing plot developments, rushed ending, and excessive fan service, leading to disappointment and a sense of unfulfilled potential. The show's failure to fully develop its interesting concepts contributes to a polarized reception.
pros: Interesting premise that hooks viewers early on
Well-choreographed action sequences and fluid animation, especially in early episodes
Good character designs and high-quality soundtracks enhance the experience
cons: Story becomes nonsensical and boring after the first few episodes
Pacing issues, with rushed endings and unresolved plot points
Overreliance on fan service and edginess feels forced and detracts from the story

anime.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm
anime.romaji_title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen
anime.synopsis:
Urano Motosu loves books and has an endless desire to read literature, no matter the subject. She almost fulfills her dream job of becoming a librarian before her life is ended in an accident. As she draws her last breath, she wishes to be able to read more books in her next life.

As if fate was listening to her prayer, she wakes up reincarnated as Myne—a frail five-year-old girl living in a medieval era. What immediately comes to her mind is her passion. She tries to find something to read, only to become frustrated by the lack of books at her disposal.  

Without the printing press, books have to be written and copied by hand, making them very expensive; as such, only a few nobles can afford them—but this won't stop Myne. She will prove that her will to read is unbreakable, and if there are no books around, she will make them herself!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some viewers praise the show's unique approach to the isekai genre, focusing on slice-of-life elements, world-building, and the protagonist's passion for books. However, others criticize its slow pacing, inconsistencies in character behavior, and subpar animation, leading to a polarized reception with strong opinions on both sides.
pros: Unique take on the Isekai genre, focusing on slice-of-life elements and character development.
Charming simplicity and focus on the protagonist's passion for books.
Good world-building.
cons: Slow pacing that may not appeal to all viewers.
Inconsistencies in character behavior, especially the MC's mental age.
Some viewers find the plot to be slow, nonsensical, and lacking in conflict.
Inconsistent animation and art quality.

anime.title: Tsugu Tsugumomo
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Mythology, School, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
When "ordinary boy" Kagami Kazuya meets the beautiful tsukumogami Kiriha, his life gets turned upside-down. As a "Taboo Child" who draws the supernatural towards him, he receives orders from the God of the Land, Kukuri, to become an exorcist and defeat these evil forces. And so, he and Kiriha do battle.

To find out information on these supernatural beings, Kazuya and his friends set up a counselor's club at school. But behind the typical-seeming troubles he hears about, he uncovers a major plot to target Kukuri...

In addition to the sadistic-yet-beautiful tsukumogami Kiriha, the situation draws other girls to Kazuya to join the fray!
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Tsugu Tsugumomo is generally well-received, with many viewers appreciating the improved storyline and action. While the ecchi elements and animation quality are points of contention, the series is considered a fun and engaging watch for fans of the genre. Many are hoping for a third season, indicating a positive overall sentiment.
pros: Improved story and world-building compared to the first season.
Well-developed characters with interesting motivations.
Enhanced action sequences with fluid animation.
Catchy OP/ED songs and a solid soundtrack.
Good balance of humor and seriousness.
cons: Animation quality is inconsistent and sometimes feels outdated.
Ecchi elements can be overbearing for some viewers.
Secondary characters could be more developed.
Some plot points feel rushed or unresolved.
Story can be common

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Chibi Theater - Survey Corps, Levi Squad!
anime.synopsis: Shingeki no Kyojin Season 3 DVD/BD specials. They are chibi parody shorts; one video was included on each of the DVD/BDs for a total of seven. Each video contained three stories (essentially chibi parody short episode 38–59) which continued the chibi parody story from the previous chibi parody specials included on the DVD/BDs of the previous seasons.
anime.consensus_summary: The Shingeki no Kyojin Season 3 Specials are chibi parody shorts that offer simple humor, but ultimately don't contribute much to the main series.  Viewers may find them enjoyable if they appreciate chibi animations or lighthearted parodies, but others may find the humor repetitive and the skits uninteresting. It's mostly aimed at completionists or die-hard fans.
pros: Good voice acting and sound quality.
Slightly better humor compared to previous chibi specials.
cons: Humor is straightforward and one-dimensional.
Does not add anything to the main series.
Humor is hit or miss.
Animation is alright, but nothing special.

anime.title: Gintama: The Very Final
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Two years have passed following the Tendoshuu's invasion of the O-Edo Central Terminal. Since then, the Yorozuya have gone their separate ways. Foreseeing Utsuro's return, Gintoki Sakata begins surveying Earth's ley lines for traces of the other man's Altana. After an encounter with the remnants of the Tendoshuu—who continue to press on in search of immortality—Gintoki returns to Edo.

Later, the regrouped Shinsengumi and Yorozuya begin an attack on the occupied Central Terminal. With the Altana harvested by the wreckage of the Tendoshuu's ship in danger of detonating, the Yorozuya and their allies fight their enemies while the safety of Edo—and the rest of the world—hangs in the balance. Fulfilling the wishes of their teacher, Shouyou Yoshida's former students unite and relive their pasts one final time in an attempt to save their futures.
anime.consensus_summary: Gintama: The Final is a largely well-received conclusion to the beloved series, praised for its blend of humor, heart, and action. While some found the animation inconsistent or the pacing slightly off, the majority of viewers felt it was a fitting farewell, offering both nostalgic callbacks and emotional closure for longtime fans. The movie successfully captures the essence of Gintama, leaving a lasting impression.
pros: Excellent blend of drama and comedy
Satisfying conclusion to the series
High-quality animation and soundtrack
Faithful to the manga with bonus scenes
cons: Pacing issues at times
Some jokes may not land with all viewers
Inconsistent animation quality
Felt like an overextended parody sketch

anime.title: Lupin the Third: Fujiko Mine's Lie
anime.romaji_title: Lupin the IIIrd: Mine Fujiko no Uso
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Drama, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Fujiko Mine is on the run with Gene, a boy who knows the location of a stash of $500 million dollars that his deceased father embezzled from the company Godfrey Mining. The boy is targeted by Bincam, an assassin hired by Godfrey Mining with a mysterious ability that allows him to bend a person’s will.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the film for its stylish animation and focus on Fujiko's character. However, some find the plot convoluted and the pacing slow compared to other Lupin entries. The film is a worthy addition to the Koike series, though not without its flaws.
pros: Gorgeous animation and art style.
Fujiko's character remains consistent and compelling.
An interesting take on the classic Lupin formula, flipping the damsel in distress trope.
cons: Overly-convoluted plot.
Lacks the simplicity and meticulous animation of previous films.
Slow burn compared to other entries in the series.

anime.title: Spriggan (ONA)
anime.synopsis: Deep in the Ararat Mountains of Turkey, a secret organization known as ARCAM has found what is believed to be Noah's Ark. However, the U.S. Machine Corps., a rogue organization of the Pentagon, wants to take over the Ark as a means of global supremacy. Only a special ARCAM operative known as a Spriggan stands in their way. Japanese Spriggan Yu Ominae teams up with French Spriggan Jean-Jacques Mondo to combat members of the U.S. Machine Corps. led by Col. MacDougall—a genetically-enhanced boy with deadly psionic powers. However, they must act fast and stop MacDougall before he uses the Ark for his own agenda.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Spriggan is moderately divided. Many appreciate its high-octane action, intriguing sci-fi premise, and fast-paced episodic format, finding it an entertaining popcorn flick. However, a significant portion criticizes its inconsistent animation, weak character development, and outdated storytelling, viewing it as a missed opportunity despite its cool concept.
pros: Visually impressive and dynamic action sequences, especially fight choreography.
Engaging world-building with a unique premise involving ancient technologies and global power struggles.
Enjoyable and fast-paced episodic structure that doesn't require heavy commitment.
Decent voice acting, particularly for the main protagonist.
cons: Inconsistent and jarring animation quality, particularly the blend of 2D and 3D CGI.
Weak character development for most supporting cast members, leading to a forgettable roster.
Episodic nature leads to a lack of overarching narrative cohesion and underdeveloped plot points.
Dated storytelling tropes and 'old-school' writing that doesn't always resonate with modern audiences.

anime.title: Psycho-Pass 3
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Detective, Gore, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Thanks to the Sibyl System, the mental states of society can now be measured on a numerical scale. Using these "crime coefficients," a culprit can be apprehended before they ever commit a crime. But is it a perfect system? For Inspectors Kei Mikhail Ignatov and Arata Shindou, that remains to be seen, as their career with the Public Safety Bureau's Crime Investigation Department has only just begun. 

Shindou and Ignatov are assigned to investigate the crash of a ship carrying immigrants, but they begin to suspect that it was no mere accident. Meanwhile, a mysterious group called Bifrost is observing them from the shadows, but they are not the only ones who have taken an interest in the two new Inspectors.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the new characters, intricate plot, and high-quality animation. However, some find the story confusing and inconsistent with previous seasons, leading to frustration with the unresolved ending. Many viewers express hope for a future season to address the lingering questions.
pros: New characters are interesting and unique, adding fresh perspectives to the world.
The plot is intricate with well-executed twists and turns, creating a compelling mystery.
Animation and fight choreography are excellent, with fluid movements and impactful action scenes.
cons: The plot can be convoluted and difficult to follow at times, with abstract storytelling.
Some world-building inconsistencies and contradictions undermine the established lore.
The ending feels incomplete, with many unresolved plot threads and a lack of meaningful conclusion.

anime.title: The Girl From the Other Side: Siúil, a Rún
anime.synopsis:
Let not an Outsider touch thee,
Lest thou shalt be cursed forever.

Once upon a time, in a land far away that was divided into two realms...
The Outside was roamed by teratomorphic creatures who had the power to curse whoever they touched. Humans could live safely only in the Inside. But when a lost little girl from the Inside named Shiva, and a demonic beast-looking Outsider simply known as "Teacher" initiate a quiet coexistence on the same side of the forest, their bond seems to transcend their incompatible natures. It is the beginning of a folktale about two outcasts -one human, one inhuman- who linger in the hazy twilight that separates night from day.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the OVA's artistic style, emotional depth, and the unique relationship between the characters. However, some find the short length and lack of explicit explanation to be drawbacks, while others praise it for its artistic merit. The adaptation seems successful, especially for those familiar with the source material.
pros: Outstanding visual and audio direction conveys emotion without words.
Beautiful art style and wonderful music create a wholesome yet tense atmosphere.
The relationship between Shiva and Sensei feels realistic and impactful.
cons: The OVA is too short and leaves the audience wanting more.
Prior knowledge of the manga may be needed to fully understand the story.
Some viewers may find the lack of explicit story and dialogue confusing.

anime.title: Phantasy Star Online 2: Episode Oracle
anime.synopsis:
A TV anime adaptation of episode 1-3 out of 5 the total episodes from the Phantasy Star Online 2 game. Some anime-original content will be created as well.

Episode 1: During their qualification exam in planet Naberius, the player and fellow ARKS trainee Afin were attacked by vile organisms known as Darkers. This is followed by the two discovering a mysterious girl who lost most of her memories, and the truth regarding Naberius and the recent spike of Darker activities. 

Episode 2: The plot follows the player and Matoi as they try to unravel a dark conspiracy regarding the origin and purpose of ARKS.

Episode 3: The discovery of the planet Harukotan brought a new quest into the fray, as the peace between the Shironian and Kuronites that dwell in the planet is disturbed by the Kuronites' sudden attack. The newly-reformed ARKS is tasked to investigate the reason behind it all, and it seems like the truth is more complicated and horrifying than expected...
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Phantasy Star Online 2: Episode Oracle is appreciated more by existing fans of the game due to its adaptation of the source material. While it features well-developed characters and engaging story arcs, the inconsistent animation, slow pacing, and sometimes simplistic writing are points of criticism. Most reviews lean towards a slightly positive or neutral sentiment, with strong feelings mostly among fans of the original game.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the game's story (Episodes 1-3)
Well-developed characters with significant depth
Interesting story arcs and plot twists in the latter half
Good soundtrack and SFX
Exploration of moral themes such as 'not sacrificing others for the greater good'
cons: Inconsistent animation quality with noticeable CGI and animation errors
Slow pacing in the first half, requiring patience to reach plot payoffs
Simplistic resolution of plot points and questionable writing choices
Bland or typical 'evil for evil's sake' villains, with few exceptions
Potential confusion for viewers unfamiliar with the Phantasy Star Online 2 game lore

anime.title: Vampire in the Garden
anime.synopsis:
During a winter long ago, near-immortal vampires began plaguing the world. As their population grew at an astounding rate, they promptly threw humanity off its place at the top of the food chain. Desperate to avoid extinction, the surviving humans concentrated in their last safe haven—a small city surrounded by an enormous wall. There, they have waged war against the vampires for many years. 

In the midst of a particularly brutal attack by the vampires, a human soldier named Momo encounters Fiine, the queen of their enemies. After seeing her try to save Momo's best friend from a rampaging vampire, Momo follows Fiine back to her house. It is there Momo connects with Fiine over their love for music and desire to escape the fighting. 

Pursuing that goal of escape, the two decide to journey toward a supposed paradise where humans and vampires coexist—despite being uncertain of its existence. However, Momo and Fiine are being targeted by both races, who they must first evade if they hope to reach their destination in one piece.
anime.consensus_summary: Vampire in the Garden is a visually and aurally beautiful production with a compelling central relationship, but it is significantly hampered by rushed pacing and underdeveloped writing. While many praise its artistic merits and emotional impact, a substantial portion of the audience finds its narrative lacking and its potential largely unmet due to its short runtime.
pros: Stunning visuals and art direction, particularly the character designs and environments, evoking a sense of melancholy beauty.
Excellent voice acting, especially from the lead VAs, which elevates the emotional impact of the story.
Beautiful and evocative soundtrack that significantly enhances the atmosphere and emotional resonance.
The core relationship between the two protagonists is compelling and drives the emotional core of the narrative, despite pacing issues.
cons: Pacing issues, with the story feeling rushed and crammed due to the short runtime, leading to underdeveloped plot points and character motivations.
Weak writing and plot, which is often predictable, cliché, and fails to explore its interesting concepts to their full potential.
Inconsistent or jarring CGI animation, particularly in action sequences or specific detailed scenes.
Underdeveloped characters and world-building, with many interesting ideas and backstories hinted at but never fully explored.

anime.title: CHOYOYU!: High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even in Another World!
anime.romaji_title: Choujin Koukousei-tachi wa Isekai demo Yoyuu de Ikinuku you desu!
anime.synopsis:
Seven Japanese high school students enjoy international renown for their remarkable talents. One day, these friends survive a plane crash only to find themselves in the medieval fantasy world of Freyjagard, where two human races live side by side in a feudal society: the byuma, who have animal features and formidable strength, and the hyuma, who have a small chance of magical aptitude. After being rescued by the byuma Winona and her adopted elven daughter Lyrule, the group pledges to use their advanced skills and knowledge to pay back the people of Elm Village for their hospitality and find a way to return back home.

Tsukasa Mikogami, the prime minister of Japan, acts as the leader of these young geniuses and organizes their efforts to intervene in Freyjagard and gather the information and resources necessary for achieving their goals. Believing that there is a connection between their current situation and an ancient legend about seven heroes from another world who defeated an evil dragon, Tsukasa directs the others to learn about the culture around them and search for any clues leading them back to Earth. But he also gives another instruction: to take it nice and easy, lest they ruin this world by giving it their all.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in the show's lighthearted and fast-paced adventure, while others criticize its reliance on generic isekai tropes and shallow character development. The show's premise of overpowered high school prodigies revolutionizing a fantasy world is seen as both a strength and a weakness. Ultimately, the lack of depth and originality leaves many viewers feeling underwhelmed, while others appreciate it as a fun, albeit flawed, experience.
pros: Unique premise of high school prodigies in another world.
Enjoyable blend of magic and modern technology.
Fast pacing and satisfying character arcs within a short span.
cons: Generic isekai tropes and predictable plot developments.
Overpowered characters with little to no flaws or compelling backstories.
Poorly written antagonists and shallow world-building.
Inconsistent art quality and forgettable music.

anime.title: Try Knights
anime.synopsis: Riku Haruma enters high school without a future in sight. He sees people playing like monsters on the ground, jumping higher than anyone else, running fast, deciding to try their best. There, he sees Akira Kariya playing rugby, a sport he was once passionate about but gave up due to his physique. While Akira is running roughly, Riku gives him a piece of advice without thinking. From that, Riku feels his dying passion for the sport set ablaze, and his future starts to brighten up...
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Reviewers heavily criticize the poor animation quality, weak story, and inaccurate portrayal of rugby. While a few found some entertainment in character interactions or over-the-top elements, these positives are overshadowed by the significant flaws, leading to overall disappointment.
pros: Some found enjoyment in character interactions despite rugby inaccuracies.
One review appreciated the rival school's over-the-top theatrics and character design.
The series can be enjoyed as a relaxed and predictable sports anime if expectations are managed.
cons: Poor animation quality, with comparisons to outdated CGI and slideshow presentations.
Weak plot and story, with a lack of depth and meaningful character development.
Inaccurate representation of rugby, failing to showcase the sport effectively or explain its rules.
Sterile voice acting and uninspired soundtrack further detract from the experience.
Failed attempts at fanservice.

anime.title: Drifting Dragons
anime.synopsis:
It has been half a century since humans took to the sky to hunt dragons. Although dragons present a great danger, every part of them is extremely valuable, and brave dragon hunters, called "drakers," risk their lives aboard special dragon-hunting airships to pursue them.

However, despite the thrill and excitement of hunting, the life of a draker is not easy. Ostracized by society, the drakers have no place to call home. Life in the air is not any easier either: maintaining an airship is dull and expensive—and dragons are even harder to catch, as each one is unique. 

One of the last remaining such airships is the Quin Zaza. Its courageous crew includes Takita, an eager newcomer trying to earn her place on the ship; Mika, a reckless but highly skilled hunter; and Jirou, an earnest young man chasing both the dragons and his past. United by the same goal, these hunters face arduous aerial battles that involve daring feats of skill, strategy, and more than their fair share of danger.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many viewers finding the show's premise intriguing but ultimately let down by its execution. Common complaints include repetitive action, shallow characters, and distracting CGI. While some appreciate the world-building and character interactions, the series struggles to deliver a compelling narrative or meaningful exploration of its themes, leading to a somewhat divisive response.
pros: Interesting and well-developed world-building.
Engaging character interactions within the crew.
Spectacular scenery and dragon designs.
cons: Repetitive dragon hunting sequences.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of backstory.
Mediocre CGI animation, especially facial expressions.
Lackluster plot and missed potential for deeper themes.

anime.title: given
anime.synopsis:
Tightly clutching his Gibson guitar, Mafuyu Satou steps out of his dark apartment to begin another day of his high school life. While taking a nap in a quiet spot on the gymnasium staircase, he has a chance encounter with fellow student Ritsuka Uenoyama, who berates him for letting his guitar's strings rust and break. Noticing Uenoyama's knowledge of the instrument, Satou pleads for him to fix it and to teach him how to play. Uenoyama eventually agrees and invites him to sit in on a jam session with his two band mates: bassist Haruki Nakayama and drummer Akihiko Kaji.
    
Satou's voice is strikingly beautiful, filling Uenoyama with the determination to make Satou the lead singer of the band. Though reticent at first, Satou takes the offer after an emotional meeting with an old friend. With the support of his new friends, Satou must not only learn how to play guitar, but also come to terms with the mysterious circumstances that led him to be its owner.
anime.consensus_summary: Given is generally well-received for its emotional depth, realistic characters, and beautiful music. While some criticize the pacing and occasional tonal inconsistencies, the overall consensus is that it's a mature and touching BL anime. Many appreciate its sensitive portrayal of LGBTQ+ themes and the characters' personal struggles.
pros: Realistic and relatable characters with depth and development.
Beautiful and emotional soundtrack, particularly Mafuyu's performance.
Delicate and mature handling of sensitive topics.
cons: Some found the pacing slow or certain scenes unnecessary.
Some found the drama forced or interrupted by comedic tone shifts.
The musical development felt rushed to some viewers.

anime.title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun
anime.synopsis:
The famous Seven Mysteries that every school seems to have are a staple of Japanese urban legends. One of the most well-known of these tales is that of Hanako-san: the ghost of a young girl who haunts the school's bathrooms.

Kamome Academy has its own version of Hanako-san's legend. Rumors claim that if one successfully manages to summon Hanako-san, she will grant her summoner any wish. Lured by the gossip, many people have tried to call upon her, yet every attempt has failed. However, when Nene Yashiro, a girl hoping for romantic fortune, dares to summon Hanako-san, she discovers that the rumored "girl" is actually a boy!

After a series of unfortunate events involving Yashiro's romantic desires, she is unwillingly entangled in the world of the supernatural, becoming Hanako-kun's assistant. Soon, she finds out about Hanako-kun's lesser-known duty: maintaining the fragile balance between mortals and apparitions.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Viewers praise the unique art style and character dynamics but critique inconsistent animation and a sometimes slow or uninspired plot. While some appreciate the blend of humor and dark themes, others find the tonal shifts jarring, leading to a somewhat polarized opinion on the series' overall quality and adaptation.
pros: Unique and stylish art style that is visually appealing.
Charismatic characters with enjoyable interactions and evolving relationships.
Balance between lighthearted humor and darker, more serious themes.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with stiffness and lack of movement at times.
Story can be slow or boring, with a formulaic structure.
Adaptation cuts content from the manga, reducing character development and nuance.

anime.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
anime.romaji_title: Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Ecchi, Fantasy, Isekai, Reincarnation
anime.synopsis:
Despite being bullied, scorned, and oppressed all of his life, a 34-year-old shut-in still found the resolve to attempt something heroic—only for it to end in a tragic accident. But in a twist of fate, he awakens in another world as Rudeus Greyrat, starting life again as a baby born to two loving parents.

Preserving his memories and knowledge from his previous life, Rudeus quickly adapts to his new environment. With the mind of a grown adult, he starts to display magical talent that exceeds all expectations, honing his skill with the help of a mage named Roxy Migurdia. Rudeus learns swordplay from his father, Paul, and meets Sylphiette, a girl his age who quickly becomes his closest friend.

As Rudeus' second chance at life begins, he tries to make the most of his new opportunity while conquering his traumatic past. And perhaps, one day, he may find the one thing he could not find in his old world—love.
anime.consensus_summary: Mushoku Tensei is a visually impressive isekai anime praised for its world-building and character development. However, it is also highly controversial due to its problematic content, particularly the protagonist's perverted behavior. The audience is divided, with some appreciating the series' unique elements and others condemning its objectionable themes.
pros: Excellent world-building and immersive fantasy setting.
High-quality animation, art, and direction.
Character development and growth throughout the story.
cons: Controversial content including depictions of pedophilia and sexual harassment.
Inconsistent story writing.
Pacing issues in the anime adaptation compared to the source material.

anime.title: No Guns Life
anime.synopsis:
The technology to create powerful cyborg soldiers has been released for public use by the Berühren Corporation. Those outfitted with robotic parts are known as the Extended. Juuzou Inui, one such Extended, was created as a soldier and has no memories of his former life. But now, after the war, he runs a business that takes care of Extended-related incidents around the city. 

Rumors of a renegade Extended that kidnapped a child reach his ears; lo and behold, as Juuzo returns to his office,  a giant robotic man with a boy on his back crashes in, asking for help. While Juuzou could just turn the guy in and be done with it, something about this situation is too fishy to ignore. It seems that everyone wants hold of this kid and, whether he likes it or not, Juuzou must find out why this Extended is on the run, how it connects to the Berühren Corporation, and just how far the treachery runs in this city.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to No Guns Life is mixed. While many appreciate its unique cyberpunk aesthetic, noir style, and action sequences, several critics find the story and character development lacking. The world-building has drawn both praise and critique with some finding it intriguing while others deem it uninspired.  Ultimately, whether or not the show is enjoyable seems to depend on individual preferences for style over substance.
pros: Unique aesthetic and noir-inspired visuals are refreshing.
The world-building is modestly good and intriguing.
Action scenes are fast-paced and enjoyable.
The opening theme is considered a banger.
cons: Story and character development are lacking, making it hard to recommend.
Plot threads are often unresolved and go all over the place.
Villains are generic and cartoonishly evil.
Some find the series boring and not living up to its expectations.

anime.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!
anime.romaji_title: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru. Kan
anime.synopsis:
Resolved to become a more independent person, Yukino Yukinoshita decides to smoothen things out with her parents, and the first step toward achieving that goal is to prove herself.

As graduation draws closer for the third-year students, Iroha Isshiki—the president of the student council—requests a graduation prom in collaboration with the Volunteer Service Club. Yukino accepts this request of her own volition, hoping to use it as a chance to demonstrate her self-reliance, but what lies ahead of her may prove to be a hard hurdle to cross.

Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru. Kan revolves around the graduation prom as emotions are poured into the preparations for the event. At the same time, a chance for the Volunteer Service Club members to better understand each other presents itself. And thus, Hachiman Hikigaya's hectic and bittersweet high school life begins to draw to a close.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the character development and emotional resonance, while others criticize the weak plot, lack of humor, and pretentious dialogue. The final season is seen as a disappointment by some, failing to live up to the standards set by earlier seasons.
pros: Emotional moments are well-supported by production quality.
Exploration of character depth, especially for side characters like Iroha.
cons: Plot is weak and revolves around an uninteresting premise (prom planning).
Characters are boring or make illogical decisions.
Humor is lacking compared to previous seasons.
Narrative feels dragged out and pretentious.

anime.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 2nd Season
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Reincarnation, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Taking a break from his time as a teacher, the powerful slime Rimuru Tempest returns to his kingdom, eponymously named Tempest, just in time to begin negotiations with a nearby nation—the Kingdom of Eurazania. While the negotiations are anything but peaceful, they do end successfully, allowing Rimuru to return and finish teaching. When trying to again return to Tempest, this time permanently, Rimuru is stopped by a mysterious figure who is somehow able to constrain the many magical abilities he has at his disposal. 

In Tempest, the situation is even worse. A group of unknown humans has invaded the land and are assaulting its citizens, both influential and innocent. They are not just trying to bring harm either—they have the intent to kill. Can Rimuru overcome his powerful and dangerous foe and return to Tempest before it is too late?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some viewers praising the series' world-building, character development, and engaging story, while others criticize its pacing, inconsistent writing, and generic characters. The season's shift towards darker themes also appears to be divisive. Ultimately, enjoyment seems tied to individual preferences for isekai tropes and narrative styles.
pros: Expands worldbuilding and introduces new characters and races.
Rimuru's development as a character, showcasing diplomatic skills and clever negotiations.
Intense and engaging story with a mix of happy moments and dark turns.
cons: Pacing issues with time-wasting recaps and filler-like episodes.
Inconsistent writing and middling story arcs.
Generic characters with little backstory or emotional attachment.

anime.title: Baki: The Great Raitai Tournament Saga
anime.synopsis:
Weakened by the poison from his last battle, Baki Hanma finds himself on the verge of death with no salvation in sight. However, after Baki's friend, Retsu Kaiou, brings him to China, he learns about the centurial Raitai Tournament, where the fiercest warriors fight to be crowned as the strongest martial artist in all of China. 

As it is now allowing entry to foreigners, Baki is informed that he will have to compete in the tournament as it holds the cure to his illness. Unfortunately, Baki's father, deemed the "Strongest Creature on Earth," is participating too. Baki 2nd Season details the events of the grand Chinese tournament, as well as Baki's encounter with the eccentric yet powerful Mohammad Alai Jr.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for improved animation and fight scenes, but criticism for weak storytelling, inconsistent animation, and anticlimactic fights. Some viewers find the series enjoyable for its over-the-top action, while others are disappointed by the lack of depth and character development. The inclusion of Mohammad Ali Jr. is a point of contention.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to previous seasons (less CGI).
Exciting and intense fight scenes with a focus on martial arts.
Enjoyable for fans of mindless fighting and ridiculous feats of strength.
Sound design is great, enhancing the impact of fights.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and occasional janky movements.
Weak or poorly written story with inconsistencies and plot holes.
Fights can be anticlimactic or too short.
Unnecessary commentary or narration that detracts from the action.
Character development is lacking for some characters.
Overreliance on explanations rather than showing the fights.

anime.title: My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 2: Heroes:Rising
anime.synopsis:
Izuku "Deku'' Midoriya and his fellow students in Class 1-A of UA High's hero course have been chosen to participate in a safety program on Nabu Island. To further improve their skills and gain experience in more ordinary heroics, the students aid the kind citizens with small services and everyday chores. With the low crime rate in the quiet community, all seems well and good, but the rise of a new villain threatens to put the students' courage to the test and challenge their capabilities as heroes.

A merciless villain by the name of Nine is in search of a certain "quirk" needed to fulfill his diabolical plan—creating a society where only those with the strongest quirks reign supreme. As his attack on Nabu Island endangers the lives of the residents, securing the citizens becomes the first priority for Class 1-A; defeating Nine along with his wicked accomplices is also imperative. A straightforward strategy is formulated until a young boy named Katsuma Shimano, whom Deku had befriended, suddenly requires particular protection. Concerned for the boy's wellbeing, Deku and his classmates must now devise a plan to ensure Katsuma's safety at all costs.

With Nine wreaking havoc to find the catalyst for his ill-intended schemes and the heroes desperate to defend Katsuma from harm, will Deku and his friends be able to come out victorious, or will they find themselves unable to escape a hopeless situation?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is notably polarized, with many praising the exceptional animation, action, and the development of Class 1-A, especially the Deku-Bakugo dynamic. However, a significant portion of viewers found the plot predictable, the villain uninspired, and the ending's resolution nonsensical and detrimental to the established canon, leading to a strong division between those who enjoyed the spectacle and those critical of the narrative shortcomings.
pros: Visually stunning animation, especially during fight sequences.
Effective inclusion and utilization of the entire Class 1-A, giving many characters moments to shine.
Strong character development and emotional resonance, particularly between Deku and Bakugo.
The camaraderie and teamwork displayed by Class 1-A are highlights.
Exciting and action-packed sequences, particularly the final battle.
cons: The plot is highly predictable and formulaic, adhering to common shonen tropes.
The main villain is unoriginal, often described as a generic All-for-One clone with weak motivations.
The movie's climax and resolutions are often seen as illogical, contrived, and consequence-free, undermining the established power system and character arcs.
The film's events have no lasting impact on the main series' canon, making it feel like glorified, albeit well-animated, filler.
Concerns about animation budget being diverted from the main anime series, potentially affecting its quality.

anime.title: Special 7: Special Crime Investigation Unit
anime.romaji_title: Keishichou Tokumubu Tokushu Kyouakuhan Taisakushitsu Dainanaka: Tokunana
anime.genres: Action, Detective, Fantasy, Mystery, Urban Fantasy, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
In Tokyo, there exists a peaceful cohabitation between supernatural creatures—elves, dwarves, vampires, and more—and humans. However, contrary to history, powerful dragons once ruled over this world of creatures and humans but have since disappeared. Consequently, a diabolical group under the alias "Nine," who seek the miracles of the once godlike dragons, stirs up trouble in the streets of Tokyo, commiting mass murder and causing destruction. To combat the dangerous group of Nine, the police organize the Special 7—a group of highly skilled professionals whose abilities exceed those of ordinary humans. 

Caught up in a bank robbery turned hostage crisis, Seiji Nanatsuki, having recently become a detective, has a chance encounter with Shiori Ichinose, a member of Special 7. Assisting with the resolution of the robbery, Seiji is recognized for his clear sense of justice and refreshing character, suddenly earning him a spot on the elite unit. 

As he takes on new missions, Seiji finds that being a detective as part of Special 7 isn't the police work he expected, where working alongside a team of different species with special abilities and vibrant personalities brings unpredictability to his daily life and police work. While the everyday crime in Tokyo continues, Seiji and the Special 7 will fight not only to resolve special cases, but also obstruct the ill-intentioned plans of the merciless group of Nine.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided, with some praising the unique premise and voice acting, while others criticize the generic characters, predictable plot, and overall lack of originality. Many find the show mediocre and uninspired, with missed potential in its world-building and execution. Ultimately, the series is considered forgettable and falls short compared to other similar anime.
pros: Unique storyline and plot
Good voice acting, particularly Tsuda Kenjirou
Enjoyable opening and ending themes
cons: Generic and forgettable characters
Predictable and uninspired story
Lacking world-building and originality
Mediocre animation and art style

anime.title: Her Blue Sky
anime.romaji_title: Sora no Aosa wo Shiru Hito yo
anime.genres: Drama, Music, Romance, Supernatural, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
High school student Aoi Aioi lives with her elder sister, Akane, after a tragic accident took their parents away 13 years ago. Because Akane has since been taking care of her single-handedly, Aoi wants to move to Tokyo after her graduation to relieve her sister's burden and pursue a musical career, inspired by Akane's ex-boyfriend Shinnosuke "Shinno" Kanamuro. Shinno was part of a band until he left for Tokyo to become a professional guitarist after the sisters' parents passed away, and he was never to be seen again.

One afternoon, while Aoi practices her bass in a guest house, she gets startled by the 18-year-old version of Shinno from 13 years ago! As if by coincidence, the current 31-year-old Shinno also returns to the town, but he has changed drastically. There are now two Shinno's in existence, but why is the Shinno from the past present?

Sora no Aosa wo Shiru Hito yo revolves around these four individuals as they confront their inner feelings toward each other and make decisions that will affect their lives from here on out.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is significantly divided on the film's narrative execution, with many praising its character depth, dialogue, and visual artistry. However, a substantial portion of viewers found the plot rushed, the supernatural elements unnecessary, and the ending abrupt, leading to a polarizing reception despite the acknowledged strengths in animation and thematic resonance.
pros: Beautiful and detailed animation, especially character movements and expressions.
Strong, naturalistic, and humorous dialogue, particularly in character interactions.
Well-developed characters who act and feel realistic for their age.
Resonant themes of regret, lost dreams, and sibling love.
Atmospheric and soaring soundtrack that enhances the melancholic mood.
cons: Story pacing issues, with a rushed or underdeveloped plot, especially in the third act.
Inconsistent tone and atmosphere, shifting between slice-of-life, supernatural mystery, and romance.
The supernatural/time travel element feels unnecessary or poorly integrated for some.
Abrupt or unsatisfying ending, with plot threads left unresolved or relegated to post-credit scenes.
Lack of focus on music despite being a central theme, with the music itself being considered bland by some.

anime.title: Hi Score Girl II
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Polygon, Romance, School, Seinen, Video Game
anime.synopsis: The year is 1996, and second-year high school students Haruo Yaguchi, Akira Oono, and Koharu Hidaka live their lives as passionately about video games as they were five years ago. Brought together by arcade games, what began as a healthy rivalry and friendship has turned into something more. As they endeavour towards understanding their unfamiliar feelings, they work with allies, navigate high school, and find that, although life has its many challenges, there's always a game or two they can rely on.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates High Score Girl II as a well-executed conclusion to the series, praising its character development, nostalgic setting, and emotional depth. While some viewers are critical of the CGI animation and rushed ending, the overall sentiment is positive, with many finding it to be a surprisingly enjoyable and memorable romance anime. The show effectively blends video game culture with a coming-of-age love story, resonating with those who experienced the arcade era.
pros: Strong character development, especially for Haruo.
Excellent use of nostalgia through accurate depictions of 90s arcade culture.
Emotional and engaging story with a satisfying conclusion.
Effective blending of romance, drama, and comedy.
Well-integrated video game elements that enhance the narrative.
cons: CGI animation style may not appeal to all viewers.
Ending felt rushed and could have benefited from more resolution, especially for Koharu's character arc.
Some found Oono's silent character to be underdeveloped or unrealistic.
The romance plot contains some clichés.

anime.title: Somali and the Forest Spirit
anime.synopsis:
In a world inhabited by demons, cyclopes, and other fantastic creatures, humans stand apart as the outcasts. Quick to anger, the human race engaged in a war that all but wiped them out. The few humans that remain are seen as a delicacy, serving no purpose but to be hunted down and eaten.

One day, a golem—a wandering protector of nature—encounters a lone human child while patrolling. Inspired by her enthusiasm, he takes the girl, named Somali, under his wing. Together, the duo embarks on a journey to find Somali's parents and bring her home.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views 'Somali to Mori no Kamisama' positively, praising its beautiful art, heartwarming story, and well-developed characters. Some find the plot predictable and the pacing slow, but the emotional core and the father-daughter relationship resonate strongly. The series is considered a wholesome and touching experience, with minor criticisms not detracting significantly from overall enjoyment.
pros: Beautiful art style and backgrounds
Heartwarming and emotional story
Well-developed characters and relationships
Exploration of themes like racism and prejudice
cons: Slow pacing
Straightforward and predictable plot
Some characters introduced but then dropped
Animation occasionally disappoints with static frames

anime.title: Goblin Slayer: Goblin's Crown
anime.synopsis:
Due to his recent accomplishments, Goblin Slayer has become well known among adventurers. His name has now spread so far that one day, he receives a letter pleading for him to rescue a noble daughter who has gone missing during a mission involving goblins. Wasting no time, Goblin Slayer accepts the quest alongside his party members: Priestess, Elf, Dwarf Shaman, and Lizardman.

Although the quest seems to be proceeding as it should, the party soon discovers a highly intelligent goblin paladin organizing the savage horde. Even with the enemy being far more formidable than initially expected, Goblin Slayer will offer no quarter to his hated foe, using any underhanded tactics and esoteric tools necessary to put the monster down.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Goblin Slayer: Goblin's Crown. While fans of the source material and the core 'goblin-slaying' premise generally enjoy it, many criticize the lengthy recap, questionable CGI, and underdeveloped new characters. The film's quality is often debated, with some viewing it as a decent but flawed installment and others as a disappointing cash grab.
pros: Visually impressive animation and art, especially during action sequences.
Sound design and music effectively enhance the atmosphere and action.
Strong adherence to the source material for fans of the light novels/manga.
Maintains the core appeal of the series: methodical goblin slaying and world-building.
cons: Excessive and often poorly implemented CGI.
The first 25-30 minutes are a recap of the first season, seen as wasted time by many.
Pacing issues and shallow character development for new characters.
Plot points and strategies are sometimes illogical or poorly explained.

anime.title: Woodpecker Detective's Office
anime.synopsis: A ghost was seen on the 12th floor of the Asakusa Juunikai building. A newspaper article featuring the sighting brought together Takuboku Ishikawa, who runs a private detective agency to support his family, and his assistant Kyosuke Kindaichi to solve the case.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the show excels in its art style, historical setting, and character-driven moments, many find the central mystery plot weak and the pacing slow. Some viewers connect with the emotional and poetic elements, while others find the story bland and unengaging. The series seems to appeal more to those seeking character relationships and atmosphere over intricate mysteries.
pros: Beautiful artwork and animation
Well-handled Meiji period setting
Interesting characters inspired by famous poets
Soothing OST that suits the mood
cons: Uninteresting or cliche mystery plots
Slow pacing and meandering story
Underdeveloped side characters
Forced or fractured relationships

anime.title: number24
anime.synopsis:
Natsuza Yuzuki has been playing rugby as a left-winger ever since he was a child. After enrolling in Doushisha University, he quickly becomes a rising star in the Kansai University League.

His dreams are shattered, however, when a nasty motorbike accident leaves him with a spinal hernia—making him unable to be able to play rugby ever again. With no role available other than the position of manager, he accepts his new post and hopes his squad can obtain a league title.

Yuzuki's team is an unlikely group, including his stoic best friend and full-back Seiichirou Jingyouji; hot-headed first-year Yasunari Tsuru, who harbors a strong dislike for Natsuza, filling his senior's old position as left wing; and Yuu Mashiro, who is struggling to hold his ground as a scrum half.

Despite Natsuza putting his all into training his team for a league title, their squad still feels incomplete. A year ago, Ibuki Ueka, the genius fly-half that was once Doushisha's ace, suddenly quit rugby—and now Natsuza is determined to get him back.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, praising the character interactions and focus on friendship. Some find the plot weak and the rugby aspect underdeveloped. The likeable characters and light-hearted tone compensate for the shortcomings, resulting in a fairly enjoyable experience for those who appreciate character-driven stories over intense sports action.
pros: Strong character-driven stories focusing on bonds and friendship.
Likeable and well-developed main characters with distinct personalities.
Enjoyable humor and light-hearted moments.
Decent animation quality, especially considering studio's outsource reliance.
cons: Weak plot and pacing issues, with some episodes feeling disjointed.
Too many characters for a one-cour anime, diluting focus on main characters.
Rugby matches are too short and lack detailed explanation of the sport.
Art style and color scheme may not appeal to everyone, some find it too bright or generic.
Animation inconsistencies and recycled visuals.

anime.title: Looking for Magical Doremi
anime.synopsis: 27-year-old Tokyo office worker Mire Yoshizuki just returned to Japan, while 22-year-old fourth-year college student Sora Nagase aspires to be a teacher, and 20-year-old boyish Reika Kawatani is a part-time Hiroshima okonomiyaki shop worker and freelancer. What draws together these three women from completely different walks of life is a magic gem. A "New Magical Story" begins when they are mysteriously brought together by chance and embark on a journey.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a love letter to the Ojamajo Doremi series and fandom in general, focusing on three young women who bond over their shared love for the show. While some appreciate the focus on the new characters and the nostalgic elements, others were disappointed by the lack of focus on the original cast and the uneven narrative. Overall, the movie seems to resonate more strongly with those already familiar with the original series.
pros: Celebrates the original Ojamajo Doremi series and its impact.
Well-developed protagonists with relatable struggles.
Captures the spirit and themes of the original series.
Evokes a sense of nostalgia for fans of the original series.
Offers a glimpse into different places in Japan.
cons: The Ojamajo Doremi cast is not the main focus.
Uneven narrative structure with inconsistent focus on each protagonist.
Some find the animation lackluster for a theatrical film.
Personal arcs of the characters are not fully explored.

anime.title: Cells at Work!!
anime.synopsis:
The cells of the human body never rest for too long; there is always something new to do and learn every day. At least, that is what Hakkekkyuu U-1146 feels as he rushes to and fro, searching for any pathogens that could cause harm to the body. Despite his dangerous line of work, it is all worth it to protect the happy smiles of Sekkekkyuu AE3803, the platelet crew, his fellow neutrophils, and the other cells he meets along the way. 

In his latest pathogen-hunting adventures, Hakkekkyuu U-1146 discovers how important cells can sometimes make mistakes, and that not all bacteria are actually bad. Everybody has their bad days, but everything eventually works out when their comrades have their backs. In the end, it is just another normal day for these hardworking cells!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience consensus is mixed. Fans of the first season generally enjoyed the second, but many felt it was unoriginal and lacked the charm and depth of its predecessor. The educational aspect remains a strong point, but some find the humor and plot weaker.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the first season
Educational content presented in an entertaining way
Good animation quality (from David Production)
cons: Lacks novelty compared to the first season
Story feels repetitive and lacks depth
Comedy can be weak or unfunny
Some animation shortcuts like CGI are jarring

anime.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 2nd Season
