While some viewers found the story predictable, others enjoyed the characters and their camaraderie. Ultimately, the show's technical flaws overshadowed its narrative strengths for many viewers.
pros: Engaging baseball gameplay creates tension.
Characters' backstories enhance emotional impact during games.
Team comradery is rewarding and meaningful.
Clear and focused story progression.
Enjoyable characters with unique personalities.
cons: Poor art and animation quality, especially 3D CGI, distracts from the story.
Forgettable character introductions in early episodes.
Predictable and boring story for some viewers.
One-dimensional characters with little depth.
Inconsistent art style with off-model faces.

anime.title: Shinkansen Henkei Robo Shinkalion: Mirai kara Kita Shinsoku no ALFA-X
anime.romaji_title: Shinkansen Henkei Robo Shinkalion: Mirai kara Kita Shinsoku no ALFA-X
anime.synopsis:
The new enemies, Nahane and Ohanefu, along with the mysterious new Giant Monstrous Beings appear from space to take over the Earth! Holding the key to these events is Shinkalion ALFA-X, which was secretly developed by the Ultra Evolution Institute...!? For Hayato and Team Shinkalion, who had been living in peace, the battle begins again.

Hayato cannot hide his anxiety after his father Hokuto goes missing during an enemy attack. Meanwhile, a 9-year old Hokuto suddenly appears from across time and space! The young Hokuto, who has slipped through time with the Glowing Particles, determines to become the driver of Shinkalion ALFA-X, which brings together the latest technologies to protect the Earth and return it to normal. Together in their thoughts, Team Shinkalion, brought together from Hokkaido Branch, Yamagata Branch, Ōmiya Branch, Nagoya Branch, Kyoto Branch, and Moji Branch confront the strongest enemy in the universe.

Can Team Shinkalion protect the peace and security of Japan!? Can Hayato reunite with Hokuto!?
anime.consensus_summary: The Shinkalion movie aimed to attract a broader audience through collaborations, including Godzilla. However, the execution of these collaborations feels underwhelming and rushed, particularly the Godzilla fight. The film's reliance on these cameos overshadows other aspects of the movie.
pros: Features Godzilla
cons: Collaborations feel pointless and rushed
Godzilla fight is short and underwhelming

anime.title: Midnight Occult Civil Servants: Lonely Vampire/Beneath the Cherry Tree Forest in Full Bloom
anime.romaji_title: Mayonaka no Occult Koumuin: Hitoribocchi no Kyuuketsuki/Sakura no Mori no Mankai no Shita
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Mythology, Shoujo, Supernatural, Workplace
anime.synopsis: Unaired Episodes 14 and 15 of Mayonaka no Occult Koumuin.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is generally well-received, particularly for its focus on Theo's character development and exploration of the supernatural. While the storyline and character interactions are appreciated, some viewers find the art quality lacking. Overall, fans of the series enjoy the additional content and deeper emotional connection with the characters.
pros: Well-written mix of fantasy and police mystery
Good story execution, portrays characters and their associations clearly
Deeper insight into Theo's character and emotions
Enjoyable exploration of vampires and supernatural elements
cons: Lackluster art and animation quality
Overplayed theme of 'understanding'
Not enough Kohaku

anime.title: Strike Witches: 501 Butai Hasshin Shimasu! Movie
anime.romaji_title: Strike Witches: 501 Butai Hasshin Shimasu! Movie
anime.synopsis: Yoshika Miyafuji spends her days peacefully after returning to her hometown. Her former superior officer Mio Sakamoto and others arranged for Yoshika to study abroad at a medical school in Europe. Yoshika returns to Europe with Shizuka Hattori, who was Sakamoto's student at the naval academy. As Yoshika returns to Europe and new signs of Neuroi emerge, the other former members of the 501st Joint Fighter Wing, who were scattered in various locations, also begin to gather again. A powerful Neuroi then appears before Yoshika and Shizuka.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is primarily enjoyable for existing fans of the Strike Witches franchise, particularly those who appreciated the chibi-style spin-off. It's considered a comical redo of the original movie, but the slower pacing might not appeal to everyone. Prior knowledge of the characters and original series is essential for full appreciation.
pros: Good if you enjoyed the chibi-style spin-off series
Enjoyable if you are familiar with the original series and characters
Eila content is highly rated (8/10)
cons: Slower pacing compared to the 12-episode spin-off series
Less funny than the 12-episode spin-off series
Not recommended if you haven't watched the original series or OVAs

anime.title: Isekai Quartet 2
anime.synopsis:
Despite completing all the tasks given to them, Ainz Ooal Gown, Tanya Degurechaff, Kazuma Satou, Subaru Natsuki, and the other members of Class 2 are surprised to find out that their role as students is far from over. With no means of returning home, the class of eccentric personalities is still mysteriously stuck in the unfamiliar world. Although, as they are becoming quite fond of each other, spending more time together does not sound that bad.

With the unexpected arrival of new transfer students, the comedic antics of our beloved characters continue to grow. Thus, their bizarre yet nonchalant school life continues.
anime.consensus_summary: Isekai Quartet 2 delivers more of the same comedic crossover action, pleasing fans of the involved series with its character interactions and lighthearted humor. However, some critics note that the formula has become stale, the new characters are underutilized, and the humor is heavily reliant on prior knowledge of the source material. Despite its flaws, the season is generally considered an enjoyable, low-effort watch for Isekai enthusiasts.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions and funny situations.
Good for fans of the involved Isekai series.
Catchy and memorable OP/ED.
A fun, chill watch that doesn't require much thought.
Improved comedic elements compared to the first season.
cons: Humor relies heavily on knowledge of the source material, making it less accessible to newcomers.
New characters (Shield Hero cast) lack sufficient screen time and integration.
Formulaic and repetitive, lacking the initial impact of the first season.
Writing is shallow, with kiddy versions of the characters and no edginess.
Bland plot with generic school-like setting and situations.

anime.title: Yamiyo
anime.synopsis: Official music video for Eve's song Yamiyo, the song was used as the second ED to the Dororo TV series. The song was on EVE's digital album release the following day.
anime.consensus_summary: The song evokes a sense of deep melancholy with an undertone of hope, although some find it generic. The animation receives mixed reviews, with some praising its smoothness and others finding it bland and uninspired. Overall, opinions are divided on the music video's artistic merit, but the song itself is generally well-received for its emotional depth.
pros: Beautiful instrumental work and vocals.
Lyrics tell a powerfully emotional story.
Animation is incredibly smooth and a unique treat for the eyes.
Relates to universal struggles.
cons: Song can sound generic.
Singer's voice can become obnoxious on repeat listens.
Blend of soft violin and trap beats doesn't work well for some.
Video is generic, bland, and uninteresting for some viewers.
Animation quality is lacking for some.

anime.title: Super Senko-san Time Episode 12
anime.synopsis: Unaired episode 12 of the special segment "Super Senko-san Time" included in the 3rd BD volume of Sewayaki Kitsune no Senko-san.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the episode comforting and gentle, appreciating its ability to relieve stress. However, some viewers find the setting and theme repetitive and boring. Overall, the audience sentiment is positive, but there is a desire for more variety in future episodes.
pros: Pleasant atmosphere
Comforting and stress-relieving
cons: Boring setting
Repetitive theme

anime.title: We Never Learn: BOKUBEN Season 2
anime.synopsis:
Under Nariyuki Yuiga's devoted tutelage, his classmates Rizu Ogata, Fumino Furuhashi, and Uruka Takemoto are finally pulling average test scores on their worst subjects. But time is ticking, and there is still a long way to go before the three geniuses of Ichinose Academy are ready for their upcoming university exams. Meanwhile, the girls still struggle to balance the pursuit of their dreams with their growing affections for their unsuspecting tutor.

Joining them are Mafuyu Kirisu, a teacher with strong views about education and talent because of her past as a rising figure skater, and Asumi Kominami, a graduate from their school aiming to attend a national medical university. With these two additions, the group of six is livelier than ever before. Completely caught up in hilarious antics with his new friends, Yuiga finds that his last year of high school now includes a lot more than just going to class and studying.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about 'Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai!'. Fans of the harem rom-com genre generally enjoy the series for its cute characters and lighthearted humor. However, many are critical of the anime's ending, which deviates from the manga and feels rushed. Some also feel the series relies too heavily on clichés and fan service.
pros: Enjoyable characters and entertaining scenes.
Good animation and voice acting.
Clear plot advancement in season 2 compared to the first season.
cons: Incomplete or rushed ending that deviates from the manga.
Skipped important scenes from the manga.
Unoriginal and clichéd harem tropes.
Felt that it was focused on some characters and not others

anime.title: Interspecies Reviewers
anime.synopsis:
Countless diverse races, from perky fairies to oozing slimes, inhabit the world. Naturally, such a melting pot of creatures has a broad and alluring variety of brothels. With so many options to choose from, it is hard to decide with which succu-girl to have a meaningful, interpersonal experience.

Fortunately, a tight group of brave warriors has come together to enlighten the public. These perverted adventurers take it upon themselves to assess the appeal of all types of succu-girls through hands-on research. Whether it be the scorchingly hot salamanders or the udderly hu-moo-ngous cow-girls, the Yoruno Gloss reviewers leave no species behind.

Directed by the mastermind behind Miru Tights, Ishuzoku Reviewers seeks to answer one of the most pressing questions there is: which species is the sexiest?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are sharply divided, with strong appreciation for its audacious humor, creative monster girl designs, and genre-pushing boldness, contrasted by significant criticism of its repetitive formula and crude subject matter. While some hail it as a "peak ecchi" masterpiece, others find it fundamentally unenjoyable and artistically lacking.
pros: Genuine humor and comedic timing, blending low-brow and high-brow.
Surprisingly detailed world-building and character development for its genre.
High originality and creativity in monster girl designs and scenarios.
Boldness in pushing the boundaries of the ecchi genre.
Characters are likable and have distinct personalities and tastes.
cons: Repetitive episode structure and sex scene formulas.
Some find the humor and subject matter to be crude or even disgusting.
Art style and character anatomy can be inconsistent or unappealing to some.
Lacks a strong overarching narrative or deep plot.
Can be seen as 'junk food' entertainment that is ultimately forgettable.

anime.title: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Eternal The Movie Part 1
anime.romaji_title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Eternal Movie 1
anime.synopsis:
The Dead Moon Circus has arrived in Juban with the hopes of liberating their queen, Nehellenia, by stealing the Legendary Silver Crystal for themselves. Using "Lemures," the Circus begins to convert people's dreams into nightmares in order to collect enough energy to plunge the Earth into darkness and turn it into a planet of death. In order to stop the Circus in their tracks, Usagi Tsukino and her friends must reprise their roles as the Inner Sailor Guardians.

When Mamoru Chiba suddenly falls ill after the appearance of a total solar eclipse, Usagi and Chibiusa encounter a pegasus by the name of Helios who is desperate to unseal the Golden Crystal, which Helios claims is the only way to save their world from the impending threat. Meanwhile, the Sailor Guardians discover that they can no longer transform following the eclipse and begin to fall victim to the Circus' Lemures. Will they be able to recover their powers in time to stop the darkness from taking over?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the movie as a visually appealing and faithful adaptation of the Dream arc, particularly praising its focus on the inner guardians and improvements over the Crystal series. However, some criticize the rushed pacing and occasional animation issues. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile watch for Sailor Moon fans, though not without its flaws.
pros: Beautiful animation and character designs.
Faithful adaptation of the manga's Dream arc.
Highlights the inner guardians and their backstories.
Excellent voice acting and soundtrack.
Addresses technical issues present in the Crystal series.
cons: Rushed pacing due to runtime constraints.
Choppy animation in some instances.
Music may not fit the atmosphere for some viewers.
Villains may not come across as threatening.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Final Season
anime.romaji_title: Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final Season
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Military, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Gabi Braun and Falco Grice have been training their entire lives to inherit one of the seven Titans under Marley's control and aid their nation in eradicating the Eldians on Paradis. However, just as all seems well for the two cadets, their peace is suddenly shaken by the arrival of Eren Yeager and the remaining members of the Survey Corps.

Having finally reached the Yeager family basement and learned about the dark history surrounding the Titans, the Survey Corps has at long last found the answer they so desperately fought to uncover. With the truth now in their hands, the group set out for the world beyond the walls.

In Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final Season, two utterly different worlds collide as each party pursues its own agenda in the long-awaited conclusion to Paradis' fight for freedom.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final Season' is highly divided. Some viewers praise the ambitious narrative, strong thematic elements, and faithful adaptation. However, many express disappointment with the animation quality, pacing, and character development, leading to a polarized overall sentiment.
pros: Strong artistic vision and soundtrack
Faithful adaptation of source material, often elevating scenes
Intricate weaving of political drama and social commentary
Exploration of moral dilemmas and shades of gray in characters
cons: Awkward dialogue and excessive shouting
Inconsistent animation quality, especially CGI
Pacing issues and slow plot progression
Underdeveloped or unlikeable new characters
Deviation from the tone and feel of previous seasons

anime.title: Squishy! Black Clover
anime.synopsis: SD Black Clover short comedy specials released exclusively on dTV.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Mugyutto! Black Clover' as a comedic and lighthearted spin-off. The show's absurd plot and self-aware humor are well-received, particularly the exaggerated character traits and unexpected parodies. It's considered a fun, albeit inconsequential, addition for fans of the original series looking for a quick laugh.
pros: Humorous and lighthearted take on Black Clover characters.
Creative and surprising plot developments.
Memorable and charismatic characters like Yuno and the Narrator.
cons: The humor might not appeal to everyone.
The plot is nonsensical and adds nothing of substance to the original series.

anime.title: The Chronicles of Rebecca
anime.synopsis: Set in a rural town in Maine, USA, at the end of the 19th century. The second of seven siblings, Rebecca, is a bright and energetic 10-year-old girl. When her father dies, Rebecca’s life becomes harder and she is sent to live with her two aunts, Miranda and Jane. Rebecca, who admires the gentle Jane, constantly cowers from the strict and nagging Miranda. One day, Rebecca is scolded by Miranda for going out in a pink dress that Jane had made for her by hand. After Miranda insults her father, Rebecca explodes and leaves the house in a rage…
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally responds positively to the animation and emotional impact of the film. Comparisons to similar works like "Anne of Green Gables" enhance its appeal. However, some find the original source material lacking, and past adaptations have been unsuccessful.
pros: Animation is full of life and lovingly done.
Scenes evoke strong emotional responses (e.g., crying scenes hit hard).
Covers an impressive breadth of experience in a short time.
cons: Previous adaptations of the source material are not faithful.
The original book is considered just okay by some.

anime.title: Odoru Mowai-kun
anime.synopsis: The anime centers on a Moai statue named Mowai-kun who is gloomy every day because it lives a dull life where it just watches the beach and the sun from atop a hill on an island. But one day Mowai-kun grows arms, and starts to dance. The anime will air within the Oha-Suta program's "Kyara-Suta" corner.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds 'Odoru Mowai-kun' to be a flawed but enjoyable short anime. While the story and art are basic, the show can elicit chuckles from viewers. Its simplicity and cute characters make it a passable, quick watch for those interested.
pros: Enjoyable despite flaws
Able to make the viewer chuckle
cons: Almost no story
Basic art
Reused animations
One-dimensional characters

anime.title: Doraemon the Movie 2020: Nobita's New Dinosaur
anime.romaji_title: Doraemon Movie 40: Nobita no Shin Kyouryuu
anime.synopsis: Nobita and the gang travel 66 million years into the past to bring a pair of adorable dinosaur twins back to where they belong.
anime.consensus_summary: The Doraemon movie is well-received as a nostalgic and adventurous installment in the franchise. Praised for its art, sound, and positive themes, it offers an enjoyable experience for fans. Minor criticisms include the CGI quality and character depth, but overall it maintains the series' charm and appeal.
pros: Great twist from the original movie with amazing references.
Astonishingly good sound effects and OSTs.
Beautiful art style, a step up from previous entries.
Teaches that evolution is important.
Fun and enjoyable, suitable for both Doraemon fans and children.
cons: CGI did not fit the art style of Miu and Qiu.
Characters are adequate but not extraordinary.

anime.title: ID: INVADED
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Detective, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
The Mizuhanome System is a highly advanced development that allows people to enter one of the most intriguing places in existence—the human mind. Through the use of so-called "cognition particles" left behind at a crime scene by the perpetrator, detectives from the specialized police squad Kura can manifest a criminal's unconscious mind as a bizarre stream of thoughts in a virtual world. Their task is to explore this psychological plane, called an "id well," to reveal the identity of the culprit.

Not just anyone can enter the id wells; the prerequisite is that you must have killed someone yourself. Such is the case for former detective Akihito Narihisago, who is known as "Sakaido" inside the id wells. Once a respected member of the police, tragedy struck, and he soon found himself on the other side of the law.

Nevertheless, Narihisago continues to assist Kura in confinement. While his prodigious detective skills still prove useful toward investigations, Narihisago discovers that not everything is as it seems, as behind the seemingly standalone series of murder cases lurks a much more sinister truth.
anime.consensus_summary: Id:Invaded is a visually stimulating and conceptually ambitious anime that divides audiences. While some appreciate its mind-bending narrative and unique premise, others criticize its reliance on existing tropes, convoluted plot, and weak character development. The series ultimately fails to fully realize its potential, leaving viewers with mixed feelings.
pros: Intriguing and perplexing story with unexpected twists.
Unique concept of diving into the unconscious mind.
Fast-paced and engaging, with each episode packed with content.
cons: Overcomplicated plot with psychobabble that doesn't always make sense.
Relies heavily on tropes from other sci-fi shows, lacking originality.
Inconsistent character development and poorly defined personalities.

anime.title: Great Pretender
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Mystery, Organized Crime
anime.synopsis:
A series of unfortunate events has led Makoto Edamura to adopt the life of crime—pickpocketing and scamming others for a living. However, after swindling a seemingly clueless tourist, Makoto discovers that he was the one tricked and, to make matters worse, that the police are now after him. 

While making his escape, he runs into the tourist once again, who turns out to be a fellow con man named Laurent Thierry, and ends up following him to Los Angeles. In an attempt to defend his self-proclaimed title of "Japan's Greatest Swindler," Makoto challenges his rival to determine the better scammer. Accepting the competition, Laurent drops them off outside a huge mansion and claims that their target will be the biggest mafia boss on the West Coast.

As Makoto becomes increasingly involved with the cunning Laurent, his colorful associates, and the world of international high-stakes fraud, he soon realizes that he got more than what he bargained for as his self-declared skills are continually put to the test.
anime.consensus_summary: Great Pretender starts strong with its visual appeal and engaging heists, but many viewers find the ending and plot resolutions disappointing. The stylish presentation and initial character development are praised, but the later narrative choices and perceived plot holes lead to a divided audience. Ultimately, the consensus is that the show's potential is squandered by a weak final arc.
pros: Visually stunning art and animation with unique color palettes.
Engaging and amusing storylines with unexpected twists and turns.
Delightful cast of characters with compelling backstories.
cons: Final arc is often considered a major disappointment, with nonsensical plot twists.
Plot holes and predictable outcomes diminish the sense of challenge and excitement.
Character development, especially for the main character Edamura, is perceived as lacking.

anime.title: Deca-Dence
anime.synopsis:
Far in the future, the lifeforms known as Gadoll suddenly arose as a threat to humanity. The last surviving humans on Earth confine themselves to the Tank, a lower district in the giant mobile fortress Deca-Dence. While the Gears who live on the upper floors are warriors who go out to fight as part of the Power, most Tankers are content to provide support from the backlines, butchering Gadoll meat and reinforcing defenses. Natsume is among those who would rather go to the front lines; undeterred by her prosthetic right arm, she seeks to join the small number of Tanker soldiers who join the Gears in combat. 

But despite her peers at the orphanage each receiving their work assignments, Natsume’s enlistment to the Power remains unapproved. In the meantime, she begins a job as a cleaner in an armor repair team led by the hard-nosed and apathetic Kaburagi, who seems to be more than he lets on. Though initially cold to his idealistic subordinate, he soon recognizes in her the potential to upset the status quo of the world. As Natsume’s new mentor, Kaburagi prepares her for the special and unique role as a game-changing bug in the system.
anime.consensus_summary: Deca-Dence is a unique anime that offers a blend of post-apocalyptic and sci-fi elements, with viewers split on its execution. While praised for its plot twists, character development, and world-building, some find the art style inconsistent and the plot confusing. Overall, the series is considered enjoyable and worth watching, though not without its flaws.
pros: Unique plot twists and world-building
Strong character development and relationships, especially between Natsume and Kaburagi
Good pacing for a 12-episode series
Memorable music and sound design
Exploration of philosophical concepts and themes
cons: Inconsistent art style and animation quality, particularly the CG
Plot can be confusing and difficult to follow at times
Some characters and plot developments are predictable or formulaic
Ending may be weaker or more convenient than expected
Relies on tropes and can feel generic at times

anime.title: Golden Kamuy Season 3
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Historical, Military, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
After obtaining information about Asirpa from the foreteller Inkarmat, Saichi "The Immortal" Sugimoto, Genjirou Tanigaki, and Cikapasi join the Seventh Division's Otonoshin Koito and Hajime Tsukishima on a journey to Karafuto. Heading further north into the freezing Russian territory, they collect any clues about Asirpa's whereabouts they can find and rush after her.

Meanwhile, Asirpa is unaware of what truly transpired at Abashiri Prison. Deeply disturbed and confused by her father Wilk's past actions, Asirpa follows his old friend Kiroranke to the place where Wilk was born and raised in order to better understand his motives. However, Kiroranke and the master sniper Hyakunosuke Ogata are scheming behind her back.

Even if they were to obtain all 24 tattooed skins that form a map to the lost Ainu gold, the various factions searching for it now understand that the map is useless without Asirpa. Realizing the danger she could be in, Sugimoto desperately hopes to reach Asirpa first and protect her from the greedy clutches of those who plan to drag her into their sins.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with many considering Golden Kamuy one of the best anime series. Viewers praise its unique blend of action, adventure, comedy, and historical elements, as well as its well-developed characters and engaging storyline. Some mention initial reservations about CGI but find the series consistently improves, becoming a hidden gem in the anime world.
pros: Well-written story with great character development.
Excellent blend of action, comedy, and suspense.
Consistent quality and never feels boring.
Educational and teaches about ethnic minorities and history.
Unique world and quirky humor.
cons: Some viewers were initially put off by the CGI in earlier seasons.
Animation quality is not as good compared to season 1 (mentioned by one reviewer).

anime.title: BNA: Brand New Animal
anime.synopsis:
Throughout history, humans have been at odds with Beastmen—a species capable of changing shape due to their genetic "Beast Factor." Because of this conflict, Beastmen have been forced into hiding. Anima City serves as a safe haven for these oppressed individuals to live free from human interference.

During a festival celebrating the town's 10th anniversary, Michiru Kagemori, a human who suddenly turned into a tanuki, finds that Anima City is a far cry from paradise. After witnessing an explosion in the square, she is confronted by Shirou Ogami, a seemingly indestructible wolf and sworn protector of all Beastmen. As they pursue the criminals behind the bombing, the two discover that Michiru is anything but an ordinary Beastman, and look to investigate her mysterious past and uncanny abilities. Could she turn out to be the missing link between Humans and Beastmen?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is generally positive, praising the show's art, animation, and music. However, many feel the story is rushed, underdeveloped, and relies on clichés. While the characters are likable, they often lack depth, resulting in a fun but ultimately unfulfilled experience.
pros: Unique and vibrant art style, a breath of fresh air compared to generic modern anime.
Excellent animation quality, especially during action sequences.
Catchy and well-implemented soundtrack, including memorable OP and ED themes.
Enjoyable character interactions and dynamics, particularly Oogami's backstory.
Addresses themes of identity and self-acceptance well through the beastmen concept.
cons: Story feels rushed and underdeveloped, particularly in the latter half.
Plot becomes cliche and predictable, with unanswered questions and inconsistencies.
World-building is inconsistent, with some ideas not fully realized or explored.
Characters can fall into stereotypes, lacking depth and originality.
Uneven pacing, with filler episodes frontloaded and exposition-heavy material later on.
anime.thematic_vibe: Urban Fantasy, Discrimination Allegory, Trigger-esque Energy

anime.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? II: Past & Future
anime.romaji_title: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka II: Past & Future
anime.synopsis: Recap of the first season of Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka.
anime.consensus_summary: The general sentiment is positive, viewing the episode as a useful refresher for the series. Dialogue and action are highlighted as strengths, though the lack of new content is noted. It's considered a worthwhile watch to prepare for season 2.
pros: Good recap of season 1
Amusing dialogue between Bell and Hestia
Highlights best fight sequences
cons: Nothing new is added
Recap doesn't mention movie events

anime.title: Vevara in Your Dream
anime.synopsis: Sana suddenly awakes and is transported to a dream world by someone or something? What she experiences will change her life in the real world forever
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response is overwhelmingly positive, particularly highlighting the character design and art style as enchanting. There's strong interest in seeing more content from the studio and producer, with a desire for a full series. The film appears to have left a memorable impression, making it a highlight for viewers.
pros: Excellent character design
Enchanting art style
Exciting potential for future content
cons: The provided review is overwhelmingly positive, lacking substantial critique. Therefore, the cons are not directly derivable.

anime.title: Gibiate
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Horror, Martial Arts, Samurai, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
The story takes place in Japan. The year is 2030 and Earth has been completely overrun by a viral disease named "Gibia" that turns infected people into various different monsters, based on their age, sex, and race.

A samurai and a ninja from the early Edo period travel together through time and arrive in a ruined Japan to aid a professor working on a cure for the virus.

Together, they fight countless Gibia monsters, outlaws, and other fierce foes on their journey to save mankind.
anime.consensus_summary: "Gibiate" is almost universally panned for its poor production quality, especially its CGI. The story is criticized as being unoriginal and poorly executed, with characters that are bland and nonsensical. While a small number of viewers found enjoyment in its campy nature, the overwhelming consensus is that it is a poorly made anime and one of the worst of 2020.
pros: Some found it enjoyable as a campy, so-bad-it's-good experience reminiscent of older anime.
The soundtrack was considered above average by some viewers.
A few viewers appreciated the straightforward plot without forced romance.
cons: Overwhelmingly criticized for atrocious CGI and animation quality.
Story and plot described as boring, generic, and nonsensical with poorly executed twists.
Characters are described as stereotypical, bland, and making illogical decisions.
Dialogue is unnatural and the overall production feels rushed and low-effort.

anime.title: Mr Love: Queen's Choice
anime.genres: Mystery, Reverse Harem, Romance, Sci-Fi, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
After her father passed away, a young woman inherited his production company, Miracle Entertainment, along with its most successful program, "Miracle Finder." In recent years, however, the show has fallen off the radar and it is now mostly forgotten. In an attempt to save the show from being canceled, this young woman desperately tries to look for a unique topic to use as inspiration. She finds it in the form of "Evol," a mysterious gene that has granted certain people special powers and is considered the next step in human evolution. But, as marvelous as this gene seems, its existence may lead to an unstoppable battle between humans for survival.

However, as she becomes more entangled with the strange world of the "Evolvers," her life is suddenly disturbed by the arrival of four men: the cheerful idol Kira; the neuroscientist and Loveland University professor, Simon; the stoic CEO of Loveland Financial Group and Miracle Entertainment's benefactor, Zen; and her high school upperclassman Haku, a former delinquent now working as a police officer.

As strange incidents begin to plague the city, will she be able to find out the truth about the "Evol" or "Black Swan," the organization behind numerous attacks from "Evolvers" and possibly connected to her father's death? What is her part to play in its plan, and how are the men around her connected to it all?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response is mixed, with strong opinions from fans of the game. While many appreciate the adaptation of characters and certain scenes, the rushed plot and inconsistent animation are significant drawbacks. Some find it enjoyable as a standalone anime, while others feel it requires prior knowledge of the game to fully understand and appreciate the story.
pros: Faithful character design and personalities from the game.
Animation of cute scenes and details from the game.
Engaging plot with mystery elements.
Respectful interactions between characters; the male characters treat the female lead with respect.
cons: Rushed storyline, especially in later episodes.
Mediocre or disappointing OST compared to the game.
Animation quality inconsistencies, particularly in running scenes.
Underdeveloped characters due to limited screen time (12 episodes).
Plot diverges from the game, confusing those unfamiliar with the source material.

anime.title: The King's Avatar: For the Glory
anime.synopsis:
Two years ago, Glory started out as just another MMORPG, but its real-world influence has grown as more countries begin to recognize esports as an official sport. Now, in China, arrangements are being made to hold the first professional league of Glory, culminating in the Glory Championship.

Friends Ye Qiu and Su Muqiu both aspire to make a career out of esports. However, due to personal reasons, Ye Qiu has been hesitant until now to chase his dream onto the national stage. When the two boys finally agree to form their own team, they are supported by Tao Xuan, their boss and the owner of Excellent Era internet cafe, after which they name their team. And so, Team Excellent Era sets their sights on defeating all opponents who stand in their way of reaching the ultimate summit of Glory.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is visually impressive with great action and sound, but suffers from a rushed and underdeveloped plot. Many viewers recommend watching the first season before diving into this prequel. While enjoyable for fans of the series, newcomers may find the lack of explanation and fast pacing confusing.
pros: Stellar animation and art quality, especially in battle sequences.
Enjoyable story with emotional moments and plot twists.
Excellent sound design and OST that enhances the viewing experience.
cons: Rushed pacing and lack of development due to cramming too much content into a short movie.
Insufficient explanation of the game mechanics, making it difficult to understand the strategies and abilities.
Incoherent story elements and subplots that are not fully integrated.
Character visuals are hard to understand without prior knowledge.

anime.title: Lupin III: The First
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: The iconic "gentleman thief" Lupin III returns in an action-packed, continent-spanning adventure, as Lupin III and his colorful underworld companions race to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Bresson Diary, before it falls into the hands of a dark cabal that will stop at nothing to resurrect the Third Reich. The gang undertakes trap-filled tombs, aerial escapades, and daring prison escapes with the trademark wit and visual finesse that have made Lupin the 3rd one of the most storied animation franchises in the world, in a thrilling new caper that is sure to delight fans old and new.
anime.consensus_summary: Lupin III: The First is a visually stunning and entertaining adventure that pays homage to the classic series. While the story is predictable, the exceptional CGI animation, faithful characters, and exciting action make it a worthwhile experience for both newcomers and longtime fans. The film successfully captures the spirit of Lupin III, though some may find the narrative lacking in depth.
pros: Stunning 3D CGI animation rivalling Western productions.
Faithful adaptation of Lupin III's iconic style and characters.
Exciting action sequences and humor.
Great soundtrack reminiscent of classic Lupin themes.
cons: Predictable and cliché story.
Some emotional scenes feel forced.
Inconsistent animation quality at times.
Some facial animations fall into the uncanny valley.

anime.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Specials
anime.romaji_title: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou Specials
anime.synopsis: Unaired episodes included with the Blu-ray releases of Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely divided on the value of these specials. While some appreciate the character insights, fanservice, and lighthearted "dumb fun" as a supplement to the main series, a significant portion views them as pointless recaps with no new content. Viewers who disliked the main series are unlikely to find these specials appealing.
pros: Provides insight into characters, particularly Yue and Kaori.
Offers enjoyable "dumb fun" and a break from the usual series.
Features good voice acting for Kaori and Tio.
Contains "fanservice" that some viewers enjoy.
cons: Primarily consists of recap content with minimal new animation or story.
Episodes are considered pointless and skippable for those who have seen Season 1.
Lacks significant plot development or new narrative elements.
Animation quality is identical to the first season and not a highlight.

anime.title: Maesetsu! Opening Act
anime.synopsis:
Manzai is a traditional form of Japanese stand-up comedy where two comedians act out skits as a straight man and funny man, guiding the audience through a series of punchlines. Two determined girls, Mafuyu Kogarashi and Fubuki Kitakaze, are aspiring manzai entertainers who struggle to achieve any real success, despite their lengthy time on stage. They often partner up with manzai newcomers and their close friends—Rin Araya and Nayuta Asougi—to help in the opening acts of each other's routines.

In order to eventually reach their desired fame, the four girls challenge themselves by changing venues, switching roles, entering competitions, and giving it their best to hone their craft and gain more experience. But before that can happen, these flourishing young artists must first grow into presentable performers to get signed as amateurs and start their dream in earnest.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Maesetsu! is mixed to negative. While some appreciate the slice-of-life elements and insight into Japanese comedy, most find the humor unsuccessful and the characters bland. The show's heavy reliance on Japanese cultural references further limits its appeal to a niche audience.
pros: Character designs are well done.
Show provides insight into the Japanese stand-up comedy scene (Owarai).
The characters show believable growth and development as they practice comedy.
Some found the music to be enjoyable.
cons: Comedy is generally unfunny or falls flat for many viewers.
Characters are bland and not memorable.
Animation is uninspired and safe.
Plot is tedious and boring.
Relies heavily on niche Japanese cultural references that are inaccessible to many viewers.

anime.title: Cooking with Valkyries
anime.synopsis: Join the table with Valkyries this summer for a feast of mouth-watering food and heartwarming memories.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Nu Wushen de Canzhuo" as a lighthearted and cute cooking anime, especially as a way to alleviate the intensity of the main Honkai Impact 3rd story. The animation and sound are appreciated, with the catchy opening theme being a highlight. While the story is simple and the episodes are short, the show is considered a worthwhile watch, even for non-fans of the Honkai series.
pros: Catchy opening music
Cute art style that fits the anime's vibe
Faithful to the characters' original personalities
Wholesome and soothing content
Delicious-looking food
Recipes at the end of episodes are a cool idea
cons: Simple story, lacks depth
Short episodes
Average art quality (not great, not bad)

anime.title: Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? Do You Love Your Mom on the Shore?
anime.romaji_title: Tsuujou Kougeki ga Zentai Kougeki de Ni-kai Kougeki no Okaasan wa Suki desu ka? Namiuchigiwa no Okaasan wa Suki desu ka?
anime.synopsis:
Unaired 13th episode.

To thank the group for all their hard work in the past, Shirase invites the party to enjoy the sunny beach. While enjoying the wonderful weather and pristine waters, an accident causes Masato to lose all his memories, including those of Mamako!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is split on this OVA, with fans of the original series largely enjoying the familiar humor and fan service, while detractors criticize the poor production values and the problematic incestuous themes. While some found it a satisfying, silly beach episode, others were disappointed by the lack of substance and weak narrative execution.
pros: Maintains the same level of humor, antics, and action as the series.
Offers enjoyable fan service and cute character designs.
The original OP is good and enjoyable to hear again.
Mamako's character interactions and dialogue, especially her purity, are highlighted positively.
cons: Art and animation quality are poor and limited, with a lack of effort in drawing.
The plot is weak, relying heavily on a contrived amnesia storyline.
Character development for secondary harem members (Wise and Medhi) is neglected.
The incestuous undertones between Masato and Mamako are a significant point of contention.
The episode prioritizes fan service over humor, leading to a flat experience for some.

anime.title: Ne Zha
anime.romaji_title: Nezha Zhi Mo Tong Jiang Shi
anime.synopsis:
From the heavenly object known as the Chaos Pearl, two elements are extracted: the Spirit Pearl and the Demon Orb. In an attempt to suppress their power, the Lord of Heaven sends the Spirit Pearl to Earth to reincarnate as Ne Zha, the third son of Li Jing, while the Demon Orb is scheduled to be destroyed by a lightning strike. However, because of a conspiracy by the Dragon King to steal the Spirit Pearl for his own son, Ne Zha is instead reincarnated with the Demon Orb.

With no way to remove the cursed effects of the Demon Orb, Ne Zha is raised under the belief that he will become the great demon hunter the Spirit Pearl destined for him to be. Fighting against his chaotic and mischievous nature, Ne Zha must decide whether to accept his evil fate or rebel against it to prove he is worthy of the future his parents foretold.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed 'Nezha,' praising its animation, story, and emotional depth, with some finding the humor childish or certain character designs unappealing. The film resonates particularly well with those familiar with Chinese mythology, although some critics felt the plot was underdeveloped. Despite some criticisms, most agree that 'Nezha' is a visually stunning and entertaining film with a strong message.
pros: Visually stunning animation, reminiscent of Pixar meets Anime.
Compelling story with complex characters and morally grey areas.
Excellent fight scenes and imaginative world-building.
Emotional depth and exploration of themes like prejudice and societal expectations.
cons: Some viewers found Ne Zha's regular human form unappealing or cringeworthy.
Pacing issues and underbaked plot elements.
Over-reliance on slapstick humor and childish elements.
Superficial treatment of supporting characters and lack of character development beyond Ne Zha.

anime.title: Arte
anime.synopsis:
In the 16th century, the city of Florence booms with cultural and creative revival in celebration of the Renaissance. Arte, a delightful young lady from an aristocratic family, dreams of being an artist and contributing to the renewal of civilization. However, with her father's death, she ends up losing the only person who believed in her passion for art. Now she is expected to marry a nobleman and live as a refined housewife without disgracing her family name. Reluctant to accept her fate, the headstrong Arte steps into the streets in search of a master artisan to take her on as an apprentice.

In her quest for a mentor, Arte has to face harsh reality when she is completely shunned for being a female artist. No one believes that women are capable of fine craftsmanship, and therefore none are willing to accept her. Luckily, a renowned artisan by the name of Leo is persuaded to take her as his disciple since he has none anyway. And thus, Arte's new life begins, far from the comfort of her noble upbringing. As an apprentice, she must earn her keep while tackling various challenges along the difficult path to becoming a full-fledged, master artisan.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Arte' are notably divided. Some viewers appreciate the show's focus on female empowerment within a unique historical setting, praising the protagonist's determination and the educational aspects. However, others criticize its historical inaccuracies, generic art style, and simplistic portrayal of complex social issues, resulting in a polarized reception.
pros: Strong female protagonist with determination and will.
Exploration of Renaissance Italy, including art workshops, gender roles and class.
Educational and entertaining, depicting a character driven story.
Good VA work
cons: Generic art style and animation, failing to capitalize on the historical setting.
Simplistic and shallow portrayal of misogyny, lacking nuance and depth.
Inaccurate depiction of historical context, particularly regarding female artists.
Pacing is too slow and can be boring.

anime.title: Rebirth
anime.synopsis: The series revolve around a team of 12 high school students who love to play the trading card game Rebirth For You.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime 'Rebirth For You' is a cute show with likable characters, but it heavily relies on being an advertisement for the card game. It doesn't succeed as an introduction to the card game itself. Jokes are not particularly funny, leading to a generally lukewarm reception.
pros: Cute art style
Likable characters
Decent moments when breaks away from advertisement roots
cons: Fails as an introduction to the card game
Watered down by card game speak
Jokes aren't very funny
Heavily relies on being an advertisement

anime.title: Oda Cinnamon Nobunaga
anime.synopsis: In the "one-of-a-kind samurai-general-reincarnated-as-a-canine comedy," Nobunaga perishes at Honnouji as in history, and reincarnates in modern-day Japan as a dog named Shinamon. Other Warring States era warlords such as Takeda Shingen eventually join him, also as dogs.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, viewers found "Oda Cinnamon Nobunaga" to be a cute and fun, but ultimately shallow, anime. The comedic premise and lighthearted tone were appreciated for relaxation, but the lack of a compelling story and repetitive jokes left many wanting more. While enjoyable as a casual watch, it's not considered a standout anime due to its simplistic narrative and middling production quality.
pros: Funny and wholesome at times.
The premise is unique and interesting.
Enjoyable for relaxation and stress relief.
Catchy opening music and good visuals.
Episodic format keeps things fresh.
cons: Lacks a strong or cohesive story.
Comedy can become repetitive and dragged out.
Jokes are not always hilarious or memorable.
Animation quality is middling.
Characters are not very deep or developed.

anime.title: ARP Backstage Pass
anime.synopsis: ARP: A 4-member dance and vocal group created by the latest AR technology. This popular group got their start with Avex, and are unique for their interactive concerts which combine highly-skilled song and dance routines with a format that changes based on how much the fans are cheering them on.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with appreciation for the music and 3D performances but criticism for the weak story and overt promotional nature. Many feel it is a worthwhile watch for those interested in idol culture and music, despite its flaws. The show serves primarily as an introduction to the music group ARP.
pros: Unique music with a variety of genres (pop, rock, hip hop)
Interesting insight into the creation of an idol group
Visually appealing 3D performances
cons: Weak story and potentially silly drama
Inconsistent art quality, with poor animation outside of performances
Show is primarily a promotional vehicle for the group ARP

anime.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Sevens
anime.synopsis:
In the ever-growing world of Duel Monsters, as duelists improve their skills and rise up the ranks, duels become increasingly complex. By adhering to strict rules, in addition to using and learning proven strategies, one can develop into a strong duelist. However, as a boy who loves inventions and discovering new possibilities, elementary school student Yuuga Oudou finds the current way of dueling predictable and rigid—in other words, boring.

Thus, he aims to craft a new path in dueling with his exhilarating new invention: Rush Duels. His ambition soon catches the attention of Tatsuhisa Kamijou, a fellow elementary school student, who brings him to a mysterious place in an attempt to discover the potential of the new system. 

While Yuuga aims to implement Rush Duels as the new dueling standard and overthrow the conventions of the game, he opens the door to his ultimate goal—to make dueling exciting again.
anime.consensus_summary: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! Sevens is a divisive entry in the franchise, with some appreciating its lighthearted tone, charming characters, and fresh take on dueling with Rush Duels. However, others criticize its repetitive story arcs, simplistic early duels, and average animation. While the show has its flaws, it ultimately offers an enjoyable experience for those willing to embrace its unique style and focus on comedy.
pros: Fresh take on the franchise, more light-hearted and comedic.
Character writing is charming and endearing, even for one-shot characters.
Story builds on itself, with plot points remembered and interconnected.
Rush Duels bring new life into the game.
cons: Story arcs can be repetitive and lack substantial plot progression.
Early duels are simplistic and can feel slow.
Simplified character designs and animation quality is average.
Humor may not appeal to all viewers.
Some characters feel like one-trick ponies.

anime.synopsis:
Miu Takigawa views the world from behind the safety of her bangs, content with peacefully passing unnoticed through life. Reserved and timid, Miu struggles to converse with or even smile at customers when at her part time job, but she works tirelessly to support her mother and precious little sister, Haru. It is a shock when a letter arrives from the entertainment company GIP, announcing that she has been chosen as a candidate for their new project. 

Miu decides to accept the invitation and heads to the meeting spot where the eccentric ensemble of other candidates filter in, all summoned by their own letters. Not long after, the girls are escorted by a manager to a luxurious secret facility, where it is explained that they must follow the mysterious directions of "The Wall," whose orders are absolute. 

The 24th of December, 2016, will see the birth of idols like no other; on that day, the group 22/7 will debut, whether or not Miu and the other members are ready to take the stage.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding the premise absurd and the emotional arcs artificial, while others appreciate the character-driven stories and the exploration of idol life's challenges. The production quality is generally praised, but the writing and overall execution are criticized for lacking depth and genuine emotional resonance. Ultimately, the show is seen as a decent but forgettable entry in the idol anime genre.
pros: Strong production values, especially character design.
Exploration of individual character backstories adds depth.
Music is enjoyable and enhances emotional impact.
cons: Ridiculous premise with a nonsensical "Wall" dictating actions.
Artificial emotional backstories that feel dishonest.
Inconsistent character development and lack of stakes.
Poor writing, generic melodies, and pretentious lyrics.

anime.title: Girls' Frontline
anime.synopsis: Tactical Dolls, or "T-Dolls", are militarized androids that rivals the strengths of human soldiers. These T-Doll girls are unstoppable fighters on the battlefield who can engage in any risky operations given to them. Although ruthless warriors in combat, they become more playful and joyful dolls in the dormitories. The daily lives of eight T-Dolls are followed along with cute interactions, lively games, ranting commanders, and many other wholesome events deployed right at your front lines.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. The first half is appreciated for its heartwarming character interactions and art style. However, the short episodes and lack of a strong story are criticized, especially in the second, more humor-focused half.
pros: Great character interactions in the first half
Heartwarming scenarios
Charming art style
Good voice acting
cons: Very short episodes limit character development
Lack of story
Inconsistent animation quality
Second half is more fast-paced and less substantial

anime.title: Porte
anime.synopsis: Concept movie released in Keina Suda's 2nd EP
anime.consensus_summary: The audience, or at least this reviewer, finds the animation enhances the musical experience, providing a deeper understanding and emotional connection. The visual storytelling is a key strength, overcoming language barriers. The reviewer discovered more of the artist's work because of the piece, showing its positive impact.
pros: The animation adds a new layer of understanding and perspective to the music.
The visuals communicate effectively, even without understanding the lyrics.
The music led the reviewer to discover and appreciate more of the artist's work.
cons: The reviewer questions the inclusion of music entries on the site.

anime.title: Hero Mask
anime.synopsis: The investigation on masks is still ongoing as Connor is still on the loose. New clues and movements starts appearing after a simple bus crashes in which only one girl survives completely untact. Who is she and how is she related to the case? SSC continue to investigate but, after Steven's death the police director - Richard put resignation, new director is suspicious of SSC. He place a new agent in SSC team...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many feeling disappointed by the second season due to unresolved plot points and character development issues. While the initial mystery and action were engaging, the rushed conclusion and lack of answers left viewers frustrated. The series is considered a decent attempt at a sci-fi thriller but falls short due to writing flaws.
pros: Engaging mystery plot with good action sequences.
Interesting sci-fi/mystery feel.
The art style is interesting and works well for the 'secret agent' type style and setting.
cons: Major plot holes and unanswered questions.
Rushed pacing and forgotten characters.
Underdeveloped and unrelatable characters with meaningless backstories.
Poor character development.

anime.title: Digimon Survive - Opening Movie
anime.synopsis: A prologue movie released on Bandai Namco's official YouTube channels for the eventual 2020 release of the Digimon Survive game. The movie was first shown at the Anime Expo's panel "The Future of Digimon" and then later posted online.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is optimistic about the upcoming game, intrigued by the darker tone and potential for a compelling story. The prologue movie is well-received for its characters and music, but some find it lacking in plot details. There's a general sense of anticipation and hope for a good Digimon game experience.
pros: Interesting characters with varied personalities.
The plot has a touch of mystery.
The music is melancholic and touching.
Well-made prologue.
cons: Not much about the plot is revealed in the ONA.

anime.title: Listeners
anime.synopsis: Set in a world where the concept of music ceases to exist. The story begins when a boy encounters Myuu, a mysterious girl who possesses an audio input jack in her body. The two intermingle with the history of rock music and embark on an unforgettable journey.
anime.consensus_summary: Listeners is a highly divisive anime. While praised for its concept, music, and some visual elements, it's heavily criticized for its confusing plot, weak characters, and poor execution. Many feel the series fails to live up to its potential, resulting in disappointment and frustration, while others appreciate its unique take on music and mecha themes, leading to a polarized audience response.
pros: Unique and creative world-building concept.
Good soundtrack, with awesome opening and ending themes.
Visually appealing art style with well-designed characters (in some instances).
cons: Poorly executed story with a garbled and confusing narrative.
Underdeveloped and unlikable characters with forced relationships.
Inconsistent animation quality with awkward CGI and stiff movements.
Over-reliance on music references without substance.
Bland and uninspired music for an anime focused on music.

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Shinemon Arc
anime.synopsis:
This is the story of "Shinemon Nitta", the future manager of Card Capital.

10 years before the reunion of Aichi Sendou and Toshiki Kai, the card shop run by the Tokura family "Card Capital" was going out of business. Then came the attempt to take over the store by Esuka Hibino, the owner of a major card shop.

In order to protect Card Capital, Shinemon Nitta stands up as the "Self-proclaimed Manager!"
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate Shinemon's character and Misaki's development, many find the plot repetitive, the side characters underdeveloped, and the fight choreography uninspired. The reliance on critical triggers in card fights is a point of contention, detracting from the main character's credibility.
pros: Character development of Misaki
Compelling motivations of the main character Shinemon
cons: Repetitive plot elements from previous seasons
Underdeveloped side characters
Uninspired fight choreography relying on critical triggers
Mediocre comedic elements in the story

anime.title: Zombie Land Saga Revenge
anime.synopsis:
The Franchouchou girls are back and better than ever! Unfortunately for them, they are also heavily in debt. After a concert bombs, the undead members are forced to take day jobs to pay off the venue, and their normally eccentric manager, Koutarou Tatsumi, sinks into alcoholism.

But dark days cannot keep these idols down! Rival idols appear, a famous talk show host retires, and existentialism takes root. Koutarou's legacy will slowly unravel while a journalist closes in on the truth. As Saga plunges into chaos, Franchouchou may realize being dead is the least of their worries—but at least the legendary Tae Yamada gets even more legendary!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Zombieland Saga Revenge is mixed, with some praising its character development, music, and emotional depth, while others criticize its meandering plot, declining animation quality, and lack of innovation compared to the first season. Some viewers found the season disappointing and generic, while others enjoyed the continuation of the story and the resolution of existing plotlines. The season's departure from the original's charm and focus on darker themes polarized viewers.
pros: Great character development, building upon established characters from season 1.
Music and performances are well done, with improved animation compared to season 1.
Successfully resolves foreshadowing and lore from season 1, providing satisfying payoffs.
Balances humor with genuine serious issues, creating emotional depth.
cons: Season 2 meanders and loses structure, with episodes lacking stakes and compelling characterization.
Animation quality has declined compared to the first season.
Fails to answer questions presented in the first season and lacks character development.
Some found the season too safe and repetitive, lacking the heart and soul of season 1.

anime.title: Jurassic!
anime.synopsis: Toei Animation announced a new short anime on Friday titled "Jurassic!" that will debut streaming on YouTube in mid-August. Most of the staff for the anime are comprised of the younger staff at Toei Animation. The anime is also the first in a series of new projects for the studio featuring the younger staff. The Real-Size Koseibutsu Zukan (Real-Size Extinct Creatures Picture Book) book by Ken Tsuchiya is inspiring the anime, and Tsuchiya is serving as the anime's "extinct creatures supervisor."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys this short anime, praising its visuals and efficient storytelling within the limited timeframe. Viewers appreciate the nostalgic and imaginative elements, with some expressing hope for a longer adaptation. The main drawback is the extremely short length, which restricts deeper narrative exploration.
pros: Beautifully animated visuals and nice music.
Time-efficient and conveys a story despite the 1-minute length.
Highlights the director's vision and potential.
cons: Extremely short length limits story development.
Not a lot of depth beyond the surface level premise.

anime.title: Kandagawa Jet Girls
anime.synopsis:
On the vivid and glistening waters of the Kanda River, Jetters and their respective Shooters race together on their jet skis, speeding through the wind as they participate in Jet Races—"the world's most intense aquatic sport!"

Chasing her dream of becoming a professional Jet Racer like her mother, Rin Namiki transfers to Asakusa Girls' High School in Tokyo. There, she stumbles upon Misa Aoi, a first-year student like her. However, tensions arise when Rin and Misa find themselves competing in a race against Team Dress from the prestigious Musashino Girls' High School.

As a result of the race, Rin tries to join her school's Jet Racing club, only to discover that there is none. But, her resolve is unshaken, and she decides to recruit Misa and three other girls to create her very own team: "Kandagawa Jet Girls." With her heart set on winning the annual Kandagawa Cup, Rin, alongside her team, approaches the grandest stage of them all.
anime.consensus_summary: Kandagawa Jet Girls is a divisive anime. Some viewers appreciate the focus on cute character interactions, yuri undertones, and fanservice, while others find the plot weak, the races repetitive, and the animation mediocre. The show seems to appeal more to fans of the 'cute girls doing cute things' genre with ecchi elements than to those seeking a compelling sports narrative.
pros: Wholesome and cute character interactions
Enjoyable fanservice for those interested
Strong focus on character relationships
cons: Weak plot and story development
Repetitive and uninspired races
Bland and underdeveloped rival characters
Mediocre animation, especially in racing sequences

anime.title: Days of Urashimasakatasen
anime.synopsis: The anime centers on the members of the real-world four-member male vocal unit Urashimasakatasen. Uratanuki, Shima, Tonari no Sakata, and Senra appear in the shorts as high school students.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with enjoyment heavily tied to prior knowledge and appreciation of the band Urashimasakatasen. Fans of the band tend to enjoy the anime's humor and character portrayals, while others may find the humor lacking and the characters underdeveloped. The short episode format leads to a fast-paced, sometimes forced, delivery of content.
pros: Appealing visuals
Good opening song
Episodic storylines with surprising elements
Memorable characters despite limited development
Enjoyable for fans of the band Urashimasakatasen
cons: Story mainly focused on jokes
Characters not well-developed
Humor may not appeal to everyone
Content feels forced due to short episode length

anime.title: I Like Ducks
anime.synopsis: One sunny afternoon, a middle-aged man goes on a walk to feed some ducks.
anime.consensus_summary: The single review available expresses a personal and reflective experience tied to the short film. The reviewer connects simple elements like 'ducks' to wider life questions, which may not be universally appreciated. Overall, the response seems more introspective than outwardly critical or praising of the film itself.
pros: Colorful cartoon style is visually appealing.
cons: The review is abstract and potentially confusing.

anime.title: Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front - Babylonia Initium Iter
anime.romaji_title: Fate/Grand Order: Zettai Majuu Sensen Babylonia - Initium Iter
anime.synopsis: The year 2010 AD. Romani Archaman has been posted to Chaldea. There, he becomes the primary doctor for a young girl. Mash Kyrielight, Chaldea's second successful summoning experiment, is interested in the word "Senpai." The interaction between the two gives Mash a reason to hope. That hope becomes a wave and starts to spread. That is your story, the story of a normal "somebody." The story at the beginning of a journey that weaves the future.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive, particularly those already invested in the Fate/Grand Order mobile game. They appreciate the animation quality and expanded backstory, but acknowledge it's not easily accessible to newcomers. Some viewers express concern over character depth and exposition.
pros: Beautiful animation and visuals.
Well-made storytelling, especially regarding Roman and Mash's backstory.
Good recap of previous singularities for Fate/GO fans.
cons: Inaccessible to viewers unfamiliar with Fate/Grand Order.
Over-reliance on exposition.
Character depth issues, particularly outside of main characters.

anime.title: The Legend of Hei
anime.synopsis:
Luo Xiaohei is a young monster who normally takes the form of a small black cat. Living freely in the forests, gradual deforestation and human development force him to flee and find a new home. Wandering the city streets, the black cat struggles to survive until he encounters Feng Xi, a fellow monster who takes Xiaohei to an isolated island inhabited by a small group of monsters. Excited to find what he thinks is his new home, Xiaohei lives with the monsters for only a short time before Wuxian, a human Guild Executor, arrives on the island in pursuit of Feng Xi.

Feng Xi and his companions manage to teleport off the island, leaving Xiaohei and Wuxian alone. Though Xiaohei refuses to cooperate with the man who attacked his friends, Wuxian forces the black cat to travel to the Guild along with him. Embarking on an uncertain journey, Xiaohei is exposed to a new perspective on the relations between humans and monsters in a rapidly changing world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves Luo Xiaohei Zhanji for its beautiful animation, heartwarming story, and well-developed characters. Some find the plot vague and the pacing uneven. Overall, the movie evokes a warm, fuzzy feeling reminiscent of Ghibli films.
pros: Stunning animation and art style, blending traditional and modern techniques.
Exceptional character development, with lovable and relatable characters.
Deeply moving narrative exploring themes of humanity, nature, and coexistence.
cons: Story can be vague and doesn't fully resolve plot points, feeling like an unfulfilling prequel.
Pacing issues with exposition-heavy moments.
Some side characters needed more development.

anime.title: Aggretsuko (ONA) 3rd Season
anime.synopsis:
After an emotional breakup with her boyfriend, red panda Retsuko closes herself off to the thought of ever being in love again—well, with an actual person anyway. Retreating into the world of VR, her virtual boyfriend showers her with praise and shows up in cute outfits, albeit for a price.

While scrambling to find other ways to earn money, Retsuko finds herself in yet another financial bind after accidentally ramming into a parked van with a rental vehicle. The owner of the van, a gruff cheetah named Hyoudou, recruits her as an accountant for an underground idol group which he manages. Retsuko soon begins to buckle under the pressure from the new job, leading to plenty of inspiration for her next death metal vent sessions.

In the midst of it all, Retsuko begins to wonder if she truly desires a colorless and uninteresting life, or if there's something waiting beyond her office desk. Will Retsuko finally come out on top, both in love and in the workplace? Or will she once again be convinced that the dull and sterile life in her office environment is the one she must lead?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Aggretsuko Season 3 is mixed. While some appreciate the new direction with the idol group storyline and character development, others find Retsuko's character irritating and the ending unsatisfying due to a perceived 'soft reset'. There is a notable divide between viewers who enjoyed the thematic shift and those who preferred the original workplace focus.
pros: Unexpected fun twist with the idol group subplot.
Character growth for Haida and Fenneko.
Relatable exploration of adult life and its challenges.
Good story and message with the typical art style.
cons: Retsuko's character becomes irritating and overly dependent for some viewers.
The idol group arc feels like a departure from the original workplace comedy.
Soft reset at the end negates character growth and feels infuriating.
Some found the new characters dull and unnecessary.
anime.thematic_vibe: Workplace Struggles, Identity Crisis, Idol Culture

anime.title: Tower of God
anime.synopsis:
There is a tower that summons chosen people called "Regulars" with the promise of granting their deepest desires. Whether it be wealth, fame, authority, or something that surpasses them all—everything awaits those who reach the top.

Twenty-Fifth Bam is a boy who had only known a dark cave, a dirty cloth, and an unreachable light his entire life. So when a girl named Rachel came to him through the light, his entire world changed. Becoming close friends with Rachel, he learned various things about the outside world from her. But when Rachel says she must leave him to climb the Tower, his world shatters around him. Vowing to follow after her no matter what it takes, he sets his sight on the tower, and a miracle occurs.

Thus begins the journey of Bam, a young boy who was not chosen by the Tower but opened its gates by himself. They call his kind "Irregulars"—beings that have shaken the very foundation of the Tower each time they set foot inside it.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Tower of God garnered mixed reactions. While praised for its world-building, unique concept and diverse characters, it was heavily criticized for its rushed pacing, confusing plot, and underwhelming animation. Many felt the adaptation failed to live up to the source material's potential, leading to disappointment among webtoon fans and anime-only viewers alike.
pros: Intriguing world-building and lore.
Diverse and fun set of characters.
Catchy opening and ending themes.
Good potential as a webtoon adaptation.
cons: Rushed pacing and cut content.
Poorly explained concepts and confusing plot.
Underwhelming and lazy animation.
Forgettable main character with weak motivations.
Inconsistent world-building with mixed elements.

anime.title: Bananya and the Curious Bunch
anime.synopsis: On a little planet live little creatures called "Bananyas." Come watch their daily lifes full of adventures and discoveries.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Bananya for its cute and unique premise, though some find the story confusing and the characters lacking depth. The show's ambition and exploration of deeper themes are appreciated by some viewers. It's considered a lighthearted and enjoyable anime for casual viewing.
pros: Unique and refreshing story
Gorgeous pastel art with a soothing effect
Ambitious storytelling with deeper themes
Humorous and fluffy characters
cons: Story can be confusing
Characters lack complex personalities
Simple art and sound design

anime.title: The Case Files of Jeweler Richard
anime.synopsis:
Possessing a deep knowledge of mineralogy, Richard Ranasinghe de Vulpian is a young and handsome British jewelry appraiser who owns a small shop in Japan. One fateful night, Seigi Nakata, a righteous college student, saves him from drunks who were harassing him due to his good looks. Upon learning of Richard's identity, Seigi hires him to appraise a pink sapphire ring that was left behind by his deceased grandmother.

Before long, Seigi becomes a trusted part-timer at Richard's shop. Together, the duo solve various jewel-related requests from diverse clients of different backgrounds. Step by step, they unravel the hidden motives and feelings that lie within the gems in order to understand and empathize with the little stories behind each piece of jewelry.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience generally enjoyed 'Housekishou Richard-shi no Nazo Kantei' as a relaxing and heartwarming slice-of-life anime with intriguing stories and beautiful visuals. While some appreciated the ambiguous relationship between the main characters, others felt it leaned towards queerbaiting. Criticisms also include pacing issues and a lack of emotional depth in the earlier episodes, but the series is considered a worthwhile watch for those seeking a gentle and thought-provoking experience.
pros: Soothing art style and animation.
Calming music and excellent voice acting.
Intriguing stories centered around gems and their connection to people's lives.
Exploration of themes like love, relationships, and self-worth.
The characters are likeable, and their friendship is unwavering.
cons: Episodic format with disconnects between some episodes.
Pacing issues due to cutting content from the source material.
Potential for queerbaiting due to the ambiguous relationship between the main characters.
Lack of emotional investment in the characters' stories.
The story felt bland.

anime.title: The Grand Lord
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis:
The Great Thousand World. It is a place where numerous planes intersect, a place where many clans live and a place where a group of lords assemble. The Heavenly Sovereigns appear one by one from the Lower Planes and they will all display a legend that others would desire as they pursue the road of being a ruler in this boundless world.

In the Endless Fire Territory that the Flame Emperor controls, thousands of fire blazes through the heavens.

Inside the Martial Realm, the power of the Martial Ancestor frightens the heaven and the earth.

At the West Heaven Temple, the might of the Emperor of a Hundred Battles is absolute.

In the Northern Desolate Hill, a place filled with thousands of graves, the Immortal Owner rules the world.

A boy from the Northern Spiritual Realm comes out, riding on a Nine Netherworld Bird, as he charges into the brilliant and diverse world. Just who can rule over their destiny of their path on becoming a Great Ruler? In the Great Thousand World, many strive to become a Great Ruler.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is split on Da Zhuzai. Some viewers praise the story, animation, and sound, while others criticize the deviation from the source material, lackluster characters, and skipped content. The lack of a second season is a common point of disappointment. Overall, the show seems to have potential but falls short in certain aspects, leading to a mixed reception.
pros: Amazing story
Entertaining characters
High quality scenes
Decent animation and sound
cons: Lack of season 2
Characters are lackluster
Story deviates from the source material
Skipped content

anime.title: Balala the Fairies: Ocean Magic
anime.romaji_title: Balala Xiao Mo Xian: Mofa Hai Ying Bao
anime.synopsis: In the magical underwater world, there is a mysterious and charming place called Hai Ying Bao. When human girls Ling Haijun and Xia Fan accidentally met the Princess of the Icy Blue City, Nahiya, they transform from ordinary girls into magic fairies.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Balala Xiao Mo Xian: Mofa Hai Ying Bao' as a lighthearted magical girl series, appreciating its cute designs and evolving characters. However, some find the story inconsistent and the sound effects repetitive. Overall, it is considered a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre despite its flaws.
pros: Adorable wand designs and costumes
Gorgeous backgrounds
Fun single-episode arcs meshing well with overarching plot
Characters evolve and grow
cons: Inconsistent and not very well-paced story
Generic music
Limited and repetitive sound effects
Awkward attack sequences and action scenes

anime.title: Cannon Busters
anime.synopsis: Follow the adventures and exploits of S.A.M, a high-end, royal-class friendship droid who's joined by a quirky, discarded maintenance robot and a brash, deadly fugitive. Together, the unlikely trio embarks on an unforgettable journey in a fantastic and dangerous world in search of S.A.M's best friend, the heir to a powerful kingdom under siege.
anime.consensus_summary: Cannon Busters is a visually appealing anime with a diverse cast and enjoyable soundtrack, but it suffers from a weak and inconsistent story. Many appreciate the episodic adventures and unique character designs, while others criticize the reliance on clichés and lack of character development.
