cons: Inconsistencies in plot and character development.
Unnecessary gore and dramatic scenes.
Poor explanation of key concepts like Incarnation.
Rushed scenes and illogical incidents.

anime.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.: Reawakened
anime.genres: Comedy, Gag Humor, School, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Kusuo Saiki is a high school student who possesses a wide range of psychic abilities. While many may believe these abilities to be a gift, to Kusuo, they are a curse as he must fight strange odds in order to try to live a normal life. Forced to use his psychic powers to protect his secret or to make up for his father's incompetence at work, will Saiki eventually come to realize how his powers can actually help his friends and family?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the season to be a satisfying and funny addition, praising the new characters and the ending. However, many felt it was unnecessary, with weaker writing, rushed pacing, and inconsistent animation compared to previous seasons, leading to disappointment.
pros: Fresh comedy and jokes fitting the situations
Enjoyable new characters added
Satisfying ending and closure to the series
Good use of recurring jokes and characters
More focus on lesser seen characters
cons: Uneven quality compared to previous seasons
Filler episodes and anachronistic placement
Rushed episodes and lack of story coherence
Inconsistent animation and different feel
New English cast not as good as original
Short season length

anime.title: Assault Lily: Bouquet
anime.synopsis:
Fifty years ago, mysterious creatures known as the "Huge" suddenly appeared all over the world, posing an existential threat to humanity. To defend against these menaces, soldiers in the form of teenage girls known as "Lilies" use the energy "Magie" within their bodies to power weapons called "Counter Huge ARMS" or "CHARMS."

After being saved by a Lily two years ago while evacuating from a Huge attack, Riri Hitotsuyanagi vowed to become a Lily herself. She enrolls in the prestigious academy of Yurigaoka, a training ground for Lilies, and discovers that one of her classmates is Yuyu Shirai—the same Lily who rescued her. Much to her confusion, however, the person she thought to be cheerful turns out to be quite antisocial and prefers to fight alone. Even so, Riri still desires to get along with Yuyu and is willing to do anything she can to reach that goal. 

With Yuyu and the other Lilies by her side, Riri's journey on becoming one of them has just bloomed!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding enjoyment in the characters, action, and aesthetics, but others are critical of the plot's complexity and underdeveloped elements. It's seen as a fun but flawed series, with many acknowledging its purpose as promotion for a toy line and upcoming game. The series is considered better than average by some, but not without its share of detractors.
pros: Great visuals and animation, especially during action sequences.
Enjoyable characters with distinct personalities and good interactions.
Excellent opening and ending songs, with a generally strong soundtrack.
cons: Overwhelming number of characters with insufficient development.
Messy plot with too much information crammed into a short space, leading to confusion.
Noticeable CGI that detracts from the overall visual experience.

anime.title: Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru: Shichikon no Ryuujinmaru
anime.romaji_title: Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru: Shichikon no Ryuujinmaru
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Fans appreciate the heartwarming story, fun characters, and good animation, especially given its availability for free. Some find the toy advertisement aspect and shortened episodes a minor drawback, but overall, it is considered a charming and enjoyable mecha anime for kids.
pros: Fun characters
Good animation segments
Simple but okay story
Free and subbed on Youtube
cons: Overly overt toy advertisement
Shortened episodes

anime.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina
anime.synopsis:
Since childhood, Elaina has always been fascinated by the stories written within her favorite book, especially those about Nike, a renowned witch who had numerous great travels across the world. Wanting to experience the awe of adventure herself, Elaina strives to become a witch, and despite the numerous trials that come her way, she eventually succeeds.

Now a full-fledged witch, Elaina finally embarks on her long-awaited journey, in which she meets many people along the way, learning their various stories. Through all of this, she explores the world at its fullest—experiencing both its bright and dark sides—starting her legendary tale.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are heavily divided on Elaina's character, with some appreciating her morally ambiguous nature and others finding her unlikeable and narcissistic. The episodic storytelling is praised for its unique concepts but criticized for its inconsistent pacing and lack of overall plot cohesion. The visuals and animation are generally well-received, but the series struggles with character development and emotional impact, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Beautiful visuals and animation, particularly backgrounds.
Unique episodic storytelling with diverse concepts.
Elaina as a morally gray and unconventional protagonist.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and abrupt time skips.
Lack of character development for Elaina and side characters.
Episodic nature prevents deeper plot cohesion.

anime.title: Lupin III: Prison of the Past
anime.romaji_title: Lupin III: Prison of the Past
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Comedy, Mystery, Seinen
anime.synopsis: The episode focuses on Lupin's gang descending upon the Kingdom of Dorrente in order to rescue a famous thief who has been detained. While this takes place, the most notorious thieves from around the world gather in the kingdom.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the nostalgic elements, modern art style, and soundtrack, while others criticize the altered theme song, inconsistent animation, and unoriginal plot. There's a divergence in opinion regarding the humor and action, with some finding it unfitting for the Lupin III series.
pros: Appreciation for the Red Jacket Lupin
Enjoyment of the art style, modern and crisp
Love for the Lupin III soundtrack, especially remastered vocal versions
Fun and nostalgic feel
cons: Inconsistent animation quality
Dislike of the altered Lupin III theme song and vocals
Cartoon-like comedy and action not fitting Lupin III's style
Lame and unoriginal plot
Stilted and stiff voice acting outside of the main cast in the dub

anime.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
anime.romaji_title: Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level Max ni Nattemashita
anime.synopsis:
In role-playing games, slimes are usually the easiest monster to kill, and because of that, they yield few experience points. But what would happen if you live long enough to keep defeating them for 300 years?

After many years of being a corporate slave, Azusa Aizawa abruptly passes away due to severe exhaustion. Seemingly headed for the afterlife, she meets a goddess who bestows her with immortality alongside a peaceful life in another world. There, Azusa enjoys her days tending to her farm, protecting the nearby village, and killing about 25 slimes per day—a routine that continues for at least three centuries.

However, this rather monotonous cycle begins to change when Azusa suddenly finds out that she has reached level 99—the maximum possible level—from slimes alone. Despite desperately trying to hide this fact in fear of ending her slow life, rumors of her strength spread nevertheless. Soon enough, various people throughout the continent, like the dragon Laika and the elf Halkara, start to appear at her doorstep—some seeking a battle, others asking for her assistance. Meeting friends and acquaintances who soon become family, Azusa finds she can live a life far better with others than when she was alone.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received as a relaxing and wholesome slice-of-life show set in a fantasy world. However, some viewers find the lack of plot and character development to be a significant drawback. The series is best enjoyed by those seeking a low-stakes and feel-good experience, rather than a complex or action-packed narrative.
pros: The anime is relaxing and easy to watch, providing a breather from more intense shows.
The art and animation are generally well-executed, with a cute and appealing style.
The voice acting and sound design are praised, particularly the use of voiced sound effects.
cons: The story lacks depth and meaningful conflict, making it feel pointless to some viewers.
The characters are often one-dimensional and lack significant development.
The isekai aspect is largely irrelevant to the plot.

anime.title: Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth
anime.synopsis: After the events of Mask of Deception, the Yamato Empire is now ruled with an iron fist by a ruthless usurper who seeks to subjugate all before him. It's up to a couple of familiar faces to band together against the might of the Imperial army, and the fate of the world hangs in the balance as nations and generals must pick a side to fight with in this perilous civil war. Secrets will be revealed, friendships will be tested, and battles will be fought. Will peace and order be restored or will victory at any cost be the beginning of the end?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with many viewers comparing the anime to the original visual novel. While praised for being a faithful adaptation and maintaining the core storyline, some feel the anime suffers from rushed pacing and cut content, diminishing the emotional impact. The series is considered a worthwhile watch, especially for those familiar with the Utawarerumono universe, but falls short of the source material for some fans.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material.
Good voice acting and animation.
Successfully conveys the core story from the VN.
cons: CGI is poorly executed.
Pacing is rushed due to content cuts, impacting character connection and build-up.
Doesn't reach the emotional impact of the original VN for some viewers.

anime.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War?
anime.romaji_title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai? Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunousen
anime.synopsis:
After a slow but eventful summer vacation, Shuchiin Academy's second term is now starting in full force. As August transitions into September, Miyuki Shirogane's birthday looms ever closer, leaving Kaguya Shinomiya in a serious predicament as to how to celebrate it. Furthermore, the tenure of the school's 67th student council is coming to an end. Due to the council members being in different classes, the only time Kaguya and Miyuki have to be together will soon disappear, putting all of their cunning plans at risk.

A long and difficult election that will decide the fate of the new student council awaits, as multiple challengers fight for the coveted title of president.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is generally positive, with many considering season 2 an improvement over the first. Viewers praise the character development and humor, with a special emphasis on Ishigami's arc. Criticisms are directed at pacing, repetitive jokes, and inconsistent art, showing that although highly favored, some viewers express disappointment with some aspects of season 2.
pros: Improved character development, especially Ishigami's arc.
Humor remains strong, with addition of serious moments.
Well-executed adaptation of source material.
Characters are colorful and engaging.
High production quality, with improvements over season 1.
cons: Inconsistent art style, with fluctuating quality.
Repetitive jokes and reliance on tropes.
Pacing issues in later episodes, with a weak climax.
Some find the humor shallow and artistically lifeless.
Lack of focus on the central romantic relationship in later episodes for some viewers.

anime.title: Suppose a Kid from the Last Dungeon Boonies Moved to a Starter Town?
anime.romaji_title: Tatoeba Last Dungeon Mae no Mura no Shounen ga Joban no Machi de Kurasu Youna Monogatari
anime.synopsis:
A long time ago, the ancient saviors of humanity founded a village as their haven, with their descendants said to assist humanity in times of extreme chaos. This village, Kunlun, is located just beside the infamous "Last Dungeon"—a place where monsters of unimaginable strength reside and which serves as the hunting grounds for Kunlun residents.

Despite being accustomed to defeating powerful enemies since childhood, Lloyd Belladonna regards himself as the weakest in his village in terms of magic, strength, and intelligence. Even so, to fulfill his desire of becoming a soldier, he goes to the Kingdom of Azami to enroll in its military academy. However, as someone whose upbringing defies common sense, Lloyd's innate power might just prove to be the key to end the crises enveloping the kingdom!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the show enjoyable for its comedic and lighthearted nature, while others criticize its reliance on overused tropes, weak plot, and uninspired characters. The humor is divisive, with some finding it funny and others finding it repetitive and annoying. Ultimately, the show is seen as a mediocre and forgettable entry in the fantasy genre, with wasted potential.
pros: Enjoyable and light atmosphere
Fun and unique characters
Good use of comedy and banter
Decent animation
cons: Overused tropes
Repetitive jokes
Weak plot
One-dimensional characters
Annoying MC
Poorly written female characters
Rushed pacing

anime.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World
anime.romaji_title: Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjou, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen
anime.synopsis:
A force known as Astral power permeates throughout the world, wielded by astral mages. Fearing its destructive power, the "Empire" persecutes those who show their abilities. The tormented mages then founded the Nebulis Sovereignty to flee from their oppressors. Since then, the two nations have been in bitter conflict, the war still going strong for more than a century.

After committing the great crime of freeing an imprisoned witch, the talented knight Iska is sentenced to prison. A year later, the Empire leadership suddenly decides to set him free, with the condition that he hunts down a fearsome mage known as the "Ice Calamity Witch." Hoping to end the war, Iska agrees. Coincidentally, the Ice Calamity Witch herself, Aliceliese "Alice" Lou Nebulis XI, also wishes for peace and is willing to do everything she can to bring down the Empire.

As Iska and Alice both yearn for a crusade that will turn the world into one without struggle, woe, or pain, the strings of fate tie them ever closer together, creating a bond that goes beyond something fabricated by mere coincidence.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is mixed, with some finding it an enjoyable, light watch due to its art and familiar romance themes. However, many criticize the show for its generic plot, poor character development, and heavy reliance on clichés. The series is considered average, with potential, but ultimately falls short due to writing and pacing issues, leaving viewers feeling unsatisfied.
pros: Good art and animation, especially Alice's design and the magical effects.
Enjoyable as a light, fun watch with fan service.
Interesting world-building and unique twist on the forbidden love trope.
cons: Generic and clichéd plot, lacking originality.
Poor character development and one-dimensional supporting cast.
Predictable story with heavy reliance on coincidences.
Incomplete feeling, with the romance not fully developed and unsatisfying ending.
Pacing issues and leaps in logic.
Lack of background information and justification for events.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romeo and Juliet, War and Peace, Magic vs. Technology

anime.title: 7 Seeds 2nd Season
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Shoujo, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Second season of 7 Seeds.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of 7 Seeds is widely seen as a significant improvement over the first, particularly in terms of character development and narrative focus. While the animation quality remains a point of contention for some, the story and character arcs have garnered strong praise, leading to a generally positive reception. Many viewers feel it has much more potential and are hopeful for future seasons, despite some lingering issues with pacing and animation consistency.
pros: Significant character development and growth, especially for previously underdeveloped characters.
Improved pacing and focus compared to the first season, leading to a more engaging narrative.
Interesting and intriguing storyline that keeps viewers invested.
Exploration of character backstories and internal struggles enhances emotional depth.
Art and backgrounds are often praised for their quality and atmosphere.
cons: Animation quality can be inconsistent, with some blurry, clunky, or choppy scenes.
Issues with scale and distance can make it hard to track character movement and plot progression.
Pacing can still feel slow or dragged out for some viewers, particularly in specific plot segments like the ship.
The story relies heavily on the first season, making it less accessible as a standalone.
Some character voice acting is noted as annoying or fake.

anime.title: Muv-Luv Alternative
anime.synopsis:
The world has been engulfed in a desperate, three-decade-long war against the BETA—an alien species that invaded the planet in 1973. Amid this chaos, a high school student named Takeru Shirogane suddenly wakes up from a terrifying nightmare where he sees mankind in utter defeat. Soon after, he realizes that his dream was nothing more than the recollections of his life in an alternative universe. In those memories, the Alternative V project is implemented, sending hundreds of thousands of people into space as a last resort to preserve humanity, while leaving the remaining billion on Earth to suffer a cruel fate.

Yearning to change this grim future, Takeru joins a military base in Yokohama, which happens to be his former high school. There, he manages to convince the base's vice-commander and leader of the Alternative IV project, Professor Yuuko Kouzuki, to prevent Alternative V from happening. To ensure the success of Alternative IV, Takeru must pilot the gigantic humanoid machines Tactical Surface Fighters (TSF) alongside his fellow cadets. However, he has only two months to complete his training and exploit his partial knowledge of the future—lest the ensuing tragedy take place.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is sharply divided, especially between VN readers and anime-only viewers. VN fans are critical of the adaptation's rushed pacing, skipped content, and subpar animation, while some appreciate the attempt to animate the story. Anime-only viewers find the series confusing and underwhelming due to the lack of context and character development. Ultimately, the adaptation is seen as failing to capture the essence of the source material, leading to disappointment and frustration among fans.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the VN's later scenes, enhancing the drama.
Well-done mech parts and battles, especially in the second half.
Awesome opening song.
Good pacing compared to the VN.
Showcases mankind's hopeless war against the BETA.
cons: Rushed pacing, especially in the beginning, skipping character interactions and setup.
Poor animation quality, with inconsistent character designs and lazy drawing.
Fails to explain core concepts.
Mediocre voice acting and sound design.
Weak characters with minimal development, making it hard to care about them.

anime.title: Healin' Good Pretty Cure
anime.synopsis:
Sickly but optimistic middle school student Nodoka Hanadera has just moved to Sukoyaka City, a place famous for its healthy atmosphere. She immediately befriends two of her classmates: the gentle but athletic Chiyu Sawaizumi, whose family runs a hot spring inn, and the bubbly and fashionable daughter of a vet, Hinata Hiramitsu.

Soon after arriving, Nodoka finds an ill puppy in a forest, surrounded by three magical talking animals: Rabbirin, Penguitan, and Nyatoran. They tell her that the puppy, Princess Latte, can only be cured by defeating a nearby monster known as a "Mega Byogen" and purifying the land it has corrupted. Despite being powerless, Nodoka refuses to give up and let Latte suffer. 

Moved by her determination, Rabbirin forms a pact with Nodoka, allowing her to transform into a hero known as a Precure. Assuming the persona of  "Cure Grace," the energized Nodoka fights off the Byogen and heals the earth, curing Latte.

As the Byogen and their leaders continue their attacks, Penguitan and Nyatoran also find their partners in Chiyu and Hinata, giving them the powers of "Cure Fontaine" and "Cure Sparkle" respectively. Now, it's up to the three Precure and their animal friends to stop the Byogen and protect the earth from their infections!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Healin' Good♡Precure is well-received, particularly for its thematic resonance with real-world events and focus on healing. While some critique the animation and character development as generic, others praise the show's consistency, engaging storyline, and positive messages, leading to a generally positive audience sentiment.
pros: Excellent and in-depth characters
Colorful and eye-catching animation
Story with great psychological messages
Consistent narrative from start to finish
Engaging start, interesting mid-story arcs and satisfying conclusion
Explains Nodoka's mysterious sickness
cons: Animation quality appears amateurish at times
Inconsistencies in hiding magical animals from regular humans
Characters can be a bit generic
Some found the second ending theme to be a downgrade

anime.title: The Stranger by the Shore
anime.synopsis:
Shun Hashimoto is an openly gay aspiring novelist living in Okinawa who was abandoned by his parents after coming out to them. Mio Chibana is a reserved, orphaned high school student, often found spending his time by the sea. One day, the two meet on the beach, and Shun is instantly captivated by Mio. The days fly by as they slowly begin to grow closer until Mio suddenly announces that he has to leave for the mainland.

Three years pass before a 20-year-old Mio returns to Okinawa to confess his love to Shun. However, in those three years, Shun's life has changed. Will he be able to accept Mio's feelings and make such a commitment?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with manga readers generally more satisfied than anime-only viewers. Many appreciate the film's visuals and respectful representation of queer themes, finding it heartwarming and emotionally resonant. However, some criticize the rushed pacing and lack of coherence, especially for those unfamiliar with the source material, leading to a mixed reception overall.
pros: Gorgeous visuals and animation, especially the backgrounds.
Realistic and respectful portrayal of LGBTQ+ themes and characters.
Heartwarming and tender story with good character development.
cons: Story feels rushed and incoherent for viewers unfamiliar with the manga.
Relationships and plot points are not fully fleshed out.
Some find the story unrealistic despite its lack of toxic elements.

anime.title: Life Lessons with Uramichi-Oniisan
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Showbiz, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
In the studio of the morning childrens' show "Together with Mama," a crew of miserable adults prepares their facades of amicable smiles and cheerful exteriors to educate a group of innocent preschoolers. In the middle of it stands Uramichi Omota, a former gymnast who can't help but bring the kids down to earth by revealing the harsh and depressing reality of adulthood, even in front of the rolling cameras.

Behind the scenes, Uramichi's much-desired peace is disturbed by his two bothersome juniors who work as the show's rabbit and bear mascots and singers: Utano Tadano, a woman who only wishes to get married; and Iketeru Daga, a handsome man with a crass sense of humor. From smoking and exercising to nihilistic outbursts, everyone's big brother Uramichi always brings up the not-so-moral side to his life lessons.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Uramichi Oniisan for its relatable depiction of adult struggles and dark humor, finding it particularly resonant with those experiencing similar disillusionment. While the voice acting and character interactions are praised, some find the humor repetitive and the plot lacking depth. The show's ability to connect with viewers on an emotional level, despite its comedic presentation, is a key factor in its appeal.
pros: Relatable portrayal of adult struggles and disillusionment with dark humor.
Strong voice acting performances by a well-known cast enhance character depth.
Effective use of 'expectation vs. reality' trope to highlight the contrast between public facade and private struggles.
cons: Repetitive humor and reliance on the same cynical jokes can become stale.
Limited character development and a lack of significant plot progression.
Simple animation style and production values may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Wings of the World
anime.synopsis:
1663 Common Era, the youngest leader of the Ming dynasty's navy Lu Changfeng is to escort an official to capture criminals but was attacked by a ghost fleet and sea beasts, causing the entire envoy to be sunk. Lu Changfeng was saved by a mysterious girl from the ocean bottom and followed her to the international center of commerce of the Age of Sail: Luzon.

At the time, over 70% of the Ming dynasty's silver was obtained from Luzon, and this tiny island determined the fate of several nations. Spanish settlers cruelly ruled, and people of all walks of life, under the guidance of Song Yingxing, constructed the international finance center: the Kingdom of Wan. Despite disagreements with Song Yingxing, Lu Changfeng still chose to join Song's team: 天工, participating in the struggle against Spanish settlers with others. Both factions used bleeding-edge technological inventions in their battle. To resist the enemy genius Vesalius‘s weapon, Song Yingxing manipulates Lu Changfeng, bringing out his days fighting Vesalius in Korea, etc.
anime.consensus_summary: The show presents an intriguing world of inventors and international commerce during the Age of Sail. However, the complex narrative and potential translation issues may make it difficult for some viewers to fully grasp the story. It is recommended for those interested in original stories and unique characters, particularly if they are native Chinese speakers or possess strong logical thinking skills.
pros: Original characters and stories
Exotic sceneries
Enjoyable conversations (when translated properly)
cons: Difficult to understand the overall story
Potentially confusing plot for non-native Chinese speakers
Translation issues
anime.thematic_vibe: Technological Innovation, Historical Fiction, International Intrigue

anime.title: Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 2 Specials
anime.synopsis: Specials included with Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 2 Blu-ray and DVD.
anime.consensus_summary: The special provides an explanation of events prior to the film, focusing on the conflict between Ooarai and BC Freedom. The art and sound are well-received, but the plot may not align with expectations set by the poster. Overall it is a solid addition to the Girls & Panzer universe.
pros: Nice art style consistent with the movie.
Good sound design, especially the ending tune.
cons: The special is not related to Chi-Ha-Tan Academy despite the poster suggesting it.
The first part of the OVA is reminiscent of the French Revolution, which might not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear XV: Senki Zesshou Shinai Symphogear
anime.romaji_title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear XV: Senki Zesshou Shinai Symphogear
anime.synopsis: Original short episodes featuring characters in super-deformed style. Bundled with Blu-ray/DVD volumes 3 to 6 of the anime.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the short episodes to be a cute and charming supplement to the main Symphogear XV series. While not essential viewing or particularly groundbreaking, it offers more content for fans of the characters and provides some lighthearted entertainment. The lack of an overarching story and short runtime are minor drawbacks.
pros: Cute and charming art style
Provides more content for fans of the characters
Some segments are linked to the main plot
cons: Not groundbreaking or essential viewing
Lacks an overarching story
Short runtime

anime.title: Revue Starlight: The Movie
anime.synopsis:
With the arrival of a new generation of talented girls, another lively year at Seishou Music Academy begins. The graduating 99th class is already preparing for the much-anticipated rendition of Starlight, a bittersweet story about the parting of two girls.

It seems like all students in the Actor Training Department have their post-graduation future figured out—except for the cheerful Karen Aijou. Having fulfilled her promise of performing in a play with Hikari Kagura, her ambitious childhood friend, Karen struggles to find her purpose. What lies beyond their promise is a mystery to Karen, as Hikari was the fuel that kept her passion for performing aflame. Now alone, Karen must confront the reality of stage girls and find her way toward the future—her very own stage.
anime.consensus_summary: The Revue Starlight Movie is overwhelmingly praised as a visually stunning and emotionally resonant conclusion to the series. While some find the story and symbolism confusing, most agree that it's a masterpiece that enhances the original show's themes and character development. The movie is particularly lauded for its music, animation, and its poignant exploration of growing up and moving on.
pros: Beautiful visuals and animation
Catchy and unique soundtrack with perfect vocal performances
Creative and well-choreographed fight scenes
Deep exploration of character relationships and flaws
Satisfying conclusion to character arcs
Effective use of symbolism to convey themes
Emotional and resonant musical numbers
Addresses themes of acceptance, change, and letting go
Perfect mix of melancholic and spectacular elements
Expands upon and improves the original series
cons: Story can be cryptic and difficult to understand
Plot may feel abstract and open to interpretation
Ending may be unsatisfying or abrupt for some viewers
Uncompleted script/story
May require familiarity with the series to fully appreciate
Overreliance on symbolism can be confusing

anime.title: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight: Rondo Rondo Rondo
anime.romaji_title: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight: Rondo Rondo Rondo
anime.synopsis:
At the performing arts division of Seishou Music Academy, the ever-evolving stage threads the lives of its students together as they tirelessly hone their craft. Yet, as the girls prepare for a new rendition of the previous year's performance, the carefree Karen Aijou begins to settle for a smaller role. However, her waning passion is reignited by the return of her childhood friend Hikari Kagura, whose sudden transfer to the academy triggers a flurry of changes in the class dynamics.

Subsequently, Karen chances upon a secret battleground underneath the school, which houses a set of auditions that will crown its ultimate victor as "Top Star." As she dives headfirst into these enigmatic trials, Karen begins to learn about the tribulations that come with vying for the top. Even if fate wills them apart, Karen and Hikari must fight in hopes of fulfilling their childhood promise: to become stars together.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a well-made recap, serving as a refresher for fans of the original series, especially before watching the sequel. However, it's considered an inferior viewing option due to its abridged nature, which sacrifices character development and can feel disjointed. The new scenes are enjoyable but not essential.
pros: Refreshing experience for fans of the original series.
Excellent refresher on the events of the series, especially before watching the sequel.
Captivating editing and presentation.
cons: Inferior viewing option compared to the series, especially for character development.
Disjointed and confusing due to being pared down from the original series.
New scenes not essential watching.

anime.title: Argonavis from BanG Dream!
anime.synopsis:
Ren Nanahoshi has been chasing a certain thrill he once experienced at a live festival when he was a child. Now, as a first-year university student, he avoids making friends and practices singing by himself, hoping to find that adrenaline once more. A fateful encounter at a karaoke bar allows Nanahoshi to meet Yuuto Goryou and Wataru Matoba—both of whom are impressed by his voice. The two have been searching for band members, and they want Nanahoshi to be their vocalist.  

Nanahoshi initially rejects their constant pestering but relents after attending their live show and performing alongside them. Joined by the carefree Rio Kikyou and passionate Banri Shiroishi, the five boys form "Argonavis" and set their sights on headlining the Destiny Rock Festival. As they begin to work together as a band, they come across the trials and tribulations that come with pursuing stardom.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the music and character designs, but criticism for the rushed storyline and weak character development. Many feel the anime serves primarily as promotion for the game, hindering its stand-alone quality. While some viewers found it enjoyable and emotionally engaging, others struggled to connect with the characters and story due to pacing issues and a lack of depth.
pros: Strong and enjoyable music that connects with the story.
Expressive character designs and well-integrated 3D animation during performances.
Engaging storylines that allow for investment in characters.
cons: Rushed pacing in the story, particularly in the band's formation and song creation.
Weak character development, leading to a lack of emotional connection.
Reliance on coincidences and logical leaps that disrupt believability.
anime.thematic_vibe: Band Dynamics, Musical Aspirations, Overcoming Obstacles

anime.title: 2.43: Seiin High School Boys Volleyball Team
anime.synopsis:
Genius setter Kimichika Haijima moves back to Fukui from Tokyo after an incident within his school's volleyball team forces him out. There, he is reunited with his childhood friend, Yuni Kuroba, a member of the Monshiro Middle School Boys' Volleyball Team, who is unaware of his own talents. Haijima notices Kuroba's abilities and is determined to form a new volleyball team with Kuroba as the team's ace. At the prefectural tournament, Kuroba crumbles under the pressure, which causes the Monshiro team to fall apart after losing. The loss also creates a rift between Haijima and Kuroba, leading the former to quit the team.

Now, as students at Seiin High School, Haijima and Kuroba find themselves on the same volleyball team once again. Having learned from his past mistakes, Haijima helps Kuroba overcome his performance anxiety to become the ace and carry the team to the prefectural championship. With support from team captain Shinichirou Oda and vice captain Misao Aoki, Seiin aim to win the prefecturals and become Fukui's representatives at the Spring Tournament. To do this, they will need to beat Fukuho Technical High School, the reigning champions of Fukui. Will Haijima's team defeat the odds, or are they doomed to repeat his history of losing?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the character-driven narrative and emotional elements, while others criticize the rushed pacing, weak plot, and inconsistent animation. Many compare it unfavorably to other sports anime like Haikyuu!!. Overall, it's considered a mediocre sports anime with some redeeming qualities, but ultimately disappointing for many viewers.
pros: Good opening and ending themes.
Character development is a highlight for some viewers.
Attempts to explore personal struggles of athletes.
cons: Rushed pacing and underdeveloped plot.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Forgettable supporting characters.
Weak or cringey dialogue.
Character designs are bland or derivative.

anime.title: Kingdom Season 3
anime.synopsis:
Following the successful Sanyou campaign, the Qin army, including 1,000-Man Commander Xin, inches ever closer to fulfilling King Ying Zheng's dream of unifying China. With a major geographical foothold in the state of Wei now under its control, Qin sets its sights eastward toward the remaining warring states.

Meanwhile Li Mu—an unparalleled strategist and the newly appointed prime minister of the state of Zhao—has taken advantage of Zhao's temporary truce with Qin to negotiate with the other states without interruption. Seemingly without warning, Ying Zheng receives news that armies from the states of Chu, Zhao, Wei, Han, Yan, and Qi have crossed into Qin territory. Realizing too late the purpose behind Li Mu's truce with Qin, Zheng quickly gathers his advisors to devise a plan to address the six-state coalition army on their doorstep. For the first time in history, the state of Qin faces complete destruction and must use every resource and strategy at their disposal to prevent themselves from being wiped off the map.
anime.consensus_summary: Kingdom's third season is largely celebrated for its significant improvements in animation and its gripping adaptation of the Coalition Invasion arc. The intensified focus on strategic warfare and character development resonated strongly with many viewers, establishing it as a standout season. While some critiques regarding animation fidelity and adaptation accuracy exist, the overall sentiment leans towards high praise, marking it as a defining moment for the anime series.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to previous seasons, with less CGI.
Compelling storyline focused on the Coalition Invasion arc, praised for its intensity and strategic depth.
Well-developed characters with significant growth and impactful roles in the story.
Epic soundtrack enhances the emotional impact and tension of scenes.
cons: Some viewers found the animation quality to be subpar, especially when compared to the manga.
Adaptation may lack certain aspects compared to the original manga source material.
anime.thematic_vibe: War Epic, Historical Drama, Tactical Warfare

anime.title: Super Cub
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Koguma, a reserved second-year high school student, has nothing—no parents, hobbies, friends, or goals. On her way home one afternoon, she visits a vehicle shop in hopes of acquiring a motor scooter. With only enough money to make ends meet, she is disheartened by the price tags and prepares to turn back. However, as she is about to leave, the shop's owner offers her a pre-owned Honda Super Cub for ten thousand yen. Believing that the motorcycle will help brighten her monotonous world, she accepts the deal. As Koguma journeys through her town on small adventures with her Super Cub, she begins to build irreplaceable friendships and eagerly advances toward her new life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some finding Super Cub a peaceful and relatable slice-of-life anime about self-discovery and the joy of motorcycling. Others view it as a thinly veiled advertisement with underdeveloped characters and a simplistic plot. While some appreciate its relaxing atmosphere and emotional resonance, others are left feeling uninspired and critical of its lack of depth.
pros: Soothing and relaxing to watch, like a comforting bath.
Captures the feeling of freedom and self-discovery through motorcycling.
Relatable to those who have experienced personal growth and independence.
Effective at portraying a mundane life transformed by a simple hobby.
cons: Can be seen as a glorified Honda advertisement.
Plot is simple and may lack significant overarching story.
Characters can feel underdeveloped, with focus heavily on the scooter itself.
Some find the series insipid and uninspiring, lacking depth.

anime.title: The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls: Spin-off!
anime.synopsis: The Idolm@ster Cinderella Girls 8th anniversary special promotional film.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views the spin-off as a short, entertaining commercial for The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls. It is appreciated for its visual style, but its primary function as promotion is clear. There's little controversy, as viewers understand its purpose.
pros: Entertaining
Visually appealing
cons: Short length
Commercial nature

anime.title: Monster Girl Doctor
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Harem, Romance
anime.synopsis:
After years of conflict, humans and monsters have settled their differences and are now at peace. This post-war era led to the foundation of Lindworm—a town which has since become the focal point of racial harmony.

As a human doctor specializing in monster biology, Glenn Litbeit runs a small clinic alongside his partner, Saphentite Neikes, who is a half-snake monster known as a lamia. He uses his knowledge to tend to any monsters who seek his aid. Whatever affliction, concern, or injury it may be, he will always be there, ready to help.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided, with many appreciating the charming monster girl designs and unique premise, while others find the ecchi elements forced and the overall narrative lacking depth. Some enjoy the slice-of-life medical cases, while others are bored by the predictable formula and poor animation.
pros: Charming and likeable characters, particularly the monster girls.
Unique and interesting concept of a doctor specializing in monster biology.
Visually appealing character designs and vibrant world-building.
Genuine and well-intentioned protagonist who earns patient trust.
cons: Animation quality is inconsistent and can be static.
Story can be formulaic and predictable, relying on a 'monster girl of the week' format.
Ecchi elements are often perceived as forced, gratuitous, or awkward.
Lack of significant character depth beyond initial archetypes.

anime.title: Kakushigoto
anime.genres: Childcare, Comedy, Gag Humor, Otaku Culture, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Kakushi Gotou is a somewhat popular manga artist whose works are known for inappropriate content. Because of this raunchiness, when his daughter Hime was born, he vowed to keep his profession hidden from her, believing that she will be disillusioned if she finds out. 

This paranoia-induced belief leads Kakushi into hectic situations. Despite being a single father, he does his best and often resorts to extreme ends just to protect his secret, such as guising as a salaryman every day or holding emergency drills in case Hime somehow finds her way to his workplace.

Kakushigoto tells the story of a father and daughter living side by side, maintaining their peaceful existence as the father attempts to preserve the status quo. However, there is a saying: "there are no secrets that time cannot reveal." In time, Hime must learn the reality behind the things she took for granted as she grew up.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is generally well-received for its heartwarming and humorous depiction of a father-daughter relationship within the manga industry. Many appreciate the comedic elements and the overarching plot, though some critique the rushed ending and occasionally simplistic artwork. The show is considered a successful blend of slice-of-life comedy with moments of emotional depth.
pros: Heartwarming father-daughter relationship
Humorous portrayal of the manga industry
Intriguing overarching plot with foreshadowing
Memorable characters with good interactions
Effective mix of comedy and serious moments
cons: Rushed ending in the final episode
Artwork not up to 2020 standards
Father-daughter relationship portrayed as immature and tedious by some
Story can be a little bland at times

anime.title: Megalobox 2: Nomad
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Combat Sports, Sci-Fi, Sports
anime.synopsis:
Megalo Box is an advanced form of boxing where competitors wear metal frames called Gear. When the first ever Megalonia tournament took place, "Gearless" Joe became its champion and known to all as a legendary fighter. However, soon after, he lost an exhibition match against the second champion and vanished from the public eye.

Seven years later, Joe now goes by "Nomad" and keeps a low profile, occasionally fighting in a few underground matches to get by. He is haunted by hallucinations and relies on a set of painkillers to numb his mind.

During a match, Joe wins against an opponent, Chief, who purposefully loses for some extra cash from gamblers. Subsequently, Joe discovers that Chief is from a community of immigrants called the Casa. Chief is gradually trying to make enough money to purchase the land where they live illegally. At first, Joe hesitates to get involved, but eventually decides to lend the Casa a helping hand.
anime.consensus_summary: Nomad: Megalo Box 2 is largely praised as a mature and thought-provoking sequel that surpasses the original for many viewers. Its strength lies in its character development, thematic depth, and artistic presentation. While some find the reduced focus on boxing and certain plot decisions disappointing, the overall audience sentiment leans heavily towards regarding it as a masterpiece.
pros: Strong character development, especially for Joe/Nomad.
Meaningful exploration of themes like loss, identity, and community.
Excellent visuals, music, and overall aesthetic.
Engaging story that builds upon the first season without relying on it.
Addresses mature themes with nuance and depth.
cons: Some viewers found the lack of focus on boxing disappointing.
The ending was divisive for some viewers.
Early episodes can be slow-paced as they focus on character development.
Thematic elements can be a bit heavy-handed at times.
Some might find the noir feel a bit jarring compared to season 1.

anime.title: Heaven Official's Blessing
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Mythology
anime.synopsis:
The heavens shake, the thunder rumbles, and Xie Lian appears with an apologetic smile—again! Eight hundred years prior, he was a beloved martial god, known as the Crown Prince of Xianle. Now, he ascends to the heavenly realm for the third time, but simply as a pitiful scrap-collecting god with no followers behind him. 

On his first mission, Xie Lian finds himself alone in the dark moonlit night. There, a gentle man dressed in red guides him through the forest. However, as abruptly as he appeared, the man suddenly dissipates into a swarm of silver butterflies.

Xie Lian later learns that this mysterious stranger was none other than Hua Cheng, the Crimson Rain Sought Flower, a Ghost King feared by both demons and gods alike. But before Xie Lian can figure out why Hua Cheng would help a Heavenly Official like himself, he meets San Lang. A young man possessing great knowledge on not only the Ghost King, but also the now forgotten Crown Prince, San Lang decides to accompany Xie Lian on his journey of unveiling the mysteries of the past.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with many praising the animation, music, and characters, especially the central romantic relationship. However, many find the storyline confusing and the pacing inconsistent, leading to frustration. Some viewers feel the adaptation does not live up to the original novel.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style
Captivating characters and their interactions
Excellent music and soundtrack
cons: Confusing storyline and pacing issues
Weak character development
Poor translations and subtitles
Underwhelming character designs

anime.title: Rakshasa Street 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Zhen Hun Jie.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Zhen Hun Jie shows marked improvements in animation, plot, and emotional storytelling compared to the first season. However, it retains elements of chaos and emotional instability, potentially overwhelming new viewers. While the show benefits from a better-defined lore, pacing issues and reliance on past trauma may still detract from the experience.
pros: Improved animation quality
More coherent plot and world-building
Better fight choreography and emotional depth
cons: Overly chaotic and emotionally unstable
Reliance on trauma flashbacks
Inconsistent pacing

anime.title: Legend of Exorcism
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Mystery, Mythology
anime.synopsis:
Having lived his entire life on Mount Taiheng, half-yao Kong Hongjun is at last presented with the chance to explore the human world. He is assigned three tasks: uncover his father's murderer, eliminate the Black Jiao and its yao tribes that have infiltrated Chang'an, and return the Heart Lamp to a descendent of the Chen family. However, on his first night in the city, the Heart Lamp is mistakenly absorbed by military general Li Jinglong.

After receiving a mysterious invitation to join Chang'an's Court of Exorcism, Kong Hongjun is reunited with a disgraced Li Jinglong as his captain. Alongside a fellow yao, a noble from a foreign land, and a cowardly scholar, Kong Hongjun and Li Jinglong must work together to purge Chang'an of the yao lurking in its streets. In the meantime, Kong Hongjun also needs to hide his true identity from Li Jinglong who loathes yao—all while attempting to retrieve the Heart Lamp from his body.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Tianbao Fuyao Lu for its engaging story, beautiful animation, and unique blend of historical and fantasy elements. However, some viewers find the pacing inconsistent and the lore confusing, and the ending unsatisfying. Despite its flaws, it's still considered an enjoyable watch, especially for those who appreciate historical fantasy and beautiful animation.
pros: Good story blending family drama, coming of age, and imperial politics.
Outstanding art and animation quality, especially in action scenes.
Compelling atmosphere merging historical intrigue with fantasy.
cons: Inconsistent pacing with episodes feeling rushed or dragging.
Complex fantasy lore introduced without enough explanation, causing confusion.
Underused supporting characters.
Abrupt ending with little resolution.

anime.title: Natsunagu!
anime.synopsis:
After earthquakes suddenly took place in the Kumamoto Prefecture, Natsuna Keyaki lost contact with her dearest online friend, Itsuki. With nothing but a drawn picture of the landscape, Natsuna embarks on a journey from Tokyo to Kumamoto to find her.

When Natsuna gets lost in a rural area of the disaster-stricken prefecture, she encounters a policeman and an energetic middle school girl named Izumi Chiba. Izumi, along with her hospitable family members, offers Natsuna shelter and information to assist her in her quest. With these kind locals helping her on every step of the way, Natsuna moves closer to discover what happened to Itsuki.
anime.consensus_summary: Natsunagu! is viewed as a cute and simple anime with a heartwarming story and aesthetically pleasing art style. However, it suffers from a generic plot, rushed pacing, and underdeveloped characters. Many feel it primarily serves as a promotional piece for the Kumamoto prefecture, limiting its narrative depth and overall impact, though some appreciate it for its relaxing and visually appealing qualities.
pros: Aesthetically pleasing art style with watercolor vibe
Enjoyable and relaxing music
Cute and likeable characters
cons: Generic and predictable plot
Rushed pacing and lack of depth
Characters can be unrealistic or underdeveloped
Promotional nature overshadows the story

anime.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
anime.genres: Action, Award Winning, School, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Idly indulging in baseless paranormal activities with the Occult Club, high schooler Yuuji Itadori spends his days at either the clubroom or the hospital, where he visits his bedridden grandfather. However, this leisurely lifestyle soon takes a turn for the strange when he unknowingly encounters a cursed item. Triggering a chain of supernatural occurrences, Yuuji finds himself suddenly thrust into the world of Curses—dreadful beings formed from human malice and negativity—after swallowing the said item, revealed to be a finger belonging to the demon Sukuna Ryoumen, the King of Curses.

Yuuji experiences first-hand the threat these Curses pose to society as he discovers his own newfound powers. Introduced to the Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School, he begins to walk down a path from which he cannot return—the path of a Jujutsu sorcerer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Jujutsu Kaisen are divided. While many praise the animation and action, others criticize it for being a generic and overhyped shonen anime with shallow characters and a weak plot. Some find it enjoyable despite the cliches, while others consider it average or even bad.
pros: High-quality animation, especially during fight scenes.
Enjoyable action sequences and fast-paced plot.
cons: Overrated and generic shonen anime with many common tropes.
Shallow characters with little depth and uninspired character design.
Weak plot and world-building with poorly explained power system.

anime.title: Redo of Healer
anime.genres: Action, Erotica, Fantasy, Gore, Harem, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
When Keyaru acquired his powers as a Hero who specialized in healing all injuries regardless of severity, it seemed that he would walk the path to a great future. But what awaited him instead was great agony; he was subjected to years of seemingly endless hellish torture and abuse. Keyaru's healing skills allowed him to secretly collect the memories and abilities of those he treated, gradually making him stronger than anyone else. But by the time he reached his full potential, it was far too late—he had already lost everything.

Determined to put his life back on track, Keyaru decided to unleash a powerful healing spell that rewound the entire world back to the time before he began to suffer his horrible fate. Equipped with the anguish of his past, he vows to redo everything in order to fulfill a new purpose—to exact revenge upon those who have wronged him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized. Some viewers praise the show's unique and edgy take on revenge, while others heavily criticize its excessive sexual violence, moral issues, and shallow plot. The show is considered highly controversial, with many questioning its themes and justifications.
pros: Unique take on dark fantasy genre
MC's unapologetic approach to revenge
Well-done fight scenes
Engaging plot for some viewers
Satisfying power fantasy for some
cons: Excessive sexual content and violence
Questionable use of rape as a plot device
Repetitive plot and shallow characters
Weak OST
Moral issues and glorification of violence
Inconsistent character motivations
Poor justification for the MC's actions

anime.title: Pretty Boy Detective Club
anime.genres: Crossdressing, Detective, Mystery, School, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis:
Mayumi Doujima promises her parents that she will give up on her dreams of becoming an astronaut on her 14th birthday if she cannot find a star she once saw long ago.  Overhearing her troubles, the eccentric Manabu Soutouin offers to help her search for the star alongside the rest of Yubiwa Academy's mysterious Pretty Boy Detective Club, whose rules are as follows: "Be pretty, be a boy, and be a detective!"

However, Mayumi is unique—she can see many things that ordinary people cannot. Her eyesight allows her to see the tiniest of details, from people approaching her at a distance to hidden traps that would otherwise go undetected. When the search for the lost star begins to sour, the Pretty Boy Detective Club end up entangled in something far beyond what they ever imagined.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with strong appreciation for the show's unique visual style and witty dialogue, but criticism for its nonsensical plots, underdeveloped characters, and potential exploitation of underage characters. Many feel the mysteries are unsatisfying and the overall narrative lacks depth and cohesion. Comparisons to Monogatari are frequent, but not always favorable.
pros: Visually stunning art style and animation, particularly backgrounds
Witty dialogues and charming philosophical conversations
Creative and attractive character designs
cons: Nonsensical and convoluted plots with illogical conclusions
Underdeveloped, one-dimensional characters lacking depth
Story lacks a clear plot or objective, feeling episodic and pointless
Inconsistent character behavior and dropped plot threads
Uncomfortable sexualization of underage characters

anime.title: SHOW BY ROCK!! Mashumairesh!!
anime.synopsis: New Show by Rock!! TV Series featuring the new band Mashumairesh!!.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the character interactions, animation, and music, others find the plot unoriginal and the character development inconsistent. Side characters and CGI performances are areas of concern.  The show is considered enjoyable for fans of the franchise but may not appeal to everyone.
pros: Strong focus on character interactions and development, especially the bonds between characters like Howan and Himeko.
Visually appealing animation style, staying true to the original Show By Rock!! aesthetic.
Enjoyable musical elements, including opening and ending themes.
cons: Unoriginal premise with a commonly used trope.
Inconsistent character development, particularly with side characters like Dokonjofinger.
Some songs have nonsensical lyrics and lack depth.
CGI chibi models in performances are static and lack punch.
Pacing issues with the story.

anime.title: Haikyu!! To the Top 2nd-cour
anime.synopsis:
Once called a fallen powerhouse and known as "Flightless Crows," Karasuno High School has finally taken flight at nationals. With a comprehensive performance against Tsubakihara Academy in their first match, the team is now facing its toughest opponent yet: the runners-up of the last Spring Tournament, Inarizaki High School. Furthermore, dealing with the formidable twin Miya brothers only makes things more difficult for Karasuno.

As soon as the match begins, Karasuno is overwhelmed by all the noise and jeers from the supporters of Inarizaki High but rekindles its strength thanks to its own loyal fans. Karasuno also gains some momentum by utilizing an attack centered on Shouyou Hinata, but the eccentric play of Atsumu and Osamu Miya delivers an unexpected blow that leaves their opponent astounded.

Things are bound to get intense as the match progresses between these two teams. Will Karasuno be able to defeat Inarizaki High and overcome the hurdles that threaten its pursuit to the top?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many praising the series' core strengths like character development and exciting matches but criticizing inconsistent animation and pacing. Some find the season a satisfying continuation, while others feel it doesn't live up to the high standards of previous seasons. Overall, opinions are divided, resulting in a moderate controversy score.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga storyline
Exciting and emotional match sequences
Character development, particularly Hinata's growth
Thematic exploration of teamwork and perseverance
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, especially in early episodes
Pacing issues, with some episodes feeling slow or filled with unnecessary filler
Character backstories of opposing teams not as engaging
Art style deviates from previous seasons.

anime.title: Planetarian: Snow Globe
anime.synopsis: The new OVA will feature the prequel short story "Snow Globe," which debuted as part of a light novel volume that bundled with a limited-edition version of the original PC game.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Planetarian: Snow Globe' as a heartwarming prequel that enriches the original series. While some find the plot simple, it offers a comfortable and happy experience, enhancing the understanding and emotional impact of the characters in the main story. It's recommended to watch before the sequel to maximize enjoyment.
pros: Enhances the experience of the sequel
Provides backstory and context for characters
Comfortable and satisfying plot
cons: Plot is insipid (bland)

anime.title: Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle!
anime.synopsis:
Long ago, a goddess descended from Heaven and blessed the desolate land of Gatepia. As a result, gigantic gates appeared, leading to dungeons abundant in "kirakuri," crystals containing the energy needed for the foundation of the world. This led to the formation of various companies of adventurers who would harvest kirakuri from the dungeons.

Following his father's disappearance inside one of the biggest gates in Gatepia, Minato is urged by his childhood friend Yutoria to become the president of his father's treasure-hunting company—the Kibou Company. He reluctantly agrees and meets with the other employees: the priest Makoto, the soldier Akari, and the accountant Guide.

Thus, Minato begins his tenure as president. As he and his comrades strive to fulfill various missions and other assorted tasks in order to keep their small company alive, they will uncover the mystery behind their former leader's sudden departure.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed to negative. Many find the anime boring and generic, criticizing the uninspired plot and characters. However, some viewers appreciate its lightheartedness and positive themes, recommending it as a relaxing watch if you don't take it too seriously. Overall, it is considered a forgettable but harmless isekai-lite experience.
pros: Colorful art and animation by Studio C2C
Relaxing and easy to watch
Positive portrayal of employer-employee relationships
cons: Generic characters and tropey plot
Boring and unmemorable story
Lacks depth and action
Slow pacing

anime.title: Scissor Seven: The Strongest Hairstylist
anime.romaji_title: Wu Liuqi: Zui Qiang Fa Xing Shi
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Martial Arts, Mystery, Super Power
anime.synopsis: Seeking to recover his memories, a scissor-wielding hairdresser, bungling quasi-assassin stumbles into a struggle for power among two feuding factions.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Wu Liuqi is highly praised for its improved narrative, character development, and comedic timing.  Viewers appreciate the blend of humor and serious themes, although some note inconsistencies in animation quality and short episode lengths.  Overall, the audience expresses strong enthusiasm and anticipation for future seasons, emphasizing its underrated status.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to season 1.
Strong character development and introduction of charismatic new characters.
Balanced mix of humor and serious plot elements.
Memorable music and sound design.
cons: Short episode length can lead to glossing over details.
Animation quality can fluctuate, with some episodes appearing low-budget.
Dubbing quality (at least in some languages) is criticized.
Initial episodes may have a slower start compared to later ones.
anime.thematic_vibe: Action Comedy, Underdog Story, Memory & Identity

anime.title: Skate-Leading Stars
anime.genres: Performing Arts, School, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis:
Child figure skating prodigy Kensei Maeshima abruptly quits the sport after his one-sided rival, Reo Shinozaki, refuses to acknowledge his skill. Now, as a student at Inodai High School, Kensei uses his athletic skills to assist the other sports teams, but he never officially joins one. One day, Reo announces his switch from singles figure skating into team-based skate-leading and joins St. Clavis Gakuin High School—last year's Grand Prix champions. Hayato Sasugai, a classmate with a mysterious connection to Reo, convinces Kensei to switch to skate-leading in order to finally defeat his rival in a competition.

Kensei's sudden entry into the Inodai Skate-Leading Club is met with backlash from the current members. Although he is a very strong singles skater, Kensei lacks the teamwork skills required to perform well in skate-leading. Factoring in his hot-headed, impatient attitude, inconsistent skating performances, and a complicated history with some of the members, Kensei's teammates do not believe he is a good fit to be their "Lead." The team must work together to resolve these issues, however, if they wish to qualify for the Grand Prix Finals and even stand a chance at defeating St. Clavis Gakuin.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative due to the rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, and lack of focus on the skating performances. Many feel the anime failed to live up to its potential, especially compared to similar anime such as 'Yuri on Ice'. While the art style and character designs are appreciated, the poor execution overshadowed any initial excitement.
pros: Good animation and character design, particularly the character art.
Potential for an interesting team-based sports theme.
Exciting moments during final performances.
cons: Rushed plot and poor execution with underdeveloped characters and lack of character development.
Insufficient focus on the sport itself, with skating performances often cut short or skipped entirely.
Weak character motivations, forced rivalries, and unlikable characters.
Generic and predictable storyline with a lack of depth.

anime.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Romance, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis:
Equipped with his passion for diving and admiration for marine biology, university student Tsuneo Suzukawa tries his best to juggle several part-time jobs to earn enough money to study abroad. But one night, in a fateful accident, he meets a girl in a wheelchair, driving his current path into a detour.

The girl, Kumiko—who prefers to be called "Josee"—initially comes off as rude. Tsuneo, however, is then convinced by Josee's grandmother to take on the paid job to be Josee's caretaker. Despite being annoyed with her bossy demeanor, Tsuneo sees the opportunity to save more funds to support his academic dream. Nonetheless, after putting up with Josee's behavior for some time, Tsuneo tries to quit, only to discover Josee's dreams of traversing the outside world—to experience a life free from her crippling condition.

Changing his mind, Tsuneo decides to accompany Josee in exploring the wonders that the world has to offer. Through their time together, the two begin to realize that the traits that bind them may be vital toward fulfilling their respective aspirations.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While praised for its beautiful visuals, soundtrack, and heartwarming moments, many find the narrative generic and predictable. The rushed character development and reliance on clichés detract from the emotional impact for some viewers, leading to a somewhat polarized reception, but overall leans positive.
pros: Beautiful animation and art style by Studio Bones
Emotionally resonant soundtrack that enhances key scenes
Heartwarming and cute interactions between the main characters
Exploration of themes like overcoming obstacles and pursuing dreams
cons: Generic and predictable story with overused tropes
Rushed character development, especially for side characters
Unrealistic or poorly executed dramatic moments
Inconsistent pacing with a weak or unsatisfying ending for some viewers
Reliance on melodrama and cliches instead of realistic drama

anime.title: Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle - Rhyme Anima
anime.romaji_title: Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle - Rhyme Anima
anime.synopsis:
In a world overtaken by war and conflict, "Hypnosis Microphones"—devices through which a user channels lyrics that can affect the listener's brain and even cause physical damage—were introduced to the masses by the Party of Words. Revolutionizing warfare, Hypnosis Mics have transformed words and music into the sole weapons used by gangsters, terrorists, and the military, with physical weapons having been banned from use.

As a result of swooping in during the chaos, the all-female Party of Words rules over the Japanese government. Women in Japan now live in Chuuouku, while men battle over surrounding territories outside the ward through rap battles.

With intentions unknown, the Party of Words begins to gather the former members of the now-disbanded legendary rap crew The Dirty Dawg to fight not for territory or war, but for their respective crew's pride and honor in the greatest rap battle of all time. The first Division Rap Battle is about to commence, and practice is not something these rappers are going to need.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided. Fans of the Hypnosis Mic franchise appreciate the music and visuals, but many find the anime's plot convoluted and character development lacking. Newcomers are likely to be confused, while long-time fans are often disappointed by the anime's deviations from the source material. Some viewers find the absurdity entertaining, while others find it off-putting.
pros: Catchy and creative rap music.
Visually appealing animation, especially during rap battles.
Unique and diverse character designs.
cons: Weak and confusing plot, especially for those unfamiliar with the franchise.
Underdeveloped characters with shallow backstories.
Poor pacing and rushed storytelling, leaving many questions unanswered.

anime.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker 7th Season
anime.romaji_title: Huyao Xiao Hongniang 7: Wei Sheng Pian
anime.synopsis: Seventh season of Huyao Xiao Hongniang.
anime.consensus_summary: The season is generally well-received by existing fans of the series, continuing the established formula.  However, there are concerns about inconsistent character development, particularly regarding Bai Yuchu's sudden power increase. The season successfully sets up anticipation for the next installment.
pros: Enjoyable continuation of the series.
Satisfying for existing fans.
Storyline leads into the next season.
cons: Inconsistent character development (Bai Yuchu).
Sudden and unexplained power increase for a character.

anime.title: Seitokai Yakuindomo Movie 2
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with long-time fans generally enjoying the film but some critics pointing out the re-use of old material. The humor remains consistent with the series, but it may not appeal to all viewers. Some appreciate the subtle romantic development, while others find the plot repetitive.
pros: Enjoyable for longtime fans of the series.
Humor consistently delivers laughs.
The relationship progression is enjoyable.
cons: Recycled scenes from previous episodes are viewed negatively.
Humor may not appeal to everyone.
Some find the plot to be a rehash of previous content.
anime.thematic_vibe: Crude Humor, School Life, Romantic Subtext

anime.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
When Myne learns that the Holy Church is in need of mana for their relics, she sees it as her chance to be cured of her life-threatening mana disorder. After seeing their bountiful library, she throws herself headfirst into the Church's grasp and begs to join their order. In exchange for her service and her unusually bountiful supply of mana, Myne is given the blue robes of a noble-born apprentice priestess, despite being a commoner. To Myne, all this talk of mana and nobility is trivial, as she now has access to an unlimited supply of books!

As Myne transitions into the next phase of her life in this new world, she soon learns that achieving her dream has come at a heavy cost. Noble society is severe, unforgiving, and fueled by politics and neglect. She must now deal with the class conflict between the noble-born blue robes and the common-born grey robes, the High Priest's attempts to oust her, and constant behavioral issues from her new retainers. With the help of her family, friends, and the enigmatic Head Priest whose loyalties and motives remain unknown, Myne seeks to overcome these obstacles and continue on the path to becoming her ideal self—the ultimate librarian!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for world-building and character development, but criticism for slow pacing and animation quality. Some find the main character unlikeable, while others appreciate the unique take on the isekai genre. Overall, the season is considered a solid continuation, but with noticeable flaws.
pros: Engaging world-building that portrays the nitty-gritty aspects of everyday life in a medieval setting.
Character development is well-executed, with a focus on Myne's relationships and growth.
Story progression with twists and turns, exploring noble society and its impact.
cons: The animation quality is sometimes lacking, with low animation levels and strange drawings, especially on faces.
Pacing can be slow, with repetitive dialogue and a focus solely on the main character.
The main character, Myne, can be unlikeable due to her childish behavior and lack of knowledge despite being a reincarnated adult.

anime.title: Reversal Dimension
anime.romaji_title: Ni Zhuan Ci Yuan: AI Jue Qi
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Sci-Fi, Video Game
anime.synopsis: Shi Jiajie and Xiao Lei, who used the game as a livelihood, accidentally received the entry of the "Epoch" game. In order to win a huge prize in the game, Shi Jiajie decided to enter the game. As everyone knows, but it is involved in the inexplicable pursuit, but this is only the prelude to this layer of conspiracy…
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the show enjoyable with good character designs and action, but the plot suffers from convenience and irrational character behavior. Some appreciate the adherence to game mechanics, while others are critical of the animation mismatch in larger fights. Overall, the show is considered a decent watch but has noticeable flaws.
pros: Well-executed story that understands game mechanics.
Nice character designs.
Good animation, especially in action scenes.
cons: Plot feels too convenient.
Irrational actions of characters are not questioned.
Character attack animations don't fit well with large bosses.
Mismatch between animation quality and the scale of fights.
anime.thematic_vibe: VR Games, AI Uprising, Death Game

anime.title: With a Dog AND a Cat, Every Day is Fun
anime.romaji_title: Inu to Neko Docchi mo Katteru to Mainichi Tanoshii
anime.synopsis: Matsumoto-san owns an innocent dog and an adorably devious cat. Laughing and crying ensue as they all live daily life together.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the anime for its cuteness, relatability, and ability to evoke joy and comfort. Viewers appreciate its simplicity and how well it captures the essence of pet ownership. The show is considered a delightful and heartwarming experience, particularly for pet lovers.
pros: Simple but cute art style that provides a comfortable feeling.
Well-handled comedic timing and endearing characters.
Effectively captures the joys and frustrations of pet ownership.
Offers a quick and enjoyable break, perfect for short viewing sessions.
Voice acting enhances the characters, particularly the dog and cat.
Successfully portrays the true feelings of pet owners.
cons: The series is very short, which may not satisfy all viewers.
Simple art style may not appeal to those seeking wild animations.
Lacks deep or complex plots.

anime.title: Ranking of Kings
anime.synopsis:
The people of the kingdom look down on the young Prince Bojji, who can neither hear nor speak. They call him "The Useless Prince" while jeering at his supposed foolishness.

However, while Bojji may not be physically strong, he is certainly not weak of heart. When a chance encounter with a shadow creature should have left him traumatized, it instead makes him believe that he has found a friend amidst those who only choose to notice his shortcomings. He starts meeting with Kage, the shadow, regularly, to the point where even the otherwise abrasive creature begins to warm up to him.

Kage and Bojji's unlikely friendship lays the budding foundations of the prince's journey, one where he intends to conquer his fears and insecurities. Despite the constant ridicule he faces, Bojji resolves to fulfill his desire of becoming the best king he can be.
anime.consensus_summary: Ousama Ranking garnered a strong initial positive response due to its charming art style and emotionally engaging story of an underdog prince. However, the series suffered from inconsistent writing in the second half, which undermined character development, pacing, and the stakes of the narrative. This led to disappointment among many viewers who felt the show failed to live up to its early potential, resulting in polarized opinions on its overall quality.
pros: Charming art style reminiscent of storybooks.
Emotionally resonant characters, especially Bojji.
Exploration of themes like friendship, overcoming adversity, and forgiveness.
cons: Inconsistent writing quality, particularly in the second half.
Frequent reversal of deaths undermines stakes.
Pacing issues and unresolved conflicts.
Questionable moral decisions and rushed resolutions.
Superficial treatment of complex themes and lack of depth.

anime.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Harem, Romance, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Kazuya Kinoshita is a 20-year-old college student who has a wonderful girlfriend: the bright and sunny Mami Nanami. But suddenly, he does not. Without warning, Mami breaks up with him, leaving him utterly heartbroken and lonely. Seeking to soothe the pain, he hires a rental girlfriend through an online app. His partner is Chizuru Mizuhara, who through her unparalleled beauty and cute demeanor, manages to gain Kazuya's affection.

But after reading similar experiences other customers had had with Chizuru, Kazuya believes her warm smile and caring personality were all just an act to toy with his heart, and he rates her poorly. Aggravated, Chizuru lambastes him for his shameless hypocrisy, revealing her true pert and hot-tempered self. This one-sided exchange is cut short, however, when Kazuya finds out that his grandmother has collapsed.

They dash toward the hospital and find Kazuya's grandmother already in good condition. Baffled by Chizuru's presence, she asks who this girl might be. On impulse, Kazuya promptly declares that they are lovers, forcing Chizuru to play the part. But with Kazuya still hung up on his previous relationship with Mami, how long can this difficult client and reluctant rental girlfriend keep up their act?
