anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, with many viewers intensely disliking the anime due to its unlikeable protagonist and questionable themes. Some find it enjoyable as a guilty pleasure or appreciate its unique premise and art style. However, the overwhelming sentiment leans towards negative criticism and frustration with the show's characters and plot.
pros: Unique premise compared to other RomCom anime.
Visually appealing animation and character designs.
Engaging despite its flaws, with some finding it addictively watchable.
cons: Protagonist Kazuya is widely disliked for being pathetic, weak-willed, and perverted.
Plot is criticized for being generic, cliché-ridden, and having non-existent progression.
Show is labeled as 'incel anime' due to the protagonist's portrayal and themes.

anime.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm: Side Story
anime.romaji_title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen OVA
anime.synopsis:
Eustachius no Shitamachi Sennyuu Dai Sakusen (Eustachius' Incognito Operation Downtown)
To get more information about Myne and her strange background, Head Priest Ferdinand sends two nobles, Eustachius and Eckhard, to investigate everything regarding her life within her hometown. However, things do not go the way they expected.

Corinna-sama no Otaku Houmon (Visiting Missus Corinna)
Otto's wife, Corinna, takes an interest in the outfit that Myne wore at her baptism. Corinna summons her alongside her mother, Eva, and sister, Turi, wishing to know the procedure in making such sophisticated attire and accessories. Naturally, for Myne, she sees an excellent opportunity for profit.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the OVA as a continuation of the anime series, praising its quality and character development. While not essential to the main plot, it's considered a worthwhile addition for fans. It serves as a pleasant appetizer before the next season.
pros: Continues directly from the anime's continuity.
Maintains the original art and sound quality.
Offers further character development, especially for supporting characters.
Provides enjoyable side stories.
Sets up the next season nicely.
cons: The OVA is not essential to the main plot.
One of the stories is less interesting than the other.

anime.title: Idoly Pride
anime.synopsis:
The VENUS Program is an idol scoring system that is entirely impartial, using AI and data to rank candidates based on an array of factors. To determine the rising stars of the idol industry, the annual VENUS Grand Prix is held utilizing these algorithms. Among all the idols that have participated, none have been as outstanding as Mana Nagase. However, on the day of the tournament's finals, a tragic accident suddenly ends her career.

Kouhei Makino, who previously worked as Mana's manager, continues his career at Hoshimi Productions years after her death. Wanting to build a new team of idols, he accepts interviews from various girls. Unexpectedly, one of the interviewees is Kotono Nagase, Mana's younger sister, who is striving to carry on her sister's legacy under the tutelage of her former advisor. Also auditioning is Sakura Kawasaki, whose voice sounds astoundingly similar to that of Mana.

Both Kotono and Sakura pass the evaluations, joining a group of eight other aspiring young girls. Living in a shared dormitory, the 10 members work together to learn more about what it means to harmonize as a team. United by an ambitious endeavor, the girls compete their way to the top as they traverse through the unforgiving world of idols.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some praising the show's emotional depth, character development, and music, while others criticize its predictable plot, underutilized characters, and inconsistent animation. Many appreciate the series' attempts to explore more profound themes than typical idol anime. While some find it a moving and enjoyable experience, others consider it mediocre and formulaic, particularly those familiar with the idol genre.
pros: Meaningful exploration of regret, loss, and redemption.
High-quality musical performances and songs.
Good character development, especially Kotono's growth.
Surprising depth beyond typical idol anime themes.
Well-executed drama and emotional moments.
cons: Predictable storyline and some clichéd character tropes.
Underutilization of side characters and rival groups.
Inconsistent CGI animation in dance sequences.
Formulaic storytelling with little challenge for the protagonists.
Superficial exploration of the idol industry.

anime.title: Breakers
anime.synopsis: The anime will center on para-athletes who all meet an outcast sports scientist named Ren Narita. The anime will have four stories about four different sports: wheelchair basketball, track and high jump, goalball, and paralympic swimming.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is appreciated for its focus on para-sports and representation of disabled athletes. However, it is criticized for its short episodes and average animation. Some viewers felt the story could have been more developed, ultimately leaving them wanting more depth.
pros: Informative about para-sports
Focuses on representation of disabled athletes
Inspiring stories of overcoming challenges
cons: Sloppy/average animation quality
Episodes are too short
Story felt shallow, like something was missing

anime.title: Dr. Stone: Stone Wars
anime.synopsis:
Senkuu has made it his goal to bring back two million years of human achievement and revive the entirety of those turned to statues. However, one man stands in his way: Tsukasa Shishiou, who believes that only the fittest of those petrified should be revived.

As the snow melts and spring approaches, Senkuu and his allies in Ishigami Village finish the preparations for their attack on the Tsukasa Empire. With a reinvented cell phone model now at their disposal, the Kingdom of Science is ready to launch its newest scheme to recruit the sizable numbers of Tsukasa's army to their side. However, it is a race against time; for every day the Kingdom of Science spends perfecting their inventions, the empire rapidly grows in number.

Reuniting with old friends and gaining new allies, Senkuu and the Kingdom of Science must stop Tsukasa's forces in order to fulfill their goal of restoring humanity and all its creations. With the two sides each in pursuit of their ideal world, the Stone Wars have now begun!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on Dr. Stone: Stone Wars. Some appreciate the educational and entertaining aspects of the show, praising the characters and pacing. However, others criticize the unrealistic inventions, weak story, and lack of character development. While many find it enjoyable, some consider it a disappointment compared to the first season.
pros: Satisfying to watch Senku build modern things from scratch.
Good pacing that keeps the show from being boring.
Great synergy between characters and unique character personalities.
cons: The story can be underwhelming and not profound.
Inventions are often over-exaggerated and not realistic.
Character development can be inconsistent and non-existent.
Action scenes are underwhelming and awkwardly directed.

anime.title: Stand By Me Doraemon 2
anime.synopsis:
After reminiscing about his late grandmother, Nobita Nobi wishes to see her again and asks Doraemon to return them to the past. Following the wholesome reunion of the two, Nobita's grandmother confesses that she hopes to meet his future bride. Nobita accepts her request out of filial love and quickly scrambles into the time machine as he and Doraemon journey forward in time.

However, when the duo warps to Nobita's wedding day, they discover that the future Nobita is missing from the ceremony! Determined to set things right, Doraemon and Nobita embark on a mission to search for Nobita's future self and encourage him to discover the happiness he deserves.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience feels emotionally connected to Stand By Me Doraemon 2, especially those who grew up with the franchise. While some find the plot convoluted or rushed, the nostalgic elements and heartwarming themes generally resonate well. The movie is praised for its emotional impact and strong visuals, making it a worthwhile experience for fans.
pros: The movie evokes nostalgia and reminds viewers of their childhood.
The 3D animation is well-done and immersive.
The story explores themes of family, love, and growing up, resonating with a wide audience.
cons: The timeline can be confusing.
The story can feel rushed or lacking in detail.
Some viewers may find the plot messy or disjointed.

anime.title: BanG Dream! Garupa☆Pico: Oomori
anime.synopsis: The second season of the mini series starring the girls of BanG Dream!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the absurd and comedic nature of BanG Dream! Garupa☆Pico: Oomori. The humor, while appreciated, is the primary focus, with the plot taking a backseat. Some viewers missed the frequency of character deaths from the first season.
pros: Humorous take on the BanG Dream! franchise
Enjoyable weekly dose of laughter
Addition of RAS and Morfonica enhances the chaos
cons: Story is minimal and not to be taken seriously
Running gag of character deaths is less frequent in Season 2

anime.title: Psycho-Pass 3: First Inspector
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Detective, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Inspectors Arata Shindou and Mikhail Kei Ignatov have uncovered a dangerous conspiracy. The Sybil System, the ultimate judge of human character in Japan, is being undermined by a criminal syndicate that is amassing wealth and power in the shadows.

Now, Bifrost agent Kouichi Azusawa launches a direct assault upon the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) by occupying its headquarters and taking Inspector Shindou and everyone with him hostage. CID Unit 01 supervisor, along with Chief Mika Shimotsuki and former unit members Shinya Kougami and Nobuchika Ginoza, face the task of reclaiming the building and saving everyone inside.

Alongside the hostage situation and Azusawa's demands for Tokyo governor Karina Komiya's resignation, there is a sinister plot hatching in the background—a secret plan that will force Inspector Shindou to confront not only Azusawa but also his own past. These events slowly bring him closer to unshrouding the mystery that has eluded him and his best friend, Ignatov, for many years.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Psycho-Pass 3: First Inspector' is mixed. While some appreciate the plot resolution, animation, and character development, others criticize the abandonment of original themes, convoluted storylines, and disappointing use of returning characters. The film is considered a decent conclusion to Season 3 but falls short of the series' initial promise.
pros: The movie wraps up most plotlines for the season.
Animation quality might possibly be the series' best yet.

The movie gave less focus on the fight scenes. This worked well for Arata and Azusawa and flesh out the ideological rivalry between the two characters, making the final culmination of their fight very satisfying.
Filled in a lot of blanks that were left in the third season, which has left me very happy.
The series has, in my opinion, totally redeemed itself from the mess that the 2nd season and the movie brought upon itself.
cons: Turning this series into a bog-standard detective show that had dropped a lot of what made it compelling.

The ending set it up as an almost complete abandonment of the grit and moral quandaries of the first season in favor of shipping several couples together in that typical anime fashion where they never kiss or confess their feelings
It has become obvious that Psycho Pass will never rise out of the mediocrity that it has been in since the end of its first season.
Plot is cumbersome, there is no explanation of Bifrost or the other Inspectors given how Kei was 13th, was expecting more since this whole 3 episode part completely melts down PP series.
The characters from the previous seasons are rather disappointing.
The slow degradation of the show's animation and heavier usage of bad CGI.

anime.title: Pokémon: Twilight Wings
anime.synopsis: Galar is a region where Pokemon battles have developed into a cultural sensation. Over the span of seven episodes, Pokemon: Twilight Wings will show in detail the dreams of Galar's residents, the realities they face, the challenges they must overcome and the conflicts they must resolve. In addition to these new stories, fans can expect to see a variety of Pokemon originally discovered in the Galar region appearing in the capsule series.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally appreciative of Twilight Wings' stunning visuals and immersive world-building, offering a refreshing take on the Pokemon universe. However, the series' brevity and perceived over-reliance on Charizard led to some criticism. While some viewers found the monthly release schedule detrimental, others enjoyed the condensed glimpses into the Galar region.
pros: Beautiful art and animation quality.
Provides glimpses into the Pokemon world, creating immersion.
Well-written characters (though limited development due to short episodes).
A breath of fresh air compared to the typical Pokemon journey formula.
cons: Episodes are too short, hindering character development.
Story can feel shallow or lacking in substance.
Some find the focus on Charizard repetitive and overdone.
Monthly release schedule made the series feel stale for some viewers.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Aspirations, Galar Region Focus

anime.title: SSSS.Dynazenon
anime.synopsis:
One day after school, first-year high school student Yomogi Asanaka comes across a starving man under a bridge. Introducing himself as Gauma, the strange drifter informs Yomogi that he is a "kaiju user," a person who deals with the "kaiju"—monsters who bring harm to the city and its citizens.

The following evening, Yomogi runs into Gauma and his classmate Yume Minami. Simultaneously, a kaiju appears in a populated area of the city. Due to Gauma's lack of experience controlling the kaiju, he brings out a mysterious object from a glowing pouch, summoning a giant robot known as Dynazenon. Requiring the cooperation of four people, the mecha drags Gauma, Yomogi, Minami, and Koyomi Yamanaka—an unemployed man who was wandering on the street—into its cockpit.

Their encounter with the kaiju marks the beginning of their entanglement with kaiju eugenicists—kaiju users who manipulate kaiju with ill intent—and their efforts toward bringing out the full potential of Dynazenon.
anime.consensus_summary: SSSS.Dynazenon is a character-focused mecha anime that resonated with viewers due to its engaging characters, strong emotional core, and a blend of slice-of-life with action. While praised for its character development and visual storytelling, some found the story pacing inconsistent and the animation quality to be lacking in certain areas. It serves as a worthy successor to SSSS.Gridman for some, while others found it average in comparison.
pros: Strong character chemistry and development, especially within the main cast.
Good balance of slice-of-life elements with action and drama.
Excellent direction and visual storytelling that enhances emotional impact.
Engaging story with underlying themes of regrets, purpose, and moving forward.
cons: Story and pacing issues, particularly in the first half of the series.
Some character arcs overshadow the main character's development.
Over-reliance on stock transformation/combination animations.
Inconsistent visual quality, with subpar 3DCG elements.

anime.title: Ai Zai Xiyuan Qian
anime.synopsis: Some aliens come to the Earth and one of them, become Babilonia's King, building the Babel Tower in order to come back to his world. But, due to technical failures his spaceship explodes, killing the main female character. The male lead and his troop stay in the Earth to find a way to come back. The female main character reincarnates 2500 years ago and met with him one more time. Then, what will happen now?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Ai Zai Xiyuan Qian' to be an enjoyable but generic Chinese romance donghua. Viewers appreciate the well-paced story and the historical scenes, but note the predictable plot and archetypal characters. The overall mood is positive but not overwhelmingly enthusiastic.
pros: Well-paced story
Enjoyable characters
Good art and animation
Interesting historical scenes before each episode
cons: Generic characters
Predictable plot
Unremarkable OST

anime.title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club
anime.romaji_title: Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Buried within the numerous clubs at Nijigasaki High School lies the school idol club. The club, while lacking popularity, definitely does not lack potential. During their debut performance, they were able to seize a sizable audience, along with the attention of their schoolmates Ayumu Uehara and Yuu Takasaki.

Enamored, the duo makes their way to join the club; however, they are disappointed to find out that the club had just been disbanded. Nevertheless, Ayumu does not believe that it should have ended there. Together with Yuu, they begin restoring the school idol club, hoping to recreate the idol performances that dazzled them before.

Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai shines its spotlight over the reformed school idol club as they recruit both former members of the club alongside newcomers. Taking the first step towards their dreams, how will these girls achieve idol stardom?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the show's character development, animation, and music. Some criticism is present regarding the lack of a strong central plot and the focus on individual idols rather than group dynamics. While some find the series innovative and refreshing, others miss the traditional Love Live formula.
pros: Strong character development, especially for a large cast.
High-quality animation, particularly the 3D CGI in performances.
Upbeat and wholesome tone, with a focus on fun and heartwarming moments.
Innovative approach to the idol genre with solo performances.
Memorable insert songs.
cons: Lack of a strong central plot or overarching story.
Character development can feel forced with dedicated episodes.
Some viewers find the focus on individual characters detracts from group dynamics.
Perceived lack of stakes or tension due to the absence of a school closure threat or competition.
Some viewers were disappointed by the perceived yuri undertones.

anime.title: Kiratto Pri☆chan Season 3
anime.synopsis: Third season of Kiratto Pri☆chan.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience feels that Season 3 provides a solid and satisfying conclusion to the Kiratto Pri☆chan series, effectively resolving character arcs and integrating elements from previous seasons. While the introduction of new mascot characters as semi-protagonists is noted, the overall sentiment is positive, with the season successfully tying up loose ends and leaving viewers feeling content. The show is not very controversial.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to character arcs
Integration of characters from all seasons
Welcomed new characters
cons: Inconsistent series overall (referring to the entire run, not just S3)
Season gimmick of new 'mascot' characters

anime.title: Komatta Jiisan
anime.synopsis: A story about a handsome, but slightly troubled old man who pretends to be a fool to make the grandma's heart flutter. A tale of a couple celebrating their 50th wedding anniversary, still nurturing a new love. This is a story of a couple's daily life with nothing but happiness that you will want to watch forever.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find 'Komatta Jiisan' to be a charming, heartwarming, and humorous short anime. Despite some cultural nuances and basic animation, the show leaves a positive impression due to its unique premise and focus on love in old age.
pros: Charming and heartwarming story
Unique premise with an elderly couple
Simple and enjoyable jokes
cons: Basic animation
Jokes may be specific to Japanese culture

anime.title: Food Wars! The Fifth Plate
anime.romaji_title: Shokugeki no Souma: Gou no Sara
anime.synopsis: Thanks to Souma Yukihira, Erina Nakiri, and the rebel forces overthrowing the regime of Azami Nakiri—the previous school director—and the former Elite Ten, Tootsuki Culinary Academy is back in order. However, its students have one more great battle ahead of them: the BLUE, a competition where young chefs seeking world-class fame compete. Faced with new trials and rivals, Souma and his friends will fight to conquer the BLUE and to defeat Asahi Saiba, the leader of an underworld organization of chefs known as Noir, who once defeated Souma and his father in a Shokugeki.
anime.consensus_summary: The final season is largely considered a disappointment due to rushed pacing, poor animation, and a weak plot. Many feel it betrays the established quality of the series. While some appreciate the character development and a somewhat satisfactory ending, the consensus is overwhelmingly negative, with the season failing to deliver on the core aspects that made the series enjoyable.
pros: Character development of Megumi, Erina and Aldini.
Satisfactory ending with an 'original' epilogue.
cons: Rushed pacing and plot development.
Poor animation quality with panning shots and off-model characters.
Uninspired and lazy fanservice.
Weak villain (Asahi) with a nonsensical motivation.
Neglect of cooking process and technicality of dishes.
Inconsistent power scaling.
Poorly integrated 'superpower' element.
Flat and superficial new characters (Noir).

anime.title: Remake Our Life!
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Romance, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Life is not going well for 28-year-old Kyouya Hashiba. Having left his office job to pursue a career in the video game industry, his internship at a popular game studio abruptly ends, leaving him unemployed and forcing him to move back in with his parents. Additionally, his jealousy toward the success of the "Platinum Generation"—a group of similarly-aged creators—has caused him to regret his decision to attend a traditional university instead of an arts college. Even though he believes there are no second chances in life, Kyouya is suddenly given one when he wakes up one day and finds himself 10 years in the past.

Instead of choosing business school like he originally had, Kyouya decides to pursue his passions and attends the Oonaka University of Art. There, he meets classmate Eiko Kawasegawa, the woman who had hired him as an intern in the present, alongside his new housemates and future Platinum Generation members: underachieving artist Aki Shino, aspiring singer and actress Nanako Kogure, and naturally-gifted writer Tsurayuki Rokuonji.

With each project they complete together, Kyouya and his friends venture closer to discovering their true potential as creators and remaking their lives into the ideal versions they desire.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed with some viewers appreciating the relatable characters and exploration of second chances, while others criticize the generic plot, forced drama, and heavy fanservice. The anime's attempt to explore deep themes is seen as superficial, and its reliance on tropes detracts from its message. Overall, the series is considered a decent time-waster but falls short of expectations due to its lack of originality and depth.
pros: Lovable cast with relatable quirks and issues
Addresses the what-ifs of life and the impact of decisions
Exploration of video game design and Japanese work culture
Mature feeling with young adult characters
cons: Generic story and characters
Rushed plot development and shallow exploration of time travel
Forced drama and romance
Superficiality and heavy fanservice
Contradictory messages
anime.thematic_vibe: Second Chance, Creative Process, Relationship Dynamics

anime.title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
anime.synopsis:
A long time ago, there was a valiant swordsman who came to be known simply as "the hero." There was a demon who has caused people suffering. The hero and his companions arrived to challenge the demon to a battle and by combining their powers, the battle was brought swift conclusion. With no one around to cause trouble, the island became a quiet place where everyone could live together in peace.

Several years later, the demon is revived. Our present-day protagonist, Dai, lives on a remote island in the southern seas and dreams of becoming a great hero. When he hears about the demon's revival, Dai and his friends take it upon themselves to stop him and the evil force that revived him. Along the way, Dai discovers the identity of "the hero," the truth behind the evil force who revived the demon, and Dai's own hidden powers that surface in times of peril.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves Dragon Quest: Dai no Daibouken (2020) for its classic shonen themes, strong characters, and well-executed story. While some find the plot simple, many appreciate its adherence to heroic archetypes and the emotional depth it provides. The series is considered a hidden gem and a worthwhile watch for fans of adventure and fantasy anime.
pros: Classical heroic narrative is refreshing and well-executed
Strong character development and memorable characters
Good mix of action, adventure, fantasy, and emotional moments
Engaging story with plot twists and a satisfying conclusion
High-quality animation and fight sequences
cons: Some consider the story to be basic or formulaic
OP and ED themes could be better
Starts as a typical shonen, potentially deterring some viewers

anime.title: World Trigger 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
After successfully holding off the invasion by Aftokrator, the Border Defense Agency prepares an away mission into the Neighbor's dimension. However, like in previous scouting expeditions, only A-rank teams are certain to secure a spot. As the B-rank wars continue, Osamu Mikumo and the rest of Tamakoma-2 quickly fight to the top in an attempt to obtain a promotion before the operation begins.

Meanwhile, a new Neighbor ship approaches Border Headquarters. Noticing that the attackers are targeting the Border Expedition Ship, forces are hastily sent to combat them. However, with fewer squads available due to the proceeding rank wars, the organization is sent into disarray. This latest offensive from the Neighbors shrouds the fate of the all-important expedition ship in uncertainty.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally agrees that World Trigger Season 2 is a significant improvement over the first season, particularly in animation quality and pacing. Viewers appreciate the strategic depth of the combat and the character development, especially Osamu's growth. While some minor criticisms exist regarding animation consistency and character depth, the overall sentiment is positive, with many recommending it to fans of the series and newcomers alike.
pros: Significant improvement in animation quality compared to Season 1.
Well-executed strategic battles and tactical combat.
Noticeable character development, especially for the protagonist, Osamu.
Faithful adaptation of the manga with added content.
Engaging and entertaining plot with good pacing in this season.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality due to TOEI production.
Underdeveloped characters, with a greater focus on strategy and world-building.
Repetitive soundtrack.
May require watching or summarizing the first season for context.
anime.thematic_vibe: Strategic Combat, Character Development, Improved Animation

anime.title: Kemono Jihen
anime.genres: Action, Detective, Mystery, Mythology, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Kohachi Inugami, a detective who specializes in the occult, arrives at a remote village in the Japanese countryside, tasked by a hostess at a local inn to investigate a string of incidents involving rotting and mutilated livestock corpses that have been appearing for seemingly no reason. While surveying, Inugami notices a peculiar young boy working in the fields. Evaded by his peers and called "Dorotabou" for his stench, the young farmhand is surprised that anybody would take an interest in him.

Inugami, piqued with curiosity, enlists Dorotabou in helping him with the investigation, despite scorned looks from the villagers. Unbeknownst to Dorotabou, this investigation will reveal a strange new world to him—one of the beast-like entities known as Kemono existing in tandem with humans—along with breathing new purpose into his previously empty life.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Kemono Jihen is well-received as a hidden gem within the shounen genre, praised for its engaging characters, intriguing mysteries, and balance of dark and lighthearted elements. Some viewers found the plot and character development lacking, and the animation inconsistent. Despite its flaws, most hope for a second season to continue the story.
pros: Endearing characters with well-developed backstories.
Good balance of dark themes with lighthearted moments.
Interesting plot with unique powers and mysteries.
Excellent opening theme and generally good soundtrack.
Strong emphasis on teamwork and character relationships.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality.
Uneven character development, with some characters feeling underdeveloped or relying on tropes.
Plot can be predictable or lack a clear overarching narrative.
Some viewers found the 'edgy' or 'mature' themes to be poorly executed or gratuitous.
Cliffhanger ending with no guarantee of a second season frustrates some viewers.

anime.title: Moriarty the Patriot
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Historical, Mystery, Organized Crime, Psychological, Shounen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
During the late 19th century, Great Britain has become the greatest empire the world has ever known. Hidden within its success, the nation's rigid economic hierarchy dictates the value of one's life solely on status and wealth. To no surprise, the system favors the aristocracy at the top and renders it impossible for the working class to ascend the ranks.

William James Moriarty, the second son of the Moriarty household, lives as a regular noble while also being a consultant for the common folk to give them a hand and solve their problems. However, deep inside him lies a desire to destroy the current structure that dominates British society and those who benefit from it. 

Alongside his brothers Albert and Louis, William will do anything it takes to change the filthy world he lives in—even if blood must be spilled.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers praise the anime for its unique perspective, faithful adaptation of Sherlock Holmes elements, and exploration of social issues. However, many find the plot predictable, the characters shallow, and the thematic exploration lacking depth, resulting in disappointment.
pros: Faithful adaptation of Sherlock Holmes elements (characters, dialogue).
Intriguing premise with a focus on Moriarty's perspective.
Visually appealing art and animation.
Enjoyable for those unfamiliar with the original Sherlock Holmes series.
Exploration of societal issues like class differences and corruption.
Mystery and suspense elements
cons: Shallow exploration of moral questions and societal issues.
Predictable plot and simplistic mysteries.
Moriarty's character lacking depth and charisma.
Overuse of the 'noble bad, poor good' trope.
Inaccuracies in historical and sociological context.
Inconsistent character portrayals.
Poor execution of a promising premise.

anime.title: Azur Lane: Slow Ahead!
anime.synopsis: In a seemingly peaceful time without looming threats of Sirens or war, shipgirls from different nations live together in harmony. Some girls, such as the destroyers Ayanami, Javelin, Laffey, and Z23, attend school. Others immerse themselves into various other activities, including sports, foraging, training, going to formal parties, or even vying for the commander's attention! But one thing is for certain: the girls will continue to deepen their friendship in the pleasant port of Azur Lane!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Azur Lane: Bisoku Zenshin!' as a lighthearted and fluffy adaptation that caters to fans of the original game. It excels in showcasing the cuteness and personalities of the shipgirls in a non-hostile environment. Some find the lack of a substantial plot and heavy reliance on fanservice to be drawbacks, but overall, it's considered a successful promotional piece and an enjoyable watch for those already invested in the Azur Lane universe.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the Azur Lane world and characters in a lighthearted setting.
Enjoyable for fans of the game due to its accurate portrayal of shipgirl personalities and references.
Provides a relaxing and fun viewing experience with short, self-contained episodes.
Improved animation quality compared to the original Azur Lane anime.
cons: Lacks a compelling or overarching story, relying heavily on episodic, slice-of-life content.
May not appeal to viewers unfamiliar with the Azur Lane franchise due to a lack of world-building and character introductions.
Relies heavily on fanservice, which may not appeal to all viewers and can border on questionable content.
Simpler aesthetics might come off as lazy.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Fanservice, Cute Girls Doing Cute Things

anime.title: Bungo and Alchemist -Gears of Judgement-
anime.romaji_title: Bungou to Alchemist: Shinpan no Haguruma
anime.synopsis:
Famous writers throughout history find themselves being reincarnated by a mysterious, unseen entity known as the Alchemist. With their souls confined and bound to an expansive library, they are tasked by the Alchemist to jump into books to purify the pages of monsters called Taints. Along the way, they must also rescue and recruit fellow authors trapped within the very stories they themselves had written.

Although the writers take on new and powerful forms for this endeavor, some still maintain a semblance of who they once were, while others struggle to remember their pasts and the works they had penned. Despite there being no apparent end to their grand mission, they remain committed to the cause in hope of resolving the mystery behind their collective resurrection as well as questions that have haunted their former lives.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the concept and visuals, particularly if they have an interest in Japanese literature. However, many find the story poorly executed, the characters underdeveloped, and the overall experience boring or generic. The anime seems to appeal to a niche audience, but its flaws prevent broader appeal.
pros: Unique concept of authors fighting to save literature.
Visually appealing art style and character designs, especially the main cast.
Good opening theme and soundtrack.
cons: Poor pacing and confusing story execution.
Shallow and stereotyped characters with little development.
Overly large cast with insufficient screen time for development.
Generic plot elements and lack of depth in exploring literary themes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Literary Appreciation, Historical Fiction, Supernatural Action

anime.title: Beastars 2nd Season
anime.genres: Anthropomorphic, Drama, Psychological, School, Shounen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
"Beastar"—a title awarded to beasts who prove their excellence through fighting inequality to unite carnivores and herbivores in an anthropomorphic animal society. Cherryton Academy has gone five years without one such leader. However, following the murder of an alpaca within the school boundaries, the growing tension between the different species poses a greater need for a Beastar to ensure peace and harmony. 

When Louis, the prime candidate for this prestigious role, rejects the offer and leaves the academy, the student council declares to honor any student who captures the culprit of the aforementioned murder as Beastar. Meanwhile, Legoshi's sense of duty as a strong wolf who must protect the weak pushes him to investigate the incident. To further complicate his life, he struggles to manage his complex feelings for the white rabbit, Haru.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided. Some viewers praised the show's deep themes, character development, and compelling story. Others criticized the plot as disjointed, the character development as inconsistent, and the ending as anticlimactic, leading to a polarized view on the season's quality.
pros: Compelling story and characters
Exploration of complex themes like prejudice and societal imbalance
Well-developed world-building
Gorgeous CG Animation
cons: Inconsistent character development
Weak plot
Storyline feels rushed and disjointed
Anticlimactic ending

anime.title: ORESUKI Are you the only one who loves me? - Our Playball / Our End Run / Our Game
anime.romaji_title: Ore wo Suki nano wa Omae dake ka yo: Oretachi no Game Set
anime.synopsis: The original video anime episode will serve as the final chapter to the television series, focusing on the rivalry between the "the protagonist" Amatsuyu Kisaragi (Jouro) and Yasuo Hazuki (Hose), "the background character."
anime.consensus_summary: The Oretachi no Game Set OVA is a mixed bag for viewers, with some praising its humor and character development, particularly the friendship between the main characters. Others were disappointed by the convoluted plot and the ending, which avoided a clear romantic resolution. Overall, the OVA seems to be appreciated by fans of the series, but its unconventional approach might not appeal to everyone.
pros: Enjoyable rivalry between main characters.
Unique harem protagonist with unexpected personality.
Satisfying resolution for supporting characters.
cons: Convoluted plot with added rules.
Ending may not satisfy viewers expecting a clear romantic pairing.
Protagonist's final decision may seem like a 'lame excuse' to some.

anime.title: Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took in a High School Runaway
anime.romaji_title: Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou.
anime.synopsis:
When regular salaryman Yoshida wakes up one Sunday morning after a long night at the bar, the last thing he expects to see is that his tiny apartment has a new resident—an unfamiliar high school girl.

The previous night, despite finally gathering the courage to confess to his boss and longtime crush, Airi Gotou, Yoshida was rejected. After drowning his sorrows at a bar with his good friend Hashimoto, Yoshida headed back to his home in a drunken stupor, only to run into Sayu Ogiwara, a runaway high schooler. She asked him to let her stay the night, and with his judgment clouded by alcohol, Yoshida complied.

Now, with his head on straight but with no memory of last night's events, Yoshida has Sayu explain just how she ended up sleeping at his apartment. Having listened to her story, Yoshida finds himself unable to kick her out—especially after learning that she came all the way from Hokkaido! So, despite his reservations about sheltering an underage girl, Yoshida allows her to stay, and their life together begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are highly divided, with some praising the heartwarming character development and exploration of difficult themes, while others criticize the show's hypocritical handling of sensitive topics and inconsistent tone. Many find the relationship between the main characters disturbing. Critics are wary of the series, some viewing it as an exploitative fantasy.
pros: Character development between Sayu and Yoshida is heartwarming and well-executed.
Exploration of complex themes like abandonment and finding one's place is gentle and uplifting.
Visually appealing art style and character designs enhance the viewing experience.
cons: Inconsistent tone and blending of heavy drama with fan service is jarring.
Characters act unrealistically and make illogical decisions.
The series attempts to cover serious topics but lacks the depth and tact to handle them effectively.

anime.title: Gundam Build Divers Re:Rise 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: The massive beam of light fired from Eldora's moon has completely shattered the BUILD DiVERS' conception of Gunpla Battle Nexus Online (GBN). This has forced Hiroto Kuga and his teammates to reevaluate their mission on Eldora now that they are faced with potentially very real consequences. Despite this, the BUILD DiVERS rejoin the fight against the One-Eyed to protect what they hold dear. In the battle that concerns the fate of both Earth and Eldora, sparks fly as Hiroto is forced to confront his past amidst the revelations of GBN's shocking secrets.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, particularly praising the improved character development and deeper narrative compared to previous entries in the Build Divers series. While some find the plot and pacing flawed, the emotional resonance and character arcs resonated with viewers. Many appreciate the series for addressing the shortcomings of its predecessor and for creating a more engaging story.
pros: Character development is well-executed, transforming bland archetypes into relatable individuals.
The plot effectively builds upon season 1, adding depth and weight to the events.
Raising the stakes made the main characters overcome their insecurities.
cons: Pacing issues with some episodes serving primarily as setup for the next.
Characters like Kazami and Parv are uninteresting.
The ending feels rushed, with some directing choices negatively impacting key scenes.
The series takes too long to become interesting after a poor first season.

anime.title: Fire Force Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Enen no Shouboutai: Ni no Shou
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
After his confrontation in the Nether with his younger brother Shou, Shinra Kusakabe's resolve to become a hero that saves lives from the flame terror strengthens. Finding a way to turn the Infernals back into people, unraveling the mystery of the Evangelist and Adolla Burst, and saving his mother and Shou—these are the goals Shinra has in mind. However, he has come to realize that attaining these goals will not be easy, especially with the imminent danger the Evangelist poses.

The Evangelist's plan is clear: to gather the eight pillars—the individuals who possess Adolla Burst—and sacrifice them to recreate the Great Cataclysm from 250 years ago. Having been revealed by the First Pillar that the birth of a new pillar is approaching, Shinra is determined to protect his fellow pillars from the Evangelist. Thus, the fiery battle between the Special Fire Force and the Evangelist ignites. Together with the Special Fire Force, Shinra's fight continues as he uncovers the truth about the Great Cataclysm and the nature of Adolla Bursts, as well as the mysteries behind human combustion.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception of Enen no Shouboutai: Ni no Shou is mixed. While some appreciate the improved pacing, animation, and character development, others criticize the messy storytelling, inconsistent pacing, and overall decline in story quality compared to the first season. The season is considered a setup for future events, leaving some viewers feeling unsatisfied.
pros: Improved pacing and storytelling compared to Season 1.
Amazing animation, fights, sound production, and OST by David Production.
Significant character development for side characters like Maki and Tamaki.
cons: Story feels messy and arcs don't relate well.
Pacing issues with some arcs feeling drawn out.
Significant step down from season 1 in terms of story and suspense.

anime.title: True Cooking Master Boy 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Sequel of Shin Chuuka Ichiban.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience has mixed feelings about the second season. There is some appreciation for continuing the original story and revealing more about the antagonists. However, many find the season unoriginal, incomplete, and not particularly engaging, suggesting a preference for the manga version. Nostalgia is a significant factor for older viewers.
pros: Continuation of the story from the original series
Seeing the Underworld Cooking Society and legendary utensils
cons: Not a unique reboot for new anime watchers
Unclear ending, story still not finished
OST is just OK, nothing that really stands out
Direct copy-and-paste of the manga

anime.title: Rail Romanesque
anime.synopsis:
The year is 1989. After the nation of Hinomoto was destabilized during the past World War, the rise of new technologies has enabled its revitalization. Modern engineering has given birth to aircraft, gasoline engines, and geomagnetic technology—revolutionizing transportation. Railroads have been rendered nearly obsolete and replaced by more efficient modes of transit.

However, a group of lively "Raillords" aims to renew the railroads' former glory. The Raillords, personified as energetic and spirited girls, act as humanoid control modules for their assigned railways. They meet in Ohitoyo City for the Raillord Summit, headed by Suzushiro, a Raillord from Manoka Railways. Together, the group capitalizes on its teamwork to get the railroads back on track, ushering in a "new railroad age."
anime.consensus_summary: Rail Romanesque is a short and simple anime that focuses on cute girls doing cute things related to trains. While some viewers find it enjoyable and wholesome, many criticize its lack of plot, underdeveloped characters, and mediocre production quality. Ultimately, it appeals to a niche audience interested in trains and the CGDCT genre.
pros: Cute and wholesome characters and interactions.
Enjoyable and relaxing to watch.
Informative tidbits about railways and trains.
cons: Weak or non-existent plot.
Underdeveloped characters.
Short episodes and overall runtime limits depth.
Mediocre animation and generic music.

anime.title: Drug Store in Another World: The Slow Life of a Cheat Pharmacist
anime.romaji_title: Cheat Kusushi no Slow Life: Isekai ni Tsukurou Drugstore
anime.synopsis:
Reiji Kirio, formerly a corporate slave, wakes up one day in another world. After discovering that he has gained superhuman pharmaceutical knowledge, he decides to open up a drugstore alongside the canine Noera and the ghostly Mina. There, he tends to the needs of all who visit the shop with potions and the like.

Cheat Kusushi no Slow Life: Isekai ni Tsukurou Drugstore follows the slow but often hectic days of Reiji's drugstore.
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is that 'Cheat Kusushi no Slow Life' is a relaxing and cute anime, perfect for casual viewing. However, many find the plot lacking in depth and the characters somewhat one-dimensional. While enjoyable for its lightheartedness, it's not considered a standout isekai due to its predictability and simple animation.
pros: Relaxing and heartwarming.
Cute and fun characters.
Episodic format makes it easy to watch casually.
cons: Lacks a compelling overarching plot.
Characters can be one-dimensional.
Repetitive and predictable.
Animation quality is mediocre.

anime.title: Hortensia SAGA
anime.synopsis:
A violent rebellion in the capital led by Duke Rugis Camellia wreaks havoc on the Kingdom of Hortensia, leaving every member of the royalty either dead or missing. Barely escaping with his life, knight Maurice Baudelaire flees the ensuing chaos after his brother, Fernando Albert, is killed by a werewolf in battle. 

To honor his legacy, Maurice treks to Albert's house and delivers his son, Alfred Ober, his father's sword. Despite his grief, Alfred is reminded of a vow he pledged with his father—to become a knight so that he could protect his land, the Albert Dominion. 

Under Maurice's tutelage, Alfred hones his combat skills to fulfill his promise. Training alongside him is Marius Casterede, an intriguing boy whose age seems to be more than meets the eye. Elsewhere, Pope Alexi Valdebron delivers the order to capture the missing princess and crowns Charlot D'Hortensia as the new king. Hortensia Saga is a tale of camaraderie and determination as Alfred, Marius, and Maurice work together with friends of past and present to bring forth light amidst Hortensia's dark times.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Hortensia Saga is mixed. Many find it enjoyable despite its generic plot and rushed execution, while others are critical of its underdeveloped characters and unsatisfying ending. The series is considered a passable watch for those seeking a simple fantasy anime, but fails to leave a lasting impression due to its numerous flaws.
pros: Enjoyable despite flaws
Decent 2D combat animation
Good art style and character design in still frames
Soundtrack and voice acting are well-done
cons: Generic story and characters
Rushed plot and pacing
Underdeveloped characters
Unsatisfying and forced ending
Poor CGI
Too many filler episodes
anime.thematic_vibe: Generic Fantasy, Kingdom Melodrama, Rushed Plot

anime.title: Back Arrow
anime.synopsis:
The world of Lingalind is surrounded by a mystical wall with seemingly nothing beyond its confines. Worshipped as the mother of the land, the wall delivers celestial gift capsules called "Rakuho'' to locations across the continent. Arriving once a month, the capsules contain metallic armbands that allow the wearer to transform into a mechanical being known as a "Briheight." As a result, Lingalind is thrown into constant turmoil by its warring nations, all hoping to strengthen their military prowess by procuring the offerings for themselves.

One day, a Rakuho crash-lands in the countryside with an unexpected inhabitant—a mysterious black-haired man. All eyes are set on this strange newcomer, who calls himself "Back Arrow," when he claims to have hailed from a place beyond the wall—a revelation that can potentially unravel Lingalind's entire dogmatic foundation.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Back Arrow are divided. Some find it to be a fun, nostalgic throwback with memorable characters and exciting twists, while others criticize its unoriginality, rushed pacing, and mediocre production quality.  The show seems to appeal more to those seeking lighthearted entertainment and over-the-top action than those looking for a deeply meaningful or technically polished experience. Despite its flaws, many viewers found it to be an enjoyable ride.
pros: Enjoyable characters with unique personalities and motivations.
Exciting and unpredictable plot twists.
Nostalgic for older mecha anime with reckless creativity.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and rushed plot development.
Over-reliance on tropes and clichés.
Mediocre CGI and animation quality.

anime.title: Re:STARS
anime.synopsis:
Qin Ze is a young man who has just entered university. From an early age he excels in singing but following a trauma, he is no longer able to sing in public.

However one day, his twin sister Qin Ya, a popular singer, will change his fate by asking him to replace her.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Jintian Kaishi Zuo Mingxing' for its comedic elements, engaging storyline, and character development. The portrayal of the entertainment industry is seen as realistic. However, some viewers find the plot far-fetched, the ending rushed, and the animation quality lacking, but these issues do not overshadow the positive reception.
pros: Engaging story with character growth.
Humorous and enjoyable plot.
Realistic portrayal of the entertainment industry.
Good relationship between the siblings.
cons: Rushed character developments and ending.
Romance felt rushed.
Far-fetched premise.
Animation quality not very good.
Voicings missed matched in the last few videos.
anime.thematic_vibe: Rom-Com, Slice of Life, Gender Bender

anime.title: Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear
anime.synopsis:
After fanatically playing the VRMMO World Fantasy Online for almost a year, the shut-in yet relatively affluent 15-year-old Yuna receives a bear costume from the game's administrators. The outfit, while somewhat embarrassing to wear, turns out to have overpowered stats and effects that make her character significantly more powerful. After accepting the bear equipment, she finds herself transported to another in-game world that prevents her from returning to reality.

Confused and unable to log out, Yuna sets out to explore this new environment. She rescues a girl named Fina from wild wolves, who then guides her to the city of Crimonia. With her eccentric bear attire, however, Yuna stands out wherever she goes, and alongside her boosted fighting prowess, her reputation quickly rises—to the point that people give her the nickname "Bloody Bear."

Undeterred by this change in her life, Yuna decides to take on the role of an adventurer and fully enjoy herself in her new world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds "Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear" to be a cute, wholesome, and relaxing isekai anime, praising its lighthearted tone and the enjoyable dynamic between characters. However, some find the plot simplistic and repetitive, lacking depth and substantial character development beyond the main character. There are criticisms about the adaptation and timeline issues in the first episode but most agree it's a good feel-good anime.
pros: Ultra-chill and relaxing viewing experience.
Great characters, especially Yuna and Fina, with a wholesome dynamic.
Unique and colorful art style enhances the cuteness.
Refreshing take on isekai tropes, focusing on real-life implications.
Good voice acting, especially Yuna's voice actor's growth throughout the series.
cons: Repetitive and lacks substantial plot depth.
Simplistic plot may not appeal to those seeking complex narratives.
The first episode is confusing due to timeline issues.
Character development primarily focuses on the main character, with others being bland.
Bad adaptation from source material

anime.title: The Light at Night in Summer
anime.synopsis: Hirofumi Mizusawa is a second year student at Nanagou High School, which is going to close this summer. One day late at night while trying to finish his summer homework, he observes a "flying orange light" from the window in his room. The next day, he tells his friends Akira and Ryo about it, and they begin to investigate the true nature of the light, but...
anime.consensus_summary: The short film is considered alright, but not exceptional. Its short length is seen as a positive, but the animation quality and underdeveloped plotlines detract from the experience. The attempt to evoke emotion falls flat due to the lack of focus and depth in the narrative.
pros: Decent background art
Short length makes it worth watching for some
cons: Poor character animation
Poorly developed emotional impact
Overstuffed plot with two underdeveloped storylines

anime.title: Stars Fall
anime.synopsis: Bai Xi and his friend Liu Chunchun experienced a bizarre car accident. Following this misfortune, Bai's new assistant Han Zhuo turns out to be a bodyguard with superpowers. Meanwhile, a famous art gallery invites Bai to hold his art exhibition under an incredibly profitable deal. Afterward, another mysterious figure by the name of Wang Yuanchen makes his appearance. As the exhibition date approaches, the truth behind the scenes begins to unfold.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is small but impressed with the storyline. The show is obscure but has unexpectedly high production quality. It's a hidden gem that deserves more attention.
pros: Intriguing plot that makes the viewer want to read the original novel.
Surprisingly remarkable anime despite low popularity.
cons: Lack of reviews and summaries makes the show unknown and difficult to discover.
Low popularity ranking indicates a small audience base.

anime.title: Hentatsu (TV)
anime.synopsis: Hentatsu follows two girls exploring a seemingly abandoned version of Nakano Broadway, a Tokyo shopping mall known for Mandarake and other shops catering to fans of anime and other forms of pop culture.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is overwhelmingly negative. Many viewers found the show pointless, unfunny, and a waste of time, criticizing its lack of story and irritating elements. A small minority who are familiar with the creators' previous work found some enjoyment in the metacommentary and jokes.
pros: Beautiful environments
Gags that land squarely (for those familiar with the creators)
cons: Nonexistent story
Unfunny jokes and irritating sound design
Poor voice acting
Pointless conversations with no meaning

anime.title: Higurashi: When They Cry – Gou
anime.romaji_title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Gou
anime.synopsis:
Rika Furude and her group of friends live in the small mountain village of Hinamizawa; in June 1983, they welcome transfer student Keiichi Maebara into their ranks, making him the only boy in their group. After school, they have fun playing games and spending each day living their lives to the fullest. Despite this seemingly normal routine, Keiichi begins noticing strange behavior from his friends, who seem to be hiding the town's dark secrets from him.

Elsewhere, a certain person watches these increasingly unsettling events unfold and remembers all the times that this, and other similar stories, have played out. Using that knowledge, this person decides to fix these broken worlds. However, when certain variables change, the individual is faced with a horrifying realization: they have no idea what to expect or how to stop the impending tragedy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reaction is highly polarized. Some appreciate the expansion of the Higurashi universe and the faithful adaptation of the visual novel's art style and deeper lore references, while others feel the sequel betrays the original's themes, suffers from poor pacing and character butchering, and fails as both a remake for newcomers and a satisfying continuation for long-time fans. The new direction taken with the story has left many feeling disappointed and that the series should have remained untouched.
pros: Voice acting is stellar, with original cast reprising their roles effectively.
New art style is faithful to the visual novel and characters are more expressive.
Expands on lore and connects to other When They Cry series, rewarding long-time fans.
cons: Story and pacing are inconsistent, with unnecessary recap and contrived plot conveniences.
New content ruins original themes and character development.
Art style is uninspired, too clean and moe, diminishing the horror atmosphere.
Fails as both a remake and a sequel, confusing newcomers and disappointing veterans.

anime.title: To Your Eternity
anime.synopsis:
An Orb, known only as It, is cast to Earth to be observed from afar. Capable of changing forms from beings whose reflections It captures, It first becomes a rock and then, due to the rising temperature, moss.

It does not move until one snowy day, a wolf at death's door barely crosses by. When It takes the animal's form, It attains awareness of its consciousness and starts to wander with an unclear destination in mind. Soon, It comes across the wolf's master—a young boy waiting for his tribe to return from a paradise abundant with fish and fruit in the south. Although the boy is lonely, he still hopes those whom he holds dear in his memories have not forgotten him and that he will reunite with them one day.

The boy wants to explore new surroundings and decides to abandon his home with It to find the paradise using the traces his tribe left behind. However, with a heavily injured body and no sight of his elder comrades, what will become of the boy?

Fumetsu no Anata e illustrates the story of an immortal being experiencing humanity, meeting all types of people in many places throughout time.
anime.consensus_summary: Fumetsu no Anata e starts with a strong emotional core and a unique premise, but the story suffers from repetitive arcs and inconsistent writing. Many viewers found the initial episodes to be masterpieces, but the overall quality declines significantly in later episodes. This leads to disappointment and a polarized audience, with some strongly recommending the first arc while advising against continuing further.
pros: The premise of an immortal being learning about humanity is captivating.
The first episode is emotionally impactful and sets a high standard.
Explores themes of love, loss, and the complexities of human emotion.
cons: Repetitive story arcs diminish emotional impact.
The quality declines after the initial episodes.
Inconsistent writing and pacing lead to a lack of narrative cohesion.
Changing cast prevents viewers from forming attachments.
World-building is weak and incomplete.
Ending arcs are disappointing and generic.

anime.title: Room Camp: Saunas and Grub and Three-Wheeler Bikes
anime.romaji_title: Heya Camp△: Sauna to Gohan to Sanrin Bike
anime.synopsis:
Upon returning from school one day, Rin Shima encounters an unfamiliar three-wheeled motorcycle parked outside her house. After asking her father about it, she learns that the vehicle is a temporary loaner while her moped undergoes its annual maintenance.  

With arrangements to go camping at Yatsugatake the next day, Rin has no choice but to utilize the three-wheeler. As she embarks on her trip, Rin's traveling experience soon shifts gears, and she discovers a refined driving performance on new unexplored roads.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers find the special episode to be a relaxing and enjoyable addition to the Yuru Camp series, praising its familiar art style, sound design, and focus on Rin's solo adventures. Any criticisms are minor, such as the lack of an opening or ending song, or the promotional aspect not being perfectly seamless.
pros: High-quality art and animation, consistent with the main series.
Relaxing and fitting sound design, utilizing familiar tracks from the first season.
Enjoyable focus on Rin Shima and her solo adventures.
Faithful to the spirit and tone of the Yuru Camp series.
cons: Lack of opening and ending song.
Promotional aspect of the episode not perfectly integrated into the story.
Minor inconsistencies in character design (helmet mask).

anime.title: Digimon Adventure:
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Kids
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2020, technology is everywhere. Every digital device around the world is connected by a singular network where data travels. Unbeknownst to humans, this network has become home to life forms known as "Digimon."

Fifth-grader Taichi Yagami is preparing for summer camp when strange occurrences begin in Tokyo; certain electronic systems have started going haywire. When he discovers that his sister and mother are trapped on an unstoppable train, he rushes to the nearby station. Suddenly, Taichi is transported to another world where he meets a strange creature by the name of Agumon, who somehow already knows his name. Taichi also receives a strange device called a "Digivice," which allows him to communicate with the undigitized world.

Taichi discovers he is in the "Network," and virus-like Digimon are attacking the areas that maintain Tokyo’s electronic systems. It is up to Taichi and his new partner Agumon to stop these cyberattacks before the whole world is threatened by the actions of mischievous Digimon.
anime.consensus_summary: The Digimon Adventure: reboot is a visually appealing but narratively weaker version of the original. While some appreciate the modern updates and action, many feel it lacks the character depth and emotional impact of the 1999 series. The show is divisive, particularly among long-time fans who find it a disappointing rehash.
pros: Improved animation quality and dynamic action sequences.
References to older Digimon games and expanded Digimon lore.
Catchy opening and evolution themes.
cons: Weak character development, with disproportionate focus on Taichi.
Poor storyline and pacing issues.
Lack of emotional resonance compared to the original series.
Underdeveloped villains with anticlimactic resolutions.

anime.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun
anime.romaji_title: Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Gore, Mystery, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
After surviving the brutal challenges of Idofront, Riko now possesses a White Whistle, allowing her to descend into the Abyss's sixth layer—The Capital of the Unreturned. Alongside Reg and Nanachi, Riko begins to explore the uncharted domain, where the ruins of the promised Golden City are located.

As the trio starts to adapt to the harsh environment, they soon encounter dangerous creatures and treacherous landscapes. Their expedition leads them to a village inhabited by strange beings known as "hollows." Despite the creeping sense of unease that welcomes them, the three venture onward to uncover the mysteries of the settlement and long-lost legacies of the forgotten adventurers who once descended into the horrors of the unexplored Abyss.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to the second season of Made in Abyss is highly divided. While some appreciate the darker themes and continued quality in visuals and sound, others are turned off by the pacing, excessive gore, and perceived fetishization. The season is criticized for feeling like a filler arc that detracts from the overall narrative.
pros: Stunning visuals and soundtrack continue to impress.
Strong world-building and character design are consistently praised.
Exploration of deep themes like trauma, sacrifice, and morality resonate with some viewers.
cons: Pacing issues, particularly in the second season, are a common complaint.
Some viewers find the excessive gore and torture, especially involving children, to be gratuitous and off-putting.
The plot can feel stagnant and disconnected from the overarching story of the Abyss.
anime.thematic_vibe: Dark Fantasy, Body Horror, Existential Dread

anime.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King
anime.synopsis: Wang Ling is a high school student with a cool and carefree demeanor. Coming off as someone with a very low spiritual force, he actually possesses a power capable of destroying the world at a moment's notice. To mitigate the volatile force within him, his parents have resorted to using an amulet as a temporary solution. However, the amulet weakens over time and Wang Ling's emotions also accelerate its deterioration. Now with the amulet on the verge of breaking, Wang Ling and his father race against time in order to fix it.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are highly divided. Some appreciate the animation and comedic elements, finding it a fun, lighthearted watch. However, many criticize the nonsensical plot, weak character development, and poor writing, deeming it a waste of time and a significant letdown compared to the source material or similar anime.
pros: Animation quality is good, especially action scenes.
Unique comedic style, refreshing compared to Japanese anime.
Enjoyable for those looking for light-hearted entertainment.
cons: Poorly written story with numerous plot holes and irrational decisions.
Characters lack depth and development.
Forced comedy and rushed backstories.
Inconsistent power scaling and unexplained events.
Bad subtitles making it hard to follow the plot

anime.title: Koikimo
anime.romaji_title: Koi to Yobu ni wa Kimochi Warui
anime.synopsis:
People fall in love in the most mysterious of ways. This statement seems to be especially true for the affluent genius playboy Ryou Amakusa. When he nearly falls off the stairs one rainy morning, a girl named Ichika Arima saves him. As if by fate, Ryou encounters Ichika again later that night; she happens to be the best friend of his little sister, Rio.

Wanting to "thank" her, Ryou attempts to woo Ichika by employing his usual flirtatious tactics only to be immediately shot down, his target creeped out by his behavior. Rather than being discouraged, Ryou instead becomes more enthralled by her, and he begins to do everything he can to steal Ichika's heart despite receiving disgusted reactions each time. However, as time passes by, will Ichika remain repulsed by Ryou's creepy yet dedicated advances?
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is highly divisive due to its problematic premise involving a large age gap and potentially predatory behavior. While some viewers appreciate the character development and comedic elements, the majority are critical of the questionable ethics and normalization of harassment. The audience is polarized, with strong opinions on both sides regarding the show's suitability and message.
pros: Some viewers found the art style cute and appealing.
The opening and ending themes were generally well-received.
A few viewers appreciated the exploration of character growth and change, particularly in Ryo.
Some viewers enjoyed the dynamic between the characters, calling it funny and heart-warming.
cons: The premise of the anime, involving a significant age gap and potential grooming, is highly controversial and off-putting for many viewers.
Many reviewers criticized the male lead's behavior as stalking and harassment.
Some felt the characters were bland, underdeveloped, and lacked chemistry.
Several reviewers found the story poorly executed, unrealistic, and lacking in meaningful plot progression.
Some found the animation and sound quality to be subpar.
Some critics found the ending unsatisfying and unbelievable.
Many viewers criticized the lack of societal disapproval within the anime, making the problematic relationship seem normalized.
anime.thematic_vibe: Uncomfortable Romance, Questionable Ethics, Age Gap

anime.title: Log Horizon: Destruction of the Round Table
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Fantasy, Video Game
anime.synopsis:
Third season of Log Horizon.

It's been a year since Shiroe and his friends were trapped in Akiba due to the Catastrophe. Their forging of the Round Table has brought order and prosperity to its people. But fracturing political alliances and the constant menace of the Genius monsters threaten to destabilize all they've fought for and built. Can faith be restored and they persevere, or is its destruction truly inevitable?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Log Horizon: Entaku Houkai is mixed, with many feeling disappointed compared to the first two seasons. While some appreciate the world-building and MMORPG elements, many criticize the slow pacing, shift in focus to less appealing characters, and rushed plot development. The season is considered a letdown, failing to live up to the standards set by its predecessors and leaving fans wanting more substantial content.
pros: World-building is strong with detailed politics and economics.
Faithful to MMORPG elements; author understands the genre.
Some enjoyable arcs, particularly focusing on Krusty and Minori.
cons: Pacing issues, feels slow and drawn out.
Focus shifts to less likable child characters.
Inconsistent quality in episodes and rushed plot lines.
Lack of significant character development for main cast.
Underdeveloped or forced political plot elements.

anime.title: The Millionaire Detective – Balance: Unlimited
anime.synopsis: Daisuke Kanbe, a man of extraordinary wealth, is assigned to the Modern Crime Prevention Headquarters as a detective. It is there that he gets partnered with Haru Katou, a humane detective who values justice above all. The two are polar opposites, and their morals clash time and time again. Haru despises Daisuke for using monetary wealth to solve cases, as he believes that money is not everything. They will have to combine their efforts, however, to solve the mysteries that are coming their way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers enjoyed the unique premise, character dynamics, and entertainment value, while others were disappointed by the rushed story, underdeveloped plot, and tonal inconsistencies. The show's potential was seen as wasted by some due to these issues.
pros: Unique concept of a millionaire detective
Good chemistry between the main characters, Katou and Daisuke
Entertaining and fun to watch
Good art style and character design
cons: Rushed story and underdeveloped plot
Episodic nature of early episodes feels redundant
Lack of character development for supporting characters
Tonal shift from lighthearted comedy to darker approach is jarring

anime.title: Princess Principal: Crown Handler - Chapter 3
anime.synopsis:
While the funeral of the assassinated Prince Edward, who was the first in line to succeed the throne, is being held, the nobles of the Kingdom of Albion discuss topics such as whether the second-in-line Princess Mary or the third-in-line Duke of Arkham, Prince Richard, will succeed the throne, and how the Duke of Normandy will act.

The Duke of Arkham asks Princess if she will side with him or the Duke of Normandy. While wishing to change the world so that all people are equal, Princess is shaken by the Duke of Arkham, who is the mastermind behind Edward's assassination. Meanwhile, Ange and Dorothy are given a mission to infiltrate as Mary's maids and investigate the state of the royal family by the Commonwealth's control. Mary is crushed and exhausted due to the pressure of becoming first in line to the throne. As chaos surrounds the succession to the throne, the Duke of Arkham's plot finally begins to unfold.

The darkness writhing in the Kingdom of Albion begins to swallow up Team White Pigeon.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the third movie, praising its intricate plot and world-building. Some felt there was more exposition than previous installments, but overall, viewers are eager for the next installment. The film successfully continues the Crown Handler arc with political intrigue and espionage elements.
pros: Compelling narrative with complex allegiances.
Good world-building and storytelling.
Exciting plot development.
cons: More exposition than previous movies.

anime.title: Love Live! SuperStar!!
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Everyone has a dream they strive to achieve, and so does the musically talented Kanon Shibuya. However, due to her stage fright, Kanon fails to make it into Yuigaoka Girls' High School's music program and instead ends up in the general curriculum. Even though Kanon makes the conscious decision to quit music altogether, her classmate Tang Keke rekindles Kanon's passion for music with her own: a passion for school idols.

Although Keke and Kanon try to form a school idol group, their effort meets strong objections from Ren Hazuki, the daughter of the school's director. Even so, the girls soon visit the director, who allows them to set up their school idol club under one condition—they must win first place at the Yoyogi School Idol Festival.

The resilience of these aspiring idols is put to the test as they face the challenges that come their way. Throughout their journey, the girls make new friends and meet new members that join them to become the dazzling idols others can only imagine.
anime.consensus_summary: Love Live! Superstar!! is generally well-received, especially as a potential entry point into the franchise. The series is praised for its animation, music, and focus on character-driven slice-of-life elements. Some find the plot predictable and character arcs rushed, but overall, the audience enjoys the refreshing take on the idol genre.
pros: Fresh take on the Love Live franchise, focusing on character development and comedy.
Visually appealing with detailed backgrounds and smooth animation.
Catchy and emotional music with great voice acting.
cons: Formulaic plot elements and overused cliches.
Rushed character development, particularly Kanon's stage fright.
Smaller cast may not appeal to fans of previous Love Live series with larger ensembles.

anime.title: My TYRANO: Together, Forever
anime.synopsis: Two dinosaurs, differently unfit for life, a T-Rex who doesn't want to be a predator and a little pterodactyl who doesn't want to fly, begin a long and hard journey to reach a legendary valley called Paradise
anime.consensus_summary: The film is generally well-received as a children's movie, with endearing characters and a simple yet touching story. While the narrative and sound design may lack depth for some adults, it is considered a pleasant viewing experience for its target audience. The overall mood is positive, emphasizing the film's heartwarming qualities and suitability for children.
pros: Endearing characters with clear motivations.
Suitable for children and enjoyable for adults who are not too critical.
Visually appealing art style.
cons: Simplistic story and characters may not appeal to all adults.
Forgettable sound design.

anime.title: Infinite Ryvius Light
anime.synopsis: Mugen no Ryvius specials released on the 3-part fan disc "Mugen no Ryvius: Light." Three episodes were dedicated to a self-titled picture drama (but are animated normally). The other three episodes were dedicated "Avant-Title," a first-person POV style of specials.
anime.consensus_summary: The Mugen no Ryvius: Light specials are well-received by fans of the main series due to their high production quality and supplementary character backstories. However, the episodes' brevity limits the depth of content. Overall, the audience mood is positive, viewing the specials as a worthwhile addition for those already invested in the Mugen no Ryvius universe.
pros: High animation quality for specials
Adds to character backstories
Enjoyable for fans of the main show
cons: Episodes are very short
Lacks in-depth content due to shortness

anime.title: Digimon Adventure: 20th Memorial Story
anime.synopsis:
A crowdfunding campaign opened for the "Digimon Adventure Memorial Story Project." It was for 5 shorts that included a prequel of the upcoming film and side stories about the daily lives of the Digimon characters and their partners, which are stories that did not make it into the film. 

The campaign was successfully backed.
anime.consensus_summary: The '20-Shuunen Memorial Story' is a mixed bag for Digimon fans. Some episodes offer great character development and nostalgic callbacks that resonate with longtime viewers, while others are considered weak or even contradictory to the original series. Overall, it's a worthwhile watch for dedicated fans, especially for the character-focused episodes.
pros: Character development, especially among the Digimon themselves
Exploration of mature themes and relationships
Nostalgic callbacks to the original Adventure series
cons: Inconsistent episode quality
Some episodes retcon established lore
Animation quality not a strong point

anime.title: Wan Jie Shen Zhu 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Second season of Wan Jie She Zhu.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience seems to find the plot repetitive. Although the action and power progression are enjoyable, the storyline mirrors the previous season, and a good part of the season is spent on world exploration, which is both good and bad.
pros: Exciting action sequences
Intriguing world building
Unlocking of deity powers
cons: Repetitive plot structure resembling Season 1
Slow pacing with extensive exploration and discovery episodes
