Due to poor lifestyle choices, a certain human's body is in constant turmoil. With germs, bacteria, and foreign substances abound, the jobs of various cells become increasingly difficult and dangerous. As some of the unfortunate ones who matured in this chaotic environment, Sekkekkyuu AA2153 and Hakkekkyuu U-1196 strive to fulfill their duties—even if it means seeing many of their fellow cells lose their lives in duty.

Set in an environment vastly different from its parent story, Hataraku Saibou Black portrays the cells' struggles as they try to maintain the body's health. However, the human's condition continues to deteriorate, and whether or not these efforts will amount to something concrete depends on the cells!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Hataraku Saibou Black for its darker and more mature take on the original series, finding it both educational and engaging. While some criticize the over-sexualization and occasional repetition, the overall consensus is positive, praising the character development and the exploration of serious health issues. Many viewers found the anime inspiring in terms of making healthier lifestyle choices.
pros: Informative and educational about the human body and the effects of unhealthy habits.
Strong character development and exploration of darker themes.
Unique and engaging story premise with high stakes.
cons: Over-sexualization of characters.
Some repetition of information from the original series.
Occasional animation inconsistencies.

anime.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
anime.romaji_title: Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Military, Romance
anime.synopsis:
After the death of his grandfather, 19-year-old Kazuya Souma—an aspiring civil servant—is left all alone with no one to call family. Out of the blue, he is transported to the Elfrieden Kingdom, a small ailing country in another world, to be a "hero." An ongoing war with the demon army has put the entire world in peril, and Kazuya was summoned to aid in the conflict as an offering from Elfrieden to its allies.

Dissatisfied with being used as tribute, Kazuya decides to help the kingdom revamp its declining economy—not by way of adventuring or war, but through administrative reform. Abruptly declared the King of Elfrieden and betrothed to the princess, the "Realist Hero" Kazuya sets out to assemble a group of talented citizens who will assist him in his bureaucratic battles to get the kingdom back on its feet.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are mixed, with some finding the focus on kingdom-building and political elements refreshing within the Isekai genre. However, many criticize the poor execution, including lackluster animation, slow pacing, and shallow political writing. The series is seen as having potential, but ultimately falls short due to its flaws.
pros: Interesting story plot about an Isekai where politics and power play come into mind.
Novelty to treating statecraft as more than an afterthought in a fantasy series.
Characters aren't completely stupid, they have flaws but are intelligent, capable of making not asinine decisions
cons: Never-ending, bloated dialogue and paradoxical scenarios.
Worldbuilding is filled with more holes than swiss cheese.
The supposed administrative reforms are rather hollow and strike the viewer as common sense.
Too much harem and clueless MC
Poor pacing
Lackluster art and animation.

anime.title: Heaven's Design Team
anime.genres: Comedy, Educational, Fantasy, Gag Humor, Mythology, Seinen, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth. He also sought after a wide variety of animals to populate the planet. However, he felt that it was too tiresome to think of new ideas within his criteria. To address this problem, God appointed an organization—the Heaven's Design Team—to do the work instead!

Shimoda is a newly-hired angel who serves as the mediator between God and the design team. As he steps into his role, he witnesses his coworkers conceive interesting ideas for many unique life forms according to God's desires. From giraffes and snakes to birds, anteaters, and everything in between, the possibilities for different animal species are endless!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Tenchi Souzou Design-bu' to be a delightful and educational anime. Its comedic approach to biology and animal design is appreciated, making learning fun and accessible. While some find the lack of a strong plot and basic animation to be drawbacks, the overall consensus is that it's a lighthearted and enjoyable watch.
pros: Informative and educational content presented in an engaging way.
Charming and well-defined characters with unique personalities.
Upbeat and catchy opening theme.
Bright and colorful art style that is pleasing to watch.
cons: Lacks a strong overarching plot and can feel episodic.
Animation quality is sometimes basic and uninspired.
Characters are not deeply complex; mainly defined by one or two traits.
Humor can be repetitive or strange at times.

anime.title: BanG Dream! Movie: Episode of Roselia - I: Yakusoku
anime.romaji_title: BanG Dream! Movie: Episode of Roselia - I: Yakusoku
anime.synopsis: To reach the stage of "FES.", Yukina Minato decides to form a band. Each holding their own convictions, the members of the band come together. The five girls now begin their journey to the top as Roselia... This is the story of their "promise" made to each other, from the start of the band to their challenge towards FUTURE WORLD FES!
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is primarily targeted towards existing fans of the BanG Dream! franchise, particularly those familiar with Roselia's band stories from the game. While fans appreciate the nostalgia and celebration of the band, newcomers may find the pacing rushed and the story lacking in depth. The movie serves as a recap for dedicated followers but fails to deliver a comprehensive or emotionally resonant experience for a broader audience.
pros: Good recap for existing fans of Roselia.
Celebration of Roselia's music and characters.
Consistent art style with seasons 2 and 3.
cons: Rushed pacing and missing details from the original story.
Lacking in story and character development for newcomers.
Assumes prior knowledge of the game and band stories.
Weak background soundtrack and emotional impact.

anime.title: BanG Dream! Movie: Episode of Roselia - II: Song I Am.
anime.romaji_title: BanG Dream! Movie: Episode of Roselia - II: Song I Am.
anime.synopsis:
After overcoming numerous tribulations, the members of Roselia promised to appear on FUTURE WORLD FES.
It is now Autumn...

Through writing the lyrics of "Promise," Lisa has matured.
Watching the change of color in the autumn leaves, Yukina and Sayo expressed their resolve in a picture letter to their future selves.
Driven by the wish to do something for Roselia, Rinko has started to compose a new song.
"The remaining quests are the contest, the tournament, and FUTURE WORLD FES..."
Reflecting on their goals, Ako starts to feel anxious.

What view will the five of them see beyond FUTURE WORLD FES?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed the movie, noting improvements in pacing and character development compared to the prequel. The animation is considered good overall, with minor flaws. There is a consensus that this movie is a positive step for the franchise.
pros: Improved pacing compared to the prequel.
Sufficient depth of character development.
Fluid animation with well-drawn models.
cons: Occasional janky gesticulations in the animation.

anime.title: Iwa Kakeru! Sport Climbing Girls
anime.synopsis:
Video games, especially puzzle games, were always at the center of Konomi Kasahara's life. However, upon entering Hanamiya High School, she decides to break away from this lifestyle. As Konomi wanders the halls in search of a new activity to engage herself in, she stumbles upon a gigantic wall owned by the school's rock climbing team. Fascinated, she attempts to scale the wall, discovering that she can use her puzzle-solving skills to help her reach the top.

Certain that she has found her calling, Konomi immediately joins the club. As she strives to improve her climbing skills, Konomi, alongside the rest of the Hanamiya Climbing Team, will learn what it truly means to be a "sports climber" and work to achieve victory in the upcoming competitions.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers enjoyed the anime for its educational aspects, animation, and the unique focus on sport climbing. However, many found the plot rushed, character development lacking, and the fan service unnecessary, leading to an overall average rating. The series is appreciated more for its concept than its execution.
pros: Educational about competitive climbing, rules, and team dynamics.
Enjoyable for those interested in CGDCT and outdoor activities.
Good music and animation.
cons: Narratively weak, with a small and self-contained scale.
Unrealistic progression of the protagonist's climbing skills.
Overly sexualized fan service.
Rushed plot and underdeveloped rivals.
Shallow character development.

anime.title: Spring and Autumn
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: Ye Chen, who is an ancient god, has fallen from the world of the gods to the world of the blue world. Here, hundreds of thousands of countries are standing, and the heroes are fighting for hegemony. Ye Chen has been in this pale blue world for hundreds of years and has established a huge force. In Baizhou Qianguo, the existence of Ye Chen has always been a legend. But the power from the world of the gods slowly extended to the blue world, and a cruel dragon battle is about to begin. In the capital city of Nanzhou, the first battle of Tianbei State, Hong Xu and the Wulong two men of Nanzhou Shuangyuemen Gate competed outside the Huashen Palace, but they were defeated in the hands of Su Xiaoxiao, the group leader of the Huashen Palace. The Northern Army emerged in the eastern part of southern South China and wanted to break South. The defender will disregard the safety of the people of Nanzhou and the hurricane, and intends to open the city gate to surrender
anime.consensus_summary: The reviews indicate disappointment with the ending of 'Wan Jie Chun Qiu,' with concerns about rushed pacing and a lack of resolution. While the journey may be enjoyable, the abrupt conclusion leaves viewers unsatisfied. There is some intrigue regarding the plot around Ancient Clans and totems.
cons: Rushed ending
Story lacks resolution
Abrupt conclusion

anime.title: The Vampire Dies in No Time
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Fantasy, Gag Humor, Shounen, Urban Fantasy, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
Vampires are known to have many weaknesses that balance out their incredible power, but the vampire lord Draluc happens to be weak to pretty much anything.

The vampire hunter Ronald receives a job to infiltrate the castle of the so-called "Invincible Progenitor" and rescue a woman's son from the monster within. But upon arriving, he is dumbfounded to discover that the vampire quickly turns to ash by something as trivial as a clap of his hands! Moreover, the child he was sent to save had merely wandered in to play the vampire lord's video games while he slept!

In a disastrous turn of events, Draluc's castle is destroyed, and the fragile vampire decides to move in with the hunter who has only just defeated him. Ronald, Draluc, and the vampire's pet armadillo John form quite the eccentric team as they are forced to work together while fending off Ronald's violent editor, the lesser vampires plaguing the city, and even their fellow vampire hunters.
anime.consensus_summary: Kyuuketsuki Sugu Shinu is a lighthearted comedy that relies on absurd humor and parody. While many find it hilarious and enjoy the characters, especially John, others find the humor repetitive or the lack of plot a drawback. The show is best enjoyed for its episodic gags and energetic animation, but some viewers may lose interest in the later episodes.
pros: Excellent comedic timing and jokes when it lands
Fun and energetic animation style by Madhouse
Memorable and endearing characters, especially John the armadillo
The OP and ED are catchy and well-received
cons: Humor can be juvenile, repetitive, or uncomfortable at times
Episodic format lacks an overarching plot and character development
Some viewers find the jokes explaining ruins the comedy
Quality dips in later episodes for some viewers with overuse of adult jokes

anime.title: King's Raid: Successors of the Will
anime.synopsis:
Long ago, the king of Orvelia, Kyle, defeated the demon king Angmund and brought peace to the world. However, one hundred years later, demons have been sighted in the forests, threatening humanity once more. A scouting expedition is sent to verify the claim but only one member returns. Meanwhile, Riheet, the leader of a dark elf mercenary group, plots to take over Orvelia to exact revenge against the humans who forsook their race a century ago.

The knight apprentice Kasel, accompanied by the priestess Frey, sets out to rescue Clause, an old friend who went missing in the tragic mission. However, along the way,  Kasel discovers that he is the son of the revered King Kyle and the only one who can wield the Holy Sword Aea—the same sword that slew the demon king. To fulfill this destiny, the young knight must embark on a perilous quest, unseal the sword, and end the fear instilled by demons. As Kasel's journey to bring hope to humanity and Riheet's vow for vengeance intertwine, what fate could possibly await them?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding the anime to be a generic but watchable fantasy series. While some appreciate the world-building and character designs, the uninspired plot, mediocre animation, and weak main character are common criticisms. The series has some redeeming qualities, but ultimately fails to stand out in the crowded fantasy genre.
pros: Good world-building with history and events leading up to the plot.
Decent animation and visually appealing character designs.
Enjoyable secondary characters that add fun to the show.
Alternating perspectives between main and secondary protagonists.
cons: Generic and predictable storyline with a chosen hero on a quest.
Mediocre animation, especially in action scenes.
Main character lacks personality and is boring.
Pacing issues with slow development and unnecessary subplots.
Ending is disappointing and rushed.
anime.thematic_vibe: Generic Fantasy, Classic RPG, Good vs Evil

anime.title: The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter
anime.synopsis:
Despite his noble title, Noir Stalgia is at the bottom of the social hierarchy. Because of this, his fellow nobles oppress him and treat him like garbage. However, he possesses a rare yet powerful ability to communicate with the Great Sage, an oracle who grants Noir the answer to absolutely anything.

After failing to secure a job as a librarian, Noir decides to join the Hero Academy. He knows he must become stronger to enter the institution. The Great Sage advises him to explore a hidden dungeon deep within the mountains. There, Noir meets Olivia Servant, a beautiful yet enchained maiden trapped within the labyrinth. Olivia bestows upon Noir a set of ridiculously powerful skills that grants him virtually total control over reality. Naturally, there is a catch—every time Noir attempts to use his powers, his life points decrease, putting his life at risk. To replenish his energy, he must give in to worldly pleasures such as kissing his childhood friend!

With his newfound powers, Noir begins his journey as a student in the Hero Academy, meeting new acquaintances and helping them through the dire situations ahead.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers enjoying the anime as a 'guilty pleasure' due to its ecchi and harem elements, while others criticize its generic plot, weak characters, and poor execution. The show is generally considered unremarkable and forgettable for those not specifically seeking this genre. Some find it self-aware and entertaining, while others find it cringeworthy and a waste of time.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the ecchi harem genre.
Some find the premise and characters fun and hilarious.
The art is considered nice by some viewers.
Shamelessly indulgent and surprisingly competently done in the lightweight 'guilty pleasure' category.
cons: Generic and uninspired plot with a focus on fan service.
Weak character development, especially for the harem members.
Poorly choreographed and animated action sequences.
Inconsistencies and plot holes.
The main character can be considered a bland self-insert.

anime.title: Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Mythology, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Half-demon twins Towa and Setsuna were always together, living happily in Feudal Japan. But their joyous days come to an end when a forest fire separates them and Towa is thrown through a portal to modern-day Japan. There, she is found by Souta Higurashi, who raises her as his daughter after Towa finds herself unable to return to her time.

Ten years later, 14-year-old Towa is a relatively well-adjusted student, despite the fact that she often gets into fights. However, unexpected trouble arrives on her doorstep in the form of three visitors from Feudal Japan; Moroha, a bounty hunter; Setsuna, a demon slayer and Towa's long-lost twin sister; and Mistress Three-Eyes, a demon seeking a mystical object. Working together, the girls defeat their foe, but in the process, Towa discovers to her horror that Setsuna has no memory of her at all. Hanyou no Yashahime: Sengoku Otogizoushi follows the three girls as they endeavor to remedy Setsuna's memory loss, as well as discover the truth about their linked destinies.
anime.consensus_summary: Yashahime is largely viewed as a disappointing sequel that fails to live up to the Inuyasha legacy. While some appreciate the nostalgic elements and faithful art style, the majority criticize the weak plot, shallow characters, and inconsistencies with the original series.  The controversial romantic pairing and overall lack of depth have alienated many fans, resulting in a polarized audience.
pros: Faithful art style to the original Inuyasha.
Nostalgic value for long-time Inuyasha fans (initially).
Enjoyable new cast (some viewers)
Good audio, especially the OP and ED themes (for some).
cons: Weak and uninspired plot, feeling like a cheap rehash.
Poor character development and shallow characterizations.
Over-reliance on nostalgia without adding anything new or substantial.
Plot holes and inconsistencies that contradict the original series.
Underdeveloped villains with weak motivations.
Inappropriate romantic pairing (Sesshomaru and Rin) perceived as grooming.
Repetitive fight sequences and lack of tension.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Rushed or slow pacing issues.
Unnecessary or poorly executed fan service.

anime.title: Are You OK?
anime.genres: Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
The current government is seeking outsiders and granting them positions according to their abilities in order to update their backwards country and create a new world! Zuo Yunqi is just an ordinary young master, but to save his father, he disguises himself as an outsider to join the government.

Unfortunately, his disguise is broken by a man hired specifically to identify who's a real outsider and who isn't. In their battle of wits, the two of them end up in many comedic situations and eventually become allies. As the two of them stop a shocking conspiracy, they discover that some of the outsiders have formed their own alliance to revolt against those in power and create a new society of peace and equality. Zuo Yunqi and his friends are forced to join in and become a part of this battle...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers found the show surprisingly engaging, blending humor with a thought-provoking storyline. While the initial comedic focus may not appeal to everyone, those who persevere are rewarded with unique characters and a compelling narrative.
pros: Stellar adaptation of the novel, seamlessly combining different character arcs.
Humor is effective and contributes to the story, especially with understanding of Chinese culture.
Unique and entertaining characters with compelling relationships.
cons: Initial focus on humor may deter some viewers before the serious story develops.
Romance is minimal, which may disappoint some viewers.

anime.title: The Island of Siliang
anime.synopsis: A stubborn girl on a mysterious island, her dreams of becoming a martial artist, and her complicated love story.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive about 'Juan Siliang', praising its animation, character development, and storyline. Some viewers find the initial episodes confusing due to the dense world-building, but the majority appreciate the unfolding narrative and the engaging characters. The show is considered visually stunning and a worthwhile watch, especially for fans of Chinese animation.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation quality.
Interesting and well-developed characters, especially the female lead, Tu Li.
Intriguing storyline with elements of mystery and political intrigue between rival families.
cons: Confusing and overwhelming amount of information in the initial episodes.
Complex premise and world-building that are not well-introduced.
Male lead, Jing Xuan, initially feels like a Mary Sue.
anime.thematic_vibe: Martial Arts, Complicated Relationships, Divine Realm

anime.title: A Will Eternal
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis:
One will to create oceans. One will to summon the mulberry fields.

One will to slaughter countless devils. One will to eradicate innumerable immortals.

Only my will… is eternal.

A Will Eternal tells the tale of Bai Xiaochun, an endearing but exasperating young man who is driven primarily by his fear of death and desire to live forever, but who deeply values friendship and family.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys 'Yi Nian Yong Heng' for its comedic elements and character development, although some find the pacing slow and the number of characters overwhelming. The animation and fight scenes are considered decent. The series is highly recommended for those who enjoy Chinese anime and cultivation stories.
pros: Comedic character lightens the mood.
Good character development.
Decent animation and fight scenes.
High-quality art, voice-acting, story, and comedy.
cons: Slow story progression.
Too many characters with hard-to-remember Chinese names.
Protagonist's character traits may not appeal to everyone.
Character development arcs are weak early on.

anime.title: The Day I Became a God
anime.synopsis:
Dressed in a conspicuous outfit and armed with an eccentric spirit, Hina Satou goes around insisting that she is the Asgardian god "Odin." When she crosses paths with a boy named Youta Narukami, she uses her precognition abilities to warn him about an impending catastrophe threatening the end of the world. But being a teenager preoccupied with his problems, Youta finds it hard to believe such a preposterous claim.

Somehow forced to tag along with her antics, he witnesses the effectiveness of Hina's skills with his own eyes and realizes that she truly is capable of divination. Nevertheless, despite her persistence in being a god, Hina is still a child who desires to see and experience the wonders life has to offer. With the world ending in 30 days, Hina, Youta, and their friends venture forward to create lasting memories they will cherish forever.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are significantly divided, with some praising the show's emotional depth and quality production values, while others criticize its inconsistent plot, underdeveloped characters, and reliance on tired melodramatic tropes. Many feel the show fails to live up to its potential, especially in its second half, leading to disappointment. The ending is particularly divisive, with some finding it emotionally resonant while others consider it manipulative.
pros: Strong emotional impact and tearjerker ending for some viewers.
Good art and animation quality, especially for Key projects.
Memorable and emotional OST that enhances key scenes.
Entertaining and funny early episodes that provide a lighthearted tone.
Well-written story and likeable characters, leading to strong emotional connection for many.
cons: Inconsistent plot and tonal shifts, particularly in the second half.
Underdeveloped supporting characters and wasted potential.
Predictable story twists and reliance on cliches.
Controversial use of a mentally disabled character.
Forced melodrama that feels unearned.
Pacing issues, with too much filler and rushed climax.

anime.title: World's End Harem
anime.synopsis:
Reito Mizuhara is a medical student at the National Advanced Medical School in Tokyo who contracts a rare, lethal disease called cellular sclerosis. In order to be treated, he is put into cryogenic sleep for five years. Upon awakening, he learns that a year into his slumber, a worldwide pandemic broke out, caused by the novel Male Killer (MK) virus which exclusively afflicts males and has killed all other men on Earth. 

Fortunately, Reito and four other men were spared during their cryosleep and are now immune to the virus. As the only men left in the world, they are thus tasked with mating with as many women as possible to repopulate the planet. However, Reito is committed to his childhood friend and sole love interest, Elisa Tachibana—only to learn that she went missing three years ago. While the other male survivors adapt accordingly to this new world, Reito instead chooses to pursue Elisa, fight never-ending temptation, and investigate this mysterious virus.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to "Shuumatsu no Harem" is highly polarized. While some viewers appreciate the unique premise and character development, especially within the ecchi genre, a significant portion criticizes the show for its shallow plot, underdeveloped characters (particularly the protagonist), and inconsistent tone. Many feel it fails to live up to its narrative potential, often being dismissed as a crude male fantasy.
pros: Interesting premise with potential for deeper exploration of themes like survival and societal impact.
Some characters, particularly Doi, show promising development and complexity.
Animation quality is generally considered good, with no reliance on 3D.
Sound design and music are often cited as above average and fitting.
The ecchi elements are sometimes seen as integral to the plot rather than purely gratuitous.
cons: The protagonist, Reito, is frequently criticized for being boring, indecisive, and uninteresting, particularly his refusal to engage in the core premise.
The plot is often described as rushed, underdeveloped, or inconclusive, especially given the short episode count.
Despite attempts at serious storytelling, the show is often perceived as a shallow male fantasy or a poorly executed hentai.
Female characters are often considered one-dimensional or lacking significant personality.
The show's tone is inconsistent, attempting to blend serious themes with explicit fan service, which alienates some viewers.

anime.title: Yuki Yuna is a Hero - Churutto!
anime.romaji_title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru Churutto!
anime.synopsis: Set in year 300 of the Era of the Gods, heroes and shrine maidens were summoned after a crisis befell on the sacred tree. The Sanshu Middle School Hero Club was transformed into a bountiful household with 27 of them gathered together. Headed by someone who has a strong sense of companionship, Fu Inubozaki, she is determined to make it an Udon Hero Club!
anime.consensus_summary: The general audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, with viewers appreciating the show's lighthearted and cheerful nature. Many find it to be a comforting and enjoyable experience, especially when in need of a mood boost. While some may find it overly simplistic, the show's overall charm and positive vibes resonate strongly with its target audience.
pros: Heartwarming, feel-good content
Cute chibi art style
Large cast of well-rounded characters
cons: Simplistic plot
May not appeal to viewers seeking complex narratives
Can be repetitive

anime.title: She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man
anime.romaji_title: Kenja no Deshi wo Nanoru Kenja
anime.genres: Adventure, Fantasy, Isekai, Magical Sex Shift
anime.synopsis:
With a dignified veteran's body and a long white beard, summoner mage Dunbalf was one of the strongest player characters in the virtual reality online multiplayer roleplaying game Ark Earth Online, even heralded as a one-man army. Together with the "Nine Wise Mages" and King Solomon, they formed the mage player Kingdom of Alcait. But one day, Dunbalf and the other Nine Wise Mages suddenly go missing, leaving no trace behind.

In an effort to spend his expiring credits, Dunbalf had purchased a cosmetic kit and tinkered with his character; however, he accidentally fell asleep during the customization process. Upon waking up, Dunbalf not only notices that the world of Ark Earth Online has become more realistic, but also discovers that he has turned into a cute girl! After reaching Alcait, he learns it has been 30 years since he supposedly disappeared.

Now tasked with finding the other missing mages by King Solomon, the avid role player proclaims his new identity as Mira—the Pupil of the Wise Man Dunbalf—and ventures forth to prove his legacy.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely considered a generic and poorly executed isekai with significant flaws in animation, story, and character development. While some viewers found the main character cute and the series enjoyable as simple entertainment, the majority express disappointment due to low production quality and uninspired writing. The show fails to capitalize on its gender-bender premise and ultimately offers a forgettable experience.
pros: Some found the main character adorable and enjoyable.
A few viewers considered it a fun, relaxing, and easily bingeable series.
The OP and ED themes were considered nice by some.
cons: Widespread criticism of bad CGI and poor animation quality with still frames.
Complaints about a generic, uninspired, and forgettable story.
Characters are one-dimensional and lack development.
Pacing issues with many scenes deemed needless.
Music and sound design are generic and misplaced.
Overreliance on tropes and lack of originality.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Chronicle
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Military, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis: The compilation film recaps the anime's 59 episodes from seasons one to three.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally agrees that "Shingeki no Kyojin: Chronicle" serves its purpose as a recap for viewers preparing for season 4. However, many find it to be a poor substitute for watching the original series due to its rushed pacing and lack of emotional impact. Most agree it is not for new viewers and serves only as a refresher.
pros: Good recap for refreshing memory before season 4.
Highlights key events and best moments of the first three seasons.
Concise and well-organized for those wanting a quick overview.
cons: Condensing 59 episodes into 2 hours leads to a rushed and incomplete experience.
Lacks emotional depth and character development compared to the original series.
May be confusing for new viewers unfamiliar with the Attack on Titan universe.

anime.title: Jiang Ziya
anime.synopsis:
Years ago, Jiang Ziya, the head disciple of Jingxu Hall, joined his master in a ravaging war to fight demons and capture the Nine-Tailed Fox Demon. Known to be the first to climb the Stairway to Heaven, he was expected to become the leader of gods.

However, Jiang Ziya's final task to execute the Nine-Tailed soon took a turn for the worse when the demon created an illusion and showed Jiang Ziya an innocent girl trapped inside her. Growing doubtful, he freed the fox spirit to save the girl. As a punishment for his transgression, Jiang Ziya was banished to the North Sea, with his divine power sealed, until he would no longer be plagued by the Nine-Tailed's mirage.

Ten years later, Jiang Ziya dwells in the North Sea alongside his friend Shen Gongbao and his pet Si Bu Xiang. At a bar, Jiang Ziya meets Xiao Jiu—who resembles the girl from the illusion. When he asks her about the Nine-Tailed Fox Demon's bracelet on her ankle, she tells him that the accessory reveals to her a place where black flowers bloom. Conflicted over what to believe, Jiang Ziya accompanies Xiao Jiu to Mount Youdu. Thus, the two begin a formidable journey that might uncover not only the truth Jiang Ziya has been searching for, but also shocking facts about the great war of the past.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many appreciate the stunning visuals and animation quality, while others find the plot confusing and inaccessible without background knowledge of Chinese mythology. The film's pacing and lack of context are also points of criticism, leading to a somewhat polarized reception.
pros: Outstanding 3D animation and visuals
Well-choreographed action scenes
Appealing character designs
cons: Story can be difficult to understand without prior knowledge of Chinese mythology
Pacing issues and unclear context
Ending requires external explanation

anime.title: Bem Movie: Become Human
anime.synopsis:
Take place 2 years after the last episode of the TV series.

Detective Sonia Summers are tracking Bem and the others. She reunited with Belo, who is fighting a dark organization alone. He brought her to Bem, but Bem doesn't remember anything and living in the city as an ordinary employee... or that is what he thought he was.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions are mixed. Some viewers found the movie enjoyable due to its premise and exploration of the main character's emotions. However, others were disappointed by the mediocre execution, pacing issues, and lack of character development, resulting in a polarized experience.
pros: Exploration of Bem's desires and motivations.
Improved emotional investment compared to the first season.
cons: Mediocre execution.
Inconsistencies and rapid-fire pacing issues.
Poor character designs and forgettable characters.
Dull music during the final fight.

anime.title: Jing-Ju Cats 3
anime.romaji_title: Jingju Mao Zhi Cheng Feng Polang
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Kids, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Third season of Jingju Mao.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers praise the storyline, music, character development, and unique aesthetic rooted in traditional Chinese elements. The show's broad appeal and well-executed action sequences contribute to its high recommendation.
pros: Top-tier storyline
Excellent music
Great character development
Loyalty to traditional Chinese fashion and architecture
Unique aesthetic
Simplistic but unique power system
Well-fleshed out and memorable support characters
Good action sequences
Classic fantasy fight elements

anime.title: Pokétoon
anime.synopsis:
Animations released on Pokémon Kids TV Japan YouTube channel.

Episodes:
#1: Zuruggu to Mimikkyu - Chase the Beans (ズルッグとミミッキュ), animated by Dandelion Animation Studio, released June 4, 2020.
#2: Hero ni Naritai Yanchamu (ヒーローになりたいヤンチャム), animated by Pancakes, released May 5, 2021.
#3: Yume no Tsubomi (ユメノツボミ), animated by Studio Colorido, released June 6, 2021.
#4: Mattete ne! Koiking (まっててね！コイキング), animated by Studio Colorido, released July 2, 2021.
#5: Pokapoka Magumaggu House (ぽかぽかマグマッグハウス), animated by Studio Colorido, released August 5, 2021.
#6: Gengar ni Nacchatta!? (ゲンガーになっちゃった！？), animated by Studio Colorido, released September 10, 2021.
#7: Fubuki no Natsu Yasumi (ふぶきのなつやすみ), animated by Mimoid, released October 8, 2021.
#8: Purin no Uta (プリンのうた), animated by StudioGOONEYS, released December 28, 2021.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising specific episodes (especially episode 5) for capturing the heart of Pokémon, while others find the remaining episodes disconnected and unengaging. The short format is appreciated, but the overall experience is inconsistent. The series seems to evoke strong feelings (both positive and negative) depending on the episode.
pros: Episode 5 captures the essence of Pokémon world
Short episodes make it easy to watch
cons: Lack of connection to the Pokémon world in some episodes
Inconsistent animation styles and storytelling across episodes
Some episodes are a pain to watch

anime.title: Edens Zero
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Space
anime.synopsis:
All his life, Shiki has been surrounded by machines. At Granbell Kingdom, a long-abandoned amusement park, he is the only one of his kind around. That is, until Rebecca Bluegarden and her feline companion Happy arrive, unaware that they are Granbell's first visitors in one hundred years. Their goal is to make fun videos for their B-Cube channel, but what they find instead is a friend in the socially awkward Shiki.

When Granbell becomes too dangerous for the three of them, they set off on an adventure through the Sakura Cosmos. They hope to make more interesting videos and even find the elusive goddess Mother, while Shiki wants to make more friends, spurred on by the words of his late grandfather. Of course, the journey will not be easy, as no one has seen Mother before, but Shiki is determined to reach his goal and explore the boundless reaches of space together with his new friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Edens Zero are divided. While some appreciate the improved animation and emotionally driven backstories, many criticize its unoriginal character designs, reliance on tropes, and weak plot. The series is often seen as a rehash of Fairy Tail, leading to disappointment among viewers seeking a fresh and innovative story.
pros: Animation quality is surprisingly good, especially in fight scenes.
Some character backstories are emotionally driven and resonate with viewers.
World-building is an improvement compared to Mashima's previous works.
cons: Character designs are unoriginal and feel like Fairy Tail rip-offs.
Plot relies heavily on the 'power of friendship' trope.
Story and world-building lack originality; feels like fantasy in space.
Inconsistent power system and convenient plot contrivances.
Excessive fan service detracts from the story.

anime.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 2 Part 2
anime.romaji_title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 2nd Season Part 2
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Isekai, Psychological, Suspense, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
After a stern yet compelling speech by Otto Suwen, Subaru Natsuki solemnly swears that he will successfully make it through this timeline and save everyone he can along the way. The first step toward achieving this goal is to help Emilia work through her past; however, that is easier said than done. Feeling as if she has been lied to by everyone around her, it will be difficult for Emilia to trust anyone, even Subaru, her self-proclaimed knight.

Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 2nd Season Part 2 presents the culmination of Subaru's experiences with the Sanctuary and its people, along with his unwillingness to give up hope on saving them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers praise the season for its character development, world-building, and emotional depth, considering it a highlight of the isekai genre. However, others criticize the slow pacing, excessive exposition, and dialogue issues, finding the season bloated and unengaging. This divide indicates a polarized reception, with strong opinions on both sides.
pros: Strong character development, especially for side characters.
Exploration of characters' histories and motivations.
Masterful direction and finale quality in each episode.
cons: Bloated with information, lore, backstories, and exposition.
Slow pacing, with the story not moving until the last few episodes.
Overuse of extreme close-ups, especially on female characters.
Dialogue is stiff, overwrought, and melodramatic.
Plot points introduced and then ignored.

anime.title: Shaman King (2021)
anime.synopsis:
Shamans are extraordinary individuals with the ability to communicate with ghosts, spirits, and gods, which are invisible to ordinary people. The Shaman Fight—a prestigious tournament pitting shamans from all over the world against each other—is held every five hundred years, where the winner is crowned Shaman King. This title allows the current incumbent to call upon the Great Spirit and shape the world as they see fit.

Finding himself late for class one night, Manta Oyamada, an ordinary middle school student, decides to take a shortcut through the local cemetery. Noticing him, a lone boy sitting on a gravestone invites Manta to stargaze with "them." Realizing that "them" refers to the boy and his ghostly friends, Manta flees in terror. Later, the boy introduces himself as You Asakura, a Shaman-in-training, and demonstrates his powers by teaming up with the ghost of six-hundred-year-old samurai Amidamaru to save Manta from a group of thugs. You befriends Manta due to his ability to see spirits, and with the help of Amidamaru, they set out to accomplish You's goal of becoming the next Shaman King.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating the attempt to faithfully adapt the manga and the memorable music/voice acting. However, the rushed pacing and subpar animation are significant drawbacks for many viewers. Nostalgia plays a large role in individual enjoyment, with some preferring the older anime adaptation despite its divergence from the manga.
pros: Faithful manga adaptation
Memorable soundtrack and voice acting
Interesting characters with distinct personalities
cons: Inconsistent pacing, especially in the beginning and end
Mediocre animation quality
Simplified or rushed fight scenes

anime.title: Cooking with Valkyries II
anime.synopsis: Second season of Nu Wushen de Canzhuo.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Nu Wushen de Canzhuo II' as a lighthearted, visually appealing cooking anime, particularly if they are fans of Honkai Impact. However, some find the story and character development lacking, and the reliance on prior knowledge of the Honkai universe may be a barrier for some viewers. The inclusion of cooking recipes at the end of each episode is a well-received feature.
pros: Visually appealing art and animation, especially the food
Enjoyable for fans of the Honkai Impact universe
Easy and succinct episodes
cons: Lacking in overall story progression and character development
Story is simple and may not appeal to those seeking depth
Relies heavily on familiarity with the Honkai Impact universe

anime.title: The Westward: Goodbye Wu Kong
anime.romaji_title: Xi Xing Ji: Zaijian Wu Kong
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Prequel to animation series "Journey to the West", Su Yi, a princess of the heavenly realm, befriends Sun Wukong in the mortal world and falls in love with him. However, Sun Wukong is violently treated as a demon by other gods and suppressed under the Five Fingers Mountain. In the past 300 years, the god Rulai has taught the Wukong how to uphold justice in his heart. Sun Wukong protects the Longevity Monk and goes to the other side of the world to retrieve the fire of creation for the benefit of the world, but finally returns after many ups and downs. The conspiracy surfaced and the fate of the master and disciples was rewritten.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is a worthy prequel that expands on Wukong's backstory and his relationships with key figures. The CGI animation is decent for a Chinese anime, but not top-tier. While familiarity with the series enhances the experience, the movie stands alone reasonably well.
pros: Adds more story layers and characters to Wukong's origins
Good quality CGI animation compared to other Chinese anime
Worthy prequel that retains the level of its series
cons: CGI animation not the best and not for everyone
Watching the series is a prerequisite (though debatable)

anime.title: Condom Battler Gorou
anime.synopsis:
The show follows Gorou, a 24-year-old man who dreams of becoming the greatest Condom Battler. His go-to weapon is a 0.01 mm condom which he loads into an arm dispenser, and it opens to reveal a red rubbery armor that Gorou wears in battle. It also gives the hero the ability to summon sperm and created an attack out of the sticky substance.

There are other characters in the anime like Miku and Hayato who duel using their own condoms. The anime is filled with absurd dialogue and fights, but these heroes always make sure to teach a sex education lesson along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views 'Condom Battler Gorou' as a surprisingly effective and entertaining parody that cleverly incorporates sex education. It's appreciated for its originality as an advertisement and its ability to teach important lessons in an engaging way. The show is not particularly controversial, enjoying mostly positive reception for its unique approach.
pros: Effective parody of shounen anime tropes
Successful and original marketing gimmick
Educational content on safe sex practices

anime.title: Take My Brother Away 4
anime.romaji_title: Ani ni Tsukeru Kusuri wa Nai! 4
anime.synopsis:
Shi Miao has a lot of experience dealing with her older brother's peculiar habits. After all her scolding, it is natural to expect that Shi Fen's antics would come to an end. But having spent their whole life together, it is obvious to Miao that some things never change—and maybe that is for the best.

Despite his recklessness, Fen usually means well. As a result, a tight-knit friend group has formed around him and his sister. Joined by their classmates—Kai Xin, Wan Sui, and Miaomiao—the Shi siblings' tenure at high school continues to be an absolute spectacle.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys 'Ani ni Tsukeru Kusuri wa Nai! 4' as a lighthearted comedy, particularly for its humor and the wholesome moments. However, some find the gags repetitive and the short episode length limiting. There's a desire for more character development and a less predictable comedic style.
pros: Enjoyable and funny.
Upbeat opening theme.
Wholesome moments, especially the last episode.
Good for new anime viewers looking for comedy.
cons: Repetitive gags and humor.
Short episode length (3 minutes).
Lack of character development and screentime for supporting characters.
Some episodes are flat and not funny.

anime.title: Tokyo Revengers
anime.genres: Action, Delinquents, Drama, Shounen, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Takemichi Hanagaki's second year of middle school was the highest point in his life. He had respect, a gang of friends he could count on, and even a girlfriend. But that was twelve years ago. Today, he's a nobody: a washed-up nonentity made fun of by children and always forced to apologize to his younger boss. A sudden news report on the Tokyo Manji Gang's cruel murder of the only girlfriend he ever had alongside her brother only adds insult to injury. Half a second before a train ends his pitiful life for good, Takemichi flashes back to that same day 12 years ago, when he was still dating Hinata Tachibana.

After being forced to relive the very same day that began his downward spiral, Takemichi meets Hinata's younger brother. Without thinking, he admits to his seeming death before flashing back to the past. Takemichi urges him to protect his sister before inexplicably returning to the future. Miraculously, he is not dead. Stranger still, the future has changed. It seems as though Takemichi can alter the flow of time. Given the chance to prevent his ex-girlfriend's tragic death at the hands of the Tokyo Manji Gang, Takemichi decides to fly through time to change the course of the future.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some find the story and characters engaging, praising its unique twist on time travel and gang warfare. Others criticize the unlikeable protagonist, generic plot, and poor production quality. The show is considered overhyped, with many feeling it doesn't live up to expectations.
pros: Interesting plot concept with time travel and gang warfare elements.
Well-developed characters, especially Mikey and the Toman members.
Mystery elements keep viewers hooked and engaged.
cons: Protagonist is unlikable, weak, and makes poor decisions.
Story is generic, cliché, and unrealistic.
Repetitive plot with reliance on screaming and violence.
Poor animation and production quality.

anime.title: Bungo Stray Dogs Wan!
anime.synopsis: Atsushi Nakajima has finally grown accustomed to the crazy lifestyle that comes with being part of the Armed Detective Agency. But even during peaceful periods of time, there is bound to be chaos! As Atsushi, his friends, and the agency's rival group—the Port Mafia—go about their days roaming the streets of Yokohama, there are no limits to the strange situations they are unwillingly thrown into.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Fans of the original Bungou Stray Dogs series enjoy the cute, comedic spin-off and its lighthearted take on the characters. It's considered a fun and enjoyable watch, especially for those seeking a mood boost, though it may not appeal to viewers seeking a serious plot.
pros: Cute character designs and animation
Fun and lighthearted vibe
Good for fans of the original BSD series
Hilarious interactions between characters
Rewatch value for serotonin boost
cons: Lacks a strong plot
May not appeal to viewers expecting a hardcore driven plot
Some jokes may not land if you haven't seen the original series
Some shorts may cut off abruptly

anime.title: Ninja Collection
anime.synopsis: Set in modern-day Tokyo where dreams and desires are afloat, a group of ninjas called "Toukeshuu" is set to stop the spread of "darkness" that prevails in the world using ancient techniques passed down through generations.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is overwhelmingly negative, citing terrible animation, repetitive stories, and a lack of tension or scares.  The inclusion of ninjas is seen as a detriment to the horror aspect. While a small minority find it enjoyable on a 'so bad it's good' level, most consider it a poorly executed and boring series. The series is highly criticized for failing to capitalize on its potential.
pros: Some appreciate the creepy atmosphere and eerie visuals.
A few find it enjoyable as a 'so bad it's good' experience or as a time waster with friends.
The ending song is considered a highlight by some.
cons: Extremely poor animation quality, often described as a slideshow.
Repetitive and predictable story structure with little tension.
Underdeveloped characters and lack of integration of ninjas into the horror stories.
Many find the series boring, incomprehensible, and a waste of time.

anime.title: Martial Universe 2
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: The whole journey of cultivation is to steal yin and yang, seize good fortune, turn nirvana, grasp life and death, and control reincarnation. In Qingyang Town of the Great Yan Dynasty, Lin Dong, an unfavored member of the family, accidentally picked up a mysterious stone talisman in a cave, and found a celestial demon mink helping him in the stone talisman. Thus embarking on the road of counterattack, a vast world of fairy tales unfolds...
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is a quantitative improvement over the first, offering more of the same cultivation-style progression. While the adaptation omits details from the novel, it's still engaging and motivates viewers to explore the source material. The story follows formulaic tropes, but the overall experience is enjoyable for fans of the genre.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source novel (to a reasonable degree)
Improved animation quality compared to the first season
Engaging story that motivates viewers to explore the source material (novel)
cons: Anime leaves some things out compared to the novel
Formulaic tropes of the cultivation genre (repetitive power-ups)
Plot lacks a clear direction

anime.title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! X
anime.romaji_title: Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shiteshimatta... X
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Reverse Harem, Romance, School, Shoujo, Villainess
anime.synopsis:
With no more death flags in sight, personable but dense Catarina Claes is finally able to lead a peaceful life surrounded by all of her friends and family. For that reason, she is determined to enjoy the school festival to the fullest without any concern on her mind.

Unbeknownst to her, however, the story of Fortune Lover—the game she used to play—has yet to end. Even more characters make an appearance, each with their own agenda to fulfill, and new mysteries await Katarina and those she loves. Will there be any way to avoid a bad ending when Catarina cannot remember what happens next?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Season 2 is mixed. While some appreciate the improved characterization and lighthearted comedy, many find the season suffers from repetitive gags, lack of meaningful plot progression, and forced romantic advances. The over reliance on established tropes and the stagnation of character development led to disappointment for viewers who enjoyed the first season's unique premise.
pros: Improved characterization and plot advancement compared to season 1
Enjoyable comedy and lighthearted moments
Satisfying mini-arcs and pacing
Good art quality consistent with the first season
cons: Repetitive gags and overused tropes, especially Katarina's denseness
Lack of meaningful character development and progression
Weak or recycled plot lines and story arcs
Characters reduced to one-dimensional traits
Forced or inappropriate romantic advances
Mediocre animation quality

anime.title: Carp Reborn
anime.synopsis: Special Forces Wang Sheng traveled to the soul world and was possessed by the waste carp Yuan soul, becoming a veritable waste person in the soul world. Wang Sheng used the knowledge he had learned in the world of master spirits like Yun Yuan to pass the battle, and even found a way to evolve the waste carp Yuan soul! The sparrow becomes a phoenix, and the carp leaps to the dragon gate. Wang Sheng has embarked on a road of Jackie Chan from the sinister soul dispute!
anime.consensus_summary: The initial episodes show promise with the unique blend of modern warfare and cultivation in an Isekai setting. However, the plot falters towards the end with poor character development and a rushed conclusion, leaving viewers disappointed. While the action and animation are praised, the weak romance and forced deaths detract from the overall experience.
pros: Interesting mix of modern warfare and cultivation.
Exciting action sequences.
Good animation quality.
cons: Weak romance subplot.
Poor character development (other than the protagonist).
Rushed plot with forced deaths.
Inconclusive ending.

anime.title: Ling Cage
anime.synopsis: Second half of Ling Long: Incarnation.
anime.consensus_summary: The second part of Ling Long: Incarnation delves deeper into the mysteries of the world, focusing on Captain Marc's journey and the political tensions within the Lighthouse. The season is action-packed but involves morally questionable decisions and political intrigue, which may divide audiences. Some viewers appreciate the expanded lore, while others may be turned off by the conflicts.
pros: Dives deeper into the lore and uncovers censored information.
Action-packed and takes place mostly on the planet surface.
cons: Story involves violating commandments and political rivalries, which may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: The World Ends with You The Animation
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Mystery, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
One day in the bustling city of Shibuya, a boy named Neku Sakuraba finds himself holding two black pins that enable him to read the minds of people around him. However, these pins also give him the ability to see the "Noise," hostile creatures capable of "erasing" people from existence. After discovering that he is trapped within the confines of the city, Neku receives a message regarding a mission that will nevertheless erase him should he fail. 

While trying to fend off a Noise attack, Neku meets a girl named Shiki Misaki who asks him to form a partnership pact with her to fight against the monsters. Shiki explains that she and Neku have become "Players" participating in the "Reaper's Game"—an event spanning over seven days, each featuring a different mission.

As Neku and Shiki both strive to survive each day that passes, they begin to meet other Players and Reapers alike, battle stronger Noise, and learn the truth behind the mystery that this game is shrouded in.
anime.consensus_summary: Fans of the original game are largely disappointed with the anime adaptation due to its rushed pacing and lack of depth. While the art style and music receive praise, the animation quality and condensed storyline fail to capture the essence of the source material. Newcomers may find the story confusing, while longtime fans are left wanting more.
pros: Faithful recreation of the game's art style and Shibuya setting.
Return of original voice actors and composer.
Music and sound design capture the spirit of the original game.
cons: Rushed pacing and condensed plot lead to underdeveloped characters and story.
Inconsistent animation quality with jarring CGI.
Missing emotional depth and humor from the original game.

anime.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
anime.synopsis:
Dreams are doomed to die in Night City, a futuristic Californian metropolis. As a teenager living in the city's slums, David Martinez is trying to fulfill his mother's lifelong wish for him to reach the top of Arasaka, the world's leading security corporation. To this end, he attends the prestigious Arasaka Academy while his mother works tirelessly to keep their family afloat.

When an incident with a street gang leaves David's life in tatters, he stumbles upon Sandevistan cyberware—a prosthetic that grants its wearer superhuman speed. Fueled by rage, David implants the device in his back, using it to exact revenge on one of his tormentors. This gets him expelled from the academy, shattering his hopes of ever making his mother proud.

After witnessing David's newfound abilities, the beautiful data thief Lucyna "Lucy" Kushinada offers to team up with him, handing him a ticket to salvation. However, associating with Lucy introduces David to the world of Edgerunners—cyborg criminals who will break any law for money. Edgerunners often lose their lives, if the cyberware does not break their minds first; but in his fight for survival inside a corrupt system, David is ready to risk it all.
anime.consensus_summary: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is a visually impressive anime with intense action, but it suffers from a shallow story and underdeveloped characters. While many praise its animation and faithfulness to the Cyberpunk universe, others find it generic, rushed, and ultimately disappointing. The series has a polarized audience, with some hailing it as a masterpiece and others finding it a letdown.
pros: Visually stunning animation by Studio Trigger.
Intense action sequences and adrenaline-pumping moments.
Faithful adaptation of the Cyberpunk 2077 universe, capturing the aesthetic and vibe.
Music effectively complements the cyberpunk setting and action.
cons: Story feels rushed and generic, relying on cyberpunk tropes without deeper exploration.
Characters lack depth and emotional connection, making deaths feel meaningless.
Ending feels pointless and unsatisfying.
Overhyped due to Studio Trigger's reputation and association with the Cyberpunk franchise.

anime.title: Battle Athletes Victory ReSTART!
anime.synopsis:
As technology advanced, humanity gradually colonized the entire solar system, occupying planetary facilities from Mercury to Pluto. This results in a large-scale athletic tournament, the "Daiundoukai," where several aspiring female athletes from all around the solar system compete. The winner of the tournament is crowned the "Cosmo Beauty," obtaining a queenlike status.

When outgoing potato farmer Kanata Akehoshi was a child, she witnessed a meteor-like object falling from the sky, crashing in a nearby forest. When she came to investigate the wreckage, she saw a damaged spaceship and a girl who seemed to have been in it weakened by the impact. The girl gave Kanata two wristbands, alongside a request that Kanata join the Daiundoukai and become the Cosmo Beauty. Kanata obliged, but before she could ask for the girl's name, she mysteriously disappeared—leaving nothing,not even the crater caused by the crash. Since then, Kanata has devoted herself to training, aiming to fulfill her promise.

After winning the qualifying round to represent the planet Earth, Kanata goes to the University Satellite—an institution where she and other candidates study to prepare themselves for the upcoming competition. There, she meets and befriends her fellow competitors, helping them get along with each other to perform better in the games. As Kanata grows closer to the coveted title, so do her chances of meeting the girl who changed her fate—and she discovers an underlying mystery behind the Daiundoukai along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Battle Athletess Daiundoukai ReSTART!' is a disappointing reboot. Reviewers criticize the poor writing, shallow characters, and low-quality animation, with some noting a confusing storyline and wasted potential. While the music evokes nostalgia, it's not enough to redeem the show's flaws.
pros: Music has a nostalgic feel.
cons: Insanely stupid story and plot.
Easy-going characters lacking depth.
Worse-than-subpar animation and visuals.
Confused storyline with major issues and conflicts that are resolved by the power of friendship.
Underdeveloped 'Cosmo Beauty' concept.

anime.title: The Dungeon of Black Company
anime.synopsis:
After working tirelessly toward his goal of a self-sustainable NEET lifestyle, Kinji Ninomiya has finally achieved his dreams. Now looking down on common folk commuting during a typhoon from the penthouse of one of his apartment buildings, Kinji gets ready to start his new, slothful life. However, all of his hard work goes to waste when a portal appears beneath him from out of nowhere.

Teleported to another world, Kinji is forced to work for a mining company that focuses solely on profits and has no care whatsoever for the safety and well-being of its employees. Refusing to live in such conditions, he begins devising plans to get rich quickly, building connections with others in this new world and making his best efforts to escape the stringent corporate life. Will Kinji be able to overcome his restraints and attain financial freedom once more?
anime.consensus_summary: Meikyuu Black Company is a refreshing Isekai anime that subverts the genre's usual tropes with its satirical take on capitalism and a charismatic anti-hero protagonist. However, the show suffers from inconsistent animation, repetitive storytelling, and pacing issues. Despite its flaws, the anime provides enough humor and entertainment to make it a worthwhile watch for those seeking a different kind of Isekai experience.
pros: Unique take on Isekai genre, subverting typical tropes.
Protagonist is charismatic and entertaining, a refreshing change from typical Isekai MCs.
Humorous and satirical commentary on capitalism and corporate exploitation.
Memorable and fitting opening and ending themes.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, often appearing cheap or outdated.
Story can be repetitive, relying heavily on the protagonist's schemes.
Pacing issues, with rushed plot developments and unresolved elements.
Over-reliance on protagonist, sidelining other characters.

anime.title: My Senpai is Annoying
anime.romaji_title: Senpai ga Uzai Kouhai no Hanashi
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
At a certain trading company, saleswoman Futaba Igarashi has managed to hold her respectable job for almost two years thanks to the guidance of her senior coworker—Harumi Takeda. However, due to Igarashi's short stature, Takeda often teases her and treats her like a kid, leaving Igarashi constantly annoyed by his antics.

Despite this, Igarashi notices Takeda's reliability as he is always ready to help whenever something at their workplace goes awry. As Igarashi and Takeda spend more time together, their relationship soon develops further than simply being coworkers at the office.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While many find the show to be a cute and wholesome workplace rom-com with likable characters, others criticize its repetitive nature, lack of progress in the main relationship, and reliance on tired tropes. The show's simplicity appeals to some, while others find it bland and unoriginal, leading to a moderate level of polarization.
pros: Cute and wholesome romance with lovable characters.
Enjoyable interactions between characters, particularly the main couple and the side couple.
The office setting provides a refreshing change from the typical high school romance.
Vibrant animation and top-notch voice acting enhances the viewing experience.
cons: Repetitive jokes and flat character dynamics can lead to boredom.
Lack of progress in the main couple's relationship becomes frustrating.
The height difference between the main characters is weird
The show relies on clichés and adds nothing new to the rom-com genre.
Some viewers find the male lead's behavior condescending and annoying.

anime.title: Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Every day, Naoto Hachiouji is teased relentlessly by Hayase Nagatoro, a first year student he meets one day in the library while working on his manga. After reading his story and seeing his awkward demeanor, she decides from that moment on to toy with him, even calling him "Senpai" in lieu of using his real name.

At first, Nagatoro's relentless antics are more bothersome than anything and leave him feeling embarrassed, as he is forced to cater to her whims. However, as they spend more time together, a strange sort of friendship develops between them, and Naoto finds that life with Nagatoro can even be fun. But one thing's for sure: his days will never be dull again.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided. Some find it a heartwarming rom-com about overcoming insecurities, praising character development and art. Others view it as normalizing bullying and promoting a toxic relationship, criticizing repetitive humor and the power imbalance between characters. The show's premise is highly controversial, leading to strong opinions on both sides.
pros: Character growth for Naoto.
Nagatoro's VA is notable.
Appealing character designs and expressive faces.
Soundtrack complements the anime.
cons: Bullying is normalized.
Repetitive humor.
Nagatoro's initial bullying is off-putting.
Questionable power dynamics in the relationship.
Generic plot and characters.
Sexual assault and harassment themes.

anime.title: Re:ZERO ~Starting Break Time From Zero~ Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Break Time 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Afraid that his life may end at any moment, Otto Suwen begins writing a diary documenting all of his experiences. Now part of Subaru Natsuki's eccentric band of colorful characters, the apprehensive merchant is certain that new dangers lie ahead in their mission at Sanctuary. But amid the rising tensions, there are still moments of respite and reflection, ripe with opportunities to make vivid memories.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Break Time 2nd Season' for its comedic elements and ability to flesh out characters and provide context to the main series. Many feel it enhances the viewing experience of season 2. However, some criticize its simplistic art style and occasional inclusion of crucial plot points that should have been in the main series.
pros: Adds context and characterization to the main Re:Zero show.
Reveals and complements the Re:Zero universe, answering questions from the main series.
Pairs well with season 2, enhancing the viewing experience.
cons: Some episodes explain critical plot points that were vague in the main season, a questionable direction.
Lacking sound effects and music.
The ending to season 2 is abrupt.

anime.title: The iDOLM@STER Million Live!
anime.synopsis:
Mirai Kasuga, who wants to carry on a dream she has yet to see. Shizuka Mogami, who yearns to be an idol and is shaken. Tsubasa Ibuki, who does not know what she can be serious about.

At 765 Production new idols gather and everyone's "dreams" will brought into brilliance at the theater! The long-awaited anime of "The IDOLM@STER Million Live!!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with established fans finding enjoyment due to pre-existing knowledge of the characters and franchise. However, the anime is criticized for its rushed pacing, lack of character development for many idols, and a weak producer character. Many feel it doesn't serve as a good introduction to the Million Live branch for newcomers, and ultimately feels like a supplement for existing fans rather than a standalone adaptation.
pros: Great pacing for character introductions (episodes 1-4).
CGI is better than expected, models match the background.
Art blends well with CGI, detailed backgrounds.
cons: Too many idols to keep track of, lack of focus on individual characters.
Producer is a non-entity, easily removable from the story.
Idol parts of the show are boring, focus primarily on work-related activities.
Rushed pacing, especially with 39 idols and only 12 episodes.
Adaptation feels like an extra for pre-existing fans, not a standalone experience for newcomers.

anime.title: Mr. Osomatsu 3
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Parody
anime.synopsis: Third season of Osomatsu-san.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Osomatsu-san 3rd Season is mixed. Many feel it doesn't live up to the standards set by the previous seasons, particularly due to the introduction of the Riceballs and a perceived decline in humor quality. However, some viewers appreciate the new dynamics and character development, especially regarding Nyaa-chan. The season is considered a departure, with opinions divided on whether the changes were ultimately beneficial.
pros: Art and sound quality remain high.
Nyaa-chan's character development is well-received.
Stories continue highlighting the sextuplets' individual personalities and pairings.
The bold addition of the Riceballs brought a new level of story continuity.
cons: Season feels underwhelming compared to previous seasons.
New characters (Riceballs) take up too much screen time and their jokes become repetitive.
Side characters like Chibita and Iyami get less screen time.
The overall quality is lower than previous seasons.

anime.title: Burning Kabaddi
anime.synopsis:
Tatsuya Yoigoshi, a once nationally recognized soccer player, is now a first-year student at Noukin High School. Due to his developed hatred for sports, he has abandoned his previous aspirations to become a famous livestreamer on the internet. One day, Souma Azemichi, a first-year on the kabaddi team, seeks to recruit Yoigoshi and spontaneously interrupts his livestream.

Without any expectations, Yoigoshi follows Souma to the school gym, where he witnesses second-years Kyouhei Misumi and Shinji Date engaged in the primal contact sport of kabaddi. Despite ridiculing the rules of play, Yoigoshi is stunned by the intensity of the round. Because of an enticing deal and slight coercion, he agrees to settle the prospect of his recruitment through the most invigorating way: a battle of kabbadi, a team sport played empty-handed.
anime.consensus_summary: Shakunetsu Kabaddi is a surprisingly enjoyable sports anime that effectively introduces the relatively obscure sport of Kabaddi to a wider audience. While the animation quality and pacing may be lacking, the well-developed characters, engaging story, and informative explanation of the sport make it a worthwhile watch, especially for fans of sports anime. The series is generally underrated, with many hoping for a second season to further explore the characters and the sport.
pros: Engaging introduction to Kabaddi rules and tactics.
Well-developed characters with distinct strengths.
Good balance of school life and sports elements.
Phenomenal music and hype-inducing opening and ending themes.
cons: Mediocre animation, often relying on slow-motion and still frames.
Slow pacing and forgotten plot points.
Underdeveloped side characters.
Overuse of the 'struggle' effect may be repetitive for some viewers.

anime.title: Healin' Good♡Precure Movie: Yume no Machi de Kyun! Tto GoGo! Daihenshin!!
anime.romaji_title: Healin' Good♡Precure Movie: Yume no Machi de Kyun! Tto GoGo! Daihenshin!!
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is generally well-received, particularly for its action sequences and nostalgic feel, though some critique the reliance on crossovers. Production delays due to the pandemic are acknowledged. The audience mood is positive, with minor reservations about the integration of past characters and overall story depth.
pros: Exciting fight scenes, reminiscent of older Precure movies.
Enjoyable plot (simple)
Good incorporation of past Precure season into the fights
cons: Crossover felt unnecessary.
Lack of interaction between teams after the battle.
Production impacted by COVID-19 pandemic, causing delays.

anime.title: Date A Bullet: Nightmare or Queen
anime.romaji_title: Date A Bullet: Nightmare or Queen
anime.synopsis: Second part of the Date A Bullet films.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on "Date A Bullet: Nightmare or Queen." While fans of the Date A Live universe, particularly Kurumi, praise its animation, music, and character development, detractors criticize its predictable plot, underdeveloped characters, and questionable narrative logic. The reliance on prior knowledge from the main series also leaves some viewers confused.
pros: Excellent animation quality, potentially better than previous installments.
Intriguing story that deepens understanding of the character Kurumi.
Well-fitting and high-quality soundtrack and sound design, including awesome OP/ED.
Kurumi's personal soundtrack is iconic.
Kurumi's character development and backstory are explored effectively for anime-only viewers.
cons: The plot is predictable and the main twist is heavily telegraphed.
The spin-off relies on knowledge from season 4 of the main series, which is not provided.
Majority of the cast is irrelevant and underdeveloped.
The logic of the story and bullet effects are inconsistent and nonsensical.
Kurumi's backstory is handled poorly, seemingly to avoid spoiling the main series.
The villain 'White Queen' is mediocre and lacks depth.
Fighting animation and choreography are lacking despite good visuals.

anime.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Season 3
anime.romaji_title: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen 3rd Season
anime.synopsis:
Winter is approaching, and Myne—now an apprentice priestess—must prepare for her stay at the church and the upcoming Dedication Ceremony. However, due to her immense knowledge and extraordinary amount of mana, she has garnered the attention of many dangerous people, who are willing to do anything to get their hands on Myne.

To keep her safe, the Head Priest assigns Myne a bodyguard and advises her to be adopted by a noble, a decision that will force her to leave her family behind. As Myne is opposed to the idea, the Head Priest gives her an ultimatum: she can be with her family until she turns 10, but if she is deemed too unstable, she will immediately be dealt with.

Placed in a tough position, Myne is uncertain about her future. Despite the twists that may lie ahead, she will do whatever she can to protect those that she loves—even if it means giving up on her dream.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the series, particularly its unique take on the isekai genre, lovable characters, and well-developed world-building. However, some viewers find the pacing slow and the adaptation lacking compared to the light novels. There is a split in opinion on whether the season maintains the quality of previous installments, with some finding it a satisfying continuation and others feeling it is the weakest season so far.
pros: Fantastic story and lovable characters
Unique take on the Isekai genre
Good world-building
Methodical pacing that rewards long-term investment
cons: Slower pace may not appeal to all viewers.
Adaptation not as good as the previous season.
Character development is lacking
The book side of the show basically makes 2% progress

anime.title: Hundred Spirits Kindergarten
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Bai Gui Youeryuan', praising its art, music and relatable characters. However, there is concern regarding the portrayal of slavery, though some believe this issue can be overlooked. Overall the anime is received positively.
pros: Relatable characters
Amazing music
Beautiful art style
cons: Encourages slavery

anime.title: Pretending to forget
anime.synopsis:
Animation film celebrating the 50th anniversary of the Senba Center Building. Based on the manga "A manga in the Semba Center Building" by You Machida.

One day, manga artist YOU Machida received a request to draw the Semba Center Building, which was celebrating its 50th anniversary. This is the story of a quiet dialogue between a manga artist who has suffered from depression in the past and the Senba Center Building, a generous old commercial facility that has lived for 50 years in the middle of Osaka, over a four-day period.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience appreciates the film's introspective narrative and authentic portrayal of depression. The clever use of a narrator to explore the main character's internal state is praised. The film is considered genuine and avoids melodramatic portrayals.
pros: Clever use of narrator to dialogue the main character's internal thoughts.
Good characterization of You Machida, conveying his dull and lifeless state.
Genuine portrayal of depression, avoiding melodrama.

anime.title: I'm Home! Chibi Godzilla
anime.synopsis: The "Chibi Godzilla" project was launched to celebrate the 65th anniversary of Toho's Godzilla franchise.
