anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Tadaima! Chibi Godzilla' to be an adorable and humorous series. Its short format and references to the Godzilla franchise are well-received. There's very little controversy, with most viewers appreciating its intended lightheartedness.
pros: Delightful and amusing scenarios.
Effective use of short episode format.
References to the Godzilla franchise.

anime.title: World Witches Take Off!
anime.synopsis: Countries all over the world formed an alliance to counter the emerging enemy of mankind "Neuroi," whom only girls with special powers could counter. However, the Neuroi never appeared. Instead of fighting, the witches spend their days idly. This time following not only unit 501, but also unit 502 known as "Brave Witches!" The 2nd volume of the comical daily drama of the witches who do not fight Neuroi begins!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Fans of the Strike Witches franchise appreciate the lighthearted comedy and character interactions, finding it a fun addition to the series. However, some criticize the show for its weak story, poor animation, and perceived lack of effort, viewing it as a disappointing cash grab compared to other entries.
pros: Witty interactions between characters, especially the 501st and 502nd witches.
Fast-paced storytelling keeps the show engaging.
Faithful to the qualities fans love from the Strike Witches franchise.
Enjoyable for fans of military moe and the World Witches series.
cons: Lazy writing and a bland story.
Sub-par animation quality, especially compared to other entries in the franchise.
Minimal character development; requires prior knowledge of the series.
Feels like a cash grab with low production effort.
anime.thematic_vibe: Comical, Slice of Life, Fan Service

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: overDress
anime.synopsis:
Shy and timid in nature, 15-year-old Yu-yu Kondou is constantly pressured by his wacky sisters to fulfill their unreasonable requests. One day, they force their brother to crossdress for the sake of their own entertainment, prompting him to run away from home. Following a series of unexpected events, Yu-yu encounters Megumi Ookura, a friendly girl who introduces him to Team Blackout—a group of individuals deeply involved in a card game called Cardfight Vanguard.

As he increasingly connects with the members of Team Blackout—Danji Momoyama, Zakusa Ishigame, Tomari Seto, and Megumi herself—Yu-yu discovers a whole new and exciting world, one he could have never imagined without the help of his newfound friends.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Many appreciate the focus on characters and relationships, as well as the fresh take on the franchise. However, others criticize the inconsistent story, weak integration of the card game, and confusing plot elements. The show seems to appeal more to those who are not necessarily Vanguard fans but enjoy character-driven stories.
pros: Fresh take on the Vanguard franchise, not following the old formula.
Focus on character development and relationships.
Great visuals, especially in the cardfight scenes.
Appealing character designs by Clamp.
Good animation and soundtrack.
Positive portrayal of femininity in male characters.
The show doesn't focus solely on the card game, making it accessible to a wider audience.
cons: Inconsistent story structure and pacing.
Filler episodes that don't advance the plot.
Card game elements are not well-integrated into the story.
Rules of the card game are not explained clearly.
Weak direction in cardfight scenes.
Story can be incomprehensible at times.
Yu-yu's crossdressing is treated as a joke.

anime.title: Fena: Pirate Princess
anime.synopsis:
A decade ago, a tragic shipwreck separated Fena Houtman from her childhood friend Yukimaru and took her father's life. Now, at age 23, she is trapped on an island and is doomed to spend the rest of her life selling herself to men. On the night she is to be forcibly wed to a client, Fena hatches a plan to escape from her employers, but two old acquaintances unexpectedly intervene and help her run away. 

The three make haste for the open sea and land upon Goblin Island—a mysterious place that a clan of fierce warriors call home. It is there that Fena learns that her father's ill-fated final journey at sea was in search of a place called "Eden," the location of something important that he had to protect. With nothing but a clear crystal as a clue, Fena is tasked with finding this place, as she is the only person who can do so. 

While still contemplating the search for what her father left behind, Fena reunites with Yukimaru, who encourages her to take up the quest. Now the captain of a seven-person crew, Fena must navigate the high seas in search of Eden. But as uncanny groups begin to target her, the perilous journey proves to be even more challenging than it previously seemed.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is heavily divided, with many viewers initially enjoying the series for its animation, soundtrack, and adventurous spirit. However, the majority express disappointment with the ending, citing a rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, and a shift in tone that undermines the initial promise. The consensus leans towards the anime being a letdown due to its poor execution in the latter half.
pros: Initially promising plot and characters.
Beautiful animation and vibrant colors.
Great soundtrack.
cons: Rushed and convoluted ending.
Underdeveloped characters and motivations.
Loss of initial charm and focus.
Contrived storytelling and fantasy elements.
Inconsistent pacing and abandoned storylines.

anime.title: Let's Make a Mug Too
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, School, Slice of Life, Visual Arts
anime.synopsis:
The city of Tajimi is well-renowned for its Mino ware ceramics and being the hometown of Himeno Toyokawa's mother. Considered a legend in the world of pottery, Himeno's mother suddenly passed away when Himeno was four. However, her legacy lives on in the dozens of unique mugs that adorn the Toyokawas' new restaurant in Tajimi.

Having moved back to the city recently following the bankruptcy of her father's company in Tokyo, Himeno brings some of her mother's mugs to her first day of high school in an attempt to make friends. One person who immediately takes an interest is Mika Kukuri, an eccentric girl in Himeno's class who soon introduces her to Tooko Aoki, the president of the Pottery Club. After learning more about her mother's contributions to the club and the art form, Himeno asks her father for permission to join, which he gladly gives.

Alongside Mika and her childhood friend Naoko Naruse, Himeno enters the Pottery Club to continue her mother's beloved work and discover her own passion for the craft.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the show's wholesomeness and introduction to pottery, while others find it bland and uninspired. The anime is seen as a simple slice-of-life show, with limited character development and a slow pace. It is generally considered inoffensive but not particularly memorable, leading to a relatively low level of audience polarization.
pros: Show introduces pottery and Tajimi culture in an accessible way.
The anime has moments of well-executed drama, adding depth.
Catchy opening and ending themes.
cons: Story and characters are generally underdeveloped and archetypal.
Some episodes feel unnecessary and don't add to the plot or character development.
Inconsistent animation quality.
The show can be boring due to the slow pace and lack of excitement.

anime.title: Yuki Yuna is a Hero: The Great Mankai Chapter
anime.romaji_title: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru: Dai Mankai no Shou
anime.synopsis:
At the cost of the gods' protection, a new era has dawned, giving the remnants of mankind a chance to rebuild. Having fulfilled their duties to Taisha, the members of Sanshu Middle School's Hero Club finally begin to enjoy their youth, living as regular students. However, such a conclusion did not come about without sacrifice.

In the year 298 of the Divine Era, Mebuki Kusunoki is among the potential candidates to become the next hero. Despite her painstaking efforts to surpass her competition, she loses the position to Karin Miyoshi, leaving Mebuki furious at Taisha's decision. Two years later, Mebuki is appointed commander of the Sentinels—a group tasked to explore uncharted territory beyond the barrier. The team's seemingly simple mission is quickly disrupted by unforeseen threats, endangering the innocent lives of the fleet. 

To prove her worth as a hero, Mebuki vows to bring everyone back alive, no matter what it takes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the series expands the YuYuYu universe and has strong production values, the confusing structure, pacing issues, and focus on side stories at the expense of the main cast frustrated many viewers. Some enjoyed the new content and character development, while others felt it detracted from the core narrative.
pros: Good balance of slice of life and plot.
Animation, music, and voice acting are top tier.
Expands on the YuYuYu world by delving into side-stories.
Ties up loose ends from previous installments.
cons: Confusing structure and pacing; events are jumbled and hard to follow.
Spends too much time on side-stories at the expense of main characters.
Some arcs feel like a rehash of previous events.
Transitions between storylines are poor.
Adapting light novel content felt rushed.

anime.title: Those Snow White Notes
anime.genres: Drama, Music, Performing Arts, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Setsu Sawamura runs away from his small home village following the death of his grandfather, the legendary shamisen master Matsugorou Sawamura. On his deathbed, Matsugorou told Setsu to give up the shamisen if he was only going to imitate others instead of playing in his own way. Grieving, Setsu heads for Tokyo, hoping that the big city can inspire him to discover his own unique playing style. But Tokyo defies his expectations by drowning out all other sounds with the deafening noise of its city life. 

Concerned about her son, Setsu's rich and successful mother, Umeko, waltzes back into his life and forces him to enroll in Umezono Academy. At the school, he meets Shuri Maeda, a girl who is fascinated by the Tsugaru shamisen and wishes to perform a song her grandmother once heard a long time ago. Shuri starts up a shamisen appreciation club and convinces Setsu to teach the members how to play the instrument. As he becomes more involved with the club, will Setsu be able to recover his love for the shamisen and discover the unique sound he lacks?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Mashiro no Oto is mixed. Many appreciate the superb music, especially the focus on the shamisen and the protagonist's growth. However, criticisms are levied at the inconsistent pacing, forced melodrama, and generic supporting characters, leading to a somewhat polarized reception despite the musical strengths.
pros: Excellent shamisen music and performances
Strong character growth for the protagonist
Good introduction to Japanese artistic culture
Unique soundtrack based on shamisen instrument
cons: Inconsistent pacing, especially in early episodes
Forced melodrama and over-dramatization
Generic and forgettable supporting characters
Predictable plot with unnecessary elements
Poorly written and rushed story

anime.title: My Hero Academia: Make It! Do-or-Die Survival Training
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Hero Academia: Ikinokore! Kesshi no Survival Kunren
anime.synopsis:
The stage this time is a survival training course, taking place before the Provisional Hero License Exam arc. 

Class 1-A students are sent to hone their survival skills at a training course. Having yet to receive their provisional licenses, they're eager to cut loose and have a little fun.

They quickly discover that the danger they face is no simulation! It's going to take their combined training, teamwork, and quick thinking if they're going to pass this assignment!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative, with many viewers finding the OVA to be unoriginal, boring, and poorly executed. While some enjoyed seeing character interactions and moments with favorite characters, the overall sentiment is one of disappointment. Many felt that the OVA did not add anything new and was a waste of time.
pros: Some enjoyable character interactions.
Nice to see Class 1-A back in action.
Bakugo shows a surprising amount of character development.
cons: Unoriginal plot and story.
Characters acting out of character.
Poor artwork and animation quality.
Forced comedy and stressful situations.
Overly excessive recap.
Artificial stakes and bad solutions.

anime.title: The Idaten Deities Know Only Peace
anime.synopsis:
Eight hundred years ago, terrifying demons threatened mankind's existence. On the brink of extinction, humans prayed to their gods, calling out for someone to save them. Emerging from these desperate pleas for salvation, battle deities known as the "Idaten" were born. Possessing unnatural strength and endurance, the Idaten managed to defeat the demons and an era of unprecedented peace was finally ushered in.

Having never encountered demons before, the present generation of Idaten knows nothing of the demon's brutality, but they have instead only lived a  peaceful existence. Training under Rin, the only remaining Idaten from 800 years ago, the new Idaten find ways to survive in a time where they have seemingly outlived their usefulness. However, when the tyrannical Zoble Empire resurrects a demon, the misfit crop of gods are called to the battlefield against their natural enemy once more.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on "Heion Sedai no Idaten-tachi." While many praise its unique art style, animation, intricate plot, and morally grey themes, others criticize its incomplete story, distasteful content, and simplistic characters. The show's unconventional approach and abrupt ending have generated both strong appreciation and disappointment. Ultimately, enjoyment hinges on tolerance for dark themes and appreciation for unconventional storytelling.
pros: Unique art style and vibrant animation by MAPPA
Intricate plot with unexpected twists and well-developed world-building
Clever characters who rely on strategy and intelligence
Excellent opening sequence with catchy music and visuals
Exploration of morally grey themes
cons: Incomplete story with an abrupt, non-conclusive ending
Distasteful and overly sexualized scenes
Simplistic character development
Uneven audio mixing and sound effects
Questionable depiction of sensitive topics

anime.title: Peach Boy Riverside
anime.synopsis:
In a magical world where humans, demihumans, and oni are heavily at odds with each other, a princess named Saltorine "Sally" Aldike is on a journey to find a person named Mikoto Kibitsu. Traversing the world, Sally comes across many truths that she had been ignorant of due to her lineage—including the knowledge that the oni possess power potent enough to wipe out humanity.

Seemingly blessed with a way to counter the oni's might, Sally has a strange power that manifests itself as a sigil resembling a peach, giving her superhuman abilities capable of defeating powerful oni with ease. Even so, Sally refuses to discriminate between humans, demihumans, and oni as much as possible, believing that peace between the three factions could be attainable one day.

On the contrary, Mikoto—who also has the same ability as Sally's but with greater mastery—has a different goal. Mikoto is out to kill and torment all oni in existence, stopping at nothing to fulfill this objective. As Sally and Mikoto continue to cross paths, the power they possess will spell the difference between amicable coexistence and utter annihilation.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of Peach Boy Riverside is heavily criticized for its non-chronological airing order, which many viewers found confusing and detrimental to the story's coherence. When watched in the intended order, the story is seen as decent and enjoyable. However, the botched presentation and shallow exploration of themes have led to a polarized reception.
pros: Unique character designs compared to other fantasy anime.
The story has a nice flow when watched in the correct order and the characters you actually care about them.
Good mix of humor, darkness, and emotional moments.
cons: The non-linear storytelling ruins enjoyment.
Generic fantasy world that doesn't get you invested.
Superficial exploration of racism with unlikeable characters.

anime.title: All Saints Street 2
anime.synopsis:
"Dear Mom and Dad, it's already been a year since I left home. Don't worry- I'm doing great! I can take care of myself now. And I've learned to take care of others, too. Before, I never could have imagined having so many friends. But now, I can hardly imagine living without them. I think... Here, is my second home."

It was all a lie.

Suspicion. Betrayal. Conspiracy.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Wan Sheng Jie 2 for its humor, unique characters, and animation. While the story is not particularly impressive, the overall experience is positive and entertaining. Some viewers find the beginning repetitive, but this does not detract significantly from the enjoyment.
pros: Unique and fun character antics.
Fluid animation and soothing color palette.
Enjoyable and can improve your day.
cons: Story doesn't do much to impress, typical demon-king plot.
Beginning feels like deja vu.

anime.title: Aikatsu Planet!
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: The story revolves around "Aikatsu Planet," a state-of-the-art virtual world where anyone can assume the role of an avatar and becoming a most popular virtual idol. Mao Otoha, an ordinary first-year student at the private academy Seirei High School, becomes a top idol avatar Hana when Hana's previous alter ego Meisa Hinata suddenly disappeared. However, Mao's new role as the avatar Hana is a secret to everyone else.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the blend of live-action and animation, the focus on idol culture, and the music. Others find the story uninteresting, the acting poor, and the CGI and music lacking. The show seems to appeal more to existing idol anime fans, but may not win over new viewers.
pros: Blends live-action and animated segments well.
Addresses modern issues with the vtuber community.
Music is excellent; soundtrack is worth downloading.
Character development is well-paced; no main character is left unexplored.
cons: Story is uninteresting and underused.
Acting is poor; characters are not interesting or unique.
CGI has improved but lacks texture and detail.
Music is generic; songs are forgettable.

anime.title: The Gymnastics Samurai
anime.synopsis:
At the pinnacle of his gymnastics career, Joutarou Aragaki—nicknamed Samurai for his signature hairstyle—suffers a shoulder injury following his wife's death. Five years later, he continues to push the limits of his body as a member of the Japanese gymnastics team. However, Joutarou's strenuous training fails to show any progress. His coach, Noriyuki Amakusa, advises that he retires.

Together with his exuberant and supportive nine-year-old daughter, Rei, Joutarou takes a trip to Ego Wonderland to break the bitter news to her. However, their excursion ends in an odd encounter with a peculiar self-proclaimed ninja named Leonardo. He follows them home and interrupts Joutarou's every attempt at telling his daughter.

Upon learning that Leonardo hopes to witness his gymnastics again, Joutarou astounds Japan with his announcement that he is not retiring. Joutarou dedicates himself to the biggest challenge of his career to prove that the gymnastics world is right where he belongs.
anime.consensus_summary: Taisou Zamurai is a heartwarming and inspirational anime that focuses on family bonds and overcoming adversity. While it may start slow, the strong character development and touching story resonate with many viewers. Criticisms primarily target the rushed pacing and mediocre CGI, but the overall sentiment is positive, with many considering it an underrated gem. Most fans enjoy the blend of sports and drama, making it a unique and memorable show.
pros: Strong character development, especially for the main character and his daughter.
The anime blends sports and family drama effectively.
The soundtrack and OP/ED themes are well-received and memorable.
The story is inspiring and heartwarming, focusing on overcoming adversity and the importance of family bonds.
cons: The pacing felt rushed due to the limited number of episodes.
Mediocre CGI animation quality, especially during gymnastics scenes.
Some side characters felt underdeveloped or introduced solely for plot convenience.
The initial episodes can be off-putting or 'boring' for some viewers.

anime.title: Princess Connect! Re:Dive Season 2
anime.synopsis: The members of the Gourmet Guild—Yuuki, Kokkoro, Pecorine, and Karyl—continue to scour the world in pursuit of their goal to seek out all delicious food in existence. However, as their adventures progress, the mysteries behind Yuuki's memories, Karyl's allegiance, and Pecorine's heritage begin to come together—seemingly forming the truth that makes up the world's very foundation.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Princess Connect! Re:Dive Season 2, praising its animation, humor, and character development. Some find the story unfocused and the protagonist underdeveloped. Despite criticisms, the season is considered a worthwhile and enjoyable adaptation, especially for fans of the first season.
pros: Consistent and high-quality animation with fluid fight scenes and vibrant details.
Well-balanced mix of comedy, drama, and action.
Strong character development, especially for Karyl and Pecorine.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality at times.
Too many side characters that are not fully utilized.
Sidelining of the protagonist, Yuuki, in favor of other characters.
Uneven pacing and a lack of direction in the overall story.

anime.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Machikado Mazoku.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Machikado Mazoku: 2-choume' as a lighthearted and fun series. Viewers appreciate the character interactions, improved pacing, and the blend of comedy with fantasy elements. Some find the plot simple, but overall, it's considered a solid and enjoyable continuation of the first season.
pros: Great characters with good chemistry
Fast-paced comedy
Plot development and lore expansion
Improved pacing compared to season 1
Easygoing and enjoyable
cons: Simple, almost unnoticeable story for some viewers
Fast-paced dialogue may cause jokes to be missed

anime.title: Kono Sekai no Tanoshimikata: Secret Story Film
anime.romaji_title: Kono Sekai no Tanoshimikata: Secret Story Film
anime.synopsis: An anime movie based on HoneyWorks' LIPxLIP virtual idol unit, commemorating the music circle's 10th anniversary.
anime.consensus_summary: Fans of HoneyWorks and LIPxLIP will likely enjoy this movie, as it delves into the backstory of the idol group. The story focuses on the characters' motivations and struggles, showcasing their journey to stardom. The movie is likely to appeal to those already familiar with the music videos, but may also serve as a good introduction for newcomers.
pros: Explores the backstory of LIPxLIP, showing how Aizou and Yuujirou became idols.
Highlights the struggles and auditions the characters face.
Good chemistry between the two main characters, cementing their bond.

anime.title: Farewell, My Dear Cramer
anime.synopsis:
Over the years, the reputation of women's soccer in Japan has been gradually waning. Despite this rather bleak scenario, there are still some schools with teams trying to keep the sport alive. With that, glimmers of hope are starting to appear.

Having played for the boys' soccer club when she was in middle school, Nozomi Onda's skills are nothing less than prodigious. Because of this, she thinks that playing soccer with fellow girls would only drag her down. She is only motivated to play her best when facing those she deems worthy opponents. Meanwhile, Sumire Suou is a promising rookie with exceptional talent—a talent hindered by a team that cannot keep up with her abilities.

Onda, convinced by her former coach to join a girls' soccer club, and Suou, accompanied by her close friend and rival Midori Soshizaki, cross paths as members of the Warabi Seinan High School's girls' soccer team. In this new field, both girls begin to display their full potential and skills. Along with their teammates, each of their steps, kicks, and goals will grant them victory—and perhaps also ensure that the sport begins its journey back into the spotlight.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the series' realistic portrayal of women's soccer and its adherence to the source material's story, many are disappointed by the inconsistent animation, pacing issues, and underdeveloped characters. The series struggles to balance sports action with character development, leaving some viewers frustrated. There is a sense of unfulfilled potential.
pros: Faithful adaptation of source material's story and characterization.
Realistic portrayal of soccer issues and player reactions.
Exploration of women's soccer challenges and dynamics.
cons: Inconsistent and sloppy animation quality, especially during character animation.
Pacing issues with rushed early episodes and drawn-out later episodes.
Over-reliance on flashbacks and monologues during matches.
Underdeveloped and one-dimensional characters.

anime.title: Shenmue the Animation
anime.synopsis: 1985, Yokosuka. Ryo Hazuki has trained to master the Hazuki Style Jujitsu under his strict father in the Hazuki Dojo from his childhood. However, one day a mysterious man named Lan Di murders his father and takes the “mirror” his father was protecting. Ryo is determined to find the truth behind his father’s murder, but soon finds himself getting stuck in a war between the underground organizations…. Traveling from Yokosuka to Hong Kong, Ryo’s long journey begins!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response is mixed. Fans of the Shenmue games appreciate the anime's faithfulness to the source material and its expansion of the story. However, some criticize the animation quality, pacing issues, and changes to characters, while newcomers find it to be an enjoyable entry point to the franchise.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the first two games.
Expands on the story and lore, adding more information and character development.
Well-paced and feels like a real story, improving on the game's pacing.
Good world-building that captures the essence of the locations.
Music recreates classic songs and reworks them for fight scenes.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with some CGI looking poor.
Rushed pacing in the second half, leading to a disappointing ending for some.
Some characters are not as well-developed or are changed in ways that are not appreciated.
The plot is simple and can feel repetitive, with a fetch quest structure.
Lacks emotional depth and character development.

anime.title: Dr. Ramune -Mysterious Disease Specialist-
anime.synopsis: At first glance, Ramune may not seem like a professional doctor—he is crass, rude, and often acts halfheartedly. But his true brilliance shines through once his patients pay him a visit: he is able to diagnose and treat all sorts of strange, mysterious diseases that come his way. From a young student whose fingers have turned into chili peppers to a child whose tears are made of condiments, Ramune is able to tap into a kind of innate, otherworldly sensibility that enables him to decipher the roots of their source. But finding the proper cure for these illnesses comes at a valuable price, and money certainly cannot be used to pay it.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience has a generally positive view of "Kai Byoui Ramune". Many appreciate the unique concept, creative storytelling, and balance of humor and seriousness. While there are criticisms regarding inconsistent writing and animation quality, the series is generally seen as a wholesome and enjoyable experience, especially for those who enjoy psychological and supernatural themes.
pros: Unique and imaginative concept with creative scenarios.
Exploration of emotional aspects tied to supernatural illnesses.
Good balance between humor and seriousness.
Characters are likable and relatable, with well-resolved issues.
The series is able to balance humour and seriousness well.
The characters are fleshed out beautifully through the short run of the show.
cons: Inconsistent storytelling and varying quality in cases.
The art direction was not great. It felt like it was going for more stylized but it didn't quite reach the threshold to be called unique.
The animation was pretty poor.
Dr. Ramune himself was not very fleshed out and often annoying.
The plot was predictable and felt repetitive at times.

anime.title: Scar on the Praeter
anime.synopsis:
Under siege by foreign organizations, the Akatsuki Special Ward is a battlefield tainted with greed and violence, abandoning its citizens caught in the crossfire. In the wake of the anarchic turmoil emerges the Scard—vigilantes who wield supernatural abilities gifted to them by divine tattoos. Among them is Eiji Arashiba, the Hero of Akatsuki, who protects the district from tyrant outsiders.

One fateful day, Eiji contends with Dusk—a mafia syndicate—alongside Yamato Kai, a boy he recently met. Amid the chaos, Yamato blocks a sniper bullet heading toward Eiji, but the shot still strikes his tattoo despite Yamato's efforts. To save the injured Yamato, Eiji passes the tattoo onto him, entrusting him with protecting the Akatsuki Special Ward in his sacrifice.

As the ward continues to collapse under conflict, will Yamato be able to use his newfound Scard powers to protect his loved ones, or will he falter trying to become the new Hero of Akatsuki?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the aesthetic elements and initial concept, but most are disappointed by the unoriginal storyline, shallow characters, and technical inconsistencies. Many find it a mediocre effort from the studio, failing to live up to its potential and overshadowed by its predecessors. The series is considered a passable time-filler for those prioritizing visuals over substance.
pros: Cool character designs and animation.
Interesting concept with potential.
Philosophical themes explored.
cons: Story is derivative of previous works by the studio (K).
Flat and underdeveloped characters with repetitive motivations.
Inconsistent visuals and jarring integration of 3D backgrounds.
Weak power system and lack of tension in battles.

anime.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent
anime.romaji_title: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu
anime.synopsis:
Since ancient times, the citizens of Slantania have lived within a shroud of miasma, a force that brings forth monsters creating havoc around the world. When the kingdom's Order of Knights becomes incapable of containing the monsters, the Grand Magus summons a holy maiden—the legendary "Saint"—to obliterate the horrid creatures and restore peace.

One evening, as Sei Takanashi returns home from a long day at work, a magical force pulls her into a foreign world. Upon her arrival to the kingdom of Slantania, she overhears that the Grand Magus inadvertently summoned two Saints—Sei and a brown-haired girl. Needing only one holy maiden, the prince declares the other girl as the Saint, leaving Sei to her own devices.

Sei sets her sight on the Medicinal Flora Research Institute, an establishment known for its studies regarding herbs and potions. While indulging in her latest passion, Sei has a fateful encounter with the commander of the Third Order of Knights. But little does she know, her aptitude as a Saint will continue to exert its influence over her new life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers found it a relaxing and enjoyable isekai with a likeable protagonist and mature characters, highlighting its combination of isekai and shoujo romance. However, many others criticized the show for its slow pace, lack of a compelling plot or antagonist, mediocre animation, and a Mary Sue-like main character, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Likeable protagonist in Sei.
Relaxing and wholesome story.
Mature characters that behave appropriately for their age.
Combines Isekai and Josei-type romance.
Addresses female self-insert power fantasy
cons: Slow-paced and boring plot.
Lack of antagonist and suspense.
Mediocre animation.
Generic and predictable story.
Mary Sue protagonist with little character development.
Filler dialogue.

anime.title: Sing a Bit of Harmony
anime.synopsis:
Satomi Amano is a model student as well as the daughter of the leading project manager of Hoshima, a company that has revolutionized AI technology. However, due to her standing, Satomi's presence has isolated her from her classmates—an obstacle she knows she may never overcome.

On an otherwise uneventful day, while preparing for school, Satomi uncovers her mother's latest exciting proposition: an AI that will prove whether robots can live alongside humans. Intrigued by how her mother will commence the project, Satomi makes her way to school, but standing in front of the class is none other than the AI herself.

As the subject of research, Shion Ashimori is tasked to fit in like a normal teenage girl without exposing her true identity. However, Shion has another goal in mind—to make Satomi happy instead. With her talent for singing, Shion strives to compose harmonious melodies that not only connect her with her newfound friends but also dispel the dissonance within Satomi's heart.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, praising the film's heartwarming story, beautiful animation, and unique musical elements. However, some viewers found the ending unsatisfying, the characters lacking depth, or the plot predictable. The integration of musical numbers is a point of contention, with some enjoying it and others finding it forced.
pros: Heartwarming story about friendship and emotions.
Beautiful animation and art style.
Unique blend of AI themes with musical elements.
Well-written characters and surprising plot twists.
cons: Climax and ending may feel unsatisfying to some.
Characters may lack depth due to movie runtime limitations.
Musical numbers may feel forced or mistimed.
Some find the story predictable or reliant on overused tropes.

anime.title: That is the Bottleneck
anime.synopsis: Set in a convenience store that seems to be everywhere, through the appearance of a convenience store clerk who does not talk properly, while raising problems with the way of modern communication, we will approach the secret of the mysterious hero Mutou.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences found 'Sore Dake ga Neck' to be a unique and enjoyable short anime with its simple, fast-paced storytelling and dry humor. While some viewers found the plot confusing and lacking depth, others appreciated the relatable characters and the show's exploration of modern communication. The series is generally recommended for those seeking a quick and unconventional viewing experience.
pros: Unique comedy and creative story.
Simple and comfortable to watch with fast-paced episodes.
Dry humor and well-written phrases.
Relatable and charming characters.
Interesting payoff that aligns with the show's themes and humor.
cons: Plotlines can become confusing and lack depth.
Story of one character gets accelerated towards the end.
Characters are somewhat disposable.

anime.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Collision
anime.romaji_title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Gekitotsu
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis: As Yang is ordered to appear before the Free Planet Alliance, he’s shaken by the corruption he discovers. Meanwhile, Marshal Reinhardt uncovers disloyalty under his command as an upstart admiral launches a vicious offensive to retake the Iserlohn Fortress. Struggling to make strides in this never-ending bloody war, these two finally see their true enemy lies not from without—but from within!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Gekitotsu' for its faithful adaptation and improved production values, but some find it lacking compared to the original. The show's exploration of political and philosophical themes is a major draw, though focus on specific characters can impact individual enjoyment. Overall, the audience reception is positive, with minor criticisms regarding character focus and design preferences.
pros: Improved CGI and animation quality.
Faithful adaptation of the novels.
Exploration of complex political and philosophical themes.
cons: New adaptation suffers in comparison to the original 80s OVA.
Some viewers find episodes not focused on specific characters (e.g., Reinhard) boring.
Designs in the new thesis are not preferred by some fans.

anime.title: Requiem of the Rose King
anime.synopsis: Richard Plantagenet has dedicated his whole life to becoming strong enough to fight alongside his father, the Duke of York. Together they have waged war to reclaim the right to the throne of England from King Henry VI and the House of Lancaster. However, the young Richard hides a secret—one that his mother scorns him for, which the cruel voices in his head never fail to remind him of. Even amid his personal turmoil, he is fortunate to find solace in the light of his father's love. But when the War of the Roses takes a turn for the bloodier, the fervent ambitions of Richard grow while his old loyalties splinter, threatening to taint his family's path to glory.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with many praising the underlying story and themes but heavily criticizing the poor animation quality and rushed adaptation. Some appreciate the attempt at LGBTQ+ representation, while others feel the narrative execution falls short. Overall, the anime is considered a disappointing adaptation of a potentially compelling manga series, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: The story is compelling and tragic, drawing viewers in despite flaws.
The voice acting is well-done and the soundtrack is good.
The anime attempts to represent intersex character Richard III
The art style, particularly the backgrounds, is unique and aesthetically pleasing.
cons: The animation quality is very poor, often relying on still frames and lacking detail.
The story feels rushed, with significant content cut from the manga adaptation.
Character designs are generic and uninspired.
The pacing is inconsistent, making it difficult to follow for viewers unfamiliar with the source material.
Significant changes from the play.

anime.title: Natsume's Book of Friends: The Waking Rock and the Strange Visitor
anime.romaji_title: Natsume Yuujinchou: Ishi Okoshi to Ayashiki Raihousha
anime.genres: Iyashikei, Mythology, Shoujo, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ishi Okoshi
While searching for Nyanko-sensei, Takashi Natsume encounters meek and small-looking youkai Mitsumi. Mitsumi was entrusted by his leader Gantetsu, a powerful and strong ayakashi, to be the year's "Ishi Okoshi," whose role consists of waking him from his deep slumber. Seeing how much Mitsumi wants to prove himself as Gantetsu's worthy servant, Natsume decides to help him fulfill his task. However, time is running out—for they are not the only ones who want to awaken the divine being.

Ayashiki Raihousha
One day, Natsume's friend Kaname Tanuma is visited by a strange man. In the subsequent days, the visitor briefly talks with Tanuma and leaves. Natsume soon discovers that the outsider is a youkai disguised as a human, who claims to bear no danger. Despite trusting the youkai, Tanuma's health slowly begins to deteriorate, causing Natsume to become more suspicious of the interloper. What is the truth of his sudden appearance and his connection with Tanuma?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the movie as two standalone episodes that maintain the series' relaxing and heartwarming feel. However, some viewers were disappointed by the lack of character progression and the slow pacing of certain segments. The second episode involving Tanuma was slightly better received than the first.
pros: Beautiful animation, music, and voice acting
Stories retain the calming atmosphere of the series
Good combination of comedy and heartwarming moments
cons: No character progression or exploration of main plot elements
First part of the movie feels slow and draggy
MC feels like a side character in some parts

anime.title: Horimiya
anime.synopsis:
On the surface, the thought of Kyouko Hori and Izumi Miyamura getting along would be the last thing in people's minds. After all, Hori has a perfect combination of beauty and brains, while Miyamura appears meek and distant to his fellow classmates. However, a fateful meeting between the two lays both of their hidden selves bare. Even though she is popular at school, Hori has little time to socialize with her friends due to housework. On the other hand, Miyamura lives under the noses of his peers, his body bearing secret tattoos and piercings that make him look like a gentle delinquent.

Having opposite personalities yet sharing odd similarities, the two quickly become friends and often spend time together in Hori's home. As they both emerge from their shells, they share with each other a side of themselves concealed from the outside world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Horimiya are divided, with some praising its art style, heartfelt moments, and balance of drama and simplicity. However, many criticize the rushed pacing, inconsistent storytelling, and superficial character development. Some viewers also find the relationship dynamics to be toxic, contributing to the polarized reception of the anime.
pros: Appealing art style and animation quality.
Likeable characters and convincing voice acting.
Heartfelt moments of connection and acceptance.
Exploration of friendship and self-acceptance.
Balances drama and simplicity effectively.
cons: Rushed pacing and inconsistent storytelling.
Superficial character development and relationships.
Generic storyline and reliance on clichés.
Contrived drama and stale comedy.
Toxic relationship dynamics perceived by some viewers.
Fails to do anything right while committing dozens of writing sins.
anime.thematic_vibe: Rom-Com, Slice of Life, High School

anime.title: The Wonderland of Ten Thousand 4th Season
anime.synopsis: Fourth season of Wan Jie Xian Zong.
anime.consensus_summary: The fourth season's story progression is criticized for being repetitive and convoluted. The narrative is perceived as a decline from previous seasons, with the plot feeling like an endless cycle. The overall sentiment suggests disappointment with the storytelling.
cons: Story progression has taken a nosedive.
Endless cycle of problem, planning, resolution is lackluster.
Story feels like babble about uncontrollable forces and evil powers.

anime.title: Despair of the Monster
anime.synopsis:
A story about fourteen-year-old alien girl Aoi Hoshino. Her family uses certain medicine to disguise themselves as humans.
For some reason the medicine slowly stops working, but only on Aoi...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the story's poignant themes and creative vision, despite its technical shortcomings. The narrative's emotional depth and unique premise resonate, though the low-budget animation and short length are noted drawbacks. Overall, viewers find it a worthwhile experience, particularly for those who value compelling storytelling over visual polish.
pros: Evocative music complements the story.
Well-written and impactful narrative.
Unique and committed vision.
cons: Subpar animation quality.
Short runtime hinders deeper development.
Production limitations due to budget constraints.

anime.title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Progressive - Aria of a Starless Night
anime.romaji_title: Sword Art Online: Progressive Movie - Hoshi Naki Yoru no Aria
anime.synopsis:
Excelling socially and academically, Asuna Yuuki is on track to ace her high school entrance exams. Her friend and classmate, Misumi "Mito" Tozawa, advises her to take a short break from studying and join her on the launch day of Sword Art Online (SAO)—the highly anticipated online virtual reality multiplayer game. Asuna accepts her offer and soon meets her in the game.

In a cruel twist of fate, Asuna, Mito, and every other player logged into SAO find themselves trapped in the game permanently. The only way out is to clear all one hundred floors of the game, and to make matters worse, dying inside the game will kill the player in real life. With SAO now turned into a nightmare death trap, Asuna and other gamers—such as the lone swordsman Kazuto "Kirito" Kirigaya—must adapt and survive, all whilst attempting to beat the unforgiving competition to the top.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is well-received, especially by fans of the series, for its stunning visuals and deeper exploration of Asuna's character. While some find the story too similar to the original Aincrad arc, the enhanced production quality and fresh perspective generally outweigh these concerns. The film is considered a worthwhile addition to the SAO franchise, offering both nostalgia and new content.
pros: Excellent animation and art style, particularly the fight scenes.
Asuna's perspective provides a fresh and engaging narrative.
The movie adds depth to Asuna's character and backstory.
Sound design and music by Yuki Kajiura are highly praised.
cons: Story closely follows the original Aincrad arc, potentially lacking novelty for some viewers.
Some felt the story was too short and didn't add enough relevant content.
Overuse of 'Swordland' OST can feel repetitive.

anime.title: SK8 the Infinity
anime.synopsis:
High school student Reki Kyan is passionate about one thing: skateboarding. When night falls, he heads to "S," an illegal underground race inside a mine where skaters compete in highly dangerous situations. After a loss that results in his skateboard being destroyed and his arm being broken, Reki is now incapable of practicing at all.

While working, Reki runs into his new classmate, Langa Hasegawa, a half-Canadian and half-Japanese boy with no skateboarding experience whatsoever. Langa is in desperate need of money. After they both visit "S" when tasked by Reki's boss, they get into trouble and are forced into a bet that requires Langa to skate in a race. However, the mysterious transfer student holds a trump card that Reki is unaware of, one which might help him win the race in the most unexpected way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many find the animation, character dynamics, and overall enjoyment high points, but are also critical of the unrealistic portrayal of skateboarding, weak plot development, and over-the-top villain. Some viewers found the ending disappointing and the Adam and Eve metaphors pointless.
pros: Beautiful animation and character design
Entertaining and relatable characters with good development
Exciting and enjoyable
cons: Unrealistic skateboarding and physics
Poor plot and villain
Clichéd elements

anime.title: Fruits Basket: The Final Season
anime.synopsis:
Hundreds of years ago, the Chinese zodiac spirits and their god swore to stay together eternally. United by this promise, the possessed members of the Souma family shall always return to each other under any circumstances. Yet, when these bonds shackle them from freedom, it becomes an undesirable burden—a curse. As head of the clan, Akito is convinced that he shares a special connection with the other Soumas. While he desperately clings to this fantasy, the rest of the family remains isolated and suppressed by the fear of punishment.

Tooru Honda, who has grown attached to the Soumas, is determined to break the chains that bind them. Her companionship with the family and her friends encourages her to move forward with lifting the curse. However, due to confounding revelations, she struggles to find the tenacity to continue her endeavors. With time slowly withering away, Tooru contends with an uncertain future in hopes of reaching the tranquility that may lie beyond all this commotion.
anime.consensus_summary: Fruits Basket: The Final receives high praise for its emotional depth, character development, and exploration of complex themes, however, some viewers found the pacing uneven and criticized the handling of certain sensitive topics, leading to a somewhat polarized reception. While many consider it a masterpiece that teaches valuable life lessons, others find it overrated and problematic in its portrayal of relationships.
pros: Beautifully crafted world with interesting premise and promising characters.
Addresses themes of love, grief, letting go of the past, and becoming your own person.
Deep character growth and complex portrayals of common feelings and emotions.
cons: Pacing issues, with some parts of the plot moving too slowly or too quickly.
Overrated with writing that becomes laughable, particularly in the final season.
Romanticization of grooming, abuse, and toxic relationships

anime.title: Baki Hanma
anime.synopsis:
The mauling of a vicious, prehistoric-sized African elephant makes international headlines. Featured in reports of the aftermath, the sole survivor of one of the animal's rampages attributes its death to a lone, unarmed man—unknowingly describing Yuujirou Hanma, nicknamed the "Ogre" and often labeled as the "strongest creature on Earth." Elsewhere, Yuujirou's 18-year-old son Baki spars with an equally formidable beast: a praying mantis.

Content with his training and determined to overtake his father, Baki abducts American President George Bosch to begin his plans. This leads to his deliberate imprisonment at the infamous Arizona State Prison where Oliva Biscuit resides—the strongest man in the United States and an inmate allowed to leave of his own volition. Hoping to gauge his abilities, Baki challenges Oliva to a fight; but Oliva is preoccupied with his eccentric rival, Jun Guevaru. Known as the "Second," he is the only other prisoner to receive special treatment from the guards.

Bewildered yet intrigued, Baki learns about his fellow inmates and tolerates the hellish conditions of prison life while waiting for an opportunity to present itself.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Hanma Baki: Son of Ogre is noticeably divided. While many long-time fans appreciate the continuation of the series' signature hyper-masculine action and stylistic elements, a significant portion of viewers find the season lacking in fights, suffering from slow pacing, and relying too heavily on exposition over action. There's a clear split between those who embrace the show's over-the-top nature and those who find it nonsensical and tedious.
pros: Animation and art style are maintained or improved, with detailed line art and character designs.
The iconic Baki confrontation soundtrack is revived and fitting for the tense atmosphere.
Characters, including Baki and Oliva, are highlighted, with some character development explored.
Dialogue can be witty and interesting, contributing to the character-heavy episodes.
The series builds tension effectively, especially for significant fights.
cons: The series is criticized for being less action-heavy than previous seasons, with a focus on exposition and dialogue.
Pacing issues are prevalent, with explanations and repetitions that can drag out the narrative.
Animation can be inconsistent, with 'peaks over consistency' and some scenes being just slides or low-quality CGI.
The realism is often sacrificed for over-the-top, nonsensical scenarios and 'cringe' techniques.
Some characters are underdeveloped or disappointing, failing to meet expectations.
Narrators and unnecessary exposition interrupt the fights, detracting from the viewing experience.
The prison setting is criticized for not feeling rigorous or dangerous.
The show's hyper-masculine themes and dialogue are perceived as "macho bullshit" or even "pathetic" by some.

anime.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby Season 2
anime.synopsis:
Within the horse-racing world, the horse girls of Team Spica have been gaining popularity as they continue to rack up victories. The one receiving the most attention in the group is Toukai Teiou, known for her cheerful personality and exceptional running skills. Teiou aims to become an undefeated Triple Crown horse girl by winning all three G1 races consecutively, a feat that has not been accomplished since the legendary Symboli Rudolf managed to do so many years ago.

On her path to obtaining the Triple Crown, Teiou is met with many challenges, encountering both old and new rivals. Amidst her fierce rivalries, however, Teiou is soon confronted with decisions that will leave a huge impact on her very own racing career.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly loves 'Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Season 2', praising its character development, emotional depth, and inspirational story. Many viewers found the series to be a significant improvement over the first season, highlighting the focus on new characters and the realistic portrayal of overcoming challenges. While some found the drama excessive, the overall sentiment is one of high praise and emotional connection.
pros: Great character development, especially for main and side characters
Story is well-written, with unexpected twists and turns
Emotionally resonant and inspiring, with viewers crying due to character success and overcoming adversity
Strong focus on themes of perseverance, never giving up, and the importance of hard work
cons: Some found the drama in the second season to be excessive
Animation quality was occasionally lackluster

anime.title: Girls' Frontline 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Shaonu Qianxian: Renxing Xiao Juchang.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some fans appreciate the continuation of the cute style and inclusion of new characters, finding the stories more entertaining. However, others feel the show has lost its comedic edge and that the slice-of-life elements are dull, with a possible decline in animation quality compared to the first season.
pros: Continuation of the cute chibi style
Familiar JP voice actors return
Stories are more entertaining than the first season for some viewers
cons: Story is lacking compared to the first season
Comedy is diminished
Slice of life is dull and boring
Animation quality is possibly lower than the first season
anime.thematic_vibe: Cute, Slice of Life, Fan Service

anime.title: What's Wrong with My Big Brother 2nd Season
anime.romaji_title: Wo Jia Da Shixiong Shi Ge Fanpai
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Transmigrating to a cultivation world only to find himself not fitting the protagonist's character description, Dongfang Xianyun mistakenly identifies his second junior brother, Yin Feixing, who has been reborn for revenge, as the "protagonist." Intending to cling to the protagonist's coattails to survive, he is instead kicked off a cliff by his "cog," thus embarking on the path of a demonic cultivator villain. Characters such as the naive and innocent Mahayana-stage demonic cultivator Yi Xiangfeng, the playboy Dongfang Wuqiong, the eldest disciple of the Xuanming Sect, and the Heavenly Dao Messenger Bu Suantian, also a transmigrator, all make their appearance. The Demon Subduing Assembly brings together a storm of events, and the battle between righteous and demonic cultivators is about to erupt. Dongfang Xianyun, the former eldest disciple of the Xiaoyao Sect and now the senior demonic cultivator of the Bai Mei Sect, is caught in a life-or-death crisis…
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the comedic and lighthearted nature of 'Wo Jia Da Shixiong Shi Ge Fanpai,' especially for stress relief. However, the later episodes, particularly the ending, received criticism for forced comedy, unreasonable plot decisions, and poor voice acting. While the series is appreciated for its humor, some viewers may find the plot simplistic.
pros: Hilarious and lighthearted; good for stress relief.
Enjoyable comedy that initially merges well with the storyline.
cons: Plot can be simple and may not appeal to those seeking complexity.
The ending became a mess due to forced comedy and unreasonable character decisions.
Unnecessary dialogues and cringy voice acting in later episodes.

anime.title: Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki 3
anime.synopsis: Third season of Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki.
anime.consensus_summary: The third season is seen as a continuation of the established formula, with some finding it enjoyable for its lightheartedness and cultural focus on Nagoya. However, others feel the central joke has become repetitive and the season unnecessary. The reception is generally mild, with little strong polarization.
pros: Cute character designs and interactions
Highlights cultural sights and food of Nagoya
Enjoyable for those wanting a lighthearted break
Good ambient sound and seiyuu selection
cons: The central joke (Nagoya vs Tokyo) wears thin
Unnecessary addition to the series, pushing the joke too far

anime.title: Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! Season 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance
anime.synopsis: During the summer holidays, energetic Hana Uzaki spent most of her time accompanying her lonesome upperclassman, Shinichi Sakurai. Now that school has resumed, Uzaki's teasing continues to ramp up, much to Sakurai's constant annoyance. Nevertheless, no amount of ridicule can damage the pair's relationship—which only seems to be getting better as their college days fly by!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on whether Uzaki-chan wa Asobitai! Double successfully advances the main relationship or merely retreads familiar ground. While many appreciate the comedic improvements and the addition of new characters, a significant portion of viewers finds the romantic progression too slow and the humor repetitive. The show is seen as a decent, lighthearted watch for fans of the genre, but it fails to universally satisfy those seeking substantial romantic development.
pros: Character development and relationship progression between the main couple, though some argue it's too slow.
Introduction and integration of new, entertaining side characters, particularly Uzaki's family.
Improved comedic timing and a shift towards more character-driven humor compared to the first season.
Generally consistent animation and upbeat soundtrack fitting the show's tone.
cons: Repetitive humor and plot points, leading to a feeling of stagnation for some viewers.
Lack of significant romantic progression, leaving some audiences frustrated by the 'slow burn'.
Animation and character designs are considered average or bland by some critics.
Pacing issues, with padding that detracts from the main narrative.

anime.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Harem, Romance, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
A year after they met, Kazuya Kinoshita and Chizuru Mizuhara still regularly see each other through the rental girlfriend app. However, Chizuru confesses that she is ready to quit her job to pursue her true passion—acting. Despite wishing to maintain the relationship they have, Kazuya decides to support her dream.

When Kazuya goes to watch Chizuru's anticipated first play, he is amazed by her talent and ability to captivate the audience. At the same time, he is saddened at the thought that she will undoubtedly be scouted by the famous director in attendance.

However, after the show, Chizuru explains that the director recruited another actress, lamenting her lack of talent. Frustrated on her behalf, Kazuya resolves to rent her every week to help her financially. But as Kazuya's ex-girlfriend Mami Nanami lingers around for unknown reasons, hesitance muddles his true feelings, and fulfilling his promise to Chizuru becomes uncertain.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely negative, with many criticizing the protagonist's lack of development and the repetitive plot. Some find it entertaining despite its flaws, while others are highly critical of its endorsement of questionable behavior. The show seems to evoke strong reactions, with viewers either hating it or finding some level of enjoyment in its train wreck nature.
pros: Some viewers appreciate Kazuya's attempts to support Chizuru's dreams.
A few reviewers feel the show provides an opportunity to discuss morality.
Some found it entertaining despite its flaws, with anticipation for each new episode.
cons: Many find Kazuya to be an unlikable, pathetic, and unrelatable protagonist.
The plot is repetitive and lacks significant character development or progression.
Humor relies heavily on cringe and overused tropes.
Several reviewers expressed concern over the endorsement of bad behavior.

anime.title: Idolls!
anime.synopsis: Despite performing as an idol group for three years, Idolls! has failed to make its mark on the entertainment world, only boasting a meager three fans. While the girls are venting their frustrations, a small wooden statue in their room suddenly starts speaking to them and convinces them to book a venue that seats one hundred fans. The only problem is that their performance is in just nine days! Now in a race against time, the girls must prove themselves worthy of stardom or face the harsh reality of failure.
anime.consensus_summary: The general consensus is that 'Idolls!' is a poorly executed anime with a weak story and low-budget production. Some viewers find it to be a relaxing and cute buffer between darker anime, while others consider it to be a waste of time due to its offensive content and lack of originality. The VTuber live performance concept is seen as an interesting idea, but the anime itself fails to impress.
pros: Relaxing watch
Cute gags
Good background music and OP/ED
Interesting VTuber live performance concept
cons: Forgettable music
Tragic combination of CG, music, story and characters
Offensive and ridiculous content
Poor character development
Low budget animation
Repetitive assets
Weak story

anime.title: Ling Cage
anime.consensus_summary: The episode directly follows the previous part, focusing on political tension and action. Viewers appreciate the continuation but note the lack of significant changes in production quality. The episode seems to serve as a bridge, setting up future events with a contained scope.
pros: Direct continuation of Part 1
Explosive fight sequence
cons: Not much has changed in art or animation
Limited content in a single episode

anime.title: Dropkick On My Devil!! X
anime.synopsis:
Ever since she was summoned from Hell by the witch Yurine Hanazono, Jashin-chan—a half-human, half-snake demon—has been searching for any way to go back. One of her options is to kill the one who summoned her, which is much easier said than done. Jashin-chan often finds herself getting violently beaten by Yurine after not only any failed murder attempt, but also when she is just causing mischief, destroying any hope of going back home to Hell.

The demon is also terrible with money and tends to gamble all of it away at pachinko. In one of these gambling sessions, she loses the three million yen she received from Hell Financing, putting her into a lifelong debt. To avoid repaying it altogether, Jashin-chan flees to Hokkaido to try and hide for the rest of her days, but her wish of having her debts forgotten may just be a pipe dream when someone comes knocking for the money.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive towards Jashin-chan Dropkick X, especially if they enjoyed the previous seasons. While many appreciate the continued humor and new characters, some find the gags repetitive and the overt product placement distracting.  The season is seen as more of the same, which is both a positive and negative depending on viewer expectations.
pros: The series continues to be a bloody fun time.
New characters are a welcome addition.
Maintains the same humor and interactions that made the previous seasons enjoyable.
cons: Gags often fall flat and feel mediocre.
Feels like a marketing scheme to promote tourism and Hatsune Miku.
Some episodes seemed dragged out.
Lacks novelty compared to the first season.

anime.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose
anime.romaji_title: Osananajimi ga Zettai ni Makenai Love Comedy
anime.synopsis:
Sueharu Maru is childhood best friends with one of Hozumino High School's most popular girls, Kuroha Shida. Cute, outgoing, and affectionate, Kuroha is the perfect older sister type. She has boys constantly begging at her feet to be with her. Yet, when she confesses to Sueharu one day, he immediately rejects her; he just can't think of her in that way! Besides, he already has his sights set on his first love—school idol and renowned author Shirokusa Kachi.

Sueharu believes that he has a chance with Kachi after one fateful meeting, but soon, he finds out that Kachi has a boyfriend! With his dreams now shattered, Sueharu agonizes over what could have been. That is, until Kuroha approaches him with a proposal: "let's get revenge."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus for 'Osananajimi ga Zettai ni Makenai Love Comedy' is largely negative, with many viewers finding the show to be a generic and poorly executed rom-com. Criticisms focus on the uninspired plot, weak characters, and abandoned revenge theme. While some enjoyed it as a guilty pleasure, the majority express disappointment and regret over watching the series, citing wasted potential and numerous unresolved plot points.
pros: Catchy opening and ending themes.
Some viewers found the anime enjoyable as a trashy harem, appreciating the character interactions and entertainment value.
Decent animation and character design were noted, with fluid movements in certain scenes.
cons: Generic and uninspired story relying heavily on rom-com cliches and tropes.
Poorly executed revenge plot that is quickly abandoned.
Weak and unlikeable characters, often described as bland and one-dimensional.
Inconsistent plot points and unresolved storylines.
Repetitive and unsatisfying 'my-turn-your-turn' scenarios between characters.
Poorly written and uninspired dialogue.

anime.title: Godzilla Singular Point
anime.synopsis:
When Yun Arikawa and his partner, Haberu Katou, investigate a house rumored to be haunted, the last thing they expect is to stumble into a mystery that will soon envelop the entire planet. While measuring strange radio signals, they receive a call from Mei Kamino, a graduate student investigating the same signal and using the equipment their company previously installed.

After an odd night, Yun returns to work at Ootaki Factory, a tech company that actually exists to produce Jet Jaguar—a robot that conspiracy theorist Gorou Ootaki has dreamed of creating. However, when flying dinosaur-like creatures known as Rodan are attracted to the strange radio signals, Jet Jaguar seems to be the only force capable of fighting them. As Yun and Mei investigate the Rodans' sudden appearance, more dangerous monsters begin to surface from the ocean—along with enigmatic red dust.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions to Godzilla: Singular Point are mixed. While some appreciate its originality, visual style, and references to the Godzilla franchise, many find the plot convoluted, confusing, and bogged down by excessive exposition. The underutilization of Godzilla himself and the lack of character development are also common criticisms, resulting in a polarized reception.
pros: Original story with intellectual themes.
Visually appealing animation style.
Soundtrack and sound design are well-executed.
References and allusions to previous Godzilla entries are appreciated by fans.
cons: Overly complex and confusing plot with excessive techno-babble.
Pacing issues and convoluted time travel elements.
Underutilization of Godzilla and other classic monsters.
Characters are not well-developed and serve primarily as plot devices.

anime.title: Wonder Egg Priority
anime.synopsis:
Following the suicide of her best and only friend, Koito Nagase, Ai Ooto is left grappling with her new reality. With nothing left to live for, she follows the instructions of a mysterious entity and gets roped into purchasing an egg, or specifically, a Wonder Egg.

Upon breaking the egg in a world that materializes during her sleep, Ai is tasked with saving people from the adversities that come their way. In doing so, she believes that she has moved one step closer to saving her best friend. With this dangerous yet tempting opportunity in the palms of her hands, Ai enters a place where she must recognize the relationship between other people's demons and her own.

As past trauma, unforgettable regrets, and innate fears hatch in the bizarre world of Wonder Egg Priority, a young girl discovers the different inner struggles tormenting humankind and rescues them from their worst fears.
anime.consensus_summary: Wonder Egg Priority initially captivated audiences with its stunning visuals and intriguing premise, promising a deep dive into psychological themes and trauma. However, the series ultimately faltered due to a convoluted and poorly executed narrative, leading to significant disappointment and frustration. Many viewers felt that the show's potential was squandered by its messy storytelling, inconsistent character development, and insensitive handling of sensitive subject matter, resulting in a highly polarized reception.
pros: Visually stunning animation and art style
Unique and original concept with potential for deep exploration of themes
Compelling character designs and distinct personalities
Excellent sound design and music
cons: Messy and incoherent narrative, especially in the later episodes
Poor character development and inconsistencies
Problematic and insensitive handling of sensitive themes like suicide and sexual assault
Overreliance on symbolism without meaningful explanation or connection
Abrupt shift in genre and introduction of sci-fi elements that feel out of place
Unsatisfactory and rushed ending that leaves many questions unanswered

anime.title: Moriarty the Patriot Part 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Historical, Mystery, Organized Crime, Psychological, Shounen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Great Britain is ablaze with news of a so-called "Lord of Crime," a criminal mastermind responsible for the downfall of several unruly nobles. In truth, the Lord of Crime is not an individual, but rather a group consisting of William James Moriarty and his two brothers, Louis and Albert. Together, they wish to destroy everything rotten about their current world and create a new, fair society for all. To accomplish their goal, they must commit criminal acts, which the great detective Sherlock Holmes and his partner, John H. Watson, cannot abide by. A dangerous cat and mouse game begins between the Lord of Crime and Sherlock, with each trying to outwit the other. Yet Sherlock, despite his skills, has no idea that his foe is right under his nose.

Involved with both parties is a woman named Irene Adler, who is as beautiful as she is cunning. No stranger to scandal, Irene has embroiled herself in one that may be too big even for her, as the classified documents she stole could shake the very foundations of the British Empire. Can Irene be saved, or does a deadly future await her?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is somewhat mixed. While many appreciate the show's intriguing premise, engaging characters, and thought-provoking themes, some find the execution lacking due to pacing issues, inconsistent character development, and a perceived over-reliance on existing Sherlock Holmes lore. The series has a dedicated fanbase, but it is not universally praised.
pros: Intriguing cat-and-mouse dynamic between Moriarty and Sherlock.
Engaging story with thought-provoking themes about class conflict and societal reform.
Visually appealing characters and overall aesthetic.
cons: Pacing issues, with some arcs feeling rushed or underdeveloped.
Inconsistent character development, particularly for Sherlock.
Over-reliance on references to other works without sufficient originality.

anime.title: Shadows House
anime.synopsis:
The Shadows, characterized by their pitch-black appearance and tendency to emit soot when agitated, are a family of nobles who reside in a colossal manor deep within the mountains far from other humans. When a Shadow child is nearly of-age, they are assigned a Living Doll who acts not only as their attendant but also as their second half—the faces they could have had if not for their complexion.

Emilico is a cheerful, newly created Doll who serves a rather soft-spoken master named Kate. Despite their difference in personalities, Emilico does what she can to carry out the needs of her master. As she learns more about her role and duty, Emilico begins to meet her fellow Dolls and their respective masters and comes to know more about the purpose of her existence.

"Do not fret over trivial matters," says one of the rules by which all Dolls must abide. But how could the ever-curious Emilico do so in the face of the deep secrets that the Shadows House holds?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many find the initial premise and mystery engaging, alongside the unique world and strong visuals. However, deviations from the manga, pacing issues, and perceived weaknesses in character development and writing, particularly in the later episodes, lead to significant disappointment for some viewers.
pros: Unique worldbuilding and premise
Engaging mystery
Strong visual storytelling and aesthetic
Good animation and music
cons: Pacing issues, especially in the early and later episodes
Anime original content deviates from the manga and is considered disappointing
Plot holes and conveniences in the writing
Characters can be one-dimensional and annoying
Lackluster reveals of mysteries

anime.title: Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It r=1-sinθ
anime.romaji_title: Rikei ga Koi ni Ochita no de Shoumei shitemita. Heart
anime.synopsis:
Following the events of their trip to Okinawa, Saitama University graduate students Shinya Yukimura and Ayame Himuro have failed to obtain the data necessary to scientifically prove their love for each other. Unable to replicate the exact conditions of the trip, the two stubborn scientists decide to seek help from elsewhere in the university—the Biological Sciences department.

Assisted by fellow graduate students and longtime couple Chris Floret and Suiu Fujiwara, Yukimura and Himuro begin to quantify their feelings by measuring their output of oxytocin in various romantic situations. The two scientists soon find that their feelings for each other are nothing compared to that of a mature couple. It is here that Chris poses a question to both Yukimura and Himuro: what will they do if their "affection" is proven not to be love after all?

Desperate to find a scientific rationale for the discrepancy, Yukimura puts everything on the line to prove that their "love" is real.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of 'Rikei ga Koi ni Ochita no de Shoumei shitemita. Heart' is met with mixed reactions. While some appreciate the focus on side characters and the initial lightheartedness, the consensus is that the final episodes, particularly involving Kanade's arc, are poorly written, tonally inconsistent, and feature unnecessary and disturbing content. This leads to a significant drop in enjoyment and a generally negative final impression, overshadowing the positive aspects of the earlier episodes.
pros: Strong focus on side characters allows them to shine.
First half of the season retains the fun, cute romantic comedy feel of season 1.
OP and ED are well-received and catchy.
VA is done well and is the reason that most of the jokes hit well.
Blue balling is low and the number of ships is high.
cons: Sudden tonal shift in the final episodes with depictions of violence and attempted sexual assault is jarring and poorly executed.
Kanade's 'Normal' arc is considered irritating, overdramatic, and poorly resolved.
The writing is inconsistent, and the plot feels disjointed compared to season 1.
Himuro's role is diminished, making her feel less like a main character.
The forced drama and love triangle feel unnecessary and detract from the wholesome romance.
The comedy can be hit or miss.
Some found the addition of Chris and Suiu to be unnecessary and annoying.
anime.thematic_vibe: Romantic Comedy, Scientific Inquiry, Relationship Dynamics

anime.title: Tsukimichi -Moonlit Fantasy-
anime.synopsis:
As part of a mysterious contract agreed upon by a goddess and his parents years ago, Makoto Misumi finds himself sent to another world to meet the goddess and become the hero. However, the deity deems Makoto to be "hideous," refusing to even lay eyes upon him and revokes his heroic title. Disdainfully giving him the ability to understand all languages except the human language as compensation, the goddess drives Makoto off to the farthest edges of the wasteland, far from human civilization.

Due to the disparity between Earth and this new world, Makoto's inherent physical and magical capabilities awaken, making him extremely powerful. He meets various demihumans and mythical beings who all end up being captivated with his characteristics and join Makoto in building a new community where all of them can peacefully coexist.

Nevertheless, despite this success, Makoto still yearns to meet fellow humans. In a world where the goddess herself has barred him from interacting with his kind, it is up to Makoto and his companions to fulfill his desire—and perhaps reform society along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some find it a fun and enjoyable isekai with good comedy and action, while others criticize its rushed pacing, shallow plot, and inconsistent character development. The controversial tone shift in later episodes polarized some viewers, while others appreciate the show's unique take on familiar tropes. Ultimately, the show is seen as a flawed but entertaining isekai with a lot of unrealized potential.
pros: Good balance of comedy and action.
Enjoyable and relatable characters, especially the MC.
Unique and quirky waifus with interesting personalities.
Fast-paced plot progression and world establishment.
Decent animation quality and unique character designs.
Good comedy that makes fun of isekai tropes.
cons: Rushed pacing and skipped content from the source material.
Inconsistent character development and abrupt character changes.
Shallow plot with little depth and complexity.
Lack of chemistry between main characters.
Cliche harem trope.
Inconsistent animation quality.
Jarring tone shifts, particularly in later episodes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Isekai Parody, Power Fantasy, Nation Building

anime.title: Dr. Stone: Stone Wars Eve of the Battle Special Feature
