anime.romaji_title: Dr. Stone: Stone Wars - Kaisen Zenya Special Eizou
anime.synopsis: A recap episode with additional scenes which was screened on Jump's official YouTube channel for Jump Special Anime Festa 2020.
anime.consensus_summary: The recap episode is well-received as a refresher and hype-builder for the next season. Viewers appreciate the inclusion of new scenes and previews, although some find the recap unnecessary if they've recently watched the first season. Overall, it serves its purpose effectively for those needing a reminder or looking forward to the new content.
pros: Well-paced recap covering key events
Includes a preview of the next season, heightening anticipation
Effective at refreshing viewers' memories
New scenes integrated to make the recap feel like an episode
Animation, sound, and characters maintain the quality of the original series
cons: Recap may be unnecessary for those who recently watched the first season
Recaps will never be as good
A couple of minute recap since the last episode onto the first episode of the new season [would be better]

anime.title: Tsurune the Movie: The First Shot
anime.synopsis:
A recap of Tsurune: Kazemai Koukou Kyuudoubu with new scenes.

Minato Narumiya reignites his passion for kyudo, the Japanese martial art of archery. Along with his friends in the school kyudo club, he returns for this feature-length sports anime film.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is primarily a recap with a few new scenes that focus on character development, particularly for Masaki and Minato. While fans appreciate the added character moments, the lack of significant plot advancement may disappoint some viewers. The overall reception appears mild, with enjoyment stemming from revisiting familiar characters and settings.
pros: New scenes contribute to character development (Masaki and Minato).
Visually appealing (inferred from the anime genre).
cons: Large portion of the movie is a recap.
New scenes don't add significantly to the plot.

anime.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War -Ultra Romantic-
anime.synopsis:
The elite members of Shuchiin Academy's student council continue their competitive day-to-day antics. Council president Miyuki Shirogane clashes daily against vice-president Kaguya Shinomiya, each fighting tooth and nail to trick the other into confessing their romantic love. Kaguya struggles within the strict confines of her wealthy, uptight family, rebelling against her cold default demeanor as she warms to Shirogane and the rest of her friends.

Meanwhile, council treasurer Yuu Ishigami suffers under the weight of his hopeless crush on Tsubame Koyasu, a popular upperclassman who helps to instill a new confidence in him. Miko Iino, the newest student council member, grows closer to the rule-breaking Ishigami while striving to overcome her own authoritarian moral code.

As love further blooms at Shuchiin Academy, the student council officers drag their outsider friends into increasingly comedic conflicts.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided on 'Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Ultra Romantic.' While some praise the show for its comedic brilliance, inventive visuals, and overall quality, many find it to be a disappointing continuation of the series. Criticisms focus on repetitive jokes, neglected side characters, and a lackluster story, leading to claims of the season being overrated.
pros: Visually inventive and passionately-driven manga adaptation.
Spectacular and versatile direction.
Excellent comedy, drama, and animation.
Well-balanced characters in the first two seasons.
cons: Repetitive jokes and character inconsistencies.
Side characters are neglected in season 3.
Dragging out the romance too long.
Story feels lackluster and boring.
Overrated and doesn't live up to the hype.
Pop culture references feel outdated and cringe-worthy

anime.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War OVA
anime.romaji_title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai? Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunousen OVA
anime.synopsis:
What do Shuchiin Academy's model students do outside of their student council duties? After a visit to the swimming pool, Kaguya Shinomiya and Chika Fujiwara take to the showers to wash themselves off. When Chika accidentally drops a bar of soap, the two find themselves in a rather slippery mishap. 

Meanwhile, Miyuki Shirogane and Yuu Ishigami examine a discarded pornographic magazine—its content bearing an uncanny resemblance to the other student council members. Later on, an intense fried rice cook-off commences as Chika and Miko Iino seek to crown a master chef amongst the council. 

These eccentric activities reveal a side of the student council that has never been seen before!
anime.consensus_summary: The Kaguya-sama OVA is highly divisive among fans. Many viewers found the excessive fanservice and sexual content to be jarring, uncomfortable, and out of character for the series. While some appreciated the comedy in the fried rice segment, the overall sentiment leans towards disappointment and criticism of the OVA's deviation from the established tone.
pros: Voice acting is top-notch.
The fried rice cook-off segment was well-received by some.
cons: Excessive and uncomfortable fanservice, particularly the shower scene.
Sexualization of underage characters and comparison to pornographic material.
Characters acting out of character.
Uneven quality, with some finding parts boring or disgusting.
The ecchi content felt out of place for a series known for its rom-com elements.

anime.title: My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising - Epilogue Plus
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 2: Heroes:Rising - Epilogue Plus - Yume wo Genjitsu ni
anime.synopsis: A picture drama epilogue to the film Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 2: Heroes:Rising, bundled with the BD/DVD release.
anime.consensus_summary: The epilogue is well-received as a proper goodbye to the island and its characters from the second movie, despite the picture drama format being less preferred. The show is good at selling viewers on the importance of characters tied to a specific arc. Overall, it provides a satisfying conclusion to the events of the movie.
pros: Good send-off for side characters
Effective at making arc-tied characters feel important
Shows the aftermath of the movie's events
cons: Picture drama format is not ideal (slideshow with voiceover)
Presentation could be better

anime.title: Kageki Shojo!!
anime.synopsis:
After being forced to graduate from JPX48 following a controversial incident with a male fan, Ai Narata swears to never interact with another man ever again. Using her talents and strong desire to get away from men, Ai auditions for the exclusive all-female Kouka School of Musical and Theatrical Arts. The school is renowned for producing the best actresses that go on to perform in the famous all-female Kouka Theatre Troupe. Coming from the idol industry, Ai is the perfect candidate for the school's hundredth generation class, but her aloof demeanor alienates her from her classmates.

The eccentric Sarasa Watanabe is the only person who wishes to become Ai's friend. She enters Kouka with the goal of becoming a top "otokoyaku" performer—an actress that plays traditionally male roles. After seeing a Kouka performance of The Rose of Versailles when she was younger, Sarasa dreams of performing as Lady Oscar one day. Unfortunately, Sarasa's inability to read a room causes friction between her and her classmates, including Ai, who reluctantly becomes her roommate and partner in many of their classes. 

Succeeding at Kouka will involve more than just raw talent for these young girls as jealousy, deceit, and the harsh realities of show business put their mental fortitude to the test. Will Sarasa and Ai be able to rise to the top and stand on the silver bridge?
anime.consensus_summary: Kageki Shoujo!! is a surprisingly impactful and emotionally resonant anime that explores mature themes within the setting of a performing arts school. Viewers praise the well-developed characters, realistic portrayal of struggles, and the blend of humor and darker elements. While some critique the animation quality and pacing, the overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, with many considering it a hidden gem.
pros: Well-developed characters with satisfying arcs.
Tackles mature themes (trauma, abuse, eating disorders) with sensitivity and realism.
Excellent blend of humor and darker elements.
Strong voice acting and impactful emotional delivery.
Unique and appealing art style.
Demonstrates a deep love and reverence for the performing arts, paying attention to details and intricacies.
Exploration of theater with care and love.
cons: Animation quality can be inconsistent, with some episodes featuring limited animation.
Pacing issues with character development feeling rushed towards the end.
The ending felt abrupt and somewhat open-ended.
Time structure can be fuzzy and unclear.
One scene mishandles sexual abuse of an underage character which is highly disturbing and inappropriate.
Story gets convoluted and directionless at times.
Inconsistent animation.

anime.title: The Way of the Househusband
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Organized Crime
anime.synopsis:
Who would have ever thought that the most feared gangster of his time now spends his days as a modest househusband? Seemingly giving up the way of the yakuza, the legendary "Immortal Dragon" Tatsu, best known for his prolific skirmishes against rival gangs, has abruptly vanished. Unbeknownst to most, however, Tatsu is currently staying at an apartment with his wife, doing his best to live a peaceful life.

Donning his trusty apron, Tatsu is now striving to become an efficient homemaker. Because of this, he has mastered the required skills—be it cooking the most delicious dishes, making sure to get the best deals at supermarkets, and everything in between—garnering the surprise of both of his former subordinates and enemies alike. Despite being a man with quite a controversial past, Tatsu's new way of life will only be more eccentric from here on out!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is significantly divided, primarily over the animation style. While many praise the core concept, humor, and voice acting, a substantial portion feels the minimal animation ruins the adaptation. This split makes the show a polarizing experience, with opinions often hinging on whether viewers can overlook the production shortcomings for the sake of the comedy.
pros: Phenomenal voice acting, particularly from Kenjiro Tsuda as Tatsu.
The humor is effective and often hilarious, landing well due to strong comedic timing and writing.
The concept of a former yakuza as a househusband is unique and inherently entertaining.
Opening and ending themes are praised for enhancing the mood and material.
The coloring is noted as good by some reviewers.
cons: Animation quality is heavily criticized as minimal, lazy, or akin to a slideshow/PowerPoint presentation.
The art style is described as ugly, lacking detail, and worse than the source material.
Sound design is called generic, stock, and depressing.
Pacing issues and confusing character introductions are mentioned.
The animation detracts from and distracts from the humor.
Lack of character depth beyond Tatsu is noted.
The overall production feels like a low-effort, rushed adaptation.

anime.title: Yasuke
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Fantasy, Gore, Historical, Samurai
anime.synopsis: A village in danger, a mysterious child, warring daimyo, and the greatest ronin never known all clash in a Japan of magic and mechs. Learn the story of the first African samurai.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is significantly divided, primarily over the jarring inclusion of sci-fi/fantasy elements like mechs and magic in a historical setting. While the animation and soundtrack receive consistent praise, the rushed pacing and weak writing detract from the experience for many, leading to disappointment for those expecting historical accuracy or a coherent narrative.
pros: Visually striking art direction and animation, particularly during fight scenes.
The soundtrack, a blend of hip-hop and traditional Japanese music, is highly praised.
Yasuke himself is a likable protagonist, with his past often seen as more compelling than the present story.
cons: Inclusion of magic and mechs in a historical setting is widely criticized as nonsensical and detrimental to the premise.
Pacing is consistently described as rushed, leading to underdeveloped plot points and characters.
The writing and character development, especially for Saki and villains, are considered weak and inconsistent.
The historical accuracy is largely disregarded, which disappoints many viewers expecting a story about the actual Yasuke.

anime.title: With Love
anime.synopsis:
A little girl brings home a plant of cherry tomato which she raised with plenty of love.
Will the happy days of the girl and cherry tomatoes begin?
anime.consensus_summary: The short film evokes a bittersweet feeling due to its narrative of a girl raising tomatoes with love only to have them meet their end. While the animation is appreciated, the story is considered average, and the lack of character development is noted. Overall, it's a touching but simple story.
pros: Nice animation
cons: Average story
No real character development

anime.title: Cue!
anime.synopsis: As a new agency, AiRBLUE's roster consists of voice actresses with absolutely no experience. Expecting to hone their skills and build courage at a gradual pace, the girls are taken aback when the head of their agency, Masaki Ootori, announces that they will be partaking in an audition for Bloomball—a popular sports manga receiving an anime adaptation. Despite all odds being stacked against them, each of the girls is now presented with a momentous chance to make their debut in the unrelenting world of voice acting.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the in-depth character development and emotional interactions between the voice actresses. However, concerns are raised about the anime's association with a mobile game known for inconsistent service and the potential for repetitive character traits, ultimately resulting in an experience considered average.
pros: Each of the 16 voice actresses is given ample time for the viewer to learn their personality, struggles, and inspiration for pursuing voice acting.
Every unit of 4 is given a unique dynamic that makes their interactions meaningful, and even emotional at times.
cons: The anime is tied to a mobile game with a questionable history of service.
Certain character traits can bleed into each other at times.
The anime stands in-between good and bad to be average at best.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Character-Driven, Voice Acting

anime.title: Getter Robo Arc
anime.synopsis:
Getter Robo Arc is the fifth Getter Robo series chronologically.

Taking place several years after Getter Robo Go, Earth is now a post-apocalyptic world. Hayato, now an aging scientist, has completed Professor Saotome's masterpiece, Getter Robo Arc. Piloting it are Ryoma's son Takuma, the human-dinosaur Kamui, and the younger brother of Tayel, Baku. Alongside the reformed Dinosaur Empire, they fight the insectoid Andromeda Flow Country attacking from across time and space.
anime.consensus_summary: Getter Robo Arc is a treat for dedicated fans of the franchise, especially those familiar with the manga. However, its reliance on extensive backstory and occasionally flawed animation makes it less appealing to newcomers. While some find the ending conclusive, others are left wanting more, resulting in a somewhat polarized, though overall appreciative, reception.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga.
Nostalgic value with classic songs and references.
Satisfying conclusion to the Getter Robo saga for long-time fans.
cons: Animation inconsistencies and rough CGI.
Requires extensive prior knowledge of the Getter Robo franchise, making it inaccessible to newcomers.
Some characters lack sufficient development.
Incomplete ending in both manga and anime, leaving many questions unanswered.

anime.title: Backflip!!
anime.synopsis:
Shoutarou Futaba has always loved sports, but he never became more than a benchwarmer on his middle school baseball team. After noticing a group of gymnasts practicing in the park, he decides to watch a rhythmic gymnastics tournament on a whim. Although displaying an exhilarating performance at the competition, the Shoushukan High School's Rhythmic Gymnastics Club places second-to-last due to penalties acquired from not fielding a full six-man roster. 

The demonstration of skill captivates Shoutarou, and he decides to enroll at Shoushukan in hopes of joining the team despite having no background in the sport. The club recruits him alongside Ryouya Misato, a prodigal gymnast who was the runner-up in a junior tournament. 

Now with a full six-man roster, the team sets out to compete in the upcoming Inter-High tournament. As he strives to accomplish this ambitious endeavor, Shoutarou must learn and master the basics of rhythmic gymnastics all while working in tandem with his new teammates if Shoushukan wants to stand a chance at claiming the title.
anime.consensus_summary: Bakuten!! is a generally enjoyable sports anime that is praised for its likeable characters, solid animation, and heart-warming story. However, many find it to be generic and predictable, relying heavily on overused tropes and lacking depth in both story and character development. The show's technical aspects, such as pacing and editing, also receive criticism.
pros: Enjoyable characters with unique personalities and development.
Well-blended CGI with 2D animation, especially during performances.
Heart-warming and inspiring storyline.
Good soundtrack, including OP and ED.
Focus on character relationships and growth.
cons: Generic and predictable storyline with overused tropes.
Lack of depth in the story and characters.
Pacing and editing issues, with random scene cuts and blending issues with BGM.
Shallow sport aspect, with the protagonist mastering gymnastics too quickly.

anime.title: The Fire Hunter
anime.synopsis:
Human civilization no longer revolves around fire, but is instead now driven by fear of it. Repeated wars have changed human biology, and people now spontaneously combust when they get close to natural flame. However, a new source of energy prevents society from complete collapse: a stone-shaped material used to produce light and steam lies within the bodies of monsters that infest numerous forests. Those tasked with collecting this precious resource are called fire hunters.

Touko, a young village girl, is saved from a forest monster by a fire hunter who perishes during his heroic action. After the hunter's dog, Kanata, heals from his own injury, the girl's family sends her to the capital in order to return Kanata and the hunter's fire sickle to his relatives.

Elsewhere, the fire hunter's son, Koushi, and his sister are adopted by a wealthy family. Koushi learns some troubling facts related to the country's ruling royal family. He conducts secret research on a special fire stone found by his late father, kickstarting a race against time between the country's leaders and those trying to save mankind from its ultimate demise.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is praised for its unique and immersive world-building, intriguing story, and atmospheric tone, but is heavily criticized for its inconsistent animation, heavy exposition, and weak character development. While some appreciate the slow pace and deliberate storytelling, others find it boring and frustrating. The audience is divided on whether the show's strengths outweigh its weaknesses, leading to a polarized reception.
pros: Original and intriguing world-building with unique lore.
Compelling story with converging storylines and satisfying connections.
Atmospheric and slow-paced, creating a sense of mystery and immersion.
Excellent soundtrack and opening/ending themes that enhance the ambience.
cons: Inconsistent and low-budget animation with awkward action scenes.
Heavy exposition and narration that can be overwhelming and unengaging.
Weak character development, with characters feeling like vessels for the story.
Pacing issues, with a slow start and abrupt ending.

anime.title: Cestvs: The Roman Fighter
anime.genres: Combat Sports, Drama, Historical, Seinen, Sports
anime.synopsis: In the year 54 AD, 15-year-old slave fighter Cestvs desires one thing—an escape from his violent life. It is the wish Cestvs' owner has promised to grant him, but only after he wins 100 battles. However, Cestvs quickly comes to terms with the fact that, as a slave, his life is expendable. After the death of his friend, the possibility of freedom is the only thing keeping him going. With a burning ambition to attain it, Cestvs embarks on a journey to earn himself back, even if it means fighting other slaves for the entertainment of the public.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with Cestvs, citing a rushed narrative, underdeveloped characters, and jarring CGI animation. Some appreciate the realistic fight choreography, but this is overshadowed by criticisms of historical inaccuracies and a lack of emotional depth. Many feel the anime failed to adapt the source material effectively, resulting in a shallow and ultimately unsatisfying experience.
pros: Realistic fight choreography and attention to detail
Enjoyable fighting styles
Fights kept the viewer on their toes
cons: Rushed and incomplete storyline
Underdeveloped characters
Poor pacing and confusing plot direction
Over-reliance on CGI and jarring animation
Historical inaccuracies and misrepresentation of Roman society

anime.title: Night Head 2041
anime.genres: Drama, Mystery, Psychological, Sci-Fi, Super Power, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2041, World War III has wiped out two-thirds of the human population, and in the newfound structure, the belief in any god or beyond-human entity is considered a preposterous notion. In order to prevent citizens from bearing possibly incriminating thoughts, the government has assembled a Special Weapon Enforcement division to capture and rehabilitate such believers.

The Kirihara brothers, Naoya and Naoto—who were hidden away from society by their captors for years to conceal their psychic abilities—were promised freedom once the world was ready to face their existence. Now, wandering in the appalling new societal climate where psychics are not welcome, the brothers find themselves on the run from the Enforcement's devoted operatives, Yuuya and Takuya Kuroki.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. Some appreciate the show's art style, sound design, and complex characters, finding it to be a worthwhile watch. However, many criticize its poor execution, rushed plot, and shallow character development, especially when compared to the original series. The show's attempt to blend political and religious themes also receives mixed reactions.
pros: Spectacular OST, especially the piece Sacrifice.
Brilliant art style with great use of CGI and backgrounds.
Complex characters, particularly Shouko Futami.
Good sound effects, especially sirens.
cons: Terrible execution and abysmal handling of characters.
Too much exposition and repetitive information.
Rushed plot development with compressed revelations.
Superficial handling of key characters and plot points.
Overuse of cliches and over-the-top action scenes.
Inconsistent use of CGI animation.

anime.title: Vazzrock the Animation
anime.synopsis: VAZZY and ROCK DOWN are the two units that make up Tsukino Talent Production's all-male VAZZROCK group. Led by Takaaki Mamiya and Shou Onoda respectively, both units announce via a round-table livestream that they are working hard to prepare for the upcoming VAZZROCK Live Flawless event. From taking extra dancing and singing lessons to starring in a TV period drama, these 12 idols must give it their all as they work toward a spectacular show that will impress their fans.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of VAZZROCK appears to have underwhelmed many fans. While the music and voice acting, core to the VAZZROCK project, are praised, the anime suffers from low-budget animation, a weak plot, and poor character introductions. It's generally agreed that the anime is not a good entry point to the VAZZROCK universe and that the music is the main draw.
pros: Good background music, especially in Shou's arc and AU episodes.
Amazing songs and talented voice actors (VAZZROCK as a whole).
Characters are unique.
cons: Low budget animation quality.
Lack of 3D MVs.
Weak introduction to the series for newcomers.
Repetitive rivalry dynamics.
Lack of overall plot or character development.
Story feels random and episodic.

anime.title: Sumikko Gurashi Movie 2: Aoi Tsukiyo no Mahou no Ko
anime.romaji_title: Sumikko Gurashi Movie 2: Aoi Tsukiyo no Mahou no Ko
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds the movie cute and heartwarming, with a surprisingly touching story that appeals to adults despite its childish presentation. The slow pace and focus on a younger audience are minor drawbacks. Overall, it's a positive experience with a bittersweet touch.
pros: Adorable character designs and animation
Surprisingly moving story with relatable themes for adults
Bittersweet resolution
cons: Pace is kind of slow
Primarily aimed at kids, with a childish narrator

anime.title: Battle Game in 5 Seconds
anime.genres: Action, High Stakes Game, Strategy Game, Super Power, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
It was just a usual morning.

Akira Shiroyanagi, a high schooler who loves games and Konpeito (Japanese sweets), has suddenly been dragged into a battlefield by a mysterious girl who calls herself Mion. The participants are told that they are "erased from the family register, involved in an experiment, and gained certain powers."

Akira is determined to win the game with his newfound powers and destroy the organization. Armed with a power no one expects and his "brain" skills, the new period of intelligence battle begins!
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience reception is mixed to negative. While some appreciate the strategic battles and unique abilities, most are disappointed by the poor animation, generic plot, and shallow characters. The anime is seen as a mediocre addition to the death game genre, failing to live up to its potential.
pros: The main character's intelligence and strategic thinking are engaging.
Unique power concepts allow for creative and unpredictable fights.
Some viewers found the initial concept intriguing and suspenseful.
cons: Poor animation quality, particularly the CGI, detracts from the viewing experience.
The plot is generic and predictable, with little originality in the death game genre.
Many characters are underdeveloped, bland, and difficult to connect with.
Inconsistent power scaling and illogical plot developments frustrate viewers.

anime.title: Girlfriend, Girlfriend
anime.synopsis:
Naoya Mukai is having the time of his life after his childhood friend Saki Saki finally accepts one of his countless confessions. Ensuring that their relationship will stay strong, he spares no effort in showering affection to his now beloved girlfriend.

However, one afternoon, another girl named Nagisa Minase suddenly confesses to Naoya following months of preparation. Even though he politely rejects her, Nagisa's irresistible charm and determination continue to attract Naoya. Wanting to fulfill both Saki and Nagisa's desires, Naoya ends up proposing a crazy idea—to date the two of them simultaneously, with both girls fully aware. This unprecedented state of affairs ultimately causes wacky and hilarious situations in whatever they do to keep their unusual relationship going.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is divided, with some finding the show hilarious and a refreshing parody of the harem genre, while others find it stupid, cringeworthy, and ethically questionable. Many appreciate the over-the-top characters and absurd situations, but others are turned off by the lack of depth and inconsistent animation. The show's success largely depends on the viewer's tolerance for cringe comedy and willingness to embrace its nonsensical premise.
pros: Hilarious and entertaining, especially the over-the-top characters and situations.
Unique take on the harem genre, subverting tropes for comedic effect.
Likeable and entertaining characters with great chemistry.
Good voice acting enhances the humor.
Bright and vibrant art style.
cons: The premise and characters are stupid and illogical, which may not appeal to all viewers.
Relies heavily on cringe comedy, which can be off-putting.
Lacks depth and character development.
Animation quality can be inconsistent.
Questionable ethical implications of the polygamous relationship.

anime.title: Banished From The Hero's Party, I Decided To Live A Quiet Life In The Countryside
anime.romaji_title: Shin no Nakama ja Nai to Yuusha no Party wo Oidasareta node, Henkyou de Slow Life suru Koto ni Shimashita
anime.synopsis:
Far away from the reaches of demons and war, near the borderland of Zoltan, D-Rank adventurer Red lives a normal existence. Through perseverance and hard work, his dream of starting his own apothecary and peaceful life in the countryside finally came true. Abruptly, Red gets a live-in partner and assistant named Rit—the princess of Duchy Loggervia and an adventurer herself—who gives everything up to join him.

Although honest, kind, and loved by all, Red has a secret shared only with Rit: his real name is Gideon, brother of Ruti Ragnason, the "Hero" and a former member of her party. Ares Drowa, the "Sage," kicked Red out of their party after their war against the Demon Lord after deciding he was weak and insignificant. Now, even though Red has left the Hero's party behind by assuming a new life together with Rit, his past has yet to let go of him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some praising the show's heartwarming romance and thematic depth, while others criticize its inconsistent pacing and animation quality. Many appreciate the slice-of-life elements mixed with fantasy, but some find the story unengaging. The show is seen as a decent watch for fans of romance and fantasy but falls short of being a standout title due to its flaws.
pros: Wholesome and well-developed romance between Red and Rit
Interesting exploration of societal expectations vs. personal desires through the 'Blessing' system
Good balance of slice-of-life elements with fantasy and adventure
cons: Inconsistent pacing with rushed story arcs and abrupt transitions
Mediocre animation quality and reuse of sound effects
Shallow character development for some characters, especially the antagonist Ares

anime.title: ABCiee Working Diary
anime.synopsis: ABCiee is a bit klutzy and ditsy, but he's full of spunk and he starts his dream job at a TV station! This is a work comedy filled with all kinds of hijinks! "I never knew it was so hard working at a TV station, ciee!" Despite having to face the unknown rules of the TV business, unique coworkers, and guest stars who have very particular quirks, ABCiee takes them head on with his positivity. Work, love, family, whatever goes!! Please watch over ABCiee as he takes on the TV business.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds "Abciee Shuugyou Nikki" to be a lighthearted and enjoyable anime, perfect for relaxation and casual viewing. It's appreciated for its educational aspect, showcasing the inner workings of a TV station in an accessible way. While some find the stories predictable and lacking depth, the overall consensus is that it's a pleasant and easy-to-watch series.
pros: Relaxing and playful
Educational about the workings of a TV network
Lighthearted and easy to watch
cons: Predictable stories
Lacks depth
Average overall

anime.title: Sasaki and Miyano
anime.synopsis:
Yoshikazu Miyano's troubles first start one hot summer day when Shuumei Sasaki steps into his life. Sasaki saves Miyano's classmate from a group of bullies, and after that, Miyano cannot seem to shake off his eccentric upperclassman. His silent admiration for Sasaki gradually sours into annoyance each time the so-called delinquent refuses to leave him alone. Constantly being called by cute nicknames and having his boundaries ignored, Miyano wonders why Sasaki wants to get close to him.

The shy and easily flustered Miyano harbors an embarrassing secret—he is a "fudanshi," a boy who likes boys' love (BL) manga. The last thing he wants is for other students to find out, but through a slip of the tongue, he reveals the truth to Sasaki. Intrigued, the clueless Sasaki asks to borrow a book to read, which he is given very reluctantly. To Miyano's surprise, Sasaki enjoys the BL that he receives and asks for more, marking a shift in their strange dynamic.

Although Sasaki appears to possess some personal agenda, his feelings for Miyano become complicated the more time they spend together. As they now share a common interest, their relationship is poised to change and further develop.
anime.consensus_summary: Sasaki to Miyano is a polarizing show, with many praising its wholesome and healthy depiction of a same-sex romance, especially its subversion of common BL tropes. However, a significant portion of the audience finds the pacing too slow and repetitive, and criticizes the lack of depth in character development and plot progression.
pros: Wholesome and innocent depiction of a same-sex relationship, praised for its lack of toxic tropes.
Healthy portrayal of consent, boundaries, and emotional connection between the main characters.
Characters are relatable and well-developed, with satisfying progression.
Art and animation are generally considered good, with some specific praise for artistic direction.
Self-aware narrative that cleverly references and subverts BL genre tropes.
cons: Pacing is too slow and repetitive, with plot points feeling dragged out for a 12-episode run.
Lack of character depth outside of the central romance for both protagonists and supporting cast.
The 'fudanshi' angle and the inciting incident feel disconnected from the main plot.
Animation can be jerky, stilted, or lacking, with overuse of visual effects to compensate.
Some critiques suggest the portrayal of queer experiences isn't entirely grounded or realistic.

anime.title: Puparia
anime.synopsis: Independent short animation by Shingo Tamagawa.
anime.consensus_summary: Puparia is overwhelmingly praised for its stunning visuals, artistic style, and emotional impact, especially considering its very short runtime. Some viewers find the lack of a clear narrative frustrating or pretentious, but most appreciate the artistry and open interpretation. The general consensus is that it is a visually captivating experience that is well worth the short time investment.
pros: Stunning visuals and unique art style
Evokes emotion and atmosphere despite lack of dialogue
High level of detail and craftsmanship
Effective use of music to enhance the experience
cons: Lack of clear narrative or plot
Meaning can be difficult to decipher
Some find it pretentious or meaningless
Very short runtime may leave viewers wanting more

anime.title: New Gods: Nezha Reborn
anime.synopsis: Donghai City, a coastal city, is short of rain and fresh water all the year round. Lin Yunxiang, a young man who loves motorcycles, was attacked by superpowers when his car collided with the rich son of the water supply company, and he awakened the dormant mysterious power in his body-Nezha. Awaiting Li Yunxiang, in addition to the vengeance from the enemy, there is a bigger conspiracy...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is that "Xin Shen Bang: Nezha Chongsheng" excels in its visual presentation and action sequences, but falls short in narrative depth and character development. The plot is considered weak and confusing for viewers unfamiliar with the Nezha lore. Overall, it is seen as an enjoyable, but ultimately forgettable, visual spectacle.
pros: Cool art and CGI animation
Nicely directed action scenes
Interesting mythological inspirations
cons: Lacking and badly explained plot
Generic conflict with poor execution
Lack of character development
Forced and unneeded climaxes
Plot hard to understand without Nezha lore knowledge

anime.title: Drowning Sorrows in Raging Fire
anime.synopsis: In the current era, a small percentage of people called "Special Abilities" have skills and powers normal humans do not possess. An autonomous organization, the Deviant Control Office, keeps these Special Abilities in check. Though some wish to maintain this order and peace, some wish to take advantage of their abilities and obtain more power in this world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is initially captivated by the novel premise and art style, but the narrative quickly devolves into a generic revenge plot with excessive flashbacks. While some appreciate the unique character designs and side characters, the overall sentiment is mixed due to the unfulfilled potential of the initial episodes.  The story fails to maintain initial quality.
pros: Engaging story in the first few episodes.
Unique and stylized CGI animation mimicking 2D.
Interesting side and villain characters.
cons: Story becomes a standard generational revenge story.
Over-reliance on long flashbacks.
Character development stagnates after initial episodes.

anime.title: Legend of Exorcism 2nd Season
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Mythology
anime.synopsis: Second season of Tianbao Fuyao Lu.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 is a solid follow-up with improved storytelling and beautiful animation, particularly in the battle scenes.  The expanded character development is a highlight, although pacing issues and abrupt transitions are noted. Overall, the audience seems appreciative of the season's enhancements despite its flaws.
pros: Improved storytelling compared to season 1
Detailed CGI animation with beautiful battle scenes
Expanded backstory and character development for the exorcism squad, especially the wolf character
cons: Pacing issues, particularly with humorous moments
Abrupt transitions and season ending
Sound design considered just fair

anime.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King 2
anime.synopsis:
Wang Ling has been living a quiet life ever since resolving a particular incident, but thanks to his previous tampering with the laws of nature, the level of psionic powers in the world has dropped drastically. To stop the levels from plummeting further, his spirit sword Jingke comes to the rescue. But due to the excessive use of power, Jingke ends up ripping a crack in space. This crack allows demons to infiltrate the world and steal spiritual energy essential to powering human society. Now the only person who has the power to thwart their plans is none other than Wang Ling.

In an attempt to balance his high school life with his supernatural one, Wang Ling must confront challenges ranging from teacher home visits, crafting spiritual swords, grappling with his growing feelings for Sun Rong, and battling invading demons!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some appreciating the improved animation and comedic moments, while others are disappointed by the disjointed story, lack of character development, and deviation from the first season's strengths. Many feel the second season suffers from inconsistent writing, an over-reliance on filler, and a rushed conclusion. The show's quality seems to have decreased from the first season.
pros: Improved animation quality and consistency.
Unique world-building and comedic elements.
Engaging side character backgrounds in some episodes.
cons: Inconsistent story and episodic nature.
Lack of character development compared to season 1.
Over-reliance on filler and meta jokes that deviate from the original's charm.
Rushed plot and underwhelming season finale.
Mediocre audio design.
Increasing Propaganda

anime.title: Heaven Official's Blessing Special
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Mythology
anime.synopsis: Xie Lian and Hua Cheng recount their recent adventures during a quiet night at Puqi Shrine. Amidst the serenity, the Crimson Rain Sought Flower reveals a little more about Xie Lian's true character, and an embarrassing memory reminds him of how much he has changed since his previous ascensions. However, no matter how much time has passed, Xie Lian never fails to believe in the good he sees in the people around him. Though the heavens may ridicule him, his words and actions have earned him the most devout of followers.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience overwhelmingly enjoyed the special, praising its character development, animation, and satisfying conclusion to the season.  Fans of the source material were particularly pleased with the faithful adaptation and the enhanced focus on the central relationship. The special successfully builds anticipation for the next season with its beautiful reveal.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to the season.
Excellent character development, especially between the main characters.
High-quality animation and soundtrack.
Faithful to the source material (novel and manhua).
cons: Focus on concluding plot threads makes it feel slightly repetitive.

anime.title: Carp Reborn 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Second season of Yuan Long.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally pleased to see the continuation of Yuan Long. They appreciate the action and interesting world-building, but criticize the plot's coherence. There is a general sense of anticipation for future developments, but disappointment in plot consistency.
pros: Interesting new setting with city rules.
Amazing fight choreography.
Direct sequel to first season.
cons: Plot is a mess.

anime.title: You're A Genius!
anime.synopsis:
In another world, there are two continents, east and west. The northern part of the Western Continent lives with the mysterious Snow Mountain tribe, while the southern part is occupied by the prosperous Daqin Empire. Magic is the source of energy in the world. The Daqin Empire relied on the power of magic to defeat countless enemies and disasters, and established a prosperous civilized world. A boy from a tribe with a forbidden demon physique from the north started a journey of magic cultivation in the southern continent full of magic power.

Bai Xiao, the son of the Snow Mountain tribe, was forced to separate from his girlfriend Qingyue in order to unravel the curse of her. However, the alien world that is thousands of miles apart and the amnesia of his girlfriend couldn't stop Bai Xiao's footsteps. He set foot on the southern continent alone with countless treasures, and started the journey to find his lover. The man destined to become a genius shocked the entire empire with his astonishing talent and extraordinary audacity. Where will his magical path of cultivation go? Can he win Qingyue's heart again?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Ni Zhenshi Ge Tiancai' for its comedic approach to the cultivation genre and its lightheartedness. It's appreciated for subverting common tropes. However, viewers seeking a serious or intricate plot may be disappointed, and familiarity with cultivation stories is helpful for understanding the humor.
pros: Humorous take on cultivation genre cliches
Lighthearted and not overly serious
MC solves problems with wealth
cons: Story takes a backseat to the comedy
May be confusing for those unfamiliar with the cultivation genre
anime.thematic_vibe: Cultivation Comedy, Trope Subversion, Romantic Quest

anime.title: Link Click
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Mystery, Super Power, Suspense, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
It is said that a picture is worth a thousand words. In this case, it holds an infinite amount of secrets. These are secrets that only Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang are able to find. In a small shop called "Time Photo Studio," the two friends provide a special service: using their extraordinary powers that let them enter photographs, they jump into pictures brought to them by clients in order to grant their wishes. Through the eyes of the photographer, they live through the events surrounding the picture and try to decipher how to solve their client's request.

But every time they jump into a picture, they take a great risk. One wrong move and they could alter the future of the person who took the picture... and possibly countless other events too. So when the events they are forced to live through in these pictures start to become personal, it will take the utmost strength to push their feelings aside and focus on accomplishing the task they were paid to do.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response to Shiguang Dailiren is overwhelmingly positive. The show is praised for its unique concept, emotional depth, and high-quality animation. Some viewers express concerns about the lack of backstory and character development, but the majority find the series to be a captivating and memorable experience.
pros: Unique time travel concept using photographs
High-quality art style and animation
Compelling mysteries and plot twists
Emotional depth and character bonds
cons: Lack of backstory and explanations for the characters' powers
Inconsistencies in the art style
Character development outside the main characters is lacking
Story leaves many questions unanswered

anime.title: JX Online3: The Adventure of Shen Jianxin II
anime.romaji_title: Jian Wang 3: Xia Gan Yi Dan Shen Jianxin II
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Full of confidence after drawing the Heavenly Sword, Shen Jianxin descended the mountain and returned to the martial world. Meanwhile, the Central Plains martial arts world faced an unprecedented crisis. Bearing the power of his birth chart and the Heavenly Sword, Shen Jianxin was tasked with a perilous mission to enter the world of seafaring, becoming embroiled in layers of intrigue. During his journey, unexpected events occurred one after another, and the identities of mysterious figures were gradually revealed…
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Jian Wang 3 delves deeper into the story, offering more action and character development but with a shift towards a heavier tone. While the animation and fighting scenes are praised, some viewers miss the comedic elements of the first season. Overall, it's an enjoyable season, particularly for those invested in Shen Jianxin's journey and the world of Jianghu.
pros: Good fighting scenes
Character growth and self-realization are well-developed
Enjoyable story with good animation
cons: Less comedy compared to the first season
Season 2 is too heavy

anime.title: B-Project: Passion*Love Call
anime.synopsis:
The idol unit "B-PROJECT" has successfully completed their second JAPAN Dome live concert, and changes are afoot at the major record company "Gandara Music."

Tsubasa Sumisora, who works as an A&R, will now oversee not only "KitaKore," "THRIVE," "MooNs," and "KiLLER KiNG" but also a new artist from a different genre named "Ultras."

The synergy created from the meeting of B-PROJECT and Ultras is now resonating with a thrilling and passionate "love call"!
anime.consensus_summary: The season is considered weak due to its episodic plot and lack of overarching story. The introduction of Ultraz had potential but was poorly executed. While the inclusion of full-length songs in the finale and varied ending songs are appreciated, the overall lack of plot and unsatisfying character resolutions leave the audience disappointed.
pros: Ending songs changed almost every episode to match the song in the episode.
Full-length songs in the final episode, including choreography.
cons: Weak ending to the season.
Episodic plot with no overarching story.
Underdeveloped conflict between Ultraz and B-Project.
Unsatisfying resolution to Yashamaru's character, who contributes almost nothing.
Mediocre CGI quality.
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture, Music Performance, Inter-group Dynamics

anime.title: Gintama: The Semi-Final
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Gag Humor, Historical, Parody, Samurai, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
As the war temporarily calms down and Edo rebuilds, Gintoki finds Shinpachi—who is still unaware of his return—on a bridge. However, as a fight quickly breaks out between the Yorozuya and the Tenshouin Naraku, suspicion grows, forcing Gintoki to use what is nearest—a loincloth—to mask his identity. Saved for the time being, Gintoki enters the Yorozuya office, but unbeknownst to him, someone else is already waiting there...

Meanwhile, Kondou departs Earth to marry Princess Bubbles in an attempt to improve diplomatic relations. After boarding the Gorilla Amanto mother ship, he realizes that he doesn't speak their language. Confused, Kondou tries conversing with them, only to inadvertently gain their support. However, someone associated with the princess crashes the ongoing ceremony. Will the wedding continue, or has Kondou just been saved from becoming the next Gorilla Prince?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the familiar humor and character moments, others find the episodes skippable and lacking in meaningful plot progression, particularly criticizing the first episode's reliance on crude humor. The special is seen as a comedic interlude that doesn't significantly advance the overarching narrative.
pros: Nostalgic feeling with familiar opening and ending themes.
Delivers the full Gintama experience with humor, callbacks, and character progression.
Kondo's marriage episode is enjoyable.
cons: First episode is weak and skippable, with recycled and crude humor.
Episodes contribute little to the overall narrative.
Plot progresses slowly.

anime.title: Ling Cage
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Mythology, Sci-Fi, Supernatural, Suspense
anime.synopsis: Final installment of Ling Long: Incarnation.
anime.consensus_summary: The final installment provides a beautifully animated and action-packed conclusion to the series. It effectively ties together all the foreshadowed plot threads from previous parts. The reviewer highlights the emotional impact and the resolution of the political conflicts.
pros: Beautiful animation
Satisfying conclusion to foreshadowed plot points

anime.title: Tropical-Rouge! Pretty Cure
anime.synopsis:
It's an exciting day for fashionable teenager Manatsu Natsumi, who is moving into the big city for the first time. Upon arriving, Manatsu is immediately charmed by the city's spectacles. However, things take an unbelievable turn when she encounters Laura—a real-life mermaid!

Laura is searching for the Precure, a group of radiant warriors who may have the key to rescuing Grand Ocean, Laura's home. This duty soon falls upon Manatsu, whose unwavering determination causes her to awaken as one of the Precure: the vivid Cure Summer. As new friends join the team, Manatsu needs to adapt to her hectic, new life while protecting humanity's liveliness from oceanic invaders! With each battle more difficult than the last, the girls must discover what is truly valuable to them.
anime.consensus_summary: Tropical-Rouge! Precure is a lighthearted and fun season, praised for its emphasis on friendship and whimsical nature. However, it is criticized for its weak plot, underutilized themes, and unthreatening villains. Audience opinions are divided, with some finding it enjoyable and others considering it a disappointment compared to previous seasons.
pros: Fun and cute with the right amount of whimsy and action.
Enjoyable if looking for a chill magical girl anime that doesn't take itself too seriously.
Captures the importance of friendship.
cons: Plot and character development are lacking compared to other PreCure seasons.
Ocean theme is highly underutilized.
Villains are not threatening and combat scenes are short.

anime.title: Thousand Autumns
anime.synopsis:
After being defeated by the leader of the Beimu clan, Mount Xuandu's chief disciple Shen Qiao falls off a cliff and nearly dies from his injuries. Unfortunately, the ruthless Cleansing Moon sect leader Yan Wushi, known for his cunning and skills, chances upon him and comes up with a sinister plan: turn the benevolent disciple into a vengeful cultivator who could one day become a worthy rival.

Shen Qiao is thrown headfirst into a world of betrayal and deception, contrasting with his once-strong beliefs that good could exist in everyone. As he encounters further hardships that push him to his wits' end, Shen Qiao is faced with the decision of continuing to uphold his kind nature—despite the cruel reality he has been shown—or giving in to the deceitful scheme of the spiteful Yan Wushi.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with novel readers expressing disappointment in the adaptation's rushed pacing and simplified themes. However, viewers unfamiliar with the source material generally find the story intriguing and the character dynamics engaging. The animation quality is considered decent given the budget constraints.
pros: Interesting story for those unfamiliar with the source material.
Catchy opening and ending themes.
Appealing character dynamics, especially between the leads.
cons: Rushed pacing compared to the novel.
Simplification of philosophical and religious themes from the novel.
Lower budget animation quality.

anime.title: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 3: World Heroes' Mission
anime.synopsis:
Under the doctrines of Quirk Doomsday Theory, the ideological group Humarise is convinced that all humans with quirks are diseased and must be eradicated. In order to rebuild the world, the group's extremists have constructed a lethal device known as a "Trigger Bomb" that causes people with quirks to lose control and die. Their leader, Flect Turn, evades capture from the Pro Heroes deployed around the world.

During his work study in the country of Otheon with Japan's number one Pro Hero, Izuku "Deku" Midoriya is accused of a crime he did not commit. Unintentionally involving Roddy Soul, a local, Deku soon finds himself on the run with the boy. It is now up to Rody, Deku, and Deku's classmates to stop the Trigger Bomb plot set in motion by Flect, all while eluding the other persistent members of Humarise.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is divided, with a significant portion finding the movie to be a disappointing, generic, and poorly written entry in the franchise, despite acknowledging good animation. Others enjoyed it as a fun, action-packed filler movie consistent with the series' quality, particularly praising the new characters. The film is seen by some as a "cash grab" with wasted potential, while others defend it against perceived "trend-hating".
pros: Visually striking animation and art, particularly during fight scenes.
New characters, especially Rody, are likable and offer some humanity.
Some enjoyable tropes and comedic moments are present.
Good sound design and voice acting, consistent with the series.
cons: Generic, predictable, and uninteresting story with major plot holes.
Inconsistent animation quality and noticeable errors, not movie-level.
Pacing issues, with many scenes feeling dragged out and boring.
Underdeveloped villains and underdeveloped plot points (e.g., eugenics, doomsday cult).
Underutilization of the broader cast, with many characters feeling like filler.
Characterization issues, with some main characters acting out of character.
Deceptive marketing, particularly regarding character outfits and their limited screen time.

anime.title: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Reincarnation, Romance
anime.synopsis:
When 20-year-old college student Haruto Amakawa dies in a traffic accident, he does not expect to wake up in an unfamiliar world in the body of a young boy named Rio. As their memories and personas fuse, Rio realizes that he now also possesses magical powers. He is relieved to find that his burning passion for revenge against his mother's murderers has not subsided, despite his newly changed identity.

Not soon after, Rio comes across the kidnapped princess of the Bertram Kingdom and saves her without hesitation. To express his gratitude, the king grants him the opportunity to enroll in the Bertram Royal Academy. Believing this to be a new chapter in his life, he is excited to study at this prestigious academy, but life here proves to be difficult for him, a slum-dweller surrounded by the majestic children of nobles.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in its adherence to Isekai tropes and simple plot, while others criticize it for being unoriginal, rushed, and poorly developed. The main character's lack of personality and the predictable storyline are frequent points of criticism. Some viewers found it to be a fun, if uninspired, way to kill time, while others considered it a waste of time due to its many flaws.
pros: Clean and simple plot structure allows for easy engagement.
Consistent and nicely animated fight scenes.
Enjoyable for those seeking a standard Isekai experience with familiar tropes.
cons: Overused clichés and generic Kirito-type main character.
Rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and skipped plot developments.
Weak character motivations and illogical plot choices.

anime.title: In/Spectre 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Mythology, Romance, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
During a blizzard, Masayuki Muroi's old high school friend pushes him off a mountain to certain death. However, Masayuki survives the fall and escapes to safety thanks to Yuki-Onna, the spirit of a beautiful young woman who is said to lead men to their demise—but all she asks in return is money.

Eleven years later, Masayuki has lived a successful life, having gotten married and amassing a great fortune. But when his company collapses and his wife cheats on him, Masayuki retreats to the city where Yuki-Onna once saved him, and he reconnects with her by offering her money and tasty meals. While Masayuki recovers from his misfortunes, another one knocks on his door: his ex-wife is found beaten to death, and now only Yuki-Onna—who cannot reveal herself—can corroborate his alibi.

With no one to turn to, Yuki-Onna enlists the help of the spirits' God of Wisdom, Kotoko Iwanaga. Revered by the various spirits that wander the earth, Kotoko uses her extraordinary wits and cunning to solve all quarrels they may have. In her duty to protect spirits and humans from colliding, Kotoko drags along her immortal boyfriend, Kurou Sakuragawa, and promises to prove Masayuki's innocence without exposing Yuki-Onna's existence.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many find Season 2 an improvement over Season 1 due to its shorter, more focused arcs and interesting mysteries, while others are critical of the excessive dialogue, lack of overarching plot, and underdeveloped characters.  The enjoyment seems heavily dependent on one's appreciation for dialogue-driven narratives and the main character, Kotoko. There's a general sentiment that the series is decent but not exceptional.
pros: Interesting supernatural mysteries and concepts.
Improved pacing compared to Season 1, with shorter arcs.
Enjoyable main character, Kotoko, and her unique personality.
Good OSTs and overall atmosphere creation.
cons: Dialogue-heavy, which can be boring for some viewers.
Lack of significant overarching plot or character development.
Mysteries can be straightforward and predictable.
Some find the humor awkward or poorly executed.
Production values are relatively low.
Straightforward mysteries are convoluted with unnecessary information.

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai 8
anime.synopsis:
Once again, the mysterious storyteller draws in the ears of any willing to listen to his macabre tales of madness—ones that could happen to anyone, no matter who they might be.

The ghastly stories delve into the cases of teenagers testing their courage at an abandoned home; children navigating nefarious family traditions; malicious apparitions haunting the lives of innocent people; individuals helplessly watching their loved ones slowly go insane; a woman growing increasingly concerned when her husband's behavior changes after eating something odd; and an evil snowman or two. These chilling tales promise to leave no soul unstirred in the most disturbing way yet.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative, citing a significant drop in quality, particularly in storytelling and horror elements. Many feel the series has lost its initial appeal and become boring or confusing. While some appreciate the voice acting and slight improvements in animation, the lack of satisfying conclusions and coherent narratives leaves most viewers disappointed and frustrated.
pros: Voice acting is consistently good.
Animation has slightly improved.
cons: Narrative lacks innovation and becomes boring.
Stories are unsatisfying with no proper conclusion.
Horror element is missing, focusing too much on psychological themes without effective horror.
The show has declined in quality since season 4.
anime.thematic_vibe: Psychological Horror, Unsatisfying Endings, Decayed Quality

anime.title: Deep Sea
anime.synopsis:
The film Deep Sea is another original animated feature film directed by Tian Xiaopeng after Monkey King: Hero Is Back and it’s also a 3D animation creation of exploration significance for October Media. Although antique stories are popular among Chinese animation works in recent years, Deep Sea will apply a different way, using unique oriental aesthetics to interpret a fantasy story with a modern background.

The film Deep Sea builds a different brand new underwater world, and tells the story of a girl who encounters a unique life journey, seeking and searching in the mysterious underwater world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Shenhai for its visual artistry and emotional depth, drawing comparisons to Spirited Away. While the fast-paced narrative and heavy themes resonate with some, others may find the story abstract or derivative. Overall, the film is well-received, especially for its animation quality.
pros: Stunning visuals and artistic style surpassing Dreamworks or Pixar.
Unique and colorful animation with a strong Chinese vibe.
Emotional story with likable characters.
cons: Abstract story with themes of loneliness and depression.
Hectic pacing with little downtime in the animated parts.
Story may feel similar to Spirited Away.

anime.title: Swallowed Star
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
One day, an unknown RR virus appeared on earth, and the world fell into disaster. Infected animals mutate into frightening and massively attacking monsters. When humans face destruction, they build walls and build base cities as the last bastion of man. The trials experienced by mankind during this period of time are called the "Period of Nirvana." In extreme living environments, human power is also gradually advancing and evolving, and martial arts are emerging, and human power is qualitatively increasing compared to before. And the best of them is called the Warriors. Luo Feng, 18, also aspires to be one of them. Currently, he will take the college entrance exam and face a choice at a crossroads in his life, but suddenly a monster attack affects the trajectory of his life. 

Under the threat of powerful monsters, the inhabitants of the city are in danger, but the military is powerless. Only one soldier stood up and maintained the security of the base city. Luo Feng is infected by a warrior force, and secretly he decides to become a fighter to protect his loved ones. This is the beginning of everything, the starting point of Luo Feng's journey as a martial artist, and also the beginning of his legendary life. Luo Feng aspires to be a martial artist, but the road ahead is not smooth. The first thing he has to deal with is the influence of the outside environment that is not visible to him. Luo Feng's family's condition was alarming and life was difficult, his parents could not provide more help and could only rely on his own efforts. 

Ultimately, under constant hard work, Luo Feng continues to explore his own potential and is recognized by his increased abilities and self-improvement. Not only that, Luo Feng not only shouldered the burden of supporting the family, but also joined other justice fighters to face evil monsters to protect the homeland of mankind and for the better survival and development of mankind. In a desperate doomsday situation, can Luo Feng and the other soldiers drive away the monsters and successfully protect the human world?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Tunshi Xingkong for its engaging story, action, and fast pacing. However, some are critical of the inconsistent animation quality and lack of character development. Despite the flaws, many find it to be an enjoyable and binge-worthy watch.
pros: Engaging story with a compelling hero.
Fast-paced plot keeps the audience engaged.
Action-packed with well-choreographed fight scenes.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and stiff animations.
Environments can look empty and unnatural.
Fast pacing may not allow for deep character development or world-building.
Romance is almost non-existent

anime.title: Be My Wife Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Xie Wang Zhui Qi 2: Yishi Qingcheng
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: The well-known special agent, Su Luo, was betrayed and killed. And before she knew it, she was reborn as the most useless Fourth Lady in Su Residence within Bi Luo Land. The public despised her and scorned her, and Lord Jin is the only person who's trying to pursue her. With the help of Lord Jin, Su Luo went to participate in a test in the Holy Temple. They realized that Su Luo is a rare talent. Numerous factions and people tried to stop Su Luo from growing stronger for their own benefit. And, her mysterious identity will be revealed soon.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, viewers find 'Xie Wang Zhui Qi 2: Yishi Qingcheng' to be a significant improvement over the first season, with better animation, pacing, and character development. While some find the story and character interactions rushed or confusing at times, most appreciate its lightheartedness and entertainment value. The improved production quality and engaging plot make it an enjoyable watch, even for those who haven't seen the first season.
pros: Improved animation and sound quality compared to Season 1
Better pacing and story development
Enjoyable character interactions and development
Humorous and lighthearted elements
cons: Pacing can still be confusing at times
Irrational character behavior
Rushed character development between main leads
Some sound effects feel out of place

anime.title: Pui Pui Molcar
anime.synopsis: Due to an adorable evolutionary miracle, guinea pigs have become furry automobiles known as "Molcars." Now, drivers can enjoy the fluffy interior of their vehicles while fulfilling their every transportation need. However,  Molcars are not simply lettuce-fueled machines; they are also sentient creatures with their own worries and desires. Whether in their drivers' presence or among each other, these motorized rodents are swept up into many wild and eventful situations—the likes of which only a Molcar could wind up in.
anime.consensus_summary: Pui Pui Molcar is overwhelmingly praised for its cuteness, creative animation, and ability to evoke emotion despite its short episodes and lack of dialogue. While some find the narrative simplistic, the show is generally considered a wholesome and enjoyable experience for viewers of all ages. The series has garnered a dedicated following, with many considering it a delightful and surprisingly impactful work.
pros: Charming stop-motion animation and art style
Creative and innovative use of short runtime
Expressive character design despite lack of dialogue
cons: Episodic narrative may not appeal to those seeking a complex plot
Humor may be too simple for some viewers
Relies heavily on cuteness

anime.title: Fate/Grand Carnival
anime.synopsis: The first episode of "season" one was pre-aired on the Fate Project New Year's Eve TV Special 2020 program.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found it to be a fun and refreshing take on the Fate/Grand Order universe, appreciating the comedic scenarios and animation style. However, others felt it failed to live up to the standards of Carnival Phantasm, criticizing its humor and charm, resulting in a polarized but not extreme overall reaction.
pros: Fun seeing Servants in comedic situations.
Refreshing animation style compared to the game.
Enjoyable for fans of Fate/Grand Order.
cons: Fails to recapture the magic of Carnival Phantasm.
Unfunny and uncharming.
Poor cover of the original season.

anime.title: PuraOra! PRIDE OF ORANGE
anime.synopsis:
Third-year junior high schooler Manaka Mizusawa is tasked by her teacher to put a poster up about a trial ice hockey class sponsored by the Dream Monkeys, their city's local professional team. Interested in attending the class herself, Manaka also persuades her younger sister Ayaka and her clubmates Kaoruko Yanagida and Mami Ono to join her.

When the four gather at the gymnasium where the tutorial is held, they meet fellow third-year students Riko Saginuma and Naomi Takagi. As the girls practice their hearts out, their fascination for the sport increases, motivating them to play on a competitive level. Wanting to experience the unique and exciting memories that ice hockey can offer, the girls gradually form a team that has the potential to reach the top.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely negative, citing poor story, shallow characters, and a failed attempt to blend sports with idol elements. While some appreciate the animation of the hockey scenes and the soundtrack, many view it as a generic advertisement for a failed mobile game. The show fails to satisfy either sports anime fans or idol anime enthusiasts, resulting in a mediocre and forgettable experience for many viewers.
pros: Well-animated ice hockey scenes show attention to detail.
Some found the characters likable and easy to get attached to.
Soundtrack, particularly by MONACA, was a highlight for some viewers.
cons: Story feels like an advertisement for a mobile game that failed.
Characters are flat, cliche, and lack depth; minimal character development.
Poor balance of ice hockey, slice-of-life, and idol elements; none are executed well.
Idol elements feel forced and unnecessary, detracting from the sports theme.
Writing is lazy and uninspired, with cheesy dialogue.
Plot and pacing are boring, lacking excitement and tension.
Anime does not explain the rules/history of hockey which is unappealing to sports fans.

anime.title: Selection Project
anime.synopsis:
Due to a weak heart, Suzune Miyama has remained bedridden for most of her childhood. However, despite her illness, she has always dreamed of becoming an idol. Eventually, her opportunity comes in the form of the seventh Selection Project—a brutal series of competitions best known as the starting point of the legendary idol Akari Amasawa.

Anxious but excited, Suzune enters the preliminary round of Selection Project. Though her singing dazzles the judges and her fellow competitors, Suzune is unfortunately overcome by her nerves and freezes up in the middle of her performance. She recovers quickly, but the stumble is great enough that she loses the winning spot and is disqualified.

Or so it seems—until Seira Kurusu, the girl Suzune lost to, announces that she plans to drop out of Selection Project, believing Suzune is a more talented singer and therefore deserves the right to compete. Suzune is caught off guard by the decision, but promises Seira that they will meet again as top idols. She prepares herself for the challenging obstacles that lie ahead.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some enjoyed the show for its visuals, music, and character interactions, viewing it as a decent idol anime or even a 'season 2' to Idoly Pride. Others heavily criticized it for being unoriginal, with a derivative plot, weak story telling, and overused tropes, considering it a disappointment.
pros: Good production quality, especially animation during performances
Likable characters with interesting backstories
Catchy music and well-designed characters/outfits
Exploration of the harsh realities of the idol world
3D animation is well-integrated
cons: Story heavily borrows/rips off from 'Idoly Pride'
Predictable plot and cookie-cutter characters
Weak storytelling with plot holes and inconsistencies
Overreliance on friendship cliché
Reused music diminishes the impact of performances

anime.title: Full Dive: The Ultimate Next-Gen Full Dive RPG Is Even Shittier than Real Life!
anime.romaji_title: Kyuukyoku Shinka shita Full Dive RPG ga Genjitsu yori mo Kusoge Dattara
anime.synopsis:
Ten years ago, at the peak of the VRMMO development industry, a game titled "Kiwame Quest" entered the scene with potential like no other. Boasting a colossal total of 10 sexdecillion branches of possible story scenarios, this game pursued ultimate realism, ranging from humanlike NPCs to the perfect replication of all senses and physical abilities. But it soon became apparent that the game was too realistic, and the popularity of VRMMOs in general gradually began to plunge.

At present, due to an accident a few years prior, the high school student Hiroshi Yuuki now immerses himself in full-dive RPGs as a form of escapism. After failing to acquire the latest version of his favorite game, Hiroshi stumbles upon a game shop and meets its beautiful clerk Reona Kisaragi who convinces him to buy a copy of Kiwame Quest so that they can play together. 

The first time Hiroshi plays the game, he marvels at the realism it offers. However, his astonishment is short-lived as he sets off a series of misfortunes, quickly realizing that the game is even worse than his already stressful life. Nevertheless, Hiroshi still finds himself logging on again despite his growing contempt for the game. With no do-overs in his current disadvantageous situation, Hiroshi only has one goal—clearing the game!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some finding the show a refreshing and funny parody of the Isekai genre, while others criticize it for its unlikable characters, repetitive jokes, and poor execution. Some viewers appreciated the self-aware humor and subversion of tropes, while others found the show to be a waste of potential due to its flawed writing and inconsistent quality. Overall, the show seems to elicit strong reactions, both positive and negative, indicating a polarized reception.
pros: Unique take on the Isekai/VRMMORPG genre, subverting common tropes.
Good comedic timing with genuinely funny moments.
Characters have flaws that persist in the game world, leading to realistic improvement.
cons: Repetitive jokes and over-explanation of humor.
Unlikable and annoying main character with no growth.
Weak plotlines and shallow side characters.
Inconsistent animation quality.

anime.title: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window
anime.romaji_title: Sankaku Mado no Sotogawa wa Yoru
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Boys Love, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Kousuke Mikado has been able to see spirits for as long as he can remember. Extremely terrified of them, he tries to suppress his ability by wearing glasses. One day, while working at a bookstore, he catches the attention of Rihito Hiyakawa, an eccentric medium who is convinced that they were destined to meet each other.

Thanks to Hiyakawa's antics, Mikado is thrust into the world of the paranormal, with the former promising that he will shed his fears if Mikado stays with him. As they continue to work together, the two discover a series of malicious curses that all point to the same name—"Erika Hiura." What is this person's goal, and how do they connect with Mikado and Hiyakawa?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some appreciating the supernatural mystery and character development, while others are disappointed by the weak BL elements and confusing plot. Many feel the anime doesn't live up to its potential, especially compared to the manga. There's a consensus that the story is interesting, but the execution is flawed, leading to a mixed reception.
pros: Interesting supernatural story with horror elements.
Well-developed side characters and their relationships.
Good animation quality and art style.
Exploration of dark themes like family issues and recovery.
cons: Pacing issues and unexplained plot points.
Lack of focus on romance despite being marketed as BL.
Confusing at the beginning with insufficient information.
Disappointing adaptation compared to the manga.
anime.thematic_vibe: Supernatural Mystery, Psychological Trauma, Queer Baiting

anime.title: Blades of the Guardians
anime.synopsis: A extraordinary guard walks in the desert of the Western regions. On the way escaping the killing by the government, he took a guarding task with destination to the capital Chang 'an. The task was thought as just a simple one, but actually it is a road full of crisis and danger. A journey affecting the fate of the world begins......
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates Biao Ren for its engaging story, well-developed characters, and high-quality animation. Some find minor issues with animation consistency and certain character roles. Overall, the series is well-received and recommended for its intriguing blend of action, politics, and emotional depth.
pros: Well-constructed story with political intrigue and strong characters.
High-quality 2D animation and striking fight scenes.
Engaging and emotional narrative with an overarching plot.
cons: Inconsistencies in animation detail.
Kid character feels stereotypical and underdeveloped.
Voice acting can be inconsistent in conveying emotions.

anime.title: Purple River
anime.synopsis:
Two hundred years ago, on the Battlefield of the Blue River, the last remaining army of the Empire of Light collapsed in the midst of demonic outcries. As the last Field Marshal and Emperor fell, the chaotic world of the Western River no longer had a common ruler. Factions were formed and endless conflicts ensued, military might became the only currency of survival, and the dream to reunite the lands became the sole goal of many rulers in the generations that came after.

In the south-eastern part of the land, a powerful faction with over two hundred years of history – House Zichuan – fought off the Demons to the east, defended against the House Liufeng to the west, and contained the House Lin to the south. In order to accomplish their great ambitions and extend the bloodline of their family, countless heroes of Zichuan gave their lives in order to make this magnificent hymn come to life. This is a story about this legendary family and a hundred years of their blood and tears.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the focus on political intrigue and character dynamics within a military setting.
