pros: Showcases a decent amount of talent for the animator.
Good energy throughout the video with a surprising variety of background tracks.
Voice acting is fine, and the main character's VA manages to play her part convincingly.
cons: Artwise, it's a very short, relatively low-quality animation, clearly made on basically no budget.
Story is very simplistic.
Sound quality is less than stellar.

anime.title: "Deji" Meets Girl
anime.synopsis: Sixteen-year-old Maise Higa spends her summer days working part-time at her family's hotel, with absolutely nothing interesting to do. That is, until she meets Ichirou Suzuki—a mysterious boy who is seemingly haunted by strange supernatural occurrences. Upon interacting with him, Maise unexpectedly enters a different reality, where hotel rooms can transform into the deep ocean and banyan trees can spawn indoors out of nowhere. Intrigued, Maise accompanies Ichirou in his quest to uncover the secrets behind the inexplicable enigmas surrounding him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is that 'Deji Meets Girl' is a visually appealing short anime with a unique art style and focus on Okinawan culture. However, the extremely short episode length hinders the story, character development, and explanation of supernatural elements, leaving viewers feeling underwhelmed. While enjoyable as a brief time-waster, it ultimately fails to reach its full potential due to its limitations.
pros: Unique and colorful art style and animation.
Captures the feeling of a Japanese summer.
Explores Okinawan culture and symbolism.
Relaxing and enjoyable for a short watch.
cons: Story feels rushed and underdeveloped due to the short episode length.
Supernatural elements are not well explained or integrated.
Characters lack depth and development.
Ending feels abrupt and unsatisfying.
Generic sound design.
anime.thematic_vibe: Okinawan Culture, Supernatural, Slice of Life

anime.title: Fantasia Sango: Realm of Legends
anime.synopsis:
In spite of their defeat, the remnant factions of the Taipingtao Revolution continue to resist, plunging China into a seemingly never-ending war. Moreover, the negative emotions left behind by the rebellion's massive death toll begin to form miasma—giving birth to malignant beings called the "wangliang." These creatures can possess humans and turn them into horrifying demons, thus bringing about more deaths and miasma and spinning a vicious cycle that inflicts further despair upon the land.

As a countermeasure, the immortal deities known as the "Tianyuan" select certain individuals to be "Hunters." Accompanying them are the "Guizhan," specialists created by the Tianyuan who can absorb miasma and transform into demons themselves, acting as indispensable weapons against the wangliang.

After a tragic accident involving an out-of-control Guizhan causes the disbandment of the Sixth Hunter Unit, the Tianyuan designate three promising Hunters—namely Ji Ying, Qiao Xun, and Yan Ding—to reform the group. However, for an unknown reason, the Tianyuan also appoint Xiao Ling—the young Guizhan responsible for the former unit's downfall—to fight alongside the trio. Despite growing tensions, the members of the revived team must settle their differences and collectively use their abilities to attain victory against the common enemy.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is overwhelmingly criticized for its poor plot, animation, and character development. Reviewers found the story boring and repetitive, the animation quality lacking, and the characters unengaging. The only redeeming quality appears to be the music, but even that is overshadowed by the anime's overall mediocrity, leading to a consensus that the show is not worth watching.
pros: The OST, particularly the opening and ending themes, are well-received and considered listenable on their own.
cons: The plot is weak and lacks a clear direction, with repetitive battles and pointless side characters.
The animation quality is substandard, with choppy movements, weird camera angles, and inadequate CGI.
The characters are bland, one-dimensional, and lack emotional depth.
The anime feels like a waste of good music due to its obscurity and overall poor quality.

anime.title: Digimon Ghost Game
anime.synopsis:
Sightings of mysterious creatures known as "Hologram Ghosts" have been a popular topic on social networks for the past few years. According to the rumors, several people have fallen victim to these specters. Those fortunate to survive their encounters with the paranormal beings claim that they resembled glitched holograms.

Hazakura Academy middle school student Hiro Amanokawa believes these sightings are merely an urban legend. However, as the incidents start to increase in frequency, he is reminded of the day his father suddenly vanished, with strange digital watches serving as the only relics of his disappearance. Much like the other sightings, what happened to Hiro's father cannot be explained by conventional logic. 

One day, when a fellow student in the academy is attacked by a Hologram Ghost, Hiro and his friend Kiyoshirou Higashimitarai decide to look into the matter. Little does Hiro know that this investigation will be their first step toward discovering a dangerous world previously unknown to mankind.
anime.consensus_summary: Digimon Ghost Game is a mixed bag, praised for its characters, Digimon designs, and horror elements, but heavily criticized for its episodic nature, lack of plot development, and rushed ending. While some appreciate the fresh take on the Digimon formula, many fans were disappointed by the wasted potential and unfulfilled narrative promises. The series is polarizing, with opinions varying based on individual tolerance for episodic storytelling and underdeveloped plots.
pros: Charismatic characters and emotional depth, including partner Digimon and supporting cast.
Well-animated Digivolution sequences that are short and impactful.
Creative and diverse Digimon designs, staying true to evolution logic.
Good music and sound track.
cons: Lack of overarching plot and meaningful character development for most of the series.
Rushed and anti-climactic ending with unresolved plot threads.
Repetitive 'Digimon of the week' formula that becomes boring.
Inconsistent animation quality outside of Digivolution sequences.
Failure to capitalize on the horror theme's potential.

anime.title: Police in a Pod
anime.synopsis:
After graduating from high school, Mai Kawai's top priority was to find a job with a stable income to avoid turning out like her father. However, despite having taken a variety of civil service exams, she was faced with a harsh reality: nearly every institute denied her entry. The only place that accepted her was a police academy, which she reluctantly joined.

Even now that she is an actual police officer, the world continues to be cruel to Mai. Due to her profession, she unexpectedly receives constant criticism from disgruntled citizens. Disheartened by the hostile treatment, she decides to submit a letter of resignation after just a few months of employment.

But on the same day Mai chooses to quit, she meets Seiko Fuji—the former ace of the Criminal Affairs Division who is assigned as her new instructor. Finding her new coworker to be enchanting, Mai delays leaving and gives her uninspiring job a second chance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Hakozume is generally positive, appreciating its unique slice-of-life portrayal of police work and its blend of humor and drama. While some find the show insightful and enjoyable, others criticize its tonal inconsistencies and limited character development. Overall, it's considered a worthwhile watch for those interested in the genre, with minor flaws.
pros: Authentic portrayal of Japanese police work, thanks to the author's experience.
Well-balanced mix of comedy and drama, with the show's characters being enjoyable.
Unique premise offering insight into the lives and struggles of police officers.
The ending is easily the best part of the show.
cons: Inconsistent tone, with abrupt shifts between lighthearted comedy and serious drama.
Uneven pacing and episodic nature can make the story feel disjointed at times.
Some viewers found the humor repetitive or unfunny.
Character development feels limited or one-dimensional for some viewers.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Workplace Comedy, Police Procedural

anime.title: Aharen-san wa Hakarenai
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Beginning his first year of high school, all Raidou wants is to make friends—starting with the cute, tiny, and soft-spoken Reina Aharen, who sits right next to him in class. Unbeknownst to Raidou, Reina shares the same sentiment, but she has a problem. Awkward and timid, Reina is incapable of determining how chummy she has to be when approaching a person.

Due to Reina's complete inability to gauge personal space, the two struggle to spark their unlikely friendship, as even the simplest tasks like talking seem impossible for them. But despite the countless yet pointless challenges that hinder the pair, the overly imaginative Raidou will do whatever it takes to befriend the indecipherable Reina.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience generally enjoys 'Aharen-san wa Hakarenai' for its wholesome, comedic, and romantic elements. The show's unique humor and relatable characters are praised, though some find the plot repetitive and the supporting cast lacking. There is a minor divide between those who love the show's specific brand of comedy and those who find it cringeworthy, but the overall sentiment is positive.
pros: The show delivers an honest yet comical representation of awkward socialization.
The main characters, Aharen and Raidou, have great chemistry and their relationship feels meaningful and wholesome.
The comedy is unique, with surreal and unexpected scenarios elevating the humor beyond typical gag anime.
The anime adaptation is faithful to the source material, streamlining the story and casting the right voice actors.
The series has a unique sense of life and personality, allowing viewers to reflect on relationships and themselves.
The series subverts rom-com tropes, offering a realistic portrayal of a progressing relationship.
Raidou's overthinking and imaginative scenarios provide a constant source of fresh and memorable jokes.
cons: The story can be predictable, with a repetitive episodic format.
Some supporting characters are considered useless or annoying and detract from the story.
Some of the humor relies on outdated references.
The animation is not always smooth and can be awkward at times.

anime.title: Non Non Biyori Nonstop: Our Club Worked Hard
anime.romaji_title: Non Non Biyori Nonstop: Bukatsu wo Ganbatta
anime.genres: CGDCT, Iyashikei, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Beginning her academic journey as a first grader, Shiori comes face to face with the aspect of school she has heard alarming rumors about—homework! However, her worries quickly turn into excitement as the Asahigaoka girls agree to work together to complete their assignments at Komari and Natsumi Koshigaya's house. Their plan appears to be successful until an all-too-familiar feeling of procrastination creates a rowdy distraction for Natsumi.

On another day, Natsumi asks her teacher Kazuho Miyauchi if she can form and lead a new badminton school club. While the lack of funding and equipment proves to be a major setback, it does not stop Natsumi and the other girls from asking the candy store owner Kaede Kagayama for some help. During their spontaneous badminton practice, a minor accident leads Kaede to reminisce about a memorable day when she babysat Renge Miyauchi.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience expresses strong appreciation for the OVA's faithful continuation of the series' strengths, including its beautiful visuals, immersive sound design, and well-developed characters. There's a sense of bittersweetness and sadness about the potential end of the series, with some minor critiques about character focus. Overall, the OVA is well-received as a fitting conclusion.
pros: Beautiful and photorealistic art style enhances the Japanese countryside setting.
Excellent sound design with tranquil and immersive sound effects.
Characters are unique, well-developed, and supportive of each other.
cons: Disappointment that the series might be ending.
Some may wish for more focus on certain characters like Hotaru.

anime.title: My Master Has No Tail
anime.romaji_title: Uchi no Shishou wa Shippo ga Nai
anime.genres: Historical, Mythology, Performing Arts, Seinen, Slice of Life, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
The beginning of the Taishou era spelled the end of the tanuki's tricks. These raccoon dogs, who are able to transform into human beings, used to love fooling humans until advanced technology rendered their endeavors futile. However, Mameda, a young tanuki girl, has not given up on this tradition, and—resolved to follow in her father's footsteps—travels to Osaka in hopes of duping people.

As others in her village predicted, Mameda fails to deceive a single person, and she is even hunted down by an angry crowd. After finding refuge in a theater, she stumbles upon a rakugo performance given by a master of the art, Bunko Daikokutei. Fascinated by the vivid images created by the rakugoka's acting, Mameda becomes enamored with this style of storytelling and decides to become Bunko's apprentice!

Despite her initial reluctance to take a disciple, Bunko begins to teach Mameda rakugo after witnessing the young tanuki's perseverance. Between undertaking a taiko apprenticeship, handling her work at the theater, and memorizing plays, Mameda needs to give her all if she ever plans to master the only art that still has a chance to fool people.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience finds "Uchi no Shishou wa Shippo ga Nai" to be a charming and wholesome anime with endearing characters and a unique focus on rakugo. While some find the pacing and art style to be lacking, the strong themes of found family and the educational elements are generally well-received.  Most viewers appreciate the show's relaxing atmosphere and its ability to introduce them to Japanese culture and storytelling.
pros: Interesting characters with strong development, especially Mameda and Bunko.
Engaging exploration of rakugo and Japanese folklore.
Heartwarming story with themes of found family and belonging.
Good art style and animation, expressive characters.
Unique and educational "No Tail Tales" segment after the ED.
cons: Pacing issues, with some episodes feeling slow or boring.
Art can be bland at times, lacking immersive scene lighting and shading.
Rakugo element may not appeal to all viewers.
Story, while charming, isn't particularly deep or complex.

anime.title: Hanabi-chan: The Girl Who Popped Out of the Game World
anime.synopsis:
Recent college graduate Musashi Shinonome is visiting the Shitamachi God Heaven pachinko hall after inheriting it from his late grandfather. Inside, he stumbles upon a girl sleeping in a futon, who wakes up upon his arrival. She introduces herself as Hanabi Hana Ariake: a self-proclaimed perfected pachislot machine that has turned into a human. To prove this, she demonstrates her ability to transform and shoot fireworks out of her body.

Over the following days, Musashi meets two of Ariake's human pachislot machine sisters—the energetic Versus Ikusa Takanawa and the loving Thunder Rai Nihonbashi. Now, Musashi and the dynamic trio must work together to make the grand reopening of Shitamachi God Heaven a success.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Hanabi-chan wa Okuregachi' to be an enjoyable, albeit not groundbreaking, short anime. The humor and catchy intro songs are appreciated, but the plot is considered absurd. Many viewers would watch a second season if it were produced.
pros: Quick and easy to watch
Catchy intro songs and videos
Good, fast-paced humor
cons: Plot is absurd and straightforward
Not life-changing or exceptionally funny
Episode 12 feels out of place

anime.title: Love All Play
anime.synopsis:
In junior high, Ryou Mizushima and his friends join the badminton club on a whim. As he grows fond of the sport, Ryou works tirelessly to improve his badminton skills until he qualifies in the prefectural tournament. Lacking a coach who can bring out his full potential, he does not consider entering a high school with a strong badminton team. Instead, he plans on attending a local high school where he can play badminton for fun.

However, Ryou's perspective changes when Yokohama Minato High School's badminton coach scouts him. Not only does the institution have one of the strongest badminton teams in the region, but it also has Kento Yusa, a player Ryou admires. Though hesitant at first, Ryou decides to enroll with the support of his sister. Possessing a firm ambition, he begins to gain experience with the proper guidance of a coach—all in hopes of surpassing Yusa one day.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While the initial episodes were promising due to character designs and themes of friendship, the later episodes were disappointing. Reviewers cited issues with character development, coaching, and the anime's outdated feel, leading to a lukewarm reception overall.
pros: Character design and personalities were initially well-received.
Friendship and supportive relationships were highlights in early episodes.
Old-school storytelling elements are appreciated by some.
cons: Main character's behavior becomes inconsistent and unlikeable in later episodes.
Coaching is portrayed poorly, with the coach failing to provide necessary guidance.
Anime feels outdated compared to more recent sports anime.
Pacing issues covering the 4-volume novel in 24 episodes
Lack of emphasis on badminton segments.
Unimpressive OST.

anime.title: The King's Avatar 3
anime.synopsis: Third season of Quanzhi Gaoshou.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is largely negative, citing a significant decline in quality compared to previous seasons. Common complaints include rushed pacing, poor animation, and problematic translations. While some appreciate the voice acting, the overall experience is seen as disappointing, with many feeling that the series has lost its way.
pros: Voice acting is peak.
Animation was great, and the fight scenes smooth (in some instances).
cons: Story feels rushed with missing details.
Decline in animation quality.
Poor subtitle translations.
Character development is lacking.
Important fights were cut out.
Pacing is horrible.

anime.title: Martial Universe 3
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: In order to become stronger and defeat Lin Langtian in the subsequent clan competitions, Lin Dong, Xiao Diao and Xiao Yan embarked on the road of practice together, with constant adventures along the way. Under Xiao Diao's guidance, Lin Dong finally came to the Ancient Monument of the Great Wilderness, and successfully obtained the clue to devour the ancestral talisman, and under the competition of Lin Langtian and many strong men, he successfully obtained the martial arts of good fortune, the Great Wilderness Prisoner's Finger!
anime.consensus_summary: The third season is well-received, particularly for its improved animation and worldbuilding. While the plot remains similar to previous seasons, the overall experience is considered entertaining and binge-worthy. Many viewers recommend continuing past the first two seasons to reach this higher-quality content.
pros: Improved animation quality compared to previous seasons
Expansion of lore and worldbuilding
Entertaining and bingeable
cons: Plot is 'more of the same'

anime.title: YaShe
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Mystery, Mythology, Supernatural, Workplace
anime.synopsis: In a busy and bustling city, history is soundlessly scattered throughout. Those legends that speak of rare treasures, lost in the flowing river of time. At this place, in this time, they are here--in an antique shop named "Ya She".
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the animation, cultural depth, and emotional storytelling. However, others criticize the episodic nature, rushed pacing, weak character development, and voice acting. This makes it polarizing, where a segment of the audience loves it for its unique charm, and another segment dislikes it for its shortcomings in narrative and character development.
pros: Spectacular art style and animation.
Powerful and emotional plots.
Unique narrative concept using antiques to tell stories.
Thoughtful, historical stories with a cultural atmosphere.
cons: Episodic structure lacks connection to main objective.
Rushed storytelling with poor character introductions.
Difficult to connect with side characters due to rapid plot progression.
Annoying and cheap voice acting (according to some viewers).
Ridiculous stories that try to do too much.

anime.title: All Saints Street 3
anime.synopsis: Third season of Wan Sheng Jie.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience enjoys Wan Sheng Jie 3 as a cute and fun, short anime. It's praised for its likeable characters and humorous take on supernatural beings dealing with everyday life. While it won't make you think deeply, it's a great option for a lighthearted viewing experience.
pros: Characters are likeable
Enjoyable slice of life
Humorous premise
cons: Short episodes
Not philosophical

anime.title: The Tatami Time Machine Blues
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Suspense, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
On a hot summer day in Kyoto, a young man walks toward his apartment, dreaming of turning on the air conditioner and cooling down. But before he can turn his dream into reality, disaster naturally strikes in the form of Ozu, who spills soda all over the remote. With the air conditioner rendered completely unusable, the man and his friends are left to suffer in the terrible August heat.

Just when all hope seems lost, the group finds a true-to-life time machine in their storage room. Not knowing the dire consequences of doing so, they decide to travel back to the past and grab the remote before Ozu even has a chance to destroy it. What awaits them on the other side is a staggering adventure none of them are prepared for.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed Yojouhan Time Machine Blues as a nostalgic and fun addition to the Tatami Galaxy universe. While some felt it didn't reach the heights of the original, most appreciated its humor, characters, and exploration of familiar themes. It's considered a love letter to fans of the original series.
pros: Faithful continuation of the original Tatami Galaxy in terms of art style and humor.
Interesting and mind-bending plot with fun characters.
Addresses themes of taking action and responsibility in a lighthearted way.
cons: May not be as groundbreaking as the original Tatami Galaxy.
Episodes are too short.
Dialogue isn't as fast as the first season.

anime.title: Blue Lock
anime.synopsis:
Yoichi Isagi was mere moments away from scoring a goal that would have sent his high school soccer team to the nationals, but a split-second decision to pass the ball to his teammate cost him that reality. Bitter, confused, and disappointed, Isagi wonders if the outcome would have been different had he not made the pass. When the young striker returns home, an invitation from the Japan Football Union awaits him. Through an arbitrary and biased decision-making process, Isagi is one of three hundred U-18 strikers selected for a controversial project named Blue Lock. 

The project's ultimate goal is to turn one of the selected players into the star striker for the Japanese national team. To find the best participant, each diamond in the rough must compete against others through a series of solo and team competitions to rise to the top. Putting aside his ethical objections to the project, Isagi feels compelled to fight his way to the top, even if it means ruthlessly crushing the dreams of 299 aspiring young strikers.
anime.consensus_summary: Blue Lock polarizes viewers with its focus on egoism and ruthless competition, diverging from typical sports anime themes. While some appreciate its unique take and intense matches, others criticize its questionable morality, unrealistic premise, and inconsistent animation. The show sparks debate about the importance of individual skill versus teamwork, resulting in a divided audience.
pros: Unique take on sports anime, focusing on individual ego and skill.
Intense matches and engaging power system based on Blue Lock rankings.
Great voice acting and energetic presentation.
Exploration of personal growth and breaking away from traditional teamwork tropes.
cons: Questionable moral compass and portrayal of characters as borderline psychopaths.
Over-explanation of moves and thought processes, disrupting the pacing.
Unrealistic premise and focus on strikers over other positions.
Inconsistent animation quality, particularly in off-the-ball moments.

anime.title: Ningen Fushin: Adventurers Who Don't Believe in Humanity Will Save the World
anime.romaji_title: Ningen Fushin no Boukensha-tachi ga Sekai wo Sukuu you desu
anime.synopsis:
Veteran adventurer Nick, mage Tiana, cleric Zem, and half-dragon Curran each show up alone at a tavern, only to find themselves seated at the same table. As the night goes on, they take turns divulging their grievances and the hobbies they have taken up as a means of coping. While their stories are utterly different, there is one common thread: betrayal. Each of the four, having been bitterly betrayed by someone they treasured, has developed a deep-seated distrust of humanity.

But in addition to their similar worldviews, the four have one more commonality: a critical lack of funds. Realizing that things cannot continue as they are, they decide to form a party, rank up, and make as much money as possible to spend on their respective hobbies. What these disillusioned adventurers do not know, however, is that they will one day save the world from unfathomable peril.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with initial promise fading due to poor execution. While the premise and characters are praised, the animation, pacing, and plot direction are heavily criticized. Many feel the show failed to live up to its potential, resulting in a generic and disappointing experience.
pros: Interesting premise of disillusioned adventurers forming a party.
Engaging characters with good dynamics and focus on personal growth.
Unique fantasy world with anachronistic elements.
cons: Poor animation quality and inconsistent art style.
Directionless plot with filler episodes and lack of clear goals.
Uneven pacing, with rushed character development and unresolved storylines.

anime.title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
anime.synopsis:
Ken Usato, an ordinary high schooler, wishes for something fantastical to occur in his unremarkable life. Such an opportunity arrives when he is transported to another world alongside Kazuki Ryuusen and Suzune Inukami, two prodigious members of his school's student council. Arriving in Llinger Kingdom, the three are deemed to be the heroes tasked with stopping the impending invasion by the Demon Lord's army. However, this is a misunderstanding—Usato was summoned by accident and, unlike his two friends, is not one of the heroes.

Despite this disheartening revelation, Usato learns that he has an aptitude for the extremely rare healing magic. This catches the attention of Rose, the intimidating captain of the kingdom's Rescue Team, who forcibly takes custody of Usato to mold him into a full-fledged healer. As he undergoes grueling training under Rose's supervision, Usato resolves to become capable enough to protect his friends from the dangers of this world.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response is mixed but leaning positive. Many viewers found 'The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic' to be a surprisingly enjoyable and refreshing isekai, praising its character interactions, subversion of tropes, and balanced humor. However, criticisms include generic plot elements, pacing issues, underdeveloped characters, and a weak ending, indicating that while the show has its strengths, it also suffers from common isekai pitfalls.
pros: Enjoyable character interactions, particularly between Usato and Rose.
Subverts typical isekai tropes, offering a refreshing take on the genre.
Balanced humor and action, with in-depth emotional development of characters.
Focus on training and support roles rather than solely overpowered abilities.
Decent animation and music quality, especially the ending song.
Absence of excessive fanservice or harem elements.
cons: Generic plot elements and overused isekai tropes.
Inconsistent pacing, especially in the latter half of the season.
Underdeveloped side characters and lack of screen time for main characters other than Usato and Rose.
Forced comedy and annoying comic relief characters (e.g., Blurin).
Weak ending with a sharp cliffhanger.
Uneven animation quality and low-budget feel in fight scenes.
Inclusion of unnecessary or poorly executed fanservice-like elements.
Sometimes 'wacky' or uninspired story elements.

anime.title: Record of Ragnarok II
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy, Gore, Mythology, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
In a shocking turn of events, humanity has won its first battle in the Ragnarök tournament—a series of 13 fights that will decide the fate of mankind. Zeus, the head of gods, sends the demigod Heracles for the next round to avenge the humiliated Greek pantheon. To face this hero loved by gods and humans alike, the Valkyrie Brunhilde decides to use Heracles' complete moral opposite: the infamous serial killer Jack the Ripper—leaving human beings unsure who they should support.

Meanwhile, tensions begin to rise between various divine pantheons, and rumors of a traitor jeopardize the unity of those who want to annihilate humanity. As the line between friend and foe becomes blurred, Brunhilde will do everything she can to make her machinations successful.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 of Record of Ragnarok shows improvement over the first season, particularly in fight choreography and character backstories. While still not reaching the quality of top-tier anime, the season offers an entertaining experience for fans of the series. However, pacing issues and the presence of filler content remain as notable drawbacks.
pros: Improved fight choreography and animation compared to Season 1.
Unique and flavorful character designs.
More in-depth and detailed backstories for fighters.
Better motivations and targets for the fighters.
Enjoyable and quick-to-read backstories
cons: Still contains filler, similar to the previous season.
Pacing issues, with some parts feeling rushed or extended unnecessarily.
Some jokes still miss the mark.

anime.title: Kimi to Fit Boxing
anime.synopsis: Kimi to Fit Boxing is a short Japanese anime television series adaptation of the Nintendo Switch game named Fitness Boxing.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a decent adaptation appreciated by fans of the game and the boxing genre, mainly for its art. Its story is considered incomplete and needs further development. The lack of availability in English is a letdown for some, and the absence of gore might disappoint others.
pros: Appealing art style
Enjoyable for fans of boxing and Nintendo
Potential for character development
cons: Story is decent, not great
Lack of brutality or gore for some viewers
Not available in English

anime.title: Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 3 Specials
anime.synopsis: Specials included with Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 3 Blu-ray and DVD.
anime.consensus_summary: The OVA is a lighthearted, comedic departure from the main series, focusing on a western-themed adventure without tanks. While entertaining, it lacks the depth and world-building present in other installments, particularly the BC Freedom focused episode. The episode is generally well-received as a fun, non-canon side story.
pros: Humorous scenarios.
Unique, non-tank focused content.
New music introduced.
cons: Lacks depth compared to previous installments.
Limited world-building (Ooarai agriculture department).
Inconsistent with established ship layouts.

anime.title: Fanfare of Adolescence
anime.synopsis:
In Japan, betting on horse racing is one of the few legal forms of gambling; thus, the public races have become an interesting part of Japanese culture. In this sport, an individual who rides a horse and competes in races is called a jockey—that is just what Yuu Arimura aspires to be.

Becoming inspired after witnessing a derby, 15-year-old idol Yuu shocks the entire nation when he leaves the entertainment industry to enroll in a prestigious horse racing school. Excited to pursue his latest passion, he gradually bonds with his new classmates—such as the talented Shun Kazanami and the self-assured Amane Grace—who are each unique in their own way. Although the path ahead may be full of obstacles, Yuu is determined to pursue his ultimate goal of becoming one with his horse.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the character relationships, OST, and exploration of themes, while others criticize the rushed pacing, lack of depth, and inconsistent visuals. Some viewers enjoyed the focus on the journey and relationships, a departure from typical sports anime. Overall, it's considered an enjoyable but flawed series, with its niche subject matter possibly limiting broader appeal.
pros: Good OST, especially the opening and ending themes.
Distinct character personalities and backgrounds.
Exploration of subtle themes resonating with personal struggles.
Visually appealing, especially regarding the portrayal of freedom in horse riding.
cons: Rushed pacing and time skips without sufficient explanation.
Lack of in-depth character backgrounds and motivations.
Unclear explanations of horse racing details, making it hard to follow for novices.
Inconsistent visuals, particularly with subpar horse CGI.
Haphazard story/plot elements with egregious character development.

anime.title: Heroines Run the Show: The Unpopular Girl and the Secret Task
anime.romaji_title: Heroine Tarumono! Kiraware Heroine to Naisho no Oshigoto
anime.synopsis:
Freshly graduating middle school, energetic 15-year-old Hiyori Suzumi moves from her coastal hometown to Tokyo, pursuing her dream of being a track and field runner. Unfortunately, as soon as her first high school year begins, she faces an imminent problem that ultimately causes her to find a part-time job to cover living costs.

After searching through countless prospective workplaces, Hiyori stumbles upon a posting looking for event staff, to which she gets accepted against all odds. It is revealed that she will be working as a manager-in-training for LIPxLIP, a rising male idol group composed of Yuujirou Someya and Aizou Shibasaki—both of whom are coincidentally her classmates. Despite this shocking revelation, Hiyori is resolved to do her best with balancing her studies, her ambition, and most importantly, her role as LIPxLIP's attendant.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many enjoyed the initial episodes, character interactions, and music. However, the final arc, particularly the stalker storyline and its resolution, was heavily criticized for poor writing and problematic themes, significantly impacting the overall impression. While some appreciate the focus on friendship over romance, others found the plot disjointed and the characters underdeveloped.
pros: Enjoyable character dynamics and chemistry between the main characters.
Good music, especially the ending songs, by HoneyWorks.
Refreshing lack of romance triangle, focusing instead on character development and the idol industry.
Fluid 2D animation during dance/idol scenes.
cons: Poor handling of the stalker arc in the last episodes, including victim-blaming and a lack of consequences.
Rushed and shallow resolution to the drama in the final episodes.
Misogynistic portrayal of women, particularly the heroine's appearance.
Lack of focus on the struggles of the idols and the showbiz industry.
Inconsistent pacing and a disconnected plot.
Shallow character development and underutilized side characters.

anime.title: Battle Through the Heavens: Three Year Agreement
anime.romaji_title: Doupo Cangqiong: San Nian Zhi Yue
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Three years ago, Nalan Yanran, the young sect leader of the Yunlan Sect, rashly broke off her engagement. Feeling deeply humiliated, Xiao Yan made a three-year pact with Nalan Yanran. For this pact, Xiao Yan cultivated tirelessly, enduring trials from the Magical Beast Mountain Range to the Tagor Desert, from alchemy to the excruciating pain of absorbing a strange fire—all to prove the saying: "Thirty years east of the river, thirty years west of the river; never underestimate a young man's potential." Now, the men of the Xiao family will rise to the challenge, never retreating. Xiao Yan's path of growth continues…
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally expresses strong positive sentiment towards 'Doupo Cangqiong: San Nian Zhi Yue', praising its animation, emotional depth, and engaging storyline. Some viewers found earlier seasons less compelling but acknowledge significant improvements in later installments. While minor criticisms exist regarding specific plot points, the overall consensus highlights a highly satisfying viewing experience.
pros: Outstanding animation quality, especially facial expressions and fight choreography.
Emotional and engaging storyline with well-developed characters.
Excellent pacing and action sequences keep viewers engaged.
High-quality voice acting and sound design enhance emotional impact.
cons: Early seasons may be less engaging compared to later seasons.
Some conflicts may feel insignificant or illogical.

anime.title: To Your Eternity Season 2
anime.synopsis:
After seeing enough death and tragedy, the immortal Fushi secludes himself on an island, defending himself from enemy Nokkers. However, instead of attacking Fushi in isolation, Nokkers begin targeting the settlements outside of his reach in hopes of luring him out. Soon, a group known as the Guardians—led by Hisame, the descendant of the deceased warrior Hayase—finds Fushi.

Inspired by how Fushi protected Janada Island from the Nokkers years ago, the Guardians have grown a considerable following and are recognized throughout the world. Initially reluctant, Fushi allows the Guardians to accompany him to the site of the Nokkers' recent attack. In their village, Fushi meets a few valuable allies, both new and old. But as the conflict with the Nokkers only leads to more loss, Fushi must find the inner strength to face his inevitable sorrow.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found the season disappointing, citing pacing issues and a lack of emotional connection compared to season 1. However, others enjoyed the continuation of the story, highlighting the well-developed characters and meaningful themes.
pros: Wonderful characters with unique personalities.
Satisfying character arcs, especially Bon's.
Continues themes of immortality, loss, and human connection.
cons: Pacing issues, especially in the first half.
New characters feel rushed and underdeveloped.
Lost the emotional impact of the first season.

anime.title: Teasing Master Takagi-san 3
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis: As summer break comes to an end, Nishikata is stoked to try out his newest pranks and finally outdo his classmate Takagi once and for all. Despite his losing streak, he is slowly getting to know the unrelenting workings of her crafty mind. However, he soon realizes that Takagi's motivations behind her teasing may not be what he initially assumed. One thing is certain, though: each fun-filled day of strategizing and competing brings the two closer than ever.
anime.consensus_summary: The third season of Takagi-san is overwhelmingly praised for its significant character development and heartwarming romance. Viewers appreciate the improved animation and the series' ability to balance humor with genuine emotional moments. While a few find the pacing slow, the overall consensus is that this season successfully elevates the series, providing a satisfying and enjoyable experience.
pros: Significant character development for both Takagi and Nishikata, especially in their relationship.
Improved animation and art style, with more vibrant and colorful visuals.
Excellent voice acting and soundtrack that complements the emotional tone of the series.
Balances humor and heart effectively, providing both funny and heartwarming moments.
Addresses pacing issues from previous seasons by focusing less on side stories and more on the main storyline.
cons: Some viewers may find the slow-burn romance frustrating or repetitive.
Occasional inconsistencies in art quality, particularly in background details.

anime.title: Teasing Master Takagi-san: The Movie
anime.genres: Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis: Takagi and Nishikata's final summer in junior high is about to begin, and it's already off to a heartwarming start! When the pair find an abandoned kitten, they decide to work together and take care of their adorable new companion until they can locate its missing mother.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san Movie' is a bittersweet conclusion to the anime series, eliciting strong emotional responses from viewers. While many fans found the movie heartwarming and a fitting end to the story, some were disappointed by its departure from the series' core teasing dynamic and a rushed conclusion. The movie is praised for its animation, soundtrack, and character development, but criticized for its slow pace and lack of comedic elements.
pros: Satisfying conclusion to the series for long-time fans.
Beautiful animation and soundtrack enhance the emotional experience.
Well-developed characters, particularly Nishikata, show growth.
The movie provides a heartwarming and feel-good experience.
cons: Some viewers found the movie deviates from the series' teasing dynamic, becoming more generic.
Rushed conclusion that skips over crucial moments in the manga, leading to disappointment for some viewers.
Movie is slow-paced and uneventful.
Lack of comedy and the usual Takagi teasing compared to previous seasons.

anime.title: Moriarty the Patriot OVA
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Historical, Mystery, Psychological, Shounen, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Yuri no Tsuioku (Reminiscence of Lilies)
A newspaper article about a vandalized painting catches the eye of William James Moriarty. Recognizing the artist from his childhood days in the slums, he takes his brother Louis with him on a trip to the city of Bath to meet with the artist personally and identify the culprit. However, the person claiming to be the painter is not the man William remembers. Joined by Sherlock Holmes and John H. Watson, William looks for clues in order to find his old friend.

Moriarty-ke no Kyuujitsu (Moriarty Family's Day Off)
The Moriarty household faces its biggest crisis to date: hosting a tea party. Mysterious and closed off to the public, the Moriarty home hides an abundance of weapons, research, and other tools used in their underground activities. To keep their secret safe from overly curious—and completely smitten—aristocratic women, the entire team must maximize their skills and protect their base of operations at all costs.
anime.consensus_summary: The Yuukoku no Moriarty OVA is generally well-received by fans of the original series as it delivers more of the same, with an emphasis on character interactions and lighthearted scenarios. The first episode offers a new mystery case with Sherlock Holmes, while the second focuses on fan service and comedic situations. While not groundbreaking, the OVA provides enjoyable extra content for those already invested in the series.
pros: Enjoyable extra content featuring beloved characters.
First episode provides more Sherlock and William interactions.
Entertaining and lighthearted second episode.
cons: First episode's story is okay, but not particularly shocking or special.
Second episode is primarily fan service with some cliche moments.
Character designs are not consistently impressive.
Music doesn't stand out.
anime.thematic_vibe: Mystery, Slice of Life, Fan Service

anime.title: The Heike Story
anime.synopsis:
The Taira clan, also known as the Heike, holds immense authority over Japan. When a young girl, gifted with an odd eye that allows her to see the future, foolishly disrespects the clan, her father pays the price of her crime with his life. Soon after, as fate would have it, Taira no Shigemori—the eldest son of the clan leader—stumbles upon the same unfortunate girl, who now calls herself "Biwa." Biwa informs him that the downfall of the Heike is imminent. After learning of the great injustice Biwa suffered at the Heike's hands, Shigemori vows to take her in and care for her rather than let her be killed.

In an era of rising military tension, the Heike are in the midst of a cunning struggle for power, and bloodstained war is on the horizon. Shigemori, whose eyes allow him to see spirits of the dead, is both anxious and hopeful to prevent his clan's demise. Biwa, however, is reluctant to reveal the future to him and must adapt to her new life filled with both happiness and sorrow in this pivotal chapter in Japanese history.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many praising the show's artistic merit and emotional depth, while others find the narrative convoluted and difficult to follow. The addition of the character Biwa is a point of contention. Despite its flaws, many consider it a worthwhile watch, especially for those interested in Japanese history and culture.
pros: Visually stunning art style reminiscent of traditional Japanese art.
Emotionally resonant storytelling that humanizes historical figures.
Thoughtful exploration of themes like impermanence and the consequences of war.
cons: Fast pacing and time skips can make the story confusing.
The large cast of characters is difficult to keep track of, especially with similar-sounding names.
Addition of Biwa feels unnecessary and detracts from the main plot for some viewers.

anime.title: Martial God Asura
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: One night, a mysterious and unexplained phenomenon occurs in the nine provinces. Five years later Chu Feng, a regular outer disciple of the Azure Dragon School, awakens one of the mysterious nine lightning beasts. And discovers an egg sealed inside him. From there we follow Chu Feng on his path of cultivation.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some viewers appreciate the stunning visuals, exciting battles, and faithful adaptation of the light novel. However, others dislike the protagonist's character, finding him unlikeable and the story too serious, with poor character development. The original source material is favored compared to the adaptation.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation quality
Exciting battles and special effects
Faithful adaptation of the light novel (for some viewers)
cons: Protagonist's character is unlikeable (arrogant, ruthless, jerk)
Story can be too serious
Character development is lacking (bidimensional, linear)

anime.title: Jade Dynasty
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Zhang Xiaofan, who turned into an orphan overnight, becomes a disciple of the Qingyun Sect. After five years of training, he performs well in the Seven Peak Martial Arts Competition. He's sent to the Kongsang Mountain to defeat the evil. During the journey, he and his senior, Lu Xueqi, met with an accident, and got to know and save the lady of the cult, Bi Yao. At the same time, new danger is ahead of him.
anime.consensus_summary: The story follows Xiao Fan, an ordinary villager child turned cultivator, due to events in his childhood. Xiao Fan was an ordinary child living in a village close to the leader of the just(or righteous) sects: QingYun Sect.
pros: Adaptation of popular web novel
Intriguing plot
cons: Xiao Fan was an ordinary child

anime.title: Under Ninja
anime.synopsis:
Once believed to be extinct, ninjas have reappeared in contemporary Japan following the Pacific War. With a headcount rumored to be two hundred thousand, these deadly assassins are now tasked with covert operations, infiltrating a significant portion of the nation's public and private institutions in the process. 

Among these ninjas is Kurou Kumogakure, who often spends his days in a run-down apartment with no motivation to do much of anything. Some might consider him a useless vagrant who does nothing but steal beer from his neighbor. Nevertheless, the 17-year-old loser might actually be more dangerous than his demeanor suggests. Kurou's hidden potential is put to the test when he is given a new mission to infiltrate a local high school, but there is more to this assignment than he could ever predict.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating Under Ninja's unique and absurdist take on the ninja genre, praising its originality and quirky characters. However, others are put off by the confusing plot structure, low production quality, and reliance on crude humor. While some find it a refreshing subversion of anime tropes, others see it as a messy and unpolished experience.
pros: Originality and subversion of anime tropes are refreshing.
Unique blend of gritty realism and bizarre humor creates a memorable experience.
Characters are quirky and engaging, defying common anime archetypes.
cons: Non-linear storytelling and time jumps can be confusing and disrupt pacing.
Mediocre animation and inconsistent art style detract from the overall experience.
Vulgar and crude humor may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting
anime.genres: Childcare, Organized Crime, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Tooru Kirishima's notoriety is spread far and wide in the underworld. He is most commonly known as "The Demon of Sakuragi"—a man who is not afraid to resort to violence if deemed necessary. After almost jeopardizing a peace treaty, his boss tasks him with the most difficult job he has ever had: taking care of seven-year-old Yaeka Sakuragi—the boss' precious daughter—so that Tooru understands what it means to be responsible for another life.

At first, the two do not seem to meet eye to eye, as Tooru has no clue on how to communicate with Yaeka, and the young girl is not used to expressing her emotions. However, as time goes on, they come to understand each other despite their differences. The fearsome right-hand man of a yakuza boss and the child he must protect are about to learn that family is not always bound by blood.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received for its heartwarming and wholesome depiction of an unlikely family bond between a Yakuza member and a young girl. While some find the Yakuza elements weak and the story occasionally unfocused, the positive character development and emotional core resonate strongly with viewers. The show is considered a hidden gem for those seeking a feel-good slice-of-life anime.
pros: Heartwarming and wholesome relationship between Kirishima and Yaeka.
Exploration of themes like family, vulnerability, and acceptance.
Positive character growth and development, especially for Kirishima.
cons: Story can feel unfocused and lack smooth flow.
Yakuza elements are generic and poorly written.
Lacking depth in world-building and character backstories in some instances.

anime.title: Sword of the Demon Hunter: Kijin Gentosho
anime.synopsis:
After Jinta and Suzune ran away from their home as children, they were taken in by Motoharu—the virtuous sentinel of Kadono Village—and his daughter, Shirayuki. The settlement was ruled by its shrine maiden, Itsukihime, whom only a select few were allowed to interact with. When Itsukihime passed away, Shirayuki was appointed in her place. Wishing to stay in contact with her, Jinta worked diligently for years and was finally selected as the next sentinel.

As the protector of the village, Jinta's duty is to eliminate any threats. One day, he encounters a demon in a nearby forest. At the end of the battle, the demon makes a proclamation about the destined ruler of all demonkind. He attaches his severed arm to Jinta, turning him into an unaging demon man. By the time Jinta comes to, Kadono is on fire. Suzune has transformed into the demon from the divination, and due to a series of misunderstandings, she murders Shirayuki and flees.

Devastated, Jinta cannot forgive Suzune for her actions; he departs on a journey to find her. As Jinta travels around Japan across the eras, he endeavors to protect as many people as possible from aggressive demons. In his quiet moments, he contemplates what he should do when he once again faces his childhood friend.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. Many appreciate the show's mature themes, character development, and storytelling depth, drawing comparisons to a blend of 'Demon Slayer' and 'Frieren'. However, the poor and inconsistent animation quality and disjointed narrative structure are major points of criticism, leading to frustration and disappointment for some viewers. Some fans feel that the anime's potential was squandered due to production issues.
pros: Mature themes exploring grief, redemption, and the passage of time.
Well-written characters with significant development, particularly the MC's journey from vengeance to peace.
Intriguing story with twists and turns, rewarding attentive viewers.
cons: Inconsistent and declining animation quality, especially in later episodes.
Disjointed storyline with mini-arcs that don't always connect to the main plot.
Pacing issues, with some finding it slow and uneventful.

anime.title: I'm Kodama Kawashiri
anime.romaji_title: Atasha Kawashiri Kodama da yo: Dangerous Lifehacker no Tadareta Seikatsu
anime.synopsis: The story depicts the lazy, unhealthy daily life of Kawashiri, who loves alcohol and anything greasy, salty, or sweet.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided. Some viewers find the show's quirky humor, relatable themes, and unique art style to be comforting and enjoyable, while others are critical of its extremely short runtime, low production quality, and repetitive content. The long opening sequence relative to the actual episode length is a common point of contention, contributing to the polarized opinions.
pros: Unique art style that fits the series
Aoi Yuki's voice acting is a highlight
Comforting and relatable for some viewers
Creative use of visual cues and metaphors
cons: Extremely short episodes with a long opening sequence
Low-quality animation and production values
Repetitive and uninteresting content
Lack of plot or character development
Questionable use of Aoi Yuki's talent
Technical issues with audio mixing
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Absurdist Humor, Self-Deprecation

anime.title: Shadows House 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
After the resolution of the debut, Kate and her Doll Emilico have officially become residents of the Shadows House. However, they are under constant vigilance by the Star Bearers—an elite group in charge of the children's wing. In order to escape from their surveillance and the morbid methods they use to keep everyone's loyalty in check, Kate and Emilico must be wary of who to trust and aim to become Star Bearers themselves.

Meanwhile, the Star Bearers have encountered their own problems. A mysterious robed figure dubbed "Master Robe" has trespassed and roams around the children's wing. At first, Master Robe is deemed harmless, but more incidents start occurring that endanger the Dolls' lives—all of them pointing to the suspicious individual.

To improve her reputation, Kate decides to solve the mystery herself. Yet, with so few clues and so many suspects, searching for Master Robe and their motive for attacking the mansion proves more challenging than she imagined.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response to Shadows House Season 2 is positive. Many appreciate the faithful adaptation and the deepened mysteries of the Shadows House. However, some viewers find the pacing slow and the characters bland, leading to a slightly mixed reception.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga (unlike some other CloverWorks projects)
Strong character development, especially for Kate
Intriguing world-building and mysteries
Good voice acting and distinct characterizations
Improved narrative focus compared to Season 1
cons: Slow pacing
Some find the characters bland or uninteresting
Story progression can be repetitive at times
Visual quality may be perceived as inferior by some
Plot relies too much on convenience instead of logical consequences

anime.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 3
anime.synopsis:
Following their heroic efforts at Walter Park, the students of the misfit class return to Babyls Demon School after their summer vacation. What awaits them is not only adoration and admiration but also the shocking revelation that, in order to stay in the luxurious Royal One classroom, the entire class must be promoted to Dalet rank before entering the second year.

As the Harvest and Music Festivals are right around the corner, there seem to be ample opportunities to rank up. Doing so will not be simple, however, as no class thus far has managed to accomplish such a feat. Hoping to give the misfit class a chance to achieve the improbable, the school appoints special tutors to aid in confronting the challenges that lie ahead.

With his sights set beyond Dalet, Iruma Suzuki decides to take strides toward the goal of ranking up, starting with gaining acknowledgement from his special tutor: the short-tempered and selfish Bachiko Barbatos.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 3 of Iruma-kun is a mixed bag. While some appreciate the focus on character development and the engaging Harvest Festival arc, others found the pacing slow and the animation quality lacking compared to previous seasons.  The season is generally considered enjoyable for existing fans, but not as strong as Season 2, and potentially off-putting for new viewers.
pros: Engaging and fun Harvest Festival arc.
Good character development for the supporting cast.
Charming writing and comedic timing.
Generally enjoyable if you liked the previous seasons.
cons: Pacing issues, especially in the first half dedicated to the Harvest Festival.
Animation quality is considered worse than previous seasons, with more panning shots and off-model characters.
Some felt it lacked content, with too few episodes of substance spread across the season.
Neglected romance thread.

anime.title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest
anime.synopsis:
For over one hundred years, a special quest has been waiting for a wizard skilled enough to complete it. On the northern continent of Guiltina, there are five immensely powerful Dragon Gods who possess great destructive force that can only be quelled by sealing them away. Natsu Dragneel and his friends from the Fairy Tail guild—Lucy Heartfilia, Gray Fullbuster, Erza Scarlet, Wendy Marvell, and the exceeds Happy and Charlés—consider this the perfect challenge to take on.

The Fairy Tail mages are not the only ones searching for the Dragon Gods. Diabolos, a guild exclusive for "Dragon Eaters," seeks to enhance their Dragon Slayer magic by devouring the dragons. Meanwhile, Fairy Tail's newest addition, Touka, appears to be hiding something sinister from her new companions—and her secrets may bring disaster to the guild while its strongest wizards are away.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While many appreciate the nostalgia, improved animation, and romantic developments, others are critical of the inconsistent power scaling, convoluted plot, and diminished role of certain characters. The humor is a point of contention, with some finding it endearing and others finding it undermines serious moments.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material.
Improved animation and dynamic fight scenes.
Satisfying romantic developments between established couples.
cons: Inconsistent character power levels.
Convoluted and disjointed story with uneven pacing.
Humor sometimes undercuts the gravity of battles.
Lucy's reduced role and development.

anime.title: Lord of Mysteries
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Fantasy, Isekai, Mystery, Suspense
anime.synopsis: In a Victorian world of steam, dreadnoughts, and occult horrors, Zhou Mingrui awakens as Klein Moretti. He walks a razor's edge between light and darkness, entangled with warring Churches. This is the legend of unlimited potential...and unspeakable danger.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are divided, with many anime-only viewers finding the initial episodes confusing due to rapid exposition. However, those who persevere and pay close attention are rewarded with a compelling mystery and unique world. Novel readers appreciate the adaptation, but some feel nuances are lost.
pros: Intriguing world-building and magic system.
Cinematography, art design, and soundtrack are top-notch.
Rewarding for close listening and repeat viewing.
cons: First three episodes are fast-paced and confusing.
Anime adaptation may not capture all the nuances of the novel.
Animation inconsistency.

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: will+Dress
anime.synopsis:
Four months after the battle at Nagoya Castle, Yu-yu and friends received an invitation to a tournament.
That "Deluxe" tournament aims to determine the strongest fighter, bringing together both "Front Fighters" who are active in official tournaments, and hidden powerhouse "Counter Fighters" like "Blackout" that compete against each other for flags.
The existing characters from overDress will be competing with new characters from will+Dress such as Raika, Michiru, and Urara, to become the strongest of them all!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with disappointment stemming from a shift in focus towards the card game itself, at the expense of character development and narrative depth that were strengths of previous seasons. While some appreciate character moments with Mirei and the introduction of Urara, the overall feeling is that the season is boring and lacks development. The plot is perceived as a simple tournament arc with setup for future seasons, leaving viewers wanting more.
pros: Mirei's character arc and heart-to-heart moments with Yu-yu.
Urara acts as audience surrogate for new watchers.
Michiru and Raika's connection unrelated to main character
cons: Over-reliance on card game mechanics overshadows narrative.
Weak characterization of new main cast, especially Urara.
Unwarranted leadership position for Yu-yu and confusing deck development.
Boring tournament plot with limited character development.
anime.thematic_vibe: Tournament Arc, Card Game Focus, Character Connection

anime.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: will+Dress Season 2
anime.synopsis:
Yu-yu, Raika, and Touya were invited to America after their win in the “Deluxe” tournament in Japan, and went on a tour of exhibition matches.

It was one blazing fight after another as their opponents were all top ranking fighters from Deluxe USA. Danji, who had arrived earlier in America to look into the background of the Deluxe tournament at Michiru’s behest, begins to suspect a connection with the case of the missing fighters.

Meanwhile, a new force emerges in Japan, with their ideal of achieving the “Ultimate Fight” in cardfights.

What is their goal of recruiting more and more fighters? This will eventually come to cast a shadow upon the future of Yu-yu and the rest of Blackout…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While there's intrigue surrounding the new Uniformers group and returning Vanguard characters, the plot's structure is criticized for being disjointed and drawn out. The America trip storyline feels disconnected from the main conflict, leading to frustration with the pacing.
cons: Plot feels disjointed with the America trip and Uniformers storyline.
Excessive suspense building without payoff.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo
anime.synopsis:
Suletta Mercury leaves her planet and enters the Asticassia School of Technology at the behest of her mother. There, right and wrong are determined through duels between students, and the top-ranking duelist will receive Miorine Rembran as their fiancée—this prize being decided by Miorine's father.

When Guel Jeturk, the best pilot in school and Miorine's current fiancé, demands that his betrothed move in with him, Suletta disapproves, so Guel challenges her. Although she emerges as champion, Suletta is subsequently detained on suspicion of piloting a forbidden type of mobile suit—a GUND-ARM, or "Gundam"—which results in her victory being voided.

Miorine refuses to accept any more injustices and proposes another duel with even higher stakes. Now, Suletta must triumph a second time, otherwise she will be expelled and the Gundam Aerial that means so much to her will be destroyed.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the character-driven narrative and accessibility for new viewers.  However, some Gundam fans are disappointed by the shift in tone and focus on school life, finding it slow and less engaging than traditional Gundam series. The series is considered a decent entry point but needs further seasons to fully realize its potential.
pros: Relatable characters with well-developed personalities, especially the female leads.
A good entry point for newcomers to the Gundam franchise.
Unique storyline and world-building, blending sci-fi, romance, and thriller elements.
cons: The shift from a dark, serious prologue to a school academy setting disappointed some viewers.
Slow pacing and repetitive formula in the academy episodes.
Over-reliance on mystery boxes and shock moments, potentially overshadowing character development.

anime.title: Black★★Rock Shooter:  Dawn Fall
anime.synopsis:
In the year 2062, Earth finds itself fiercely battling Artemis—an AI which rebelled against humankind following a grand-scale workforce automation project failure years prior. In the hope of winning the war, a group of three highly skilled human warriors is assembled, known as the guardians of humanity.

Empress, the last surviving guardian, wakes up alone in an empty research facility. Unable to recall anything from the past except a place called "Lighthouse No. 8," she begins to search for answers. It is not long before she discovers an impending threat from Artemis—and she is the sole person who can save the world from destruction.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Black Rock Shooter: Dawn Fall is mixed to negative. Many criticize the story, characters, and overall execution, finding it a poor adaptation of the franchise. While some appreciate the fresh take and passable CGI, the overwhelming consensus points to disappointment and a feeling that the series failed to live up to the Black Rock Shooter name.
pros: Some enjoyed the fresh take on the BRS universe.
The CGI, while not perfect, was considered passable or even well-blended by some.
The soundtrack was appreciated by some, especially in action scenes.
cons: The story was criticized for being generic, underdeveloped, and full of plot holes.
Many felt the characters were unlikable, lacked depth, or were poorly redesigned.
The show was considered a weak adaptation of the Black Rock Shooter franchise, failing to capture the emotional core of previous iterations.
The mix of CGI and 2D animation was inconsistent, with some finding the CGI to be poorly integrated.

anime.title: To Every You I've Loved Before
anime.romaji_title: Boku ga Aishita Subete no Kimi e
anime.synopsis:
A world where it has been established that people routinely swing between slightly different parallel worlds...

Koyomi Takasaki, who lives with his mother following his parents' divorce, enrolls in a local university prep school. Due to the atmosphere concentrated on studies and his social awkwardness, Koyomi is unable to make friends. One day, he is suddenly approached by his classmate Kazune Takigawa, who tells him that she has travelled from the 85th world where she and Koyomi are lovers.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the parallel world concept and romance, while others find the plot confusing, characters shallow, and execution lacking. The interconnected nature of the two movies is both praised and criticized. Ultimately, the film seems to polarize viewers based on their tolerance for complex narratives and their expectations for emotional depth.
pros: Interesting concept of parallel worlds and multiple perspectives.
Exploration of love, relationships, and choices.
Potential for emotional impact and thought-provoking scenarios.
cons: Confusing and convoluted plot, leading to difficulty following the narrative.
Repetitive scenes and lack of additional context.
Shallow characters and lack of character development.
Monotone voice acting diminishes the emotional impact.
Rushed storytelling and lack of explanation.
Mediocre or dated animation quality.

anime.title: To Me, The One Who Loved You
anime.romaji_title: Kimi wo Aishita Hitori no Boku e
anime.synopsis:
With the divorce of his parents, seven-year-old Koyomi Hidaka makes the important decision to live with his father. As a researcher at the Japanese Institute of Virtual Science, Koyomi's father is involved in the investigation of the phenomenon of parallel worlds. Through his father's job, the young boy meets Shiori Satou, the daughter of another divorced researcher. Soon becoming friends, the two spend much of their childhood together.

As Koyomi and Shiori grow closer together over the years, the two intend to marry in the future. However, their plan comes to a halt when their parents decide to marry each other. Now fated to being step-siblings, the two friends refuse to accept their new reality. Using their parents' research, Koyomi and Shiori escape to a parallel world to start their lives anew together, only to face repercussions that will put the very futures they strove for in danger.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the emotional depth, exploration of love, and interconnected narrative with 'Boku Ai.' Others are critical of the voice acting, plot inconsistencies, and underdeveloped romance, ultimately finding the film underwhelming.
pros: Intricate portrayal of love's complexities.
Exploration of love that defies the constraints of fate and time.
Compelling exploration of love and regret.
Satisfying character journeys.
Intertwined stories offer depth, especially when viewed alongside 'Boku Ai'.
cons: Voice acting is often criticized for being emotionless and detracting from the experience.
Plot holes and inconsistencies in the sci-fi elements, particularly concerning parallel shifts and inter-dimensional travel.
The romance can feel underdeveloped, with a lack of chemistry between the leads.
Some viewers find the plot cheesy and contrived.
Technical jargon is used excessively, making it difficult to follow the story and diminishing believability.

anime.title: Cinderella Chef 2nd Season
anime.romaji_title: Meng Qi Shi Shen: Zaijie Liangyuan
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Gourmet, Historical, Romance, Time Travel
anime.synopsis: Ye Jiayao is a modern-day celebrity chef who loves traditional Chinese recipes and often experiments with them. However, when a food experiment goes wrong, she travels back in time to the ancient times, where she becomes the daughter of a magistrate with the name Ye Jin Xuan. When she wakes up she is suddenly kidnapped to Hei Fang Camp where she meets the leader of the bandits, Xia Chun Yu, the young master of the Jing An Marquis manor, who is actually an undercover agent for the king. He had infiltrated the Black Wind Fortress bandits to investigate a plot to overthrow the king. The two then get engaged in a fake marriage. Ye Jia Yao starts to win over hearts, including Xia Chun Yu's, with her superb cooking skills and modern street smarts.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the increased focus on food and romance in season 2, while others find the plot less engaging and the animation inconsistent. The female lead's characterization also receives criticism. Overall, the show is seen as a fun but somewhat flawed continuation of the first season.
pros: More food adventures and mouth-watering scenes in season 2.
Romance gets more development in the sequel.
The story execution is solid with comedy, drama, and romance.
Visually appealing food and backgrounds.
cons: Season 2 has less tension and conflict compared to season 1.
Story can be predictable with glossed over plot points.
Animation quality can be inconsistent and awkward.
Female lead can be whiny outside of cooking scenarios.

anime.title: Management of a Novice Alchemist
anime.synopsis:
After her parents are killed by bandits, young Sarasa Feed is sent to an orphanage where she learns about the prestigious world of alchemy. Determined to follow in her late parents' footsteps and become an independent business owner, she enrolls at the Royal Alchemist Academy to train and get certified as an official alchemist.

Five years later, Sarasa graduates from the institution and nearly achieves her dream before realizing that she lacks the funds to do so. Left with little choice, she makes do with a low-priced storefront in a town situated far away from the bustling capital. Despite the threat of treacherous terrain and dangerous monsters in the remote countryside, Sarasa begins her exciting new life as an alchemist.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding it a relaxing and enjoyable slice-of-life anime, while others criticize it for its flat characters, predictable story, and inconsistent focus on alchemy. The overpowered protagonist and lack of tension are also common complaints. Overall, it's considered a mediocre and inoffensive show, best suited for those seeking a lighthearted and easy-to-watch experience.
pros: Relaxing and cute atmosphere.
Enjoyable alchemy genre elements.
Upbeat and energetic OP.
cons: Flat and unoriginal characters.
Predictable and cliché story.
Inconsistent focus on alchemy elements.
Overpowered protagonist removes tension.
Mediocre animation and art style.

anime.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Shinigami Bocchan to Kuro Maid 2nd Season
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Love Status Quo, Romance
anime.synopsis:
The duke, full of love and kindness, treads carefully around every living being, be it a tender flower or his seductive maid, Alice Lendrott. Were it not for the devotion Alice shows him and the fondness that grows ever stronger between them, the duke would have barely paid heed to his mother's demand: to either lift the dreadful curse placed upon him or lose his family inheritance. Although the duke has no greed for riches, he yearns to be rid of his frightful powers—which cause all he touches to die—for the sake of those closest to him.

As the duke, Alice, and their friends enjoy spirited days filled with the ridiculous affairs of the supernatural, the spring deadline looms heavily over them. Nonetheless, the duke refuses to take any shortcuts in this endeavor if it means betraying the trust of his cherished friends.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the second season, praising the romantic developments and CGI animation. However, some viewers are disappointed by the shift in focus, choppy pacing, and weak villain. The season is seen as a bridge to the next, with hopes for a stronger conclusion.
pros: Romantic developments are well-received and story substantially better than season 1.
Awesome CGI animation style that brings charm and uniqueness.
Focus on the supporting cast and their development is appreciated.
cons: Deviation from the core narrative with unnecessary plotlines.
Choppy scene transitions and pacing issues.
Villain is perceived as weak and unthreatening.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sweet Romance, Supernatural Mystery, Character Development

anime.title: The Success Of Empyrean Xuan Emperor
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Mythology
anime.synopsis:
Of all the races in the world only 3 stand at the top. Each race possesses a master of the martial arts, a Golden Martial God. The balance of power appears to be shifting after Wang Fan's brother is killed triggering a chain of events that will begin to turn the world upside down. Disguising himself as the Silver Tiger King, Wang Fan becomes a symbol of power and the hope of the human race.

Some days Wang Fan is a boy genius that tries to blend in as a smart but helpless student. Other days he becomes a powerful tiger. Every race has their eyes on the Silver Tiger King as he continues to surpass every precedent and excel far beyond his peers all while under the guise of an unassuming student.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers find the storyline engaging and the main character charismatic despite animation flaws. Others find the plot repetitive and boring, criticizing the main character's decisions and the overall story's predictability.
pros: Engaging storyline
Charismatic main character
MC's displays of mental and martial dominance
cons: Poor animation quality
Awkward character animations and lines
Rushed storyline
Repetitive plot structure (defeat, escape, repeat)

anime.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: The Movie - Scarlet Bond
anime.romaji_title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken Movie: Guren no Kizuna-hen
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Reincarnation, Shounen
anime.synopsis: In Raja, a small country located to the west of Tempest. Rimuru and his companions get involved in a long-running conspiracy that swirls around the mysterious power of the queen. Rimuru and his commander Benimaru also encounter another ogre survivor named Hiiro, a man that used to be the brother of Benimaru.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some fans enjoyed the movie as a fun, albeit non-essential, addition to the series with good animation and character interactions, many were disappointed by the weak, predictable plot, pacing issues, and reliance on deus ex machina. The movie is considered a decent watch for fans of the anime but falls short of expectations for a high-quality, impactful story.
pros: Amazing animation quality in some scenes.
Feels like a natural extension of the anime series, fitting well into the world of Tensura.
Enjoyable character interactions and familiar chemistry between characters.
Introduces new canon characters and expands on existing ones like Diablo.
cons: The plot is bland, generic, and predictable.
Pacing issues, feeling both slow and rushed at the same time.
Over-reliance on exposition and info dumps.
Unsatisfying conclusion with unnecessary asspulls.
Inconsistent power scaling.
