The protagonist's development and the supernatural elements are appreciated, but the action and romance aspects are less compelling. Overall, it's considered a decent watch with potential, but falls short of being exceptional.
pros: Interesting main protagonist with convincing portrayal of grief and hatred.
Fun rapport between Hyouma and Botan's tsukumogami.
Solid character designs.
Good OP and ED.
Refreshing story with a blend of action, comedy, and slice-of-life elements.
Well-done world-building and character introductions.
cons: Visually atrocious with horrible filters and poor compositing.
Bland action scenes with incapable animation.
Unsure of its direction with a lack of clear conflict or villain.
Hyouma's transition from seething rage to guileless dork is too sudden.
Forced romance component feels tacked on.
Fight sequences are not eye-catching compared to other shows.

anime.title: Chained Soldier
anime.synopsis:
As his school days draw to an end, Yuuki Wakura worries about his future. While lamenting the prospect of living an ordinary life, he is suddenly drawn into the world of Mato: an alternate dimension filled with dangerous monsters called Shuuki. Over the years since the existence of Mato was first confirmed, incidents of people accidentally wandering into the other world have become commonplace. To combat the threat of the Shuuki and rescue victims like Yuuki, the all-female Demon Defense Force was established. Its members have been blessed with the power of "Peaches"—Mato fruits that grant supernatural abilities only to women.

Though Yuuki's situation is dire, he is saved in the nick of time by Kyouka Uzen, the chief of the Demon Defense Force's seventh unit. Despite Kyouka's impeccable skills in battle, she has long been held back by her Peach-granted ability, Slave. Slave allows Kyouka to put a living being under her control and draw out its strength, but the Shuuki that she had enslaved until now had all proven to be exceedingly weak.

When Yuuki and Kyouka become surrounded by a horde of Shuuki, Kyouka resorts to something she has never tried before: using her ability on a man. To her surprise, Yuuki's slave form is much more powerful than she could have imagined. Believing the young man to be the key to unlocking her true potential, Kyouka invites Yuuki to join the Demon Defense Force—but not as a regular member.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some enjoy the series as a fun ecchi anime with engaging action and character interactions, praising its animation and unique story elements. However, many are disappointed by the poor adaptation, generic characters, and over-reliance on fanservice at the expense of plot and world-building. This leads to a polarized view, with some considering it a guilty pleasure and others a complete waste of time.
pros: Good combination of elements creates an enthralling watch, with surprising depth in relationship building, story progression, and character development.
Some reviewers praise the animation and visual fluidity, especially in action scenes and fanservice.
The story is original, with well-developed female characters and a clear evolution of Yuuki's powers.
cons: Many find the adaptation disappointing, failing to capture the magic of the manga with changed or omitted scenes.
The animation quality is often criticized, especially the use of bad CGI for monsters and transformations.
Some reviewers find the characters generic, underdeveloped, and unlikeable, with a weak and spineless main character.

anime.title: Heaven Official's Blessing Season 2
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Mythology
anime.synopsis:
Although most gods in the heavenly realm avoid dealing with the forgotten god Xie Lian, Heavenly Emperor Jun Wu holds him in good graces. Xie Lian's luck is otherwise terrible, and adding to his troubles, the gods seem to suspect that Xie Lian's recent companion was the dreaded Ghost King Hua Cheng. Despite what others may think of him, Xie Lian fondly recalls Hua Cheng's promise: the next time they meet, Hua Cheng will appear in his true form.

Jun Wu informs Xie Lian of the unsettling news that a god's distress signal was seen coming from the Ghost City—the most prosperous place in the ghost realm, where the only law is Hua Cheng himself. As Xie Lian has no qualms about stepping into Hua Cheng's territory, he infiltrates the city to locate the lost god. There, the genuine Hua Cheng is already waiting. He is the most feared being across the three realms, yet before Xie Lian, his arrogance erodes. Without revealing the reason for his generosity, he spares no power or means to ease the burdens of Xie Lian's endlessly unfortunate past.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Tian Guan Cifu is a visually appealing and emotionally engaging continuation of the first, though some viewers found the plot confusing and the pacing uneven. While the animation and voice acting are praised, some critique the delayed reveals and romantic development. Overall, the season is considered a satisfying addition, but slightly less impactful than the first.
pros: Faithful to the novel
Expressive animation, especially facial expressions
High-quality English dub and voice acting
Beautiful character designs and landscapes
Satisfying conclusion
cons: Story can be confusing, especially with names
Slow pacing in the middle episodes
Uneven romantic development between main characters
Tension lost due to Hua Cheng's overpowered nature
Frustrating withholding of information before 'The Reveal'
anime.thematic_vibe: Emotional Angst, Chinese Mythology, Romantic Development

anime.title: What's Wrong with My Big Brother 3rd Season
anime.romaji_title: Wo Jia Da Shixiong You Dian Kaopu
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Dongfang Xianyun, the big brother who finally recognized himself as the "big protagonist", fell into nothingness due to Dongfang Wuxian's misunderstanding. With the help of Bu Suantian, an envoy of the Tao of Heaven who was a time traveler, Dongfang Xianyun was forced to be reborn and once again involved in the battle between good and evil. The war intensified and everyone waited for Dongfang Xianyun's efforts to turn the tide, the big brother finally became reliable.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the show, praising the action and plot twists. Some viewers find the animation quality to be average. Overall, the show is well-received, with fans appreciating the character interactions and increasing depth of the story.
pros: Cool fight scenes
Interesting plot twists
Character interactions
cons: Animation may not meet high standards

anime.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King 3
anime.synopsis: As demons are now refugees after the destruction of their home, the Kyuumiya family plots to drain their energy with the help of their first daughter Yoshiko. Sent off to study at Faction 60 as her cover, she befriends Wang Ling and his crew, but it doesn’t take long before her true purpose is discovered. Will Wang Ling be able to stop the Kyuumiya before they achieve their goal?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the third season to recapture the magic of the first, praising its humor and episodic nature. However, others criticized the lack of continuity, filler episodes, and disconnected storytelling, leading to a polarized view of the season's overall quality.
pros: Recaptures the magic of season 1 with an overarching plot and episodic quality.
Humorous satire with engaging episodic plotlines.
Good english dub.
Fresh twist to the general dynamics of the characters that isn't immediately apparent at the start, but wraps up nicely in the final couple of episodes.
Unique art styles, including 3D CGI, low-poly 3D, VN-style dialogue, game style, and live-action segments.
cons: Lack of continuity between episodes.
Episodes seem disconnected and can be skipped or reordered.
Story dropped off a cliff with standalone episodes.
Too many cameos and fourth wall breaks.
Filler episodes.
Soundtrack reuses a lot of music.
Not overly well produced.

anime.title: One Piece Film: Red
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Award Winning, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Idols (Female), Shounen
anime.synopsis:
As a child, Uta—the Red Hair Pirates' ex-musician and Monkey D. Luffy's childhood friend—promised that she would build a new era of freedom by performing joyful music for the world.

Luffy and the Straw Hat Crew arrive at Uta's first ever live concert, where many fans have gathered to enjoy the diva's otherworldly singing. Due to a childhood trauma, Uta bears a deep-seated hatred for pirates; her happy reunion with Luffy is cut short when she learns that he has since become one. Luffy's refusal to change his ways results in Uta unleashing her powers on the Straw Hats. The crew soon learns that their minds have already been trapped in Uta's dream world since the beginning of the concert, while their unconscious bodies remain asleep in the real world.

With time quickly running out, the Straw Hats must find a way to escape the nightmare or be trapped in Uta's dream forever.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided, with some praising the film's unique musical approach, emotional moments, and connection to the One Piece world, while others criticize the incoherent plot, over-reliance on music, and shallow character development, particularly Uta. The film's non-canon status and deviation from typical One Piece storytelling contribute to the polarized opinions. Many felt that Shanks's limited role was a missed opportunity given his prominent marketing.
pros: Enjoyable and engaging for fans of the series.
Unique narrative compared to other One Piece films.
Showcases Uta's character and the magical world of Film Red effectively.
Great fight scenes and emotional moments.
Music is a key part of Uta and the movie as a whole.
Visually fantastic, especially on a big screen.
Sound design, music, and voice acting are well-done.
cons: Non-canon and incoherent story.
Too much focus on music, with some songs being generic and cliche.
Uta's character development is lacking.
Shanks' appearance is not significant enough despite being heavily promoted.
Plot is simple and not very deep.
Some viewers found the musical elements and dance choreography cringy.
Rushed pacing and nonsensical plot points.

anime.title: Skip and Loafer
anime.synopsis:
In order to pursue her dream of bringing positive changes to Japan, Mitsumi Iwakura leaves her countryside town to attend a prestigious high school in the hustle and bustle of Tokyo. As she has already mapped a clear life plan, she has absolute confidence that there will be zero mishaps from then onwards.

Despite her ambitious promise, the country girl ends up running late on the first day when she gets lost on her way to school. Fortunately, she meets a fellow first-year student, Sousuke Shima, who is in the same situation and offers to go with her. They eventually make it to school, but the misfortunes do not end there, as Mitsumi leaves an unfavorable first impression in front of her classmates.

Nevertheless, the class soon takes notice of her friendship with Sousuke despite their opposing personalities. Only time will tell whether Mitsumi will be able to forge fruitful relationships with her classmates, and she will certainly not be alone.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. 'Skip to Loafer' is praised for its realistic characters, heartwarming relationships, and feel-good atmosphere. Viewers appreciate the show's departure from typical anime tropes and its ability to create a genuine and engaging high school slice-of-life experience.
pros: Well-written characters with realistic depth and growth.
Nuanced and genuine portrayal of relationships, avoiding typical anime tropes.
Refreshing and positive themes, offering a feel-good viewing experience.
High-quality animation and art style that enhances the show's overall charm.
cons: Story may be considered simple by some viewers.
The title 'Skip and Loafer' is confusing to some viewers.

anime.title: Gudetama Freestyle
anime.romaji_title: Gudetama: Muhou Chitai de Jiyuu mo Fujiyuu
anime.synopsis: Web shorts focusing on the Sanrio character Gudetama.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a bizarre, humorous series featuring Gudetama. While it has moments of fun, the execution is somewhat amateurish and the content is already showing its age due to its focus on pandemic-related issues. The show seems overall harmless and inoffensive.
pros: Good sense of humor
cons: Amateurish execution
Dated content (pandemic related)

anime.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
anime.synopsis:
Third-year high school student Jirou Yakuin is in love with his childhood friend and classmate, Shiori Sakurazaka. Thus, he hopes to be paired with her for the marriage practical: their school's practice of randomly selecting boy-girl pairs to live as pretend married couples while monitoring and rating them on how close they have gotten. Meanwhile, the lively Akari Watanabe wants to be assigned to her crush, the popular and good-looking Minami Tenjin.

Much to their dismay, Jirou and Akari find out that not only have they been paired together, but so have Shiori and Minami! Determined to be with their crushes, Jirou and Akari strive to earn as many points as possible, as the top 10 pairs earn the right to switch their partners—so long as both couples agree.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers find the show enjoyable with unique elements and good character dynamics, praising the animation and art style. However, others criticize the cliché story, bland characters, and the questionable premise, resulting in a polarized, but overall moderate, audience reception.
pros: Enjoyable characters with good dynamic and conversations
Animation is good with great art design
Unique premise
cons: MC is indecisive and bland
Story can be cliché with overused tropes
Artificial and unrealistic plot
Unethical school premise
Lacks substance with little character development

anime.title: My Journey in an Alternate World
anime.romaji_title: Wo de Yi Jie Zhi Lu
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Young Chen Xiaofan entered an alternate world after he accidentally swallowed a Chaos Orb, and became Young Master Chen, the prettiest man in Muyun City. Although he was adored by all the ladies in Muyun City, he was useless as he was not able to cultivate. With his mind set on going back to his original world, he gave up his stable lifestyle as a young master and went against his family’s wishes, determined to walk the path of a cultivator.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a standard isekai cultivation story. The plot revolves heavily around Chen Xiaofan's cultivation journey. However, the story may be repetitive.
cons: Repetitive focus on cultivation.

anime.title: The Infinitors
anime.synopsis: An affluent white-collar worker receives a mysterious invitation: "Would you like to know what life is about?" "Would you like to live your life fully?" It is sent into the unpredictable space of the Lord God, and future human beings will invite and challenge the present world, and the different challenges that humans face during the era of great universe development will be simulated as copies as well. The "copies" will guide the selected people to overcome many traps, meet life-and-death comrades, and become leaders. All of this is in the interest of human evolution, survival, and infinite futures!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the donghua's setting unique, combining game-like elements with a survival theme. It follows a depressed protagonist thrust into a dangerous world controlled by a 'God'. The story explores human evolution and the search for meaning in life through challenging trials.

anime.title: Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki 4
anime.synopsis: Fourth season of Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki Yonsatsume is generally negative. Many viewers feel that the show has devolved into blatant advertisement, with an overabundance of cultural references that are difficult to understand. The short episode length and initially charming premise have worn thin, leaving viewers feeling unfulfilled and questioning the show's direction.
pros: Art is pretty nice
Easy to binge due to short episodes
cons: Over-reliance on cultural references that are not easily understood
Feels like blatant advertisement for Japanese tourism
Story is confusing and lacks depth
Seasons 2-4 do not match the balance of Season 1

anime.title: Swarm
anime.synopsis: A seemingly ordinary bus accident has caused many forces to be involved. Just as everyone scrambled to investigate the truth, a series of surprises broke out. The crisis hidden behind the unsolved case is far beyond everyone's imagination... While human beings are exploring their own limits, they do not realize that they are once again standing at the crossroads of evolution, and a magnificent era has begun.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is intrigued by the show's futuristic setting and initial promise of a mind-bending sci-fi thriller. However, many are disappointed by the plot's direction and the lack of a satisfying conclusion by episode 12. The show's 'to be continued' ending has left viewers with mixed feelings, awaiting a potential continuation.
pros: Great CGI
Cool, futuristic setting with advanced technology
Interesting sci-fi concept with potential paradigm shift
cons: Plot goes in dumb directions
Unsatisfying conclusion (incomplete plot at episode 12)
Over promises; doesn't quite deliver

anime.title: The Indomitable
anime.synopsis: Qian Cong, a young man from the country of "Hua", is a Squib with a mark but unable to use speech. Even so, he dreams of becoming the strongest speech master and enters the Academy City to study, thus beginning his immortal life.
anime.consensus_summary: The donghua is praised for its action sequences and the protagonist's cleverness, which compensates for his initial weakness. The CGI animation is a potential drawback for some viewers, but the show is generally well-received, especially for its engaging fight scenes and unique magic system. There's a desire for a second season, suggesting a positive audience reception.
pros: Fast-paced and exciting action sequences.
Interesting "Power Word" magic system.
Main character's cunning and strategic thinking compensate for initial lack of ability.
cons: CGI character animation may be off-putting to some.

anime.title: Immortality
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Fang Han, a humble family slave, held the belief since childhood that "I would rather be a beggar than a slave", and traversed the world by himself. With an unyielding stubbornness, he broke through the mystery of supernatural powers and forged his body into an immortal body. Work hard to step into the fairyland step by step, and eventually become the peak king.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive, highlighting the thrilling plot and well-developed characters. The revenge story and unique storytelling style are also appreciated. Some viewers note a lack of familiarity with the source material prevents them from assessing the adaptation's quality, but overall, the series is recommended for fans of the genre.
pros: Thrilling plot and story play
Well-written characters and environment
Unique direction and story-play style
cons: Adaptation quality not assessed (reader unfamiliar with source material)
Plot may rely on common tropes

anime.title: Three-Body
anime.synopsis: Countless thin lines stretched across the starry sky, like a giant brush. The Trisolaran fleet would arrive in 400 years. A distant butterfly flapped its wings, altering Luo Ji's fate; behind the door that swung open lay the world's center—the Wallfacer Project. Meanwhile, within the Wallbreaker chamber created by the Sophon, the Wallbreakers took their places one by one…
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is quite polarized, with many viewers expressing disappointment due to poor animation quality and significant deviations from the source material. Some appreciate the fast-paced action, but most agree that prior knowledge of the books is essential to understand the plot. Overall, the adaptation is considered a failure by many fans of the Three-Body Problem series.
pros: Constant action and fast-paced plot progression.
Adaptation of the second book, 'The Dark Forest'.
cons: Animation quality is poor; unnatural movements and unrealistic lighting.
Plot deviates significantly from the original novel, making characters irrational.
Assumes prior knowledge of the first book, making it confusing for newcomers.
Lacks substance and depth without the background from the books.

anime.title: Undetectable Box
anime.synopsis: I often fall into the fantasy upon her back. What kind of person is she? What does she like? What world view does she hold? From the occasional detailed observations of her daily life, I have inferred many unexplainable clues... After a series of fantastic imagination, I suddenly realized that the girl who has been dialoging with me in my mind is just my own wishful thinking. Therefore, on the day of the reunion, I decided to take this step...
anime.consensus_summary: The short film deeply resonated with viewers, particularly those who struggle with self-doubt and anxiety. The animation and voice acting were praised for their ability to convey complex emotions effectively. The narrative's exploration of fantasy versus reality connected with audiences on a personal level.
pros: Breathtaking animation
Great voice acting
Powerful imagery conveying complex emotions

anime.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs
anime.romaji_title: Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu
anime.genres: Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Mecha, Reincarnation, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Blackmailed into playing a dating simulator set in a matriarchy, an ordinary man must put up with the unbearable and convoluted world until he clears the game. After countless days of grinding, he finally manages to beat it, but his hardcore gaming comes at a cost: extreme sleep deprivation and hunger.

While heading out to the convenience store to solve one of these problems, the man tumbles down the stairs and falls unconscious, only to wake up to the worst possible realization—he has been reincarnated into the game as the mob character Leon Fou Bartfort. Now trapped in a world he despises, Leon must use his knowledge of the game to navigate through the plot safely and sustain himself in a society where the odds are heavily stacked against him.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response is mixed but leans towards positive. Many find the anime enjoyable due to its unique protagonist and comedic elements, despite the mediocre production quality. While some appreciate the story and character development, others criticize the rushed pacing and shallow plot, resulting in a somewhat polarized but ultimately forgiving audience.
pros: Enjoyable anti-hero protagonist with a distinct personality.
Humorous interactions and comedic elements are well-received.
The story is entertaining and engaging despite being predictable.
Good character development, especially for Angelica.
cons: Mediocre animation and art quality, with some instances of poor CGI and rushed scenes.
Inconsistent pacing and rushed storytelling, failing to fully adapt the source material.
Shallow plot and underdeveloped characters besides the protagonist.
Inconsistencies in world-building, such as the matriarchal society not being well-defined.

anime.title: False Memory
anime.synopsis: In order to go back to the past, Guan Chao tries hard to find the "burning stone" that activates the time gun, but accidentally falls into the Memory Management Bureau. Only by conquering the BUG people in the memory layer can he return to reality. With the help of administrators such as Fangtang and Baizhong, can Guan Chao successfully complete the task? What kind of challenges are awaiting Guan Chao in each memory layer...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive, praising the visuals and storytelling. The short film is seen as a promising pilot for the upcoming full-length series. Some find the message too overt, but overall reception is favorable and excitement is high for the 2025 release.
pros: Compelling visuals and storytelling
Refreshing animation style
Fight scenes
Interesting concept
cons: Message is primary; narrative secondary
Subtitle quality (potentially)

anime.title: Phantom of the Idol
anime.genres: Comedy, Idols (Female), Idols (Male), Josei, Music, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Kazuki Yoshino and Yuuya Niyodo are idols who make up the duo ZINGS. While Kazuki gives his all in every performance, Yuuya views the job as just another means of making money. Yuuya's apathetic attitude toward the fans and inability to take his job seriously causes his manager to give him an ultimatum: unless he starts putting in more effort, he will be fired.

Backstage, Yuuya meets Asahi Mogami, an idol dressed in a colorful costume. Asahi would have had a bright future ahead of her—had she not died a year prior. Even as a ghost, Asahi wants nothing more than to perform for fans again. When she finds out that Yuuya does not hold the same passion for the idol life that she once did, she is overcome by a fit of rage and demands that he let her take his place. In a strange twist, Yuuya wakes up to find that Asahi has possessed him and can do what he is too lazy to do himself.

With Asahi performing for him, Yuuya thinks he has a ticket to an easy idol life. However, Asahi has other plans. Though she is no longer alive, she wishes for Yuuya to find the ambition that she still has. Together, she wants them to become the best idol the world has ever seen. But can an unmotivated man like Yuuya ever care about anything besides money?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed but generally positive. Many appreciate the show's unique premise, comedic elements, and well-developed characters, particularly the interactions between the lazy protagonist, the ghost idol, and the enthusiastic fan base. However, criticisms are directed toward the inconsistent animation quality, repetitive humor, and a perceived lack of plot development, preventing it from being a standout title for some viewers.
pros: Unique premise blending idol anime with paranormal elements.
Well-developed and engaging characters, especially the main trio and the fan club.
Humorous portrayal of idol culture, contrasting the lazy protagonist with dedicated fans and a passionate ghost.
Exploration of themes like fan culture, the idol industry's pressures, and finding passion in work.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, particularly the CGI used for dance sequences.
Repetitive humor and some pacing issues.
Underdeveloped plot with limited story progression, especially in later episodes.
Music is catchy but not particularly memorable.
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture Satire, Ghostly Collaboration, Slacker Comedy

anime.title: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire ♀
anime.romaji_title: Eiyuuou, Bu wo Kiwameru Tame Tenseisu: Soshite, Sekai Saikyou no Minarai Kishi♀
anime.synopsis:
The hero-king Inglis—who dedicated his entire life to building his country—is now approaching death. To award him for his honorable achievements, the goddess Alistia appears and grants him one wish. Having never been able to master the blade, Inglis asks to be reincarnated in order to do so.

In a blink of an eye, Inglis finds himself born in the far future as a daughter of the Eucus noble family. Six years later, Inglis is discovered to be Runeless—incapable of utilizing the runes that enable the use of magic in this era. She is therefore ineligible to become a knight. However, this fits in well with Inglis' plan: she instead decides to become the squire for her cousin, Rafinha Bilford, allowing Inglis to focus on pushing her limits.

For Inglis, the challenges this familiar yet different world has to offer are instead opportunities for her to hone her skills—and possibly become an extraordinary squire in the process.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers found the OP main character and action entertaining, while others criticized the poor animation, underdeveloped characters, and unresolved plot points. Many felt the series had potential but failed to deliver, with the ending leaving them unsatisfied due to unanswered questions. The series is considered average overall and is not recommended for those seeking depth or strong storytelling.
pros: Enjoyable OP main character with a battle junkie personality
Good world-building, but under-explored
Unique art style that some viewers appreciated
Decent story underneath the action
Refreshing take on the isekai trope by focusing on personal development rather than heroics.
cons: Poor animation quality, especially in action scenes
Underdeveloped supporting characters
Plot introduces mysteries but fails to resolve them
Misleading title, as the MC rarely uses a blade
Inconsistent pacing
Questionable writing with plot holes and inconsistencies
Unnecessary gender swap that does not contribute meaningfully to the story

anime.title: Condom Battler Gorou: Revive
anime.synopsis:
Set five years and six months after Condom Battler Gorou and has a much more somber and realistic style. Although the shorts are presented in digest form, they are drawn from a hypothetical 5-6 hour long classic anime that doesn't actually exist. The new series comments on the legacy of the old-school Condom Battler Goro, as the protagonist struggles with the realities of adulthood and the feeling of being a "has-been."

The series is split into two one-minute parts: The first has the theme "It's wrong to think that it's embarrassing to wear a condom."

Meanwhile, the theme of the second part is "It's a big problem to not be able to say 'Wear a condom.'"
anime.consensus_summary: The sequel is a welcome return, offering a new perspective while retaining familiar elements. However, the shorter format and lack of subtitles are drawbacks. Some viewers still prefer the original series, but overall, it's a worthwhile watch.
pros: Sequel to a surprisingly enjoyable series
Story has changed things up, offering a new learning experience
Animation and voice acting are decent and improved over the original
Return of all the characters
cons: Shorter episode count limits the writing
Characters are less impactful than before
Lack of subtitles and educational content
Some prefer the original

anime.title: Golden Kamuy Season 4
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Historical, Military, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
The race to obtain the lost Ainu gold is nearing its peak, as even more formidable ex-prisoners are set on keeping their tattooed skins intact. Saichi "The Immortal" Sugimoto and Asirpa can finally move forward together, but Asirpa's time with Kiroranke and Ogata Hyakunosuke has slightly altered her ambition and strengthened her determination. As their party leaves the Russian territory, they gain a peculiar follower.

Meanwhile, Toshizou Hijikata's crew makes major moves to get invaluable skins, falling into the poisonous trap of a dangerous convict. Although each group possesses a strong advantage over the others, even First Lieutenant Tokushirou Tsurumi—the most powerful and ruthless contender—cannot advance without Asirpa's help. However, his ominous plans for when they will inevitably meet remain a mystery.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Golden Kamuy Season 4 is mixed. While some appreciate the humor, character development, and overall progression toward the ending, others are critical of the new studio's handling of the plot and pacing. There's concern that the season feels disjointed and has lost some of the genuine qualities of previous seasons.
pros: Character development is praised, especially the old dogs like Hijikata and Tsurumi.
The season is considered funnier than ever, with many hilarious moments.
The series is moving towards a successful conclusion with every character getting screentime.
cons: New studio change has impacted the quality of the show.
The season retcons already established backstory.
The stories told in the season are a little short and disjointed.

anime.title: Fairies Album Season 3
anime.synopsis: This story told the experience between Tao Yao, Mo Ya and Childe Liu's tour in JingShi, which showed that the distance between human and human, human and fairy may not be as insurmountable as imagined. Whether the interaction between Tao Yao and Ding Sansi, or the guidance the Old Zhang told to Childe Liu about life-overstep and cooking skills, or the dilemma when Mo Ya faced Xi Nang, these let each of them acquire new growth. Meanwhile, Feng Wule, Chen Baishui and others also obtained their own redemption. It may be that the journey of life is influenced by each other in this way with all of its flavors.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves the season, praising the animation, music, and character development. Fans appreciate the episodic format and find the stories engaging, similar to fairy tales. There is a strong recommendation for viewers who enjoyed previous seasons or like short, episodic narratives.
pros: Improved animation quality with fluid and well-choreographed scenes.
Better OSTs that enhance immersion and cliffhangers.
Engaging episodic stories with character development, particularly for Liu Gongzi and Moya.
Enjoyable story structure akin to a book of fairy tales.
cons: Basic art style, although the animation compensates.
Limited character development for the main characters, with a focus on arc characters.

anime.title: Master of the Star Spring
anime.synopsis: Su Jiu, a useless young man, was hit by the divine stone "Xingyuan", from an ordinary student without any training qualifications, to become the new master of Xingyuan. The two super beauties of Wanjie, You Yihan and Shen Mengxue, also came to pursue "Xingyuan". The two of them borrowed strongly in the name of avoiding the enemy's family. In order to attract Su Jiu to enter their own sect, they temporarily reached an agreement to teach them together. Su Jiu practiced. Unexpectedly, Su Jiuxiu, who has "Xingyuan", has made rapid progress, far beyond the imagination of the two girls.
anime.consensus_summary: The donghua is considered 'trash tier' due to its low budget and generic plot. However, the underlying plot has some merit. The show relies on familiar cultivation tropes and harem elements, lacking originality.
cons: Low budget animation
Cheap character models
Short episode length
Simplistic plot
Unoriginal themes

anime.title: Bubble
anime.synopsis:
Five years ago, gravity-defying bubbles with mysterious powers rained down upon the earth. After a huge explosion of uncertain origin, Tokyo became ground zero, with the city being enclosed in a gigantic bubble. As a result of this "Bubble Fall" phenomenon, the metropolis that was once the capital of Japan drowned in a gravity-bending sea; the government declared it a prohibited zone, and the residents abandoned it.

Children orphaned by the Bubble Fall now squat illegally in Tokyo, partaking in dangerous parkour team battles across the city's dilapidated buildings. Hibiki—a talented ace in these games with the ability to jump between bubbles—claims he can hear sounds from the Tokyo Tower. Determined to uncover its mysteries, he sets off toward the source, but he falls into the waters below.

A strange girl, whom he later nicknames Uta, saves him. But little does Hibiki know that Uta's appearance in his life will reveal the secrets behind the disastrous event that changed their world forever.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is sharply divided between those who are mesmerized by the film's stunning visuals and incredible soundtrack, and those who find the story and characters severely lacking. While the production quality is almost universally praised, the narrative's incoherence and lack of character development leave a significant portion of viewers feeling disappointed and underwhelmed.
pros: Astounding visuals and animation, particularly the intricate character movement and design.
Incredible soundtrack and music, with Hiroyuki Sawano's score consistently praised.
Visually stunning and breathtaking world-building, with detailed and vibrant environments.
Parkour sequences are a highlight, described as dynamic, engaging, and a visual spectacle.
Praise for WIT Studio's animation quality and detail, setting a high standard.
cons: Incohesive, weak, or underdeveloped story and plot.
Lack of character development and emotional connection to characters.
Plot is nonsensical, full of unanswered questions, and relies on plot conveniences or 'magic'.
The narrative feels half-fulfilled, disappointing, or underwhelming despite high anticipation.
Forced or mediocre romance that doesn't feel natural or earned.

anime.title: Yowamushi Pedal: Limit Break
anime.synopsis:
Unable to achieve the desired results on the first and second days of the Inter-High competition, members of the Souhoku High Bicycle Racing Club use their frustration as motivation to perform better on the final day of the race. However, it is easier said than done as they are up against the overwhelming talent of Hakone Academy and the shrewd strategies of Kyoto Fushimi High.

Despite the challenge, Souhoku members are not disheartened by the obstacles that they need to overcome. After all, no matter what their opponents try, Souhoku will have the last laugh as long as they are the first to cross the finish line.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with 'Yowamushi Pedal: Limit Break,' criticizing its repetitive plot, excessive flashbacks, and slow pacing. Many feel that the season rehashes previous storylines and character arcs, leading to a sense of stagnation. While some appreciate the music, the overall consensus points to a decline in narrative quality and originality.
pros: Music is superb, especially the background music.
cons: Plot is a carbon copy of previous seasons with identical strategies.
Excessive flashbacks used as filler and disrupt the pacing.
Pacing is slow, with episodes covering very little distance.
Characters feel like rehashes of previous characters, lacking originality.
Midousuji's character has become less terrifying and more reasonable.

anime.title: Megaton Musashi Season 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Megaton-kyuu Musashi.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season has improved mecha fights and introduces compelling characters, but suffers from inconsistent animation quality and a rushed, unsatisfying final arc. The series is watchable for fans of the first season, but its production issues are noticeable. The audience is generally forgiving but acknowledges the flaws.
pros: New and relevant characters
Giant robot fights with fluid 3D action
Frantic music enhances mecha fights
cons: Average to bad 2D animation
Rushed final arc with missing explanations
Unnatural or out-of-place interactions due to production issues

anime.title: Face on Lie
anime.synopsis: Han Yuxi, a young woman who is insecure about her appearance, has tolerated criticism and abuse all her life. Devastated upon learning that her boyfriend has been cheating on her, she decides to take action and goes to a hospital to receive plastic surgery. There, she meets with plastic surgeon Ling Huantao, who wants to recreate the face of his vegetative wife who he is obsessed with. Huantao offers Yuxi the hope of living a better life, but a new face may not provide her with the happiness that she desperately desires.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Huang Yan" for its engaging plot, character development, and exploration of societal issues, though some find the animation style and unsubtle themes to be drawbacks. The show evokes strong emotions and is considered underrated by many viewers. Most agree that it is worth watching despite its flaws.
pros: Fantastic character development of the main character.
The story delivers messages about society and the illusions we draw for ourselves regarding materialistic desires.
Well-written story with ups and downs that sheds light on a lot.
Tense and nail-biting plot with consistent tone and foreshadowing.
cons: Animation style might not appeal to everyone.
Visuals are not the strongest point, with some awkwardness in character models and proportions.
Themes are a bit on the nose.

anime.title: The Magic Chef of Ice and Fire
anime.synopsis: Nian Bing is the son of a fire mage and an ice mage. After both of his parents were killed by the Ice Lord, Nian Bing received both of his parents' magic gems. When Nian Bing was trying to escape from the Ice Lord's followers, he managed to cast both fire and ice magic at the same time. An impossible feat for a mage. He fell from the cliff, unconscious, and was saved by an oldman. After he woke up, the oldman gave him a food so delicious he never tasted before. It turned out that the oldman was a genius chef, once called a spirit chef. And he wants Nian Bing to be his disciple no matter what! Is Nian Bing able to seek vengeance while aiming to become the greatest chef?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the main character to be weak and inconsistent, the story and pacing to be poor, and the sound design to be lacking. The animation is seen as decent, but not enough to compensate for the other flaws. Overall, the audience expresses strong disappointment.
pros: Decent animation
cons: Weak and inconsistent main character
Poor story and pacing
Bad background sounds
Stupid character designs

anime.title: Reign of the Seven Spellblades
anime.romaji_title: Nanatsu no Maken ga Shihai suru
anime.synopsis:
Impressed by Nanao Hibiya's skill with a sword, Kimberly Magic Academy instructor Theodore McFarlane saves the samurai from certain death amid a fierce battle. With his encouragement, Nanao enrolls in the academy, where she instantly becomes a celebrity after she and four of her peers save a student from an enraged troll. Under the leadership of Oliver Horn, a young man who seems to hide a troubled past, Nanao and her newfound friends start their magical apprenticeship at Kimberly—where only four out of five students make it to graduation in one piece.

It does not take long for Oliver and his friends to experience the dangers of the academy firsthand, as a near-death encounter in the labyrinth under the school leaves Nanao grappling with her bloody past. The inexperienced yet determined students must stick together if they want to have a chance to survive and uncover the mysteries that the academy holds.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some finding the anime enjoyable for its action and unique characters, while others criticize its rushed pacing, inconsistent tone, and reliance on tired tropes. Many feel the series has potential but suffers from poor execution and a lack of focus. The show struggles to balance dark themes with more lighthearted elements, leading to a disjointed narrative experience.
pros: Well-animated fight scenes with strategic elements.
Unique and varied characters that avoid being too cliche.
Good background music that complements the scenes.
Potential for a darker, more engaging story if future seasons delve deeper.
cons: Rushed pacing, especially in the initial episodes.
Underdeveloped main plot with disconnected story arcs.
Characters become friends too quickly, making relationships feel forced.
Inconsistent tone, oscillating between dark themes and slice-of-life moments.
Plot relies on overused fantasy tropes and lacks originality.
Main cast is too large, leading to shallow character development and sidelined characters.
Tell-not-show writing style and lack of verisimilitude.

anime.title: Butareba -The Story of a Man Who Turned into a Pig-
anime.romaji_title: Buta no Liver wa Kanetsu Shiro
anime.synopsis:
An arrogant scientist awakens in the middle of a muddy pigpen, and the last thing he remembers is eating a raw pig liver and collapsing in the subway. He quickly gathers that he has turned into a pig and is now in a strange fantasy land. As he struggles to grasp reality, a young girl named Jess comes to his aid. Jess happens to be a Yesma—a discriminated class of servants distinguished by their telepathic abilities and the silver collars around their necks. Despite his inappropriate thoughts about her, Jess makes sacrifices for his sake, and the pig resolves to repay her the best he can within the limits of his new body.

But Jess' generosity does not absolve her from the prejudice the Yesmas face daily, and the pig begins to suspect that Jess is in greater danger than she thinks. While he wants to visit the royal capital and beg the king to change him back into a human, the pig realizes that he cannot simply turn his back on his kind savior.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed but leans positive. While many were initially put off by the seemingly degenerate premise and inconsistent animation, many viewers found the story surprisingly deep, complex, and emotionally resonant. The strong character development and exploration of dark themes were praised, making it a worthwhile watch for those who can overlook the flaws.
pros: Surprisingly deep and complex story
Likeable and well-developed characters, especially the female MC
Good world-building and exploration of dark themes
Excellent voice acting performances
Unique premise that stands out from other isekais
cons: Inconsistent or poor animation quality, especially in action scenes
Tonal dissonance between lighthearted and dark elements
MC's perverted thoughts and meta-humor can be off-putting
Uneven pacing and abrupt story transitions
Initial perception of being a generic or ecchi isekai can deter viewers

anime.title: Migi & Dali
anime.synopsis:
Osamu and Youko Sonoyama want more than anything to adopt every child from Soramame House, but the wealthy couple can only pick one due to their increasingly old age. While they contemplate this delicate decision, one child's alluring beauty and gentle soul instantly draw them in. Two months later, the Sonoyamas welcome 13-year-old Hitori into their warm and loving home.

However, Hitori's humble and overly polite exterior is merely a masquerade. In reality, Hitori is a carefully crafted character played by identical twins Migi and Dali. For them, being the ideal child of this kind couple is merely a stepping stone to infiltrating a certain quiet town. While dutifully protecting their cover, the twins work toward their true objective: to discover the truth behind a past incident that left them with a burning desire for vengeance.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reaction to 'Migi to Dali' is largely positive, praising its originality, well-developed characters, and blend of humor and suspense. Some find the dark themes and fast pace challenging, but the overall consensus highlights its unique and memorable qualities. The series is recommended for viewers seeking something different, with a storyline that balances quirky comedy with a deeper, more complex narrative.
pros: Unique and original plot with unexpected twists
Well-developed characters, especially Migi and Dali, with complex relationships
Excellent balance of comedy, suspense, and emotional depth
Thought-provoking themes and symbolism
High-quality animation and voice acting
cons: Dark moments may be too intense for some viewers
Fast-paced plot can be confusing or difficult to follow
Initial episodes may be slow or boring for some viewers
Some plot points or themes may not be fully resolved due to brevity

anime.title: Raven of the Inner Palace
anime.synopsis:
Among the royal court, there is an individual feared as much as revered: the Raven Consort Ryuu Jusetsu. Residing in her jet-black palace and isolated from the emperor, she is the subject of countless rumors. Claimed to possess mystic abilities, she is said to take on any request—from finding lost items to inflicting curses. While some call her an immortal sage, others believe her to be a terrifying revenant. But such comments fail to faze Jusetsu, who prefers to spend her days in quiet solitude. That is, until the emperor, Ka Koushun, barges into her court and asks for her assistance with a mysterious case.

The young emperor's request requires Jusetsu to step out of her palace for the first time. Despite Ka Koushun's frequent visits annoying her to no end, she cannot bring herself to turn him away. Her predecessor's teachings echo in her ears: the Raven Consort is destined to remain forever alone and never desire anything. Yet Jusetsu finds herself making the first of several bonds when she asks Jiujiu, an innocently inquisitive court girl, to be her sole attendant.

Together, they begin fulfilling requests from the people of the palace. However, unknown perils lurk in the outside world, and drawing attention to herself may bring Jusetsu face-to-face with a past that is better left undisturbed.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Koukyuu no Karasu' for its unique setting, well-crafted mysteries, and strong female lead. While some find the episodic nature and slow pace to be drawbacks, most appreciate the character development and beautiful art style. The series is considered underrated, with many viewers hoping for a second season.
pros: Unique setting in ancient China with a focus on mythology.
Well-crafted mysteries that are not typical murder mysteries but focus on unraveling the truth behind events.
Strong female protagonist who grows and develops throughout the series.
Beautiful art style and character design that captures the spirit of a period drama.
Enchanting music that portrays soul
cons: Episodic nature of the show can lead to a hit-or-miss quality in the mysteries.
Romance elements are subtle and may disappoint viewers looking for a strong romantic plot.
Animation is considered low-budget by some viewers.
Some viewers may find the pace slow and boring due to its focus on character development and mysteries rather than action.

anime.title: The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes
anime.romaji_title: Natsu e no Tunnel, Sayonara no Deguchi
anime.synopsis:
Kaoru Touno's family is falling apart. After the death of a sibling and his parents' divorce, he no longer feels any peace at home. Following a heated confrontation with his father, Kaoru runs out of his house and finds himself before a mysterious tunnel, which pulls him in. Bewildered by what he sees inside, he rushes to the exit, picking up a bird that looks identical to his deceased pet on his way out.

Upon emerging outside, Kaoru realizes that, despite him spending just a few minutes inside the tunnel, an entire week has passed. The bizarre experience leads him to remember the rumors of "Urashima Tunnel"—a passage that grants wishes in exchange for one's lifespan. Given the resurrection of his pet bird, Kaoru cannot help but wonder if another visit can help fix his messed up life.

However, when he returns to the entrance of the mysterious tunnel, Kaoru realizes that he has been followed by Anzu Hanashiro, a new transfer student in his class. She also knows about the rumors and asks him to help her with an experiment—it turns out that she, too, has a wish that only the tunnel can grant.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers found the movie visually stunning and emotionally resonant, praising its themes and animation. However, many criticized the rushed pacing, shallow character development, and the significant deviations from the original light novel, leading to disappointment among fans of the source material. The movie is generally considered an enjoyable watch for those unfamiliar with the light novel, but a weaker adaptation.
pros: Beautiful animation and scenery, especially the tunnel's interior
Meaningful key messages about grief, regret, and living in the present
Engaging and committed characters, portrayed with depth
cons: Rushed pacing and abrupt scenes due to movie runtime limitations
Significant details and entire characters cut from the light novel
Weak character development and bland conversations
Predictable plot with cliche tropes

anime.title: Suzume
anime.synopsis:
On her way to school one day, Suzume Iwato stumbles upon Souta Munakata, a young man searching for abandoned areas. The high school girl directs Souta to a nearby ruin, but out of pure curiosity, she herself decides to head to the same destination.

Once there, Suzume discovers an isolated door with a dreamlike universe lying beyond it—a place that she can see and feel, but not enter. A strange stone rests on the ground nearby, but it turns into a cat-like creature and scurries away when Suzume lifts it. Suddenly afraid, she heads back toward her school, not realizing that her act of leaving the door open will have consequences.

With the "keystone" released, the evil within the other universe can now freely escape and wreak havoc throughout Japan. Intending to correct her dangerous mistake, Suzume joins Souta—whose true goal is to prevent evil from festering—in finding and locking all open doors before the country is destroyed.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Suzume no Tojimari is noticeably divided, primarily centering on its narrative and thematic execution. While there is widespread praise for its breathtaking visuals and sound design, many critics find the story to be derivative of Makoto Shinkai's previous works, suffering from pacing issues and underdeveloped plot points. The forced romance subplot is a significant point of contention, leading to a polarized view on its overall effectiveness.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation, with detailed backdrops and ethereal supernatural elements.
Impeccable sound design and SFX, contributing to the film's realism.
Great soundtrack by Radwimps that elevates certain scenes.
Captures the atmosphere and landscapes of various regions in Japan effectively.
Explores profound themes of loss, grief, remembrance, and coming to terms with tragedy, particularly in relation to the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake.
cons: The story is considered repetitive of Shinkai's previous works and lacks originality.
The plot can be confusing, with plot holes and a lack of explanation for supernatural occurrences.
The pacing feels rushed, with too much crammed into the runtime, leading to unsatisfying resolution.
The romance subplot is frequently criticized as forced, awkward, and underdeveloped, lacking chemistry.
Character development is shallow, with many side characters serving only as plot devices.
The film's reliance on Japanese mythology may be a barrier for international audiences.
Some CGI elements, like the worm, are criticized for looking unrefined.

anime.title: Aggretsuko (ONA) 5th Season
anime.synopsis:
The red panda accountant Retsuko and her hyena coworker, Haida, have finally started dating. Things seem to be looking up in Retsuko's life; however, Haida is now grappling with unemployment and an evolving gaming addiction. As Haida attempts to keep his struggles from his girlfriend, cracks begin to form in their relationship. Moreover, Haida is evicted from his apartment and seeks refuge in an internet cafe, where he meets his online friend, a skunk named Shikabane.

As the secrets Haida hides from Retsuko pile up, their romantic journey reaches a tumultuous climax while a major presidential election looms ahead. To make matters worse, one of the candidates takes a particular interest in Retsuko and her singing talent, complicating their already hectic lives.
anime.consensus_summary: The final season of Aggretsuko successfully revisited relatable societal issues and delivered strong character development, particularly for Haida. However, a significant portion of the audience found the late introduction of a political plotline jarring and poorly executed, which detracted from the otherwise satisfying conclusion for many. Despite this divisive element, the season is generally viewed as a solid, albeit imperfect, send-off that retained the show's signature humor and emotional depth.
pros: Excellent exploration of relatable societal issues like unemployment, financial struggles, and the meaning of work.
Strong character development, particularly for Haida, and Retsuko's continued growth and self-expression.
Sharp, awkward, and anxious comedy remains a core strength.
High-quality animation and music, with noticeable upgrades throughout the seasons.
Thought-provoking dialogue and profound insights into adult life and societal pressures.
cons: The introduction and execution of the political campaign plotline felt abrupt, out of place, and detracted from the core narrative for some viewers.
The season finale lacked a strong sense of closure for some, feeling rushed despite longer episodes.
The pacing of Retsuko and Haida's relationship progression felt underdeveloped, especially regarding their dating phase.
Some plot points, like attempted murder, were rushed or not fully explored.
The season felt like it strayed too far from the grounded, relatable core that defined earlier seasons.

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai 10
anime.synopsis: Tenth season of Yami Shibai.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the consistent delivery of horror shorts. The main critique is a missed opportunity with a particular story concept. Overall, it's considered enjoyable for fans of the genre, especially around Halloween.
pros: More horror shorts
Art and storytelling are consistent
Halloween fun
cons: Missed opportunity with '100th Story' concept
Some seasons feel more atmospheric than others
Some seasons having more gruesome art design than others

anime.title: Spy x Family Part 2
anime.genres: Action, Childcare, Comedy, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
With Anya Forger successfully enrolled at the renowned Eden Academy, Operation Strix advances to its second phase. To investigate Ostanian politician Donovan Desmond, Anya must either befriend his son Damian or collect eight Stella Stars to become an Imperial Scholar. Fortunately, Anya has already acquired her first star. In celebration, her adoptive father, Loid, decides to fulfill her wish to adopt a dog.

During their canine search, Loid receives new orders from his superiors, who have found that a band of Berlint University students is plotting to assassinate Westalis' Minister Brantz using bombs worn by trained dogs. While Loid tries to stop their plans, Anya stumbles upon the terrorists' base of operations. There, she befriends a kindhearted, clairvoyant dog who the family later names Bond.

Although the Forgers continue to lead their individual lives in secrecy, the family—with a new fluffy addition—remains united through all of the unusual obstacles thrown their way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Spy x Family Part 2 is mixed. While many appreciate the continued focus on family dynamics, character interactions, and animation quality, some find the plot stagnant and the comedy less impactful than the first part. Some felt the show became stale due to the slice-of-life format that overtook the main espionage storyline.
pros: Enjoyable family dynamics and character interactions.
Good animation and character designs.
Balances humor and heart effectively.
Slice of life moments
cons: Story feels less fresh and more repetitive compared to Part 1.
Plot progression stagnates, with the main conflict taking a backseat.
Comedy doesn't hit as well as in the first part for some viewers.
Lacks standout moments and feels more like filler at times.
Overhyped and disappointing to some viewers.

anime.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Go Rush!!
anime.synopsis:
After inheriting the company from their parents, siblings Yuuhi and Yuamu Oudou have started to work at the Alien Trouble Consultancy, an organization that hunts aliens. Although they have never encountered aliens before, Yuuhi is desperate to meet one as he believes that an alien has stolen his important item, called the "Earthdama".

One day, while searching for extraterrestrial creatures, Yuuhi and Yuamu find a strange spot in the forest where many trees have fallen, forming a scenery similar to a crop circle. As they venture further, they discover a mysterious spaceship and enter it out of curiosity. To their surprise, they come across Yuudias Velgear, an alien from the Velgear Star Cluster. As it turns out, Yuudias is seeking to learn about Rush Duel—a card game popular among elementary school students—as he believes that it will save his home from a long war.

With the siblings agreeing to teach Yuudias about Rush Duel, they eventually realize that their first contact with an alien may not be a random coincidence.
anime.consensus_summary: Yu-Gi-Oh! Go Rush!! is a divisive series with an ambitious but flawed execution. Some appreciate the unique alien themes, character development, and dueling, while others criticize the childish writing, weak plot cohesion, and poor comedy. The show seems to be a step up from Sevens, but still has issues holding it back.
pros: Ambitious plot with aliens and connections to previous series.
Good dueling quality.
Enjoyable characters with solid development, especially Yudias and the Ohdo twins.
Menacing and varied antagonists.
Shorter duels are more enjoyable.
cons: Childish writing with plot holes and logic holes.
Tutorial-heavy start.
Alien characters can be hard to relate to or understand.
Weak connections between characters.
Poor comedy.
Lack of focus on a clear end-goal makes the plot hard to follow.

anime.title: Tokyo Revengers: Christmas Showdown
anime.genres: Action, Delinquents, Drama, Shounen, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
In spite of his best time-leaping efforts, Takemichi Hanagaki continuously fails to prevent the present-day death of Hinata Tachibana, his adolescent love. The adult Takemichi grapples with grief and the ramifications of the Tokyo Manji gang's criminal empire—an unintended product of his timeline meddling. Though the gang once operated under the idealistic Manjirou "Mikey" Sano, it has now been taken over by the malicious Tetta Kisaki and, as a result, has abandoned its original optimistic intent.

Despite feeling hopeless, Takemichi travels to the past once again to investigate Black Dragon, a rival motorcycle gang whose actions ultimately lead to Hinata's demise. There, he meets the young Hakkai Shiba, a fellow gang member whose older brother, Taiju, tyrannically rules Black Dragon. When Taiju brutally beats Takemichi in a one-sided street brawl, Hakkai attempts to withdraw from Tokyo Manji in apology—an act that Takemichi must prevent to spare Hakkai a grim future.

Through a shared tragedy, Takemichi bonds with Chifuyu Matsuno, establishing a close comradery both boys desperately need. With Chifuyu on his side, Takemichi works to unravel the fates of Black Dragon's members, fighting to create a happy future for his loved ones.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Tokyo Revengers: Seiya Kessen-hen is mixed, with many finding it a significant step down from the first season. Common complaints include a frustratingly weak protagonist, repetitive plotlines, and poor pacing. While some appreciate the character backstories and cliffhangers, the overall consensus leans towards disappointment.
pros: Engaging cliffhangers.
Good background music.
Some character backstories are well-explained.
cons: Repetitive plot structure.
Main character is annoying and lacks development.
Plot twists are poorly explained.
Pacing is slow and stretched out.
Animation quality is inconsistent.

anime.title: Dr. Stone: Ryusui
anime.synopsis:
Now that brains and brawns have united forces, the next step in Senkuu's plan to unravel the mystery behind the green light that once petrified humanity is to go to the other side of the Earth and investigate its origin. However, to achieve this, Senkuu must first build a ship.

With the help of Tsukasa Shishiou's former underlings, the base of the ship is rapidly assembled, but there is one missing piece: a skilled captain. During their search, Senkuu and his crew come across a petrified Ryuusui Nanami—the heir of the biggest maritime conglomerate, known for his vast knowledge of sailboats but unpleasant personality. Despite this, Senkuu takes the risk and revives Ryuusui.

Ryuusui, upon realizing there are no ownership rights in this new civilization, is excited at the prospect of claiming everything for himself. But before he agrees to play a crucial part in their upcoming journey and command the vessel through the restless seas, he and Senkuu must find the king of fuels to power the ship—oil.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Dr. Stone: Ryuusui' special is largely well-received, acting as a bridge between seasons and re-engaging viewers with its charming story and fun science elements. Ryuusui's character is a highlight for many, though some find him one-dimensional. The special successfully maintains the established Dr. Stone feel and generates excitement for the upcoming season.
pros: Charming and fun story
Fantastic art and animation quality
Ryuusui's character design and VA are well-received
Serves as a good bridge between seasons
Good mix of humor and serious work
cons: No real threat in the story
Some consider Ryuusui one-dimensional
Pacing may be too fast or skip steps
Mediocre action compared to science focus

anime.title: Rurouni Kenshin
anime.synopsis:
In the late 19th century, as the cruel times of the Bakumatsu period came to a close, a new Meiji era marked the age of restoration for Japan. With the war over, its infamous hero Hitokiri Battousai disappeared into thin air, leaving only his legend behind.

Years later, a seemingly plain wanderer named Kenshin Himura encounters Kaoru Kamiya, the owner of a struggling local dojo in Tokyo. Kaoru pursues a self-proclaimed Battousai who roams the streets, indiscriminately killing citizens and police officers. Furthermore, the warrior professes to use the Kamiya Kasshin-ryu—a sword style developed by Kaoru's father deeply rooted in the essence of life, not death.

Kenshin decides to help Kaoru take down the impostor and restore her father's dojo. Unbeknownst to all, Kenshin is none other than the real warrior whose name still terrifies the people. Although Kaoru eventually learns the truth, his oath to atone for his murderous history by bloodlessly protecting the weak moves her, and she welcomes Kenshin to stay at her dojo. However, Kenshin's ideals are soon challenged by ghosts of the past and enemies of the present.
anime.consensus_summary: The Rurouni Kenshin remake is a decent, but not outstanding, adaptation that generally pleases both new and old fans. It is praised for its faithfulness to the source material and strong voice acting, but criticized for its animation quality, uninspired music, and lack of emotional depth. The series suffers from comparisons to the original, with many feeling that it does not live up to the nostalgia or artistic merits of the 90s anime.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga source material.
Good voice acting, especially for Kenshin.
Enjoyable for both newcomers and longtime fans.
Updated visuals capture the essence of the original while modernizing it.
cons: Animation quality is not consistently engrossing or dynamic; lacks the resources of studios like MAPPA or Ghibli.
Background music is forgettable compared to the original soundtrack.
Some villains are one-dimensional.
Plot can meander, with some arcs feeling like a rehash of earlier material.
The art style is bland compared to the original series.
Lacks emotional depth.

anime.title: Komi Can't Communicate Season 2
anime.synopsis:
After an exciting and momentous cultural festival, Shouko Komi continues her endeavor to make one hundred friends alongside her friend and classmate Hitohito Tadano. As winter begins, the class is joined by the seemingly delinquent student Makoto Katai, who has been absent since the first week of school. Despite his intimidating appearance, Katai has difficulty communicating with others and just wants to befriend his classmates.

As new friendships form and current ones deepen, Komi and Tadano’s relationship begins to change—though not necessarily for the worse.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some praising the show's heartwarming exploration of social anxiety and character growth, while others criticize its repetitive humor, shallow characters, and slow-paced romance. The second season is considered a disappointment by some compared to the first. There are complaints about the animation quality declining in later episodes.
pros: Animation is stunning with vibrant colors and expressive character designs.
Komi's character development is genuinely inspiring; her progress from a silent, isolated student to a confident, expressive individual is noteworthy.
The show tackles complex themes like communication disorders, empathy, and self-acceptance with remarkable sensitivity.
cons: The show suffers from unfunny comedy and too much repetition.
The characters are shallow and some are downright annoying.
The anime is annoyingly dragging itself as a romance, and falling apart.
Animation declines after episode 9
anime.thematic_vibe: Slice of Life, Social Anxiety, Friendship

anime.title: Jiandao Di Yi Xian
anime.synopsis: In his previous life, the protagonist Su Yi was the respected XuanJun Sword Master in Dahuang. In order to pursue supreme swordsmanship, he chose to reincarnate and retrain. After reincarnation, Su Yi's new identity is the servant of the Su family in zhou Yujing's kingdom. But, he bravely ran away from home at the age of fourteen and went to Qinghe Sword House to practice. Never thought that three years later, when Su Yi would become the core disciple of Qinghe Sword House, he suddenly lost his cultivation level overnight and became a paralyzed person, thus becoming an abandoned disciple of Qinghe Sword House. Su Yi, who fell into a slump, was forced to accept the Su family's power arrangement and became the son-in-law of the Wen family, one of the three major clans in the remote town. His wife, Wen Lingzhao, is the most beautiful woman in Guangling City. She rejected this marriage in her heart, never admitted that Su Yi was her husband, and desperately wanted to dissolve the marriage. As for Su Yi, one year after he became a son-in-law, he evoked memories of his past life, and finally realized that in his past life, he was the famous Xuanjun Sword Master. in Dahuang Jiuzhou! Su Yi embarked on the road to rise. Like his wife Wen Lingzhao, he also wanted to dissolve the marriage. Moreover, in order to know the truth of his mother's death, he began to fight with the power of the Su family. When these grievances are resolved, Su Yi will return to Dahuang Jiuzhou to find the disciples who betrayed him one by one and end his grievances.‎
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is somewhat engaged with the anime due to its familiar 'reincarnation and revenge' theme, but also feels that the story is underdeveloped and confusing. Many feel that it has potential, but needs more episodes and better plot development. There is an overall desire for a deeper exploration of the world and cultivation system.
pros: Protagonist is overpowered and starts his comeback.
Similar feel to 'Wushen Zhuzai' (The god of war dominates).
cons: Story starts abruptly and skips plot points, leaving the viewer in the dark.
Cultivation system is not described clearly.
Feels underdeveloped for only 20 episodes; more episodes are desired.

anime.title: Pulling Mountains and Rivers
anime.synopsis:
The story tells that Prince Tang, the son of the East, was born at an untimely time, and the country was ruined. With his wet nurse living in a border town, the wet nurse has been raising the prince quietly, and hoped that he could take up the task of restoring the country in the future. The name of family and country feelings: Xizitang. In the blink of an eye, Xizitang was eight years old, and was sent to Chuiyun Mountain by his wet nurse to practice. 

After practicing for ten years, I finally broke through the martial world and stepped into the fairyland with the hammer of the god of martial arts left by my ancestors, and with the momentum of a newborn calf that is not afraid of tigers, I vowed to hang the Eight Immortals and smash the Penglai Liberation Four. The continent is at peace. There are immortal cultivators all over the four continents, and Xi Zitang is just a younger brother. Under the identification of the town's immortal list, he received the certificate of Fanxian's inferior, but in today's Datang, even the job requirements for food delivery are Fanxian. Wait, how can this be good? After accumulating buffs for ten years, how will Xi Zitang, who has just entered the arena, set off a bloody storm in the arena?
anime.consensus_summary: The show started with promise, drawing viewers in with its poster and initial plot. However, the execution failed to deliver, particularly with a main character who is perceived as unintelligent and inactive. The series is considered a disappointment, not living up to its potential.
cons: Main character is strong but dumb
Main character barely does anything
Plot does not live up to the initial potential

anime.title: Muv-Luv Alternative 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
Thanks to Professor Yuuko Kouzuki's technology and Kasumi Yashiro's psychic powers, Cadet Takeru Shirogane travels back to his original world. With no time to lose, Takeru aims to enlist Yuuko's help in his world to complete the Alternative IV project—the last hope humanity has against the BETA, an alien species invading the planet. As the anti-BETA project nears completion, Takeru and other cadets graduate from the Yokohama pilot training academy.

However, during a test of the new operating system for the Tactical Surface Fighters—the giant combat suits used by humanity against their adversary—the BETA ambush Takeru and his team. Barely escaping with his life, Takeru is left traumatized after witnessing the cruel death of one of his close friends.

Losing his will to fight, Takeru flees back to the other world, where he experiences a similar tragedy. According to Yuuko's theory, people from parallel universes are bound to suffer the same fate. As a result, Takeru must overcome his trauma if he wants to protect the ones he holds dear.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with visual novel fans having stronger opinions. Many appreciate the mecha action, sound design and the adaptation of certain arcs like Sadogashima. However, the anime's reliance on prior VN knowledge and perceived rushing of key plot points are points of contention, leading to a somewhat polarized, but overall positive, sentiment.
pros: Phenomenal mecha animation and sound mixing.
Well-paced adaptation, especially the Sadogashima arc.
Plot is top-notch with great surprises and emotional impact.
cons: Requires prior VN knowledge (Extra/Unlimited).
Rushed adaptation of important VN parts (chapter 7).
Stale and lifeless character designs and color palettes.

anime.title: Endo and Kobayashi Live! The Latest on Tsundere Villainess Lieselotte
anime.romaji_title: Tsundere Akuyaku Reijou Liselotte to Jikkyou no Endou-kun to Kaisetsu no Kobayashi-san
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Video Game, Villainess
anime.synopsis:
Broadcasting club member Shihono Kobayashi always gushes to her friend Aoto Endou about MagiKoi, an otome game where protagonist Fiene attends the Royal Academy of Magic. But despite the colorful cast, the one character Kobayashi is most obsessed with is the villainess Lieselotte Riefenstahl. Contrary to her rude remarks toward Fiene, Lieselotte longs to be her friend. Lieselotte is also deeply in love with her own fiancé, Prince Siegwald Fitzenhagen—the game's main love interest. Unfortunately, in almost every route, Lieselotte is doomed to a tragic end.

Kobayashi manages to convince Endou to play MagiKoi to practice his speaking skills. What begins as a normal playthrough turns extraordinary when Siegwald suddenly hears the players' voices inside the game! Now labeled as "gods," Endou and Kobayashi use their comments and analyses to save their beloved tsundere villainess from her fated demise.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys the unique premise and characters of 'Tsundere Akuyaku Reijou Liselotte,' finding it a fun and entertaining watch. While the animation quality and later plot developments receive criticism, the show is generally well-received for its comedic and romantic elements.  Many viewers appreciate the meta-commentary aspect and the fresh take on the isekai/otome genre, making it a worthwhile experience despite its flaws. The ending is divisive, with some feeling it detracts from the overall enjoyment.
pros: Unique premise with real-world commentators influencing the game world.
Likeable and well-developed characters, especially Lieselotte and the main couple.
Good balance of comedy, romance, and drama.
Refreshing take on the villainess trope.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with some janky or underwhelming scenes.
Plot may become dragged out and lose quality in the later episodes.
Repetitive jokes and overused tsundere tropes can become annoying.
Unresolved or poorly handled relationship development between the real-world couple.

anime.title: Pop Team Epic Season 2
anime.synopsis: High school girl duo Popuko and Pipimi are back and more unhinged than ever after their initial efforts to create a full-fledged anime production were met with a great reception. With no regard for their audience, they continue to live their reckless everyday lives consisting of comedy skits and parodies of epic proportions. No one is immune to the effects of their antics—including hapless live actor Shouta Aoi, who is on the run and stuck trying to be a hero in the wrong series.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Pop Team Epic continues its tradition of chaotic and absurdist humor, with a strong emphasis on variety and meta-commentary. While some find the pacing rushed or the jokes hit-or-miss, the show's willingness to experiment and push boundaries is widely appreciated. The audience generally enjoys the bizarre and unpredictable nature of the series.
pros: Variety of animation styles keeps the show fresh and unpredictable.
The show doesn't hesitate to go to extremes, creating memorable and shocking moments.
Guest animation and anthology format allows for diverse storytelling within the Pop Team Epic universe.
cons: Some jokes don't translate well to animation, working better in the original 4-koma format.
Pacing can feel too fast at times, making some episodes feel rushed.
Quality may vary depending on the specific skits and animation styles, so not every segment lands equally well.

anime.title: The Faraway Paladin: The Lord of the Rust Mountains
anime.romaji_title: Saihate no Paladin: Tetsusabi no Yama no Ou
anime.synopsis: Second season of Saihate no Paladin.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Saihate no Paladin: Tetsusabi no Yama no Ou is mixed.
