While some appreciate the improved animation and adventure elements, many find the plot generic, the characters lacking depth, and the storytelling underwhelming compared to the source material. There's a sense of disappointment that the series didn't live up to its potential, with some calling it a generic isekai.
pros: Improved animation and action scenes compared to season 1
Solid world-building with Tolkien references
Enjoyable adventure story with a classic quest structure
Pacing is much better in the second season
cons: Generic and predictable plot, especially the dwarves/dragon arc
Characters lack depth and strong personality traits
Underwhelming storytelling and poor directing fail to capture emotional depth
Mediocre or ill-fitting OST
Some found Will's character becoming less human and more of a plot device

anime.title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Behind the Line
anime.romaji_title: Soukyuu no Fafner: Dead Aggressor - Behind the Line
anime.synopsis: Taking place after the events of Heaven and Earth and before Exodus, Behind the Line depicts the moments of boys and girls after Soushi Minashiro returned home.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is that 'Behind the Line' is a worthwhile addition to the Fafner franchise, serving as a bridge between major story arcs. While not a stand-alone experience due to its lack of Festum action, it is valued for its character development and lore expansion, setting the stage for future installments. It's recommended for those invested in the broader Fafner narrative.
pros: Character development of original Fafner pilots
Provides time to breathe between intense arcs
Positions characters and lore for future installments
cons: Not a stand-alone project
Very little focus on Festum

anime.title: AMAIM Warrior at the Borderline Part 2
anime.synopsis: Second part of Kyoukai Senki.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with significant criticisms regarding pacing, character development, and thematic execution. While some appreciate the improved character arcs and resolution in Part 2, many find the story shallow and the political elements unengaging. The series is seen by some as a mediocre marketing ploy, failing to deliver a compelling narrative.
pros: Improvements in Amou's character development.
Decent resolution to the Part 1 setup.
Some character dynamics, like Shion and Nayuta, are enjoyable.
The last 2 episodes bring some kind of redemption.
cons: Slow pacing and unlikeable characters in Part 1.
Watered-down war story with a lack of depth.
Undeveloped character motivations until the very end.
Elementary story and politics.
Childish portrayal of death and war clashing with political intrigue.
Boring political scheming.
Forgettable music.

anime.title: KAGI-NADO
anime.synopsis:
Although it is a miracle that Kaginado Academy remains standing, Yuri Nakamura and her cohorts vow to retaliate against the god that created their universe. Pointing out its many absurdities, she proposes that the academy is actually a stand-in for the afterlife.

Yuri's theory makes everyone restless; some begin questioning and even second-guessing their own memories. However, not all agree with the notion, defending the fact that their current existence is a result of their past rather than the interference of an omniscient being. Life at Kaginado Academy continues to be frenetic—despite how much the students want it to be otherwise!
anime.consensus_summary: Kaginado Season 2 is a love letter to Key fans, filled with inside jokes and meta-humor that rewards those familiar with the company's extensive catalog. While the chibi art style and reliance on prior knowledge may deter some viewers, the series generally succeeds in delivering a lighthearted and comedic experience. Most criticisms are directed at the necessity of being familiar with the original works for maximum enjoyment and some specific creative choices.
pros: Nostalgic value for Key fans
Funny interactions between characters from different series
Effective use of audio and music for comedic effect
cons: Requires extensive knowledge of Key franchises to fully enjoy
Chibi art style may not appeal to all viewers
Angel Beats inclusion and jokes were not well-received by some

anime.title: Summer Pockets
anime.synopsis:
Far from the city's noise lies Torishirojima—a quaint and peaceful island where time seems to move slowly. Hairi Takahara, a young boy nursing a wounded heart, uses the recent death of his grandmother as a quiet reason to leave the city for a summer retreat to Torishirojima.

Upon reaching the island, Hairi finds himself surrounded by a refreshing, laid-back atmosphere, a far cry from the hustle and bustle he is used to. After moving in with his aunt, Kyouko Misaki, he prepares to spend the summer helping her sort through a shed full of artifacts his grandmother collected over the years alongside his cousin, Umi Katou, who is staying with them.

While adjusting to the island's slower pace, Hairi decides to spend his free time exploring. He soon meets the cheerful Tsumugi Wenders; the antisocial Shiroha Naruse; the wandering Kamome Kushima; and the sharp-tongued Ao Sorakado. Drawn into their lives and the island's subtle mysteries, Hairi is gradually swept up in a summer filled with fun, nostalgia, and life-changing moments that will stay with him forever.
anime.consensus_summary: Summer Pockets evokes strong emotional responses and nostalgia, typical of Key visual novel adaptations, but it suffers from pacing issues and a confusing plot. Some find the initial episodes slow and the transitions between character routes abrupt, leading to a disjointed viewing experience. However, the emotional payoff and well-developed characters resonate with many, making it a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre despite its flaws.
pros: Emotional and impactful storytelling.
Well-developed characters with engaging backstories.
Excellent music that enhances the emotional experience.
cons: Slow pacing in early episodes.
Confusing plot with time travel elements.
Rushed romantic parts and route transitions.
Incomplete explanations of mysteries and characters.
Derivative of earlier Key works

anime.title: MF Ghost
anime.synopsis:
As electric vehicles dominate everyday life in the 2020s, interest in traditional combustion engine cars is maintained through a motorsports series known as the MFG. Hundreds of ambitious drivers, with a staggering 30 million viewers online, fiercely compete for a spot in the Godly Fifteen—the leading 15 racers—and a chance at the grand prize of 100 million yen. Among these individuals aiming for the top is 19-year-old Kanata Rivington.

Having attended a famous racing school in England, Kanata sets his sights on the upcoming MFG tournament and enrolls in the competition under the alias "Kanata Katagiri." In comparison to his opponents' flashy vehicles, Kanata's Toyota 86 GT, passed down from a former MFG contestant, puts him at a considerable disadvantage. Kanata receives guidance from a Godly Fifteen member, but he still treats the MFG as only a stepping stone for his true goal: locating his estranged father. Meanwhile, Kanata's appearance sends shockwaves through the scene as his driving style eerily resembles that of a once legendary racer.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling disappointed due to its failure to live up to Initial D's legacy. While some appreciate the nostalgic elements and racing visuals, the unoriginal plot, weak characters, and excessive fan service are major drawbacks. Many feel it relies too heavily on Initial D and fails to stand on its own.
pros: CGI animation during races is phenomenal
Eurobeat music enhances the racing scenes
Nostalgic value for Initial D fans
cons: Poorly written characters with little depth
Unoriginal plot with heavy reliance on Initial D references
Unrealistic racing scenarios and car performance
Excessive and unnecessary fan service
Boring romance and filler content that interrupts the races

anime.title: Lycoris Recoil
anime.synopsis:
The number of terrorist acts in Japan has never been lower, thanks to the efforts of a syndicate called Direct Attack (DA). The organization raises orphaned girls as killers to carry out assassinations under their "Lycoris" program. Takina Inoue is an exceptional Lycoris with a strong sense of purpose and a penchant for perfection. Unfortunately, a hostage situation tests her patience, and the resulting act of insubordination leads to her transfer out of DA. Not thrilled about losing the only place she belonged to, she reluctantly arrives at her new base of operations—LycoReco, a cafe in disguise.

Takina's new partner, however, turns out to be quite different from what she imagined. Despite being the famed Lycoris prodigy, Chisato Nishikigi appears almost unconcerned with her duties. She drags Takina along on all kinds of odd jobs under the simple explanation of helping people in need. Takina is even more puzzled when Chisato takes down a group of armed assailants without killing any of them. Feeling like a fish out of water, Takina itches to get reinstated into DA—but Chisato is determined to prove to her that there is more to a life than just taking them.
anime.consensus_summary: Lycoris Recoil is a visually appealing anime with endearing characters, particularly the dynamic between Chisato and Takina.  While praised for its animation and character interactions, the plot is often criticized for being weak and relying on overused tropes.  The show's success hinges on its ability to create emotional connections with viewers despite its narrative shortcomings, resulting in a somewhat polarized but overall positive reception.
pros: Strong character interactions and development, especially between Chisato and Takina.
High-quality animation, art style, and character designs.
Successful balance between slice-of-life elements and tense action sequences.
Music complements the show well, enhancing both calm and serious moments.
cons: Weak or generic plot, especially in the latter half of the series.
Antagonists with shallow motivations.
Illogical or plot-convenient scenarios that undermine tension.
Over-reliance on 'cute girls doing cute things' trope at the expense of serious narrative.

anime.title: Urusei Yatsura
anime.synopsis:
When aliens known as the Oni threaten to invade the Earth, they promise to leave under one condition—a randomly-chosen human must win a one-on-one game of tag against Lum, the beautiful daughter of the Oni leader. The "lucky" person selected happens to be the lustful and unlucky high schooler Ataru Moroboshi. Given 10 days to attempt to grab Lum's horns, Ataru realizes how impossible the challenge is as he is faced with Lum's extraterrestrial powers.

Motivated by a promise of marriage from his childhood friend Shinobu Miyake, Ataru manages to catch Lum off guard. He mistakenly grabs hold of her bikini top first, but he eventually achieves his true goal. Although the game is over, Lum misunderstands that she is the one whom Ataru wants to marry, and she decides to move in with him. The poor student constantly tries to shake off the clingy Lum while doing his best to reconcile with his desired fiancée. After Ataru's heroic feat results in such a disastrous outcome, it is questionable whether luck will ever be on his side.
anime.consensus_summary: The Urusei Yatsura (2022) remake is a visually appealing and mostly faithful adaptation of the classic manga and anime. While many appreciate the modernized animation and nostalgic charm, some find the humor and characters outdated or repetitive. The show is generally well-received, but divided on the lasting appeal of older tropes.
pros: Modernized animation and art style are visually appealing and accessible to new viewers.
Faithful adaptation of Rumiko Takahashi's original work, capturing its charm and humor.
Catchy opening and ending themes enhance the viewing experience.
Well-done voice acting (especially in the subbed version) and sound design.
Successfully revitalizes a classic anime for a new generation.
cons: Repetitive situations and gags can become boring over time.
Some jokes and plot points have not aged well, feeling outdated to some viewers.
Ataru's character is unlikeable to some viewers, negatively impacting their enjoyment.
Pacing can be slow, with a lack of overarching plot development.
Comedy is subjective and may not resonate with all viewers.

anime.title: The Irregular at Magic High School Season 3
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Romance, School, Sci-Fi, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Driven by conflicting interest groups, the anti-magic movement is gaining dangerous momentum. Warned by the Yotsuba family, Tatsuya Shiba takes countermeasures to foil the plans of crooked politicians and corrupt journalists. He repels the first attack, which framed First High School as an unofficial venue for military education, but his most formidable enemies have yet to act. If Tatsuya wants to preserve his peaceful life with his sister, Miyuki, he must demonstrate once more that no one in the world can outsmart him.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards the third season of Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei is mixed. While some appreciate the world-building, political intrigue, and improved pacing, many find the season weaker than its predecessors. Common criticisms include pacing issues, a lack of exciting fights, generic plot elements, and uneven character development, leading to disappointment for some long-time fans.
pros: Detailed world-building and complex magical system.
Improved pacing compared to previous seasons (though some disagree).
Strong narrative flow and informative story building.
Good animation quality, especially in action scenes (at times).
Well-developed character relationships (at times).
Excellent music and opening/ending themes.
cons: Pacing issues: felt rushed or disjointed.
Boring or predictable fights with a lack of suspense.
Weak plot progression and anticlimactic moments.
Excessive focus on dialogue over action.
Uneven character development.
Inconsistent animation quality, including overuse of CGI.
Story felt generic and slow, lacking tension and high stakes.
Unlikable or underdeveloped new characters.
Too many cut content
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Power Fantasy, Ethical Dilemmas

anime.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level Max ni Nattemashita: Sono Ni
anime.synopsis: Three hundred years ago, the newly reincarnated Azusa Aizawa had resolved to live a slow life forever. At that point, she would have never even thought of reaching level 99 through only killing slimes, let alone becoming the strongest being in the continent. Nevertheless, it is due to her strength and kindness that many girls from different backgrounds—including the dragon Laika, the elf Halkara, the demon queen Pecora, and even the anthropomorphized slime girls Falfa and Shalsha—are all drawn to her. With her ever-growing circle of companions, Azusa's laid-back adventures are far from over—and with even more girls appearing on her doorstep, her already enjoyable life is slated to become even livelier!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many feeling that Season 2 fails to live up to the standards set by Season 1. While some appreciate the show's relaxing and feel-good nature, others criticize the lack of plot, disjointed episodes, and the introduction of too many new characters at the expense of developing the main cast. Many found the season to be mediocre and forgettable.
pros: Relaxing and easy to watch
Wholesome and feel-good
Charismatic characters
cons: Lack of overarching plot
Episodic and disjointed
Too many new characters, neglecting the main cast
Inconsistent writing quality compared to Season 1
Forgettable episodes

anime.title: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
anime.romaji_title: Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken
anime.synopsis:
Mahiru Shiina is worthy of her nickname "Angel": she is a divine beauty loved by all, and she excels in both academics and athletics. Shiina lives in an entirely different world from Amane Fujimiya, her next-door neighbor. Despite living so close together, they have never spoken once. But their silence is broken when Fujimiya spots Shiina gloomily sitting on a swing amidst a heavy rainstorm and lends her his umbrella. 

When Fujimiya catches a cold the next day, Shiina wishes to return the favor for the umbrella by nursing him back to health. Believing that this would be their first and last interaction, he silently appreciates her kindness. However, Shiina—who cannot help but worry about Fujimiya's lack of tidiness and proper nutrition—begins to cook and clean for him. As the unlikely pair spend time together in Fujimiya's apartment, they explore the true nature of their relationship and the gentle emotions that emerge from it.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some viewers find the anime to be a sweet and wholesome romance with appealing characters, others criticize it for being generic, bland, and poorly produced. The slow pacing and lack of conflict also contribute to the mixed reception, with many agreeing that the series is predictable and doesn't offer anything particularly unique.
pros: Cute and heartwarming interactions between the main characters.
Well-written relationship development, especially in the first half.
Mahiru is an appealing female lead.
Relaxing and enjoyable to watch.
cons: Generic and predictable plot.
Bland and uninteresting main character (Amane).
Poor animation quality and limited backgrounds.
Story stagnates in the second half.
Unrealistic premise and contrived situations.
Lacks depth and drama.

anime.title: Teppen—!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Laughing 'til You Cry
anime.synopsis:
The Teppen Grand Prix is a competition established out of an appreciation for stand-up comedy. As devoted fans of such performances, Yayoi Sakamoto and her two friends—Yomogi Takahashi and Yuzu Hosono—form the stand-up trio Young Wai-Wai. After qualifying for the final round in the prix, the three go up against other comedic trios, but only one group can emerge victorious.

With participants housed in a famous dorm where many comedians before them have lodged, the contestants' time living at the establishment will give them a chance to prove they have what it takes to make their audience laugh until they cry!
anime.consensus_summary: Teppen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! is a divisive comedy anime that leans heavily on Japanese cultural references and Gen Z humor, making it inaccessible to some viewers. While praised for its animation, voice acting, and creative opening, many find the humor inconsistent and the plot underdeveloped. The show is best enjoyed by those familiar with Japanese comedy and culture, but its niche appeal limits its overall reception.
pros: Unique and varied characters with memorable traits.
Creative and well-animated OP with a catchy song.
Show exceeded expectations in animation, voice acting, and script density.
The show has soul and personality and clearly had effort put into it.
cons: Comedy is heavily Japanese-centric and relies on cultural knowledge, making it difficult for Western audiences to understand.
Some jokes don't land, and references can be outdated.
Actual manzai scenes are often the weakest parts.
The main plot is sidelined, and the show's comedy, the main focus, is not consistently funny.
anime.thematic_vibe: Wacky, Gen Z Humor, Japanese Culture

anime.title: Insomniacs After School
anime.synopsis:
High schooler Ganta Nakami has trouble falling asleep most nights. As a result, he is irritable at school, always searching for an opportunity to find a secluded place to doze off. On the other hand, Isaki Magari is a free spirit who is well liked by her friends, but no one is aware of her sleep disorder. She makes use of the school's abandoned astronomy club observatory as her secret sleeping bunker when she needs to get some shut-eye. 

As fate would have it, Nakami finds Magari napping in the observatory. When Magari discovers that she and Nakami have something in common, she offers to share her secret sleeping spot with her fellow insomniac. As the two find warmth in each other's company, the struggles they face start to become easier to confront.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's realistic and wholesome portrayal of romance and mental health. Viewers appreciate the mature handling of the characters and their relationships, finding it a refreshing departure from typical anime tropes. Some find the pacing slow but overall the show is considered a comforting and beautiful experience.
pros: Realistic portrayal of adolescent struggles and mental health issues like insomnia.
Gentle and quiet approach to romance, focusing on genuine connection and understanding.
Beautiful animation and sound design, creating a nostalgic and immersive atmosphere.
Mature handling of situations, avoiding overused romance tropes.
cons: Some viewers may find the pacing slow or the story uneventful.
Limited exploration of side characters and their backgrounds.

anime.title: Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki 2nd Stage
anime.synopsis:
Fumiya Tomozaki is now cruising through the game of life—all thanks to the guidance of Aoi Hinami, his popular classmate and rival in the online game Attack Families, widely known as "Tackfam." As the summer holiday draws to a close and a new term commences, Tomozaki reunites with Aoi, who reminds him of his ultimate goals: to become well-liked among his peers and find himself a girlfriend.

However, Tomozaki puts his ambitions on hold when his innocent friend, Hanabi Natsubayashi, starts being bullied. To make matters worse, Aoi is characteristically out of touch with the situation. But Tomozaki is not alone in resolving this issue—he now has a group of loyal friends who are all determined to help Hanabi and ensure they enjoy their youths together to the fullest.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Jaku-Chara Tomozaki-kun 2nd Stage is mixed. While many appreciate the continued focus on character development and social dynamics, others find the plot rushed and lacking depth compared to the first season or the light novel source material. The shift in focus and the handling of certain characters, particularly Hinami, have also drawn criticism, leading to a somewhat polarized, but ultimately mild, reaction.
pros: Strong character interactions and relationships
Exploration of fitting in and personal growth
Well-developed characters with distinct personalities
cons: Rushed plot and lack of depth compared to the source material
Uneven pacing, especially in the second half
Hinami's character feels underdeveloped and inconsistent
Repetitive or boring dialogue in some episodes
Shift in focus from Tomozaki to other characters may disappoint some viewers

anime.title: Handyman Saitou in Another World
anime.synopsis:
Despite being a handyman with a wide range of skills, Saitou is severely undervalued and underpaid. When he complains, his boss fires him, claiming that he is easily replaceable. As if his luck was not bad enough, Saitou soon finds himself about to be run over by a truck on his way home.

Surprisingly enough, Saitou does not die; instead, he is transported to another world. There, he meets a party composed of the female knight Raelza, the moonlight fairy Lafanpan, and the mage Morlock, who are all coincidentally looking to recruit a new member with a skill set like Saitou's.

Throughout their time together, Saitou uses his expertise to assist his fellow party members and soon comes to receive the recognition he never thought was possible. However, Saitou's presence may just be the catalyst that will connect a diverse cast of people from different places, slowly uncovering the fate that could bring a great change to this world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed 'Benriya Saitou-san, Isekai ni Iku' as a refreshing and comedic take on the Isekai genre, appreciating its focus on an average protagonist and unique storytelling. However, some found the narrative structure disjointed and the plot lacking depth. Overall, it's considered a satisfying and wholesome show with a good balance of humor and character development.
pros: Unique take on the Isekai genre, focusing on an average protagonist.
Well-executed tonal shifts, balancing humor and serious moments.
Good animation and fight scenes, especially for Studio C2C.
cons: Chopped up narrative style with mini-episodes that lack clear beginnings and ends.
Story and plot are simple and barebones.
Protagonist Saitou can be boring and lacks depth.

anime.title: Alice Gear Aegis Expansion
anime.synopsis: Centuries ago, mankind abandoned planet Earth after the Vice, a race of mechanical aliens, drove them from their home into a life adrift in space. Now resigned to starships forged of pieces of Earth’s shattered moon, the final hope for humanity lies in the hands of Actresses, young women born with the ability to wield the only weapons that can harm the Vice: Alice Gears, mechanical suits that can finally turn the tide against the alien incursion.
anime.consensus_summary: Alice Gear Aegis is a fun, lighthearted show with strange humor and cute girls. However, the final episodes and certain plot elements feel out of place and detract from the overall experience. Despite its flaws, the show is generally enjoyable for its unique charm and weirdness.
pros: Fun romp with cute girls doing weird things
Strange, weird, subversive humor keeps jokes from getting stale
cons: Questionable production values
Final two episodes spoil the show
Evil Chihaya plotline feels out of place
Lack of focus on other characters
anime.thematic_vibe: Off-Kilter, Slice of Life, Subversive Humor

anime.title: Arifureta: From a Detour to the World's Strongest
anime.romaji_title: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou: Arifureta Yorimichi de Sekai Saikyou
anime.synopsis: Unaired episode included in the first Blu-ray volume.
anime.consensus_summary: This unaired episode is viewed as pure filler content, offering cute and funny moments but lacking any significant plot progression. While entertaining for dedicated fans, it's not considered essential viewing and can be confusing if not watched in the correct sequence relative to the main series.
pros: cute and funny moments centered around Yue and other characters
entertaining for existing fans of Arifureta
cons: 100% filler episode
not essential viewing
chronological placement can be confusing if watched out of sequence

anime.title: Prima Doll
anime.synopsis:
Black Cat Cafe is located in the fifth ward of the Imperial Capital. Having lost their purpose after the war ended a few years prior, advanced mechanical dolls known as Automata have been restored and now work at the cafe wearing elegant kimonos. While they adjust to the peaceful world, events of the past continue to haunt the Automata, preventing them from letting go of the responsibility they once held.

Among the Automata working at Black Cat Cafe is the recently restored Haizakura, who has lost her memories during a reset. Her identity and role in this unfamiliar world are a mystery to her, but one thing is certain—she loves to sing. With never-ending curiosity and beautiful songs to guide them, Haizakura and the Automata search for their new purpose together, supporting each other no matter how rigorous that endeavor might be.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While many appreciate the show's aesthetic appeal, cute characters, and emotional moments, they are often disappointed by the underdeveloped plot, pacing issues, and tonal inconsistencies. Some viewers enjoyed it as a moe slice-of-life anime with sad elements, while others felt it failed to deliver on its darker, more serious premise.
pros: Endearing characters with well-developed personalities and backstories.
Beautiful art style and character designs.
Enjoyable songs and OST that enhance emotional scenes.
cons: Rushed and underdeveloped plot, especially in the latter half.
Shallow character arcs and forced emotional moments.
Inconsistent tone with jarring shifts between slice-of-life and serious themes.

anime.title: Mr. Stone Feels Lonely
anime.synopsis: Shi Zhou Wu is the older brother of the Ren Tian Faction. He has dedicated himself to martial arts and has been oblivious to worldly affairs since he was a child. He is serious, does not smile and is often feared by the people around him. Once, at a martial arts conference, he was surrounded by too many knightly couples, this seriously stimulated his spirit, causing a feeling of invincible loneliness to haunt him. Therefore, he decided to find his own happy and predestined marriage...
anime.consensus_summary: The show is well-received as a super-comedy animation, especially for those who enjoyed similar shows like 'Chivalrous Hero Shen Jianxin.' Viewers praise its art style, animation, funny plot, and character growth. The only notable critique is the background art, but overall, the audience consensus is highly positive, especially among viewers who approach the show with an open mind.
pros: Good original art skills and animation special effects.
Funny plot with unique style of art and comedy.
Noticeable character growth.
Amazing opening song.
cons: Weak background art.

anime.title: Bibliophile Princess
anime.synopsis:
For generations, the Bernstein family has been recognized as a house of nobles who favor books over everything else. Elianna Bernstein, daughter of a baron of the Sauslind Kingdom, is no different. But instead of being called a bookworm, she is known as the Bibliophile Princess.

Four years ago, the crown prince, Christopher Selkirk Asherald, offered Elianna a special arrangement: if she would become his fiancée, he promised that she could continue to spend all her free time reading. Despite having to inherit a title of great responsibility, she agreed to the proposal, enticed by the prospect of gaining access to the royal archives housing a wide selection of books.

To this day, Elianna firmly believes that her engagement is void of romantic sentiment. When she notices Christopher's interactions with another girl, she presumes that the days she spends with him will soon reach an end. Yet, during this period of uncertainty, Elianna and Christopher open a new chapter in their relationship, gradually uncovering their genuine feelings as they grow to better understand each other.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding it a cute and enjoyable romance with a charming female lead, while others criticize the repetitive plot, the female lead's lack of agency, and underdeveloped political intrigue. The show is seen as a light and airy watch, suitable for casual enjoyment, but ultimately forgettable. There are criticisms of the character development, particularly with the female lead who is often seen as naive.
pros: Cute and enjoyable romance between the main characters.
Pleasant art style and character designs, particularly the female lead.
Subtle character development of the female lead, Elianna, as she learns to navigate her role.
cons: Repetitive misunderstandings drive the plot, becoming tiresome.
Female lead is often naive and helpless, lacking agency and significant growth.
Political elements and conflicts feel underdeveloped and unengaging.
Several reviewers feel the ML regresses from a cool noble prince to a simp who can only fawn over Eli
anime.thematic_vibe: Cute Romance, Political Intrigue, Character Development

anime.title: Thousands of Worlds
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Teenage boy Lin Fei was unable to practice martial arts due to a defect in his meridians. After witnessing his master and his best friend died in the battle in the Black Abyss, he began to practice an ancient art of artifact refinement. He vowed to avenge them and hunt down the leader of the Black Abyss, even if it cost him his own life. A mysterious power revived him in a new era, and Lin Fei was determined to rebuild his sect and make it flourish.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is somewhat divided. Some viewers appreciate the animation quality and the emotional connection to the main character's story of loss and revenge. However, others are critical of the slow plot progression, lack of world-building, and underdeveloped characters and fight scenes.
pros: Good animation quality
Interesting premise
Touching story with relatable MC
cons: Slow plot progress
Lacking world building
Underdeveloped characters
Disappointing fight scenes
Unclear cultivation levels and powers

anime.title: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World
anime.synopsis:
Despite standing at the zenith as the strongest exorcist, Haruyoshi Kuga sought even greater power, which led to his demise at the hands of those who envied his might. As he draws his last breath, he casts a spell that allows him to reincarnate and swears to become more cunning, hoping that all his efforts will prove useful in his next life.

Haruyoshi is soon reborn in another world as Seika Lamprogue, an illegitimate son of a noble family that prides itself on magic. However, his new family largely ignores him due to his lineage and magic deficiency. Nevertheless, the unbothered Seika leverages the knowledge from his previous life to make numerous valuable allies. As he begins to explore the true limits of his abilities, Seika must also be wary of the consequences that tarnished his past and avoid repeating the same mistakes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the unique protagonist and engaging plot, while others criticize the generic isekai elements and inconsistent writing. Some viewers enjoyed the show as a fun power fantasy, while others found it to be a repetitive and uninspired addition to the isekai genre. The animation quality and rushed fight scenes were also points of concern for some viewers.
pros: Unique protagonist with cunning and strategic mind
Well-paced plot with interesting twists
Enjoyable blend of action, humor, and character development
Good world-building and power mechanics
cons: Generic isekai tropes
Mediocre animation quality
Rushed fight scenes
Underdeveloped supporting characters
Inconsistent plot development

anime.title: Stars*Collection
anime.synopsis: A series of shorts following the eccentric and hilarious daily lives of the Holostars VTubers!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Stars*Collection!, finding it a funny and well-executed sitcom-style series. It is considered a worthy counterpart to Holo no Graffiti, with praise for its comedic timing and a satisfying finale. The show is not particularly controversial, with viewers appreciating its lighthearted nature.
pros: Comparable quality to Holo no Graffiti despite smaller cast.
Effective randomness and gag comedy.
Positive finale.
anime.thematic_vibe: Sitcom, Gag Comedy, Slice of Life

anime.title: Onipan!
anime.synopsis: Three oni-kids who, through the power of the onipan (a portmanteau of "oni" and "pantsu") become human to help fix the relationship between humans and oni. The three girls transfer into a normal Tokyo high school to aid in their task and help fix their image by revitalizing the town, sometimes jumping headfirst into school events, and other times...becoming idols!
anime.consensus_summary: Onipan! is a lighthearted and comedic show that offers a relaxing viewing experience, particularly due to its short episode format and bright animation. While the amateur voice acting and sanitized humor may be drawbacks, the show's goofy antics and 4th wall breaks are generally well-received. The show is enjoyable for those who appreciate Japanese-style comedy and don't mind the references to older media.
pros: Goofy antics and 4th wall breaks provide a relaxing viewing experience.
The show's short episode format prevents plots from dragging.
Bright, vivid colors and pleasant animation style are reminiscent of Doga Kobo comedies.
cons: Amateur voice acting from the MCs can be jarring.
Sanitized humor may erase some of the comedic impact.
References to older media may not resonate with younger audiences.

anime.title: Chimimo
anime.synopsis:
In her house, Mei Onigami discovers a strange round creature that only says "chimi." Her sisters, Mutsumi and Hazuki, agree to let the being stay with them until its owner comes to claim it. However, as soon as one of them utters the word "hell," more creatures show up until there are 12 in total. The sisters think nothing of this until the critters create a portal that summons an envoy from Hell.

Jabberwock the Eighth, a horned and fanged man covered in fur, has come to unleash a living hell on earth under orders from his boss. However, when living in the human realm proves to be challenging, the Onigami sisters allow him to stay with them. They also take in his "Chimimoryo spirits"—the round demons that preceded his arrival. Called Jigoku-san by the Onigami sisters, this messenger from Hell has a lot of work cut out for him if he wants to take over the world. But before that, he will have to survive the everyday hells of human life.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Chimimo' to be a heartwarming and enjoyable anime.  Many appreciate its lighthearted comedy, focus on family bonds, and cute character designs. The show is perceived as soothing and suitable for viewers of all ages, with little to no controversy surrounding it.
pros: Innocent comedy suitable for all ages
Realistic sibling interactions
Characters evoke empathy
Soothing and mood-lifting
Cute animations and lovely kid-friendly themes

anime.title: Death Hall
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is deeply moved by Shiyakusho, particularly its emotional depth and tragic storytelling. The voice acting and simple art style contribute to the heartbreaking experience. Despite the potential drawback of the art style not appealing to everyone, the overall consensus is that the anime is a powerful and impactful tearjerker.
pros: Voice acting is heartbreaking and impactful.
The short length makes it a quick and emotionally effective experience.
Simple art style enhances the sadness.
cons: Art style may not be catchy for some viewers.

anime.title: Extreme Hearts
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, Sci-Fi, Sports, Team Sports
anime.synopsis:
Hiyori Hayama is an aspiring singer who moved to Tokyo to make her debut. She has always loved singing and hopes to stand on stage like her favorite artist. Unfortunately, the entertainment industry is not all fun and games, as she fails her auditions one after another and struggles to sell her songs.

Finding herself still standing at the start line, Hiyori pursues her only opportunity to take the next step forward—partaking in Extreme Hearts. The popular event is a Hyper Sports tournament where participants compete in various sports using ability-enhancing gear for a chance to make their big break. Despite being athletic, however, Hiyori's lack of familiarity with Hyper Sports poses a problem for her. Fortunately, she befriends girls experienced in different sports, and they join the tournament alongside Hiyori, hoping to see her rise to the top.

Now playing under Team RISE, Hiyori and her teammates learn about the unspoken rule of Extreme Hearts—all competitors must be entertainers or aspire to be one. For the members of Team RISE, facing the competition head-on is an inspiring endeavor that paves the way to discovering newfound interests and everlasting friendships.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some viewers finding the series enjoyable for its positive themes, character diversity, and blend of sports and idol elements. However, many criticize the generic plot, poor animation, lack of focus, and underdeveloped sci-fi aspects. The show is generally considered a simple and uninspired addition to the idol/sports genre.
pros: Positive message about challenging oneself and forging friendships.
Diverse cast of characters with individual backstories.
Enjoyable merging of sports and idol themes.
Upbeat and wholesome atmosphere.
cons: Generic plot and archetypal characters.
Poor animation quality and uninspired character designs.
Lack of focus on sports or idol elements, resulting in a disjointed narrative.
Underdeveloped sci-fi elements and unexplained technology.
Pacing issues, with rushed or stalled events.
Generic OST.

anime.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2
anime.synopsis:
The year is 2006, and the halls of Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School echo with the endless bickering and intense debate between two inseparable best friends. Exuding unshakeable confidence, Satoru Gojou and Suguru Getou believe there is no challenge too great for young and powerful Special Grade sorcerers such as themselves. They are tasked with safely delivering a sensible girl named Riko Amanai to the entity whose existence is the very essence of the jujutsu world. However, the mission plunges them into an exhausting swirl of moral conflict that threatens to destroy the already feeble amity between sorcerers and ordinary humans.

Twelve years later, students and sorcerers are the frontline defense against the rising number of high-level curses born from humans' negative emotions. As the entities grow in power, their self-awareness and ambition increase too. The curses unite for the common goal of eradicating humans and creating a world of only cursed energy users, led by a dangerous, ancient cursed spirit. To dispose of their greatest obstacle—the strongest sorcerer, Gojou—they orchestrate an attack at Shibuya Station on Halloween. Dividing into teams, the sorcerers enter the fight prepared to risk everything to protect the innocent and their own kind.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2 are heavily divided. While some praise the animation and specific story arcs, many criticize the incoherent plot, shallow characters, and inconsistent production quality. There is a sense of wasted potential, with some attributing the issues to the creator's choices and the studio's working conditions.
pros: High-quality animation, especially in fight scenes (though inconsistent).
Compelling story arcs (Hidden Inventory and Shibuya Incident praised by some).
Good music and sound design.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality and character design compared to season 1.
Incoherent storytelling and world-building.
Characters lack depth and personality.
Pacing issues with too many fights and not enough time for emotional development.
Contrived plot points and character deaths.
Power scaling inconsistencies.
Studio's work conditions affecting production quality.

anime.title: A Ripple in Time
anime.synopsis: Satoshi and Pikachu were having a Pokemon battle with a certain trainer. In the midst of an incandescent battle, he is suddenly surrounded by a large light and is blown to a strange place. What Satoshi and his friends see after chasing Celebi, the only clue to return to the original place ...!?
anime.consensus_summary: The short film is appreciated for its unique artistic collaboration and accessibility with official English subtitles. However, some viewers may find the localization choices distracting, and the inability to remove the baked-in subtitles could be a minor inconvenience. Overall, it seems to be a well-received short, primarily due to its novelty and accessibility.
pros: Officially released with English subtitles for worldwide streaming.
Unique collaboration between Pokémon and Daniel Arsham.
cons: Localization choices might bother some viewers (English names instead of Japanese).
Subtitles are baked into the video, which cannot be turned off.

anime.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc
anime.romaji_title: Kimetsu no Yaiba: Katanakaji no Sato-hen
anime.synopsis:
For centuries, the Demon Slayer Corps has sacredly kept the location of Swordsmith Village a secret. As the village of the greatest forgers, it provides Demon Slayers with the finest weapons, which allow them to fight night-crawling fiends and ensure the safety of humans. After his sword was chipped and deemed useless, Tanjirou Kamado, along with his precious little sister Nezuko, is escorted to the village to receive a new one.

Meanwhile, the death of an Upper Rank Demon disturbs the idle order in the demon world. As Tanjirou becomes acquainted with Mist Hashira Muichirou Tokitou and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji, ferocious powers creep from the shadows and threaten to shatter the Demon Slayers' greatest line of defense.
anime.consensus_summary: The Swordsmith Village Arc is seen as a significant downgrade compared to previous seasons, with criticisms focusing on pacing, repetitive plot elements, and weak character development. While the animation remains a highlight, it's not enough to overcome the narrative and structural issues. Many feel the season is stretched and lacks the emotional impact and excitement of earlier installments.
pros: High budget animation by Ufotable, especially fire effects.
Enjoyable humor and slice-of-life scenes with sympathetic characters in early episodes.
Visually appealing fighting scenes and animation style.
cons: Pacing issues with drawn-out fights and mid-fight backstories.
Repetitive plot elements and predictable character arcs.
Over-reliance on flashbacks and forced sympathy for characters.
Inconsistent animation quality and uninspired action sequences.
Weak or uninteresting character development.

anime.title: Helck
anime.synopsis:
Three months have passed since the Demon King was defeated by a hero. Mankind rejoices over their victory, but dwellers of the demon world do not share the same sentiment. With the loss of their king, they must now hold a tournament to decide who will become his successor. 

Monitoring the competition is the hot-headed yet powerful Vamirio—one of the Four Heavenly Kings. Among all the participants, she is extremely distrustful of one: Helck, a human hero who claims to hate humanity. As much as she wants to get rid of him, it is impossible due to Helck's incredible strength and popularity. 

Amidst the competition, Vamirio discovers that humans have vanished from various towns. As a result of this puzzling turn of events, Vamirio grows desperate to reveal Helck's true intentions by carefully crafting a plan to make Helck lose. If she proves to be successful, she might uncover where his loyalty truly lies before the demon world is endangered.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally positive about Helck, praising its unexpected depth, well-developed characters, and balanced blend of comedy and drama. However, some are critical of the animation quality, pacing issues, and the unresolved plot due to the lack of a second season.  The shift from lighthearted comedy to a darker storyline surprised and pleased many viewers.
pros: Well-developed characters with backstories
Balanced mix of comedy and dark moments
Surprising and evolving storyline that defies expectations
Good world-building
Emotional depth and impact
cons: Animation quality is sometimes lacking
Pacing issues due to side quests
Incomplete plot with a cliffhanger ending and no confirmed season 2
Initial comedy might deter some viewers before the story gets serious

anime.title: Fights Break Sphere: Origin
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: Remake of the first season of Doupo Cangqiong.
anime.consensus_summary: The remake is considered somewhat unnecessary but offers additional insights into certain characters, specifically Yao Chen and Xun'er. Some elements from the original are missed, but the remake is generally enjoyable for those already familiar with the series. It is not recommended as a starting point for new viewers.
pros: Reveals more about Yao Chen.
Highlights Xun'er's power.
Enjoyable overall.
cons: Unnecessary remake.
Doesn't serve as a full introduction.
雅妃姐姐's introduction is missing.
anime.thematic_vibe: Remake, Yao Chen Focus, Xun'er Power

anime.title: Black Summoner
anime.synopsis:
To prepare for reincarnation in another world, Kelvin gives up select memories from his previous life in exchange for powerful abilities, additional skill points, and an S-class summoner title. As a bonus, the goddess facilitating his rebirth, Melfina, offers him a choice of any companion to give him a head start in his summoner role. Kelvin—who has fallen head over heels for Melfina at first sight—promptly chooses the deity, confident that his passionate feelings for her will resurface even without all of his memories.

Kelvin embarks on his exciting new journey with Melfina as his guide. However, in order to summon his beloved goddess' physical form, he needs to acquire significant amounts of mana points—and the best way to accomplish this is to level up by fighting strong enemies and making contracts with even stronger companions.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is mixed. Many find it to be a generic but enjoyable isekai that is easy to watch, while others criticize it for its lack of originality, rushed pacing, and reliance on tired tropes. The show is considered a decent time-killer for isekai fans, but ultimately forgettable and not particularly noteworthy.
pros: Enjoyable action and adventure sequences
Decent character development for the supporting cast
Uplifting and positive vibe
cons: Rushed pacing and underdeveloped plot
Generic isekai tropes and cliches
Over-reliance on CGI animation

anime.title: Classroom of the Elite II
anime.romaji_title: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 2nd Season
anime.synopsis:
Life back on the cruise following the Island Special Examination is anything but smooth sailing. Almost immediately after their return, the first-year students of Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Nurturing High School face yet another special exam, with both class and individual points on the line.

In addition to the complicated ruleset, more issues arise in the form of Kakeru Ryuuen and Kei Karuizawa. Angered by the previous test's outcome, Ryuuen is dead set on outdoing every class in the new challenge using any means necessary. Meanwhile, Karuizawa, a crucial pillar of Class D, is close to crumbling under the pressure of her past.

The stage is now set for Kiyotaka Ayanokouji to once again—using the full extent of his planning, foresight, and ruthless manipulation—steer Class D to victory as dangerously close enemy forces try to bring it down.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the improved pacing, strategic depth, and character insights compared to the first season. However, criticisms include inconsistent animation quality, a lack of character development, and a perceived disconnect from the initial 'elite school' concept. Viewers are polarized between finding the series compelling and feeling detached due to the edgelord protagonist.
pros: Improved pacing compared to Season 1
More engaging and immersive plot
Intriguing character backstories, especially Karuizawa and Kushida
Ayanokoji's strategic brilliance is a highlight
Suspenseful and addictive mind games
cons: Animation quality is inconsistent and sometimes subpar
Lack of significant character development, especially for Ayanokoji
The 'elite school' premise feels misleading to some viewers
Some find the plot boring or dry
Overreliance on edgy or overpowered character tropes

anime.title: NieR:Automata Ver1.1a
anime.synopsis:
In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by alien-crafted "Machine Lifeforms," humanity is preparing for its last stand. Forced to retreat to the Moon for safety, humans are pinning their hopes on a group of man-made androids known as YoRHa soldiers. Led by the all-purpose battle android YoRHa 2-gou B-gata "2B," the group will fight to take control of the Earth back from its invaders.

As war against the machines rages on, the YoRHa slowly begin to see the first shards of truth underlying the brutal conflict. Facing the harsh reality before her, the unwavering warrior 2B starts to question her very existence and just how much she must sacrifice for the sake of humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided. Fans of the game appreciate the anime's faithfulness to the source material's world and music, but many find the adaptation rushed, with poor pacing and underdeveloped characters. Newcomers may struggle to understand the plot without prior knowledge, while veterans are disappointed by the deviations and diminished impact compared to the game. Production issues and animation inconsistencies further contribute to a mixed reception.
pros: Faithful recreation of the game's world and music.
Original voice actors enhance the experience.
Moments of brilliance that complement the source material.
Exploration of consciousness in robots is compelling.
cons: Rushed storyline and pacing.
Lack of character development.
Adaptation struggles to capture the depth of the video game.
Inconsistent animation quality and overuse of CGI.
Poorly integrated side quests.
Awkward or meaningless deviations from the game's plot.

anime.title: Lonely Castle in the Mirror
anime.synopsis:
In a tranquil neighborhood of Tokyo, seven students are avoiding going to school—hiding in their darkened bedrooms, unable to face their family and friends—until the moment they find the mirrors in their bedrooms are shining.

At a single touch, they are pulled from their lonely lives into a wondrous castle straight out of a Grimm's fairy tale. This whimsical place, oddly lacking in food and running water but full of electrical sockets, is home to a petulant girl in a mask, named Wolf Queen and becomes their playground and refuge during school hours. Hidden within the walls, they're told there's a key that will grant one wish, as well as a set of clues to find it. But there's a catch: the key must be found by the end of the school year and they must leave the premises by five o'clock each day or else suffer a fatal end.

As time passes, a devastating truth emerges: only those brave enough to share their stories will be saved. And so they begin to unlock each other's stories: how a boy is showered with more gadgets than love; how another suffers a painful and unexplained rejection, and how a girl lives in fear of her predatory stepfather. As they struggle to abide by the rules of the game, a moving story unfolds, of seven characters trapped in a cycle of misunderstanding and loneliness, who are ultimately set free by the power of friendship, empathy, and sacrifice.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the emotional depth and relatable characters, but criticism for pacing and adaptation issues. Some find the storytelling beautiful and the conclusion satisfying, while others feel it's a waste of time due to a rushed plot and missing details from the original work. The movie explores themes of bullying, escapism, and the importance of empathy, but its execution divides viewers.
pros: Relatable characters with interesting backstories.
Good animation and music.
Satisfying conclusion that answers questions arising from the plot.
cons: Pacing issues, especially in the first half.
Missing details and rushed storytelling compared to the source material.
Theme is unclear and plotting is muddled.

anime.title: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger
anime.synopsis:
Several years after The Fruit of Grisaia...

What was once "Mihama Academy," a sanctuary for young girls, has now been transformed into a SORD (Special Organization for Research & Development) training school dedicated to fostering talent for national defense. Rena and Maki specialize in firearms, Tohka and Gumi excel at sniping, Chris handles explosives and data processing, and Murasaki is a skilled ninja for intelligence operations. Together, they take on cases too complex for the police or Self-Defense Forces, repeatedly facing dangerous missions. This is the story of these young girls, painted in blood and gunpowder.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Grisaia: Phantom Trigger is mixed. While the production quality and character backstories are praised, the lack of player agency and episodic format are criticized. Many find it a decent addition to the Grisaia universe but not as compelling as the original trilogy.
pros: Excellent Production Quality (art, character designs, CG, voice acting, sound design)
Engaging Character Backstories (in some volumes)
Satisfying Action Sequences
Continuation of the Grisaia Universe
cons: Lack of Player Agency (kinetic novel format)
Formulaic Structure (for some volumes)
Short Playtime (especially earlier volumes)
Less Focus on a Central Protagonist
Confusing Overarching Plot (for some)
Not as Good as the Original Trilogy (subjective)

anime.title: Spice and Wolf: Merchant Meets the Wise Wolf
anime.romaji_title: Ookami to Koushinryou: Merchant Meets the Wise Wolf
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Adventure, Drama, Romance, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
With a cartload of fur pelts in tow, traveling merchant Kraft Lawrence stops by the village of Pasloe. According to local folklore, centuries ago, one of the villagers made a promise with the wolf deity Holo, who swore to bless Pasloe with bountiful harvests of wheat. Yet, as time passed, such stories became little more than relics of the past.

After quickly finishing his business in the village, Lawrence sets out to his next destination. His journey, however, takes an unexpected turn when he discovers a nude, animal-eared girl sleeping among his pelts. Even more surprisingly, the youthful-looking woman claims to be Holo—the wolf of legend.

Holo wishes to return to her hometown in the north, and though their first encounter is rocky, she convinces Lawrence to accompany her on her travels. In return, she vows to earn her keep, using her quick wits and lifetime of experience to help her newfound companion in his dealings. As they continue their journey, Lawrence and Holo take advantage of whatever economic opportunities they come across, often landing in situations that put both their business skills and their relationship to the test.
anime.consensus_summary: The remake of Spice and Wolf is generally well-received, especially by fans of the original series. The adaptation is considered faithful to the source material, with improvements in character development and animation quality. While some find the pacing slow or the economic themes dense, the strong relationship between Holo and Lawrence and the unique premise make it a worthwhile watch for fans of romance and low fantasy.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the light novels, including previously skipped content.
Improved character development, making Lawrence more assertive and Holo more nuanced.
Strong focus on economics and trade, setting it apart from typical fantasy anime.
Well-developed relationship between Holo and Lawrence, with a focus on their evolving dynamic.
High-quality voice acting, especially in the dubbed version, which captures Holo's personality effectively.
Beautiful artwork and animation, blending 2D and 3D CGI seamlessly.
cons: Animation can occasionally look cheap.
Pacing can be slow, which may deter some viewers.
The heavy focus on economic and theological themes can be difficult to understand for some viewers.
Some viewers find the remake unnecessary since the original still holds up well.

anime.title: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
anime.romaji_title: Noumin Kanren no Skill bakka Agetetara Nazeka Tsuyoku Natta.
anime.synopsis:
Al Wayne's greatest goal is to become the best farmer he can be. With utmost effort, he reaches the apex of his farming skills and earns the title of a first-rate cultivator. Due to this achievement, Al gains a substantial upgrade to his stats which now eclipse even the strength of legendary heroes of old.

Soon after discovering his potential, the royal family enlists his help against the rising number of disasters that coincidentally began right as his true power was awakened. Although reluctant, Al concedes that in order to protect his precious fields, he must do his best to keep all threats at bay.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with many criticizing the anime for its generic plot, poor writing, and mediocre production quality. Some viewers appreciate the light-hearted parody and easy-going nature of the show, while others find it to be a disappointing and uninspired addition to the isekai genre. The misleading marketing and lack of focus on farming also contributed to negative sentiment.
pros: Light-hearted and easy to watch.
Enjoyable for those who like fantasy parodies.
Some found the humor and characters likeable, especially the MC's mom.
Unique premise of a farmer becoming OP.
cons: Generic plot with many overused tropes.
Poor character development and static characters.
Inconsistent power scaling and illogical plot moments.
Mediocre animation and subpar CGI.
Misleading marketing, with little focus on actual farming.
Repetitive dialogue and forced emotional moments.

anime.title: The First Immortal of the Seven Realms
anime.synopsis: Because of a sudden kindness, Liang Xi has ten thousand years of true power, and joins Tianlingmen to embark on the official path of self-cultivation. Turning your hands into clouds and covering your hands into rain, while talking and laughing, the powerful enemies are wiped out. My wish is very simple. It is nothing more than planting flowers and raising grass, and making bubble girls and refining treasures. Covering the world with one hand, very good and powerful. Liang Xi looked at the sentient beings in the seven realms crawling under her feet, and emphasized that I am a man with a strong sense of chastity.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is criticized for its protagonist's focus on women and lack of seriousness towards cultivation and dealing with enemies. While the art style is appreciated, the protagonist's flawed priorities and underutilization of powers are major drawbacks. Some viewers may find it enjoyable if they can overlook these issues.
pros: Good art style
cons: Protagonist prioritizes women over cultivation.
Protagonist doesn't properly utilize his powers.
Protagonist isn't serious about dealing with enemies and lets them escape.

anime.title: Kizuna no Allele
anime.synopsis:
It has been five years since AI Kizuna disappeared from the virtual world. Despite being an AI, she has captured the hearts of her fans, including Miracle, an aspiring virtual artist, with her performances. As Miracle attends ADEN Academy, a school for virtual artists, she makes new friends while learning more about singing, performing, and streaming. 

Miracle's ultimate goal is to win the prestigious Lapin d'Or at the Virtual Grid Awards, an achievement Kizuna has earned five consecutive times. To do this, she works to improve her channel ranking through streams and performances, trying to stand out among other students at the academy. Determined to fulfill her dream of inspiring others the same way Kizuna inspired her, the budding star will not give up.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience response to Kizuna no Allele is largely negative. Many feel the anime fails to capture the charm and essence of VTubers, relying on tired tropes and uninspired characters. The repetitive music and perceived promotion of controversial elements like NFTs further contribute to the disappointment, with some viewers suggesting that the anime would have been better suited as a YouTube series rather than a full-fledged anime production.
pros: Some enjoyed the characters as VTuber characters.
Animations are nice to look at.
The performed songs are really good overall (though repetitive).
cons: The anime lies to the audience about Kizuna Ai's presence in the show.
Attempts to promote NFTs and cryptocurrency are seen negatively.
Characters are bland and lack depth.
The plot is unoriginal and devolves into generic tropes, including an unnecessary isekai-like episode.
Repetitive music with only one main song used throughout the series.
Fails to capture the essence of what makes VTubers appealing.
VTuber anime may not appeal to a broad audience.
Characters feel hollow without chat interaction.
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture, Virtual Reality, School Life

anime.title: One Piece: New Year's Special - The Secret of the Straw Hat Pirates!
anime.romaji_title: One Piece: Otoshidama Special - Tokubetsu Hou Mugiwara Kaizokudan no Himitsu!
anime.synopsis: A recap that aired as a New Year special. It recaps how the first seven crew members joined.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally views this special as a nostalgic recap of the series' origins. While some appreciate the coverage and charm, others find it unnecessary if familiar with the main story. The cut-and-paste style and reliance on existing context are potential drawbacks, but overall, it serves as a decent memory refresh for One Piece fans.
pros: Nostalgic flair retained.
Covers a large amount of content.
Charming Manga promo between transitions.
cons: Classic cut and paste style of recap.
Requires context of the story to fully appreciate.
Moments being great doesn’t make the recap great.
Weirdly placed movie promo.

anime.title: Classroom of the Elite III
anime.romaji_title: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 3rd Season
anime.synopsis: Third season of Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with anime-only viewers generally enjoying the thrilling plot and character developments, while light novel readers are critical of the rushed pacing and missing content. The season is praised for its intriguing storyline and consistent production, but criticized for shallow strategies and underdeveloped character emotions. Overall, the season maintains a decent level of engagement but fails to fully satisfy those familiar with the source material.
pros: Intriguing plot with twists and turns.
Complex and well-developed characters.
Consistent production quality, especially visuals in season 3.
Exploration of social commentary and themes.
cons: Rushed pacing and skipped content compared to the light novel.
Lack of emotional attachment due to poor character development for some viewers.
Confusing plot elements and lack of context without LN knowledge.
Simple strategies presented as complex intelligence.

anime.title: Zi Chuan: Yincang Hudong Ju
anime.synopsis: Alternative timelines of plot points from Zi Chuan.
anime.consensus_summary: The supplemental episodes are generally well-received for expanding the main story and building characters. However, they are considered dependent on the main story and should be watched in conjunction with it. There is little controversy surrounding these episodes as they enhance the experience of the original series.
pros: Expands on things mentioned in the main story
Builds characters that will be important later
cons: Requires the main story to be understood

anime.title: Cinderella Chef 3rd Season
anime.romaji_title: Meng Qi Shi Shen: Huanxi Zhui Hun
anime.synopsis: The third season of Meng Qi Shi Shen.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the series as a lighthearted, gourmet-themed story set in historical China. While it doesn't delve deep into culinary education, the chef's creative problem-solving and the satisfying final episode contribute to a positive viewing experience. It is primarily appreciated by fans of the genre for its entertainment value.
pros: Appeals to fans of the gourmet genre.
Features a talented chef using her skills to overcome challenges.
The final episode significantly elevates the season.
cons: Doesn't focus heavily on teaching about food or cooking techniques.
May rely on the novelty of delicious food as a plot device.

anime.title: Vermeil in Gold
anime.romaji_title: Kinsou no Vermeil: Gakeppuchi Majutsushi wa Saikyou no Yakusai to Mahou Sekai wo Tsukisusumu
anime.synopsis:
Alto Goldfilled, a diligent student at the Ortigia Academy of Magic, aspires to become a powerful sorcerer. But he is unable to become one as, despite his excellent grades and strong commitment to his studies, he fails his summoning class. With the threat of repeating a year hanging over his head, Alto tries following an old, worn-out grimoire in a desperate attempt to resolve his situation.

To his surprise, he succeeds and summons a powerful demon named Vermeil. As a sign of gratitude for releasing her, Vermeil agrees to become Alto's familiar, sealing their relationship with a deep kiss. Little does Alto know what else he is capable of and what Vermeil's past hides.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Many viewers enjoyed the fanservice and some aspects of the characters, particularly Vermeil. However, most found the plot generic, the characters bland, and the villains poorly written. The show is seen as a passable ecchi anime that doesn't offer much beyond its fanservice elements.
pros: Enjoyable fanservice
Decent animation, especially in ecchi scenes
Some character development, particularly for Vermeil
Good chemistry between Alto and Vermeil
Enjoyable pacing
cons: Generic and formulaic plot
Uninspired and unoriginal story
Bland and uninteresting characters, especially the MC
Poorly explained magic system
Weak and terribly written villains
Over-reliance on fanservice can feel repetitive

anime.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu Season 2
anime.synopsis:
The king of Slantania has officially appointed Sei Takanashi as the Holy Saint—an omnipotent maiden summoned from another world to save the kingdom. After months of relentless fighting against monsters, Sei can finally relax and continue her study at the Medicinal Flora Research Institute. Although her relationship with Albert Hawke, the commander of the Third Order of Knights, gradually blossoms, her bachelorette status attracts unwanted attention from other men—much to Albert's dismay.

Moreover, Tenyuu—one of the many princes from the faraway Zaidera Empire—has taken an interest in Slantania and its powerful healing potions. Given that Sei's identity is a national secret, she must lay low in the royal palace until Tenyuu satisfies his curiosity at the institute and returns to his country. Despite his unimpressive appearance, the foreign prince is far from clueless. He has come to Slantania for a clear reason, and Sei's unique skills may just hold the answer to his cryptic research.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some fans enjoying the series' wholesome romance and continuation of established themes. However, many critics found the second season suffered from slow pacing, filler content, and a lack of substantial plot development compared to the first season. Some viewers felt the main character's development regressed, diminishing the impact of the romantic storyline.
pros: Well-executed continuation of Season 1 for fans of the series.
Cute, wholesome romance with well-developed characters.
Good production quality and consistent animation.
cons: Slow pacing with a lack of substantial plot and tension.
Filler-like content, particularly in the first half of the season, that doesn't advance the main story.
Inconsistent animation quality and a less refined OST compared to Season 1.
Character development regressed from season 1.

anime.title: My One-Hit Kill Sister
anime.romaji_title: Isekai One Turn Kill Neesan: Ane Douhan no Isekai Seikatsu Hajimemashita
anime.synopsis:
While saving a child from harm, otaku Asahi Ikusaba is transported to another world and believes he has reincarnated with cheat skills similar to those of the characters from his favorite games and novels. Unfortunately, reality strikes when an encounter with a powerful monster shows that he is still nothing more than an average person.

In this moment of extreme danger, Asahi instinctively calls out to his overly doting sister, Maya, who appears out of nowhere, possessing the overpowered abilities he thought he had. Maya is ecstatic to see her brother again and resolves to use her newfound powers to protect Asahi no matter what.

Together, the close-knit siblings attempt to find a way back home while enjoying their new lives. However, it soon becomes clear that their arrival in this world may have had a purpose. With the Demon King's overwhelmingly powerful army approaching, no one but Maya seems to be able to stand in its way.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some find the show to be an enjoyable and funny isekai, others are put off by the repetitive plot, incestuous themes, and shallow characters. The art and animation are generally praised, but the overall lack of depth and originality leaves many viewers feeling underwhelmed. Ultimately, enjoyment depends on one's tolerance for fan service and generic isekai tropes.
pros: Good art and animation quality, especially for a new studio
Enjoyable and easy-going adventure, good for turning your brain off
Characters have unique personalities and chemistry, enhancing the comedy
Some fight scenes are well-animated
MC isn't overly dramatic or useless, showing some development
Catchy ED music
cons: Repetitive plot structure, with Maya constantly rescuing Asahi
Over-reliance on incestuous themes that may be uncomfortable for some viewers
Shallow character development for most of the cast besides Kilmaria
Comedy can be hit-or-miss, relying on predictable tropes
Story lacks a strong central goal and feels episodic
Second half introduces too many new characters, diluting the focus

anime.title: Spy Classroom
anime.synopsis:
A decade ago, mankind witnessed the deadly potential of weapons caused by the Great War. To avoid another catastrophe, governments worldwide have resorted to espionage to fulfill their agendas.

In the Din Republic, Lily is an enthusiastic young girl who aspires to become a spy and serve her nation. However, she begins to doubt her abilities, as she struggles to perform well academically. Lily's passion is reignited when she is offered provisional graduation by joining the spy team Lamplight, which she eagerly accepts despite the enigmatic nature of the opportunity.

Upon arriving at her destination, Lily is surprised to find six other girls waiting there, all of whom have faced their own academic difficulties as well. A mysterious man named Klaus soon appears and reveals they must complete an "Impossible Mission": to infiltrate the Galgad Empire after just one month of training. Although skeptical, the girls eventually agree to work together under Klaus' guidance—as this might be their only chance to prove their worth as spies.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience response to Spy Kyoushitsu is mixed, with many feeling disappointed by its subpar adaptation of the light novel series. While some appreciate its lighthearted take on the spy genre and the character interactions, many criticize the poor pacing, convoluted plot structure, and underdeveloped characters. The anime is seen as a missed opportunity, failing to capture the magic of the source material.
pros: Enjoyable light action comedy with fun characters.
Well-paced with character development in the mid-season.
Charming voice acting.
The OP and ED themes are well-done.
cons: Poor pacing and direction, especially in the first half.
Adapts side stories instead of the main story, feeling like filler.
Relies too heavily on plot twists and shock value.
Characters are gimmicky and lack real personality or growth.
Overly sexualized characters obstruct the plot.
Animation is not special.
Inconsistent tone and structure.
Boring plot twists and characters in later episodes.
anime.thematic_vibe: Light Action Comedy, Espionage, Cute Girls Doing Cute Things

anime.title: Law of Devil
anime.synopsis: Duwei is born into this new world from Earth without a sound, he does not cry, he simply stares at the people around him. As he grows he does not speak and curses this new world he was forced into. His Father a Great General is sure there must be something he has an aptitude for, however he is simply trash. Disregarded by his family as the Retarded heir. This is the story of his journey to discover the truths of this world and use the knowledge of his past life to remove his title of retard, even if he has to become a devil.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Emo Faze' for its unique take on the isekai genre, blending Western fantasy elements into a Chinese donghua. Reviewers appreciate the engaging plot and well-designed characters, though some note minor issues with animation and pacing. The overall mood is positive, with viewers recommending the series for its fresh approach.
pros: Unique storytelling and plot presentation.
Well-designed characters.
Good animation quality.
Departure from typical Chinese donghua tropes.
Linear and well-developed storyline.
cons: Animation could be better.
Character expressions look shabby.
Story jumps around a bit.
Odd mix of monsters and references to other Western fantasies.

anime.title: Eternal Boys
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Idols (Male), Music, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Washed-up salaryman Kentarou Sanada is at his wits end trying to find a job, applying anywhere and everywhere since his former company went bankrupt. After unknowingly showing up to an idol audition that he thinks is a regular job interview, Sanada is shocked when he gets a callback saying that he has been accepted. Along with five other men in their forties, he has been chosen as a member of Eternal Boys—a new idol group that strives to prove that people can debut at any age. However, as the Eternal Boys attempt to establish themselves in an industry saturated with much younger talent, they wonder whether their age will hold them back or their experience will be their key to success.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates 'Eternal Boys' for its realistic portrayal of older idols and its focus on mature themes. Viewers find the characters relatable and the pacing effective, though some find the emotional stakes to be somewhat low. Overall, the show is well-received as a feel-good slice of life with unexpected depth.
pros: Characters feel real and relatable, with understandable reactions.
Episode length and pacing are well-managed, utilizing montages effectively.
The show tackles mature themes with bravery and clear intention.
cons: The realistic idol show concept restricts depth.
Emotional stakes remain relatively low.
Message and themes are adult and may not resonate with all viewers.

anime.title: Ragna Crimson
anime.synopsis:
Said to be humanity's natural enemy, formidable dragons that belong to an ancient bloodline roam the world. Only two ways prove effective to kill a dragon: freezing their blood with silverine—an aura that comes from silver weapons—or letting their bodies be incinerated by sunlight.

Young hunter prodigy Leonica is accompanied by her close friend Ragna, who appears to lack the skills necessary in their profession. Moreover, many shun Ragna, considering him cursed because dragons always seem to attack him and slaughter his close ones.
