Nevertheless, Leonica sees potential in Ragna and gladly partners up with him. Likewise, Ragna feels certain that Leonica is immune to his misfortune thanks to her incredible strength.

His confidence is shaken, however, when Ragna dreams of Leonica's death, believing this to be a prophecy. As the destined day arrives, he comes face-to-face with his future self, who bestows him enormous power and memories from the future to ensure Leonica's safety. In order to succeed, Ragna must join forces with a mysterious figure known as Crimson and eradicate all dragons for good.
anime.consensus_summary: Ragna Crimson presents a dark fantasy world with a compelling revenge narrative, but its inconsistent animation and pacing issues detract from the overall experience. While the characters and their dynamics are praised, the story suffers from unnecessary deaths and forced sympathy for villains. The audience is divided, with some appreciating the unique premise and character development, while others are disappointed by the execution.
pros: Interesting and unique premise involving time travel and revenge.
Well-developed characters with complex motivations, especially Ragna and Crimson.
Enjoyable action sequences and fight choreography.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, particularly in later episodes.
Pacing issues and slow progression in the second half.
Unnecessary character deaths and forced sympathy for villains.

anime.title: FLCL: Grunge
anime.genres: Avant Garde, Comedy, Mecha, Parody, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: While the adults have no hope for tomorrow, the youth accept the decline and poverty of the city as an ordinary part of their reality until Haruko throws the city into chaos.
anime.consensus_summary: FLCL: Grunge is overwhelmingly viewed as a disappointing and unnecessary addition to the FLCL franchise. Critics heavily pan its cheap CGI animation, uninspired story, and poorly developed characters. While some appreciate the music and multi-perspective approach, the consensus is that it fails to capture the magic of the original and offers little of substance, leaving fans and newcomers alike feeling underwhelmed.
pros: Some appreciate the unique CGI visual style.
The Pillows' music remains a strong point, evoking nostalgia.
The multi-perspective storytelling approach is appreciated by some.
Some viewers found the ending heartfelt and satisfying.
cons: The CGI animation is widely criticized as cheap, stiff, and ugly.
The story is considered a rehash of the original FLCL, lacking originality and depth.
Characters are seen as bland, uninteresting, and poorly developed.
The series fails to explore meaningful themes and messages.
Poorly implemented music cues.
Inconsistent world-building and unexplained elements.
Over-reliance on nostalgia and callbacks to the original series.
Haruko's character is diminished and reduced to fan service.
Pacing is rushed due to the short 3-episode runtime.
Dubbing feels forced and unnatural.

anime.title: Housing Complex C
anime.synopsis: "Housing Complex C" centers around Kimi, who lives in a small, low-cost housing complex located in the seaside town of Kurosaki. Trouble seems to follow her wherever she goes, and horrific incidents begin to occur. Is an ancient evil stalking the residents of Housing Complex C?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many find the premise interesting but criticize the execution, citing rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and ineffective horror elements. Some appreciate its brevity, while others feel it squanders potential. There's agreement that it's not a particularly scary or well-executed horror anime, but opinions vary on whether it's a worthwhile watch.
pros: Interesting premise with potential.
Unique blend of horror with slice-of-life elements.
Good voice acting, particularly in later episodes.
A few unsettling visuals.
Short length doesn't overstay its welcome.
The ending may catch you off guard.
cons: Rushed pacing and excessive exposition, especially in the final episode.
Underdeveloped characters and plot threads.
Ineffective horror elements; lacks tension and atmosphere.
Dialogue is stilted and poorly written.
Animation is basic and low budget; contains errors.
Poor handling of social commentary, bordering on racist stereotypes.
Incoherent plot with many plot holes and inconsistencies.
The series fails to develop any kind of satisfying payoff, especially when it comes to the world building.

anime.title: Baki Hanma 2nd Season
anime.romaji_title: Hanma Baki: Son of Ogre 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Second season of Hanma Baki: Son of Ogre.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely divided on the narrative execution and pacing, with strong praise for the improved animation and intense action sequences. While many fans appreciate the continuation of the Baki universe and the spectacle it provides, others find the heavy reliance on exposition and the sometimes inconsistent plot development to be significant drawbacks. The show is generally seen as a solid entry for existing fans, offering the expected over-the-top martial arts action.
pros: Animation quality has improved significantly, with a reduction in CGI and more traditional drawn animation for fights.
Character development, especially for Baki and Yujiro, is a strong point, with their father-son relationship explored more deeply.
The fights are described as dynamic, intense, and spectacular, with innovative moves and a focus on extreme muscularity.
Soundtracking and voice acting (both Japanese and Portuguese dubs) are highly praised.
The Pickle arc, in particular, is highlighted for its emotional impact and excellent fight choreography.
cons: The narrative can be overly reliant on narration and exposition, often over-explaining every move and plot point, which some find tiresome and detracts from the action.
The pacing can be inconsistent, with some arcs (like Retsu's boxing) feeling like filler or rushed.
The visual style, while appreciated by some for its unique aesthetic, is criticized by others for relying heavily on still images and panning cameras rather than fluid animation during fights.
The overall plot can feel repetitive and simplistic, focusing heavily on 'big men fighting big men' without much depth beyond the core premise.
Some characters' portrayals are inconsistent or feel off compared to previous seasons (e.g., Oliva in the Prison Arc).

anime.title: Baise Shandian
anime.synopsis: After a crushing defeat in a major tournament, Zhang Ruoyi, forced to abandon her professional career, returned to school. In the unfamiliar environment, table tennis, which had once cast a shadow over her, became a ray of light piercing through her confusion—on the table, she made teammates; off the court, she gained friendships. This time, the young woman decided to give it her all and swing her racket towards the future.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Baise Shandian" for its character interactions, animation, and exploration of personal growth. The primary criticisms are its short length, which leads to a simplistic story and underdeveloped side characters. Overall, the audience consensus is positive, but with some reservations about the pacing and character depth.
pros: Delightful character interactions
Stellar animation and cinematography
Exploration of character introspections
cons: Story feels simplistic due to short length
Underdeveloped side characters

anime.title: Throne of Seal
anime.synopsis:
Six thousand years ago, mankind's glorious reign ended as a result of an invasion of the demon race, brought about by the emergence of 72 demon gods. To safeguard the remnants of humanity, the Alliance of Temples appeared to stop the demons' progress and temporarily stabilize the situation.

At present, nine-year-old Long Hao Chen is training to become a part of the Knight Temple Hall. Through sheer dedication and the support of his companions, he passes the knight exam. Now, under the tutelage of his teacher Long Xing Yu, Long Hao Chen endures the Holy Resurrection Ritual to ascertain his capability. The ritual reveals that Long Hao Chen is a Son of Light—an individual who possesses a vast amount of spiritual energy.

Recognizing his disciple's promising potential, Long Xing Yu urges Long Hao Chen to become a strong knight capable of defeating the Demon Lord alongside him. With countless challenges awaiting him, Long Hao Chen may be the warrior that can end the era of darkness.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, 'Shen Yin Wangzuo' is a reasonably well-received series, particularly for fans of progression fantasy and similar shows like 'Soul Land'. While some find the story and characters endearing, others are turned off by the childish elements and occasional inconsistencies. The animation is generally praised, but some find the art style too visually overwhelming.
pros: Great fight scenes and animation quality, especially for a 3D donghua.
Likeable main character with good motivations and development.
Solid and well-executed storyline despite being simple and containing familiar elements.
Enjoyable tournament arc with decent worldbuilding.
cons: Art style may be too bright and visually busy for some viewers.
Show can feel childish with stereotypical characters and writing.
Inconsistencies in character behavior and world lore.
Unnecessary comedic elements (dance mimics, fluffy animals) detract from the overall quality.
anime.thematic_vibe: Progression Fantasy, Good vs Evil, Medieval MMORPG

anime.title: Tekken: Bloodline
anime.synopsis:
Thanks to their family's martial arts style, Jin Kazama and his mother, Jun, have had to overcome all sorts of challenges. But even with their strong bond, the two are no match for the terrifying demon that invades their home, harboring a bloodlust for Jun. Cornered by such a stubborn creature, Jun commands Jin to find his grandfather, Heihachi Mishima, before she disappears along with the demon in an explosion.

Jin arrives at his grandfather's abode, only to be treated like a stranger from a different bloodline. However, upon discovering that Ogre was the demon behind the Kazamas' tragedy, Heihachi takes Jin under his tutelage and begins to train the young man rigorously. With a flaming vengeance, Jin turns his blood, sweat, and tears into strength for his fists—all for the sake of Ogre's demise.
anime.consensus_summary: Tekken: Bloodline is a polarizing anime, primarily appealing to hardcore fans due to its faithful adaptation of game mechanics and nostalgic elements. While praised for its fight choreography and respect for the source material, it is heavily criticized for its inconsistent animation quality, rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and disappointing soundtrack, leaving many viewers divided on its overall success.
pros: Faithful adaptation of iconic game moves and special effects, exciting for fans of the franchise.
Visually stunning choreography that accurately reflects the characters' move sets from the games.
Strong nostalgia factor for long-time Tekken fans, evoking childhood memories.
Inclusion of classic Tekken 3 story elements and characters.
cons: Inconsistent and cheap-looking animation, with jarring transitions between 2D and 3D.
Stiff and low-intensity fight animations, lacking impact and fluidity.
Underdeveloped characters and rushed plot, with insufficient context for newcomers.
Subpar voice acting and unusual speech patterns, particularly in the English dub.
Generic and uninspired music that fails to capture the original game's soundtrack.
Pacing issues, feeling both too fast for character development and too slow for plot progression.
Anachronistic character inclusions that don't contribute to the story.

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean Part 2
anime.romaji_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 6: Stone Ocean Part 2
anime.synopsis:
Thrown into solitary confinement after a daring rescue attempt, Jolyne Kuujou fights to uncover the sinister plot of Whitesnake, an enemy Stand whose mysterious wielder remains unknown to her.

Whitesnake's user is actually Enrico Pucci, priest and chaplain of Green Dolphin Street Prison. Pucci shares a deep connection with a villain who once plagued the Joestar bloodline, making his feud with Jolyne and her father, Joutarou, a personal one. Intent on executing the master plan of his deceased friend, Pucci uses the prison and its inmates to fulfill his nefarious schemes.

Assisted by fellow prisoners, like Ermes Costello and Foo Fighters, Jolyne battles several enemy Stand users. As the ramifications of Pucci's plot spread beyond the confines of the prison and begin to threaten the rest of the world, Jolyne embraces her family lineage and risks her life to put an end to evil.
anime.consensus_summary: The second part of Stone Ocean receives mixed reviews. Many appreciate the action, character development, and unique style, but some criticize the weaker arcs, complicated mechanics, and Netflix's release strategy which hurt audience engagement. There's a notable divide between those who find it entertaining and those who feel it falls short of previous JoJo installments.
pros: Great action sequences and creative stand abilities.
Well-done character development, especially for Jolyne.
Faithful adaptation of the source material with improvements.
Unique art style, bold character designs, and great music.
cons: Weak arcs in the beginning, and some fights are uninteresting.
Overly complicated stand mechanics.
The release schedule impacted hype and discussion.
Inconsistent animation quality at times.

anime.title: Orient: Awajishima Gekitou-hen
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Samurai, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
After Musashi rescues Michiru Saruwatari from a demon, his friend Kojirou Kanemaki discovers that his father was a member of the Uesugi clan. Determined to learn more about his own past, Kojirou—alongside his Kanemaki clansmen—decides to participate in Uesugi's punitive expedition against the demon lord of Awaji Island: Yamata no Orochi, an eight-headed dragon that threatens to engulf the entire region.

However, upon joining Uesugi's military alliance, Musashi faces the harsh reality of fighting against powerful demons. Humiliated by his lack of power and inability to work in groups, he has to learn how to cooperate with his newfound allies. Meanwhile, the Obsidian Eight—a group pursuing the Obsidian Goddess that dwells within Musashi's body—resumes its hunt for Musashi, and plans to thwart the ongoing island operation. As the situation grows chaotic, Musashi and his friends must foil the machinations of the various factions conspiring to seize the Obsidian Goddess.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to 'Orient: Awajishima Gekitou-hen' is mixed. While some appreciate the potential of the story, character development, and fight scenes, many are disappointed by the animation quality, pacing issues, and inconsistent narrative.  The series shows promise but suffers from poor execution, leading to a sense of wasted potential.
pros: Potential for worldbuilding and power system.
Character development of the main and supporting cast.
Mixing of fight scenes with emotional story beats (after initial episodes).
cons: Animation quality is inconsistent and often lacking.
Pacing issues, particularly in the early episodes and during action scenes.
Inconsistent story quality, with a perceived decline in the second season.
Newly introduced characters that were stand-off ish and hard to like.
Unclear elements in the power system.
Rushed plot.

anime.title: Kengan Ashura Season 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Kengan Ashura.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys Kengan Ashura Season 2 for its intense fight scenes and character development, despite some criticisms of the CGI animation and pacing. Fans of the first season will likely enjoy the continuation of the tournament arc, with many considering the fights to be a highlight. While some find the plot overcomplicated, the engaging action and strategic combat keep viewers invested.
pros: High-quality fight animation, especially considering it's CGI.
Exciting and unpredictable fight outcomes.
Strong character development and backstories.
More focused narrative due to a reduction in the number of characters.
Engaging fight choreography and strategy.
cons: Overcomplicated plot with too many characters.
CGI animation can be jarring outside of fight scenes.
Uneven pacing, particularly with the coup attempt storyline.
Story can be standard or predictable.

anime.title: Shine On! Bakumatsu Bad Boys
anime.synopsis:
Following a ruthless attack from an imperialist criminal gang known as the Masked Demons, Shinsengumi's Eighth Division—the law-enforcing squad in Kyoto that remains faithful to the shogunate—is nearly annihilated, with its sole survivor, Heisuke Toudou, critically injured. Urged to rebuild the Shinsengumi by the local feudal lord, Katamori Matsudaira, Toudou decides to offer eight convicts the chance to redeem themselves: they must abandon their old names and become substitutes for the eight Shinsengumi captains. All accept but one, who ends up immediately executed by the former assassin Sakuya.

However, Toudou has a hard time transforming the seven reformed criminals into loyal servants. Due to his lack of discipline, the impulsive and vengeful Ichibanboshi, whose family perished at the hands of the Masked Demons, threatens the success of Toudou's strategy. As Toudou pledges to protect the shogunate against imperialists and foreign invaders, other factions, such as Kogorou Katsura's group, start to put their plans in motion with only one goal in mind—to seize power at the dusk of the Edo period.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the anime entertaining due to its vibrant art style, unique character designs, and enjoyable character dynamics. However, many critics point out the weak plot, inconsistent animation, and lack of character development. The show is considered to have wasted potential, ultimately being a passable but not particularly special watch.
pros: Colorful and vibrant art style
Unique character designs
Enjoyable character dynamics and interactions
Good use of interesting character combos
cons: Weak plot and over-arching narrative
Barely any character development
Inconsistent animation quality and reuse of slides
Tacky and uninteresting flashbacks
Unexplained supernatural occurrences making the terrorist's plan less interesting

anime.title: Forty Millenniums of Cultivation
anime.synopsis: Li Yao, a genius craftsman, has been unable to break through the bottleneck due to the low development of his psychic powers, and then he obtained 40,000 years of cultivation by chance. Knowledge, thus opened up, but still missed the joint entrance examination. With the encouragement of friends and mentors, relying on his willpower to regain the opportunity to participate in the joint entrance examination, he finally entered the university of his choice and entered the story of realizing his dream of becoming a craftsman.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience seems to be enthusiastic and eagerly awaiting a second season. There is praise for the plot and the main character's journey.  The show is considered underrated, suggesting a positive but not widely known reception.
pros: Resourceful main character
Interesting premise with 40,000 years of cultivation knowledge
Exciting plot with spirit possession and self-discovery
cons: Adaptation quality is unknown without reading the source material
anime.thematic_vibe: Sci-Fi Fantasy Cultivation, Underdog Story, Perseverance

anime.title: Love Flops
anime.genres: Comedy, Ecchi, Harem, Romance, School, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis:
In the near future when technology has significantly advanced, a famous AI TV fortune teller seemingly foresees high school student Asahi Kashiwagi's day with pinpoint accuracy. On his way to school, he encounters Aoi Izumisawa, Bai Mongfa, Karin Istel, Amelia Irving, and Ilya Ilyukhin. Despite meeting them for the first time, Asahi suddenly receives love confessions from all of them at the end of the same day, perfectly aligning with the fortune teller's prediction.

As if that was not enough, Asahi soon learns that these five individuals are actually candidates to become his bride, and they have been invited by his father to live at Asahi's home. Left with no other choice, he reluctantly allows them to stay, resulting in a bawdy turn of events that brightens up his average high school life.

However, as Asahi spends more time with them, forgotten memories gradually resurface. While uncovering the hidden truth, Asahi begins to believe that his fate with these potential partners might be more than just mere coincidence.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided regarding Renai Flops. Many found the initial harem setup generic and off-putting, while others appreciated the plot twists and deconstruction of tropes in the second half. The rushed character development and pacing issues detracted from the overall experience for some, although the ending was generally considered satisfactory. Ultimately, the show's success depends on individual tolerance for harem tropes and appreciation for its attempts at subversion.
pros: Plot twists subvert harem tropes
Interesting exploration of technology/reality themes
Satisfying ending for those who enjoyed the harem aspects
cons: Generic and tropey first half
Rushed character development in the first half
Plot holes and pacing issues in the second half
Ecchi content feels lackluster and inconsistent

anime.title: Engage Kiss
anime.synopsis:
Bayron City, a pioneering metropolis built on a newly discovered energy source, promises every citizen a luxurious and comfortable lifestyle. In reality, young demon exterminator Shuu Ogata's life is far from extravagant. Despite running a private military business, he often struggles to make ends meet due to reckless expenses. Fortunately, Kisara, his demon partner, is more than eager to help Shuu with household matters—albeit a little too forcefully for his comfort.

The two work side by side, taking countermeasures against demon hazards, which stand as the biggest threats to the city. With danger lurking in the shadows, Shuu and Kisara strive to grant the town's safety; however, exterminating the possessed comes with a price unbeknownst to others.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with some finding 'Engage Kiss' to be a hidden gem due to its action, animation, and some emotional depth, while others criticize it for poor pacing, generic characters, and an unlikable protagonist. The series is seen as having potential that was not fully realized, with inconsistent execution and reliance on overused tropes. Many reviewers highlight the disconnect between the initial rom-com vibe and the later melodramatic elements.
pros: High-quality animation and fight scenes, especially from A-1 Pictures.
Interesting world and story concept with potential, blending romance, action, and sci-fi elements.
Well-executed emotional scenes and backstories that add depth to characters.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and the story tries to do too much in too few episodes, leading to a rushed or messy plot.
Mediocre or generic characters with underdeveloped motivations, making it hard to connect with them.
Poor world-building and the plot is often predictable or clichéd, relying on tired harem tropes.
Protagonist is unlikable or frustrating, with questionable morals and actions.
anime.thematic_vibe: Action Harem, Demon Hunting, Dysfunctional Romance

anime.title: Three Thousand Roads
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis:
Locked into a relentless duel, cultivation experts Cang Di and Song Yu fight each other until both reach their final breaths. However, just before perishing, Song Yu finds a wandering soul and decides to use the last of his powers to revive it. Now placing his trust in this unsuspecting individual, Song Yu instills his own sword skills and medicinal knowledge onto the soul.

Transmigrating into a cultivation world as Xu Wuzhou, the son-in-law of the Qin family, the wandering soul now finds himself in a slew of embarrassing troubles, thanks to the preposterous acts of his body's previous owner. Nevertheless, Xu Wuzhou is determined to prove himself a worthy member of the Qin family, and his newfound skills could be the secret to unlocking his full potential.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed with some viewers enjoying the MC's scheming personality and the potential of the story, while others find the MC foolish and the plot disjointed. Some find the series enjoyable despite its flaws, while others are disappointed by the lack of depth and meaningful relationships. The show is considered a decent promotion for the novel, but not a standout anime.
pros: The MC, Xu Wuzhou, is more developed and his actions are more reasonable compared to similar MCs.
The MC's inner persona is scheming yet sensible, with a strong sense of self-respect.
Story is typical with good execution.
The story has very good potential to get better further down.
The animation of this dongua is great
cons: MC was a fool and worthless.
MC is always overestimating himself and fooling around.
Anime has a lot of extra motions for fighting moves
The story is average.
The episodes are short, and this is not enough to introduce the entire background of the story
Scenes are not continuous and random.
The MC did not build any meaningful relationship after he reincarnated into another guy's body.

anime.title: Level 1 Demon Lord and One Room Hero
anime.romaji_title: Lv1 Maou to One Room Yuusha
anime.synopsis:
After the climactic battle to decide the fate of humanity, the hero Max, alongside his party, emerges victorious against the formidable Demon Lord. As he draws his last breath, the defeated Maou vows to return more powerful than ever to take his revenge.

Ten years later, although Maou has resurrected, the process is incomplete, resulting in him taking on the form of a child. Nevertheless, not wanting to waste another second, Maou pays his nemesis a visit—but the hero who once gallantly protected humankind from the demon's clutches is now a pitiful slob bearing no resemblance to a man of his former caliber.

Despite his disappointment, Maou moves in with Max in hope of building him back up into a worthy adversary. But as the demon learns more about the events that transpired in the decade of his absence, he realizes that there is a story behind Max's downfall that he knows nothing of.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, with many praising the show's surprising depth, heartfelt character interactions, and unique deconstruction of fantasy tropes. However, some viewers find the heavy reliance on fan service and the later shift to political themes to be detriments, leading to a moderate level of division on its overall quality.
pros: Engaging and heartfelt character writing, particularly for the main duo.
Deconstructs fantasy tropes to explore themes of post-heroism and societal expectations.
Strong chemistry and dynamic between the main characters.
Surprising depth and emotional resonance beyond its comedic premise.
Good voice acting and expressive animation, especially in later episodes.
Unique and entertaining premise that subverts expectations.
cons: Excessive and sometimes distracting fan service, primarily focused on Zenia.
Pacing issues, with the plot taking time to develop or feeling inconsistent.
The shift towards political thriller elements in later parts can feel jarring and disconnected from the initial premise.
Max's character can be perceived as too passive or unmotivated, even for a 'washed-up' hero.
The rapid transition from medieval to modern Japan in ten years feels abrupt to some.

anime.title: Tonari no Yokai-san
anime.synopsis:
In the town of Engamori, supernatural beings known as yokai, gods, and humans have been living amongst each other for centuries, each striving to lead ordinary, peaceful lives. One day Buchio, a 20-year-old cat, mysteriously evolves into a nekomata, a feline yokai, near the end of his life. Although this allows him to stay with his human family longer, it also makes him question the reason behind his evolution, along with the special abilities that have recently manifested in himl.

Meanwhile, an elementary school girl named Mutsumi "Muu-chan" Sugimoto begins to feel more attached to Jirou, a tengu—a crow-like yokai—and Jirou begins to fill the void left by her late father. While both are unable to properly communicate their intentions at first, they gradually form a companionship where they protect each other.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, "Tonari no Youkai-san" is well-received as a heartwarming slice-of-life anime with supernatural elements. Viewers praise its beautiful art, well-developed characters, and exploration of emotional themes like love and grief. While some find certain character relationships frustrating or character designs confusing, the majority appreciate the show's ability to create a peaceful yet intriguing world.
pros: Beautiful art style and animation (skillfully rendered)
Well-developed characters that are easy to love/understand
Intriguing world-building with a good balance of calm and underlying sinister elements
Soundtrack syncs perfectly with the viewer's emotions.
Exploration of various types of love and grief, resonating with viewers on a personal level.
cons: Character designs can be too similar, leading to confusion
Some aspects of the story feel abrupt
Certain character relationships (e.g., Mutsumi and Jiro) can be frustrating for some viewers

anime.title: Farming Life in Another World
anime.synopsis: During the final years of his life, Hiraku Machio remained confined to a hospital bed with a terminal illness until he finally passed away. Taking pity on the unfair life he lived, a god decides to reincarnate Hiraku in another world where he can live as he pleases. Wanting to try farming in this new life, he is bestowed with an all-in-one "Almighty Farming Tool" that can transform into any useful implement he wishes. Hiraku is then transported to a forest seemingly far from civilization. Here, he plans to build and farm everything from scratch—gradually developing the lifeless area into a thriving new society.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers find the show relaxing, wholesome, and enjoyable for its laid-back atmosphere and focus on farming and village development. However, others criticize it for lacking depth, having a repetitive plot, and failing to develop its characters or harem elements effectively, leading to a polarized view on its overall quality.
pros: Relaxing and laid-back atmosphere
Appealing to those who enjoy farming simulators or homesteading themes
Good world progression and immersion with village development
Some find the art style fitting and visually appealing
cons: Repetitive or bland content
Lack of depth in plot and character development
Over-reliance on monologue
Harem elements feel underdeveloped or confusing
Pacing issues, with events happening too quickly
Uninspired or average voice acting and animation

anime.title: The Little Lies We All Tell
anime.genres: Comedy, Crossdressing, Gag Humor, School, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis: What do an alien, former ninja, weak telepath, and boy pretending to be a girl have in common? They are all classmates at Kashihara Girls' Academy, and they hide their true identities from the world. Rikka, Chiyo, Sekine, and Tsubasa seem like the best of friends, but they each harbor a monumental secret that they cannot reveal, no matter what. In order to continue masquerading as normal middle school girls, each of them must invent creative ways to conceal their true selves. But that is easier said than done, as the four students end up entangled in numerous shenanigans along the way.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds '4-nin wa Sorezore Uso wo Tsuku' to be a fun and enjoyable comedy anime, especially for those who appreciate absurdist humor and well-defined characters. While the plot is weak and the animation isn't stellar, the show's comedic timing and character interactions are praised. Some find the humor hit-or-miss, but overall, it's considered a lighthearted and entertaining watch.
pros: Unique and well-defined characters with strong chemistry.
Episodic format allows for consistently funny and crazy situations.
Effective use of Japanese comedy tropes in a digestible manner.
cons: Plot is mostly non-existent and repetitive.
Jokes can be over-explained and grow old.
Animation and art style are bland and lack detail.

anime.title: The Fruit of Evolution: Before I Knew It, My Life Had It Made Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Shin Shinka no Mi: Shiranai Uchi ni Kachigumi Jinsei
anime.synopsis:
Thanks to the Fruit of Evolution, Seiichi Hiiragi's amazing new life in another world allows him to meet dependable allies and create formidable spells. His abilities catch the attention of Barnabus Ablitt, the principal of the Barbador Academy of Magic, who invites Seiichi to become a teacher at the institution. Coincidentally, Seiichi's classmates from Earth are enrolled there, which will lead to an awkward reunion if he is to meet them.

Behind the scenes, however, an enigmatic cult called The Great Devil Order devises a sinister scheme to resurrect their deity and sacrifice the students of Barbador to hasten the process. As Seiichi's power is second to none, it is up to him to protect not only his friends but also the entire world from the looming darkness.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Shin Shinka no Mi is overwhelmingly considered a significant drop in quality compared to the first.  Reviewers express disappointment with the poor animation, nonsensical plot, and cringe-worthy humor. Many feel it disrespects the source material and wastes its potential, leading to a largely negative reception and strong recommendations against watching it.
pros: Catchy opening and ending songs
Some enjoy it as a 'so bad it's good' experience
Slightly better production values than Season 1
cons: Abysmal animation quality with choppy movements and bland backgrounds
One-dimensional or annoying characters
Poorly executed new elements that disrupt the pacing
Overuse of tired isekai tropes
Incoherent storytelling with a lack of continuity
Forced and irritating comedy
Disrespects the source material's storyline
Unsatisfying plot resolutions and emotional moments
Lack of character development and worldbuilding

anime.title: Masamune-kun's Revenge R
anime.synopsis:
With the tumultuous cultural festival behind him, Masamune Makabe continues his efforts to carry out his revenge: to make the "Cruel Princess" Aki Adagaki deeply fall for him and then immediately dump her. As his class is going on a trip to Paris, widely known as the City of Love, Masamune has the perfect opportunity to get even for his childhood heartbreak.

Before Masamune can impress Aki, the two meet Muriel Besson, a French high school otaku who aspires to create a romantic comedy manga series. Muriel believes Masamune is the ideal model for the protagonist and asks for his help. The boy reluctantly agrees, dragging Aki along to provide inspiration for the love interest's character. But to do so, the two must show Muriel what Japanese love is like.

To make matters more complicated, Kanetsugu Gasou is masquerading as Aki's childhood friend, Masamune, to trick and use her. With mix-ups and love rivals galore, Masamune's revenge is proving to be quite the difficult task.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is divided, with some praising the conclusive ending and improved plot twists compared to the first season. However, many viewers found the character development and plot progression confusing, inconsistent, and frustrating. While some appreciate the unique and unpredictable elements, others are disappointed by what they perceive as a decline in quality and nonsensical character decisions.
pros: Satisfying ending to the story arc.
Improved upon the first season's plot with funny twists.
Good pacing in the second season with the story moving forward.
cons: Character development is questionable and sometimes nonsensical.
Some parts of the plot feel confusing, rushed, or unnecessary.
Inconsistent character behavior, making them seem annoying or unrealistic.

anime.title: Millenniums Of Warring States
anime.synopsis: Ji Qing, the anchor of Gaowan, took the plug-in "Shaohao Bone" to travel through the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period. However, the trajectory of history deviates, Jing Ke succeeded in stabbing Qin in Xianyang Palace, the seven kingdoms rose together, and the Warring States lasted for a thousand years. Heroes and Ren Yong coexist with hundreds of science and technology, and family loyalty and heroes are upholding. Let's see Ji Qing, the immortal, who left Yongcheng, entered the school palace, and used Jiuli's capital to roam the chaotic world.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience seems cautiously optimistic about Zhan Qiannian. The combination of isekai elements with Chinese cultivation and historical drama settings is intriguing.  The protagonist's balanced power progression is appreciated, though some viewers may find the political debates tedious.
pros: Interesting premise with a mix of Isekai and Chinese cultivation elements
MC has a cheat, but it's not overpowered and requires effort to utilize
Setting and presentation are similar to historical dramas
cons: Potentially long-winded political debates

anime.title: Tonikawa: Over The Moon For You - Uniform
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Tonikaku Kawaii released Fall 2022.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the 'Seifuku' OVA, appreciating the balance of romance and comedy and the character development between Nasa and Tsukasa.  Many viewers noted improvements in the art and animation quality. The episode is seen as a positive sign for the upcoming second season, maintaining the series' original charm and heartwarming feel.
pros: Improved art and animation quality compared to the first season, particularly character designs.
Well-balanced mix of romance and comedy.
Character growth and development, showing a shift towards a deeper relationship between the main characters.
Maintained the light-hearted and charming style of the series.
cons: Some found the romance scenes a bit more passionate than previous episodes, though this was not necessarily a negative.
One review noted that the art and animation were only average, like the first season, contradicting claims of improvement.

anime.title: Attack on Titan: Final Season - The Final Chapters
anime.romaji_title: Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final Season - Kanketsu-hen
anime.genres: Action, Drama, Gore, Military, Shounen, Survival, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
In the wake of Eren Yeager's cataclysmic actions, his friends and former enemies form an alliance against his genocidal rampage. Though once bitter foes, Armin Arlert, Mikasa Ackerman, and the remaining members of the Scout Regiment join forces with Reiner Braun and the survivors of the Marleyan military. Their meager united front sets out on a mission to stop Eren's wrath and—if possible—save their old comrade in the process.

As Eren pushes forward at any cost, he battles his own internal turmoil. Although he feels immense remorse over his horrific invasion, Eren believes he harbors noble intentions: he believes the path ahead is the only way to save his friends and, to a greater extent, his people.

The opposing battalions spiral toward an inevitable final clash that may claim the lives of millions. Though they face an army of monsters beyond anything they could have previously imagined, Mikasa, Armin, and their allies stand brave in the face of certain doom.
anime.consensus_summary: The ending of 'Attack on Titan: The Final Season' is highly divisive, with many viewers expressing disappointment and frustration over character development and plot resolution. While some appreciate the exploration of philosophical themes, the prevailing sentiment is one of dissatisfaction, with the ending failing to live up to the expectations set by the earlier seasons and a considerable portion of the audience felt betrayed by the ending. The series' legacy is now tainted with an ending that is actively disliked among a significant portion of its long-term fans.
pros: Strong animation quality, especially in action sequences (MAPPA)
Compelling story initially with mysteries and theories
Exploration of complex themes such as freedom, morality, and the human condition
cons: Disappointing and rushed ending
Character assassination, particularly Eren's
Plot holes and inconsistencies introduced in later seasons
Ending thematically felt unearned given earlier seasons
Political commentary at the end felt ideologically driven

anime.title: The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls: U149
anime.synopsis:
Mature grade school student Arisu Tachibana is an aspiring idol who receives an invitation from her company president to participate in the Third Entertainment Section—a new idol project. Arisu and eight other young girls soon meet their producer before beginning idol-related activities.

To the girls' surprise, their producer appears to be a childlike adult and nothing like what they had imagined. The producer, who is taking on the position for the first time, also had no idea that he would be meeting a group of short, young idols. The awkward situation leaves Arisu disappointed, and she wishes for a producer change.

However, the producer, with his genuine love for idols and his desire to see them shine, will not let this opportunity pass and expresses that he is serious about working with the girls. Thankfully, the young idols accept the producer after seeing his unwavering passion for idols, serving as the start of their journey to the stage of dreams.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves 'U149' for its beautiful animation, well-developed characters, and heartwarming stories, making it a good entry point to the Idolmaster franchise. Some find the occasional inappropriate jokes or the CG animation during dance scenes to be a minor drawback. A few viewers also find the themes exploring the darker sides of the idol industry to be conflicting.
pros: Visually stunning animation and creative direction.
Well-developed character spotlights with surprising depth.
Effective at creating emotional connections with characters.
Good entry point to the IDOLM@STER franchise.
cons: Occasional inappropriate jokes that are out of place.
Dance scenes utilize CG animation which is inferior to hand-drawn animation.
Potentially disturbing elements related to the idol industry's exploitation of young girls.

anime.title: Blood and Heart: The Legendary Life of a Japanese Youth in China
anime.synopsis: This work tells the legendary life of Megumi Sunahara, a Chinese People's Liberation Army soldier of Japanese descent, introducing the true history of this little-known special group of PLA members of Japanese descent. He was born in Kyushu, Japan in 1933, and came to Northeast China with his parents when he was young. After Japan's defeat and surrender, he was unable to return to Japan and lived in a landlord's house in Liaoning herding cattle. In 1948, Megumi Sunahara joined the PLA under the name "Zhang Rongqing", and he experienced the Liaoshen and Pingjin campaigns and devoted himself to the proletarian revolutionary cause while contributing to other battles in the Chinese Civil War and the Korean War.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is somewhat divided on Xue Yu Xin. While some appreciate the captivating narrative and historical context, others are critical of its potential bias and lack of depth. The show's portrayal of historical events, particularly regarding the relationship between China and Japan, appears to be a point of contention.
pros: Captivating narrative
Interesting historical context
cons: Lacks depth and clarity
Feels like propaganda at times
Potential for boredom if not interested in history

anime.title: My Happy Marriage
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Fantasy, Historical, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Misery seems everlasting in Miyo Saimori's life. Born from an arranged marriage, she was quickly discarded after her mother's tragic death. Her father remarried, and her younger half-sister Kaya received all the affection, while Miyo was degraded to a lowly servant. Lacking the strength to fight against her family's abuse, Miyo loses hope that her luck will ever turn.

Unexpectedly, Miyo's father summons her to deliver surprising news: she is to marry Kiyoka Kudou, the head of the distinguished Kudou family. Despite his noble background, Kiyoka is known to be a callous man who has thus far dismissed all of his former fiancées.

Upon arriving at the Kudou household, Miyo expects coarse treatment and to be tossed aside. However, contrary to her assumptions, Kiyoka shows her the kindness and love that she has desperately needed. Marrying Kiyoka may be Miyo's one chance to break free from her neglectful family and embrace a life of happiness.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While the show boasts beautiful animation and explores themes of trauma, many find the plot weak, the characters inconsistent, and the supernatural elements unnecessary. Some viewers appreciate the romance and emotional depth, while others find it forced and unfulfilling.
pros: Beautiful animation and character design
Excellent voice acting, particularly for Miyo
Addresses delicate subjects like abuse and trauma with sensitivity
cons: Weak plot and pacing
Inconsistent character development, especially Miyo regressing
Unnecessary supernatural elements detract from the story
Romance feels forced and lacks chemistry

anime.title: Witch Hat Atelier
anime.synopsis:
In a world where witches wield breathtaking magic, Coco, coming from a humble background, often wishes she were born one herself. After all, the secret behind casting magic is strictly guarded from non-witches. But when Coco manages to catch a glimpse of the witch Qifrey casting a spell, her revelation on the truth behind magic drastically alters the course of her life.

However, Coco's curiosity pays a steep price when a disastrous spell cast in ignorance brings a tragic fate upon her beloved mother. Qifrey takes the shaken girl in, recognizing both her resolve to save her mother and her link to a group of forbidden magic heretics. Secrets are a heavy burden, and between navigating a society that views her as an uninvited guest and mastering the art of magic, Coco must give her all to prove her worth as a witch.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences are highly divided on Witch Hat Atelier, with near-universal praise for its breathtaking animation and unique magic system often contrasted with significant disappointment in its underdeveloped story and pacing. While some find the depth and thematic exploration compelling, others feel the narrative fails to deliver on its visual promise, leaving them with a sense of incompleteness and frustration.
pros: Stunning animation and high production quality, with meticulous attention to detail in every frame and movement.
Visually exquisite aesthetic with impressive art direction and clothing designs.
Creative and well-developed magic system with hard rules and defined mechanics.
Atmospheric storytelling that effectively blends a bright magical world with underlying darkness.
Coco is a relatable and endearing protagonist, allowing the audience to experience the fantasy world through her eyes.
cons: Story is underdeveloped, lacking clear direction, a cohesive message, or conclusive plot points, often feeling like an unfinished appetizer.
Pacing is frequently criticized as too slow or inconsistent, with too much talking and lingering, even in high-stress situations.
Character development is lacking, with many characters feeling one-dimensional, generic, or inconsistently written.
Coco's character arc is flawed, particularly her lack of visible trauma or urgency regarding her mother's fate.
The ending is abrupt and unsatisfying, ending on a cliffhanger that feels like a cheap ploy for a second season.

anime.title: D4DJ All Mix
anime.synopsis:
Arisugawa Academy's DJ unit Lyrical Lily is known for bringing smiles to people's faces through music. Thanks to their efforts, the local city hall requests them to perform monthly for a year as part of Operation Beckoning Cat, the town revitalization project.

Unfortunately, given the long and demanding event, Lyrical Lily wonders if they can successfully meet the expectations placed on them. To better their chances, they decide to invite the DJ units that supported them during their first performance: Happy Around, Photo Maiden, Peaky P-key, Rondo, and Merm4id. Intrigued by the opportune event, the other units gladly accept Lyrical Lily's request.

However, the project is extremely demanding. To attract visitors and new residents to the town, the energetic girls of the participating DJ units must give their best to create a memorable experience for their audiences.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is divided. Some appreciate the artistic animation and character variety. However, many find the plot weak and the attempt to develop multiple groups within a short season unsuccessful, leading to a downgrade from the first season.
pros: Artistically great animation quality by SANZIGEN.
Characters shine in loads of ways.
cons: Weak plot with too many characters to develop properly.
Downgrade from the first season in almost every way.
Confusing mess of a story due to trying to develop multiple groups in just 12 episodes.
Opening song is not comparable to the first season.
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Culture, Music Performance, Group Dynamics

anime.title: Ao no Orchestra
anime.synopsis:
Once a prize-winning violin prodigy, Hajime gave up on music after his father, professional violinist Ryuuji Aono, was involved in a scandal that led the media to harass his family. Now living alone with his mother and entering his final year of middle school, Hajime struggles to find a new career path. However, the sound of his classmate Ritsuko Akine playing the violin inspires Hajime to dream of a musical career once more.

With the help of Ritsuko, Hajime prepares to take the entrance exam for the prestigious Umimaku High School. But if he wishes to join Umimaku's orchestra, Hajime must overcome his past trauma and open himself up to new musical horizons.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, Ao no Orchestra is viewed as an enjoyable anime, especially for those with an interest in classical music or personal growth stories. While the narrative and characters are praised for their realism and emotional depth, the poor CGI during performances is a significant drawback for many viewers. The series is considered a hidden gem, though not without its flaws.
pros: Engrossing story with well-written characters that feel real and relatable.
Authentic friendships and a realistic portrayal of teenagers using music as an outlet.
Insightful exploration of the world of orchestra and technical aspects of classical music.
Good voice acting contributing to the realistic feel.
cons: CGI during musical performances is often poor and detracts from the experience.
Some arcs focusing on side characters feel underdeveloped and boring.
Story development can be slow at times.
Repetitive musical pieces.

anime.title: In Another World With My Smartphone 2
anime.romaji_title: Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni. 2
anime.genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Harem, Isekai, Romance
anime.synopsis:
Touya Mochizuki grows accustomed to his new life in another world. Armed with his trusty smartphone, the teenager accepts small quests at his leisure while spending time with his new fiancées: Yumina Urnea Belfast, Yae Kokonoe, and twin sisters Linse and Elze Shileska. But even in a relaxing environment, Touya is only beginning to understand the responsibilities that come with these engagements.

In addition to his romantic woes, the elder fairy Lean wishes to locate the remaining pieces of Babylon, the floating island that the mysterious Professor Regina Babylon created five thousand years ago. Touya reluctantly accepts her request and seeks out the teleportation circles that will lead to the islands. However, strange monsters have emerged—possibly powerful enough to destroy the world. In order to save the second life he was given, Touya must weaponize ancient technologies to fight these monsters—all while balancing his overwhelming number of relationships.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in its lighthearted and easy-to-watch nature, while others criticize its poor animation, generic plot, and misogynistic elements. Many find it to be a trashy but enjoyable isekai, while others consider it a waste of time due to its lack of originality and depth. The show seems to cater to fans of the genre who are looking for a simple and unchallenging viewing experience.
pros: Easy and fun to watch.
Fast-paced progression.
Lighthearted tone provides a refreshing viewing experience.
cons: Poor animation quality and off-model faces.
Repetitive and predictable plot.
Overused harem tropes with little character development.
Misogynistic portrayal of female characters.

anime.title: The Unwanted Undead Adventurer
anime.synopsis:
While exploring a labyrinth, Rentt Faina, an adventurer with lots of experience but little to show for it, is killed by a dragon upon discovering its lair. Shockingly, he wakes up to find himself turned into a skeleton, the lowest class of undead monsters. As Rentt fights against the other monsters of the labyrinth, he discovers that slaying them gains him experience towards higher stages of undead evolution—even ones with flesh! With this revelation in hand, Rentt obtains a new objective in his undeath: keep evolving in the hope of eventually becoming a vampire, the highest form of undead that is nearly indistinguishable from human beings.

Despite being forced to hide his past identity and monstrous nature under an unremovable mask, Rentt manages to return to a semblance of his former life. Granted shelter by Lorraine Vivier, an elite researcher and retired adventurer, Rentt assumes her surname and starts over from scratch as a rookie. Determined to pursue his childhood dream and become a mithril-class adventurer, Rentt must be cautious not to disclose his new bodily circumstances, lest the adventurers’ guild seek to exterminate the monster he has become.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Nozomanu Fushi no Boukensha' to be a relaxing and enjoyable fantasy anime, particularly praising its character development and slice-of-life elements. Some viewers find the pacing slow and note inconsistencies in animation quality. While not groundbreaking, it's considered a solid and comforting watch for fans of the genre, with a dedicated following anticipating a potential second season.
pros: Well-developed characters and their interactions
Enjoyable slice-of-life adventuring
Unique premise with a focus on character growth and humanity
cons: Slow pacing and potential for filler episodes
Inconsistent animation quality
Underdeveloped exploration of the protagonist's undead nature
Comedy can fall flat

anime.title: Shaman King: Flowers
anime.synopsis: The story will center on You and Anna's son, Hana.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with nostalgia playing a significant role. While some appreciate the tonal consistency and engaging plot, many find the adaptation generic and underdeveloped, especially in terms of lore and character depth. The pacing and unanswered questions leave viewers wanting more but uncertain about a potential second season.
pros: Tonally consistent with the original series.
Engaging main plot with intrigue.
Some fun and berserk moments.
cons: Generic animation and voice acting.
Underdeveloped lore and story explanations.
Pacing issues with a rushed narrative.
Characters feel bland and generic.

anime.title: Onimai: I'm Now Your Sister!
anime.genres: CGDCT, Comedy, Magical Sex Shift, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Self-professed "home security guard" Mahiro Oyama has not left his home in years, secluding himself in his room playing erotic visual novels. This depraved lifestyle causes his prodigious sister, Mihari, to worry about his well-being. In hopes of solving this problem, she devises a plan to rehabilitate him back to normalcy.

The first part of Mihari's plan is to concoct a medicine that changes her brother's biological constitution into a bona fide female, much to Mahiro's vehement dismay. Stuck in this predicament, Mahiro has no choice but to live out his life as a cute girl until the effect wears off—if it ever does.
anime.consensus_summary: Oniichan wa Oshimai! is a polarizing anime due to its gender-bender premise and initial fanservice, but many viewers find it to be a heartwarming and well-animated slice-of-life story about self-acceptance. The high-quality animation by Studio Bind is consistently praised, while some critique the passive protagonist and potentially questionable content. Overall, the audience is divided on whether the show's positive aspects outweigh its potentially problematic elements.
pros: High-quality animation by Studio Bind
Heartwarming and funny story about self-acceptance and growth
Engaging and well-developed characters
cons: Potentially off-putting premise and initial fanservice
Some find the protagonist passive and lacking agency
Questionable scenes and sexualization of characters may be uncomfortable for some viewers

anime.title: Play It Cool, Guys
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Iyashikei, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis: Despite their distinctive personalities, Souma Shiki, Hayate Ichikura, Shun Futami, and Takayuki Mima all have one thing in common: though naturally clumsy, the four disguise their embarrassment from tiny slip-ups by maintaining a composed demeanor. However, it is actually the guys' airheaded natures that makes the girls' hearts throb. No matter what happens in their daily lives, the boys do their best not to lose their cool!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Cool Doji Danshi' to be a delightful and comforting slice-of-life anime. Viewers appreciate the relatable characters, the positive friendships, and the lighthearted humor. The show is praised for its ability to create a wholesome and healing experience, although some wish the episodes were longer.
pros: Relatable characters and situations
Comforting and healing to watch
Positive portrayal of friendship
Unique premise: 'Cool Guys Doing Clumsy Things'
Charming and heart-warming interactions
cons: Episodes are too short
Lacks a deep or complex plot
Some find the premise basic or repetitive

anime.title: Sword Quest
anime.synopsis: The world says I am incompetent, but who knows that I am actually the greatest swordsman in the world? What does it matter to me if I am a son-in-law, let's see my sword sweep the world and break the sky!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly negative due to the show's extremely short episodes, low-budget feel, and generic plot. Viewers find the experience frustrating, especially with the seasonal format. There is little positive sentiment, with most criticism focused on the production quality and lack of substantial content.
cons: Very short episodes with minimal content.
Poor execution of a generic plot.
Low budget animation quality.
Seasonal release makes the short content even more frustrating.

anime.title: My Daughter is a Zombie
anime.synopsis: One year after an unprecedented zombie attack that killed hundreds of thousands, South Korea has finally been declared zombie-free. But Jeonghwan holds a secret: his daughter is the last zombie left on earth. When her cravings are satisfied and her violent tendencies die down, it almost seems like there's hope for her to have a normal life. But how long can he keep Su-ah a secret from everyone else?
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is praised for being a heartwarming and faithful adaptation of the original webtoon. However, it suffers from a low animation budget and limited accessibility. Overall, fans of the webtoon are happy with the adaptation's existence, despite its shortcomings.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the webtoon
Heartwarming story
cons: Low animation budget
Limited availability due to region lock and lack of subtitles

anime.title: Nights with a Cat
anime.synopsis: Fuuta-kun has never owned a cat before, but his younger sister, Pii-chan, moves into his house with the round gray cat Kyuruga. Inexperienced with cats, Fuuta-kun has no idea what to expect, and each night after he returns home is marked by odd and endearing surprises from his new pet.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, particularly among cat owners who find the show relatable and enjoyable. Viewers appreciate the short, cute episodes that capture the quirks of living with a cat. While some note the simplicity of the show, most find it to be a charming and relaxing experience.
pros: Relatable experiences for cat owners
Short and easy to watch
Cute art style and music
Accurate portrayal of cat behavior
Soothing and comedic
cons: Episodes are very short
Not enough material for longer episodes
Simplistic art style may not appeal to everyone
Lacks drama or intrigue

anime.title: Kamikatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Parody, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Under the belief that the omnipotent god Mitama will come to save him, Yukito Urabe participates in a ritual to become the new leader of his father's cult. But when the boy drowns during the ritual, he wishes to be reborn in a world without gods or religion.

Reawakening in a completely different world devoid of spirituality. He meets a deviant girl named Aruaru, who introduces him to her village. However, his idyllic image of this world's society is short-lived when he witnesses a public group suicide and learns of the country's end-of-life system: at any moment, the government may order any citizen to die.

Aruaru and her sister are forcibly taken for execution soon after, prompting Yukito to rush to their rescue—but to no avail. In a moment of desperation, Yukito recalls his father's teachings and utters a prayer for Mitama to save them. Seemingly answering his call, a little girl descends from the sky and annihilates everyone who harmed Yukito and his friends. To Yukito's surprise, the girl introduces herself as Mitama.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinion is sharply divided, primarily over the show's intentional use of 'bad' CGI and its extreme, often crude, dark humor. While many praise its unpredictable narrative, unique concept, and high-quality voice acting as a brilliant "shitpost" isekai, others are put off by the juvenile humor, jarring tonal shifts, and the consistently poor CGI, finding it simply bad rather than intentionally funny.
pros: Intentional, humorous, and high-quality shitposting/parody of the isekai genre.
Excellent voice acting performances that convey genuine enjoyment.
Unpredictable plot twists and a unique, bizarre, and often hilarious narrative direction.
Engaging dark comedy that makes fun of serious topics like religion and fascism.
Unique concept that stands out from typical isekai tropes.
cons: Extremely poor and intentionally bad CGI that significantly detracts from the viewing experience for many.
Some find the humor juvenile, cringe-worthy, and overly reliant on sex-related jokes and fan service.
The MC is considered by some to be a typical, uninteresting anime loser.
The tonal shift to dark and brutal elements can feel jarring and inappropriate for the otherwise comedic tone.
Censorship issues in scenes that arguably should have been more explicit, given the show's themes.

anime.title: A Galaxy Next Door
anime.genres: Childcare, Otaku Culture, Romance, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Ichirou Kuga has suddenly found himself taking on the responsibility of caring for his two younger siblings after their father's untimely death. To make ends meet, Ichirou rents out rooms in the apartment complex he inherited and works full-time as a shoujo manga artist. However, his manga sales are low, his assistants have recently left, and deadlines are fast approaching.

As stress threatens to overtake Ichirou, salvation comes in the form of an extremely competent novice artist, Shiori Goshiki, who becomes his new assistant. With her skills, they are able to tide over the difficult situation, and things begin looking up. But in a bizarre accident, a supernatural experience unfolds between Ichirou and Shirou, which leads her to declare them engaged.

With this seemingly innocuous action upending his life, Ichirou now has to manage his new and peculiar relationship with the mysterious girl, all the while following his own passion and fulfilling the duties that rest on his shoulders.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Otonari ni Ginga' to be a wholesome and heartwarming romance, especially appealing to those tired of high school-aged romance. However, some find the pacing too slow and the plot lacking depth, with the supernatural elements feeling tacked on. While the characters are likable, some criticize the protagonist's generic personality and the animation's inconsistencies.
pros: Mature romance with working-age characters, making it relatable
Healthy relationship development between the leads with realistic conversations
Heartwarming depiction of the protagonist's relationship with his siblings
Simple and sweet diabetic filled wholesomeness
The romance actually starts pretty early
cons: Slow pacing that can feel boring at times
Predictable plot with a lack of depth and substance
Supernatural elements feel unnecessary and not well-integrated
Generic protagonist with a lack of individual character
Animation quality is inconsistent with noticeable shortcuts

anime.title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
anime.romaji_title: Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu
anime.synopsis:
As the first commoner to attend the prestigious Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White is immediately met with contempt from some of the students hailing from nobility. Unbeknownst to them, Ray's real identity is that of the famous Iceblade Sorcerer—a hero who led the country to victory in a past war and is one of the seven strongest sorcerers alive. Despite his legendary status, Ray wants nothing more than to live out the ordinary school life he never had.

Ray quickly makes friends with some of the most influential students thanks to his kind and amiable nature. Unfortunately, as those with nefarious motives begin to make their move, Ray may soon have no choice but to use his true power to preserve the bonds that make his new life worthwhile.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in the show's lightheartedness and likeable protagonist, while others criticize its reliance on tired tropes and subpar production quality. The show is considered average with some viewers finding it surprisingly enjoyable despite its flaws. Most agree it had wasted potential.
pros: Likeable protagonist who isn't afraid to be charming or interact with female characters.
Enjoyable blend of slice-of-life, harem, and fantasy elements.
Potential in the magic system and overall world-building.
cons: Generic and trope-filled plot with an overpowered main character.
Mediocre animation and dated art style.
Rushed pacing and lack of meaningful character development for secondary characters.

anime.title: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Cosmos the Movie
anime.romaji_title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Cosmos Movie
anime.synopsis: The final battle for the Sailor Guardians begins as they face Sailor Iron Mouse, Sailor Aluminum Siren, Sailor Lead Crow, Sailor Tin Nyanko and more.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Sailor Moon Cosmos is mixed. While many appreciate its faithfulness to the manga, improved animation, and emotional moments, several critics point to pacing issues, underdeveloped characters, and a lack of emotional depth compared to the original anime. Long-time fans of the manga are more likely to enjoy it, while newcomers may find it confusing.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the manga's Stars arc, improving upon certain elements.
Visually stunning animation, especially in key scenes and transformations.
Strong voice acting performances, particularly Kotono Mitsuishi as Usagi.
Effective use of music to enhance emotional scenes.
Improved pacing compared to previous Crystal seasons and Eternal movies (especially in part 2).
cons: Pacing issues in the first movie, feeling rushed and incoherent.
Underdeveloped Starlights and Animamates due to limited screen time.
Inconsistent tone and jarring scene transitions.
Over-reliance on stock footage.
Lack of emotional depth and character bonding compared to the original 90s anime.
Disappointing OST compared to the original anime's soundtrack.
Inconsistent character personalities.

anime.title: Everlasting God Of Sword
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis:
In the world of Jiuyou, Shen Zhenyi, the third son of Abandoned Sword Villa, acquired the ancient martial arts "Wan Zang Sword Sutra", which attracted the coveted of martial arts in the world. The leader of the Demon Sect, Minyiren, fought with him for the sword, but the third son disappeared.

A year later, Abandoned Sword Villa reopened the mountain gate, and Shen Zhenyi asked his disciples to teach the "Wan Zang Sword Sutra" in person! The rivers and lakes are shocked by it!

Chu Huoluo, a female disciple of Lieyang Mansion, became Shen Zhenyi's apprentice by chance. As the master and apprentice broke the puzzle, the crisis was quietly approaching, and when the final conspiracy surfaced, all the reasons pointed to an ancient legend called "Zhanyue Feixian".
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is divided on "Wangu Jian Shen (2022)". Some appreciate the unique cultivation plot and decent animation. However, many find the adaptation rushed and filled with unnecessary filler, detracting from the overall experience. This results in mixed reviews and a moderate level of audience polarization.
pros: Unique cultivation plot
Interesting plot
Animation is not half bad
cons: Rushed adaptation from the original work
Some scenes lack clarification
Filler episodes unnecessarily extend the show

anime.title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Road to the Top
anime.romaji_title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Road to the Top
anime.synopsis:
After making a promise to stand on the top of the Twinkle Series with her trainer as a child, horse girl Narita Top Road has been practicing diligently ever since. After winning several races, Top Road's efforts finally pay off when she earns a chance to participate in the race she has always dreamed of: the first race of the prestigious Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho.

However, winning the Satsuki Sho is no simple task. Numerous brilliant horse girls are also joining the race—including two other rising racers—the flamboyant T.M. Opera O and the reserved Admire Vega, who seeks revenge against Top Road for a previous defeat. Although triumphing in the Satsuki Sho and the rest of the Triple Crown races is far from guaranteed, there is nothing that can stop Top Road on her road to the top.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus leans positively, praising the animation, sound design, and character development within the limited OVA format. Some critics found the story rushed and certain character arcs weaker compared to previous installments, while others appreciated the serious tone and emotional depth. The show is generally well-received as a visually pleasing and heartfelt entry in the Uma Musume franchise.
pros: Visually splendid animation and sound design.
Compelling exploration of talent, hard work, and the reality of losing.
Well-written and developed characters for an OVA, with relatable motives.
Faithful to real-life events and Japanese horse racing details.
Emotional moments and heartfelt experience, with a serious tone.
Strong narrative consistency, despite the short runtime.
cons: Rushed pacing due to the limited number of episodes.
Some characters, like T.M. Opera O, lack sufficient development.
The story basis for the main characters is not the most narratively compelling.
Some viewers found the emotional moments not as impactful as previous seasons.
Admire Vega's situation felt asinine and made her less enjoyable.

anime.title: My Unique Skill Makes Me OP Even at Level 1
anime.romaji_title: Level 1 dakedo Unique Skill de Saikyou desu
anime.synopsis:
As a corporate slave, Ryouta Satou experiences the worst forms of stress, overwork, and loneliness. Even after he is hospitalized due to exhaustion, his days of toil only become worse. Soon enough, the sheer fatigue catches up to him and kills him in his sleep. However, Ryouta is given a second chance at life: he wakes up in another world as a slime drop—much to the surprise of Emily Brown, the petite blonde girl who defeated said slime.

Acquainting himself with the rules of this RPG-like world, Ryouta finds out that he will never grow past level 1. However, he also discovers that one of his skills is at the maximum level: the skill which determines the rarity of monster drops. This allows him to acquire not only items of the best quality, but also some that are unheard of.

Ryouta sets out to make the most of his ability—meeting new friends, grinding through dungeons, and acquiring unique items along the way. Reveling in his new life seems to be the long-awaited and much-deserved reward for all the tribulations he had suffered.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative due to the show's adherence to generic isekai tropes, poor writing, and lack of originality. While some found it mildly entertaining as a brainless diversion, most reviewers criticized its shallow characters, inconsistent world-building, and overall mediocrity. The show is generally considered a low-effort isekai that doesn't stand out from the crowd.
pros: Some viewers found the show enjoyable as a 'turn your brain off' experience.
The relationship between the MC and Emily was seen as wholesome and functional by some.
The show's absurdity and lack of seriousness made it surprisingly watchable for some.
cons: Generic and unoriginal plot with many Isekai cliches.
Poor world-building and inconsistencies in the power system.
Underdeveloped and one-dimensional characters with little to no depth.
Lazy writing with convenient plot devices and illogical scenarios.
Mediocre animation and soundtrack.
anime.thematic_vibe: Isekai, OP MC, Slice of Life

anime.title: My Hero Academia ONA
anime.genres: School, Shounen, Sports, Super Power, Team Sports
anime.synopsis:
Episode 1: HLB

HLB stands for "Hero League of Baseball"—it is a baseball league founded by pro-heroes who love baseball!

It's game day! The last game of HLB championship is between Gang Orca and Shishido's two rival agencies. They form a team ("Orcas" and "Lionels") to compete. In the world of HLB, there is no rule—using their Quirks is of course accepted; however, just when the game is about to finish, they are interrupted by a villain. Who will be the winner of HLB?!


Episode 2: Laugh! As if you are in hell

Deku, Bakugo, and Todoroki participate in an internship under the No.1 hero, Endeavor's agency. One of their tasks these days is to find a villain ("Smiley") who draws doodles in the city; however, since the urgency is so low, they let other pro-heroes solve this case.

One day, Smiley draws a doodle on Endeavor's house! Being furious, Endeavor himself and the 1-A trio go out to get the villain' however, Smiley's Quirk turns out to be something ridiculous but powerful... It is to make anyone who looks into his eyes laugh hysterically!

Can the team capture the villain and stop laughing?!
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences generally found these ONAs to be fun, lighthearted, and entertaining diversions from the main series. While not essential to the plot, they are appreciated for their humor, vibrant animation, and the opportunity to see characters in relaxed, silly situations. However, some viewers noted a lack of narrative depth and the episodes' disposable nature.
pros: Provides a fun and entertaining break from the main series' tension
Animation is bright, colorful, and energetic, with quirks popping off the screen
Features creative and inventive use of superpowers in a sports context
Offers wholesome and heartwarming interactions between characters, including supporting cast
Humorous and lighthearted tone allows for silly and amusing character moments
cons: Completely skippable and non-essential to the main plot
Lacks significant narrative interest, character development, or conflict
Can feel disposable and lacks depth for those not invested in baseball
Pacing can sometimes feel overwhelming with too much happening on screen

anime.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse
anime.romaji_title: Nanatsu no Taizai: Mokushiroku no Yonkishi
anime.synopsis:
Percival has always lived with his grandfather on God's Finger, a remote haven that sits high above the clouds. And though he loves the simple life, he secretly longs for adventure. But Percival's life is changed forever when an intruder—who shares a shocking connection with him—tears away everything he's ever known.

With nothing left to do but chase down the one who took everything from him, Percival sets out on his own. During his journey, the sheltered boy discovers that there are a lot of things he doesn't know about normal life. Luckily, he meets friends along the way who can help him get by—but how will they react when they find out about Percival's destiny... and how it's connected to the end of the world?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the return to form and exciting narrative, while others criticize the forced premise, animation quality, and character development. The series seems to evoke nostalgia for earlier seasons of the original series for some viewers.  Concerns about character design and potentially problematic content contribute to the divided opinions.
pros: Exciting narrative and plot development
Recaptures the feeling of the first two seasons of the original series
Main cast is interesting with well-developed personalities
cons: Forced premise at the beginning of the story
Animation during combats needs improvement, especially with fast-paced action
Some find the main character annoying with a bad design
Inconsistent character chemistry

anime.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Intrigue
anime.romaji_title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Sakubou
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Military, Sci-Fi, Space
anime.synopsis:
After Yang Wen-li successfully captures the Iserlohn Fortress, the Free Planets Alliance grows bolder in its militaristic ambitions. With recent incursions into Galactic Empire territory and the possession of a perfect beachhead, the Alliance is now able to deal significant damage to the Empire.
