As the two gain more experience with one another in and out of the game, their tentative acquaintance may level up in a way neither expects.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some enjoying the show's art, music, and shoujo romance elements, while others criticize its slow pace, underutilized gaming theme, and reliance on character tropes. Many find the plot generic and the characters underdeveloped, particularly disliking the emphasis on physical attractiveness over personality. Overall, the anime is seen as a visually appealing but ultimately bland romance that doesn't fully utilize its potential.
pros: Attractive art style and animation quality, especially the shoujo-esque aesthetic.
Catchy and upbeat opening and ending themes that fit the show's atmosphere.
Enjoyable for fans of shoujo romance, with focus on tender moments and gradual relationship development.
Some find the characters relatable and well-developed, appreciating Akane's mature portrayal.
cons: Slow pacing that can make the anime feel uneventful and reliant on internal monologues.
Underutilization of the video game aspect, serving more as a backdrop than an integral part of the story.
Characters, especially the protagonists, can feel flat, dull, and lacking depth, relying on common tropes.
Overemphasis on Yamada's attractiveness at the expense of his personality, making him feel vapid.
Inconsistent visual quality with noticeable dips in art and animation in some scenes.
Predictable and generic romance story with little in the way of unique twists.
anime.thematic_vibe: Slow Burn Romance, Gaming Culture, Shoujo Tropes

anime.title: Fate/strange Fake: Whispers of Dawn
anime.synopsis:
In the American city of Snowfield, a new Holy Grail War is about to erupt. Such ruthless confrontations pit against each other magic experts known as magi, who ascend to the status of Master by summoning Servants—heroic spirits of the past. The winner is thought to have any one of their wishes granted.

However, it appears that the organization behind the present situation has merely managed to create an imperfect copy of the Third Holy Grail War. As the unusual ritual catches the attention of the Mage's Association in London, Flatt Escardos, the young apprentice of Lord El-Melloi II—a former participant of the Fourth Holy Grail War—travels to Snowfield and, to the great dismay of his teacher, joins the ranks of the Masters.

In this fake conflict where the line between Masters and Servants is blurred, the different factions will have a hard time preventing the city of Snowfield from plunging into total chaos.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed 'Fate/Strange Fake: Whispers of Dawn' as a prologue, praising its animation and unique take on the Holy Grail War. Some found the pacing rushed and confusing for newcomers to the Fate series. Despite minor criticisms, anticipation is high for the full series.
pros: Amazing animation quality, movie-level visuals.
Interesting twist on the Holy Grail War setting in America.
Well-done character introductions and voice acting.
Unique and memorable art style.
cons: Rushed pacing due to condensing a light novel volume into one episode.
Story and characters may not appeal to non-Fate fans.
Some choppy animation and inconsistent lip syncing were observed.
Fight scenes, specifically Gilgamesh vs. Enkidu, felt too short.
anime.thematic_vibe: Action-Fantasy, Holy Grail War, Servant Clashes

anime.title: Atri -My Dear Moments-
anime.synopsis:
Due to the dramatic rise of the sea levels, humanity has lost a significant part of its inhabitable lands, forcing it to rely on pre-existing technology to survive. Among the many people affected by the tragedy, Natsuki Ikaruga, a brilliant recent graduate who had lost a leg in a submarine accident, is now reduced to living a miserable life on a near-deserted island.

After Natsuki encounters a mysterious woman named Catherine, he uncovers an advanced humanoid robot that belonged to his grandmother Nonko, a renowned climatologist. Atri, the salvaged robot with the appearance and demeanor of a young girl, reveals to Natsuki that Nonko has tasked her with an important mission, but she has forgotten what it was.

Although Natsuki was initially planning to sell Atri, the opportunity to connect with his grandmother's research through Atri makes him rethink his decision. Natsuki once had to sacrifice his dream to partake in a prestigious scientific mission. But as he opens up to his fellow islanders, he discovers that he can still make a difference in a desolate world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the animation and initial story setup contrasting with criticism regarding the central relationship's uncomfortable implications and a perceived decline in plot quality as the series progresses. Many feel the anime adaptation failed to capture the depth and emotional resonance of the visual novel. While some viewers found the story moving and enjoyable, others were put off by what they considered forced melodrama and weak character development, resulting in a polarized viewing experience.
pros: Visually appealing animation with attention to detail.
The series explores themes of love, loss, and what it means to be human through the lens of a human-robot relationship.
The initial episodes are well-paced and engaging, with cohesive storytelling.
cons: The relationship between the protagonist and Atri, a robot with a childlike appearance, is perceived as unsettling or creepy by some viewers.
The plot suffers from pacing issues, contrived conflicts, and underdeveloped supporting characters.
The anime adaptation cuts out crucial plot points from the visual novel, diminishing the story's depth and emotional impact.

anime.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Venturing Out
anime.romaji_title: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Odekake Sister no Yume wo Minai
anime.synopsis: Sakuta Azusagawa's little sister, Kaede, is wrapping up middle school and needs to make an important decision. The school counselor believes it is in Kaede's best interest to attend an online high school, given her history of being a shut-in and her crippling phobia of traditional classrooms. However, Kaede wishes to enroll in Minegahara High School, just like her brother, as she desperately hopes for a typical high school experience. She pleads with Sakuta; his girlfriend, Mai Sakurajima; and Mai's half-sister, Nodoka Toyohama, to help her study for the entrance exam—and they enthusiastically agree. But her envisioned high school life does not unfold as planned. With her unresolved trauma coming to a head, Kaede grapples with the conflict of determining what sort of future path she truly wants to embark upon.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While praised for its heartwarming moments, animation quality, and exploration of Kaede's character, many find the movie's pacing slow and its plot less engaging than previous installments. It's recommended for dedicated fans of the series, but newcomers may find it less compelling.
pros: High-quality animation consistently maintained by Cloverworks.
Voice acting perfectly encapsulates the characters' emotions.
Characters are endearing and well-developed.
Exploration of relatable themes like self-discovery and aspirations.
cons: Pacing feels slow and prolonged, stretching the narrative unnecessarily.
Story lacks the supernatural mystery and impactful conflicts of previous arcs.
Plot is perceived as plain and uneventful.
Other characters' perspectives not fleshed out enough.

anime.title: UniteUp!
anime.synopsis: Akira Kiyose, a high schooler who loves to sing, gets recruited by a talent agency called sMiLea Production. Akira learns that the legendary idols "Anela," who shocked the world with their sudden retirement, are behind the agency developing talent. Together with Banri Naoe and Chihiro Isuzugawa, also recruited by the agency, they form an idol group as they chase their dream towards super stardom alongside other idol groups "LEGIT" and "JAXX/JAXX."
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys UniteUp! for its charming characters, wholesome friendships, and great music. Some feel the story rushes character development across multiple groups, and specific plots can be weak. However, the series is considered enjoyable, especially for those who appreciate the idol genre and value character interactions and encouragement.
pros: Charming characters with diverse personalities and musical styles.
Well-written with a good and diverse cast of characters.
Deals with drama realistically.
Great songs, especially from JAXX/JAXX.
cons: Rushed development of all characters at the expense of the original group's story.
Some plots brought the overall score down.

anime.title: Our Little Pond
anime.synopsis: I’m the only one who can't live without an oxygen tank in the underwater world. No matter how suffocated I feel, I preserve peace and harmony by pretending the selfish girl and my friends with complicated family backgrounds don’t bother me.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally appreciates the anime's gentle art style and relatable themes of loneliness and not fitting in. However, some find the ending too enigmatic and confusing. Most viewers feel it is a worthwhile watch unless they are strictly interested in action or are overly critical of indie anime.
pros: Gentle, indie art style is a nice change of pace.
Relatable themes of loneliness, not fitting in, and poor home life.
Realistic and enjoyable characters.
cons: Enigmatic and confusing ending.

anime.title: The Way of the Househusband Season 2
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Gag Humor, Organized Crime
anime.synopsis:
With a wicked scar on his face, a terrifying gaze, and an apron adorned with a teddy bear, ex-yakuza member Tatsu proudly assumes the role of a full-time househusband. Already familiar with the regular challenges of grocery shopping, Tatsu now takes it to the next level by joining a women's organization—but acceptance is not easily achieved without first mastering the elegance of flower arranging and housekeeping.

Approaching homemaking ventures through the lens of his former occupation, Tatsu faces haiku battles, typhoon alerts, and cosplaying villains. For his dearest wife Miku, Tatsu will do anything, even if he is interrupted by his old acquaintances, whose former vigor has also yet to subside. Never faltering before a new challenge, Tatsu's tranquil days as a househusband are proving to be just as hectic as before.
anime.consensus_summary: Audiences largely agree that Gokushufudou Season 2 delivers on its promise of comedic entertainment, building upon the successful formula of its predecessor. While the improved animation is a welcome change for many, a segment of the audience still finds the visual style too simplistic. The show's formulaic nature is seen as both a strength (consistent enjoyment) and a weakness (lack of innovation) by different viewers.
pros: The animation has noticeably improved, with more movement compared to the first season, enhancing character personality and comedic timing.
The humor is consistently praised as quirky, unorthodox, and effective, leading to frequent laughter.
The core premise of an ex-yakuza as a househusband remains fresh and entertaining due to creative spins on the concept and Tatsu's characterization.
Charismatic characters and a unique, engaging art style contribute to the show's overall enjoyment.
cons: The animation, while improved, is still considered simplistic and sometimes static by some viewers.
The show's adherence to the same rhythm and premise as the first season might feel repetitive or uninnovative to some.

anime.title: Lookism
anime.synopsis:
Violence, name-calling, and humiliation are a daily reality for high school student Park Hyung Suk. Chubby and insecure, he is often used as a plaything and punching bag for bullies, which leads him to wish he could just disappear. Unexpectedly, when he transfers schools in the hopes of starting anew, a miraculous opportunity emerges: he awakens in a tall, handsome, and strangely athletic body. Hyung Suk quickly realizes that he is now the owner of two disparate bodies; when one falls asleep, he wakes up in the other.

Feeling like he has won the lottery of life, Hyung Suk enters his new school as this attractive and strong young man. However, it soon becomes evident that being a popular student is not all smooth sailing. From girls wanting him only for his good looks to delinquents picking fights out of jealousy, he can never seem to escape trouble. In trying to balance his two different lives, Hyung Suk may find both of them to be sources of ceaseless challenges.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is polarized. Some appreciate the anime's exploration of social issues and character growth, finding it relatable and emotionally engaging. Others criticize its exaggerated portrayal of bullying, reliance on clichés, and inconsistent animation quality, deeming it shallow and unrealistic. There are conflicting views on the depth and meaningfulness of the narrative.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material.
Exploration of social issues like bullying and appearance-based discrimination.
Relatable characters and potential for emotional connection.
cons: Exaggerated and unrealistic portrayal of bullying.
Questionable values and morals of some characters.
Reliance on cheap emotional tricks and cliches.
Animation quality and CGI use are inconsistent.

anime.title: Sorcerous Stabber Orphen -Chaos in Urbanrama-
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: After the events of Kimluck, Orphen is on a quest to find Azalie, only to find himself in a war in between celestial beings and humans.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience expresses disappointment with the adaptation of 'Majutsushi Orphen Hagure Tabi: Urbanrama-hen,' citing a rushed plot, inconsistent animation, and generic music as major drawbacks. Many feel the anime fails to capture the essence of the original light novels and that it's primarily targeted towards dedicated fans willing to overlook its flaws. There's a sentiment that the production quality has declined over time, leading to a less engaging viewing experience.
pros: Voice acting is acceptable.
cons: Rushed plot adaptation from light novels.
Animation quality is inconsistent and generic, particularly backgrounds.
Music is generic and unmemorable, mostly reused from previous seasons.
Fails to capture the spirit and quality of the original source material.
Pacing issues make the story confusing for viewers.

anime.title: Too Cute Crisis
anime.synopsis:
Upon first seeing Earth from the Azatos Empire's survey ship, Chief Investigator Liza Luna plans to eradicate every lifeform on it immediately, leaving behind only useful resources. While surveying the planet, Liza discovers that human civilization has evolved at a pathetic rate compared to other lifeforms.

Liza makes her way to the surface of the planet to properly inspect and understand its inhabitants. Still convinced that there is nothing beneficial to be found, the investigator makes her way into a cafe to gauge the planet's food culture. Liza walks into a cat cafe, where she meets creatures far cuter than anything else in the galaxy. Motivated by this new discovery, Liza decides to investigate Earth's numerous adorable inhabitants.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Kawaisugi Crisis' to be a charming and enjoyable show, particularly for its cute and comedic elements. While some find it repetitive and lacking depth, others appreciate its simplicity and the feel-good atmosphere it creates. The show is especially appealing to those who love animals and are looking for something lighthearted.
pros: Unique premise blending aliens and Earth beings.
Over-the-top reactions and charm create a joyful atmosphere.
Enjoyable for viewers who appreciate cute animals and simple stories.
cons: Repetitive jokes and one-dimensional characters.
Lacks depth and complexity in plot.
Animation and music are decent but not outstanding.

anime.title: Giant Beasts of Ars
anime.synopsis:
In the world of Ars, humans lead a decades-long war against giant beasts that ravage the lands and feed on their resources. Those tasked with fighting them are Paladins, who utilize the destructive power of Clerics: beings gifted with uncontrollable magical powers.

While mourning the death of his war partner, former Paladin Jiiro crosses paths with Kuumi, a young woman who has just awakened her magical powers. After the pair form a contract to save the city from a giant beast attack, Jiiro learns that Kuumi has escaped a laboratory and is being hunted by the underlings of Mezami, the head of the research facility.

Reluctantly agreeing to help Kuumi flee from her pursuers, Jiiro starts traveling with his new partner and her friend Myaa, a young girl with a cat headdress. As the unlikely trio wanders the Arsian lands, top officials begin setting their plans into motion—and the group of adventurers soon discover that men are to be feared more than monsters.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed to negative. While the premise and characters show promise, the execution falls short, particularly in the lackluster animation, battles, and a disappointing ending. Many feel the series squandered its potential, leaving viewers underwhelmed and hesitant to recommend it without a guaranteed sequel.
pros: Interesting setting and lore with potential for a unique fantasy world.
Likeable characters with decent chemistry, particularly the main cast.
Opening theme is catchy and upbeat.
Politics and negotiation are well done, characters act on a serious level.
cons: Poor execution of the story, making it feel half-baked and wishy-washy.
Underdeveloped characters with shallow motivations.
Lackluster battle scenes and animation quality, especially the CGI.
Rushed and disappointing ending that undermines the entire show.
Inconsistent tone and pacing.

anime.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo Season 2
anime.synopsis:
After surviving a brutal terrorist attack on Plant Quetta, Suletta Mercury returns to dueling at the Asticassia School of Technology, while Miorine Rembran sits at her injured father's side, waiting to see if he will recover. As the residents of Earth House are preoccupied with their respective troubles, two members of Dawn of Fold—the perpetrators of the attack—secretly infiltrate the school, putting Suletta and her friends at risk.

At the same time, Prospera, Suletta's mother, approaches Miorine to propose the continuation of "Quiet Zero"—a project headed by Miorine's father that can allegedly end all war. Prospera seems to be another political figure with hidden, opposing motives, and whether she truly has Suletta's well-being at heart remains to be seen.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is strongly divided. Some viewers praise the series for its modern take on Gundam, character development, and political themes, considering it a significant upgrade. However, many criticize the rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, illogical plot developments, and weak world-building, leading to a disappointing experience for those seeking classic Gundam depth.
pros: Upgrade in every way to season 1.
Connect with characters in a way we haven’t really been able to in a Gundam before, as well as making the franchise accessible for newcomers.
The second season was an expected life-changing twist in the story that would take the show back to the 'real Gundam' side.
Gorgeous animation and music.
The production values are fantastic throughout.
cons: The world building is bad.
The plot is bad.
The finale is even worse.
This is the shortest TV Gundam ever, only two cours long and it really feels like it.
It explores the use of violence to protect.
Pacing is downright bad and every plot line suffers for it.
The plot of this anime went completely over my head.

anime.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2 Part 2
anime.synopsis:
Following the revelations of the archangel Gabriel, Ente Isla hero Emilia Justina—who lives on Earth under the alias Emi Yusa—starts doubting the validity of her mission to slay the Demon Lord Satan, now reduced to a modest employee of MgRonald's as Sadao Maou. At the same time, Sadao's high school-aged coworker Chiho Sasaki pursues a new dream with hopes to protect not only herself but also her friends. Secretly training with Emi and Suzuno Kamazuki to develop telepathic powers, Chiho's training is cut short when a group of demons abducts her.

As angel and demon attacks threaten the fragile peace between the two worlds, Sadao and Emi need to put their troubled past behind them if they want to have a chance to find their new purpose in life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely negative, with many feeling the second season failed to live up to the original's quality due to poor animation, rushed storytelling, and a shift away from the slice-of-life elements that made the first season enjoyable. However, some viewers appreciated the character development and lore expansion, resulting in a polarized reception. Most agree that the long-awaited sequel was a disappointment, and many wish the series had remained a one-season wonder.
pros: Character development, particularly Maou and Emi becoming more integrated into human society.
Expansion of lore and deeper dive into the fantasy elements.
Exploration of the relationships between characters from Ente Isla and Earth, showing growth and adaptation.
Some viewers found the increased focus on the overarching storyline and character interactions enjoyable.
cons: Significant disappointment with animation quality compared to Season 1.
Rushed storytelling and pacing issues.
Bland plot and uninteresting villains.
Over-reliance on stale jokes and lack of novelty.
Fights are too simple, quick and easy to give any sense of tension.
Inconsistent animation style.
Reduced focus on slice-of-life elements, which were a draw for some viewers.
Failure to meet high expectations set by the first season, especially after a long wait.

anime.title: Kingdom Season 5
anime.synopsis: Fifth season of Kingdom.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's strategic depth, compelling characters, and emotional impact, particularly from season 2 onwards. While the initial CGI is a common criticism, viewers agree that the story and character development are well worth overlooking this early flaw. Many consider Kingdom to be an underrated masterpiece that deserves significantly more attention.
pros: Amazing story with great character development.
Visuals improve significantly after season 1.
Strategic thinking and meticulous planning are highlighted.
Shin's character development is rewarding to watch.
Battles are a favorite part of the series.
cons: Early seasons have poor CGI which can be off-putting.
anime.thematic_vibe: Strategic Warfare, Character Development, Emotional Depth

anime.title: Shy
anime.synopsis:
In the middle of the 21st century, powerful individuals with superhuman strength appeared all across the world. These people who wore flashy clothes and performed incredible feats in the name of peace became known as heroes—symbolic figures of the nation they came from. In Japan, 14-year-old middle school student Teru Momijiyama is widely known by her secret identity as Japan's hero, Shy.

As a young, timid girl, Shy is a fairly new hero with a lot to learn. She struggles with self-confidence and questions if she is worthy of the hero title. Even though she is unsure of herself, Shy works hard to save people and do the right thing. As new, powerful threats reveal themselves, Shy must cooperate with heroes around the world all while learning what it means to be a hero.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards 'Shy' is mixed but generally positive. Many appreciate the series' focus on character development, emotional themes, and unique take on the superhero genre, finding it to be a heartwarming and inspirational story. However, some viewers are critical of the inconsistent animation, pacing issues, and occasional cheesy dialogue.
pros: Meaningful exploration of character growth and emotional themes.
Unique approach to the superhero genre, focusing on personal struggles and relationships.
Well-developed characters with relatable backstories.
Strong visual and character design.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, especially in action sequences.
Pacing issues due to prolonged character moments and exposition.
Dialogue can be cheesy and boring at times.
Some viewers may find the pervasive positivity and cuteness grating.
Uneven focus between the main character and supporting characters.

anime.title: The Great Cleric
anime.romaji_title: Seija Musou: Salaryman, Isekai de Ikinokoru Tame ni Ayumu Michi
anime.synopsis:
Right as he is about to earn a promotion, a salaryman meets an untimely demise. Taking pity, a mysterious being grants him a second life in the land of Galdardia as a teenager. Choosing the name Luciel for himself and a role as a healer, the young man sets off for the nearby town of Merratoni. There, he learns that healers are a coveted resource, yet they often take advantage of others for monetary gain. Vowing to be different from other healers, he joins the local branch of the Healers' Guild and begins unlocking his magical potential.

After failing to save someone with his magic, Luciel is determined to get stronger. To improve his physical strength and hone his magic skills, he registers as an adventurer and takes rigorous training under Brod, the chief instructor of the Adventurers' Guild. Soon, Luciel gradually finds his way through Galdardia, gaining a reputation as a selfless healer who aids others regardless of expense.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a lighthearted isekai focused on a healer's journey and hard work, appealing to those who enjoy a slower pace and character development through grinding. However, the slow pacing, generic elements, and underdeveloped characters may deter viewers seeking a more action-packed or complex story. Despite its flaws, the show has a certain charm and provides a relaxing viewing experience for some.
pros: Hardworking MC with visible progress
Relaxing and humorous moments
Interesting world-building hints
Enjoyable summary conversations between characters
cons: Slow pacing with repetitive content
Generic world and characters
Underdeveloped side characters
Rushed adaptation skipping crucial plot parts
Simplistic and unambitious writing

anime.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean Part 3
anime.romaji_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 6: Stone Ocean Part 3
anime.synopsis:
After finally escaping the confines of Green Dolphin Street Jail, Jolyne Kuujou—alongside her companions Ermes Costello and Emporio Alniño—pursues the villainous priest Enrico Pucci across the state of Florida. Jolyne's allies, Weather Report and Narciso Anasui, struggle to catch up with her in order to help bring an end to Pucci's plot. As both parties pursue the priest, they must battle against Pucci's band of enemy Stand users.

While Jolyne's comrades fight for their lives, Pucci races to the Kennedy Space Center. There he hopes to enact his ultimate goal, one he believes God has entrusted to him. He aims to fulfill the will of the Joestars' blood enemy Dio Brando and—by robbing humanity of free will and making them slaves to fate—to create a world where all humans are blissfully happy.

Unable to rely on the aid of her comatose father Joutarou, Jolyne must weaponize all she has learned in prison to confront Pucci in a climactic battle while the world itself hangs in the balance.
anime.consensus_summary: Stone Ocean Part 3 receives high praise for its spectacular and emotional finale, marking a satisfying end to the original JoJo continuity. While many laud the pacing, character development, and music, some critics point out pacing issues, occasional animation flaws, and confusing plot elements. Despite mixed feelings towards earlier parts, the ending arc is largely considered a must-watch for JoJo fans, solidifying its place within the series.
pros: Spectacular and emotional finale.
Excellent pacing in the final batch of episodes.
Well-developed characters with enjoyable backstories.
Amazing voice acting performances.
The music since batch 2 is IMMACULATE
Faithful manga adaptation with crisp visuals.
David Production understands JoJo and delivers grand adaptations.
cons: Weak pacing and pointless dialogues.
Occasional lacking animation.
Some plot conveniences.
Dragging and boring sections.
Confusing execution of some Stand abilities.
Rushed product.
anime.thematic_vibe: Fate vs. Free Will, Cosmic Horror, Redemption

anime.title: Love Live! Superstar!! Season 3
anime.genres: Idols (Female), Music, School, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
As the Love Live! Competition draws to a close, Kanon Shibuya takes an offer to study abroad and bids farewell to her friends and fellow members of the school idol group Liella!. Although they will live on opposite sides of the world, both Kanon and the group remain motivated to continue their idol activities.

Unbeknownst to Kanon, however, her plans are cut short by Wien Margarete's parents, who request that Kanon remain in Japan for another year so that their daughter can learn from her. While Kanon finds herself in awkward limbo, Wien cannot bring herself to join her once fierce rival Liella! and decides to start a group of her own.

Not wanting Wien's determination to go to waste, Kanon joins the new group, recruiting her former group member's sister Tomari Onitsuka in the process. As the newfound unit strives to wash off Wien's controversial past, the new Liella! is also wrestling with the struggles of losing their irreplaceable center.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the season a heartwarming conclusion to character arcs, while others criticize the predictable plot, underdeveloped characters, and inconsistent writing. Many feel the season fails to live up to the potential of the earlier seasons and is too safe. There is a sentiment that the series has lost its way, relying too much on established formulas instead of innovating.
pros: Beautiful animation and engaging performances.
Meaningful character interactions and development for many characters.
Satisfying conclusion to character arcs for Chisato, Keke, and Natsumi.
cons: Directionless plot and contrived plot conveniences.
Underdeveloped second-year characters and superfluous new additions.
Inconsistent character writing and thematic contradictions.
Predictable and safe storytelling that lacks depth and nuance.

anime.title: A Girl & Her Guard Dog
anime.synopsis:
When Isaku Senagaki was five years old, the death of her parents left her to be raised by her yakuza boss grandfather, Tasuke. Now preparing to enter high school, Isaku is determined to start fresh with an honest attempt at having a normal high school experience. All she wants is to be able to make friends and find love without being defined by her connection to the yakuza.

But Isaku's dreams are thwarted when her overprotective caretaker, 26-year-old Keiya Utou, takes it upon himself to enroll in Isaku's school by bribing the school administration. While Isaku yearns for a reciprocated love, she is trapped in a one-sided infatuation with Keiya, who only sees her as the boss's granddaughter he helped raise. Her longing for a normal life becomes a constant battle, and breaking free from her heart's grip is far more challenging than it sounds, as Keiya's overprotectiveness and disregard for her boundaries make it almost impossible to move on.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly polarized, primarily due to the controversial age gap and the nature of the relationship between the characters. Many find the animation and plot execution disappointing, overshadowing any potential enjoyment of the romance elements. While some appreciate the taboo romance, the prevalent negative sentiment focuses on the problematic themes and poor production quality.
pros: Some viewers enjoy the romance events and scenes, particularly those who like shoujo anime.
The opening and ending themes (OST) are well-received.
Some appreciate the concept of a forbidden love story, finding it entertaining as escapist fantasy.
cons: The animation quality is frequently criticized as being very poor, with noticeable errors and inconsistencies.
Many find the age gap and the romanticization of a guardian-ward relationship to be disturbing and problematic, bordering on grooming.
The plot execution is considered weak, with a lack of tension, stakes, and meaningful consequences for inappropriate behavior.
Some reviewers note the inclusion of near sexual assault scenes being brushed off or played as jokes.
The male lead is described as an overprotective and sometimes violent character, and some find that the characters are underdeveloped or unlikeable.

anime.title: My Tiny Senpai
anime.romaji_title: Uchi no Kaisha no Chiisai Senpai no Hanashi
anime.synopsis:
"My senpai from work... is tiny and cute."

Shinozaki is an office worker who is taken care of and coddled by his senior team member Shiori Katase: a gorgeous, profoundly kind, loving, and diminutive woman.

Shinozaki certainly hopes that she's not doing it out of duty... but her joy of doing so increasingly exposes her feelings!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is mixed. While some find 'My Tiny Senpai' to be a cute and harmless rom-com, many criticize its generic plot, slow pacing, and reliance on tired tropes. Several reviewers noted that the side characters were more interesting than the main couple. Ultimately, the show is considered a passable time-waster for fans of the genre, but not a standout title.
pros: Cute and heartwarming interactions
Enjoyable side characters
Catchy OP/ED music
cons: Generic plot and characters
Slow and repetitive progression
Unrealistic workplace scenarios
Lack of character development

anime.title: Heavenly Delusion
anime.synopsis:
Fifteen years ago, disaster struck human civilization, and now dangerous man-eating monsters roam the ravaged lands, posing an existential threat to the remaining survivors. Amid this turmoil, an isolated facility shelters children and nurtures them in peace. However, as a few among them find out about the world beyond the narrow periphery of their nursery's walls, their curiosity about it slowly grows.

Meanwhile, in the outside world, young survivors Maru and Kiruko band together to search for a special place called Heaven, each for their own reasons. Carrying past burdens and tragic secrets, the two hope to find answers to the cruelty they have experienced in their lives and in the world, which still remains in tatters.
anime.consensus_summary: Tengoku Daimakyou is a visually stunning anime with a compelling post-apocalyptic setting and intriguing mysteries. However, the series is marred by pacing issues, unnecessary and disturbing content, and unresolved plot threads. While some appreciate the show's ambition and world-building, others are left disappointed by the execution and handling of sensitive themes.
pros: High production value with detailed art and sound design.
Intriguing mystery elements that encourage viewer engagement and discourse.
Unique world-building and exploration of a post-apocalyptic Japan.
Well-crafted characters with fascinating backgrounds.
The dual narrative adds additional charm to the plot.
cons: Pacing issues with boring and pointless scenes, especially those involving the children in 'heaven'.
Unpleasant and unnecessary sexual violence, particularly towards the end of the series.
Too much 'new' mystery without enough building on existing mysteries, leading to unanswered questions.
The LGBTQ+ representation is questionable and mishandled.
The main characters on the 'outside' have no likeable qualities
anime.thematic_vibe: Post-Apocalyptic Mystery, Bleak Hope, Body Horror

anime.title: New Saga
anime.synopsis:
Humanity and demonkind have been on bad terms for millennia, resulting in the continent of Leunders being split in two. Although the situation has stabilized between the races, the fragile peace breaks when the new demon king launches a fierce all-out attack. With all of the non-demon nations falling to the violence in under a year, humanity's hope rests in a special squad, led by swordsman Kyle Leonard, that must assassinate the demon king in order to bring an end to the war.

During the dangerous mission, Kyle ends up in a clash with the demon king that brings him to the brink of death. As Kyle realizes he has lost everything he wanted to protect, a mysterious gem transports him back in time before the conflict even started! Now with knowledge of future events and a strong desire to save his loved ones, Kyle sets out to become even stronger to prevent the extinction of humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some finding the series enjoyable due to its familiar time-travel elements, likeable characters, and decent pacing in the early episodes. However, many are critical of its generic plot, inconsistent animation, and shallow character development. The series fails to stand out in a crowded genre, resulting in a mediocre experience for some viewers.
pros: Good pacing in the beginning, quickly moving the plot forward.
Likeable characters with unique personalities and some depth.
MC who acts mature and isn't overly shy or perverted.
Enjoyable arcs that introduce new side characters and stories.
Great opening song that pumps up the audience
Decent world-building with potential for future seasons.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with rough spots and low-quality fight scenes.
Generic or bland characters with little to no development.
Slow pacing in the later half, with filler storylines that drag on.
Predictable plot twists and lack of surprises for those familiar with the genre.
Uninspired villains who aren't threatening or memorable.
Soundtrack choices sometimes clash with the mood of the scene
Some fanservice elements feel shoehorned in and unnecessary.

anime.title: Em-Shade!
anime.synopsis: A spin-off chibi anime of Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute!.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mildly positive towards Kagejitsu!, primarily due to its cute art style and focus on the female characters. However, the lack of a compelling story and simplistic animation are noted drawbacks. It is mostly seen as a lighthearted and non-essential spin-off for fans of the original series.
pros: Cute art style reminiscent of Isekai Quartet
Equal representation of female characters
Provides a lighthearted breather from the main anime
cons: Lack of overarching story
Simplistic animation quality
Comedy may not appeal to all viewers

anime.title: Bartender Glass of God
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Drama, Gourmet, Seinen, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
Miwa Kurushima and her colleague Yukari Higuchi hunt for a skilled individual to run the counter bar at the famous Hotel Cardinal. The chairman of the hotel demands only one thing of the potential hire: the bartender must be able to craft the ultimate drink known as the "Glass of God." Because Miwa does not fully understand the requirement, her search runs dry after everyone she has scouted cannot get past the chairman's scrutiny.

Nestled in a quiet and secluded place among the bustling alleys of Ginza is Eden Hall. This cozy bar is maintained by Ryuu Sasakura, a prodigy mixologist who knows exactly what drink will ease his customers' worries at any given time. Every glass that he serves is garnished with humility, providing much-needed solace to people from all walks of life in their time of need.

In a chance encounter, the chairman is left speechless by Ryuu's astute bartending skills and is determined to have him join Hotel Cardinal. He becomes one of Ryuu's regulars, attempting daily to convince Ryuu to leave Eden Hall. But even with the assistance of Miwa, it is more difficult than expected to recruit this particular bartender.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Bartender: Kami no Glass' to be a calming and insightful anime that explores adult themes with empathy. Viewers appreciate the realistic portrayal of characters and the art of mixology. While some find the pacing slow and the resolutions too simple, the overall sentiment is positive, with many praising the show's ability to create a soothing and reflective experience.
pros: Realistic portrayal of adult issues and conversations.
Appreciation for the show's calming and meditative pacing.
Positive reception of the main character, Ryuu Sasakura's, caring nature and ability to understand customers.
Use of real alcohol brands adds realism and immersion.
Exploration of mixology as an art and a means of connection.
cons: Slow pacing may not appeal to all viewers.
Some find the problem-solving to be overly simplistic and lacking depth.
Occasional feeling of pretentiousness.
Lack of romance and more animation budget

anime.title: Laid-Back Camp Season 3
anime.synopsis:
Within the narrow walls of the Outdoor Activities Club room, the few but lively members carry on the camping spirit as they have fun with DIY club experiments. Exciting experiences such as these have brought Nadeshiko Kagamihara deep into the world of camping, making her want to once again go on a solo trip.

However, other plans come first, as Ayano Toki and Rin Shima invite Nadeshiko to camp near Ooi River. Eager to go on their first journey together, the girls set off to forge precious memories that will stick with their hearts for years to come.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 3 of Yuru Camp is divisive among fans, primarily due to the change in animation studio. While some appreciate the continuation of the series' relaxing atmosphere and focus on solo camping, many criticize the lower production quality, character redesigns, and shift in focus towards food rather than camping. The change has led to a split in the fanbase with some feeling that the magic of the earlier seasons has been lost.
pros: Maintains the comfy and wholesome atmosphere of previous seasons
Focus on solo camping provides a fresh narrative perspective
Cooking recipes and sightseeing remain enjoyable aspects
cons: Noticeable drop in production quality due to the studio change, including CGI and art style
Character redesigns may be jarring for some viewers
Feels like the series now focuses too much on food and not enough on camping or landscapes
Missing the charm from the previous seasons, particularly the music
Some find the season less heartwarming, more sleepy

anime.title: Buddy Daddies
anime.synopsis:
On Christmas Eve, four-year-old Miri Unasaka arrives in Tokyo completely alone, in search of her father. The bright lights and merry atmosphere guide Miri to a big hotel and a man with a delicious-looking cake. However, the child has just unknowingly walked into the center of an elaborate, foolproof plan for assassinating a dangerous mafia boss.

Professional assassins Kazuki Kurusu and Rei Suwa live together, fleeing memories of their grim childhoods and avoiding emotional connections. When their mission goes awry and they end up bringing Miri home, there is only one reasonable thing to do: return Miri to her mother. But the girl's innocent laugh and pure worldview quickly enamor her to Kazuki, who secretly enjoys playing a parent, and it is not long before Rei's impenetrable heart makes room for Miri.

Miri's every move is unpredictable, and Kazuki and Rei find raising an energetic child harder than any of their missions. Although it presents a great risk to their careers, Kazuki and Rei—both assuming the affectionate nickname "papa"—decide to provide Miri with a normal childhood despite all the odds stacked against them.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, with many appreciating the show's unique blend of action and heartwarming parenting themes, and the realistic portrayal of children. However, there's a notable split regarding the believability of the child character and the seamless integration of its diverse genres, leading to some confusion about its narrative direction.
pros: Realistic portrayal of children's behavior and the challenges of parenting.
Strong emotional beats and character development, particularly in the parent-child dynamic.
Enjoyable blend of genres including comedy, action, and heartwarming slice-of-life moments.
High-quality production values including animation, voice acting, and music (OP/ED).
cons: The child's behavior is sometimes perceived as unrealistic or plot-device-like, leading to a disconnect from the serious themes.
The narrative struggles to seamlessly transition between serious action/thriller elements and lighthearted comedy/slice-of-life scenes.
The plot can feel confused or underdeveloped, with some critics finding the pacing or story progression weak, especially given the short runtime.
Some action sequences are criticized for being unbelievable or undermining the show's grounded tone.

anime.title: Lupin Zero
anime.synopsis:
How did this young boy become notorious gentleman thief "Lupin III"?

Loosely based on Young Lupin III from the original manga, Lupin Zero will tell a nostalgic, yet brand new original story, finally lifting the veil cast upon Lupin III's humble beginnings. Set during the era in which the original series was first published, the anime depicts Young Lupin III running around the streets of 1960's Japan during the country's economic boom.

A young boy climbs the staircase to villainhood. What was he thinking and what steps did he take? This is the untold origin story of the world's greatest thief.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Lupin Zero' as a stylish and engaging prequel that explores the origins of Lupin III. The show's episodic structure and predictable conclusion are minor drawbacks, but the overall experience is positive, especially for newcomers to the franchise. Most find the characters likable and the setting appealing.
pros: Stylish animation and art direction.
Engaging character dynamics.
Interesting exploration of Lupin's origins.
cons: Episodic nature of the first half may not appeal to all viewers.
Predictable conclusion.

anime.title: Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable!
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Having just moved from Tokyo to Hokkaido, high school student Tsubasa Shiki decides to explore the picturesque winter landscape he could never experience in the nation's capital. It only takes a moment for Tsubasa's idealized view of Japan's northernmost prefecture to crumble, as the sheer cold and frigid air quickly overwhelm him. While trying to find the way to his new home, Tsubasa runs into Minami Fuyuki—a talkative and friendly Hokkaido native who, despite the cold, is wearing a short skirt. The girl wastes no time in striking up a conversation, and Tsubasa comes to realize that the winter weather is not all that is too much for him to handle.

The next day, Tsubasa is shocked to learn that not only is Fuyuki in his class, but her seat is also right next to his. Swept along by Fuyuki's persistent advances, the young man soon becomes captivated by both life in Hokkaido and the beautiful girl determined to get closer to him. As he deepens his relationship with Fuyuki and meets other fashionable girls from his school, Tsubasa finds out that Hokkaido gals truly are adorable.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews are mixed, with many finding it to be an average but enjoyable rom-com. The show is appreciated for its wholesome characters and promotion of Hokkaido, but criticized for its reliance on tired tropes, weak plot, and underdeveloped characters, especially the male lead. While some found it refreshing and sweet, others felt it was unoriginal and forgettable.
pros: Well-written characters that are easy to like and root for.
Pleasant and efficient execution of genre basics.
Show effectively promotes Hokkaido's best features and culture.
cons: Repetitive plot and character interactions.
Underdeveloped supporting characters.
Predictable and trope-heavy storylines.
Weak or unsatisfying ending to the first season.
MC is bland and unoriginal, lacks a strong personality.
Inexplicable reasons for girls' attraction to the main character

anime.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
anime.romaji_title: Maou no Ore ga Dorei Elf wo Yome ni Shitanda ga, Dou Medereba Ii?
anime.synopsis:
The young but feared sorcerer Zagan is a candidate to become a member of the 13 Archdemons—a group of the strongest sorcerers in the world—following the death of their eldest member, Marchosias. When attending the deceased Archdemon's estate auction, Zagan finds something he did not expect: love at first sight. The sorcerer impulsively spends all his money to take Nephelia, a rare elf slave, back to his castle. Given the girl's mysterious and troubling past, there is a lot for Zagan to uncover about his new companion.

However, Zagan's lack of experience with the unfamiliar feeling of love leads to many awkward moments between him and Nephelia, whom he calls by the nickname "Nephy." As the two grow closer and get more comfortable around each other, it becomes increasingly evident that Nephy's feelings might not be so different from Zagan's.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is mixed. Many viewers find the romance between Zagan and Nephy to be adorable and heartwarming, praising the characters' interactions and the show's overall lightheartedness. However, some criticize the predictable plot, reliance on tropes, and lack of depth in both the story and the world-building, leading to a somewhat average experience.
pros: Adorable and heartwarming romance between Zagan and Nephy.
Likeable characters with entertaining interactions and decent development.
Enjoyable blend of comedy, action, and romance.
Refreshing take on the typical demonic archetype.
cons: Story lacks progression and depth.
Romance can feel awkward and stagnant.
Reliance on overplayed tropes and cliches.
Animation and visuals are unimpressive and generic.

anime.title: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior
anime.romaji_title: Higeki no Genkyou to Naru Saikyou Gedou Last Boss Joou wa Tami no Tame ni Tsukushimasu.
anime.synopsis:
Eight-year-old Pride Royal Ivy suddenly recalls her former life as a fan of the otome game Our Ray of Light. While on her way to replay it, she tragically died, reincarnating as the game's final boss and firstborn princess of Freesia. Her knowledge of the game's events leads everyone to believe she has the power of precognition. But unlike the game's original princess, this new Pride does not wish to torment those around her, such as her younger sister and adopted brother.

Haunted by nightmares of her other self's atrocities, Pride resolves to protect her family and country while progressing the story. As the world around her changes, she prepares for the day she will have to die at the hands of the game's main characters. Nevertheless, before that happens, Pride will either transform her kingdom for the better or fall under the weight of her possible crimes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed but leans positive. Many appreciate the strong character development, mature themes, and proactive female lead. Criticisms focus on predictable plot elements, average animation, and occasional over-dramatization, with a few reviewers expressing discomfort with the protagonist's age in certain contexts. Overall, the series is seen as a decent entry in the villainess isekai genre, with potential for further development.
pros: Strong character development, especially for the protagonist and supporting cast.
The series tackles interpersonal relationships and ideological issues with maturity and communication.
The female lead is intelligent, empathetic, and proactive in addressing systemic issues.
Worldbuilding is well-executed, and the plot unfolds at a deliberate pace, allowing for character development.
Several reviewers praise the show for breaking away from typical villainess tropes and offering a unique and engaging story.
cons: Animation quality is average and sometimes noticeably low grade, especially during action sequences.
The plot can be predictable and repetitive, following a similar formula for resolving conflicts.
Some reviewers found the over-dramatic elements and constant worrying of the MC annoying and repetitive.
The lack of significant external conflict or high stakes can make the story feel less compelling.
The MC being a 13-year-old in situations with romantic undertones is off-putting to some viewers.

anime.title: Berserk of Gluttony
anime.synopsis:
Fate Graphite lives miserably as a gatekeeper in a world where skills given at birth determine an individual's entire life. Afflicted by the seemingly harmful skill Gluttony, which makes him perpetually hungry, he is abused by the holy knights—the supposed protectors of the populace—who view him as a dreg of society due to his skill. However, Fate's destiny takes a dramatic turn after he kills an escaping injured thief. To his surprise, Gluttony activates, enhancing his stats and granting him new skills.

Following this epiphanic event, Fate receives a job offer from Roxy Hart, the only benevolent holy knight in the city, which he happily accepts. Eager to further explore Gluttony's true potential, he partners with a mysterious talking sword named Greed, who warns him that Gluttony is a taboo skill that breaks the logic of the world. Now forced to live a double life, Fate must slay monsters at night to satisfy his awakened appetite for souls, lest he go berserk and lose all chances at finding happiness.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some find it an enjoyable, albeit generic, dark fantasy with engaging elements and functional romance. However, many criticize its mediocre production quality, rushed pacing, and uninspired characters, leading to a consensus that it's a fairly average and forgettable anime experience.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the genre seeking a mindless, overpowered MC.
The dark fantasy setting is suitable, and the Fate/Roxy relationship offers functional romance.
Story is engaging and moves forward, with no harem elements.
cons: Generic power fantasy with mediocre art, animation, and basic storytelling.
Rushed pacing hinders character development, making side characters feel like cardboard cutouts.
Plot is predictable with cringy dialogue and nonsensical plot points. Animation is often static and budget.

anime.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
anime.romaji_title: Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi
anime.synopsis:
Salaryman Tsuyoshi Mukouda is accidentally summoned as a hero to the Kingdom of Reijseger in another world to help defend against their enemies. Wary of the royal family's true intentions, Mukouda is able to talk his way out of the situation due to his non-combat skill, "Online Supermarket," which is deemed useless.

However, this power proves to be anything but useless. With this ability, Mukouda is able to cheaply purchase food products and utensils from Japan—most of which are considered luxuries in this world. As Mukouda cooks up a storm using his ability, he catches the eye of the fearsome mythical wolf Fel. The legendary beast swiftly negotiates a contract to become Mukouda's familiar, unable to resist the delicious dishes. With Fel by his side, Mukouda travels the world, earning his keep as an adventurer and merchant all the while enjoying delectable meals.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi' as a relaxing and entertaining isekai anime with a focus on cooking and character interactions.  Viewers appreciate the laid-back atmosphere and the delicious-looking food. However, some find the lack of a strong plot and repetitive formula to be a drawback, with some finding it boring if consumed in large quantities.
pros: Relaxing and peaceful atmosphere
Delicious-looking food and cooking animation
Funny and entertaining character interactions
Unique concept of online supermarket skill in another world
Focus on travel and relationships rather than power struggles
cons: Lack of a strong plot or overarching conflict
Repetitive formula of cooking and eating
MC not particularly strong or proactive
Generic isekai elements detract from the unique cooking aspect
Uneven pacing, can be boring when binged

anime.title: To Be Hero X
anime.synopsis: This is a world where heroes are created by people's trust, and the hero who has received the most trust is known as "X." In this world, people's trust can be calculated by data, and these values will be reflected on everyone's wrist. As long as enough trust points are obtained, ordinary people can also have superpowers and become superheroes that save the world. However, the ever-changing trust value makes the hero's path full of unknowns...
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reviews for 'Tu Bian Yingxiong X' are largely positive, praising its unique animation, character development, and storytelling. However, some viewers found the pacing uneven, the plot confusing, and the ending rushed. Despite its flaws, many consider it a worthwhile and innovative anime.
pros: Diverse animation styles enhance storytelling
Unique character arcs and world-building
Impactful music and sound design
cons: Pacing issues, especially in early episodes
Rushed ending with unanswered questions
Complex plot can be confusing
Inconsistent integration of animation styles

anime.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King 4
anime.synopsis: To be able to see the true Heaven, practitioners utilize all available resources to achieve the Three Thousand Ways of Heaven. In search of one of the Three Thousand ways of heaven, "High Level Swordsmanship", modern swordsman Yi Jianchuan and his younger brother, Evil Sword God Chen Nanxuan, went in different directions. Wang Ling was concerned with which heavenly path to follow today to have a tranquil daily life, while the rest of the world was concerned with how to maintain the heavenly path.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Xian Wang de Richang Shenghuo 4 is moderately divided. While many viewers acknowledge its continued humor and decent production values, a significant portion feels the season is becoming stale, lacks substantial plot progression, and suffers from a decline in action and originality compared to earlier seasons. There's a clear split between long-time fans who appreciate the familiar elements and those who desire more narrative depth and development.
pros: Retains enjoyable aspects from previous seasons
Solid animation quality and overall production
Nostalgic music use, specifically reusing the first season's theme
Action scenes are considered good, though not great
Pacing is generally good, with episodes not overstaying their welcome
Decent production quality compared to many other Donghua
cons: Season feels like a collection of filler-like episodes with limited contribution to the main plot
Fails to deliver meaningful depth in its philosophical themes
Lack of character development for the main character
Slow pacing in the initial episodes due to heavy dialogue
Noticeably less action compared to previous seasons
Limited soundtrack variety, with overuse of old tracks
Comedy feels stagnant and less prominent
Rigid CG usage in scenes
Zooming on single images instead of redrawing frames can reduce resolution
Some effects are low resolution
Story is becoming stale
Voice acting is fine but uninspiring
OP and ED are underwhelming compared to previous seasons

anime.title: The Magic Chef of Ice and Fire 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Second season of Binghuo Mochu.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reactions to 'Binghuo Mochu 2' are mixed. Some appreciate the clear romantic focus and action, while others are disappointed by the rushed pacing, shallow character development, and generic storyline. The shift in the main character's personality is a point of contention.
pros: Clear main couple with deep love and loyalty.
Exciting fight scenes and cool powers.
cons: Rushed pacing and shallow scenes.
Forced dialogue and awkward character explanations.
Character development sacrificed for action.
Main character becomes a generic stoic power fantasy, losing his initial charm.
Supporting characters are less developed and mainly serve plot purposes.

anime.title: Banished From The Hero's Party, I Decided To Live A Quiet Life In The Countryside Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Shin no Nakama ja Nai to Yuusha no Party wo Oidasareta node, Henkyou de Slow Life suru Koto ni Shimashita 2nd
anime.synopsis: Finally free of her Blessing's impulses, former Hero Ruti has settled into her idyllic slow life with assassin housemate Tisse in the border town of Zoltan. She's happy to once again be close to her apothecary brother Red, the former Guide of her previous Hero's Party, while he's living his best loved-up life with his partner (and soon-to-be fiancee) Princess Rit. Unfortunately, there's a new Hero on the scene whose fundamentalist interpretation of his Blessing's urges will bring conflict and despair to sleepy Zoltan…
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 is a mixed bag, with some viewers appreciating the focus on blessings, character development and romance. However, many find the plot predictable, the new antagonist weak, and the main characters stagnant. The series struggles to balance its slice-of-life elements with darker themes, leading to a generally less favorable reception compared to the first season.
pros: Exploration of blessings and freedom.
Satisfying conclusion.
Further development of Red and Rit's relationship.
Ruti's character development.
Consistent animation quality.
cons: Stagnant character development for main characters.
Predictable and bland plot.
Inconsistent themes (slow life vs. violence).
New hero Van is a weak and unlikeable antagonist.
Pacing issues.
Lack of substance in story arcs.

anime.title: My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer
anime.romaji_title: Boukensha ni Naritai to Miyako ni Deteitta Musume ga S-Rank ni Natteta
anime.synopsis:
While on an errand in the forest, retired E-rank adventurer Belgrieve stumbles upon a basket that holds an abandoned baby girl. Taking pity on her, Belgrieve decides to adopt the infant and names her Angeline.

Growing up, Angeline idolized her father, especially admiring his swordsmanship and wishing to become an adventurer just like Belgrieve once was. To fulfill this ambition, Angeline sets out to the royal capital. Over the years, she rises to S-rank, gaining the title of the Black-Haired Valkyrie. Despite surpassing her father, Angeline boasts about him and embellishes his exploits, generously calling him the Red Ogre.

At last, the time for Angeline to go back home has come, but she quickly realizes that various evil forces persist in preventing her from returning to her beloved father's side.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received for its heartwarming and wholesome portrayal of a father-daughter relationship within a fantasy setting. While the story is simple and enjoyable, some viewers find the plot predictable and the characters underdeveloped.  Criticism focuses on the mediocre animation quality and the daughter's sometimes overly-clingy behavior, but overall, the show is considered a relaxing and feel-good experience.
pros: Heartwarming father-daughter relationship
Simple and enjoyable story
Positive portrayal of family values
Charming and relaxing atmosphere
cons: Mediocre animation quality
Underdeveloped supporting characters
Predictable plot with lack of surprises
Repetitive or excessive clinginess of the daughter character
Rushed or poorly executed action scenes

anime.title: April Showers Bring May Flowers
anime.synopsis: At the age of 15, Hana Tabata has already made peace with the idea of never experiencing an unforgettable high school romance. Although she likes shoujo manga, flowers, and anything cute, Tabata considers herself a mere background character; she is a little bit chubby, with a round face, glasses, and freckles—all things that would make her conventionally unattractive. But when Tabata accidentally befriends Yousuke Ueno, a warm and charming classmate, things start to change. While she grapples with conflicting feelings about her unexpected new relationship with Ueno, Tabata has yet to realize that the love story she has been dreaming of has already begun.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience finds 'Busu ni Hanataba wo.' to be a heartwarming and enjoyable rom-com, praising its sweet narrative and relatable characters. While some criticize the animation and reliance on certain tropes, the general sentiment is positive. Many viewers appreciate the anime's focus on self-esteem and the development of its supporting cast, making it a worthwhile watch for fans of the genre.
pros: Heartwarming and sweet romance with genuine characters.
Addresses self-esteem issues realistically.
Well-developed supporting characters that contribute to the story.
cons: Animation quality is not the best, can be basic.
Some character designs could be better.
Relies on some overused rom-com tropes.

anime.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
anime.romaji_title: Tensei shitara Dainana Ouji Datta node, Kimama ni Majutsu wo Kiwamemasu
anime.synopsis:
In his past life, Prince Lloyd de Saloum was a commoner who could not become adept at magic, no matter how knowledgeable or obsessed he was about it. Now reincarnated into his current royal lineage, he receives a body with seemingly endless mana, making his desire to master all things arcane attainable. Moreover, as the seventh prince of the kingdom, Lloyd has no claim to the throne, allowing him to nurture his abilities as freely as he wants.

Unfortunately for Lloyd, ancient seals that imprison powerful demons begin to break down and release the horrors within, endangering the peace. With these monstrosities roaming around, Lloyd's overwhelming magical prowess is the ultimate weapon that can neutralize these threats before all things descend to chaos.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with many appreciating the animation and unique magic focus, while others are put off by the fanservice and generic isekai elements. Some find it enjoyable as a 'so bad it's good' experience, while others consider it a waste of potential. The show's humor and character interactions are generally well-received, but the plot is seen as cliché.
pros: High-quality animation, especially in fight scenes
Fast-paced and engaging plot progression
Unique focus on magic research over typical isekai tropes
cons: Overuse of fanservice with a young protagonist
Generic isekai elements despite attempts at parody
Questionable character designs

anime.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby Season 3
anime.synopsis:
Since childhood, horse girls Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond have admired and aspired to be like their fellow horse girl named Toukai Teiou. Chasing their dreams, they enroll in Tracen Academy, an institution dedicated to training horse girls and preparing them for legendary races. Soon after, Kitasan Black lands on Team Spica, the same team as Teiou. Beaming with motivation, she remains undefeated until she fails to win her first Grade 1 (G1) race—the most prestigious type of race in the league—but she is determined to unleash her true potential as a horse girl.

Meanwhile, Satono Diamond comes from a long line of horse girls who, despite sporting incredible running prowess, have never won a G1 race. It is up to her to finally break this curse and bring the Satono clan the glory it deserves.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 3 of Uma Musume: Pretty Derby is a solid, enjoyable addition to the franchise, though it doesn't reach the emotional heights of Season 2. While the animation and race sequences are praised, some viewers find the character development of the protagonists, particularly Kitasan Black, less compelling. The season is considered a worthwhile watch for fans of the series but falls short of being a masterpiece.
pros: Expressive animation and voice acting, especially for Kitasan Black.
Exciting race sequences with improved animation and direction.
Heartwarming moments and wholesome tone consistent with the series.
Exploration of the challenges and struggles faced by athletes, particularly focusing on mental state.
cons: Kitasan Black's character arc is not as compelling as previous protagonists, with some finding her emotional responses excessive.
Satono Diamond feels like a supporting character rather than a co-lead.
Side characters are underdeveloped and underutilized.
Repetitive flashbacks and dialogue.
Narrative inconsistencies and pacing issues compared to Season 2.

anime.title: Detective Conan Movie 26: Black Iron Submarine
anime.romaji_title: Meitantei Conan Movie 26: Kurogane no Submarine
anime.synopsis:
This time's location is set in the sea near the Hachijo-jima island, Tokyo. Engineers from around the world have gathered for the full-scale operation of "Pacific Buoy," an offshore facility to connect security cameras owned by the worldwide police forces. A test of a certain "new technology" based on a face recognition system is underway there.

Meanwhile, Conan and the Detective Boys visit Hachijo-jima at Sonoko's invitation and receive a phone call from Subaru Okiya informing them that a Europol employee was murdered in Germany by the Black Organization's Jin.

Conan, who is disquieted, sneaks into the facility and finds that a female engineer has been kidnapped by the Black Organization...! Furthermore, a USB drive containing certain information in her possession ends up in the hands of the organization... A black shadow also creeps up on Ai Haibara ...
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is generally well-received as a thrilling and action-packed addition to the Detective Conan franchise. It is praised for its focus on character relationships, animation, and suspenseful plot, although some find the physics and certain elements to be questionable. Long-time fans may have mixed feelings but most people enjoyed the movie overall.
pros: Thrilling and action-packed with plenty of explosions.
Strong focus on character relationships, especially Haibara's role.
Great animation and soundtrack enhance the experience.
Unpredictable plot with subtle hints and well-written mystery.
cons: Physics in some scenes don't make sense.
Some typical Detective Conan elements feel out of place.
Plot may not be compelling for long-time viewers.
Too many questions and not enough answers.

anime.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 3
anime.romaji_title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 3rd Season
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, Reincarnation, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Rimuru Tempest is victorious following his climactic showdown with Demon Lord Clayman. With Diablo's aid, the war with the Falmuth Kingdom ends decisively in Rimuru's favor. Fueled by increased migration and the integration of Jura Forest, the nation of Tempest undergoes rapid growth.

Rimuru's victory shifts the balance of power, giving rise to a renewed period of peace—but whether that peace will last is another matter. Yuuki Kagurazaka and Kazalim are conspiring with the Harlequin Alliance to bring about Rimuru's downfall. Furthermore, the Western Holy Church continues its intolerant crusade against Rimuru and his non-human subordinates. Both allies and enemies engage in a battle of wits, carefully advancing their agendas without shattering the delicate status quo. But once the first domino inevitably falls, the race to supremacy begins.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment towards Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken Season 3 is heavily divided. While some appreciate the focus on political intrigue and world-building, many are critical of the excessive dialogue and slow pacing, with the season described by many as boring and uneventful. The shift away from action and adventure, along with concerns about animation quality, has led to disappointment and a feeling of wasted potential for a significant portion of viewers.
pros: Faithful adaptation of light novel content for dedicated fans.
World-building and expansion of Tempest's political dynamics.
Character development, particularly for Rimuru and supporting characters.
Logical story progression with good decision-making.
cons: Overabundance of meetings and dialogue-heavy scenes, leading to slow pacing.
Lack of action and excitement compared to previous seasons.
Perceived decline in animation quality during certain episodes.
Filler-like content and stretched-out scenes.
Shallow character development, with many characters merely serving Rimuru.
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Nation Building, Isekai Fatigue

anime.title: Modern Love Tokyo: He's Playing Our Song
anime.romaji_title: Modern Love Tokyo: Kare ga Kanaderu Futari no Shirabe
anime.synopsis:
Though her high school days are long behind her, Tamami Sakurai is still just as awkward and clumsy as ever. At night, she is often seen at a local Tokyo bar, which has become a safe haven from her stressful job. After a few too many drinks, Tamami begins to feel as if she is invincible, but the hangover afterward begs to differ.

One such night ends on a disparate note when an intoxicated Tamami hears some familiar chords playing on the record player, bringing tears to her eyes as she recalls bygone years. The melody reminds her of a shy pianist named Rin Kajitani—a boy who was once the closest friend she ever had.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoyed 'Modern Love Tokyo,' praising its heartwarming narrative, delightful music, and unique art style. Some critics found the animation generic and the story lacking risk, while others appreciated its simplicity. Overall, it's considered a charming and cozy experience, though some wish it was longer.
pros: Charming and cozy experience with heartwarming moments
Delightful and flawless music that complements the story
Unique and appealing art style
cons: Length of the movie is short
Animation is generic
Story is straightforward and takes no risks

anime.title: The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash
anime.romaji_title: Saijaku Tamer wa Gomi Hiroi no Tabi wo Hajimemashita.
anime.synopsis:
Born into a loving family, Femicia appears to have a bright future ahead of her. When she finally turns five, the time comes to go to the church to have her skills appraised. However, while she does receive a monster tamer skill, it turns out that Femicia has zero stars for that ability. To make matters worse, society considers those who have zero stars to be harbingers of misfortune; as a result, Femicia is shunned by everyone—including her family.

Soon enough, Femicia is chased out of her village and is constantly on the run. Fearing for her life, she decides to masquerade as a boy and change her name to Ivy. With a goal given to her by a fortune teller to reach the royal capital, Ivy meets and successfully tames a slime, starting an unlikely friendship that may provide a means to get the destiny she deserves.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Saijaku Tamer" for its heartwarming story, endearing characters, and unique take on the Isekai genre, especially its avoidance of common tropes. However, some find the plot armor, inconsistent world-building, and slow pacing to be significant drawbacks. Despite these criticisms, the show is largely considered a wholesome and comforting watch, with many viewers expressing a desire for a second season.
pros: Endearing characters and their development, particularly Ivy's resilience
Unique and refreshing take on the Isekai genre, avoiding common tropes
Beautiful animation and art style
Positive messages about overcoming adversity and finding trust
Well-developed, relatable characters
Good world-building in early episodes
Soothing and comforting slice-of-life elements
cons: Inconsistent world-building and poorly explained skill system
Over-reliance on plot armor and convenient plot devices
Repetitive praise for the main character
Slow pacing and dull investigation arcs in later episodes
Lack of communication from Sora
Underdeveloped side characters
The second half falls flat
convenient plot devices

anime.title: Dead Mount Death Play
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Reincarnation, Seinen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
A powerful necromancer known as the Corpse God dies during a legendary battle, only to be reborn as Polka Shinoyama, a young boy in modern-day Tokyo. In the process of trying to adapt to his new physical body, he gets targeted by various groups that deal with the supernatural. Among them is Misaki Sakimiya, a high school girl who can see spirits and is out for his blood from the very moment they meet.

Attempting to make sense of this situation where unknown parties want him dead, Polka eventually meets Takumi Kuruya, a contractor skilled in surveillance and hacking, and Lisa Kuraki, a crime boss operating out of Shinjuku. Alongside these—and other unexpected—allies, Polka braves danger to reveal the truth of his reincarnation and the fate awaiting the world he now lives in.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the unique premise and world-building, many find the plot slow, the characters underdeveloped, and the overall experience unsatisfying due to unresolved plot threads. The show is seen as having potential but ultimately fails to deliver a cohesive and engaging narrative, leaving viewers feeling disappointed.
pros: Interesting world-building and unique premise.
Engaging mystery and suspenseful elements.
Some viewers appreciate the combination of genres.
Animation quality is generally well-received.
cons: Pacing issues, with slow plot development and excessive world-building.
Too many characters introduced without proper development or resolution.
Plot threads are often left unresolved, leading to disappointment.
Inconsistent tone, with comic relief disrupting serious moments.
Protagonist is seen as passive and lacking personality.
Story feels like a setup with no satisfying conclusion.
anime.thematic_vibe: Urban Fantasy, Supernatural Thriller, Reverse Isekai

anime.title: My Clueless First Friend
anime.romaji_title: Jijou wo Shiranai Tenkousei ga Guigui Kuru.
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Akane Nishimura's quiet nature makes her classmates perceive her as a gloomy and unlikeable person. Combined with her intimidating gaze, it earns Akane the ominous nickname "Grim Reaper," condemning her to endless bullying for her supposed cursed powers that bring misfortune to everyone around her.

However, none of these rumors deter transfer student Taiyou Takada from trying to befriend Akane. As someone who finds the supernatural fascinating, Taiyou approaches the Grim Reaper without hesitation, blissfully unaware of the complicated situation within the class. His bright personality and optimistic worldview may just bring about the change that Akane desperately needs.
