Unfortunately, his struggle begins early on during the entrance exams; although he is ranked first of his group, Desir is assigned to the Beta Class, the default class for commoners.

Now, Desir's next objective is to rally someone to his cause that he could not save in his previous life: the wind mage Romantica Eru. Then, Desir will have to show his worth to the Alpha Class with his newly formed party if he wants to ultimately save as many lives as possible.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many criticizing the anime adaptation for its subpar animation quality and rushed pacing, which detracts from the source material's potential. Some viewers appreciate the story's premise and character dynamics, while others find it generic and uninspired. Overall, the adaptation fails to fully capture the essence of the source material, resulting in a middling experience for many viewers.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the source material's story and pacing.
Interesting premise with a unique blend of fantasy tropes.
Distinctive characters with well-defined motivations.
cons: Clunky and uninspired animation, particularly in fight scenes.
Rushed pacing, skipping over important character and world-building arcs.
Inconsistent writing and confusing plot elements.
Characters feel forced and lack depth.

anime.title: Demon Lord 2099
anime.synopsis:
Five hundred years ago, the fantasy world of Alneath was torn apart by a war between magically gifted immortals and mortals armed with magical artifacts. The conflict came to an end when mortals' hero, Gram, slayed the Demon Lord Veltol Velvet Velsvolt. In 2099, the world looks a bit different. Alneath and technologically advanced Earth have fused in an event known as Fantasion. Immortals have been hunted down to near extinction, and technological implants called Familia allow mortals to use magic.

As the new world slowly recovers, Veltol's vassal Machina Solege resurrects him in Shinjuku, a techno-magical city constructed in the middle of devastated lands. However, Veltol's magic is severely weakened, and his former ally Marcus has betrayed him. To regain his fame and magical abilities, Veltol follows the advice of Takahashi—Machina's friend and a professional hacker—to start an unusual career: live streaming. His sharp tongue and comically poor gaming skills quickly secure him followers, but to dominate the world once again, Veltol must first uncover Shinjuku's secrets and thwart Marcus' vile plans.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audiences found 'Maou 2099' to be a surprisingly enjoyable anime due to its unique setting and character interactions. However, some felt the plot became generic and the story lost its way later in the season. While praised for its animation and world-building, the anime is ultimately considered a decent watch that doesn't leave a lasting impression.
pros: Unique blend of fantasy and cyberpunk elements
Well-developed characters with strong chemistry
Good pacing and story development, especially in the first arc
High-quality animation and character design by JC Staff
Refreshing take on the demon lord trope with a focus on adaptation and character growth
cons: Underdeveloped narrative and plot in later arcs
Inconsistent character development, especially for the MC
Sound design and music not particularly outstanding
Some scenes feel cliche or inorganic
Pacing can feel slow or dull at times

anime.title: Shadowverse Flame: Seven Shadows-hen
anime.synopsis: Second part of Shadowverse Flame.
anime.consensus_summary: The Seven Shadows arc is well-received, particularly for its fanservice and focus on character development. The writers designed smart matchups for everyone in the main cast. Mikado's transition is a humorous highlight, and Ryoga's plotline progresses smoothly.
pros: Satisfying character matchups designed for the main cast.
Mikado's character development from cocky rival to friend is a highlight.
Ryoga's plotline progression is well-executed and engaging.

anime.title: Senpai is an Otokonoko
anime.genres: Crossdressing, Drama, Love Polygon, Romance, School
anime.synopsis:
Much like the other students at her school, first-year student Saki Aoi finds herself captivated by the beauty of her senior on the school board, Makoto Hanaoka. While she worries that Hanaoka would be uncomfortable receiving a confession from another girl, Aoi musters up the courage to tell her anyway. However, Hanaoka's response surprises Aoi for a completely different reason—Hanaoka is actually a cross-dressing boy!

Fully expecting Aoi to be abhorred by this revelation, Hanaoka is shocked to find that she has no issues with it. Though Hanaoka rejects Aoi's request to go out with her—citing his identity and the fact that he has never fallen in love before—Aoi insists that she will become his first love. Taken aback by Aoi's determination, Hanaoka wonders if he can really fall in love with her if he cannot find it in him to truly love himself first.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some praising the show's sensitive portrayal of LGBTQ+ themes and character development. Others criticize the rushed pacing, underdeveloped subplots, and tonal inconsistencies. While the show tackles important topics, its execution leaves some viewers disappointed, resulting in a moderately polarized reception.
pros: Respectful and mature depiction of gender dysphoria and sexual identity.
Exploration of important conversations about cross-dressing, gender identity, sexuality, friendship, love, and family.
Well-rounded characters with relatable strengths and flaws.
Addresses complex issues such as abusive parenting and neglect.
cons: Underdeveloped subplots and themes.
Awkward pacing and a fudged narrative.
Incomplete adaptation with rushed content.
Messy tone that struggles to balance comedy with serious themes.

anime.title: Horimiya: The Missing Pieces
anime.synopsis: As the graduation ceremony at Katagiri High School comes to an end, Kyouko Hori, her boyfriend Izumi Miyamura, and their friends begin to look back on their time as students. The moments they shared together may be fleeting, but each one is a colorful piece of their precious memories.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many appreciating the additional slice-of-life content and character development, while others find it lacks a compelling plot and feels like unnecessary filler. Some viewers enjoyed seeing more of the side characters and consider it a wholesome addition to the series. However, a significant portion feels that the season doesn't add much to the overall story and may not appeal to those primarily interested in the central romance.
pros: Excellent character dynamics, especially for side characters
High-quality animation and sound design
Enjoyable and relaxing 'feel-good' content
Complements the original series by filling in missing content
cons: Lack of significant plot progression
Repetitive slice-of-life content that may become boring
Uneven timeline and disjointed episode structure
Potential disappointment for viewers seeking romance progression
Focus may shift away from the main couple

anime.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3
anime.romaji_title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 3rd Season
anime.genres: Drama, Fantasy, Isekai, Psychological, Suspense, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
One year after the events at the Sanctuary, Subaru Natsuki trains hard to better face future challenges. The peaceful days come to an end when Emilia receives an invitation to a meeting in the Watergate City of Priestella from none other than Anastasia Hoshin, one of her rivals in the royal selection. Considering the meeting's significance and the potential dangers Emilia could face, Subaru and his friends accompany her.

However, as Subaru reconnects with old associates and companions in Priestella, new formidable foes emerge. Driven by fanatical motivations and engaging in ruthless methods to achieve their ambitions, the new enemy targets Emilia and threaten the very existence of the city. Rallying his allies, Subaru must give his all once more to stop their nefarious goals from becoming a concrete reality.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Re:Zero Season 3 is divided. While some appreciate the improved animation and faithful adaptation, many feel the season deviates from the series' core strengths, becoming a generic action anime with repetitive plot structures. The shift in tone and focus has left some viewers disappointed, while others enjoyed the faster pace and increased intensity.
pros: Improved animation quality, a significant step up from previous seasons.
Faithful adaptation of Arc 5 from the light novel, pleasing fans of the source material.
Fast-paced and intense compared to previous seasons, with more graphic content.
cons: Shift in focus towards action and away from psychological suspense and drama, leading to a generic feel.
Underwhelming antagonists and distasteful content diminish the impact of the conflict.
Repetitive cycles of bad guy appears, team deals with bad guy, rinse and repeat.
Dialogue is excessively eccentric or comical, breaking immersion and making it difficult to understand the plot.

anime.title: HYPNOSISMIC -Division Rap Battle- Rhyme Anima PLUS
anime.romaji_title: Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle - Rhyme Anima +
anime.synopsis:
A recent uptick in civilian riots and crimes has been observed across the country following the conclusion of the second Division Rap Battle. To make matters more chaotic, the individuals perpetrating the crimes have no recollection of the incidents nor any reason to be committing them in the first place. Suspecting these events to be linked to the effect of the Hypnosis Microphones, the governing Party of Words begins investigating the whereabouts of the mastermind behind them.

These cases have been more frequent in the six divisions, and their respective leaders are scrambling to find a way to prevent further havoc. But when the culprit pulling the strings threatens their territories with more calamity, the six leaders must put aside their personal differences and work together to stop this mayhem.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally perceives 'Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle - Rhyme Anima +' as a disappointing sequel. While the animation quality remains consistent, the storyline is considered unoriginal and driven by commercial interests rather than creative vision. The new characters offer some appeal, but ultimately the season fails to capture the essence that made the first season enjoyable.
pros: Animation quality remains high despite weaker plot.
Introduction of new characters from Dotsuitare Hompo and Bad Ass Temple adds some novelty.
cons: Plot feels cliché and uninspired compared to Season 1.
Season 2 feels unnecessary, potentially driven by commercial interests.
OP is not as memorable as Season 1's opening theme.

anime.title: Rinkai!
anime.synopsis:
Women's competitive cycling had been defunct for decades until the newly formed Rinkai League revived the sport, making headlines with its first few races. It has inspired many women across Japan, who flock to the league in hopes of realizing their dreams of becoming professional athletes.

Cycling enthusiast Izumi Itou is reluctant to stake her future on a racing competition, despite her friends' encouragement. That changes when she discovers that her grandmother is a former champion in women's cycling. She offers to train Izumi, hoping to help her recognize her own talent. Although Izumi lacks experience, the appearance of a fierce Swiss contestant who aims to dominate the competition motivates her to give it all on the track and, ultimately, win.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime had potential but suffers from poor execution and character development. Viewers were disappointed by the lack of focus on the main character and the awkward pacing. The use of 3DCG animation was also a point of criticism, though some appreciated the 2D animation quality and soundtrack.
pros: Good 2D animation quality
Interesting character designs
Decent soundtrack that immerses in tense scenes
cons: Awkward story execution and pacing
Poor character development, especially for the main character
Too much focus on supporting characters at the expense of the main storyline
Mediocre and out-of-place 3DCG animation during cycling scenes
Bland and boring characters with wasted potential

anime.title: Trigun Stargaze
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Adventure, Sci-Fi, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Two and a half years after the dark day of the Lost JuLai, Meryl Stryfe roams in the desert wilderness of Noman's Land alongside her younger assistant, Milly Thompson. She still pursues Vash the Stampede, the culprit behind the cataclysmic events that took the lives of 90 percent of the JuLai city population. Vash, also referred to as the "Humanoid Typhoon," is now sought after for 60 billion double dollars—the largest bounty in the history of the planet.

In a backwater town of Noman's Land, an apathetic Vash has been rescued and cared for by Hoppered the Gauntlet, a man who covers his mutilated body with armor. But Hoppered's secluded life is abruptly interrupted by the arrival of young Jessica seeking help for her endangered home.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Trigun Stargaze is mixed, with many finding it a disappointing sequel to Stampede. While the animation and music are praised, the rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, and overreliance on fanservice are major points of criticism. Many feel the season fails to deliver a satisfying conclusion and lacks the emotional depth of previous installments.
pros: Impressive 3D animation and expressive character models
Fantastic musical score
Visually stunning fight scenes
cons: Rushed and compressed plot leading to a disjointed story
Underdeveloped or regressed character arcs
Weak and superficial writing with nonsensical plot elements
Overreliance on fanservice at the expense of meaningful storytelling
Poor pacing and wasted runtime with filler content

anime.title: Blue Lock Season 2
anime.synopsis:
The next phase of the controversial Blue Lock project is underway with the candidate pool being dwindled down to just 35. Out of the remaining strikers, only a select few will be chosen to play in an upcoming exhibition game against the current U-20 Japanese soccer team. Playing in this match comes with a caveat: winning will grant the players the right to represent the nation as the new U-20 team, but losing will bring an end to Blue Lock in its entirety. Among the ones left in the running is Yoichi Isagi, who is coming to terms with his own abilities.

To further complicate matters, the six best players in the pool have already been named to the starting lineup and the remaining 29 will have to duke it out to claim a coveted spot. Each candidate must select a top six pairing to team up with for the selection to prove their competence. But if this mishmash of strikers wants to overthrow the current U-20 team, they will need to find a way to combine their playstyles effectively.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is heavily divided due to the jarring animation quality, particularly in the initial episodes, which significantly detracted from the viewing experience. While many appreciate the engaging story, compelling characters, and hype-inducing moments, the animation issues are a major point of contention. Some viewers found the later episodes and the overall narrative strong enough to overcome the animation flaws, while others were too disappointed to enjoy the series.
pros: Compelling characters with well-developed backstories and dynamics.
Exciting and suspenseful story, particularly in crucial moments and later episodes.
Effective at building hype and anticipation, creating an immersive experience despite flaws.
The story is interesting.
cons: Inconsistent and often poor animation quality, especially in early episodes (described as a 'PowerPoint presentation').
Over-reliance on static shots and internal monologues, leading to a lack of fluid action.
Cringeworthy and repetitive dialogue, with an overemphasis on 'selfishness'.
Questionable portrayal of football, with unrealistic scenarios and tactics.
Inconsistent animation quality negatively impacts the viewing experience.

anime.title: Blue Lock: Episode Nagi
anime.synopsis: A spin-off of Blue Lock focusing on Seishirou Nagi.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many criticizing the film for being a glorified recap with reused content and lackluster animation. Some viewers, particularly fans of Nagi and Reo, appreciated the film for providing their perspectives on the events of the first season and offering a refresher before the next season. However, most agree that the movie misses the opportunity to explore Nagi's backstory in depth and lacks substantial new material.
pros: Provides Nagi's perspective on events from the first season, offering a deeper understanding of his and Reo's motivations.
Enjoyable for hardcore Nagi fans and those interested in his backstory.
Serves as a refresher for the original anime before the next season.
cons: Largely a recap of the first season with reused footage and minimal new content.
Fails to delve deeper into Nagi's past or offer significant new insights.
Animation quality is underwhelming for a theatrical release, with some scenes feeling rushed or poorly integrated.
Some found the new scenes poorly integrated

anime.title: High Card Season 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of High Card.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to High Card Season 2 is mixed. While some appreciate the satisfying conclusion and action elements, many feel the season suffered from rushed pacing, underdeveloped characters, and a juggling of too many plot concepts.  The animation quality was also a point of criticism. Overall, it's considered an average anime that doesn't stand out significantly.
pros: Satisfying ending with fleshed-out character motives.
Solid shonen card battle animations and overall art.
Nice soundtrack that accompanies each episode well.
Characters experience believable arcs.
cons: Rushed pacing, especially after the middle of the season.
Lack of depth in exploring the intricacies of the story and characters.
Uneven character development and screen time for new characters.
Story juggles multiple concepts without giving enough detail to each.
Animation and CGI were not spectacular

anime.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Knapsack Kid
anime.romaji_title: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Randoseru Girl no Yume wo Minai
anime.synopsis:
As Sakuta Azusagawa waits for Mai Sakurajima at the beach on her high school graduation day, he encounters a version of Mai from her child acting days. However, when Mai finally arrives, her younger self disappears, leaving him confused. Sakuta spots an unfamiliar scar on his body when he returns home, which confirms his suspicion—he is involved in another case of the inexplicable Puberty Syndrome.

Not long after, Sakuta and his sister, Kaede, receive a call from their father. He tells them that their mother, who had been recently discharged from the hospital, wants to see her daughter once more. Experiencing strange occurrences while visiting his mother with Kaede, Sakuta must find a way to solve the Puberty Syndrome abnormalities.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is generally positive, with many appreciating the emotional depth and character development, particularly Sakuta's growth and the focus on family. However, some find the plot slow and less engaging than previous installments, and the supernatural elements can be confusing. Despite some criticisms, the movie is considered a worthwhile addition to the series for fans.
pros: Strong character development, especially for Sakuta.
Relatable emotional themes.
Consistent quality compared to previous installments.
Satisfying resolution of Sakuta's personal issues.
Good soundtrack and animation.
cons: Plot can be slow and uneventful.
Supernatural elements can be confusing.
Some find Mai's character inconsistent or frustrating.
May not be as dramatic as previous movies.

anime.title: Since I Wasn't the Heroine
anime.romaji_title: Ta Bu Dang Nuzhu Hen Duo Nian
anime.synopsis:
Beiyi used a strategy to attack Baicheng, an important town in the northern border of Daqi Kingdom. Tang Yao, the guard of Baicheng, led his people to resist desperately, but they were outnumbered, and all sacrificed. Only the second daughter, Tang Ying, survived.

What makes Tang Ying even more indignant is that his father sacrificed his life for the country, but in return he was charged with collaborating with the enemy. In order to take the place of her father, Tang Yingyi went to the capital, but found that things were not as simple as imagined.

Is Yuan Lang, the second prince of the Daqi Kingdom who has been hostage for decades, related to Beiyi?

Why is the woman pretending to be herself so strangely similar?

What happened to the otherworldly person that Yao Niang from the movie department was talking about?

There are also those strange and familiar memories that appeared nervously... There are too many mysteries waiting for Tang Ying to answer.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is intrigued by the show's mysterious plot and genre-bending elements, appreciating the gradual unfolding of the story and the quality of animation and action sequences. Some viewers find the initial lack of clarity and the incomplete nature of the first season slightly off-putting. Overall, there's a positive sentiment with anticipation for the second season to resolve the mysteries.
pros: Intriguing mystery that unfolds gradually.
Excellent genre blending (comedy, action).
Beautiful animation and majestic sound effects.
Hectic war/fight scenes.
cons: Incomplete story as of the first season.
Initial confusion due to lack of information and genre blending.

anime.title: Malevolent Spirits: Mononogatari 2nd Season
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Mythology, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Although Hyouma Kunato has begun to feel comfortable around Botan Nagatsuki and her family of tsukumogami—objects possessed by spirits called marebito—he has not forgotten about his main goal in life: revenge.

Unbeknownst to Hyouma, while he is training in Kyoto under the supervision of the Kadomori family, the Bureau of Traditional Music, a group of three musical instrument tsukumogami, begins to enact its plan. The trio questions Botan's family about their intentions regarding Hyouma's presence near the person embodying the frontier between the human and marebito worlds. Soon after, the paper umbrella tsukumogami that Hyouma had been pursuing for years suddenly reappears and abducts Botan along with her university friends. Rushing to save the one he swore to protect, Hyouma might have to change his priorities if he wants to keep his promise to Botan.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the character development, intriguing plot, and solid world-building, while others criticize the slow pacing, underwhelming animation, and repetitive plot elements. The series is considered decent but lacks the 'wow' factor to make it stand out.
pros: Well-written characters and intriguing plot.
Impressive character development, particularly Hyoma's evolving relationship.
Solid worldbuilding and clear story.
cons: Pacing issues with drawn-out plot and lack of progression.
Underwhelming animation quality.
Repetitive plot elements and plot holes.

anime.title: Bungo Stray Dogs 5
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Detective, Mystery, Organized Crime, Seinen, Super Power, Vampire
anime.synopsis:
The Armed Detective Agency is still on the run from the Hunting Dogs, but not all hope is lost. Detective Ranpo Edogawa has a plan to prove the Agency's innocence and save the world from chaos: to find and capture Kamui—the leader of the terrorist organization Decay of the Angel. 

In order to determine Kamui's whereabouts, Ranpo and his colleague Atsushi Nakajima must convince Ouchi Fukuchi, the renowned captain of the Hunting Dogs, for amnesty. Although Fukuchi was tasked with arresting the members of the Agency, his past with the Agency's president, Yukichi Fukuzawa, may be the key to earning his trust. But unbeknownst to them, Fukuchi might not be as honorable as he proclaims.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the action, suspense, and plot twists. However, some viewers are critical of the overuse of deus ex machina and contrived plot developments, which they feel detract from the story's overall quality. Additionally, some concerns exist over animation inconsistencies and pacing issues, leading to a somewhat divided opinion on the season's success.
pros: Engaging plot with many twists and turns.
Improved animation quality.
Strong character development, especially for lesser-used characters.
Excellent soundtrack that enhances the viewing experience.
High stakes and tension keep viewers on the edge of their seats.
cons: Excessive use of deus ex machina moments that undermine narrative cohesion.
Plot twists can feel contrived and overdone.
Some find Atsushi's role to be irrelevant.
Inconsistencies in animation detail (e.g., characters lacking eyes in certain scenes).
Pacing issues, with some feeling the season rushes through the manga content.

anime.title: Wind Breaker
anime.synopsis:
From an early age, Haruka Sakura was made an outcast due to his unconventional appearance and lack of social skills. However, the rough treatment turned him into a proficient fighter, which is now the only thing he prides himself on. Starting at Furin High School, where it is rumored that strength is valued over academics, Sakura has only one goal—taking the top spot.

Involved in a street brawl the day before his enrollment, Sakura happens to meet a group of his future schoolmates. Instead of the usual rejection, they fight alongside him, demonstrating that what the school actually cares about is protecting the town of Makochi from any harm—hence why the students call themselves "Bofurin." Surprised by the support and appreciation of the townspeople, Sakura has a hard time accepting their goodwill.

Though unfamiliar with kindness being shown to him, Sakura must learn to push past his discomfort when Bofurin is pitted against formidable enemies. After experiencing the feeling of acceptance, he finds himself fighting for the sake of others for the first time.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Many praise the stunning visuals and action sequences but criticize the weak plot and shallow character development. Some viewers find the themes of friendship and self-acceptance childish, while others appreciate the unique portrayal of delinquents.
pros: Amazing animation and fight choreography by Cloverworks.
Cool and well-developed side characters.
Potential for emotional connection with the main character.
cons: Weak or nonexistent plot.
Incoherent or childish themes.
Overhyped due to animation, distracting from poor writing.
Forced character development and cringe-worthy dialogue.
Repetitive exposition and lack of depth.

anime.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
anime.romaji_title: Shinmai Ossan Boukensha, Saikyou Party ni Shinu hodo Kitaerarete Muteki ni Naru.
anime.synopsis:
Determined to pursue his glorious childhood dreams, 30-year-old Rick Gladiatol, a modest clerk in the adventurers' guild, is offered a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity after he fatefully encounters the dark elf Reanette Elfelt. Reanette happens to be an elite adventurer of the legendary party Orichalcum Fist, whose members welcome Rick under the condition that he follow a Spartan training.

Two years later, Rick is finally ready to take the E-Rank exam officially qualifying him as an adventurer. However, raw magical power can only be developed until one turns 20. As such, Rick faces the general hostility of fellow participants and examiners alike, leaving him no choice but to show the world that his hellish training has turned him into an invincible warrior.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a fairly generic but enjoyable watch, particularly for those who appreciate old-school shonen themes. Many find the characters likeable and the action satisfying, although some find the humor and fan service off-putting. While it doesn't break any new ground, it provides a simple and entertaining experience for viewers looking for a lighthearted fantasy adventure.
pros: Enjoyable action sequences, particularly in the later episodes.
Likeable and engaging characters with a heartwarming dynamic.
Positive message about pursuing dreams regardless of age.
cons: Generic and predictable storyline with overused tropes.
Inconsistent humor, particularly the repetitive '30 = old' joke.
Unnecessary fan service that feels out of place.

anime.title: Bikkurimen
anime.synopsis: The story is set in a world where the value of Bikkuri-Man stickers are so high that they have to be transported in a cash transport vehicle. There was also the famous robbery case one year ago, called the "300 million Bikkuri-Man sticker case." One day, a high-school delivery part-timer named Yamato gets involved in a battle over stickers between two competing convenience stores. The Angel Mart owned by the Phoenix store manager is famous for its easy-to-use glitter stickers. The Devil Store across the street also tries to attract Bikkuri-Man fans to their store. Former comrades are divided into allies and foes, and the battle of destiny begins.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience views Bikkurimen as a cute and nostalgic anime with an interesting premise centered around collectible stickers. However, the story lacks depth and feels scattered, preventing it from being a highly engaging series. Despite its flaws, some viewers express a willingness to watch another season if it were to be released.
pros: Nice idea for an anime
Impressive character design
Cute opening song
cons: Story is very scattered
No depth to the characters

anime.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets~
anime.synopsis: Featuring stories from the manga not adapted in the main anime.
anime.consensus_summary: The general sentiment is positive, particularly among manga readers who felt previous adaptations missed key elements. Many viewers appreciated the improved animation quality and the filling in of plot gaps, especially regarding Yotsuba's character. Some found the placement and relevance of the episodes questionable, but overall, fans of the series enjoyed the additional content.
pros: Animation quality significantly improved, especially by Shaft Studios.
Faithful manga adaptation filling in missing plot points.
Provides additional character development, especially for Yotsuba.
Enjoyable scenes for each sister.
cons: Feels like 'scraps' left out of previous adaptations.
Some consider the episodes irrelevant to the main story and strangely placed.
The placement within the timeline of the overall series is confusing.
anime.thematic_vibe: Warm interactions, Character Development, Romantic undertones

anime.title: Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku Arc
anime.genres: Action, Delinquents, Drama, Shounen, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
After succeeding in their winter conflict against Taiju Shiba and his Black Dragons, the Tokyo Manji Gang absorbs their group's remaining members. Due to his heroic courage and indomitable spirit, Takemichi Hanagaki should have accomplished his goal of defeating the tragic fate awaiting his girlfriend, Hinata Tachibana.

In reality, Takemichi's troubles are far from over. Although Takemichi's actions have exposed Tetta Kisaki's treachery, the conniving schemer has found power elsewhere: Tenjiku, a dangerous gang led by the enigmatic Izana Kurokawa. Izana sets his sights on Manjirou "Mikey" Sano, pursuing a vicious interest in the Tokyo Manji Gang's aloof leader.

In the future, Takemichi discovers that the machinations of Izana and Kisaki led to Mikey's moral ruin—a downfall that directly results in Hinata's death. Unfortunately, a terrible loss robs Takemichi of his time-leaping ability, stranding him in the past with one final chance to rescue everyone he loves.
anime.consensus_summary: The Tenjiku-hen arc is considered a significant improvement over previous seasons, primarily due to the compelling storyline, emotional depth, and Takemichi's character development. However, the season is criticized for inconsistent animation quality, pacing issues, and some plot points that feel rushed or poorly explained. Despite its flaws, many viewers found the season enjoyable and engaging, with a satisfying ending that leaves them anticipating a potential continuation.
pros: Compelling story with high stakes
Takemichi's character development is a highlight
Interesting new characters and backstories add depth
Satisfying ending (to the season) with potential for more
cons: Animation quality is inconsistent and sometimes poor
Pacing issues and repetitive elements in the first part of the season
Some plot points and character motivations feel rushed or unexplained
Reliance on flashbacks and backstories disrupts the flow
Predictable elements and wasted potential in the story

anime.title: 30,000 Miles From Chang'an
anime.synopsis: A few years after the Anshi Rebellion, the Tibetan army invaded the southwest and the Tang dynasty military commander Gao Shi suffered a defeat in battle. Chang'an was in imminent danger. Gao Shi, who was trapped in the besieged city, recalled his past experiences with Li Bai to the eunuch who served as the military supervisor.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely positive, praising the animation quality, mature storytelling, and historical depth. Some criticism is directed towards character design and potential difficulties for non-Chinese speakers due to the heavy use of poetry. Overall, the film is considered a high-quality animated experience, especially for those interested in Chinese history and culture.
pros: Stunning animation rivaling Disney and Dreamworks
Excellent storyboarding and direction
High production value and quality
Gorgeous cinematography and sound design
Mature, historical drama with substance
cons: Character designs perceived as weird or annoying
Potential difficulty with subtitles due to complex poetry
Map visualization could be improved

anime.title: Spy Classroom Season 2
anime.synopsis:
Four members of the Din Republic's spy team Lamplight embark on a mission to capture an enemy spy. Although they struggle to work together due to their clashing personalities, Thea, Monika, Erna, and Annett complete their objective. While enjoying a short break, the four girls encounter a woman named Matilda, who claims to be Annett's mother. As they get to know Matilda, the team is dragged into an escalating conflict that tests their teamwork and allegiances.

Meanwhile, the remaining Lamplight members notice that the dispatched squad has yet to report back. Worried about their allies, Klaus and Lily set out on an emergency expedition to locate their missing teammates. As the two uncover troubling information about rising tensions in the area where their friends last were, they must act quickly to reassemble the team before the mission reaches the point of no return.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, audience sentiment is positive regarding Spy Kyoushitsu 2nd Season. Many feel that it improves upon the first season by addressing pacing and character development issues. While some find the adaptation imperfect and the story not exceptionally strong, the season is generally considered enjoyable, especially for those who appreciated the premise of the series.
pros: Improved pacing and narrative flow compared to Season 1
Faithful adaptation of the light novels, particularly volumes 3 and 4
Better character development, especially for Thea, Annette, and Monika
More emphasis on spy elements and trickery
Clearer overarching story direction with defined enemies and goals
cons: Still not a perfect adaptation of the source material
Some pacing issues remain, particularly in the final arc
The story is not the strongest piece of writing
Some viewers found the pacing random and hard to follow
Originality and charm are slightly diminished compared to Season 1

anime.title: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!
anime.synopsis:
In their last year of middle school, the five band members of CRYCHIC went their separate ways after an unpleasant disbandment. Each wrestling with their own regrets, the girls enrolled in different high schools, hoping never to hear from one another again.

Meanwhile, Anon Chihaya transfers to Haneoka Girls' Academy in the middle of the school year. As most students play in a band as a hobby, Anon desires to fit in and spends her first days trying to recruit members for her own band, envisioning herself as the group's vocalist. She befriends Tomori Takamatsu, a shy girl who seems interested but hesitant about joining. As it turns out, Tomori used to be part of CRYCHIC, an experience that has scarred her deeply.

Through Tomori, Anon meets Taki Shiina and Soyo Nagasaki, both former members of the same band. Although Taki detests the idea of playing with Anon, Soyo is delighted to help her out. Now with Soyo by her side, Anon's dream of forming a band is within reach—if only she could find a few more members.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience response to 'BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!' is largely positive, praising its mature themes, realistic characters, and dramatic storytelling. Some viewers may be put off by the 3D animation or the initially somber tone, but the show is ultimately a standout in the BanG Dream! franchise and the music anime genre.
pros: Well-written characters with flaws and depth.
Excellent use of camera work and visual storytelling.
Realistic portrayal of interpersonal conflicts and emotional struggles.
Strong character development and exploration of past traumas.
Innovative storytelling techniques and emotional depth
departure from typical 'wholesome' music anime
cons: Mediocre voice acting.
Initial reliance on 3D animation may deter some viewers.
Plot may be slow or uninteresting to viewers seeking light-hearted content.

anime.title: Pseudo Harem
anime.genres: Comedy, Love Status Quo, Romance, School, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Eiji Kitahama has a dream shared by many high school guys: to be popular and have a harem of girls fawning over him. Luckily for him, his new junior in the drama club, Rin Nanakura, has decided to help him realize this wish. Using her impressive acting abilities, she takes on many personalities, from teasing to calm and collected, to play characters in Eiji's simulated harem.

As her connection with Eiji deepens, Rin expands her repertoire, quickly swapping between characters while enjoying high school life together in the club. Through her acting, the real Rin Nanakura tries her best to win Eiji's heart.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is largely positive, praising the wholesome romance and unique character acting. However, some viewers find the plot simplistic and the pacing inconsistent. The show is considered enjoyable but lacks depth for some.
pros: Heartwarming and cute romance.
Unique premise with personality switching.
Fast-paced and enjoyable.
cons: Simplistic storyline with lack of emotional depth.
Pacing issues with time jumps and unclear plot progression.
Underdeveloped side characters and lack of conflict.

anime.title: Fabulous Beasts
anime.synopsis: In the wake of scientific advancement, the once majestic mythological animals can't be compared to the olden days now. The mythological animal Sibuxiang received orders to descend to the mortal world and to help out other mythological animals in dire straits wandering the human world. In the secular world, he met his old colleague Pixiu in a tight spot, his drinking buddy Tuye down in his luck, and the gold and silver Jue brothers who were demoted to the mortal world... what kind of stories will happen between them?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the donghua, praising its cute visuals and the incorporation of Chinese folklore. The short episode format is suitable for lighthearted entertainment. There appear to be cross-series references, which are exciting for fans of other donghua.
pros: Cute and soft visuals with detailed brushstrokes.
Characters based on traditional Chinese folklore and ancient literature.

anime.title: The Rich God
anime.synopsis: The financial talent Wang Ke was accidentally brought to the Shenzhou Star by the ancestral sword. With the help of his family's blazing sun, he drove low and walked high, and worshiped the fairy gate. He thought he would make a fortune, but he didn't want to be involved in the two turbulent undercurrents of righteousness and evil. Relying on his talent and wit, Wang Ke made every step of the way, won the hearts of beauties, built a business empire, stepped on the road of defending the way and eliminating demons step by step, and eventually became the immortal king.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience enjoys the comedic aspects and the initial concept of a business-oriented protagonist in a cultivation setting. However, the inconsistent plot development and the overbearing comedy detract from the overall experience. The portrayal of unfair business tactics also raises concerns for some viewers.
pros: Humorous situations
Unique premise of business in a cultivation world
cons: Inconsistent plot
Comedy overshadows the main plot
Unfair business practices portrayed by antagonists

anime.title: Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister
anime.synopsis:
After witnessing his mother's death at a young age, Uryuu Kamihate grew up disillusioned with the gods, dismissing faith in them as utter nonsense. Due to his beliefs, he aims to become a doctor, spending most of his time studying to enter the prestigious Kyoto University.

To further his studies, Uryuu searches for a new place to take him in and get away from the noisy environment of the orphanage where he grew up. Chidori Amagami, head priest of the Amagami Shrine, allows him to stay at the Amagami residence. However, Uryuu has to live there with Chidori's three granddaughters—Yae, Yuna, and Asahi—who serve as shrine maidens. Moreover, Chidori has another condition for Uryuu: he has to marry one of the sisters to ensure the shrine's future and one day inherit it. But with Uryuu's goals and outlook naturally clashing against the sisters' beliefs, this already daunting ordeal seems outright impossible.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received for its unique blend of harem romance with supernatural elements and charming characters. While some find the initial pacing slow and the fanservice distracting, the majority appreciate the engaging story, visual quality, and character development. Overall, it's considered an enjoyable watch, especially for fans of the genre seeking something with a fresh twist.
pros: Unique supernatural twists on the harem genre
Well-developed and charming characters
Visually appealing art and animation with beautiful backgrounds
cons: Slow start that requires patience to get into
Unnecessary fanservice can be distracting
Supernatural elements can feel messy or contribute little to the story

anime.title: Girls Band Cry
anime.synopsis:
Everyone yearns to find their true purpose in life. This is also true for Nina Iseri, a 17-year-old girl looking to enroll in a good university, but the world always seems to work against her. On her very first day in Tokyo, she gets lost, ignored, and locked out of her new apartment. However, an unexpected opportunity arises when Nina meets Momoka Kawaragi, one of her favorite guitarists.

After Nina joins Momoka for a street performance, Momoka decides they should start a band together. While Nina initially hesitates, her determination grows as they start acquiring more bandmates—the beautiful drummer Subaru Awa, the aloof keyboardist Tomo Ebizuka, and the intelligent bassist Rupa. The five girls face challenges both in the music industry and within themselves, but their shared passion for music never lets them give up on their dreams.
anime.consensus_summary: Girls Band Cry is a visually stunning and emotionally resonant anime that stands out in the girls band genre. While the 3D animation and initial character traits may deter some viewers, the show offers a nuanced story about self-discovery and musical passion.  The series is praised for its strong character development, amazing music, and willingness to tackle personal challenges, although some find the plot and characters' initial personalities off-putting.
pros: Groundbreaking 3D animation with expressive characters
Strong character-focused writing with genuine growth
Amazing music that enhances the viewing experience
Nuanced story that avoids typical tropes
cons: 3D animation can be off-putting to some viewers
Protagonist's personality can be initially irritating
Plot can be perceived as cliché at times
Similar to other band anime like It's Mygo!!!!

anime.title: Ensemble Stars!! Tsuioku Selection Crossroad
anime.synopsis: New Ensemble Stars!! web animated series based on the game story "Crossroad".
anime.consensus_summary: The adaptation is considered a failure due to its rushed pacing and omission of key content from the original story. This negatively impacts character development and makes it difficult for new viewers to engage with the narrative. The original source material is recommended instead.
cons: Poor adaptation of original material
Rushed pacing leading to loss of important scenes
Weakened characterization due to time constraints
Unsuitable for newcomers to the series

anime.title: The Foolish Angel Dances with the Devil
anime.romaji_title: Oroka na Tenshi wa Akuma to Odoru
anime.genres: Comedy, Mythology, Romance, School, Seinen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Losing their war against Heaven's angel army, the demons of Hell are on the cusp of collapse. As a last ditch attempt to turn the tides of the war, the demons send Akutsu Masatora to the mortal plane on Earth to save their homeland from the angels. Disguising himself as a high school student, Akutsu seeks to recruit someone with the capability to lead the demons to victory.

Akutsu does not have to look far: among his classmates is the magnificent Lily Amane, a transfer student who seems like the perfect candidate for Akutsu's plans. But as luck would have it, Lily is one of the very angels that Akutsu is meant to be fighting against, and his attempt to recruit her might end up being the biggest blunder in the failing war. Worse yet, Akutsu may fall in love with his own worst enemy.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions on 'Oroka na Tenshi wa Akuma to Odoru' are mixed, with many acknowledging a rocky start but praising the later development of the romance and action elements. While some find the series generic and inconsistent, others appreciate its ability to subvert expectations and deliver a heartfelt story. The humor is divisive, and the overall plot lacks depth, leading to a polarizing reception.
pros: Strong on-screen chemistry between Akutsu and Lily, relationship feels natural.
Voice acting is well-executed, bringing characters to life effectively.
Action scenes are surprisingly well-animated for a romcom.
The series subverts expectations after a weak start, becoming a heartfelt enemies-to-lovers romance.
Well-paced romance that feels natural with great moments between the characters
cons: First few episodes are considered weak and boring by many viewers.
Humor can be hit-or-miss, with some jokes falling flat.
Inconsistent quality throughout the series, with moments of both brilliance and mediocrity.
Overarching story lacks depth and development, and can feel generic.
Character motivations can waver

anime.title: The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor
anime.romaji_title: Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Shoujo, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
Jill Savelle—fiancée of the crown prince Gerald der Kratos and known as the "Lady Goddess of War"—is being hunted down by the same country she swore to protect. Betrayed by her betrothed, she is framed as a traitor and imprisoned. In her last moments, Jill is filled with regret, but just as death approaches, she awakens six years in the past. This time, she will not be a mere pawn.

Now as a 10-year-old girl, Jill resolves to escape her imminent engagement to the prince. To this end, she jokingly professes her love to the 19-year-old dragon emperor Hadis Teos Rave, who will one day stain the land in blood due to madness. But against all expectations, he accepts!

In contrast to the tyrant from Jill's memories, the Hadis of this time is a kind albeit unfortunate emperor. Can Jill prevent Hadis from descending down the same dark, villainous road, or is he bound to an inevitable future?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided due to the controversial age gap between the main characters, overshadowing potentially good elements like plot and world-building. Some appreciate the strong female lead and political intrigue, while others are disgusted by the romantic relationship. The consensus is that the anime had promise, but the problematic relationship dynamic significantly detracts from the overall experience.
pros: Interesting time-rewind premise with potential for clever plot twists.
Strong female lead character in some episodes.
Well-developed political world and power dynamics.
Good balance of serious tone and humor.
Excellent world-building.
cons: Creepy and unsettling age gap between the 10-year-old protagonist and 19-year-old male lead.
Questionable romantic undertones that overshadow the plot.
Inconsistent character writing and lack of depth.
Rushed pacing and extreme exposition dumps.
Cartoonishly evil villains and weak world-building.
anime.thematic_vibe: Controversial Romance, Time Travel, Political Intrigue

anime.title: The Great Ruler
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Romance
anime.synopsis: In the vast world, planes converge and numerous races thrive. A gathering of extraordinary talents unfolds, where one after another, supreme beings from the lower planes come forth. In this boundless realm, they weave captivating legends that inspire admiration, pursuing the path to dominance.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the cultivation donghua, praising the strong protagonist and character dynamics. However, some find the plot repetitive and lacking depth, particularly the unexplained plot points and predictable conflicts. The show is primarily focused on the main character's journey to power.
pros: Strong protagonist with exceptional talent.
Loyal and kind friends.
Varied character cast.
cons: Unexplained plot points (reason for 'drop-out' label).
Repetitive conflict and predictable outcomes.
Motivations solely based on power accumulation.

anime.title: The Yuzuki Family's Four Sons
anime.synopsis: The Yuzuki family, which consists of four brothers, lost their parents two years ago. Hayato, the eldest son, is a hard worker and the pillar of the family. Mikoto, the second son, is calm and collected, but he has a soft spot for his younger brother Minato, whom he adores and thinks is cute. Minato, the third son, is energetic and adores his brothers, but he is clumsy and awkward. Gakuto, the fourth son, is a studious and mature first-grader who is often referred to as a "wise man." The manga depicts the four brothers' daily lives as they navigate their family, school, and community.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, praising the show's heartwarming portrayal of family and its ability to balance emotional depth with lighthearted moments. Viewers appreciate the well-developed characters and the realistic depiction of sibling dynamics. While some note the limited animation, the overall sentiment is one of enjoyment and emotional connection.
pros: Heartwarming portrayal of familial relationships and sibling bonds.
Well-balanced mix of emotional depth and uplifting moments.
Unique and well-developed characters with relatable personalities.
Good writing that avoids clichés and creates authentic family dynamics.
cons: Limited animation budget leading to frequent use of still shots.
Some may find the story too light-hearted at times.

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai 11
anime.synopsis: Eleventh season of Yami Shibai.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus for Yami Shibai 11 is overwhelmingly negative.  Reviewers express disappointment with the lack of scares, uninspired stories, and poor production quality compared to earlier seasons. There's a strong sense that the series has declined in creativity and execution, leading to frustration among longtime fans.  Overall, the season is considered a significant letdown.
pros: Catchy opening theme song (Review 1)
cons: Fails to deliver genuine scares or suspense (Review 1)
Stories are bland, predictable, and illogical (Review 1)
Cheap jump scares and clichéd tropes (Review 1)
Poor animation with stiff movements and dull colors (Review 1)
Mediocre voice acting and overused sound effects (Review 1)
No creativity (Review 2)
Episodes are non-sensical, boring, or stupid (Review 2)
No compelling atmosphere (Review 2)
Stories seem unfinished (Review 2)
Poorly written suspense (Review 2)

anime.title: Hidari Pilot Film
anime.synopsis: Pilot film released on the HIDORI official channel to garner interest for the Kickstarter of the upcoming Hidari stop-motion movie.
anime.consensus_summary: The 'Hidari' pilot film is well-received for its high-quality stop-motion animation and unique concept. Viewers are excited about the potential of the feature-length film. The pilot successfully generates interest and anticipation for the full movie.
pros: High animation quality
Unique concept
Engaging story (despite short length)
anime.thematic_vibe: Japanese Folklore, Stop-Motion Animation, Edo Period

anime.title: Tonbo!
anime.synopsis:
Trying to move on in his life, former professional golfer Kazuyoshi Igarashi arrives at Hinoshima Island for a job at its development center. Expecting the island to be a very rural area with nothing much to offer, Kazuyoshi cannot hide his amazement when he discovers a complete golf course made by the island's inhabitants. Using the seaside terrain to their advantage, the people there have adopted golfing as their hobby.

To add to his surprise, Kazuyoshi meets a young girl named Tonbo Ooi, who has been playing golf using only a 3-iron—a notoriously difficult-to-use club. As the former pro gets more involved with Tonbo and witnesses her seemingly impossible shots, he begins to see golf in a whole new light, rediscovering how fun the sport can actually be.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Ooi! Tonbo' for its character-driven narrative and grounded approach to golf, setting it apart from more fantastical sports anime. While the animation and voice acting receive some criticism, the engaging story and focus on personal growth resonate with viewers. The show appeals to those who appreciate slice-of-life elements within a sports context.
pros: Grounded and realistic portrayal of golf.
Focus on character development.
Enjoyable story with breathing space to get to know the characters.
cons: Animation can be weak in places.
Voice acting sometimes seems wooden.
May disappoint those expecting a traditional sports anime or peaceful slice-of-life.

anime.title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World
anime.romaji_title: Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru
anime.synopsis:
After passing away, a Japanese office worker finds himself reincarnated in another world as Ars, the newborn son of the noble Louvent family. The Summerforth Empire, where the Louvents rule over a small territory of a few thousand people, is a medieval-like land plagued by social inequality and political instability. As Ars grows older and learns more and more about his new environment, he becomes convinced that war will soon erupt.

Fortunately, though Ars was not blessed with unrivaled strength or extraordinary magical aptitude, he does possess Appraisal: a seemingly unique skill that allows him to instantly grasp someone's current abilities and latent talents merely by looking at them. In an effort to prepare his domain for the imminent strife, Ars resolves to enlist the most exceptional people he can find, paying no attention to superficial qualities like race or social status.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. While some appreciate the refreshing take on the isekai genre, focusing on nation-building and character development, others find the plot predictable, the isekai elements unnecessary, and the pacing slow. The quality of writing and production values are also points of contention.
pros: Unique take on isekai genre with focus on nation building and political intrigue.
Well-written characters with compelling backstories.
Refreshing change from OP MC trope, emphasizing strategic growth and leadership.
Good worldbuilding
cons: Isekai elements feel unnecessary and tacked on.
Slow pacing, especially early episodes.
Shallow characters.
Predictable plot with little conflict or challenge.
Inconsistent writing quality.
Outdated art and animation.

anime.title: My New Boss Is Goofy
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Iyashikei, Slice of Life, Workplace
anime.synopsis:
After 26-year-old Kentarou Momose develops health problems due to his boss' abuse, he quits his job and joins a different company. Now, he hopes to start anew under the care of his mentor and direct supervisor, 34-year-old Yuusei Shirosaki.

Shirosaki is a capable boss admired by his coworkers, which makes Momose fear letting him down and reliving the past traumas. However, Momose can rest easy, as Shirosaki is always delighted to help—even if he looks absolutely ridiculous doing it. Although it may take some adjusting, Momose realizes that there is no need for caution around his new, endearingly eccentric boss after all.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is overwhelmingly praised as a heartwarming and feel-good anime, offering a comforting and humorous portrayal of workplace dynamics and personal healing. While some find the plot simplistic or the humor repetitive, the consensus highlights its positive message and endearing characters as its main strengths.  Many viewers enjoyed the subtle romantic undertones, though the lack of explicit romantic development was a minor point of contention for some.
pros: Characters are endearing and relatable.
The show provides a comforting and relaxing viewing experience.
Positive message about overcoming trauma and finding happiness.
cons: Simple plot may not appeal to viewers seeking complex narratives.
Animation quality is sometimes lacking.
Repetitive jokes or behaviors.

anime.title: Touhou Fantasy Kaleidoscope: The Memories of Phantasm
anime.romaji_title: Gensou Mangekyou: The Memories of Phantasm
anime.synopsis: Marisa, an ordinary magician, suspects a youkai is behind the winterly weather in the middle of spring. She goes off to investigate and soon arrives in the netherworld, facing the youkai behind the strange incident. Will her friend, the shrine maiden Reimu, arrive in time to save the day or will all be lost?
anime.consensus_summary: Audience consensus is largely positive among existing Touhou fans, praising the high production quality for a fan-made series. However, newcomers may find the anime confusing due to the non-canonical order and reliance on prior knowledge of the Touhou universe. Some viewers also critique the excessive fanservice and flanderization of characters.
pros: High production quality for a fan-made anime.
Appeals to existing Touhou fans.
Good animation and music.
Develops character personalities according to fanon.
cons: Story can be confusing for newcomers to the Touhou series.
Non-canonical order of events.
Excessive fanservice.
Characters are flanderized.
Cameos are sometimes unnecessary.

anime.title: Medalist
anime.synopsis:
Tsukasa Akeuraji always dreamed of becoming a competitive solo figure skater, but starting too late in life meant his ambitions never got off the ground. Now barely scraping by, he takes on an assistant coach job, resigned to a future far from the one he once imagined.

Before his first day, Tsukasa meets Inori Yuitsuka, a shy fifth grader sneaking into the rink to practice. Captivated by figure skating, but held back by her mother's overprotectiveness and her own self-doubt, Inori has never been encouraged to pursue her passion until she encounters Tsukasa. Beneath her personality lies great potential, waiting to be unlocked with the right guidance.

Moved by Inori's determination to change and reminded of his own struggles, Tsukasa offers to coach and help her chase the dream she has been too afraid to voice. While the road ahead is long and filled with unfamiliar challenges and rival skaters, Inori dedicates herself to the art and strives to one day reach the Olympics and become a medalist.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers are deeply moved by the inspirational story, strong character development, and impressive animation quality. The show is considered a standout sports anime, with a heartwarming portrayal of the coach-student relationship and the pursuit of dreams.
pros: Excellent character development, especially the coach-student dynamic.
High-quality animation, particularly the figure skating sequences.
Emotionally resonant storytelling that emphasizes perseverance and support systems.
cons: Some awkwardly placed time skips.
Questionable realism in the portrayal of children's behavior.
Uneven impact of supporting coach characters.

anime.title: Bocchi the Rock! Movie
anime.synopsis: Theatrical compilation of Bocchi the Rock!
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is viewed as a serviceable recap for existing fans of 'Bocchi the Rock!', helping to refresh their memory of the plot before the second season. However, it's not recommended for newcomers due to the omission of crucial character development and gags that are integral to the anime's appeal. While it captures some of the original's essence, the consensus is that it's best enjoyed as a supplementary experience rather than a standalone introduction to the series.
pros: Good recap for those who have seen the anime.
Manages to retain many of the smaller gags and details from the original series.
cons: Skips over significant character development scenes.
Misses many gags present in the anime.
Not suitable for viewers who have not seen the anime.

anime.title: Little Shark's Outings
anime.synopsis:
The adventures of a baby shark in nostalgia-filled Yauo Town.

Whether it's cider on a summer day, freeze pops, radio calisthenics, festival stalls, or hanging out with friends, the world sparkles when reflected in the eyes of the baby shark.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive, emphasizing the show's cuteness and surprisingly engaging storytelling despite its short episodes. Some viewers desire longer episodes, but overall, the show is appreciated for its lighthearted and adorable adventures. It's often compared favorably to other similar 'cute' anime.
pros: Adorable character design
Compelling storytelling despite short runtime
Enjoyable world-building
Good for listening comprehension of Japanese
cons: Episodes are very short
Visual-CGI is not highly rated

anime.title: Zatsu Tabi: That's Journey
anime.genres: Adventure, Iyashikei, Seinen, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
Chika Suzugamori, an 18-year-old newcomer manga artist, has just had three of her drafts rejected in a single day. Her editor suggests incorporating her interests into her work, but Chika is an indoor person who only thinks about manga day and night. At a loss, she feels a sudden desire to get away from everything and go on a journey somewhere. 

Due to the results of an online poll that she posted on a whim, Chika hops on a train and heads north from Tokyo on an impromptu solo trip. When she ends up at the top of Mount Haguro in Aizu-Wakamatsu, she realizes she feels refreshed and more motivated than before. Even if her projects get turned down again in the future, Chika plans to journey around Japan with friends old and new.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the show's relaxing nature, beautiful locations, and detailed travel information, finding it a pleasant and informative experience. Others find it slow, boring, and lacking in substance, criticizing its perceived promotional nature and shallow characters. Overall, the anime appeals more to viewers interested in Japanese travel and slice-of-life content.
pros: Showcases lesser-known Japanese destinations, offering detailed travel information.
Relaxing and introspective, provides a calming viewing experience.
Accurately captures the travel experience and its positive impact on life.
cons: Slow pace and lack of significant plot or character development can be boring.
Feels like a tourism promotion, lacking depth and complexity.
Solo travel focus can make it less engaging compared to episodes with friends.

anime.title: Brave Bang Bravern!
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Mecha, Military, Parody, Sci-Fi
anime.synopsis: In a world where humanoid armored weapons known as "Titatonostrider" ("TS" for short) are used in warfare, troops from various countries converge on the island of Oahu, Hawaii, including Ao Isami of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force and Lewis Smith of the United States Marine Corps. Isami and Smith cross paths during battle, but suddenly, their teams are attacked by an unknown enemy, scattering soldiers and sending their forces into disarray. In order to save their friends and survive on the deadly battlefield, they must fight with every ounce of courage and pride that they can muster.
anime.consensus_summary: Yuuki Bakuhatsu Bang Bravern is overwhelmingly well-received as a fun, unique, and self-aware mecha anime. Its over-the-top nature, homoerotic themes, and comedic elements are seen as strengths, although some find the plot too absurd. The show's strong animation, sound design, and ability to blend humor with genuine emotion contribute to its popularity, making it a standout title of the season.
pros: Excellent animation and sound design, especially the opening and ending themes.
The show embraces absurdity and humor while still having heartfelt moments.
Unique and original take on the mecha genre, parodying tropes in a loving way.
cons: The plot can be nonsensical and requires suspension of disbelief.
Humor may not appeal to all viewers.
Some may find the overt homoeroticism off-putting.

anime.title: The Prince of Tennis II U-17 World Cup Semifinal
anime.romaji_title: Shin Tennis no Oujisama: U-17 World Cup Semifinal
anime.synopsis:
After the intense quarterfinals, the U-17 World Cup competition has been whittled down to four formidable teams. Standing between Team Japan's quest for international glory is the nine-time tournament champion, Germany, and their star-studded team, pro player Jurgen Borisovich Volk at its helm. With both the momentum and the crowd's favor on the side of their opponents, Japan faces an uphill battle.

Determined to avenge an earlier loss, Japan sends seven of their best—including team captain Houou Byoudouin—to challenge the German national team. But trying to reach the finals for the first time in Japan's tennis history may cause even these fearless players to crumble under mounting waves of pressure as they venture into uncharted territories.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some enjoying the over-the-top action and nostalgic elements while others feel the series has strayed too far from its roots and become overly absurd. There is a sense that the plot has become repetitive and predictable, with the Japan team frequently relying on plot armor. Some viewers are finding the increasingly unrealistic power levels and special moves to be a detriment to their enjoyment.
pros: Nostalgic appeal for OG Prince of Tennis fans.
Embraces the ridiculousness and physics-defying elements.
Unique and memorable special moves.
cons: Loss of realistic sports elements.
Over-reliance on plot armor for the Japan team.
Repetitive or uninspired storyline.
Characters' abilities become too exaggerated and unbelievable.

anime.title: A Condition Called Love
anime.synopsis:
Hotaru Hinase has lived nearly sixteen years without romance. She is satisfied alone as long as she can enjoy the little things in life with her beloved friends and family. In her mind, she is not meant to fall in love, nor does she understand the concept.

While out with a friend, Hotaru witnesses the severe breakup of her schoolmate Hananoi, to whom she has never spoken. Afterward, she sees him sitting in the snow and holds her umbrella over him. To her surprise, this gesture results in him confessing his feelings for her at school the next day. Though Hotaru rejects him, Hananoi insists on letting her get to know him. He does whatever he can to woo her, from changing his hairstyle to finding her lost hairpin in the snow.

Although she has no romantic feelings towards him, Hotaru believes that by spending more time with him, she will learn how to love. She agrees to date him and slowly begins to navigate what being a girlfriend entails, including how to reciprocate the kind gestures that Hananoi continues to perform for her.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided on 'Hananoi-kun to Koi no Yamai'. Some appreciate the exploration of an unconventional romance and character growth, especially Hotaru's journey of understanding love. However, many are critical of the male lead's toxic behavior and the show's handling of sensitive themes, leading to a polarized reception, with some finding it cute and others deeply problematic.
pros: Exploration of different types of love and relationships
Character development for both leads as they learn and grow
Open communication about issues within the relationship
Cute and wholesome moments between the main couple
cons: Toxic and overbearing behavior of the male lead
Questionable ethics of portraying intense jealousy
Lack of character development for the male lead in some opinions
Mediocre animation quality
Shallow or surface-level trauma representation
anime.thematic_vibe: Awkward Romance, Character Development, Shoujo Tropes

anime.title: Snack Basue
anime.synopsis: Located five stations away from Hokkaido's largest downtown area Susukino. A fun shop called "Snack Busue" can be found run by mama Basue and mama Akemi. Filled with the laughter of the girls and their unusual regulars, you'll be smiling along with them before you know it.
anime.consensus_summary: Snack Basue is a unique and humorous slice-of-life anime that delves into Japanese drinking culture. While its specific humor and animation style may not appeal to everyone, many appreciate its relatable characters, witty dialogue, and catchy opening song. The show is generally well-received by those who enjoy laid-back, character-driven comedies, but is unlikely to appeal to viewers looking for action or a complex plot.
pros: Unique and charming aesthetic.
Hilarious humor with Gintama vibes.
Relatable and well-developed characters.
Banger opening song.
Showcases a hidden side of Japanese culture (Nomikai).
Enjoyable main character Akemi.
Good talking humor.
cons: Animation style may not appeal to everyone.
Humor may be too specific for some viewers.
Production feels stinted.
Episodic with no overarching plot.
Can be boring to some viewers.
Heavy dialogue might be hard to understand for foreigners.

anime.title: Dr. Stone: New World Part 2
anime.synopsis:
Years ago, astronaut Byakuya left behind precious materials in the belief that his son, the scientifically-gifted Senkuu, would one day find them. In the present, the Kingdom of Science's Kohaku and Ginrou have infiltrated the harem of the Petrification Kingdom’s leader with the help of Amaryllis, a local girl. At first, their mission progresses without a hitch. Unfortunately, an error enacted by Kohaku and Ginrou leads Minister Ibara and the Island’s strongest warrior, Moz, to identify the intruding duo as enemies.

Even worse, Moz tails Amaryllis when she returns to inform Senkuu of the news, discovering the scientist's secret hideout. However, Moz's agenda does not align with Ibara's—he wants to dethrone the minister and keep the petrification device for himself. If Senkuu plays his cards right, he could gain a powerful ally and win the war once and for all.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Dr. Stone: New World Part 2' for its engaging storyline, strategic battles, and well-developed characters. Some find the science aspects less grounded than previous seasons, while others feel the adaptation captures the manga's excitement effectively. Overall, there is positive sentiment, with many anticipating the next season.
pros: Excellent adaptation from the manga, recreating the excitement of the original material.
The storyline is engaging, focusing on the mystery of petrification and inventive strategies.
Characters are well-written with good dynamics, and villains like Ibara are compelling.
cons: Some inventions and creations feel rushed compared to earlier seasons.
The science aspect is becoming less realistic, shifting towards a more mystical sci-fi tone.
Pacing can be inconsistent, with some plot holes.

anime.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You - High School Days
anime.synopsis:
Nasa, at the request of his former junior high school teacher, Ms. Yanagi, finds himself entrusted with teaching a programming class at a high school. But here's the catch—it's an all-girls' school. Surrounded by the limitless energy of teenage girls, Nasa tries to maintain his composure, but deep down, he can't help feeling nervous.

A capricious boyfriend, secret admiration for someone, and a multitude of romantic dilemmas that can't be solved by programming, Nasa wonders if he can crack the equation of love!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is generally positive, with many viewers finding 'Joshikou-hen' a refreshing return to form after a weaker second season. The introduction of new characters and hints of a deeper plot are praised. However, some criticize the rushed pacing and inconsistent animation, and it may not appeal to those already tired of the series' repetitive nature.
pros: Recaptures the charm of the first season, unlike the second.
Introduces interesting and engaging new characters.
Hints at a deeper, more supernatural plot.
Provides a fresh perspective with the high school setting.
cons: Story feels rushed due to the limited number of episodes.
Animation quality is inconsistent in some frames.
Repetitive elements of the series may not appeal to everyone.
Some find the comedy dry and the characters unengaging
anime.thematic_vibe: Wholesome, Romantic Comedy, Slice of Life

anime.title: The Demon Hunter
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: Meng Chuan witnessed his mother killed before his eyes, so he trained very hard hoping to one day avenge her death. But his peaceful days were broken as his wedding engagement was called off, an invasion by foreign forces, the sanctuary fell into enemy hands... In order to protect the people of Ning City, he picked up his sword and vowed to be the strongest. This is a heavy responsibility and a long journey.
anime.consensus_summary: The donghua boasts excellent visuals, animation, and fight choreography, creating an immersive experience with emotionally engaging characters. However, the story and character designs have some flaws, and the adaptation diverges significantly from the source material. While some appreciate the emotional depth and world-building, others are critical of the story's shortcomings and the changes made from the original web novel.
pros: Consistent visual delivery and good animation quality
Enjoyable fight choreography
Immersive and emotionally investing characters
Visually stunning character design and world-building
cons: Story is not the best and has cringe moments
Main character's transformation design is a flop
Donghua adaptation is a completely different story than the source web novel

anime.title: Immortality 2
anime.romaji_title: Yong Sheng: Shi Nian Zhi Yue
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis: In the majestic fantasy world, how does the protagonist Fang Han traverse the world with his own strength. Relying on an unyielding stubbornness to break through the mysteries of supernatural powers, and forge the physical body into an immortal body. There are endless novel magic weapons, and the brand-new prosperity of the Three Realms of Immortals, Demons and Fans will be opened by the protagonist in turn. It will take you to experience the fantasy demeanor of the immortal sect, demons, gods, kings and emperors. The protagonist will also experience the love and hatred in the world, the entanglement of grievances and resentments, and the disputes between immortals and demons. Finally lead you on the road to the top king.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Yong Sheng: Shi Nian Zhi Yue', finding it comforting and engaging. While the storyline and characters are well-received, some viewers suggest improvements in art update frequency and character uniqueness. Overall, the audience sentiment is positive, with viewers considering it a favorite and recommending it to others.
pros: Engaging characters
Well-developed storyline and background
cons: Art updates could be more frequent
Character attitudes lack uniqueness

anime.title: Harmony of Mille-Feuille
anime.synopsis:
Just like any other high school student, first-year Uta Komaki wants to make the most of her youth. With her namesake talent in singing, she attempts to join her school's light music club but repeatedly fails due to her extreme shyness and lack of confidence. Intimidated by the dazzling presence of the club's members, Uta fears to even submit her application.

One day, Uta receives an invitation from Airi Kojou, president of the a cappella club, to check out their club instead. Unlike the light music club, this group performs purely without instruments. Uta soon finds herself amazed by the way the members' voices resonate with one another—delicate yet cohesive, resembling a mille-feuille dessert's thousand layers. Moved, Uta takes a quiet step forward into creating a harmony where everyone shines together.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a short, sweet, and relatively uncontentious watch, primarily recommended for fans of a cappella music. While the unique musical element is appreciated, the story and animation are considered average and somewhat generic.  It's viewed as a decent, relaxing show, but not particularly groundbreaking or attention-grabbing, resulting in a generally positive but not enthusiastic reception.
pros: A cappella music is a unique and refreshing element compared to typical anime.
The music is well-done and a highlight of the show.
Characters have chemistry, making viewers want to learn more about them.
