Having resolved the crisis in the Petrification Kingdom, Senkuu and his companions gear up to deal directly with the mastermind behind the petrification phenomenon—who supposedly resides on the moon. The ambitious spaceship project, however, requires immense manpower and critical resources scattered across the world. Thus, the Kingdom of Science exploration team kick-starts its transcontinental journey on the ship Perseus to gather them all.

Equipped with modern technology and bolstered by the new, capable members in their ranks, the exploration team feels confident about setting sail to their first destination: America. They soon realize that the region now hosts adversaries controlling the resources they need, doing so with scientific technology which rivals and even exceeds their own. In a battle of science versus science, Senkuu and his team must outsmart their rivals if they are to have any chance of ensuring the continued survival and rejuvenation of humanity.
anime.consensus_summary: The season introduces compelling antagonists and an exciting science rivalry, though pacing issues and character writing are noted. While some found it a thrilling addition to the Dr. Stone franchise, others felt it deviated from the core scientific discovery aspect. Overall, the season is considered enjoyable for fans of the series.
pros: Exciting race against time with a worthy rival.
Introduction of compelling antagonists, Xeno and Stanley.
Continues the humor and art style of previous seasons.
Adventurous moments and clever strategies keep the narrative engaging.
cons: Rushed pacing compared to the manga.
Struggles with writing decent female characters.
Filler episodes drag down the start.
Less scientific discovery than previous seasons.
anime.thematic_vibe: Scientific Rivalry, Over-the-Top Thriller, Charismatic Characters

anime.title: You are Ms. Servant.
anime.synopsis:
One day, Hitoyoshi Yokoya wakes up to a mysterious nameless girl dressed as a maid ringing his doorbell, asking to be his servant. With her former master referring her to the Yokoya household, she offers her expertise as an assassin. Intimidated by her background, Hitoyoshi tries to send her away; but when she leaves something behind, he rushes to return it to her and is nearly hit by a truck in the process. With her fast reflexes, the girl saves him just in time, and Hitoyoshi ends up taking her in. 

Ironically, the maid lacks any skills apart from the art of killing she has perfected since childhood. Nevertheless, Hitoyoshi welcomes the girl with open arms, encouraging her to leave her monochromatic past behind and experience a normal life. To seal the deal, Hitoyoshi names her Yuki, marking the beginning of her path to redemption and happiness.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, appreciating the wholesome and therapeutic aspects centered around Yuki's character development and the exploration of normality. However, many find the male lead uninspired, the plot meandering, and the ending disappointing. This leads to frustration regarding the unfulfilled potential of the premise.
pros: Yuki's character is well-developed and endearing, driving the emotional core of the anime.
The anime offers moments of slow, passionate romance that are genuinely enjoyable.
The show explores themes of finding beauty in normality and healing from past trauma.
cons: The male MC is often criticized for being bland, immature, and lacking character development.
The pacing and plot direction are inconsistent, with the main storyline sometimes feeling disconnected from slice-of-life subplots.
The ending is often seen as unsatisfying and abrupt, leaving many unresolved plot points and character arcs.
Animation quality is inconsistent, with some scenes appearing low budget.

anime.title: Shadowverse Flame: Arc-hen
anime.synopsis: Third part of Shadowverse Flame.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Viewers appreciate the show as a grand finale that effectively concludes the storylines that began in earlier seasons. The emphasis on character relationships and the deeper meaning of the game resonates well with the audience, solidifying the show's position as a standout card game anime.
pros: Epic conclusion to the Shadowverse Flame saga
Strong focus on character connections and the meaning of the game
Satisfying resolution to long-standing plot points
cons: N/A

anime.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo 2nd Season
anime.genres: Comedy, Harem, Parody, Romance, School, Seinen
anime.synopsis:
Ever since Rentarou Aijou found out that he would meet a total of one hundred soulmates in high school, his life has been anything but boring. Now with six girlfriends—each with their own unique quirks—Rentarou has never been happier.

The group expands once again when Rentarou meets Kurumi Haraga, a girl with a never-ending appetite; and Mei Meido, the maid of the Hanazono family. As he encounters more of his soulmates, Rentarou has to juggle ways to date them all, since failure results in a grim fate. Fortunately, Rentarou has no shortage of love to give to each of his girlfriends!
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of '100 Girlfriends' is a successful continuation of the series' unique blend of harem, romance, and meta-comedy. While the growing cast presents some challenges in character development, the show's self-awareness, absurd humor, and heartfelt core continue to resonate with fans. The audience generally enjoys the over-the-top nature and the show's refusal to take itself seriously.
pros: Unique and hilarious take on the harem genre.
Self-aware humor and fourth-wall breaks are well-executed.
Each girlfriend has a distinct personality and design.
Faithful adaptation of the manga, with creative liberties that enhance the comedy.
Wholesome and heart-pounding core despite the over-the-top antics.
cons: Increasing number of girlfriends leads to diminished screen time for each, making newer characters feel less developed.
Some jokes may be obnoxious or miss the mark.
The plot is secondary to the comedy, which may not appeal to all viewers.

anime.title: Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Kamonohashi Ron no Kindan Suiri 2nd Season
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Detective, Mystery, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
Not long after forming their partnership, detectives Ron Kamonohashi and Totomaru Isshiki have proven adept at solving various cases together. However, the two are further motivated to continue their work when they discover that the House of M—an infamous crime syndicate—orchestrated Ron's expulsion from the prestigious Detective Training Academy BLUE five years prior. It appears that this group is also linked to Ron's mysterious ability that causes those around him to lose their lives, a phenomenon which Ron is desperate to stop.

A member of the House of M soon starts to commit boastful serial murders around Shibuya as an act of provocation toward Ron. Consequently, the investigative pair must do their best to apprehend the culprit for the sake of justice as well as learning more about Ron's dark past and present condition.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the improved mystery elements and character development in the second season. However, others criticize the inconsistent plot, weak villains, and unsatisfying resolutions. There is a notable divide between viewers interested in the main story arc and those enjoying the fan service elements.
pros: Season two provides more hints for viewers to guess the culprit.
The story delves into Ron's past, adding depth to the character.
Random investigations in season 2 serve the main plot, unlike season 1.
cons: The main villains introduced at the beginning disappear for many episodes.
The final stretch feels bland, with a vulnerable protagonist.
Mysteries are easy to solve or don't make sense.
House of M stuff is goofy and cartoon villain-ish.
Violation of police protocol.

anime.title: A Nobody's Way Up to an Exploration Hero
anime.synopsis: Meet Kaito Takagi, your typical high schooler with a low profile. He spends his days exploring dungeons in Japan, hunting slimes for some extra cash. On the side, he quietly admires his childhood friend, the popular girl in class. One day, a rare golden slime shows up, and after Kaito defeats it, he finds a super valuable item—a card that can summon mythical beings! He decides to use it and summons a stunning warrior maiden. Now, Kaito has a chance to rise above his ordinary explorer life. Get ready for a modern fantasy story filled with battles!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed to negative, with many finding the anime generic, uninspired, and poorly executed. Some viewers found enjoyment in the series despite its flaws, particularly praising the action and character interactions. However, the overall consensus is that the anime fails to live up to its potential and is ultimately forgettable.
pros: Enjoyable despite being unoriginal
Some found the action moments surprisingly good
Pacing and character growth appreciated by some
Likeable characters with strengths and weaknesses
Takes tropes and executes them well
cons: Generic and uninspired plot
Poor worldbuilding and stakes
Weak character development
Mediocre animation, with reused scenes and cut corners
Uninspired music and sound design
MC gets too lucky, world bends over backwards for him

anime.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Beginning of a New Era
anime.romaji_title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Shin Jidai no Tobira
anime.synopsis:
Running in the highest level of horse racing, the Twinkle Series, is the dream of many horse girls. Although she has only taken part in freestyle racing before, horse girl Jungle Pocket discovers that very same aspiration after she witnesses Fuji Kiseki's tremendous victory on a grand stage. Equipped with unwavering self-confidence, Jungle Pocket is quickly able to accumulate a few victories, allowing her to participate in higher-level races.

When Jungle Pocket takes part in her first G1 race alongside another rising racer—the highly intelligent and eccentric Agnes Tachyon—she realizes the enormous gap in their abilities. However, that only motivates Jungle Pocket even further as she resolves to get her revenge against Tachyon by winning the honored Triple Crown Classic title the following year. Although the world of horse racing is never predictable or easy, Jungle Pocket is determined to take down Tachyon and herald the beginning of a new era.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie is largely praised for its animation, pacing, and emotional depth, exceeding expectations even for fans of the series. While some find certain characters underdeveloped or unlikeable, the overall reception is overwhelmingly positive, with many calling it one of the best anime films they've seen.  The film successfully conveys themes of rivalry and determination, making it accessible to both newcomers and long-time fans.
pros: Amazing animation and cinematography, especially during races.
Tight pacing and well-structured narrative.
Strong emotional impact and character writing.
Unique sound and directing create a psychological atmosphere.
Can be watched without prior knowledge of the series.
cons: Some characters lack development due to runtime constraints.
The main character may be unlikable to some viewers.
One reviewer thought the movie was shallow and mid.
Some find the 'mad scientist' character trope forced.

anime.title: Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!
anime.synopsis:
Since childhood, Kazuhiro Kitase has been able to dream of a different world. He can return to reality by falling asleep or dying, and he can pick up where he left off by sleeping again. For years, he has had many adventures alongside Mariabelle, a beautiful elf who works for the Sorcery Guild.

On one of their escapades, they come across the lair of a dragon taking care of its eggs. They inadvertently wake the slumbering beast, who promptly reduces them to ashes. For Kazuhiro, it is merely a temporary setback, as he can simply go back. However, he is shocked to find Mariabelle herself safe and sound asleep next to him.

Kazuhiro realizes that his dream world is an alternate reality altogether. In the meantime, he makes the most of this bizarre circumstance, introducing Mariabelle to the sights and wonders of Japan. Now, with their time together spanning two worlds, their real adventures have just begun!
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Nihon e Youkoso Elf-san' for its wholesome and refreshing take on the Isekai genre, praising the charming romance and beautiful visuals. While the fantasy world elements are considered generic, the reverse-Isekai slice-of-life aspects and character interactions in Japan are highly appreciated. The show is seen as a cozy and heartwarming experience with a unique twist, although some find the plot somewhat clichéd.
pros: Refreshing take on the Isekai genre with reverse-Isekai elements.
Charming and heartwarming romance between the main characters.
Beautiful visuals and animation, especially the depiction of food and Japanese scenery.
Endearing characters with realistic development and quirks.
Well-executed blend of comedy, romance, and fantasy elements.
Strong voice acting performances.
cons: The fantasy world segments are generic and less engaging compared to the Japan segments.
Story can feel a bit clichéd at times.
The Isekai element felt like it was just checking the box.

anime.title: Otherworldly Evil Monarch
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Historical, Isekai, Reincarnation
anime.synopsis: Jun Xie, a legendary ace agent feared by all, suffered an accident during a mission and was reborn in the Xuanxuan Continent as Jun Moxie, the infamous and utterly useless young master of the Tianxiang Kingdom. His family is now mired in trouble and facing numerous crises. Though his body is now a useless shell, he remains a king in this life, and will continue to do so in this new world! He will roam the martial world, wielding his sword, caring not who reigns supreme; for him, a late-night snack is nothing more than a pot of turtle soup.
anime.consensus_summary: The show is a mix of tropes with a focus on comedy, but the execution is inconsistent. The audience is divided on whether the comedic elements enhance or detract from the overall experience. While some appreciate the light-hearted fun and CGI, others find the pacing and genre-blending jarring.
pros: CGI is well done.
Good facial expressions that hold up the comedic feel.
cons: Pacing is screwed and plot feels rushed.
Comedy feels repetitive and loses freshness.
Genre is not well-defined due to comedic tone conflicting with serious plot points.

anime.title: Jujutsu Kaisen: The Culling Game Part 1
anime.synopsis:
Kenjaku, the one known as Noritoshi Kamo and most recently as Suguru Getou, has initiated the next step in his destructive, thousand-year plan of ordinary humans' evolution and eventual eradication. The jujutsu world higher-ups reinstate 15-year-old Yuuji Itadori's execution, as Satoru Gojou is incapacitated as a result of Kenjaku's master plan in Shibuya. While Yuuji is unaware of this, he patrols the abandoned Tokyo streets with Chousou, exterminating any and all cursed spirits in his way.

Meanwhile, the bigoted and arrogant Naoya Zenin's pride takes a hit when Megumi Fushiguro is selected as the Zenin Clan's next head. To draw out Megumi and eliminate him, he goes after Yuuji—but Yuuta Okkotsu is set on being Yuuji's executioner. Kenjaku's "Culling Game"—a rigorous battle royale spanning throughout Japan and forcing the jujutsu competitors to kill each other—is set in motion, and the young jujutsu sorcerers join the fray to settle old scores, free Gojou, and liberate the jujutsu world from the threat that is Kenjaku.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is significantly divided, particularly regarding the new director's artistic choices and their impact on pacing and narrative coherence. While the animation quality remains a high point, many feel the story has become convoluted and emotionally detached. This has led to disappointment among long-time fans, with some even suggesting skipping large portions of the season.
pros: High production value and animation quality by MAPPA, especially in fight choreography and art direction.
Unique art style and direction choices are appreciated by some viewers.
Standout fights with awesome ideas and execution.
The series delves into the inner turmoil of characters.
Addition of Higuruma as a character is well-received.
cons: Inconsistent pacing and disjointed narrative due to the director's 'artsy' style.
Tone-deaf background music that kills the mood and weight of key moments.
Iconic manga panels adapted poorly, losing their impact.
Boring and one-dimensional new characters with uninspired cursed techniques.
Over-reliance on exposition and complex rule explanations, particularly in Episode 3, which is considered one of the worst.
Some find the story and plot weak, feeling directionless and without emotional investment.
Incomprehensible action sequences due to chaotic sakuga and camera angles.
Overuse of CGI backgrounds

anime.title: The Richest Man in Game
anime.romaji_title: Kui Cheng Shoufu Cong Youxi Kaishi
anime.synopsis: Pei Qian, an ordinary migrant worker, was accidentally bound to the wealth conversion system, which gave him a good opportunity to spend money in business and start his life over again. However, the system stipulates that you can only earn one yuan if you make a profit of 100 yuan, but all the money you lose can go into your own pocket. In order to lose money, Pei Qian chose the high-risk, money-burning game industry, and deliberately produced "alternative" games that went against the rules of the market. However, he unexpectedly became popular time and time again, earning a lot of money, and painfully became Pei Qian the "business wizard" admired by everyone, but only Pei Qian understands that he really just wants to lose money...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys "Kui Cheng Shoufu Cong Youxi Kaishi" for its unique premise, fast-paced storytelling, and engaging characters. It's praised for subverting typical power fantasy tropes and drawing parallels to real-world events. While some desire more animation detail and a deeper exploration of the system's mechanics, the overall sentiment is positive, with many viewers finding the series exciting and binge-worthy.
pros: Fast-paced and genuinely exciting narrative.
Unique premise subverting typical power fantasy tropes.
Engaging characters with no redundant or irritating roles.
Story mirrors real-world examples from the game industry, adding depth.
Effective visual and storytelling alignment with the show's philosophy.
cons: Animation could benefit from more frames for smoother visuals.
Desired more detail on the Wealth Conversion System's mechanics.
Story may become repetitive after a while as the viewers know what is going to happen, and the edge is lost.

anime.title: Fruit Brains
anime.synopsis: The title is a portmanteau on kudomono (fruit) and nou (brains). The anime consists of three two-minutes skits, with basically the same structure. Orange and Pineapple are in Hong Kong, Ancient Egypt, Outer Space. Orange is trying to accomplish something - watching a drug deal go down, taking a break from work, trying to defuse a bomb outside a space station - while Pineapple pesters him with pointless and increasingly obscure questions. Eventually, Orange goes ballistic, calling Pineapple a "fruit brain.". They both peel down their skins to expose their brains and launch into a dance number with the locals - the subjects of the stakeout, Egyptian laborers and gods, astronauts and aliens. Orange`s task is forgotten, with the expected results. Stir and repeat.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Reviewers consider the show hilarious, well-produced, and excellently written. There is little to no dissent expressed in the provided data.
pros: Hilarious and enjoyable
Very good sound design
Amazing art
Incredible voice acting
Incredible writing and jokes

anime.title: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
anime.genres: Comedy, Fantasy, Isekai, School, Seinen, Villainess
anime.synopsis:
Although Kenzaburou Tondabayashi is a 52-year-old bureaucrat, he is well versed in reincarnation stories where a protagonist suddenly awakens in a fantasy world. After being hit by a truck, Kenzaburou lands in that exact situation. However, what baffles him is the fact he wound up in the world of an otome game—as the young villainess and the daughter of a duke, Grace Auvergne.

Fortunately for Kenzaburou, he is somewhat familiar with his new world, as it is based on the game called Magical Academy: Love & Beast. He was a proud father in his previous life, and he often listened to his daughter rave about the game's setting and characters. Armed with background knowledge and a lifetime's worth of dad skills, Kenzaburou strives to make the most of his new life, though his kind-hearted nature makes it difficult to fully embrace the role of a villainess.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is generally well-received for its unique premise of a middle-aged man reincarnated as a villainess. Viewers appreciate the heartwarming portrayal of a father figure and the comedic elements. Some find the characters simplistic and the plot somewhat generic, but overall, the show is considered an enjoyable and refreshing take on the isekai genre.
pros: Unique twist on the villainess genre with an older male protagonist.
Heartwarming portrayal of a father figure in a fantasy world.
Well-paced and genuinely funny gags.
Good animation and character acting.
cons: Some jokes may not land for those unfamiliar with the genre.
Characters can be simple and not deeply explored.
Relies on established tropes, which may feel repetitive to some.
Story elements can feel non-existent.

anime.title: Dorohedoro Season 2
anime.genres: Action, Comedy, Fantasy, Gore, Horror, Seinen
anime.synopsis: Second season of Dorohedoro.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception for Dorohedoro Season 2 is overwhelmingly positive, with fans thrilled by the long-awaited continuation. Key highlights include the exceptional animation, the masterful blend of dark themes with humor, and the depth of its characters and world-building. Minor criticisms revolve around pacing and potential viewer confusion due to the series' complexity and the long gap since Season 1.
pros: Impeccable and improved animation quality, praised for its blend of 2D and 3D/CG techniques.
Visually stunning with incredibly detailed hand-drawn backgrounds and dynamic action sequences.
Captivating and unique characters with deep, complex development, even for the supporting cast.
Exceptional sound design and a highly praised soundtrack, including new opening and ending themes.
Masterful blend of dark, gory themes with absurd, deadpan, and dark humor.
Intriguing and complex lore-heavy story that expands on mysteries without oversimplifying.
Unique and charmingly ridiculous world-building that feels alive and immersive.
cons: Pacing can feel crowded or rushed at times, especially with limited episode counts.
Some confusion or frustration may arise for viewers who don't recall Season 1 details or are not manga readers.
The CGI character designs, specifically faces, were occasionally awkward, though improved from Season 1.
The long wait between seasons led to forgetting details, requiring recaps.
The resolution of resurrection/healing magic, while fitting the world, can reduce overall mortality stakes.

anime.title: Touhai: Ura Rate Mahjong Touhairoku
anime.genres: Drama, Organized Crime, Psychological, Seinen, Strategy Game, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
Ever since moving into his own apartment, quiet high school student Kei has been looking for a new thrill. He soon finds himself playing mahjong, but his whole life takes a dramatic turn when he is forced to play the game with a criminal group. Even though the odds seem against him, Kei is able to outmatch the others. Instead of claiming his reward in cash, however, he decides to take an abducted girl named Amina under his wing.

Due to Kei's skills and cold playstyle, the mysterious Hideharu Seki takes an interest in him, introducing him to mahjong parlors and new potential opponents. But when matched up against an experienced player named Doujima, Kei is severely outskilled and only narrowly escapes going into serious debt. If he wants to protect his new life with Amina, Kei must find a way to outwit these shady characters and come out on top in every game he plays.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some appreciate the suspenseful plot and strategic elements, even without fully understanding mahjong. Others are critical of the weak adaptation, rushed pacing, and excessive violence used to compensate for weak writing. The series seems best enjoyed by those already familiar with mahjong or the yakuza genre.
pros: Successfully conveys tension and stakes of the original story.
Engaging plot development and evolving world.
Well-crafted characters with understandable motivations.
Masterfully builds suspense and delivers unexpected twists.
Decent animation and backgrounds.
cons: Weak adaptation of the source material due to low budget.
Mahjong rules not fully explained, potentially confusing for new viewers.
Violence used to fill gaps in writing.
Rushed mahjong sequences.
Character development is non-existent

anime.title: Shinkalion: Change the World
anime.synopsis: Once upon a time, an unidentified enemy, the Unknown, suddenly appeared. The "Super Evolutionary Railway Development Agency," had developed the "Shinkalion," a robot that transforms into a bullet train, as a countermeasure against this threat.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some appreciating the series' cool mecha designs and intriguing storylines, while others criticize the slower pacing and protagonist's lack of maturity. The change in art style and the initial setup also draw some criticism. Overall, fans of the franchise find enjoyment, while newcomers might find some aspects lacking.
pros: Cool combiner sequences and designs.
Interesting stories and character development.
Efficient handling of procedural episodes.
Yuki Kaji's casting as a villain
cons: Art style change is not as energetic.
Slower initial pacing.
Protagonist's immature decision making.
Length of the series compared to previous entries.

anime.title: White Snake: Afloat
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts, Mythology
anime.synopsis: In Hangzhou during the Southern Song Dynasty, Xiaobai and Xiaoqing find Xu Xian, the reincarnation of A Xuan. Xiaobai and Xu Xian eventually become husband and wife. The two open Baoan Hall to heal the sick and save lives, but Fahai discovers Xiaobai and Xiaoqing's true identities as demons and tries to prevent them from being together.
anime.consensus_summary: While visually appealing, "Bai She: Fusheng" suffers from pacing issues, particularly in the first half, due to excessive exposition. The narrative is more coherent than previous entries, and the second half improves significantly. Overall, it's a mixed bag of visual strengths and writing missteps, but represents an improvement over its immediate predecessor.
pros: Solid story compared to previous installments.
Visually spectacular.
Improved pacing in the second half.
cons: Excessive exposition in the first half.
Slow pacing in the beginning.
Struggles to balance limited content with runtime.

anime.title: A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace
anime.synopsis: New shoujo manga artist Nana Futami works hard every day while being supported by Kaede Satou, her female editor who is older than her, and Mizuki Hazama, her assistant. According to the girl herself, she sometimes drums up intense daydream delusions of occupational illness! A working girls comedy set in the entertainment industry, brought to you by an author who always draws various girls.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Egao no Taenai Shokuba desu.' for its character-driven narrative and realistic depiction of the mangaka industry. Viewers appreciate the animation quality and the wholesome interactions between characters. However, some find the episodic plot and running gags repetitive, and the music unremarkable.
pros: Enjoyable and well-developed characters
Realistic portrayal of the mangaka industry
Fluid and high-quality animation with no noticeable errors
Mix of hilarious, wholesome, and heartwarming interactions
Progression of Futami’s career and milestones
cons: Episodic plot with A/B plot structure can be repetitive
Running gags can become annoying
Music is generic and not noteworthy
Initial episodes may feel slow or boring to some viewers
anime.thematic_vibe: Workplace Comedy, Yuri-Adjacent, Slice of Life

anime.title: Monogatari Series: Off & Monster Season
anime.synopsis:
Koyomi Araragi spent his last year of high school helping girls in his town resolve various supernatural afflictions. But now Araragi has departed for university, leaving his friends to fend for themselves against new problems and curses that plague them. Yotsugi Ononoki, once a human corpse and now a living doll, takes residence in Araragi's home, keeping watch over his sister Tsukihi, a girl harboring a mystical secret of her own. As part of her duties, Yotsugi fills Araragi's vacated role as occult expert, assisting others in town with their issues.

One of these girls, middle school student Nadeko Sengoku, slowly recovers from her own recent brushes with the paranormal. She avoids returning to school, instead spending time alone in her room and pursuing her dream of becoming a professional manga artist. In order to speed up Nadeko's quest for mastery of her craft, Yotsugi convinces her to create four copies of herself, each representing a distinct aspect of Nadeko's personality. However, the clones refuse to help Nadeko, instead escaping into the town and creating a chaotic mess. Now forced to grapple with her own fractured sense of identity, Nadeko sets out to capture them and resolve her inner conflict.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally praises the series' return, citing its faithfulness to the source material and unique artistic style. While some note occasional animation issues and a complex narrative structure, the strong character development and overall quality outweigh these concerns. Most agree that it continues to be a worthwhile entry in the Monogatari series, especially for long-time fans.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the novels, respecting the author's vision.
Unique and engaging visual style and art direction from Studio Shaft.
Strong character development, particularly for Nadeko, with meaningful growth and resolution.
The storytelling is unique and symbolism rich.
cons: Animation stiffness is noticeable at times.
Complex storyline and abundant monologues can be confusing for some viewers.
The non-chronological order can be confusing for those trying to follow the LN order.

anime.title: The Secrets of Star Divine Arts
anime.genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Martial Arts
anime.synopsis:
Chen Xing is the young master of the Chen family in Dongyang City. Both his parents died. He could have succeeded him as the head of the family when he came of age, but was plotted and plotted by the ambitious acting head of the family, Chen Sheng, to occupy the magpie nest. 

Who would have thought that Chen Xing would survive the catastrophe, accidentally obtain the long-lost supreme skill "The Ancient Star God Art", and learn some of the moves, come back strong, expose Chen Sheng's ugly face, and imprison him. The matter was put aside for the time being. Chen Xing took precautions and carefully studied the "Ancient Star God Technique" to collect the star beasts needed for the technique and grow rapidly. 

During this period, Chen Xing rescued Mu Qinglan, the daughter of the palace lord of Xuanyang Palace, because of a star beast, and on her advice, she went through all kinds of hardships to enter Xuanyang Palace. However, as soon as he started, Chen Xing had constant disputes with Jian Feikong, the son of the deputy sect leader.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds 'Taigu Xing Shen Jue' to be a typical cultivation donghua. It offers satisfying fight choreography and a robust power system, but suffers from a weak plot and antagonists. The fast pacing may appeal to some, but detracts from narrative depth.
pros: Good fight choreography
Robust power system
Fast pacing
cons: Minimal story and plot development
Weak antagonists
Pacing too fast

anime.title: The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army Was a Human
anime.romaji_title: Maougun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta
anime.synopsis:
Under the tutelage of the great demon warlock Romberg, Ike grew up with knowledge regarding an ancient advanced civilization that once ruled the land. Coupled with his innate talent in magical arts, this upbringing allows Ike to quickly rise in the Demon Lord's army ranks, leading his brigade to consecutive victories against humans.

However, Ike has a secret—he is a human himself. Despite knowing all too well the consequences if this information is ever to leak, Ike is willing to face such immense danger to achieve his goal: find a way for humans and demons to coexist and stop the war that has been carried on for far too long.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding the premise and tactical elements interesting, while others are turned off by the poor animation and generic storyline. Many feel the show fails to live up to its potential due to weak execution and uninspired characters. The series is considered watchable only for those with low standards or a strong interest in the genre.
pros: Interesting premise of human/demon coexistence
Focus on tactics and large-scale battles
Some characters are interesting and enjoyable
cons: Poor animation quality, especially CGI
Predictable and sometimes nonsensical plot
Weak character development and one-dimensional villains
Overuse of tropes and repetitive notions
anime.thematic_vibe: Generic Fantasy, Isekai Elements, Tactical Warfare

anime.title: Dad is a Hero, Mom is a Spirit, I'm a Reincarnator
anime.romaji_title: Chichi wa Eiyuu, Haha wa Seirei, Musume no Watashi wa Tenseisha.
anime.synopsis:
Being a girl of both spirit and human blood, eight-year-old Ellen has power over the elements—though not the traditional four-element kind. She has the power to transform her surroundings by manipulating the elements of the periodic table. On top of that, Ellen also has a great amount of scientific knowledge due to being a scientist in her past life.

During the war against a neighboring kingdom, Rovel Vankreift, the hero of the Kingdom of Tenbahl and eldest son of house Vankreift—as well as Ellen's father—was fatally injured. However, the spirit who fought by Rovel's side, Lady Origin, brought him to her realm to save him from the clutches of death. Lady Origin, who happens to be the Queen of the Spirit Realm as well as Ellen's eventual mother, is one of the most powerful spirits in existence, making little Ellen quite powerful in contrast to her innocent looks.

But even a family as happy as this one has its fair share of problems, as Ellen and her parents are forced to reconnect their old ties to the Vankreift household in order to defend their relatives' honor—all while hiding Ellen's dangerous existence from the public to preserve their undisturbed happiness.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally disappointed with the show's execution despite its interesting premise. Many feel the pacing is too fast, the characters are underdeveloped, and the story becomes a mess due to illogical character decisions and reliance on overused isekai tropes. While some find the family dynamics and main character enjoyable, the consensus leans towards wasted potential.
pros: Interesting premise with a focus on family dynamics.
Solid animation quality and fitting soundtrack.
Likeable main character (Ellen) who drives the story.
cons: Fast pacing and disjointed plot that feels unfocused.
Shallow supporting characters with underdeveloped personalities.
Artificial drama created by characters acting illogically.
Over-reliance on isekai tropes without sufficient exploration of unique elements.
MC's abilities are not explored to their full potential.

anime.title: Loner Life in Another World
anime.synopsis:
High school student Haruka has always been a content loner. One day, he and his class are abruptly transported to another world and given skill points to use when choosing from an assortment of abilities and magical powers. Unfortunately, Haruka arrives last, and he can only use his points on the seemingly impractical abilities the others had no interest in. Although he is on his own again and must adjust to his new life by himself, he much prefers it that way.

However, Haruka's peaceful solitude is short-lived, as he runs into some of his classmates. Weak to their pleas for help, he ends up sheltering and helping them reunite with the others. But the different cliques struggle to see eye to eye, forcing Haruka to find a way to end the infighting and restore harmony between them to survive the unfamiliar world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding it a generic and poorly executed isekai. Some viewers found it entertaining despite its flaws, while others criticized its shallow writing, inconsistent plot, and unlikeable characters. The anime seems to appeal to those who enjoy mindless entertainment but disappoints those seeking depth or originality.
pros: Entertaining for viewers who enjoy generic isekai tropes.
Some viewers found the MC's antics and personality enjoyable.
The art is decent, and the intro and outro music are surprisingly good.
cons: Generic isekai with shallow writing and inconsistencies.
MC is a hypocritical loner who contradicts himself.
Classmates are shallow and lack meaningful development.
Battles are uninspired and lack good choreography.
The world-building is bland and lacks detail.
Forced harem vibes with girls inexplicably liking the MC.
Inconsistent use of levels and stats, making them irrelevant.
Poor adaptation of the source material (light novel/manga).
Tonal whiplash with serious themes not being handled well.
Skill usage is stretched to the point of being illogical.

anime.title: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything With Low-Level Spells
anime.romaji_title: Hazurewaku no "Joutai Ijou Skill" de Saikyou ni Natta Ore ga Subete wo Juurin suru made
anime.synopsis:
When loner Touka Mimori is summoned to another world alongside his classmates, he obtains the power to inflict status ailments, such as paralysis or poison, on his enemies. Unfortunately for him, skills of this nature are considered useless due to their low success rate, and Touka is thus assigned the title of E-rank hero. Things take a further turn for the worse when Vicius, the goddess who summoned the class, reveals that the lowest-ranked hero will be disposed of so that they do not hinder those with greater talent.

Banished to a notoriously dangerous area, Touka comes face-to-face with death after being cornered by a minotaur-like creature. In a desperate attempt to survive, he uses his supposedly worthless skill—only to quickly realize that it works almost every time. Armed with the ability to render the monsters standing in his way completely helpless, Touka resolves to track down the goddess that tossed him aside and exact his revenge.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some viewers appreciate the revenge-driven plot and the protagonist's development, finding it a satisfying power fantasy. However, many are critical of the poor animation quality, generic isekai tropes, and the overuse of sexual assault as a plot device, leading to a polarized viewing experience.
pros: Compelling character development of the MC.
Ruthless and goal-oriented protagonist.
Interesting monster designs.
Decent pacing that keeps the viewer engaged.
cons: Poor animation quality, especially the CGI.
Generic isekai tropes and a predictable plot.
Over-reliance on sexual assault to characterize villains.
Overpowered MC leading to lack of stakes in fights.

anime.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 4
anime.romaji_title: Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari Season 4
anime.synopsis:
Aiming to protect Raphtalia from the assassins of Q'ten Lo, Naofumi Iwatani travels with his friends to the eastern isolationist kingdom. On his way, Naofumi stops over in Siltvelt, a kingdom built by a former shield hero, where he is revered as a god and is offered a chance to rule the country.

Naofumi is unwilling to accept the position, preferring to continue his journey before the next wave of monsters threatens to destroy the world. Nevertheless, he finds himself embroiled in local political feuds. After he escapes from an assassination attempt, Naofumi decides to confront the leaders of Siltvelt, and this time, he is determined to show that old grudges and petty ambitions are nothing compared to his resolve to save the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 4 of Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari is largely considered a disappointment, failing to live up to the standards set by the first season. While some reviewers noted slight improvements in animation, the consensus is that the plot is weak, the characters are underdeveloped, and the overall narrative feels disjointed and uninspired. Many long-time viewers express frustration and a sense of obligation rather than genuine enjoyment, with some even suggesting that the series should have ended after the first season.
pros: Improved animation and visual presentation compared to Season 2 and some aspects of Season 3.
Clearer plotline and consistent progression compared to the previous season.
Interesting world-building and lore.
cons: Weak and uninspired writing, with a plot that deviates significantly from the original essence of the series.
Poorly developed characters, especially new additions, who feel like empty shells.
Pacing issues, with the season feeling like a collection of side quests disconnected from the main storyline.
Lackluster combat scenes and animation quality during action sequences.
Political arcs without meaningful political depth, often resolved through simplistic fights.
Deus Ex Machina plot devices and nonsensical resolutions, particularly in the season finale.
Over-reliance on side characters at the expense of main character development.
The wave timer not being mentioned
anime.thematic_vibe: Political Intrigue, Disappointing Adaptation, Wasted Potential

anime.title: A Few Moments of Cheers
anime.synopsis: Kanata Asaya, a high school boy who is immersed in making music videos, is deeply moved by a street performance one day. He strongly wishes to create a music video for the song. However, the person singing was Yuu Orie, a female teacher who had given up on pursuing a career in music.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds 'Suu-funkan no Yell wo' to be a joyous and endearing experience. It's praised for its innovative use of music videos, spectacular visuals, and a compelling message about creativity and aspirations.  While some find it slightly cheesy, the overall sentiment is positive, highlighting the emotional impact and well-executed story.
pros: Tightly written tale of youth with tons of flair.
Fresh and innovative approach using music videos to enhance the story.
Spectacular visual presentation, especially the 3D CG cel-shaded animation and shots of the sky.
Great message for anyone who has ever created something.
Excellent main song (Mimei) and fitting ending song.
cons: Slightly cheesy.
Familiar territory due to the story being centered around a musician at a high school.

anime.title: The Healer Who Was Banished From His Party, Is, in Fact, the Strongest
anime.romaji_title: Party kara Tsuihou sareta Sono Chiyushi, Jitsu wa Saikyou ni Tsuki
anime.synopsis:
Throughout his youth, unskilled healer Laust was taken advantage of by unscrupulous adventurers. Despite intensive efforts to improve himself, Laust is swindled by the members of Blades of Lightning—the first party that he joins after completing his training—and is eventually banished by its leader Margulus.

As the subject of public ridicule, Laust is not hopeful about his future prospects. However, novice adventurer Narsena unexpectedly offers to form a party with him, and he happily accepts. The duo quickly gain fame by conquering uncharted parts of the labyrinth. While there seems to be a reason behind Narsena's hasty proposal, Laust is oblivious to what it could be.

Meanwhile, Margulus fails for the second time to slay a poisonous hydra, even after enlisting the help of elite healer Lyra for the quest. Laust soon finds himself being asked to rejoin Blades of Lightning, but it is not as easy as he imagined to move on from his former comrades-in-arms despite his new path and current companion.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely considered a generic and mediocre addition to the isekai/fantasy genre. Many viewers found the plot unoriginal, the characters bland, and the animation lacking. While a few enjoyed it as a time-filler, most felt it was forgettable and ultimately not worth watching, with a rushed ending adding to the disappointment.
pros: Some viewers found the plot and characters engaging enough to consider exploring the light novel.
A few reviewers felt it was an okay watch if bored and enjoy the OP main character trope.
Narsena is considered a good and likeable character by some.
cons: Generic and unoriginal plot with tired tropes and lack of depth.
Poor animation quality, static backgrounds, and inconsistent art style.
Weak and forgettable characters with little to no development.
Rushed ending with many loose ends and unanswered questions.
MC is inconsistent, and his abilities are poorly explained.

anime.title: Tasuketsu: Fate of the Majority
anime.genres: Action, Drama, High Stakes Game, Psychological, Suspense
anime.synopsis:
During his school computer class, Saneatsu Narita is presented with a strange screen posing a yes-or-no question that quickly disappears. The next day, Saneatsu wakes up to a world where everyone, save for himself and a few others, is dead.

An announcement from a mysterious figure known only as the Emperor begins to shed light on the situation. The question that Saneatsu saw on the screen is part of a game called Tasuuketsu. Every day, the survivors will see a question appear on a screen, and answering it will determine who lives to see the next day. Responding the same as the majority will guarantee death, and the last player standing will earn the right to meet the Emperor.

Saneatsu resolves to beat the Emperor at their own game, making use of the hidden envelopes containing powers that can aid the players. With the help of his small group of friends, Saneatsu must avoid falling into the machinations of the other players and win this wicked game.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is highly divided, particularly regarding the show's pacing and initial lack of explanation. While the second season is often praised for its improvements in plot and character development, the first season is criticized for being slow and confusing. Many find the series mediocre overall, with the ending failing to fully redeem the initial shortcomings.
pros: The second season improves significantly on the first, with better pacing and clearer goals.
Introduction of manipulative characters like Raion Ouno in the second season adds intrigue.
The second half delivers suspense, twists, and smart strategies.
cons: The first season suffers from slow pacing and weak character development.
The plot is confusing at the start, with little explanation of events.
The large number of characters and their unique abilities can be difficult to keep track of.
The animation and music are mediocre and forgettable.
Characters are often perceived as unintelligent, leading to frustration.

anime.title: Himitsu no AiPri
anime.synopsis:
Ever since she was a child, Himari Aozora has adored the world of the idol princesses known as AiPri. Long ago, Himari made a promise with her best friend, Mitsuki Hoshikawa, that they would debut as AiPris together. However, Himari has grown to be incredibly shy, and she has all but given up on her dream.

Both girls enroll as first years at Paradise Private Academy. On the first day of school, Himari gets lost on her way back to the dormitory and stumbles upon a room radiating a pink light. She falls into the room, and a bracelet clasps onto her wrist, transporting her to the AiPriVerse—the world where AiPris perform.

Himari accidentally enters the newcomer auditions for the AiPriVerse, and her performance impresses Paradise Academy's Student Council. They offer to become her producers, with the condition that she will conceal her status as an AiPri. Little does Himari know that Mitsuki herself is also an AiPri and has been hiding it from her! Their childhood dream of performing together gradually comes to fruition—even as the academy's principal threatens to ban AiPri from school grounds entirely.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds 'Himitsu no AiPri' to be a lighthearted and enjoyable series, particularly praising its charming characters and vibrant setting. However, it is criticized for lacking depth and substance, making it a fun but ultimately forgettable addition to the Pretty series franchise. The show is not particularly controversial, with most viewers holding similar opinions about its strengths and weaknesses.
pros: Engaging supporting cast with unique personalities.
Vibrant and lively academy setting.
Fun and entertaining, suitable for weekly viewing.
cons: Lacks substantial depth or meaningful plot development.
Formulaic structure may lead to repetition.
Relies heavily on established tropes of the genre.

anime.title: Mayonaka Punch
anime.synopsis:
Masaki's career on NewTube ends abruptly when the Harikiri Sisters decide to kick her out of their group during a livestream. With her bad reputation, Masaki has a slim chance of returning to popularity with a solo channel and she is plagued by comments of hate.

Masaki soon meets Live, a vampire who just woke up from her slumber in which she dreamed of Masaki and developed an obsession with her. Believing this discovery will be the next internet sensation, Masaki forms a pact with Live: in exchange for Masaki's blood, Live will help her reach the milestone of a million subscribers.

Now, with the other vampires in Live's house on board with Masaki's ambitious plan, she and Live work together to film videos and restore her to career glory.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Mayonaka Punch' for its humor, heart, and surprisingly insightful take on internet culture. The show's strengths lie in its well-developed characters and balanced mix of comedy and drama. While some find the side character development lacking and note occasional tonal inconsistencies, the overall reception is positive, with many praising its sincere and heartwarming nature.
pros: Well-balanced comedy and drama.
Lovable and well-developed characters.
Excellent animation and art style.
Insightful portrayal of online content creation and its challenges.
Catchy opening and fitting ending themes.
Redemption arc
cons: Some side characters lack development.
Pacing issues in character development.
Potential tonal dissonance between comedy and drama.

anime.title: Enjou Bokumetsu! Mahou Shoujo Aiko
anime.synopsis: With reports of adultery, power harassment, and compliance violations reported almost daily, the city's morals have reached rock bottom. To fight against this "unpunished evil," good citizens take up their smartphones, and magical girl Aiko takes up her Eye Stick. Aiming to realize a just and pure society, Aiko continues to fight against controversial celebrities and adulterous politicians. Aiko, be angry! Until the flames of justice burn away all evil.
anime.consensus_summary: The series sparks heated online discussion and controversy due to its satirical take on social issues and online culture. While some appreciate its fast pace and comedic elements, others find its approach overly reliant on commentary. The ending undermines the seriousness which adds another layer of meaning.
pros: Exploration of online culture and group mentality
Fast pacing enhances the impact of the commentary
Combines heavy themes with comedic elements
cons: Series relies heavily on themes relating to commentary
Over the top nature of the presentation

anime.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword
anime.synopsis:
When humanity was oppressed by mysterious foes known as the Celestial Hosts, five exceptional mages joined forces to defeat them. In fear that these formidable enemies would return, the five most powerful mages, known as the Magia Vander, built a magical dome and a tower to contain them. Since then, the five strongest mages of every generation are tasked with monitoring the dome from the top of the Wizard's Tower.

Inspired by this story, childhood friends Will Serfort and Elfaria Albis Serfort promised each other that they would climb to the top of the Wizard's Tower. However, now a sixth-year student at Regarden Magic Academy, Will's future looks bleak. Although Elfaria managed to join the ranks of the Magia Vander five years prior thanks to her unparalleled magical power, Will has no magical abilities whatsoever, attracting the ire of teachers and students alike.

However, blessed with an exceptional physique, Will is able to slay monsters in the labyrinth and prevail against skilled magicians with the only aid of his sword and a few magical items. Determined to climb the Wizard's Tower at all cost, Will is determined to not let anyone or anything prevent him from keeping the promise he made to Elfaria.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some find the series enjoyable due to its action and animation, while others criticize its generic plot, uninspired characters, and reliance on clichés. The main character's perceived lack of personality and development is a common point of contention. Overall, the anime is considered average, with potential that is not fully realized.
pros: Good animation quality and fight choreography, especially in early episodes.
Exciting and well-choreographed fights.
Potentially immersive world-building.
cons: Generic plot and characters, lacking originality.
Main character is bland, submissive, and lacks development.
Cliche scenes and dialogues.
Inconsistent pacing.

anime.title: Sorairo Utility
anime.synopsis:
Avid gacha player Minami Aoba finds herself at an impasse when her favorite game announces the end of its live service. Left adrift without her beloved characters, she realizes she has been wasting her first year of high school and sets out to try different clubs to find a new, more productive hobby. However, the harsh truth sets in that she is completely unfit for pretty much every sport her school's clubs have to offer.

One fateful afternoon, Minami stumbles upon a golf driving range after helping an old man carry his equipment there. Inside, she meets Haruka Akane, who promptly introduces her to the sport. Much like her previous attempts at athletics, Minami has no natural talent for golf, but something about the rhythm of swinging the club captivates her. Finally, Minami feels the spark of genuine excitement that she has been looking for—a new obsession within her reach.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally finds Sorairo Utility to be a relaxing and enjoyable slice-of-life anime about finding passion in hobbies. While some appreciate its comfy atmosphere and relatable characters, others find it to be average and lacking in unique qualities. The show is not particularly controversial, appealing to viewers looking for a lighthearted and simple story.
pros: Relatable story of finding enjoyment in hobbies without needing to be the best.
Relaxing and comfy atmosphere.
Good direction and animation.
Likeable characters.
cons: Average production quality.
Story can be slow-paced.
Doesn't stand out, feels average.
Lacks uniqueness.

anime.title: Viral Hit
anime.synopsis:
The bullies at Yoo Hobin's high school are no ordinary trouble-makers: they are NewTubers, budding internet celebrities who force Hobin to partake in humiliating videos and host live-streams in his house. Hobin only manages to stay strong by reminding himself that he needs to work hard to support his hospitalized mother. However, during his classmate Woo Jihyeok's live stream, Hobin completely snaps after a humiliating incident. As a result, the two men engage in a grotesque fistfight that lasts until dawn.

The following day, Hobin discovers that the livestream of his fight went viral on NewTube, turning him into a celebrity overnight. After he realizes that making viral videos is a very lucrative endeavor, Hobin agrees to team up with Jihyeok to create a channel that features his martial prowess. However, Hobin needs to become a seasoned fighter and keep his distance from those who seek to use him for his newfound fame, unless he wants a lack of views to become the least of his problems. Thankfully for him, the unexpected discovery of a series of obscure self-learning videos might be just what he needs to survive in the content creation industry.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Kenka Dokugaku' for its engaging characters, action, and relevant social media themes.  Viewers find the character development satisfying and the storyline entertaining, though some criticize the plot's depth and the cringeworthy moments. Overall, it is seen as a fun watch, especially for those interested in martial arts and underdog stories.
pros: Engaging characters with remarkable development, especially the MC.
Intense and brilliant action scenes.
The concept of mixing bullying with social media is interesting and fun.
Each episode has a solid setup that makes viewers hooked and invested in the characters.
Realistic process of the MC's creation
cons: Story lacks depth and intensity.
Some cringe moments.
The plot is not that important.
The YouTuber aspect is not that realistic.
Starts off slow

anime.title: I'm Living with an Otaku NEET Kunoichi!?
anime.romaji_title: NEET Kunoichi to Nazeka Dousei Hajimemashita
anime.synopsis:
Tsukasa Atsumi is a salaryman who leads an ordinary, solitary life. On his way back from work one evening, he is saved from a demon attack by a mysterious woman in a ninja outfit. Introducing herself as Shizuri Ideura, she claims that demons target people like Tsukasa, who have Samurai Blood in their veins, and that her kind have been protecting them from the shadows.

Told by Shizuri that the attacks are going to become more frequent, Tsukasa makes a deal to provide her with housing in exchange for his safety. To his surprise, he quickly finds out that Shizuri is a shut-in who loves to play video games whenever she is not busy with her ninja duties. As the two spend more time together, Tsukasa grows to appreciate Shizuri's company—and his feelings just might be mutual.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed. Some find it an entertaining, brain-off comedy with a charming lead and unique premise, while others criticize its lack of story, problematic humor, and subpar production quality. It's best enjoyed by those who appreciate lighthearted humor and are willing to overlook its flaws.
pros: Unique Premise blending ninjas, NEET culture, and romantic comedy provides a fresh take.
Charming lead Kunoichi with relatable otaku habits and developing feelings.
Voice acting and referential gags are well-executed.
Side characters & their antics are entertaining, providing consistent entertainment.
Comedy lands well for fans of wacky and madcap slapstick humor.
cons: Lacks story, cohesion & basic formatting, leading to a jumbled blob of conflicting tones, genres & ideas.
Animation quality is flat and basic, lacking subtle character expressions.
Problematic humor with potentially transphobic elements and jokes about sensitive topics.
Pacing and format can feel disjointed with episodes divided into short segments.
Tsukasa is a passive protagonist.
The show heavily relies on tropes & stereotypes in the medium.
The production is quite a bit hit or miss; subpar, with likely budget constraints.

anime.title: Look Back
anime.synopsis:
Ayumu Fujino may only be in the fourth grade, but she already basks in high praise for her hand-drawn four-panel comics featured in the school's newspaper. However, when she is asked to share the page with Kyoumoto—a reclusive student she has never met—Fujino feels inadequate for the first time: her free-spirited drawings look embarrassingly amateurish next to Kyoumoto's breathtakingly detailed art.

For a year, Fujino shuts out the world, obsessively studying manga creation and drawing tirelessly to catch up to her faceless competition. But Kyoumoto's talent far exceeds hers, and Fujino quits it all. Another year passes, and on the day of their graduation, Fujino finally meets Kyoumoto. This unkempt, shy, and stuttering girl has actually been Fujino's biggest fan all along. Their encounter reignites Fujino's passion for art and sparks the beginning of a years-long friendship built on rivalry, admiration, and their shared love of manga.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves 'Look Back' for its emotional depth, beautiful animation, and poignant storytelling. It explores themes of regret, connection, and artistic passion, resonating deeply with many viewers. Some find the story more impactful with knowledge of the author's background, but overall, it's considered a heartfelt and memorable experience.
pros: Beautiful animation and music enhance the emotional impact.
Effectively portrays the complexities of human relationships and artistic pursuits.
Captures the essence of Fujimoto's art style and storytelling.
cons: The story may be more meaningful to those familiar with Fujimoto's personal life.
Character design lacks detail.

anime.title: The Shiunji Family Children
anime.synopsis:
The wealthy and esteemed Shiunji family consists of seven siblings: Banri, Seiha, Ouka, Arata, Shion, Minami, and Kotono. Arata, the family heir, is constantly teased by his sisters for his inability to find love. However, during Kotono's 15th birthday, the siblings learn a shocking, long-hidden secret—all of them are adopted!

The siblings all agree that their relationship will remain the same. But that promise does not last long, as each of the girls begins to approach Arata with intentions that go beyond sibling affection. Arata, who cherishes his family more than anything, must now find a way to protect their precious bonds and ensure that the Shiunji family never changes.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some finding the show enjoyable due to its character development and animation quality, while others are critical of its reliance on incestuous themes and harem tropes. Many compare it unfavorably to the author's other work, Rent-a-Girlfriend, while some see it as an improvement. The show is considered a decent watch but not particularly groundbreaking or memorable.
pros: Well-developed characters, especially Arata and some of the sisters (Minami, Ouka).
Strong animation quality and appealing art style, often reaching high visual standards.
Good pacing that allows the story to breathe, with slow-burn romance development.
Enjoyable and well-executed character arcs that provide emotional depth.
Better than Rent-a-Girlfriend, improved communication and MC isn't a coward
cons: The premise relies on potentially uncomfortable 'incest-adjacent' themes.
Some characters feel underdeveloped or neglected, particularly Shion and some of the sisters.
Relies on overused harem tropes and stereotypes.
Inconsistent character behavior and rushed development at times.
Repetitive flashbacks and unnecessary expositional dialogue.
Questionable narrative choices from the author Reiji Miyajima

anime.title: The Girl Downstairs Extra
anime.synopsis: Extra episode of Aishang Ta de Liyou.
anime.consensus_summary: The extra episode is well-received for providing a conclusive ending that deviates from the source material, offering closure that the first season lacked. However, some viewers wished to see more of the characters' dating life and felt the ending was somewhat rushed. Overall, the audience appreciates the alternative ending, particularly as it avoids the frustrating conclusion of the original source.
pros: Provides a full conclusion unlike S1
Conclusive ending
Avoids the frustrating ending of the source material
cons: Skips over the dating period
Ending felt rushed

anime.title: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
anime.synopsis: Konoha Satou has a dark history. After all, she spent her teen years writing self-indulgent fantasy romance fics-like her Dark History. But since she's become its most despicable villainess, remembering every last detail is now a matter of life-and-death. Having avoided the first couple of death flags, Satou's suddenly left in the dark when a mysterious stranger returns from the Lily Kingdom-a character she doesn't recall writing in the original script. Although Yomi claims to be her ally, can Satou really trust a character she knows nothing about in such a dangerous world?
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Tensei Akujo no Kuro Rekishi' as a comedic and self-aware take on the villainess isekai trope. Viewers appreciate the main character's relatability and the story's ability to poke fun at common tropes. However, some are critical of the low-budget animation and underdeveloped supporting characters, leading to mixed feelings but overall positive reception.
pros: The show is a fun parody of Otome tropes, aware of its own cringe and using it for humor.
The main character, Iana, is well-written, entertaining, and relatable as she cringes at her past self.
The story subverts the generic plot lines and gives weight to events, making the characters feel real.
cons: The animation quality is low and on a budget, with overuse of chibi models that break immersion.
Some find the comedy annoying and the protagonist's antics irritating.
Supporting characters are neglected and underdeveloped, existing only to serve the protagonist's story.
anime.thematic_vibe: Cringy Comedy, Self-Aware Parody, Villainess Isekai

anime.title: Let This Grieving Soul Retire
anime.romaji_title: Nageki no Bourei wa Intai shitai
anime.synopsis:
As dungeon-like treasure vaults started appearing throughout the land, more and more people began signing up as treasure hunters—risking their lives to obtain the vast riches and ancient relics inside. In the imperial capital of Zebrudia, the top hunter party is the Grieving Souls—a group of six childhood friends led by Krai Andrey, who is thought to be the strongest of them due to having a reputed wide array of skills.

However, Krai actually has no special talent. His accomplishments are actually the result of his friends being overpowered. Krai has repeatedly attempted to leave the party out of fear his lack of aptitudes would one day cause his companions' downfall. Nevertheless, everyone around Krai thinks differently, making him feel obligated to remain the group's leader.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided, with some appreciating the comedic and unique premise, while others find the execution lacking in character development and story depth. Many enjoy the humor derived from misunderstandings surrounding the main character's perceived strength. However, some viewers are frustrated by the lack of progress and the reliance on luck rather than skill.
pros: Good comedic timing and subplots
Interesting world-building that makes the plot work
Exceptional voice acting
cons: Lack of character development and progression
Predictable story with dry comedy
Uneven pacing and some lackluster moments

anime.title: The Stories of Girls Who Couldn't Be Magicians
anime.romaji_title: Mahoutsukai ni Narenakatta Onnanoko no Hanashi
anime.synopsis:
From a young age, Kurumi Mirai has aspired to become a magician. Driven by her ambition, she has spent her childhood preparing to join the prestigious Rettoran Academy of Magic. Although Kurumi excels in the selection exam, her dream is crushed when she is not chosen for the elite magic class.

Admitted to the standard class at the academy instead, Kurumi soon befriends Maki Kumiiru, her new roommate; and Yuzu Edel, another girl unhappy with her placement. However, to everyone's surprise, their homeroom teacher, Minami Suzuki, promises to teach the class magic anyway. Although skeptical at first, the girls start to believe that this may be their second chance at realizing their dreams and becoming wonderful magicians.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is largely disappointed with Mahoutsukai ni Narenakatta Onnanoko no Hanashi. While the art style receives praise, the plot, characters, and world-building are heavily criticized. Many feel the show failed to capitalize on its potential, resulting in a mediocre and forgettable experience, although some viewers found it enjoyable despite its flaws.
pros: Unique watercolor art style and backgrounds
Charming character designs by Lily Hoshino
Catchy opening theme by PuffyAmiYumi
cons: Weak and convoluted plot with irrelevant elements
Underdeveloped and bland characters
Poor worldbuilding and magic system
Slow pacing and lack of character growth
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Slice of Life, Disappointing Potential

anime.title: Nyaight of the Living Cat
anime.synopsis:
In the 21st century, humanity's love for cats grew so deep that nearly everyone owns one as a pet. However, selective breeding of cats results in an extraordinary individual who carries a strange virus. The outbreak—dubbed the Nyandemic—turns any human who makes contact with an infected feline into one themselves.

Kunagi, a man who has lost all of his memories, is forced to flee mid-shift from a cat cafe. With him are siblings who run the place, Gaku and Kaoru, and a customer named Tanishi. But Gaku confesses that he is already infected and pleads with Kunagi to protect his sister. After experiencing the danger firsthand, the remaining three begin searching for a way to survive the very animals they adore.

Despite the government's best efforts to halt the feline hordes, the Nyandemic uncontrollably spreads. Human extinction seems more probable by the hour—but Kunagi, Kaoru, and Tanishi refuse to surrender their humanity without a fight!
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is a bizarre parody that appeals mainly to cat lovers, but its weak story, flat characters, and inconsistent tone disappoint many. While the premise is unique and the cat trivia resonates, the execution falls short. Viewers find the lack of character depth and illogical non-violence frustrating, leading to a mixed reception.
pros: Cat trivia and details resonate with cat owners.
The premise is unique and humorous.
The theme songs are catchy.
cons: Weak story and flat characters.
Inconsistent tone, failing as both horror and comedy.
Basic animation and low-quality CGI for cats.
Over-the-top reactions of the protagonist are annoying.
Repetitive plot reminiscent of typical zombie stories.
Illogical non-violence of human characters, even during the apocalypse.

anime.title: Nights With a Cat Season 3
anime.romaji_title: Yoru wa Neko to Issho Season 3
anime.synopsis: Third season of Yoru wa Neko to Issho.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys the third season of 'Yoru wa Neko to Issho,' finding it relatable, funny, and a good way to relax. Viewers appreciate the increased number of episodes and the expansion of the cat universe. The show maintains its established formula, which is seen as a positive for existing fans.
pros: More episodes than previous seasons.
Relatable and funny stories.
Good for practicing listening to Japanese.
cons: Characters are a little flat.

anime.title: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.
anime.genres: Drama, Reverse Harem, Romance, School, Shoujo
anime.synopsis:
Aspiring manga artist Mizuho Nishino has grown alongside her four childhood friends: Kizuki Hazawa, Shuugo Hoshikawa, Shin Kashiwagi, and Airu Izumi. But on Mizuho's 17th birthday, Kizuki suddenly asks to be her boyfriend. Having no previous experience with romance, Mizuho brushes it off easily, but Kizuki is genuine and intends to win her heart.

Kizuki no longer hides his affections, and Mizuho hesitates, worried about the consequences their potential relationship could have on their whole friend group. As Mizuho works through the confusion of youth, it seems that the other three boys have fallen for her as well—and she must find a way to sort her feelings out without shattering the close-knit group she holds dear.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is largely criticized for its poor animation, weak story, and frustrating characters. Some viewers find it addictively bad, like a train wreck they can't look away from, while others find it a painful waste of time. The series has a lot of shoujo stereotypes that have negative impacts.
pros: Character designs are cute.
Some found the messiness fun to watch.
Soundtrack and Visuals are not bad.
cons: Glacial pacing and muted drama.
Atrocious production values with PowerPoint animation.
Story feels empty and characters frustrate.
Forced seduction and senseless actions by characters.
Inconsistent timeline with present day and pandemic restrictions barely relevant.

anime.title: Honey Lemon Soda
anime.synopsis:
First-year high school student Uka Ishimori wants a fresh start. In middle school, Uka was given the nickname "Rocky" by her peers, being misunderstood as having no emotions when she was actually shy and introverted. As a result, Uka was relentlessly bullied and experienced a lonely, isolated school life. Now, Uka is determined to change.

During the first week of school, Uka accidentally gets drenched in lemon soda by her classmate Kai Miura—whose cool personality is the complete opposite of hers. After the incident, Uka is surprised when Kai performs small acts of kindness for her, encouraging her to gradually break out of her shell. Like a lemon soda, bubbly and exciting feelings are beginning to stir.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some viewers finding the show a heartwarming and relatable story of overcoming social anxiety and bullying, praising its character development and animation. However, others criticize it for being clichéd, unoriginal, and having an overly emotional main character. Some find the show enjoyable as a comfort anime, while others find it frustrating and immature.
pros: Heartwarming and inspiring character development, especially for those who relate to social anxiety and bullying.
Charming and cute animation style.
Comfort anime, easy to grasp and feel good.
cons: Characters and plot are stereotypical and unoriginal.
Overly emotional main character can be annoying.
Unrealistic and clichéd scenarios.

anime.title: My Wife Has No Emotion
anime.romaji_title: Boku no Tsuma wa Kanjou ga Nai
anime.synopsis:
Takuma Kosugi is an office worker who does not have enough time to take care of everything at home. To make his daily life easier, he purchases a secondhand housekeeping robot named Mina, who quickly proves her worth. One day, after returning from work and having one too many beers, Takuma somewhat jokingly blurts out that she should become his wife! Much to his surprise, Mina takes his words seriously, and the two gradually begin living as if they are married.

As the days go by, Takuma and Mina grow closer and start doing more activities together, like going on a picnic and spending a day at the beach. However, much of society still considers human-robot relationships unusual. The couple must figure out if their arrangement can succeed and how to convince the people around them of their sincerity.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed, with some viewers finding the anime to be a cute and wholesome story about love and connection, while others view it as disturbing and unsettling due to the questionable morality of the relationship. Some appreciate the exploration of loneliness and technology, while others criticize the shallow writing and lack of depth. Ultimately, the anime evokes conflicting feelings, with individual interpretations largely depending on personal morality and perspectives on love and relationships.
pros: Relatable protagonist and endearing story.
Mina's character development is phenomenal; her progression from robot to expressing emotions is heartwarming.
Balances lighthearted moments with deeper themes about loneliness and relationships.
Charming characters.
Exploration of the line between humanity and technology is interesting.
Presents an interesting story about AI development and relationships.
cons: The story can feel shady and uncomfortable due to the robot's lack of emotion and the power dynamic.
The romance feels forced and unfulfilling, more like self-indulgence than genuine love.
Writing can be childish and simplistic, especially when dealing with mature subjects.
The world feels empty, lacking depth and realism.
Animation quality is average and unmemorable.
Several times when we think that deeper and more complex themes are going to be debated, this doesn't happen.
anime.thematic_vibe: Loneliness, Unconventional Romance, Humanity vs. Technology

anime.title: The iDOLM@STER Shiny Colors Season 2
anime.synopsis:
Following the success of Shiny Colors' first concert, Mano Sakuragi and her friends continue to face new challenges. After Straylight, a new unit of 283 Production, makes its debut concert, the members of the units are temporarily shuffled into new groups to prepare for a Halloween event to help them grow individually as idols.

While Mano struggles to express her ideas, her fellow unit member Hiori Kazano feels left out by her new comrades' talent. At the same time, Fuyuko Mayuzumi, who has bitterly failed to become Straylight's center, proves completely unable to show her real personality, jeopardizing the entire project in the process. Shiny Colors' producer will have to find a way for Fuyuko to break out of her shell if he wants to see his idol units illuminate the world once more.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season is perceived as only marginally better than the first, retaining similar flaws in visuals and narrative. The introduction of new units feels incomplete due to the exclusion of others, leading to a sense of awkwardness. Overall, the season is considered unnecessary, with resources potentially better allocated to improving the first season or completing the cast.
cons: Poor Visuals
Incomplete Roster
Weak Story
Unnecessary Season
anime.thematic_vibe: Idol Growth, Interpersonal Challenges, Performance Pressure

anime.title: Pop Pop City
