The humor is divisive, with some finding it funny and others finding it predictable. Ultimately, the show doesn't live up to the hype, but some viewers find it enjoyable.
pros: Engaging adult cast and mature setting.
Good balance of comedy and action.
Unique and interesting premise.
Well-choreographed action sequences that utilize environments well.
Character development on many characters, not just the MC
cons: Inconsistent tone and pacing.
Bland and uninspired story.
Predictable comedy.
Animation and visual style are lacking.
Relies on overused tropes.

anime.title: 9: Ruler's Crown
anime.genres: Mystery, Romance, School, Super Power, Time Travel
anime.synopsis:
While helping out at an anime convention to promote his city, high school student Kakeru Niimi is caught up in a sudden earthquake. During the emergency, he ends up entering a shrine where he sees a peculiar relic shatter. The very next day, his classmate Miyako Kujou, who was cosplaying at the event, worries that she has been cursed as a result of the earthquake, but Niimi brushes her suspicions off.

However, Niimi's mind changes when he discovers that various people have gained supernatural powers in the city—and that some have started using them for nefarious purposes. Fortunately, Niimi is not alone: he is joined by Miyako, his sister Sora, and a cold girl named Noa Yuuki, who have all awakened to their own abilities. If the group wants to keep their hometown safe, they must strive to prevent any future incidents while unraveling the mystery behind it all.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime adaptation of 9-nine-: Ruler's Crown receives mixed reactions, particularly from visual novel fans. While the plot and action are engaging, the rushed adaptation sacrifices character development and emotional depth. Many feel the anime fails to capture the essence of the original visual novel, resulting in a disappointing experience for those familiar with the source material.
pros: Engaging plot with cool twists and reveals.
Likeable characters with decent comedy.
Well-executed blend of urban fantasy and time travel elements.
cons: Rushed adaptation sacrifices character development and story depth.
Weak writing, forced plot devices, and bland main character.
Inconsistent character development with abrupt transitions.
Animation shortcuts with lazy stills.

anime.title: 0 Years Old Child Starting Dash Story
anime.synopsis: A woman in her thirties, who is enthusiastic about games, is reincarnated in another world. Born into the noble Carol family as Lilia, she could not be happier when she finds out that this world hosts magic. Despite being an infant, she quickly learns different skills and magic by using her gaming knowledge and memories from her previous life. To make the most of her new life, Lilia sets her sights on becoming a strong adventurer!
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely criticized for its poor animation, pacing, and storyboarding, failing to deliver on its promising premise. Reviewers found the short episode length to be both a blessing and a curse, highlighting wasted screentime and a lack of meaningful content. Overall, the audience expresses disappointment with the anime's execution.
pros: Unique animation style (subjective)
Short episode length
cons: Poor animation quality
Slow pacing
Useless/meaningless scenes
Poor storyboarding
Inconsistent story
Lack of character development
Rushed plot progression
Recaps and outros take up significant screentime

anime.title: How Dare You!?
anime.synopsis: Yu Wanyin is teleported into a novel about palace struggles. The female protagonist of the novel is also teleported into it. To reverse her fate as a villain, Yu Wanyin chooses to join forces with a tyrant, who also turns out to be a modern man teleported in. Yu Wanyin hopes for the three modern people to put aside the palace struggles and just play cards and eat hotpot together peacefully. However, the female protagonist believes she is the chosen one, and still chooses to go against Yu Wanyin and the male protagonist King Duan's team. Thus, Yu Wanyin has to carry out a series of actions in order to survive and help Xia dynasty prevent the drought crisis...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally loves 'Cheng He Titong,' praising its unique take on the isekai genre, engaging characters, and humor. The storyline and its twists are well-received, though some find the animation style initially off-putting.  The show's music and emotional depth also contribute to its positive reception, creating anticipation for a second season.
pros: Unique transmigration concept with multiple characters
Cute and funny character relationships
Expansive story with good pacing and plot twists
Excellent music and voice acting that enhances emotional impact
Addresses emotional trauma of transmigration well
Lovable characters and strong humor
cons: Animation style might not appeal to everyone
May seem shallow at the beginning

anime.title: Bogus Skill <<Fruitmaster>>: About That Time I Became Able to Eat Unlimited Numbers of Skill Fruits (That Kill You)
anime.romaji_title: Hazure Skill "Kinomi Master": Skill no Mi (Tabetara Shinu) wo Mugen ni Taberareru You ni Natta Ken ni Tsuite
anime.synopsis:
It is said that the sole way to gain skills is to eat a fruit called Skill Fruit. Each person may eat only one during their life, as ingesting a second would result in instant death. Light Underwood wishes for a powerful skill that would allow him to become an adventurer with his childhood friend Lena Floria. When the day of selection arrives, the excited boy regrettably acquires Fruitmaster, a skill which merely improves his cultivation of fruits. Even worse, he is separated from Lena when she obtains an exceptional ability.

Although disappointed by the result, Light begins his life as a farmer and takes in a young girl named Ayla Lawrence. One day, due to a misunderstanding, the two consume Skill Fruits. However, instead of dying, Light miraculously receives a second skill, suited for combat, with his original ability. Now seemingly the only person who can gain multiple skills, Light wants to catch up to Lena and make history as the strongest adventurer.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime is largely considered a disappointment due to its generic plot, weak main character, and inconsistent writing. While a few viewers found some enjoyment in the overall plot and world-building, the majority express frustration with the unfulfilled potential and poor execution. The show's reliance on tired tropes and lack of innovation contributed to a negative reception.
pros: Some found the plot surprisingly cohesive compared to other similar anime.
A few reviewers appreciated the world-building and potential of side characters.
Lena's character was often highlighted as a positive aspect.
cons: The main character, Light, is widely criticized as bland, incompetent, and frustrating.
Many found the plot to be generic, predictable, and poorly executed.
The animation quality is frequently described as low-budget and inconsistent.
Inconsistencies and logical flaws in the writing were a major point of contention.
Several reviewers felt the anime wasted the potential of its premise.

anime.title: Theatre of Darkness: Yamishibai 13
anime.synopsis: Thirteenth season of Yami Shibai.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds Yami Shibai 13 to be a very average season. Some appreciate it as a way to pass the time and enjoy the overarching connection provided by the final episode. However, many find the stories inconsistent in quality and the reliance on jump scares ineffective.  The art style in some episodes is also a point of criticism.
pros: Good to watch to pass some time
Episode 13 ties things together
cons: Some stories miss the mark
Too many jump scares that don't work
Some art direction is odd, too much like scribbles

anime.title: Spy x Family Season 3
anime.genres: Action, Childcare, Comedy, Shounen, Super Power
anime.synopsis:
Despite occasional setbacks, Operation Strix has remained on track to extract sensitive information from the enigmatic politician Donovan Desmond. To this end, spy Loid Forger has managed to maintain his pretend family consisting of his telepathic daughter, Anya; assassin wife, Yor; and their clairvoyant dog, Bond. Still the only one aware of everyone's true identities, Anya tries to sustain the family's cohesion while working to befriend Donovan's son Damian, her Eden Academy classmate.

However, Anya's efforts instead earn her another Tonitrus Bolt, bringing her closer to getting expelled and jeopardizing the operation's success. Hearing the news, Loid faints from shock. In his unconsciousness, he reminisces about his tragic past and his journey to becoming a spy. Realizing what Operation Strix means to him and the world, Loid finds renewed motivation. Although they each work toward their own covert goals, the Forgers continue to cherish their chaotic yet blissful family life.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 3 of Spy x Family is generally well-received, with many viewers finding it an improvement over season 2 due to its stronger plot and deeper character exploration. However, some recurring criticisms persist, including slow plot progression and repetitive comedic elements. Despite these issues, the series continues to be a comfort anime for many, maintaining its core appeal with high production values.
pros: Stronger plot than season 2 with meaningful progress.
Exploration of character backgrounds, particularly Loid's past.
Good balance of action, comedy, and family moments.
High production value with smooth animation and great voice acting.
Arcs are more intricate and detailed, leading to character and world development.
The series tackles serious topics with a light touch.
cons: Repetitive elements and stagnant plot progression.
Comedy can be hit-or-miss, sometimes lacking subtlety.
Slow narrative momentum, with dynamics often resetting.
Yor's character may become annoying due to repetitive gags.
Star and Thunderbolt system is disappointing.
Romance between Loid and Yor progresses slowly.
anime.thematic_vibe: Spy Comedy, Family Dynamics, Cold War Espionage

anime.title: Tamon's B-Side
anime.synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old Utage Kinoshita lives and breathes for her favorite idol group, F/ACE—but the group's center, Tamon Fukuhara, occupies a special place in her heart. Every waking moment Utage dedicates to the thoughts of the wild and sexy Tamon, even taking on a part-time housecleaning job just to afford her fangirl lifestyle.

What was supposed to be an ordinary job turns out to be anything but when Utage realizes she is cleaning the apartment of the very idol she so fervently admires! But adding to the surprise, Tamon is nothing like his on-stage persona; he suffers from severe anxiety and painfully low self-esteem. Keenly aware of the gap between their worlds, Utage cannot bear to see Tamon so depressed and decides to support him the best she can as his housekeeper.

As time passes, Utage becomes more and more privy to the aspects of Tamon's life he reveals to nobody else. And the bond that forms between them soon leaves Utage wondering if she has accidentally crossed the sacred line between fan and idol.
anime.consensus_summary: Overall, the audience enjoys Tamon's B-Side as a lighthearted and entertaining romance anime. Many appreciate the well-developed characters, humor, and animation quality. However, some reviewers find the female lead's obsessive behavior and the show's treatment of serious mental health issues to be problematic, contributing to a slightly divisive but overall positive reception.
pros: Well-developed and endearing characters, especially Tamon and Utage
Excellent animation and music
Positive portrayal of idol culture and fan support
Humorous and entertaining storyline
Strong female lead who is supportive and self-aware
cons: Protagonist's obsession and idol worship are problematic.
Superficial treatment of serious topics like depression and mental health.
Inappropriate jokes regarding mental health
Unrealistic/idealized premise
The male lead is unlikable with eccentric personality

anime.title: Maarui Kanojo to Zannen na Kareshi
anime.romaji_title: Maarui Kanojo to Zannen na Kareshi
anime.synopsis: The romantic comedy follows Mariko, a plus-sized nurse who loves to eat. Having no love experience, she thinks her life is devoid of love, until she meets a handsome man named Nagi at a group date that she is invited to. Nagi then asks her out on a date.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime had a promising concept of showcasing a plus-sized girl in a genuine romance, but it ultimately fails in its execution. The low-quality animation and inconsistent character development detract from the initial intent. While the voice acting is appreciated, the overall experience leaves viewers disappointed, as the story abandons its unique premise for generic tropes.
pros: Voice acting is well-done, especially the male lead.
The concept of a plus-sized girl in a regular romance is good.
cons: Low budget animation quality.
Main character's personality shifts to a bland shoujo trope.
Story fails to deliver on its initial concept.
Love interest's endearment feels fake.

anime.title: Flower and Asura
anime.romaji_title: Hana wa Saku, Shura no Gotoku
anime.synopsis:
Since childhood, Hana Haruyama has been enthralled by the art of storytelling. After watching a child her age perform on television with mesmerizing grace, Hana decides to try it herself. She practices by reciting tales to Tonaki Island's children, who are always enthusiastic about her performances. However, growing up in such a small community, Hana remains unaware of the possibilities beyond her world, satisfied with how things are.

Entering Sumomogaoka High School as a first-year student, Hana catches the attention of Mizuki Usurai, the president of the broadcasting club, with her skills. Despite Hana's hesitation and anxiety about the road ahead, Mizuki successfully convinces her to join the club, nurture her gift, and perhaps one day reach the top—the nationals of the NHK Broadcasting Competition.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While the show is praised for its unique premise, beautiful visuals, and genuine characters, it's criticized for a simple plot, under-developed character arcs, and an over-reliance on visuals during recitations rather than strong voice acting. The show has a niche appeal, and doesn't live up to its potential.
pros: Beautiful visuals and music enhance the dramatic readings.
Characters are genuine, fun, and demonstrate growth.
The concept of broadcasting and bringing literature to life is unique and interesting.
cons: Plot and characters are simple and not particularly outstanding.
The second half feels less engaging than the first, with the introduction of new characters feeling disruptive.
Recitations rely too heavily on visual and sound effects rather than voice acting itself.
Character backstories feel forced and conveniently timed.

anime.title: Gachiakuta
anime.synopsis:
The inhabitants of a certain wealthy town think nothing of throwing objects away. However, their waste is priceless to Rudo, a resident of the town's slums. Despite the constant warnings from his adoptive father Regto, Rudo spends his days searching for reusable materials that would otherwise be sent to the giant disposal area known as the Pit. Due to its vastness, the Pit doubles as a means of criminal punishment; those dropped in are never to return again.

When Regto is murdered by a mysterious assailant, Rudo is falsely accused of the crime and thrown into the Pit. To his surprise, he awakens in a trash-filled area inhabited by enormous monsters formed from the junk. As the toxic air and Trash Beasts push Rudo to the brink of death, he is saved by Enjin, one of the Cleaners who wield weapons known as Vital Instruments to fight the monstrosities. Having gained his own Vital Instrument, Rudo soon joins the Cleaners in the hopes of finding a way to escape the Pit and avenge his father.
anime.consensus_summary: Gachiakuta is a visually appealing anime with a unique aesthetic and interesting world-building. However, it suffers from weak writing, inconsistent pacing, and audio issues, leading to a divided audience. While some appreciate its originality and mature themes, others find it generic and emotionally lacking.
pros: Visually impressive with fluid animation and striking aesthetics.
Unique world-building with a creative concept of discarding and marginalization.
Interesting power system based on cherished objects reflecting character traits.
cons: Weak and poorly executed writing with shallow story and no emotional impact.
Inconsistent audio design with constant screaming and poor audio mixing.
Generic shonen story with weird pacing undermining its uniqueness.

anime.title: Guilty Gear Strive: Dual Rulers
anime.synopsis:
After the decline of the once robust fields of science and technology, a new energy source known as magic fuels the modern era. Humanity creates forbidden biological weapons: Gears. Those Gears eventually stand against humanity in a rebellion. Although they manage to overcome in the struggle for survival known as the Crusades, humanity's losses are so great that even after several decades pass, their emotional wounds remain unable to fully heal.

Sin Kiske, the child of a human and a Gear, heads to his father Ky and mother Dizzy's wedding ceremony. Their wedding breaks the ultimate taboo: a union between a human and a Gear. Even with the world at peace, it took many years for such a ceremony to come to fruition. Despite the complex array of emotions surrounding it, the wedding ceremony is met with blessings. When suddenly, a mysterious girl appears... The fated child inheriting Gear blood–and the mysterious girl who despises Gears. Their meeting would shake the world.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with strong criticism outweighing praise. Fans of the Guilty Gear franchise are largely disappointed, citing a failure to adapt the game's rich lore and character depth effectively. While some appreciate the 3D animation and character interactions, the consensus points to a rushed plot, poor animation quality, and a general lack of depth that fails to capture the essence of the source material.
pros: Likeable characters with interesting dynamics.
Solid 3D animation with good camera work.
Voice acting is authentic and unique.
cons: Underwhelming soundtrack compared to the game.
Poor 2D animation and compositing.
Rushed and shallow plot with underdeveloped characters.
Excessive exposition and narrator overuse.
Poor pacing.

anime.title: Princession Orchestra
anime.synopsis:
Alicepia Channel is a video sharing website exclusively for girls to share their singing, makeup, and dancing. Unbeknownst to others, users of the platform can travel to Alicepia, a secret world where time passes more slowly than reality. For Minamo Sorano and her best friend Natsu Hinoshita, Alicipia allows them to watch the idol Kagari Shirube live.

However, the upbeat atmosphere is ruined when monsters called Jamaocks attack Shirube's concert venue, causing panic in the audience. Only princesses whose hearts are filled with song can save Alicepia from the Jamaocks, and Minamo will find herself among the brave defenders of this wonderland.
anime.consensus_summary: Princession Orchestra is generally well-received as a love letter to magical girl fans, with a creative story, memorable characters, and catchy music. While the animation quality is inconsistent and the overarching plot has some hiccups, the series offers a unique and enjoyable experience. The show is appreciated for its world-building and character interactions.
pros: Creative and well-structured story with good worldbuilding.
Memorable characters with enjoyable interactions and chemistry.
Excellent and catchy J-pop insert songs.
Unique edge with a combination of magical girl elements and Alice in Wonderland-inspired fantasy.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality.
Naviyu not a strong mascot character.
Occasional hiccups with the overarching story and plot twists.
Some scenes of singing feel stilted and awkward.

anime.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Tensei shitara Dainana Ouji Datta node, Kimama ni Majutsu wo Kiwamemasu 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Prince Lloyd de Saloum—once a commoner who could never grasp magic—is now blessed with inexhaustible mana and has all the time in the world to master it, as he has no claim to the throne. After mastering demonic magic, he sets his sights on the Church to learn the secrets of divine magic that will bring him one step closer to completing his arsenal. However, due to his fondness for unholy magic, he draws the scrutiny of divine beings who see him as little more than a demonic spawn.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 is a mixed bag. Many viewers found it enjoyable and appreciated its animation and humor, but others felt it was a step down from Season 1 due to a weaker story, overemphasis on side characters, and repetitive elements. The season's single-arc focus was divisive, and some criticized the fan service.
pros: High production values and impressive animation, especially in fight scenes.
Faithful adaptation of the source material, including gags and references.
Entertaining and fun, with a focus on comedy and visual gags.
cons: Story is weaker compared to Season 1, with a drawn-out and generic arc.
Overemphasis on side characters, diluting the focus on the main character.
Repetitive music.
Excessive fan service, sometimes inappropriate for the character's age.

anime.title: Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra: World Conquest Starts with the Civilization of Ruin
anime.romaji_title: Isekai Mokushiroku Mynoghra: Hametsu no Bunmei de Hajimeru Sekai Seifuku
anime.synopsis:
Takuto Ira spent his short life confined to a hospital bed, with the civilization-building game Eternal Nations as his only form of entertainment. His favorite faction within the game—Mynoghra—was infamously complex to navigate and skewed toward evil; moreover, he insisted on playing at the highest difficulty.

After his untimely death, Takuto awakens in a world uncannily reminiscent of Eternal Nations. He is reincarnated as the King of Ruin, sovereign of Mynoghra itself. At his side stands Odei no Atou, the default hero unit of his chosen nation. Remembering every battle they fought together, she pledges unwavering loyalty to Takuto once more.

As Takuto begins to build Mynoghra from scratch in this new world, his early-game strategy remains unchanged: lie low, avoid war, and ensure survival at all costs—ironic for an evil ruler meant to conquer the world. When he offers refuge to persecuted Dark Elves fleeing destruction, a fledgling empire born of a darkness the world has yet to understand begins to take shape.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. While some appreciate the unique premise and focus on nation-building, others find the execution lacking. Common criticisms include a bland MC, slow pacing, and mediocre animation. Atou is generally well-received, and the plot twists generate some excitement.
pros: Unique premise blending isekai with 4X strategy game elements offers something different.
Atou is a well-liked character who carries the show and has a sweet relationship with the MC.
The story has unexpected twists and interconnected worlds that add to the excitement.
cons: MC is bland, uninteresting, and often sidelined.
Pacing is slow, with episodes dragging and simple arcs stretched out.
Animation quality is mediocre, with stiff character movements and uninspired battle choreography.
Kingdom-building aspect feels underdeveloped, lacking depth and variety.

anime.title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 2
anime.romaji_title: Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 2nd Season
anime.synopsis: Second season of Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed. Some appreciate the political and character-driven aspects, finding the story engaging despite its isekai trappings. However, many are critical of the poor animation quality, pacing issues, and bland main character, leading to a somewhat divided overall impression. The series is seen as decent but flawed, with potential for improvement.
pros: Engaging story with depth and tension.
Character growth, even in side characters, is well-executed.
Ars's appraisal skill and its development is a highlight.
Soundtrack and Lord's theme are well-received.
cons: Poor animation quality, especially in action sequences and backgrounds.
Pacing issues, stretching events out excessively.
Bland main character (Ars) and a romance plotline some find unappealing due to the characters' ages.
Tactics in war portions are simplistic and uninspired.
Inconsistencies in character development, with Ars sometimes feeling underdeveloped.

anime.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
anime.romaji_title: Class no Daikirai na Joshi to Kekkon suru Koto ni Natta.
anime.synopsis:
There is only one person that high school student Saito Houjou truly cannot stand—and that is his temperamental classmate, Akane Sakuramori. The two have always been on bad terms; their contrasting views and personalities only lead to endless fighting. However, everything changes when Saito's grandfather and Akane's grandmother arrange a sudden meeting and insist that the two get married!

Walking down the aisle is the last thing Saito and Akane want, but they are quickly coerced into accepting the ridiculous plan and soon move into a shared house as husband and wife. Although Saito and Akane despise each other, navigating life together under the same roof may just turn their bitter hatred into everlasting love.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is largely negative, with many criticizing the show for its reliance on tired tropes, unlikeable characters, and a frustrating lack of plot progression. Some viewers found enjoyment in the show's absurdity, but the overwhelming consensus points to disappointment and frustration. The series is seen as a poor example of the rom-com genre, with many feeling that it squandered its initial potential.
pros: Some found the absurdity and cringe humorous.
Character designs are considered functional and appealing to some.
Initial episodes showed promise for some viewers.
cons: Female lead is widely disliked, described as verbally abusive and insufferable.
Male lead is seen as bland and lacking personality.
Plot is repetitive with little to no progress in character development or relationship dynamics.
Relies heavily on overused and poorly executed rom-com tropes.
Ending feels incomplete and unsatisfying.
Inconsistent character behavior and forgotten plot points.
Comedy often falls flat, relying on loudness and arguing.
New characters introduced felt out of place and ruined the dynamic.
anime.thematic_vibe: Cringe Comedy, Trope Overload, Forced Relationship

anime.title: Tasokare Hotel
anime.synopsis:
Situated within an endless twilight, the Tasogare Hotel welcomes anyone stuck between life and death. Unaware of their fate, guests must regain lost memories through mementos hidden in their designated hotel room. Most guests pass on or return to the world of living within days, while few others find themselves staying at the hotel for much longer than usual.

Neko Tsukahara, a young woman with an expressionless face, finds herself at this hotel. As she is guided along by the staff, Neko regains enough of her memories to become invested in the plights of the other guests. Solving the guests' affairs and the mystery behind the hotel turns out to be too interesting of a situation to pass up; Neko decides that simply being a guest is not enough to satisfy her curiosity.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the show's premise, episodic stories, and emotional depth, drawing comparisons to 'Death Parade'. However, others criticize weak character development, a predictable plot, and a rushed, unsatisfying resolution to the central mystery. While some find the series engaging and deserving of wider recognition, others consider it a letdown and recommend the original game over the anime.
pros: Interesting premise akin to Death Parade.
Enjoyable episodic format with an overarching plot.
Likable characters and engaging individual stories.
cons: Weak character development, especially Neko's inconsistent decision-making.
Predictable plot and unsatisfying, rushed ending.
Lack of viewer involvement in solving the main mystery; reveals are 'plopped' in.

anime.title: Unnamed Memory Season 2
anime.synopsis: Second season of Unnamed Memory.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is mixed. Some viewers found the second season to be a satisfying conclusion to the characters' stories, praising the character dynamics and development. However, many criticize the rushed and confusing narrative, feeling it's a poor adaptation of the source material, with an overemphasis on less engaging plot elements.
pros: Strong character dynamics and development, especially Tinasha and Oscar
Satisfying ending for characters despite flaws in adaptation
Intriguing concept of a love story against time and the universe
cons: Rushed and confusing narrative, feeling disjointed and incoherent
Poor adaptation of source material, speedrunning the story
Uneven storytelling with abrupt time skips and narrative shifts
Overemphasis on governmental issues detracts from the core story
anime.thematic_vibe: Fantasy Romance, Time Travel, Complex Narrative

anime.title: Even Given the Worthless "Appraiser" Class, I’m Actually the Strongest
anime.romaji_title: Fuguushoku "Kanteishi" ga Jitsu wa Saikyou Datta
anime.synopsis:
In a world where strong classes are preferred, Ein has always been treated with disdain due to his mere Appraiser job, which allows him to appraise anything. During a dungeon expedition—where Ein usually only watches from the sidelines—a dangerous enemy appears, and Ein's allies use him as bait to escape the dire situation.

Prepared to die, Ein falls into the abyss, where he is miraculously saved by Yuri, the spirit of the long-lost World Tree, and Ursula, her fierce guardian. The two utilize their marvelous abilities to heal Ein's grave injuries and bestow him with the prosthetic "Spirit Eye," which lets him predict his opponents' moves and receive an infinite number of skills.

To help Ein leave the dungeon depths, Ursula decides to train him. After weeks of hard training, Ein's body is enchanted even further, and he takes Yuri and Ursula back to the surface with him. As the trio begins their journey together, Ein aims to reunite Yuri with her family and become a hero who will never be forgotten.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some finding enjoyment in the lighthearted harem aspects and likeable characters, while others criticize the generic plot, weak MC, and uninspired production. Many feel the show relies too heavily on tired tropes without offering anything new or substantial. Ultimately, it's considered a time-pass anime with little lasting impact.
pros: Enjoyable for fans of the harem genre.
Some found the characters likeable and charming, especially the female leads.
The initial concept of the MC using the Appraisal skill in combat was seen as unique.
cons: The story is generic and predictable, with overused tropes.
The MC is often criticized for being a weak, unconvincing 'beta' character with little to no character growth.
The plot is thin, and the villains lack depth, leading to unsatisfying fights.
Animation and OST are considered mediocre and uninspired.

anime.title: Wind Breaker Season 2
anime.synopsis:
Ever since Haruka Sakura joined Furin High School, where its students call themselves Bofurin and protect the town of Makochi, he has gained new friends despite his initial skepticism. Now starting to learn how to fight alongside his classmates and slowly growing out of his solitary past, Sakura has become the grade captain of the first-years.

Sakura's skills are put to the test when he and his classmates are faced with KEEL—a delinquent group known for its ruthless violence and coercion. While KEEL seems to be another rowdy group at first glance, their sudden appearance and strength in numbers might just be hiding a greater evil behind it. With all the odds against the Bofurin members, Sakura must accept that recognizing his shortcomings and receiving help from his upperclassmen will be necessary to preserve the peace in Makochi.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception of Wind Breaker Season 2 is divided. Some viewers appreciate the focus on character development, emotional depth, and thematic exploration, considering it an improvement over Season 1. However, others criticize the pacing, excessive dialogue, and inconsistent tone, finding the season less exciting and emotionally resonant, with some feeling that it deviates too much from the action-oriented nature of the first season.
pros: Strong character development, especially for Sakura.
Meaningful exploration of themes like tolerance, acceptance, and healthy relationships.
Good animation, particularly in fight choreography (though pacing is sometimes criticized).
Faithful adaptation of the manga, conveying important emotional moments.
cons: Pacing issues, with some arcs feeling rushed and others drawn out.
Excessive dialogue during fights, disrupting the momentum.
Forced emotional moments and sentimental parts that fall flat.
Inconsistent tone, shifting abruptly between gang violence and feel-good moments.
Some find the story declining and less exciting compared to Season 1.
anime.thematic_vibe: Character Growth, Delinquent Gangs, Emotional Healing

anime.title: Bad Girl
anime.synopsis:
High school first year Yuu Yuutani has always been a good girl, following the rules, helping out around her house, and generally going through life unnoticed. From afar, she reveres her upperclassman and the school's Public Decency Officer, Atori Mizutori, and desperately wants her attention. When she realizes that the best way to get Atori to notice her is to be a delinquent, she begins to dress differently: she dyes parts of her hair a bright red, wears clips on her ears to resemble piercings, and attaches jumbo erasers to her shoes to give them thicker soles.

Despite Yuu's best efforts and even with the advice of her "natural born delinquent" friend Suzu Suzukaze, all of her plans to be a bad girl go awry. Still, Yuu manages to befriend Atori and pledges to spend as much time as possible together, not knowing there are others vying for Atori's attention. In the process, Yuu has also gained the attention of the school's self-proclaimed idol, Rura Ruriha, filling her once-invisible life with more attention than she may be able to handle.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with many finding the show enjoyable for its comedic and yuri elements, while others criticize its shallow plot and repetitive humor. The show is appreciated for its lightheartedness and over-the-top antics. However, it may not appeal to viewers seeking substantial character development or a complex narrative.
pros: Catchy and unique opening and ending themes.
Enjoyable and memorable comedy with absurd and subtle humor.
Voice acting, particularly in the English dub, enhances the comedic tone.
cons: Simplistic story that may not appeal to those seeking depth.
Repetitive antics and reliance on ecchi elements can become tiresome.
Character development is minimal, with some characters being annoying to some viewers.

anime.title: Once Upon a Witch's Death
anime.synopsis:
Magic is all Meg Raspberry has ever known. Being raised by Faust, the Eternal Witch, Meg wishes to become a witch as great as her master. However, her life crumbles on her 17th birthday when Faust delivers the worst news possible: Meg has one year left to live. Due to a congenital curse, after turning 18, she will age a thousand times faster than normal and then die in mere days.

Faust tells Meg there is a way to cure her affliction: she needs to consume a seed of life. In order to create the seed, Meg must collect a thousand tears of joy within 12 months. Although she is distraught by the difficulty of the task at hand, Meg nonetheless embarks on the journey to prolong her life, meeting countless people with their own stories to tell.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Aru Majo ga Shinu Made' for its engaging characters and its mix of lighthearted comedy and emotional moments. However, some viewers found the animation inconsistent, the humor at times undermined the emotional impact, and the overall story lacked depth. Despite these flaws, the series is considered a decent watch for those seeking a lighthearted yet emotional anime.
pros: Charismatic and relatable main character (Meg)
Well-balanced blend of humor, drama, and tragedy
Interesting premise with potential for emotional depth
Strong side characters and their interactions with the MC
cons: Inconsistent animation quality
The comedy sometimes undermines the seriousness of the situation
Episodic nature leads to uneven quality between episodes
Lacks deep emotional connection with the audience

anime.title: Tonbo! Season 2
anime.synopsis:
After graduating middle school, Tonbo Ooi sets sail from the isolated island of Tokara to Kumamoto in hopes of advancing her golf career. Using his connections, Tonbo's mentor Kazuyoshi Igarashi is able to convince coach Hajime Udou to train her. While Tonbo initially has trouble showing off her abilities with her peculiar playstyle and inexperience with using a variety of golf clubs, she quickly proves her worth at her course debut by making use of her unique skills.

Leaving an impression on Hajime and the people around her, Tonbo is sent to compete in the Kyushu Women's Championship. Met with familiar faces and new rivals, she is determined to dive deeper into the professional world of golf.
anime.consensus_summary: The second season of Ooi! Tonbo is generally liked by fans of the first season, but it suffers from pacing issues and a less engaging story. While the characters and improved visuals are appreciated, the slow progression and frequent flashbacks detract from the overall experience. The audience sentiment is mildly positive but with reservations.
pros: Tonbo's character is well-received.
Introduction of new characters with developed backstories.
Improved CGI for golf shots compared to the first season.
cons: Pacing feels slow due to focus on a single golf tournament.
Use of flashback episodes disrupts the story flow.
Story not as good as first season

anime.title: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly
anime.synopsis: Fuu Nonoyama and Rui Nonoyama are sisters from a "land of magic," who were once on terms with one another, but have drifted apart. Suddenly, they are given magical powers by two cat-like spirits, Uguisu and Azuki, allowing them to transform into magical girl idols. However, there is a catch: these powers only last for a year and they cannot tell anyone that that magic exists. While neither Fuu nor Rui knows one another are magical girls, they soon begin their careers as idols.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience sentiment is split between appreciation for the show's emotional depth, beautiful art, and relatable themes, and frustration with the protagonist's actions. While many praise its production values and unique storytelling about sisterhood, others find the main character's behavior off-putting, leading to a somewhat divided reception.
pros: Beautiful and bright artistic direction, contrasting with darker emotional undertones.
Endearing and relatable characters with believable insecurities and struggles.
Emotionally resonant story about sisterly bonds and personal growth.
Good voice acting and music, with notable inclusion of popular artists in the OP.
Well-produced anime for its under-the-radar status.
Innovative distribution model via official YouTube channel, potentially reducing piracy.
cons: Protagonist Yuu's character can be rage-inducing and feel undeserving of her powers.
Yuu's character development is perceived as less significant compared to her sister Rui's.
Episodic nature may hinder a strong sense of overarching plot progression for some viewers.
The concept of a minor wielding uncontrolled magic is seen as potentially problematic or 'wild'.
anime.thematic_vibe: Magical Girl, Slice of Life, Drama

anime.title: Kaiju No. 8 Season 2
anime.genres: Action, Adult Cast, Fantasy, Military, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis:
Following the massive operation that led to the confinement of recent recruit Kafka Hibino, otherwise known as Kaijuu No. 8, the Defense Force has been puzzled by how to deal with him. Kafka is the first kaijuu to side with humans, and after careful consideration, he is eventually transferred to the Defense Force's First Division in the hope of adding his power to the strongest division, capable of handling any threat. However, some people are still doubtful about Kafka, and he must prove his worth in the next mission.

Kafka and the First Division are soon dispatched when a massive horde of ant-like kaijuu begins wreaking havoc. Thanks to the combined strength of Kafka's friend Kikoru Shinomiya and their captain, Gen Narumi, the mission seems to progress as it should. However, when Kafka fails to transform into his kaijuu form, the dreadful Kaijuu No. 9 joins the battle with only one goal—to eliminate him and steal his power. Although the situation is looking grim, Kafka must overcome his most difficult trial yet with the others if he wants to keep pursuing his dream: fighting side by side with his childhood friend and Third Division captain, Mina Ashiro.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed with praise for animation and lore, but criticism towards weak character development, a clichéd plot, and inconsistent pacing. Many feel Season 1 was superior, with Season 2 suffering from uninspired storytelling. The cliffhanger ending generates some anticipation for a third season, though overall enthusiasm is tempered.
pros: Improved pacing compared to Season 1 in some episodes.
Engaging lore due to deeper exploration of the kaiju plans and motivations.
Solid and consistent animation quality with unique touches in each episode.
cons: Weak character development, with characters feeling one-dimensional and arcs being poorly executed.
The plot feels clichéd, repetitive, and lacks depth, relying heavily on shonen tropes.
Inconsistent pacing with unnecessary or dragged-out episodes.
Bland character designs with a lack of charisma.
Rushed story structure and underwhelming emotional beats.

anime.title: Whimsical Wish
anime.synopsis: Wei Ran, a college graduate, was accidentally led into a world he never thought existed by a cat. When he was trying to find a way to return home, he learned that the only train that could take him back to the human world would only arrive in half a year. He could only temporarily live in the shop run by Mao Mao Yaya - Guaixiang Sale. Just when life seemed to be settling down, Wei Ran unexpectedly discovered that no matter where he went, dragon scales would appear. And every time the dragon scales appear, it causes completely different strange effects...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience consensus is mildly positive, with viewers appreciating the show's aesthetic and characters despite its weak plot and low budget. It's considered an enjoyable watch for those seeking a relaxing and visually appealing experience, but not for those seeking complex storytelling or high-quality animation. The show seems to cater to a specific audience that values atmosphere and character design over narrative depth.
pros: Cute and pleasing visual style
Good character designs
Enjoyable voice acting
cons: Weak plot
Low budget animation
Lacking in action

anime.title: Caged Character
anime.synopsis: Fei Xingkong and Sirui suddenly found themselves living in a comic cage, and they wanted to escape back to the real world. However, facing the absolute control of the "author", the two were forced to flee in the unpredictable world of the story...
anime.consensus_summary: The audience generally enjoys 'Long Zhong Ren' for its creativity and engaging scenarios, particularly praising the character dynamics. However, some find the numerous subplots overwhelming and note issues with subtitles. The ending, while setting up a sequel, leaves viewers with a mix of bewilderment and shock, creating anticipation for a potential second season.
pros: Creative and engaging scenarios
Good character dynamic between the two main characters
Well-paced story with changing art styles to reflect different chapter genres
cons: Subtitles may not always be the best
Last few episodes feel a little dragged on
Many subplots can be a bit much when binge-watching

anime.title: Roommates
anime.synopsis: Bai Junyan, a neighbor's white lotus with the fragrance of tea; Luo Ben, a flower of wealth in the world with eyes higher than the top. The two drama queens were assigned to the same dormitory and joined the same drama club. In front of them, there appeared the sophomore drama club senior and iceberg male god Gao Shu, and his mysterious roommate Ouyang who is highly socially afraid... At this point, the actors on the stage have gathered. Will they take off their masks and be honest? treat each other; or will they each show their special powers and create a campus drama of intrigue?
anime.consensus_summary: The anime starts strong with a refreshing take on familiar tropes, evoking emotional responses from viewers. However, the story suffers from a rushed ending and a lack of in-depth character development, leaving the audience wanting more. This results in a somewhat incomplete and unsatisfying viewing experience.
pros: Unique take on tropes
Exploration of emotional depth
cons: Rushed ending
Lack of character development
Insufficient background details

anime.title: Fuuto PI: The Portrait of Kamen Rider Skull
anime.romaji_title: Fuuto Tantei Movie: Kamen Rider Skull no Shouzou
anime.synopsis:
"How were Gaia Memories created?" "Why did W begin to fight?" To answer Tokime's questions, Shoutarou quietly begins to tell a story. He speaks of his meeting and parting with a man he admired and called his old man—his mentor, Soukichi Narumi.

Mysterious people called Dopants, who utilized the powers of Gaia Memories, had begun appearing in the shadows of Fuuto, the windy city. A young Shoutarou had become an assistant of the detective Soukichi and, though called half-baked, began to follow in his footsteps. Unaware that, in addition to his detective work, Soukichi was secretly acting as Skull, Shoutarou began to grow frustrated with his mentor. That was when the Narumi Detective Agency received a phone call—a request from Hell inviting Shoutarou and company to a fateful night! When Shoutarou tracked down Soukichi to deliver the "trump card" bestowed by the mysterious caller, what did he see?

Shoutarou and Philip. The one detective made of two and the night when Kamen Rider W began. That whole story will finally be revealed.
anime.consensus_summary: The movie mainly retells the origins of Kamen Rider W, providing more details to the 'Begins Night' event. Viewers already familiar with the story might find the flashback portion repetitive. However, the new details and hints at future plot developments are appreciated, creating a generally positive but not overly enthusiastic reception.
pros: Explains the origins of Shotaro, Philip, and Kamen Rider W.
Adds extra scenes and details to the 'Begins Night' event.
cons: The majority of the movie is a flashback, potentially causing impatience for viewers familiar with the original story.
One scene may conflict with another of W's live-action movies.
anime.thematic_vibe: Origin Story, Detective Noir, Kamen Rider Lore

anime.title: Go! Go! Loser Ranger! Season 2
anime.synopsis:
After Sentouin D successfully infiltrated the Ranger Force in the disguise of Hibiki Sakurama, he is closer than ever to defeating the heroic Dragon Keepers. While strategizing his ideal placement in the Force, he discovers that he is assigned to the Green Squadron, whose main duty is to search and eradicate long-lost boss monsters.

Joined by another new member, Angel Usukubo; their senior, Kanon Hisui; and a mysterious informant, Chidori, Sentouin D is first tasked with identifying suspicious activity in an abandoned school frequented by delinquents. During their investigation, they fall into a trap, and the group soon realizes that a boss monster is behind it all. Sentouin D must now find a way to escape alongside the others if he wants to continue pursuing his ultimate goal—achieving his ideal world free from boss monsters and the Dragon Keepers.
anime.consensus_summary: Season 2 of Sentai Daishikkaku is largely considered a disappointment due to its rushed pacing, incoherent plot, and decline in production quality. While the initial episodes and concept held promise, the overwhelming consensus points to a significant drop in quality compared to the first season. Many reviewers recommend reading the manga instead of watching the second season, as significant plot points and character development were cut or altered.
pros: Interesting concept of monsters vs rangers with distinct personalities.
First half of the season, especially the school arc, was well-paced and engaging for some viewers.
English dub praised by some reviewers
cons: Rushed pacing in the second half, skipping key plot developments and character development.
Incoherent story with inconsistent character behavior and unclear motivations.
Noticeable dip in animation quality and underwhelming music.
Plot feels 'butchered' and difficult to follow, especially for those familiar with the manga.
Ending feels rushed and unsatisfying.

anime.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Movie: Infinity Castle - Part 1: Akaza Returns
anime.romaji_title: Kimetsu no Yaiba Movie 1: Mugenjou-hen - Akaza Sairai
anime.synopsis: First anime movie of the trilogy adaptation of the Infinity Castle Arc.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with praise for the visual and action elements but strong criticism for the pacing and narrative structure. Many feel the excessive flashbacks and disjointed feel detract from the overall experience. While visually impressive, the movie struggles to maintain consistent tension and a cohesive storyline.
pros: Stunning animation quality, especially in fight scenes
Strong atmosphere and immersive world-building
Well-executed action choreography
cons: Pacing issues due to excessive flashbacks
Flashbacks disrupt tension and flow of the movie
Weak narrative control and forced emotional moments
Feels like disjointed anime episodes stitched together
Repetitive backstories diminish impact
Soundtrack choices feel mismatched

anime.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3
anime.romaji_title: Mushoku Tensei III: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu
anime.genres: Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Isekai, Reincarnation, School
anime.synopsis: Third season of Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is significantly polarized, with strong opinions on both sides. While many praise the show's deep character development, mature themes of redemption, and high production quality, a substantial segment finds the explicit sexual content and the protagonist's morally bankrupt actions to be deeply problematic and off-putting. This divide suggests a strong reaction to both the narrative's ambition and its controversial content.
pros: Exceptional world-building and side character development.
Deeply layered and realistic character growth, particularly for the protagonist.
High-quality animation and production values, with cinematic direction.
Engaging exploration of themes like redemption, second chances, and personal accountability.
Masterful depiction of emotional struggles and impactful moments, even in quiet conversations.
cons: Pervasive and excessive sexual content, to the point of being unwatchable for some.
Protagonist's persistent morally questionable behavior and "harem" elements are off-putting to many.
Concerns about misogynistic portrayal of female characters as subservient to the protagonist.
The story's adherence to problematic elements of the source material is divisive.
Pacing can be slow, with some viewers feeling it prioritizes slice-of-life over plot progression.

anime.title: Classic★Stars
anime.synopsis: Gloria Private Academy is a school where promising young people gather in all fields of entertainment, including music, art, and sports. In the music department, those who match the "talent" of great musicians are transplanted with a "gift" into their bodies and are called by the name of that musician. Beethoven, a young man who was discovered to be compatible after an injury, is one of them. After transferring to the school, Beethoven meets classmates with different gifts and discovers the charm of music, while aiming to win the competition.
anime.consensus_summary: The anime has an interesting premise with creative music remixes, but is held back by inconsistent animation and a story that loses focus. Some find the plot similar to other music anime, impacting overall enjoyment. Despite flaws, it's considered worth watching for those interested in music and willing to overlook animation issues.
pros: Creative remixes of classic music
Interesting character concepts based on classical composers
Satisfying ending
cons: Story loses focus with character background episodes
Animation quality is inconsistent and sometimes poor
Story may feel similar to other music anime, potentially uninteresting to some

anime.title: Clevatess
anime.romaji_title: Clevatess: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha
anime.synopsis:
Surrounded by four armies of dark beasts, five humanoid races strive to push the known boundaries of the world. Unfortunately, the 13 heroes dispatched to the southern region are easily wiped out by Clevatess, one of the Lords of Dark Beasts. Determined to get revenge against humanity, Clevatess bursts into the capital of the Kingdom of Hiden, leaving a trail of death and destruction behind him.

Although the situation looks desperate, humanity still has a chance to appease Clevatess' anger. Alicia Glenfall, one of the 13 heroes, is revived by Clevatess to help him raise a newborn infant, Luna, whose choices shall shape the fate of the human world. Although reluctant to help the dark beast at first, Alicia understands that Luna is the only thing that stands between humanity and complete annihilation. 

Hiding himself by taking on a human form, Clevatess sets out in search for a wet nurse with Alicia and Luna. With Clevatess unwilling to reveal his identity, it falls on Alicia to slay all enemies that stand in their way. Meanwhile, the neighboring countries prepare to advance on the weakened Hiden, aiming to control the only forge capable of producing the heroes' weapons.
anime.consensus_summary: Clevatess divides viewers with its dark fantasy setting and moral ambiguities. While praised for its unique premise, strong characters, and engaging plot, some find the pacing rushed and the world-building weak. The series is considered a hidden gem by many, while others see wasted potential due to inconsistent writing.
pros: Original premise and unpredictable plot
Well-rounded characters with authentic decisions and compelling growth
Strong start with interesting narration and good characters
Good art and character design
Cohesive story with mystery and lore
Serious tone and grounded storytelling
Balances smaller arcs and larger plotlines effectively
cons: Pacing issues due to limited episodes
Rushed story and thin explanations
Lack of character development depth
Predictable plot elements
Inability to build a world that speaks for itself
Expository dialogue treats the viewer like a moron
Garbage world building and idiot characters

anime.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
anime.synopsis:
The Mikadono sisters—Miwa, Niko, and Kazuki—stand at the pinnacle of Saika Academy as its Three Royals, renowned respectively as prodigies in shogi, karate, and theater. Unfortunately, they have drifted apart from each other due to their overwhelming dedication to their fields, effectively turning them into strangers living under the same roof.

Enter Yuu Ayase, the son of the late Subaru Ayase, a legendary actress who graduated from Saika. Unlike his mother, Yuu lacks any extraordinary talent whatsoever, much to the disappointment of those who knew her. Still, he transfers to her alma mater with one quiet promise in his heart: to fulfill her final wish that he build a true and happy family.

It just so happens that the Mikadono patriarch is also Subaru's longtime friend and benefactor, and he offers Yuu both a place to stay and a fresh start. Thrust into the lives of three estranged sisters who act cold toward him, Yuu may not be a genius himself, but the clumsy sincerity he brings might be what they all need to start anew.
anime.consensus_summary: The series is generally well-received as a heartwarming and wholesome rom-com. Viewers appreciate the relatable characters, excellent pacing, and avoidance of typical harem tropes. Some find the characters generic and the lack of major conflict a drawback, but overall, it's considered an enjoyable and relaxing watch.
pros: Charming and relatable characters
Excellent pacing and writing
Minimal fanservice and avoidance of negative tropes
High production values with stylized animation and fun sound
cons: Generic character archetypes
Lack of major conflict and high stakes
Repetitive premise

anime.title: Blue Exorcist: The Blue Night Saga
anime.synopsis:
Unlike his twin brother, Yukio, Rin Okumura never wished to know about their parents and the circumstances surrounding his own birth. Yet the master of time, Mephisto Pheles, gives Rin a key that transports him 40 years into the past when his late mother, Yuri Frederick Egin, was merely a child. With Mephisto's guidance, Rin leaps through the years of Yuri's childhood and her adolescence as an exorcist-in-training.

Early on, Yuri meets Shirou Fujimoto, Rin and Yukio's adoptive father. As Rin follows Yuri and Shirou's lives, he witnesses firsthand the initial appearances of Satan, his true father, and the horrors unfolding at the True Cross Order's special Section 13. Yuri's unique connection to Satan eventually leads Rin to the truth behind the most horrific event in exorcist history and the day he and Yukio were born—the Blue Night.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mostly positive, with many considering it the best arc of the series due to its focus on character backstories and emotional depth. However, some viewers found the pacing slow, the animation lacking, and the story less engaging. The season's success hinges on the viewer's appreciation for character-driven narratives over action.
pros: The season provides answers to long-standing questions about characters' backstories.
The focus on Yuri, Shiro, and Satan allows for deep character exploration.
The writing is praised for its ability to create emotional bonds with new or underutilized characters.
cons: Animation quality is inconsistent and doesn't always meet modern standards.
Pacing issues, with dialogue feeling slow and unnatural.
Some find the story drags and suffers from tonal inconsistencies.

anime.title: Black Butler: Emerald Witch Arc
anime.genres: Action, Historical, Mystery, Mythology, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
Queen Victoria of England has ordered her loyal watchdog, 13-year-old Earl Ciel Phantomhive, to investigate a series of suspicious deaths in southern Germany. Across multiple villages, all the victims have one thing in common: they had entered the so-called Werewolves' Forest right before they developed strange deformities and subsequently died. The rumors put blame on a "witch's curse," the nearby villagers' firm belief based on old folklore.

Unconvinced that anything truly supernatural is at play, Ciel and his contracted demonic butler, Sebastian Michaelis—along with the rest of the Phantomhive servants—come across an isolated village in the Werewolves' Forest. Its residents are only women, hostile toward the outsiders and serving a young girl with emerald eyes and bound feet, Sieglinde "Green Witch" Sullivan. Ciel and Sebastian investigate to uncover the truth, but as they soon fall victim to the curse themselves, it appears that there is more to the local myths than meets the eye.
anime.consensus_summary: The "Emerald Witch Arc" adaptation received mixed reactions. Many appreciated its faithfulness to the manga and improved animation, particularly praising the opening and ending themes. However, criticisms arose regarding inconsistent animation quality, pacing issues, and overuse of recaps, leading to a slightly polarized audience.
pros: Faithful adaptation of the Emerald Witch arc from the manga.
Improved animation quality compared to previous seasons, particularly from Cloverworks.
Strong opening and ending themes that fit the show's atmosphere.
Exploration of character backstories, especially Ciel's, adding depth to the main cast.
Intriguing premise and setting, with Sullivan and Wolf being excellent additions.
cons: Inconsistent animation quality, with some scenes appearing lazy and lacking fluid movement.
Short arc length and pacing issues, especially in the middle portion of the series.
Overuse of recaps, which some viewers found unnecessary and disruptive.
Some viewers felt the adaptation didn't fully capture the essence of the manga, leading to disappointment.

anime.title: Fire Force Season 3 Part 2
anime.romaji_title: Enen no Shouboutai: San no Shou Part 2
anime.genres: Action, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Shounen, Urban Fantasy
anime.synopsis: Second part of Enen no Shouboutai: San no Shou.
anime.consensus_summary: The final season of Fire Force is divisive, with many praising the animation and thematic ambition, while others criticize the rushed pacing, convoluted plot, and shift in tone. Some viewers felt the ending was unearned and stereotypical, while others appreciated the philosophical exploration and closure to character arcs. The connection to Soul Eater also split the audience, with some enjoying the expanded universe and others finding it distracting.
pros: Exceptional animation quality by David Production, especially in action sequences.
Strong sound design, music, and opening/ending themes.
Satisfying conclusion to character arcs, particularly Arthur's.
Exploration of philosophical themes and the battle between hope and despair.
cons: Pacing issues in the final season, feeling rushed in some areas.
Abandonment of earlier fun and frenetic energy in favor of philosophical preaching.
Overcomplicated plot with unsatisfying explanations and reliance on external lore.
Character development feels lacking for some characters.
Shift in tone from a focus on Humans vs. Fire to a human conflict, which disappointed some viewers.

anime.title: Magic Maker: How to Make Magic in Another World
anime.romaji_title: Magic Maker: Isekai Mahou no Tsukurikata
anime.synopsis:
A 30-year-old man who dreams of becoming a wizard suddenly loses his life. Reincarnated in another world as a young child named Shion, he grows up alongside Marie, his dependable older sister who adores him. Shion eagerly anticipates using magical powers, but he discovers that the new world seemingly does not have any magic. He spends the ensuing years as a gloomy and dejected child until a mystical phenomenon at a nearby lake catches the siblings' attention and breathes life back into his magical dream.

While experimenting on the peculiar light emanating from the water, Shion finally confirms that magical energy really exists. It may not be convenient for anything just yet, but Shion devotes his time to studying the anomaly, determined to uncover all the existing wonders in his quest to make magic.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are mixed, with some appreciating the fresh take on the isekai genre and the focus on magic invention. However, many find the execution lacking, citing issues with plot inconsistencies, character development, and animation quality. While some enjoyed it as a relaxing watch, others felt it failed to live up to its potential, resulting in a polarizing but ultimately lukewarm reception.
pros: Unique premise of inventing magic in a world without it.
Focus on experimentation and discovery, rather than instant power.
Calming exploration of magic-making with some action.
cons: Inconsistent plot and writing quality, especially in the later episodes.
Mediocre animation and use of CGI.
Uninspired or bland characters.

anime.title: Sanda
anime.synopsis:
In a future where children are few and regarded as Japan's most valuable assets, Christmas has become a mere legend of the past. For the students of Daikoku Welfare Academy—a boarding school where they are educated, protected, and monitored—the mythical Santa Claus is a forgotten character of fiction. For the adults, Santa Claus is a very real menace that needs to be neutralized by the Saint Nick Pursuit Unit in case he makes an appearance.

Shiori Fuyumura, a student of Daikoku Welfare Academy, is determined to find her best friend, Ichie Ono, who has been declared dead after being missing for six months. One morning, Fuyumura summons her fellow class representative, Kazushige Sanda, only to attack the unknowing boy. She is convinced that Sanda is the descendant of the infamous Santa Claus—the only person who can make her wish of finding Ono come true—and is determined to force out his dormant true self by any means necessary.
anime.consensus_summary: Sanda is a visually striking anime with a unique premise and strong thematic elements, though the execution is uneven. While praised for its artistry, creativity, and exploration of complex themes, viewers are divided about the plot's coherence, pacing issues, and the impact of certain story choices. Overall, it's a thought-provoking show that may not fully deliver on its potential.
pros: Unique and creative story premise exploring themes of adolescence, identity, and fear of aging.
Expressive and stylized art style with well-executed animation and character designs.
Solid voice acting, well-written human interactions, and a fitting soundtrack.
cons: Plot can be a jumbled mess with abandoned ideas and a contrived climax.
Tone jumps can be jarring, and world-building feels undercooked.
Pacing can feel off, and the ending may be disappointing for some.

anime.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend Season 4
anime.genres: Adult Cast, Comedy, Harem, Romance, Shounen
anime.synopsis:
After the success of his crowdfunded movie featuring the woman of his dreams, Chizuru Ichinose, university student Kazuya Kinoshita resumes his life of lies and deception. Although he pretends that he has been in an ideal relationship with Chizuru for more than a year, Kazuya still mostly sees her through a rental girlfriend company's services.

However, after Kazuya attends a private party with Chizuru, he reaches the decision to finally confess his feelings to her. Unfortunately for him, his trial girlfriend Ruka Sarashina and his ex-girlfriend Mami Nanami continue to complicate his already messy attempts at romance. While he is forced to keep up his facade, Kazuya is under pressure to find a solution to his ever chaotic love life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception to Kanojo, Okarishimasu Season 4 is largely negative, with many viewers expressing frustration over the lack of plot progression and character development. The season is criticized for its repetitive nature, annoying characters, and contrived situations. While some appreciate the animation quality, the overall sentiment is disappointment and a sense of wasted potential, with some considering dropping the series altogether.
pros: Consistent animation quality.
Enjoyable for laid-back viewing (despite flaws).
Some appreciate the characters, finding them relatable or entertaining.
The opening theme by ClariS is well-regarded.
Hawaii arc provided a fresh setting and charm for characters
cons: Lack of meaningful plot progression.
Repetitive character interactions and dialogue.
Protagonist's indecisiveness and lack of growth.
Annoying and unlikeable side characters (Ruka, Mami).
Artificial plot devices and contrived situations.
Stale and hollow storytelling.
Unrealistic character behavior.
Pacing issues with too many flashbacks

anime.title: Slay The Gods
anime.synopsis: It follows the journey of Lin Qiye, a blind high school student who unexpectedly becomes a night watchman, tasked with protecting the nation from "mystical" invasions as the mist descends and gods reawaken. Leading his team, he tirelessly eliminates mythical creatures that emerge in modern society and eventually sets out on the path of god-slaying, evolving from guarding his small family to defending the nation.
anime.consensus_summary: The audience is generally appreciative of the show's visuals and action sequences but expresses concerns about the rushed pacing, inconsistent power scaling, and an overabundance of underdeveloped characters. While the animation quality and soundtrack are definite highlights, the narrative structure and plot consistency are areas needing improvement. This divide results in a mixed, but leaning positive, reception.
pros: Stunning visuals and animation, especially in fight scenes.
Engaging narrative with well-rounded characters.
Good soundtrack that enhances scenes.
cons: Fast pacing leads to confusing story and underdeveloped plots.
Inconsistent power scaling and abilities.
Too many secondary characters with little importance.
Overabundance of camera cuts and lack of continuity.

anime.title: Shirohiyo - Reincarnated as a Neglected Noble: Raising My Baby Brother With Memories From My Past Life
anime.romaji_title: Shirobuta Kizoku desu ga Zense no Kioku ga Haeta node Hiyoko na Otouto Sodatemasu
anime.genres: Childcare, Fantasy, Isekai, Reincarnation, Slice of Life
anime.synopsis:
In a world where Western and Asian cultures mix together, the only son of Count Kikunoi from the Kiryuu Empire, is Ageha. His life was already over at the age of 5. He, who was born in a corner of the country, has zero allies or useful skills in addition to being overweight. What's more, it seems that his brother Regulus, who suddenly appeared on his life and was presented for the Count as his brother, will kill him in the future for his right to succeed...

His only weapons, are the abilities of "cooking and sewing," that he suddenly acquired along with the memories of his previous Japanese life. In the midst of all this, Ageha ends up raising his younger brother, but... "My brother is super cute?" And before he knows it, he becomes a full-blown doting older brother?!

Making handmade educational toys for his cute little brother and delicious chawanmushi (steamed egg custard)... With the help of his previous life's skills and my power as a housekeeper, he's able to improve the rough life of the people living in his territory. A fantasy of two young brothers managing their territory, where a single step gets even the gods involved in changing their country!
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are divided. Some viewers found the anime to be a wholesome and heartwarming isekai with a refreshing protagonist and well-developed relationships. However, others criticized it for being cliché, slow-paced, and having a weak main character, underdeveloped plotlines, and limited animation. The show is generally seen as cute and relaxing, but may not appeal to those seeking complex or engaging narratives.
pros: Refreshing protagonist with a strong moral compass.
Organically developed relationships.
Impressive art style enhances immersion.
Good story, better than the majority of anime out there.
Relaxing and heartwarming.
cons: Painfully slow and cliché.
Main character is spineless and unconvincing.
Trivial events with no real stakes.
Forgotten plotlines and underdeveloped characters.
Limited animation quality.
Plot gets replaced with the story of a kid who wants to educate peasants

anime.title: The Legend of Sky Lord
anime.synopsis: The only body cultivator in the nine realms was betrayed by his close friend Li Yunfei, and his body and soul disappeared. By chance, his soul remained immortal, and unexpectedly happened to Xiao Chen, a dying disciple of Qingyun Sect. After rebirth, Xiao Chen not only resurrected, but also awakened his supreme magical power. He also vowed to take back everything that belonged to him, and walked out on his own magical path as the "Venerable God".
anime.consensus_summary: The audience finds the donghua entertaining initially due to its frequent fight scenes and straightforward plot about an overpowered main character seeking revenge. However, the repetitive nature, mediocre animation, and uninteresting side characters lead to diminished enjoyment over time. The story is considered generic, with little depth beyond the action sequences.
pros: Frequent fight scenes
Distinct side character personalities
cons: Mediocre animation quality
Amateurish sound and music
Uninteresting side characters
Predictable and straightforward MC
Repetitive plot progression

anime.title: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube
anime.genres: Comedy, Horror, Mythology, School, Shounen, Supernatural
anime.synopsis:
In Doumori, an imbalance of spiritual forces threatens to plunge the small city into complete chaos. Thankfully, for the students of Doumori Elementary School, new teacher and exorcist Meisuke "Nube" Nueno is determined to prevent the malignant spirits—known as youkai—from accomplishing their evil deeds.

The first student who catches Nube's attention is transfer student Hiroshi Tateno, who displays inexplicable outbursts of anger, often lashing out at his classmates. When they find out that Hiroshi is possessed by a youkai, Nube manages to free his student thanks to the demonic power sealed in his left hand. However, a youkai hiding behind the appearance of doctor Kyousuke Tamano bursts onto the scene and quickly abducts Hiroshi.

Helped by his student Kyouko Inaba and his expertise in the occult, Nube quickly uncovers Kyousuke's sinister plans. Rushing to Hiroshi's rescue, Nube will show once more that he will stop at nothing to protect his beloved students against all supernatural threats.
anime.consensus_summary: The reboot of Jigoku Sensei Nube is met with mixed reactions. While some appreciate the nostalgia and the core concept, many find the updated version to be overly simplistic, juvenile, and lacking in depth compared to the original. The poor animation and repetitive storytelling further contribute to the disappointment, leaving fans wanting a darker and more mature adaptation.
pros: Nostalgia factor for original fans.
The concept of a demon-armed teacher fighting yokai is still engaging.
Occasional stories delve into folklore horror effectively.
cons: Storytelling feels outdated and overly simplistic.
Morals are spoon-fed, and dialogue is dumbed down.
The remake plays it too safe, lacking the potential darker tone of the original.
Repetitive episodic formula with no overarching plot.
Flat and underdeveloped characters with no meaningful arcs.
Animation quality is subpar and drab.

anime.title: Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four!
anime.romaji_title: Salaryman ga Isekai ni Ittara Shitennou ni Natta Hanashi
anime.synopsis:
Suffering years of workplace abuse and shuffling between different countries to take on jobs no one else wants, Dennosuke Uchimura never expected his next transfer to be to another world. After all, his tireless efforts catch the Demon Lord's attention; he deems Uchimura the perfect candidate to fill the vacant spot among the Four Heavenly Generals.

Despite Uchimura being an ordinary human, he earns the Demon Lord's recognition through his knack for solving impossible situations—a skill he honed through years as an overseas manager. With rising dissension among the demon army and failing negotiations with other tribes, it is up to Uchimura to justify the faith bestowed upon him and bring one final push for the Demon Lord's vision of dominance and perfection.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience reception is mixed, with some praising the anime's unique premise of blending business concepts with a fantasy setting. However, others criticize the rushed plot, underdeveloped characters, and superficial world-building. Overall, it's considered an enjoyable but not exceptional isekai anime, appealing particularly to those interested in business and management themes.
pros: Unique blend of fantasy and corporate drama, integrating real-world business theories.
Clever story building with viable character motivations.
Protagonist applies business strategies to improve the demon army, offering a fresh perspective.
cons: Rushed execution and plot holes.
Underdeveloped relationships between characters and world-building.
Superficial explanation of problems and solutions, assuming prior knowledge.

anime.title: Rock Is a Lady's Modesty
anime.romaji_title: Rock wa Lady no Tashinami deshite
anime.synopsis:
Oushin Girls' Academy is a respected institution reserved only for wealthy young ladies. Very few of its students excel enough to earn the title of Noble Maiden, awarded to those who embody the ideal Japanese woman of culture and refinement. Lilisa Suzunomiya, a girl of common roots, has suddenly found herself as the daughter of a newly remarried real estate mogul and seeks to become a Noble Maiden to prove that commoners like her can be noble as well.

The most difficult challenge Lilisa has faced in pursuit of this goal is abandoning her love of rock music to keep up the rich girl facade she must now wear. But her resolve crumbles once she happens upon Otoha Kurogane, the daughter of a prominent politician, skillfully playing the drums while rocking out in an abandoned school building. Despite initially being at odds, they embrace their passion for music together while leading a double life.
anime.consensus_summary: Audience opinions are generally positive, praising the music, characters, and themes of self-discovery. However, some find the plot predictable and the writing shallow. There are mixed feelings regarding the 3D animation, with some appreciating its use during musical performances, and others disliking it. While most viewers enjoyed the series, some felt it didn't quite live up to its potential.
pros: Excellent music and sound design, particularly the instrumental rock performances.
Strong and well-developed characters with unique personalities and engaging interactions.
Visually appealing animation, with effective use of 3D CGI for musical performances in many instances.
The story explores themes of self-acceptance and breaking free from societal expectations in a compelling manner.
cons: Inconsistent character development, especially with the deuteragonist Otoha, who is considered dull.
Repetitive comedic gags and reliance on tropes.
Shallow writing and lack of depth in exploring character motivations and backstories.
Predictable plot progression and a feeling that nothing significant happens until late in the series.
